CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostWT2Receipt]
	@VCCode CHAR(3),
	@cMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPInquiryTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cStatus CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @strInsert NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cRCIDNumber CHAR(13), @RCVCCode CHAR(3), @cSiteN VARCHAR(33), @cSiteX VARCHAR(33), @dIssue SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @vTypeIssue CHAR(2), @vTypeReceipt CHAR(2), @vTransReceipt CHAR(2)

	SELECT @RCVCCode = 'PNI'
	SELECT @cRCIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, @VCCode, @RCVCCode)

	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m65$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d65$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT a.* INTO #ipmaster FROM m55$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ipdetail FROM d55$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strInsert =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ipmaster', '#master', @cMasterTable, @cIPMasterTable, '1=1')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strInsert

	SELECT @strInsert =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ipdetail', '#detail', @cDetailTable, @cIPDetailTable, '1=1')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strInsert

	SELECT @cSiteN = ma_khon, @cSiteX = ma_kho, @dIssue = ngay_ct, @vTypeIssue = loai_ct  FROM #master
	SELECT @vTypeReceipt = CASE @vTypeIssue WHEN '9' THEN '9' ELSE '2' END, @vTransReceipt = CASE @vTypeIssue WHEN '9' THEN '9' ELSE '2' END
	UPDATE #ipmaster SET status = @cStatus, ma_ct = @RCVCCode, ma_kho = @cSiteN, ma_khox = @cSiteX, ngay_px = @dIssue, stt_rec = @cRCIDNumber, loai_ct = @vTypeReceipt, ma_gd = @vTransReceipt

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_trin, ma_ct = @RCVCCode, tk_du = a.tk_du, tk_vt = a.tk_vt
			, pn_gia_tb = CASE WHEN (c.gia_ton = 1 OR c.gia_ton = 4) AND a.px_gia_dd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, stt_rec_px = '', stt_rec0px = ''
		FROM #ipdetail JOIN #detail a ON #ipdetail.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND #ipdetail.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 JOIN dmvt c ON #ipdetail.ma_vt = c.ma_vt

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET tk_vt = b.tk_dl
		FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #ipmaster c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE c.ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE dai_ly_yn = 1) AND b.tk_dl IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 1)

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET tk_vt = b.tk_vt
		FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #ipmaster c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE c.ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE dai_ly_yn = 0) AND b.tk_vt IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 1)

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET stt_rec = @cRCIDNumber, so_luong0 = so_luong
	--UPDATE #ipdetail SET ma_nx = b.ma_nx FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmnx b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	SELECT @strSQL = 'delete ' + @cIPDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @cIPMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete c55$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into ' + @cIPMasterTable + ' select * from #ipmaster'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @cIPDetailTable + ' select * from #ipdetail'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into c55$000000 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0) select ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''', ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0 from #ipmaster'


	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' select ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.status, a.user_id0,'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'convert(varchar(12), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec,'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + '''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_kho) + ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.ma_khox) + ''#30$'' + rtrim(a.ma_gd) + ''#40$'' + rtrim(a.ma_nt), '''','
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + '''#00#%$'' + rtrim(b.id) + ''$%'''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'from #ipmaster a left join dmkho b with(nolock) on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho'


	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'declare @v10 varchar(8000), @v20 varchar(8000), @v30 varchar(8000), @count int, @i int'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @count = count(*) from #ipdetail'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @i = 1'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'while @count >= @i begin'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v10 = '''', @v20 = '''', @v30 = '''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v10 = @v10 + ''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_vt) from (select distinct ma_vt from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v20 = @v20 + ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.tk_vt) from (select distinct tk_vt from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v30 = @v30 + ''#30$'' + rtrim(a.ma_nx) from (select distinct ma_nx from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' set d$ = isnull(@v10, '''') + isnull(@v20, '''') + isnull(@v30, '''') where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @i = @i + 1'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCRTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @Debit NVARCHAR(128), @Credit NVARCHAR(128), @Debit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Credit2 NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Debit = cname, @Debit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT053'
	SELECT @Credit = cname, @Credit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT054'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, stt_rec, tk_co, tt AS tien, tt_nt AS tien_nt, tt AS t_tt, tt_nt AS t_tt_nt, line_nbr INTO #tmp FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, dien_giai AS ten_kh, dien_giai AS ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX2
			, t_tien AS tien, t_tien_nt AS tien_nt, t_tien AS t_tt, t_tien_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2
			, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct
			, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #report FROM wrkcrtran

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 3, 0, 1, a.stt_rec, rtrim(a.ong_ba), rtrim(b.ten_kh), rtrim(b.ten_kh2), a.dia_chi, a.dien_giai, N''' + REPLACE(@Debit, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@Debit2, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.so_ct_goc, a.dien_giai_ct_goc, a.ma_nk, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id'
	SET @q = @q + ' , replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringValue(a.ty_gia), a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m41$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, stt_rec, tk_co, tien, tien_nt, a.tien, tien_nt, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('d41$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT MIN(sysorder), 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', '', '', '', @Credit, @Credit2, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', '', tk_co, 0, NULL, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', MIN(line_nbr), '', NULL, NULL, ''
			FROM #tmp
			WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #report)
			GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_co

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia, so_ct_goc = b.so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc = b.dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia = b.chuoi_ty_gia
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ma_nk, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 3) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE sysorder = 5

	UPDATE #report SET dien_giaix = '', dien_giaix2 = '' WHERE sysorder = 5 AND line_nbr <> 1

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #report where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#report', '#report', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Bilingual = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select * from (
	select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
		, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaix + case when dien_giaix <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaix2 + case when dien_giaix2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaix
		, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2
		, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
		, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''1'' as xgroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report
	union all
	select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
		, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaix + case when dien_giaix <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaix2 + case when dien_giaix2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaix
		, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2
		, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
		, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''2'' as xgroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report
	) a order by xgroup, sysorder, line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaix + case when dien_giaix <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaix2 + case when dien_giaix2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaix
	, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_in_word
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_nt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_nt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_nt_in_word
	, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
	, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ExecAllocTrans]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Stt_rec NUMERIC(18),
	@Ten_bt NVARCHAR(511),
	@Tk VARCHAR(32),
	@Loai_pb TINYINT,
	@So_ct VARCHAR(32),
	@Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Ma_nt VARCHAR(32),
	@Ty_gia NUMERIC(24, 12),
	@Tien NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32),
	@User_id2 INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @roundAmount int, @roundFAmount int
	DECLARE @managementObjectField1 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField2 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField3 VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @managementObjectField1 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '04'
	SELECT @managementObjectField2 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '05'
	SELECT @managementObjectField3 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '06'
	SELECT @roundAmount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @roundFAmount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl

	SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt1, ma_td2 AS ma_dtqt2, ma_td3 AS ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt INTO #gl0 FROM wrkgl
	IF ABS(@Tien) + ABS(@Tien_nt) <> 0
		INSERT INTO #gl0 SELECT @Tk, @Ma_dvcs, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', @Ma_nt, @Tien, @Tien_nt
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT * INTO #gl0_0 FROM #gl0
		INSERT INTO #gl0_0
			SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
					, CASE WHEN @Loai_pb = 1 THEN SUM(ps_no - Ps_co) ELSE SUM(ps_co - ps_no) END AS ps
					, CASE WHEN @Loai_pb = 1 THEN SUM(ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt) ELSE SUM(ps_co_nt - ps_no_nt) END AS ps_nt
				FROM #ct00
				WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk) + '%')
				GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
				HAVING SUM(ps_no - ps_co) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt) <> 0

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_kh_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_kh = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_vv_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_vv = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_sp_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_sp = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_bp_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_bp = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_hd_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_hd = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_ku_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_ku = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_phi_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_phi = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_lsx_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET so_lsx = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_td1_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_dtqt1 = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_td2_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_dtqt2 = ''
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpb WHERE stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND pb_td3_yn = 0)
			UPDATE #gl0_0 SET ma_dtqt3 = ''

		INSERT INTO #gl0 SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
			FROM #gl0_0 GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
	END

	DECLARE cusTran CURSOR
		FOR SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, ps, ps_nt FROM #gl0

	-- Define variables for cursor
	DECLARE @vcTk VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_nt VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_sp VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_bp VARCHAR(32)
		, @vcMa_hd VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_ku VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_phi VARCHAR(32), @vcSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt1 VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt2 VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt3 VARCHAR(32)
		, @vcPs NUMERIC(28, 6), @vcPs_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	DECLARE @veTk VARCHAR(32), @veMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @veMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @veMa_sp VARCHAR(32), @veMa_bp VARCHAR(32), @veMa_hd VARCHAR(32), @veMa_ku VARCHAR(32)
		, @veMa_phi VARCHAR(32), @veSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @veMa_td1 VARCHAR(32), @veMa_td2 VARCHAR(32), @veMa_td3 VARCHAR(32)
		, @veHe_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @veT_He_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @veT_Ps_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @veT_Ps NUMERIC(28, 6), @veNh_dk VARCHAR(32), @veLine_nbr NUMERIC(5)
	-- Define variables for ct00
	DECLARE @vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13), @vdMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_ct VARCHAR(3), @vdNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @vdNgay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @vdSo_ct VARCHAR(32)
		, @vdSo_lo VARCHAR(32), @vdNgay_lo SMALLDATETIME, @vdOng_ba NVARCHAR(128), @vdDien_giai NVARCHAR(128), @vdNh_dk VARCHAR(32), @nNh_dk INT, @vdLine_nbr NUMERIC(5)
		, @vdTk VARCHAR(32), @vdTk_du VARCHAR(32), @vdPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_nt VARCHAR(3), @vdTy_gia NUMERIC(24, 12)
		, @vdPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_sp VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_bp VARCHAR(32)
		, @vdMa_hd VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_ku VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_phi VARCHAR(32), @vdSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt1 VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt2 VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt3 VARCHAR(32)
		, @vduser_id0 INT, @vddate0 DATETIME, @vduser_id2 INT, @vddate2 DATETIME, @vdstatus VARCHAR(1)
	-- Set value for variables of table ct00
	SET @vdMa_ct = 'PK4'
	SET @vdNgay_ct = @dTo
	SET @vdNgay_lct = @dTo
	SET @vdSo_lo = ''
	SET @vdNgay_lo = NULL
	SET @vdOng_ba = ''
	SET @vdDien_giai = RTRIM(@Ten_bt) + ' - ' +RTRIM(@Tk)
	SET @vduser_id0 = @nUserID
	SET @vddate0  = GETDATE()
	SET @vduser_id2 = @user_id2
	SET @vddate2 = GETDATE()
	SET @vdstatus = '1'

	-- Lay stt_rec
	DECLARE @strSQLExec NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' FROM dmpbn WHERE stt_rec = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@Stt_rec  AS CHAR))) + ' AND nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT

	IF @vdStt_rec = '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @Ws_id CHAR(1)
		SELECT @Ws_id = RTRIM(Val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(Name) = 'M_WS_ID'
		SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = MAX(stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ') FROM dmpbn WHERE nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT

		SELECT @vdStt_rec = @Ws_id + STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(SUBSTRING(@vdStt_rec, 8, 3) AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ', '0') + @vdMa_ct
		SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmpbn SET stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' = ''' +  @vdStt_rec + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@Stt_rec  AS CHAR))) + ' AND nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
	END

	-- Lay so_ct
	SET @vdSo_ct = @So_ct
	IF @vdSo_ct = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @vdSo_ct = STR(So_ct + 1, dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
		UPDATE dmct SET so_ct = so_ct + 1 WHERE ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
		SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmpbn SET so_ct' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' = ''' + @vdSo_ct + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@Stt_rec AS CHAR))) + ' AND nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
	END

	OPEN cusTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcMa_kh, @vcMa_vv, @vcMa_sp, @vcMa_bp, @vcMa_hd, @vcMa_ku, @vcMa_phi, @vcSo_lsx, @vcMa_dtqt1, @vcMa_dtqt2, @vcMa_dtqt3, @vcMa_nt, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt
	SELECT @vdNh_dk = '001', @nNh_dk = 1

	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr INTO #t FROM r00$000000
	SELECT @strSQLExec = 'insert into #t select max(line_nbr) from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(stt_rec)) where %[stt_rec = ''' + @vdStt_rec + ''']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @strSQLExec, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
	SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1 FROM #t

	--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1 FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @vdStt_rec
	--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = 1

	SELECT * INTO #dmpb1n FROM dmpb1n WHERE 1 = 0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @vdMa_kh = @vcMa_kh
		SET @vdMa_vv = @vcMa_vv
		SET @vdMa_sp = @vcMa_sp
		SET @vdMa_bp = @vcMa_bp
		SET @vdMa_hd = @vcMa_hd
		SET @vdMa_ku = @vcMa_ku
		SET @vdMa_phi = @vcMa_phi
		SET @vdSo_lsx = @vcSo_lsx
		SET @vdMa_dtqt1 = @vcMa_dtqt1
		SET @vdMa_dtqt2 = @vcMa_dtqt2
		SET @vdMa_dtqt3 = @vcMa_dtqt3
		SET @vdMa_nt = @vcMa_nt
		IF @vcPs_nt <> 0
			SET @vdTy_gia = ROUND(@vcPs/@vcPs_nt, @roundFAmount)
		ELSE
			SET @vdTy_gia = 0

		TRUNCATE TABLE #dmpb1n
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' AND val = '1')
			INSERT INTO #dmpb1n SELECT * FROM dmpb1n WHERE nam = YEAR(@dTo) AND stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND ma_dvcs = @Ma_dvcs
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #dmpb1n SELECT * FROM dmpb1n WHERE nam = YEAR(@dTo) AND stt_rec = @Stt_rec AND ISNULL(ma_dvcs, '') = ''

		IF @vdMa_kh <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_kh = @vdMa_kh)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_kh <> @vdMa_kh
		END
		IF @vdMa_vv <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_vv = @vdMa_vv)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_vv <> @vdMa_vv
		END
		IF @vdMa_sp <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_sp = @vdMa_sp)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_sp <> @vdMa_sp
		END
		IF @vdMa_bp <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_bp = @vdMa_bp)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_bp <> @vdMa_bp
		END
		IF @vdMa_hd <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_hd = @vdMa_hd)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_hd <> @vdMa_hd
		END
		IF @vdMa_ku <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_ku = @vdMa_ku)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_ku <> @vdMa_ku
		END
		IF @vdMa_phi <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_phi = @vdMa_phi)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_phi <> @vdMa_phi
		END
		IF @vdSo_lsx <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE so_lsx = @vdSo_lsx)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE so_lsx <> @vdSo_lsx
		END
		IF @vdMa_dtqt1 <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td1 = @vdMa_dtqt1)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td1 <> @vdMa_dtqt1
		END
		IF @vdMa_dtqt2 <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td2 = @vdMa_dtqt2)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td2 <> @vdMa_dtqt2
		END
		IF @vdMa_dtqt3 <> '' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td3 = @vdMa_dtqt3)
				DELETE #dmpb1n WHERE ma_td3 <> @vdMa_dtqt3
		END

		SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @veT_He_so = SUM(he_so' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ') FROM #dmpb1n'
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@veT_He_so NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT', @veT_He_so = @veT_He_so OUTPUT
		IF @veT_He_so = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(
				SELECT 1 FROM #dmpb1n WHERE (@vdMa_vv = ma_vv AND @vdMa_sp = ma_sp AND @vdMa_bp = ma_bp AND @vdMa_hd = ma_hd AND @vdMa_ku = ma_ku AND @vdMa_phi = ma_phi AND @vdSo_lsx = so_lsx AND @vdMa_dtqt1 = ma_td1 AND @vdMa_dtqt2 = ma_td2 AND @vdMa_dtqt3 = ma_td3)
					AND (ma_vv <> '' OR ma_sp <> '' OR ma_bp <> '' OR ma_hd <> '' OR ma_ku <> '' OR ma_phi <> '' OR so_lsx <> '' OR ma_td1 <> '' OR ma_td2 <> '' OR ma_td3 <> '')
		) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcMa_kh, @vcMa_vv, @vcMa_sp, @vcMa_bp, @vcMa_hd, @vcMa_ku, @vcMa_phi, @vcSo_lsx, @vcMa_dtqt1, @vcMa_dtqt2, @vcMa_dtqt3, @vcMa_nt, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt
			CONTINUE
		END

		SET @strSQLExec = 'DECLARE csQ CURSOR FOR SELECT tk, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, He_so' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') 
			+ ' FROM #dmpb1n' + CASE WHEN @veT_He_so <> 0 THEN ' WHERE He_so' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' <> 0' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec

		OPEN csQ
		SET @veT_Ps_nt = 0
 		SET @veT_Ps = 0
		-- SET @veNh_dk = '999'
		SET @veNh_dk = 'ZZZ'
		FETCH NEXT FROM csQ INTO @veTk, @veMa_kh, @veMa_vv, @veMa_sp, @veMa_bp, @veMa_hd, @veMa_ku, @veMa_phi, @veSo_lsx, @veMa_td1, @veMa_td2, @veMa_td3, @veHe_so
		SET @vdSo_ct = SPACE(dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct') - LEN(RTRIM(@vdSo_ct))) + @vdSo_ct
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			IF @veNh_dk > @vdNh_dk SET @veNh_dk = @vdNh_dk
			SET @vdTk = @veTk
			SET @vdTk_du = @vcTk
			IF @veT_He_so <> 0
				SET @vdPs_no_nt = ROUND(@vcPs_nt*@veHe_so/@veT_He_so, @roundFAmount)
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF @veHe_so = 0
					SET @vdPs_no_nt = ROUND(@vcPs_nt, @roundFAmount)
				ELSE
					SET @vdPs_no_nt = 0
			END
			SET @veT_Ps_nt = @veT_Ps_nt + @vdPs_no_nt
			IF @veT_He_so <> 0
				SET @vdPs_no = ROUND(@vcPs*@veHe_so/@veT_He_so, @roundAmount)
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF @veHe_so = 0
					SET @vdPs_no = ROUND(@vcPs, @roundAmount)
				ELSE
					SET @vdPs_no = 0
			END
			SET @veT_Ps = @veT_Ps + @vdPs_no
			SET @vdPs_co_nt = 0
			SET @vdPs_co = 0
			SET @vdMa_dvcs = @vcMa_dvcs
			SET @vdMa_kh = @veMa_kh
			SET @vdMa_vv = @veMa_vv
			SET @vdMa_sp = @veMa_sp
			SET @vdMa_bp = @veMa_bp
			SET @vdMa_hd = @veMa_hd
			SET @vdMa_ku = @veMa_ku
			SET @vdMa_phi = @veMa_phi
			SET @vdSo_lsx = @veSo_lsx
			SET @vdMa_dtqt1 = @veMa_td1
			SET @vdMa_dtqt2 = @veMa_td2
			SET @vdMa_dtqt3 = @veMa_td3

			IF @Loai_pb <> 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @vdPs_co_nt = @vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co = @vdPs_no
				SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = 0, @vdPs_no = 0
			END

			IF @vdPs_no_nt <> 0 OR @vdPs_co_nt <> 0 OR @vdPs_no <> 0 OR @vdPs_co <> 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba,
					dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh,
					ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
					values (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct,
						@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk, @vdTk_du,
						@vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co,
						@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3, @vduser_id0,
						@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)',
					@s = '@vdStt_rec varchar(13), @vdMa_dvcs varCHAR(32), @vdMa_ct varchar(3), @vdNgay_ct smalldatetime, @vdNgay_lct smalldatetime, @vdSo_ct varchar(32)
					, @vdSo_lo varCHAR(32), @vdNgay_lo smalldatetime, @vdOng_ba nvarchar(128), @vdDien_giai nvarchar(128), @vdNh_dk varCHAR(32), @vdLine_nbr numeric(5)
					, @vdTk varCHAR(32), @vdTk_du varCHAR(32), @vdPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_nt varchar(3), @vdTy_gia numeric(24, 12)
					, @vdPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_kh varCHAR(32), @vdMa_vv varCHAR(32), @vdMa_sp varCHAR(32), @vdMa_bp varCHAR(32)
					, @vdMa_hd varCHAR(32), @vdMa_ku varCHAR(32), @vdMa_phi varCHAR(32), @vdSo_lsx varCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt1 varCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt2 varCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt3 varCHAR(32)
					, @vduser_id0 int, @vddate0 datetime, @vduser_id2 int, @vddate2 datetime, @vdstatus varchar(1)'

				EXEC sp_executesql @q, @s, @vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct
					, @vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr
					, @vdTk, @vdTk_du, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia
					, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co, @vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp
					, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3
					, @vduser_id0, @vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus

				SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1

				SET @q = 'insert into #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba,
					dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh,
					ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
					values (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct,
						@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk_du, @vdTk,
						@vdPs_co_nt, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_co, @vdPs_no,
						@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3, @vduser_id0,
						@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)'

				EXEC sp_executesql @q, @s, @vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct
					, @vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr
					, @vdTk, @vdTk_du, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia
					, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co, @vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp
					, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3
					, @vduser_id0, @vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus

				-- SET @vdNh_dk = REPLACE(STR(CAST(@vdNh_dk AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ' , '0')
				--SET @vdNh_dk = RIGHT('00' + dbo.ff_IncreaseSeq(@vdNh_dk), 3)

				SELECT @nNh_dk = @nNh_dk + 1
				SELECT @vdNh_dk = RIGHT('00' + dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(@nNh_dk), 3)

				SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM csQ INTO @veTk, @veMa_kh, @veMa_vv, @veMa_sp, @veMa_bp, @veMa_hd, @veMa_ku, @veMa_phi, @veSo_lsx, @veMa_td1, @veMa_td2, @veMa_td3, @veHe_so
		END

		IF @veT_Ps <> @vcPs BEGIN -- Co chenh lech khi phan bo
			UPDATE #gl SET ps_no = ps_no + @vcPs - @veT_Ps,
				ps_no_nt = ps_no_nt + @vcPs_nt - @veT_Ps_nt
				WHERE stt_rec = @vdStt_rec AND nh_dk = @veNh_dk AND ps_no <> 0
			UPDATE #gl SET ps_co = ps_co + @vcPs - @veT_Ps,
				ps_co_nt = ps_co_nt + @vcPs_nt - @veT_Ps_nt
				WHERE stt_rec = @vdStt_rec AND nh_dk = @veNh_dk AND ps_co <> 0
		END
		CLOSE csQ
		DEALLOCATE csQ
		FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcMa_kh, @vcMa_vv, @vcMa_sp, @vcMa_bp, @vcMa_hd, @vcMa_ku, @vcMa_phi, @vcSo_lsx, @vcMa_dtqt1, @vcMa_dtqt2, @vcMa_dtqt3, @vcMa_nt, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt
	END
	CLOSE cusTran
	DEALLOCATE cusTran

	-- Khai bao ma phi, bo phan cho tai khoan
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	-- Insert into ct00
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	-- Insert into r00
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'INSERT INTO r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' SELECT * FROM #gl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Insert into #ct00
	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', ma_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt from #gl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptOriginalDocumentList] -- fs_JournalVCRegBook
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33), 
	@Size TINYINT, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ngay_ct AS ngay_ctgs, so_ct AS so_ctgs, dien_giai, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt, ps_no AS tien
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @TableName, @controller, @sysDatabase, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT, 1
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a'), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a')

	-- @Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.so_ctgs <> '''' and a.ps_no +  a.ps_no_nt <> 0' 
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ctgs >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ctgs <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 


	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, '''', ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt, ps_no + ps_co' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @queryJoin + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt%sumFields%)'
	SET @q = @q + 'select 0, 0, 0, N''' + REPLACE(@s, '''', '''''')+ ''', sum(tien), sum(tien_nt)%sumValues% from #report where systotal = 1'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%sumFields%', CASE WHEN @totalFields <> '' THEN ',' + @totalFields ELSE '' END), '%sumValues%', CASE WHEN @sumTotalFields <> '' THEN ',' + @sumTotalFields ELSE '' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (1, 0, 0,  '', 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, max(sysprint) as sysprint, max(systotal) as systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, case when max(sysprint) <> 0 then max(b.dien_giai) else max(a.dien_giai) end as dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', sum(a.tien_nt) as tien_nt, sum(a.tien) as tien, max(b.stt) as stt, cast(0 as bit) as tag'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', a.so_ctgs + convert(char(8), a.ngay_ctgs, 112) as sttkey, convert(char(8), a.ngay_ctgs, 112) as ngay ' + CASE WHEN @sumFields <> '' THEN ',' + @sumFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #report a left join ctgs b on a.ngay_ctgs = b.ngay_ctgs and a.so_ctgs = b.so_ctgs'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.sysorder, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'order by a.sysorder, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, stt'	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$VoucherNumberStruct] (@str VARCHAR(32), @b VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(8))
RETURNS VARCHAR(32)
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @v NVARCHAR(32), @i1 INT, @i2 INT, @s VARCHAR(32), @l INT, @isBase INT
	SELECT @v = '', @s = LTRIM(RTRIM(@str)), @b = LTRIM(RTRIM(@b)), @l = LEN(@s), @isBase = 0
	IF @b <> '' SET @isBase = 1 ELSE SET @b = @s
	SET @i1 = CHARINDEX('[', @b)
	IF @i1 > 0 BEGIN
		SET @i2 = CHARINDEX(']', @b, @i1)
		IF @i2 > @i1 BEGIN
			SELECT @v = SUBSTRING(@s, @i1 + 1 - @isBase, @i2 - @i1 - 1), @v = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(@v) = 1 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, 0, @i1) + @c + SUBSTRING(@s, @i2 + 1 - (@isBase * 2), @l) ELSE '' END
			RETURN @v
		END
	END

	-- Without region
	DECLARE @i INT, @n1 NVARCHAR(32), @n2 NVARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @n2 = '', @s = @str
	WHILE @s <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', @s), @s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@i = PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', @s), @n1 = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, 1, @i - 1) ELSE @s END, 
			@s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@n2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@n2) < LEN(@n1) THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END
	END
	SELECT @i1 = CHARINDEX(@n2, @str)
	RETURN SUBSTRING(@str, 0, @i1) + @c + SUBSTRING(@str, @i1 + LEN(@n2), @l)
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostPOClosed]
	@UserID INT,
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@typeVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1 Local, 2 - Import
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(33), @HisTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	, @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1)
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @GeneralTable = '', @HisTable = '', @voucherCode = 'PO' + @typeVoucher
	SELECT @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	IF @typeVoucher = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SELECT @GeneralTable = 'c94$000000', @MasterTable = 'm94$' + @Dyn, @DetailTable = 'd94$' + @Dyn, @InquiryTable = 'i94$' + @Dyn, @HisTable = 'a94$000000'
		SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SELECT @GeneralTable = 'c95$000000', @MasterTable = 'm95$' + @Dyn, @DetailTable = 'd95$' + @Dyn, @InquiryTable = 'i95$' + @Dyn, @HisTable = 'a95$000000'
		SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	END
	
	--
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c91$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	
	-- History
	SET @q = '
		declare @stt int
		select @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) + 1 from ' + @HisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
		insert into ' + @HisTable + ' (stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset)
		select stt_rec, rtrim(@stt), status, u_status, ''2'', user_id2, datetime2, 0
			from ' + @masterTable + '
			where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI104] -- Phân tích doanh thu theo khoản mục
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1000), 
	@UOM VARCHAR(10),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @strSQL AS NVARCHAR(4000), @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER, @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @CreditAccount = REPLACE(@CreditAccount, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)
	
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -14, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '006'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '007'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '008'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '009'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '010'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '011'  
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '012' 
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '013'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '014'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, tk, ps_co, ps_no INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, tk, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no) as ps_no'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @tkdt + ''') = 0 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@CreditAccount) + ''') = 1]%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ngay_ct, tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin	

	SELECT ngay_ct, tk, SUM(ps_co - ps_no) AS doanh_thu INTO #ct00 FROM #tmp GROUP BY ngay_ct, tk
	SELECT tk, ISNULL(CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_ngan) <> '' THEN ten_ngan ELSE ten_tk END ELSE CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_ngan2) <> '' THEN ten_ngan2 ELSE ten_tk2 END END, '') AS ten_tk
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS doanh_thu INTO #bi4 FROM dmtk WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @CreditAccount) = 1

	DECLARE @select AS NVARCHAR(1000), @end AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	SET @select = ' select tk, sum(doanh_thu)/' + CAST(@UOM AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' as doanh_thu into #result from #ct00 '
	SET @end = ' group by tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' declare @tk as nvarchar(16)'
	SET @end = @end + ' declare db_cursor cursor for select tk from #bi4'
	SET @end = @end + ' open db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' fetch next from db_cursor into @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' while @@fetch_status = 0  '
	SET @end = @end + ' begin  '
	SET @end = @end + ' update #bi4 set doanh_thu = (select sum(doanh_thu) from #result where dbo.ff_inlist(tk, @tk) = 1) where tk = @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' fetch next from db_cursor into @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' end'
	SET @end = @end + ' close db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' deallocate db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' drop table #ct00, #result'
	SET @end = @end + ' select * into #re from #bi4 where doanh_thu > 0; declare @sum as numeric(28, 6); select @sum = (select sum(doanh_thu) from #re)'
	SET @end = @end + ' select tk, ten_tk, (100 * doanh_thu / @sum) as doanh_thu from #re'
	--SET @end = @end + ' drop table #bi4'
	DECLARE @week AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SELECT @week =  'declare @GetDate as smalldatetime; set @GetDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) + ''''
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @strSQL = @week + char(13) + @select + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = datepart(wk, @GetDate) and year(ngay_ct) = year(@GetDate)' + @end
	ELSE
		IF @TimeID = '004'
			SELECT @strSQL = @week + char(13) + @select + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then 53 else (datepart(wk, @GetDate) - 1) end and year(ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then (year(@GetDate) - 1) else year(@GetDate) end' + @end
		ELSE
			SET @strSQL = @select + @end
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpSpecialist]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Gender VARCHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Specialists VARCHAR(33),
	@SpecialistsLevel VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)	
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(ma_cm VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 VARCHAR(5), ma_bac VARCHAR(32), ma_nv VARCHAR(32))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Gender), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'is not null' ELSE 'is null' END

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Specialists <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and r.ma_cm like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Specialists), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SpecialistsLevel <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and r.ma_bac like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SpecialistsLevel), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	--Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	-- @q	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (ma_cm, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_bac, ma_nv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.ma_cm, r.stt_rec, r.stt_rec0, r.ma_bac, a.ma_nv from hrebcm r join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #result(ma_cm VARCHAR(48), ma_cm0 VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 VARCHAR(5), ma_bac VARCHAR(32), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #result(ma_cm, ma_cm0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_bac, ma_nv)
		SELECT STR(b.stt, 16) + a.ma_cm, a.ma_cm, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_bac, ma_nv FROM (
			SELECT ma_cm, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_bac, ma_nv FROM #report
			UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ma_cm, '', '', '', '' FROM #report
		) a JOIN hrdmcm b ON a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm ORDER BY b.stt, a.ma_cm, a.ma_nv, a.stt_rec0

	SELECT stt, ma_cm INTO #order FROM #result WHERE ma_nv = ''

	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt - o.stt as stt, a.ma_cm, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_bac, a.ma_nv, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.ma_nv = '''' then f.ten_cm%l else rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) end as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao, e.bo_phan, e.tinh_trang_nv, e.vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as ten_vi_tri, f.ten_cm%l as ten_cm, g.ten_bac%l as ten_bac, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' when e.gioi_tinh = ''2'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' else '''' end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #result a join #order o on a.ma_cm = o.ma_cm left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrdmcm f on a.ma_cm0 = f.ma_cm left join hrdmbcm g on a.ma_bac = g.ma_bac order by a.ma_cm, a.ma_nv, a.stt_rec0'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInvestmentSource] --dt_thdt2--
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@cJob VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@Form VARCHAR(33),
	@Table CHAR(16),
	@isDetail INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nYear NUMERIC(4), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @y0 INT, @isBgFY BIT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nYear = YEAR(@dateFrom), @dateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@dateFrom), @dateTo0 = @dateFrom - 1
	SELECT @y0 = YEAR(@dateFrom0), @isBgFY = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DAY(ngay_dn) = DAY(ngay_dn2) AND MONTH(ngay_dn) = MONTH(ngay_dn2)) SELECT @isBgFY = 0

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs
	SET @q = 'insert into #dmdvcs select ma_dvcs from dmdvcs' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' where ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, b.tk_no, b.tk_no_du, b.tk_no_gt, b.tk_co, b.tk_co_du, b.tk_co_gt, b.loai_sd INTO #dtthdt FROM dtthdt a, dtdmct b
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 INTO #dtcdct FROM dtcdct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt INTO #dtlkct FROM dtlkct

	SET @q = 'insert into #dtthdt select a.*, b.tk_no, b.tk_no_du, b.tk_no_gt, b.tk_co, b.tk_co_du, b.tk_co_gt, b.loai_sd'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' a with(nolock) left join dtdmct b with(nolock) on a.ma_so_ct = b.ma_so where form = @Form'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Form varchar(33)', @Form

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#dtthdt', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #dtcdct EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Investment @dateFrom, @Unit, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Accumulate
	INSERT INTO #dtlkct EXEC FastBusiness$Accumulate$Investment @dateFrom, @Unit, @Language, @UserID, @Admin


	SELECT stt, ma_so, CAST(chi_tieu as NVARCHAR(1024)) as chi_tieu, CAST(chi_tieu2 AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS chi_tieu2, cach_tinh, ma_so_ct
			, bold, in_ck, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_vv), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_vv, tk_no, tk_no_du, tk_no_gt, tk_co, tk_co_du, tk_co_gt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS kh_nam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS kh_nam_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_dau, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_dau_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_kc
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_kc_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_kc2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn_nt2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_kc_nt2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_cuoi, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_cuoi_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn_tmp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn_nt_tmp
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn2_tmp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lk_dn_nt2_tmp
		INTO #report
		FROM #dtthdt

	-- ct00
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, ma_vv, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''LKKN'''
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, tk_du, ma_vv'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom0, @dateTo0, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, ma_vv, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''KN'''
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, tk_du, ma_vv'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Ke hoach chi tieu
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT -1, '', '' AS chi_tieu, '' AS chi_tieu2, '' AS cach_tinh, a.ma_so, 0 AS bold, 1 AS in_ck, ma_vv AS ma_vv
			, '' AS tk_no, '' AS tk_no_du, '' AS tk_no_gt, '' AS tk_co, '' AS tk_co_du, '' AS tk_co_gt
			, SUM(tien) AS kh_nam, SUM(tien_nt) AS kh_nam_nt
			, 0 AS du_dau, 0 AS du_dau_nt
			, 0 AS tien, 0 AS lk_dn, 0 AS lk_kc
			, 0 AS tien_nt, 0 AS lk_dn_nt, 0 AS lk_kc_nt
			, 0 AS tien2, 0 AS lk_dn2, 0 AS lk_kc2
			, 0 AS tien_nt2, 0 AS lk_dn_nt2, 0 AS lk_kc_nt2
			, 0 AS du_cuoi, 0 AS du_cuoi_nt
			, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM dtkhct a JOIN #dtthdt b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ct AND b.cach_tinh = ''
		WHERE nam = @y0 AND ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_dvcs FROM #dmdvcs)
		GROUP BY a.ma_so, ma_vv

	IF @isBgFY = 0 BEGIN
		-- Du dau ky
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT -1, '', '' AS chi_tieu, '' AS chi_tieu2, '' AS cach_tinh, a.ma_so, 0 AS bold, 1 AS in_ck, ma_vv AS ma_vv
				, '' AS tk_no, '' AS tk_no_du, '' AS tk_no_gt, '' AS tk_co, '' AS tk_co_du, '' AS tk_co_gt
				, 0 AS kh_nam, 0 AS kh_nam_nt
				, CASE WHEN MAX(b.loai_sd) = 1 THEN SUM(du_no00 - du_co00) ELSE SUM(du_co00 - du_no00) END AS du_dau, CASE WHEN MAX(b.loai_sd) = 1 THEN SUM(du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00) ELSE SUM(du_co_nt00 - du_no_nt00) END AS du_dau_nt
				, 0 AS tien, 0 AS lk_dn, 0 AS lk_kc
				, 0 AS tien_nt, 0 AS lk_dn_nt, 0 AS lk_kc_nt
				, 0 AS tien2, 0 AS lk_dn2, 0 AS lk_kc2
				, 0 AS tien_nt2, 0 AS lk_dn_nt2, 0 AS lk_kc_nt2
				, 0 AS du_cuoi, 0 AS du_cuoi_nt
				, 0, 0, 0, 0
			FROM dtcdct a JOIN #dtthdt b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ct AND b.cach_tinh = ''
			WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_dvcs FROM #dmdvcs)
			GROUP BY a.ma_so, ma_vv

		-- Luy ke khoi cong
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT -1, '', '' AS chi_tieu, '' AS chi_tieu2, '' AS cach_tinh, a.ma_so, 0 AS bold, 1 AS in_ck, ma_vv AS ma_vv
				, '' AS tk_no, '' AS tk_no_du, '' AS tk_no_gt, '' AS tk_co, '' AS tk_co_du, '' AS tk_co_gt
				, 0 AS kh_nam, 0 AS kh_nam_nt
				, 0 AS du_dau, 0 AS du_dau_nt
				, 0 AS tien, 0 AS lk_dn, SUM(lk_no + lk_no_dk) AS lk_kc
				, 0 AS tien_nt, 0 AS lk_dn_nt, SUM(lk_no_nt + lk_no_dk_nt) AS lk_kc_nt
				, 0 AS tien2, 0 AS lk_dn2, 0 AS lk_kc2
				, 0 AS tien_nt2, 0 AS lk_dn_nt2, 0 AS lk_kc_nt2
				, 0 AS du_cuoi, 0 AS du_cuoi_nt
				, SUM(lk_no_dk) AS lk_dn_tmp, SUM(lk_no_dk_nt) AS lk_dn_nt_tmp
				, 0, 0
			FROM dtlkct a JOIN #dtthdt b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ct AND b.cach_tinh = ''
			WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_dvcs FROM #dmdvcs)
			GROUP BY a.ma_so, ma_vv

		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT -1, '', '' AS chi_tieu, '' AS chi_tieu2, '' AS cach_tinh, a.ma_so, 0 AS bold, 1 AS in_ck, ma_vv AS ma_vv
				, '' AS tk_no, '' AS tk_no_du, '' AS tk_no_gt, '' AS tk_co, '' AS tk_co_du, '' AS tk_co_gt
				, 0 AS kh_nam, 0 AS kh_nam_nt
				, 0 AS du_dau, 0 AS du_dau_nt
				, 0 AS tien, 0 AS lk_dn, 0 AS lk_kc
				, 0 AS tien_nt, 0 AS lk_dn_nt, 0 AS lk_kc_nt
				, 0 AS tien2, 0 AS lk_dn2, SUM(lk_co + lk_co_dk) AS lk_kc2

			, tien = b.tien, lk_dn = b.lk_dn, lk_kc = b.lk_kc
			, tien_nt = b.tien_nt, lk_dn_nt = b.lk_dn_nt, lk_kc_nt = b.lk_kc_nt
			, tien2 = b.tien2, lk_dn2 = b.lk_dn2, lk_kc2 = b.lk_kc2
			, tien_nt2 = b.tien_nt2, lk_dn_nt2 = b.lk_dn_nt2, lk_kc_nt2 = b.lk_kc_nt2
			, du_cuoi = b.du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt = b.du_cuoi_nt
		FROM #report2 a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt, ma_so_ct
						, SUM(kh_nam) AS kh_nam, SUM(kh_nam_nt) AS kh_nam_nt
						, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt
						, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(lk_dn) AS lk_dn, SUM(lk_kc) AS lk_kc
						, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, SUM(lk_dn_nt) AS lk_dn_nt, SUM(lk_kc_nt) AS lk_kc_nt
						, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(lk_dn2) AS lk_dn2, SUM(lk_kc2) AS lk_kc2
						, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2, SUM(lk_dn_nt2) AS lk_dn_nt2, SUM(lk_kc_nt2) AS lk_kc_nt2
						, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
					FROM #report2
					GROUP BY stt, ma_so_ct) b ON a.stt = b.stt AND a.ma_so_ct = b.ma_so_ct
		WHERE ma_vv = ''

	-- SUM gia tri cho dong chi tieu chinh
/*
	update #report2 set kh_nam = b.kh_nam, kh_nam_nt = b.kh_nam_nt
		FROM #report2 a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt, SUM(kh_nam) AS kh_nam, SUM(kh_nam_nt) AS kh_nam_nt
					FROM #report2
					WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT ma_vv_me FROM dmvv b WHERE #report2.ma_vv = b.ma_vv  AND b.ma_vv_me <> '' AND b.ma_vv <> @cJob )
					GROUP BY stt) b ON a.stt = b.stt
		WHERE ma_vv = ''
*/

	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh FROM #dtthdt WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '')

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set kh_nam = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(kh_nam) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set du_dau = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(du_dau) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_dn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_dn) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(tien) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_kc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_kc) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_dn2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_dn2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set tien2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(tien2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_kc2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_kc2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set du_cuoi = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(du_cuoi) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set kh_nam_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(kh_nam_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set du_dau_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(du_dau_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_dn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_dn_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(tien_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_kc_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_kc_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_dn_nt2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_dn_nt2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set tien_nt2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(tien_nt2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set lk_kc_nt2 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(lk_kc_nt2) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'update #report2 set du_cuoi_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(select max(du_cuoi_nt) from #report2 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- Insert Parent Records
	DECLARE @strInsertParentRecords NVARCHAR(MAX)
	SELECT @strInsertParentRecords = dbo.ff_InsertParentRecords('#report2', 'ma_vv', 'ma_vv_me', 'kh_nam, kh_nam_nt, du_dau, du_dau_nt, tien, lk_dn, lk_kc, tien_nt, lk_dn_nt, lk_kc_nt, tien2, lk_dn2, lk_kc2, tien_nt2, lk_dn_nt2, lk_kc_nt2, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt', 'stt2', 'cap', 'dmvv', 'ma_vv', 'ma_vv_me', 'stt, ma_so, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, cach_tinh, bold, in_ck, ma_so_ct', '#dtthdt', 'stt', 'ma_so_ct <> ' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39))
	EXEC sp_executesql @strInsertParentRecords

	-- Tinh kh nam
	UPDATE #report2 SET kh_nam = b.kh_nam, kh_nam_nt = b.kh_nam_nt FROM  #report2 a JOIN #reportKH b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv AND a.stt = b.stt  AND a.ma_vv <> ''
	-- End

	UPDATE #report2 SET chi_tieu = SPACE(10) + ten_vv, chi_tieu2 = SPACE(10) + ten_vv2
		FROM #report2 a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
		WHERE a.ma_vv <> ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff_CreateSpaceName('#report2', 'chi_tieu, chi_tieu2', 'nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)', 'stt2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @isDetail = 0
		DELETE #report2 WHERE ma_so = '' OR ma_vv <> ''

	SELECT stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, bold, ma_so_ct, ma_vv
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN chi_tieu2 ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu2
			, kh_nam, du_dau, tien, lk_dn, lk_kc, tien2, lk_dn2, lk_kc2, du_cuoi
			, kh_nam_nt, du_dau_nt, tien_nt, lk_dn_nt, lk_kc_nt, tien_nt2, lk_dn_nt2, lk_kc_nt2, du_cuoi_nt
		FROM #report2 ORDER BY stt, ma_so, stt2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetUnitRightList](@nUserID INT)  
RETURNS VARCHAR(1023)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = ISNULL(@cUnits, '') + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + ',' FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @nUserID AND r_access = 1
	IF RTRIM(ISNULL(@cUnits, '')) <> ''	SET @cUnits = LEFT(@cUnits, LEN(@cUnits) - 1)

	RETURN @cUnits
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostPRAuthorize]
	@type CHAR(1), -- 1 - Master approval, 2 - Detail approval
	@action CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@role VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@idLineNumber CHAR(3) = '',
	@quantity NUMERIC(19, 3) = 0,
	@description NVARCHAR(512) = '',
	@isLastRow INT = 1,
	@remoteApprove BIT = 0,
	@CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@voucherApproveLog BIT = 1,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @idLineNumber = REPLACE(@idLineNumber, '''', ''), @commentApproval = REPLACE(@commentApproval, '''', '''''')

	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @detailTable VARCHAR(32), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(128),
		@status VARCHAR(32), @uStatus VARCHAR(32), @xStatus VARCHAR(32), @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(19, 3), @lastUser INT, @getMailList_yn BIT, @notifyMail BIT, @created_mail_yn BIT, @createdUser INT
		, @msg NVARCHAR(1024), @datetime2 DATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @Category VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @status = '', @uStatus = '', @xStatus = '', @curStatus = '', @dept = '', @notifyMail = 0, @created_mail_yn = 0, @lastUser = 0, @createdUser = 0, @getMailList_yn = 1, @UnitKey = '', @admin = 0
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	--
	IF @role <> '' OR @type = '2' SET @getMailList_yn = 0

	--
	SET @dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112)
	SET @masterTable = 'm91$' + @dyn
	SET @detailTable = 'd91$' + @dyn
	SET @inquiryTable = 'i91$' + @dyn


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	INSERT INTO #listUser SELECT MAX(stt), user_id4 FROM a91$000000 WHERE reset = 0 and stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4 HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC


	-- Get Created User
	SET @q = 'select @u = user_id0 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@u int output', @createdUser OUTPUT


	-- Check remote aprrove
	IF @remoteApprove = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @d = datetime2 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d datetime output', @datetime2 OUTPUT

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id = @userID AND datetime2 = @datetime2) BEGIN
			SELECT '1' AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Get Role
	IF @role = '' BEGIN
		--
		SELECT @msg = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END

		--
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #listUser WHERE user_id = @userID) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		--
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')

		--
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), dept_id VARCHAR(32), ma_nt VARCHAR(32), t_tien_nt NUMERIC(19, 2), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, dept_id, ma_nt, t_tien_nt, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SET @q = @q + ' and status <> ''*'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @curStatus = u_status, @dept = dept_id, @FC = ma_nt, @amount = t_tien_nt, @Category = kieu_duyet FROM #role

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalRole '1', 'PR1', @userID, @dept, @FC, @amount, @curStatus, @language, @Category, @CategoryApprove OUTPUT, @role OUTPUT

		IF @role = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE SELECT @curStatus = u_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE s_status = '1' AND loai_duyet = '1'


	-- Get next status
	IF @type = 2 SELECT @uStatus = status2, @notifyMail = notify_mail_yn, @created_mail_yn = created_mail_yn FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @curStatus AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove
		ELSE SELECT @uStatus = CASE WHEN @action = '1' THEN status2 ELSE status0 END, @notifyMail = notify_mail_yn, @created_mail_yn = created_mail_yn FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @curStatus AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove

	SELECT @status = s_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE u_status = @uStatus AND loai_duyet = '1'
	SELECT @xStatus = CASE WHEN @action = '1' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END


	-- Key
	SET @key = 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF (RTRIM(@idLineNumber) <> '') SET @key = @key + ' and stt_rec0 = ''' + @idLineNumber + ''''


	-- Update detail table
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND u_status = @uStatus and (user_id4 = 0 OR user_id4 = @userID)) AND @uStatus IN ('0', '1') AND @action = '2' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update '+ @detailTable + ' set sl_duyet = 0, xstatus = '''''
		SET @q = @q + ', user_id3 = ''' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''', datetime3 = getdate(), ghi_chu = ' + CASE WHEN @type = '2' THEN 'N''' + REPLACE(@description, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'ghi_chu' END
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @type = '2' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update '+ @detailTable + ' set sl_duyet = ' + RTRIM(@quantity) + ', xstatus = ''' + REPLACE(@xStatus, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ', user_id3 = ''' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''', datetime3 = getdate(), ghi_chu = ' + CASE WHEN @type = '2' THEN 'N''' + REPLACE(@description, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'ghi_chu' END
			SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update '+ @detailTable + ' set sl_duyet = case when xstatus = '''' and sl_duyet = 0 then so_luong else sl_duyet end, xstatus = case when xstatus = '''' then ''' + REPLACE(@xStatus, '''', '') + ''' else xstatus end'
			SET @q = @q + ', user_id3 = ''' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''', datetime3 = getdate(), ghi_chu = ' + CASE WHEN @type = '2' THEN 'N''' + REPLACE(@description, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'ghi_chu' END
			SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
		END
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	-- MRP
	IF @status = '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PR @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, @userID

	IF @isLastRow = 1 BEGIN
		-- Update master table
		SET @q = 'update ' + @masterTable
		SET @q = @q + ' set t_duyet = (select count(1) from ' + @detailTable + ' where xstatus = ''2'' and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', t_huy = (select count(1) from ' + @detailTable + ' where xstatus = ''1'' and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		IF @status = '5' SET @q = @q + ', xtag2 = status'
		SET @q = @q + ', status = ''' + REPLACE(@status, '''', '') + ''', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@uStatus, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''
		SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
