		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @inquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + REPLACE(@status, '''', '') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c91$000000 set status = ''' + REPLACE(@status, '''', '') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @action = '1' EXEC rs_AfterUpdatePR @idNumber

		-- History Approve
		DECLARE @stt INT
		SELECT @stt = 0
		SELECT @stt = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) + 1 FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

		SET @q = 'insert into a91$000000(stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset, comment)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ''' + RTRIM(@stt) + ''', status, u_status, ''1'', user_id2, datetime2, 0, N''' + @commentApproval + ''''
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		-- History Detail Approve
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.sl_duyet, a.xstatus INTO #hisDetail
			FROM e91$000000 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, MAX(stt) AS stt FROM e91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, stt_rec0) b
				ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 AND a.stt = b.stt
		--
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, sl_duyet, xstatus AS xstatus0, xstatus, ghi_chu, 0 AS xtype INTO #tDetail FROM d91$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #tDetail select stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, sl_duyet, xstatus, xstatus, ghi_chu, 0 from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		UPDATE #tDetail SET so_luong = b.sl_duyet, xstatus0 = b.xstatus FROM #hisDetail b WHERE b.stt_rec = #tDetail.stt_rec AND b.stt_rec0 = #tDetail.stt_rec0
		UPDATE #tDetail SET xtype = 1 WHERE so_luong <> sl_duyet AND xstatus0 = xstatus
		UPDATE #tDetail SET xtype = 2 WHERE so_luong = sl_duyet AND xstatus0 <> xstatus
		UPDATE #tDetail SET xtype = 3 WHERE so_luong <> sl_duyet AND xstatus0 <> xstatus

		INSERT INTO e91$000000 SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, @stt, sl_duyet, xstatus, ghi_chu, xtype FROM #tDetail WHERE xtype <> 0

		-- Reset
		DECLARE @minReset INT
		SET @minReset = 0
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND u_status = @uStatus and (user_id4 = 0 OR user_id4 = @userID)) BEGIN
			SELECT @minReset = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) FROM a91$000000
				WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
					AND u_status = @uStatus
					AND stt < @stt
					AND stt in (SELECT a.stt FROM a91$000000 a
						JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(stt) AS stt FROM a91$000000 WHERE reset = 0 AND stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt AND a.xtype = '1')
			UPDATE a91$000000 SET reset = reset + 1 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND stt > @minReset

			-- Log
			IF @voucherApproveLog = 1 BEGIN
				DECLARE @idLog INT, @deleteDay INT
				SELECT @idLog = 0, @deleteDay = 0

				SET @q = 'select @deleteDay = isnull(logday, 0) from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..sysmaintenance where type = ''1'''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@deleteDay int output', @deleteDay OUTPUT
				DELETE d91log FROM m91log a JOIN d91log b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.id = b.id WHERE a.datetime2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())
				DELETE m91log WHERE DATETIME2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())


				SELECT @idLog = ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM m91log WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
				SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #mLogTemp FROM m91$000000
				SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #dLogTemp FROM d91$000000
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #mLogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #dLogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('m91log', '#mLogTemp', 'm91log', 'm91log', '1=1', null)
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('d91log', '#dLogTemp', 'd91log', 'd91log', '1=1', null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		-- Mail
		IF @getMailList_yn = 1 BEGIN
			-- Notify Mail
			IF @notifyMail = 0 SET @lastUser = 0
			-- Created Mail
			IF @created_mail_yn = 0 SET @createdUser = 0

			DECLARE @useNotify CHAR(1)
			SET @q = 'select @r = status from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifygroup where code = ''02'''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(1) out', @useNotify OUT

			IF @useNotify = '0' BEGIN
				SELECT '' AS message
				EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @masterTable, '1', 'PR1', @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser
			END ELSE BEGIN
				DECLARE @notifyCode VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000)
				CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
				INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @masterTable, '1', 'PR1', @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail) BEGIN
					CREATE TABLE #notifyContent(title NVARCHAR(128), title2 NVARCHAR(128), content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT, ref_code VARCHAR(32), s1 VARCHAR(32), e$ NVARCHAR(4000), [type] TINYINT, popup_title NVARCHAR(1024), popup_title2 NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content2 NVARCHAR(1024))
					EXEC rs_CreateNotifyPRTran @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, '#notifyContent'

					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 2) BEGIN
						EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '02', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
							'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 0',
							null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 2', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

						SET @q = 'update ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser set s1 = ma_nhan, s2 = ma_huy from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser a join dmxn b on a.user_id = b.user_id where a.code = @notifyCode and b.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
						EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@notifyCode varchar(32), @stt_rec char(13)', @notifyCode, @idNumber

						IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
						IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
					END
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 1) BEGIN
						EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '12', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
							'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 12',
							null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 1', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

						IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
						IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
					END
				END

				IF @invoke IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT '' AS message
				END
				SELECT * FROM #mail

			END
		END
	END


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2Detail]
	@period AS INT,
	@year AS INT,
	@type AS CHAR(1),
	@tsType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsDept AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@group NVARCHAR(256),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @group_yn BIT

	IF @type = '1'
		IF @period = 1 SELECT @period = 12, @year = @year - 1 ELSE SELECT @period = @period - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_dc AS ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc AS fx_ma_bp,
			a.so_luong as so_luong, a.nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb AS gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl AS gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt AS gt_cl_nt, a.gt_pb_ky AS gt_pb_ky, a.gt_pb_ky_nt AS gt_pb_ky_nt,
			b.loai_dc, b.ngay_tang AS ngay_tang, b.so_ky_pb AS so_ky_pb,
			b.ma_nt AS ma_nt, b.ty_gia AS ty_gia, b.ten_dc, b.ten_dc2
		INTO #report FROM ctcddc a, dmccdc b

	-- Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	-- Key
	SET @key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' and a.so_luong > 0'
	IF @tsType <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @tsDept <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	IF @group <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @group_yn = case when ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('''fx_ma_bp''', 'exactinlist', @group) + ' then 1 else 0 end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@group_yn bit output', @group_yn OUTPUT
	END ELSE SELECT @group_yn = 0
	IF @group_yn = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = '
			insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.ma_dc, max(a.ma_bp_dc),
					sum(a.so_luong), sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt), sum(a.gt_da_pb), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt), sum(a.gt_cl), sum(a.gt_cl_nt), sum(a.gt_pb_ky), sum(a.gt_pb_ky_nt),
					max(b.loai_dc), max(b.ngay_tang), max(b.so_ky_pb), max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia), ' +
					CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_dc)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_dc2)' ELSE '''''' END +
				' from ctcddc a join dmccdc b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				 where ' + @key +
				 ' group by a.ma_dc'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = '
			insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc,
					 sum(a.so_luong), sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt), sum(a.gt_da_pb), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt), sum(a.gt_cl), sum(a.gt_cl_nt), sum(a.gt_pb_ky), sum(a.gt_pb_ky_nt),
					 max(b.loai_dc), max(b.ngay_tang), max(b.so_ky_pb), max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia), ' +
					CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_dc)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_dc2)' ELSE '''''' END +
				' from ctcddc a join dmccdc b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				 where ' + @key + ' group by a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc'
	END

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_dc, fx_ma_bp', 'INT, #, VARCHAR(32)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @group <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @o = @group + ', ma_dc'
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'ma_dc, fx_ma_bp', '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	IF @group <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@group, 'dc', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dc', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dc, ngay_tang, so_ky_pb, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ten_dc, ten_dc2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from  #report order by ' + CASE WHEN @group <> '' THEN @group + ', ' ELSE '' END + 'sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpDecreasingByDept]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateInFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateInTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(32), 
	@Gender CHAR(1),
	@ChangeType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @i INT, @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @d2 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15), @c1 NVARCHAR(512), @c2 NVARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + '''', @d2 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	SELECT @c1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM005'
	SELECT @c2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM007'

	-- Struct	
	CREATE TABLE #report(bo_phan VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_vao SMALLDATETIME, loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%j', '%j', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%where'

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key +' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%j.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DateInFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateInFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateInTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateInTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %r.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %r.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join	
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 + @Level <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on %r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	IF @ChangeType <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = 'r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and (r.ngay_tu between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ') and r.loai_thay_doi = ''2'''
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'r'), '%j', 'b'), '%where', @Where)
	
		-- Transfer in
		CREATE TABLE #in(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), bac_quan_ly VARCHAR(32), tinh_chat VARCHAR(32), loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #in (stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu) select stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu from hreqtlvht'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where (ngay_tu between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ') and tinh_chat = ''1'' and loai_thay_doi = ''2'' order by stt_rec, ngay_tu'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
		-- Transfer out
		CREATE TABLE #transfer(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), bac_quan_ly VARCHAR(32), tinh_chat VARCHAR(32), loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
		INSERT INTO #transfer(stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu) SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu FROM hreqtlvht WHERE tinh_chat = '1' AND loai_thay_doi NOT IN ('4', '5') AND ngay_tu <= @DateTo AND stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #in) ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_tu
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.tinh_chat, b.loai_thay_doi, b.ngay_tu AS ngay_tu, a.ngay_tu AS ngay_vao INTO #out FROM #transfer a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt - 1 AS stt, ngay_tu, loai_thay_doi FROM #transfer WHERE ngay_tu >= @DateFrom AND loai_thay_doi = '2')  b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt

		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'r'), '%j', 'b'), '%where', '(1 = 1)')

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (bo_phan, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.bo_phan, r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, r.vi_tri, r.ngay_tu, r.ngay_vao, r.loai_thay_doi'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #out r left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec ' + REPLACE(@Join, '%r', 'r') + ' where ' + @Where
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @ChangeType <> '2' BEGIN
		IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
		SELECT @Where = '(a.ngay_nghi between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')'
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%j', 'a'), '%where', @Where)

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (bo_phan, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.bo_phan, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.vi_tri, null, a.ngay_vao, ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a' + REPLACE(@Join, '%r', 'a') + ' where ' + @Where
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @DeptKey = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%where', '(1 = 1)'), '%j', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#report', 'bo_phan'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Report
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct a.bo_phan, b.bp_me from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%where', '(1 = 1)'), '%j', 'b')
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = max(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
 	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0) - 1
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct b.ma_bp, b.bp_me from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (b.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	CREATE TABLE #result(bo_phan VARCHAR(568), bo_phan0 VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_vao SMALLDATETIME, loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(1), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result(bo_phan, bo_phan0, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select cast(b.stt_ref as char(512)) + a.bo_phan, a.bo_phan, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi from ('
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select bo_phan, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi from #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' union all select distinct bo_phan, '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''' from #r'
	SELECT @q = @q + ') a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp order by b.stt_ref, a.bo_phan, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = min(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	SELECT stt, bo_phan INTO #order FROM #result WHERE ma_nv = ''
	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result) INSERT INTO #result(bo_phan, bo_phan0, stt_rec, ma_nv, vi_tri, ngay_tu, ngay_vao, loai_thay_doi) SELECT '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, ''

	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt - o.stt as stt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.ma_nv = '''' then '''' else rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) end as ho_ten_nv, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ngay_tu as ngay_chuyen, e.ngay_vao, case when a.loai_thay_doi = ''1'' then e.ngay_nghi else null end as ngay_nghi, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.ma_nv <> '''' then '''' else space(2 * (b.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(STR(@step, 5)) + ')) + b.ten_bp%l end as ten_bp, d.ten_vtr%l as ten_vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' when e.gioi_tinh = ''2'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' else '''' end as gioi_tinh, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.loai_thay_doi = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@c1, '''', '''''') + ''' when a.loai_thay_doi = ''2'' then N''' + REPLACE(@c2, '''', '''''') + ''' else '''' end as ten_loai_td'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #result a left join #order o on a.bo_phan = o.bo_phan left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan0 = b.ma_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr order by a.bo_phan, a.ma_nv'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs20_CalcBookExRate @nCycle TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cVC CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @cFC VARCHAR(3), @cBaseFC CHAR(3)
	SELECT @cBaseFC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_MA_NT0'

	DECLARE crFC CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_nt FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt <> @cBaseFC
	OPEN crFC
	FETCH NEXT FROM crFC INTO @cFC
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs20_CalcBookExRatex @nCycle, @nYear, @cFC, @cVC
			FETCH NEXT FROM crFC INTO @cFC
		END
	CLOSE crFC
	DEALLOCATE crFC

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInterestDetailedByLoanContract] --fs20_KUbktl--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@LoanFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@LoanTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@ContractType CHAR(1),
	@LoanContract VARCHAR(32),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @k1 NVARCHAR(4000), @k2 NVARCHAR(4000), @k3 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c INT
	DECLARE @round TINYINT, @fcRound TINYINT, @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @days INT, @daysOfYear INT, @OldLoanContract VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @round = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @fcRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @daysOfYear = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_ls_nam'
	SELECT @days = CASE WHEN val = 1 THEN 30 ELSE @daysOfYear END FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kieu_ls'
	SELECT @d1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@LoanFrom), @d2 = @LoanFrom - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku, tk, ngay_ct AS ngay_tu, ngay_ct AS ngay_den, ps_no AS da_tra, ps_co AS so_du, ps_no_nt AS da_tra_nt, ps_co_nt AS so_du_nt INTO #tmp1 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku, tk, ps_no, ps_no_nt INTO #tmp2 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku + tk AS ma_ku_tk, ma_ku, ngay_ku1 INTO #dmku FROM dmku

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @k2 = 'a.ma_ku <> ''''', @k1 = ''
	IF @Account <> '' SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account), @k2 = @k2 + @k1

	SELECT @k1 = 'a.tinh_trang = ''1'' and a.loai_ku = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractType), '''', '''''') + '''' + @k1
	IF @LoanContract <> '' SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@LoanContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ngay_ku1 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ngay_ku1 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Job <> '' SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SELECT @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--
	SET @k1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k1)

	-- Danh sách khế ước thỏa điều kiện
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmku select ma_ku + tk, ma_ku, ngay_ku1 from dmku a with(nolock) where loai_ku = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractType), '''', '''''') + ''' and ' + @k1
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @ContractType = '1' BEGIN
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select ma_ku, tk, case when ' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '') + ' = ''1'' and sum(ps_no) > 0 then ngay_ct + 1 else ngay_ct end as ngay_tu' +
			', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanTo, 112) + ''' as ngay_den, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)' +
			' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku_tk from #dmku) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END +
			']% group by ma_ku, tk, ngay_ct'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, ngay_ct, @LoanFrom, @LoanTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select ma_ku, tk, case when ' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '') + ' = ''1'' and sum(ps_co) > 0 then ngay_ct + 1 else ngay_ct end AS ngay_tu' +
			', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanTo, 112) + ''' as ngay_den, sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co_nt), sum(ps_no_nt)' +
			' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku_tk from #dmku) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END +
			']% group by ma_ku, tk, ngay_ct'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, ngay_ct, @LoanFrom, @LoanTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Chèn dòng dữ liệu mà chỉ có phát sinh chi
	INSERT INTO #tmp1(ma_ku, tk, ngay_tu, ngay_den, da_tra, so_du, da_tra_nt, so_du_nt)
		SELECT ma_ku, tk, @LoanFrom, @LoanTo, 0, 0, 0, 0
			FROM #tmp1
			GROUP BY ma_ku, tk
			HAVING SUM(so_du) <= 0 AND MIN(ngay_tu) > @LoanFrom


	-- Chèn dữ liệu không xảy ra nghiệp vụ thu chi nào được chuyển từ năm trước sang
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp2 select a.ma_ku, a.tk, sum(a.du_no00 - a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00)' +
		' from cdku a with(nolock, index(nam)) join dmku b on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@LoanFrom)) + ' and ' + @k2 + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k1, 'a.', 'b.') + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END +
		' group by a.ma_ku, a.tk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp2 select a.ma_ku, a.tk, sum(a.ps_no - a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt - a.ps_co_nt)' +
		' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmku b on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku where %[a.status = ''1'' and ' + @k2 + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k1, 'a.', 'b.') + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%' +
		' group by a.ma_ku, a.tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @d1, @d2, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	SELECT ma_ku, tk, SUM(ps_no) AS du, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_nt INTO #dk1 FROM #tmp2 GROUP BY ma_ku, tk

	-- Chèn dữ liệu
	IF @ContractType = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp1 (ma_ku, tk, ngay_tu, ngay_den, da_tra, so_du, da_tra_nt, so_du_nt) ' +
			' select distinct ma_ku, tk, ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanFrom, 112) + ''', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanTo, 112) + ''', du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00' +
			' from cdku a where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@LoanFrom)) + ' and ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku_tk from #dmku) ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END +
			 ' and ma_ku + tk not in (select ma_ku + tk from #tmp1)' +
			' and ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku + tk from #dk1 where du <> 0 or du_nt <> 0)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp1 (ma_ku, tk, ngay_tu, ngay_den, da_tra, so_du, da_tra_nt, so_du_nt) ' +
			' select distinct ma_ku, tk, ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanFrom, 112) + ''', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanTo, 112) + ''', du_co00, du_no00, du_co_nt00, du_no_nt00' +
			' from cdku a where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@LoanFrom)) + ' and ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku_tk from #dmku) ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END +
			' and ma_ku + tk not in (select ma_ku + tk from #tmp1)' +
			' and ma_ku + tk in (select ma_ku + tk from #dk1 where du <> 0 or du_nt <> 0)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Chèn dữ liệu không có phát sinh nv chi trong khoan tg, ma nghiệp vụ thu phat sinh trong nam
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp1(ma_ku, tk, ngay_tu, ngay_den, da_tra, so_du, da_tra_nt, so_du_nt) ' +
		' select distinct ma_ku, tk, ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanFrom, 112) + ''', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @LoanTo, 112) + ''', 0, 0, 0, 0' +
		' from #dk1 where du <> 0' +
		' and ma_ku + tk not in (select ma_ku + tk from #tmp1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update lại ngay_den = ngay_tu liền sau
	UPDATE #tmp1 SET ngay_den = ISNULL(
						(
							SELECT CASE WHEN @Status = '1'  THEN MIN(x.ngay_tu) - 1 ELSE MIN(x.ngay_tu) END
								FROM #tmp1 x WHERE x.ngay_tu > #tmp1.ngay_tu AND #tmp1.ma_ku = x.ma_ku AND #tmp1.tk = x.tk
						), ngay_den)

	-- Tính lại số dư
	SELECT TOP 0 du_no00 AS du, du_no_nt00 AS du_nt INTO #cdku FROM cdku
	DECLARE @LoanContract2 VARCHAR(32), @Account2 VARCHAR(32), @Ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, @Ngay_tu2 SMALLDATETIME, @BalanceType INT
	SELECT @BalanceType = CASE WHEN @Status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
	DECLARE Cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_ku, tk, ngay_tu FROM #tmp1 WHERE so_du = 0 OR ngay_tu >= @LoanFrom
	OPEN Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @LoanContract2, @Account2, @Ngay_tu
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #cdku

		IF @BalanceType = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmku WHERE ma_ku = @LoanContract2 AND ngay_ku1 = @Ngay_tu)
			INSERT INTO #cdku EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$BContract @Ngay_tu, @Unit, @Account2, @LoanContract2, @ContractType, 2, 1, @UserID, @Admin, '', ''
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #cdku EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$BContract @Ngay_tu, @Unit, @Account2, @LoanContract2, @ContractType, @BalanceType, 1, @UserID, @Admin, '', ''

		UPDATE #tmp1 SET so_du = (ISNULL(a.Du, 0)), so_du_nt = (ISNULL(a.Du_nt, 0))
			FROM #cdku a
			WHERE #tmp1.ma_ku = @LoanContract2 AND #tmp1.tk = @Account2 AND #tmp1.ngay_tu = @Ngay_tu

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @LoanContract2, @Account2, @Ngay_tu
	END
	CLOSE Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cur

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, b.ngay_ku1 AS ngay_vay, b.ngay_ku2 AS ngay_dh, b.tien AS tien_vay, b.tien_nt AS tien_vay_nt, b.ten_ku, b.ten_ku2, b.ma_hd, b.ma_vv
		, b.ls_t * 0 AS ls_th, b.ls_qh * 0 AS ls_qh
		, CASE
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 >= a.ngay_den THEN DATEDIFF(day, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den) + 1
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 >= a.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_ku2 < a.ngay_den THEN DATEDIFF(day, a.ngay_tu, b.ngay_ku2) + 1
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 < a.ngay_tu THEN 0
			END AS so_ngay_th
		, CASE
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 >= a.ngay_den THEN 0
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 >= a.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_ku2 < a.ngay_den THEN DATEDIFF(day, b.ngay_ku2, a.ngay_den)
			WHEN b.ngay_ku2 < a.ngay_tu THEN DATEDIFF(day, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den) + 1
			END AS so_ngay_qh
		, CAST(0 AS INT) AS so_ngay_tong, b.tien * 0 AS tl_th, b.tien * 0 AS tl_qh, b.tien * 0 AS tl_tong
		, b.tien_nt * 0 AS tl_th_nt, b.tien_nt * 0 AS tl_qh_nt, b.tien_nt * 0 AS tl_tong_nt
		, b.so_ku, c.ten_tk, c.ten_tk2, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS r_id
		INTO #Report
		FROM #tmp1 a JOIN dmku b ON a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku AND a.tk = b.tk AND b.loai_ku = @ContractType
				LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk = c.tk AND a.tk = c.tk

	SELECT ma_ku, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS _id, ngay_hl, ls INTO #ctdmku FROM ctdmku WHERE ma_ku IN (SELECT ma_ku FROM #Report) ORDER BY ma_ku, ngay_hl


	ALTER TABLE #Report ALTER COLUMN tl_th NUMERIC(38, 12) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #Report ALTER COLUMN tl_qh NUMERIC(38, 12) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #Report ALTER COLUMN tl_th_nt NUMERIC(38, 12) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #Report ALTER COLUMN tl_qh_nt NUMERIC(38, 12) NULL


	SELECT @OldLoanContract = ''
	DECLARE @_iday INT, @_ma_ku VARCHAR(32), @_dfrom SMALLDATETIME, @_dto SMALLDATETIME, @_dend SMALLDATETIME, @_dvalid SMALLDATETIME
		, @_d_th INT, @_d_qh INT, @_ls NUMERIC(28, 6), @r_id INT

	DECLARE Cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_ku, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ngay_dh, so_ngay_th, so_ngay_qh, r_id FROM #Report ORDER BY ma_ku, ngay_tu
	OPEN Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @_ma_ku, @_dfrom, @_dto, @_dend, @_d_th, @_d_qh, @r_id
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @_ma_ku <> @OldLoanContract AND @Status = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @c = COUNT (1) FROM #report WHERE ma_ku = @_ma_ku
		END
		IF @c > 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @_d_th = @_d_th - 1
			UPDATE #Report SET  so_ngay_th = so_ngay_th - 1 WHERE r_id = @r_id
			SELECT @c = @c - 1
		END
		SET @OldLoanContract = @_ma_ku

		SET @_iday = 0
		WHILE @_iday <= @_d_th + @_d_qh - 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @_ls = 0, @_dvalid = NULL
			IF @Status = 1 SET @_dvalid = DATEADD(d, - @_iday, @_dto) ELSE SET @_dvalid = DATEADD(d, @_iday, @_dfrom)
			SELECT @_ls = ls FROM #ctdmku WHERE _id IN (SELECT MAX(_id) AS _id FROM #ctdmku WHERE ma_ku = @_ma_ku AND ngay_hl <= @_dvalid)
			SELECT @_ls = 0 WHERE @_ls IS NULL

			IF @_dvalid <= @_dend
				UPDATE #Report SET tl_th = tl_th + (so_du * (@_ls / 100) / @days), tl_th_nt = tl_th_nt + (so_du_nt * (@_ls / 100) / @days)
					WHERE r_id = @r_id
			ELSE
				UPDATE #Report SET tl_qh = tl_qh + (so_du * (@_ls / 100) / @days), tl_qh_nt = tl_qh_nt + (so_du_nt * (@_ls / 100) / @days)
					WHERE r_id = @r_id

			SET @_iday = @_iday + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @_ma_ku, @_dfrom, @_dto, @_dend, @_d_th, @_d_qh, @r_id
	END
	CLOSE Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cur

	UPDATE #Report SET tl_th = ROUND(tl_th, @round), tl_th_nt = ROUND(tl_th_nt, @fcRound), tl_qh = ROUND(tl_qh, @round), tl_qh_nt = ROUND(tl_qh_nt, @fcRound)

	UPDATE #Report SET so_ngay_tong = so_ngay_th + so_ngay_qh
		, tl_tong = tl_th + tl_qh
		, tl_tong_nt = tl_th_nt + tl_qh_nt
		, ls_th = CASE WHEN so_du = 0 OR so_ngay_th = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tl_th / so_du / so_ngay_th * @days * 100, 2) END
		, ls_qh = CASE WHEN so_du = 0 OR so_ngay_qh = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tl_qh / so_du / so_ngay_qh * @days * 100, 2) END

	SELECT * FROM #Report ORDER BY tk, ma_ku, ngay_tu

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrrmkqktr]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dot, a.ma_hs, RTRIM(b.ho_uv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_uv AS ho_va_ten, a.noi_dung, a.ngay_ktr, a.diem, 
		d.ten_kq, d.ten_kq2, e.ten_tt, e.ten_tt2, a.ma_vong, c.ten_vong, c.ten_vong2, ISNULL(c.stt, 0) AS stt_vong, a.ma_dvcs,
		a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
	FROM hrrmkqktr a LEFT JOIN hrrmhs b ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_hs = b.ma_hs
		LEFT JOIN hrdmvongtd c ON a.ma_vong = c.ma_vong
		LEFT JOIN hrdmkq d ON a.ma_kq = d.ma_kq
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtths e ON a.tt_hs = e.ma_tt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCRTranExport_v1]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Table CHAR(2),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@nCharge BIT = 0,
	@printCharge BIT = 0,
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Debit NVARCHAR(128), @Credit NVARCHAR(128), @Debit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Credit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Desc INT
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = '', @Voucher = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Debit = cname, @Debit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT053'
	SELECT @Credit = cname, @Credit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT054'

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, tk_co AS tk, tt, tt_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(15)) AS xGroup, 1 AS so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ong_ba,
			dien_giai AS ten_kh, dien_giai AS ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc,
			dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp,
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #m FROM wrkcrtran

	SET @q = 'insert into #m select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec + ''01'', ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ','
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_nk, a.ong_ba, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, a.dia_chi, a.dien_giai,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.tk, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.so_ct_goc, a.dien_giai_ct_goc,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id,'
	SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang,'
	SET @q = @q + ' rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringValue(a.ty_gia), a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m' + @Table + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, tk_co, tien, tien_nt from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('d' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @nCharge = 1 AND @printCharge = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec, stt_rec + '01' AS xGroup, tk, SUM(tt) AS tien, SUM(tt_nt) AS tien_nt, CAST(9 AS INT) AS in_yn
		INTO #d FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk ORDER BY stt_rec, tk

	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #sx FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #d SET in_yn = 3 FROM #d a JOIN #sx b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn) SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01', tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, 1 FROM #m

	IF @nCharge = 1 AND @printCharge = 1 BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmp

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_cp, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_thue, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn) SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01', tk, SUM(tt) AS tien, SUM(tt_nt) AS tien_nt, 2 FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk ORDER BY stt_rec, tk
	END

	IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '02', 2, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc,	t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_bp, ngay, thang, nam, chuoi_ty_gia, [user_id0], datetime0, contact_sign FROM #m
		INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn)
			SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '02', tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn FROM #d ORDER BY stt_rec, xGroup, stt, tk
	END

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #m where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#m', '#m', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup,
		so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk,	ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, chuoi_ty_gia,
		so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, ngay, thang, nam, b.line_account
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
	from #m a join (select xgroup,count(tk) as line_account from #d group by xgroup) b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by ngay_ct, so_ct, a.xgroup'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup,
		so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk,	ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, chuoi_ty_gia,
		so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, ngay, thang, nam, b.line_account
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
	from #m a join (select xgroup,count(tk) as line_account from #d group by xgroup) b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, a.xgroup'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Bilingual = '1' SELECT @Debit = @Debit + ':', @Credit = @Credit + ':', @Debit2 = @Debit2 + ':', @Credit2 = @Credit2 + ':'

	IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 3 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 3 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, a.xgroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 3 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 3 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by b.ngay_ct desc, b.so_ct desc, a.xgroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Debit nvarchar(128), @Credit nvarchar(128), @Debit2 nvarchar(128), @Credit2 nvarchar(128)', @Debit, @Credit, @Debit2, @Credit2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ExecClosingTrans]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@So_tt INT,
	@Ten_bt NVARCHAR(511),
	@Tk_no VARCHAR(32),
	@Tk_co VARCHAR(32),
	@Loai_kc TINYINT,
	@So_ct VARCHAR(32),
	@Kc_ct_yn BIT,
	@Kc_kh_yn BIT,
	@Kc_vv_yn BIT,
	@Kc_sp_yn BIT,
	@Kc_bp_yn BIT,
	@Kc_hd_yn BIT,
	@Kc_ku_yn BIT,
	@Kc_phi_yn BIT,
	@Kc_lsx_yn BIT,
	@Kc_td1_yn BIT,
	@Kc_td2_yn BIT,
	@Kc_td3_yn BIT,
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@User_id2 INT,
	@Key NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_round_tg INT, @m_tk_kqkd VARCHAR(128), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @m_type INT, @m_tk_thue_kc VARCHAR(128), @m_tk_thue_tt VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @managementObjectField1 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField2 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField3 VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @m_round_tg = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT @m_tk_kqkd = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_kqkd'
	SELECT @m_type = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_closing_type'
	SELECT @m_tk_thue_kc = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_thue_kc'
	SELECT @m_tk_thue_tt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tien_thue'

	SELECT @managementObjectField1 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '04'
	SELECT @managementObjectField2 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '05'
	SELECT @managementObjectField3 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '06'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt1, ma_td2 AS ma_dtqt2, ma_td3 AS ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #gl0 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #gl1 FROM #gl0

	-- Phat sinh
	IF @Loai_kc = 1
		INSERT INTO #gl1
			SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
				FROM #ct00
				WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk_co) + '%')
				GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
				HAVING SUM(ps_no) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_no_nt) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co_nt) <> 0

	IF @Loai_kc = 2
		INSERT INTO #gl1
			SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
				FROM #ct00
				WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk_no) + '%')
				GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
				HAVING SUM(ps_no) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_no_nt) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co_nt) <> 0

	IF @Loai_kc = 3 AND @m_tk_kqkd <> '' BEGIN
		IF @Tk_no LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%'
			INSERT INTO #gl1
				SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
					FROM #ct00
					WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk_no) + '%')
					GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
					HAVING SUM(ps_no) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_no_nt) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co_nt) <> 0

		IF @Tk_co LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%'
			INSERT INTO #gl1
				SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
					FROM #ct00
					WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk_co) + '%')
					GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
					HAVING SUM(ps_no) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_no_nt) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co) <> 0 OR SUM(ps_co_nt) <> 0
	END

	IF @Loai_kc = 4 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Dmtk WHERE Tk = @Tk_no AND Loai_tk = 1) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Dmtk WHERE Tk = @Tk_co AND Loai_tk = 1) RETURN

		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t1 FROM cdtk
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #t2 FROM #t1
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #t3 FROM #t1

		IF dbo.ff_InList(@Tk_no, @m_tk_thue_kc) = 1 BEGIN
			-- ps_co
			INSERT INTO #t3 (ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
				SELECT ma_dvcs, @Tk_no, 0, SUM(ps_co), 0, SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE tk = @Tk_no GROUP BY ma_dvcs

			-- ps_no
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ps_no, ps_no_nt INTO #ct00Tax FROM r00$000000
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00Tax select ma_dvcs, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[tk = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Tk_no), '''', '''''') + ''''
			IF @m_tk_thue_tt <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @m_tk_thue_tt)
			IF @Key <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (' + @Key + ')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by ma_dvcs'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
			--
			INSERT INTO #t3 (ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
				SELECT ma_dvcs, @Tk_no, SUM(ps_no), 0, SUM(ps_no_nt), 0 FROM #ct00Tax GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			--
			INSERT INTO #t1 (ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
				SELECT ma_dvcs, @Tk_no, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #t3 GROUP BY ma_dvcs
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #t1 (ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt) EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dTo, @cUnit, @Tk_no, 2, 2, @User_id2, 0
		END
		DELETE #t1 WHERE du_co - du_no <= 0
		UPDATE #t1 SET du_co = du_co - du_no, du_co_nt = du_co_nt - du_no_nt, du_no = 0, du_no_nt = 0

		INSERT INTO #t2 (ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt) EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dTo, @cUnit, @Tk_co, 2, 2, @User_id2, 0
		DELETE #t2 WHERE du_no - du_co <= 0
		UPDATE #t2 SET du_no = du_no - du_co, du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt, du_co = 0, du_co_nt = 0

		INSERT INTO #gl0
			SELECT @Tk_no, a.ma_dvcs, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', SUM(a.du_no), SUM(a.du_no_nt), SUM(a.du_co), SUM(a.du_co_nt)
				FROM (SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt FROM #t1 UNION ALL SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt FROM #t2) a
					GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs HAVING SUM(a.du_no) <> 0 AND SUM(du_co) <> 0

	END	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Kc_kh_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_kh = ''
		IF @Kc_vv_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_vv = ''
		IF @Kc_sp_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_sp = ''
		IF @Kc_bp_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_bp = ''
		IF @Kc_hd_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_hd = ''
		IF @Kc_ku_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_ku = ''
		IF @Kc_phi_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_phi = ''
		IF @Kc_lsx_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET so_lsx = ''
		IF @Kc_td1_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_dtqt1 = ''
		IF @Kc_td2_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_dtqt2 = ''
		IF @Kc_td3_yn = 0 UPDATE #gl1 SET ma_dtqt3 = ''

		IF @Kc_ct_yn = 1
			DELETE #gl1 WHERE ma_kh + ma_vv + ma_sp + ma_bp + ma_hd + ma_ku + ma_phi + so_lsx + ma_dtqt1 + ma_dtqt2 + ma_dtqt3 = ''

		IF @Loai_kc <> 3 AND @m_type = 0
			INSERT INTO #gl0
				SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
					FROM #gl1
					GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #gl0
				SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, '', SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
					FROM #gl1
					GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3
	END

	-- Define variables for cursor
	DECLARE @vcTk VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_nt VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_sp VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_bp VARCHAR(32)
		, @vcMa_hd VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_ku VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_phi VARCHAR(32), @vcSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt1 VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt2 VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dtqt3 VARCHAR(32)
		, @vcPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @vcPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vcPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @vcPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	-- Define variables for ct00
	DECLARE @vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13), @vdMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_ct VARCHAR(3), @vdNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @vdNgay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @vdSo_ct VARCHAR(32), @vdSo_lo VARCHAR(32), @vdNgay_lo SMALLDATETIME, @vdOng_ba NVARCHAR(128), @vdDien_giai NVARCHAR(128)
		, @vdNh_dk VARCHAR(32), @nNh_dk INT, @vdLine_nbr INT, @vdTk VARCHAR(32), @vdTk_du VARCHAR(32), @vdPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_nt VARCHAR(32)
		, @vdTy_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_sp VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_bp VARCHAR(32)
		, @vdMa_hd VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_ku VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_phi VARCHAR(32), @vdSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt1 VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt2 VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_dtqt3 VARCHAR(32)
		, @vduser_id0 INT, @vddate0 DATETIME, @vduser_id2 INT, @vddate2 DATETIME, @vdstatus VARCHAR(1)
	-- Set value for variables of table ct00
	SELECT @vdMa_ct = 'PK3', @vdNgay_ct = @dTo, @vdNgay_lct = @dTo, @vdSo_lo = '', @vdNgay_lo = NULL, @vdOng_ba = '', @vdDien_giai = RTRIM(@Ten_bt) + ' - ' +RTRIM( @Tk_no) + ', ' + @Tk_co, @vdMa_kh = ''
		, @vduser_id0 = @nUserID, @vddate0  = GETDATE(), @vduser_id2 = @User_id2, @vddate2 = GETDATE(), @vdstatus = '1'

	-- Lay stt_rec
	DECLARE @strSQLExec NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') +  ' FROM dmkc1 WHERE stt = ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + ''' AND Nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dTo))
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT

	IF @vdStt_rec = '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @Ws_id CHAR(1)
		SELECT @Ws_id = RTRIM(Val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(Name) = 'M_WS_ID'
		SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = MAX(stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ') FROM dmkc1 WHERE nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dTo))
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT

		SELECT @vdStt_rec = @Ws_id + RTRIM(YEAR(@dTo)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(SUBSTRING(@vdStt_rec, 8, 3) AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ', '0') + @vdMa_ct
		SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmkc1 SET stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' = ''' +  @vdStt_rec + ''' WHERE stt = ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + ''' AND nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dTo))
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
	END

	-- Lay so_ct
	SET @vdSo_ct = @So_ct
	IF @vdSo_ct = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @vdSo_ct = STR(So_ct + 1, dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
		UPDATE dmct SET So_ct = So_ct + 1 WHERE ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
		SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmkc1 SET so_ct' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0') + ' = ''' +  @vdSo_ct + ''' WHERE stt = ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + ''' AND nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dTo))
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
	END

	DECLARE cusTran CURSOR FOR SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_dtqt1, ma_dtqt2, ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #gl0
	OPEN cusTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcMa_kh, @vcMa_vv, @vcMa_sp, @vcMa_bp, @vcMa_hd, @vcMa_ku, @vcMa_phi, @vcSo_lsx, @vcMa_dtqt1, @vcMa_dtqt2, @vcMa_dtqt3, @vcMa_nt, @vcPs_no, @vcPs_no_nt, @vcPs_co, @vcPs_co_nt
	DECLARE @isContinue TINYINT
	SELECT @vdSo_ct = SPACE(dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct') - LEN(RTRIM(@vdSo_ct))) + @vdSo_ct
	SELECT @vdNh_dk = '001', @nNh_dk = 1

	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr INTO #t FROM r00$000000
	SELECT @strSQLExec = 'insert into #t select max(line_nbr) from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(stt_rec)) where %[stt_rec = ''' + @vdStt_rec + ''']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @strSQLExec, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
	SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1 FROM #t

	--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1 FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @vdStt_rec
	--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = 1

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @isContinue = 1
		IF @Loai_kc = 1 BEGIN -- Ket chuyen tu co sang no
			SELECT @vdTk = @Tk_no, @vdTk_du = @vcTk
			--
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @Tk_no AND loai_tk = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @vdTk = RTRIM(@Tk_no) + RIGHT(RTRIM(@vcTk), LEN(@vcTk) - LEN(@Tk_co))
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @vdTk AND loai_tk = 1)
					SET @isContinue = 0
			END
		END
		IF @Loai_kc = 2 BEGIN -- Ket chuyen tu no sang co
			SELECT @vdTk = @vcTk, @vdTk_du = @Tk_co
			--
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @Tk_co AND loai_tk = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @vdTk_du = RTRIM(@Tk_co) + RIGHT(RTRIM(@vcTk), LEN(@vcTk) - LEN(@Tk_no))
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @vdTk_du AND loai_tk = 1)
					SET @isContinue = 0
			END
		END
		IF @Loai_kc = 3 BEGIN -- Ket chuyen tu dong
			SELECT @vdTk = @vcTk, @vdTk_du = CASE WHEN @Tk_co LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%' THEN @Tk_no ELSE @Tk_co END
			--
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = CASE WHEN @Tk_co LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%' THEN @Tk_no ELSE @Tk_co END AND loai_tk = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @vdTk_du = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Tk_co LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%' THEN @Tk_no ELSE @Tk_co END) + RIGHT(RTRIM(@vcTk), LEN(@vcTk) - LEN(CASE WHEN @Tk_co LIKE RTRIM(@m_tk_kqkd) + '%' THEN @Tk_co ELSE @Tk_no END))
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @vdTk_du AND loai_tk = 1)
					SET @isContinue = 0
			END
		END

		IF @Loai_kc = 4 -- Ket chuyen VAT
			SELECT @vdTk = @Tk_no, @vdTk_du = @Tk_co

		IF @isContinue = 1 BEGIN
			IF @Loai_kc = 1
				SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = @vcPs_no_nt - @vcPs_co_nt, @vdPs_no = @vcPs_no - @vcPs_co, @vdPs_co_nt = 0, @vdPs_co = 0

			IF @Loai_kc = 2
				SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = @vcPs_co_nt - @vcPs_no_nt, @vdPs_no = @vcPs_co - @vcPs_no, @vdPs_co_nt = 0, @vdPs_co = 0

			IF @Loai_kc = 3
				IF @vcPs_co - @vcPs_no < 0
					SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = 0, @vdPs_no = 0, @vdPs_co_nt = @vcPs_no_nt - @vcPs_co_nt, @vdPs_co = @vcPs_no - @vcPs_co
				ELSE
					SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = @vcPs_co_nt - @vcPs_no_nt, @vdPs_no = @vcPs_co - @vcPs_no, @vdPs_co_nt = 0, @vdPs_co = 0

			IF @Loai_kc = 4 BEGIN
				IF @vcPs_co - @vcPs_no < 0
					SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = @vcPs_co_nt, @vdPs_no = @vcPs_co
				ELSE
					SELECT @vdPs_no_nt = @vcPs_no_nt, @vdPs_no = @vcPs_no
				SELECT @vdPs_co_nt = 0, @vdPs_co = 0

			END

			SELECT @vdMa_dvcs = @vcMa_dvcs, @vdMa_nt = @vcMa_nt, @vdTy_gia = CASE WHEN @vcPs_no_nt = @vcPs_co_nt THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ABS(@vcPs_no - @vcPs_co) / ABS(@vcPs_no_nt - @vcPs_co_nt), @m_round_tg) END
				, @vdMa_kh = @vcMa_kh, @vdMa_vv = @vcMa_vv, @vdMa_sp = @vcMa_sp, @vdMa_bp = @vcMa_bp, @vdMa_hd = @vcMa_hd, @vdMa_ku = @vcMa_ku, @vdMa_phi = @vcMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx = @vcSo_lsx
				, @vdMa_dtqt1 = @vcMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2 = @vcMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3 = @vcMa_dtqt3

			SELECT @q = 'insert into #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba,
				dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh,
				ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				values (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct,
					@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk, @vdTk_du,
					@vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co,
					@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3, @vduser_id0,
					@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)',
				@s = '@vdStt_rec varchar(13), @vdMa_dvcs varchar(32), @vdMa_ct varchar(3), @vdNgay_ct smalldatetime, @vdNgay_lct smalldatetime, @vdSo_ct varchar(32)
				, @vdSo_lo varchar(32), @vdNgay_lo smalldatetime, @vdOng_ba nvarchar(128), @vdDien_giai nvarchar(128), @vdNh_dk varchar(32), @vdLine_nbr numeric(5)
				, @vdTk varchar(32), @vdTk_du varchar(32), @vdPs_no_nt numeric(28, 6), @vdPs_co_nt numeric(28, 6), @vdMa_nt varchar(3), @vdTy_gia numeric(24, 12)
				, @vdPs_no numeric(28, 6), @vdPs_co numeric(28, 6), @vdMa_kh varchar(32), @vdMa_vv varchar(32), @vdMa_sp varchar(32), @vdMa_bp varchar(32)
				, @vdMa_hd varchar(32), @vdMa_ku varchar(32), @vdMa_phi varchar(32), @vdSo_lsx varchar(32), @vdMa_dtqt1 varchar(32), @vdMa_dtqt2 varchar(32), @vdMa_dtqt3 varchar(32)
				, @vduser_id0 int, @vddate0 datetime, @vduser_id2 int, @vddate2 datetime, @vdstatus varchar(1)'

			EXEC sp_executesql @q, @s, @vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct
				, @vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr
				, @vdTk, @vdTk_du, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia
				, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co, @vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp
				, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3
				, @vduser_id0, @vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus

			SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1

			SET @q = 'insert into #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba,
				dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh,
				ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				values (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct,
					@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk_du, @vdTk,
					@vdPs_co_nt, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_co, @vdPs_no,
					@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3, @vduser_id0,
					@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, @s, @vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct
				, @vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr
				, @vdTk, @vdTk_du, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia
				, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co, @vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdMa_sp, @vdMa_bp
				, @vdMa_hd, @vdMa_ku, @vdMa_phi, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_dtqt1, @vdMa_dtqt2, @vdMa_dtqt3
				, @vduser_id0, @vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcMa_kh, @vcMa_vv, @vcMa_sp, @vcMa_bp, @vcMa_hd, @vcMa_ku, @vcMa_phi, @vcSo_lsx, @vcMa_dtqt1, @vcMa_dtqt2, @vcMa_dtqt3, @vcMa_nt, @vcPs_no, @vcPs_no_nt, @vcPs_co, @vcPs_co_nt

		SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1

		--SELECT @vdNh_dk = REPLACE(STR(CAST(@vdNh_dk AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ' , '0')
		SELECT @nNh_dk = @nNh_dk + 1
		SELECT @vdNh_dk = RIGHT('00' + dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(@nNh_dk), 3)

	END
	CLOSE cusTran
	DEALLOCATE cusTran

	-- Khai bao ma phi, bo phan cho tai khoan
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	-- Delete
	DELETE #gl WHERE ps_no_nt = 0 AND ps_no = 0 AND ps_co_nt = 0 AND ps_co = 0

	-- Insert into ct00
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	-- Insert into r00
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'INSERT INTO r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' SELECT * FROM #gl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Insert into #ct00
	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ' + @managementObjectField1 + ', ' + @managementObjectField2 + ', ' + @managementObjectField3 + ', ma_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt from #gl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$ShiftScheduleByDay$CopyRow]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DepartmentRef VARCHAR(128),
	@EmployeeList VARCHAR(8000),
	@SourceEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @EmployeeID VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
	DECLARE @Partition NVARCHAR(4000), @t NVARCHAR(32), @c NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @lastDateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @day INT, @day2 INT

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @DateFrom >= ngay_gh1 AND @DateTo <= ngay_gh2) RETURN
	
	SELECT @EmployeeID = '', @q = '', @Key = ''

	IF @EmployeeList <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @EmployeeList = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmployeeList), ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''')
		SELECT @Key = 'e.ma_nv in(''' + @EmployeeList + ''')'
	END
	IF @Type = 0 SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.status <> ''1'''
	SELECT @EmployeeID = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @SourceEmployee

	IF DATEDIFF(DAY,@DateFrom, @DateTo) > 39 SELECT @DateTo = DATEADD(DAY, 39, @DateFrom)
	SELECT @lastDateFrom = DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m, 0, @DateFrom) + 1,0))
	IF @lastDateFrom > @DateTo SELECT @lastDateFrom = @DateTo
	SELECT @d1 = @DateFrom, @day = DAY(@DateFrom), @i = 1, @q = '', @Partition = ''
	WHILE CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d1, 112) <= CONVERT(CHAR(6), @DateTo, 112)  BEGIN
		IF @d1 > @lastDateFrom SELECT @lastDateFrom = @DateTo
		SELECT @day2 = DAY(@lastDateFrom), @c = '', @t = ''
		WHILE @day <= @day2 BEGIN
			SELECT @t = 'n' + REPLACE(STR(@day, 2), ' ', 0)
			SELECT @c = @c + + @t + ' = b.' + @t + ','
			SELECT @day = @day + 1, @i = @i + 1
		END

		SELECT @c = RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@c, 1, LEN(@c) - 1))
		SELECT @Partition = 'hrca$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d1, 112)
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @Partition + ' set ' + @c + ', ngay_dk = b.ngay_dk, status = b.status, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from ' + @Partition + ' a join hrnv e on a.stt_rec_nv = e.stt_rec, (select * from ' + @Partition + ' where stt_rec_nv = ''' + REPLACE(@EmployeeID, '''', '''''') + ''') b' + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'where e.bp_ref like ''' + REPLACE(@DepartmentRef, '''', '''''') + '%''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Key
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @d1 = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d1), @day = 1
	END
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetDOP (@cP CHAR(2), @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @nP INT, @nType TINYINT)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @dRet SMALLDATETIME, @nYNow INT, @nPNow INT, @nYd INT, @nPd INT, @i INT, @iP INT, @pMax INT, @isExit BIT
	SELECT @nYNow = ISNULL(nam, 0), @nPNow = ISNULL(ky, 0) FROM mctdmky WHERE ma_ky = @cP AND (@dNow BETWEEN ngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2)
	SELECT @nYNow = ISNULL(@nYNow, 0), @nPNow = ISNULL(@nPNow, 0)
	SELECT @nP = @nP + @nPNow

	SELECT @i = @nYNow, @iP = @nP, @isExit = 0
	WHILE @isExit = 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mctdmky WHERE ma_ky = @cP AND nam = @i)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @pMax = MAX(ky) FROM mctdmky WHERE ma_ky = @cP AND nam = @i
					SELECT @pMax = ISNULL(@pMax, 0)
					IF @iP <= @pMax
						SELECT @nYd = @i, @nPd = @iP, @isExit = 1
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SELECT @i = @i + 1, @iP = @iP - @pMax
						END
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nYd = @i - 1
					SELECT @pMax = MAX(ky) FROM mctdmky WHERE ma_ky = @cP AND nam = @i - 1
					SELECT @pMax = ISNULL(@pMax, 0)
					SELECT @nPd =  @pMax, @isExit = 1
				END	
			
		END

	SELECT @dRet = CASE WHEN @nType = 0 THEN ngay_ct1 ELSE ngay_ct2 END FROM mctdmky WHERE ma_ky = @cP AND nam = @nYd AND ky = @nPd

	IF @dRet IS NULL SELECT @dRet = @dNow
	RETURN @dRet
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI105] -- Phân tích chi phí theo yếu tố
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@UOM VARCHAR(10),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @strSQL AS NVARCHAR(4000), @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER
	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @DebitAccount = REPLACE(@DebitAccount, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)
	
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -14, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '006'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '007'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '008'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '009'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '010'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '011'  
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '012' 
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '013'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '014'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, tk, ps_co, ps_no INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, tk, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no) as ps_no'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @tkdt + ''') = 0 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@DebitAccount) + ''') = 1]%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ngay_ct, tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin		 

	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.tk, SUM(a.ps_no - a.ps_co) AS chi_phi INTO #ct00 FROM #tmp a GROUP BY a.ngay_ct, a.tk
	SELECT tk, ISNULL(CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_ngan) <> '' THEN ten_ngan ELSE ten_tk END ELSE CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_ngan2) <> '' THEN ten_ngan2 ELSE ten_tk2 END END, '') AS ten_tk
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS chi_phi INTO #bi5  FROM dmtk WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @DebitAccount) = 1
		
	DECLARE @select AS NVARCHAR(1000), @end AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @select = 'select tk, sum(chi_phi)/' + CAST(@UOM AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' as chi_phi into #result from #ct00 '
	SET @end = ' group by tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' declare @tk as nvarchar(16)'
	SET @end = @end + ' declare db_cursor cursor for select tk from #bi5'
	SET @end = @end + ' open db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' fetch next from db_cursor into @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' while @@fetch_status = 0  '
	SET @end = @end + ' begin  '
	SET @end = @end + ' update #bi5 set chi_phi = (select sum(chi_phi) from #result where dbo.ff_inlist(tk, @tk) = 1) where tk = @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' fetch next from db_cursor into @tk'
	SET @end = @end + ' end'
	SET @end = @end + ' close db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' deallocate db_cursor'
	SET @end = @end + ' drop table #ct00, #result'
	SET @end = @end + ' select * into #re from #bi5 where chi_phi > 0; declare @sum as numeric(28, 6); select @sum = (select sum(chi_phi) from #re)'
	SET @end = @end + ' select tk, ten_tk, (100 * chi_phi / @sum) as chi_phi from #re'

	DECLARE @week AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SELECT @week =  'declare @GetDate as smalldatetime; set @GetDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) + ''''

	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @strSQL = @week + char(13) + @select + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = datepart(wk, @GetDate) and year(ngay_ct) = year(@GetDate)' + @end
	ELSE
		IF @TimeID = '004'
			SELECT @strSQL = @week + char(13) + @select + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then 53 else (datepart(wk, @GetDate) - 1) end and year(ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then (year(@GetDate) - 1) else year(@GetDate) end' + @end
		ELSE
			SET @strSQL = @select + @end
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpForeignLanguage]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Gender VARCHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Foreign VARCHAR(33),
	@Certificate VARCHAR(33),
	@DFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
