	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)	
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
		
	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(ma_nn VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), diem NVARCHAR(128), bang_cap VARCHAR(32), ngay_cap SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'is not null' ELSE 'is null' END
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ma_nn <> '''''
	IF @Foreign <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ma_nn like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Foreign), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Certificate <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.bang_cap like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Certificate), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ngay_cap$ >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ngay_cap$ <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
		
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'
	
	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (ma_nn, stt_rec, ma_nv, diem, bang_cap, ngay_cap) select a.ma_nn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.diem, a.bang_cap, a.ngay_cap_bang from hrnv a with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%a', 'a'), '$', '_bang')
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #report (ma_nn, stt_rec, ma_nv, diem, bang_cap, ngay_cap) select r.ma_nn, r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, r.diem, r.bang_cap, r.ngay_cap from hrenn r join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec ' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) +  ' where r.stt_rec + r.ma_nn + r.bang_cap not in (select stt_rec + ma_nn + bang_cap from #report) and (' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%a', 'r'), '$', '') + ')'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	CREATE TABLE #result(ma_nn VARCHAR(48), ma_nn0 VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), diem NVARCHAR(128), bang_cap VARCHAR(32), ngay_cap SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #result(ma_nn, ma_nn0, stt_rec, ma_nv, diem, bang_cap, ngay_cap)
		SELECT STR(b.stt, 16) + a.ma_nn, a.ma_nn, stt_rec, ma_nv, diem, bang_cap, ngay_cap FROM (
			SELECT ma_nn, stt_rec, ma_nv, diem, bang_cap, ngay_cap FROM #report
			UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ma_nn, '', '', '', '', NULL FROM #report
		) a JOIN hrdmnn b ON a.ma_nn = b.ma_nn ORDER BY b.stt, a.ma_nn, a.ma_nv

	SELECT stt, ma_nn INTO #order FROM #result WHERE ma_nv = ''

	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt - o.stt as stt, a.ma_nn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.diem, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.ma_nv = '''' then f.ten_nn%l else rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) end as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao, e.bo_phan, e.tinh_trang_nv, e.vi_tri, a.bang_cap, a.ngay_cap, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as ten_vi_tri, f.ten_nn%l as ten_nn, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' when e.gioi_tinh = ''2'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' else '''' end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #result a join #order o on a.ma_nn = o.ma_nn left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrdmnn f on a.ma_nn0 = f.ma_nn order by a.ma_nn, a.ma_nv'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION hf_GetUpdateOrderE(
	@cKeyFields VARCHAR(128), 
	@cTypeFields VARCHAR(128), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@cField VARCHAR(16), 
	@cOrder VARCHAR(128)
	)
RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQL VARCHAR(8000), @strList VARCHAR(128), @strType VARCHAR(128), @cCode VARCHAR(16), @cType VARCHAR(16), @nStart SMALLINT, @strKey VARCHAR(128), @strVar VARCHAR(128), @nStartE TINYINT
	SELECT @strList = @cKeyFields + ',', @strType = @cTypeFields + ',', @strKey = '', @strVar = '', @nStart = 1, @nStartE = 1
	SET @strSQL = 'DECLARE crOrder CURSOR FOR SELECT ' +  @cKeyFields + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' ORDER BY ' + @cOrder
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @i INT'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @cCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
		SET @cType = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strType, @nStartE, CHARINDEX(',', @strType,  @nStartE) - @nStartE)))
		IF @cType = '#'
			SELECT @cType = 'CHAR(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(dbo.ff_GetDataLength(@cCode)))) + ')'
		IF @cType LIKE '&%'
			SELECT @cType = 'CHAR(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(dbo.ff_GetDataLength(REPLACE(@cType, '&', ''))))) + ')'

		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @' + @cCode + ' ' + @cType
		IF @nStart = 1 SET @strKey = @strKey + @cCode + ' = @'  + @cCode  ELSE SET @strKey = @strKey + ' AND ' + @cCode + ' = @'  + @cCode
		IF @nStart = 1 SET @strVar = @strVar +  '@'  + @cCode ELSE SET @strVar = @strVar + ', @'  + @cCode
		SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		SET @nStartE = CHARINDEX(',', @strType,  @nStartE) + 1
	END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'OPEN crOrder'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'FETCH NEXT FROM crOrder INTO ' + @strVar
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = 0'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'BEGIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = @i + 1'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cField + ' = @i WHERE ' + @strKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'FETCH NEXT FROM crOrder INTO ' + @strVar
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'END'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'CLOSE crOrder'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'DEALLOCATE crOrder'
	RETURN @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetUnitRightListDel](@nUserID INT)  
RETURNS VARCHAR(1023)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = ISNULL(@cUnits, '') + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + ',' FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @nUserID AND r_del = 1
	IF RTRIM(ISNULL(@cUnits, '')) <> ''	SET @cUnits = LEFT(@cUnits, LEN(@cUnits) - 1)

	RETURN @cUnits
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostPRAuthorize]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32),
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @commentApproval = REPLACE(@commentApproval, '''', '''''')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(33), @UStatus VARCHAR(33), @RecordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(33), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @lastApproveUser INT,
		@dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(19, 3), @userID0 INT, @role VARCHAR(33), @oldStt INT, @category VARCHAR(32), @CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32), @nextUStatus VARCHAR(33), @datetime4 DATETIME
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @Status = '', @RecordHasBeenChanged = '', @lastApproveUser = 0, @oldStt = 0

	SELECT @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SELECT @MasterTable = 'm91$' + @Dyn, @DetailTable = 'd91$' + @Dyn, @InquiryTable = 'i91$' + @Dyn


	EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PR @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, @userID


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	INSERT INTO #listUser SELECT a.stt, a.user_id4 FROM a91$000000 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(stt) AS stt FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id4 <> @userID GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt AND a.xtype = '1'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastApproveUser = user_id, @oldStt = stt FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC

	DECLARE @notCheckStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = '9'
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = @notCheckStatus + ',' + status from dmctduyet WHERE ma_ct = 'PR1'

	-- Get old status
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype, @datetime4 = datetime4 FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	IF @lastUserID = @userID AND @xtype = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(33), u_status0 VARCHAR(32), dept_id VARCHAR(32), ma_nt VARCHAR(32), t_tien_nt NUMERIC(19, 2), user_id0 INT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, u_status0, dept_id, ma_nt, t_tien_nt, user_id0, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and (datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @datetime4, 121) + ''' or status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@notCheckStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @nextUStatus = u_status, @UStatus = u_status0, @dept = dept_id, @FC = ma_nt, @amount = t_tien_nt, @userID0 = user_id0, @category = kieu_duyet FROM #role
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalRole '1', 'PR1', @lastUserID, @dept, @FC, @amount, @UStatus, @language, @category, @CategoryApprove OUTPUT, @role OUTPUT
	END

	--
	IF @UStatus IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @Status = '0'
	SELECT @Status = s_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE u_status = @UStatus AND loai_duyet = '1'

	-- Update
	IF @oldStt <> 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM e91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND stt = @oldStt) BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update ' + @DetailTable + ' set sl_duyet = b.sl_duyet, xstatus = b.xstatus from ' + @DetailTable + ' a left join e91$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
			SET @q = @q + ' where b.stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and b.stt = ' + RTRIM(@oldStt) + ''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update ' + @DetailTable + ' set sl_duyet = 0, xstatus = '''''
		SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' set t_duyet = (select count(1) from ' + @DetailTable + ' where xstatus = ''2'' and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', t_huy = (select count(1) from ' + @DetailTable + ' where xstatus = ''1'' and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status = ''' + @UStatus + ''', u_status0 = '''', xtag2 = '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@lastApproveUser) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' +  @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c91$000000 set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- History Approve
	DECLARE @stt INT
	SELECT @stt = 0
	SELECT @stt = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) + 1 FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	SET @q = 'insert into a91$000000(stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset, comment)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ''' + RTRIM(@stt) + ''', status, u_status, ''2'', user_id2, datetime2, 0, N''' + @commentApproval + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @masterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- History Detail Approve
	DECLARE @td INT
	SET @td = 0
	SELECT @td = b.stt FROM e91$000000 a JOIN a91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt WHERE a.stt_rec = @idNumber AND b.user_id4 = @userID

	SET @q = 'delete e91$000000'
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt = ' + RTRIM(@td)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	DECLARE @minReset INT
	SET @minReset = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND u_status = @nextUStatus and (user_id4 = 0 OR user_id4 = @userID)) BEGIN
			SELECT @minReset = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) FROM a91$000000
				WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
					AND u_status = @nextUStatus
					AND stt < @stt - 1
					AND stt in (SELECT a.stt FROM a91$000000 a
						JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(stt) AS stt FROM a91$000000 WHERE reset = 0 AND stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt AND a.xtype = '1')
			UPDATE a91$000000 SET reset = reset - 1 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND stt > @minReset AND stt < @stt
		END

	-- Mail
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND notify_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @lastApproveUser = 0
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = '1' AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND created_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @userID0 = 0

	DECLARE @useNotify CHAR(1)
	SET @q = 'select @r = status from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifygroup where code = ''02'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(1) out', @useNotify OUT

	IF @useNotify = '0' BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS message
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @MasterTable, '1', 'PR2', @sysDatabaseName, @lastApproveUser, 1, @userID0
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @notifyCode VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000)
		CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
		INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @MasterTable, '1', 'PR2', @sysDatabaseName, @lastApproveUser, 1, @userID0

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail) BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #notifyContent(title NVARCHAR(128), title2 NVARCHAR(128), content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT, ref_code VARCHAR(32), s1 VARCHAR(32), e$ NVARCHAR(4000), [type] TINYINT, popup_title NVARCHAR(1024), popup_title2 NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content2 NVARCHAR(1024))
			EXEC rs_CreateNotifyPRTran @idNumber, @MasterTable, @DetailTable, '#notifyContent'

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 2) BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '02', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
					'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 0',
					null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 2', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

				SET @q = 'update ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser set s1 = ma_nhan, s2 = ma_huy from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser a join dmxn b on a.user_id = b.user_id where a.code = @notifyCode and b.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@notifyCode varchar(32), @stt_rec char(13)', @notifyCode, @idNumber

				IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
				IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
			END
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 1) BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '12', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
					'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 12',
					null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 1', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

				IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
				IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
			END
		END

		IF @invoke IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT '' AS message
		END
		SELECT * FROM #mail

	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostTSRequisitionClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @MasterTable = 'hrccyccp'
	SET @DetailTable = 'hrccctyccp'
	SET @InquiryTable = 'hriccyccp'
	SET @HisTable = 'hraccyccp'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM hraccyccp WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	--

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''3'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2Summary]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@type VARCHAR(32),
	@dept VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@group VARCHAR(254),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @xGroup VARCHAR(254), @xDetail VARCHAR(254), @total NVARCHAR(511), @total2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @iColname VARCHAR(32), @iColdatatype VARCHAR(32), @iReftable VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldcode VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname2 VARCHAR(32)

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k NVARCHAR(4000)

	CREATE TABLE #tblColumn (colname VARCHAR(32), coldatatype VARCHAR(32), reftable VARCHAR(32), reffieldcode VARCHAR(32), reffieldname VARCHAR(32), reffieldname2 VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'ma_dc', 'VARCHAR(32)', 'dmccdc', 'ma_dc', 'ten_dc', 'ten_dc2'
	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'loai_dc', 'VARCHAR(32)', 'dmplcc', 'ma_loai', 'ten_loai', 'ten_loai2'
	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'fx_ma_bp', 'VARCHAR(32)', 'dmbpcc', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp', 'ten_bp2'

	SELECT @total = cname, @total2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dc, b.loai_dc, a.ma_bp_dc AS fx_ma_bp
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_cl, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl_nt
		INTO #dt FROM ctcddc a, dmccdc b
	-- Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	-- Key
	SET @key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year)
	IF @type <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@type, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @dept <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@dept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #dt select a.ma_dc, b.loai_dc, a.ma_bp_dc'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_cl, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctcddc a with(nolock) join dmccdc b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @k = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('''%f''', 'notexactinlist', @group), @q = ''
	IF @k IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q = '' THEN '' ELSE CHAR(13) END + 'update #dt set ' + colname + ' = '''' where ' + REPLACE(@k, '%f', colname) FROM #tblColumn
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT 1 AS igroup, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ma_dc, loai_dc, fx_ma_bp
			, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl
			, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_pb_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_dt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_dt2, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
		INTO #report
		FROM #dt GROUP BY ma_dc, loai_dc, fx_ma_bp

	DELETE #report WHERE nguyen_gia = 0 AND nguyen_gia_nt = 0 AND gt_da_pb = 0 AND gt_da_pb_nt = 0

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'igroup, stt, ma_dc, loai_dc, fx_ma_bp', 'int, int, varchar(32), varchar(32), varchar(32)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @xDetail = @group
	IF dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@xDetail) > 1 SET @xDetail = LTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@xDetail, dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@xDetail)))

	SELECT @iColname = colname, @iColdatatype = coldatatype, @iReftable = reftable, @iReffieldcode = reffieldcode, @iReffieldname = reffieldname, @iReffieldname2 = reffieldname2
		FROM #tblColumn WHERE colname = @xDetail

	SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET ten_dt = b.' + @iReffieldname + ', ten_dt2 = b.' + @iReffieldname2 + ' FROM #report a LEFT JOIN ' + @iReftable + ' b ON a.' + @iColname + ' = b.' + @iReffieldcode
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @xGroup = RTRIM(@group)
	IF dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@xGroup) > 1	SELECT @xGroup = LEFT(@xGroup, LEN(@xGroup) - CHARINDEX(',', REVERSE(@xGroup)))
	ELSE SET @xGroup = ''

	-- Order
	IF @xGroup <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @o = @xGroup + ',' + @xDetail

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @xGroup, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@xGroup, 'dt', 'nguyen_gia, gt_da_pb, gt_cl, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @xDetail, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	UPDATE #report SET igroup = 2
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 0, 5, 0, 0, '', '', ''
				, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(gt_da_pb), SUM(gt_cl)
				, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_pb_nt), SUM(gt_cl_nt)
				, @total, @total2, NULL
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report(igroup, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 5, 0, 0)

	IF @xGroup <> '' SET @q = 'select * from  #report order by igroup, '  + @xGroup + ',sysorder, stt' + CASE WHEN @xDetail <> @xGroup THEN ', ' + @xDetail ELSE '' END
		ELSE SET @q = 'select * from  #report order by igroup, sysorder, stt, ' + @xDetail

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInterpretationFinancial] --fs30_FinanceLecture
	@DatePFrom SMALLDATETIME
	, @DatePTo SMALLDATETIME
	, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	, @Type VARCHAR(2) --10 - browse chi tieu don, 20 - dang cot, 3 - tang giam
	, @Unit VARCHAR(1023)
	, @Form CHAR(16)
	, @Language CHAR(1)
	, @UserID INT
	, @Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @strsql_bal_update NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ky1_0 CHAR(1), @No_co CHAR(1), @Dau_cuoi CHAR(1), @Cong_tru CHAR(1), @Khong_am CHAR(1), @Tk VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_du VARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @Tk_0_gt VARCHAR(1023), @Phi_ct CHAR(1), @Cong_no CHAR(1), @Cong_no_ct CHAR(1), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @LimitRate NUMERIC(4, 2)
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q1 NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q3 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @iTk VARCHAR(33), @nCount INT, @i INT, @nMax INT
	DECLARE @dFY SMALLDATETIME, @dPFY SMALLDATETIME, @dBeginInputData SMALLDATETIME, @yBeginInputData INT
	DECLARE @dTmpF SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpPF SMALLDATETIME, @glTable VARCHAR(33), @glTable0 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @dFY = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateTo), @dPFY = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePTo) -- ngày đầu năm tài chính kỳ này/kỳ trước
	SELECT @yBeginInputData = nam_bd, @dBeginInputData = ngay_ky1 FROM dmstt -- năm/ngày bđ nhập liệu

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey ELSE SET @Key = ''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @strsql_bal_update = 'declare @du_no numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @strsql_bal_update = @strsql_bal_update + CHAR(13) + '
		update #bal_table set @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end
			 where %condition%'

	-- Get raw data
	-- Khai báo mẫu
	SELECT CAST(5 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(1 AS INT) AS systotal, *, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_kh), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt0
		INTO #t1 FROM v30gltctm WHERE form = @Form AND loai_ma_so = '1'
	SELECT *, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_phi), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_phi, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps01, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps02, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps03, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps04, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps05, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps06, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps07, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps08, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps09, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps10, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps11, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps12, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt01, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt02, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt03, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt04, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt05, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt06, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt07, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt08, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt09, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt10, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt11, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt12
		INTO #t2 FROM v30gltctm WHERE form = @Form AND loai_ma_so = '2'
	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_dau, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tang, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS giam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_cuoi, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_dau_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tang_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS giam_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #t3 FROM v30gltctm WHERE form = @Form AND loai_ma_so = '3'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t2', @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t3', @UserID, @Admin

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ma_vv, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #gl20 FROM wrkgl

	-- Data
	-- Arising
	SET @s = 'insert into %table select %fields, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @s = @s + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ']% group by %groupfields'
	--
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%table', '#gl1'), '%fields', 'tk, tk_du, isnull(ma_kh, ''''), isnull(ma_vv, ''''), isnull(ma_phi, '''')'), '%groupfields', 'tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_phi')

	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%table', '#gl10'), '%fields', 'tk, tk_du, isnull(ma_kh, ''''), isnull(ma_vv, ''''), isnull(ma_phi, '''')'), '%groupfields', 'tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_phi')

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dPFY, @DatePTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Balance
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #tmpBalAcc FROM #BgCusts
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #tmpBalCus FROM #BgCusts
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_vv, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #tmpBalJob FROM #BgCusts
	--
	SET @s = 'truncate table %tmptable'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'insert into %tmptable select %fields, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt from %bgtable'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'insert into %tmptable select %fields, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from %gltable group by %fields'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'insert into %table (%fields, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt) select %fields, %sumfields from %tmptable group by %fields'
	--
	SET @q1 = 'sum(du_no), sum(du_co), sum(du_no_nt), sum(du_co_nt)'
	SET @q2 = 'case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ', case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ', case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end'

	-- Số dư tài khoản
	IF @dFY < @dBeginInputData SELECT @dTmpF = @dateFrom, @glTable = '#gl1' ELSE SELECT @dTmpF = @dFY, @glTable = '#gl2'
	IF @dPFY < @dBeginInputData SELECT @dTmpPF = @datePFrom, @glTable0 = '#gl10' ELSE SELECT @dTmpPF = @dPFY, @glTable0 = '#gl20'

	INSERT INTO #BgAccount EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dTmpF, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key
	INSERT INTO #BgAccount0 EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dTmpPF, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key
	--
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%fields', 'tk'), '%bgtable', '#BgAccount'), '%gltable', RTRIM(@glTable)), '%table', '#EdAccount'), '%tmptable', '#tmpBalAcc'), '%sumfields', @q1)
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%fields', 'tk'), '%bgtable', '#BgAccount0'), '%gltable', RTRIM(@glTable0)), '%table', '#EdAccount0'), '%tmptable', '#tmpBalAcc'), '%sumfields', @q1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Số dư chi tiết theo khách hàng
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND cong_no = '1' AND cong_no_ct = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #BgCusts EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dTmpF, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key
		INSERT INTO #BgCusts0 EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dTmpPF, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND cong_no = '1' AND cong_no_ct = '1' AND dau_cuoi = 2) BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%fields', 'tk, ma_kh'), '%bgtable', '#BgCusts'), '%gltable', RTRIM(@glTable)), '%table', '#EdCusts'), '%tmptable', '#tmpBalCus'), '%sumfields', @q2)
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%fields', 'tk, ma_kh'), '%bgtable', '#BgCusts0'), '%gltable', RTRIM(@glTable0)), '%table', '#EdCusts0'), '%tmptable', '#tmpBalCus'), '%sumfields', @q2)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Số dư chi tiết theo vụ việc
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND vv_ct = '1') BEGIN

	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND vv_ct = '1' AND dau_cuoi = 2) BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%fields', 'tk, ma_vv'), '%bgtable', '#BgJob'), '%gltable', RTRIM(@glTable)), '%table', '#EdJob'), '%tmptable', '#tmpBalJob'), '%sumfields', @q2)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Get Balance Fiscal Year
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #BFYAccount FROM #BgAccount
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #BFYCusts FROM #BgCusts

	SET @q = 'insert into #BFYAccount select tk, sum(isnull(du_no1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_co1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_no_nt1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_co_nt1, 0))'
	SET @q = @q + 'from cdtk with(index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@yBeginInputData) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ' group by tk'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #BFYCusts select tk, ma_kh, sum(isnull(du_no1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_co1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_no_nt1, 0)), sum(isnull(du_co_nt1, 0))'
	SET @q = @q + 'from cdkh with(index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@yBeginInputData) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ' group by tk, ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Report
	-- 1
	DECLARE @xKey1 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey2 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey3 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKeyTmp NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey1Ref NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey2Ref NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey3Ref NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT TOP 0 ps_no AS ps, ps_no AS ps0, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt0 INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT 0, 0, 0, 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), kind, no_co, dau_cuoi, khong_am, REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_du, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_0_gt, '''', ''), cong_no FROM #t1 WHERE kind IN ('1', '2') --AND (cong_no_ct = '' OR cong_no_ct = '0')
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Kind, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #tmp SET ps = 0, ps0 = 0, ps_nt = 0, ps_nt0 = 0

		IF @kind = '2' BEGIN -- Arising
			SELECT @xKey1 = '(1 = 1)', @xKey2 = '(1 = 1)', @xKey3 = '(1 = 1)'
			IF @Tk <> '' BEGIN
				SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk)
				SET @xKey2 = @xKey1
				SET @xKey3 = @xKey1
			END
			IF @Tk_du <> '' SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du)
			SET @xKey2 = @xKey2 + CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END
			SET @xKey3 = @xKey3 + CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @Tk_0_gt) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END

			SET @q = 'update #tmp set ps = a.ps, ps_nt = a.ps_nt from (select sum(ps) as ps, sum(ps_nt) as ps_nt'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ('
			SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no as ps, ps_no_nt as ps_nt' ELSE 'ps_co as ps, ps_co_nt as ps_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl1 where ' + @xKey1
			SET @q = @q + ' union all'
			SET @q = @q + ' select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN '- ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE '- ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl1 where ' + @xKey2
			SET @q = @q + ' union all'
			SET @q = @q + ' select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN '- ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE '- ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl1 where ' + @xKey3
			SET @q = @q + ') a) a'

			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps0 = a.ps, ps_nt0 = a.ps_nt from (select sum(ps) as ps, sum(ps_nt) as ps_nt'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ('
			SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no as ps, ps_no_nt as ps_nt' ELSE 'ps_co as ps, ps_co_nt as ps_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl10 where ' + @xKey1
			SET @q = @q + ' union all'
			SET @q = @q + ' select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN '- ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE '- ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl10 where ' + @xKey2
			SET @q = @q + ' union all'
			SET @q = @q + ' select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN '- ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE '- ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from #gl10 where ' + @xKey3
			SET @q = @q + ') a) a'
		END

		IF @kind <> '2' -- Balance
			SET @xKey1 = CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '1 = 0' END

		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 1 BEGIN
			IF @dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #tmp set ps = a.ps, ps_nt = a.ps_nt from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no) as ps, sum(du_no_nt) as ps_nt' ELSE 'sum(du_co) as ps, sum(du_co_nt) as ps_nt' END
				SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgCusts' END + ' where ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #tmp set ps = a.ps, ps_nt = a.ps_nt from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no) as ps, sum(du_no_nt) as ps_nt' ELSE 'sum(du_co) as ps, sum(du_co_nt) as ps_nt' END
				SET @q = @q + ' from #EdCusts where ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
			END

			-- Luôn lấy số dư đầu năm tài chính cho trường "Đầu năm" (không theo khai báo mẫu)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps0 = a.ps, ps_nt0 = a.ps_nt from ('
			SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no) as ps, sum(du_no_nt) as ps_nt' ELSE 'sum(du_co) as ps, sum(du_co_nt) as ps_nt' END
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgCusts' END + ' where ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
		END

		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 0 BEGIN
			IF @dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #tmp set ps = a.ps from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no - du_co)' ELSE 'sum(du_co - du_no)' END + ' as ps'
				SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END + ' where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no - du_co > 0' ELSE 'du_co - du_no > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps_nt = a.ps_nt from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt)' END + ' as ps_nt'
				SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END + ' where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no_nt - du_co_nt > 0' ELSE 'du_co_nt - du_no_nt > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #tmp set ps = a.ps from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no - du_co)' ELSE 'sum(du_co - du_no)' END + ' as ps'
				SET @q = @q + ' from #EdAccount where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no - du_co > 0' ELSE 'du_co - du_no > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps_nt = a.ps_nt from ('
				SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt)' END + ' as ps_nt'
				SET @q = @q + ' from #EdAccount where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no_nt - du_co_nt > 0' ELSE 'du_co_nt - du_no_nt > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
			END

			--  Luôn lấy số dư đầu năm tài chính cho trường "Đầu năm" (không theo khai báo mẫu)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps0 = a.ps from ('
			SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no - du_co)' ELSE 'sum(du_co - du_no)' END + ' as ps'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END
			SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no - du_co > 0' ELSE 'du_co - du_no > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tmp set ps_nt0 = a.ps_nt from ('
			SET @q = @q + 'select ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt)' END + ' as ps_nt'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END
			SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @xKey1 + CASE WHEN @Khong_am <> '0' THEN ' and ' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN 'du_no_nt - du_co_nt > 0' ELSE 'du_co_nt - du_no_nt > 0' END ELSE '' END + ') a'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #t1 SET ps = a.ps, ps0 = a.ps0, ps_nt = a.ps_nt, ps_nt0 = a.ps_nt0 FROM #t1, #tmp a WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Kind, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	--
	UPDATE #t1 SET ma_kh = ''

	-- TT200
	DECLARE @Ps NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- Chi tiết theo khách hàng
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_kh, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0 INTO #t1_0 FROM #t1
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), no_co, dau_cuoi, REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), tl_gh, ISNULL(ps, 0) AS ps, ISNULL(ps0, 0) AS ps0, ISNULL(ps_nt, 0) AS ps_nt, ISNULL(ps_nt0, 0) AS ps_nt0
		FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND cong_no = '1' AND cong_no_ct = '1' AND vv_ct = '0' AND phi_ct = '0'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Dau_cuoi = '1' BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc; TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc0
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT * FROM #BgCusts' + CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN ' WHERE ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #tCalc SET tk = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_InList2(tk, @Tk))
			INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc GROUP BY tk, ma_kh

			SET @strsql = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strsql_bal_update, '#bal_table', '#tCalc0'), '%condition%', '1=1')
			EXEC sp_executesql @strsql

			INSERT INTO #t1_0 SELECT @Ma_so, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tCalc0 a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t1_0 b WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ma_so)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Ma_so)) AND b.ma_kh = a.ma_kh)
			UPDATE #t1_0 SET ps = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no ELSE b.du_co END, ps_nt = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no_nt ELSE b.du_co_nt END
				FROM #t1_0 a JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_so = @Ma_so AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		END ELSE BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc; TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc0
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT * FROM #EdCusts' + CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN ' WHERE ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #tCalc SET tk = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_InList2(tk, @Tk))
			INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc GROUP BY tk, ma_kh

			SET @strsql = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strsql_bal_update, '#bal_table', '#tCalc0'), '%condition%', '1=1')
			EXEC sp_executesql @strsql

			INSERT INTO #t1_0 SELECT @Ma_so, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tCalc0 a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t1_0 b WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ma_so)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Ma_so)) AND b.ma_kh = a.ma_kh) GROUP BY ma_kh
			UPDATE #t1_0 SET ps = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no ELSE b.du_co END, ps_nt = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no_nt ELSE b.du_co_nt END
				FROM #t1_0 a JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_so = @Ma_so AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		END

		--  Luôn lấy số dư đầu năm tài chính cho trường "Đầu năm" (không theo khai báo mẫu)
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc; TRUNCATE TABLE #tCalc0
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT * FROM ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYCusts' ELSE '#BgCusts' END + CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN ' WHERE ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #tCalc SET tk = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_InList2(tk, @Tk))
		INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
		SET @strsql = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strsql_bal_update, '#bal_table', '#tCalc0'), '%condition%', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strsql

		INSERT INTO #t1_0 SELECT @Ma_so, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tCalc0 a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t1_0 b WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ma_so)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Ma_so)) AND b.ma_kh = a.ma_kh)
		UPDATE #t1_0 SET ps0 = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no ELSE b.du_co END, ps_nt0 = CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN b.du_no_nt ELSE b.du_co_nt END
			FROM #t1_0 a JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_so = @Ma_so AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		DELETE #t1_0 WHERE ABS(ps) + ABS(ps0) + ABS(ps_nt) + ABS(ps_nt0) = 0

		IF @LimitRate > 0 BEGIN
			DELETE #t1_0 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ps < (@ps * @LimitRate)/100
			SELECT @Ps = @Ps - SUM(ps), @Ps_nt = @Ps_nt - SUM(ps_nt), @Ps0 = @Ps0 - SUM(ps0), @Ps_nt0 = @Ps_nt0 - SUM(ps_nt0) FROM #t1_0 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @Ps + @Ps_nt + @Ps0 + @Ps_nt0 > 0 INSERT INTO #t1_0 SELECT @Ma_so, '', @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
		END
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- TT200: Chi tiết theo công trình, vụ việc
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_so, b.ma_vv, a.ps, a.ps0, a.ps_nt, a.ps_nt0 INTO #t1_1 FROM #t1 a, wrkgl b
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), no_co, dau_cuoi, REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), tl_gh, ISNULL(ps, 0) AS ps, ISNULL(ps0, 0) AS ps0, ISNULL(ps_nt, 0) AS ps_nt, ISNULL(ps_nt0, 0) AS ps_nt0
		FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '1' AND vv_ct = '1' AND cong_no_ct = '0' AND phi_ct = '0'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #t1_1 SELECT ''' + @Ma_so + ''' AS ma_so, ISNULL(a.ma_vv, ''''), SUM(ps), SUM(ps0), SUM(ps_nt), SUM(ps_nt0) FROM'
		SET @q = @q + ' (SELECT ma_vv'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN ', du_no - du_co as ps, 0 * du_no as ps0, du_no_nt - du_co_nt as ps_nt, 0 * du_no_nt as ps_nt0' ELSE ', du_co - du_no as ps, 0 * du_co as ps0, du_co_nt - du_no_nt as ps_nt, 0 * du_co_nt as ps_nt0' END
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM %tBalJob' + CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN ' WHERE ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' UNION ALL'
		SET @q = @q + ' SELECT ma_vv'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @No_co = '1' THEN ', 0 , du_no - du_co as ps0, 0, du_no_nt - du_co_nt as ps_nt0' ELSE ', 0, du_co - du_no as ps0, 0, du_co_nt - du_no_nt as ps_nt0' END
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #BgJob' + CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN ' WHERE ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ') a GROUP BY ma_vv'

		IF @Dau_cuoi = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%tBalJob', '#BgJob') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%tBalJob', '#EdJob')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE #t1_1 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ABS(ps) + ABS(ps0) + ABS(ps_nt) + ABS(ps_nt0) = 0
		DELETE #t1_1 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ma_vv = ''

		IF @LimitRate > 0 BEGIN
			DELETE #t1_1 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ps < (@ps * @LimitRate)/100
			SELECT @Ps = @Ps - SUM(ps), @Ps_nt = @Ps_nt - SUM(ps_nt), @Ps0 = @Ps0 - SUM(ps0), @Ps_nt0 = @Ps_nt0 - SUM(ps_nt0) FROM #t1_1 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @Ps + @Ps_nt + @Ps0 + @Ps_nt0 <> 0 INSERT INTO #t1_1 SELECT @Ma_so, '', @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
		END
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- TT200: Chi tiết theo mã phí
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_so, b.ma_phi, a.ps, a.ps0, a.ps_nt, a.ps_nt0 INTO #t1_2 FROM #t1 a, wrkgl b
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_phi, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0 INTO #t1_2_tmp FROM #t1_2
	--
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), no_co, dau_cuoi, REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_du, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_0_gt, '''', ''), tl_gh, ISNULL(ps, 0) AS ps, ISNULL(ps0, 0) AS ps0, ISNULL(ps_nt, 0) AS ps_nt, ISNULL(ps_nt0, 0) AS ps_nt0
		FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '2' AND phi_ct = '1' AND cong_no_ct = '0' AND vv_ct = '0'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @xKey1 = '1 = 1', @xKey2 = '1 = 1', @xKey3 = '1 = 1'
		IF @Tk <> '' BEGIN
			SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk)
			SET @xKey2 = @xKey1
			SET @xKey3 = @xKey1
		END
		IF @Tk_du <> '' SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du)
		SET @xKey2 = @xKey2 + CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END
		SET @xKey3 = @xKey3 + CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @Tk_0_gt) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END

		TRUNCATE TABLE #t1_2_tmp
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #t1_2_tmp SELECT ma_phi, SUM(ps), 0, SUM(ps_nt), 0 FROM'
		SET @q = @q + ' (SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt' ELSE ', ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt' END + ' FROM #gl1 WHERE ' + @xKey1
		SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
		SET @q = @q + '	SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', - ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE ', - ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END + ' FROM #gl1 WHERE ' + @xKey2
		SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
		SET @q = @q + '	SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', - ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE ', - ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END + ' FROM #gl1 WHERE ' + @xKey3
		SET @q = @q + ') a GROUP BY a.ma_phi'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #t1_2_tmp SELECT ma_phi, 0, SUM(ps), 0, SUM(ps_nt) FROM'
		SET @q = @q + ' (SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt' ELSE ', ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt' END + ' FROM #gl10 WHERE ' + @xKey1
		SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
		SET @q = @q + '	SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', - ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE ', - ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END + ' FROM #gl10 WHERE ' + @xKey2
		SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
		SET @q = @q + '	SELECT ma_phi' + CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ', - ps_co, - ps_co_nt' ELSE ', - ps_no, - ps_no_nt' END + ' FROM #gl10 WHERE ' + @xKey3
		SET @q = @q + ') a GROUP BY a.ma_phi'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		INSERT INTO #t1_2 SELECT @Ma_so, ma_phi, SUM(ps), SUM(ps0), SUM(ps_nt), SUM(ps_nt0) FROM #t1_2_tmp GROUP BY ma_phi

		DELETE #t1_2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ABS(ps) + ABS(ps0) + ABS(ps_nt) + ABS(ps_nt0) = 0
		DELETE #t1_2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ma_phi = ''

		IF @LimitRate > 0 BEGIN
			DELETE #t1_2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so AND ps < (@ps * @LimitRate)/100
			SELECT @Ps = @Ps - SUM(ps), @Ps_nt = @Ps_nt - SUM(ps_nt), @Ps0 = @Ps0 - SUM(ps0), @Ps_nt0 = @Ps_nt0 - SUM(ps_nt0) FROM #t1_2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @Ps + @Ps_nt + @Ps0 + @Ps_nt0 <> 0 INSERT INTO #t1_2 SELECT @Ma_so, '', @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
		END

		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @LimitRate, @Ps, @Ps0, @Ps_nt, @Ps_nt0
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 2
	SET @q1 = 'UPDATE #tmp SET ps = a.ps, ps_nt = a.ps_nt FROM (SELECT SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' FROM ('
	SET @q1 = @q1 + 'SELECT CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END AS ps, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END AS ps_nt'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey1'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' UNION ALL'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' SELECT CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey2'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' UNION ALL'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' SELECT CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey3'
	SET @q1 = @q1 + ') a) a'
	SET @q2 = 'UPDATE #tmp SET ps = a.ps, ps_nt = a.ps_nt FROM ('
	SET @q2 = @q2 + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no ELSE du_co END) AS ps, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no_nt ELSE duc_co_nt END) AS ps_nt'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey1) a'
	SET @q3 = 'UPDATE #tmp SET ps = a.ps FROM ('
	SET @q3 = @q3 + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no - du_co ELSE du_co - du_no END) AS ps'
	SET @q3 = @q3 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey1 AND (@Khong_am = 0 OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no - du_co ELSE du_co - du_no END > 0)) a'
	SET @q3 = @q3 + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #tmp SET ps_nt = a.ps_nt FROM ('
	SET @q3 = @q3 + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no_nt - du_co_nt ELSE du_co_nt - du_no_nt END) AS ps_nt'
	SET @q3 = @q3 + ' FROM @Table WHERE @xKey1 AND (@Khong_am = 0 OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN du_no_nt - du_co_nt ELSE du_co_nt - du_no_nt END > 0)) a'

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), kind, ky1_0, no_co, dau_cuoi, khong_am, REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_du, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk_0_gt, '''', ''), cong_no FROM #t2 WHERE kind IN ('1', '2')
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Kind, @Ky1_0, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @Cong_no = 0 -- do luon = 0

		UPDATE #tmp SET ps = 0, ps0 = 0, ps_nt = 0, ps_nt0 = 0
		SELECT @nCount = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk), @i = 1
		IF @nCount > @nMax SET @nCount = @nMax

		SET @xKey1Ref = CASE WHEN @Tk_du <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du) ELSE '' END
		SET @xKey2Ref = CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '') THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @Tk_du) ELSE ' 1 = 0' END
		SET @xKey3Ref = CASE WHEN (@Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '') THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @Tk_0_gt) ELSE ' 1 = 0' END

		WHILE @i <= @nCount BEGIN
			SET @iTk = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, @i)))

			IF @kind = '2' BEGIN --Arising
				SET @xKeyTmp = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @iTk)
				SET @xKey1 = @xKeyTmp + CASE WHEN @xKey1Ref <> '' THEN ' and ' + @xKey1Ref ELSE '' END
				SET @xKey2 = @xKeyTmp + CASE WHEN @xKey2Ref <> '' THEN ' and ' + @xKey2Ref ELSE '' END
				SET @xKey3 = @xKeyTmp + CASE WHEN @xKey3Ref <> '' THEN ' and ' + @xKey3Ref ELSE '' END

				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q1, '@xKey1', @xKey1), '@xKey2', @xKey2), '@xKey3', @xKey3)
				IF @Ky1_0 = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#gl2') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#gl20')
			END

			IF @kind <> '2'-- Balance
				SET @xKey1 = CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @iTk) ELSE '1 = 0' END

			IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 1 AND @dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(@q2, '@xKey1', @xKey1)
				IF @Ky1_0 = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgCusts' END)
					ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', CASE WHEN (@dPFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgCusts0' END)
			END

			IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 1 AND @dau_cuoi = 2 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(@q2, '@xKey1', @xKey1)
				IF @Ky1_0 = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#EdCusts') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#EdCusts0')
			END

			IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 0 AND @dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q3, '@xKey1', @xKey1), '@Khong_am', RTRIM(@Khong_am))
				IF @Ky1_0 = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END)
					ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', CASE WHEN (@dPFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount0' END)
			END

			IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = 0 AND @dau_cuoi = 2 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q3, '@xKey1', @xKey1), '@Khong_am', RTRIM(@Khong_am))
				IF @Ky1_0 = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#EdAccount') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Table', '#EdAccount0')
			END

			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@no_co', RTRIM(@no_co))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #t2 SET Ps%ii = a.ps, Ps_nt%ii = a.ps_nt FROM #t2, #tmp a WHERE ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%ii', REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0'))
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Kind, @Ky1_0, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 3
	SELECT TOP 0 ps_no AS du_dau, ps_no_nt AS du_dau_nt, ps_no AS tang, ps_no_nt AS tang_nt, ps_no AS giam, ps_no_nt AS giam_nt, ps_no AS du_cuoi, ps_no_nt AS du_cuoi_nt INTO #tmp2 FROM wrkgl
	INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), no_co FROM #t3 WHERE kind IN ('1')
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk, @no_co
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #tmp2 SET du_dau = 0, du_dau_nt = 0, tang = 0, tang_nt = 0, giam = 0, giam_nt = 0, du_cuoi = 0, du_cuoi_nt = 0

		SET @xKey1 = CASE WHEN @Tk <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Tk) ELSE '1 = 0' END

		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp2 SET du_dau = a.du_dau, du_dau_nt = a.du_dau_nt FROM ('
		SET @q = @q + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN (du_no - du_co) ELSE (du_co - du_no) END) AS du_dau'
		SET @q = @q + ', SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN (du_no_nt - du_co_nt) ELSE (du_co_nt - du_no_nt) END) AS du_dau_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM ' + CASE WHEN (@dFY < @dBeginInputData) THEN '#BFYAccount' ELSE '#BgAccount' END + ' WHERE ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@no_co', RTRIM(@no_co))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp2 SET tang = a.tang, tang_nt = a.tang_nt, giam = a.giam, giam_nt = a.giam_nt FROM ('
		SET @q = @q + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END) AS tang, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END) AS tang_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co <> 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END) AS giam, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co <> 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END) AS giam_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #gl2 WHERE ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@no_co', RTRIM(@no_co))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp2 SET du_cuoi = a.du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt = a.du_cuoi_nt FROM ('
		SET @q = @q + 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN (du_no - du_co) ELSE (du_co - du_no) END) AS du_cuoi'
		SET @q = @q + ', SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN (du_no_nt - du_co_nt) ELSE (du_co_nt - du_no_nt) END) AS du_cuoi_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #EdAccount WHERE ' + @xKey1 + ') a'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@no_co', RTRIM(@no_co))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #t3 SET du_dau = a.du_dau, du_dau_nt = a.du_dau_nt, tang = a.tang, tang_nt = a.tang_nt, giam = a.giam, giam_nt = a.giam_nt, du_cuoi = a.du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt = a.du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #t3, #tmp2 a WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk, @no_co
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 1
	UPDATE #t1 SET ps = ISNULL(ps, 0), ps_nt = ISNULL(ps_nt, 0), ps0 = ISNULL(ps0, 0), ps_nt0 = ISNULL(ps_nt0, 0)

	-- 2
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @nMax BEGIN
		SET @strSql = 'update #t2 set psXX = isnull(psXX, 0), ps_ntXX = isnull(ps_ntXX, 0)'
		SET @strSql = REPLACE(@strSql, 'XX', REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0'))
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	-- 3
	UPDATE #t3 SET du_dau = ISNULL(du_dau, 0), du_dau_nt = ISNULL(du_dau_nt, 0)
		, tang = ISNULL(tang, 0), tang_nt = ISNULL(tang_nt, 0)
		, giam = ISNULL(giam, 0), giam_nt = ISNULL(giam_nt, 0)
		, du_cuoi = ISNULL(du_cuoi, 0), du_cuoi_nt = ISNULL(du_cuoi_nt, 0)

	-- Update cong tru
	UPDATE #t1 SET ps = -1 * ps, ps0 = -1 * ps0, ps_nt = -1 * ps_nt, ps_nt0 = -1 * ps_nt0 WHERE cong_tru = '2'
	UPDATE #t2 SET ps01 = -1 * ps01, ps02 = -1 * ps02, ps03 = -1 * ps03, ps04 = -1 * ps04, ps05 = -1 * ps05, ps06 = -1 * ps06, ps07 = -1 * ps07, ps08 = -1 * ps08, ps09 = -1 * ps09, ps_nt01 = -1 * ps_nt01, ps_nt02 = -1 * ps_nt02, ps_nt03 = -1 * ps_nt03, ps_nt04 = -1 * ps_nt04, ps_nt05 = -1 * ps_nt05, ps_nt06 = -1 * ps_nt06, ps_nt07 = -1 * ps_nt07, ps_nt08 = -1 * ps_nt08, ps_nt09 = -1 * ps_nt09 WHERE cong_tru = '2'
	UPDATE #t3 SET du_dau = -1 * du_dau, du_dau_nt = -1 * du_dau_nt, tang = -1 * tang, tang_nt = -1 * tang_nt, giam = -1 * giam, giam_nt = -1 * giam_nt, du_cuoi = -1 * du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt = -1 * du_cuoi_nt WHERE cong_tru = '2'

	-- 1
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(Ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(Cach_tinh, '''', '') FROM #t1 WHERE kind = '0' AND ISNULL(cach_tinh, '') <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t1 SET ps = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(ps) FROM #t1 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t1 SET ps0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(ps0) FROM #t1 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t1 SET ps_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(ps_nt) FROM #t1 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t1 SET ps_nt0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(ps_nt0) FROM #t1 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 2
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(Ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(Cach_tinh, '''', '') FROM #t2 WHERE kind = '0' AND ISNULL(cach_tinh, '') <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @nMax BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t2 SET psXX = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(psXX) FROM #t2 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = @strSql + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #t2 SET ps_ntXX = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(ps_ntXX) FROM #t2 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = REPLACE(@strSql, 'XX', REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0'))
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 3
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(Ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(Cach_tinh, '''', '') FROM #t3 WHERE kind = '0' AND ISNULL(cach_tinh, '') <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET du_dau = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(du_dau) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET du_dau_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(du_dau_nt) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET tang = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(tang) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET tang_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(tang_nt) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET giam = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(giam) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET giam_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(giam_nt) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET du_cuoi = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(du_cuoi) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

		SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #t3 SET du_cuoi_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(du_cuoi_nt) FROM #t3 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh

	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	--
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(1024), @s12 NVARCHAR(1024)
	SElECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT050'

	INSERT INTO #t1 (sysorder, systotal, form, stt, ma_so, loai_ma_so, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, kind, ky1_0, no_co, dau_cuoi, cong_tru, khong_am, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt, cong_no, cong_no_ct, vv_ct, phi_ct, cach_tinh, tl_gh, ids, iscal, ma_kh, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0)
		SELECT CASE WHEN c.ten_kh IS NULL OR c.ten_kh2 IS NULL THEN 9 ELSE 8 END, 0, a.form, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.loai_ma_so, SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_kh, @s1), SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_kh2, @s12), a.kind, a.ky1_0, a.no_co, a.dau_cuoi, a.cong_tru, a.khong_am
				, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.tk_0_gt, a.cong_no, a.cong_no_ct, a.vv_ct, a.phi_ct, a.cach_tinh, a.tl_gh, a.ids, a.iscal, b.ma_kh
				, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps ELSE b.ps END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps0 ELSE b.ps0 END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt ELSE b.ps_nt END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt0 ELSE b.ps_nt0 END
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #t1_0 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON b.ma_kh = c.ma_kh
			WHERE a.kind = '1' AND a.cong_no_ct = '1'

	SElECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT051'
	INSERT INTO #t1 (sysorder, systotal, form, stt, ma_so, loai_ma_so, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, kind, ky1_0, no_co, dau_cuoi, cong_tru, khong_am, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt, cong_no, cong_no_ct, vv_ct, phi_ct, cach_tinh, tl_gh, ids, iscal, ma_kh, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0)
		SELECT CASE WHEN c.ten_vv IS NULL OR c.ten_vv2 IS NULL THEN 11 ELSE 10 END, 0, a.form, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.loai_ma_so, SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_vv, @s1), SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_vv2, @s12), a.kind, a.ky1_0, a.no_co, a.dau_cuoi, a.cong_tru, a.khong_am
				, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.tk_0_gt, a.cong_no, a.cong_no_ct, a.vv_ct, a.phi_ct, a.cach_tinh, a.tl_gh, a.ids, a.iscal, b.ma_vv
				, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps ELSE b.ps END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps0 ELSE b.ps0 END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt ELSE b.ps_nt END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt0 ELSE b.ps_nt0 END
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #t1_1 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so LEFT JOIN dmvv c ON b.ma_vv = c.ma_vv
			WHERE a.kind = '1' AND a.vv_ct = '1'

	SElECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT052'
	INSERT INTO #t1 (sysorder, systotal, form, stt, ma_so, loai_ma_so, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, kind, ky1_0, no_co, dau_cuoi, cong_tru, khong_am, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt, cong_no, cong_no_ct, vv_ct, phi_ct, cach_tinh, tl_gh, ids, iscal, ma_kh, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0)
		SELECT CASE WHEN c.ten_phi IS NULL OR c.ten_phi2 IS NULL THEN 13 ELSE 12 END, 0, a.form, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.loai_ma_so, SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_phi, @s1), SPACE(3) + ISNULL(c.ten_phi2, @s12), a.kind, a.ky1_0, a.no_co, a.dau_cuoi, a.cong_tru, a.khong_am
				, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.tk_0_gt, a.cong_no, a.cong_no_ct, a.vv_ct, a.phi_ct, a.cach_tinh, a.tl_gh, a.ids, a.iscal, b.ma_phi
				, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps ELSE b.ps END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps0 ELSE b.ps0 END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt ELSE b.ps_nt END, CASE WHEN cong_tru = '2' THEN -b.ps_nt0 ELSE b.ps_nt0 END
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #t1_2 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so LEFT JOIN dmphi c ON b.ma_phi = c.ma_phi
			WHERE a.kind = '2' AND a.phi_ct = '1'
	--
	--UPDATE #t1 SET ma_kh = ma_so WHERE cong_no_ct = '1' AND ma_kh = ''

	-- 1
	SELECT sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0 FROM #t1 ORDER BY Stt, sysorder
	-- 2
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, ps01, ps02, ps03, ps04, ps05, ps06, ps07, ps08, ps09, ps10, ps11, ps12, ps_nt01, ps_nt02, ps_nt03, ps_nt04, ps_nt05, ps_nt06, ps_nt07, ps_nt08, ps_nt09, ps_nt10, ps_nt11, ps_nt12 FROM #t2 ORDER BY Stt
	-- 3
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, du_dau, tang, giam, du_cuoi, du_dau_nt, tang_nt, giam_nt, du_cuoi_nt FROM #t3 ORDER BY Stt
	-- 4 - Browse
	IF @Type = '10' BEGIN
		SELECT sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, ma_kh
				, ps, ps0, ps_nt, ps_nt0
				, 0 AS ps01, 0 AS ps02, 0 AS ps03, 0 AS ps04, 0 AS ps05, 0 AS ps06, 0 AS ps07, 0 AS ps08, 0 AS ps09, 0 AS ps10, 0 AS ps11, 0 AS ps12, 0 AS ps_nt01, 0 AS ps_nt02, 0 AS ps_nt03, 0 AS ps_nt04, 0 AS ps_nt05, 0 AS ps_nt06, 0 AS ps_nt07, 0 AS ps_nt08, 0 AS ps_nt09, 0 AS ps_nt10, 0 AS ps_nt11, 0 AS ps_nt12
				, 0 AS du_dau, 0 AS tang, 0 AS giam, 0 AS du_cuoi, 0 AS du_dau_nt, 0 AS tang_nt, 0 AS giam_nt, 0 AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #t1 ORDER BY Stt, ma_so, sysorder
		RETURN
	END
	IF @Type = '20' BEGIN
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, ma_phi AS ma_kh
				, 0 AS ps, 0 AS ps0, 0 AS ps_nt, 0 AS ps_nt0
				, ps01, ps02, ps03, ps04, ps05, ps06, ps07, ps08, ps09, ps10, ps11, ps12, ps_nt01, ps_nt02, ps_nt03, ps_nt04, ps_nt05, ps_nt06, ps_nt07, ps_nt08, ps_nt09, ps_nt10, ps_nt11, ps_nt12
				, 0 AS du_dau, 0 AS tang, 0 AS giam, 0 AS du_cuoi, 0 AS du_dau_nt, 0 AS tang_nt, 0 AS giam_nt, 0 AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #t2 ORDER BY Stt, ma_so, sysorder
		RETURN
	END
	IF @Type = '30' BEGIN
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS xkey, ma_so, '' AS ma_kh
				, 0 AS ps, 0 AS ps0, 0 AS ps_nt, 0 AS ps_nt0
				, 0 AS ps01, 0 AS ps02, 0 AS ps03, 0 AS ps04, 0 AS ps05, 0 AS ps06, 0 AS ps07, 0 AS ps08, 0 AS ps09, 0 AS ps10, 0 AS ps11, 0 AS ps12, 0 AS ps_nt01, 0 AS ps_nt02, 0 AS ps_nt03, 0 AS ps_nt04, 0 AS ps_nt05, 0 AS ps_nt06, 0 AS ps_nt07, 0 AS ps_nt08, 0 AS ps_nt09, 0 AS ps_nt10, 0 AS ps_nt11, 0 AS ps_nt12
				, du_dau, tang, giam, du_cuoi, du_dau_nt, tang_nt, giam_nt, du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #t3 ORDER BY Stt, ma_so, sysorder
		RETURN
	END

END
