CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAggregationReportPivot] --fs20_AccRateDept
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@AccountList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@AcctListNonDeduction VARCHAR(1024),
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(64),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(64),
	@PivotBy VARCHAR(64),
	@GroupFee1 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee2 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	--Declare
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @Total NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @AccountKey VARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @i INT, @Tmp VARCHAR(33), @TmpName NVARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'		
	SELECT @cNoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	
	-- Khai báo động chi tiết theo, nhóm theo...
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2_name VARCHAR(64))
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', '', '', '', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'a.tk', 'dmtk', 'tk', 'ten_tk'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'a.ma_phi', 'dmphi', 'ma_phi', 'ten_phi'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'a.ma_dvcs', 'dmdvcs', 'ma_dvcs', 'ten_dvcs'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'a.ma_bp', 'dmbp', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'a.ma_vv', 'dmvv', 'ma_vv', 'ten_vv'
	IF @Language <> 'V' UPDATE #t SET xfield2_name = xfield2_name + '2' WHERE xtype <> 0
	--
	DECLARE @reportTable VARCHAR(64), @reportField VARCHAR(64), @reportFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @pivotTable VARCHAR(64), @pivotField VARCHAR(64), @pivotFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	--
	SELECT @ReportBy = xfield, @reportTable = xtable2, @reportField = xfield2, @reportFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @ReportBy
	SELECT @GroupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @GroupBy
	SELECT @PivotBy = xfield, @pivotTable = xtable2, @pivotField = xfield2, @pivotFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @PivotBy
	
	--@Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and isnull(' + @ReportBy + ', '''') <> '''' and isnull(' + @PivotBy + ', '''') <> ''''', @Join = '', @AccountKey = ''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @AccountList <> '' SET @AccountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @AccountList)
	
	IF @GroupFee1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_phi1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_phi2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_phi3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey 
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @GroupFee1 + @GroupFee2 + @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmphi b on a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'

	-- Dữ liệu thô
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, tk, tk_du, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS reportBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS groupBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS pivotBy, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM r00$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ngay_ct, tk, tk_du, rtrim(' + @ReportBy + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN ', ''''' ELSE ', rtrim(isnull(' + @GroupBy + ', ''''))' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @PivotBy = '' THEN ', ''''' ELSE ', rtrim(' + @PivotBy + ')' END 
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ngay_ct, tk, tk_du, ' + @ReportBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END + ', ' + @PivotBy
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	CREATE INDEX ngay_ct ON #tmp(ngay_ct)

	-- Begin - Insert chi tiết
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS reportBy, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS reportByName
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xCol, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS xColName, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS xKey
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS groupBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS pivotBy
			, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt
		INTO #report FROM r00$000000

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, reportBy, isnull(max(b.' + @reportFieldName + '), N'''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', pivotBy, pivotBy'
	SET @q = @q + ', groupBy + space(1) + reportBy'
	SET @q = @q + ', groupBy, pivotBy, sum(a.ps), sum(a.ps_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from'
	
	SET @q = @q + ' (select reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(ps_no) as ps, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_nt' ELSE 'sum(ps_co) as ps, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_nt' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @AccountKey <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @AccountKey
	SET @q = @q + ' group by reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy'
	
	SET @q = @q + ' union all'
	
	SET @q = @q + ' (select reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-ps_co), sum(-ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-ps_no), sum(-ps_no_nt)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a'
	
	IF @AcctListNonDeduction <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' where ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
		IF @AccountKey <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @AccountKey
		SET @q = @q + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @AcctListNonDeduction)
	END ELSE SET @q = @q + ' where 1 = 0'
	
	SET @q = @q + ' group by reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy)'

	SET @q = @q + ' ) a left join ' + @reportTable + ' b on a.reportBy = b.' + @reportField
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + @pivotTable + ' c on a.pivotBy = c.' + @pivotField
	SET @q = @q + ' where ps + ps_nt <> 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- End - Insert chi tiết

	-- Begin - Insert group 
	IF @groupBy <> '' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET reportByName = SPACE(2) + reportByName
		
		SET @q = 'insert into #report'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 3, 1, 0, 0, '''', isnull(max(' + @groupFieldName + '), N''' + @cNoGroup + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', xCol, max(xColName), groupBy, groupBy, '''', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.groupBy = b.' + @groupField
		SET @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by xCol, groupBy'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	-- End - Insert group 
	
	-- Begin - Insert row total
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportBy, reportByName, xCol, xColName, xKey, ps, ps_nt)
		SELECT 1, 0, 0, 0, '', @Total, xCol, MAX(xColName), CHAR(10), SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY xCol
			
	--
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportBy, reportByName, xCol, xColName, xKey, ps, ps_nt)
		SELECT TOP 1 2, 0, 0, 0, '', '', xCol, xColName, CHAR(13), 0, 0 FROM #report

	-- Print
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportBy, reportByName, xCol, xColName, xKey, ps, ps_nt)
		SELECT 9, 1, 0, 0, '', @Total, xCol, xColName, 'zzz', ps, ps_nt
			FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 1
	-- End - Insert row total

	-- Stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, groupBy, reportBy INTO #o FROM #report WHERE sysorder <> 6 GROUP BY groupBy, reportBy ORDER BY groupBy, reportBy
	SELECT groupBy, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY groupBy
	IF @groupBy = '' SET @i = 1 ELSE SET @i = 0
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id + @i FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.reportBy = b.reportBy AND a.groupBy = b.groupBy JOIN #g c ON a.groupBy = c.groupBy

	--View
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportByName as ten_ky, ps, ps_nt, reportBy as xDetail, xCol, xColName, reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy, xKey'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by xKey, sysorder, stt, xCol'	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'ps$' ELSE 'ps_nt$' END, xCol FROM #report ORDER BY xCol	
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'ps' ELSE 'ps_nt' END, @Total
	
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSLiquidationReport] --fs20_FXLiquidate
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@TSType VARCHAR(33),
	@TSDepartment VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),  
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'status <> ''*'' and ((year(ngay_mua) * 12) + month(ngay_mua)) <= ' + STR(@Year * 12 + @Month)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TSType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@TSType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @TSDepartment <> '' SET @Key =	@Key + ' and ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@TSDepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'select 0 AS tag, so_the_ts, case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''V'' then ten_ts else ten_ts2 end as ten_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0'	SET @q = @q + ', so_ky_kh, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, nh_ts1, nh_ts2, nh_ts3 from dmcc a where ' + @Key + ' order by so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrrmkqpv]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dot, a.ma_hs, RTRIM(b.ho_uv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_uv AS ho_va_ten, a.noi_dung, a.ngay_pv, a.diem, 
		d.ten_kq, d.ten_kq2, e.ten_tt, e.ten_tt2, a.ma_vong, c.ten_vong, c.ten_vong2, ISNULL(c.stt, 0) AS stt_vong,
		a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
	FROM hrrmkqpv a LEFT JOIN hrrmhs b ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_hs = b.ma_hs
		LEFT JOIN hrdmvongtd c ON a.ma_vong = c.ma_vong
		LEFT JOIN hrdmkq d ON a.ma_kq = d.ma_kq
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtths e ON a.tt_hs = e.ma_tt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCBTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@printCharge BIT = 0,
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' --  1: Asc, 2: Desc
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @Debit NVARCHAR(128), @Credit NVARCHAR(128), @Debit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Credit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Desc INT
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @f = '', @Voucher = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SELECT @Debit = cname, @Debit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT053'
	SELECT @Credit = cname, @Credit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT054'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, tk_co, tt AS tien, tt_nt AS tien_nt, tt AS t_tt, tt_nt AS t_tt_nt, line_nbr INTO #tmp FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, dien_giai AS ten_kh, dien_giai AS ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX2
			, t_tien AS tien, t_tien_nt AS tien_nt, t_tien AS t_tt, t_tien_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2
			, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia
			, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #report FROM wrkcrtran

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 3, 0, 1, a.stt_rec, rtrim(a.ong_ba), rtrim(b.ten_kh), rtrim(b.ten_kh2), a.dia_chi, a.dien_giai, N''' + REPLACE(@Debit, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@Debit2, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.so_ct_goc, a.dien_giai_ct_goc, a.ma_nk, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' , replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringValue(a.ty_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m46$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, tk_co, tien, tien_nt, a.tien, tien_nt, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('d46$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @printCharge = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f46$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f46$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec, stt_rec + '01' AS xGroup, tk_co, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, CAST(99 AS INT) AS in_yn
		INTO #d FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_co ORDER BY stt_rec, tk_co

		SELECT stt_rec, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #sx FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
		UPDATE #d SET in_yn = 3 FROM #d a JOIN #sx b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt

		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmp
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_cp, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f46$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m46$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_thue, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f46$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m46$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk_co, tien, tien_nt, in_yn) SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01', tk_co, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, 2 FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_co ORDER BY stt_rec, tk_co

		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', '', '', '', @Credit, @Credit2, tien, tien_nt, tien, tien_nt, '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', '', tk_co, 0, NULL, '', '', '', in_yn, '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, ''
				FROM #d
				WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #report)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', '', '', '', @Credit, @Credit2, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', '', tk_co, 0, NULL, '', '', '', MIN(line_nbr), '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, ''
				FROM #tmp
				WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #report)
				GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_co
	END

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia, so_ct_goc = b.so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc = b.dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia = b.chuoi_ty_gia
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ma_nk, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 3) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE sysorder = 5

	UPDATE #report SET dien_giaix = '', dien_giaix2 = '' WHERE sysorder = 5 AND (line_nbr = 2 OR line_nbr = 99)

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #report where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#report', '#report', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	IF @Bilingual = '2' BEGIN
		IF @Desc = 0 SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			ELSE SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select * from (
	select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
		, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaix <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
		, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
		, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''1'' as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report
	union all
	select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
		, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaix <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
		, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
		, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''2'' as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report
	) a order by xGroup, sysorder, line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_in_word, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_nt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_nt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_nt_in_word, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
	, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt
	, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_in_word, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_nt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_nt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_nt_in_word, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
	, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ExecExRDTrans]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@So_tt INT, 
	@Ten_bt NVARCHAR(511),
	@Tk VARCHAR(32),
	@So_ct VARCHAR(32), 
	@nFCRate NUMERIC(24, 12),
	@nUserID INT,
	@user_id2 INT,
	@nPeriod INT = 0,
	@nYear INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @Round INT, @RoundExRate INT, @ExRate NUMERIC(24, 12)

	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @RoundExRate = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	SELECT @ExRate = @nFCRate

	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl

	DECLARE @nPTk_cn TINYINT, @cPMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @cPTk_cltg VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @cPTk_cltg = Tk_cltg FROM dmcltg WHERE stt = @So_tt
	IF @cPTk_cltg IS NULL SET @cPTk_cltg = ''
	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE Tk = @cPTk_cltg AND Loai_tk = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @nPTk_cn = Tk_cn FROM Dmtk WHERE Tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%'
		IF @nPTk_cn IS NULL SET @nPTk_cn = 0
		IF @nPTk_cn = 0
			DECLARE cusTran CURSOR 
				FOR SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, SUM(Ps) AS Ps, SUM(Ps_nt) AS Ps_nt FROM
					(SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, SUM(Ps_no - Ps_co) AS Ps, SUM(Ps_no_nt - Ps_co_nt) AS Ps_nt
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk) + '%')
						GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs
					UNION ALL(
						SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, SUM(Du_no00 - Du_co00), SUM(Du_no_nt00 - Du_co_nt00)
							FROM cdtk WITH (INDEX(nam))
							WHERE (Du_no_nt00 + Du_co_nt00 <> 0) AND Tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk) + '%') AND Nam = YEAR(@dFrom)
								AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
							GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs
						)
				)a
				GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs
				HAVING SUM(Ps_nt) <> 0

		IF @nPTk_cn = 1 BEGIN
			-- TT179
			DECLARE @kieu_tk_cn CHAR(1), @ds_tk_no VARCHAR(1024), @ds_tk_co VARCHAR(1024), @loai_danh_gia TINYINT
			SELECT @kieu_tk_cn = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE [name] = 'm_kieu_cltg_tk_cn'
			SELECT @ds_tk_no = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE [name] = 'm_tk_cn_cltg_no'
			SELECT @ds_tk_co = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE [name] = 'm_tk_cn_cltg_co'

			SELECT @loai_danh_gia = CASE WHEN dbo.ff_inlist(@Tk, @ds_tk_no) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN dbo.ff_Inlist(@Tk, @ds_tk_co) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
			IF @kieu_tk_cn = '1' AND @loai_danh_gia = 0 RETURN

			DECLARE cusTran CURSOR 
				FOR SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh, SUM(Ps) AS Ps, SUM(Ps_nt) AS Ps_nt FROM
					(SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh, SUM(Ps_no - Ps_co) AS Ps, SUM(Ps_no_nt - Ps_co_nt) AS Ps_nt
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk) + '%')
						GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh
					UNION ALL(
						SELECT Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh, SUM(Du_no00 - Du_co00), SUM(Du_no_nt00 - Du_co_nt00)
							FROM cdkh WITH (INDEX(nam))
							WHERE (Du_no_nt00 + Du_co_nt00 <> 0) AND Tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Tk) + '%') AND Nam = YEAR(@dFrom)
								AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
							GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh
						)
				) a
				GROUP BY Tk, Ma_dvcs, Ma_kh
				HAVING (@kieu_tk_cn = '2' AND SUM(Ps_nt) <> 0) OR  (
					@kieu_tk_cn <> '2' AND (
						(@loai_danh_gia = 1 AND SUM(Ps_nt) > 0) OR (@loai_danh_gia = 2 AND SUM(Ps_nt) < 0)
					)
				)
		END

		-- Define variables for cursor
		DECLARE @vcTk VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_nt VARCHAR(32), @vcMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vcPs NUMERIC(28, 6), @vcPs_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		-- Define variables for ct00
		DECLARE @vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13), @vdMa_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_ct VARCHAR(3), @vdNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @vdNgay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @vdSo_ct VARCHAR(32), @vdSo_lo VARCHAR(32), @vdNgay_lo SMALLDATETIME, 
			@vdOng_ba NVARCHAR(128), @vdDien_giai NVARCHAR(128), @vdNh_dk VARCHAR(32), @nNh_dk INT, @vdLine_nbr INT, @vdTk VARCHAR(32), @vdTk_du VARCHAR(32), @vdPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), 
			@vdMa_nt VARCHAR(32), @vdTy_gia NUMERIC(24, 12), @vdPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @vdMa_kh VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_vv VARCHAR(32), @vdSo_lsx VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_td1 VARCHAR(32), 
			@vdMa_td2 VARCHAR(32), @vdMa_td3 VARCHAR(32), @vduser_id0 INT, @vddate0 DATETIME, @vduser_id2 INT, @vddate2 DATETIME, @vdstatus VARCHAR(1)
		
		-- Set value for variables of table ct00
		SELECT @vdDien_giai = dien_giai FROM v20dmdg WHERE ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
		SELECT @vdMa_ct = 'PK6', @vdNgay_ct = @dFrom, @vdNgay_lct = @dFrom, @vdSo_lo = '', @vdNgay_lo = NULL, @vdOng_ba = '', @vdDien_giai = ISNULL(@vdDien_giai, ''), @vdMa_kh = '', 
			@vdSo_lsx = '', @vdMa_td1 = '', @vdMa_td2 = '', @vdMa_td3 = '', @vduser_id0 = @user_id2, @vddate0  = GETDATE(), @vduser_id2 = @user_id2, @vddate2 = GETDATE(), @vdstatus = '1'
		
		-- Lay stt_rec
		DECLARE @strSQLExec NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = Stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dFrom), 2), ' ', '0') +  ' FROM dmcltg1 WHERE Stt = ' + CHAR(39) + lTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + CHAR(39) + ' AND Nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dFrom), 4)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT

		IF @vdStt_rec = '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @Ws_id CHAR(1)
			SELECT @Ws_id = RTRIM(Val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(Name) = 'M_WS_ID'
			SET @strSQLExec = N'SELECT @vdStt_rec = MAX(Stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + ') FROM dmcltg1 WHERE Nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dFrom), 4)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec, N'@vdStt_rec VARCHAR(13) OUTPUT', @vdStt_rec = @vdStt_rec OUTPUT
		
			SELECT @vdStt_rec = @Ws_id + STR(YEAR(@dFrom), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + 
				REPLACE(STR(CAST(SUBSTRING(@vdStt_rec, 8, 3) AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ', '0') + @vdMa_ct
			SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmcltg1 SET Stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + 
				' = ' + CHAR(39) +  @vdStt_rec + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE Stt = ' + 
				CHAR(39) + lTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + CHAR(39) + ' AND Nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dFrom), 4)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
		END
		-- Lay so_ct
		SET @vdSo_ct = @So_ct
		IF @vdSo_ct = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @vdSo_ct = STR(So_ct + 1, dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')) FROM Dmct WHERE Ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
			UPDATE Dmct SET So_ct = So_ct + 1 WHERE Ma_ct = @vdMa_ct
			SET @strSQLExec = 'UPDATE dmcltg1 SET So_ct' + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + 
				' = ' + CHAR(39) +  @vdSo_ct + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE Stt = ' + 
				CHAR(39) + lTRIM(RTRIM(@So_tt)) + CHAR(39) + ' AND Nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dFrom), 4)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLExec
		END
		SET  @vdMa_vv = ''

		OPEN cusTran
		IF @nPTk_cn = 0
			FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt
		ELSE
			FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @cPMa_kh, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt

		DECLARE @dForm2 SMALLDATETIME
		SET @dForm2 = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @dFrom + 1)
		SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr INTO #t FROM r00$000000
		SELECT @strSQLExec = 'insert into #t select max(line_nbr) from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(stt_rec)) where %[stt_rec = ''' + @vdStt_rec + ''']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @strSQLExec, NULL, NULL, @dForm2, @dFrom, 1, 1
		SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1 FROM #t

		--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) + 1  FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @vdStt_rec
		--SELECT @vdLine_nbr = 1
		SELECT @vdNh_dk = '001', @nNh_dk = 1
		SET @vdSo_ct = SPACE(dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct') - LEN(RTRIM(@vdSo_ct))) + @vdSo_ct

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmtgdg WHERE ky = @nPeriod AND nam = @nYear AND ma_dvcs = @vcMa_dvcs AND tk = @vcTk) SELECT @nFCRate = ty_gia FROM #dmtgdg WHERE ky = @nPeriod AND nam = @nYear AND ma_dvcs = @vcMa_dvcs AND tk = @vcTk
				ELSE SELECT @nFCRate = @ExRate
	
			IF ROUND(@vcPs_nt * @nFCRate, @Round) <> @vcPs BEGIN
				IF ROUND(@vcPs_nt * @nFCRate, @Round) > @vcPs BEGIN
					SET @vdTk = @vcTk
					SET @vdTk_du = @cPTk_cltg
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SET @vdTk = @cPTk_cltg
					SET @vdTk_du = @vcTk
				END

				SET @vdPs_no_nt = 0
				SET @vdPs_no = ABS(ROUND(@vcPs_nt * @nFCRate, @Round) - @vcPs)
				SET @vdPs_co_nt = 0
				SET @vdPs_co = 0
				SET @vdMa_dvcs = @vcMa_dvcs 
				SET @vdMa_nt = ''
				IF @nPTk_cn <> 0 SET @vdMa_kh = @cPMa_kh
				SELECT @vdTy_gia = CASE WHEN @vcPs_nt  = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@vcPs/@vcPs_nt, @RoundExRate) END

				INSERT INTO #gl (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, So_lo, Ngay_lo, Ong_ba,
					Dien_giai_h, Dien_giai, Nh_dk, Line_nbr, Tk, Tk_du, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co, Ma_kh, 
					Ma_vv, So_lsx, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
					VALUES (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct, 
						@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk, @vdTk_du, 
						@vdPs_no_nt, @vdPs_co_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_no, @vdPs_co, 
						@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_td1, @vdMa_td2, @vdMa_td3, @vduser_id0, 
						@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)
				SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1		
				INSERT INTO #gl (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, So_lo, Ngay_lo, Ong_ba,
					Dien_giai_h, Dien_giai, Nh_dk, Line_nbr, Tk, Tk_du, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co, Ma_kh, 
					Ma_vv, So_lsx, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
					VALUES (@vdStt_rec, @vdMa_dvcs, @vdMa_ct, @vdNgay_ct, @vdNgay_lct, @vdSo_ct, 
						@vdSo_lo, @vdNgay_lo, @vdOng_ba, @vdDien_giai, @vdDien_giai, @vdNh_dk, @vdLine_nbr, @vdTk_du, @vdTk, 
						@vdPs_co_nt, @vdPs_no_nt, @vdMa_nt, @vdTy_gia, @vdPs_co, @vdPs_no, 
						@vdMa_kh, @vdMa_vv, @vdSo_lsx, @vdMa_td1, @vdMa_td2, @vdMa_td3, @vduser_id0, 
						@vddate0, @vduser_id2, @vddate2, @vdstatus)
			END
			IF @nPTk_cn = 0
				FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt
			ELSE
				FETCH NEXT FROM cusTran INTO @vcTk, @vcMa_dvcs, @cPMa_kh, @vcPs, @vcPs_nt

			--SET @vdNh_dk = REPLACE(STR(CAST(@vdNh_dk AS INT) + 1, 3), ' ' , '0')
			SELECT @nNh_dk = @nNh_dk + 1
			SELECT @vdNh_dk = RIGHT('00' + dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(@nNh_dk), 3)

			SET @vdLine_nbr = @vdLine_nbr + 1
		END
		CLOSE cusTran
		DEALLOCATE cusTran
	END

	DECLARE @cFC VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @cFC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @Tk AND ma_nt <> @cFC)
		SELECT @cFC = ma_nt FROM dmtk WHERE tk =@Tk AND ma_nt <> @cFC
	ELSE
		SELECT @cFC = ''

	UPDATE #gl SET ma_nt = @cFC, loai_ct = '', ma_nk = '', ma_sp = '', so_ct0 = '', ma_gd = '', nam = 0, ky = 0, ma_hd = '', ma_ku = '', ma_phi = '', so_dh = '', sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0, gc_td1 = '', gc_td2 = '', gc_td3 = '', s1 = '', s2 = '', s3 = '', s4 = 0, s5 = 0, s6 = 0
	UPDATE #gl SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai, dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai FROM #gl a JOIN v20dmdg b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	-- Insert into r00
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dFrom BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'INSERT INTO r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dFrom, 112) + ' SELECT * FROM #gl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdmnt
AS
SELECT     CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, *
FROM         dbo.dmnt
WHERE     (1 = 0)

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$ShiftScheduleByDay$CopyColumn]
	@SourceDay INT,
	@SourceMonth INT,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@SourceEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@TargetDays VARCHAR(1024),
	@TargetMonths VARCHAR(1024),
	@DepartmentRef VARCHAR(128),
	@EmployeeList VARCHAR(8000),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Prime VARCHAR(32), @Partition NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @maxID INT, @minID INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @m INT, @Value VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @EmployeeID VARCHAR(32), @v VARCHAR(32), @k VARCHAR(32), @d VARCHAR(8000), @f VARCHAR(8000)
	DECLARE @x INT, @x1 VARCHAR(128), @y INT, @y1 VARCHAR(128), @z INT, @z1 VARCHAR(2), @z2 VARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @EmployeeID = '', @Value = '', @Key = '', @v = '', @k = '', @d = '', @f = '', @q = '', @i = 1, @m = 1
	SELECT @TargetDays = REPLACE(REPLACE(@TargetDays, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
	SELECT @TargetMonths = REPLACE(REPLACE(@TargetMonths, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @DateFrom >= ngay_gh1 and @DateTo <= ngay_gh2) RETURN

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nv, n01 AS c INTO #tmp FROM hrca$000000

	CREATE TABLE #date(ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME NULL, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME NULL, ds_ngay VARCHAR(4000), copy BIT, id INT IDENTITY(1,1))

	SELECT @d1 = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @DateFrom)
	IF (DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0, @DateFrom) + 1, 0)) < @DateTo) INSERT INTO #date (ngay_tu, ngay_den, ds_ngay) SELECT @DateFrom, DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0, @DateFrom) + 1, 0)), ''
	IF (YEAR(@d1)* 12 + MONTH(@d1) < YEAR(@DateTo) * 12 + MONTH(@DateTo)) INSERT INTO #date (ngay_tu, ngay_den, ds_ngay) SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @d1), 0), DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0, @d1) + 1, 0)), ''
	INSERT INTO #date (ngay_tu, ngay_den, ds_ngay) SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTo), 0), @DateTo, ''

	SELECT @Prime = 'hrca$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_tu, 112) FROM #date WHERE MONTH(ngay_tu) = @SourceMonth
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec_nv, n' + REPLACE(STR(@SourceDay, 2), ' ', 0) + ' from ' + @Prime
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tmp) RETURN

	IF @TargetMonths = '' UPDATE #date SET copy = 1
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @y = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@TargetMonths, ',')
		WHILE 0 < @y BEGIN
			SELECT @y1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@TargetMonths, @y, ',')
			IF ISNUMERIC(@y1) = 1 UPDATE #date SET copy = 1 WHERE MONTH(ngay_tu) = @y1
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @i = SUBSTRING(@y1, 0, CHARINDEX('-', @y1)), @m = RIGHT(@y1, LEN(@y1) - LEN(@i) - 1)
				WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
					UPDATE #date SET copy = 1 WHERE MONTH(ngay_tu) = @i
					SELECT @i = @i + 1
				END
			END
			SET @y = @y - 1
		END
		DELETE #date WHERE copy IS NULL
	END

	SELECT @x = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@TargetDays, ',')
	WHILE 0 < @x BEGIN
		SELECT @x1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@TargetDays, @x, ',')
		IF ISNUMERIC(@x1) = 1 UPDATE #date SET ds_ngay = ds_ngay + REPLACE(STR(@x1, 2),' ', '0') + ',' WHERE @x1 BETWEEN DAY(ngay_tu) AND DAY(ngay_den) AND CHARINDEX(REPLACE(STR(@x1, 2),' ', '0'), ds_ngay) = 0
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @i = SUBSTRING(@x1, 0, CHARINDEX('-', @x1)), @m = RIGHT(@x1, LEN(@x1) - LEN(@i) - 1)
			WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
				UPDATE #date SET ds_ngay = ds_ngay + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2),' ', '0') + ',' WHERE @i BETWEEN DAY(ngay_tu) AND DAY(ngay_den) AND CHARINDEX(REPLACE(STR(@i, 2),' ', '0'), ds_ngay) = 0
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @x = @x - 1
	END
	DELETE #date WHERE ds_ngay = ''

	-- Value by Employee
	IF @SourceEmployee <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @EmployeeID = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @SourceEmployee
		SELECT @Value = c FROM #tmp WHERE stt_rec_nv = @EmployeeID
	END

	IF @EmployeeList <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @EmployeeList = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmployeeList), ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''')
		SELECT @Key = 'b.ma_nv in(''' + @EmployeeList + ''')'
	END

	SELECT @maxID = MAX(id), @minID = MIN(id) FROM #date
	WHILE @minID <= @maxID BEGIN
		SELECT @Partition = 'hrca$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_tu, 112) FROM #date WHERE id = @maxID
		IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT @d = 'n' + REPLACE(ds_ngay, ',', ' = %v%,n') FROM #date WHERE id = @maxID
			SET @d = LEFT(@d, LEN(@d) - 2)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @d = ''
			SELECT @z2 = ds_ngay FROM #date WHERE id = @maxID
			SELECT @z = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@z2, ',')
			WHILE 0 < @z BEGIN
				SELECT @z1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@z2, @z, ',')
				IF @z1 <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @k = 'n' + @z1
					SELECT @d = @d + @k + ' = case when isnull(' + @k + ', '''') = '''' then %v% else ' + @k  + ' end,'
				END
				SET @z = @z - 1
			END
			SET @d = LEFT(@d, LEN(@d) - 1)
		END

		IF @SourceEmployee <> ''
			SELECT @d = REPLACE(@d, '%v%', CHAR(39) + ISNULL(@Value, '') + CHAR(39))
		ELSE SELECT @d = REPLACE(@d, '%v%', 'c')
	
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @Partition + ' set ' + @d + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + CHAR(13)	
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from ' + @Partition + ' a join hrnv b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec join #tmp c on a.stt_rec_nv = c.stt_rec_nv' + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'where b.bp_ref like ''' + REPLACE(@DepartmentRef, '''', '''''') + '%''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Key
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @i = 1, @f = '', @v = ''
		WHILE @i < 32 BEGIN
			SELECT @v = CASE WHEN @i > 9 THEN RTRIM(@i) ELSE '0' + RTRIM(@i) END
			SELECT @f = @f +  'isnull(n' + @v + ', '''')+'
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		SELECT @f = SUBSTRING(RTRIM(@f), 0, LEN(@f))
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @Partition + ' set status = case when (rtrim(' + @f + ')) <> '''' then ''1'' else ''0'' end' + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from ' + @Partition + ' a join hrnv b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec' + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'where b.bp_ref like ''' + REPLACE(@DepartmentRef, '''', '''''') + '%''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Key
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @maxID = @maxID - 1
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff30_GetIdGLJournal15] (@DrAccount VARCHAR(33), @CrAccount VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS VARCHAR(33)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @cReturn = MIN(ma_snk) FROM v30dmsnk15
		WHERE xtype = '1'
			AND ma_snk <> 'ZZHDA'
			AND (((dbo.ff_Inlist(@DrAccount, tk) = 1 AND ma_snk <> 'NKBAN'))
			OR (((tk_du01 <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@CrAccount, tk_du01) = 1) OR (tk_du02 <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@CrAccount, tk_du02) = 1) OR (tk_du03 <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@CrAccount, tk_du03) = 1))
			 	AND ma_snk = 'NKBAN' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@DrAccount, tk) = 1))

	IF @cReturn IS NULL SET @cReturn = ''
	RETURN @cReturn
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrenn]
AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ten_nn, b.ten_nn2, a.bang_cap, c.ten_cc, c.ten_cc2, a.diem, a.ngay_cap
	FROM hrenn  a LEFT JOIN hrdmnn b ON a.ma_nn = b.ma_nn
	LEFT JOIN hrdmcc c ON a.bang_cap = c.ma_cc
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI109] -- Số dư công nợ phải thu quá hạn
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@OUM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q AS NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey AS NVARCHAR(4000), @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @DebitAccount = REPLACE(@DebitAccount, '''', '')

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, t_tt AS tien, CAST(0 AS INT) AS qua_han, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien1
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien3, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien4
		INTO #report FROM cttt20

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select a.ma_kh, a.t_tt - a.t_tt1 as tien, datediff(day, a.ngay_ct0 + b.han_tt, ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @GetDate, 112) + ''') as qua_han, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'--CONVERT(VARCHAR, @GetDate(), 112)
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt20 a with(nolock) join dmtt b on a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.loai_tt = 0 and a.tat_toan = 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, ''' + @DebitAccount + ''') = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE FROM #report WHERE qua_han < 0
	DELETE FROM #report WHERE tien < 0
	UPDATE #report SET tien1 = tien WHERE qua_han > 0 AND qua_han <= 30
	UPDATE #report SET tien2 = tien WHERE qua_han > 30 AND qua_han <= 60
	UPDATE #report SET tien3 = tien WHERE qua_han > 60 AND qua_han <= 90
	UPDATE #report SET tien4 = tien WHERE qua_han > 90
	
	SET @q = 'select a.ma_kh, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_kh)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_kh2)' END + ' as ten_kh, sum(a.tien1 + a.tien2 + a.tien3 + a.tien4) as tien, sum(a.tien1) as tien1, sum(a.tien2) as tien2, sum(a.tien3) as tien3, sum(a.tien4) as tien4'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #result'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_kh  order by tien desc'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ma_kh, ten_kh, cast(tien as varchar) as tien, cast(tien1 as varchar) as tien1, cast(tien2 as varchar) as tien2, cast(tien3 as varchar) as tien3, cast(tien4 as varchar) as tien4 from #result where tien <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpWorkSeniority]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Gender VARCHAR(1),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15), @d VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @d = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc < ' + @d

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 + @Level <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	
	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec) select a.stt_rec from hrnv a with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec) SELECT ''

	SELECT @q = 'select case when a.stt_rec = '''' then 0 else a.stt end as stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_chinh_thuc, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(e.ngay_chinh_thuc, case when (e.ngay_nghi is null or e.ngay_nghi > ' + @d + ') then ' + @d + ' else e.ngay_nghi end) as nam_lv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', e.bo_phan, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.stt_rec = '''' then '''' else case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' else N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' end end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
  
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$OpeningBalance$ConvertLot2Stock] @Item VARCHAR(32), @Type INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @StartYear INT
	SELECT @StartYear = nam_bd FROM dmstt
	IF @Type = 3
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO cdlo(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
				SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
					FROM cdntxt a WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ma_ct = ''
						AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
					GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo					

			UPDATE cdlo SET ton00 = a.ton00, du00 = a.du00, du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
				FROM cdlo u WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
					SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS ton00, SUM(tien) AS du00, SUM(tien_nt) AS du_nt00
						FROM cdntxt WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ma_ct = ''
						GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
					) a ON u.nam = a.nam AND u.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND u.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri AND u.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND u.ma_lo = a.ma_lo
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item

			UPDATE cdlo SET ton00 = 0, cdlo.du00 = 0, cdlo.du_nt00 = 0
				FROM cdlo u WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item AND
					NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdntxt a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ma_ct = '' AND ma_kho = u.ma_kho AND ma_vi_tri = u.ma_vi_tri AND ma_vt = u.ma_vt AND ma_lo = u.ma_lo)
			DELETE cdlo WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
		END

	IF @Type = 1 OR @Type = 3
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO cdvt(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
				SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
					FROM cdlo a WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
					GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt

			INSERT INTO cdvitri(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
				SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
					FROM cdlo a WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
					GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt

			UPDATE cdvt SET ton00 = a.ton00, du00 = a.du00, du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
				FROM cdvt u WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
					SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00
						FROM cdlo WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt
					) a ON u.nam = a.nam AND u.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND u.ma_vt = a.ma_vt
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item

			UPDATE cdvitri SET  ton00 = a.ton00, du00 = a.du00, du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
				FROM cdvitri u WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
					SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00
						FROM cdlo WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt
					) a ON u.nam = a.nam AND u.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND u.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri AND u.ma_vt = a.ma_vt
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item

			UPDATE cdvt SET ton00 = 0, du00 = 0, du_nt00 = 0
				FROM cdvt u WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_kho = u.ma_kho AND ma_vt = u.ma_vt)

			UPDATE cdvitri SET ton00 = 0, du00 = 0, du_nt00 = 0
				FROM cdvitri u WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_kho = u.ma_kho AND ma_vt = u.ma_vt AND ma_vi_tri = u.ma_vi_tri)

			DELETE cdvitri WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
			DELETE cdvt WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO cdvt2(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
				SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
					FROM cdlo2 a WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt2 b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
					GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt

			INSERT INTO cdvitri2(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
				SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
					FROM cdlo2 a WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri2 b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
					GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt

			UPDATE cdvt2 SET ton00 = a.ton00, du00 = a.du00, du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
				FROM cdvt2 u WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
					SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00
						FROM cdlo2 WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt
					) a ON u.nam = a.nam AND u.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND u.ma_vt = a.ma_vt
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item

			UPDATE cdvitri2 SET  ton00 = a.ton00, du00 = a.du00, du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
				FROM cdvitri2 u WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
					SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00
						FROM cdlo2 WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item
						GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt
					) a ON u.nam = a.nam AND u.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND u.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri AND u.ma_vt = a.ma_vt
				WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_vt = @Item

			UPDATE cdvt2 SET ton00 = 0, du00 = 0, du_nt00 = 0
				FROM cdvt2 u WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_kho = u.ma_kho AND ma_vt = u.ma_vt)

			UPDATE cdvitri2 SET ton00 = 0, du00 = 0, du_nt00 = 0
				FROM cdvitri2 u WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_kho = u.ma_kho AND ma_vt = u.ma_vt AND ma_vi_tri = u.ma_vi_tri)

			DELETE cdvitri2 WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
			DELETE cdvt2 WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_vt = @Item AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
		END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Print58Tran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3) 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.tk_no, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.dien_giai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 5, '''+@cVoucher+''', ''tk_no, dien_giai'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE FUNCTION ff_Max(@Value1 NUMERIC(38, 9), @Value2 NUMERIC(38, 9))
RETURNS NUMERIC(38, 9) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @iRet NUMERIC(38, 9)
	IF @Value1 > @Value2 SET @iRet = @Value1 ELSE SET @iRet = @Value2
	RETURN @iRet
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_Convert2AccountBalance  AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Convert to cdtk from dmtk
	DECLARE @nYear INT, @cUnit VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @nYear = Nam_bd FROM Dmstt

	-- Cap nhat nhung tai khoan moi va xoa nhung ban ghi khong thoa man trong danh muc tai khoan
	DECLARE @m_tk_du0 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @m_tk_du0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_du0'

	DELETE cdtk FROM cdtk WITH (INDEX(nam))  WHERE Nam = @nYear AND (
						Tk NOT IN (SELECT Tk FROM dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1) 
						OR (@m_tk_du0 <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @m_tk_du0) = 1)
					)
	DELETE cdtk FROM cdtk WITH (INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs <> '' AND Ma_dvcs NOT IN (SELECT Ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs)

	DECLARE csUnit CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs
	OPEN csUnit
	FETCH NEXT FROM csUnit INTO @cUnit
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs_Convert2AccountBalance4Unit @nYear, @cUnit
			FETCH NEXT FROM csUnit INTO @cUnit
		END
	CLOSE csUnit
	DEALLOCATE csUnit
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetUnitRightListNew](@nUserID INT)  
RETURNS VARCHAR(1023)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = ISNULL(@cUnits, '') + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + ',' FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @nUserID AND r_new = 1
	IF RTRIM(ISNULL(@cUnits, '')) <> ''	SET @cUnits = LEFT(@cUnits, LEN(@cUnits) - 1)

	RETURN @cUnits
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostPOAuthorize]
	@typeVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1 Local, 2 - Import
	@action CHAR(1), -- 1 - Approve, 2 - Cancel
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@role VARCHAR(33) = '', -- Direct Approval
	@remoteApprove BIT = 0,
	@CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@voucherApproveLog BIT = 1,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @commentApproval = REPLACE(@commentApproval, '''', '''''')

	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(32), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @detailTable VARCHAR(32), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(128),
		@status VARCHAR(32), @uStatus VARCHAR(32), @xStatus VARCHAR(32), @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(19, 3), @recordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(32), @lastUser INT, @getMailList_yn BIT, @notifyMail BIT,
		@voucherCode VARCHAR(32), @datetime2 DATETIME, @created_mail_yn BIT, @createdUser INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @category VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @status = '', @uStatus = '', @xStatus = '', @curStatus = '', @dept = '', @recordHasBeenChanged = '', @notifyMail = 0, @lastUser = 0, @created_mail_yn = 0, @createdUser = 0, @getMailList_yn = 1, @voucherCode = 'PO' + @typeVoucher, @UnitKey = '', @admin = 0
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID


	--
	IF @role <> '' SET @getMailList_yn = 0


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)


	IF @typeVoucher = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SELECT @GeneralTable = 'c94$000000', @MasterTable = 'm94$' + @Dyn, @DetailTable = 'd94$' + @Dyn, @InquiryTable = 'i94$' + @Dyn, @HisTable = 'a94$000000'
		INSERT INTO #listUser SELECT MAX(stt), user_id4 FROM a94$000000 WHERE reset = 0 and stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4 HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SELECT @GeneralTable = 'c95$000000', @MasterTable = 'm95$' + @Dyn, @DetailTable = 'd95$' + @Dyn, @InquiryTable = 'i95$' + @Dyn, @HisTable = 'a95$000000'
		INSERT INTO #listUser SELECT MAX(stt), user_id4 FROM a95$000000 WHERE reset = 0 and stt_rec = @idNumber GROUP BY stt_rec, user_id4 HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1
	END


	--
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC

	-- Get Created User
	SET @q = 'select @u = user_id0 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@u int output', @createdUser OUTPUT

	-- Check remote aprrove
	IF @remoteApprove = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @d = datetime2 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d datetime output', @datetime2 OUTPUT

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id = @userID AND datetime2 = @datetime2) BEGIN
			SELECT '1' AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END


	-- Get Role
	IF @role = '' BEGIN
		--
		DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @msg = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END

		--
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #listUser WHERE user_id = @userID) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		--
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')

		--
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), dept_id VARCHAR(32), ma_nt VARCHAR(32), t_tien_nt NUMERIC(19, 2), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, dept_id, ma_nt, t_tien_nt, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SET @q = @q + ' and status <> ''*'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @curStatus = u_status, @dept = dept_id, @FC = ma_nt, @amount = t_tien_nt, @category = kieu_duyet FROM #role

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalRole '2', @voucherCode, @userID, @dept, @FC, @amount, @curStatus, @language, @category, @CategoryApprove OUTPUT, @role OUTPUT

		IF @role = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE SELECT @curStatus = u_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE s_status = '1' AND loai_duyet = '2'

	-- Get next status
	SELECT @uStatus = CASE WHEN @action = '1' THEN status2 ELSE status0 END, @notifyMail = notify_mail_yn, @created_mail_yn = created_mail_yn FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = '2' AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @curStatus AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove
	SELECT @status = s_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE u_status = @uStatus AND loai_duyet = '2'

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''', @Status = REPLACE(@Status, '''', '')

	-- Update table
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set'
	IF @status = '5' SET @q = @q + ' xtag = status,'
	SET @q = @q + ' status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@UStatus, '''', '') + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''

	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @GeneralTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @action = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @loai_ct VARCHAR(32)

		SET @q = 'select @p = loai_ct from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p varchar(32) output', @loai_ct OUTPUT
		IF @loai_ct <> '2' AND @status = '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID
	END

	-- History
	SET @q = '
		declare @stt int
		select @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) + 1 from ' + @HisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
		insert into ' + @HisTable + ' (stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset, comment)
		select stt_rec, rtrim(@stt), status, u_status, ''1'', user_id2, datetime2, 0, N''' + @commentApproval + '''
			from ' + @masterTable + '
			where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''

	-- Reset
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		declare @minReset int
		select @minReset = 0
		if exists(select 1 from dmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''2'' and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @HisTable + '
				where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
					and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + '''
					and stt < @stt
					and stt in (select a.stt from ' + @HisTable + ' a
						join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + @HisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'')
			update ' + @HisTable + ' set reset = reset + 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt > @minReset
		end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Log
	IF @voucherApproveLog = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = '2' AND u_status = @uStatus and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = @userID)) BEGIN
		DECLARE @idLog INT, @deleteDay INT
		SELECT @deleteDay = 0, @idLog = 0

		SET @q = 'select @deleteDay = isnull(logday,0) from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..sysmaintenance where type = ''2'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@deleteDay int output', @deleteDay OUTPUT

		IF @typeVoucher = '1' BEGIN
			DELETE d94log FROM m94log a JOIN d94log b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.id = b.id WHERE a.datetime2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())
			DELETE m94log WHERE DATETIME2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())

			SELECT @idLog = ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM m94log WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #m94LogTemp FROM m94$000000
			SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #d94LogTemp FROM d94$000000
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #m94LogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #d94LogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('m94log', '#m94LogTemp', 'm94log', 'm94log', '1=1', null)
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('d94log', '#d94LogTemp', 'd94log', 'd94log', '1=1', null)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DELETE d95log FROM m95log a JOIN d95log b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.id = b.id WHERE a.datetime2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())
			DELETE m95log WHERE DATETIME2 < DATEADD(DAY, -@deleteDay, GETDATE())

			SELECT @idLog = ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM m95log WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #m95LogTemp FROM m95$000000
			SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, * INTO #d95LogTemp FROM d95$000000
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #m95LogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #d95LogTemp select ' + RTRIM(@idLog) + ', * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('m95log', '#m95LogTemp', 'm95log', 'm95log', '1=1', null)
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('d95log', '#d95LogTemp', 'd95log', 'd95log', '1=1', null)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END


	-- Mail
	IF @getMailList_yn = 1 BEGIN
		-- Notify Mail
		IF @notifyMail = 0 SET @lastUser = 0
		-- Created Mail
		IF @created_mail_yn = 0 SET @createdUser = 0


		DECLARE @useNotify CHAR(1), @notifyGroup VARCHAR(32)
		SET @notifyGroup = CASE WHEN @typeVoucher = '1' THEN '03' ELSE '04' END
		SET @q = 'select @r = status from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifygroup where code = ''' + @notifyGroup + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(1) out', @useNotify OUT

		IF @useNotify = '0' BEGIN
			SELECT '' AS message
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @masterTable, '2', @voucherCode, @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @notifyCode VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000)
			CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
			INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @masterTable, '2', @voucherCode, @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail) BEGIN
				CREATE TABLE #notifyContent(title NVARCHAR(128), title2 NVARCHAR(128), content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT, ref_code VARCHAR(32), s1 VARCHAR(32), e$ NVARCHAR(4000), [type] TINYINT, popup_title NVARCHAR(1024), popup_title2 NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content2 NVARCHAR(1024))
				IF @typeVoucher = '1'
					EXEC rs_CreateNotifyPOTran @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, '#notifyContent'
				ELSE
					EXEC rs_CreateNotifyPITran @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, '#notifyContent'

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 2) BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post @notifyGroup, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
						'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 0',
						null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 2', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

					SET @q = 'update ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser set s1 = ma_nhan, s2 = ma_huy from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser a join dmxn b on a.user_id = b.user_id where a.code = @notifyCode and b.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@notifyCode varchar(32), @stt_rec char(13)', @notifyCode, @idNumber

					IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
					IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
				END
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 1) BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '12', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
						'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 12',
						null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 1', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

					IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
					IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
				END
			END

			IF @invoke IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT '' AS message
			END
			SELECT * FROM #mail
		END


	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEInvoiceStatusCheckInventory]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32), @p TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableNameInventory @VoucherCode, @table OUTPUT, @c OUTPUT

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @p = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_payment_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	CREATE TABLE #name (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))
	CREATE TABLE #payment (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))

	INSERT INTO #name SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI004' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI005' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI006' THEN 2 WHEN ccode = 'EI007' THEN 3 WHEN ccode = 'EI008' THEN 9 WHEN ccode = 'EI009' THEN 8 WHEN ccode = 'EI010' THEN 4 WHEN ccode = 'EI011' THEN 5 WHEN ccode = 'EI012' THEN 6 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI004', 'EI005', 'EI006', 'EI007', 'EI008', 'EI009', 'EI010', 'EI011', 'EI012')

	INSERT INTO #payment SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI014' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI015' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI016' THEN 2 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI014', 'EI015', 'EI016')


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct AS so_ct_hddt, so_ct AS so_seri_hddt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS mau_hddt, ma_kh, t_tien_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, status AS tinh_trang_hddt, status AS trang_thai_tt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS dich_vu_hddt INTO #result FROM m84$000000

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @p = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''1'', ''8'') or (isnull(b.trang_thai_tt, '''') = ''1'' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''2'', ''3'')))'
	ELSE SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''1'', ''8'')'

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
	IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, b.mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, b.tinh_trang_hddt, b.trang_thai_tt, 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @importType TINYINT
	SELECT @importType = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_import_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, ISNULL(c.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph INTO #type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN dmkieuphhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, c.dich_vu_hddt INTO #unit FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN tkhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1

	--- Update payment status
	UPDATE #result SET dich_vu_hddt = b.dich_vu_hddt, trang_thai_tt = CASE WHEN b.dich_vu_hddt = 1 THEN a.trang_thai_tt ELSE '' END FROM #result a JOIN #unit b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

	SELECT 0 AS tag, stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, tien_nt, ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, c.name AS tinh_trang, a.tinh_trang_hddt, ISNULL(d.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph,
		 ISNULL(a.trang_thai_tt, 0) AS trang_thai_tt, ISNULL(p.name, '') AS thanh_toan, a.dich_vu_hddt
		FROM #result a
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN #name c ON a.tinh_trang_hddt = c.code
			LEFT JOIN #type d ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs
			LEFT JOIN #payment p ON a.trang_thai_tt = p.code
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	DROP TABLE #result
	DROP TABLE #type
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTSRequisitionStatusReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@TSType VARCHAR(33),
