CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetFADeprAlloc]
	@nFrom NUMERIC(2),
	@nTo NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@cType CHAR(1), -- 0 - Post 2 GL, 1 - Post to ctpbts, 2 - View Detail, 3 - Post to ctpbtsd
	@cKey4ViewDetail NVARCHAR(4000),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') -- 2FCs
		BEGIN
			EXEC rs_GetFADeprAlloc42FCs @nFrom, @nTo, @nYear, @cType, @cKey4ViewDetail, @nUserID, @cUnit, @cAction
			RETURN
		END -- End 2FCs

	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @cRound VARCHAR(3), @cFCRound VARCHAR(3), @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @isSysDep BIT
	SELECT @cFCRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @cRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = 'fa_ma_bp' AND xtableref = 'dmbp') SET @isSysDep = 1 ELSE SET @isSysDep = 0

	IF @cAction = 'New'
		SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	ELSE
		SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightList(@nUserID)

	SELECT ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp AS ma_bp0, ma_bp AS ma_bp_ts, tk AS tk_kh, tk AS tk_cp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt
			, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
		INTO #tctkhts FROM wrkcolumns

	SET @strSQL = 'insert into #tctkhts select b.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN 'c.ma_bp0' ELSE 'a.ma_bp' END + ', a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, sum(a.gt_kh_ky), sum(a.gt_kh_ky_nt), '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
			+ ' from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN ' left join dmbpts c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp' ELSE '' END
			+ ' where a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@nYear) + ' and (a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@nFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@nTo) + ') and dbo.ff_InUnitRights(b.ma_dvcs, rtrim(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1'
			+ ' group by b.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN ', c.ma_bp0' ELSE '' END + ', a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@cUnit varchar(1023), @cUnits varchar(1023)', @cUnit, @cUnits

	-- Detail
	SELECT a.*, b.ma_dvcs, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt
		INTO #cthspbts 
		FROM cthspbts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE a.ky = @nTo AND a.nam = @nYear AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(b.ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1 

	UPDATE #cthspbts SET ma_bp_ts = b.ma_bp
		FROM #cthspbts a JOIN (
					SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts, ma_bp FROM ctkhts
						WHERE so_the_ts + STR(ky, 3) IN (
											SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(ky), 3) FROM ctkhts 
												WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky BETWEEN @nFrom AND @nTo
												GROUP BY so_the_ts
										)
					) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_bp_ts, '') = ''

	UPDATE #cthspbts SET ma_bp_ts = b.ma_bp
		FROM #cthspbts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_bp_ts, '') = ''

	-- Allocation table
	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #tpb
		FROM #tctkhts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts FROM #cthspbts)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
								'#tpb', 
								'so_the_ts', 
								'tien', 
								'#cthspbts', 
								'he_so', 
								'tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3',
								'1=1',
								@cRound
								)

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	--FC
	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
								'#tpb', 
								'so_the_ts', 
								'tien_nt', 
								'#cthspbts', 
								'he_so', 
								'tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3',
								'1=1',
								@cFCRound
								)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	DELETE #tctkhts WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts FROM #cthspbts)

	INSERT INTO #tctkhts(ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #cthspbts

	DELETE #tctkhts WHERE ABS(tien) + ABS(tien_nt) = 0
	UPDATE #tctkhts SET ma_bp0 = '' WHERE ma_bp0 IS NULL

	UPDATE #tctkhts SET ma_phi = b.ma_phi FROM #tctkhts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_phi, '') = ''

	IF @cType = '0'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, '' AS so_the_ts, ma_bp0, '' AS ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #tctkhts
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3

	IF @cType = '1'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, '' AS so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #tctkhts
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3

	IF @cType = '2' BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = 'select ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3 FROM #tctkhts WHERE ' + @cKey4ViewDetail
		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'order by ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, so_the_ts, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3'
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	END

	IF @cType = '3'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #tctkhts
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetOptions]
	@Parameter VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Output BIT OUTPUT,
	@Date SMALLDATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @provider INT, @value CHAR(1)

	IF @Date IS NULL SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	ELSE SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1 AND b.ngay_hl <= @Date ORDER BY b.ngay_hl DESC

	SELECT @Output = 0

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtkb WHERE params = @Parameter AND supplier = @provider AND value = '*') BEGIN
		SELECT @Output = 1
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Output = CASE WHEN a.value IN ('1', '*') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dmhddtkb a WHERE a.params = @Parameter AND a.supplier = @provider AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options b WHERE b.name = a.options AND b.val = '1')

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$String2GroupThree] (@String VARCHAR(500))
RETURNS 
@ReturnTable TABLE ([id] [INT] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [part] [VARCHAR](50) NULL)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @numberGroup INT, @modChar INT, @part VARCHAR(50)
	SET @modChar = LEN(@String) % 3
	IF @modChar > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @part = LEFT(@String,@modChar)
		INSERT  @ReturnTable(part) VALUES(@part)
		SELECT @String = RIGHT(@String, LEN(@String) - @modChar)
	END
	SET @numberGroup = LEN(@String)/3 
	WHILE @numberGroup > 0 BEGIN 
		SELECT @part = LEFT(@String,3)
		INSERT  @ReturnTable(part) VALUES (@part)
		SELECT @String = RIGHT(@String, LEN(@String) - 3)
		SELECT @numberGroup = LEN(@String)/3 
	END 
	RETURN 
END

GO

AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.mac_dinh_yn, a.truong_hoc, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.loai_tot_nghiep, a.ghi_chu, b.ten_tdhv, b.ten_tdhv2, c.ten_cn, c.ten_cn2
	FROM hrehv a LEFT JOIN hrdmtdhv  b ON a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv
	LEFT JOIN hrdmcn c ON a.ma_cn = c.ma_cn

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI113] -- Kết quả kinh doanh
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousBegin AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousEnd AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ReportType CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1, @ReportType = '1'
	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM biForm013
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		-- Luy ke nam nay
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		-- Luy ke nam truoc
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END
	END

	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(48), @Tk_co CHAR(48), @Giam_tru TINYINT, @Tk_kqkd VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Tk_no, Tk_co, Giam_tru FROM #report WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	SELECT @Tk_kqkd = (RTRIM(val) + '%') FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_TK_KQKD'
	
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
				END
			END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn, 
				Ky_truoc_nt = @Ky_truoc_nt, Ky_nay_nt = @Ky_nay_nt, Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt , Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	
	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc = 0 WHERE ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc_nt = 0 WHERE ky_truoc_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay_nt = 0 WHERE ky_nay_nt IS NULL

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT ma_so, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, CAST(ky_nay AS VARCHAR) AS ky_nay FROM #report WHERE in_ck = 1 ORDER BY Stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRewardList]
	@DateFromReward SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateToReward SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33),	
	@Gender CHAR(1), 
	@RewardType VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)	
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	
	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(5), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END
		
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Gender), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DateFromReward IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.ngay_ky >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFromReward, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateToReward IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.ngay_ky <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateToReward, 112) + ''''
	IF @RewardType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.hinh_thuc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@RewardType), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'

	-- @q	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, stt_rec0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select e.stt_rec, e.stt_rec0 from hrekt e with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on e.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, stt_rec0) SELECT '', ''
	
	SELECT @q = 'select case when a.stt_rec = '''' then 0 else a.stt end as stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', e.bo_phan, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri, z.hinh_thuc, z.ly_do, z.ngay_ky as ngay_kt, x.ten_kt%l as loai_kt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when a.stt_rec = '''' then '''' else case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' else N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' end end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrekt z on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = z.stt_rec0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrdmkt x on z.hinh_thuc = x.ma_kt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMonthlyAverageExRateList] -- fs20_GLPostingExchangeRateTable
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du
			, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, sua_tg_yn, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct1
		INTO #gl FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)	

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and (' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
		SET @Key = @Key + ' or ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'like', @Account) + ')'
	END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (c.loai_cl_no = 1 or c.loai_cl_co = 1 or e.loai_cl_no = 1 or e.loai_cl_co = 1)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct <> ''PK8'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and not (abs(a.ps_no) + abs(a.ps_no_nt) <> 0 and c.loai_cl_co = 1 and e.loai_cl_no = 1)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and not (abs(a.ps_co) + abs(a.ps_co_nt) <> 0 and c.loai_cl_no = 1 and e.loai_cl_co = 1)'
	-- Check @Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key) 

	-- @q 
	SET @q = 'insert into #gl'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, sua_tg_yn, b.ma_ct_in, b.ma_ct_in'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk left join dmtk e on a.tk_du = e.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
 	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, * INTO #report FROM #gl WHERE 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, * from #gl where left(stt_rec, 10) in (select left(stt_rec, 10) from r00$%Partition a with (nolock) where %[ma_ct = ''PK8'']% )'
	SET @q2 = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ', a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, sua_tg_yn, b.ma_ct_in, b.ma_ct_in'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[left(a.stt_rec, 10) in (select left(stt_rec, 10) from #gl) and a.ma_ct = ''PK8'']%'

	IF @Status = '1' OR @Status = '*' BEGIN		
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @Status = '2' OR @Status = '*' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, * FROM #gl WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM gltgdd) AND loai_ct = '1'
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, * FROM #gl WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM gltgdd) AND loai_ct = '5' AND sua_tg_yn = 1
	END

	UPDATE #report SET ma_ct1 = b.ma_ct0
		FROM (SELECT * FROM #report WHERE ma_ct = 'PK8') a JOIN (SELECT * FROM #report WHERE ma_ct <> 'PK8') b ON LEFT(a.stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(b.stt_rec, 10)

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.ma_ct, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, dien_giai, ma_vv, stt_rec, a.tk, tk_du
			, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct1
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
		ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct1, a.so_ct, stt_rec, nh_dk, line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoGenerateReceiptVoucherView]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@FormVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1: Sales, 2 - Service Invoice
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @baseCurrency CHAR(3), @ex CHAR(2)

	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@baseCurrency), '', '''') + '%', @KeyDetail = '', @ex = CASE WHEN @FormVoucher = '1' THEN '81' ELSE '21' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ps_no AS t_tt, a.ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl a

	-- Key
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%' + @KeyMaster
	SET @Key = @Key + 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	--
	IF @Account <> '' SELECT @KeyDetail = CASE WHEN @FormVoucher = '1' THEN '%#50$' ELSE '%#10$' END + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Account), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyDetail <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyDetail), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) = 0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')' ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))' END
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	IF @FormVoucher = '1' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from d' + @ex + '$%Partition c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec and c.km_yn = ''0'')'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt, b.ma_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from i' + @ex + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m' + @ex + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin, 1

	--
	DELETE #tmp FROM #tmp a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v02$000000 c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec_hd)

	-- View
	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, a.t_tt, a.ma_nt
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_TransferGetCode]
	@ID VARCHAR(32),
	@CheckPass VARCHAR(32),
	@@SysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c BIT, @pass VARCHAR(32), @keys VARCHAR(32), @hash VARCHAR(32), @rkey VARCHAR(32)
	SET @q = 'exec ' + @@SysDatabaseName + '..FastBusiness$System$CheckSum ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''' + REPLACE(@CheckPass, '''', '''''') + ''', 0, @c output'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c bit output', @c OUTPUT

	IF @c = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS value
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @pass = password, @keys = keys, @rkey = rkey from ' + @@SysDatabaseName + '..userinfo2 where id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@pass varchar(32) output, @keys varchar(32) output, @rkey varchar(32) output', @pass OUTPUT, @keys OUTPUT, @rkey OUTPUT
		SELECT SUBSTRING(@keys, 3, 1) + SUBSTRING(@pass, 2, LEN(@pass) - 2) + SUBSTRING(@keys, 2, 1) AS pass, @rkey AS rkey, ma_so AS code FROM dmscsl WHERE id = @ID
		RETURN
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_UpdateCoBCTManualData(
		@dReport SMALLDATETIME, 
		@cPrd VARCHAR(33), 
		@cDept VARCHAR(33), 
		@cMO VARCHAR(33), 
		@cUnit VARCHAR(1023), 
		@RPCode CHAR(2), 
		@cForm VARCHAR(16), 
		@cReportTable VARCHAR(32), 
		@cColumnName VARCHAR(32),
		@cColumnOrder CHAR(2),
		@cColumnType CHAR(1)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQLRet NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strSQLRet = 'UPDATE %Table SET %ColumnName = b.%Field'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' FROM %Table a JOIN ('
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' SELECT * FROM xcobct0 WHERE dreport = %dReport AND ma_sp = %cPrd AND ma_bp = %cDept AND dbo.xf20_GetMO(so_lsx) = dbo.xf20_GetMO(%cMO)'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' AND form = %cForm AND ma_dvcs = %cUnit AND ma_bc = %RPCode AND cot = %cColumnOrder'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' ) b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'

	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Table', @cReportTable)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%ColumnName', @cColumnName)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Field', CASE WHEN @cColumnType = 'D' THEN 'ngay' WHEN @cColumnType = 'N' THEN 'so' ELSE 'chu' END)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%dReport', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @dReport, 102) + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cPrd', CHAR(39) + @cPrd + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cDept', CHAR(39) + @cDept + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cMO', CHAR(39) + @cMO + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cUnit', CHAR(39) + @cUnit + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%RPCode', CHAR(39) + @RPCode + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cColumnOrder', CHAR(39) + @cColumnOrder + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cForm', CHAR(39) + @cForm + CHAR(39))
	RETURN @strSQLRet
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetSQLFieldsType](@cTable VARCHAR(16), @cType VARCHAR(128))
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strReturn VARCHAR(4000), @cName VARCHAR(64)
	SET @strReturn =''
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CASE WHEN @strReturn <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + name
		FROM syscolumns a
			WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE name = @cTable) AND
				EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM systypes b WHERE CHARINDEX(name, @cType) > 0 AND a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype)
	RETURN @strReturn
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$PostAuthorize]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@action CHAR(1), -- 1 - Approve, 2 - Cancel
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@role VARCHAR(32) = '', -- Direct Approval
	@remoteApprove BIT = 0,
	@CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@voucherApproveLog BIT = 1,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@command NVARCHAR(4000) = '' -- Query after sent mail(s).
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(32), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @detailTable VARCHAR(32), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(128),
		@status VARCHAR(32), @uStatus VARCHAR(32), @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @recordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(32), @lastUser INT, @getMailList_yn BIT, @notifyMail BIT,
		@datetime2 DATETIME, @created_mail_yn BIT, @createdUser INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @status = '', @uStatus = '', @curStatus = '', @recordHasBeenChanged = '', @notifyMail = 0, @lastUser = 0, @created_mail_yn = 0, @createdUser = 0, @getMailList_yn = 1, @UnitKey = '', @admin = 0, @voucherCode = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Direct Approval(approve by voucher)
	IF @role <> '' SET @getMailList_yn = 0

	-- Struct
	SELECT @GeneralTable = '', @MasterTable = '', @DetailTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @HisTable = '', @Dyn = ''
	SELECT @GeneralTable = c$, @MasterTable = m$, @DetailTable = d$, @InquiryTable = i$, @HisTable = a$ FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @GeneralTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @Dyn OUTPUT
		IF RIGHT(@MasterTable, 1) = '$' SET @MasterTable = @MasterTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@DetailTable, 1) = '$' SET @DetailTable = @DetailTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@InquiryTable, 1) = '$' SET @InquiryTable = @InquiryTable + @Dyn
	END

	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #listuser select max(stt), user_id4 from ' + @HisTable + ' where xtype in (''1'', ''2'') and reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idnumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC


	-- Get Created User
	SET @q = 'select @u = user_id0, @v = u_status from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@u int output, @v varchar(32) output', @createdUser OUTPUT, @curStatus OUTPUT


	-- Check remote aprrove
	IF @remoteApprove = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @d = datetime2 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d datetime output', @datetime2 OUTPUT

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id = @userID AND datetime2 = @datetime2) BEGIN
			SELECT '1' AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END


	-- Get Role
	IF @role = '' BEGIN
		--
		DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @msg = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END

		--
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #listUser WHERE user_id = @userID) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		--
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')

		--
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SET @q = @q + ' and status <> ''*'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @curStatus = u_status, @CategoryApprove = kieu_duyet FROM #role

		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalRole @voucherType, @userID, @curStatus, @CategoryApprove, @role OUTPUT

		IF @role = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE IF @curStatus IN ('', '0') SELECT @curStatus = '1'

	-- Get next status
	SELECT @uStatus = CASE WHEN @action = '1' THEN status2 ELSE status0 END, @notifyMail = notify_mail_yn, @created_mail_yn = created_mail_yn FROM gndmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @curStatus AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove
	SELECT @status = s_status FROM gndmttcttg WHERE u_status = @uStatus AND loai_duyet = @voucherType


	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''', @Status = REPLACE(@Status, '''', '')


	-- Update table
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set'
	SET @q = @q + ' xtag = status, status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@UStatus, '''', '') + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @InquiryTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @GeneralTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- After update
	CREATE TABLE #processData(stt_rec CHAR(13), xtype VARCHAR(32))
	IF @voucherCode IN ('BN1', 'PC1') AND @status = '0' BEGIN		
		IF @getMailList_yn = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #processData(stt_rec) select distinct stt_rec_dn as stt_rec from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt_rec_dn <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PaymentRequest @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', '52', @userID
	END

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1', @commentApproval

	-- Reset
	SET @q = '
		declare @minReset int, @stt int
		select @minReset = 0, @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @hisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''

		if exists(select 1 from gndmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @HisTable + '
				where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
					and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + '''
					and stt < @stt
					and stt in (select a.stt from ' + @HisTable + ' a
						join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + @HisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'')
			update ' + @HisTable + ' set reset = reset + 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt > @minReset
		end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Log
	IF @voucherApproveLog = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gndmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND u_status = @uStatus and (user_id4 = 0 OR user_id4 = @userID)) BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Log @idNumber, @voucherCode, @Dyn, '1'
	END


	-- Mail
	IF @getMailList_yn = 1 BEGIN
		-- Notify Mail
		IF @notifyMail = 0 SET @lastUser = 0
		-- Created Mail
		IF @created_mail_yn = 0 SET @createdUser = 0

		DECLARE @notifyGroup VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000), @invokeProcess NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @notifyGroup = '', @invoke = '', @invokeProcess = ''
		SELECT @notifyGroup = notify_group FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

		CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
		INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @Dyn, @voucherType, @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser

		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetNotifyAndMail @pushNotify, @pushNotifyDevice, @userID, @sysDatabaseName, '#processData', @invokeProcess OUTPUT
		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetNotify @notifyGroup, @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, @pushNotify, @pushNotifyDevice, @userID, @sysDatabaseName, '#mail', @invoke OUTPUT

		IF @invokeProcess <> '' SELECT @invoke = @invoke + CASE WHEN @invoke = '' THEN '' ELSE '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' END + @invokeProcess
		SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify, @command AS command
		SELECT * FROM #mail
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO


CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency$EN] (
	@cCurrencyCode CHAR(3),
	@mAmount MONEY
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @cNumInWord VARCHAR(4000), @nRandec INT, @cRa12 VARCHAR(128), @cRa22 VARCHAR(128), @cRa32 VARCHAR(128), @cRa42 VARCHAR(128), @cRa52 VARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @cNumInWord = ''
	SET @mAmount = ISNULL(@mAmount,0)
	SELECT @nRandec = ra_ndec, @cRa12 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_12)) , @cRa22 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_22)) , @cRa32 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_32)),
			@cRa42 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_42)), @cRa52 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_52)) FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt = @cCurrencyCode

	IF ((@nRandec = 0) OR (CAST(RIGHT(STR(ABS(@mAmount),18, @nRandec), @nRandec) AS INT) = 0))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @cNumInWord = @cRa12 + CASE WHEN @mAmount >= 0 THEN ' ' ELSE ' Minus ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Number2Words$EN(@mAmount)+ ' ' + @cRa22 + CASE @cRa22 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END + @cRa52
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @cNumInWord = @cRa12 + CASE WHEN @mAmount >= 0 THEN ' ' ELSE ' Minus ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Number2Words$EN(FLOOR(ABS(@mAmount))) + ' ' + @cRa22 + CASE @cRa22 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END +
							@cRa32 + CASE @cRa32 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Number2Words$EN(CAST(RIGHT(STR(@mAmount,18, @nRandec), @nRandec) AS INT))  + ' ' + @cRa42
	END
	RETURN LTRIM(RTRIM(@cNumInWord))

END








GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetInsertGroup2
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18),
	@cxGroup VARCHAR(128)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @c3 VARCHAR(32), @c4 VARCHAR(32), @c5 VARCHAR(32), @c6 NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			IF EXISTS(SELECT xfieldkey FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @c1 = xfieldkey, @c2 = xtableref, @c3 = xfieldkeyref, @c4 = xfieldnameref, @c5 = xfieldnameref2, @c6 = xkeyref FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @c1 ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @c1
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ', ' + @cxGroup + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.' + @c4 + '),MAX(b.' + @c5 + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')' + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ' + @c2 + ' WHERE ' + @c6 + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' b ON a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c3 + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ', ' + @cxGroup + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')' + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a '
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
END


GO
/*
**	If the property already exists, reset the value; otherwise add property
**		id -- the id in sysobjects of the object
**		property -- the name of the property
**		value -- the text value of the property
**		lvalue -- the binary value of the property (image)
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_setpropertybyid
	@id int,
	@property varchar(64),
	@value varchar(255),
	@lvalue image
as
	set nocount on
	declare @uvalue nvarchar(255) 
	set @uvalue = convert(nvarchar(255), @value) 
	if exists (select * from dbo.dtproperties 
			where objectid=@id and property=@property)
	begin
		--
		-- bump the version count for this row as we update it
		--
		update dbo.dtproperties set value=@value, uvalue=@uvalue, lvalue=@lvalue, version=version+1
			where objectid=@id and property=@property
	end
	else
	begin
		--
		-- version count is auto-set to 0 on initial insert
		--
		insert dbo.dtproperties (property, objectid, value, uvalue, lvalue)
			values (@property, @id, @value, @uvalue, @lvalue)
	end




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJobActivity] --fs20_AccountJob--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@isSubJob BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @Du_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ps_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Du_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @JobKey NVARCHAR(1024)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai, tk_du
			, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'status = ''1''', @JobKey = ''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)	
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Job <> '' BEGIN
		IF @isSubJob = 0 SELECT @JobKey = 'a.ma_vv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @isSubJob = 1 SELECT @JobKey = 'dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @JobKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai, tk_du'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000), @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @JoinClause = '', @WhereClause = @JobKey

	IF @Customer <> '' SET @WhereClause = @WhereClause + CASE WHEN @WhereClause <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' ma_kh like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
--	IF @isSubJob = 1 SET @WhereClause = @WhereClause + CASE WHEN @WhereClause = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and' END+ ' dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + ''', ma_vv) = 1'

    SELECT ma_vv, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #b FROM wrkgl
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Job @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, '', 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @JoinClause, @WhereClause

 	SELECT @Du_dk = du, @Du_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t
	IF @Du_dk IS NULL SET @Du_dk = 0
	IF @Du_dk_nt IS NULL SET @Du_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @Ps_no = SUM(ps_no), @Ps_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @Ps_co = SUM(ps_co), @Ps_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	IF @Ps_no IS NULL SET @Ps_no = 0
	IF @Ps_co IS NULL SET @Ps_co = 0
	IF @Ps_no_nt IS NULL SET @Ps_no_nt = 0
	IF @Ps_co_nt IS NULL SET @Ps_co_nt = 0

	SET @Du_ck = @Du_dk + @Ps_no - @Ps_co
	SET @Du_ck_nt = @Du_dk_nt + @Ps_no_nt - @Ps_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, 
				CASE WHEN @Du_dk >= 0 THEN @Du_dk ELSE 0 END, 
				CASE WHEN @Du_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @Du_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
				CASE WHEN @Du_dk < 0 THEN -@Du_dk ELSE 0 END, 
				CASE WHEN @Du_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@Du_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
				)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @Ps_no, @Ps_no_nt, @Ps_co, @Ps_co_nt)
	
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
			CASE WHEN @Du_ck >= 0 THEN @Du_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @Du_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @Du_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @Du_ck < 0 THEN -@Du_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @Du_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@Du_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)
		
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)
	
	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_kh, ma_vv, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du
			, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
			LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct 
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, c.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COAllocatedArisingCost]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Dept VARCHAR(33), 
	@FactorType VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k1 NVARCHAR(4000), @k2 NVARCHAR(4000), @k3 NVARCHAR(4000),  @q NVARCHAR(4000), @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_yt VARCHAR(33), @sKey VARCHAR(128), @naRound VARCHAR(3), @nfaRound VARCHAR(3), @nqaRound VARCHAR(3), @objectUnit CHAR(1)

	SELECT @naRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @nfaRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'
	SELECT @nqaRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_SL'
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'

	-- Key
	SELECT @k1 = 'a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Dept <> '' SET @k1 = @k1 + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @k3 = @k1
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k1 = @k1 + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'
	SET @k1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k1)
	
	SET @k2 = '(th_sp = 0' + CASE WHEN @costDept = '1' THEN ' or th_bp = 0' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @costMO = '1' THEN ' or th_lsx = 0' ELSE '' END + ')'
	IF @FactorType <> '' SET @k2 = @k2 + ' and loai_yt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FactorType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k2 = @k2 + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @k2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k2)
	
	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt INTO #xcppstk FROM xcppstk 
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt 	

	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #xcppstk select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcppstk a with(nolock) where ' + @k1
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @objectUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
		SET @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs(ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx INTO #xdmyt0 FROM xdmyt
		SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt0(ma_dvcs, ma_yt, th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select rtrim(a.ma_dvcs), rtrim(a.ma_yt), a.th_sp, a.th_bp, a.th_lsx, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx'
		SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a join #dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs where 1 = 1 ' 
		IF @FactorType <> '' SET @q = @q + + ' and loai_yt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FactorType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #xdmyt0 SET x_dt_sp = 1, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0
		INSERT INTO #xdmyt(ma_dvcs, ma_yt) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt FROM #xdmyt0 WHERE th_sp = 0 OR (x_dt_bp = 1 AND th_bp = 0) OR (x_dt_lsx = 1 AND th_lsx = 0)
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a with(nolock) where ' + @k2 + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Allocate
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt FROM #xdmyt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM xctpbtg b WHERE b.ky = @Period AND b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs) ORDER BY a.ma_yt
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ma_dvcs, @ma_yt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @sKey = @k3 + ' and a.ma_dvcs = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_dvcs), '''', '''''') + CHAR(39) + ' and a.ma_yt = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_yt), '''', '''''') + CHAR(39)
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
				'#xcppstk', 
				dbo.xf20_GetGatherFields(@ma_dvcs, @ma_yt), 
				'ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, sl_tk', 
				'xctpbtg', 
				'he_so', 
				dbo.xf20_GetRemainFields(@ma_dvcs, @ma_yt),
				@sKey,
				@naRound + ', ' + @nfaRound + ', ' + @nqaRound
			)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q	
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ma_dvcs, @ma_yt
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	-- Delete
	SET @q = 'delete xctkqpb from xctkqpb a join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt where ' + @k1
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Insert
	SET @q = 'insert into xctkqpb (ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3'
	SET @q = @q + ', s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ', ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', getdate(), getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctpbtg a with(nolock) join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @k1
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodPurchaseAnalysis] 
	@Time AS CHAR(1),
	@Count AS INT,
	@DateStart AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32), 	
	@Supplier AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),  
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Size TINYINT, 
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024), @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sQuantity NVARCHAR(1024), @sAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @sFCAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sQuantity = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT001'
	SELECT @sAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT022'
	SELECT @sFCAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT023'
	
	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien0, tien_nt0 INTO #tmp FROM wrkin	
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xCycle, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien0, tien_nt0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS cKey INTO #report FROM wrkin
	
	SELECT @DateEnd = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12 * @Count, @DateStart) END)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nxt = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Supplier <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Supplier), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 + @ItemType <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(case when ma_nt = '''' or  ma_nt = ''' + RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) + ''' then 0 else a.tien_nt_n end) from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(case when ma_nt = '''' or  ma_nt = ''' + RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) + ''' then 0 else a.tien_nt_n end) from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin	
	END

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @DateStart
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
				WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @d) END)
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, @i, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien0), SUM(tien_nt0), @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @d AND @d2 GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 0, @i, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1	
	END

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #o (stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, ma_vt VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
	CREATE INDEX o ON #o(ma_vt)
	INSERT INTO #o SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, 0, '', 0, 0, 0, ''
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, a.stt, REPLACE(STR(a.xCycle, 3), ' ', '0') AS xCycle, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien0 AS tien2, a.tien_nt0 AS tien_nt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, b.dvt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.xCycle

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header INT NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT DISTINCT xCycle FROM #report ORDER BY xCycle
	
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'so_luong$', @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien2$', @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien_nt2$', @sFCAmount

	SELECT a.id, b.id AS id2, b.name + LTRIM(a.id) AS name, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(a.header) + ' - ' + b.header AS header
		INTO #pivot 
		FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b 
	
	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 1, 'so_luong', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien_nt2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sFCAmount

	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, id2
	DROP TABLE #pivot

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
