CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetFADeprAlloc42FCs]
	@nFrom NUMERIC(2),
	@nTo NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@cType CHAR(1), -- 0 - Post 2 GL, 1 - Post to ctpbts, 2 - View Detail
	@cKey4ViewDetail NVARCHAR(4000),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @cRound VARCHAR(3), @cFCRound VARCHAR(3), @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @isSysDep BIT
	SELECT @cRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @cFCRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = 'fa_ma_bp' AND xtableref = 'dmbp') SET @isSysDep = 1 ELSE SET @isSysDep = 0

	IF  @cAction = 'New'
		SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	ELSE
		SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightList(@nUserID)

	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts, c.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, SUM(a.gt_kh_ky) AS tien, SUM(a.gt_kh_ky_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #infodata FROM vctkhtsfc a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts LEFT JOIN dmbpts c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

	SET @strSQL = 'insert into #infodata select b.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN 'c.ma_bp0' ELSE 'a.ma_bp' END + ', a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, sum(a.gt_kh_ky), sum(a.gt_kh_ky_nt)'
		+ ' from vctkhtsfc a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN ' left join dmbpts c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp' ELSE '' END
		+ ' where a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@nYear) + ' and (a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@nFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@nTo) + ') and dbo.ff_InUnitRights(b.ma_dvcs, rtrim(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1'
		+ ' group by b.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN ', c.ma_bp0' ELSE '' END + ', a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@cUnit varchar(1023), @cUnits varchar(1023)', @cUnit, @cUnits
	
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		, MAX(b.ma_kh) AS ma_kh, MAX(b.ma_vv) AS ma_vv, MAX(b.ma_sp) AS ma_sp
		, MAX(b.ma_hd) AS ma_hd, MAX(b.ma_ku) AS ma_ku, MAX(b.ma_phi) AS ma_phi, MAX(b.so_lsx) AS so_lsx
		, MAX(b.ma_td1) AS ma_td1, MAX(b.ma_td2) AS ma_td2, MAX(b.ma_td3) AS ma_td3
		INTO #tctkhts FROM #infodata a LEFT JOIN wrkColumns b ON 1=1
		GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp

	-- Detail
	SELECT a.*, b.ma_dvcs, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt
		INTO #cthspbts 
		FROM vcthspbtsfc a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(b.ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
		WHERE a.ky = @nTo AND a.nam = @nYear

	UPDATE #cthspbts SET ma_bp_ts = b.ma_bp
		FROM #cthspbts a JOIN (
					SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts, ma_bp FROM vctkhtsfc
						WHERE so_the_ts + STR(ky, 3) IN (
											SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(ky), 3) FROM vctkhtsfc 
												WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky BETWEEN @nFrom AND @nTo
												GROUP BY so_the_ts
										)
					) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_bp_ts, '') = ''
	
	UPDATE #cthspbts SET ma_bp_ts = b.ma_bp
		FROM #cthspbts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_bp_ts, '') = ''

	-- Allocation table
	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #tpb
		FROM #tctkhts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts FROM #cthspbts)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
								'#tpb', 
								'so_the_ts', 
								'tien', 
								'#cthspbts', 
								'he_so', 
								'tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3',
								'1=1',
								@cRound
								)

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	--FC
	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
								'#tpb', 
								'so_the_ts', 
								'tien_nt', 
								'#cthspbts', 
								'he_so', 
								'tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3',
								'1=1',
								@cFCRound
								)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	DELETE #tctkhts WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT DISTINCT so_the_ts FROM #cthspbts)

	INSERT INTO #tctkhts(ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #cthspbts

	DELETE #tctkhts WHERE ABS(tien) + ABS(tien_nt) = 0
	UPDATE #tctkhts SET ma_bp0 = '' WHERE ma_bp0 IS NULL

	UPDATE #tctkhts SET ma_phi = b.ma_phi FROM #tctkhts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_phi, '') = ''

	IF @cType = '0'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, '' AS so_the_ts, ma_bp0, '' AS ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #tctkhts
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3

	IF @cType = '1'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, '' AS so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			FROM #tctkhts
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3

	IF @cType = '2' BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = 'SELECT ma_dvcs, so_the_ts, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3 FROM #tctkhts WHERE ' + @cKey4ViewDetail
		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, so_the_ts, tien, tien_nt, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3'
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	END
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ff_GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(	
	@dDate AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@nType AS TINYINT -- 1 - Begin, 2 - End
)
RETURNS @tabRet  TABLE (y INT, y0 INT, p0 INT, dStart SMALLDATETIME, dEnd SMALLDATETIME)
AS  
BEGIN
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME, @dLock SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @dLock = ngay_ks FROM dmstt	

	IF @nType = 1
		IF @dLock < @dDate
			BEGIN
				IF YEAR(@dLock) < YEAR(@dDate)
					SELECT @y = YEAR(@dDate), @y0 = 0, @p0 = 0, @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dDate), @dEnd = @dDate - 1
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = YEAR(@dDate), @p0 = CASE WHEN @dLock = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) THEN MONTH(@dLock) + 1 ELSE MONTH(@dLock) END
						SELECT @dStart = CASE WHEN @dLock = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) THEN dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock) + 1, YEAR(@dLock)) ELSE dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) END
						SELECT @dEnd = @dDate - 1
					END
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @dDate = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dDate)
					SELECT @y = YEAR(@dDate), @y0 = 0, @p0 = 0, @dStart = '20000102', @dEnd = '20000101'
				ELSE
					SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = YEAR(@dDate), @p0 = MONTH(@dDate), @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dDate), YEAR(@dDate)), @dEnd = @dDate - 1
			END
	ELSE -- @nType = 2
		IF @dLock < @dDate
			BEGIN
				IF YEAR(@dLock) < YEAR(@dDate)
					SELECT @y = YEAR(@dDate), @y0 = 0, @p0 = 0, @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dDate), @dEnd = @dDate
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = YEAR(@dDate), @p0 = CASE WHEN @dLock = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) THEN MONTH(@dLock) + 1 ELSE MONTH(@dLock) END
						SELECT @dStart = CASE WHEN @dLock = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) THEN dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock) + 1, YEAR(@dLock)) ELSE dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock)) END
						SELECT @dEnd = @dDate
					END
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @dDate = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dDate)
					SELECT @y = YEAR(@dDate), @y0 = 0, @p0 = 0, @dStart = @dDate, @dEnd = @dDate
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @y0 = YEAR(@dDate), @p0 = MONTH(@dDate)
						IF DAY(@dDate) = DAY(dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p0, @y0)) AND @dLock >= dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p0, @y0)
							IF @p0 = 12
								SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = @y0 + 1, @p0 = 1, @dStart = '20000102', @dEnd = '20000101'
							ELSE
								SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = @y0, @p0 = @p0 + 1, @dStart = '20000102', @dEnd = '20000101'
						ELSE
							SELECT @y = 0, @y0 = @y0, @p0 = @p0, @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p0, @y0), @dEnd = @dDate
					END
			END

	INSERT INTO @tabRet SELECT @y AS y, @y0 AS y0, @p0 AS p0, @dStart AS dStart, @dEnd AS dEnd
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI114]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DatePreviousBegin SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DatePreviousEnd SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Form CHAR(16) , 
	@Account VARCHAR(1023),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	CREATE TABLE #tmp (tk VARCHAR(1024))
	DECLARE @Kind CHAR(1), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(512), @Tk_co CHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
		, @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_naynt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truocnt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @i INT, @ds_tk VARCHAR(1023), @ReportType CHAR(1)

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1, @ReportType = '1'

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')

	--Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM biForm014
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #balanceKN FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceKT FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKN FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKT FROM #balanceKN

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by tk, tk_du'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Balance
	DECLARE @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @WhereClause = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	--
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKN EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKT EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DatePreviousBegin0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKN
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKN' GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKT
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKT' GROUP BY tk
	--
	SELECT tk INTO #acct FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	
	DECLARE Cal_Cur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT kind, ma_so, tk_no, tk_co FROM #report WHERE kind <> '0'
	OPEN Cal_Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
			IF @Tk_no = '#'	BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_co)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_co, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00	WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_no
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_co) = 1	
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''	
										
				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_co <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so


				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_co = '#' BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_no)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_no, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00	WHERE Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_co
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_no) = 1
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_no <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_no <> '#' AND @Tk_co <> '#' BEGIN
				IF @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
					
					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
				END
			END
		END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt , Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt 
				, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt , Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co
	END
	CLOSE Cal_Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cal_Cur

	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = 0 WHERE Ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = 0 WHERE ky_naynt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = 0 WHERE Ky_truocnt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = - ky_nay, ky_truoc = - ky_truoc, ky_naynt = - ky_naynt, ky_truocnt = - ky_truocnt 
		, Lk_kn = - Lk_kn, Lk_kt = - Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = - Lk_kn_nt, Lk_kt_nt = -  Lk_kt_nt
		WHERE dau = 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_nay) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truoc) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_naynt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truocnt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT ma_so,CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, CAST(ky_nay AS VARCHAR) AS ky_nay FROM #report WHERE in_ck = 1 ORDER BY Stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptDisciplineViolator]
	@DisciplineDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DisciplineDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33), 
	@Gender CHAR(1),
	@Discipline VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1028),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	
	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(5), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END
		
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Gender), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DisciplineDateFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.ngay_ky >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DisciplineDateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DisciplineDateTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.ngay_ky <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DisciplineDateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Discipline <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.hinh_thuc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Discipline), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'
	
	-- @q	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, stt_rec0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select e.stt_rec, e.stt_rec0 from hrekl e with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on e.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, stt_rec0) SELECT '', ''
	
	SELECT @q = ' select case when a.stt_rec = '''' then 0 else a.stt end as stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', e.bo_phan, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri, z.hinh_thuc, z.ly_do, z.ngay_ky as ngay_kl, x.ten_kl%l as loai_kl'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when a.stt_rec = '''' then '''' else case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' else N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' end end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrekl z on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = z.stt_rec0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrdmkl x on z.hinh_thuc = x.ma_kl'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$Report$GetFields]
	@Table VARCHAR(128),
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128),
	@isBiMode VARCHAR(1) OUTPUT,
	@Key NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
	@Fields VARCHAR(8000) OUTPUT,
	@Debug TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @isBiMode = '0', @Fields = ''
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PlantKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @q = '', @Fields = '', @isBiMode = '1'
	SELECT @Fields = CASE WHEN @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL THEN ', %o.ma_bp0' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL THEN ', %g.ma_nh0' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @PlantCode IS NOT NULL THEN ', %p.ma_vung' ELSE '' END

	SELECT REPLACE(data, ' ', '') AS t INTO #t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Table, ',')
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'alter table ' + t + ' add ma_bp0 varchar(32) null;' ELSE '' END +
		CASE WHEN @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'alter table ' + t + ' add ma_nh0 varchar(32) null;' ELSE '' END +
		CASE WHEN @PlantCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'alter table ' + t + ' add ma_vung varchar(32) null;' ELSE '' END
	FROM #t
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	ELSE EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	--
	IF @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('%o.ma_bp0', @PurOrgCode, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	END
	IF @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter '%g.ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGrKey OUTPUT, '2'
		IF @PurGrCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and %g.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGrCode), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
		IF @PurGrKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PurGrKey + ')'
	END
	IF @PlantCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter '%p.ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and %p.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PlantCode), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PlantKey + ')'
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff30_GetSQLReverse(
		@cTable VARCHAR(32), 
		@cMasterTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
		@cJoin VARCHAR(128) = ''
		)
RETURNS VARCHAR(8000)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strCol VARCHAR(8000), @strSQL VARCHAR(8000), @cView VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @nColID INT, @cColName NVARCHAR(64),  @cColName0 NVARCHAR(64), @cColName2 NVARCHAR(64), @xType INT, @cType CHAR(1), @nCount INT
	
	SELECT @cType = xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@cTable) AND xType IN ('U', 'V')
	SELECT @nCount = 1
	IF @cType IS NULL RETURN ''

	SELECT @strCol = '', @nColID = 1, @cView = CASE WHEN @cType ='U' THEN 'v' ELSE ''  END + RTRIM(@cTable) + 'fc'
	WHILE @nColID IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @cColName0 = NULL, @cColName2 = NULL
			SELECT @cColName = a.name, @xType = a.xtype FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE b.name = @cTable AND colid = @nColID
			SELECT @cColName2 = a.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE b.name = @cTable AND a.xtype = 108 AND CHARINDEX('_nt', a.name) > 0 AND (REPLACE(a.name, '_nt', '') = @cColName)
			SELECT @cColName0 = a.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE b.name = @cTable AND a.xtype = 108 AND CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName) > 0 AND (REPLACE(@cColName, '_nt', '') = a.name)
			--Ngắt dòng
			IF @nCount % 12 = 0 OR dbo.ff_Inlist(@cColName, 'status,ma_td1,s1,ma_nt,fcode1') > 0 SELECT @strCol = @strCol + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9), @nCount = 0
			
			IF (@cColName0 IS NULL AND @cColName2 IS NULL)
				SELECT @strCol = @strCol + CASE WHEN @cColName = 'ma_nt' THEN ' dbo.ff30_FCC(ma_nt) AS ma_nt' + ',' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) ELSE ' a.' + @cColName + ',' END
			ELSE
				BEGIN 
					SELECT @strCol = @strCol + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + ' CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN ' 
							 + ISNULL(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName0) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName) > 0 THEN 'dbo.ff30_FCVal(' + 'a.' + @cColName0 + ', ma_nt)' ELSE  'a.' + @cColName0 END, '')
							 + ISNULL(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName2) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName) > 0 THEN 'dbo.ff30_FCVal(' + 'a.' + @cColName2 + ', ma_nt)' ELSE  'a.' + @cColName2 END, '')
							 + ' ELSE '
							 + ISNULL(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('_nt', @cColName) > 0 THEN 'dbo.ff30_FCVal(' + 'a.' + @cColName + ', ma_nt)' ELSE  'a.' + @cColName END, '')
							 + ' END AS ' + @cColName + ','
					SELECT @nCount = -1
				END
			SELECT @nCount = @nCount + 1
		SELECT @nColID = MIN(colid) FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE b.name = @cTable AND colid > @nColID
		END

	SELECT @strCol = LEFT(@strCol, LEN(@strCol) - 1)

	SELECT @strSQL = 'SELECT' + REPLACE(@strCol, CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + CHAR(13), CHAR(13)) + CHAR(13) + 'FROM ' + RTRIM(@cTable) + ' a'  + CASE WHEN @cMasterTable <> '' THEN ' LEFT JOIN ' + @cMasterTable + ' b' + ' ON ' + RTRIM(@cJoin) ELSE '' END 
	RETURN @strSQL
END






GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_InsertParentRecords] (
	-- Report Data
	@t1 VARCHAR(16) /* Table */, @c1 VARCHAR(16) /* Code */, @p1 VARCHAR(16), -- Parent

	@s VARCHAR(1024) /* Sum */, @o VARCHAR(16) /* Order */, @l VARCHAR(16), -- Level

	-- List
	@t2 VARCHAR(16) /* Table */, @c2 VARCHAR(16) /* Code */, @p2 VARCHAR(16), -- Parent

	@m VARCHAR(1024) = '', -- Max
	-- Norm
	@t3 VARCHAR(16) = '' /* Table */, @c3 VARCHAR(16) = '' /* Code */,
	@k VARCHAR(16) = '' -- Key Filter

) RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ts TABLE(f VARCHAR(32), id INT)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(MAX), @$u VARCHAR(MAX), @$s VARCHAR(MAX), @$m VARCHAR(MAX), @$i VARCHAR(MAX), @$t CHAR(1)

	SELECT @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '''', ''), ' ', ''), @$u = '', @$s = '', @$i = '', @$m = '', @$t = CASE WHEN @t3 = '' OR @c3 = '' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END

	IF @m <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @tm TABLE(f VARCHAR(32), id INT)
		SELECT @m = REPLACE(REPLACE(@m, '''', ''), ' ', '')
		INSERT INTO @tm SELECT RTRIM(data), id FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@m,',')

		SELECT @$m = @$m + CASE WHEN @$m = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + 'max(a.' + RTRIM(f) + ') as ' + RTRIM(f),
			@$i = @$i + CASE WHEN @$i = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + 'b.' + RTRIM(f) FROM @tm ORDER BY id
	END

	INSERT INTO @ts SELECT RTRIM(data), id FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@s,',')
	SELECT @$u = @$u + CASE WHEN @$u = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + RTRIM(f) + ' = a.' + RTRIM(f) + ' + b.' + RTRIM(f),
		@$s = @$s + CASE WHEN @$s = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + 'sum(a.' + RTRIM(f) + ') as ' + RTRIM(f),
		@$i = @$i + CASE WHEN @$i = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + 'b.' + RTRIM(f) FROM @ts ORDER BY id



	SELECT @q = 'declare @g table(%p1 varchar(32), %c1 varchar(32), path varchar(max));' + CASE @$t
		WHEN '1' THEN 'declare @o table (%c3 varchar(32));insert into @o select %c3 from %t3 %k group by %c3 order by %c3;'
		ELSE ''
	END + '; with e(%c1, %p1, path, e) as (
	select distinct a.%c1, b.%p2, cast('','' + cast(a.%c1 as varchar(32)) + '','' as varchar(max)), 0 from %t1 a join %t2 b on a.%c1 = b.%c2
	union all
	select e.%p1, b.%p2, e.path + cast(e.%p1 as varchar(32)) + '','', case when e.path like ''%,'' + cast(e.%p1 as varchar(32)) + '',%'' then 1 else 0 end
		from e e join %t2 b on e.%p1 = b.%c2 and e.e = 0
), f as (
	select distinct %c1, %p1 from e
), g(%p1, %c1, path, e) as (
	select %c1, %c1, cast('','' + cast(%c1 as varchar(32)) + '','' as varchar(max)), 0 from e
	union all
	select g.%p1, a.%c1, g.path + cast(a.%c1 as varchar(32)) + '','', case when g.path like ''%,'' + cast(a.%c1 as varchar(32)) + '',%'' then 1 else 0 end
		from e a join g g on a.%p1 = g.%c1 and g.e = 0
)

insert into @g select distinct %p1, %c1, path from g where e = 0;


merge %t1 as a using (
	select b.%p1 as %c1, max(a.%o) as %o, max(a.%l) as %l, max(a.%p1) as %p1' + CASE WHEN @m <> '' THEN ', %$m' ELSE '' END + ', %$s
		from %t1 a join @g b on a.%c1 = b.%c1 and b.%p1 <> a.%c1 ' + CASE @$t WHEN '1' THEN 'cross join @o c where a.%c3 = c.%c3' ELSE '' END + '
			group by b.%p1' + CASE @$t WHEN '1' THEN ', c.%c3' ELSE '' END + '
) b on a.%c1 = b.%c1' + CASE @$t WHEN '1' THEN ' and a.%c3 = b.%c3' ELSE '' END + '

when matched then update set %$u
when not matched by target then insert (%c1, %o, %l, %p1' + CASE WHEN @m <> '' THEN ', %m' ELSE '' END + ', %s) values(b.%c1, b.%o, b.%l, b.%p1, %$i);

;with p(%p1, %c1, path) as (select b.%p2, a.%c1, a.path from @g a join %t2 b on a.%p1 = b.%c2)
update a set %o = b.path from %t1 a join p b on a.%c1 = b.%c1 where a.%c1 <> '''' and b.%p1 = '''';
'



	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q,
		'%p1',@p1),
		'%c1', @c1),

		'%p2',@p2),
		'%c2', @c2),
		'%c3', @c3),

		'%t1', @t1),
		'%t2', @t2),
		'%t3', @t3),

		'%o', @o),
		'%l', @l),

		'%m', @m),
		'%s', @s),
		'%$m', @$m),

		'%$u', @$u),
		'%$s', @$s),
		'%$i', @$i),

		'%k', 'where ' + @k
	)
	RETURN @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$UnPostAuthorize]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(33),
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @HisTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(33), @UStatus VARCHAR(33), @RecordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(33), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1),
		@lastApproveUser INT, @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(28, 6), @userID0 INT, @role VARCHAR(33), @CategoryApprove VARCHAR(33), @datetime4 DATETIME, @nextUStatus VARCHAR(33), @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Status = '', @RecordHasBeenChanged = '', @lastApproveUser = 0, @voucherCode = ''
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- struct
	SELECT @GeneralTable = '', @MasterTable = '', @DetailTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @HisTable = '', @Dyn = ''
	SELECT @GeneralTable = c$, @MasterTable = m$, @DetailTable = d$, @InquiryTable = i$, @HisTable = a$ FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @GeneralTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @Dyn OUTPUT
		IF RIGHT(@MasterTable, 1) = '$' SET @MasterTable = @MasterTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@DetailTable, 1) = '$' SET @DetailTable = @DetailTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@InquiryTable, 1) = '$' SET @InquiryTable = @InquiryTable + @Dyn
	END


	--
	CREATE TABLE #a(user_id4 INT, xtype VARCHAR(32), datetime4 DATETIME)
	SET @q = 'insert into #a select top 1 user_id4, xtype, datetime4 from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and xtype in (''1'', ''2'') order by stt desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype, @datetime4 = datetime4 FROM #a


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #listUser select a.stt, a.user_id4 from ' + @HisTable + ' a join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and xtype in (''1'', ''2'') and user_id4 <> ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastApproveUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC

	DECLARE @notCheckStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = '9'
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = @notCheckStatus + ',' + status from dmctduyet WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	-- Get old status
	IF @lastUserID = @userID AND @xtype = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), u_status0 VARCHAR(32), user_id0 INT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, u_status0, user_id0, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and (datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @datetime4, 121) + ''' or status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@notCheckStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @nextUStatus = u_status, @UStatus = u_status0, @userID0 = user_id0, @CategoryApprove = kieu_duyet FROM #role
		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalRole @voucherType, @lastUserID, @UStatus, @CategoryApprove, @role OUTPUT
	END


	--
	IF @UStatus IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END

	-- Before Update
	CREATE TABLE #processData(stt_rec CHAR(13), xtype VARCHAR(32))
	IF @voucherCode IN ('BN1', 'PC1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @curStatus = status from ' + QUOTENAME(@MasterTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@curStatus varchar(32) output', @curStatus OUTPUT
		IF @curStatus = '0' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PaymentRequest @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', '52', @userID
			SET @q = 'insert into #processData(stt_rec) select distinct stt_rec_dn as stt_rec from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt_rec_dn <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	SELECT @status = '0'
	SELECT @Status = s_status FROM gndmttcttg WHERE u_status = @UStatus AND loai_duyet = @voucherType


	-- Update
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' set status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '') + ''', u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@UStatus, '''', '') + ''', u_status0 = '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@lastApproveUser) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @InquiryTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' +  QUOTENAME(@InquiryTable) + ' set status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + QUOTENAME(@GeneralTable) + ' set status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- After update	
	IF @voucherCode IN ('BN1', 'PC1') AND @Status = '0' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #processData(stt_rec) select distinct stt_rec_dn as stt_rec from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt_rec_dn <> '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PaymentRequest @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', '52', @userID
	END

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2', @commentApproval

	-- Reset
	SET @q = '
		declare @minReset int, @stt int
		select @minReset = 0, @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
		if exists(select 1 from gndmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''' + REPLACE(@voucherType, '''', '') + ''' and u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@nextUStatus, '''', '') + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + '
				where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
					and u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@nextUStatus, '''', '') + '''
					and stt < @stt - 1
					and stt in (select a.stt from ' + @HisTable + ' a
						join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'')
			update ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' set reset = reset - 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt > @minReset and stt < @stt
		end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Mail
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gndmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND notify_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @lastApproveUser = 0
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gndmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND created_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @userID0 = 0

	DECLARE @notifyGroup VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000), @invokeProcess NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @notifyGroup = '', @invoke = '', @invokeProcess = ''
	SELECT @notifyGroup = notify_group FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
	INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @Dyn, @voucherType, @sysDatabaseName, @lastApproveUser, 1, @userID0

	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetNotifyAndMail @pushNotify, @pushNotifyDevice, @userID, @sysDatabaseName, '#processData', @invokeProcess OUTPUT
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetNotify @notifyGroup, @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, @pushNotify, @pushNotifyDevice, @userID, @sysDatabaseName, '#mail', @invoke OUTPUT

	IF @invokeProcess <> '' SELECT @invoke = @invoke + CASE WHEN @invoke = '' THEN '' ELSE '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' END + @invokeProcess
	SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
	SELECT * FROM #mail

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADepreciation] --fs20_FADepreciationReport--
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group VARCHAR(254),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_bp),'') FROM wrkColumns) AS fa_ma_bp
		, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
		, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
		, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
	INTO #report
	FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, a.so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
			, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
		INTO #data
			FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT id, so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi INTO #dataMax FROM #data

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.nam * 12 + a.ky between ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Key = ' where ' + @Key

	SELECT @q = '
	insert into #data select a.nam * 12 + a.ky, a.so_the_ts, a.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt,
			ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts as loai_cc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia,
			a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
		from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #dataMax SELECT id, so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt), MAX(tk_ts), MAX(tk_kh), MAX(tk_cp), MAX(ma_bp), MAX(ma_phi)
		FROM #data a
			WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM #data b WHERE a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts)
			GROUP BY id, so_the_ts

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, '' AS fx_ma_bp,
		b.nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt, b.gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt, b.gt_cl, b.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, a.ten_ts, a.ten_ts2,
		a.so_ky_kh, a.ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0, a.loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
	FROM (
		SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia,
				MAX(ten_ts) AS ten_ts, MAX(ten_ts2) AS ten_ts2, MAX(so_ky_kh) AS so_ky_kh, MAX(ngay_mua) AS ngay_mua, MAX(ngay_kh0) AS ngay_kh0, MAX(loai_ts) AS loai_ts
			FROM #data GROUP BY so_the_ts
	) a LEFT JOIN #dataMax b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts


	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_kh0 > dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))

	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year))
	)

	UPDATE #report SET gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE so_the_ts IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) <= dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))
	)

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp INTO #dept FROM cthsts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 16) IN (
	SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)
		FROM cthsts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @Year * 12 + @Period
		GROUP BY so_the_ts
	) AND @Period = @Period2

	ALTER TABLE #dept ALTER COLUMN ma_bp VARCHAR(33) NULL

	INSERT INTO #dept SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dept)

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT a.so_the_ts FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ma_bp NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@FaDept) + '%' ))

	UPDATE #report SET fa_ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(nam*12+ky) AS so_ky
		INTO #temp
		FROM ctkhts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report WHERE nguyen_gia IS NULL)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN (
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, 0 AS gt_cl,  0 AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
				FROM ctkhts a JOIN #temp b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND (a.nam*12+a.ky) = b.so_ky
				GROUP BY a.so_the_ts) b
			ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts, fa_ma_bp', 'INT, #, &ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi from #report order by '  + @Group + ',sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi from #report order by sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIVendorEvaluation]
	@PeriodType CHAR(2),
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@Vendor VARCHAR(1024),
	@VendorGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(1024),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @joinItem NVARCHAR(1023), @joinVendor NVARCHAR(1023), @tableData NVARCHAR(1023), @p INT, @y INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST (0 AS INT) AS tag, a.nam, a.ky, a.loai_ky, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, a.ma_vt, c.ten_vt, a.diem_so AS diem, a.diem_so AS diem_kn, a.diem_so AS diem_kt INTO #t FROM bidgkq00$0000 a, dmkh b, dmvt c

	-- PurOrgKey
	SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @joinItem = '', @joinVendor = '', @tableData = CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN 'bidgkqkh02' ELSE 'bidgkq02' END
	IF @ReportType = '1' OR @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @joinItem = ' left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt'
	IF @ReportType = '1' OR @VendorGroup1 <> '' OR @VendorGroup2 <> '' OR @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @joinVendor = ' left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'

	SELECT @Key = ' and a.loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	--
	IF @Vendor <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Vendor, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Item, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @ReportForm = '20' BEGIN -- Prev
		SELECT @p = MIN(ky) FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType AND nam = @Year
		IF @p = @Period SELECT @p = MAX(ky), @y = @Year - 1 FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType AND nam = @Year - 1
			ELSE SELECT @p = @Period - 1, @y = @Year
		SELECT @p = ISNULL(@p, 0), @y = ISNULL(@y, 0)

		SELECT @Key2 = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@p) + @Key
	END
	-- Current
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + @Key



	-- Current Score
	IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select 0 as tag, a.nam, a.ky, a.loai_ky, a.ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'k.ten_kh' ELSE 'k.ten_kh2' END
		IF (@ReportType = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'v.ten_vt' ELSE 'v.ten_vt2' END ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.diem_so as diem, ' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '20' THEN 'a.diem_so' ELSE '0' END + ' as diem_kn, 0 as diem_kt'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh' + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN ' order by a.ma_kh' ELSE ' order by a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END



	-- Old Score
	IF (@ReportForm = '20' AND OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #t set diem_kt = isnull(b.diem_so, 0) from #t a'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' left join (select a.diem_so, a.ma_kh' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN '' ELSE ', a.ma_vt' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinVendor + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key2 + ') b'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN '' ELSE ' and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END



	-- Browse
	IF @ReportType = '0' SELECT * FROM #t ORDER BY ma_kh ELSE SELECT * FROM #t ORDER BY ma_kh, ma_vt



	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
/*
**	Retrieve the owner object(s) of a given property
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_getobjwithprop
	@property varchar(30),
	@value varchar(255)
as
	set nocount on

	if (@property is null) or (@property = '')
	begin
		raiserror('Must specify a property name.',-1,-1)
		return (1)
	end

	if (@value is null)
		select objectid id from dbo.dtproperties
			where property=@property

	else
		select objectid id from dbo.dtproperties
			where property=@property and value=@value



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJobBalance] --fs20_JobsSummary--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@JobParent VARCHAR(33),
	@Job VARCHAR(33),
	@Group0 CHAR(1),-- 2 - Khach hang, 1 - Vu viec me, 0 - Khong
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Groups VARCHAR(128),
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b1 FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b2 FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, a.ma_vv, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt, ma_vv_me, a.ma_kh, nh_vv1, nh_vv2, nh_vv3, ten_vv, ten_vv2, 0 AS bac_vv INTO #report FROM #t a, dmvv b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vv, ten_vv2, bac_vv', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_vv <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @Group0 = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @JobParent <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobParent), '''', '''''') + ''' , a.ma_vv) = 1'
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group0 = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b2 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$JobCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Job, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b1 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Job @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Job, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_vv, '', du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b1
	END

	-- Key
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
 	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_vv, ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '2' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_vv' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '2' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Summary
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, '''', a.ma_vv, sum(no_dk), sum(no_dk_nt), sum(co_dk), sum(co_dk_nt), sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), sum(no_ck), sum(no_ck_nt), sum(co_ck), sum(co_ck_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '1' THEN 'ma_vv_me' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '2' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '0' THEN 'max(nh_vv1), max(nh_vv2), max(nh_vv3)' ELSE ''''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_vv)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_vv2)' ELSE '''''' END + ', 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vv' + CASE @Group0 WHEN '1' THEN ', ma_vv_me' WHEN '2' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GroupByParentJob '#report', '', 'no_dk, co_dk, ps_no, ps_co, no_ck, co_ck, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt'
		UPDATE #report SET systotal = CASE WHEN bac_vv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
		UPDATE #report SET ten_vv = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE '' END, ten_vv2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vv2 END
			FROM #report a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
	END ELSE IF @Group0 = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT @o = 'ma_kh, ' + @Order
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

			SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'vv', 'no_dk, co_dk, ps_no, ps_co, no_ck, co_ck, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Groups = '' BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @o = @Groups + ', ' + @Order
				EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
			END

			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups, 'vv', 'no_dk, co_dk, ps_no, ps_co, no_ck, co_ck, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vv', 'no_dk, co_dk, ps_no, ps_co, no_ck, co_ck, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt'
	IF @Group0 = '1' SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv, 0) * 3) + ma_vv) as ma_vv, rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv, 0) * 3) + ten_vv) as ten_vv, rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv, 0) * 3) + ten_vv2) AS ten_vv2 '
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ', ma_vv, ten_vv, ten_vv2'
	IF @Group0 = '2' SET @q = @q + ', ma_kh' ELSE SET @q = @q + ', '''' as ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report order by '
	IF @Group0 = '0'
		IF @Groups = '' SET @q = @q + 'sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
			ELSE SET @q = @q + @Groups + ', sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	IF @Group0 = '1' SET @q = @q + 'sysorderrow, sysorder'
	IF @Group0 = '2' SET @q = @q + 'ma_kh, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInventoryItemAlert] --fs_StockBalanceAlert
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@OrderBy VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #temp FROM wrkin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	INSERT #temp EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateTo, @Unit, '', @Item, 2, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, a.ma_vt, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3, MIN(b.sl_min) AS sl_min, MAX(b.sl_max) AS sl_max
		INTO #report
		FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		HAVING (SUM(a.so_luong) < MIN(sl_min) AND MIN(sl_min) <> 0) OR (SUM(a.so_luong) > MAX(sl_max) AND MAX(sl_max) <> 0)

	DELETE #report WHERE (so_luong >= sl_min OR sl_min = 0) AND (so_luong <= sl_max OR sl_max = 0)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'NUMERIC(5)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@OrderBy) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @OrderBy END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @OrderBy, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt' , 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report', 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy, 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, sl_min, sl_max, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt from #report'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = ''
		SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, ' + @OrderBy + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@GroupBy  , 'sysorder,' + @OrderBy) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodPurchaseAnalysisByTwoCriteria]
	@dateStart SMALLDATETIME,	
	@Time AS CHAR(1),	
	@Count AS TINYINT,	
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(32),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(128),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 	
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Mẫu chuẩn, 20 - Mẫu ngoại tệ
	@DataType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Thực tế, 2 - Hóa đơn
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @dateEnd  AS SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sNotDefine NVARCHAR(1024), @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @sNotDefine = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt AS reportby, ma_vt AS groupby, tien0 AS tien, tien_nt0 AS tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_ky, reportby, groupby, tien, tien_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_key INTO #report FROM #tmp
