								SELECT @dStart1 = @dFrom, @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dFrom), YEAR(@dFrom))
								SELECT @dStart2 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dEndCalc), YEAR(@dEndCalc)), @dEnd2 = @dEndCalc
							END
						ELSE
							BEGIN
								SELECT @p1 = MONTH(DATEADD(Day, 1, dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dFrom), YEAR(@dFrom))))
								SELECT @y1 = YEAR(DATEADD(Day, 1, dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dFrom), YEAR(@dFrom))))
								SELECT @p2 = MONTH(@dEndCalc)
								SELECT @y2 = YEAR(@dEndCalc)
								SELECT @dStart1 = @dFrom, @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dFrom), YEAR(@dFrom))
								SELECT @dStart2 = '20000102', @dEnd2 = '20000101'
							END
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @dEndCalc < dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dFrom), YEAR(@dFrom))
						SELECT @p1 = 0, @y1 = 0, @p2 = 0, @y2 = 0, @dStart1 = @dFrom, @dEnd1 = @dEndCalc, @dStart2 = '20000102', @dEnd2 = '20000101'
					ELSE
						IF @dEndCalc <> dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dEndCalc), YEAR(@dEndCalc))
							BEGIN
								SELECT @p1 = MONTH(@dFrom)
								SELECT @y1 = YEAR(@dFrom)
								SELECT @p2 = MONTH(DATEADD(Day, -1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dEndCalc), YEAR(@dEndCalc))))
								SELECT @y2 = YEAR(DATEADD(Day, -1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dEndCalc), YEAR(@dEndCalc))))
								SELECT @dStart1 = '20000102', @dEnd1 = '20000101'
								SELECT @dStart2 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dEndCalc), YEAR(@dEndCalc)), @dEnd2 = @dEndCalc
							END
						ELSE
							BEGIN
								SELECT @p1 = MONTH(@dFrom)
								SELECT @y1 = YEAR(@dFrom)
								SELECT @p2 = MONTH(@dEndCalc)
								SELECT @y2 = YEAR(@dEndCalc)
								SELECT @dStart1 = '20000102', @dEnd1 = '20000101'
								SELECT @dStart2 = '20000102', @dEnd2 = '20000101'
							END
				END

			IF @dLock < @dTo
				IF @p1 <> 0
					IF @dLock = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@dLock), YEAR(@dLock))
						SELECT @dStart2 = DATEADD(Day, 1, @dLock), @dEnd2 = @dTo
					ELSE
						SELECT @dEnd2 = @dTo
				ELSE
					SELECT @dEnd1 = @dTo
		END

	INSERT INTO @tabRet SELECT @p1 AS p1, @y1 AS y1, @p2 AS p2, @y2 AS y2, @dStart1 AS dStart1, @dEnd1 AS dEnd1, @dStart2 AS dStart2, @dEnd2 AS dEnd2
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CaclFIFOPriceOSTI]
	@nFifoType TINYINT,
	@cLcItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@dLcDate SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(33), 
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM wrkstkffit WHERE ma_vt = @cLcItem AND ngay_ct = @dLcDate AND px_co_gia = 0) RETURN
	DECLARE @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(33), @ma_lo VARCHAR(33), @cDynTable VARCHAR(64), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @gia NUMERIC(28, 6), @gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @so_luongi NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_luongj NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_luongd NUMERIC(28, 6), @tiend NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_ntd NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nPRound TINYINT, @nFCPRound TINYINT, @QRound TINYINT

	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'
	SELECT @nPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @nFCPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'
	SELECT @QRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_SL'

	DECLARE @stt_rec_nt CHAR(13), @stt_rec_nt0 CHAR(3), @ton_kho13 NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_du13 NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_du_nt13  NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @isOk TINYINT, @stt_rec_dc CHAR(13)
	DECLARE @isSP BIT, @cRCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cRCLineIDNumber CHAR(3), @nTransfer TINYINT
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)	

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)

	--SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_kho INTO #wrkstkffit
	--	FROM wrkstkffit
	--	WHERE ma_vt = @cLcItem AND ngay_ct = @dLcDate
	--		AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
	--	GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_kho
	--	ORDER BY stt_kho, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_kho, ma_ct, CASE WHEN ma_ct = 'PXB' THEN 0 ELSE 999 END AS stt_kho0
		INTO #wrkstkffitTmp
		FROM wrkstkffit
		WHERE ma_vt = @cLcItem AND ngay_ct = @dLcDate AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1

	-- A-B-C
	DECLARE @i INT
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #wrkstkffitTmp SET stt_kho0 = @i WHERE ma_ct = 'PXB' AND stt_kho0 = @i - 1 AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_khon FROM #wrkstkffitTmp WHERE ma_ct = 'PXB' AND stt_kho0 = @i - 1)
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_kho, MIN(stt_kho0) AS stt_kho0
		INTO #wrkstkffit
		FROM #wrkstkffitTmp
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_kho

	CREATE TABLE #tIr (stt_rec_nt CHAR(13), stt_rec_nt0 CHAR(3), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, stt_ctntxt NUMERIC(5,0), so_ct VARCHAR(33), 
			ton_kho13 NUMERIC(28, 6), so_du13 NUMERIC(28, 6), so_du_nt13 NUMERIC(28, 6))

	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo FROM #wrkstkffit ORDER BY stt_kho0, stt_kho, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_kho, @ma_vi_tri, @ma_lo
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			DECLARE crIssues CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_luong, ct_dc, px_gia_dd, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn
				FROM wrkstkffit
				WHERE ngay_ct = @dLcDate AND ma_vt = @cLcItem AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ma_vi_tri = @ma_vi_tri AND ma_lo = @ma_lo AND so_luong > 0
				ORDER BY ct_dc DESC, px_gia_dd DESC, stt_ntxt0
			-- Scan Issues
			OPEN crIssues
			FETCH NEXT FROM crIssues INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @so_luong, @nTransfer, @isSP, @cRCIDNumber, @cRCLineIDNumber
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @ngay_ct BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) SELECT @cDynTable = 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @ngay_ct, 112)
						ELSE SELECT @cDynTable = ''

					DELETE  #tIr
					-- Retrieve Receipts
					INSERT INTO #tIr (stt_rec_nt, stt_rec_nt0, ngay_ct, stt_ctntxt, so_ct, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13) 
						SELECT stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, stt_ctntxt, so_ct, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13 FROM cdntxt
						WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate)
							AND ((YEAR(ngay_ct)*12 + MONTH(ngay_ct) <= YEAR(@dLcDate) *12 + MONTH(@dLcDate) AND ma_ct <> '') OR ma_ct = '')
							AND ma_vt = @cLcItem AND ma_kho = @ma_kho
							AND ma_vi_tri = @ma_vi_tri AND ma_lo = @ma_lo AND ton_kho13 > 0 AND pn_co_gia = 1
							
					IF @nFifoType = 1 DELETE #tIr WHERE ngay_ct > @dLcDate
					-- Specific cost
					IF @isSP = 1 AND RTRIM(@cRCIDNumber) <> '' DELETE #tIr WHERE NOT (stt_rec_nt = @cRCIDNumber AND stt_rec_nt0 = @cRCLineIDNumber)
					SELECT @so_luongi = SUM(ton_kho13) FROM #tIr
					IF @so_luongi IS NULL SET @so_luongi = 0
					-- Not full
					IF @so_luongi < @so_luong
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO wrkstkffnis(stt_rec, stt_rec0) VALUES (@stt_rec, @stt_rec0) 
						END
					-- Luck
					IF @so_luongi = @so_luong
						BEGIN
							SELECT @tien = SUM(so_du13), @tien_nt = SUM(so_du_nt13) FROM #tIr 
							IF @tien IS NULL SET @tien = 0
							IF @tien_nt IS NULL SET @tien_nt = 0
							SELECT @gia = ROUND(@tien/@so_luong, @nPRound), @gia_nt = ROUND(@tien_nt/@so_luong, @nFCPRound)

							SELECT @stt_rec_dc = LEFT(@stt_rec, 10) + 'PNF'
							-- Update FIFO Balance
							UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho13 = 0, so_du13 = 0, so_du_nt13 = 0
								FROM cdntxt a JOIN #tIr b ON a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_nt AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec_nt0
								WHERE a.nam = YEAR(@dLcdate)

							-- Stock Transfer in
							IF @nTransfer = 1 UPDATE cdntxt SET pn_co_gia = 1, so_du13 = @tien, so_du_nt13 = @tien_nt WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate) AND stt_rec_nt = @stt_rec_dc AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
							-- Update 4 details
							INSERT INTO wrkstkffiis(stt_rec, stt_rec0) VALUES (@stt_rec, @stt_rec0) 
							IF @nTransfer = 1 INSERT INTO wrkstkffiis(stt_rec, stt_rec0) VALUES (@stt_rec_dc, @stt_rec0) 
							-- Update Inventory
							UPDATE ct70 SET gia = @gia, tien_xuat = @tien,
								gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @gia_nt END, 
								tien_nt_x =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, 
								gia1 = ROUND(@gia*he_so1, @nPRound), 
								gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@gia_nt*he_so1, @nFCPRound) END
								WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
							-- Update r70 tables
							IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
								SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET gia = ' + RTRIM(@gia) + ', tien_xuat = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ','
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ' END,'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'tien_nt_x =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END,'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia1 = ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nPRound) + '),'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nFCPRound) + ') END'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''''
								EXEC sp_executesql @q
							END
							IF @nTransfer = 1 
								BEGIN 
									UPDATE ct70 SET gia = @gia, tien_nhap = @tien,
										gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @gia_nt END, 
										tien_nt_n =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, 
										gia1 = ROUND(@gia*he_so1, @nPRound), 
										gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@gia_nt*he_so1, @nFCPRound) END
									WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec_dc AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
									-- Update r70 tables
									IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
										SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET gia = ' + RTRIM(@gia) + ', tien_nhap = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ','
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ' END,'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'tien_nt_n =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END,'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia1 = ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nPRound) + '),'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nFCPRound) + ') END'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec_dc + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''''
										EXEC sp_executesql @q
									END
								END
						END
					-- Ok
					IF @so_luongi > @so_luong
						BEGIN
							DECLARE crReceipts CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nt, stt_rec_nt0, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13 FROM #tIr ORDER BY ngay_ct, stt_ctntxt, so_ct
							OPEN crReceipts
							FETCH NEXT FROM crReceipts INTO @stt_rec_nt, @stt_rec_nt0, @ton_kho13, @so_du13, @so_du_nt13
							SELECT @so_luongj = 0, @tien = 0, @tien_nt = 0
							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								BEGIN
									-- No Problem
									IF @so_luongj + @ton_kho13 < @so_luong
										BEGIN
											SELECT @so_luongj = @so_luongj + @ton_kho13, @tien = @tien + @so_du13, @tien_nt = @tien_nt + @so_du_nt13
											UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho13 = 0, so_du13 = 0, so_du_nt13 = 0 WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate) AND stt_rec_nt = @stt_rec_nt AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec_nt0
										END
									ELSE
										-- Luck
										IF @so_luongj + @ton_kho13 = @so_luong
											BEGIN
												SELECT @so_luongj = @so_luong, @tien = @tien + @so_du13, @tien_nt = @tien_nt + @so_du_nt13
												UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho13 = 0, so_du13 = 0, so_du_nt13 = 0 WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate) AND stt_rec_nt = @stt_rec_nt AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec_nt0
												BREAK
											END
											ELSE
												-- @so_luongj + @ton_kho13 > @so_luong
												-- Ok
												BEGIN
													SET @so_luongd = @so_luongj + @ton_kho13 - @so_luong
													SET @tiend = ROUND(@so_luongd*@so_du13/@ton_kho13, @nRound)
													SET @tien_ntd =  ROUND(@so_luongd*@so_du_nt13/@ton_kho13, @nFCRound)
													SET @tien = @tien + @so_du13 - @tiend
													SET @tien_nt = @tien_nt + @so_du_nt13 - @tien_ntd
													UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho13 = @so_luongd, so_du13 = @tiend, so_du_nt13 = @tien_ntd WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate) AND stt_rec_nt = @stt_rec_nt AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec_nt0
													BREAK				
												END
									FETCH NEXT FROM crReceipts INTO @stt_rec_nt, @stt_rec_nt0, @ton_kho13, @so_du13, @so_du_nt13
								END
							CLOSE crReceipts
							DEALLOCATE crReceipts
							SELECT @stt_rec_dc = LEFT(@stt_rec, 10) + 'PNF'
							-- Stock Transfer in
							IF @nTransfer = 1 UPDATE cdntxt SET pn_co_gia = 1, so_du13 = @tien, so_du_nt13 = @tien_nt WHERE nam = YEAR(@dLcdate) AND stt_rec_nt = @stt_rec_dc AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
							-- Update 4 details
							INSERT INTO wrkstkffiis(stt_rec, stt_rec0) VALUES (@stt_rec, @stt_rec0) 
							IF @nTransfer = 1 INSERT INTO wrkstkffiis(stt_rec, stt_rec0) VALUES (@stt_rec_dc, @stt_rec0) 
							-- Update Inventory
							SELECT @gia = ROUND(@tien/@so_luong, @nPRound), @gia_nt = ROUND(@tien_nt/@so_luong, @nFCPRound)
							UPDATE ct70 SET gia = @gia, tien_xuat = @tien, 
								gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @gia_nt END, 
								tien_nt_x =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, 
								gia1 = ROUND(@gia*he_so1, @nPRound), 
								gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@gia_nt*he_so1, @nFCPRound) END
								WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
							-- Update r70 tables
							IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
								SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET gia = ' + RTRIM(@gia) + ', tien_xuat = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ','
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ' END,'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'tien_nt_x =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END,'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia1 = ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nPRound) + '),'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nFCPRound) + ') END'
								SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''''
								EXEC sp_executesql @q
							END
							IF @nTransfer = 1
								BEGIN
									UPDATE ct70 SET gia = @gia, tien_nhap = @tien, 
										gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @gia_nt END, 
										tien_nt_n =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, 
										gia1 = ROUND(@gia*he_so1, @nPRound), 
										gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@gia_nt*he_so1, @nFCPRound) END
									WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec_dc AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
									-- Update r70 tables
									IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
										SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET gia = ' + RTRIM(@gia) + ', tien_nhap = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ','
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ' END,'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'tien_nt_n =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END,'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia1 = ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nPRound) + '),'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nFCPRound) + ') END'
										SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec_dc + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''''
										EXEC sp_executesql @q
									END
								END
					END
			
					FETCH NEXT FROM crIssues INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @so_luong, @nTransfer, @isSP, @cRCIDNumber, @cRCLineIDNumber
				END
			CLOSE crIssues
			DEALLOCATE crIssues
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_kho, @ma_vi_tri, @ma_lo
		END	
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.rs_AfterUpdateGL4PXG
	@cIDVoucher CHAR(13), 
	@cMTable CHAR(10), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3), 
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ma_ct_pxg CHAR(3), @stt_rec_pxg CHAR(13)

	SELECT @ma_ct_pxg = 'PXG', @stt_rec_pxg = LEFT(@cIDVoucher, 10) + 'PXG'

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, dien_giai_h, ma_bp, ma_phi INTO #gl FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDVoucher

	UPDATE ct00 SET dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai_h, ma_bp = b.ma_bp, ma_phi = b.ma_phi
		FROM ct00 a JOIN #gl b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk AND a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr AND a.tk = b.tk
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @stt_rec_pxg AND a.ma_ct = @ma_ct_pxg

END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptSIHIDeclaration]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateSIFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateSITo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Empty BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec, ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv, bo_phan INTO #report FROM hrnv

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.status <> ''0'''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Empty <> 0 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and isnull(b.ma_so_bhxh, '''') = '''''

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateSIFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.si_date2 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateSIFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DateSITo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.si_date2 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateSITo, 112) + ''')'
	
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, bo_phan)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv, a.bo_phan'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock) left join hrttbh b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, a.bo_phan AS ma_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp ORDER BY a.stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_HRM$EmployeeCreateNotify]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64),
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32),
	@HasAvatar CHAR(1) = '0',
	@HasFullAvatar CHAR(1) = '0'
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @bodyInfo VARCHAR(32), @bodyContent VARCHAR(32), @idEmpl VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @bodyInfo = '', @bodyContent = ''
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT @idEmpl = stt_rec_nv FROM dvhrnv WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @masterTable) > 0 RETURN
	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @detailTable) > 0 RETURN
	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @notifyTable) > 0 RETURN

	SELECT * INTO #master FROM vdvhrnvnew WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @priority = 1, @e$ = ''

	--Filter master different value
	SELECT * INTO #hrnv FROM vdvhrnvold WHERE stt_rec = @idEmpl
	SELECT * INTO #dvhrnv FROM vdvhrnvnew WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE INTO #type FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'hrnv'
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, a.id AS sys_stt, field, name, name2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS old_val, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS new_val, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS old_val2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS new_val2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS old, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS new, b.DATA_TYPE AS xtype INTO #table FROM dvfieldsname a LEFT JOIN #type b ON a.field = b.COLUMN_NAME WHERE controller = 'hrEmployeeInformation' AND xgroup = '4' ORDER BY a.id

	DECLARE @p VARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @p = REPLACE(MIN(field), '''', '') FROM #table
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC(N'update #table set old_val = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.' + @p + N', 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.' + @p + N' as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #hrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
		EXEC(N'update #table set new_val = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.' + @p + N', 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.' + @p + N' as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #dvhrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #table WHERE field = @p + '2') BEGIN
			EXEC(N'update #table set old_val2 = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.' + @p + N'2, 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.' + @p + N'2 as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #hrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
			EXEC(N'update #table set new_val2 = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.' + @p + N'2, 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.' + @p + N'2 as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #dvhrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
			EXEC(N'update #table set old = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.ma_' + @p + N', 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.ma_' + @p + N' as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #hrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
			EXEC(N'update #table set new = case when xtype in (''datetime'',''smalldatetime'') then cast(isnull(convert(varchar(12), b.ma_' + @p + N', 103), ''  /  /    '') as nvarchar(512)) else isnull(cast(b.ma_' + @p + N' as nvarchar(512)), '''') end from #dvhrnv b where field = ''' + @p + N'''')
		END ELSE BEGIN
			EXEC(N'update #table set new_val2 = new_val, old_val2 = old_val, old = old_val, new = new_val where field = ''' + @p + '''')
		END

		SELECT @p = REPLACE(MIN(field), '''', '') FROM #table WHERE field > @p
	END
	DELETE #table WHERE xtype IS NULL OR old = new

	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html BIT)
	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))

	INSERT INTO #headInfo(col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
		SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	INSERT INTO #headContent(colspan, text_style, label, label2, val, val2)
		SELECT '', '', N'Nhân viên', N'Employee', RTRIM(ma_nv) +  ' - ' + RTRIM(ten), RTRIM(ma_nv) +  ' - ' + RTRIM(ten) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Bộ phận', N'Department', RTRIM(bo_phan), RTRIM(bo_phan2) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Vị trí công việc', N'Position', RTRIM(vi_tri), RTRIM(vi_tri2) FROM #master

	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo(col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
		SELECT 'name', 120, '', '', N'Trường', N'Field', 'name', 'name2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'old_val', 180, '', '', N'Giá trị cũ', N'Old Value', 'old_val', 'old_val2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'new_val', 180, '', '', N'Giá trị mới', N'New Value', 'new_val', 'new_val2', 1

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2 INTO #bodyContent FROM #table
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #table) BEGIN
		SELECT @bodyInfo = '#bodyInfo', @bodyContent = '#bodyContent'
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2)
			SELECT '', '', name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2 FROM #table
	END

	IF @HasAvatar = '1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hreanh WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SELECT @bodyInfo = '#bodyInfo', @bodyContent = '#bodyContent'
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hreanh WHERE stt_rec = @idEmpl)
			INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2) SELECT '', '', N'Ảnh', N'Image', N'Có', N'Có', N'Yes', N'Yes'
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2) SELECT '', '', N'Ảnh', N'Image', N'Không', N'Có', N'No', N'Yes'

		IF @HasFullAvatar = '1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hreanh2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hreanh2 WHERE stt_rec = @idEmpl)
				INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2) SELECT '', '', N'Ảnh khác', N'Full Image', N'Có', N'Có', N'Yes', N'Yes'
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, name, name2, old_val, new_val, old_val2, new_val2) SELECT '', '', N'Ảnh khác', N'Full Image', N'Không', N'Có', N'No', N'Yes'
		END
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS v, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS e INTO #ct2
	EXEC ds_HRM$EmployeeCreateNotifyDetail @idNumber, '#ct2'

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))

	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02521', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02521', 'E', 1, 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent(colspan, text_style, label, label2, val, val2) select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END


	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Nhân viên: ' + RTRIM(ma_nv) + N' - ' + RTRIM(ten) + '. ' + N'Bộ phận: ' + RTRIM(bo_phan),
			@popupContent2 = N'Employee: ' + RTRIM(ma_nv) + N' - ' + RTRIM(ten) + '. ' + N'Department: ' + RTRIM(bo_phan2)
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '', @bodyInfo, @bodyContent, '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', '', '', '#ct2'

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Thông tin nhân viên'', N''Employee Information'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Thông tin nhân viên'', N''Employee Information'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt thông tin nhân viên'', N''Employee Information workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt thông tin nhân viên'', N''Employee Information workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$


	DROP TABLE #master
	DROP TABLE #headInfo
	DROP TABLE #headContent
	DROP TABLE #footContent
	DROP TABLE #msgv
	DROP TABLE #msge
	DROP TABLE #notify$Content

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADepreciationByCapital]--[fs_FADepreciationReportByCap]
	@PeriodFrom AS NUMERIC(2),
	@YearFrom AS NUMERIC(4),
	@PeriodTo AS NUMERIC(2),
	@YearTo AS NUMERIC(4),
	@FixedAssetType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@FixedAssetDepartment AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Standard, 20 - FC
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @rpt019 AS NVARCHAR(1024), @sTotal AS NVARCHAR(511), @noGroup AS NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @sTotal = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @rpt019 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT019'
	SELECT @noGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NOGROUP'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv AS sysColumn, loai_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
			, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_mua, CAST (NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_kh0, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(6, 0)) AS so_ky_kh
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_ts, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_ts2, a.ma_nt, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(24, 12)) AS ty_gia
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkColumns a LEFT JOIN ctkhts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('c.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @FixedAssetType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'c.loai_ts like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FixedAssetType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT so_the_ts INTO #dmts FROM dmts WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom))

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, loai_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, SPACE(2) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ', SPACE(2) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_ts2' ELSE '''''' END
	SET	@q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ' from'
	SET @q = @q + ' (select so_the_ts, ma_nv, sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt, max(ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(ty_gia) as ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhts where (nam * 12 + ky between ' + RTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ') group by ma_nv, so_the_ts) a'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join'
	SET @q = @q + ' (select so_the_ts, ma_nv, sum(nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt, sum(gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh, sum(gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt, sum(gt_cl) as gt_cl , sum(gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhts where nam = ' + RTRIM(@YearTo) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@PeriodTo) + ' group by ma_nv, so_the_ts) b'
	SET @q = @q + ' on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts and a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv join dmts c on a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@PeriodTo, @YearTo)
	DELETE #tmp WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WHERE ngay_kh0 > @d)

	SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom))
	DELETE #tmp WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = @d)

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp INTO #dept FROM cthsts WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 16)	IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)
			FROM cthsts WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom
			GROUP BY so_the_ts
	) AND @PeriodFrom = @PeriodTo

	INSERT INTO #dept SELECT so_the_ts, ISNULL(ma_bp, '') FROM dmts WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dept)
	DELETE #tmp WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT a.so_the_ts FROM #tmp a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ma_bp NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@FixedAssetDepartment) + '%' ))

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, MAX(nam*12+ky) AS so_ky, MAX(ISNULL(gt_cl,0)) AS gt_cl, MAX(ISNULL(gt_cl_nt,0)) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #tmp2
		FROM ctkhts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #tmp WHERE nguyen_gia IS NULL) AND (nam * 12 + ky BETWEEN @YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom AND @YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts, ma_nv
	UPDATE #tmp2 SET gt_cl = ISNULL(b.gt_cl,0), gt_cl_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_cl_nt,0) FROM #tmp2 a JOIN ctkhts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv AND (b.nam*12+b.ky) = a.so_ky

	UPDATE #tmp SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
		FROM #tmp a JOIN (
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, MAX(b.gt_cl) AS gt_cl, MAX(b.gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
				FROM ctkhts a JOIN #tmp2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv AND (a.nam*12 + a.ky) = b.so_ky
				GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv) b
			ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.sysColumn = b.ma_nv

	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, systotal, sysprint, sysColumn, so_the_ts, ten_ts, ten_ts2, loai_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt)
		SELECT 3, 0, 1, sysColumn, '', ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_loai), @noGroup), ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_loai2), @noGroup), a.loai_ts, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), SUM(a.gt_kh_ky), SUM(a.gt_kh_ky_nt)
			FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmplts b ON a.loai_ts = b.ma_loai GROUP BY a.loai_ts, sysColumn
	SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodTo, @YearTo))
	UPDATE #tmp SET gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) <= @d)

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'loai_ts', 'loai_ts, so_the_ts, sysorder', '#tmp', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, sysColumn
				, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt
				, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt
				, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
				, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, ma_nt, ty_gia)
		SELECT MAX(sysorder), MAX(sysprint), MAX(systotal), MAX(stt), so_the_ts, '00000000', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				, SUM(gt_kh_ky), SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt)
				, MAX(ten_ts), MAX(ten_ts2), MAX(so_ky_kh), MAX(ngay_mua), MAX(ngay_kh0), loai_ts, MAX(ma_nt), MAX(ty_gia)
			FROM #tmp
			GROUP BY loai_ts, so_the_ts, sysColumn

 	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, sysColumn
				, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt
				, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt
				, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
				, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts)
		SELECT 99, 1, 0, NULL, '', sysColumn
				, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				, SUM(gt_kh_ky), SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt)
				, @sTotal, @sTotal, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'ZZZZZZZZ'
			FROM #tmp
			WHERE systotal = 1
			GROUP BY sysColumn
	--
 	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, sysColumn
				, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt
				, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt
				, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
				, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts)
		SELECT 1, 0, 0, NULL, '', sysColumn
				, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				, SUM(gt_kh_ky), SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt)
				, @sTotal, @sTotal, NULL, NULL, NULL, CHAR(9)
			FROM #tmp
			WHERE systotal = 1
			GROUP BY sysColumn
 	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, sysColumn
				, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt
				, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt
				, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
				, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts)
		SELECT 2, 0, 0, NULL, '', sysColumn
				, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
				, 0, 0
				, '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, CHAR(10)
			FROM #tmp
			WHERE systotal = 1
			GROUP BY sysColumn
	--

	SELECT loai_ts, so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #tmp1 FROM #tmp WHERE systotal = 1

	UPDATE #tmp SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt
			, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
			, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt
		FROM #tmp a JOIN (
			SELECT so_the_ts
					, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
					, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
					, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
				FROM #tmp1 GROUP BY so_the_ts
		) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	UPDATE #tmp SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt
			, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
			, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt
		FROM #tmp a JOIN (
			SELECT loai_ts
					, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
					, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
					, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
				FROM #tmp1 GROUP BY loai_ts
			) b ON a.loai_ts = b.loai_ts
		WHERE a.so_the_ts = ''

	UPDATE #tmp SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt
			, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
			, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt
		FROM #tmp a JOIN (
			SELECT 'ZZZZZZZZ' AS so_the_ts
					, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
					, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
					, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
				FROM #tmp1
		) b ON a.loai_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT loai_ts + STR(ISNULL(stt, 0), 6) + so_the_ts AS xRow, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_nv ELSE '' END AS h_ma_nv
			, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_nv2 END AS h_ma_nv2, b.ten_nv AS h_ma_nv_in, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_nv2 ELSE '' END AS h_ma_nv_in2, a.*
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmnv b ON a.sysColumn = b.ma_nv

	UPDATE #report SET h_ma_nv = @rpt019, h_ma_nv2 = @rpt019, h_ma_nv_in = @rpt019, h_ma_nv_in2 = @rpt019 WHERE sysColumn = '00000000'

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, xRow, sysColumn, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(h_ma_nv_in, '') ELSE ISNULL(h_ma_nv_in2, '') END AS sysColumnName
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ts ELSE '' END AS ten_ts, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_ts2 ELSE '' END AS ten_ts2
			, so_the_ts, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ISNULL(gt_kh_ky, 0) AS gt_kh_ky, ISNULL(gt_kh_ky_nt, 0) AS gt_kh_ky_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY xRow, sysorder, sysColumn

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot(name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'gt_kh_ky$' ELSE 'gt_kh_ky_nt$' END, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(MAX(h_ma_nv), ' ') ELSE ISNULL(MAX(h_ma_nv2), ' ') END
		FROM #report GROUP BY sysColumn ORDER BY sysColumn
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id)
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll009]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @DeptKeyExt NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @bac INT, @Total NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @DeptKeyExt = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'c.', 0, @DeptKeyExt OUTPUT
	IF @Department0 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department0), 'a.', 'b.')

	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	SELECT @Filter = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Filter)

	SELECT @Key =  @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.loai = 2'
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	END

	--
	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.')
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department0 + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp'
	IF @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrnv c with(nolock) on c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, he_so, tien, tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM hrluongsp$000000

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0, max(a.he_so), sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrluongsp$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join+ ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.ma_bp0, a.stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, NULL, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, NULL, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		IF @EmpKey = '' SELECT @DeptKey = @Filter
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#tmp', 'ma_bp'

		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	SELECT TOp 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_bp, a.stt_rec, a.he_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, hrbp b
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, cast(0 as int) as stt, a.ma_bp, a.stt_rec, max(a.he_so) as he_so, sum(a.tien) as tien, sum(a.tien_nt) as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, max(b.stt_ref) as stt_ref'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp group by a.ma_bp, a.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_bp, stt_rec INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_bp, stt_rec ORDER BY MAX(stt_ref), stt_rec
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	SELECT ma_bp, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY ma_bp
	UPDATE #report SET stt = a.stt - b.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #g b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 1, 1, 0, '', '', 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '', 0, '' FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 1, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, '', 0, ''

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, ma_bp, '', 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), MAX(bp_me), MAX(bac_bp), MAX(stt_ref) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY ma_bp

	SELECT @bac = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	WHILE @bac > 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, 1, 1, 0, a.bp_me, '''', 0, 0, 0, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bp_me = b.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + CASE WHEN @DeptKeyExt <> '' AND @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN ' and ' + @DeptKeyExt ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' and sysorder = 5 and a.stt = 0 and a.bp_me not in (select distinct ma_bp from #report where bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + ' - 1)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt
			FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #report WHERE stt = 0 AND bac_bp = @bac GROUP BY bp_me) b ON a.ma_bp = b.bp_me
			WHERE a.stt = 0 AND a.bac_bp = @bac - 1
		--
		SELECT @bac = @bac - 1
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @bac = ISNULL(MIN(bac_bp), 0) FROM #report WHERE ma_bp <> ''
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, a.stt, a.he_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.stt_ref, a.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.sysorder = 3 then N''' + @Total + ''' else case when a.stt = 0 then isnull(space(2 * (a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@bac) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_bp' ELSE 'c.ten_bp2' END + ', '' '') else '' '' end end as ten_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.stt = 0 then '' '' else b.ma_nv end as ma_nv, case when a.stt = 0 then '' '' else rtrim(b.ho_nv) + '' '' + b.ten_nv end as ten_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join hrnv b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join ' + @c + 'hrbp c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.stt_ref, a.stt, b.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIVendorsNotEvaluatedSince]
	@PeriodType CHAR(2),
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1),
	@Vendor VARCHAR(4000),
	@VendorGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(4000),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @joinItem NVARCHAR(1024), @joinVendor NVARCHAR(1024), @tableData NVARCHAR(128)

	IF (STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', 0) < STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', 0)) BEGIN
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, null AS stt, '' AS ma, '' AS ten, 0 AS ky, 0 AS nam, '' AS ky_nam, '' AS ky_cuoi
		RETURN
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST (0 AS INT) AS stt
			, a.ma_vt AS ma, b.ten_vt AS ten, a.ky, a.nam, CAST ('' AS VARCHAR(12)) AS ky_nam
		INTO #report FROM bidgkq00$0000 a, dmvt b

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh INTO #vendor FROM dmkh
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh INTO #vendorCheck FROM dmkh
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #item FROM dmvt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #itemEvaluated FROM dmvt

	-- PurOrgKey
	SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Join
	SELECT @joinItem = ' left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt', @joinVendor = ' left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '(str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(a.ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') < ''' + STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' or str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(a.ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') > ''' + STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', '0') + ''')'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (''' + STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', '0') + ''' >= ''' + STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') + ''')'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	--
	SELECT @Key2 = ''
	IF (@ReportBy = '1') BEGIN
		IF @Vendor <> '' SELECT @Key2 = ' and a.ma_kh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Vendor, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
		IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and k.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @VendorGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and k.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and k.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key2 = ' and a.ma_vt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Item, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
		IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and v.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and v.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and v.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END

	--
	SELECT @Key = @Key + @Key2
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Vendor
	INSERT INTO #vendor SELECT ma_kh FROM dmkh WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmncctsbp0 b WHERE b.ma_kh = dmkh.ma_kh AND ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '0')
			AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmncctsbp0 b WHERE b.ma_kh = dmkh.ma_kh AND ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '1')
			OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmnccts b WHERE b.ma_kh = dmkh.ma_kh AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '1'))

	-- Item
	INSERT INTO #item SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmvttsbp0 b WHERE b.ma_vt = dmvt.ma_vt AND ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '0')
			AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmvttsbp0 b WHERE b.ma_vt = dmvt.ma_vt AND ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '1')
			OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmvtts b WHERE b.ma_vt = dmvt.ma_vt AND name = 'danh_gia_ncc' AND val = '1'))

	IF (@ReportBy = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'delete #vendor where ma_kh not in (select a.ma_kh from #vendor a left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh where 1=1' + @Key2 + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'delete #item where ma_vt not in (select a.ma_vt from #item a left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt where 1=1' + @Key2 + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Score
	DECLARE @year INT, @period INT, @type VARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @n INT, @m INT, @y INT, @id INT

	SELECT nam, ky, nam * 99 + ky AS id INTO #kbky FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType
	SELECT @id = MAX(id), @n = 1 FROM #kbky WHERE id <= (@YearFrom * 99 + @PeriodFrom)
	WHILE @id IS NOT NULL AND @n <= 12 BEGIN
		SELECT @y = nam, @m = ky FROM #kbky where id = @id

		SELECT @tableData = CASE WHEN @ReportBy = '1' THEN 'bidgkqkh02' ELSE 'bidgkq02' END
		IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 0'
			IF (@ReportBy = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'k.ten_kh' ELSE 'k.ten_kh2' END
				ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'v.ten_vt' ELSE 'v.ten_vt2' END
			SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ky, a.nam, str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(a.ky, 8), '' '', ''0'')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @ReportBy = '1' THEN @joinVendor ELSE @joinItem END
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@m)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			--
			SELECT @id = MAX(id), @n = @n + 1 FROM #kbky WHERE id < @id
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @id = NULL
		END
	END

	SELECT @y = @YearFrom
	WHILE @y <= @YearTo BEGIN
		IF (@ReportBy = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #vendorCheck select ma_kh from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''' and ' + REPLACE(@PurOrgKey, 'a.', '')
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and (str(nam, 4) + replace(str(ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') >= ''' + STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and str(nam, 4) + replace(str(ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') <= ''' + STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', '0') + ''')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #itemEvaluated select ma_vt from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''' and ' + REPLACE(@PurOrgKey, 'a.', '')
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and (str(nam, 4) + replace(str(ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') >= ''' + STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and str(nam, 4) + replace(str(ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') <= ''' + STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', '0') + ''')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		--
		SELECT @y = @y + 1
	END

	IF (@ReportBy = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT DISTINCT 0, a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN k.ten_kh ELSE k.ten_kh2 END, 0, 0, ''
				FROM #vendor a LEFT JOIN dmkh k WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh
					WHERE a.ma_kh NOT IN (SELECT ma FROM #report)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT DISTINCT 0, a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN k.ten_vt ELSE k.ten_vt2 END, 0, 0, ''
				FROM #item a LEFT JOIN dmvt k WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = k.ma_vt
					WHERE a.ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma FROM #report)
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #vendorCheck) DELETE #report WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #vendorCheck v WHERE v.ma_kh = #report.ma)
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #itemEvaluated) DELETE #report WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #itemEvaluated v WHERE v.ma_vt = #report.ma)


	-- Most Recently Period
	DELETE #report WHERE NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ma, MAX(STR(a.nam, 4) + REPLACE(STR(a.ky, 8), ' ', '0')) AS ky_nam FROM #report a
			WHERE STR(a.nam, 4) + REPLACE(STR(a.ky, 8), ' ', '0') <= STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') GROUP BY ma) b
				WHERE #report.ma = b.ma AND #report.ky_nam = b.ky_nam) AND ky_nam <> ''


	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'ma', '#report', 'stt', ''

	-- Browse
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, null AS stt, '' AS ma, '' AS ten, 0 AS ky, 0 AS nam, '' AS ky_nam, '' AS ky_cuoi
		ELSE SELECT *, CASE WHEN ky <> 0 THEN RTRIM(ky) + '/' + RTRIM(nam) ELSE '' END AS ky_cuoi FROM #report ORDER BY ma, stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_hrEmployeeWorkdayAdditionalTranferData]
	@Table VARCHAR(128),
	@Column VARCHAR(128),
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Fail BIT OUTPUT,
	@Row INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @s VARCHAR(4000), @u VARCHAR(4000), @item VARCHAR(4000), @Employee VARCHAR(32), @len0 INT, @len INT,
		@cong VARCHAR(32), @ca VARCHAR(32), @ca_ct VARCHAR(32), @gio VARCHAR(5), @gio_vao VARCHAR(5)


	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS gt, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nv, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS id , IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #t
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nv, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS cong, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ca, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ca_ct, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(5)) AS gio_vao, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(5,2)) AS so_gio, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt INTO #data

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select ' + @Column + ', ma_nv, stt from '+ @Table
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @i = MIN(stt) FROM #t
	SELECT @s = ''
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE @count INT, @j INT
		SELECT TOP 1 @count = LEN(gt) - LEN(REPLACE(gt, ',','')), @s = gt, @Employee = ma_nv, @Row = id FROM #t WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @len0 = LEN(@s) - LEN(REPLACE(@s, ',',''))
		IF RTRIM(@s) <> '' SELECT @count = @count + 1
		WHILE @count > 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @u = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@s, @count, ',')
			SELECT @len = LEN(@u)
			IF CHARINDEX('(', @u) <> 0 OR CHARINDEX(')', @u) <> 0 BEGIN
				IF NOT ((CHARINDEX('(', @u) + 1 <> CHARINDEX(')', @u)) AND LEFT(@u, 1) <> '(' AND RIGHT(@u, 1) = ')' AND (@len - LEN(REPLACE(@u, '(', '')) = 1) AND (@len - LEN(REPLACE(@u, ')', '')) = 1)) BEGIN
					SELECT @Fail = 1
					GOTO Rresult
				END
			END
			SELECT @item = REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@u, 2, '('), ')', '')
			SELECT @cong = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@u, 1, '(')
			SELECT @gio = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@item, 1, '-'),
				@ca = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@item, 2, '-'), 1, '['),
				@ca_ct = REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@item, 2, '-'), 2, '['), ']', ''),
				@gio_vao = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@item, 3, '-'), 1, '[')
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@gio, 0)) = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @Fail = 1
				GOTO Rresult 
			END
			INSERT INTO #data (ma_nv, ngay, cong, ca, ca_ct, gio_vao, so_gio, stt) SELECT UPPER(@Employee), @Date, UPPER(@cong), UPPER(@ca), UPPER(@ca_ct), @gio_vao, @gio, @i
			SELECT @count = @count - 1
		END
		SELECT @i = MIN(stt) FROM #t a WHERE stt > @i
	END

	Rresult:
	SELECT * FROM #data
	DROP TABLE #t, #data
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
/*
**	If the property already exists, reset the value; otherwise add property
**		id -- the id in sysobjects of the object
**		property -- the name of the property
**		uvalue -- the text value of the property
**		lvalue -- the binary value of the property (image)
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_setpropertybyid_u
	@id int,
	@property varchar(64),
	@uvalue nvarchar(255),
	@lvalue image
as
	set nocount on
	-- 
	-- If we are writing the name property, find the ansi equivalent. 
	-- If there is no lossless translation, generate an ansi name. 
	-- 
	declare @avalue varchar(255) 
	set @avalue = null 
	if (@uvalue is not null) 
	begin 
		if (convert(nvarchar(255), convert(varchar(255), @uvalue)) = @uvalue) 
		begin 
			set @avalue = convert(varchar(255), @uvalue) 
		end 
		else 
		begin 
			if 'DtgSchemaNAME' = @property 
			begin 
				exec dbo.dt_generateansiname @avalue output 
			end 
		end 
	end 
	if exists (select * from dbo.dtproperties 
			where objectid=@id and property=@property)
	begin
		--
		-- bump the version count for this row as we update it
		--
		update dbo.dtproperties set value=@avalue, uvalue=@uvalue, lvalue=@lvalue, version=version+1
			where objectid=@id and property=@property
	end
	else
	begin
		--
		-- version count is auto-set to 0 on initial insert
		--
		insert dbo.dtproperties (property, objectid, value, uvalue, lvalue)
			values (@property, @id, @avalue, @uvalue, @lvalue)
	end



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJobCostingSummary] --fs20_CostingSummaryByJob
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(33),
	@Job VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@CalType NUMERIC(1), -- 1 - By Ref. Acct, 2 - By Deduct Acct.
	@GroupBy CHAR(1), -- 1 - Parent Job, 0 - None
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Key0 NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @sdu_dk NVARCHAR(511), @sdu_ck NVARCHAR(511), @sTotal NVARCHAR(511), @sTotal2 NVARCHAR(511), @ps VARCHAR(128), @ps_nt VARCHAR(128), @ps2 VARCHAR(128), @ps_nt2 VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tang_giam NUMERIC(1), @No_co NUMERIC(1), @Tk VARCHAR(511), @Tk_du VARCHAR(511), @Tk_gt VARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @sdu_dk = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI001'
	SELECT @sdu_ck = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI004'
	SELECT @sTotal = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @sTotal2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL2'

	-- Openning
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #tBgTmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_vv <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(@ParentJob, '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1'
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv1 like ''' + REPLACE(@Group1, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv2 like ''' + REPLACE(@Group2, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv3 like ''' + REPLACE(@Group3, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	INSERT INTO #tBgTmp EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Job @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Job, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT ma_vv, SUM(du_no - du_co) AS du_dk, SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) AS du_dk_nt, MAX(tk) AS tk
		INTO #tBg FROM #tBgTmp GROUP BY ma_vv

	-- Arrising
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #tGL FROM wrkgl

	SET @q = ' insert into #tGL select a.ma_vv, a.tk, a.tk_du, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and ' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_vv, a.tk, a.tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT ma_vv, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)) AS tang_giam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ps_nt INTO #tAr FROM wrkcolumns

	DECLARE xCur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT RTRIM(ma_so) AS ma_so, tang_giam, no_co, RTRIM(tk) AS tk, RTRIM(tk_du) AS tk_du, RTRIM(tk_gt) AS tk_gt FROM v20covvth3 ORDER BY stt
	OPEN xCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @Ma_so, @Tang_giam, @No_co, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_gt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @ps = CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'sum(ps_no)' ELSE 'sum(ps_co)' END, @ps_nt = CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'sum(ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(ps_co_nt)' END
			, @ps2 = CASE WHEN @No_co = 2 THEN 'sum(ps_no)' ELSE 'sum(ps_co)' END, @ps_nt2 = CASE WHEN @No_co = 2 THEN 'sum(ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(ps_co_nt)' END

		IF @CalType = 1 BEGIN
			SET @Tk_du = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Tk_du), '''', '''''')
			IF CHARINDEX(',', @Tk_du) <= 0 SET @Key = 'where (''' + @Tk_du + ''' = '''' or tk_du like ''' + @Tk_du + '%'')'
			ELSE SET @Key = 'where (''' + @Tk_du + ''' = '''' or exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_du, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where tk_du like fc.fc))'

			SET @Tk = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Tk), '''', '''''')
			IF CHARINDEX(',', @Tk) <= 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and tk like ''' + @Tk + '%'''
			ELSE SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where tk like fc.fc)'

			SET @q = 'insert into #tAr select ma_vv, ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ma_so, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')  + ''', ' + RTRIM(@Tang_giam) + ', ' + @ps + ', ' + @ps_nt
			SET @q = @q	+ ' from #tGL ' + @Key
			SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_vv'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @Tk_gt = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Tk_gt), '''', '''''')
			IF CHARINDEX(',', @Tk_gt) <= 0 SET @Key = 'where (''' + @Tk_gt + ''' <> '''' and tk_du like ''' + @Tk_gt + '%'')'
			ELSE SET @Key = 'where (''' + @Tk_gt + ''' <> '''' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_gt, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where tk_du like fc.fc))'

			SET @Tk = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Tk), '''', '''''')
			IF CHARINDEX(',', @Tk) <= 0 BEGIN
				SET @Key0 = ' where tk like ''' + @Tk + '%'''
				SET @Key = @Key + ' and tk like ''' + @Tk + '%''' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Tk_gt) <= 0 THEN '' ELSE ')' END
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @Key0 = ' where exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where tk like fc.fc)'
				SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where tk like fc.fc)'
			END

			SET @q = 'insert into #tAr select ma_vv, ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ma_so, ' ', ''), '''', '''''') + ''', ' + RTRIM(@Tang_giam) + ', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt)'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (' + CHAR(13)
			SET @q = @q + 'select ma_vv, ' + @ps2 + ' as ps, ' + @ps_nt2 + ' as ps_nt from #tGL ' + @Key0 + ' group by ma_vv'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all' + CHAR(13)
			SET @q = @q + 'select ma_vv, - ' + @ps + ' as ps, - ' + @ps_nt + ' as ps_nt'
			SET @q = @q	+ ' from #tGL ' + @Key
			SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_vv) a group by ma_vv'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @Ma_so, @Tang_giam, @No_co, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_gt
	END
	CLOSE xCur
	DEALLOCATE xCur

	INSERT INTO #tAr
		SELECT a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, b.tang_giam, 0, 0
			FROM (SELECT MIN(ma_vv) AS ma_vv FROM #tAr) a CROSS JOIN v20covvth3 b
			WHERE b.ma_so NOT IN (SELECT ma_so FROM #tAr)

	-- Ending
	SELECT ma_vv, SUM(ps) AS du_ck, SUM(ps_nt) AS du_ck_nt
		INTO #tEd
		FROM (
			SELECT ma_vv, du_dk AS ps, du_dk_nt AS ps_nt FROM #tBg
			UNION ALL
			SELECT ma_vv, CASE WHEN tang_giam = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * ps, CASE WHEN tang_giam = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * ps_nt FROM #tAr
			) a GROUP BY ma_vv

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, ma_vv
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS sysorderrow, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_so, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS sysRowName, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS sysColumnName, 0 AS bac_vv
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0, '', CASE WHEN a.tang_giam = 1 THEN '01' ELSE '03' END + a.ma_so, ps, ps_nt
			, '', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(c.chi_tieu) ELSE RTRIM(c.chi_tieu2) END, 0
		FROM #tAR a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv LEFT JOIN v20covvth3 c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0, '', '02', SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt), '', @sTotal2, 0
		FROM #tAR a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
		WHERE tang_giam = 1
		GROUP BY a.ma_vv, b.ma_vv_me

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0, '', '00', du_dk, du_dk_nt, '', @sdu_dk, 0
		FROM #tBg a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0, '', '04', du_ck, du_ck_nt, '', @sdu_ck, 0
		FROM #tEd a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv

	-- Xu ly khong co cot so du dau ky
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '00')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 1, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0, '', '00', 0, 0, '', @sdu_dk, 0 FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv ORDER BY a.ma_vv

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT @sdu_dk
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END FROM v20covvth3 WHERE tang_giam = 1
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT @sTotal2
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END FROM v20covvth3 WHERE tang_giam = 2
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT @sdu_ck

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = 10 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'ps$', '' ELSE INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'ps_nt$', ''

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), a.header FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id
	UPDATE #pivot SET header = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN v20covvth3.chi_tieu ELSE v20covvth3.chi_tieu2 END FROM v20covvth3 WHERE header = v20covvth3.ma_so
	DROP TABLE #xpivot
	DROP TABLE #xcolumn

	--Group by parent job
	IF @GroupBy = '1' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GroupByParentJob '#report', 'ma_so, sysColumnName', 'ps, ps_nt'
		UPDATE #report SET systotal = CASE WHEN bac_vv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #order(stt INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, keyorder VARCHAR(33))
		INSERT INTO #order(keyorder) SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ma_vv) FROM #report
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt, sysorderrow = REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 10), ' ', '0') FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #order b ON a.ma_vv = b.keyorder
		DROP TABLE #order
	END

	UPDATE #report SET sysRowName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE b.ten_vv2 END
		FROM #report a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv

	-- Total row
	DECLARE @maxOrder VARCHAR(1023), @minOrder VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @maxOrder = MAX(sysorderrow) + 'Z', @minOrder = ' ' + MIN(sysorderrow) FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 9, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, @maxOrder, ma_so, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt), @sTotal, MAX(sysColumnName), 0 FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_so

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 0, 0, '', CHAR(9), NULL, @minOrder, ma_so, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt), @sTotal, MIN(sysColumnName), 0 FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_so
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, '', CHAR(10), NULL, @minOrder, ma_so, 0, 0, '', MIN(sysColumnName), 0 FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_so

	-- Xu ly cot chua co du lieu
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so LIKE '00%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 0, ma_vv_me, ma_vv, stt, sysorderrow, '00', 0, 0, sysRowName, @sdu_dk, bac_vv FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so LIKE '01%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 0, b.ma_vv_me, b.ma_vv, b.stt, b.sysorderrow, '01' + a.ma_so, 0, 0, b.sysRowName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, b.bac_vv FROM v20covvth3 a, (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv) b WHERE a.tang_giam = 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so LIKE '03%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 0, b.ma_vv_me, b.ma_vv, b.stt, b.sysorderrow, '03' + a.ma_so, 0, 0, b.sysRowName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, b.bac_vv FROM v20covvth3 a, (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv) b WHERE a.tang_giam <> 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so LIKE '02%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 0, ma_vv_me, ma_vv, stt, sysorderrow, '02', 0, 0, sysRowName, @sTotal2, bac_vv FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ma_so LIKE '04%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 0, ma_vv_me, ma_vv, stt, sysorderrow, '04', 0, 0, sysRowName, @sdu_ck, bac_vv FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv

	-- Xu ly khong co du lieu
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', '', 0, '', REPLACE(STR(id, 10), ' ', '0'), 0, 0, '', header, 0 FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN ma_vv = '' THEN ' ' ELSE (SPACE(bac_vv * 3) + RTRIM(ma_vv)) END AS ma_vv, stt, ma_so AS sysColumn, ps, ps_nt, CASE WHEN sysRowName = '' THEN ' ' ELSE (SPACE(bac_vv * 3) + sysRowName) END AS sysRowName,
			sysColumnName, sysorderrow AS sysRow, ISNULL(CASE WHEN stt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(stt AS VARCHAR(8)) END, ' ') AS sttex
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorderrow, ma_so
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptOutofDateItem] -- fs20_StockOverDate
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroups VARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1- Theo thực tế, 2 - Theo hóa đơn
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, ma_lo, a.dvt, ton00 AS so_luong
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vt2, c.loai_vt, a.nh_vt1, a.nh_vt2, a.nh_vt3
			, b.datetime0 AS ngay_hhsd, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(5)) AS ngay_cl
		INTO #report FROM wrkcolumns a, cdvt b, dmvt c
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #bal FROM wrkin

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	INSERT INTO #bal EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Lot @DateTo, @Unit, @Site, '', @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, MAX(b.dvt), SUM(so_luong)
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END
