			, MAX(b.loai_vt), MAX(b.nh_vt1), MAX(b.nh_vt2), MAX(b.nh_vt3)
			, CASE WHEN NOT MAX(c.ngay_hhsd) IS NULL THEN MAX(c.ngay_hhsd) ELSE DATEADD(dd, MAX(b.so_ngay_sp), MAX(c.ngay_nhap)) END
			, 0
		FROM #bal a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmlo c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = c.ma_lo
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo

	DELETE #report WHERE so_luong <= 0
	DELETE #report WHERE ngay_hhsd >= @DateTo
	UPDATE #report SET ngay_cl = DATEDIFF(dd, ngay_hhsd, @DateTo)
	DELETE #report WHERE ngay_cl = NULL

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @ItemGroups + CASE WHEN @Order = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @ItemGroups <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @ItemGroups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF @ItemGroups <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@ItemGroups)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@ItemGroups , 'vt', 'so_luong', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #report))
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong) SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(so_luong) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@ItemGroups)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_lo, ngay_hhsd as han_sd, ngay_cl as so_ngay_qua, so_luong as sl_ton from #report order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_lo, ngay_hhsd as han_sd, ngay_cl as so_ngay_qua, so_luong as sl_ton from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@ItemGroups  , 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrkcccong] AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ma_ca, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, 
		a.ghi_chu, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan, 
		b.bp_ref, b.vi_tri, b.bac_quan_ly
	FROM hrkcccong a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetItemFromBOM]
	@FieldExternal NVARCHAR(4000),
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nMax INT, @cItem VARCHAR(33), @iCount INT, @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRoundQty INT, @nBOMRate NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nxRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @nLn INT, @cIDNumber VARCHAR(13)
	DECLARE @cxItem VARCHAR(33), @cxUOM NVARCHAR(33), @nxItemRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @nxQty NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @nMax = 10, @iCount = 0, @nRoundQty = 3
	SELECT * INTO #ctsx FROM ctsx WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	-- Structs
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ct FROM #ctsx
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ctx FROM #ct
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #cty FROM #ct

	WHILE @iCount < @nMax AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ctsx WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_sp FROM phdm WHERE status = '1')) BEGIN
		DELETE #cty
		-- MO Items
		DECLARE crBOM CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_vt, so_luong, he_so, line_nbr FROM #ctsx WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_sp FROM phdm WHERE status = '1') ORDER BY ma_vt
		OPEN crBOM
		FETCH NEXT FROM crBOM INTO @cItem, @nQty, @nRate, @nLn
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @nBOMRate = he_so, @cIDNumber = stt_rec FROM phdm WHERE ma_sp = @cItem
			IF @nBOMRate = 0
				SELECT @nxRate = 0
			ELSE
				SELECT @nxRate = ROUND(@nQty*@nRate/@nBOMRate, @nRoundQty)

			-- BOM Items
			DECLARE crItems CURSOR FOR
				SELECT ma_vt, dvt, he_so, ROUND(@nxRate * (so_luong * (1 + tl_hh)), @nRoundQty) AS so_luong
					FROM ctdm WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND (ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR ngay_ct1 <= @Date) AND (ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR ngay_ct2 >= @Date)
			OPEN crItems
			FETCH NEXT FROM crItems INTO @cxItem, @cxUOM, @nxItemRate, @nxQty

			TRUNCATE TABLE #ct
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ctx

			INSERT INTO #ctx SELECT * FROM #ctsx WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND line_nbr = @nLn
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #ctx SET ma_vt = @cxItem, dvt = @cxUOM, he_so = @nxItemRate, so_luong = @nxQty
				INSERT INTO #ct SELECT * FROM #ctx
				FETCH NEXT FROM crItems INTO @cxItem, @cxUOM, @nxItemRate, @nxQty
			END
			CLOSE crItems
			DEALLOCATE crItems

			DELETE #ctsx WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND line_nbr = @nLn
			INSERT INTO #cty SELECT * FROM #ct WHERE ma_vt <> @cItem

			FETCH NEXT FROM crBOM INTO @cItem, @nQty, @nRate, @nLn
		END
		CLOSE crBOM
		DEALLOCATE crBOM
		SET @iCount = @iCount + 1

		INSERT INTO #ctsx SELECT * FROM #cty
	END

	UPDATE #ctsx SET ma_vi_tri = '', ma_lo = ''

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @q = 'select ' + @FieldExternal + ' from #ctsx a left outer join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join cdvt13 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho order by a.ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
/*
	THIS PROCEDURE IS OBSOLETE AND NOT USED
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CalcBookExRate] @nMonth TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cFC VARCHAR(33), @cUnit VARCHAR(33), @cBaseFC CHAR(33), @cVC CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @cKey NVARCHAR(4000), @cDCKey NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nMonth), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nMonth)

	DELETE ct00 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo and ma_dvcs LIKE (RTRIM(@cUnit)+ '%') AND ma_ct = @cVC AND ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%')
	UPDATE ct00 SET s5 = ps_no WHERE s5 = 0 AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%')
	UPDATE ct00 SET s6 = ps_co WHERE s6 = 0 AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%')
	DELETE gltggs WHERE ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') AND ma_nt <> @cBaseFC AND thang = @nMonth AND nam = @nYear

	SELECT tk, loai_cl_no, loai_cl_co
		INTO #tk FROM dmtk 
		WHERE ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') AND ma_nt <> @cBaseFC AND tk_cn = 0 AND loai_tk = 1 AND (loai_cl_co = 1 OR loai_cl_no = 1) 

	SET @cKey = 'tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk) AND ma_dvcs LIKE '+ CHAR(39)+ RTRIM(@cUnit)+ '%' + CHAR(39)
	SELECT tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt 
		INTO #dudau
		FROM cdtk
		WHERE 1=0

	SET @strSQL =  'INSERT #dudau SELECT a.tk'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ', SUM(a.du_no) AS du_no, SUM(a.du_co) AS du_co, SUM(a.du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(a.du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM (SELECT tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM cdtk WITH (INDEX(nam)) WHERE nam = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@nYear)))   + ' AND ' + @cKey
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' UNION ALL (SELECT tk,  SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM ct00 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct))  WHERE ngay_ct >= ' +CHAR(39) + dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dFrom) +CHAR(39)  + ' AND ngay_ct < ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) +CHAR(39)   + ' AND ' + @cKey + ' AND ma_nt LIKE ' + CHAR(39) + (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') + CHAR(39)
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' GROUP BY tk)) a GROUP BY a.tk'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no =0 WHERE du_no IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no_nt =0 WHERE du_no_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co =0 WHERE du_co IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co_nt =0 WHERE du_co_nt IS NULL

	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no = du_no - du_co, du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt

	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co = 0 WHERE du_no>0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co = -du_no WHERE du_no<=0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no = du_no WHERE du_no>0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no = 0 WHERE du_no<=0

	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt>0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_co_nt = -Du_no_nt WHERE du_no_nt<=0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no_nt = Du_no_nt WHERE du_no_nt>0
	UPDATE #dudau SET du_no_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt<=0

	SELECT a.tk, SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_gia, @nMonth AS thang,  @nYear AS nam
		INTO #tygia2
		FROM 
			(SELECT tk, SUM(s5) AS ps_no, SUM(s6) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
				FROM ct00  WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct))
				WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk from #tk) AND ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') AND ma_dvcs LIKE (RTRIM(@cUnit)+ '%')
				GROUP BY tk
			UNION ALL 
			(SELECT tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #dudau)) a GROUP BY a.tk

	SELECT a.*, 
		CASE
			WHEN b.loai_cl_no = 1 THEN 1
			WHEN b.loai_cl_co = 1 THEN 2
			ELSE 0
		END AS no_co, b.ma_nt
		INTO #tygia
		FROM #tygia2 a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk= b.tk	


	UPDATE #tygia SET ty_gia = ROUND(ps_co/ ps_co_nt, 2) WHERE ps_co_nt <> 0 AND no_co= 1
	UPDATE #tygia SET ty_gia = ROUND(ps_no/ ps_no_nt, 2) WHERE ps_no_nt <> 0 AND no_co= 2

	INSERT INTO gltggs (thang, nam, tk, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs, ma_kh)
		SELECT thang, nam, tk, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia, '' FROM #tygia WHERE ty_gia <> 0

	SELECT tk, loai_cl_no, loai_cl_co INTO #tkcn FROM dmtk
		WHERE ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') AND ma_nt <> @cBaseFC AND tk_cn = 1 AND loai_tk = 1 AND (loai_cl_co = 1 OR loai_cl_no = 1) 

	SET @cDCKey = 'tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tkcn) AND ma_dvcs LIKE '+ CHAR(39)+ RTRIM(@cUnit)+ '%'+ CHAR(39)

	SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt 
		INTO #dudaukh
		FROM cdkh
		WHERE 1=0

	SET @strSQL =  'INSERT #dudaukh SELECT a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ', SUM(a.du_no) AS du_no, SUM(a.du_co) AS du_co, SUM(a.du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(a.du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM (SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM cdkh WITH (INDEX(nam)) WHERE nam = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@nYear)))   + ' AND ' + @cDCKey
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' UNION ALL (SELECT tk,  ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' FROM ct00 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct))  WHERE ngay_ct >= ' +CHAR(39) + dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dFrom) +CHAR(39)  + ' AND ngay_ct < ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + CHAR(39)   + ' AND ' + @cDCKey + ' AND ma_nt LIKE ' + CHAR(39) + (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') + CHAR(39)
	SET @strSQL =  @strSQL + ' GROUP BY tk, ma_kh)) a GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_kh'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no =0 WHERE du_no IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no_nt =0 WHERE du_no_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co =0 WHERE du_co IS NULL
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co_nt =0 WHERE du_co_nt IS NULL

	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no = du_no - du_co, du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt

	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co = 0 WHERE du_no>0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co = -du_no WHERE du_no<=0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no = du_no WHERE du_no>0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no = 0 WHERE du_no<=0

	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt>0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_co_nt = -Du_no_nt WHERE du_no_nt<=0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no_nt = Du_no_nt WHERE du_no_nt>0
	UPDATE #dudaukh SET du_no_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt<=0

	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(38, 12)) AS ty_gia, @nMonth AS thang,  @nYear AS nam
		INTO #tygia3
		FROM 
			(SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(s5) AS ps_no, SUM(s6) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
				FROM ct00 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct))
				WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk from #tkcn) AND ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFC)+'%') AND ma_dvcs LIKE (RTRIM(@cUnit)+ '%')
				GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
			UNION ALL 
			(SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #dudaukh)) a GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_kh

	SELECT a.*,
		CASE
			WHEN b.loai_cl_no = 1 THEN 1
			WHEN b.loai_cl_co = 1 THEN 2
			ELSE 0
		END AS no_co, b.ma_nt
		INTO #tygia1
		FROM #tygia3 a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk= b.tk	

	DECLARE @nRRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nRRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_TG'

	UPDATE #tygia1 SET ty_gia = ROUND(ps_co/ ps_co_nt, @nRRound) WHERE ps_co_nt <> 0 AND no_co= 1
	UPDATE #tygia1 SET ty_gia = ROUND(ps_no/ ps_no_nt, @nRRound) WHERE ps_no_nt <> 0 AND no_co= 2

	INSERT INTO gltggs (thang, nam, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs)
		SELECT thang, nam, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia FROM #tygia1 WHERE ty_gia <> 0
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostASTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 	
	@idNumber CHAR(13), 
	@groups VARCHAR(128), 
	@step TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @loai_ct CHAR(1), @tk VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT, @dien_giai NVARCHAR(512)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m32$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d32$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT a.*, a.ma_kh2 AS cuc_thue INTO #inputvat FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'	


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #inputvat' + ' select *, ma_kh2 as cuc_thue from ctgt30 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_no AS tk, tk_no AS tk_du, tk_no AS tk0, tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, 
		CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @tk = tk, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @dien_giai = dien_giai FROM #master

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#inputvat', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '10'
	

	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SELECT @isPost = 1, @noAccounts = ''
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0

	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN				
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_no, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh,  ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tt - thue, ps_co_nt = tt_nt - thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1
	
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
			IF @loai_ct = '3' UPDATE #dGL SET ma_kh = ma_kh_i WHERE ma_kh_i <> ''

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Thue
		IF @isPost = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE (t_thue + t_thue_nt) <> 0) BEGIN
			DECLARE @stt INT
			SELECT @stt = MAX(stt) FROM #dGL
			UPDATE #inputvat SET cuc_thue = '' FROM #inputvat a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
			SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_thue_no AS tk, t_thue AS ps_no, t_thue_nt AS ps_no_nt, t_thue AS ps_co, t_thue_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk INTO #tGL FROM #inputvat

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL', '#inputvat', 't_thue + t_thue_nt <> 0', 't_thue, t_thue_nt', 'tk_thue_no, cuc_thue' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = t_thue, ps_co_nt = t_thue_nt, dien_giai = @dien_giai, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + @stt + 2) / 2), line_nbr = stt + @stt + 1

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET line_nbr = line_nbr + 1, tk = tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
			UPDATE #tGL SET ma_kh = ma_kh2 FROM #tGL a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1) AND a.ma_kh2 <> ''

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_EmployeePITInformationCreate]
	@DateEffective SMALLDATETIME,
	@Kind CHAR(1),
	@Labor CHAR(1),
	@Tax CHAR(1),
	@Deduction CHAR(1),
	@Authorization CHAR(1),
	@RefAuthorization BIT,
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@Message NVARCHAR(511) OUT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT,
	@Debug INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @v NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @mF$ NVARCHAR(4000), @mFV$ NVARCHAR(4000), @dF$ NVARCHAR(4000), @dFV$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @d = GETDATE()

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #master FROM hrtttncn
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #detail FROM hrtttncnct

	-- Set
	IF @IDNumbers = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @IDNumbers = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @IDNumbers <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@IDNumbers, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- + m
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master (stt_rec, doi_tuong, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, cn_nn_duoi12, hop_dong_yn, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, @doi_tuong, @tinh_thue_yn, @tinh_gt_yn, @uy_quyen_yn, @cn_nn_duoi12, @hop_dong_yn, @d, @d, @u, @u'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@doi_tuong char(1), @tinh_thue_yn char(1), @tinh_gt_yn char(1), @uy_quyen_yn char(1), @cn_nn_duoi12 bit, @hop_dong_yn char(1), @d smalldatetime, @u int'
		, @doi_tuong = @Kind, @tinh_thue_yn = @Tax, @tinh_gt_yn = @Deduction, @uy_quyen_yn = @Authorization, @cn_nn_duoi12 = @RefAuthorization, @hop_dong_yn = @Labor, @d = @d, @u = @UserID
	--
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#master', 'stt_rec, doi_tuong, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, cn_nn_duoi12, hop_dong_yn, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2', 1

	-- + d
	IF @DateEffective IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail (stt_rec, stt_rec0, doi_tuong, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, cn_nn_duoi12, hop_dong_yn, ngay_hl, line_nbr)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, ''001'', @doi_tuong, @tinh_thue_yn, @tinh_gt_yn, @uy_quyen_yn, @cn_nn_duoi12, @hop_dong_yn, @d, 1'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #master a'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@doi_tuong char(1), @tinh_thue_yn char(1), @tinh_gt_yn char(1), @uy_quyen_yn char(1), @cn_nn_duoi12 bit, @hop_dong_yn char(1), @d smalldatetime'
			, @doi_tuong = @Kind, @tinh_thue_yn = @Tax, @tinh_gt_yn = @Deduction, @uy_quyen_yn = @Authorization, @cn_nn_duoi12 = @RefAuthorization, @hop_dong_yn = @Labor, @d = @DateEffective
		--
		EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#detail', 'stt_rec, stt_rec0, doi_tuong, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, cn_nn_duoi12, hop_dong_yn, ngay_hl, line_nbr', 1

		-- Delete Data
		DELETE #detail FROM #detail a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrtttncnct b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	END

	-- Delete Data
	DELETE #master FROM #master a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrtttncn b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)


	-- + Table: hrtttncn
	IF @Debug <> 1 SET @q = 'insert into hrtttncn' ELSE SET @q = NULL
	SET @q = @q + ' select * from #master'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: hrtttncnct
	IF @DateEffective IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @Debug <> 1 SET @q = 'insert into hrtttncnct' ELSE SET @q = NULL
		SET @q = @q + ' select * from #detail'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_ReplaceWordAt(@strString NVARCHAR(4000), @strWord NVARCHAR(511), @intNum INT)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nCount INT, @nStart INT, @nNum INT
	DECLARE @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strReturn = @strString
	SET @nCount = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strString)
	IF @intNum BETWEEN 1 AND @nCount
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nStart = 1, @nNum = 0, @strString = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) + ',', @strReturn = ''
			WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart) > 0
				BEGIN
					SET @nNum = @nNum + 1
					IF @nNum < @intNum
						SET @strReturn = @strReturn + SUBSTRING(@strString, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart) - @nStart) + ','
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strWord
							SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart)
							IF @nStart < LEN(@strString)
								SET @strReturn = @strReturn + SUBSTRING(@strString, @nStart, LEN(@strString) - @nStart)
							BREAK
						END
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart) + 1
				END
		END

	RETURN RTRIM(LTRIM(@strReturn))
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_Convert2AccountBalance4Unit @nYear INT, @cUnit VARCHAR(33) AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Cap nhat nhung tai khoan moi va xoa nhung ban ghi khong thoa man trong danh muc tai khoan
	DECLARE @m_tk_du0 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @m_tk_du0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_du0'

/*
	DELETE cdtk WHERE Nam = @nYear AND (
						Tk NOT IN (SELECT Tk FROM dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1) 
						OR (@m_tk_du0 <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @m_tk_du0) = 1)
					)
	DELETE cdtk WHERE Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs <> '' AND Ma_dvcs NOT IN (SELECT Ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs)
*/

	INSERT INTO Cdtk(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, dien_giai, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @nYear, @cUnit, tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
		FROM Dmtk 
		WHERE Loai_tk = 1 AND (@m_tk_du0 = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @m_tk_du0) = 0) AND NOT 
			EXISTS (SELECT * FROM cdtk WHERE Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND Tk = Dmtk.Tk)
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_LoadEITran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - Release, 2 - Adjustment, 3 - Replacement, 9 - Cancelled
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@AdjustMode BIT = 0,
	@KeyList VARCHAR(MAX) = '',
	@Packet BIT = 0,
	@PacketQuantity INT = 0,
	@PacketExternal VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Mobile BIT = 0 -- 1 - Mobile, 0 - Web
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(1), @Table VARCHAR(32), @Join VARCHAR(4000), @provider INT, @tinh_trang_hddt VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Key = ''

	SELECT @Table = mtable, @Status = status_gl FROM hddtfields WHERE xtype = 3 and ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt, ps_no AS tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, user_id2, datetime2
		, stt_rec AS stt_rec1, ma_ct AS ma_ct1, so_ct AS so_ct1, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct1, ps_no_nt AS t_km_nt
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	--
	CREATE TABLE #keyList(stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$keys') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @KeyList = CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), text) FROM #$keys
	END
	IF @KeyList <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @cPacket VARCHAR(1)
		SELECT @cPacket = CHAR(255)
		INSERT INTO #keyList SELECT data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@KeyList, @cPacket)
	END

	-- Packet
	DECLARE @optionPack INT, @optionNumofPack INT, @queryTopRow VARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @optionPack = 0, @queryTopRow = ''
	IF @PacketQuantity < 0 SELECT @PacketQuantity = 0
	IF @Packet = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @optionNumofPack = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_limit_invoice_hddt'
		SELECT @optionPack = val FROM options WHERE name = 'limit_release_packet'
		IF @optionPack > @PacketQuantity SELECT @optionPack = @PacketQuantity
		SELECT @queryTopRow = N' top ' + RTRIM(@optionPack * @optionNumofPack) + ' '
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = CASE WHEN @provider = 3 THEN '''0'',''1''' ELSE '''0''' END

	IF @Type = '9' BEGIN
		SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt ' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN 'in (''2'',''3''' + CASE WHEN @AdjustMode = 1 THEN ',''9'')' ELSE ')' END ELSE '= ''2''' END
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' SET @Key = @Key + ' and not exists(select 1 from hddt01 c with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec0)'
	END
	IF @Type IN ('1', '2') SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt in (' + @tinh_trang_hddt + ') and b.status = ''' + @Status + ''' and not exists(select 1 from hddt01 d with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec1)'
	IF @Type = '3' BEGIN
		SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt in (' + @tinh_trang_hddt + ') and b.status = ''' + @Status + ''''
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from hddt01 c with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec1)'
	END
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN ' and stt_rec_hd = ''''' WHEN @Type = 2 THEN ' and stt_rec_hd <> ''''' ELSE '' END

	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select ' + @queryTopRow + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' AND @Packet = 0 THEN 'c.stt_rec0' ELSE 'a.stt_rec' END + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN 'c.ngay_ct0, c.so_ct0' ELSE 'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.user_id2, a.datetime2' +
			CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', null' END + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HDF') THEN CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN ', a.t_km_nt' ELSE ', a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt' END ELSE ', 0' END +
			' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' +
			CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN ' join hddt01 c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec1' ELSE '' END +
			CASE WHEN @KeyList <> '' THEN ' join #keyList d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec' ELSE '' END +
			' where %[' + @Key + ']% order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN 'a.stt_rec_hd' ELSE 'a.stt_rec' END +
			', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN 'a.ma_ct_hd, null, ''''' ELSE 'a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct' END +
			', a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.user_id2, a.datetime2' +
			CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', null' END + ', 0' +
			' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' +
			' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @Type = '3' BEGIN
			DECLARE @c VARCHAR(32), @t VARCHAR(32)
			SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_ct)) as c INTO #v FROM #tmp
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #v) BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @c = c FROM #v
				SELECT @t = CASE @c WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' WHEN 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' END
				SELECT @q = 'update #tmp set ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct from #tmp a join ' + @t + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				DELETE #v WHERE c = @c
			END
		END
	END

	EXEC FastBusiness$Generate$Key @UserID, @Key OUTPUT

	IF @Packet = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Mobile = 0
			SELECT 0 AS tag, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct,
					a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh,
					a.tien_nt + a.t_km_nt AS tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct,
					REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), a.datetime2, 20), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '-', '') AS chuoi_ngay,
					a.stt_rec1, a.ma_ct1, a.ngay_ct1, a.so_ct1, CASE WHEN @Type <> '3' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec) ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec1) END AS [hash]
				FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
				ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
		ELSE
			SELECT 0 AS isCheck, 0 AS line_nbr, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct,
					a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh,
					a.tien_nt + a.t_km_nt AS tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct,
					REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), a.datetime2, 20), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '-', '') AS chuoi_ngay,
					a.stt_rec1, a.ma_ct1, a.ngay_ct1, a.so_ct1, CASE WHEN @Type <> '3' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec) ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec1) END AS [hash]
				FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
				ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Type = '3' UPDATE #tmp SET stt_rec = stt_rec1, so_ct = so_ct1, ngay_ct = ngay_ct1, ma_ct = ma_ct1
		UPDATE #tmp SET stt_rec1 = 0
		ALTER TABLE #tmp ALTER COLUMN stt_rec1 INT
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(32)) AS chuoi_ngay, so_ct AS so_ct_tu, so_ct AS so_ct, 0 AS so_luong, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec_key, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS stt_rec, stt_rec1, 0 AS ph_yn
			INTO #tpackTemp FROM #tmp
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #tpack FROM #tpackTemp
		CREATE TABLE #tngay(p VARCHAR(6))

		--
		INSERT INTO #tngay SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #tmp
		DECLARE @w1 VARCHAR(32)
		DECLARE @ngay1 DATETIME, @ngay2 DATETIME
		DECLARE @w2 VARCHAR(32), @value VARCHAR(MAX)

		SELECT @w1 = MIN(p) FROM #tngay
		WHILE @w1 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @ngay1 = @w1 + '01', @ngay2 = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @ngay1) - 1
			SELECT @w2 = '', @value = ''
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tpackTemp
			SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, *, 0 AS ph_yn INTO #tmp1 FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @ngay1 AND @ngay2 ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
			UPDATE #tmp1 SET stt_rec1 = ((id - 1) /@optionNumofPack)
			IF @PacketExternal = '0' BEGIN
				UPDATE #tmp1 SET ph_yn = 1 FROM #tmp1 a JOIN khhddt b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh WHERE b.status <> 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				UPDATE #tmp1 SET ph_yn = 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #tpackTemp
				SELECT MAX(ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs,MAX(ma_ct) AS ma_ct, MIN(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct_tu, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct
					, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), MAX(datetime2), 20), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '-', '') AS chuoi_ngay
					, MIN(so_ct) AS so_ct_tu, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct
					, COUNT(*) AS so_luong
					, MAX(stt_rec) AS stt_rec_key, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS stt_rec, stt_rec1, MIN(ph_yn) AS ph_yn
						 FROM #tmp1 GROUP BY stt_rec1 ORDER BY stt_rec1

			SELECT @w2 = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #tpackTemp
			WHILE @w2 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @value = ''
				SELECT @value = ISNULL(@value + CHAR(255), '') + stt_rec FROM #tmp1 WHERE stt_rec1 = @w2
				UPDATE #tpackTemp SET stt_rec = STUFF(@value, 1, 1, '') WHERE stt_rec1 = @w2
				SELECT @w2 = MIN(stt_rec1) FROM #tpackTemp WHERE stt_rec1 > @w2
			END

			INSERT INTO #tpack(ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct, chuoi_ngay, so_ct_tu, so_ct, so_luong, stt_rec_key, stt_rec, stt_rec1, ph_yn)
				SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct, chuoi_ngay, so_ct_tu, so_ct, so_luong, stt_rec_key, stt_rec, stt_rec1, ph_yn FROM #tpackTemp ORDER BY stt_rec1

			DROP TABLE #tmp1
			SELECT @w1 = MIN(p) FROM #tngay WHERE p > @w1
		END

		IF @Mobile = 0
			SELECT 0 AS tag, *, '0' AS packet_status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Chưa thực hiện' ELSE N'No Action' END AS packet_status_name, NULL AS packet_bd, NULL AS packet_kt FROM #tpack ORDER BY id --ngay_ct_tu, so_ct_tu
		ELSE
			SELECT 0 AS isCheck, 0 AS line_nbr, *, '0' AS packet_status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Chưa thực hiện' ELSE N'No Action' END AS packet_status_name, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS packet_bd, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS packet_kt FROM #tpack ORDER BY id --ngay_ct_tu, so_ct_tu

		DROP TABLE #tpack
		DROP TABLE #tpackTemp
		DROP TABLE #tngay
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_FADelDeprAlloc]
	@nFrom TINYINT,
	@nTo TINYINT,
	@nYear INT,
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	IF @cAction = 'Del' SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	IF @cAction = 'New' SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nFrom, @nYear), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nTo, @nYear)

	-- Delete from ct00
	DELETE ct00 WHERE ma_ct = @cVC AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

	-- Delete from r00
	SELECT @q = 'delete r00$%Partition where %[ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@cVC, '''', '') + ''' and dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, ''' + REPLACE(@cUnit, '''', '') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@cUnits, '''', '') + ''') = 1]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIScoreByItem] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, a.ghi_chu, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_ct' + @cE + ' AS ten_chi_tieu'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bidmctdg g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_chi_tieu = g.ma_ct'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 4, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''stt, ma_chi_tieu, ten_chi_tieu'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END
