CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptMultiPeriodJobLeavingStatisticsByReason]
	@periodType TINYINT,
	@periodCount TINYINT,
	@DateStart SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Permanent, 2 - Probationary, * - All
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Filter NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @i AS INT, @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @Total NVARCHAR(1024), @HRM013 NVARCHAR(1024)

	--	
	SELECT @HRM013 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM013'
	SELECT @sPeriod = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @DateTo = 
		CASE @periodType
			WHEN 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY, @periodCount*7, @DateStart)
			WHEN 2 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, @periodCount*1, @DateStart)
			WHEN 3 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, @periodCount*3, @DateStart)
			WHEN 4 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, @periodCount*6, @DateStart)
			WHEN 5 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, @periodCount*12, @DateStart)
		END - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_nghi, ly_do_nghi INTO #hrnv FROM hrnv
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xPeriod, CAST(0 AS INT) AS so_nv, ma_ldnv INTO #p FROM hrdmldnv

	CREATE INDEX n ON #hrnv(ngay_nghi)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a', '%a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%a.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.ngay_nghi is not null and a.ngay_nghi between @d1 and @d2)'
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpType = '1' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= @d2'
	IF @EmpType = '2' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > @d2)'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF (@PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c with(nolock) on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	-- Employee
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrnv select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_nghi, a.ly_do_nghi'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%a', 'a')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p int, @d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @p = @i, @d1 = @DateStart, @d2 = @DateTo
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #p select replace(str(@p, 3), space(1), ''0''), count(stt_rec), ly_do_nghi'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #hrnv a where ngay_nghi between @d1 and @d2 group by ly_do_nghi'
	--
	SELECT @DateFrom = @DateStart, @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @DateTo = 
			CASE @periodType
				WHEN 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 7, @DateFrom)
				WHEN 2 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @DateFrom)
				WHEN 3 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @DateFrom)
				WHEN 4 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @DateFrom)
				WHEN 5 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @DateFrom)
			END - 1
		SELECT @dStart = dStart1, @dEnd = dEnd1 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
		--
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p int, @d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @p = @i, @d1 = @dStart, @d2 = @dEnd
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #p WHERE xPeriod = @i) INSERT INTO #p SELECT TOP 1 REPLACE(STR(@i, 3), SPACE(1), '0'), 0, ly_do_nghi FROM #hrnv
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1, @DateFrom = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @DateTo)
	END
	--
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(b.stt, 0), 9), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + a.ma_ldnv AS xRow
			, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ldnv ELSE b.ten_ldnv2 END, @HRM013) AS xRowName
			, a.xPeriod AS xColumn, @sPeriod + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(CAST(a.xPeriod AS INT)) AS xColumnName
			, a.so_nv INTO #report
		FROM #p a LEFT JOIN hrdmldnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ldnv = b.ma_ldnv

	-- Total
	IF (SELECT SUM(so_nv) FROM #p) <> 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 0, 0, CHAR(9), @Total, xColumn, MAX(xColumnName), SUM(so_nv) FROM #report GROUP BY xColumn
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, CHAR(10), '', xColumn, MAX(xColumnName), 0 FROM #report GROUP BY xColumn
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 9, 0, 1, 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ', @Total, xColumn, MAX(xColumnName), SUM(so_nv) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY xColumn
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, CHAR(9), CHAR(9), REPLACE(STR(@i, 3), SPACE(1), '0'), @sPeriod + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(@i), 0
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, MAX(xColumnName) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY xColumn ORDER BY xColumn
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = 'so_nv$' + RTRIM(id)
	INSERT INTO #pivot (name, header) SELECT 'so_nv', @Total

	-- View
	SELECT *, CAST(xColumn AS INT) AS xPeriod FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, xRow
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
/*
**	Retrieve the owner object(s) of a given property
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_getobjwithprop_u
	@property varchar(30),
	@uvalue nvarchar(255)
as
	set nocount on

	if (@property is null) or (@property = '')
	begin
		raiserror('Must specify a property name.',-1,-1)
		return (1)
	end

	if (@uvalue is null)
		select objectid id from dbo.dtproperties
			where property=@property

	else
		select objectid id from dbo.dtproperties
			where property=@property and uvalue=@uvalue



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJobsBalance] --fs20_JobsBalance
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(33),
	@Job VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy CHAR(1),
	@JobGroup VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupOrder VARCHAR(128),
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Du_no AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_no_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_co AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_co_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT tk, ma_vv, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #tmp1 FROM #tmp
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, a.ma_vv, du_no, du_co
		, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ma_vv_me, a.ma_kh, nh_vv1, nh_vv2, nh_vv3, b.ten_vv, b.ten_vv2, 0 AS bac_vv INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvv b

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_vv <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @GroupBy = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1'
	IF @JobGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, bac_vv, ten_vv, ten_vv2', 'int, int, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, '''', a.ma_vv, sum(du_no), sum(du_co), sum(du_no_nt), sum(du_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '1' THEN 'ma_vv_me' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '2' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '0' THEN 'max(nh_vv1), max(nh_vv2), max(nh_vv3)' ELSE ''''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_vv)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_vv2)' ELSE '''''' END + ', 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from %Table a left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vv' + CASE @GroupBy WHEN '1' THEN ', ma_vv_me' WHEN '2' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END

	IF @GroupBy = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT #tmp EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$JobCustomer @Date, @Unit, @Account, @Job, '', @BalanceType, '2', @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Table', '#tmp')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT #tmp1 EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Job @Date, @Unit, @Account, @Job, @BalanceType, '2', @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Table', '#tmp1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @GroupBy = '0' BEGIN
		IF @GroupOrder = '' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @o = @GroupOrder + ', ' + @Order
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupOrder, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		END

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupOrder, 'vv', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF @GroupBy = '1' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GroupByParentJob '#report', '', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt'
		UPDATE #report SET systotal = CASE WHEN bac_vv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		UPDATE #report SET ten_vv = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE '' END, ten_vv2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vv2 END
			FROM #report a JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
	END
	IF @GroupBy = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @o = 'ma_kh, ' + @Order
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'vv', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vv', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt'
	IF @GroupBy = '1' SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv,0) * 3) + ma_vv) as ma_vv, rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv, 0) * 3) + ten_vv) as ten_vv, rtrim(space(isnull(bac_vv, 0) * 3) + ten_vv2) as ten_vv2 '
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ', ma_vv, ten_vv, ten_vv2'
	SET @q = @q + ', du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, sysorderrow from #report order by '
	IF @GroupBy = '0'
		IF @GroupOrder = '' SET @q = @q + 'sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
			ELSE SET @q = @q + @GroupOrder + ', sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	IF @GroupBy = '1' SET @q = @q + 'sysorderrow, sysorder'
	IF @GroupBy = '2' SET @q = @q + 'ma_kh, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdcvaora] AS
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.gio, a.hs_yn, a.gio0, a.vao_ra, a.ghi_chu, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan, b.bp_ref, b.vi_tri, b.bac_quan_ly
		FROM hrdcvaora a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetMaterialsFromBOMByProduct] @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @product VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nMax INT, @i INT, @nQRound INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @nMax = 10, @i = 1, @nQRound = 8, @dVC = ISNULL(@dVC, getDate())

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_sp, dvt, so_luong, he_so INTO #phdm FROM phdm
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, so_luong, tl_hh INTO #ctdm FROM ctdm WHERE (ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR ngay_ct1 <= @dVC) AND (ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR ngay_ct2 >= @dVC) AND so_luong <> 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS lvl, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ref, ma_sp, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, he_so AS he_so2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_hh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(24, 12)) AS so_luong, 0 AS xmaster, 0 AS xdetail INTO #ctsx FROM ctsx
	SELECT TOP 0 lvl, ref, ma_sp, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, he_so2, tl_hh, so_luong, 0 AS stt INTO #t FROM #ctsx

	SET @q = 'insert into #ctsx(lvl, ref, ma_sp, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, he_so2, tl_hh, so_luong, xmaster, xdetail) select 0, 0, a.ma_sp, a.ma_sp, a.dvt, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0 from #phdm a' + CASE WHEN @product <> '' THEN ' where a.ma_sp like ''' + @product + '%''' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	WHILE (@i <= @nMax) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT @i, a.stt, a.ma_sp, c.ma_vt, c.dvt, b.he_so, c.he_so, c.tl_hh, ROUND(CASE WHEN b.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (a.so_luong / b.he_so) END * c.he_so * c.so_luong * (1 + c.tl_hh), @nQRound), stt
			FROM #ctsx a JOIN #phdm b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_sp JOIN #ctdm c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE a.xmaster = 0 AND a.ma_vt <> c.ma_vt

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

		UPDATE #ctsx SET xmaster = 1 FROM #ctsx a JOIN #t b ON a.stt = b.stt WHERE a.xmaster = 0
		INSERT INTO #ctsx (lvl, ref, ma_sp, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, he_so2, tl_hh, so_luong, xmaster, xdetail) SELECT lvl, ref, ma_sp, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, he_so2, tl_hh, so_luong, 0, stt FROM #t

		-- Next
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	SELECT * FROM #ctsx ORDER BY stt
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CalDepreciation]
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ts_kh' AND val  = '1')
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs_CalDepreciationByDay @nCycle, @nYear, @nUserID, @cUnit
			RETURN
		END

	-- 1. Declare
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nDayTo INT, @nRound INT, @nFCRound INT
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @fromCycles VARCHAR(16), @baseCurrency CHAR(3)

	-- 2. Set
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear), @fromCycles = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dFrom), @nDayTo = DAY(@dTo)
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, 0, 'New')
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	-- 3. Create template file
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ky_kh00, tl_kh00, so_ky_kh_cl, ngay_kh_kt
		INTO #dmts FROM dmts

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmts select so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ky_kh00, tl_kh00, so_ky_kh_cl, ngay_kh_kt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dmts where ((ngay_giam is null) or (''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' <= ngay_giam))'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmts(so_the_ts)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv INTO #ctkhts FROM ctkhts a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE a.ky = @nCycle AND a.nam = @nYear AND a.sua_kh = 1
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmts
		FROM ctdmts a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmts(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmts_ex
		FROM ctdmts a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) > dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dTo) and dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @fromCycles AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmts_ex(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	INSERT INTO #tctdmts SELECT * FROM #tctdmts_ex a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tctdmts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, c.loai_tg_ts, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmts1
		FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmtgts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @fromCycles AND a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @fromCycles

	UPDATE #tctdmts1 SET nguyen_gia = - nguyen_gia, gt_cl = - gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = - gt_kh_ky,
		nguyen_gia_nt = -nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl_nt = -gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = -gt_kh_ky_nt WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmts2Tmp FROM #tctdmts
	INSERT INTO #tctdmts2Tmp SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, 0, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, 0, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt FROM #tctdmts1 a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky,
			SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt
		INTO #tctdmts2 FROM #tctdmts2Tmp GROUP BY so_the_ts, ma_nv

	SELECT a.*, b.tk_kh, b.tk_ts, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt INTO #tFaDepr FROM #tctdmts2 a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(tk_kh) AS tk_kh, MAX(tk_ts) AS tk_ts, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
		INTO #tctbpts
		FROM cthsts WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 20) IN
				(SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 20) FROM cthsts WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts)
				AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmts)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #tFaDepr SET tk_kh = b.tk_kh, tk_ts = b.tk_ts, tk_cp = b.tk_cp, ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #tctbpts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	UPDATE #tFaDepr SET gt_kh_ky = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ngay_kh1 < @dFrom

	-- 4. Delete
	DELETE ctkhts WHERE ky = @nCycle AND nam = @nYear AND sua_kh = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmts)

	-- 5. Calc
	-- + Units-of-production
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CASE WHEN b.tong_sl <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.nguyen_gia * ISNULL(c.sl_kh, 0) / b.tong_sl, @nRound) ELSE CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) END AS gt_kh_ky,
			a.nguyen_gia_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt,
			CASE WHEN b.tong_sl <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.nguyen_gia_nt * ISNULL(c.sl_kh, 0) / b.tong_sl, @nFCRound) ELSE CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) END AS gt_kh_ky_nt, 0 AS is_suspend, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt INTO #res
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts LEFT JOIN ctslts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND c.nam = @nYear AND c.ky = @nCycle
		WHERE b.kieu_kh = 1 AND b.tong_sl <> 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles

	-- + Declinning-balance with Adjustment
	DECLARE @nTMOYs INT
	SELECT @nTMOYs = 12
	SELECT *, MONTH(ngay_kh0) - ky_kh00 AS open_cycle, MONTH(ngay_kh0) - ky_kh00 AS start_cycle, @nYear AS open_year, YEAR(ngay_kh0) AS start_year
			, so_ky_kh_cl + ky_kh00 AS remain_period, 1 AS remain_value_type
		INTO #t1 FROM #dmts	WHERE kieu_kh = 2 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles
	UPDATE #t1 SET open_cycle = open_cycle + @nTMOYs, start_year = start_year - 1 WHERE open_cycle <= 0
	UPDATE #t1 SET open_year = open_year - 1 WHERE open_cycle > @nCycle
	UPDATE #t1 SET remain_value_type = 2, remain_period = remain_period + (start_year * 12 + start_cycle) - (open_year * 12 + open_cycle) FROM #t1 WHERE (@nYear * 12 + @nCycle) - (start_year * 12 + start_cycle) >= @nTMOYs

	INSERT INTO #res SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia,
		a.nguyen_gia, 0, 0, 0, 0,
		dbo.ff_max(ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl + c.gt_da_kh00 ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl, 0) END * b.tl_kh00 / @nTMOYs, @nRound),
		CASE WHEN b.remain_period > 0 THEN ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl + c.gt_da_kh00 ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl, 0) END / b.remain_period, @nRound) ELSE 0 END),
		a.nguyen_gia_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0,
		dbo.ff_max(ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl_nt + c.gt_da_kh00_nt ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl_nt, 0) END * b.tl_kh00 / @nTMOYs, @nFCRound),
		CASE WHEN b.remain_period > 0 THEN ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl_nt + c.gt_da_kh00_nt ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl_nt, 0) END / b.remain_period, @nFCRound) ELSE 0 END),
		0, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt
	FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #t1 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN ctdmts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv LEFT JOIN ctkhts d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = d.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = d.ma_nv AND d.nam = b.open_year AND d.ky = b.open_cycle - 1

	-- + Straight-line: Suspending
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den INTO #dmtskkh FROM dmtskkh a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= @dTo AND a.ngay_hl_den >= @dFrom
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_giam, a.ngay_kh0, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, 0 AS is_suspend
		INTO #t2 FROM #dmts	a LEFT JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, MIN(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu, MAX(ngay_hl_den) AS ngay_hl_den FROM #dmtskkh GROUP BY so_the_ts) b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	WHERE a.kieu_kh = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(a.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles

	UPDATE #t2 SET ngay_hl_tu = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, ngay_hl_tu) + 1, 0) WHERE ngay_hl_tu IS NOT NULL AND ngay_hl_tu > DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, ngay_hl_tu), 0)
	UPDATE #t2 SET ngay_hl_den = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, ngay_hl_den), -1) WHERE ngay_hl_den IS NOT NULL AND ngay_hl_den < DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, ngay_hl_den) + 1, -1)
	UPDATE #t2 SET is_suspend = 1 WHERE MONTH(@dFrom) BETWEEN MONTH(ngay_hl_tu) AND MONTH(ngay_hl_den)

	INSERT INTO #res SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia,
		a.nguyen_gia, 0, 0, 0, 0, CASE b.is_suspend WHEN 0 THEN a.gt_kh_ky ELSE 0 END,
		a.nguyen_gia_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, CASE b.is_suspend WHEN 0 THEN a.gt_kh_ky_nt ELSE 0 END,
		b.is_suspend, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt
	FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #t2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- Acc. Depreciation Value
	INSERT INTO #res
		SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, b.ma_bp, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, c.ma_nt, c.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh
				, 0, 0, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, 0, 0, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, -1, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt
			FROM #tctdmts2 a
				JOIN #tFaDepr b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv
				JOIN #dmts c ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #res b WHERE a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv)

	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #res a JOIN #tctdmts2 b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #res a JOIN ctkhts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @nYear * 12 + @nCycle - 1

	-- Add depreciated value on adj. table
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + b.gt_da_kh_dc, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + b.gt_da_kh_dc_nt FROM #res a
		JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(gt_da_kh * CASE WHEN loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt * CASE WHEN loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc_nt
				FROM #tctdmts1 WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts, ma_nv
			) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	--
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_kh_ky, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_kh_ky_nt
	UPDATE #res SET gt_cl = nguyen_gia - gt_da_kh, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - gt_da_kh_nt
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = gt_kh_ky + gt_cl, gt_cl = 0 WHERE gt_cl <= tien_cl
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = gt_kh_ky_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE gt_cl_nt <= tien_cl_nt

	-- Last Period
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ts_kh_ky0' AND val = '1')
		UPDATE #res SET gt_kh_ky = a.gt_kh_ky + a.gt_cl, gt_kh_ky_nt = a.gt_kh_ky_nt + a.gt_cl_nt, gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_da_kh = a.nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt
			FROM #res a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			WHERE a.is_suspend = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh_kt) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dTo)

	-- Base currency
	UPDATE #res SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_tang_nt = 0, gt_giam_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

	-- Insert Result
	INSERT INTO ctkhts(so_the_ts, sua_kh, ma_nv, ky, nam, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
	SELECT so_the_ts, 0, ma_nv, @nCycle, @nYear, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
		FROM #res
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesArisingSummaryByUnit] -- fs20_AccRateDept1PeriodUnit
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023) ,
	@AccountNoMinus VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Report VARCHAR(128),
	@Group VARCHAR(128),
	@GroupFee1 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee2 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @strName CHAR(8), @Groups VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1
	SELECT @cNoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cName) ELSE RTRIM(cName2) END FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'

	SELECT @Report = CASE @Report
		WHEN '1' THEN 'tk'
		WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_phi'
		WHEN '3' THEN 'ma_dvcs'
	END

	SELECT @Group = CASE @Group
		WHEN '1' THEN 'ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_phi'
		WHEN '3' THEN 'tk'
		WHEN '4' THEN 'ma_dvcs, ma_phi'
		WHEN '5' THEN 'ma_dvcs, tk'
		WHEN '6' THEN 'ma_phi, ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '7' THEN 'ma_phi, tk'
		WHEN '8' THEN 'tk, ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '9' THEN 'tk, ma_phi'
		ELSE ''
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_phi, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, ps_no AS lk, ps_no_nt AS lk_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_dvcs' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dvcs <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @GroupFee1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @AccountNoMinus <> ''
		SET @Key2 = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'notinlist', @AccountNoMinus)
	ELSE
		SET @Key2 = '(1 = 0)'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	IF @GroupFee1 + @GroupFee2 + @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmphi b on a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'

	SET @s = 'insert into #tmp select a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi, @ReportField'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @s = @s + ' where %[@Key]%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi'

	-- Trong ky
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Trong ky (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Luy ke
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom0, @DateTo0, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Luy ke (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom0, @DateTo0, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi
			, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(lk) AS lk, SUM(lk_nt) AS lk_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_dvcs, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_dvcs2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xKey, CAST('' AS CHAR(64)) AS xDetail
		INTO #report1 FROM #tmp a GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi

	IF @Report = 'tk' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_tk = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END, ten_tk2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	IF @Report = 'ma_dvcs' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_dvcs = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_dvcs ELSE '' END, ten_dvcs2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_dvcs2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_phi = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_phi ELSE '' END, ten_phi2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_phi2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmphi b ON a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi

	UPDATE #report1 SET ps = ISNULL(ps, 0), ps_nt = ISNULL(ps_nt, 0), lk = ISNULL(lk, 0), lk_nt = ISNULL(lk_nt, 0)
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps + ps_nt + lk + lk_nt = 0

	-- Update luy ke
	UPDATE #report1 SET lk = lk + ps, lk_nt = lk_nt + ps_nt

	SET @q = 'update #report1 set xDetail = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report1 WHERE xDetail = '' OR xDetail IS NULL
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps = 0 AND lk = 0
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM #report1 WHERE 1 = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #report '
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select distinct 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, max(tk), max(ma_dvcs), max(ma_phi)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt), sum(lk), sum(lk_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', max(ten_tk), max(ten_tk2), max(ten_dvcs), max(ten_dvcs2), max(ten_phi), max(ten_phi2), max(xkey), max(xdetail)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #report1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by @Group xDetail'
	IF @Group <> '' SET @q = REPLACE(@q , '@Group', @Group + ',') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q , '@Group', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_dvcs, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_dvcs, ten_dvcs2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33) , NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ps = 0 AND lk  = 0 AND systotal = 1
	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup3(@Group , REPLACE(@Report, 'ma_', ''),  'ps,ps_nt,lk,lk_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	UPDATE #report SET tk = ISNULL(tk, ''), ma_phi = ISNULL(ma_phi, ''), ma_dvcs = ISNULL(ma_dvcs, ''), xDetail = ISNULL(xDetail, '')

	SET @Groups = REPLACE(@Group, ',', ' + ')
	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Groups + ' + xDetail'
	ELSE
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT DISTINCT MAX(sysorder) AS sysorder, MAX(sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(systotal) AS systotal, 0 AS stt, xKey , MAX(xDetail) AS xDetail, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs
			, MAX(ma_phi) AS ma_phi, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(lk) AS lk,SUM(lk_nt) AS lk_nt
			, MAX(ten_tk) AS ten_tk, MAX(ten_tk2) AS ten_tk2, MAX(ten_phi) AS ten_phi, MAX(ten_phi2) AS ten_phi2, MAX(ten_dvcs) AS ten_dvcs, MAX(ten_dvcs2) AS ten_dvcs2
		INTO #report3
		FROM #report
		GROUP BY xKey, sysorder

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report3', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_dvcs, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_dvcs, ten_dvcs2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @o = 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN @Group = '' THEN ', ' ELSE ', ' + @Group + ', ' END + 'xkey'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	UPDATE #report3 SET stt = NULL WHERE stt = 0
	IF UPPER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 1, 3)) = 'MA_'
		SET @strName = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 'ma_', 'ten_')))
	ELSE
		SET @strName =LTRIM(RTRIM('ten_' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report))))

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + ' = N' + CHAR(39)+ @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ', ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + '2 =  ' + CHAR(39)+ @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ' where systotal = 0 and ( ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName )) + ' is null or ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName ))  + ' = N' +  CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ' )'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'alter table #report3 alter column ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' NVARCHAR(511) NULL'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' alter table #report3 alter column ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 NVARCHAR(511) NULL'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' = SPACE(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 = SPACE(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 WHERE sysorder > 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report3) INSERT INTO #report3 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, systotal, sysprint, tk, ma_phi, ma_dvcs, ps, ps_nt, lk, lk_nt, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '  AS ten_key,  ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 AS ten_key2 FROM #report3 ORDER BY xKey, sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetSQLSearchVoucher(@cSystemData VARCHAR(64), @cMTable VARCHAR(64), @cDTable VARCHAR(64), @ctmpMTable VARCHAR(64), @ctmpDTable VARCHAR(64), @ctmpMOrder VARCHAR(64), @ctmpDOrder VARCHAR(64))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQLExecute NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @strSQLExecute = CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @tempMasterID INT, @tempDetailID INT'
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @tempMasterID = OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..@ctmpMTable''), @tempDetailID = OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..@ctmpDTable'')'
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @strQuery VARCHAR(8000), @strMasterQuery NVARCHAR(4000), @strDetailQuery NVARCHAR(4000)'

	DECLARE @strQueryStruct NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = 'SELECT @strQuery = NULL'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @strQuery = ISNULL(@strQuery, %%) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@strQuery, %%) = %% THEN %% ELSE %,% END + a.name FROM '
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '('
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT CASE'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '			WHEN c.name IS NULL THEN'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '				CASE'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '					WHEN d.name IN (%bit%, %bigint%, %float%, %int%, %money%, %real%, %tinyint%, %smallint%, %smallmoney%) THEN %CAST(0 AS % + d.name + %) AS % + a.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '					WHEN d.name IN (%numeric%, %decimal%) THEN %CAST(0 AS % + d.name + %(% + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(a.xprec, 3))) + %, % + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(a.xscale, 3))) + %)) AS % + a.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '					WHEN d.name IN (%char%, %nchar%, %varchar%, %nvarchar%) THEN %CAST(%%%% AS % + d.name + %(% + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(a.prec, 3))) + %)) AS % + a.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '					WHEN d.name IN (%text%, %ntext%) THEN %CAST(%%%% AS % + d.name + %) AS % + a.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '					ELSE %CAST(0 AS % + d.name + %) AS % + a.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '				END'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '			ELSE a.name' 
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '		END AS name, a.colorder'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '		FROM @cSystemData..syscolumns a JOIN @cSystemData..sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '			LEFT JOIN (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = @tempMasterID) c ON a.name = c.name'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '			JOIN (SELECT name, xtype, xusertype FROM @cSystemData..systypes WHERE name <> %sysname%) d ON a.xtype = d.xtype and a.xusertype = d.xusertype'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + '		WHERE b.name = %@cSystemMasterTable%'
	SELECT @strQueryStruct = @strQueryStruct + CHAR(13) + ') a ORDER BY a.colorder'

	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + @strQueryStruct
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @strMasterQuery = %SELECT  % + @strQuery + % FROM @ctmpMTable ORDER BY @ctmpMOrder%'
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + REPLACE(REPLACE(@strQueryStruct, '@tempMasterID', '@tempDetailID'), '@cSystemMasterTable', '@cSystemDetailTable')
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @strDetailQuery = %SELECT  % + @strQuery + % FROM @ctmpDTable ORDER BY @ctmpDOrder%'
	
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC (@strMasterQuery)'
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = @strSQLExecute + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC (@strDetailQuery)'

	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '%', ''''), '@cSystemData', @cSystemData)
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '@cSystemMasterTable', @cMTable + 'tmp'), '@cSystemDetailTable', @cDTable + 'tmp')
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '@ctmpMTable', @ctmpMTable)
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '@ctmpDTable', @ctmpDTable)
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '@ctmpMOrder', @ctmpMOrder)
	SELECT @strSQLExecute = REPLACE(@strSQLExecute, '@ctmpDOrder', @ctmpDOrder)

	RETURN @strSQLExecute
END

GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[zc_LoadQRCode]
	@qrcode VARCHAR(33)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(MAX), @Item VARCHAR(33), @dvt nvarchar(33), @ten_vt nvarchar(512), @sl_td1 numeric(19, 4), @sl_td2 numeric(19, 4)
	SELECT @Item = RTRIM(ma_vt), @ten_vt = ten_vt, @dvt = dvt, @sl_td1 = sl_td1, @sl_td2 = sl_td2 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @qrCode

	IF ISNULL(@Item,'') = '' BEGIN
		SELECT N'setItems(''qrcode'', ''''); setItems(''ma_vt'', ''' + @qrcode + '''); setItems(''ten_vt'', ''' + @qrCode + '''); setItems(''dvt'', ''''); setItems(''sl_td1'', ''0''); setItems(''sl_td2'', ''0''); setItems(''new_yn'', ''1''); focus(''ten_vt'', true);' AS script
		RETURN
	END
	
	SELECT 'setItems(''qrcode'', '''')'
			+ '; setItems(''temp'', '''')'
			+ '; setItems(''ma_vt'', ''' + @Item + ''')'
			+ '; setItems(''ten_vt'', ''' + @ten_vt + ''')'
			+ '; setItems(''dvt'', ''' + @dvt + ''')'
			+ '; setItems(''sl_td1'', ''' + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(@sl_td1, 0), 19), ' ', '') + ''')'
			+ '; setItems(''sl_td2'', ''' + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(@sl_td2, 0), 19), ' ', '') + ''')'
			+ '; setItems(''new_yn'', ''0'')'
			+ '; invokeScripts(''afterRequestQRCode'')' AS script

	SELECT @Item AS ma_vt, @ten_vt AS ten_vt, @dvt AS dvt, @sl_td1 AS sl_td1, @sl_td2 AS sl_td2
	/**/

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalCategory]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@code NVARCHAR(4000),	
	@category VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Struct
	DECLARE @c AS CHAR(1)
	SET @c = CHAR(253)
	SELECT * INTO #key FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@code, @c)

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @customerGroup1 VARCHAR(1023), @customerGroup2 VARCHAR(1023), @customerGroup3 VARCHAR(1023), @i INT
		, @dvcs_yn VARCHAR(32), @bp_yn VARCHAR(32), @hrbp_yn VARCHAR(32), @kh_yn VARCHAR(32), @tk_yn VARCHAR(32), @sl_yn VARCHAR(32), @tien_yn VARCHAR(32), @loai_ct_yn VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @q = '', @key = '', @category = '', @customerGroup1 = '', @customerGroup2 = '', @customerGroup3 = '', @i = 0
	SELECT @dvcs_yn = dvcs_yn, @bp_yn = bp_yn, @hrbp_yn = hrbp_yn, @kh_yn = kh_yn, @tk_yn = tk_yn, @sl_yn = sl_yn, @tien_yn = tien_yn, @loai_ct_yn = loai_ct_yn FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Key
	IF @dvcs_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.dvcs = '''' or (a.dvcs = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.dvcs = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @bp_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_bp = '''' or (a.ma_bp = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_bp = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @hrbp_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_hrbp = '''' or (exists(select 1 from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ' and data in (select ma_bp from hrbp where bp_ref like (select bp_ref + ''%'' from hrbp where ma_bp = a.ma_hrbp))) and b.ma_hrbp = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @kh_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @customerGroup1 = nh_kh1, @customerGroup2 = nh_kh2, @customerGroup3 = nh_kh3 FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = (SELECT data FROM #key WHERE id = @i)
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh1 = '''' or (a.nh_kh1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh1 = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh2 = '''' or (a.nh_kh2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh2 = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh3 = '''' or (a.nh_kh3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh3 = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @tk_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.tk = '''' or (a.tk = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.tk = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @sl_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.sl_tu = 0 or (a.sl_tu <= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.so_luong = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.sl_den = 0 or (a.sl_den >= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.so_luong = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @tien_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_nt = '''' or (a.ma_nt = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_nt = ''1''))'
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.tien_tu = 0 or (a.tien_tu <= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.tien = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.tien_den = 0 or (a.tien_den >= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.tien = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @loai_ct_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.loai_ct = '''' or (a.loai_ct = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.loai_ct = ''1''))'
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @category = rtrim(isnull(b.ma_kieu, '''')) from gnctkieuduyet a left join gndmkieuduyet b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and b.ma_kieu = a.ma_kieu'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and a.status = ''1'' and b.status = ''1''' + @key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt, b.ma_kieu'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@category varchar(33) output', @category OUTPUT
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_FXDelDisAlloc]
	@nFrom TINYINT,
	@nTo TINYINT,
	@nYear INT,
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	IF @cAction = 'Del' SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	IF @cAction = 'New' SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nFrom, @nYear), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nTo, @nYear)

	-- Delete from ct00
	DELETE ct00 WHERE ma_ct = @cVC AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

	-- Delete from r00
	SELECT @q = 'delete r00$%Partition where %[ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@cVC, '''', '') + ''' and dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, ''' + REPLACE(@cUnit, '''', '') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@cUnits, '''', '') + ''') = 1]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIScoreEvaluationPeriod] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'  
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_chi_tieu, c.trong_so, a.ma_vt, a.diem, a.ghi_chu, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_ct' + @cE + ' AS ten_chi_tieu'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', v.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bidmctdg g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_chi_tieu = g.ma_ct'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN #t c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_chi_tieu = c.ma_chi_tieu'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dmvt v WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''stt, ma_chi_tieu, ten_chi_tieu'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployeeTurnoverListByReasons]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Gender VARCHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Reason VARCHAR(32),
	@DateLeaveFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateLeaveTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Male NVARCHAR(512), @Female NVARCHAR(512), @Other NVARCHAR(512)	

	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	SELECT @Other = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM013'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt, ly_do_nghi, stt_rec, ma_nv
		, RTRIM(ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_nv) AS ho_ten_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS gioi_tinh
		, bo_phan, vi_tri, nv_ql, ngay_vao, ngay_nghi INTO #report FROM hrnv

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ngay_nghi is not null'

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'is not null' ELSE 'is null' END
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Reason <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ly_do_nghi like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DateLeaveFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_nghi >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateLeaveFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateLeaveTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_nghi <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateLeaveTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'

	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt, isnull(a.ly_do_nghi, ''''), a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(a.ten_nv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when a.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + RTRIM(@Male) + ''' else N''' + RTRIM(@Female) + ''' end, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.nv_ql, a.ngay_vao, a.ngay_nghi'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, a.stt_rec, a.ly_do_nghi INTO #o
			FROM #report a
				LEFT JOIN hrdmldnv b ON a.ly_do_nghi = b.ma_ldnv
				LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp
				LEFT JOIN hrvt d ON a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr
			ORDER BY b.stt, b.ma_ldnv, a.stt, a.ma_nv, c.stt_ref, d.stt, d.ma_vtr
		SELECT ly_do_nghi, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY ly_do_nghi
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt
			FROM #report a
				JOIN (SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ly_do_nghi, (a.id - b.id + 1) AS stt FROM #o a LEFT JOIN #g b on a.ly_do_nghi = b.ly_do_nghi) b
					ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ly_do_nghi = b.ly_do_nghi
		--
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 3, 0, 0, 0, ly_do_nghi, '', '', ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ldnv ELSE b.ten_ldnv2 END, @Other), '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL
				FROM #g a LEFT JOIN hrdmldnv b ON a.ly_do_nghi = b.ma_ldnv
	END

	-- View
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt
		, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.nv_ql, a.ngay_vao, a.ngay_nghi
		, a.bo_phan, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp
		, a.vi_tri, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vtr ELSE c.ten_vtr2 END AS ten_vtr
		, a.ly_do_nghi, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_ldnv ELSE d.ten_ldnv2 END, @Other) AS ten_ldnv
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
			LEFT JOIN hrdmldnv d ON a.ly_do_nghi = d.ma_ldnv
		ORDER BY a.ly_do_nghi, a.sysorder, a.stt
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
/*
**	Retrieve properties by id's
**
**	dt_getproperties objid, null or '' -- retrieve all properties of the object itself
**	dt_getproperties objid, property -- retrieve the property specified
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_u
	@id int,
	@property varchar(64)
as
	set nocount on

	if (@property is null) or (@property = '')
		select property, version, uvalue, lvalue
			from dbo.dtproperties
			where  @id=objectid
	else
		select property, version, uvalue, lvalue
			from dbo.dtproperties
			where  @id=objectid and @property=property



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJournalAccountLedger] -- fs30_AcctJLedger15
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Account VARCHAR(33) , 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ngay_ct AS ngay_ctgs, so_ct AS so_ctgs, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giai2, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr AS stt
		INTO #Report FROM wrkgl

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1''' 
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #Report select 5, 1, 1, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_tk)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_tk2)' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_tk2)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_tk)' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tk_du, sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), max(a.ma_nt), max(c.stt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk join ctgs c on a.ngay_ctgs = c.ngay_ctgs and a.so_ctgs = c.so_ctgs'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk_du, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'CLBAL'
	
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)
		FROM #Report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #Report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1,
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END)

	INSERT INTO #Report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #Report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3,
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END)

	INSERT INTO #Report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES  (3, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	SELECT *, CONVERT(CHAR(10), ngay_ctgs, 112) AS ngay  FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ctgs, stt, so_ctgs, tk_du

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockByOld] --fs20_StockByOld
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@PeriodType CHAR(1),
	@Time INT,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(128),
	@OrderBy VARCHAR(128),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @DateFrom = CASE WHEN @PeriodType = '1' THEN DATEADD(day, -(@Time -1), @DateTo) ELSE DATEADD(day, 1, DATEADD(month, -@Time, @DateTo)) END
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #Balance FROM cdvt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #ps FROM wrkin

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SELECT @Key = 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType <> '' OR @filterKey <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	INSERT #Balance EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateTo, @Unit, @Site, @Item, 2, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT @Key = 'a.sl_nhap > 0' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @Key
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #ps select a.ma_vt, sum(-a.sl_nhap), sum(-a.tien_nhap), sum(-a.tien_nt_n)'
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	INSERT INTO #ps SELECT ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) FROM #Balance GROUP BY ma_vt

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt
			, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
			, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE MAX(b.ten_vt2) END AS ten_vt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #ps a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		HAVING SUM(a.so_luong) > 0

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_vt, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3', 'NUMERIC(5), VARCHAR(32), NVARCHAR(511), VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@OrderBy) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @OrderBy END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @OrderBy, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = 'loai_vt' SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt' , 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy, 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt from #report'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = '' SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, ' + @OrderBy + ', stt'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@GroupBy, 'sysorder, ' + @OrderBy) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckFactorCodeNotAllocated] -- xs20_COCheckFactorCodeNotCoeff
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @cFactor VARCHAR(33), @cUnit VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1), @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costUnit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'
	
	-- Struct 
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt INTO #xcppstk FROM xcppstk WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, he_so INTO #xctpbtg FROM xctpbtg WHERE 1 = 0

	-- Key	
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)		
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
	SET @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs(ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @objectUnit = '1'
		UPDATE #dmdvcs SET x_dt_sp = 1, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0
	ELSE UPDATE #dmdvcs SET x_dt_sp = 1, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO
	
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx 
		INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
		WHERE th_sp = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs b WHERE xdmyt.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs)

	UPDATE #xdmyt SET x_dt_sp = b.x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp = b.x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx = b.x_dt_lsx 
		FROM #xdmyt a JOIN #dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

	DELETE #xdmyt WHERE x_dt_bp = 1 AND th_bp = 0
	DELETE #xdmyt WHERE x_dt_lsx = 1 AND th_lsx = 0

	INSERT INTO #xcppstk
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt		
			FROM xcppstk
			WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs b WHERE xcppstk.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs)
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #xdmyt a WHERE a.ma_yt = xcppstk.ma_yt)			

	INSERT INTO #xctpbtg
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, he_so		
			FROM xctpbtg
			WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs b WHERE xctpbtg.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs)
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #xdmyt a WHERE a.ma_yt = xctpbtg.ma_yt)

	DECLARE crFactor CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT ma_yt, ma_dvcs FROM #xcppstk ORDER BY ma_yt, ma_dvcs
	OPEN crFactor
	FETCH NEXT FROM crFactor INTO @cFactor, @cUnit
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND th_sp = 0) UPDATE #xctpbtg SET ma_sp = '' WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND th_bp = 0) UPDATE #xctpbtg SET ma_bp = '' WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND th_bp0 = 0) UPDATE #xctpbtg SET ma_bp0 = '' WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND th_lsx = 0) UPDATE #xctpbtg SET so_lsx = '' WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND th_nvl = 0) UPDATE #xctpbtg SET ma_vt = '' WHERE ma_yt = @cFactor AND ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM crFactor INTO @cFactor, @cUnit
	END
	CLOSE crFactor
	DEALLOCATE crFactor

	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, SUM(ps_tk) AS ps_tk, SUM(ps_tk_nt) AS ps_tk_nt, SUM(he_so) AS t_he_so
		INTO #xctpbtgtmp
		FROM #xctpbtg
		GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs,
			CASE WHEN a.ma_yt IS NULL THEN b.ma_yt ELSE a.ma_yt END AS ma_yt,
			CASE WHEN a.ma_bp0 IS NULL THEN b.ma_bp0 ELSE a.ma_bp0 END AS ma_bp0,
			CASE WHEN a.ma_sp IS NULL THEN b.ma_sp ELSE a.ma_sp END AS ma_sp,
			CASE WHEN a.ma_bp IS NULL THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END AS ma_bp,
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx IS NULL THEN b.so_lsx ELSE a.so_lsx END AS so_lsx,
			CASE WHEN a.ma_vt IS NULL THEN b.ma_vt ELSE a.ma_vt END AS ma_vt,
			CASE WHEN a.ps_tk_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.ps_tk_nt END AS ps_tk_nt,
			CASE WHEN a.ps_tk IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.ps_tk END AS ps_tk,
			CASE WHEN b.t_he_so IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE b.t_he_so END AS t_he_so
		FROM #xcppstk a FULL JOIN #xctpbtgtmp b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0
		WHERE (a.ps_tk <> b.ps_tk OR (a.ps_tk IS NULL) OR (b.ps_tk IS NULL)) OR (a.ps_tk_nt <> b.ps_tk_nt OR (a.ps_tk_nt IS NULL) OR (b.ps_tk_nt IS NULL))

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_DeleteTimekeeping]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32), 
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32), 
	@UserID INT, 
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @RangeFrom SMALLDATETIME, @RangeTo SMALLDATETIME, @d SMALLDATETIME, @c VARCHAR(512), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Delta INT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0, @RangeFrom = ngay_gh1, @RangeTo = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	IF @DateFrom < @RangeFrom SELECT @DateFrom = @RangeFrom
	IF @DateTo > @RangeTo SELECT @DateTo = @RangeTo

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')		
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @Key = ' where (a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END
	
	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'

	-- Delete
	SELECT @d = @DateFrom, @Delta = YEAR(@DateTo) * 12 + MONTH(@DateTo)
	WHILE YEAR(@d) *12 + MONTH(@d) <= @Delta BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @d, 112)
		SELECT @s = 'delete hrvaora$' + @c + ' from hrvaora$' + @c + ' a' + @Join + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	
		--
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(month, 1, @d)
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END
GO
