	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_gh, a.ghi_chu, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan, b.bp_ref, b.vi_tri, b.bac_quan_ly, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
		FROM hrdccongbp a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetTSDisAlloc]
	@periodFrom INT,
	@periodTo INT,
	@year INT,
	@type CHAR(1), -- 0 - Post 2 GL, 1 - Post to ctpbdc, 2 - View Detail
	@key4ViewDetail NVARCHAR(4000),
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@action VARCHAR(5),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cRound VARCHAR(3), @cFCRound VARCHAR(3), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @cRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cFCRound = RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin, @action)
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@periodFrom, @year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@periodTo, @year)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi
		INTO #tctpbcc FROM ctpbdc

	SET @q = 'insert into #tctpbcc
			select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, '''', sum(a.gt_pb_ky) + sum(isnull(a.cl_giam, 0)), sum(a.gt_pb_ky_nt) + sum(isnull(a.cl_giam_nt, 0)), '''', '''', '''', '''', b.ma_bp0, '''', ''''
				from ctcddc a left join dmbpcc b on a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp
				where a.nam = ' + REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ' , '') + ' and a.ky between ' + REPLACE(STR(@periodFrom, 2), ' ' , '') + ' and ' + REPLACE(STR(@periodTo, 2), ' ' , '')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, b.ma_bp0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt INTO #cthspbdc FROM cthspbdc
	SET @q = 'insert into #cthspbdc select *, 0, 0 from cthspbdc where not (ngay_hl_tu > ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''' or ngay_hl_den < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Allocation table
	SELECT a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #tpb FROM #tctpbcc a
		WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cthspbdc b WHERE a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc)
		GROUP BY a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
		'#tpb',
		'ma_dc, ma_bp_dc',
		'tien',
		'#cthspbdc',
		'he_so',
		'tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi',
		'1=1',
		@cRound
	)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--FC
	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable(
		'#tpb',
		'ma_dc, ma_bp_dc',
		'tien_nt',
		'#cthspbdc',
		'he_so',
		'tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi',
		'1=1',
		@cFCRound
	)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #tctpbcc FROM #tctpbcc a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cthspbdc b WHERE a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc)

	INSERT INTO #tctpbcc(ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi FROM #cthspbdc

	DELETE #tctpbcc WHERE ABS(tien) + ABS(tien_nt) = 0
	UPDATE #tctpbcc SET ma_bp = '' WHERE ma_bp IS NULL
	UPDATE #tctpbcc SET ma_phi = b.ma_phi FROM #tctpbcc a JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc WHERE ISNULL(a.ma_phi, '') = ''

	IF @type = '0'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, '' AS ma_dc, '' AS ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi
			FROM #tctpbcc
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi

	IF @type = '1'
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi
			FROM #tctpbcc
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_dc
			ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_dc

	IF @type = '2' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi from #tctpbcc where ' + @key4ViewDetail
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_dc, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$Report$TaxDepartment](@Dept VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS @res TABLE(ma_bp VARCHAR(33))
AS
BEGIN
	IF RTRIM(@Dept) = '' RETURN
	DECLARE @max INT, @n1 INT, @n2 INT, @c INT
	INSERT INTO @res SELECT ma_bp FROM txdmbp WHERE ma_bp LIKE (RTRIM(@Dept) + '%')
	SELECT @max = 10, @c = 1, @n1 = 0, @n2 = COUNT(*) FROM @res
	WHILE @c <= @max AND @n1 <> @n2 BEGIN
		SELECT @n1 = @n2, @c = @c + 1
		INSERT INTO @res SELECT DISTINCT b.ma_bp FROM @res a JOIN txdmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp_me
			WHERE b.ma_bp_me <> '' AND b.ma_bp IS NOT NULL AND b.ma_bp NOT IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM @res)
		SELECT @n2 = COUNT(*) FROM @res
	END
RETURN
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrctloailuong] AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(b.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2, ISNULL(c.ten_cong, '') AS ten_cong, ISNULL(c.ten_cong2, '') AS ten_cong2
		FROM hrctloailuong a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong
		ORDER BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong DESC
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CalDepreciationByDay]
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- 1. Declare
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nDayTo INT, @nRound INT, @nFCRound INT
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @fromCycles VARCHAR(16), @baseCurrency CHAR(3)

	-- 2. Set
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear), @fromCycles = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dFrom), @nDayTo = DAY(@dTo)
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, 0, 'New')
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	-- 3. Create template file
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ky_kh00, tl_kh00, so_ky_kh_cl, ngay_kh_kt
		INTO #dmts FROM dmts

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmts select so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ky_kh00, tl_kh00, so_ky_kh_cl, ngay_kh_kt'
	SELECT @q = @q + '  from dmts where ((ngay_giam is null) or (''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' <= ngay_giam))'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmts(so_the_ts)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv INTO #ctkhts FROM ctkhts a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE a.ky = @nCycle AND a.nam = @nYear AND a.sua_kh = 1
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt
		INTO #tctdmts
		FROM ctdmts a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmts(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky_nt
		INTO #tctdmts_ex
		FROM ctdmts a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) > dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dTo) AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @fromCycles
			AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmts_ex(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	INSERT INTO #tctdmts SELECT * FROM #tctdmts_ex a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tctdmts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, c.loai_tg_ts, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt
		INTO #tctdmts1
		FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmtgts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @fromCycles AND a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @fromCycles

	UPDATE #tctdmts1 SET nguyen_gia = - nguyen_gia, gt_cl = - gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = - gt_kh_ky WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2
	UPDATE #tctdmts1 SET nguyen_gia_nt = - nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl_nt = - gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = - gt_kh_ky_nt WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmts2Tmp FROM #tctdmts
	INSERT INTO #tctdmts2Tmp SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, 0, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, 0, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt FROM #tctdmts1 a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky
			, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt
			, MAX(ngay_kh0) AS ngay_kh0, ISNULL(MAX(b.ngay_kh1), @dTo + 1) AS ngay_kh1, @dTo AS ngay_kh2, ISNULL(MAX(b.ngay_giam), @dTo + 1) AS ngay_giam
			, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(2, 0)) AS so_ng_kh1
		INTO #tctdmts2 FROM #tctdmts2Tmp a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv

	UPDATE #tctdmts2 SET so_ng_kh1 = dbo.ff_GetDayDepreciation(@dFrom, @dTo, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh2, ngay_kh1, ngay_giam)
	UPDATE #tctdmts2 SET gt_kh_ky = ROUND(gt_kh_ky * (so_ng_kh1 / @nDayTo), @nRound), gt_kh_ky_nt = ROUND(gt_kh_ky_nt * (so_ng_kh1 / @nDayTo), @nFCRound)

	SELECT a.*, b.tk_kh, b.tk_ts, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt INTO #tFaDepr FROM #tctdmts2 a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(tk_kh) AS tk_kh, MAX(tk_ts) AS tk_ts, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
		INTO #tctbpts
		FROM cthsts WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 20) IN
				(SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 20) FROM cthsts WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts)
				AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmts)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #tFaDepr SET tk_kh = b.tk_kh, tk_ts = b.tk_ts, tk_cp = b.tk_cp, ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #tctbpts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- 4. Delete
	DELETE ctkhts WHERE ky = @nCycle AND nam = @nYear AND sua_kh = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmts)

	-- 5. Calc
	-- + Units-of-production
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia,  CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CASE WHEN b.tong_sl <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.nguyen_gia * ISNULL(c.sl_kh, 0) / b.tong_sl, @nRound) ELSE CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) END AS gt_kh_ky,
			a.nguyen_gia_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt,
			CASE WHEN b.tong_sl <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.nguyen_gia_nt * ISNULL(c.sl_kh, 0) / b.tong_sl, @nFCRound) ELSE CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) END AS gt_kh_ky_nt, 0 AS is_suspend, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt INTO #res
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts LEFT JOIN ctslts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND c.nam = @nYear AND c.ky = @nCycle
		WHERE b.kieu_kh = 1 AND b.tong_sl <> 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles

	-- + Declinning-balance with Adjustment
	DECLARE @nTMOYs INT
	SELECT @nTMOYs = 12
	SELECT *, MONTH(ngay_kh0) - ky_kh00 AS open_cycle, MONTH(ngay_kh0) - ky_kh00 AS start_cycle, @nYear AS open_year, YEAR(ngay_kh0) AS start_year
			, so_ky_kh_cl + ky_kh00 AS remain_period, 1 AS remain_value_type
		INTO #t1 FROM #dmts WHERE kieu_kh = 2 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles
	UPDATE #t1 SET open_cycle = open_cycle + @nTMOYs, start_year = start_year - 1 WHERE open_cycle <= 0
	UPDATE #t1 SET start_cycle = open_cycle
	UPDATE #t1 SET open_year = open_year - 1 WHERE open_cycle > @nCycle
	UPDATE #t1 SET remain_value_type = 2, remain_period = remain_period + (start_year * 12 + start_cycle) - (open_year * 12 + open_cycle) FROM #t1 WHERE (@nYear * 12 + @nCycle) - (start_year * 12 + start_cycle) >= @nTMOYs

	INSERT INTO #res SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia
			, a.nguyen_gia, 0, 0, 0, 0
			, dbo.ff_max(ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl + c.gt_da_kh00 ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl, 0) END * b.tl_kh00 / @nTMOYs, @nRound)
				, CASE WHEN b.remain_period > 0 THEN ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl + c.gt_da_kh00 ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl, 0) END / b.remain_period, @nRound) ELSE 0 END)
			, a.nguyen_gia_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
			, dbo.ff_max(ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl_nt + c.gt_da_kh00_nt ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl_nt, 0) END * b.tl_kh00 / @nTMOYs, @nFCRound)
				, CASE WHEN b.remain_period > 0 THEN ROUND(CASE WHEN b.remain_value_type = 1 THEN c.gt_cl_nt + c.gt_da_kh00_nt ELSE ISNULL(d.gt_cl_nt, 0) END / b.remain_period, @nFCRound) ELSE 0 END)
			, 0, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #t1 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN ctdmts c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv
			LEFT JOIN ctkhts d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = d.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = d.ma_nv AND d.nam * 12 + d.ky = b.open_year * 12 + b.open_cycle - 1

	-- + Straight-line: Suspending
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_giam, a.ngay_kh0, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, dbo.ff_GetDayDepreciation(@dFrom, @dTo, a.ngay_kh0, @dTo, @dTo + 1, a.ngay_giam) AS depr_days
		INTO #t2 FROM #dmts	a
		WHERE a.kieu_kh = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(a.ngay_kh0) <= @fromCycles

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.ngay_hl_tu < b.ngay_kh0 THEN b.ngay_kh0 ELSE a.ngay_hl_tu END <= @dFrom THEN
						CASE
							WHEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ngay_giam - 1, a.ngay_hl_den) < a.ngay_hl_den THEN b.ngay_giam - 1 ELSE a.ngay_hl_den END >= @dTo THEN b.depr_days
							ELSE DATEDIFF(day, @dFrom, CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ngay_giam - 1, a.ngay_hl_den) < a.ngay_hl_den THEN b.ngay_giam - 1 ELSE a.ngay_hl_den END) + 1
						END
					ELSE
						CASE
							WHEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ngay_giam - 1, a.ngay_hl_den) < a.ngay_hl_den THEN b.ngay_giam - 1 ELSE a.ngay_hl_den END >= @dTo THEN DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN a.ngay_hl_tu < b.ngay_kh0 THEN b.ngay_kh0 ELSE a.ngay_hl_tu END, @dTo) + 1
							ELSE DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN a.ngay_hl_tu < b.ngay_kh0 THEN b.ngay_kh0 ELSE a.ngay_hl_tu END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ngay_giam - 1, a.ngay_hl_den) < a.ngay_hl_den THEN b.ngay_giam - 1 ELSE a.ngay_hl_den END) + 1
						END
					END
				) AS suspend_days
		INTO #t3 FROM dmtskkh a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #t2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= @dTo AND a.ngay_hl_den >= @dFrom AND (b.ngay_giam IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_tu < b.ngay_giam)
		GROUP BY a.so_the_ts

	INSERT INTO #res SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia
			, a.nguyen_gia, 0, 0, 0, 0
			, CASE WHEN b.depr_days = 0 OR ISNULL(c.suspend_days, 0) >= b.depr_days THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((a.gt_kh_ky * (b.depr_days - ISNULL(c.suspend_days, 0))) / b.depr_days, @nRound) END
			, a.nguyen_gia_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
			, CASE WHEN b.depr_days = 0 OR ISNULL(c.suspend_days, 0) >= b.depr_days THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((a.gt_kh_ky_nt * (b.depr_days - ISNULL(c.suspend_days, 0))) / b.depr_days, @nFCRound) END
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.suspend_days, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt
		FROM #tFaDepr a JOIN #t2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			LEFT JOIN #t3 c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts


	-- Acc. Depreciation Value
	INSERT INTO #res
		SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, b.ma_bp, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, c.ma_nt, c.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh
				, 0, 0, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, 0, 0, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, -1, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt
			FROM #tctdmts2 a
				JOIN #tFaDepr b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv
				JOIN #dmts c ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #res b WHERE a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv)

	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #res a JOIN #tctdmts2 b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #res a JOIN ctkhts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @nYear * 12 + @nCycle - 1

	-- Add depreciated value on adj. table
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + b.gt_da_kh_dc, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + b.gt_da_kh_dc_nt FROM #res a
		JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(gt_da_kh * CASE WHEN loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt * CASE WHEN loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc_nt
				FROM #tctdmts1 WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts, ma_nv
			) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	--
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_kh_ky, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_kh_ky_nt
	UPDATE #res SET gt_cl = nguyen_gia - gt_da_kh, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - gt_da_kh_nt
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = gt_kh_ky + gt_cl, gt_cl = 0 WHERE gt_cl <= tien_cl
	UPDATE #res SET gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = gt_kh_ky_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE gt_cl_nt <= tien_cl_nt

	-- Last Period
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ts_kh_ky0' AND val = '1')
		UPDATE #res SET gt_kh_ky = a.gt_kh_ky + a.gt_cl, gt_kh_ky_nt = a.gt_kh_ky_nt + a.gt_cl_nt, gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_da_kh = a.nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt
			FROM #res a JOIN #dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			WHERE a.is_suspend = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh_kt) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dTo)
				AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_kh1 OR b.ngay_kh1 IS NULL) AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_giam OR b.ngay_giam IS NULL)

	-- Base currency
	UPDATE #res SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_tang_nt = 0, gt_giam_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

	-- Insert Result
	INSERT INTO ctkhts(so_the_ts, sua_kh, ma_nv, ky, nam, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky
			, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT so_the_ts, 0, ma_nv, @nCycle, @nYear, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky
				, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
			FROM #res

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptDeliveryPlan] -- fs_SO2SIReport
	@VoucherDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Depatment VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item VARCHAR(32), 
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	 SELECT a.ma_vt, b.ma_nvbh AS ma_bp, a.so_luong AS so_luong, a.sl_giao AS sl_dh INTO #cttmp FROM d64$000000 a, m64$000000 b

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = '(b.status in (''2'', ''4'')) and b.loai_ct = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_giao between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR (8), @DateFrom, 112)+ ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Depatment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Depatment), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #cttmp select a.ma_vt, b.ma_nvbh as ma_bp, sum(a.so_luong*a.he_so) as so_luong, sum(a.sl_giao*a.he_so) as sl_dh'
	SET @q = @q + ' from d64$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m64$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt, b.ma_nvbh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'b.ngay_ct', @VoucherDateFrom, @VoucherDateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DELETE #cttmp WHERE so_luong = sl_dh
	IF @Type = 1 UPDATE #cttmp SET ma_bp = ''

	SELECT ma_vt, ma_bp, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(sl_dh) AS sl_dh
		INTO #report FROM #cttmp GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_bp ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_bp

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT  TOP 1 * FROM #Report)BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #Report(so_luong, sl_dh, ma_vt, ma_bp) VALUES(0, 0, '', '')
		SELECT 0 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, a.*, 0 AS sl_cl, '' AS dvt, '' AS ten_vt, '' AS ten_vt2
		FROM #report a
	END
	ELSE
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, a.so_luong - a.sl_dh AS sl_cl, b.dvt,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_vt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetInsertGroup4
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(4), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18),
	@cxGroup VARCHAR(128)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @c3 VARCHAR(32), @c4 VARCHAR(32), @c5 VARCHAR(32), @c6 NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			IF EXISTS(SELECT xfieldkey FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @c1 = xfieldkey, @c2 = xtableref, @c3 = xfieldkeyref, @c4 = xfieldnameref, @c5 = xfieldnameref2, @c6 = xkeyref FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @c1 ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @c1
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ', ' + @cxGroup + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.' + @c4 + '),MAX(b.' + @c5 + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')' + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ' + @c2 + ' WHERE ' + @c6 + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' b ON a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c3 + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ', ' + @cxGroup + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')' + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a '
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ', ' + @cxGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', LTRIM(RTRIM(@cType)))
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetUpdateFreeFields(
	@cIdNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cFields VARCHAR(128), 
	@cRefFields VARCHAR(128), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@cTableRef VARCHAR(16) 
	)
RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQL VARCHAR(8000), @strList VARCHAR(128), @strRef VARCHAR(128), @cCode VARCHAR(16), @cRef VARCHAR(16), @nStart SMALLINT, @strKey VARCHAR(128), @nStartE TINYINT, @f_type VARCHAR(64), @f_type0 CHAR(1)
	SELECT @strList = @cFields + ',', @strRef = @cRefFields + ',', @strKey = 'b.stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @cIdNumber + CHAR(39), @nStart = 1, @nStartE = 1
	SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' +  @cTable + ' SET '
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @cCode = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
		SET @cRef = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strRef, @nStartE, CHARINDEX(',', @strRef,  @nStartE) - @nStartE)))
		SELECT @f_type = c.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id 
						JOIN systypes c ON a.xtype = c.xtype AND a.xusertype = c.xusertype WHERE a.name = @cCode AND b.name = @cTable AND b.xtype = 'U'
		SELECT @f_type0 = CASE
			WHEN dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@f_type, 'char,nchar,ntext,nvarchar,text,varchar') = 1 THEN 'C'
			WHEN dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@f_type, 'bit,decimal,float,int,money,numeric,real,smallint,smallmoney,tinyint') = 1 THEN 'N'
			WHEN dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@f_type, 'datetime,smalldatetime') = 1 THEN 'D'
			ELSE ''
		END
		IF @nStart = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + @cCode ELSE SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + @cCode

		IF @f_type0 <> ''
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' = CASE WHEN a.' + @cCode + ' IS NULL OR a.' + @cCode + 	CASE 
				WHEN @f_type0 = 'C' THEN ' = '''''
				WHEN @f_type0 = 'N' THEN ' = 0'
				WHEN @f_type0 = 'D' THEN ' IS NULL'
			END
					+ ' THEN b.' + @cRef + ' ELSE a.' + @cCode + ' END'
		ELSE SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' = b.'  + @cRef

		SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		SET @nStartE = CHARINDEX(',', @strRef,  @nStartE) + 1
	END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a JOIN ' + @cTableRef + ' b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE ' + @strKey
	RETURN @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_TSDelAllocationTransaction]
	@periodFrom TINYINT,
	@periodTo TINYINT,
	@year INT,
	@voucherCode CHAR(3),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@action VARCHAR(5),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin, @action),
		@dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@periodFrom, @year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@periodTo, @year),
		@key = 'ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', '') + ''''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SET @q = 'delete ct00 where ' + @key + ' and (ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Delete from r00
	SELECT @q = 'delete r00$%Partition where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin
END

GO


CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency$VI] (
	@cCurrencyCode CHAR(3),
	@mAmount NVARCHAR(50)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cNumber NVARCHAR(50), @Integer NVARCHAR(50), @Decimal NVARCHAR(50), @cMinus NVARCHAR(1), @index INT, @nWordLen INT, @cWord NVARCHAR(4000), @cNumInWord NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @nRandec INT, @cRa1 NVARCHAR(128), @cRa2 NVARCHAR(128), @cRa3 NVARCHAR(128), @cRa4 NVARCHAR(128), @cRa5 NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @cNumber = CAST(@mAmount AS NVARCHAR(50))
	SELECT @cMinus = LEFT(@cNumber,1)
	IF @cMinus = '-' SELECT @cNumber = RIGHT(@cNumber, LEN(@cNumber) - 1)
	SELECT @cNumber = REPLACE(@cNumber, ',', '.')
	SELECT @index = CHARINDEX('.', @cNumber)
	SELECT @nRandec = ra_ndec, @cRa1 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_1)), @cRa2 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_2)), @cRa3 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_3)), @cRa4 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_4)), @cRa5 = LTRIM(RTRIM(ra_5)) FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt = @cCurrencyCode
	IF @index <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Integer = LEFT(@cNumber,@index - 1)
		SELECT @Decimal = LEFT(SUBSTRING(@cNumber,@index + 1,LEN(@cNumber) - @index + 1),@nRandec)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Integer = @cNumber
		SELECT @Decimal = '0'
	END
	DECLARE @cMnusWord NVARCHAR(8)
	SELECT @cMnusWord = ' âm '
	SET @cWord = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Number2Words$VI(@Integer)))
	SET @nWordLen = LEN(@cWord)
	IF (@nRandec = 0 OR CAST(@decimal as int) = 0) 
		SET @cNumInWord = @cRa1 + CASE @cMinus WHEN '-' THEN @cMnusWord ELSE N' ' END + CASE @cRa1 WHEN '' THEN SUBSTRING(@cWord,1,1) + RIGHT(@cWord,@nWordLen-1) ELSE @cWord END + CASE @cRa2 WHEN '' THEN N'' ELSE N' ' END + @cRa2 + CASE @cRa5 WHEN '' THEN N'' ELSE N' ' END + @cRa5
	ELSE
		SELECT @cNumInWord = @cRa1 + CASE @cMinus WHEN '-' THEN @cMnusWord ELSE N' ' END + CASE @cRa1 WHEN '' THEN SUBSTRING(@cWord,1,1) + RIGHT(@cWord,@nWordLen-1) ELSE @cWord END + CASE @cRa2 WHEN '' THEN N'' ELSE N' ' END + @cRa2 + CASE @cRa3 WHEN '' THEN N'' ELSE N' ' END + @cRa3 
							+ dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Number2Words$VI(@Decimal)  + N' ' + @cRa4
	SET @cNumInWord = LTRIM(RTRIM(@cNumInWord))
	RETURN UPPER(LEFT(@cNumInWord, 1)) + RIGHT(@cNumInWord, LEN(@cNumInWord) - 1)
END



GO
