CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ConvertAmount2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @d0 VARCHAR(33), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME

	--
	SELECT @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @dStart = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @dEnd = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')
	SELECT @d0 = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @UnitKey = ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tk_cn INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tk_cn INTO #gldcsd FROM gldcsd

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = ''
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt), max(b.tk_cn)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmtk b with(nolock) on a.tk = b.tk'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + @UnitKey + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Dieu chinh so du dau nam
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gldcsd (ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, tk_cn)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt), max(b.tk_cn)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from gldcsd a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) join dmtk b with(nolock) on a.tk = b.tk'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + '''' + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	--
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Chuyen so du khach hang
	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdkh where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'insert into cdkh (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00), ''1'', ' + @d0 + ', ' + @d0 + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00 from cdkh b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'b.ma_dvcs') + ' and exists(select 1 from dmtk c where b.tk = c.tk and c.tk_cn = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 where ma_kh <> ''''' + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs') + ' and tk_cn = 1 group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh)) a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update cdkh set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no00 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no_nt00 end
				, du_co00 = case when - @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no00 end, du_co_nt00 = case when - @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no_nt00 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cap nhat tu dieu chinh khach hang
	SELECT @q = 'update cdkh set du_no00 = b.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from cdkh a join dccdkh b on a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update cdkh set du_no00 = a.du_no00 + c.ps_no, du_co00 = a.du_co00 + c.ps_co, du_no_nt00 = a.du_no_nt00 + c.ps_no_nt, du_co_nt00 = a.du_co_nt00 + c.ps_co_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from cdkh a join #gldcsd c on a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs and a.tk = c.tk and a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh and c.tk_cn = 1 where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into cdkh (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', 0 as du_no1, 0 as du_co1, 0 as du_no_nt1, 0 as du_co_nt1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''1'' as status, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime0, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime2, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id0, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id2'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from (select nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', 0 as du_no1, 0 as du_co1, 0 as du_no_nt1, 0 as du_co_nt1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''1'' as status, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime0, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime2, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id0, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id2'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dccdkh a where not exists (select 1 from cdkh b where a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh)' + @UnitKey + ' group by nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' union all select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, ''1'', ' + @d0 + ', ' + @d0 + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #gldcsd a where not exists (select 1 from cdkh b where b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh) and a.tk_cn = 1 ' + @UnitKey + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh) a group by a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @q = 'delete cdkh where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0 and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'update cdkh set du_no1 = du_no00, du_co1 = du_co00, du_no_nt1 = du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = du_co_nt00 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Chuyen so du tai khoan
	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdtk where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- So du cua cac tai khoan khong phai la cong no
	SELECT @q = 'insert into cdtk (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00), 0, 0, 0, 0, ''1'', ' + @d0 + ', ' + @d0 + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from cdtk b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'b.ma_dvcs') + ' and exists (select 1 from dmtk c where b.tk = c.tk and c.tk_cn = 0) group by ma_dvcs, tk'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 where tk_cn = 0' + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs') + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk )) a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update cdtk set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no00 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no_nt00 end
				, du_co00 = case when - @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no00 end, du_co_nt00 = case when - @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no_nt00 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- So du cua cac tai khoan la cong no
	SELECT @q = 'insert into cdtk (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, 0, 0, 0, 0, ''1'', ' + @d0 + ', ' + @d0 + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, sum(case when du_no00 > du_co00 then du_no00 - du_co00 else 0 end) as du_no00,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'sum(case when du_no00 < du_co00 then du_co00 - du_no00 else 0 end) as du_co00, sum(case when du_no_nt00 > du_co_nt00 then du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00 else 0 end) as du_no_nt00,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'sum(case when du_no_nt00 < du_co_nt00 then du_co_nt00 - du_no_nt00 else 0 end) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from cdkh with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs') + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh) b group by b.ma_dvcs, b.tk ) a'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cap nhat tu dieu chinh tai khoan
	SELECT @q = 'update cdtk set du_no00 = b.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from cdtk a join dccdtk b on a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update cdtk set du_no00 = a.du_no00 + c.ps_no, du_co00 = a.du_co00 + c.ps_co, du_no_nt00 = a.du_no_nt00 + c.ps_no_nt, du_co_nt00 = a.du_co_nt00 + c.ps_co_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from cdtk a join #gldcsd c on a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs and a.tk = c.tk and c.tk_cn = 0 where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--

	SELECT @q = 'insert into cdtk (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select nam, ma_dvcs, tk, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', 0 as du_no1, 0 as du_co1, 0 as du_no_nt1, 0 as du_co_nt1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''1'' as status, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime0, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime2, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id0, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id2'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from (select nam, ma_dvcs, tk, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', 0 as du_no1, 0 as du_co1, 0 as du_no_nt1, 0 as du_co_nt1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''1'' as status, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime0, ' + @d0 + ' as datetime2, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id0, ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' as user_id2'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dccdtk a where not exists (select 1 from cdtk b where a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk)' + @UnitKey + ' group by nam, ma_dvcs, tk'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' union all select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, ''1'', ' + @d0 + ', ' + @d0 + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #gldcsd a where not exists (select 1 from cdtk b where b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.tk = b.tk) and a.tk_cn = 0 ' + + @UnitKey + '  group by ma_dvcs, tk) a group by a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @q = 'delete cdtk where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0 and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'update cdtk set du_no1 = du_no00, du_co1 = du_co00, du_no_nt1 = du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = du_co_nt00 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
 	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADepreciationAllocation] --fs_FADepAllocationSheet--
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(511),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.tien AS gt_kh_ky, a.tien_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt,
			c.ten_tk AS ten_tk_kh, c.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_kh2, d.ten_tk AS ten_tk_cp, d.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_cp2
		INTO #report FROM ctpbts a LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_kh = c.tk LEFT JOIN dmtk d ON a.tk_cp = d.tk ORDER BY 1

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '(a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, sum(a.tien) as gt_kh_ky, sum(a.tien_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(c.ten_tk) as ten_tk_kh, max(c.ten_tk2) as ten_tk_kh2, max(d.ten_tk) as ten_tk_cp, max(d.ten_tk2) as ten_tk_cp2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctpbts a'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk c on a.tk_kh = c.tk'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmtk d on a.tk_cp = d.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString('sysorder', @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_tk_kh as ten_tk_kh, '''' as ten_tk_kh2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_tk_kh, ten_tk_kh2 as ten_tk_kh2,' END + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' tk_cp, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_tk_cp as ten_tk_cp, '''' as ten_tk_cp2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_tk_cp, ten_tk_cp2 AS ten_tk_cp2,' END + ' gt_kh_ky_nt, gt_kh_ky from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs20_ChangeCodeID 
	@coCode NVARCHAR(32), 
	@cnCode NVARCHAR(32), 
	@strList VARCHAR(1024), 
	@sRejectedTables VARCHAR(256), 
	@sDeletedDuplicateTables VARCHAR(256), 
	@nDebugMode TINYINT
AS
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @coCode = @cnCode OR @strList = '' 	RETURN

	IF RIGHT(RTRIM(@strList), 1) <> ',' SELECT @strList = RTRIM(@strList) + ','
	
	DECLARE @cCode VARCHAR(30), @nStart SMALLINT, @cTable VARCHAR(30), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @sPKFields VARCHAR(128), @sNFields VARCHAR(8000), @isOk BIT, @sJoin VARCHAR(128), @cP VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @xtype NUMERIC(1), @sPrint NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	CREATE TABLE #t(value NUMERIC(10))
	
	IF @nDebugMode = 1 CREATE TABLE #rs(xtype NUMERIC(1), xtable VARCHAR(30), xvalue NVARCHAR(4000))
	
	SET  @nStart = 1
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @cCode = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
		SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1

		IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist('#', @sRejectedTables) = 0
			DECLARE crCode CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects
				WHERE xType = 'U' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM syscolumns WHERE name = @cCode) 
					AND name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM syscurrentfiles) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(name, @sRejectedTables) = 0
		ELSE
			DECLARE crCode CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects
				WHERE xType = 'U' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM syscolumns WHERE name = @cCode) 
					AND name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM syscurrentfiles) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(name, @sRejectedTables) = 1
	
		OPEN crCode
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			BEGIN
				--
				SELECT @sPKFields = NULL
				SELECT @sPKFields= ISNULL(@sPKFields, '') + column_name + ', '
					FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
					WHERE table_name = @cTable AND constraint_name IN (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype = 'PK')
	
				IF NOT @sPKFields IS NULL SELECT @sPKFields = RTRIM(LEFT(@sPKFields, LEN(@sPKFields)-1))
				SELECT @isOk = 0
				--
				IF @sPKFields IS NULL 
					SELECT @isOk = 1
				ELSE
					IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cCode, @sPKFields) = 0 SELECT @isOk = 1
				--
				IF @isOk = 0
					BEGIN
						-- Check duplicate records
						SET @strSQL = 'DECLARE @n1 NUMERIC(10), @n2 NUMERIC(10)'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @n1 = @@ROWCOUNT'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @n2 = @@ROWCOUNT'
						SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT CASE WHEN @n1 = @n2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value'
	
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sPKFields', @sPKFields)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTable', @cTable)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cCode', @cCode)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cnCode', CHAR(39) + @cnCode + CHAR(39))
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@coCode', CHAR(39) + @coCode + CHAR(39))
	
						DELETE #t
						INSERT INTO #t (value) EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
						IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #t WHERE value = 1) SELECT @isOk = 1
					END
				--
				IF @isOk = 1 -- No duplicate
					BEGIN
						SET @xtype = 1
						SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + @cnCode + CHAR(39) + '  WHERE ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + @coCode + CHAR(39)
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						--
						SELECT @sNFields = NULL SELECT @sNFields= ISNULL(@sNFields, '') + column_name + ' = a.' + column_name + ' + b.' + column_name + ', '
							FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
							WHERE table_name = @cTable AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(column_name, @sPKFields) = 0
								AND data_type IN ('bigint', 'decimal', 'float', 'int', 'money', 'numeric', 'real', 'smallint', 'smallmoney', 'tinyint')
			
						IF NOT @sNFields IS NULL SELECT @sNFields = RTRIM(LEFT(@sNFields, LEN(@sNFields)-1))
	
						SELECT @i = 1, @sJoin = ''
						WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@sPKFields)
							BEGIN
								SET @cP = RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sPKFields, @i)))
								IF @i > 1 SET @sJoin = @sJoin + ' AND '
								SET @sJoin = @sJoin + 'a.' + @cP + ' = b.' + @cP
								SET @i = @i + 1
							END
						IF (dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cTable, @sDeletedDuplicateTables) = 1) OR (@sNFields IS NULL) -- Delete duplicate records
							BEGIN
								SET @xtype = 3
								SET @strSQL = 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT * INTO #tmpDel FROM #tmpData'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE #tmpDel FROM #tmpDel a LEFT JOIN #tmpGroup b ON @sJoin WHERE b.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE @cTable FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
							END
						ELSE
							BEGIN -- Total on PK fields before delete duplicate records
								SET @xtype = 2
								SET @strSQL = 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT * INTO #tmpDel FROM #tmpData'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE #tmpDel FROM #tmpDel a LEFT JOIN #tmpGroup b ON @sJoin WHERE b.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT a.* INTO #tmpUpdate FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpUpdate SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE @cTable SET @sNFields FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpUpdate b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @cnCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
								SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE @cTable FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
							END
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sNFields', @sNFields)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sPKFields', @sPKFields)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTable', @cTable)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cCode', @cCode)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sJoin', @sJoin)
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cnCode', CHAR(39) + @cnCode + CHAR(39))
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@coCode', CHAR(39) + @coCode + CHAR(39))

					END

				SET @sPrint = '-- ' + @cTable + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + @strSQL

				IF @nDebugMode = 0 EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
				IF @nDebugMode = 1 INSERT INTO #rs(xtype, xtable, xvalue) VALUES (@xtype, @cTable, @strSQL)
				IF @nDebugMode = 2 PRINT @strSQL
				IF @nDebugMode = 3 AND @xtype <> 1  PRINT @sPrint

			END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable		
		END
		CLOSE crCode
		DEALLOCATE crCode
	END
	
IF @nDebugMode = 1 SELECT * FROM #rs ORDER BY xtype

SET NOCOUNT OFF

END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vmdmlichlv] 
AS 
	SELECT a.*, b.form_id, b.form_id2, b.form_name, b.form_name2
		FROM mdmlichlv a LEFT JOIN sysrpoptions b ON b.form = 'V20Calendar' AND form_type = '001' AND DATEPART(dw, a.ngay_nghi) = b.form_id

GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[bet_host_history]
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @stt INT, @user_id INT, @df NVARCHAR(MAX), @dt NVARCHAR(MAX), @money_win NUMERIC(19, 4), @InsertStr NVARCHAR(MAX)
	
	CREATE TABLE #bet_host_history (stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1), user_id INT, username NVARCHAR(MAX), datefrom DATETIME, dateto DATETIME, money_win NUMERIC(19, 4))
	INSERT INTO #bet_host_history
		SELECT a.user_id, b.comment AS username, a.datefrom, NULL, NULL AS money_win 
			FROM bet_host a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id = b.id
			ORDER BY a.datefrom
	
	UPDATE a SET dateto = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, b.datefrom)
		FROM #bet_host_history a JOIN #bet_host_history b ON a.stt = b.stt - 1

	create table #data (money_win numeric(19, 2))
	SET @stt = 1
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #bet_host_history WHERE stt = @stt) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #data
		SELECT TOP 1 @user_id = user_id, @df = CONVERT(VARCHAR(128), datefrom, 112), @dt = CONVERT(VARCHAR(128), dateto, 112) FROM #bet_host_history WHERE stt = @stt
		SELECT @InsertStr = 'insert into #data select money_win from #result where user_id = ''' + REPLACE(STR(@user_id), ' ', '') + ''''
		exec [bet_ticket_result] -1, '', '', 1, 2, 2, @df, @dt, @InsertStr

		UPDATE a SET money_win = ISNULL(b.money_win, 0) FROM #bet_host_history a, #data b WHERE stt = @stt
		SET @stt = @stt + 1
	END
	
	SELECT * FROM #bet_host_history a ORDER BY a.datefrom DESC
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_VendorEvaluationData]
	@PriceRound INT,
	@QuantityRound INT,
	@UpdateAdjustment BIT,
	@CalculateInspectionScore BIT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @BaseCurrency CHAR(3), @Round INT, @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @key NVARCHAR(4000), @purOrg VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @cTable VARCHAR(64), @i INT, @p CHAR(6), @vc CHAR(3), @preYear CHAR(4)
	DECLARE @xTable VARCHAR(1024), @xField NVARCHAR(1024), @xKey NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT TOP 1 @dateFrom = ngay_bd, @dateTo = ngay_kt, @purOrg = ma_bp0, @preYear = REPLACE(STR(nam - 1, 4), ' ', '0') from #dotdg

	-- Customer list
	INSERT INTO #khdg(ma_kh) SELECT a.ma_kh FROM dmkh a
			LEFT JOIN bidmncctsbp0 b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND b.ma_bp0 = @purOrg AND b.name = 'danh_gia_ncc'
			LEFT JOIN bidmnccts c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND c.name = 'danh_gia_ncc'
		WHERE (b.val IS NOT NULL OR (b.val IS NULL AND c.val IS NOT NULL)) AND ISNULL(b.val, c.val) = '1' AND a.status = '1'


	-- Item list
	INSERT INTO #vtdg(ma_vt, dvt) SELECT a.ma_vt, a.dvt FROM dmvt a
			LEFT JOIN bidmvttsbp0 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.ma_bp0 = @purOrg AND b.name = 'danh_gia_ncc'
			LEFT JOIN bidmvtts c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND c.name = 'danh_gia_ncc'
		WHERE (b.val IS NOT NULL OR (b.val IS NULL AND c.val IS NOT NULL)) AND ISNULL(b.val, c.val) = '1' AND a.status = '1'


	-- From Evaluation Adjustment - P08
	INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, trong_so, diem_so, nguon_xd)
		SELECT b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, '', '', b.ma_ct, NULL, '', b.ma_kh, c.ma_vt, c.ma_chi_tieu, c.trong_so, c.diem, b.ma_ct
		FROM #dotdg a JOIN bim08$000000 b ON a.loai_ky = b.loai_ky AND a.nam = b.nam AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 JOIN bid08$000000 c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE c.ma_chi_tieu IN (SELECT ma_chi_tieu FROM #kbct) AND b.ma_kh IN (SELECT ma_kh FROM #khdg)

	IF @UpdateAdjustment = 1 RETURN

	-- Calculate Function
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #part

	-- From Score by Item Entry - P04
	SELECT b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.ma_vt INTO #m04 FROM #dotdg a JOIN bim04$000000 b ON b.ngay_ct BETWEEN a.ngay_bd AND a.ngay_kt AND b.ma_bp0 = a.ma_bp0
	INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, trong_so, diem_so, nguon_xd)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, '', '', a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, b.ma_chi_tieu, b.trong_so, b.diem_so, a.ma_ct
		FROM #m04 a JOIN bid04$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE b.ma_chi_tieu IN (SELECT ma_chi_tieu FROM #kbct) AND a.ma_kh IN (SELECT ma_kh FROM #khdg) AND a.ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #vtdg)


	-- From Enter Score by Evaluation Period - P05
	INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, trong_so, diem_so, nguon_xd)
		SELECT b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, '', '', b.ma_ct, NULL, '', b.ma_kh, c.ma_vt, c.ma_chi_tieu, d.trong_so, c.diem, b.ma_ct
		FROM #dotdg a JOIN bim05$000000 b ON a.loai_ky = b.loai_ky AND a.nam = b.nam AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0
			JOIN bid05$000000 c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #kbct d ON d.ma_chi_tieu = c.ma_chi_tieu
		WHERE b.ma_kh IN (SELECT ma_kh FROM #khdg) AND (c.ma_vt = '' OR c.ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #vtdg))




	-- From PO, PI, SA
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('10', '20')) BEGIN
		SET @s = 'insert into #ngdg(nguon_xd, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_rb, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng)'
		SET @key = 'a.ma_bp0 = (select top 1 ma_bp0 from #dotdg) and a.ma_kh in (select ma_kh from #khdg) and b.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #vtdg)'
		SELECT @vc = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '01'
		WHILE @vc IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @xTable = xtable, @xField = xfield, @xKey = xkey FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '01' AND ma_ct = @vc
			SET @q = @s + ' select ' + @xField + ' from ' + @xTable + ' where %[' + @key + ']%' + SPACE(1) + @xKey
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%PriceRound', @PriceRound), '%QuantityRound', @QuantityRound)
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin
			--
			SELECT @vc = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '01' AND ma_ct > @vc
		END
	END

	SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_bp0, b.ma_vung INTO #dmbp0g1 FROM #dotdg a JOIN bidmbp0g1 b ON a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0

	-- From 90: PD1 - Purchase Receipt Voucher
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('30', '40', '50')) BEGIN
		SET @s = 'insert into #ngdg(nguon_xd, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_rb, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, ma_vung)'

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_vung, sl_nhap1 AS so_luong, dvt1 AS dvt, he_so1 AS he_so, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia1 AS gia INTO #r90 FROM r90$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #r90 select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.sl_nhap1, a.dvt1, a.he_so1, a.gia_nt0, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.gia0'
			+ ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) left join #dmbp0g1 d on a.ma_vung = d.ma_vung'
				+ ' join #dotdg b on b.ma_bp0 = case when isnull(a.ma_bp0, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_bp0 else isnull(d.ma_bp0, '''') end'
			+ ' where %[a.ma_ct in (select ma_ct from #kbngdl where ma_nhom = ''02'') and a.ma_kh in (select ma_kh from #khdg) and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #vtdg)]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r90) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #part
			INSERT INTO #part SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #r90

			SELECT @key = 'a.ma_ct = ''%VoucherCode''', @p = NULL
			SELECT @vc = ma_ct, @p = part, @i = 1 FROM #part WHERE id = 1
			WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @xTable = xtable, @xField = xfield, @xKey = xkey FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '02' AND ma_ct = @vc

				SET @q = @s + ' select ' + @xField + ' from ' + @xTable + ' where ' + @key + SPACE(1) + @xKey
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%PriceRound', @PriceRound), '%QuantityRound', @QuantityRound), '%Partition', @p), '%VoucherCode', @vc)
				IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @i = @i + 1, @p = NULL
				SELECT @vc = ma_ct, @p = part FROM #part WHERE id = @i
			END
		END
	END


	-- From 70: Invoice PNA, PNB, PNG
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('40', '50', '60', '70')) BEGIN
		SET @s = 'insert into #ngdg(nguon_xd, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_rb, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng)'

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, sl_nhap1 AS so_luong, dvt1 AS dvt, he_so1 AS he_so, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, loai_ct INTO #r70 FROM r70$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #r70 select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap1, a.dvt1, a.he_so1, a.gia_nt0, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.gia0, loai_ct'
			+ ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) left join #dmbp0g1 d on a.ma_vung = d.ma_vung'
				+ ' join #dotdg b on b.ma_bp0 = case when isnull(a.ma_bp0, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_bp0 else isnull(d.ma_bp0, '''') end'
			+ ' where %[a.ma_ct in (select ma_ct from #kbngdl where ma_nhom = ''03'') and a.ma_kh in (select ma_kh from #khdg) and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #vtdg)]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		-- #V3: Invoice used in method 40, 50; #V3 + #V4: Invoice used in method 60, 70
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r70) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #part
			INSERT INTO #part SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #r70

			SELECT @key = 'a.ma_ct = ''%VoucherCode''', @p = NULL
			SELECT @vc = ma_ct, @p = part, @i = 1 FROM #part WHERE id = 1
			WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @xTable = xtable, @xField = xfield, @xKey = xkey FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '03' AND ma_ct = @vc

				SET @q = @s + ' select ' + @xField + ' from ' + @xTable + ' where ' + @key + SPACE(1) + @xKey
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%PriceRound', @PriceRound), '%QuantityRound', @QuantityRound), '%Partition', @p), '%VoucherCode', @vc)
				IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @i = @i + 1, @p = NULL
				SELECT @vc = ma_ct, @p = part FROM #part WHERE id = @i
			END
		END
	END

	-- From Inspection
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp = '30') BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_lo_kd, a.stt_rec_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, a.diem_so INTO #m14 FROM bim14$000000 a
		SET @q = 'insert into #m14 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_lo_kd, a.stt_rec_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, a.diem_so'
			+ ' from bim14$%Partition a with(nolock) left join #dmbp0g1 d on a.ma_vung = d.ma_vung'
				+ ' join #dotdg b on b.ma_bp0 = case when isnull(a.ma_bp0, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_bp0 else isnull(d.ma_bp0, '''') end'
			+ ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_kh in (select ma_kh from #khdg) and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #vtdg)]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		DECLARE @ins1 SMALLDATETIME, @ins2 SMALLDATETIME
		SELECT @ins1 = MIN(ngay_lo_kd), @ins2 = MAX(ngay_lo_kd) FROM #m14
		SET @q = 'delete #m14 from #m14 a join bikd00$%Partition b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec where %[b.status = ''5'']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'b.ngay_ct', @ins1, @ins2, @UserID, @Admin

		INSERT INTO #ngdg(nguon_xd, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_rb, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, diem_so)
			SELECT '#KD', a.stt_rec, '', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_lo_kd, 0, 0, '', 1, 0, null, '', a.stt_rec_kd, '', a.diem_so
			FROM #m14 a

	END

	-- PO, IR Reference
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('40', '50', '60', '70')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '04') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'insert into #ngdg(nguon_xd, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_rb, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng)'

		SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec_ng AS stt_rec, stt_rec0ng AS stt_rec0, RIGHT(stt_rec_ng, 3) AS ma_ct
			INTO #ref FROM #ngdg a WHERE nguon_xd IN ('#V2', '#V3', '#V4') AND ISNULL(stt_rec_ng, '') <> '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ngdg b WHERE nguon_xd = '#V1' AND b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_ng AND b.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0ng)

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ref) BEGIN
			SELECT @vc = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '04'
			WHILE @vc IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #part
				SET @cTable = NULL
				SELECT @cTable = c$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @vc
				IF @cTable IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SET @q = 'insert into #part select distinct '''', convert(char(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) from #ref a join ' + @cTable + '000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.ma_ct = ''' + @vc + ''''
					IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END

				SELECT @key = 'r.ma_ct = ''%VoucherCode''', @p = NULL
				SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part
				WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SELECT @xTable = xtable, @xField = xfield, @xKey = xkey FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '04' AND ma_ct = @vc

					SET @q = @s + ' select ' + @xField + ' from ' + @xTable + ' where ' + @key + SPACE(1) + @xKey
					SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%PriceRound', @PriceRound), '%QuantityRound', @QuantityRound), '%Partition', @p), '%VoucherCode', @vc)
					IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
					--
					SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @p
				END
				--
				SELECT @vc = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #kbngdl WHERE ma_nhom = '04' AND ma_ct > @vc
			END
		END
	END

	UPDATE #ngdg SET ma_nt = @BaseCurrency WHERE ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = '' and nguon_xd IN ('#V1', '#V2', '#V3')


	-- Get Info Record
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('10', '20')) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_nt, ma_nt, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, nguon_xd)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, '', a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong1, a.dvt1, a.he_so1, a.gia_nt1, a.ma_nt, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, '#IR'
			FROM bigia01 a JOIN bigia02 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 JOIN #vtdg v ON a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt JOIN #khdg k ON a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh
			WHERE a.status = '1' AND a.ma_bp0 = @purOrg AND (b.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_tu <= @dateTo) AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= @dateTo)

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp = '20') BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_nt, ma_nt, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, nguon_xd)
				SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, '', a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong1, a.dvt1, a.he_so1, a.gia_nt1, a.ma_nt, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, '#O1'
				FROM bigia01 a JOIN bigia02 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 JOIN #vtdg v ON a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt JOIN #khdg k ON a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh
				WHERE a.status = '1' AND a.ma_bp0 = @purOrg AND (b.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_tu <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @dateTo)) AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= DATEADD(YEAR, - 1, @dateTo))
		END
	END


	-- Exchange Rate
	SELECT a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_ct, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt
		INTO #tygia FROM dmtgnt a JOIN (SELECT ma_nt, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct FROM dmtgnt WHERE ma_nt IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_nt FROM #ngdg) AND ngay_ct <= @dateTo GROUP BY ma_nt) b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
	INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguon_xd, ma_kh, ma_vt)
		SELECT '#ER.' + RTRIM(id_stt), '', '', '', ngay_ct, '', ma_nt, ty_gia, '#ER', '', '' FROM #tygia
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp = '20') BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_ct, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt
			INTO #tygia_cu FROM dmtgnt a JOIN (SELECT ma_nt, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct FROM dmtgnt WHERE ma_nt IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_nt FROM #ngdg) AND ngay_ct <= DATEADD(YEAR, - 1, @dateTo) GROUP BY ma_nt) b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
		INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguon_xd, ma_kh, ma_vt)
			SELECT '#ER.' + RTRIM(id_stt), '', '', '', ngay_ct, '', ma_nt, ty_gia, '#O2', '', '' FROM #tygia_cu
	END


	-- Market Price
	SELECT a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.gia_nt AS gia, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt
		INTO #giatt FROM bigiatt a
			JOIN (SELECT x.ma_vt, x.dvt, MAX(x.ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu FROM bigiatt x JOIN #vtdg v ON x.ma_vt = v.ma_vt
				WHERE (x.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_tu <= @dateTo) AND (x.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_den >= @dateTo) GROUP BY x.ma_vt, x.dvt
			) b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.dvt = b.dvt AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu
		WHERE a.ma_bp0 = @purOrg


	INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_vt, gia, dvt, he_so, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, nguon_xd, ma_kh)
		SELECT '#MP.' + RTRIM(a.id_stt), '', '', '', '', @BaseCurrency, 1, a.ma_vt, a.gia, a.dvt, ISNULL(b.he_so, 1), a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, '#MP', ''
		FROM #giatt a LEFT JOIN dmqddvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.dvt = b.dvt

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp = '20') BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.gia_nt AS gia, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt
			INTO #giatt_cu FROM bigiatt a
				JOIN (SELECT x.ma_vt, x.dvt, MAX(x.ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu FROM bigiatt x JOIN #vtdg v ON x.ma_vt = v.ma_vt
					WHERE (x.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_tu <= DATEADD(YEAR, - 1, @dateTo)) AND (x.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_den >= DATEADD(YEAR, - 1, @dateTo)) GROUP BY x.ma_vt, x.dvt
				) b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.dvt = b.dvt AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu
			WHERE a.ma_bp0 = @purOrg

		INSERT INTO #ngdg(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_vt, gia, dvt, he_so, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, nguon_xd, ma_kh)
			SELECT '#MP.' + RTRIM(id_stt), '', '', '', '', @BaseCurrency, 1, ma_vt, gia, dvt, 1, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, '#O3', '' FROM #giatt_cu
	END


	UPDATE #ngdg SET stt_rec1 = '' WHERE stt_rec1 IS NULL
	CREATE INDEX ma_ct ON #ngdg(ma_ct)
	CREATE INDEX nguon_xd ON #ngdg(nguon_xd)

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptListOfEmpWithoutTimekeepingData]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@HourForm VARCHAR(32),
	@HourTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @d SMALLDATETIME, @dF VARCHAR(32), @dT VARCHAR(32)
	
	SELECT @Key = '', @Key2 = '', @Join = '', @dF = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + '''', @dT = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #hrnv0(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ngay_nghi SMALLDATETIME, ngay_vao SMALLDATETIME)
	CREATE TABLE #hrnv1(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ngay SMALLDATETIME)
	CREATE TABLE #cc(stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay SMALLDATETIME)
	CREATE TABLE #ca(stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay SMALLDATETIME)

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'

	-- Employee
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrnv0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.ngay_nghi, a.ngay_vao'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > @DateFrom) and (a.ngay_vao <= @DateTo)'
	IF @Key <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		SELECT @Key = 'a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #hrnv0)'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@DateFrom smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime', @DateFrom = @DateFrom, @DateTo = @DateTo
	CREATE INDEX i0 ON #hrnv0(stt_rec)

	-- Timekeeping
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key2 = @Key
	IF @Key2 = '' SELECT @Key = '(b.ngay_nghi is null or b.ngay_nghi > @DateFrom) and (b.ngay_vao <= @DateTo)', @Join = ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and @$keyTime'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and not exists (select 1 from #cc c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec@$keyExt and a.ngay = c.ngay)'
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #cc select distinct a.stt_rec, a.ngay from @$table a' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	-- + In/Out Period
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$table', 'hrvaora$%Partition'), '@DateFrom', @dF), '@DateTo', @dT), '@$keyExt', ''), '@$keyTime', '(convert(char(5), a.thoi_gian, 114) between ''' + @HourForm + ''' and ''' + @HourTo + ''')')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- + Adjustment Period
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$table', 'hrdcdulieu$%Partition'), '@DateFrom', @dF), '@DateTo', @dT), '@$keyExt', ''), '@$keyTime', '(convert(char(5), a.thoi_gian_vao, 114) between ''' + @HourForm + ''' and ''' + @HourTo + ''')')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s = @s + ' and (a.ngay between @DateFrom and @DateTo)'

	-- + In/Out
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$table', 'hrvaora'), '%[', ''), ']%', ''), '@$keyExt', ' and a.ngay = c.ngay'), '@$keyTime', '(a.gio >= @HourForm and (a.gio <= @HourTo or a.hs_yn = 1))')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@DateFrom smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime, @HourForm varchar(32), @HourTo varchar(32)'
		, @DateFrom = @DateFrom, @DateTo = @DateTo, @HourForm = @HourForm, @HourTo = @HourTo

	-- + Adjustment
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$table', 'hrdcvaora'), '%[', ''), ']%', ''), '@$keyExt', ' and a.ngay = c.ngay'), '@$keyTime', '(a.gio >= @HourForm and (a.gio <= @HourTo or a.hs_yn = 1))')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@DateFrom smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime, @HourForm varchar(32), @HourTo varchar(32)'
		, @DateFrom = @DateFrom, @DateTo = @DateTo, @HourForm = @HourForm, @HourTo = @HourTo

	-- Schedule
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = @Key2
	IF @Key2 = '' SELECT @Key = '(b.ngay_nghi is null or b.ngay_nghi > ' + @dF + ') and (b.ngay_vao <= ' + @dT + ')', @Join = ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and isnull(a.n@$col, '''') <> '''' and a.status = ''1'''
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #ca select distinct a.stt_rec, ''@$date'' from hrca$%Partition a' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	-- By Day
	SELECT @d = @DateFrom
	WHILE @d <= @DateTo BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #hrnv1(stt_rec, bo_phan, ngay) SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, @d FROM #hrnv0 a WHERE (a.ngay_nghi IS NULL OR a.ngay_nghi > @d) AND a.ngay_vao <= @d
		--
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$col', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@d), 2), ' ', '0')), '@$date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112)), 'a.stt_rec', 'a.stt_rec_nv'), '@DateFrom', @dF), '@DateTo', @dT)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @d, @d, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SELECT @d = @d + 1
	END


	DELETE #hrnv1 FROM #hrnv1 a JOIN hrkcccong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den
	DELETE #hrnv1 FROM #hrnv1 a JOIN hrnghi b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den
	DELETE #hrnv1 FROM #hrnv1 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ca b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay)
	DELETE #hrnv1 FROM #hrnv1 a JOIN #cc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay = b.ngay
	--
	DELETE hrnvkcc FROM hrnvkcc a JOIN hrkcccong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den
	DELETE hrnvkcc FROM hrnvkcc a JOIN hrnghi b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den
	DELETE hrnvkcc FROM hrnvkcc a JOIN #cc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay = b.ngay
	--
	DELETE #hrnv0 FROM #hrnv0 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrnv1 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)

	-- Get Work Information
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv AS ten_nv, b.bo_phan, b.vi_tri INTO #stt_rec0 FROM #hrnv0 a JOIN hrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Order By Day
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ngay, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, MAX(b.ten_nv) AS ten_nv
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_bp) ELSE MAX(c.ten_bp2) END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(d.ten_vtr) ELSE MAX(d.ten_vtr2) END AS ten_vtr INTO #stt_rec
		FROM #hrnv1 a
			JOIN #stt_rec0 b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrvt d WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr
		GROUP BY a.ngay, c.stt_ref, d.stt, b.vi_tri, b.ma_nv, a.stt_rec

	SELECT ngay, MIN(id) AS stt INTO #g FROM #stt_rec GROUP BY ngay
	UPDATE #stt_rec SET stt = a.id - b.stt + 1 FROM #stt_rec a JOIN #g b ON a.ngay = b.ngay

	-- View
	SELECt 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, a.ngay, c.stt, a.stt_rec, c.ma_nv, c.ten_nv, c.ten_bp, c.ten_vtr
			, ISNULL(b.chitieu_01, 0) AS chitieu_01, ISNULL(b.chitieu_02, 0) AS chitieu_02, ISNULL(b.chitieu_03, 0) AS chitieu_03
			, ISNULL(b.chitieu_04, 0) AS chitieu_04, ISNULL(b.chitieu_05, 0) AS chitieu_05, ISNULL(b.chitieu_06, 0) AS chitieu_06
			, ISNULL(b.chitieu_07, 0) AS chitieu_07, ISNULL(b.chitieu_08, 0) AS chitieu_08, ISNULL(b.chitieu_09, 0) AS chitieu_09
			, ISNULL(b.chitieu_10, 0) AS chitieu_10
		FROM #hrnv1 a
			LEFT JOIN hrnvkcc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay
			JOIN #stt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ngay = c.ngay
		ORDER BY a.ngay, c.stt

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
