CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJournalVCRegBook] --fs_JournalVCRegBook
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@VoucherFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@VoucherTo VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nTien NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)	

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, b.stt AS stt, b.dien_giai AS dien_giai, ps_no  AS Tien, ps_no_nt  AS Tien_nt				
		INTO #report
		FROM r00$000000 a LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct, ctgs b
		ORDER BY 1

	--Key		 
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.status =' + CHAR (39) + '1' + CHAR (39)
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + ' a.so_ctgs <> '''' '
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + ' isnull(a.ps_no, 0) + isnull(a.ps_no_nt, 0) <> 0 '
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, max(b.stt) as stt, max(b.dien_giai) as dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q	+ ', sum(ps_no + ps_co) as Tien, sum(ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt) as Tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ctgs b on a.ngay_ctgs = b.ngay_ctgs and a.so_ctgs = b.so_ctgs where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @VoucherFrom <> '' DELETE #report WHERE so_ctgs < @VoucherFrom
	IF @VoucherTo <> '' DELETE #report WHERE so_ctgs > @VoucherTo
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @nTien = SUM(Tien), @nTien_nt = SUM(Tien_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @Language = 'V' INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (0, 0, 0,  @s1, @nTien, @nTien_nt)
	ELSE INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (0, 0, 0,  @s12, @nTien, @nTien_nt)
	
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (1, 0, 0,  '', 0, 0)
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Tag, convert(char(10), ngay_ctgs, 112) as ngay
		FROM #report 
		ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ctgs, stt, so_ctgs
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhddt01]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_kh AS ten_kh0, b.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh02, c.ten_kh AS ten_kh1, c.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh12
		FROM dbo.hddt01 a JOIN dbo.dmkh b ON a.ma_kh0 = b.ma_kh JOIN dbo.dmkh c ON a.ma_kh1 = c.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$ManagementObject]
	@ObjectType TINYINT,
	@Field VARCHAR(32),
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectCode VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Management Object, 2 Multi Management Object
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_dtqt, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @ObjectCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.%ma like ''' + REPLACE(@ObjectCode, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_dtqt, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cddtqt' + RTRIM(@ObjectType) + ' a with(nolock)'
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_dtqt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%ma', 'ma_dtqt'), @Field, 'ma_dtqt')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.' + RTRIM(@Field) + ', sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%ma', @Field) ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.' + RTRIM(@Field) + ''
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_dtqt, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_dtqt order by tk, ma_dtqt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcDisCoeffByUserDefine]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@FactorCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @FactorCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_yt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@FactorCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx INTO #xdmyt0 FROM xdmyt
	SELECT TOP 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, ma_dvcs, ma_yt INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
	SET @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs(ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
 
 
	IF @objectUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt0(ma_dvcs, ma_yt, th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select rtrim(a.ma_dvcs), rtrim(a.ma_yt), a.th_sp, a.th_bp, a.th_lsx, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx'
		SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a join #dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs' 		
		SET @q = @q + ' where exists(select 1 from xcthspb b where b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ')'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q	
		
		UPDATE #xdmyt0 SET x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0
		INSERT INTO #xdmyt(ma_dvcs, ma_yt) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt FROM #xdmyt0 WHERE th_sp = 0 OR (x_dt_bp = 1 AND th_bp = 0) OR (x_dt_lsx = 1 AND th_lsx = 0)			
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt(ma_dvcs, ma_yt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select rtrim(ma_dvcs), rtrim(ma_yt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a with(nolock) where' 
		SET @q = @q + ' (a.th_sp = 0' + CASE WHEN @costDept = '1' THEN ' or a.th_bp = 0' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @costMO = '1' THEN ' or a.th_lsx = 0' ELSE '' END + ')'
		SET @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from xcthspb b where b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt AND ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ')'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_yt VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #xdmyt
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_yt = RTRIM(ma_yt) FROM #xdmyt WHERE id = @i
		EXEC xs20_COCalcDisCoeffByUserDefineByFactor @Period, @Year, @ma_yt, @ma_dvcs, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$GetRowID] @RowID VARCHAR(3) OUTPUT, @RowNumber INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT @RowNumber = @RowNumber + 1, @RowID = dbo.ff_IncreaseSeq(@RowID)
	IF LEN(@RowNumber) > 3 RETURN ''
	SELECT @RowID = REPLICATE('0', 3 - LEN(@RowID)) + @RowID

END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSDetailReports]
	@dFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@cItem AS VARCHAR(33),
	@cAction AS VARCHAR(4000),
	@cVersion CHAR(2),
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@nDateFormat INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- @nDateFormat: 103 - dd/mm/yyyy, 101 - mm/dd/yyyy
	DECLARE @cActionMessage NVARCHAR(128), @cQtyFormat VARCHAR(20), @nHs NUMERIC(28, 6), @nSize TINYINT
	SET @nSize = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')
	SELECT @cQtyFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, a.nguon AS loai_dh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, b.ten_cb, a.nguon, c.ten_nguon,
			a.so_dh AS so_ct, a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, a.ngay_yc, a.nxt, a.muc_do, a.stt, a.stt_rec
		INTO #rs
	FROM mpctyc a, mpdmcb b, mrdmnguon c

	ALTER TABLE #rs ALTER COLUMN ten_cb NVARCHAR(128) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #rs ALTER COLUMN ten_nguon NVARCHAR(128) NULL

	IF @cVersion = '' BEGIN
		INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
			CASE
				WHEN nguon IN ('FP', 'PL') AND sl_da_yc > 0 THEN 'PR'
				ELSE nguon
			END AS loai_dh, 
			a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END AS ten_cb, 
			a.nguon, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
			a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
			a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
			a.ngay_yc,
			a.nxt, 
			a.muc_do,
			a.stt, 
			a.stt_rec
		FROM mpctyc a LEFT JOIN mpdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
			AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')
			AND dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 1
	END 
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
			a.nguon, 
			a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, '',
			a.nguon, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon,
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
			a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
			a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
			a.ngay_yc,
			a.nxt, 
			a.muc_do, 
			a.stt, 
			a.stt_rec
		FROM mphistory a LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
			AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')			
			AND a.version = @cVersion

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #rs) BEGIN
			INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
				a.nguon, 
				a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, '',
				a.nguon, 
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
				CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
				a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
				a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
				a.ngay_yc,
				a.nxt, 
				a.muc_do, 
				a.stt, 
				a.stt_rec
			FROM mpctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
			WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND a.nguon <> 'PL' -- AND a.nguon <> 'FP'
		END

		-- Action Message
		EXEC rs_RunGenerateActionMessage '#rs', 1, 1, NULL
		IF RTRIM(@cAction) <> '' DELETE #rs WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 0
		UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END FROM #rs a LEFT JOIN mpdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb
	END

	-- Action Message
	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '11'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '12'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '21'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '22'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '31'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '32'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '33'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '34'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = '' WHERE ten_cb IS NULL
	SELECT a.*
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_nguon ELSE b.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_dh
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
			, c.dvt
		INTO #report
		FROM #rs a
			LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon b ON a.loai_dh = b.ma_nguon
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_vt, ngay_ct, nxt, muc_do, stt
	UPDATE #report SET so_dh = '', ten_dh = '', sl_dh = NULL, sl_da_yc = NULL, sl_nhap = NULL, ngay_dat = NULL WHERE sl_xuat > 0
	UPDATE #report SET ten_nguon = '', so_ct = '',  sl_xuat = NULL WHERE (NOT sl_dh IS NULL)

	DECLARE @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dMin SMALLDATETIME, @nOnHand NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @stt NUMERIC(20), @sl_nhap NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_xuat NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_ton NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @dNow = run_date FROM mplog
	SELECT @dMin = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM #report
	
	SELECT TOP 0 sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Item @dMin, '', '', @cItem, 2, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	
	SELECT @nOnHand = SUM(so_luong) FROM #t
	SELECT @nOnHand = ISNULL(@nOnHand, 0)

	-- Stock
	DECLARE crActionDetail CURSOR FOR SELECT stt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ngay_ct <= @dNow ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_ct, muc_do, stt
	OPEN crActionDetail
	FETCH NEXT FROM crActionDetail INTO @stt, @sl_nhap, @sl_xuat
	SELECT @sl_ton = @nOnHand
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sl_ton = @sl_ton + @sl_nhap - @sl_xuat
			UPDATE #report SET sl_ton = @sl_ton WHERE stt = @stt
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crActionDetail INTO @stt, @sl_nhap, @sl_xuat
		END

	CLOSE crActionDetail
	DEALLOCATE crActionDetail
	--
	SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, a.ten_dh, a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ten_cb, a.ten_nguon, a.so_ct, a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.nxt, a.muc_do, a.stt
	FROM #report a ORDER BY a.ma_vt, ngay_ct, nxt, muc_do, stt
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdmtgbh] AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_nt, '') AS ten_nt, ISNULL(b.ten_nt2, '') AS ten_nt2 FROM hrdmtgbh a LEFT JOIN dmnt b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		ORDER BY a.ma_nt, a.ngay_hl DESC
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ConvertBContracts2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @dStart = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @dEnd = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @UnitKey = '', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gldcsd FROM gldcsd

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = ''
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @UserID = 1, @Admin = 1
	END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[ma_ku <> '''' and  exists(select 1 from dmku b where a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and b.ku_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gldcsd select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from gldcsd a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ma_ku <> '''' and a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from dmku b where a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and b.ku_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdku where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdku (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_ku, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdku b with(index(nam), nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and exists(select 1 from dmku c where c.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and ku_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku)) a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_ku'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update cdku set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no00 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no_nt00 end
				, du_co00 = case when - @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no00 end, du_co_nt00 = case when - @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no_nt00 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdku where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_Inlists(@cItem1 NVARCHAR(511), @strList1 NVARCHAR(4000), @cItem2 NVARCHAR(511), @strList2 NVARCHAR(4000))  
RETURNS INT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nReturn INT
	SET  @nStart = 1
	SET  @nReturn = 0
	SET @cItem1 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem1))
	SET @strList1 = ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@strList1)) + ' ,'
	SET @cItem2 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem2))
	SET @strList2 = ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@strList2)) + ' ,'
	
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			IF (@cItem1 LIKE (RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList1, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart) - @nStart))) + '%')) 
				AND (@cItem2 LIKE (RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList2, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList2,  @nStart) - @nStart))) + '%'))
				BEGIN
					SET @nReturn = 1
					BREAK
				END
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN @nReturn
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rpt02KK]--ts_xRpt02KK_28
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @MonthFrom INT, @MonthTo INT, @dvt1 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt2 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt3 NVARCHAR(16)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	
	
	SELECT @dvt1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT01'
	SELECT @dvt2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT02'
	SELECT @dvt3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT03'

	IF @Type = '1' SELECT @MonthFrom = @Month, @MonthTo = @Month
		ELSE SELECT @MonthFrom = (@Month * 3 - 2), @MonthTo = (@Month * 3)
	SELECT @dateFrom = (RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@MonthFrom, 2), ' ', '0') + '01'), @dateTo = (RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@MonthTo, 2), ' ', '0') + '01'), @dateTo = DATEADD(dd, -1, DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(mm, 0, @dateTo) + 1, 0))

	SELECT 1 AS systotal, stt, stt_in, ma_so, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu2
			, gia_tri AS tien, gia_tri AS tien_nt, bold, iscal, cach_tinh, truy_van, truy_van2, loai_dvt, ids INTO #report
		FROM t02kk
		WHERE form = @Form --TT156

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- Blacklist
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT ma_ns, loai_tn, loai_tn AS ma_tn, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct, tn_ct_nt AS tn_ct_nt0, tn_ct AS tn_ct0, thue_nt, thue, thue_giam_nt, thue_giam, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS bang INTO #tmp FROM t01$0000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	
	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.ky between ''' + RTRIM(@MonthFrom) + ''' and ''' + RTRIM(@MonthTo) + '''', @Key2 = ''
	IF @Department <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_bp INTO #t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$TaxDepartment(@Department)
		SELECT @Key2 = 'b.ma_bp in (select ma_bp from #t)', @Join = @Join + ' left join phns b with(nolock) on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns'
	END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Key2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @Key2
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn, '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
		, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
		, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), ''t1'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from t01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #tmp select a.ma_ns, '''', '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
		, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
		, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), 0, 0, ''t2'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from t02$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.ma_ns'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_ns, '''', a.ma_tn, sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct), 0, 0, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), ''t0'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from t00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	IF @Key2 <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.ma_ns, a.ma_tn'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @truy_van VARCHAR(4000), @truy_van2 VARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024), @iscal INT
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', ''), iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = (' + @truy_van + '), tien_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien = 0 where tien is null and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien_nt = 0 where tien_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@ma_so <> '' AND @cach_tinh <> '') BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #report set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
					+ ', tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien_nt from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
					+ ', systotal = 0 where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(@ma_so) + CHAR(39)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	END
	CLOSE cur
	DEALLOCATE cur

Result:
	SELECT a.systotal, a.stt, a.stt_in, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.bold
			, CASE WHEN a.loai_dvt = 1 THEN @dvt1 ELSE @dvt2 END AS dvt, CASE WHEN a.loai_dvt = 1 THEN @dvt1 ELSE @dvt3 END AS dvt_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu2
		FROM #report a ORDER BY a.stt, a.ma_so

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Item]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Site VARCHAR(33),	
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Item, 2 Multi Item
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1 - Physics, 2 - Book
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM cdvt

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key =  @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @s = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, sum(a.ton00), sum(a.du00), sum(a.du_nt00)'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @DataType = 1 THEN 'cdvt2' ELSE 'cdvt' END + ' a with (nolock, index(nam)) '
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @s = @s + 'left join dmkho z on a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @s = @s + @JoinClause
	SET @s = @s + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + '%key'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @s = @s + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @s = @s + ' group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '%key', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	IF @DataType = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = YEAR(@Date)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, 'cdvt2', 'cdvt'), '%key', ' and not exists(select 1 from cdlo2 b with(nolock) where b.nam = a.nam and b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END 
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
	END

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(so_luong), 0) as so_luong, isnull(sum(tien), 0) as tien, isnull(sum(tien_nt), 0) as tien_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_kho, ma_vt, isnull(sum(so_luong), 0) as so_luong, isnull(sum(tien), 0) as tien, isnull(sum(tien_nt), 0) as tien_nt'		
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by ma_kho, ma_vt order by ma_kho, ma_vt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptListOfEmpWithoutTimekeepingDataSave]
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Result INT OUTPUT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @kCode NVARCHAR(4000), @vCode NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @l0 INT, @l1 INT, @l2 INT, @l3 INT, @i INT, @n INT, @m INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(32), @day SMALLDATETIME, @col VARCHAR(32), @value VARCHAR(32)
		
	CREATE TABLE #k0 (id INT, data VARCHAR(512))
	CREATE TABLE #v0 (id INT, data VARCHAR(512))
	
	SELECT @l0 = (SELECT TOP 1 DATALENGTH(text) FROM #k)
	SELECT @l2 = CHARINDEX(',', TEXT) FROM #v
	SELECT @l3 = CHARINDEX(',', TEXT) FROM #k
	IF @l2 = 0 SELECT @l2 = (SELECT TOP 1 DATALENGTH(text) FROM #v)/2
	IF @l3 = 0 SELECT @l3 = (SELECT TOP 1 DATALENGTH(text) FROM #k)/2

	SELECT @n = @l0/8000, @l1 = 173, @i = 0, @Result = 0
	SELECT @s = 'delete hrnvkcc where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and ngay = @$ngay'
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'if @$value = 1 insert into hrnvkcc (stt_rec, ngay, @$col, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2) select @$stt_rec, @$ngay, @$value, getdate(), getdate(), @user_id, @user_id'

	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @kCode = SUBSTRING(text, (@i * @l2 * @l1) + 1, ((@i + 1) * @l2 * @l1) - 1) FROM #k
		SELECT @vCode = SUBSTRING(text, (@i * @l3 * @l1) + 1, ((@i + 1) * @l3 * @l1) - 1) FROM #v

		TRUNCATE TABLE #k0
		TRUNCATE TABLE #v0

		INSERT INTO #k0 SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@kCode, ',')
		INSERT INTO #v0 SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@vCode, ',')

		SELECT @m = MAX(id) FROM #k0
		WHILE (@m IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @stt_rec = SUBSTRING(data, 1, (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data) - 1)), @day = SUBSTRING(data, (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data) + 1), LEN(RTRIM(data)) - (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data))) FROM #k0 WHERE id = @m
			SELECT @col = SUBSTRING(data, 1, (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data) - 1)), @value = SUBSTRING(data, (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data) + 1), LEN(RTRIM(data)) - (CHARINDEX(CHAR(252), data))) FROM #v0 WHERE id = @m
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '@$col', @col)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@$stt_rec varchar(32), @$ngay smalldatetime, @$value bit, @user_id int'
				, @$stt_rec = @stt_rec, @$ngay = @day, @$value = @value, @user_id = @UserID
			--
			SELECT @m = MAX(id) FROM #k0 WHERE id < @m
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT @Result = 1
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptLedgerOfReturnVATAccount] --fs_AcctLedger--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@rType CHAR(1) = '1', 
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- KeyAccount
	SET @Key = ' status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh
			, a.ma_vv, a.so_lsx, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai_h, a.so_ctgs, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_lo, a.ngay_lo, a.ong_ba
			, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.line_nbr, a.tk
		INTO #dt FROM wrkgl a

	SET @q = 'insert into #dt'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, nh_dk, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_vv, so_lsx, dien_giai, dien_giai_h, so_ctgs, ngay_ctgs, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ', tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with (nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh
			, a.ma_vv, a.so_lsx, a.dien_giai, a.so_ctgs, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_lo, a.ngay_lo, a.ong_ba
			, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.line_nbr
			, c.ten_tk, c.ten_tk2
			, b.ten_kh AS ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh2
			, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, a.tk
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_du = c.tk LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
		ORDER BY 1

	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	IF @rType = '1'
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh
				, a.ma_vv, a.so_lsx, a.dien_giai, a.so_ctgs, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_lo, a.ngay_lo, a.ong_ba
				, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
				, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.line_nbr
				, ISNULL(c.ten_tk, ''), ISNULL(c.ten_tk2, '')
				, ISNULL(b.ten_kh, ''), ISNULL(b.ten_kh2, '')
				, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in, a.tk
				FROM #dt a 
					LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmkh)) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
					LEFT JOIN dmtk c WITH (INDEX(PK_dmtk)) ON a.tk_du = c.tk 
					LEFT JOIN dmct d WITH (INDEX(PK_dmct)) ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
	IF @rType = '2'
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, '', a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, MAX(a.so_ct0), a.ma_kh
				, MAX(a.ma_vv), MAX(a.so_lsx), MAX(a.dien_giai), MAX(a.so_ctgs), MAX(a.ngay_ctgs), MAX(a.so_lo), MAX(a.ngay_lo), MAX(a.ong_ba)
				, a.tk_du, SUM(a.ps_no), SUM(a.ps_co), SUM(a.ps_no_nt), SUM(a.ps_co_nt)
				, MAX(a.ma_nt), MAX(a.ty_gia), MIN(a.line_nbr)
				, MAX(c.ten_tk), MAX(c.ten_tk2)
				, ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_kh), ''), ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_kh2), '')
				, MAX(d.stt_ct_nkc), MAX(d.ma_ct_in), @Account
				FROM #dt a 
						LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
						LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_du = c.tk 
						LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
				GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk_du

	IF @rType = '3'
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, '', a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, MAX(a.so_ct0), MAX(a.ma_kh)
				, MAX(a.ma_vv), MAX(a.so_lsx), CASE WHEN MAX(a.dien_giai_h) <> '' THEN MAX(a.dien_giai_h) ELSE MAX(a.dien_giai) END, MAX(a.so_ctgs), MAX(a.ngay_ctgs), MAX(a.so_lo), MAX(a.ngay_lo), MAX(a.ong_ba)
				, '', SUM(a.ps_no), SUM(a.ps_co), SUM(a.ps_no_nt), SUM(a.ps_co_nt)
				, MAX(a.ma_nt), MAX(a.ty_gia), MIN(a.line_nbr)
				, MAX(c.ten_tk), MAX(c.ten_tk2)
				, ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_kh), ''), ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_kh2), '')
				, MAX(d.stt_ct_nkc), MAX(d.ma_ct_in), @Account
				FROM #dt a 
					LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
					LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_du = c.tk 
					LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
				GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'

	CREATE TABLE #temp(du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)) 
	INSERT INTO #temp EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @nDu_dk = Du, @nDu_dk_nt = Du_nt FROM #temp

	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)
		FROM #report
		WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)		
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)
	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_vv, ma_ct, stt_rec
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADetailByCapitalReport]  -- fs_FADetailReportByCapitals
	@Period AS INT,
	@Year AS INT,
	@Type AS CHAR(1), --1 - Openning, 2 - Closing
	@FATypeCode AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FADepartment AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FAGroup1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FAGroup2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FAGroup3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@ReportType CHAR(2), --10 - Standard, 20 - FC
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Total AS NVARCHAR(1024), @NoGroup AS NVARCHAR(1024), @Capital AS NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @NoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT @Capital = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'RPT010'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
			, b.loai_ts, b.ngay_mua, b.so_ky_kh, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_ts
		INTO #tmp FROM ctkhts a, dmts b

	-- Key
	IF @Type = '1'
		IF @Period = 1 SELECT @Period = 12, @Year = @Year -1
			ELSE SELECT @Period = @Period - 1
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @FATypeCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FATypeCode, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FADepartment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FADepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FAGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FAGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FAGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FAGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FAGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FAGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(sum(a.nguyen_gia), 0), isnull(sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0), isnull(sum(a.gt_da_kh), 0)'
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(sum(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0), isnull(sum(a.gt_cl), 0) as gt_cl, isnull(sum(a.gt_cl_nt), 0)'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.loai_ts), max(b.ngay_mua), max(b.so_ky_kh), max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ', space(2) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_ts)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_ts2)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Ko lên những tài sản đã khai báo giảm trong kỳ
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	DELETE #tmp WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_giam BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)

	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ma_nv, ten_ts, loai_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt)
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, NULL, '', a.ma_nv, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_loai), @NoGroup) ELSE ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_loai2), @NoGroup) END, a.loai_ts
				, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt)
			FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmplts b ON a.loai_ts = b.ma_loai
			GROUP BY a.loai_ts, a.ma_nv

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'loai_ts', 'loai_ts, so_the_ts, sysorder', '#tmp', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, loai_ts, ten_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia)
		SELECT 9, 1, 0, NULL, '', ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt), 'ZZZZZZZZ', @total, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL
			FROM #tmp WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nv

	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, loai_ts, ten_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia)
		SELECT 1, 0, 0, NULL, '', ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt), CHAR(9), @total, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL
			FROM #tmp WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nv
	INSERT INTO #tmp (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, loai_ts, ten_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia)
		SELECT 2, 0, 0, NULL, CHAR(10), ma_nv, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL
			FROM #tmp WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nv

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, loai_ts + so_the_ts AS sysrow, ma_nv, @Capital + ' ' + ma_nv AS xten_nv, so_the_ts, ten_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia
			, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt
		FROM #tmp ORDER BY loai_ts, sysorder, stt, ma_nv

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT ma_nv FROM #tmp ORDER BY ma_nv

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	IF @ReportType = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'nguyen_gia$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT024'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_da_kh$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT026'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT028'
	END
	IF @ReportType = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'nguyen_gia_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT025'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_da_kh_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT027'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT029'
	END

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), b.header + ' ' + RTRIM(a.header), b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY b.id, a.id
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW vdmkc1 
AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT d.*, a.tk_no, a.Tk_co, a.Ten_bt, a.loai_kc, a.kc_ct_yn, a.kc_vv_yn, a.kc_kh_yn, a.kc_sp_yn, a.kc_bp_yn, a.kc_hd_yn, a.kc_ku_yn
			, a.kc_phi_yn, a.kc_lsx_yn, a.kc_td1_yn, a.kc_td2_yn, a.kc_td3_yn, a.Status, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk_no, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_no2, c.ten_tk AS ten_tk_co, c.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_co2 
		FROM dbo.dmkc1 d JOIN dmkc a ON d.stt = a.stt 
			INNER JOIN dbo.dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk 
			INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM dmtk) c ON a.tk_co = c.tk 
		ORDER BY d.stt, a.tk_no, a.tk_co

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrnghi0] AS
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.thu, a.so_gio, 
			CASE a.thu 
				WHEN '1' then N'Chủ nhật' 
				WHEN '2' then N'Thứ 2'
				WHEN '3' then N'Thứ 3'
				WHEN '4' then N'Thứ 4'
				WHEN '5' then N'Thứ 5'
				WHEN '6' then N'Thứ 6'			 
				ELSE N'Thứ 7'
			END AS ten_thu,
			CASE a.thu WHEN '1' then N'Sunday' 
				 WHEN '2' then N'Monday'
				 WHEN '3' then N'Tuesday'
				 WHEN '4' then N'Wednesday'
				 WHEN '5' then N'Thursday'
				 WHEN '6' then N'Friday'			 
				 ELSE N'Saturday' 
			END AS ten_thu2,
			a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2,
			b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2
		FROM hrnghi0 a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunATPQuery]
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@dateNow SMALLDATETIME,
	@rate NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@periodCode CHAR(2)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @nPeriodCount INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @nForecast NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRequirement NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPromised NUMERIC(28, 6), @nScheduledReceipt NUMERIC(28, 6) , @nProjectedOnHand NUMERIC(28, 6), @nNetRequirement NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPlannedOrderReceipt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPlanedOrderRelease NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPeriodCoverage NUMERIC(28, 6), @nSaleOrder NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @item = REPLACE(@item, '''', ''''''), @periodCode = REPLACE(@periodCode, '''', ''''''), @i = 0
	SELECT ma_so, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(chi_tieu) ELSE RTRIM(chi_tieu) END AS chi_tieu INTO #rs FROM mpdmctkh WHERE loai = 2 ORDER BY ma_so

	SELECT @nPeriodCount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ky_hd'

	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount
		BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'alter table #rs add ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' numeric(28, 6)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @nForecast = sl_db,
					@nSaleOrder = sl_dh,
					@nScheduledReceipt = sl_kh,
					@nProjectedOnHand = ton_kho,
					@nNetRequirement = nc_rong,
					@nPlannedOrderReceipt = sl_dat,
					@nPlanedOrderRelease = sl_kt
				FROM mpctvtky WHERE ma_vt = @item AND ky = @i

			SELECT @nPromised = SUM(a.sl_qd) FROM mpdh a WHERE a.ma_vt = @item AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@periodCode, @dateNow, a.ngay_yc) = @i AND a.status = '1'

			SELECT @q = '
				update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = case
					when ma_so = ''01'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nForecast, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''02'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nSaleOrder, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''03'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nPromised, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''04'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nScheduledReceipt, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''05'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nProjectedOnHand, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''06'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nNetRequirement, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''07'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nPlannedOrderReceipt, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''08'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nPlanedOrderRelease, 0)) + '
					else 0
				end
			'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

	-- Update ATP and CATP
	SELECT CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl INTO #tmp
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount - 1
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @nNext INT
			SELECT @nNext = @i
			WHILE (@nNext < @nPeriodCount) BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT ma_vt FROM mpctvtky WHERE ma_vt = @item AND ky = @nNext + 1 GROUP BY ma_vt HAVING SUM(sl_nhap) > 0) BREAK
				SELECT @nNext = @nNext + 1
			END

			IF @i <= @nNext BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
					declare @n1 numeric(28, 6), @n2 numeric(28, 6), @k int, @nplanned numeric(28, 6), @q nvarchar(4000)
					select @n1 = 0, @nPlanned = sum(ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ') from #rs where ma_so in(''07'')
					select @n2 = sum(ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ') from #rs where ma_so in(''04'', ''07'')
					select @k = ' + RTRIM(@i) + '
					update #tmp set sl = 0
					while @k <= ' + RTRIM(@nNext) + ' begin
						set @q = ''update #tmp set sl = sl - (select sum(ky'' + rtrim(@k) + '') from #rs where ma_so in (''''02'''', ''''03''''))''
						exec sp_executesql @q
						select @k = @k + 1
					end
					select @n1 = @n2 + sum(sl) from #tmp'
				IF @i = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @n1 = @n1 + (select sum(ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ') from #rs where ma_so in(''05''))'
				ELSE SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if isnull(@nPlanned, 0) = 0 select @n1 = 0'

				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + '= @n1 where ma_so = ''09''
					update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + '= @n1 ' + ' + (select ky' + RTRIM(@i - 1) + ' from #rs where ma_so = ''10'') ' + ' where ma_so = ''10''
					'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

	-- Update coefficient
	IF @rate <> 0 AND @rate <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 0
		WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = ' + 'ky' + RTRIM(@i) + '/' + RTRIM(@rate)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END
	--
	SELECT * FROM #rs ORDER BY ma_so
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhretn]
AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.tn_ld_yn, a.ngay_tn, a.so_ngay_nghi, 
		a.ghi_chu, b.ten_tn, b.ten_tn2
	FROM hretn a LEFT JOIN hrdmtn b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_tn
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ConvertJobs2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @dStart = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @dEnd = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @UnitKey = '', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gldcsd FROM gldcsd

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = ''
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @UserID = 1, @Admin = 1
	END
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[ma_vv <> '''' and exists (select 1 from dmvv b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and b.vv_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gldcsd select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from gldcsd a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ma_vv <> '''' and a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists (select 1 from dmvv b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and b.vv_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdvv where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdvv (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, '''', sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdvv e with(index(nam), nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and exists (select 1 from dmvv f where e.ma_vv = f.ma_vv and f.vv_sd_pslk = 1) and exists (select 1 from dmtk g where e.tk = g.tk and tk_cn = 0)'  + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 b'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and tk_cn = 0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd b'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and tk_cn = 0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into cdvv (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdvv e with(index(nam), nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and exists (select 1 from dmvv f where e.ma_vv = f.ma_vv and f.vv_sd_pslk = 1) and exists (select 1 from dmtk g where e.tk = g.tk and tk_cn = 1)' + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 b'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and tk_cn = 1)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd b'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and tk_cn = 1)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update cdvv set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no00 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else @du_no_nt00 end
				, du_co00 = case when - @du_no00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no00 end, du_co_nt00 = case when - @du_no_nt00 < 0 then 0 else - @du_no_nt00 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdvv where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADepreciationExceeding] --fs20_FADepreciationReport--
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType VARCHAR(32),
	@FaDept VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group VARCHAR(254),
	@Display CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_bp),'') FROM wrkColumns) AS fa_ma_bp
		, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, b.nguyen_gia_vm, b.nguyen_gia_vm_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt
		, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, b.so_ky_kh, b.ngay_mua, b.ngay_kh0, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
		, b.so_ky_kh_qd, b.ty_le_kh_vm, b.hs_vm
		, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_qd, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_cl_thua, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_cl_thieu
		, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_qd_nt, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_cl_thua_nt, 0 * a.gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt
	INTO #report
	FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = 'c.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Key = ' where ' + @Key

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as syprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + ' (select isnull(max(ma_bp), '''') from wrkColumns a) as fa_ma_bp, c.t_nguyen_gia, c.t_nguyen_gia_nt, c.nguyen_gia_vm, c.nguyen_gia_vm_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, c.ten_ts, c.ten_ts2, c.so_ky_kh,'
	SET @q = @q + ' c.ngay_mua, c.ngay_kh0, c.loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ', c.so_ky_kh_qd, c.ty_le_kh_vm, c.hs_vm'
	SET @q = @q + '	, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + '	, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ('
	SET @q = @q + 'select so_the_ts, sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt, max(ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(ty_gia) as ty_gia from ctkhts where (nam * 12 + ky) between (' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ') and (' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2) + ') group by so_the_ts) a'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ('
	SET @q = @q + 'select so_the_ts, sum(nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt from ctkhts where nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year2) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period2) + ' group by so_the_ts) b'
	SET @q = @q + ' on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts join dmts c on a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts '
	SET @q = @q + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_kh0 > dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))

	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year))
	)

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp INTO #dept FROM cthsts WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 16) IN (
			SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)
				FROM cthsts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @Year * 12 + @Period
				GROUP BY so_the_ts
		)
		AND @Period = @Period2

	ALTER TABLE #dept ALTER COLUMN ma_bp VARCHAR(32) NULL

	INSERT INTO #dept SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dept)

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT a.so_the_ts FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ma_bp NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@FaDept) + '%' ))


	---
	UPDATE #report SET so_ky_kh_qd = 0 WHERE so_ky_kh_qd IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ty_le_kh_vm = 0 WHERE ty_le_kh_vm IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET hs_vm = 0 WHERE hs_vm IS NULL

	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_qd = CASE WHEN (1 + ty_le_kh_vm = 0) OR (nguyen_gia = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (((gt_kh_ky)/(1 + ty_le_kh_vm/100))-((gt_kh_ky)*(nguyen_gia_vm/nguyen_gia)/(1 + ty_le_kh_vm/100)))* hs_vm END
	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_qd_nt = CASE WHEN (1 + ty_le_kh_vm = 0) OR (nguyen_gia_nt = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (((gt_kh_ky_nt)/(1 + ty_le_kh_vm/100))-((gt_kh_ky_nt)*(nguyen_gia_vm_nt/nguyen_gia_nt)/(1 + ty_le_kh_vm/100)))* hs_vm END

	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_cl_thieu = CASE WHEN (gt_kh_ky <= gt_kh_qd) THEN (gt_kh_qd - gt_kh_ky) ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt = CASE WHEN (gt_kh_ky_nt <= gt_kh_qd_nt) THEN (gt_kh_qd_nt - gt_kh_ky_nt) ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_cl_thua = CASE WHEN (gt_kh_ky > gt_kh_qd) THEN (gt_kh_ky - gt_kh_qd) ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #report SET gt_kh_cl_thua_nt = CASE WHEN (gt_kh_ky_nt > gt_kh_qd_nt) THEN (gt_kh_ky_nt - gt_kh_qd_nt) ELSE 0 END

	IF @Display = '1' DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_cl_thua <= 0 AND gt_kh_cl_thua_nt <= 0
	IF @Display = '2' DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_cl_thieu <= 0 AND gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt <= 0
	IF @Display = '3' DELETE #report WHERE (gt_kh_cl_thua + gt_kh_cl_thieu = 0) AND (gt_kh_cl_thua_nt + gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt = 0)

	UPDATE #report SET fa_ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(nam*12+ky) AS so_ky
		INTO #temp
		FROM ctkhts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report WHERE nguyen_gia IS NULL)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN (
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
				FROM ctkhts a JOIN #temp b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND (a.nam*12+a.ky) = b.so_ky
				GROUP BY a.so_the_ts) b
			ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts, fa_ma_bp', 'INT, #, &ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_qd, gt_kh_cl_thua, gt_kh_cl_thieu, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, gt_kh_qd_nt, gt_kh_cl_thua_nt, gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, gt_kh_qd, gt_kh_cl_thua, gt_kh_cl_thieu, gt_kh_qd_nt, gt_kh_cl_thua_nt, gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts AS ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2 as ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, so_ky_kh_qd, ty_le_kh_vm, hs_vm, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, gt_kh_qd_nt, gt_kh_cl_thua_nt, gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_qd, gt_kh_cl_thua, gt_kh_cl_thieu from #report order by '  + @Group + ', sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts AS ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2 as ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, so_ky_kh_qd, ty_le_kh_vm, hs_vm, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, gt_kh_qd_nt, gt_kh_cl_thua_nt, gt_kh_cl_thieu_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_qd, gt_kh_cl_thua, gt_kh_cl_thieu from #report order by sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rpt02KK]--rs_rpt02KK
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @MonthFrom INT, @MonthTo INT, @dvt1 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt2 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt3 NVARCHAR(16), @t_tncn_thuc_chi VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @t_tncn_thuc_chi = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_tncn_thuc_chi'
	SELECT @dvt1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT01'
	SELECT @dvt2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT02'
	SELECT @dvt3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TXDVT03'
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = '', @Key2 = ''
	IF @Type = '1' SELECT @MonthFrom = @Month, @MonthTo = @Month
		ELSE SELECT @MonthFrom = (@Month * 3 - 2), @MonthTo = (@Month * 3)
	SELECT @dateFrom = (RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@MonthFrom, 2), ' ', '0') + '01'), @dateTo = (RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@MonthTo, 2), ' ', '0') + '01'), @dateTo = DATEADD(dd, -1, DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(mm, 0, @dateTo) + 1, 0))

	SELECT 1 AS systotal, stt, stt_in, ma_so, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu2
			, gia_tri AS tien, gia_tri AS tien_nt, bold, iscal, cach_tinh, truy_van, truy_van2, loai_dvt, ids INTO #report
		FROM t02kk
		WHERE form = @Form --TT156

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- Blacklist
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT stt_rec AS ma_ns, loai_tn, loai_tn AS ma_tn, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct, tn_ct_nt AS tn_ct_nt0, tn_ct AS tn_ct0, thue_nt, thue, thue_giam_nt, thue_giam, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS bang INTO #tmp FROM hrt01$0000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key2 OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SET @Key = 'a.ky between ''%mFrom'' and ''%mTo'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF @Key2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @Key2
	
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	IF @Form IN ('3', '5') AND ISNULL(@t_tncn_thuc_chi, '0') = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn, '''', sum(a.cl_tnct_nt), sum(a.cl_tnct)
			, sum(case when (a.cl_thue_nt + a.cl_thue) > 0 then a.cl_tnct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.cl_thue_nt + a.cl_thue) > 0 then a.cl_tnct else 0 end)
			, sum(a.cl_thue_nt), sum(a.cl_thue), sum(a.cl_thue_giam_nt), sum(a.cl_thue_giam), ''t9'''
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrt09 a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where a.nam = '+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%mFrom', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn'
		IF @MonthFrom = 1 AND @Type <> '1' BEGIN
			SET @MonthTo = @MonthTo - 1
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn, '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
				, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
				, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), ''t1'''
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%mFrom', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, '''', '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
				, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
				, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), 0, 0, ''t2'''
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt02$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%mFrom', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by a.stt_rec'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		print @q

		SELECT @Year = CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 1 THEN (@Year - 1) ELSE @Year END
			, @MonthFrom = CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 1 THEN 12 ELSE (@MonthFrom - 1) END
			, @MonthTo = CASE @Type WHEN '1' THEN @MonthFrom ELSE CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 12 THEN @MonthFrom ELSE (@MonthTo - 1) END END
	END
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn, '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
		, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
		, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), ''t1'''
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%mFrom', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.loai_tn'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, '''', '''', sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)
		, sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct_nt else 0 end), sum(case when (a.thue_nt + a.thue) > 0 then a.tn_ct else 0 end)
		, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), 0, 0, ''t2'''
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrt02$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%mFrom', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by a.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, '''', a.ma_tn, sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct), 0, 0, sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), ''t0'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from hrt00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	IF @Join <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @Join
	IF @Key2 <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_tn'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @truy_van VARCHAR(4000), @truy_van2 VARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024), @iscal INT
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', ''), iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = (' + @truy_van + '), tien_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
