CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunGetSemiPrdFromBOMByProduct] @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cPrdRq VARCHAR(32), @dRq SMALLDATETIME, @nQtyRq NUMERIC(28, 6)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nMax INT, @i INT, @nQRound INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @nMax = 1, @i = 0, @nQRound = 8

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_sp, he_so, null AS ngay_yc INTO #phdm FROM phdm
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, tl_hh, tg_th INTO #ctdm FROM ctdm WHERE (ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR ngay_ct1 <= @dVC) AND (ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR ngay_ct2 >= @dVC) AND so_luong <> 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(24, 12)) AS so_luong, ngay_ct AS ngay_yc, 0 AS xmaster, 0 AS xdetail INTO #ctsx FROM ctsx
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, 0 AS stt INTO #t FROM #ctsx

	INSERT INTO #ctsx(ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, xmaster, xdetail) SELECT @cPrdRq, @cPrdRq, 1, @nQtyRq, @dRq, 0, 0

	WHILE (@i < @nMax) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT a.ma_sp, c.ma_vt, b.he_so, ROUND(CASE WHEN b.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (a.so_luong / b.he_so) END *c.he_so*c.so_luong*(1 + c.tl_hh), @nQRound), dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(a.ngay_yc, c.tg_th + 1), a.stt
			FROM #ctsx a JOIN #phdm b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_sp JOIN #ctdm c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE a.xmaster = 0 AND a.ma_vt <> c.ma_vt

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

		UPDATE #ctsx SET xmaster = 1 FROM #ctsx a JOIN #t b ON a.stt = b.stt WHERE a.xmaster = 0
		INSERT INTO #ctsx (ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, xmaster, xdetail) SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, 0, stt FROM #t

		-- Next
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- DELETE #ctsx WHERE xmaster = 1 OR xdetail = 0
	DELETE #ctsx WHERE ma_vt = @cPrdRq

	UPDATE #ctsx SET ngay_yc = dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(@dRq, b.tg_th +1) FROM #ctsx a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	SELECT ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, ngay_yc FROM #ctsx WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE loai_vt IN ('41', '51') AND kieu_hd <> 0) GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_yc ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_yc
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_GetArisingDate]
	@TimeID CHAR(3),
	@d1 SMALLDATETIME OUTPUT,
	@d2 SMALLDATETIME OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @d SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INT

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2), @d = GETDATE() FROM dmstt

	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @d = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@d), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@d), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)
	IF MONTH(@d) >= @month SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@d), @month) ELSE SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@d) - 1, @month)

	SELECT @d1 = CASE @TimeID
		WHEN '001' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '002' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @d), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '003' THEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 2 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d), CAST(@d AS DATETIME)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '004' THEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 2 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d - 7), CAST(@d - 7 AS DATETIME)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '005' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@d)-1),@d), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '006' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@d)-1), @d)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '007' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '008' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '009' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '010' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '011' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '012' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '013' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	END

	SELECT @d2 = CASE @TimeID
		WHEN '001' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '002' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @d), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '003' THEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 8 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d), CAST(@d AS DATETIME)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '004' THEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 8 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d - 7), CAST(@d - 7 AS DATETIME)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '005' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '006' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@d)),@d), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '007' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '008' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '009' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '010' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '011' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '012' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		WHEN '013' THEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
		ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CopySODiscountDetail]
	@cDiscountFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@cDiscountTo VARCHAR(33), 
	@nPercentChange NUMERIC(28, 6), 
	@cFCFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@cFCTo VARCHAR(33), 
	@nExchange NUMERIC(24, 12), 
	@cxSite VARCHAR(33), 
	@cxCust VARCHAR(33), 
	@cxCustGroup VARCHAR(33), 
	@cxItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cxItemGroup VARCHAR(33), 
	@nOver TINYINT, 
	@cDiscount VARCHAR(33), 
	@cSite VARCHAR(33), 
	@cCust VARCHAR(33), 
	@cCustGroup VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup VARCHAR(33), 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME
	
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @cBC VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val)  FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @cBC = @cFCTo SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
		ELSE SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	IF @cFCTo = @cFCFrom SET @nExchange = 1

	SELECT ma_ck, ma_kho, ma_kh, nh_kh9, ma_vt, nh_vt9, so_luong, ma_nt, ngay_hl, tl_ck, tien_ck, dvt, he_so INTO #tdmck2 FROM dmck2 a
		WHERE a.ma_ck LIKE (RTRIM(@cDiscount) + '%') AND a.ma_kho LIKE (RTRIM(@cSite) + '%') AND a.ma_kh LIKE (RTRIM(@cCust) + '%') AND a.nh_kh9 LIKE (RTRIM(@cCustGroup) + '%') AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') AND a.nh_vt9 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup) + '%') AND a.ngay_hl <= @dTo 
			AND a.ma_kho LIKE (RTRIM(@cxSite) + '%') AND a.ma_kh LIKE (RTRIM(@cxCust) + '%') AND a.nh_kh9 LIKE (RTRIM(@cxCustGroup) + '%') AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cxItem) + '%') AND a.nh_vt9 LIKE (RTRIM(@cxItemGroup) + '%') AND a.ma_nt LIKE (RTRIM(@cFCFrom) + '%')
	UPDATE #tdmck2 SET ma_ck = @cDiscountTo
	IF RTRIM(@cFCFrom) <> '' UPDATE #tdmck2 SET ma_nt = @cFCTo, tien_ck = ROUND(tien_ck*@nExchange, @nRound)
	IF @nPercentChange <> 0 UPDATE #tdmck2 SET tl_ck = tl_ck - ROUND(tl_ck*@nPercentChange/100, 2), tien_ck = tien_ck - ROUND(tien_ck*@nPercentChange/100, @nRound)
	IF @nOver = 1 
		DELETE dmck2 FROM dmck2 a JOIN #tdmck2 b ON a.ma_ck = b.ma_ck AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.nh_kh9 = b.nh_kh9 AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.nh_vt9 = b.nh_vt9 AND a.so_luong = b.so_luong AND a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl WHERE b.ma_ck = @cDiscountTo
	ELSE 
		DELETE #tdmck2 FROM #tdmck2 a JOIN dmck2 b ON a.ma_ck = b.ma_ck AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.nh_kh9 = b.nh_kh9 AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.nh_vt9 = b.nh_vt9 AND a.so_luong = b.so_luong AND a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl WHERE b.ma_ck = @cDiscountTo

	INSERT INTO dmck2 (ma_ck, ma_kho, ma_kh, nh_kh9, ma_vt, nh_vt9, so_luong, ma_nt, ngay_hl, tl_ck, tien_ck, dvt, he_so) SELECT * FROM #tdmck2
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFADetail] --fs20_FADetailReport--
	@Period AS INT,
	@Year AS INT,
	@Type AS CHAR(1),
	@FaType AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group NVARCHAR(256),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @Type = '1'
		IF @Period = 1 SELECT @Period = 12, @Year = @Year -1 ELSE SELECT @Period = @Period - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp AS fa_ma_bp
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt
			, b.loai_ts, b.ngay_mua, b.so_ky_kh, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2
		INTO #report FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp as fa_ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt, sum(a.gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt, sum(a.gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(a.gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt, sum(a.gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(a.gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.loai_ts) as loai_ts, max(b.ngay_mua) as ngay_mua, max(b.so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(b.ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(b.ty_gia) as ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_ts)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_ts2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhts a join dmts b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp '
	EXEC sp_executesql 	@q

	-- Ko lên những tài sản đã khai báo giảm trong kỳ
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_giam BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts, fa_ma_bp', 'INT, #, &ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + ', ' + 'so_the_ts'
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'so_the_ts', '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_the_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ten_ts, ten_ts2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from  #report order by ' + CASE WHEN @Group <> '' THEN @Group + ', ' ELSE '' END + 'sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptOtherExpensesJournal] --dt_OthersCostBook
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key1 VARCHAR(1024), @Key2 VARCHAR(1024), @Key3 VARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @nRow INT, @Accounts VARCHAR(4000), @bgDate SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s7 NVARCHAR(511), @s8 NVARCHAR(511), @lk_no_dk_nt NVARCHAR(511), @total NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI001'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI002'
	SELECT @s7 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI007X'
	SELECT @s8 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI008X'
	SELECT @lk_no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AI004X'
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTALAMT'

	SELECT REPLACE(STR(stt, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS syscolumn, tk, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ngan ELSE ten_ngan2 END AS ten_ngan
		INTO #dtsocpkhac FROM dtsocpkhac WHERE RTRIM(form) = @Form
	SELECT @Accounts = '', @bgDate = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom)
	SELECT @Accounts = @Accounts + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM #dtsocpkhac
	SET @Accounts = SUBSTRING(@Accounts, 2, LEN(@Accounts))

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl a

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key1 = 'status = ''1''', @Key2 = ''
	IF @VoucherFrom <> '' SET @Key1 = @Key1 + ' and so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @VoucherTo <> '' SET @Key1 = @Key1 + ' and so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key1 = @Key1 + CASE WHEN @Key1 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_du', 'like', @Account)
	
	-- Dynamic
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
		SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
		IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key1 = @Key1 + CASE WHEN @Key1 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	END
	SET @Key1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key1)
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key3 = 'dbo.ff_IsRelationJob (''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + ''', ma_vv) <> 0'
	IF @Accounts <> '' SET @Key3 = @Key3 + CASE WHEN @Key3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Accounts)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key3 = @Key3 + CASE WHEN @Key3 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key3 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key3)
	SET @Key2 = @Key3
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select 0, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', tk, tk_du, dien_giai, line_nbr, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key1 + CASE WHEN @Key2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Key2 + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @bgDate, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	UPDATE #tmp SET tag = 1 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdvv FROM cdvv
	INSERT INTO #cdvv EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Job @DateFrom, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key3
	
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt INTO #lkvv0 FROM lkvv
	INSERT INTO #lkvv0 EXEC FastBusiness$Accumulate$Job @DateFrom, '', '', NULL, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key3

	SELECT tk, SUM(lk_no) AS lk_no, SUM(lk_no_nt) AS lk_no_nt, SUM(lk_co) AS lk_co, SUM(lk_co_nt) AS lk_co_nt INTO #lkvv FROM #lkvv0 GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', tk, '', '', 0, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt FROM #lkvv0

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS syscolumn, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0
		, tk, tk_du, dien_giai, line_nbr, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct AS ma_ct0 INTO #report FROM #tmp

	DECLARE @acc VARCHAR(32), @syscolumn VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT syscolumn, tk FROM #dtsocpkhac ORDER BY syscolumn, tk
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @syscolumn, @acc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 1, 0, @syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', @acc, '', @s1, 0, SUM(du_no - du_co), SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0, '' FROM #cdvv WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@acc) + '%')
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 1, 0, @syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', @acc, '', @s2, 0, 0, 0, 0, ''
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, @syscolumn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr, CASE WHEN ps_no > 0 THEN ps_no ELSE - ps_co END, CASE WHEN ps_no_nt > 0 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE - ps_co_nt END, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in
			FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE a.tag = 1 AND a.tk LIKE (RTRIM(@acc) + '%')
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @syscolumn, @acc
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	UPDATE #report SET ps = 0 WHERE ps IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ps_nt = 0 WHERE ps_nt IS NULL

	-- Total Arising Amount in Period
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 10, 1, 0, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', MAX(tk), '', @s7, 0, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ps > 0 THEN ps ELSE 0 END), 0), ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ps_nt > 0 THEN ps_nt ELSE 0 END), 0), 0, ''
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn
	-- Other Expenses Allocated to Investments
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 15, 1, 0, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', MAX(tk), '', @s8, 0, ISNULL(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN ps < 0 THEN ps ELSE 0 END)), 0), ISNULL(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN ps_nt < 0 THEN ps_nt ELSE 0 END)), 0), 0, ''
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn
	-- Other Expenses Unallocated to Investments
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 20, 1, 0, a.syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', a.tk, '', @lk_no_dk_nt, 0, a.ps + ISNULL(b.ps, 0) - ISNULL(c.ps, 0), a.ps_nt + ISNULL(b.ps_nt, 0) - ISNULL(c.ps_nt, 0), 0, ''
		FROM (SELECT syscolumn, MAX(tk) AS tk, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn) a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT syscolumn, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 10 GROUP BY syscolumn) b ON a.syscolumn = b.syscolumn
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT syscolumn, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 15 GROUP BY syscolumn) c ON a.syscolumn = c.syscolumn

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SELECT STR(a.sysorder) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + a.ma_ct0 + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec + STR(line_nbr) AS sysRow
			, a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.sysColumn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0
			, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai AS sysRowName, a.ps, a.ps_nt, a.ma_ct0, b.ten_ngan AS sysColumnName
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #dtsocpkhac b ON a.syscolumn = b.syscolumn
		ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.syscolumn

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot (name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'ps' ELSE 'ps_nt' END, @total
	INSERT INTO #pivot (name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'ps$' ELSE 'ps_nt$' END, ten_ngan FROM #dtsocpkhac ORDER BY syscolumn
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id - 1) WHERE id > 1
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$LocationLot]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Site VARCHAR(33),	
	@Location VARCHAR(33),
	@Lot VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing	
	@DataType TINYINT, --1 - Physics, 2 - Book
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@GroupClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@Statement NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @Fields VARCHAR(511), @Groups VARCHAR(511), @Wheres VARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Fields = 'a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt', @Groups = 'a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt', @Wheres = 'b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and b.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri and b.ma_lo = a.ma_lo and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt'
	IF CHARINDEX(', a.ma_vi_tri', @GroupClause) = 0 SELECT @Fields = REPLACE(@Fields, ', a.ma_vi_tri', ', '''''), @Groups = REPLACE(@Groups, ', a.ma_vi_tri', ''), @Wheres = REPLACE(@Wheres, ' and b.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri', '')
	IF CHARINDEX(', a.ma_lo', @GroupClause) = 0 SELECT @Fields = REPLACE(@Fields, ', a.ma_lo', ', '''''), @Groups = REPLACE(@Groups, ', a.ma_lo', ''), @Wheres = REPLACE(@Wheres, ' and b.ma_lo = a.ma_lo', '')
	
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM cdlo

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(@Site, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Location <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vi_tri like ''' + REPLACE(@Location, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Lot <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(@Lot, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Balance (year)
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.ton00), sum(a.du00), sum(a.du_nt00)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @DataType = 1 THEN 'cdlo2' ELSE 'cdlo' END + ' a with (nolock, index(nam)) '

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + 'left join dmkho z on a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho'
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @s = @s + @JoinClause

	SELECT @s = @s + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + '%key'
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SELECT @s = @s + ' group by ' + @Groups

	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%key', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	IF @DataType = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = YEAR(@Date)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, 'cdlo2', 'cdlo'), '%key', ' and not exists(select 1 from cdlo2 b with(nolock) where b.nam = a.nam and ' + @Wheres + ')')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SELECT @Date = @Date - 1

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @JoinClause

		SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END 
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause

		SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by ' + @Groups
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
	END

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) '

		IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by ' + @Groups
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	Result:
	SELECT @q = 'select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, isnull(sum(so_luong), 0) as so_luong, isnull(sum(tien), 0) as tien, isnull(sum(tien_nt), 0) as tien_nt'		
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #t a group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_vi_tri order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalRole]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@status VARCHAR(32),	
	@category VARCHAR(32),
	@role VARCHAR(32) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)
	SELECT TOP 1 @role = RTRIM(a.ma_quyen)
		FROM (SELECT * FROM gndmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN gndmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN gndmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen JOIN gndmttcttg d ON a.loai_duyet = d.loai_duyet AND d.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND c.status = d.u_status
			WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType
				AND a.status = '1'				
				AND a.user_id = @userID
				AND b.status = '1'
				AND c.status = @status
				AND d.status = '1'
				AND c.kieu_duyet = @category

	SELECT @role = ISNULL(@role, '')

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_VendorEvaluationBySemiAuto]
	@ScoreRound INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT a.ma_chi_tieu, kieu_tinh, loai_tinh_diem, b.diem_toi_da, b.diem_toi_thieu INTO #kb FROM #kbct a, #dotdg b WHERE a.kieu_tinh IN ('2', '3')

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kb) RETURN

	-- Manual Criterion
	SELECT b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, b.ma_chi_tieu, b.diem_so, a.kieu_tinh
		INTO #map FROM #kb a JOIN #ngdg b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu 
		WHERE b.ma_ct IN ('P04', 'P05') AND b.ma_vt <> ''

	SELECT ma_kh, ma_vt INTO #khvt FROM #ngdg WHERE nguon_xd IN ('#V1', '#V2', '#V3') GROUP BY ma_kh, ma_vt
	INSERT INTO #map SELECT c.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, b.ma_chi_tieu, b.diem_so, a.kieu_tinh
		FROM #kb a JOIN #ngdg b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu CROSS JOIN #vtdg c
		WHERE b.ma_ct IN ('P05') AND b.ma_vt = '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #khvt x WHERE x.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND x.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kb WHERE kieu_tinh = '2') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, nguon_xd, diem_so1)
			SELECT b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, '#02', 
				CASE WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '1' THEN ROUND(SUM(b.diem_so)/COUNT(*), @ScoreRound)
					WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '2' THEN MAX(b.diem_so) 
					WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '3' THEN MIN(b.diem_so) 
					WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '9' THEN SUM(b.diem_so) 
				ELSE NULL END
			FROM #kb a JOIN #map b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE a.kieu_tinh = '2' GROUP BY a.ma_chi_tieu, b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.loai_tinh_diem 

		UPDATE a SET diem_so1 = b.diem_toi_thieu FROM #kqct a JOIN #kb b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE b.diem_toi_thieu <> 0 AND a.nguon_xd = '#02' AND a.diem_so1 < b.diem_toi_thieu
		UPDATE a SET diem_so1 = b.diem_toi_da FROM #kqct a JOIN #kb b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE b.diem_toi_da <> 0 AND a.nguon_xd = '#02' AND a.diem_so1 > b.diem_toi_da
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kb WHERE kieu_tinh = '3') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, diem_so1, nguon_xd) SELECT ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, diem_so, '#03' FROM #map WHERE kieu_tinh = '3'
	END
	
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_displayoaerror
    @iObject int,
    @iresult int
as

set nocount on

declare @vchOutput      varchar(255)
declare @hr             int
declare @vchSource      varchar(255)
declare @vchDescription varchar(255)

    exec @hr = master.dbo.sp_OAGetErrorInfo @iObject, @vchSource OUT, @vchDescription OUT

    select @vchOutput = @vchSource + ': ' + @vchDescription
    raiserror (@vchOutput,16,-1)

    return




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptLoanContractStatusSummary]	-- fs20_KUbcthtv
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@ContractType CHAR(1),
	@LoanContract VARCHAR(33),
	@Job VARCHAR(33),
	@Contract VARCHAR(33),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023)
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku, tk, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) ngay_vay, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) ngay_dh
			, ps_no AS du_dk, ps_no AS ps_no, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_no AS du_ck
			, ps_no_nt AS du_dk_nt, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt, ps_no_nt AS du_ck_nt
		INTO #ReportTmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, * INTO #Report FROM #ReportTmp

	-- @Key
	SET @Key2 = ''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @LoanContract <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@LoanContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = 'a.tinh_trang in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''') and a.loai_ku = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + @Key2	
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	IF @ContractType = '1' BEGIN
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SET @q = 'insert into #ReportTmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select b.ma_ku, b.tk, max(a.ngay_ku1), max(a.ngay_ku2), 0, sum(b.ps_no), sum(b.ps_co), 0, 0, sum(b.ps_no_nt), sum(b.ps_co_nt), 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dmku a join r00$%partition b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by b.ma_ku, b.tk'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin		
	END ELSE BEGIN 
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SET @q = 'insert into #ReportTmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select b.ma_ku, b.tk, max(a.ngay_ku1), max(a.ngay_ku2), 0, sum(b.ps_co), sum(b.ps_no), 0, 0, sum(b.ps_co_nt), sum(b.ps_no_nt), 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dmku a join r00$%partition b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by b.ma_ku, b.tk'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin		
	END

	INSERT INTO #Report SELECT 5, 1, 1, ma_ku, tk, max(ngay_vay), max(ngay_dh), 0, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), 0, 0, sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), 0 FROM #ReportTmp GROUP BY ma_ku, tk

	-- Chèn dữ liệu không xảy ra nghiệp vụ thu chi nào
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku, tk, Ps_no AS Du, Ps_no_nt AS Du_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_ku, a.tk, sum(du_no00 - du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdku a with(nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_ku)) '
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@DateFrom)) + ' and ma_ku <> '''''
	SET @q = @q + @Key2 + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_ku'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Phat sinh
	DECLARE @bgDate SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @bgDate = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateFrom)
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ma_ku, tk, sum(ps_no - ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q +' from r00$%partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q +' where %[status = ''1'' and ma_ku <> ''''' + @Key2 + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q +' group by ma_ku, tk'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @bgDate, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT ma_ku, tk, SUM(Du) Du, SUM(Du_nt) Du_nt INTO #dk1 FROM #tmp GROUP BY ma_ku, tk
	--
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and not exists (select x.* from #Report x where x.ma_ku = a.ma_ku and x.tk = a.tk)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (b.du <> 0 or b.du_nt <> 0)'
	SET @q = ' insert into #Report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_ku, tk, ngay_vay, ngay_dh, du_dk, ps_no, ps_co, du_ck, du_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_ck_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select distinct 5, 1, 1, a.ma_ku, a.tk, a.ngay_ku1, a.ngay_ku2, abs(b.du), 0, 0, abs(b.du), abs(b.du_nt), 0, 0, abs(b.du_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmku a join #dk1 b on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #tBg (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	CREATE TABLE #tEd (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))

	-- Tính lại số dư
	DECLARE @ma_ku2 VARCHAR(33), @cAcc2 VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE Cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_ku, tk FROM #Report WHERE du_dk = 0 AND du_dk_nt = 0
	OPEN Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @ma_ku2, @cAcc2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT #tBg EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$BContract @DateFrom, @Unit, @cAcc2, @ma_ku2, @ContractType, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
		UPDATE #Report SET du_dk = ISNULL(a.du, 0), du_dk_nt = ISNULL(a.du_nt, 0)
			FROM #tBg a WHERE ma_ku =  @ma_ku2 AND tk = @cAcc2
		
		INSERT #tEd EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$BContract @DateTo, @Unit, @cAcc2, @ma_ku2, @ContractType, 2, 1, @UserID, @Admin
		UPDATE #Report SET du_ck = ISNULL(a.du, 0), du_ck_nt = ISNULL(a.Du_nt, 0)
			FROM #tEd a WHERE ma_ku = @ma_ku2 AND tk = @cAcc2
		
		DELETE FROM #tBg
		DELETE FROM #tEd
		FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @ma_ku2, @cAcc2
	END
	CLOSE Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cur

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 sysprint FROM #Report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #Report VALUES (0, 0, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		SELECT *, '' ten_tk, '' ten_tk2, '' ten_ku, '' ten_ku2, '' ma_ku FROM #Report
	END ELSE
		SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk2
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_ku ELSE '' END AS ten_ku, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN c.ten_ku ELSE '' END AS ten_ku2
			FROM #Report a 
					LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
					LEFT JOIN dmku c ON a.ma_ku = c.ma_ku
			ORDER BY a.tk, c.ngay_ku1, a.ma_ku
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_CheckColumnExists (@FieldKey VARCHAR(30), @cTable VARCHAR(30))
RETURNS TINYINT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nReturn TINYINT
	IF EXISTS(SELECT b.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE a.name = @FieldKey AND b.name = @cTable)
		SELECT @nReturn = 1
	ELSE
		SELECT @nReturn = 0
	RETURN @nReturn
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptManagementObjectsBalance]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 	
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 
	@ObjectType TINYINT, 
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ObjectCode VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT  
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @s NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @f VARCHAR(32), @objTable VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @f = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = CASE @ObjectType WHEN 1 THEN '04' WHEN 2 THEN '05' WHEN 3 THEN '06' END
	SELECT @objTable = CASE @ObjectType WHEN 1 THEN 'dmdtqt1' WHEN 2 THEN 'dmdtqt2' WHEN 3 THEN 'dmdtqt3' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_dtqt, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt,
			ma_dtqt, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #t

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.tk <> '''''
	IF @ObjectCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.' + RTRIM(@f) + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @ObjectGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_dtqt1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ObjectGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_dtqt2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ObjectGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_dtqt3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''	
	IF @ObjectGroup1 + @ObjectGroup2 + @ObjectGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join ' + @objTable + ' b on a.' + RTRIM(@f) + ' = b.ma_dtqt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	INSERT INTO #t EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$ManagementObject @ObjectType, @f, @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @ObjectCode, @BalanceType, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , a.ma_dtqt, sum(du_no) as du_no, sum(du_no_nt) as du_no_nt, sum(du_co) as du_co, sum(du_co_nt) as du_co_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''V'' then max(b.ten_dtqt) else '''' end as ten'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , case when ''' + @Language + ''' <> ''V'' then max(b.ten_dtqt2) else '''' end as ten2'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #t a left join ' + @objTable + ' b on a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dtqt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ABS(du_no) + ABS(du_no_nt) + ABS(du_co) + ABS(du_co_nt) = 0
	DELETE #report WHERE ma_dtqt = ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten, ten2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_dtqt INTO #o FROM #report ORDER BY ma_dtqt
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt

	-- Total
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten, ten2, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	-- Result
	SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, ma_dtqt, ten AS ten_dtqt, ten2 AS ten_dtqt2, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, stt	

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrphepbp] AS
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.so_phep, a.ngay_hl, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2 FROM hrphepbp a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunItemForecast] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dM SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nQRound INT, @i INT, @stt INT
	DECLARE @nBackwardConsumptionDays INT, @nForwardConsumptionDays INT, @nForecastPastDueDays INT, @nSOPastDueDays INT, @d0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Count INT, @m INT, @y INT, @p VARCHAR(6), @dtable VARCHAR(33), @mtable VARCHAR(33), @dBegin SMALLDATETIME, @d1 VARCHAR(8)

	DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3), @ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @dbngay_ct1 SMALLDATETIME, @dbngay_ct2 SMALLDATETIME, @dbso_luong NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDementQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @dBack SMALLDATETIME, @dForward SMALLDATETIME, @nNonWorkingDays INT, @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

	SELECT @nForecastPastDueDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_db_hh'
	SELECT @nSOPastDueDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_dh_hh'

	SELECT @dBegin = @dNow - @nSOPastDueDays, @d0 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, 0, 0)
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dBegin, 112)

	-- SO
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_da_yc, stt_rec, stt_rec0 INTO #d64 FROM d64$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #p64 FROM c64$000000
	INSERT INTO #p64(m, y) SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct) FROM c64$000000 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dBegin AND @dM
	SELECT @i = 1, @Count = MAX(stt) FROM #p64

	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @m = m, @y = y FROM #p64 WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @p = RTRIM(@y) + REPLACE(STR(@m, 2), ' ', '0')
		SELECT @dtable = 'd64$' + @p, @mtable = 'm64$' + @p

		SET @q = 'insert into #d64 select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, case when a.ngay_giao is null then a.ngay_ct else a.ngay_giao end, a.so_ct, round((case when a.so_luong > a.sl_xuat then a.so_luong - a.sl_xuat else 0 end)*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.so_luong*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_xuat*a.he_so, @nQRound), a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0'
			+ ' from ' + @dtable + ' a join ' + @mtable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.status in (''2'', ''4'') and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d1 + ''''
			+ ' and ((a.ngay_giao is null and a.ngay_ct >= @dNow) or (a.ngay_giao is not null and a.ngay_giao >= @dNow))'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@nQRound', @nQRound)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow smalldatetime', @dNow

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	DELETE #d64 WHERE ngay_ct < @d0 OR ngay_ct > @dM

	-- Allocation
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_db INTO #ctdb FROM mdbbh

	SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, ROUND(so_luong*he_so, @nQRound) AS so_luong, ma_vt + ma_kho + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_ct1, 112) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_ct2, 112) AS ma_pb, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct1) AS ky_hd
		INTO #mdbbh FROM mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dM AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #dmvt)


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcthsdb WHERE ma_ky = @cDefaultPeriod) BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS ky, stt, he_so INTO #hs FROM mcthsdb WHERE ma_ky = @cDefaultPeriod ORDER BY stt

		SELECT a.ma_pb, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ngay_ct1, a.ngay_ct2, a.so_luong, b.ky, b.he_so, a.ky_hd
			INTO #hspb FROM #mdbbh a CROSS JOIN #hs b WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #dmvt)

		SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable('#mdbbh', 'ma_pb', 'so_luong', '#hspb', 'he_so', 'ky', '1=1', 3)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #hspb SET ngay_ct1 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, ngay_ct1, ky - 1, 0), ngay_ct2 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, ngay_ct1, ky - 1, 1)

		-- Start Period
		DECLARE @nStartPeriodCount INT, @dStartPeriod SMALLDATETIME
		SELECT @dStartPeriod = MIN(ngay_ct1) FROM #hspb WHERE ky_hd = 0
		IF @dStartPeriod IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @nStartPeriodCount = dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dStartPeriod, @dNow)
			IF @nStartPeriodCount > 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #hspb SET ky = ky - @nStartPeriodCount WHERE ky_hd = 0 AND ngay_ct1 < @dNow
				UPDATE #hspb SET ky = 0 WHERE ky < 0 AND ngay_ct1 < @dNow
			END
		END -- End Start Period

		INSERT INTO #ctdb(ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong, sl_db)
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, SUM(so_luong), SUM(so_luong) FROM #hspb GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #mdbbh SET ngay_ct1 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd, 0), ngay_ct2 = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd, 1)
		INSERT INTO #ctdb(ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong, sl_db)
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, SUM(so_luong), SUM(so_luong) FROM #mdbbh GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2
	END

	DELETE #mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 > @dNow
	DELETE #ctdb WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dNow + @nForecastPastDueDays + 1
	-- End Allocation

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kieu_db' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(val)) = '0') -- Sales Forecast Only
		DELETE #d64
	ELSE 	-- Forecast Consumers Sales Orders
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nBackwardConsumptionDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_db_qh'
			SELECT @nForwardConsumptionDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_db_dh'

			DECLARE crSalesOrder CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_ct FROM #d64 WHERE ngay_ct > @dNow ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0
			OPEN crSalesOrder
			FETCH NEXT FROM crSalesOrder INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @so_luong, @ngay_ct
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nDementQty = @so_luong

					-- Backward & Forward Consumption Days
					SELECT @dTo = @ngay_ct, @dFrom = DATEADD(day, - @nBackwardConsumptionDays, @ngay_ct)
					WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
						BEGIN
							SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
							SELECT @dTo = @dFrom -1
							SELECT @dFrom = @dFrom - @nNonWorkingDays
						END
					SELECT @dBack = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @dFrom), 0)

					SELECT @dFrom = @ngay_ct, @dTo = DATEADD(day, @nForwardConsumptionDays, @ngay_ct)
					WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
						BEGIN
							SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
							SELECT @dFrom = @dTo + 1
							SELECT @dTo = @dTo + @nNonWorkingDays
						END
					SELECT @dForward = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @dTo), 1)

					-- Backward Consumption
					DECLARE crBackwardConsumption CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong FROM #ctdb WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND (ngay_ct1 BETWEEN @dBack AND @ngay_ct) AND so_luong > 0 ORDER BY ngay_ct1 DESC
					OPEN crBackwardConsumption
					FETCH NEXT FROM crBackwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							IF @nDementQty <= @dbso_luong
								BEGIN
									UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = @dbso_luong - @nDementQty WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
									SELECT @nDementQty = 0
									BREAK
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = 0 WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
									SELECT @nDementQty = @nDementQty - @dbso_luong
								END
							--
							FETCH NEXT FROM crBackwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
						END
					CLOSE crBackwardConsumption
					DEALLOCATE crBackwardConsumption

					-- Forward Consumption
					IF @nDementQty > 0
						BEGIN
							DECLARE crForwardConsumption CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong FROM #ctdb WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 > @ngay_ct AND ngay_ct1 <= @dForward AND so_luong > 0 ORDER BY ngay_ct1
							OPEN crForwardConsumption
							FETCH NEXT FROM crForwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								BEGIN
									IF @nDementQty <= @dbso_luong
										BEGIN
											UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = @dbso_luong - @nDementQty WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
											SELECT @nDementQty = 0
											BREAK
										END
									ELSE
										BEGIN
											UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = 0 WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
											SELECT @nDementQty = @nDementQty - @dbso_luong
										END
									--
									FETCH NEXT FROM crForwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
								END
							CLOSE crForwardConsumption
							DEALLOCATE crForwardConsumption
						END

					UPDATE #d64 SET so_luong = @nDementQty WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0 AND 1 = 0
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crSalesOrder INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @so_luong, @ngay_ct
				END

			CLOSE crSalesOrder
			DEALLOCATE crSalesOrder
			DELETE #d64 WHERE so_luong = 0
			DELETE #ctdb WHERE so_luong = 0 AND sl_db = 0
		END


	-- Update Detail
	DELETE mpctyc WHERE nguon IN ('SF', 'SO')
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'SF', '', ma_vt, ngay_ct1
				, NULL
				, 0, so_luong
				, 0, sl_db
				, 0, 0, 0, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, '', '', 2, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #ctdb

	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'SO', '', ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, 0, so_luong
				, 0, 0
				, 0, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_ct, '', 2, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d64
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_GetUnitInfo] -- Lấy đvcs đưa vào combobox trên form
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM dbreports WHERE xtype = '00' AND ccode = '001'

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @q = 'select rtrim(ma_dvcs) as ma_dvcs, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'ten_dvcs' ELSE 'ten_dvcs2' END + ' as ten_dvcs into #dvcs from dmdvcs'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @UnitKey END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #dvcs(ma_dvcs, ten_dvcs) values ('''', N''' + @s + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #dvcs order by ma_dvcs'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CreateINDeffTrans]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(33), 
	@item VARCHAR(33), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@itemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT,
	@userID INT, 
	@admin TINYINT,
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = '', 
	@itemTable VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@siteTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) RETURN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @round TINYINT, @fcRound TINYINT, @maxIDLine INT, @isFC TINYINT, @autoUpdate TINYINT, @m_gia_cl_x0 TINYINT, @description NVARCHAR(511), @key NVARCHAR(1024), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, 
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @dynTable VARCHAR(64), @d SMALLDATETIME, @k VARCHAR(512), @j VARCHAR(512), 
		@ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(33), @ma_lo VARCHAR(33), 
		@tien_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @line_nbr NUMERIC(5), @nID NUMERIC(5), 
		@xIDNumber CHAR(13), @xIDLineNumber CHAR(3), @xcVC CHAR(3), @ws CHAR(1), 
		@idNumber CHAR(13), @vcNumber VARCHAR(33), @unitCode VARCHAR(33), 
		@xtk VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(33), @tk_dl VARCHAR(33), @tk_cl_vt VARCHAR(33), @glID NUMERIC(5), @idLine CHAR(3), 
		@c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @c3 VARCHAR(32), @multiple INT		


	-- Set
	SELECT @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dFrom)
	SELECT @description = dien_giai FROM v20dmdg WHERE ma_ct = @vcDeffCode
	SELECT @multiple = CASE WHEN MONTH(@dFrom) = MONTH(@dTo) AND YEAR(@dFrom) = YEAR(@dTo) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
	SELECT @description = ISNULL(@description, '')

	SELECT @round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @fcRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'
	SELECT @isFC = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_TB_NT' 
	SELECT @autoUpdate = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_CL'
	SELECT @m_gia_cl_x0 = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_CL_X0'
	SELECT @ws = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_WS_ID'

	SELECT @vcNumber = REPLACE(STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0')
	SET @vcNumber = dbo.ff_PadL(@vcNumber, dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct'))
	--SELECT @idNumber = @ws + CAST(@costType AS CHAR(1)) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + @vcDeffCode
	SELECT @idNumber = @ws + CAST(@costType AS CHAR(1)) + CONVERT(CHAR(4), @dTo, 12) + REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(SECOND, GETDATE()), 2), ' ', '0') + LEFT(RTRIM(DATEPART(MILLISECOND, GETDATE())), 2) + @vcDeffCode

	SElECT @q = 'select @nID = max(line_nbr), @idLine = max(stt_rec0) from r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@nID numeric(5) output, @idLine char(3) output', @nID OUTPUT, @idLine OUTPUT
	IF @nID IS NULL SELECT @nID = 0
	IF @idLine IS NULL SET @idLine = '000'
	
	SELECT @k = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''''
	

	-- Struct
	IF @itemTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #xItem FROM dmvt
		SELECT @key = ' gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
		IF @item <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @itemType <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xItem select ma_vt from dmvt where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @itemTable = '#xItem'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xItem(ma_vt)
	END

	IF @site = '' AND @siteGroup = '' SELECT @siteTable = 'dmkho'
	ELSE IF @siteTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho INTO #xSite FROM dmkho
		SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @site <> '' THEN 'ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%''' ELSE '' END
		IF @siteGroup <> '' SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@siteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xSite select ma_kho from dmkho where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @siteTable = '#xSite'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xSite(ma_kho)

	END

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tbin FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tbgl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap AS ton_cuoi, tien_nhap AS du_cuoi, tien_nt_n AS du_cuoi_nt INTO #tb0 FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #vtx FROM wrkin

	SELECT @j = ' join ' + @itemTable + ' b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @siteTable <> 'dmkho' SELECT @j = @j + ' join ' + @siteTable + ' c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'

	-- Skip
	IF @deffType = 0 GOTO Adj



	-- 10074
	IF @itemTable <> '' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tinh_x0' AND val = '1') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_vt' AND val = '1')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tinh_x1' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #yItem FROM dmvt
		SELECT @key = ' gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
		IF @item <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @itemType <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #yItem select ma_vt from dmvt where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @itemTable + ' select distinct a.ma_vt from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join #yItem b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt join ' + @siteTable + ' c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[(a.nxt = 1 or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd = 1)) and not exists(select 1 from ' + @itemTable + ' d where d.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dTo, @userID, @admin	
	END



	-- Closing
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tb0 select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, sum(a.ton00), sum(a.du00), sum(a.du_nt00) from cdlo a with (index(nam)) ' + @j
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dFrom)) + ' group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tb0 select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x) from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @j + 
		' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39) + ']% group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dTo, @userID, @admin	

	SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl_nt, SUM(ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt INTO #tb
		FROM #tb0 GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo

	-- Remove
	IF @siteType = 1 AND @m_gia_cl_x0 = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #vtx0 FROM #vtx

		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @multiple = 1 THEN '#vtx0' ELSE '#vtx' END + ' select distinct a.ma_vt from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @j + ' where %[a.nxt = 2]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dTo, @userID, @admin

		IF @multiple = 1 INSERT INTO #vtx SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #vtx0

		CREATE INDEX i ON #vtx(ma_vt)
		DELETE #tb FROM #tb a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vtx b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
	END

	IF @isFC = 1 DELETE #tb WHERE ABS(ton_cuoi) + ABS(du_cuoi) + ABS(du_cuoi_nt) = 0
		ELSE DELETE #tb WHERE ABS(ton_cuoi) + ABS(du_cuoi) = 0


	IF @deffType = 1 BEGIN
		DELETE #tb WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0
		UPDATE #tb SET tien_cl = du_cuoi, tien_cl_nt = du_cuoi_nt

	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @siteType = 2
			UPDATE #tb SET tien_cl = CASE WHEN b.gia IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN a.ton_cuoi = 0 THEN a.du_cuoi ELSE a.du_cuoi/a.ton_cuoi END ELSE a.du_cuoi - ROUND(ton_cuoi * b.gia, @round) END, tien_cl_nt = CASE WHEN b.gia_nt IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN a.ton_cuoi = 0 THEN a.du_cuoi_nt ELSE a.du_cuoi_nt/a.ton_cuoi END ELSE a.du_cuoi_nt - ROUND(ton_cuoi * b.gia_nt, @fcRound) END
				FROM #tb a LEFT JOIN #wrkstkprice b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho			
		ELSE
			UPDATE #tb SET tien_cl = CASE WHEN b.gia IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN a.ton_cuoi = 0 THEN a.du_cuoi ELSE a.du_cuoi/a.ton_cuoi END ELSE a.du_cuoi - ROUND(ton_cuoi * b.gia, @round) END, tien_cl_nt = CASE WHEN b.gia_nt IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN a.ton_cuoi = 0 THEN a.du_cuoi_nt ELSE a.du_cuoi_nt/a.ton_cuoi END ELSE a.du_cuoi_nt - ROUND(ton_cuoi * b.gia_nt, @fcRound) END
				FROM #tb a LEFT JOIN #wrkstkprice b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	END

	IF @isFC = 1 DELETE #tb WHERE tien_cl = 0 AND tien_cl_nt = 0
		ELSE DELETE #tb WHERE tien_cl = 0

	--
	IF @autoUpdate = 1 BEGIN	
		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_nt, a.so_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc INTO #issue0 FROM wrkin a, dmct b	
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_nt INTO #issue FROM wrkin
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #issue0 (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_nt, so_ct, stt_ct_nkc) select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, a.ma_nt, a.so_ct, t.stt_ct_nkc from r70$%Partition a join dmct t on a.ma_ct = t.ma_ct ' + @j + 		
			' where %[a.ct_dc = 0 and a.nxt = 2 and a.ma_ct <> ''PXG'' and a.px_gia_dd = 0]%' + 
			' order by a.ngay_ct desc, t.stt_ct_nkc desc, a.ma_ct desc, a.so_ct desc'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin

		INSERT INTO #issue (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_nt)
			SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_nt FROM #issue0 ORDER BY ngay_ct DESC, stt_ct_nkc DESC, ma_ct DESC, so_ct DESC


		SELECT MIN(stt) AS stt, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo INTO #stt FROM #issue GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo
		SELECT a.*, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl_nt INTO #lastIssue FROM #issue a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt b WHERE a.stt = b.stt)
		CREATE INDEX i ON #lastIssue(stt_rec, stt_rec0)


		UPDATE #lastIssue SET tien_cl = b.tien_cl, tien_cl_nt = b.tien_cl_nt FROM #lastIssue a JOIN #tb b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
		--UPDATE ct70 SET tien_xuat = a.tien_xuat + b.tien_cl, tien_nt_x = a.tien_nt_x + b.tien_cl_nt FROM ct70 a WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) JOIN #lastIssue b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
		--	WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo

		-- r70
		SELECT @r = 'update @ctable set tien_xuat = a.tien_xuat + b.tien_cl, tien_nt_x = a.tien_nt_x + b.tien_cl_nt' + 
			' from @ctable a join #lastIssue b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'

		SELECT @d = @dFrom	
		WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @dynTable = 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112)
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '@ctable', @dynTable)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			
			SET @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
		END

		UPDATE #lastIssue SET tien_cl_nt = tien_cl WHERE ma_nt = ''
		SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien_cl) AS tien_cl, SUM(tien_cl_nt) AS tien_cl_nt INTO #mIssue FROM #lastIssue GROUP BY stt_rec


		CREATE INDEX i ON #mIssue(stt_rec)
		SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) AS c INTO #p FROM #lastIssue
		SELECT @c1 = MIN(c + ma_ct) FROM #p
		WHILE @c1 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @c2 = m$ + LEFT(@c1, 6), @c3 = d$ + LEFT(@c1, 6) FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = RIGHT(@c1, 3)
			SELECT @q = 'update ' + @c3 + ' set tien = a.tien + b.tien_cl, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_cl_nt from ' + @c3 + ' a join #lastIssue b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 
				'update ' + @c2 + ' set t_tien = a.t_tien + b.tien_cl, t_tien_nt = a.t_tien_nt + b.tien_cl_nt from ' + @c2 + ' a join #mIssue b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'

			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @c1 = MIN(c + ma_ct) FROM #p WHERE c + ma_ct > @c1
		END
		--


		CREATE INDEX o ON #lastIssue(ma_vt, ma_kho)
		--DELETE #tb FROM #tb a JOIN #lastIssue b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
		DELETE #tb FROM #tb a JOIN #lastIssue b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
	END			



	--
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt INTO #pxcl FROM #tb ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo
	INSERT INTO #tbin (stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, nxt, px_gia_dd, ngay_ct, 
			ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, tien_xuat,
			tk_vt, 
			tk_du, tien_nt_x, 
			line_nbr, 
			ma_dvcs, 
			stt_rec0, 
			dvt1, he_so1)
		SELECT @idNumber, @vcDeffCode, @vcNumber, 2, 1, @dTo, 
				a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.tien_cl, 
				CASE WHEN c.dai_ly_yn = 0 THEN b.tk_vt ELSE CASE WHEN b.tk_dl = '' THEN b.tk_vt ELSE b.tk_dl END END, 
				b.tk_cl_vt, @isFC * a.tien_cl_nt, a.stt + @nID, 
				c.ma_dvcs, 
				dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(dbo.ff_Seq2Dec(@idLine) + stt), 
				b.dvt, 1
			FROM #pxcl a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho

	--
	UPDATE #tbin SET ngay_lct = ngay_ct, gia_nt0 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, gia0 = 0, tien0 = 0, gia01 = 0, gia_nt01 = 0, ct_dc = 0, pn_gia_tb = 0, so_seri = '', ma_khon = '', 
		gia_nt21 = 0, gia21 = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, gia2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, tien2 = 0, tk_gv = '', tk_dt = '', cp_nt = 0, cp = 0, thue_suat_nk = 0, nk_nt = 0, nk = 0, tk_thue_nk = '', ma_tt = '', 
		cp_thue_yn = 0, thue_suat = 0, thue_nt = 0, thue = 0, tk_thue_no = '', tk_thue_co = '', ck_nt = 0, ck = 0, tk_ck = '', 
		so_dh2 = '', so_dh3 = '', ma_nvbh = '', sl_nhap= 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia1 = 0, gia_nt1 = 0, 
		stt_rec_pn = '', stt_rec0pn = '', stt_rec_px = '', stt_rec0px = '', stt_rec_dc = '', so_ct0 = '', so_seri0 = '', status = '1', ty_gia = 0, ma_nt = '', 
		ma_nk = '', so_lo = '', ma_kh = '', ma_vi_trin = '', ong_ba = '', ma_nv = '', stt_rec_yc = '', stt_rec0yc = '', tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, 
		loai_ct = '7', ma_gd = '7', 
		cp_vc_nt = 0, cp_bh_nt = 0, cp_khac_nt = 0, cp_vc = 0, cp_bh = 0, cp_khac = 0, thue_suat_ttdb = 0, ttdb_nt = 0, ttdb = 0, tk_thue_ttdb = '', 
		ma_vv = '', ma_sp = '', ma_bp = '', so_lsx = '', ma_ku = '', ma_hd = '', ma_phi = '', ma_td1 = '', ma_td2 = '', ma_td3 = '', 
		sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0, gc_td1 = '', gc_td2 = '', gc_td3 = '', s1 = '', s2 = '', s3 = '', s4 = 0, s5 = 0, s6 = 0, 
		dien_giai = @description, stt_rec0 = REPLACE(dbo.ff_PadL(stt_rec0, 3), ' ', '0'), ma_nx = '',  tk_du = CASE WHEN ISNULL(tk_du, '') = '' THEN @deffAcct ELSE tk_du END, 
		user_id0 = @userID, user_id2 = @userID, datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE()


	--EXEC fs_DeleteINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item,  @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @siteGroup, @updateType

	--INSERT INTO ct70 SELECT * FROM #tbin

	-- Insert into r70
	SELECT @q = 'insert into r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' select * from #tbin'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


Adj:
	IF @updateType <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, tien_xuat AS tien, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, stt_rec0 AS nh_dk INTO #tpxf FROM wrkin
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, tien, tien_nt, nh_dk INTO #pxf FROM #tpxf
		
		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @multiple = 1 THEN '#tpxf' ELSE '#pxf' END + ' (ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, tien, tien_nt, nh_dk) select ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_x), max(stt_rec0)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition with(nolock) where %[ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@vcDeffCode, '''', '') + ''' and substring(stt_rec, 2, 1) = ' + STR(@costType, 1) + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du ' + CASE WHEN @multiple = 0 THEN ' having sum(abs(tien_xuat)) + sum(abs(tien_nt_x)) <> 0' ELSE '' END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin

		IF @multiple = 1 
			INSERT INTO #pxf (ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, tien, tien_nt, nh_dk) 
				SELECT ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), MAX(nh_dk) FROM #tpxf GROUP BY ma_dvcs, tk_vt, tk_du HAVING SUM(ABS(tien)) + SUM(ABS(tien_nt)) <> 0

		INSERT INTO #tbgl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, so_ct, ct_nxt, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, line_nbr, nh_dk)			
			SELECT @idNumber, ma_dvcs, @vcDeffCode, @vcNumber, 1, @dTo, @dTo, tk_du, tk_vt, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, stt, nh_dk FROM #pxf

		INSERT INTO #tbgl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, so_ct, ct_nxt, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, line_nbr, nh_dk)			
			SELECT @idNumber, ma_dvcs, @vcDeffCode, @vcNumber, 1, @dTo, @dTo, tk_vt, tk_du, 0, 0, tien, tien_nt, stt + 1, nh_dk FROM #pxf

		UPDATE #tbgl SET ngay_lct = ngay_ct, ty_gia = 0, ma_nt = '', ma_vv = '', ma_sp = '', ma_bp = '', so_lsx = '', ma_ku = '', ma_hd = '', ma_phi = '', ma_td1 = '', ma_td2 = '', ma_td3 = '', so_lo = '', 
			loai_ct = '7', so_ctgs = '', ong_ba = '', dien_giai = @description, ma_kh = '', ma_nk = '', so_ct0 = '', ma_gd = '7', status = '1', so_dh = '', 
			sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0, gc_td1 = '', gc_td2 = '', gc_td3 = '', s1 = '', s2 = '', s3 = '', s4 = 0, s5 = 0, s6 = 0, 
			user_id0 = @userID, user_id2 = @userID, datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE()

		--
		UPDATE #tbgl SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tbgl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		UPDATE #tbgl SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tbgl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk
		--
		--INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #tbgl
		
		-- Insert into r00
		SELECT @q = 'insert into r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' select * from #tbgl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
