CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rpt03KK] --ts_Rpt03KK_28
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - month, 2 - quarter
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @MonthFrom INT, @MonthTo INT

	IF @Type = '1' SELECT @MonthFrom = @Month, @MonthTo = @Month
		ELSE SELECT @MonthFrom = (@Month * 3 - 2), @MonthTo = (@Month * 3)

	SELECT 1 AS systotal, stt, stt_in, ma_so, ma_so_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu2
			, gia_tri AS tien, gia_tri AS tien_nt, bold, iscal, cach_tinh, truy_van, truy_van2, ids, nhom INTO #report
		FROM t03kk
		WHERE form = @Form --TT156

	SELECT systotal, ma_so, tien AS luy_ke, tien_nt AS luy_ke_nt INTO #lk FROM #report -- TT92

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- Blacklist
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt, thue_nt, thue, thue_giam_nt, thue_giam, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct INTO #tmp FROM t01$0000 a

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.ky between %k and ' + RTRIM(@MonthTo)
	IF @Department <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_bp INTO #t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$TaxDepartment(@Department)
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_bp in (select ma_bp from #t)', @Join = @Join + ' left join phns b with(nolock) on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns'
	END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn, sum(a.tn_tt_nt), sum(a.tn_tt), sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from t01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%k', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)) + ' group by a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	

	DECLARE @truy_van VARCHAR(4000), @truy_van2 VARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @stt VARCHAR(10), @cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024), @iscal INT
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' OR truy_van <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = (' + @truy_van + '), tien_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien = 0 where tien is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien_nt = 0 where tien_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
				+ ', tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien_nt from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
				+ ', systotal = 0 where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	END
	CLOSE cur
	DEALLOCATE cur

	-- TT92
	IF @Form IN ('3', '5') BEGIN
		IF @MonthTo > 1 BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tmp
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn, sum(a.tn_tt_nt), sum(a.tn_tt), sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_giam_nt), sum(a.thue_giam), sum(a.tn_ct_nt), sum(a.tn_ct)'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from t01$'+ RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%k', '1') + ' group by a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DECLARE cur2 CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' OR truy_van <> '' ORDER BY ids
			OPEN cur2
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur2 INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update #lk set luy_ke = (' + @truy_van + '), luy_ke_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
					SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #lk set luy_ke = 0 where luy_ke is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #lk set luy_ke_nt = 0 where luy_ke_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update #lk set luy_ke = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select luy_ke from #lk where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
						+ ', luy_ke_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select luy_ke_nt from #lk where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
						+ ', systotal = 0 where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
				FETCH NEXT FROM cur2 INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
			END
			CLOSE cur2
			DEALLOCATE cur2
		END ELSE
			UPDATE #lk SET luy_ke = b.tien, luy_ke_nt = b.tien_nt FROM #lk a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
	END
Result:
	SELECT a.systotal, a.stt_in, a.ma_so_in as ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.bold, a.nhom, a.chi_tieu, a.chi_tieu2, b.luy_ke, b.luy_ke_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN #lk b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so ORDER BY a.stt, a.ma_so

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_AfterUpdateGL]
	@cIDVoucher CHAR(13), 
	@cMTable CHAR(10), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@nUserID INT,
	@Datetime2 DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id WHERE a.name = 'dien_giai' AND a.xtype IN (239, 231) AND b.name = @cMTable	) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update ct00 set dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai from ct00 a with(index(stt_rec)) join ' + @cMTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
			' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @cIDVoucher + ''' and a.ma_ct = ''' + @cVoucher + '''' + ' and isnull(a.dien_giai_h, '''') = '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	IF @cVoucher IN ('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD4', 'HD6', 'HD2', 'HDF', 'HD3') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update ct00 set ' + RTRIM(field) + ' = b.ma_nvbh from ct00 a with(index(stt_rec)) join ' + @cMTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
			' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @cIDVoucher + ''' and a.ma_ct = ''' + @cVoucher + ''''
			FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '01'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	UPDATE ct00 SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, 
			ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END
		FROM ct00 a WITH(INDEX(stt_rec)) JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @cIDVoucher AND a.ma_ct = @cVoucher

	UPDATE ct00 SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, 
			ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END
		FROM ct00 a WITH(INDEX(stt_rec)) JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @cIDVoucher AND a.ma_ct = @cVoucher
	--
	IF @Datetime2 IS NOT NULL
		UPDATE ct00 SET user_id2 = @nUserID, datetime2 = @Datetime2
			WHERE stt_rec = @cIDVoucher AND ma_ct = @cVoucher

END

GO


CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vmpdh]
AS
	SELECT     a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_kho, c.ten_kho2, c.ma_dvcs, d.ten_dvt, d.ten_dvt2,
			e.ten_kh, e.ten_kh2
	FROM         dbo.mpdh a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	                      dbo.dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	                      dbo.dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho LEFT OUTER JOIN
	                      dbo.dmdvt d ON a.dvt = d.dvt LEFT OUTER JOIN
		dbo.dmkh e ON a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$SiteLocationItemLot]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Site VARCHAR(33),	
	@Location VARCHAR(33),	
	@Lot VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing	
	@DataType TINYINT, --1 - Physics, 2 - Book
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@GroupClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@Statement NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--  Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @Fields VARCHAR(511), @Groups VARCHAR(511), @Wheres VARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Fields = 'a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt', @Groups = 'a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt', @Wheres = 'b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and b.ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_tri and b.ma_lo = a.ma_lo and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt'
	
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM cdlo

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(@Site, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Location <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vi_tri like ''' + REPLACE(@Location, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Lot <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(@Lot, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--  Balance (year)
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.ton00), sum(a.du00), sum(a.du_nt00)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @DataType = 1 THEN 'cdlo2' ELSE 'cdlo' END + ' a with (nolock, index(nam)) '

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + 'left join dmkho z on a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho'
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @s = @s + @JoinClause

	SELECT @s = @s + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + '%key'
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SELECT @s = @s + ' group by ' + @Groups

	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%key', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @DataType = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = YEAR(@Date)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, 'cdlo2', 'cdlo'), '%key', ' and not exists(select 1 from cdlo2 b with(nolock) where b.nam = a.nam and ' + @Wheres + ')')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--  Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SELECT @Date = @Date - 1

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @JoinClause

		SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END 
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause

		SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by ' + @Groups
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
	END

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select ' + @Fields + ', sum(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_nhap - a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_n - a.tien_nt_x)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) '

		IF @JoinClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by ' + @Groups
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	Result:
	SELECT @q = 'select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, isnull(sum(so_luong), 0) as so_luong, isnull(sum(tien), 0) as tien, isnull(sum(tien_nt), 0) as tien_nt'		
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #t a group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptDueSalesInvoiceReport] -- fs20_ARDueInvoice
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@AlertDays DECIMAL,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@ContractGroup CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound TINYINT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @sReportDate VARCHAR(8), @cname NVARCHAR(1024), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @sReportDate = CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112)
	SELECT @cname = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT076'

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_nt0, t_tt0, t_tt_qd0
	    , t_tt_nt0 * 0 AS da_tt_nt, t_tt0 * 0 AS da_tt, t_tt_nt0 * 0 AS cl_nt, t_tt0 * 0 AS cl
	    , ngay_ct AS ngay_dh, t_tt0 * 0 AS so_ngay_dh, 0 AS status, ma_hd, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_hd
	INTO #tt0 FROM wrkar

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.loai_tt = 0'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct0 <= ''' + @sReportDate + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and datediff(dd, ''' + @sReportDate + ''', dateadd(dd, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0)) <= ' + LTRIM(STR(@AlertDays))
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @UnitKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Join = 'left join dmtt b with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt'
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tt0 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tt_nt0, a.t_tt0, a.t_tt_qd0'
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', dateadd(dd, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0), datediff(dd, ''' + @sReportDate + ''', dateadd(dd, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0)), 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'a.ma_hd, d.ten_hd' else 'a.ma_hd, d.ten_hd2' END ELSE ''''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt20 a with(nolock)'
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' SET @q = @q + ' left join dmhd d with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = d.ma_hd '
	SET @q = @q + @Join + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS tt_qd, SUM(tt_cn) AS tt INTO #tt1
		FROM cttt20
			WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #tt0) AND ngay_ct <= @ReportDate
				GROUP BY stt_rec_tt

	UPDATE #tt0 SET da_tt_nt = ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0) + a.t_tt_qd0
	            , da_tt = ISNULL(b.tt, 0) + ROUND(a.t_tt_qd0 * CASE a.ma_nt WHEN '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END, @nRound)
	FROM #tt0 a LEFT JOIN #tt1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt
	UPDATE #tt0 SET cl_nt = t_tt_nt0 - da_tt_nt, cl = t_tt0 - da_tt
	DELETE #tt0 WHERE CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN cl ELSE cl_nt END <= 0

	UPDATE #tt0 SET t_tt_nt0 = 0, da_tt_nt = 0, cl_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #tt0 SET status = 1 WHERE so_ngay_dh <= 0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, a.*, b.ma_ct, b.so_ct, b.so_ct AS so_ct0, b.ngay_ct0, b.dien_giai AS ten_dg, b.dien_giai AS ten_dg2, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_kh ELSE d.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
	INTO #report
	FROM #tt0 a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 0) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	        LEFT JOIN dmct c ON b.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
	        LEFT JOIN dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN status NUMERIC(1)

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
	IF @ContractGroup = '0' SELECT @o = 'ma_kh, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec'
		ELSE SELECT @o = 'ma_kh, ma_hd, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'dg', 't_tt_nt0, t_tt0, da_tt_nt, da_tt, cl_nt, cl', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	SET @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dg', 't_tt_nt0, t_tt0, da_tt_nt, da_tt, cl_nt, cl', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, LEN(stt_rec) - 3) + ma_ct WHERE RIGHT(stt_rec, 3) <> ma_ct AND ma_ct <> ''
	UPDATE #report SET sysprint = 0 WHERE systotal = 0
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''

	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct into #hd FROM #report
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @DateFrom = MIN(b.ngay_ct), @DateTo = MAX(b.ngay_ct) FROM #report a JOIN cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #hd select stt_rec, so_ct_hddt from hddt00$%Partition a where %[exists (select 1 from #report b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) and a.ma_ct in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		UPDATE #report SET so_ct0 = ''
		UPDATE #report SET so_ct0 = b.so_ct FROM #report a JOIN #hd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	END

	IF @ContractGroup = '0'
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_rec, ma_kh, ma_nt, t_tt_nt0, t_tt0, da_tt_nt, da_tt, cl_nt, cl
	        , ngay_dh, so_ngay_dh, ma_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_dg ELSE ten_dg2 END AS ten_dg, ten_kh, '' AS ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, '' AS ten_hd_ex
	    FROM #report ORDER BY ma_kh, sysorder, stt
	ELSE
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_rec, ma_kh, ma_nt, t_tt_nt0, t_tt0, da_tt_nt, da_tt, cl_nt, cl
	        , ngay_dh, so_ngay_dh, ma_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_dg ELSE ten_dg2 END AS ten_dg, ten_kh, ma_hd, ten_hd, CASE WHEN ma_hd = '' THEN '' ELSE ten_hd END AS ten_hd_ex
	    FROM #report ORDER BY ma_kh, ma_hd, sysorder, stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalRole]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@status VARCHAR(32),	
	@category VARCHAR(32),
	@role VARCHAR(32) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)
	SELECT TOP 1 @role = RTRIM(a.ma_quyen)
		FROM (SELECT * FROM sodmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN sodmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN sodmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen JOIN sodmttcttg d ON a.loai_duyet = d.loai_duyet AND d.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND c.status = d.u_status
			WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType
				AND a.status = '1'
				AND a.user_id = @userID
				AND b.status = '1'
				AND c.status = @status
				AND d.status = '1'
				AND c.kieu_duyet = @category

	SELECT @role = ISNULL(@role, '')

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_VendorEvaluationByInvoice]
	@PriceRound INT, 
	@RateRound INT,
	@QuantityRound INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_chi_tieu, ma_pp, diem_ngam_dinh INTO #kb FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp IN ('60', '70')
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kb) RETURN

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_ng, a.stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ng, a.gia AS gia_ng, a.dvt AS dvt_ng, a.so_luong * a.he_so AS sl_ng, 
			b.stt_rec AS stt_rec_tc, b.stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0tc, b.gia AS gia_tc, b.so_luong * b.he_so AS sl_tc
		INTO #map FROM #ngdg a JOIN #ngdg b ON b.nguon_xd IN ('#V1', '#V2') AND a.stt_rec_ng = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0ng = b.stt_rec0
		WHERE a.nguon_xd IN ('#V3', '#V4') 


	SELECT a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, b.ma_chi_tieu, a.stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, gia_ng, sl_ng, dvt_ng, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, gia_tc, sl_tc,
			CASE WHEN ma_pp = '60' AND gia_tc <> 0 THEN ROUND((gia_ng - gia_tc)/gia_tc * 100, @RateRound) ELSE 0 END AS cl_tl, 
			CASE WHEN ma_pp = '70' THEN a.sl_ng - a.sl_tc ELSE 0 END AS cl_sl, 
			b.ma_pp, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt
		INTO #tg FROM #map a, #kb b

	INSERT INTO #kqtg(ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, gia_ng, sl_ng, dvt_ng, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, stt_rec1tc, gia_tc, sl_tc, cl_tl, cl_sl, nguon_xd) 
		SELECT ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, gia_ng, sl_ng, dvt_ng, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, '', gia_tc, sl_tc, 
			CASE WHEN ma_pp = '60' THEN cl_tl ELSE 0 END,
			CASE WHEN ma_pp = '70' THEN cl_sl ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN ma_pp = '60' THEN '#AD.6' ELSE '#AD.7' END
		FROM #tg


	SELECT a.id_stt, MAX(b.chenh_lech_tl) AS chenh_lech_tl INTO #o1 FROM #tg a JOIN #kbpp b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE a.ma_pp = '60' AND a.cl_tl >= 0 AND b.loai = '1' AND ABS(b.chenh_lech_tl) <= ABS(a.cl_tl) GROUP BY a.id_stt
	INSERT INTO #o1 SELECT a.id_stt, MAX(b.chenh_lech_tl) FROM #tg a JOIN #kbpp b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE a.ma_pp = '60' AND a.cl_tl < 0 AND b.loai = '2' AND ABS(b.chenh_lech_tl) <= ABS(a.cl_tl) GROUP BY a.id_stt
	INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, cl_tl, diem_so0, nguon_xd)
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.cl_tl, 
			CASE WHEN d.diem_toi_thieu <> 0 AND c.diem_so < d.diem_toi_thieu THEN d.diem_toi_thieu WHEN d.diem_toi_da <> 0 AND c.diem_so > d.diem_toi_da THEN d.diem_toi_da ELSE c.diem_so END, 
			'#01'
		FROM #tg a JOIN #o1 b ON a.id_stt = b.id_stt JOIN #kbpp c ON a.ma_chi_tieu = c.ma_chi_tieu AND c.loai = CASE WHEN a.cl_tl >= 0 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AND b.chenh_lech_tl = c.chenh_lech_tl CROSS JOIN #dotdg d
		WHERE a.ma_pp = '60'


	SELECT a.id_stt, MAX(b.chenh_lech_sl) AS chenh_lech_sl INTO #o2 FROM #tg a JOIN #kbpp b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE a.ma_pp = '70' AND a.cl_sl >= 0 AND b.loai = '1' AND ABS(b.chenh_lech_sl) <= ABS(a.cl_sl) GROUP BY a.id_stt
	INSERT INTO #o2 SELECT a.id_stt, MAX(b.chenh_lech_sl) FROM #tg a JOIN #kbpp b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu WHERE a.ma_pp = '70' AND a.cl_sl < 0 AND b.loai = '2' AND ABS(b.chenh_lech_sl) <= ABS(a.cl_sl) GROUP BY a.id_stt
	INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, cl_sl, diem_so0, nguon_xd)
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.cl_sl, 
			CASE WHEN d.diem_toi_thieu <> 0 AND c.diem_so < d.diem_toi_thieu THEN d.diem_toi_thieu WHEN d.diem_toi_da <> 0 AND c.diem_so > d.diem_toi_da THEN d.diem_toi_da ELSE c.diem_so END, 
			'#01'
		FROM #tg a JOIN #o2 b ON a.id_stt = b.id_stt JOIN #kbpp c ON a.ma_chi_tieu = c.ma_chi_tieu AND c.loai = CASE WHEN a.cl_sl >= 0 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AND b.chenh_lech_sl = c.chenh_lech_sl CROSS JOIN #dotdg d
		WHERE a.ma_pp = '70'

	INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, nguon_xd) 
		SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, b.ma_chi_tieu, '#01'
		FROM #map a CROSS JOIN #kb b WHERE b.diem_ngam_dinh <> '4' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tg c WHERE c.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND c.ma_kh = a.ma_kh AND c.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu)

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

	SELECT a.*, b.ten_nh AS ten_nh, b.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh2, b.ma_px
		FROM sfkbnhnc a JOIN sfdmnhomnc b ON a.ma_nh = b.ma_nh

CREATE proc dbo.dt_addtosourcecontrol
    @vchSourceSafeINI varchar(255) = '',
    @vchProjectName   varchar(255) ='',
    @vchComment       varchar(255) ='',
    @vchLoginName     varchar(255) ='',
    @vchPassword      varchar(255) =''

as

set nocount on

declare @iReturn int
declare @iObjectId int
select @iObjectId = 0

declare @iStreamObjectId int
select @iStreamObjectId = 0

declare @VSSGUID varchar(100)
select @VSSGUID = 'SQLVersionControl.VCS_SQL'

declare @vchDatabaseName varchar(255)
select @vchDatabaseName = db_name()

declare @iReturnValue int
select @iReturnValue = 0

declare @iPropertyObjectId int
declare @vchParentId varchar(255)

declare @iObjectCount int
select @iObjectCount = 0

    exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OACreate @VSSGUID, @iObjectId OUT
    if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError


    /* Create Project in SS */
    exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iObjectId,
											'AddProjectToSourceSafe',
											NULL,
											@vchSourceSafeINI,
											@vchProjectName output,
											@@SERVERNAME,
											@vchDatabaseName,
											@vchLoginName,
											@vchPassword,
											@vchComment


    if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

    /* Set Database Properties */

    begin tran SetProperties

    /* add high level object */

    exec @iPropertyObjectId = dbo.dt_adduserobject_vcs 'VCSProjectID'

    select @vchParentId = CONVERT(varchar(255),@iPropertyObjectId)

    exec dbo.dt_setpropertybyid @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSProjectID', @vchParentId , NULL
    exec dbo.dt_setpropertybyid @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSProject' , @vchProjectName , NULL
    exec dbo.dt_setpropertybyid @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSourceSafeINI' , @vchSourceSafeINI , NULL
    exec dbo.dt_setpropertybyid @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLServer', @@SERVERNAME, NULL
    exec dbo.dt_setpropertybyid @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLDatabase', @vchDatabaseName, NULL

    if @@error <> 0 GOTO E_General_Error

    commit tran SetProperties
    
    select @iObjectCount = 0;

CleanUp:
    select @vchProjectName
    select @iObjectCount
    return

E_General_Error:
    /* this is an all or nothing.  No specific error messages */
    goto CleanUp

E_OAError:
    exec dbo.dt_displayoaerror @iObjectId, @iReturn
    goto CleanUp





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMonthlyAverageExRateDemonstration] -- fs20_GLExchangeRateTableDesc
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s32 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTy_gia NUMERIC(24, 12)
	DECLARE @loai_sd CHAR(1), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @m_round_tg NUMERIC(2)
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT ngay_lct, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_vv, stt_rec, nh_dk, line_nbr INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- @UnitKey	
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', '=', @Account)		
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh = ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key2 = @Key

	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (c.loai_cl_no = 1 or c.loai_cl_co = 1)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (c.loai_cl_no = 1 or abs(a.ps_no) + abs(a.ps_no_nt) <> 0) and (c.loai_cl_co = 1 or abs(a.ps_co) + abs(a.ps_co_nt) <> 0)'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and (c.loai_cl_no = 1 or c.loai_cl_co = 1)'
	SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and (c.loai_cl_co = 1 or abs(a.ps_no) + abs(a.ps_no_nt) <> 0) and (c.loai_cl_no = 1 or abs(a.ps_co) + abs(a.ps_co_nt) <> 0)'
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TGGSTBT'
	
	SELECT @loai_sd = CASE WHEN loai_cl_no = 1 THEN 'C' ELSE 'N' END FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @Account
	SELECT @DateFrom = REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + '01', @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @m_round_tg = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	-- Tinh so du dau ky
	SELECT TOP 0 du_no00 AS du_dk, du_no_nt00 AS du_dk_nt INTO #tbg FROM cdtk
	IF @Customer = ''
		INSERT INTO #tbg EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #tbg EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Customer, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @loai_sd = 'N' BEGIN
			UPDATE #tbg SET du_dk = 0 WHERE du_dk < 0
			UPDATE #tbg SET du_dk_nt = 0 WHERE du_dk_nt < 0
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #tbg SET du_dk = 0 WHERE du_dk > 0
		UPDATE #tbg SET du_dk_nt = 0 WHERE du_dk_nt > 0
	END
	SELECT @nDu_dk = ABS(du_dk), @nDu_dk_nt = ABS(du_dk_nt) FROM #tbg

	-- Tinh so phat sinh tang
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tps0 FROM #tmp
	SET @q = 'insert into #tps0 select a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, '
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr '
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Tinh so phat sinh giam
	SELECT * INTO #tps1 FROM #tmp
	SET @q = '	insert into #tps1 select a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, '
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd)'
	SET @q = @q + ' and (loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''9'')'
	SET @q = @q + ' or (loai_ct = ''5'' and a.sua_tg_yn = 1))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tps1 '
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, '
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[ '+ @Key2 + ' and a.ma_ct = ''PK8'' and left(stt_rec, 10) in (select left(stt_rec, 10) from #tps1)]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Tinh ty gia trung binh
	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt)
		FROM (
			SELECT ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #tps0
			UNION ALL SELECT ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #tps1
			) a

	SELECT @nDu_dk = ISNULL(@nDu_dk, 0), @nDu_dk_nt = ISNULL(@nDu_dk_nt, 0)
		, @nPs_no = ISNULL(@nPs_no, 0), @nPs_no_nt = ISNULL(@nPs_no_nt, 0), @nPs_co = ISNULL(@nPs_co, 0), @nPs_co_nt = ISNULL(@nPs_co_nt, 0)

	SET @nTy_gia = CASE WHEN (@nDu_dk_nt + CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_no_nt ELSE @nPs_co_nt END - CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_co_nt ELSE @nPs_no_nt END) = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE ROUND((@nDu_dk + CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_no ELSE @nPs_co END - CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_co ELSE @nPs_no END)
			/ (@nDu_dk_nt + CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_no_nt ELSE @nPs_co_nt END - CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nPs_co_nt ELSE @nPs_no_nt END), @m_round_tg)
		END

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_vv, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.*, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in
			FROM #tps0 a LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.*, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in
			FROM #tps1 a LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s1, CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END
			, CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'N' THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			, CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'C' THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END
			, CASE WHEN @loai_sd = 'C' THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) SELECT 1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ty_gia) SELECT 2, 0, 0, @s3 , @nTy_gia
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) SELECT 3, 0, 0

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk_du
			, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_vv, stt_rec, ma_ct0
			, @nDu_dk AS du_dk0, @nDu_dk_nt AS du_dk0_nt, @nPs_no AS ps_no0, @nPs_no_nt AS ps_no0_nt
			, @nPs_co AS ps_co0, @nPs_co_nt AS ps_co0_nt, @nTy_gia AS ty_gia0 
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, nh_dk, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunPlanOrderInPeriod] @cItem VARCHAR(33), @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dPeriod SMALLDATETIME, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nSize TINYINT
	SET @nSize = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_dh')
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND kieu_hd = 0) RETURN
	--
	DECLARE @nProjectedOnHand NUMERIC(28, 6) , @nReceipt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nIssue NUMERIC(28, 6), @nSafetyStock NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTimeFence INT, @nNetRequirement NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFixedPeriodCover NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @dPlanedOrderReceipt SMALLDATETIME, @dFixedPeriodComing SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @W CHAR(1), @nIDMax NUMERIC(12, 0), @nPONum INT, @cIDNumber CHAR(13)
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @nQRound INT

	--
	SELECT @nPONum = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_dh_ht'
	SELECT @W = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	SELECT @cIDNumber = MAX(stt_rec) FROM mpctyc WHERE nguon IN ('FP', 'PL')
	IF @cIDNumber IS NULL SELECT @cIDNumber = '00'
	IF @cIDNumber = '' SELECT @cIDNumber = '00'
	SELECT @nIDMax = CAST(RIGHT(@cIDNumber, 12) AS NUMERIC(12, 0))
	IF @nIDMax IS NULL SELECT @nIDMax = 0

	--
	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @dPlanedOrderReceipt = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND sl_xuat <> 0 AND ngay_ct0 = @dPeriod
	SELECT @dPlanedOrderReceipt = CASE WHEN @dPlanedOrderReceipt IS NULL THEN dbo.mf_GetNextWorkDate(@dPeriod) ELSE dbo.mf_GetNextWorkDate(@dPlanedOrderReceipt) END
	SELECT @nTimeFence = vung_hd, @nSafetyStock = ton_at FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @cItem
	--

	-- Projected On Hand
	SELECT @nProjectedOnHand = ton_kho FROM mpctvtky WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ky = 0
	SELECT @nReceipt = SUM(sl_nhap), @nIssue = SUM(sl_xuat) FROM mpctyc WHERE ngay_ct0 <= @dPeriod AND ma_vt = @cItem
	SELECT @nProjectedOnHand = ISNULL(@nProjectedOnHand, 0), @nReceipt = ISNULL(@nReceipt, 0), @nIssue = ISNULL(@nIssue, 0)
	SELECT @nProjectedOnHand = @nProjectedOnHand + @nReceipt - @nIssue

	-- Net Requirement
	SELECT @nNetRequirement = @nSafetyStock - @nProjectedOnHand
	IF @nNetRequirement < 0 SELECT @nNetRequirement = 0
	IF @nNetRequirement = 0 RETURN
	IF @nTimeFence <> 0 AND DATEADD(day, - @nTimeFence, @dPlanedOrderReceipt) <= @dNow RETURN

	-- Allocation
	SELECT ma_kho, ty_le, muc_do, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS nc_rong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS dat_hang, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_nhan, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_dat, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(so_dh), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS so_dh, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec
		INTO #mrctdhkho
		FROM mdmvtkho
		WHERE ma_vt = @cItem

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #mrctdhkho)
		INSERT INTO #mrctdhkho (ma_kho, ty_le, muc_do, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th, nc_rong, dat_hang, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat)
			SELECT '', 1, 1, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th, 0, 0, NULL, NULL
				FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @cItem

	SELECT @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedValue
		(
			@nNetRequirement, 
			'#mrctdhkho', 
			'ty_le', 
			'ma_kho', 
			'nc_rong', 
			@nQRound
		)

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	DECLARE @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @kieu_hd NUMERIC(1), @ton_at NUMERIC(28, 6), @co_lo NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_ngay_dh NUMERIC(5), @tg_th  INT, @nc_rong NUMERIC(28, 6), @dat_hang NUMERIC(28, 6), @ngay_nhan SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dat SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE crSite CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_kho, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th, nc_rong FROM #mrctdhkho ORDER BY ma_kho
	OPEN crSite
	FETCH NEXT FROM crSite INTO @ma_kho, @kieu_hd, @ton_at, @co_lo, @so_ngay_dh, @tg_th, @nc_rong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			-- Discrete
			IF @kieu_hd = 1 SELECT @dat_hang = @nc_rong
			-- Fixed Order Quantity
			IF @kieu_hd = 2 SELECT @dat_hang = CASE WHEN @co_lo = 0 THEN 0 ELSE @co_lo*CEILING(@nc_rong/@co_lo) END
			-- Fixed Period
			IF @kieu_hd = 3
				BEGIN
					SELECT @dFixedPeriodComing = dbo.mf_GetNetForwardDate(@dPlanedOrderReceipt, @so_ngay_dh)
					SELECT @nFixedPeriodCover = SUM(sl_xuat) FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ngay_ct0 > @dPeriod AND ngay_ct0 <= @dFixedPeriodComing
					SELECT @dat_hang = ISNULL(@nFixedPeriodCover, 0) + @nc_rong
				END
			--
			SELECT @ngay_nhan = @dPlanedOrderReceipt
--			SELECT @ngay_dat = dbo.mf_GetWorkDate(DATEADD(day, - @tg_th, @ngay_nhan))
			SELECT @ngay_dat = dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(@ngay_nhan, @tg_th)
			SELECT @nIDMax = @nIDMax + 1, @nPONum = @nPONum + 1
			--
			UPDATE #mrctdhkho SET ngay_nhan = @ngay_nhan, ngay_dat = @ngay_dat, dat_hang = @dat_hang, stt_rec = @W + REPLACE(STR(@nIDMax, 12), ' ', '0'), so_dh = STR(@nPONum, @nSize) WHERE ma_kho = @ma_kho
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crSite INTO @ma_kho, @kieu_hd, @ton_at, @co_lo, @so_ngay_dh, @tg_th, @nc_rong
		END
	CLOSE crSite
	DEALLOCATE crSite

	UPDATE options SET val = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@nPONum, @nSize))) WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_SO_DH_HT'

	-- Generate Plan Order
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
		(
			nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
			, ngay_ct0
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, sl_ton, sl_db
			, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
			, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
			, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
		)
	SELECT 'PL', '', @cItem, ngay_nhan
			, @dPeriod
			, dat_hang, 0
			, 0, 0
			, nc_rong, dat_hang, 0, ngay_dat
			, 0, '', NULL, 0
			, so_dh, stt_rec, 1, 0
			, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
			, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
			, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
		FROM #mrctdhkho

END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptListOfItemHasNotCompletedPhysicalCount]
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Year CHAR(4), @unitKey nvarchar(4000), @siteKey nvarchar(4000)
	SELECT @Year = CAST(YEAR(ngay_ct) AS CHAR(4)) FROM kkyc WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, a.ma_kho, b.ma_vt, ma_vi_tri AS vi_tri, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_lo INTO #report FROM kkycct a, dmvt b
	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, vi_tri, ma_lo INTO #kktt FROM #report
	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, vi_tri, ma_lo INTO #kkdc FROM #report

	--
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @unitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @siteKey OUTPUT

	SELECT @Join = ' join kkyc c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Key = ' a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'a.', 'd.')
		SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join dmkho d on a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho'
	END
	IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @siteKey
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #$ttemp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo from $table a ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '#$ttemp', '#kktt'), '$table', 'kktt$' + @Year)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	CREATE INDEX i ON #kktt(ma_kho, ma_vt, vi_tri, ma_lo)

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '#$ttemp', '#kkdc'), '$table', 'kkdc')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	CREATE INDEX i ON #kkdc(ma_kho, ma_vt, vi_tri, ma_lo)
	
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and not exists (select 1 from #kktt z where a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho and a.ma_vt = z.ma_vt and a.ma_vi_tri = z.vi_tri and a.ma_lo = z.ma_lo)'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and not exists (select 1 from #kkdc y where a.ma_kho = y.ma_kho and a.ma_vt = y.ma_vt and a.ma_vi_tri = y.vi_tri and a.ma_lo = y.ma_lo)'

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_kho, ma_vt, vi_tri, ma_lo) select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo from kkss$' + @Year + ' a ' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' END + @Key + ' order by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #g(ma_kho VARCHAR(33), stt INT)
	INSERT INTO #g SELECT ma_kho, MIN(stt) FROM #report GROUP BY ma_kho

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_vt) SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', ''

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt - o.stt + 1 AS stt, a.stt_rec AS phieu_yc, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.vi_tri, ma_lo, so_ct + ' - ' + b.dien_giai AS dien_giai,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt,
			CASE WHEN sysorder = 0 THEN so_ct + ' - ' + b.dien_giai ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_kho ELSE d.ten_kho2 END END AS ten_kho
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN #g o ON a.ma_kho = o.ma_kho
			LEFT JOIN kkyc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmkho d ON a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho
		ORDER BY a.ma_kho, o.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdgsp] AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_sp, '') AS ten_sp, ISNULL(b.ten_sp2, '') AS ten_sp2 FROM hrdgsp a LEFT JOIN hrdmsp b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp
		ORDER BY a.ma_sp, a.ngay_hl DESC
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_Dashboard002] -- Phân tích doanh thu theo khoản mục, chi phi theo yeu to
	@fieldID VARCHAR(32),
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(1024), 
	@UOM INT = 1,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @max_record INT
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME


	SELECT @Account = REPLACE(@Account, ' ', '')
	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')
	SELECT @max_record = max_record FROM dbfield WHERE field_id = @fieldID
	EXEC ds_GetArisingDate @TimeID, @dateFrom OUTPUT, @dateTo OUTPUT
	IF @timeID IN ('001', '002', '003', '004')
		SELECT @dStart1 = @dateFrom, @dEnd1 = @dateTo, @dStart2 = '20000102', @dEnd2 = '20000101', @y1 = 0
	ELSE
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)


	-- Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @tkdt)
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS gia_tri INTO #t FROM wrkgl


	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select tk, sum(' + CASE WHEN @fieldID = 'C003' THEN 'ps_no - ps_co' ELSE 'ps_co - ps_no' END + ') from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']% group by tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select tk, sum(' + CASE WHEN @fieldID = 'C003' THEN 'ps_no - ps_co' ELSE 'ps_co - ps_no' END + ') from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']% group by tk'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	-- Group
	SELECT * INTO #g FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Account, ',')
	SELECT b.data AS tk, SUM(a.gia_tri) AS gia_tri INTO #r FROM #t a JOIN #g b ON a.tk LIKE (b.data + '%') GROUP BY b.data
	


	-- Result
	DECLARE @n INT, @c NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @n = COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT 1 AS c FROM #r GROUP BY tk) a
	IF @max_record <> 0 AND @n > @max_record BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM dbreports WHERE xtype = '00' AND ccode = CASE WHEN @fieldID = 'C002' THEN '003' ELSE '002' END
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #r2 FROM #r
		SET @q = 'insert into #r2 select top ' + RTRIM(@max_record - 1) + ' tk, gia_tri from #r order by gia_tri desc'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		INSERT INTO #r2 SELECT NULL, (SELECT SUM(gia_tri) FROM #r) - (SELECT SUM(gia_tri) FROM #r2)
		SET @q = 'select a.tk as colID, isnull(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN + 'case when b.ten_ngan = '''' then b.ten_tk else b.ten_ngan end' ELSE + 'case when b.ten_ngan2 = '''' then b.ten_tk2 else b.ten_ngan2 end' END + ', N''' + @c + ''') as colname, a.gia_tri from #r2 a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where gia_tri >= 0 order by gia_tri desc'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select a.tk as colID, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN + 'case when b.ten_ngan = '''' then b.ten_tk else b.ten_ngan end' ELSE + 'case when b.ten_ngan2 = '''' then b.ten_tk2 else b.ten_ngan2 end' END + ' as colname, gia_tri from #r a join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.gia_tri >= 0 order by a.gia_tri desc'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ExecReUpdateExDeff] @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @cFC VARCHAR(33), @cDrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), @cCrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), @cVC CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #ct00 FROM ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	--
	DELETE ct00 WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_ct = @cVC AND ma_nt = @cFC
	--
	UPDATE ct00 SET s5 = ps_no WHERE s5 = 0 AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = @cFC
	UPDATE ct00 SET s6 = ps_co WHERE s6 = 0 AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = @cFC
	UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = s5, ps_co = s6, s4 = 0 WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = @cFC
	--
	DECLARE @nRound INT
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @tk VARCHAR(33), @tk_du VARCHAR(33), @nh_dk VARCHAR(33), @ma_kh VARCHAR(33), @ps_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @xtk VARCHAR(33), @xma_kh VARCHAR(33), @xno_co NUMERIC(1), @xty_gia_gs NUMERIC(24, 12)
	DECLARE @nAmt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nxRate NUMERIC(24, 12)
	DECLARE @isContinue INT, @xCust VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @isContinue = 0
	--
	DECLARE crEx CURSOR FOR SELECT tk, ma_kh, no_co, ty_gia_gs FROM gltggs WHERE ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo) ORDER BY tk, ma_kh, no_co
	OPEN crEx
	FETCH NEXT FROM crEx INTO @xtk, @xma_kh, @xno_co, @xty_gia_gs
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @xno_co = 1
				BEGIN
					DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, tk, tk_du, nh_dk, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co FROM ct00 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = @cFC AND s4 = 0 AND tk = @xtk AND ps_no <> 0 AND (ma_kh LIKE RTRIM(@xma_kh) + '%') AND ma_ct <> @cVC
					OPEN crTran
					FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							--
							SELECT @isContinue = 1
							IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
								BEGIN
									SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_no_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
									IF @nAmt > @ps_no
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
									IF @nAmt < @ps_no
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cDrDeffAcct, tk_du = @tk_du, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END

								END
							--
							SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_kh = @xCust AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
								BEGIN

									SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_no_nt*@nxRate, @nRound)
									SELECT @ps_no = ROUND(@ps_no_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
									IF @nAmt > @ps_no
										BEGIN

											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @ps_no, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk --AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl

											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk --AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = 502
											UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
									IF @nAmt < @ps_no
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END

								END
							--
							IF (@isContinue = 1) AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))

											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @ps_no, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501

											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501

											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
										END

								END
						
							--
							FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
						END
					CLOSE crTran
					DEALLOCATE crTran
					
				END
				-- End Dr = 1

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN

							--
							IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
								BEGIN
									SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
