											UPDATE ct00 SET s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
									IF @nAmt < @ps_co
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk --AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cCrDeffAcct, tk_du = @Tk_du, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, tk = @tk_du, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END

								END
							--
							SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_kh = @xCust AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
								BEGIN
									SELECT @isContinue = 0
									SELECT @nxRate = ty_gia_gs FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_kh = @xCust AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo)
									SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@nxRate, @nRound)
									SELECT @ps_co = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
									IF @nAmt > @ps_co
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @ps_co, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @ps_co, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = 502
											UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
									IF @nAmt < @ps_co
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk-- AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END

								END
							--
							IF (@isContinue = 1) AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
								BEGIN
									SELECT @nxRate = ty_gia_gs FROM gltggs WHERE tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo)
									SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@nxRate, @nRound)
									SELECT @ps_co = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
									IF @nAmt > @ps_co
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @ps_co, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @ps_co, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cCrDeffAcct, tk_du = @tk_du, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, tk = @tk_du, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
									IF @nAmt < @ps_co
										BEGIN
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, s4 = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											DELETE #gl
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 501
											INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND ma_kh = @ma_kh
											UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = 502 WHERE line_nbr <> 501
											UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ngay_ct = @dTo, ma_ct = @cVC
											UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cDrDeffAcct, tk_du = @tk_du, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 501
											UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, tk = @tk_du, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = 502
											INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
										END
								END

							
							--
							FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
						END
					CLOSE crTran
					DEALLOCATE crTran
					
				END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crEx INTO @xtk, @xma_kh, @xno_co, @xty_gia_gs
		END
	CLOSE crEx
	DEALLOCATE crEx	
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #ct00
END


GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff20_GetInsertTotalEx]
	(
	@cName VARCHAR(33),
	@cName2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	
	SELECT @strReturn = ''
	SET @strReturn = 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + '(' + CASE WHEN @cName <> '' THEN @cName + ',' ELSE + '' END + CASE WHEN @cName2 <> '' THEN @cName2 + ',' ELSE '' END 
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES(' + CASE WHEN @cName <> '' THEN ''''',' ELSE + '' END + CASE WHEN @cName2 <> '' THEN ''''',' ELSE + '' END + ' -8, 0, 0)'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + '(' + CASE WHEN @cName <> '' THEN @cName + ',' ELSE + '' END + CASE WHEN @cName2 <> '' THEN @cName2 + ',' ELSE '' END 
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn	+ ' sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ' + @strSum + ')'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + '	SELECT ' + CASE WHEN @cName <> '' THEN + 'N''' + RTRIM(@s1) + ''',' ELSE + '' END + CASE WHEN @cName2 <> '' THEN + 'N''' + RTRIM(@s12) + ''',' ELSE '' END + '-9, 0, 0' + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a WHERE systotal = 1'
	RETURN @strReturn
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesSummaryByObject]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Account AS VARCHAR(512),
	@RefAccount AS VARCHAR(512),
	@TaxAccount AS VARCHAR(512),
	@RefTaxAccount AS VARCHAR(512),
	@DisAccount AS VARCHAR(512),
	@RefDisAccount AS VARCHAR(512),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ContractGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ContractGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ContractGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(256),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Opject TINYINT, -- 1 - Khách hàng, 2 - Vụ việc, 3 - Bộ phận
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @AccountKey NVARCHAR(4000), @TaxKey NVARCHAR(4000), @DiscountKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_vv AS ma, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt AS dt_nt, ps_no AS dt INTO #temp FROM wrkgl

	IF (ISNULL(@SalesEmployeeColumn, '') = '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_compact_mode' AND RTRIM(val) = '1')) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #temp SELECT '', '', '', '', 0, 0
		SELECT 0 AS stt, ma, dt_nt, dt, dt_nt AS thue_nt, dt AS thue, dt_nt AS ck_nt, dt AS ck, dt_nt AS pt_nt, dt AS pt, '' AS ten, '' AS ten2   FROM #temp
		RETURN
	END

	SET @AccountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @RefAccount <> '' SET @AccountKey = @AccountKey + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @RefAccount)
	SET @AccountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@AccountKey)
	--
	SET @TaxKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @TaxAccount)
	IF @RefTaxAccount <> '' SET @TaxKey = @TaxKey + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @RefTaxAccount)
	SET @TaxKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@TaxKey)
	--
	SET @DiscountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @DisAccount)
	IF @RefDisAccount <> '' SET @DiscountKey = @DiscountKey + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @RefDisAccount)
	SET @DiscountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@DiscountKey)
	IF @DisAccount = '' SET @DiscountKey = '1=0'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vv1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vv2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vv3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @ContractGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.nh_hd1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ContractGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.nh_hd2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ContractGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and e.nh_hd3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((' + @AccountKey + ') or (' + @TaxKey + ') or (' + @DiscountKey + '))'
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	-- Join
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmvv d on a.ma_vv = d.ma_vv'
	IF @ContractGroup1 + @ContractGroup2 + @ContractGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmhd e on a.ma_hd = e.ma_hd'

	SELECT *, tk AS tk_thue, tk_du AS tk_thue_du, tk AS tk_ck, tk_du AS tk_ck_du, dt_nt AS thue_nt, dt AS thue, dt_nt AS ck_nt, dt AS ck INTO #doanhthu FROM #temp

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select stt_rec, ' + CASE WHEN @Opject = 1 THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE CASE WHEN @Opject = 2 THEN 'a.ma_vv' ELSE 'a.ma_bp' END END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt, ps_no + ps_co'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[(((' + @Key + ')))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @Opject = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update #temp set ma = b.ma from #temp a join ('
		SET @q = @q + 'select stt_rec, max(ma) as ma from #temp a where ' + @AccountKey + ' group by stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ') b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where ' + @TaxKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #doanhthu select stt_rec, ma, max(a.tk), max(a.tk_du), sum(dt_nt), sum(dt), '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #temp a'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ' + @AccountKey
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.stt_rec, ma'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #doanhthu set tk_thue = b.tk, tk_thue_du = b.tk_du, thue_nt = b.dt_nt, thue = b.dt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #doanhthu a join (select max(tk) as tk, max(tk_du) as tk_du, sum(dt) as dt, sum(dt_nt) as dt_nt, stt_rec, ma from #temp a'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ' + @TaxKey
	SET @q = @q + ' group by stt_rec, ma) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ma = b.ma'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #doanhthu set tk_ck = b.tk, tk_ck_du = b.tk_du, ck_nt = b.dt_nt, ck = b.dt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #doanhthu a join (select max(tk) as tk, max(tk_du) as tk_du, sum(dt) as dt, sum(dt_nt) as dt_nt, stt_rec, ma from #temp a'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ' + @DiscountKey
	SET @q = @q + ' group by stt_rec, ma) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ma = b.ma'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT 0 AS stt, ma, SUM(dt_nt)AS dt_nt , SUM(dt) AS dt, SUM(thue_nt) AS thue_nt, SUM(thue) AS thue, SUM(ck_nt) AS ck_nt, SUM(ck) AS ck
		INTO #report FROM #doanhthu GROUP BY ma
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'NUMERIC(5)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'ma', '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (stt, ma, dt_nt, dt, thue_nt, thue, ck_nt, ck) VALUES(NULL, '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select a.*, dt_nt - ck_nt + thue_nt as pt_nt, dt - ck + thue as pt, case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''V'' then ten_xx else '''' end as ten, case when ''' + @Language + '''<> ''V'' then ten_xx2 else '''' end as ten2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmxx b on a.ma = b.ma_xx order by a.ma'
	IF @Opject = 1 SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', 'kh')
	IF @Opject = 2 SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', 'vv')
	IF @Opject = 3 SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', 'bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vv20vvlkct
AS
	SELECT     v20vvlkct.*, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs AS ten_dvcs, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs2 AS ten_dvcs2, dbo.dmvv.ten_vv AS ten_vv, 
		                      dbo.dmvv.ten_vv2 AS ten_vv2, dbo.v20dmvvct.chi_tieu AS chi_tieu, dbo.v20dmvvct.chi_tieu2 AS chi_tieu2
		FROM         v20vvlkct LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmdvcs ON v20vvlkct.ma_dvcs = dbo.dmdvcs.ma_dvcs LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmvv ON v20vvlkct.ma_vv = dbo.dmvv.ma_vv LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.v20dmvvct ON v20vvlkct.ma_so = dbo.v20dmvvct.ma_so
		WHERE     (nam IN
		                          (SELECT     nam_bd
		                            FROM          dmstt))

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rpt03KK] --rs_rpt03KK
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @MonthFrom INT, @MonthTo INT, @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @t_tncn_thuc_chi VARCHAR(1)

	SELECT @t_tncn_thuc_chi = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_tncn_thuc_chi'

	IF @Type = '1' SELECT @MonthFrom = @Month, @MonthTo = @Month
	ELSE SELECT @MonthFrom = (@Month * 3 - 2), @MonthTo = (@Month * 3)

	SELECT 1 AS systotal, stt, stt_in, ma_so, ma_so_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu2
			, gia_tri AS tien, gia_tri AS tien_nt, bold, iscal, cach_tinh, truy_van, truy_van2, ids, nhom INTO #report
		FROM t03kk
		WHERE form = @Form --TT156

	SELECT systotal, ma_so, tien AS luy_ke, tien_nt AS luy_ke_nt INTO #lk FROM #report -- TT92

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- Blacklist
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec AS ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt, thue_nt, thue, thue_giam_nt, thue_giam, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct INTO #tmp FROM hrt01$0000 a

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ky between %k and %mTo'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrnv a with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'

	IF @Form IN ('3', '5') AND ISNULL(@t_tncn_thuc_chi, '0') = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @YearExt INT, @MonthFromExt INT, @MonthToExt INT
		SELECT @YearExt = @Year, @MonthFromExt = @MonthFrom, @MonthToExt = @MonthTo

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.cl_tntt_nt), sum(b.cl_tntt), sum(b.cl_thue_nt), sum(b.cl_thue), sum(b.cl_thue_giam_nt), sum(b.cl_thue_giam), sum(b.cl_tnct_nt), sum(b.cl_tnct)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrt09 b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where b.loai_tn <> '''' and b.nam = '+ LTRIM(@YearExt) + ' and ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', RTRIM(@MonthFromExt)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthToExt)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
		IF @MonthFrom = 1 AND @Type <> '1' BEGIN
			SET @MonthTo = @MonthTo - 1
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.tn_tt_nt), sum(b.tn_tt), sum(b.thue_nt), sum(b.thue), sum(b.thue_giam_nt), sum(b.thue_giam), sum(b.tn_ct_nt), sum(b.tn_ct)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @Year = CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 1 THEN (@Year - 1) ELSE @Year END
			, @MonthFrom = CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 1 THEN 12 ELSE (@MonthFrom - 1) END
			, @MonthTo = CASE @Type WHEN '1' THEN @MonthFrom ELSE CASE @MonthFrom WHEN 12 THEN @MonthFrom ELSE (@MonthTo - 1) END END
	END
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.tn_tt_nt), sum(b.tn_tt), sum(b.thue_nt), sum(b.thue), sum(b.thue_giam_nt), sum(b.thue_giam), sum(b.tn_ct_nt), sum(b.tn_ct)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', RTRIM(@MonthFrom)), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @truy_van VARCHAR(4000), @truy_van2 VARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @stt VARCHAR(10), @cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024), @iscal INT
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' OR truy_van <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = (' + @truy_van + '), tien_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien = 0 where tien is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set tien_nt = 0 where tien_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #report set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
				+ ', tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select tien_nt from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
				+ ', systotal = 0 where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	END
	CLOSE cur
	DEALLOCATE cur

	-- TT92
	IF @Form IN ('3', '5') BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmp
		IF @Form IN ('3', '5') AND ISNULL(@t_tncn_thuc_chi, '0') = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.cl_tntt_nt), sum(b.cl_tntt), sum(b.cl_thue_nt), sum(b.cl_thue), sum(b.cl_thue_giam_nt), sum(b.cl_thue_giam), sum(b.cl_tnct_nt), sum(b.cl_tnct)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt09 b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where b.nam = '+ LTRIM(@YearExt) + ' and ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', '1'), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthToExt)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.tn_tt_nt), sum(b.tn_tt), sum(b.thue_nt), sum(b.thue), sum(b.thue_giam_nt), sum(b.thue_giam), sum(b.tn_ct_nt), sum(b.tn_ct)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@YearExt - 1) + ' b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', '12'), '%mTo', '12') + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.tn_tt_nt), sum(b.tn_tt), sum(b.thue_nt), sum(b.thue), sum(b.thue_giam_nt), sum(b.thue_giam), sum(b.tn_ct_nt), sum(b.tn_ct)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@YearExt) + ' b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', '1'), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn, sum(b.tn_tt_nt), sum(b.tn_tt), sum(b.thue_nt), sum(b.thue), sum(b.thue_giam_nt), sum(b.thue_giam), sum(b.tn_ct_nt), sum(b.tn_ct)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from hrt01$'+ LTRIM(@Year) + ' b with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%k', '1'), '%mTo', RTRIM(@MonthTo)) + ' group by b.stt_rec, b.loai_tn'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		DECLARE cur2 CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' OR truy_van <> '' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN cur2
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur2 INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			IF @iscal = 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #lk set luy_ke = (' + @truy_van + '), luy_ke_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
				SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%table', '#tmp')
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #lk set luy_ke = 0 where luy_ke is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #lk set luy_ke_nt = 0 where luy_ke_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #lk set luy_ke = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select luy_ke from #lk where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
					+ ', luy_ke_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select luy_ke_nt from #lk where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
					+ ', systotal = 0 where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur2 INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
		END
		CLOSE cur2
		DEALLOCATE cur2
	END
Result:
	SELECT a.systotal, a.stt_in, a.ma_so_in as ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.bold, a.nhom, a.chi_tieu, a.chi_tieu2, b.luy_ke, b.luy_ke_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN #lk b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so ORDER BY a.stt, a.ma_so

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Posting$Post2GL]
	@sysData VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber0 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber1 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber2 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber3 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber4 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber5 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber6 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber7 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber8 VARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber9 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime0 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime1 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime2 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime3 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime4 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime5 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime6 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime7 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime8 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Datetime9 VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@deductible TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @dyn VARCHAR(32), @m$ VARCHAR(32), @d$ VARCHAR(32), @i$ VARCHAR(32), @c$ VARCHAR(32), @stt_rec CHAR(13), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @xstatus CHAR(1), @groupby VARCHAR(128), @dDatetime2 DATETIME
	DECLARE @ten_khthue NVARCHAR(512), @dia_chi_thue NVARCHAR(512), @ma_so_thue NVARCHAR(512), @LockDate SMALLDATETIME, @date_time2 DATETIME
	DECLARE @usedEI TINYINT, @usedEIVC VARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @date_time2 = GETDATE()

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND RTRIM(val) = '1')
		SELECT @usedEI = 1, @usedEIVC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
	ELSE
		SELECT @usedEI = 0, @usedEIVC = ''
	

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec AS xstt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(14)) AS xdatetime2 INTO #t1 FROM wrkgl
	
	SELECT @IDNumber0 = REPLACE(@IDNumber0, '''', ''), @IDNumber1 = REPLACE(@IDNumber1, '''', ''), @IDNumber2 = REPLACE(@IDNumber2, '''', ''), @IDNumber3 = REPLACE(@IDNumber3, '''', ''), 
		@IDNumber4 = REPLACE(@IDNumber4, '''', ''), @IDNumber5 = REPLACE(@IDNumber5, '''', ''), @IDNumber6 = REPLACE(@IDNumber6, '''', ''), 
		@IDNumber7 = REPLACE(@IDNumber7, '''', ''), @IDNumber8 = REPLACE(@IDNumber8, '''', ''), @IDNumber9 = REPLACE(@IDNumber9, '''', '')

	SET @s = 'DECLARE @i INT, @c VARCHAR(14), @d DATETIME'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = 1'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(''@IDNumber'') BEGIN'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'SET @c = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(''@Datetime'', @i)'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(''@IDNumber'', @i), '''' + @c + '''''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = @i + 1'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'END'

	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber0), '@Datetime', @Datetime0)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @IDNumber1 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber1), '@Datetime', @Datetime1); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber2 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber2), '@Datetime', @Datetime2); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber3 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber3), '@Datetime', @Datetime3); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber4 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber4), '@Datetime', @Datetime4); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber5 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber5), '@Datetime', @Datetime5); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber6 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber6), '@Datetime', @Datetime6); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber7 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber7), '@Datetime', @Datetime7); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber8 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber8), '@Datetime', @Datetime8); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
	IF @IDNumber9 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @IDNumber9), '@Datetime', @Datetime9); EXEC sp_executesql @q END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1 WHERE xstt_rec LIKE '%''%' OR xdatetime2 LIKE '%''%') RETURN

	-- Loai cac chung tu da chuyen trang thai khac va them mot so thong tin
	SELECT b.stt_rec, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.ma_dvcs, a.xdatetime2
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c.m$), 6) = '000000' THEN c.m$ ELSE c.m$ + LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.ngay_ct, 112), 6) END AS m$
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c.d$), 6) = '000000' THEN c.d$ ELSE c.d$ + LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.ngay_ct, 112), 6) END AS d$
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c.i$), 6) = '000000' THEN c.i$ ELSE c.i$ + LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.ngay_ct, 112), 6) END AS i$
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c.c$), 6) = '000000' THEN c.c$ ELSE c$ + '000000' END AS c$
			, datetime2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), datetime2, 112) + REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(hour, datetime2), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(minute, datetime2), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DATEPART(second, datetime2), 2), ' ', '0') AS cdatetime2
		INTO #t2 FROM #t1 a JOIN p00$000000 b ON a.xstt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN dmct9 c ON b.ma_ct = c.ma_ct

	-- Check ngay khoa so
	SELECT @LockDate = ngay_ks FROM dmstt
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2 WHERE ngay_ct <= @Lockdate) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 stt_rec AS message, 1 AS type FROM #t2 WHERE ngay_ct <= @Lockdate
		RETURN
	END
	-- Check ngay khoa so theo dvcs
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2 a JOIN dmdvcsks b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs WHERE b.ngay_ks IS NOT NULL AND a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 stt_rec AS message, 1 AS type FROM #t2 a JOIN dmdvcsks b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs WHERE b.ngay_ks IS NOT NULL AND a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks
		RETURN
	END
	-- Check truong hop chuyen sang trang thai khac, khong ton tai trong p00$000000
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 xstt_rec AS message, 2 AS type FROM #t1
		RETURN
	END
	-- Check truong hop chinh sua chung tu
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2 WHERE xdatetime2 <> cdatetime2) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 xstt_rec AS message, 2 AS type FROM #t1
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @glMaster NVARCHAR(256), @glDetail NVARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @glMaster = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gl_master'
	SELECT @glDetail = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gl_detail'
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS groupby INTO #voucherinfo FROM wrkgl
	SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #voucherinfo SELECT ma_ct, groupby FROM ' + RTRIM(@sysData) + '..voucherinfo'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112), 6), a.ma_ct, m$, d$, i$, c$, b.groupby, c.xstatus, a.datetime2 FROM #t2 a JOIN #voucherinfo b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct ORDER BY a.ma_ct, m$
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @stt_rec, @dyn, @ma_ct, @m$, @d$, @i$, @c$, @groupby, @xstatus, @dDatetime2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p00$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND datetime2 = @dDatetime2) BEGIN
			SELECT @stt_rec = REPLACE(@stt_rec, '''', '')
			IF @ma_ct IN ('HD1', 'HD2', 'HD3', 'HD4', 'HD6') SELECT @ten_khthue = REPLACE(RTRIM(ten_kh), '''', ''''''), @dia_chi_thue = REPLACE(RTRIM(dia_chi), '''', ''''''), @ma_so_thue = REPLACE(RTRIM(ma_so_thue), '''', '''''') FROM ctgt21 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec

			SELECT @q = CASE
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PK1', 'HD9', 'PN9') THEN 'exec fs_PostGLTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', 2, 1'

				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PT1', 'PT2') THEN 'exec fs_PostCRTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, null, 0, 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('BC1') THEN 'exec fs_PostCRTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, null, 1, 2'

				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PC1', 'PC2') THEN 'exec fs_PostCDTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, default, default, ' + RTRIM(@deductible) + ', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('BN1') THEN 'exec fs_PostCDTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, null, 1, ' + RTRIM(@deductible) + ', 2'

				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PN2') THEN 'exec fs_PostASTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PN1') THEN 'exec fs_PostAPTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, '''', 2'

				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('HDA') THEN 'exec fs_PostSVTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, '''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('HDF') THEN 'exec fs_PostSRTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PNA') THEN 'exec fs_PostPVTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, 0, '''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PNB') THEN 'exec fs_PostPMTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, 0, '''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PNC') THEN 'exec fs_PostPFTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, '''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PXC') THEN 'exec fs_PostPSTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PND') THEN 'exec fs_PostIRTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PXA') THEN 'exec fs_PostISTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PXB') THEN 'exec fs_PostITTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PNF') THEN 'exec fs_PostIPTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('PNG') THEN 'exec fs_PostPGTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, '''', 2'
					+ '; exec fs_PostPGTranEx ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''m84$000000'', ''d84$000000'', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'

				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('HD1') THEN 'exec fs_PostARTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', ''' + @ten_khthue + ''', ''' + @dia_chi_thue + ''', ''' + @ma_so_thue + ''', 2, '''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('HD2') THEN 'exec fs_PostSDTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', ''' + @ten_khthue + ''', ''' + @dia_chi_thue + ''', ''' + @ma_so_thue + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct IN ('HD3') THEN 'exec fs_PostGRTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', ''' + @ten_khthue + ''', ''' + @dia_chi_thue + ''', ''' + @ma_so_thue + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct = 'HD4' THEN 'exec fs_PostSPTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', ''' + @ten_khthue + ''', ''' + @dia_chi_thue + ''', ''' + @ma_so_thue + ''', 2, 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct = 'HD6' THEN 'exec fs_PostVATran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct = 'PNE' THEN 'exec fs_PostPATran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2, 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct = 'PKH' THEN 'exec fs_PostGCTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', 2'
				WHEN @ma_ct = 'PXD' THEN 'exec fs_PostPXTran ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @glMaster + ''', ''' + @glDetail + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @groupby + ''', 2'
			END

			-- After update
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec dbo.fs20_AfterUpdateGL ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @ma_ct + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @date_time2, 121) + ''''
			IF @ma_ct = 'PNG' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec dbo.rs_AfterUpdateGL4PXG ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''', ''' + @ma_ct + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)

			-- ct00 to r00
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO r00$' + @dyn + ' SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''''
			IF @ma_ct = 'PNG' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO r00$' + @dyn + ' SELECT * FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = ''' + LEFT(@stt_rec, 10) + 'PXG' + ''''

			-- Current customer balance
			IF @ma_ct IN ('PK1', 'PKH', 'PC1', 'PT1', 'BC1', 'BN1', 'HDA', 'HD1', 'HD2', 'HDF', 'HD3', 'HD4', 'HD6', 'PXC', 'HD9', 'PC2', 'PN2', 'PN9', 'PT2')
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$CurrentCustomerBalance ''r00$' + @dyn + ''', ''' + @stt_rec + ''', ''' + @ma_ct + ''', ''Edit'''

			-- Update voucher status
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @c$ + ' SET status = ''' + @xstatus + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @i$ + ' SET status = ''' + @xstatus + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @m$ + ' SET status = ''' + @xstatus + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @date_time2, 121) + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''''

			-- Update E-Invoice
			IF @usedEI = 1 AND CHARINDEX(@ma_ct, @usedEIVC) > 0 SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE hddt00$' + @dyn + ' SET status = ''' + @xstatus + ''' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''''
			
			--
			EXEC sp_executesql @q			
			DELETE p00$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @stt_rec, @dyn, @ma_ct, @m$, @d$, @i$, @c$, @groupby, @xstatus, @dDatetime2
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SELECT '' AS message, 0 as type

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_kho, c.ten_kho2, c.ma_dvcs, d.ten_dvt, d.ten_dvt2
