CREATE proc dbo.dt_checkoutobject
    @chObjectType  char(4),
    @vchObjectName varchar(255),
    @vchComment    varchar(255),
    @vchLoginName  varchar(255),
    @vchPassword   varchar(255),
    @iVCSFlags     int = 0,
    @iActionFlag   int = 0/* 0 => Checkout, 1 => GetLatest, 2 => UndoCheckOut */

as

	set nocount on

	declare @iReturn int
	declare @iObjectId int
	select @iObjectId =0

	declare @VSSGUID varchar(100)
	select @VSSGUID = 'SQLVersionControl.VCS_SQL'

	declare @iReturnValue int
	select @iReturnValue = 0

	declare @vchTempText varchar(255)

	/* this is for our strings */
	declare @iStreamObjectId int
	select @iStreamObjectId = 0

    declare @iPropertyObjectId int
    select @iPropertyObjectId = (select objectid from dbo.dtproperties where property = 'VCSProjectID')

    declare @vchProjectName   varchar(255)
    declare @vchSourceSafeINI varchar(255)
    declare @vchServerName    varchar(255)
    declare @vchDatabaseName  varchar(255)
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSProject',       @vchProjectName   OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSourceSafeINI', @vchSourceSafeINI OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLServer',     @vchServerName    OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLDatabase',   @vchDatabaseName  OUT

    if @chObjectType = 'PROC'
    begin
        /* Procedure Can have up to three streams
           Drop Stream, Create Stream, GRANT stream */

        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OACreate @VSSGUID, @iObjectId OUT

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iObjectId,
												'CheckOut_StoredProcedure',
												NULL,
												@sProjectName = @vchProjectName,
												@sSourceSafeINI = @vchSourceSafeINI,
												@sObjectName = @vchObjectName,
												@sServerName = @vchServerName,
												@sDatabaseName = @vchDatabaseName,
												@sComment = @vchComment,
												@sLoginName = @vchLoginName,
												@sPassword = @vchPassword,
												@iVCSFlags = @iVCSFlags,
												@iActionFlag = @iActionFlag

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError


        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAGetProperty @iObjectId, 'GetStreamObject', @iStreamObjectId OUT

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        create table #commenttext (id int identity, sourcecode varchar(255))


        select @vchTempText = 'STUB'
        while @vchTempText is not null
        begin
            exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iStreamObjectId, 'GetStream', @iReturnValue OUT, @vchTempText OUT
            if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError
            
            if (@vchTempText = '') set @vchTempText = null
            if (@vchTempText is not null) insert into #commenttext (sourcecode) select @vchTempText
        end

        select 'VCS'=sourcecode from #commenttext order by id
        select 'SQL'=text from syscomments where id = object_id(@vchObjectName) order by colid

    end

CleanUp:
    return

E_OAError:
    exec dbo.dt_displayoaerror @iObjectId, @iReturn
    GOTO CleanUp





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodCashFlowForecasting]
	@dateStart SMALLDATETIME,
	@reportType CHAR(1),
	@periodNum INT,
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Chi_tieu NVARCHAR(512), @Nguon_dl VARCHAR(2), @Cach_tinh VARCHAR(511), @Thu_chi CHAR(1), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Cuoi_ky TINYINT
	DECLARE @Ma_ct VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @Total NVARCHAR(511), @PeriodCol NVARCHAR(511), @ds_tk_pth VARCHAR(511), @ds_tk_ptr VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @p INT, @t INT, @c INT, @i INT, @j INT, @n INT, @m INT, @k INT, @o INT, @f INT
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @PeriodCol = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @ds_tk_pth = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_pth'
	SELECT @ds_tk_ptr = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_ptr'
	SELECT @ds_tk_pth = REPLACE(REPLACE(@ds_tk_pth, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @ds_tk_ptr = REPLACE(REPLACE(@ds_tk_ptr, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')

	SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk INTO #ds_tk_pth FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ds_tk_pth, ',')
	SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk INTO #ds_tk_ptr FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ds_tk_ptr, ',')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk INTO #ds_tk
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #BgAccts FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, tien, tien_nt INTO #kh FROM khdttuan

	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt INTO #report FROM bcdtky WHERE form = @formCode
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS id, ma_so, nguon_dl, thu_chi, ds_tk, ds_chi_tieu, cuoi_ky INTO #formReport FROM #report WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '2' ORDER BY stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS id, ma_so, ds_tk, cuoi_ky INTO #balReport FROM #report WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '1' ORDER BY stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS id, ma_so, cach_tinh, cuoi_ky INTO #formulaReport FROM #report WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt INTO #reportTmp FROM #report
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, tien, tien_nt INTO #result FROM #report
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, cuoi_ky INTO #resultTmp FROM #report

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	-- Key
	SELECT @xKey = '%date between ''%dFrom'' and ''%dTo''', @key = ''
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	--
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@unitKey) ELSE SELECT @unitKey = ISNULL(@unitKey, '')

	-- Data
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #BgAccts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dateStart, NULL, '', 1, 2, @userID, @admin, '', @unitKey
		CREATE INDEX i ON #BgAccts(tk)
	END

	--
	SELECT @p = 1, @dFrom = @dateStart
	WHILE (@p <= @periodNum) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #reportTmp
		--
		SELECT @dTo = CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN @dFrom + 6 WHEN '2' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dFrom) - 1 ELSE DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @dFrom) - 1 END
		SELECT @key = REPLACE(REPLACE(@xKey, '%dFrom', CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112)), '%dTo', CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dTo, 112))

		-- Bal
		SELECT @c = COUNT(id) FROM #balReport
		SELECT @t = 1
		WHILE (@t <= @c) BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_so = ma_so, @Ds_tk = REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_tk, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Cuoi_ky = cuoi_ky FROM #balReport WHERE id = @t
			--
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk
			INSERT INTO #ds_tk SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk, ',')
			--
			IF @p = 1
				INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT RTRIM(@Ma_so), SUM(ISNULL(a.du_no, 0) - ISNULL(a.du_co, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.du_no_nt, 0) - ISNULL(a.du_co_nt, 0)) FROM #BgAccts a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk)
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT RTRIM(@Ma_so), SUM(ISNULL(tien, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)) FROM #resultTmp WHERE cuoi_ky = 1 AND xPeriod = (@p - 1)
			--
			SELECT @t = @t + 1
		END
		INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT @p, ma_so, SUM(ISNULL(tien, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)), @Cuoi_ky FROM #reportTmp GROUP BY ma_so

		-- Scan Norm
		TRUNCATE TABLE #reportTmp
		SELECT @n = COUNT(id) FROM #formReport
		SELECT @i = 1
		WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_so = ma_so, @Nguon_dl = LTRIM(RTRIM(nguon_dl)), @Thu_chi = thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu = ds_chi_tieu, @Cuoi_ky = cuoi_ky FROM #formReport WHERE id = @i
			SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', ''''''), @Ds_chi_tieu = REPLACE(@Ds_chi_tieu, '''', '''''')
			--
			IF @Nguon_dl IN ('1', '2') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #reportTmp'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' select ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''', a.tt, a.tt_nt'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctdmku2 a with(nolock) left join dmku b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku left join dmkh c with(nolock) on b.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_ku = ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 1 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ' and ' + @key
				IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (exists(select 1 from dmkudv d with(nolock) where a.ma_ku = d.ma_ku and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'd.ma_dvcs') + ') or (b.ds_dvcs = ''''))'
				--
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_tt')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			IF @Nguon_dl IN ('3', '4') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #reportTmp'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' select ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''', t_tt0 - t_tt1, t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 3 THEN 'cttt20' ELSE 'cttt30' END + ' a with(nolock) left join dmtt b with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.loai_tt = 0 and ((t_tt0 - t_tt1 > 0) or (t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1 > 0)) and ' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from #ds_tk' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 3 THEN '_pth' ELSE '_ptr' END + ' tk where a.tk like tk.tk)'
				IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
				--
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'dateadd(day, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			IF @Nguon_dl IN ('5', '6') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #reportTmp'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' select ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''', a.tien, a.tien_nt'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctdmhd a with(nolock) left join dmhd b with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd left join dmkh c with(nolock) on b.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_hd = ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 5 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ' and ' + @key
				IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (exists(select 1 from dmhddv d with(nolock) where a.ma_hd = d.ma_hd and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'd.ma_dvcs') + ') or (b.ds_dvcs = ''''))'
				--
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.han_tt')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			IF @Nguon_dl IN ('7', '8') BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #kh
				SELECT @m = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ',')
				WHILE @m > 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @m, ',')
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct AND status = '1') BEGIN
						SELECT @j = CASE @Nguon_dl WHEN '7' THEN 12 ELSE 4 END, @k = 1
						WHILE @k <= @j BEGIN
							SELECT @q = 'insert into #kh'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_ct, a.tien%k, a.tien_nt%k'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN 'khdtthang' ELSE 'khdttuan' END + ' a with(nolock)'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @key + ' and a.ma_ct = ''' + @Ma_ct + ''''
							IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @unitKey
							SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN 'khdtthang' ELSE 'khdttuan' END + ' b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.nam = b.nam ' +
								CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.ky = b.ky' END + ' and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv group by nam, ' +
								CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN '' ELSE 'ky, ' END + 'ma_dvcs, ma_bp, ma_vv having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
							SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_dk%k'), '%k', REPLACE(STR(@k, 2), ' ', '0'))
							EXEC sp_executesql @q
							--
							SELECT @k = @k + 1
						END
					END
					--
					SELECT @m = @m - 1
				END
				--
				INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT RTRIM(@Ma_so), SUM(ISNULL(tien, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)) FROM #kh
			END
			--
			IF @Nguon_dl IN ('9', '10') BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #reportTmp'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' select ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''', ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 9 THEN 'a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt' ELSE 'a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt' END
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from m' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 9 THEN '57' ELSE '52' END + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.dong_tien_yn = 1 and ' + @key
				IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @unitKey
				SELECT @q = @q + ']%'
				--
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_ct')
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin
			END
			--
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #reportTmp WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so) INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT @Ma_so, 0, 0
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		--
		UPDATE #reportTmp SET tien = - a.tien, tien_nt = - a.tien_nt FROM #reportTmp a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.thu_chi = 0
		INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT @p, ma_so, SUM(ISNULL(tien, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)), @Cuoi_ky FROM #reportTmp GROUP BY ma_so

		-- Scan Formula
		SELECT @f = COUNT(id) FROM #formulaReport
		SELECT @o = 1
		WHILE (@o <= @f) BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_so = ma_so, @Cach_tinh = cach_tinh, @Cuoi_ky = cuoi_ky FROM #formulaReport WHERE id = @o
			SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
			--
			INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT @p, @Ma_so, 0, 0, @Cuoi_ky
			IF @Cach_tinh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #resultTmp set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(tien), 0) from #resultTmp where xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@p) + ' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@p) + ' and ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + CHAR(39)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SET @q = 'update #resultTmp set tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(tien_nt), 0) from #resultTmp where xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@p) + ' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@p) + ' and ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + CHAR(39)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			SELECT @o = @o + 1
		END
		--
		SELECT @p = @p + 1, @dFrom = @dTo + 1
	END

	-- Pivot
	SELECT DISTINCT xPeriod AS id, CASE WHEN @reportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END + RTRIM(xPeriod) AS name, RTRIM(@PeriodCol) + SPACE(1) + REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 2), ' ', '0') AS header INTO #pivot FROM #resultTmp ORDER BY xPeriod

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT 999, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.cuoi_ky FROM #resultTmp a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.kind = '1' AND xPeriod = 1
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT 999, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.cuoi_ky FROM #resultTmp a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.kind <> '1' AND xPeriod = (@p - 1) AND a.cuoi_ky = 1
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT 999, a.ma_so, SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), MAX(a.cuoi_ky) FROM #resultTmp a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.kind <> '1' AND a.cuoi_ky <> 1 GROUP BY a.ma_so
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pivot) INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT MAX(id) + 1, CASE WHEN @reportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END + RTRIM(MAX(id) + 1), @Total FROM #pivot

	-- View
	SELECT a.xPeriod
			, b.stt AS sysorder, b.in_ck AS sysprint, b.stt AS sysorder, CASE WHEN b.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.ma_so) AS xRow, REPLACE(STR(a.xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn
			, CASE WHEN xPeriod < 999 THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0'), 2) ELSE @Total END AS xColumnName
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.chi_tieu ELSE b.chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, b.ma_so, b.bold, CASE WHEN b.ma_so_in <> '' THEN b.ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in
			, a.tien, a.tien_nt
		FROM #resultTmp a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so ORDER BY a.xPeriod, b.stt, a.ma_so
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdtcdct
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.chi_tieu, b.chi_tieu2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_vv, d.ten_vv2
		FROM dbo.dtcdct a INNER JOIN dbo.dtdmct b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
			INNER JOIN dbo.dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			INNER JOIN dbo.dmvv d ON a.ma_vv = d.ma_vv	
		WHERE (
			a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt)
			AND a.ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs WHERE status = '1')
			AND a.ma_so IN (SELECT ma_so FROM dtdmct WHERE status = '1')
			AND a.ma_vv IN (SELECT ma_vv FROM dmvv WHERE status = '1')
			)
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_so

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetLockedProcess (@cType CHAR(3))
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @bRet BIT
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM msysprocesses a JOIN master..sysprocesses b ON a.spid = b.spid AND a.login_time = b.login_time WHERE a.type = @cType AND a.status = '1')
		SELECT @bRet = 1
	ELSE
		SELECT @bRet = 0
	RETURN @bRet
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrcttp] AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.loai, a.ly_do, a.tien, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan AS ma_bp, b.bp_ref, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
	FROM hrcttp a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunProductRequisition] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dM SMALLDATETIME, @userID INT, @admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Delete tables
	DELETE mpctyc WHERE nguon IN ('PO', 'PR', 'MO', 'PS')
	DELETE mpctyc WHERE nguon IN ('PS', 'MO', 'PL', 'FP') AND nxt = 2
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @nQRound INT, @dMin SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dh_hh INT, @ngay_nc_hh INT, @dBegin SMALLDATETIME, @d1 VARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @Count INT, @i INT, @m INT, @y INT, @p VARCHAR(6), @dtable VARCHAR(33), @mtable VARCHAR(33), @d0 SMALLDATETIME, @periodCode VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @ngay_dh_hh = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_dh_hh'
	SELECT @ngay_nc_hh = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_nc_hh'
	SELECT @periodCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'

	SELECT @dMin = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM phsx WHERE ngay_ct <= @dM AND status IN ('1', '2')
	SELECT @dMin = ISNULL(@dMin, @dNow), @dBegin = @dNow - @ngay_dh_hh, @d0 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@periodCode, @dNow, 0, 0)
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dBegin, 112)

	-- PO1
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt AS ma_sp, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_da_yc INTO #d94 FROM d94$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #p94 FROM c94$000000
	INSERT INTO #p94(m, y) SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct)FROM c94$000000 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dBegin AND @dM


	SELECT @i = 1, @Count = MAX(stt) FROM #p94

	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @m = m, @y = y FROM #p94 WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @p = RTRIM(@y) + REPLACE(STR(@m, 2), ' ', '0')
		SELECT @dtable = 'd94$' + @p, @mtable = 'm94$' + @p

		SET @q = 'insert into #d94 select a.ma_vt, case when a.ngay_giao is null then a.ngay_ct else a.ngay_giao end, a.so_ct, round((case when a.so_luong > a.sl_nhan then a.so_luong - a.sl_nhan else 0 end)*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.so_luong*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_nhan*a.he_so, @nQRound)'
			+ ' from ' + @dtable + ' a join ' + @mtable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.status in (''2'', ''3'') and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d1 + ''''
			+ ' and ((a.ngay_giao is null and a.ngay_ct >= @dNow) or (a.ngay_giao is not null and a.ngay_giao >= @dNow))'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@nQRound', @nQRound)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow smalldatetime', @dNow

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #d94 WHERE ngay_ct < @d0 OR ngay_ct > @dM

	-- PO2
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt AS ma_sp, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_da_yc INTO #d95 FROM d95$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #p95 FROM c95$000000
	INSERT INTO #p95(m, y) SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct)FROM c95$000000 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dBegin AND @dM

	SELECT @i = 1, @Count = MAX(stt) FROM #p95

	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @m = m, @y = y FROM #p95 WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @p = RTRIM(@y) + REPLACE(STR(@m, 2), ' ', '0')
		SELECT @dtable = 'd95$' + @p, @mtable = 'm95$' + @p

		SET @q = 'insert into #d95 select a.ma_vt, case when a.ngay_giao is null then a.ngay_ct else a.ngay_giao end, a.so_ct, round((case when a.so_luong > a.sl_nhan then a.so_luong - a.sl_nhan else 0 end)*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.so_luong*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_nhan*a.he_so, @nQRound)'
			+ ' from ' + @dtable + ' a join ' + @mtable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.status in (''2'', ''3'') and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d1 + ''''
			+ ' and ((a.ngay_giao is null and a.ngay_ct >= @dNow) or (a.ngay_giao is not null and a.ngay_giao >= @dNow))'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@nQRound', @nQRound)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow smalldatetime', @dNow

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #d95 WHERE ngay_ct < @d0 OR ngay_ct > @dM

	-- PR
	SELECT @dBegin = @dNow - @ngay_nc_hh
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt AS ma_sp, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_da_yc INTO #d91 FROM d91$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #p91 FROM c91$000000
	INSERT INTO #p91(m, y) SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct)FROM c91$000000 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dBegin AND @dM
	SELECT @i = 1, @Count = MAX(stt) FROM #p91

	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @m = m, @y = y FROM #p91 WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @p = RTRIM(@y) + REPLACE(STR(@m, 2), ' ', '0')
		SELECT @dtable = 'd91$' + @p, @mtable = 'm91$' + @p

		SET @q = 'insert into #d91 select a.ma_vt, case when a.ngay_yc is null then a.ngay_ct else a.ngay_yc end, a.so_ct, round((case when a.sl_duyet > a.sl_dh then a.sl_duyet - a.sl_dh else 0 end)*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_duyet*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_dh*a.he_so, @nQRound)'
			+ ' from ' + @dtable + ' a join ' + @mtable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.status in (''2'', ''3'') and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d1 + ''''
			+ ' and ((a.ngay_yc is null and a.ngay_ct >= @dNow) or (a.ngay_yc is not null and a.ngay_yc >= @dNow))'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@nQRound', @nQRound)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow smalldatetime', @dNow

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #d91 WHERE ngay_ct < @d0 OR ngay_ct > @dM

	-- PS
	SELECT so_dh, ma_sp, ngay_ct, ROUND(SUM(so_luong*he_so), @nQRound) AS so_luong
		INTO #khsx
		FROM mctkhsx
		WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNow AND @dM) AND status = '1' AND 1=0
		GROUP BY so_dh, ma_sp, ngay_ct


	-- MO
	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, b.ngay_th2, b.ngay_kh2, a.so_luong, a.he_so, b.ngay_kh1 INTO #lsx0
		FROM ctsx a JOIN phsx b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dMin AND @dM) AND b.status IN ('1', '2') AND ((b.ngay_kh2 IS NULL AND a.ngay_ct >= @dNow) OR (b.ngay_kh2 IS NOT NULL AND b.ngay_kh2 >= @dNow))

	SELECT dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct) AS so_lsx, MAX(a.so_ct) AS so_ct, a.ma_vt AS ma_sp, MAX(ISNULL(ISNULL(a.ngay_th2, a.ngay_kh2), a.ngay_ct)) AS ngay_ct, ROUND(SUM(a.so_luong*a.he_so), @nQRound) AS so_luong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_sx, MAX(a.ngay_kh1) AS ngay_kh1
		INTO #lsx FROM #lsx0 a GROUP BY dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct), a.ma_vt

	-- Receipt Item
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt AS ma_sp, so_lsx, sl_nhap AS so_luong INTO #ctnhap FROM wrkin

	SET @q = 'insert into #ctnhap select a.ma_vt, dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_lsx), sum(a.sl_nhap) from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and dbo.xf20_GetMO(so_lsx) in (select distinct so_lsx from #lsx) and sl_nhap <> 0 and so_lsx <> '''' and ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt)'
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.ma_vt, dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_lsx)'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dMin, @dNow, @userID, @admin

	UPDATE #lsx SET sl_sx = so_luong
	UPDATE #lsx SET so_luong = a.so_luong - b.so_luong FROM #lsx a JOIN #ctnhap b ON a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp
	DELETE #lsx WHERE so_luong <= 0

	-- Update
	-- PO1
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PO', '', ma_sp, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, so_luong, 0
				, 0, 0
				, 0, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_ct, '', 1, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d94 WHERE sl_da_yc < sl_dh


	-- PO2
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PO', '', ma_sp, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, so_luong, 0
				, 0, 0
				, 0, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_ct, '', 1, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d95 WHERE sl_da_yc < sl_dh

	-- PR
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PR', '', ma_sp, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, so_luong, 0
				, 0, 0
				, 0, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_ct, '', 1, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d91 WHERE sl_da_yc < sl_dh

	-- PS
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PS', '', ma_sp, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, so_luong, 0
				, 0, 0
				, 0, 0, 0, NULL
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_dh, '', 1, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #khsx
			WHERE 1=0
	-- MO
	INSERT INTO mpctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
				, ngay_ct0
				, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
				, sl_ton, sl_db
				, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
				, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'MO', so_lsx, ma_sp, ngay_ct
				, NULL
				, so_luong, 0
				, 0, 0
				--, 0, sl_sx, sl_sx - so_luong, dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(a.ngay_ct, b.tg_th +1)
				, 0, sl_sx, sl_sx - so_luong, ISNULL(a.ngay_kh1, dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(a.ngay_ct, b.tg_th +1))
				, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, so_ct, '', 1, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #lsx a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Adjustment$CreateDifference] @idNumber CHAR(32), @detail VARCHAR(32), @voucherCurrency VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @r1 INT, @r2 INT, @DownPayment VARCHAR(32), @Force INT = 0
AS BEGIN
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6)
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #cl select stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_ir, stt_rec0ir, so_luong, tien0, tien_nt0, 0, 0, '''', ''''' + 
		'from ' + @detail + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt_rec_ir <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_nx, tk_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) as ma_nt INTO #ref FROM d74$000000
	SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0ir as stt_rec0, CONVERT(CHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) AS ky INTO #p FROM c74$000000 a join #cl b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_ir
	
	SELECT @p = MIN(ky) FROM #p
	WHILE @P IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #ref select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_nx, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, c.ma_nt' +
			' from d74$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) join #p b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join m74$' + @p + ' c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @p = MIN(ky) FROM #p WHERE ky > @p
	END
	DELETE #cl FROM #cl a JOIN #ref b ON a.stt_rec_ir = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0ir = b.stt_rec0 WHERE @voucherCurrency <> @baseCurrency and b.ma_nt <> @voucherCurrency
	
	UPDATE #cl SET tien_cl = a.tien - CASE WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong or b.so_luong = 0 THEN b.tien ELSE ROUND(a.so_luong * b.tien / b.so_luong, @r1) END, 
			tien_cl_nt = a.tien_nt - CASE WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong  or b.so_luong = 0 THEN b.tien_nt ELSE ROUND(a.so_luong * b.tien_nt / b.so_luong, @r2) END,
			ma_nx = b.ma_nx, tk_vt = b.tk_vt
		FROM #cl a JOIN #ref b ON a.stt_rec_ir = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0ir = b.stt_rec0

	IF (@Force = 0 AND @DownPayment <> '' AND @DownPayment <> 'None') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #cl set tien_cl = a.tien_cl + b.cl from #cl a join ' + @DownPayment + ' b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckItemIssueNotInBOM] -- fs20_COCheckItemIssueNotInBOM
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1), @JoinDept NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dien_giai, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_ct, c.ten_ct2
		INTO #report
		FROM r70$000000 a left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'c.ct_nxt = ''2'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, tk_no, tk_co, ma_bp INTO #xdmytct FROM xdmytct
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmytct'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, rtrim(a.tk_no), rtrim(a.tk_co), rtrim(a.ma_bp) from xdmytct a join xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where b.kieu_yt = 1 and b.th_sp <> 1' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @JoinDept = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmytct WHERE ma_bp <> '') THEN ' and (a.ma_bp = '''' or d.ma_bp = '''' or a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp)' ELSE '' END

	IF @costUnit = '1' CREATE INDEX k ON #xdmytct(ma_dvcs, tk_no, tk_co)
		ELSE CREATE INDEX k ON #xdmytct(tk_no, tk_co)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dien_giai' 
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', b.ten_vt, '''' AS ten_vt2, c.ten_ct, '''' AS ten_ct2' ELSE ', '''' AS ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, '''' AS ten_ct, c.ten_ct2' END	
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' join #xdmytct d on ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs and ' ELSE '' END  + 'a.tk_du like d.tk_no and a.tk_vt like d.tk_co' + @JoinDept
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT ma_vt INTO #ctdm FROM ctdm WHERE (ngay_ct1 <= @DateFrom OR ngay_ct1 IS NULL) AND (ngay_ct2 >= @DateTo OR ngay_ct2 IS NULL) AND so_luong <> 0	
	DELETE #report WHERE EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt FROM #ctdm WHERE #report.ma_vt = #ctdm.ma_vt)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_vt0, ma_dvcs INTO #xdmvt2 FROM xdmvt2
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmvt2 select ma_vt, ma_vt0, ma_dvcs from xdmvt2 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	
	SELECT ma_vt, ma_dvcs INTO #item FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #ctdm)
	INSERT INTO #item SELECT ma_vt, ma_dvcs FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE ma_vt0 IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #ctdm)
	INSERT INTO #item SELECT ma_vt0, ma_dvcs FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #ctdm)
	INSERT INTO #item SELECT ma_vt0, ma_dvcs FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE ma_vt0 IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #ctdm)
	DELETE #xdmvt2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt FROM #item WHERE #xdmvt2.ma_dvcs = #item.ma_dvcs AND (#xdmvt2.ma_vt = #item.ma_vt OR #xdmvt2.ma_vt0 = #item.ma_vt))
	DELETE #report WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE #xdmvt2.ma_dvcs = #report.ma_dvcs AND #xdmvt2.ma_vt = #report.ma_vt)
	DELETE #report WHERE EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt0 FROM #xdmvt2 WHERE #xdmvt2.ma_dvcs = #report.ma_dvcs AND #xdmvt2.ma_vt0 = #report.ma_vt)
	
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ma_dvcs, stt_rec, stt_rec0

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_GetERD]
	@cAccount VARCHAR(32), 
	@nMethod TINYINT,
	@nType TINYINT,
	@dVC SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cCust VARCHAR(32), 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1024),
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@nCFC NUMERIC(28, 6), 
	@cVC CHAR(12), 
	@CalcUnit TINYINT = 0,
	@rateOuput NUMERIC(24, 12) OUTPUT,
	@table VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), 
		@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @nDr TINYINT, 
		@nBAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nBFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), 
		@nDFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRound TINYINT, @nRRound TINYINT, @xUnit VARCHAR(1024), 


		-- FIFO Method
		@nCRAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFCCRAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDRAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFCDRAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nxFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nxAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), 
		@dNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @cSo_ct VARCHAR (33), @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), 
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), 

		@RAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @RFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6)



	-- Set
	SELECT @cAccount = REPLACE(@cAccount, '''', ''), @cCust = REPLACE(@cCust, '''', ''), @cUnit = REPLACE(@cUnit, '''', ''), @cIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, '''', '')
	IF @CalcUnit = 0 SELECT @cUnit = '', @UnitKey = ''
		ELSE SELECT @UnitKey = 'ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cUnit), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey <> '' SELECT @Key = ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT @nDr = tk_cn FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
	SELECT @xUnit = RTRIM(@cUnit) + '%'
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nRRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 du_no00*0 AS du, du_no_nt00*0 AS du_nt INTO #t FROM cdtk



	IF @nMethod = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @dFrom = DATEADD(Day, 1 - DAY(@dVC), @dVC), @dTo = DATEADD(Day, -1, DATEADD(Month, 1, @dFrom))
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t

		-- By Unit
		IF @nDr = 0 INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dFrom, NULL, @cAccount, 1, 1, 1, 1, '', @UnitKey
			ELSE INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dFrom, NULL, @cAccount, @cCust, 1, 1, 1, 1, '', @UnitKey

		IF @table <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #t select ps, ps_nt from ' + @table + ' where tk = ''' + @cAccount + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END




		SELECT @nBAmount = SUM(du), @nBFCAmount = SUM(du_nt) FROM #t
		SELECT @nBAmount = ISNULL(@nBAmount, 0), @nBFCAmount = ISNULL(@nBFCAmount, 0)

		IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
			IF @nDr = 1 BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct)) ' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and a.ps_co <> 0 and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
					' and ((((loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0)) or (sua_tg_yn = 1))) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and a.ps_co <> 0 and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
					' and ((sua_tg_yn = 1) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #t
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
				' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
				' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and (a.ps_no + a.ps_no_nt <> 0) and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
				' and ((((loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0)) or (sua_tg_yn = 1))) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + 
				@Key + 
				']%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

			SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
		END


		SELECT @RAmount = ISNULL(@RAmount, 0), @RFCAmount = ISNULL(@RFCAmount, 0)
		IF @nDr = 0 BEGIN
			IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + '''' + 
					@Key + CASE WHEN @table <> '' THEN ' and stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + '''' ELSE '' END + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @nBAmount = - @nBAmount, @nBFCAmount = - @nBFCAmount, @RAmount = - @RAmount, @RFCAmount = - @RFCAmount
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + '''' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN -- @nDr = 1
			IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @nBAmount = - @nBAmount, @nBFCAmount = - @nBFCAmount, @RAmount = - @RAmount, @RFCAmount = - @RFCAmount
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END

		SELECT @nDAmount = ISNULL(@nDAmount, 0), @nDFCAmount = ISNULL(@nDFCAmount, 0)
		SELECT @nBAmount = @nBAmount + @nDAmount - @RAmount, @nBFCAmount = @nBFCAmount + @nDFCAmount - @RFCAmount
		
		SELECT @nRate = CASE WHEN @nBFCAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nBAmount/@nBFCAmount, @nRRound) END
	END -- End @nMethod = 1



	IF @nMethod = 4 BEGIN			
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t
		IF @nDr = 0 INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dVC, @cUnit, @cAccount, 1, 1, 1, 1, '', @UnitKey
			ELSE INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dVC, @cUnit, @cAccount, @cCust, 1, 1, 1, 1, '', @UnitKey
		
		IF @table <> '' BEGIN			
			SET @q = 'insert into #t select ps, ps_nt from ' + @table + ' where tk = ''' + @cAccount + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END	
		
		SELECT @nBAmount = SUM(du), @nBFCAmount = SUM(du_nt) FROM #t
		SELECT @nBAmount = ISNULL(@nBAmount, 0), @nBFCAmount = ISNULL(@nBFCAmount, 0)


		--
		IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
			IF @nDr = 1 BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct)) ' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and a.ps_co <> 0 and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
					' and ((((loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0)) or (sua_tg_yn = 1))) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + @Key 
				EXEC sp_executesql @q									

				SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and a.ps_co <> 0 and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
					' and ((sua_tg_yn = 1) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + @Key					
						
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #t
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' + 
				' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112)+ ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
				' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''' and a.stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and (a.ps_no + a.ps_no_nt <> 0) and (' + RTRIM(@nDr) + ' = 0 or ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''')' + 
				' and ((((loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0)) or (sua_tg_yn = 1))) or (ma_ct = ''PK2''))' + @Key 								
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @RAmount = du, @RFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
		END


		SELECT @RAmount = ISNULL(@RAmount, 0), @RFCAmount = ISNULL(@RFCAmount, 0)
		--
						
		IF @nDr = 0 BEGIN
			IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct)) ' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + '''' + 
					@Key + CASE WHEN @table <> '' THEN ' and stt_rec <> ''' + @cIDNumber + '''' ELSE '' END 
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				
				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @nBAmount = - @nBAmount, @nBFCAmount = - @nBFCAmount					
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + '''' + 
					@Key 
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN -- @nDr = 1
			IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''' and a.ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END ELSE BEGIN				
				SELECT @nBAmount = - @nBAmount, @nBFCAmount = - @nBFCAmount, @RAmount = - @RAmount, @RFCAmount = - @RFCAmount
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
					' from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dVC, 112) + ' a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and a.ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''' and a.ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @nDAmount = du, @nDFCAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			END
		END

		SELECT @nDAmount = ISNULL(@nDAmount, 0), @nDFCAmount = ISNULL(@nDFCAmount, 0)
		SELECT @nBAmount = @nBAmount + @nDAmount - @RAmount, @nBFCAmount = @nBFCAmount + @nDFCAmount - @RFCAmount

		SELECT @nRate = CASE WHEN @nBFCAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nBAmount/@nBFCAmount, @nRRound) END
	END -- End @nMethod = 4



	IF @nMethod = 3 BEGIN
		SELECT @nxAmount = 0, @nxFCAmount = 0, @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dVC)
		IF @nDr = 0 BEGIN
			-- Pay
			TRUNCATE TABLE #t
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
				' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
				' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and stt_rec <> ''' + RTRIM(@cIDNumber) + ''' and (so_ct <= ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@cVC, '''', '''''')) + ''' or ngay_ct < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''')' + 
				@Key + 
				']%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1
			

			SELECT @nCRAmount = du, @nFCCRAmount = du_nt FROM #t
			SELECT @nCRAmount = ISNULL(@nCRAmount, 0), @nFCCRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCCRAmount, 0)

			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust)
				SELECT @nCRAmount = @nCRAmount + SUM(du_co00), @nFCCRAmount = @nFCCRAmount + SUM(du_co_nt00) FROM  cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust

			SELECT @nDRAmount = SUM(du_no00), @nFCDRAmount = SUM(du_no_nt00) FROM cdtk WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit
			SELECT @nDRAmount = ISNULL(@nDRAmount, 0), @nFCDRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCDRAmount, 0)

			-- Receipt
			SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt INTO #ct00tmp FROM r00$000000
			
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00tmp select ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt' + 
				' from r00$%Partition with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
				' where %[tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ps_no_nt > 0' + 
				@Key + 
				']%' + 
				' order by ngay_ct, so_ct'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1
			
			IF @nFCDRAmount > 0 INSERT #ct00tmp (ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt) VALUES (@dFrom -1, '', @nDRAmount, @nFCDRAmount)

			-- Scan	
			DECLARE csct00tmp CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt FROM #ct00tmp ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct
			SET @nCFC = @nCFC + @nFCCRAmount
			OPEN csct00tmp
			FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				IF @nPs_no_nt < @nCFC BEGIN
					SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_no_nt, 
						@nxAmount = @nxAmount + @nPs_no, 
						@nCFC = @nCFC - @nPs_no_nt
				END ELSE IF @nPs_no_nt = @nCFC BEGIN
					SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_no_nt, 
						@nxAmount  = @nxAmount + @nPs_no, 
						@nCFC = 0
					BREAK
				END ELSE IF @nPs_no_nt > @nCFC BEGIN
					SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nCFC, 
						@nxAmount = @nxAmount + ROUND(@nCFC*(@nPs_no/@nPs_no_nt), @nRound), 
						@nCFC = 0
					BREAK
				END
				FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt
			END
			CLOSE csct00tmp
			DEALLOCATE csct00tmp

			IF @nCFC = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @nxAmount = @nxAmount - @nCRAmount, 
					@nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount - @nFCCRAmount, 
					@nRate = CASE WHEN @nxFCAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nxAmount/@nxFCAmount, @nRRound) END
			END
			-- End Scan

		 -- End @nDr = 0
		END ELSE BEGIN -- @nDr = 1
			IF LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and stt_rec <> ''' + RTRIM(@cIDNumber) + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''' and (so_ct <= ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@cVC, '''', '''''')) + ''' or ngay_ct < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''')' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1

				SELECT @nCRAmount = du, @nFCCRAmount = du_nt FROM #t
				SELECT @nCRAmount = ISNULL(@nCRAmount, 0), @nFCCRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCCRAmount, 0)

				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust)
					SELECT @nCRAmount = @nCRAmount + SUM(du_co00), @nFCCRAmount = @nFCCRAmount + SUM(du_co_nt00) FROM  cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust

				SELECT @nDRAmount = SUM(du_no00), @nFCDRAmount = SUM(du_no_nt00) FROM cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust
				SELECT @nDRAmount = ISNULL(@nDRAmount, 0), @nFCDRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCDRAmount, 0)

				-- Receipt							
				SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt INTO #ct00tmp1 FROM r00$000000

				SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00tmp1 select ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt' + 
					' from r00$%Partition with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ps_no_nt > 0 and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key + 
					']%' + 
					' order by ngay_ct, so_ct'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1

				IF @nFCDRAmount > 0 INSERT #ct00tmp1(ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no, ps_no_nt) VALUES (@dFrom - 1,'' ,@nDRAmount, @nFCDRAmount)
				SET @nCFC = @nCFC + @nFCCRAmount

				DECLARE csCt00Tmp1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #Ct00Tmp1 ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct
				-- Scan
				OPEN csct00tmp1
				FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp1 INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
					IF @nPs_no_nt < @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_no_nt, 
							@nxAmount = @nxAmount + @nPs_no, 
							@nCFC = @nCFC - @nPs_no_nt
					END ELSE IF @nPs_no_nt = @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_no_nt, 
							@nxAmount  = @nxAmount + @nPs_no, 
							@nCFC = 0
						BREAK
					END ELSE IF @nPs_no_nt > @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nCFC, 
							@nxAmount = @nxAmount + ROUND(@nCFC*(@nPs_no/@nPs_no_nt), @nRound), 
							@nCFC = 0
						BREAK
					END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp1 INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt
				END
				CLOSE csct00tmp1
				DEALLOCATE csct00tmp1

				IF @nCFC = 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @nxAmount = @nxAmount - @nCRAmount, 
						@nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount - @nFCCRAmount, 
						@nRate = CASE WHEN @nxFCAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nxAmount/@nxFCAmount, @nRRound) END
				END

			 -- End LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '1' OR LEFT(@cAccount,1) = '2'
			END ELSE BEGIN							
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' + 
					' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[a.tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and stt_rec <> ''' + RTRIM(@cIDNumber) + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + ''' and (so_ct <= ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@cVC, '''', '''''')) + ''' or ngay_ct < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dVC, 112) + ''')' + 
					@Key + 
					']%'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1

				SELECT @nCRAmount = du, @nFCCRAmount = du_nt FROM #t
				SELECT @nCRAmount = ISNULL(@nCRAmount, 0), @nFCCRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCCRAmount, 0)

				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust)
					SELECT @nCRAmount = @nCRAmount + SUM(du_no00), @nFCCRAmount = @nFCCRAmount + SUM(du_no_nt00) FROM  cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust

				SELECT @nDRAmount = SUM(du_co00), @nFCDRAmount = SUM(du_co_nt00) FROM cdkh WHERE tk = @cAccount AND nam = YEAR(@dVc) AND ma_dvcs LIKE @xUnit AND ma_kh = @cCust
				SELECT @nDRAmount = ISNULL(@nDRAmount, 0), @nFCDRAmount = ISNULL(@nFCDRAmount, 0)
				
				-- Receipt							
				SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00tmp2 FROM r00$000000

				SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00tmp2 select ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_co, ps_co_nt' + 
					' from r00$%Partition with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + 
					' where %[tk = ''' + RTRIM(@cAccount) + ''' and ps_co_nt > 0 and ma_kh = ''' + RTRIM(@cCust) + '''' + 
					@Key + 
					']%' + 
					' order by ngay_ct, so_ct'
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dVC, 1, 1

				IF @nFCDRAmount > 0 INSERT #ct00tmp2 (ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES (@dFrom - 1 ,'', @nDRAmount, @nFCDRAmount)
				SET @nCFC = @nCFC + @nFCCRAmount

				DECLARE csCt00Tmp2 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #Ct00Tmp2 
				-- Scan
				OPEN csct00tmp2
				FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp2 INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
					IF @nPs_co_nt < @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_co_nt, 
							@nxAmount  = @nxAmount + @nPs_co, 
							@nCFC = @nCFC - @nPs_co_nt
					END ELSE IF @nPs_co_nt = @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nPs_co_nt, 
							@nxAmount = @nxAmount + @nPs_co, 
							@nCFC = 0
						BREAK
					END ELSE IF @nPs_co_nt > @nCFC BEGIN
						SELECT @nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount + @nCFC, 
							@nxAmount = @nxAmount + ROUND(@nCFC*(@nPs_co/@nPs_co_nt), @nRound), 
							@nCFC = 0
						BREAK
					END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM csct00tmp2 INTO @dNgay_ct,@cSo_ct, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt
				END
				CLOSE csct00tmp2
				DEALLOCATE csct00tmp2

				IF @nCFC = 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @nxAmount = @nxAmount - @nCRAmount, 
						@nxFCAmount = @nxFCAmount - @nFCCRAmount, 
						@nRate = CASE WHEN @nxFCAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nxAmount/@nxFCAmount, @nRRound) END
				END
			END	
		-- End	
		END -- End @nDr = 1
	END -- End @nMethod = 3



	SELECT @rateOuput = ISNULL(@nRate, 0)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ErrorLog]
	@errorCode INT,
	@action VARCHAR(33),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(33),
	@userID INT,
	@Message NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @sysDatabaseName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@sysDatabaseName, '''', ''), ' ', ''), '[', ''), ']', '')
	DECLARE @logDay INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyCheck CHAR(16), @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @keyCheck = LOWER(LEFT(REPLACE(NEWID(), '-', ''), 16))

	SELECT @q = 'select @d = getdate() - logday from [' + @sysDatabaseName + ']..syspara'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime output', @d OUTPUT
	DELETE loghddt WHERE datetime0 <= @d

	INSERT INTO loghddt (id, error_code, action, datetime0, user_id0, mess_text) SELECT @keyCheck, @errorCode, @action, GETDATE(), @userID, @Message

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSDetail] --fs20_FXDetailReport--
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Type AS CHAR(1),
	@FaType AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group NVARCHAR(256),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @Type = '1'
		IF @Period = 1 SELECT @Period = 12, @Year = @Year -1 ELSE SELECT @Period = @Period - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp AS fx_ma_bp,
			a.nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh AS gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt AS gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl AS gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt AS gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt,
			b.loai_ts AS loai_cc, b.ngay_mua AS ngay_mua, b.so_ky_kh AS so_ky_kh,
			b.ma_nt AS ma_nt, b.ty_gia AS ty_gia, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2
		INTO #report FROM ctkhcc a, dmcc b

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp as fx_ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt, sum(a.gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh, sum(a.gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt, sum(a.gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(a.gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt, sum(a.gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(a.gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.loai_ts) as loai_cc, max(b.ngay_mua) as ngay_mua, max(b.so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(b.ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(b.ty_gia) as ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_ts)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_ts2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Ko lên những công cụ đã khai báo giảm trong kỳ
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_giam BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts, fx_ma_bp', 'INT, #, &ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + ', ' + 'so_the_ts'
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'so_the_ts', '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_the_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ten_ts, ten_ts2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from  #report order by ' + CASE WHEN @Group <> '' THEN @Group + ', ' ELSE '' END + 'sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPAutoGenerateCalendar]
	@GenKey VARCHAR(32),
	@Year INT,
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT
	DECLARE @date SMALLDATETIME

	SET @date = @dateFrom
	WHILE @date < dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(12, @Year) BEGIN
		IF dbo.ff_Inlist(DATEPART(dw, @date), @GenKey) = 1 BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT ngay_nghi FROM mdmlichlv WHERE ngay_nghi = @date)
				INSERT INTO mdmlichlv (ngay_nghi, dien_giai, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
						, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
						, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
					VALUES(@date, N'', 0, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END
		ELSE
			IF 0 = (SELECT status FROM mdmlichlv WHERE ngay_nghi = @date)
				DELETE mdmlichlv WHERE ngay_nghi = @date
		SET @date = DATEADD(Day, 1, @date)
	END	
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_Convert2AccountBalanceFromCustomerBalance4Unit 
	@nYear INT, 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(33)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Chuyen doi tu can doi khach hang sang can doi tai khoan
	DECLARE @nMonth TINYINT, @nStartMonth TINYINT
	SELECT @nMonth = MONTH(Ngay_dn2), @nStartMonth = MONTH(Ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt
	INSERT INTO Cdtk (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT nam, ma_dvcs, tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '1', NULL, NULL, 1, 1 FROM cdkh
			WHERE nam = @nYear
			GROUP BY nam, ma_dvcs, tk
			HAVING STR(nam, 4) + ma_dvcs + tk NOT IN (SELECT STR(nam, 4) + ma_dvcs + tk FROM cdtk)
	
	IF @nStartMonth = @nMonth
		UPDATE cdtk SET
			du_no00 = a.Du_no00, 
			du_co00 = a.Du_co00, 
			du_no_nt00 = a.Du_no_nt00, 
			du_co_nt00 = a.Du_co_nt00, 
			du_no1 = a.Du_no00, 
			du_co1 = a.Du_co00, 
			du_no_nt1 = a.Du_no_nt00, 
			du_co_nt1 = a.Du_co_nt00
		FROM cdtk JOIN (
				SELECT Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk, SUM(Du_no00) AS Du_no00, SUM(Du_co00) AS Du_co00
					, SUM(Du_no_nt00) AS Du_no_nt00, SUM(Du_co_nt00) AS Du_co_nt00
					FROM Cdkh WITH (INDEX(nam))
					GROUP BY Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk
					HAVING Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1 AND Tk_cn <> 0)
			) a ON a.Nam = cdtk.Nam AND a.Tk = cdtk.Tk AND a.Ma_dvcs = cdtk.Ma_dvcs
		WHERE cdtk.Nam = @nYear AND cdtk.Ma_dvcs = @cUnit
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_CN_DN' AND val = 1)
				UPDATE cdtk SET
					du_no00 = a.Du_no00, 
					du_co00 = a.Du_co00, 
					du_no_nt00 = a.Du_no_nt00, 
					du_co_nt00 = a.Du_co_nt00
				FROM cdtk JOIN (
						SELECT Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk, SUM(Du_no00) AS Du_no00, SUM(Du_co00) AS Du_co00
							, SUM(Du_no_nt00) AS Du_no_nt00, SUM(Du_co_nt00) AS Du_co_nt00
							FROM Cdkh WITH (INDEX(nam))
							GROUP BY Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk
							HAVING Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1 AND Tk_cn <> 0)
					) a ON a.Nam = cdtk.Nam AND a.Tk = cdtk.Tk AND a.Ma_dvcs = cdtk.Ma_dvcs
				WHERE cdtk.Nam = @nYear AND cdtk.Ma_dvcs = @cUnit
			ELSE
				UPDATE cdtk SET
					du_no00 = a.Du_no00, 
					du_co00 = a.Du_co00, 
					du_no_nt00 = a.Du_no_nt00, 
					du_co_nt00 = a.Du_co_nt00, 
					du_no1 = a.Du_no1, 
					du_co1 = a.Du_co1, 
					du_no_nt1 = a.Du_no_nt1, 
					du_co_nt1 = a.Du_co_nt1
					FROM cdtk JOIN (
							SELECT Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk, SUM(Du_no00) AS Du_no00, SUM(Du_co00) AS Du_co00
								, SUM(Du_no_nt00) AS Du_no_nt00, SUM(Du_co_nt00) AS Du_co_nt00
								, SUM(Du_no1) AS Du_no1, SUM(Du_co1) AS Du_co1
								, SUM(Du_no_nt1) AS Du_no_nt1, SUM(Du_co_nt1) AS Du_co_nt1
								FROM Cdkh WITH (INDEX(nam))
								GROUP BY Nam, Ma_dvcs, Tk
								HAVING Nam = @nYear AND Ma_dvcs = @cUnit AND Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1 AND Tk_cn <> 0)
						) a ON a.Nam = cdtk.Nam AND a.Tk = cdtk.Tk AND a.Ma_dvcs = cdtk.Ma_dvcs
					WHERE cdtk.Nam = @nYear AND cdtk.Ma_dvcs = @cUnit
			
		END
	

	UPDATE cdtk SET
				cdtk.du_no00 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_co00 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_no_nt00 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_co_nt00 = 0,
				cdtk.du_no1 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_co1 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_no_nt1 = 0, 
				cdtk.du_co_nt1 = 0
		WHERE Nam = @nYear AND Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM dmtk WHERE Tk_cn <> 0) 
			AND STR(nam, 4) + ma_dvcs + tk NOT IN (SELECT STR(nam, 4) + ma_dvcs + tk FROM cdkh)
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$ChangeCodeID] 
	@coCode NVARCHAR(32), 
	@cnCode NVARCHAR(32), 
	@strList VARCHAR(1024), 
	@sRejectedTables VARCHAR(1024), 
	@sDeletedDuplicateTables VARCHAR(1024), 
	@nDebugMode TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @coCode = @cnCode OR @strList = '' RETURN

	DECLARE @cCode VARCHAR(30), @nStart SMALLINT, @cTable VARCHAR(30), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @sPKFields VARCHAR(128), @sNFields VARCHAR(8000), @isOk BIT, @sJoin VARCHAR(128), @cP VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @xtype NUMERIC(1), @sPrint NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF RIGHT(RTRIM(@strList), 1) <> ',' SELECT @strList = RTRIM(@strList) + ','
	
	CREATE TABLE #t(value NUMERIC(10))
	IF @nDebugMode = 1 CREATE TABLE #rs(xtype NUMERIC(1), xtable VARCHAR(30), xvalue NVARCHAR(4000))
	
	SET @nStart = 1
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList, @nStart) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @cCode = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
		SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList, @nStart) + 1

		IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist('#', @sRejectedTables) = 0
			DECLARE crCode CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects
				WHERE xType = 'U' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM syscolumns WHERE name = @cCode) 
					AND name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM syscodechangedeclare WHERE xtype = 1) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(name, @sRejectedTables) = 0
		ELSE
			DECLARE crCode CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects
				WHERE xType = 'U' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM syscolumns WHERE name = @cCode) 
					AND name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM syscodechangedeclare WHERE xtype = 1) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(name, @sRejectedTables) = 1
	
		OPEN crCode
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			--
			SELECT @sPKFields = NULL
			SELECT @sPKFields= ISNULL(@sPKFields, '') + column_name + ', '
				FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
				WHERE table_name = @cTable AND constraint_name IN (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype = 'PK')

			IF NOT @sPKFields IS NULL SELECT @sPKFields = RTRIM(LEFT(@sPKFields, LEN(@sPKFields)-1))
			SELECT @isOk = 0
			--
			IF @sPKFields IS NULL 
				SELECT @isOk = 1
			ELSE
				IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cCode, @sPKFields) = 0 SELECT @isOk = 1
			--
			IF @isOk = 0 BEGIN
				-- Check duplicate records
				SET @strSQL = 'DECLARE @n1 NUMERIC(10), @n2 NUMERIC(10)'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @n1 = @@ROWCOUNT'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @n2 = @@ROWCOUNT'
				SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT CASE WHEN @n1 = @n2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value'

				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sPKFields', @sPKFields)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTable', @cTable)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cCode', @cCode)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cnCode', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cnCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@coCode', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@coCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))

				DELETE #t
				INSERT INTO #t (value) EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #t WHERE value = 1) SELECT @isOk = 1
			END
			--
			IF @isOk = 1 BEGIN -- No duplicate
				SET @xtype = 1
				SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cnCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39) + '  WHERE ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@coCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39)
			END ELSE BEGIN
				--
				SELECT @sNFields = NULL SELECT @sNFields = ISNULL(@sNFields, '') + column_name + ' = a.' + column_name + ' + b.' + column_name + ', '
					FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
					WHERE table_name = @cTable AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(column_name, @sPKFields) = 0
						AND data_type IN ('bigint', 'decimal', 'float', 'int', 'money', 'numeric', 'real', 'smallint', 'smallmoney', 'tinyint')
	
				IF NOT @sNFields IS NULL SELECT @sNFields = RTRIM(LEFT(@sNFields, LEN(@sNFields)-1))

				SELECT @i = 1, @sJoin = ''
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@sPKFields) BEGIN
					SET @cP = RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sPKFields, @i)))
					IF @i > 1 SET @sJoin = @sJoin + ' AND '
					SET @sJoin = @sJoin + 'a.' + @cP + ' = b.' + @cP
					SET @i = @i + 1
				END
				IF (dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cTable, @sDeletedDuplicateTables) = 1) OR (@sNFields IS NULL) BEGIN -- Delete duplicate records
					SET @xtype = 3
					SET @strSQL = 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT * INTO #tmpDel FROM #tmpData'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE #tmpDel FROM #tmpDel a LEFT JOIN #tmpGroup b ON @sJoin WHERE b.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE @cTable FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
				END ELSE BEGIN -- Total on PK fields before delete duplicate records
					SET @xtype = 2
					SET @strSQL = 'SELECT @sPKFields INTO #tmpData FROM @cTable WHERE @cCode = @coCode OR @cnCode = @cnCode'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT * INTO #tmpDel FROM #tmpData'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpData SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT DISTINCT @sPKFields INTO #tmpGroup FROM #tmpData'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE #tmpDel FROM #tmpDel a LEFT JOIN #tmpGroup b ON @sJoin WHERE b.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'SELECT a.* INTO #tmpUpdate FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE #tmpUpdate SET @cCode  = @cnCode WHERE @cCode = @coCode'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'UPDATE @cTable SET @sNFields FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpUpdate b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @cnCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DELETE @cTable FROM @cTable a JOIN #tmpDel b ON @sJoin WHERE a.@cCode = @coCode AND a.@cCode IS NOT NULL'
				END
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sNFields', @sNFields)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sPKFields', @sPKFields)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTable', @cTable)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cCode', @cCode)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@sJoin', @sJoin)
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cnCode', CHAR(39) + @cnCode + CHAR(39))
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@coCode', CHAR(39) + @coCode + CHAR(39))
			END

			SET @sPrint = '-- ' + @cTable + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + @strSQL

			IF @nDebugMode = 0 EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			IF @nDebugMode = 1 INSERT INTO #rs(xtype, xtable, xvalue) VALUES (@xtype, @cTable, @strSQL)
			IF @nDebugMode = 2 PRINT @strSQL
			IF @nDebugMode = 3 AND @xtype <> 1 PRINT @sPrint

			FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable		
		END
		CLOSE crCode
		DEALLOCATE crCode
	END
	
	IF @nDebugMode = 1 SELECT * FROM #rs ORDER BY xtype

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptNumberLaborFluctuationNotification]		
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,	
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Join NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @dFrom VARCHAR(8), @dTo VARCHAR(8), @Form VARCHAR(33), @Where NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @HRM050 NVARCHAR(1023), @HRM051 NVARCHAR(1023), @HRM052 NVARCHAR(1023), @HRM053 NVARCHAR(1023)
	
	SELECT @dFrom = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112), @dTo = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112), @Form = 'TSTHTDLD'
	SELECT @HRM050 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM050'
	SELECT @HRM051 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM051'
	SELECT @HRM052 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM052'
	SELECT @HRM053 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM053'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS xCode, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS xNorm
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS tong_ld, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ld_nu, CAST(0 AS INT) AS dai_hoc, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cao_dang
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS trung_cap, CAST(0 AS INT) AS so_cap_nghe, CAST(0 AS INT) AS day_nghe, CAST(0 AS INT) AS chua_dt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS khong_xd
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xac_dinh, CAST(0 AS INT) AS thoi_vu, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nghi_huu, CAST(0 AS INT) AS don_phuong, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky_luat
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS thoa_thuan, CAST(0 AS INT) AS khac, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ghi_chu
		INTO #report
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, b.loai_hd INTO #dk FROM hrnv a, hrcthd b
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, b.loai_hd INTO #ck FROM hrnv a, hrcthd b
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, b.loai_hd INTO #tang FROM hrnv a, hrcthd b
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, b.loai_hd, a.ly_do_nghi INTO #giam FROM hrnv a, hrcthd b

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @q = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
