	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SET @Join = ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'

	-- 1. Employee
	-- Begin Period
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dk select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, '''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_vao < ''' + @dFrom + ''' and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi >= ''' + @dFrom + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Increase
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tang select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, '''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_vao >= ''' + @dFrom + ''' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + @dTo + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Decreased
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #giam select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, '''', a.ly_do_nghi'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_nghi >= ''' + @dFrom + ''' and a.ngay_nghi <= ''' + @dTo + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- End Period
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ck select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.gioi_tinh, a.ma_tdhv, '''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_vao <= ''' + @dTo + ''' and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ''' + @dTo + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	UPDATE #dk SET ma_tdhv = '' WHERE ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep >= @DateFrom
	UPDATE #tang SET ma_tdhv = '' WHERE ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep > @DateTo
	UPDATE #giam SET ma_tdhv = '' WHERE ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep > @DateTo
	UPDATE #ck SET ma_tdhv = '' WHERE ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep > @DateTo

	-- 2. Education Level
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_tdhv, ngay_tot_nghiep AS ngay INTO #t1 FROM hrehv
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #t1 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_tdhv, a.ngay_tot_nghiep'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from hrehv a with(nolock) join #dk b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where a.mac_dinh_yn = ''1'' and a.ngay_tot_nghiep %Opr ''@dFrom'''
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @s = @s + 'delete #t1 from #t1 a left join (select stt_rec, max(ngay) as ngay from #t1 group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ngay = b.ngay where b.stt_rec is null'
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @s = @s + 'update #dk set ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv from #dk a join #t1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'

	-- Begin Period
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dFrom), '%Opr', '<')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Increase
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#tang'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Decreased
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#giam'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- End Period
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#ck'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 3. Contract
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, loai_hd, ngay_ky_hd AS ngay INTO #t2 FROM hrcthd
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #t2 select a.stt_rec, a.loai_hd, a.ngay_ky_hd'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from hrcthd a with(nolock) join #dk b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where a.ngay_ky_hd %Opr ''@dFrom'''
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @s = @s + 'delete #t2 from #t2 a left join (select stt_rec, max(ngay) as ngay from #t2 group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ngay = b.ngay where b.stt_rec is null'
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @s = @s + 'update #dk set loai_hd = b.loai_hd from #dk a join #t2 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'

	-- Begin Period
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dFrom), '%Opr', '<')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Increase
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#tang'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Decreased
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#giam'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- End Period
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@dFrom', @dTo), '#dk', '#ck'), '%Opr', '<=')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Total labor
	INSERT INTO #report(xCode, xNorm, tong_ld, ld_nu) SELECT 'A', @HRM050, COUNT(1), SUM(CASE WHEN gioi_tinh = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) FROM #dk
	INSERT INTO #report(xCode, xNorm, tong_ld, ld_nu) SELECT 'B', @HRM051, COUNT(1), SUM(CASE WHEN gioi_tinh = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) FROM #tang
	INSERT INTO #report(xCode, xNorm, tong_ld, ld_nu) SELECT 'C', @HRM052, COUNT(1), SUM(CASE WHEN gioi_tinh = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) FROM #giam
	INSERT INTO #report(xCode, xNorm, tong_ld, ld_nu) SELECT 'D', @HRM053, COUNT(1), SUM(CASE WHEN gioi_tinh = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) FROM #ck
	
	DECLARE @i INT
	SELECT 0 AS id, 'dai_hoc' AS name, ts_ma_006 AS value INTO #t FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'cao_dang', ts_ma_005 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'trung_cap', ts_ma_004 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'so_cap_nghe', ts_ma_007 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'day_nghe', ts_ma_008 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'chua_dt', ts_ma_009 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'khong_xd', ts_ma_010 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'xac_dinh', ts_ma_014 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'thoi_vu', ts_ma_015 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form

		UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'nghi_huu', ts_ma_016 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'don_phuong', ts_ma_017 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'ky_luat', ts_ma_020 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'thoa_thuan', ts_ma_019 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
		UNION ALL SELECT 13, 'khac', ts_ma_021 FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc = @Form
	
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i <= 13 BEGIN
		IF @i <= 8 BEGIN -- Education Level & Contract
			SELECT @s = 'update #report set ' + name + ' = (select count(1) from #dk where %fields in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(value, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + ''')) where xcode = ''%xcode''' FROM #t WHERE id = @i
	
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xcode', 'A'), '%fields', CASE WHEN @i <=5 THEN 'ma_tdhv' ELSE 'loai_hd' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xcode', 'B'), '#dk', '#tang'), '%fields', CASE WHEN @i <=5 THEN 'ma_tdhv' ELSE 'loai_hd' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xcode', 'C'), '#dk', '#giam'), '%fields', CASE WHEN @i <=5 THEN 'ma_tdhv' ELSE 'loai_hd' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xcode', 'D'), '#dk', '#ck'), '%fields', CASE WHEN @i <=5 THEN 'ma_tdhv' ELSE 'loai_hd' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN -- Reasons
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set ' + name + ' = (select count(1) from #giam where ly_do_nghi in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(value, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + ''')) where xcode = ''C''' FROM #t WHERE id = @i
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	-- Result
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, * FROM #report ORDER BY xCode, sysorder

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_VendorEvaluationSaving]
	@CustomerKey NVARCHAR(4000), 
	@JoinCustomer NVARCHAR(1023), 
	@ItemKey NVARCHAR(4000), 
	@JoinItem NVARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@UpdateAdjustment BIT,
	@AdjustmentID CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @strYear CHAR(4), @now SMALLDATETIME, @delStr NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strYear = REPLACE(STR(nam, 4), ' ', '0'), @now = GETDATE() FROM #dotdg

	-- Delete and Insert
	SELECT @key = '', @delStr = 'delete a from %table$' + @strYear + ' a join #dotdg b on a.loai_ky = b.loai_ky and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0'


	-- Resource
	IF @CustomerKey <> '' SET @key = '(a.ma_kh = '''' or (' + @CustomerKey + '))'
	IF @ItemKey <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.ma_vt = '''' or (' + @ItemKey + '))'
	IF @UpdateAdjustment = 1 SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'nguon_xd = ''P08'''
	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgng00') + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (nguon_xd = ''#IR'' or (' + @key + '))' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgng00$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, nguon_xd, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, ngay_giao, ma_chi_tieu, trong_so, diem_so, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, a.nguon_xd, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.gia_chuan_nt, a.gia_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.gia, a.ngay_giao, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den'
		+ ' from #ngdg a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (nguon_xd = ''#IR'' or (' + @key + '))' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Intermediate Result
	IF @UpdateAdjustment = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkqtg00') + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
			+ 'insert into bidgkqtg00$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, stt_tg, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_chi_tieu, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng, gia_ng, sl_ng, dvt_ng, ngay_ng, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, stt_rec1tc, gia_tc, sl_tc, ngay_tc, cl_tl, cl_sl, cl_sn)'
			+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.stt_tg, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.stt_rec_ng, a.stt_rec0ng, a.gia_ng, a.sl_ng, a.dvt_ng, a.ngay_ng, a.stt_rec_tc, a.stt_rec0tc, a.stt_rec1tc, a.gia_tc, a.sl_tc, a.ngay_tc, cl_tl, cl_sl, cl_sn'
			+ ' from #kqtg a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	-- Item Result
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @CustomerKey <> '' THEN '(' + @CustomerKey + ')' ELSE '' END
	IF @ItemKey <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + @ItemKey + ')'

	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkq00') + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkq00$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, trong_so0, diem_so0, trong_so1, diem_so1, trong_so2, diem_so2, trong_so, diem_so, loai_chi_tieu, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.trong_so0, a.diem_so0, a.trong_so1, a.diem_so1, a.trong_so2, a.diem_so2, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, a.loai_chi_tieu, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kq00 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID
	
	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkq01')	+ @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkq01$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_kh, loai_chi_tieu, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, trong_so, diem_so, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.loai_chi_tieu, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kq01 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkq02')	+ @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkq02$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_kh, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, diem_so, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.diem_so, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kq02 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + @JoinItem + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID


	-- Customer Result
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @CustomerKey <> '' THEN '(' + @CustomerKey + ')' ELSE '' END

	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkqkh00') + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkqkh00$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, trong_so, diem_so, loai_chi_tieu, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, a.loai_chi_tieu, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kqkh00 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkqkh01') + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkqkh01$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_kh, loai_chi_tieu, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, trong_so, diem_so, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_kh, a.loai_chi_tieu, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.trong_so, a.diem_so, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kqkh01 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	SET @q = REPLACE(@delStr, '%table', 'bidgkqkh02') + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END + CHAR(13) 
		+ 'insert into bidgkqkh02$' + @strYear + '(nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_kh, t_cl_tl, t_cl_sl, t_cl_sn, diem_so, datetime0, user_id0)'
		+ ' select b.nam, b.ky, b.loai_ky, b.ma_bp0, a.ma_kh, a.t_cl_tl, a.t_cl_sl, a.t_cl_sn, a.diem_so, @d, @u'
		+ ' from #kqkh02 a cross join #dotdg b' + @JoinCustomer + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where (' + @key + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE proc dbo.dt_isundersourcecontrol
    @vchLoginName varchar(255) = '',
    @vchPassword  varchar(255) = '',
    @iWhoToo      int = 0 /* 0 => Just check project; 1 => get list of objs */

as

	set nocount on

	declare @iReturn int
	declare @iObjectId int
	select @iObjectId = 0

	declare @VSSGUID varchar(100)
	select @VSSGUID = 'SQLVersionControl.VCS_SQL'

	declare @iReturnValue int
	select @iReturnValue = 0

	declare @iStreamObjectId int
	select @iStreamObjectId   = 0

	declare @vchTempText varchar(255)

    declare @iPropertyObjectId int
    select @iPropertyObjectId = (select objectid from dbo.dtproperties where property = 'VCSProjectID')

    declare @vchProjectName   varchar(255)
    declare @vchSourceSafeINI varchar(255)
    declare @vchServerName    varchar(255)
    declare @vchDatabaseName  varchar(255)
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSProject',       @vchProjectName   OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSourceSafeINI', @vchSourceSafeINI OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLServer',     @vchServerName    OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLDatabase',   @vchDatabaseName  OUT

    if (@vchProjectName = '')	set @vchProjectName		= null
    if (@vchSourceSafeINI = '') set @vchSourceSafeINI	= null
    if (@vchServerName = '')	set @vchServerName		= null
    if (@vchDatabaseName = '')	set @vchDatabaseName	= null
    
    if (@vchProjectName is null) or (@vchSourceSafeINI is null) or (@vchServerName is null) or (@vchDatabaseName is null)
    begin
        RAISERROR('Not Under Source Control',16,-1)
        return
    end

    if @iWhoToo = 1
    begin

        /* Get List of Procs in the project */
        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OACreate @VSSGUID, @iObjectId OUT
        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iObjectId,
												'GetListOfObjects',
												NULL,
												@vchProjectName,
												@vchSourceSafeINI,
												@vchServerName,
												@vchDatabaseName,
												@vchLoginName,
												@vchPassword

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAGetProperty @iObjectId, 'GetStreamObject', @iStreamObjectId OUT

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        create table #ObjectList (id int identity, vchObjectlist varchar(255))

        select @vchTempText = 'STUB'
        while @vchTempText is not null
        begin
            exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iStreamObjectId, 'GetStream', @iReturnValue OUT, @vchTempText OUT
            if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError
            
            if (@vchTempText = '') set @vchTempText = null
            if (@vchTempText is not null) insert into #ObjectList (vchObjectlist ) select @vchTempText
        end

        select vchObjectlist from #ObjectList order by id
    end

CleanUp:
    return

E_OAError:
    exec dbo.dt_displayoaerror @iObjectId, @iReturn
    goto CleanUp





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodsBudgetReport]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@reportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Tháng, 2 - Quý, 3 - Nửa năm, 4 - Năm
	@periodNum INT,
	@planType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mới nhất, 2 - Gốc, 3 - Tùy chọn
	@revision INT,
	@deptCode VARCHAR(32),
	@jobCode VARCHAR(32),
	@unitCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511), @PeriodCol NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @pTmpFrom INT, @yTmpFrom INT, @pTmpTo INT, @yTmpTo INT, @pTmp INT, @yTmp INT
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_so VARCHAR(32), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ma_ct VARCHAR(32), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_du VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_gt VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_phi VARCHAR(512), @Cong_no CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Gt_th NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_th_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_ns NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_ns_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year), @key = ''
	SELECT @dateTo =
		CASE
			WHEN @reportType = '1' THEN DATEADD(DAY, - 1, DATEADD(MONTH, (@periodNum * 1), @dateFrom))
			WHEN @reportType = '2' THEN DATEADD(DAY, - 1, DATEADD(MONTH, (@periodNum * 3), @dateFrom))
			WHEN @reportType = '3' THEN DATEADD(DAY, - 1, DATEADD(MONTH, (@periodNum * 6), @dateFrom))
			WHEN @reportType = '4' THEN DATEADD(DAY, - 1, DATEADD(MONTH, (@periodNum * 12), @dateFrom))
		END
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @PeriodCol = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, tk, tk_du, ma_phi, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #r00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_ns, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_ns_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt INTO #repNorm FROM bcnsky
	SELECT TOP 0 gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_ns, gt_ns_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #valueTmp FROM #repNorm

	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_ns, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_ns_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #report FROM bcnsky WHERE form = @formCode
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, RTRIM(stt_in) AS stt_in
		, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_ns, gt_ns_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #result FROM #report
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk INTO #ds_tk
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du INTO #ds_tk_du
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_gt INTO #ds_tk_gt
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_phi INTO #ds_ma_phi

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	-- Key
	IF @deptCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@deptCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @jobCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_vv INTO #xdmvv FROM dmvv WHERE ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(@jobCode) + '%'
		SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS xcode, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS code, ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv0 FROM wrkcolumns
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv INTO #dmvv1 FROM #dmvv0
		--
		INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
		INSERT INTO #dmvv1 SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv1
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #dmvv1(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv) SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'exists(select 1 from #dmvv1 b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)'
	END
	--
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unitCode, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @unitKey
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key), @unitKey = ISNULL(@unitKey, '')

	-- Get Data Arising
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select (month(a.ngay_ct) + year(a.ngay_ct) * 12), a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by (month(a.ngay_ct) + year(a.ngay_ct) * 12), a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Get Data Plan
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #valueTmp'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' select 0, 0, sum(a.tien%xMonth), sum(a.tien_nt%xMonth), 0, 0'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from glns a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where nam = %xYear and ma_ct = ''%xNorm''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @planType = 1 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from glns b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
							WHEN @planType = 2 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from glns b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct having min(b.lan) = a.lan)'
												ELSE ' and a.lan = (select max(lan) from glns b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and b.lan <= ' + RTRIM(@revision) + ')' END

	-- Scan từng kỳ
	SELECT @i = 1, @dTmpFrom = @dateFrom, @pTmpFrom = @period, @yTmpFrom = @year, @q = ''
	--
	WHILE @i <= @periodNum BEGIN
		SELECT @pTmpTo = @pTmpFrom + CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 0 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 5 WHEN '4' THEN 11 END, @yTmpTo = @yTmpFrom
			, @dTmpTo = DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 6 WHEN '4' THEN 12 END, @dTmpFrom))
		IF @pTmpTo > 12  SELECT @pTmpTo = @pTmpTo%12, @yTmpTo = @yTmpTo + 1

		-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu báo cáo
		TRUNCATE TABLE #repNorm
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, ds_chi_tieu FROM #report WHERE kind = '1'
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ds_chi_tieu
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #valueTmp
			-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu ngân sách
			SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ',')
			WHILE @n > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @n, ',')
				SELECT @Ds_tk = REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_tk, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_du = REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_tk_du, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_gt = REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_tk_gt, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_phi = REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_ma_phi, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Cong_no = cong_no FROM dmctns WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct
				--
				IF @Ds_tk <> '' BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk
					TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_du
					TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_gt
					TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_ma_phi

					INSERT INTO #ds_tk SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk, ',')
					INSERT INTO #ds_tk_du SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_du, ',')
					INSERT INTO #ds_tk_gt SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_gt, ',')
					INSERT INTO #ds_ma_phi SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_ma_phi, ',')
					--
					INSERT INTO #valueTmp
						SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
							FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_du c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_du) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi) AND xPeriod BETWEEN (MONTH(@dTmpFrom) + YEAR(@dTmpFrom) * 12) AND (MONTH(@dTmpTo) + YEAR(@dTmpTo) * 12)
					INSERT INTO #valueTmp
						SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
							FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_gt c WHERE a.tk_du NOT LIKE c.tk_gt) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi)	AND xPeriod BETWEEN (MONTH(@dTmpFrom) + YEAR(@dTmpFrom) * 12) AND (MONTH(@dTmpTo) + YEAR(@dTmpTo) * 12)
				END
				--
				SELECT @pTmp = @pTmpFrom, @yTmp = @yTmpFrom
				WHILE (@yTmp * 12 + @pTmp) <= (@yTmpTo * 12 + @pTmpTo) BEGIN
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xMonth', REPLACE(STR(@pTmp, 2), ' ', '0')), '%xYear', @yTmp), '%xNorm', @Ma_ct)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
					--
					SELECT @pTmp = @pTmp + 1
					IF @pTmp > 12 SELECT @pTmp = 1, @yTmp = @yTmp + 1
				END

				SELECT @n = @n - 1
			END
			--
			INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_ns), SUM(gt_ns_nt), 0, 0 FROM #valueTmp
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ds_chi_tieu
		END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		UPDATE #report SET gt_th_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_th_nt, 0), gt_th = ISNULL(b.gt_th, 0), gt_ns_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_ns_nt, 0), gt_ns = ISNULL(b.gt_ns, 0), gt_cl_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_cl_nt, 0), gt_cl = ISNULL(b.gt_cl, 0) FROM #report a JOIN #repNorm b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		--
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_th = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_th) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_th_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_th_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_ns = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_ns) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_ns_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_ns_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
			END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		UPDATE #report SET gt_cl = gt_ns - gt_th, gt_cl_nt = gt_ns_nt - gt_th_nt

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT RTRIM(@i), stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_ns, gt_ns_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt FROM #report
		--
		SELECT @dTmpFrom = DATEADD(MONTH, (@i * CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 6 WHEN '4' THEN 12 END), @dateFrom), @pTmpFrom = @pTmpFrom + CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 6 WHEN '4' THEN 12 END
		IF @pTmpFrom > 12 SELECT @pTmpFrom = CASE WHEN @pTmpFrom = 24 THEN 12 ELSE @pTmpFrom%12 END, @yTmpFrom = @yTmpFrom + 1
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 999, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in, MAX(chi_tieu), ma_so, MAX(ma_so_in), MAX(bold), SUM(ISNULL(gt_th, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_th_nt, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_ns, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_ns_nt, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_cl, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_cl_nt, 0)) FROM #result GROUP BY ma_so, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	--
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') FROM #result
	IF @reportForm = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_ns$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT091'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_th$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT077'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT079'
	END
	IF @reportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_ns_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT092'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_th_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT080'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT082'
	END
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN a.header <> '999' THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(RTRIM(a.header), 2) ELSE @Total END + ' - ' + b.header, b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY b.id, a.id

	-- View
	SELECT xPeriod, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_so) AS xRow, REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn
		, CASE WHEN xPeriod < 999 THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0'), 2) ELSE @Total END AS xColumnName
		, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN stt_in <> '' THEN stt_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so
		, CASE WHEN ma_so_in <> '' THEN ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_ns, gt_ns_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt FROM #result a ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdtdtvv
AS
	SELECT     dbo.dtdtvv.*, dbo.dmvv.ten_vv AS ten_vv, dbo.dmvv.ten_vv2 AS ten_vv2, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs AS ten_dvcs, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs2 AS ten_dvcs2
		FROM         dbo.dtdtvv LEFT JOIN
		                      dbo.dmvv ON dbo.dtdtvv.ma_vv = dbo.dmvv.ma_vv LEFT JOIN
		                      dbo.dmdvcs ON dbo.dtdtvv.ma_dvcs = dbo.dmdvcs.ma_dvcs

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrcttngt]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.loai, a.ly_do, a.tien, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan AS ma_bp, b.bp_ref, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
	FROM hrcttngt a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunQuery]
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@dateNow SMALLDATETIME,
	@rate NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@periodCode CHAR(2),
	@version CHAR(2)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @nPeriodCount INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @nSaleOrder NUMERIC(28, 6), @bFocast INT
	DECLARE @nForecast NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRequirement NUMERIC(28, 6), @nScheduledReceipt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nProjectedOnHand NUMERIC(28, 6), @nNetRequirement NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPlannedOrderReceipt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPlanedOrderRelease NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPeriodCoverage NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @item = REPLACE(@item, '''', ''''''), @i = 0
	SELECT @nPeriodCount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ky_hd'
	SELECT @bFocast = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kieu_db' AND val = '0') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
	SELECT ma_so, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(chi_tieu) ELSE RTRIM(chi_tieu2) END AS chi_tieu INTO #rs FROM mpdmctkh WHERE loai = 1 ORDER BY ma_so

	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount
		BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'alter table #rs add ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' numeric(28, 6)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @nForecast = sl_xuat,
					@nSaleOrder = sl_dh,
					@nRequirement = tong_nc,
					@nScheduledReceipt = sl_kh,
					@nProjectedOnHand = ton_kho,
					@nNetRequirement = nc_rong,
					@nPlannedOrderReceipt = sl_dat,
					@nPlanedOrderRelease = sl_kt
				FROM mpctvtky WHERE ma_vt = @item AND ky = @i

			SELECT @nForecast = @nForecast + CASE WHEN @nForecast > 0 THEN ISNULL(@nSaleOrder, 0) ELSE 0 END

			IF @version <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @nPlannedOrderReceipt = SUM(sl_nhap) FROM mphistory WHERE ma_vt = @item AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@periodCode, @dateNow, ngay_ct) = @i AND version = @version
				SELECT @nPlannedOrderReceipt = ISNULL(@nPlannedOrderReceipt, 0) + ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap), 0) FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @item AND nguon = 'FP' AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@periodCode, @dateNow, ngay_ct) = @i
				SELECT @nPlanedOrderRelease = SUM(sl_nhap) FROM mphistory WHERE ma_vt = @item AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@periodCode, @dateNow, ngay_dat) = @i AND version = @version
				SELECT @nPlanedOrderRelease = ISNULL(@nPlanedOrderRelease, 0) + ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap), 0) FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @item AND nguon = 'FP' AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@periodCode, @dateNow, ngay_dat) = @i
			END

			SELECT @q = '
				update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = case
					when ma_so = ''01'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nForecast, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''02'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nRequirement, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''03'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nScheduledReceipt, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''04'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nProjectedOnHand, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''05'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nNetRequirement, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''06'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nPlannedOrderReceipt, 0)) + '
					when ma_so = ''07'' then ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@nPlanedOrderRelease, 0)) + '
					else 0
				end
			'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

	-- Update Period Coverage
	SELECT CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl INTO #tmp
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount - 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
				declare @n1 numeric(28, 6), @n2 numeric(28, 6), @k int, @nProjectedOnHand numeric(28, 6), @q nvarchar(4000)
				select @n1 = 0, @n2 = 0, @k = ' + RTRIM(@i + 1) + '
				select @nProjectedOnHand = sum(ton_kho) from
					(
						select sum(ky' + RTRIM(@i)+ ') as ton_kho from #rs where ma_so in (''03'', ''04'', ''06'')
						union all
						select - (case when p.ton > k.ton then p.ton else k.ton end) from (select ky' + RTRIM(@i)+ ' as ton from #rs where ma_so = ''01'') p cross join (select ky' + RTRIM(@i)+ ' as ton from #rs where ma_so = ''02'') k
					) a
				select @nProjectedOnHand = isnull(@nProjectedOnHand, 0)
				while @n1 <= @nProjectedOnHand and @k <= ' + RTRIM(@nPeriodCount) + ' begin
					set @q = ''declare @x01 numeric(28, 6), @x02 numeric(28, 6)''
						+ '' select @x01 = ky'' + rtrim(@k) + '' from #rs where ma_so = ''''01''''''
						+ '' select @x02 = ky'' + rtrim(@k) + '' from #rs where ma_so = ''''02''''''
						+ '' update #tmp set sl = case when @x01 > @x02 then @x01 else @x02 end''
					exec sp_executesql @q
					select @n1 = @n1 + sum(sl) from #tmp
					if @n1 <= @nProjectedOnHand select @n2 = @n2 + sum(sl) from #tmp else select @n2 = @n1
					select @k = @k + 1
				end
				update #tmp set sl = null where sl = 0
				if @n2 <> 0 update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + '= (@k - ' + RTRIM(@i) + ')' + ' + ((@nProjectedOnHand - @n2 - (select sl from #tmp))/(select sl from #tmp))'+ ' where ma_so = ''08''
			'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

	-- Update coefficient
	IF @rate <> 0 AND @rate <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 0
		WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #rs set ky' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = ' + 'ky' + RTRIM(@i) + '/' + RTRIM(@rate)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END
	--
	SELECT * FROM #rs ORDER BY ma_so
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckObjectNotInput] --fs20_COCheckObjectNoInput--
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2), 
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1), @JoinDept NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_yt), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_yt, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, dien_giai, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, tk_du, tk_vt, nxt INTO #ct70gt FROM wrkin 
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_yt), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_yt, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, dien_giai, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00gt FROM wrkgl

	-- Unit Key
	SELECT @Key = 'not (ma_ct = ''PND'' and ma_gd = ''4'')'
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, tk_no, tk_co, ma_bp INTO #xdmytct FROM xdmytct
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmytct select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, rtrim(tk_no), rtrim(tk_co), rtrim(ma_bp) from xdmytct a with(nolock)'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @JoinDept = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmytct WHERE ma_bp <> '') THEN ' and (a.ma_bp = '''' or b.ma_bp = '''' or a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp)' ELSE '' END
	
	IF @costUnit = '1' CREATE INDEX k ON #xdmytct(ma_dvcs, tk_no, tk_co)
		ELSE CREATE INDEX k ON #xdmytct(tk_no, tk_co)

	SET @q = 'insert into #ct70gt'
	SET @q = @q + ' select distinct ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs' ELSE '''''' END + ', b.ma_yt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt, a.nxt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' join #xdmytct b on ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and ' ELSE '' END  + 'a.tk_du like b.tk_no and a.tk_vt like b.tk_co' + @JoinDept
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT * INTO #ct70gtx FROM #ct70gt

	DELETE #ct70gt FROM #ct70gt c
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, ma_yt, ma_dvcs FROM #ct70gt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM xdmyt b WHERE b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt AND b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND b.kieu_yt = '1') AND nxt = 2
			UNION ALL
			SELECT stt_rec, ma_yt, ma_dvcs FROM #ct70gt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM xdmyt b WHERE b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt AND b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND b.kieu_yt = '1' AND tk_dd <> '') AND nxt = 1 
		) d WHERE d.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND d.ma_yt = c.ma_yt AND d.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs)

	DELETE #ct70gtx FROM #ct70gtx c
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, ma_yt, ma_dvcs FROM #ct70gtx a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xdmyt b WHERE ma_yt = b.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND b.kieu_yt = '1') AND nxt = 1
		)d WHERE d.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND d.ma_yt = c.ma_yt AND d.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs)

	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00gt'
	SET @q = @q + ' select distinct ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs' ELSE '''''' END + ', b.ma_yt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' join #xdmytct b on ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and ' ELSE '' END  + 'a.tk like b.tk_no and a.tk_du like b.tk_co' + @JoinDept
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @UnitKey + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	

	DELETE #ct00gt FROM #ct00gt c
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, ma_yt, ma_dvcs FROM #ct00gt a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xdmyt b WHERE a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND b.kieu_yt <> '1') AND ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0
			UNION ALL
			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_yt, a.ma_dvcs FROM #ct00gt a JOIN xdmyt b ON a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs WHERE b.kieu_yt <> '1' AND a.tk_du NOT LIKE RTRIM(b.tk_dd) + '%' AND ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0
		) d WHERE d.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND d.ma_yt = c.ma_yt AND d.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs)

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.th_sp, b.th_bp, b.th_bp0, b.th_lsx
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_yt ELSE '' END AS ten_yt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_yt2 ELSE '' END AS ten_yt2
		INTO #report
		FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (
				SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, dien_giai, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx FROM #ct70gt
				UNION ALL SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, dien_giai, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx FROM #ct70gtx
				UNION ALL SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, dien_giai, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx FROM #ct00gt
			) a
		) a JOIN xdmyt b ON a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

	DELETE #report WHERE ((ma_sp <> '' AND th_sp = 1) OR th_sp = 0) 
		AND ((so_lsx <> '' AND th_lsx = 1) OR th_lsx = 0) 
		AND ((ma_bp <> '' AND th_bp = 1 AND ma_bp IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM xdmbp WHERE truc_tiep = 1)) OR th_bp = 0)
		AND ((ma_bp <> '' AND th_bp0 = 1 AND ma_bp IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM xdmbp WHERE truc_tiep = 0)) OR th_bp0 = 0)

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.dien_giai, ten_yt, ten_yt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ct ELSE '' END AS ten_ct, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_ct2 ELSE '' END AS ten_ct2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_yt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_GetSOPrice]
	@cField VARCHAR(32),
	@cVCID VARCHAR(3),
	@dPrice SMALLDATETIME,
	@cTerm VARCHAR(33),
	@cFC VARCHAR(33),
	@cCust VARCHAR(33),
	@cItem VARCHAR(33),
	@cSite VARCHAR(33),
	@cUOM NVARCHAR(33),
	@nQty NUMERIC(28, 12),
	@nRate NUMERIC(28, 6)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nPRound TINYINT, @nBasePrice NUMERIC(28, 12), @nPrice NUMERIC(28, 12), @nDiscount NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@cCustGroup1 VARCHAR(33), @cCustGroup2 VARCHAR(33), @cCustGroup3 VARCHAR(33), @cCustGroup9 VARCHAR(33),
		@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), @cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), @cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), @cItemGroup9 VARCHAR(33), @cBaseFC VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @nQty = ROUND(@nQty * @nRate, 12)
	SELECT @cBaseFC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF RTRIM(@cFC) = '' OR RTRIM(@cFC) = RTRIM(@cBaseFC) BEGIN
		SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
		SELECT @nPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
		SELECT @nPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @nBasePrice = 0, @nPrice = 0, @nDiscount = 0, @cField = RTRIM(@cField), @cVCID = RTRIM(@cVCID), @cTerm = RTRIM(@cTerm),
		@cFC = RTRIM(@cFC), @cCust = RTRIM(@cCust), @cItem = RTRIM(@cItem), @cSite = RTRIM(@cSite), @cUOM = RTRIM(@cUOM)

	SELECT @cCustGroup1 = RTRIM(nh_kh1), @cCustGroup2 = RTRIM(nh_kh2), @cCustGroup3 = RTRIM(nh_kh3), @cCustGroup9 = RTRIM(nh_kh9) FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @cCust
	SELECT @cItemGroup1 = RTRIM(nh_vt1), @cItemGroup2 = RTRIM(nh_vt2), @cItemGroup3 = RTRIM(nh_vt3), @cItemGroup9 = RTRIM(nh_vt9) FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @cItem

	IF @cCust = '' SET @cCust = '?'
	IF @cItem = '' SET @cItem = '?'
	IF @cSite = '' SET @cSite = '?'

	IF ISNULL(@cCustGroup1, '') = '' SET @cCustGroup1 = '?'
	IF ISNULL(@cCustGroup2, '') = '' SET @cCustGroup2 = '?'
	IF ISNULL(@cCustGroup3, '') = '' SET @cCustGroup3 = '?'

	IF ISNULL(@cCustGroup9, '') = '' SET @cCustGroup9 = '?'

	IF ISNULL(@cItemGroup1, '') = '' SET @cItemGroup1 = '?'
	IF ISNULL(@cItemGroup2, '') = '' SET @cItemGroup2 = '?'
	IF ISNULL(@cItemGroup3, '') = '' SET @cItemGroup3 = '?'

	IF ISNULL(@cItemGroup9, '') = '' SET @cItemGroup9 = '?'
	IF @cFC = '' SET @cFC = '?'

	-- Base Price List
	SELECT loai_gia, ma_kho, ma_kh, nh_kh1, nh_kh2, nh_kh3, nh_kh9, MAX(ngay_ban) AS ngay_ban INTO #tSalesPrice
		FROM dmgia2
		WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_nt = @cFC AND ngay_ban <= @dPrice AND
			((ma_kho = '' OR ma_kho LIKE (@cSite + '%'))) AND
			((ma_kh = '' OR ma_kh LIKE (@cCust + '%'))) AND

			((nh_kh1 = '' OR nh_kh1 LIKE (@cCustGroup1 + '%'))) AND
			((nh_kh2 = '' OR nh_kh2 LIKE (@cCustGroup2 + '%'))) AND
			((nh_kh3 = '' OR nh_kh3 LIKE (@cCustGroup3 + '%'))) AND

			((nh_kh9 = '' OR nh_kh9 LIKE (@cCustGroup9 + '%')))
		GROUP BY loai_gia, ma_kho, ma_kh, nh_kh1, nh_kh2, nh_kh3, nh_kh9

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tSalesPrice) BEGIN
		DECLARE @cType1 CHAR(1), @cType2 CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @cType1 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_uu_tien1'
		SELECT @cType2 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_uu_tien2'

		SELECT @q = N'
		select top 1 @nBasePrice = a.gia_qd_nt2
			from dmgia2 a' + CASE WHEN @cType1 = '3' THEN ' join dmloaigia2 b on a.loai_gia = b.loai_gia' ELSE '' END + '
				join #tSalesPrice p on a.loai_gia = p.loai_gia and a.ngay_ban = p.ngay_ban and a.ma_kho = p.ma_kho and a.ma_kh = p.ma_kh and a.nh_kh1 = p.nh_kh1 and a.nh_kh2 = p.nh_kh2 and a.nh_kh3 = p.nh_kh3 and a.nh_kh9 = p.nh_kh9
				where a.ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@cItem, '''', '') + ''' and a.ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@cFC, '''', '') + '''
				order by ' + CASE WHEN @cType1 = '3' THEN 'b.stt, ' ELSE '' END + 'a.gia_qd_nt2' + CASE WHEN @cType1 = '2' OR (@cType1 = '3' AND @cType2 = '2') THEN ' desc' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@nBasePrice numeric(28, 12) output', @nBasePrice OUTPUT
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS gia_ban_nt, 0 AS gia_nt2, 0 AS ck_nt
		RETURN
	END
	-- End Base Price List


	-- Filter
	SELECT a.ma_ck, a.he_so, ROUND(a.so_luong * a.he_so, 12) AS so_luong, b.ngay_ct1 AS ngay_hl, a.tl_ck, a.tien_ck, b.muc_do, b.tien_yn, b.tien_hang_yn, b.cong_yn, b.con_lai_yn
		INTO #tDiscount
		FROM dmck2 a JOIN dmck b ON a.ma_ck = b.ma_ck
		WHERE ((a.ma_kho = '' OR a.ma_kho LIKE (@cSite + '%'))) AND
			((a.ma_kh = '' OR a.ma_kh LIKE (@cCust + '%'))) AND

			((a.nh_kh1 = '' OR a.nh_kh1 LIKE (@cCustGroup1 + '%'))) AND
			((a.nh_kh2 = '' OR a.nh_kh2 LIKE (@cCustGroup2 + '%'))) AND
			((a.nh_kh3 = '' OR a.nh_kh3 LIKE (@cCustGroup3 + '%'))) AND

			((a.nh_kh9 = '' OR a.nh_kh9 LIKE (@cCustGroup9 + '%'))) AND


			((a.ma_vt = '' OR a.ma_vt LIKE (@cItem + '%'))) AND

			((a.nh_vt1 = '' OR a.nh_vt1 LIKE (@cItemGroup1 + '%'))) AND
			((a.nh_vt2 = '' OR a.nh_vt2 LIKE (@cItemGroup2 + '%'))) AND
			((a.nh_vt3 = '' OR a.nh_vt3 LIKE (@cItemGroup3 + '%'))) AND

			((a.nh_vt9 = '' OR a.nh_vt9 LIKE (@cItemGroup9 + '%'))) AND


			((a.ma_nt = '' OR a.ma_nt LIKE (@cFC + '%')))
			AND a.status = '1' AND b.status = '1' AND b.ngay_ct1 <= @dPrice AND b.ngay_ct2 >= @dPrice AND a.ngay_hl >= @dPrice
			AND ROUND(a.so_luong * a.he_so, 12) <= @nQty
		ORDER BY b.muc_do

	SELECT ma_ck, MAX(so_luong) AS so_luong INTO #tQty FROM #tDiscount GROUP BY ma_ck ORDER BY ma_ck
	DELETE #tDiscount FROM #tDiscount a JOIN #tQty b ON a.ma_ck = b.ma_ck WHERE a.so_luong <> b.so_luong

	SELECT ma_ck, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #tDate FROM #tDiscount GROUP BY ma_ck ORDER BY ma_ck
	DELETE #tDiscount FROM #tDiscount a JOIN #tDate b ON a.ma_ck = b.ma_ck WHERE a.ngay_hl <> b.ngay_hl

	DECLARE @nPriority NUMERIC(5)
	SELECT @nPriority = MIN(muc_do) FROM #tDiscount
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #tDiscount WHERE muc_do = @nPriority AND cong_yn = 1) DELETE #tDiscount WHERE cong_yn = 0
		ELSE DELETE #tDiscount WHERE cong_yn = 0 AND muc_do <> @nPriority
	UPDATE #tDiscount SET tien_ck = 0, he_so = 1 WHERE he_so = 0
	-- End Filter

	-- Begin Calculate
	DECLARE crPrice CURSOR FOR SELECT tl_ck, /* ROUND(tien_ck / he_so, @nRound) AS */tien_ck, tien_yn, tien_hang_yn, con_lai_yn FROM #tDiscount ORDER BY muc_do
	DECLARE @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nExAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nExPrice NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDeltaPrice NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDiscRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDiscAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @isFlat BIT, @isApplyAmount BIT, @isRemain BIT

	OPEN crPrice
	SELECT @nAmount = ROUND(@nQty * @nBasePrice, @nRound)
	SELECT @nExAmount = @nAmount, @nPrice = @nBasePrice, @nDiscount = 0

	FETCH NEXT FROM crPrice INTO @nDiscRate, @nDiscAmount, @isFlat, @isApplyAmount, @isRemain
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @isFlat = 1 BEGIN
			IF @isApplyAmount = 1 SELECT @nDiscount = @nDiscount + @nDiscAmount, @nExAmount = @nExAmount - @nDiscAmount
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @nPrice = @nPrice - @nDiscAmount
				SELECT @nExAmount = @nExAmount - ROUND(@nQty * @nDiscAmount, @nRound)
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @isApplyAmount = 1 BEGIN
				IF @isRemain = 1 BEGIN
					SELECT @nDiscount = @nDiscount + ROUND(@nExAmount * @nDiscRate / 100, @nRound)
					SELECT @nExAmount = @nExAmount - ROUND(@nExAmount * @nDiscRate / 100, @nRound)
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @nDiscount = @nDiscount + ROUND(@nAmount * @nDiscRate / 100, @nRound)
					SELECT @nExAmount = @nExAmount - ROUND(@nAmount * @nDiscRate / 100, @nRound)
				END
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @isRemain = 1 BEGIN
					SET @nDeltaPrice = ROUND(@nPrice * @nDiscRate / 100, @nPRound)
					SET @nPrice = @nPrice - @nDeltaPrice
					SELECT @nExAmount = @nExAmount - ROUND(@nQty * @nDeltaPrice, @nRound)
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SET @nDeltaPrice = ROUND(@nBasePrice * @nDiscRate / 100, @nPRound)
					SET @nPrice = @nPrice - @nDeltaPrice
					SELECT @nExAmount = @nExAmount - ROUND(@nQty * @nDeltaPrice, @nRound)
				END
			END
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crPrice INTO @nDiscRate, @nDiscAmount, @isFlat, @isApplyAmount, @isRemain
	END
	CLOSE crPrice
	DEALLOCATE crPrice

	-- End Calculate
	SELECT @nBasePrice = ISNULL(@nBasePrice, 0), @nDiscount = ISNULL(@nDiscount, 0)
	IF ISNULL(@nPrice, 0) = 0 SET @nPrice = @nBasePrice

	SELECT @nBasePrice = ROUND(@nBasePrice * @nRate, @nPRound), @nPrice = ROUND(@nPrice * @nRate, @nPRound)
	SELECT @nBasePrice AS gia_ban_nt, @nPrice AS gia_nt2, @nDiscount AS ck_nt INTO #tPrice

	IF (@cField  <> 'ma_vt') AND @cField  <> 'dvt' UPDATE #tPrice SET gia_ban_nt = NULL

	SELECT * FROM #tPrice
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_ParentAcct(@cAcct VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS VARCHAR(33)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cRet VARCHAR(33), @cParAcct VARCHAR(33)
	IF @cAcct IS NULL RETURN ''
	SELECT @cParAcct = @cAcct, @cRet = @cAcct
	WHILE (@cRet <> '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cRet = tk_me FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cParAcct
			IF @cRet = '' RETURN @cParAcct ELSE SET @cParAcct = @cRet
		END
	RETURN ''
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSDetailIncreaseDecrease] --fs20_FXDetailIncDes--
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Type AS CHAR(1),  -- 1 - Increase, 2 - Decrease
	@FaType AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@GroupBy NVARCHAR(256),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @cFC VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @cFC = val FROM Options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp AS fx_ma_bp
			, b.nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt, b.gt_da_kh AS gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt AS gt_da_kh_nt
			, b.gt_cl AS gt_cl, b.gt_cl_nt AS gt_cl_nt, b.gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_ky, b.gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt
			, a.loai_ts AS loai_cc, a.ten_ts AS ten_ts, a.ten_ts2 AS ten_ts2, a.ngay_mua AS ngay_mua, a.so_ky_kh AS so_ky_kh
			, c.ten_tg_ts AS ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2 AS ten_tg_ts2
			, a.ma_nt AS ma_nt, a.ty_gia AS ty_gia
		INTO #report
		FROM dmcc a JOIN ctdmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			LEFT JOIN dmtgcc c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
			LEFT JOIN dmnv d ON b.ma_nv = d.ma_nv
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '1 = 1'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Type <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.loai_tg_ts = ''' + @Type + ''''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, max(a.ma_bp) as fx_ma_bp,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(b.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(b.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt, sum(b.gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh, sum(b.gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(b.gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(b.gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt, sum(b.gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(b.gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(a.loai_ts) as loai_ts, max(a.ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(a.ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(a.ngay_mua) as ngay_mua, max(a.so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(c.ten_tg_ts) as ten_tg_ts, max(c.ten_tg_ts2) as ten_tg_ts2, max(a.ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(a.ty_gia) as ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmcc a with(nolock) join ctdmcc b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmnv d on b.ma_nv = d.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ' where (year(a.ngay_mua) * 12 + month(a.ngay_mua)) between ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period)) + ''' and ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)) + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_tg_ts <> '''' and ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.so_the_ts '
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Key
	SET @Key2 = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'a.loai_ts', 'b.loai_ts'), 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5 , 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, b.ma_bp, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, b.loai_ts, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ky_kh, c.ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctdmcc1 a with(nolock) left join dmcc b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam * 12 + a.ky between ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period)) + ''' and ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)) + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_tg_ts <> '''' and ' + @Key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Key
	SET @Key2 = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'a.loai_ts', 'b.loai_ts'), 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, max(b.ma_bp), sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt), sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(a.gt_da_kh_nt), sum(a.gt_cl), sum(a.gt_cl_nt), sum(a.gt_kh_ky), sum(a.gt_kh_ky_nt),'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(b.loai_ts), max(b.ten_ts), max(b.ten_ts2), max(b.ngay_giam), max(b.so_ky_kh), max(c.ten_tg_ts), max(c.ten_tg_ts2),  max(a.ma_nt), max(a.ty_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhcc a with(nolock) left join dmcc b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on b.ma_giam_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where b.ngay_giam between ''' + dbo.ff_GetBOP(@Year, @Period) + ''' and ''' + dbo.ff_GetEOP(@Year2, @Period2) + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ' and b.ma_giam_ts <> '''' and dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetBOP(a.nam, a.ky)) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_giam) and ' + @Key2
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.so_the_ts '
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @cFC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts,ten_ts,ten_ts2', 'INT,#,NVARCHAR(511),NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + ', ' + @Order
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_the_ts, ngay_mua, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_ts2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_tg_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_tg_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_tg_ts2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_tg_ts2'

	IF @GroupBy <> ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from  #report order by ' + @GroupBy + ', sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from  #report order by sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO


CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_UpdateFLManualData2](
		@nPeriod1 INT, 
		@nYear1 INT, 
		@nPeriod2 INT, 
		@nYear2 INT, 
		@cUnit VARCHAR(128), 
		@RPCode CHAR(2), 
		@cForm VARCHAR(16), 
		@nReportType TINYINT,
		@nPeriodType TINYINT,
		@nPeriodCount INT,
		@cReportTable VARCHAR(32), 
		@cColumnName VARCHAR(32),
		@cColumnOrder CHAR(2),
		@cColumnType CHAR(1)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQLRet NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strSQLRet = 'UPDATE %Table SET %ColumnName = b.%Field'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' FROM %Table a JOIN ('
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' SELECT * FROM gltcpt99 WHERE ky1 = %nPeriod1 AND nam1 = %nYear1 AND ky2 = %nPeriod2 AND nam2 = %nYear2 '
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' AND dang_bc = %nReportType AND loai_ky = %nPeriodType AND so_ky = %nPeriodCount AND form = %cForm AND ma_dvcs = %cUnit AND ma_bc = %RPCode AND cot = %cColumnOrder'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' ) b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Table', @cReportTable)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%ColumnName', @cColumnName)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Field', CASE WHEN @cColumnType = 'D' THEN 'ngay' WHEN @cColumnType = 'N' THEN 'so' ELSE 'chu' END)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nPeriod1', STR(@nPeriod1, 2))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nYear1', STR(@nYear1, 4))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nPeriod2', STR(@nPeriod2, 2))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nYear2', STR(@nYear2, 4))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cUnit', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cUnit, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%RPCode', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@RPCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nReportType', STR(@nReportType, 3))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nPeriodType', STR(@nPeriodType, 3))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%nPeriodCount', STR(@nPeriodCount, 3))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cColumnOrder', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cColumnOrder, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cForm', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cForm, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	RETURN @strSQLRet
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_Convert2AccountBalanceFromCustomerBalance  AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @nYear INT, @cUnit VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @nYear = Nam_bd FROM Dmstt
	DECLARE csUnit CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs
	OPEN csUnit
	FETCH NEXT FROM csUnit INTO @cUnit
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs_Convert2AccountBalanceFromCustomerBalance4Unit @nYear, @cUnit
			FETCH NEXT FROM csUnit INTO @cUnit
		END
	CLOSE csUnit
	DEALLOCATE csUnit
	SELECT DISTINCT Tk FROM Cdkh WHERE Nam = @nYear AND Tk NOT IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Tk_cn <> 0 AND Loai_tk = 1)
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$ChangeCode]
	@IDNumber INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @id_no INT, @old_value NVARCHAR(33), @new_value NVARCHAR(33), @fields VARCHAR(1024), @rejected VARCHAR(1024), @duplicate VARCHAR(1024), @xtype TINYINT, @basetable VARCHAR(64), @basefield VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @inquiry_table2 VARCHAR(64), @xtype2 TINYINT, @operation2 VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_gh1 SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_gh2 SMALLDATETIME

	CREATE TABLE #c (value TINYINT)
	INSERT INTO #c SELECT 1
	SELECT @ngay_gh1 = ngay_gh1, @ngay_gh2 = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR
		SELECT a.id_no, a.old_value, a.new_value, b.fields, b.rejected, b.duplicate, a.xtype, b.basetable, b.basefield
			FROM syscodechange a LEFT JOIN syscodechangelist b ON a.code = b.code
			WHERE a.status = 0 AND (@IDNumber IS NULL OR id_no = @IDNumber)
			ORDER BY id_no
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id_no, @old_value, @new_value, @fields, @rejected, @duplicate, @xtype, @basetable, @basefield
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #c SET value = 1
	
		-- Kiểm tra loại xtype = 1 (đổi mã) nhưng mã đã có hoặc lồng
		IF @xtype = 1 BEGIN
			-- dmtk không kiểm tra lồng
			IF @basetable = 'dmtk' SET @q = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @basetable WHERE @basefield  = ''@new_value%'')'
				ELSE SET @q = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @basetable WHERE (@basefield <> ''@old_value'') AND @basefield LIKE (''@new_value%'')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @basetable WHERE (@basefield <> ''@old_value'') AND ''@new_value'' LIKE (RTRIM(@basefield) + ''%''))'
			SET @q = @q + ' UPDATE #c SET value = 0'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@basetable', @basetable), '@basefield', @basefield), '@old_value', REPLACE(@old_value, '''', '''''')), '@new_value', REPLACE(@new_value, '''', ''''''))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #c WHERE value = 0) UPDATE syscodechange SET status = 2, datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id2 = @UserID WHERE id_no = @id_no
		END
		-- Kiểm tra loại xtype = 2 (gộp mã) nhưng mã được gộp không tồn tại
		IF @xtype = 2 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @basetable WHERE (@basefield = ''@new_value''))'
			SET @q = @q + ' UPDATE #c SET value = 0'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@basetable', @basetable), '@basefield', @basefield), '@old_value', REPLACE(@old_value, '''', '''''')), '@new_value', REPLACE(@new_value, '''', ''''''))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #c WHERE value = 0) UPDATE syscodechange SET status = 3, datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id2 = @UserID WHERE id_no = @id_no
		END

		-- Run
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #c WHERE value = 1) BEGIN
			--UPDATE syscodechange SET status = 1, datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id2 = @UserID WHERE id_no = @id_no

			EXEC FastBusiness$System$ChangeCodeID @old_value, @new_value, @fields, @rejected, @duplicate, 0
			-- Cập nhật các bảng tìm kiếm chứng từ
			DECLARE r CURSOR FOR SELECT inquiry_table, xtype, operation FROM syscodechangevoucher WHERE CHARINDEX(',' + RTRIM(field) + ',', ',' + @fields + ',') > 0 and inquiry_table <> '' -- Thêm vào inquiry_table <> ''
			OPEN r
			FETCH NEXT FROM r INTO @inquiry_table2, @xtype2, @operation2
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = 'UPDATE ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@inquiry_table2, '$', '$%Partition')) + ' SET ' + CASE WHEN @xtype2 = 1 THEN 'm' ELSE 'd' END + '$ = REPLACE(' + CASE WHEN @xtype2 = 1 THEN 'm' ELSE 'd' END + '$, ''#' + RTRIM(@operation2) + '$' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@old_value, '''', '''''')) + ''', ''#' + RTRIM(@operation2) + '$' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@new_value, '''', '''''')) + ''')'	

				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @ngay_gh1, @ngay_gh2, @UserID, @Admin, 1

				FETCH NEXT FROM r INTO @inquiry_table2, @xtype2, @operation2
			END
			CLOSE r
			DEALLOCATE r
			
			UPDATE syscodechange SET status = 9, datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id2 = @UserID WHERE id_no = @id_no
			SET @q = 'UPDATE ' + @basetable + ' SET datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' WHERE ' + @basefield + ' = ''' + @new_value + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id_no, @old_value, @new_value, @fields, @rejected, @duplicate, @xtype, @basetable, @basefield
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetPurGroupFilter]
	@Pur VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Field VARCHAR(32),
	@Return VARCHAR(1024) OUTPUT,
	@OutType TINYINT -- 0 - return by code column, 1 - return by identity column
AS  
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN

	SET @Return = ''

	-- Admin
	IF @Admin = 1 BEGIN
		SET @Return = '(1 = 1)'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Full access rights
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @userID) BEGIN
		SET @Return = '(1 = 1)'
		RETURN
	END

	IF @Pur = '' BEGIN
		IF @OutType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = @Return + '$' + RTRIM(b.id) FROM bisyspurgrouprights a JOIN bidmnhom0 b ON a.ma_nh0 = b.ma_nh WHERE a.[user_id] = @UserID ORDER BY b.id
			SET @Return = '''' + @Return + '$'' like ''%$'' + ' + @Field + ' + ''$%'''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @Return = @Field + ' in (select ma_nh0 from bisyspurgrouprights where user_id = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
		END
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- No access rights
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND ma_nh0 = @Pur) BEGIN
			SET @Return = '(1 = 0)'
			RETURN
		END
	END
	
	--	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vsfctnx]
AS
	SELECT a.kind, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.ma_px, a.ma_kh, a.ma_nx, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
			b.ten_ct AS ten_ct, b.ten_ct2 AS ten_ct2, c.ten_loai AS ten_loai, c.ten_loai2 AS ten_loai2
		FROM dbo.sfctnx a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmloaict c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = c.loai_ct

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.dt_removefromsourcecontrol

as

    set nocount on

    declare @iPropertyObjectId int
    select @iPropertyObjectId = (select objectid from dbo.dtproperties where property = 'VCSProjectID')

    exec dbo.dt_droppropertiesbyid @iPropertyObjectId, null

    /* -1 is returned by dt_droppopertiesbyid */
    if @@error <> 0 and @@error <> -1 return 1

    return 0
