CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunSemiPrdRequisition] @cItem VARCHAR(33), @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nguon CHAR(3), @so_lsx VARCHAR(33), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_ct0 SMALLDATETIME, @so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_dh VARCHAR(33), @i INT, @count INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT ma_vt, nguon, so_lsx, ngay_ct, ngay_dat AS ngay_yc, sl_nhap + sl_xuat AS so_luong, so_dh INTO #mpctyc FROM mpctyc WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT ma_vt, so_luong, ngay_ct AS ngay_yc INTO #ctbtp FROM #mpctyc

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, nguon, so_lsx, ISNULL(ngay_dat, ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, sl_nhap + sl_xuat AS so_luong, so_dh INTO #run FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND nguon IN ('PS', 'MO', 'PL', 'FP') AND ISNULL(ma_sp, '') = '' ORDER BY ngay_ct
	SELECT @count = MAX(stt) FROM #run

	SELECT @i = 1
	WHIlE (@i <= @count) BEGIN
		SELECT @nguon = nguon, @so_lsx = so_lsx,  @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @so_luong = so_luong, @so_dh = so_dh FROM #run WHERE stt = @i
		TRUNCATE TABLE #ctbtp

		INSERT INTO #ctbtp(ma_vt, so_luong, ngay_yc) EXEC rs_MPSRunGetSemiPrdFromBOMByProduct @ngay_ct, @cItem, @ngay_ct, @so_luong
		INSERT INTO #mpctyc(ma_vt, nguon, so_lsx, ngay_ct, ngay_yc, so_luong, so_dh) SELECT ma_vt,  @nguon, @so_lsx, @ngay_ct, ngay_yc, so_luong, @so_dh FROM #ctbtp

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END



	INSERT INTO mpctyc
		(
			nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
			, ngay_ct0
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, sl_ton
			, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
			, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
			, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
			, ma_sp
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
		)
	SELECT nguon, so_lsx, ma_vt, ngay_ct
			, ngay_ct -- ngay_yc
			, 0, so_luong
			, 0
			, 0, 0, 0, NULL
			, 0, '', NULL, 0
			, so_dh, '', 2, 0
			, @cItem
			, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
			, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
			, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
		FROM #mpctyc
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostAITran]
	@cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cCustName NVARCHAR(511), 
	@cAddress NVARCHAR(511), 
	@cTaxCode NVARCHAR(511),
	@nVAT CHAR(1), -- 1 ctgt20, 2 - ctgt30, 9 - Other
	@cType CHAR(1), -- Kieu bang ke: 1 duong, 2 am
	@DetailTax BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DELETE ctgt20 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
	DELETE ctgt30 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber

	IF @nVAT = '9' RETURN

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @strInsertMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @strUpdateDetail NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @n INT
	DECLARE @cCustTax VARCHAR(33), @cCust VARCHAR(33), @cSo_ct VARCHAR(32), @cSeri VARCHAR(33), @ma_nt CHAR(3), @cBC VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @Ten_vt NVARCHAR(511), @Ghi_chu NVARCHAR(511), @Tk_thue_no VARCHAR(33), @Tk_thue_co VARCHAR(33), @cVATTbl VARCHAR(33), @tmp VARCHAR(33), @ma_thue CHAR(8), @thue_suat NUMERIC(5,2)
	DECLARE @so_ct VARCHAR(33), @so_ct0 VARCHAR(33), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_kh VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @cType = '1' SELECT @n = 1 ELSE SELECT @n = -1


	-- Struct	
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #master FROM hddc
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #detail FROM cthddc
	SELECT * INTO #outputvat FROM wrkoutputvat
	SELECT * INTO #inputvat FROM wrkinputvat


	SET @strSQL = 'INSERT INTO #master' + ' SELECT * FROM ' + @cMasterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @cIDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	-- (Loại kê khai)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ISNULL(loai_kk, '') = '9') RETURN

	SET @strSQL = 'INSERT INTO #detail' + ' SELECT * FROM ' + @cDetailTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @cIDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @cSo_ct = so_ct, @cSeri = RTRIM(so_seri), @ma_nt = ma_nt, @tien2 = @n * (t_tien2 - t_ck), @tien_nt2 = @n * (t_tien_nt2 - t_ck_nt), 
			@thue = @n * t_thue, @thue_nt = @n * t_thue_nt, @Ten_vt = RTRIM(ten_vtthue), @Ghi_chu = ghi_chuthue, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct,
			@ma_thue = ma_thue, @thue_suat = 0, @Tk_thue_co = tk_thue_co, @Tk_thue_no = tk_thue_no, @ma_kh = RTRIM(ma_kh)
		FROM #master

	IF @ma_thue <> '' SELECT @thue_suat = ISNULL(thue_suat, 0) FROM dmthue WHERE ma_thue = @ma_thue

	SELECT @cVATTbl = CASE WHEN @nVAT = 1 THEN 'ctgt20' ELSE 'ctgt30' END, @tmp = CASE WHEN @nVAT = 1 THEN '#outputvat' ELSE '#inputvat' END

	IF @DetailTax = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Ten_vt = '' SELECT @Ten_vt = (SELECT TOP 1 dien_giai FROM #detail ORDER BY tien2 DESC)

		SET @strSQL = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert(@tmp, '#master', @cMasterTable, @cVATTbl, '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @strUpdateDetail = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE(
				@tmp,
				'#detail', 
				@cDetailTable, 
				@cVATTbl,
				'1 = 1', 
				'line_nbr = 1', 
				'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 
				'line_nbr'
			)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strUpdateDetail

		IF @nVAT = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien2 = @tien2, t_tien_nt2 = @tien_nt2, t_thue = @thue, t_thue_nt = @thue_nt,
				tk_thue_co = @Tk_thue_co, tk_du = @Tk_thue_no,
				ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ma_thue = @ma_thue, thue_suat = @thue_suat, ghi_chu = @Ghi_chu,
				stt_rec0 = '001', line_nbr = 1, ma_mau_ct = '', ky = 0, nam = 0
		END ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE #inputvat SET t_tien = @tien2, t_tien_nt = @tien_nt2, t_thue = @thue, t_thue_nt = @thue_nt, so_luong = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia = 0,
				tk_thue_no = @Tk_thue_co, tk_du = @Tk_thue_no,
				ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ma_thue = @ma_thue, thue_suat = @thue_suat, ghi_chu = @Ghi_chu,
				stt_rec0 = '001', line_nbr = 1, ma_mau_ct = '',
				so_seri0 = @cSeri, ma_nt = @ma_nt, so_ct0 = @cSo_ct, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_ct
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert(@tmp, '#detail', @cDetailTable, @cVATTbl, '1 = 1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @strSQL = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE(@tmp, '#master', @cMasterTable, @cVATTbl, '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ma_thue, thue_suat, ma_kh2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SELECT @strSQL = ''
		IF @Ten_vt = ''
			SET @strSQL = 'select c.ma_thue, d.dien_giai as ten_vt into #tenvt'
					+ ' from (select a.ma_thue, min(b.line_nbr) as line_nbr from (select ma_thue, max(tien2) as tien2 from #detail group by ma_thue) a join #detail b on a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue and a.tien2 = b.tien2 group by a.ma_thue) c'
					+ ' join #detail d on c.ma_thue = d.ma_thue and c.line_nbr = d.line_nbr'
		IF @nVAT = 1 BEGIN
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'update #outputvat set tk_thue_co = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode,'
				+ ' ten_vt = ' +  CASE WHEN @Ten_vt = '' THEN ' c.ten_vt' ELSE '@ten_vt' END + ', ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,'
				+ ' t_tien_nt2 = @n * (b.tien_nt2 - b.ck_nt), t_tien2 = @n * (b.tien2 - b.ck), t_thue_nt = @n * b.thue_nt, t_thue = @n * b.thue, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ma_mau_ct = '''''
				+ ' from #outputvat a join #detail b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' 
				+ CASE WHEN @Ten_vt = '' THEN ' join #tenvt c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' ELSE '' END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'update #inputvat set tk_thue_no = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode,'
				+ ' ten_vt = ' +  CASE WHEN @Ten_vt = '' THEN ' c.ten_vt' ELSE '@ten_vt' END + ', ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,'
				+ ' t_tien_nt = @n * (b.tien_nt2 - b.ck_nt), t_tien = @n * (b.tien2 - b.ck), t_thue_nt = @n * b.thue_nt, t_thue = @n * b.thue, so_luong = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia = 0, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ma_mau_ct = '''','
				+ ' so_seri0 = @cSeri, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_ct, so_ct0 = @cSo_ct'
				+ ' from #inputvat a join #detail b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' 
				+ CASE WHEN @Ten_vt = '' THEN ' join #tenvt c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' ELSE '' END
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@tk_thue_no varchar(32), @cCustName nvarchar(511), @cAddress nvarchar(511), @cTaxCode nvarchar(511), @ten_vt nvarchar(511), @ghi_chu nvarchar(511), @ma_kh varchar(32), @cSeri varchar(33), @ngay_ct smalldatetime, @cSo_ct varchar(32), @n int', @tk_thue_no, @cCustName, @cAddress, @cTaxCode, @ten_vt, @ghi_chu, @ma_kh, @cSeri, @ngay_ct, @cSo_ct, @n	
	END

	IF @nVAT = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cBC
		INSERT INTO ctgt20 SELECT * FROM #outputvat
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #inputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cBC
		INSERT INTO ctgt30 SELECT * FROM #inputvat
	END
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_IsRelationAcct(@cpAcct VARCHAR(33), @cAcct VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Ret BIT
	IF RTRIM(@cpAcct) = RTRIM(@cAcct) RETURN 1
	IF dbo.ff_ParentAcct(@cpAcct) = dbo.ff_ParentAcct(@cAcct) AND LEN(RTRIM(@cpAcct)) < LEN(RTRIM(@cAcct)) SET @Ret = 1 ELSE SET @Ret = 0
	RETURN @Ret
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UserInfoReUpdate]
	@oldCode VARCHAR(30)
	, @newCode VARCHAR(30)
	, @cSysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strsql NVARCHAR(4000), @nStart INT
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @ma_nk VARCHAR(33), @lstuser2 VARCHAR(8000), @lstuser0 VARCHAR(8000), @lstuser02 VARCHAR(8000), @iuser VARCHAR(30)
	CREATE TABLE #u_info (id INT, name CHAR(30), user_yn TINYINT, user_lst VARCHAR(3000))

	SET @strsql = 'INSERT INTO #u_info SELECT id, name, user_yn, user_lst FROM ' + @cSysDB + '..userinfo2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strsql

	IF @oldCode <> '' BEGIN
		UPDATE v20dmctnk SET lstuser2 = REPLACE(', ' + lstuser2 + ',', ', ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@oldCode)) + ',', ', ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@newCode)) + ',')
			WHERE CHARINDEX(', ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@oldCode)) + ',', ', ' + lstuser2 + ',') > 0
		UPDATE v20dmctnk SET lstuser2 = SUBSTRING(lstuser2, 3, LEN(lstuser2) - 3)
			WHERE LEFT(lstuser2, 2) = ', '
	END
	
	DECLARE xCur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, ma_nk, lstuser2 FROM v20dmctnk WHERE lstuser2 <> ''
	OPEN xCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @ma_ct, @ma_nk, @lstuser2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @lstuser2 = @lstuser2 + ','
			SET @nStart = 1; SET @lstuser02 = ''; SET @lstuser0 = ''
			WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @lstuser2,  @nStart) > 0
				BEGIN
					SET @iuser = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@lstuser2, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @lstuser2, @nStart + 1) - @nStart)))
					IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #u_info WHERE name = @iuser) BEGIN
						SET @lstuser02 = @lstuser02 + ', ' + @iuser
						IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #u_info WHERE name = @iuser AND user_yn = 1)
							SET @lstuser0 = @lstuser0 + ', ' + @iuser
						ELSE
							IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #u_info WHERE name = @iuser AND user_yn = 0 AND user_lst <> '')
								SET @lstuser0 = @lstuser0 + ', ' + (SELECT RTRIM(user_lst) FROM #u_info WHERE name = @iuser)
					END

					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @lstuser2,  @nStart) + 1
				END

			IF @lstuser02 <> '' SET @lstuser02 = SUBSTRING(@lstuser02, 3, LEN(@lstuser02))
			IF @lstuser0 <> '' SET @lstuser0 = SUBSTRING(@lstuser0, 3, LEN(@lstuser0))
			UPDATE v20dmctnk SET lstuser2 = @lstuser02, lstuser = @lstuser0 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct AND ma_nk = @ma_nk

			FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @ma_ct, @ma_nk, @lstuser2
		END
	CLOSE xCur
	DEALLOCATE xCur

	DELETE dmctks2 WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM #u_info)
	DELETE dmctks WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM #u_info)
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostMRClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c87$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm87$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd87$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i87$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'a87$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a87$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''5'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c87$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO

	FROM dmdvcskb a LEFT JOIN dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff20_GetInsertTotal]
	(
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @strReturn = ''
	SET @strReturn = 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + '(ten_XX, ten_XX2, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES('''', '''', -8, 0, 0)'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + '(ten_XX, ten_XX2, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ' + @strSum + ')'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + '	SELECT N''' + RTRIM(@s1) + ''', N''' + RTRIM(@s12) + ''', -9, 0, 0' + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a WHERE systotal = 1'
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTimesheetByDay]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @Where NVARCHAR(1023), @max INT, @i INT, @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @day INT
	SELECT @Where = '', @Join = '', @Key = '', @EmpKey = ''
	SELECT @day = DATEDIFF(DAY,@DateFrom, @DateTo)
		
	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #t(k CHAR(23), stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay SMALLDATETIME, cong VARCHAR(64), ma_cong VARCHAR(64), so_gio NUMERIC(9, 5), so_ngay NUMERIC(9, 5), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #report(
		stt_rec CHAR(23), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(512), 
		n01 VARCHAR(64), n02 VARCHAR(64), n03 VARCHAR(64), n04 VARCHAR(64), n05 VARCHAR(64), n06 VARCHAR(64), n07 VARCHAR(64), n08 VARCHAR(64), n09 VARCHAR(64), n10 VARCHAR(64), 
		n11 VARCHAR(64), n12 VARCHAR(64), n13 VARCHAR(64), n14 VARCHAR(64), n15 VARCHAR(64), n16 VARCHAR(64), n17 VARCHAR(64), n18 VARCHAR(64), n19 VARCHAR(64), n20 VARCHAR(64), 
		n21 VARCHAR(64), n22 VARCHAR(64), n23 VARCHAR(64), n24 VARCHAR(64), n25 VARCHAR(64), n26 VARCHAR(64), n27 VARCHAR(64), n28 VARCHAR(64), n29 VARCHAR(64), n30 VARCHAR(64), n31 VARCHAR(64), 
		n32 VARCHAR(64), n33 VARCHAR(64), n34 VARCHAR(64), n35 VARCHAR(64), n36 VARCHAR(64), n37 VARCHAR(64), n38 VARCHAR(64), n39 VARCHAR(64), n40 VARCHAR(64), 
		c01 NUMERIC(9, 5), c02 NUMERIC(9, 5), c03 NUMERIC(9, 5), c04 NUMERIC(9, 5), c05 NUMERIC(9, 5), c06 NUMERIC(9, 5), c07 NUMERIC(9, 5), c08 NUMERIC(9, 5), c09 NUMERIC(9, 5), c10 NUMERIC(9, 5),
		c11 NUMERIC(9, 5), c12 NUMERIC(9, 5), c13 NUMERIC(9, 5), c14 NUMERIC(9, 5), c15 NUMERIC(9, 5), c16 NUMERIC(9, 5), c17 NUMERIC(9, 5), c18 NUMERIC(9, 5), c19 NUMERIC(9, 5), c20 NUMERIC(9, 5),
		stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1)
	)
	SELECT TOP 20 ma_ct, ds_ma_cong, loai_dl, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(9, 5)) AS gt, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #hrkbctbcc FROM hrkbctbcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE in_ck = 1 AND status = '1' ORDER BY stt, ma_ct

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	-- Group
	IF @EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #empGroup FROM hrnv
		IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
		SELECT @Where = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(SUBSTRING(@Where, 6, LEN(@Where)))
		SET @q = 'insert into #empGroup select stt_rec from hrnv where ' + @Where
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' exists (select 1 from #empGroup g where g.stt_rec = r.stt_rec)'
	END

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	IF @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' 

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t (k, stt_rec, ngay, cong, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay) select '''', r.stt_rec, r.ngay, r.ma_cong + case when sum(r.so_ngay) = 1 then '''' else ''('' + '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when right(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), 2) =''00'' then parsename(sum(r.so_gio), 2) when right(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), 1) = ''0'' then left(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), len(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio))) - 1) else rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)) end'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' + '')'' end, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio), sum(r.so_ngay)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock) join hrdmcong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.ngay, c.stt, r.ma_cong'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by r.stt_rec, r.ngay, c.stt, r.ma_cong'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	UPDATE #t SET k = stt_rec + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay, 112)

	-- Order
	CREATE INDEX o ON #t(k)
	SELECT k, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #t GROUP BY k
	CREATE INDEX o ON #order(k)

	SELECT a.stt - o.stt + 1 AS stt, a.k, a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.cong INTO #k FROM #t a JOIN #order o ON a.k = o.k
	CREATE INDEX o ON #k(k)

	-- Update
	SELECT k, stt_rec, ngay, cong INTO #r FROM #k WHERE stt = 1
	SELECT @max = MAX(stt) FROM #k
	SELECT @i = 2
	WHILE @i <= @max BEGIN
		UPDATE #r SET cong = a.cong + ', ' + b.cong FROM #r a JOIN #k b WITH (INDEX(o)) ON a.k = b.k WHERE b.stt = @i
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, n01, n02, n03, n04, n05, n06, n07, n08, n09, n10, n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20, n21, n22, n23, n24, n25, n26, n27, n28, n29, n30, n31, n32, n33, n34, n35, n36, n37, n38, n39, n40)
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
			FROM #r a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			ORDER BY b.ma_nv

	IF @Form = '20' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = COUNT(*) FROM #hrkbctbcc
		WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set c' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' = ' + CASE WHEN loai_dl = '1' THEN 'so_gio' ELSE 'so_ngay' END + ' from #report a join (select stt_rec, sum(so_gio) as so_gio, sum(so_ngay) as so_ngay from #t where ma_cong in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_ma_cong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''') group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
				FROM #hrkbctbcc WHERE id = @i
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SELECT @i = @i - 1
		END
	END

	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i <= @day BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set n' + REPLACE(STR(@i+1, 2), ' ', '0') + ' = b.cong from #report a join #r b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.ngay = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8),(DATEADD(DAY, @i, @DateFrom)), 112) + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY stt

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptObjectDetailCashFlowStatementsByMonth]
	@periodFrom INT,
	@yearFrom INT,
	@periodTo INT,
	@yearTo INT,
	@planType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mới nhất, 2 - Gốc, 3 - Tùy chọn
	@revision INT,
	@pivotBy CHAR(1), -- 1 - Đơn vị, 2 - Bộ phận, 3 - Vụ việc
	@deptCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@jobCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@subJobTotal CHAR(1), -- 1 - Including, 0 - No
	@unitCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@bug TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @fieldBy VARCHAR(33), @FieldType VARCHAR(33), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Thu_chi CHAR(1), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ma_ct VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_du VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_gt VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_loai VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_phi VARCHAR(512), @Cong_no CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Gt_th NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_th_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @yearFrom = @yearFrom + (@periodFrom/12), @periodFrom = @periodFrom%12, @yearTo = @yearTo + (@periodTo/12), @periodTo = @periodTo%12
	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@periodFrom, @yearFrom), @dateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@periodTo, @yearTo), @key = ''
	SELECT @fieldBy = CASE @pivotBy WHEN '1' THEN 'ma_dvcs' WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_bp' WHEN '3' THEN 'ma_vv' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @FieldType = RTRIM(field) FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '02'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, tk, tk_du, ma_phi, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_ltc, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #r00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #BgBalanceAcc FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #EdBalanceAcc FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #BgBalanceJob FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #EdBalanceJob FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, ma_ct, tien, tien_nt INTO #kh FROM khdtthang

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, ma_so, tien AS gt_th, tien_nt AS gt_th_nt, tien AS gt_kh, tien_nt AS gt_kh_nt, tien AS gt_cl, tien_nt AS gt_cl_nt, thu_chi AS thu_chi INTO #repNorm FROM bcdtthang a, khdtthang b
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #valueTmp FROM #repNorm

	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt INTO #report FROM bcdtthang WHERE form = @formCode
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #result FROM #report
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS data INTO #data
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS xcode, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS code, ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv0 FROM wrkcolumns
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv FROM wrkcolumns
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy INTO #xPivotBy

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk INTO #ds_tk
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du INTO #ds_tk_du
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_gt INTO #ds_tk_gt
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_loai INTO #ds_ma_loai
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_phi INTO #ds_ma_phi

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.' + @fieldBy + ' <> '''''
	IF @deptCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @deptCode = REPLACE(REPLACE(@deptCode, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		INSERT INTO #data SELECT id, data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@deptCode, ',')
		SELECT a.ma_bp INTO #xdmbp FROM dmbp a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_bp LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #xdmbp b where a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp)'
	END
	IF @jobCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @jobCode = REPLACE(REPLACE(@jobCode, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		INSERT INTO #data SELECT id, data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@jobCode, ',')
		IF @subJobTotal = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT a.ma_vv INTO #xdmvv FROM dmvv a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
			--
			INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
			INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
			--
			SELECT @i = MIN(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)) BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #dmvv(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv) SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END ELSE INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM dmvv a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #dmvv b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)'
	END
	--
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unitCode, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @unitKey
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Get Data Arising
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r00 select a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldType, '') <> '' THEN ', isnull(a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType) + ', '''')' ELSE ', ''''' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldType, '') <> '' THEN ', a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType) ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Get Data Balance
	IF @pivotBy <> '2' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind <> '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '2') BEGIN
			IF @pivotBy = '1' INSERT INTO #BgBalanceAcc EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dateFrom, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
			IF @pivotBy = '3' INSERT INTO #BgBalanceJob EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Job @dateFrom, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '3') BEGIN
			IF @pivotBy = '1' INSERT INTO #EdBalanceAcc EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dateTo, NULL, '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
			IF @pivotBy = '3' INSERT INTO #EdBalanceJob EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Job @dateTo, NULL, '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
		END
	END

	-- Get Data Plan
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #kh select a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.ma_ct, sum(a.tien%xMonth), sum(a.tien_nt%xMonth)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from khdtthang a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where nam = %xYear'
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @planType = 1 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdtthang b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct group by b.' + @fieldBy + ' having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
								WHEN @planType = 2 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdtthang b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct group by b.' + @fieldBy + ' having min(b.lan) = a.lan)'
									ELSE ' and a.lan = (select max(b.lan) from khdtthang b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and b.lan <= ' + RTRIM(@revision) + ')' END
	SELECT @s = @s + ' group by a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.ma_ct'

	SELECT @i = @periodFrom, @n = @yearFrom
	--
	WHILE (@n * 12 + @i) <= (@yearTo * 12 + @periodTo) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xYear', RTRIM(@n)), '%xMonth', REPLACE(STR(@i,2), ' ', '0'))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
		IF @i > 12 SELECT @i = 1, @n = @n + 1
	END

	--
	IF @pivotBy = '3' AND @subJobTotal = '1' AND @jobCode = '' BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy AS ma_vv INTO #xdmvv2 FROM #r00
		INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #kh a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #BgBalanceJob) INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #BgBalanceJob a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #EdBalanceJob) INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #EdBalanceJob a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
		INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
		WHILE @i >= 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #dmvv(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv)
				SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(a.ma_vv), ISNULL(b.ma_vv_me, ''), a.bac_vv
					FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv_me AS ma_vv, b.bac_vv FROM #dmvv a LEFT JOIN #dmvv0 b ON a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv WHERE a.bac_vv = @i AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND a.ma_vv_me NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #dmvv)) a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
			SELECT @i = @i - 1
		END
	END

	-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu báo cáo
	TRUNCATE TABLE #repNorm
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, thu_chi, ds_chi_tieu FROM #report WHERE kind = '1'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #valueTmp
		-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu dòng tiền
		SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ',')
		WHILE @n > 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @n, ',')
			SELECT @Kind = kind, @Ds_tk = ds_tk, @Ds_tk_du = ds_tk_du, @Ds_tk_gt = ds_tk_gt, @Ds_ma_loai = ds_ma_loai, @Ds_ma_phi = ds_ma_phi, @Cong_no = cong_no FROM dmctdt WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct
			SELECT @Ds_tk = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_du = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk_du, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_gt = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk_gt, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_loai = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_ma_loai, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_phi = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_ma_phi, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
			--
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_du
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_gt
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_ma_loai
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_ma_phi

			INSERT INTO #ds_tk SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_tk_du SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_du, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_tk_gt SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_gt, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_ma_loai SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_ma_loai, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_ma_phi SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_ma_phi, ',')
			--
			IF @Ds_tk <> '' BEGIN
				IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #valueTmp
						SELECT xPivotBy, SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
							FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_du c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_du) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_loai e WHERE a.ma_ltc LIKE e.ma_loai) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi) GROUP BY xPivotBy

					IF @Ds_tk_gt <> ''
						INSERT INTO #valueTmp
							SELECT xPivotBy, SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
								FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_gt c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_gt) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_loai e WHERE a.ma_ltc LIKE e.ma_loai) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi) GROUP BY xPivotBy
				END
				--
				IF @pivotBy <> '2' AND @Kind <> '1' BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'insert into #valueTmp select ' + @fieldBy + ', case when ' + RTRIM(@Cong_no) + ' = 1 then sum(du_no - du_co) else sum(du_co - du_no) end, case when ' +
						RTRIM(@Cong_no) + ' = 1 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) end, 0, 0, 0, 0 from ' + CASE @Kind WHEN '2' THEN '#BgBalance' ELSE '#EdBalance' END +
						CASE @pivotBy WHEN '1' THEN 'Acc' ELSE 'Job' END + ' a where exists(select 1 from #ds_tk b where a.tk like b.tk) group by ' + @fieldBy
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END ELSE INSERT INTO #valueTmp SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #r00
			END
			--
			INSERT INTO #valueTmp SELECT xPivotBy, 0, 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0 FROM #kh WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct GROUP BY xPivotBy
			--
			SELECT @n = @n - 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT xPivotBy, @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), 0, 0, @Thu_chi FROM #valueTmp GROUP BY xPivotBy
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	--
	IF @pivotBy = '3' AND @subJobTotal = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
		WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_th = a.gt_th + b.gt_th, gt_th_nt = a.gt_th_nt + b.gt_th_nt, gt_kh = a.gt_kh + b.gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = a.gt_kh_nt + b.gt_kh_nt
				FROM #repNorm a JOIN (
					SELECT b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_so, SUM(gt_th) AS gt_th, SUM(gt_th_nt) AS gt_th_nt, SUM(gt_kh) AS gt_kh, SUM(gt_kh_nt) AS gt_kh_nt
						FROM #repNorm a JOIN #dmvv b ON a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv
						WHERE b.ma_vv_me <> '' AND bac_vv = @i
						GROUP BY b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_so
				) b ON a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv_me AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so
			SELECT @i = @i - 1
		END
	END
	--
	UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_th = - gt_th, gt_th_nt = - gt_th_nt, gt_kh = - gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = - gt_kh_nt WHERE thu_chi = 0

	SELECT xPivotBy INTO #del FROM #repNorm GROUP BY xPivotBy HAVING SUM(ABS(gt_th)) + SUM(ABS(gt_kh)) + SUM(ABS(gt_th_nt)) + SUM(ABS(gt_kh_nt)) = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #del) DELETE #repNorm FROM #repNorm a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #del b WHERE a.xPivotBy = b.xPivotBy)
	INSERT INTO #xPivotBy SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #repNorm
	--
	SELECT @fieldBy = MIN(xPivotBy) FROM #xPivotBy
	WHILE @fieldBy IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
				INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT @fieldBy, @Ma_so, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL
				--
				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_th = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_th_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th_nt), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_kh = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_kh_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh_nt), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
			END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		SELECT @fieldBy = MIN(xPivotBy) FROM #xPivotBy WHERE xPivotBy > @fieldBy
	END
	--
	UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_cl = gt_th - gt_kh, gt_cl_nt = gt_th_nt - gt_kh_nt

	-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT b.xPivotBy, a.stt, a.in_ck, CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.stt_in,
				CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, a.ma_so, a.ma_so_in, a.bold,
				ISNULL(c.gt_th, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_th_nt, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_kh, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_kh_nt, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_cl, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_cl_nt, 0)
			FROM #report a CROSS JOIN #xPivotBy b LEFT JOIN #repNorm c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so AND b.xPivotBy = c.xPivotBy

	-- Total
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result)
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT 'ZZZTOTAL', sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt) FROM #result GROUP BY sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT 'ZZZTOTAL', a.stt, a.in_ck, CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, a.ma_so, a.ma_so_in, a.bold, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #report a

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	--
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #result ORDER BY xPivotBy
	IF @reportForm = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT077'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT078'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT079'
	END
	IF @reportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT080'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT081'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT082'
	END
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN a.header <> 'ZZZTOTAL' THEN RTRIM(a.header) ELSE @Total END + ' - ' + RTRIM(b.header), b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	-- View
	SELECT xPivotBy
			, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_so) AS xRow
			, xPivotBy AS xColumn
			, CASE WHEN xPivotBy = 'ZZZTOTAL' THEN @Total ELSE xPivotBy END AS xColumnName
			, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN stt_in <> '' THEN stt_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so
			, CASE WHEN ma_so_in <> '' THEN ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in, bold
			, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPivotBy, sysorder, ma_so
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdtlkct
AS
	SELECT    dtlkct.*, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs AS ten_dvcs, dbo.dmdvcs.ten_dvcs2 AS ten_dvcs2, dbo.dmvv.ten_vv AS ten_vv, 
	                  dbo.dmvv.ten_vv2 AS ten_vv2, dbo.dtdmct.chi_tieu AS chi_tieu, dbo.dtdmct.chi_tieu2 AS chi_tieu2
		FROM         dtlkct LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmdvcs ON dtlkct.ma_dvcs = dbo.dmdvcs.ma_dvcs LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmvv ON dtlkct.ma_vv = dbo.dmvv.ma_vv LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dtdmct ON dtlkct.ma_so = dbo.dtdmct.ma_so
		WHERE     (nam IN   (SELECT  nam_bd  FROM  dmstt))

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesReportByObjects] -- fs20_SOSalesAmtByCust --
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@GroupBy INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @RefField VARCHAR(64), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @RefField = CASE @GroupBy
		WHEN 0 THEN 'kh'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'nvbh'
		WHEN 2 THEN 'nx'
		WHEN 3 THEN 'vv'
		WHEN 4 THEN 'hd'
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma, ma_nt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien_xuat AS tien, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, tien2 AS lai, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt
			, gia, gia_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, tien2 AS pt, tien_nt2 AS pt_nt INTO #Tmp FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, ma_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, lai, lai_nt
			, gia, gia_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom3
		INTO #Report FROM #Tmp

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_' + @RefField + ' <> '''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #Tmp select a.ma_' + @RefField + ', a.ma_nt'
	IF @Form = '1' SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) as lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) as lai_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) as pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) as pt_nt'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #Tmp SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0, lai_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SET @q = 'alter table #report add ma_xx VARCHAR(32), ten_xx NVARCHAR(511), ten_xx2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, max(a.ma_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(so_luong), sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt), sum(a.lai), sum(a.lai_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien2), sum(tien_nt2), sum(a.ck), sum(a.ck_nt), sum(a.thue), sum(a.thue_nt), sum(a.pt), sum(a.pt_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @RefField = 'kh' OR @RefField = 'vv' THEN ', max(c.nh_xx1), max(c.nh_xx2), max(c.nh_xx3)' ELSE ', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', max(c.ten_xx), ''''' ELSE ', '''', max(c.ten_xx2)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmxx c on a.ma = c.ma_xx'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END
		, gia2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien2/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt2/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_xx, ten_xx2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE '' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE REPLACE('ma_xx', 'xx', @RefField) END, REPLACE('ma_xx', 'xx', @RefField))
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF (@RefField = 'kh' OR @RefField = 'vv') AND @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups , 'xx', 'so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt', '#report')
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	IF @nSo_Ma_nt > 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('xx', 'so_luong', '#report')
	ELSE
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('xx', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt', '#report')
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) <> ''
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_xx as ma, ten_xx as ten, ten_xx2 as ten2, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt FROM #report ORDER BY ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder, ma_xx') + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_xx as ma, ten_xx as ten, ten_xx2 as ten2, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_xx, stt'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_UpdateAvgPriceIN	
	@dDate SMALLDATETIME, 
	@nSiteType TINYINT, 
	@nFCPriceType TINYINT, 
	@sIPVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@stt_rec CHAR(13), 
	@stt_rec0 CHAR(3), 
	@ma_vt VARCHAR(33), 
	@ma_kho VARCHAR(33), 
	@ma_khon VARCHAR(33), 
	@ma_nt CHAR(3), 
	@ma_ct CHAR(3), 
	@nxt TINYINT, 
	@ct_dc TINYINT, 
	@gia NUMERIC (38,12), 
	@gia_nt NUMERIC (38,12)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cDynTable VARCHAR(64), @sVCKey NVARCHAR(4000), @strBaseSQL NVARCHAR(4000),  @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nPRound TINYINT, @nFCPRound TINYINT, @nM TINYINT, @stt_rec_dc CHAR(13)
	SELECT @stt_rec_dc = LEFT(@stt_rec, 10) + @sIPVCCodes
	SELECT @nRound = 0, @nFCRound = 2, @nPRound = 2, @nFCPRound = 4, @nM = @nFCPriceType
	IF RTRIM(@ma_nt) = '' SELECT @nPRound = 0, @nFCPRound = 2, @gia_nt = 0
	
	SET @sVCKey = ' AND RTRIM(ma_ct) <> RTRIM(''' + @sIPVCCodes + ''')'

	SET @strBaseSQL = 'UPDATE ct70 SET'
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'gia = ' + RTRIM(@gia) + ','
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'tien_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat*' + RTRIM(@gia) + ', ' + RTRIM(@nRound) + '),'
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt = ' + RTRIM(@nM) + '* ' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ','
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'tien_nt_x = ' + RTRIM(@nM) + '* ROUND(sl_xuat*' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + ', ' + RTRIM(@nFCRound) + '),'
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'gia1 = ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nPRound) + '),'
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'gia_nt1 = ' + RTRIM(@nM) + '*ROUND(' + RTRIM(@gia_nt) + '*he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@nFCPRound) + ')'
	SET @strBaseSQL = @strBaseSQL + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''''

	SET @cDynTable = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) SET @cDynTable = 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112)	
	
	IF @nxt = 2 -- Issue
		BEGIN
			-- Update ct70
			EXEC sp_executesql @strBaseSQL

			-- Update r70
			IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strBaseSQL, 'ct70', @cDynTable)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			END

			IF @ct_dc = 1
				BEGIN
					-- Update ct70
					SET @strSQL = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strBaseSQL, 'xuat', 'nhap'), 'tien_nt_x', 'tien_nt_n'), @stt_rec, @stt_rec_dc)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

					-- Update r70
					IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
						SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, 'ct70', @cDynTable)
						EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
					END
				END
		END

	ELSE -- Receipt
		BEGIN
			-- Update ct70
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strBaseSQL, 'xuat', 'nhap'), 'tien_nt_x', 'tien_nt_n') + @sVCKey
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

			-- Update r70
			IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, 'ct70', @cDynTable)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			END
		END
END
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrhsbp]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_hl, a.he_so, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
	FROM hrhsbp a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPAutoGenerateSalesForecast]
	@cItem VARCHAR(33),
	@cSite VARCHAR(33),
	@nQuantity DECIMAL(28, 6),
	@cUOM NVARCHAR(33),
	@nCoeff DECIMAL(28, 6),
	@dStartDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@nPeriodQty INT,
	@nType INT,
	@nWeekend INT,
	@nEndMonth INT, 
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @nDaysOfFirstWeek INT
	IF @nType = 1 -- Weekly
		BEGIN
			-- Gen for first week (The interval days may be < 7)
			SET @i = 0
			SET @nDaysOfFirstWeek = 0
			WHILE @i < 7
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					SET @nDaysOfFirstWeek = @nDaysOfFirstWeek + 1
					IF DATEPART(dw, DATEADD(Day, @i, @dStartDate)) = @nWeekend SET @i = 7
				END
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt FROM mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 = @dStartDate AND ngay_ct2 = DATEADD(Day, @nDaysOfFirstWeek, @dStartDate) AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite)
				INSERT INTO mdbbh (ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong, dvt, he_so, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
						, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
						, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
					VALUES(@dStartDate, DATEADD(Day, @nDaysOfFirstWeek, @dStartDate), @cItem, @cSite, @nQuantity, @cUOM, @nCoeff, 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
			SET @dStartDate = DATEADD(Day, @nDaysOfFirstWeek + 1, @dStartDate)			
			-- Generate for continues weeks
			SET @i = 1
			WHILE @i < @nPeriodQty
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt FROM mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 = @dStartDate AND ngay_ct2 = DATEADD(Day, 6, @dStartDate) AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite)
						INSERT INTO mdbbh (ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong, dvt, he_so, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
								, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
								, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
							VALUES(@dStartDate, DATEADD(Day, 6, @dStartDate), @cItem, @cSite, @nQuantity, @cUOM, @nCoeff, 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
								, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
								, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
					SET @dStartDate = DATEADD(Day, 7, @dStartDate)
				END
		END
	ELSE -- Monthly
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @dEndDate SMALLDATETIME
			IF DAY(@dStartDate) >= @nEndMonth
				IF MONTH(@dStartDate) = 12
					SET @dEndDate = dbo.mf_GetDateOfEndDay(YEAR(@dStartDate) + 1, 1, @nEndMonth)
				ELSE
					SET @dEndDate = dbo.mf_GetDateOfEndDay(YEAR(@dStartDate), MONTH(@dStartDate) + 1, @nEndMonth)
			ELSE
				SET @dEndDate = dbo.mf_GetDateOfEndDay(YEAR(@dStartDate), MONTH(@dStartDate), @nEndMonth)
			SET @i = 1
			WHILE @i < @nPeriodQty
				BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ma_vt FROM mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 = @dStartDate AND ngay_ct2 = @dEndDate AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite)
						INSERT INTO mdbbh (ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong, dvt, he_so, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
								, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
								, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
							VALUES(@dStartDate, @dEndDate, @cItem, @cSite, @nQuantity, @cUOM, @nCoeff, 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
								, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
								, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
					SET @i = @i + 1
					SET @dStartDate = DATEADD(Day, 1, @dEndDate)
					SET @dEndDate = DATEADD(Month, 1, @dEndDate)
					SET @dEndDate = dbo.mf_GetDateOfEndDay(YEAR(@dEndDate), MONTH(@dEndDate), @nEndMonth)
				END
		END
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostGSTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @u NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(32)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gs FROM gldcsd a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 *, nh_dk AS nh_dk0, line_nbr AS line_nbr0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xtype, CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS head_item INTO #dGS0 FROM #detail
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, * INTO #dGS FROM #dGS0


	-- Get data
	SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#master', @masterTable, @masterTable, 'm10$000000', 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#detail', @detailTable, @detailTable, 'd10$000000', 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct FROM #master


	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	SELECT nh_dk, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype, --1-N, 0-C
			CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS head_item, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #grtype FROM #detail GROUP BY nh_dk
	UPDATE #grtype SET head_item = dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(id) WHERE id < 36

	SELECT a.*, a.tk AS tk_du, a.tk AS tk0, b.xtype, b.head_item INTO #d1 FROM #detail a JOIN #grtype b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) > 0 AND b.xtype = 1
	SELECT a.*, a.tk AS tk_du, a.tk AS tk0, b.xtype, b.head_item INTO #d2 FROM #detail a JOIN #grtype b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) > 0 AND b.xtype = 0

	SELECT a.* INTO #d10 FROM #detail a WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d1 b WHERE a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk)
	SELECT a.* INTO #d20 FROM #detail a WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d2 b WHERE a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk)

	SET @u = 'ma_kh = case when isnull(a.ma_kh, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_kh else b.ma_kh end, ma_vv = case when isnull(a.ma_vv, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_vv else b.ma_vv end, ma_hd = case when isnull(a.ma_hd, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_hd else b.ma_hd end, ma_ku = case when isnull(a.ma_ku, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_ku else b.ma_ku end, ma_td1 = case when isnull(a.ma_td1, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td1 else b.ma_td1 end, ma_td2 = case when isnull(a.ma_td2, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td2 else b.ma_td2 end, ma_td3 = case when isnull(a.ma_td3, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td3 else b.ma_td3 end, gc_td1 = case when isnull(a.gc_td1, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td1 else b.gc_td1 end, gc_td2 = case when isnull(a.gc_td2, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td2 else b.gc_td2 end, gc_td3 = case when isnull(a.gc_td3, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td3 else b.gc_td3 end, s1 = case when isnull(a.s1, '''') <> '''' then a.s1 else b.s1 end, s2 = case when isnull(a.s2, '''') <> '''' then a.s2 else b.s2 end, s3 = case when isnull(a.s3, '''') <> '''' then a.s3 else b.s3 end, sl_td1 = case when isnull(a.sl_td1, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td1 else b.sl_td1 end, sl_td2 = case when isnull(a.sl_td2, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td2 else b.sl_td2 end, sl_td3 = case when isnull(a.sl_td3, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td3 else b.sl_td3 end, s4 = case when isnull(a.s4, 0) <> 0 then a.s4 else b.s4 end, s5 = case when isnull(a.s5, 0) <> 0 then a.s5 else b.s5 end, s6 = case when isnull(a.s6, 0) <> 0 then a.s6 else b.s6 end, ngay_td1 = case when not a.ngay_td1 is null then a.ngay_td1 else b.ngay_td1 end, ngay_td2 = case when not a.ngay_td2 is null then a.ngay_td2 else b.ngay_td2 end, ngay_td3 = case when not a.ngay_td3 is null then a.ngay_td3 else b.ngay_td3 end, s7 = case when not a.s7 is null then a.s7 else b.s7 end, s8 = case when not a.s8 is null then a.s8 else b.s8 end, s9 = case when not a.s9 is null then a.s9 else b.s9 end, dien_giai = case when isnull(a.dien_giai, '''') <> '''' then a.dien_giai else b.dien_giai end'

	SET @q = 'update #d1 set tk_du = b.tk, ' + @u + ' from #d1 a join #d10 b on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #d2 set tk_du = b.tk, ' + @u + ' from #d2 a join #d20 b on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGS0', '#d1', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGS0', '#d2', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGS', '#dGS0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'nh_dk, line_nbr', NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGS SET nh_dk0 = nh_dk, line_nbr0 = line_nbr, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gs', '#dGS', '#gs', '#dGS', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGS SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0 WHERE xtype = 1
	UPDATE #dGS SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0 WHERE xtype = 0

	SET @q = 'update #dGS set ' + @u + ' from #dGS b join #d10 a on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk0 where b.xtype = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #dGS set ' + @u + ' from #dGS b join #d20 a on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk0 where b.xtype = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gs', '#dGS', '#gs', '#dGS', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT nh_dk, dien_giai INTO #gd1 FROM #gs WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0
	SELECT nh_dk, dien_giai INTO #gd2 FROM #gs WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0
	UPDATE #gs SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai FROM #gs a JOIN #gd1 b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) <> 0
	UPDATE #gs SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai FROM #gs a JOIN #gd2 b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) <> 0


	-- Post to gldcsd
	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gs', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'status = 1, ma_gd = ''''', '', 'dien_giai', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai', ''

	DELETE gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO gldcsd SELECT * FROM #gs

	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

	SELECT @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Allocate$Number(@t, @n, @p, @c, @h, @k, @f)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
