CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CO2GL]
	@Period NUMERIC(2), 
	@Year NUMERIC(4), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- @Key 
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and c.pb_yn = 1 and (ps_tk <> 0 or ps_tk_nt <> 0)'
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, b.tk_spdd as tk_no, dbo.ff_GetWordNum(c.tk_no, 1) as tk_co'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(ps_tk) as tien, sum(ps_tk_nt) as tien_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xcdytdd a with(nolock) left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt left join xdmyt c with(nolock) on a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, b.tk_spdd, c.tk_no'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostAPTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 	
	@idNumber CHAR(13), 
	@groups VARCHAR(128), 
	@step TINYINT, 	
	@downPayment VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@postFrom TINYINT = 1 -- 1 - Voucher, 2 - Post Transaction
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_nt VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT,
		@ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_ct0 SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct0 VARCHAR(32), @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @cMemo NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m31$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d31$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.ma_kh2 AS cuc_thue INTO #inputvat FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ap FROM cttt30 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #inputvat' + ' select *, ma_kh2 as cuc_thue from ctgt30 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk_du, tk_vt AS tk0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	SELECT TOP 1 @tk = tk, @ma_nt = ma_nt, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_ct = ma_ct, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct0, @so_ct0 = so_ct0, @so_ct = so_ct, @cMemo = dien_giai FROM #master

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#inputvat', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '10'
	

	-- Down Payment
	DECLARE @Change BIT
	SELECT @Change = 0
	IF @downPayment = '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_ut' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF (@ma_nt <> @baseCurrency) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p31 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #u(stt_rec0 CHAR(3), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), cl NUMERIC(28, 6))
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$DownPayment$CreateDifference @idNumber, 'p31', '#master', '#detail', '', 'tien'			
			SELECT @downPayment = '#u'
		END
	END
	IF (@downPayment <> '' AND @downPayment <> 'None') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update #detail set tien = a.tien + b.cl from #detail a join ' + @downPayment + ' b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DECLARE @n NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @n = SUM(cl) FROM #u
	
		IF ISNULL(@n, 0) <> 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #master SET t_tien = t_tien + @n, t_tt = t_tt + @n
			SELECT @Change = 1
		END
	END


	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SET @isPost = 1
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0

	IF @step > 1 BEGIN	
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = tien_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Thue
		IF @isPost = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE (t_thue + t_thue_nt) <> 0) BEGIN
			DECLARE @stt INT
			SELECT @stt = MAX(stt) FROM #dGL
			UPDATE #inputvat SET cuc_thue = '' FROM #inputvat a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
			SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_thue_no AS tk, t_thue AS ps_no, t_thue_nt AS ps_no_nt, t_thue AS ps_co, t_thue_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai INTO #tGL FROM #inputvat

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL', '#inputvat', 't_thue + t_thue_nt <> 0', 't_thue, t_thue_nt', 'tk_thue_no, cuc_thue' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, dien_giai = @cMemo, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = t_thue, ps_co_nt = t_thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + @stt + 2) / 2), line_nbr = stt + @stt + 1

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET line_nbr = line_nbr + 1, tk = tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
			UPDATE #tGL SET ma_kh = ma_kh2 FROM #tGL a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1) AND a.ma_kh2 <> ''

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 0, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', 'so_ct0, ngay_ct0', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'
		UPDATE #gl SET ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_ct0 ELSE ngay_ct0 END, so_ct0 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(so_ct0, '') = '' THEN @so_ct0 ELSE so_ct0 END
		
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$PostInvoiceNumber @masterTable, @detailTable, '', '', @idNumber, @groups, 0
	
		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	
	IF @postFrom <> 1 RETURN

	-- TT
	-- Down Payment
	DECLARE @r INT
	IF @Change = 1 SELECT @r = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_po_tt' AND val = '0') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #inputvat)
	BEGIN
		-- Begin
		DECLARE @Tat_toan TINYINT, @T_tt_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ngay_tt SMALLDATETIME, @cMode CHAR(1), @T_tt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_tt_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = SUM(tt_qd), @T_tt1 = SUM(tt), @T_tt_nt1= SUM(tt_nt)
			FROM cttt30 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt = @idNumber
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = CASE WHEN @T_tt_qd IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_qd END, @T_tt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt1 END, @T_tt_nt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt_nt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_nt1 END

		SELECT @Tat_toan = 0, @Ngay_tt = NULL, @cMode = 'N'
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber)
			SELECT @Tat_toan = tat_toan, @Ngay_tt = ngay_tt, @cMode = 'E' FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt30', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt, t_tt_qd = @T_tt_qd , t_tt1 = @T_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = @T_tt_nt1, 
			ngay_tt = CASE WHEN @cMode = 'E' THEN @ngay_tt ELSE ngay_tt END, ma_gd = 0, line_nbr = 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateOtherFields('#ap','#detail', @detailTable, 'cttt30', '1=1', '1=1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct = @ngay_ct, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_ct0, so_ct = @so_ct0, so_ct0 = @so_ct0, Dien_giai = @cMemo
		IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct

		UPDATE #ap SET tat_toan = 0 WHERE tat_toan IS NULL
		UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd0 = 0 WHERE t_tt_qd0 IS NULL
		
		UPDATE #ap SET t_tien_nt0 = t_tien_nt, t_tien0 = t_tien, t_cp_nt = 0, t_cp = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, t_nk = 0
		
		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NULL
		UPDATE #ap SET so_ct0 = @so_ct, so_ct = @so_ct WHERE ISNULL(so_ct0, '') = ''

		-- Down Payment
		IF @Change = 1 UPDATE #ap SET ty_gia = ROUND(t_tt/t_tt_nt, @r) WHERE t_tt_nt <> 0

		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap
		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInvoiceNumber 'cttt30', @idNumber, 1
		-- End
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- Begin
		SELECT a.* INTO #inputvat_gr FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsertGroupE('#inputvat_gr', '#inputvat', 'ctgt30', '1=1', 'so_luong, t_tien_nt, t_tien, t_thue_nt, t_thue', 'so_ct0, ngay_ct0, so_seri0')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		ALTER TABLE #ap ALTER COLUMN ma_gd CHAR(2) NULL
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#inputvat_gr', 'ctgt30', 'cttt30', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ma_gd = b.ma_gd, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, tk = b.tk, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia, t_tien_nt0 = a.t_tien_nt, t_tien0 = a.t_tien, t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien = 0
				, dien_giai = b.dien_giai
			FROM #ap a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, so_ct = so_ct0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_cp = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, t_nk = 0, t_tt_nt = t_tien_nt0 + t_thue_nt, t_tt = t_tien0 + t_thue
			, t_tt_nt0 = t_tien_nt0 + t_thue_nt, t_tt0 = t_tien0 + t_thue, t_tt_qd = 0, t_tt_qd0 = 0, tat_toan = 0, ngay_tt = NULL
			, tt_nt = 0, tt = 0, t_tt_nt1 = 0, t_tt1 = 0

		UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

		IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct

		UPDATE #ap SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + stt_rec0

		-- Down Payment
		IF @Change = 1 UPDATE #ap SET ty_gia = ROUND(t_tt/t_tt_nt, @r) WHERE t_tt_nt <> 0

		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + '%')
		INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap

		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInvoiceNumber 'cttt30', @idNumber, 2
		-- End
	END
	
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmpb1]
AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2 
		FROM dbo.dmpb1 a INNER JOIN dbo.dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		ORDER BY a.stt_rec

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSFullyAllocatedInUseList] --fs20_FXListOutOfDistribution
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@FaType VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDepartment VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT so_the_ts, ky, nam INTO #xtmp
		FROM ctkhcc WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ky <= MONTH(@ReportDate) AND nam <= YEAR(@ReportDate)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts, ky, nam
		HAVING SUM(gt_cl) = 0

	SELECT so_the_ts, nam, ky INTO #tmp
		FROM #xtmp
		WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 16) IN (SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MIN(nam * 12 + ky), 16) FROM #xtmp GROUP BY so_the_ts)

	SELECT a.*, b.nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt, b.gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt, dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(a.ky, a.nam) AS ngay_kt_kh
		INTO #tmp2
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ky, nam, so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
						FROM ctkhcc GROUP BY ky, nam, so_the_ts
					) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.nam = b.nam

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ten_ts, a.so_hieu_ts, a.ten_ts2, a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, a.ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0, a.so_ky_kh, a.ngay_kh_kt, a.loai_ts, b.gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt, b.ngay_kt_kh, b.nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp2 b LEFT JOIN dmcc a ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '(a.ngay_giam > ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8),@ReportDate,112) + ''' or a.ngay_giam IS NULL)'
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDepartment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.status <> ''*'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ten_ts, a.so_hieu_ts, a.ten_ts2, a.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0, a.so_ky_kh, a.ngay_kh_kt, a.loai_ts '
	SET @q = @q + ', b.gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt, b.ngay_kt_kh, b.nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp2 b left join dmcc a with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString('loai_ts', @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'loai_ts', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup2 ('loai_ts', 'so_the_ts', 'ten_ts', 'ma_loai', 'ten_loai', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt', '#report', 'dmplcc', '0')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts as ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_ts, ten_ts2 as ten_ts2,' END + ' ma_bp, ma_nt, ty_gia, '
	SET @q = @q + 'ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh_kt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, ngay_kt_kh, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt from #report order by loai_ts, sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vv20dmctnk] AS
	SELECT  a.*, b.ten_nk AS ten_nk, b.ten_nk2 AS ten_nk2, c.ten_ct AS ten_ct, c.ten_ct2 AS ten_ct2, ISNULL(b.ma_dvcs, '') AS ma_dvcs
		FROM dbo.v20dmctnk a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.v20dmnk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
		WHERE b.status = '1'

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetIdGLJournal (@DrAccount VARCHAR(33), @CrAccount VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS VARCHAR(33)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @cReturn = MIN(ma_snk) FROM v20dmsnk
		WHERE xtype = '1' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@DrAccount, tk_no) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(@CrAccount, tk_co) = 1

	IF @cReturn IS NULL SET @cReturn = ''
	RETURN @cReturn
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSSCard]
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@TSType VARCHAR(33),
	@TSDepartment VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@TSGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),  
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	-- UnitKey
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'status <> ''*'' and ((year(ngay_mua) * 12) + month(ngay_mua)) <= ' + STR(@Year * 12 + @Month)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TSType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@TSType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @TSDepartment <> '' SELECT @Key =	@Key + ' and ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@TSDepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TSGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'select 0 AS tag, so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END + ' as ten_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp  from dmcc a with(nolock) where ' + @Key + ' order by so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_ShiftScheduleTruncate]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DepartmentRef VARCHAR(128),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGrade VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Prime VARCHAR(32), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join VARCHAR(4000)
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE YEAR(@DateFrom) >= YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(@DateFrom) <= YEAR(ngay_gh2)) OR @DateFrom > @DateTo RETURN

	SELECT @Key = 'exists (select 1 from hrnv c where a.stt_rec_nv = c.stt_rec and c.ngay_nghi is not null and c.ngay_nghi <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''') and b.bp_ref like ''' + REPLACE(@DepartmentRef, '''', '') + '%''', @Join = 'left join hrnv b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.stt_rec_nv = ''' + (SELECT RTRIM(REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '')) FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGrade <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGrade), '''', '''''') + ''''

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay1, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay2, IDENTITY (INT, 1,1) AS id INTO #t

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @f1 SMALLDATETIME, @f2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @d = DATEADD(month, ((YEAR(@DateFrom) - 1900) * 12) + MONTH(@DateFrom), -1)
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT @DateFrom, CASE WHEN @d > @DateTo THEN @DateTo ELSE @d END
	IF @d < @DateTo BEGIN
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @DateTo), -1)
		IF DATEDIFF(month, @d, @DateTo) = 2 INSERT INTO #t SELECT DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @d2), 0), @d2
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @DateTo), 0), @DateTo
	END
	SELECT @i = MAX(id) FROM #t
	WHILE @i >= 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @f1 = ngay1, @f2 = ngay2 FROM #t WHERE id = @i
		SELECT @Prime = 'hrca$' + RTRIM(YEAR(@f1)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@f1), 2), ' ', '0')
		IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE DAY(DATEADD(DD,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(mm, 0, ngay1) + 1, 0))) = (DATEDIFF(day, ngay1, ngay2) + 1) AND id = @i) BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @Prime + ' from ' + @Prime + ' a ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key
				EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'update ' + @Prime + ' set '
				WHILE @f1 <= @f2 BEGIN
					SELECT @q = @q + 'n' + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@f1), 2), ' ', 0) + ' = ''''' + CASE WHEN @f1 < @f2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END
					SELECT @f1 = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @f1)
				END
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @Prime + ' a ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @Prime + ' set status = 0 from ' + @Prime + ' a ' + @Join + ' where isnull(n01, '''') + isnull(n02, '''') + isnull(n03, '''') + isnull(n04, '''') + isnull(n05, '''')'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' + isnull(n06, '''') + isnull(n07, '''') + isnull(n08, '''') + isnull(n09, '''') + isnull(n10, '''') + isnull(n11, '''') + isnull(n12, '''') + isnull(n13, '''') + isnull(n14, '''')'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' + isnull(n15, '''') + isnull(n16, '''') + isnull(n17, '''') + isnull(n18, '''') + isnull(n19, '''') + isnull(n21, '''') + isnull(n22, '''') + isnull(n23, '''')'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' + isnull(n24, '''') + isnull(n25, '''') + isnull(n26, '''') + isnull(n27, '''') + isnull(n28, '''') + isnull(n29, '''') + isnull(n30, '''') + isnull(n31, '''') = '''' and ' + @Key
				EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @Prime + ' from ' + @Prime + ' a ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' and a.status = 0'
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @i = @i - 1
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintCRTran2] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END

	SET @strSQL = 'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.tk_co, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.ma_kh_i AS ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + @cE + ' AS ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', b.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh2' ELSE '' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh_i = b.ma_kh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END



GO
CREATE proc dbo.dt_whocheckedout
        @chObjectType  char(4),
        @vchObjectName varchar(255),
        @vchLoginName  varchar(255),
        @vchPassword   varchar(255)

as

set nocount on

declare @iReturn int
declare @iObjectId int
select @iObjectId =0

declare @VSSGUID varchar(100)
select @VSSGUID = 'SQLVersionControl.VCS_SQL'

    declare @iPropertyObjectId int

    select @iPropertyObjectId = (select objectid from dbo.dtproperties where property = 'VCSProjectID')

    declare @vchProjectName   varchar(255)
    declare @vchSourceSafeINI varchar(255)
    declare @vchServerName    varchar(255)
    declare @vchDatabaseName  varchar(255)
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSProject',       @vchProjectName   OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSourceSafeINI', @vchSourceSafeINI OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLServer',     @vchServerName    OUT
    exec dbo.dt_getpropertiesbyid_vcs @iPropertyObjectId, 'VCSSQLDatabase',   @vchDatabaseName  OUT

    if @chObjectType = 'PROC'
    begin
        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OACreate @VSSGUID, @iObjectId OUT

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        declare @vchReturnValue varchar(255)
        select @vchReturnValue = ''

        exec @iReturn = master.dbo.sp_OAMethod @iObjectId,
												'WhoCheckedOut',
												@vchReturnValue OUT,
												@sProjectName = @vchProjectName,
												@sSourceSafeINI = @vchSourceSafeINI,
												@sObjectName = @vchObjectName,
												@sServerName = @vchServerName,
												@sDatabaseName = @vchDatabaseName,
												@sLoginName = @vchLoginName,
												@sPassword = @vchPassword

        if @iReturn <> 0 GOTO E_OAError

        select @vchReturnValue

    end

CleanUp:
    return

E_OAError:
    exec dbo.dt_displayoaerror @iObjectId, @iReturn
    GOTO CleanUp





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptObjectDetailCashFlowStatementsByWeek]
	@weekFrom INT,
	@periodFrom INT,
	@yearFrom INT,
	@weekTo INT,
	@periodTo INT,
	@yearTo INT,
	@planType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mới nhất, 2 - Gốc, 3 - Tùy chọn
	@revision INT,
	@pivotBy CHAR(1), -- 1 - Đơn vị, 2 - Bộ phận, 3 - Vụ việc
	@deptCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@jobCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@subJobTotal CHAR(1), -- 1 - Including, 0 - No
	@unitCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @fieldBy VARCHAR(33), @FieldType VARCHAR(33), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @n INT, @t1 INT, @t2 INT
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Thu_chi CHAR(1), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ma_ct VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_du VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_gt VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_loai VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_phi VARCHAR(512), @Cong_no CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Gt_th NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_th_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @dt_tuan_2 VARCHAR(33), @dt_tuan_3 VARCHAR(33), @dt_tuan_4 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @dt_tuan_2 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_2'
	SELECT @dt_tuan_3 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_3'
	SELECT @dt_tuan_4 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_4'
	SELECT @yearFrom = @yearFrom + (@periodFrom/12), @periodFrom = @periodFrom%12, @yearTo = @yearTo + (@periodTo/12), @periodTo = @periodTo%12
	IF @weekFrom > 4 SELECT @weekFrom = 1, @yearFrom = CASE @periodFrom WHEN 12 THEN @yearFrom + 1 ELSE @yearFrom END, @periodFrom = CASE @periodFrom WHEN 12 THEN 1 ELSE @periodFrom + 1 END
	SELECT @weekTo = CASE WHEN @weekTo > 4 THEN 4 ELSE @weekTo END, @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@periodFrom, @yearFrom), @dateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@periodTo, @yearTo), @key = ''
	SELECT @dateFrom = CASE @weekFrom
			WHEN 2 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@dt_tuan_2, 2), ' ', '0')
			WHEN 3 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@dt_tuan_3, 2), ' ', '0')
			WHEN 4 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@dt_tuan_4, 2), ' ', '0')
			ELSE @dateFrom
		END
		, @dateTo = CASE @weekTo
			WHEN 1 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTo)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateTo), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
			WHEN 2 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTo)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateTo), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
			WHEN 3 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTo)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateTo), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
			ELSE @dateTo
		END
	SELECT @fieldBy = CASE @pivotBy WHEN '1' THEN 'ma_dvcs' WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_bp' WHEN '3' THEN 'ma_vv' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @FieldType = RTRIM(field) FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '02'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, tk, tk_du, ma_phi, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_ltc, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #r00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #BgBalanceAcc FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #EdBalanceAcc FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #BgBalanceJob FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #EdBalanceJob FROM cdvv
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, ma_ct, tien, tien_nt INTO #kh FROM khdttuan

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, ma_so, tien AS gt_th, tien_nt AS gt_th_nt, tien AS gt_kh, tien_nt AS gt_kh_nt, tien AS gt_cl, tien_nt AS gt_cl_nt, thu_chi AS thu_chi INTO #repNorm FROM bcdtthang a, khdttuan b
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #valueTmp FROM #repNorm

	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt INTO #report FROM bcdttuan WHERE form = @formCode
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #result FROM #report
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS data INTO #data
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS xcode, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS code, ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv0 FROM wrkcolumns
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv FROM wrkcolumns
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPivotBy INTO #xPivotBy

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk INTO #ds_tk
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du INTO #ds_tk_du
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_gt INTO #ds_tk_gt
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_loai INTO #ds_ma_loai
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_phi INTO #ds_ma_phi

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.' + @fieldBy + ' <> '''''
	IF @deptCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @deptCode = REPLACE(REPLACE(@deptCode, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		INSERT INTO #data SELECT id, data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@deptCode, ',')
		SELECT a.ma_bp INTO #xdmbp FROM dmbp a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_bp LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #xdmbp b where a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp)'
	END
	IF @jobCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @jobCode = REPLACE(REPLACE(@jobCode, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		INSERT INTO #data SELECT id, data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@jobCode, ',')
		IF @subJobTotal = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT a.ma_vv INTO #xdmvv FROM dmvv a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
			--
			INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
			INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
			--
			SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)) BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #dmvv(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv)
					SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END ELSE INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM dmvv a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #data b WHERE a.ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(b.data))
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #dmvv b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)'
	END
	--
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unitCode, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @unitKey
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Get Data Arising
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r00 select a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldType, '') <> '' THEN ', isnull(a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType) + ', '''')' ELSE ', ''''' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@FieldType, '') <> '' THEN ', a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType) ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Get Data Balance
	IF @pivotBy <> '2' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind <> '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '2') BEGIN
			IF @pivotBy = '1' INSERT INTO #BgBalanceAcc EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dateFrom, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
			IF @pivotBy = '3' INSERT INTO #BgBalanceJob EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Job @dateFrom, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '3') BEGIN
			IF @pivotBy = '1' INSERT INTO #EdBalanceAcc EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @dateTo, NULL, '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
			IF @pivotBy = '3' INSERT INTO #EdBalanceJob EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Job @dateTo, NULL, '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @key
		END
	END

	-- Get Data Plan
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #kh select a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.ma_ct, sum(a.tien%xWeek), sum(a.tien_nt%xWeek)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from khdttuan a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where nam = %xYear and ky = %xPeriod'
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE
		WHEN @planType = 1 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdttuan b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct group by b.' + @fieldBy + ' having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
		WHEN @planType = 2 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdttuan b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct group by b.' + @fieldBy + ' having min(b.lan) = a.lan)'
		ELSE ' and a.lan = (select max(b.lan) from khdttuan b where a.' + @fieldBy + ' = b.' + @fieldBy + ' and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and b.lan <= ' + RTRIM(@revision) + ')'
	END
	SELECT @s = @s + ' group by a.' + @fieldBy + ', a.ma_ct'

	SELECT @t1 = @weekFrom, @t2 = 4, @i = @periodFrom, @n = @yearFrom
	--
	WHILE (@n * 12 + @i) <= (@yearTo * 12 + @periodTo) BEGIN
		IF (@n * 12 + @i) <> (@yearFrom * 12 + @periodFrom) SELECT @t1 = 1
		IF (@n * 12 + @i) = (@yearTo * 12 + @periodTo) SELECT @t2 = @weekTo
		SELECT @q = ''
		WHILE (@t1 <= @t2) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xPeriod', @i), '%xYear', RTRIM(@n)), '%xWeek', REPLACE(STR(@t1,2), ' ', '0'))
			SELECT @t1 = @t1 + 1
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
		IF @i > 12 SELECT @i = 1, @n = @n + 1
	END
	--
	IF @pivotBy = '3' AND @subJobTotal = '1' AND @jobCode = '' BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy AS ma_vv INTO #xdmvv2 FROM #r00
		INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #kh a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #BgBalanceJob) INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #BgBalanceJob a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #EdBalanceJob) INSERT INTO #xdmvv2 SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #EdBalanceJob a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
		INSERT INTO #dmvv SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv2 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
		WHILE @i >= 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #dmvv(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv)
				SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(a.ma_vv), ISNULL(b.ma_vv_me, ''), a.bac_vv
					FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv_me AS ma_vv, b.bac_vv FROM #dmvv a LEFT JOIN #dmvv0 b ON a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv WHERE a.bac_vv = @i AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND a.ma_vv_me NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #dmvv)) a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
			SELECT @i = @i - 1
		END
	END

	-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu báo cáo
	TRUNCATE TABLE #repNorm
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, thu_chi, ds_chi_tieu FROM #report WHERE kind = '1'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #valueTmp
		-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu dòng tiền
		SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ',')
		WHILE @n > 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @n, ',')
			SELECT @Kind = kind, @Ds_tk = ds_tk, @Ds_tk_du = ds_tk_du, @Ds_tk_gt = ds_tk_gt, @Ds_ma_loai = ds_ma_loai, @Ds_ma_phi = ds_ma_phi, @Cong_no = cong_no FROM dmctdt WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct
			SELECT @Ds_tk = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_du = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk_du, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_gt = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tk_gt, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_loai = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_ma_loai, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_phi = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_ma_phi, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
			--
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_du
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_tk_gt
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_ma_loai
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ds_ma_phi

			INSERT INTO #ds_tk SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_tk_du SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_du, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_tk_gt SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_tk_gt, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_ma_loai SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_ma_loai, ',')
			INSERT INTO #ds_ma_phi SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Ds_ma_phi, ',')
			--
			IF @Ds_tk <> '' BEGIN
				IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #valueTmp
						SELECT xPivotBy, SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
							FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_du c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_du) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_loai e WHERE a.ma_ltc LIKE e.ma_loai) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi) GROUP BY xPivotBy
					IF @Ds_tk_gt <> ''
						INSERT INTO #valueTmp
							SELECT xPivotBy, SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END), SUM(CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END), 0, 0, 0, 0
								FROM #r00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_tk_gt c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_gt) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_loai e WHERE a.ma_ltc LIKE e.ma_loai) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds_ma_phi d WHERE a.ma_phi LIKE d.ma_phi) GROUP BY xPivotBy
				END
				--
				IF @pivotBy <> '2' AND @Kind <> '1' BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'insert into #valueTmp select ' + @fieldBy + ', case when ' + RTRIM(@Cong_no) + ' = 1 then sum(du_no - du_co) else sum(du_co - du_no) end, case when ' + RTRIM(@Cong_no) + ' = 1 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) end, 0, 0, 0, 0 from ' +
						CASE @Kind WHEN '2' THEN '#BgBalance' ELSE '#EdBalance' END + CASE @pivotBy WHEN '1' THEN 'Acc' ELSE 'Job' END + ' where dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Ds_tk) + ''') = 1 group by ' + @fieldBy
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END ELSE INSERT INTO #valueTmp SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #r00
			END
			--
			INSERT INTO #valueTmp SELECT xPivotBy, 0, 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0 FROM #kh WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct GROUP BY xPivotBy
			--
			SELECT @n = @n - 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT xPivotBy, @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), 0, 0, @Thu_chi FROM #valueTmp GROUP BY xPivotBy
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	--
	IF @pivotBy = '3' AND @subJobTotal = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv
		WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_th = a.gt_th + b.gt_th, gt_th_nt = a.gt_th_nt + b.gt_th_nt, gt_kh = a.gt_kh + b.gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = a.gt_kh_nt + b.gt_kh_nt
				FROM #repNorm a JOIN (SELECT b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_so, SUM(gt_th) AS gt_th, SUM(gt_th_nt) AS gt_th_nt, SUM(gt_kh) AS gt_kh, SUM(gt_kh_nt) AS gt_kh_nt FROM #repNorm a JOIN #dmvv b ON a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv
					WHERE b.ma_vv_me <> '' AND bac_vv = @i
					GROUP BY b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_so) b ON a.xPivotBy = b.ma_vv_me AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so
				SELECT @i = @i - 1
			END
	END
	--
	UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_th = - gt_th, gt_th_nt = - gt_th_nt, gt_kh = - gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = - gt_kh_nt WHERE thu_chi = 0

	SELECT xPivotBy INTO #del FROM #repNorm GROUP BY xPivotBy HAVING SUM(ABS(gt_th)) + SUM(ABS(gt_kh)) + SUM(ABS(gt_th_nt)) + SUM(ABS(gt_kh_nt)) = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #del) DELETE #repNorm FROM #repNorm a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #del b WHERE a.xPivotBy = b.xPivotBy)
	INSERT INTO #xPivotBy SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #repNorm
	--
	SELECT @fieldBy = MIN(xPivotBy) FROM #xPivotBy
	WHILE @fieldBy IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
				INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT @fieldBy, @Ma_so, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL
				--
				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_th = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_th_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th_nt), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_kh = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #repNorm set gt_kh_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh_nt), 0) from #repNorm where xPivotBy = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@fieldBy), '''', '') + ''' and ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where xPivotBy = ''' + RTRIM(@fieldBy) + ''' and ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
			END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		SELECT @fieldBy = MIN(xPivotBy) FROM #xPivotBy WHERE xPivotBy > @fieldBy
	END
	--
	UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_cl = gt_th - gt_kh, gt_cl_nt = gt_th_nt - gt_kh_nt

	-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT b.xPivotBy, a.stt, a.in_ck, CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, a.ma_so, a.ma_so_in, a.bold,
			ISNULL(c.gt_th, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_th_nt, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_kh, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_kh_nt, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_cl, 0), ISNULL(c.gt_cl_nt, 0)
		FROM #report a CROSS JOIN #xPivotBy b LEFT JOIN #repNorm c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so AND b.xPivotBy = c.xPivotBy

	-- Total
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result)
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT 'ZZZTOTAL', sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt) FROM #result GROUP BY sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT 'ZZZTOTAL', a.stt, a.in_ck, CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, a.ma_so, a.ma_so_in, a.bold, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #report a

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	--
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT xPivotBy FROM #result ORDER BY xPivotBy
	IF @reportForm = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT077'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT078'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT079'
	END
	IF @reportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT080'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT081'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT082'
	END
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN a.header <> 'ZZZTOTAL' THEN RTRIM(a.header) ELSE @Total END + ' - ' + RTRIM(b.header), b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY b.id, a.id

	-- View
	SELECT xPivotBy
			, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_so) AS xRow
			, xPivotBy AS xColumn
			, CASE WHEN xPivotBy = 'ZZZTOTAL' THEN @Total ELSE xPivotBy END AS xColumnName
			, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN stt_in <> '' THEN stt_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so
			, CASE WHEN ma_so_in <> '' THEN ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in, bold
			, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPivotBy, sysorder, ma_so
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

		FROM dbo.dtcpkhac a LEFT JOIN dbo.dtdmct b ON a.ma_so_ct = b.ma_so

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintITTran]
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@FormID VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong'
	IF @FormID IN ('030', '040', '050', '060') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_008' AND RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) = '1')
		SELECT @q = @q + ', gia_nt2 as gia, gia_nt2 as gia_nt, a.tien_nt2 as tien, a.tien_nt2 as tien_nt'
	ELSE
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	--Edit BI
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--Edit BI
	SET @q = @q + ', cast(' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as nvarchar(4000)) as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' INTO #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @q = @q + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#visibleFieldPrint') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Report$VisibleFieldSetting ''#report'',''rs_PrintITTran'''
	END

	--Edit BI start
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI end
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdmcltg1 AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT d .*, a.tk, a.Ten_bt, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2, a.status, a.tk_cltg, b.Ma_nt , c.Ten_tk AS Ten_tk_cltg, c.Ten_tk2 AS Ten_tk_cltg2
		FROM dbo.dmcltg1 d JOIN dmcltg a ON d .stt = a.stt INNER JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN (SELECT * FROM dmtk) c ON a.tk_cltg = c.tk
		WHERE b.Ma_nt <> '' AND b.Ma_nt NOT IN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_ma_nt0')
		ORDER BY d .stt, a.tk

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCardMultiPrint]
	@Period1 INT, 
	@Year1 INT, 
	@Period2 INT, 
	@Year2 INT, 
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1), @costD INT, @costMO INT, @objectUnit INT
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	SELECT @costD = val FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = val FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'

	IF @objectUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @costD = x_dt_bp, @costMO = x_dt_lsx FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND status = '1' AND (x_dt_bp <> 0 or x_dt_lsx <> 0 or x_dt_sp <> 0)
		SELECT @costD = ISNULL(@costD, 0), @costMO = ISNULL(@costMO, 0)
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_tp, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #tmp FROM xctgtsp a

	SELECT @Key = '((a.nam * 100 + a.ky) between (' + RTRIM((@Year1*100) + @Period1) + ') and (' + RTRIM((@Year2 * 100) + @Period2) + '))'
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(a.so_lsx) like ''' + REPLACE(LTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_sp,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costD = 1 THEN ' a.ma_bp,' ELSE ' '''',' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costMO = 1 THEN ' a.so_lsx,' ELSE ' '''',' END
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(isnull(a.sl_tp, 0)), 0, 0, sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctgtsp a with(nolock) where ' + @Key + ' group by a.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costD = 1 THEN ', a.ma_bp' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costMO = 1 THEN ', a.so_lsx' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costD = 1 THEN ', a.ma_bp' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @costMO = 1 THEN ', a.so_lsx' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	UPDATE #tmp SET gia = ROUND(tien / sl_tp, 2), gia_nt = ROUND(tien_nt / sl_tp, 4) WHERE sl_tp <> 0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag,
			a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, a.ma_bp + a.so_lsx + RTRIM(a.ma_sp) AS xKey
		FROM #tmp a JOIN vdmsp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt ORDER BY stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPBucketReports]
	@cItem AS VARCHAR(32),
	@cVersion CHAR(2),
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@nDateFormat INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @nPeriodCount INT, @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cP CHAR(2)

	SELECT @cP = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'
	SELECT @dNow = run_date FROM mplog
	-- Structs
	SELECT CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_vt), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS ma_vt, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ma_so, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS so_luong INTO #rs WHERE 1 = 0
	
	IF @cVersion <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT *, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cP, @dNow, ngay_ct) AS ky, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cP, @dNow, ngay_dat) AS ky2 INTO #mrhistory FROM mrhistory WHERE ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') AND version = @cVersion
		SELECT *, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cP, @dNow, ngay_ct) AS ky, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cP, @dNow, ngay_dat) AS ky2 INTO #mrctyc FROM mrctyc WHERE ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')	
	END	
	SELECT * INTO #mrctvtky FROM mrctvtky WHERE ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')

	SELECT @nPeriodCount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ky_hd'
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount BEGIN			
		INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '01',  SUM(ISNULL(tong_nc, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '02',  SUM(ISNULL(sl_kh, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '03',  SUM(ISNULL(ton_kho, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '04',  SUM(ISNULL(nc_rong, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt
				
		IF @cVersion = '' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '05',  SUM(ISNULL(sl_dat, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt
			INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, ma_vt, '06',  SUM(ISNULL(sl_kt, 0)) FROM #mrctvtky WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt					
		END ELSE BEGIN 
			INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, a.ma_vt, '05', SUM(sl_nhap) FROM (
				SELECT ma_vt, SUM(ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0)) AS sl_nhap FROM #mrctyc WHERE ky = @i AND nguon = 'FP' GROUP BY ma_vt
					UNION ALL (SELECT ma_vt, SUM(ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0)) FROM #mrhistory WHERE ky = @i GROUP BY ma_vt)) a GROUP BY a.ma_vt	
					
			INSERT INTO #rs SELECT @i, a.ma_vt, '06', SUM(sl_nhap) FROM (
				SELECT ma_vt, SUM(ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0)) AS sl_nhap FROM #mrctyc WHERE ky2 = @i AND nguon = 'FP' GROUP BY ma_vt
					UNION ALL (SELECT ma_vt, SUM(ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0)) FROM #mrhistory WHERE ky2 = @i GROUP BY ma_vt)) a GROUP BY a.ma_vt					
		END
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_vt INTO #rs08 FROM #rs
	INSERT INTO #rs08(ma_vt) SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #rs

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so INTO #code FROM #rs
		SELECT @i = 1
		WHILE @i < 7 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #code SELECT '0' + STR(@i, 1)
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	SELECT a.ma_vt, b.ma_so INTO #full FROM #rs08 a CROSS JOIN #code b
	INSERT INTO #rs SELECT 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_so, 0 FROM #full a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rs b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so)

	DECLARE @cMa_ky CHAR(2), @dRunDate SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @cMa_ky = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'
	SELECT @dRundate = ISNULL(run_date, GETDATE()) FROM mrlog

	SELECT a.*, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ky))) AS fkey, a.ma_vt + a.ma_so AS fsearch
			, CONVERT(NCHAR(10), dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cMa_ky, @dRundate, ky, 1), @nDateFormat) AS fkey_name
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, b.dvt
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
		INTO #report
		FROM #rs a
			LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN mrdmctkh c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so
		ORDER BY ky, a.ma_vt, a.ma_so

	UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = ' ', dvt = '' WHERE ma_so <> '01'
	UPDATE #report SET fkey_name = (SELECT CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN form_name ELSE form_name2 END FROM sysrpoptions WHERE form = 'V20MRPReports' AND form_type = '001' AND form_id = 'ky0') WHERE ky = 0
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(ky, 3), ' ', '0') AS ky, ma_vt, ma_vt + ma_so AS ma_so, so_luong, ten_vt, dvt, chi_tieu, fkey_name, CONVERT(INT, fkey) AS fkey FROM #report ORDER BY ma_so
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, fkey_name AS header INTO #report1 FROM #report GROUP BY ky, fkey_name ORDER BY ky
	SELECT id, 'so_luong$' + RTRIM(id) AS name, header AS header FROM #report1
END


GO
