CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRunItemForecast] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dM SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(32), @userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nQRound INT, @i INT, @stt INT
	DECLARE @nBackwardConsumptionDays INT, @nForwardConsumptionDays INT, @nSOPastDueDays INT, @d0 SMALLDATETIME, @d1 VARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Count INT, @m INT, @y INT, @p VARCHAR(6), @dtable VARCHAR(33), @mtable VARCHAR(33), @dBegin SMALLDATETIME



	DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3), @ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ky INT
	DECLARE @dbngay_ct1 SMALLDATETIME, @dbngay_ct2 SMALLDATETIME, @dbso_luong NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDementQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @dBack SMALLDATETIME, @dForward SMALLDATETIME, @nNonWorkingDays INT, @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'	
	SELECT @nSOPastDueDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_dh_hh'
	SELECT @dBegin = @dNow - @nSOPastDueDays, @d0 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, 0, 0)
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dBegin, 112)
	
	-- SO
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, so_luong AS sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_da_yc, stt_rec, stt_rec0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky INTO #d64 FROM d64$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #p64 FROM c64$000000
	INSERT INTO #p64(m, y) SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct) FROM c64$000000 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dBegin AND @dM			
	SELECT @i = 1, @Count = MAX(stt) FROM #p64


	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @m = m, @y = y FROM #p64 WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @p = RTRIM(@y) + REPLACE(STR(@m, 2), ' ', '0')
		SELECT @dtable = 'd64$' + @p, @mtable = 'm64$' + @p

		SET @q = 'insert into #d64 select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, case when a.ngay_giao is null then a.ngay_ct else a.ngay_giao end, a.so_ct, round((case when a.so_luong > a.sl_xuat then a.so_luong - a.sl_xuat else 0 end)*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.so_luong*a.he_so, @nQRound), round(a.sl_xuat*a.he_so, @nQRound), a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @dtable + ' a join ' + @mtable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.status in (''2'', ''4'') and a.ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d1 + ''''
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@nQRound', @nQRound)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	DELETE #d64 WHERE ngay_ct < @d0 OR ngay_ct > @dM
	UPDATE #d64 SET ky = dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct)
	

	-- Allocation
	SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong INTO #ctdb FROM mdbbh WHERE 1 = 0

	SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, ROUND(so_luong*he_so, @nQRound) AS so_luong, ma_vt + ma_kho + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_ct1, 112) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_ct2, 112) AS ma_pb, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct1) AS ky_hd
		INTO #mdbbh FROM mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dM


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mcthsdb WHERE ma_ky = @cDefaultPeriod) BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS ky, stt, he_so INTO #hs FROM mcthsdb WHERE ma_ky = @cDefaultPeriod ORDER BY stt

		SELECT a.ma_pb, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ngay_ct1, a.ngay_ct2, a.so_luong, b.ky, b.he_so, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct1) AS ky_hd
			INTO #hspb FROM #mdbbh a CROSS JOIN #hs b WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #dmvt)

		SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAllocatedTable('#mdbbh', 'ma_pb', 'so_luong', '#hspb', 'he_so', 'ky', '1=1', 3)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q		

		-- Start Period
		DECLARE @nStartPeriodCount INT, @dStartPeriod SMALLDATETIME
		SELECT @dStartPeriod = MIN(ngay_ct1) FROM #hspb WHERE ky_hd = 0
		IF @dStartPeriod IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @nStartPeriodCount = dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dStartPeriod, @dNow)
			IF @nStartPeriodCount > 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #hspb SET ky = ky - @nStartPeriodCount WHERE ky_hd = 0
				UPDATE #hspb SET ky = 0 WHERE ky < 0
			END
		END -- End Start Period

		UPDATE #hspb SET ngay_ct1 = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd + ky -1, 0), ngay_ct2 = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd + ky -1, 1)
		INSERT INTO #ctdb(ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong)
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, SUM(so_luong) FROM #hspb GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dNow
		UPDATE #mdbbh SET ngay_ct1 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd, 0), ngay_ct2 = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ky_hd, 1)
		INSERT INTO #ctdb(ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong)
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, SUM(so_luong) FROM #mdbbh GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2
	END	 

	DELETE #mdbbh WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dNow
	DELETE #ctdb WHERE ngay_ct1 < @dNow

	-- End Allocation

	-- Update Sales Forecast
	DELETE mctdbbh
	INSERT INTO mctdbbh
			(
				ngay_ct, ma_kho, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, so_dh
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT a.ngay_ct1, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, SUM(a.so_luong), b.dvt, 1, ''
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #ctdb a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			GROUP BY a.ngay_ct1, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, b.dvt




	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kieu_db' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(val)) = '0') -- Sales Forecast Only
		DELETE #d64 WHERE ngay_ct > @dNow
	ELSE 	-- Forecast Consumers Sales Orders
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nBackwardConsumptionDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_db_qh'
			SELECT @nForwardConsumptionDays = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ngay_db_dh'

			DECLARE crSalesOrder CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_ct, ky FROM #d64 WHERE ngay_ct > @dNow ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0
			OPEN crSalesOrder
			FETCH NEXT FROM crSalesOrder INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @so_luong, @ngay_ct, @ky
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nDementQty = @so_luong

					-- Backward & Forward Consumption Days
					SELECT @dTo = @ngay_ct, @dFrom = DATEADD(day, - @nBackwardConsumptionDays, @ngay_ct)
					WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
						BEGIN
							SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
							SELECT @dTo = @dFrom -1
							SELECT @dFrom = @dFrom - @nNonWorkingDays
						END
					SELECT @dBack = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @dFrom), 0)

					SELECT @dFrom = @ngay_ct, @dTo = DATEADD(day, @nForwardConsumptionDays, @ngay_ct)
					WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
						BEGIN
							SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
							SELECT @dFrom = @dTo + 1
							SELECT @dTo = @dTo + @nNonWorkingDays
						END
					SELECT @dForward = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @dTo), 1)

					-- Backward Consumption
					DECLARE crBackwardConsumption CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong FROM #ctdb WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND (ngay_ct1 BETWEEN @dBack AND @ngay_ct) AND so_luong > 0 ORDER BY ngay_ct1 DESC
					OPEN crBackwardConsumption
					FETCH NEXT FROM crBackwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							IF @nDementQty <= @dbso_luong
								BEGIN
									UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = @dbso_luong - @nDementQty WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
									SELECT @nDementQty = 0
									BREAK
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = 0 WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
									SELECT @nDementQty = @nDementQty - @dbso_luong
								END
							--
							FETCH NEXT FROM crBackwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
						END
					CLOSE crBackwardConsumption
					DEALLOCATE crBackwardConsumption

					-- Forward Consumption
					IF @nDementQty > 0
						BEGIN
							DECLARE crForwardConsumption CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2, so_luong FROM #ctdb WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 > @ngay_ct AND ngay_ct1 <= @dForward AND so_luong > 0 ORDER BY ngay_ct1
							OPEN crForwardConsumption
							FETCH NEXT FROM crForwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								BEGIN
									IF @nDementQty <= @dbso_luong
										BEGIN
											UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = @dbso_luong - @nDementQty WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
											SELECT @nDementQty = 0
											BREAK
										END
									ELSE
										BEGIN
											UPDATE #ctdb SET so_luong = 0 WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND ngay_ct1 = @dbngay_ct1 AND ngay_ct2 = @dbngay_ct2
											SELECT @nDementQty = @nDementQty - @dbso_luong
										END
									--
									FETCH NEXT FROM crForwardConsumption INTO @dbngay_ct1, @dbngay_ct2, @dbso_luong
								END
							CLOSE crForwardConsumption
							DEALLOCATE crForwardConsumption
						END

					UPDATE #d64 SET so_luong = @nDementQty WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crSalesOrder INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @so_luong, @ngay_ct, @ky
				END

			CLOSE crSalesOrder
			DEALLOCATE crSalesOrder
			DELETE #d64 WHERE so_luong = 0

		END

	SELECT ma_vt, ROUND(so_luong*he_so, @nQRound) AS so_luong, ngay_ct, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct) AS ky, so_dh
		INTO #mctdbbh FROM mctdbbh WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNow AND @dM) AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #dmvt)

	-- Update Detail
	INSERT INTO mrctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, so_dh, stt_rec
				, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'SF', '', '', ma_vt, ngay_ct, 0, so_luong, so_dh, ''
				, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mctdbbh

	INSERT INTO mrctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, so_dh, stt_rec
				, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'SO', '', '', ma_vt, ngay_ct, 0, so_luong, so_ct, ''
				, 0, 0, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, NULL, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d64
	--
	INSERT INTO mrctycloai
			(
				loai, ky, ma_vt, so_luong
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT '02', ky, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong)
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mctdbbh
			GROUP BY ky, ma_vt

	INSERT INTO mrctycloai
			(
				loai, ky, ma_vt, so_luong
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT '03', ky, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong)
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #d64
			GROUP BY ky, ma_vt

	-- Gross Requirement
	DELETE mrctvtky
	INSERT INTO mrctvtky
			(
				ky, ma_vt, tong_nc, sl_dh, sl_yc, sl_xn, sl_kh, kh_nhan, ton_kho, nc_rong, dat_hang, kt_dh
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT ky, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM mrctycloai
			GROUP BY ky, ma_vt
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$GS]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Unit NVARCHAR(32), @Year INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @Unit = ma_dvcs, @Year = YEAR(ngay_ct) FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	-- cdtk
	SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00 INTO #cdtk FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber GROUP BY tk
	UPDATE cdtk SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		, du_no1 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co1 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt1 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdtk a JOIN cdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdtk(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdtk a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdtk b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk)

	-- cdkh - tk_cn = 1
	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdkh FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_kh
	UPDATE cdkh SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		, du_no1 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co1 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt1 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdkh a JOIN cdkh b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdkh(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdkh a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdkh b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh)

	-- cdkh - tk_cn = 0
	SELECT a.tk, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdkh0 FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
		GROUP BY a.tk
	UPDATE cdkh SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		, du_no1 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co1 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt1 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdkh0 a JOIN cdkh b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_kh = ''
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdkh(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdkh0 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdkh b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_kh = '')

	-- cdku
	SELECT tk, ma_ku, SUM(ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00 INTO #cdku FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber GROUP BY tk, ma_ku
	UPDATE cdku SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdku a JOIN cdku b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdku(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_ku, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_ku, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdku a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdku b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku)

	-- cdhd - tk_cn = 1
	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdhd FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh
	UPDATE cdhd SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdhd a JOIN cdhd b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdhd(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdhd a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdhd b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh)

	-- cdhd - tk_cn = 0
	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_hd, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdhd0 FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_hd
	UPDATE cdhd SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdhd0 a JOIN cdhd b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.ma_kh = ''
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdhd(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdhd0 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdhd b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.ma_kh = '')

	-- cdvv - tk_cn = 1
	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdvv FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh
	UPDATE cdvv SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdvv a JOIN cdvv b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdvv(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdvv a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdvv b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh)

	-- cdvv - tk_cn = 0
	SELECT a.tk, a.ma_vv, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdvv0 FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_vv
	UPDATE cdvv SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdvv0 a JOIN cdvv b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv AND a.ma_kh = ''
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdvv(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cdvv0 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdvv b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv AND a.ma_kh = '')

	-- cdnvbh - tk_cn = 1
	SELECT a.tk, a.s3 AS ma_nvbh, a.ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdnvbh FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.s3, a.ma_kh
	UPDATE cdnvbh SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdnvbh a JOIN cdnvbh b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_nvbh = b.ma_nvbh AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdnvbh(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			 FROM #cdnvbh a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdnvbh b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_nvbh = b.ma_nvbh AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh)

	-- cdnvbh - tk_cn = 0
	SELECT a.tk, a.s3 AS ma_nvbh, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS ma_kh, SUM(a.ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(a.ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00
		INTO #cdnvbh0 FROM gldcsd a
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @IDNumber AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.s3
	UPDATE cdnvbh SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cdnvbh0 a JOIN cdnvbh b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_nvbh = b.ma_nvbh AND a.ma_kh = ''
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cdnvbh(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			 FROM #cdnvbh0 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdnvbh b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_nvbh = b.ma_nvbh AND a.ma_kh = '')

	-- cddtqt1
	SELECT tk, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt, SUM(ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00 INTO #cddtqt1 FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber GROUP BY tk, ma_td1
	UPDATE cddtqt1 SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cddtqt1 a JOIN cddtqt1 b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cddtqt1(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_dtqt, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cddtqt1 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cddtqt1 b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt)

	-- cddtqt2
	SELECT tk, ma_td2 AS ma_dtqt, SUM(ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00 INTO #cddtqt2 FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber GROUP BY tk, ma_td2
	UPDATE cddtqt2 SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cddtqt2 a JOIN cddtqt2 b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cddtqt2(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_dtqt, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cddtqt2 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cddtqt2 b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt)

	-- cddtqt3
	SELECT tk, ma_td3 AS ma_dtqt, SUM(ps_no) AS du_no00, SUM(ps_co) AS du_co00, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS du_co_nt00 INTO #cddtqt3 FROM gldcsd WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber GROUP BY tk, ma_td3
	UPDATE cddtqt3 SET du_no00 = b.du_no00 - a.du_no00, du_co00 = b.du_co00 - a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = b.du_no_nt00 - a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = b.du_co_nt00 - a.du_co_nt00
		FROM #cddtqt3 a JOIN cddtqt3 b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt
			WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit
	INSERT INTO cddtqt3(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year, @Unit, tk, ma_dtqt, -du_no00, -du_co00, -du_no_nt00, -du_co_nt00, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #cddtqt3 a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cddtqt3 b WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdcluong] AS
SELECT a.*, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, c.bp_ref, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2, d.ten_loai_lg, d.ten_loai_lg2
	FROM hrdcluong a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp JOIN hrloailuong d ON a.ma_loai_lg = d.ma_loai_lg

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostCRTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@step TINYINT,
	@isDel20 TINYINT = NULL,
	@charge TINYINT = 0,
	@postFrom TINYINT = 1 -- 1 - Voucher, 2 - Post Transaction
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @chargeTable VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @loai_ct CHAR(1), @dien_giai NVARCHAR(512),
		@ma_nt VARCHAR(3), @ty_gia NUMERIC(24, 12), @ty_gia_ht NUMERIC(24, 12), @ty_gia_u NUMERIC(24, 12), @m_Tk_cl_tg VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @tk_cl_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_cl_co VARCHAR(32),
		@round TINYINT, @round_Tg TINYINT, @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct0 SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct0 VARCHAR(32), @stt INT,
		@fchar VARCHAR(512), @fnumeric VARCHAR(512), @fdate VARCHAR(512), @charge_yn BIT, @editExRate BIT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #xmaster FROM m46$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 *, ma_kh_i AS ma_kh, tien AS tien0, tien_nt AS tien_nt0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xcl_tg, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xno_co_cl, tien AS tien_cl_tg, ty_gia_ht2 AS ty_gia INTO #xdetail FROM d46$000000

	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ar FROM cttt20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
/*
	CREATE TABLE #rcdb(line_nbr INT NULL, tt_cn NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, ty_gia_dg NUMERIC(24, 12) NULL, tien_cl_no NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, tien_cl_co NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL)
*/
	SELECT TOP 0 *, tk_co AS tk, tk_co AS tk_du, tk_co AS tk0, tien AS ps_no, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS o INTO #dGL0 FROM #xdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, line_nbr AS line_nbr0, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS ma_nt INTO #dGL FROM #dGL0

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @m_Tk_cl_tg = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cl_tg'
	SELECT TOP 1 @round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT TOP 1 @round_Tg = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	SELECT @fchar = ISNULL(@fchar, '') + CASE WHEN @fchar IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + value FROM sysudf WHERE status = '1' ORDER BY id
	SET @fnumeric = 'sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, s4, s5, s6'
	SET @fdate = 'ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, s7, s8, s9'
	SET @charge_yn = 0

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdetail select *, ma_kh_i, tien as tien0, tien_nt as tien_nt0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #xmaster select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @tk = tk, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @ma_ct = ma_ct, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @so_ct = so_ct, @ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct0, @so_ct0 = so_ct0, @ma_nt = ma_nt, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ty_gia = ty_gia, @ty_gia_ht = ty_gia_ht, @ty_gia_u = ty_gia, @dien_giai = dien_giai, @editExRate = sua_tg_yn FROM #xmaster
	SELECT TOP 1 @tk_cl_no = tk_pscl_no, @tk_cl_co = tk_pscl_co FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt
	UPDATE #xdetail SET ma_kh = CASE WHEN @loai_ct <> '3' THEN @ma_kh ELSE ma_kh_i END


	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#xmaster', '#xdetail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''


	IF @charge <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT * INTO #inputvat FROM wrkinputvat
		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, m.ma_dvcs, m.loai_ct, m.ma_ct, m.ngay_lct, m.ngay_ct, m.so_ct, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ma_cp, b.tk_cp, a.tk_du, m.ty_gia, a.ty_gia AS ty_gia_ht, m.ma_nt
				, a.tien_cp_nt, a.tien_cp, a.dien_giai
				, b.ma_thue, b.tk_thue, t.thue_suat, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.tien_cp_nt AS t_tien_nt, a.tien_cp AS t_tien
				, b.mau_bc, b.ma_tc, c.ma_kh, b.ma_kh2, e.ten_kh, c.dia_chi, c.ma_so_thue, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr
				, m.status, m.datetime0, m.datetime2, m.user_id0, m.user_id2
				, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi
				, z.*, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3
				, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6
				, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9
				, a.hd_ln, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xcl_tg, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xno_co_cl, tien_cp AS tien_cl_tg
			INTO #charge FROM f46$000000 a, dmcpnh b, dmnh c, m46$000000 m, dmthue t, dmkh e, sysudt z

		SET @masterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(@masterTable))
		SET @chargeTable = 'f46$' + SUBSTRING(@masterTable, CHARINDEX('$', @masterTable) + 1, 6)

		SET @q = 'insert into #charge '
		SET @q = @q + ' select distinct a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, m.ma_dvcs, m.loai_ct, m.ma_ct, m.ngay_lct, m.ngay_ct, m.so_ct, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ma_cp, b.tk_cp, a.tk_du, m.ty_gia, a.ty_gia, m.ma_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.tien_cp_nt, a.tien_cp, a.dien_giai'
		SET @q = @q + ', b.ma_thue, b.tk_thue, t.thue_suat, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.tien_cp_nt as t_tien_nt, a.tien_cp as t_tien'
		SET @q = @q + ', b.mau_bc, b.ma_tc, d.ma_kh, b.ma_kh2, isnull(e.ten_kh, ''''), d.dia_chi, d.ma_so_thue, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr'
		SET @q = @q + ', m.status, m.datetime0, m.datetime2, m.user_id0, m.user_id2'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi'
		SET @q = @q + REPLACE(', ' + @fchar, ', ', ', a.')
		SET @q = @q + REPLACE(', ' + @fnumeric, ', ', ', a.')
		SET @q = @q + REPLACE(', ' + @fdate, ', ', ', a.')
		SET @q = @q + ', case when isnull(a.tk_du, '''') = '''' then a.hd_ln else 0 end, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @chargeTable + ' a join #xmaster m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp join dmthue t on b.ma_thue = t.ma_thue'
		SET @q = @q + ' join dmtknh c on m.tk = c.tk and (c.ma_dvcs = '''' or m.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs) join dmnh d on c.ma_nh = d.ma_nh left join dmkh e on d.ma_kh = e.ma_kh'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge) AND @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT hd_ln, SUM(tien_cp_nt) AS tien_cp_nt, SUM(tien_cp) AS tien_cp, SUM(t_thue_nt) AS t_thue_nt, SUM(t_thue) AS t_thue INTO #tcharge FROM #charge WHERE ISNULL(tk_du, '') = '' GROUP BY hd_ln
			IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 SET @charge_yn = 1
			UPDATE #xdetail SET tien0 = a.tien0 - b.tien_cp - b.t_thue, tien_nt0 = a.tien_nt0 - b.tien_cp_nt - b.t_thue_nt FROM #xdetail a JOIN #tcharge b ON a.line_nbr = b.hd_ln
		END
	END


	/* cltg */
	IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND @loai_ct = '2' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdetail WHERE tien0 <> ROUND(tien_nt0 * @ty_gia, @round)) BEGIN
		UPDATE #xdetail SET tien0 = CASE WHEN tien0 > tien_nt0 * @ty_gia THEN ROUND(tien_nt0 * @ty_gia, @round) ELSE tien0 END
				, xcl_tg = 1, xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN tien0 > tien_nt0 * @ty_gia THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(tien_nt0 * @ty_gia, @round) - tien0)
			WHERE tien0 <> ROUND(tien_nt0 * @ty_gia, @round)
	END


	IF @isDel20 IS NULL DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber


	IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT a.*, a.ma_nt AS ma_nt_hd, a.ty_gia AS ty_gia_i, a.ty_gia AS ty_gia_hd, a.t_tt_nt AS tien_hd_nt, a.t_tt AS tien_hd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_hd, 0 AS xcl_tg, 0 AS xno_co_cl, 0*a.t_tt_nt AS tien_cl_tg, b.tien0 AS tien, b.tien_nt0 AS tien_nt, b.tien AS tien_tt, b.tt_qd AS tt_qd0, b.tk_co, b.line_nbr AS stt
			INTO #cttt20 FROM cttt20 a JOIN #xdetail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE b.stt_rec_tt <> ''
		UPDATE #cttt20 SET ma_nt_hd = @baseCurrency WHERE ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''


		IF @m_Tk_cl_tg <> '' BEGIN
			UPDATE #cttt20 SET ty_gia_i = dbo.ff_GetExRateWithReverse(ty_gia_i, ngay_hd, @ngay_ct, ma_nt_hd, 1, stt_rec)
			UPDATE #cttt20 SET ty_gia_hd = CASE WHEN tien_hd_nt <> 0 THEN ROUND(tien_hd / tien_hd_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE 0 END WHERE ma_nt_hd <> @baseCurrency AND ty_gia_i = 0
			UPDATE #cttt20 SET ty_gia_hd = CASE WHEN ty_gia_i = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ty_gia_i END WHERE NOT (ma_nt_hd <> @baseCurrency AND ty_gia_i = 0)

			UPDATE #cttt20 SET xcl_tg = 1, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(a.ty_gia_hd * a.tien_nt, @round) - a.tien), xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN a.tien < ROUND(a.ty_gia_hd * a.tien_nt, @round) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				FROM #cttt20 a WHERE a.ma_nt_hd = @ma_nt AND a.ma_nt_hd <> @baseCurrency
			UPDATE #cttt20 SET xcl_tg = 1, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(a.ty_gia_hd * a.tt_qd0, @round) - a.tien), xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN a.tien < ROUND(a.ty_gia_hd * a.tt_qd0, @round) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				FROM #cttt20 a WHERE a.ma_nt_hd <> @ma_nt
/*
SELECT a.stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_qd, 0) + b.tt_qd0) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt, 0) + b.tien) AS t_tt, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_cn, 0) + b.tien) AS t_tt_cn, SUM(b.tien_hd_nt) AS tien_hd_nt, SUM(b.tien_hd) AS tien_hd INTO #pay
	FROM cttt20 a JOIN #cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec <> @idNumber GROUP BY a.stt_rec_tt
*/
			SELECT a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0)) + MAX(a.tt_qd0) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_cn, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt_cn, MAX(a.tien_hd_nt) AS tien_hd_nt, MAX(a.tien_hd) AS tien_hd INTO #pay
				FROM #cttt20 a LEFT JOIN cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE (b.stt_rec IS NULL OR b.stt_rec <> @idNumber) GROUP BY a.stt_rec

			IF @charge_yn = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pay WHERE t_tt_qd = tien_hd_nt) BEGIN
				SELECT a.stt_rec_hd, SUM(ISNULL(a.tien_cl_co, 0) - ISNULL(a.tien_cl_no, 0)) AS t_tt_cl INTO #cttt21 FROM cttt21 a JOIN #pay b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE b.t_tt_qd = b.tien_hd_nt GROUP BY a.stt_rec_hd -- HAVING SUM(ISNULL(a.tien_cl_co, 0) - ISNULL(a.tien_cl_no, 0)) > 0

				UPDATE #cttt20 SET tien_cl_tg = ABS(c.t_tt_cn - a.tien_hd - ISNULL(b.t_tt_cl, 0)), xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN c.t_tt_cn > a.tien_hd + ISNULL(b.t_tt_cl, 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, tien_hd = a.tien_hd + ISNULL(b.t_tt_cl, 0)
					FROM #cttt20 a LEFT JOIN #cttt21 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd JOIN #pay c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec_tt AND c.t_tt_qd = c.tien_hd_nt
					WHERE c.t_tt_qd = c.tien_hd_nt
			END

			UPDATE #cttt20 SET xcl_tg = 0 WHERE tien_cl_tg = 0
/*
			INSERT INTO #rcdb (line_nbr, tt_cn, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co) SELECT stt, tien_tt + tien_cl_tg, ty_gia_hd, tien_cl_tg, 0 FROM #cttt20 WHERE xcl_tg  = 1 AND xno_co_cl = 1
			INSERT INTO #rcdb (line_nbr, tt_cn, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co) SELECT stt, tien_tt - tien_cl_tg, ty_gia_hd, 0, tien_cl_tg FROM #cttt20 WHERE NOT (xcl_tg  = 1 AND xno_co_cl = 1)
*/
		END

		UPDATE #xdetail SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia_hd, xcl_tg = b.xcl_tg, xno_co_cl = b.xno_co_cl, tien_cl_tg = b.tien_cl_tg FROM #xdetail a JOIN #cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr = b.stt WHERE b.ma_nt <> @baseCurrency
		UPDATE #xdetail SET tien0 = tien0 - tien_cl_tg WHERE xcl_tg = 1 AND xno_co_cl = 0
	END



	--- Tax
	IF @charge <> 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge) BEGIN
			EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#xmaster', '#charge', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '20'

			--phi ngan hang
			IF @loai_ct = '1' UPDATE #charge SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, tk_du = b.tk_co FROM #charge a JOIN #xdetail b ON a.hd_ln = b.line_nbr WHERE ISNULL(a.tk_du, '') = ''

			SELECT @c = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Columns('r30$000000', '#charge', NULL, NULL)
			SELECT @c = REPLACE(@c, 'a.', '')
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #inputvat (' + @c + ') select ' + @c + ' from #charge where so_ct0 <> '''' and ngay_ct0 is not null'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q


			UPDATE #inputvat SET tk_thue_no = b.tk_thue, ten_vt = b.dien_giai, nam = 0, ky = 0, so_luong = 0, gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, ma_tt = '', ma_mau_ct = '', so_dh = '', ma_kho = ''
				FROM #inputvat a JOIN #charge b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

			DELETE ctgt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			INSERT INTO ctgt30 SELECT * FROM #inputvat

			SELECT @q = 'delete r30$' + SUBSTRING(@masterTable, CHARINDEX('$', @masterTable) + 1, 6) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ' insert into r30$' + SUBSTRING(@masterTable, CHARINDEX('$', @masterTable) + 1, 6) + ' select * from #inputvat'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END


	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		/* 1. detail */
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#xdetail', NULL, 'tien0 <> 0 or tien_nt0 > 0', NULL, 'line_nbr')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_co, tk0 = @tk, ps_no = tien0, ps_no_nt = tien_nt0, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = @ty_gia_u, c = 1, o = 1

		IF @loai_ct = '2' UPDATE #dGL0 SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) < @ty_gia THEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE @ty_gia END WHERE ps_no_nt <> 0

		/* 1.1 cltg */
		IF (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND @m_Tk_cl_tg <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdetail WHERE xcl_tg = 1 AND tien_cl_tg > 0) BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#xdetail', NULL, 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 1 and tien_cl_tg > 0', NULL, 'line_nbr')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk_cl_no, tk_du = tk_co, tk0 = @tk_cl_no, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#xdetail', NULL, 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 0 and tien_cl_tg > 0', NULL, 'line_nbr')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @tk_cl_co, tk0 = @tk, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
		END

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#dGL0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'line_nbr, o', NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL SET nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr0 = line_nbr, line_nbr = stt

		/* Cross Currency */
		IF @loai_ct = '1' AND @ma_nt = @baseCurrency BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET ps_no_nt = a.tt_qd, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia FROM #dGL a JOIN #cttt20 b ON b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_tt WHERE a.o = 1 AND b.ma_nt <> '' AND b.ma_nt <> @baseCurrency
		END
		/* Cross Currency */

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
		/* Cross Currency */
		--IF @loai_ct = '1' AND @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency UPDATE #dGL SET Ps_co_nt = b.tt_qd0 FROM #dGL a JOIN #cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr - 1 = b.stt WHERE b.ma_nt_hd <> @baseCurrency AND b.ma_nt_hd <> @ma_nt AND a.Ps_co_nt <> 0
		IF @loai_ct = '1' AND @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET Ps_co_nt = b.tt_qd0, ma_nt = b.ma_nt_hd FROM #dGL a JOIN #cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr0 = b.stt
				WHERE b.ma_nt_hd <> @baseCurrency AND b.ma_nt_hd <> @ma_nt AND a.Ps_co_nt <> 0
		END


		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @loai_ct = '1' AND @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency BEGIN
			UPDATE #gl SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt <> 0 THEN ROUND((ps_no + ps_co) / (ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt), @round_Tg) ELSE 0 END
		END

		UPDATE #gl SET so_ct0 = @so_ct0, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_ct0--, ty_gia = CASE WHEN ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt <> 0 THEN ROUND((ps_no + ps_co) / (ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt), @round_Tg) ELSE 0 END
		-- Charge
		IF @charge <> 0 BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge) BEGIN
				SELECT @stt = MAX(line_nbr) - 1 FROM #gl
				SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS tk0, t_tien AS ps_no, t_tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, t_tien AS ps_co, t_tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS o INTO #fGL0 FROM #charge
				SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, * INTO #fGL FROM #fGL0

				/* cltg */
				IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge WHERE ty_gia <> @ty_gia AND ty_gia_ht = 0) BEGIN
					UPDATE #charge SET t_tien = CASE WHEN t_tien > t_tien_nt * ty_gia THEN ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia, @round) ELSE t_tien END
							, xcl_tg = 1, xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN t_tien > t_tien_nt * ty_gia THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia, @round) - t_tien)
						WHERE ty_gia <> @ty_gia AND t_tien <> ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia, @round) AND ty_gia_ht = 0
				END

				IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge WHERE t_tien <> ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) AND ty_gia_ht <> 0) BEGIN
					UPDATE #charge SET t_tien = CASE WHEN t_tien > ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) THEN ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) ELSE t_tien END
							, xcl_tg = 1, xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN t_tien > t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) - t_tien)
						WHERE t_tien <> ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) AND ty_gia_ht <> 0
				END


				UPDATE #charge SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN t_tien_nt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(t_tien / t_tien_nt, @round_Tg) END
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#fGL0', '#charge', '(t_tien <> 0 or t_tien_nt <> 0)', 't_tien, t_tien_nt', 'tk_cp, tk_du, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q


				UPDATE #fGL0 SET tk = tk_cp, tk0 = tk_cp, ps_no = t_tien, ps_no_nt = t_tien_nt, ty_gia = CASE WHEN t_tien_nt <> 0 THEN ROUND(t_tien / t_tien_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE 0 END, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, c = 1, o = 1
				IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge WHERE t_tien <> ROUND(t_tien_nt * ty_gia, @round)) BEGIN
					UPDATE #fGL0 SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) < ty_gia THEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE ty_gia END WHERE ps_no_nt <> 0
				END

				/* 1.1 cltg */
				IF (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND @m_Tk_cl_tg <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge WHERE xcl_tg = 1 AND tien_cl_tg > 0) BEGIN
					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#fGL0', '#charge', 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 1 and tien_cl_tg > 0', 'tien_cl_tg', 'tk_cp, tk_du, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					UPDATE #fGL0 SET tk = tk_cp, tk_du = @tk_cl_co, tk0 = tk_cp, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0

					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#fGL0', '#charge', 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 0 and tien_cl_tg > 0', 'tien_cl_tg', 'tk_cp, tk_du, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					UPDATE #fGL0 SET tk = @tk_cl_no, tk0 = @tk_cl_no, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				END

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#fGL', '#fGL0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'line_nbr, o', null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #fGL SET nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + ISNULL(@stt, -1) + 2) / 2), line_nbr = stt + ISNULL(@stt, -1) + 1

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#fGL', '#gl', '#fGL', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #fGL SET line_nbr = line_nbr + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
				UPDATE #fGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh FROM #fGL a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#fGL', '#gl', '#fGL', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q


				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #inputvat WHERE t_thue <> 0 OR t_thue_nt <> 0) BEGIN
					SELECT @stt = MAX(line_nbr) - 1 FROM #gl
					SELECT a.*, b.hd_ln, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xcl_tg, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xno_co_cl, 0 * a.t_thue AS tien_cl_tg, b.dien_giai, b.ty_gia_ht INTO #xvat FROM #inputvat a JOIN #charge b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr
					SELECT TOP 0 *, tk_thue_no AS tk, tk_thue_no AS tk0, ma_kh AS ma_kh0, t_thue AS ps_no, t_thue_nt AS ps_no_nt, t_thue AS ps_co, t_thue_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tax, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS o INTO #tGL0 FROM #xvat
					SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, * INTO #tGL FROM #tGL0

					/* cltg */
					IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xvat WHERE ty_gia <> @ty_gia AND ty_gia_ht = 0) BEGIN
						UPDATE #xvat SET t_thue = CASE WHEN t_thue > ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia, @round) THEN ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia, @round) ELSE t_thue END
							, xcl_tg = 1, xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN t_thue > t_thue_nt * ty_gia THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia, @round) - t_thue)
							WHERE t_thue <> ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia, @round) AND ty_gia_ht = 0
					END

					IF @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xvat WHERE t_thue <> ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) AND ty_gia_ht <> 0) BEGIN
						UPDATE #xvat SET t_thue = CASE WHEN t_thue > ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) THEN ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) ELSE t_thue END
							, xcl_tg = 1, xno_co_cl = CASE WHEN t_thue > t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_tg = ABS(ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) - t_thue)
							WHERE t_thue <> ROUND(t_thue_nt * ty_gia_ht, @round) AND ty_gia_ht <> 0
					END

					UPDATE #xvat SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN t_thue_nt <> 0 THEN ROUND(t_thue / t_thue_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE 0 END

					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL0', '#xvat', 't_thue <> 0 or t_thue_nt <> 0', 't_thue, t_thue_nt', 'tk_thue_no, tk_du, ma_kh2, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					UPDATE #tGL0 SET tk = tk_thue_no, tk0 = tk_thue_no, ma_kh0 = ma_kh, ps_no = t_thue, ps_no_nt = t_thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, c = 1, tax = 1, o = 1
					UPDATE #tGL0 SET ma_kh = ma_kh2 FROM #tGL0 a WHERE a.tax = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1) AND a.ma_kh2 <> ''
					UPDATE #tGL0 SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) < ty_gia THEN ROUND(ps_no / ps_no_nt, @round_Tg) ELSE ty_gia END WHERE ps_no_nt <> 0

					/* cltg */
					IF (@loai_ct = '1' OR @loai_ct = '2') AND @m_Tk_cl_tg <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xvat WHERE xcl_tg = 1 AND tien_cl_tg > 0) BEGIN
						SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL0', '#xvat', 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 1 and tien_cl_tg > 0', 'tien_cl_tg', 'tk_thue_no, tk_du, ma_kh2, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
						EXEC sp_executesql @q

						UPDATE #tGL0 SET tk = tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_cl_co, tk0 = tk_thue_no, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0

						SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL0', '#xvat', 'xcl_tg = 1 and xno_co_cl = 0 and tien_cl_tg > 0', 'tien_cl_tg', 'tk_thue_no, tk_du, ma_kh2, hd_ln' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
						EXEC sp_executesql @q

						UPDATE #tGL0 SET tk = @tk_cl_no, tk0 = @tk_cl_no, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_no = tien_cl_tg, Ps_co = 0, ty_gia = 0, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
					END

					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL', '#tGL0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'line_nbr, o', null)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					UPDATE #tGL SET nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + @stt + 2) / 2), line_nbr = stt + @stt + 1

					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', null, null)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					UPDATE #tGL SET line_nbr = line_nbr + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
					UPDATE #tGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh FROM #tGL a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)

					SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', null, null)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
		END


		IF @loai_ct = '9' AND @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency AND @editExRate = 0 BEGIN
			DECLARE @m_tk_cn_pth VARCHAR(128)
			SELECT TOP 1 @m_tk_cn_pth = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_pth'
			SELECT data + '%' AS v INTO #tk_cn_pth FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@m_tk_cn_pth, ',')
			UPDATE #gl SET sua_tg_yn = 1 FROM #gl a JOIN #tk_cn_pth b ON a.tk LIKE b.v JOIN (SELECT tk_co AS tk FROM #xdetail) c ON a.tk = c.tk
		END

		-- Post to ct00
		--EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#xmaster', '#xdetail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', 'ty_gia, ngay_ct0, so_ct0', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai', 'ps_no_nt = ps_no and ps_co_nt = ps_co'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#xmaster', '#xdetail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', 'ty_gia, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ma_nt, sua_tg_yn', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai, ma_nt = isnull(a.ma_nt, b.ma_nt), sua_tg_yn = isnull(a.sua_tg_yn, 0)', 'ps_no_nt = ps_no and ps_co_nt = ps_co'


		UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp, ma_phi = b.ma_phi FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE a.tk IN (SELECT tk_pscl_no FROM dmnt) OR a.tk IN (SELECT tk_pscl_co FROM dmnt)

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END


	-- TT
	-- Begin


	-- TT
	-- Begin
/*
	IF @loai_ct = '1' AND @charge <> 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #inputvat WHERE t_thue <> 0 OR t_thue_nt <> 0) BEGIN
			UPDATE #rcdb SET tt_cn = a.tt_cn + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) + ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0), tien_cl_no = a.tien_cl_no + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) + ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0)
				FROM #rcdb a JOIN #charge b ON a.line_nbr = b.hd_ln JOIN #xvat c ON a.line_nbr = c.hd_ln JOIN #cttt20 d ON a.line_nbr = d.stt WHERE d.xcl_tg  = 1 AND d.xno_co_cl = 1

			UPDATE #rcdb SET tt_cn = a.tt_cn - ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) - ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0), tien_cl_co = a.tien_cl_co + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) + ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0)
				FROM #rcdb a JOIN #charge b ON a.line_nbr = b.hd_ln JOIN #xvat c ON a.line_nbr = c.hd_ln JOIN #cttt20 d ON a.line_nbr = d.stt WHERE NOT (d.xcl_tg  = 1 AND d.xno_co_cl = 1)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #charge) BEGIN
				UPDATE #rcdb SET tt_cn = a.tt_cn + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0), tien_cl_no = a.tien_cl_no + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0)
				FROM #rcdb a JOIN #charge b ON a.line_nbr = b.hd_ln JOIN #cttt20 d ON a.line_nbr = d.stt WHERE d.xcl_tg  = 1 AND d.xno_co_cl = 1

			UPDATE #rcdb SET tt_cn = a.tt_cn - ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0), tien_cl_co = a.tien_cl_co + ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0)
				FROM #rcdb a JOIN #charge b ON a.line_nbr = b.hd_ln JOIN #cttt20 d ON a.line_nbr = d.stt WHERE NOT (d.xcl_tg  = 1 AND d.xno_co_cl = 1)
			END
		END
	END
*/

	IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ar', '#xdetail', @detailTable, 'cttt20', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		DELETE #ar FROM #ar a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_tt)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#ar', '#xmaster', '#xdetail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', 'ty_gia = b.ty_gia, ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
/*
		UPDATE #ar SET tk = b.tk_co, tt_nt = CASE WHEN @ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE b.tien_nt END, tt = b.tien,
				tt_cn = ISNULL(c.tt_cn, 0), ty_gia_dg = ISNULL(c.ty_gia_dg, 0), tien_cl_no = ISNULL(c.tien_cl_no, 0), tien_cl_co = ISNULL(c.tien_cl_co, 0), tt_qd = b.tt_qd, loai_tt = 1
			FROM #ar a LEFT JOIN #xdetail b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr JOIN #rcdb c ON a.line_nbr = c.line_nbr
*/
		UPDATE #ar SET tk = b.tk_co, tt_nt = CASE WHEN @ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE b.tien_nt END, tt = b.tien,
				tt_cn = b.tien + CASE WHEN b.xcl_tg = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.xno_co_cl = 1 THEN ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) ELSE ISNULL(-b.tien_cl_tg, 0) END ELSE 0 END, ty_gia_dg = ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0),
				tien_cl_no = CASE WHEN b.xcl_tg = 1 AND b.xno_co_cl = 1 THEN ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_co = CASE WHEN b.xcl_tg = 1 AND b.xno_co_cl = 1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(b.tien_cl_tg, 0) END,
				tt_qd = b.tt_qd, loai_tt = 1
			FROM #ar a LEFT JOIN #xdetail b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr JOIN #cttt20 c ON a.stt_rec_tt = c.stt_rec

		UPDATE #ar SET t_tien_nt2 = ISNULL(t_tien_nt2, 0), t_tien2 = ISNULL(t_tien2, 0), t_thue_nt = ISNULL(t_thue_nt, 0), t_thue = ISNULL(t_thue, 0), t_ck_nt = ISNULL(t_ck_nt, 0), t_ck = ISNULL(t_ck, 0),
				t_tt_nt0 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt0, 0), t_tt0 = ISNULL(t_tt0, 0), t_tt_nt1 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt1, 0), t_tt1 = ISNULL(t_tt1, 0), t_tt_qd = ISNULL(t_tt_qd, 0), tat_toan = ISNULL(tat_toan, 0),
				ma_tt = ISNULL(ma_tt, ''), ma_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN '' ELSE ma_nt END, ty_gia = CASE WHEN ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE ty_gia END,
				so_seri = '', ma_nvbh = ''

		INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar
	END
	-- End


	-- Post from Voucher
	IF @postFrom = 1 BEGIN
		-- Begin Post to cttt30
		SELECT a.* INTO #ap FROM cttt30 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + '%')

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xmaster WHERE hd_yn = 1) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdetail a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_co = b.tk WHERE b.loai_tk = 1 AND b.tk_cn = 1) BEGIN
			SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#xdetail', @detailTable, 'cttt30', 'tk_co in (select tk from dmtk where loai_tk = 1 and tk_cn = 1)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#ap', '#xmaster', '#xdetail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', 'ty_gia = b.ty_gia'

			SELECT a.stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_qd, 0)) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt, 0)) AS t_tt1, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_nt, 0)) AS t_tt_nt1 INTO #t30
				FROM cttt30 a WHERE a.loai_tt = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ap b WHERE a.stt_rec_tt = LEFT(b.stt_rec, 10) + b.stt_rec0) GROUP BY a.stt_rec_tt

			UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, ma_gd = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + b.stt_rec0, so_ct = so_ct0, ma_kh = CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ma_kh_i, '') = '' THEN @ma_kh ELSE b.ma_kh_i END,
					tk = b.tk_co, t_tien_nt = b.tien_nt, t_tien = b.tien, t_tien_nt0 = b.tien_nt, t_tien0 = b.tien, t_cp_nt = 0, t_cp = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, t_nk = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_thue = 0,
					t_tt_nt = b.tien_nt, t_tt = b.tien, t_tt_nt0 = b.tien_nt, t_tt0 = b.tien, stt_rec_tt = NULL
				FROM #ap a JOIN #xdetail b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr

			UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = b.t_tt_qd , t_tt1 = b.t_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = b.t_tt_nt1
				FROM #ap a JOIN #t30 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt

			UPDATE #ap SET ngay_tt = b.ngay_tt FROM #ap a JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			UPDATE #ap SET tat_toan = 0 WHERE tat_toan IS NULL
			UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd0 = 0 WHERE t_tt_qd0 IS NULL
			UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
			UPDATE #ap SET so_ct0 = @so_ct, so_ct = @so_ct WHERE ISNULL(so_ct0, '') = ''

			INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInvoiceNumber 'cttt30', @idNumber, 2
		END
	END
	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@t1 VARCHAR(128), @t2 VARCHAR(128), @t3 VARCHAR(128), @k VARCHAR(1024), @f VARCHAR(256), @g VARCHAR(128))
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000)
	IF @g IS NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE @c VARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @c = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Fields(@t3, @k, NULL, NULL)
		SELECT @s = 'insert into ' + @t1 + '(' + @c + ') select ' + @c + ' from ' + @t2 + CASE WHEN @f IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @f END
	END
	ELSE
		SELECT @s = 'insert into ' + @t1 + ' select ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Fields(@t3, @t3, @f, @g) + ' from ' + @t2 + CASE WHEN @k IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @k END + ' group by ' + @g + ' order by ' + @g

	RETURN @s
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFASCardExport]
	@nMonth INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@So_the_ts VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @So_the_ts <> '' THEN 'a.so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@So_the_ts, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts INTO #ts from dmts
	SET @q = 'insert into #ts select distinct so_the_ts from dmts a with(nolock) where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- master
	DECLARE @h_line1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @h_line2 AS NVARCHAR(128), @h_line3 AS NVARCHAR(128), @h_line4 AS NVARCHAR(128), @isSysDep BIT
	SELECT @h_line1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DEC045'
	SELECT @h_line2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DEC046'
	SELECT @h_line3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DEC047'
	SELECT @h_line4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DEC048'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = 'fa_ma_bp' AND xtableref = 'dmbp') SET @isSysDep = 1 ELSE SET @isSysDep = 0

	SET @q = 'select a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_kh0, a.so_ky_kh, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, a.nh_ts1, a.nh_ts2, a.nh_ts3, a.nuoc_sx, a.nam_sx, 
			a.ts_kt, a.so_hieu_ts, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_giam, a.ngay_mua, a.ngay_dc, a.so_ct, a.so_ct_giam, a.ly_do_dc, a.ly_do_giam, a.ma_nt, 
			a.ten_ts, a.ten_ts2, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2, 
			@h_line1 AS h_line1, @h_line2 AS h_line2, @h_line3 AS h_line3, @h_line4 AS h_line4
		from dmts a with(nolock) left join ' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN 'dmbpts' ELSE 'dmbp' END + ' b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp join #ts c on a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@h_line1 as nvarchar(128), @h_line2 as nvarchar(128), @h_line3 as nvarchar(128), @h_line4 as nvarchar(128)', @h_line1, @h_line2, @h_line3, @h_line4
 
	-- detail 1
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS ikey, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai
		INTO #detail11
		FROM (
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, SUM(a.nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, MAX(a.dien_giai) AS dien_giai
				FROM ctdmts a WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN #ts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
					GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct
			UNION 
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN a.nguyen_gia ELSE -1 * a.nguyen_gia END AS nguyen_gia
			, CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN a.nguyen_gia_nt ELSE -1 * a.nguyen_gia_nt END AS nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai
				FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK)
				LEFT JOIN dmtgts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
				JOIN #ts c ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts
					WHERE YEAR(a.ngay_ct) * 12 + MONTH(a.ngay_ct) <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
			) a
		ORDER BY a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct
 
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS ikey, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, ISNULL(a.nam, b.nam) AS nam, ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nam, 0) AS gt_kh_nam, ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nam_nt, 0) AS gt_kh_nam_nt, ISNULL(b.gt_kh_lk, 0) AS gt_kh_lk,  ISNULL(b.gt_kh_lk_nt, 0) AS gt_kh_lk_nt
		INTO #detail12
		FROM (
			SELECT so_the_ts, nam, SUM(gt_kh_nam) AS gt_kh_nam, SUM(gt_kh_nam_nt) AS gt_kh_nam_nt
				FROM (
					SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.nam, SUM(a.gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_nam, SUM(a.gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_nam_nt
						FROM ctkhts a WITH(NOLOCK)
						JOIN #ts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
						WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
						GROUP BY a.nam, a.so_the_ts
					UNION ALL
					SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.nam, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * a.gt_da_kh), SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * a.gt_da_kh_nt)
						FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK)
						JOIN dmtgts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
						JOIN #ts c ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts
						WHERE a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
						GROUP BY a.nam, a.so_the_ts
					) a
				GROUP BY a.nam, a.so_the_ts
			) a FULL JOIN (
					SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.nam, SUM(a.gt_da_kh) AS gt_kh_lk, SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_kh_lk_nt
						FROM ctkhts a WITH(NOLOCK) 
						JOIN (SELECT b.so_the_ts, MAX(b.ky) AS ky, b.nam
								FROM ctkhts b WITH(NOLOCK)
								JOIN #ts c ON b.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts
									WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
										GROUP BY b.so_the_ts, b.nam
									) b
							ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.nam = b.nam
						GROUP BY a.nam, a.so_the_ts
					) b ON a.nam = b.nam AND a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			ORDER BY a.so_the_ts, ISNULL(a.nam, b.nam)

	CREATE TABLE #stt(stt INT, so_the_ts VARCHAR(33))
	INSERT INTO #stt SELECT MIN(ikey), so_the_ts FROM #detail11 GROUP BY so_the_ts
	UPDATE #detail11 SET stt = #detail11.ikey + 1 - a.stt FROM #stt a WHERE a.so_the_ts = #detail11.so_the_ts
	
	TRUNCATE TABLE #stt
	INSERT INTO #stt SELECT MIN(ikey), so_the_ts FROM #detail12 GROUP BY so_the_ts
	UPDATE #detail12 SET stt = #detail12.ikey + 1 - a.stt FROM #stt a WHERE a.so_the_ts = #detail12.so_the_ts

	SELECT ISNULL(a.stt, b.stt) AS ikey, ISNULL(a.so_the_ts, b.so_the_ts) AS so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai, b.nam, b.gt_kh_nam, b.gt_kh_nam_nt, b.gt_kh_lk, b.gt_kh_lk_nt
		INTO #detail1 FROM #detail11 a FULL OUTER JOIN #detail12 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.stt = b.stt

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.line_nbr, a.ten_ptkt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_tri, a.gia_tri_nt INTO #detail2
		FROM ctctts a WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN #ts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	
	DECLARE @FC VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @FC = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	UPDATE #detail1 SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_kh_nam_nt = 0, gt_kh_lk_nt = 0 FROM dmts a
		WHERE #detail1.so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND RTRIM(ma_nt) = @FC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''
	UPDATE #detail2 SET gia_tri_nt = 0 FROM dmts a
		WHERE #detail2.so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND RTRIM(ma_nt) = @FC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	INSERT INTO #detail1(so_the_ts, nam) SELECT so_the_ts, 0 FROM #ts WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #detail1)
	INSERT INTO #detail2(so_the_ts, dvt, ten_ptkt) SELECT so_the_ts, '', '' FROM #ts WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #detail2)
	
	SELECT * FROM #detail1
	SELECT * FROM #detail2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptServiceSalesReturnInvoiceList]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Salesman VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@ContactID VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @c0 NVARCHAR(512), @c1 NVARCHAR(512)

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID('d23$000000')) SELECT @c0 = 'b.tien2', @c1 = 'b.tien_nt2'
	ELSE SELECT @c0 = '(case when b.loai = ''90'' then -b.tien2 else b.tien2 end)', @c1 = '(case when b.loai = ''90'' then -b.tien_nt2 else b.tien_nt2 end)'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh,
			a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2,
			a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.tien2 AS pt, a.tien_nt2 AS pt_nt,
			a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai AS dien_giai_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vv, dvt1 AS dvt, line_nbr
		INTO #report FROM wrkin a


	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @DynamicKeyTable, @controller, @SysDB, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'b'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a.ma_nvbh', 'a.ma_nvbh'), '%a.user_id', 'a.user_id'), '%a.datetime', 'a.datetime'), '%a', 'b'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'b'), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'b'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a.ma_nvbh', 'a.ma_nvbh'), '%a.user_id', 'a.user_id'), '%a.datetime', 'a.datetime'), '%a', 'b')

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'status not in (''0'', ''*'')'

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when b.ma_vv <> '''' then b.ma_vv else a.job_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('b.tk_no', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ContactID <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when b.ma_hd <> '''' then b.ma_hd else a.contract_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContactID), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when b.ma_bp <> '''' then b.ma_bp else a.dept_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + @UnitKey

	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'b')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh,'
	SET @q = @q + 'b.so_luong, b.gia, b.gia_nt, ' + @c0 + ', ' + @c1 + ', b.thue, b.thue_nt, (' + @c0 + ' + b.thue), (' + @c1 + ' + b.thue_nt),'
	SET @q = @q + 'a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, b.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, case when b.ma_vv <> '''' then b.ma_vv else a.job_id end, b.dvt, b.line_nbr' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from m23$%Partition a with(nolock) join d23$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	UPDATE #report SET gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.pt, a.pt_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vv, a.dvt, a.line_nbr, (convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec) as rp_group'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh2'
	SET @q = @q + ', d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0' + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', a.stt_rec, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmpb] 
AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2, ISNULL(b.ds_dvcs, '') AS ds_dvcs
		 FROM dmpb a INNER JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk 
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.tk

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhddt05]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh0, ISNULL(b.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh02, ISNULL(c.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh1, ISNULL(c.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh12
		FROM dbo.hddt05 a LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh b ON a.ma_kh0 = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh c ON a.ma_kh1 = c.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PaymentRequest]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@TableUpdate VARCHAR(2), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dn, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dn INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d56$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_dn, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dn <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dn <> '') BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set dyn_dn = rtrim(year(ngay_ct)) + replace(str(month(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') from #beforeUpdate a join c' + @TableUpdate + '$000000 b on a.stt_rec_dn = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s	
	END

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cBPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @dyn_dn VARCHAR(64)
	-- Update datetime, user, status...
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dn, MAX(dyn_dn) AS dyn_dn FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dn
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cBPCIDNumber, @dyn_dn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cBPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dn <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @TableUpdate + '$' + @dyn_dn + ' SET status = ''3'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cBPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status <> ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @TableUpdate + '$' + @dyn_dn + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cBPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status <> ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @TableUpdate + '$000000 SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cBPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status <> ''4'''			
		END
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		-- Update Down Payment in PO
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
			DECLARE @BPCMasterTable VARCHAR(33), @BPCDetailTable VARCHAR(33), @c INT
			SELECT @BPCMasterTable = 'm' + @TableUpdate + '$' + @dyn_dn, @BPCDetailTable = 'd' + @TableUpdate + '$' + @dyn_dn, @c = 1
			SET @s = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @BPCMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cBPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and loai_ct  = ''1'') select @r = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@r int output', @c OUTPUT
			--
			IF (@c = 1) EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$CD @masterTable, @detailTable, @IDNumber, @BPCMasterTable, @BPCDetailTable, @cBPCIDNumber
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cBPCIDNumber, @dyn_dn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[cf_GetNetBackwardDate] (@d SMALLDATETIME, @nDay INT, @nType TINYINT) -- 1 - Used Calendar, 0 - Not used
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nNonWorkingDays INT
	SELECT @dTo = @d, @dFrom = DATEADD(day, - @nDay, @d)
	IF @nType = 1
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
			SELECT @dTo = @dFrom -1
			SELECT @dFrom = @dFrom - @nNonWorkingDays
		END
	RETURN @dFrom
END

GO
