							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 09 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 10 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 11 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 12 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 13 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 14 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 15 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_fk.ordinal_position WHEN 16 THEN ', [' + kcu_fk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
						')' + @cNewLine + @cTab + 
						'REFERENCES [' + tc.table_schema + '].[' + tc.table_name + ']' + @cNewLine +
						' (' +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 01 THEN   '[' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 02 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 03 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 04 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 05 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 06 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 07 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 08 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 09 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 10 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 11 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 12 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 13 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 14 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 15 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
							MAX(CASE kcu_pk.ordinal_position WHEN 16 THEN ', [' + kcu_pk.column_name + ']' ELSE '' END) +
						')' + @cNewLine + @cGo
						AS [add_f]
					FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
						JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu_pk ON tc.table_name = kcu_pk.table_name AND tc.constraint_name = kcu_pk.constraint_name
						JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc ON rc.unique_constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
						JOIN information_schema.table_constraints fc ON fc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
						JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu_fk ON fc.table_name = kcu_fk.table_name AND fc.constraint_name = kcu_fk.constraint_name
					WHERE fc.table_schema = @cTableSchema AND fc.table_name = @cTableName AND fc.constraint_name IN (SELECT constraint_name FROM @tDropc)
					GROUP BY fc.table_schema, fc.table_name, fc.constraint_name, fc.constraint_type, tc.table_schema, tc.table_name
			
			DELETE @sysIndexes
			INSERT INTO @sysIndexes
				SELECT si.id, 
						OBJECT_NAME(si.id), 
						USER_NAME(OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'OwnerId')), 
						si.name, 
						si.indid, 
						'', 
						COALESCE(OBJECTPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(si.name), 'IsPrimaryKey'), 0), 
						COALESCE(OBJECTPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(si.name), 'CnstIsClustKey'), 0),    
						COALESCE(OBJECTPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(si.name), 'IsUniqueCnst'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IndexFillFactor'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsClustered'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsStatistics'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsAutoStatistics'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsHypothetical'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsPadIndex'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsUnique'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsPageLockDisallowed'), 0), 
						COALESCE(INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsRowLockDisallowed'), 0), 
						COALESCE(OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'CnstIsNonclustKey'), 0), 
						COALESCE(OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'CnstIsNotTrusted'), 0), 
						groupid, 
						''
					FROM sysindexes si 
					WHERE OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'IsUserTable') = 1 AND OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'TableHasIndex') = 1
						AND si.indid > 0 AND si.indid < 255
						AND INDEXPROPERTY(si.id, name, 'IsStatistics') = 0
						AND USER_NAME(OBJECTPROPERTY(si.id, 'OwnerId')) = @cTableSchema AND object_name(si.id) = @cTableName
					ORDER BY 1,2
			
			UPDATE @sysIndexes SET [filegroup_name] = b.groupname FROM @sysIndexes a JOIN sysfilegroups b ON a.[filegroup_id] = b.groupid
			
			--
			DECLARE curIndexes CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT index_name FROM @sysIndexes
			OPEN curIndexes
			FETCH NEXT FROM curIndexes INTO @cIndexName
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					DELETE @keyColumns
					SELECT @KeysTableId = OBJECT_ID(@cTableSchema + '.' + @cTableName)
					INSERT INTO @keyColumns
						SELECT sk.keyno, 
								'[' + RTRIM(sc.name) + ']' , 
								CASE WHEN INDEXKEY_PROPERTY(@KeysTableId, si.indid, sk.keyno, 'IsDescending') = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
							FROM syscolumns sc JOIN sysobjects so ON so.id = sc.id AND so.id = @KeysTableId
								JOIN sysindexes si ON si.id = so.id AND si.name = @cIndexName
								JOIN sysindexkeys sk ON sk.id = so.id AND sk.indid = si.indid AND sk.colid = sc.colid 
							ORDER BY sk.keyno
				
					IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @keyColumns WHERE column_name = '[' + @ColumnName + ']')
						BEGIN
							SET @KeyNumber = Null
							SELECT @KeyNumber = MIN(key_no) FROM @keyColumns
							IF @KeyNumber IS NOT NULL
								SELECT @sKeyString = column_name + CASE WHEN column_order_desc = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE '' END
									FROM @keyColumns WHERE key_no = @KeyNumber
						
							SELECT @KeyNumber = MIN(key_no) FROM @keyColumns WHERE key_no > @KeyNumber
							WHILE @KeyNumber IS NOT NULL
								BEGIN
									SELECT @sKeyString = @sKeyString + ', ' + column_name + 
											CASE WHEN column_order_desc = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE '' END
										FROM @keyColumns WHERE key_no = @KeyNumber
									SELECT @KeyNumber = MIN(key_no) FROM @keyColumns WHERE key_no > @KeyNumber
								END
						
							UPDATE @sysIndexes SET index_key_string = @sKeyString WHERE table_name = @cTableName AND table_schema = @cTableSchema AND index_name = @cIndexName
						END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM curIndexes INTO @cIndexName
				END
			CLOSE curIndexes
			DEALLOCATE curIndexes
			--
			DELETE @sysIndexes WHERE is_primary_key = 1
			DELETE @sysIndexes WHERE index_key_string = ''
			--
	
			DECLARE curIndexes CURSOR FOR SELECT index_name, is_unique_constraint, is_uniqueindex, is_clustered, is_statistics, index_key_string, cnst_is_nottrusted, index_fillfactor, [filegroup_name], is_padindex FROM @sysIndexes
			OPEN curIndexes
			FETCH NEXT FROM curIndexes INTO @cIndexName, @isUniqueConstraint, @isUniqueIndex, @isClustered, @isStatistics, @IndexKeyString, @cnstIsNottrusted, @IndexFillFactor, @FileGroupName, @IsPadIndex
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @tDropi
						SELECT 'DROP INDEX [' + @cTableSchema + '].[' + @cTableName + '].[' + @cIndexName + ']' + @cNewLine + @cGo
				
					SET @strSQL = 'CREATE '
					IF @isUniqueIndex = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'UNIQUE '
					IF @isClustered = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'CLUSTERED '
					SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'INDEX [' + @cIndexName + '] ON [' + @cTableSchema + '].[' + @cTableName + '] (' + @IndexKeyString + ')'
					IF @IsPadIndex = 1 
						IF CHARINDEX('WITH', @strSQL) <> 0
							SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', PAD_INDEX '
						ELSE
							SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'WITH PAD_INDEX '
					IF @IndexFillFactor <> 0 
						IF CHARINDEX('WITH', @strSQL) <> 0
							SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', FILLFACTOR = ' + LTRIM(STR(@IndexFillFactor))
						ELSE
							SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'WITH FILLFACTOR = ' + LTRIM(STR(@IndexFillFactor))
					IF NOT @FileGroupName IS NULL SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ON [' + @FileGroupName + ']' + @cNewLine + @cGo
				
					INSERT INTO @tAddi SELECT @strSQL
	
					FETCH NEXT FROM curIndexes INTO @cIndexName, @isUniqueConstraint, @isUniqueIndex, @isClustered, @isStatistics, @IndexKeyString, @cnstIsNottrusted, @IndexFillFactor, @FileGroupName, @IsPadIndex
				END
			CLOSE curIndexes
			DEALLOCATE curIndexes
	
			--
			SELECT @nCounter = @nCounter - 1
		END
	

	SELECT @strSQL =  'SET NOCOUNT ON'
	PRINT @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL =  @cNewLine
	PRINT @strSQL
	
	DECLARE @strPrint NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE crPrint CURSOR FOR
		SELECT drop_c FROM @tDropc
		UNION ALL SELECT * FROM @tDropi
		UNION ALL SELECT * FROM @tScript
		UNION ALL SELECT * FROM @tAddu
		UNION ALL SELECT * FROM @tAddf
		UNION ALL SELECT * FROM @tAddi
	
	OPEN crPrint
	FETCH NEXT FROM crPrint INTO @strPrint
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
		BEGIN
			PRINT @strPrint
			PRINT CHAR(13)
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crPrint INTO @strPrint
		END
	CLOSE crPrint
	DEALLOCATE crPrint


	SELECT @strSQL = ''
	IF OBJECT_ID('v20ctimport') IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine + 'UPDATE v20ctimport SET column_type = ''' + LOWER(@DataType) + ''', column_length = ' + @ColumnLength + ' WHERE column_id = ''' + @ColumnName + ''''
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('v30ctimport') IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine + 'UPDATE v30ctimport SET column_type = ''' + LOWER(@DataType) + ''', column_length = ' + @ColumnLength + ' WHERE column_id = ''' + @ColumnName + ''''
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('v20tblref') IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine + 'UPDATE v20tblref SET xfieldtype = ''' + UPPER(@DataType) + ''' WHERE xfieldkey = ''' + @ColumnName + ''''
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('dmmaubc0') IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine + 'UPDATE dmmaubc0 SET rp_fieldsize = ' + @ColumnLength + ' WHERE rp_field = ''' + @ColumnName + ''''
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('columns') IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine + 'UPDATE columns SET len = ' + @ColumnLength + ' WHERE name = ''' + @ColumnName + ''''
	
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + @cNewLine
	
	PRINT @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL =  @cNewLine + 'SET NOCOUNT OFF'
	PRINT @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFAHandoverReportExport] --fs20_FAExchange_detail
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@FACode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	IF @FACode = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @FACode = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @FACode <> '' THEN 'a.so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FACode, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, line_nbr, ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt INTO #ctctts FROM ctctts
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, t_nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, t_nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, ts_kt AS cong_suat, so_hieu_ts, nuoc_sx, nam_sx, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam_sd, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL) AS tl_kh
			, ten_ts2 AS ten_ts, b.line_nbr, b.ten_ptkt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia_tri, b.gia_tri_nt, 0 AS type
		INTO #report
		FROM dmts a, #ctctts b	
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'		
	SET @q = @q + ' select 1, a.so_the_ts, t_nguyen_gia, t_nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ts_kt, so_hieu_ts, nuoc_sx, nam_sx, isnull(year(ngay_dvsd), 0), case when so_ky_kh = 0 then 0 else 1200/so_ky_kh end,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ten_ts%l, b.line_nbr, '''', '''', b.so_luong, b.gia_tri, b.gia_tri_nt, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmts a with(nolock) left join #ctctts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN nguyen_gia ELSE -nguyen_gia END) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN nguyen_gia_nt ELSE -nguyen_gia_nt END) AS nguyen_gia_nt
		INTO #ctdmts1
		FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmtgts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report) AND ((nam * 12 + ky) <= (@Year * 12 + @Month))
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = a.nguyen_gia + b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt + b.nguyen_gia_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN #ctdmts1 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 2, so_the_ts, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, N'', line_nbr, ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, 1
			FROM ctctts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report)

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 2, so_the_ts, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, N'', 0, N'', N'', 0, 0, 0, 1
			FROM #report WHERE type = 0 AND so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report WHERE type = 1)

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY so_the_ts, stt, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetWordCount(@strString NVARCHAR(4000))
RETURNS INT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nReturn INT
	SET  @nStart = 1; SET  @nReturn = 0
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) = ''	RETURN 0
	SET @strString = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) + ','
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @nReturn = @nReturn + 1
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strString,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN @nReturn
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhreqtlbhht]
AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_thay_doi, a.ngay_thay_doi2, a.luong_co_ban, a.tien_bhxh, a.tien_bhyt, a.tien_bhtn, a.tien_kpcd, a.ghi_chu, b.ten_loai, b.ten_loai2
	FROM hreqtlbhht a LEFT JOIN hrdmltdbh b ON a.loai_thay_doi = b.ma_loai

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostPVTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@step TINYINT,
	@difference INT = 0,
	@downPayment VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@postFrom TINYINT = 1 -- 1 - Voucher, 2 - Post Transaction
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @loai_ct VARCHAR(32), @ma_nt VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT,
		@ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_ct0 SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct0 VARCHAR(32), @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @cMemo NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m71$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS kieu, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_vt0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl_nt INTO #detail FROM d71$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.ma_kh2 AS cuc_thue INTO #inputvat FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ap FROM cttt30 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #inputvat' + ' select *, ma_kh2 as cuc_thue from ctgt30 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @tk = tk, @ma_ct = ma_ct, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @ma_nt = ma_nt, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct0, @so_ct0 = so_ct0, @so_ct = so_ct, @cMemo = dien_giai FROM #master

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select *, null, '''', 0, 0 from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#inputvat', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '10'


	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS o INTO #dGL0 FROM #detail
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, * INTO #dGL FROM #dGL0

	-- Down Payment
	DECLARE @Change BIT
	SELECT @Change = 0
	IF @downPayment = '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_ut' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt <> @baseCurrency) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p71 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #u(stt_rec0 CHAR(3), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), cl NUMERIC(28, 6))
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$DownPayment$CreateDifference @idNumber, 'p71', '#master', '#detail'
			SELECT @downPayment = '#u'
		END
	END

	IF (@downPayment <> '' AND @downPayment <> 'None') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update #detail set tien0 = a.tien0 + b.cl, tien = a.tien + b.cl, tt = a.tt + b.cl from #detail a join ' + @downPayment + ' b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DECLARE @n NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @n = SUM(cl) FROM #u

		IF ISNULL(@n, 0) <> 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #master SET t_tien0 = t_tien0 + @n, t_tien = t_tien + @n, t_tt = t_tt + @n
			SELECT @Change = 1
		END
	END


	-- Adjustment
	IF @Difference = 0 AND @loai_ct = '5' BEGIN
		DECLARE @r1 INT, @r2 INT
		SELECT @r1 = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
		SELECT @r2 = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

		CREATE TABLE #cl(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(3), stt_rec_ir CHAR(13), stt_rec0ir CHAR(3), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), ma_nx VARCHAR(32), tk_vt VARCHAR(32))
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Adjustment$CreateDifference @idNumber, '#detail', @ma_nt, @baseCurrency, @r1, @r2, @downPayment, 1
	END

	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SET @isPost = 1
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0


	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			IF @loai_ct = '5' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'update #detail set kieu = case when b.tien_cl > 0 then 1 when b.tien_cl < 0 then 2 else 0 end, tien_cl = b.tien_cl, tien_cl_nt = b.tien_cl_nt, tk_vt0 = b.tk_vt from #detail a join #cl b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			DECLARE @t TINYINT, @p CHAR(6)
			SELECT @t = 0
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_compact_mode' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'select @t = case when @loai_ct = ''6'' and exists(select 1 from #detail where stt_rec_ir <> '''') then 1 else 0 end'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if @t = 1 begin'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select distinct a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0ir as stt_rec0, convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) as ky into #p from c74$000000 a join #detail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_ir'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_nx, tk_vt into #ref0 from d74$000000'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @p = min(ky) from #p'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'while @p is not null begin'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @q = ''insert into #ref0 select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_nx, a.tk_vt from d74$'' + @p + '' a with(nolock) join #p b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @q'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @p = min(ky) from #p where ky > @p'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'end'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #detail set tk_vt0 = b.tk_vt from #detail a join #ref0 b on a.stt_rec_ir = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0ir = b.stt_rec0'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'end'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@t tinyint output, @p char(6), @q nvarchar(4000), @loai_ct varchar(32)', @t OUTPUT, @p, @q, @loai_ct
			END

			/*1. Gia von*/
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#detail', '1 = 1', 'tien, tien_nt, cp, cp_nt' + CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '5' OR @t = 1 THEN ', tien_cl, tien_cl_nt' ELSE '' END, 'tk_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '5' OR @t = 1 THEN 'kieu, tk_vt0,' ELSE '' END + @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @loai_ct = '5' BEGIN
				UPDATE #dGL0 SET tien = tien - CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN tien_cl ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN kieu IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE cp END,
					tien_nt = tien_nt - CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN tien_cl_nt ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN kieu IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE cp_nt END
			END

			UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien - CASE WHEN @t = 1 THEN cp ELSE 0 END, ps_co_nt = tien_nt - CASE WHEN @t = 1 THEN cp_nt ELSE 0 END, c = 1, o = 1

			IF @loai_ct = '5' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail WHERE kieu IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				-- Difference
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#detail', 'kieu in (1, 2)', 'tien, tien_nt, cp, cp_nt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt', 'tk_vt, kieu, tk_vt0,' + @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN @tk ELSE tk_vt0 END, tk_du = CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN tk_vt0 ELSE tk_vt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN @tk ELSE tk_vt0 END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0,
					ps_co = ABS(tien_cl) + CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN cp ELSE 0 END, ps_co_nt = ABS(tien_cl_nt) + CASE WHEN kieu = 1 THEN cp_nt ELSE 0 END, c = 1, o = 2 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0

				-- Charge
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#detail', 'kieu in (0, 2) and (cp <> 0 or cp_nt <> 0)', 'cp, cp_nt', 'tk_vt, kieu, tk_vt0,' + @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_vt0, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = cp, ps_co_nt = cp_nt, c = 1, o = 3 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END
			IF @t = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#detail', '(cp <> 0 or cp_nt <> 0)', 'cp, cp_nt', 'tk_vt, kieu, tk_vt0,' + @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #dGL0 SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_vt0, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = cp, ps_co_nt = cp_nt, c = 1, o = 3 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#dGL0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'line_nbr, o', NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt
			IF @t = 1 UPDATE #detail SET tk_vt = tk_vt0 WHERE tk_vt0 <> ''

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Thue
		IF @isPost = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE (t_thue + t_thue_nt) <> 0) BEGIN
			DECLARE @stt INT
			SELECT @stt = MAX(stt) FROM #dGL
			UPDATE #inputvat SET cuc_thue = '' FROM #inputvat a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 0)
			SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_thue_no AS tk, t_thue AS ps_no, t_thue_nt AS ps_no_nt, t_thue AS ps_co, t_thue_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('000' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk INTO #tGL FROM #inputvat

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#tGL', '#inputvat', 't_thue + t_thue_nt <> 0', 't_thue, t_thue_nt', 'tk_thue_no, cuc_thue' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = t_thue, ps_co_nt = t_thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + @stt + 2) / 2), line_nbr = stt + @stt + 1

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tGL SET line_nbr = line_nbr + 1, tk = tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
			UPDATE #tGL SET ma_kh = ma_kh2 FROM #tGL a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk_thue_no = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1) AND a.ma_kh2 <> ''

			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#tGL', '#gl', '#tGL', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', 'so_ct0, ngay_ct0', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'
		UPDATE #gl SET ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_ct0 ELSE ngay_ct0 END, so_ct0 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(so_ct0, '') = '' THEN @so_ct0 ELSE so_ct0 END

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$PostInvoiceNumber @masterTable, @detailTable, @glMasterTable, @glDetailTable, @idNumber, @groups, @step

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END


	IF @postFrom <> 1 RETURN

	-- TT
	-- Down Payment
	DECLARE @r INT
	IF @Change = 1 SELECT @r = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_po_tt' AND val = '0') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #inputvat)
	BEGIN
		-- Begin
		DECLARE @Tat_toan TINYINT, @T_tt_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ngay_tt SMALLDATETIME, @cMode CHAR(1), @T_tt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_tt_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = SUM(tt_qd), @T_tt1 = SUM(tt), @T_tt_nt1= SUM(tt_nt)
			FROM cttt30 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt = @idNumber
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = CASE WHEN @T_tt_qd IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_qd END, @T_tt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt1 END, @T_tt_nt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt_nt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_nt1 END

		SELECT @Tat_toan = 0, @Ngay_tt = NULL, @cMode = 'N'
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber)
			SELECT @Tat_toan = tat_toan, @Ngay_tt = ngay_tt, @cMode = 'E' FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt30', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt, t_tt_qd = @T_tt_qd , t_tt1 = @T_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = @T_tt_nt1,
			ngay_tt = CASE WHEN @cMode = 'E' THEN @ngay_tt ELSE ngay_tt END, ma_gd = 0, line_nbr = 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateOtherFields('#ap','#detail', @detailTable, 'cttt30', '1=1', '1=1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct = @ngay_ct, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_ct0, so_ct = @so_ct0, so_ct0 = @so_ct0, Dien_giai = @cMemo
		IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct

		UPDATE #ap SET tat_toan = 0 WHERE tat_toan IS NULL
		UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd0 = 0 WHERE t_tt_qd0 IS NULL
		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NULL
		UPDATE #ap SET so_ct0 = @so_ct, so_ct = @so_ct WHERE ISNULL(so_ct0, '') = ''

		-- Down Payment
		IF @Change = 1 UPDATE #ap SET ty_gia = ROUND(t_tt/t_tt_nt, @r) WHERE t_tt_nt <> 0

		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap
		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInvoiceNumber 'cttt30', @idNumber, 1
		-- End
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- Begin
		SELECT a.* INTO #inputvat_gr FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsertGroupE('#inputvat_gr', '#inputvat', 'ctgt30', '1=1', 'so_luong, t_tien_nt, t_tien, t_thue_nt, t_thue', 'so_ct0, ngay_ct0, so_seri0')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		ALTER TABLE #ap ALTER COLUMN ma_gd CHAR(2) NULL
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#inputvat_gr', 'ctgt30', 'cttt30', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ma_gd = b.ma_gd, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, tk = b.tk, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia, t_tien_nt0 = a.t_tien_nt, t_tien0 = a.t_tien, t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien = 0
				, dien_giai = b.dien_giai
			FROM #ap a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, so_ct = so_ct0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_cp = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, t_nk = 0, t_tt_nt = t_tien_nt0 + t_thue_nt, t_tt = t_tien0 + t_thue
			, t_tt_nt0 = t_tien_nt0 + t_thue_nt, t_tt0 = t_tien0 + t_thue, t_tt_qd = 0, t_tt_qd0 = 0, tat_toan = 0, ngay_tt = NULL
			, tt_nt = 0, tt = 0, t_tt_nt1 = 0, t_tt1 = 0

		UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

		IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct

		UPDATE #ap SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + stt_rec0

		-- Down Payment
		IF @Change = 1 UPDATE #ap SET ty_gia = ROUND(t_tt/t_tt_nt, @r) WHERE t_tt_nt <> 0

		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + '%')
		INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap

		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInvoiceNumber 'cttt30', @idNumber, 2
		-- End
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup5
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn VARCHAR(8000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'

	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			SET @i = @i + 1
			IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_XX,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dmnhXX WHERE loai_nh = '
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@cItemGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b ON a.' + @cItemGroup + ' = b.ma_nh WHERE a.systotal = 1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  ' + CHAR(39) + 'ZZZZ' + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  ' + CHAR(39) + 'ZZZZ' + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$GetInputInvoice]
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@ID VARCHAR(16),
	@TaxCode VARCHAR(18),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ProcessStatus CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@LimitImportNumber INT,
	@IsSchedule BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(MAX), @r NVARCHAR(MAX), @s NVARCHAR(MAX), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @ErrorCount TINYINT, @ExistsCount INT = 0, @JOIN NVARCHAR(4000), @WHERE NVARCHAR(4000), @EndDate SMALLDATETIME, @StartDate SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @ErrorCount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tax_error_count'
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 mst, mau_so, ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, error_count INTO #dt FROM t15$000000
	CREATE TABLE #dtTax (mst VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, mau_so VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, ky_hieu VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, so_hd VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, tt_hd CHAR(1) NULL, ngay_hd SMALLDATETIME NOT NULL, ngay_tdtt SMALLDATETIME NULL)

	SELECT CAST(0 AS INT) AS id INTO #dtExist

	SELECT @EndDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1 + DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateFrom), -1)
	SELECT @StartDate = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 1, @DateTo), 0)

	-- Key
	SELECT @TaxCode = REPLACE(@TaxCode, '''', ''), @TableName = QUOTENAME(REPLACE(@TableName, '''', '')), @ProcessStatus = REPLACE(@ProcessStatus, '''', '')

	SET @q = 'insert into #dtTax select * from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @JOIN = 't15$%Partition b with(nolock) on b.tax_code = ''' + @TaxCode + ''' and a.mst = b.mst and a.mau_so = b.mau_so and a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu and cast(a.so_hd as int) = cast(b.so_hd as int) and a.ngay_hd = b.ngay_hd'
	SELECT @Key = 'b.hd_yn = 1 or b.error_count >= ' + CAST(@ErrorCount AS VARCHAR(32)) + ' or b.type <> ''' + @ProcessStatus + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--
	SET @q = 'declare @existsCount int = 0, @exceptCount int = 0
update t15$%Partition set tt_hd = b.tt_hd from t15$%Partition a with(nolock) join #dtTax b with(nolock) on a.mst = b.mst and a.mau_so = b.mau_so and a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu and cast(a.so_hd as int) = cast(b.so_hd as int) and a.ngay_hd = b.ngay_hd @@where and (a.tt_hd = '''' or a.tt_hd <> b.tt_hd)
delete #dtTax from #dtTax a with(nolock) join ' + @JOIN + ' where %[' +  @Key + ']%
insert into #dt select a.mst, a.mau_so, a.ky_hieu, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, isnull(b.error_count, 0) from #dtTax a with(nolock) left join ' + @JOIN + ' @@where
delete #dtTax from #dtTax a with(nolock) join ' + @JOIN + '
insert into t15$%Partition(tax_code, mst, mau_so, ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, tt_hd, stt_rec_hd, hd_yn, type, error_count, error_log, datetime0, user_id0) select ''' + @TaxCode+ ''', mst, mau_so, ky_hieu, dbo.ff_PadL(rtrim(so_hd), 12), ngay_hd, tt_hd, '''', 0, ''' + @ProcessStatus +  ''', 0, '''', getdate(), ' + CAST(@UserID AS VARCHAR(32)) + ' from #dtTax a @@where
update t15$%Partition set hd_yn = 1, stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec, error_count = 0, error_log = '''' from t15$%Partition a with(nolock) join m15$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.tax_code = b.mst_kh and a.mst = b.mst_cn and a.mau_so = b.mau_so and a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu and cast(a.so_hd as int) = cast(b.so_ct as int) and a.ngay_hd = b.ngay_ct @@where and a.tax_code = ''' + @TaxCode+ ''' and b.status <> ''*''
delete #dt from #dt a with(nolock) join ' + @JOIN + ' and b.hd_yn = 1
select @existsCount = @existsCount + count(1) from ' + @TableName + ' a with(nolock) join ' + @JOIN + ' where %[b.hd_yn = 1]%
update #dtExist set id = id + @existsCount'

	SET @r = 'update m15$%Partition set tc_hd = b.tt_hd, ngay_tdtt = b.ngay_tdtt, ngay_ph_tdtt = getdate() from m15$%Partition a with(nolock) join #dtTax b with(nolock) on a.mst_cn = b.mst and a.mau_so = b.mau_so and a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu and cast(a.so_ct as int) = cast(b.so_hd as int) and a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_hd @@where and (a.tc_hd = ''0'' or a.tc_hd <> b.tt_hd)'

	IF @EndDate < @DateTo BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + '; delete #dtTax from #dtTax a @@where'

		SET @s = REPLACE(@r, '@@where', 'where %[a.ngay_ct < cast(''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @StartDate, 112)  + ''' as smalldatetime)]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @EndDate, @UserID, 1
		SET @s = REPLACE(@q, '@@where', 'where %[a.ngay_hd < cast(''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @StartDate, 112)  + ''' as smalldatetime)]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'a.ngay_hd', @DateFrom, @EndDate, @UserID, 1

		SET @s = REPLACE(@r, '@@where', 'where %[a.ngay_ct > cast(''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @EndDate, 112) + ''' as smalldatetime)]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @StartDate, @DateTo, @UserID, 1
		SET @s = REPLACE(@q, '@@where', 'where %[a.ngay_hd > cast(''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @EndDate, 112) + ''' as smalldatetime)]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'a.ngay_hd', @StartDate, @DateTo, @UserID, 1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @r = REPLACE(@r, '@@where', '')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @r, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, 1
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@@where', '')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_hd', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, 1
	END

	SELECT TOP(@LimitImportNumber) * FROM #dt ORDER BY ngay_hd ASC, mau_so DESC, so_hd ASC
	SELECT id AS exist_count FROM #dtExist
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$GetIdentityNumber]
	@wsID AS CHAR(1),
	@Code CHAR(3),
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Field VARCHAR(32) = 'stt_rec'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Type TINYINT

	SELECT @Type = 0
	SELECT @Type = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_identity_type' -- 0 - Normal, 1 - Auto Increment, 2 - Sequence [0-9][A-Z]


	IF @Type = '0' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
		declare @e int, @maxIdentityNumber numeric(9)
		set @e = 0
		
		update dmstt set stt_rec = stt_rec + 1
		select @maxIdentityNumber = stt_rec from dmstt
		while exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@Table) + ' where ' + @Field + ' = ''' + @wsID + ''' + replace(str(@maxIdentityNumber, 9), '' '', ''0'') + ''' + @Code + ''')
			select @e = 1, @maxIdentityNumber = @maxIdentityNumber + 1
		
		if @e = 1 update dmstt set stt_rec = @maxIdentityNumber
		select (''' + @wsID +''' + replace(str(@maxIdentityNumber, 9), '' '', ''0'') + ''' + @Code + ''') as IdNumber
'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Type = '1' SELECT @q = 'insert into identity0(c) select ''''' + CHAR(13) + 'select (''' + @wsID +''' + replace(str(@@identity, 9), '' '', ''0'') + ''' + @Code + ''') as IdNumber'
		ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @Seq36 CHAR(1)
			IF @UserID % 36 < 10 SELECT @Seq36 = @UserID % 36 ELSE SELECT @Seq36 = CHAR(@UserID % 36 + 55)

			SELECT @q = 'insert into identity' + @Seq36 + '(c) select ''''' + CHAR(13) + 'select (''' + @wsID + @Seq36 + ''' + replace(str(@@identity, 8), '' '', ''0'') + ''' + @Code + ''') as IdNumber'

		END
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmgia2] AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_nt, c.ten_nt2, d.ten_kh, d.ten_kh2, e.ten_kho, e.ten_kho2,
		f.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh1, f.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh12,

		h.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh3, h.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh32,
		i.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh9, i.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh92,
		z.ten_loai, z.ten_loai2, b.ds_dvcs
	FROM dbo.dmgia2 a 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnt c ON a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkho e ON a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho

		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh g ON a.nh_kh2 = g.ma_nh AND g.loai_nh = '2'
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh h ON a.nh_kh3 = h.ma_nh AND h.loai_nh = '3'
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh2 i ON a.nh_kh9 = i.ma_nh
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmloaigia2 z ON a.loai_gia = z.loai_gia

GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$Convert$Unicode](@b VARCHAR(MAX)) 
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN 
	IF @b = '' RETURN ''

	DECLARE @v VARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(MAX), @i INT, @n1 INT, @n2 INT, @n3 INT, @w INT
	SELECT @i = 1, @r = '', @v = CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), CAST(@b AS XML).value('xs:base64Binary(sql:column("b"))', 'varbinary(max)')) FROM (SELECT @b AS b) a
	WHILE @i <= LEN(@v) BEGIN

		SET @n1 = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@v, @i, 1))

		IF @n1 < 128 SELECT @w = @n1, @i = @i + 1
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @n2 = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@v, @i + 1, 1))

			IF @n1 > 191 AND @n1 < 224 BEGIN
				SELECT @w = ((@n1 & 31) * 64) | (@n2 & 63), @i = @i + 2
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @n3 = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@v, @i + 2, 1)), @w = ((@n1 & 15) * 4096) | ((@n2 & 63) * 64) | (@n3 & 63), @i = @i + 3
			END
		END
		SET @r = @r + NCHAR(@w)
	END
	RETURN @r
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPR2POReport] --fs_PR2POReport
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- Struct
	SELECT ma_vt, ma_bp, so_luong, sl_dh, so_luong AS sl_cl INTO #tmp FROM d91$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_bp, so_luong, sl_dh, sl_cl INTO #report FROM #tmp

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @Key = 'a.xstatus <> ''1'' and b.status in (''2'', ''3'')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or a.ma_kho = '''')'

	IF @DateFrom2 IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_yc >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom2, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo2 IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_yc <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo2, 112) + ''''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @f$Ext VARCHAR(125), @isBiMode VARCHAR(1)
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Report$GetFields '#tmp,#report', NULL, NULL, @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, NULL, @isBiMode OUTPUT, @Key OUTPUT, @f$Ext OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, '%p', 'b'), @f$Ext = REPLACE(@f$Ext, '%p', 'b')
	IF @isBiMode = '1' BEGIN
		ALTER TABLE #tmp ADD ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32) NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ADD ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32) NULL
		SELECT @f$Ext = @f$Ext + ', b.ma_dvcs'
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp'	
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.so_luong*a.he_so) as so_luong, (a.sl_dh*a.he_so) AS sl_dh, (a.so_luong - a.sl_dh) as sl_cl' + @f$Ext
	SET @q = @q + ' from d91$%Partition a with(nolock) join m91$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DELETE #tmp WHERE so_luong = sl_dh
	IF @Type = 10 UPDATE #tmp SET ma_bp = ''

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #report select b.ma_vt, b.ma_bp, sum(b.so_luong), sum(b.sl_dh), sum(b.sl_cl)' + @f$Ext + ' from #tmp b group by b.ma_vt, b.ma_bp' + @f$Ext + ' order by b.ma_vt, b.ma_bp' + @f$Ext + '
if not exists (select 1 from #report) insert into #report (ma_vt, ma_bp, so_luong, sl_dh, sl_cl) values ('''', '''', 0, 0, 0)
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2, b.dvt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		ORDER BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_vt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll008]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Round INT, @bac INT, @Total NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, ma_sp, gia, so_luong, tien, tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM hrluongsp$000000

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department0), 'a.', 'b.')

	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	SELECT @Filter = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Filter)
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.loai = 2'
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.')
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department0 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on r.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select r.ma_bp0, r.ma_sp, r.gia, max(r.so_luong), sum(r.tien), sum(r.tien_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrluongsp$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by r.ma_bp0, r.ma_sp, r.gia'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, NULL, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, NULL, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, '#tmp', 'ma_bp'

		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt
			, a.gia, a.gia AS gia_nt, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, hrbp b

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, cast(0 as int) as stt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, sum(a.so_luong) as so_luong, sum(a.tien) as tien, sum(a.tien_nt) as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia*0 as gia_nt, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, max(b.stt_ref) as stt_ref'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp group by a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, a.gia'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @Round) END

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_bp, ma_sp, gia INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_bp, ma_sp, gia ORDER BY MAX(stt_ref), ma_sp, gia
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.gia = b.gia
	SELECT ma_bp, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY ma_bp
	UPDATE #report SET stt = a.stt - b.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #g b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 1, 1, 0, '', '', SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0, '', 0, '' FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 1, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', 0, ''

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, ma_bp, '', SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0, MAX(bp_me), MAX(bac_bp), MAX(stt_ref) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY ma_bp

	SELECT @bac = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	WHILE @bac > 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, 1, 1, 0, a.bp_me, '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bp_me = b.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + CASE WHEN @Filter <> '' AND @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN ' and ' + @Filter ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' and sysorder = 5 and a.stt = 0 and a.bp_me not in (select distinct ma_bp from #report where bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + ' - 1)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET so_luong = a.so_luong + b.so_luong, tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt
			FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #report WHERE stt = 0 AND bac_bp = @bac GROUP BY bp_me) b ON a.ma_bp = b.bp_me
			WHERE a.stt = 0 AND a.bac_bp = @bac - 1
		--
		SET @bac = @bac - 1
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @bac = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE ma_bp <> ''

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, a.stt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, a.stt_ref'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.stt = 0 then isnull(space(2 * (a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(ISNULL(@bac, 0)) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_bp' ELSE 'c.ten_bp2' END + ', '' '') else '' '' end as ten_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.sysorder = 3 then N''' + @Total + ''' else case when a.stt = 0 then '' '' else ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_sp' ELSE 'd.ten_sp2' END + ' end end as ten_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp left join hrdmsp d on a.ma_sp = d.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.sysorder, a.stt_ref, a.ma_sp, a.gia'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[cf_GetNetDays] (@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nType TINYINT) -- 1 - Used Calendar, 0 - Not used
RETURNS INT
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nDays INT, @nNonWorkingDays INT
	SELECT @nDays = dbo.ff_Getdays(@dTo, @dFrom) + 1
	IF @nType = 1
		SELECT @nDays = @nDays - COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
	RETURN @nDays
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptProfitabilityByCustomer] --fs20_SOprofitReport--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@CustomerGroup1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@CustomerGroup2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@CustomerGroup3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1023),
	@Customer CHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Group VARCHAR(254),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @iNum INT, @nSUM NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFCSUM NUMERIC(28, 6), @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nPRound TINYINT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @cNoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cName) ELSE RTRIM(cName2) END FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @nPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tl'

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, ma_nt, tien_xuat AS tien_xuat, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_x, tien2 AS tien2, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2, ck AS ck, ck_nt AS ck_nt
		INTO #t FROM wrkin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh '
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kh, ma_nt, sum(tien_xuat) as tien_xuat, sum(tien_nt_x) as tien_nt_x, sum(tien2) as tien2,'
		SET @q = @q + ' sum(tien_nt2) as tien_nt2, sum(ck) as ck, sum(ck_nt) as ck_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ' ]% group by a.ma_kh, ma_nt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kh, ma_nt, sum(tien_xuat) as tien_xuat, sum(tien_nt_x) as tien_nt_x, sum(tien2) as tien2,'
		SET @q = @q + ' sum(tien_nt2) as tien_nt2, sum(ck) as ck, sum(ck_nt) as ck_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with (nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_kh, ma_nt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @Customer <> '0' DELETE #t WHERE ma_kh NOT IN (SELECT rp2_id FROM dmmaubc2 WHERE RTRIM(rp_id) = '00' AND RTRIM(rp1_id) = @Customer)

	UPDATE #t SET tien_nt2 = 0, tien_nt_x = 0, ck_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_kh
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, SUM(a.tien_xuat) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Type = 0 THEN SUM(a.tien2) ELSE SUM(a.tien2) - SUM(a.ck) END AS tien2, CASE WHEN @Type = 0 THEN SUM(a.tien_nt2) ELSE SUM(a.tien_nt2) - SUM(a.ck_nt) END AS tien_nt2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lai, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS lai_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_nt
			, MAX(b.nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(b.nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(b.nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3, MAX(b.nh_kh9) AS nh_kh9
		INTO #report
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	DELETE #report WHERE tien = 0 AND tien2 = 0
	UPDATE #report SET lai = ROUND(tien2 - tien, @nRound), lai_nt = ROUND(tien_nt2 - tien_nt, @nFCRound)
	SELECT @nSUM = SUM(lai), @nFCSUM = SUM(lai_nt) FROM #report

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_kh, nh_kh1, nh_kh2, nh_kh3, nh_kh9', 'NUMERIC(5), #, #, #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group , 'kh', 'tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, lai, lai_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	UPDATE #report SET ty_le = CASE WHEN @nSUM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(lai*100/@nSUM, @nPRound) END, ty_le_nt = CASE WHEN @nFCSUM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(lai_nt*100/@nFCSUM, @nPRound) END

	IF @Language = 'V'
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = @cNoGroup WHERE systotal = 0 AND (RTRIM(LTRIM(ten_kh)) = ''	OR ten_kh IS NULL)
	ELSE
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh2 = @cNoGroup WHERE systotal = 0 AND (RTRIM(LTRIM(ten_kh2)) = '' OR ten_kh2 IS NULL)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES(1, 0, 0)

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = 'SELECT stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, lai, lai_nt, ty_le, ty_le_nt FROM #report ORDER BY ' + @Group + ', sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'SELECT stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, lai, lai_nt, ty_le, ty_le_nt FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem](@Table VARCHAR(16), @ItemField VARCHAR(16), @Type CHAR(1))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_002' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		RETURN '--'
	END

	DECLARE @Return NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Type = 0
		SELECT @Return = '--'
	ELSE
		SET @Return = 'delete ' + @Table + ' where ' + @ItemField + ' in (select ma_vt from dmvt with(nolock) where vt_ton_kho = 0)'

	RETURN @Return
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Report$GetQuaterAndYear]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @dNgay_dn SMALLDATETIME, @p INT, @y INT
	SELECT @p = 0, @y = 0
	SELECT @dNgay_dn = ngay_dn2 FROM dmstt

	IF MONTH(@DateFrom) * 31 + DAY(@DateFrom) >= MONTH(@dNgay_dn) * 31 + DAY(@dNgay_dn)
		SET @d = CAST(STR(YEAR(@DateFrom), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dNgay_dn), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dNgay_dn), 2), ' ', '0') AS SMALLDATETIME)
	ELSE
		SET @d = CAST(STR(YEAR(@DateFrom) - 1, 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dNgay_dn), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dNgay_dn), 2), ' ', '0') AS SMALLDATETIME)

	CREATE TABLE #t(xtype INT, dStart SMALLDATETIME, dEnd SMALLDATETIME)
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT 1, @d, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @d) - 1
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT 2, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @d), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @d) - 1
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT 3, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @d), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @d) - 1
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT 4, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @d), DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @d) - 1
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT 12, @d, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @d) - 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE dStart = @DateFrom AND dEnd = @DateTo)
		SELECT CASE WHEN xtype = 12 THEN 0 ELSE xtype END AS quy, YEAR(@d) AS nam FROM #t WHERE dStart = @DateFrom AND dEnd = @DateTo 
	ELSE
		SELECT 0 AS quy, 0 AS nam

	DROP TABLE #t

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockCardAllItems] --fs_StockCardBySite
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128)= '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64)= '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkcolumns a, cdvt b
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien  AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #report FROM #t

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_kho = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '''', @Join = ''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, '', '', 1, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #t

	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report select a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--Nhom lai va tinh ton cuoi
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 
			a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt,
			MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3,
			SUM(a.ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(a.du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(a.du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt, SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(a.tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap,
			SUM(a.tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(a.tien_xuat)  AS tien_xuat, SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x,
			MAX(a.ton_dau * 0) AS ton_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau * 0) AS du_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau_nt * 0) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #incd1
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmvt)) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		ORDER BY 1

	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#incd1', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #incd1 SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	DELETE #incd1 WHERE systotal = 1 AND ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0 AND ton_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi_nt = 0

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#incd1', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt 
		FROM #incd1
		ORDER BY ma_vt
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
