CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostPXTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@step TINYINT,
	@vat TINYINT = 1 --1: ctgt30, 2: ctgt20
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @tk_thue VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh2 VARCHAR(32),
		@noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT, @seri VARCHAR(32), @ma_nk VARCHAR(32), @dien_giai NVARCHAR(512), @ten_vt NVARCHAR(1024)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m26$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d26$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #inputvat FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #outputvat FROM r20$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_co AS tk, tk_co AS tk_du, tk_co AS tk0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tax INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable))
		EXEC sp_executesql N'update #detail set tien_nt = - tien_nt, tien = - tien from #detail where loai = ''90'''

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct, @tk = tk, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_kh2 = ma_kh2, @tk_thue = tk_thue, @ma_nk = ma_nk, @seri = RTRIM(so_seri), @dien_giai = dien_giai, @ten_vt = CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_vt) <> '' THEN ten_vt ELSE dien_giai END FROM #master

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SELECT @isPost = 1
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0


	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		/*1. Cong no*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', NULL, 'tk_co <> ' + CHAR(39) + @tk + CHAR(39), NULL, 'line_nbr')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_co, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = tien_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
		END


		/*2. Thue*/
		IF @isPost = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE t_thue + t_thue_nt <> 0 AND tk_thue <> '') BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'thue + thue_nt <> 0', 'thue, thue_nt', @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @tk_thue, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, dien_giai = @dien_giai, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
		END


		-- Post to #gl
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0

		IF @ma_kh2 <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @tk_thue AND tk_cn = 1) UPDATE #dGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh2 WHERE tax = 1
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- (Loại kê khai)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ISNULL(loai_kk, '') = '9') GOTO EndPostVAT

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE mau_bc <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @vatTable VARCHAR(32), @tmp VARCHAR(32), @t_tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien NUMERIC(28, 6)

		SELECT @vatTable = CASE WHEN @vat = 1 THEN 'ctgt30' ELSE 'ctgt20' END, @tmp = CASE WHEN @vat = 1 THEN '#inputvat' ELSE '#outputvat' END
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert(@tmp, '#master', @masterTable, @vatTable, '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE (@tmp, '#detail', @detailTable, @vatTable, '1=1', 'line_nbr = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'line_nbr')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Update Voucher Form (TT156)
		DECLARE @ma_mau_ct VARCHAR(32)
		IF ISNULL(@ma_nk, '') <> '' SELECT @ma_mau_ct = RTRIM(ISNULL(ky_hieu,'')) FROM v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @ma_nk

		-- Update dữ liệu bảng ctgt20 hay ctgt30
		DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT
		SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

		IF @vat = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #inputvat SET ten_vt = @ten_vt, ngay_ct0 = ngay_lct, so_ct0 = LTRIM(so_ct), so_seri0 = @seri, t_tien_nt = - t_tien_nt, t_tien = - t_tien, t_thue_nt = - t_thue_nt, t_thue = - t_thue,
				tk_du = @tk, tk_thue_no = @tk_thue, stt_rec0 = '001', line_nbr = 1, so_luong = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia = 0

			UPDATE #inputvat SET ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue, dia_chi = b.dia_chi FROM #inputvat a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

			IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
				UPDATE #inputvat SET t_tien = t_tien + b.tien, t_tien_nt = t_tien_nt + tien_nt FROM #inputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				DELETE #inputvat WHERE t_tien = 0 AND t_tien_nt = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
			END

			UPDATE #inputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
			IF @ma_mau_ct <> '' UPDATE #inputvat SET ma_mau_ct = @ma_mau_ct
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @t_tien_nt = t_tien_nt, @t_tien = t_tien FROM #master
			UPDATE #outputvat SET ten_vt = @ten_vt, tk_du = @tk, tk_thue_co = @tk_thue, stt_rec0 = '001', line_nbr = 1, t_tien_nt2 = @t_tien_nt, t_tien2 = @t_tien
			UPDATE #outputvat SET ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue, dia_chi = b.dia_chi FROM #outputvat a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

			IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
				UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien2 = t_tien2 - b.tien2, t_tien_nt2 = t_tien_nt2 - tien_nt2 FROM #outputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt2 FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				DELETE #outputvat WHERE t_tien2 = 0 AND t_tien_nt2 = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
			END

			UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
			IF @ma_mau_ct <> '' UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_mau_ct = @ma_mau_ct
		END
	END

	DELETE ctgt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	DELETE ctgt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	IF @vat = 1 INSERT INTO ctgt30 SELECT * FROM #inputvat
	ELSE INSERT INTO ctgt20 SELECT * FROM #outputvat
EndPostVAT:

	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 2, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$PostInvoiceNumber @masterTable, @detailTable, @glMasterTable, @glDetailTable, @idNumber, @groups, @step, 1
		ELSE
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$PostInvoiceNumber @masterTable, @detailTable, @glMasterTable, @glDetailTable, @idNumber, @groups, @step

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[FastBusiness$Report$GroupByParentJob]
	@Table VARCHAR(33), --Table must have column: ma_vv_me, ma_vv, stt INT, sysorderrow VARCHAR(1023), bac_vv INT
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(511),
	@TotalFields VARCHAR(511)
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @GroupByMatch VARCHAR(511), @maxLevel INT
	DECLARE @n INT, @k INT, @f VARCHAR(33)
	
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS xcode, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS code, ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #xJobStruct FROM wrkcolumns
	INSERT INTO #xJobStruct EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
	SET @q = 'UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET bac_vv = ISNULL((SELECT bac_vv FROM #xJobStruct a WHERE a.ma_vv = ' + @Table + '.ma_vv), 0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @maxLevel = MAX(bac_vv) FROM ' + @Table
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@maxLevel int OUTPUT', @maxLevel OUTPUT
	IF @TotalFields <> '' SELECT @n = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@TotalFields)

	-- Parent job if not exist
	SELECT @GroupByMatch = '', @k = 1
	IF @GroupBy <> '' SET @GroupByMatch = ',a.' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@GroupBy), ' ',''), ',', ',a.')
	SET @q = 'DECLARE @i INT SET @i = ' + LTRIM(@maxLevel)
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vv, a.bac_vv' + @GroupByMatch + ' INTO #pJob FROM ' + @Table + ' a'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vv, a.bac_vv' + @GroupByMatch + ' INTO #pJob2 FROM ' + @Table + ' a'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @i >= 0 BEGIN'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	DELETE FROM #pJob'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  INSERT #pJob SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv_me, b.bac_vv' + @GroupByMatch + ' FROM ' + @Table + ' a LEFT JOIN #xJobStruct b ON a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		WHERE a.bac_vv = @i AND a.ma_vv_me <> '''' AND a.ma_vv_me NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM ' + @Table + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  INSERT INTO ' + @Table + '(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv_me, ma_vv, bac_vv, stt' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy <> '' THEN ',' + @GroupBy ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @TotalFields <> '' THEN ',' + @TotalFields ELSE '' END + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '    SELECT DISTINCT 4, 1, 0, ISNULL(b.ma_vv_me, ''''), RTRIM(a.ma_vv), a.bac_vv, 0' + @GroupByMatch
	WHILE @k <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @f = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@TotalFields, @k)
		SET @q = @q + ', 0'
		SET @k = @k + 1
	END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  FROM #pJob a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	DELETE FROM #pJob2'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  INSERT #pJob2 SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv_me, b.bac_vv' + @GroupByMatch + ' FROM ' + @Table + ' a LEFT JOIN #xJobStruct b ON a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		WHERE a.bac_vv = @i AND a.ma_vv_me <> '''' AND a.ma_vv_me IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM ' + @Table + ') AND a.ma_vv_me NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #pJob)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET sysorder = 4 FROM ' + @Table + ' a WHERE a.ma_vv IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vv FROM #pJob2)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  SET @i = @i - 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'END'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	SET @q = 'DECLARE @i INT SET @i = 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET stt = 0, sysorderrow = '''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'CREATE TABLE #order(stt INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, keyorder VARCHAR(33))'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #order(keyorder) SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ma_vv) FROM ' + @Table + ' WHERE bac_vv = 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET stt = b.stt, sysorderrow = REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 3), '' '', ''0'') + RTRIM(ma_vv) FROM ' + @Table + ' a LEFT JOIN #order b ON a.ma_vv = b.keyorder WHERE bac_vv = 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @i <= ' + LTRIM(@maxLevel) + ' BEGIN'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET sysorderrow = (SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(a.sysorderrow) FROM ' + @Table + ' a WHERE a.ma_vv = ' + @Table + '.ma_vv_me AND a.bac_vv = @i AND a.sysorderrow <> '''') + REPLACE(STR(@i, 3), '' '', ''0'') + REPLACE(STR(bac_vv, 3), '' '', ''0'') + RTRIM(ma_vv)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  	WHERE stt = 0 AND bac_vv >= @i AND (sysorderrow = '''' OR sysorderrow IS NULL)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT @i = @i + 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'END'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--Total group
	IF @TotalFields <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @m INT, @t INT, @s VARCHAR(33)
		SELECT @q = 'DECLARE @i INT SET @i = ' + LTRIM(@maxLevel - 1), @k = 1
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @i >= 0 BEGIN'
			WHILE @k <= @n BEGIN
				SELECT @f = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@TotalFields, @k)
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  UPDATE ' + @Table + ' SET ' + @f + ' = ' + @f + ' + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(t.' + @f + ', 0)) FROM ' + @Table + ' t WHERE t.ma_vv_me = ' + @Table + '.ma_vv'
				IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @m = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@GroupBy), @t = 1
					WHILE @t <= @m BEGIN
						SELECT @s = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@GroupBy, @t)
						SET @q = @q + ' AND t.' + @s + ' = ' + @Table + '.' + @s
						SET @t = @t + 1
					END
				END
				SET @q = @q + '), 0) WHERE bac_vv = @i'
				SET @k = @k + 1
			END
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '  SET @i = @i - 1'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'END'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate]
	@tableName VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode CHAR(3),
	@unit VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @voucherCode = REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', ''), @language = REPLACE(@language, '''', ''), @tableName = REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '')

	--
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @v BIT, @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @$u BIT, @$n INT, @$j INT, @$c VARCHAR(32), @$m VARCHAR(32), @$d VARCHAR(32), @$i VARCHAR(32), @$cDate SMALLDATETIME, @$lDate SMALLDATETIME, @$f0 VARCHAR(128), @$f1 VARCHAR(128), @$f2 VARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @$u = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_cnsct' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, @$n = (SELECT CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_thang_kt')
		, @$f0 = '', @$f1 = '', @$f2 = ', ''''', @d = GETDATE()

	IF @$u = 0 RETURN

	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @tableName + ' set so_ct_hddt = dbo.ff_PadL(ltrim(rtrim(so_ct_hddt)), ' + RTRIM(COL_LENGTH('wrkcolumns', 'so_ct')) + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT [type], ref_table, ref_key, ref_update, CAST(0 AS INT) AS e INTO #dmct8 FROM dmct8 WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND [type] IN (2, 3, 4, 5) AND [status] = '1'
	SELECT @$c = RTRIM(c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END, @$m = RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(m$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, @$d = RTRIM(d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(d$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, @$i = RTRIM(i$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(i$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@$m, '%Partition', '000000')) AND name = 'so_seri') SELECT @$f0 = CASE WHEN @voucherCode IN ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN '' ELSE ',so_seri = b.so_seri_hddt' END, @$f2 = ', a.so_seri'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@$c) AND name = 'so_seri') SELECT @$f1 = ',so_seri = b.so_seri_hddt'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@$c) AND name = 'k')  SELECT @$f1 = ',k = b.so_seri_hddt'

	-- Update Voucher Number/Serial for release invoice
	CREATE TABLE #$pe (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #$ide (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #$pe select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @$c + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
insert into #$ide select stt_rec, convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @$c + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = '
insert into hddt03$%Partition (stt_rec, so_seri, so_ct) select a.stt_rec' + @$f2 + ', a.so_ct from ' + @$m + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join #$ide c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec where c.p = ''%Partition'' and not exists(select 1 from hddt03$%Partition d where d.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
update a set so_ct = b.so_ct_hddt' +  @$f0 + ' from ' + @$m + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
update a set so_ct = b.so_ct_hddt, c$ = convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + b.so_ct_hddt + a.stt_rec from ' + @$i + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@$d, '%Partition', '000000')) AND name = 'so_ct') BEGIN
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update a set so_ct = b.so_ct_hddt from ' + @$d + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	END
	SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update a set ' + REPLACE(ref_update, 'b.so_ct', 'b.so_ct_hddt') + ' from ' + ref_table + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on ' + ref_key FROM #dmct8 WHERE [type] = 2

	SELECT @p = MIN(p), @$cDate = CAST((@p + '01') AS SMALLDATETIME) FROM #$pe
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Partition', @p)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @d, @userID
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #$pe WHERE p > @p
	END
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @$c + ' set so_ct = b.so_ct_hddt' +  @$f1 + ' from ' + @$c + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update Orginal Tables
	IF @$n > 0 and @$cDate IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update a set ' + REPLACE(ref_update, 'b.so_ct', 'b.so_ct_hddt') + ' from ' + ref_table + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on ' + ref_key FROM #dmct8 WHERE [type] > 2 AND CHARINDEX('%Partition', ref_table) <= 0
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct8 WHERE [type] > 2 AND CHARINDEX('%Partition', ref_table) > 0) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @$j = 0, @$lDate = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
			WHILE @$j <= @$n BEGIN
				SELECT @q = ''
				UPDATE #dmct8 SET e = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(ref_table, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @$cDate, 112)))
				IF @$cDate <= @$lDate
					SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update a set ' + REPLACE(ref_update, 'b.so_ct', 'b.so_ct_hddt') + ' from ' + REPLACE(ref_table, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @$cDate, 112)) + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on ' + ref_key
						FROM #dmct8 WHERE [type] > 2 AND CHARINDEX('%Partition', ref_table) > 0 AND e IS NOT NULL
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				--
				SELECT @$j = @$j + 1, @$cDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @$cDate)
			END
		END
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmgia3]
AS
	SELECT  a.*, b.ten_vt AS ten_vt, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_vt2, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.nh_vt2, b.nh_vt3, d.ten_kh AS ten_kh, d.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh2, c.ten_nt AS ten_nt, c.ten_nt2 AS ten_nt2, ISNULL(b.ds_dvcs, '') AS ds_dvcs
		FROM dmgia3 a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN dbo.dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh JOIN dmnt c ON a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReceivableReportByInvoice] --fs_ARByInvoices--
	@DateGLFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateGLTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateReport AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Account VARCHAR(32), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup3 VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT, 
	@Size TINYINT,
	@BalanceView TINYINT,
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@ContractGroup CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound TINYINT, @cname NVARCHAR(1024), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cname = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT076'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.loai_tt, a.ma_gd, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.loai_ct
			, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct AS so_ct0, a.so_seri, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp
			, a.ma_nvbh, a.tk, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_tien2, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_ck_nt, a.t_ck, a.t_tt_nt
			, a.t_tt_nt0, a.t_tt_nt0 * 0 AS con_pt_nt, a.t_tt0 * 0 AS con_pt, a.ma_tt, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_qd0, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt1
			, a.t_tt0, a.ngay_ct0, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, b.stt_ct_nkc, c.ten_kh, a.ngay_ct0 + d.han_tt AS ngay_tt0
			, a.line_nbr, d.han_tt AS han_tt, a.ma_hd, a.status, a.tat_toan, a.tt, a.tt_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_hd
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkar a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct, dmkh c, dmtt d
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLTo, 112) + '''', @PaymentKey = 'a.loai_tt = 1 and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + '''', @PaymentJoin = ''
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ngay_ct0 is null or ngay_ct0 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ngay_ct0 is null or ngay_ct0 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_tt = ''0'''
	IF @Type = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and tat_toan = 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.tk like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Account, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @s = ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''')) + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SELECT @PaymentJoin = ' left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	--
	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable))) BEGIN
		SELECT a.name, b.name AS [type], a.prec INTO #struct FROM tempdb..syscolumns a LEFT JOIN tempdb..systypes b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable) AND b.name IN ('char', 'nvarchar', 'varchar', 'decimal', 'int', 'tinyint', 'datetime', 'smalldatetime')
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #struct WHERE name = 'filterkey') BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #t1 (a int)
			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #t1 add ' + [name] + ' ' + RTRIM([type]) + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('char', [type]) > 0 THEN '(' + RTRIM(prec) + ')' ELSE '' END + ' null' FROM #struct
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			ALTER TABLE #t1 DROP COLUMN a
			SELECT TOP 1 * INTO #t2 FROM #t1
			--
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t1 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) <= 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #t2 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) > 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t1', @filterKey OUTPUT
		END
	END
	--
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @PaymentKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@PaymentKey)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_tt, tt_qd AS t_tt_qd, tt_cn AS t_tt_cn INTO #payment FROM cttt20
	SET @q = 'insert into #payment select a.stt_rec_tt, sum(a.tt_qd), sum(a.tt_cn) from cttt20 a with(nolock)' + @PaymentJoin + ' where ' + @PaymentKey + ' group by a.stt_rec_tt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.loai_tt, a.ma_gd, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.loai_ct,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, '''', a.so_seri, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp,' 
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_nvbh, a.tk, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_tien2, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_ck_nt, a.t_ck, a.t_tt_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.t_tt_nt0, 0 as con_pt_nt, 0 as con_pt, a.ma_tt, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_qd0, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt1,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.t_tt0, a.ngay_ct0, b.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, b.stt_ct_nkc, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh' ELSE 'c.ten_kh2' end + ', a.ngay_ct0 + d.han_tt as ngay_tt0,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.line_nbr, d.han_tt as han_tt, a.ma_hd, a.status, a.tat_toan, a.tt, a.tt_nt, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.ten_hd' ELSE 'e.ten_hd2' END ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt20 a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct b with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtt d with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = d.ma_tt'
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' SET @q = @q + ' left join dmhd e with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = e.ma_hd'
	IF @BalanceView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk t on a.tk = t.tk left join #payment p on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @BalanceView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' and isnull(t.tk_cn, 1) <> 0 and isnull(case when a.ma_nt <> '''' then a.t_tt_nt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_qd else a.t_tt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_cn end, 1) > 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') OR @PrintType = 1) AND OBJECT_ID (N'hddt00$' + (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112) FROM dmstt), N'U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct into #hd FROM #report
		-- Dynamic
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t2', @filterKey OUTPUT
		SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #hd select stt_rec, so_ct_hddt from hddt00$%Partition a where %[exists (select 1 from #report b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)' + CASE WHEN @filterKey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateGLFrom, @DateGLTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF @PrintType = 1 UPDATE #report SET so_ct0 = b.so_ct FROM #report a JOIN #hd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		IF @filterKey <> '' BEGIN
			DELETE #report FROM #report a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hd b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
			DELETE #payment FROM #payment a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hd b WHERE a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec)
		END
	END
	SELECT stt_rec_tt AS stt_rec, t_tt_qd, t_tt_cn AS t_tt1 INTO #cttt FROM #payment WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #report)
	INSERT INTO #cttt SELECT stt_rec, 0, 0 FROM #report WHERE NOT stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt)

	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_qd = b.t_tt_qd + a.t_tt_qd0, t_tt1 = b.t_tt1 + ROUND(a.t_tt_qd0 * CASE a.ma_nt WHEN '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END, @nRound)
		FROM #report a JOIN #cttt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_qd WHERE ma_nt <> ''
	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_nt1 = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt_nt = t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1, con_pt = t_tt0 - t_tt1
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt_nt= 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt = 0, con_pt_nt = 0, t_tt1 = t_tt0, t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_nt0 WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 0)
	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, LEN(stt_rec) - 3) + ma_ct WHERE RIGHT(stt_rec, 3) <> ma_ct AND ma_ct <> ''
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh) VALUES (1, 1, 0, '')
	IF @ContractGroup = '0'
		SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, ma_kh, ten_kh, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt1, con_pt_nt, ty_gia, t_tt0, t_tt1, con_pt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, ma_vv, tk, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, '' AS ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, '' AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_kh, ngay_ct0, so_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, ma_kh, ten_kh, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt1, con_pt_nt, ty_gia, t_tt0, t_tt1, con_pt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, ma_vv, tk, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, ma_hd, ten_hd, CASE WHEN ma_hd = '' THEN '' ELSE ten_hd END AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_kh, ma_hd, ngay_ct0, so_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Key]
	@Action TINYINT, -- 1 - Loading, 2 - Finding
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),

	@PartitionTable VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionPrime VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionInquiry VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionField VARCHAR(32),
	@PrimaryFields VARCHAR(32),
	@Query VARCHAR(4000) = '', -- Ex: stt_rec when drilldowwn

	@Admin BIT,
	@UserID INT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,

	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32) = '',

	@AppType TINYINT = 0,
	@ProcessType TINYINT = 0,

	@Alias VARCHAR(32) = '',

	@Extension VARCHAR(1024),
/*
	@OrderType: 0 - Option, 1 - Asc, 2 - Desc
*/

	@Desc BIT OUTPUT,
	@ExtKey NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @OrderType CHAR(1)


/*
	Default
*/
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Extension = '' SELECT @OrderType = '0'



/*
	Order
*/
	IF ((@OrderType = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = 1)) OR @OrderType = 2) SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0



/*
	Delete Log
*/
	IF @Action = 1 BEGIN -- Loading
		IF @Query = '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = 1) BEGIN
			DECLARE @isStatus BIT
			SELECT @q = N'if exists(select 1 from syscolumns a join sysobjects b on a.id = b.id where b.name = ''' + @PartitionTable + ''' and a.name = ''status'') select @isStatus = 1 else select @isStatus = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@isStatus bit output', @isStatus OUTPUT
			IF @isStatus = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + N'status <> ''*'''
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @AppType = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = 1) BEGIN
			IF @Status = '-' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(' + @Alias + 'status = ''*'')'
				ELSE SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(' + @Alias + 'status <> ''*'')'
		END
	END


	-- Result
	SELECT @ExtKey = @Key



	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_BackupDatabase @cDatabase VARCHAR(128), @cFileName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQL = 'BACKUP DATABASE ' + @cDatabase + ' TO DISK = ' + CHAR(39) + @cFileName + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Partition$CheckExists]
	@condition NVARCHAR(4000),
	@dField VARCHAR(64),
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@partitionLimit BIT,
	@result BIT OUT,
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_gh1 SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_gh2 SMALLDATETIME, @m_so_thang_kt INT, @w NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @ngay_gh1 = ngay_gh1, @ngay_gh2 = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	SELECT @d1 = @dFrom, @d2 = @dTo

	IF @partitionLimit = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @m_so_thang_kt = ABS(CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_thang_kt'

		IF @d2 IS NULL OR @d2 > @ngay_gh2 SET @d2 = @ngay_gh2

		SET @d = DATEADD(MONTH, -@m_so_thang_kt, @d2)
		IF @d < @ngay_gh1 SET @d = @ngay_gh1

		IF @d1 IS NULL OR @d1 < @d SET @d1 = @d
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @d2 IS NULL OR @d2 > @ngay_gh2 SET @d2 = @ngay_gh2
		IF @d1 IS NULL OR @d1 < @ngay_gh1 SET @d1 = @ngay_gh1
	END

	SELECT @result = 0, @d1 = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d1, 112) + '01', @d2 = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d2, 112) + '01', @d = @d2
	WHILE @result = 0 AND @d >= @d1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@condition, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @d, 112)), '%[', '(('), @w = ''
		IF ISNULL(@dField, '') <> '' AND CHARINDEX(']%', @q) > 0 BEGIN
			IF @dFrom IS NOT NULL AND @dFrom > @d SET @w = @dField + ' >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''''
			IF @dTo IS NOT NULL AND @dTo < DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)) SET @w = @w + CASE WHEN @w <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @dField + ' <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''''
			IF @w <> '' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, ']%', ') and (' + @w + '))')
				ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, ']%', '))')
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, ']%', '))')
		END

		SET @q = 'if ' + @q + ' set @r = 1 else set @r = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r bit out', @result out
		IF @result = 1 RETURN
		--
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @d)
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptProfitabilityByCustomer2] -- fs20_SOSalesByItem
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ContactID AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tl'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct
			, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap, tien2 AS tien2, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2, tien_xuat AS tien_xuat, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_x
			, ck AS ck, ck_nt AS ck_nt, tien_nhap AS tien_nhap, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt_n
		INTO #temp
		FROM wrkin a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = ''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = ' ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @SalesAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @SalesAccount)
	IF @ContactID <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContactID), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @Group <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @Group + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh '
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(sl_xuat) as sl_xuat, sum(sl_nhap) as sl_nhap'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien2) as tien2, case when a.ma_nt = '''' then 0 else sum(tien_nt2) end as tien_nt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien_xuat) as tien_xuat, case when a.ma_nt = '''' then 0 else sum(tien_nt_x) end as tien_nt_x'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(ck) as ck, case when a.ma_nt = '''' then 0 else sum(ck_nt) end as ck_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien_nhap) as tien_nhap, case when a.ma_nt = '''' then 0 else sum(tien_nt_n) end as tien_nt_n'

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct, a.ma_nt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct, a.ma_nt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT 0 AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ma_kh
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, MAX(nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_ban, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_so_luong
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt0
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt1
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ck, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ck_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien3, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt3
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien4, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt4
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ck_tl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ck_tl_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien_nt0
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien_nt1
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS t_tien_nt2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le2
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le12, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le22
		INTO #report
		FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	--UDAPTE
	UPDATE #report SET sl_ban = b.sl_xuat, tien3 = b.tien_xuat, tien_nt3 = b.tien_nt_x, ck = b.ck, ck_nt = b.ck_nt
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat, SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ck) AS ck, SUM(ck_nt) AS ck_nt
					FROM #temp WHERE nxt = 2 GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	--Doanh thu ban
	UPDATE #report SET tien0 = b.tien2, tien_nt0 = b.tien_nt2
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2
					FROM #temp WHERE nxt = 2 AND RTRIM(ma_ct) <> 'HD2' AND NOT (RTRIM(ma_ct) = 'HD4' AND RTRIM(loai_ct) = '1') GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
	--Tra lai
	UPDATE #report SET sl_tl = b.sl_nhap, tien1 = b.tien2, tien_nt1 = b.tien_nt2, tien4 = b.tien_nhap, tien_nt4 = b.tien_nt_n, ck_tl = b.ck_tl, ck_tl_nt = b.ck_tl_nt
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(ck) AS ck_tl, SUM(ck_nt) AS ck_tl_nt
					FROM #temp WHERE nxt = 1 GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	--Giam gia
	UPDATE #report SET tien2 = - b.tien2, tien_nt2 = - b.tien_nt2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2 FROM #temp WHERE RTRIM(ma_ct) = 'HD2' OR (RTRIM(ma_ct) = 'HD4' AND RTRIM(loai_ct) = '1') GROUP BY ma_kh) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	DECLARE @sl_ban NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	, @tien1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien3 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt3 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien4 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt4 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	, @ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	, @t_tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6)

	UPDATE #report SET @sl_ban = ISNULL(sl_ban, 0), @sl_tl = ISNULL(sl_tl, 0), @tien0 = ISNULL(tien0, 0), @tien_nt0 = ISNULL(tien_nt0, 0), @tien1 = ISNULL(tien1, 0), @tien_nt1 = ISNULL(tien_nt1, 0)
		,@tien2 = ISNULL(tien2, 0), @tien_nt2 = ISNULL(tien_nt2, 0), @tien3= ISNULL(tien3, 0), @tien_nt3 = ISNULL(tien_nt3, 0), @tien4 = ISNULL(tien4, 0), @tien_nt4 = ISNULL(tien_nt4, 0), @ck = ISNULL(ck, 0), @ck_nt = ISNULL(ck_nt, 0), @ck_tl = ISNULL(ck_tl, 0), @ck_tl_nt = ISNULL(ck_tl_nt, 0)
		, @t_tien0 = @tien0 - @tien1 - @ck - @tien2 + @ck_tl, @t_tien_nt0 = @tien_nt0 - @tien_nt1 - @ck_nt - @tien_nt2 + @ck_tl_nt
		, @t_tien1 = @tien3 - @tien4, @t_tien_nt1 = @tien_nt3 - @tien_nt4
		, @t_tien2 = @t_tien0 - @t_tien1, @t_tien_nt2 = @t_tien_nt0 - @t_tien_nt1
		, t_so_luong = @sl_ban - @sl_tl
		, t_tien0 = @t_tien0, t_tien_nt0 = @t_tien_nt0
		, t_tien1 = @t_tien1, t_tien_nt1 = @t_tien_nt1
		, t_tien2 = @t_tien2, t_tien_nt2 = @t_tien_nt2
		, ty_le1 = CASE WHEN @t_tien0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@t_tien2*100/@t_tien0, @nRound) END
		, ty_le12 = CASE WHEN @t_tien_nt0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@t_tien_nt2*100/@t_tien_nt0, @nRound) END
		, ty_le2 = CASE WHEN @t_tien1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@t_tien2*100/@t_tien1, @nRound) END
		, ty_le22 = CASE WHEN @t_tien_nt1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@t_tien_nt2*100/@t_tien_nt1, @nRound) END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Groups + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @Groups <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups , 'kh',
			'sl_ban, sl_tl, tien0, tien_nt0, tien1, tien_nt1, ck, ck_nt, ck_tl, ck_tl_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, tien3, tien_nt3, tien4, tien_nt4, t_so_luong, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_tien1, t_tien_nt1, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2',
			'#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2 , sl_ban, sl_tl, t_so_luong, tien0, tien_nt0, tien1, tien_nt1, ck, ck_nt, ck_tl, ck_tl_nt,'
		SET @q = @q + 'tien2, tien_nt2, tien3, tien_nt3, tien4, tien_nt4, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_tien1, t_tien_nt1, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, ty_le1, ty_le2, ty_le12, ty_le22'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, sl_ban, sl_tl, t_so_luong, tien0, tien_nt0, tien1, tien_nt1, ck, ck_nt, ck_tl, ck_tl_nt,'
		SET @q = @q + 'tien2, tien_nt2, tien3, tien_nt3, tien4, tien_nt4, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_tien1, t_tien_nt1, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, ty_le1, ty_le2, ty_le12, ty_le22'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups , 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem](@Table VARCHAR(16), @ItemField VARCHAR(16), @Type CHAR(1))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_002' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		RETURN '--'
	END

	DECLARE @Return NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Type = 0
		SELECT @Return = '--'
	ELSE
		SET @Return = 'delete ' + @Table + ' where ' + @ItemField + ' in (select ma_vt from dmvt with(nolock) where vt_ton_kho = 0)'

	RETURN @Return
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintIPTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.ma_nx, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt'
									WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report ' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#visibleFieldPrint') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Report$VisibleFieldSetting ''#report'',''rs_PrintIPTran'''
	END

	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 11, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFAReappraisalReportExport] --fs20_FAReEvaluate_Detail
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@FACode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xkey INTO #t
	
	IF @FACode = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @FACode = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select so_the_ts + cast(max(nam * 12 + ky) as varchar(128)) from ctkhts where nam * 12 + ky <= ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Month) + ' and '
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @FACode <> '' THEN 'so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FACode, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'select identity(int, 1,1) as stt, a.so_the_ts, sum(a.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh, sum(a.gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt, sum(a.gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(a.gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.so_hieu_ts) as so_hieu_ts, max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END + ') as ten_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + '	into #report from ctkhts a left join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.so_the_ts + cast((a.nam*12 + a.ky) as varchar(128)) in (select xkey from #t) group by a.so_the_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.so_the_ts'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, * from #report order by stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrpnbp] AS
SELECT *, SPACE(2 * (CASE WHEN bac_pn > 0 THEN bac_pn - 1 ELSE 0 END)) + ten_pn AS ten, 
		SPACE(2 * (CASE WHEN bac_pn > 0 THEN bac_pn - 1 ELSE 0 END)) + ten_pn2 AS ten2
	FROM  dbo.hrpnbp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostS1Tran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@rawTable VARCHAR(16),
	@wasteTable VARCHAR(16),
	@machineTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @loai_ct VARCHAR(2), @ma_lsx VARCHAR(32), @so_lsx VARCHAR(32), @ma_sp VARCHAR(32), @ma_cd VARCHAR(32), @ma_cd0 VARCHAR(32), @ma_cd2 VARCHAR(32), @cd_sau VARCHAR(32), @ma_lt VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_vt VARCHAR(32), @dvt NVARCHAR(32), @userID INT, @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @auto TINYINT, @tqty NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@ma_ccv VARCHAR(32), @ma_bp VARCHAR(32), @td_chuyen TINYINT, @td_chuyen0 TINYINT, @dung_kt TINYINT, @nk_yn TINYINT, @xk_yn TINYINT, @nhap_sl TINYINT, @tl_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tl_kt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @rq TINYINT, @p VARCHAR(6), @ma_px VARCHAR(32), @ma_kho VARCHAR(32), @ma_khox VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @maxLineD INT, @maxSttD CHAR(3), @rcIDNumber CHAR(13), @rVCCode CHAR(3), @ma_nx VARCHAR(32), @doi_tac NVARCHAR(24), @dien_giai NVARCHAR(256)

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @p = RIGHT(@masterTable, 6), @maxLineD = 0, @ma_kho = '', @auto = 0

	SELECT a.* INTO #ms1 FROM ms1$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.so_luong AS sl_nhap1, nh_nc AS ma_nh INTO #ds1 FROM ds1$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.sl_tn AS sl_xuat1, a.sl_tn AS sl_nhap1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS loai INTO #es1 FROM es1$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #fs1 FROM fs1$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gs1 FROM gs1$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #ms1 select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_ct = ma_ct, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @ma_lsx = ma_lsx, @ma_cd = ma_cd, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_px = ma_px, @dien_giai = ghi_chu, @userID = user_id2 FROM #ms1
	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_lt = ma_lo_trinh FROM sfctwo WHERE ma_lsx = @ma_lsx
	SELECT TOP 1 @dung_kt = a.dung_kt, @td_chuyen = a.td_chuyen, @nk_yn = nk_yn, @xk_yn = xk_yn, @cd_sau = a.cd_sau, @ma_ccv = a.ma_ccv FROM ctrt a WHERE a.ma_cd = @ma_cd AND a.ma_lo_trinh = @ma_lt


	SET @q = 'insert into #ds1 select *, so_luong, nh_nc from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #es1 select *, sl_tn, sl_tn, ' + CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '04' THEN 'case when rework = 1 then ''30'' else '''' end' ELSE '''''' END + ' from ' + @rawTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #fs1 select * from ' + @wasteTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #gs1 select * from ' + @machineTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #es1 SET tl_kt = 100 WHERE ISNULL(tl_kt, 0) = 0

	-- 1. Post nhập xuất tồn
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, * INTO #sfpost FROM #sfctpx

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds1', '#sfctpx', '#ds1', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms1', '#ds1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', 'tg_bd = convert(char(8), b.ngay_ct, 112) + space(1) + b.gio_bd, tg_kt = convert(char(8), b.ngay_ct, 112) + space(1) + b.gio_kt'

	UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 1, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', xtab = 1,
		sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, sl_lech = 0, sl_lech1 = 0,
		loai = CASE WHEN @dung_kt = 1 THEN '20' ELSE '' END

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', '#sfctpx', '#sfpost', '#sfctpx', null, null)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- 1. Tự động chuyển
	IF @td_chuyen = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @nhap_sl = a.nhap_sl, @tl_kt = tl_kt FROM ctrt a WHERE a.ma_cd = @cd_sau AND a.ma_lo_trinh = @ma_lt
		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctnvl FROM sfctnvl$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		IF @nhap_sl = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctnvl', '#ds1', '#sfctnvl', '#ds1', NULL, NULL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctnvl', '#ms1', '#ds1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

			UPDATE #sfctnvl SET ma_pxn = ma_px, ma_lsxn = ma_lsx, ma_cdn = @cd_sau, so_luong1 = ROUND(so_luong*@tl_kt/100, @rq), so_luong = ROUND(so_luong*he_so*@tl_kt/100, @rq), tl_kt = @tl_kt

			SET @q = 'insert into sfctnvl$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctnvl'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END	ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @c INT
			SELECT TOP 0 *, sl_nhap AS sl_btp INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_cd, nhap_sl, td_chuyen, tl_kt, tl_kt2, ma_vt, dvt, nk_yn INTO #ctrtctwo FROM ctrt

			SELECT @ma_cd0 = @ma_cd, @td_chuyen0 = @td_chuyen
			INSERT INTO #ctrtctwo (ma_cd, nhap_sl, td_chuyen, tl_kt, tl_kt2, ma_vt, dvt, nk_yn)
				SELECT a.ma_cd, b.nhap_sl, b.td_chuyen, b.tl_kt, b.tl_kt2, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.nk_yn
					FROM sfctwo a JOIN ctrt b ON a.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
					WHERE a.ma_lsx = @ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd > @ma_cd

			DECLARE crOpr CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_cd, nhap_sl, td_chuyen, tl_kt, tl_kt2, ma_vt, dvt, nk_yn FROM #ctrtctwo ORDER BY ma_cd
			OPEN crOpr
			FETCH NEXT FROM crOpr INTO @ma_cd2, @nhap_sl, @td_chuyen, @tl_kt, @tl_kt2, @ma_vt, @dvt, @nk_yn
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				IF @nhap_sl = 1 BEGIN
					IF @td_chuyen0 = 1 BEGIN
						IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sfctpx0) INSERT INTO #sfctpx0 SELECT *, 0 FROM #sfctpx

						SELECT *, sl_nhap1 AS so_luong1, sl_nhap AS so_luong INTO #nvl FROM #sfctpx0

						SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctnvl', '#nvl', '#sfctnvl', '#nvl', NULL, NULL)
						EXEC sp_executesql @q

						UPDATE #sfctnvl SET ma_pxn = ma_px, ma_lsxn = ma_lsx, ma_cd = @ma_cd0, ma_cdn = @ma_cd2, so_luong1 = ROUND(so_luong1*@tl_kt/100, @rq), so_luong = ROUND(so_luong*@tl_kt/100, @rq), tl_kt = @tl_kt

						SET @q = 'insert into sfctnvl$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctnvl'
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END

					BREAK -- Stop
				END

				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sfctpx0) INSERT INTO #sfctpx0 SELECT *, 0 FROM #sfctpx

				UPDATE #sfctpx0 SET ct_dc = 1, nxt = 2, ma_cd = @ma_cd0, xtab = 1, sl_xuat1 = sl_nhap1, sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_btp = sl_nhap1, sl_nhap = 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_lech = 0, sl_lech1 = 0
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', '#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #sfctpx0 SET nxt = 1, ma_cd = @ma_cd2, sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_xuat*@tl_kt/100, @rq), sl_nhap1 = ROUND(sl_xuat1*@tl_kt/100, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', '#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #sfctpx0 SET ct_dc = 0, nxt = 2, ma_cd = @ma_cd2, sl_xuat = sl_nhap, sl_xuat1 = sl_nhap1, sl_lech1 = ROUND((100 - @tl_kt)*sl_nhap1/CASE WHEN @tl_kt <> 0 THEN @tl_kt ELSE 1 END, @rq), sl_lech = ROUND((100 - @tl_kt)*sl_nhap/CASE WHEN @tl_kt <> 0 THEN @tl_kt ELSE 1 END, @rq), sl_nhap = 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, xtab = 2
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', '#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #sfctpx0 SET nxt = 1, ma_vt = @ma_vt, sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_btp*he_so*@tl_kt2/100, @rq), sl_nhap1 = ROUND(sl_btp*@tl_kt2/100, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, xtab = 1, sl_lech = 0, sl_lech1 = 0
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', '#sfpost', '#sfctpx0', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				IF @td_chuyen = 0 BEGIN
					IF @nk_yn = 1 SET @auto = 1
					BREAK -- Stop
				END

				SELECT @ma_cd0 = @ma_cd2, @td_chuyen0 = @td_chuyen
				FETCH NEXT FROM crOpr INTO @ma_cd2, @nhap_sl, @td_chuyen, @tl_kt, @tl_kt2, @ma_vt, @dvt, @nk_yn
			END
			CLOSE crOpr
			DEALLOCATE crOpr
		END
	END



	-- 2. Tự động nhập kho
	IF @nk_yn = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds1) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @so_lsx = so_lsx, @ma_sp = ma_sp FROM cs2$000000 WHERE ma_lsx = @ma_lsx
		DECLARE @so_lsx2 VARCHAR(33)
		SELECT @so_lsx2 = SPACE(dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct') - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@so_lsx)))) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@so_lsx))
		SELECT TOP 1 @ma_kho = ma_kho FROM ctsx WHERE so_ct = @so_lsx2 AND ma_vt = @ma_sp
		SELECT TOP 1 @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_nx = ma_nx FROM sfctnx WHERE status = '1' AND kind = '1' AND ma_ct = @ma_ct AND loai_ct = @loai_ct AND ma_px = @ma_px
		IF @auto = 1 SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ccv = a.ma_ccv FROM ctrt a WHERE a.ma_cd = @ma_cd2 AND a.ma_lo_trinh = @ma_lt
		SELECT TOP 1 @ma_bp = ma_bp FROM sfdmcumcv WHERE ma_ccv = @ma_ccv
		SELECT TOP 1 @doi_tac = doi_tac FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @ma_kh

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_kho = @ma_kho AND status = '1') BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID AND ma_kho = @ma_kho) BEGIN

				-- Post PNH
				SELECT @rVCCode = 'PNH', @ma_kh = ISNULL(@ma_kh, ''), @ma_nx = ISNULL(@ma_nx, '')
				SELECT @rcIDNumber = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + @rVCCode

				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #m34 FROM m34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #d34 FROM d34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #i34 FROM i34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#m34', '#ms1', '#m34', '#ms1', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#d34', '#ds1', '#d34', '#ds1', null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #m34 SET ma_ct = @rVCCode, stt_rec = @rcIDNumber, loai_ct = '2', ma_gd = '4', ngay_lct = ngay_ct, so_lo = '', ma_nt = @baseCurrency, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ty_gia = 1, ong_ba = @doi_tac, dien_giai = @dien_giai, t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien = 0, status = 0
				IF @auto = 1 UPDATE #d34 SET ma_vt = b.ma_vt, dvt = b.dvt, he_so = b.he_so, so_luong = b.sl_nhap1 FROM #d34 a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
				UPDATE #d34 SET ma_ct = @rVCCode, stt_rec = @rcIDNumber, ma_sp = '', ma_bp = @ma_bp, so_lsx = @so_lsx, ma_kho = @ma_kho, ma_vi_tri = '', ma_vv = '', ma_nx = @ma_nx, tk_du = '', tk_vt = '', gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, tien = 0, tien_nt = 0, sl_ss = 0, pn_gia_tb = 0, stt_rec_px = '', stt_rec0px = '', ma_hd = '', ma_ku = '', ma_phi = '', so_dh_i = ''
				UPDATE #d34 SET tk_vt = b.tk_vt, tk_du = c.tk FROM #d34 a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN dmnx c ON a.ma_nx = c.ma_nx



				INSERT INTO #i34 SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec, '#10$' + RTRIM(ma_kh) + '#20$2#30$' + ma_nt, '', '' FROM #m34
				SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i34', '#d34', 'd$', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, tk_vt, ma_nx', '#10$, #20$, #30$, #40$', 'stt_rec', default, default, @rVCCode, 'e$', 1)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @q = 'delete d34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete m34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete i34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete c34$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @q = 'insert into m34$' + @p + ' select * from #m34'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into d34$' + @p + ' select * from #d34'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into c34$000000 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0 from #m34'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into i34$' + @p + ' select * from #i34'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q


				-- Xuất xưởng
				IF @auto = 1 UPDATE #sfctpx0 SET nxt = 2, ma_kho = @ma_kho, sl_xuat1 = sl_nhap1, xtab = 1, sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_nhap = 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, sl_lech = 0, sl_lech1 = 0

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfpost', CASE WHEN @auto = 1 THEN '#sfctpx0' ELSE '#sfctpx' END, '#sfpost', CASE WHEN @auto = 1 THEN '#sfctpx0' ELSE '#sfctpx' END, null, null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

	-- 3. Tự động xuất kho
	IF @xk_yn = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #es1 WHERE ma_px = '' AND ma_lsx = '' AND ma_cd = '') BEGIN

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_kho = @ma_khox AND status = '1') BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID AND ma_kho = @ma_khox) BEGIN

				SELECT @rcIDNumber = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + @rVCCode

				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #m38 FROM m38$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #d38 FROM d38$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
				SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #i38 FROM i38$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#m38', '#ms1', '#m38', '#ms1', null, null)

				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#d38', '#es1', '#d38', '#es1', 'ma_px = '''' and ma_lsx = '''' and ma_cd = ''''', null)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#d38', '#ms1', '#es1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

				UPDATE #d38 SET ma_ct = @rVCCode, stt_rec = @rcIDNumber, ma_sp = @ma_sp, ma_bp = @ma_bp, so_lsx = @so_lsx, ma_kho = @ma_khox, ma_vi_tri = '', ma_vv = '', ma_nx = @ma_nx, tk_du = '', tk_vt = '', gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, tien = 0, tien_nt = 0, sl_ss = 0, px_gia_dd = 0, stt_rec_pn = '', stt_rec0pn = '', ma_hd = '', ma_ku = '', ma_phi = '', so_dh_i = ''
				UPDATE #d38 SET tk_vt = b.tk_vt, tk_du = c.tk FROM #d38 a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN dmnx c ON a.ma_nx = c.ma_nx
				UPDATE #d38 SET so_luong = b.sl_sd FROM #d38 a JOIN #es1 b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

				INSERT INTO #i38 SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec, '#10$' + RTRIM(ma_kh) + '#20$2#30$' + ma_nt, '', '' FROM #m38
				SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i38', '#d38', 'd$', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, tk_vt, ma_nx', '#10$, #20$, #30$, #40$', 'stt_rec', default, default, @rVCCode, 'e$', 1)

				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete c38$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @q = 'insert into m38$' + @p + ' select * from #m38'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into d38$' + @p + ' select * from #d38'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into c38$000000 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0 from #m38'
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into i38$' + @p + ' select * from #i38'

	-- 3. Chờ kiểm định

	-- 4. Xuất NVL (Note: trường hợp rework đã cập nhật loai = '30')
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #es1 WHERE ma_cd <> '') BEGIN

			sl_xuat = ROUND(a.sl_xuat1*a.he_so*100/b.tl_kt, @rq), sl_xuat1 = ROUND(a.sl_xuat1*100/b.tl_kt, @rq), sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, loai = ISNULL(a.loai, ''), xtab = 1
			FROM #sfctpx a JOIN #es1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

			sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, loai = ISNULL(loai, ''), xtab = 0
