CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MPSRunPlanOrder] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @nMPSRunType TINYINT, @userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @cDefaultPeriod = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'
	
	-- DELETE mpctyc WHERE nguon IN ('PL', 'FP') AND xac_nhan = 0
	--
	DELETE mpctyc WHERE status = '*'
	IF @nMPSRunType = 0 DELETE mpctyc WHERE nguon = 'PL'
	UPDATE mpctyc SET ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct
	--UPDATE mpctyc SET ngay_ct0 = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct), 0) 
	--
	DECLARE @cItem VARCHAR(33), @dPeriod SMALLDATETIME, @nOver INTEGER, @Id INT, @nMaxCout INT
	SELECT @nMaxCout = 30
	--
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt, CAST(1 AS NUMERIC(16)) AS stt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tinh INTO #mpsp FROM mpctyc
	INSERT INTO #mpsp (ma_vt, stt, tinh) SELECT a.ma_vt, 1, 0 FROM dmvt a WHERE a.kieu_hd <> 0 AND a.loai_vt = '41' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mpsp b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)

	SELECT * INTO #mB FROM phdm
	SELECT * INTO #dB FROM ctdm

	SET @nOver = 1
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mpsp WHERE tinh = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @nOver = @nOver + 1
		IF  @nOver > @nMaxCout BREAK

		DECLARE crCalc CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_vt FROM #mpsp WHERE tinh = 0
		OPEN crCalc
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCalc INTO @cItem
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dB a JOIN #mB b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_sp = @cItem AND a.ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #mpsp WHERE tinh = 0))  BEGIN
				SELECT @Id  = SUM(stt) FROM #mpsp WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT a.ma_vt FROM #dB a JOIN #mB b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_sp = @cItem)
				SELECT @Id = ISNULL(@Id, 0)
				UPDATE #mpsp SET stt = @Id + 1, tinh = 1 WHERE ma_vt = @cItem
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM crCalc INTO @cItem
		END
		CLOSE crCalc
		DEALLOCATE crCalc
	END



	DECLARE crItems CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_vt FROM #mpsp ORDER BY stt DESC, ma_vt
	OPEN crItems
	FETCH NEXT FROM crItems INTO @cItem
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ngay_ct0 > @dNow AND nxt = 2) BEGIN
			DECLARE crDate CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct0 FROM mpctyc WHERE ma_vt = @cItem AND ngay_ct0 > @dNow AND nxt = 2 ORDER BY ngay_ct0
			OPEN crDate
			FETCH NEXT FROM crDate INTO @dPeriod
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					EXEC rs_MPSRunPlanOrderInPeriod @cItem, @dNow, @dPeriod, @userID
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crDate INTO @dPeriod
				END
			CLOSE crDate
			DEALLOCATE crDate
		END ELSE EXEC rs_MPSRunPlanOrderInPeriod @cItem, @dNow, @dNow, @userID
		--
		EXEC rs_MPSRunSemiPrdRequisition @cItem, @userID

		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM crItems INTO @cItem
	END
	CLOSE crItems
	DEALLOCATE crItems			
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetWordCountEx(@strString NVARCHAR(4000))
RETURNS INT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nReturn INT
	SET  @nStart = 1; SET  @nReturn = 0
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) = ''	RETURN 0
	SET @strString = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) + ';'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(';', @strString,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @nReturn = @nReturn + 1
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(';', @strString,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN @nReturn
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_CreateNotifyBISATran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Process Info
	DECLARE @processType VARCHAR(32), @columnBottom VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @processType = '', @columnBottom = '5'
	SELECT TOP 1 @processType = xtype FROM bia06$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	IF @processType = '3' SET @columnBottom = '6'
	
	-- Get Data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM bim06$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM bid06$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số hợp đồng', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Nhà cung cấp', N'Supplier', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vt', 100, '', '', N'Mã hàng', N'Item', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vt', 300, '', '', N'Tên mặt hàng', N'Item Description', 'ten_vt', 'ten_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dvt', 50, '', '', N'Đvt', N'UOM', 'dvt', 'dvt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'sl_nhap', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng nhập', N'Receipt Quantity', 'sl_nhap', 'sl_nhap', 0 WHERE @processType = '3'
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'gia', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Đơn giá', N'Price', 'gia', 'gia', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Thành tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, RTRIM(a.dvt) AS dvt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.gia_nt0, @priceFormat) AS gia,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt0, @amountFormat) AS tien,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.sl_nhap, @quantityFormat) AS sl_nhap
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Tiền hàng', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt0, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Chi phí', N'Charges', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_cp_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Tổng tiền', N'Total Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01255', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01255', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', nhà cung cấp: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Supplier: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Hợp đồng mua hàng chờ duyệt'', N''Schedule agreement waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Hợp đồng mua hàng chờ duyệt'', N''Schedule agreement waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt hợp đồng mua hàng'', N''Schedule agreement approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt hợp đồng mua hàng'', N''Schedule agreement approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
