CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll010]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Bank VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@isUnicode TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ds_loai_luong VARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @ds_loai_luong = RTRIM(ds_loai_luong) FROM hrPayroll003 WHERE ma_bc = 'PAY10'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'z', 'z', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_loai_lg in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@ds_loai_luong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.tk_nh <> '''''
	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department0), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Employee <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nv = @Employee
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@IDNumber) + ''''
	END
	IF @Bank <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Bank), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'y.')
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department0 + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp z on a.ma_bp0 = z.ma_bp'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp y with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = y.ma_bp'

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, a.gt AS tien, a.gt_nt AS tien_nt
			, b.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv, c.tk_nh, c.ma_nh, c.ngan_hang
		INTO #report FROM hrluongth$000000 a, hrnv b, hrttluong c

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, tien, tien_nt, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, tk_nh, ma_nh, ngan_hang)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, sum(gt), sum(gt_nt), b.ma_nv, rtrim(max(b.ho_nv)) + space(1) + max(b.ten_nv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(c.tk_nh), max(c.ma_nh), max(c.ngan_hang)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrluongth$' + RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hrttluong c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, b.stt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt, b.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @isUnicode = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ho_ten_nv = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Message$ConvertToUnsign(ho_ten_nv)
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 0, 0, '', SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '', @Total, '', '', '' FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 0, 0, '', 0, 0, '', '', '', '', ''

	-- Result
	SELECT stt_rec, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN sysorder = 5 THEN stt ELSE NULL END AS stt
			, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv
			, tk_nh, CASE WHEN a.ma_nh <> '' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_nh ELSE b.ten_nh2 END ELSE a.ngan_hang END AS ngan_hang
			, tien, tien_nt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmnh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh = b.ma_nh
		ORDER BY sysorder, stt
	
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptProvisionalCorporationTax] --fs20_Tax01_28
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Form VARCHAR(24),
	@Addition TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_co INTO #tk_co
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_no INTO #tk_no
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #tax01_28 FROM tax01_28 WHERE form = @Form

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#tax01_28', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_co VARCHAR(1023), @Giam_tru TINYINT, @Tk_kqkd  VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Tk_no, Tk_co, Giam_tru FROM #tax01_28 WHERE Cach_tinh = '' AND tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	SELECT @Tk_kqkd = (RTRIM(val) + '%') FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_TK_KQKD'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		--
		SELECT @Tk_no = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Tk_co = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_no
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_co

		INSERT INTO #tk_no SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_no, ',')
		INSERT INTO #tk_co SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_co, ',')
		--
		IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(ps), @Tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT a.ps_co AS ps, a.ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_co b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co)
					UNION ALL
					SELECT - a.ps_no, - a.ps_no_nt FROM #ct00 a WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND a.tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_co b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co)
					) a
		END

		IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(ps), @Tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT a.ps_no AS ps, a.ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_no b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no)
					UNION ALL
					SELECT - a.ps_co, - a.ps_co_nt FROM #ct00 a WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND a.tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_no b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no)
					) a
		END

		IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(a.ps_no), @Tien_nt = SUM(a.ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00 a WHERE a.ps_no <> 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_no b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_co c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_co)
		END

		UPDATE #tax01_28 SET Tien = @Tien, Tien_nt = @Tien_nt WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 4 Manual Data
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#tax01_28', 'tien', '1', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#tax01_28', 'tien_nt', '2', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #tax01_28 SET Tien = ISNULL(Tien, 0), Tien_nt = ISNULL(Tien_nt, 0)

	-- Begin Adjust
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SET @d1 = CASE WHEN @DateFrom <> dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateFrom), YEAR(@DateFrom)) THEN DATEADD(month, 1, @DateFrom) ELSE @DateFrom END
	SET @d2 = CASE WHEN @DateTo <> dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateTo), YEAR(@DateTo)) THEN DATEADD(month, -1, @DateTo) ELSE @DateTo END
	--
	SET @Key = 'b.cach_tinh = '''' and nam * 12 + ky between ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@d1) * 12 + MONTH(@d1)) + ' and ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@d2) * 12 + MONTH(@d2))
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS ky, b.tk_no, b.tk_co, b.giam_tru, a.tien, a.tien_nt INTO #s1 FROM tax0128_luu a JOIN #tax01_28 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
	SET @q = 'insert into #s1 select a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, (rtrim(a.nam) + replace(str(a.ky, 2), '' '', ''0'')) as ky, b.tk_no, b.tk_co, b.giam_tru, a.tien, a.tien_nt from tax0128_luu a join #tax01_28 b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #s1) BEGIN
		DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @Ky VARCHAR(6)
		CREATE TABLE #ps (ps NUMERIC(28, 6), ps_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))

		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT RTRIM(Ma_so), RTRIM(ma_dvcs), ky, MAX(Tk_no), MAX(Tk_co), MAX(Giam_tru) FROM #s1 WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> '' GROUP BY ma_so, ma_dvcs, ky
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @Ky, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @tien = 0, @tien_nt = 0
			SELECT @Ma_dvcs = REPLACE(@Ma_dvcs, '''', ''''''), @Tk_no = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Tk_co = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), @Tk_kqkd = REPLACE(@Tk_kqkd, '''', '''''')

			IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #ps
				TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_co
				INSERT INTO #tk_co SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_co, ',')

				SET @q = 'insert into #ps select sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' a with(nolock) where a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_co b where a.tk like b.tk_co)'
				IF @Giam_tru = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ps select -sum(a.ps_no), -sum(a.ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' a with(nolock) where a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and a.tk_du not like ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_kqkd) + ''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_co b where a.tk like b.tk_co)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)FROM #ps
				UPDATE #tax01_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END

			IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #ps
				TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_no
				INSERT INTO #tk_no SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_no, ',')

				SET @q = 'insert into #ps select sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' a with(nolock) where a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_no b where a.tk like b.tk_no)'
				IF @Giam_tru = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ps select -sum(a.ps_co), -sum(a.ps_co_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' a with(nolock) where a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and a.tk_du not like ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_kqkd) + ''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_no b where a.tk like b.tk_no)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)FROM #ps
				UPDATE #tax01_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END

			IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_no
				TRUNCATE TABLE #tk_co

				INSERT INTO #tk_no SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_no, ',')
				INSERT INTO #tk_co SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_co, ',')

				SELECT @q = 'select @tien = sum(a.ps_no), @tien_nt = sum(a.ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' a with(nolock) where a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and a.ps_no <> 0 and exists(select 1 from #tk_no b where a.tk like b.tk_no) and exists(select 1 from #tk_co b where a.tk_du like b.tk_co)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tien NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT, @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT', @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
				UPDATE #tax01_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END

			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @Ky, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
		END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR

		--
		SET @q = 'select ma_so, sum(tien) as tien, sum(tien_nt) as tien_nt into #s2 from #s1 group by ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #tax01_28 set tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt from #tax01_28 a join #s2 b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	-- End Adjust

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #tax01_28 WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')

		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tax01_28 SET Tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Tien) FROM #tax01_28 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tax01_28 SET Tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Tien_nt) FROM #tax01_28 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	SELECT stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, stt_in, ma_so, tien, tien_nt, @Addition as bo_sung, bold
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN chi_tieu2 ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu2
			, CASE WHEN cach_tinh <> '' THEN '0' WHEN tk_no + tk_co <> '' THEN '1' ELSE '9' END AS kind
		FROM #tax01_28 ORDER BY stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
    SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintMRTran] ---[rs_PrintSOTran]----
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table CHAR(10), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3), 
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	--IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.ngay_yc, b.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt, b.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @DetailKey + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'',''ngay_yc, so_luong'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2HandoverReportExport]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@code VARCHAR(4000),
	@dept VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @key NVARCHAR(4000), @keyDept NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = '', @key = '', @keyDept = ''

	IF @code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @code <> '' THEN 'a.ma_dc in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@code, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.ma_dc) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	IF @dept <> '' SET @keyDept = ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@dept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
	SET @keyDept = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@keyDept)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_dc, b.so_hieu_dc
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
			, b.ten_dc, b.so_ky_pb AS tl_pb, b.nam_sx
			, b.nuoc_sx, b.ts_kt AS cong_suat, SPACE(16) AS qc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(4)) AS nam_sd
			, c.line_nbr, c.ten_pt, c.dvt, c.so_luong, c.gia_tri, c.gia_tri_nt, 0 AS type
		INTO #report
		FROM ctcddc a, dmccdc b, dmdcpt c


	SET @q = 'insert into #report
 select 5, 1, 0, 1, a.ma_dc, max(b.so_hieu_dc)
, sum(a.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt
, sum(a.gt_da_pb), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt), sum(a.gt_cl), sum(a.gt_cl_nt), max(b.ten_dc%l)
, case when max(b.so_ky_pb) = 0 then 0 else 1200 / max(b.so_ky_pb) end, max(b.nam_sx)
, max(b.nuoc_sx), max(b.ts_kt), space(16), cast(max(year(b.ngay_sd)) as numeric(4))
, 0, '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, 0
 from ctcddc a with(nolock) left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
 left join dmbpcc c on a.ma_bp_dc = c.ma_bp
 where ' + @key + @keyDept + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' group by a.ma_dc'

	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET @q = 'insert into #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, line_nbr, ten_pt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, type)
 select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, a.line_nbr, a.ten_pt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_tri, a.gia_tri_nt, 1
 from dmdcpt a with(nolock)
 where ma_dc in (select distinct ma_dc from #report) ' + @keyDept + ' order by line_nbr'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, type)
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, 2, ma_dc, 1
			FROM #report WHERE type = 0 AND ma_dc NOT IN (SELECT ma_dc FROM #report WHERE type = 1)

	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_dc', 'type, ma_dc, line_nbr', '#report', 'stt', 'type = 1 and line_nbr is not null'
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ma_dc, stt, line_nbr

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTSDecrease] @idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @tsCode VARCHAR(33), @tsDept VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @dDecrease SMALLDATETIME, @So_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), @gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @cKey VARCHAR(1024), @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nYPrev INT, @nMPrev INT

	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT * INTO #gpbdc FROM gpbdc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT TOP 1 @tsCode = ma_dc, @tsDept = ma_bp_dc, @dDecrease = ngay_ct, @So_luong = so_luong, @cKey = CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(so_ct) + RTRIM(@idNumber) FROM #gpbdc

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmccdc WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_nt = (SELECT val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0')) SELECT @nFCRound = @nRound


	IF MONTH(@dDecrease) = 1 SELECT @nMPrev = 12, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dDecrease) - 1
		ELSE SELECT @nMPrev = MONTH(@dDecrease) - 1, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dDecrease)


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 so_luong, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #r FROM ctcddc


	-- Get data from ctcddc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT so_luong, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
			FROM ctcddc WHERE ky = @nMPrev AND nam = @nYPrev AND ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept

	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r) SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMPrev, @nYPrev)


	-- Get data from ctpsdc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM((nguyen_gia_n - gt_da_pb_n) - (nguyen_gia_x - gt_da_pb_x)), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM((nguyen_gia_nt_n - gt_da_pb_nt_n) - (nguyen_gia_nt_x - gt_da_pb_nt_x)), 0)
			FROM ctpsdc WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept AND (@d IS NULL OR ngay_ct > @d)
				AND stt_rec <> @idNumber
				AND CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec < @cKey

	--
	SELECT @gt_cl = CASE WHEN SUM(so_luong) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN @So_luong = SUM(so_luong) THEN SUM(gt_cl) ELSE ROUND(SUM(gt_cl) * @So_luong / SUM(so_luong), @nRound) END
			, @gt_cl_nt = CASE WHEN SUM(so_luong) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN @So_luong = SUM(so_luong) THEN SUM(gt_cl_nt) ELSE ROUND(SUM(gt_cl_nt) * @So_luong / SUM(so_luong), @nFCRound) END
		FROM #r
	SELECT @gt_cl = ISNULL(@gt_cl, 0), @gt_cl_nt = ISNULL(@gt_cl_nt, 0)


	-- Post
	DELETE ctpsdc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ctpsdc (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc
			, ma_ld_tg, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, loai_ps, ma_nt
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x
			, gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_da_pb_x, gt_da_pb_nt_x
			, gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, gt_cl_x, gt_cl_nt_x
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @idNumber, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc
				, a.ma_ld_giam, c.tk_dc, c.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, 2, a.ma_nt
				, 0, a.so_luong
				, 0, 0, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt
				, 0, 0, a.nguyen_gia - @gt_cl, a.nguyen_gia_nt - @gt_cl_nt
				, 0, 0, a.gt_pb, a.gt_pb_nt
				, '1', a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
			FROM #gpbdc a LEFT JOIN dmdcct b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc
				LEFT JOIN dmccdc c ON a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$UpdateVoucherNumberRegion]
	@so_ct VARCHAR(33), 
	@ma_nk VARCHAR(33)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @so_ct1 VARCHAR(33), @so_ct0 VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @so_ct1 = so_ct1, @so_ct0 = so_ct0 FROM v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @ma_nk

	DECLARE @sr BIT, @sn BIGINT, @sv VARCHAR(33), @ss1 VARCHAR(33), @ss2 VARCHAR(33)
	EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @so_ct1, @sr OUT, @sn OUT, @sv OUT, @ss1 OUT, 0, @ss2 OUT, 0

	DECLARE @cr BIT, @cn BIGINT, @cv VARCHAR(33), @cs1 VARCHAR(33), @cs2 VARCHAR(33)
	EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @so_ct0, @cr OUT, @cn OUT, @cv OUT, @cs1 OUT, 0, @cs2 OUT, 0

	DECLARE @xv VARCHAR(33), @xs1 VARCHAR(33), @xs2 VARCHAR(33), @xNumber VARCHAR(33), @lv INT, @l1 INT, @l2 INT
	SELECT @lv = LEN(@sv), @l1 = LEN(@ss1), @l2 = LEN(@ss2)

	IF @sr = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @xs1 = SUBSTRING(@so_ct, 1, @l1 - 1) + '[', @xs2 = ']' + SUBSTRING(@so_ct, @l1 + @lv, @l2), @xv = SUBSTRING(@so_ct, @l1, @lv), @xNumber = @xs1 + @xv + @xs2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @xs1 = SUBSTRING(@so_ct, 1, @l1), @xs2 = SUBSTRING(@so_ct, @l1 + @lv + 1, LEN(@so_ct)), @xv = SUBSTRING(@so_ct, @l1 + 1, @lv), @xNumber = @xs1 + @xv + @xs2
	END

	IF @xs1 = @ss1 AND @xs2 = @ss2 AND LEN(@xv) = @lv AND ISNUMERIC(@xv) = 1 AND @xNumber > @so_ct0 BEGIN
		UPDATE v20dmnk SET so_ct0 = @xNumber WHERE ma_nk = @ma_nk
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSHandoverReportExport] --fs20_FXExchange_Detail
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@FACode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @FACode = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @FACode = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @FACode <> '' THEN 'a.so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FACode, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, line_nbr, ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt INTO #ctctcc FROM ctctcc
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, t_nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, t_nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, ts_kt AS cong_suat, so_hieu_ts, nuoc_sx, nam_sx, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam_sd, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL) AS tl_kh
			, ten_ts2 AS ten_ts, b.line_nbr, b.ten_ptkt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia_tri, b.gia_tri_nt, 0 AS type
		INTO #report
		FROM dmcc a, #ctctcc b
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'		
	SET @q = @q + ' select 1, a.so_the_ts, t_nguyen_gia, t_nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ts_kt, so_hieu_ts, nuoc_sx, nam_sx, isnull(year(ngay_dvsd), 0), case when so_ky_kh = 0 then 0 else 1200/so_ky_kh end,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ten_ts%l, b.line_nbr, '''', '''', b.so_luong, b.gia_tri, b.gia_tri_nt, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmcc a with(nolock) left join #ctctcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN nguyen_gia ELSE -nguyen_gia END) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN nguyen_gia_nt ELSE -nguyen_gia_nt END) AS nguyen_gia_nt
		INTO #ctdmcc1
		FROM ctdmcc1 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmtgcc b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report) AND ((nam * 12 + ky) <= (@Year * 12 + @Month))
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = a.nguyen_gia + b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt + b.nguyen_gia_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN #ctdmcc1 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 2, so_the_ts, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, N'', line_nbr, ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, 1
			FROM ctctcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report)

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 2, so_the_ts, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, N'', 0, N'', N'', 0, 0, 0, 1
			FROM #report WHERE type = 0 AND so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report WHERE type = 1)

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY so_the_ts, stt, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrmapbhdd] 
AS 
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_tinh, b.ten_tinh2, c.ten_quan, c.ten_quan2, d.ten_phuong, d.ten_phuong2
		FROM hrmapbhdd a
			LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh b ON a.f_ma_tinh = b.ma_tinh
			LEFT JOIN hrdmquan c ON a.f_ma_tinh = c.ma_tinh and a.f_ma_quan = c.ma_quan
			LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong d ON a.f_ma_tinh = d.ma_tinh and a.f_ma_quan = d.ma_quan and a.f_ma_phuong = d.ma_phuong

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostSPTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@custName NVARCHAR(511),
	@address NVARCHAR(511),
	@taxCode NVARCHAR(511),
	@step TINYINT,
	@postFrom TINYINT = 1 -- 1 - Voucher, 2 - Post Transaction
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @tk_thue VARCHAR(32), @tk_thue_no VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh2 VARCHAR(32), @loai_ct CHAR(1),
		@noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT, @isPostTax TINYINT, @ten_vt NVARCHAR(511), @ghi_chu NVARCHAR(511), @meno NVARCHAR(511), @ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_ct VARCHAR(3),
		@masterTaxCode VARCHAR(32)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m25$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d25$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #outputvat FROM r20$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ar FROM cttt20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien2 AS ps_no, tien2 AS ps_co, tien_nt2 AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt2 AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tax INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @groupTaxReduction VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @groupTaxReduction = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_post_hh_hddt' AND val = '1')
			SELECT @groupTaxReduction = ', loai'
		ELSE
			EXEC sp_executesql N'update #detail set tien_nt2 = - tien_nt2, tien2 = - tien2 from #detail where loai = ''90'''
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct, @ngay_lct = ngay_lct, @tk = tk, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_kh2 = ma_kh2, @tk_thue = tk_thue, @tk_thue_no = tk_thue_no, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @meno = dien_giai, @ten_vt =  CASE WHEN RTRIM(ten_vtthue) <> '' THEN ten_vtthue ELSE dien_giai END, @ghi_chu = ghi_chuthue,
		@masterTaxCode = ma_thue FROM #master

	--
	IF (@masterTaxCode <> '' AND COL_LENGTH('d25$000000', 'ma_thue') IS NOT NULL) EXEC(N'update #detail set ma_thue = b.ma_thue, thue_suat = b.thue_suat from #detail a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')


	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SELECT @isPost = 1, @isPostTax = 1
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk_thue_no, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPostTax = 0


	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		/*1. Cong no*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(tien2 <> 0 or tien_nt2 <> 0)', 'tien2, tien_nt2', 'tk_du' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @groupTaxReduction = '' BEGIN
				IF @loai_ct = '1' UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_du, tk0 = tk_du, tk_du = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_du, tk0 = tk_du, tk_du = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @loai_ct = '1' UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_du END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_du END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_du ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_du END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_du END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_du ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END
		END

		/*2. Thue*/
		IF @isPostTax = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE t_thue + t_thue_nt <> 0 AND tk_thue_no <> '') BEGIN
			IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'thue <> 0 or thue_nt <> 0', 'thue, thue_nt', @groups, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				IF @loai_ct = '1' UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
					ELSE UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #detail set ma_kh2 = '''' from #detail a where exists(select 1 from dmtk b where a.tk_thue = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 0)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(thue + thue_nt <> 0)', 'thue, thue_nt', 'tk_thue, ma_kh2' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				IF @loai_ct = '1'
					SET @q = 'update #dGL set tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 where isnull(c, 0) = 0'
				ELSE
					SET @q = 'update #dGL set tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 where isnull(c, 0) = 0'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_no varchar(32), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_no, @ma_kh
			END
		END

		-- Post to #gl
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0 WHERE tax = 0
			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0 WHERE tax = 1
		END	ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0 WHERE tax = 0
			UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0 WHERE tax = 1
		END

		IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
			IF @ma_kh2 <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @tk_thue AND tk_cn = 1) UPDATE #dGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh2 WHERE tax = 1
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #dGL set ma_kh = ma_kh2 from #dGL a join dmtk b on a.tk_thue = b.tk where a.tax = 1 and b.tk_cn = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 0, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_dh = '''', so_lo = '''', so_ctgs = '''', so_ct0 = '''', gt_no = 0, gt_co = 0, nam = 0, ky = 0, gt_dd = 0', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	-- (Loại kê khai)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ISNULL(loai_kk, '') = '9') GOTO EndPostVAT

	-- Post tep thue
	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT
	SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#outputvat', '#master', @masterTable, 'ctgt20', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE('#outputvat', '#detail', @detailTable, 'ctgt20', '1 = 1', 'line_nbr = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #outputvat SET tk_thue_co = @tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @custName, dia_chi = @address, ma_so_thue = @taxcode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ghi_chu = @ghi_chu, ma_kh = @ma_kh
		IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien2 = t_tien2 - b.tien2, t_tien_nt2 = t_tien_nt2 - tien_nt2 FROM #outputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2 FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			DELETE #outputvat WHERE t_tien2 = 0 AND t_tien_nt2 = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @dkey VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @dkey = '1=1'
		IF @isGoodsType = 1 SELECT @dkey = 'loai <> ''07'''

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#outputvat', '#detail', @detailTable, 'ctgt20', @dkey)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE('#outputvat', '#master', @masterTable, 'ctgt20', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ma_thue, thue_suat, ma_kh2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'update #outputvat set tk_thue_co = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @custName, dia_chi = @address, ma_so_thue = @taxcode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ghi_chu = @ghi_chu, ma_kh = @ma_kh,  t_tien_nt2 = b.tien_nt2, t_tien2 = b.tien2, t_thue_nt = b.thue_nt, t_thue = b.thue from #outputvat a join #detail b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_no varchar(32), @custName nvarchar(511), @address nvarchar(511), @taxcode nvarchar(511), @ten_vt nvarchar(511), @ma_kh varchar(32), @ghi_chu NVARCHAR(511)', @tk_thue_no, @custName, @address, @taxcode, @ten_vt, @ma_kh, @ghi_chu
	END
	IF @loai_ct = '1' UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien_nt2 = - t_tien_nt2, t_tien2 = - t_tien2, t_thue_nt = - t_thue_nt, t_thue = - t_thue
	UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
	UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_mau_ct = '', nam = 0, ky = 0

	DELETE ctgt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ctgt20 SELECT * FROM #outputvat
EndPostVAT:

	IF @postFrom <> 1 RETURN

	-- Post thanh toan
	DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @loai_ct = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @Tat_toan TINYINT, @T_tt_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ngay_tt SMALLDATETIME, @mode CHAR(1), @T_tt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_tt_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = SUM(tt_qd), @T_tt1 = SUM(tt), @T_tt_nt1= SUM(tt_nt) FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt = @idNumber
		SELECT @T_tt_qd = ISNULL(@T_tt_qd, 0), @T_tt1 = ISNULL(@T_tt1, 0), @T_tt_nt1 = ISNULL(@T_tt_nt1, 0), @Tat_toan = 0, @Ngay_tt = NULL, @mode = 'N'

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber)
			SELECT @Tat_toan = tat_toan, @Ngay_tt = ngay_tt, @mode = 'E' FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ar', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt20', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ar SET loai_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt, t_tt_qd = @T_tt_qd , t_tt1 = @T_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = @T_tt_nt1,
			ngay_tt = CASE WHEN @mode = 'E' THEN @ngay_tt ELSE ngay_tt END, ma_gd = 0, line_nbr = 1

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateOtherFields('#ar', '#detail', @detailTable, 'cttt20', '1=1', '1=1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		UPDATE #ar SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_ck_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
		IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ar SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct
		UPDATE #ar SET tat_toan = CASE WHEN tat_toan IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE tat_toan END,
			t_tt_qd0 = CASE WHEN t_tt_qd0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_qd0 END,
			dien_giai = @meno, ngay_ct0 = @ngay_lct, so_dh = '', t_ck = 0, nam = 0, ky = 0

		INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar
	END


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostIRTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@idNumber CHAR(13), 
	@groups VARCHAR(128), 
	@step TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @step <= 1 RETURN

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @ma_ct CHAR(3)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m74$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d74$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk0, tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'	


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct FROM #master
	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''


	/*1. Gia von*/
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(tk_vt <> tk_du) and (not (' + '(''' +@noAccounts + ''' <> '''') and (dbo.ff_inlist(tk_du, ''' + @noAccounts + ''') = 1)))', 'tien, tien_nt', 'tk_vt, tk_du' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = tk_du, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = tien_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt

	-- Post to #gl
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_vt, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_lo = '''', so_ctgs = '''', so_ct0 = '''', so_dh = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai, ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
		
	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl		


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rpt053BK] --rs_rpt053BK
	@Year INT,
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT

	SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '1231' AS SMALLDATETIME)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nv as ma_ns, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS ten_ns, b.ma_so_thue
			, b.ma_pt, b.ten_pt, b.ngay_sinh AS ngay_sinh_pt, b.quoc_tich AS ma_qt_pt, b.ma_loai_gt AS ma_loai_gt, b.cmnd AS cmnd_pt, b.quan_he AS quan_he_pt, b.so_khai_sinh AS so_khai_sinh_pt, b.quyen_so AS quyen_so_pt, b.quoc_gia AS quoc_gia_pt
			, b.tinh_thanh AS tinh_thanh_pt, b.quan_huyen AS quan_huyen_pt, b.phuong_xa AS phuong_xa_pt, b.ma_so_thue AS ma_so_thue_pt, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den
			, b.loai_qh
		INTO #report FROM hrnv a, hrttctpt b

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- @Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'e.'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '((h.ngay_hl_tu <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''') and ((h.ngay_hl_den is null) or (h.ngay_hl_den >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''')))'
	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and e.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + '''' END
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 0, e.stt, e.ma_dvcs, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ten_nv, b.ma_so_thue'
	SET @q = @q + ', h.ma_pt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'h.ten_pt' ELSE 'h.ten_pt2' END + ', h.ngay_sinh, h.quoc_tich, h.ma_loai_gt, h.cmnd,' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_qh' ELSE 'c.ten_qh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', h.so_khai_sinh, h.quyen_so, h.quoc_gia, h.tinh_thanh, h.quan_huyen, h.phuong_xa, h.ma_so_thue, h.ngay_hl_tu, h.ngay_hl_den, h.loai_qh'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrttctpt h with(nolock) left join hrnv e with(nolock) on h.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrtttncn b with(nolock) on h.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmqhpt c with(nolock) on h.loai_qh = c.loai_qh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' and e.stt_rec + e.ma_dvcs in (select stt_rec + ma_dvcs from hrt03$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' where f009 + f009_nt > 0)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_hl_tu = @DateFrom WHERE ngay_hl_tu < @DateFrom
	UPDATE #report SET ngay_hl_den = @DateTo WHERE ngay_hl_den > @DateTo OR ngay_hl_den IS NULL

	-- Stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_dvcs, ma_ns INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns, stt ORDER BY ma_dvcs, stt, ma_ns
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id, sysorder = b.id FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #o b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
	DROP TABLE #o

	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = NULL, ma_dvcs = '', ma_ns = '', ten_ns = '', ma_so_thue = ''
		WHERE ma_dvcs + ma_ns + ma_pt + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_hl_tu, 112) NOT IN (SELECT ma_dvcs + ma_ns + MIN(ma_pt + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_hl_tu, 112)) FROM #report GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns)

	Result:
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, ma_pt) SELECT '', '', ''

	IF @Form = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @cmnd_pt VARCHAR(128)
		UPDATE #report SET @cmnd_pt = CASE WHEN cmnd_pt = '' THEN so_khai_sinh_pt ELSE cmnd_pt END,
			ma_loai_gt = CASE WHEN ma_so_thue_pt <> '' THEN '' ELSE ma_loai_gt END,
			cmnd_pt = CASE WHEN ma_so_thue_pt <> '' THEN '' ELSE @cmnd_pt END
	END
	SELECT a.sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.ten_ns, a.ma_so_thue, a.ma_pt, a.ten_pt, a.ngay_sinh_pt, a.cmnd_pt
			, a.loai_qh AS ma_qh_pt, a.quan_he_pt
			, a.so_khai_sinh_pt, a.quyen_so_pt, a.quoc_gia_pt, a.tinh_thanh_pt, a.quan_huyen_pt, a.phuong_xa_pt, MONTH(a.ngay_hl_tu) AS tu_thang, MONTH(a.ngay_hl_den) AS den_thang
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_qt ELSE b.ten_qt2 END AS ten_qt, a.ma_so_thue_pt
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_so_thue <> '' THEN '0' ELSE c.ma_htkk END AS ma_loai_gt
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_so_thue <> '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_loai_gt ELSE c.ten_loai_gt2 END END AS ten_loai_gt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmqt b ON a.ma_qt_pt = b.ma_qt LEFT JOIN dmloaigt c ON a.ma_loai_gt = c.ma_loai_gt
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.ma_pt, a.ngay_hl_tu

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GetInputInvoiceData]
	@VoucherList VARCHAR(MAX),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @VoucherList = REPLACE(@VoucherList, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', ''), @UnitCode = REPLACE(@UnitCode, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '')

	-- DECLARE
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @code VARCHAR(32), @name NVARCHAR(512), @taxCode VARCHAR(32), @taxRate DECIMAL(38, 12), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @voucherTemplate VARCHAR(32), @ma_thue VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @voucherTemplate = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_mau_ct_dv'
	SELECT @ma_thue = ma_thue FROM dmthue WHERE ma_thue = 'KHAC' AND status = '1'

	-- STRUCT
	SELECT TOP 0 a.mau_so, a.ky_hieu, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.ghi_chu
			, a.ten_cn AS ten_kh, a.dia_chi_cn AS dia_chi, a.mst_cn AS ma_so_thue
			, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, b.ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.dvt AS dvt_goc, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, b.thue_suat AS thue_suat_d, b.ma_thue AS ma_thue_d
			, c.thue_suat AS thue_suat_ext, c.t_tien AS tien_ext, c.t_thue AS thue_ext, b.tinh_chat, a.tk_nh_cn AS tk_nh, a.ten_nh_cn AS ten_nh
		INTO #dt FROM m15$000000 a, d15$000000 b, e15$000000 c

	CREATE TABLE #r (ky_hieu VARCHAR(32), so_hd VARCHAR(32), ngay_hd DATETIME, ngay_ph DATETIME, ma_tt VARCHAR(32), hinh_thuc_tt NVARCHAR(512)
		, ma_nt VARCHAR(8), ty_gia DECIMAL(38, 12), t_tien DECIMAL(38, 12), thue_suat DECIMAL(38, 12), t_thue DECIMAL(38, 12), t_thanh_toan DECIMAL(38, 12)
		, t_thue1 DECIMAL(38, 12), t_thue0 DECIMAL(38, 12), t_thue5 DECIMAL(38, 12), t_thue10 DECIMAL(38, 12), ghi_chu NVARCHAR(512)
		, ky_hieu_d VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), ten_vt NVARCHAR(512), dvt NVARCHAR(32), he_so DECIMAL(38, 12), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32)
		, ma_lo VARCHAR(32), so_luong DECIMAL(38, 12), gia DECIMAL(38, 12), tien DECIMAL(38, 12), ma_thue_d VARCHAR(32), thue_suat_d DECIMAL(38, 12), thue DECIMAL(38, 12), tk_vt VARCHAR(32)
		, gia_ton INT, vi_tri_yn BIT, lo_yn BIT, tao_lo BIT, nhieu_dvt BIT, sua_tk_vt BIT, stt INT
		, ma_kh VARCHAR(32), ten_kh NVARCHAR(512), dia_chi NVARCHAR(512), ma_so_thue NVARCHAR(512), ong_ba NVARCHAR(512), tk VARCHAR(32), ten_tk NVARCHAR(512)
		, ref VARCHAR(32), ten_vt_goc NVARCHAR(512), dvt_goc NVARCHAR(32), ma_mau_ct NVARCHAR(128), tien_ext DECIMAL(38, 12), ma_thue_ext VARCHAR(32)
		, thue_suat_ext DECIMAL(38, 12), thue_ext DECIMAL(38, 12), tinh_chat CHAR(1), tk_nh VARCHAR(32), ten_nh NVARCHAR(512), type CHAR(1), nhom_thue_d VARCHAR(16))

	SELECT a.ma_thue AS ma_thue_mvcn, a.nhom_thue AS nhom_thue_mvcn, b.thue_suat AS thue_suat_mvcn INTO #dmthuemvcn FROM dmthuemvcn a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmthue b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue WHERE a.status = 1

	-- KEY
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @VoucherList <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherList, ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE '1 = 1' END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- SELECT
	SET @q = '
insert into #dt select a.mau_so, a.ky_hieu, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.ghi_chu
		, a.ten_cn as ten_kh, a.dia_chi_cn as dia_chi, a.mst_cn as ma_so_thue
		, b.ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.dvt as dvt_goc, dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, b.thue_suat as thue_suat_d, b.ma_thue as ma_thue_d
		, isnull(c.thue_suat, '''') as thue_suat_ext, c.t_tien as tien_ext, c.t_thue as thue_ext, b.tinh_chat, a.tk_nh_cn as tk_nh, a.ten_nh_cn as ten_nh
	from m15$%Partition a with(nolock)
		left join d15$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		left join e15$%Partition c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec and b.ma_thue = c.thue_suat
	where %[' + @Key + ']% order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.line_nbr'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #r(ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, ngay_ph, ma_tt, hinh_thuc_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tien, thue_suat, t_thue, t_thanh_toan, t_thue1, t_thue0, t_thue5, t_thue10, ghi_chu, ky_hieu_d
		, ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, so_luong, gia, tien, ma_thue_d, thue_suat_d, thue, tk_vt, gia_ton, vi_tri_yn, lo_yn, tao_lo, nhieu_dvt, sua_tk_vt
		, stt, ma_kh, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, ong_ba, tk, ten_tk, ref, ten_vt_goc, dvt_goc, ma_mau_ct
		, tien_ext, ma_thue_ext, thue_suat_ext, thue_ext, tinh_chat, tk_nh, ten_nh, nhom_thue_d, type)
	SELECT ky_hieu, so_ct, ngay_ct, NULL AS ngay_ph, '' AS ma_tt, hinh_thuc_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tien, thue_suat, t_thue, t_thanh_toan
		, NULL AS t_thue1, NULL AS t_thue0, NULL AS t_thue5, NULL AS t_thue10, ghi_chu, '' AS ky_hieu_d, ma_vt2, ten_vt, dvt AS dvt, 1 AS he_so, '' AS ma_kho,'' AS ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_lo
		, so_luong, gia, tien
		, CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ma_thue_mvcn, '') = '' AND a.ma_thue_d = 'KHAC' THEN ISNULL(@ma_thue, '') ELSE ISNULL(c.ma_thue_mvcn, '') END AS ma_thue_d
		, CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ma_thue_mvcn, '') = '' AND a.ma_thue_d = 'KHAC' THEN (CASE WHEN a.tien_ext = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (a.thue_ext*100)/a.tien_ext END) ELSE thue_suat_d END
		, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 12)) AS thue, '', CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS gia_ton, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS vi_tri_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS lo_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tao_lo
		, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS nhieu_dvt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS sua_tk_vt, stt, '' AS ma_kh
		, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, '' AS ong_ba, '' AS tk, '' AS ten_tk, '', ten_vt, dvt_goc
		, CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.mau_so, '') = '' THEN @voucherTemplate ELSE a.mau_so END
		, tien_ext
		, CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ma_thue_mvcn, '') = '' AND a.thue_suat_ext = 'KHAC' THEN ISNULL(@ma_thue, '') ELSE ISNULL(b.ma_thue_mvcn, '') END
		, CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ma_thue_mvcn, '') = '' AND a.thue_suat_ext = 'KHAC' THEN (CASE WHEN a.tien_ext = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (a.thue_ext * 100) / a.tien_ext END) ELSE b.thue_suat_mvcn END
		, thue_ext, tinh_chat
		, a.tk_nh, a.ten_nh, ISNULL(c.nhom_thue_mvcn, '')
		, CASE WHEN a.tinh_chat = '4' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END
	  FROM #dt a
		LEFT JOIN #dmthuemvcn b ON ISNULL(a.thue_suat_ext, '') = dbo.ff_GetTaxCodeExt(b.nhom_thue_mvcn, b.thue_suat_mvcn) AND a.thue_suat_ext <> 'KHAC' AND a.tinh_chat <> '4'
		LEFT JOIN #dmthuemvcn c ON ISNULL(a.ma_thue_d, '') = dbo.ff_GetTaxCodeExt(c.nhom_thue_mvcn, c.thue_suat_mvcn) AND a.ma_thue_d <> 'KHAC'

	-- CUSTOMER CODE
	DECLARE @w NVARCHAR(4000), @useUnit TINYINT
	SELECT @useUnit = 0, @w = '', @code = '', @name = ten_kh, @taxCode = ma_so_thue FROM #r WHERE stt = 1
	IF @Customer <> '' AND @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @useUnit = 1
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUnitFilter @UnitCode, @UserID, @Admin, 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ma_dvcs', 'ds_dvcs', 'dmkhdv', @w OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @q = 'update #r set ma_kh = b.ma_kh from #r a join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue and status = 1 and cc_yn = 1 ' + CASE WHEN @w = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @w END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #r SET ong_ba = RTRIM(b.doi_tac), tk = b.tk, ma_tt = RTRIM(b.ma_tt), hinh_thuc_tt = c.ten_tt FROM #r a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmtt c ON b.ma_tt = c.ma_tt
	UPDATE #r SET ten_tk = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE b.ten_tk2 END FROM #r a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #r SET ma_nt = @baseCurrency WHERE ma_nt = '' OR (ma_nt = @baseCurrency AND ty_gia = 1)
	UPDATE #r SET ty_gia = 1 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

	--
	SELECT a.ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.so_hd)) AS so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.ngay_ph, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat,
		a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_thue1, a.t_thue0, a.t_thue5, a.t_thue10, a.ghi_chu,
		a.ky_hieu_d, RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, a.ma_thue_d, a.thue_suat_d, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_thue_d, a.thue,
		a.tk_vt, a.gia_ton, a.vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, a.tao_lo, a.nhieu_dvt, a.sua_tk_vt, a.stt,
		a.ma_tt AS ma_tt, RTRIM(a.ma_kh) AS ma_kh, RTRIM(a.ten_kh) AS ten_kh, RTRIM(a.dia_chi) AS dia_chi, RTRIM(a.ma_so_thue) AS ma_so_thue,
		RTRIM(a.ong_ba) AS ong_ba, RTRIM(a.tk) AS tk, RTRIM(a.ten_tk) AS ten_tk,
		a.ten_vt AS ten_vt_tax, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_thue_tax, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue_suat_tax,
		CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_tax, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue_tax, a.ref, a.ten_vt_goc, a.dvt_goc, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE b.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk_vt,
		CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kh ELSE c.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh_n, a.ma_mau_ct, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(d.ten_mau_ct, '') ELSE ISNULL(d.ten_mau_ct2, '') END AS ten_mau_ct,
		CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_thue_no, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_tk_thue_no, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tk_cn, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tk_cn_d, tien_ext, ma_thue_ext, thue_suat_ext, thue_ext, tinh_chat, RTRIM(a.tk_nh) AS tk_nh, RTRIM(a.ten_nh) AS ten_nh, a.nhom_thue_d, type
	  INTO #k1 FROM #r a WITH(NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN dmtk b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.tk_vt = b.tk
		LEFT JOIN dmkh c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh
		LEFT JOIN dmmauct d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_mau_ct = d.ma_mau_ct
	  ORDER BY a.stt

	--
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_tax = '' WHERE type = '0'
	UPDATE #k1 SET thue_suat_tax = thue_suat_d, tien_tax = tien, thue_tax = thue
	UPDATE #k1 SET thue_suat_tax = 0, tien_tax = 0 WHERE ma_thue_tax = ''
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_ext = RTRIM(b.ma_thue) FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON REPLACE(STR(a.ma_thue_ext, 2), ' ', '0') = b.ma_thue WHERE LEN(a.ma_thue_ext) = 1 AND TYPE = '1'
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_ext = RTRIM(ISNULL(b.ma_thue, '')) FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue_ext = b.ma_thue WHERE LEN(a.ma_thue_ext) > 1 AND TYPE = '1'
	UPDATE #k1 SET tk_thue_no = RTRIM(a.tk_thue_no3), ten_tk_thue_no = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE b.ten_tk2 END, tk_cn = b.tk_cn FROM #k1 k JOIN dmthue a ON k.ma_thue_ext = a.ma_thue LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_thue_no3 = b.tk WHERE k.type = '1'
	UPDATE #k1 SET thue_suat_ext = 0 WHERE ma_thue_ext = '' OR thue_suat_ext < 0
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_tax = '', type = '1' WHERE ISNULL(thue_ext, -1) <> -1 AND type = '0'
	UPDATE #k1 SET tien_ext = t_tien WHERE ma_thue_ext IN (SELECT ma_thue_mvcn FROM #dmthuemvcn WHERE nhom_thue_mvcn = 'KTS') AND type = '1'

	--
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_d = RTRIM(b.ma_thue) FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON REPLACE(STR(a.ma_thue_d, 2), ' ', '0') = b.ma_thue WHERE LEN(a.ma_thue_d) = 1
	UPDATE #k1 SET ma_thue_d = RTRIM(ISNULL(b.ma_thue, '')) FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue_d = b.ma_thue WHERE LEN(a.ma_thue_d) > 1
																																								

	-- RESULT
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PNA', 'PNG', 'PNE', 'HDF') BEGIN
		-- UPDATE INFO ITEM
		DECLARE @i INT, @n INT
		SELECT @i = 1
		SELECT @n = COUNT(*) FROM #k1
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			DECLARE @Item VARCHAR(32), @Site VARCHAR(32), @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(28, 5), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32)

			SELECT @Item = ma_vt, @Site = ma_kho FROM #k1 WHERE stt = @i
			SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, gia_ton, lo_yn, tao_lo, nhieu_dvt, sua_tk_vt INTO #Item FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
			SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

			IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
					SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite
				ELSE
					UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
				ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

			UPDATE #k1 SET ma_kho = RTRIM(a.ma_kho), ma_vi_tri = RTRIM(a.ma_vi_tri), dvt = RTRIM(@UOM), he_so = @Rate, tk_vt = RTRIM(@ItemAccount), gia_ton = a.gia_ton, vi_tri_yn = CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ma_kho FROM dmvitri WHERE dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT), lo_yn = a.lo_yn, tao_lo = a.tao_lo, nhieu_dvt = a.nhieu_dvt, sua_tk_vt = a.sua_tk_vt
				FROM #Item a WHERE stt = @i

			DROP TABLE #Item
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		--
		IF @VoucherCode = 'HDF' BEGIN
			UPDATE #k1 SET type = '1' WHERE tinh_chat = '4'
			UPDATE #k1 SET tk_thue_d = RTRIM(a.tk_thue_no), tk_cn_d = ISNULL(b.tk_cn, 0) FROM #k1 k JOIN dmthue a ON k.ma_thue_d = a.ma_thue LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_thue_no = b.tk
			SELECT '' AS array$, a.ky_hieu, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.ngay_ph, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_thue1, a.t_thue0, a.t_thue5, a.t_thue10, a.ghi_chu, a.ky_hieu_d, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, a.thue_suat_d, a.thue, a.tk_vt, a.gia_ton, a.vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, a.tao_lo, a.nhieu_dvt, a.sua_tk_vt, a.stt, a.ma_tt, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh, a.dia_chi, a.ma_so_thue, a.ong_ba, a.tk, a.ten_tk, a.ten_vt_tax, a.ma_thue_tax, a.thue_suat_tax, a.tien_tax, a.thue_tax, a.ref, a.ten_vt_goc, a.dvt_goc, a.ten_kh_n, a.ma_mau_ct, a.ten_mau_ct, a.tk_thue_no, a.ten_tk_thue_no, a.tk_cn, a.tien_ext, a.ma_thue_ext, a.thue_suat_ext, a.thue_ext
					, RTRIM(b.ma_nvbh) AS ma_nvbh, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.ten_nvbh ELSE c.ten_nvbh2 END AS ten_nvbh, a.tinh_chat
					, RTRIM(d.tk_tl) AS tk_tl, CASE WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = d.tk_tl AND loai_tk = 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS kieu_tl
					, RTRIM(d.tk_gv) AS tk_gv, CASE WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = d.tk_gv AND loai_tk = 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS kieu_gv
					, RTRIM(d.tk_cpbh) AS tk_cpbh, CASE WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = d.tk_cpbh AND loai_tk = 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS kieu_cpbh
					, a.ma_thue_d, a.tk_thue_d, a.tk_cn_d
					, a.type, RTRIM(a.tk_nh) AS tk_nh, RTRIM(a.ten_nh) AS ten_nh, RTRIM(a.nhom_thue_d) AS nhom_thue_d
				FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmnvbh c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_nvbh = c.ma_nvbh LEFT JOIN dmvt d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt
				ORDER BY a.stt
			RETURN
		END

		--
		SELECT '' AS array$, ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, ngay_ph, hinh_thuc_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tien, thue_suat, t_thue, t_thanh_toan, t_thue1, t_thue0, t_thue5, t_thue10, ghi_chu, ky_hieu_d, ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat_d, thue, tk_vt, gia_ton, vi_tri_yn, lo_yn, tao_lo, nhieu_dvt, sua_tk_vt, stt, ma_tt, ma_kh, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, ong_ba, tk, ten_tk, ten_vt_tax, ma_thue_tax, thue_suat_tax, tien_tax, thue_tax, ref, ten_vt_goc, dvt_goc, ten_kh_n, ma_mau_ct, ten_mau_ct, tk_thue_no, ten_tk_thue_no, tk_cn, tien_ext, ma_thue_ext, thue_suat_ext, thue_ext, type, RTRIM(tk_nh) AS tk_nh, RTRIM(ten_nh) AS ten_nh
			FROM #k1 ORDER BY stt
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PN1', 'PN2', 'PNC', 'PC1', 'PK1', 'HD9', 'PN9') BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS array$, ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, ngay_ph, hinh_thuc_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tien, thue_suat, t_thue, t_thanh_toan, t_thue1, t_thue0, t_thue5, t_thue10, ghi_chu, ky_hieu_d, ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat_d, thue, tk_vt, stt, ma_tt, ma_kh, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, ong_ba, tk, ten_tk, ten_vt_tax, ma_thue_tax, thue_suat_tax, tien_tax, thue_tax, ref, ten_vt_goc, dvt_goc, ten_tk_vt, ten_kh_n, ma_mau_ct, ten_mau_ct, tk_thue_no, ten_tk_thue_no, tk_cn, tien_ext, ma_thue_ext, thue_suat_ext, thue_ext, type, RTRIM(tk_nh) AS tk_nh, RTRIM(ten_nh) AS ten_nh
			FROM #k1 ORDER BY stt
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD3' BEGIN
		UPDATE #k1 SET type = '1' WHERE tinh_chat = '4'
		UPDATE #k1 SET tk_thue_d = RTRIM(a.tk_thue_no), tk_cn_d = ISNULL(b.tk_cn, 0) FROM #k1 k JOIN dmthue a ON k.ma_thue_d = a.ma_thue LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_thue_no = b.tk
		SELECT '' AS array$, a.ky_hieu, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.ngay_ph, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_thue1, a.t_thue0, a.t_thue5, a.t_thue10, a.ghi_chu, a.ky_hieu_d, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, a.thue_suat_d, a.thue, a.tk_vt, a.stt, a.ma_tt, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh, a.dia_chi, a.ma_so_thue, a.ong_ba, a.tk, a.ten_tk, a.ten_vt_tax, a.ma_thue_tax, a.thue_suat_tax, a.tien_tax, a.thue_tax, a.ref, a.ten_vt_goc, a.dvt_goc, a.ten_tk_vt, a.ten_kh_n, a.ma_mau_ct, a.ten_mau_ct, a.tk_thue_no, a.ten_tk_thue_no, a.tk_cn_d, a.tien_ext, a.ma_thue_ext, a.thue_suat_ext, a.thue_ext, RTRIM(b.ma_nvbh) AS ma_nvbh, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.ten_nvbh ELSE c.ten_nvbh2 END AS ten_nvbh, a.ma_thue_d, a.tk_thue_d, a.type, RTRIM(a.tk_nh) AS tk_nh, RTRIM(a.ten_nh) AS ten_nh
			FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmnvbh c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_nvbh = c.ma_nvbh
			ORDER BY a.stt
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'BN1' BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS array$, a.ky_hieu, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.ngay_ph, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tien, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_thue1, a.t_thue0, a.t_thue5, a.t_thue10, a.ghi_chu, a.ky_hieu_d, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, a.thue_suat_d, a.thue, a.tk_vt, a.stt, a.ma_tt, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh, a.dia_chi, a.ma_so_thue, a.ong_ba, a.tk, a.ten_tk, a.ten_vt_tax, a.ma_thue_tax, a.thue_suat_tax, a.tien_tax, a.thue_tax, a.ref, a.ten_vt_goc, a.dvt_goc, a.ten_tk_vt, a.ten_kh_n, a.ma_mau_ct, a.ten_mau_ct, a.tk_thue_no, a.ten_tk_thue_no, a.tk_cn, a.tien_ext, a.ma_thue_ext, a.thue_suat_ext, a.thue_ext, a.type
				, a.tk_nh, a.ten_nh
				, RTRIM(b.tinh_thanh) AS tinh_thanh, RTRIM(b.chi_nhanh) AS chi_nhanh, RTRIM(b.quoc_gia) AS quoc_gia, RTRIM(b.ma_nh_dt) AS ma_nh_dt, RTRIM(eb.citad) AS ma_citad, RTRIM(b.nguoi_thu_huong) AS nguoi_thu_huong, RTRIM(a.tk_nh) AS tk_nh_xml, RTRIM(a.ten_nh) AS ten_nh_xml
			FROM #k1 a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh  LEFT JOIN dmmsnh eb WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_nh_dt = eb.ma_nh_dt
			ORDER BY stt
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmck2] 
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_kh, c.ten_kh2, d.ten_kho, d.ten_kho2,
			f.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh1, f.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh12,
			g.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh2, g.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh22,
			h.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh3, h.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh32,
			i.ten_nh AS ten_nh_kh9, i.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_kh92,
			j.ten_nh AS ten_nh_vt1, j.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_vt12,
			k.ten_nh AS ten_nh_vt2, k.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_vt22,
			l.ten_nh AS ten_nh_vt3, l.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_vt32,
			m.ten_nh AS ten_nh_vt9, m.ten_nh2 AS ten_nh_vt92,
			z.ten_ck, z.ten_ck2, COALESCE(b.ds_dvcs, c.ds_dvcs, '')  AS ds_dvcs
		FROM dbo.dmck2 a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkho d ON a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho
			
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh f ON a.nh_kh1 = f.ma_nh AND f.loai_nh = '1'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh g ON a.nh_kh2 = g.ma_nh AND g.loai_nh = '2'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh h ON a.nh_kh3 = h.ma_nh AND h.loai_nh = '3'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh2 i ON a.nh_kh9 = i.ma_nh
			
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhvt j ON a.nh_vt1 = j.ma_nh AND f.loai_nh = '1'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh k ON a.nh_vt2 = k.ma_nh AND g.loai_nh = '2'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh l ON a.nh_vt3 = l.ma_nh AND h.loai_nh = '3'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhvt2 m ON a.nh_vt9 = m.ma_nh
			JOIN dbo.dmck z ON a.ma_ck = z.ma_ck
		ORDER BY a.ma_ck, a.ma_kho, a.ma_kh, a.nh_kh1, a.nh_kh2, a.nh_kh3, a.nh_kh9, a.ma_vt, a.nh_vt1, a.nh_vt2, a.nh_vt3, a.nh_vt9, a.so_luong

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$CancelInvoice]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	DECLARE @provider INT, @e INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	SELECT @e = a.kieu_ky_so FROM dmkysohddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND b.status = 1
	SELECT @e = CASE WHEN @e IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ELSE @e END

	IF @provider = 1 AND @e = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherID AS [key]
		RETURN
	END


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD1' SELECT @refTable = '21$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c21$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD4' SELECT @refTable = '25$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c25$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @refTable = '81$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SELECT @refTable = '22$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c22$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXC' SELECT @refTable = '86$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c86$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' SELECT @refTable = '26$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM m26$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @refTable = '', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD6' SELECT @refTable = '42$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM m42$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' SELECT @refTable = '', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + @p
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXD', 'HD6') SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + '000000'
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @m = 'hddc'

	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select a.so_bi_mat, b.ma_dvcs, b.mau_hddt, c.ly_do_huy, c.so_huy as so_bb_huy, c.ngay_huy from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hddt04 c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END


	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt, ngay_ct INTO #master FROM hddt00$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, rtrim(b.ma_dvcs), '''', a.mau_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.so_ct_hddt, a.ngay_ct from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @m + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(ma_so_thue) FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND status = '1'
	IF @taxCode IS NULL SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_thue'
	UPDATE #master SET ma_so_thue = ISNULL(@taxCode, '')

	IF @provider = 3
		SELECT stt_rec AS [key], ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, (RTRIM(so_seri_hddt) + LTRIM(RTRIM(so_ct_hddt))) AS so_ct_hddt, '""' AS ghi_chu, ngay_ct FROM #master
	ELSE
		SELECT stt_rec AS [key], ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt FROM #master

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetWordNumEx(@strString NVARCHAR(4000), @intNum INT)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(511)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nNum INT, @cReturn NVARCHAR(511)
	SET  @nStart = 1; SET @nNum = 0
	SET @strString = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) + ';'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(';', @strString,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @nNum = @nNum + 1
			IF @nNum = @intNum
				BEGIN
					SET @cReturn = SUBSTRING(@strString, @nStart, CHARINDEX(';', @strString,  @nStart) - @nStart)
					BREAK
				END
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(';', @strString,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN RTRIM(LTRIM(@cReturn))
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintSATran] --fs_PrintPOTran
    @Language CHAR(1), 
    @DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
    @Table VARCHAR(32), 
    @Voucher CHAR(3),
    @Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
    @extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
    @extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Table = REPLACE(@Table, '''', '')
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt0 as gia_nt, a.gia0 as gia, a.tien_nt0 as tien_nt, a.tien0 as tien, a.thue_nk_nt + a.thue_ttdb_nt + a.thue_bvmt_nt + a.thue_nt as thue_nt, a.thue_nk + a.thue_ttdb + a.thue_bvmt + a.thue as thue'

	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt' -- song ngữ
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2'

	SET @q = @q + ', a.ngay_giao, a.ngay_ct, stt_rec_nc, isnull(b.so_ct, '''') as so_nc'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt left outer join c91$000000 b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec'

	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.line_nbr'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_giao smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_ct smalldatetime null'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 ngay_giao from #report order by line_nbr'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
