CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll011]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@isUnicode TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ds_loai_luong VARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @ds_loai_luong = RTRIM(ds_loai_luong) FROM hrPayroll003 WHERE ma_bc = 'PAY11'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'z', 'z', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_loai_lg in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@ds_loai_luong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.tk_nh = '''''
	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department0), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and z.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Employee <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nv = @Employee
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@IDNumber) + ''''
	END
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'y.')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department0 + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp z on a.ma_bp0 = z.ma_bp'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp y with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = y.ma_bp'

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, a.gt AS tien, a.gt_nt AS tien_nt, b.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv
		INTO #report FROM hrluongth$000000 a, hrnv b

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, tien, tien_nt, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, sum(gt), sum(gt_nt), b.ma_nv, rtrim(max(b.ho_nv)) + space(1) + max(b.ten_nv)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrluongth$' + RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with(nolock) left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hrttluong c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, b.stt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt, b.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @isUnicode = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ho_ten_nv = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Message$ConvertToUnsign(ho_ten_nv)
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 0, 0, '', SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '', @Total FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 0, 0, '', 0, 0, '', ''

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN sysorder = 5 THEN stt ELSE NULL END AS stt, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, tien, tien_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPRPOPIComparison] --fs_PRPOComparison
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@PODateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@PODateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@PRFrom AS VARCHAR(33),
	@PRTo AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Status AS CHAR(64),
	@Size AS TINYINT,
	@TransactionCode VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @Status = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '*', '3, 4')

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.dept_id, a.status, a.ma_ct, a.ma_md, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.sl_duyet, a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, c.he_so
		INTO #pr FROM m91$000000 a, d91$000000 b, dmqddvt c

	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ty_gia, a.ma_nt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.sl_nhan, b.sl_tl0, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt
			, a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec_nc, b.stt_rec0nc, c.he_so
		INTO #popi FROM m94$000000 a, d94$000000 b, dmqddvt c

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.dept_id, a.status, a.ma_md, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.sl_duyet, b.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct2
			, b.so_ct AS so_ct2, b.ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ct2, b.ty_gia, b.ma_nt, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_nc, a.stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0nc
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_nhan, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tl0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_cl
		INTO #report FROM #pr a, #popi b

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'b.ma_ct = ''PR1'' and a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or ma_kho = '''')'

	IF @PRFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PRFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @PRTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PRTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.dept_id like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @f$Ext VARCHAR(125), @isBiMode VARCHAR(1)
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Report$GetFields '#report,#pr', NULL, NULL, @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, NULL, @isBiMode OUTPUT, @Key OUTPUT, @f$Ext OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, '%p', 'a'), @f$Ext = REPLACE(@f$Ext, '%p', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #pr select a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.dept_id, a.status, a.ma_ct, a.ma_md, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.sl_duyet, a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, isnull(c.he_so, 1)' + @f$Ext
	SET @q = @q + ' from m91$%Partition a with(nolock) inner join d91$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmqddvt c on b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt and b.dvt = c.dvt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #popi select a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ty_gia, a.ma_nt, b.dvt'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.so_luong, b.sl_nhan, b.sl_tl0, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec_nc, b.stt_rec0nc, isnull(c.he_so, 1)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m94$%Partition a with(nolock) inner join d94$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmqddvt c on b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt and b.dvt = c.dvt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[(a.status in (''2'', ''3'', ''4'') or (a.status = ''5'' and  b.sl_nhan <> 0))
		and b.stt_rec_nc in (select distinct(stt_rec) from #pr)' + CASE WHEN @isBiMode = '0' THEN ' and a.loai_ct = ''1''' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from dmloaict v where v.ma_ct = a.ma_ct and v.loai_ct = a.loai_ct and v.bi_mode = ''1'')' END + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @PODateFrom, @PODateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- PO/PI
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '94$', '95$')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @PODateFrom, @PODateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- SA
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'd95$', 'bid06$'), 'm95$', 'bim06$'), 'b.sl_nhan', 'b.sl_nhap')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @PODateFrom, @PODateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #report
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.dept_id, a.status, a.ma_md, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.sl_duyet, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.ma_ct, b.ty_gia, b.ma_nt, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0
		, cast(b.so_luong*b.he_so/a.he_so as numeric(28, 6)), cast((b.sl_nhan*b.he_so/a.he_so + b.sl_tl0*b.he_so/a.he_so) as numeric(28, 6)), cast(b.sl_tl0*b.he_so/a.he_so as numeric(28, 6)), cast((b.so_luong*b.he_so/a.he_so - b.sl_nhan*b.he_so/a.he_so) as numeric(28, 6))' + @f$Ext + '
	from #pr a left join #popi b on b.stt_rec_nc = a.stt_rec and b.stt_rec0nc = a.stt_rec0
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, h.ma_ct_in as ma_ct02, a.so_ct, dept_id, a.ma_vt, ten_vt, a.dvt, so_luong, sl_duyet, ngay_ct2, so_ct2, a.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', gia_nt, tien_nt, a.ma_nt, ty_gia, gia, tien, so_luong2, sl_nhan, sl_tl0, sl_cl, a.ma_ct, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.statusname' ELSE 'e.statusname2' END + ' as statusname'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' as ten_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE 'c.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'f.ten_md' ELSE 'f.ten_md2' END + ' as ten_md'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.ten_kh' ELSE 'g.ten_kh2' END + ' as ten_kh' + @f$Ext
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmbp b on a.dept_id = b.ma_bp left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmttct e on a.status = e.status and e.ma_ct = a.ma_ct left join dmmd f on a.ma_md = f.ma_md and a.ma_ct = f.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh g on a.ma_kh = g.ma_kh left join dmct h on a.ma_ct2 = h.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, stt_rec_nc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2list]
	@dateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@tsType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsDept AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@order VARCHAR(254),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @FC VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @FC = val FROM Options WHERE name = 'M_MA_NT0'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt,
			a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc AS ten_dc, a.ten_dc2 AS ten_dc2, a.so_hieu_dc AS so_hieu_dc,
			b.so_luong, b.nguyen_gia, b.gt_da_pb, b.gt_cl, gt_pb_ky AS gt_pb_ky, b.nguyen_gia_nt, b.gt_da_pb_nt, b.gt_cl_nt, b.gt_pb_ky_nt,
			a.ngay_tang AS ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0 AS ngay_pb0, a.ngay_pb_kt AS ngay_pb_kt, a.so_ky_pb AS so_ky_pb,
			nh_dc1 AS nh_dc1, nh_dc2 AS nh_dc2, nh_dc3 AS nh_dc3, loai_dc AS loai_cc, ma_nt AS ma_nt, ty_gia AS ty_gia,
			a.so_ct AS so_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct, a.tk_dc AS tk_dc, a.tk_pb AS tk_pb, b.tk_cp AS tk_cp, a.ma_dvcs AS ma_bp_dc, a.ma_phi AS ma_phi
		INTO #report FROM dmccdc a, dmdcct b

	--Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_tang between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @tsType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_bp_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsDept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKey

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc,
max(a.ten_dc) as ten_dc, max(a.ten_dc2) as ten_dc2, max(a.so_hieu_dc) as so_hieu_dc,
sum(so_luong) as so_luong, sum(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, sum(gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, sum(gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(gt_pb_ky) as gt_pb_ky, sum(nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt, sum(gt_da_pb_nt) as gt_da_pb_nt, sum(gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt,
sum(gt_pb_ky_nt) as gt_pb_ky_nt, max(a.ngay_tang) as ngay_tang, max(a.ngay_pb0) as ngay_pb0,
max(a.ngay_pb_kt) as ngay_pb_kt, max(a.so_ky_pb) as so_ky_pb, max(nh_dc1) as nh_dc1, max(nh_dc2) as nh_dc2,
max(nh_dc3) as nh_dc3, max(loai_dc) as loai_cc, max(ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(ty_gia) as ty_gia,
max(a.so_ct), max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.tk_dc), max(a.tk_pb), b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc, max(a.ma_phi)
from dmccdc a with(nolock) join dmdcct b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
where ' + @Key + 'group by a.ma_dc, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_dc', 'NUMERIC(5), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @f NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @f = 'sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, ma_dc, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'ten_dc' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_dc, ' + CASE WHEN @language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_dc2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_dc2'
	SET @f = @f + ', so_ct, ngay_ct, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_bp_dc, ma_phi, so_hieu_dc, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, so_luong, nguyen_gia, gt_da_pb, gt_cl, gt_pb_ky, ngay_tang, ngay_pb0, ngay_pb_kt, so_ky_pb'

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_pb_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_pb_ky_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @FC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@groups, '') <> '' THEN @groups ELSE 'ma_dc' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, 'ma_dc'), @groups = ISNULL(@groups, '')
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	-- Group
	IF @groups <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@groups , 'dc',
			'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt,so_ky_pb',
			'#report')
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'dmnhdc', 'dmnhcc')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Total
	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dc', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt,so_ky_pb', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Query
	IF @groups <> '' BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END
		SET @q = 'select ' + @f + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@groups, 'sysorder,' + @order) + ', stt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END
		SET @q = 'select ' + @f + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order+',stt' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Print22TranMultiCopies]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@cMTable CHAR(10),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),	
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @so_lien INT, @max INT
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511), @printTable VARCHAR(32), @printJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33)
	
	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai
			, b.doi_tac, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS thanh_toan, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS thanh_toan2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt AS t_tt, a.t_tt_nt AS t_tt_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS thue_suat, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS sd_hddt_yn, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS in_yn
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM wrk22tran a, dmkh b

	SELECT @eiFields = ' isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), ''''), a.so_seri, a.so_ct', @eiJoin = '', @printJoin = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @ei001 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
		SELECT @ei002 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		SELECT @eiFields = N' isnull(case when w.mau_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei001) + ''' else w.mau_hddt end, isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''')),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_seri_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei002) + ''' else w.so_seri_hddt end, a.so_seri),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_ct_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei003) + ''' else w.so_ct_hddt end, a.so_ct)',
			@eiJoin = ' left join hddt00$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6) + ' w with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = w.stt_rec'
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sl_in' AND val = '1')  SELECT @printTable = 'hdin$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6), @printJoin = ' left join ' + @printTable + ' p with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh,' + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ong_ba, e.ten_kh, e.ten_kh, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan, c.ten_ngan2'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word'	
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @eiJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when w.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @printJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when p.in_yn = 1 then 1 else 0 end' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @cMTable + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + @cDTable + ' d with(nolock) on (a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec and d.stt_rec0 = (select min(stt_rec0) from ' + @cDTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = a.stt_rec)) left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk' + @eiJoin	+ @printJoin
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(8)) AS ma_thue, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue_suat, thue_nt, thue INTO #detail FROM wrksvdetail a, dmvt b
	SET @q =  'insert into #detail select 1, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, cast('''' as nvarchar(33)), 0, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt, a.tien_nt2, gia, a.tien2, a.dien_giai' --Service Invoice
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ', a.ma_thue, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 12, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #detail set stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #copy(xGroup INT, ten_lien NVARCHAR(128), ten_lien2 NVARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = 1, @so_lien = so_lien FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVoucher
	SELECT ccode, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '') AS cname, cname2 INTO #reports FROM reports WHERE LEN(ccode) = 5 AND ccode LIKE (RTRIM('LIEN') + '%')
	SELECT @max = COUNT(*) FROM #reports
	WHILE @i <= @so_lien BEGIN
		IF @i <= @max BEGIN
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #copy SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', cname, cname2 FROM #reports WHERE ccode = ''LIEN' + RTRIM(@i) + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #copy VALUES(@i, '', '')
		END
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.sysprint, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
			, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
			, c.doi_tac, c.ma_so_thue, c.dia_chi, c.dien_thoai, c.tk_nh, c.ngan_hang, c.tinh_thanh, c.ma_nt, c.ngay_ct, c.ky_hieu, c.so_ct, c.so_seri, c.ngay, c.thang, c.nam
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') THEN '/' ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(a.thue_suat) END ELSE c.thue_suat END AS thue_suat
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kh ELSE c.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.thanh_toan ELSE c.thanh_toan2 END AS thanh_toan
			, c.t_tien2, c.t_tien_nt2, c.t_thue, c.t_thue_nt, c.t_tt, c.t_tt_nt, c.t_tt_nt_in_word, c.t_tt_in_word
			, c.dien_giai, c.customize, a.detail

			, a.thue_nt, a.thue
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 10 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_10, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 10 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_10
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 5 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_5, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 5 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_5
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_8, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_8
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_0, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_0
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_99, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_99
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 10 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_10, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 10 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_10
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 5 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_5, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 5 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_5
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_8, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_8
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_0, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_0
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_99, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_99
		INTO #report FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
				, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
		FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT xGroup, SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
								, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
							FROM #report WHERE ma_vt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY xGroup
							) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup
	UPDATE #report SET so_lien = '', so_lien2 = '', dien_giai = '', doi_tac = '', ten_kh = '', ma_so_thue = '', dia_chi = '', dien_thoai = '', tk_nh = '', ngan_hang = '', tinh_thanh = '', ma_nt = '', ngay_ct = NULL, ky_hieu = '', so_ct = '', so_seri = '', ngay = '', thang = '', nam = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1
	UPDATE #report SET t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt_in_word = '', t_tt_in_word = '', tien_nt_10 = 0, tien_10 = 0, tien_nt_5 = 0, tien_5 = 0, tien_nt_8 = 0, tien_8 = 0, tien_nt_0 = 0, tien_0 = 0, thue_nt_10 = 0, thue_10 = 0, thue_nt_5 = 0, thue_5 = 0, thue_nt_8 = 0, thue_8 = 0, thue_nt_0 = 0, thue_0 = 0, thue_nt_99 = 0, thue_99 = 0 WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	UPDATE #report SET customize = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1 AND line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	IF @printVATDetail = 0 UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 1
		SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup
				, so_lien, so_lien2, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam
				, thue_suat, ten_kh, thanh_toan, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word, dien_giai, customize, detail
			FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$IncreaseVoucherNumber]
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherNumber VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @VoucherNumber = RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherNumber))
	IF RTRIM(@VoucherBook) = '' BEGIN
		EXEC fs_IncreaseVoucherNo @VoucherNumber, @VoucherCode
	END ELSE BEGIN
		--EXEC fs20_UpdateVNo @VoucherNumber, @VoucherBook
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateVoucherNumberRegion @VoucherNumber, @VoucherBook
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSLiquidationReportExport] --fs20_FXLiquidate_Detail
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@TSCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @TSCode = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @TSCode = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	SELECT @Key = 'nam = ' + STR(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + STR(@Month), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @TSCode <> '' THEN 'so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@TSCode, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'select so_the_ts, sum(nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(gt_da_kh) as gt_da_kh, sum(gt_da_kh_nt) as gt_da_kh_nt, sum(gt_cl) as gt_cl, sum(gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt
		into #report from ctkhcc where ' + @Key + ' group by so_the_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select a.*, b.so_hieu_ts, b.nuoc_sx, b.nam_sx, isnull(year(b.ngay_dvsd), 0) as nam_sd'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''V'' then b.ten_ts else b.ten_ts2 end as ten_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhreqtlkdht]
AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_bd, CASE tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN N'Chính thức' ELSE N'Thử việc' END AS ten_tc, 
		CASE tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN 'Official' ELSE 'Probationary' END AS ten_tc2, a.he_so, a.luong_co_ban, a.t_tien_phu_cap, a.t_thu_nhap, a.ghi_chu, b.ten_nt, b.ten_nt2
	FROM hreqtlkdht a LEFT JOIN dmnt b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostSRTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@step TINYINT,
	@vat TINYINT = 1 --1:ctgt20, 2:ctgt30
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @tk VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @cMemo NVARCHAR(511), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT, @isPostTax TINYINT,
		@ten_vt NVARCHAR(511), @ghi_chu NVARCHAR(511), @tk_thue_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_thue_co VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh2 VARCHAR(32),
		@ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @so_ct0 VARCHAR(32), @so_seri VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct0 SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME,
		@t_tc_thue_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_thue NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@masterTaxCode VARCHAR(32), @EnvironmentalTax BIT


	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m76$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d76$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #outputvat FROM r20$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #inputvat FROM r30$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk_du, tk_vt AS tk0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tax, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS disc INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_thue_mt' AND val = '1') SELECT @EnvironmentalTax = 1 ELSE SELECT @EnvironmentalTax = 0

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @groupTaxReduction VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @groupTaxReduction = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_post_hh_hddt' AND val = '1')
			SELECT @groupTaxReduction = ', loai'
		ELSE
			EXEC sp_executesql N'update #detail set tien_nt2 = - tien_nt2, tien2 = - tien2 from #detail where loai = ''90'''
	END

	--
	SELECT TOP 1 @tk = tk, @cMemo = dien_giai, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_kh2 = ma_kh2, @ma_ct = ma_ct,
			@ten_vt = RTRIM(ten_vtthue), @ghi_chu = ghi_chuthue, @tk_thue_no = tk_thue_no, @tk_thue_co = tk_thue_co,
			@so_ct = so_ct, @so_ct0 = so_ct0, @so_seri = so_seri, @ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct0, @ngay_lct = ngay_lct,
			@t_tc_tien_nt2 = t_tc_tien_nt2 - t_ck_nt, @t_tc_tien2 = t_tc_tien2 - t_ck, @t_tc_thue_nt = t_tc_thue_nt, @t_tc_thue = t_tc_thue,
			@masterTaxCode = ma_thue
		FROM #master

	--
	IF (@masterTaxCode <> '' AND COL_LENGTH('d76$000000', 'ma_thue') IS NOT NULL) EXEC(N'update #detail set ma_thue = b.ma_thue, thue_suat = b.thue_suat from #detail a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''


	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SELECT @isPost = 1, @isPostTax = 1
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk_thue_co, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPostTax = 0

	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		/*1. Gia von*/
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '1 = 1', 'tien, tien_nt', 'tk_vt, tk_gv' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_gv, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = tk_gv, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = tien_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0


		/*2. Doanh thu*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			IF @EnvironmentalTax = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0 and tk_ck <> ''''', 'tien2, tien_nt2,thue_mt, thue_mt_nt', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - thue_mt, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - thue_mt_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - thue_mt, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - thue_mt_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0 and tk_ck <> ''''', 'tien2, tien_nt2', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END
		END

		/*3. Chiet khau*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0 and tk_ck <> ''''', 'ck, ck_nt', 'tk_ck' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_ck, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = ck, ps_no_nt = ck_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
		END

		/*4. Doanh thu ko nhap ck*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			IF @EnvironmentalTax = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0 and tk_ck = ''''', 'tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue_mt, thue_mt_nt', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - ck - thue_mt, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt - thue_mt_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - ck - thue_mt, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt - thue_mt_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0 and tk_ck = ''''', 'tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - ck, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2 - ck, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END
		END

		/*5. Chi phi ban hang*/
/*
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 1 and tk_dt <> tk_cpbh', 'tien2, tien_nt2', 'tk_dt, tk_cpbh' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = tien2, ps_co_nt = tien_nt2, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
*/

		/*6. Thue*/
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE t_thue + t_thue_nt + t_thue_km + t_thue_km_nt <> 0 AND tk_thue_co <> '') BEGIN

			IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(thue + thue_nt <> 0) and ((' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@isPostTax)) + ' = 1 and km_yn = 0) or km_yn > 1)', 'thue, thue_nt', 'km_yn, tk_cpbh' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk_thue_co, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, tk0 = @tk_thue_co, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0 AND km_yn = 0
				UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1, disc = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0 AND km_yn > 1
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #detail set ma_kh2 = '''' from #detail a where exists(select 1 from dmtk b where a.tk_thue = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 0)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(thue + thue_nt <> 0) and ((' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@isPostTax)) + ' = 1 and km_yn = 0) or km_yn > 1)', 'thue, thue_nt', 'km_yn, tk_cpbh, tk_thue, ma_kh2' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ',' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SET @q = 'update #dGL set tk = @tk_thue_co, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_co, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1, disc = 0 where isnull(c, 0) = 0 and km_yn = 0'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #dGL set tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co = thue, ps_co_nt = thue_nt, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1, disc = 0 where isnull(c, 0) = 0 and km_yn > 1'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_co varchar(32), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_co, @ma_kh
			END
		END

		/*7. Thue moi truong*/
		IF @EnvironmentalTax = 1 BEGIN
			EXEC rs_PostEnvironmentTax @masterTable, @detailTable, @glMasterTable, @glDetailTable, @idNumber, @groups, @step, 3, @isPost
		END

		-- Post to #gl
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0 WHERE disc = 1
		UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0 WHERE disc = 0
		IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh2 FROM #dGL a WHERE a.tax = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #dGL set ma_kh = ma_kh2 from #dGL a join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.tax = 1 and b.tk_cn = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_ctgs = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'

		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	-- (Loại kê khai)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ISNULL(loai_kk, '') = '9') RETURN

	-- Post tep thue
	DECLARE @cCustName NVARCHAR(511), @cAddress NVARCHAR(511), @cTaxCode NVARCHAR(511), @cCust VARCHAR(32), @vatTable VARCHAR(32), @tmp VARCHAR(32)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @ma_kh AND ma_so_thue <> '')
		SELECT @cCustName = ten_kh, @cAddress = dia_chi, @cTaxCode = ma_so_thue FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @ma_kh
	ELSE
		SELECT @cCustName = ten_kh, @cAddress = dia_chi, @cTaxCode = ma_so_thue FROM ctgt21 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	SELECT @vatTable = CASE WHEN @vat = 1 THEN 'ctgt20' ELSE 'ctgt30' END, @tmp = CASE WHEN @vat = 1 THEN '#outputvat' ELSE '#inputvat' END

	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT
	SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
		IF @ten_vt = ''	SELECT @ten_vt = ten_vt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = (SELECT TOP 1 ma_vt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_vt ORDER BY SUM(tien2) DESC)
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert(@tmp, '#master', @masterTable, @vatTable, '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #outputvat SET line_nbr = 1 WHERE line_nbr IS NULL
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE(@tmp, '#detail', @detailTable, @vatTable, 'a.line_nbr = 1', 'line_nbr = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'line_nbr')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @vat = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #outputvat SET tk_thue_co = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,
				t_tien2 = -@t_tc_tien2, t_tien_nt2 = -@t_tc_tien_nt2, t_thue = -@t_tc_thue, t_thue_nt = -@t_tc_thue_nt, ngay_ct = ngay_lct, ma_mau_ct = ''
			UPDATE #outputvat SET ngay_lct = CASE WHEN @ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_lct ELSE @ngay_ct0 END, so_ct = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@so_ct0, '') = '' THEN @so_ct ELSE @so_ct0 END

			IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
				UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien2 = t_tien2 + b.tien2, t_tien_nt2 = t_tien_nt2 + tien_nt2 FROM #outputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2 FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				DELETE #outputvat WHERE t_tien2 = 0 AND t_tien_nt2 = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE #inputvat SET tk_thue_no = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,
				t_tien = @t_tc_tien2, t_tien_nt = @t_tc_tien_nt2, t_thue = @t_tc_thue, t_thue_nt = @t_tc_thue_nt, stt_rec0 = '001', line_nbr = 1, so_luong = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia = 0
			UPDATE #inputvat SET so_seri0 = ISNULL(@so_seri, ''), ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN @ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_lct ELSE @ngay_ct0 END

			IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
				UPDATE #inputvat SET t_tien = t_tien - b.tien, t_tien_nt = t_tien_nt - tien_nt FROM #inputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien2) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				DELETE #inputvat WHERE t_tien = 0 AND t_tien_nt = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
			END
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @w NVARCHAR(511)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail WHERE ma_thue <> '') SET @w = '(ma_thue <> '''' or tien2 <> 0 or thue_suat <> 0)'
		ELSE SET @w = '1=1'
		IF @isGoodsType = 1 SELECT @w = @w + ' and loai <> ''07'''

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert(@tmp, '#detail', @detailTable, @vatTable, @w)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE(@tmp, '#master', @masterTable, @vatTable, '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ma_thue, thue_suat, ma_kh2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = ''
		IF @ten_vt = ''
			SET @q = 'select c.ma_thue, e.ten_vt into #tenvt'
					+ ' from (select a.ma_thue, min(b.line_nbr) as line_nbr from (select ma_thue, max(tien2) as tien2 from #detail group by ma_thue) a join #detail b on a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue and a.tien2 = b.tien2 group by a.ma_thue) c'
					+ ' join #detail d on c.ma_thue = d.ma_thue and c.line_nbr = d.line_nbr join dmvt e on d.ma_vt = e.ma_vt'
		IF @vat = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #outputvat set tk_thue_co = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode,'
					+ ' ten_vt = ' +  CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' c.ten_vt' ELSE '@ten_vt' END + ', ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,'
					+ ' t_tien_nt2 = -(b.tien_nt2 - b.ck_nt), t_tien2 = -(b.tien2 - b.ck), t_thue_nt = -b.thue_nt, t_thue = -b.thue, ngay_ct = ngay_lct, ma_mau_ct = '''', ma_kh = @ma_kh'
				+ ' from #outputvat a join #detail b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
				+ CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' join #tenvt c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_co varchar(32), @cCustName nvarchar(511), @cAddress nvarchar(511), @cTaxCode nvarchar(511), @ten_vt nvarchar(511), @ghi_chu nvarchar(511), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_co, @cCustName, @cAddress, @cTaxCode, @ten_vt, @ghi_chu, @ma_kh

			UPDATE #outputvat SET ngay_lct = CASE WHEN @ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_lct ELSE @ngay_ct0 END, so_ct = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@so_ct0, '') = '' THEN @so_ct ELSE @so_ct0 END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #inputvat set tk_thue_no = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode,'
					+ ' ten_vt = ' +  CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' c.ten_vt' ELSE '@ten_vt' END + ', ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,'
					+ ' t_tien_nt = b.tien_nt2 - b.ck_nt, t_tien = b.tien2 - b.ck, t_thue_nt = b.thue_nt, t_thue = b.thue, so_luong = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia = 0, ma_kh = @ma_kh'
				+ ' from #inputvat a join #detail b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
				+ CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' join #tenvt c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_co varchar(32), @cCustName nvarchar(511), @cAddress nvarchar(511), @cTaxCode nvarchar(511), @ten_vt nvarchar(511), @ghi_chu nvarchar(511), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_co, @cCustName, @cAddress, @cTaxCode, @ten_vt, @ghi_chu, @ma_kh

			UPDATE #inputvat SET so_seri0 = ISNULL(@so_seri, ''), ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN @ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN @ngay_lct ELSE @ngay_ct0 END
		END
	END
	UPDATE #inputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

	DELETE ctgt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	DELETE ctgt30 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	IF @vat = 1 INSERT INTO ctgt20 SELECT * FROM #outputvat
	ELSE INSERT INTO ctgt30 SELECT * FROM #inputvat


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostISTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@idNumber CHAR(13), 
	@groups VARCHAR(128), 
	@step TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @step <= 1 RETURN

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @ma_ct CHAR(3)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m84$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d84$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk0, tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk INTO #dGL FROM #detail
			
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct FROM #master
	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''


	/*1. Gia von*/
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(tk_vt <> tk_du) and (not (' + '(''' +@noAccounts + ''' <> '''') and (dbo.ff_inlist(tk_du, ''' + @noAccounts + ''') = 1)))', 'tien, tien_nt', 'tk_vt, tk_du' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = tk_du, ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = tien_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt

	-- Post to #gl
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_vt, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 2, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_lo = '''', so_ctgs = '''', so_ct0 = '''', so_dh = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai, ma_kh = b.ma_kh'

	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl			


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rpt053BK] --rs_rpt05ABK
	@Year INT,
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '1231' AS SMALLDATETIME)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.ten_ns, a.ma_so_thue
			, b.ma_pt, b.ten_pt, b.ngay_sinh AS ngay_sinh_pt, b.ma_qt AS ma_qt_pt, b.ma_loai_gt AS ma_loai_gt, b.cmnd AS cmnd_pt, b.quan_he AS quan_he_pt, b.so_khai_sinh AS so_khai_sinh_pt, b.quyen_so AS quyen_so_pt, b.quoc_gia AS quoc_gia_pt
			, b.tinh_thanh AS tinh_thanh_pt, b.quan_huyen AS quan_huyen_pt, b.phuong_xa AS phuong_xa_pt, b.ma_so_thue AS ma_so_thue_pt, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den
			, b.loai_qh
		INTO #report FROM phns a, ctns2 b

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	--Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = '((a.ngay_hl_tu <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''') and ((a.ngay_hl_den is null) or (a.ngay_hl_den >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''')))'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + 'b.ma_ns like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_bp INTO #t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$TaxDepartment(@Department)
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_bp in (select ma_bp from #t)'
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 0, 0, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_ns, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_ns' ELSE 'b.ten_ns2' END + ', b.ma_so_thue'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_pt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'a.ten_pt' ELSE 'a.ten_pt2' END + ', a.ngay_sinh, a.ma_qt, a.ma_loai_gt, a.cmnd,' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_qh' ELSE 'c.ten_qh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.so_khai_sinh, a.quyen_so, a.quoc_gia, a.tinh_thanh, a.quan_huyen, a.phuong_xa, a.ma_so_thue, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.loai_qh'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctns2 a with(nolock) left join phns b with(nolock) on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns left join dmqhpt c with(nolock) on a.loai_qh = c.loai_qh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' and b.ma_ns + b.ma_dvcs in (select ma_ns + ma_dvcs from t03$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' where f009 + f009_nt > 0)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_hl_tu = @DateFrom WHERE ngay_hl_tu < @DateFrom
	UPDATE #report SET ngay_hl_den = @DateTo WHERE ngay_hl_den > @DateTo OR ngay_hl_den IS NULL

	--Stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_dvcs, ma_ns INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	UPDATE #report SET #report.stt = a.id, #report.sysorder = a.id FROM #o a WHERE #report.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND #report.ma_ns = a.ma_ns
	DROP TABLE #o

	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = NULL, ma_dvcs = '', ma_ns = '', ten_ns = '', ma_so_thue = ''
		WHERE ma_dvcs + ma_ns + ma_pt + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_hl_tu, 112) NOT IN (SELECT ma_dvcs + ma_ns + MIN(ma_pt + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_hl_tu, 112)) FROM #report GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns)

	Result:
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, ma_pt) SELECT '', '', ''
	IF @Form = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @cmnd_pt VARCHAR(128)
		UPDATE #report SET @cmnd_pt = CASE WHEN cmnd_pt = '' THEN so_khai_sinh_pt ELSE cmnd_pt END,
			ma_loai_gt = CASE WHEN ma_so_thue_pt <> '' THEN '' ELSE ma_loai_gt END,
			cmnd_pt = CASE WHEN ma_so_thue_pt <> '' THEN '' ELSE @cmnd_pt END
	END

	SELECT a.sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.ten_ns, a.ma_so_thue, a.ma_pt, a.ten_pt, a.ngay_sinh_pt, a.cmnd_pt
			, a.loai_qh AS ma_qh_pt, a.quan_he_pt
			, a.so_khai_sinh_pt, a.quyen_so_pt, a.quoc_gia_pt, a.tinh_thanh_pt, a.quan_huyen_pt, a.phuong_xa_pt, MONTH(a.ngay_hl_tu) AS tu_thang, MONTH(a.ngay_hl_den) AS den_thang
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_qt ELSE b.ten_qt2 END AS ten_qt, a.ma_so_thue_pt
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_so_thue <> '' THEN '0' ELSE c.ma_htkk END AS ma_loai_gt
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_so_thue <> '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_loai_gt ELSE c.ten_loai_gt2 END END AS ten_loai_gt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmqt b ON a.ma_qt_pt = b.ma_qt LEFT JOIN dmloaigt c ON a.ma_loai_gt = c.ma_loai_gt
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.ma_pt, a.ngay_hl_tu

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_BIUDMultiCreate]
	@inspectionDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@inspectionDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@usageDecisionCode VARCHAR(32),
	@resultCode VARCHAR(32),
	@reason VARCHAR(32),
	@desciption NVARCHAR(512),
	@status VARCHAR(1),
	@voucherList VARCHAR(4000),
	@field VARCHAR(32) OUT,
	@message NVARCHAR(512) OUT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @d0 SMALLDATETIME, @stockStatus VARCHAR(1), @qualityScore NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @wsID VARCHAR(8), @voucherCode CHAR(3), @size INT, @id0 VARCHAR(32), @id1 VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @n INT, @m$ VARCHAR(32), @d$ VARCHAR(32), @i$ VARCHAR(32), @c$ VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @p1 VARCHAR(32), @p2 VARCHAR(32), @p3 VARCHAR(32), @l2 INT, @startCode NVARCHAR(33), @endCode NVARCHAR(33), @startNum NUMERIC(12,0), @maxNum NUMERIC(12, 0), @count NUMERIC(12, 0)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_kd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_lo_kd, a.so_ct AS so_lo_kd, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai, a.ma_vt, a.qd_tung_phan
		, b.dvt, b.he_so, b.ma_kho, b.ma_lo, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, b.ma_vung, b.ma_nguon, b.ma_kh, b.so_luong0 , CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS pp_chat_luong, CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS diem_yn, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_so
		, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong, b.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_vv, b.chuyen_ton_kho, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt INTO #qdsd FROM bikd a, bikd00$000000 b
	SELECT TOP 0 x.*, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(8000)) AS c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(8000)) AS m$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(8000)) AS d$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(8000)) AS e$ INTO #m FROM bim14$000000 x RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 x.* INTO #d FROM bid14$000000 x RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Set
	IF @usageDecisionCode = '' SELECT @usageDecisionCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_loai'
	IF @resultCode = '' SELECT @resultCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_kq'
	IF @reason = '' SELECT @reason = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_ld'

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bikddmlqd WHERE ma_loai_qd = @usageDecisionCode)BEGIN
		SELECT @field = 'ma_loai_qd', @message = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN N'Trường <span class="Highlight">Loại quyết định</span> chưa nhập hoặc giá trị nhập không hợp lệ.' ELSE N'Field <span class="Highlight">Usage Decision Code</span> must not be blank or has invalid value.' END
		RETURN
	END
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bikddmkq WHERE ma_kq = @resultCode) BEGIN
		SELECT @field = 'ma_kq', @message = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN N'Trường <span class="Highlight">Kết quả</span> chưa nhập hoặc giá trị nhập không hợp lệ.' ELSE N'Field <span class="Highlight">Result Code</span> must not be blank or has invalid value.' END
		RETURN
	END
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmnx WHERE ma_nx = @reason) BEGIN
		SELECT @field = 'ma_ly_do', @message = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN N'Trường <span class="Highlight">Lý do</span> chưa nhập hoặc giá trị nhập không hợp lệ.' ELSE N'Field <span class="Highlight">Reason</span> must not be blank or has invalid value.' END
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @qualityScore = diem_so FROM bikddmlqd WHERE ma_loai_qd = @usageDecisionCode
	SELECT @stockStatus = tt_ton_kho FROM bikddmkq WHERE ma_kq = @resultCode

	SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	IF @voucherList = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @voucherList = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @d0 = GETDATE(), @voucherCode = 'KD6', @size = character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'bim14$000000' and column_name = 'so_ct'
	SELECT @m$ = m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(m$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, @d$ = d$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(d$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, @i$ = i$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(i$), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, @c$ = c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @voucherList <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherList, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Source
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #qdsd (stt_rec_kd, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, part, stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, dien_giai, ma_vt, qd_tung_phan, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_lo, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh, so_luong0)
	select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112), '''', '''', ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), CAST(@voucherDate AS SMALLDATETIME), 112) + ''', '''', a.ma_vt, a.qd_tung_phan, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_lo, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong
		from bikd00$%Partition a where %[' + @Key + ']% order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @inspectionDateFrom, @inspectionDateTo, @userID, @admin

	-- Destination
	-- + Number
	IF (@voucherBook = '') BEGIN
		SELECT @startNum = so_ct FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
		UPDATE #qdsd SET so_ct = CAST((@startNum + id_stt) AS VARCHAR(33))
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @startCode = so_ct0, @endCode = so_ct2 FROM v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @voucherBook

		DECLARE @r BIT
		EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @StartCode, @r OUT, @startNum OUT, @p2 OUT, @p1 OUT, 1, @p3 OUT, 1

		IF @p2 = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @field = 'ma_quyen', @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Không xác định được số bắt đầu của quyển chứng từ: <span class="Highlight">' ELSE N'Can not determine the number of voucher book: <span class="Highlight">' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherBook, '\', '\\'), '''', '\''') + '</span>'
			RETURN
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @l2 = LEN(@p2), @maxNum = SUBSTRING(@endCode, LEN(@p1) + CASE WHEN @r = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, @l2)
		END

		SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #qdsd
		IF (@count + @startNum) > @maxNum BEGIN
			SELECT @field = 'ma_quyen', @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Không đủ số chứng từ của quyển chứng từ: <span class="Highlight">' ELSE N'Not enough remaining voucher numbers of voucher book: <span class="Highlight">' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherBook, '\', '\\'), '''', '\''') + '</span>'
			RETURN
		END

		-- ++ Update Voucher Number
		UPDATE #qdsd SET so_ct = @p1 + RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', 33) + CAST((@startNum + id_stt) AS VARCHAR(33)), CASE WHEN @l2 >= LEN(RTRIM((@startNum + id_stt))) THEN @l2 ELSE LEN(RTRIM((@startNum + id_stt))) END) + @p3
	END

	UPDATE #qdsd SET so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(so_ct), @size)
	SELECT @endCode = RTRIM(LTRIM(MAX(so_ct))) FROM #qdsd
	IF RTRIM(@voucherBook) = ''
		EXEC fs_IncreaseVoucherNo @endCode, @voucherCode
	ELSE
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateVoucherNumberRegion @endCode, @voucherBook

	-- + Update
	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #qdsd
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, @voucherCode, @count, @userID, '#qdsd', 'stt_rec', 'id_stt'

	-- Score
	SELECT DISTINCT part INTO #$p FROM #qdsd
	SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #$p
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
update a
	set pp_chat_luong = c.pp_chat_luong
		, diem_yn = isnull(rtrim(d.val), isnull(rtrim(e.val), rtrim(f.val)))
		, so_luong = case when a.qd_tung_phan = ''1'' then (isnull(b.so_luong0, 0) - isnull(b.sl_qdsd, 0)) else b.so_luong0 end
		, ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri, ma_vv = b.ma_vv, chuyen_ton_kho = b.chuyen_ton_kho
from #qdsd a
	left join bikd00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec left join bikddmloai c on b.ma_loai_kd = c.ma_loai left join bidmvttsbp0 d on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_bp0 = d.ma_bp0 and d.name = ''danh_gia_ncc''
	left join bidmvtts e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and e.name = ''danh_gia_ncc'' left join bidmts f on f.controller = ''Item'' and f.name = ''danh_gia_ncc''
where a.part = ''' + @p + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #$p WHERE part > @p
	END
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_so INTO #$qdsd FROM #qdsd WHERE pp_chat_luong <> '1' AND diem_yn = '1'
	EXEC bs_CalculateInspectionScore '#$qdsd', NULL, @userID, @admin
	UPDATE a SET diem_so = b.diem_so FROM #qdsd a JOIN #$qdsd b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec_kd

	-- m$, d$, i$, c$
	INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_kq, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_ly_do, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, tt_ton_kho, ghi_chu, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, '001', @resultCode, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, @reason, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, @stockStatus, '', a.ma_vv, '', '', '', '', '', '', 1 FROM #qdsd a
	INSERT INTO #m (stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh, ma_vt, chuyen_ton_kho, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_gd, dien_giai, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ma_loai_qd, sl_lo_kd, t_so_luong, diem_so, [status], datetime0, [datetime2], user_id0, user_id2, job_id, prd_id, dept_id, mo_nbr, contract_id, bcontract_id, fee_id, s6)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.chuyen_ton_kho, 'KD6', '1', '1', CASE WHEN @desciption <> '' THEN @desciption ELSE a.dien_giai END, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct
				, @voucherBook, @usageDecisionCode, a.so_luong0, 0, CASE WHEN a.pp_chat_luong = '1' THEN @qualityScore ELSE ISNULL(a.diem_so, 0) END, @status, @d0, @d0, @userID, @userID, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', 0
			FROM #qdsd a LEFT JOIN #d d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
	UPDATE a SET t_so_luong = b.so_luong FROM #m a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(ISNULL(so_luong, 0)) AS so_luong FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	--
	SELECT @m$ = m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(m$), 1) = '$' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) ELSE '' END, @d$ = d$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(d$), 1) = '$' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) ELSE '' END
		, @i$ = i$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(i$), 1) = '$' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) ELSE '' END, @c$ = c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	-- + i$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#m', '#d', 'd$', 'ma_kho', '#10$', 'stt_rec', 'c$ = convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec, m$ = ''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_vt )+ ''#15$'' + rtrim(a.loai_ct )+ ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.ma_vung),', DEFAULT, @voucherCode, 'e$', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: d$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@d$, '#d', @d$, @d$, NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: m$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@m$, '#m', @m$, @m$, NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: i$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@i$, '#m', @i$, @i$, NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: c$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@c$, '#m', @c$, @c$, NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Post Inspection
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(id_stt) FROM #qdsd
	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @id0 = stt_rec_kd, @p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_lo_kd, 112), @id1 = stt_rec FROM #qdsd WHERE id_stt = @i

		SELECT @q = 'insert into bikd04$' + @p + ' (stt_rec_goc, ngay_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_ct_goc, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, nhom_du_lieu) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_ct, ''KD6'', stt_rec_kd, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, ''06'' from #m where stt_rec = @id1 and stt_rec_kd = @id0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@id0 char(13), @id1 char(13)', @id0, @id1

		IF @status = '1' EXEC bs_PostInspection '6', @voucherCode, @id1, @id0, @userID, @admin, @sysDB

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
