CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$CancelInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @provider INT, @e INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	SELECT @e = a.kieu_ky_so FROM dmkysohddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND b.status = 1
	SELECT @e = CASE WHEN @e IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ELSE @e END

	IF @provider = 1 AND @e = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherID AS [key]
		RETURN
	END


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' SELECT @refTable = '84$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c84$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' SELECT @refTable = '85$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c85$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + @p

	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select a.so_bi_mat, b.ma_dvcs, b.mau_hddt, c.ly_do_huy, c.so_huy as so_bb_huy, c.ngay_huy from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hddt04 c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END


	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt, ngay_ct INTO #master FROM hddt00$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, rtrim(b.ma_dvcs), '''', a.mau_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.so_ct_hddt, a.ngay_ct from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @m + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(ma_so_thue) FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND status = '1'
	IF @taxCode IS NULL SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_thue'
	UPDATE #master SET ma_so_thue = ISNULL(@taxCode, '')

	--
	SELECT stt_rec AS [key], ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt FROM #master

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_BgYear(@pS TINYINT, @yS INT)
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @dS SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dS = CAST(STR(@yS, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@pS, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' AS SMALLDATETIME)
	RETURN YEAR(dbo.ff_BgDate(@dS))
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll006]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Type CHAR(1),-- 1 - Increase, 2 - Decrease
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Income, 2 - Award
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Round INT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @Total NVARCHAR(256), @Ma_nt CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @Table VARCHAR(32), @NameField VARCHAR(32), @OrderField VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WITH(nolock) WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @Ma_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'

	IF @ReportType = 1
		SELECT @DetailTable = 'hrcttngt', @Table = 'hrdmtngt', @NameField = 'ten_loai', @OrderField = '0'
	ELSE
		SELECT @DetailTable = 'hrcttp', @Table = 'hrdmloaitp', @NameField = 'ten_ngan', @OrderField = 'max(c.stt)'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay, ngay AS ngay_cuoi_ky, a.stt_rec, a.loai, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, a.tien, a.tien AS tien_nt INTO #t1 FROM hrcttp a, hrdmtgtl b
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, a.ky, a.nam, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay INTO #hrky FROM hrky a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.tien, a.tien_nt, b.stt, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_nv, a.loai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_loai, b.stt AS stt_tp
		INTO #report FROM #t1 a, hrnv b

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT	
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'b.')

	INSERT INTO #hrky EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$GetPeriod$Department @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, '', @Key, 'b', @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	SELECT @Key = 'c.loai = ' + @Type + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ' and tien <> 0'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nv = REPLACE(@EmployeeID, '''', '''''')
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@IDNumber) + ''''
	END

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SET @Join = ' left join #hreqtlvht b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join #hrky e on a.ngay between e.ngay_tu and e.ngay_den and e.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	-- Current Working History
	SELECT @d1 = MIN(ngay_tu), @d2 = MAX(ngay_den) FROM #hrky
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan AS ma_bp, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #hreqtlvht0 FROM hreqtlvht
	--
	INSERT INTO #hreqtlvht0 EXEC hs_GetEmployeeWorkingHistory @d1, @d2, 'a.tinh_chat = ''1''', '', 1, '', '', 1
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1023)) AS bp_ref, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv3, CAST(0 AS INT) AS [user_id] INTO #hreqtlvht FROM #hreqtlvht0 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_den) AS ngay_den FROM #hreqtlvht0 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den
	UPDATE #hreqtlvht SET ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs, bp_ref = b.bp_ref, nh_nv1 = c.nh_nv1, nh_nv2 = c.nh_nv2, nh_nv3 = c.nh_nv3, [user_id] = c.[user_id] FROM #hreqtlvht a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN hrnv c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t1 select a.ngay, e.ngay_den, a.stt_rec, a.loai, d.ma_nt, null, a.tien, a.tien' 	
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock) left join ' + @Table + ' c with(nolock) on a.loai = c.ma_loai left join hrttluong d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Calculate Exchange Rate
	SELECT a.ngay_cuoi_ky, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl, a.ma_nt INTO #ty_gia1
		FROM #t1 a JOIN hrdmtgtl b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND b.ngay_hl <= a.ngay_cuoi_ky
		WHERE a.ma_nt <> @Ma_nt
		GROUP BY a.ngay_cuoi_ky, a.ma_nt

	SELECT a.ngay_cuoi_ky, a.ma_nt, b.ty_gia
		INTO #ty_gia2 FROM #ty_gia1 a JOIN hrdmtgtl b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl

	UPDATE #t1 SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia FROM #t1 a JOIN #ty_gia2 b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_cuoi_ky = b.ngay_cuoi_ky
	UPDATE #t1 SET tien = ROUND(tien * ISNULL(ty_gia, 0), @Round) WHERE ma_nt <> @ma_nt

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt),'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' max(b.stt), a.stt_rec, max(b.ma_nv), max(b.ho_nv) + space(1) + max(b.ten_nv), a.loai, '
	SELECT @q = @q + ' max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @NameField ELSE @NameField + '2' END + '),' + @OrderField
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #t1 a left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'left join ' + @Table + ' c with(nolock) on a.loai = c.ma_loai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.stt_rec, a.loai'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, stt_rec INTO #stt FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_nv, stt ORDER BY stt, ma_nv
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 1, 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), NULL, '', '', @Total, loai, MAX(ten_loai), MAX(stt_tp) FROM #report GROUP BY loai
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, NULL, CHAR(10), '', '', loai, MAX(ten_loai), MAX(stt_tp) FROM #report GROUP BY loai
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', '', '', 0

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END AS VARCHAR(32)) AS name, MAX(ten_loai) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY loai ORDER BY MAX(stt_tp), loai
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = RTRIM(name) + RTRIM(id)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien' ELSE 'tien_nt' END, @Total

	-- Result
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_rec, ma_nv, ten_nv, REPLICATE('0', 5 - LEN(RTRIM(stt_tp))) + RTRIM(stt_tp) + loai AS loai, ten_loai, tien, tien_nt FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, stt, stt_tp, loai
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdtyctvt]
	AS
		SELECT a.*, b.stt_ref, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2, c.ten_vtr, c.ten_vtr2, d.ten_mh, d.ten_mh2, c.stt AS stt_vtr, d.stt AS stt_mh
			FROM hrdtyctvt a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr LEFT JOIN hrdmmh d ON a.ma_mh = d.ma_mh
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPurchaseExpenseSummary]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	DECLARE @cp_vc AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_vc_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_bh AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_bh_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_khac AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_khac_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @cp_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @thue AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @s AS NVARCHAR(512)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT
	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt, a.cp_vc, a.cp_vc_nt, a.cp_bh, a.cp_bh_nt, a.cp_khac, a.cp_khac_nt, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt
		INTO #t
		FROM wrkin a

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + REPLACE(@Form, '''', '') + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + REPLACE(@CalculateTransfer, '''', '')
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT

	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_vt, max(a.ma_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.cp_vc), sum(a.cp_vc_nt), sum(a.cp_bh), sum(a.cp_bh_nt), sum(a.cp_khac), sum(a.cp_khac_nt), sum(a.cp), sum(a.cp_nt), sum(case when a.ma_ct <> ''PNC'' then 0 else a.thue end), sum(case when a.ma_ct <> ''PNC'' then 0 else a.thue_nt end)'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, MAX(dvt) AS dvt, MAX(nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3, MAX(loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt
			, SUM(cp_vc) AS cp_vc, SUM(cp_vc_nt) AS cp_vc_nt, SUM(cp_bh) AS cp_bh, SUM(cp_bh_nt) AS cp_bh_nt, SUM(cp_khac) AS cp_khac, SUM(cp_khac_nt) AS cp_khac_nt, SUM(cp) AS cp, SUM(cp_nt) AS cp_nt
			, SUM(thue) AS thue, SUM(thue_nt) AS thue_nt
		INTO #report
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		HAVING SUM(cp) + SUM(cp_nt) > 0

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement


	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(CASE WHEN @Groups <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE 'ma_vt' END, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	SELECT @cp_vc = SUM(cp_vc), @cp_bh = SUM(cp_bh), @cp_khac = SUM(cp_khac), @cp = SUM(cp), @thue = SUM(thue),
			@cp_vc_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cp_vc_nt) END, @cp_bh_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cp_bh_nt) END,
			@cp_khac_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cp_khac_nt) END, @cp_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cp_nt) END,
			@thue_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_nt) END
		FROM #report
		WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = 'LOAI_VT'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt',
				'cp_vc, cp_vc_nt, cp_bh, cp_bh_nt, cp_khac, cp_khac_nt, cp, cp_nt, thue, thue_nt',
				'#report', 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups , 'vt',
				'cp_vc, cp_vc_nt, cp_bh, cp_bh_nt, cp_khac, cp_khac_nt, cp, cp_nt, thue, thue_nt',
				'#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, cp_vc, cp_vc_nt, cp_bh, cp_bh_nt, cp_khac, cp_khac_nt, cp, cp_nt, thue, thue_nt)
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s, @s, @cp_vc, @cp_vc_nt, @cp_bh, @cp_bh_nt, @cp_khac, @cp_khac_nt, @cp, @cp_nt, @thue, @thue_nt)
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = ''
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, cp_vc, cp_vc_nt, cp_bh, cp_bh_nt, cp_khac, cp_khac_nt, cp, cp_nt, thue, thue_nt FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, cp_vc, cp_vc_nt, cp_bh, cp_bh_nt, cp_khac, cp_khac_nt, cp, cp_nt, thue, thue_nt FROM #report ORDER BY ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder, ' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPMTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt0, a.gia0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0 '
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt'
									WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 11, '''+@cVoucher+''', ''dvt, ma_kho, ma_vt, tk_vt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2ReappraisalReportExport]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@code VARCHAR(4000),
	@dept VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @code <> '' THEN 'a.ma_dc in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@code, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.ma_dc) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @key = @key + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year)
	IF @dept <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@dept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, b.ma_dc, b.so_hieu_dc
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, b.ten_dc
		INTO #report
		FROM ctcddc a, dmccdc b

	SET @q = 'insert into #report
	select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, max(b.so_hieu_dc)
			, sum(a.nguyen_gia) as nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) as nguyen_gia_nt
			, sum(a.gt_da_pb) as gt_da_pb, sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt) as gt_da_pb_nt, sum(a.gt_cl) as gt_cl
			, sum(a.gt_cl_nt) as gt_cl_nt, max(b.ten_dc%l)
		 from ctcddc a with(nolock)
		 left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
		 where ' + @Key +
		' group by a.ma_dc'

	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'ma_dc', '#report', 'stt', ''
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_dc

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintFACard] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cmDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cMDTable CHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, MAX(a.ngay_gs) ngay_gs'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', SUM(a.nguyen_gia) nguyen_gia, SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt) nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', SUM(a.gt_da_kh) gt_da_kh, SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt) gt_da_kh_nt, MAX(a.dien_giai) dien_giai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct ORDER BY a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT h.line_nbr, h.ten_ptkt,h.dvt,h.so_luong,h.gia_tri,h.gia_tri_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cMDTable)+' h' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' +@cmDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY h.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintAITran]
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@MTable CHAR(10),
	@DTable CHAR(10),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @l CHAR(1), @Copy NVARCHAR(511), @Copy2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), @so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), @so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), @discount NVARCHAR(256), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Bilingual = 1 SET @l = 'V' ELSE SET @l = @Language
	SELECT @Copy = CASE WHEN @l = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, @Copy2 = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN cname2 ELSE '' END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT056'
	SELECT @q = ''

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @p CHAR(13)
		SELECT @p = 'hddt00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

		IF OBJECT_ID(@p) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		  CREATE TABLE #hddt(mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32))
		  SET @q = 'insert into #hddt select mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt from ' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		  EXEC sp_executesql @q
		  SELECT @mau_hddt = mau_hddt, @so_seri_hddt = so_seri_hddt, @so_ct_hddt = so_ct_hddt FROM #hddt
		END
		IF @so_ct_hddt = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @mau_hddt = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
			SELECT @so_seri_hddt = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
			SELECT @so_ct_hddt = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		END
	END

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba as doi_tac, a.ma_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh2, isnull(e.ma_so_thue, b.ma_so_thue) as ma_so_thue, isnull(e.dia_chi, b.dia_chi) as dia_chi,'
	SET @q = @q + N' b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan as thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 as thanh_toan2, N''' + RTRIM(@Copy) + ''' as so_lien,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @mau_hddt IS NOT NULL THEN '''' + REPLACE(@mau_hddt, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'isnull(k.ky_hieu, '''')' END + ' as ky_hieu, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @so_seri_hddt IS NOT NULL THEN '''' + REPLACE(@so_seri_hddt, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'a.so_seri' END + ' as so_seri, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @so_ct_hddt IS NOT NULL THEN '''' + REPLACE(@so_ct_hddt, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE 'a.so_ct' END + ' as so_ct, '
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ngay_ct, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(t.thue_suat) as thue_suat,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_nt, (a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck) as t_tien2, (a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt) as t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang,'
	SET @q = @q + ' cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam, a.dien_giai,'

	IF @Form = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien2, ''' + REPLACE(@l, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt2, ''' + REPLACE(@l, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien2, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt2, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2,'
		SET @q = @q + N' N''' + RTRIM(@Copy2) + ''' as so_lien2, 1 as fix_yn'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END + ' as customize'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@MTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmthue t with(nolock) on a.ma_thue = t.ma_thue'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@MTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q = 'select a.line_nbr, cast('''' as varchar(33)) as tk_dt, a.tien_nt2, a.tien2, a.dien_giai as dien_giai_ct, cast('''' as nvarchar(33)) as ma_vt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' 0 as km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt as gia_nt2, gia as gia2, a.dien_giai as ten_vt, cast('''' as nvarchar(511)) as ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@DTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''

	--Them dong tien chiet khau		
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_006' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'select @discountOut = ghi_chuthue, @tienOut = t_ck, @tien_ntOut = t_ck_nt from ' + @MTable + ' a where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@discountOut nvarchar(256) output, @tienOut numeric(28, 6) output, @tien_ntOut numeric(28, 6) output', @discount OUTPUT, @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
		IF @discount = ''
			SELECT @discount = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'

		IF @tien <> 0 OR @tien_nt <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'declare @c int select @c = max(line_nbr) + 1 from #report'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #report (ten_vt, ten_vt2, km_yn, line_nbr, tk_dt, so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, detail) select N''' + REPLACE(@discount, '''', '''''') + ''', '''', 0, @c, '''',0, 0 , 0,' + RTRIM(@tien) + ',' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ', '''''
		END
	END

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 13, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''tk_dt, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt, ten_vt2'', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$CheckVoucherNumber]
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(13),
	@NextVoucherNumber VARCHAR(32) = '' OUTPUT,
	@ExternalCheck TINYINT = 0,
	@ExternalValue VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Force VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @nType INT, @c VARCHAR(2), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @n INT, @ExternalKey NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @CheckVoucherBook CHAR(1), @IsNextVoucher CHAR(1), @ParentVoucher CHAR(3), @CurrentVoucherNumber VARCHAR(33), @VoucherBookUnit NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @MinVoucherBookNumber VARCHAR(32), @MaxVoucherBookNumber VARCHAR(32), @oldVoucherBook VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @nType = NULL, @c = '0', @NextVoucherNumber = ''
	SELECT @CheckVoucherBook = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_quyen'
	SELECT @IsNextVoucher = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ct_tt'
	SELECT @ParentVoucher = ma_ct_me FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	IF @VoucherBook <> '' SELECT @VoucherBookUnit = ma_dvcs, @nType = m_trung_so, @CurrentVoucherNumber = so_ct0, @MinVoucherBookNumber = so_ct1, @MaxVoucherBookNumber = so_ct2 FROM v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook
	IF @nType IS NULL SELECT @nType = m_trung_so, @CurrentVoucherNumber = so_ct FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF @nType < 0 SELECT @c = '-1', @nType = - @nType

	IF @Force = '1' SELECT @nType = 5, @c = '0', @oldVoucherBook = @VoucherBook, @VoucherBook = ''
	IF @nType = 0
		SELECT CAST(1 AS INT) AS value
	ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UserAdmin INT

		SELECT @DateFrom = ngay_gh1, @DateTo = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
		SELECT TOP 1 @UserAdmin = id FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE admin = 1 AND user_yn = 1
		SELECT @q = '', @Key = ''
		CREATE TABLE #t (so_ct VARCHAR(32))

		SELECT @Key = CASE
				WHEN @nType = 1 THEN 'ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @VoucherDate, 112) + ''''
				WHEN @nType = 2 THEN 'month(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(MONTH(@VoucherDate), 2) + ' and year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				WHEN @nType = 3 THEN 'datepart(qq, ngay_ct) = ' + STR(DATEPART(qq, @VoucherDate), 2) + ' and year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				WHEN @nType = 4 THEN 'year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				ELSE ''
			END

		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'so_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @VoucherBook <> '' AND @CheckVoucherBook = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_nk = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherBook, '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @VoucherBook <> '' AND @VoucherBookUnit <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherBookUnit, '''', '''''') + ''''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = 1) SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and status <> ''*'''

		CREATE TABLE #e (ma_ct CHAR(3), e NVARCHAR(1024))
		IF @ExternalCheck = 1 AND OBJECT_ID('dmct7') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			DECLARE @k VARCHAR(512), @output VARCHAR(128), @e NVARCHAR(4000), @p NVARCHAR(4000)
			SELECT @p = '@o varchar(128) output', @e = 'select @o = k from dmct7 where ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @e, @p, @output OUTPUT
			--
			IF ISNULL(@output, '') <> '' SELECT @ExternalKey = ' and (' + REPLACE(@output, '%s', REPLACE(@ExternalValue, '''', '''''')) + ')'

			IF @VoucherBook <> '' SELECT @q = 'insert into #e select ma_ct, '' and '' + replace(k, ''%s'', ''' + REPLACE(@ExternalValue, '''', '''''''''') + ''') from dmct7 where ma_ct <> ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '') + ''' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from v20dmctnk where ma_nk = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherBook, '''', '') + ''')'
				ELSE SELECT @q = 'insert into #e select ma_ct, '' and '' + replace(k, ''%s'', ''' + REPLACE(@ExternalValue, '''', '''''''''') + ''') from dmct7 where ma_ct <> ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '') + ''' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from dmct where ma_ct_me = ''' + REPLACE(@ParentVoucher, '''', '') + ''')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		CREATE TABLE #q (id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), q NVARCHAR(4000))
		IF @VoucherBook <> '' BEGIN
			IF @VoucherCode = 'PNF'
				INSERT INTO #q
					SELECT 'insert into #t select top 1 so_ct from ' + c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' where ' + @Key + ISNULL(b.e, '')
						FROM dmct9 a LEFT JOIN #e b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE c$ <> '' AND a.ma_ct <> @VoucherCode AND a.ma_ct <> 'PXB' AND a.ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM v20dmctnk WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook)
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF @VoucherCode = 'PNI'
					INSERT INTO #q
						SELECT 'insert into #t select top 1 so_ct from ' + c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' where ' + @Key + ISNULL(b.e, '')
							FROM dmct9 a LEFT JOIN #e b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE c$ <> '' AND a.ma_ct <> @VoucherCode AND a.ma_ct <> 'PXI' AND a.ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM v20dmctnk WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook)
				ELSE
					INSERT INTO #q
						SELECT 'insert into #t select top 1 so_ct from ' + c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' where ' + @Key + ISNULL(b.e, '')
							FROM dmct9 a LEFT JOIN #e b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE c$ <> '' AND a.ma_ct <> @VoucherCode AND a.ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM v20dmctnk WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook)
			END
		END ELSE
			INSERT INTO #q
				SELECT 'insert into #t select top 1 so_ct from ' + c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' where ' + @Key + ISNULL(b.e, '')
					FROM dmct9 a LEFT JOIN #e b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE c$ <> '' AND a.ma_ct <> @VoucherCode AND a.ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct_me = @ParentVoucher)
		--
		INSERT INTO #q
			SELECT 'insert into #t select top 1 so_ct from ' + @Table + ' where ' + @Key + ISNULL(@ExternalKey, '') + CASE WHEN @IDNumber = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and stt_rec <> ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '') + '''' END

		--
		SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(1) FROM #q
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			SELECT @q = q FROM #q WHERE id = @i
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t) BREAK

			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

		IF @Force = '1' SELECT @VoucherBook = @oldVoucherBook
		IF @IsNextVoucher = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #t) BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetVoucherNumberRegion @VoucherBook, @CurrentVoucherNumber, @MinVoucherBookNumber, @MaxVoucherBookNumber, @NextVoucherNumber OUTPUT
			IF LTRIM(@NextVoucherNumber) = LTRIM(@VoucherNumber) BEGIN
				SELECT @CurrentVoucherNumber = LTRIM(@VoucherNumber)
				EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetVoucherNumberRegion @VoucherBook, @CurrentVoucherNumber, @MinVoucherBookNumber, @MaxVoucherBookNumber, @NextVoucherNumber OUTPUT
			END
		END

		SELECT TOP 1 CAST(@c AS INT) AS value FROM #t
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbidmbp0g1] 
AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_bp AS ten_bp, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp2, c.ten_vung AS ten_vung, c.ten_vung2 AS ten_vung2, c.ma_dvcs AS ma_dvcs
		 FROM bidmbp0g1 a LEFT JOIN bidmbp0 b ON b.ma_bp = a.ma_bp0 LEFT JOIN bidmvung c ON c.ma_vung = a.ma_vung 
		ORDER BY a.ma_bp0, a.ma_vung

GO

AS
SELECT  a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_bd, a.he_so, a.luong_co_ban, a.t_tien_phu_cap, a.t_thu_nhap, a.ghi_chu, b.ten_nt, b.ten_nt2
	FROM hreqtlkddk a LEFT JOIN dmnt b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostSVTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@groups VARCHAR(128),
	@step TINYINT,
	@downPayment VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@postFrom TINYINT = 1 -- 1 - Voucher, 2 - Post Transaction
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3), @tk VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @cMemo NVARCHAR(511),
		@noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @isPost TINYINT, @isPostTax TINYINT, @ten_vt NVARCHAR(511), @ghi_chu NVARCHAR(511), @tk_thue_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_thue_co VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh2 VARCHAR(32),
		@t_tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_thue_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_thue NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_tien_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_tc_tien2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@masterTaxCode VARCHAR(32), @EnvironmentalTax BIT

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m81$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d81$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #outputvat FROM r20$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ar FROM cttt20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk_du, tk_vt AS tk0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh,
		tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS c, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS tax INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	-- Option
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_thue_mt' AND val = '1') SELECT @EnvironmentalTax = 1 ELSE SELECT @EnvironmentalTax = 0


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT, @groupTaxReduction VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @groupTaxReduction = '', @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_post_hh_hddt' AND val = '1')
			SELECT @groupTaxReduction = ', loai'
		ELSE
			EXEC sp_executesql N'update #detail set tien_nt2 = - tien_nt2, tien2 = - tien2 from #detail where loai = ''90'''
	END
	--
	SELECT TOP 1 @tk = tk, @cMemo = dien_giai, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @ma_kh2 = ma_kh2, @ma_ct = ma_ct,
			@ten_vt = RTRIM(ten_vtthue), @ghi_chu = ghi_chuthue, @tk_thue_no = tk_thue_no, @tk_thue_co = tk_thue_co, @t_tc_tien_nt2 = t_tc_tien_nt2 - t_km_nt, @t_tc_tien2 = t_tc_tien2 - t_km,
			@t_tien_nt2 = t_tien_nt2 + t_km_nt, @t_tien2 = t_tien2 + t_km, @t_tc_thue_nt = t_tc_thue_nt + t_thue_km_nt, @t_tc_thue = t_tc_thue + t_thue_km,
			@masterTaxCode = ma_thue
		FROM #master

	--
	IF (@masterTaxCode <> '' AND COL_LENGTH('d81$000000', 'ma_thue') IS NOT NULL) EXEC(N'update #detail set ma_thue = b.ma_thue, thue_suat = b.thue_suat from #detail a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')


	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	SELECT * INTO #ctgt20 FROM #detail
	IF @isGoodsType = 1 DELETE #ctgt20 WHERE loai = '07'
	UPDATE #ctgt20 SET tien_nt2 = tien_nt2 - ck_nt WHERE ck_nt <> 0
	UPDATE #ctgt20 SET tien2 = tien2 - ck WHERE ck <> 0

	-- Down Payment
	DECLARE @Change BIT
	SELECT @Change = 0
	IF @downPayment = '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_ut' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt <> @baseCurrency) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p81 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #u(stt_rec0 CHAR(3), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), cl NUMERIC(28, 6))
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$DownPayment$CreateDifference @idNumber, 'p81', '#master', '#detail', 'km_yn <> 1', 'tien2'
			SELECT @downPayment = '#u'
		END
	END
	IF (@downPayment <> '' AND @downPayment <> 'None') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update #detail set tien2 = a.tien2 + b.cl, tt = a.tt + b.cl from #detail a join ' + @downPayment + ' b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DECLARE @n NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @n = SUM(cl) FROM #u

		IF ISNULL(@n, 0) <> 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #master SET t_tien2 = t_tien2 + @n,  t_tt = t_tt + @n
			SELECT @Change = 1, @t_tc_tien2 = @t_tc_tien2 + @n
		END
	END

	-- Tai khoan khu trung
	SELECT @isPost = 1, @isPostTax = 1

	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPost = 0
	IF (@noAccounts <> '') AND (dbo.ff_inlist(@tk_thue_no, @noAccounts) = 1) SET @isPostTax = 0

	-- Update lại trường tiền khi không nhập tk_ck
	UPDATE #detail SET tien_nt2 = tien_nt2 - ck_nt WHERE ck_nt <> 0 AND tk_ck = ''
	UPDATE #detail SET tien2 = tien2 - ck WHERE ck <> 0 AND tk_ck = ''

	IF @step > 1 BEGIN
		/*1. Gia von*/
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '1 = 1', 'tien, tien_nt', 'tk_vt, tk_gv' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_gv, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = tk_gv, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = tien_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0

		/*2. Doanh thu*/
		IF @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			IF @EnvironmentalTax = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0', 'tien2, tien_nt2, thue_mt, thue_mt_nt', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2 - thue_mt, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2 - thue_mt_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2 - thue_mt, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2 - thue_mt_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 0', 'tien2, tien_nt2', 'tk_dt' + @groupTaxReduction + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @groupTaxReduction = ''
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = @tk, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
				ELSE
					UPDATE #dGL SET tk = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, tk_du = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN @tk ELSE tk_dt END, tk0 = CASE WHEN loai = '90' THEN tk_dt ELSE @tk END, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
			END
		END

		/*3. Chi phi ban hang*/
/*
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'km_yn = 1 and tk_dt <> tk_cpbh', 'tien2, tien_nt2', 'tk_dt, tk_cpbh' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = tk_dt, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = tien2, ps_no_nt = tien_nt2, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
*/

		/*4. Chiet khau*/
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE t_ck + t_ck_nt <> 0) AND @isPost = 1 BEGIN
			--4.1 tk chiet khau va tk cong no
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'tk_ck <> '''' and km_yn = 0 and ck + ck_nt <> 0', 'ck, ck_nt', 'tk_ck' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_ck, tk_du = @tk, tk0 = tk_ck, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = ck, ps_no_nt = ck_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0

			--4.2 tk chiet khau va tk cpbh
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', 'tk_ck <> '''' and km_yn = 1 and ck + ck_nt <> 0', 'ck, ck_nt', 'tk_ck, tk_cpbh' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_ck, tk_du = tk_cpbh, tk0 = tk_ck, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = ck, ps_no_nt = ck_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 0 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0
		END


		/*5. Thue*/
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE t_thue + t_thue_nt + t_thue_km + t_thue_km_nt <> 0 AND tk_thue_no <> '') BEGIN
			DECLARE @taxGroups VARCHAR(128)
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_005' AND val = 1) SELECT @taxGroups = ''
				ELSE SELECT @taxGroups = @groups

			IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(thue + thue_nt <> 0) and ((' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@isPostTax)) + ' = 1 and km_yn = 0) or km_yn > 1)', 'thue, thue_nt', 'km_yn, tk_cpbh' + CASE WHEN @taxGroups <> '' THEN ',' + @taxGroups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				UPDATE #dGL SET tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0 AND km_yn = 0
				UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = @tk_thue_co, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 WHERE ISNULL(c, 0) = 0 AND km_yn > 1
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #detail set ma_kh2 = '''' from #detail a where exists(select 1 from dmtk b where a.tk_thue = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 0)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(thue + thue_nt <> 0) and ((' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@isPostTax)) + ' = 1 and km_yn = 0) or km_yn > 1)', 'thue, thue_nt', 'km_yn, tk_cpbh, tk_thue, ma_kh2' + CASE WHEN @taxGroups <> '' THEN ',' + @taxGroups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SET @q = 'update #dGL set tk = @tk_thue_no, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = @tk_thue_no, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 where isnull(c, 0) = 0 and km_yn = 0'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #dGL set tk = tk_cpbh, tk_du = tk_thue, tk0 = tk_cpbh, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ps_no = thue, ps_no_nt = thue_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(floor(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt, c = 1, tax = 1 where isnull(c, 0) = 0 and km_yn > 1'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_no varchar(32), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_no, @ma_kh
			END
		END

		/*6. Thue moi truong*/
		IF @EnvironmentalTax = 1 BEGIN
			EXEC rs_PostEnvironmentTax @masterTable, @detailTable, @glMasterTable, @glDetailTable, @idNumber, @groups, @step, 2, @isPost
		END

		-- Post to #gl
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
		IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
			UPDATE #dGL SET ma_kh = @ma_kh2 FROM #dGL a WHERE a.tax = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk AND b.tk_cn = 1)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #dGL set ma_kh = ma_kh2 from #dGL a join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.tax = 1 and b.tk_cn = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 1, status = 1, so_ctgs = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai'
		DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	END

	-- (Loại kê khai)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ISNULL(loai_kk, '') = '9') GOTO EndPostVAT

	-- Post tep thue
	DECLARE @cCustName NVARCHAR(511), @cAddress NVARCHAR(511), @cTaxCode NVARCHAR(511), @cCust VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @cCustName = ten_kh, @cAddress = dia_chi, @cTaxCode = ma_so_thue FROM ctgt21 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	IF @masterTaxCode <> '' BEGIN
		IF @ten_vt = ''	SELECT @ten_vt = ten_vt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = (SELECT TOP 1 ma_vt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_vt ORDER BY SUM(tien2) DESC)

		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#outputvat', '#master', @masterTable, 'ctgt20', '1=1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #outputvat SET line_nbr = 1 WHERE line_nbr IS NULL
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE('#outputvat', '#detail', @detailTable, 'ctgt20', 'a.line_nbr = 1', 'line_nbr = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'line_nbr')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #outputvat SET tk_thue_co = @tk_thue_co, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode, ten_vt = @ten_vt, ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,
			t_tien_nt2 = @t_tien_nt2, t_tien2 = @t_tien2, t_thue_nt = @t_tc_thue_nt, t_thue = @t_tc_thue,
			ma_mau_ct = ''

		IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #outputvat SET t_tien2 = t_tien2 - b.tien2, t_tien_nt2 = t_tien_nt2 - tien_nt2 FROM #outputvat a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2 FROM #detail WHERE loai = '07' GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			DELETE #outputvat WHERE t_tien2 = 0 AND t_tien_nt2 = 0 AND t_thue = 0 AND t_thue_nt = 0
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @w NVARCHAR(511)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail WHERE ma_thue <> '')
			SET @w = '(ma_thue <> '''' or tien2 <> 0 or thue_suat <> 0)'
		ELSE
			SET @w = '1=1'
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#outputvat', '#ctgt20', @detailTable, 'ctgt20', @w)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateE('#outputvat', '#master', @masterTable, 'ctgt20', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ma_thue, thue_suat, ma_kh2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = ''
		IF @ten_vt = ''
			SET @q = 'select c.ma_thue, e.ten_vt into #tenvt'
					+ ' from (select a.ma_thue, min(b.line_nbr) as line_nbr from (select ma_thue, max(tien2) as tien2 from #ctgt20 group by ma_thue) a join #ctgt20 b on a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue and a.tien2 = b.tien2 group by a.ma_thue) c'
					+ ' join #ctgt20 d on c.ma_thue = d.ma_thue and c.line_nbr = d.line_nbr join dmvt e on d.ma_vt = e.ma_vt'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #outputvat set tk_thue_co = b.tk_thue, tk_du = @tk_thue_no, ten_kh = @cCustName, dia_chi = @cAddress, ma_so_thue = @cTaxCode,'
			+ ' ten_vt = ' +  CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' c.ten_vt' ELSE '@ten_vt' END + ', ghi_chu = @ghi_chu,'
			+ ' t_tien_nt2 = b.tien_nt2, t_tien2 = b.tien2, t_thue_nt = b.thue_nt, t_thue = b.thue, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ma_mau_ct = '''''
			+ ' from #outputvat a join #ctgt20 b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
			+ CASE WHEN @ten_vt = '' THEN ' join #tenvt c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tk_thue_no varchar(32), @cCustName nvarchar(511), @cAddress nvarchar(511), @cTaxCode nvarchar(511), @ten_vt nvarchar(511), @ghi_chu nvarchar(511), @ma_kh varchar(32)', @tk_thue_no, @cCustName, @cAddress, @cTaxCode, @ten_vt, @ghi_chu, @ma_kh
	END
	UPDATE #outputvat SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

	DELETE ctgt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ctgt20 SELECT * FROM #outputvat
EndPostVAT:

	IF @postFrom <> 1 RETURN

	-- Post thanh toan
	DECLARE @Tat_toan TINYINT, @T_tt_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @ngay_tt SMALLDATETIME, @cMode CHAR(1), @T_tt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_tt_nt1 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @T_tt_qd = SUM(tt_qd), @T_tt1 = SUM(tt), @T_tt_nt1= SUM(tt_nt) FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt = @idNumber
	SELECT @T_tt_qd = CASE WHEN @T_tt_qd IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_qd END, @T_tt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt1 END, @T_tt_nt1 = CASE WHEN @T_tt_nt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @T_tt_nt1 END

	SELECT @Tat_toan = 0, @ngay_tt = NULL, @cMode = 'N'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber)
		SELECT @Tat_toan = tat_toan, @ngay_tt = ngay_tt, @cMode = 'E' FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ar', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt20', '1=1')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #ar SET loai_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt, t_tt_qd = @T_tt_qd , t_tt1 = @T_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = @T_tt_nt1,
		ngay_tt = CASE WHEN @cMode = 'E' THEN @ngay_tt ELSE ngay_tt END, ma_gd = 0, line_nbr = 1

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdateOtherFields('#ar', '#detail', @detailTable, 'cttt20', '1=1', '1=1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @t_ck_nt = SUM(ck_nt), @t_ck = SUM(ck) FROM #detail WHERE km_yn = 0
	UPDATE #ar SET t_tien_nt2 = @t_tc_tien_nt2, t_tien2 = @t_tc_tien2, dien_giai = @cMemo, t_ck_nt = @t_ck_nt, t_ck = @t_ck

	UPDATE #ar SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_ck_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
	IF @isPost <> 1 UPDATE #ar SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = ngay_ct

	UPDATE #ar SET tat_toan = 0 WHERE tat_toan IS NULL
	UPDATE #ar SET t_tt_qd0 = 0 WHERE t_tt_qd0 IS NULL

	UPDATE #ar SET ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_lct FROM #ar a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec


	-- Down Payment
	IF @Change = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @r INT
		SELECT @r = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
		UPDATE #ar SET ty_gia = ROUND(t_tt/t_tt_nt, @r) WHERE t_tt_nt <> 0
	END

	DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostITTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glMasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@glDetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@idNumber CHAR(13), 
	@groups VARCHAR(128), 
	@step TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @step <= 1 RETURN

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @noAccounts VARCHAR(128), @ma_ct VARCHAR(3)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m85$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d85$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, *, tk_vt AS tk, tk_vt AS tk0, tien AS ps_no, tien AS ps_co, tien_nt AS ps_no_nt, tien_nt AS ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS nh_dk INTO #dGL FROM #detail

	SELECT TOP 1 @noAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct FROM #master

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	/*1. Gia von*/
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#detail', '(tk_vt <> tk_du) and (not (' + '(''' + @noAccounts + ''' <> '''') and (dbo.ff_inlist(tk_du, ''' + @noAccounts + ''') = 1)))', 'tien, tien_nt', 'tk_vt, tk_du' + CASE WHEN @groups <> '' THEN ', ' + @groups ELSE '' END, 'min(line_nbr)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #dGL SET tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk_vt, tk0 = tk_du, ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = tien, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt

	-- Post to #gl
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_vt, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'ct_nxt = 2, status = 1, head_item = '''', so_lo = '''', so_ctgs = '''', so_ct0 = '''', so_dh = ''''', '', '', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai, ma_kh = b.ma_kh'

	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl		


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_CalculateInspectionScore]
	@KeyTable VARCHAR(64),
	@EvaluationDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, stt_rec_goc, ma_bp0, ma_vung, ma_bp0 AS ma_bp0_diem, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_chuan INTO #kdky FROM bikd
	SET @q = 'insert into #kdky select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, b.stt_rec, isnull(a.ma_bp0, ''''), a.ma_vung, '''', 0'
		+ ' from bikd a join ' + @KeyTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vung, CASE WHEN a.ma_bp0 <> '' THEN a.ma_bp0 ELSE ISNULL(b.ma_bp0, '') END AS ma_bp0
		INTO #vungbp0 FROM #kdky a LEFT JOIN bidmbp0g1 b ON a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND b.status <> '0'

	SELECT c.stt_rec, c.ma_bp0, c.ngay_hieu_luc, d.diem_chuan, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #diemchuan0
		FROM (SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0, MAX(b.ngay_hieu_luc) AS ngay_hieu_luc FROM #vungbp0 a JOIN bim03$000000 b ON a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 AND b.ngay_hieu_luc <= ISNULL(@EvaluationDate, a.ngay_ct) GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0) c
			JOIN bim03$000000 d ON d.ma_bp0 = c.ma_bp0 AND d.ngay_hieu_luc = c.ngay_hieu_luc
		ORDER BY c.ngay_hieu_luc DESC, c.ma_bp0 ASC

	SELECT c.stt_rec, d.ma_bp0, d.diem_chuan
		INTO #diemchuan
		FROM (SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id FROM #diemchuan0 GROUP BY stt_rec) c JOIN #diemchuan0 d ON c.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND c.id = d.id

	UPDATE #kdky SET ma_bp0_diem = b.ma_bp0, diem_chuan = ISNULL(b.diem_chuan, 0)
		FROM #kdky a LEFT JOIN #vungbp0 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ma_vung = c.ma_vung
			JOIN #diemchuan b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND ((a.ma_bp0 <> '' AND b.ma_bp0 = a.ma_bp0) OR (a.ma_bp0 = '' AND b.ma_bp0 = c.ma_bp0))

	SELECT @dateFrom = MIN(ngay_ct), @dateTo = MAX(ngay_ct) FROM #kdky

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vt, kd_dac_tinh, sd_diem_kd, stt_rec_goc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_loai_kd, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_chuan INTO #kd FROM bikd
	SELECT TOP 0 c.nhom_du_lieu, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.stt_rec_goc, c.stt_rec0goc, c.ma_ct_goc, c.ngay_ct_goc, c.so_ct_goc,
			a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, c.so_luong, c.sl_kd_nh1, c.sl_kd_nh2, c.ma_loai_qd, c.ma_dac_tinh, c.ma_diem, c.ma_loi, c.ma_loai_loi, c.ma_ph_loai, c.diem_so
		INTO #kiemdinh FROM bikd00$000000 a, bikd02$000000 c
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec_kd, a.ma_diem, b.stt_rec0, b.tinh_diem_cl, b.trong_so
		INTO #kd03 FROM bikd03m$000000 a, bikd03d$000000 b

	SET @q = 'insert into #kd select b.stt_rec, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.ma_vt, b.kd_dac_tinh, b.sd_diem_kd, a.stt_rec_goc, b.ma_loai_kd, a.diem_chuan'
			+ ' from #kdky a join bikd00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		+ CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into #kiemdinh select c.nhom_du_lieu, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.stt_rec_goc, c.stt_rec0goc, c.ma_ct_goc, c.ngay_ct_goc, c.so_ct_goc, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt,'
				+ 'c.so_luong, c.sl_kd_nh1, c.sl_kd_nh2, c.ma_loai_qd, c.ma_dac_tinh, c.ma_diem, c.ma_loi, c.ma_loai_loi, c.ma_ph_loai, c.diem_so'
			+ ' from #kd a join bikd02$%Partition c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
		+ CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into #kd03 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_diem, c.stt_rec0, c.tinh_diem_cl, c.trong_so'
			+ ' from #kiemdinh a join bikd03m$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kd and a.ma_diem = b.ma_diem join bikd03d$%Partition c on c.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0goc = c.stt_rec0'
			+ ' where %[a.nhom_du_lieu = ''04'']%'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT a.stt_rec_goc AS stt_rec, ISNULL(b.ma_loai_qd, '') AS ma_loai_qd, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_kd, a.ma_loai_kd, c.pp_chat_luong, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_so, a.diem_chuan
		INTO #core FROM #kd a JOIN bikddmloai c ON a.ma_loai_kd = c.ma_loai LEFT JOIN #kiemdinh b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND b.nhom_du_lieu = '06'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '1') BEGIN
		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = b.diem_so FROM #core a JOIN bikddmlqd b ON b.ma_loai_qd = a.ma_loai_qd WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '1'
	END


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong IN ('2', '3', '4', '5', '6')) BEGIN
		SELECT b.nhom_du_lieu, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_kd, b.ma_dac_tinh, ISNULL(c.tinh_diem_cl, '0') AS tinh_diem_cl, b.ma_loi, ISNULL(b.ma_ph_loai, '') AS ma_ph_loai, ISNULL(e.diem_so, 0) AS diem_ph_loai,
				b.so_luong, b.sl_kd_nh1, b.sl_kd_nh2, ISNULL(c.trong_so, 0) AS trong_so, a.diem_chuan
			INTO #thdiem FROM #core a JOIN #kiemdinh b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec
				LEFT JOIN #kd03 c ON a.stt_rec_kd = c.stt_rec_kd AND b.ma_diem = c.ma_diem AND b.stt_rec0goc = c.stt_rec0
				LEFT JOIN bikddmphloailoi e ON b.ma_ph_loai = e.ma_ph_loai
			WHERE a.pp_chat_luong IN ('2', '3', '4', '5', '6') AND b.nhom_du_lieu IN ('04', '05')
	END

	-- Theo điểm chất lượng thấp nhất của đặc tính
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '2') BEGIN
		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = c.diem_so FROM #core a JOIN (
			SELECT t.stt_rec, MIN(t.diem_chuan - t.diem_ph_loai) AS diem_so FROM #thdiem t WHERE t.tinh_diem_cl = 1 GROUP BY t.stt_rec
			) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '2'
	END

	-- Theo điểm chất lượng bình quân các đặc tính có xét trọng số
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '3') BEGIN
		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = CASE WHEN c.t_trong_so <> 0 THEN c.t_diem_so / c.t_trong_so ELSE 0 END
			FROM #core a JOIN (
				SELECT t.stt_rec, SUM(t.trong_so) AS t_trong_so,
						SUM(CASE WHEN t.so_luong <> 0 THEN ((t.so_luong - t.sl_kd_nh2) * t.diem_chuan + (t.sl_kd_nh2 * (t.diem_chuan - t.diem_ph_loai))) / t.so_luong * t.trong_so ELSE 0 END) AS t_diem_so
					FROM #thdiem t WHERE t.tinh_diem_cl = 1 AND ISNULL(ma_dac_tinh, '') <> '' AND t.trong_so > 0 GROUP BY t.stt_rec
			) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '3'
	END

	-- Theo điểm lỗi lớn nhất
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '4') BEGIN
		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = CASE WHEN c.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN c.diem_so ELSE a.diem_chuan END
			FROM #core a
				LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT t.stt_rec, MIN(t.diem_chuan - t.diem_ph_loai) AS diem_so FROM #thdiem t WHERE t.ma_ph_loai <> '' GROUP BY t.stt_rec
				) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '4'
	END

	-- Theo điểm lỗi bình quân
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '5') BEGIN
		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = CASE WHEN c.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN c.t_sl_kd_nh2 <> 0 THEN c.t_diem_so / c.t_sl_kd_nh2 ELSE 0 END ELSE a.diem_chuan END
			FROM #core a
				LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT t.stt_rec, SUM(t.sl_kd_nh2) AS t_sl_kd_nh2, SUM(t.sl_kd_nh2 * (t.diem_chuan - t.diem_ph_loai)) AS t_diem_so
					FROM #thdiem t WHERE t.ma_ph_loai <> '' GROUP BY t.stt_rec
				) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '5'
	END

	-- Theo điểm lỗi bình quân các đặc tính có xét trọng số
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #core WHERE pp_chat_luong = '6') BEGIN
		SELECT t.stt_rec, t.ma_dac_tinh, SUM(t.sl_kd_nh2) AS sl_kd_nh2, MAX(t.trong_so) AS trong_so, SUM(t.sl_kd_nh2 * (t.diem_chuan - t.diem_ph_loai)) AS diem_dac_tinh
			INTO #diemdactinh
			FROM #thdiem t
			WHERE ISNULL(t.ma_dac_tinh, '') <> '' AND t.tinh_diem_cl = 1 AND t.ma_ph_loai <> '' GROUP BY t.stt_rec, t.ma_dac_tinh

		UPDATE #core SET diem_so = CASE WHEN c.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN c.t_trong_so <> 0 AND c.t_sl_kd_nh2 <> 0 THEN c.t_diem_so / (c.t_sl_kd_nh2 * c.t_trong_so) ELSE 0 END ELSE a.diem_chuan END
			FROM #core a
				LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT stt_rec, SUM(sl_kd_nh2) AS t_sl_kd_nh2, SUM(trong_so) AS t_trong_so,	SUM(diem_dac_tinh * trong_so) AS t_diem_so
					FROM #diemdactinh GROUP BY stt_rec
				) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE a.pp_chat_luong = '6'
	END

	SET @q = 'update a set diem_so = b.diem_so from ' + @KeyTable + ' a join #core b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxdmbp]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2, ISNULL(c.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp0, ISNULL(c.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp02, ISNULL(b.ds_dvcs, '') AS ds_dvcs
		FROM xdmbp a LEFT JOIN dmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN dmbp c ON a.ma_bp0 = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$InputInvoiceLog$Save]
	@TaxCode VARCHAR(18),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@Serial VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@UserID VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT @TaxCode = REPLACE(@TaxCode, '''', ''), @Form = REPLACE(@Form, '''', ''), @Serial = REPLACE(@Serial, '''', ''), @InvoiceNumber = REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', ''), @UserID = REPLACE(@UserID, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @key NVARCHAR(256), @sl_mua INT, @sl_hd INT
	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @InvoiceDate, 112)

	SELECT @key = 'mst = ''' + @TaxCode + ''' and mau_so = ''' + @Form + ''' and ky_hieu = ''' + @Serial + ''' and so_hd = ''' + @InvoiceNumber + ''' and convert(char(8), ngay_hd, 112) = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @InvoiceDate, 112) + ''''
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	--
	SELECT @q = '
if not exists (select 1 from h15$%Partition where  %[' +  @Key + ']%) begin
	insert into h15$%Partition(mst, mau_so, ky_hieu, so_hd, ngay_hd, datetime0, user_id0)
	values (''' + @TaxCode + ''',''' + @Form + ''',''' + @Serial + ''',''' + @InvoiceNumber + ''',''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @InvoiceDate, 112) + ''',getdate(),' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')
end'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_hd', @InvoiceDate, @InvoiceDate, @UserID, 1
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPurchaseReturnSummary] -- fs_POReceiveSummary
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Supplier AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@GroupBy AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt
			, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong, a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, a.gia as gia, a.gia_nt as gia_nt, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec
		INTO #temp FROM wrkin a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.tk_vt <> ''''', @Join = ''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Supplier <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Supplier), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 + @ItemType <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #temp SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt as ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(c.dvt) as dvt
		, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		, MAX(c.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(c.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(c.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(c.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
	INTO #report
	FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
	GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = ISNULL(@GroupBy, ''), @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(CASE WHEN ISNULL(@GroupBy, '') <> '' THEN @GroupBy ELSE 'ma_vt' END, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt)
		VALUES (0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0 ,0)

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@GroupBy))) = 'LOAI_VT'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy , 'vt', 'so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	IF @nSo_Ma_nt > 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong', '#report')
	ELSE
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) <> ''
