	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ngay_ct', 'SMALLDATETIME')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @FormType = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		SELECT @cName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE '' END, @cName2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'E' THEN cname2 ELSE '' END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct) VALUES (2, 0, 0, '', '')
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct) VALUES (2, 1, 0, '', '')

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, stt_rec, ma_ct, ten_kh, ten_kh2)
			SELECT 1, 0, 0, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(ck), SUM(ck_nt)
					, SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(pt), SUM(pt_nt), '', '', @cName, @cName2
				FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

		-- EInvoice
		IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.gia, a.gia2, a.tien2, a.tien, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.pt_nt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nx, a.dien_giai'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.pt, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct order by a.sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order ) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order  END + ', a.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @FormType = 2 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, stt_rec, ma_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(ck), SUM(ck_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(pt), SUM(pt_nt), '', '', ma_kh
					, RTRIM(ma_kh) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh) ELSE MAX(ten_kh2) END
				FROM #report
				WHERE systotal = 1
				GROUP BY ma_kh

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

		-- EInvoice
		IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia2, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt2, a.tien_nt, a.tien2, a.tien, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.pt_nt, a.pt, a.ck, a.ck_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_nvbh, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct order by a.ma_kh, a.sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', a.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @FormType = 3 BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, ma_vv, stt_rec, ma_ct, ten_kh, ten_kh2)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, SUM(so_luong), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(ck), SUM(ck_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(pt), SUM(pt_nt), a.ma_vv, '', ''
					, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_vv) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_vv) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_vv) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_vv2) ELSE '' END
				FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_vv

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
		-- EInvoice
		IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia, a.tien_nt2, a.tien_nt, a.tien2, a.tien, a.thue_nt, a.thue, a.ck_nt, a.ck, a.pt_nt, a.pt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nx, a.dien_giai, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_vv, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vv' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vv, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vv2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vv2'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmvv c on a.ma_vv = c.ma_vv order by a.ma_vv, a.sysorder ' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', a.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @FormType = 4 BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, ma_nx, stt_rec, ma_ct, ten_kh, ten_kh2)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, SUM(so_luong), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(ck), SUM(ck_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(pt), SUM(pt_nt), a.ma_nx, '', ''
					, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_nx) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_nx) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_nx) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_nx2) ELSE '' END
				FROM #report a left join dmnx b on a.ma_nx = b.ma_nx WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_nx

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
		-- EInvoice
		IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia, a.tien_nt2, a.tien_nt, a.tien2, a.tien, a.thue_nt, a.thue, a.ck_nt, a.ck, a.pt_nt, a.pt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nx, a.dien_giai, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nvbh, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_nx' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_nx, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_nx2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_nx2'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmnx c on a.ma_nx = c.ma_nx order by a.ma_nx, sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetDateOfEndDay(@nYear NUMERIC(4), @nCycle NUMERIC(2), @nDay NUMERIC(2))
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @dReturn SMALLDATETIME

	IF DATEPART(dd, dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)) > @nDay
		SET @dReturn = CAST(STR(@nYear, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@nCycle, 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@nDay, 2), ' ', '0') AS SMALLDATETIME)
	ELSE
		SET @dReturn = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)

	RETURN @dReturn
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintARTran]
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@MTable CHAR(10),
	@DTable CHAR(10),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '', 
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0,
	@isFC BIT = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @l CHAR(1), @discount NVARCHAR(256), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @ListNo VARCHAR(32), @ListDate SMALLDATETIME, @Enclosed NVARCHAR(511), @Copy NVARCHAR(511), @Copy2 NVARCHAR(511), @d CHAR(2), @m CHAR(2), @y CHAR(4)
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	IF @Bilingual = 1 SET @l = 'V' ELSE SET @l = @Language
	SELECT @Copy = CASE WHEN @l = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, @Copy2 = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN cname2 ELSE '' END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT056'
	SELECT @Enclosed = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT, @descriptGoodsType NVARCHAR(4000), @descriptGoodsType2 NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_nt VARCHAR(32), @fAmount NVARCHAR(256), @fAmountFC NVARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@DTable)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	IF @Form = '2' AND @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @fAmount = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @fAmountFC = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @q = 'select @ma_nt = a.ma_nt from ' + REPLACE(@DTable, 'd21$', 'm21$') + ' a where stt_rec = @IDNumber'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@IDNumber varchar(32), @ma_nt varchar(32) output', @IDNumber, @ma_nt OUTPUT
		SELECT TOP 1 @descriptGoodsType = REPLACE(a.dien_giai, '#dv_tien_giam#', SPACE(1) + b.ra_2), @descriptGoodsType2 = REPLACE(a.dien_giai2, '#dv_tien_giam#', SPACE(1) + b.ra_22) FROM dmloaihh a CROSS JOIN dmnt b WHERE a.loai = '90' AND b.ma_nt = CASE WHEN @isFC = 0 THEN @m_ma_nt0 WHEN @isFC = 1 THEN @ma_nt ELSE '' END
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_in_bk_yn' AND val = '1') OR (@Form = '3') BEGIN
		SELECT @ListNo = REPLACE(so_bk, '''', ''''''), @ListDate = ngay_bk, @d = REPLACE(STR(DAY(ngay_bk), 2), ' ', '0'), @m = REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_bk), 2), ' ', '0'),
			@y = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_bk)) FROM v01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	END
	SELECT @ListNo = ISNULL(@ListNo, ''), @d = ISNULL(@d, ''), @m = ISNULL(@m, ''), @y = ISNULL(@y, ''), @q = ''

	SELECT @eiFields = ' isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''') as ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct', @eiJoin = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @ei001 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
		SELECT @ei002 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		SELECT @eiFields = N' isnull(case when w.mau_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei001) + ''' else w.mau_hddt end, isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''')) as ky_hieu,'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_seri_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei002) + ''' else w.so_seri_hddt end, a.so_seri) as so_seri,'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_ct_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei003) + ''' else w.so_ct_hddt end, a.so_ct) as so_ct',
			@eiJoin = ' left join hddt00$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@MTable), 6) + ' w with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = w.stt_rec'
	END

	IF @Form <> '3' BEGIN
		-- Loc trong tep ph
		IF @Form = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba as doi_tac, a.ma_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh2, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh,'
			SET @q = @q + N' c.ten_ngan as thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 as thanh_toan2, N''' + RTRIM(@Copy) + ''' as so_lien,'			
			SET @q = @q + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end as thue_suat,'
			SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_nt, (a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck) as t_tien2, (a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt) as t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
			SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang,'
			SET @q = @q + ' cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam, a.dien_giai,'			
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba as doi_tac, a.ma_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh2, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh,'
			SET @q = @q + N' c.ten_ngan as thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 as thanh_toan2, N''' + RTRIM(@Copy) + ''' as so_lien,'
			SET @q = @q + N' N''' + RTRIM(@Copy2) + ''' as so_lien2,'			
			SET @q = @q + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end as thue_suat,'
			SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_nt, (a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck) as t_tien2, (a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt) as t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck, ''' + REPLACE(@l, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt, ''' + REPLACE(@l, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2,'
			SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2,'
			SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang,'
			SET @q = @q + ' cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam, a.dien_giai, 1 as fix_yn,'
		END		
		SET @q = @q + ' ''' + RTRIM(@ListNo) + ''' as so_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@d) + ''' as ngay_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@m) + ''' as thang_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@y) + ''' as nam_bk'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END + ' as customize'
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@MTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' d with(nolock) on (a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' and d.stt_rec0 = (select min(stt_rec0) from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = a.stt_rec))'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk' + @eiJoin		
		IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@MTable), 6))
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Loc trong tep ct
		IF (@ListNo <> '' AND @ListDate <> '') BEGIN
			SET @q = 'select 1 as line_nbr, cast('''' as varchar(32)) as tk_dt, (a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt) as tien_nt2, (a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck) as tien2,'
			SET @q = @q + ' cast('''' as nvarchar(511)) as dien_giai, cast('''' as varchar(32)) as ma_vt, 0 as km_yn, cast('''' as nvarchar(511)) as dvt,'
			SET @q = @q + ' 0 as so_luong, 0 as gia_nt2, 0 as gia2, a.ten_vtthue as ten_vt, a.ten_vtthue as ten_vt2'
			SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
			IF @Form = '2' AND @isGoodsType = 1 SET @q = @q + ', a.loai'
			SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@MTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
			SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
			IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@DTable), 6))
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report select 2, '''', 0, 0, '''', '''', 0, '''', 0, 0, 0, N'''
			SET @q = @q + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Enclosed, '%n', RTRIM(@ListNo)), '%d', @d), '%m', @m), '%y',@y) + ''', '''', '''''
			IF @Form = '2' AND @isGoodsType = 1 SET @q = @q + ', '''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'select a.line_nbr, a.tk_dt, a.tien_nt2, a.tien2, a.dien_giai as dien_giai_ct, cast('''' as nvarchar(32)) as ma_vt,' --Service Invoice
			SET @q = @q + ' 0 as km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt as gia_nt2, gia as gia2, a.dien_giai as ten_vt, cast('''' as nvarchar(511)) as ten_vt2' --Sale Invoice, VAT Invoice
			SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
			IF @Form = '2' AND @isGoodsType = 1 SET @q = @q + ', a.loai'
			SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
			IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@DTable), 6))
			SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		END
		IF @Form = '2' AND @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = @q + '
declare @row int
select @row = max(line_nbr) + 1 from #report
select ' + CASE WHEN @isFC = 0 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sum(tien2), @fAmount)' WHEN @isFC = 1 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sum(tien_nt2), @fAmountFC)' ELSE '0' END + ' as tien_giam into #tmp from #report where loai = ''90''
delete #report where loai = ''90''
insert into #report (tk_dt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, km_yn, line_nbr) select '''', replace(@descriptGoodsType'+ CASE WHEN @l = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', ''#so_tien_giam#'', tien_giam), replace(@descriptGoodsType' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN '2' ELSE '' END + ', ''#so_tien_giam#'', tien_giam), 0, @row from #tmp
exec dbo.FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField ''km_yn'', ''line_nbr'', ''#report'', ''line_nbr'', ''''
'
		END
		--Them dong tien chiet khau		
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_006' AND val = '1') AND @ListNo = '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'select @discountOut = ghi_chuthue, @tienOut = t_ck, @tien_ntOut = t_ck_nt from ' + @MTable + ' a where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@discountOut nvarchar(256) output, @tienOut numeric(28, 6) output, @tien_ntOut numeric(28, 6) output', @discount OUTPUT, @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
			IF @discount = ''
				SELECT @discount = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'
				
			IF @tien <> 0 OR @tien_nt <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'declare @c int select @c = max(line_nbr) + 1 from #report'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #report (ten_vt, ten_vt2, km_yn, line_nbr, tk_dt, so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, detail) select N''' + REPLACE(@discount, '''', '''''') + ''', '''', 0, @c, '''',0, 0 , 0,' + RTRIM(@tien) + ',' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ', '''''
			END
		END
		
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 13, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''tk_dt, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt, ten_vt2'', '''', ''line_nbr'''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@descriptGoodsType nvarchar(4000), @descriptGoodsType2 nvarchar(4000), @fAmount varchar(256), @fAmountFC varchar(256)', @descriptGoodsType, @descriptGoodsType2, @fAmount, @fAmountFC
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba AS doi_tac, a.ma_kh, e.ten_kh AS ten_kh, e.ten_kh AS ten_kh2, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.tk_nh,
				c.ten_ngan AS thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 as thanh_toan2, a.dien_giai AS so_lien, k.ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct,
				CAST(CAST(d.thue_suat AS INT) AS VARCHAR) + '%' AS thue_suat, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt,
				a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word,
				@d AS ngay, @m AS thang, @y AS nam, a.dien_giai, @ListNo AS so_bk, @d AS ngay_bk, @m AS thang_bk, @y AS nam_bk
				, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
			INTO #master FROM m21$000000 a, dmkh b, dmtt c, d21$000000 d, ctgt21 e, v20dmnk k
		SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint,a.*, b.line_nbr, b.tk_dt, b.tien_nt2, b.tien2, b.dien_giai AS dien_giai_ct, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(32)) AS ma_vt, 0 AS km_yn,
				b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia_nt AS gia_nt2, b.gia AS gia2, b.dien_giai AS ten_vt
				, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail, b.ma_thue, b.thue_suat AS vat, thue_nt, thue, b.ck_nt, b.ck
			INTO #detail FROM #master a, wrkardetail b

		-- Loc trong tep ph
		SET @q = 'insert into #master'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba as doi_tac, a.ma_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh) as ten_kh2, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.tk_nh,'
		SET @q = @q + N' c.ten_ngan as thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 as thanh_toan2, N''' + RTRIM(@Copy) + ''' as so_lien,'		
		SET @q = @q + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end as thue_suat,'
		SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_nt, a.t_tien2 - a.t_ck, a.t_tien_nt2 - a.t_ck_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word,'
		SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
		SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang,'
		SET @q = @q + '  cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam, a.dien_giai,'
		SET @q = @q + ' ''' + RTRIM(@ListNo) + ''' as so_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@d) + ''' as ngay_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@m) + ''' as thang_bk, ''' + RTRIM(@y) + ''' as nam_bk'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@MTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' d with(nolock) on (a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' and d.stt_rec0 = (select min(stt_rec0) from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = a.stt_rec))'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk' + @eiJoin
		IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@MTable), 6))
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Loc trong tep ct
		SET @q = 'insert into #detail select 1, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null,'
		SET @q = @q + ' case when a.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' then dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(a.thue_suat) else ''\'' end, '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''','
		SET @q = @q + ' a.line_nbr, a.tk_dt, a.tien_nt2, a.tien2, a.dien_giai as dien_giai_ct' --Service Invoice
		SET @q = @q + ', cast('''' as nvarchar(32)) as ma_vt, 0 as km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt as gia_nt2, gia as gia2, a.dien_giai as ten_vt' --Sale Invoice, VAT Invoice
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ', a.ma_thue, a.thue_suat, a.thue_nt, a.thue, a.ck_nt, a.ck'
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@DTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
		IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@DTable), 6))
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
		
		--Them dong tien chiet khau		
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_006' AND val = '1') BEGIN
			SET @s = 'select @discountOut = ghi_chuthue, @tienOut = t_ck, @tien_ntOut = t_ck_nt from ' + @MTable + ' a where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@discountOut nvarchar(256) output, @tienOut numeric(28, 6) output, @tien_ntOut numeric(28, 6) output', @discount OUTPUT, @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
			IF @discount = ''
				SELECT @discount = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'
		
			IF @tien <> 0 OR @tien_nt <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'declare @c int select @c = max(line_nbr) + 1 from #detail'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #detail (sysprint, ten_vt, ma_nt, so_ct, ma_kh, stt_rec, km_yn, line_nbr, tk_dt, so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, detail) select 0, N''' + REPLACE(@discount, '''', '''''') + ''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, @c, '''', 0, 0, 0,' + RTRIM(@tien) + ',' + RTRIM(@tien_nt)+ ', '''''
			END
		END
		
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 45, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''tk_dt, dien_giai_ct, ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt, ten_vt2'','''', ''line_nbr'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #detail SET stt_rec = @IDNumber
		UPDATE #detail SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		UPDATE #detail SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, so_bk = b.so_bk, ngay_bk = b.ngay_bk, thang_bk = b.thang_bk, nam_bk = b.nam_bk
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE line_nbr = 1

		UPDATE #detail SET thue_suat = b.thue_suat, t_tien2 = b.t_tien2, t_tien_nt2 = b.t_tien_nt2, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_thue_nt = b.t_thue_nt,
				t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE a.line_nbr = (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

		IF @printVATDetail = 0
			SELECT *, '' AS ten_vt2 , stt_rec AS xGroup FROM #detail a ORDER BY line_nbr
		ELSE
			SELECT *, '' AS ten_vt2 , a.stt_rec AS xGroup, b.* FROM #detail a
				JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (10, 7) THEN tien_nt2 - ck_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (10, 7) THEN tien2 - ck ELSE 0 END) AS tien_10
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (5, 3.5) THEN tien_nt2 - ck_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (5, 3.5) THEN tien2 - ck ELSE 0 END) AS tien_5
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 8 THEN tien_nt2 - ck_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 8 THEN tien2 - ck ELSE 0 END) AS tien_8
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 0 AND ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 THEN tien_nt2 - ck_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 0 AND ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 THEN tien2 - ck ELSE 0 END) AS tien_0
						, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 THEN tien_nt2 - ck_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 THEN tien2 - ck ELSE 0 END) AS tien_99
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (10, 7) THEN thue_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (10, 7) THEN thue ELSE 0 END) AS thue_10
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (5, 3.5) THEN thue_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(CASE WHEN vat IN (5, 3.5) THEN thue ELSE 0 END) AS thue_5
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 8 THEN thue_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 8 THEN thue ELSE 0 END) AS thue_8
						, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 0 AND ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 THEN thue_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(CASE WHEN vat = 0 AND ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 THEN thue ELSE 0 END) AS thue_0
						, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 THEN thue_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 THEN thue ELSE 0 END) AS thue_99
					FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec
				) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
					ORDER BY line_nbr
	END
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbisyspurgrouprights]
AS
	SELECT b.id, b.name, b.comment, b.user_yn, a.ma_nh0, c.ten_nh, c.ten_nh2
		FROM bisyspurgrouprights2 a LEFT JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id = b.id LEFT JOIN bidmnhom0 c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh0 = c.ma_nh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PRAuthorize]
	@cAction CHAR(4), 
	@nUserID INT, 
	@cDept VARCHAR(33), 
	@cFC VARCHAR(33), 
	@nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRet TINYINT
	SELECT @nRet = 0
	IF EXISTS
		(
			SELECT * FROM dmduyet WHERE loai_duyet = 1 AND user_id = @nUserID AND status = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC 
				AND (ma_bp = '' OR ma_bp = @cDept) AND (tien_nt = 0 OR tien_nt >= @nAmount)
		)
	SELECT @nRet = 1
	SELECT @nRet
END


GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vglns]
AS SELECT a.*, b.ten_ct AS ten_ct, b.ten_ct2 AS ten_ct2, b.stt AS stt FROM glns a JOIN dmctns b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CalculateTSAllocationExpense]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@tsCode VARCHAR(1023),
	@tsDept VARCHAR(32),
	@tsType VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@Diff TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- 1. Declare
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @dPrevious SMALLDATETIME, @datetime2 DATETIME, @dNFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dNTo SMALLDATETIME,
		@ma_dc_pb_ky0 VARCHAR(1), @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @keyD NVARCHAR(4000), @keyM NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- @UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin, 'New')

	SELECT @keyD = '', @keyM = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @keyM = @UnitKey
	IF @tsCode <> '' SET @keyM = @keyM + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END +
		CASE
			WHEN LEN(@tsCode) > 128 THEN 'dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_dc, ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsCode), '''', '''''') + ''') = 1'
			ELSE 'ma_dc' + CASE
				WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @tsCode) = 0 THEN ' = ''' + REPLACE(@tsCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
				ELSE ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@tsCode, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
			END
		END
	IF @tsType <> '' SET @keyM = @keyM + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'loai_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup1 <> '' SET @keyM = @keyM + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup2 <> '' SET @keyM = @keyM + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup3 <> '' SET @keyM = @keyM + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @tsDept <> '' SET @keyD = ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsDept), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #dmccdc FROM dmccdc

	SET @q = 'insert into #dmccdc select * from dmccdc' + CASE WHEN @keyM <> '' THEN ' where ' + @keyM ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 2. Set value, data temp
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year), @dTo = DATEADD(month, 1, @dFrom) - 1
	SELECT @dNFrom = @dTo + 1, @dNTo = DATEADD(month, 2, @dFrom) - 1

	SELECT @dPrevious = @dFrom - 1
	SELECT @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cc_pb_ky0'
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #t FROM ctpsdc
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong INTO #t2 FROM tpbdc
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp INTO #tPrev FROM ctcddc

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #dmccdc SET ngay_pb_kt = DATEADD(MONTH, so_ky_pb, ngay_pb0) - 1 WHERE ngay_pb_kt IS NULL AND kieu_pb = '0'
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.* from ctpsdc a with(index(ngay_ct)) join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc where a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + '''' + @keyD
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #t2
			select a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, sum(a.so_luong) as so_luong
				from tpbdc a join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				where (not (a.ngay_hl_tu > ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''' or a.ngay_hl_den < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + '''))' + @keyD +
				' group by a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 3. Tinh ton dau ky
	SET @q = 'insert into #tPrev
			select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, sum(a.so_luong), sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt),
					sum(a.gt_da_pb), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt), sum(a.gt_cl), sum(a.gt_cl_nt), max(a.tk_dc), max(a.tk_pb), max(a.tk_cp)
				from ctcddc a with (index(ky_nam)) join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(MONTH(@dPrevious)) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dPrevious)) + @keyD +
				' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #tPrev (ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat)
				, SUM(nguyen_gia_n - nguyen_gia_x), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt_n - nguyen_gia_nt_x)
				, SUM(gt_da_pb_n - gt_da_pb_x), SUM(gt_da_pb_nt_n - gt_da_pb_nt_x)
				, SUM(gt_cl_n - gt_cl_x), SUM(gt_cl_nt_n - gt_cl_nt_x)
				, MAX(tk_dc) AS tk_dc, MAX(tk_pb) AS tk_pb, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp
		 	FROM #t WHERE ngay_ct <= @dPrevious AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tPrev WHERE #t.ma_dc = #tPrev.ma_dc AND #t.ma_bp_dc = #tPrev.ma_bp_dc)
			GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc HAVING SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat) > 0

	-- Cap nhat lai cac tk neu nguoi dung co thay doi thong tin ccdc
	UPDATE #tPrev SET tk_dc = b.tk_dc, tk_pb = b.tk_pb, tk_cp = b.tk_cp, ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc
		FROM #tPrev a JOIN (SELECT ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp FROM #t WHERE loai_ps = '0') b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc

	-- 4. Tinh phat sinh trong ky
	INSERT INTO #tPrev (ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat)
				, SUM(nguyen_gia_n - nguyen_gia_x), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt_n - nguyen_gia_nt_x)
				, SUM(gt_da_pb_n - gt_da_pb_x), SUM(gt_da_pb_nt_n - gt_da_pb_nt_x)
				, SUM(gt_cl_n - gt_cl_x), SUM(gt_cl_nt_n - gt_cl_nt_x)
				, MAX(tk_dc) AS tk_dc, MAX(tk_pb) AS tk_pb, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp
		 	FROM #t WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc

	DELETE #tPrev WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctcddc b WHERE b.ky = @period AND b.nam = @year AND b.sua_pb = 1 AND b.ma_dc = #tPrev.ma_dc AND b.ma_bp_dc = #tPrev.ma_bp_dc)

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, MAX(b.ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(b.ty_gia) AS ty_gia
			, MAX(b.kieu_pb) AS kieu_pb, MAX(b.ngay_pb0) AS ngay_pb0, MAX(b.ngay_pb_kt) AS ngay_pb_kt
			, MAX(a.tk_dc) AS tk_dc, MAX(a.tk_pb) AS tk_pb, MAX(a.tk_cp) AS tk_cp
			, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, SUM(a.gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(a.gt_da_pb_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt
			, SUM(a.gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(a.gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(20, 6)) AS gt_pb_ky1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(20, 6)) AS gt_pb_ky_nt1
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(20, 6)) AS gt_pb_ky, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(20, 6)) AS gt_pb_ky_nt
		INTO #tFX FROM #tPrev a JOIN #dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc

	-- Truong hop khai bao giam co dieu chinh gia tri
	UPDATE #tFX SET gt_cl = nguyen_gia - gt_da_pb, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - gt_da_pb_nt

	UPDATE #tFX SET gt_pb_ky1 = b.gt_pb_ky1, gt_pb_ky_nt1 = b.gt_pb_ky_nt1 FROM #tFX a JOIN #dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc

	-- 5. Delete
	SET @q = 'delete ctcddc from ctcddc a join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' and a.sua_pb = 0' + @keyD
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 6. Calc
	DECLARE @periodF INT, @periodT INT
	SELECT @periodF = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dFrom), @periodT = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@dTo)

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky = ROUND((a.so_luong - ISNULL(b.so_luong, 0)) * a.gt_pb_ky1, @nRound), gt_pb_ky_nt = ROUND((a.so_luong - ISNULL(b.so_luong, 0)) * a.gt_pb_ky_nt1, @nFCRound)
		FROM #tFx a LEFT JOIN #t2 b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc WHERE a.so_luong > 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(a.ngay_pb0) <= @periodF

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky = 0, gt_pb_ky_nt = 0 WHERE kieu_pb = 1 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_pb0) <> @periodF AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_pb_kt) <> @periodT

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky = gt_cl, gt_pb_ky_nt = gt_cl_nt WHERE kieu_pb = 1 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_pb_kt) = @periodT

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky = gt_cl WHERE gt_pb_ky > gt_cl
	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky_nt = gt_cl_nt WHERE gt_pb_ky_nt > gt_cl_nt

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_da_pb = gt_da_pb + gt_pb_ky, gt_da_pb_nt = gt_da_pb_nt + gt_pb_ky_nt

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1'
		UPDATE #tFx SET gt_pb_ky = gt_cl, gt_pb_ky_nt = gt_cl_nt, gt_da_pb = nguyen_gia, gt_da_pb_nt = nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0
			WHERE kieu_pb = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_pb_kt) = @periodT

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_cl = gt_cl - gt_pb_ky, gt_cl_nt = gt_cl_nt - gt_pb_ky_nt WHERE NOT (@ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1' AND kieu_pb = 0 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_pb_kt) = @periodT)

	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_cl = 0 WHERE gt_cl < 0
	UPDATE #tFx SET gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE gt_cl_nt < 0

	INSERT INTO ctcddc (
				ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp,
				so_luong, nguyen_gia, gt_da_pb, gt_cl, gt_pb_ky, ng_giam, cl_giam,
				ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_pb_ky_nt, ng_giam_nt, cl_giam_nt,
				sua_pb, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
		) SELECT @period, @year, ma_dvcs, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp,
				a.so_luong, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_cl, a.gt_pb_ky, ISNULL(b.ng_giam, 0), ISNULL(b.cl_giam, 0),
				a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_pb_ky_nt, ISNULL(b.ng_giam_nt, 0), ISNULL(b.cl_giam_nt, 0),
				0, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
			FROM #tFx a LEFT JOIN
				(
					SELECT ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, SUM(nguyen_gia_x) AS ng_giam , SUM(nguyen_gia_nt_x) AS ng_giam_nt, SUM(gt_cl_x) AS cl_giam, SUM(gt_cl_nt_x) AS cl_giam_nt
						FROM #t
						WHERE loai_ps = 2 AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
				)
			GROUP BY ma_dc, ma_bp_dc) b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc
			WHERE
				NOT (a.so_luong = 0 AND a.nguyen_gia = 0 AND a.gt_da_pb = 0 AND a.gt_cl = 0 AND a.gt_pb_ky = 0 AND ISNULL(b.ng_giam, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(b.cl_giam, 0) = 0 AND
				a.nguyen_gia_nt = 0 AND a.gt_da_pb_nt = 0 AND a.gt_cl_nt = 0 AND a.gt_pb_ky_nt = 0 AND ISNULL(b.ng_giam_nt, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(b.cl_giam_nt, 0) = 0)

/*
	UPDATE ctpsdc SET gt_cl_n = ROUND(b.gt_cl * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_cl_nt_n = ROUND(b.gt_cl_nt * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_cl_x = ROUND(b.gt_cl * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_cl_nt_x = ROUND(b.gt_cl_nt * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_da_pb_n = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_da_pb_nt_n = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb_nt * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_da_pb_x = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_da_pb_nt_x = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb_nt * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		FROM ctpsdc a JOIN #tFx b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNFrom AND @dNTo) AND b.so_luong > 0 AND a.loai_ps = 1
			AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dcbpsddc c WHERE c.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND c.ma_bp_tu = b.ma_bp_dc AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNFrom AND @dNTo))

	UPDATE ctpsdc SET gt_cl_n = ROUND(b.gt_cl * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_cl_nt_n = ROUND(b.gt_cl_nt * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_cl_x = ROUND(b.gt_cl * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_cl_nt_x = ROUND(b.gt_cl_nt * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_da_pb_n = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_da_pb_nt_n = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb_nt * a.sl_nhap / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		, gt_da_pb_x = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nRound), gt_da_pb_nt_x = ROUND(b.gt_da_pb_nt * a.sl_xuat / b.so_luong, @nFCRound)
		FROM ctpsdc a JOIN #tFx b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNFrom AND @dNTo) AND b.so_luong > 0 AND a.loai_ps = 2
			AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gpbdc c WHERE c.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND c.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc AND c.sua_gt_pb = '0' AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dNFrom AND @dNTo))
*/


	IF @Diff = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_dc, MAX(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.gt_pb_ky) AS gt_pb_ky, SUM(a.gt_pb_ky_nt) AS gt_pb_ky_nt
			INTO #re FROM ctcddc a JOIN #dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			WHERE a.ky = @period AND a.nam = @year AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2 c WHERE a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc)
				AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ctcddc d WHERE (d.nam * 12 + d.ky <= @year * 12 + @period) AND d.ma_dc = a.ma_dc AND d.sua_pb = '1')
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_pb_kt) <> @periodT
			GROUP BY a.ma_dc HAVING SUM(a.gt_pb_ky + gt_pb_ky_nt) <> 0 AND SUM(a.cl_giam + a.cl_giam_nt) = 0

		SELECT a.ma_dc, a.t_gt_pb_ky - b.gt_pb_ky AS cl, a.t_gt_pb_ky_nt - b.gt_pb_ky_nt AS cl_nt, b.so_luong INTO #diff
			FROM dmccdc a JOIN #re b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc WHERE (a.t_gt_pb_ky - b.gt_pb_ky <> 0) OR (a.t_gt_pb_ky_nt - b.gt_pb_ky_nt) <> 0

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #diff) BEGIN
			SELECT a.ma_dc, MAX(a.ma_bp_dc) AS ma_bp_dc INTO #u FROM #tFx a JOIN #diff b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.so_luong = b.so_luong GROUP BY a.ma_dc

			UPDATE ctcddc SET gt_pb_ky = a.gt_pb_ky + b.cl, gt_pb_ky_nt = a.gt_pb_ky_nt + b.cl_nt,
					gt_da_pb = a.gt_da_pb + b.cl, gt_da_pb_nt = a.gt_da_pb_nt + b.cl_nt, gt_cl = a.gt_cl - b.cl, gt_cl_nt = a.gt_cl_nt - b.cl_nt
				FROM ctcddc a JOIN #diff b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				WHERE a.ky = @period AND a.nam = @year AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #u WHERE #u.ma_dc = a.ma_dc AND #u.ma_bp_dc = a.ma_bp_dc)
		END

		DROP TABLE #re, #diff
	END

	SET @q = 'update ctcddc set nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_pb_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_pb_ky_nt = 0, ng_giam_nt = 0
			from ctcddc a join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' and a.ma_nt in (select val from options where name = ''m_ma_nt0'')' + @keyD
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update ctcddc set nguyen_gia_nt = 0, nguyen_gia = 0, gt_da_pb_nt = 0, gt_da_pb = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_cl = 0
				, ng_giam_nt = ng_giam_nt + nguyen_gia_nt, ng_giam = ng_giam + nguyen_gia
				, cl_giam_nt = cl_giam_nt + gt_da_pb_nt + gt_cl_nt, cl_giam = cl_giam + gt_da_pb + gt_cl
			from ctcddc a join #dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' and a.so_luong = 0' + @keyD
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	DROP TABLE #tFX, #tPrev, #t, #t2

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_Post2InfoRecord]
	@msterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@keys NVARCHAR(512),
	@masterField NVARCHAR(512),
	@external NVARCHAR(512),
	@subPriceName VARCHAR(16) = '' -- Ex: OA -  gia_nt0,  otherwise  gia_nt
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @qtyRound INT, @priceRound INT, @updateString NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @qtyRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #gia01 FROM bigia01 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #gia02 FROM bigia02 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #bigia0dc FROM bigia0dc a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr AS id, gia_nt AS gia_cl_nt, gia_nt AS ck_dv_nt, gia_nt AS cp_dv_nt, ck_nt AS ck_nt, cp_nt AS cp_nt, gia_nt AS gia_net, line_nbr AS id_pv
		INTO #cts FROM bigia01
	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr AS id, so_luong AS sl_tu, gia_nt, ghi_chu, ct_gia_dk, ct_gia_dk AS ct_gia_kq, stt_rec1, c.gia_cl_nt, c.ck_dv_nt, c.cp_dv_nt, c.ck_nt, c.cp_nt
		INTO #giapv FROM #gia01 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL AS b) b ON 1 = 0 CROSS JOIN #cts c

	-- Data for posting
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #dprice FROM #detail
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dprice select * from ' + @detailTable + CASE WHEN @keys <> '' THEN ' where ' + @keys ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Only Voucher Detail
	SELECT @q = N'
insert into #gia01(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, dien_giai, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, 
	ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt1, he_so1, so_luong1, gia_chuan_nt1, gia_nt1, ck_dv_nt1, cp_dv_nt1, ck_nt, cp_nt, ct_gia_dk, ghi_chu)
	select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, '''', b.ma_ct, b.loai_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_nt, b.dien_giai, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
			b.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, 0, a.gia_chuan_nt, a.gia_nt' + @subPriceName + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', ''''
		from #dprice a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.ct_gia_pv = '''' and a.ct_gia_dk = ''''
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @detailTable) AND name = 'ghi_chu') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #gia01 set ghi_chu = b.ghi_chu from #gia01 a join ' + @detailTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- SCL, CTs
	DECLARE @ct_gia_pv NVARCHAR(4000), @ct_gia_dk NVARCHAR(4000), @ct_gia_kq NVARCHAR(4000), @ln INT, @gia_chuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @stt_rec1 CHAR(3)
	SELECT @ln = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #dprice WHERE (ct_gia_pv <> '' OR ct_gia_dk <> '')
	WHILE @ln IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @ct_gia_pv = ct_gia_pv, @ct_gia_dk = ct_gia_dk, @gia_chuan = gia_chuan_nt FROM #dprice WHERE line_nbr = @ln
		
		-- + CTs
		IF @ct_gia_dk <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = N'
insert into #gia01(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, dien_giai, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung,
	ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt1, he_so1, so_luong1, gia_chuan_nt1, gia_nt1, ck_dv_nt1, cp_dv_nt1, ck_nt, cp_nt, ct_gia_dk, ghi_chu)
	select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, '''', b.ma_ct, b.loai_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_nt, b.dien_giai, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
			b.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, 0, a.gia_chuan_nt, a.pp_gia_cl_nt, a.pp_ck_dv_nt, a.pp_cp_dv_nt, a.pp_ck_nt, a.pp_cp_nt, a.ct_gia_dk, ''''
		from #dprice a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where line_nbr = @ln
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@ln int', @ln
		END

		-- + SCL
		IF @ct_gia_pv <> '' BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #cts
			TRUNCATE TABLE #giapv
			
			EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_gia_pv, '#giapv', 'id, sl_tu, gia_nt, ghi_chu, ct_gia_dk, ct_gia_kq'
			UPDATE #giapv SET stt_rec1 = RIGHT('000' + LTRIM(id), 3)
			

			DECLARE @x INT
			SELECT @x = MIN(id) FROM #giapv WHERE ct_gia_dk <> ''
			WHILE @x IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @ct_gia_kq = '[' + ct_gia_kq + ']' FROM #giapv WHERE id = @x
				EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_gia_kq, '#cts', 'id, gia_cl_nt, ck_dv_nt, cp_dv_nt, ck_nt, cp_nt, gia_net', 1
				UPDATE #cts SET id_pv = @x WHERE id_pv IS NULL
				--
				SELECT @x = MIN(id) FROM #giapv WHERE ct_gia_dk <> '' AND id > @x
			END

			INSERT INTO #gia01(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, dien_giai, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung,
					ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt1, he_so1, so_luong1, gia_chuan_nt1, gia_nt1, 
					ck_dv_nt1, cp_dv_nt1, ck_nt, cp_nt, ct_gia_dk, ghi_chu) 
				SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, c.stt_rec1, b.ma_ct, b.loai_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_nt, b.dien_giai, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
					b.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, c.sl_tu, c.gia_nt, 
					CASE WHEN c.ct_gia_dk = '' THEN c.gia_nt ELSE ISNULL(d.gia_cl_nt, 0) END,
					CASE WHEN c.ct_gia_dk = '' THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.ck_dv_nt, 0) END, CASE WHEN c.ct_gia_dk = '' THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.cp_dv_nt, 0) END, 
					CASE WHEN c.ct_gia_dk = '' THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.ck_nt, 0) END, CASE WHEN c.ct_gia_dk = '' THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(d.cp_nt, 0) END, 
					c.ct_gia_dk, c.ghi_chu
				FROM #dprice a JOIN #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec CROSS JOIN #giapv c LEFT JOIN #cts d ON c.id = d.id_pv
				WHERE line_nbr = @ln
		END
		
		--
		SELECT @ln = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #dprice WHERE (ct_gia_pv <> '' OR ct_gia_dk <> '') AND line_nbr > @ln
	END

	-- Convert to Orginal UOM
	DECLARE @hs NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #gia01 SET so_luong = ROUND(so_luong1 * he_so1, @qtyRound), 
			gia_chuan_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 <> 0 THEN ROUND(gia_chuan_nt1 / he_so1, @priceRound) ELSE 0 END,
			gia_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 <> 0 THEN ROUND(gia_nt1 / he_so1, @priceRound) ELSE 0 END, 
			ck_dv_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 <> 0 THEN ROUND(ck_dv_nt1 / he_so1, @priceRound) ELSE 0 END, 
			cp_dv_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 <> 0 THEN ROUND(cp_dv_nt1 / he_so1, @priceRound) ELSE 0 END
		FROM #gia01 a

	
	-- 
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) stt, stt_rec0, stt_rec1 INTO #o FROM #gia01 ORDER BY stt_rec0, stt_rec1
	UPDATE #gia01 SET line_nbr = o.stt FROM #gia01 a JOIN #o o ON a.stt_rec0 = o.stt_rec0 AND a.stt_rec1 = o.stt_rec1
	UPDATE #gia01 SET status = '1', datetime0 = a.datetime0, [datetime2] = a.[datetime2], user_id0 = a.user_id0, user_id2 = a.user_id2 FROM #master a
	

	INSERT INTO #gia02(stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, dien_giai, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, 
			ma_kh, ma_vt, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, ma_rb, so_ngay_giao, sl_dat_tt, sl_dat_td, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ma_ct, b.loai_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_nt, b.dien_giai, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
			b.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN b.ma_ct = 'PO1' AND b.loai_ct IN('3', '4') THEN b.ngay_ct ELSE b.ngay_hl_tu END, CASE WHEN b.ma_ct = 'PO1' AND b.loai_ct IN('3', '4') THEN NULL ELSE b.ngay_hl_den END, a.ma_rb, a.so_ngay_giao, ROUND(sl_dat_tt * a.he_so, @qtyRound), ROUND(sl_dat_td * a.he_so, @qtyRound), 1, b.datetime0, b.datetime2, b.user_id0, b.user_id2
		FROM #dprice a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	
	-- Post IR
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#bigia0dc', @detailTable, NULL, @Keys, NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @masterField <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @updateString = ''
		SELECT @updateString = @updateString + CASE WHEN @updateString <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) + ' = b.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@masterField, ',')
		SELECT @q = 'update #bigia0dc set ' + @updateString + ' from #bigia0dc a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF ISNULL(@external, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #bigia0dc set ' + @External + ' from #bigia0dc a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + CASE WHEN charindex('c.', @External) = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' join #detail c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec0' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Delete and Save
	DELETE bigia0dc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO bigia0dc SELECT * FROM #bigia0dc ORDER BY line_nbr

	-- Delete and Save
	DELETE bigia01 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO bigia01 SELECT * FROM #gia01 ORDER BY line_nbr

	DELETE bigia02 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO bigia02 SELECT * FROM #gia02

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$Allocation]
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherType CHAR(1), 
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@MasterForeignCurrencyField VARCHAR(16), 
	@MasterBaseCurrencyField VARCHAR(16), 
	@DetaiForeignCurrencyField VARCHAR(16),
	@DetaiBaseCurrencyField VARCHAR(16),
	@PostingTable VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerField VARCHAR(32),
	@DetailFields VARCHAR(4000),
	@BalanceAccountChecking TINYINT = 0,
	@AccountField VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--

	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @CommonFields VARCHAR(1024), @Type TINYINT, @i INT, @c INT, @Field VARCHAR(32), @Table NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @Where VARCHAR(1024)
	
	SELECT @strSQL = N'select @o = count(1) from ' + @MasterTable + ' where loai_ct <> ''3'''
	EXECUTE sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@o int output', @o = @c OUTPUT

	IF ((@c > 0 OR @VoucherType = '0') AND @VoucherType <> '3') BEGIN

		SELECT @CommonFields = 'ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, dien_giai, tk, ma_nt, ty_gia, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
		SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into ' + @PostingTable + '(' + @CommonFields + ', stt_rec, ma_kh, t_tt_nt, t_tt, da_pb, stt_rec_pb) select '




		IF (@BalanceAccountChecking = 1 AND @AccountField <> '') BEGIN
			SELECT @Where = '(a.' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ' + a.' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ' <> 0)'

			SELECT @CommonFields = ', b.' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@CommonFields, ' ', ''), ',', ', b.') + ','
			SELECT @CommonFields = SUBSTRING(@CommonFields, 3, LEN(@CommonFields) - 3)
			SELECT @CommonFields = REPLACE(@CommonFields, 'b.tk', 'a.' + @AccountField + '')

			SELECT @Table = '(select a.stt_rec, min(stt_rec0) as stt_rec0, a.' + @AccountField + ', sum(' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ') as ' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ', sum(' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ') as ' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a join dmtk b on a.' + @AccountField + ' = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 1 group by a.stt_rec, a.' + @AccountField + ')'

			SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + @CommonFields + ', left(a.stt_rec, 10) + a.stt_rec0, b.ma_kh, a.' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ', a.' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ', 0, '''' from ' + @Table + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherType = '0' THEN @Where ELSE @Where + ' and loai_ct <> ''3''' END

		END ELSE BEGIN

			SELECT @Where = '(a.' + @MasterForeignCurrencyField + ' + a.' + @MasterBaseCurrencyField + ' <> 0)'
			SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + @CommonFields + ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, a.' + @MasterForeignCurrencyField + ', a.' + @MasterBaseCurrencyField + ', 0, '''' from ' + @MasterTable + ' a where ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherType = '0' THEN @Where ELSE @Where + ' and loai_ct <> ''3''' END

		END


		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	END


	IF @VoucherType = '0' RETURN


	SELECT @strSQL = N'select @o = count(1) from ' + @MasterTable + ' where loai_ct = ''3'' or ''' + @VoucherType + ''' = ''3'''
	EXECUTE sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@o int output', @o = @c OUTPUT
	
	IF (@c > 0) BEGIN 
		SELECT @CommonFields = 'ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, dien_giai, tk, ma_nt, ty_gia, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
		SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into ' + @PostingTable + '(' + @CommonFields + ', stt_rec, ma_kh, t_tt_nt, t_tt, da_pb, stt_rec_pb) select ' 	
		SELECT @CommonFields = ', b.' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@CommonFields, ' ', ''), ',', ', b.') + ','

		IF @DetailFields <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@DetailFields, ',') BEGIN
				SELECT @Field = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@DetailFields, @i, ',')
				SELECT @CommonFields = REPLACE(@CommonFields, ', b.' + @Field + ',', ', a.' + @Field + ',')
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END

		SELECT @Where = '(a.' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ' + a.' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ' <> 0)'
		IF (@BalanceAccountChecking = 1 AND @AccountField <> '') SELECT @Join = ' join dmtk c on c.tk = a.' + @AccountField, @Where = @Where + ' and c.tk_cn = 1' ELSE SELECT @Join = ''

		SELECT @CommonFields = SUBSTRING(@CommonFields, 3, LEN(@CommonFields) - 3)
		IF @AccountField <> '' SELECT @CommonFields = REPLACE(@CommonFields, 'b.tk', 'a.' + @AccountField + '')
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + @CommonFields + ', left(a.stt_rec, 10) + a.stt_rec0, a.' + @CustomerField + ', a.' + @DetaiForeignCurrencyField + ', a.' + @DetaiBaseCurrencyField + ', 0, '''' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where (b.loai_ct = ''3'' or ''' + @VoucherType + ''' = ''3'') and ' + @Where

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintARTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@SalesAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@TaxCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '', '''') + '%'

	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @SalesAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TaxCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TaxCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i21$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m21$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptViewAccessVoucher] -- fs20_VoucherLog  
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 	
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(128),
	@Action CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @m$ VARCHAR(128), @dateField VARCHAR(64), @Ngay_gh1 SMALLDATETIME, @Ngay_gh2 SMALLDATETIME

	IF @Action = 1 SET @dateField = 'datetime0' ELSE SET @dateField = 'datetime2'
	SELECT @Ngay_gh1 = ngay_gh1, @Ngay_gh2 = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt

	-- Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = '(' + @dateField + ' between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, dien_giai, datetime2 AS ngay_sc INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	DECLARE xCur CURSOR FOR	SELECT RTRIM(m$) AS m$ FROM dmct9 a JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE (@VoucherCode = '' OR a.ma_ct = @VoucherCode) AND m$ <> '' AND RTRIM(UPPER(m$)) NOT IN ('PHDM', 'PHRT', 'PHWO', 'PHSF', 'PHNL') ORDER BY m$
	OPEN xCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @m$
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.dien_giai'
		SET @q = @q + ', NULL'--' , b.datetime2'
		SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @m$ + '%Partition a with(nolock)'--, index(' + @dateField + '))'
		--SET @q = @q + ' left join (select stt_rec, min(datetime2) as datetime2 from r00$%Partition with(nolock) group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key
		IF @Action = '2' SET @q = @q + ' and datetime0 <>  datetime2'
		SET @q = @q + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, @dateField, @Ngay_gh1, @Ngay_gh2, @UserID, @Admin

		FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @m$
	END
	CLOSE xCur
	DEALLOCATE xCur

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, a.datetime0 AS ngay, a.datetime2, a.user_id0 AS userID, dien_giai, ngay_sc
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.comment ELSE b.comment2 END AS userName
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id0 = b.id
		ORDER BY a.datetime0, ma_ct

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEInvoiceUnPost]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32),  @Status VARCHAR(1)

	SELECT @Table = mtable, @Status = status_gl FROM hddtfields WHERE xtype = 3 and ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	CREATE TABLE #name (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))

	INSERT INTO #name SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI004' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI005' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI006' THEN 2 WHEN ccode = 'EI007' THEN 3 WHEN ccode = 'EI008' THEN 9 WHEN ccode = 'EI009' THEN 8 WHEN ccode = 'EI010' THEN 4 WHEN ccode = 'EI011' THEN 5 WHEN ccode = 'EI012' THEN 6 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI004', 'EI005', 'EI006', 'EI007', 'EI008', 'EI009', 'EI010', 'EI011', 'EI012')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct AS so_ct_hddt, so_seri AS so_seri_hddt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS mau_hddt, ma_kh, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, status AS tinh_trang_hddt, t_tt_nt AS t_km_nt INTO #result FROM m81$000000

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''' and c.kieu_xl = ''0'''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''4'', ''9'') and b.status = ''' + @Status + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
	IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @VoucherCode IN('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, b.mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt, b.tinh_trang_hddt' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN ', a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt' ELSE ', 0' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join hddt02 c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, tien_nt + a.t_km_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, c.name AS tinh_trang, a.tinh_trang_hddt
		FROM #result a
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN #name c ON a.tinh_trang_hddt = c.code
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	DROP TABLE #result

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostPITran]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @qtyRound INT, @priceRound INT, @vcNumber CHAR(12), @vcDate SMALLDATETIME, @vendor VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @qtyRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m95$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, 0 AS sl_dat_tt, 0 AS sl_dat_td, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS ct_gia_pv INTO #detail FROM d95$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Get Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select *, 0, 0, '''' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @vcNumber = so_ct, @vcDate = ngay_ct, @vendor = ma_kh FROM #master


	-- Post Price
	DECLARE @external NVARCHAR(512), @masterField NVARCHAR(512), @keys NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @keys = 'cn_tt_gia = ''1'' and so_tham_chieu = ''''', @external = 'ma_vt_ncc = c.ma_vt0, status = 1, ncc_tx = 0, tien_nt = c.tien_nt0, gia_nt = c.gia_nt0, ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_ct, ngay_hl_den = null', @masterField = 'ma_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, ma_dvcs, ma_nh0, ma_bp0, ma_kh, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	EXEC bs_Post2InfoRecord '#master', '#detail', @idNumber, @keys,	@masterField, @external, '0'

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptRawMaterialComparisonByProduct] -- fs20_Cobcssttdm
	@Period1 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year1 NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @iNum INT
	DECLARE @nPRound TINYINT, @nFCPRound TINYINT, @nRound TINYINT, @nqRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @nFCPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TL'
	SELECT @nqRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_SL'
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = '((a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between (' + RTRIM(@Year1 * 12 + @Period1) + ') and (' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2) + '))'
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_yt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@CE, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	-- Unit
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, b.sl_tp, a.ma_yt, a.sl_gt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.ky, a.nam INTO #report0 FROM xcdvtdd a, xcdspdd b
	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt INTO #report2 FROM ctdm a LEFT JOIN phdm b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	SET @q = 'insert into #report0 select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, b.sl_tp, a.ma_yt, a.sl_gt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.ky, a.nam'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdvtdd a with(nolock) left join xcdspdd b with(nolock) on a.ky = b.ky and a.nam = b.nam and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Report
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt
			, SUM(sl_gt) AS sl_gt, SUM(gt) AS gt, SUM(gt_nt) AS gt_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt0, MAX(sl_tp) AS sl_tp 
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(16)) AS tien_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt_cl		
			, ky, nam
		INTO #report1 FROM #report0 GROUP BY ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt

	SET @Key = '(a.ngay_ct1 <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period1, @Year1), 112) + ''' or a.ngay_ct1 is null)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ngay_ct2 >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year1), 112) + ''' or a.ngay_ct2 is null)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_luong <> 0'
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SET @q = 'insert into #report2 select b.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, round((a.so_luong/b.he_so)*a.he_so, ' + RTRIM(@nqRound) + ') as so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctdm a with(nolock) left join phdm b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report1 SET so_luong0 = b.so_luong, tien0 = b.tien, tien_nt0 = b.tien_nt
		 FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN #report2 b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt 

	UPDATE #report1 SET so_luong0 = CASE WHEN sl_tp IS NULL THEN so_luong0 ELSE so_luong0 * sl_tp END 
	UPDATE #report1 SET tien0 = CASE WHEN sl_tp IS NULL THEN tien0 ELSE tien0 * sl_tp END 
	UPDATE #report1 SET tien_nt0 = CASE WHEN sl_tp IS NULL THEN tien_nt0 ELSE tien_nt0 * sl_tp END
	
	UPDATE #report1 SET gia = CASE WHEN sl_gt = 0 OR sl_gt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt/sl_gt, @nPRound) END 
	UPDATE #report1 SET gia_nt = CASE WHEN sl_gt = 0 OR sl_gt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt_nt/sl_gt, @nFCPRound) END  
	UPDATE #report1 SET gia0 = gia, gia_nt0 = gia_nt
	
	UPDATE #report1 SET tien0 = gia0 * so_luong0 
	UPDATE #report1 SET tien_nt0 = gia_nt0 * so_luong0	
	UPDATE #report1 SET sl_cl = sl_gt - so_luong0, tien_cl = gt - tien0, tien_nt_cl = gt_nt - tien_nt0
	
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt
			, SUM(sl_gt) AS sl_gt, SUM(gt) AS gt, SUM(gt_nt) AS gt_nt, SUM(so_luong0) AS so_luong0, SUM(tien0) AS tien0, SUM(tien_nt0) AS tien_nt0, SUM(sl_tp) AS sl_tp
			, AVG(gia0) AS gia0, AVG(gia_nt0) AS gia_nt0, AVG(gia) AS gia, AVG(gia_nt) AS gia_nt
			, SUM(sl_cl) AS sl_cl, SUM(tien_cl) AS tien_cl, SUM(tien_nt_cl) AS tien_nt_cl
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_sl_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_tien_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_tien_nt_cl
		INTO #report
		FROM #report1
		GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_lsx, ma_bp, ma_sp, ma_vt, ma_dvcs', 'INT, #, #, #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 0, 0, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_sp, SUM(sl_gt), SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt), SUM(so_luong0), SUM(tien0), SUM(tien_nt0), AVG(sl_tp)
			, SUM(gia0), SUM(gia_nt0), SUM(gia), SUM(gia_nt), SUM(sl_cl), SUM(tien_cl), SUM(tien_nt_cl), SUM(ty_le_sl_cl), SUM(ty_le_tien_cl), SUM(ty_le_tien_nt_cl) 
		FROM #report GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp

	UPDATE #report SET ty_le_sl_cl = CASE WHEN so_luong0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(sl_cl*100/so_luong0, @nRound) END
	UPDATE #report SET ty_le_tien_cl = CASE WHEN tien0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_cl*100/tien0, @nRound) END
	UPDATE #report SET ty_le_tien_nt_cl = CASE WHEN tien_nt0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt_cl*100 / tien_nt0, @nRound) END
	
	UPDATE #report SET gia0 = CASE WHEN so_luong0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien0/so_luong0, @nPRound) END 
	UPDATE #report SET gia_nt0 = CASE WHEN so_luong0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt0/so_luong0, @nFCPRound)END
	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN (sl_gt = 0 OR sl_gt IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt/sl_gt, @nPRound) END 
	UPDATE #report SET gia_nt = CASE WHEN (sl_gt = 0 OR sl_gt IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt_nt/sl_gt, @nFCPRound) END 
	
	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_dvcs INTO #stt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 4 ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
		WHERE a.sysorder = 4
	UPDATE #report SET stt = NULL WHERE sysorder = 5
	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_bp) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '')	

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt2 FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.sysorder, a.stt, a.ma_vt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END




GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_Dec2Seq(@nDec AS BIGINT) 
RETURNS VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nQuot BIGINT, @sHex VARCHAR(128), @nRem AS BIGINT, @cHex VARCHAR(1)
	SELECT @sHex = '', @nQuot = @nDec 
	WHILE @nQuot > 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nRem=@nQuot%36
			SELECT @nQuot=@nQuot/36
			SELECT @cHex = CASE WHEN @nRem < 10 THEN CAST(@nRem AS VARCHAR) ELSE CHAR(@nRem + 55) END
			SET @sHex = @cHex + @sHex
		END 
	RETURN @sHex
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPFTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.dvt, a.ma_kho, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.cp'
	--Edit BI start
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt'
