									WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', rtrim(a.ma_vt) as ma_vt, (rtrim(a.ma_vt) + '' - '' + rtrim(g.ten_vt' + @cE + ')) as description'
	--Edit BI End
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'  
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	--Edit BI start
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN '' WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ',ma_vt, description'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI End
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReceiptTransactionList]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer  VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Site_n VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(254),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@MONumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Size_lsx TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: thuc te , 2: Hoa don , 3: thuc te dvt, 4: hoa don dvt
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr, stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.tk_du, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_ct
			, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong, a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, a.dvt1 AS dvt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkin a

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @TableName, @controller, @SysDB, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a'), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a')

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site_n <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_khon like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site_n), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MONumber <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MONumber), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @queryJoin <> '' SET @Join = @Join + @queryJoin

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select line_nbr, stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.tk_du, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_ct, a.gia$, a.gia_nt$'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', a.sl_nhap$, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n' ELSE ', a.sl_xuat$, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.dvt1, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields

	IF @DataType >= 3
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '$', '1')
	ELSE
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'a.dvt1', 'null'), '$', '')

	IF @DataType = '1' OR @DataType = '3' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType = '2' OR @DataType = '4' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET  @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET  @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vt', 0)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(ma_vt, ma_kh) VALUES ('', '')

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SET @q = 'SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec AS rp_group, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.tk_du, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ISNULL(a.dvt, c.dvt) AS dvt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'd.ten_kh2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh2'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Order), '''', '''''') + ', a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

  --
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetNextWorkDate (@d SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN 
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE ngay_nghi = @d)
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(day, 1, @d)

	RETURN @d
END
GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetListFieldType
	(
	@cListField VARCHAR(128)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(256) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @i INT, @cField VARCHAR(32), @cFieldType VARCHAR(32), @cRe NVARCHAR(256)
	SET @i = 1
	SET @cRe = ''
	WHILE 1 = 1
	BEGIN
		SET @cField = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cListField, @i)
		SELECT @cFieldType = xfieldtype FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cField
		IF @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@cListField) SET @cRe = @cRe + ',' + @cFieldType ELSE BREAK
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	IF @cRe <> '' SET @cRe = SUBSTRING(@cRe, 2, LEN(@cRe))
	RETURN @cRe
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintARTranMultiCopies]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@cMTable CHAR(10),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@eTable CHAR(10) = '', 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @so_lien INT, @max INT, @discount NVARCHAR(256), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @ListNo VARCHAR(32), @ListDate SMALLDATETIME, @Enclosed NVARCHAR(511), @d CHAR(2), @m CHAR(2), @y CHAR(4)
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511), @printTable VARCHAR(32), @printJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33)
	
	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Enclosed = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'
	SELECT @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @eTable = CASE WHEN @eTable <> ''  THEN @eTable ELSE 'e21$000000' END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_in_bk_yn' AND val = '1') begin
		SELECT @ListNo = REPLACE(so_bk, '''', ''''''), @ListDate = ngay_bk, @d = REPLACE(STR(DAY(ngay_bk), 2), ' ', '0'), @m = REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_bk), 2), ' ', '0'),
			@y = CAST(YEAR(ngay_bk) AS CHAR(4)) FROM v01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	END
	SELECT @ListNo = ISNULL(@ListNo, ''), @d = ISNULL(@d, ''), @m = ISNULL(@m, ''), @y = ISNULL(@y, '')

						, case when a.thue_suat in (5, 3.5) then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_5, case when a.thue_suat in (5, 3.5) then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_5

	IF @printVATDetail = 0
		UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 1

	ELSE
		SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup
				, so_lien, so_lien2, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam
				, thue_suat, ten_kh, thanh_toan, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word
				, so_hd, ngay_hd, ht_tt, dd_gh, dd_nh, so_vd, so_con, dv_vc, dien_giai
				, customize, detail
			FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoCreateMaterialsIssue]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - New, 2 - Delete
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64),
	@Message NVARCHAR(511) = '' OUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @optStyle CHAR(1), @optDes NVARCHAR(511), @optStatus CHAR(1), @optInstockSplit CHAR(1), @optMovingStock CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @unitKeyAccess NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKeyNew NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKeyDel NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
	DECLARE @identityNumber CHAR(13), @sysKey VARCHAR(32), @status CHAR(1), @p CHAR(6), @stock tinyint
	DECLARE @count INT, @wsID varchar(8), @baseCurrency varchar(8), @datetime0 SMALLDATETIME, @voucherID varchar(8), @contact NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @soct0 VARCHAR(32), @soct1 VARCHAR(32), @soct2 VARCHAR(32), @numStr0 VARCHAR(32), @numPart1 VARCHAR(32), @numPart2 VARCHAR(32), @num0 BIGINT, @num2 BIGINT, @numMaxLen INT, @endCode NVARCHAR(33)

	-- Options
	SELECT @optInstockSplit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split'
	SELECT @optMovingStock = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options where name in ('m_instock_process3', 'm_instock_process4', 'm_instock3', 'm_instock4') and val > 0) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	SELECT @datetime0 = GETDATE(), @voucherID = 'PXA', @Message = ''

	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_vt AS ma_sp, ma_kho, sl_nhap AS so_luong, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd INTO #pn from wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sl_nhap, sl_xuat INTO #currentStock FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat INTO #movingStock FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #i84 FROM i84$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS sysKey, *, CAST(0 AS INT) AS id INTO #m84 FROM wrkistran
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS sysKey, *, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #d84 FROM wrkisdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS sysKey, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, so_luong INTO #vdetail FROM #pn
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS sysKey, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_sp, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #vmaster FROM #pn

	-- General Key
	IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
		SET @unitKeyAccess = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
		SET @unitKeyNew = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @unitKeyDel = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'Delete')
	END

	-- Delete Auto-Generated Issue
	SET @key = 'a.ngay_ct between @DateFrom and @DateTo and exists(select 1 from cttd z where a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec)'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SET @key = @key + ' and a.[status] <> ''*'''
	IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
		IF @unitKeyNew IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKeyNew
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @unitKeyDel IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKeyDel
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, [status], CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part INTO #vdel FROM r70$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #vdel select a.stt_rec, a.status, convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from c84$000000 a with(nolock) where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@DateFrom smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo

	IF @Type = '2' GOTO DelVoucher;







	-- Generate
	SELECT @optStyle = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_xknvl_kieu'
	SELECT @optDes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_xknvl_dg'
	SELECT @optStatus = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_xknvl_tt'
	SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @contact = ong_ba FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @Customer
	SELECT @numMaxLen = character_maximum_length FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'm84$000000' AND column_name = 'so_ct'
	SELECT @soct0 = so_ct0, @soct1 = so_ct1, @soct2 = so_ct2 from v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

	DECLARE @r BIT
	EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @soct0, @r OUT, @num0 OUT, @numStr0 OUT, @numPart1 OUT, 1, @numPart2 OUT, 1
	IF @numStr0 = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Không xác định được số bắt đầu của quyển chứng từ: ' ELSE N'Can not determine the number of voucher book: ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherBook, '\', '\\'), '''', '\''')
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @num2 = SUBSTRING(@soct2, LEN(@numPart1) + CASE WHEN @r = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, LEN(@numStr0))
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vt, b.loai_vt INTO #item FROM dmvtxktd a, dmvt b
	SET @q = 'insert into #item select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vt, b.loai_vt from dmvtxktd a with(nolock) join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @unitKeyAccess IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @unitKeyAccess
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @Key = 'ma_ct = ''PND'' and a.loai_ct = ''2'' and a.ma_gd = ''4'''
	IF @unitKeyAccess IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKeyAccess
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #pn select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.sl_nhap, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join #item b on b.loai_vt in (''41'', ''51'') and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--+ Voucher Number
	IF @optStyle = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #vdetail(sysKey, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, so_luong)
			SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, MAX(ngay_ct), MAX(so_ct), ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, SUM(so_luong)
				FROM #pn GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd
		INSERT INTO #vmaster(syskey, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs) SELECT DISTINCT syskey, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs FROM #vdetail ORDER BY so_ct
	END

	--+ Date
	IF @optStyle = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #vdetail(sysKey, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, so_luong)
			SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112),
					'', ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, SUM(so_luong)
				FROM #pn GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd
		INSERT INTO #vmaster(syskey, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs) SELECT DISTINCT sysKey, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs FROM #vdetail ORDER BY ngay_ct
	END

	--+ Date and Product
	IF @optStyle = '3' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #vdetail(sysKey, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, so_luong)
			SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + ma_sp,
					'', ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, SUM(so_luong)
				FROM #pn GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd
		INSERT INTO #vmaster(syskey, ngay_ct, ma_sp) SELECT DISTINCT syskey, ngay_ct, ma_sp FROM #vdetail ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_sp
	END

	--+ BOM
	SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct, ma_sp INTO #product FROM #vdetail
	CREATE INDEX k ON #product(ma_sp)
	CREATE TABLE #bom (ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ma_sp VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), so_luong NUMERIC(24, 12))
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_sp INTO #productTemp FROM #product

	SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct INTO #vDate FROM #product
	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @d = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM #vDate
	WHILE @d IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DELETE #productTemp
		INSERT INTO #productTemp SELECT ma_sp FROM #product WHERE ngay_ct = @d
		INSERT INTO #bom(ma_sp, ma_vt, so_luong) EXEC xs20_COGetMaterialsFromBOMByProduct @d, '#productTemp', 1
		UPDATE #bom SET ngay_ct = @d WHERE ngay_ct IS NULL
		--
		SELECT @d = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM #vDate WHERE ngay_ct > @d
	END
	DELETE #bom FROM #bom a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #item b WHERE b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)

/*
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vmaster WHERE id = @i) BEGIN
		SELECT @sysKey = sysKey FROM #vmaster WHERE id = @i
		INSERT INTO #d84(sysKey, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, ma_nx, tk_du, tk_vt, ma_phi, line_nbr, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct)
			SELECT a.sysKey, '', '', b.ma_vt, a.so_luong * b.so_luong AS so_luong,
					c.dvt, 1, d.ma_kho, d.ma_vi_tri, d.ma_lo, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, d.ma_nx, d.tk_cp, c.tk_vt, d.ma_phi, 0, '', a.ngay_ct, @voucherID
				FROM #vdetail a JOIN #bom b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
					JOIN dmvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
					LEFT JOIN dmxknvltd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp AND c.tk_vt = d.tk_vt
				WHERE a.sysKey = @sysKey
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
*/

	INSERT INTO #d84(sysKey, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_hd, ma_nx, tk_du, tk_vt, ma_phi, line_nbr, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct)
		SELECT a.sysKey, '', '', b.ma_vt, a.so_luong * b.so_luong AS so_luong,
				c.dvt, 1, d.ma_kho, d.ma_vi_tri, d.ma_lo, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, d.ma_nx, d.tk_cp, c.tk_vt, d.ma_phi, 0, '', a.ngay_ct, @voucherID
			FROM #vdetail a JOIN #bom b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
				JOIN dmvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
				LEFT JOIN dmxknvltd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp AND c.tk_vt = d.tk_vt

	UPDATE #d84 SET ma_kho = d.ma_kho, ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri, ma_lo = d.ma_lo, ma_nx = d.ma_nx, tk_du = d.tk_cp, ma_phi = d.ma_phi
		FROM #d84 a JOIN dmxknvltd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp
		WHERE a.ma_kho IS NULL AND d.tk_vt = ''

	UPDATE #d84 SET ma_kho = d.ma_kho, ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri, ma_lo = d.ma_lo, ma_nx = d.ma_nx, tk_du = d.tk_cp, ma_phi = d.ma_phi
		FROM #d84 a JOIN dmxknvltd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.tk_vt = d.tk_vt
		WHERE a.ma_kho IS NULL AND d.ma_bp = ''

	UPDATE #d84 SET ma_kho = d.ma_kho, ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri, ma_lo = d.ma_lo, ma_nx = d.ma_nx, tk_du = d.tk_cp, ma_phi = d.ma_phi
		FROM #d84 a JOIN dmxknvltd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_dvcs = @Unit
		WHERE a.ma_kho IS NULL AND d.ma_bp = '' AND d.tk_vt = ''

	DELETE #d84 WHERE ma_kho IS NULL


	INSERT INTO #m84(sysKey, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, ong_ba, ma_kh, dien_giai, t_so_luong, status, id)
		SELECT a.sysKey, '', @Unit, @VoucherBook, a.ngay_ct, '', @voucherID, @contact, @Customer, @optDes, b.so_luong, @optStatus, id
			FROM #vmaster a JOIN (SELECT sysKey, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong FROM #d84 GROUP BY sysKey) b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey

	--+
	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #m84
	IF @count = 0 RETURN
	IF @count > (@num2 - @num0) BEGIN
		SELECT @Message = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Không đủ số chứng từ của quyển chứng từ.' ELSE N'Not enough remaining voucher numbers of voucher book.' END
		RETURN
	END

	DelVoucher:
/*
	SELECT @identityNumber = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #vdel
	WHILE @identityNumber IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @identityNumber = stt_rec, @status = [status], @p = part FROM #vdel WHERE stt_rec = @identityNumber

		IF @status <> '0' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'exec FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$IS ''m84$' + @p + ''', ''d84$' + @p + ''', ''' + @identityNumber + ''', ''Delete'', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
			IF @optInstockSplit = '1'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$Transaction ''d84$' + @p + ''', ''c38$'', ''m38$'', ''d38$'', ''' + @identityNumber + ''', ''Delete'', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SELECT @stock = 0
		DELETE #currentStock
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock('r70$' + @p, 'r90$' + @p, @identityNumber, @voucherID, 'Delete', @Stock)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @optMovingStock = '1' BEGIN
			DELETE #movingStock
		END
		--
		SELECT @identityNumber = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #vdel WHERE stt_rec > @identityNumber
	END
*/



	-- Optimize
	SELECT DISTINCT part AS p INTO #pDel FROM #vdel WHERE [status] <> '0'
	SELECT * INTO #vdelStatus FROM #vDel WHERE [status] <> '0'
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #vdelRef FROM #vDel
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pDel) BEGIN
		DECLARE @rQuantity TINYINT, @s NVARCHAR(4000), @e VARCHAR(8000), @part VARCHAR(6)
		SELECT @rQuantity = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

		DELETE #currentStock
		SELECT @s = '
insert into #currentStock select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(round(a.so_luong * a.he_so, @rQuantity)), 0 from d84$%Partition a where exists(select 1 from #vdelStatus b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo
insert into #vdelRef select * from #vdelStatus a where exists(select 1 from d84$%Partition b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and b.stt_rec_yc <> ''''' + CASE @optInstockSplit WHEN '1' THEN ' or b.stt_rec_wh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pDel) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @p = p FROM #pDel
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Partition', @p)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@rQuantity tinyint', @rQuantity
			--
			DELETE #pDel WHERE p = @p
		END

		SELECT @identityNumber = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #vdelRef
		WHILE @identityNumber IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @identityNumber = stt_rec, @status = [status], @p = part FROM #vdelRef WHERE stt_rec = @identityNumber

			SET @q = 'exec FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$IS ''m84$' + @p + ''', ''d84$' + @p + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@identityNumber, '''', '') + ''', ''Delete'', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
			IF @optInstockSplit = '1' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$Transaction ''d84$' + @p + ''', ''c38$'', ''m38$'', ''d38$'', ''' + REPLACE(@identityNumber, '''', '') + ''', ''Delete'', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @optMovingStock = '1' DELETE #movingStock
			--
			SELECT @identityNumber = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #vdelRef WHERE stt_rec > @identityNumber
		END

		SET @e = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock('', '', '', @voucherID, 'new', @Stock)
		EXEC(@e)
	END
	-- End



	SELECT @q = '
	delete a from i84$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from d84$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from v00$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from m84$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from r00$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from r70$%Partition a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = '
	delete a from c84$000000 a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from ct00 a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from ct70 a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	delete a from p00$000000 a join #vdel b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
		DELETE cttd FROM cttd a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vdel b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		RETURN
	END

	--+
	SELECT b.sysKey, b.id, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #od FROM #m84 a JOIN #d84 b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey ORDER BY a.id, b.ma_vt
	SELECT sysKey, MIN(stt) AS stt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) stt_rec_moi INTO #om FROM #od GROUP BY sysKey

	UPDATE dmstt SET stt_rec = stt_rec + @count
	SET @endCode = @numPart1 + REPLACE(STR(@num0 + @count, LEN(@numStr0)), ' ', '0') + @numPart2
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateVoucherNumberRegion @endCode, @VoucherBook

	UPDATE #d84 SET line_nbr = b.stt - c.stt + 1 FROM #d84 a JOIN #od b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey AND a.id = b.id JOIN #om c ON a.sysKey = c.sysKey
	UPDATE #m84 SET so_ct = @numPart1 + REPLACE(STR(@num0 + b.id, LEN(@numStr0)), ' ', '0') + @numPart2 FROM #m84 a JOIN #om b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey



	EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, @voucherID, @count, @userID, '#om', 'stt_rec_moi', 'id'



	UPDATE #m84 SET stt_rec = stt_rec_moi FROM #m84 a JOIN #om b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey
	UPDATE #d84 SET stt_rec = stt_rec_moi FROM #d84 a JOIN #om b ON a.sysKey = b.sysKey
	UPDATE #m84 SET so_ct = SPACE(@numMaxLen - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(so_ct)))) + LTRIM(RTRIM(so_ct)), ma_ct = @voucherID, loai_ct = '2', ma_gd = '6',
		ngay_lct = ngay_ct, ma_nt = @baseCurrency, ty_gia = 1, datetime0 = @datetime0, datetime2 = @datetime0, user_id0 = @UserID, user_id2 = @UserID
	UPDATE #d84 set stt_rec0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(a.line_nbr), ma_ct = b.ma_ct, ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
		FROM #d84 a join #m84 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#m84', 'sysKey,stt_rec,ma_dvcs,ma_nk,ngay_ct,so_ct,ma_ct,ong_ba,ma_kh,dien_giai,t_so_luong,status,id,loai_ct,ma_gd,ngay_lct,ma_nt,ty_gia,datetime0,datetime2,user_id0,user_id2', 1
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#d84', 'sysKey,stt_rec,stt_rec0,ma_vt,so_luong,dvt,he_so,ma_kho,ma_vi_tri,ma_lo,ma_sp,ma_bp,so_lsx,ma_vv,ma_hd,ma_nx,tk_du,tk_vt,ma_phi,line_nbr,so_ct,ngay_ct,ma_ct,id', 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options where name = 'm_compact_mode' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') BEGIN
		UPDATE #d84 SET ma_vi_tri = '', ma_lo = ''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @optInstockSplit = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = ''
			SELECT @q = 'ma_vi_tri = ''''' FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_td_vitri_yn' AND val = 0
			SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_lo = ''''' FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_td_lo_yn' AND val = 0
			IF @q <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #d84 set ' + @q
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #i84 SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, @UserID, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec,
		'#10$' + rtrim(ma_kh) + '#20$6#30$' + rtrim(@baseCurrency), '', '' FROM #m84
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i84', '#d84', 'd$', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, tk_vt, ma_nx', '#10$, #20$, #30$, #40$', 'stt_rec', default, default, @voucherID, 'e$', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q





	-- Insert
	DECLARE @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @detailTable VARCHAR(32), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @insertKey VARCHAR(128)

	SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) AS p, MONTH(ngay_ct) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct) AS y INTO #k FROM #m84
	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #k

	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @key = 'convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) = ''' + @p + ''''

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('m84$' + @p, '#m84', 'm84$000000', 'wrkistran', @key, null)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('d84$' + @p, '#d84', 'd84$000000', 'wrkisdetail', @key, null)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('i84$' + @p, '#i84', 'i84$000000', 'i84$000000', @key, null)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #k WHERE p > @p
	END

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert('c84$000000', '#m84', 'c84$000000', 'wrkistran', '1=1', null)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @optStatus <> '0' BEGIN
	  DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	  SELECT @Statement = 'update #in set ngay_lct = ngay_ct, datetime0 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @datetime0, 112) + ''', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @datetime0, 112) + ''', user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from #in '
	  EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostInventory '#m84', '#d84', @voucherID, '#k',
		'gia_nt0, tien_nt0, gia0, tien0, gia01, gia_nt01, ct_dc, pn_gia_tb, cp_nt, cp, thue_suat_nk, nk_nt, nk, gia_nt21, gia21, gia_nt2, gia2, tien_nt2, tien2, cp_thue_yn, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue, ck_nt, ck, nam, ky, cp_vc, cp_bh, cp_khac, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, s4, s5, s6',
		'so_seri, ma_khon, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_thue_nk, ma_tt, tk_thue_no, tk_thue_co, tk_ck, so_dh2, so_dh3, ma_nvbh, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dc, so_ct0, so_seri0, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, so_lo',
		'gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt', @Statement, 0, 2
	END

	IF @optStatus = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @fieldSelect VARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @fieldSelect = 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ''' + @voucherID + ''' , ngay_ct, so_ct, t_tien_nt , t_tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai,''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @datetime0, 112) + ''','  + RTRIM(@UserID)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostLater '#m84', @voucherID, @fieldSelect, ''
	END

	IF @optStatus = '3' BEGIN
		DECLARE @glGroup VARCHAR(128), @glAcctField VARCHAR(128), @glAcctFieldRef VARCHAR(128), @glAmountField VARCHAR(128), @glFCAmountField VARCHAR(128), @glKey VARCHAR(512), @glNoAccList VARCHAR(128), @glNoAccListRef VARCHAR(128)
		DECLARE @Numeric NVARCHAR(4000), @String NVARCHAR(4000), @External NVARCHAR(4000), @cNoAccounts VARCHAR(128)

		SELECT @cNoAccounts = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'
		SELECT @glAcctField = 'tk_du', @glAcctFieldRef = 'tk_vt', @glAmountField = 'tien', @glFCAmountField = 'tien_nt', @glKey = '1 = 1', @glNoAccList = '0', @glNoAccListRef = '0'
		SELECT @Numeric = 'nam, ky, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, s4, s5, s6', @String = 'so_lo, ong_ba, so_dh, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3', @External = 'ct_nxt = 2, ma_gd = ''6'', ma_nk = b.ma_nk, dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai, datetime0 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @datetime0, 112) + ''', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @datetime0, 112) + ''', user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID), @Statement = ''

		SET @q = 'select @x = groupby from ' + @SysDatabaseName + '..voucherinfo where ma_ct = ''' + @voucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x varchar(128) out', @x = @glGroup out

		SELECT a.*, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_kh, b.ma_kh AS ma_kh_ref, b.loai_ct, b.ngay_ct AS ngay_lct, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.dien_giai AS dien_giai, b.dien_giai AS dien_giai_h
			INTO #dGL FROM #d84 a JOIN #m84 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE (a.tk_vt <> a.tk_du) AND(NOT(@cNoAccounts <> '' AND dbo.ff_inlist(tk_du, @cNoAccounts) = 1))
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostGL '#m84', '#dGL', @voucherID, @glAcctField, @glAcctFieldRef, @glAmountField, @glFCAmountField, @glKey, @glNoAccList, @glNoAccListRef, @glGroup, @Numeric, @String, @External, @Statement, '#k'
	END

	IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
		DELETE cttd FROM cttd a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #i84 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		INSERT INTO cttd (stt_rec, ma_ct, stt_rec_yc) SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, '' FROM #m84
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_RMRequestPrint]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	SET @q =  'SELECT a.line_nbr as stt, a.ma_vtr, b.ten_vtr' + @cE + ' as ten_vtr, a.so_luong, a.ky_nang_yc, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den'
	SET @q = @q + ' INTO #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' FROM hrrmycct a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @q = @q + ' hrvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr'
	SET @q = @q + ' WHERE a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten_nv'','''', ''stt'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbioptionsnsd] 
AS 
	SELECT a.name, a.[user_id], a.val,
			a.[status], a.datetime0, a.[datetime2], a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.loai_phan_he, b.ma_phan_he, b.descript, b.descript2,
			SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) AS [type], b.irregular_yn, b.nb_yn, b.stt_sx,
			CASE WHEN b.[type] = 'C' AND (b.irregular_yn = 1 OR b.nb_yn = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS check_yn,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'FN' THEN SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 4, LEN(b.inputmask)) ELSE '' END AS number_format,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 2), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_val,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 3), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view1,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 4), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view2,
			a.val AS lookup_val,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 2) ELSE '' END AS lookup_controller,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 3) ELSE '' END AS lookup_key,
			CASE SUBSTRING(b.inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', b.inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(b.inputmask, '^', ','), 4) ELSE '' END AS lookup_check,
			b.upper_yn,
			CASE
				WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4)= 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(val, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask)), '')
				WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', '')) 
			ELSE val END AS val_view,
		
			CASE
				WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(val, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask)), 'E')
				WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', ''))
			ELSE val END AS val_view2

		FROM bioptionsnsd a LEFT JOIN bioptions b ON a.name = b.name AND b.loai_phan_he = '2'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT name, CAST(0 AS int) AS [user_id], CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS val,
			CAST('1' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS [status], GETDATE() AS datetime0, GETDATE() AS [datetime2], CAST(0 AS INT) AS user_id0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS user_id2, loai_phan_he, ma_phan_he, descript, descript2,
			SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) AS [type],
			irregular_yn, nb_yn, stt_sx,
			CASE WHEN [type] = 'C' AND (irregular_yn = 1 OR nb_yn = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS check_yn,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'FN' THEN SUBSTRING(inputmask, 4, LEN(inputmask)) ELSE '' END AS number_format,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 2), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_val,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 3), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view1,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'CBO' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 4), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view2,
			CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS lookup_val,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 2) ELSE '' END AS lookup_controller,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 3) ELSE '' END AS lookup_key,
			CASE SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) WHEN 'AUTO' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 4) ELSE '' END AS lookup_check,
			upper_yn,
			CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS val_view,
			CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS val_view2
		FROM bioptions WHERE loai_phan_he = '2'

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrebcm]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ten_cm, b.ten_cm2, c.ten_bac, c.ten_bac2, a.ghi_chu
	FROM hrebcm AS a LEFT JOIN hrdmcm AS b ON a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm AND b.status = '1'
	LEFT JOIN hrdmbcm AS c ON a.ma_bac = c.ma_bac AND c.status = '1'
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateFIFOPrice2GL]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemType CHAR(2), 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(33),
	@nCostType TINYINT, 
	@sIRVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sISVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sIBVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @cDynTable VARCHAR(64), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct, a.ma_gd, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt AS tk, a.tk_vt, a.tk_gv, a.ma_dvcs, 
			a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, 
			a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, 
			b.post_vv, b.post_sp, b.post_bp, b.post_hd, b.post_ku, b.post_phi, b.post_lsx, b.post_td1, b.post_td2, b.post_td3
		INTO #tintmp
		FROM ct70 a LEFT JOIN dmct AS b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		WHERE ngay_ct >= @dFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dTo
			AND ((nxt = 1 AND (pn_gia_tb = 1 OR a.ct_dc = 1)) OR (nxt = 2))
			AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%') 
			AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
			AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1

	INSERT INTO #tintmp(
				stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, nxt, loai_ct, ma_gd, ma_nx, tk_du, tk, tk_vt, tk_gv, ma_dvcs, 
				ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, 
				tien, tien_nt, 
				post_vv, post_sp, post_bp, post_hd, post_ku, post_phi, post_lsx, post_td1, post_td2, post_td3
			)
		SELECT  a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.nxt, a.loai_ct, a.ma_gd, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.tk_vt AS tk, a.tk_vt, a.tk_gv, a.ma_dvcs, 
			a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, 
			a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, 
			b.post_vv, b.post_sp, b.post_bp, b.post_hd, b.post_ku, b.post_phi, b.post_lsx, b.post_td1, b.post_td2, b.post_td3
		FROM ct70 a LEFT JOIN dmct AS b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		WHERE ngay_ct >= @dFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dTo
			AND a.stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #tintmp)
			AND a.stt_rec + a.stt_rec0 NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec + stt_rec0 FROM #tintmp)

	-- UPDATE #tintmp SET tk = tk_vt, tk_du = ma_nx WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_ct, RTRIM(@sIRVCCodes) + ', ' + RTRIM(@sISVCCodes)) = 1
	UPDATE #tintmp SET tk = tk_vt, tk_du = tk_gv WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_ct, @sIBVCCodes) = 1

	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_vv = '' WHERE post_vv = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_sp = '' WHERE post_sp = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_bp = '' WHERE post_bp = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_hd = '' WHERE post_hd = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_ku = '' WHERE post_ku = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_phi = '' WHERE post_phi = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET so_lsx = '' WHERE post_lsx = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_td1 = '' WHERE post_td1 = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_td2 = '' WHERE post_td2 = 0
	UPDATE #tintmp SET ma_td3 = '' WHERE post_td3 = 0

	SELECT ma_ct, stt_rec, ngay_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #tgltmp
		FROM #tintmp
		GROUP BY ma_ct, stt_rec, ngay_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
		ORDER BY ma_ct, stt_rec, ngay_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3

	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @stt_rec CHAR(13), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @nxt TINYINT, @tk VARCHAR(33), @tk_du VARCHAR(33), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), 
		@ma_vv VARCHAR(33), @ma_sp VARCHAR(33), @ma_bp VARCHAR(33), @ma_hd VARCHAR(33), @ma_ku VARCHAR(33), 
		@ma_phi VARCHAR(33), @so_lsx VARCHAR(33), @ma_td1 VARCHAR(33), @ma_td2 VARCHAR(33), @ma_td3 VARCHAR(33)
	
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_ct, stt_rec, ngay_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, tien, tien_nt
		FROM #tgltmp ORDER BY ma_ct, stt_rec, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_ct, @stt_rec, @ngay_ct, @nxt, @tk, @tk_du, @ma_dvcs, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi, @so_lsx, @ma_td1, @ma_td2, @ma_td3, @tien, @tien_nt
	
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cDynTable = ''
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @ngay_ct BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) SET @cDynTable = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @ngay_ct, 112)
			
			IF @nxt = 1
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @tien, ps_no_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
						WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs
							AND ma_vv LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_vv) + '%') AND ma_sp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_sp) + '%') AND ma_bp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_bp) + '%') 
							AND ma_hd LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_hd) + '%') AND ma_ku LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_ku) + '%') AND ma_phi LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_phi) + '%') 
							AND so_lsx LIKE ('%' + RTRIM(@so_lsx) + '%') AND ma_td1 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td1) + '%') AND ma_td2 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td2) + '%') 
							AND ma_td3 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td3) + '%')
					IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN						
						SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET ps_no = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ', ps_no_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND tk = ''' + REPLACE(@tk, '''', '''''') + ''' AND tk_du = ''' + REPLACE(@tk_du, '''', '''''') + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(@ma_dvcs, '''', '''''') + ''''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_vv LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_vv), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_sp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_sp), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_bp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_bp), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_hd LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_hd), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_ku LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_ku), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_phi LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_phi), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND so_lsx LIKE ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@so_lsx), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_td1 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td1), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td2 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td2), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td3 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END					

				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @tien, ps_co_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
						WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs
							AND ma_vv LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_vv) + '%') AND ma_sp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_sp) + '%') AND ma_bp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_bp) + '%') 
							AND ma_hd LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_hd) + '%') AND ma_ku LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_ku) + '%') AND ma_phi LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_phi) + '%') 
							AND so_lsx LIKE ('%' + RTRIM(@so_lsx) + '%') AND ma_td1 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td1) + '%') AND ma_td2 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td2) + '%') 
							AND ma_td3 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td3) + '%')
					IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET ps_co = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ', ps_co_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND tk = ''' + REPLACE(@tk, '''', '''''') + ''' AND tk_du = ''' + REPLACE(@tk_du, '''', '''''') + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(@ma_dvcs, '''', '''''') + ''''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_vv LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_vv), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_sp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_sp), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_bp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_bp), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_hd LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_hd), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_ku LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_ku), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_phi LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_phi), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND so_lsx LIKE ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@so_lsx), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_td1 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td1), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td2 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td2), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td3 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END
				END

			IF @nxt <> 1
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = @tien, ps_no_nt =  CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0
						WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs
							AND ma_vv LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_vv) + '%') AND ma_sp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_sp) + '%') AND ma_bp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_bp) + '%') 
							AND ma_hd LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_hd) + '%') AND ma_ku LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_ku) + '%') AND ma_phi LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_phi) + '%') 
							AND so_lsx LIKE ('%' + RTRIM(@so_lsx) + '%') AND ma_td1 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td1) + '%') AND ma_td2 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td2) + '%') 
							AND ma_td3 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td3) + '%')
					IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET ps_no = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ', ps_no_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND tk_du = ''' + REPLACE(@tk, '''', '''''') + ''' AND tk = ''' + REPLACE(@tk_du, '''', '''''') + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(@ma_dvcs, '''', '''''') + ''''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_vv), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_sp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_sp), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_bp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_bp), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_hd), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_ku LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_ku), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_phi LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_phi), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@so_lsx), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_td1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td1), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td2 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td2), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td3 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct00 SET ps_co = @tien, ps_co_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE @tien_nt END, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0
						WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs
							AND ma_vv LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_vv) + '%') AND ma_sp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_sp) + '%') AND ma_bp LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_bp) + '%') 
							AND ma_hd LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_hd) + '%') AND ma_ku LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_ku) + '%') AND ma_phi LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_phi) + '%') 
							AND so_lsx LIKE ('%' + RTRIM(@so_lsx) + '%') AND ma_td1 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td1) + '%') AND ma_td2 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td2) + '%') 
							AND ma_td3 LIKE (RTRIM(@ma_td3) + '%')
					IF @cDynTable <> '' BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cDynTable + ' SET ps_co = ' + RTRIM(@tien) + ', ps_co_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '''' THEN 0 ELSE ' + RTRIM(@tien_nt) + ' END, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + ''' AND tk_du = ''' + REPLACE(@tk, '''', '''''') + ''' and tk = ''' + REPLACE(@tk_du, '''', '''''') + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(@ma_dvcs, '''', '''''') + ''''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_vv), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_sp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_sp), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_bp LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_bp), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_hd), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_ku LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_ku), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_phi LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_phi), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@so_lsx), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'AND ma_td1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td1), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td2 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td2), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_td3 LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ma_td3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END
				END
				
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_ct, @stt_rec, @ngay_ct, @nxt, @tk, @tk_du, @ma_dvcs, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi, @so_lsx, @ma_td1, @ma_td2, @ma_td3, @tien, @tien_nt				
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintGCTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vv, a.tk, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 8, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''dien_giai, ma_vv, tk'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcttt20]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk,
		CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN (SELECT RTRIM(val)  FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0')  ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
		a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2
	FROM cttt20 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN dmkh AS b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
	WHERE ma_ct = 'HD0'

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionLotDecision]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@InspectionID CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @p CHAR(6), @insPart CHAR(6), @vcpart CHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherIDKey NVARCHAR(1024), @InspectionIDKey NVARCHAR(128), @voucherCode CHAR(3), @roundQuantity INT

	IF @VoucherID <> '' SET @VoucherIDKey = 'a.stt_rec_goc = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InspectionID <> '' SET @InspectionIDKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InspectionIDKey IS NULL RETURN

	SELECT @roundQuantity = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT TOP 1 @vcpart = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM bic14$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #qd$m14 FROM bim14$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #qd$d14 FROM bid14$000000

	SET @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''' and a.stt_rec_kd = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @q = 'insert into #qd$m14 select a.* from bim14$' + @vcpart + ' a where a.status = ''1''' + ' and ' + @key
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into #qd$d14 select a.* from bid14$' + @vcpart + ' a join #qd$m14 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_goc, b.stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0goc, a.stt_rec_kd AS stt_rec, a.so_ct AS so_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct_goc, a.ma_nk AS ma_nk_goc, a.ma_ct AS ma_ct_goc,
		a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_loai_qd, a.diem_so, a.ma_vt, b.ma_kq,
		b.so_luong, b.dvt, b.he_so, b.ma_ly_do, b.ma_kho, b.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_lo, a.dien_giai, b.ghi_chu, b.tt_ton_kho,
		a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ma_vv, b.ma_sp, b.ma_bp, b.so_lsx, b.ma_hd, b.ma_ku, b.ma_phi
	INTO #qd$nguon FROM #qd$m14 a JOIN #qd$d14 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec


	SELECT TOP 0 *, 0 AS nguon_yn INTO #qd$kd FROM bikd
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #qd$th FROM bikd00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part_goc INTO #qd$vc1 FROM bikd01$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part_goc INTO #qd$vc2 FROM bikd02$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part, stt_rec_goc, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part_goc INTO #qd$prevc FROM bikd02$000000

	SET @q = 'insert into #qd$kd select a.*, case when b.stt_rec is not null then 1 else 0 end from bikd a left join (select distinct stt_rec from #qd$nguon) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where ' + @InspectionIDKey
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @insPart = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @d = GETDATE() FROM #qd$kd


	-- Post Inspection
	SET @q =  'insert into #qd$prevc select stt_rec, convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112), stt_rec_goc, convert(char(6), ngay_ct_goc, 112) from bikd02$' + @insPart + ' a where nhom_du_lieu = ''06'' and ' + @VoucherIDKey
		+ CHAR(13) +
		'delete a from bikd02$' + @insPart + ' a where nhom_du_lieu = ''06'' and ' + @VoucherIDKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #qd$kd WHERE nguon_yn = 1) BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into bikd02$' + @insPart + '(nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_kh, dien_giai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, '
					+ 'ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2, sl_kd_nh3,'
					+ 'ma_kq, ma_ly_do, ma_loai_qd, diem_so, ghi_chu, tt_ton_kho,'
					+ 'status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi)'
				+ ' select ''06'', a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.stt_rec, b.so_ct, b.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, '''', b.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, '''', '''', '
					+ 'a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, 0, 0, 0,'
					+ 'a.ma_kq, a.ma_ly_do, a.ma_loai_qd, a.diem_so, a.ghi_chu, a.tt_ton_kho,'
					+ 'a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi'
				+ ' from #qd$nguon a join bikd00$' + @insPart + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	END
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @d, @UserID

	SET @q = 'insert into #qd$th select a.* from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into #qd$vc1 select a.*, convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct_goc, 112) from bikd01$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into #qd$vc2 select a.*, convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct_goc, 112) from bikd02$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.stt_rec, SUM(a.so_luong * a.he_so) AS so_luong INTO #qd$ct FROM #qd$vc2 a WHERE a.nhom_du_lieu = '06' GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT TOP 1 stt_rec, diem_so INTO #qd$last FROM #qd$vc2 WHERE nhom_du_lieu = '06' ORDER BY ngay_ct_goc DESC, so_ct_goc DESC

	UPDATE #qd$th SET sl_qdsd = CASE WHEN e.stt_rec IS NOT NULL AND a.he_so <> 0 THEN ROUND(e.so_luong / a.he_so, @roundQuantity) ELSE 0 END, diem_so = ISNULL(b.diem_so, 0)
		FROM #qd$th a LEFT JOIN #qd$ct e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #qd$last b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @InspectionID

	SET @q = 'update a set sl_qdsd = b.sl_qdsd, diem_so = b.diem_so'
			+ ' from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a join #qd$th b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @d, @UserID

	DECLARE @inspectionStatus CHAR(1)
	EXEC bs_PostInspectionStatus @InspectionID, 0, @UserID, @Admin, default, default, default, @Debug, @inspectionStatus OUT

	-- Update Orginal Voucher
	DECLARE @voucherTable VARCHAR(64), @t_sl_kd NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_sl_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), @x NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @t_sl_kd = sl_qdsd, @t_sl_cl = sl_qdsd FROM #qd$th
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.ma_ct_goc, so_luong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_da_kd INTO #qd$uvc FROM #qd$vc1 a ORDER BY a.line_nbr
	UPDATE #qd$uvc SET @x = CASE WHEN @t_sl_cl > 0 THEN CASE WHEN so_luong <= @t_sl_cl THEN so_luong ELSE @t_sl_cl END ELSE 0 END, @t_sl_cl = @t_sl_cl - @x, sl_da_kd = @x OPTION (MAXDOP 1)


	SELECT TOP 1 @voucherTable = d$ FROM #qd$uvc a JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct_goc = b.ma_ct
	SET @voucherTable = @voucherTable + CASE WHEN RIGHT(@voucherTable, 1) = '$' THEN @insPart ELSE '' END
	SET @q = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'sl_kt' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@voucherTable)) SET @q = 'sl_kt = b.sl_da_kd'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'xstatus' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@voucherTable)) SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'xstatus = case when @tt_kd = ''4'' then ''2'' else ''1'' end'
	IF @q <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update a set ' + @q + ' from ' + @voucherTable + ' a join #qd$uvc b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_goc and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0goc'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tt_kd char(1)', @inspectionStatus
	END


	-- Stock
	DECLARE @stock INT, @stockType INT, @transferStock CHAR(1), @postWrkin BIT, @wrkinNumeric NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinString NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinExternal NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinStatement NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT TOP 1 @transferStock = chuyen_ton_kho FROM #qd$th
	SELECT TOP 1 @stock = a.dl_ton_kho, @stockType = a.loai_ton_kho, @postWrkin = a.chuyen_ton_kho
		FROM bikdngct a JOIN (SELECT c.ma_ct, c.loai_ct FROM #qd$th b JOIN bikddmnguon c ON b.ma_nguon = c.ma_nguon) d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = d.loai_ct

	SELECT @wrkinNumeric = wrkin_numeric_field, @wrkinString = wrkin_string_field, @wrkinExternal = wrkin_external_field, @wrkinStatement = wrkin_statement FROM bikddmct WHERE ma_ct = 'KD6'

	IF @postWrkin = '1' AND @transferStock = '1' BEGIN

		-- Before Post Stock
		CREATE TABLE #qd$masterKey(stt_rec CHAR(13))
		SELECT DISTINCT part_goc AS part INTO #qd$prePart FROM #qd$prevc
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #qd$prePart
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			DELETE #qd$masterKey
			SET @q = 'insert #qd$masterkey select distinct stt_rec_goc from #qd$prevc where part_goc = ' + @p
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'delete a from biss90$' + @p + ' a join #qd$masterKey b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			IF @stock <> -1 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete a from r70$' + @p + ' a join #qd$masterKey b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
				DELETE a FROM ct70 a JOIN #qd$masterKey b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			END
			IF @stock <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete a from r90$' + @p + ' a join #qd$masterKey b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
				DELETE a FROM ct90 a JOIN #qd$masterKey b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			END
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #qd$prePart WHERE part > @p
		END


		-- Post Stock
		SELECT a.*, CONVERT(CHAR(6), a.ngay_ct_goc, 112) AS part_goc INTO #qd$post FROM #qd$nguon a JOIN bikddmkq b ON a.ma_kq = b.ma_kq WHERE b.loai_kq IN ('1', '5')
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec AS stt_rec_goc, gia_nt, gia INTO #qd$gia FROM biss90$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #qd$gia select a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec, case when sum(b.sl_nhap) <> 0 then sum(b.gia_nt * b.sl_nhap) / sum(b.sl_nhap) else 0 end, case when sum(b.sl_nhap) <> 0 then sum(b.gia * b.sl_nhap) / sum(b.sl_nhap) else 0 end'
			+ ' from (select distinct p.stt_rec, v.stt_rec_goc, v.stt_rec0goc from #qd$post p join #qd$vc1 v on p.stt_rec = v.stt_rec) a'
			+ ' join biss90$' + @insPart + ' b on a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0goc = b.stt_rec0 where b.nxt = ''1'' group by a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT a.*, b.stt_rec_goc, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_lct
			INTO #qd$master FROM #qd$m14 a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec_goc FROM #qd$post) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_goc
		SELECT a.*, c.gia_nt, c.gia, a.so_luong * c.gia AS tien, a.so_luong * c.gia_nt AS tien_nt, a.ma_ly_do AS ma_nx, d.tk AS tk_du
			INTO #qd$detail FROM #qd$d14 a JOIN #qd$post b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0goc JOIN #qd$gia c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN dmnx d ON a.ma_ly_do = d.ma_nx

		SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct_goc) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct_goc) AS y INTO #qd$ky FROM #qd$post
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostInventory '#qd$master', '#qd$detail', 'KD6', '#qd$ky', @wrkinNumeric, @wrkinString, @wrkinExternal, @wrkinStatement, -1, 2, 1, default, 1
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostInventory '#qd$master', '#qd$detail', 'KD6', '#qd$ky', @wrkinNumeric, @wrkinString, @wrkinExternal, @wrkinStatement, -1, @stockType, 1
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APGetPaymentVoucher]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(3),
	
	@Refresh BIT,
	@PageIndex INT, 
	@PageCount INT, 
	@LastPage INT, 
	@LastCount INT, 
	@FirstItem VARCHAR(128),
	@LastItem VARCHAR(128),

	@SearchCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @baseCurrency VARCHAR(3), @key NVARCHAR(1000), @itemCount INT, @q NVARCHAR(1000), @f NVARCHAR(1000), @tkcn CHAR(1)
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @tkcn = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_pb_tk'

	SELECT @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Currency = REPLACE(@Currency, '''', ''), @SearchCode = REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SearchCode)), '''', ''''''), @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '''''')

	SELECT @key = 'ma_dvcs = ''' + @Unit + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + @Customer + ''' and ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + ''' and '
	SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @baseCurrency = @Currency THEN '(ma_nt = '''' or ma_nt = ''' + @Currency + ''')' ELSE '(ma_nt = ''' + @Currency + ''')' END
	SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN 'da_pb <> 1' ELSE 'loai_tt = 0 and tat_toan = 0' END

	IF @Account <> '' BEGIN
		IF @tkcn = '1' SELECT @key = @key + ' and tk = ''' + @Account + ''''
		ELSE SELECT @key = @key + ' and tk like ''' + @Account + '%'''
	END

	IF @SearchCode <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(so_ct)) like ''%' + @SearchCode + '%'''

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tien_pb_nt, t_tt_nt AS tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, t_tien_pb, t_tt AS tien_cl INTO #r1 FROM cttt60
		SET @f = 'so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, isnull(t_tien_pb_nt, 0) as t_tien_pb_nt, 0 as tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, isnull(t_tien_pb, 0) as t_tien_pb, 0 as tien_cl'

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Payment$Finding 'cttt60', '#r1', @Refresh, @PageIndex, @PageCount, @LastPage, @LastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @key, 
			'convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec', @f, '', 'ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec', 1, @UserID, 1, @itemCount OUTPUT

		UPDATE #r1 SET tien_cl_nt = t_tt_nt - t_tien_pb_nt, tien_cl = t_tt - t_tien_pb

		SELECT so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, DATEDIFF(DAY, ngay_ct, @Date) AS han_tt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tien_pb_nt, tien_cl_nt AS cl_nt FROM #r1 ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tt_qd AS da_tt_nt, t_tt_nt AS cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, ma_tt INTO #r2 FROM cttt30

		SET @f = 'so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tt_qd as da_tt_nt'
		SET @f = @f + ', case when ma_nt = '''' then t_tt else t_tt_nt end - t_tt_qd as cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, ma_tt'

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Payment$Finding 'cttt30', '#r2', @Refresh, @PageIndex, @PageCount, @LastPage, @LastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @key, 
			'convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec', @f, '', 'ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec', 1, @UserID, 1, @itemCount OUTPUT

		SELECT TOP 0 tt_qd, stt_rec_tt INTO #tt FROM cttt30
		UPDATE #r2 SET da_tt_nt = da_tt_nt - #tt.tt_qd, cl_nt = cl_nt + #tt.tt_qd FROM #tt WHERE stt_rec = #tt.stt_rec_tt

		UPDATE #r2 SET t_tt_nt = t_tt, ma_nt = @baseCurrency WHERE ma_nt = ''

		SELECT a.*, ISNULL(b.han_tt, 99999) AS han_tt0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS han_tt INTO #r from #r2 a LEFT JOIN dmtt b ON a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
		
		UPDATE #r SET han_tt = CASE WHEN han_tt0 = 99999 THEN han_tt0 ELSE han_tt0 - DATEDIFF(DAY, ngay_ct, GETDATE()) END

		SELECT so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, han_tt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, da_tt_nt, cl_nt FROM #r WHERE ma_nt = @Currency ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
		
	END

	SELECT @itemCount

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCBTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tien_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @CreditAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CreditAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i46$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m46$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs20_DeleteAllocation
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cIDNumber0 CHAR(3),
	@cModule CHAR(16)
AS
BEGIN
	IF UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@cModule))) = 'AR'
		DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND (@cIDNumber0 = '' OR stt_rec0 = @cIDNumber0)
	ELSE
		DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND (@cIDNumber0 = '' OR stt_rec0 = @cIDNumber0)

END
