CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPGetMPS2MO]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@SOFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@SOTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112)  + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''' and a.status = ''1'''

	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @SOFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_dh >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@SOFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @SOTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_dh <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@SOTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, dvt INTO #report FROM mctkhsx
	
	SET @q = 'insert #report select a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_kho, a.so_luong, a.dvt from mctkhsx a join dmkho b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.*, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_sp, 
			RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(so_dh) + RTRIM(so_lsx) + RTRIM(ma_sp) + RTRIM(a.ma_kho)) AS rkey
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_dh, a.so_lsx, ma_sp, a.ma_kho
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialStructureAnalysis] -- fs_FinancialStructureAnalysis4Period
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@reportType TINYINT, -- 1 - Chi tiet, 2 - Tong hop
	@Unit VARCHAR(512), 
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #t1 FROM gltcpt11 WHERE form = @Form
	
	--Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t1', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Giá trị
	INSERT INTO #t1 EXEC rs_rptFinancialStructureAnalysisTemplate @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, 0, 1, @reportType, @Unit, @Form, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu còn thiếu
	SELECT ma_so, cot, so, chu INTO #gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99
		WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearTo AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '11'
	IF @Language = 'V' UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '1'
		ELSE UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '2'

	SELECT stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN bold = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS systotal, ma_so
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
			, danh_gia, gt, ts, kind
		FROM #t1 ORDER BY stt, ma_so

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReceiveBySupplier]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CustomerGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType  TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128)= '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64)= '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @so_luong AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt
		INTO #t FROM wrkin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

 	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''' and a.ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') +  '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key =	@Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	--
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'c')
	--
	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n)' ELSE ', sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x)' END

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#t', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_kh
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, MAX(nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3
			, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #report
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, nh_kh1, nh_kh2, nh_kh3', 'int, varchar(32), varchar(32), varchar(32)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @tien = SUM(tien), @so_luong =  SUM(so_luong), @tien_nt = SUM(tien_nt) FROM #report

	-- Order - Insert Group
	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @o = @Groups + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		--
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo. ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups, 'kh', 'so_luong,tien,tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END
	--

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh, ten_kh2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s, @s, @so_luong, @tien, @tien_nt)
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, tien, tien_nt, so_luong from #report order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, tien, tien_nt, so_luong from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups  , 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_Seq2Dec(@sHex VARCHAR(128)) 
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @i AS INT, @nLen INT, @cHex VARCHAR(1), @nRem INT, @nDec AS BIGINT
	SELECT @nDec = 0, @i = 1, @nLen = LEN(@sHex)
	WHILE @i <= @nLen
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cHex = SUBSTRING(@sHex, @i, 1)
			SELECT @nRem = ASCII(@cHex)

			SELECT @nRem = @nRem - CASE WHEN @nRem < 58 THEN  48 ELSE 55 END
			SELECT @nDec = @nDec*36 + @nRem, @i = @i + 1
		END 
	RETURN @nDec
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPATran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt2 AS ten_vt2' ELSE '' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report ' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', ten_vt2''' ELSE '''' END + ','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPOReceiptwithoutInvoice]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Site Key
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'b.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'a.status not in (''0''' + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' and val = '1') THEN ', ''*''' ELSE '' END + ') and a.t_thue = 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 as sysorder, 0 as sysprint, 0 as systotal, stt_rec, line_nbr, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS  ma_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS dien_giai, ma_vt, ma_kho, dvt, so_luong AS sl_pn, so_luong AS t_sl_pn, so_luong AS sl_hd, ma_vv, ma_bp, ma_hd
		INTO #report FROM wrkpgdetail

	-- 83
	SELECT a.stt_rec_hd, a.ma_vt, SUM(a.so_luong) AS sl_hd INTO #d83 FROM d83$000000 a LEFT JOIN m83$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom2 AND @DateTo2 AND stt_rec_hd <> '' AND b.status <> '0'
		GROUP BY stt_rec_hd, ma_vt

	-- 71, 78
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, min(b.line_nbr), max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.so_ct), max(a.ma_ct), max(a.ma_kh), max(a.dien_giai), max(b.ma_vt), max(b.ma_kho), max(b.dvt), sum(b.so_luong), max(a.t_so_luong), 0, max(ma_vv), max(ma_bp), max(ma_hd)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m71$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' join d71$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, b.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '71$%Partition', '78$%Partition')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	DELETE #report WHERE stt_rec IN
		(SELECT stt_rec
			FROM (SELECT stt_rec_hd, SUM(sl_hd) AS sl_hd FROM #d83 GROUP BY stt_rec_hd) a
				JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, t_sl_pn FROM #report) b
					ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec AND a.sl_hd = t_sl_pn)

	UPDATE #report SET sl_hd = b.sl_hd FROM #d83 b WHERE #report.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd AND #report.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) SELECT 5, 1, 1

	SELECT a.*, (CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec) AS xgroup, a.sl_pn - a.sl_hd AS sl_cl, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0 FROM #report a
		lEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
		LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
	ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, d.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockByTimeLot] --fs20_StockByTimeLot
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@PeriodType INT, -- 1 Ngay, 2 Thang
	@PeriodCycle INT, 
	@PeriodNo INT,
	@Site VARCHAR(4000), 
	@Item VARCHAR(32), 
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @h1 AS  NVARCHAR(511), @h2 AS NVARCHAR(511), @h3 AS NVARCHAR(511), @Ten_ky AS NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @PeriodNoTmp AS INT

	IF @PeriodType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT032'
		SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT033'
		SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT034'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT035'
		SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT036'
		SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT037'
	END

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lo, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #bal FROM cdlo
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS tuoi, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_vt, ma_lo, sl_nhap AS so_luong
		INTO #report FROM r70$000000

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	IF @ItemType <> '' OR @filterKey <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Tồn kho cuối kỳ
	INSERT #bal EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Lot @DateTo, @Unit, @Site, '', @Item, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#bal', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 0, '', CASE WHEN @PeriodType = 1 THEN DATEDIFF(day, b.ngay_nhap, @DateTo) ELSE DATEDIFF(month, DATEADD(day, 1 - day(b.ngay_nhap), b.ngay_nhap), DATEADD(day, 1 - day(b.ngay_nhap), @DateTo)) END
				, 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong
			FROM #bal a LEFT JOIN dmlo b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
			WHERE a.so_luong >= 0 AND b.ngay_nhap IS NOT NULL AND b.ngay_nhap <= @DateTo

	UPDATE #report SET ky = (tuoi / @PeriodCycle) + 1	
	UPDATE #report SET ky = @PeriodNo WHERE ky > @PeriodNo

	-- Thêm các kỳ không có số liệu
	DECLARE @Ma_vt VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNo, @Ma_vt = MIN(ma_vt) FROM #report
	IF @Ma_vt IS NULL SET @Ma_vt = ''
	WHILE @PeriodNoTmp > 0 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE ky = @PeriodNoTmp)
			INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 @PeriodNoTmp, @Ten_ky, 0, 0, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0 FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_lo

		SELECT @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNoTmp - 1 			
	END	

	-- Tên kỳ
	UPDATE #report SET ten_ky = REPLACE(@h1, '%n1', RTRIM(@PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky = 1
	UPDATE #report SET ten_ky = REPLACE(REPLACE(@h2, '%n1', RTRIM((ky - 1) * @PeriodCycle)), '%n2', RTRIM(ky * @PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky > 1 AND ky < @PeriodNo
	UPDATE #report SET ten_ky = REPLACE(@h3, '%n1', RTRIM((@PeriodNo - 1) * @PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky = @PeriodNo

	-- Stt
	CREATE TABLE #o(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #o(ma_vt, ma_lo) SELECT ma_vt, ma_lo FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_lo ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_lo
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo

	--View
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, a.ma_vt + a.ma_lo AS sysRow
			, a.ky, a.ten_ky, a.stt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong
			, REPLACE(STR(a.ky, 3), ' ', '0') AS sysColumn , b.dvt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY stt, ky

	-- Pivot	
	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT DISTINCT ky, 'so_luong$' + RTRIM(CAST(ky AS INT)), ten_ky FROM #report ORDER BY ky
	SELECT * FROM #pivot
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$Split](@s NVARCHAR(MAX), @d CHAR(1)) 
RETURNS @r TABLE (id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), data NVARCHAR(MAX))
AS
BEGIN 
	IF @s IS NULL RETURN
	DECLARE @q VARCHAR(1)
	SELECT @q = CHAR(255), @d = LOWER(@d)
	SELECT @s = REPLACE(@s, ' ', @q)
	DECLARE @i INT, @c NVARCHAR(MAX) 
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <> 0 BEGIN 
		SELECT @i = CHARINDEX(@d Collate Latin1_General_BIN, LOWER(@s) Collate Latin1_General_BIN)
		SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @i <> 0 THEN LEFT(@s, @i - 1) ELSE @s END
		INSERT INTO @r(data) VALUES(@c) 
		SELECT @s = RIGHT(@s, LEN(@s) - @i)

		IF LEN(@s) = 0 BEGIN
			IF @i <> 0 INSERT INTO @r(data) VALUES('') 
			BREAK
		END
	END

	UPDATE @r SET data = REPLACE(data, @q, ' ')
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintASTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cVC CHAR(3), 
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cMTable VARCHAR(16),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @tk VARCHAR(33), @ma_kh VARCHAR(33), @so_ct VARCHAR(33), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @dMaxDate SMALLDATETIME, @nCount INT, @i INT
	DECLARE @sVC NVARCHAR(511), @sNumber NVARCHAR(511), @sDate NVARCHAR(511), @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s4 NVARCHAR(511), @s5 NVARCHAR(511), @s6 NVARCHAR(511), @s7 NVARCHAR(511)
	--BI Add start
	DECLARE @sVCBI NVARCHAR(511), @sNumberBI NVARCHAR(511), @sDateBI NVARCHAR(511), @s1BI NVARCHAR(511), @s2BI NVARCHAR(511), @s3BI NVARCHAR(511), @s4BI NVARCHAR(511), @s5BI NVARCHAR(511), @s6BI NVARCHAR(511), @s7BI NVARCHAR(511)
	--BI Add end
	------
	DECLARE @nTien NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nTt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDTien NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDTien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 du_no00 AS du, du_no_nt00 AS du_nt INTO #b FROM cdkh
	CREATE TABLE #print(sysorder INT, sysprint NUMERIC(1), systotal NUMERIC(1), bold NUMERIC(1) NULL, dien_giai NVARCHAR(511) NULL, dien_giai2 NVARCHAR(511) NULL, tien NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL,  tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL)	
	SELECT ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, so_ct INTO #temp01 FROM m32$000000

	SET @strSQL = 'INSERT INTO #temp01 SELECT TOP 1 ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, so_ct FROM ' + @cMTable + ' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	SELECT @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @tk = tk, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @so_ct = so_ct FROM #temp01

	DECLARE @curYear INT, @curMonth INT, @k INT, @param NVARCHAR(100), @partition VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @curYear = CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(@cMTable,6),4) AS INT), @curMonth = CAST(RIGHT(@cMTable, 2) AS INT), @k = 1, @param = '@retDate SMALLDATETIME OUTPUT'
	WHILE (@k <= 24) --Xử lý lùi trong khoảng thời gian 24 kỳ
		BEGIN
			SET @partition = REPLACE(STR(@curYear, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@curMonth, 2), ' ', '0') 
			SET @strSQL = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = ''m32$' + @partition + ''' AND type = ''U'')'
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'SELECT @retDate = MAX(ngay_ct) FROM m32$' + @partition + ' WITH(NOLOCK)'
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ngay_ct < ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @ngay_ct, 112) + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + @ma_dvcs + ''' AND tk = ''' + @tk + ''' AND ma_kh = ''' + @ma_kh + ''' AND status <> ''*'' AND status <> ''0'''
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, @param, @retDate = @dMaxDate OUTPUT
			IF @dMaxDate IS NULL
				BEGIN
					IF @curMonth = 1
						SELECT @curMonth = 12, @curYear = @curYear - 1
					ELSE
						SET @curMonth = @curMonth - 1
					SET @k = @k + 1
				END
				ELSE
					SET @k = 99
		END
	IF @dMaxDate IS NULL SET @dMaxDate = CAST(dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@ngay_ct) AS SMALLDATETIME) - 1

	--BI edit start
	IF(@Bilingual = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @sVC = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS01'
		SELECT @sNumber = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS02'
		SELECT @sDate = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS03'
		SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS04'
		SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS05'
		SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS06'
		SELECT @s3 = @s3 + '(' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @dMaxDate + 1, 103) + ' - ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @ngay_ct, 103) + ')'
		SELECT @s4 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS07'
		SELECT @s5 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS08'
		SELECT @s6 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS09'
		SELECT @s7 = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname)  ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS10'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @sVC = RTRIM(cname)FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS01'
		SELECT @sNumber = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS02'
		SELECT @sDate = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS03'
		SELECT @s1 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS04'
		SELECT @s2 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS05'
		SELECT @s3 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS06'
		SELECT @s3 = @s3 + '(' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @dMaxDate + 1, 103) + ' - ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @ngay_ct, 103) + ')'
		SELECT @s4 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS07'
		SELECT @s5 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS08'
		SELECT @s6 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS09'
		SELECT @s7 = RTRIM(cname) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS10'	
	END
	
	SELECT @sVCBI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS01'
	SELECT @sNumberBI =  RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS02'
	SELECT @sDateBI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS03'
	SELECT @s1BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS04'
	SELECT @s2BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS05'
	SELECT @s3BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS06'
	SELECT @s3BI = @s3BI + '(' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @dMaxDate + 1, 103) + ' - ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @ngay_ct, 103) + ')'
	SELECT @s4BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS07'
	SELECT @s5BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS08'
	SELECT @s6BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS09'
	SELECT @s7BI = RTRIM(cname2) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'AS10'
	--BI end

	SELECT @nCount = max_row - 8 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVC

	DECLARE @ngay_ky1 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @ngay_ky1 = ngay_ky1 FROM dmstt
	IF @dMaxDate >= @ngay_ky1
		INSERT INTO #b EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dMaxDate, @ma_dvcs, @Tk, @ma_kh, 2, 1, 1, 1, '', ''
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #b EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @ngay_ky1, @ma_dvcs, @Tk, @ma_kh, 1, 1, 1, 1, '', ''


	SELECT @nDu_ck = Du, @nDu_ck_nt = Du_nt FROM #b

	IF @nDu_ck IS NULL SET @nDu_ck = 0
	IF @nDu_ck_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_ck_nt = 0

	SELECT @sVC + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumber + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDate + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai, SUM(ps_no) AS tien, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS tien_nt
	--BI Add start
	, @sVCBI + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumberBI + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDateBI + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai2
	--BI Add end
		INTO #astmp
		FROM ct00 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmct b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		WHERE a.tk = @tk AND a.ma_kh = @ma_kh AND a.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND a.ngay_ct > @dMaxDate AND a.ngay_ct < = @ngay_ct AND (a.ps_no <> 0 OR a.ps_no_nt <> 0)
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, b.ma_ct_in, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	-- Xu ly da co phieu thanh toan cung ngay	
	SELECT t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #temp02 FROM m32$000000 WHERE 1=0
	SET @strSQL = 'INSERT INTO #temp02 SELECT t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt FROM ' + @cMTable + ' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ngay_ct, 112) + ''' AND ma_dvcs = ''' + @ma_dvcs + ''' AND tk = ''' + @tk + ''' AND ma_kh = ''' + @ma_kh + ''' AND status <> ''*'' AND status <> ''0'' AND so_ct < ''' + @so_ct + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #temp02)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nDu_ck = @nDu_ck + ISNULL(SUM(tien), 0), @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_ck_nt + ISNULL(SUM(tien_nt), 0) FROM #astmp
			SELECT @nDu_ck = @nDu_ck - ISNULL(SUM(t_tt), 0), @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_ck_nt - ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0 THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_nt END), 0) 
				FROM #temp02
			DELETE #astmp
		END
	--------------------------------------------------------------------

	SELECT @nCount = @nCount - COUNT(*) FROM #astmp
	SELECT @nTien = SUM(tien), @nTien_nt = SUM(tien_nt) FROM #astmp
	IF @nTien IS NULL SET @nTien = 0
	IF @nTien_nt IS NULL SET @nTien_nt = 0


	SELECT @sVC + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumber + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDate + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai, t_tt AS tien, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt
	--BI Add start
	, @sVCBI + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumberBI + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDateBI + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai2
	--BI Add end
		INTO #paytmp FROM m32$000000 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmct b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE 1=0
	SET @strSQL = 'INSERT INTO #paytmp SELECT N''' + @sVC + ''' + '' '' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + '' '' + N''' + @sNumber + ''' + '' '' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + '' '' + N''' + @sDate + ''' + '' '' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai'	
	SET	@strSQL = @strSQL + ', t_tt AS tien, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = ''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''' THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_nt END AS tien_nt'
	--BI Add start
	SET	@strSQL = @strSQL + ', N''' + @sVCBI + ''' + '' '' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + '' '' + N''' + @sNumberBI + ''' + '' '' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + '' '' + N''' + @sDateBI + ''' + '' '' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai2'
	--BI Add end
	SET	@strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' FROM ' + @cMTable + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmct b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' AND (t_tt <> 0 OR t_tt_nt <> 0)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	-- Xu ly phan SO TIEN DA CHI: them so lieu tu phieu thu
	INSERT INTO #paytmp
		SELECT @sVC + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumber + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDate + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai, ps_co AS tien, ps_co_nt AS tien_nt
	--BI Add start
		, @sVCBI + ' ' + RTRIM(b.ma_ct_in) + ' ' + @sNumberBI + ' ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + ' ' + @sDateBI + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) AS dien_giai2
	--BI Add end
			FROM ct00 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmct b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
			WHERE a.ma_ct <> 'PN2' AND a.tk = @tk AND a.ma_kh = @ma_kh AND a.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND a.ngay_ct > @dMaxDate AND a.ngay_ct < = @ngay_ct AND (a.ps_co <> 0 OR a.ps_co_nt <> 0)
			ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct
	-- Tinh lai doan tong so tien da chi
	SELECT @Tien = SUM(tien), @Tien_nt = SUM(tien_nt) FROM #paytmp
	IF @Tien IS NULL SET @Tien = 0
	IF @Tien_nt IS NULL SET @Tien_nt = 0
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	SELECT @nCount =@nCount -  COUNT(*) FROM #paytmp
	SELECT @nTt = @nDu_ck + @nTien, @nTt_nt = @nDu_ck_nt + @nTien_nt
	SELECT @nDTien = @nTt - @tien, @nDTien_nt = @nTt_nt - @tien_nt

	--BI Edit start
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (0, 1, 0, 1, @s1, @s1BI, @nTt, @nTt_nt)
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (1, 1, 1, 0, @s2, @s2BI, @nDu_ck, @nDu_ck_nt)
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (2, 1, 1, 0, @s3, @s3BI, @nTien, @nTien_nt)
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) SELECT 3, 1, 1, 0, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt FROM #astmp

	IF @nCount > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @i = 0
			WHILE @i <@nCount
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (4, 1, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0)
					SET @i = @i + 1
				END
		END

	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (5, 1, 0, 1, @s4, @s4BI, @Tien, @Tien_nt)
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) SELECT 6, 1, 1, 0, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt FROM #paytmp
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (7, 1, 0, 1, @s5, @s5BI, ABS(@nDTien), ABS(@nDTien_nt))
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (8, 1, 1, 0, @s6, @s6BI, dbo.ff_Max(@nDTien, 0), dbo.ff_Max(@nDTien_nt, 0))
	INSERT INTO #print(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, bold, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (9, 1, 1, 0, @s7, @s7BI, -dbo.ff_Min(@nDTien, 0), -dbo.ff_Min(@nDTien_nt, 0))
	--BI Edit start
	--EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher '#print', 7, @cVC, 'dien_giai','', 'sysorder'

	SELECT * FROM #print ORDER BY sysorder
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$GetPeriod$Department]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DepartmentKey NVARCHAR(4000),
	@DeptAlias VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @PeriodCount INT
	SELECT @PeriodCount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_ky'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @DeptAlias = CASE WHEN @DeptAlias = '' THEN 'a' ELSE @DeptAlias END
	IF @DepartmentKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @DepartmentKey
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
		IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_ref INTO #bp FROM hrbp
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, a.ky, a.nam, a.ngay_tu AS ky_ngay_tu, a.ngay_den AS ky_ngay_den, a.so_ngay INTO #hrky FROM hrky a, hrbp b

	SELECT a.*, b.bp_ref INTO #dmky FROM hrky a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hrbp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		WHERE (a.nam * @PeriodCount + a.ky BETWEEN @YearFrom * @PeriodCount + @PeriodFrom AND @YearTo * @PeriodCount + @PeriodTo)
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #bp select ma_bp, bp_ref from hrbp ' + @DeptAlias + ' with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ky, b.nam, MAX(b.bp_ref) max_bp_ref 
		INTO #bp0 FROM #bp a CROSS JOIN #dmky b WHERE a.bp_ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%' GROUP BY a.ma_bp, b.ky, b.nam

	INSERT INTO #hrky SELECT a.ma_bp, a.bp_ref, b.ky, b.nam, c.ngay_tu, c.ngay_den, c.so_ngay 
		FROM #bp a JOIN #bp0 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #dmky c ON b.max_bp_ref = c.bp_ref AND b.ky = c.ky AND b.nam = c.nam

	SELECT * FROM #hrky

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbisysplantrights]
AS
	SELECT b.id, b.name, b.comment, b.user_yn, a.ma_vung, c.ten_vung, c.ten_vung2
		FROM bisysplantrights2 a LEFT JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id = b.id LEFT JOIN bidmvung c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vung = c.ma_vung

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_CaclFIFOPrice1Item]
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13)
	, @dValid SMALLDATETIME
	, @cSite VARCHAR(33)
	, @cItem VARCHAR(33)
	, @cLocation VARCHAR(33)
	, @cLot VARCHAR(33)
	, @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6)
	, @nQty0 VARCHAR(8000) = '' -- cac lan xuat truoc do trong phieu
	-- cac lan xuat dich danh truoc do trong phieu
	, @stt_rec_pn VARCHAR(8000) = ''
	, @stt_rec0pn VARCHAR(8000) = ''
	, @sl_xuat VARCHAR(8000) = ''
	, @tien_xuat VARCHAR(8000) = ''
	, @tien_nt_x VARCHAR(8000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strsql NVARCHAR(4000), @cMonth CHAR(2), @m_gia_ntxt TINYINT, @m_round_gia TINYINT, @m_round_gia_nt TINYINT, @m_round_tien TINYINT, @m_round_tien_nt TINYINT
		, @index INT, @stt_rec CHAR(13), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3), @So_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @QtyBal NUMERIC(28, 6), @AmtBal NUMERIC(28, 6), @FCAmtBal NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @i INT, @j INT, @So_luong_j NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SET @cMonth = REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dValid), 2), ' ', '0')
	SELECT @m_gia_ntxt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_ntxt'
	SELECT @m_round_gia = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @m_round_gia_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @m_round_tien = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @m_round_tien_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	-- Struct phieu nhap

	--CREATE TABLE #input (i INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(3), ma_ct CHAR(3), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, so_ct CHAR(12), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	SELECT CAST(0 AS INT) AS i, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS stt_rec0, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, so_ct, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt INTO #input FROM wrkcolumns

	-- Lay tu file can doi dau thang
	SET @strsql = 'INSERT INTO #input'
	SET @strsql = @strsql + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT 0, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ton_khoXX, so_duXX, so_du_ntXX'
	SET @strsql = @strsql + CHAR(13) + '		FROM cdntxt WHERE ma_vt = ' + CHAR(39) + @cItem + CHAR(39) + ' AND ma_kho = ' + CHAR(39) + @cSite + CHAR(39)+ ' AND ma_vi_tri = ' + CHAR(39) + @cLocation + CHAR(39) + ' AND ma_lo = ' + CHAR(39) + @cLot + CHAR(39)
	SET @strsql = @strsql + CHAR(13) + '		AND nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@dValid), 4) + ' AND ton_khoXX <> 0'
	SET @strsql = REPLACE(@strsql, 'XX', @cMonth)
	EXEC sp_executesql @strsql

	-- Xoa nhung phieu nhap trong thang da duoc luu trong file cdntxt
	DELETE #input WHERE YEAR(ngay_ct) = YEAR(@dValid) AND MONTH(ngay_ct) = MONTH(@dValid)
	-- Chi phi phat sinh trong thang (tinh ca thang cho dong nhat voi chuc nang chay cuoi thang)
	SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_cp, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_cp_nt INTO #tFeetmp
		FROM ct70 WITH (INDEX (ngay_ct)) 
		WHERE YEAR(ngay_ct) = YEAR(@dValid) AND MONTH(ngay_ct) = MONTH(@dValid)
			AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite AND ma_vi_tri = @cLocation AND ma_lo = @cLot
			AND status = '1' AND nxt = 1 AND stt_rec_pn <> '' AND sl_nhap + sl_xuat = 0
		GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn

	-- Lay phat sinh nhap trong ky
	INSERT INTO #input
		SELECT 0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n FROM ct70 WITH (INDEX (ngay_ct)) 
			WHERE YEAR(ngay_ct) = YEAR(@dValid) AND MONTH(ngay_ct) = MONTH(@dValid) AND ((@m_gia_ntxt = 1 AND ngay_ct <= @dValid) OR @m_gia_ntxt <> 1)
			AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite AND ma_vi_tri = @cLocation AND ma_lo = @cLot
			AND status = '1' AND (nxt = 1 AND pn_gia_tb = 0) AND stt_rec <> @cIDNumber
			AND stt_rec + stt_rec0 NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec + stt_rec0 FROM #input)
			AND stt_rec_pn = ''

	-- Cong chi phi vao phieu nhap. Luu y: doan nay se bi sai trong truong hop da tinh tinh cuoi thang roi ma quay nguoc lai sua luu phieu ==> phan chi phi se bi doi len
	UPDATE #input SET tien = a.tien + b.tien_cp, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_cp_nt FROM #input a JOIN #tFeetmp b ON a.stt_rec  = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn

	-- Giam tru nhung phan da xuat dich danh
	SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat, SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x INTO #ouput_direct
		FROM (
			SELECT a.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec0pn, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt <> '' THEN a.tien_nt_x ELSE ROUND(a.sl_xuat / b.sl_nhap * b.tien_nt_n, @m_round_tien_nt) END AS tien_nt_x
				FROM ct70 a WITH (INDEX (stt_rec_pn)) JOIN ct70 b WITH (INDEX (PK_ct70)) ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0
				WHERE a.stt_rec_pn + a.stt_rec0pn IN (SELECT stt_rec + stt_rec0 FROM #input)
			) a GROUP BY a.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec0pn

	-- phan xuat dich danh truoc do trong phieu
	IF @stt_rec_pn <> '' BEGIN
		SET @j = 1
		WHILE @j <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@nQty0) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #ouput_direct 
				SELECT CHAR(39) + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@stt_rec_pn, @j) + CHAR(39), CHAR(39) + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@stt_rec0pn, @j) + CHAR(39)
					, dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sl_xuat, @j), dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tien_xuat, @j), dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tien_nt_x, @j)
			SET @j = @j + 1
		END
	END

	UPDATE #input SET so_luong = a.so_luong - b.sl_xuat, tien = a.tien - b.tien_xuat, tien_nt = a.tien_nt - b.tien_nt_x 
		FROM #input a JOIN #ouput_direct b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn
	--
	-- Danh so thu tu uu tien phieu nhap
	SET @index = 0
	DECLARE crInput CURSOR FOR
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0 FROM #input a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ctntxt, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct
	OPEN crInput
	FETCH NEXT FROM crInput INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #input SET i = @index WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
			SET @index = @index + 1
			FETCH NEXT FROM crInput INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0
		END
	CLOSE crInput
	DEALLOCATE crInput
	-- Struct phieu xuat
	--CREATE TABLE #output (i INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(3), ma_ct CHAR(3), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, so_ct CHAR(12), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	SELECT CAST(0 AS INT) AS i, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS stt_rec0, CAST('' AS CHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, so_ct, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt INTO #output FROM wrkcolumns

	-- Lay phat sinh xuat trong ky (khong lay phieu xuat dich danh)
	INSERT INTO #output
		SELECT 0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, sl_xuat, 0, 0 FROM ct70 WITH (INDEX (ngay_ct)) 
			WHERE YEAR(ngay_ct) = YEAR(@dValid) AND MONTH(ngay_ct) = MONTH(@dValid) AND ((@m_gia_ntxt = 1 AND ngay_ct <= @dValid) OR @m_gia_ntxt <> 1)
			AND ma_vt = @cItem AND ma_kho = @cSite AND ma_vi_tri = @cLocation AND ma_lo = @cLot
			AND status = '1' AND nxt = 2 AND px_gia_dd = 0 AND stt_rec <> @cIDNumber
	-- Danh so thu tu uu tien phieu xuat
	SET @index = 0
	DECLARE crOutput CURSOR FOR
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0 FROM #output a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ctntxt, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct
	OPEN crOutput
	FETCH NEXT FROM crOutput INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #output SET i = @index WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
			SET @index = @index + 1
			FETCH NEXT FROM crOutput INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0
		END
	CLOSE crOutput
	DEALLOCATE crOutput
	-- Xu ly 1 vat tu duoc xuat nhieu lan tren cung 1 phieu (cac dong phia truoc) 
	IF @nQty0 <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @index = MAX(i) FROM #output
		IF @index IS NULL SET @index = 0

		SET @j = 1
		WHILE @j <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@nQty0) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #output SELECT @index + @j, '', '', '', NULL, '', dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@nQty0, @j), 0, 0
			SET @j = @j + 1
		END
	END
	--
	-- Giam tru cho phieu nhap dua tren cac phieu xuat truoc do
	SELECT @QtyBal = 0, @AmtBal = 0, @FCAmtBal = 0, @i = 0, @j = 0
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #input WHERE @i <= i) BEGIN
		SELECT @QtyBal = @QtyBal + so_luong, @AmtBal = @AmtBal + tien, @FCAmtBal = @FCAmtBal + tien_nt FROM #input WHERE i = @i

		WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #output WHERE @j <= i) BEGIN
			SELECT @So_luong_j = so_luong FROM #output WHERE i = @j
			IF @QtyBal <= @So_luong_j BEGIN
				SET @So_luong_j = @So_luong_j - @QtyBal
				UPDATE #output SET so_luong = @So_luong_j WHERE i = @j
				SELECT @QtyBal = 0, @AmtBal = 0, @FCAmtBal = 0
				BREAK
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @AmtBal = @AmtBal - ROUND(@So_luong_j * @AmtBal / @QtyBal, @m_round_tien), @FCAmtBal = @FCAmtBal - ROUND(@So_luong_j * @FCAmtBal / @QtyBal, @m_round_tien_nt)
				SELECT @QtyBal = @QtyBal - @So_luong_j
				SET @So_luong_j = 0
				UPDATE #output SET so_luong = @So_luong_j WHERE i = @j
				SET @j = @j + 1
			END
		END

		UPDATE #input SET so_luong = @QtyBal, tien = @AmtBal, tien_nt = @FCAmtBal FROM #input WHERE i = @i

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #output WHERE @j <= i) BREAK

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	-- Tinh gia xuat cho phieu xuat hien thoi
	SELECT @QtyBal = 0, @AmtBal = 0, @FCAmtBal = 0
	DECLARE crInput CURSOR FOR
	SELECT i, so_luong, tien, tien_nt FROM #input ORDER BY i
	OPEN crInput
	FETCH NEXT FROM crInput INTO @index, @So_luong, @Tien, @Tien_nt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @QtyBal = @QtyBal + @So_luong, @AmtBal = @AmtBal + @Tien, @FCAmtBal = @FCAmtBal + @Tien_nt

			IF @QtyBal = @nQty BEGIN
				SET @QtyBal = @nQty
				BREAK
			END

			IF @QtyBal > @nQty BEGIN
				SELECT @AmtBal = @AmtBal - ROUND((@QtyBal - @nQty) * @Tien / @So_luong, @m_round_tien), @FCAmtBal = @FCAmtBal - ROUND((@QtyBal - @nQty) * @Tien_nt / @So_luong, @m_round_tien_nt), @QtyBal = @nQty
				BREAK
			END

			FETCH NEXT FROM crInput INTO @index, @So_luong, @Tien, @Tien_nt
		END
	CLOSE crInput
	DEALLOCATE crInput

	IF @QtyBal = @nQty
		SELECT ISNULL(ROUND(@AmtBal / @QtyBal, @m_round_gia), 0) AS gia, ISNULL(ROUND(@FCAmtBal / @QtyBal, @m_round_gia_nt), 0) AS gia_nt, ISNULL(@AmtBal, 0) AS tien, ISNULL(@FCAmtBal, 0) AS tien_nt
	ELSE
		SELECT 0 AS gia, 0 AS gia_nt, 0 AS tien, 0 AS tien_nt
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_CopyCOCoeffOfDis]
	@nPeriod_dest NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear_dest NUMERIC(4),
	@nPeriod_src NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear_src NUMERIC(4), 
	@cFactorCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear_src) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod_src)
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ma_yt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cFactorCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	-- Unit Key
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tb FROM xcthspb
	SET @q = 'insert into #tb select * from xcthspb with(nolock) where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	UPDATE #tb SET user_id0 = @UserID, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE(), ky = @nPeriod_dest, nam = @nYear_dest
	INSERT INTO xcthspb 
		SELECT * FROM #tb a
			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1  
				FROM xcthspb b
				WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt 
					AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx
					AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
				)
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcttt29]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk,
		CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0') ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
		a.t_tien_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_pb_nt, a.t_tien_pb, a.t_tien_pb_nt0, a.t_tien_pb0, a.t_tien_cl_nt, a.t_tien_cl, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2
	FROM cttt29 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN dmkh AS b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionLotResult]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@InspectionID CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @insPart CHAR(6), @vcpart CHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @now SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherIDKey NVARCHAR(1024), @InspectionIDKey NVARCHAR(128), @firstResult BIT, @key NVARCHAR(1024), @existDecision BIT

	IF @VoucherID <> '' SET @VoucherIDKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InspectionID <> '' SET @InspectionIDKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InspectionIDKey IS NULL RETURN

	SELECT * INTO #kd FROM bikd WHERE stt_rec = @InspectionID
	SELECT TOP 1 @insPart = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @now = GETDATE() FROM #kd
	SELECT TOP 1 @vcpart = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM bic12$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID


	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tonghop FROM bikd00$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 a.nhom_du_lieu, a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_nk_goc, c.ma_dvcs, c.ma_bp0, c.ma_vung, c.ma_nguon,
			a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong AS sl_mau, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, c.ma_loai_kd,
			a.stt_rec_tc, a.stt_rec0tc, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi,
			a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.chuyen_ton_kho, c.kieu_tao_lo, c.kd_dac_tinh, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS kd_yn,
			a.nv_kd, a.nh_nc, a.ma_diem, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, a.ma_dac_tinh, a.ma_cd, a.ma_loi, a.ma_loai_loi, a.ma_ph_loai, a.sl_kd_nh1, a.sl_kd_nh2, a.sl_kd_nh3,
			a.danh_gia, a.ct_cd_dt, a.ghi_chu
		INTO #nguon FROM bikd02$000000 a CROSS JOIN #tonghop c RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #nguon(nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, stt_rec, so_ct, so_ct_goc, ngay_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_nguon, nv_kd, nh_nc, ma_diem, ngay_ket_thuc, ma_vt, '
			+ 'ma_dac_tinh, ma_cd, ma_loi, ma_loai_loi, ma_ph_loai, sl_mau, so_luong, sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2, sl_kd_nh3, dien_giai, danh_gia, ct_cd_dt, ghi_chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
		+ ' select ''04'', a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.nv_kd, a.nh_nc, a.ma_diem, a.ngay_ket_thuc, a.ma_vt, '
			+ 'b.ma_dac_tinh, b.ma_cd, b.ma_loi, isnull(c.ma_loai, ''''), isnull(c.ma_ph_loai, ''''), b.sl_mau, b.so_luong, b.ket_qua, b.sl_kd_nh2, b.sl_kd_nh3, b.dien_giai, b.danh_gia, b.ct_cd_dt, b.ghi_chu, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2'
		+ ' from bim12$' + @vcpart + ' a join bid12$' + @vcpart + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join bikddmloi c on b.ma_loi = c.ma_loi join bikd k on a.stt_rec_kd = k.stt_rec'
		+ ' where ' + @VoucherIDKey + ' and a.datetime2 <> a.datetime0'

		+ CHAR(13) +
		'insert into #nguon(nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, stt_rec, so_ct, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_nguon, nv_kd, nh_nc, ma_diem, ma_vt, '
			+ 'ma_loi, ma_loai_loi, ma_ph_loai, so_luong, sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2, sl_kd_nh3, dien_giai, ghi_chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
		+ ' select ''05'', a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, '''', '''', ''KD4'', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.nv_kd2, '''', a.ma_diem, a.ma_vt, '
			+ 'b.ma_loi, b.ma_loai, b.ma_ph_loai, b.sl_loi, 0, b.sl_loi, 0, a.dien_giai, b.ghi_chu, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime3, a.user_id0, a.user_id2'
		+ ' from bim12$' + @vcpart + ' a join bie12$' + @vcpart + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join bikd k on a.stt_rec_kd = k.stt_rec'
		+ ' where ' + @VoucherIDKey
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Process
	SET @q = 'insert into #tonghop select a.* from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'delete a from bikd02$' + @insPart + ' a where nhom_du_lieu in (''04'', ''05'') and a.stt_rec_goc = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nguon) BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into bikd02$' + @insPart + '(nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_kh, dien_giai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, '
					+ 'ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, nv_kd, nh_nc, ma_diem, sl_mau, sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2, sl_kd_nh3, ma_dac_tinh, ma_cd, danh_gia, ma_loi, ma_loai_loi, ma_ph_loai,'
					+ 'ct_cd_dt, ghi_chu, status, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
				+ ' select a.nhom_du_lieu, a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, b.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, '''', b.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, b.ma_kho, b.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_lo, '''', '''', '
					+ 'a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, b.dvt, b.he_so, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, a.nv_kd, a.nh_nc, a.ma_diem, a.sl_mau, a.sl_kd_nh1, a.sl_kd_nh2, a.sl_kd_nh3, a.ma_dac_tinh, a.ma_cd, a.danh_gia, a.ma_loi, a.ma_loai_loi, a.ma_ph_loai,'
					+ 'a.ct_cd_dt, a.ghi_chu, a.status, b.ma_vv, b.ma_sp, b.ma_bp, b.so_lsx, b.ma_hd, b.ma_ku, b.ma_phi, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2'
				+ ' from #nguon a join #tonghop b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	END
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID


	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #vc FROM bikd02$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #dc FROM bikd03m$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #vc select a.* from bikd02$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
		+ CHAR(13) +
		'insert into #dc select a.* from bikd03m$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@InspectionIDKey, 'a.stt_rec', 'a.stt_rec_kd')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.stt_rec, MIN(ngay_ct_goc) AS ngay_ct_min, MIN(a.ngay_bat_dau) AS ngay_bat_dau, MAX(a.ngay_ket_thuc) AS ngay_ket_thuc, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong,
			SUM(a.sl_kd_nh1) AS sl_kd_nh1, SUM(a.sl_kd_nh2) AS sl_kd_nh2, SUM(a.sl_kd_nh3) AS sl_kd_nh3
		INTO #kq FROM #vc a WHERE a.nhom_du_lieu = '04' GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.sl_kd_nh1) AS sl_kd_nh1, SUM(a.sl_kd_nh2) AS sl_kd_nh2, SUM(a.sl_kd_nh3) AS sl_kd_nh3
		INTO #loi FROM #vc a WHERE a.nhom_du_lieu = '05' GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec_kd AS stt_rec, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.status, 0) = '1' THEN a.so_luong ELSE 0 END) AS sl_kq_kd, MIN(ISNULL(b.status, 0)) AS tt_mau
		INTO #template FROM #dc a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_goc, MAX(status) AS status FROM #vc WHERE nhom_du_lieu = '04' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc) b ON LEFT(a.stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(b.stt_rec_goc, 10) GROUP BY a.stt_rec_kd


	UPDATE #tonghop SET ngay_bat_dau = ISNULL(b.ngay_bat_dau, b.ngay_ct_min), ngay_ket_thuc = CASE WHEN tt_mau = '1' THEN b.ngay_ket_thuc ELSE NULL END,
			sl_kq_kd = ISNULL(c.sl_kq_kd, 0), sl_kd_nh1 = ISNULL(b.sl_kd_nh1, 0) + ISNULL(e.sl_kd_nh1, 0), sl_kd_nh2 = ISNULL(b.sl_kd_nh2, 0) + ISNULL(e.sl_kd_nh2, 0), sl_kd_nh3 = ISNULL(b.sl_kd_nh3, 0) + ISNULL(e.sl_kd_nh3, 0)
		FROM #tonghop a
			JOIN #template c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #kq b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #loi e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec


	SET @q = 'update a set ngay_bat_dau = b.ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc = b.ngay_ket_thuc, sl_kq_kd = b.sl_kq_kd, sl_kd_nh1 = b.sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2 = b.sl_kd_nh2'
			+ ' from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a join #tonghop b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	DECLARE @outStatus CHAR(1)
	EXEC bs_PostInspectionStatus @InspectionID, 0, @UserID, @Admin, '#tonghop', '#dc', '#vc', @Debug, @outStatus out
	UPDATE #tonghop SET status = @outStatus

	-- Auto Create Dicision
	SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from bikd04$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey + ' and nhom_du_lieu = ''06'') set @x = 1 else set @x = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x bit out', @existDecision out

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nguon WHERE status = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tonghop a JOIN bikddmloai b ON a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai WHERE b.qd_tu_dong_yn = 1 AND a.status = '3' AND a.ngay_ket_thuc IS NOT NULL) AND @existDecision = 0 BEGIN
		DECLARE @wsID varchar(1), @stt_rec CHAR(13), @usageDecisionType VARCHAR(32), @usageDecisionResult VARCHAR(32), @usageDecisionDescription VARCHAR(32), @t_so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), @stockStatus CHAR(1), @diem_so_qd NUMERIC(28, 6)
		DECLARE @masterTable VARCHAR(64), @detailTable VARCHAR(64), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(64), @vcNumber CHAR(12), @size_so_ct INT

		SELECT @usageDecisionType = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_loai'
		SELECT @usageDecisionResult = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_kq'
		SELECT @usageDecisionDescription = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_qdsd_ld'

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bikddmlqd WHERE ma_loai_qd = @usageDecisionType) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bikddmkq WHERE ma_kq = @usageDecisionResult) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmnx WHERE ma_nx = @usageDecisionDescription) BEGIN

			SELECT @stockStatus = tt_ton_kho FROM bikddmkq WHERE ma_kq = @usageDecisionResult
			SELECT @diem_so_qd = diem_so FROM bikddmlqd WHERE ma_loai_qd = @usageDecisionType
			SELECT @size_so_ct = [length] FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('bim14$000000') AND name = 'so_ct'

			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ket_thuc AS ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.dien_giai,
					a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi,
					a.so_luong0 - ISNULL(a.sl_qdsd, 0) AS so_luong, GETDATE() AS datetime0, GETDATE() AS datetime2, b.pp_chat_luong
				INTO #qdsd
				FROM #tonghop a JOIN bikddmloai b ON a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai
				WHERE b.qd_tu_dong_yn = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vc x WHERE x.nhom_du_lieu = '04' AND x.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND x.danh_gia <> '1')
					AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vc x WHERE x.nhom_du_lieu = '05' AND x.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #qdsd) BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 0 x.* INTO #master FROM bim14$000000 x RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
				SELECT TOP 0 x.* INTO #detail FROM bid14$000000 x RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

				SELECT TOP 1 @vcNumber = dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(so_ct + 1), @size_so_ct) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'KD6'

				INSERT INTO #detail(stt_rec0, ma_kq, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_ly_do, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, tt_ton_kho, ghi_chu, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr)
					SELECT '001', @usageDecisionResult, so_luong, dvt, he_so, @usageDecisionDescription, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ISNULL(@stockStatus, ''), '', ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, 1
					FROM #qdsd

				INSERT INTO #master(stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh, ma_vt, chuyen_ton_kho, dien_giai,
						ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ma_loai_qd, sl_lo_kd, t_so_luong, diem_so, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2,
						job_id, prd_id, dept_id, mo_nbr, contract_id, bcontract_id, fee_id, s6)
					SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.dien_giai,
						a.ngay_ct, @vcNumber, '', @usageDecisionType, a.so_luong, a.so_luong, CASE WHEN a.pp_chat_luong = '1' THEN @diem_so_qd ELSE 0 END, '1', a.datetime0, a.datetime2, @UserID, @UserID,
						'', '', '', '', '', '', '', 0
						FROM #qdsd a

				SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
				CREATE TABLE #idNumber (stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
				INSERT INTO #idNumber EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetIdentityNumber @wsID, 'KD6', 'bim14$000000', @UserID
				SELECT @stt_rec = stt_rec FROM #idNumber
				DROP TABLE #idNumber

				UPDATE #master SET stt_rec = @stt_rec, ma_ct = 'KD6', loai_ct = '1', ma_gd = '1'
				UPDATE #detail SET stt_rec = @stt_rec

				DECLARE @calScore CHAR(1), @$k1 VARCHAR(128), @$k2 VARCHAR(128), @$k3 VARCHAR(128)
				SELECT @$k1 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(ma_vt , '''', '''''') + ''' and ma_bp0 = ''' + REPLACE(ma_bp0, '''', '''''') + '''', @$k2 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(ma_vt , '''', '''''') + '''', @$k3 = 'controller = ''Item''' FROM #master
				EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Options$GetValue 'danh_gia_ncc', @calScore out, 'bidmvttsbp0', @$k1, 'bidmvtts', @$k2, 'bidmts', @$k3
				IF @calScore = '1' BEGIN
				  SELECT TOP 1 @stt_rec AS stt_rec, @InspectionID AS stt_rec_kd, CAST(null AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_so INTO #$qdsd

				  EXEC bs_CalculateInspectionScore '#$qdsd', null, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug
				  UPDATE #master SET diem_so = ISNULL(a.diem_so, 0) FROM #$qdsd a WHERE a.stt_rec = @stt_rec
				END

				SET @q = 'insert into bim14$' + @vcpart + ' select * from #master'
					+ CHAR(13) +
					+ 'insert into bid14$' + @vcpart + ' select * from #detail'
					+ CHAR(13) +
					+ 'insert into bikd04$' + @insPart + '(stt_rec_goc, ngay_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_ct_goc, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, nhom_du_lieu) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, '''', so_ct, ma_ct, stt_rec_kd, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, '''', ''06'' from #master'
				IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				SELECT @masterTable = 'bim14$' + @vcpart, @detailTable = 'bid14$' + @vcpart, @inquiryTable = 'bii14$' + @vcpart
				EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInquiryTable 'KD6', @inquiryTable, @masterTable, @detailTable, 'stt_rec', @stt_rec, 'ma_vt,loai_ct,ma_vung;#10$,#15$,#20$;bid14, , :ma_kho;#10$;bid14', 'ma_nguon, ma_vung', 2
				EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateGrandTable 'KD6', 'bic14$000000', @masterTable, 'stt_rec', @stt_rec, 1
				EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateGeneral 'KD6', @masterTable, @detailTable, @inquiryTable, @masterTable, @stt_rec

				EXEC fs_IncreaseVoucherNo @vcNumber, 'KD6'

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tonghop WHERE ma_ct_goc IN ('PD1')) BEGIN
					EXEC bs_PostInspection '6', 'KD6', @stt_rec, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB
				END ELSE BEGIN
					EXEC bs_PostInspection '6', 'KD6', @stt_rec, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB
				END
			END
		END
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ARGetPaymentVoucher]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(3),
	
	@Refresh BIT,
	@PageIndex INT, 
	@PageCount INT, 
	@LastPage INT, 
	@LastCount INT, 
	@FirstItem VARCHAR(128),
	@LastItem VARCHAR(128),

	@SearchCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @baseCurrency VARCHAR(3), @key NVARCHAR(1000), @itemCount INT, @q NVARCHAR(1000), @f NVARCHAR(1000), @tkcn CHAR(1)
	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @tkcn = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_pb_tk'

	SELECT @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Currency = REPLACE(@Currency, '''', ''), @SearchCode = REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@SearchCode)), '''', ''''''), @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '''''')

	SELECT @key = 'ma_dvcs = ''' + @Unit + ''' and ma_kh = ''' + @Customer + ''' and ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + ''' and '
	SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @baseCurrency = @Currency THEN '(ma_nt = '''' or ma_nt = ''' + @Currency + ''')' ELSE '(ma_nt = ''' + @Currency + ''')' END
	SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN 'da_pb <> 1' ELSE 'loai_tt = 0 and tat_toan = 0' END

	IF @Account <> '' BEGIN
		IF @tkcn = '1' SELECT @key = @key + ' and tk = ''' + @Account + ''''
		ELSE SELECT @key = @key + ' and tk like ''' + @Account + '%'''
	END

	IF @SearchCode <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(so_ct)) like ''%' + @SearchCode + '%'''
		
	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tien_pb_nt, t_tt_nt AS tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, t_tien_pb, t_tt AS tien_cl INTO #r1 FROM cttt60
		SELECT @f = 'so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, isnull(t_tien_pb_nt, 0) as t_tien_pb_nt, 0 as tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, isnull(t_tien_pb, 0) as t_tien_pb, 0 as tien_cl'

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Payment$Finding 'cttt50', '#r1', @Refresh, @PageIndex, @PageCount, @LastPage, @LastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @key, 
			'convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec', @f, '', 'ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec', 1, @UserID, 1, @itemCount OUTPUT
		
		UPDATE #r1 SET tien_cl_nt = t_tt_nt - t_tien_pb_nt, tien_cl = t_tt - t_tien_pb

		SELECT so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, DATEDIFF(DAY, ngay_ct, @Date) AS han_tt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tien_pb_nt, tien_cl_nt AS cl_nt FROM #r1 ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tt_qd AS da_tt_nt, t_tt_nt AS cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, ma_tt INTO #r2 FROM cttt20
		SET @f = 'so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, t_tt_nt, t_tt_qd as da_tt_nt'
		SET @f = @f + ', case when ma_nt = '''' then t_tt else t_tt_nt end - t_tt_qd as cl_nt, ma_nt, t_tt, ma_tt'

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Payment$Finding 'cttt20', '#r2', @Refresh, @PageIndex, @PageCount, @LastPage, @LastCount, @FirstItem, @LastItem, @key, 
			'convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec', @f, '', 'ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec', 1, @UserID, 1, @itemCount OUTPUT

		SELECT TOP 0 tt_qd, stt_rec_tt INTO #tt FROM cttt30 WHERE 1 = 0
		UPDATE #r2 SET da_tt_nt = da_tt_nt - #tt.tt_qd, cl_nt = cl_nt + #tt.tt_qd FROM #tt WHERE stt_rec = #tt.stt_rec_tt
		
		UPDATE #r2 SET t_tt_nt = t_tt, ma_nt = @baseCurrency WHERE ma_nt = ''

		SELECT a.*, ISNULL(b.han_tt, 99999) AS han_tt0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS han_tt INTO #r from #r2 a LEFT JOIN dmtt b ON a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
		
		UPDATE #r SET han_tt = CASE WHEN han_tt0 = 99999 THEN han_tt0 ELSE han_tt0 - DATEDIFF(DAY, ngay_ct, GETDATE()) END
		
		SELECT so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, han_tt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, da_tt_nt, cl_nt FROM #r WHERE ma_nt = @Currency ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	END

	SELECT @itemCount

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCDTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @CreditAccount <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CreditAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i51$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m51$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintWRTran]
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table CHAR(10), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	SET @q = 'select a.line_nbr, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @q = @q + ', b.ten_tk' + @cE + ' AS ten_tk'
	ELSE SET @q = @q +  ', b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmtk b with(nolock) on a.tk = b.tk'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @DetailKey + ''' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
