			b.ma_dvcs, b.ky_hieu, b.so_seri, dbo.FastBusiness$VoucherNumberStruct(so_ct1, '', @vnFormat) AS dinh_dang, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt
		INTO #nk FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_nk FROM #ct) a JOIN v20dmnk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
	UPDATE #nk SET r_len = LEN(r_so_ct1)
	
	UPDATE #ct SET so_ct1 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(r_so_ct1, b.r_len), ' ', '0')), so_ct2 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(r_so_ct2, b.r_len), ' ', '0')) FROM #ct a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk WHERE a.loai = 2
	UPDATE #ct SET so_tu = dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(a.so_ct1, b.so_ct1) FROM #ct a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk WHERE so_tu = 0
	UPDATE #ct SET so_den = dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(a.so_ct2, b.so_ct1) FROM #ct a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk WHERE so_den = 0


	-- Correct #ct
	CREATE INDEX loai ON #ct(loai)
	UPDATE #ct SET nhom_td = stt WHERE loai = 1 OR loai = 2
	UPDATE #ct SET so_luong = so_den - so_tu + 1 WHERE loai = 2
	UPDATE #ct SET so_ct1 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(a.so_tu, b.r_len), ' ', '0')), so_ct2 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(a.so_den, b.r_len), ' ', '0'))
		FROM #ct a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk WHERE loai IN (1, 3, 4)
	UPDATE #ct SET so_den = so_tu WHERE loai = 5 OR loai = 6
	UPDATE a SET nhom_td = b.nhom_td FROM #ct a LEFT JOIN #ct b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.so_tu BETWEEN b.so_tu AND b.so_den WHERE a.loai IN (3, 4, 5, 6, 7) AND b.loai IN (1, 2)
	UPDATE #ct SET nhom_td = ISNULL(b.nhom_td, 0) + 1 FROM #ct a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_nk, MAX(nhom_td) AS nhom_td FROM #ct WHERE loai = 1 OR loai = 2 GROUP BY ma_nk) b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
		WHERE a.loai IN (3, 4, 5, 6, 7) AND a.nhom_td IS NULL

	-- Tổng sử dụng, xóa, mất, hủy
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT 7, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2 FROM #ct WHERE loai IN (3, 4, 5, 6)

	-- Merge and sum quantity
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ctm FROM #ct
	DECLARE @l1 INT, @l2 INT, @g1 INT, @g2 INT, @k1 VARCHAR(32), @k2 VARCHAR(32), @x1 INT, @x2 INT, @y1 INT, @y2 INT, @e1 VARCHAR(32), @e2 VARCHAR(32), @f1 VARCHAR(32), @f2 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @i INT, @m INT, @f bit, @s VARCHAR(4000), @s1 VARCHAR(32), @s2 VARCHAR(32), @n INT

	SELECT loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #seg FROM #ct ORDER BY loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den
	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(stt), @f = 1, @s = '', @n = 0 FROM #seg
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		IF @f = 1 SELECT @l1 = loai, @k1 = ma_nk, @g1 = nhom_td, @x1 = so_tu, @y1 = so_den, @e1 = so_ct1, @f1 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i
		IF @i < @m SELECT @l2 = loai, @k2 = ma_nk, @g2 = nhom_td, @x2 = so_tu, @y2 = so_den, @e2 = so_ct1, @f2 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i + 1

		IF @l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @g1 <> @g2 OR @i = @m OR @y1 + 1 < @x2 BEGIN
			SELECT @f = 1, @n = @n + @y1 - @x1 + 1,
				@s1 = CASE WHEN LEN(@x1) <= r_len THEN REPLACE(dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(@x1, r_len), ' ', '0')) ELSE LTRIM(@e1) END,
				@s2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@y1) <= r_len THEN REPLACE(dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(@y1, r_len), ' ', '0')) ELSE LTRIM(@f1) END,
				@s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + @s1 + CASE WHEN @x1 <> @y1 THEN ' - ' + @s2 ELSE '' END
			FROM #nk WHERE ma_nk = @k1

			INSERT INTO #ctm(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
					SELECT @l1, @k1, @g1, @x1, @y1, @y1 - @x1 + 1, @s1, @s2

			IF (@l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @i = @m) AND @AppMode <> 1 BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nk, xgroup, so_td, sl_td, so_ph, sl_ph, so_mat, sl_mat, so_huy, sl_huy, so_sd, sl_sd, so_xoa, sl_xoa, t_so_sd, t_sl_sd)
					SELECT 5, 1, 1, @k1, 1,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 1 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 1 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 2 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 2 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 3 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 3 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 4 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 4 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 5 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 5 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 6 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 6 THEN @n ELSE 0 END,
						CASE WHEN @l1 = 7 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 7 THEN @n ELSE 0 END
				SELECT @s = '', @n = 0
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @y2 > @y1 SELECT @y1 = @y2, @f1 = @f2
			SELECT @f = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END


	-- Xác định các đoạn tồn cuối: dựa vào tổng sử dụng, xóa, mất, hủy và chỉ xét các số trong phạm vi của từng tồn đầu
	-- + Đoạn tồn chưa phát sinh trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
		SELECT 8, a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td, a.so_tu, a.so_den, a.so_luong, a.so_ct1, a.so_ct2 FROM #ctm a WHERE a.loai IN (1, 2) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctm b WHERE b.loai = 7 AND b.ma_nk = a.ma_nk AND a.nhom_td = b.nhom_td)

	-- + Đoạn tồn giữa các đoạn đã phát sinh trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
		SELECT 8, a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td, a.so_den + 1 AS so_tu, b.so_tu - 1 AS so_den, b.so_tu - 1 - a.so_den AS so_luong, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS so_ct1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS so_ct2
			FROM #ctm a JOIN #ctm b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.stt = b.stt - 1 AND a.nhom_td = b.nhom_td
					JOIN (SELECT ma_nk, nhom_td FROM #ctm WHERE loai IN (1, 2)) c ON a.ma_nk = c.ma_nk AND a.nhom_td = c.nhom_td
				WHERE a.loai = 7 AND b.loai = 7

	-- + Đoạn tồn trước và sau phát sinh của từng đoạn
	SELECT a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td, MIN(a.so_tu) AS so_tu, MAX(a.so_den) AS so_den
		INTO #mm FROM #ctm a JOIN (SELECT ma_nk, nhom_td FROM #ctm WHERE loai IN (1, 2)) c ON a.ma_nk = c.ma_nk AND a.nhom_td = c.nhom_td WHERE a.loai = 7 GROUP BY a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
		SELECT 8, a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td, a.so_tu, b.so_tu - 1 AS so_den, b.so_tu - 1 - a.so_tu AS so_luong, '', '' FROM #ctm a JOIN #mm b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.nhom_td = b.nhom_td WHERE a.loai IN (1, 2) AND a.so_tu < b.so_tu
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
		SELECT 8, a.ma_nk, a.nhom_td, b.so_den + 1 AS so_tu, a.so_den, a.so_den - b.so_den - 1 AS so_luong, '', '' FROM #ctm a JOIN #mm b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.nhom_td = b.nhom_td WHERE a.loai IN (1, 2) AND a.so_den > b.so_den


	-- + Merge tồn cuối và tính số lượng tồn cuối
	TRUNCATE TABLE #seg
	INSERT INTO #seg(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2 FROM #ct WHERE loai = 8 ORDER BY loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den
	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(stt), @f = 1, @s = '', @n = 0 FROM #seg
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		IF @f = 1 SELECT @l1 = loai, @k1 = ma_nk, @g1 = nhom_td, @x1 = so_tu, @y1 = so_den, @e1 = so_ct1, @f1 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i
		IF @i < @m SELECT @l2 = loai, @k2 = ma_nk, @g2 = nhom_td, @x2 = so_tu, @y2 = so_den, @e2 = so_ct1, @f2 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i + 1

		IF @l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @g1 <> @g2 OR @i = @m OR @y1 + 1 < @x2 BEGIN
			SELECT @f = 1, @n = @n + @y1 - @x1 + 1,
					@s1 = CASE WHEN LEN(@x1) <= r_len THEN REPLACE(dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(@x1, r_len), ' ', '0')) ELSE LTRIM(@e1) END,
					@s2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@y1) <= r_len THEN REPLACE(dinh_dang, @vnFormat, REPLACE(STR(@y1, r_len), ' ', '0')) ELSE LTRIM(@f1) END,
					@s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + @s1 + CASE WHEN @x1 <> @y1 THEN ' - ' + @s2 ELSE '' END
				FROM #nk WHERE ma_nk = @k1

			INSERT INTO #ctm(loai, ma_nk, nhom_td, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, so_ct1, so_ct2)
				SELECT @l1, @k1, @g1, @x1, @y1, @y1 - @x1 + 1, @s1, @s2

			IF (@l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @i = @m) AND @AppMode <> 1 BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nk, xgroup, so_tc, sl_tc) SELECT 5, 1, 1, @k1, 1, @s, @n
				SELECT @s = '', @n = 0
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @y2 > @y1 SELECT @y1 = @y2, @f1 = @f2
			SELECT @f = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Save
	IF @AppMode = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @d DATETIME
		SELECT @d = GETDATE()

		IF @Quarter = 4 SELECT @Year = @Year + 1, @Quarter = 1 ELSE SELECT @Quarter = @Quarter + 1

		DELETE sthd FROM sthd a JOIN #nk b ON a.nam = @Year AND a.quy = @Quarter AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND RTRIM(a.ma_nk) = RTRIM(b.ma_nk)

		INSERT INTO sthd (nam, quy, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_luong, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT @Year, @Quarter, b.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.so_tu, a.so_den, a.so_luong, @d, @d, @UserID, @UserID
				FROM #ctm a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
				WHERE a.loai = 8 AND a.so_luong > 0
		RETURN
	END

	-- Min/max phát sinh trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nk, xgroup, so_min, so_max)
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, ma_nk, 1, MIN(so_ct1), MAX(so_ct2)
			FROM #ctm WHERE loai = 7 GROUP BY ma_nk

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nk, xgroup, so_min, so_max) SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', 1, '', ''
		INSERT INTO #nk SELECT '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', '', ''
	END

	-- Export
	SELECT a.sysorder, MAX(a.sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(a.systotal) AS systotal, a.ma_nk, xgroup, MAX(b.stt) AS stt, xgroupct,
			MAX(so_td) AS so_td, SUM(sl_td) AS sl_td, MAX(so_ph) AS so_ph, SUM(sl_ph) AS sl_ph, SUM(sl_td) + SUM(sl_ph) AS t_sl_td,
			MAX(t_so_sd) AS t_so_sd, SUM(t_sl_sd) AS t_sl_sd,
			MAX(so_sd) AS so_sd, SUM(sl_sd) AS sl_sd, MAX(so_xoa) AS so_xoa, SUM(sl_xoa) AS sl_xoa,
			MAX(so_mat) AS so_mat, SUM(sl_mat) AS sl_mat, MAX(so_huy) AS so_huy, SUM(sl_huy) AS sl_huy,
			MAX(ISNULL(so_tc, '')) AS so_tc, SUM(ISNULL(sl_tc, 0)) AS sl_tc,
			MAX(ISNULL(so_min, '')) AS so_min, MAX(ISNULL(so_max, '')) AS so_max,
			MAX(ISNULL(m.loai_hd, '')) AS loai_hd,
			MAX(ISNULL(n.ten_loai_hd, '')) AS ten_loai_hd,
			MAX(ISNULL(n.ten_loai_hd2, '')) AS ten_loai_hd2,
			MAX(ISNULL(b.ky_hieu, '')) AS ky_hieu,
			MAX(ISNULL(b.so_seri, '')) AS so_seri
		FROM #report a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk LEFT JOIN dmmauct m ON b.ky_hieu = m.ma_mau_ct LEFT JOIN dmloaihd2 n ON m.loai_hd = n.loai_hd
		GROUP BY a.ma_nk, a.sysorder, xgroup, xgroupct

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmnsdtd]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_quyen, b.ten_quyen2, c.name, c.comment, c.comment2, d.ten_loai, d.ten_loai2
		FROM dbo.dmnsdtd a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmquyentd b ON a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen AND a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet
			LEFT JOIN dbo.vsysuserinfo c ON a.user_id = c.id
			LEFT JOIN dmloaiduyet d ON d.loai_duyet = a.loai_duyet

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrekl]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.cap_quyet_dinh, a.so_quyet_dinh, a.ngay_ky, 
		a.ghi_chu, b.ten_kl, b.ten_kl2
	FROM hrekl a LEFT JOIN hrdmkl b ON a.hinh_thuc = b.ma_kl
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_VoucherBookTemplatesDelete]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT ma_nkt INTO #master FROM v20dmnkt WHERE ma_nkt IN (SELECT data FROM #t)

	UPDATE #master SET ma_nkt = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ma_nkt, '[YYYY]', RTRIM(@Year)), '[YY]', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Year), 2)), '[MM]', RIGHT('0' + RTRIM(@Period), 2))

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v20dmnk a JOIN #master b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nkt WHERE a.so_ct0 >= a.so_ct1) BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS array$, 1 AS value
		RETURN
	END

	DELETE v20dmctnk FROM v20dmctnk a JOIN #master b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nkt
	DELETE v20dmnk FROM v20dmnk a JOIN #master b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nkt
	--
	SELECT '' AS array$, 0 AS value
	RETURN

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_FXCalDis]
	@Cycle NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@UserID INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cc_kh' AND val  = '1')
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs20_FXCalDisByDay @Cycle, @Year, @UserID, @Unit
			RETURN
		END

	-- 1. Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_dc_pb_ky0 VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @CycleFrom INT, @CycleTo INT, @Round INT, @FCRound INT, @BaseCurrency CHAR(3)

	--2. Set
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Cycle, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Cycle, @Year), @CycleFrom = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@DateFrom), @CycleTo = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@DateTo)
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @FCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cc_pb_ky0'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, 0, 'New')
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	-- 3. Create template file
	-- ++ #dmcc
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ngay_kh_kt, so_ky_kh, ngay_hong
		INTO #dmcc FROM dmcc
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmcc(so_the_ts)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmcc select so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_kh0), ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ngay_kh_kt, so_ky_kh, ngay_hong'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dmcc where ((ngay_giam is null) or (''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' <= ngay_giam))'
	IF ISNULL(@UnitKey, '') <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #dmcc SET ngay_kh_kt = DATEADD(MONTH, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0) - 1 WHERE ngay_kh_kt IS NULL AND kieu_kh = '0'
	END

	-- ++ #ctkhcc
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv INTO #ctkhcc FROM ctkhcc a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE a.ky = @Cycle AND a.nam = @Year AND a.sua_kh = 1

	-- ++ #tctdmcc
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc
		FROM ctdmcc a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE b.ky_kh0 <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmcc(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	-- ++ #tctdmcc_ex
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc_ex
		FROM ctdmcc a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE b.ky_kh0 > @CycleTo AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmcc_ex(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	INSERT INTO #tctdmcc SELECT * FROM #tctdmcc_ex a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tctdmcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	-- ++ #tctdmcc1
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, c.loai_tg_ts, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc1
		FROM ctdmcc1 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmtgcc c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ctkhcc c WHERE a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv AND c.ky = @Cycle AND nam = @Year AND sua_kh = 1) AND a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @CycleFrom

	UPDATE #tctdmcc1 SET nguyen_gia = -nguyen_gia, gt_cl = -gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = -gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt = -nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl_nt = -gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = -gt_kh_ky_nt WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #temp FROM #tctdmcc
	INSERT INTO #temp SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, 0, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, 0, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt FROM #tctdmcc1

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt
	INTO #tctdmcc2 FROM #temp GROUP BY so_the_ts, ma_nv

	SELECT a.*, b.tk_kh, b.tk_ts, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.kieu_kh, b.ngay_hong INTO #tFxDepr FROM #tctdmcc2 a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(tk_kh) AS tk_kh, MAX(tk_ts) AS tk_ts, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
		INTO #tctbpcc
		FROM cthscc WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 20) IN
				(SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 20) FROM cthscc WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @Year * 12 + @Cycle GROUP BY so_the_ts)
				AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmcc)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #tFxDepr SET tk_kh = b.tk_kh, tk_ts = b.tk_ts, tk_cp = b.tk_cp, ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #tFxDepr a JOIN #tctbpcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	UPDATE #tFxDepr SET gt_kh_ky = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 FROM #tFxDepr a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ngay_kh1 < @DateFrom
	-- 4. Delete
	DELETE ctkhcc WHERE ky = @Cycle AND nam = @Year AND sua_kh = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmcc)

	-- 5. Calc
	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, kieu_kh, ngay_hong INTO #r
		FROM #tFxDepr

	UPDATE #r SET gt_kh_ky = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 FROM #r a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			WHERE b.kieu_kh = 1 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) < @CycleFrom AND @CycleFrom <> dbo.ff_GetCycles(CASE WHEN b.ngay_hong <= b.ngay_kh_kt THEN b.ngay_hong ELSE b.ngay_kh_kt END)

	-- Acc. Depreciation Value
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r a JOIN ctkhcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @Year * 12 + @Cycle - 1)
		UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #r a JOIN ctkhcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @Year * 12 + @Cycle - 1
	ELSE UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #r a JOIN #tctdmcc2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	-- Add depreciated value on adj. table
	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + b.gt_da_kh_dc, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + b.gt_da_kh_dc_nt FROM #r a
		JOIN (SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, SUM(a.gt_da_kh * CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc, SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt * CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc_nt
				FROM ctdmcc1 a JOIN dmtgcc b ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts WHERE a.nam = @Year AND a.ky = @Cycle GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv
			) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_kh_ky, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_kh_ky_nt
	UPDATE #r SET gt_cl = nguyen_gia - gt_da_kh, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - gt_da_kh_nt
	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = gt_kh_ky + gt_cl, gt_cl = 0 WHERE gt_cl <= tien_cl
	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = gt_kh_ky_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE gt_cl_nt <= tien_cl_nt

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1'
		UPDATE #r SET gt_kh_ky = a.gt_kh_ky + a.gt_cl, gt_kh_ky_nt = a.gt_kh_ky_nt + a.gt_cl_nt, gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_da_kh = a.nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt
			FROM #r a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.kieu_kh = '0' AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh_kt) = @CycleTo AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_kh1 OR b.ngay_kh1 IS NULL) AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_giam OR b.ngay_giam IS NULL)

	UPDATE #r SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_tang_nt = 0, gt_giam_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency

	-- Insert
	INSERT INTO ctkhcc(so_the_ts, sua_kh, ma_nv, ky, nam, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
		ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT so_the_ts, 0, ma_nv, @Cycle, @Year, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
		FROM #r
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_CopyCORuleOfCoeff]
	@nPeriod_dest NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear_dest NUMERIC(4),
	@nPeriod_src NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear_src NUMERIC(4), 
	@cFactorCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear_src) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod_src)
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ma_yt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cFactorCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	-- Unit
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tb FROM xdmcdsp
	SET @q = 'insert into #tb select * from xdmcdsp where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	UPDATE #tb SET user_id0 = @UserID, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE(), ky = @nPeriod_dest, nam = @nYear_dest
	INSERT INTO xdmcdsp 
		SELECT * FROM #tb a
			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1  
				FROM xdmcdsp b
				WHERE a.nam = b.nam AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt 
				AND a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx
				AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs 
				)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptSIHIDeclarationDependantExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@TypeReport TINYINT, -- 1 - QD 595
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @HRM001 NVARCHAR(1023), @HRM002 NVARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @HRM001 = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @HRM002 = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, z.ma_nv, a.ho_ten, a.ho_ten as ho_ten_ch, a.ma_so_bhxh, a.ngay_sinh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS gioi_tinh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS qh_gd, a.cmnd_so, a.ghi_chu
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS noi_cap_ks
			, a.dien_thoai, a.ho_khau_so, a.dia_chi
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_phuong
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_quan
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_tinh
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay_bc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang_bc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam_bc
			, a.line_nbr, f.ma_so_hgd, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS quoc_tich, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS dan_toc
			INTO #result FROM hrhgd a, hrdmphuong b, hrdmquan c, hrdmtinh d, hrnv z, hrdmqhgd y, hrttbh f

	-- stt_rec
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	
	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #$keys (text NTEXT)
		INSERT INTO #$keys SELECT @IDNumbers
	END

	DECLARE @l INT, @size INT, @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @size = COL_LENGTH('hrnv', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @i = 1, @l = DATALENGTH(text)/2 FROM #$keys
	WHILE @i + @size <= @l + 1 BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #stt_rec SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(text, @i, @size), '''', '') FROM #$keys
		  SELECT @i = @i + @size + 1
	END
 
 	-- Household
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(stt_rec0) AS stt_rec0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_ten, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS dien_thoai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_so, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dia_chi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_phuong, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_quan, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ho_khau_tinh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS quoc_tich, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS dan_toc
		INTO #hrhgd FROM hrhgd WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #stt_rec) AND chu_ho = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #hrhgd SET ho_ten = b.ho_ten, dien_thoai = b.dien_thoai, ho_khau_so = b.ho_khau_so, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, ho_khau_phuong = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(c.ten_phuong, '') ELSE ISNULL(c.ten_phuong2, '') END, ho_khau_quan = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(d.ten_quan, '') ELSE ISNULL(d.ten_quan2, '') END, ho_khau_tinh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(e.ten_tinh, '') ELSE ISNULL(e.ten_tinh2, '') END
		, dan_toc = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN f.ten_dt ELSE f.ten_dt2 END, quoc_tich = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN g.ten_qt ELSE g.ten_qt END
		FROM #hrhgd a JOIN hrhgd b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong c WITH(NOLOCK) ON c.ma_tinh = b.ho_khau_tinh AND c.ma_quan = b.ho_khau_quan AND c.ma_phuong = b.ho_khau_phuong LEFT JOIN hrdmquan d WITH(NOLOCK) ON d.ma_tinh = b.ho_khau_tinh AND d.ma_quan = b.ho_khau_quan LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ma_tinh = b.ho_khau_tinh LEFT JOIN hrdmdt f WITH(NOLOCK) ON f.ma_dt = b.dan_toc LEFT JOIN dmqt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON g.ma_qt = b.quoc_tich

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, z.ma_nv, a.ho_ten, '''', a.ma_so_bhxh, a.ngay_sinh, case when a.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + @HRM001 + ''' else N''' + @HRM002 + ''' end, isnull(e.ten_qh%l, ''''), a.cmnd_so, a.ghi_chu'
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(b.ten_phuong%l, '''') + '', '' + isnull(c.ten_quan%l, '''') + '', '' + isnull(d.ten_tinh%l, '''') as noi_cap_ks, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(''' + STR(DAY(@ReportDate), 2)+ ''', '' '', ''0''), replace(''' + STR(MONTH(@ReportDate), 2) + ''', '' '', ''0''), ''' + RTRIM(YEAR(@ReportDate)) + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ', a.line_nbr, f.ma_so_hgd, '''','''''
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrhgd a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmphuong b with(nolock) on b.ma_quan = a.ma_quan and b.ma_tinh = a.ma_tinh and b.ma_phuong = a.ma_phuong'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan c with(nolock) on c.ma_quan = a.ma_quan and c.ma_tinh = a.ma_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh d with(nolock) on d.ma_tinh = a.ma_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmqhgd e with(nolock) on e.ma_qh = a.ma_qh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrttbh f with(nolock) on f.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrnv z with(nolock) on z.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #stt_rec)'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by z.ma_nv'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	UPDATE #result SET ho_ten_ch = b.ho_ten, dien_thoai = b.dien_thoai, ho_khau_so = b.ho_khau_so, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, ho_khau_phuong = b.ho_khau_phuong, ho_khau_quan = b.ho_khau_quan, ho_khau_tinh = b.ho_khau_tinh, quoc_tich = b.quoc_tich, dan_toc = b.dan_toc FROM #result a LEFT JOIN #hrhgd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Not Exists
	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT a.stt_rec, z.ma_nv, '', '', '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@ReportDate), 2), ' ', '0'), REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@ReportDate), 2), ' ', '0'), RTRIM(YEAR(@ReportDate)), NULL, '', '', ''
			FROM #stt_rec a LEFT JOIN hrnv z WITH(NOLOCK) ON z.stt_rec = a.stt_rec WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrhgd b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	
	-- VIew
	SELECT * FROM #result ORDER BY ma_nv, line_nbr
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_EditCodeID @coCode VARCHAR(33), @cnCode VARCHAR(33), @strList VARCHAR(511)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @cCode VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT
	SET  @nStart = 1
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @cCode = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))
		SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		DECLARE crCode CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects
			WHERE xType = 'U' AND id in (SELECT id FROM syscolumns WHERE name = @cCode) AND name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM syscurrentfiles)
		DECLARE @cTable VARCHAR(30)
		DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
		OPEN crCode
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			BEGIN
				SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + @cnCode + CHAR(39) + 
					'  WHERE ' + @cCode + ' = ' + CHAR(39) + @coCode + CHAR(39)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crCode INTO @cTable		
		END
		CLOSE crCode
		DEALLOCATE crCode
	END
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcttt39]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk,
		CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0') ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
		a.t_tien_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_pb_nt, a.t_tien_pb, a.t_tien_pb_nt0, a.t_tien_pb0, a.t_tien_cl_nt, a.t_tien_cl, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2
	FROM cttt39 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN dmkh AS b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesSummaryByThreeCriteria2]--[fs20_SOUnitReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 	
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(48),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(48),
	@PivotBy VARCHAR(48),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(128),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Tunrover, 1 - Net Tunrover, 3 - Discount
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), 
	@DataType CHAR(1), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key VARCHAR(1023), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @sNotDefine NVARCHAR(1024), @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @sNotDefine = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	DECLARE @ct_giam VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @ct_giam = '''HD2'', ''HD4'''
	
	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, loai_ct, nxt, ma_nvbh, ma_dvcs, ma_kho, ma_bp, ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_nt AS ck_tl, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt INTO #temp FROM wrkin a
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt AS reportby, ma_vt AS groupby, ma_vt AS pivotby, tien2 AS tien, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin a
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, *, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS reportby_name INTO #report FROM #tmp
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield_name2 VARCHAR(64), xkey VARCHAR(1024))

	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', '', '', '', '', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'a.ma_vt', 'dmvt', 'ma_vt', 'ten_vt', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'b.nh_vt1', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'b.nh_vt2', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'b.nh_vt3', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'b.nh_vt9', 'dmnhvt2', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '6', 'a.ma_kh', 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '7', 'c.nh_kh1', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '8', 'c.nh_kh2', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '9', 'c.nh_kh3', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '10', 'c.nh_kh9', 'dmnhkh2', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '11', 'a.ma_nvbh', 'dmnvbh', 'ma_nvbh', 'ten_nvbh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '12', 'a.ma_dvcs', 'dmdvcs', 'ma_dvcs', 'ten_dvcs', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '13', 'a.ma_kho', 'dmkho', 'ma_kho', 'ten_kho', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '14', 'a.ma_bp', 'dmbp', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp', ''

	DECLARE @join VARCHAR(1024), @reportTable VARCHAR(64), @reportField VARCHAR(64), @reportFieldName VARCHAR(64), @reportKey VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64), @groupKey VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @pivotTable VARCHAR(64), @pivotField VARCHAR(64), @pivotFieldName VARCHAR(64), @pivotKey VARCHAR(64)
	
	SET @Join = ''
	IF (@ReportBy BETWEEN 2 AND 5) OR (@GroupBy BETWEEN 2 AND 5) OR (@PivotBy BETWEEN 2 AND 5) SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b with (index(pk_dmvt)) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF (@ReportBy BETWEEN 7 AND 10) OR (@GroupBy BETWEEN 7 AND 10) OR (@PivotBy BETWEEN 7 AND 10) SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c with (index(pk_dmkh)) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	
	SELECT @ReportBy = xfield, @reportTable = xtable2, @reportField = xfield2, @reportFieldName = xfield_name2, @reportKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @ReportBy
	SELECT @GroupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield_name2, @groupKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @GroupBy
	SELECT @PivotBy = xfield, @pivotTable = xtable2, @pivotField = xfield2, @pivotFieldName = xfield_name2, @pivotKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @PivotBy

	--@Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nxt, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_kho, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_nt, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien2 end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck_nt end,'
	
	SET @q = @q + 'case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then tien2 else 0 end as giam_gia, case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then tien_nt2 else 0 end as giam_gia_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + 'case when nxt = 1 then tien2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl, case when nxt = 1 then tien_nt2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl_nt, case when nxt = 1 then ck else 0 end as ck_tl, case when nxt = 1 then ck_nt else 0 end as ck_tl_nt'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '''''' ELSE @GroupBy END + ' as groupby, ' + @PivotBy
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien2 - ck - (-giam_gia) - doanh_thu_tl + ck_tl)'
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when (a.ma_nt = '''' or a.ma_nt is null) then 0 else tien_nt2 - ck_nt - (-giam_gia_nt) - doanh_thu_tl_nt + ck_tl_nt end)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #temp a ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' group by ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + @PivotBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #temp WHERE ma_ct IN('HDF', 'HDR') OR (ma_ct IN('HD2', 'HD4') AND loai_ct = 1)
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '''''' ELSE @GroupBy END + ' as groupby, ' + @PivotBy
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'sum(tien2 - (-giam_gia))' ELSE 'sum(ck)' END
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when (a.ma_nt = '''' or a.ma_nt is null) then 0 else ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'tien_nt2 - (-giam_gia_nt)' ELSE 'ck_nt' END + ' end)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #temp a ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' group by ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + @PivotBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, reportby, groupby, pivotby, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(max(b.' + @reportFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), N''' + @sNotDefine + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join ' + @reportTable + ' b on a.reportby = b.' + @reportField + CASE WHEN @reportKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @reportKey END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by reportby, groupby, pivotby'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ISNULL(tien, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(tien_nt, 0) = 0
	UPDATE #report SET reportby = '-' WHERE ISNULL(reportby, '') = ''
	UPDATE #report SET groupby = '-' WHERE ISNULL(groupby, '') = ''
	UPDATE #report SET pivotby = '-' WHERE ISNULL(pivotby, '') = ''

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #o (stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, reportby VARCHAR(33) NOT NULL, groupby VARCHAR(33) NOT NULL)
	INSERT INTO #o SELECT DISTINCT reportby, groupby FROM #report ORDER BY groupby, reportby
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT MIN(stt) AS stt, groupby INTO #o2 FROM #o GROUP BY groupby
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt - ISNULL(c.stt, 0) + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.groupby = b.groupby AND a.reportby = b.reportby JOIN #o2 c ON a.groupby = c.groupby
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.reportby = b.reportby 
	END

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET reportby_name = SPACE(2) + reportby_name
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 3, 0, 1, null, '''', groupby, pivotby, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), isnull(max(b.' + @groupFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), N''' + @sNotDefine + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.groupby = b.' + @groupField + CASE WHEN @groupKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @groupKey END + ' group by pivotby, groupby'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, groupby + reportby + ISNULL(RTRIM(stt), '') AS xkey
			, CASE WHEN reportby = '-' THEN '' ELSE reportby END AS xrow, CASE WHEN groupby = '-' THEN '' ELSE groupby END AS groupby
			, reportby_name AS ten_row, pivotby AS sysColumn, pivotby AS sysColumnName, tien, tien_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY  groupby, reportby, stt
		
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, CAST(pivotby AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY pivotby ORDER BY pivotby
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien' ELSE 'tien_nt' END, @sTotal
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCRTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tien_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @CreditAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CreditAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i41$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m41$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_UnPostBISAClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM bic06$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'bim06$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'bid06$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'bii06$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'bia06$000000'

	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM bia06$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''5'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update bic06$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_PadL](@cpItem VARCHAR(33), @nLen TINYINT)  
RETURNS VARCHAR(33) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)
	SET @cReturn = SPACE(@nLen - LEN(RTRIM(@cpItem))) + RTRIM(@cpItem)
	RETURN ISNULL(@cReturn, '')
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSVTran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@isFC BIT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Code VARCHAR(13), @discount NVARCHAR(256), @discount2 NVARCHAR(256), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @bk_yn BIT
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_vt2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail INTO #report FROM d81$000000

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT, @descriptGoodsType NVARCHAR(4000), @descriptGoodsType2 NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_nt VARCHAR(32), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @fAmount NVARCHAR(256), @fAmountFC NVARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
		SELECT @fAmount = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @fAmountFC = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @strSQL = 'select @ma_nt = a.ma_nt from ' + REPLACE(dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable), 'd81$', 'm81$') + ' a where ' + @cDetailKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@ma_nt varchar(32) output', @ma_nt OUTPUT
		SELECT TOP 1 @descriptGoodsType = REPLACE(a.dien_giai, '#dv_tien_giam#', SPACE(1) + b.ra_2), @descriptGoodsType2 = REPLACE(a.dien_giai2, '#dv_tien_giam#', SPACE(1) + b.ra_22) FROM dmloaihh a CROSS JOIN dmnt b WHERE a.loai = '90' AND b.ma_nt = CASE WHEN @isFC = 0 THEN @m_ma_nt0 WHEN @isFC = 1 THEN @ma_nt ELSE '' END
		SELECT @strSQL = 'select top 0 loai from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable)
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#report', @strSQL
	END

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'INSERT INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' SELECT a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', CAST(g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_vt, g.ten_vt2'
	ELSE SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' -- song ngữ
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	IF @isGoodsType = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', a.loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	-- Hiển thị thêm diễn giải cho hàng khuyến mãi
	DECLARE @promotion1 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion12 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion2 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion22 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion3 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion32 NVARCHAR(256)

	SELECT @promotion1 = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 OR @cLan = 'V' THEN title11 ELSE title112 END, @promotion12 = title112
			, @promotion2 = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 OR @cLan = 'V' THEN title12 ELSE title122 END, @promotion22 = title122
			, @promotion3 = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 OR @cLan = 'V' THEN title13 ELSE title132 END, @promotion32 = title132
		FROM v30dmsnk15 WHERE ma_snk = 'ZZHDA'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion1, ten_vt2 = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion12 WHERE km_yn = 1'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion2, ten_vt2 = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion22 WHERE km_yn = 2'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion3, ten_vt2 = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion32 WHERE km_yn = 3'

	-- Hiển thị mã hàng trên mẫu in hóa đơn bán hàng
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_vt_ar_yn' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = RTRIM(ma_vt) + '' - '' + ten_vt'
	END
	IF @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + '
declare @row int
select @row = max(line_nbr) + 1 from #report
select stt_rec, ' + CASE WHEN @isFC = 0 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sum(tien2), @fAmount)' WHEN @isFC = 1 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sum(tien_nt2), @fAmountFC)' ELSE '0' END + ' as tien_giam, max(line_nbr) as line_nbr into #tmp from #report where loai = ''90'' group by stt_rec
delete #report where loai = ''90''
insert into #report (stt_rec, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, line_nbr) select stt_rec, '''', replace(@descriptGoodsType' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN @cE ELSE '' END + ', ''#so_tien_giam#'', tien_giam), replace(@descriptGoodsType2, ''#so_tien_giam#'', tien_giam), @row from #tmp
exec dbo.FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField ''stt_rec'', ''line_nbr'', ''#report'', ''line_nbr'', ''''
'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		, N'@promotion1 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion12 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion2 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion22 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion3 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion32 NVARCHAR(256), @descriptGoodsType nvarchar(4000), @descriptGoodsType2 nvarchar(4000), @fAmount varchar(256), @fAmountFC varchar(256)'
		, @promotion1, @promotion12, @promotion2, @promotion22, @promotion3, @promotion32, @descriptGoodsType, @descriptGoodsType2, @fAmount, @fAmountFC

	SELECT TOP 1 @Code = stt_rec, @bk_yn = 0 FROM #report
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_in_bk_yn' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @Code AND so_bk <> '' AND ngay_bk IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			DECLARE @listNo VARCHAR(32), @listDate SMALLDATETIME, @amount NUMERIC(28, 6), @amountFC NUMERIC(28, 6), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @detail2 NVARCHAR(4000)
			SELECT @bk_yn = 1
			SELECT @detail = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 OR @cLan = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'
			SELECT @detail2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'

	  		SELECT @listNo = so_bk, @listDate = ngay_bk FROM v01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @Code
			--SELECT @amountFC = SUM(tien_nt2), @amount = SUM(tien2) FROM #report

			DELETE #report
			--
			SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, ten_vt, ten_vt2, detail)'
			SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + 'select '''', 1, '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, t_tien_nt2, 0, t_tien2, a.ten_vtthue, a.ten_vtthue, '''''
			SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(REPLACE(@cDTable, 'd81$', 'm81$')) + ' a'
			SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL --, N'@amountFC NUMERIC(28, 6), @amount NUMERIC(28, 6)', @amountFC = @amountFC, @amount = @amount
			--

			INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, ten_vt, ten_vt2, detail)
				SELECT '', 2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 
					REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@detail, '%n', RTRIM(@listNo)), '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@listDate),2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@listDate),2),' ','0')), '%y', RTRIM(YEAR(@listDate))),
					REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@detail2, '%n', RTRIM(@listNo)), '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@listDate),2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@listDate),2),' ','0')), '%y', RTRIM(YEAR(@listDate))), ''''
		END
	END
	
	--Them dong tien chiet khau
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_006' AND val = '1') AND @bk_yn = 0  BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = 'select @discountOut = ghi_chuthue, @tienOut = t_ck, @tien_ntOut = t_ck_nt from ' + REPLACE(@cDTable, 'd81', 'm81') + ' a where ' + @cDetailKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL, N'@discountOut nvarchar(256) output, @tienOut numeric(28, 6) output, @tien_ntOut numeric(28, 6) output', @discount OUTPUT, @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
		SELECT @discount2 = @discount
		IF @discount = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @discount = CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 OR @cLan = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'
			SELECT @discount2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'
		END
		
		IF @tien <> 0 OR @tien_nt <> 0
			INSERT #report (stt_rec, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, km_yn, line_nbr, tien2, tien_nt2, detail) SELECT MAX(stt_rec), '', REPLACE(@discount, '''', ''''''), REPLACE(@discount2, '''', ''''''), 0, MAX(line_nbr) + 1, @tien, @tien_nt, '' FROM #report
	END

	EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher '#report', 11, @cVoucher, 'ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', '', 'line_nbr'

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptVCNoChecking]
	@checking1 SMALLDATETIME, 
	@checking2 SMALLDATETIME, 
	@issuing1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@issuing2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@effFrom1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@effFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@effTo1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@effTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherBook VARCHAR(1023), 
	@unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@type TINYINT = 0 -- 0 - Tax, 1 - Ledger, 2 - Inventory
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @r NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @k NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @c VARCHAR(33)

	-- Unit Key
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin), @key = '', @k = ''

	IF @voucherBook <> '' SELECT @key = ' and b.ma_nk in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherBook, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @issuing1 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_ph >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @issuing1, 112) + ''''
	IF @issuing2 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_ph <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @issuing2, 112) + ''''
	IF @effFrom1 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_hl_tu >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @effFrom1, 112) + ''''
	IF @effFrom2 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_hl_tu <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @effFrom2, 112) + ''''
	IF @effTo1 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_hl_den >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @effTo1, 112) + ''''
	IF @effTo2 IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and b.ngay_hl_den <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @effTo2, 112) + ''''

	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and (b.ma_dvcs = '''' or ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'a.', 'b.') + ')'
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS loai, stt_rec, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_ct, CAST(0 AS INT) AS iso_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS chuoi_so, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS dinh_dang INTO #ps FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS loai, ma_nk, iso_ct AS so_tu, iso_ct AS so_den, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS so_ct1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS so_ct2, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #ct FROM #ps
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_nk, ten_nk, ten_nk2, ky_hieu, ngay_ph, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, so_ct1, so_ct2, so_ct0, 
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS so_gd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS so_trung, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS so_ngoai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS so_sai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS so_hl
		INTO #report FROM v20dmnk
	
	-- Data
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @unitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @unitKey ELSE '' END + @key
	SELECT @k = '(not exists (select 1 from #ps c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec))' + @key 
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key), @k = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k)

	SELECT @r = 'insert into #ps(loai, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_ct) select 1, a.stt_rec, max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.ma_nk), max(a.so_ct)' + 
		' from $%table%Partition a with(nolock) join v20dmnk b with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk  where %[' + @k + ']% group by a.stt_rec'
	
	IF @type = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '$%table', 'r20$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @checking1, @checking2, @userID, @admin
	END

	IF @type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '$%table', 'r00$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @checking1, @checking2, @userID, @admin
	END

	IF @type = 2 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '$%table', 'r90$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @checking1, @checking2, @userID, @admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k0 NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k0 OUTPUT, 0, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k0, '%a', 'a')

		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '$%table', 'r70$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @checking1, @checking1, @userID, @admin
	END

	-- Cancelled Invoice
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, tu_so AS so_tu, den_so AS so_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #huy FROM cthd1
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #huy(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den) select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, c.ma_nk, c.tu_so, c.den_so' + 
		' from phhd1 a with(nolock) join cthd1 c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec join v20dmnk b with(nolock) on c.ma_nk = b.ma_nk' + 
		' where a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @checking1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @checking2, 112) + '''' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Lost Invoice
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, tu_so AS so_tu, den_so AS so_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #mat FROM cthd
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #mat(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den) select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, c.ma_nk, c.tu_so, c.den_so' + 
		' from phhd a with(nolock) join cthd c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec join v20dmnk b with(nolock) on c.ma_nk = b.ma_nk' + 
		' where a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @checking1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @checking2, 112) + '''' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	DECLARE @vnFormat CHAR(1)
	SELECT @vnFormat = CHAR(255)
	SELECT a.ma_nk, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, b.so_ct1, b.so_ct2, b.so_ct0, dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(b.so_ct1, '') AS r_so_ct1, CAST(0 AS INT) AS r_len, 
			dbo.FastBusiness$VoucherNumberStruct(b.so_ct1, '', @vnFormat) AS dinh_dang, CAST(0 AS INT) AS iso_ct1, CAST(dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(b.so_ct2, '') AS INT) AS iso_ct2,
			ten_nk, ten_nk2, ky_hieu, ngay_ph
		INTO #nk FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_nk FROM #ps) a JOIN v20dmnk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
	UPDATE #nk SET iso_ct1 = CAST(r_so_ct1 AS INT), r_len = LEN(r_so_ct1)

	UPDATE #ps SET @c = dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(a.so_ct, b.so_ct1), iso_ct = CAST(@c AS INT), chuoi_so = @c, dinh_dang = dbo.FastBusiness$VoucherNumberStruct(a.so_ct, b.so_ct1, @vnFormat) FROM #ps a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ps(ma_nk)


	--  Interruption (Except Invalid Format)
	SELECT a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct AS so_tu, a.iso_ct AS so_den INTO #sd FROM #ps a JOIN #nk b ON a.iso_ct BETWEEN b.iso_ct1 AND b.iso_ct2 AND a.dinh_dang = b.dinh_dang GROUP BY a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct
	INSERT INTO #sd SELECT ma_nk, so_tu, so_den FROM #huy
	INSERT INTO #sd SELECT ma_nk, so_tu, so_den FROM #mat

	-- + Merge
	DECLARE @l1 INT, @l2 INT, @k1 VARCHAR(33), @k2 VARCHAR(33), @x1 INT, @x2 INT, @y1 INT, @y2 INT, @e1 VARCHAR(33), @f1 VARCHAR(33), @f2 VARCHAR(33), @i INT, @m INT, @f bit, @s VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT TOP 0 *, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #sdm FROM #sd
	SELECT ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #segsd FROM #sd ORDER BY ma_nk, so_tu, so_den
	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(stt), @f = 1 FROM #segsd
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		IF @f = 1 SELECT @k1 = ma_nk, @x1 = so_tu, @y1 = so_den FROM #segsd WHERE stt = @i
		IF @i < @m SELECT @k2 = ma_nk, @x2 = so_tu, @y2 = so_den FROM #segsd WHERE stt = @i + 1

		IF @k1 <> @k2 OR @i = @m OR @y1 + 1 < @x2 BEGIN
			SELECT @f = 1
			INSERT INTO #sdm(ma_nk, so_tu, so_den) SELECT @k1, @x1, @y1
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @y2 > @y1 SELECT @y1 = @y2
			SELECT @f = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den) 
		SELECT 1, a.ma_nk, a.so_den + 1 AS so_tu, b.so_tu - 1 AS so_den
			FROM #sdm a JOIN #sdm b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.stt = b.stt - 1
	
	UPDATE #ct SET so_ct1 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, CASE WHEN LEN(so_tu) < b.r_len THEN REPLACE(STR(so_tu, b.r_len), ' ', '0') ELSE LTRIM(so_tu) END),
			so_ct2 = REPLACE(b.dinh_dang, @vnFormat, CASE WHEN LEN(so_den) < b.r_len THEN REPLACE(STR(so_den, b.r_len), ' ', '0') ELSE LTRIM(so_den) END)
		FROM #ct a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk
		WHERE a.loai = 1

	-- Duplicate
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT 2, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, LTRIM(a.so_ct), LTRIM(a.so_ct)
		FROM (SELECT ma_nk, so_ct, COUNT(*) AS so_luong, MAX(iso_ct) AS iso_ct FROM #ps GROUP BY ma_nk, so_ct) a 
		WHERE a.so_luong > 1

	-- + Join between arised and cancelled table
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT 2, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct
		FROM #ps a JOIN #huy b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.iso_ct BETWEEN b.so_tu AND b.so_den
	
	-- + Join between arised and lost table
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT 2, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct
		FROM #ps a JOIN #mat b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.iso_ct BETWEEN b.so_tu AND b.so_den

	-- Out of Range
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT DISTINCT 3, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, LTRIM(a.so_ct), LTRIM(a.so_ct)
		FROM #ps a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND (a.iso_ct < b.iso_ct1 OR a.iso_ct > b.iso_ct2)

	-- Invalid Format
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT DISTINCT 4, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, LTRIM(a.so_ct), LTRIM(a.so_ct)
		FROM #ps a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk AND a.dinh_dang <> b.dinh_dang

	-- Expired
	INSERT INTO #ct(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2) SELECT DISTINCT 5, a.ma_nk, a.iso_ct, a.iso_ct, LTRIM(a.so_ct), LTRIM(a.so_ct)
		FROM #ps a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk 
		WHERE (b.ngay_hl_tu IS NOT NULL AND a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_hl_tu) OR (b.ngay_hl_den IS NOT NULL AND a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_hl_den)

	-- Merge Result
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ctm FROM #ct
	SELECT loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #seg FROM #ct ORDER BY loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den

	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(stt), @f = 1, @s = '' FROM #seg
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		IF @f = 1 SELECT @l1 = loai, @k1 = ma_nk, @x1 = so_tu, @y1 = so_den, @e1 = so_ct1, @f1 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i
		IF @i < @m SELECT @l2 = loai, @k2 = ma_nk, @x2 = so_tu, @y2 = so_den, @f2 = so_ct2 FROM #seg WHERE stt = @i + 1

		IF @l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @i = @m OR @y1 + 1 < @x2 BEGIN
			SELECT @f = 1, @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(LTRIM(@e1)) + CASE WHEN @x1 <> @y1 THEN ' - ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@f1)) ELSE '' END 
			INSERT INTO #ctm(loai, ma_nk, so_tu, so_den, so_ct1, so_ct2)
				SELECT @l1, @k1, @x1, @y1, @e1, @f1

			IF @l1 <> @l2 OR @k1 <> @k2 OR @i = @m BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nk, so_gd, so_trung, so_ngoai, so_sai, so_hl) SELECT 5, 1, 1, @k1,
					CASE WHEN @l1 = 1 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 2 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 3 THEN @s ELSE '' END, 
					CASE WHEN @l1 = 4 THEN @s ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @l1 = 5 THEN @s ELSE '' END
				SELECT @s = ''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @y2 > @y1 SELECT @y1 = @y2, @f1 = @f2
			SELECT @f = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT ma_nk, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_nk
	SELECT MAX(o.stt) AS stt, a.ma_nk, MAX(b.ten_nk) AS ten_nk, MAX(b.ten_nk2) AS ten_nk2, 
			MAX(b.ky_hieu) AS ky_hieu, MAX(b.ngay_ph) AS ngay_ph, MAX(b.ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu, MAX(b.ngay_hl_den) AS ngay_hl_den,
			MAX(b.so_ct1) AS so_ct1, MAX(b.so_ct2) AS so_ct2, MAX(b.so_ct0) AS so_ct0,
			MAX(ISNULL(a.so_gd, '')) AS so_gd, MAX(ISNULL(a.so_trung, '')) AS so_trung, MAX(ISNULL(a.so_ngoai, '')) AS so_ngoai, 
			MAX(ISNULL(a.so_sai, '')) AS so_sai, MAX(ISNULL(a.so_hl, '')) AS so_hl
		FROM #report a JOIN #nk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk JOIN #o o ON a.ma_nk = o.ma_nk
		GROUP BY a.ma_nk
		ORDER BY MAX(o.stt)

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintTMCourseResult]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @okResult NVARCHAR(63), @notResult NVARCHAR(63)

	IF @cLan = 'V' SELECT @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = '2'
	SELECT @okResult = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM036'
	SELECT @notResult = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM037'

	-- Filter
	SELECT @strSQL =  'select a.line_nbr as stt, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_nv, b.ma_nv, b.ten, a.diem, b.ten_bp' + @cE + ' as bo_phan, b.ten_vtr' + @cE + ' as vi_tri, c.ten_loai' + @cE + ' as xep_loai'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ', case a.dat_yn when ''1'' then N''' + @okResult + ''' else N''' + @okResult + ''' end as ket_qua'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from hrdtctkq a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join vhrnv b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join hrdmxldt c with(nolock) on a.xep_loai = c.ma_loai'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten'','''', ''stt'''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by stt'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	--
	SET NOCOUNT ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbigia0dc]
AS
	SELECT a.*, ISNULL('#' + RTRIM(d.id) + '#', '') AS id_dvcs, ISNULL('#' + RTRIM(e.id) + '#', '') AS id_bp, ISNULL('#' + RTRIM(f.id) + '#', '') AS id_nh, ISNULL('#' + RTRIM(g.id) + '#', '') AS id_vung,
			b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2
		FROM dbo.bigia0dc a			
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmdvcs d ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs
			LEFT JOIN dbo.bidmbp0 e ON a.ma_bp0 = e.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dbo.bidmnhom0 f ON a.ma_nh0 = f.ma_nh
			LEFT JOIN dbo.bidmvung g ON a.ma_vung = g.ma_vung

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vctkieuduyet]
AS
	SELECT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(b.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2, ISNULL(c.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh1, ISNULL(c.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh12, ISNULL(d.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh2, ISNULL(d.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh22
		, ISNULL(e.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh3, ISNULL(e.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh32
		, ISNULL(f.ten_md, '') AS ten_md, ISNULL(f.ten_md2, '') AS ten_md2
		, ISNULL(k.ten_dvcs, '') AS ten_dvcs, ISNULL(k.ten_dvcs2, '') AS ten_dvcs2
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_bp0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_bp02
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_nh0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_nh02
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vung, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vung2
		FROM dbo.ctkieuduyet a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh c ON a.nh_kh1 = c.ma_nh AND c.loai_nh = '1'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh d ON a.nh_kh2 = d.ma_nh AND d.loai_nh = '2'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh e ON a.nh_kh3 = e.ma_nh AND e.loai_nh = '3'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmmd f ON a.ma_md = f.ma_md AND f.ma_ct = 'PR1'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkieuduyet g ON a.loai_duyet = g.loai_duyet and a.ma_kieu = g.ma_kieu
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmdvcs k ON a.dvcs = k.ma_dvcs

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_FXCalDisByDay]
	@Cycle NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@UserID INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- 1. Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_dc_pb_ky0 VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @CycleFrom INT, @CycleTo INT, @Round INT, @FCRound INT, @BaseCurrency CHAR(3)

	--2. Set
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Cycle, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Cycle, @Year), @CycleFrom = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@DateFrom), @CycleTo = dbo.ff_GetCycles(@DateTo)
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @FCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cc_pb_ky0'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, 0, 'New')
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	-- 3. Create template file
	-- ++ #dmcc
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky_kh0, ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ngay_kh_kt, so_ky_kh, ngay_hong
		INTO #dmcc FROM dmcc
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmcc(so_the_ts)

	SET @q = 'insert into #dmcc select so_the_ts, ngay_giam, ngay_kh0, dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_kh0), ngay_kh1, ngay_mua, tk_kh, tk_ts, tk_cp, ma_bp, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tong_sl, kieu_kh, ngay_kh_kt, so_ky_kh, ngay_hong'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmcc where ((ngay_giam is null) or (''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' <= ngay_giam))'
	IF ISNULL(@UnitKey, '') <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #dmcc SET ngay_kh_kt = DATEADD(MONTH, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0) - 1 WHERE ngay_kh_kt IS NULL AND kieu_kh = '0'
	END

	-- ++ #ctkhcc
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv INTO #ctkhcc FROM ctkhcc a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE a.ky = @Cycle AND a.nam = @Year AND a.sua_kh = 1

	-- ++ #tctdmcc
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc
		FROM ctdmcc a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE b.ky_kh0 <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmcc(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	-- ++ #tctdmcc_ex
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc_ex
		FROM ctdmcc a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE b.ky_kh0 > @CycleTo AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctkhcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts and ma_nv = a.ma_nv)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tctdmcc_ex(so_the_ts, ma_nv)

	INSERT INTO #tctdmcc SELECT * FROM #tctdmcc_ex a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tctdmcc WHERE so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts AND ma_nv = a.ma_nv)

	-- ++ #tctdmcc1
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, c.loai_tg_ts, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_cl, a.gt_kh_ky, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #tctdmcc1
		FROM ctdmcc1 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmtgcc c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_mua) <= @CycleFrom AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ctkhcc c WHERE a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv AND c.ky = @Cycle AND nam = @Year AND sua_kh = 1) AND a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @CycleFrom

	UPDATE #tctdmcc1 SET gt_kh_ky = a.gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt = a.gt_kh_ky_nt FROM #tctdmcc1 a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.kieu_kh <> 1
	UPDATE #tctdmcc1 SET nguyen_gia = -nguyen_gia, gt_cl = -gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = -gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt = -nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl_nt = -gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = -gt_kh_ky_nt WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2

	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #temp FROM #tctdmcc
	INSERT INTO #temp SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, 0, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, nguyen_gia_nt, 0, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt FROM #tctdmcc1

	SELECT a.so_the_ts, ma_nv, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt,
		MAX(b.ngay_kh0) AS ngay_kh0, ISNULL(MAX(b.ngay_kh1), @DateTo + 1) AS ngay_kh1, @DateTo AS ngay_kh2, ISNULL(MAX(b.ngay_giam), @DateTo + 1) AS ngay_giam, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2, 0)) AS so_ng_kh1
	INTO #tctdmcc2 FROM #temp a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv

	UPDATE #tctdmcc2 SET so_ng_kh1 = dbo.ff_GetDayDepreciation(@DateFrom, @DateTo, ngay_kh0, ngay_kh2, ngay_kh1, ngay_giam)
	UPDATE #tctdmcc2 SET gt_kh_ky = ROUND(a.gt_kh_ky * (a.so_ng_kh1 / DAY(@DateTo)), @Round), gt_kh_ky_nt = ROUND(a.gt_kh_ky_nt * (a.so_ng_kh1 / DAY(@DateTo)), @FCRound)
		FROM #tctdmcc2 a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.kieu_kh <> 1

	UPDATE #tctdmcc2 SET gt_kh_ky = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0
		FROM #tctdmcc2 a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			WHERE b.kieu_kh = 1 AND ((b.ky_kh0 = @CycleFrom AND (b.ngay_kh0 >= b.ngay_kh1 OR b.ngay_kh0 >= b.ngay_giam)) or (dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh_kt) = @CycleFrom AND (b.ngay_kh_kt >= b.ngay_kh1 OR  b.ngay_kh_kt >= b.ngay_giam)))

	SELECT a.*, b.tk_kh, b.tk_ts, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.tien_cl, b.tien_cl_nt, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.kieu_kh, b.ngay_hong INTO #tFxDepr FROM #tctdmcc2 a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(tk_kh) AS tk_kh, MAX(tk_ts) AS tk_ts, MAX(tk_cp) AS tk_cp, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
		INTO #tctbpcc
		FROM cthscc WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 20) IN
				(SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 20) FROM cthscc WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @Year * 12 + @Cycle GROUP BY so_the_ts)
				AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmcc)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts
		
	UPDATE #tFxDepr SET tk_kh = b.tk_kh, tk_ts = b.tk_ts, tk_cp = b.tk_cp, ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #tFxDepr a JOIN #tctbpcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- 4. Delete
	DELETE ctkhcc WHERE ky = @Cycle AND nam = @Year AND sua_kh = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmcc)

	-- 5. Calc
	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_nv, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_tang_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, kieu_kh, ngay_hong INTO #r
		FROM #tFxDepr

	UPDATE #r SET gt_kh_ky = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 FROM #r a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
			WHERE b.kieu_kh = 1 AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh0) < @CycleFrom AND @CycleFrom <> dbo.ff_GetCycles(CASE WHEN b.ngay_hong <= b.ngay_kh_kt THEN b.ngay_hong ELSE b.ngay_kh_kt END)

	-- Acc. Depreciation Value
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r a JOIN ctkhcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @Year * 12 + @Cycle - 1)
		UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #r a JOIN ctkhcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv WHERE b.nam * 12 + b.ky = @Year * 12 + @Cycle - 1
	ELSE UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt FROM #r a JOIN #tctdmcc2 b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	-- Add depreciated value on adj. table
	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + b.gt_da_kh_dc, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + b.gt_da_kh_dc_nt FROM #r a
		JOIN (SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, SUM(a.gt_da_kh * CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc, SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt * CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS gt_da_kh_dc_nt
				FROM ctdmcc1 a JOIN dmtgcc b ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts WHERE a.nam = @Year AND a.ky = @Cycle GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv
			) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_kh_ky, gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_kh_ky_nt
	UPDATE #r SET gt_cl = nguyen_gia - gt_da_kh, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - gt_da_kh_nt
