	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh = gt_da_kh + gt_cl, gt_kh_ky = gt_kh_ky + gt_cl, gt_cl = 0 WHERE gt_cl <= tien_cl
	UPDATE #r SET gt_da_kh_nt = gt_da_kh_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt = gt_kh_ky_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE gt_cl_nt <= tien_cl_nt

	IF @ma_dc_pb_ky0 = '1'
		UPDATE #r SET gt_kh_ky = a.gt_kh_ky + a.gt_cl, gt_kh_ky_nt = a.gt_kh_ky_nt + a.gt_cl_nt, gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_da_kh = a.nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt
			FROM #r a JOIN #dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.kieu_kh = '0' AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(b.ngay_kh_kt) = @CycleTo AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_kh1 OR b.ngay_kh1 IS NULL) AND (b.ngay_kh_kt < b.ngay_giam OR b.ngay_giam IS NULL)

	UPDATE #r SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_tang_nt = 0, gt_giam_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency

	-- Insert
	INSERT INTO ctkhcc(so_the_ts, sua_kh, ma_nv, ky, nam, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
		ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT so_the_ts, 0, ma_nv, @Cycle, @Year, ma_bp, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_tang_nt, gt_giam_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
		FROM #r

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptSIHIDeclarationAndChangeLaborInformationExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@TypeReport TINYINT, -- 1 - Mẫu tham gia mới, 2 - Mẫu thay đổi thông tin, 3 - Mẫu thay đổi thông tin 595, 4 - Mẫu tham gia mới 595, 5 - Mẫu thay đổi thông tin 888, 6 - Mẫu tham gia mới 888, 7 -- Mẫu thay đổi thông tin 505
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @Male NVARCHAR(256), @FeMale NVARCHAR(256)

	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @FeMale = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	
	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #$keys (text NTEXT)
		INSERT INTO #$keys SELECT @IDNumbers
	END

	-- IDNumber
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	DECLARE @l INT, @size INT, @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @size = COL_LENGTH('hrnv', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @i = 1, @l = DATALENGTH(text)/2 FROM #$keys
	WHILE @i + @size <= @l + 1 BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #stt_rec SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(text, @i, @size), '''', '') FROM #$keys
		  SELECT @i = @i + @size + 1
	END

	-- Cập nhật thay đổi thông tin
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_hl, tn_bhxhtn, pt_bhxhtn, ma_kcb, noi_dung_khac, ho_so_gk, td_ho_ten, td_gioi_tinh, td_ngay_sinh, td_noi_ks, td_cmns_hc INTO #hrbhtdtt FROM hrbhtdtt
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_hl INTO #hrbhtdtt0 FROM hrbhtdtt
	--
	INSERT INTO #hrbhtdtt SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_hl, a.tn_bhxhtn, a.pt_bhxhtn, a.ma_kcb, a.noi_dung_khac, a.ho_so_gk, a.td_ho_ten, a.td_gioi_tinh, a.td_ngay_sinh, a.td_noi_ks, a.td_cmns_hc FROM hrbhtdtt a WHERE a.ngay_hl <= @ReportDate AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt_rec b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	INSERT INTO #hrbhtdtt0 SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_hl) FROM #hrbhtdtt GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #hrbhtdtt FROM #hrbhtdtt a LEFT JOIN #hrbhtdtt0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ', c.si_no as so_bhxh' -- [02]
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(e.ten_kcb%l, '''') as ten_kcb' -- [12]
	SET @q = @q + ', c.ma_so_hgd as ma_hgd' -- [10]
	--
	IF @TypeReport IN ('1', '4', '6') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(a.email_cty) as email_cty' --[08]
		SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv as ho_va_ten_nv' --[01]
		SET @q = @q + ', '''' as noi_dung_khac' -- [13]
		SET @q = @q + ', case when a.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + @Male + ''' else N''' + @FeMale + ''' end as gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh, isnull(b.ten_qt%l, '''') as quoc_tich' -- [03], [04], [05]
		IF @TypeReport = '6' -- [09]/[14]
			SET @q = @q + ', '''' as ma_bhxh, '''' as ho_so_gk, '''' as ho_va_ten_nv2, null as ngay_sinh2'
		ELSE 
			SET @q = @q + ', c.ma_so_bhxh as ma_bhxh, isnull(d.ho_so_gk, '''') as ho_so_gk' -- [14]

		IF @TypeReport = '1' -- [06.1]
			SET @q = @q + ', a.que_quan_phuong'
		ELSE 
			SET @q = @q + ', isnull(g4.ten_phuong%l, '''') as que_quan_phuong'
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(g3.ten_quan%l, '''') as que_quan_quan'  -- [06.2]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(h3.ten_tinh%l, '''') as que_quan_tinh'  -- [06.3]	
		SET @q = @q + ', a.cmnd_so' -- [07]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_th_tru_so' -- [08.1]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_th_tru_phuong' -- [08.2]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(g.ten_quan%l, '''') as dia_chi_th_tru_quan' -- [08.3]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(h.ten_tinh%l, '''') as dia_chi_th_tru_tinh' -- [08.4]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_ht_so' -- [09.1]
		IF @TypeReport = '1' -- [09.2]
			SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_ht_phuong'
		ELSE 
			SET @q = @q + ', isnull(g5.ten_phuong%l, '''') as dia_chi_ht_phuong'
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(g2.ten_quan%l, '''') as dia_chi_ht_quan' -- [09.3]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(h2.ten_tinh%l, '''') as dia_chi_ht_tinh' -- [09.4]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(d.tn_bhxhtn, 0) as tn_bhxhtn' -- [10]
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(d.pt_bhxhtn, '''') as pt_bhxhtn' -- [11]
		/* 595 */
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'i.ten_dt' ELSE 'i.ten_dt2' END + ' as dan_toc' -- [05]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.giam_ho' -- [08]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dien_thoai_dd' -- [09.1]
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ho_chieu_so'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @TypeReport = '5'
			SET @q = @q + ', '''' as ho_va_ten_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv as ho_va_ten_nv2, a.ngay_sinh as ngay_sinh2'
		ELSE
			SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv as ho_va_ten_nv'
		IF (@TypeReport = '7') BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ', isnull(d.tn_bhxhtn, 0) as tn_bhxhtn, isnull(d.pt_bhxhtn, '''') as pt_bhxhtn'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_ho_ten = 1 then rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv  else '''' end as ho_va_ten_nv3, case when d.td_ngay_sinh = 1 then a.ngay_sinh else null end as ngay_sinh3, case when d.td_gioi_tinh = 1 then case when a.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + @Male + ''' else N''' + @FeMale + ''' end else '''' end as gioi_tinh3' --505
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then isnull(g4.ten_phuong%l, '''') else '''' end as que_quan_phuong3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then isnull(g3.ten_quan%l, '''') else '''' end as que_quan_quan3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then isnull(h3.ten_tinh%l, '''') else '''' end as que_quan_tinh3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then a.dia_chi_th_tru_phuong else '''' end as dia_chi_th_tru_phuong3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then isnull(g.ten_quan%l, '''') else '''' end as dia_chi_th_tru_quan3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_noi_ks = 1 then isnull(h.ten_tinh%l, '''') else '''' end as dia_chi_th_tru_tinh3'
			SET @q = @q + ', case when d.td_cmns_hc = 1 then case when isnull(a.cmnd_so, '''') <> '''' then a.cmnd_so else a.ho_chieu_so end else '''' end as cmnd_so3'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ', 0 as tn_bhxhtn, '''' as pt_bhxhtn'
		END
		SET @q = @q + ', c.ma_so_bhxh as ma_bhxh' -- [09]
		SET @q = @q + ', d.noi_dung_khac' -- [13]
		SET @q = @q + ', '''' as gioi_tinh, null as ngay_sinh, '''' as quoc_tich, '''' as que_quan_phuong, '''' as que_quan_quan, '''' as que_quan_tinh, '''' as cmnd_so, '''' as dia_chi_th_tru_so, '''' as dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, '''' as dia_chi_th_tru_quan, '''' as dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, '''' as dia_chi_ht_so, '''' as dia_chi_ht_phuong, '''' as dia_chi_ht_quan, '''' as dia_chi_ht_tinh'
		/* 595 */
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @TypeReport IN (3, 5, 7) THEN 'isnull(d.ho_so_gk, '''')' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ho_so_gk' -- [14]
		SET @q = @q + ', '''' as dan_toc, '''' as giam_ho, '''' as dien_thoai_dd'
	END
	--
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(''' + STR(DAY(@ReportDate), 2)+ ''', '' '', ''0'') as ngay_bc, replace(''' + STR(MONTH(@ReportDate), 2) + ''', '' '', ''0'') as thang_bc, ''' + RTRIM(YEAR(@ReportDate)) + ''' as nam_bc'
	--
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrttbh c with(nolock) on c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join #hrbhtdtt d with(nolock) on d.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	--
	IF @TypeReport IN ('1', '4', '6', '7') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' left join dmqt b with(nolock) on b.ma_qt = a.quoc_tich'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g with(nolock) on g.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan and g.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h with(nolock) on h.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g2 with(nolock) on g2.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_ht_quan and g2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h2 with(nolock) on h2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g3 with(nolock) on g3.ma_quan = a.que_quan_quan and g3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h3 with(nolock) on h3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrttbh f with(nolock) on f.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmkcb e with(nolock) on e.ma_kcb = f.noi_kham'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmdt i with(nolock) on a.dan_toc = i.ma_dt'
		IF @TypeReport IN ('4', '6', '7') BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmphuong g4 with(nolock) on g4.ma_phuong = a.que_quan_xa and g4.ma_quan = a.que_quan_quan and g4.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
			SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmphuong g5 with(nolock) on g5.ma_phuong = a.dia_chi_ht_xa and g5.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_ht_quan and g5.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmkcb e with(nolock) on e.ma_kcb = d.ma_kcb'
	END
	--
	SET @q = @q + ' where exists(select 1 from #stt_rec f where a.stt_rec = f.stt_rec) '
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_nv'

	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesAnalysis2] -- fs20_SOSalesAnalysis
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePrevPeriod AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee AS VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@GroupBy AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @Obsolete BIT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 VARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT
	DECLARE @DateStart SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @ct_giam VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @ct_giam = '''HD2'', ''HD4'''

	SELECT @DateStart = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom)
	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Obsolete = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_nt, loai_ct
			, sl_xuat AS so_luong
			, tien2 AS tien2
			, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2, ck AS ck, ck_nt AS ck_nt
			, tien_xuat AS tien, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, tien2 AS lai, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt

			, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_nt AS ck_tl, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt
			, tien_nhap AS tien_von_tl, tien_nt_n AS tien_von_tl_nt
		INTO #temp_kt FROM wrkin
	SELECT * INTO #temp_kn FROM #temp_kt
	SELECT * INTO #temp_lk FROM #temp_kt

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.tk_vt <> ''''', @Join = '', @Key2 = ''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key2 = ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	END

	SET @q = 'select a.ma_ct, a.ma_vt, ma_nt, a.loai_ct, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.sl_xuat end as so_luong'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien2 end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck end, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_xuat end as tien, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_nt_x end as tien_nt, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap as so_luong_tl, case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then (tien2) else 0 end as giam_gia, case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then (tien_nt2) else 0 end as giam_gia_nt, case when nxt = 1 then tien2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl, case when nxt = 1 then tien_nt2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl_nt, case when nxt = 1 then ck else 0 end AS ck_tl, case when nxt = 1 then ck_nt else 0 end as ck_tl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when nxt = 1 then tien_nhap else 0 end as tien_von_tl, case when nxt = 1 then tien_nt_n else 0 end as tien_von_tl_nt'

	-- Ky nay
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kn ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kn ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Ky truoc
	SET @DateFrom = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @DateFrom)
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kt ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePrevPeriod, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kt ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePrevPeriod, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_lk ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_lk ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--
	INSERT INTO #temp_lk SELECT * FROM #temp_kn

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_nt, loai_ct
		, sl_xuat AS so_luong_kt, sl_xuat AS so_luong_kn, sl_xuat AS so_luong_lk
		, tien2 AS tien2_kt, tien2 AS tien2_kn, tien2 AS tien2_lk, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2_kt, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2_kn, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2_lk
		, ck AS ck_kt, ck AS ck_kn, ck AS ck_lk, ck_nt AS ck_nt_kt, ck_nt AS ck_nt_kn, ck_nt AS ck_nt_lk

		, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl_kt, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl_kn, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl_lk
		, tien2 AS giam_gia_kt, tien2 AS giam_gia_kn, tien2 AS giam_gia_lk, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt_kt, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt_kn, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt_lk
		, tien2 AS doanh_thu_tl_kt, tien2 AS doanh_thu_tl_kn, tien2 AS doanh_thu_tl_lk, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt_kt, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt_kn, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt_lk
		, ck AS ck_tl_kt, ck AS ck_tl_kn, ck AS ck_tl_lk, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt_kt, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt_kn, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt_lk
		, tien_nhap AS tien_von_tl_kt, tien_nhap AS tien_von_tl_kn, tien_nhap AS tien_von_tl_lk, tien_nt_n AS tien_von_tl_nt_kt, tien_nt_n AS tien_von_tl_nt_kn, tien_nt_n AS tien_von_tl_nt_lk

		, tien_xuat AS tien_kt, tien_xuat AS tien_kn, tien_xuat AS tien_lk, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_kt, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_kn, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_lk
		, tien2 AS lai_kt, tien2 AS lai_kn, tien2 AS lai_lk, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt_kt, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt_kn, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt_lk
	INTO #temp FROM wrkin

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_nt, loai_ct
			, so_luong, 0, 0
			, tien2, 0, 0
			, tien_nt2, 0, 0
			, ck, 0, 0
			, ck_nt, 0, 0
			, so_luong_tl, 0, 0
			, -giam_gia, 0, 0
			, -giam_gia_nt, 0, 0
			, doanh_thu_tl, 0, 0
			, doanh_thu_tl_nt, 0, 0
			, ck_tl, 0, 0
			, ck_tl_nt, 0, 0
			, tien_von_tl, 0, 0
			, tien_von_tl_nt, 0, 0
			, tien, 0, 0
			, tien_nt, 0, 0
			, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM #temp_kt

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_nt, loai_ct
			, 0, so_luong, 0
			, 0, tien2, 0
			, 0, tien_nt2, 0
			, 0, ck, 0
			, 0, ck_nt, 0
			, 0, so_luong_tl, 0
			, 0, -giam_gia, 0
			, 0, -giam_gia_nt, 0
			, 0, doanh_thu_tl, 0
			, 0, doanh_thu_tl_nt, 0
			, 0, ck_tl, 0
			, 0, ck_tl_nt, 0
			, 0, tien_von_tl, 0
			, 0, tien_von_tl_nt, 0
			, 0, tien, 0
			, 0, tien_nt, 0
			, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM #temp_kn

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_nt, loai_ct
			, 0, 0, so_luong
			, 0, 0, tien2
			, 0, 0, tien_nt2
			, 0, 0, ck
			, 0, 0, ck_nt
			, 0, 0, so_luong_tl
			, 0, 0, -giam_gia
			, 0, 0, -giam_gia_nt
			, 0, 0, doanh_thu_tl
			, 0, 0, doanh_thu_tl_nt
			, 0, 0, ck_tl
			, 0, 0, ck_tl_nt
			, 0, 0, tien_von_tl
			, 0, 0, tien_von_tl_nt
			, 0, 0, tien
			, 0, 0, tien_nt
			, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM #temp_lk

	UPDATE #temp SET tien_nt2_kt = 0, tien_nt2_kn = 0, tien_nt2_lk = 0, ck_nt_kt = 0, ck_nt_kn = 0, ck_nt_lk = 0
			, giam_gia_nt_kt = 0, giam_gia_nt_kn = 0, giam_gia_nt_lk = 0
			, doanh_thu_tl_nt_kt = 0, doanh_thu_tl_nt_kn = 0, doanh_thu_tl_nt_lk = 0
			, ck_tl_nt_kt = 0, ck_tl_nt_kn = 0, ck_tl_nt_lk = 0
			, tien_von_tl_nt_kt = 0, tien_von_tl_nt_kn = 0, tien_von_tl_nt_lk = 0
		WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt as ma_vt, ma_nt, c.dvt AS dvt
			, so_luong_kt, so_luong_kn, so_luong_lk
			, tien2_kt, tien2_kn, tien2_lk
			, tien_nt2_kt, tien_nt2_kn, tien_nt2_lk

			, tien_kt, tien_kn, tien_lk, tien_nt_kt, tien_nt_kn, tien_nt_lk
			, lai_kt, lai_kn, lai_lk, lai_nt_kt, lai_nt_kn, lai_nt_lk

			, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2
			, c.loai_vt, c.nh_vt1, c.nh_vt2, c.nh_vt3
		INTO #report FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt as ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(c.dvt) AS dvt
				, SUM(so_luong_kt - so_luong_tl_kt) AS so_luong_kt, SUM(so_luong_kn - so_luong_tl_kn) AS so_luong_kn, SUM(so_luong_lk - so_luong_tl_lk) AS so_luong_lk
				, SUM(tien2_kt - ck_kt - giam_gia_kt - doanh_thu_tl_kt + ck_tl_kt) AS tien2_kt, SUM(tien2_kn - ck_kn - giam_gia_kn - doanh_thu_tl_kn + ck_tl_kn) AS tien2_kn, SUM(tien2_lk - ck_lk - giam_gia_lk - doanh_thu_tl_lk + ck_tl_lk) AS tien2_lk
				, SUM(tien_nt2_kt - ck_nt_kt - giam_gia_nt_kt - doanh_thu_tl_nt_kt + ck_tl_nt_kt) AS tien_nt2_kt, SUM(tien_nt2_kn - ck_nt_kn - giam_gia_nt_kn - doanh_thu_tl_nt_kn + ck_tl_nt_kn) AS tien_nt2_kn, SUM(tien_nt2_lk - ck_nt_lk - giam_gia_nt_lk - doanh_thu_tl_nt_lk + ck_tl_nt_lk) AS tien_nt2_lk

				, SUM(tien_kt - tien_von_tl_kt) AS tien_kt, SUM(tien_kn - tien_von_tl_kn) AS tien_kn, SUM(tien_lk - tien_von_tl_lk) AS tien_lk, SUM(tien_nt_kt - tien_von_tl_nt_kt) AS tien_nt_kt, SUM(tien_nt_kn - tien_von_tl_nt_kn) AS tien_nt_kn, SUM(tien_nt_lk - tien_von_tl_nt_lk) AS tien_nt_lk
				, SUM(tien2_kt - ck_kt - giam_gia_kt - doanh_thu_tl_kt + ck_tl_nt_kt - tien_kt + tien_von_tl_kt) AS lai_kt, SUM(tien2_kn - ck_kn - giam_gia_kn - doanh_thu_tl_kn + ck_tl_nt_kn - tien_kn + tien_von_tl_kn) AS lai_kn, SUM(tien2_lk - ck_lk - giam_gia_lk - doanh_thu_tl_lk + ck_tl_nt_lk - tien_lk + tien_von_tl_lk) AS lai_lk
				, SUM(tien_nt2_kt - ck_nt_kt - giam_gia_nt_kt - doanh_thu_tl_nt_kt + ck_tl_nt_kt - tien_nt_kt + tien_von_tl_nt_kt) AS lai_nt_kt, SUM(tien_nt2_kn - ck_nt_kn - giam_gia_nt_kn - doanh_thu_tl_nt_kn + ck_tl_nt_kn - tien_nt_kn + tien_von_tl_nt_kn) AS lai_nt_kn, SUM(tien_nt2_lk - ck_nt_lk - giam_gia_nt_lk - doanh_thu_tl_nt_lk + ck_tl_nt_lk - tien_nt_lk + tien_von_tl_nt_lk) AS lai_nt_lk

				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
				, MAX(c.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(c.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(c.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(c.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
				FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
					GROUP BY a.ma_vt
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #temp WHERE ma_ct IN('HDF', 'HDR') OR (ma_ct IN('HD2', 'HD4') AND loai_ct = 1)
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt as ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(c.dvt) AS dvt
				, SUM(so_luong_kt) AS so_luong_kt, SUM(so_luong_kn) AS so_luong_kn, SUM(so_luong_lk) AS so_luong_lk
				, SUM(tien2_kt) AS tien2_kt, SUM(tien2_kn) AS tien2_kn, SUM(tien2_lk) AS tien2_lk
				, SUM(tien_nt2_kt) AS tien_nt2_kt, SUM(tien_nt2_kn) AS tien_nt2_kn, SUM(tien_nt2_lk) AS tien_nt2_lk

				, SUM(tien_kt) AS tien_kt, SUM(tien_kn) AS tien_kn, SUM(tien_lk) AS tien_lk, SUM(tien_nt_kt) AS tien_nt_kt, SUM(tien_nt_kn) AS tien_nt_kn, SUM(tien_nt_lk) AS tien_nt_lk
				, SUM(tien2_kt - ck_kt - tien_kt) AS lai_kt, SUM(tien2_kn - ck_kn - tien_kn) AS lai_kn, SUM(tien2_lk - ck_lk - tien_lk) AS lai_lk
				, SUM(tien_nt2_kt - ck_nt_kt - tien_nt_kt) AS lai_nt_kt, SUM(tien_nt2_kn - ck_nt_kn - tien_nt_kn) AS lai_nt_kn, SUM(tien_nt2_lk - ck_nt_lk - tien_nt_lk) AS lai_nt_lk

				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
				, MAX(c.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(c.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(c.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(c.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
				FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
					GROUP BY a.ma_vt
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	SET @q2 = 'so_luong_kt,so_luong_kn,so_luong_lk,tien2_kt,tien2_kn,tien2_lk,tien_nt2_kt,tien_nt2_kn,tien_nt2_lk'

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', @q2, '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(254), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(32), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(254), @n TINYINT
			DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @strSum VARCHAR(512)
			SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'NOGROUP'
			SELECT  @nStart = 1, @n = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) + ',', @cItemGroups = ''

			SET @strSum = 'so_luong_kt,so_luong_kn,so_luong_lk,tien2_kt,tien2_kn,tien2_lk,tien_nt2_kt,tien_nt2_kn,tien_nt2_lk,tien_nt_kt,tien_nt_kn,tien_nt_lk,tien_kt,tien_kn,tien_lk,lai_nt_kt,lai_nt_kn,lai_nt_lk,lai_kt,lai_kn,lai_lk'
			WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = ''
				SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
				SET @n = @n + 1
				IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt = space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt2) where systotal = 1'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_vt,ten_vt,ten_vt2,' + @cItemGroups + ','
				SET @q = @q + @strSum + ') select ' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
				SET @q = @q + 'max(b.ten_nh),max(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',sum(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),sum(a.') + ')'
				SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join (select * from dmnhvt where loai_nh = '
				SET @q = @q + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@cItemGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b on a.' + @cItemGroup + ' = b.ma_nh where a.systotal = 1'
				SET @q = @q + ' group by a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt = space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + '-2) + isnull(ten_vt, N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + '), ten_vt2 = space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + '-2) + isnull(ten_vt2, N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ') where systotal = 0 and not ' + @cItemGroup + ' is null'
				SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
	END

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	IF @nSo_Ma_nt > 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong_kt, so_luong_kn, so_luong_lk', '#report')
	ELSE
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', @q2, '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q2 = 'so_luong_kt, so_luong_kn, so_luong_lk, tien2_kt, tien2_kn, tien2_lk, tien_nt2_kt, tien_nt2_kn, tien_nt2_lk, tien_nt_kt, tien_nt_kn, tien_nt_lk, tien_kt, tien_kn, tien_lk, lai_nt_kt, lai_nt_kn, lai_nt_lk, lai_kt, lai_kn, lai_lk'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) <> ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3, ' + @q2 + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@GroupBy, 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ' + @q2 + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIPriceComparison]
	@purOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@plant VARCHAR(33),
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateCompare SMALLDATETIME,
	@item VARCHAR(1024),
	@uomType CHAR(1),
	@priceType CHAR(1),
	@quantityType CHAR(1),
	@quantityFrom NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@quantityTo NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@refType CHAR(1),
	@purGroup VARCHAR(33),
	@reportType CHAR(1),
	@voucherType CHAR(1),
	@reportForm CHAR(1),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@graph CHAR(1) = N'0',
	@object_value VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @voucherCode VARCHAR(33), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @n NUMERIC(4,3)
	DECLARE @purOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @purGroupKey NVARCHAR(4000), @plantKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @roundAmount INT, @roundQ INT, @roundPrice INT
	SELECT @roundAmount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @roundQ = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @roundPrice = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	SELECT @n = CASE WHEN @roundQ = 1 THEN 0.1 WHEN @roundQ = 2 THEN 0.01 WHEN @roundQ = 3 THEN 0.001 ELSE 1 END
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(128)) AS ma,
			a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
			a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.so_luong AS so_luong2, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia_chuan_nt, a.gia_nt AS gia_nt0, a.tien_nt AS ck_dv_nt, a.tien_nt AS cp_dv_nt, a.tien_nt AS ck_nt, a.tien_nt AS cp_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ncc_tx,
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS hang, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_trong,
			CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten2, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec1, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #report FROM bigia0dc a

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, a.stt_rec0 INTO #dataKey FROM bigia01 a

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_vt, ma_kh, ck_nt, cp_nt, ma_nt, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung,
			so_luong, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt, ck_dv_nt, cp_dv_nt, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, ngay_ct AS ngay_hl_tu, ngay_ct AS ngay_hl_den,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS he_so_dh, so_luong AS so_luong0, a.so_luong AS so_luong2, dvt1 AS dvt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #data FROM bigia01 a

	--
	SELECT @voucherCode = CASE
			WHEN @voucherType = '1' THEN 'PQ2'
			WHEN @voucherType = '2' THEN 'PA1'
			WHEN @voucherType = '3' THEN 'PA2'
			WHEN @voucherType = '4' THEN 'PO1'
			WHEN @voucherType = '5' THEN 'PO2'
			ELSE '*'
		END

	-- Key
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin)
	SELECT @purOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @purOrg, @userID, @admin)
	EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @plant, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @plantKey OUTPUT, '1'
	EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_nh0', @purGroup, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @purGroupKey OUTPUT, '2'
	SELECT @key2 = '', @key = ''
	IF @purOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @key2 = @purOrgKey

	IF @plantKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.ma_vung = '''' or (' + @plantKey + '))'
	IF @purGroupKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @purGroupKey
	IF @plant <> '' AND @plantKey IS NULL SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.ma_vung = ''' + REPLACE(@plant, '''', '''''') + ''')'
	IF @purGroup <> '' AND @purGroupKey IS NULL SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(@purGroup, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @item <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_vt, ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@item, '''', ''''''), ', ', ',') + ''') = 1'
	IF @object_value <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@object_value, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @voucherCode <> '*' SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_ct = ''' + @voucherCode + ''''
	ELSE SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''PQ2'', ''PA1'', ''PA2'', ''PO1'', ''PO2'')'

	SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key2

	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dataKey select distinct a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from bigia01 a with(nolock) where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #data
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ck_nt, a.cp_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
				a.so_luong, a.gia_chuan_nt, a.gia_nt, a.ck_dv_nt, a.cp_dv_nt, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, 0 AS tien_nt, 1 AS he_so_dh, a.so_luong, a.so_luong AS so_luong2, NULL
			FROM bigia01 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN bigia02 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 JOIN #dataKey k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = k.stt_rec0
				WHERE b.ngay_hl_tu = (
							SELECT MAX(c.ngay_hl_tu)
								FROM bigia02 c
									WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dataKey k1 WHERE c.stt_rec = k1.stt_rec AND c.stt_rec0 = k1.stt_rec0) AND
										(a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt) AND
										(c.ngay_hl_tu <= @dateCompare) AND
										(c.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR c.ngay_hl_den >= @dateCompare)
						) OR b.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL

	IF @quantityType = '0' BEGIN
		DELETE #data FROM #data a WHERE ((a.so_luong > (SELECT MIN(c.so_luong) FROM #data c WHERE a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)))
		-- Loại bảng ghi không phải giá tối thiểu
		IF @priceType = '2' BEGIN
			DELETE #data FROM #data a WHERE ((a.gia_chuan_nt > (SELECT MIN(c.gia_chuan_nt) FROM #data c WHERE a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)))
			DELETE #data FROM #data a WHERE ((a.stt_rec > (SELECT MIN(c.stt_rec) FROM #data c WHERE a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.so_luong = c.so_luong AND a.gia_chuan_nt = c.gia_chuan_nt)))
		END
		IF @priceType = '1' BEGIN
			DELETE #data FROM #data a WHERE ((a.gia_nt + a.cp_dv_nt - a.ck_dv_nt > (SELECT MIN(c.gia_nt + c.cp_dv_nt - c.ck_dv_nt) FROM #data c WHERE a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)))
			DELETE #data FROM #data a WHERE ((a.stt_rec > (SELECT MIN(c.stt_rec) FROM #data c WHERE a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.so_luong = c.so_luong AND (a.gia_nt + a.cp_dv_nt - a.ck_dv_nt) = (c.gia_nt + c.cp_dv_nt - c.ck_dv_nt))))
		END
	END

	IF @uomType = '1' BEGIN
		IF @plant <> '' UPDATE #data SET dvt = b.val FROM #data a JOIN bidmvttsvung b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung WHERE b.name = 'dvt'
		UPDATE #data SET dvt = b.val FROM #data a JOIN bidmvtts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL AND b.name = 'dvt'
		UPDATE #data SET dvt = b.dvt FROM #data a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL
		UPDATE #data SET he_so_dh = b.he_so, so_luong = ROUND(so_luong / b.he_so, @roundQ),
				gia_chuan_nt = ROUND(gia_chuan_nt * b.he_so, @roundPrice),
				gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt * b.he_so, @roundPrice),
				ck_dv_nt = ROUND(ck_dv_nt * b.he_so, @roundAmount),
				cp_dv_nt = round(cp_dv_nt * b.he_so, @roundAmount)
			FROM #data a LEFT JOIN dmqddvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.dvt = b.dvt
			WHERE b.he_so <> 0
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #data SET dvt = b.dvt FROM #data a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL
	END

	IF @quantityType = '4' BEGIN
		UPDATE #data SET so_luong2 = b.so_luong - @n
			FROM #data a LEFT JOIN (SELECT so_luong, stt_rec, stt_rec0, id FROM #data) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 AND a.id = b.id - 1
	END

	-- Số lượng xét
	SELECT a.ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, so_luong, so_luong AS so_luong_qd, ma_vung INTO #po FROM m94$000000 a, d94$000000 b
	SELECT ma_vt, dvt, he_so, so_luong, so_luong AS so_luong_qd INTO #gpo FROM m94$000000 a, d94$000000 b
	IF @quantityType IN ('1', '2', '3') BEGIN
		DECLARE @name VARCHAR(32), @xkey VARCHAR(128)
		DECLARE @table TABLE(name VARCHAR(32), xkey VARCHAR(128))
		INSERT INTO @table SELECT 'm94', 'loai_ct <> ''9'' and a.status in(''2'', ''3'', ''4'', ''5'')'
		INSERT INTO @table SELECT 'm95', 'loai_ct <> ''9'' and a.status in(''2'', ''3'', ''4'', ''5'')'
		INSERT INTO @table SELECT 'bim06', 'a.status in(''2'', ''3'', ''4'', ''5'')'
		SELECT @name = MIN(name) FROM @table
		IF @plant <> '' SELECT @key2 = @key2 + CASE WHEN @key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(b.ma_vung = ''' + REPLACE(@plant, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		SELECT @key2 = @key2 + ' and b.ma_vt in(select ma_vt from #data)'
		WHILE @name IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @xkey = xkey FROM @table WHERE name = @name
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #po select a.ma_kh, b.ma_vt, null, b.he_so, b.so_luong, b.so_luong, b.ma_vung
				from ' + @name + '$%Partition a with(nolock) join ' + REPLACE(@name, 'm', 'd') + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
					where %[' + @key2 + ' and ' + @xkey + ']%
			'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @userID, @admin
			SELECT @name = MIN(name) FROM @table WHERE name > @name
		END

		UPDATE #po SET so_luong = CASE WHEN he_so <> 0 THEN ROUND(so_luong * he_so, @roundQ) END
		IF @uomType = '1' BEGIN
			IF @plant <> '' UPDATE #po SET dvt = b.val FROM #po a JOIN bidmvttsvung b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung WHERE b.name = 'dvt'
			UPDATE #po SET dvt = b.val FROM #po a JOIN bidmvtts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL AND b.name = 'dvt'
			UPDATE #po SET dvt = b.dvt FROM #po a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL
			UPDATE #po SET so_luong_qd = ROUND(so_luong_qd * (1/b.he_so * a.he_so), @roundQ)
				FROM #po a LEFT JOIN dmqddvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.dvt = b.dvt
				WHERE b.he_so <> 0
		END ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE #po SET dvt = b.dvt, so_luong_qd = CASE WHEN he_so <> 0 THEN ROUND(so_luong_qd * he_so, @roundQ) ELSE 0 END
				FROM #po a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.dvt IS NULL
		END
		IF @quantityType = '1' INSERT INTO #gpo SELECT ma_vt, dvt, MAX(he_so), AVG(so_luong), AVG(so_luong_qd) FROM #po GROUP BY ma_vt, dvt
		IF @quantityType = '2' INSERT INTO #gpo SELECT ma_vt, dvt, MAX(he_so), MIN(so_luong), MIN(so_luong_qd) FROM #po GROUP BY ma_vt, dvt
		IF @quantityType = '3' INSERT INTO #gpo SELECT ma_vt, dvt, MAX(he_so), MAX(so_luong), MAX(so_luong_qd) FROM #po GROUP BY ma_vt, dvt
	END

	-- Xử lý dữ liệu
	SELECT @key = ''
	IF @quantityType IN('0', '1', '2', '3')
		SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(
			a.so_luong0 =
				case when c.so_luong is null then (select min(b.so_luong) from #data b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0)
				else (select max(b.so_luong0) as so_luong from #data b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and b.so_luong0 <= c.so_luong)
				end
			)
	'
	IF @quantityType = '4' SELECT @key = @key +
		CASE WHEN @uomType = '1' THEN '(((@quantityFrom between a.so_luong and a.so_luong2) or (a.so_luong between @quantityFrom and @quantityTo) or (a.so_luong2 is null and a.so_luong <= @quantityTo)) and a.stt_rec1 <> '''')'
			ELSE '(((@quantityFrom between a.so_luong0 and a.so_luong2) or (a.so_luong0 between @quantityFrom and @quantityTo) or (a.so_luong2 is null and a.so_luong0 <= @quantityTo)) and a.stt_rec1 <> '''')'
		END

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, so_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, ma_nt, ncc_tx, so_luong, so_luong2, gia_chuan_nt, gia_nt0, ck_dv_nt, cp_dv_nt, ck_nt, cp_nt, gia_nt, tien_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_kh, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, stt_rec1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so_dh, dc.ma_nt, dc.ncc_tx,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'isnull(c.so_luong_qd, a.so_luong), isnull(c.so_luong_qd, a.so_luong2), a.gia_chuan_nt, a.gia_nt, a.ck_dv_nt, a.cp_dv_nt, a.ck_nt, a.cp_nt,'
	IF @priceType = '1' BEGIN -- net
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE
				WHEN @quantityType = '0' THEN 'a.gia_nt + cp_dv_nt - ck_dv_nt as gia_moi, a.so_luong * a.gia_chuan_nt'
				ELSE 'case when a.so_luong = 0 then a.gia_nt + cp_dv_nt - ck_dv_nt else round((a.so_luong * a.gia_nt + (a.so_luong * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (a.so_luong * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt) / a.so_luong, @roundQ) end as gia_moi, (a.so_luong * a.gia_nt + (a.so_luong * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (a.so_luong * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt) as tien_nt'
			END
	END ELSE BEGIN -- gross
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'a.gia_chuan_nt, a.so_luong * a.gia_chuan_nt'
	END

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #data a left join bigia0dc dc on a.stt_rec = dc.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = dc.stt_rec0 left join #gpo c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt' + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' END + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@quantityFrom numeric(28, 6), @quantityTo numeric(28, 6), @roundQ int', @quantityFrom, @quantityTo, @roundQ

	-- Cập nhật số lượng, giá, thành tiền theo số lượng
	IF @quantityType <> '0' BEGIN
		IF @quantityType = '4' BEGIN
			UPDATE #report SET so_luong = CASE WHEN @quantityFrom BETWEEN so_luong AND so_luong2 AND @quantityTo <= so_luong2 THEN @quantityTo
				ELSE CASE WHEN @quantityFrom BETWEEN so_luong AND so_luong2 AND @quantityFrom <> 0 THEN @quantityFrom ELSE so_luong2 END END
			UPDATE #report SET so_luong = @quantityTo WHERE so_luong = so_luong2 AND @quantityTo <= so_luong2
			UPDATE #report SET so_luong = @quantityTo WHERE so_luong2 IS NULL
		END
		IF @priceType = '1' BEGIN -- net
			UPDATE #report SET gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN gia_nt0 + cp_dv_nt - ck_dv_nt ELSE ROUND((so_luong * gia_nt0 + (so_luong * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (so_luong * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt) / so_luong, @roundQ) END,
				tien_nt = (so_luong * gia_nt0 + (so_luong * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (so_luong * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt)
		END ELSE BEGIN -- gross
			IF @priceType = '2' UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = so_luong * gia_chuan_nt
		END
	END

	-- quantityType = 4, trường hợp không có giá scale
	IF @quantityType = '4' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
		insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, so_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_kh, ma_vt, dvt, he_so, ma_nt, ncc_tx, so_luong, gia_nt, tien_nt)
			select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_kh, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung,
					a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.he_so_dh, dc.ma_nt, dc.ncc_tx, @quantityTo,
		'
		IF @priceType = '1' BEGIN -- net
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE
					WHEN @quantityType = '0' THEN 'a.gia_nt + cp_dv_nt - ck_dv_nt as gia_moi, @quantityTo * a.gia_chuan_nt as tien_nt'
					ELSE 'case when @quantityTo = 0 then a.gia_nt + cp_dv_nt - ck_dv_nt else round((@quantityTo * a.gia_nt + (@quantityTo * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (@quantityTo * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt) / @quantityTo, @roundQ) end as gia_moi, (@quantityTo * a.gia_nt + (@quantityTo * cp_dv_nt) + cp_nt - (@quantityTo * ck_dv_nt) - ck_nt) as tien_nt'
				END
		END ELSE BEGIN -- gross
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'a.gia_chuan_nt, @quantityTo * a.gia_chuan_nt'
		END

		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
			from #data a left join bigia0dc dc on a.stt_rec = dc.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = dc.stt_rec0
				where not exists (select 1 from #report b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) and a.stt_rec1 = ''''
		'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@quantityTo numeric(28, 6), @roundQ int', @quantityTo, @roundQ
	END

	IF @quantityType <> '0' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, gia_nt, MIN(id) AS id INTO #idDel FROM #report GROUP BY ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, gia_nt
		SELECT ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong, MIN(gia_nt) AS gia_nt INTO #giaDel FROM #idDel GROUP BY ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong
		DELETE #report WHERE id NOT IN(SELECT id FROM #idDel a JOIN #giaDel b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_luong = b.so_luong AND a.gia_nt = b.gia_nt)
	END

	-- Hạng
	SELECT ma_vt, gia_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #o1 FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vt, gia_nt ORDER BY ma_vt, gia_nt
	SELECT ma_vt, MIN(id) -1 AS id INTO #o2 FROM #o1 GROUP BY ma_vt ORDER BY ma_vt

	-- Tỷ trọng
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, gia_nt INTO #t FROM #o1
	SELECT @q = 'insert #t select ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @refType = '1' THEN 'min(gia_nt)' WHEN @refType = '2' THEN 'max(gia_nt)' WHEN @refType = '3' THEN 'avg(gia_nt)' ELSE '1' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #o1 group by ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	UPDATE #report SET hang = (b.id - c.id), ty_trong = CASE WHEN t.gia_nt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE a.gia_nt/t.gia_nt * 100 END, ten = k.ten_kh, ten2 = k.ten_kh2
		FROM #report a JOIN #o1 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.gia_nt = b.gia_nt JOIN #o2 c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			JOIN #t t ON a.ma_vt = t.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmkh k ON a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh

	-- Group
	IF @reportType <> '0' BEGIN
		DECLARE @g1 INT, @g2 INT, @sp1 INT, @sp2 INT
		SELECT @g1 = 1, @g2 = 2, @sp1 = 0, @sp2 = 2
		IF @reportType = '1' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ma_nh0, ma_vt, ten, ten2, stt_rec, stt_rec0)
				SELECT @g1, 1, 0, SPACE(@sp1) + a.ma_nh0, a.ma_nh0, MIN(a.ma_vt) AS ma_vt, ten = MAX(b.ten_nh), ten2 = MAX(b.ten_nh2), '', ''
					FROM #report a JOIN bidmnhom0 b ON a.ma_nh0 = b.ma_nh
						GROUP BY a.ma_nh0
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ma_nh0, ma_vt, ten, ten2, stt_rec, stt_rec0)
				SELECT @g2, 1, 0, SPACE(@sp2) + a.ma_vt, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vt, ten = SPACE(2) + MAX(b.ten_vt), ten2 = SPACE(2) + MAX(b.ten_vt2), '', ''
					FROM #report a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
						GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_nh0
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ma_nh0, ma_vt, ten, ten2, stt_rec, stt_rec0)
				SELECT @g1, 1, 0, SPACE(@sp1) + a.ma_vt, MIN(a.ma_nh0), a.ma_vt, ten = SPACE(2) + MAX(b.ten_vt), ten2 = SPACE(2) + MAX(b.ten_vt2), '', ''
					FROM #report a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
						GROUP BY a.ma_vt
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ma_nh0, ma_vt, ten, ten2, stt_rec, stt_rec0)
				SELECT @g2, 1, 0, SPACE(@sp2) + a.ma_nh0, a.ma_nh0, MIN(a.ma_vt) AS ma_vt, ten = MAX(b.ten_nh), ten2 = MAX(b.ten_nh2), '', ''
					FROM #report a JOIN bidmnhom0 b ON a.ma_nh0 = b.ma_nh
						GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_nh0
		END

		UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(4) + ten, ten2 = SPACE(4) + ten2, ma = SPACE(4) + ma WHERE sysorder = 5
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ma_vt, ten, ten2, stt_rec, stt_rec0)
		SELECT 1, 1, 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vt, ten = MAX(b.ten_vt), ten2 = MAX(b.ten_vt2), '', ''
			FROM #report a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
				GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(2) + ten, ten2 = SPACE(2) + ten2, ma = SPACE(2) + ma WHERE sysorder = 5
	END

	-- Stt
	DECLARE @order VARCHAR(128)
	IF @reportType = '1' SELECT @order = 'ma_nh0, ma_vt'
	IF @reportType = '2' SELECT @order = 'ma_vt, ma_nh0'
	IF @reportType = '0' SELECT @order = 'ma_vt'
	CREATE TABLE #onumber(ma_nh0 VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), stt INT, id INT IDENTITY(1, 1))
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_nh0, ma_vt, ma_kh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #oreport FROM #report
	SELECT @q = ' insert into #oreport(ma_nh0, ma_vt, ma_kh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1) select ma_nh0, ma_vt, ma_kh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec1 from #report where sysorder = 5 order by ' + @order + ', hang, ncc_tx desc, ma_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #onumber(' + @order + ', stt) select ' + @order + ', min(id) - 1 from #oreport group by ' + @order
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @reportType <> '0' UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.stt FROM #report a JOIN #oreport b  ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 AND a.stt_rec1 = b.stt_rec1 JOIN #onumber c ON b.ma_nh0 = c.ma_nh0 AND b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
	ELSE UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.stt FROM #report a JOIN #oreport b  ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 AND a.stt_rec1 = b.stt_rec1 JOIN #onumber c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt

	SELECT @q = 'select ' + CASE WHEN @Graph = '1' THEN ''''' as array$, ' ELSE '' END + 'a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.ma, a.ten, a.ten2, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.hang, a.ty_trong, a.stt, d.ten_ct as nguon, d.ten_ct2 as nguon2
		from #report a left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Graph = '1' THEN ' where sysorder = 5' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by ' + @order + ', a.sysorder, a.hang, a.ncc_tx desc, a.stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintIRTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Transaction VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@InventoryAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Reason VARCHAR(1023),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@DataType CHAR(1) = '2' -- 1: Physics, 2: Book
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024), @tName VARCHAR(33)

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @tName = '74'
		ELSE SELECT @tName = '34'

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '', @KeyDetail = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Transaction <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Transaction), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Admin = 0 SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @KeyDetail = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @InventoryAccount <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@InventoryAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#40$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyDetail <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyDetail), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i' + @tName + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m' + @tName + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.rf_GetUserList(@cObject VARCHAR(30))
RETURNS VARCHAR(3000)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cUserLstTmp VARCHAR(3000), @cUserLst VARCHAR(3000)
	SELECT  @cUserLst = '', @cUserLstTmp = ''
	SELECT @cUserLstTmp = RTRIM(user_lst)
		FROM vsysuserinfo
		WHERE name = @cObject

	IF LEN(@cUserLstTmp)>0
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @nCount INT, @nI INT, @nCount2 INT, @nJ INT, @nUser_yn INT
			DECLARE @cUser VARCHAR(30), @cUsers VARCHAR(3000)
			SET  @nI = 1
			SET  @nCount = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@cUserLstTmp)
			WHILE @nI <= @nCount
				BEGIN
					SET @cUser = RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cUserLstTmp, @nI))
					SELECT @nUser_yn = user_yn FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE name = @cUser
					IF @nUser_yn = 1
						BEGIN
							IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cUser, @cUserLst) = 0
								SET @cUserLst = @cUserLst + ',' + @cUser
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @cUsers = dbo.ff_GetUserList(@cUser)
							IF LEN(@cUsers) > 0
								BEGIN
									SET  @nJ = 1
									SET  @nCount2 = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@cUsers)
									WHILE @nJ <= @nCount2
										BEGIN
											SET @cUser = RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cUsers, @nJ))
											IF dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cUser, @cUserLst) = 0
												SET @cUserLst = @cUserLst + ',' + @cUser
											SET  @nJ =  @nJ + 1
										END
								END
						END
					SET  @nI =  @nI + 1
				END
		END
	IF LEN(@cUserLst)>0
		SET @cUserLst = RIGHT(@cUserLst, LEN(@cUserLst)-1)
	RETURN @cUserLst
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRecommendations]
	@dFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@cItem AS VARCHAR(33),
	@cAction AS VARCHAR(4000),
	@cVersion CHAR(2),
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@nDateFormat INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSize TINYINT
	SET @nSize = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')

	DECLARE @cActionMessage NVARCHAR(128), @cQtyFormat VARCHAR(20)	
	SELECT @cQtyFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, a.nguon AS loai_dh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb,
				b.ten_cb AS ten_cb, a.nguon,
				c.ten_nguon AS ten_nguon, a.so_lsx AS so_ct, 
				a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
				a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, a.ngay_yc, a.nxt, a.muc_do, a.stt, a.stt_rec
		INTO #rs
		FROM mrctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon

	IF @cVersion = '' BEGIN
		-- Không theo Version
		INSERT INTO #rs
		SELECT
				a.ngay_ct,
				a.so_dh,
				CASE
					WHEN nguon IN ('FP', 'PL') AND sl_da_yc > 0 THEN 'PR'
					ELSE nguon
				END AS loai_dh,
				a.ma_vt,
				a.sl_nhap,
				a.ngay_dat,
				a.ma_cb,
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END AS ten_cb,
				a.nguon,
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon,
				CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct,
				a.sl_xuat,
				a.sl_ton,
				a.ma_sp,
				a.nc_rong,
				a.sl_dh,
				a.sl_da_yc,
				a.xac_nhan,
				a.sl_yc,
				a.ngay_yc,
				a.nxt,
				a.muc_do,
				a.stt,
				a.stt_rec
			FROM mrctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
			WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
				AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')
				AND dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 1
				AND a.ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM mrctyc WHERE ma_cb <> '')
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
			a.nguon, 
			a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, '',			
			a.nguon, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
			a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
			a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
			a.ngay_yc,
			a.nxt, 
			a.muc_do, 
			a.stt, 
			a.stt_rec
		FROM mrhistory a LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
			AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')
			AND a.version = RTRIM(@cVersion)

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #rs ) BEGIN
			INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
				a.nguon, 
				a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, 
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END AS ten_cb, 
				a.nguon, 
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
				CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
				a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
				a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
				a.ngay_yc,
				a.nxt, 
				a.muc_do, 
				a.stt, 
				a.stt_rec
			FROM mrctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
			WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
				AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')								
				AND a.nguon <> 'PL' -- AND a.nguon <> 'FP'
		END

		-- Action Message
		EXEC rs_RunGenerateActionMessage '#rs', 2, 1, NULL
		IF RTRIM(@cAction) <> '' DELETE #rs WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 0
		UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END FROM #rs a LEFT JOIN mpdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb
	END

	-- Action Message
	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '11'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '12'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '21'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '22'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '31'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '32'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '33'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '34'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = '' WHERE ten_cb IS NULL

	SELECT a.*
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_nguon ELSE b.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_dh
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
			, c.dvt
		FROM #rs a
			LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon b ON a.loai_dh = b.ma_nguon
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_vt, ngay_ct, nxt, muc_do, stt 

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTMImplementation]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@CourseCode VARCHAR(33),
	@SubjectCode VARCHAR(33),
	@TrainingProvider VARCHAR(33),
	@TrainingType VARCHAR(33),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ma_khoa, a.ten_khoa, b.ten_mh AS mon_hoc, c.ten_loai AS loai_hinh_dt, doi_tuong AS doi_tuong_dt, ngay_hoc1 AS tu_ngay, ngay_hoc1 AS den_ngay, sl_hv_dk AS sl_hv, t_cp_dk AS tong_cp
		INTO #report
		FROM hrdtkh a, hrdmmh b, hrdmlhdt c

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ngay_hoc1 between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and '''+ CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @CourseCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_khoa like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CourseCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SubjectCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_mh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SubjectCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TrainingProvider <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dvdt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TrainingProvider), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TrainingType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_hinh_dt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TrainingType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report '	
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_khoa, a.ten_khoa%l, b.ten_mh%l, c.ten_loai%l, a.doi_tuong, a.ngay_hoc1, a.ngay_hoc2, a.sl_hv_tt, t_cp_tt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from hrdtkh a with(nolock) left join hrdmmh b with(nolock) on a.ma_mh = b.ma_mh left join hrdmlhdt c with(nolock) on a.loai_hinh_dt = c.ma_loai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_khoa'
	--
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists(select 1 from #report) select 0 as stt, 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, '''' as ma_khoa, '''' as ten_khoa, '''' as mon_hoc, '''' as loai_hinh_dt, '''' as doi_tuong_dt, null as tu_ngay, null as den_ngay, 0 as sl_hv, 0 as tong_cp'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'else select * from #report order by stt'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesEmployeeActivity] --fs20_ARContractDetail--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0,
	@Nested BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @CustomerKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nvbh INTO #report FROM wrkgl
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ma_nvbh', 'VARCHAR(32)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF ISNULL(@SalesEmployeeColumn, '') = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
		SELECT systotal, sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_lct, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, '' AS ma_ct0, ma_nvbh, '' AS ten_kh, '' AS ten_kh2 FROM #report
		RETURN
	END	

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = 'status = ''1''', @CustomerKey = ''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(@SalesEmployee, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @Nested = 1 AND @Customer <> '' BEGIN
		SET @CustomerKey = 'a.ma_kh = ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + ''''
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @CustomerKey
	END
	ELSE IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, ' + @SalesEmployeeColumn
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s1 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'
	
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	IF @Customer = '' INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployee @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @SalesEmployee, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @SalesEmployeeColumn
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Nested = 1 INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployeeCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @SalesEmployee, '', 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @SalesEmployeeColumn, '', @CustomerKey
		ELSE INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployeeCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @SalesEmployee, @Customer, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @SalesEmployeeColumn
	END
	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t

	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1,
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
					)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
					)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES  (3, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SELECT a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du
			, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, a.ma_nvbh
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report a 
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
			LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct 
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, c.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_PadR](@cpItem VARCHAR(33), @nLen TINYINT)  
RETURNS VARCHAR(33) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)
	SET @cReturn = LTRIM(@cpItem) + SPACE(@nLen - LEN(LTRIM(@cpItem)))
	RETURN ISNULL(@cReturn, '')
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSVTranMultiCopies]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@cMTable CHAR(10),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@eTable CHAR(10) = '', 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0,
	@printVATDataDetail BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @so_lien INT, @max INT, @xk_yn CHAR(1), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @discount NVARCHAR(256), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @bk_yn BIT
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511), @printTable VARCHAR(32), @printJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'	
	SELECT @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + '''', @bk_yn = 0
	SELECT @eTable = CASE WHEN @eTable <> ''  THEN @eTable ELSE 'e81$000000' END
	SELECT @detail = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai
			, b.doi_tac, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan AS thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 AS thanh_toan2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt AS t_tt, a.t_tt_nt AS t_tt_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS thue_suat, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word
			, x.so_hd, x.ngay_hd, x.ht_tt, x.dd_gh, x.dd_nh, x.so_vd, x.so_con, x.dv_vc
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS so_bk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay_bk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang_bk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam_bk, a.sl_in, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS sd_hddt_yn, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS in_yn
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_vtthue
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize, a.ma_thue, a.thue_suat AS thue_suatx
		INTO #master FROM wrksvtran a, dmkh b, dmtt c, e81$000000 x

	SELECT @eiFields = ' isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), ''''), a.so_seri, a.so_ct', @eiJoin = '', @printJoin = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @ei001 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
		SELECT @ei002 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		SELECT @eiFields = N' isnull(case when w.mau_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei001) + ''' else w.mau_hddt end, isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''')),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_seri_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei002) + ''' else w.so_seri_hddt end, a.so_seri),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_ct_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei003) + ''' else w.so_ct_hddt end, a.so_ct)',
			@eiJoin = ' left join hddt00$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6) + ' w with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = w.stt_rec'
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sl_in' AND val = '1') SELECT @printTable = 'hdin$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6), @printJoin = ' left join ' + @printTable + ' p with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh,' + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai, a.ong_ba, isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh), isnull(e.ten_kh, b.ten_kh), e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan, c.ten_ngan2'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.t_tien2 + a.t_km), (a.t_tien_nt2 + a.t_km_nt), (a.t_thue + a.t_thue_km), (a.t_thue_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt), (a.t_tt + a.t_km + a.t_thue_km), (a.t_tt_nt + a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or a.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', (a.t_tt + a.t_km + a.t_thue_km), ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, (a.t_tt_nt + a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt), ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ', x.so_hd, x.ngay_hd, x.ht_tt, x.dd_gh, x.dd_nh, x.so_vd, x.so_con, x.dv_vc'
	SET @q = @q + ', y.so_bk, replace(str(day(y.ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay_bk, replace(str(month(y.ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang_bk, rtrim(year(y.ngay_bk)) as nam_bk, a.sl_in'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @eiJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when w.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @printJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when p.in_yn = 1 then 1 else 0 end' END
