	SET @q = @q + ', a.ten_vtthue'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END 
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue, d.thue_suat' ELSE ''''',0' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @cMTable + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt left join dmthue d on a.ma_thue = d.ma_thue left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + @eTable + ' x with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join v01$000000 y with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = y.stt_rec' + @eiJoin + @printJoin
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(8)) AS ma_thue, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(5,2)) AS thue_suat, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue_nt, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue, a.ck, a.ck_nt
		INTO #detail FROM wrksvdetail a, dmvt b
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt_10, tien2 AS tien_10, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt_5, tien2 AS tien_5, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt_8, tien2 AS tien_8, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt_0, tien2 AS tien_0, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt_99, tien2 AS tien_99, thue_nt AS thue_nt_10, thue AS thue_10, thue_nt AS thue_nt_5, thue AS thue_5, thue_nt AS thue_nt_8, thue AS thue_8, thue_nt AS thue_nt_0, thue AS thue_0, thue_nt AS thue_nt_99, thue AS thue_99 INTO #VAT FROM #detail

	SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #detail SELECT 1, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2'
	SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' AS ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN ', a.ma_thue, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue' ELSE ', '''', 0, thue_nt, thue' END + ', a.ck, a.ck_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @q = @q + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' WHERE ' + @key

	-- Hiển thị thêm diễn giải cho hàng khuyến mãi
	DECLARE @promotion NVARCHAR(256), @promotion2 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion3 NVARCHAR(256)

	SELECT @promotion = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN title11 ELSE title112 END, @promotion2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN title12 ELSE title122 END, @promotion3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN title13 ELSE title132 END FROM v30dmsnk15 WHERE ma_snk = 'ZZHDA'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion WHERE km_yn = 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion2 WHERE km_yn = 2'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET ten_vt = ten_vt + '' - '' + @promotion3 WHERE km_yn = 3'

	-- Hiển thị mã hàng trên mẫu in hóa đơn bán hàng
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_vt_ar_yn' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET ten_vt = RTRIM(ma_vt) + '' - '' + ten_vt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@promotion NVARCHAR(256), @promotion2 NVARCHAR(256), @promotion3 NVARCHAR(256)'
		, @promotion, @promotion2, @promotion3

	-- Fix tax rate
	IF @printVATDetail = 0 AND @printVATDataDetail = 1 BEGIN		
		UPDATE #master SET thue_suat = CASE WHEN d.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR d.ma_thue = '' THEN '\' ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) END FROM #master a JOIN #detail d ON (a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND d.line_nbr = (SELECT MIN(line_nbr) FROM #detail WHERE stt_rec = a.stt_rec))
	END


	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_in_bk_yn' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber AND so_bk <> '' AND ngay_bk IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @bk_yn = 1
			
			SET @q = 'insert into #VAT select a.stt_rec, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 10 then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_10, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 10 then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_10
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 5 then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_5, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 5 then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_5
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 8 then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_8, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 8 then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_8
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 0 and ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and a.ma_thue <> ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and c.ma_thue <> ''''' END + ' then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_0, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 0 and ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and a.ma_thue <> ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and c.ma_thue <> ''''' END + ' then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_0
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or a.ma_thue = ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or c.ma_thue = ''''' END + ' and a.sysprint = 1 then a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt else 0 end as tien_nt_99, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or a.ma_thue = ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or c.ma_thue = ''''' END + ' and a.sysprint = 1 then a.tien2 - a.ck else 0 end as tien_99
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 10 then a.thue_nt else 0 end as thue_nt_10, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 10 then a.thue else 0 end as thue_10
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 5 then a.thue_nt else 0 end as thue_nt_5, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 5 then a.thue else 0 end as thue_5
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 8 then a.thue_nt else 0 end as thue_nt_8, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 8 then a.thue else 0 end as thue_8
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 0 and ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and a.ma_thue <> ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and c.ma_thue <> ''''' END + ' then a.thue_nt else 0 end as thue_nt_0, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.thue_suat' ELSE 'c.thue_suatx' END + ' = 0 and ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and a.ma_thue <> ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue <> ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' and c.ma_thue <> ''''' END + ' then a.thue else 0 end as thue_0
						, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or a.ma_thue = ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or c.ma_thue = ''''' END + ' and a.sysprint = 1 then a.thue_nt else 0 end as thue_nt_99, case when ' + CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN 'a.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or a.ma_thue = ''''' ELSE 'c.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or c.ma_thue = ''''' END + ' and a.sysprint = 1 then a.thue else 0 end as thue_99'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #detail a with(nolock) left join #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec '
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DELETE #detail
			IF @printVATDataDetail = 1 
				INSERT INTO #detail SELECT 0, stt_rec, 1, '', '', '', 0, 0, t_tien_nt2, 0, t_tien2, ten_vtthue, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #master			
			ELSE				
				INSERT INTO #detail SELECT 0, stt_rec, 1, '', '', '', 0, 0, t_tien_nt2, 0, t_tien2, ten_vtthue, '', ma_thue, thue_suatx, t_thue_nt, t_thue, 0, 0 FROM #master

			INSERT INTO #detail
				SELECT 0, stt_rec, 2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@detail, '%n', RTRIM(so_bk)), '%d', ngay_bk), '%m', thang_bk), '%y', nam_bk), '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #master
		END
	END

	--Them dong tien chiet khau
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_006' AND val = '1') AND @bk_yn = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @discountOut = ghi_chuthue, @tienOut = t_ck, @tien_ntOut = t_ck_nt from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@discountOut nvarchar(256) output, @tienOut numeric(28, 6) output, @tien_ntOut numeric(28, 6) output', @discount OUTPUT, @tien OUTPUT, @tien_nt OUTPUT
		IF @discount = ''
			SELECT @discount = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'
		IF @tien <> 0 OR @tien_nt <> 0 
			INSERT #detail (sysprint, stt_rec, ten_vt, km_yn, line_nbr, tien2, tien_nt2, detail) SELECT 0, @IDNumber, REPLACE(@discount, '''', ''''''), 0, MAX(line_nbr) + 1, @tien, @tien_nt, '' FROM #detail
	END

	SET @q = 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #copy(xGroup INT, ten_lien NVARCHAR(128), ten_lien2 NVARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = 1, @so_lien = so_lien FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVoucher
	SELECT ccode, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '') AS cname, cname2 INTO #reports FROM reports WHERE LEN(ccode) = 5 AND ccode LIKE (RTRIM('LIEN') + '%')
	SELECT @max = COUNT(*) FROM #reports
	WHILE @i <= @so_lien BEGIN
		IF @i <= @max BEGIN
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #copy SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', cname, cname2 FROM #reports WHERE ccode = ''LIEN' + RTRIM(@i) + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #copy VALUES(@i, '', '')
		END
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_thue, a.sysprint, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
			, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
			, c.doi_tac, c.ma_so_thue, c.dia_chi, c.dien_thoai, c.tk_nh, c.ngan_hang, c.tinh_thanh, c.ma_nt, c.ngay_ct, c.ky_hieu, c.so_ct, c.so_seri, c.ngay, c.thang, c.nam			
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 AND @printVATDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') THEN '\' ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(a.thue_suat) END ELSE c.thue_suat END AS thue_suat
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kh ELSE c.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.thanh_toan ELSE c.thanh_toan2 END AS thanh_toan
			, c.t_tien2, c.t_tien_nt2, c.t_thue, c.t_thue_nt, c.t_tt, c.t_tt_nt, c.t_tt_nt_in_word, c.t_tt_in_word, c.so_hd, c.ngay_hd, c.ht_tt, c.dd_gh, c.dd_nh, c.so_vd, c.so_con, c.dv_vc
			, so_bk, ngay_bk, thang_bk, nam_bk, c.dien_giai, c.customize, a.detail

			, a.thue_nt, a.thue
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 10 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_10
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 10 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END AS tien_10
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 5 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_5
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 5 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END AS tien_5
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 8 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_8
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 8 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END AS tien_8
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 0 AND CASE WHEN (@printVATDataDetail = 1 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '') OR (@printVATDataDetail = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_0
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 0 AND CASE WHEN (@printVATDataDetail = 1 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '') OR (@printVATDataDetail = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END AS tien_0						
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt ELSE 0 END  END AS tien_nt_99
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.tien2 - a.ck ELSE 0 END END AS tien_99
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 10 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_10
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 10 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_10
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 5 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_5
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 5 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_5
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 8 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_8
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 8 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_8
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 0 AND CASE WHEN (@printVATDataDetail = 1 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '') OR (@printVATDataDetail = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_0
			, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN a.thue_suat ELSE c.thue_suatx END = 0 AND CASE WHEN (@printVATDataDetail = 1 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '') OR (@printVATDataDetail = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_0			
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END  END AS thue_nt_99
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '') AND a.sysprint = 1 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END END AS thue_99

		INTO #report FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	IF @printVATDetail = 1 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #VAT) BEGIN
			UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
						, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
					FROM (SELECT SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
								, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
							FROM #VAT
						) b
		END ELSE
			UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
					, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
				FROM #report a JOIN (
						SELECT xGroup, SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
								, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
							FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup
					) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET so_lien = '', so_lien2 = '', doi_tac = '', ten_kh = '', ma_so_thue = '', dia_chi = '', dien_thoai = '', tk_nh = '', ngan_hang = '', tinh_thanh = '', thanh_toan = '', ma_nt = '', ngay_ct = NULL, ky_hieu = '', so_ct = '', so_seri = '', ngay = '', thang = '', nam = '', so_hd = '', ngay_hd = NULL, ht_tt = '', dd_gh = '', dd_nh = '', so_vd = '', so_con = '', dv_vc = '', so_bk = '', ngay_bk = '', thang_bk = '', nam_bk = '', dien_giai = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1
		UPDATE #report SET t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt_in_word = '', t_tt_in_word = '', tien_nt_10 = 0, tien_10 = 0, tien_nt_5 = 0, tien_5 = 0, tien_nt_8 = 0, tien_8 = 0, tien_nt_0 = 0, tien_0 = 0, thue_nt_10 = 0, thue_10 = 0, thue_nt_5 = 0, thue_5 = 0, thue_nt_8 = 0, thue_8 = 0, thue_nt_0 = 0, thue_0 = 0, thue_nt_99 = 0, thue_99 = 0 WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
		UPDATE #report SET customize = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1 AND line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
		IF @printVATDetail = 0 BEGIN
			IF @printVATDataDetail = 1 UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = b.thue_suat FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT xGroup, MAX(thue_suat) AS thue_suat FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup WHERE line_nbr = (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
			UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
		END ELSE
			UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE  so_luong = 0 AND tien2 = 0
	END

	IF @printVATDetail = 1
		SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT sysprint, line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup, so_lien, so_lien2
				, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam
				, thue_suat, ten_kh, thanh_toan	, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word
				, so_hd, ngay_hd, ht_tt, dd_gh, dd_nh, so_vd, so_con, dv_vc, so_bk, ngay_bk, thang_bk, nam_bk, dien_giai, customize, detail
			FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_EmployeeTimeInOutAdjustingCopy]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@SourceEmployee VARCHAR(33),
	@DepartmentRef VARCHAR(128),
	@EmployeeList VARCHAR(8000),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #hrnv FROM hrnv

	SET @Key = 'e.bp_ref like ''' + REPLACE(@DepartmentRef, '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @EmployeeList <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @EmployeeList = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmployeeList), ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''')
		SELECT @Key = 'e.ma_nv in (''' + @EmployeeList + ''')'
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #hrnv select stt_rec from hrnv e with(nolock) where (e.status = ''1'' or e.ngay_nghi > ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + ''') and e.stt_rec <> ''' + REPLACE(@SourceEmployee, '''', '''''') + ''' and '+ @Key
	EXECUTE sp_executesql @q

	IF @Type = 1
		DELETE hrdcvaora FROM hrdcvaora a JOIN #hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay = @Date
	ELSE
		DELETE #hrnv FROM #hrnv a JOIN hrdcvaora b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ngay = @Date

	INSERT INTO hrdcvaora(stt_rec, ngay, gio, hs_yn, gio0, vao_ra, thoi_gian, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT e.stt_rec, b.ngay, b.gio, b.hs_yn, b.gio0, b.vao_ra, b.thoi_gian, b.ghi_chu, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #hrnv e CROSS JOIN hrdcvaora b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay = @Date AND b.stt_rec = @SourceEmployee

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbikbcdhtvt] AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_kh, c.ten_kh2, b.ds_dvcs, c.ds_dvmh
	FROM dbo.bikbcdhtvt a 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt 		
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

GO
