AS
	SELECT a.*, b.name, b.comment, b.comment2
		FROM dbo.kbmailduyet a			
			LEFT JOIN dbo.vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id4 = b.id

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs30_FACalcValueAdjust]
	@so_the_ts VARCHAR(33)
	, @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	, @ma_nv VARCHAR(33)
	, @ma_tg_ts VARCHAR(33)
	, @nam NUMERIC(4)
	, @ky NUMERIC(2)
	, @so_ky_kh INT
	, @gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6)
	, @gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ma_nt VARCHAR(33), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33), @m_round_tien TINYINT, @m_round_tien_nt TINYINT
	DECLARE @01 INT, @02 NUMERIC(28, 6), @02_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @03 NUMERIC(28, 6), @03_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @04 NUMERIC(28, 6), @04_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @05 NUMERIC(28, 6), @05_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @ma_nt = ma_nt FROM dmts WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @m_round_tien = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @m_round_tien_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	IF @ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0 SET @m_round_tien_nt = @m_round_tien

	-- 01. So ky con lai
	IF @so_ky_kh = 0
		SELECT @01 = so_ky_kh + dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_kh0) - dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@ky, @nam)) FROM dmts WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts
	ELSE
		SELECT @01 = @so_ky_kh
	-- 02. Gia tri khau hao ky truoc dieu chinh
	SELECT @02 = ISNULL(SUM(gt_kh_ky), 0), @02_nt = ISNULL(SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt), 0)
		FROM (
			SELECT a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt
				FROM ctdmts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE b.so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = @ma_nv
			UNION ALL
			SELECT gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam * 12 + ky <= @nam * 12 + @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 1)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(ma_tg_ts) + STR(nam, 4) + STR(ky, 2) <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(@ma_tg_ts) + STR(@nam, 4) + STR(@ky, 2))
			UNION ALL
			SELECT - gt_kh_ky, - gt_kh_ky_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam * 12 + ky <= @nam * 12 + @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(ma_tg_ts) + STR(nam, 4) + STR(ky, 2) <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(@ma_tg_ts) + STR(@nam, 4) + STR(@ky, 2))
			) a

	-- 03. Gia tri khau hao ky sau dieu chinh
	SELECT gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #tmp
		FROM ctkhts 
		WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv 
			AND (nam * 12 + ky) IN (
						SELECT MAX(nam * 12 + ky) FROM ctkhts 
							WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND (nam * 12 + ky) < (@nam * 12 + @ky))
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #tmp)
		INSERT INTO #tmp
			SELECT gt_cl, gt_cl_nt FROM ctdmts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE b.so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND a.ma_nv = @ma_nv 

	SELECT @03 = CASE WHEN @01 <> 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(gt_cl) / @01, @m_round_tien) ELSE 0 END, @03_nt = CASE WHEN @01 <> 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(gt_cl_nt) / @01, @m_round_tien_nt) ELSE 0 END
		FROM (
			SELECT * FROM #tmp
			UNION ALL
			SELECT gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam = @nam AND ky = @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 1)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) +  RTRIM(ma_tg_ts) <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) +  RTRIM(@ma_tg_ts))
			UNION ALL
			SELECT - gt_cl, - gt_cl_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam = @nam AND ky = @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) +  RTRIM(ma_tg_ts) <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) +  RTRIM(@ma_tg_ts))
			UNION ALL
			SELECT @gt_cl, @gt_cl_nt WHERE @ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 1)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT - @gt_cl, - @gt_cl_nt WHERE @ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2)
			) a
/*
	SELECT @03 = CASE WHEN @01 <> 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(gt_cl) / @01, @m_round_tien) ELSE 0 END, @03_nt = CASE WHEN @01 <> 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(gt_cl_nt) / @01, @m_round_tien_nt) ELSE 0 END
		FROM (
			SELECT gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				FROM ctkhts WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv 
				AND (nam * 12 + ky) IN (
							SELECT MAX(nam * 12 + ky) FROM ctkhts 
								WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND (nam * 12 + ky) < (@nam * 12 + @ky)
							)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam = @nam AND ky = @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 1)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + ma_tg_ts <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) + @ma_tg_ts)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT - gt_cl, - gt_cl_nt
				FROM ctdmts1 WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nv = @ma_nv AND nam = @nam AND ky = @ky
					AND ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2)
					AND (@ngay_ct IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + ma_tg_ts <> CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ngay_ct, 112) + @ma_tg_ts)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT @gt_cl, @gt_cl_nt WHERE @ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 1)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT - @gt_cl, - @gt_cl_nt WHERE @ma_tg_ts IN (SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE loai_tg_ts = 2)
			) a
*/
	-- 04. Gia tri dieu chinh khau hao ky
	SELECT @04 = @03 - @02, @04_nt = @03_nt - @02_nt
	-- 05. Gia tri khau hao ky sau dieu chinh
	SELECT @05 = @03, @05_nt = @03_nt

	IF EXISTS(SELECT ma_tg_ts FROM dmtgts WHERE ma_tg_ts = @ma_tg_ts AND loai_tg_ts = 2)
		SELECT @04 = - @04, @04_nt = - @04_nt

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmts WHERE so_the_ts = @so_the_ts AND ma_nt IN (SELECT val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'))
		SELECT @02_nt = @02, @03_nt = @03, @04_nt = @04, @05_nt = @05

	SELECT ISNULL(@01, 0) AS _01, ISNULL(@02, 0) AS _02, ISNULL(@02_nt, 0) AS _02_nt, ISNULL(@03, 0) AS _03, ISNULL(@03_nt, 0) AS _03_nt, ISNULL(@04, 0) AS _04, ISNULL(@04_nt, 0) AS _04_nt, ISNULL(@05, 0) AS _05, ISNULL(@05_nt, 0) AS _05_nt
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodSalesAnalysis2] -- fs20_SOSalesAnalysis4MC
	@Time AS CHAR(1),
	@Count AS INT,
	@DateStart AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32), 	
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@SalesEmployee AS VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),  
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Size TINYINT, 
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), 
	@ReportType CHAR(1), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024), @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sQuantity NVARCHAR(1024), @sAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @sFCAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @ct_giam VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @ct_giam = '''HD2'', ''HD4'''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sQuantity = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT001'
	SELECT @sAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT002'
	SELECT @sFCAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT003'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_ct, loai_ct, nxt, ma_vt, ma_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_nt AS ck_tl, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt INTO #temp FROM wrkin a
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkin	
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xCycle, ma_vt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS cKey INTO #report FROM wrkin

	SELECT @DateEnd = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
		WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
		WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7 * @Count, @DateStart)
		WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
		WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3 * @Count, @DateStart)
		WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6 * @Count, @DateStart)
		WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12 * @Count, @DateStart)
	END)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 + @ItemType <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nxt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt
		, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien2 end
		, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end
		, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck end
		, case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck_nt end'
		
	SET @q = @q + ', case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.sl_xuat end as so_luong_tl, a.sl_nhap as so_luong_tl, case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then (tien2) else 0 end as giam_gia, case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then (tien_nt2) else 0 end as giam_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when nxt = 1 then tien2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl, case when nxt = 1 then tien_nt2 else 0 end as doanh_thu_tl_nt, case when nxt = 1 then ck else 0 end as ck_tl, case when nxt = 1 then ck_nt else 0 end as ck_tl_nt'

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, SUM(a.so_luong - so_luong_tl), SUM(a.tien2 - ck - (-giam_gia) - doanh_thu_tl + ck_tl)
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) THEN 0 ELSE a.tien_nt2 - ck_nt - (-giam_gia_nt) - doanh_thu_tl_nt + ck_tl_nt END) FROM #temp a GROUP BY a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #temp WHERE ma_ct IN('HDR', 'HDF', 'HD2', 'HD4')
		INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, SUM(a.so_luong), SUM(a.tien2), SUM(CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) THEN 0 ELSE a.tien_nt2 END) FROM #temp a GROUP BY a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt
	END

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @DateStart
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
				WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(DAY, 7, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @d) END)
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, @i, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @d AND @d2 GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 0, @i, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1	
	END

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #o (stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, ma_vt VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
	CREATE INDEX o ON #o(ma_vt)
	INSERT INTO #o SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, 0, '', 0, 0, 0, ''
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, a.stt, REPLACE(STR(a.xCycle, 3), ' ', '0') AS xCycle, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, b.dvt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.xCycle

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header INT NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT DISTINCT xCycle FROM #report ORDER BY xCycle
	
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'so_luong$', @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien2$', @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien_nt2$', @sFCAmount

	SELECT a.id, b.id AS id2, b.name + LTRIM(a.id) AS name, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(a.header) + ' - ' + b.header AS header
		INTO #pivot 
		FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b 
	
	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 1, 'so_luong', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien_nt2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sFCAmount

	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, id2
	DROP TABLE #pivot

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIRankingListOfVendors]
	@PeriodType CHAR(2),
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@Vendor VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Graph CHAR(1) = N'0',
	@object_value VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @gItem CHAR(16), @joinItem NVARCHAR(1024), @joinCustomer NVARCHAR(1024), @tableData NVARCHAR(128), @i INT, @n INT, @markRound INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST (0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST (0 AS INT) AS sysprint, CAST (0 AS INT) AS systotal, CAST (0 AS INT) AS stt
			, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, a.ma_vt, c.ten_vt, a.diem_so AS diem_tong, a.diem_so AS diem_tb, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS chenh_lech
			, a.diem_so AS diem1, a.diem_so AS diem2, a.diem_so AS diem3, a.diem_so AS diem4, a.diem_so AS diem5
		INTO #report FROM bidgkq00$0000 a, dmkh b, dmvt c

	-- PurOrgKey
	SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Join
	SELECT @joinItem = ' left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt', @joinCustomer = ' left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	--
	IF @Vendor <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Vendor, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Item, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @object_value <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@object_value, '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	-- Score
	SELECT @tableData = CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN 'bidgkqkh02' ELSE 'bidgkq02' END
	IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'k.ten_kh' ELSE 'k.ten_kh2' END
		IF (@ReportType = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, ''''' ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.diem_so, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinCustomer
		IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Update Average Score and Variance
	SELECT @markRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_diem'
	SELECT ma_vt,ROUND(SUM(diem_tong)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb INTO #sumScore FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #report SET diem_tb = b.diem_tb FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #sumScore b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	UPDATE #report SET chenh_lech = CASE WHEN diem_tb = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((diem_tong - diem_tb)/diem_tb) * 100, 2) END


	-- Update Main Evaluation Criterion
	SELECT @tableData = CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN 'bidgkqkh01' ELSE 'bidgkq01' END
	IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kh, loai_chi_tieu, diem_so INTO #loai FROM bidgkq01$0000
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #loai select '
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'a.ma_vt, ' ELSE ''''', ' END + 'a.ma_kh, a.loai_chi_tieu, a.diem_so'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)'
		IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' OR @VendorGroup2 <> '' OR @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @joinCustomer
		IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= 5 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set diem' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = isnull(b.diem_so, 0)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #loai b' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN ' on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh' ELSE ' on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' END
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and b.loai_chi_tieu = ''' + RTRIM(@i) + '0'''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END


	-- Group
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = SPACE(2) + ten_kh
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 3, 1, 0, null, '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', rtrim(a.ma_vt) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'
			THEN ' case when max(v.ten_vt) = '''' then '''' else '' - '' + max(v.ten_vt) end'
			ELSE ' case when max(v.ten_vt2) = '''' then '''' else '' - '' + max(v.ten_vt2) end' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(v.ten_vt)' ELSE 'max(v.ten_vt2)' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a ' + @joinItem + ' group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Rank
	CREATE TABLE #stt(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, diem_tong NUMERIC(28, 6))
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #g(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, ma_vt CHAR(16))
		INSERT INTO #g(ma_vt) SELECT ma_vt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_vt

		SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(1) FROM #g
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #stt
			SELECT @gItem = ma_vt FROM #g WHERE id = @i
			INSERT INTO #stt(diem_tong) SELECT DISTINCT diem_tong FROM #report WHERE ma_vt = @gItem AND systotal = 1 ORDER BY diem_tong DESC
			UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.diem_tong = b.diem_tong AND a.ma_vt = @gItem WHERE a.systotal = 1
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #stt(diem_tong) SELECT DISTINCT(diem_tong) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 ORDER BY diem_tong DESC
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.diem_tong = b.diem_tong
	END


	-- Browse
	IF @Graph = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT *, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_tb1, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_tb2, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_tb3, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_tb4, CAST (0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_tb5
			INTO #t FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5

		SELECT ma_vt
				, ROUND(SUM(diem1)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb1
				, ROUND(SUM(diem2)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb2
				, ROUND(SUM(diem3)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb3
				, ROUND(SUM(diem4)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb4
				, ROUND(SUM(diem5)/COUNT(1), @markRound) AS diem_tb5
			INTO #sumScoreGraph FROM #t GROUP BY ma_vt

		UPDATE #t SET diem_tb1 = b.diem_tb1, diem_tb2 = b.diem_tb2, diem_tb3 = b.diem_tb3, diem_tb4 = b.diem_tb4, diem_tb5 = b.diem_tb5
			FROM #t a LEFT JOIN #sumScoreGraph b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE sysorder = 5

		SELECT '' AS array$, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kh, ten_kh, ma_vt, ten_vt, diem_tong, diem_tb, chenh_lech
				, diem_tong AS diem0, diem_tong - diem_tb AS chenh_lech0
				, diem1, diem1 - diem_tb1 AS chenh_lech1
				, diem2, diem2 - diem_tb2 AS chenh_lech2
				, diem3, diem3 - diem_tb3 AS chenh_lech3
				, diem4, diem4 - diem_tb4 AS chenh_lech4
				, diem5, diem5 - diem_tb5 AS chenh_lech5
			FROM #t WHERE sysorder = 5 ORDER BY ma_vt, stt
	END ELSE SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vt, stt


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintISTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Transaction VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@InventoryAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Reason VARCHAR(1023),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@DataType CHAR(1) = '2' -- 1: Physics, 2: Book
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024), @tName VARCHAR(33)

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @tName = '84'
		ELSE SELECT @tName = '38'

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '', @KeyDetail = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Transaction <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Transaction), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Admin = 0 SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @KeyDetail = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @InventoryAccount <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@InventoryAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#40$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyDetail <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyDetail), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i' + @tName + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m' + @tName + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPDetailReports]
	@dFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@cItem AS VARCHAR(33),
	@cAction AS VARCHAR(4000),
	@cVersion CHAR(2),
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@nDateFormat INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSize TINYINT
	SET @nSize = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')

	DECLARE @cActionMessage NVARCHAR(128), @cQtyFormat VARCHAR(20)
	SELECT @cQtyFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, a.nguon AS loai_dh, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, b.ten_cb, a.nguon, c.ten_nguon,
		a.so_dh AS so_ct, a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, a.ngay_yc, a.nxt, a.muc_do, a.stt, a.stt_rec
		INTO #rs
		FROM mrctyc a, mrdmcb b, mrdmnguon c

	ALTER TABLE #rs ALTER COLUMN ma_sp CHAR(16)NULL
	ALTER TABLE #rs ALTER COLUMN ten_cb NVARCHAR(128) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #rs ALTER COLUMN ten_nguon NVARCHAR(128) NULL

	IF @cVersion = '' BEGIN
		INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
			CASE
				WHEN nguon IN ('FP', 'PL') AND sl_da_yc > 0 THEN 'PR'
				ELSE nguon
			END AS loai_dh, 
			a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END AS ten_cb, 
			a.nguon, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
			a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
			a.ngay_yc,a.nxt, a.muc_do, a.stt, a.stt_rec
		FROM mrctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
			AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')
			AND dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 1
	END 
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
			a.nguon, 
			a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, '',			
			a.nguon, 
			CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
			CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
			a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
			a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
			a.ngay_yc,
			a.nxt, 
			a.muc_do, 
			a.stt, 
			a.stt_rec
		FROM mrhistory a LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
			AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')			
			AND a.version = @cVersion

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #rs ) BEGIN
			INSERT #rs SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, 
				a.nguon, 
				a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_dat, a.ma_cb, '',				
				a.nguon, 
				CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_nguon ELSE c.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_nguon, 
				CASE WHEN a.so_lsx <> '' THEN RIGHT(a.so_lsx, @nSize) ELSE a.so_dh END AS so_ct, 
				a.sl_xuat, a.sl_ton, a.ma_sp, a.nc_rong, 
				a.sl_dh, a.sl_da_yc, a.xac_nhan, a.sl_yc, 
				a.ngay_yc,
				a.nxt, 
				a.muc_do, 
				a.stt, 
				a.stt_rec
			FROM mrctyc a LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon c ON a.nguon = c.ma_nguon
			WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo
				AND a.ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%')					
				AND a.nguon <> 'PL' -- AND a.nguon <> 'FP'
		END

		-- Action Message		
		EXEC rs_RunGenerateActionMessage '#rs', 2, 1, NULL
		IF RTRIM(@cAction) <> '' DELETE #rs WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_cb, RTRIM(@cAction)) = 0
		UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_cb ELSE b.ten_cb2 END FROM #rs a LEFT JOIN mpdmcb b ON a.ma_cb = b.ma_cb
	END

	-- Action Message
	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '11'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '12'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '01' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '21'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '22'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat))))  WHERE ma_cb = '02' AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '31'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '32'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc > sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '33'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc < ngay_ct

	SELECT @cActionMessage = LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN ten_cb ELSE ten_cb2 END)) FROM mrdmcb WHERE ma_cb = '34'
	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = REPLACE(REPLACE(@cActionMessage, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @cQtyFormat)))), '%d', RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ngay_yc, @nDateFormat)))) WHERE ma_cb = '03' AND sl_yc < sl_nhap AND ngay_yc > ngay_ct

	UPDATE #rs SET ten_cb = '' WHERE ten_cb IS NULL

	SELECT a.*
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN b.ten_nguon ELSE b.ten_nguon2 END AS ten_dh
			, CASE WHEN @cLan = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
			, c.dvt
		FROM #rs a
			LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon b ON a.loai_dh = b.ma_nguon
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_vt, ngay_ct, nxt, muc_do, stt 
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTMPlan]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@CourseCode VARCHAR(33),
	@SubjectCode VARCHAR(33),
	@TrainingProvider VARCHAR(33),
	@TrainingType VARCHAR(33),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	--Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ma_khoa, a.ten_khoa, b.ten_mh AS mon_hoc, c.ten_loai AS loai_hinh_dt, doi_tuong AS doi_tuong_dt, ngay_du_kien1 AS tu_ngay, ngay_du_kien2 AS den_ngay, sl_hv_dk AS sl_hv, t_cp_dk AS tong_cp
		INTO #report
		FROM hrdtkh a, hrdmmh b, hrdmlhdt c

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_du_kien1 between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and '''+ CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @CourseCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_khoa like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CourseCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SubjectCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_mh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SubjectCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TrainingProvider <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dvdt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TrainingProvider), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TrainingType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_hinh_dt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TrainingType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report '	
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_khoa, a.ten_khoa%l, b.ten_mh%l, c.ten_loai%l, a.doi_tuong, a.ngay_du_kien1, a.ngay_du_kien2, a.sl_hv_dk, t_cp_dk'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from hrdtkh a with(nolock) left join hrdmmh b with(nolock) on a.ma_mh = b.ma_mh left join hrdmlhdt c with(nolock) on a.loai_hinh_dt = c.ma_loai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_khoa'
	--
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists(select 1 from #report) select 0 as stt, 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, '''' as ma_khoa, '''' as ten_khoa, '''' as mon_hoc, '''' as loai_hinh_dt, '''' as doi_tuong_dt, null as tu_ngay, null as den_ngay, 0 as sl_hv, 0 as tong_cp'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'else select * from #report order by stt'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesEmployeesBalance]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@Group0 CHAR(1),-- 1 - Nhân viên bán hàng, 2 - Khách hàng, 0 - Không
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @BalanceKey NVARCHAR(1023), @ArisingKey NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_nvbh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b1 FROM cdnvbh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b2 FROM cdnvbh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, s1 AS ma_nv, ma_kh, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, ma_nv, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt, a.ma_kh, b.ten_nvbh AS ten_nv, b.ten_nvbh2 AS ten_nv2, c.ten_kh AS ten_kh, c.ten_kh2 AS ten_kh2, b.ten_nvbh AS ten_nv_sx INTO #report FROM #t a, dmnvbh b, dmkh c

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_nv, ten_nv, ten_nv2, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, ten_nv_sx', 'int, varchar(16), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), varchar(16), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF ISNULL(@SalesEmployeeColumn, '') = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)
		SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_nv AS ma_nvbh, ten_nv AS ten, ten_nv2 AS ten2, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt, ma_nv AS ma2 FROM #report
		RETURN
	END

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @BalanceKey = ''
	IF @Group0 <> '0' SET @BalanceKey = 'ma_kh <> '''''
	SET @BalanceKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@BalanceKey)
	SET @ArisingKey = @BalanceKey
	--


	IF @Group0 <> '0' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b2 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployeeCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @SalesEmployee, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @SalesEmployeeColumn, '', @BalanceKey, '', @ArisingKey
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #b2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b1 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployee @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @SalesEmployee, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @SalesEmployeeColumn, '', @BalanceKey, '', @ArisingKey
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select tk, ma_nvbh, '''', du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #b1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	SET @ArisingKey = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @ArisingKey END
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @ArisingKey = @ArisingKey + ' and a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @ArisingKey = @ArisingKey + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @ArisingKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@ArisingKey)
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t select '''', a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 <> '0' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) '
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @ArisingKey + ']% group by a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + '' + CASE WHEN @Group0 <> '0' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Summary
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, '''', a.ma_nv, sum(no_dk), sum(no_dk_nt), sum(co_dk), sum(co_dk_nt), sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), sum(no_ck), sum(no_ck_nt), sum(co_ck), sum(co_ck_nt), a.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_nvbh)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_nvbh2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(c.ten_kh)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(c.ten_kh2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_nvbh)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_nvbh2)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a left join dmnvbh b on a.ma_nv = b.ma_nvbh left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_nv, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Group0 = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @o = 'ma_kh, ' + @Order + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '_nv' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '_nv' ELSE '_nv2' END END
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'nv', 'no_dk,co_dk,ps_no,ps_co,no_ck,co_ck,no_dk_nt,co_dk_nt,ps_no_nt,ps_co_nt,no_ck_nt,co_ck_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE
		IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT @o = 'ma_nv, ' + @Order + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '_kh' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '_kh' ELSE '_kh2' END END
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_nv', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
			SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_nv', 'kh', 'no_dk,co_dk,ps_no,ps_co,no_ck,co_ck,no_dk_nt,co_dk_nt,ps_no_nt,ps_co_nt,no_ck_nt,co_ck_nt', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			UPDATE #report SET ten_nv = b.ten_nvbh, ten_nv2 = b.ten_nvbh2, ten_nv_sx = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_nvbh ELSE b.ten_nvbh2 END FROM #report a JOIN dmnvbh b ON a.ma_nv = b.ma_nvbh WHERE systotal = 0
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @o = @Order + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '_nv' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '_nv' ELSE '_nv2' END END
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		END

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_nv, ten_nv2, ten_kh, ten_kh2, no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, @s, @s, SUM(No_dk), SUM(Co_dk), SUM(No_dk_nt), SUM(Co_dk_nt), SUM(Ps_no), SUM(Ps_no_nt), SUM(Ps_co), SUM(Ps_co_nt), SUM(No_ck), SUM(Co_ck), SUM(No_ck_nt), SUM(Co_ck_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ma_kh as ma_nvbh, ten_kh as ten, ten_kh2 as ten2, ma_nv as ma2'
		SET @q = @q + ', no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report order by ' + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN 'ma_nv' ELSE 'ten_nv_sx' END + ', sysorder, stt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ma_nv as ma_nvbh, ten_nv as ten, ten_nv2 as ten2, ma_kh as ma2'
		SET @q = @q + ', no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report order by ma_kh, sysorder, ' + @Order + '_nv' + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END END + ', stt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs20_GetAutoVNo @ma_nk VARCHAR(33)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @curVNo VARCHAR(33), @newVNo VARCHAR(33), @maxVNo VARCHAR(33), @minVNo VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @curVNo = so_ct0, @maxVNo = so_ct2, @minVNo = so_ct1 FROM v20dmnk WHERE ma_nk = @ma_nk
	SELECT @newVNo = dbo.ff20_GetAutoVNo(@curVNo, -1)
	IF @newVNo > @maxVNo AND @maxVNo <> ''
		SELECT dbo.ff20_GetAutoVNo(@curVNo, 999999999999) AS so_ct, dbo.ff20_GetAutoVNo(@curVNo, 999999999999) AS so_ct_max
	ELSE
		SELECT @newVNo AS so_ct, dbo.ff20_GetAutoVNo(@curVNo, 999999999999) AS so_ct_max
END
GO
CREATE TRIGGER iDmkc ON dbo.dmkc 
FOR INSERT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nAuto NUMERIC(18), @nNumber INT
	SELECT @nAuto = MAX(stt_rec) FROM dmkc
	SELECT @nNumber = stt FROM inserted
	UPDATE dmkc SET stt_rec = @nAuto + 1 WHERE stt = @nNumber
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Account]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Account, 2 Multi Account
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@Date, @BalanceType)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdtk

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	-- Balance (year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk a with(nolock, index(nam_tk)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4)
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with(nolock, index(tk)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where 1 = 1'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, sum(du_no) as du_no, sum(du_co) as du_co, sum(du_no_nt) as du_no_nt, sum(du_co_nt) as du_co_nt from #t group by tk order by tk'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPRTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	--IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, g.ten_vt'+ @cE + ' as ten_vt0, g.ten_vt2 as ten_vt02, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.ngay_yc'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt0'',''ngay_yc'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff30_FC1]()
RETURNS VARCHAR(33)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)
	SET @cReturn = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') SELECT @cReturn = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_nt1'
	RETURN ISNULL(@cReturn, '')
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintVATranMultiCopies]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@cMTable CHAR(10),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),	
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @so_lien INT, @max INT, @ext VARCHAR(6)
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511), @printTable VARCHAR(32), @printJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @ext = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM m42$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai
			, b.doi_tac, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS thanh_toan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS thanh_toan2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt AS t_tt, a.t_tt_nt AS t_tt_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS thue_suat, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS sd_hddt_yn, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS in_yn
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM wrkartran a, dmkh b

	SELECT @eiFields = ' isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), ''''), a.so_seri, a.so_ct', @eiJoin = '', @printJoin = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @ei001 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
		SELECT @ei002 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		SELECT @eiFields = N' isnull(case when w.mau_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei001) + ''' else w.mau_hddt end, isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''')),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_seri_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei002) + ''' else w.so_seri_hddt end, a.so_seri),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_ct_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei003) + ''' else w.so_ct_hddt end, a.so_ct)',
			@eiJoin = ' left join hddt00$' + @ext + ' w with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = w.stt_rec'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = N'm_sl_in' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @printTable = 'hdin$' + @ext, @printJoin = ' left join ' + @printTable + ' p with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec'
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh,' + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ong_ba, e.ten_kh, e.ten_kh, e.ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(d.thue_suat) end'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word'	
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @eiJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when w.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @printJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when p.in_yn = 1 then 1 else 0 end' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @cMTable + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + @cDTable + ' d with(nolock) on (a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec and d.stt_rec0 = (select min(stt_rec0) from ' + @cDTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = a.stt_rec)) left join ctgt21 e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk' + @eiJoin + @printJoin
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(8)) AS ma_thue, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS thue_suat, thue_nt, thue INTO #detail FROM wrksvdetail a, dmvt b
	SET @q =  'insert into #detail select 1, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, cast('''' as nvarchar(33)), 0, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt, a.tien_nt2, gia, a.tien2, a.dien_giai' --Service Invoice
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ', a.ma_thue, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 12, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #detail set stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #copy(xGroup INT, ten_lien NVARCHAR(128), ten_lien2 NVARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = 1, @so_lien = so_lien FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVoucher
	SELECT ccode, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '') AS cname, cname2 INTO #reports FROM reports WHERE LEN(ccode) = 5 AND ccode LIKE (RTRIM('LIEN') + '%')
	SELECT @max = COUNT(*) FROM #reports
	WHILE @i <= @so_lien BEGIN
		IF @i <= @max BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #copy select ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', cname, cname2 from #reports where ccode = ''LIEN' + RTRIM(@i) + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #copy VALUES(@i, '', '')
		END
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.sysprint, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
			, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
			, c.doi_tac, c.ma_so_thue, c.dia_chi, c.dien_thoai, c.tk_nh, c.ngan_hang, c.tinh_thanh, c.ma_nt, c.ngay_ct, c.ky_hieu, c.so_ct, c.so_seri, c.ngay, c.thang, c.nam
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') THEN '/' ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(a.thue_suat) END ELSE c.thue_suat END AS thue_suat
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kh ELSE c.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS thanh_toan
			, c.t_tien2, c.t_tien_nt2, c.t_thue, c.t_thue_nt, c.t_tt, c.t_tt_nt, c.t_tt_nt_in_word, c.t_tt_in_word
			, c.dien_giai, c.customize, a.detail

			, a.thue_nt, a.thue
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (10, 7) THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_10, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (10, 7) THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_10
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (5, 3.5) THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_5, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (5, 3.5) THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_5
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_8, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_8
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_0, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_0
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_99, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_99
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (10, 7) THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_10, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (10, 7) THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_10
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (5, 3.5) THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_5, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat IN (5, 3.5) THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_5
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_8, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 8 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_8
			, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_0, CASE WHEN a.thue_suat = 0 AND a.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND a.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_0
			, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_99, CASE WHEN a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_99
		INTO #report FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

		UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
				, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT xGroup, SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
							, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
						FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup
				) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup

	UPDATE #report SET so_lien = '', so_lien2 = '', dien_giai = '', doi_tac = '', ten_kh = '', ma_so_thue = '', dia_chi = '', dien_thoai = '', tk_nh = '', ngan_hang = '', tinh_thanh = '', ma_nt = '', ngay_ct = NULL, ky_hieu = '', so_ct = '', so_seri = '', ngay = '', thang = '', nam = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1
	UPDATE #report SET t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt_in_word = '', t_tt_in_word = '', tien_nt_10 = 0, tien_10 = 0, tien_nt_5 = 0, tien_5 = 0, tien_nt_8 = 0, tien_8 = 0, tien_nt_0 = 0, tien_0 = 0, thue_nt_10 = 0, thue_10 = 0, thue_nt_5 = 0, thue_5 = 0, thue_nt_8 = 0, thue_8 = 0, thue_nt_0 = 0, thue_0 = 0, thue_nt_99 = 0, thue_99 = 0 WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	UPDATE #report SET customize = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1 AND line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 0
			UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 1
		SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup
				, so_lien, so_lien2, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam, thue_suat
				, ten_kh, thanh_toan, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word, dien_giai, customize, detail
			FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPeriodicTrans]
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(4000), 
	@Table CHAR(10), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @q = 'select b.ma_bt, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.dien_giai as description, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmpbky1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if exists(select 1 from #report) begin'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select ma_bt, line_nbr, identity(int, 1, 1) as stt into #o from #report group by ma_bt, line_nbr order by ma_bt, line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update #report set line_nbr = b.stt from #report a join #o b on a.ma_bt = b.ma_bt and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
