CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs30_ReCaclPaymentERD] @cVC CHAR(3), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @Group VARCHAR(128), @nCharge TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cIDLineNumber CHAR(3), @nRound INT, @cBaseCur VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT * INTO #master FROM wrkcdtran
	SELECT * INTO #detail FROM wrkcddetail
	SELECT * INTO #inputvat FROM wrkinputvat

	SELECT @cIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, '''', '')
	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cBaseCur = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #inputvat' + ' select * from ctgt30 where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #master WHERE sua_tg_yn = 1) BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @nMethod INT, @cAccount VARCHAR(33), @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cCust VARCHAR(33), @cUnit VARCHAR(33), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @cNumber VARCHAR(33), @nRate NUMERIC(38, 20), 
		@cFC VARCHAR(33), @cFC_i VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @cCust = ma_kh, @cUnit = ma_dvcs, @dVC = ngay_ct, @cNumber = so_ct, @cFC = ma_nt FROM #master

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #master WHERE loai_ct = '2')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
			OPEN crPaymentERD
			FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @cAccount = tk_no, @nFCAmount = tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
					SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_no FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
					IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2
						BEGIN
							EXEC fs_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, 1, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cNumber, 1, @nRate OUTPUT
							UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate, tien = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound), tt = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
						END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber	
				END
			CLOSE crPaymentERD
			DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD
		END

	--
	SELECT @cAccount = tk, @nFCAmount = t_tt_nt FROM #master
	SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
	IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, 1, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cNumber, 1, @nRate OUTPUT
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1', '2'))
				UPDATE #master SET ty_gia = @nRate
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('9'))
				UPDATE #master SET ty_gia_ht = @nRate
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1'))
				BEGIN
					DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT a.stt_rec0, b.ma_nt AS ma_nt_i FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec WHERE b.loai_tt = 0 ORDER BY a.line_nbr
					OPEN crPaymentERD
					FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber, @cFC_i
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
							UPDATE #detail SET tien = ROUND(tien_nt * @nRate, @nRound), thue = ROUND(thue_nt * @nRate, @nRound), tt = ROUND(tt_nt * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
							IF @cFC_i = '' SET @cFC_i = @cBaseCur
							IF @cFC_i <> @cFC AND @cFC_i = @cBaseCur
								UPDATE #detail SET tt_qd = tien WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
							--
							FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber, @cFC_i
						END
					CLOSE crPaymentERD
					DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD
				END				
		END

	UPDATE #master SET t_thue = b.thue, t_tien = b.tt - b.thue, t_tt = b.tt
		FROM #master a JOIN (
					SELECT SUM(tt) AS tt, SUM(thue) AS thue
						FROM (
							SELECT SUM(tt) AS tt, SUM(thue) AS thue FROM #detail
							UNION ALL
							SELECT 0, SUM(t_thue) FROM #inputvat WHERE CAST(stt_rec0 AS INT) >= 500
							) a
					) b ON 1 = 1

	SELECT @q = 'UPDATE @cDetailTable SET ty_gia_ht2 = b.ty_gia_ht2, tien = b.tien, thue = b.thue, tt = b.tt, tt_qd = b.tt_qd FROM @cDetailTable a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' + 
		CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE @cMasterTable SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, ty_gia_ht = b.ty_gia_ht, t_tien = b.t_tien, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_tt = b.t_tt FROM @cMasterTable a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
		CHAR(13) + 'EXEC fs_PostCDTran %@cMasterTable%, %@cDetailTable%, %@cIDNumber%, %@Group%, 2, null, ' + RTRIM(@nCharge)

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable)
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cIDNumber', @cIDNumber)
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Group', @Group)
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%', CHAR(39))


	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_VendorEvaluationByInspection]
	@ScoreRound INT,
	@CalcInspectionScore BIT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @dateTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_chi_tieu, diem_ngam_dinh, loai_tinh_diem, kieu_tinh INTO #kb FROM #kbct WHERE kieu_tinh IN ('1', '2') AND ma_pp = '30'
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kb) RETURN

	-- Tính điểm chất lượng
	IF @CalcInspectionScore = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @dateTo = ngay_kt from #dotdg
		SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, ngay_ct, stt_rec_ng AS stt_rec_kd, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS diem_so INTO #$qdsd FROM #ngdg WHERE nguon_xd = '#KD'
		EXEC bs_CalculateInspectionScore '#$qdsd', @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		UPDATE #ngdg SET diem_so = ROUND(b.diem_so, @ScoreRound) FROM #ngdg a JOIN #$qdsd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.nguon_xd = '#KD'
	END

	-- Tính đánh giá
	SELECT * INTO #ins FROM #ngdg WHERE nguon_xd = '#KD'

	SELECT b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, b.diem_so, a.kieu_tinh
		INTO #map
		FROM #kb a, #ins b

	INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, nguon_xd, diem_so0)
		SELECT b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, '#01',
			CASE WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '1' THEN ROUND(SUM(b.diem_so)/COUNT(*), @ScoreRound)
				WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '2' THEN MAX(b.diem_so)
				WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '3' THEN MIN(b.diem_so)
				WHEN a.loai_tinh_diem = '9' THEN SUM(b.diem_so)
			ELSE NULL END
		FROM #kb a JOIN #map b ON a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu GROUP BY a.ma_chi_tieu, b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.loai_tinh_diem


	-- PNM/Invoice
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(ma_kh) AS ma_kh, ma_vt, stt_rec_ng AS stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0ng AS stt_rec0dh, MAX(ma_vung) AS ma_vung
		INTO #pmn FROM #ngdg WHERE nguon_xd IN ('#V2', '#V3') GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_vt, stt_rec_ng, stt_rec0ng

	SELECT a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt
		INTO #khvt FROM #pmn a JOIN bikdvt b ON a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND b.ngay_hl_tu <= a.ngay_ct AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_ct)
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #kqct(ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, diem_so0, nguon_xd)
		SELECT DISTINCT b.ma_vt, b.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, c.diem_chuan, '#01' FROM #kb a CROSS JOIN #khvt b CROSS JOIN #dotdg c

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPGTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '', @KeyDetail = '', @SiteKey = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @CreditAccount <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CreditAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'

	IF (@Admin = 0) SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey('PNG', @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i78$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m78$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRun] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @nMRPRunType TINYINT, @userID INT, @admin BIT
AS
/* 
	@nMRPRunType = 0 - Regenerate, 1 - Net Change
*/
BEGIN
	-- Check Locked Precess
	IF dbo.ff_GetLockedProcess('MRP') = 1 RETURN

	-- Lock Process
	EXEC fs_LockProcess 'MRP'

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dM SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @dStart DATETIME

	SELECT @dStart = GETDATE()

	-- Set
	SELECT @nPeriodCount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ky_hd'
	SELECT @cDefaultPeriod = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'
	SELECT @dM = dbo.mf_GetDOP (@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @nPeriodCount, 1)

	SELECT ma_vt, vung_hd, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th INTO #dmvt FROM dmvt WHERE kieu_hd <> 0

	-- 1. Product Requisition
	EXEC rs_MRPRunProductRequisition @dNow, @dM, @userID

	-- 2. BOM Explode
	EXEC rs_MRPRunBOMExplode @dNow, @dM, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID

	-- 3. Item Issued
	EXEC rs_MRPRunMOItemIssued @dNow, @dM, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID, @admin

	-- 4. Item Forecast
	EXEC rs_MRPRunItemForecast @dNow, @dM, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID

	-- 5. Scheduled Receipt
	EXEC rs_MRPRunScheduledReceipt @dNow, @dM, @nMRPRunType, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID

	-- 6. On Hand
	EXEC rs_MRPRunInventoryOnHand @dNow, @dM, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID, @admin

	--7. Plan Order
	EXEC rs_MRPRunPlanOrder @dNow, @dM, @nPeriodCount, @cDefaultPeriod, @userID

	-- 8. Insert Plan Order Detail
	EXEC rs_MRPRunInsertPlanOrderDetail @userID

	-- 9. Generate Action Message
	EXEC rs_RunGenerateActionMessage 'mrctyc', 2, 0, @dNow

	-- Unlock Process
	EXEC fs_UnlockProcess 'MRP'

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mrlog)
		INSERT INTO mrlog (run_date, run_type, user_id, start_time, finish_time) VALUES (@dNow, @nMRPRunType, @userID, @dStart, GETDATE())
	ELSE
		UPDATE mrlog SET run_date = @dNow, run_type = @nMRPRunType, user_id = @userID, start_time = @dStart, finish_time = GETDATE()

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdctcd]
AS
SELECT  a.*, e.ma_nv, e.ho_nv, e.ten_nv, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten, e.bo_phan AS ma_bp, e.bp_ref, b.ten_tcbh, b.ten_tcbh2
	FROM hrdctcd a LEFT JOIN hrdmtcbh b ON a.ma_tc = b.ma_tcbh JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$S5]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_gd INTO #beforeUpdate FROM ds5$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_gd <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_gd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN cs1$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_gd = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE @cS1IDNumber CHAR(13), @cS1LineNumber CHAR(13), @dyn_gd VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, dyn_gd FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS1IDNumber, @cS1LineNumber, @dyn_gd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cS1IDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_gd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update sfctqc$' + @dyn_gd + ' set xstatus = ''1'', status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1LineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			IF (@Action = 'Delete') BEGIN
				SET @s = 'update sfctqc$' + @dyn_gd + ' set xstatus = ''0'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1LineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @s
			END
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS1IDNumber, @cS1LineNumber, @dyn_gd
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesReportByObjects2] -- fs20_SOSalesAmtByCust --
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@GroupBy INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @RefField VARCHAR(64), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @ct_giam VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @so_luong_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_luong_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @giam_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_giam_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@ck_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@tien_von_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @giam_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_giam NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_tl NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@thue_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @RefField = CASE @GroupBy
		WHEN 0 THEN 'kh'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'nvbh'
		WHEN 2 THEN 'nx'
		WHEN 3 THEN 'vv'
		WHEN 4 THEN 'hd'
	END
	SELECT @ct_giam = '''HD2'', ''HD4'''

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma, nxt, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_nt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien_xuat AS tien, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, tien2 AS lai, tien_nt2 AS lai_nt
			, gia, gia_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, tien2 AS pt, tien_nt2 AS pt_nt
			, sl_xuat AS so_luong_thuan, sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl, tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt, thue_nt AS thue_giam_nt
			, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt, thue_nt AS thue_tl_nt, tien_nt2 AS tien_von_tl_nt
			, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_thuan_nt, tien_nt2 AS thue_thuan_nt, tien_nt2 AS tien_von_thuan_nt
			, tien2 AS giam_gia, thue AS thue_giam
			, tien2 AS doanh_thu_tl, ck AS ck_tl, thue AS thue_tl, tien2 AS tien_von_tl
			, tien2 AS doanh_thu_thuan, tien2 AS thue_thuan, tien2 AS tien_von_thuan
		INTO #Tmp FROM wrkin

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, ma_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, lai, lai_nt
			, gia, gia_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, pt, pt_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nhom3
			, giam_gia, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam, thue_giam_nt, so_luong_tl, doanh_thu_tl, doanh_thu_tl_nt
			, ck_tl, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl, thue_tl_nt, so_luong_thuan, tien_von_tl_nt, tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_nt AS thue_thuan_nt, tien_nt2 AS tien_von_thuan_nt, tien_von_tl
			, tien2 AS doanh_thu_thuan, thue AS thue_thuan, tien2 AS tien_von_thuan
		INTO #Report FROM #Tmp

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = ''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' a.ma_' + @RefField + ' <> '''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #Tmp select a.ma_' + @RefField + ', nxt, ma_ct, loai_ct, a.ma_nt'
	IF @Form = '1' SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) as lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) as lai_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) as pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) as pt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, a.sl_nhap as so_luong_tl, a.tien_nt2 as giam_gia_nt, thue_nt as thue_giam, a.tien_nt2 as doanh_thu_tl_nt, a.ck_nt as ck_tl_nt, a.thue_nt as thue_tl_nt, a.tien_nt_n as tien_von_tl_nt, 0, 0, 0, a.tien2 as giam_gia, a.thue as thue_giam, a.tien2 as doanh_thu_tl, a.ck as ck_tl, a.thue as thue_tl, a.tien_nhap as tien_von_tl, 0, 0, 0'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #Tmp SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0, lai_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SET @q = 'alter table #report add ma_xx varchar(32), ten_xx nvarchar(511), ten_xx2 nvarchar(511)'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, max(a.ma_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else so_luong end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.tien_nt end), sum(a.lai), sum(a.lai_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else tien2 end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else tien_nt2 end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.ck_nt end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.thue end), sum(case when nxt = 1 or (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then 0 else a.thue_nt end), sum(a.pt), sum(a.pt_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @RefField = 'kh' OR @RefField = 'vv' THEN ', max(c.nh_xx1), max(c.nh_xx2), max(c.nh_xx3)' ELSE ', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then -giam_gia else 0 end) as giam_gia, sum(case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then -giam_gia_nt else 0 end) as giam_gia_nt, sum(case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then -thue_giam else 0 end) as thue_giam, sum(case when (ma_ct in (' + @ct_giam + ') and loai_ct = 1) then -thue_giam_nt else 0 end) as thue_giam_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(so_luong_tl) as so_luong_tl, sum(case when nxt = 1 then doanh_thu_tl else 0 end) as doanh_thu_tl, sum(case when nxt = 1 then doanh_thu_tl_nt else 0 end) as doanh_thu_tl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nxt = 1 then ck_tl else 0 end) as ck_tl, sum(case when nxt = 1 then ck_tl_nt else 0 end) as ck_tl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nxt = 1 then thue_tl else 0 end) as thue_tl, sum(case when nxt = 1 then thue_tl_nt else 0 end) as thue_tl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(so_luong * 0) as so_luong_thuan, sum(case when nxt = 1 then tien_von_tl_nt else 0 end) as tien_von_tl_nt, sum(tien_nt2 * 0) as doanh_thu_thuan_nt, sum(thue_nt * 0) as thue_thuan_nt, sum(tien_nt2 *0) as tien_von_thuan_nt, sum(case when nxt = 1 then tien_von_tl else 0 end) as tien_von_tl'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(tien2 * 0) as doanh_thu_thuan, sum(thue * 0) as thue_thuan, sum(tien2 * 0) as tien_von_thuan'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', max(c.ten_xx), ''''' ELSE ', '''', max(c.ten_xx2)' END

	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmxx c on a.ma = c.ma_xx'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END
		, gia2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien2/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt2/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END

	--
	UPDATE #report SET so_luong_thuan = so_luong - so_luong_tl, @doanh_thu_thuan = tien2 - ck - giam_gia - doanh_thu_tl + ck_tl,
		@thue_thuan = thue - thue_giam - thue_tl, @tien_von_thuan = tien - tien_von_tl, @doanh_thu_thuan_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt - giam_gia_nt - doanh_thu_tl_nt + ck_tl_nt,
		@thue_thuan_nt = thue_nt - thue_giam_nt - thue_tl_nt, @tien_von_thuan_nt = tien_nt - tien_von_tl_nt,
		doanh_thu_thuan = @doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan = @thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan = @tien_von_thuan,
		doanh_thu_thuan_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt = @thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt = @tien_von_thuan_nt,
		pt = @doanh_thu_thuan + @thue_thuan, pt_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt + @thue_thuan_nt, lai = @doanh_thu_thuan - @tien_von_thuan, lai_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt - @tien_von_thuan_nt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_xx, ten_xx2', 'int, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE '' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE REPLACE('ma_xx', 'xx', @RefField) END, REPLACE('ma_xx', 'xx', @RefField))
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	IF (@RefField = 'kh' OR @RefField = 'vv') AND @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @fieldGroup VARCHAR(16), @fieldGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT, @strSum VARCHAR(4000)
		DECLARE @noGroup NVARCHAR(511), @noGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
		SELECT @strSum = 'so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan'
		SELECT @noGroup = RTRIM(cName), @noGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
		SELECT @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) + ',', @q = '', @fieldGroups = ''

		SELECT @q = 'alter table #report alter column ten_XX nvarchar(511)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ten_XX2 nvarchar(511)'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList, @nStart) > 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = ''
			SET @fieldGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
			SET @i = @i + 1
			IF @fieldGroups = '' SET @fieldGroups = @fieldGroup ELSE SET @fieldGroups = @fieldGroups + ',' + @fieldGroup
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_xx = space(1) + rtrim(ten_xx), ten_xx2 = space(1) + rtrim(ten_xx2) where systotal=1'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_xx,ten_xx,ten_xx2,' + @fieldGroups + ','
			SET @q = @q + @strSum + ') select ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
			SET @q = @q + 'max(b.ten_nh),max(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@fieldGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',sum(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),sum(a.') + ')'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join (select * from dmnhxx where loai_nh = '
			SET @q = @q + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@fieldGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b ON a.' + @fieldGroup + '=b.ma_nh where a.systotal=1'
			SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@fieldGroups, ',', ',a.')
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_xx= N' + CHAR(39) + @noGroup + CHAR(39) + ' where ten_xx is null and systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_xx2= N' + CHAR(39) + @noGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' where ten_xx2 is null and systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_xx=space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + rtrim(ten_xx), ten_xx2=space(1) + rtrim(ten_xx2) where systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	IF @nSo_Ma_nt > 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('xx', 'so_luong', '#report')
	ELSE
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('xx', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, gia, gia_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan', '#report')
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) <> ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_xx as ma, ten_xx as ten, ten_xx2 as ten2, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder, ma_xx') + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_xx as ma, ten_xx as ten, ten_xx2 as ten2, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan from #report order by sysorder, ma_xx, stt'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'xx', @RefField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Customer]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Account, 2 Multi Account
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@Date, @BalanceType)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdkh

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh is not null'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	-- Balance (year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh a with (nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4)
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with (nolock, index(tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where 1 = 1'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk_ma_kh)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin
	
	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_kh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_kh order by tk, ma_kh'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSATran] --fs_PrintSTTran
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table CHAR(10), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt, a.ghi_chu, a.ma_kh, c.ten_kh' + @cE + ' as ten_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_dat, a.gia_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ngay_ct1, a.ngay_ct2, a.tg_th'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt left outer join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr '
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 13, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt, ghi_chu'',''sl_dat'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReceiptTransactionListForQualityAssurance] --fs_QATransaction
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@PDFrom AS VARCHAR(33),
	@PDTo AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Supplier AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.ma_kt, b.ma_nx, b.ma_kho, b.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_lo, b.ghi_chu, b.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec, b.line_nbr
		INTO #report FROM m97$000000 a, d97$000000 b

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''PD2'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'') and a.status not in (''0'', ''*'')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @PDFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PDFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @PDTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PDTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Supplier <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Supplier), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.ma_kt, b.ma_nx, b.ma_kho, b.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_lo, b.ghi_chu, b.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec, b.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m97$%Partition a with(nolock) inner join d97$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt_rec, ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_ct, ma_dvcs', 'VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(1023)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (so_luong) VALUES(0)

	SET @q = 'select a.*, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, g.ngay_ct as ngay_pn, g.so_ct as so_pn'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE 'b.ten_kh2' END + ' as ten_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE 'c.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.ten_kt' ELSE 'e.ten_kt2' END + ' as ten_kt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'f.ten_nx' ELSE 'f.ten_nx2' END + ' as ten_nx'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmloaikt e on a.ma_kt = e.ma_kt left join dmnx f on a.ma_nx = f.ma_nx left join c96$000000 g on a.stt_rec_pn = g.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPGetResourceDetailByPeriod]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@ResourceID VARCHAR(32),
	@UOM NVARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@OverLoad CHAR(1) = '0'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nHe_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @Round TINYINT
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'
	SELECT @nHe_so = CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END FROM crdmdvt WHERE dvt = @UOM

	SELECT a.ma_nl, a.ky, a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, a.nguon, a.loai_nl, a.ngay_ht, a.so_luong, a.so_ngay, a.ngay_bd
			, ROUND(a.cong_suat/@nHe_so, @Round) AS cong_suat
			, ROUND(a.cs_dc/@nHe_so, @Round) AS cs_du
			, a.cs_dc * 0  AS cs_sd
			, a.cong_suat * 0 AS t_cong_suat
			, b.dien_giai, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2
			, d.ten_nguon, d.ten_nguon2
		INTO #report
		FROM crhdnlsx a
			LEFT JOIN dmlsx b ON RTRIM(LTRIM(a.so_dh)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(b.so_lsx))
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN mrdmnguon d ON a.nguon = d.ma_nguon
		WHERE ma_nl = @ResourceID AND a.ngay_cuoi_ky =  @Date
		ORDER BY a.ngay_bd, a.ngay_ht

	SELECT ma_vt, so_dh, ROUND(SUM(cong_suat)/@nHe_so, @Round) AS t_cong_suat INTO #tSum FROM crhdnlsx WHERE ma_nl = @ResourceID GROUP BY ma_vt, so_dh
	SELECT ma_nl, ky, ROUND(SUM(cong_suat)/@nHe_so, @Round) AS cs_sd INTO #tSum1 FROM crhdnlsx WHERE ma_nl = @ResourceID GROUP BY ma_nl, ky

	UPDATE #report SET t_cong_suat = b.t_cong_suat FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #tSum b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = b.so_dh
	UPDATE #report SET cs_sd = b.cs_sd FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #tSum1 b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ky = b.ky

	IF @OverLoad = '1' DELETE #report WHERE cs_du >= cs_sd

	SELECT ngay_bd, so_dh
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(ten_nguon) ELSE RTRIM(ten_nguon2) END AS ten_nguon
		, dien_giai, ngay_ht, so_luong, cong_suat, t_cong_suat, ma_vt
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
		FROM #report ORDER BY nguon, so_dh, ma_vt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbisysinspectionrights]
AS
	SELECT a.id, a.name, a.comment, a.user_yn, b.ma_nguon
			, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_new, 0) AS BIT) AS r_new, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_edit, 0) AS BIT) AS r_edit, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_del, 0) AS BIT) AS r_del
			, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_access, 0) AS BIT) AS r_access
		FROM vsysuserinfo a LEFT JOIN bisysinspectionrights2 b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.id = b.user_id AND b.ma_nguon IN (SELECT ma_nguon FROM bikddmnguon WITH(NOLOCK))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs30_ReCaclReceiveERD] @cVC CHAR(3), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @Group VARCHAR(128), @nCharge TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cIDLineNumber CHAR(3), @nRound INT, @cBaseCur VARCHAR(32), @chargeTable VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT * INTO #master FROM wrkcrtran
	SELECT * INTO #detail FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT * INTO #xcharge FROM f46$000000

	SELECT @cIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, '''', '')
	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cBaseCur = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE sua_tg_yn = 1) BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @cVC = 'BC1' BEGIN
		SELECT @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(@cMasterTable))
		SET @chargeTable = 'f46$' + SUBSTRING(@cMasterTable, CHARINDEX('$', @cMasterTable) + 1, 6)
				
		SET @q = 'insert into #xcharge' + ' select * from ' + @chargeTable + ' where tk_du <> '''' and stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	
	DECLARE @nMethod INT, @cAccount VARCHAR(32), @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cCust VARCHAR(32), @cUnit VARCHAR(32), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @cNumber VARCHAR(32), @nRate NUMERIC(38, 20)

	SELECT @cCust = ma_kh, @cUnit = ma_dvcs, @dVC = ngay_ct, @cNumber = so_ct FROM #master

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct = '2') BEGIN
		DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
		OPEN crPaymentERD
		FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @cAccount = tk_co, @nFCAmount = tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
			IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2 BEGIN
				EXEC fs_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, 0, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cNumber, 1, @nRate OUTPUT
				UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate, tien = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber	
		END
		CLOSE crPaymentERD
		DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD
	END

	
	-- Charge
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1', '2')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xcharge) BEGIN
		DECLARE crFeeERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #xcharge ORDER BY line_nbr
		OPEN crFeeERD
		FETCH NEXT FROM crFeeERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @cAccount = tk_du, @nFCAmount = tien_cp_nt FROM #xcharge WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
			IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2 BEGIN
				EXEC fs_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, 0, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cNumber, 1, @nRate OUTPUT
				UPDATE #xcharge SET ty_gia = @nRate WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
				--UPDATE #xcharge SET ty_gia = @nRate, tien_cp = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound), t_thue = ROUND(t_thue_nt * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crFeeERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		END
		CLOSE crFeeERD
		DEALLOCATE crFeeERD
	END


	UPDATE #master SET t_tien = b.tien FROM #master a JOIN (SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien FROM #detail) b ON 1 = 1

	-- F1
	SET @q = 'update @cDetailTable set ty_gia_ht2 = b.ty_gia_ht2, tien = b.tien from @cDetailTable a join #detail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update @cChargeTable SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, tien_cp = b.tien_cp, t_thue = b.t_thue FROM @cChargeTable a JOIN #xcharge b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update @cMasterTable set t_tien = b.t_tien from @cMasterTable a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC fs_PostCRTran %@cMasterTable%, %@cDetailTable%, %@cIDNumber%, %@Group%, 2, default, ' + RTRIM(@nCharge)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable)
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cChargeTable', @chargeTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cIDNumber', @cIDNumber)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Group', @Group)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%', CHAR(39))	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckMOProduct] -- fs20_COCheckMOProduct
	@TransactionCodes VARCHAR(64),
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, so_lsx, dien_giai INTO #report FROM r70$000000

	-- Unit Key
	IF @costUnit = '1' SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@TransactionCodes), ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and not exists (select 1 from ctsx a join phsx b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where dbo.xf20_GetMO(r.so_lsx) = dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct) and a.ma_vt = r.ma_vt and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''' and b.status <> ''*'')'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_vt in (select ma_vt from vdmsp)'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_lsx <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'ma_dvcs' ELSE '''''' END + ', stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, so_lsx, dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition r with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_vt2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_ct ELSE '' END AS ten_ct, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN c.ten_ct2 ELSE '' END AS ten_ct2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct 
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_ViewStatus]
	@tableName VARCHAR(32),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS

BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @field VARCHAR(32)

	DECLARE @split VARCHAR(32), @sl_nhap NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_hd NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nhap NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_hd NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @split = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split'
	
	SELECT @field = CASE WHEN @tableName = 'bih06$000000' THEN 'stt_rec_hd' ELSE 'stt_rec_dh' END
	
	IF @tableName = '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 c1, 0 c2, 0 c3, 0 c4
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = '
if @split = ''1'' begin
	select @sl_nhap = sum(case
		when ((ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'', ''PNG'') and loai_ct = ''2'') or ma_ct = ''PD1'') then sl_nhap
		when ((ma_ct = ''PXR'' and tt_yn = 1)) then - sl_xuat
		else 0
	end),
	@sl_hd = sum(case when (ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'') and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''5'', ''6'')) or (ma_ct = ''PNG'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'')) then sl_nhap else 0 end),
	@tien_nhap = sum(case
		when ((ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'', ''PNG'') and loai_ct = ''2'') or ma_ct = ''PD1'') then tien_nhap
		when ((ma_ct = ''PXR'' and tt_yn = 1)) then - tien_xuat
		else 0
	end),
	@tien_hd = sum(case when (ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'') and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''5'', ''6'')) or (ma_ct = ''PNG'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'')) then tien_nhap else 0 end)

		from ' + @tableName + ' where ' + @field + ' = @idNumber
end else begin
	select @sl_nhap =  sum(case
		when ((ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'', ''PNG'') and loai_ct = ''2'') or ma_ct = ''PD1'') then sl_nhap
		when (((ma_ct = ''PXC'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''6'', ''9'')) or ma_ct = ''PXR'') and tt_yn = 1) then - sl_xuat
		else 0
	end),
	@sl_hd = sum(case when((ma_ct in(''PNA'', ''PNB'') and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''5'', ''6'')) or (ma_ct =''PNG'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3''))) then sl_nhap else 0 end),
	@tien_nhap = sum(case
		when ((ma_ct in (''PNA'', ''PNB'', ''PNG'') and loai_ct = ''2'') or ma_ct = ''PD1'') then tien_nhap
		when (((ma_ct = ''PXC'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''6'', ''9'')) or ma_ct = ''PXR'') and tt_yn = 1) then - tien_xuat
		else 0
	end),
	@tien_hd = sum(case when((ma_ct in(''PNA'', ''PNB'') and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''5'', ''6'')) or (ma_ct = ''PNG'' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''3''))) then tien_nhap else 0 end)

		from ' + @tableName + ' where ' + @field + ' = @idNumber
end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @split varchar(32), @sl_nhap numeric(28, 6) out, @sl_hd numeric(28, 6) out, @tien_nhap numeric(28, 6) out, @tien_hd numeric(28, 6) out',
		@idNumber, @split, @sl_nhap output, @sl_hd output, @tien_nhap output, @tien_hd output

	SELECT @sl_nhap c1, @tien_nhap c2, @sl_hd c3, @tien_hd c4

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPMTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@InventoryAccount VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '', @KeyDetail = '', @SiteKey = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Account), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Admin = 0 SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @KeyDetail = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @InventoryAccount <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@InventoryAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyDetail <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyDetail), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) = 0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i72$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m72$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.FastBusiness$Report$UpdateReportForm
	@TableName CHAR(16), 
	@Form CHAR(16)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @q = 'SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, ids, iscal, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaList(cach_tinh, 2) AS lstvar INTO #t FROM @TableName WHERE form = ''@Form'' and cach_tinh <> ' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @lstVar NVARCHAR(256), @nOver INT, @iIds INT'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #t SET iscal = 0, ids = 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'SET @nOver = 1; SET @iIds = 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE isCal = 0)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'BEGIN'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	IF @nOver >= 100 BREAK'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, lstvar FROM #t WHERE iscal = 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	OPEN cr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Ma_so, @lstVar'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #t WHERE iscal = 0 AND '','' + @lstVar + '','' LIKE ''%,'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_so)) + '',%'') BEGIN'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UPDATE #t SET Ids = @iIds, isCal = 1 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so'	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			SET @iIds = @iIds + 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		END'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Ma_so, @lstVar'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	END'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	CLOSE cr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	DEALLOCATE cr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SET @nOver = @nOver + 1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'END'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE @TableName SET ids = b.ids, iscal = b.iscal FROM @TableName a JOIN #t b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE a.form = ''@Form'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'DROP TABLE #t'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@TableName', @TableName), '@Form', @Form)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPayableReportByInvoice] -- fs_APByInvoices
	@DateGLFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateGLTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateReport AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Account VARCHAR(32), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerGroup3 VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32), 
	@Type TINYINT, 
	@Size TINYINT,
	@BalanceView TINYINT,
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@ContractGroup CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound TINYINT, @cname NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cname = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT076'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.tk, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt0
			, a.t_tt_qd0, a.ma_dvcs, a.t_tt0, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt1, a.ty_gia, a.t_tt_nt1, a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0
			, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, b.stt_ct_nkc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_kh, a.ngay_ct0 + d.han_tt AS ngay_tt0
			, a.line_nbr, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vv, a.t_tt0 * 0 AS con_pt, a.t_tt_nt0 * 0 AS con_pt_nt, d.han_tt AS han_tt
			, a.loai_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_hd, a.loai_tt, a.ma_gd, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.tat_toan, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_hd
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkap a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct, dmkh c, dmtt d
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)	

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLTo, 112) + '''', @PaymentKey = 'a.loai_tt = 1 and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + '''', @PaymentJoin = ''
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ngay_ct0 is null or ngay_ct0 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ngay_ct0 is null or ngay_ct0 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct0 >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct0 <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_tt = ''0'''
	IF @Type = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and tat_toan = 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.tk like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Account, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @s = ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''')) + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and c.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	--
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SET @PaymentJoin = ' left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @PaymentKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@PaymentKey)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_tt, tt_qd AS t_tt_qd, tt_cn AS t_tt_cn INTO #payment FROM cttt30
	SET @q = 'insert into #payment select a.stt_rec_tt, sum(a.tt_qd), sum(a.tt_cn) from cttt30 a with(nolock)' + @PaymentJoin + ' where ' + @PaymentKey + ' group by a.stt_rec_tt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.tk, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.t_tt_qd0, a.ma_dvcs, a.t_tt0, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt1, a.ty_gia, a.t_tt_nt1, a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , b.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, b.stt_ct_nkc, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(c.ten_kh,'''')' ELSE 'isnull(c.ten_kh2,'''')' end + ', a.ngay_ct0 + d.han_tt as ngay_tt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.line_nbr, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vv, a.t_tt0 * 0 as con_pt, a.t_tt_nt0 * 0 as con_pt_nt, d.han_tt as han_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.loai_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_hd, a.loai_tt, a.ma_gd, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.tat_toan'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.ten_hd' else 'e.ten_hd2' END ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt30 a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct b with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtt d with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = d.ma_tt'
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' SET @q = @q + ' left join dmhd e with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = e.ma_hd'
	IF @BalanceView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk t on a.tk = t.tk left join #payment p on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @BalanceView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' and isnull(t.tk_cn, 1) <> 0 and isnull(case when a.ma_nt <> '''' then a.t_tt_nt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_qd else a.t_tt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_cn end, 1) > 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT stt_rec_tt AS stt_rec, t_tt_qd, t_tt_cn AS t_tt1 INTO #cttt FROM #payment WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #report)
	INSERT INTO #cttt SELECT stt_rec, 0, 0 FROM #report WHERE NOT stt_rec in (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt)
	
	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_qd = b.t_tt_qd + a.t_tt_qd0, t_tt1 = b.t_tt1 + ROUND(a.t_tt_qd0 * CASE a.ma_nt WHEN '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END, @nRound)
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #cttt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_qd WHERE ma_nt <> ''
	UPDATE #report SET t_tt_nt1 = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt_nt = t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1, con_pt = t_tt0 - t_tt1
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt_nt= 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #report SET con_pt = 0, con_pt_nt = 0, t_tt1 = t_tt0, t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_nt0 WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 0)
	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, LEN(stt_rec) - 3) + ma_ct WHERE RIGHT(stt_rec, 3) <> ma_ct AND ma_ct <> ''
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''
	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh) VALUES (1, 1, 0, '')

	IF @ContractGroup = '0'
		SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, ma_kh
				, ten_kh, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt1, con_pt_nt, ty_gia, t_tt0, t_tt1, con_pt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, ma_vv, tk, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, '' AS ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, '' AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_kh, ngay_ct0, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, so_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, ma_kh
				,ten_kh, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt1, con_pt_nt, ty_gia, t_tt0, t_tt1, con_pt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, ma_vv, tk, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, ma_hd, ten_hd, CASE WHEN ma_hd = '' THEN '' ELSE ten_hd END AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_kh, ma_hd, ngay_ct0, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, so_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
