CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRunProductRequisition] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dM SMALLDATETIME, @userID INT
AS
BEGIN	
	DECLARE @nQRound INT, @dMin SMALLDATETIME, @periodCode VARCHAR(33), @d0 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @periodCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd'

	SELECT @dMin = MIN(ngay_ct) FROM phsx WHERE ngay_ct <= @dM AND status IN ('1', '2')
	SELECT @dMin = ISNULL(@dMin, @dNow), @d0 = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@periodCode, @dNow, 0, 0)
	

	SELECT so_dh, ma_sp, ma_kho, ngay_ct AS ngay_yc, ROUND(SUM(so_luong*he_so), @nQRound) AS so_luong
		INTO #khsx FROM mctkhsx
		WHERE (ngay_ct BETWEEN @d0 AND @dM) AND status = '1'
		GROUP BY so_dh, ma_sp, ma_kho, ngay_ct


	SELECT dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct) AS so_lsx, a.ma_vt AS ma_sp, a.ma_kho, 
			CASE 
				WHEN b.ngay_th2 IS NOT NULL THEN b.ngay_th2 ELSE
				CASE WHEN b.ngay_kh2 IS NOT NULL THEN b.ngay_kh2 ELSE b.ngay_ct END
			END  AS ngay_yc, 
			ROUND(SUM(a.so_luong*a.he_so), @nQRound) AS so_luong
		INTO #lsx
		FROM ctsx a WITH(INDEX(ngay_ct)) JOIN phsx b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dMin AND @dM) AND b.status IN ('1', '2')
		GROUP BY dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct), a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, CASE 
				WHEN b.ngay_th2 IS NOT NULL THEN b.ngay_th2 ELSE
				CASE WHEN b.ngay_kh2 IS NOT NULL THEN b.ngay_kh2 ELSE b.ngay_ct END
			END

	-- Delete tables
	TRUNCATE TABLE mrncsp
	TRUNCATE TABLE mrctyc
	--

	INSERT INTO mrncsp
			(
				nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PS', so_dh, '', ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_yc
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #khsx

	INSERT INTO mrncsp
			(
				nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'MO', '', so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_yc
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #lsx
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$S5]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_gd INTO #afterUpdate FROM ds5$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_gd <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_gd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN cs1$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_gd = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE @cS1IDNumber CHAR(13), @cS1LineNumber CHAR(3), @dyn_gd VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_gd, stt_rec0gd, dyn_gd AS dyn_gd FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS1IDNumber, @cS1LineNumber, @dyn_gd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cS1IDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_gd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'if exists (select 1 from ds1$' + @dyn_gd + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''') and exists (select 1 from cs5$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status = ''2'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update sfctqc$' + @dyn_gd + ' set status = ''0'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1LineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'else'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update sfctqc$' + @dyn_gd + ' set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1LineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s

			SET @s = 'if exists (select 1 from ds1$' + @dyn_gd + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''') and exists (select 1 from cs5$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '') + ''')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update sfctqc$' + @dyn_gd + ' set xstatus = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1IDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cS1LineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS1IDNumber, @cS1LineNumber, @dyn_gd
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesReportDetailedByItem] --fs20_SOSalesSummary--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @so_luong AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @tien2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @ck AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @pt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @pt_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @thue AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @lai AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @lai_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong, a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) AS lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) AS lai_nt
			, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt
			, (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) AS pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) AS pt_nt
		INTO #temp
		FROM wrkin a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY 1

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key +  ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @SalesAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @SalesAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT

	--
	IF @Group <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @Group + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt'
	IF @Form = '1' SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) as lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) as lai_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) as pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) as pt_nt'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #temp SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0, lai_nt = 0
			WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt
			, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt2, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2
			, SUM(ck) AS ck, SUM(ck_nt) AS ck_nt, SUM(pt) AS pt, SUM(pt_nt) AS pt_nt
			, SUM(thue) AS thue, SUM(thue_nt) AS thue_nt, SUM(lai) AS lai, SUM(lai_nt) AS lai_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt
		INTO #report
		FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END
		, gia2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien2/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt2/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	SELECT @so_luong =  SUM(so_luong)
			, @tien = SUM(tien), @tien_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_nt) END
			, @tien2 = SUM(tien2), @tien_nt2 = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_nt2) END
			, @ck = SUM(ck), @ck_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ck_nt) END
			, @thue = SUM(thue), @thue_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_nt) END
			, @pt = SUM(pt), @pt_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(pt_nt) END
			, @lai = SUM(lai), @lai_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(lai_nt) END
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Groups + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Groups <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt',
				'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt',
				'#report', 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups , 'vt',
				'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt',
				'#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #Report)
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt)
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s, @s, @so_luong, @tien, @tien_nt, @tien2, @tien_nt2, @ck, @ck_nt, @pt, @pt_nt, @thue, @thue_nt, @lai, @lai_nt)

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt FROM #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt FROM #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReturnToSupplierList]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt
			, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong, a.tien_nhap AS tien, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, line_nbr
		INTO #detail FROM wrkin a

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#detail', @TableName, @controller, @SysDB, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a'), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a')

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + RTRIM(@Form) + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @queryJoin <> '' SET @Join = @Join + @queryJoin
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', a.sl_nhap AS so_luong' ELSE ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', a.tien_nhap AS tien' ELSE ', a.tien_xuat as tien' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt' ELSE ', a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(2000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#detail', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail) INSERT INTO #detail(ma_vt) VALUES('')

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #detail set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', so_luong, gia_nt, tien_nt, gia, tien, (CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec) AS rp_group, b.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', d.dvt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'd.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #detail a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join dmvt d on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, ' + @Order + ', a.stt_rec, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPOverResource]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Resource VARCHAR(32),
	@Uom NVARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Coeffi NUMERIC(28, 6), @Round TINYINT, @nPFrom INT, @nPTo INT
	SELECT @Round = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'
	SELECT @Coeffi = CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END FROM crdmdvt WHERE dvt = @Uom

	SELECT @nPFrom = dbo.cf_RCCPDate2Period(@DateFrom, @DateTo, 0)
	SELECT @nPTo = dbo.cf_RCCPDate2Period(@DateFrom, @DateTo, 1)

	SELECT a.ma_nl, a.ngay_kt AS ky, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_nl ELSE c.ten_nl2 END AS ten_nl
			, ROUND(CAST(a.cs_dc/@Coeffi AS NUMERIC(18, 5)), @Round) AS cs_du
			, ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(b.cong_suat/@Coeffi, 0) AS NUMERIC(18, 5)), @Round) AS cs_sd
		INTO #report
		FROM crnlsx a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_nl, ky, SUM(cong_suat) AS cong_suat FROM crhdnlsx GROUP BY ky, ma_nl) b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ky = b.ky
			LEFT JOIN crdmnl c ON a.ma_nl = c.ma_nl
		WHERE a.ky BETWEEN @nPFrom AND @nPTo
			AND a.ngay_kt BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
			AND a.ma_nl LIKE (RTRIM(@Resource) + '%')

	DELETE #report WHERE cs_du >= cs_sd

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ky, ma_nl

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(@d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS NUMERIC(20, 6) AS
BEGIN 
	IF @d1 IS NULL OR @d2 IS NULL RETURN NULL
	DECLARE @n INT, @r DECIMAL(20, 6), @d SMALLDATETIME, @y INT, @t DECIMAL(20, 6), @g INT, @l INT
	SELECT @g = 1
	IF (@d2 < @d1) SELECT @g = -1, @d = @d1, @d1 = @d2, @d2 = @d

	SELECT @n = DATEDIFF(year, @d1, @d2)

	SELECT @d = DATEADD(year, @n, @d1)
	IF @d2 = @d SELECT @r = @n
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @d > @d2 SELECT @n = @n - 1, @d = DATEADD(year, -1, @d)
		SELECT @y = YEAR(@d2)
		SELECT @t = CASE WHEN @y %4 = 0 THEN 
					CASE WHEN @y %100 = 0 THEN 
						CASE WHEN @y %400 = 0 THEN 366 ELSE 365 END
					ELSE 366 END
				ELSE 365 END

		SELECT @l = DATEDIFF(day, @d, @d2)
		IF @l = 365 SELECT @t = 366

		SELECT @r = @l/@t + @n
	END

	RETURN @g * @r
END


GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[bet_host_transfer]
	@user_id INT,
	@date DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @hostname NVARCHAR(MAX)

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bet_host WHERE datefrom = @date) BEGIN	
		SELECT @hostname = RTRIM(LTRIM(b.comment)) FROM bet_host a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id = b.id WHERE a.datefrom = @date
		SELECT 0 AS isSuccess, N'Ngày ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @date, 103) + N' đã được setup chuyển giao cho ' + @hostname AS msg
		RETURN
	END

	INSERT INTO bet_host SELECT @date, @user_id
	SELECT @hostname = RTRIM(LTRIM(comment)) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @user_id
	SELECT 1 AS isSuccess, N'Chuyển giao cho ' + @hostname + N' từ ngày ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), @date, 103) AS msg
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_ApprovedAnnualLeaveRequestTransfer]
	@Employee VARCHAR(4000), 
	@LeaveType VARCHAR(32),
	@ShiftCode VARCHAR(32),
	@HoursNum NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@TypeTransfer TINYINT, -- 1 - Overwrite, 0 - No
	@Result BIT OUTPUT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d DATETIME
	DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @Workday VARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @d = GETDATE(), @q = '', @Key = '', @Result = 0
	SELECT @Workday = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_cong'
	SELECT @LeaveType = REPLACE(@LeaveType, '''', ''''''), @ShiftCode = REPLACE(@ShiftCode, '''', ''''''), @Workday = REPLACE(@Workday, '''', '''''')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, loai_nghi, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, muc_do, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2 INTO #n0 FROM hrnghi

	-- Key
	IF @Employee = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Employee = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Employee <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Employee, ' ', ''), '''', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #n0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_bd, dateadd(day, (a.so_ngay - 1), a.ngay_bd), @typeLeave, @shiftCode, @typeWorkday, @hoursNum, ''2'', '''', @d, @d, @id, @id'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrphepdd a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@typeLeave varchar(32), @typeWorkday varchar(32), @shiftCode varchar(32), @hoursNum numeric(28, 6), @id int, @d datetime'
		, @typeLeave = @LeaveType, @typeWorkday = @Workday, @shiftCode = @ShiftCode, @hoursNum = @HoursNum, @id = @UserID, @d = @d

	IF @TypeTransfer = 0 DELETE #n0 FROM #n0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrnghi b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.loai_nghi = b.loai_nghi AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu)

	DELETE #n0 FROM #n0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrnghi b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.loai_nghi = b.loai_nghi AND a.ngay_tu <> b.ngay_tu AND ((a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay_den AND a.ngay_den >= b.ngay_tu) OR (b.ngay_tu <= a.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den >= a.ngay_den)))
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #n0) BEGIN
		UPDATE #n0 SET datetime0 = b.datetime0, user_id0 = b.user_id0 FROM #n0 a JOIN hrnghi b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.loai_nghi = b.loai_nghi AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu
		--
		SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #ttcc0 FROM hrttchamcong a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #n0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay_tu) GROUP BY a.stt_rec
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, b.ca, b.so_gio INTO #ttcc1 FROM #ttcc0 a JOIN hrttchamcong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, a.ca, a.so_gio INTO #ttcc2 FROM hrttchamcong a LEFT JOIN #n0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_tu > b.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay_den ORDER BY a.ngay_tu
		UPDATE #ttcc1 SET ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu FROM #ttcc1 a JOIN #n0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ca, a.so_gio, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #ttcc
			FROM (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ca, so_gio FROM #ttcc1 WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #ttcc2)
					UNION ALL SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ca, so_gio FROM #ttcc2) a
			 ORDER BY a.ngay_tu
		UPDATE #ttcc SET ngay_den = b.ngay_tu FROM #ttcc a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, id - 1 AS id FROM #ttcc) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.id = b.id

		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, b.loai_nghi
				, CASE WHEN a.ca <> '' THEN a.ca ELSE @ShiftCode END AS ma_ca
				, b.ma_cong
				, CASE WHEN a.so_gio <> 0 THEN a.so_gio ELSE @HoursNum END AS so_gio
				, b.muc_do, b.ghi_chu, b.datetime0, b.datetime2, b.user_id0, b.user_id2
			INTO #n FROM #ttcc a LEFT JOIN #n0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		--
		INSERT INTO #n(stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, loai_nghi, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, muc_do, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, loai_nghi, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, muc_do, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				FROM #n0 a
					WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #n b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
		--
		DELETE hrnghi FROM hrnghi a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #n b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu AND a.loai_nghi = b.loai_nghi)
		INSERT INTO hrnghi (stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, loai_nghi, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, muc_do, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, loai_nghi, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, muc_do, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2 FROM #n
		--
		UPDATE hrphepdd SET datetime2 = b.datetime2, user_id2 = b.user_id2, status = '1' FROM hrphepdd a JOIN #n0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_bd = b.ngay_tu
	END	
	--
	SELECT @Result = 1
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_Dashboard004] -- Số dư công nợ phải thu, phải trả quá hạn
	@fieldID VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - AR, 2 - AP
	@OUM INT = 1,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q AS NVARCHAR(4000), @Key AS NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey AS NVARCHAR(4000), @Nam_bc INT, @d SMALLDATETIME, @max_record INT


	SELECT @max_record = max_record FROM dbfield WHERE field_id = @fieldID
	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @d = GETDATE() FROM dmstt
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @d = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@d), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@d), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)


	-- Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, t_tt AS tien, CAST(0 AS INT) AS qua_han, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien3, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien4 INTO #r FROM cttt20


	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #r select a.ma_kh, a.t_tt - isnull(a.t_tt1, 0) as tien, datediff(day, a.ngay_ct0 + b.han_tt, ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @d, 112) + ''') as qua_han, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'cttt20' ELSE 'cttt30' END + ' a with(nolock) join dmtt b on a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.loai_tt = 0 and a.tat_toan = 0 and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	DELETE FROM #r WHERE qua_han < 0 OR tien < 0
	UPDATE #r SET tien1 = tien WHERE qua_han > 0 AND qua_han <= 30
	UPDATE #r SET tien2 = tien WHERE qua_han > 30 AND qua_han <= 60
	UPDATE #r SET tien3 = tien WHERE qua_han > 60 AND qua_han <= 90
	UPDATE #r SET tien4 = tien WHERE qua_han > 90


	-- Result
	DECLARE @n INT, @c NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @n = COUNT(1) FROM #r
	IF @max_record <> 0 AND @n > @max_record BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM dbreports WHERE xtype = '00' AND ccode = CASE WHEN @fieldID = 'G004' THEN '004' ELSE '005' END
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS i, ma_kh, tien, tien1, tien2, tien3, tien4 INTO #r2 FROM #r
		SET @q = 'insert into #r2 (ma_kh, tien, tien1, tien2, tien3, tien4) select top ' + RTRIM(@max_record - 1) + ' ma_kh, sum(tien), sum(tien1), sum(tien2), sum(tien3), sum(tien4) from #r group by ma_kh order by sum(tien) desc'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		INSERT INTO #r2 SELECT NULL, a.tien - b.tien, a.tien1 - b.tien1, a.tien2 - b.tien2, a.tien3 - b.tien3, a.tien4 - b.tien4
			FROM (SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien1) AS tien1, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien3) AS tien3, SUM(tien4) AS tien4 FROM #r) a, (SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien1) AS tien1, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien3) AS tien3, SUM(tien4) AS tien4 FROM #r2) b
		SET @q = 'select a.ma_kh, isnull(' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE 'b.ten_kh2' END + ', N''' + @c + ''') as ten_kh, a.tien, a.tien1, a.tien2, a.tien3, a.tien4 from #r2 a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.i'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select' + CASE WHEN @max_record = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' top ' + RTRIM(@max_record) END + ' a.ma_kh, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_kh)' ELSE 'max(b.ten_kh2)' END + ' as ten_kh, sum(a.tien) as tien, sum(a.tien1) as tien1, sum(a.tien2) as tien2, sum(a.tien3) as tien3, sum(a.tien4) as tien4'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #r a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_kh order by tien desc'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPVTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@InventoryAccount VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDetail NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000),@q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT top 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ps_no_nt AS t_tt_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = '', @KeyDetail = '', @SiteKey = ''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Account), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Admin = 0 SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @KeyDetail = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @InventoryAccount <> '' SET @KeyDetail = @KeyDetail + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@InventoryAccount), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyDetail <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyDetail), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) = 0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.t_tt_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i71$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m71$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = '
select distinct 0 as tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt
	from #tmp a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vrptdmmagd]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_gd, ten_gd, ten_gd2, ten_loai, ten_loai2, ten_ct, ten_ct2, ct_nxt
		FROM (
			SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.ma_gd, a.ten_gd, a.ten_gd2, b.ten_loai, b.ten_loai2, c.ten_ct, c.ten_ct2, c.ct_nxt
				FROM dmmagd a JOIN dmloaict b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = b.loai_ct JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
				WHERE a.ma_ct IN ('DX1', 'HD2', 'HD4', 'HDA', 'HDF', 'HDR', 'PD1', 'PD2', 'PNA', 'PNB', 'PNC', 'PND', 'PNH', 'PNE', 'PNF', 'PNI', 'PNG', 'PXA', 'PXB', 'PXC', 'PXH', 'PXI', 'PXR') OR (a.ma_ct = 'DXA' AND a.loai_ct = '3')
			UNION ALL
				SELECT 0, ma_ct, '7', '7', ten_ct, ten_ct2, ten_ct, ten_ct2, ten_ct, ten_ct2, ct_nxt FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PXF'
			UNION ALL
				SELECT 0, 'PXG', a.loai_ct, a.ma_gd, a.ten_gd, a.ten_gd2, b.ten_loai, b.ten_loai2, c.ten_ct, c.ten_ct2, c.ct_nxt FROM dmmagd a JOIN dmloaict b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = b.loai_ct JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct WHERE a.ma_ct = 'PNG'
		) a
		ORDER BY ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_gd
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRunBOMExplode] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @dM SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @userID INT
AS
BEGIN			
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_sp, ma_vt, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc AS ngay_yc0 INTO #ycvt FROM mrctycvt
	SELECT nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, so_luong, ngay_yc INTO #mrncsp FROM mrncsp
	INSERT INTO #ycvt(ma_sp, ma_vt, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc0) EXEC rs_MRPRunGetMaterialsFromBOMByProduct @dNow, '#mrncsp'

	SELECT a.nguon, a.so_dh, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_kho, b.ma_vt, b.so_luong, b.ngay_yc, dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, b.ngay_yc) AS ky
		INTO #mrctycvt FROM mrncsp a JOIN #ycvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ngay_yc = b.ngay_yc0 WHERE b.so_luong <> 0

	--
	TRUNCATE TABLE mrctycvt
	INSERT INTO mrctycvt
			(
				nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, ma_vt, so_luong, ngay_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), ngay_yc
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mrctycvt
			GROUP BY nguon, so_dh, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_kho, ma_vt, ngay_yc
	--


	TRUNCATE TABLE mrctyclsx
	INSERT INTO mrctyclsx
			(
				loai, ky, ma_vt, so_lsx, so_luong
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT '01', ky, ma_vt, so_lsx, SUM(so_luong)
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mrctycvt
			WHERE so_lsx <> ''
			GROUP BY ky, ma_vt, so_lsx
	--
	INSERT INTO mrctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, so_dh, stt_rec
				, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PS', '', ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_yc, 0, so_luong, so_dh, ''
				, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM mrctycvt
			WHERE nguon = 'PS'
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSOTran] ---[rs_PrintSVTran]----
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table CHAR(10), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt) as tien_ck_nt, (a.tien2 - a.ck) as tien_ck'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt' -- song ngữ
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_vv, a.ngay_giao, a.ngay_ct, (case when a.ma_vt <> '''' then rtrim(a.ma_vt) else '''' end '
	SET @q = @q + ' + case when g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' <> '''' then '' - '' + rtrim(g.ten_vt' + @cE + ') else '''' end) as description'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_giao smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_ct smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 ngay_giao, ngay_ct, ma_vv from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintCDTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cTaxTable VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @strSQL = 'SELECT a.tk_no, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM (SELECT 0 AS l1, line_nbr, tk_no, tt - thue AS tien, tt_nt - thue_nt AS tien_nt FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UNION ALL'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT 1, line_nbr, tk_thue_no, t_thue, t_thue_nt FROM ' + @cTaxTable + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ) a'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' GROUP BY a.tk_no ORDER BY MIN(a.l1), MIN(a.line_nbr)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_SFPostQC]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @rq TINYINT, @p VARCHAR(6), @maxLineD INT, @maxSttD CHAR(3)

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @p = RIGHT(@masterTable, 6)

	SELECT a.* INTO #ms5 FROM ms5$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.sl_duyet AS sl_nhap1, a.sl_duyet AS sl_xuat1, a.sl_hong AS sl_hong1 INTO #ds5 FROM ds5$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Get Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #ms5 select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #ds5 select *, sl_duyet, so_luong, sl_hong from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	-- 1. Post nhập xuất tồn
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds5', '#sfctpx', '#ds5', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms5', '#ds5', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

	UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 2, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
		sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so, @rq), sl_nhap = 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, loai = '20'


	SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds5 WHERE sl_duyet > 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @maxLineD = MAX(line_nbr), @maxSttD = MAX(stt_rec0) FROM #sfctpx
		SELECT @maxLineD = ISNULL(@maxLineD, 0), @maxSttD = ISNULL(@maxSttD, '000')
		TRUNCATE TABLE #sfctpx

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds5', '#sfctpx', '#ds5', 'sl_duyet > 0', NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms5', '#ds5', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

		UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 1, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', loai = '', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
			sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, xtab = 1,
			stt_rec0 = REPLACE(STR((CAST(@maxSttD AS INT) + line_nbr), 3), ' ', '0'), line_nbr = line_nbr + @maxLineD

		SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds5 WHERE sl_lam_lai > 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @maxLineD = MAX(line_nbr), @maxSttD = MAX(stt_rec0) FROM #sfctpx
		SELECT @maxLineD = ISNULL(@maxLineD, 0), @maxSttD = ISNULL(@maxSttD, '000')
		TRUNCATE TABLE #sfctpx

		UPDATE #ds5 SET sl_nhap1 = sl_lam_lai
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds5', '#sfctpx', '#ds5', 'sl_lam_lai > 0', NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms5', '#ds5', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

		UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 1, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', loai = '30', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
			sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0,
			stt_rec0 = REPLACE(STR((CAST(@maxSttD AS INT) + line_nbr), 3), ' ', '0'), line_nbr = line_nbr + @maxLineD

		SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ds5 WHERE sl_hong > 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @maxLineD = MAX(line_nbr), @maxSttD = MAX(stt_rec0) FROM #sfctpx
		SELECT @maxLineD = ISNULL(@maxLineD, 0), @maxSttD = ISNULL(@maxSttD, '000')
		TRUNCATE TABLE #sfctpx

		UPDATE #ds5 SET sl_nhap1 = sl_hong1
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds5', '#sfctpx', '#ds5', 'sl_hong > 0', NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms5', '#ds5', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

		UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 1, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', loai = '40', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
			sl_hong = ROUND(sl_hong1*he_so, @rq), sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0,
			stt_rec0 = REPLACE(STR((CAST(@maxSttD AS INT) + line_nbr), 3), ' ', '0'), line_nbr = line_nbr + @maxLineD


		SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesReportDetailedByItem2] --fs20_SOSalesSummary--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @so_luong AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @tien2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @ck AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @pt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @pt_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @thue AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @lai AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @lai_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT

	DECLARE @ct_giam VARCHAR(32), @ct_giam2 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @so_luong_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @so_luong_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @giam_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_giam_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@ck_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_tl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@tien_von_thuan_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @giam_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_giam NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @ck_tl NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@thue_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_tl NUMERIC(28, 6), @doanh_thu_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_von_thuan NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @ct_giam = 'HD2', @ct_giam2 = 'HD4'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 nxt, ma_ct, loai_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong, a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt
			, (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) AS lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) AS lai_nt
			, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt
			, (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) AS pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) AS pt_nt

			, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong_thuan, a.sl_xuat AS so_luong_tl, a.tien_nt2 AS giam_gia_nt, a.thue_nt AS thue_giam_nt
			, a.tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_tl_nt, a.ck_nt AS ck_tl_nt, a.thue_nt AS thue_tl_nt, a.tien_nt2 AS tien_von_tl_nt
			, a.tien_nt2 AS doanh_thu_thuan_nt, a.tien_nt2 AS thue_thuan_nt, a.tien_nt2 AS tien_von_thuan_nt

			, a.tien2 AS giam_gia, a.thue AS thue_giam
			, a.tien2 AS doanh_thu_tl, a.ck AS ck_tl, a.thue AS thue_tl, a.tien2 AS tien_von_tl
			, a.tien2 AS doanh_thu_thuan, a.tien2 AS thue_thuan, a.tien2 AS tien_von_thuan

		INTO #temp
		FROM wrkin a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY 1

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = ''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @SalesAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @SalesAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT

	--
	IF @Group <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @Group + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.nxt, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt'
	IF @Form = '1' SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 - a.ck - a.tien_xuat) as lai, (a.tien_nt2 - a.ck_nt - a.tien_nt_x) as lai_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, case when a.nxt = 1 then 0 else a.gia2 end as gia2, case when a.nxt = 1 then 0 else a.gia_nt2 end as gia_nt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.nxt = 1 then 0 else a.tien2 end as tien2, case when a.nxt = 1 then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end as tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) as pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) as pt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, a.sl_nhap as so_luong_tl, a.tien_nt2 as giam_gia_nt, thue_nt as thue_giam, a.tien_nt2 as doanh_thu_tl_nt, a.ck_nt as ck_tl_nt, a.thue_nt as thue_tl_nt, a.tien_nt_n as tien_von_tl_nt, 0, 0, 0, a.tien2 as giam_gia, a.thue as thue_giam, a.tien2 as doanh_thu_tl, a.ck as ck_tl, a.thue as thue_tl, a.tien_nhap as tien_von_tl, 0, 0, 0'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #temp SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0, lai_nt = 0
			WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt
			, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE so_luong END) AS so_luong, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien END) AS tien, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END) AS tien_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt2, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien2 END) AS tien2, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt2 END) AS tien_nt2
			, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE ck END) AS ck, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE ck_nt END) AS ck_nt, SUM(pt) AS pt, SUM(pt_nt) AS pt_nt
			, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE thue END) AS thue, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 OR (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN 0 ELSE thue_nt END) AS thue_nt, SUM(lai) AS lai, SUM(lai_nt) AS lai_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt

			, SUM(CASE WHEN (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN -giam_gia ELSE 0 END) AS giam_gia, SUM(CASE WHEN (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN -giam_gia_nt ELSE 0 END) AS giam_gia_nt, SUM(CASE WHEN (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN -thue_giam ELSE 0 END) AS thue_giam, SUM(CASE WHEN (ma_ct IN(@ct_giam, @ct_giam2) AND loai_ct = 1) THEN -thue_giam_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_giam_nt
			, SUM(so_luong_tl) AS so_luong_tl, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN doanh_thu_tl ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_tl, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN doanh_thu_tl_nt ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_tl_nt
			, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN ck_tl ELSE 0 END) AS ck_tl, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN ck_tl_nt ELSE 0 END) AS ck_tl_nt
			, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN thue_tl ELSE 0 END) AS thue_tl, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN thue_tl_nt ELSE 0 END) AS thue_tl_nt
			, SUM(so_luong * 0) AS so_luong_thuan, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN tien_von_tl_nt ELSE 0 END) AS tien_von_tl_nt, SUM(tien_nt2 * 0) AS doanh_thu_thuan_nt, SUM(thue_nt * 0) AS thue_thuan_nt, SUM(tien_nt2 *0) AS tien_von_thuan_nt, SUM(CASE WHEN nxt = 1 THEN tien_von_tl ELSE 0 END) AS tien_von_tl
			, SUM(tien2 * 0) AS doanh_thu_thuan, SUM(thue * 0) AS thue_thuan, SUM(tien2 * 0) AS tien_von_thuan
		INTO #report
			FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
				GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END
		, gia2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien2/so_luong, @cPRound) END
		, gia_nt2 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tien_nt2/so_luong, @cPFCRound) END

	--
	UPDATE #report SET so_luong_thuan = so_luong - so_luong_tl, @doanh_thu_thuan = tien2 - ck - giam_gia - doanh_thu_tl + ck_tl,
		@thue_thuan = thue - thue_giam - thue_tl, @tien_von_thuan = tien - tien_von_tl, @doanh_thu_thuan_nt = tien_nt2 - ck_nt - giam_gia_nt - doanh_thu_tl_nt + ck_tl_nt,
		@thue_thuan_nt = thue_nt - thue_giam_nt - thue_tl_nt, @tien_von_thuan_nt = tien_nt - tien_von_tl_nt,
		doanh_thu_thuan = @doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan = @thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan = @tien_von_thuan,
		doanh_thu_thuan_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt = @thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt = @tien_von_thuan_nt,
		pt = @doanh_thu_thuan + @thue_thuan, pt_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt + @thue_thuan_nt, lai = @doanh_thu_thuan - @tien_von_thuan, lai_nt = @doanh_thu_thuan_nt - @tien_von_thuan_nt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', 'int, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	SELECT @so_luong =  SUM(so_luong)
			, @tien = SUM(tien), @tien_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_nt) END
			, @tien2 = SUM(tien2), @tien_nt2 = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_nt2) END
			, @ck = SUM(ck), @ck_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ck_nt) END
			, @thue = SUM(thue), @thue_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_nt) END
			, @pt = SUM(pt), @pt_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(pt_nt) END
			, @lai = SUM(lai), @lai_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(lai_nt) END

			, @so_luong_thuan = SUM(so_luong_thuan), @so_luong_tl = SUM(so_luong_tl)
			, @giam_gia = SUM(giam_gia), @giam_gia_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(giam_gia_nt) END
			, @thue_giam = SUM(thue_giam), @thue_giam_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_giam_nt) END
			, @doanh_thu_tl = SUM(doanh_thu_tl), @doanh_thu_tl_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(doanh_thu_tl_nt) END
			, @ck_tl = SUM(ck_tl), @ck_tl_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ck_tl_nt) END
			, @thue_tl = SUM(thue_tl), @thue_tl_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_tl_nt) END
			, @tien_von_tl = SUM(tien_von_tl), @tien_von_tl_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_von_tl_nt) END
			, @doanh_thu_thuan = SUM(doanh_thu_thuan), @doanh_thu_thuan_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(doanh_thu_thuan_nt) END
			, @thue_thuan = SUM(thue_thuan), @thue_thuan_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(thue_thuan_nt) END
			, @tien_von_thuan = SUM(tien_von_thuan), @tien_von_thuan_nt = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_von_thuan_nt) END
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE 'ma_vt' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt',
				'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan',
				'#report', 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @fieldGroup VARCHAR(16), @fieldGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT, @strSum VARCHAR(4000)
			DECLARE @noGroup NVARCHAR(511), @noGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
			SELECT @strSum = 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan'
			SELECT @noGroup = RTRIM(cName), @noGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			SELECT @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) + ',', @q = '', @fieldGroups = ''

			SELECT @q = 'alter table #report alter column ten_vt nvarchar(511)'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ten_vt2 nvarchar(511)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList, @nStart) > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = ''
				SET @fieldGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
				SET @i = @i + 1
				IF @fieldGroups = '' SET @fieldGroups = @fieldGroup ELSE SET @fieldGroups = @fieldGroups + ',' + @fieldGroup
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt=space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt),ten_vt2=space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt2) where systotal=1'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_vt,ten_vt,ten_vt2,' + @fieldGroups + ','
				SET @q = @q + @strSum + ') select ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
				SET @q = @q + 'max(b.ten_nh),max(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@fieldGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',sum(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),sum(a.') + ')'
				SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join (select * from dmnhvt where loai_nh = '
				SET @q = @q + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@fieldGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b ON a.' + @fieldGroup + '=b.ma_nh where a.systotal=1'
				SET @q = @q + ' group by a.' + REPLACE(@fieldGroups, ',', ',a.')
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt= N' + CHAR(39) + @noGroup + CHAR(39) + ' where ten_vt is null and systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt2= N' + CHAR(39) + @noGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' where ten_vt2 is null and systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt=space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + rtrim(ten_vt), ten_vt2=space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt2) where systotal=0 and not ' + @fieldGroup + ' is null'
				SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

		END
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #Report)
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt, so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan)
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s, @s, @so_luong, @tien, @tien_nt, @tien2, @tien_nt2, @ck, @ck_nt, @pt, @pt_nt, @thue, @thue_nt, @lai, @lai_nt, @so_luong_thuan, @so_luong_tl, @giam_gia_nt, @thue_giam_nt, @doanh_thu_tl_nt, @ck_tl_nt, @thue_tl_nt, @tien_von_tl_nt, @doanh_thu_thuan_nt, @thue_thuan_nt, @tien_von_thuan_nt, @giam_gia, @thue_giam, @doanh_thu_tl, @ck_tl, @thue_tl, @tien_von_tl, @doanh_thu_thuan, @thue_thuan, @tien_von_thuan)

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia2, gia_nt, gia_nt2, tien, tien_nt, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, lai, lai_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', so_luong_thuan, so_luong_tl, giam_gia_nt, thue_giam_nt, doanh_thu_tl_nt, ck_tl_nt, thue_tl_nt, tien_von_tl_nt, doanh_thu_thuan_nt, thue_thuan_nt, tien_von_thuan_nt, giam_gia, thue_giam, doanh_thu_tl, ck_tl, thue_tl, tien_von_tl, doanh_thu_thuan, thue_thuan, tien_von_thuan'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion] (@str VARCHAR(32), @b VARCHAR(32))
RETURNS VARCHAR(32)
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @v NVARCHAR(32), @i1 INT, @i2 INT, @s VARCHAR(32), @isBase INT
	SELECT @v = '', @s = LTRIM(RTRIM(@str)), @b = LTRIM(RTRIM(@b)), @isBase = 0
	IF @b <> '' SET @isBase = 1 ELSE SET @b = @s
	SET @i1 = CHARINDEX('[', @b)
	IF @i1 > 0 BEGIN
		SET @i2 = CHARINDEX(']', @b, @i1)
		IF @i2 > @i1 BEGIN
			SELECT @v = SUBSTRING(@s, @i1 + 1 - @isBase, @i2 - @i1 - 1), @v = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(@v) = 1 THEN @v ELSE '' END
			RETURN @v
		END
	END

	-- Without region
	DECLARE @i INT, @n1 NVARCHAR(32), @n2 NVARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @n2 = '', @s = @str
	WHILE @s <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', @s), @s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@i = PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', @s), @n1 = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, 1, @i - 1) ELSE @s END, 
			@s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@n2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@n2) < LEN(@n1) THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END
	END
	RETURN @n2
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_IncreaseVoucherNo  
	@cVoucherNo VARCHAR(33), 
	@cCode CHAR(3)

	IF dbo.ff_IsNumeric(@cVoucherNo) = 0 RETURN

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$DCAccount]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@Date, @BalanceType)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	-- Balance (year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh a with(nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4)
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a WITH (INDEX(tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where 1 = 1'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (index(tk_ma_kh)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	SET @q = 'select tk, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk order by tk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO

		FROM sthd a JOIN v20dmnk b ON a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk JOIN dmmauct c ON b.ky_hieu = c.ma_mau_ct LEFT JOIN dmloaihd2 d ON c.loai_hd = d.loai_hd
