	SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.kieu_tinh, b.ky_ngay_tu, b.ky_ngay_den, a.loai_luong INTO #hrstt_rec FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrky b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hrstt_rec(stt_rec)

	-- Xác định bộ phận quản lý của nv tại thời điểm tính (gần nhất so với ngày cuối kỳ lương).
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay_tu, b.bo_phan AS ma_bp INTO #bpqt FROM #hrstt_rec a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hreqtlvht b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp <> b.bo_phan
		JOIN (SELECT e.stt_rec, MAX(f.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM #hrstt_rec e JOIN hreqtlvht f WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.stt_rec = f.stt_rec
				WHERE f.tinh_chat = 1 AND f.ngay_tu <= e.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY e.stt_rec) c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.ngay_tu = c.ngay_tu
		WHERE b.ngay_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_den >= a.ky_ngay_den

	UPDATE #hrstt_rec SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp, ky_ngay_tu = c.ky_ngay_tu, ky_ngay_den = c.ky_ngay_den FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN #bpqt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrky c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
	UPDATE #hrluong SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp FROM #hrluong a JOIN #bpqt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	/*
		Kết thúc tạo danh sách nhân viên mỗi dòng chỉ có một bản ghi
	*/



	/*
		Tạo bảng công tổng hợp
	*/
	CREATE TABLE #hrcongthtemp(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(12, 5))
	CREATE TABLE #part(part CHAR(6)) -- Dùng lại ở nhiều nơi khác

	DECLARE @d CHAR(6), @ky_max CHAR(6)
	SELECT @d = CONVERT(CHAR(6), MIN(ky_ngay_tu), 112), @ky_max = CONVERT(CHAR(6), MAX(ky_ngay_den), 112) FROM #hrky
	WHILE @d <= @ky_max BEGIN
		SELECT @c = 'hrcongth$' + @d
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrcongthtemp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, sum(a.so_gio), sum(a.so_ngay)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @c + ' a with(nolock) join #hrstt_rec b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay between b.ky_ngay_tu and b.ky_ngay_den group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		INSERT INTO #part SELECT @d
		SELECT @d = CONVERT(CHAR(6), DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d + '01'), 112)
	END

	--
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong, SUM(so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(so_ngay) AS so_ngay INTO #hrcongth FROM #hrcongthtemp GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hrcongth(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong)

	/*
		Kết thúc tạo bảng công tổng hợp
	*/


	-- Lấy thêm nhân viên theo bộ phận trong bảng tổng hợp công
	SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, b.loai_luong, b.kieu_tinh INTO #nvtemp
		FROM #hrcongth a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_bp <> b.ma_bp
	INSERT INTO #hrluong (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, loai_luong, kieu_tinh, bpql_yn)
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, loai_luong, kieu_tinh, 0 FROM #nvtemp


	--
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec_bp ON #hrluong(stt_rec, ma_bp)
/*
	Kêt thúc phần tạo danh sách các nhân viên tính lương theo quyền bộ phận
*/



/*
	Tính tỷ giá tính lương và tỷ giá tính bảo hiểm
*/
	-- 3. #hrdmtgtl: Tỷ giá tính lương
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_nt INTO #tgnt FROM #hrluong
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, b.ty_gia INTO #hrdmtgtl FROM (SELECT d.ma_bp, c.ma_nt, MAX(c.ngay_hl) ngay_hl FROM hrdmtgtl c, #hrky d WHERE c.ngay_hl <= d.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY d.ma_bp, c.ma_nt) a LEFT JOIN hrdmtgtl b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
		WHERE a.ma_nt IN (SELECT ma_nt FROM #tgnt)
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmtgtl WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency) INSERT INTO #hrdmtgtl SELECT ma_bp, @BaseCurrency, 1 FROM #hrky
	CREATE INDEX ma_nt_bp ON #hrdmtgtl(ma_bp, ma_nt)

	-- 4. #hrdmtgbh: Tỷ giá tính bảo hiểm
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, b.ty_gia INTO #hrdmtgbh FROM (SELECT d.ma_bp, c.ma_nt, MAX(c.ngay_hl) ngay_hl FROM hrdmtgbh c, #hrky d WHERE c.ngay_hl <= d.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY d.ma_bp, c.ma_nt) a LEFT JOIN hrdmtgbh b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
		WHERE a.ma_nt IN (SELECT ma_nt FROM #tgnt)
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmtgbh WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency) INSERT INTO #hrdmtgbh SELECT ma_bp, @BaseCurrency, 1 FROM #hrky
	CREATE INDEX ma_nt_bp ON #hrdmtgbh(ma_bp, ma_nt)
/*
	Kết thúc phần tính tỷ giá tính lương và tỷ giá tính bảo hiểm
*/


/*
	Tạo bảng lương tối thiểu
*/
	-- #hrdmlttc: Lương tối thiểu chung
	SELECT a.ma_bp, c.ngay_hl, c.luong_tt INTO #hrdmlttc FROM #hrky a
		JOIN (SELECT m.ma_bp, MAX(n.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM #hrky m, hrdmlttc n WHERE n.ngay_hl <= m.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY m.ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		JOIN hrdmlttc c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl

	-- 5. #hrdmlttv: Bảng lương tối thiểu vùng
	-- Bộ phận chính nó hoặc bộ phận mẹ gần nhất có khai báo lương tối thiểu vùng
	SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, a.ky_ngay_den, MAX(c.bp_ref) max_bp_ref
		INTO #hrdmlttv0 FROM #hrky a CROSS JOIN hrdmlttv b WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hrbp c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		WHERE b.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den AND a.bp_ref LIKE RTRIM(c.bp_ref) + '%'
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, a.ky_ngay_den
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.max_bp_ref, b.ma_bp AS max_ma_bp, MAX(ngay_hl) AS max_ngay_hl
		INTO #hrdmlttv1 FROM #hrdmlttv0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.max_bp_ref = b.bp_ref JOIN hrdmlttv c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt
		WHERE c.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.max_bp_ref, b.ma_bp
	SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, c.luong_tt
		INTO #hrdmlttv FROM #hrky a JOIN #hrdmlttv1 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN hrdmlttv c ON b.max_ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt AND b.max_ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX bp_nt ON #hrdmlttv(ma_bp, ma_nt)

	-- #hrdmlttcty: Lương tối thiểu công ty
	SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, a.ky_ngay_den, MAX(c.bp_ref) max_bp_ref
		INTO #hrdmlttcty0 FROM #hrky a CROSS JOIN hrdmlttcty b WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hrbp c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		WHERE b.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den AND a.bp_ref LIKE RTRIM(c.bp_ref) + '%'
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, a.ky_ngay_den
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.max_bp_ref, b.ma_bp AS max_ma_bp, MAX(ngay_hl) AS max_ngay_hl
		INTO #hrdmlttcty1 FROM #hrdmlttcty0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.max_bp_ref = b.bp_ref JOIN hrdmlttcty c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt
		WHERE c.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.max_bp_ref, b.ma_bp
	SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, c.luong_tt
		INTO #hrdmlttcty FROM #hrky a JOIN #hrdmlttcty1 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN hrdmlttcty c ON b.max_ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt AND b.max_ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX bp_nt ON #hrdmlttcty(ma_bp, ma_nt)

	-- #hrdmlttxl: Lương tối thiểu để tính toán các chỉ tiêu lương (L00, L01,...)
	SELECT TOP 0 *, 0 AS loai_ltt INTO #hrdmlttxl FROM #hrdmlttv
	INSERT INTO #hrdmlttxl SELECT *, 3 FROM #hrdmlttcty
	INSERT INTO #hrdmlttxl SELECT *, 2 FROM #hrdmlttv a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmlttcty b WHERE b.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = @BaseCurrency)
	INSERT INTO #hrdmlttxl SELECT ma_bp, @BaseCurrency, luong_tt, 1 FROM #hrdmlttc a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmlttxl b WHERE b.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = @BaseCurrency)
	CREATE INDEX bp_nt ON #hrdmlttxl(ma_bp, ma_nt)
/*
	Kết thúc phần tạo bảng lương tối thiểu
*/


/*
	Tạo bảng chi tiết loại lương của công
*/
	-- 6. #hrctloailuong: Chi tiết loại lương của công
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, a.loai_luong, RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%' AS bp_ref, b.bac_bp INTO #hrctloailuong FROM hrctloailuong a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.bp_ref, b.ma_cong, CAST(0 AS INT) AS loai_luong
		INTO #hrctloailuongtemp
		FROM hrbp a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_cong FROM #hrctloailuong) b
		WHERE a.ma_bp NOT IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM #hrctloailuong)

	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #hrctloailuong
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		UPDATE #hrctloailuongtemp SET loai_luong = b.loai_luong
			FROM #hrctloailuongtemp a JOIN #hrctloailuong b ON a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong
			WHERE b.bac_bp = @i
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #hrctloailuongtemp WHERE loai_luong = 0

	INSERT INTO #hrctloailuong (ma_bp, ma_cong, loai_luong) SELECT ma_bp, ma_cong, loai_luong FROM #hrctloailuongtemp
	CREATE INDEX bp_cong ON #hrctloailuong(ma_bp, ma_cong)

/*
	Kết thúc phần tạo bảng chi tiết loại lương của công
*/


/*
	Xác định hệ số thử việc ứng với bp của từng đoạn trong thông tin lương
*/
	-- Chèn thêm thời gian hợp đồng thử việc: nếu đoạn thời gian đó giao với thời gian thử việc và bộ phận ở đoạn đó có khai báo hệ số thử việc
	SELECT 0 AS l01, 0 AS l21, 0 AS l51, 0 AS l53, 0 AS d11, 0 AS d13, 0 AS d21, 0 AS d23, 0 AS l31 INTO #hrhstvll -- Loại lương có xử lý hệ số thử việc
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrhstvll WHERE status = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT LOWER(ma_loai_lg) AS ma_loai_lg INTO #hrhstvll_tmp FROM hrhstvll WHERE status = '1'
		SELECT @c = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #hrhstvll_tmp
		WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #hrhstvll set ' + REPLACE(@c, '''', '') + ' = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @c = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #hrhstvll_tmp WHERE ma_loai_lg > @c
		END
	END
/*
	 Kết thúc xác định loại lương có xử lý hệ số thử việc
*/


/*
	Tạo bảng thông tin lương
*/
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ngach, a.ma_bac, a.he_so_luong, a.tien_khoan, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_hl AS ngay_tu, a.ngay_hl AS ngay_den, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS nhieu_doan, a.he_so_luong AS he_so_tv
		INTO #ttluong FROM hrttctluong a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT NULL c) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ttluongqtbp FROM #ttluong
	EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollInformation
/*
	Kết thúc tạo bảng thông tin lương
*/


/*
	Tạo bảng thông tin thuế TNCN
*/
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, c.tinh_thue_yn, c.tinh_gt_yn, c.hop_dong_yn, 0 AS bhxh_yn, 0 AS bhyt_yn, 0 AS bhtn_yn, c.doi_tuong,
			a.ma_bp, a.ky_ngay_tu, a.ky_ngay_den, a.ma_nt
		INTO #phns FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN hrtttncn c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
	EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollPITInformation
/*
	Kết thúc tạo bảng thông tin thuế TNCN
*/


/*
	Xóa các bảng lương tạo trong kỳ
*/
	SET @p = REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0')
	IF OBJECT_ID('hrluongth$' + @p) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @k  = @p + ' r' + @Join + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key  ELSE '' END

		--Lương tổng hợp, lương tổng hợp mới (chi tiết theo giai đoạn)
		SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongth$' + @p + ' from hrluongth$' + @k
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hrluongth2$' + @p + ' from hrluongth2$' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--Lương theo công, lương theo công mới
		SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongtc$' + @p + ' from hrluongtc$' + @k
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hrluongtc2$' + @p + ' from hrluongtc2$' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--Lương sản phẩm
		SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongsp$' + @p + ' from hrluongsp$' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--Lương phụ cấp, lương phụ cấp mới
		SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongpc$' + @p + ' from hrluongpc$' + @k
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hrluongpc2$' + @p + ' from hrluongpc2$' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--Lương thu nhập/giảm trừ
		SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongtngt$' + @p + ' from hrluongtngt$' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
/*
	Kết thúc phần xóa các bảng lương tạo trong kỳ
*/

	-- Cập nhật tỷ giá cho bản ghi bpql
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_tl = b.ty_gia FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_bh = b.ty_gia FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgbh b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1


/*
	Tính các chỉ tiêu lương
*/
	-- Bảng thông tin loại lương
	SELECT ma_loai_lg, kieu, cong_thuc, status, stt, kieu_qd, lam_tron_gt_nt, lam_tron_gt INTO #hrloailuong FROM hrloailuong WITH(NOLOCK)

	-- Tính lương cơ bản: Cập nhật trường hệ số và lương cơ bản
	EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByBaseSalary @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tạo bảng thông tin chung
	-- Đối với lương cb không thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, l00 AS luong_cb INTO #hrluong0_1 FROM #hrluong WHERE bpql_yn = 1
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hrluong0_1(stt_rec)
	-- Đối với lương cb có thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt AS luong_cb INTO #hrluong0_2 FROM #hrluong2 WHERE ma_loai_lg = 'L00'
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hrluong0_2(stt_rec)

	-- Tính lương, tăng ca, chênh lệch tăng ca, chênh lệch ca đêm theo thời gian và khoán
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 1))  EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByTime @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính lương sản phẩm, phần vượt tăng ca và vượt ca đêm
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 2))  EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByProduct @Period, @Year, @Department, @Filter, @JointUnit, @JointDept, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính chênh lệch  lương tăng ca, thêm giờ và ban đêm được trừ khi tính thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 1, 2)) UPDATE #hrluong SET d01 = ISNULL(d11, 0) + ISNULL(d13, 0) + ISNULL(l52, 0), d02 = ISNULL(d21, 0) + ISNULL(l54, 0) + ISNULL(d23, 0)

	-- Tính lương bổ sung theo giờ công
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 3))  EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByWorkHours @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính lương theo hệ số bình bầu khen thưởng
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 4))  EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByEmulation @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính phụ cấp khác
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 5)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByAllowance @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính thưởng, phạt, thu nhập, giảm trừ khác và tạm ứng
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 6)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByOtherFactor @Period, @Year, @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính bảo hiểm, kinh phí công đoàn và chênh lệch đóng bảo hiểm, kinh phí công đoàn
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 7)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByInsurance @Round, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB
	/*
		Cập nhật liên quan đến bảo hiểm
	*/
	UPDATE #hrluong SET ma_bp0 = ISNULL(c.ma_bp, b.ma_bp) FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #bpqt c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_bp0 IS NULL
	SELECT @k = 'insert into hrluongth$' + @p + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt) select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, upper(''%s1''), round(%s1, %r2), case when tg_bh = 0 then 0 else round(%s1 / tg_bh, %r1) end from #hrluong where isnull(%s1, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @c = 'b00, b01, b02, b03, b04, b05, b06, c01, c02, c09, e01', @i = 0

	SELECT @n = LEN(@c)
	WHILE @i * 5 + 1 < @n BEGIN
		SET @w = SUBSTRING(@c, @i * 5 + 1, 3)
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k, '%s1', @w), '%r1', lam_tron_gt_nt), '%r2', lam_tron_gt) FROM #hrloailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @w
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	UPDATE #hrluong SET b00 = ROUND(b00 / tg_bh, @Round), b01 = ROUND(b01 / tg_bh, @Round), b02 = ROUND(b02 / tg_bh, @Round), b03 = ROUND(b03 / tg_bh, @Round),
		b04 = ROUND(b04 / tg_bh, @Round), b05 = ROUND(b05 / tg_bh, @Round), b06 = ROUND(b06 / tg_bh, @Round), c01 = ROUND(c01 / tg_bh, @Round),
		c02 = ROUND(c02 / tg_bh, @Round), c09 = ROUND(c09 / tg_bh, @Round), e01 = ROUND(e01 / tg_bh, @Round) WHERE ISNULL(tg_bh, 0) <> 0 AND bpql_yn = 1
	/*
		Kết thúc cập nhật liên quan đến bảo hiểm
	*/

	-- Tính cho các trường hệ số
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 8, 10, 12)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollCoefficientFields @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính cho các trường loại khác
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 9, 10, 12)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollOtherFields @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính loại lương kiểu 3 - theo chỉ tiêu lương
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 14)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByNorm @Period, @Year, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Cập nhật điều chỉnh lương
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 13)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollAdjustment @Period, @Year, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB


	-- Cập nhật tỷ giá
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_tl = b.ty_gia FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		WHERE a.bpql_yn <> 1
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_bh = b.ty_gia FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgbh b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		WHERE a.bpql_yn <> 1
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_tl = 0 WHERE tg_tl IS NULL
	UPDATE #hrluong SET tg_bh = 0 WHERE tg_bh IS NULL


	-- Tính các chỉ tiêu công thức trước chỉ tiêu thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 10, 12)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByFormula '', 'T20', @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	-- Tính thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.thue_nt AS t20_nt, a.tn_ct_nt AS t12_nt, a.gt_bt_nt AS t13_nt, a.gt_pt_nt AS t14_nt, a.gt_tt_nt AS t15_nt, a.gt_ht_nt AS t16_nt, a.tn_tt_sqd_nt AS t19_nt, a.thue_nt AS e02_nt, a.thue_nt AS t21_nt,
			a.thue AS t20, a.tn_ct AS t12, a.gt_bt AS t13, a.gt_pt AS t14, a.gt_tt AS t15, a.gt_ht AS t16, a.tn_tt_sqd AS t19, a.thue AS e02, a.thue AS t21, b.ma_bp, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nt
		INTO #hrluongthuetncn FROM hrt02$0000 a, #hrluong b
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 11)) EXEC hs_CalcPersonalIncomeTax @Period, @Year, @Round, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB
	/*
		Cập nhật liên quan đến thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	*/
	SET @q = 'update #hrluong set t20 = b.t20_nt, t12 = b.t12_nt, t13 = b.t13_nt, t14 = b.t14_nt, t15 = b.t15_nt, t16 = b.t16_nt, t19 = b.t19_nt, e02 = b.e02_nt, t21 = b.t21_nt
				from #hrluong a left join #hrluongthuetncn b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.bpql_yn = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #hrluongthuetncn SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp, ma_bp0 = ISNULL(a.ma_bp0, c.ma_bp), ma_nt = b.ma_nt FROM #hrluongthuetncn a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.bpql_yn = 1 JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
	SELECT @k = 'insert into hrluongth$' + @p + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt)
		select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, upper(''%s1''), round(%s1, %r2), round(%s1_nt, %r1) from #hrluongthuetncn where isnull(%s1, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @c = 't12, t13, t14, t15, t16, t19, t20, t21, e02', @i = 0
	SELECT @n = LEN(@c)
	WHILE @i * 5 + 1 < @n BEGIN
		SET @w = SUBSTRING(@c, @i * 5 + 1, 3)
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k, '%s1', @w), '%r1', lam_tron_gt_nt), '%r2', lam_tron_gt) FROM #hrloailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @w
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	/*
		Kết thúc cập nhật liên quan đến thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	*/

	IF @DebugMode = 1 SELECT b.ma_nv, a.* FROM #hrluong a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec ORDER BY b.ma_nv

	-- Tính các chỉ tiêu công thức sau chỉ tiêu thuế thu nhập cá nhân
	IF (@DebugMode = 0 OR @Step  IN (0, 12)) EXEC hs_CalculatePayrollByFormula 'T20', '', @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB


/*
	Kết thúc tính các chỉ tiêu lương
*/

/*
	Cập nhật bộ phận quản lý cho các bản ghi
*/
	UPDATE #hrluong SET ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE ma_bp0 IS NULL
	UPDATE #hrluong2 SET ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp FROM #hrluong2 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
/*
	Kết thúc cập nhật bộ phận quản lý cho các bản ghi
*/

/*
	Cập nhật bảng chi tiết
*/
	IF @DebugMode = 1 AND @Step > 0 AND @Step < 9 RETURN

	-- Xóa lại dữ liệu bảng luonngth do quá trình tính toán có insert dữ liệu tạm
	SELECT @k  = @p + ' r' + @Join + ' where ma_loai_lg not in (''t12'', ''t13'', ''t14'', ''t15'', ''t16'', ''t19'', ''t20'', ''t21'', ''e02'')' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key  ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = 'delete hrluongth$' + @p + ' from hrluongth$' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @ec BIT
	SELECT @k = 'insert into hrluongth$' + @p + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt) select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, upper(''%s1''), round([%s1] * %s2, %r2), round([%s1], %r1) from #hrluong where isnull([%s1], 0) <> 0'
	SELECT ma_loai_lg INTO #upgt FROM #hrloailuong WHERE status = '1' AND ma_loai_lg NOT IN ('t12', 't13', 't14', 't15', 't16', 't19', 't20', 't21', 'e02')
	SELECT @c = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #upgt
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @c = LTRIM(RTRIM(@c))
		SELECT @convertStyle = kieu_qd FROM #hrloailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @c
		SELECT @ec = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = @c + '_qd' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#hrluong')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		SELECT @s = CASE
			WHEN @convertStyle = 1 THEN 'tg_tl'
			WHEN @convertStyle = 2 THEN 'tg_bh'
			WHEN @convertStyle = 3 THEN '1'
			WHEN @convertStyle = 4 THEN CASE WHEN @ec = 1 THEN '0 + ' + @c + '_qd' ELSE '0' END
			ELSE '1'
		END
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k, '%s1', @c), '%s2', @s), '%r1', lam_tron_gt_nt), '%r2', lam_tron_gt) FROM #hrloailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @c
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @c = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #upgt WHERE ma_loai_lg > @c
	END

	SELECT @q = 'update #hrluong2 set gt = round(b.ty_gia * a.gt_nt, ' + LTRIM(STR(@Round)) + ') from #hrluong2 a join #hrdmtgtl b on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt where ma_loai_lg in (select ma_loai_lg from #hrloailuong where kieu_qd = 1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongth2$' + @p + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt, gt_nt)'
		+ ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nt, a.ma_loai_lg, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, round(a.gt, b.lam_tron_gt), round(a.gt_nt, b.lam_tron_gt_nt) from #hrluong2 a join #hrloailuong b on a.ma_loai_lg = b.ma_loai_lg where a.gt + a.gt_nt <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
/*
	Kết thúc cập nhật bảng chi tiết
*/

	IF @DebugMode = 1 SELECT b.ma_nv, a.* FROM #hrluong a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec ORDER BY b.ma_nv

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoGenerateWorkOrder]
	@nameWO NVARCHAR(512),
	@nameWO2 NVARCHAR(512),
	@routing VARCHAR(32),
	@workingShift VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherList VARCHAR(4000),
	@field VARCHAR(32) OUT,
	@message NVARCHAR(512) OUT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin TINYINT,
	@debug INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @v NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @d0 VARCHAR(32), @part CHAR(6)
	DECLARE @ExtTable VARCHAR(8), @voucherCode CHAR(3), @wsID VARCHAR(8), @ExtField VARCHAR(512)
	DECLARE @mF$ NVARCHAR(4000), @mFV$ NVARCHAR(4000), @dF$ NVARCHAR(4000), @dFV$ NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @count NUMERIC(12, 0), @l0 INT, @l1 INT, @l2 INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_lsx, a.ten_lsx, a.ten_lsx2, a.so_lsx, a.stt_rec_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lo_trinh, a.ma_ca, a.sl_yc, a.t_so_luong, a.dien_giai, b.c$, b.m$, b.d$, a.ma_nk INTO #master FROM ms2$000000 a, is2$000000 b
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_cd, so_luong, line_nbr INTO #detail FROM ds2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nk, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_lsx, stt_rec_lsx INTO #stt_rec0 FROM ms2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, stt_rec_lsx INTO #stt_rec1 FROM #stt_rec0

	-- Set
	SELECT @ExtField = '', @ExtTable = '', @d0 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(512), GETDATE(), 121), @ExtTable = 's2', @voucherCode = 'SF2'
	SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('cs2$000000') AND name = 'ma_nk') SELECT @ExtField = ', ma_nk'
	SELECT @l0 = character_maximum_length FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'ms2$000000' AND column_name = 'so_ct'
	SELECT @l1 = character_maximum_length FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'ms2$000000' AND column_name = 'ma_lsx'
	SELECT @l2 = character_maximum_length FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'ms2$000000' AND column_name = 'so_lsx'
	IF @voucherList = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @voucherList = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @voucherList <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@voucherList, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- WO Data Tmp
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt_rec1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select c.ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct, space(' + RTRIM(@l2 - @l0) + ') + a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, b.ma_lo_trinh, '''', a.so_luong, a.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctsx a join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join phsx c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ' and c.status <> ''*'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #stt_rec0 (ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, stt_rec, ma_lsx, stt_rec_lsx)
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lo_trinh, @workingShift, SUM(a.sl_yc), '', a.stt_rec0, stt_rec_lsx
			FROM #stt_rec1 a GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_lo_trinh, a.stt_rec_lsx

	-- WO Check
	-- + Unit
	IF ((@admin = 0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt_rec0 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysunitrights b WHERE a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND b.r_new = 1 AND b.user_id = @userID))) BEGIN
		SELECT @field = '', @message = '$NotAuthorized'
		RETURN
	END

	-- + Locked Date
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt_rec0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmdvcsks b WHERE b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND b.ngay_ks >= a.ngay_ct)) BEGIN
		SELECT @field = 'ngay_ct', @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày giới hạn hoặc ngày khóa sổ.' ELSE N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' END
		RETURN
	END

	-- + Routing
	DECLARE @c0 VARCHAR(32), @c1 VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT DISTINCT so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh INTO #p FROM #stt_rec0
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #p a WHERE a.ma_lo_trinh = '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ctrtvt b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt AND b.ma_lo_trinh = @routing)) BEGIN
		SELECT @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Lộ trình <span class="Highlight">%s</span> không đúng.' ELSE N'The Routing <span class="Highlight">%s</span> is invalid.' END
		SELECT 'ma_lo_trinh' AS field, REPLACE(@message, '%s', RTRIM(@routing)) AS message
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT TOP 1 @c0 = so_lsx, @c1 = ma_sp FROM #p a WHERE a.ma_lo_trinh <> '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ctrtvt b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt and a.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh)
	IF @c0 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @message = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Lệnh sản xuất <span class="Highlight">%s0</span>, sản phẩm <span class="Highlight">%s1</span> không đúng.' ELSE N'MO Number <span class="Highlight">%s0</span>, product <span class="Highlight">%s1</span> is invalid.' END
		SELECT '' AS field, REPLACE(REPLACE(@message, '%s0', RTRIM(@c0)), '%s1', RTRIM(@c1)) AS message
		RETURN
	END

	-- WO Data Insert
	-- + Update
	UPDATE #stt_rec0 SET ma_lo_trinh = @routing WHERE ma_lo_trinh = ''
	UPDATE #stt_rec0 SET ma_lsx = LTRIM(RTRIM(so_lsx)) + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_lsx))
	DELETE #stt_rec0 FROM #stt_rec0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cs2$000000 b WHERE a.ma_lsx LIKE RTRIM(b.ma_lsx) + '%' AND b.status <> '0') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cs2$000000 b WHERE b.ma_lsx LIKE RTRIM(a.ma_lsx) + '%' AND b.status <> '0')
	DELETE cs2$000000 FROM cs2$000000 a WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt_rec0 b WHERE b.ma_lsx LIKE RTRIM(a.ma_lsx) + '%') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt_rec0 b WHERE a.ma_lsx LIKE RTRIM(b.ma_lsx) + '%')) AND a.status = '0'
	--
	CREATE INDEX i ON #stt_rec0(ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, stt_rec_lsx)
	ALTER TABLE #stt_rec0 ADD id_stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #stt_rec0
	IF @debug <> 1 EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, @voucherCode, @count, @userID, '#stt_rec0', 'stt_rec', 'id_stt'

	-- + m$
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, @vCode, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_lsx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', replace(replace(@nameWO, ''[#1]'', ltrim(rtrim(so_lsx))), ''[#2]'', convert(char(10), ngay_ct, 103))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', replace(replace(@nameWO2, ''[#1]'', ltrim(rtrim(so_lsx))), ''[#2]'', convert(char(10), ngay_ct, 103))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.so_lsx, a.stt_rec_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lo_trinh, a.ma_ca, a.sl_yc, 0, '''', '''', '''', ''''' + @ExtField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #stt_rec0 a with(nolock)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		, N'@vCode varchar(3), @nameWO nvarchar(512), @nameWO2 nvarchar(512)'
		, @vCode = @voucherCode, @nameWO = @nameWO, @nameWO2 = @nameWO2

	-- + d$
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select c.stt_rec, '''', @vCode, c.ngay_ct, a.ma_cd, a.sl_bd_cds, 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctrt a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' join #stt_rec0 c with(nolock) on a.ma_lo_trinh = c.ma_lo_trinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where exists(select 1 from #master d where c.stt_rec = d.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@vCode varchar(3)', @vCode = @voucherCode

	SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_cd, line_nbr, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #d0 FROM #detail ORDER BY stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_cd
	UPDATE #d0 SET line_nbr = b.min_stt FROM #d0 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS min_stt FROM #d0 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #d0 SET line_nbr = id - line_nbr + 1, stt_rec0 = REPLACE(STR(id - line_nbr + 1, 3), ' ', '0')
	UPDATE #detail SET line_nbr = b.line_nbr, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 FROM #detail a JOIN #d0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
	UPDATE #master SET t_so_luong = b.so_luong FROM #master a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- + i$
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#master', '#detail', 'd$', 'ma_cd', '#10$', 'stt_rec', 'c$ = convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + space(' + RTRIM(@l0) + ') + a.stt_rec, m$ = ''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_lsx) + ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.ma_lo_trinh),', DEFAULT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Fields
	SELECT @mF$ = 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_gd, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2, so_lsx, stt_rec_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, t_so_luong, dien_giai, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	SELECT @mFV$ = 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ''1'', ''1'', ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2, so_lsx, stt_rec_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, t_so_luong, dien_giai, ''0'', @d0, @d0, @userID, @userID'

	SELECT @dF$ = 'stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_cd, so_luong, line_nbr'
	SELECT @dFV$ = 'stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, '''', ma_cd, so_luong, line_nbr'

	-- Insert Data
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m FROM ms2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #d FROM ds2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #i FROM is2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #c FROM cs2$000000

	-- + Table: #m
	SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @debug <> 1 THEN 'insert into #m (' + @mF$ + ')' ELSE NULL END + ' select ' + @mFV$ + ' from #master'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d0 datetime, @userID int', @d0 = @d0, @userID = @userID
	--
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#m', 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_gd, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2, so_lsx, stt_rec_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lo_trinh, ma_ca, sl_yc, t_so_luong, dien_giai, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2', 1

	-- + Table: #d
	SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @debug <> 1 THEN 'insert into #d (' + @dF$ + ')' ELSE NULL END + ' select ' + @dFV$ + ' from #detail'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d0 datetime, @userID int', @d0 = @d0, @userID = @userID
	--
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#d', 'stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_cd, so_luong, line_nbr', 1

	-- + Table: #i
	SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @debug <> 1 THEN 'insert into #i (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, c$, m$, d$)' ELSE NULL END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ngay_ct, '''', ma_dvcs, ''0'', @userID, c$, m$, d$ from #master'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d0 datetime, @userID int', @d0 = @d0, @userID = @userID
	--
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#i', 'stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, c$, m$, d$', 1

	-- + Table: #c
	IF @debug <> 1 SET @q = 'insert into #c(stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2' + @ExtField + ')' ELSE SET @q = NULL
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ngay_ct, '''', ma_dvcs, ''0'', @userID, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2' + @ExtField + ' from #master'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d0 datetime, @userID int', @d0 = @d0, @userID = @userID
	--
	SELECT @ExtField = 'stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ten_lsx, ten_lsx2' + @ExtField
	EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#c', @ExtField, 1

	-- + Table: c$
	SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @debug <> 1 THEN 'insert into cs2$000000' ELSE NULL END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + ' select * from #c'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- + Table: m$, d$, i$
	SELECT stt_rec INTO #c0 FROM #c a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cs2$000000 b WHERE b.status <> '0' AND a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx)

	SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) AS part INTO #part FROM #stt_rec0
	SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #part
	--
	WHILE @part IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @debug <> 1 THEN '' ELSE NULL END
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'delete ms2$' + @part + ' from ms2$' + @part + ' a where not exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'insert into ms2$' + @part + ' select * from #m a where convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) = ''' + @part + ''' and exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'delete ds2$' + @part + ' from ds2$' + @part + ' a where not exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'insert into ds2$' + @part + ' select * from #d a where convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) = ''' + @part + ''' and exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'delete is2$' + @part + ' from is2$' + @part + ' a where not exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(10) + 'insert into is2$' + @part + ' select * from #i a where convert(char(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) = ''' + @part + ''' and exists(select 1 from cs2$000000 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @part
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_Dashboard007]
	@fieldID VARCHAR(32),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DatePreviousBegin SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DatePreviousEnd SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(33), 
	@Form CHAR(16) , 
	@Account VARCHAR(1024),
	@UOM INT = 1,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	CREATE TABLE #tmp (tk VARCHAR(1024))
	DECLARE @Kind CHAR(1), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(512), @Tk_co CHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
		, @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_naynt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truocnt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @i INT, @ds_tk VARCHAR(1023), @ReportType CHAR(1)

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1, @ReportType = '1'

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')

	--Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM biForm014
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #balanceKN FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceKT FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKN FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKT FROM #balanceKN

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by tk, tk_du'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Balance
	DECLARE @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @WhereClause = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	--
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKN EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKT EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DatePreviousBegin0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKN
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKN' GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKT
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKT' GROUP BY tk
	--
	SELECT tk INTO #acct FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	
	DECLARE Cal_Cur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT kind, ma_so, tk_no, tk_co FROM #report WHERE kind <> '0'
	OPEN Cal_Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
			IF @Tk_no = '#'	BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_co)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_co, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_no
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_co) = 1	
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''	
										
				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_co <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so


				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_co = '#' BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_no)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_no, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_co
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_no) = 1
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_no <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so


				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_no <> '#' AND @Tk_co <> '#' BEGIN
				IF @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
					
					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
				END
			END
		END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt , Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt 
				, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt , Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co
	END
	CLOSE Cal_Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cal_Cur

	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = 0 WHERE Ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = 0 WHERE ky_naynt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = 0 WHERE Ky_truocnt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = - ky_nay, ky_truoc = - ky_truoc, ky_naynt = - ky_naynt, ky_truocnt = - ky_truocnt 
		, Lk_kn = - Lk_kn, Lk_kt = - Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = - Lk_kn_nt, Lk_kt_nt = -  Lk_kt_nt
		WHERE dau = 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_nay) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truoc) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_naynt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truocnt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT ma_so,CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, CAST(ky_nay AS VARCHAR) AS ky_nay FROM #report WHERE in_ck = 1 ORDER BY Stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$InputInvoice$UpdateNullValue](
	@cTable VARCHAR(32), --Temporary table(@cTable)
	@cBaseTable VARCHAR(32),
	@strFieldsNotUpdate VARCHAR(1024),
	@strKey NVARCHAR(4000)
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @nColID INT, @cName VARCHAR(128), @cType VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @nColID = MIN(ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK)  WHERE table_name = @cBaseTable
	WHILE @nColID IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @cName =column_name, @cType = LOWER(data_type) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE ordinal_position = @nColID AND table_name = @cBaseTable
		IF EXISTS (SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE  table_name = @cBaseTable AND column_name = @cName ) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cName, @strFieldsNotUpdate) <> 1
			BEGIN
				SET @strSQL = ' UPDATE ' + @cBaseTable + ' SET ' + @cName  + ' = '
					+ CASE WHEN @cType IN ('char','varchar','nchar','nvarchar') THEN ''''''
					 	WHEN @cType IN ('datetime','smalldatetime') THEN 'NULL'
					  	WHEN @cType IN ('uniqueidentifier') THEN  ''''''
					 	WHEN @cType IN ('text','ntext') THEN ''''''
					   	WHEN @cType IN ('binary','varbinary') THEN  'NULL'
					   	WHEN @cType IN ('tinyint','int','float','real','money','smallmoney','numeric','bit')THEN  '0'
					   	ELSE 'NULL'
				 	END
				 + ' WHERE ' + @cName + ' IS NULL' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@strKey) <> '' THEN ' AND ' + RTRIM(@strKey ) ELSE '' END
				 SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, @cBaseTable, @cTable)
				 EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			END
		SELECT @nColID = MIN(ordinal_position)  FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE table_name = @cBaseTable AND ordinal_position > @nColID
	END

END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.v20vctslts
AS
	SELECT     a.*, b.ten_ts AS ten_ts, b.ten_ts2 AS ten_ts2
		FROM         dbo.ctslts a LEFT OUTER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$MO$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0, 
	@OldSite VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(16, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Site = @OldSite

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, lo_yn INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
			SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite
		ELSE
			UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
	END

	SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_kho) AS ma_kho, RTRIM(a.ma_vi_tri) AS ma_vi_tri, RTRIM(@UOM) AS dvt, @Rate AS he_so,
			CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ma_kho FROM dmvitri WHERE dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn
		FROM #Item a

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

		FROM dbo.dmctvtrlo a JOIN dbo.dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintS6Tran]
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@Table CHAR(10),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.ma_may, a.gio_bd, a.gio_kt, a.line_nbr, a.so_gio, a.ghi_chu'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(b.ten_may, '''')' ELSE 'isnull(b.ten_may2, '''')' END + ' as ten_may'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join sfdmmay b on a.ma_may = b.ma_may'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesSummaryByPrice] --fs20_SOSalesSummaryByPrice
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @so_luong AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @tien2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT

	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_nt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2 INTO #temp FROM wrkin

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select a.ma_vt, a.ma_nt, a.sl_xuat, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2'

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	UPDATE #temp SET gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt,
			a.ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_vt) AS ten_vt, MAX(b.ten_vt2) AS ten_vt2, (a.ma_vt + STR(gia2)) AS fOrder,
			MAX(dvt) AS dvt, MAX(nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3, MAX(loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt,
			SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, SUM(tien2) AS tien2, SUM(tien_nt2) AS tien_nt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt, gia2, gia_nt2

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE 'fOrder' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2)
		VALUES (0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0 ,0)

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @so_luong =  SUM(so_luong), @tien2 = SUM(tien2), @tien_nt2 = CASE WHEN @nSo_Ma_nt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tien_nt2) END
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @Groups <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@Groups))) = 'LOAI_VT'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups , 'vt', 'so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #report SET gia2 = 0, gia_nt2 = 0 WHERE systotal = 0 --Khi thuc hien group thi truong gia khong sum, khong tinh trung binh
	END

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2)
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, @s12, @so_luong, @tien2, @tien_nt2)
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2)
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0)


	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (0, 0, 1)

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_vt as ten_vt, '''' as ten_vt2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_vt, ten_vt2 as ten_vt2,' END + 'dvt, '
		SET @q = @q + 'so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2 from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_vt as ten_vt, '''' as ten_vt2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_vt, ten_vt2 as ten_vt2,' END + 'dvt, '
		SET @q = @q + ' so_luong, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2 from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Groups, 'sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$MaxNumericInString] (@s VARCHAR(32))
RETURNS VARCHAR(32)
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @n1 NVARCHAR(32), @n2 NVARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @n2 = ''
	WHILE @s <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', @s), @s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@i = PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', @s), @n1 = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, 1, @i - 1) ELSE @s END, 
			@s = CASE WHEN @i > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@s, @i, LEN(@s)) ELSE '' END, 
			@n2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@n2) < LEN(@n1) THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END
	END
	RETURN @n2
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSRTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@Stock INT = -1,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL = 'select a.line_nbr, a.dvt, a.so_luong, '
	IF @Stock <> 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2'
	ELSE SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'a.gia as gia2, a.gia_nt as gia_nt2, a.tien as tien2, a.tien_nt as tien_nt2'

	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL +
		 CASE
			WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt, rtrim(a.ma_vt) as ma_vt, (rtrim(a.ma_vt) + '' - '' + rtrim(g.ten_vt' + @cE + ')) as description'
			WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2, rtrim(a.ma_vt) as ma_vt, (rtrim(a.ma_vt) + '' - '' + rtrim(g.ten_vt)) as description, (rtrim(a.ma_vt) + '' - '' + rtrim(g.ten_vt2)) as description2'
		END

	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g with(nolock) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @strSQL <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, '''+ @cVoucher+ ''', ''dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN '' WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', ten_vt2' END + ', ma_vt, description'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesReturnList]

	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),

	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT

	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.line_nbr, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck), (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	UPDATE #report SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q = 'select a.*, (convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec) as rp_group'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', c.dvt, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0' + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt left join dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx](@UnitField VARCHAR(64), @Unit VARCHAR(1023), @UserID INT, @Admin BIT, @Right VARCHAR(8))
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @UnitKey = NULL

	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Unit = '' BEGIN
			IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dmdvcs) = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND (CASE WHEN @Right = 'New' THEN r_new WHEN @Right = 'Edit' THEN r_edit WHEN @Right = 'Delete' THEN r_del ELSE r_access END) = 1) BEGIN
				SET @UnitKey = ''
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @UnitKey = ISNULL(@UnitKey, '') + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + '''' FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND (CASE WHEN @Right = 'New' THEN r_new WHEN @Right = 'Edit' THEN r_edit WHEN @Right = 'Delete' THEN r_del ELSE r_access END) = 1
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @UnitKey = ISNULL(@UnitKey, '') + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + '''' FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND (CASE WHEN @Right = 'New' THEN r_new WHEN @Right = 'Edit' THEN r_edit WHEN @Right = 'Delete' THEN r_del ELSE r_access END) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_dvcs, @Unit) = 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Unit <> '' SELECT @UnitKey = ISNULL(@UnitKey, '') + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + '''' FROM dmdvcs WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_dvcs, @Unit) = 1
	END

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL AND @UnitKey <> '' SET @UnitKey = '(' + @UnitField + ' in (' + @UnitKey + '))'
	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = '(1 = 0)'
		IF @UnitKey = '' SET @UnitKey = NULL
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL AND @Unit <> '' SET @UnitKey = '(1 = 0)'
	END

	RETURN @UnitKey
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_RightItem](@cpItem VARCHAR(33), @cSeparator VARCHAR(1))  
RETURNS VARCHAR(33) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @cItem VARCHAR(33)
	SET @cItem = RTRIM(@cpItem)
	IF CHARINDEX(@cSeparator, @cItem) > 0
		SET @cReturn = RIGHT(@cItem, LEN(@cItem) - CHARINDEX(@cSeparator, @cItem) + 1) 
	ELSE
		SET @cReturn = ''
	RETURN ISNULL(@cReturn, '')
END

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
