CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_CoverBookCode](@StartCode CHAR(33), @FormCode NUMERIC(12, 0))
RETURNS VARCHAR(33)
AS BEGIN
	IF @StartCode IS NULL OR @FormCode IS NULL RETURN ''
	DECLARE @c NVARCHAR(1), @p1 VARCHAR(33), @p2 VARCHAR(33), @p3 VARCHAR(33), @n1 VARCHAR(33), @n2 VARCHAR(33), @j INT, @len INT
	SELECT @j = 0, @p1 = '', @p2 = '', @p3 = '', @n1 = '', @n2 = '', @len = LEN(@StartCode)

	WHILE @j < @len BEGIN
		SET @c = SUBSTRING(@StartCode, @j + 1, 1)
		IF ISNUMERIC(@c) = 1 AND @c NOT IN('+', '-', '.',',') BEGIN
			IF @p3 = '' SELECT @p2 = @p2 + @c, @n1 = @n1 + @c
				ELSE SELECT @p3 = @p3 + @c, @n2 = @n2 + @c
			IF @n1 <> '' AND @n2 <> '' AND LEN(@n1) < LEN(@n2) SELECT @n1 = @n2, @p1 = @p1 + @p2 + SUBSTRING(@p3, 1, LEN(@p3) - LEN(@n2)), @p2 = @n2, @p3 = '', @n2 = ''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @p2 = '' SELECT @p1 = @p1 + @c
				ELSE SELECT @p3 = @p3 + @c, @n2 = ''
		END
		--
		SET @j = @j + 1
	END
	RETURN (@p1 + REPLACE(STR(@FormCode, LEN(@p2)), ' ', '0') + @p3)
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFilterKey] @f NVARCHAR(4000), @sysDatabase VARCHAR(128), @filterkey NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @filterkey = ''
	IF @f = '' RETURN

	SELECT @sysDatabase = REPLACE(@sysDatabase, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @controller VARCHAR(128), @fields VARCHAR(512), @values NVARCHAR(4000), @c CHAR(1), @d CHAR(1), @e CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @v NVARCHAR(32), @i INT, @n INT, @field VARCHAR(32), @query NVARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @c = CHAR(255), @d = CHAR(252), @e = CHAR(253)

	-- Data	
	SELECT * INTO #f FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@f, @c)
	SELECT @controller = REPLACE(data, '''', '') FROM #f WHERE id = 1
	SELECT @fields = REPLACE(data, '''', '') FROM #f WHERE id = 2
	SELECT @values = REPLACE(data, @d, '''') FROM #f WHERE id = 3

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS id, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS filterkey, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS datasource, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS sourcekey, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS basekey INTO #$query
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(256)) AS fields, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS query INTO #query

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #query select name, fields, query from ' + @sysDatabase + '..reportfilters where controller = ''' + @controller + ''' and charindex(fields, ''' + @fields + ''') > 0 '
	EXECUTE sp_executesql @q
	SELECT * INTO #fields FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@fields, ',')
	SELECT * INTO #v FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@values, @e)


	SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(1) FROM #fields
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @field = data FROM #fields WHERE id = @i
		SELECT @v = data FROM #v WHERE id = @i + 1
		SELECT @query = query FROM #query WHERE fields = @field
		SELECT @query = REPLACE(@query, '%[@id]%', @v)
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @query

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT @filterkey = @filterkey + CASE WHEN @filterkey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + filterkey FROM #$query

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_LeftItem](@cpItem VARCHAR(33), @cSeparator VARCHAR(1))  
RETURNS VARCHAR(33) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cReturn VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @cItem VARCHAR(33)
	SET @cItem = RTRIM(@cpItem)
	IF CHARINDEX(@cSeparator, @cItem) > 0
		SET @cReturn =  LEFT(@cItem, CHARINDEX(@cSeparator, @cItem) - 1) 
	ELSE
		SET @cReturn = @cItem
	RETURN ISNULL(@cReturn, '')
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rpt06BK] --ts_Rpt06BBK_28
	@Year INT,
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @t_gt_pt NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_gt_pt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 1 AS systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f027_nt AS cn_tk_nt, f028_nt AS thue_dkt_nt, f027 AS cn_tk, f028 AS thue_dkt
		INTO #report FROM t03$0000

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	--Key
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = 'a.f027 + a.f027_nt + a.f028 + a.f028_nt > 0', @Join = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ns like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_bp INTO #t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$TaxDepartment(@Department)
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_bp in (select ma_bp from #t)', @Join = ' left join phns b on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns'
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.f027_nt, a.f028_nt, a.f027, a.f028'
	SET @q = @q + ' from t03$' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

Result:
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0
	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ns ELSE b.ten_ns2 END AS ten_ns, b.ma_so_thue, b.cmnd
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN phns b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns ORDER BY stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintARWriteOff] -- fs20_TransGLReportDetailByCust
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33), 
	@Size TINYINT,
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10)
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ma_kh, tk, tk_du, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', '''''') + ''' and a.ps_no + a.ps_no_nt <> 0'
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct0 >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct0 <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin	

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('kh', 'ps, ps_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @DateFrom AS date_from, @DateTo AS date_to, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, ps, @Language) AS t_ps_in_word FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct0, so_ct0

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurGroupKey](
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Type TINYINT -- 1 - Master, 2 - Detail
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @PurGroupKey VARCHAR(4000), @n INT, @RangeNumber INT
	SELECT @PurGroupKey = ''

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PurGroupKey = @PurGroupKey + CASE WHEN @PurGroupKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + RTRIM(ma_nh0) FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID ORDER BY ma_nh0
			SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@PurGroupKey, ',')
			SELECT @RangeNumber = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_site_number'
			IF @n <= @RangeNumber BEGIN
				IF @n = 1 SELECT @PurGroupKey = '(ma_nh0 = ''' + REPLACE(@PurGroupKey, ',', ''',''') + ''')'
				ELSE SELECT @PurGroupKey = '(ma_nh0 in (''' + REPLACE(@PurGroupKey, ',', ''',''') + '''))'
			END ELSE SELECT @PurGroupKey = '(ma_nh0 in (select ma_nh0 from bisyspurgrouprights where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + '))'
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PurGroupKey = @PurGroupKey + '$' + RTRIM(b.id) + '$%' FROM bisyspurgrouprights a JOIN bidmnhom0 b ON a.ma_nh0 = b.ma_nh WHERE a.[user_id] = @UserID ORDER BY b.id
			SELECT @PurGroupKey = '''#00#' + @PurGroupKey + ''' like g$'
		END
	END

	RETURN @PurGroupKey
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey] (@dept VARCHAR(32))
RETURNS VARCHAR(512) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ref VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @ref = RTRIM(bp_ref) FROM hrbp WHERE ma_bp = @dept
	RETURN 'a.bp_ref LIKE ''' + @ref + '%'''
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByFormula]
	@PayTypeFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@PayTypeTo VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(33), @f NVARCHAR(2048), @i INT, @v VARCHAR(32), @convertStyle INT, @fqd NVARCHAR(2048), @group BIT

	SELECT ma_loai_lg, RTRIM(cong_thuc) AS cach_tinh, kieu, status, kieu_qd, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS tt INTO #loailuong FROM #hrloailuong ORDER BY stt, ma_loai_lg
	IF @PayTypeFrom <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = tt FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @PayTypeFrom
		DELETE #loailuong WHERE tt < @i
	END

	IF @PayTypeTo <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = tt FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @PayTypeTo
		DELETE #loailuong WHERE tt > @i
	END

	DELETE #loailuong WHERE kieu <> 2

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#loailuong', @UserID, @Admin, default, 2

	CREATE TABLE #rep(s1 VARCHAR(128), s2 VARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = MIN(tt) FROM #loailuong
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c = LOWER(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)), @f = REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', ''''''), @fqd = '', @v = status, @convertStyle = kieu_qd FROM #loailuong WHERE tt = @i

		SET @q = 'alter table #hrluong add ' + @c + ' numeric(28, 6)'
		IF @convertStyle = 4 SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #hrluong add ' + @c + '_qd numeric(28, 6)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @f <> '' AND @v = '1' BEGIN
			IF CHARINDEX('SUM', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MAX', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MIN', @f) > 0 SET @group = 1
				ELSE SET @group = 0

			IF @convertStyle = 4 BEGIN
				DELETE #rep
				INSERT INTO #rep SELECT '[' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)) + ']' AS s1, CASE
					WHEN kieu_qd = 1 THEN '[' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)) + ']*' + CASE WHEN @group = 1 THEN 'min([tg_tl])' ELSE '[tg_tl]' END
					WHEN kieu_qd = 2 THEN '[' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)) + ']*' + CASE WHEN @group = 1 THEN 'min([tg_bh])' ELSE '[tg_bh]' END
					WHEN kieu_qd = 4 THEN '[' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)) + '_qd]'
					ELSE ''
				END AS s2 FROM #hrloailuong WHERE CHARINDEX('[' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_loai_lg)) + ']', @f) > 0

				SET @fqd = @f
				SELECT @fqd = REPLACE(@fqd, s1, s2) FROM #rep WHERE s2 <> ''
			END

			SELECT @f = REPLACE(REPLACE(@f, '[', 'isnull('), ']', ', 0)'), @fqd = REPLACE(REPLACE(@fqd, '[', 'isnull('), ']', ', 0)')

			IF @group = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = 'select stt_rec, ' + @f + ' as gt_nt' + CASE WHEN @convertStyle = 4 THEN @fqd + ' as gt' ELSE '' END + ' into #group from #hrluong group by stt_rec'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'create index i on #group(stt_rec)'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #hrluong set ' + @c + ' = b.gt_nt' + CASE WHEN @convertStyle = 4 THEN @c + '_qd = b.gt' ELSE '' END + ' from #hrluong a join #group b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.bpql_yn = 1'
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update #hrluong set ' + @c + ' = ' + @f + CASE WHEN @convertStyle = 4 THEN ', ' + @c + '_qd = ' + @fqd ELSE '' END
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		SELECT @i = MIN(tt) FROM #loailuong WHERE tt > @i
	END
END



GO
CREATE VIEW vctkhcc 
AS
	SELECT b.ma_dvcs, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.gt_kh_ky AS tien, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_bp0
		,a.so_the_ts, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_bp_ts, CAST('' AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS tien_nt
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_vv, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_sp
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_hd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_ku, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_phi
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3 
		FROM ctkhcc a JOIN dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE 1 = 0

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpenseLedger] --rs_rptDetailRevenueLedger
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key VARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @n INT, @syscolumn VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @total0 NVARCHAR(128), @total1 NVARCHAR(128), @Accounts VARCHAR(8000), @m_tk_kqkd VARCHAR(512), @acc VARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @total0 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @total1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT117'
	SELECT @m_tk_kqkd = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_kqkd'

	-- Form
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(stt, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS syscolumn, REPLACE(tk, ' ', '') AS tk, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN ten_ngan ELSE ten_ngan2 END AS ten_ngan, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #arcpsxkd FROM arcpsxkd WHERE RTRIM(form) = @Form ORDER BY stt, ma_so
	SELECT TOP 0 syscolumn, tk INTO #arcpsxkdct0 FROM #arcpsxkd
	SELECT TOP 0 syscolumn, tk INTO #arcpsxkdct1 FROM #arcpsxkd
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(*) FROM #arcpsxkd
	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @acc = tk, @syscolumn = syscolumn FROM #arcpsxkd WHERE id = @i
		INSERT INTO #arcpsxkdct0 SELECT @syscolumn, RTRIM(data) + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@acc, ',') WHERE data <> ''
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	SELECT RTRIM(data) + '%' AS tk_kqkd INTO #tkkd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@m_tk_kqkd, ',') WHERE data <> ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl a
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS syscolumn, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, tk, tk_du, dien_giai, line_nbr, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct AS ma_ct0 INTO #report FROM #tmp

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = 'status = ''1'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #arcpsxkdct0)  SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #arcpsxkdct0 z where a.tk like z.tk)'
	
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	
	-- Dynamic
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
		SELECT @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
		IF @filterKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	END
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', tk, tk_du, dien_giai, isnull(line_nbr, 0), ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(*) FROM #arcpsxkd
	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @acc = RTRIM(tk), @syscolumn = syscolumn FROM #arcpsxkd WHERE id = @i
		IF @acc <> '' BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #arcpsxkdct1
			INSERT INTO #arcpsxkdct1 SELECT @syscolumn, RTRIM(data) + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@acc, ',') WHERE data <> ''
			--
			INSERT INTO #report
				SELECT @syscolumn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in
					FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #arcpsxkdct1 tk WHERE a.tk LIKE tk.tk)
			INSERT INTO #report
				SELECT @syscolumn, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr, - a.ps_co, - a.ps_co_nt, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in
					FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #arcpsxkdct1 tk WHERE a.tk LIKE tk.tk) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tkkd tkkd WHERE a.tk_du LIKE tkkd.tk_kqkd)
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #report WHERE ps = 0 AND ps_nt = 0

	-- Result
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(syscolumn AS VARCHAR(64)) AS syscolumn, stt_rec, MAX(ma_ct) AS ma_ct, MAX(ngay_lct) AS ngay_lct, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct, MAX(ISNULL(so_ct0, '')) AS so_ct0
			, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(tk_du) AS tk_du, MAX(dien_giai) AS dien_giai, MAX(line_nbr) AS line_nbr, MAX(stt_ct_nkc) AS stt_ct_nkc, MAX(ma_ct0) AS ma_ct0, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt INTO #result
		FROM #report GROUP BY syscolumn, stt_rec

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result) INSERT INTO #result SELECT 5, 1, 1, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', '', '', '', 0, 0, '', 0, 0 FROM #arcpsxkd
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #arcpsxkd a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result b WHERE b.syscolumn = a.syscolumn)) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #result
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, b.syscolumn, a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ma_ct), MAX(a.ngay_lct), MAX(a.ngay_ct), MAX(a.so_ct), MAX(ISNULL(a.so_ct0, '')), MAX(a.tk), MAX(a.tk_du), MAX(a.dien_giai)
					, MAX(a.line_nbr), MAX(a.stt_ct_nkc), MAX(a.ma_ct0), 0, 0
				FROM #result a CROSS JOIN (SELECT syscolumn FROM #arcpsxkd a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result b WHERE b.syscolumn = a.syscolumn)) b
				GROUP BY a.stt_rec, b.syscolumn
		
	END

	-- Total Arising Amount in Period
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 0, 0, 0, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', MAX(tk), '', @total0, 0, 0, '', SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt) FROM #result WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 1, 0, 0, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', MAX(tk), '', '', 0, 0, '', 0, 0 FROM #result WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 99, 0, 0, syscolumn, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', MAX(tk), '', @total0, 0, 0, '', SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt) FROM #result WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY syscolumn

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #result set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- View
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal
			, STR(a.sysorder) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + a.ma_ct0 + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec AS sysRow
			, a.dien_giai AS sysRowName, a.sysColumn, b.ten_ngan AS sysColumnName
			, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk_du, a.ps, a.ps_nt
		FROM #result a LEFT JOIN #arcpsxkd b ON a.syscolumn = b.syscolumn
		ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.syscolumn

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot (name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'ps' ELSE 'ps_nt' END, @total1
	INSERT INTO #pivot (name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'ps$' ELSE 'ps_nt$' END, ten_ngan FROM #arcpsxkd ORDER BY syscolumn
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id - 1) WHERE id > 1
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptInaccurateTimeInOutReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT, 
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	SELECT @Key = ''
	
	-- Struct	
	CREATE TABLE #t(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), tg DATETIME, vao_ra INT, loai INT, ma_nv CHAR(16), bo_phan CHAR(16), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	
	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(ngay between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Report
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #t (ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra, loai, ma_nv, bo_phan) select distinct a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.tg, a.vao_ra, a.loai, e.ma_nv, e.bo_phan from hrvrloi a left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec where '+ @Key + ' order by a.ngay, e.ma_nv, a.tg'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT a.stt, a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, e.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + e.ten_nv AS ten_nv, a.tg, a.loai, a.bo_phan, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN CASE WHEN a.vao_ra = '1' THEN N'Vào' WHEN a.vao_ra = '2' THEN N'Ra' ELSE N'' END ELSE CASE WHEN a.vao_ra = '1' THEN N'In' WHEN a.vao_ra = '2' THEN N'Out' ELSE N'' END END AS vao_ra, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.tg, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(5), a.tg, 108) AS s_tg
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
		ORDER BY a.stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostS2Tran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @rq TINYINT, @rt VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'

	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM ms2$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM ds2$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #sfctdmwo FROM sfctdmwo a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	DELETE sfctwo WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	DELETE sfctdmwo WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	SET @q = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where status in(''2'', ''3'', ''4'') and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @idNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @idNumber + CHAR(39)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		INSERT INTO sfctwo (stt_rec, ngay_ct, loai_ct, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_cd) SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay_ct, b.loai_ct, b.ma_lsx, b.ma_lo_trinh, a.ma_cd FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		INSERT INTO #sfctdmwo (stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, loai_btp, dvt)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_ct, b.loai_ct, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, c.ma_vt, c.loai_btp, ''
			 FROM #detail a
				JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				JOIN ctrtvt c ON b.ma_lo_trinh = c.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd

		SELECT TOP 1 @rt = ma_lo_trinh FROM #master
		UPDATE #sfctdmwo SET dvt = b.dvt FROM #sfctdmwo a JOIN ctrt b ON b.ma_lo_trinh = @rt AND a.loai_btp = 1 AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

		INSERT INTO sfctdmwo SELECT * FROM #sfctdmwo
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCMaterialResourceUsageOrder] --fs_SFCProduction
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@MO VARCHAR(32),
	@WO VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Total = CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt AS ma_sp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_bd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_kt
		, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_lsx AS ma_cd, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_lsx
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th
		, a.status, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS tinh_trang, loai_ct
		INTO #report FROM ms2$000000 a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and b.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@WO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 0, b.stt_rec, max(b.ngay_ct), min(a.ngay_bd), max(a.ngay_kt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.so_lsx), b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx, max(b.ma_lo_trinh), max(a.ma_cd)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.ten_lsx' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.sl_yc), null, max(b.status), max(c.statusname' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), max(b.loai_ct)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmttct c with(nolock) on b.status = c.status and c.ma_ct = ''SF2'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by b.stt_rec, b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #report b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd)'

	SELECT @q = @q + ' and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp, SUM(a.sl_th) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx a GROUP BY a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp

	--
	UPDATE #report SET sl_th = b.sl_th FROM #report a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp WHERE a.sl_th IS NULL


	-- View
	SELECT tag, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ten_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, status, tinh_trang
		FROM #report a ORDER BY so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyPITran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get Data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m95$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d95$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số đơn hàng', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Nhà cung cấp', N'Supplier', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vt', 100, '', '', N'Mã hàng', N'Item', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vt', 300, '', '', N'Tên mặt hàng', N'Item Description', 'ten_vt', 'ten_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dvt', 50, '', '', N'Đvt', N'UOM', 'dvt', 'dvt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'gia', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Đơn giá', N'Price', 'gia', 'gia', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Thành tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, RTRIM(a.dvt) AS dvt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.gia_nt, @priceFormat) AS gia,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt, @amountFormat) AS tien
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền hàng', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Chi phí', N'Charges', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_cp_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế nhập khẩu', N'Import Tax', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_nk_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế tiêu thụ đb', N'Excise Tax', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_ttdb_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế gtgt', N'VAT Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]5', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng tiền', N'Total Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '2', 'PO2', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '2', 'PO2', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', nhà cung cấp: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Supplier: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Đơn hàng nhập khẩu chờ duyệt'', N''Import purchase order waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Đơn hàng nhập khẩu chờ duyệt'', N''Import purchase order waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt đơn hàng nhập khẩu'', N''Import purchase order approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt đơn hàng nhập khẩu'', N''Import purchase order approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Contract]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Contract VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Contract, 2 Multi Contract
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(@Contract, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_hd, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdhd a with(nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_hd)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1	SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_hd, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_hd'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_hd, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_hd order by tk, ma_hd'
		
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptCurriculumVitaeExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @IDNumber NVARCHAR(33), @i INT, @j INT, @Male NVARCHAR(10), @Female NVARCHAR(10), @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	-- Struct
	-- Personal
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, (a.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + a.ten_nv) AS ten, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ngay_sinh, a.ngay_vao,
			a.gioi_tinh, a.ton_giao, a.noi_sinh, a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, a.email_cty,
			a.cmnd_so, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap as noi_cap, a.dia_chi_ht as cmnd_noi_cap, a.dia_chi_ht, a.hon_nhan
		INTO #banthan
		FROM hrnv a

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, stt_rec, ho_ten, ma_qh, ngay_sinh, nghe_nghiep INTO #giadinh FROM hregd
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, truong_hoc, ma_tdhv, ma_cn INTO #hocvan FROM hrehv
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, a.stt_rec, b.ngay_hoc1 as ngay_tu, b.ngay_hoc2 as ngay_den, b.ten_khoa as khoa_hoc, c.ten_dvdt as to_chuc_dt INTO #dtnganhan
		FROM hredt a, hrdtkh b, hrdmdvdt c

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, b.bac_quan_ly, a.vi_tri, a.ly_do INTO #qtlamviec
		FROM hreqtlvht a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan AND a.vi_tri = b. vi_tri

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, stt_rec, hinh_thuc, ngay_ky, tien, ly_do, ghi_chu INTO #thuong FROM hrekt
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, stt_rec, hinh_thuc, ngay_ky, tien, ly_do, ghi_chu INTO #kyluat FROM hrekl

	-- General
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS xKey, 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS xCode, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ten, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ngay_sinh, a.ngay_vao,
			a.gioi_tinh, a.ton_giao, a.noi_sinh, a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, a.email_cty,
			a.cmnd_so, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.noi_cap, a.cmnd_noi_cap, a.dia_chi_ht, a.hon_nhan,
			b.ho_ten, b.ma_qh, b.ngay_sinh AS ngay_sinh_gd, b.nghe_nghiep,
			c.ngay_tu AS ngay_tu_hv, c.ngay_den AS ngay_den_hv, c.truong_hoc, c.ma_tdhv, c.ma_cn,
			d.ngay_tu AS ngay_tu_dt, d.ngay_den AS ngay_den_dt, d.khoa_hoc, d.to_chuc_dt,
			e.bo_phan AS bo_phan_qt, e.ngay_tu AS ngay_tu_qt, e.ngay_den AS ngay_den_qt, e.vi_tri AS cong_viec_qt, e.bac_quan_ly AS vi_tri_qt, e.ly_do AS ly_do_qt,
			f.hinh_thuc AS hinh_thuc_t, f.ngay_ky AS ngay_ky_t, f.tien AS tien_t, f.ly_do AS ly_do_t, f.ghi_chu AS ghi_chu_t,
			g.hinh_thuc AS hinh_thuc_kl, g.ngay_ky AS ngay_ky_kl, g.tien AS tien_kl, g.ly_do AS ly_do_kl, g.ghi_chu AS ghi_chu_kl
		INTO #report
		FROM #banthan a LEFT JOIN #giadinh b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hocvan c  ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #dtnganhan d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #qtlamviec e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #thuong f ON a.stt_rec = f.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #kyluat g ON a.stt_rec = g.stt_rec
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_nv VARCHAR(33) NULL

	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #$keys (text NTEXT)
		INSERT INTO #$keys SELECT @IDNumbers
	END

	-- Data
	DECLARE @l INT, @size INT, @k  INT
	SET @i = 1
	SELECT @size = COL_LENGTH('hrnv', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @k  = 1, @l = DATALENGTH(text)/2 FROM #$keys
	WHILE @k  + @size <= @l + 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @c = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@i AS VARCHAR(32))))
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(SUBSTRING(text, @k , @size), '''', ''), @k  = @k  + @size + 1 FROM #$keys

		-- Self
		SET @q = CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, ma_nv, ten, bo_phan, vi_tri, ngay_sinh, ngay_vao, '
		SET @q = @q + 'gioi_tinh, ton_giao, noi_sinh, dien_thoai_nha, dien_thoai_dd, email_cty, '
		SET @q = @q + 'cmnd_so, cmnd_ngay_hl, noi_cap, cmnd_noi_cap, dia_chi_ht, hon_nhan)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 0,'+ @c +', 0, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, (a.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + a.ten_nv) AS ten, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ngay_sinh, a.ngay_vao, '
		SET @q = @q + 'a.gioi_tinh, a.ton_giao, a.noi_sinh, a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, a.email_cty, '
		SET @q = @q + 'a.cmnd_so, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap, z.ten_tinh%l'
		SET @q = @q + ', (case when a.dia_chi_ht is null then '''' else rtrim(a.dia_chi_ht) end) + '', '' + (case when a.dia_chi_ht_quan is null then '''' else rtrim(c.ten_quan%l) end) + '', '' + (case when a.dia_chi_ht_tinh is null then '''' else rtrim(b.ten_tinh%l) end), a.hon_nhan'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock) left join hrdmtinh b on a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = b.ma_tinh left join hrdmquan c on a.dia_chi_ht_quan = c.ma_quan'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh z on a.cmnd_noi_cap = z.ma_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''

		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Family
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, ho_ten, ma_qh, ngay_sinh_gd, nghe_nghiep)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 1,'+ @c +', line_nbr, stt_rec, ho_ten, ma_qh, ngay_sinh, nghe_nghiep'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hregd with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Education
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, ngay_tu_hv, ngay_den_hv, truong_hoc, ma_tdhv, ma_cn)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 2,'+ @c +', 1, stt_rec, ngay_hoc_tu, ngay_hoc_den, truong_hoc, ma_tdhv, ma_cn'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrnv with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''

		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, ngay_tu_hv, ngay_den_hv, truong_hoc, ma_tdhv, ma_cn)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 2,'+ @c +', 1 + r.line_nbr, r.stt_rec, r.ngay_tu, r.ngay_den, r.truong_hoc, r.ma_tdhv, r.ma_cn'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrehv r with(nolock) join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' where r.stt_rec + r.ma_tdhv + r.ma_cn not in (select stt_rec + ma_tdhv + ma_cn from #report where ma_tdhv + ma_cn is not null) and (r.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Training
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, ngay_tu_dt, ngay_den_dt, khoa_hoc, to_chuc_dt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 3,'+ @c +', a.line_nbr, a.stt_rec, b.ngay_hoc1, b.ngay_hoc2, b.ten_khoa%l, c.ten_dvdt%l'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hredt a with(nolock) join hrdtkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_khoa = b.ma_khoa join hrdmdvdt c with(nolock) on b.ma_dvdt = c.ma_dvdt'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Working
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, bo_phan_qt, ngay_tu_qt, ngay_den_qt, cong_viec_qt, vi_tri_qt, ly_do_qt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 4,'+ @c +', line_nbr, a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.ly_do'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hreqtlvht a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Award
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, hinh_thuc_t, ngay_ky_t, tien_t, ly_do_t, ghi_chu_t)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 5,'+ @c +', line_nbr, stt_rec, hinh_thuc, ngay_ky, tien, ly_do, ghi_chu'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrekt with(nolock)  where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Violation
		SET @q = 'insert into #report (xKey, sysorder, xCode, stt_rec, hinh_thuc_kl, ngay_ky_kl, tien_kl, ly_do_kl, ghi_chu_kl)'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 6,'+ @c +', line_nbr, stt_rec, hinh_thuc, ngay_ky, tien, ly_do, ghi_chu'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hrekl with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--
		SELECT @j = 1
		WHILE @j < 7 BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE xKey = @j AND sysorder = @i) INSERT INTO #report (xKey, sysorder, stt_rec, xCode) VALUES(@j, @i, @IDNumber, 1)
			--
			SELECT @j = @j + 1
		END
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Report
	UPDATE #report SET ten = '' WHERE ten IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ma_nv = '' WHERE ma_nv IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET noi_sinh = '' WHERE noi_sinh IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET dien_thoai_nha = '' WHERE dien_thoai_nha IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET dien_thoai_dd = '' WHERE dien_thoai_dd IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET email_cty = '' WHERE email_cty IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET cmnd_so = '' WHERE cmnd_so IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET cmnd_noi_cap = '' WHERE cmnd_noi_cap IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET dia_chi_ht = '' WHERE dia_chi_ht IS NULL

	SELECT a.xKey, sysorder, xCode, a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN xKey <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE k.imagedata END AS anh,
			a.ma_nv, a.ten, a.ngay_sinh, a.ngay_vao,
			a.noi_sinh, a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, a.email_cty AS email_ca_nhan, a.cmnd_so, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap, a.dia_chi_ht,
			a.ho_ten, a.ngay_sinh_gd, a.nghe_nghiep, a.ngay_tu_hv, a.ngay_den_hv, a.truong_hoc,
			a.ngay_tu_dt, a.ngay_den_dt, a.khoa_hoc, a.to_chuc_dt, a.ngay_tu_qt, a.ngay_den_qt,
			a.ly_do_qt, a.ngay_ky_t, a.tien_t, a.ly_do_t, a.ghi_chu_t, a.ngay_ky_kl, a.tien_kl, a.ly_do_kl, a.ghi_chu_kl,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN i.ten_kt ELSE i.ten_kt2 END AS hinh_thuc_t,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN j.ten_kl ELSE j.ten_kl2 END AS hinh_thuc_kl,
			ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_bp ELSE e.ten_bp2 END, '') AS bo_phan_ht,
			ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_vtr ELSE d.ten_vtr2 END, '') AS vi_tri_ht,
			CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = '1' THEN @Male ELSE @Female END AS gioi_tinh,
			ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN f.ten_tg ELSE f.ten_tg2 END, '') AS ton_giao,
			ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN g.ten_tthn ELSE g.ten_tthn2 END, '') AS hon_nhan,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN h.ten_qh ELSE h.ten_qh2 END AS ma_qh,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tdhv ELSE b.ten_tdhv2 END AS trinh_do_hv,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_bp ELSE e.ten_bp2 END AS bo_phan_qt,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_vtr ELSE d.ten_vtr2 END AS cong_viec_qt,
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_bac ELSE c.ten_bac2 END AS vi_tri_qt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmtdhv b ON a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv
			LEFT JOIN hrdmbql c ON a.vi_tri_qt = c.ma_bac
			LEFT JOIN hrvt d ON (a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr) OR (a.cong_viec_qt = d.ma_vtr)
			LEFT JOIN hrbp e ON a.bo_phan = e.ma_bp OR a.bo_phan_qt = e.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrdmtg f ON a.ton_giao = f.ma_tg
			LEFT JOIN hrdmtthn g ON a.hon_nhan = g.ma_tthn
			LEFT JOIN hrdmqhgd h ON a.ma_qh = h.ma_qh
			LEFT JOIN hrdmkt i ON a.hinh_thuc_t = i.ma_kt
			LEFT JOIN hrdmkl j ON a.hinh_thuc_kl = j.ma_kl
			LEFT JOIN hreanh k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec
		ORDER BY a.stt_rec, a.xKey, sysorder, xCode

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountActivity] --fs_AcctActivity--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- Struct 
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh
			, a.ma_vv, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.line_nbr
			, a.ps_no AS du_no, a.ps_co AS du_co, a.ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS id
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status =' + CHAR (39) + '1' + CHAR (39)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert #report select 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, a.ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'

	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @nDu_dk = Du, @nDu_dk_nt = Du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t

	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)
		FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	--  Balance
	SELECT id, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_no_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS stt INTO #bal FROM #report a JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr
	CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX i ON #bal(stt)

	SELECT @du_no = @nDu_dk, @du_no_nt = @nDu_dk_nt
	UPDATE #bal SET @du_no = @du_no + ps_no - ps_co, @du_no_nt = @du_no_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt, du_no = ISNULL(@du_no, 0), du_no_nt = ISNULL(@du_no_nt, 0) FROM #bal WITH(INDEX(i))
	UPDATE #report SET du_no = b.du_no, du_no_nt = b.du_no_nt FROM #report a JOIN #bal b ON a.id = b.id

	UPDATE #report SET du_co = - du_no, du_no = 0 WHERE du_no < 0
	UPDATE #report SET du_co_nt = - du_no_nt, du_no_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt < 0

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du, a.ma_vv, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec
			, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt
			, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2
			, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
		FROM #report a  
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_du = c.tk 
			LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalcPersonalIncomeTaxReal]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Khai báo
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @Round INT


	-- Gán giá trị biến
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@Year, @Period), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@Year, @Period)

/*
	Lấy danh sách nhân viên và thông tin thuế cần tính
*/

	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan AS ma_bp, ma_dvcs, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ky_ngay_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ky_ngay_den 
		INTO #hrstt_rec FROM hrnv a
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrstt_rec select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.ma_dvcs, @dFrom, @dTo from hrnv a where a.ngay_vao <= @dTo and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > @dFrom)' + CASE @Key WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dFrom smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime', @dFrom, @dTo


	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, c.tinh_thue_yn, c.tinh_gt_yn, c.hop_dong_yn, c.doi_tuong, a.ma_bp, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ky_ngay_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ky_ngay_den, d.ma_nt
		INTO #phns FROM #hrstt_rec a, hrtttncn c, hrttluong d

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.tinh_thue_yn, a.tinh_gt_yn, a.hop_dong_yn, a.doi_tuong INTO #tttncn FROM hrtttncnct a WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN (SELECT b.stt_rec, MAX(c.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM #hrstt_rec b JOIN hrtttncnct c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE c.ngay_hl <= @dTo GROUP BY b.stt_rec
			) d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = d.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tttncn(stt_rec)

	INSERT INTO #phns SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, ISNULL(e.tinh_thue_yn, c.tinh_thue_yn) AS tinh_thue_yn, ISNULL(e.tinh_gt_yn, c.tinh_gt_yn) AS tinh_gt_yn, ISNULL(e.hop_dong_yn, c.hop_dong_yn) AS hop_dong_yn, 
			ISNULL(e.doi_tuong, c.doi_tuong) AS doi_tuong, a.ma_bp, @dFrom, @dTo, ISNULL(d.ma_nt, '')
		FROM #hrstt_rec a LEFT JOIN hrtttncn c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec 
			LEFT JOIN hrttluong d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #tttncn e ON e.stt_rec = a.stt_rec

	
/*
	Kết thúc tạo bảng thông tin thuế TNCN
*/

	-- #hrdmtgtl: Tỷ giá tính lương
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_nt INTO #tgnt FROM #phns
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1)) ma_bp, a.ma_nt, c.ty_gia INTO #hrdmtgtl FROM #tgnt a 
		JOIN (SELECT ma_nt, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrdmtgtl WHERE ngay_hl <= @dTo GROUP BY ma_nt) b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtgtl c ON a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt AND b.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl

	DECLARE @CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @CurrencyCode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmtgtl WHERE ma_nt = @CurrencyCode)
		INSERT INTO #hrdmtgtl SELECT '', @CurrencyCode, 1

	-- Tính thuế
	EXEC hs_CalcPersonalIncomeTax @Period, @Year, @Round, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTimesheet]
	@Month INT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @Where NVARCHAR(1023), @max INT, @i INT, @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @day INT, @p VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Where = '', @Join = '', @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @p = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Month, 2), ' ', '0')
	SELECT @day = DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, @p + '01')) - 1)
		
	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #t(k CHAR(15), stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay INT, cong VARCHAR(64), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #report(
		stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(512), 
		n01 VARCHAR(64), n02 VARCHAR(64), n03 VARCHAR(64), n04 VARCHAR(64), n05 VARCHAR(64), n06 VARCHAR(64), n07 VARCHAR(64), n08 VARCHAR(64), n09 VARCHAR(64), n10 VARCHAR(64), 
		n11 VARCHAR(64), n12 VARCHAR(64), n13 VARCHAR(64), n14 VARCHAR(64), n15 VARCHAR(64), n16 VARCHAR(64), n17 VARCHAR(64), n18 VARCHAR(64), n19 VARCHAR(64), n20 VARCHAR(64), 
		n21 VARCHAR(64), n22 VARCHAR(64), n23 VARCHAR(64), n24 VARCHAR(64), n25 VARCHAR(64), n26 VARCHAR(64), n27 VARCHAR(64), n28 VARCHAR(64), n29 VARCHAR(64), n30 VARCHAR(64), n31 VARCHAR(64), 
		stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1)
	)
	
	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	
	-- Group
	IF @EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #empGroup FROM hrnv
		IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

		SELECT @Where = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(SUBSTRING(@Where, 6, LEN(@Where)))
		SET @q = 'insert into #empGroup select stt_rec from hrnv where ' + @Where
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' exists (select 1 from #empGroup g where g.stt_rec = r.stt_rec)'
	END

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	IF @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' 

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t (k, stt_rec, ngay, cong) select '''', r.stt_rec, day(r.ngay), r.ma_cong + case when sum(r.so_ngay) = 1 then '''' else ''('' + '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when right(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), 2) =''00'' then parsename(sum(r.so_gio), 2) when right(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), 1) = ''0'' then left(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)), len(rtrim(sum(r.so_gio))) - 1) else rtrim(sum(r.so_gio)) end'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' + '')'' end'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$' + @p + ' r with(nolock) join hrdmcong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q +  CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @Key END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, day(r.ngay), c.stt, r.ma_cong'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by r.stt_rec, day(r.ngay), c.stt, r.ma_cong'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #t SET k = stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(DAY(ngay), 2), ' ', '0')

	-- Order
	CREATE INDEX o ON #t(k)
	SELECT k, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #t GROUP BY k
	CREATE INDEX o ON #order(k)

	SELECT a.stt - o.stt + 1 AS stt, a.k, a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.cong INTO #k FROM #t a JOIN #order o ON a.k = o.k
	CREATE INDEX o ON #k(k)

	-- Update
	SELECT k, stt_rec, ngay, cong INTO #r FROM #k WHERE stt = 1
	SELECT @max = MAX(stt) FROM #k
	SELECT @i = 2
	WHILE @i <= @max BEGIN
		UPDATE #r SET cong = a.cong + ', ' + b.cong FROM #r a JOIN #k b WITH (INDEX(o)) ON a.k = b.k WHERE b.stt = @i
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, n01, n02, n03, n04, n05, n06, n07, n08, n09, n10, n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20, n21, n22, n23, n24, n25, n26, n27, n28, n29, n30, n31)
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
			FROM #r a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			ORDER BY b.ma_nv
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @day BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set n' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' = b.cong from #report a join #r b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.ngay = ' + RTRIM(@i)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY stt

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPlantKey](
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Type TINYINT -- 1 - Master, 2 - Detail
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @PlantKey VARCHAR(4000), @n INT, @RangeNumber INT
	SELECT @PlantKey = ''

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisysplantrights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PlantKey = @PlantKey + CASE WHEN @PlantKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + RTRIM(ma_vung) FROM bisysplantrights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID ORDER BY ma_vung
			SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@PlantKey, ',')
			SELECT @RangeNumber = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_site_number'
			IF @n <= @RangeNumber BEGIN
				IF @n = 1 SELECT @PlantKey = '(ma_vung = ''' + REPLACE(@PlantKey, ',', ''',''') + ''')'
				ELSE SELECT @PlantKey = '(ma_vung in (''' + REPLACE(@PlantKey, ',', ''',''') + '''))'
			END ELSE SELECT @PlantKey = '(ma_vung in (select ma_vung from bisysplantrights where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + '))'
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisysplantrights WHERE [user_id] = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PlantKey = @PlantKey + '$' + RTRIM(b.id) + '$%' FROM bisysplantrights a JOIN bidmvung b ON a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung WHERE a.[user_id] = @UserID ORDER BY b.id
			SELECT @PlantKey = '''#00#' + @PlantKey + ''' like f$'
		END
	END

	RETURN @PlantKey
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetDays(
	@d1 AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@d2 AS SMALLDATETIME
	)
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN
	DECLARE @intResult AS INT
	IF @d1 > @d2
		SET @intResult = CAST(@d1 - @d2 AS INT)
	ELSE
		SET @intResult = - CAST(@d2 - @d1 AS INT)
	RETURN @intResult
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintHRWrittenRequest]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.stt_rec, g.ma_nv, rtrim(g.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(g.ten_nv) as ten_nv, a.ma_so, a.noi_dung, a.nd_cu, a.nd_moi, a.can_cu'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + @cDTable + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' hrnv g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = g.stt_rec'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten_nv'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	print @strSQL
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByInsurance]
	@Round INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @extraInsurance CHAR(1), @baseType CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @BaseCurrency CHAR(3)
	SELECT @extraInsurance = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_si_trich_bh'
	SELECT @baseType = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bh_nguon_ltt'
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'


/*
	Tính bảo hiểm, kinh phí công đoàn và chênh lệch đóng bảo hiểm, kinh phí công đoàn

	B00: Lương bảo hiểm
	B01: Bảo hiểm xã hội
	B02: Bảo hiểm y tế
	B03: Bảo hiểm thất nghiệp

	B04: Bảo hiểm xã hội công ty
	B05: Bảo hiểm y tế công ty
	B06: Bảo hiểm thất nghiệp công ty

	C01: Kinh phí công đoàn
	C09: Phần chênh lêch đóng bảo hiểm và kinh phí công đoàn

	E01: Hỗ trợ bảo hiểm
	E04: Chênh lệch tỷ giá tính lương và bảo hiểm
*/



/*
	Tạo các bảng thông tin lương và tỷ lệ, thời gian đóng bảo hiểm
*/

	-- Thông tin lương bảo hiểm
	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #hrttctluongbh_1 FROM hrttctluongbh a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl <= b.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.he_so_luong, a.tien_bh, a.tien_cl, a.ngay_hl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_bh_qd, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_cl_qd
		INTO #hrttctluongbh_2 FROM hrttctluongbh a JOIN #hrttctluongbh_1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
	UPDATE #hrttctluongbh_2 SET tien_bh_qd = ROUND(a.tien_bh * c.ty_gia, @Round), tien_cl_qd = ROUND(a.tien_cl * c.ty_gia, @Round)
		FROM #hrttctluongbh_2 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgbh c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp and b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt

	-- Thông tin quá trình tham gia bảo hiểm, luong_co_ban trong quá trình luôn là tiền hạch toán
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_thay_doi, luong_co_ban, ty_le_bhxh, ty_le_bhyt, ty_le_bhtn INTO #qtbh FROM hreqtlbhht
	IF @extraInsurance = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(ngay_thay_doi) AS ngay_thay_doi, MAX(b.ky_ngay_den) AS ky_ngay_den INTO #hreqtlbhht FROM hreqtlbhht a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_thay_doi <= b.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY a.stt_rec
		INSERT INTO #qtbh SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_thay_doi, a.luong_co_ban, a.ty_le_bhxh, a.ty_le_bhyt, a.ty_le_bhtn FROM hreqtlbhht a JOIN #hreqtlbhht b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_thay_doi = b.ngay_thay_doi AND (a.ngay_thay_doi2 >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_thay_doi2 IS NULL)
	END

	-- Nhân viên xét bảo hiểm xã hội, bảo hiểm y tế, bảo hiểm thất nghiệp
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #hrttctxh FROM hrttctxh
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #hrttctyt FROM hrttctyt
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #hrttcttn FROM hrttcttn

	IF @extraInsurance = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #hrttctxh SELECT stt_rec FROM #qtbh WHERE ty_le_bhxh <> 0
		INSERT INTO #hrttctyt SELECT stt_rec FROM #qtbh WHERE ty_le_bhyt <> 0
		INSERT INTO #hrttcttn SELECT stt_rec FROM #qtbh WHERE ty_le_bhtn <> 0
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #hrttctxh SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM hrttctxh a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ky_ngay_den AND (a.ngay_hl_den >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)
		INSERT INTO #hrttctyt SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM hrttctyt a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ky_ngay_den AND (a.ngay_hl_den >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)
		INSERT INTO #hrttcttn SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM hrttcttn a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ky_ngay_den AND (a.ngay_hl_den >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)
	END


	-- Thông tin kinh phí công đoàn, tiền phí công đoàn luôn là tiền hạch toán
	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu INTO #hrttctcd_1 FROM hrttctcd a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ky_ngay_den AND (a.ngay_hl_den >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.tien INTO #hrttctcd_2 FROM hrttctcd a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrttctcd_1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu

	-- Thông tin loại đối tượng
	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu INTO #hrttctdt_1 FROM hrttctdtbh a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ky_ngay_den AND (a.ngay_hl_den >= b.ky_ngay_den OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.loai_dt INTO #hrttctdt_2 FROM hrttctdtbh a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrttctdt_1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu

	-- Tỷ lệ đóng bảo hiểm
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.loai_dt, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #hrdmtlbh_1
		FROM #hrstt_rec a LEFT JOIN #hrttctdt_2 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN hrdmtlbh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON ISNULL(c.loai_dt, '') = b.loai_dt
		WHERE b.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY a.stt_rec, b.loai_dt

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.loai_dt, b.tl_bhxh0, b.tl_bhyt0, b.tl_bhtn0, b.tl_kpcd0, b.tl_bhxh1, b.tl_bhyt1, b.tl_bhtn1, b.tl_kpcd1 INTO #hrdmtlbh_2
		FROM #hrdmtlbh_1 a JOIN hrdmtlbh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl AND a.loai_dt = b.loai_dt
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hrdmtlbh_2(stt_rec)


	-- Mức trần bảo hiểm
	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_bp, a.loai_bh, a.he_so, a.cach_tinh, luong_tt AS muc_tran, b.ma_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(26, 12)) AS muc_tran_qd INTO #hrmucdbh FROM hrmucdbh a, #hrdmlttv b
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_mucbh' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #hrmucdbh SELECT b.ma_bp, a.loai_bh, a.he_so, a.cach_tinh, 0, '', 0
			FROM hrmucdbh a JOIN (SELECT a.ma_bp, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl, b.loai_bh FROM #hrky a CROSS JOIN hrmucdbh b WHERE b.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY a.ma_bp, b.loai_bh) b ON a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl AND a.loai_bh = b.loai_bh

		UPDATE #hrmucdbh SET ma_nt = @BaseCurrency, muc_tran = a.he_so * b.luong_tt FROM #hrmucdbh a JOIN #hrdmlttc b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.cach_tinh = 1
		UPDATE #hrmucdbh SET ma_nt = b.ma_nt, muc_tran = a.he_so * b.luong_tt FROM #hrmucdbh a JOIN #hrdmlttv b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.cach_tinh = 2
		UPDATE #hrmucdbh SET muc_tran_qd = ROUND(b.ty_gia * a.muc_tran, @Round) FROM #hrmucdbh a JOIN #hrdmtgbh b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
	END

/*
	Kết thúc tạo các bảng thông tin lương và tỷ lệ, thời gian đóng bảo hiểm
*/

	/*
	Tính lương bảo hiểm
		Nếu nhập trong thông tin chi tiết sẽ tính theo ngày hiệu lực bằng công thức: Hệ số * Lương tối thiểu + Lương bảo hiểm
		Nếu không nhập sẽ tính bằng Hệ số lương kinh doanh * Lương tối thiểu
	*/

	DECLARE @v NUMERIC(26, 12)
	IF @extraInsurance = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #hrluong SET b00 = ISNULL(d.luong_co_ban, 0) FROM #hrluong a LEFT JOIN #qtbh d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update #hrluong set b00 = round(case when b.he_so_luong is null then a.l00 else b.he_so_luong * isnull(c.luong_tt, 0) end * a.tg_bh, @round) + b.tien_bh_qd' +
				' from #hrluong a left join #hrttctluongbh_2 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + CASE
					WHEN @baseType = 2 THEN ' left join #hrdmlttv c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp and a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt'
					WHEN @baseType = 3 THEN ' left join #hrdmlttcty c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp and a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt'
					ELSE ' left join #hrdmlttc c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp'
				END
				+ ' where a.bpql_yn = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@round int', @Round
	END

	-- Bảo hiểm xã hội và chênh lệch
	UPDATE #hrluong SET @v = CASE WHEN e.muc_tran_qd IS NOT NULL AND a.b00 > e.muc_tran_qd THEN e.muc_tran_qd ELSE a.b00 END,
			b01 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhxh0 / 100, @Round), b04 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhxh1 / 100, @Round), c09 = ROUND(c.tien_cl_qd * d.tl_bhxh1 / 100, @Round)
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttctxh b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrttctluongbh_2 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtlbh_2 d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrmucdbh e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND e.loai_bh = '1'
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1

	-- Bảo hiểm y tế và chênh lệch
	UPDATE #hrluong SET @v = CASE WHEN e.muc_tran_qd IS NOT NULL AND a.b00 > e.muc_tran_qd THEN e.muc_tran_qd ELSE a.b00 END,
			b02 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhyt0 / 100, @Round), b05 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhyt1 / 100, @Round), c09 = ISNULL(a.c09, 0) + ROUND(ISNULL(c.tien_cl_qd, 0) * d.tl_bhyt1 / 100, @Round)
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttctyt b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrttctluongbh_2 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtlbh_2 d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrmucdbh e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND e.loai_bh = '2'
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1

	-- Bảo hiểm thất nghiệp và chênh lệch
	UPDATE #hrluong SET @v = CASE WHEN e.muc_tran_qd IS NOT NULL AND a.b00 > e.muc_tran_qd THEN e.muc_tran_qd ELSE a.b00 END,
			b03 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhtn0 / 100, @Round),	b06 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_bhtn1 / 100, @Round), c09 = ISNULL(a.c09, 0) + ROUND(ISNULL(c.tien_cl_qd, 0) * d.tl_bhtn1 / 100, @Round)
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttcttn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrttctluongbh_2 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtlbh_2 d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrmucdbh e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND e.loai_bh = '3'
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1

/*
	Tính kinh phí công đoàn và chênh lệch
*/

	-- Kinh phí công đoàn
	UPDATE #hrluong SET @v = CASE WHEN e.muc_tran_qd IS NOT NULL AND a.b00 > e.muc_tran_qd THEN e.muc_tran_qd ELSE a.b00 END,
			c01 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.tien, 0) = 0 THEN ROUND(@v * d.tl_kpcd0 / 100, @Round) ELSE b.tien END,
			c09 = ISNULL(a.c09, 0) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.tien, 0) = 0 THEN ROUND(ISNULL(c.tien_cl_qd, 0) * d.tl_kpcd1 / 100, @Round) ELSE 0 END
