		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttctcd_2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrttctluongbh_2 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtlbh_2 d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrmucdbh e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND e.loai_bh = '1'
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1

	-- + Tối đa chỉ bằng 10% mức lương cơ bản
	UPDATE #hrluong SET c01 = b.luong_tt * 0.1 FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrdmlttc b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1 AND a.c01 > (b.luong_tt * 0.1)

	UPDATE #hrluong SET @v = CASE WHEN e.muc_tran_qd IS NOT NULL AND a.b00 > e.muc_tran_qd THEN e.muc_tran_qd ELSE a.b00 END,
			c02 = ROUND(@v * d.tl_kpcd1 / 100, @Round)
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttctxh b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtlbh_2 d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrmucdbh e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND e.loai_bh = '1'
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1


	-- Hỗ trợ bảo hiểm
	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #hrhtbh FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN hrttctluongnet b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ngay_hl <= a.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	UPDATE #hrluong SET e01 = CASE WHEN ISNULL(c.ho_tro_bh, 0) = 1 THEN ISNULL(a.b01, 0) + ISNULL(a.b02, 0) + ISNULL(a.b03, 0) ELSE 0 END
		FROM #hrluong a LEFT JOIN #hrhtbh b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrttctluongnet c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1


/*
	Kết thúc tính bảo hiểm, kinh phí công đoàn và chênh lệch
*/

END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckStopMO] -- fs20_COCheckStopMO
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'

	-- Unit Key
	IF @costUnit = '1' SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT so_lsx, ma_dvcs INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select distinct so_lsx, ' + CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN 'ma_dvcs' ELSE '''''' END + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' where%[' + @UnitKey + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT DISTINCT so_lsx, ma_dvcs INTO #MO FROM #tmp

	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct AS so_lsx, dien_giai, CASE WHEN @costUnit = 1 THEN a.ma_dvcs ELSE '' END AS ma_dvcs
		FROM phsx a JOIN #MO b ON dbo.xf20_GetMO(a.so_ct) = dbo.xf20_GetMO(b.so_lsx) AND (@costUnit = 0 OR a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs)
		WHERE a.[status] NOT IN ('0', '*') AND (a.ngay_th2 IS NOT NULL) AND (a.ngay_th2 < @dFrom)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalRole]
	@VoucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@FC VARCHAR(33),
	@Amount NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Category VARCHAR(32),
	@CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT,
	@Role VARCHAR(32) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = '
declare @d smalldatetime
select @d = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 121)
select top 1 @r = rtrim(a.ma_quyen), @Category = rtrim(c.kieu_duyet)
	from (select * from dmduyet where @d >= ngay_hl and (@d <= ngay_hl2 or ngay_hl2 is null)) a join dmquyen b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen join dmquyenct c on b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet and b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen join dmttcttg d on a.loai_duyet = d.loai_duyet and d.loai_duyet = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherType, '''', '''''') + ''' and c.status = d.u_status
	where a.loai_duyet = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherType, '''', '''''') + '''
		and a.status = ''1''
		and a.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and (a.ma_nt = '''' or a.ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@FC, '''', '''''') + ''') and (a.tien_nt = 0 or a.tien_nt >= ' + RTRIM(@Amount) + ')' +
		CASE WHEN @VoucherType = '1' THEN ' and (a.ma_bp = ''' + REPLACE(@Department, '''', '''''') + ''' or a.ma_bp = '''')' ELSE '' END +
		' and b.status = ''1''
		 and c.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + '''
		 and d.status = ''1''
		 and c.kieu_duyet = ''' + REPLACE(@Category, '''', '''''') + '''
	order by a.ma_bp desc'

	EXECUTE sp_executesql @q, N'@r varchar(33) output, @Category varchar(33) output', @r = @Role OUTPUT, @Category = @Category OUTPUT
	SELECT @Role = ISNULL(@Role, ''), @CategoryApprove = ISNULL(@Category, '')

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Receipt$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0, 
	@OldSite VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0, 
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(28, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Site = @OldSite

	SELECT a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_dl, a.gia_ton, a.lo_yn, a.ma_thue, b.thue_suat, a.tao_lo INTO #Item 
		FROM dmvt a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue WHERE ma_vt = @Item 

	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PD1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql N'if not exists(select 1 from dmkho where ma_kho = @DefaultSite and ma_vung = @PlantCode) begin select @DefaultSite = '''';update #Item set ma_kho = '''', ma_vi_tri = ''''; end'
			, N'@DefaultSite varchar(32) output, @PlantCode varchar(32)', @DefaultSite OUTPUT, @PlantCode
	END

	IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
			SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite
		ELSE
			UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
	END

	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
		ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

	SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_kho) AS ma_kho, RTRIM(a.ma_vi_tri) AS ma_vi_tri, RTRIM(@UOM) AS dvt, @Rate AS he_so, RTRIM(@ItemAccount) AS tk_vt, a.gia_ton, 
			CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ma_kho FROM dmvitri WHERE dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, ma_thue, thue_suat, a.tao_lo, @Stock AS stock
		FROM #Item a

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCMaterialResourceUsageOrderExport] --rs_rptSFCProductionDetailStatus
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @rq TINYINT

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_bd, ngay_ct AS ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_lsx AS ma_cd, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS tinh_trang, loai_ct INTO #master FROM ms2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, ma_cd
		, ma_sp AS ma_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_vt
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_cl, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS xGroup, CAST(0 AS INT) AS line_nbr, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #detail FROM #master
	-- Key
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and b.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- s
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, @$quantity'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where %[@$key]%'

	-- master
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select b.stt_rec, max(b.ngay_ct), min(a.ngay_bd), max(a.ngay_kt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.so_lsx), b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx, max(b.ma_lo_trinh), max(a.ma_cd), max(b.sl_yc), null, max(c.statusname' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), max(b.loai_ct)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmttct c with(nolock) on b.status = c.status and c.ma_ct = ''SF2'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by b.stt_rec, b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$quantity', 'a.sl_nhap'), '@$key', 'exists(select 1 from #master b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd) and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	UPDATE #master SET sl_th = b.sl FROM #master a JOIN (SELECT ma_lsx, ma_vt, SUM(sl) AS sl FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt WHERE a.sl_th IS NULL --AND a.loai_ct = '1'

	-- Detail
	TRUNCATE TABLE #sfctpx
	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$quantity', 'a.sl_xuat'), '@$key', 'exists(select 1 from #master b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx) and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 2 and a.loai = '''') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''2''))')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT ma_lsx, ma_vt, SUM(sl) AS sl INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_vt

	-- BOM
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_lo_trinh INTO #d0 FROM #detail
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #d0 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, so_luong, ma_lo_trinh)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, '''', a.so_luong, b.ma_lo_trinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #master c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	UPDATE #d0 SET ma_vt = b.ma_vt FROM #d0 a JOIN ctrt b ON a.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
	--
	SELECT DISTINCT b.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.he_so, a.so_luong, a.tl_hh, a.ngay_ct1 INTO #ctdm
		FROM ctdm a LEFT JOIN phdm b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #d0 c ON b.ma_sp = c.ma_vt
			WHERE (a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct1 <= c.ngay_ct) AND (a.ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct2 >= c.ngay_ct)
	SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, MAX(ngay_ct1) AS ngay_ct1 INTO #ctdm0 FROM #ctdm GROUP BY ma_sp, ma_vt
	DELETE #ctdm FROM #ctdm a WHERE a.ngay_ct1 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctdm0 b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct1 = b.ngay_ct1)
	DELETE #ctdm FROM #ctdm a WHERE a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctdm0 b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct1 IS NOT NULL)

	SELECT b.stt_rec, b.ma_lsx, b.ma_cd, a.ma_vt, ROUND(a.so_luong * a.he_so * b.so_luong * (1 + a.tl_hh), @rq) AS so_luong INTO #sfctdmwo FROM #d0 b RIGHT JOIN #ctdm a ON b.ma_vt = a.ma_sp
	--
	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, MAX(a.ma_cd) AS ma_cd, a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE MAX(b.ten_vt2) END, SUM(a.so_luong)
			FROM #sfctdmwo a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.loai_vt IN ('21', '31')
				WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
					GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, '', b.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END, 0
			FROM #sfctpx0 b
				JOIN cs2$000000 a ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
				JOIN dmvt c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND c.loai_vt IN ('21', '31')
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail c WHERE b.ma_lsx = c.ma_lsx AND b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)
	--
	UPDATE #detail SET sl_tt = b.sl FROM #detail a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	UPDATE #detail SET sl_cl = (ISNULL(sl_tt, 0) - sl_yc_vt)
	UPDATE #detail SET xGroup = b.so_lsx + b.ma_sp + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_bd, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_kt, ''), 112) + a.stt_rec FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	--
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail SET line_nbr = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #detail a JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	--
	UPDATE #detail
			SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ngay_bd = b.ngay_bd, ngay_kt = b.ngay_kt
				, so_lsx = b.so_lsx, ma_sp = b.ma_sp, ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
				, sl_yc = b.sl_yc, sl_th = b.sl_th, tinh_trang = b.tinh_trang
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE line_nbr = 1

	--
	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, xGroup, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ma_cd, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, line_nbr)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_lsx + a.ma_sp + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_bd, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_kt, ''), 112) + a.stt_rec
				, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_bd, a.ngay_kt, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lsx, '', a.sl_yc, a.sl_th, a.tinh_trang, 1
			FROM #master a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, 2 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, c.ten_cd, ma_cm, ma_may, tg_cai_dat AS tg_std, tg_cai_dat AS amt_std, tg_cai_dat AS tg_act, tg_cai_dat AS amt_act,
			 CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tg_lech, ma_cm AS fieldkey, CAST('01' AS CHAR(2)) AS type, cach_tinh, nang_suat, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS resource, c.line_nbr AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS xcode
		INTO #detail2
		FROM sfctwo a LEFT JOIN ctrt c ON c.ma_lo_trinh = a.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd LEFT JOIN sfctmay$000000 d ON a.ma_lsx = d.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = d.ma_cd

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail2 select distinct a.stt_rec, 2, 1, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_cd' ELSE 'c.ten_cd2' END + ', f.ma_cm, d.ma_may, g.tg_cai_dat, 0, 0, 0, 0, f.ma_cm, ''01'', cach_tinh, c.nang_suat, '''', c.line_nbr, a.ma_lsx + a.ma_cd + d.ma_may'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctwo a left join ctrt c on c.ma_lo_trinh = a.ma_lo_trinh and a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd left join sfctmay$%Partition d on a.ma_lsx = d.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = d.ma_cd left join sfdmmay f on d.ma_may = f.ma_may left join sfdmcummay g on f.ma_cm = g.ma_cm'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #detail)]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #detail20 FROM #detail2 WHERE ISNULL(ma_may, '') <> ''

	INSERT INTO #detail20
		SELECT stt_rec, 3, systotal, a.ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_cd, a.ma_cm, a.ma_may, 0, c.cp_dv, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_may, '01', cach_tinh, a.nang_suat, '', line_nbr, xcode
			FROM #detail20 a LEFT JOIN sfdmcummay b ON a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm LEFT JOIN sfdmmay c ON (a.ma_may = c.ma_may)

	SELECT @q = 'update #detail20 set tg_act = b.thoi_gian, amt_act = b.thoi_gian * c.cp_dv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #detail20 a left join (select a.ma_gd, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_may, sum(a.so_gio) as thoi_gian from sfctmay$%Partition a where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''') group by a.ma_gd, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_may) b on b.ma_gd = ''01'' and a.type = b.ma_gd and a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd and a.ma_may = b.ma_may left join sfdmmay c on (a.ma_may = c.ma_may)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.type = ''01'' and b.thoi_gian is not null and a.sysorder = 3]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #detail20
		SELECT stt_rec, sysorder, 1, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_cd, ma_cm, ma_may, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fieldkey, '02', cach_tinh, nang_suat, '', line_nbr, xcode
			FROM #detail20
				WHERE sysorder = 2

	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_cd, b.ma_cm, b.ma_may, cach_tinh, a.nang_suat, line_nbr, xcode
		INTO #detail201
			FROM #detail20 a LEFT JOIN sfdmmay b ON a.ma_may = b.ma_may WHERE a.ma_may IS NOT NULL AND b.ma_cm NOT IN(SELECT ma_cm FROM #detail20) AND sysorder = 2

	INSERT INTO #detail20
		SELECT stt_rec, 2, 1, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_cd, a.ma_cm, a.ma_may, c.tg_cai_dat, 0, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_cm, '01', cach_tinh, a.nang_suat, '', line_nbr, xcode
			FROM #detail201 a LEFT JOIN sfdmmay b ON a.ma_may = b.ma_may LEFT JOIN sfdmcummay c ON b.ma_cm = c.ma_cm

	INSERT INTO #detail20
		SELECT stt_rec, 2, 1, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_cd, ma_cm, ma_may, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ma_cm, '02', cach_tinh, nang_suat, '', line_nbr, xcode
			FROM #detail201

	INSERT INTO #detail20
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, sysorder, 1, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, ten_cd, a.ma_cm, a.ma_may, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fieldkey, '02', cach_tinh, a.nang_suat, '', a.line_nbr, xcode
			FROM #detail20 a
		WHERE sysorder = 3


	UPDATE #detail20 SET tg_std = CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '1' THEN CASE WHEN a.nang_suat = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(so_luong/a.nang_suat, 2) END ELSE CASE WHEN a.nang_suat = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(so_luong*a.nang_suat, 2) END END
		FROM #detail20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT ma_lsx, SUM(sl_th) AS so_luong FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_lsx) b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
		WHERE sysorder = 2 AND TYPE = '02'

	SELECT @q = 'update #detail20 set tg_act = b.thoi_gian, amt_act = b.thoi_gian * c.cp_dv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #detail20 a left join (select a.ma_gd, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_may, sum(a.so_gio) as thoi_gian from sfctmay$%Partition a where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''') group by a.ma_gd, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_may) b on b.ma_gd = ''02'' and a.type = b.ma_gd and a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd and a.ma_may = b.ma_may left join sfdmmay c on (a.ma_may = c.ma_may)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.type = ''02'' and b.thoi_gian is not null and a.sysorder = 3]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	SELECT ma_cd, type, sysorder, SUM(tg_act) AS tg_act, SUM(amt_act) AS amt_act, ma_cm, ma_lsx INTO #temp FROM #detail20 WHERE sysorder = 3 GROUP BY ma_cd, type, sysorder, ma_cm, ma_lsx

	UPDATE #detail20 SET tg_act = b.tg_act, amt_act = b.amt_act
		FROM #detail20 a JOIN #temp b ON a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd AND a.type = b.type AND a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm AND a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
		WHERE a.sysorder = 2

	UPDATE #detail20 SET xcode = ma_cm WHERE sysorder = 2
	DELETE FROM #detail20 WHERE xcode IS NULL AND type IS NOT NULL

	UPDATE #detail20 SET amt_std = b.amt_std * a.tg_std FROM #detail20 a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_cm, MIN(amt_std) AS amt_std FROM #detail20 WHERE ISNULL(amt_std, 0) <> 0 and ISNULL(ma_cm, '') <> '' GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_cm) b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd AND a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm WHERE sysorder = 2

	INSERT INTO #detail20(stt_rec, sysorder, systotal, ma_lsx, ma_cd, fieldkey, resource, tg_std, amt_std, tg_act, amt_act, line_nbr, ma_may)
		SELECT stt_rec, MIN(sysorder), 0, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_cm, fieldkey, SUM(tg_std), SUM(amt_std), SUM(tg_act), SUM(amt_act), line_nbr, ma_may FROM #detail20 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, fieldkey, sysorder, systotal, line_nbr, ma_cm, ma_may

	INSERT INTO #detail20(stt_rec, sysorder, systotal, ma_lsx, ma_cd, resource, line_nbr)
		SELECT stt_rec, 1, 0, ma_lsx, ma_cd, LTRIM(RTRIM(ma_cd)) + ' - ' + MAX(ten_cd), line_nbr FROM #detail20 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, line_nbr

	UPDATE #detail20
		SET resource = LTRIM(RTRIM(a.ma_may)) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_may ELSE b.ten_may2 END
		FROM #detail20 a JOIN sfdmmay b ON a.ma_may = b.ma_may
		WHERE a.sysorder = 3

	UPDATE #detail20
		SET resource = LTRIM(RTRIM(a.fieldkey)) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_cm ELSE b.ten_cm2 END
		FROM #detail20 a JOIN sfdmcummay b ON a.fieldkey = b.ma_cm
		WHERE a.resource <> '' AND a.sysorder = 2

	UPDATE #detail20 SET tg_std = 0 WHERE tg_std IS NULL
	UPDATE #detail20 SET tg_act = 0 WHERE tg_act IS NULL
	UPDATE #detail20 SET tg_lech = tg_act - tg_std

	UPDATE #detail20 SET resource = (SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_gd ELSE ten_gd2 END FROM dmmagd WHERE ma_ct = 'SF6' AND ma_gd = '01') WHERE type = '01'
	UPDATE #detail20 SET resource = (SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_gd ELSE ten_gd2 END FROM dmmagd WHERE ma_ct = 'SF1' AND ma_gd = '02') WHERE type = '02'

	UPDATE #detail20 SET resource = SPACE(1) + SPACE(1) + SPACE(1) + SPACE(1)+ SPACE(1) + SPACE(1) + resource WHERE systotal = 1
	UPDATE #detail20 SET resource = SPACE(1) + SPACE(1) + SPACE(1) + resource WHERE systotal = 0 AND sysorder > 1

	UPDATE #detail20 SET xcode = RTRIM(ISNULL(ma_cm, fieldkey)) + RTRIM(sysorder) + CASE WHEN sysorder = 3 THEN ISNULL(ma_may, '') ELSE '' END

	DELETE FROM #detail20 WHERE sysorder = 3

	SELECT xGroup, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt, sl_tt, sl_cl, line_nbr FROM #detail ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	SELECT sysorder, b.xGroup, a.systotal, tg_std, amt_std, tg_act, amt_act, tg_lech, resource, a.line_nbr, type, xcode FROM #detail20 a LEFT JOIN #Detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec GROUP BY sysorder, b.xGroup, a.systotal, tg_std, amt_std, tg_act, amt_act, tg_lech, resource, a.line_nbr, type, xcode ORDER BY a.line_nbr, xcode, sysorder, type, b.xGroup, a.systotal, tg_std, amt_std, tg_act, amt_act, tg_lech, resource

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyMRTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m87$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d87$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số phiếu', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vt', 100, '', '', N'Mã hàng', N'Item', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vt', 300, '', '', N'Tên mặt hàng', N'Item Description', 'ten_vt', 'ten_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dvt', 50, '', '', N'Đvt', N'UOM', 'dvt', 'dvt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
						CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, RTRIM(a.dvt) AS dvt,
						dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, so_luong)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng số lượng', N'Total Quantity', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_so_luong, @quantityFormat)
		FROM #master


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01510', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01510', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', diễn giải: ' + RTRIM(a.dien_giai),
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Memo: ' + RTRIM(a.dien_giai)
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Phiếu yêu cầu lĩnh vật tư chờ duyệt'', N''Material requisition waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Phiếu yêu cầu lĩnh vật tư chờ duyệt'', N''Material requisition waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu lĩnh vật tư'', N''Material requisition workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu lĩnh vật tư'', N''Material requisition workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptServicePurchaseInvoiceList]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound TINYINT, @m_ma_nt0 CHAR(3)

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giai_ct, ma_ct, ma_hd, ma_bp, dvt1 AS dvt,
			sl_nhap AS so_luong, gia0, gia_nt0, tien0, tien_nt0, thue, thue_nt, tien0 AS pt, tien_nt0 AS pt_nt, line_nbr
		INTO #report FROM wrkin
	SELECT stt_rec, thue, thue_nt INTO #tax FROM #report

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @TableName, @controller, @SysDB, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a.user_id', 'b.user_id'), '%a.datetime', 'b.datetime'), '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a'), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a')
	--

	SELECT @Join = 'join m31$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', @Key = 'b.status not in (''0'', ''9'', ''*'')'

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when a.ma_vv <> '''' then a.ma_vv else b.job_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when a.ma_hd <> '''' then a.ma_hd else b.contract_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'case when a.ma_bp <> '''' then a.ma_bp else b.dept_id end like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')

	--
	IF @queryJoin <> '' SET @Join = @Join + @queryJoin
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kh, case when a.ma_vv <> '''' then a.ma_vv else b.job_id end, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.dien_giai, a.dien_giai, b.ma_ct, case when a.ma_hd <> '''' then a.ma_hd else b.contract_id end, case when a.ma_bp <> '''' then a.ma_bp else b.dept_id end, a.dvt,'
	SET @q = @q + 'a.so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, thue, thue_nt, 0 as pt, 0 as pt_nt, line_nbr' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from d31$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Tax
	SET @q = 'insert into #tax select a.stt_rec, sum(t_thue), sum(t_thue_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r30$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #report b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)]%'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Update
	UPDATE #report SET thue = CASE WHEN c.t_tien0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(b.thue/c.t_tien0 * a.tien0, @nRound) END, thue_nt = CASE WHEN c.t_tien_nt0 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(b.thue_nt/c.t_tien_nt0 * a.tien_nt0, @nRound) END
		FROM #report a JOIN #tax b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			JOIN (SELECT SUM(tien0) AS t_tien0, SUM(tien_nt0) AS t_tien_nt0, stt_rec FROM #report z GROUP BY stt_rec) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET thue = a.thue + (c.thue - b.t_thue), thue_nt = a.thue_nt + (c.thue_nt - b.t_thue_nt)
		FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT SUM(thue) AS t_thue, SUM(thue_nt) AS t_thue_nt, stt_rec FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			JOIN #tax c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE a.line_nbr = (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report d WHERE a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec)
	UPDATE #report SET pt = tien0 + thue, pt_nt = tien_nt0 + thue_nt

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	UPDATE #report SET ma_nt = '', ty_gia = 0, gia_nt0 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0
		WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_ct) VALUES ('', '')

	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, stt_rec as rp_group, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.pt, a.pt_nt, a.line_nbr, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + @Order + ', a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xc_FIFOBalance]
	@mF TINYINT,
	@mT TINYINT,
	@year INT,	
	@unit VARCHAR(33),
	@updateType TINYINT,
	@userID INT,
	@admin TINYINT,
	@debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k VARCHAR(1024), @f VARCHAR(1024), @p NVARCHAR(4000), @location BIT, @lot BIT, @cY VARCHAR(4), @cM VARCHAR(2), @d1 VARCHAR(8), @d2 VARCHAR(8)

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@mF, @year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@mT, @year)
	SELECT @cY = REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ', '0'), @cM = REPLACE(STR(@mF, 2), ' ', '0'), @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112), @d2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dTo, 112), @location = 1, @lot = 1

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_ntxt_vitri' AND val = '0') SELECT @location = 0
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_ntxt_lo' AND val = '0') SELECT @lot = 0


	-- Deleted Data
	IF @updateType <> 2 BEGIN
		DELETE cdntxt FROM cdntxt a WHERE a.nam = @year AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT ma_vt FROM #fifoItem b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		DELETE cdntxt FROM cdntxt a JOIN #dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho
			WHERE a.nam = @year AND (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND a.ma_ct <> ''
	END


	-- Filter
	IF @unit IS NOT NULL SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	SELECT @k = ' where %[a.status = ''1''', 
		@f = ' select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nxt, a.ct_dc, a.pn_gia_tb, a.px_gia_dd, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + 
			'a.ma_khon, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, ' + 
			'a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.dvt1, a.sl_nhap1, a.sl_xuat1, a.he_so1, a.gia_nt1, a.gia1, ' + 
			'a.tk_vt, a.tk_gv, a.tk_dt, a.sl_nhap, a.sl_xuat, a.gia_nt, a.gia, a.tien_nt_n, a.tien_nt_x, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_xuat, ' + 
			'a.line_nbr, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.stt_rec_dc, a.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec0pn, a.stt_rec_px, a.stt_rec0px, 0, 0, null', 
		@q = 'insert into #ps70' + @f + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join #dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' + 
			' join #dmkho c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho' + @k

	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @unitKey + ']%' ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin

	CREATE INDEX i ON #ps70(stt_rec, stt_rec0)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ps70gl' + @f + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join #stt_rec b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where %[a.status = ''1'']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin

	IF @updateType <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #ps00' + 
			' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.nh_dk, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, ' + 
			'a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ct_nxt, a.line_nbr, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3' + 
			' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) join #stt_rec b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
			@k + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin
	END


	IF @updateType <> 2 BEGIN
		DELETE #ps70 WHERE ma_ct = 'PXA' AND loai_ct = '7'
		INSERT INTO #fifoVoucher SELECT ma_ct, stt_ctntxt FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM #ps70)

		SELECT *, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, 0 AS pn_co_gia, sl_nhap AS ton00, tien_nhap AS du00, tien_nt_n AS du_nt00 INTO #tIRtmp FROM #ps70 WHERE nxt = 1
		UPDATE #tIRtmp SET cp = 0, cp_nt = 0

		-- Charge
		SELECT ma_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n INTO #tFtmp FROM #tIRtmp WHERE stt_rec_pn <> '' AND sl_nhap = 0

		-- Difference Between Invoice and Receipt
		UPDATE #tFtmp SET stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0pn
			FROM #tFtmp a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn FROM #tFtmp) b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0

		IF COL_LENGTH('d71$000000', 'stt_rec_ir') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #d(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt_rec0 CHAR(3), stt_rec_pn CHAR(13), stt_rec0pn CHAR(3))
			SELECT @p = 'insert into #d select b.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec_ir, b.stt_rec0ir' + 
				' from #tFtmp a join d%t$%Partition b on a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0 and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' + 
				' join m%t$%Partition c on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec where %[c.loai_ct in (''5'', ''6'') and c.status <> ''0'']%'

			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@p, '%t', '71')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@p, '%t', '72')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin

			UPDATE #tFtmp SET stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0pn FROM #tFtmp a JOIN #d b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0pn = b.stt_rec0
		END		


		SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_cp, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_cp_nt
			INTO #tFeetmp FROM #tFtmp GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt

		UPDATE #tIRtmp SET cp = b.tien_cp, cp_nt = b.tien_cp_nt FROM #tIRtmp a JOIN #tFeetmp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn

		-- Specific Issue
		SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt, SUM(sl_xuat) AS so_luong, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt
			INTO #tReturn FROM #ps70 WHERE nxt = 2 AND stt_rec_pn <> '' AND sl_xuat > 0 AND px_gia_dd = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt
		CREATE INDEX i ON #tReturn(stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, ma_vt)

		-- Update receipt
		UPDATE #tIRtmp SET so_luong = a.so_luong - ISNULL(b.so_luong, 0), tien = a.tien - ISNULL(b.tien, 0), tien_nt = a.tien_nt - ISNULL(b.tien_nt, 0)
			FROM #tIRtmp a JOIN #tReturn b ON a.stt_rec  = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt


		SELECT a.*, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_nt, b.stt_ctntxt AS stt_ctntxt, a.cp AS tien_cp, a.cp_nt AS tien_cp_nt, 
				a.so_luong AS ton_khoxx, a.tien + a.cp AS so_duxx, a.tien_nt + a.cp_nt AS so_du_ntxx, 
				a.so_luong AS ton_kho13, a.tien + a.cp AS so_du13, a.tien_nt + a.cp_nt AS so_du_nt13
			INTO #tIRtmpz FROM #tIRtmp a LEFT JOIN #fifoVoucher b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE a.so_luong <> 0	


		UPDATE #tIRtmpz SET pn_co_gia = CASE WHEN ct_dc = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
		UPDATE #tIRtmpz SET pn_co_gia = 1 WHERE ct_dc = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ps70 b WHERE b.nxt = 2 AND b.ct_dc = 1 AND b.sl_xuat > 0 AND b.px_gia_dd = 1 AND LEFT(b.stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(#tIRtmpz.stt_rec, 10) AND b.stt_rec0 = #tIRtmpz.stt_rec0)

		-- Update FIFO Balance
		UPDATE cdntxt SET pn_co_gia = 1 WHERE nam = @year AND ma_ct = ''


		-- Deleted Receipts Data
		IF @updateType <> 2
			DELETE cdntxt FROM cdntxt a JOIN #vt0x b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho
				WHERE a.nam = @year AND (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND a.ma_ct <> '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tIRtmpz z WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = z.stt_rec)


		DECLARE @cT VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @cT = REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo) + 1, 2), ' ', '0')

		SELECT @q = 'update cdntxt set ton_kho13 = ton_kho' + @cM + ', so_du13 = so_du' + @cM  + ', so_du_nt13 = so_du_nt' + @cM  + 
			CASE WHEN @mT < 12 THEN ', ton_kho' + @cT + ' = ton_kho' + @cM + ', so_du' + @cT + ' = so_du' + @cM + ', so_du_nt' + @cT + ' = so_du_nt' + @cM ELSE '' END + 
			' where nam = ' + @cY + ' and ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #dmvt) and ma_kho in (select ma_kho from #dmkho)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Arising
		INSERT INTO #cdntxt(id, nam, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, ngay, ma_ct, stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, ma_nt, tien, tien_nt, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt, ton_kho, so_du, so_du_nt, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, line_nbr) 
			SELECT id, @year, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, 0, ma_ct, stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sl_nhap, ma_nt, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt, 0, 0, 0, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, line_nbr FROM #tIRtmpz

		SELECT @q = 'update #cdntxt set ton_kho = b.ton_khoxx, so_du = b.so_duxx, so_du_nt = b.so_du_ntxx' + 
			' from #cdntxt a join #tIRtmpz b on a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_nt and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		-- Openning
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #cdntxt(id, nam, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, ngay, ma_ct, stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, ma_nt, tien, tien_nt, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt, ton_kho, so_du, so_du_nt, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, line_nbr) select 0, a.nam, a.stt_rec_nt, a.stt_rec0, a.pn_co_gia, a.ngay, a.ma_ct, a.stt_ctntxt, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, ' +
			'a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong, a.ma_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.ton_kho' + @cM + ', a.so_du' + @cM + ', a.so_du_nt' + @cM + ', a.ton_kho13, a.so_du13, a.so_du_nt13, a.line_nbr' + 
			' from cdntxt a join #dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt join #dmkho c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho where a.nam = ' + @cY + ' and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + @d2 + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Except receipts with specific method (receipt in previous periods)
		SELECT @q = 'update #cdntxt set ton_kho = a.ton_kho - isnull(b.so_luong, 0), ' + 
			'so_du = a.so_du - isnull(b.tien, 0), ' + 
			'so_du_nt = a.so_du_nt - isnull(b.tien_nt, 0), ' + 
			'ton_kho13 = a.ton_kho13 - isnull(b.so_luong, 0), so_du13 = a.so_du13 - isnull(b.tien, 0), so_du_nt13 = a.so_du_nt13 - isnull(b.tien_nt, 0)' + 
			' from #cdntxt a join #tReturn b on a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_pn and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' + 
			' where a.ngay_ct < ''' + @d1 + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		-- Location and Lot Control
		IF @location = 0 AND @lot = 0 BEGIN
			UPDATE #ps70 SET ma_vi_tri = '', ma_lo = ''
			UPDATE #cdntxt SET ma_vi_tri = '', ma_lo = ''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @location = 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #ps70 SET ma_vi_tri = ''
				UPDATE #cdntxt SET ma_vi_tri = ''
			END
			IF @lot = 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #ps70 SET ma_lo = ''
				UPDATE #cdntxt SET ma_lo = ''
			END
		END				

	END
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCOCheckWithoutIssuingMaterialOfBOM]
	@period NUMERIC(2),
	@year NUMERIC(4),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @date SMALLDATETIME, @unitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @factorTypes NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @date = RTRIM(@year) + REPLACE(STR(@period, 2), ' ', '0') + '01'
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	SELECT @factorTypes = REPLACE(val, '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dslytcp'

	CREATE TABLE #result (ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), so_lsx VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32))

	SELECT @key2 = 'nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@period)
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@unit), '''', ''''''), @userID, @admin)
		IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key2 = @key2 + ' and ' + @unitKey
	END
	SELECT @key = 'sl_sx > 0 and ' + @key2
	IF @factorTypes <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and loai_yt in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@factorTypes, ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx INTO #xcdloaiytdd2 FROM xcdloaiytdd2
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt INTO #xcppstk FROM xcppstk

	SELECt @q = '
insert into #xcdloaiytdd2 select ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx
	from xcdloaiytdd2
		where ' + @key + '
		group by ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECt @q = '
insert into #xcppstk select ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt
	from xcppstk
		where ' + @key2 + '
		group by ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #result SELECT c.ma_dvcs, c.ma_sp, c.ma_bp, so_lsx, a.ma_vt FROM ctdm a
			JOIN phdm b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			JOIN #xcdloaiytdd2 c ON b.ma_sp = c.ma_sp AND (b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp OR b.ma_bp = '')
		WHERE ((@date >= a.ngay_ct1 AND (a.ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR @date <= a.ngay_ct2)) OR a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL AND a.ngay_ct2 IS NULL)

	--
	DELETE #result FROM #result a JOIN #xcppstk b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	DELETE #result FROM #result a JOIN #xcppstk b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE b.ma_sp = ''
	DELETE #result FROM #result a JOIN #xcppstk b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE b.ma_sp = '' AND b.ma_bp = '' AND b.so_lsx = ''

	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2
		FROM #result a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter](@PurField VARCHAR(64), @Pur VARCHAR(1023), @UserID INT, @Admin BIT)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @PurKey VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @PurKey = NULL

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN @PurKey

	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Pur = '' BEGIN
			IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmbp0) = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1) BEGIN
				SET @PurKey = ''
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @PurKey = ISNULL(@PurKey, '') + CASE WHEN @PurKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_bp0) + '''' FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @PurKey = ISNULL(@PurKey, '') + CASE WHEN @PurKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_bp0) + '''' FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_bp0, @Pur) = 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Pur <> '' SELECT @PurKey = ISNULL(@PurKey, '') + CASE WHEN @PurKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_bp) + '''' FROM bidmbp0 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_bp, @Pur) = 1
	END

	IF @PurKey IS NOT NULL AND @PurKey <> '' SET @PurKey = '(' + @PurField + ' in (' + @PurKey + '))'
	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @PurKey IS NULL SET @PurKey = '(1 = 0)'
		IF @PurKey = '' SET @PurKey = NULL
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @PurKey IS NULL AND @Pur <> '' SET @PurKey = '(1 = 0)'
	END

	RETURN @PurKey
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintEmployeeProductQuantityInput] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cE = CASE @cLan WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END 

	SET @strSQL =  'select b.ma_nv as ma_nv, rtrim(b.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(b.ten_nv) as ten_nv, c.ten_sp' + @cE + ' as ten_sp, a.so_luong, d.ten_bp' + @cE + ' as ten_bp, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @cDTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec left join hrdmsp c on a.ma_sp = c.ma_sp left join hrbp d on a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 7, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten_nv, ten_sp'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByNorm]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @r NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p AS CHAR(6), @qth NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @t VARCHAR(32), @j VARCHAR(1023), @c VARCHAR(32), @v VARCHAR(32), @s CHAR(1), @type INT, @g NVARCHAR(1024), @f NVARCHAR(2048)
	DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(1024), @k1 NVARCHAR(1024), @k2 NVARCHAR(1024), @k3 NVARCHAR(1024), @k4 NVARCHAR(1024), @k5 NVARCHAR(1024), @k6 NVARCHAR(1024)

	-- Init
	SELECT @p = REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0'), @qth = ''

	SELECT ma_loai_lg, RTRIM(cong_thuc) AS cach_tinh INTO #loailuong FROM #hrloailuong WHERE status = '1' AND kieu = '3'
	SELECT ma_ct, kind, nguon, type, ds_bp, ds_loai_luong, ds_sp, ds_pc, ds_cong, ds_tp, ds_tn_gt, cach_tinh, ids, status
		INTO #chitieu FROM hrdmctluong WITH(NOLOCK)

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu a JOIN #loailuong b ON CHARINDEX('[' + RTRIM(a.ma_ct) + ']', b.cach_tinh) > 0 WHERE b.cach_tinh <> '')
		RETURN

	CREATE INDEX ma_ct ON #chitieu(ma_ct)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#loailuong', @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#chitieu', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_sp, so_luong, tien INTO #luongsp FROM hrluongsp$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien INTO #luongpc FROM hrluongpc$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien INTO #luongtc FROM hrluongtc$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, loai, ma_tngt, tien INTO #luongtngt FROM hrluongtngt$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp INTO #luongct FROM #hrstt_rec

	-- Data Sources
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu WHERE nguon = '2') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #luongsp select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.ma_sp, sum(b.so_luong), sum(b.tien_nt) from #hrstt_rec a join hrluongsp$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec group by b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.ma_sp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu WHERE nguon = '3') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #luongpc select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.ma_pc, b.tien_nt from #hrstt_rec a join hrluongpc$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu WHERE nguon = '4') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #luongtc select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.ma_cong, b.so_gio, b.so_ngay, b.tien_nt from #hrstt_rec a join hrluongtc$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu WHERE nguon = '5' OR nguon = '6') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #luongtngt select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.loai, b.ma_tngt, b.tien_nt from #hrstt_rec a join hrluongtngt$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Alter detail table
	SELECT @c = LOWER(MIN(ma_ct)) FROM #chitieu
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'alter table #luongct add [' + RTRIM(@c) + '] numeric(28, 6) default 0',
				@qth = @qth + CASE WHEN @qth <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'sum([' + RTRIM(@c) + '])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @c = LOWER(MIN(ma_ct)) FROM #chitieu WHERE ma_ct > @c
	END
	DELETE #chitieu WHERE status = '0'

	-- Calculate Norm
	SELECT @r = 'insert into #luongct(stt_rec, ma_bp, [%c]) select stt_rec, ma_bp, %v from %t %k'
	SELECT @c = LOWER(RTRIM(MIN(ma_ct))) FROM #chitieu WHERE kind = 1
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = nguon, @type = type,
				@t = CASE WHEN @s = '2' THEN '#luongsp' WHEN @s = '3' THEN '#luongpc'
						WHEN @s = '4' THEN '#luongtc' WHEN @s = '5' OR @s = '6' THEN '#luongtngt' WHEN @s = '7' THEN '#hrcongth' ELSE '' END,
				@v = CASE WHEN @s = '2' THEN CASE WHEN @type = 2 THEN 'so_luong' ELSE 'tien' END
						WHEN @s IN ('3', '5', '6') THEN 'tien'
						WHEN @s = '4' THEN CASE WHEN @type = 2 THEN 'so_ngay' ELSE 'tien' END
						WHEN @s = '7' THEN 'so_ngay'
						ELSE '' END,
				@k = CASE WHEN ds_bp <> '' THEN 'ma_bp in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_bp, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE '' END,
				@k1 = ds_loai_luong, @k2 = ds_sp, @k3 = ds_pc, @k4 = ds_cong, @k5 = ds_tp, @k6 = ds_tn_gt
			FROM #chitieu WHERE ma_ct = @c

		IF @s IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6') AND @k1 <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_loai_lg in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k1, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		END
		IF @s = '2' AND @k2 <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_sp in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k2, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		END
		IF @s = '3' AND @k3 <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_pc in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k3, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		END
		IF @s IN ('4', '7') AND @k4 <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k4, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		END
		IF @s = '5' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'loai = 2'
			IF @k5 <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @k = @k + ' and ma_tngt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k5, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			END
		END
		IF @s = '6' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'loai = 1'
			IF @k6 <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @k = @k + ' and ma_tngt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@k6, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			END
		END

		IF @t <> '' AND @v <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '%c', @c), '%t', @t), '%v', @v), '%k', CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ' where ' + @k ELSE '' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		SELECT @c = LOWER(RTRIM(MIN(ma_ct))) FROM #chitieu WHERE kind = 1 AND ma_ct > @c
	END

	-- Norm Formula
	DECLARE @i INT, @m INT

	SELECT TOP 0 *, 0 AS bpql_yn INTO #luongctth FROM #luongct
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #luongct) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #luongctth select stt_rec, ma_bp, ' + @qth + ', 0 from #luongct group by stt_rec, ma_bp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #luongctth SET bpql_yn = 1 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrstt_rec a WHERE a.stt_rec = #luongctth.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = #luongctth.ma_bp)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #chitieu WHERE kind = 2 AND cach_tinh <> '')
			INSERT INTO #luongctth(stt_rec, ma_bp, bpql_yn) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, 1 FROM #hrstt_rec
	END

	SELECT @r = 'update #luongctth set [%c] = (select top 1 %f from #luongctth a where a.stt_rec = #luongctth.stt_rec %k1 %g) %k2'
	SELECT ma_ct, cach_tinh, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #index FROM #chitieu WHERE kind = 2 AND cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	SELECT @m = COUNT(id), @i = 1 FROM #index
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		SELECT @g = '', @k1 = 'and a.ma_bp = #luongctth.ma_bp', @k2 = ''
		SELECT @c = LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(ma_ct))), @f = REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', '''''') FROM #index WHERE id = @i

		IF (CHARINDEX('SUM', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MAX', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MIN', @f) > 0)
			SELECT @g = 'group by a.stt_rec', @k1 = '', @k2 = 'where bpql_yn = 1'

		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '%c', @c), '%f', @f), '%k1', @k1), '%g', @g), '%k2', @k2)
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Insert missing department in the table #hrluong
	INSERT INTO #hrluong(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, loai_luong, kieu_tinh, tg_tl, tg_bh, bpql_yn)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, b.loai_luong, b.kieu_tinh, b.tg_tl, b.tg_bh, 0
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, ma_bp FROM #luongctth) a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.bpql_yn = 1
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrluong c WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ma_bp = a.ma_bp)

	SELECT @r = 'update #hrluong set [%c] = (select top 1 %f from #luongctth a where a.stt_rec = #hrluong.stt_rec %k1 %g) %k2'
	SELECT @c = LOWER(MIN(ma_loai_lg)) FROM #loailuong
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c = LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@c))), @g = '', @q = 'alter table #hrluong add [' + @c + '] numeric(28, 6)', @k1 = 'and a.ma_bp = #hrluong.ma_bp', @k2 = ''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @f = REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', '''''') FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @c
		IF (CHARINDEX('SUM', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MAX', @f) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('MIN', @f) > 0)
			SELECT @g = 'group by a.stt_rec', @k1 = '', @k2 = 'where bpql_yn = 1'

		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '%c', @c), '%f', @f), '%k1', @k1), '%g', @g), '%k2', @k2)
		SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @c = LOWER(MIN(ma_loai_lg)) FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg > @c
	END

END


GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AccRateDeptPeriod1] --fs20_AccRateDeptPeriod1]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 	
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME, 		
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Account VARCHAR(1023) ,
	@AccountNoMinus VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF			
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	-- @UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)	
	-- Struct
	SELECT tk, ma_bp, ma_phi , (ps_no *0) AS ps, (ps_no_nt *0) AS ps_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	
	-- @Key
	SET @Key = ' status = ''1'''	
	IF @Account <> '' 
		BEGIN	
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.ff_Inlist('a.tk', @Account) + '= ''1'
		END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--@q
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select  tk , ma_bp, ma_phi, '
	SET @q = @q + ' case when ' + @Type +'= ''1'' then sum(ps_no) else sum(ps_co) end  as ps, '
	SET @q = @q + ' case when ' + @Type +' = ''1'' then sum(ps_no_nt) else sum(ps_co_nt) end  as ps_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by tk, ma_bp, ma_phi'	
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		
	-- @Key 
	SET @Key = ' status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' 
		BEGIN	
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.ff_Inlist('a.tk', @Account) + '= ''1'
		END
	IF @AccountNoMinus <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.ff_Inlist('tk_du', @AccountNoMinus) +' = ''0'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, '
	SET @q = @q + ' case when ' + @Type + ' = ''1'' then sum(- ps_co) else sum(- ps_no) end, '
	SET @q = @q + ' case when ' + @Type + ' = ''1'' then sum(- ps_co_nt) else sum(- ps_no_nt) end '
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by tk, ma_bp, ma_phi'
	SELECT tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM (ps_nt) AS ps_nt INTO #Report FROM #tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_bp, ma_phi
	
	SELECT 0 AS ky,CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS  ten_ky, * FROM #Report ORDER BY ma_bp, ma_phi, tk
	
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRunGetMaterialsFromBOMByProduct] @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cTable VARCHAR(32) = '', @dOutput SMALLDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nMax INT, @i INT, @nQRound INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @nMax = 10, @i = 0, @nQRound = 8

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_vt AS ma_sp, so_luong, he_so, ngay_ct1 AS ngay_yc INTO #phdm FROM ctdm
	
	IF @cTable <> '' SET @q = 'insert into #phdm select a.stt_rec, a.ma_sp, isnull(b.so_luong, 1), a.he_so, b.ngay_yc from phdm a left join ' + @cTable + ' b on a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp'
	ELSE SET @q = 'insert into #phdm select a.stt_rec, a.ma_sp, 1, a.he_so, null from phdm a'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, tl_hh, tg_th INTO #ctdm FROM ctdm WHERE (ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR ngay_ct1 <= @dVC) AND (ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR ngay_ct2 >= @dVC) AND so_luong <> 0

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(24, 12)) AS so_luong, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_yc, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_yc0, 0 AS xmaster, 0 AS xdetail INTO #ctsx FROM ctsx
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc0, 0 AS stt INTO #t FROM #ctsx

	INSERT INTO #ctsx(ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc0, xmaster, xdetail) SELECT ma_sp, ma_sp, 1, SUM(so_luong), ngay_yc, ngay_yc, 0, 0 FROM #phdm GROUP BY ma_sp, ngay_yc

	WHILE (@i < @nMax) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT a.ma_sp, c.ma_vt, b.he_so, ROUND(CASE WHEN b.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (a.so_luong / b.he_so) END *c.he_so*c.so_luong*(1 + c.tl_hh), @nQRound), dbo.mf_GetNetBackwardDate(a.ngay_yc, c.tg_th + 1), a.ngay_yc0, a.stt
			FROM #ctsx a JOIN #phdm b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_sp JOIN #ctdm c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE a.xmaster = 0 AND a.ma_vt <> c.ma_vt

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

		UPDATE #ctsx SET xmaster = 1 FROM #ctsx a JOIN #t b ON a.stt = b.stt WHERE a.xmaster = 0
		INSERT INTO #ctsx (ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc0, xmaster, xdetail) SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, he_so, so_luong, ngay_yc, ngay_yc0, 0, stt FROM #t

		-- Next
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	DELETE #ctsx WHERE xmaster = 1 OR xdetail = 0 OR ngay_yc IS NULL

	IF @dOutput IS NULL
		SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, MAX(so_luong) AS so_luong, ngay_yc, MAX(ngay_yc0) AS ngay_yc0 FROM #ctsx WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE kieu_hd <> 0) GROUP BY ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_yc ORDER BY ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_yc
	ELSE 
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ctsx) SELECT TOP 1 @dOutput = ngay_yc FROM #ctsx ORDER BY ngay_yc
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBankingAccountBalance]
	@Bank VARCHAR(32),
	@AccountNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @AccountNumber = REPLACE(REPLACE(@AccountNumber, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
	SELECT * INTO #stk FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@AccountNumber, ',')

	SELECT a.ma_nh_dt, a.so_tk_nh, a.so_du_kd, a.so_du_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ngay_sd, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_nh ELSE c.ten_nh2 END AS ten_nh
		FROM dmknnh a WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN dmtknhnsd b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn AND b.user_id = @UserID
			JOIN dmnhdt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh_dt = c.ma_nh_dt
		WHERE a.ma_nh_dt = @Bank AND (@AccountNumber = '' OR a.so_tk_nh IN (SELECT data FROM #stk))


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintHDTran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	
	-- loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'select a.line_nbr, b.ky_hieu, b.so_seri, dbo.ff_CoverBookCode(b.so_ct1, a.tu_so) as tu_so, dbo.ff_CoverBookCode(b.so_ct1, a.den_so) as den_so, a.so_luong, a.lien_hd'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', b.ten_hd' + @cE + ' as ten_hd' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', b.ten_hd2 as ten_hd2' ELSE '' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', c.ten_loai' + @cE + ' as ghi_chu' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', b.ten_loai2 as ghi_chu2' ELSE '' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report ' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join v20dmhd b on a.ma_nk = b.ma_nk'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join dmhonghd c on a.ma_loai = c.ma_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 11, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ten_hd' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', ten_hd2''' ELSE '''' END + ','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBISLTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_kh, a.vung_cu, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.ghi_chu, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_kh' + @cE + ' AS ten_kh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', h.ten_vung' + @cE + ' AS ten_vung'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dmkh g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = g.ma_kh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bidmvung h WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.vung_cu = h.ma_vung'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_vung'',''ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCProductionDetailStatus] --fs_SFCProduction
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@MO VARCHAR(32),
	@WO VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Total = CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt AS ma_sp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_bd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_kt
		, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_lsx AS ma_cd, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_lsx
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th
		, a.status, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS tinh_trang, loai_ct
		INTO #report FROM ms2$000000 a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and b.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@WO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 0, b.stt_rec, max(b.ngay_ct), min(a.ngay_bd), max(a.ngay_kt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.so_lsx), b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx, max(b.ma_lo_trinh), max(a.ma_cd)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.ten_lsx' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.sl_yc), null, max(b.status), max(c.statusname' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), max(b.loai_ct)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmttct c with(nolock) on b.status = c.status and c.ma_ct = ''SF2'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by b.stt_rec, b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #report b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp, SUM(a.sl_th) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx a GROUP BY a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp
	--
	UPDATE #report SET sl_th = b.sl_th FROM #report a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp WHERE a.sl_th IS NULL

	-- View
	SELECT tag, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ten_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, status, tinh_trang
		FROM #report a ORDER BY so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyDTTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @voucherType VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m57$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d57$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112), @voucherType = loai_ct FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số chứng từ', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Khách hàng', N'Customer', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lý do thanh toán', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	SELECT * INTO #tempInfo FROM #bodyInfo

	INSERT INTO #tempInfo SELECT 'so_hd', 100, '', '', N'Số hóa đơn', N'Invoice No.', 'so_hd', 'so_hd2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_hd', 100, '', '', N'Ngày hóa đơn', N'Invoice Date', 'ngay_hd', 'ngay_hd', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tk', 100, '', '', N'TK có', N'Credit Account', 'tk', 'tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_tk', 300, '', '', N'Tên tài khoản', N'Account Description', 'ten_tk', 'ten_tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dien_giai', 300, '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Description', 'dien_giai', 'dien_giai', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien_hd_nt', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền trên hóa đơn', N'Invoice Amount', 'tien_hd_nt', 'tien_hd_nt', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_nt', 100, '', '', N'Ngoại tệ', N'Currency', 'ma_nt', 'ma_nt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_co) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk, CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_co) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk2,
			b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2,
			RTRIM(a.dien_giai) AS dien_giai,
			CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd, CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), d.ngay_ct, 103) AS ngay_hd,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(CASE WHEN d.ma_nt = '' THEN d.t_tt ELSE d.t_tt_nt END, @amountFormat) AS tien_hd_nt, CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.ma_nt, '') = '' THEN @ma_nt0 ELSE d.ma_nt END AS ma_nt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt, @amountFormat) AS tien
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a
			LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_co = b.tk
			LEFT JOIN cttt20 d ON a.stt_rec_tt = d.stt_rec

	IF @voucherType = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
