				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('ten_tk')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
	END

	IF @voucherType = ('2') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
	END


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tien_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tien_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00625', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00625', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', khách hàng: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Customer: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Đề nghị thu tiền chờ duyệt'', N''Customer payment request waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Đề nghị thu tiền chờ duyệt'', N''Customer payment request waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt đề nghị thu tiền'', N''Customer payment request approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt đề nghị thu tiền'', N''Customer payment request approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ConvertItems2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Stock TINYINT = 0 -- 1 Stock Balance
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Split BIT, @DateNext1 SMALLDATETIME, @DateNext2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @DateNext1 = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @DateNext2 = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @UnitKey = '', @Join = '', @q = '', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Split = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @Split = 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, ngay_ct AS ngay_nhap, ngay_ct AS ngay_xuat INTO #ct70 FROM r70$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ct70x FROM #ct70
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho as ma$kho INTO #kho FROM dmkho

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @UnitKey = ''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #kho select ma_kho from dmkho where ' + @UnitKey
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			CREATE INDEX i ON #kho(ma$kho)
			SET @Join = ' join #kho k on z.ma_kho = k.ma$kho'
		END
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @UserID = 1, @Admin = 1
	END

	--
	SELECT @q = ''
	IF @Stock = 0
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct70 select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x), max(case when nxt = 1 then ngay_ct else null end), max(case when nxt = 2 then ngay_ct else null end) from r70$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	IF (@Stock = 0 AND @Split = 0) BEGIN
		-- Physics key
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, 0, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @k = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ct70x select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x), max(case when nxt = 1 then ngay_ct else null end), max(case when nxt = 2 then ngay_ct else null end) from r70$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + REPLACE(@k, '%a.', '') + ' and ' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	END
	IF @Stock = 1 OR @Split = 0
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ct70x select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x), max(case when nxt = 1 then ngay_ct else null end), max(case when nxt = 2 then ngay_ct else null end) from r90$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Adjustment
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_ct, line_nbr INTO #adj FROM indcsd a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_ct INTO #adj2 FROM #adj

	-- Get data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #adj select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_ct, line_nbr from indcsd a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey = '' THEN '' ELSE @UnitKey + ' and ' END + ' a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext2, 112) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Stock = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'delete cdvt from cdvt z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdvt(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from cdvt z with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70 group by ma_kho, ma_vt)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj group by ma_kho, ma_vt)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdvt from cdvt z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		SELECT @q = 'delete cdvitri from cdvitri z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdvitri(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from cdvitri z with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdvitri from cdvitri z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		SELECT @q = 'delete cdlo from cdlo z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdlo(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from cdlo z with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdlo from cdlo z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		SELECT @q = 'delete cdntxt from cdntxt z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdntxt('
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'nam, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, ngay, ma_ct, stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, ma_nt, tien, tien_nt, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho01, so_du01, so_du_nt01, ton_kho02, so_du02, so_du_nt02, ton_kho03, so_du03, so_du_nt03, ton_kho04, so_du04, so_du_nt04,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho05, so_du05, so_du_nt05, ton_kho06, so_du06, so_du_nt06, ton_kho07, so_du07, so_du_nt07, ton_kho08, so_du08, so_du_nt08,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho09, so_du09, so_du_nt09, ton_kho10, so_du10, so_du_nt10, ton_kho11, so_du11, so_du_nt11, ton_kho12, so_du12, so_du_nt12,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13,  datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status, line_nbr)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, ngay, '''', stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton_kho13, ma_nt, so_du13, so_du_nt13, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13,'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13, ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'', line_nbr'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdntxt z with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + @Join
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and (abs(ton_kho13) + abs(so_du13) + abs(so_du_nt13) > 0)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho01 = ton_kho01 + b.so_luong, so_du01 = so_du01 + b.tien, so_du_nt01 = so_du_nt01 + b.tien_nt, so_luong = a.so_luong + b.so_luong, tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt
			FROM cdntxt a WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) JOIN (
				SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, stt_rec_pn, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
					FROM #adj
						WHERE stt_rec_pn <> ''
						GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, stt_rec_pn
			) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_pn
		WHERE a.nam = (@nYear + 1)

		SELECT @q = '
		insert into cdntxt(nam, stt_rec_nt, stt_rec0, pn_co_gia, ngay, ma_ct, stt_ctntxt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, ma_nt, tien, tien_nt, tien_cp, tien_cp_nt,ton_kho01, so_du01, so_du_nt01,ton_kho02, so_du02, so_du_nt02, ton_kho03, so_du03, so_du_nt03, ton_kho04, so_du04, so_du_nt04,ton_kho05, so_du05, so_du_nt05, ton_kho06, so_du06, so_du_nt06, ton_kho07, so_du07, so_du_nt07, ton_kho08,so_du08, so_du_nt08,ton_kho09, so_du09, so_du_nt09, ton_kho10, so_du10, so_du_nt10, ton_kho11, so_du11, so_du_nt11, ton_kho12, so_du12, so_du_nt12,ton_kho13, so_du13, so_du_nt13,  datetime0, datetime2,user_id0, user_id2, status, line_nbr)
			select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', stt_rec, stt_rec0, 1, 0, '''', 0, ngay_ct, so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, so_luong, '''', tien, tien_nt, 0, 0,
				so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt,
				so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt,
				so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt,
				so_luong, tien, tien_nt, ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'', a.line_nbr
			from #adj a join dmvt y on a.ma_vt = y.ma_vt where y.gia_ton = 3 and a.stt_rec_pn = '''' and not exists(select 1 from cdntxt b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_nt and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ') and a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext2, 112) + '''
		'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

	END

	IF @Stock = 1 OR @Split = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #adj2 select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, so_ct from indcsd2 a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey = '' THEN '' ELSE @UnitKey + ' and ' END + ' a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateNext2, 112) + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		EXEC fs20_ConvertItems2NextYear2 @nYear, @Join, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Vat tu cham luan chuyen
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_VT_CLC' AND val = '1') EXEC rs_ConvertSlowItems2NextYear @nYear, @Stock

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountLedger] --fs30_AcctLedger15--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai, tk_du
			, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr
		INTO #dt FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'status = ''1'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #dt select stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai, tk_du'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai
			, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	IF @Type = '0' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_vv, dien_giai
					, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr
				FROM #dt
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report 
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, MAX(ma_ct), MAX(ngay_ct), MAX(ngay_lct), MAX(so_ct), MAX(so_ct0), ma_kh, MAX(ma_vv), MAX(dien_giai)
					, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), MAX(ma_nt), MAX(ty_gia), MIN(line_nbr)
				FROM #dt GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_du, ma_kh
	END

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'

	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t
		
	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES (3, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SELECT a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
			, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report a 
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
			LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
		ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, a.so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostIT2Receipt]
	@VCCode CHAR(3),
	@cMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIPInquiryTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cStatus CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @strInsert NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cRCIDNumber CHAR(13), @RCVCCode CHAR(3), @cSiteN VARCHAR(33), @cSiteX VARCHAR(33), @dIssue SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @vTypeIssue CHAR(2), @vTypeReceipt CHAR(2), @vTransReceipt CHAR(2)

	SELECT @RCVCCode = 'PNF'
	SELECT @cRCIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, @VCCode, @RCVCCode)

	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m85$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d85$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ipmaster FROM m75$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #ipdetail FROM d75$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strInsert =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ipmaster', '#master', @cMasterTable, @cIPMasterTable, '1=1')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strInsert

	SELECT @strInsert =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ipdetail', '#detail', @cDetailTable, @cIPDetailTable, '1=1')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strInsert

	SELECT @cSiteN = ma_khon, @cSiteX = ma_kho, @dIssue = ngay_ct, @vTypeIssue = loai_ct FROM #master
	SELECT @vTypeReceipt = CASE @vTypeIssue WHEN '9' THEN '9' ELSE '2' END, @vTransReceipt = CASE @vTypeIssue WHEN '9' THEN '9' ELSE '2' END
	UPDATE #ipmaster SET status = @cStatus, ma_ct = @RCVCCode, ma_kho = @cSiteN, ma_khox = @cSiteX, ngay_px = @dIssue, stt_rec = @cRCIDNumber, loai_ct = @vTypeReceipt, ma_gd = @vTransReceipt

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET ma_vi_tri = a.ma_vi_trin, ma_ct = @RCVCCode, tk_du = a.tk_du, tk_vt = a.tk_vt
			, pn_gia_tb = CASE WHEN (c.gia_ton = 1 OR c.gia_ton = 4) AND a.px_gia_dd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, stt_rec_px = '', stt_rec0px = ''
		FROM #ipdetail JOIN #detail a ON #ipdetail.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND #ipdetail.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 JOIN dmvt c ON #ipdetail.ma_vt = c.ma_vt

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET stt_rec = @cRCIDNumber, so_luong0 = so_luong
	--UPDATE #ipdetail SET ma_nx = b.ma_nx FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmnx b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET tk_vt = b.tk_dl
		FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #ipmaster c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE c.ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE dai_ly_yn = 1) AND b.tk_dl IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 1)

	UPDATE #ipdetail SET tk_vt = b.tk_vt
		FROM #ipdetail a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #ipmaster c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE c.ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE dai_ly_yn = 0) AND b.tk_vt IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 1)

	SELECT @strSQL = 'delete ' + @cIPDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @cIPMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'delete c75$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into ' + @cIPMasterTable + ' select * from #ipmaster'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @cIPDetailTable + ' select * from #ipdetail'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into c75$000000 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0) select ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''', ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0 from #ipmaster'

	--  Right
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' select ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.status, a.user_id0,'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'convert(varchar(12), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec,'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + '''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_kho) + ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.ma_khox) + ''#30$'' + rtrim(a.ma_gd) + ''#40$'' + rtrim(a.ma_nt), '''','
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + '''#00#%$'' + rtrim(b.id) + ''$%'''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'from #ipmaster a left join dmkho b with(nolock) on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho'
	-- End

	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'declare @v10 varchar(8000), @v20 varchar(8000), @v30 varchar(8000), @count int, @i int'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @count = count(*) from #ipdetail'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @i = 1'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'while @count >= @i begin'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v10 = '''', @v20 = '''', @v30 = '''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v10 = @v10 + ''#10$'' + rtrim(a.ma_vt) from (select distinct ma_vt from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v20 = @v20 + ''#20$'' + rtrim(a.tk_vt) from (select distinct tk_vt from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @v30 = @v30 + ''#30$'' + rtrim(a.ma_nx) from (select distinct ma_nx from #ipdetail where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''') a'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @cIPInquiryTable + ' set d$ = isnull(@v10, '''') + isnull(@v20, '''') + isnull(@v30, '''') where stt_rec = ''' + @cRCIDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select @i = @i + 1'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry](@master VARCHAR(32), @detail VARCHAR(32), @column VARCHAR(32), @fields VARCHAR(256), @sign VARCHAR(256), @id VARCHAR(32), @set VARCHAR(512) = '', @join VARCHAR(512) = '', @voucher VARCHAR(3) = '', @extension VARCHAR(32) = '', @right INT = 0)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @i1 INT, @j1 INT, @i2 INT, @j2 INT, @count INT, @v VARCHAR(32), @field VARCHAR(64), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @w VARCHAR(3), @table VARCHAR(32), @o VARCHAR(32), @data VARCHAR(512), @list VARCHAR(512), @alias VARCHAR(2), @b BIT, @r BIT, @t VARCHAR(32), @e VARCHAR(32), @f VARCHAR(64), @c BIT, @y BIT, @k VARCHAR(32), @biMode BIT
	-- Set
	SELECT @w = CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), @q = 'declare @id$ varchar(32),@s$ varchar(8000)', @sign = @sign + ',', @fields = @fields + ',', @i1 = 0, @j1 = CHARINDEX(',', @sign), @i2 = 0, @j2 = CHARINDEX(',', @fields), @count = 0, @data = '', @list = '', @t = '', @b = 1, @r = 0, @e = '', @c = 1, @k = '', @y = 0
	SELECT @biMode = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	--
	WHILE @j1 > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @v = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@sign, @i1, @j1 - @i1)), @field = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@fields, @i2, @j2 - @i2)), @count = @count + 1, 
			@i1 = @j1 + 1, @j1 = CHARINDEX(',', @sign, @j1 + 2), 
			@i2 = @j2 + 1, @j2 = CHARINDEX(',', @fields, @j2 + 2), 
			@table = '@c$' + RTRIM(@count), 
			@o = '@a$' + RTRIM(@count), 
			@alias = CHAR(97 + @count),
			@data = @data + CASE WHEN @count = 1 THEN '' ELSE '+' END + @alias + '.s', 
			@list = @list + ' join ' + @o + ' ' + @alias + ' on a.' + @id + '=' + @alias + '.id'
		
		Q:
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'declare ' + @table + ' table(id varchar(32),c varchar(32),s varchar(8000),unique clustered(id,c))'
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'declare ' + @o + ' table(id varchar(32),s varchar(8000),unique clustered(id))'
		
		SELECT @f = CASE WHEN @t = '' AND @k = '' THEN @id + ',' + @field ELSE 'a.' + @id + ',b.id' END
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'insert into ' + @table + '(id,c) select distinct ' + @f + ' from ' + @detail + CASE WHEN @t = '' THEN '' ELSE ' a join dmkho b on a.' + @field + '=b.ma_kho' END + CASE WHEN @k = '' THEN '' ELSE ' a join bidmvung b on a.' + @field + '=b.ma_vung' END + ' order by ' + @f

		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'update ' + @table + ' set c=''' + @v + '''+rtrim(c)'
		IF @t <> '' SELECT @q = @q + '+''' + @t + '''', @t = ''
		IF @k <> '' SELECT @q = @q + '+''' + @k + '''', @k = ''
		
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'set @id$=null'
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'update ' + @table + ' set @s$=s=coalesce(case when id<>coalesce(@id$,'''') then ''''+c else @s$+c end,''''),@id$=id'
		SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'insert into ' + @o + ' select id,max(s) as s from ' + @table + ' group by id'
		IF @right = @count AND (@b = 1 OR @c = 1) BEGIN
			IF @b = 1 BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct where ma_ct = @voucher AND xin_site_rights = 1) BEGIN
					SELECT @r = 1, @b = 0, @table = '@r$', @o = '@o$', @v = '$', @t = '$%', @k = '', @field = 'ma_kho'
					GOTO Q
				END ELSE SELECT @e = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('e$', @extension) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('e$', @e) = 0 THEN 'e$ ='''',' ELSE '' END
			END
			IF @c = 1 AND @biMode = 1 BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct where ma_ct = @voucher AND x_plant = 2) BEGIN
					SELECT @y = 1, @c = 0, @table = '@r2$', @o = '@o2$', @v = '$', @t = '', @k = '$%', @field = 'ma_vung'
					GOTO Q
				END ELSE SELECT @e = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('f$', @extension) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('f$', @e) = 0 THEN 'f$ ='''',' ELSE '' END
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @q = @q + @w + 'update ' + @master + ' set ' + @e + @set + @column + '=' + @data + CASE WHEN @r = 1 AND CHARINDEX('e$', @extension) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('e$', @e) = 0 THEN ',e$=''#00#%''+z.s' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @y = 1 AND @biMode = 1 AND CHARINDEX('f$', @extension) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('f$', @e) = 0 THEN ',f$=''#00#%''+y.s' ELSE '' END + ' from ' + @master + ' a' + @join + @list
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @r = 1 THEN ' join @o$ z on a.' + @id + '=z.id' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @y = 1 AND @biMode = 1 THEN ' join @o2$ y on a.' + @id + '=y.id' ELSE '' END
	
	RETURN @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintDepartmentProductQuantityInput] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cE = CASE @cLan WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END 

	SET @strSQL =  'select a.ma_bp, b.ten_bp' + @cE + ' as ten_bp, c.ten_sp' + @cE + ' as ten_sp, a.so_luong, a.dien_giai, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @cDTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp left join hrdmsp c on a.ma_sp = c.ma_sp'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 7, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_bp, ten_bp, ten_sp, dien_giai'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByOtherFactor]
	@Period INT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Round TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN

/*
	Tính thưởng, phạt, thu nhập, giảm trừ khác và tạm ứng
	Thưởng: P30
	Phạt: P40
	Thu nhập: P50
	Giảm trừ P60
	Tạm ứng: U00
*/

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(512), @d SMALLDATETIME, @p VARCHAR(6)

	-- Thưởng phạt
	SELECT a.stt_rec, SUM(CASE WHEN c.loai = 1 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END) AS p30, SUM(CASE WHEN c.loai = 2 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END) AS p40, 
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt, a.loai AS ma_tngt, 2 AS loai, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS p30_tg, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS p40_tg
		INTO #hr30_t0 FROM hrcttp a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN hrdmloaitp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.loai = c.ma_loai
		WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ky_ngay_tu AND b.ky_ngay_den
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.loai, c.loai

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hr30_t0(stt_rec)

	-- Thu nhập, giảm trừ khác
	SELECT a.stt_rec, SUM(CASE WHEN c.loai = 1 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END) AS p50, SUM(CASE WHEN c.loai = 2 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END) AS p60, 
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt, a.loai AS ma_tngt, 1 AS loai, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS p50_tg, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS p60_tg
		INTO #hr30_t1 FROM hrcttngt a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN hrdmtngt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.loai = c.ma_loai
		WHERE a.ngay BETWEEN b.ky_ngay_tu AND b.ky_ngay_den
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.loai, c.loai

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hr30_t1(stt_rec)


	-- Tạm ứng
	CREATE TABLE #hr30_t2(stt_rec CHAR(13), tien NUMERIC(28, 6))
	SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c = 'd05$' + @p
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #hr30_t2 select a.stt_rec_nv, sum(a. tien)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @c + ' a with(nolock) join #hrstt_rec b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec and convert(char(6), b.ky_ngay_tu, 112) <= ''' + @p + ''' and convert(char(6), b.ky_ngay_den, 112) >= ''' + @p + ''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_ct between b.ky_ngay_tu and b.ky_ngay_den group by a.stt_rec_nv'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @p
	END

	SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien) AS u00, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS u00_tg INTO #hr30_t3 FROM #hr30_t2 GROUP BY stt_rec
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hr30_t3(stt_rec)

	-- Cập nhật vào bảng thu nhập, giảm trừ, tạm ứng
	UPDATE #hr30_t0 SET ma_bp = c.ma_bp, ma_nt = c.ma_nt, p30_tg = ROUND(a.p30 * ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0), @Round), p40_tg = ROUND(a.p40 * ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0), @Round) FROM #hr30_t0 a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
	UPDATE #hr30_t1 SET ma_bp = c.ma_bp, ma_nt = c.ma_nt, p50_tg = ROUND(a.p50 * ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0), @Round), p60_tg = ROUND(a.p60 * ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0), @Round) FROM #hr30_t1 a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
	UPDATE #hr30_t3 SET ma_bp = c.ma_bp, ma_nt = c.ma_nt, u00_tg = ROUND(a.u00 * ISNULL(b.ty_gia, 0), @Round) FROM #hr30_t3 a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
	
	SET @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + '(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_tngt, loai, tien, tien_nt)'
	SET @q = 'insert into hrluongtngt$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ''P30'', ma_tngt, loai, p30_tg, p30 from #hr30_t0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtngt$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ''P40'', ma_tngt, loai, p40_tg, p40 from #hr30_t0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtngt$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ''P50'', ma_tngt, loai, p50_tg, p50 from #hr30_t1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtngt$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ''P60'', ma_tngt, loai, p60_tg, p60 from #hr30_t1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtngt$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ''U00'', '''', 3, u00_tg, u00 from #hr30_t3'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cập nhật vào bảng lương
	UPDATE #hrluong SET p30 = b.p30, p40 = b.p40 FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(p30) AS p30, SUM(p40) AS p40 FROM #hr30_t0 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
	UPDATE #hrluong SET p50 = b.p50, p60 = b.p60 FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(p50) AS p50, SUM(p60) AS p60 FROM #hr30_t1 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
	UPDATE #hrluong SET u00 = b.u00 FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hr30_t3 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalMailList]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@partition VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherType CHAR(32),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@lastUser INT = 0,
	@isChange BIT = 0,
	@createdUser INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(32), @Amount NUMERIC(28, 6), @CurStatus VARCHAR(32), @p INT, @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @mailUser INT, @datetime2 DATETIME, @unit VARCHAR(32), @Category VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @d SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #m(id int IDENTITY(1,1), stt_rec CHAR(13), user_id INT, type INT, parallel_yn BIT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32), deny_mail_yn BIT)
	CREATE TABLE #tmp(u_status VARCHAR(32), datetime2 DATETIME, ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #ds(user_id INT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #parallel(user_id INT NULL)

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)
	SELECT @masterTable = m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @hisTable = a$ FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ds select user_id4 from ' + @hisTable + ' where xtype in (''1'', ''2'') and reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having sum(cast(xtype as int)) % 3 <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select u_status, datetime2, ma_dvcs, kieu_duyet from ' + QUOTENAME(@masterTable) + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @CurStatus = u_status, @datetime2 = datetime2, @unit = ma_dvcs, @Category = kieu_duyet FROM #tmp


	-- Unit rights
	SELECT id INTO #user FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE status = 1 AND (admin = 1 OR (admin = 0 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sysunitrights WHERE ma_dvcs = @unit AND r_edit = 1)))

	--Device
	INSERT INTO #m SELECT @idNumber, a.user_id, '2', c.parallel_yn, c.kieu_duyet, c.deny_mail_yn FROM (SELECT * FROM dmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN dmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN dmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
		WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND a.status = 1 AND b.status = 1
			AND c.status = @CurStatus
			AND a.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #ds)
			AND a.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM #user)
			AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE ma_phan_he = 'SM' AND name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @voucherCode CHAR(3)
		SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType
		SET @q = 'exec ds_CreateVoucherPending @voucherCode, @idNumber, ''#m'', ''user_id'', @sysDatabaseName'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @voucherCode, @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName
	END

	-- Approval mail (with link)
	DELETE #m WHERE deny_mail_yn = 1


	-- Notification mail (without link)
	IF @lastUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @lastUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @lastUser, '1'
	END

	-- Mail Created User (without link)
	IF @createdUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @createdUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @createdUser, '1'
	END

	-- Mail Approved User When Change status (without link)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kbmailduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND status = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type)
			SELECT @idNumber, b.user_id4, '1'
				FROM #ds a
				JOIN (SELECT user_id4 FROM kbmailduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND status = '1') b ON a.user_id = b.user_id4
					WHERE b.user_id4 NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #m)
	END

	--
	IF @isChange = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #parallel SELECT a.user_id FROM #m a JOIN dmxn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE a.parallel_yn = 1
		DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END


	-- Delete valid mail/sms
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_nhan INTO #xn FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
		INSERT INTO #xn SELECT ma_huy FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)

		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from #xn)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END

	-- Delete dmxn, dbxn
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$DeleteLog @sysDatabaseName

	-- Create new mail/sms
	SELECT @p = MIN(id) FROM #m
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @mailUser = user_id FROM #m WHERE id = @p
		SELECT @c1 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6)), @c2 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6))
		INSERT INTO dmxn(stt_rec, user_id, ma_nhan, ma_huy, datetime2) SELECT @idNumber, @mailUser, @c1, @c2, @datetime2
		SET @q = 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c1 + ''', ''1'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c2 + ''', ''0'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m WHERE id > @p
	END


	-- Update datetime2 for valid old mail/sms
	UPDATE dmxn SET datetime2 = @datetime2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)


	SELECT id, stt_rec, user_id, type FROM #m


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI101] -- Doanh thu/Chi phí
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@UOM INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @month AS INT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')
	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @CreditAccount = REPLACE(@CreditAccount, '''', ''), @DebitAccount = REPLACE(@DebitAccount, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)

	-- Lay moc thoi gian loc
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -14, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '006'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '007'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '008'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '009'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '010'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '011'  
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '012' 
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '013'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '014'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, tk, ps_co, ps_no INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SET @Key = 'dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @tkdt + ''') = 0 and ('
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @DebitAccount <> '' THEN ' dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @DebitAccount + ''') = 1' ELSE '1 = 0' END
	SET @Key = @Key + ' or '
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @CreditAccount <> '' THEN ' dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @CreditAccount + ''') = 1' ELSE '1 = 0' END
	SET @Key = @Key + ')'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, tk, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no) as ps_no'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']% group by ngay_ct, tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT ngay_ct, SUM(ps_co - ps_no) AS doanh_thu 
		INTO #ct01 FROM #tmp WHERE (@CreditAccount <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @CreditAccount) = 1) GROUP BY ngay_ct

	SELECT ngay_ct, SUM(ps_no - ps_co) AS chi_phi 
		INTO #ct02 FROM #tmp WHERE (@DebitAccount <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @DebitAccount) = 1) GROUP BY ngay_ct

	SELECT ISNULL(a.ngay_ct, b.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct, ISNULL(a.doanh_thu, 0) AS doanh_thu, ISNULL(b.chi_phi, 0) AS chi_phi
		INTO #ct00 FROM #ct01 a FULL JOIN #ct02 b ON a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct

	DECLARE @ct00 AS NVARCHAR(1000), @select AS NVARCHAR(1000), @strEnd AS NVARCHAR(1000), @strBegin AS NVARCHAR(1000), @notNull AS NVARCHAR(255)
	SET @ct00 = ' select sum(doanh_thu) as doanh_thu, sum(chi_phi) as chi_phi into #ct from #ct00 '
	SET @select = ' sum(doanh_thu) as doanh_thu, sum(chi_phi) as chi_phi'
	SET @strBegin = ' select (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,'
	SET @strEnd =' group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct select thang,' + @select + ' from #ct group by thang'
	SET @notNull = ' doanh_thu, chi_phi from #ct where doanh_thu is not null and chi_phi is not null'
	SET @q = ' declare @ngay_dn as smalldatetime; declare @GetDate as smalldatetime; set @ngay_dn = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) + ''';set @GetDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) + ''''

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE @timeID
		WHEN '001' THEN @ct00 + N' select N''Hôm nay'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '002' THEN @ct00 + N' select N''Hôm trước'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '003' THEN @ct00 + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = datepart(wk, @GetDate) and year(ngay_ct) = year(@GetDate)' + N' select N''Tuần này'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '004' THEN @ct00 + ' where datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = case datepart( wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then 53 else (datepart(wk, @GetDate) - 1) end and year(ngay_ct) = case datepart( wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then (year(@GetDate) - 1) else year(@GetDate) end' + N' select N''Tuần trước'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '005' THEN @ct00 + N' select N''Tháng này'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '006' THEN @ct00 + N' select N''Tháng trước'' as tit, ' + @notNull
		WHEN '007' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '008' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '009' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '010' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '011' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '012' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00'+ @strEnd
		WHEN '013' THEN @strBegin + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00' + @strEnd
		WHEN '014' THEN ' select (datediff(month,dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn),ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00' + @strEnd
		ELSE ''
	END

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPRunInsertPlanOrderDetail] @userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nSOSize TINYINT
	SET @nSOSize = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_dh')

	DECLARE @ky INT, @ma_vt VARCHAR(32), @ngay_nhan SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dat SMALLDATETIME, @ma_kho VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @W CHAR(1), @nIDMax NUMERIC(12, 0), @nPONum INT, @cIDNumber CHAR(13)
	--
	SELECT @nPONum = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_dh_ht'
	SELECT @W = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	SELECT @cIDNumber = MAX(stt_rec) FROM mrctdh
	IF @cIDNumber IS NULL SELECT @cIDNumber = '00'
	--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ct91 WHERE stt_rec_kh > @cIDNumber AND stt_rec_kh <> '') SELECT @cIDNumber = MAX(stt_rec_kh) FROM ct91 WHERE stt_rec_kh <> ''


	SELECT @nIDMax = CAST(RIGHT(@cIDNumber, 12) AS NUMERIC(12, 0))
	IF @nIDMax IS NULL SELECT @nIDMax = 0

	--
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_kho, ky, ma_vt, SUM(nc_rong) AS nc_rong, SUM(dat_hang) AS dat_hang, SUM(dat_hang) AS kt_dh, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(so_dh), '') FROM wrkcolumns) AS so_dh, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec
		INTO #mrctdh FROM mrctdhkho GROUP BY ma_kho, ky, ma_vt, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat ORDER BY ky, ma_vt, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat 

	UPDATE #mrctdh SET stt_rec = @W + REPLACE(STR(@nIDMax + stt, 12), ' ', '0'), so_dh = STR(@nPONum + stt, @nSOSize)

	SELECT @nPONum = @nPONum + ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) FROM #mrctdh
	UPDATE options SET val = LTRIM(STR(@nPONum)) WHERE name = 'm_so_dh_ht'


	INSERT INTO mrctdh
			(
				ky, ma_vt, nc_rong, dat_hang, kt_dh, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc, so_dh, stt_rec, sl_da_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT ky, ma_vt, nc_rong, dat_hang, kt_dh, ngay_nhan, ngay_dat, 0, '', NULL, 0, so_dh, stt_rec, 0
				, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mrctdh

	INSERT INTO mrctyc
			(
				nguon, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, so_dh, stt_rec
				, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			)
		SELECT 'PL', '', '', ma_vt, ngay_nhan, dat_hang, 0, so_dh, stt_rec
				, 0, nc_rong, dat_hang, 0, ngay_dat, 0, '', NULL, 0
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM mrctdh WHERE status = '1'
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintHDCTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END

	-- loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'select a.line_nbr, c.ky_hieu, c.so_seri, dbo.ff_CoverBookCode(c.so_ct1, a.tu_so) as tu_so, dbo.ff_CoverBookCode(c.so_ct1, a.den_so) as den_so, a.so_luong'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', b.ten_loai_hd' + @cE + ' as ten_hd' + CASE WHEN @bilingual = 1 THEN ', b.ten_loai_hd2 as ten_hd2' ELSE '' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report '
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmloaihd2 b on a.loai_hd = b.loai_hd'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left outer join v20dmhd c on a.ma_nk = c.ma_nk'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ten_hd' + CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 1 THEN ', ten_hd2''' ELSE '''' END + ','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollPITInformation]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.tinh_thue_yn, a.tinh_gt_yn, a.hop_dong_yn, a.doi_tuong INTO #tttncn FROM hrtttncnct a WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN (SELECT b.stt_rec, MAX(c.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM #hrstt_rec b JOIN hrtttncnct c ON b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec WHERE c.ngay_hl <= b.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY b.stt_rec
			) d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = d.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tttncn(stt_rec)

	INSERT INTO #phns SELECT b.ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec, ISNULL(e.tinh_thue_yn, c.tinh_thue_yn) AS tinh_thue_yn, ISNULL(e.tinh_gt_yn, c.tinh_gt_yn) AS tinh_gt_yn, ISNULL(e.hop_dong_yn, c.hop_dong_yn) AS hop_dong_yn, 
			CASE WHEN a.b01 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bhxh_yn, 
			CASE WHEN a.b02 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bhyt_yn, 
			CASE WHEN a.b03 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bhtn_yn, 
			ISNULL(e.doi_tuong, c.doi_tuong) AS doi_tuong, a.ma_bp, d.ky_ngay_tu, d.ky_ngay_den, a.ma_nt
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN hrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec 
			LEFT JOIN hrtttncn c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #tttncn e ON e.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
			JOIN #hrky d ON a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1


	-- Xác định kiểu tính thuế theo Đối tượng và HĐLĐ: 1 - Lũy tiến, 2 - Toàn phần, 0/null - K xác định
	UPDATE #hrluong SET e03 = CASE WHEN b.doi_tuong = 2 OR b.hop_dong_yn = 0 THEN 2 WHEN b.hop_dong_yn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #phns b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIQATran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.stt, a.ma_kh, a.so_luong, a.ty_trong, a.sl_th, a.ghi_chu, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_kh' + @cE + ' AS ten_kh'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dmkh g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = g.ma_kh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 5, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''stt, ma_kh, ten_kh'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostS2Closed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM cs2$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'ms2$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'ds2$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'is2$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'as2$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM as2$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''5'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update cs2$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	EXEC fs_PostS2Tran @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @idNumber

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCProductionDetailStatusExport] --rs_rptSFCProductionDetailStatus
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@bug CHAR(1) = '0'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @rq TINYINT

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_bd, ngay_ct AS ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_lsx AS ma_cd, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS tinh_trang, loai_ct INTO #master FROM ms2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, ma_cd
		, ma_sp AS ma_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_vt
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_cl, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS xGroup, CAST(0 AS INT) AS line_nbr, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #detail FROM #master
	-- Key
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and b.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- s
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, @$quantity'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where %[@$key]%'

	-- master
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select b.stt_rec, max(b.ngay_ct), min(a.ngay_bd), max(a.ngay_kt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.so_lsx), b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx, max(b.ma_lo_trinh), max(a.ma_cd), max(b.sl_yc), null, max(c.statusname' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), max(b.loai_ct)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmttct c with(nolock) on b.status = c.status and c.ma_ct = ''SF2'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by b.stt_rec, b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$quantity', 'a.sl_nhap'), '@$key', 'exists(select 1 from #master b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd) and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	UPDATE #master SET sl_th = b.sl FROM #master a JOIN (SELECT ma_lsx, ma_vt, SUM(sl) AS sl FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt WHERE a.sl_th IS NULL --AND a.loai_ct = '1'

	--  Detail
	TRUNCATE TABLE #sfctpx
	--
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@$quantity', 'a.sl_xuat'), '@$key', 'exists(select 1 from #master b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx) and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 2 and a.loai = '''') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''2''))')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT ma_lsx, ma_vt, SUM(sl) AS sl INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_vt

	-- BOM
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_lo_trinh INTO #d0 FROM #detail
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #d0 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, so_luong, ma_lo_trinh)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, '''', a.so_luong, b.ma_lo_trinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #master c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	UPDATE #d0 SET ma_vt = b.ma_vt FROM #d0 a JOIN ctrt b ON a.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
	--
	SELECT DISTINCT b.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.he_so, a.so_luong, a.tl_hh, a.ngay_ct1 INTO #ctdm
		FROM ctdm a LEFT JOIN phdm b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #d0 c ON b.ma_sp = c.ma_vt
			WHERE (a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct1 <= c.ngay_ct) AND (a.ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct2 >= c.ngay_ct)
	SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, MAX(ngay_ct1) AS ngay_ct1 INTO #ctdm0 FROM #ctdm GROUP BY ma_sp, ma_vt
	DELETE #ctdm FROM #ctdm a WHERE a.ngay_ct1 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctdm0 b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct1 = b.ngay_ct1)
	DELETE #ctdm FROM #ctdm a WHERE a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctdm0 b WHERE a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct1 IS NOT NULL)

	SELECT b.stt_rec, b.ma_lsx, b.ma_cd, a.ma_vt, ROUND(a.so_luong * a.he_so * b.so_luong * (1 + a.tl_hh), @rq) AS so_luong INTO #sfctdmwo FROM #d0 b RIGHT JOIN #ctdm a ON b.ma_vt = a.ma_sp
	--
	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, MAX(a.ma_cd) AS ma_cd, a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE MAX(b.ten_vt2) END, SUM(a.so_luong)
			FROM #sfctdmwo a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.loai_vt IN ('21', '31')
				WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
					GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, '', b.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vt ELSE c.ten_vt2 END, 0
			FROM #sfctpx0 b
				JOIN cs2$000000 a ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
				JOIN dmvt c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND c.loai_vt IN ('21', '31')
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail c WHERE b.ma_lsx = c.ma_lsx AND b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt)
	--
	UPDATE #detail SET sl_tt = b.sl FROM #detail a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	UPDATE #detail SET sl_cl = (ISNULL(sl_tt, 0) - sl_yc_vt)
	UPDATE #detail SET xGroup = b.so_lsx + b.ma_sp + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_bd, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(b.ngay_kt, ''), 112) + a.stt_rec FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	--
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail SET line_nbr = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #detail a JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	--
	UPDATE #detail
			SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ngay_bd = b.ngay_bd, ngay_kt = b.ngay_kt
				, so_lsx = b.so_lsx, ma_sp = b.ma_sp, ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
				, sl_yc = b.sl_yc, sl_th = b.sl_th, tinh_trang = b.tinh_trang
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE line_nbr = 1

	--
	INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, xGroup, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ma_cd, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, line_nbr)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_lsx + a.ma_sp + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_ct, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_bd, ''), 112) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ISNULL(a.ngay_kt, ''), 112) + a.stt_rec
				, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_bd, a.ngay_kt, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lsx, '', a.sl_yc, a.sl_th, a.tinh_trang, 1
			FROM #master a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)

	-- View
	SELECT xGroup, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, sl_yc, sl_th, tinh_trang, ma_cd, ma_vt, ten_vt, sl_yc_vt, sl_tt, sl_cl, line_nbr FROM #detail ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn @Table VARCHAR(128), @Query NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(128)
	CREATE TABLE #c (c VARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #c EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$Structure @Query
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT c FROM #c FOR  READ ONLY
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @c
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQL = 'alter table ' + @Table + ' add ' + @c + ' null'
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @c
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyDCTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @voucherType VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m52$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d52$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112), @voucherType = loai_ct FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số chứng từ', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Khách hàng', N'Customer', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lý do thanh toán', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	SELECT * INTO #tempInfo FROM #bodyInfo

	INSERT INTO #tempInfo SELECT 'so_hd', 100, '', '', N'Số hóa đơn', N'Invoice No.', 'so_hd', 'so_hd2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_hd', 100, '', '', N'Ngày hóa đơn', N'Invoice Date', 'ngay_hd', 'ngay_hd', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tk', 100, '', '', N'TK nợ', N'Debit Account', 'tk', 'tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_tk', 300, '', '', N'Tên tài khoản', N'Account Description', 'ten_tk', 'ten_tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dien_giai', 300, '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Description', 'dien_giai', 'dien_giai', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien_hd_nt', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền trên hóa đơn', N'Invoice Amount', 'tien_hd_nt', 'tien_hd_nt', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_nt', 100, '', '', N'Ngoại tệ', N'Currency', 'ma_nt', 'ma_nt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk, CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk2,
			b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2,
			RTRIM(a.dien_giai) AS dien_giai,
			CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd, CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), d.ngay_ct, 103) AS ngay_hd,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(CASE WHEN d.ma_nt = '' THEN d.t_tt ELSE d.t_tt_nt END, @amountFormat) AS tien_hd_nt, CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.ma_nt, '') = '' THEN @ma_nt0 ELSE d.ma_nt END AS ma_nt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt, @amountFormat) AS tien
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a
			LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk
			LEFT JOIN cttt30 d ON a.stt_rec_tt = d.stt_rec

	IF @voucherType = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('ten_tk')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
	END

	IF @voucherType = ('2') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master

	END

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NTEXT, label2 NTEXT, val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00630', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00630', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', khách hàng: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
