			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Customer: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Đề nghị chi tiền chờ duyệt'', N''Supplier payment request waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Đề nghị chi tiền chờ duyệt'', N''Supplier payment request waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt đề nghị chi tiền'', N''Supplier payment request workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt đề nghị chi tiền'', N''Supplier payment request workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$ContractCustomer]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Contract, 2 Multi Contract
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey

	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(@Contract, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''


	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdhd a with(nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_hd)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + ' and ' + @Key
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and ' + @Key
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_hd, ma_kh order by tk, ma_hd, ma_kh'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetQuarter(@d SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	RETURN YEAR(@d)*4 + DATEPART(quarter, @d)
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountRefTForm]
	@dateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dateTo AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@creditAccount VARCHAR(1023), 
	@debitAccount VARCHAR(1023), 
	@nonDeductionAccount VARCHAR(1023), 
	@deductionAccount VARCHAR(1023), 
	@customer VARCHAR(1023), 
	@department VARCHAR(1023), 
	@expense VARCHAR(1023), 
	@unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @creditAccount = REPLACE(@creditAccount, '''', ''), @debitAccount = REPLACE(@debitAccount, '''', ''), @nonDeductionAccount = REPLACE(@nonDeductionAccount, '''', ''), @deductionAccount = REPLACE(@deductionAccount, '''', ''), 
		@customer = REPLACE(@customer, '''', ''), @department = REPLACE(@department, '''', ''), @expense = REPLACE(@expense, '''', ''), @unit = REPLACE(@unit, '''', '')


	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s32 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmtk b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_tk, ten_tk2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @creditAccount <> '' AND @debitAccount = '' BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @creditAccount)
		IF @deductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
			SELECT @s = 'delete #tmp from #tmp a where ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @deductionAccount)
			SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'delete #tmp where ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @creditAccount)
		END
		IF @nonDeductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' or ' ELSE '' END + '(ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @creditAccount)
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @nonDeductionAccount) + ')'
		END
		IF @nonDeductionAccount = '' AND @deductionAccount = '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
		SET @Key = @Key + ')' 
	END

	IF @debitAccount <> '' AND @creditAccount = '' BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @debitAccount)
		IF @deductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
			SELECT @s = 'delete #tmp from #tmp a where ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @deductionAccount)
			SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'delete #tmp where ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @debitAccount)
		END
		IF @nonDeductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' or ' ELSE '' END + '(ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @debitAccount)
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @nonDeductionAccount) + ')'
		END
		IF @nonDeductionAccount = '' AND @deductionAccount = '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
		SET @Key = @Key + ')' 
	END

	IF @debitAccount <> '' AND @creditAccount <> '' BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @creditAccount)
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @debitAccount)
		IF @deductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' or ' ELSE '' END + '(ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @debitAccount)
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @deductionAccount)
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' or ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @debitAccount) + '))'
		END

		IF @nonDeductionAccount <> '' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' or ' ELSE '' END + '('
			SELECT @Key = @Key + '((ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0 and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @creditAccount) + ')'
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0 and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @debitAccount) + '))'
			SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'notinlist', @nonDeductionAccount) + ')'
			SET @Key = @Key + ')'
		END
		IF @nonDeductionAccount = '' AND @deductionAccount = '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
		SET @Key = @Key + ')' 
	END
	
	IF @customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_kh', 'inlist', @customer)
	IF @department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_bp', 'inlist', @department)
	IF @expense <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_phi', 'inlist', @expense)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(tk))'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and (' + @Key + ')' ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[(' + @Key + ')]%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, tk_du'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1 , 1 , 0, a.tk,'', SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)
		, RTRIM(a.tk) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN LTRIM(MAX(b.ten_tk)) ELSE '' END, RTRIM(a.tk) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN LTRIM(MAX(b.ten_tk2)) ELSE '' END
	FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk GROUP BY a.tk

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5 , 1 , 1, a.tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk2) ELSE '' END
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk GROUP BY a.tk, tk_du

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY tk, sysorder, tk_du

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMPerformanceFormExport]
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @cTotal NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @cTotal = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	SET @key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, a.stt_rec, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.diem_nv_dg, a.diem_ql_dg, a.dien_giai, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr
			, b.stt_rec_nv, b.stt_rec_ndg, b.t_diem_nv_dg, b.t_diem_ql_dg, b.ngay_dg, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS yk_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS yk_ql_tt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS yk_ql_cc
			, d.ma_nv, d.ho_nv + space(1) + d.ten_nv AS ten_nv, d.bac_quan_ly, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, d.ngay_chinh_thuc, d.ngay_vao
		INTO #report FROM hrdgthct a, hrdgth b, hrnv d
			
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.diem_nv_dg, a.diem_ql_dg, a.dien_giai, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.stt_rec_nv, b.stt_rec_ndg, b.t_diem_nv_dg, b.t_diem_ql_dg, b.ngay_dg'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.yk_nv + char(13) + b.yk_nv2 + char(13) + b.yk_nv3 + char(13) + b.yk_nv4 + char(13) + b.yk_nv5'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.yk_ql_tt + char(13) + b.yk_ql_tt2 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_tt3 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_tt4 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_tt5'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.yk_ql_cc + char(13) + b.yk_ql_cc2 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_cc3 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_cc4 + char(13) + b.yk_ql_cc5'
	SET @q = @q + ', d.ma_nv, d.ho_nv + space(1) + d.ten_nv as ten_nv, d.bac_quan_ly, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, d.ngay_chinh_thuc, d.ngay_vao'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrdgthct a with(nolock) left join hrdgth b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hrnv d on b.stt_rec_nv = d.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Ref.
	UPDATE #report SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, vi_tri = b.vi_tri, bac_quan_ly = b.bac_quan_ly, ngay_chinh_thuc = b.ngay_tu
		FROM #report a JOIN hreqtlvht b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec
			AND b.ngay_tu = (SELECT MAX(c.ngay_tu) FROM hreqtlvht c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE c.tinh_chat = '1' AND c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_nv AND c.ngay_tu <= a.ngay_dg)

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 6, 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', @cTotal, SUM(trong_so), MAX(t_diem_nv_dg), MAX(t_diem_ql_dg), '', '', 0, '', '', 0, 0, NULL
			, MAX(yk_nv), MAX(yk_ql_tt), MAX(yk_ql_cc), MAX(ma_nv), '', 0, MAX(bo_phan), MAX(vi_tri), NULL, NULL
		FROM #report WHERE stt0 = '' GROUP BY stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec_ndg = '', ten_nv = '', ngay_vao = NULL, ngay_dg = NULL WHERE line_nbr > 1
	UPDATE #report SET yk_nv = '', yk_ql_tt = '', yk_ql_cc = '' WHERE line_nbr <> 0

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, a.stt_rec, MAX(d.ten_bp) AS ten_bp, MAX(d.ten_bp2) AS ten_bp2, MAX(e.ten_vtr) AS ten_vtr, MAX(e.ten_vtr2) AS ten_vtr2
		INTO #o FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.bo_phan = d.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt e WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.vi_tri = e.ma_vtr
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec ORDER BY MAX(d.stt_ref), MAX(e.stt), MAX(e.ma_vtr), MAX(a.ma_nv), a.stt_rec

	-- Result
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, REPLACE(STR(x.id, 5), ' ', '0') + a.stt_rec AS stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.ngay_dg, a.yk_nv, a.yk_ql_tt, a.yk_ql_cc, a.ngay_vao
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_vao, a.ngay_dg) ELSE 0 END AS nam_lv
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_chinh_thuc, a.ngay_dg) ELSE 0 END AS nam_cv
			, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.diem_nv_dg, a.diem_ql_dg, a.dien_giai, a.ghi_chu
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bac ELSE b.ten_bac2 END ELSE '' END AS bac_quan_ly
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN x.ten_bp ELSE x.ten_bp2 END ELSE '' END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN x.ten_vtr ELSE x.ten_vtr2 END ELSE '' END AS ten_vtr
			, c.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + c.ten_nv AS nguoi_dg
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmbql b ON a.bac_quan_ly = b.ma_bac LEFT JOIN hrnv c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_ndg = c.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #o x ON a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec
		ORDER BY x.id, a.sysorder, a.line_nbr

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByProduct]
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32), 
	@Filter NVARCHAR(4000), 
	@JointUnit BIT, 
	@JointDept BIT, 
	@Round INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN

/*
	Tính lương sản phẩm cá nhân và làm theo bộ phận
*/
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join VARCHAR(512), @d SMALLDATETIME, @c VARCHAR(512), @k1 NVARCHAR(4000), @k2 NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @Join = '', @k1 = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Filter + ')' END, @k2 = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where (' + @Filter + ')' END
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' join hrbp a on r.ma_bp = a.ma_bp'

/*
	Lấy thông tin sản phẩm thực hiện trong kỳ
*/
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, stt_rec_nv, ma_sp, so_luong, ma_bp INTO #d03 FROM d03$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_bp, ma_sp, so_luong INTO #d04 FROM d04$000000
	-- Bảng công tổng hợp cho sản phẩm
	CREATE TABLE #hrcongthsp(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6))

	SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Cá nhân: chỉ lấy cho những nv đang tính
		SET @c = 'd03$' + @p
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #d03 select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_sp, a.so_luong, a.ma_bp'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @c + ' a with(nolock) join #hrstt_rec b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'
			SET @q = @q + ' where a.ngay_ct between b.ky_ngay_tu and b.ky_ngay_den'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Bộ phận: chỉ lấy cho những bp đang tính
		SET @c = 'd04$' + @p
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #d04 select r.stt_rec, r.ngay_ct, r.ma_bp, r.ma_sp, r.so_luong'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @c + ' r with(nolock) join #hrky k on r.ma_bp = k.ma_bp' + @Join
			SET @q = @q + ' where r.ngay_ct between k.ky_ngay_tu and k.ky_ngay_den' + @k1
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Tính công tổng hợp
		SET @c = 'hrcongth$' + @p
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #hrcongthsp select r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @c + ' r with(nolock) join #hrky d on r.ma_bp = d.ma_bp' + @Join 
			SET @q = @q + ' where r.ngay between d.ky_ngay_tu and d.ky_ngay_den' + @k1 + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @p
	END
/*
	Kết thúc lấy thông tin sản phẩm thực hiện trong kỳ
*/

/*
	Lấy đơn giá sản phẩm
*/
	SELECT ma_sp INTO #masptemp FROM #d03
	INSERT INTO #masptemp SELECT ma_sp FROM #d04
	
	SELECT @dateFrom = MIN(ky_ngay_tu), @dateTo = MAX(ky_ngay_den) FROM #hrky
	SELECT a.ma_sp, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #hr03_t0 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_sp FROM #masptemp) a JOIN hrdgsp b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp WHERE b.ngay_hl <= @dateFrom GROUP BY a.ma_sp
	SELECT a.ma_sp, a.don_gia, a.ngay_hl INTO #hr03_t1 FROM hrdgsp a JOIN #hr03_t0 b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
	SELECT ma_sp, don_gia, ngay_hl INTO #hr03_t2 FROM hrdgsp WHERE ngay_hl > @dateFrom AND ngay_hl <= @dateTo

	-- Tạo bảng lưu các thông tin không thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT * INTO #hr03_t3 FROM #hr03_t1 WHERE ma_sp NOT IN (SELECT ma_sp FROM #hr03_t2)
	CREATE INDEX ma_sp ON #hr03_t3(ma_sp)

	-- Tạo bảng lưu thông tin thay đổi trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #hr03_t2 SELECT * FROM #hr03_t1 WHERE ma_sp NOT IN (SELECT ma_sp FROM #hr03_t3)

	-- Tạo bảng giới hạn từ ngày hiệu lực đến ngày kế tiếp
	CREATE TABLE #hr03_t4(ma_sp VARCHAR(32), don_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #hr03_t4 (ma_sp, don_gia, ngay_tu) SELECT ma_sp, don_gia, ngay_hl FROM #hr03_t2 ORDER BY ma_sp, ngay_hl
	UPDATE #hr03_t4 SET ngay_den = b.ngay_tu FROM #hr03_t4 a JOIN (SELECT ma_sp, ngay_tu, stt - 1 AS stt FROM #hr03_t4) b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.stt = b.stt
	UPDATE #hr03_t4 SET ngay_den = @dateTo + 1 WHERE ngay_den IS NULL
	CREATE INDEX ma_sp ON #hr03_t4(ma_sp)

/*
	Kết thúc lấy đơn giá sản phẩm
*/
	-- Bảng lưu thông tin số lượng sản phẩm cá nhân không thay đổi và thay đổi trong kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #hr03_t5(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_bp0 VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), don_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), ma_nt VARCHAR(32), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
	CREATE TABLE #hr03_t6(stt INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6))

	-- Bảng lưu thông tin số lượng sản phẩm bộ phận không thay đổi và thay đổi trong kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #hr04_t5(ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), don_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6))
	CREATE TABLE #hr04_t6(stt INT, ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), so_luong NUMERIC(28, 6))


/*
	Tính cho cá nhân
*/
	-- Tính cho các sản phẩm không thay đổi trong kỳ
	SET @q = 'insert into #hr03_t5 select a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_bp, '''', a.ma_sp, sum(a.so_luong), max(c.don_gia), sum(a.so_luong * c.don_gia), '''', 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #d03 a with (nolock) join #hr03_t3 c with (index(ma_sp)) on a.ma_sp = c.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Tính cho các sản phẩm thay đổi trong kỳ
	SET @q = 'insert into #hr03_t6 select a.stt, b.stt_rec_nv, b.ma_bp, b.ma_sp, sum(b.so_luong)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #hr03_t4 a join #d03 b on a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay_ct and a.ngay_den > b.ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt, b.stt_rec_nv, b.ma_bp, b.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

/*
	Tính cho bộ phận
*/
	-- Tính cho các sản phẩm không thay đổi trong kỳ
	SET @q = 'insert into #hr04_t5 select r.ma_bp, r.ma_sp, sum(r.so_luong), max(c.don_gia), sum(r.so_luong * c.don_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #d04 r with (nolock) join #hr03_t3 c with (index(ma_sp)) on r.ma_sp = c.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by r.ma_bp, r.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Tính cho các sản phẩm thay đổi trong kỳ
	SET @q = 'insert into #hr04_t6 select t.stt, r.ma_bp, r.ma_sp, sum(r.so_luong)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #hr03_t4 t join #d04 r on t.ma_sp = r.ma_sp and t.ngay_tu <= r.ngay_ct and t.ngay_den > r.ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by t.stt, r.ma_bp, r.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

/*
	Tính cho các sản phẩm thay đổi trong kỳ
*/
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr03_t4(stt)
	INSERT INTO #hr03_t5 SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, '', a.ma_sp, a.so_luong, b.don_gia, a.so_luong * b.don_gia, '', 0 FROM #hr03_t6 a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN #hrky d ON c.ma_bp = d.ma_bp JOIN #hr03_t4 b ON a.stt = b.stt
	INSERT INTO #hr04_t5 SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, a.so_luong, b.don_gia, a.so_luong * b.don_gia FROM #hr04_t6 a JOIN #hrky c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp JOIN #hr03_t4 b ON a.stt = b.stt
	
	-- Bảng phân bổ
	SELECT ma_bp, ma_sp, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, don_gia, SUM(tien) AS tien INTO #hr04_t7 FROM #hr04_t5 GROUP BY ma_bp, ma_sp, don_gia

/*
	Phân bổ cho cá nhân
*/

	-- Tính hệ số theo bộ phận và nhân viên
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp INTO #hr04_t8 FROM #hr04_t7
	CREATE INDEX ma_bp ON #hr04_t8(ma_bp)

	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.stt_rec, CAST(a.he_so AS NUMERIC(19, 6)) AS he_so INTO #hr04_t9
		FROM hrhsbp a WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN #hr04_t8 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
			JOIN (SELECT m.ma_bp, m.stt_rec, MAX(m.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrhsbp m WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrky n ON m.ma_bp = n.ma_bp WHERE m.ngay_hl <= n.ky_ngay_den GROUP BY m.ma_bp, m.stt_rec) c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl

	-- Lấy hệ số  trong tổng hợp công theo số giờ và hệ số công
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, SUM(a.so_gio * b.he_so) AS so_gio
		INTO #hr05_t2
		FROM #hrcongthsp a JOIN hrdmcong b ON a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong
			LEFT JOIN #hrctloailuong c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong
		WHERE b.loai_luong = 2 OR c.loai_luong = 2
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp

	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr05_t2(stt_rec,ma_bp )


	-- Bảng hệ số
	UPDATE #hr04_t9 SET he_so = a.he_so * ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) FROM #hr04_t9 a LEFT JOIN #hr05_t2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	-- Xóa trong trường hợp hệ số là 0 như không chấm công trong bộ phận đó
	DELETE #hr04_t9 WHERE he_so = 0

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp0, b.ma_sp, b.don_gia, a.he_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_luong0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt
		INTO #hr04_t10
		FROM #hr04_t9 a JOIN #hr04_t7 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp


	-- Phân bổ
	SELECT ma_bp, ma_sp, don_gia, SUM(he_so) AS t_he_so INTO #hr04_t11 FROM #hr04_t10 GROUP BY ma_bp, ma_sp, don_gia
	DELETE #hr04_t11 WHERE t_he_so = 0

	UPDATE #hr04_t10 SET tien = ROUND(b.tien * a.he_so / c.t_he_so, @Round), so_luong0 = b.so_luong
		FROM #hr04_t10 a JOIN #hr04_t7 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.don_gia = b.don_gia
			JOIN #hr04_t11 c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.ma_sp = c.ma_sp AND a.don_gia = c.don_gia


	-- Điều chỉnh
	SELECT ma_bp, ma_sp, don_gia, MAX(stt_rec) AS stt_rec, SUM(tien) AS tien INTO #hr04_t12 FROM #hr04_t10 GROUP BY ma_bp, ma_sp, don_gia
	UPDATE #hr04_t12 SET tien = b.tien - a.tien FROM #hr04_t12 a JOIN #hr04_t7 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.don_gia = b.don_gia
	DELETE #hr04_t12 WHERE tien = 0

	UPDATE #hr04_t10 SET tien = a.tien + b.tien FROM #hr04_t10 a JOIN #hr04_t12 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.don_gia = b.don_gia
	
	-- Tính và xóa các bản ghi không thóa mãn
	UPDATE #hr04_t10 SET tien0 = ROUND(a.tien * ISNULL(c.ty_gia, 0), @Round), ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp FROM #hr04_t10 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl c ON b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt AND b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
	DELETE #hr04_t10 WHERE ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''


/*
	Kết thúc phân bổ
*/



/*
	Cập nhật vào các bảng
*/
	
	-- Cập nhật trường bộ phân, ngoại tệ cho cá nhân
	UPDATE #hr03_t5 SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp FROM #hr03_t5 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #hr03_t5 SET tien0 = ROUND(a.tien * c.ty_gia, @Round) FROM #hr03_t5 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgtl c ON b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt AND b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

	-- Cập nhật vào bảng chi tiết lương sản phẩm cá nhân
	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_sp, loai, so_luong, gia, he_so, tien, tien_nt)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongsp$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L11'', ma_sp, ''1'', sum(so_luong), don_gia, 0, sum(tien0), sum(tien)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #hr03_t5 group by stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_sp, don_gia, ma_nt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cập nhật vào bảng chi tiết lương sản phẩm theo bộ phận
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongsp$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L12'', ma_sp, ''2'', so_luong0, don_gia, he_so, tien0, tien from #hr04_t10'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	
	-- Cập nhật lương sản phẩm cá nhân
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(tien) AS l11 INTO #hr03_t7 FROM #hr03_t5 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr03_t7(stt_rec, ma_bp)
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l11 = b.l11 FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hr03_t7 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	-- Cập nhật lương sản phẩm theo bộ phận
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(tien) AS l12 INTO #hr04_t13 FROM #hr04_t10 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr04_t13(stt_rec, ma_bp)

	UPDATE #hrluong SET l12 = b.l12 FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hr04_t13 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp


/*
	Tính lương tăng ca, vượt tăng ca và phần vượt ban đêm cho lương sản phẩm
*/
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong,
			SUM(a.so_gio) AS so_gio, -- Phần này không nhân với hệ số
			SUM(a.so_ngay) AS so_ngay,
			SUM(CASE WHEN c.tinh_chat = 2 THEN so_gio ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN b.he_so > 1 THEN b.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS l52, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN c.tinh_chat <> 2 AND b.kieu_cong = 2 THEN so_gio ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN b.he_so > 1 THEN b.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS l54
		INTO #hr05_t3
		FROM #hrcongth a 
			JOIN hrdmcong b ON a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong 
			JOIN hrdmloaicong c ON b.ma_loai = c.ma_loai
			LEFT JOIN #hrctloailuong d ON a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = d.ma_cong
		WHERE b.loai_luong = 2 OR d.loai_luong = 2
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong

	DELETE #hr05_t3 WHERE so_gio = 0
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr05_t3(stt_rec, ma_bp)

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(so_ngay) AS so_ngay INTO #hr05_t3_t FROM #hr05_t3 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr05_t3_t(stt_rec, ma_bp)	

	-- Tính lương vượt tăng ca sản phẩm và phần vượt ban đêm
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp0, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay, ROUND((ISNULL(b.l11, 0) + ISNULL(b.l12, 0)) * a.l52 / c.so_gio, @Round) AS l52, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l52_tg,
			ROUND((ISNULL(b.l11, 0) + ISNULL(b.l12, 0)) * a.l54 / c.so_gio, @Round) AS l54, b.ma_nt
		INTO #hr05_t3r FROM #hr05_t3 a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #hr05_t3_t c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

	UPDATE #hr05_t3r SET l52_tg = ROUND(a.l52 * ISNULL(c.ty_gia, 0), @Round), ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp FROM #hr05_t3r a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt

	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien_nt, tien)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L52'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, l52, l52_tg from #hr05_t3r'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #hrluong SET l52 = b.l52,  l54 = b.l54
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(l52) AS l52, SUM(l54) AS l54 FROM #hr05_t3r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

/*
	Kết thúc tính lương tăng ca, chênh lệch tăng ca và chênh lệch ban đêm cho lương sản phẩm
*/

END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_DelDepreciation]
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2), 
	@nYear NUMERIC(4), 
	@cType CHAR(1),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	SELECT so_the_ts INTO #dmtsRight FROM dmts WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

	IF @cType = '0'
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dmts SET ngay_kh1 = NULL FROM dmts a JOIN (
				SELECT so_the_ts FROM ctkhts WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts HAVING SUM(gt_cl) = 0) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

			DELETE ctkhts WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmtsRight)
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dmts SET ngay_kh1 = NULL FROM dmts a JOIN (
				SELECT so_the_ts FROM ctkhts WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND sua_kh = 0 GROUP BY so_the_ts HAVING SUM(gt_cl) = 0) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

			DELETE ctkhts WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND sua_kh = 0  AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmtsRight)
		END
	DELETE ctpbts WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1
	DELETE ctpbtsd WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ReportJDetailAccount]--[fs_ReportJDetailAccount]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VocherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Vocher VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023)
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	
	--Struct
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, so_ctgs, ngay_ctgs, tk AS tk_no, tk_du AS tk_co, ps_no AS tien, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt
		 INTO #Report FROM wrkgl

	--@Key
	SET @Key = ' (a.ps_no + a.ps_no_nt <> 0) and a.status = ''1'' and ngay_ctgs = ''' + CONVERT ( CHAR(8), @VocherDate, 112)+''''
			 + ' and a.so_ctgs = ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Vocher), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--@q
	SET @q = ' insert into #Report select 5, 1, 1, a.so_ctgs, a.ngay_ctgs, a.tk, a.tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt)'
		   + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
		   + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		   + ' group by a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk, a.tk_du'
		   + ' order by a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk, a.tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk_no, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk_no2,
				CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk_co, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE c.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk_co2, 0 AS no_co 
		FROM #report a	LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk
						LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_co = c.tk
						LEFT JOIN ctgs d ON a.so_ctgs = d.so_ctgs AND a.ngay_ctgs = d.ngay_ctgs					
		ORDER BY sysorder, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollAdjustment]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @r NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s AS VARCHAR(33)
	
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_loai_lg, b.tien INTO #dcluong FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN hrdcluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE b.nam = @Year AND b.ky = @Period

	-- Bổ sung thêm bộ phận còn thiếu trong bảng #hrluong
	INSERT INTO #hrluong(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, loai_luong, kieu_tinh, tg_tl, tg_bh, bpql_yn) 
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, b.ma_nt, b.loai_luong, b.kieu_tinh, b.tg_tl, b.tg_bh, 0
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, ma_bp FROM #dcluong) a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.bpql_yn = 1
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrluong c WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ma_bp = a.ma_bp)

	SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ma_loai_lg) AS field INTO #field FROM #dcluong
	SELECT @r = 'update #hrluong set %field = b.tien FROM #hrluong a JOIN #dcluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND b.ma_loai_lg = ''%code'''
	SELECT @s = MIN(field) FROM #field
	WHILE @s IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = REPLACE(@s, '''', ''''''), @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '%field', LOWER(@s)), '%code', @s)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @s = MIN(field) FROM #field WHERE field > @s
	END

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$PU$UnPostAuthorize]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(33),
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @HisTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(33), @UStatus VARCHAR(33), @RecordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(33), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @currentStatus VARCHAR(32),
		@lastApproveUser INT, @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(28, 6), @userID0 INT, @role VARCHAR(33), @CategoryApprove VARCHAR(33), @datetime4 DATETIME, @nextUStatus VARCHAR(33), @voucherCode VARCHAR(32), @modeFBI VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT TOP 1 @modeFBI = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'
	SELECT @Status = '', @RecordHasBeenChanged = '', @lastApproveUser = 0, @voucherCode = '', @currentStatus = ''
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- struct
	SELECT @GeneralTable = '', @MasterTable = '', @DetailTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @HisTable = '', @Dyn = ''
	SELECT @GeneralTable = c$, @MasterTable = m$, @DetailTable = d$, @InquiryTable = i$, @HisTable = a$ FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @GeneralTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @Dyn OUTPUT
		IF RIGHT(@MasterTable, 1) = '$' SET @MasterTable = @MasterTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@DetailTable, 1) = '$' SET @DetailTable = @DetailTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@InquiryTable, 1) = '$' SET @InquiryTable = @InquiryTable + @Dyn
	END


	--
	CREATE TABLE #a(user_id4 INT, xtype VARCHAR(32), datetime4 DATETIME)
	SET @q = 'insert into #a select top 1 user_id4, xtype, datetime4 from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and xtype in (''1'', ''2'') order by stt desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype, @datetime4 = datetime4 FROM #a


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #listUser select a.stt, a.user_id4 from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' a join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and xtype in (''1'', ''2'') and user_id4 <> ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastApproveUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC

	DECLARE @notCheckStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = '9'
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = @notCheckStatus + ',' + status from dmctduyet WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	-- Get old status
	IF @lastUserID = @userID AND @xtype = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #role(status VARCHAR(32), u_status VARCHAR(32), u_status0 VARCHAR(32), user_id0 INT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select status, u_status, u_status0, user_id0, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and (datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @datetime4, 121) + ''' or status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@notCheckStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @currentStatus = status, @nextUStatus = u_status, @UStatus = u_status0, @userID0 = user_id0, @CategoryApprove = kieu_duyet FROM #role
		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalRole @voucherType, @lastUserID, @UStatus, @CategoryApprove, @role OUTPUT
	END


	--
	IF @UStatus IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @status = '0'
	SELECT @Status = s_status FROM dmttcttg WHERE u_status = @UStatus AND loai_duyet = @voucherType
	IF @modeFBI = '1' BEGIN
		IF @voucherCode IN ('PA1', 'PA2') BEGIN
			IF @currentStatus = '2' BEGIN
				SET @q = 'delete from bigia01 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
					+ CHAR(13) + 'delete from bigia02 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
					+ CHAR(13) + 'delete from bigia0dc where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		
		IF @voucherCode = 'PA2' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$BISA @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID
		END
	END
	-- Update
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@UStatus, '''', '') + ''', u_status0 = '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@lastApproveUser) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @InquiryTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' +  QUOTENAME(@InquiryTable) + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + QUOTENAME(@GeneralTable) + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- After Update
	

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2', @commentApproval

	-- Reset
	SET @q = '
		declare @minReset int, @stt int
		select @minReset = 0, @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
		if exists(select 1 from dmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and u_status = ''' + @nextUStatus + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + '
				where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
					and u_status = ''' + @nextUStatus + '''
					and stt < @stt - 1
					and stt in (select a.stt from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' a
						join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'')
			update ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' set reset = reset - 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt > @minReset and stt < @stt
		end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Mail
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND notify_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @lastApproveUser = 0
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @UStatus AND created_mail_yn = '1' AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove) SELECT @userID0 = 0

	DECLARE @notifyGroup VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @notifyGroup = '', @invoke = ''
	SELECT @notifyGroup = notify_group FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
	INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @Dyn, @voucherType, @sysDatabaseName, @lastApproveUser, 1, @userID0

	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetNotify @notifyGroup, @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, @pushNotify, @pushNotifyDevice, @userID, @sysDatabaseName, '#mail', @invoke OUTPUT

	SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
	SELECT * FROM #mail

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI102] -- So sánh doanh thu giữa các kỳ
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@CreditAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')
	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @CreditAccount = REPLACE(@CreditAccount, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)
		
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, SUM(ps_co - ps_no) AS doanh_thu INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SET @Key = 'dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @tkdt + ''') = 0 and '
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @CreditAccount <> '' THEN ' dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @CreditAccount + ''') = 1' ELSE '1 = 0' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, sum(ps_co - ps_no) as doanh_thu'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %['+ @Key +']% group by ngay_ct'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin		 
	
	SELECT ngay_ct, SUM(doanh_thu) AS doanh_thu INTO #ct00 FROM #tmp GROUP BY ngay_ct
	DELETE #ct00 WHERE doanh_thu = 0
	
	SET @q = 'declare @ngay_dn as smalldatetime; set @ngay_dn = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) + ''''
	
	DECLARE @select AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SET @select = ' sum(doanh_thu) AS doanh_thu '

	DECLARE @quy1 AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @quy1 = ' (case when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 1 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 3 then 1'
	SET @quy1 = @quy1 + ' when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 4 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 6 then 2' 
	SET @quy1 = @quy1 + ' when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 7 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 9 then 3 else 4 end)'

	DECLARE @quy2 AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @quy2 = ' (case when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 1 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 3 then 1'
	SET @quy2 = @quy2 + ' when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 4 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 6 then 2'
	SET @quy2 = @quy2 + ' when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 7 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 9 then 3 else 4 end)'
	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE @timeID
		WHEN '001' THEN ' select (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00 group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + 'from #ct where doanh_thu <> 0 group by thang'
		WHEN '002' THEN ' select ' + @quy2 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00 group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' drop table #ct00 select quy,' + @select + 'from #ct where doanh_thu <> 0 group by quy'
		WHEN '003' 
		THEN ' select (year(@ngay_dn) - 1) as nam,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn ' + 
			+' select year(@ngay_dn) as nam,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn ' + 
			+' select * into #result from #ct1 insert into #result select * from #ct2 select nam, isnull(doanh_thu, 0) as doanh_thu from #result order by nam'
			+' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			
		WHEN '004' THEN ' select (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + ' into #ct001 from #ct1 group by thang'
			+ ' select (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + ' into #ct002 from #ct2 group by thang'
			+ ' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			+ ' select distinct case when a.thang is null then b.thang else a.thang end as thang, isnull(a.doanh_thu, 0) as doanh_thu1, isnull(b.doanh_thu, 0) as doanh_thu2 from #ct002 a full join #ct001 b on a.thang = b.thang'
		WHEN '005' THEN ' select ' + @quy1 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select quy,' + @select + 'into #ct001 from #ct1 group by quy'
			+ ' select ' + @quy2 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select quy,' + @select + ' into #ct002 from #ct2 group by quy'
			+ ' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			+ ' select distinct case when a.quy is null then b.quy else a.quy end as quy, isnull(a.doanh_thu, 0) as doanh_thu1, isnull(b.doanh_thu, 0) as doanh_thu2 from #ct002 a full join #ct001 b on a.quy = b.quy'
		ELSE ''
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignValue]
	@unit VARCHAR(32),
	@languageType VARCHAR(1), -- 1. Standard, 2. Bilingual
	@language VARCHAR(1),
	@profile NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
	@userID INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @unit = REPLACE(@unit, '''', ''), @profile = REPLACE(@profile, '''', '')

	DECLARE @u VARCHAR(32), @id VARCHAR(32), @sign NVARCHAR(4000), @p NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c CHAR(1), @k CHAR(1), @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @v$ID VARCHAR(32), @v$Code VARCHAR(3), @v$Period VARCHAR(6), @v$Master VARCHAR(32), @v$Detail VARCHAR(32), @dateSign VARCHAR(128), @preparedBy NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @p = @profile, @c = CHAR(255), @k = CHAR(253), @q = ''
	SELECT id, RTRIM(data) AS data INTO #profile FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@p, @c)

	SELECT @u = data FROM #profile WHERE id = 1
	SELECT @sign = data FROM #profile WHERE id = 2
	SELECT @v$ID = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, @k), @v$Code = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, @k) FROM #profile WHERE id = 3
	IF ISNULL(@v$ID, '') <> '' AND @v$Code IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@v$Code, '') = '' SELECT @v$Code = RIGHT(RTRIM(@v$ID), 3)

	IF ISNULL(@v$Code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @v$Period = convert(varchar(6), ' + CASE @v$Code WHEN 'KD3' THEN 'ngay_lo_kd' ELSE 'ngay_ct' END  + ', 112) from ' + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN RTRIM(c$) + '000000' ELSE RTRIM(c$) END + ' where stt_rec = @v$ID'
				, @v$Master = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(m$), 1) = '$' THEN RTRIM(m$) + '%Partition' ELSE RTRIM(m$) END, @v$Detail = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(d$), 1) = '$' THEN RTRIM(d$) + '%Partition' ELSE RTRIM(d$) END
			FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
		IF CHARINDEX('%Partition', @v$Master) > 0 BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@v$ID varchar(32), @v$Period varchar(6) output', @v$ID, @v$Period OUTPUT
			SELECT @v$Master = REPLACE(@v$Master, '%Partition', @v$Period), @v$Detail = REPLACE(@v$Detail, '%Partition', @v$Period)
		END
	END ELSE SELECT @v$Master = '', @v$Detail = ''
	SELECT @u = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@u, '') <> '' THEN @u ELSE @unit END

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS para_name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS para_value, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #para
	SELECT dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, ':') AS ma_ttck, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, ':') AS stt_rec0, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 3, ':') AS ma_loai INTO #sign FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@sign, @k)
	SELECT b.para_name, c.updateClause, c.fromClause, c.joinClause, c.whereClause INTO #signSript FROM dmttckct a LEFT JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck LEFT JOIN dmttckloaixl c ON a.xu_ly = c.xu_ly AND a.loai = c.loai WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign s WHERE s.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND s.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 AND a.ma_loai = s.ma_loai) AND a.loai <> 0 AND c.updateClause <> ''
	INSERT INTO #signSript SELECT b.para_name, d.updateClause, d.fromClause, d.joinClause, d.whereClause FROM #sign a JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_ttck, xu_ly FROM dmttckloai) c ON a.ma_ttck = c.ma_ttck JOIN dmttckloaixl d ON a.ma_loai = d.loai AND c.xu_ly = d.xu_ly WHERE a.stt_rec0 = '' AND (ISNULL(@v$Code, '') <> '' OR a.ma_loai = '2')

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ong_ba' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@v$Master)) DELETE #signSript WHERE para_name = 'contactName'
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign WHERE ma_ttck = '95000' AND stt_rec0 = '' AND ma_loai = '1') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign a JOIN dmttckct b on a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai WHERE a.ma_ttck = '95000' AND b.loai = '1')) AND (@v$Code IN ('KD3', 'SF3') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ngay_ct' AND id = OBJECT_ID(@v$Master))) BEGIN
		DELETE #signSript WHERE para_name = 'reportDate'
		DELETE #sign WHERE ma_ttck = '95000' AND stt_rec0 = '' AND ma_loai = '1'
		DELETE a FROM #sign a JOIN dmttckct b on a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 and a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai WHERE a.ma_ttck = '95000' AND b.loai = '1'
	END
	IF @languageType = '1' BEGIN
		IF @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT DISTINCT @v$ID, b.para_name, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN a.para_value ELSE a.para_value2 END FROM dmttckct a LEFT JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign s WHERE s.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND s.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 AND a.ma_loai = s.ma_loai)
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, b.para_name, '' FROM #sign a JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE a.stt_rec0 = ''

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #signSript) BEGIN
				SELECT @id = MIN(para_name) FROM #signSript
				WHILE @id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'update #para set para_value = ' + RTRIM(updateClause) + ' from ' + RTRIM(fromClause) + ' ' + RTRIM(joinClause) + ' where para_name = @id ' + RTRIM(whereClause) + '' FROM #signSript WHERE para_name = @id
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$%m', @v$Master), '$%d', @v$Detail), '$%s', '#para'), '$%u', 'vsysuserinfo'), '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@userID int, @v$ID varchar(32), @id varchar(32)', @userID, @v$ID, @id
					SELECT @id = MIN(para_name) FROM #signSript WHERE para_name > @id
				END
			END
			IF @v$Code IS NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @k = CHAR(252)
				SELECT @dateSign = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@sign, 1, @k), @preparedBy = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@sign, 2, @k)
				IF ISNULL(@dateSign, '') <> '' BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para WHERE para_name = 'reportDate') INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'reportDate', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%y', YEAR(@dateSign)) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT118'
					ELSE UPDATE #para SET para_value = (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%y', YEAR(@dateSign)) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT118') WHERE para_name = 'reportDate'
				END

				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para WHERE para_name = 'preparedByName') INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'preparedByName', REPLACE(@preparedBy, CHAR(251), ' ')
				ELSE UPDATE #para SET para_value = REPLACE(@preparedBy, CHAR(251), ' ') WHERE para_name = 'reportDate'
			END
		END

		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'companyTaxCode', ma_so_thue FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'companyTaxCode')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'phoneNumber', so_dt FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'phoneNumber')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'bankInfoInvoice', tk_nh FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'bankInfoInvoice')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'directorName', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_gd ELSE ten_gd2 END FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'directorName')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'chiefAccountantName', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_ktt ELSE ten_ktt2 END FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'chiefAccountantName')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'cashierName', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_tq ELSE ten_tq2 END FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'cashierName')
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT DISTINCT @v$ID, RTRIM(b.para_name) + '_v', a.para_value FROM dmttckct a LEFT JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign s WHERE s.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND s.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 AND a.ma_loai = s.ma_loai)
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT DISTINCT @v$ID, RTRIM(b.para_name) + '_e', a.para_value2 FROM dmttckct a LEFT JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sign s WHERE s.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND s.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 AND a.ma_loai = s.ma_loai)
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT DISTINCT @v$ID, CASE WHEN b.para_name = 'reportDate' THEN 'biReportDate2' ELSE RTRIM(b.para_name) END + '_v', '' FROM #sign a JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE a.stt_rec0 = ''
			INSERT INTO #para SELECT DISTINCT @v$ID, CASE WHEN b.para_name = 'reportDate' THEN 'biReportDate2' ELSE RTRIM(b.para_name) END + '_e', '' FROM #sign a JOIN dmttck b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck WHERE a.stt_rec0 = ''

			UPDATE #para SET para_name = REPLACE(para_name, 'reportDate', 'biReportDate2') WHERE para_name LIKE 'reportDate%'
			UPDATE #signSript SET para_name = 'biReportDate2', updateClause = REPLACE(updateClause, 'RPT118', 'RPT119') WHERE para_name LIKE 'reportDate%'

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #signSript) BEGIN
				SELECT @id = MIN(para_name) FROM #signSript
				WHILE @id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'update #para set para_value = ' + RTRIM(updateClause) + ' from ' + RTRIM(fromClause) + ' ' + RTRIM(joinClause) + ' where para_name = rtrim(@id) + ''_v''' + RTRIM(whereClause) + ';' FROM #signSript WHERE para_name = @id
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$%m', @v$Master), '$%d', @v$Detail), '$%s', '#para'), '$%u', 'vsysuserinfo'), '%l', '')
					SELECT @q = @q + 'update #para set para_value = ' + RTRIM(updateClause) + ' from ' + RTRIM(fromClause) + ' ' + RTRIM(joinClause) + ' where para_name = rtrim(@id) + ''_e''' + RTRIM(whereClause) + ';' FROM #signSript WHERE para_name = @id
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$%m', @v$Master), '$%d', @v$Detail), '$%s', '#para'), '$%u', 'vsysuserinfo'), '%l', '2')

					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@userID int, @v$ID varchar(32), @id varchar(32)', @userID, @v$ID, @id
					SELECT @id = MIN(para_name) FROM #signSript WHERE para_name > @id
				END
			END
			IF @v$Code IS NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @k = CHAR(252)
				SELECT @dateSign = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@sign, 1, @k), @preparedBy = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@sign, 2, @k)
				IF ISNULL(@dateSign, '') <> '' BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para WHERE para_name LIKE 'biReportDate2%') BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'biReportDate2_v', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%y', YEAR(@dateSign)) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT119'
						INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'biReportDate2_e', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%y', YEAR(@dateSign)) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT119'
					END ELSE UPDATE #para SET para_value = (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '%d', REPLACE(STR(DAY(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%m', REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dateSign), 2), ' ', '0')), '%y', YEAR(@dateSign)) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT119') WHERE para_name LIKE 'biReportDate2%'
				END
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para WHERE para_name LIKE 'preparedByName%') BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'preparedByName_v', REPLACE(@preparedBy, CHAR(251), ' ')
					INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'preparedByName_e', REPLACE(@preparedBy, CHAR(251), ' ')
				END ELSE UPDATE #para SET para_value = REPLACE(@preparedBy, CHAR(251), ' ') WHERE para_name LIKE 'preparedByName%'
			END
		END

		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'companyTaxCode_v', ma_so_thue FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'companyTaxCode_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'companyTaxCode_e', ma_so_thue FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'companyTaxCode_e')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'phoneNumber_v', so_dt FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'phoneNumber_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'phoneNumber_e', so_dt FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'phoneNumber_e')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'bankInfoInvoice_v', tk_nh FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'bankInfoInvoice_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'bankInfoInvoice_e', tk_nh FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'bankInfoInvoice_e')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'directorName_v', ten_gd FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'directorName_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'directorName_e', ten_gd2 FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'directorName_e')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'chiefAccountantName_v', ten_ktt FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'chiefAccountantName_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'chiefAccountantName_e', ten_ktt2 FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'chiefAccountantName_e')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'cashierName_v', ten_tq FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'cashierName_v')
		INSERT INTO #para SELECT @v$ID, 'cashierName_e', ten_tq2 FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @u AND [status] = '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para p WHERE p.para_name = 'cashierName_e')
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #para) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 '' AS companyTaxCode, '' AS phoneNumber, '' AS bankInfoInvoice, '' AS directorName, '' AS chiefAccountantName, '' AS cashierName FROM dmdvcskb
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS para INTO #para_view
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(id) FROM #para

	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @s = '', @q = ''
		SELECT @s = 'alter table #para_view add ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' nvarchar(128) null'
			, @q = 'update #para_view set ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' = N''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(para_value), '''', '''''') + '''' FROM #para WHERE id = @i
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	ALTER TABLE #para_view DROP COLUMN para

	-- View
	SELECT * FROM #para_view

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetCustomer]
	@tableName VARCHAR(33),
	@connectionCode VARCHAR(33),
	@userID INT,
	@admin TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT @tableName = REPLACE(@tableName, '''', ''), @connectionCode = REPLACE(@connectionCode, '''', '')
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @q = 'select d.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.ngan_hang, cast('''' as nvarchar(256)) as ten_tk_nh, b.tk_nh as so_tk_nh, b.e_mail, b.fax, b.dien_thoai, a.nguoi_lien_he, a.nguoi_dai_dien, a.loai_kh'
		+ ' from ' + REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '''''') + ' d join khhddt a with(nolock) on d.ma_kh = a.ma_kh join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
		+ ' where exists(select 1 from ctkhhddt e join tkhddtdv g on e.ma_dvcs = g.ma_dvcs where g.status = 1 and e.ma_kh = a.ma_kh and ma_kn = ''' + REPLACE(@connectionCode, '''', '''''') + ''') or not exists(select 1 from ctkhhddt f where f.ma_kh = a.ma_kh)' 
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostPQClosed]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @status CHAR(1)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct, @status = status FROM c92$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @status = '*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm92$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd92$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i92$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'a92$000000'

	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status <> ''5'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''5'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c92$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'

	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCProductionStatus] --fs_SFCProductionStatus
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@MO VARCHAR(32),
	@WO VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Total = CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt AS ma_sp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
		, a.so_lsx, a.stt_rec_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_lsx, ma_lo_trinh, ma_lsx AS ma_cd, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_bd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_kt
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_yc, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_th
		, a.status, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS tinh_trang, loai_ct
		INTO #report FROM ms2$000000 a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and b.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@WO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, b.so_lsx, b.stt_rec_lsx, b.ma_sp, b.ma_lsx, max(b.ma_lo_trinh), max(a.ma_cd), max(b.ngay_ct), min(a.ngay_bd), max(a.ngay_kt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', space(4) + b.ma_lsx, space(4) + max(b.ten_lsx' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', max(b.sl_yc), null, max(b.status), max(c.statusname' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), max(b.loai_ct)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ds2$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ms2$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join dmttct c with(nolock) on b.status = c.status and c.ma_ct = ''SF2'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by b.so_lsx, b.stt_rec_lsx, b.ma_lsx, b.ma_sp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #report b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and ((a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') or (a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp, SUM(a.sl_th) AS sl_th INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx a GROUP BY a.ma_lsx, a.ma_sp
	--
	UPDATE #report SET sl_th = b.sl_th FROM #report a JOIN #sfctpx0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp WHERE a.sl_th IS NULL

	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'so_lsx, ma_sp', 'so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx', '#report', 'stt', ''

	-- Total
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, '', @Total, SUM(sl_yc), SUM(sl_th), '', '', '' FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', 0, 0, '', '', ''
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, 0, a.so_lsx, a.stt_rec_lsx, a.ma_sp, '', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, SPACE(2) + a.ma_sp, SPACE(2) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE MAX(b.ten_vt2) END, SUM(a.sl_yc), SUM(a.sl_th), '', '', ''
				FROM #report a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY a.stt_rec_lsx, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp ORDER BY a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 3, 1, 0, 0, a.so_lsx, a.stt_rec_lsx, '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, LTRIM(a.so_lsx), MAX(b.dien_giai), SUM(a.sl_yc), SUM(a.sl_th), '', '', ''
				FROM #report a JOIN phsx b ON a.stt_rec_lsx = b.stt_rec WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY a.stt_rec_lsx, a.so_lsx ORDER BY a.so_lsx
	END ELSE INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', 0, 0, '', '', ''

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_lsx, ngay_ct, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, ma, ten, sl_yc, sl_th, status, tinh_trang
		FROM #report a ORDER BY so_lsx, ma_sp, stt
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CreateNotifyTSReq]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM hrccyccp a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM hrccctyccp a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số yêu cầu', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Description', dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_nv', 100, '', '', N'Mã nhân viên', N'Employee ID', 'ma_nv', 'ma_nv', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_nv', 150, '', '', N'Họ và tên', N'Employee Name', 'ten_nv', 'ten_nv', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_cc', 100, '', '', N'Mã công cụ', N'Tool & Supply Code', 'ma_cc', 'ma_cc', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_cc', 150, '', '', N'Tên công cụ', N'Tool & Supply Name', 'ten_cc', 'ten_cc2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_hh', 80, '', '', N'Ngày hết hạn', N'Expiry Date', 'ngay_hh', 'ngay_hh', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ghi_chu', 300, '', '', N'Ghi chú', N'Note', 'ghi_chu', 'ghi_chu', 1

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
