			RTRIM(b.ma_nv) AS ma_nv, b.ten AS ten_nv, a.ma_cc, ISNULL(c.ten_cc, '') AS ten_cc, ISNULL(c.ten_cc2, '') AS ten_cc2,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong,
			ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_hh, 103), ' / /    ') AS ngay_hh, a.ghi_chu
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN vhrnv b ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrcc c ON a.ma_cc = c.ma_cc


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02601', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02601', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', diễn giải: ' + dien_giai,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Description: ' + dien_giai
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Phiếu yêu cầu cấp phát công cụ, dụng cụ chờ duyệt'', N''Tool & supply requisition waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Phiếu yêu cầu cấp phát công cụ, dụng cụ chờ duyệt'', N''Tool & supply requisition waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt yêu cầu cấp phát công cụ, dụng cụ'', N''Tool & supply requisition workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt yêu cầu cấp phát công cụ, dụng cụ'', N''Tool & supply requisition workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2UsingDepartmentTransfer]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@tsCode VARCHAR(32),
	@tsType VARCHAR(32),
	@deptSource VARCHAR(32),
	@deptTarget VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@order VARCHAR(254),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @baseCurrency = val FROM options WHERE name = 'M_MA_NT0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_tu AS ma_bp1, a.ma_bp_den AS ma_bp2, a.so_luong
			, b.ten_dc, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt
		INTO #report
		FROM dcbpsddc a, dmccdc b

	--Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	--Key
	SET @key = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @tsCode <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsType <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.loai_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @deptSource <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_tu like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@deptSource), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @deptSource <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_den like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@deptTarget), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey

	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0,
a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_tu, a.ma_bp_den, a.so_luong,
b.ten_dc%l, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, a.so_luong * b.nguyen_gia1, a.so_luong * b.nguyen_gia_nt1
from dcbpsddc a with(nolock) left join dmccdc b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
where ' + @key

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @baseCurrency OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc) SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, ''

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTS2TranImport] @tableName VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32)

	-- Do not select value from option
	SELECT @nRound = 12, @nFCRound = 12, @baseCurrency = REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', ''), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, nguyen_gia1, nguyen_gia_nt1, gt_pb_ky1, gt_pb_ky_nt1 INTO #dmdcct FROM dmdcct

	SELECT @q = 'update dmdcct set
				nguyen_gia1 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(nguyen_gia / so_luong, ' + RTRIM(@nRound) + ') end,
				nguyen_gia_nt1 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(nguyen_gia_nt / so_luong, ' + RTRIM(@nFCRound) + ') end,
				gt_pb_ky1 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(gt_pb_ky / so_luong, ' + RTRIM(@nRound) + ') end,
				gt_pb_ky_nt1 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(gt_pb_ky_nt / so_luong, ' + RTRIM(@nFCRound) + ') end
			from dmdcct a
			where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmdcct
			select stt_rec, nguyen_gia1, nguyen_gia_nt1, gt_pb_ky1, gt_pb_ky_nt1
			from dmdcct a
			where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) and a.stt_rec0 = ''001'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update dmccdc set nguyen_gia1 = b.nguyen_gia1, nguyen_gia_nt1 = b.nguyen_gia_nt1
			, gt_pb_ky1 = case when a.so_ky_pb = 0 then 0 else round(b.nguyen_gia1 / a.so_ky_pb, ' + RTRIM(@nRound) + ') end
			, gt_pb_ky_nt1 = case when a.so_ky_pb = 0 then 0 else round(b.nguyen_gia1 / a.so_ky_pb, ' + RTRIM(@nRound) + ') end
			from dmccdc a left join #dmdcct b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'delete ctpsdc from ctpsdc a where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into ctpsdc (
			stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc, ma_ld_tg, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp,
			loai_ps, ma_nt, ma_bp_dc, sl_nhap, sl_xuat,
			nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x,
			gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_da_pb_x, gt_da_pb_nt_x,
			gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, gt_cl_x, gt_cl_nt_x,
			status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
		) select
			a.stt_rec, b.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, b.ngay_tang, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc, b.ma_ld_tang, b.tk_dc, b.tk_pb, a.tk_cp,
			0, b.ma_nt, a.ma_bp_dc, a.so_luong, 0,
			a.nguyen_gia, case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @baseCurrency + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end, 0, 0,
			a.gt_da_pb, case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @baseCurrency + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_pb_nt end, 0, 0,
			a.gt_cl, case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @baseCurrency + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end, 0, 0,
			b.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
		from dmdcct a left join dmccdc b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where exists(select 1 from ' + @tableName + ' c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountsLedger] --[fs_AcctsLedger]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@GLAccount TINYINT,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Level INT,
	@AccountType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @AccountKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @AccountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	SET @Key = 'loai_tk = 1'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @AccountKey

	-- 1 Tinh so du dau ky cho cac tai khoan
	CREATE TABLE #tBg (tk varchar(33), Du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_co NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #tBg EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @Key

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk INTO #loai_tk1 FROM dmtk
	SET @q = 'insert into #loai_tk1 select tk from dmtk a where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 2
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #temp FROM wrkgl

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from #loai_tk1)'
	IF(@Account <> '')SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @AccountKey
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #temp SELECT tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tBg

	SELECT tk AS tk, SUM(no_dk) no_dk, SUM(co_dk) co_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk_nt) co_dk_nt, SUM(ps_no) ps_no, SUM(ps_co) ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt) ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) ps_co_nt, SUM(no_ck) no_ck, SUM(co_ck) co_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck_nt) co_ck_nt
		INTO #tAcctsLedger FROM #temp a GROUP BY tk

	-- 3
	DELETE #tAcctsLedger WHERE ABS(No_dk) + ABS(No_dk_nt) + ABS(Co_dk) + ABS(Co_dk_nt) + ABS(Ps_no) + ABS(Ps_no_nt) + ABS(Ps_co) + ABS(Ps_co_nt) = 0

	-- 4
	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #tAcctsLedger SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	-- 5
	DECLARE @tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE crAcc CURSOR FOR SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 0 AND tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Account) + '%')
	OPEN crAcc
	FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #tAcctsLedger WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%') BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tAcctsLedger (tk, no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt)
				SELECT @Tk, SUM(no_dk), SUM(co_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(co_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck_nt)
					FROM #tAcctsLedger
					WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #loai_tk1)
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE crAcc
	DEALLOCATE crAcc

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN b.bac_tk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, a.tk, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag
			, ABS(no_dk - co_dk) AS du_dk, ABS(no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt) AS du_dk_nt
			, ABS(no_ck - co_ck) AS du_ck, ABS(no_ck_nt - co_ck_nt) AS du_ck_nt
			, CASE WHEN no_dk >= co_dk THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_dk, CASE WHEN no_ck >= co_ck THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_ck
			, CASE WHEN no_dk >= co_dk THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_dk2, CASE WHEN no_ck >= co_ck THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_ck2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
		FROM #tAcctsLedger a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		WHERE b.tk_sc >= @GLAccount AND b.bac_tk <= @Level AND b.loai_tk >= @AccountType
		ORDER BY a.tk

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionKey](@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), @UserID INT, @Admin BIT)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @InspectionKey VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @InspectionKey = NULL
	SELECT @InspectionKey = ISNULL(@InspectionKey, '') + CASE WHEN @InspectionKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_nguon) + '''' FROM bisysinspectionrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1
	IF @InspectionKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @InspectionKey = '(ma_nguon in (' + @InspectionKey + '))'
	RETURN @InspectionKey
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMPerformanceFormBlankExport]
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@DateAppraisal DATETIME,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @cTotal NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @cTotal = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	SET @key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, a.stt_rec, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr
			, b.stt_rec_nv
			, d.ma_nv, d.ho_nv + space(1) + d.ten_nv AS ten_nv, d.bac_quan_ly, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, d.ngay_chinh_thuc, d.ngay_vao
		INTO #report FROM hrdgthct a, hrdgth b, hrnv d

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.dien_giai, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', b.stt_rec_nv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', d.ma_nv, d.ho_nv + space(1) + d.ten_nv as ten_nv, d.bac_quan_ly, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, d.ngay_chinh_thuc, d.ngay_vao'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrkbctdgct a with(nolock) left join hrkbctdg b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hrnv d on b.stt_rec_nv = d.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Ref.
	UPDATE #report SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, vi_tri = b.vi_tri, bac_quan_ly = b.bac_quan_ly, ngay_chinh_thuc = b.ngay_tu
		FROM #report a JOIN hreqtlvht b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec
			AND b.ngay_tu = (SELECT MAX(c.ngay_tu) FROM hreqtlvht c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE c.tinh_chat = '1' AND c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_nv AND c.ngay_tu <= @DateAppraisal)

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 6, 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', @cTotal, SUM(trong_so), '', 0, '', MAX(ma_nv), '', 0, MAX(bo_phan), MAX(vi_tri), NULL, NULL
		FROM #report WHERE stt0 = '' GROUP BY stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET ten_nv = '', ngay_vao = NULL WHERE line_nbr > 1
	
	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, a.stt_rec, MAX(d.ten_bp) AS ten_bp, MAX(d.ten_bp2) AS ten_bp2, MAX(e.ten_vtr) AS ten_vtr, MAX(e.ten_vtr2) AS ten_vtr2
		INTO #o FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.bo_phan = d.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt e WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.vi_tri = e.ma_vtr
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec ORDER BY MAX(d.stt_ref), MAX(e.stt), MAX(e.ma_vtr), MAX(a.ma_nv), a.stt_rec

	-- Result
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, REPLACE(STR(x.id, 5), ' ', '0') + a.stt_rec AS stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv
			, a.ngay_vao, a.stt, a.stt0, a.chi_tieu, a.trong_so, a.dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN @DateAppraisal ELSE NULL END AS ngay_dg
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_vao, @DateAppraisal) ELSE 0 END AS nam_lv
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_chinh_thuc, @DateAppraisal) ELSE 0 END AS nam_cv
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bac ELSE b.ten_bac2 END ELSE '' END AS bac_quan_ly
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN x.ten_bp ELSE x.ten_bp2 END ELSE '' END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN a.line_nbr = 1 THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN x.ten_vtr ELSE x.ten_vtr2 END ELSE '' END AS ten_vtr
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmbql b ON a.bac_quan_ly = b.ma_bac JOIN #o x ON a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec
		ORDER BY x.id, a.sysorder, a.line_nbr

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintSalaryAdvance] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cE = CASE @cLan WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END 

	SET @strSQL =  'select b.ma_nv, rtrim(b.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(b.ten_nv) as ten_nv, a.tien, a.dien_giai, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @cDTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 7, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten_nv, dien_giai'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByTime]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Round INT,		
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),	
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	IF @DebugMode = 1 PRINT 'Payroll by Time'
/*
	Tính lương, tăng ca, chênh lệch tăng ca, chênh lệch ca đêm theo thời gian và khoán
	Các loại lương:
		+ L01: Lương thời gian
		+ L21: Lương khoán
		+ L51: Tăng ca thời gian
		+ L53: Tăng ca khoán

		+ D11: Chênh lệch tăng ca theo lương thời gian
		+ D13: Chênh lệch tăng ca theo lương khoán

		+ D21: Chênh lệch ban đêm theo lương thời gian
		+ D23: Chênh lệch ban đêm theo lương khoán
*/

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(512), @d SMALLDATETIME, @p VARCHAR(6)

/*
	Cập nhật đối với kiểu không tính lương theo ngày
*/
	-- Đối với các bản ghi không thay đổi trong kỳ 
	UPDATE #hrluong SET 
			l01 = CASE WHEN a.loai_luong = 1 THEN a.l00 ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN h.l01 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END,
			l21 = CASE WHEN a.loai_luong = 3 THEN b.tien_khoan ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN h.l21 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #ttluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec CROSS JOIN #hrhstvll h
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1 AND a.kieu_tinh = 0 AND b.nhieu_doan = 0

	-- Đối với các bản ghi thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT a.*, DATEDIFF(day, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den) + 1 AS so_ngay, b.kieu_tinh, b.ma_bp AS ma_bp_ltt, b.ma_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt
		INTO #hrttctluong_v5 FROM #ttluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.nhieu_doan = 1 ORDER BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, SUM(a.so_ngay * a.he_so_luong * ISNULL(b.luong_tt, 0)) AS luong_cb, SUM(a.so_ngay * a.tien_khoan) AS tien_khoan, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay, MAX(he_so_tv) AS he_so_tv
		INTO #hrttctluong_v6
		FROM #hrttctluong_v5 a LEFT JOIN #hrdmlttxl b ON a.ma_bp_ltt = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		WHERE a.kieu_tinh = 0 GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay

	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.loai_luong, a.kieu_tinh, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, b.tien_khoan, 
			CASE WHEN loai_luong = 1 AND c.so_ngay_cl <> 0 THEN ROUND(b.luong_cb / c.so_ngay_cl, @Round) ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN h.l01 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END AS l01, 
			CASE WHEN loai_luong = 3 AND c.so_ngay_cl <> 0 THEN ROUND(b.tien_khoan / c.so_ngay_cl, @Round) ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN h.l21 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END AS l21
		INTO #hrluong2_tmp
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hrttctluong_v6 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrky c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp CROSS JOIN #hrhstvll h
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1 AND a.kieu_tinh = 0

	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L01', ngay_tu, ngay_den, l01 FROM #hrluong2_tmp
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L21', ngay_tu, ngay_den, l21 FROM #hrluong2_tmp
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l01 = b.l01, l21 = b.l21
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(l01) AS l01, SUM(l21) AS l21 FROM #hrluong2_tmp GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1 AND a.kieu_tinh = 0

	-- Cập nhật lương làm thêm thời gian, lương khoán và các loại chênh lệch là 0 nếu không tính theo ngày
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l51 = 0, l53 = 0, d11 = 0, d13 = 0, d21 = 0, d23 = 0 WHERE kieu_tinh = 0
/*
	Kết thúc phần cập nhật đối với kiểu không tính lương theo ngày
*/



/*
	Cập nhật đối với kiểu tính lương theo ngày
*/

	-- Cập nhật thêm các bản ghi không thay đổi trong kỳ mà không khai báo trong chi tiết
	-- Đối với các bản ghi không thay đổi trong kỳ 
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, SUM(a.so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(a.so_ngay) AS so_ngay,
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 1 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * c.he_so) AS so_ngay_tg1, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * c.he_so) AS so_ngay_tg2, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cl_ngay_tg2, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat <> 2 AND c.kieu_cong = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cl_dem_tg2, 

			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 1 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * c.he_so) AS so_ngay_khoan1, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * c.he_so) AS so_ngay_khoan2, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cl_ngay_khoan2, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat <> 2 AND c.kieu_cong = 2 THEN so_ngay ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cl_dem_khoan2,
			c.loai_luong AS loai_luong_dmc, e.loai_luong AS loai_luong_ltc
		INTO #hrttctluong_v7
		FROM #hrcongth a 
			JOIN #ttluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.nhieu_doan = 0
			JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong 
			JOIN hrdmloaicong d ON c.ma_loai = d.ma_loai
			LEFT JOIN #hrctloailuong e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = e.ma_cong
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, c.loai_luong, e.loai_luong

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, f.ma_bp AS ma_bp0, f.ma_nt, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay,
			/*
				+ L01: Lương thời gian
			*/
			CASE
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0
				ELSE ROUND(
					(d.l00 * a.so_ngay_tg1 * CASE WHEN h.l01 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS l01, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l01_tg,



			/*
				L51: Tăng ca thời gian
			*/		
			CASE
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0
				ELSE ROUND(
					(CASE WHEN d.loai_luong = 9 AND (a.loai_luong_dmc = 1 OR a.loai_luong_ltc = 1) THEN c.he_so_luong * ISNULL(v.luong_tt, 0) ELSE d.l00 END 
					* CASE WHEN h.l51 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
					* a.so_ngay_tg2) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS l51, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l51_tg,



			/*
				D11: Chênh lệch tăng ca theo lương thời gian
			*/
			CASE
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0
				ELSE ROUND(
					(d.l00 * a.cl_ngay_tg2 * CASE WHEN h.d11 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round) 
			END AS d11, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d11_tg,



			/*
				D21: Chênh lệch ban đêm theo lương thời gian
			*/
			CASE 
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 
				ELSE ROUND(
					(d.l00 * a.cl_dem_tg2 * CASE WHEN h.d21 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS d21, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d21_tg,





			/*
				L21: Lương khoán
			*/
			CASE 
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 
				ELSE ROUND(
					(c.tien_khoan * a.so_ngay_khoan1 * CASE WHEN h.l21 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS l21, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l21_tg,



			/*
				L53: Tăng ca khoán
			*/
			CASE 
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 
				ELSE ROUND(
					(c.tien_khoan * a.so_ngay_khoan2 * CASE WHEN h.l53 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS l53, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l53_tg,



			/*
				D13: Chênh lệch tăng ca theo lương khoán
			*/
			CASE 
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 
				ELSE ROUND(
					(c.tien_khoan * a.cl_ngay_khoan2 * CASE WHEN h.d13 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS d13, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d13_tg,



			/*
				D23: Chênh lệch ban đêm theo lương khoán
			*/
			CASE 
				WHEN e.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 
				ELSE ROUND(
					(c.tien_khoan * a.cl_dem_khoan2 * CASE WHEN h.d23 = 1 AND c.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN c.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END) / e.so_ngay
				, @Round)
			END AS d23, 
			--
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d23_tg



		INTO #hrttctluong_v7r FROM #hrttctluong_v7 a
			LEFT JOIN #ttluong c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND nhieu_doan = 0
			JOIN #hrluong d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND d.bpql_yn = 1
			JOIN #hrstt_rec f ON a.stt_rec = f.stt_rec
			JOIN #hrky e ON f.ma_bp = e.ma_bp
			CROSS JOIN #hrhstvll h
			LEFT JOIN #hrdmlttxl v ON a.ma_bp = v.ma_bp AND d.ma_nt = v.ma_nt

	UPDATE #hrttctluong_v7r SET l01_tg = ROUND(a.l01 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			l51_tg = ROUND(a.l51 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			d11_tg = ROUND(a.d11 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			d21_tg = ROUND(a.d21 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			l21_tg = ROUND(a.l21 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			l53_tg = ROUND(a.l53 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			d13_tg = ROUND(a.d13 * b.ty_gia, @Round),
			d23_tg = ROUND(a.d23 * b.ty_gia, @Round)
		FROM #hrttctluong_v7r a JOIN #hrstt_rec c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgtl b ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND c.ma_nt = b.ma_nt
	
	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien_nt, tien)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L01'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, l01, l01_tg from #hrttctluong_v7r where isnull(l01, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L21'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, l21, l21_tg from #hrttctluong_v7r where isnull(l21, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L51'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, l51, l51_tg from #hrttctluong_v7r where isnull(l51, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L53'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, l53, l53_tg from #hrttctluong_v7r where isnull(l53, 0) <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #hrluong SET l01 = b.l01, l51 = b.l51, d11 = b.d11, d21 = b.d21, l21 = b.l21, l53 = b.l53, d13 = b.d13, d23 = b.d23
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(l01) AS l01, SUM(l51) AS l51, SUM(d11) AS d11, SUM(d21) AS d21, SUM(l21) AS l21, SUM(l53) AS l53, SUM(d13) AS d13, SUM(d23) AS d23 FROM #hrttctluong_v7r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		WHERE a.kieu_tinh = 1

	-- Đối với các bản ghi thay đổi trong kỳ
	DELETE #hrttctluong_v5 WHERE kieu_tinh = 0
	CREATE TABLE #hrttctluong_v8(stt INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(12, 5), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID('hrcongth$' + @p) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrttctluong_v8 select a.stt, a.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong, sum(b.so_gio), sum(b.so_ngay), a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #hrttctluong_v5 a join hrcongth$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and b.ngay between a.ngay_tu and a.ngay_den'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.stt, a.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @p
	END


	/*
		Loại lương: 1 - Thời gian, 3 - Khoán
		Tính chất: 1 - Trong giờ quy định, 2 - Tăng ca
	*/
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ma_cong, SUM(a.so_gio) AS so_gio,SUM( a.so_ngay) AS so_ngay,
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 1 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				c.he_so * b.he_so_luong * ISNULL(f.luong_tt, 0) *
				CASE WHEN h.l01 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS l01, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				c.he_so * b.he_so_luong * ISNULL(f.luong_tt, 0) *
				CASE WHEN h.l51 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS l51, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END * b.he_so_luong * ISNULL(f.luong_tt, 0) *
				CASE WHEN h.d11 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS d11, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 1 OR e.loai_luong = 1) AND d.tinh_chat <> 2 AND c.kieu_cong = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END * b.he_so_luong * ISNULL(f.luong_tt, 0) *
				CASE WHEN h.d21 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS d21, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 1 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				c.he_so * b.tien_khoan *
				CASE WHEN h.l21 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS l21, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				c.he_so * b.tien_khoan *
				CASE WHEN h.l53 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS l53, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END * b.tien_khoan *
				CASE WHEN h.d13 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS d13, 
			SUM(
				CASE WHEN (c.loai_luong = 3 OR e.loai_luong = 3) AND d.tinh_chat <> 2 AND c.kieu_cong = 2 THEN a.so_ngay ELSE 0 END *
				CASE WHEN c.he_so > 1 THEN c.he_so - 1 ELSE 0 END * b.tien_khoan *
				CASE WHEN h.d23 = 1 AND b.he_so_tv IS NOT NULL THEN b.he_so_tv ELSE 1 END
			) AS d23

		INTO #hrttctluong_v9
		FROM #hrttctluong_v8 a 
			JOIN #hrttctluong_v5 b ON a.stt = b.stt
			JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong
			JOIN hrdmloaicong d ON c.ma_loai = d.ma_loai
			LEFT JOIN #hrctloailuong e ON a.ma_bp = e.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = e.ma_cong
			LEFT JOIN #hrdmlttxl f ON a.ma_bp = f.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = f.ma_nt
			CROSS JOIN #hrhstvll h
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ma_cong


	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, b.ma_bp AS ma_bp0, b.ma_nt, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.l01 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS l01, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l01_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.l21 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS l21, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l21_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.l51 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS l51, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l51_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.l53 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS l53, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS l53_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.d11 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS d11, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d11_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.d13 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS d13, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d13_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.d21 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS d21, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d21_tg,
			CASE WHEN c.so_ngay = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.d23 / c.so_ngay, @Round) END AS d23, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS d23_tg
		INTO #hrttctluong_v9r
		FROM #hrttctluong_v9 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec JOIN #hrky c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

	UPDATE #hrttctluong_v9r SET l01_tg = ROUND(a.l01 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			l21_tg = ROUND(a.l21 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			l51_tg = ROUND(a.l51 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			l53_tg = ROUND(a.l53 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			d11_tg = ROUND(a.d11 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			d13_tg = ROUND(a.d13 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			d21_tg = ROUND(a.d21 * c.ty_gia, @Round),
			d23_tg = ROUND(a.d23 * c.ty_gia, @Round)
		FROM #hrttctluong_v9r a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #hrdmtgtl c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt

	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_gio, so_ngay, tien_nt, tien)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongtc2$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L01'', ma_cong, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_gio, so_ngay, l01, l01_tg from #hrttctluong_v9r where isnull(l01, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc2$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L21'', ma_cong, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_gio, so_ngay, l21, l21_tg from #hrttctluong_v9r where isnull(l21, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc2$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L51'', ma_cong, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_gio, so_ngay, l51, l51_tg from #hrttctluong_v9r where isnull(l51, 0) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc2$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L53'', ma_cong, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_gio, so_ngay, l53, l53_tg from #hrttctluong_v9r where isnull(l53, 0) <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien_nt, tien)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L01'', ma_cong, sum(so_gio), sum(so_ngay), sum(l01), sum(l01_tg) from #hrttctluong_v9r group by stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_cong, ma_nt having sum(l01) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L21'', ma_cong, sum(so_gio), sum(so_ngay), sum(l21), sum(l21_tg) from #hrttctluong_v9r group by stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_cong, ma_nt having sum(l21) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L51'', ma_cong, sum(so_gio), sum(so_ngay), sum(l51), sum(l51_tg) from #hrttctluong_v9r group by stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_cong, ma_nt having sum(l51) <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L53'', ma_cong, sum(so_gio), sum(so_ngay), sum(l53), sum(l53_tg) from #hrttctluong_v9r group by stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_cong, ma_nt having sum(l53) <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L01', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(l01) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L21', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(l21) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L51', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(l51) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L53', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(l53) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'D11', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(d11) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'D13', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(d13) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'D21', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(d21) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den
	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'D23', ngay_tu, ngay_den, SUM(d23) FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den

	UPDATE #hrluong SET l01 = b.l01, l21 = b.l21, l51 = b.l51, l53 = b.l53,d11 = b.d11, d13 = b.d13, d21 = b.d21, d23 = b.d23
		FROM #hrluong a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(l01) AS l01, SUM(l21) AS l21, SUM(l51) AS l51, SUM(l53) AS l53, SUM(d11) AS d11, SUM(d13) AS d13, SUM(d21) AS d21, SUM(d23) AS d23 FROM #hrttctluong_v9r GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

/*
	Kết thúc phần cập nhật đối với kiểu  tính lương theo ngày
*/
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_FXDelDis]
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2), 
	@nYear NUMERIC(4), 
	@cType CHAR(1),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	SELECT so_the_ts INTO #dmccRight FROM dmcc WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

	IF @cType = '0'
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dmcc SET ngay_kh1 = NULL FROM dmcc a JOIN (
				SELECT so_the_ts FROM ctkhcc WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle GROUP BY so_the_ts HAVING SUM(gt_cl) = 0) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE a.kieu_kh <> 1	AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1

			DELETE ctkhcc WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmccRight)
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dmcc SET ngay_kh1 = NULL FROM dmcc a JOIN (
				SELECT so_the_ts FROM ctkhcc WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND sua_kh = 0 GROUP BY so_the_ts HAVING SUM(gt_cl) = 0) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
				WHERE a.kieu_kh <> 1 AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1
			
			DELETE ctkhcc WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND sua_kh = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dmccRight)
			
		END
	DELETE ctpbcc WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1
	DELETE ctpbccd WHERE nam = @nYear AND ky = @nCycle AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs,  @cUnit, @cUnits) = 1
END

GO
CREATE VIEW vctkhts 
AS
	SELECT b.ma_dvcs, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.gt_kh_ky AS tien, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_bp0
		,a.so_the_ts, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_bp_ts, CAST('' AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS tien_nt
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_vv, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_sp
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_hd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_ku, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_phi
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3  
		FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		WHERE 1 = 0

GO

AS
	SELECT     a.*, b.ten_ct AS ten_ct, b.ten_ct2 AS ten_ct2, c.ten_loai AS ten_loai, c.ten_loai2 AS ten_loai2
		FROM         dbo.dmmagd a LEFT JOIN dbo.dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dbo.dmloaict c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = c.loai_ct

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ReleaseInvoiceInventory]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c0 VARCHAR(4000), @c1 VARCHAR(4000), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @table VARCHAR(33), @amountField VARCHAR(128), @amountDetailField VARCHAR(128), @email VARCHAR(256), @userName NVARCHAR(256)
	DECLARE @isFc BIT, @isNote BIT

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_nn_hddt' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') SELECT @Language = 'V'	
	SELECT @isFc = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_fc_hddt' and val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @isNote = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(@Extension, 3, 1) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @email = e_mail, @userName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN comment ELSE comment2 END FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID
	
	SELECT @table = ctable
			, @amountField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN mamount ELSE fcmamount END
			, @amountDetailField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN damount ELSE fcdamount END
		FROM hddtfields WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode and xtype = 1
	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_008' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') BEGIN
		IF @isFc = 0 SELECT @amountField = REPLACE(@amountField, 'a.t_tien', 'a.t_tien_nt2'), @amountDetailField = REPLACE(@amountDetailField, 'a.gia, a.tien', 'a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2')
		ELSE SELECT @amountField = REPLACE(@amountField, 'a.t_tien_nt', 'a.t_tien_nt2'), @amountDetailField = REPLACE(@amountDetailField, 'a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt', 'a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2')
	END	
	
	-- Struct
	--++ Master
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ong_ba, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, b.hd_so, b.hd_ngay, b.hd_cua, b.hd_ve_viec
			, b.ma_so_thue, b.ten_van_chuyen, b.hd_van_chuyen, b.pt_van_chuyen, b.xuat_tai_kho, b.nhap_tai_kho, b.nguoi_nhan
			, e.e_mail AS e_mail
		INTO #m0 FROM m84$000000 a, v84$000000 b, dmkh e
	--++ Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ma_vt, b.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr INTO #d0 FROM d84$000000 a, dmvt b


	-- Declare External Fields
	DECLARE @structFields VARCHAR(4000), @structFrom VARCHAR(4000), @queryFields VARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @resultFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFrom VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @detailResultFields VARCHAR(4000), @script NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @structFields = '', @structFrom = '', @queryFields = '', @queryJoin = '', @resultFields = '', @detailStructFields = '', @detailStructFrom = '', @detailQueryFields = '', @detailQueryJoin = '', @detailResultFields = '', @script = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @structFields = REPLACE(struct_fields, '''', '''''')
			, @structFrom = REPLACE(struct_from, '''', '''''')
			, @queryFields = REPLACE(query_fields, '''', '''''')
			, @queryJoin = REPLACE(query_join, '''', '''''')
			, @resultFields = REPLACE(result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND detail_struct_fields <> '') SELECT @detailStructFields = REPLACE(detail_struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailStructFrom = REPLACE(detail_struct_from, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryFields = REPLACE(detail_query_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryJoin = REPLACE(detail_query_join, '''', ''''''), @detailResultFields = REPLACE(detail_result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND script <> '') SELECT @script = script FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct External Fields
	IF @structFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @structFields + ' from ' + @structFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q 
	END
	IF @detailStructFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @detailStructFields + ' from ' + @detailstructFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q 
	END

	-- Integrated
	DECLARE @provider INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	IF @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 cast('''' as nvarchar(1024)) as ghi_chuhoadon'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q 
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #master FROM #m0
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0

	SELECT @c0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#m0', '#master', null, null)
	SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c0 = REPLACE(',' + @c0, ',key,', '[key],'), @c1 = REPLACE(',' + @c1, ',key,', '[key],')


	--++ Master
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master(' + @c0 + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, ltrim(a.so_ct)' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN ',a.ma_kh' ELSE ',''''' END + ',a.ong_ba'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ' + @amountField + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', isnull(v.hd_so, ''''), v.hd_ngay, isnull(v.hd_cua, '''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', isnull(v.hd_ve_viec, ''''), isnull(v.ma_so_thue, ''''), isnull(v.ten_van_chuyen, ''''), isnull(v.hd_van_chuyen, ''''), isnull(v.pt_van_chuyen, ''''), isnull(v.xuat_tai_kho, ''''), isnull(v.nhap_tai_kho, ''''), isnull(v.nguoi_nhan, '''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN ', case when isnull(v05.e_mail, '''') <> '''' then isnull(e.e_mail, '''') + case when isnull(e.e_mail, '''') <> '''' then '','' else '''' end + isnull(v05.e_mail, '''') else e.e_mail end' ELSE ', isnull(v05.e_mail, '''')' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @queryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + REPLACE(@queryFields, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END) END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 THEN ', rtrim(isnull(y.xu_ly, ''0'')) + char(255) + case when isnull(y.xu_ly, ''0'') = ''2'' then y.ghi_chuhoadon else '''' end' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from m' + @table + ' a with(nolock)'

	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' AND @VoucherCode <> 'PXB' SELECT @q = @q + ' join khhddt b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'

	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN ' join dmkh e with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join v05$%Partition v05 with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = v05.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join v' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@table), '%Partition', '000000') + ' v with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = v.stt_rec' + @queryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 THEN ' left join v03$000000 y on a.stt_rec = y.stt_rec' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' z where a.stt_rec = z.[key])]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--++ Detail
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail(' + @c1 + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec,a.ma_vt,e.ten_vt%l,a.dvt,a.so_luong,' + @amountDetailField + ',a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailQueryFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from d' + @table + ' a with(nolock) join dmvt e with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt join ' + @TableName + ' z on a.stt_rec = z.[key]' + @detailQueryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	--- FC
	IF @isFc = 0 AND @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #master set ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') +  ''', ty_gia = 1 where ma_nt <> ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Circular 635
	ALTER TABLE #detail ADD xu_ly VARCHAR(2) NULL;
	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #detail set xu_ly = ''1'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- External script
	IF RTRIM(@script) <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @script = REPLACE(@script, '%language', @Language)
		EXEC sp_executesql @script
	END

	-- Note
	IF @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' a join v03$000000 b on a.[key] = b.stt_rec where b.xu_ly = 1) begin
	insert #detail ([key], ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr, xu_ly)
		select a.[key], '''', b.ghi_chuhoadon, '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, ''4'' from ' + @TableName + ' a join v03$000000 b on a.[key] = b.stt_rec where b.xu_ly = 1
end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @q = 'select ' + @c0 + CASE WHEN @resultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @resultFields END  + ',''' +  REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '') + ''' as ma_dvcs, case when e_mail <> '''' then e_mail else ''' + REPLACE(@email, '''', '''''') + ''' end as email_kh, N''' + REPLACE(@userName, '''', '''''') + ''' as ten_kh from #master order by id'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + @c1 + CASE WHEN @detailResultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailResultFields END + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN ', xu_ly' ELSE '' END + ' from #detail order by [key], id'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @provider = 8  BEGIN 
		SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, '' AS ky_hieu, '' AS loai_hd
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @VoucherBook = RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook))
	IF @VoucherBook <> '' SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(mau_so)) AS mau_so, LTRIM(RTRIM(ky_hieu)) AS ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(loai_hd)) AS loai_hd FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI103] -- So sánh chi phí giữa các kỳ
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @tkdt AS NVARCHAR(20), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @tkdt = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = RTRIM('m_tk_kqkd')
	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @DebitAccount = REPLACE(@DebitAccount, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)
		
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, SUM(ps_no - ps_co) AS chi_phi INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SET @Key = 'dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @tkdt + ''') = 0 and '
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @DebitAccount <> '' THEN ' dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @DebitAccount + ''') = 1' ELSE '1 = 0' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, sum(ps_no - ps_co) as chi_phi'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %['+ @Key +']% group by ngay_ct'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin		 
	
	SELECT ngay_ct, SUM(chi_phi) AS chi_phi INTO #ct00 FROM #tmp GROUP BY ngay_ct
	DELETE #ct00 WHERE chi_phi = 0
	
	SET @q = 'declare @ngay_dn as smalldatetime; set @ngay_dn = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) + ''''
	DECLARE @select AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SET @select = ' sum(chi_phi) AS chi_phi '

	DECLARE @quy1 AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @quy1 = ' (case when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 1 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 3 then 1'
	SET @quy1 = @quy1 + ' when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 4 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 6 then 2' 
	SET @quy1 = @quy1 + ' when (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) >= 7 and (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) <= 9 then 3 else 4 end)'

	DECLARE @quy2 AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @quy2 = ' (case when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 1 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 3 then 1'
	SET @quy2 = @quy2 + ' when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 4 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 6 then 2'
	SET @quy2 = @quy2 + ' when (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) >= 7 and (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) <= 9 then 3 else 4 end)'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE @timeID
		WHEN '001' THEN ' select (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00 group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + 'from #ct where chi_phi <> 0 group by thang'
		WHEN '002' THEN ' select ' + @quy2 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct from #ct00 group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' drop table #ct00 select quy,' + @select + 'from #ct where chi_phi <> 0 group by quy'
		WHEN '003' 
		THEN ' select (year(@ngay_dn) - 1) as nam,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn ' + 
			+' select year(@ngay_dn) as nam,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn ' + 
			+' select * into #result from #ct1 insert into #result select * from #ct2 select nam, isnull(chi_phi, 0) as chi_phi from #result order by nam'
			+' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			
		WHEN '004' THEN ' select (datediff(month, dateadd(year, -1, @ngay_dn), ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + ' into #ct001 from #ct1 group by thang'
			+ ' select (datediff(month, @ngay_dn, ngay_ct) + 1) as thang,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select thang,' + @select + ' into #ct002 from #ct2 group by thang'
			+ ' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			+ ' select distinct case when a.thang is null then b.thang else a.thang end as thang, isnull(a.chi_phi, 0) as chi_phi1, isnull(b.chi_phi, 0) as chi_phi2 from #ct002 a full join #ct001 b on a.thang = b.thang'
		WHEN '005' THEN ' select ' + @quy1 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct1 from #ct00 where ngay_ct < @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select quy,' + @select + 'into #ct001 from #ct1 group by quy'
			+ ' select ' + @quy2 + ' as quy,' + @select + ' into #ct2 from #ct00 where ngay_ct >= @ngay_dn group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct' + ' select quy,' + @select + ' into #ct002 from #ct2 group by quy'
			+ ' drop table #ct00, #ct1, #ct2'
			+ ' select distinct case when a.quy is null then b.quy else a.quy end as quy, isnull(a.chi_phi, 0) as chi_phi1, isnull(b.chi_phi, 0) as chi_phi2 from #ct002 a full join #ct001 b on a.quy = b.quy'
		ELSE ''
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PR]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_kh, sl_duyet, he_so INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d91$000000
	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select distinct a.stt_rec_kh, a.sl_duyet, a.he_so from ' + @detailTable + ' a left join ' + @masterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_kh <> '''' and b.status = ''2'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec_kh, SUM(ROUND(sl_duyet * CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END, 3)) AS so_luong INTO #ct91 FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_kh
		UPDATE mrctdh SET sl_da_yc = a.sl_da_yc - b.so_luong, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() FROM mrctdh a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
		UPDATE mrctyc SET sl_da_yc = a.sl_da_yc - b.so_luong, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() FROM mrctyc a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
		UPDATE mrctyc SET sl_nhap = CASE WHEN a.sl_dh > a.sl_da_yc THEN a.sl_dh - a.sl_da_yc ELSE 0 END FROM mrctyc a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_LoadESTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@SourceSite VARCHAR(32),
	@DestinationSite VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - Release, 2 - Adjustment, 3 - Replacement, 9 - Cancelled
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@AdjustMode BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(1), @Table VARCHAR(32), @Join VARCHAR(4000), @provider INT, @tinh_trang_hddt VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Key = ''

	SELECT @Table = mtable, @Status = status_gl FROM hddtfields WHERE xtype = 3 and ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs
		, ma_kh, ma_kh AS ma_kho, ma_kh AS ma_khon
		, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt, ps_no AS tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, user_id2, datetime2
		, stt_rec AS stt_rec1, ma_ct AS ma_ct1, so_ct AS so_ct1, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct1
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = CASE WHEN @provider = 3 THEN '''0'',''1''' ELSE '''0''' END

	IF @Type = '9' SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt ' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN 'in (''2'',''3''' + CASE WHEN @AdjustMode = 1 THEN ',''9'')' ELSE ')' END ELSE '= ''2''' END + ' and not exists(select 1 from hddt05 c with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec0)'
	IF @Type IN ('1', '2') SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt in (' + @tinh_trang_hddt + ') and b.status = ''' + @Status + ''' and not exists(select 1 from hddt05 d with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec1)'
	IF @Type = '3' SET @Key = 'b.tinh_trang_hddt in (' + @tinh_trang_hddt + ') and b.status = ''' + @Status + ''''

	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXA', 'PX5') BEGIN
		IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' BEGIN
		IF @SourceSite <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SourceSite), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @DestinationSite <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_khon like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DestinationSite), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	END
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	DECLARE @c VARCHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_008' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') THEN '2' ELSE '' END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp' +
		' select ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN 'c.stt_rec0' ELSE 'a.stt_rec' END + ', a.ma_dvcs' +
		CASE WHEN @VoucherCode <> 'PXB' THEN ', a.ma_kh, '''', ''''' ELSE ', '''', a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon' END +
		', a.ma_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN 'c.ngay_ct0, c.so_ct0' ELSE 'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct' END + ', a.t_tien_nt' + @c + ', a.t_tien' + CASE WHEN @c = '' THEN '' ELSE '_nt2' END + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.user_id2, a.datetime2' +
		CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', null' END +
		' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' +
		CASE WHEN @Type = '3' THEN ' join hddt05 c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec1' ELSE '' END +
		' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	EXEC FastBusiness$Generate$Key @UserID, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct,
			a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh,
			a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon,
			a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct,
			REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), a.datetime2, 20), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '-', '') AS chuoi_ngay,
			a.stt_rec1, a.ma_ct1, a.ngay_ct1, a.so_ct1, CASE WHEN @Type <> '3' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec) ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Hash(@Key + a.stt_rec1) END AS [hash]
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
