CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostPQClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c92$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm92$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd92$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i92$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'a92$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a92$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''5'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c92$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$JobUnit]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023),
	@Job VARCHAR(1023),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Job, 2 Multi Job	
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'', 
	@Type TINYINT = 0 -- 0: Default, 1 - Multi-Accounts
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdvv

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Type = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(@Job, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.ma_vv', 'exactinlist', @Job)
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	END

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdvv a with (nolock, index(nam)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (index(ma_vv)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t group by ma_dvcs order by ma_dvcs'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv order by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_vv'
	END	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCWorkInProcessReport] --fs_SFCPhantom
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@MO VARCHAR(32),
	@WO VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @Total = CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @NoGroup = CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_lsx INTO #r FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_nhap, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_xuat INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_lsx, b.ma_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_nhap, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_xuat INTO #report FROM ms2$000000 a, ctrt b

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'exists(select 1 from phsx z where z.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and a.stt_rec_lsx = z.stt_rec)'
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@WO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select a.ma_lsx, a.ten_lsx' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' from ms2$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.sl_xuat)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #r b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx) and a.ma_ct <> ''SF1'' and a.loai = '''' and b.loai_vt in (''41'', ''51'')]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #r b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx) and (a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc <> ''1'') and a.loai = '''' and b.loai_vt in (''41'', ''51'')]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, 0, sum(a.sl_xuat + isnull(a.sl_lech, 0))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from #r b where a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx) and (a.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and ((a.xtab = 2) or (a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc = 0))) and a.loai = '''' and b.loai_vt in (''41'', ''51'')]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT ma_lsx, ma_vt, SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat INTO #sfctpx0 FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_vt
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_lsx, ten_lsx INTO #r0 FROM #r
	--
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, RTRIM(a.ma_lsx) + ' - ' + RTRIM(b.ten_lsx), a.sl_nhap, a.sl_xuat FROM #sfctpx0 a JOIN #r0 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
	UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = @NoGroup WHERE ten_vt IS NULL

	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_lsx', 'ma_lsx, ma_vt', '#report', 'stt', ''

	-- Total
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 0, 0, 0, '', '', @Total, SUM(sl_nhap), SUM(sl_xuat) FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 0, 0, ma_lsx, '', MAX(ten_vt), SUM(sl_nhap), SUM(sl_xuat) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY ma_lsx
	END ELSE INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0

	-- View
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap, a.sl_xuat
			, CASE a.sysorder WHEN 5 THEN SPACE(2) + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END ELSE a.ten_vt END AS ten_vt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY ma_lsx, stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CreateNotifyTMReq]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM hrdtyc a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM hrdtctyc a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số phiếu', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Nội dung', N'Content', dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_nv', 100, '', '', N'Mã nhân viên', N'Employee ID', 'ma_nv', 'ma_nv', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_nv', 150, '', '', N'Họ và tên', N'Employee Name', 'ten_nv', 'ten_nv', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vtr', 150, '', '', N'Vị trí công việc', N'Job Position', 'ten_vtr', 'ten_vtr2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_mh', 100, '', '', N'Môn học', N'Subject', 'ma_mh', 'ma_mh', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_tu', 80, '', '', N'Yêu cầu từ ngày', N'From Date', 'ngay_tu', 'ngay_tu', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_den', 80, '', '', N'Đến ngày', N'To Date', 'ngay_den', 'ngay_den', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'loai_hinh_dt', 100, '', '', N'Loại hình đào tạo', N'Training Type', 'loai_hinh_dt', 'loai_hinh_dt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ghi_chu', 300, '', '', N'Ghi chú', N'Note', 'ghi_chu', 'ghi_chu', 1

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			RTRIM(b.ma_nv) AS ma_nv, b.ten AS ten_nv, c.ten_vtr, c.ten_vtr2, a.ma_mh,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_tu, 103) AS ngay_tu, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_den, 103) AS ngay_den, a.loai_hinh_dt, a.ghi_chu
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN vhrnv b ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON b.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02501', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02501', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', diễn giải: ' + dien_giai,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Description: ' + dien_giai
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Phiếu yêu cầu đào tạo chờ duyệt'', N''Training request waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Phiếu yêu cầu đào tạo chờ duyệt'', N''Training request waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu đào tạo'', N''Training request workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu đào tạo'', N''Training request workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountsLedgerExport] --fs30_AcctLedger15
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Accounts VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Group CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0,
	@Excel TINYINT = 0
/*
	IN LIÊN TỤC
	1 - Excel
	2 - Excel song ngữ
	3 - PDF
	4 - PDF song ngữ
*/
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Account VARCHAR(32), @i INT

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giai2 INTO #tmp2 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 *, tk AS xgroup INTO #tmp FROM #tmp2
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, ma_ct AS ma_ct0, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr, xgroup
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai2, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #report FROM #tmp

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Accounts <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Accounts) ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where tk like [text] + ''%'')' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp2 select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_ct, tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr, dien_giai, '''''
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Xử lý lấy lại tài khoản để lên báo cáo

	IF @Accounts <> '' BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Accounts) BEGIN
			SELECT @Account = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Accounts, @i)
			SELECT @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ''' + @Account + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp2 where ' + @Key
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @i = @i + 1
	   END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Account = MIN([text]) FROM #$keys
		SELECT @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')
		WHILE @Account IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ma_nt, line_nbr, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ''' + @Account + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp2 where ' + @Key
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--			
			SELECT @Account = MIN([text]) FROM #$keys WHERE [text] > @Account
		END
	END

	IF @Group = '1'
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, MAX(a.ngay_ct), MAX(ngay_lct), MAX(a.so_ct), MAX(a.so_ct0), MAX(a.ma_ct), MAX(c.ma_ct_in), MAX(a.tk), a.tk_du, SUM(a.ps_no_nt), SUM(a.ps_co_nt), SUM(a.ps_no), SUM(a.ps_co), MAX(a.ma_nt), 0
					, xgroup, MAX(a.dien_giai), MAX(a.dien_giai2), MAX(c.stt_ct_nkc)
				FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
				GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk_du, a.ma_kh
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, c.ma_ct_in, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_nt, line_nbr
					, xgroup, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai2, c.stt_ct_nkc
				FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct

	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', NULL, NULL, '', '', '', '', text, '', 0, 0, 0, 0, '', 0, text, '', '', 0
			FROM #$keys
			WHERE text NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT xgroup FROM #report)

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s11 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s33 NVARCHAR(511), @AccountName NVARCHAR(511), @AccountName2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname WHEN @Language <> 'V' AND @Excel IN (2, 4) THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s11 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OpBal'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname WHEN @Language <> 'V' AND @Excel IN (2, 4) THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PrA2'
	SELECT @s22 = cname2  FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PrA2'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname WHEN @Language <> 'V' AND @Excel IN (2, 4) THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'
	SELECT @s33 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'
	SELECT @AccountName = cname , @AccountName2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Account'

	-- Tính lại số dư cho nhiều tài khoản
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	DECLARE crAccount CURSOR FOR SELECT xgroup FROM #Report GROUP BY xgroup ORDER BY xgroup
	OPEN crAccount
	FETCH NEXT FROM crAccount INTO @Account
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN
		INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
		SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t

		IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
		IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0
		DELETE FROM #t

		SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)
			FROM #Report WHERE systotal = 1 AND xgroup = @Account

		IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
		IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
		IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
		IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

		SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
		SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, @s11,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, @Account)

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @s22, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt, @Account)

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, @s33,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, @Account)

		IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xgroup, tk) VALUES (4, 1, 0, @Account, @Account)
		END
		IF @Excel = 1 OR @Excel = 2
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xgroup, tk) VALUES (-1, 1, 0, @Account, @Account)
			
		FETCH NEXT FROM crAccount INTO @Account
	END
	CLOSE crAccount
	DEALLOCATE crAccount

	IF @Excel = 1 OR @Excel = 2
		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = -1 AND tk = (SELECT MIN(tk) FROM #report)

	IF @Excel = 2 BEGIN
		UPDATE a SET a.dien_giai = @AccountName + ' ' + RTRIM(b.tk) + ' - '  + b.ten_tk, a.dien_giai2 = @AccountName2 + ' ' + b.ten_tk2 FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE a.sysorder = 4
	END ELSE IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE a SET a.dien_giai = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @AccountName + ' ' + RTRIM(b.tk) + ' - ' + b.ten_tk ELSE @AccountName2 + ' ' + RTRIM(b.tk) + ' - ' + b.ten_tk2 END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE a.sysorder = 4
	END

	--Order
	IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET
			sysorder = CASE sysorder
				WHEN 2 THEN 3
				WHEN 1 THEN 2
				WHEN 0 THEN 1
				WHEN 4 THEN 0
				ELSE sysorder
			END, sysprint = CASE
				WHEN sysorder = 0 THEN 1
				WHEN sysorder = 1 THEN 1
				WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN 1
				ELSE sysprint
			END
			WHERE sysorder IN (0, 1, 2, 4);
		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 5 AND so_ct = '' AND so_ct0 = '' AND dien_giai = '' AND ps_no = 0 AND ps_co = 0 AND ps_no_nt = 0 AND ps_co_nt = 0
	END
	IF @Excel = 3 OR @Excel = 4 BEGIN
		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 0
	END
	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.xgroup AS s_group, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai2, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.xgroup = b.tk
		ORDER BY xgroup, sysorder, ngay_ct, stt, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionFilter](@InspectionField VARCHAR(64), @Inspection VARCHAR(1023), @UserID INT, @Admin BIT)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @InspectionKey VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @InspectionKey = NULL

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN @InspectionKey

	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Inspection = '' BEGIN
			IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bikddmnguon) = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bisysinspectionrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1) BEGIN
				SET @InspectionKey = ''
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @InspectionKey = ISNULL(@InspectionKey, '') + CASE WHEN @InspectionKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_nguon) + '''' FROM bisysinspectionrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @InspectionKey = ISNULL(@InspectionKey, '') + CASE WHEN @InspectionKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_nguon) + '''' FROM bisysinspectionrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND r_access = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_nguon, @Inspection) = 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Inspection <> '' SELECT @InspectionKey = ISNULL(@InspectionKey, '') + CASE WHEN @InspectionKey IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE ',''' END + RTRIM(ma_nguon) + '''' FROM bikddmnguon WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_nguon, @Inspection) = 1
	END

	IF @InspectionKey IS NOT NULL AND @InspectionKey <> '' SET @InspectionKey = '(' + @InspectionField + ' in (' + @InspectionKey + '))'
	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		IF @InspectionKey IS NULL SET @InspectionKey = '(1 = 0)'
		IF @InspectionKey = '' SET @InspectionKey = NULL
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @InspectionKey IS NULL AND @Inspection <> '' SET @InspectionKey = '(1 = 0)'
	END

	RETURN @InspectionKey
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintHRFlatRateTariff]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, g.ma_nv, rtrim(g.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(g.ten_nv) as ten_nv, a.tn_ct, a.tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tien_gt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt, thue_nt, thue'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + @cDTable + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' hrnv g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = g.stt_rec'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 12, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_nv, ten_nv'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByWorkHours]
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Round INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),	
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
/*
	Tính lương bổ sung theo giờ
*/

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @c VARCHAR(512), @i INT, @n INT, @p VARCHAR(6)

/*
	Lấy đơn giá giờ công
*/
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, MAX(a.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl INTO #hr31_t0 FROM hrdgcong a JOIN #hrky b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.ngay_hl <= b.ky_ngay_tu GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, a.don_gia, a.ngay_hl, RTRIM(c.bp_ref) + '%' AS bp_ref, c.bac_bp INTO #hr31_t1 FROM hrdgcong a JOIN #hr31_t0 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, a.don_gia, a.ngay_hl, RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%' AS bp_ref, b.bac_bp INTO #hr31_t2 FROM hrdgcong a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #hrky c ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.ngay_hl > c.ky_ngay_tu AND a.ngay_hl <= c.ky_ngay_den

	-- Tạo bảng lưu các thông tin không thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT a.* INTO #hr31_t3 FROM #hr31_t1 a LEFT JOIN #hr31_t2 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong WHERE b.ma_bp IS NULL
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr31_t3(ma_bp, ma_cong)

	-- Tạo bảng lưu thông tin thay đổi trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #hr31_t2 SELECT a.* FROM #hr31_t1 a LEFT JOIN #hr31_t3 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong WHERE b.ma_bp IS NULL

	-- Tạo bảng giới hạn từ ngày hiệu lực đến ngày kế tiếp
	CREATE TABLE #hr31_t4(ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), don_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME, bp_ref VARCHAR(513),  bac_bp INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #hr31_t4 (ma_bp, ma_cong, don_gia, ngay_tu, bp_ref, bac_bp) SELECT ma_bp, ma_cong, don_gia, ngay_hl, bp_ref, bac_bp FROM #hr31_t2 ORDER BY ma_bp, ma_cong, ngay_hl
	UPDATE #hr31_t4 SET ngay_den = b.ngay_tu - 1 FROM #hr31_t4 a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, ma_cong, ngay_tu, stt - 1 AS stt FROM #hr31_t4) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong AND a.stt = b.stt
	UPDATE #hr31_t4 SET ngay_den = b.ky_ngay_den FROM #hr31_t4 a JOIN #hrky b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.ngay_den IS NULL

	-- Tạo thêm cho các bộ phân khác đối với bảng không thay đổi
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.bp_ref, b.ma_cong, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS don_gia
		INTO #hr31_t5
		FROM hrbp a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_cong FROM #hr31_t3) b
		WHERE a.ma_bp NOT IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM #hr31_t3)

	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #hr31_t3
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		UPDATE #hr31_t5 SET don_gia = b.don_gia
			FROM #hr31_t5 a JOIN #hr31_t3 b ON a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong AND a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref
			WHERE b.bac_bp = @i
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #hr31_t5 WHERE don_gia IS NULL

	INSERT INTO #hr31_t3 (ma_bp, ma_cong, don_gia, ngay_hl) SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, a.don_gia, b.ky_ngay_tu FROM #hr31_t5 a JOIN #hrky b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	-- Tạo thêm cho các bộ phân khác đối với bảng thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.bp_ref, b.ma_cong, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS don_gia
		INTO #hr31_t6
		FROM hrbp a CROSS JOIN #hr31_t4 b
		WHERE a.ma_bp NOT IN (SELECT ma_bp FROM #hr31_t4)

	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #hr31_t4
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		UPDATE #hr31_t6 SET don_gia = b.don_gia
			FROM #hr31_t6 a JOIN #hr31_t4 b ON a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong AND a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref
			WHERE b.bac_bp = @i
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #hr31_t6 WHERE don_gia IS NULL

	INSERT INTO #hr31_t4 (ma_bp, ma_cong, don_gia, ngay_tu, ngay_den) SELECT ma_bp, ma_cong, don_gia, ngay_tu, ngay_den FROM #hr31_t6

	-- Xóa những bộ phận ở bảng không thay đổi có trong bảng thay đổi
	DELETE #hr31_t3 FROM #hr31_t3 a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp, ma_cong FROM #hr31_t4) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong
/*
	Kết thúc lấy đơn giá giờ công
*/
	DECLARE @hstvl31_yn BIT
	SELECT TOP 1 @hstvl31_yn = l31 FROM #hrhstvll

	-- Bảng lưu thông tin thay đổi trong kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #hr31_t7(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), tien NUMERIC(28, 6))
	SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c = 'hrcongth$' + @p
		IF OBJECT_ID(@c) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #hr31_t7 select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong, sum(b.so_gio), sum(b.so_ngay), sum(b.so_gio * a.don_gia' + CASE WHEN @hstvl31_yn = 1 THEN ' * isnull(f.he_so_tv, 1)' ELSE '' END + ')'
				+ ' from #hr31_t4 a'
				+ ' join ' + @c + ' b with (nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong and b.ngay between a.ngay_tu and a.ngay_den'
				+ ' join #hrstt_rec c with (index(stt_rec)) on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
				+ CASE WHEN @hstvl31_yn = 1 THEN ' left join #ttluong f on b.stt_rec = f.stt_rec and b.ngay between f.ngay_tu and f.ngay_den' ELSE '' END
				+ ' group by a.stt, b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong' + CASE WHEN @hstvl31_yn = 1 THEN ', f.ngay_tu' ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @hstvl31_yn = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #hr31_t7 select b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong, sum(b.so_gio), sum(b.so_ngay), sum(b.so_gio * a.don_gia * isnull(f.he_so_tv, 1))'
					+ ' from #hr31_t3 a join #hrky g on g.ma_bp = a.ma_bp'
					+ ' join ' + @c + ' b with (nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong and b.ngay between g.ky_ngay_tu and g.ky_ngay_den'
					+ ' join #hrstt_rec c with (index(stt_rec)) on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
					+ ' left join #ttluong f on b.stt_rec = f.stt_rec and b.ngay between f.ngay_tu and f.ngay_den'
					+ ' group by g.ky_ngay_tu, b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.ma_cong, f.ngay_tu'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @p
	END
	

	-- Tạo bảng lưu thông tin không thay đổi
	IF @hstvl31_yn <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, SUM(a.so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(a.so_ngay) AS so_ngay, SUM(a.so_gio * b.don_gia) AS tien
			INTO #hr31_t8
			FROM #hrcongth a JOIN #hr31_t3 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong
			GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong

		INSERT INTO #hr31_t7 SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien FROM #hr31_t8
	END

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt, ma_cong, SUM(so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(so_ngay) AS so_ngay, ROUND(SUM(tien), @Round) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien0
		INTO #hr31_t9
		FROM #hr31_t7
		GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong

	UPDATE #hr31_t9 SET tien0 = ROUND(a.tien * ISNULL(c.ty_gia, 0), @Round), ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp, ma_nt = b.ma_nt FROM #hr31_t9 a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #hrdmtgtl c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND b.ma_nt = c.ma_nt

/*
	Cập nhật vào các bảng
*/
	SELECT @c = RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' (stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt)'
	SELECT @q = 'insert into hrluongtc$' + @c + ' select stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_nt, ''L31'', ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien0, tien from #hr31_t9'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, SUM(tien) AS l31 INTO #hr31_t10 FROM #hr31_t9 GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp
	CREATE INDEX i ON #hr31_t10(stt_rec, ma_bp)

	UPDATE #hrluong SET l31 = b.l31 FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hr31_t10 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

/*
	Kết thúc cập nhật vào các bảng
*/

END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$PrintRight]
	@Controller VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@OutType CHAR(2) = '00',
	@ReportRight VARCHAR(4000) = '' OUT,
	@FormRight VARCHAR(4000) = '' OUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF (@Admin = 1) RETURN

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r VARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(33), @s VARCHAR(511)

	IF SUBSTRING(@OutType, 1, 1) = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #reportForm (report_id CHAR(3))
		SET @q = 'insert into #reportForm select report_id from ' + @sysDB + '..sysreportidright'
		SET @q = @q + ' where user_id = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ' and controller = ''' + REPLACE(@Controller, '''', '''''') + ''' and r_limit = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @r = ''
		SELECT @r = @r + CASE WHEN @r <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + '''' + RTRIM(report_id) + '''' FROM #reportForm
	
		SET @ReportRight = @r
	END

	IF SUBSTRING(@OutType, 2, 1) = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #printForm (form_id CHAR(3))
		SET @q = 'insert into #printForm select form_id from ' + @sysDB + '..sysreportformidright'
		SET @q = @q + ' where user_id = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ' and controller = ''' + REPLACE(@Controller, '''', '''''') + ''' and r_limit = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @r = ''
		SELECT @r = @r + CASE WHEN @r <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + '''' + RTRIM(form_id) + '''' FROM #printForm
	
		SET @FormRight = @r
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE TRIGGER udmtk2 ON dbo.dmtk2 
FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE 
AS
INSERT INTO dmtk2 (type, tk2, nh_tk2, dau, ten_tk2, ten_tk22, bac, loai)
SELECT 'A', '', nh_tk2, '', '', '', 0, 0
	FROM Inserted WHERE Inserted.nh_tk2 NOT IN (
	SELECT nh_tk2 FROM dmtk2 WHERE tk2 = '')

DELETE dmtk2 WHERE type = 'A' AND tk2 = '' AND nh_tk2 IN (SELECT nh_tk2 FROM Deleted) 
	AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT nh_tk2 FROM dmtk2 WHERE tk2 <> '' AND nh_tk2 
		IN (SELECT nh_tk2 FROM Deleted))

GO

	SELECT a.*, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, c.ten_nv, c.ten_nv2, b.ma_dvcs
		FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmnv c ON a.ma_nv = c.ma_nv
		WHERE 1 = 0

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCBTranExport_v1]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Table CHAR(2),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@printCharge BIT = 0,
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1', --  1: Asc, 2: Desc
	@External TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @Debit NVARCHAR(128), @Credit NVARCHAR(128), @Debit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Credit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Desc INT, @BankAccountUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @f = '', @Voucher = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Debit = cname, @Debit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT053'
	SELECT @Credit = cname, @Credit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT054'

	SELECT @BankAccountUnit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_td_tknh_dv'
	SELECT @BankAccountUnit = ISNULL(@BankAccountUnit, '0')

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, tk_co AS tk, tt, tt_nt, dien_giai, line_nbr INTO #tmp FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(15)) AS xGroup, 1 AS so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ong_ba,
			dien_giai AS ten_kh, dien_giai AS ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc,
			dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2,
			dien_giai AS tknh, dien_giai AS ten_nh, dien_giai AS ten_nh2,
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia,
			ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #m FROM wrkcrtran

	SET @q = 'insert into #m select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec + ''01'', ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ','
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_nk, a.ong_ba, case when a.ong_ba <> '''' then rtrim(a.ong_ba) else rtrim(b.ten_kh) end,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when a.ong_ba <> '''' then rtrim(a.ong_ba) else rtrim(b.ten_kh2) end, a.dia_chi, a.dien_giai,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.tk, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.so_ct_goc, a.dien_giai_ct_goc,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2, c.tknh, c.ten_nh, c.ten_nh2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang,'
	SET @q = @q + ' rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringValue(a.ty_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m' + @Table + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtknh c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk' + CASE WHEN @BankAccountUnit = '1' THEN ' and a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs' ELSE '' END + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, tk_co, tien, tien_nt, dien_giai, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('d' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @printCharge = 1 AND @External = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.dien_giai, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.tk_du, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.dien_giai, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join m46$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, stt_rec + '01'  AS xGroup, tk, tt AS tien, tt_nt AS tien_nt, dien_giai AS dien_giai, CAST(9 AS INT) AS in_yn
		INTO #d FROM #tmp ORDER BY stt_rec, line_nbr

	IF @External = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #d SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01' AS xGroup, tk, SUM(tt) AS tien, SUM(tt_nt) AS tien_nt, MAX(dien_giai) AS dien_giai, CAST(9 AS INT) AS in_yn
		FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk ORDER BY stt_rec, tk
	END ELSE BEGIN	
		INSERT INTO #d(stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, dien_giai, in_yn) 
			SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01' AS xGroup, tk, tt AS tien, tt_nt AS tien_nt, dien_giai AS dien_giai, CAST(9 AS INT) AS in_yn
		FROM #tmp ORDER BY stt_rec, line_nbr
	END

	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #sx FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #d SET in_yn = 3 FROM #d a JOIN #sx b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	IF @External = 0 INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn) SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01', tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, 1 FROM #m

	IF @printCharge = 1 AND @External = 0 BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmp
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_cp, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, a.dien_giai, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, b.tk_thue, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.dien_giai, line_nbr from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('f' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m' + @Table + '$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn) SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '01', tk, SUM(tt) AS tien, SUM(tt_nt) AS tien_nt, 2 FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, tk ORDER BY stt_rec, tk
	END

	IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '02', 2, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt,
			ma_nt, ty_gia, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc,	t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, ngay, thang, nam, chuoi_ty_gia,
			ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, contact_sign FROM #m
		INSERT INTO #d (stt_rec, xGroup, tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn)
			SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec + '02', tk, tien, tien_nt, in_yn FROM #d ORDER BY stt_rec, xGroup, stt, tk
	END

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #m where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#m', '#m', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as stt_rec, xGroup,
		so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, chuoi_ty_gia,
		so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, tknh, ten_nh, ten_nh2, ngay, thang, nam' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
	from #m order by ngay_ct, so_ct, xGroup'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as stt_rec, xGroup,
		so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, tk, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, chuoi_ty_gia,
		so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, tknh, ten_nh, ten_nh2, ngay, thang, nam' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
	from #m order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, xGroup'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Bilingual = '1' SELECT @Debit = @Debit + ':', @Credit = @Credit + ':', @Debit2 = @Debit2 + ':', @Credit2 = @Credit2 + ':'

	IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
		IF @External = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xGroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 3 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 3 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xGroup = b.xGroup order by b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, a.xGroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xGroup, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.dien_giai,
		b.tk as tk_no,
		a.tk as tk_co
	from #d a join #m b on a.xGroup = b.xGroup order by b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, a.xGroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @External = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 3 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 3 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xGroup = b.xGroup order by b.ngay_ct desc, b.so_ct desc, a.xGroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
	select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.dien_giai,
			b.tk as tk_no,
			a.tk as tk_co
		from #d a, #m b  order by b.ngay_ct desc, b.so_ct desc, a.xGroup, in_yn, a.stt, a.tk'
		END
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Debit nvarchar(128), @Credit nvarchar(128), @Debit2 nvarchar(128), @Credit2 nvarchar(128)', @Debit, @Credit, @Debit2, @Credit2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PR]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_kh, sl_duyet, he_so INTO #afterUpdate FROM d91$000000
	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_kh, sl_duyet, he_so from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_kh <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec_kh, SUM(ROUND(sl_duyet * CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END, 3)) AS so_luong INTO #ct91 FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_kh

		UPDATE mrctdh SET sl_da_yc = a.sl_da_yc + b.so_luong, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() FROM mrctdh a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
		UPDATE mrctyc SET sl_da_yc = a.sl_da_yc + b.so_luong,  user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() FROM mrctyc a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
		UPDATE mrctyc SET sl_nhap = CASE WHEN a.sl_dh > a.sl_da_yc THEN a.sl_dh - a.sl_da_yc ELSE 0 END FROM mrctyc a JOIN #ct91 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kh
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeAdjustmentInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(33), @dTable VARCHAR(33), @code VARCHAR(33), @r VARCHAR(33), @tinh_trang_hddt CHAR(1), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @provider INT
	SELECT @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' SELECT @mTable = 'pxdc', @dTable = 'ctpxdc'

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, '', '', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Customer
	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' BEGIN
		IF @Customer <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM khhddt WHERE ma_kh = @Customer AND [status] <> 0) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @Customer AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Replacement
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hddt05 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Modify Date
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Status E-Invoice
	IF @provider <> 3 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''' and b.tinh_trang_hddt <> ''0'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Reference Voucher
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @rOut = isnull(stt_rec_px, ''''), @codeOut = so_ct, @vCode = right(stt_rec_px, 3) from ' + @dTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''' order by stt_rec_px desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@rOut char(13) output, @codeOut varchar(33) output, @vCode varchar(33) output', @r OUTPUT, @code OUTPUT, @vCode OUTPUT

	IF (@r = '') BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' SELECT @refp = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@vCode, @r)

		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @x = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hddt00$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @r + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x char(1) output', @x = @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

		IF @tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt NOT IN ('2','3') BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--
	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetCustomerUnit]
	@tableName VARCHAR(33),
	@userID INT,
	@admin TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT @tableName = REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from khhddt a join ' + REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '''''') + ' b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where not exists(select 1 from ctkhhddt c where a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh)) begin'
		+ CHAR(13) + '   select ma_kn from tkhddtdv where status = 1 group by ma_kn'
		+ CHAR(13) + ' end else begin'
		+ CHAR(13) + '   select distinct c.ma_kn from ' + REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '''''') + ' a join ctkhhddt b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh join tkhddtdv c on b.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs where c.status = 1'
		+ CHAR(13) + ' end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPITran] --fs_PrintPOTran
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table VARCHAR(32), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @mt_nt VARCHAR(32), @mt VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Table = REPLACE(@Table, '''', ''), @mt_nt = CASE WHEN @Voucher = 'PO2' THEN ' + a.bvmt_nt' ELSE '' END, @mt = CASE WHEN @Voucher = 'PO2' THEN ' + a.bvmt' ELSE '' END
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong'
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1')
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt0 as gia_nt, a.gia0 as gia, a.tien_nt0 as tien_nt, a.tien0 as tien, a.nk_nt + a.ttdb_nt' + @mt_nt + ' + a.thue_nt as thue_nt, a.nk + a.ttdb ' + @mt + ' + a.thue as thue, a.nk_nt, a.nk, a.ttdb_nt, a.ttdb'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.nk_nt, a.nk, a.ttdb_nt, a.ttdb'
	
	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt' -- song ngữ
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ngay_giao, a.ngay_ct, stt_rec_nc, isnull(b.so_ct, '''') as so_nc'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt left outer join c91$000000 b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_giao smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_ct smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 ngay_giao from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
