CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPRun] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Check Locked Precess
	IF dbo.ff_GetLockedProcess('CRP') = 1 RETURN

	-- Lock Process
	EXEC fs_LockProcess 'CRP'

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nCRPRunType INT, @dStart DATETIME, @i INT

	SELECT @dStart = GETDATE()

	-- Set
	SELECT @nPeriodCount = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_ky_hd_crp'
	SELECT @cDefaultPeriod = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hd_nd_crp'
	SELECT @nCRPRunType = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_pp_hd_crp'

	-- Calc capacity available
	EXEC rs_RCCPRunCalcAvailableCapacity @dNow, @cDefaultPeriod, @nPeriodCount, @nUserID

	-- Calc capacity coeff
	EXEC rs_RCCPRunCalcCapacityCoeff @dNow, @cDefaultPeriod, @nPeriodCount, @nCRPRunType, @nUserID

	-- Calc capacity requirement for resources
	EXEC rs_RCCPRunCalcRequirementCapacity @dNow, @cDefaultPeriod, @nPeriodCount, @nCRPRunType, @nUserID

	-- Calculate
	EXEC rs_RCCPRunAllocatedCapacity @dNow, @cDefaultPeriod, @nPeriodCount, @nCRPRunType, @nUserID

	-- Update Order Quantity of Period
	EXEC rs_RCCPRunUpdateOrderQuantity

	-- Unlock Process
	EXEC fs_UnlockProcess 'CRP'

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crlog)
		INSERT INTO crlog (run_date, run_type, user_id, start_time, finish_time) VALUES (@dNow, @nCRPRunType, @nUserID, @dStart, GETDATE())
	ELSE
		UPDATE crlog SET run_date = @dNow, run_type = @nCRPRunType, user_id = @nUserID, start_time = @dStart, finish_time = GETDATE()

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CreateNotifyRMReq]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM hrrmyc a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM hrrmycct a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số phiếu', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Nội dung', N'Content', dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vtr', 100, '', '', N'Mã vị trí', N'Position Code', 'ma_vtr', 'ma_vtr2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vtr', 300, '', '', N'Tên vị trí công việc', N'Position Name', 'ten_vtr', 'ten_vtr2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ky_nang_yc', 150, '', '', N'Kỹ năng yêu cầu', N'Required Skills', 'ky_nang_yc', 'ky_nang_yc', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_tu', 80, '', '', N'Yêu cầu từ ngày', N'From Date', 'ngay_tu', 'ngay_tu', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_den', 80, '', '', N'Đến ngày', N'To Date', 'ngay_den', 'ngay_den', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ghi_chu', 300, '', '', N'Ghi chú', N'Note', 'ghi_chu', 'ghi_chu', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vtr) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vtr, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vtr) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vtr2, b.ten_vtr, b.ten_vtr2, a.ky_nang_yc,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_tu, 103) AS ngay_tu, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_den, 103) AS ngay_den, a.ghi_chu,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN hrvt b ON a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vtr, ma_vtr2, so_luong)
		SELECT '[ma_vtr]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng cộng', N'Total Quantity', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_so_luong, @quantityFormat)
		FROM #master


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02801', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '02801', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', diễn giải: ' + dien_giai,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Description: ' + dien_giai
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Phiếu yêu cầu tuyển dụng chờ duyệt'', N''Recruitment request waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Phiếu yêu cầu tuyển dụng chờ duyệt'', N''Recruitment request waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu tuyển dụng'', N''Recruitment request workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu tuyển dụng'', N''Recruitment request workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Accumulate$Investment]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dE SMALLDATETIME, @isFirst BIT, @dBgSolar SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dE = dbo.ff_BgDate(@Date), @isFirst = 0, @dBgSolar = CAST(STR(YEAR(@dE), 4) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt INTO #tabRet FROM dtlkct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE) BEGIN -- The 1st year
		SET @q = 'insert into #tabret select ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dtlkct with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@Date)) + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @isFirst = 1
	END

	IF @isFirst = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tabret select ma_so, ma_vv, sum(lk_no + lk_no_dk), sum(lk_co + lk_co_dk), sum(lk_no_nt + lk_no_dk_nt), sum(lk_co_nt + lk_co_dk_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dtlkct with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dE)) + @Key + ' group by ma_so, ma_vv'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_vv, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1'' and ma_vv <> ''''' + @Key
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by ma_vv, tk, tk_du'
		SET @dE = @dE - 1
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dBgSolar, @dE, @UserID, @Admin

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ct00) BEGIN
			DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @tk_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_co VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_gt VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_gt VARCHAR(32)

			SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_gt,
					REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_gt,
					CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', tk_no) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_du) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_du) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype
				INTO #dtdmct FROM dtdmct WITH(NOLOCK)

			UPDATE #dtdmct SET tk_no = tk_no + '%', tk_no_du = tk_no_du + '%', tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt + '%', tk_co = tk_co + '%', tk_co_du = tk_co_du + '%', tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt + '%' WHERE xtype = 0

			SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1
			WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @tk_no = tk_no, @tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt, @tk_no_du = tk_no_du, @tk_co = tk_co, @tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt, @tk_co_du = tk_co_du FROM #dtdmct WHERE ma_so = @ma_so

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', b.data + '%', '', '', '', '', 2
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_du, ',') b

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', '', c.data + '%', '', '', '', 3
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_gt, ',') c

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', e.data + '%', '', 4
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_du, ',') e

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', '', f.data + '%', 5
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_gt, ',') f

				--
				SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1 AND ma_so > @ma_so
			END
			DELETE #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ps_no, 0, a.ps_no_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_du AND ps_no <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 2)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, - a.ps_co, 0, - a.ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_gt AND ps_co <> 0 AND tk_no_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 3)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, 0, a.ps_co, 0, a.ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_du AND ps_co <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 4)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, 0, - a.ps_no, 0, - a.ps_no_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_gt AND ps_no <> 0 AND tk_co_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 5)
		END
	END

	SELECT ma_so, ma_vv, SUM(lk_no), SUM(lk_co), SUM(lk_no_nt), SUM(lk_co_nt), SUM(lk_no_dk), SUM(lk_co_dk), SUM(lk_no_dk_nt), SUM(lk_co_dk_nt)
		FROM #tabRet GROUP BY ma_so, ma_vv

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs30_ExecReUpdateERD  @nCycle TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cFC VARCHAR(33), @cSysDB CHAR(32) 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @cVC CHAR(3)
		, @m_phdbf VARCHAR(16), @m_ctdbf VARCHAR(16), @groupby VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nCycle)

	CREATE TABLE #vc (ma_ct CHAR(3), vc_type CHAR(1), m_phdbf VARCHAR(16), m_ctdbf VARCHAR(16), groupby VARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #vc SELECT a.ma_ct, b.type, a.m_phdbf, a.m_ctdbf, '' FROM dmct a JOIN gltgdd b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE b.type IN ('1', '2')

	SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #vc SET groupby = b.groupby FROM #vc a JOIN ' + @cSysDB + '..voucherinfo b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	DECLARE VCCur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct FROM ct00 a WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) JOIN #vc b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		WHERE  a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND ma_nt = @cFC AND a.loai_ct IN ('1', '2', '9')
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct
		ORDER BY MAX(a.ngay_ct), MAX(b.vc_type), MAX(a.so_ct)
	OPEN VCCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM VCCur INTO @cIDNumber, @cVC
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @m_phdbf = m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf = m_ctdbf, @groupby = groupby FROM #vc WHERE ma_ct = @cVC
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #vc WHERE ma_ct = @cVC AND vc_type = '1')
				EXEC fs30_ReCaclReceiveERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby
			ELSE
				EXEC fs30_ReCaclPaymentERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby

			FETCH NEXT FROM VCCur INTO @cIDNumber, @cVC
		END
	CLOSE VCCur
	DEALLOCATE VCCur
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Check idNumber access

	DECLARE @provider INT
	SELECT @provider = dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt WHERE ma_kn = @Account

	IF @provider <> 8 RETURN


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	SELECT @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hrc01$000000 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt_rec as [key], a.keys as so_bi_mat, rtrim(a.ma_dvcs) as ma_dvcs, ''' + @p + ''' as ky from hrm01$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountsTFormExport] --fs_AcctsTForm
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Accounts VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Excel TINYINT = 0
/*
	IN LIÊN TỤC
	1 - Excel
*/
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @i INT, @Account VARCHAR(33)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, tk AS xgroup, dien_giai INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'status = ''1'''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Accounts <> '' THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', @Accounts) ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where tk like [text] + ''%'')' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']% group by tk, tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Xử lý lấy lại tài khoản để lên báo cáo
	SET @i = 1
	IF @Accounts <> '' BEGIN
		WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Accounts) BEGIN
			SELECT @Account = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Accounts, @i)
			SELECT @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

			SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''' + @Account + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ' , max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_tk' ELSE 'b.ten_tk2' END + ')'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk where ' + @Key + ' group by tk_du'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Account = MIN([text]) FROM #$keys
		SELECT @Account = REPLACE(@Account, '''', '')
		WHILE @Account IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
			SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

			SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''' + @Account + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ' , max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_tk' ELSE 'b.ten_tk2' END + ')'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk where ' + @Key + ' group by tk_du'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			--
			SELECT @Account = MIN([text]) FROM #$keys WHERE [text] > @Account
		END
	END

	IF @Accounts <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, tk, '''' from dmtk where tk not in (select distinct xgroup from #report) and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'exactinlist', @Accounts)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', 0, 0, 0, 0, text, ''
				FROM #$keys
				WHERE text NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT xgroup FROM #report)
	END

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @AccountName NVARCHAR(511), @AccountName2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- Balance
	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'CLBAL'
	SELECT @AccountName = cname , @AccountName2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Account'

	-- Tính lại số dư cho nhiều tài khoản
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	DECLARE crAccount CURSOR FOR SELECT xgroup FROM #Report GROUP BY xgroup ORDER BY xgroup
	OPEN crAccount
	FETCH NEXT FROM crAccount INTO @Account
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0 BEGIN
		INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
		SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t

		IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
		IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0
		DELETE FROM #t

		SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(Ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(Ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)
			FROM #Report WHERE systotal = 1 AND xgroup = @Account

		IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
		IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
		IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
		IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

		SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
		SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (0, 1, 0, @s1,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, @Account)

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (1, 1, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt, @Account)

		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, xgroup)
			VALUES (2, 1, 0, @s3,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END,
				CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, @Account)

		IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xgroup) VALUES (4, 1, 0, @Account)
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xgroup) VALUES (-1, 1, 0, @Account)
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crAccount INTO @Account
	END
	CLOSE crAccount
	DEALLOCATE crAccount

	IF @Excel = 1 OR @Excel = 2
		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = -1 AND xgroup = (SELECT MIN(xgroup) FROM #report)

	IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET dien_giai = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @AccountName + ' ' + RTRIM(xgroup) ELSE @AccountName2 + ' ' + RTRIM(xgroup) END FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 4
	END
	--Order
	IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report
			SET sysorder = CASE sysorder
				WHEN 2 THEN 3
				WHEN 1 THEN 2
				WHEN 0 THEN 1
				WHEN 4 THEN 0
				ELSE sysorder
			END, sysprint = CASE
				WHEN sysorder = 0 THEN 1
				WHEN sysorder = 1 THEN 1
				WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN 1
				ELSE sysprint
			END
			WHERE sysorder IN (0, 1, 2, 4);
	END
	DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 5 AND dien_giai = '' AND ps_no = 0 AND ps_co = 0 AND ps_no_nt = 0 AND ps_co_nt = 0

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, xgroup AS s_Group
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk
		ORDER BY xgroup, sysorder, tk_du

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJournalVoucherExport] -- fs_ReportJDetailAccount
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Invoice VARCHAR(4000), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct AS ngay_ctgs, so_ct AS so_ctgs, tk AS tk_no, tk AS tk_co
			, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt, ps_no AS tien, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_tk_no, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_tk_no2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_tk_co, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_tk_co2, tk, tk_du
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	IF @Invoice = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Invoice = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ps_no +  a.ps_no_nt <> 0' 
	SELECT @key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Invoice <> '' THEN 'a.so_ctgs + convert(char(8), a.ngay_ctgs, 112) in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Invoice, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + a.so_ctgs + convert(char(8), a.ngay_ctgs, 112) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk, a.tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_no, '''', '''', '''', '''', a.tk, a.tk_du'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	
	SELECT ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, COUNT(stt_rec) AS so_ctgs_goc INTO #count FROM #report a GROUP BY  ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs
	
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, MAX(d.no_co) AS no_co
			, MAX(b.ten_tk) AS ten_tk_no, MAX(b.ten_tk2) AS ten_tk_no2
			, MAX(c.ten_tk) AS ten_tk_co, MAX(c.ten_tk2) AS ten_tk_co2, MAX(e.so_ctgs_goc) AS so_ctgs_goc
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_du = c.tk
			LEFT JOIN ctgs d ON a.so_ctgs = d.so_ctgs AND a.ngay_ctgs = d.ngay_ctgs
			LEFT JOIN #count e ON a.so_ctgs = e.so_ctgs AND a.ngay_ctgs = e.ngay_ctgs
		WHERE a.ngay_ctgs IS NOT NULL
		GROUP BY a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk_no, a.tk_co
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, a.tk_no, a.tk_co

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintHRProgressiveTaxTariff]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, g.ma_nv, rtrim(g.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(g.ten_nv) as ten_nv, a.tn_ct, a.tn_ct_nt'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + @cDTable + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' hrnv g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = g.stt_rec'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Generate$DynamicStructureSplit] @numberID VARCHAR(32), @action VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3)

	IF @action = 'Delete' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmbbnct WHERE stt_rec = @numberID AND status = 1) BEGIN
		DELETE ctdmbbncttk WHERE stt_rec = @numberID
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN
	END

	DELETE ctdmbbncttk WHERE stt_rec = @numberID
	SELECT * INTO #ctdmbbnct FROM ctdmbbnct WHERE stt_rec = @numberID

	SELECT @q = '', @stt_rec0 = MIN(stt_rec0) FROM #ctdmbbnct
	SELECT @numberID = REPLACE(@numberID, '''', '')

	WHILE @stt_rec0 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @stt_rec0 = REPLACE(@stt_rec0, '''', '')
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ds_tk, '''', ''), ', ', ','), ',', ''';insert into ctdmbbncttk select ''' + @numberID + ''', ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''', ''') FROM #ctdmbbnct WHERE stt_rec0 = @stt_rec0
		IF @q <> '' SELECT @q = 'insert into ctdmbbncttk select ''' + @numberID + ''', ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''', ''' + @q + ''''
		ELSE SELECT @q = 'insert into ctdmbbncttk select ''' + @numberID + ''', ''' + @stt_rec0 + ''', '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @stt_rec0 = MIN(stt_rec0) FROM #ctdmbbnct WHERE stt_rec0 > @stt_rec0
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollCoefficientFields]
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f VARCHAR(2048), @s VARCHAR(32), @v VARCHAR(32), @c CHAR(1), @i INT, @j BIT, @l INT, @k INT, @e VARCHAR(12), @r VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT ma_loai_lg, RTRIM(cong_thuc) AS cach_tinh, status INTO #loailuong FROM #hrloailuong WHERE kieu = '1'
	SELECT @e = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #loailuong

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#loailuong', @UserID, @Admin, default, 2

	-- Process
	WHILE @e IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = LOWER(RTRIM(@e)), @f = '(' + RTRIM(cach_tinh) + ')', @r = status FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @e

		SELECT @q = 'alter table #hrluong add ' + @s + ' numeric(28, 6)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @f <> '()' AND @r = '1' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '', @v = '', @j = 0, @i = 1, @l = LEN(@f)
			WHILE @i <= @l BEGIN
				SELECT @c = SUBSTRING(@f, @i, 1)
				SELECT @k = ASCII(@c)
				IF @c = '@' SELECT @v = '', @j = 1
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF @j = 1 AND ((@k BETWEEN 48 AND 57) OR (@k BETWEEN 65 AND 90) OR (@k BETWEEN 97 AND 122) OR @k = 95) SELECT @v = @v + @c
					ELSE BEGIN
						IF @j = 1 BEGIN
							SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'declare @' + @v + ' numeric(28, 6)'
							SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @' + @v + ' = cast(rtrim(val) as numeric(28, 6)) from options where upper(name) = ''' + UPPER(REPLACE(@v, '''', '''''')) + ''''
							SELECT @v = '', @j = 0
						END
					END
				END
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END

			SELECT @f = REPLACE(@f, '!', 'b.')
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #hrluong set ' + @s + ' = ' + REPLACE(@f, '''', '''''') + ' from #hrluong a join hrttluong b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		--
		SELECT @e = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg > @e
	END
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$BContract]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@BContract VARCHAR(33),
	@ContractType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Borrow, 2 - Lend
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Contract, 2 Multi Contract
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_ku, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdku

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @BContract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(@BContract, '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_ku, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdku a with(nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_ku)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_ku'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1	SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_ku, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_ku'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(case when b.loai_ku = ''1'' then (a.du_co - a.du_no) else (a.du_no - a.du_co) end), 0) as du'
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(sum(case when b.loai_ku = ''1'' then (a.du_co_nt - a.du_no_nt) else (a.du_no_nt - a.du_co_nt) end), 0) as du_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t a join dmku b on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_ku'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_ku order by tk, ma_ku'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO

SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.loai_tn, a.tn_ld_yn, a.ngay_tn, a.so_ngay_nghi, a.muc_do, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2,

	FROM hretn AS a LEFT JOIN hrdmtn AS b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_tn

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_DeleteAllocPeriod]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Action VARCHAR(8)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @stt_rec CHAR(13), @ma_bt VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME

	SET @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SET @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	--
	IF @Action = 'Delete' SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'Delete')
	IF @Action = 'New' SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')

	--
	SET @Key = 'stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @s = 'delete ctpbky where ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) +' and ma_bt = ''%ma_bt''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'delete from ct00 where ' + @Key
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'delete from r00$%partition where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists(select 1 from r00$%partition where stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'') update dmpbky1 set stt_rec = '''' where ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) +' and ma_bt = ''%ma_bt''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	--
	DECLARE csTran CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_bt, stt_rec FROM dmpbky1 WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND tag <> 0
	OPEN csTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @ma_bt, @stt_rec
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%stt_rec', RTRIM(@stt_rec)), '%ma_bt', RTRIM(@ma_bt))
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @ma_bt, @stt_rec
			END
	CLOSE csTran
	DEALLOCATE csTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRMTestInterviewSchedule]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@PeriodCode VARCHAR(33),
	@RoundCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Applicant VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @exists CHAR(1)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS stt_pdf, a.ma_hs, c.ho_uv + SPACE(1) + c.ten_uv AS ten, c.dien_thoai AS dien_thoai_uv, c.email AS email_uv, f.ten_vtr
			, b.nguoi_pv, b.ngay_pv, b.thoi_gian_pv, b.dia_diem_pv, b.noi_dung_pv, b.ghi_chu, f.stt AS stt_vtr, b.ma_vtr
			, a.ma_dot, d.ngay_ct, d.ten_dot, b.ma_vong, e.ten_vong, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #report
		FROM hrrmlichctuv a, hrrmlichct b, hrrmhs c, hrrmdot d, hrdmvongtd e, hrvt f

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('c.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @exists = '0'
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'g', 'g', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ngay_pv between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @PeriodCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dot like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @RoundCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vong like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@RoundCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Applicant <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hs like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Applicant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_hs, rtrim(c.ho_uv) + space(1) + c.ten_uv AS ten, c.dien_thoai, c.email'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', isnull(f.ten_vtr%l, ''''), b.nguoi_pv, b.ngay_pv, b.thoi_gian_pv, b.dia_diem_pv, b.noi_dung_pv, b.ghi_chu'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', f.stt, b.ma_vtr, a.ma_dot, d.ngay_ct, d.ten_dot%l, b.ma_vong, isnull(e.ten_vong%l, '''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrrmlichctuv a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrrmlichct b with(nolock) on a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot and a.stt_rec0lich = b.stt_rec0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' join hrrmhs c with(nolock) on a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot and a.ma_hs = c.ma_hs'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrrmdot d with(nolock) on a.ma_dot = d.ma_dot'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrdmvongtd e with(nolock) on b.ma_vong = e.ma_vong'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt f with(nolock) on b.ma_vtr = f.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrbp g with(nolock) on g.ma_bp = c.ma_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by d.ngay_ct, a.ma_dot, b.ma_vong, f.stt, b.ma_vtr, a.ma_hs'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, ma_hs INTO #o FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #o (ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, ma_hs) SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, ma_hs FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, ma_hs
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vong
	UPDATE #report SET stt_pdf = b.id - c.id + 1
		FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct AND a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_vong = b.ma_vong AND a.ma_hs = b.ma_hs AND a.stt_vtr = b.stt_vtr AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr
						 JOIN #g c ON a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct AND a.ma_vong = c.ma_vong AND a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot

	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_pdf, ma_vong, ma_dot, ten_dot, ma_vtr, ma_hs, ten_vtr, ten_vong)
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		SET @exists = '1'
	END

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN @exists = '0' THEN stt ELSE 0 END AS stt, stt_pdf, ma_hs, ten, dien_thoai_uv, email_uv
			, ten_vtr, stt_vtr, nguoi_pv, ngay_pv, thoi_gian_pv, dia_diem_pv, noi_dung_pv, ghi_chu, ma_dot, ten_dot, ma_vong, ten_vong
		FROM #report ORDER BY stt, ma_vong, stt_pdf

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPRunCalcAvailableCapacity] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT, @nSo_ngay INT, @dNgay_bd SMALLDATETIME, @dNgay_kt SMALLDATETIME

	-- Tinh lai ngay ket thuc cho bien so cong suat (truong hop thay doi lich nghi)
	UPDATE crdmctnl SET ngay_kt = dbo.mf_GetNetForwardDate(ngay_bd, so_ngay - 1)

	-- Delete database
	DELETE crnlsx

	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @nPeriodCount
		BEGIN
			SET @dNgay_bd = dbo.cf_GetNetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 1, 0, 1)
			SET @dNgay_kt = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 1, 1)
			SET @nSo_ngay = dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dNgay_bd, @dNgay_kt, 1)

			INSERT INTO crnlsx
				(
					ky, ma_nl, loai_nl, cong_suat, cs_dc
					, ngay_bd, ngay_kt, so_ngay
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
				SELECT @i, ma_nl, loai_nl, dbo.cf_RCCPGetCapacityOfDays(ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @dNgay_kt, 1), dbo.cf_RCCPGetCapacityOfDays(ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @dNgay_kt, 2)
						, @dNgay_bd, @dNgay_kt, @nSo_ngay
						, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
					FROM crdmnl
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Accumulate$Norm]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dE SMALLDATETIME, @isFirst BIT, @dBgSolar SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dE = dbo.ff_BgDate(@Date), @isFirst = 0, @dBgSolar = CAST(STR(YEAR(@dE), 4) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt INTO #tabRet FROM v20vvlkct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE) BEGIN -- The 1st year
		SET @q = 'insert into #tabret select ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from v20vvlkct with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@Date)) + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @isFirst = 1
	END

	IF @isFirst = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tabret select ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs, sum(lk_no + lk_no_dk), sum(lk_co + lk_co_dk), sum(lk_no_nt + lk_no_dk_nt), sum(lk_co_nt + lk_co_dk_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from v20vvlkct with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dE)) + @Key + ' group by ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_vv, ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1'' and ma_vv <> ''''' + @Key
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by ma_vv, ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'
		SET @dE = @dE - 1
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dBgSolar, @dE, @UserID, @Admin

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ct00) BEGIN
			DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @tk_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_co VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_gt VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_gt VARCHAR(32)

			SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_gt,
				REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_gt,
				CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', tk_no) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_du) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_du) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype
			INTO #v20dmvvct FROM dtdmct WITH(NOLOCK)
			UPDATE #v20dmvvct SET tk_no = tk_no + '%', tk_no_du = tk_no_du + '%', tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt + '%', tk_co = tk_co + '%', tk_co_du = tk_co_du + '%', tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt + '%' WHERE xtype = 0

			SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #v20dmvvct WHERE xtype = 1
			WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @tk_no = tk_no, @tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt, @tk_no_du = tk_no_du, @tk_co = tk_co, @tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt, @tk_co_du = tk_co_du FROM #v20dmvvct WHERE ma_so = @ma_so

				INSERT INTO #v20dmvvct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', b.data + '%', '', '', '', '', 2
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_du, ',') b

				INSERT INTO #v20dmvvct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', '', c.data + '%', '', '', '', 3
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_gt, ',') c

				INSERT INTO #v20dmvvct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', e.data + '%', '', 4
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_du, ',') e

				INSERT INTO #v20dmvvct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', '', f.data + '%', 5
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_gt, ',') f

				--
				SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #v20dmvvct WHERE xtype = 1 AND ma_so > @ma_so
			END
			DELETE #v20dmvvct WHERE xtype = 1

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ma_dvcs, a.ps_no, 0, a.ps_no_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #v20dmvvct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_du AND ps_no <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 2)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ma_dvcs, - a.ps_co, 0, - a.ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #v20dmvvct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_gt AND ps_co <> 0 AND tk_no_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 3)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ma_dvcs, 0, a.ps_co, 0, a.ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #v20dmvvct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_du AND ps_co <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 4)

			INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ma_dvcs, 0, - a.ps_no, 0, - a.ps_no_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #ct00 a, #v20dmvvct b
				WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_gt AND ps_no <> 0 AND tk_co_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 5)
		END
	END

	SELECT ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs, SUM(lk_no_dk), SUM(lk_co_dk), SUM(lk_no), SUM(lk_co), SUM(lk_no_dk_nt), SUM(lk_co_dk_nt), SUM(lk_no_nt), SUM(lk_co_nt)
		FROM #tabRet GROUP BY ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterConvertInvoiceTaxDeduction]

	END


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountTForm] --fs_AcctTForm--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s32 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmtk b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_tk, ten_tk2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(tk))'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk_du'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5 , 1 , 1, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk2) ELSE '' END
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk GROUP BY tk_du

	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = cname, @s22 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = cname, @s32 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'CLBAL'
	
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t
	
	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, @s12, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @s22, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, @s32, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES (3, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0)

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, tk_du
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

























GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPV0Tran]
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0 -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 8, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintRDTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.so_phieu, a.ngay_phieu, a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.tt_nt, a.tt_qd, a.ma_nt_hd, a.ty_gia_hd, a.tt, cast('''' as varchar(128)) as chuoi_ty_gia, cast('''' as varchar(128)) as chuoi_ty_gia_hd'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg' AND CAST(val AS INT) > 10) BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'declare @s nvarchar(4000)'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'set @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringColumn(''#report'', ''ty_gia'', ''chuoi_ty_gia'')'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @s'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'set @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringColumn(''#report'', ''ty_gia_hd'', ''chuoi_ty_gia_hd'')'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @s'
	END

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 13, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''so_phieu, ma_nt, ma_nt_hd'', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByEmulation]
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Round INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
/*
	Tính lương dựa vào kết quả bình bầu hệ số khen thưởng
	Công thức tính: (Lương thời gian + Lương sản phẩm + Lương khoán) * Hệ số
*/	
	SELECT a.stt_rec, c.he_so INTO #hr71_t0 FROM hrctloaikt a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN  hrdmloaikt c ON a.loai_kt = c.ma_loai WHERE a.ky = @Period AND a.nam = @Year AND c.status = '1'
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #hr71_t0(stt_rec)

	-- Cập nhật bảng lương
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l71 = ROUND((ISNULL(a.l01, 0) + ISNULL(a.l11, 0) + ISNULL(a.l12, 0) + ISNULL(a.l21, 0) - ISNULL(a.l51, 0) - ISNULL(a.l53, 0)) * b.he_so, @Round) FROM #hrluong a JOIN #hr71_t0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollInformation]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(512), @i INT, @n INT

/*
	Dữ liệu bảng thông tin lương (#ttluong)
*/



	-- Xác định thông tin lương (#ttluong) không thay đổi (nhieu_doan = 0) và có thay đổi (nhieu_doan = 1) trong kỳ tính lương
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ngach, a.ma_bac, a.he_so_luong, a.tien_khoan, a.ngay_hl, CASE WHEN a.ngay_hl < d.ky_ngay_tu THEN d.ky_ngay_tu ELSE a.ngay_hl END AS ngay_tu 
		INTO #ttluong_max FROM hrttctluong a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (
				SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl, MAX(b.ky_ngay_tu) AS ky_ngay_tu FROM hrttctluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl <= b.ky_ngay_tu GROUP BY a.stt_rec
			) d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = d.ngay_hl
	INSERT INTO #ttluong_max SELECT b.stt_rec, b.ma_ngach, b.ma_bac, b.he_so_luong, b.tien_khoan, NULL, a.ky_ngay_tu FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN hrttluong b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #ttluong_max)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ttluong_max(stt_rec)

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ngach, a.ma_bac, a.he_so_luong, a.tien_khoan, a.ngay_hl
		INTO #ttluong_td FROM hrttctluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_hl > b.ky_ngay_tu AND a.ngay_hl <= b.ky_ngay_den

	CREATE INDEX i ON #ttluong(stt_rec)
	CREATE INDEX nhieu_doan ON #ttluong(nhieu_doan)

	INSERT INTO #ttluong(stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu) 
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu FROM #ttluong_max WHERE stt_rec NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #ttluong_td)

	INSERT INTO #ttluong(stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu) 
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu FROM #ttluong_max WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #ttluong_td)

	INSERT INTO #ttluong(stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu)
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_hl FROM #ttluong_td

	-- Xác định từng đoạn thời gian từ/đến
	SELECT stt_rec, COUNT(*) AS n INTO #nhieudoan FROM #ttluong GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #ttluong SET nhieu_doan = CASE WHEN b.n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM #ttluong a JOIN #nhieudoan b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #ttluong_o FROM #ttluong WHERE nhieu_doan = 1 ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_tu
	UPDATE #ttluong SET ngay_den = c.ngay_tu - 1 FROM #ttluong a JOIN #ttluong_o b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND ISNULL(a.ngay_tu, 0) = ISNULL(b.ngay_tu, 0) JOIN #ttluong_o c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.stt = c.stt - 1
	UPDATE #ttluong SET ngay_den = b.ky_ngay_den FROM #ttluong a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ngay_den IS NULL

	-- Xác định bộ phận theo từng đoạn trong thông tin lương
	UPDATE #ttluong SET ma_bp = b.bo_phan FROM #ttluong a LEFT JOIN hreqtlvht b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN (
		SELECT f.stt_rec, e.ngay_den, MAX(f.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu
			FROM #ttluong e JOIN hreqtlvht f WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.stt_rec = f.stt_rec 
			WHERE f.tinh_chat = 1 AND f.ngay_tu <= e.ngay_den GROUP BY f.stt_rec, e.ngay_den
		) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = c.ngay_den AND b.ngay_tu = c.ngay_tu
	UPDATE #ttluong SET ma_bp = b.bo_phan FROM #ttluong a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_bp IS NULL

	-- Lấy dữ liệu để chia đoạn theo quá trình làm việc
	INSERT INTO #ttluongqtbp SELECT * FROM #ttluong

	-- Xác định hệ số thử việc ứng với bp của từng đoạn trong thông tin lương
	-- Chèn thêm thời gian hợp đồng thử việc: nếu đoạn thời gian đó giao với thời gian thử việc và bp ở đoạn đó có khai báo hệ số thử việc.
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrhstvll WHERE status = '1') BEGIN -- Chỉ xét khi tồn tại Loại lương có xử lý hệ số thử việc
		SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(ISNULL(b.ngay_hl_den, a.ky_ngay_den)) AS ngay_hd_den, MAX(a.ky_ngay_den) AS ky_ngay_den
			INTO #thuviec FROM #hrstt_rec a JOIN hrcthd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN hrdmloaihd c ON b.loai_hd = c.ma_loai
			WHERE c.tinh_chat = '2' AND b.ngay_hl_tu <= a.ky_ngay_den AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ky_ngay_tu)
			GROUP BY a.stt_rec

		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, CASE WHEN a.ngay_den <= b.ngay_hd_den THEN a.ngay_den ELSE b.ngay_hd_den END AS ngay_den, a.ma_bp, c.bp_ref, 
				CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS he_so, CASE WHEN a.ngay_den <= b.ngay_hd_den THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS chen_them
			INTO #ttluongtv FROM #ttluong a JOIN #thuviec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay_hd_den JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

		SELECT DISTINCT b.ma_bp, b.ngay_hl, b.he_so, c.bp_ref
			INTO #hrhstv FROM #ttluongtv a JOIN hrhstv b ON b.ngay_hl <= a.ngay_den JOIN hrbp c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.bp_ref LIKE c.bp_ref + '%'

		UPDATE #ttluongtv SET he_so = c.he_so, chen_them = CASE WHEN c.he_so IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE chen_them END FROM #ttluongtv a
			JOIN (
				SELECT g.stt_rec, g.ngay_den, MAX(h.bp_ref) AS bp_ref
					FROM #ttluongtv g JOIN #hrhstv h ON h.ngay_hl <= g.ngay_den AND g.bp_ref LIKE h.bp_ref + '%'
					GROUP BY g.stt_rec, g.ngay_den
			) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den
			JOIN (
				SELECT g.stt_rec, g.ngay_den, h.bp_ref, MAX(h.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl
					FROM #ttluongtv g JOIN #hrhstv h ON h.ngay_hl <= g.ngay_den
					GROUP BY g.stt_rec, g.ngay_den, h.bp_ref
			) d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = d.ngay_den AND b.bp_ref = d.bp_ref
			JOIN #hrhstv c ON c.bp_ref = b.bp_ref AND c.ngay_hl = d.ngay_hl

		INSERT INTO #ttluong(stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ma_bp, he_so_tv) 
			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ngach, a.ma_bac, a.he_so_luong, a.tien_khoan, a.ngay_hl, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, a.ma_bp, b.he_so
				FROM #ttluong a JOIN #ttluongtv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.chen_them = 1

		UPDATE #ttluong SET nhieu_doan = 1 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ttluongtv b WHERE b.stt_rec = #ttluong.stt_rec AND b.chen_them = 1)
		UPDATE #ttluong SET ngay_tu = b.ngay_den + 1 FROM #ttluong a JOIN #ttluongtv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den > b.ngay_den WHERE b.chen_them = 1
		UPDATE #ttluong SET he_so_tv = b.he_so FROM #ttluong a JOIN #ttluongtv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.chen_them = 0 AND b.he_so IS NOT NULL
	END


	-- Xác định ngày hl thang bảng lương theo từng đoạn trong thông tin lương. Chỉ xét với ngày cuối đoạn.
	-- Trường hợp trong 1 đoạn có thay đổi các thông tin này thì tư vấn tách thành nhiều đoạn thông tin lương.
	SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, b.bp_ref INTO #ttluong_tbl FROM #ttluong a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE (a.ma_ngach <> '' OR a.ma_bac <> '')
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, c.ma_bp AS ma_bp_tbl, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl_tbl
		INTO #tbl_max FROM (
			SELECT g.ma_bp, g.ngay_den, MAX(k.bp_ref) AS bp_ref
				FROM #ttluong_tbl g JOIN hrtbl h ON h.ngay_hl <= g.ngay_den JOIN hrbp k ON h.ma_bp = k.ma_bp AND g.bp_ref LIKE k.bp_ref + '%'
				GROUP BY g.ma_bp, g.ngay_den
		) a JOIN hrtbl b ON b.ngay_hl <= a.ngay_den JOIN hrbp c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.bp_ref = c.bp_ref
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, c.ma_bp

	UPDATE #ttluong SET he_so_luong = 0 WHERE (ma_ngach <> '' OR ma_bac <> '')
	UPDATE #ttluong SET he_so_luong = c.he_so FROM #ttluong a JOIN #tbl_max b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den 
		JOIN hrtblct c ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp_tbl AND c.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl_tbl AND c.ma_ngach = a.ma_ngach AND c.ma_bac = a.ma_bac



/*
	Kết thúc tạo bảng thông tin lương
*/


/*
	Tạo bảng chia đoạn theo biến động về lương + biến động về quá trình làm việc
*/

	-- Xác định các ngày cần tách trong mỗi đoạn biến động về lương
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ngay_tu AS ngay_tach, ma_bp, 0 AS loai INTO #ngaydoibp FROM #ttluongqtbp
	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec INTO #ttluongrec FROM #ttluongqtbp
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan AS ma_bp, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt 
		INTO #qtbp FROM hreqtlvht a JOIN #ttluongrec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.tinh_chat = 1 AND a.loai_thay_doi IN ('1', '2') ORDER BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu
	UPDATE a SET ngay_den = DATEADD(day, -1, b.ngay_tu) FROM #qtbp a JOIN #qtbp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt - 1 WHERE a.ngay_den IS NULL
	DELETE #qtbp FROM #qtbp a JOIN #hrstt_rec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND (a.ngay_den < b.ky_ngay_tu OR a.ngay_tu > b.ky_ngay_den)

	INSERT INTO #ngaydoibp SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, b.ngay_tu, b.ma_bp, 1
		FROM #ttluongqtbp a JOIN #qtbp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ngay_tu > a.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_tu <= a.ngay_den

	INSERT INTO #ngaydoibp SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, b.ngay_den, b.ma_bp, 2
		FROM #ttluongqtbp a JOIN #qtbp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ngay_den >= a.ngay_tu and b.ngay_den < a.ngay_den AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #qtbp c WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tu - 1 = b.ngay_den)

	SELECT *, 0 AS stt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #ngaytach FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ngay_tu AS ngay, 0 AS loai FROM #ngaydoibp GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den
			UNION SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ngay_tach, loai FROM #ngaydoibp
			UNION SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ngay_den, 0 FROM #ngaydoibp GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den
		) a ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay
	UPDATE #ngaytach SET stt = a.id - b.id + 1 
		FROM #ngaytach a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den, MIN(id) AS id FROM #ngaytach GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den

	-- Tạo các đoạn thời gian mới theo qtlv
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #bosung FROM #ttluongqtbp
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(stt) FROM #ngaytach
	WHILE @i < @n BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bosung(stt_rec, ma_ngach, ma_bac, he_so_luong, tien_khoan, ngay_hl, ngay_tu, ngay_den, nhieu_doan)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, c.ma_ngach, c.ma_bac, c.he_so_luong, c.tien_khoan, c.ngay_hl, 
					CASE WHEN a.loai = 0 OR a.loai = 1 THEN a.ngay WHEN a.loai = 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 1, a.ngay) ELSE NULL END, 
					CASE WHEN b.loai = 0 OR b.loai = 2 THEN b.ngay WHEN b.loai = 1 THEN DATEADD(day, -1, b.ngay) ELSE NULL END,
					1
				FROM #ngaytach a JOIN #ngaytach b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den
					JOIN #ttluongqtbp c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = c.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den = c.ngay_den
				WHERE a.stt = @i AND b.stt = @i + 1
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	DELETE #ttluongqtbp FROM #ttluongqtbp a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ngaydoibp b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay_tu = a.ngay_tu AND b.ngay_den = a.ngay_den)
	INSERT INTO #ttluongqtbp SELECT * FROM #bosung

	-- Xác định bộ phận cho mỗi đoạn thời gian, nv k có qtlv thì lấy theo bp hiện hành.
	UPDATE #ttluongqtbp SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp FROM #ttluongqtbp a LEFT JOIN #qtbp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN (
		SELECT f.stt_rec, e.ngay_den, MAX(f.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu
			FROM #ttluongqtbp e JOIN #qtbp f WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.stt_rec = f.stt_rec 
			WHERE f.ngay_tu <= e.ngay_den AND (f.ngay_den IS NULL OR f.ngay_den >= e.ngay_den)
			GROUP BY f.stt_rec, e.ngay_den
		) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = c.ngay_den AND b.ngay_tu = c.ngay_tu
	
	UPDATE #ttluongqtbp SET ma_bp = b.bo_phan FROM #ttluongqtbp a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec 
		WHERE a.ma_bp IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #qtbp c WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
	UPDATE #ttluongqtbp SET ma_bp = '' WHERE ma_bp IS NULL

	-- Xác định ngày hl thang bảng lương theo từng đoạn trong thông tin lương. Chỉ xét với ngày cuối đoạn.
	-- Trường hợp trong 1 đoạn có thay đổi các thông tin này thì tư vấn tách thành nhiều đoạn thông tin lương.
	SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, b.bp_ref INTO #ttluongqtbp_tbl FROM #ttluongqtbp a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE (a.ma_ngach <> '' OR a.ma_bac <> '')
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, c.ma_bp AS ma_bp_tbl, MAX(b.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl_tbl
		INTO #qtbp_tbl_max FROM (
			SELECT g.ma_bp, g.ngay_den, MAX(k.bp_ref) AS bp_ref
				FROM #ttluongqtbp_tbl g JOIN hrtbl h ON h.ngay_hl <= g.ngay_den JOIN hrbp k ON h.ma_bp = k.ma_bp AND g.bp_ref LIKE k.bp_ref + '%'
				GROUP BY g.ma_bp, g.ngay_den
		) a JOIN hrtbl b ON b.ngay_hl <= a.ngay_den JOIN hrbp c ON b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.bp_ref = c.bp_ref
		GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ngay_den, c.ma_bp

	UPDATE #ttluongqtbp SET he_so_luong = 0 WHERE (ma_ngach <> '' OR ma_bac <> '')
	UPDATE #ttluongqtbp SET he_so_luong = c.he_so FROM #ttluongqtbp a JOIN #qtbp_tbl_max b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den 
		JOIN hrtblct c ON c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp_tbl AND c.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl_tbl AND c.ma_ngach = a.ma_ngach AND c.ma_bac = a.ma_bac
/*
	Kết thúc bảng chia đoạn theo biến động về lương + biến động về quá trình làm việc
*/

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetInfoRecord]
	@Unit VARCHAR(16),
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(16),
	@PurGroup VARCHAR(16),
	@Plant VARCHAR(16),
	@Customer VARCHAR(16),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Currency VARCHAR(16),
	@Item VARCHAR(16),
	@DefaultUOM CHAR(1),
	@UOM NCHAR(10),
	@Quantity NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Field VARCHAR(1024),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@AutoConvertUOM BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @he_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @priceRound INT, @k1 NVARCHAR(1024), @k2 NVARCHAR(1024), @k3 NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	IF @DefaultUOM = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @k1 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + ''' and ma_vung = ''' + REPLACE(@Plant, '''', '''''') + '''', @k2 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + '''', @k3 = 'controller = ''Item'''
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Options$GetValue 'dvt', @UOM OUT, 'bidmvttsvung', @k1, 'bidmvtts', @k2, 'bidmts', @k3
		IF ISNULL(@UOM, '') = '' SELECT @UOM = dvt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 @he_so = he_so FROM dmqddvt WHERE dvt = @UOM AND (ma_vt = @Item OR ma_vt = '*')
	SELECT @he_so = ISNULL(@he_so, 1), @sl_qd = @Quantity * @he_so

	SELECT a.*, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, b.ma_rb, b.sl_dat_tt, b.sl_dat_td, b.so_ngay_giao
		INTO #gia FROM bigia01 a JOIN bigia02 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
		WHERE a.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.status = '1' AND a.ma_nt = @Currency
			AND (a.ma_vung = @Plant OR a.ma_vung = '')
			AND a.ma_kh = @Customer AND a.ma_vt = @Item
			AND (b.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_tu <= @VoucherDate) AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= @VoucherDate)

	IF @Plant <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #gia WHERE ma_vung = @Plant) DELETE #gia WHERE ma_vung = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #gia WHERE dvt1 = @UOM) DELETE #gia WHERE dvt1 <> @UOM

	-- Exist SCL
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> '' AND so_luong <= @sl_qd) BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, MAX(so_luong) AS so_luong INTO #t FROM #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> '' AND so_luong <= @sl_qd GROUP BY stt_rec, stt_rec0
		DELETE #gia FROM #gia a WHERE a.stt_rec1 <> '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t t WHERE t.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND t.stt_rec0 = t.stt_rec0 AND t.so_luong = a.so_luong)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> ''
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 a.* INTO #res FROM #gia a JOIN bidmngm b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE b.ma_cn = @VoucherCode ORDER BY b.stt ASC, a.ngay_hl_tu DESC, a.gia_nt ASC, a.stt_rec
	IF @AutoConvertUOM = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #res SET gia_chuan_nt = ROUND(gia_chuan_nt * @he_so, @priceRound), gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt * @he_so, @priceRound),
			ck_dv_nt = ROUND(ck_dv_nt * @he_so, @priceRound), cp_dv_nt = ROUND(cp_dv_nt * @he_so, @priceRound)
	END

	IF @UOM <> (SELECT TOP 1 dvt1 FROM #res) BEGIN
		DECLARE @ct_gia_dk NVARCHAR(4000), @he_so1 NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT TOP 1 @ct_gia_dk = ct_gia_dk, @he_so1 = he_so1 FROM #res
		IF ISNULL(@ct_gia_dk, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(@he_so1, 0) <> 0 BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 0 b.line_nbr AS id, a.ma_loai, a.ma_loai as ma_so, b.gia_nt as gia_tri, b.ct_gia_dk as cong_thuc, b.ct_gia_dk as ghi_chu,
					a.kieu_tinh, a.kieu_cap_nhat
				INTO #cts FROM bidmldkg a, bigia01 b
			EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_gia_dk, '#cts', 'id, ma_loai, ma_so, gia_tri, cong_thuc, ghi_chu'

			UPDATE #cts SET kieu_tinh = b.kieu_tinh, kieu_cap_nhat = b.kieu_cap_nhat FROM #cts a JOIN bidmldkg b ON a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai
			UPDATE #cts SET gia_tri = gia_tri/@he_so1 * @he_so WHERE kieu_tinh = '2' AND kieu_cap_nhat IN ('1', '2', '3')

			SET @ct_gia_dk = ''
			SELECT @ct_gia_dk = @ct_gia_dk + CASE WHEN @ct_gia_dk <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END +
					+ '["' + REPLACE(RTRIM(ma_loai), '"', '\"') + '","'
					+ REPLACE(RTRIM(ma_so), '"', '\"') + '",'
					+ LTRIM(CAST(ISNULL(gia_tri, 0) AS FLOAT)) + ',"'
					+ REPLACE(cong_thuc, '"', '\"') + '","'
					+ REPLACE(ghi_chu, '"', '\"') + '"]'
				FROM #cts

			UPDATE #res SET ct_gia_dk = '[' + @ct_gia_dk + ']'
		END
	END

	IF @Field = ''
		SELECT * FROM #res
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ' + @Field + ' from #res'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI106] --Doanh thu theo khách hàng
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)

	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -14, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '006'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '007'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '008'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '009'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '010'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '011'  
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '012' 
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '013'
