		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '014'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_kh, tien2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, ma_kh, sum(tien2) as tien2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition with(nolock) where %[charindex(ma_ct, ''HDA, E01'') > 0]% group by ngay_ct, ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	
	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh) ELSE MAX(b.ten_kh2) END AS ten_kh, SUM(a.tien2) AS tien
		INTO #ct70
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY ngay_ct, a.ma_kh

	DECLARE @select AS VARCHAR(1000), @end AS VARCHAR(255)
	SET @select = ' select ma_kh, max(ten_kh) as ten_kh, cast(sum(tien) as varchar) as tien from #ct70 where tien <> 0'
	SET @end = ' group by ma_kh'

	DECLARE @week AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SELECT @week =  'declare @GetDate as smalldatetime; set @GetDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) + ''''

	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @q = @week + char(13) + @select + ' and datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = datepart(wk, @GetDate) and year(ngay_ct) = year(@GetDate)' + @end
	ELSE
		IF @TimeID = '004'
			SELECT @q = @week + char(13) + @select + ' and datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then 53 else (datepart(wk, @GetDate) - 1) end and year(ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then (year(@GetDate) - 1) else year(@GetDate) end' + @end
		ELSE
			SET @q = @select + @end
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CheckCO2GL]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 tk_spdd AS tk_no, tk_spdd AS tk_co INTO #report FROM dmvt

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select b.tk_spdd, dbo.ff_GetWordNum(c.tk_no, 1)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdytdd a with(nolock) left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' join xdmyt c with(nolock) on a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt and a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and c.pb_yn = 1 and (ps_tk <> 0 or ps_tk_nt <> 0)'
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, b.tk_spdd, c.tk_no'
	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@q)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_co = c.tk WHERE tk_no = '' OR tk_co = '' OR b.loai_tk = 0 OR c.loai_tk = 0)
		SELECT 1 AS xValue
	ELSE
		SELECT 0 AS xValue

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_DeleteClosingTrans]
	@nMF INT,
	@nMT INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(8)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @cStt_rec CHAR(13), @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	IF @cAction = 'Delete'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Delete')
	IF @cAction = 'New'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'New')

	SELECT @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMT, @nYear)

	--
	SELECT @s = 'DELETE FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DELETE FROM %r00 WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--

	SET @i = @nMF
	WHILE @i <= @nMT BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'DECLARE csTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' AS stt_rec'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' FROM dmkc1 WHERE Nam = ' + STR(@nYear, 4) + ' AND tag <> 0 AND stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' <> '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		OPEN csTran
		FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%stt_rec', RTRIM(@cStt_rec)), '%r00', 'r00$' + RTRIM(@nYear) + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0'))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
		END
		CLOSE csTran
		DEALLOCATE csTran

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterAdjustmentInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceID CHAR(13),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(33),
	@Serial VARCHAR(33),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@Resign BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @InvoiceID = REPLACE(@InvoiceID, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @r NVARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @p = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@VoucherCode, @VoucherID)
	IF CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @ResultProcess = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @referenceField VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @referenceField = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '07'

	--
	SELECT @r = ' set so_ct0 = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''';'

	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', so_seri_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@Serial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_ct_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ''' + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ct00' + @r + 'update ct70' + @r + 'update ct90' + @r + 'update r00$' + @p + @r + 'update r70$' + @p + @r + 'update r90$' + @p + @r

	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @vCode = RIGHT(stt_rec_px, 3) FROM ctpxdc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID AND stt_rec_px <> ''
		SELECT @refp = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@vCode, @InvoiceID)
	END

	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @refp + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 3, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #stt2 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_bi_mat VARCHAR(512))
	INSERT INTO #stt2 SELECT @VoucherID, @InvoiceNumber, @InvoiceTemplate, @Serial, @SecretNumber
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate '#stt2', @VoucherCode, DEFAULT, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployeeLateInEarlyOutStatistics]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@LITFrom INT,
	@LITTo INT,
	@LIMFrom INT,
	@LIMTo INT,
	@EOTFrom INT,
	@EOTTo INT,
	@EOMFrom INT,
	@EOMTo INT,
	@TotalTimesFrom INT,
	@TotalTimesTo INT,
	@TotalMinutesFrom INT,
	@TotalMinutesTo INT,
	@WorkdayType CHAR(1),	
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = '', @EmpKey = ''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #temp(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), sl_di_muon INT, sl_ve_som INT, sp_di_muon INT, sp_ve_som INT)
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), sl_di_muon INT, sl_ve_som INT, sp_di_muon INT, sp_ve_som INT, ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(128), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.tg_di_muon + r.tg_ve_som <> 0'

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	IF @WorkdayType <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN  '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ma_cong in (select ma_cong from hrdmcong a where exists (select 1 from hrdmloaicong b where a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai and b.tinh_chat = ''' + RTRIM(@WorkdayType) + '''))'
	
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	--	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp select r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp, sum(case when r.tg_di_muon = 0 then 0 else 1 end), sum(case when r.tg_ve_som = 0 then 0 else 1 end), sum(r.tg_di_muon), sum(r.tg_ve_som)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongct$%Partition r with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, SUM(sl_di_muon) AS sl_di_muon, SUM(sl_ve_som) AS sl_ve_som, SUM(sp_di_muon) AS sp_di_muon, SUM(sp_ve_som) AS sp_ve_som INTO #r FROM #temp GROUP BY stt_rec, bo_phan

	IF @LITFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_di_muon < @LITFrom
	IF @LITTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_di_muon > @LITTo
	IF @LIMFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_di_muon < @LIMFrom
	IF @LIMTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_di_muon > @LIMTo
	
	IF @EOTFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_ve_som < @EOTFrom
	IF @EOTTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_ve_som > @EOTTo
	IF @EOMFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_ve_som < @EOMFrom
	IF @EOMTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_ve_som > @EOMTo

	IF @TotalTimesFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_di_muon +  sl_ve_som < @TotalTimesFrom
	IF @TotalTimesTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sl_di_muon +  sl_ve_som > @TotalTimesTo
	IF @TotalMinutesFrom > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_di_muon +  sp_ve_som < @TotalMinutesFrom
	IF @TotalMinutesTo > 0 DELETE #r WHERE sp_di_muon +  sp_ve_som > @TotalMinutesTo

	-- Report
	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, sl_di_muon, sl_ve_som, sp_di_muon, sp_ve_som, ho_ten_nv)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, a.sl_di_muon, a.sl_ve_som, a.sp_di_muon, a.sp_ve_som, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv
			FROM #r a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			ORDER BY b.ma_nv, a.bo_phan

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, sl_di_muon, sl_ve_som, sp_di_muon, sp_ve_som, ho_ten_nv) SELECT '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, ''

	-- Result
	SELECT a.stt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, a.bo_phan, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, 
			a.sl_di_muon, a.sl_ve_som, a.sp_di_muon, a.sp_ve_som, a.sl_di_muon + a.sl_ve_som AS t_so_lan, a.sp_ve_som + a.sp_di_muon AS t_so_phut
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
		ORDER BY a.stt

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRMInformation]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@PeriodCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),	
	@Position VARCHAR(33),	
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt_x, 0 AS stt_y, a.stt_rec, b.ma_dot, b.ma_dot AS ma_dot_in, b.ten_dot, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den
			, a.ma_vtr, c.ten_vtr, a.ma_bp, d.ten_bp, d.stt_ref, a.so_luong, c.stt AS stt_vtr, b.ngay_ct
		INTO #report
		FROM hrrmdotct a, hrrmdot b, hrvt c, hrbp d

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'b.ma_dvcs'), 'a.bp_ref', 'd.bp_ref') + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ngay_tu between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @PeriodCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dot like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'd.')
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT @Join = ' left join hrrmdot b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c with(nolock) on a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp d with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp'

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, a.stt_rec, b.ma_dot, b.ma_dot, b.ten_dot%l, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' a.ma_vtr, isnull(c.ten_vtr%l, ''''), a.ma_bp, isnull(d.ten_bp%l, ''''), d.stt_ref, a.so_luong, c.stt, b.ngay_ct'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrrmdotct a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot INTO #o1 FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #o1 SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct, ma_dot FROM #report
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o1 b ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
	
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp INTO #o2 FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot INTO #g FROM #o2 GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dot
	UPDATE #report SET stt_x = b.id - c.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o2 b ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #g c ON a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot AND a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct
	
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vtr INTO #g2 FROM #o2 GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vtr
	UPDATE #report SET stt_y = b.id - c.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o2 b ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #g2 c ON a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr AND a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct
	
	UPDATE #report SET stt = 0 WHERE stt_x <> 1

	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_x, stt_y, stt_rec, ma_dot, ma_dot_in, ten_dot, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ten_vtr, ten_bp, so_luong)
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', NULL

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_x, stt_y, ma_dot, ma_dot_in, ten_dot, ngay_tu, ngay_den, ma_vtr, ten_vtr, ten_bp, so_luong
		FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Voucher$CheckingBasic]
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@tableName VARCHAR(64),
	@importTable VARCHAR(64),
	@controller VARCHAR(128),
	@userID INT,
	@admin INT,
	@language VARCHAR(32),
	@sysDataName VARCHAR(64),
	@errorLine INT OUTPUT,
	@errorCode VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @notAuthorized VARCHAR(32), @lockedDate VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @notAuthorized = '$NotAuthorized', @lockedDate = 'LockedDate'

	SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from @@table a join dmttct b on a.status = b.status where b.ma_ct = @v and b.xdel = 1) begin
	select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
	return
end

if @a <> 1 begin
  if @sysDataName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetAuthorize(@a, @u, @c, ''Del'') = 0 begin
    select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
    return
  end

  select distinct ma_dvcs into #$unit from @@table
  if (select count(ma_dvcs) from #$unit) <> (select count(b.ma_dvcs) from #$unit a left join sysunitrights b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs where b.user_id = @u and b.r_del = 1) begin
    select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
    return
  end

  select a.stt_rec, b.status into #$statusright from @@table a join dmttct b on a.status = b.status where b.ma_ct = @v and b.right_yn = 1
  if exists(select 1 from #$statusright) begin
	if exists(select 1 from #$statusright a where not exists(select 1 from @sysDataName..sysactionrights b where b.action_id = a.status and b.user_id = @u and b.ma_ct = @v and b.right_yn = 1)) begin
      select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
      return
    end
    if exists(select 1 from #$statusright a join @sysDataName..sysstatusrights b on b.status_id = a.status where b.user_id = @u and b.ma_ct = @v and b.r_del = 1) begin
      select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
      return
    end
  end
'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @purOrg TINYINT, @inspection TINYINT
		EXEC sp_executesql N'select @purOrg = x_pur_org, @inspection = x_inspection from dmct where ma_ct = @voucherCode', N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @purOrg tinyint output, @inspection tinyint output', @voucherCode, @purOrg OUTPUT, @inspection OUTPUT
		SELECT @purOrg = ISNULL(@purOrg, 0), @inspection = ISNULL(@inspection, 0)

		IF @purOrg = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = @q + '
  select distinct a.ma_bp0 into #$purorg from ' + RTRIM(c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' a where exists(select 1 from @@table b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
  if (select count(ma_bp0) from #$purorg) <> (select count(b.ma_bp0) from #$purorg a left join bisyspurorgrights b on a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 where b.user_id = @u and b.r_del = 1) begin
	select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
	return
  end
' FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
		END
		IF @inspection = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = @q + '
  select distinct a.ma_nguon into #$inspection from ' + RTRIM(c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + ' a where exists(select 1 from @@table b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
  if (select count(ma_nguon) from #$inspection) <> (select count(b.ma_nguon) from #$inspection a left join bisysinspectionrights b on a.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon where b.user_id = @u and b.r_del = 1) begin
	select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
	return
  end
' FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
		END
	END

	SELECT @q = @q + '
  if exists(select 1 from @@table where user_id0 <> @u) begin
    declare @fullDelete bit
    exec @sysDataName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetShareAccess @v, @u, @a, 2, @fullDelete output
    if (@fullDelete = 0) begin
      select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @n else @e1 end
      return
    end
  end
end
if exists (select 1 from @@table a, dmstt b where (a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_gh1) or (a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_gh2) or (a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks)) select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @l1 else @e1 end
if exists (select 1 from @@table a, dmctks b where b.user_id = @u and b.ma_ct = @v and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks) select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @l1 else @e1 end
if exists (select 1 from @@table a, dmdvcsks b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks) select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @l1 else @e1 end
if exists (select 1 from @@table a, sysdaterules b where b.user_id = @u and ((b.ngay_ct1 is not null and a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_ct1) or (b.ngay_ct2 is not null and a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_ct2)))select @e0 = 1, @e1 = case when @e1 = '''' then @l1 else @e1 end
'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@sysDataName', @sysDataName), '@@table', @tableName), '@importTable', @importTable)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q,
		N'@u int, @a int, @v varchar(3), @l0 varchar(32), @c varchar(128), @n varchar(128), @l1 varchar(128), @e1 varchar(32) output, @e0 int output',
		@userID, @admin, @voucherCode, @language, @controller, @notAuthorized, @lockedDate, @errorCode output, @errorLine output
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@strString NVARCHAR(4000), @intNum INT, @seperate CHAR(1))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nNum INT, @cReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @nStart = 1; SET @nNum = 0
	SET @strString = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strString)) + @seperate
	WHILE CHARINDEX(@seperate, @strString,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @nNum = @nNum + 1
			IF @nNum = @intNum
				BEGIN
					SET @cReturn = SUBSTRING(@strString, @nStart, CHARINDEX(@seperate, @strString,  @nStart) - @nStart)
					BREAK
				END
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(@seperate, @strString,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN RTRIM(LTRIM(@cReturn))
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPRunCalcCapacityCoeff] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nCRPRunType INT, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ncRound TINYINT
	SELECT @ncRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'cr_round_hs' --'M_ROUND_CS'

	SELECT * INTO #crhsnlsx FROM crhsnlsx WHERE 1 = 0

	IF @nCRPRunType = 1 -- CPOF
		BEGIN
			-- Lay du lieu tu dinh muc thoi gian san xuat san pham
			SELECT ma_vt, dbo.ff_D2C(MAX(ngay_hl)) AS m INTO #m FROM crdmtgsp WHERE status = '1' AND ngay_hl <= @dNow GROUP BY ma_vt
			SELECT a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN a.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.cs_qd / a.he_so, @ncRound) END AS cs_qd INTO #crdmtgsp FROM crdmtgsp a WHERE a.status = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND dbo.ff_D2C(a.ngay_hl) = b.m)

			-- Lay he so phan bo nguon luc
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_nl, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl, dbo.ff_D2C(MAX(ngay_hl)) AS m INTO #d FROM crdmhspbnl WHERE status = '1' AND ngay_hl <= @dNow GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_nl
			SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_nl, a.he_so INTO #crdmhspbnl FROM crdmhspbnl a WHERE a.status = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND dbo.ff_D2C(a.ngay_hl) = b.m)

			INSERT INTO #crhsnlsx
				(
					ma_vt, ma_nl, loai_nl, he_so, tg_cai_dat, tg_bo_sung, so_ngay
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
				SELECT a.ma_vt, b.ma_nl, '', ROUND((ISNULL(a.cs_qd, 0) * ISNULL(b.he_so, 0)) / ISNULL(d.t_he_so, 1), @ncRound), 0, 0, 0
						, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
					FROM #crdmtgsp a
						LEFT JOIN #crdmhspbnl b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
						LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_vt, SUM(he_so) AS t_he_so FROM #crdmhspbnl GROUP BY ma_vt) d ON a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt
		END

	IF @nCRPRunType = 2 OR @nCRPRunType = 3 BEGIN-- Bill of Resource or RPA
		SELECT b.ma_sp AS ma_sp, b.he_so, MAX(a.stt_rec) AS stt_rec, MAX(a.stt_rec0) AS stt_rec0 INTO #nl FROM ctnl a JOIN phnl b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE (a.ngay_ct1 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct1 <= @dNow) AND (a.ngay_ct2 IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct2 >= @dNow)
				GROUP BY b.ma_sp, a.ma_nl, b.he_so


		INSERT INTO #crhsnlsx
				(
					ma_vt, ma_nl, loai_nl, he_so, tg_cai_dat, tg_bo_sung, so_ngay
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
				SELECT b.ma_sp, a.ma_nl, '', CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.he_so, 0) <> 0 THEN ROUND(CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = 2 THEN a.cs_qd ELSE CASE WHEN a.cs_qd <> 0 THEN ROUND(1/a.cs_qd, @ncRound) ELSE 0 END END/ISNULL(b.he_so, 0), @ncRound) ELSE 0 END, a.tg_cai_dat, a.tg_bo_sung, so_ngay
						, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
					FROM ctnl a LEFT JOIN #nl b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

		END

	DELETE #crhsnlsx WHERE he_so = 0

	TRUNCATE TABLE crhsnlsx
	INSERT INTO crhsnlsx SELECT * FROM #crhsnlsx
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStocktakingReport]
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @FieldData VARCHAR(33), @FieldGroup VARCHAR(33), @NoGroup NVARCHAR(128), @Total NVARCHAR(128), @Round INT, @l CHAR(1), @Year CHAR(4), @unitKey nvarchar(4000), @siteKey nvarchar(4000), @TypeGroup CHAR(1)
	SELECT @Year = CAST(YEAR(ngay_ct) AS CHAR(4)) FROM kkyc WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	SELECT @NoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NoGroup'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @Round = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tl'
	SELECT @l = CASE WHEN @Language = 'E' THEN '2' ELSE '' END 

	SELECT @TypeGroup = CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 'nh_vt1' THEN '1' WHEN @GroupBy = 'nh_vt2' THEN '2' WHEN @GroupBy = 'nh_vt3' THEN '3' ELSE '' END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' SELECT @FieldData = @GroupBy, @FieldGroup = ',' + @GroupBy
		ELSE SELECT @FieldData = '''''', @FieldGroup = ''		
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, a.ma_kho, ma_vt AS nh_vt, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_can_kk, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_da_kk INTO #tmp FROM kkss$0000 a
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, nh_vt, ma_vt INTO #tmpss FROM #tmp
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, nh_vt, ma_vt INTO #tmptt FROM #tmp
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_kho, nh_vt1 AS nh_vt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_can_kk, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_da_kk INTO #report FROM kkycct

	--
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @unitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @siteKey OUTPUT

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = ''
	SET @Key = ' a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'a.', 'd.')
		SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join dmkho d on a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho'
	END
	IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @siteKey
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR @GroupBy <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into $table select a.ma_kho, ' + @FieldData + ', a.ma_vt from $data a' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_kho' + @FieldGroup + ', a.ma_vt'

	SELECT @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$table', '#tmpss'), '$data', 'kkss$' + @Year)
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$table', '#tmptt'), '$data', 'kktt$' + @Year)
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$table', '#tmptt'), '$data', 'kkdc')
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	INSERT INTO #tmp (stt_rec, ma_kho, nh_vt, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk)
		SELECT @IDNumber, ma_kho, nh_vt, COUNT(ma_vt), 0
		FROM #tmpss GROUP BY ma_kho, nh_vt

	INSERT INTO #tmp (stt_rec, ma_kho, nh_vt, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk)
		SELECT @IDNumber, ma_kho, nh_vt, 0, COUNT(ma_vt)
		FROM (SELECT ma_kho, nh_vt, ma_vt FROM #tmptt GROUP BY ma_kho, nh_vt, ma_vt) a
		WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmpss z WHERE a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho AND a.nh_vt = z.nh_vt AND a.ma_vt = z.ma_vt)	
		GROUP BY ma_kho, nh_vt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_kho, nh_vt, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk)
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, @IDNumber, ma_kho, nh_vt, SUM(sl_can_kk), SUM(sl_da_kk) FROM #tmp GROUP BY ma_kho, nh_vt ORDER BY ma_kho, nh_vt
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, '' AS phieu_yc, 0 AS stt, '' AS ma_kho, '' AS nhom_vt, 0 AS sl_can_kk, 0 AS sl_da_kk, 0 AS sl_con_kk, 0 AS ty_trong, '' AS dien_giai2, '' AS so_ct, NULL AS dien_giai, '' AS ten_kho, '' AS ten_nhom_vt
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@GroupBy <> '') BEGIN
			SELECT MIN(stt) AS stt, ma_kho INTO #g FROM #report GROUP BY ma_kho
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_kho, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk) SELECT 2, 0, 0, @IDNumber, ma_kho, SUM(sl_can_kk), SUM(sl_da_kk) FROM #report GROUP BY ma_kho
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk) SELECT 0, 0, 0, @IDNumber, SUM(sl_can_kk), SUM(sl_da_kk) FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk) SELECT 1, 0, 0, @IDNumber, 0, 0

			SELECT @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt - o.stt + 1 as stt, a.stt_rec as phieu_yc, a.ma_kho, a.nh_vt as nhom_vt, d.so_ct, d.dien_giai, '
			SELECT @q = @q + ' sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk, sl_can_kk - sl_da_kk as sl_con_kk, case when sl_can_kk = 0 then 0 else cast(round(sl_da_kk/sl_can_kk * 100, ' + LTRIM(@Round) + ') as NUMERIC(28, 6)) end as ty_trong, '
			SELECT @q = @q + ' case when a.nh_vt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@NoGroup) + ''' else c.'+ CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 'loai_vt' THEN 'ten_loai_vt' + @l ELSE 'ten_nh' + @l END + ' end as ten_nhom_vt,'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' case when sysorder = 0 then N''' + @Total + ''' else case when sysorder = 2 then e.ma_kho + '' - '' + e.ten_kho' + @l + ' else '''' end end as dien_giai2, e.ten_kho' + @l + ' as ten_kho'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #g o on a.ma_kho = o.ma_kho and a.nh_vt is not null'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' left join ' +  CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 'loai_vt' THEN 'dmloaivt c on a.nh_vt = c.ma_loai_vt ' ELSE 'dmnhvt c on a.nh_vt = c.ma_nh and loai_nh = ' + @TypeGroup END
			SELECT @q = @q + ' left join kkyc d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' left join dmkho e on a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_kho, o.stt'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk) SELECT 0, 0, 0, @IDNumber, SUM(sl_can_kk), SUM(sl_da_kk) FROM #report
			INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec) SELECT 1, 0, 0, ''
			SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt AS stt, a.stt_rec AS phieu_yc, a.ma_kho, a.nh_vt AS nhom_vt,
					sl_can_kk, sl_da_kk, sl_can_kk - sl_da_kk AS sl_con_kk,
					CASE WHEN sl_can_kk = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ROUND(sl_da_kk/sl_can_kk * 100, @Round) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) END AS ty_trong, 
					CASE WHEN sysorder = 1 THEN e.ma_kho + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_kho ELSE e.ten_kho2 END WHEN sysorder = 0 THEN d.so_ct + ' - ' + d.dien_giai ELSE '' END AS dien_giai2,
					d.so_ct, d.dien_giai, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_kho ELSE e.ten_kho2 END AS ten_kho, '' AS ten_nhom_vt
				FROM #report a
					LEFT JOIN kkyc d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
					LEFT JOIN dmkho e ON a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho
				ORDER BY a.ma_kho
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Investment]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dBgSolar SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dBgSolar = CAST(STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + '0101' AS SMALLDATETIME)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 INTO #tabRet FROM dtcdct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	SET @q = 'insert into #tabret select ma_so, ma_vv, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dtcdct with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@Date)) + @Key + ' group by ma_so, ma_vv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @BalanceType = 1	SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_vv, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1'' and ma_vv <> ''''' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by ma_vv, tk, tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dBgSolar, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ct00) BEGIN
		DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @tk_no VARCHAR(32), @tk_co VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_no_gt VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_du VARCHAR(32), @tk_co_gt VARCHAR(32)

		SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_gt,
				REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_gt,
				CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', tk_no) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_du) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_du) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype
			INTO #dtdmct FROM dtdmct WITH(NOLOCK)
		UPDATE #dtdmct SET tk_no = tk_no + '%', tk_no_du = tk_no_du + '%', tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt + '%', tk_co = tk_co + '%', tk_co_du = tk_co_du + '%', tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt + '%' WHERE xtype = 0

		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1
		WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @tk_no = tk_no, @tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt, @tk_no_du = tk_no_du, @tk_co = tk_co, @tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt, @tk_co_du = tk_co_du FROM #dtdmct WHERE ma_so = @ma_so

			INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', b.data + '%', '', '', '', '', 2
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_du, ',') b

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', '', c.data + '%', '', '', '', 3
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_gt, ',') c

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', e.data + '%', '', 4
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_du, ',') e

				INSERT INTO #dtdmct
					SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, '', '', '', d.data + '%', '', f.data + '%', 5
						FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') d CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_gt, ',') f

			SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1 AND ma_so > @ma_so
		END
		DELETE #dtdmct WHERE xtype = 1

		INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, a.ps_no, 0, a.ps_no_nt, 0
			FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
			WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_du AND ps_no <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 2)

		INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, - a.ps_co, 0, - a.ps_co_nt, 0
			FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
			WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_gt AND ps_co <> 0 AND tk_no_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 3)

		INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, 0, a.ps_co, 0, a.ps_co_nt
			FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
			WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_du AND ps_co <> 0 AND b.xtype IN (0, 4)

		INSERT INTO #tabRet SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_vv, 0, - a.ps_no, 0, - a.ps_no_nt
			FROM #ct00 a, #dtdmct b
			WHERE a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_gt AND ps_no <> 0 AND tk_co_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 5)
	END

	SELECT ma_so, ma_vv, SUM(du_no00) AS du_no, SUM(du_co00) AS du_co, SUM(du_no_nt00) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co_nt00) AS du_co_nt
		FROM #tabRet GROUP BY ma_so, ma_vv

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ReleaseInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c0 VARCHAR(4000), @c1 VARCHAR(4000), @table VARCHAR(33), @userName NVARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @userName = RTRIM(name) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)

	-- Options
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = 'VND'

	-- Struct
	--++ Master
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.ma_gd, a.datetime2, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh, a.ten_kh
			, a.mst_kh AS ma_so_thue, a.dia_chi_kh AS dia_chi, a.dien_thoai_kh AS dien_thoai, a.email_kh AS e_mail, a.quoc_tich, a.doi_tuong, a.so_giay_to
			, a.ngay_cap_giay_to, a.noi_cap_giay_to, a.ghi_chuhoadon, a.t_tnc_thue, a.t_tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_bh_bb, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word
		INTO #m0 FROM hrm01$000000 a

	--++ Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.line_nbr, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt, a.thang_kt, a.thang_kt1, a.thang_kt2, a.nam_kt, a.tnc_thue, a.tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.thue, a.bh_bb
		INTO #d0 FROM hrd01$000000 a


	-- Declare External Fields
	DECLARE @structFields VARCHAR(4000), @structFrom VARCHAR(4000), @queryFields VARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @resultFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFrom VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @detailResultFields VARCHAR(4000), @script NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @structFields = '', @structFrom = '', @queryFields = '', @queryJoin = '', @resultFields = '', @detailStructFields = '', @detailStructFrom = '', @detailQueryFields = '', @detailQueryJoin = '', @detailResultFields = '', @script = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @structFields = REPLACE(struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @structFrom = REPLACE(struct_from, '''', ''''''), @queryFields = REPLACE(query_fields, '''', ''''''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(query_join, '''', ''''''), @resultFields = REPLACE(result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND detail_struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @detailStructFields = REPLACE(detail_struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailStructFrom = REPLACE(detail_struct_from, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryFields = REPLACE(detail_query_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryJoin = REPLACE(detail_query_join, '''', ''''''), @detailResultFields = REPLACE(detail_result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND script <> '')
		SELECT @script = script FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct External Fields
	IF @structFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @structFields + ' from ' + @structFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q
	END
	IF @detailStructFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @detailStructFields + ' from ' + @detailstructFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q
	END


	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #master FROM #m0
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0

	SELECT @c0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#m0', '#master', null, null)
	SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c0 = REPLACE(',' + @c0, ',key,', '[key],'), @c1 = REPLACE(',' + @c1, ',key,', '[key],')

	--++ Master
	-- Master Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master(' + @c0 + ') select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_gd, a.datetime2, a.ngay_lct, ''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', 1 as ty_gia'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', rtrim(b.ma_nv), a.ten_kh, a.mst_kh, a.dia_chi_kh, a.dien_thoai_kh, a.email_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.quoc_tich, a.doi_tuong, a.so_giay_to, a.ngay_cap_giay_to, a.noi_cap_giay_to, a.ghi_chuhoadon'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.t_tnc_thue, a.t_tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_bh_bb, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_thanh_toan, ''' + @Language + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @queryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + REPLACE(@queryFields, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END) END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrm01$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec' + @queryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' z where a.stt_rec = z.[key])]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail(' + @c1 + ') select a.stt_rec, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.line_nbr, rtrim(a.line_nbr), a.thang_kt, a.thang_kt1, a.thang_kt2, a.nam_kt, a.tnc_thue, a.tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.thue, a.bh_bb'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailQueryFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrd01$%Partition a with(nolock) join ' + @TableName + ' z on a.stt_rec = z.[key]' + @detailQueryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	-- External script
	IF RTRIM(@script) <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @script = REPLACE(@script, '%language', @Language)
		EXEC sp_executesql @script
	END

	-- Note
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE RTRIM(ghi_chuhoadon) <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #master SET ghi_chuhoadon = '2' + CHAR(255) + RTRIM(ghi_chuhoadon) WHERE RTRIM(ghi_chuhoadon) <> ''
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT *, @Unit AS ma_dvcs, 0 AS loai_hd, 1 AS tinh_chat, @userName AS user_name FROM #master ORDER BY id
	SELECT * FROM #detail ORDER BY [key], id

	--
	SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, '' AS ky_hieu, '' AS loai_hd

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAcountsBalance] --fs_AcountsBalance
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@GLAccount TINYINT,
	@Level INT,
	@AccountType TINYINT,
	@ReportType TINYINT,
	@BalanceType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@DateTo, @BalanceType)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co AS du_co, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Temp
	SELECT tk INTO #tk_cn0 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1 AND tk_cn = 0
	SELECT tk INTO #tk_cn1 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1 AND tk_cn = 1
	SELECT tk INTO #loai_tk1 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1

	-- Balance (Year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_kh, tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh with(nolock, index(nam))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and tk in (select tk from #tk_cn1)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select '''', tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and tk in (select tk from #tk_cn0)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (Period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_kh, tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' with(nolock, index(tk))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where tk in (select tk from #tk_cn1)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select '''', tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' with(nolock, index(tk))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where tk in (select tk from #tk_cn0)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (Arising)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_kh, tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from #loai_tk1)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	-- DC Account
	SELECT ma_kh, tk, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt
		INTO #dc FROM #t WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn1) GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	UPDATE #dc SET du_no = CASE WHEN du_no - du_co > 0 THEN du_no - du_co ELSE 0 END, du_co = CASE WHEN du_co - du_no > 0 THEN du_co - du_no ELSE 0 END
		, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN du_no_nt - du_co_nt > 0 THEN du_no_nt - du_co_nt ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN du_co_nt - du_no_nt > 0 THEN du_co_nt - du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

	-- Account
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, tk, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt
		INTO #Balance FROM #t
		WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn0)
		GROUP BY tk

	CREATE INDEX i ON #Balance(tk)
	DECLARE @Tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #Balance SET @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
		, du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END
		, du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

	INSERT INTO #Balance SELECT 5, 1, 1, tk, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #dc GROUP BY tk

	SELECT @du_no = 0, @du_no_nt = 0, @du_co = 0, @du_co_nt = 0
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 0 ORDER BY tk DESC
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #Balance WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%') BEGIN
			SELECT @du_no = SUM(du_no), @du_no_nt = SUM(du_no_nt), @du_co = SUM(du_co), @du_co_nt = SUM(du_co_nt)
				FROM #Balance WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #loai_tk1)

			INSERT INTO #Balance (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt)
				VALUES(5, 1, 0, @Tk, ISNULL(@du_no, 0), ISNULL(@du_no_nt, 0), ISNULL(@du_co, 0), ISNULL(@du_co_nt, 0))
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	IF @GLAccount = 1 DELETE #Balance FROM #Balance a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE tk_sc = 0
	IF @Level <> 99 DELETE #Balance FROM #Balance a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE bac_tk > @Level
	IF @AccountType = 1 DELETE #Balance FROM #Balance a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE loai_tk = 0

	EXEC(N'declare @c varchar(32), @d varchar(32), @i int; update #Balance set @d = tk, @i = case when @d like @c then 0 else 1 end, @c = case when @i = 1 then rtrim(@d) + ''%'' else @c end, systotal = @i from #Balance with (index(i)) option (maxdop 1)')

	DELETE #Balance WHERE ISNULL(du_no, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(du_co, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(du_no_nt, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(du_co_nt, 0) = 0

	INSERT INTO #Balance (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, '', SUM(du_no), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #Balance WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #Balance (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk) VALUES (1, 0, 0, '')

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
		FROM #Balance a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		ORDER BY sysorder, a.tk
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostBeforeAdjustmentInventory]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @year INT, @status CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @d2 VARCHAR(32), @roundQ TINYINT

	SELECT @roundQ = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.status INTO #master FROM m37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec0pn INTO #detail FROM d37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select stt_rec, ngay_ct, status from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @year = YEAR(ngay_ct), @status = status FROM #master
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), GETDATE(), 113), @d2 = @d1

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn from ' + CASE WHEN @status = '2' THEN 'indcsd2' ELSE 'indcsd' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = '
UPDATE cdvt SET ton00 = ton00 - b.so_luong, du00 = du00 - b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 - b.tien_nt
	FROM cdvt a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '

UPDATE cdvitri SET ton00 = ton00 - b.so_luong, du00 = du00 - b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 - b.tien_nt
	FROM cdvitri a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '

UPDATE cdlo SET ton00 = ton00 - b.so_luong, du00 = du00 - b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 - b.tien_nt
	FROM cdlo a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '

INSERT INTO cdvt(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vt, -SUM(so_luong), -SUM(tien), -SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt

INSERT INTO cdvitri(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, -SUM(so_luong), -SUM(tien), -SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt

INSERT INTO cdlo(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, -SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, -SUM(tien) AS tien, -SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
'

	IF @status = '1' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		UPDATE d37$000000 SET sl_dc = sl_dc - b.so_luong FROM d37$000000 a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn AND a.stt_rec <> @idNumber
		UPDATE cdntxt SET ton_kho01 = ton_kho01 - b.so_luong, so_du01 = so_du01 - b.tien, so_du_nt01 = so_du_nt01 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho02 = ton_kho02 - b.so_luong, so_du02 = so_du02 - b.tien, so_du_nt02 = so_du_nt02 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho03 = ton_kho03 - b.so_luong, so_du03 = so_du03 - b.tien, so_du_nt03 = so_du_nt03 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho04 = ton_kho04 - b.so_luong, so_du04 = so_du04 - b.tien, so_du_nt04 = so_du_nt04 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho05 = ton_kho05 - b.so_luong, so_du05 = so_du05 - b.tien, so_du_nt05 = so_du_nt05 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho06 = ton_kho06 - b.so_luong, so_du06 = so_du06 - b.tien, so_du_nt06 = so_du_nt06 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho07 = ton_kho07 - b.so_luong, so_du07 = so_du07 - b.tien, so_du_nt07 = so_du_nt07 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho08 = ton_kho08 - b.so_luong, so_du08 = so_du08 - b.tien, so_du_nt08 = so_du_nt08 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho09 = ton_kho09 - b.so_luong, so_du09 = so_du09 - b.tien, so_du_nt09 = so_du_nt09 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho10 = ton_kho10 - b.so_luong, so_du10 = so_du10 - b.tien, so_du_nt10 = so_du_nt10 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho11 = ton_kho11 - b.so_luong, so_du11 = so_du11 - b.tien, so_du_nt11 = so_du_nt11 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho12 = ton_kho12 - b.so_luong, so_du12 = so_du12 - b.tien, so_du_nt12 = so_du_nt12 - b.tien_nt,
				ton_kho13 = ton_kho13 - b.so_luong, so_du13 = so_du13 - b.tien, so_du_nt13 = so_du_nt13 - b.tien_nt,
				so_luong = a.so_luong - b.so_luong, tien = a.tien - b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt - b.tien_nt
			FROM cdntxt a JOIN (
				SELECT x.ma_kho, x.ma_vi_tri, x.ma_vt, x.ma_lo, CASE WHEN x.stt_rec_pn = '' THEN @idNumber ELSE x.stt_rec_pn END AS stt_rec_pn, x.stt_rec0pn, SUM(x.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(x.tien) AS tien, SUM(x.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
					FROM #detail x JOIN dmvt y ON x.ma_vt = y.ma_vt
					WHERE y.gia_ton = 3
					GROUP BY x.ma_kho, x.ma_vi_tri, x.ma_vt, x.ma_lo, x.stt_rec_pn, x.stt_rec0pn
					) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn
			WHERE a.nam = RTRIM(@year)
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF @status = '2' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, 'cdvt', 'cdvt2'), 'cdvitri', 'cdvitri2'), 'cdlo', 'cdlo2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	EXEC fs_Adjustment$UpdateCurrentStock 'delete', @status

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintDDTran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.so_phieu, a.ngay_phieu, a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.so_hd, a.ngay_hd, a.tt_nt, a.tt_qd, a.ma_nt_hd, a.ty_gia_hd, a.tt, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia_hd'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg' AND CAST(val AS INT) > 10) BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'declare @s nvarchar(4000)'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'set @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringColumn(''#report'', ''ty_gia'', ''chuoi_ty_gia'')'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @s'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'set @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringColumn(''#report'', ''ty_gia_hd'', ''chuoi_ty_gia_hd'')'
		SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @s'
	END

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 13, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''so_phieu, ma_nt, ma_nt_hd'', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollOtherFields]
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s VARCHAR(33), @e VARCHAR(12)
	SELECT ma_loai_lg INTO #loailuong FROM #hrloailuong WHERE kieu = '9'
	SELECT @e = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #loailuong

	-- Process
	WHILE @e IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = LOWER(RTRIM(@e)) FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg = @e

		SELECT @q = 'alter table #hrluong add ' + @s + ' numeric(28, 6)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--
		SELECT @e = MIN(ma_loai_lg) FROM #loailuong WHERE ma_loai_lg > @e
	END
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCheckCoeffValidate]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@FactorCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @ma_bp0 VARCHAR(33), @ma_bp VARCHAR(33), @so_lsx VARCHAR(33), @ma_sp VARCHAR(33)

	-- Template tables
	SELECT ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp INTO #t0 FROM xdmcdsp WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #t1 FROM #t0
	SELECT * INTO #t2 FROM #t1
	SELECT * INTO #t3 FROM #t1

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp0 INTO #bp0 FROM xctpbtg WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp INTO #bp FROM xctpbtg WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode
	SELECT DISTINCT so_lsx INTO #lsx FROM xctpbtg WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_sp INTO #sp FROM xctpbtg WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode

	-- Replace blank item with all items
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp FROM #t0 ORDER BY ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ma_bp0, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_sp
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
			INSERT INTO #t1(ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp) VALUES (@ma_bp0, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_sp)

			IF @ma_bp0 = ''
				BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
					INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT b.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp FROM #t1 a CROSS JOIN #bp0 b
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
					INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT * FROM #t2
				END

			IF @ma_bp = ''
				BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
					INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT a.ma_bp0, b.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp FROM #t1 a CROSS JOIN #bp b
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
					INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT * FROM #t2
				END
				
			IF @so_lsx = ''
				BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
					INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, b.so_lsx, a.ma_sp FROM #t1 a CROSS JOIN #lsx b
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
					INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT * FROM #t2
				END

			IF @ma_sp = ''
				BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
					INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.ma_sp FROM #t1 a CROSS JOIN #sp b
					TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
					INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT * FROM #t2
				END
			--
			INSERT INTO #t3 SELECT * FROM #t1
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ma_bp0, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_sp
		END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr
	
	TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
	INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp FROM #t3

	-- Delete for not validated
	DELETE xctpbtg
		FROM xctpbtg a LEFT JOIN #t1 b ON a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp
		WHERE a.ky = @Period AND a.nam = @Year AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_yt = @FactorCode AND (b.ma_sp IS NULL)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptLoanContractStatusDetail] -- fs20_KUbccttv
	  @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	, @Account VARCHAR(33)
	, @ContractType CHAR(1)
	, @LoanContract VARCHAR(33)
	, @Job VARCHAR(33)
	, @Contract VARCHAR(33)
	, @Status VARCHAR(32)
	, @Unit VARCHAR(1023)
	, @Language CHAR(1)
	, @UserID INT
	, @Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @BalanceKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023), @i INT

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ku, tk, ngay_ct, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) ngay_vay, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) ngay_dh
			, ps_no AS du_dk, ps_no AS ps_no, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_no AS du_ck
			, ps_no_nt AS du_dk_nt, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt, ps_no_nt AS du_ck_nt
			, dien_giai
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.tinh_trang in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''') and a.loai_ku = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @LoanContract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@LoanContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @ContractType = '1' BEGIN
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SET @q = 'insert into #report'
		SET @q = @q + ' select b.ma_ku, b.tk, b.ngay_ct, null, null, 0, sum(b.ps_no), sum(b.ps_co), 0'
		SET @q = @q + ', 0, sum(b.ps_no_nt), sum(b.ps_co_nt), 0, max(b.dien_giai)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dmku a join r00$%partition b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by b.tk, b.ma_ku, b.ngay_ct'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- Lấy những phát sinh thu chi thỏa điều kiện đưa vào
		SET @q = 'insert into #report'
		SET @q = @q + ' select b.ma_ku, b.tk, b.ngay_ct, null, null, 0, sum(b.ps_co), sum(b.ps_no), 0'
		SET @q = @q + ', 0, sum(b.ps_co_nt), sum(b.ps_no_nt), 0, max(b.dien_giai)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from dmku a join r00$%partition b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.tk = b.tk'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by b.tk, b.ma_ku, b.ngay_ct'
	END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Lấy số dư đầu kỳ các khế ước
	SET @BalanceKey = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'x.')
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_ku, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #dk FROM cdku
	INSERT INTO #dk EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$BContract @DateFrom, @Unit, '', '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmku x on a.tk = x.tk and a.ma_ku = x.ma_ku', @BalanceKey

	-- Đánh số theo thứ tự tk, ma_ku, ngay_ct
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS id2, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, tk, ma_ku, ngay_ct, ngay_vay, ngay_dh
			, du_dk, ps_no, ps_co, du_ck, du_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_ck_nt, dien_giai
		INTO #report2 FROM #report ORDER BY tk, ma_ku, ngay_ct
	--
	SELECT tk, ma_ku, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #report2 GROUP BY tk, ma_ku
	UPDATE #report2 SET id2 = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #report2 a JOIN #g b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku

	-- Cập nhật số dư đầu kỳ cho ngày đầu tiên theo tk, ma_ku
	UPDATE #report2
		SET du_dk = CASE WHEN c.loai_ku = '1' THEN (b.du_co - b.du_no) ELSE (b.du_no - b.du_co) END
				, du_dk_nt = CASE WHEN c.loai_ku = '1' THEN (b.du_co_nt - b.du_no_nt) ELSE (b.du_no_nt - b.du_co_nt) END
		FROM #report2 a
			JOIN #dk b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku
			JOIN dmku c ON a.tk = c.tk AND a.ma_ku = c.ma_ku
		WHERE a.id2 = 1

	-- Cập nhật dư đầu, dư cuối cho các ngày tiếp theo
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= (SELECT MAX(id2) FROM #report2) BEGIN
		UPDATE #report2 SET du_ck = du_dk - ps_no + ps_co, du_ck_nt = du_dk_nt - ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt WHERE id2 = @i
		UPDATE #report2 SET du_dk = b.du_ck, du_dk_nt = b.du_ck_nt FROM #report2 a JOIN (SELECT tk, ma_ku, du_ck, du_ck_nt FROM #report2 WHERE id2 = @i) b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku WHERE id2 = @i + 1
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Insert dòng tổng
	INSERT INTO #report2
		SELECT 0, 4, 1, 0, a.tk, a.ma_ku, NULL, b.ngay_ku1, b.ngay_ku2, du_dk, 0, 0, 0, du_dk_nt, 0, 0, 0, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ku ELSE b.ten_ku2 END
			FROM #report2 a JOIN dmku b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku
			WHERE id2 = 1

	-- Cập nhật phát sinh cho dòng tổng
	UPDATE #report2 SET ps_no = b.ps_no, ps_co = b.ps_co, ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt
		FROM #report2 a JOIN (SELECT tk, ma_ku, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt FROM #report2 GROUP BY tk, ma_ku) b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku
		WHERE sysorder = 4

	-- Insert dòng tổng cho các khế ước không có phát sinh trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #report2
		SELECT 0, 4, 1, 0, a.tk, a.ma_ku, NULL, b.ngay_ku1, b.ngay_ku2
				, CASE WHEN b.loai_ku = '1' THEN (a.du_co - a.du_no) ELSE (a.du_no - a.du_co) END, 0, 0, 0
				, CASE WHEN b.loai_ku = '1' THEN (a.du_co_nt - a.du_no_nt) ELSE (a.du_no_nt - a.du_co_nt) END, 0, 0, 0
				, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ku ELSE b.ten_ku2 END
			FROM #dk a JOIN dmku b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report2 x WHERE x.tk = a.tk AND x.ma_ku = a.ma_ku)

	-- Cập nhật dư cuối cho dòng tổng
	UPDATE #report2 SET du_ck = (du_dk - ps_no + ps_co), du_ck_nt = (du_dk_nt - ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt) WHERE id2 = 0

	-- Kết quả
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 sysprint FROM #report2) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report2(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ma_ku) VALUES (0, 0, 0, '', '')
		SELECT *, '' ten_tk, '' ten_tk2, '' ten_ku, '' ten_ku2, '' ma_ku_in FROM #report2
	END ELSE
		SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.tk, a.ma_ku, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_vay, a.ngay_dh, a.du_dk, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.du_ck, a.du_dk_nt, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.du_ck_nt, a.dien_giai
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_tk2 END ten_tk2
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_ku ELSE '' END ten_ku, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE c.ten_ku2 END ten_ku2
				, CASE WHEN systotal = 0 THEN a.ma_ku ELSE '' END AS ma_ku_in
			FROM #report2 a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN dmku c ON a.ma_ku = c.ma_ku
			ORDER BY a.tk, c.ngay_ku1, a.ma_ku, a.sysorder, a.ngay_ct

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetInfoRecord$Multi]
	@Unit VARCHAR(16),
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(16),
	@PurGroup VARCHAR(16),
	@Customer VARCHAR(16),
	@Currency VARCHAR(16),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@DefaultUOM CHAR(1),
	@Field VARCHAR(1024),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@AutoConvertUOM BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @he_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @priceRound INT, @k1 NVARCHAR(1024), @k2 NVARCHAR(1024), @k3 NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'

	SELECT c.id AS xgroup, c.sl_qd AS p_sl_qd, c.ma_vung AS p_ma_vung, a.*, b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, b.ma_rb, b.sl_dat_tt, b.sl_dat_td, b.so_ngay_giao, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #gia FROM bigia01 a JOIN bigia02 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 JOIN #data c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND (a.ma_vung = c.ma_vung OR a.ma_vung = '')
		WHERE a.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.status = '1' AND a.ma_nt = @Currency
			AND a.ma_kh = @Customer
			AND (b.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_tu <= @VoucherDate) AND (b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den >= @VoucherDate)

	-- Xóa dữ liệu không ưu tiên
	SELECT a.xgroup, a.id INTO #notDeletePlant FROM #gia a JOIN #data b ON a.xgroup = b.id AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung
	INSERT INTO #notDeletePlant SELECT xgroup, id FROM #gia WHERE xgroup NOT IN (SELECT xgroup FROM #notDeletePlant)
	DELETE #gia FROM #gia a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #notDeletePlant b WHERE a.xgroup = b.xgroup AND a.id = b.id)

	SELECT a.xgroup, a.id INTO #notDeleteUOM FROM #gia a JOIN #data b ON a.xgroup = b.id AND a.dvt1 = b.dvt
	INSERT INTO #notDeleteUOM SELECT xgroup, id FROM #gia WHERE xgroup NOT IN (SELECT xgroup FROM #notDeleteUOM)
	DELETE #gia FROM #gia a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #notDeleteUOM b WHERE a.xgroup = b.xgroup AND a.id = b.id)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> '' AND so_luong <= p_sl_qd) BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, MAX(so_luong) AS so_luong, xgroup INTO #t FROM #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> '' AND so_luong <= p_sl_qd GROUP BY xgroup, stt_rec, stt_rec0
		DELETE #gia FROM #gia a WHERE a.stt_rec1 <> '' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t t WHERE t.xgroup = a.xgroup AND t.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND t.stt_rec0 = t.stt_rec0 AND t.so_luong = a.so_luong)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE #gia FROM #gia WHERE stt_rec1 <> ''
	END

	-- Thứ tự ưu tiên giá theo chứng từ
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS xid, id, xgroup INTO #id FROM #gia a JOIN bidmngm b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE b.ma_cn = @VoucherCode ORDER BY b.stt ASC, ngay_hl_tu DESC, gia_nt ASC, a.stt_rec

	SELECT a.* INTO #res FROM #gia a JOIN #id b ON a.id = b.id JOIN (SELECT MIN(xid) AS stt, xgroup FROM #id GROUP BY xgroup) c ON b.xid = c.stt

	IF @AutoConvertUOM = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #res SET gia_chuan_nt = ROUND(gia_chuan_nt * b.he_so, @priceRound), gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt * b.he_so, @priceRound),
			ck_dv_nt = ROUND(ck_dv_nt * b.he_so, @priceRound), cp_dv_nt = ROUND(cp_dv_nt * b.he_so, @priceRound)
			FROM #res a JOIN #data b ON a.xgroup = b.id
	END

	SELECT a.ct_gia_dk, a.he_so1, a.xgroup INTO #ctgiaqd FROM #res a JOIN #data b ON a.xgroup = b.id WHERE a.dvt1 <> b.dvt AND ISNULL(a.ct_gia_dk, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(a.he_so1, 0) <> 0
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ctgiaqd) BEGIN
		DECLARE @ct_gia_dk NVARCHAR(4000), @he_so1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @xgroup INT
		SELECT @xgroup = MIN(xgroup) FROM #ctgiaqd
		SELECT TOP 0 b.line_nbr AS id, a.ma_loai, a.ma_loai as ma_so, b.gia_nt as gia_tri, b.ct_gia_dk as cong_thuc, b.ct_gia_dk as ghi_chu, a.kieu_tinh, a.kieu_cap_nhat
			INTO #cts FROM bidmldkg a, bigia01 b

		WHILE @xgroup IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ct_gia_dk = ct_gia_dk, @he_so1 = he_so1 FROM #ctgiaqd WHERE xgroup = @xgroup

			EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_gia_dk, '#cts', 'id, ma_loai, ma_so, gia_tri, cong_thuc, ghi_chu'
			UPDATE #cts SET kieu_tinh = b.kieu_tinh, kieu_cap_nhat = b.kieu_cap_nhat FROM #cts a JOIN bidmldkg b ON a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai
			UPDATE #cts SET gia_tri = gia_tri/@he_so1 * @he_so WHERE kieu_tinh = '2' AND kieu_cap_nhat IN ('1', '2', '3')

			SET @ct_gia_dk = ''
			SELECT @ct_gia_dk = @ct_gia_dk + CASE WHEN @ct_gia_dk <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END +
					+ '["' + REPLACE(RTRIM(ma_loai), '"', '\"') + '","'
					+ REPLACE(RTRIM(ma_so), '"', '\"') + '",'
					+ LTRIM(CAST(ISNULL(gia_tri, 0) AS FLOAT)) + ',"'
					+ REPLACE(cong_thuc, '"', '\"') + '","'
					+ REPLACE(ghi_chu, '"', '\"') + '"]'
				FROM #cts

			UPDATE #res SET ct_gia_dk = '[' + @ct_gia_dk + ']' WHERE xgroup = @xgroup
			SELECT @xgroup = MIN(xgroup) FROM #ctgiaqd WHERE xgroup > @xgroup
			TRUNCATE TABLE #cts
		END
	END

	IF @Field = ''
		SELECT * FROM #res
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ' + @Field + ' from #res'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhreqtlkdht]
AS
SELECT     a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_bd, a.ma_nt, a.tinh_chat, a.he_so, a.luong_co_ban, a.hs_phu_cap1, a.hs_phu_cap2, a.hs_phu_cap3, a.tien_phu_cap1, a.tien_phu_cap2, 
                      a.tien_phu_cap3, a.t_tien_phu_cap, a.t_thu_nhap, a.ly_do, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ten_nt AS ten_ma_nt, 
                      b.ten_nt2 AS ten_ma_nt2, CASE tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN N'Chính thức' ELSE N'Thử việc' END AS ten_tinh_chat, 
                      CASE tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN N'Official' ELSE N'Probationary' END AS ten_tinh_chat2
FROM         dbo.hreqtlkdht AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.dmnt AS b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI107] --Doanh thu theo mặt hàng
	@TimeID CHAR(3), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ngay_dn AS SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_dn0 AS SMALLDATETIME, @month AS INTEGER
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc, @ngay_dn0 = ngay_dn2, @month = MONTH(ngay_dn2) FROM dmstt
