	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	IF MONTH(@GetDate) >= @month
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), @month)
	ELSE
		SET @ngay_dn = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate) - 1, @month)
	
	IF @TimeID = '001'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '002'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DAY, -1, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, 7, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '004'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -14, @GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '005'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate))),DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '006'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)-1),@GetDate)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY,-(DAY(@GetDate)),@GetDate), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '007'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '008'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '009'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '010'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 9, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '011'  
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '012' 
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(MONTH, 6, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '013'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @ngay_dn, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ngay_dn)), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)
	IF @TimeID = '014'
		SELECT @DateFrom = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ngay_dn), 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt, tien2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select ngay_ct, ma_vt, sum(tien2) as tien2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where %[charindex(ma_ct, ''HDA, E01'') > 0]% group by ngay_ct, ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE MAX(b.ten_vt2) END AS ten_vt, SUM(a.tien2) AS tien
		INTO #ct70
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY ngay_ct, a.ma_vt

	DECLARE @select AS VARCHAR(1000), @end AS VARCHAR(255)
	SET @select = ' select ma_vt, max(ten_vt) as ten_vt, cast(sum(tien) as varchar) as tien from #ct70 where tien <> 0'
	SET @end = ' group by ma_vt order by tien desc'

	DECLARE @week AS NVARCHAR(1000)
	SELECT @week =  ' declare @GetDate as smalldatetime; set @GetDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) + ''''

	IF @TimeID = '003'
		SELECT @q = @week + char(13) + @select + ' and datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = datepart(wk, @GetDate) and year(ngay_ct) = year(@GetDate)' + @end
	ELSE
		IF @TimeID = '004'
			SELECT @q = @week + char(13) + @select + ' and datepart(wk, ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then 53 else (datepart(wk, @GetDate) - 1) end and year(ngay_ct) = case datepart(wk, ngay_ct) when 1 then (year(@GetDate) - 1) else year(@GetDate) end' + @end
		ELSE
			SET @q = @select + @end
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_MRPPlanOrderHistory] @version VARCHAR(32), @nUserID INT, @type TINYINT = 1 -- 1, Save, 2 - Delete
AS
BEGIN
	DELETE mrhistory WHERE version = @version
	IF @type <> 1 RETURN
	INSERT INTO mrhistory
		(
			version, nguon, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton
			, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
			, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
			, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
		)
	SELECT @version, nguon,so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ngay_ct
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton
			, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
			, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
			, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
		FROM mrctyc WHERE nguon = 'PL'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_DeleteExRDTrans]
	@nMF INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@cAction VARCHAR(8)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @cStt_rec CHAR(13), @dDate SMALLDATETIME

	SET @dDate = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMF, @nYear)

	IF @cAction = 'Delete'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Delete')
	IF @cAction = 'New'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'New')

	--
	SELECT @s = 'DELETE FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DELETE FROM r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112) + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--

	SET @q = 'DECLARE csTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@nMF, 2), ' ', '0') + ' AS stt_rec FROM dmcltg1'
	SET @q = @q + ' WHERE Nam = ' + STR(@nYear, 4) + ' AND tag <> '''' AND stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@nMF, 2), ' ', '0') + ' <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	OPEN csTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%stt_rec', RTRIM(@cStt_rec))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
	END
	CLOSE csTran
	DEALLOCATE csTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReplaceInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @r VARCHAR(32), @tinh_trang_hddt CHAR(1), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @VoucherIDReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDateReplace SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherNo VARCHAR(32), @VoucherNoReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherUnit VARCHAR(32), @provider INT

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, '', '', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @VoucherIDReplace = REPLACE(stt_rec0, '''', ''), @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct0, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct0, @VoucherNo = so_ct1 FROM hddt05 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID

	SELECT @mTable = '', @q = '', @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112), @refp = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDateReplace, 112)

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' SELECT @mTable = 'm84$' + @p, @dTable = 'd84$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' SELECT @mTable = 'm85$' + @p, @dTable = 'd85$' + @p

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' SELECT @mTable = 'pxdc', @dTable = ''

	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Lock Date of Original Voucher
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @VoucherDateReplace, @UserID, @Unit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Modify Date
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Customer
	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 1, 1) = '0' AND @VoucherCode = 'PXA' BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM khhddt WHERE ma_kh = @Customer AND status <> '0') BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Customer AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Replacement Voucher
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @x = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hddt00$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x char(1) output', @x = @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

	IF (@tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '0') AND @provider <> 3 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END
	--
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @x = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hddt00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDateReplace, 112) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherIDReplace + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x char(1) output', @x = @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

	IF @tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '2' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Flow
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
		DECLARE @checkStatus BIT, @table VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @table = CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN '84' ELSE '85' END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hddt05 WHERE stt_rec0 = @VoucherIDReplace AND cn_qui_trinh = 1) BEGIN
			SET @q = 'if exists(select top 1 1 from d' + @table + '$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec1 and (stt_rec_pn <> '''' or stt_rec_yc <> '''' or stt_rec_wh <> '''')) set @checkStatus = 1 else set @checkStatus = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec1 char(13), @checkStatus bit out', @VoucherID, @checkStatus OUT
			IF @checkStatus = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 6 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END

			SET @q = 'if (select loai_ct from m' + @table + '$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec0) <> (select loai_ct from m' + @table + '$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec1) set @checkStatus = 1 else set @checkStatus = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec0 char(13), @stt_rec1 char(13), @checkStatus bit out', @VoucherIDReplace, @VoucherID, @checkStatus out
			IF @checkStatus = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	--
	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRMActivitySummary]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@PeriodRcrt VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@RoundRcrt VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dot INTO #period FROM hrrmdot
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dot, a.ma_hs, c.ma_vtr, c.ma_bp, a.ma_vong, b.ma_pv AS ma_ktr_pv, a.noi_dung, a.ma_kq INTO #tmp FROM hrrmkqpv a, hrrmkqpvct b, hrrmhs c
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt_x, a.ma_dot, b.ngay_ct, b.ten_dot, a.ma_vtr, e.ten_vtr, e.stt AS stt_vtr
			, a.ma_bp, f.ten_bp, f.stt_ref, a.so_luong AS sl_td, a.so_luong AS sl_uv, a.so_luong AS sl_dt, d.ma_vong, g.ten_vong
			, h.ma_pv AS ma_ktr_pv, e.ten_vtr AS noi_dung, a.so_luong AS sl_dat, a.so_luong AS sl_kdat INTO #report
		FROM hrrmdotct a, hrrmdot b, hrrmhs c, hrrmkqpv d, hrvt e, hrbp f, hrdmvongtd g, hrrmkqpvct h

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @Key2 = ''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--	
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'b.ma_dvcs'), 'a.bp_ref', 'z.bp_ref') + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.%day between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
		
	IF @PeriodRcrt <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_dot like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodRcrt), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.ma_vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'z.')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SET @Key2 = @Key
	IF @RoundRcrt <> '' SELECT @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and b.ma_vong like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@RoundRcrt), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	
	-- Get Period
	INSERT INTO #period SELECT ma_dot FROM hrrmdot where ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo

	-- Get Data
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @Join = @Join + ' left join %detail b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		SET @Join = @Join + ' left join %ref e with(nolock) on a.ma_%v = e.ma_%v'
	END
	SET @Join = @Join + ' join hrrmhs c with(nolock) on b.ma_hs = c.ma_hs and b.ma_dot = c.ma_dot'
	SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on c.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'
	
	SET @strSQL = 'insert into #tmp select distinct b.ma_dot, b.ma_hs, c.ma_vtr, c.ma_bp, b.ma_vong, %codeTI, %nameTI, b.ma_kq'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from %table with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @Key2
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' and b.ma_dot in (select ma_dot from #period)'

	---- Interview
	IF @Type = 2 OR @Type = 3 BEGIN
		IF @ReportType = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '%codeTI','a.ma_pv'), '%nameTI', 'e.ten_pv%l'), '%table', 'hrrmkqpvct a'), '%detail', 'hrrmkqpv'), '%ref', 'hrdmpv'), '%v', 'pv'), '%day', 'ngay_pv')
			ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '%codeTI', ''''''), '%nameTI', ''''''), '%table', 'hrrmkqpv b'), '%detail', ''), '%ref', 'hrdmpv'), '%v', 'pv'), '%day', 'ngay_pv')
		IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	---- Test
	IF @Type = 1 OR @Type = 3 BEGIN
		IF @ReportType = '1' SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '%codeTI', 'a.ma_ktr'), '%nameTI', 'e.ten_ktr%l'), '%table', 'hrrmkqktrct a'), '%detail', 'hrrmkqktr'), '%ref', 'hrdmktr'), '%v', 'ktr'), '%day', 'ngay_ktr') + ' and not exists(select 1 from #tmp where ma_dot = b.ma_dot and ma_hs = b.ma_hs and ma_vong = b.ma_vong)'
			ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '%codeTI', ''''''), '%nameTI', ''''''), '%table', 'hrrmkqktr b'), '%detail', ''), '%ref', 'hrdmktr'), '%v', 'ktr'), '%day', 'ngay_ktr') + ' and not exists(select 1 from #tmp where ma_dot = b.ma_dot and ma_hs = b.ma_hs and ma_vong = b.ma_vong)'
		IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Passed/Failed
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv, noi_dung, 0 AS sl_dat, 0 AS sl_kdat INTO #d FROM #tmp
	INSERT INTO #d
		SELECT ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv, MAX(noi_dung), COUNT(ma_hs), 0
			FROM #tmp WHERE ma_kq = '1' GROUP BY ma_dot, ma_hs, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv
	INSERT INTO #d
		SELECT ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv, MAX(noi_dung), 0, COUNT(ma_hs)
			FROM #tmp WHERE ma_kq = '2' GROUP BY ma_dot, ma_hs, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv
	SELECT ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv, MAX(noi_dung) AS noi_dung, SUM(sl_dat) AS sl_dat, SUM(sl_kdat) AS sl_kdat INTO #d2
		FROM #d GROUP BY ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv

	-- Get Period Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, c.ma_dot, b.ngay_ct, b.ten_dot%l, c.ma_vtr, isnull(d.ten_vtr%l, ''''), d.stt, c.ma_bp, isnull(z.ten_bp%l, ''''), z.stt_ref'
	SET @q = @q + ', c.so_luong, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrrmdotct c with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on c.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrrmdot b with(nolock) on c.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d with(nolock) on c.ma_vtr = d.ma_vtr'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%day', 'ngay_ct')
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET sl_dt = c.sl
		FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT COUNT(b.ma_hs) AS sl, b.ma_dot, b.ma_vtr, b.ma_bp FROM hrrmhs b WHERE b.status = '1' GROUP BY b.ma_dot, b.ma_vtr, b.ma_bp) c ON a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
	UPDATE #report SET sl_uv = c.sl
		FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT COUNT(b.ma_hs) AS sl, b.ma_dot, b.ma_vtr, b.ma_bp FROM hrrmhs b GROUP BY b.ma_dot, b.ma_vtr, b.ma_bp) c ON a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp

	-- Order Print
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp INTO #o1
		FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp
	INSERT INTO #o1 (ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp)
		SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot INTO #g FROM #o1 GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dot
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id + 1
		FROM #report a JOIN #o1 b ON a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct AND a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp JOIN #g c ON a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct AND a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot

	-- Insert Passed/Failed
	INSERT INTO #report 
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, b.ma_dot, b.ngay_ct, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_dot ELSE b.ten_dot2 END
				, ISNULL(a.ma_vtr, ''), CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(c.ten_vtr, '') ELSE ISNULL(c.ten_vtr2, '') END, c.stt
				, ISNULL(a.ma_bp, ''), CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(d.ten_bp, '') ELSE ISNULL(d.ten_bp2, '') END, d.stt_ref, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_vong
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(e.ten_vong, '') ELSE ISNULL(e.ten_vong2, '') END, a.ma_ktr_pv, ISNULL(a.noi_dung, ''), a.sl_dat, a.sl_kdat
			FROM #d2 a LEFT JOIN hrrmdot b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot LEFT JOIN hrvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr
						LEFT JOIN hrbp d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrdmvongtd e WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vong = e.ma_vong

	-- Order Suppress
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv INTO #o2 FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #o2 (ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv)
		SELECT DISTINCT ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv
			FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong, ma_ktr_pv
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong INTO #g2
		FROM #o2 GROUP BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong
	UPDATE #report SET stt_x = b.id - c.id + 1
		FROM #report a JOIN #o2 b ON a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct AND a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_vong = b.ma_vong AND a.ma_ktr_pv = b.ma_ktr_pv
						JOIN #g2 c ON a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct AND a.ma_dot = c.ma_dot AND a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr AND a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp AND a.ma_vong = c.ma_vong
	
	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_x, ma_dot, ten_dot, ten_vtr, ten_bp, sl_td, sl_uv, sl_dt, ma_vong, ten_vong, noi_dung, sl_dat, sl_kdat)
			VALUES (5, 1, 1, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0)

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_x, ngay_ct, ma_dot, ma_vtr, ma_bp, ma_vong, ten_dot, ten_vtr, ten_bp, sl_td, sl_uv, sl_dt, ten_vong, ma_ktr_pv, noi_dung, sl_dat, sl_kdat
		FROM #report ORDER BY ngay_ct, ma_dot, stt_vtr, ma_vtr, stt_ref, ma_bp, ma_vong

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW vctdmts1 
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ma_dvcs, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, b.loai_ts, c.loai_tg_ts
		FROM ctdmts1 a JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts JOIN dmtgts c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ky, a.so_the_ts

CREATE VIEW dbo.vctcttsfc 
AS 
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ten_ptkt, a.dvt, a.so_luong,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gia_tri_nt ELSE a.gia_tri END AS gia_tri,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gia_tri ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gia_tri_nt, ma_nt) END AS gia_tri_nt,	 
			a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.line_nbr,	 
			a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3,	 a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9 
		FROM ctctts a LEFT JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPRunCalcRequirementCapacity] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nCRPRunType INT, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ncRound TINYINT
	SELECT @ncRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #crhdnlsx FROM crhdnlsx

	-- Lay du lieu tu MPS
	SELECT ma_vt, so_dh, ngay_ct AS ngay_ht, sl_dh AS so_luong, nguon, ngay_dat INTO #mpctyc FROM mpctyc
		WHERE nguon IN ('MO', 'FP', 'PL') AND sl_dh > 0 AND ngay_ct >= @dNow AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct) <= @nPeriodCount

	-- Tinh nhu cau cong suat cho tung nguon luc
	IF @nCRPRunType = 1 -- CPOF
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #crhdnlsx
				(
					ma_vt, so_dh, nguon, ma_nl, loai_nl, ngay_ht, so_luong, cong_suat, so_ngay, ngay_bd
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
				SELECT a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, a.nguon, b.ma_nl, b.loai_nl, a.ngay_ht, a.so_luong, ROUND(a.so_luong * ISNULL(b.he_so, 0), @ncRound), 0, a.ngay_dat
						, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
					FROM #mpctyc a JOIN crhsnlsx b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		END

	IF @nCRPRunType = 2 OR @nCRPRunType = 3 -- Bill of Resource or RPA
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #crhdnlsx
				(
					ma_vt, so_dh, nguon, ma_nl, loai_nl, ngay_ht, so_luong
					, cong_suat, so_ngay
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
				SELECT a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, a.nguon, b.ma_nl, b.loai_nl, a.ngay_ht, a.so_luong
						,  ROUND(a.so_luong * ISNULL(b.he_so, 0), @ncRound) + ISNULL(b.tg_cai_dat, 0) + ISNULL(b.tg_bo_sung, 0), ISNULL(b.so_ngay, 0)
						, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
						, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
					FROM #mpctyc a JOIN crhsnlsx b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		END

	DELETE #crhdnlsx WHERE cong_suat <= 0
	TRUNCATE TABLE crhdnlsx
	INSERT INTO crhdnlsx SELECT * FROM #crhdnlsx
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSubAccountBalance] -- fs_SubAccountSummary
	@BalanceType TINYINT,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@bug TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @BalanceKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 AS SMALLDATETIME, @d2 AS SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @d1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateFrom), @d2 = @DateFrom - 1, @BalanceKey = '', @Key = ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #tBg FROM cdhd
	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tBg select a.tk, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[(a.tk in (select tk from dmtk where tk_cn = 0)) and a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @d1, @d2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #tBg select a.tk, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk a where (a.tk in (select tk from dmtk where tk_cn = 0)) and nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@DateFrom)) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- 1
	SET @BalanceKey = ' exists(select 1 from dmtk where tk = a.tk and tk_cn = 1)'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	INSERT INTO #tBg EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$DCAccount @DateFrom, NULL, @Account, '' , 1, @UserID, @Admin, '', @BalanceKey

	-- 2
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #tEdD FROM cdhd
	INSERT INTO #tEdD EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$DCAccount @DateTo, NULL, @Account, '' , 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @BalanceKey
	-- 3
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS Co_dk_nt,
				ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt,
				ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #c FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SET @q = 'insert into #c select tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no), SUM(Ps_no_nt), SUM(Ps_co), SUM(Ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0 '
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #c SELECT Tk, Du_no, Du_no_nt, Du_co, Du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tBg
	INSERT INTO #c SELECT Tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, Du_no, Du_no_nt, Du_co, Du_co_nt FROM #tEdD

	SELECT Tk, SUM(No_dk) AS No_dk, SUM(No_dk_nt) AS No_dk_nt, SUM(Co_dk) AS Co_dk, SUM(Co_dk_nt) AS Co_dk_nt,
			SUM(Ps_no) AS Ps_no, SUM(Ps_no_nt) AS Ps_no_nt, SUM(Ps_co) AS Ps_co, SUM(Ps_co_nt) AS Ps_co_nt,
			SUM(No_ck) AS No_ck, SUM(No_ck_nt) AS No_ck_nt, SUM(Co_ck) AS Co_ck, SUM(Co_ck_nt) AS Co_ck_nt
		INTO #tTrial
		FROM #c
		GROUP BY tk

	-- 4
	DELETE #tTrial WHERE ABS(No_dk) + ABS(No_dk_nt) + ABS(Co_dk) + ABS(Co_dk_nt) + ABS(Ps_no) + ABS(Ps_no_nt) + ABS(Ps_co) + ABS(Ps_co_nt) = 0

	-- 5
	DECLARE crAcc CURSOR FOR SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 0
	DECLARE @Tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @No_dk AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @No_dk_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Co_dk AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Co_dk_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ps_no AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_no_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_co AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ps_co_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @No_ck AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @No_ck_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Co_ck AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Co_ck_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)

	UPDATE #tTrial SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		WHERE Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1 AND Tk_cn = 0)
	SELECT @no_dk = 0, @no_dk_nt = 0, @no_ck = 0, @no_ck_nt = 0

	-- 6
	OPEN crAcc
	FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @Tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #tTrial WHERE Tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%')
			BEGIN
				SELECT @No_dk = SUM(No_dk), @No_dk_nt = SUM(No_dk_nt),
						@Co_dk = SUM(Co_dk), @Co_dk_nt = SUM(Co_dk_nt),
						@Ps_no = SUM(Ps_no), @Ps_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt),
						@Ps_co = SUM(Ps_co), @Ps_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt),
						@No_ck = SUM(No_ck), @No_ck_nt = SUM(No_ck_nt),
						@Co_ck = SUM(Co_ck), @Co_ck_nt = SUM(Co_ck_nt)
					FROM #tTrial
					WHERE Tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND Tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 1)
				INSERT INTO #tTrial (Tk, No_dk, No_dk_nt, Co_dk, Co_dk_nt, Ps_no, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co, Ps_co_nt, No_ck, No_ck_nt, Co_ck, Co_ck_nt)
					VALUES (@Tk, @No_dk, @No_dk_nt, @Co_dk,@Co_dk_nt,@Ps_no, @Ps_no_nt,@Ps_co, @Ps_co_nt, @No_ck,@No_ck_nt, @Co_ck,@Co_ck_nt)
			END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE crAcc
	DEALLOCATE crAcc

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, b.loai_tk AS systotal, a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2 INTO #report
		FROM #tTrial a JOIN Dmtk b ON a.Tk = b.Tk
		ORDER BY a.Tk
	SELECT @No_dk = SUM(No_dk), @No_dk_nt = SUM(No_dk_nt),
			@Co_dk = SUM(Co_dk), @Co_dk_nt = SUM(Co_dk_nt),
			@Ps_no = SUM(Ps_no), @Ps_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt),
			@Ps_co = SUM(Ps_co), @Ps_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt),
			@No_ck = SUM(No_ck), @No_ck_nt = SUM(No_ck_nt),
			@Co_ck = SUM(Co_ck), @Co_ck_nt = SUM(Co_ck_nt)
		FROM #report
		WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2,
			Tk, No_dk, No_dk_nt, Co_dk, Co_dk_nt, Ps_no, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co, Ps_co_nt,
			No_ck, No_ck_nt, Co_ck, Co_ck_nt)
			VALUES (0, 0, 0, '', '', '', @No_dk, @No_dk_nt, @Co_dk, @Co_dk_nt, @Ps_no, @Ps_no_nt, @Ps_co, @Ps_co_nt,
				@No_ck,@No_ck_nt, @Co_ck,@Co_ck_nt)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2) VALUES (1, 0, 0, '', '', '')

	IF @BalanceType = 1
		SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, No_dk - Co_dk AS Du_dk, No_dk_nt - Co_dk_nt AS Du_dk_nt, No_ck - Co_ck AS Du_ck, No_ck_nt - Co_ck_nt AS Du_ck_nt
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, tk
	ELSE
		SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, Co_dk - No_dk AS Du_dk, Co_dk_nt - No_dk_nt AS Du_dk_nt, Co_ck - No_ck AS Du_ck, Co_ck_nt - No_ck_nt AS Du_ck_nt
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
			FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, tk

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Charge] @c VARCHAR(32), @d VARCHAR(32), @k VARCHAR(128), @f VARCHAR(32) = 'tien0', @r VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @loai_cp VARCHAR(32), @loai_pb VARCHAR(32), @tien_cp_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), @tien_cp NUMERIC(38, 12), @h VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @r = CASE WHEN @r = '' THEN 'm_round_tien_nt' ELSE @r END

	CREATE TABLE #c(loai_cp VARCHAR(32), loai_pb VARCHAR(32), tien_cp_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), tien_cp NUMERIC(38, 12))
	CREATE TABLE #d(stt_rec0 VARCHAR(32), sl NUMERIC(38, 12), tt NUMERIC(38, 12), kl NUMERIC(38, 12), gt NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), cp NUMERIC(38, 12), 
		cp_vc_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_bh_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_khac_nt NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_vc NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_bh NUMERIC(38, 12), cp_khac NUMERIC(38, 12))

	EXEC('insert into #c select b.loai_cp, b.loai_pb, sum(a.tien_cp_nt), sum(a.tien_cp) from ' + @c + ' a left join dmcp b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_loai where ' + @k + ' group by b.loai_cp, b.loai_pb')
	EXEC('insert into #d select a.stt_rec0, a.so_luong*a.he_so, b.volume, b.weight, ' + @f + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from ' + @d + ' a left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where ' + @k)

	UPDATE #d SET tt = ROUND(sl*tt, 12), kl = ROUND(sl*kl, 12)

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT RTRIM(loai_cp), RTRIM(loai_pb), tien_cp_nt, tien_cp FROM #c FOR READ ONLY
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @loai_cp, @loai_pb, @tien_cp_nt, @tien_cp
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @h = CASE WHEN @loai_pb = '1' THEN 'sl' WHEN @loai_pb = '2' THEN 'tt' WHEN @loai_pb = '3' THEN 'kl' ELSE 'gt' END
		UPDATE #d SET cp = 0, cp_nt = 0

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Number '#d', @tien_cp_nt, 'cp_nt', @r, @h, '1=1', 'stt_rec0'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Number '#d', @tien_cp, 'cp', 'm_round_tien', @h, '1=1', 'stt_rec0'

		SELECT @strSQL = REPLACE('update #d set %s_nt = %s_nt + cp_nt, %s = %s + cp', '%s', CASE WHEN @loai_cp = '1' THEN 'cp_vc' WHEN @loai_cp = '2' THEN 'cp_bh' ELSE 'cp_khac' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @loai_cp, @loai_pb, @tien_cp_nt, @tien_cp
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c
	
	UPDATE #d SET cp_nt = cp_vc_nt + cp_bh_nt + cp_khac_nt, cp = cp_vc + cp_bh + cp_khac

	SELECT @strSQL = 'update ' + @d + ' set cp_nt = b.cp_nt, cp_vc_nt = b.cp_vc_nt, cp_bh_nt = b.cp_bh_nt, cp_khac_nt = b.cp_khac_nt, cp = b.cp, cp_vc = b.cp_vc, cp_bh = b.cp_bh, cp_khac = b.cp_khac'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @d + ' a join #d b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 where ' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO


CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_UpdateFLManualData3](
		@dPFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
		@dPTo SMALLDATETIME, 
		@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
		@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
		@cUnit VARCHAR(128), 
		@RPCode CHAR(2), 
		@cForm VARCHAR(16), 
		@cReportTable VARCHAR(32), 
		@cColumnName VARCHAR(32),
		@cColumnOrder CHAR(2),
		@cColumnType CHAR(1)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQLRet NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strSQLRet = 'UPDATE %Table SET %ColumnName = b.%Field'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' FROM %Table a JOIN ('
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' SELECT * FROM gltctm98 WHERE ngay_ct01 = %dPFrom AND ngay_ct02 = %dPTo AND ngay_ct11 = %dFrom '
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' AND ngay_ct12 = %dTo AND form = %cForm AND ma_dvcs = %cUnit AND ma_bc = %RPCode AND cot = %cColumnOrder'
	SET @strSQLRet = CHAR(13) + @strSQLRet + ' ) b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND a.stt = b.stt'

	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Table', @cReportTable)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%ColumnName', @cColumnName)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%Field', CASE WHEN @cColumnType = 'D' THEN 'ngay' WHEN @cColumnType = 'N' THEN 'so' ELSE 'chu' END)
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%dPFrom', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dPFrom, 112) + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%dPTo', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dPTo, 112) + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%dFrom', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%dTo', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cUnit', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cUnit, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%RPCode', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@RPCode, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cColumnOrder', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cColumnOrder, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	SET @strSQLRet = REPLACE(@strSQLRet, '%cForm', CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cForm, '''', '''''') + CHAR(39))
	RETURN @strSQLRet
END






GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UpdateJournalVCTotal]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2 INTO #ctgs FROM ctgs
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	SET @Key = '1=1'
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ctgs >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ctgs <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @q = 'insert into #ctgs select ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2 from ctgs where ' + @Key
	EXEC(@q)
	SET @q = 'update ctgs set tien = 0, tien_nt = 0 where ' + @Key
	EXEC(@q)

	SELECT @DateFrom = MIN(ngay_ct1) FROM #ctgs
	SELECT @DateTo = MAX(ngay_ct2) FROM #ctgs

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, sum(ps_no + ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition where %[(ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0) and convert(char(8), ngay_ctgs, 112) + so_ctgs in (select convert(char(8), ngay_ctgs, 112) + so_ctgs from #ctgs)]%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt INTO #t2 FROM #t GROUP BY ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs

	UPDATE ctgs SET tien = b.ps, tien_nt = b.ps_nt
		FROM ctgs a JOIN #t2 b ON a.ngay_ctgs = b.ngay_ctgs AND a.so_ctgs = b.so_ctgs

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ReplaceInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(4000), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @oldNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @userName NVARCHAR(64)
	SELECT @userName = RTRIM(name) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID

	-- Options
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = 'VND'

	-- Struct
	--++ Master
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.ma_gd, a.datetime2, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh, a.ten_kh
			, a.mst_kh AS ma_so_thue, a.dia_chi_kh AS dia_chi, a.dien_thoai_kh AS dien_thoai, a.email_kh AS e_mail, a.quoc_tich, a.doi_tuong, a.so_giay_to
			, a.ngay_cap_giay_to, a.noi_cap_giay_to, a.t_tnc_thue, a.t_tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_bh_bb, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word
		INTO #master FROM hrm01$000000 a

	--++ Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.line_nbr, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt, a.thang_kt, a.nam_kt, a.tnc_thue, a.tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.thue, a.bh_bb
		INTO #d0 FROM hrd01$000000 a

	-- Declare External Fields
	DECLARE @structFields VARCHAR(4000), @structFrom VARCHAR(4000), @queryFields VARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @resultFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFrom VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @detailResultFields VARCHAR(4000), @script NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @structFields = '', @structFrom = '', @queryFields = '', @queryJoin = '', @resultFields = '', @detailStructFields = '', @detailStructFrom = '', @detailQueryFields = '', @detailQueryJoin = '', @detailResultFields = '', @script = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @structFields = REPLACE(struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @structFrom = REPLACE(struct_from, '''', ''''''), @queryFields = REPLACE(query_fields, '''', ''''''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(query_join, '''', ''''''), @resultFields = REPLACE(result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND detail_struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @detailStructFields = REPLACE(detail_struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailStructFrom = REPLACE(detail_struct_from, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryFields = REPLACE(detail_query_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryJoin = REPLACE(detail_query_join, '''', ''''''), @detailResultFields = REPLACE(detail_result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND script <> '')
		SELECT @script = script FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct External Fields
	IF @structFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @structFields + ' from ' + @structFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#master', @q
	END
	IF @detailStructFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @detailStructFields + ' from ' + @detailstructFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q
	END


	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0
	SELECT @c = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c = REPLACE(',' + @c, ',key,', '[key],')

	-- Process
	-- Master Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_gd, a.datetime2, a.ngay_lct, ''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', 1 as ty_gia'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', rtrim(b.ma_nv), a.ten_kh, a.mst_kh, a.dia_chi_kh, a.dien_thoai_kh, a.email_kh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.quoc_tich, a.doi_tuong, a.so_giay_to, a.ngay_cap_giay_to, a.noi_cap_giay_to'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.t_tnc_thue, a.t_tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, a.t_bh_bb, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_thanh_toan, ''' + @Language + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @queryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + REPLACE(@queryFields, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END) END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrm01$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec' + @queryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail(' + @c + ') select a.stt_rec, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.line_nbr, rtrim(a.line_nbr), a.thang_kt, a.nam_kt, a.tnc_thue, a.tnt_thue, a.thue_suat, a.thue, a.bh_bb'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailQueryFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrd01$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @detailQueryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin



	DECLARE @fkey VARCHAR(32), @p VARCHAR(6),@oldVoucherKeys VARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @q = 'select @fkey = stt_rec_hd_goc from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@fkey varchar(32) output', @fkey OUTPUT

	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @fkey

	SELECT @q = 'select @oldVoucherKeys = keys from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@fkey, '''', '') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@oldVoucherKeys varchar(512) output', @oldVoucherKeys OUTPUT


	-- Result
	SELECT *, @oldVoucherKeys AS original_inv, @Unit AS ma_dvcs, 4 AS loai_hd, 3 AS tinh_chat, '' AS hddt_tt, @userName AS user_name FROM #master
	SELECT *, @fkey AS fkey FROM #detail ORDER BY id

	--
	SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, '' AS ky_hieu, '' AS loai_hd

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
