CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAllAccountsActivity] --fs_AcctsActivity
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@GLAccount TINYINT,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Level INT,
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @AccountKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @AccountKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	SET @Key = 'loai_tk = 1'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @AccountKey

	-- Tinh so du dau ky cho cac tai khoan
	CREATE TABLE #tBg (tk varchar(33), Du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_co NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), Du_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #tBg EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @Key

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk INTO #loai_tk1 FROM dmtk
	SET @q = 'insert into #loai_tk1 select tk from dmtk a where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #temp FROM wrkgl

	-- @Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from #loai_tk1)'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @AccountKey
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #temp SELECT tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tBg

	SELECT tk AS tk, SUM(no_dk) no_dk, SUM(co_dk) co_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk_nt) co_dk_nt, SUM(ps_no) ps_no, SUM(ps_co) ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt) ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) ps_co_nt, SUM(no_ck) no_ck, SUM(co_ck) co_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck_nt) co_ck_nt
		INTO #tAcctsLedger FROM #temp a GROUP BY tk

	-- 3
	DELETE #tAcctsLedger WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	-- 4
	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #tAcctsLedger SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	-- 5
	DECLARE @tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE crAcc CURSOR FOR SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 0 AND tk LIKE (RTRIM(@Account) + '%')
	OPEN crAcc
	FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #tAcctsLedger WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%') BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tAcctsLedger (tk, no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt)
				SELECT @Tk, SUM(no_dk), SUM(co_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(co_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck_nt)
					FROM #tAcctsLedger
					WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #loai_tk1)
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crAcc INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE crAcc
	DEALLOCATE crAcc

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, CASE WHEN b.bac_tk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, a.tk, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag
			, ABS(no_dk - co_dk) AS du_dk, ABS(no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt) AS du_dk_nt
			, ABS(no_ck - co_ck) AS du_ck, ABS(no_ck_nt - co_ck_nt) AS du_ck_nt
			, CASE WHEN no_dk >= co_dk THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_dk, CASE WHEN no_ck >= co_ck THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_ck
			, CASE WHEN no_dk >= co_dk THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_dk2, CASE WHEN no_ck >= co_ck THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS nc_ck2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
		FROM #tAcctsLedger a JOIN Dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		WHERE b.tk_sc >= @GLAccount AND b.bac_tk <= @Level AND b.loai_tk >= @Type
		ORDER BY a.tk

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vdmcltg0 AS 
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT d .*, a.tk, a.Ten_bt, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2, a.status, a.tk_cltg, b.Ma_nt , c.Ten_tk AS Ten_tk_cltg, c.Ten_tk2 AS Ten_tk_cltg2
		FROM dbo.dmcltg0 d JOIN dmcltg a ON d .stt = a.stt INNER JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN (SELECT * FROM dmtk) c ON a.tk_cltg = c.tk
		WHERE b.Ma_nt <> '' AND b.Ma_nt NOT IN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_ma_nt0')
		ORDER BY d .stt, a.tk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostAfterAdjustmentInventory]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @year INT, @status CHAR(1), @userID INT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @d2 VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @roundQ TINYINT

	SELECT @roundQ = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id2 INTO #master FROM m37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.stt_rec_pn, a.stt_rec0pn INTO #detail FROM d37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select stt_rec, ngay_ct, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id2 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @year = YEAR(ngay_ct), @status = status, @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), datetime0, 113), @d2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), datetime2, 113), @userID = user_id2 FROM #master

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn from ' + CASE WHEN @status = '2' THEN 'indcsd2' ELSE 'indcsd' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q ='
UPDATE cdvt SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @d2 + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdvt a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '
INSERT INTO cdvt(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt

UPDATE cdvitri SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @d2 + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdvitri a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '
INSERT INTO cdvitri(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt

UPDATE cdlo SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @d2 + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdlo a JOIN (SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
	WHERE a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + '
INSERT INTO cdlo(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT ' + RTRIM(@year) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ''' + @d1 + ''', ''' + @d2 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo b WHERE b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) + ' AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
		GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
'

	IF @status = '1' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		UPDATE d37$000000 SET sl_dc = sl_dc + b.so_luong FROM d37$000000 a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn AND a.stt_rec <> @idNumber
		UPDATE cdntxt SET
			ton_kho01 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho01 + b.so_luong END, so_du01 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du01 + b.tien END, so_du_nt01 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt01 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho02 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho02 + b.so_luong END, so_du02 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du02 + b.tien END, so_du_nt02 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt02 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho03 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho03 + b.so_luong END, so_du03 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du03 + b.tien END, so_du_nt03 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt03 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho04 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho04 + b.so_luong END, so_du04 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du04 + b.tien END, so_du_nt04 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt04 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho05 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho05 + b.so_luong END, so_du05 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du05 + b.tien END, so_du_nt05 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt05 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho06 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho06 + b.so_luong END, so_du06 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du06 + b.tien END, so_du_nt06 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt06 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho07 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho07 + b.so_luong END, so_du07 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du07 + b.tien END, so_du_nt07 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt07 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho08 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho08 + b.so_luong END, so_du08 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du08 + b.tien END, so_du_nt08 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt08 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho09 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho09 + b.so_luong END, so_du09 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du09 + b.tien END, so_du_nt09 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt09 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho10 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho10 + b.so_luong END, so_du10 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du10 + b.tien END, so_du_nt10 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt10 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho11 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho11 + b.so_luong END, so_du11 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du11 + b.tien END, so_du_nt11 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt11 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho12 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho12 + b.so_luong END, so_du12 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du12 + b.tien END, so_du_nt12 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt12 + b.tien_nt END,
			ton_kho13 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE ton_kho13 + b.so_luong END, so_du13 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE so_du13 + b.tien END, so_du_nt13 = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE so_du_nt13 + b.tien_nt END,
			so_luong = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.so_luong ELSE a.so_luong + b.so_luong END,
			tien = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien ELSE a.tien + b.tien END,
			tien_nt = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master c WHERE a.stt_rec_nt = c.stt_rec) THEN b.tien_nt ELSE a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt END,
			datetime2 = @d2, user_id2 = @userID
			FROM cdntxt a WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) JOIN (
				SELECT x.ma_kho, x.ma_vi_tri, x.ma_vt, x.ma_lo, CASE WHEN x.stt_rec_pn = '' THEN @idNumber ELSE x.stt_rec_pn END AS stt_rec_pn, x.stt_rec0pn, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
					FROM #detail x JOIN dmvt y ON x.ma_vt = y.ma_vt
						WHERE y.gia_ton = 3
						GROUP BY x.ma_kho, x.ma_vi_tri, x.ma_vt, x.ma_lo, x.stt_rec_pn, x.stt_rec0pn
				) b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.stt_rec_nt = b.stt_rec_pn AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0pn
			WHERE a.nam = @year

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @status = '2' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'cdvt', 'cdvt2'), 'cdvitri', 'cdvitri2'), 'cdlo', 'cdlo2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	EXEC fs_Adjustment$UpdateCurrentStock 'insert', @status

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculateTimesheet]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@Type INT = 0, -- 0: Default - Calculate, 1: Adjustment
	@withoutTimekeeping BIT = 0, -- 0: Default - Ignore, 1: Include
	@accountReadonly BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	-- Declare
	DECLARE @RangeFrom SMALLDATETIME, @RangeTo SMALLDATETIME, @d SMALLDATETIME, @Shift VARCHAR(32), @WorkingDay VARCHAR(32), @Hours NUMERIC(28, 6), @Weekday INT, @Ref VARCHAR(512), @c VARCHAR(512), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @Delta INT, @t REAL, @m REAL, @i INT, @j INT
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d0 VARCHAR(32), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @d2 VARCHAR(32), @k NVARCHAR(4000), @w NVARCHAR(4000), @g1 SMALLDATETIME, @g2 SMALLDATETIME, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @DeptRightKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Set
	SELECT @RangeFrom = ngay_gh1, @RangeTo = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	IF @DateFrom < @RangeFrom SELECT @DateFrom = @RangeFrom
	IF @DateTo > @RangeTo SELECT @DateTo = @RangeTo
	IF @RangeFrom < @DateFrom SELECT @RangeFrom = @DateFrom - 1
	IF @RangeTo > @DateTo SELECT @RangeTo = @DateTo + 1

	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + '''', @d2 = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + '''', @Key = '', @DeptRightKey = '', @Join = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0

	SELECT @Delta = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_kc_min'
	SELECT @Delta = ISNULL(@Delta, 0)
	SELECT @Hours = 60 * CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_gio'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #t0(stt_rec CHAR(13), tg DATETIME, vao_ra INT)
	CREATE TABLE #tg(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), tg DATETIME, vao_ra INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #vr(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), tg_tu INT, tg_den INT, tg_vao DATETIME, tg_ra DATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	CREATE TABLE #order(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), tg DATETIME, vao_ra INT, loai INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE INDEX i ON #order (ngay, stt_rec, tg)

	CREATE TABLE #c0(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_ca VARCHAR(48), i INT)
	CREATE TABLE #ca(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_tang_ca VARCHAR(32), ma_ca VARCHAR(32), nguon INT NULL, tang_ca INT NULL, ma_ly_do VARCHAR(32) NULL, ma_ca_ct VARCHAR(32) NULL, so_phut_tt NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, so_gio_td NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, tt INT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #bp(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME, ngay_hh SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #gio(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME, ngay_hh SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #delta(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), tg_lech1 INT, tg_lech2 INT, tg_tu DATETIME, tg_den DATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #d(ngay SMALLDATETIME, thu INT)
	CREATE INDEX ngay ON #d (ngay)

	SELECT * INTO #dk FROM #ca





	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Key <> '' AND CHARINDEX('stt_rec', @Key) = 0 SET @DeptRightKey = @Key
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.%field = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv e on a.%field = e.stt_rec'





	-- Time
	SELECT @d = @RangeFrom
	WHILE @d <= @RangeTo BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #d (ngay, thu) SELECT @d, DATEPART(weekday, @d)
		SELECT @d = @d + 1
	END
	SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay, 112) AS ky INTO #p0 FROM #d ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay, 112)
	SELECT @c = MIN(ky) FROM #p0
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #t0 (stt_rec, tg, vao_ra) select a.stt_rec, a.thoi_gian, a.vao_ra from hrvaora$' + @c + ' a' + REPLACE(@Join, '%field', 'stt_rec')
		SELECT @s = @s + ' where (a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom - 1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo + 1, 112) + ''')'
		SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + REPLACE(@Key, '%field', 'stt_rec') + ')' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		--
		SELECT @c = MIN(ky) FROM #p0 WHERE ky > @c
	END
	UPDATE #t0 SET tg = CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), tg, 100) -- Remove second time
	INSERT INTO #tg(stt_rec, tg, vao_ra) SELECT stt_rec, tg, vao_ra FROM #t0 ORDER BY stt_rec, tg

	IF @Delta > 0 DELETE #tg FROM #tg a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, tg, stt + 1 AS stt FROM #tg) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt WHERE ABS(DATEDIFF(second, a.tg, b.tg)) < @Delta - 1





	-- Shift
	-- + Regular
	SELECT @d = @RangeFrom
	WHILE @d <= @RangeTo BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #c0
		SELECT @c = 'isnull(a.n' + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@d), 2), ' ', '0') + ', '''')'
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #c0 (stt_rec, ma_ca, i) select a.stt_rec_nv, ' + @c + ', charindex('','', ' + @c + ') from hrca$' + STR(YEAR(@d), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@d), 2), ' ', '0') + ' a' + REPLACE(@Join, '%field', 'stt_rec_nv')
		SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where (' + REPLACE(@Key, '%field', 'stt_rec_nv') + ')' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		INSERT INTO #ca (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, nguon, ma_ly_do, ma_ca_ct, so_phut_tt, so_gio_td, tt) SELECT @d, stt_rec, '', ma_ca, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0 FROM #c0 WHERE i = 0
		DELETE #c0 WHERE i = 0
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #c0) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #ca (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, nguon, ma_ly_do, ma_ca_ct, so_phut_tt, so_gio_td, tt) SELECT @d, stt_rec, '', LEFT(ma_ca, i - 1), 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0 FROM #c0
			UPDATE #c0 SET ma_ca = LTRIM(RIGHT(ma_ca, LEN(ma_ca) - i))
			UPDATE #c0 SET i = CHARINDEX(',', ma_ca)
			--
			INSERT INTO #ca (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, nguon, ma_ly_do, ma_ca_ct, so_phut_tt, so_gio_td, tt) SELECT @d, stt_rec, '', ma_ca, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0 FROM #c0 WHERE i = 0
			DELETE #c0 WHERE i = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @d = @d + 1
	END

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, '%field', 'stt_rec'), @Join = REPLACE(@Join, '%field', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @k = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END

	-- + Overtime
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #dk (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, nguon, ma_ly_do, ma_ca_ct, so_phut_tt, so_gio_td, tt) select b.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_tang_ca, a.ma_ca, 1, a.ma_ly_do, a.ma_ca_ct, a.so_phut_tt, a.so_gio_td, 0 from hrdktangca a cross join #d b' + @Join
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where (a.ngay_tu <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo + 1, 112) + ''' and a.ngay_den >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom - 1, 112) + ''') and (b.ngay between a.ngay_tu and a.ngay_den)' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s


	-- + Index
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ca (stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct)
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dk (stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct)

	-- + Combine
	UPDATE #dk SET tt = 1 FROM #dk a JOIN #ca b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca
	UPDATE #dk SET tang_ca = CASE WHEN b.tinh_chat = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM #dk a JOIN hrdmca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca
	UPDATE #ca SET tang_ca = CASE WHEN b.tinh_chat = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM #ca a JOIN hrdmca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca

	INSERT INTO #ca SELECT * FROM #dk WHERE tt = 0
	DELETE #ca WHERE ma_ca = ''

	DELETE #d WHERE (ngay = @DateFrom - 1) OR (ngay = @DateTo + 1)






	-- Date
	-- + Delta
	INSERT INTO #delta (ngay, stt_rec, tg_lech2) SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, MAX(b.tg_lech) FROM #ca a LEFT JOIN hrdmca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay ORDER BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay
	UPDATE #delta SET tg_lech2 = 0 WHERE tg_lech2 IS NULL

	UPDATE #delta SET tg_lech1 = b.tg_lech2 FROM #delta a JOIN (SELECT ngay + 1 AS ngay, stt_rec, tg_lech2, stt + 1 AS stt FROM #delta) b ON a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	DELETE #delta WHERE ngay = @DateFrom - 1

	UPDATE #delta SET tg_lech1 = 0 WHERE tg_lech1 IS NULL
	UPDATE #delta SET tg_tu = DATEADD(minute, tg_lech1, ngay), tg_den = DATEADD(minute, tg_lech2, ngay + 1)

	-- + Update
	UPDATE #tg SET ngay = b.ngay FROM #tg a JOIN #delta b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND (a.tg >= b.tg_tu AND a.tg < b.tg_den)
	DELETE #tg WHERE ngay IS NULL OR (ngay = @DateFrom - 1) OR (ngay = @DateTo + 1)

	-- + Remove
	SELECT @r = 'insert into #tg (ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra) select a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.thoi_gian, a.vao_ra from %table a' + @Join
	SELECT @r = @r + ' where (a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Key <> '' SELECT @r = @r + ' and (' + @Key + ')'

	SELECT @s = REPLACE(@r, '%table', 'hrvaora')
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DELETE #tg FROM #tg a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrdcvaora b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay)
	SELECT @s = REPLACE(@r, '%table', 'hrdcvaora')
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	DELETE #tg FROM #tg a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrdccong b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay)

	-- + In/Out Adjustment Data...
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay, thoi_gian_vao, gio_vao, hs_vao, thoi_gian_vao0, gio_vao0, hs_vao0, thoi_gian_ra, gio_ra, hs_ra, thoi_gian_ra0, gio_ra0, hs_ra0, xoa_yn, loai_dl, gio0_vao, gio0_ra, ghi_chu, 1 AS goc_yn INTO #dc FROM hrdcdulieu$000000
	SELECT @c = MIN(ky) FROM #p0
	WHILE @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @r = ' from hrdcdulieu$' + @c + ' a' + @Join
		SELECT @r = @r + ' where (a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
		IF @Key <> '' SELECT @r = @r + ' and (' + @Key + ')'

		IF @accountReadonly = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @s = 'delete hrdcdulieu$' + @c + @r
			SELECT @s = @s + ' and loai_dl = 2 and xoa_yn = 1'
			SELECT @s = @s + ' and not exists(select 1 from #tg b where b.stt_rec = stt_rec and b.ngay = ngay and (b.tg = thoi_gian_vao0 or b.tg = thoi_gian_ra0))'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END

		SELECT @s = 'insert into #dc select a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.thoi_gian_vao, a.gio_vao, a.hs_vao, a.thoi_gian_vao0, a.gio_vao0, a.hs_vao0, a.thoi_gian_ra, a.gio_ra, a.hs_ra, a.thoi_gian_ra0, a.gio_ra0, a.hs_ra0, a.xoa_yn, a.loai_dl, a.gio0_vao, a.gio0_ra, a.ghi_chu, 1'
		SELECT @s = @s + @r
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		--
		SELECT @c = MIN(ky) FROM #p0 WHERE ky > @c
	END
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dc (stt_rec, ngay, thoi_gian_vao0, thoi_gian_ra0)

	-- Remove time which adjusted
	DELETE #tg FROM #tg a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dc b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay AND (a.tg = b.thoi_gian_vao0 OR a.tg = b.thoi_gian_ra0))





	-- In/Out
	INSERT INTO #order (ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra, loai) SELECT ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra, 0 FROM #tg ORDER BY ngay, stt_rec, tg
	SELECT ngay, stt_rec, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #o1 FROM #order GROUP BY ngay, stt_rec ORDER BY ngay, stt_rec
	CREATE INDEX i ON #o1 (ngay, stt_rec)

	UPDATE #order SET @i = a.stt - b.stt, loai = @i - 2 * CAST(@i / 2 AS INT) + 1 FROM #order a JOIN #o1 b ON a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec,
			CAST(NULL AS INT) AS tg_tu, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS tg_den,
			CASE WHEN a.vao_ra = 1 OR (a.vao_ra = 0 AND a.loai = 1) THEN a.tg ELSE NULL END AS tg_vao,
			CASE
				WHEN (a.vao_ra = 1 OR (a.vao_ra = 0 AND a.loai = 1)) AND b.tg IS NOT NULL THEN b.tg
				ELSE CASE
					WHEN (a.vao_ra = 2 OR (a.vao_ra = 0 AND a.loai = 2)) AND c.tg IS NULL THEN a.tg
					ELSE NULL
				END
			END AS tg_ra
		INTO #vrdc FROM #order a
			LEFT JOIN #order b ON (a.vao_ra = 1 OR (a.vao_ra = 0 AND a.loai = 1)) AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt - 1 AND (b.vao_ra = 2 OR (b.vao_ra = 0 AND b.loai = 2))
			LEFT JOIN #order c ON (a.vao_ra = 2 OR (a.vao_ra = 0 AND a.loai = 2)) AND a.ngay = c.ngay AND a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.stt = c.stt + 1 AND (c.vao_ra = 1 OR (c.vao_ra = 0 AND c.loai = 1))


	DELETE #vrdc WHERE tg_vao IS NULL AND tg_ra IS NULL
	UPDATE #vrdc SET tg_tu = ISNULL(DATEDIFF(minute, ngay, tg_vao), ''), tg_den = ISNULL(DATEDIFF(minute, ngay, tg_ra), '')
	UPDATE #dc SET goc_yn = 0 FROM #dc a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #vrdc b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay AND (b.tg_vao = a.thoi_gian_vao0 OR b.tg_vao = a.thoi_gian_ra0 OR b.tg_ra = a.thoi_gian_vao0 OR b.tg_ra = a.thoi_gian_ra0))

	SELECT stt_rec, ngay, thoi_gian_vao AS tg_vao, thoi_gian_ra AS tg_ra, CAST(gio_vao AS CHAR(5)) AS gio_vao, ISNULL(hs_vao, 0) AS hs_vao,
			CAST(gio_ra AS CHAR(5)) AS gio_ra, ISNULL(hs_ra, 0) AS hs_ra, xoa_yn,
			CAST(gio_vao0 AS CHAR(5)) AS gio_vao0, hs_vao0, CAST(gio_ra0 AS CHAR(5)) AS gio_ra0, hs_ra0, loai_dl, ghi_chu
		INTO #result FROM #dc

	INSERT INTO #result SELECT stt_rec, ngay, tg_vao, tg_ra,
			ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(5), a.tg_vao, 108), ''), CASE WHEN ISNULL(tg_tu, 0) < 1440 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
			ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(5), a.tg_ra, 108), ''), CASE WHEN ISNULL(tg_den, 0) < 1440 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 0,
			ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(5), a.tg_vao, 108), ''), CASE WHEN ISNULL(tg_tu, 0) < 1440 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
			ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(5), a.tg_ra, 108), ''), CASE WHEN ISNULL(tg_den, 0) < 1440 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, 2, ''
		FROM #vrdc a

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		IF @withoutTimekeeping = 1 BEGIN
			-- Include employees without timekeeping by day
			SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_nghi INTO #nv FROM hrnv
			SELECT @s = 'insert into #nv select stt_rec, ngay_nghi from hrnv a with(nolock) where ngay_vao <= @dTo and (ngay_nghi is null or ngay_nghi >= @dFrom)' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'e.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs'), 'e.bp_ref', 'a.bp_ref') ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@dTo smalldatetime, @dFrom smalldatetime', @dTo = @DateTo, @dFrom = @DateFrom

			INSERT INTO #result SELECT a.stt_rec, d.ngay, null, null, '', 0, '', 0, 0, '', 0, '', 0, 1, ''
				FROM #nv a CROSS JOIN #d d LEFT JOIN #result r ON r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND r.ngay = d.ngay
					LEFT JOIN hrnghi n WITH(NOLOCK) ON n.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND d.ngay BETWEEN n.ngay_tu AND n.ngay_den
					LEFT JOIN hrkcccong p WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND d.ngay BETWEEN p.ngay_tu AND p.ngay_den
				WHERE (a.ngay_nghi is null or d.ngay < ngay_nghi) and r.stt_rec IS NULL AND n.stt_rec IS NULL AND p.stt_rec IS NULL
		END

		SELECT r.ma_nv, RTRIM(r.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + r.ten_nv AS ten_nv, a.stt_rec, a.ngay,
				a.gio_vao, a.hs_vao, a.gio_ra, a.hs_ra, a.xoa_yn, a.ghi_chu, a.gio_vao0, a.hs_vao0, a.gio_ra0, a.hs_ra0, a.loai_dl,
				a.gio_vao AS gio_vao_old, a.hs_vao AS hs_vao_old, a.gio_ra AS gio_ra_old, a.hs_ra AS hs_ra_old
			FROM #result a LEFT JOIN hrnv r WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec ORDER BY r.ma_nv, a.ngay, a.tg_vao
		RETURN
	END





	-- Error after adjustment data
	SELECT ngay, stt_rec, tg_vao AS tg, CASE WHEN gio_vao0 <> '''' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS vao_ra, 1 AS loai
		INTO #err1 FROM #result WHERE tg_vao IS NOT NULL AND (tg_ra IS NULL OR tg_vao >= tg_ra) AND xoa_yn = 0
	INSERT INTO #err1 SELECT ngay, stt_rec, tg_ra AS tg, CASE WHEN gio_ra0 <> '''' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS vao_ra, 2 AS loai
		FROM #result WHERE tg_ra IS NOT NULL AND (tg_vao IS NULL OR tg_vao >= tg_ra) AND xoa_yn = 0

	-- Correct #vr after adjustment data, use for calculate timesheet
	INSERT INTO #vr (ngay, stt_rec, tg_tu, tg_den, tg_vao, tg_ra)
		SELECT ngay, stt_rec, DATEDIFF(minute, ngay, tg_vao), DATEDIFF(minute, ngay, tg_ra), tg_vao, tg_ra
		FROM #result WHERE tg_vao IS NOT NULL AND tg_ra IS NOT NULL AND tg_vao < tg_ra AND xoa_yn = 0
		ORDER BY tg_vao

	-- Detail
	SELECT DISTINCT a.ngay, a.stt_rec INTO #err2 FROM #vr a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ca b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay)
	DELETE #vr FROM #vr a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ca b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ngay = a.ngay)





	-- + Init
	CREATE TABLE #ct(ngay SMALLDATETIME, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_tang_ca VARCHAR(32), ma_ca VARCHAR(32), ma_ca_ct VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32),
		tg_tu0 INT, tg_den0 INT, tg_tu INT, tg_den INT,
		so_phut0 FLOAT, so_phut FLOAT, tg_di_muon INT, tg_ve_som INT, ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_bp0 VARCHAR(32), loai INT, so_ngay FLOAT,
		so_phut_tt NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, so_gio_td NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, tang_ca INT NULL, ma_ly_do VARCHAR(32) NULL, nguon INT NULL, tt INT NULL, tang_ca0 INT NULL, gh INT NULL, cl REAL, stt0 INT, stt2 INT, ct INT,
		so_phut_bu_muon NUMERIC(28, 6), so_phut_bu_som NUMERIC(28, 6), duoc_bu_muon NUMERIC(28, 6), duoc_bu_som NUMERIC(28, 6), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1)
	)
	INSERT INTO #ct (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, loai, so_phut_tt, so_gio_td, tang_ca, ma_ly_do, nguon, tt, tang_ca0, ct, so_phut_bu_muon, so_phut_bu_som)
		SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_tang_ca, a.ma_ca, b.ma_ca_ct, b.ma_cong,
				c.tg_tu, c.tg_den,
				CASE WHEN b.tg_tu > c.tg_tu THEN b.tg_tu ELSE c.tg_tu END,
				CASE WHEN b.tg_den > c.tg_den THEN c.tg_den ELSE b.tg_den END,
				0, 0, 0, 0, '', 0,
				CASE WHEN a.so_phut_tt = 0 THEN b.so_phut_tt ELSE a.so_phut_tt END, CASE WHEN a.so_gio_td = 0 THEN b.so_gio_td ELSE a.so_gio_td END, 0, a.ma_ly_do, a.nguon, a.tt, a.tang_ca,
				CASE WHEN a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct OR a.ma_ca_ct = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, b.so_phut_bu_muon, b.so_phut_bu_som
			FROM #ca a JOIN hrdmctca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca CROSS JOIN #vr c
			WHERE a.ngay = c.ngay AND a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.tg_den > c.tg_tu AND b.tg_tu < c.tg_den
			ORDER BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.ma_ca, b.ma_ca_ct, c.tg_tu

	UPDATE #ct SET tang_ca = CASE WHEN c.tinh_chat = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM #ct a JOIN hrdmcong b ON a.ma_cong = b.ma_cong JOIN hrdmloaicong c ON b.ma_loai = c.ma_loai

	-- + Process
	UPDATE #ct SET tt = 1, so_phut_tt = CASE WHEN b.so_phut_tt = 0 OR (a.tang_ca = 0 AND b.ma_ca_ct = '') THEN a.so_phut_tt ELSE b.so_phut_tt END, so_gio_td = CASE WHEN b.so_gio_td = 0 OR (a.tang_ca = 0 AND b.ma_ca_ct = '') THEN a.so_gio_td ELSE b.so_gio_td END, ma_ly_do = CASE WHEN a.tang_ca = 0 AND b.ma_ca_ct = '' THEN a.ma_ly_do ELSE b.ma_ly_do END
		FROM #ct a JOIN #dk b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca
		WHERE a.nguon = 0 AND (a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct OR b.ma_ca_ct = '')

	DELETE #ct WHERE nguon = 0 AND tang_ca0 = 0 AND tang_ca = 1 AND tt = 0
	DELETE #ct WHERE nguon = 1 AND ct = 0





	-- Calculation
	UPDATE #ct SET so_phut0 = tg_den - tg_tu
	UPDATE #ct SET so_phut = CASE WHEN b.khoang_cach > 0 THEN
				b.khoang_cach * CASE
					WHEN b.lam_tron = '1' THEN CEILING(a.so_phut0 / b.khoang_cach)
					WHEN b.lam_tron = '2' THEN FLOOR(a.so_phut0 / b.khoang_cach)
					ELSE ROUND(a.so_phut0  / b.khoang_cach, 0)
				END
			ELSE so_phut0
			END
		FROM #ct a JOIN hrdmca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca

	SELECT stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, MIN(stt) AS stt1, MAX(stt) AS stt2, SUM(so_phut) AS so_phut, COUNT(*) AS so_lan INTO #o2 FROM #ct GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct
	CREATE INDEX i ON #o2 (stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct)

	UPDATE #ct SET tg_di_muon = CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt1 THEN CASE WHEN a.so_phut_tt <> 0 AND b.so_phut < a.so_phut_tt THEN 0 WHEN a.tg_tu > c.tg_tu + c.tg_di_muon THEN a.tg_tu - c.tg_tu - c.tg_di_muon ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END,
			tg_ve_som = CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt2 THEN CASE WHEN a.so_phut_tt <> 0 AND b.so_phut < a.so_phut_tt THEN 0 WHEN c.tg_den > a.tg_den + c.tg_ve_som THEN c.tg_den - a.tg_den - c.tg_ve_som ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END,
			so_phut =
				CASE
					WHEN a.so_phut_tt <> 0 AND b.so_phut < a.so_phut_tt THEN 0
					ELSE CASE WHEN a.so_gio_td <> 0 AND b.so_phut + (CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt2 THEN c.so_phut_them ELSE 0 END) > a.so_gio_td * 60 AND b.so_lan = 1 THEN a.so_gio_td * 60 ELSE a.so_phut + (CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt2 THEN c.so_phut_them ELSE 0 END) END
				END,
			gh = CASE WHEN a.so_gio_td <> 0 AND b.so_phut + c.so_phut_them > a.so_gio_td * 60 AND b.so_lan > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			cl = b.so_phut + c.so_phut_them - a.so_gio_td * 60,
			stt0 = b.stt1, stt2 = b.stt2
		FROM #ct a JOIN #o2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca AND a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct
		JOIN hrdmctca c ON a.ma_ca = c.ma_ca AND a.ma_ca_ct = c.ma_ca_ct

	SELECT @i = MAX(stt) FROM #ct WHERE gh = 1
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @m = so_phut, @t = cl, @j = stt0 FROM #ct WHERE stt = @i
		WHILE @t > 0 AND @m IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			UPDATE #ct SET so_phut = CASE WHEN @t > @m THEN 0 ELSE @m - @t END WHERE stt = @i
			SELECT @t = @t - @m, @m = NULL, @i = CASE WHEN @t > 0 THEN @i - 1 ELSE @j END
			IF @t > 0 SELECT @m = so_phut FROM #ct WHERE stt = @i
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = MAX(stt) FROM #ct WHERE gh = 1 AND stt < @i
	END





	-- Late Arrival and Early Out
	DECLARE @allowLateArrival NUMERIC(28, 6), @allowEarlyOut NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, SUM(so_phut) AS t_so_phut, MAX(so_gio_td) * 60 AS so_phut_td
		INTO #buctca FROM #ct GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct HAVING MAX(so_gio_td) = 0 OR SUM(so_phut) < MAX(so_gio_td) * 60

	UPDATE #ct SET @allowLateArrival = CASE WHEN a.stt = a.stt0 AND a.so_phut_bu_muon <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN a.tg_di_muon < a.so_phut_bu_muon THEN a.tg_di_muon ELSE a.so_phut_bu_muon END ELSE 0 END,
			@allowLateArrival = CASE WHEN @allowLateArrival <> 0 AND b.so_phut_td <> 0 AND b.t_so_phut + @allowLateArrival > b.so_phut_td THEN b.so_phut_td - t_so_phut ELSE @allowLateArrival END,
			so_phut = so_phut + @allowLateArrival, duoc_bu_muon = @allowLateArrival
		FROM #ct a JOIN #buctca b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca AND a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct WHERE a.stt = a.stt0 OR a.stt = a.stt2

	UPDATE #buctca SET t_so_phut = t_so_phut + b.duoc_bu_muon FROM #buctca a JOIN #ct b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca AND a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct WHERE ISNULL(b.duoc_bu_muon, 0) > 0
	UPDATE #ct SET @allowEarlyOut = CASE WHEN a.stt = a.stt2 AND a.so_phut_bu_som <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN a.tg_ve_som < a.so_phut_bu_som THEN a.tg_ve_som ELSE a.so_phut_bu_som END ELSE 0 END,
			@allowEarlyOut = CASE WHEN @allowEarlyOut <> 0 AND b.so_phut_td <> 0 AND b.t_so_phut + @allowLateArrival + @allowEarlyOut > b.so_phut_td THEN b.so_phut_td - t_so_phut - @allowLateArrival ELSE @allowEarlyOut END,
			so_phut = so_phut + @allowEarlyOut, duoc_bu_som = @allowEarlyOut
		FROM #ct a JOIN #buctca b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca AND a.ma_ca_ct = b.ma_ca_ct WHERE a.stt = a.stt0 OR a.stt = a.stt2





	-- Employee History Records
	-- + History Data
	DECLARE @keyHistory NVARCHAR(4000), @keyEmpInfo NVARCHAR(4000), @keyGetData NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @keyEmpInfo = CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN '(' + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.stt_rec', 'e.stt_rec') + ')' ELSE '' END,
		@keyHistory = 'a.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @keyEmpInfo <> '' THEN ' and ' + @keyEmpInfo ELSE '' END

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan AS ma_bp, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #qtlamviec FROM hreqtlvht
	INSERT INTO #qtlamviec EXEC hs_GetEmployeeWorkingHistory @DateFrom, @DateTo, @keyHistory, '', 1, '', @keyEmpInfo, 1

	-- + None Working Data
	SELECT @s = REPLACE(@DeptRightKey, 'e.', 'a.'), @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp in (select distinct ma_bp from #qtlamviec)',
		@keyGetData = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, ngay, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio INTO #ngaynghi FROM hrdmngaynghi
	INSERT INTO #ngaynghi EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentGetData @s, 'hrdmngaynghi', 'ngay, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio', @keyGetData, '', 0






	-- None Working
	-- + 1. Regular
	CREATE TABLE #cd(stt_rec CHAR(13))
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #cd select distinct a.stt_rec from hrnghicd a ' + @Join
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where (a.ngay_tu <= ' + @d2 + ' and a.ngay_den >= ' + @d1 + ')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #cd (stt_rec)

	SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ngay INTO #dl FROM #o2 a JOIN #cd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	SELECT @r = 'insert into #ct (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, ma_ly_do, loai) select '
	SELECT @s = @r + 'a.ngay, a.stt_rec, '''', b.ma_ca, '''', b.ma_cong, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, b.so_gio * 60, 0, 0, '''', '''', 10'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from #dl a join hrnghicd b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and (a.ngay between b.ngay_tu and b.ngay_den)' + @Join
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where (' + @Key + ')' END
	SELECT @s = @s + ' order by a.stt_rec, a.ngay, b.ma_ca'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s



	-- + 2. Absence
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay, b.thu, a.ma_ca, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.muc_do, c.ma_bp
		INTO #nvnghi FROM hrnghi a
			JOIN #d b ON b.ngay BETWEEN a.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den
			JOIN #qtlamviec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.ngay >= c.ngay_tu AND (c.ngay_den IS NULL OR b.ngay <= c.ngay_den)
		WHERE a.ngay_tu <= @DateTo AND a.ngay_den >= @DateFrom

	/*
		Priority: 1 - By Defined Workday, 2 - By Public Holiday, * - All
		Field: muc_do
	*/

	-- ++ 2.1 By Defined Workday
	INSERT INTO #ct (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, ma_ly_do, loai)
		SELECT ngay, stt_rec, '', ma_ca, '', ma_cong, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, so_gio * 60, 0, 0, ma_bp, '', CASE WHEN muc_do = '1' THEN 20 ELSE 30 END
			FROM #nvnghi WHERE muc_do <> '2'

	/*
		By Department & Employee
	*/
	-- ++ 2.2 Public Holiday by Department
	SELECT @s = REPLACE(@DeptRightKey, 'e.', 'a.')
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, thu, so_gio INTO #lichnghibp0 FROM hrnghi0
	INSERT INTO #lichnghibp0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentGetData @s, 'hrnghi0', 'thu, so_gio', '', '', 0

	-- ++ 2.3 Public Holiday by Employee
	-- ++ 2.3.1 Define
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, thu, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, so_gio INTO #lichnghinv0 FROM hrnvnghi0
	SET @s = 'insert into #lichnghinv0 select a.stt_rec, a.thu, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.so_gio from hrnvnghi0 a ' + @Join + ' where ngay_hl_tu <= @dTo and (ngay_hl_den is null or ngay_hl_den >= @dFrom)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@dFrom smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo

	DELETE a FROM #lichnghinv0 a JOIN #lichnghinv0 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.thu = b.thu AND b.ngay_hl_tu > a.ngay_hl_tu
		WHERE a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL AND b.ngay_hl_tu <= @DateFrom
	SELECT stt_rec, thu, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt1 INTO #u FROM #lichnghinv0 ORDER BY stt_rec, thu
	SELECT stt_rec, thu, ngay_hl_tu, 0 AS stt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt2 INTO #o FROM #lichnghinv0 ORDER BY stt_rec, thu, ngay_hl_tu

	UPDATE #o SET stt = o.stt2 - u.stt1 + 1 FROM #o o JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, thu, MIN(stt1) AS stt1 FROM #u GROUP BY stt_rec, thu) u ON o.stt_rec = u.stt_rec AND o.thu = u.thu
	UPDATE #lichnghinv0 SET ngay_hl_den = DATEADD(DAY, -1, c.ngay_hl_tu)
		FROM #lichnghinv0 a JOIN #o b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.thu = b.thu AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu JOIN #o c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.thu = c.thu AND b.stt + 1 = c.stt
		WHERE a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL
	UPDATE #lichnghinv0 SET ngay_hl_tu = @DateFrom WHERE ngay_hl_tu < @DateFrom
	UPDATE #lichnghinv0 SET ngay_hl_den = @DateTo WHERE ngay_hl_den IS NULL

	-- ++ 2.3.2 Remain
	SELECT stt_rec, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, NULL AS g
		INTO #lichnghinv1 FROM #lichnghinv0 GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_hl_tu

	UPDATE a SET ngay_hl_tu = CASE WHEN b.ngay_hl_tu < a.ngay_hl_tu THEN b.ngay_hl_tu ELSE a.ngay_hl_tu END,
			ngay_hl_den = CASE WHEN b.ngay_hl_den > a.ngay_hl_den THEN b.ngay_hl_den ELSE a.ngay_hl_den END
		FROM #lichnghinv1 a JOIN #lichnghinv1 b ON b.stt > a.stt AND b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
			AND ((b.ngay_hl_tu < a.ngay_hl_tu AND b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_hl_tu) OR (b.ngay_hl_tu <= a.ngay_hl_den AND b.ngay_hl_den > a.ngay_hl_den))

	DELETE b FROM #lichnghinv1 a JOIN #lichnghinv1 b ON b.stt > a.stt AND b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
		AND ((b.ngay_hl_tu <= a.ngay_hl_tu AND b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_hl_tu) OR (b.ngay_hl_tu <= a.ngay_hl_den AND b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_hl_den))

	/*
		End  Department & Employee
	*/
	SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN c.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN c.so_gio ELSE b.so_gio END AS so_gio
		INTO #nvlichnghi FROM (SELECT stt_rec, ngay, MAX(thu) AS thu, MAX(muc_do) AS muc_do, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp FROM #nvnghi GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay) a
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghibp0 b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.thu = b.thu
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghinv1 k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec AND a.ngay BETWEEN k.ngay_hl_tu AND k.ngay_hl_den
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghinv0 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.thu = c.thu AND a.ngay BETWEEN c.ngay_hl_tu AND c.ngay_hl_den
		WHERE a.muc_do <> '1' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ngaynghi f WHERE f.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND f.ngay = a.ngay)
			AND (b.so_gio IS NOT NULL OR (k.stt_rec IS NOT NULL AND c.so_gio IS NOT NULL))

	CREATE INDEX i ON #nvlichnghi (stt_rec, ngay)

	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay, b.thu, a.so_gio, c.ma_bp, a.ma_ca, a.ma_cong
		INTO #nvkcccong FROM hrkcccong a JOIN #d b ON b.ngay BETWEEN a.ngay_tu AND a.ngay_den JOIN #qtlamviec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND b.ngay >= c.ngay_tu AND (c.ngay_den IS NULL OR b.ngay <= c.ngay_den)
		WHERE a.ngay_tu <= @DateTo AND a.ngay_den >= @DateFrom

	INSERT INTO #nvlichnghi SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN k.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(e.so_gio, a.so_gio) ELSE d.so_gio END AS so_gio
		FROM #nvkcccong a
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghibp0 d ON a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp AND a.thu = d.thu
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghinv1 k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec AND a.ngay BETWEEN k.ngay_hl_tu AND k.ngay_hl_den
			LEFT JOIN #lichnghinv0 e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND a.thu = e.thu AND a.ngay BETWEEN e.ngay_hl_tu AND e.ngay_hl_den
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nvlichnghi f WITH(INDEX(i)) WHERE f.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND f.ngay = a.ngay)
			AND (d.so_gio IS NOT NULL OR (k.stt_rec IS NOT NULL AND e.so_gio IS NOT NULL))

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay, MAX(c.ngay_tu) ngay_tu, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_gio
		INTO #ttccnvnghi FROM #nvnghi a JOIN hrttchamcong c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tu <= a.ngay AND (c.ngay_den IS NULL OR c.ngay_den >= a.ngay)
		WHERE a.muc_do = '2' GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay
	UPDATE #ttccnvnghi SET so_gio = c.so_gio FROM #ttccnvnghi a JOIN hrttchamcong c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tu = a.ngay_tu

	INSERT INTO #ct (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, ma_ly_do, loai)
		SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, '', a.ma_ca, '', a.ma_cong, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
			CASE WHEN b.stt_rec IS NULL THEN a.so_gio ELSE
				CASE WHEN a.so_gio <= (ISNULL(c.so_gio, @Hours / 60) - ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0)) THEN a.so_gio ELSE a.so_gio - (ISNULL(c.so_gio, @Hours / 60) - ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0)) END
			END * 60 AS so_phut,
			0, 0, a.ma_bp, '', CASE WHEN a.muc_do = '2' THEN 40 ELSE 50 END
		FROM #nvnghi a LEFT JOIN #nvlichnghi b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay = b.ngay LEFT JOIN #ttccnvnghi c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ngay = a.ngay
		WHERE a.muc_do = '2'
			AND (b.stt_rec IS NULL OR (b.stt_rec IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(c.so_gio, @Hours/60) > ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0)))
			AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ngaynghi n WHERE n.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND n.ngay = a.ngay)


	-- + 3. Public Holiday: Exclude priority value equals 1 - by defined workday
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay, MAX(c.ngay_tu) ngay_tu
		INTO #ttccnghi FROM #qtlamviec a JOIN #ngaynghi b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay AND (a.ngay_den IS NULL OR b.ngay <= a.ngay_den)
			JOIN hrttchamcong c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tu <= b.ngay AND (c.ngay_den IS NULL OR c.ngay_den >= b.ngay)
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, b.ngay

	INSERT INTO #ct (ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, ma_ly_do, loai)
		SELECT b.ngay, a.stt_rec, '', CASE WHEN ISNULL(g.ca, '') = '' THEN b.ma_ca ELSE g.ca END, '',
				CASE WHEN ISNULL(g.cong, '') = '' THEN b.ma_cong ELSE g.cong END, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
				CASE WHEN ISNULL(g.so_gio, 0) = 0 THEN b.so_gio ELSE g.so_gio END * 60, 0, 0, a.ma_bp, '', 60
			FROM #qtlamviec a JOIN #ngaynghi b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_tu <= b.ngay AND (a.ngay_den IS NULL OR b.ngay <= a.ngay_den)
				LEFT JOIN #ttccnghi h ON a.stt_rec = h.stt_rec AND b.ngay = h.ngay
				LEFT JOIN hrttchamcong g ON a.stt_rec = g.stt_rec AND g.ngay_tu = h.ngay_tu
			WHERE a.stt_rec NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec from #ct WHERE ngay = b.ngay AND loai = 20)

	-- Without Timekeeping
	INSERT INTO #ct(ngay, stt_rec, ma_tang_ca, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, tg_tu0, tg_den0, tg_tu, tg_den, so_phut0, so_phut, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_bp, ma_ly_do, loai)
		SELECT ngay, stt_rec, '', ma_ca, '', ma_cong, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, so_phut, 0, 0, '', '', 70
		FROM
		(SELECT a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ca, a.ma_cong,
				(a.so_gio - ISNULL(d.so_gio, 0)) * 60 - ISNULL(g.so_phut, 0) AS so_phut
			FROM #nvkcccong a
				LEFT JOIN #nvlichnghi d ON d.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND d.ngay = a.ngay
				LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay, SUM(so_phut) AS so_phut FROM #ct GROUP BY stt_rec, ngay) g ON g.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND g.ngay = a.ngay
			WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ct f WHERE f.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND f.ngay = a.ngay AND f.ma_cong = a.ma_cong)
		) t WHERE so_phut > 0



	-- Department
	CREATE TABLE #o5(stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay_hl SMALLDATETIME)
	CREATE TABLE #o6(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ngay_hl SMALLDATETIME, ngay_hh SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #o5 select a.stt_rec, max(a.ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from hrdccongbp a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay_hl <= ' + @d1 + ' and (a.ngay_gh is null or a.ngay_gh >= ' + @d1 + '))' + @k + ' group by a.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' insert into #o6 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_gh from hrdccongbp a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay_hl > ' + @d1 + ' and a.ngay_hl <= ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #o5 (stt_rec, ngay_hl)
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_gh AS ngay_hh INTO #o7 FROM hrdccongbp a JOIN #o5 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl

	INSERT INTO #bp (stt_rec, ma_bp, ngay_tu, ngay_hh)
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM #o7 WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #o6)
			UNION ALL SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM #o6
		) a ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_hl
	UPDATE #bp SET ngay_den = b.ngay_hl FROM #bp a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu AS ngay_hl, stt - 1 AS stt FROM #bp) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	DELETE #o7 WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #o6)

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #o7 (stt_rec)
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #bp (stt_rec)

	UPDATE #ct SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp FROM #ct a JOIN #o7 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE (b.ngay_hh IS NULL OR a.ngay <= b.ngay_hh)
	UPDATE #ct SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp FROM #ct a JOIN #bp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_tu AND (b.ngay_den IS NULL OR a.ngay < b.ngay_den) AND (b.ngay_hh IS NULL OR a.ngay <= b.ngay_hh) WHERE a.ma_bp = ''
	--
	UPDATE #ct SET ma_bp = b.ma_bp FROM #ct a JOIN #qtlamviec b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_tu AND (b.ngay_den IS NULL OR a.ngay <= b.ngay_den) WHERE a.ma_bp = ''

	UPDATE #ct SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ngay < b.ngay_vao THEN ISNULL(c.bo_phan, b.bo_phan) ELSE b.bo_phan END
		FROM #ct a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT d1.stt_rec, d1.bo_phan FROM hreqtlvht d1
						JOIN (SELECT d2.stt_rec, MIN(d3.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec FROM #ct) d2 JOIN hreqtlvht d3 ON d2.stt_rec = d3.stt_rec GROUP BY d2.stt_rec) d4 ON d1.stt_rec = d4.stt_rec
					) c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE a.ma_bp = ''

	-- Adjustment
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ct (ngay, stt_rec)
	DELETE #ct FROM #ct a JOIN hrdccong b ON a.ngay = b.ngay AND a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	SELECT @s = @r + 'a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_tang_ca, a.ma_ca, a.ma_ca_ct, a.ma_cong, datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_tu), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_den), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_tu), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_den), 0, a.so_gio * 60, a.tg_di_muon, a.tg_ve_som, a.ma_bp, a.ma_ly_do, 80'
	SELECT @s = @s + '  from hrdccong a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s


	-- Additional
	SELECT @s = @r + 'a.ngay, a.stt_rec, a.ma_tang_ca, a.ma_ca, a.ma_ca_ct, a.ma_cong, datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_tu), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_den), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_tu), datediff(minute, a.ngay, a.tg_den), 0, a.so_gio * 60, a.tg_di_muon, a.tg_ve_som, a.ma_bp, a.ma_ly_do, 90'
	SELECT @s = @s + '  from hrbscong a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s


	-- Convert
	CREATE TABLE #o8(stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay_hl SMALLDATETIME)
	CREATE TABLE #o9(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_hl SMALLDATETIME, ngay_hh SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #o8 select a.stt_rec, max(a.ngay_tu) from hrttchamcong a' + @Join + ' where (a.so_gio > 0 and a.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ')' + @k + ' group by a.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' insert into #o9 select a.stt_rec, a.so_gio, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den from hrttchamcong a' + @Join + ' where (a.so_gio > 0 and a.ngay_tu > ' + @d1 + ' and a.ngay_tu <= ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_gio, a.ngay_tu AS ngay_hl, a.ngay_den AS ngay_hh INTO #oa FROM hrttchamcong a JOIN #o8 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_hl
	INSERT INTO #gio (stt_rec, so_gio, ngay_tu, ngay_hh) SELECT stt_rec, so_gio, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, so_gio, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM #oa WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #o9)
			UNION ALL SELECT stt_rec, so_gio, ngay_hl, ngay_hh FROM #o9
		) a ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_hl
	UPDATE #gio SET ngay_den = b.ngay_hl FROM #gio a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu AS ngay_hl, stt - 1 AS stt FROM #gio) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt

	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #oa (stt_rec)
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #gio (stt_rec)

	UPDATE #ct SET so_ngay = a.so_phut / (60 * b.so_gio) FROM #ct a JOIN #oa b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE (b.ngay_hh IS NULL OR a.ngay <= b.ngay_hh)
	UPDATE #ct SET so_ngay = a.so_phut / (60 * b.so_gio) FROM #ct a JOIN #gio b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_tu AND (b.ngay_den IS NULL OR a.ngay < b.ngay_den) AND (b.ngay_hh IS NULL OR a.ngay <= b.ngay_hh) WHERE a.so_ngay IS NULL
	IF @Hours > 0 UPDATE #ct SET so_ngay = so_phut / @Hours WHERE so_ngay IS NULL
	UPDATE #ct SET so_ngay = 0 WHERE so_ngay IS NULL

	-- Update working department
	UPDATE #ct SET ma_bp0 = c.ma_bp FROM #ct a
		JOIN ( SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM #qtlamviec GROUP BY stt_rec ) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		JOIN #qtlamviec c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu

	-- Update
	SELECT @s = 'delete hrvrloi from hrvrloi a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
	SELECT @s = @s + ' insert into hrvrloi (ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra, loai) select ngay, stt_rec, tg, vao_ra, loai from #err1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @d = @DateFrom, @Delta = YEAR(@DateTo) * 12 + MONTH(@DateTo)
	WHILE YEAR(@d) *12 + MONTH(@d) <= @Delta BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @d, 112)
		SELECT @s = 'delete hrcongct$' + @c + ' from hrcongct$' + @c + ' a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ' delete hrcongth$' + @c + ' from hrcongth$' + @c + ' a' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @k
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		--
		SELECT @g1 = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, @c + '01', 112), @g2 = DATEADD(month, 1, @g1) - 1
		SELECT @w = ' where (ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @g1, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @g2, 112) + ''')'

		SELECT @s = 'insert into hrcongct$' + @c + ' (ngay, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, so_gio, so_phut0, so_phut, gio_tu0, gio_den0, gio_tu, gio_den, tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_tang_ca, ma_ly_do, loai, line_nbr)'
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ' select ngay, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, ma_cong, round(so_phut / 60, 2), so_phut0, so_phut, dateadd(minute, tg_tu0, ngay), dateadd(minute, tg_den0, ngay), dateadd(minute, tg_tu, ngay), dateadd(minute, tg_den, ngay), tg_di_muon, tg_ve_som, ma_tang_ca, ma_ly_do, loai, stt from #ct' + @w
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		--
		SELECT @s = 'insert into hrcongth$' + @c + ' (ngay, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_ca, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay)'
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ' select ngay, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_ca, ma_cong, sum(round(so_phut / 60, 2)), sum(so_ngay) from #ct' + @w + ' group by ngay, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_ca, ma_cong'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		--
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(month, 1, @d)
	END





	-- Drop
	DROP TABLE #t0
	DROP TABLE #c0
	DROP TABLE #p0

	DROP TABLE #d
	DROP TABLE #ct
	DROP TABLE #vr

	DROP TABLE #err1

	DROP TABLE #order
	DROP TABLE #tg
	DROP TABLE #ca
	DROP TABLE #dk
	DROP TABLE #gio
	DROP TABLE #bp

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$ImportPurchase$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0,
	@OldSite VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Environment BIT = 0,
	@EnvironmentDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
	@EnvironmentType CHAR(1) = '1',
	@Plant VARCHAR(32) = NULL,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(32) = NULL,
	@ExField NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@ExFrom NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@ExWhere NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@Lot TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(19, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32), @LotNumber VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @EnvironmentRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentRate2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentUOM NVARCHAR(33), @EnvironmentAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentPercent NUMERIC(5,2), @EnvironmentAccount VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @Site = @OldSite

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, gia_ton, lo_yn, ma_thue_nk, ma_thue, tao_lo INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
			SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite
		ELSE
			UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
		ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

	DECLARE @PurGr VARCHAR(32), @k1 NVARCHAR(2048), @k2 NVARCHAR(2048), @k3 NVARCHAR(2048), @AssignedVendor VARCHAR(32), @AssignedPlant VARCHAR(32)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF @Plant IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @k1 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + ''' and ma_vung = ''' + REPLACE(@Plant, '''', '''''') + '''', @k2 = 'ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(@Item, '''', '''''') + '''', @k3 = 'controller = ''Item'''
			EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Options$GetValue 'dvt', @UOM OUT, 'bidmvttsvung', @k1, 'bidmvtts', @k2, 'bidmts', @k3
			EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Options$GetValue 'ma_nh0', @PurGr OUT, 'bidmvttsvung', @k1, 'bidmvtts', @k2, 'bidmts', @k3

			IF ISNULL(@UOM, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @Rate = he_so FROM dmqddvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item AND dvt = @UOM
				SELECT @Rate = ISNULL(@Rate, 1)
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1 FROM #Item
			END
		END
		IF @Plant IS NOT NULL AND @PurOrg IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bid01$000000 a LEFT JOIN bim01$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_vt = @Item AND b.ma_vung = @Plant AND b.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.ma_kh <> '' AND a.cd_ncc = 1) = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @AssignedVendor = ma_kh FROM bid01$000000 a LEFT JOIN bim01$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_vt = @Item AND b.ma_vung = @Plant AND b.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.ma_kh <> '' AND a.cd_ncc = 1
			END
			IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bid01$000000 a LEFT JOIN bim01$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_vt = @Item AND b.ma_vung = @Plant AND b.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.vung_cu <> '' AND a.cd_ncc = 1) = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @AssignedPlant = vung_cu FROM bid01$000000 a LEFT JOIN bim01$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_vt = @Item AND b.ma_vung = @Plant AND b.ma_bp0 = @PurOrg AND a.vung_cu <> '' AND a.cd_ncc = 1
			END
		END
	END

	IF @Lot = 1 BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #LotNumber (ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
		INSERT INTO #LotNumber EXEC fs_GetLotNumber @Item
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #LotNumber) SELECT @LotNumber = ma_lo FROM #LotNumber
	END

	IF @Environment = 1 BEGIN
		IF @EnvironmentDate IS NULL SELECT @EnvironmentDate = GETDATE()
		EXEC rs_EnvironmentTax @Item, @UOM, @EnvironmentDate, @EnvironmentType, @EnvironmentRate OUTPUT, @EnvironmentRate2 OUTPUT, @EnvironmentUOM OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAmount OUTPUT, @EnvironmentPercent OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAccount OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select ' + CASE WHEN @ExField <> '' THEN @ExField + ',' ELSE '' END + 'rtrim(a.ma_kho) as ma_kho, rtrim(a.ma_vi_tri) as ma_vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'N''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@UOM, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as dvt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@Rate, 0)) + ' as he_so, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@ItemAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_vt, a.gia_ton, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'cast(case when exists(select top 1 ma_kho from dmvitri where dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(a.ma_thue_nk) as ma_thue_nk, isnull(b.thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat_nk,rtrim( isnull(b.tk_thue, '''')) as tk_thue_nk, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(a.ma_thue) as ma_thue, isnull(c.thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat, rtrim(isnull(c.tk_thue_no3, '''')) as tk_thue, a.tao_lo'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ',' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentRate, 0)) + ' as he_so_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentAmount, 0)) + ' as muc_thue_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentPercent, 0)) + ' as tl_chiu_thue_mt, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@EnvironmentAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_thue_mt'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') AND @Plant IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@PurGr, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as ma_nh0'
		ELSE SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', '''' as ma_nh0'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') AND @PurOrg IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@AssignedVendor, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as ma_ncc_cd, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@AssignedPlant, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as ma_vung_cd'
		ELSE SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', '''' as ma_ncc_cd, '''' as ma_vung_cd'
	IF @Lot = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@LotNumber, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as ma_lo'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #item a left join dmthuenk b on a.ma_thue_nk = b.ma_thue left join dmthue c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue' + @ExFrom
		+ CASE WHEN @ExWhere <> '' THEN ' where ' + @ExWhere ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_BI108] -- Số dư công nợ phải thu
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(255),
	@UOM INTEGER,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @Nam_bc INT, @GetDate SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(200), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @Nam_bc = nam_bc FROM dmstt
	SELECT @GetDate = GETDATE()
	IF @Nam_bc <> 0 SELECT @GetDate = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Nam_bc) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(DAY(@GetDate), 2), ' ', '0'), 112)

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @DebitAccount = REPLACE(@DebitAccount, '''', '')

	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(YEAR(@GetDate), 1), @DateTo = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @GetDate, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, ps_no AS so_du INTO #tmpp FROM wrkgl

	SET @Key = CASE WHEN @DebitAccount <> '' THEN 'dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @DebitAccount + ''') = 1' ELSE '1 = 0' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmpp select ma_kh, SUM(ps_no - ps_co) AS so_du'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %['+ @Key +']% group by ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT ma_kh, SUM(so_du) AS so_du INTO #tmp FROM #tmpp WHERE ma_kh <> '' GROUP BY ma_kh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdkh
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateTo, @Unit, @DebitAccount, '', 1 , 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', 'ma_kh <> '''''

	SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_no - du_no) AS so_du
		INTO #cdkh FROM #t
		WHERE (@DebitAccount <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @DebitAccount) = 1)
		GROUP BY ma_kh

	SET @q = 'select c.ma_kh, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'd.ten_kh' ELSE 'd.ten_kh2' END + ' AS ten_kh, (c.so_du/' + CAST(@UOM AS VARCHAR(10)) + ') AS so_du'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #temp'
	SET @q = @q + ' from (select case when a.ma_kh is null then b.ma_kh else a.ma_kh end as ma_kh, (isnull(a.so_du, 0) + isnull(b.so_du, 0)) as so_du'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a full join #cdkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh) c left join dmkh d on c.ma_kh = d.ma_kh order by so_du desc'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ma_kh, max(ten_kh) as ten_kh, cast(sum(so_du) as varchar) as so_du from #temp where so_du <> 0 group by ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9

			, sl_ton
			, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat
			, xac_nhan, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc
			, so_dh, stt_rec, nxt, muc_do
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2

		FROM mpctyc WHERE nguon = 'PL'
END
