	DECLARE @RangeFrom VARCHAR(6), @RangeTo VARCHAR(6), @c VARCHAR(512), @Ref VARCHAR(512), @l NUMERIC(28, 6), @y NUMERIC(28, 6), @m NUMERIC(28, 6), @i INT, @k NVARCHAR(4000), @e CHAR(2), @p SMALLDATETIME, @q NUMERIC(28, 6), @max INT

	SELECT @RangeFrom = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112), @RangeTo = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh2, 112) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @d = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, STR(@Year, 4) + '1231', 112), @Key = '', @Join = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0, @e = RTRIM(DAY(CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '0301' AS SMALLDATETIME) - 1)), @max = 0

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Delta = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_nam_tham_nien'
		SELECT @y = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_nam'
		SELECT @m = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_thang'
		SELECT @WorkingHours = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_gio'
		SELECT @WorkingDay = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_cong'

		-- Struct
		CREATE TABLE #t(stt_rec CHAR(13), n FLOAT, l NUMERIC(28, 6), m NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_gh SMALLDATETIME, phep_gh NUMERIC(28, 6) NULL, ref VARCHAR(512))
	END

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'

	-- Process
	SELECT @k = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END, @c = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112) + ''''

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #t (stt_rec, n, l, m, ref) select a.stt_rec, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_vao, ' + @c + '), 0, 0, a.bp_ref from hrnv a'
		SELECT @s = @s + ' where (a.ngay_vao < ' + @c + ' and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi >= ' + @c + '))' + @k	
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		UPDATE #t SET l = CASE WHEN @Delta = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(n / @Delta) END + CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN @y ELSE @m * ROUND(n * 12, 0) END

		-- Department
		SELECT a.ma_bp, a.thang, a.ngay INTO #g1 FROM hrghphep a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(nam_hl) AS nam_hl FROM hrghphep WHERE nam_hl <= @Year GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.nam_hl = b.nam_hl
		SELECT a.ma_bp, a.so_ngay INTO #g2 FROM hrghphep a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(nam_hl) AS nam_hl FROM hrghphep WHERE nam_hl <= @Year + 1 GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.nam_hl = b.nam_hl
		SELECT a.ma_bp, a.so_phep INTO #p1 FROM hrphepbp a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrphepbp WHERE ngay_hl <= @d GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
		SELECT DISTINCT ref INTO #ref FROM #t
		SELECT @Ref = MIN(ref) FROM #ref
		WHILE @Ref IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @p = NULL, @q = NULL, @l = 0, @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #g1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @Ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
			IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @p = CASE WHEN a.ngay = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(a.thang, 2), ' ', '0') + CASE WHEN a.thang = 2 AND a.ngay > 28 THEN @e ELSE REPLACE(STR(a.ngay, 2), ' ', '0') END) END
					FROM #g1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
				UPDATE #t SET ngay_gh = @p WHERE ref = @Ref
			END
			SELECT @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #g2 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @Ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
			IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @q = so_ngay FROM #g2 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
				IF @q IS NOT NULL UPDATE #t SET phep_gh = @q WHERE ref = @Ref
			END
			SELECT @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #p1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @Ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
			IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @l = so_phep FROM #p1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
				SELECT @l = ISNULL(@l, 0)
				UPDATE #t SET l = l + @l WHERE ref = @Ref
			END
			--
			SELECT @Ref = MIN(ref) FROM #ref WHERE ref > @Ref
		END

		SELECT @max = MAX(MONTH(ngay_gh)) FROM #t WHERE ngay_gh IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @max = ISNULL(@max, 0)

		-- Employee
		SELECT @c = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112) + ''''

		CREATE TABLE #p2(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_phep FLOAT)
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select a.stt_rec, a.so_phep from hrphepnv a join ('
		SELECT @s = @s + 'select r.stt_rec, max(r.ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from hrphepnv r' + @Join + ' where ngay_hl <= ' + @c + @k + ' group by r.stt_rec'
		SELECT @s = @s + ') b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		UPDATE #t SET l = l + b.so_phep FROM #t a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		
		-- Delta
		TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(r.so_phep) from hrphepps r ' + @Join + ' where year(r.ngay) = ' + STR(@Year, 4) + @k + ' group by r.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		UPDATE #t SET l = l + b.so_phep FROM #t a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		--
		CREATE TABLE #g(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6))
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #g select a.stt_rec, a.so_gio from hrttchamcong a join ('
		SELECT @s = @s + 'select r.stt_rec, max(r.ngay_tu) as ngay_tu from hrttchamcong r' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @c + ' and (r.ngay_den is null or r.ngay_den >= ' + @c + '))' + @k
		SELECT @s = @s + ' group by r.stt_rec'
		SELECT @s = @s + ') b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s		

		SELECT @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= 12 BEGIN
			SELECT @c = STR(@Year, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0')
			IF (@c BETWEEN @RangeFrom AND @RangeTo) BEGIN
				SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_gio) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r' + @Join + ' where r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@WorkingDay, '''', '''''') + '''' + @k + ' group by r.stt_rec'
				TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
				EXEC sp_executesql @s
			
				UPDATE #p2 SET so_phep = 
						CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 AND @WorkingHours = 0 THEN 0
							ELSE ROUND(a.so_phep / CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 THEN @WorkingHours ELSE b.so_gio END, 2)
						END
					FROM #p2 a LEFT JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				UPDATE #t SET l = l - b.so_phep FROM #t a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				IF @i <= @max BEGIN
					TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
					SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_gio) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r join #t t on r.stt_rec = t.stt_rec ' + @Join
					SELECT @s = @s + ' where r.ngay <= t.ngay_gh and r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@WorkingDay, '''', '''''') + '''' + @k
					SELECT @s = @s + ' group by r.stt_rec'
					EXEC sp_executesql @s
					UPDATE #p2 SET so_phep = 
							CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 AND @WorkingHours = 0 THEN 0
								ELSE ROUND(a.so_phep / CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 THEN @WorkingHours ELSE b.so_gio END, 2)
							END
						FROM #p2 a LEFT JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
					UPDATE #t SET m = m + b.so_phep FROM #t a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				END
			END
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		DELETE #t WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM hrphepnam WHERE nam = @Year + 1 AND loai <> '1')

		-- Previous
		UPDATE #t SET l = l + CASE WHEN ngay_gh IS NOT NULL AND b.so_phep > b.da_nghi + a.m THEN a.m ELSE b.so_phep - b.da_nghi END
			FROM #t a JOIN hrphepnam b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.nam = @Year
		-- Limit
		UPDATE #t SET l = phep_gh WHERE phep_gh IS NOT NULL AND l > phep_gh AND phep_gh IS NOT NULL
	END
	
	-- Delete
	SELECT @s = 'delete hrphepnam from hrphepnam r' + @Join + ' where (r.nam = ' + STR(@Year + 1, 4) + ' and loai = ''1'')' + @k
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- Insert
	IF @Type = 1 INSERT INTO hrphepnam (nam, stt_rec, so_phep, da_nghi, loai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2) SELECT @Year + 1, stt_rec, l, 0, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID FROM #t WHERE l > 0
		
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$Message$Leave]
	@Sender VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@LeaveDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@LeaveDay NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@DayLeft NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT,
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32), 
	@Language CHAR(1) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	CREATE TABLE #k(tt INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv CHAR(16), ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(128), tham_nien FLOAT, phep_dn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_hh NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_tn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_den_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_th NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_cl NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT INTO #k EXEC hs_rptEmployeeAnnualLeaveSummary '', @EmployeeID, '', '', '', '', '', '', @LeaveDate, '', @Language, 0, 1, @SysDatabase
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #k) SELECT @DayLeft = ISNULL(phep_cl, 0) FROM #k
	ELSE SELECT @DayLeft = 0
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CalculatePayrollByBaseSalary]
	@Month TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Round TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@DebugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Cập nhật lương tối thiểu
	-- + Nhân viên có thông tin không thay đổi trong kỳ
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l00 = CASE WHEN a.loai_luong = 1 THEN ROUND(c.he_so_luong * ISNULL(b.luong_tt, 0), @Round) ELSE ROUND(c.tien_khoan, @Round) END
		FROM #hrluong a LEFT JOIN #hrdmlttxl b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt JOIN #ttluongqtbp c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1 AND c.nhieu_doan = 0

	-- + Nhân viên có thông tin thay đổi trong kỳ
	SELECT a.stt_rec, c.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, c.ngay_tu, c.ngay_den, CASE WHEN a.loai_luong = 1 THEN ROUND(c.he_so_luong * ISNULL(b.luong_tt, 0), @Round) ELSE ROUND(c.tien_khoan, @Round) END AS l00 --, c.ty_le
		INTO #hrluong2_tmp
		FROM #hrstt_rec a LEFT JOIN #hrdmlttxl b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt JOIN #ttluongqtbp c ON c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND c.nhieu_doan = 1

	INSERT INTO #hrluong2(stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, ma_loai_lg, ngay_tu, ngay_den, gt_nt) --, gt_nt_ct
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_nt, 'L00', ngay_tu, ngay_den, l00 --, ROUND(l00 * ty_le, @Round)
		FROM #hrluong2_tmp
	UPDATE #hrluong SET l00 = b.l00 FROM #hrluong a JOIN (
		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.l00 FROM (
			SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM #hrluong2_tmp GROUP BY stt_rec
		) a JOIN #hrluong2_tmp b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu
	) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.bpql_yn = 1
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetCycles(@d SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	RETURN YEAR(@d)*12 + MONTH(@d)
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_GetGroupStatusRight
	@cSysDB VARCHAR(32), 
	@nGroupID INT, 
	@cVC VARCHAR(3), 
	@cStatusID CHAR(1) , 
	@cRight NCHAR(16)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQL = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ' + @cSysDB + '.dbo.syssgrouptatusrights WHERE ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + @cVC + CHAR(39) + ' AND r_' + @cRight + ' = 1 AND status_id = ' + CHAR(39) + @cStatusID + CHAR(39) + ' AND group_id = ' + CAST(@nGroupID AS CHAR) + ')'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT 0 AS xvalue'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE IF NOT EXISTS('
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM ' + @cSysDB + '.dbo.sysstatusinfo WHERE ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + @cVC + CHAR(39) + ' AND xstatus = ' + CHAR(39) + @cStatusID + CHAR(39) + ' AND xstatus2 = ' + CHAR(39) + @cStatusID + CHAR(39)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'AND xaction IN (SELECT action_id FROM ' + @cSysDB + '.dbo.sysgroupactionrights'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + @cVC + CHAR(39) + ' AND group_id = ' + CAST(@nGroupID AS CHAR) + ' AND right_yn = 1'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UNION ALL(SELECT action_id FROM dmxlct WHERE (ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ' OR ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + @cVC + CHAR(39) + ') AND right_yn = 0)))'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT 0  AS xvalue'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE '
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT 1  AS xvalue'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMPerformanceFormBlank]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@DateAppraisal DATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
		
	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nam * 100 + a.ky <= ' + RTRIM(@Year * 100 + @Period)
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Query
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec_nv, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xkey, b.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv, b.bo_phan, b.vi_tri INTO #t FROM hrkbctdg a, hrnv b
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select a.stt_rec_nv, max(a.nam * 100 + a.ky), max(b.ma_nv), rtrim(max(b.ho_nv)) + space(1) + max(b.ten_nv), max(b.bo_phan), max(b.vi_tri)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrkbctdg a with(nolock) left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.stt_rec_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Report
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri
		INTO #qtlvht
		FROM hreqtlvht a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM hreqtlvht WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE tinh_chat = 1 AND ngay_tu <= @DateAppraisal AND stt_rec IN (SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec FROM #t) GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu
	UPDATE #t SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, vi_tri = b.vi_tri FROM #t a JOIN #qtlvht b ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec

	-- View
	SELECT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, b.ho_ten_nv
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_bp ELSE c.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_vtr ELSE d.ten_vtr2 END AS ten_vtr
		FROM hrkbctdg a JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec_nv AND a.nam * 100 + a.ky = xkey
			LEFT JOIN hrbp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt d WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr
		ORDER BY c.stt_ref, d.stt, b.vi_tri, b.ma_nv

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RCCPRunUpdateOrderQuantity]
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nQRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nQRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

	SELECT MIN(ky) AS ky, ma_nl, ma_vt, so_dh, SUM(cong_suat) AS t_cong_suat, MAX(so_luong) AS t_so_luong
		INTO #tSum FROM crhdnlsx GROUP BY ma_nl, ma_vt, so_dh

	-- Dis
	UPDATE crhdnlsx SET so_luong = CASE WHEN b.t_cong_suat <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.so_luong * a.cong_suat / b.t_cong_suat, @nQRound) ELSE 0 END
		FROM crhdnlsx a JOIN #tSum b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = b.so_dh

	-- Adj
	SELECT a.ma_nl, a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, SUM(a.so_luong) AS t_so_luong INTO #s FROM crhdnlsx a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tSum b WHERE a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = b.so_dh)
		GROUP BY a.ma_nl, a.ma_vt, a.so_dh

	UPDATE crhdnlsx SET so_luong = b.t_so_luong - c.t_so_luong
		FROM crhdnlsx a
			JOIN #tSum b ON a.ky = b.ky AND a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = b.so_dh
			JOIN #s c ON a.ma_nl = c.ma_nl AND a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = c.so_dh

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTaxRefundInputVATList]
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@MonthFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@MonthTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@TaxRate VARCHAR(33),
	@TaxAccount VARCHAR(128),
	@CorrTaxAccount VARCHAR(33),
	@CustomerID VARCHAR(33),
	@TaxAuthority VARCHAR(33),
	@SiteID VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm VARCHAR(1024),
	@TaxProperty VARCHAR(1024),
	@OrderBy VARCHAR(1024),
	@Classify CHAR(1),
	@ItemDetail CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Type TINYINT, -- 0: Normal, 1: Detail
	@Circular CHAR (1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Sys VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@VoucherTax VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@VoucherTaxNot VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@VoucherPost VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@VoucherOrg VARCHAR(512) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @Sys = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Sys), '''', ''), @Controller = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Controller), '''', '')


	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @vCode VARCHAR(32), @cancelInvoice NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_price_fc INT, @r_price INT, @r_amount_fc INT, @r_amount INT, @i INT, @n INT

	SELECT @cancelInvoice = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT057'
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@MonthFrom, @YearFrom), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@MonthTo, @YearTo)
	SELECT @r_price_fc = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @r_price = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @r_amount_fc = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'
	SELECT @r_amount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'

	SELECT @VoucherTax = 'a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('-', @VoucherTax) > 0 THEN ' not' else '' end + ' in ('''  + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherTax, '(-)', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		, @VoucherTaxNot = 'a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('-', @VoucherTaxNot) > 0 THEN ' not' else '' end + ' in ('''  + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherTaxNot, '(-)', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		, @VoucherPost = 'a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('-', @VoucherPost) > 0 THEN ' not' else '' end + ' in ('''  + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherPost, '(-)', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		, @VoucherOrg = 'a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('-', @VoucherOrg) > 0 THEN ' not' else '' end + ' in ('''  + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherOrg, '(-)', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #dt FROM wrkinputvat
	SELECT * INTO #dt0 FROM #dt

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status not in (''0'', ''*'') and a.ma_tc <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @VoucherTaxNot <> '' THEN ' and ' + @VoucherTaxNot ELSE '' END

	IF @CustomerID <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(REPLACE(@CustomerID, '''', '''''')) + '%' + CHAR(39) + ''
	IF @TaxAuthority <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh2 like ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(REPLACE(@TaxAuthority, '''', '''''')) + '%' + CHAR(39) + ''
	IF @SiteID <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ' + CHAR(39) + RTRIM(REPLACE(@SiteID, '''', '''''')) + '%' + CHAR(39) + ''
	IF @ReportForm <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.mau_bc in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@ReportForm, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @TaxProperty <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_tc in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TaxProperty, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @TaxAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_thue_no', 'inlist', RTRIM(REPLACE(@TaxAccount, '''', '''''')))
	IF @CorrTaxAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_du', 'like', RTRIM(REPLACE(@CorrTaxAccount, '''', '''''')))
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #dt0 select * from ctgt30 a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherTax <> '' THEN @VoucherTax + ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' ngay_ct between @d1 and @d2 and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo

	SET @q = 'insert into #dt select * from r30$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	IF @Classify = '0' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #dt select * from ctgt30 a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherTax <> '' THEN @VoucherTax + ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' ngay_ct between @d1 and @d2 and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q2, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @lstF NVARCHAR(4000), @lstFSum NVARCHAR(512), @lstFAvg NVARCHAR(512), @lstFGroup NVARCHAR(512)
		SELECT @lstFSum = 't_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, so_luong', @lstFAvg = 'gia, gia_nt', @lstFGroup = 'ma_tc, so_seri0, so_ct0, ma_thue, ngay_ct0, ma_so_thue'

		SELECT @q2 = '
select @lstF = isnull(@lstF, '''') + '','' + case
	when ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.name', 'exactinlist', @lstFSum) + ' then ''sum('' + rtrim(a.name) + '')''
	else case
		when ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.name', 'exactinlist', @lstFAvg) + ' then ''avg('' + rtrim(a.name) + '')''
		else case
			when ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.name', 'exactinlist', @lstFGroup) + ' then rtrim(a.name)
			else ''max('' + rtrim(a.name) + '')''
		end
	end
end
from syscolumns a join sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id where b.name = ''r30$000000'' and b.xtype = ''U'' order by a.colorder'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q2, N'@lstF nvarchar(4000) output, @lstFSum nvarchar(512), @lstFAvg nvarchar(512), @lstFGroup nvarchar(512)', @lstF OUTPUT, @lstFSum, @lstFAvg, @lstFGroup

		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '#dt', '#dt0')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @q = 'insert into #dt select ' + SUBSTRING(@lstF, 2, 4000) + ' from #dt0 a '
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by ' + @lstFGroup

		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
update #dt set stt_rec = '''', ma_ct = ''''
	from #dt a join (
		select ' + @lstFGroup + ' from (select distinct stt_rec, ' + @lstFGroup + ' from #dt0) a group by ' + @lstFGroup + ' having count(*) > 1
	) b on a.' + REPLACE(@lstFGroup, ', ', ' + a.') + ' = b.' + REPLACE(@lstFGroup, ', ', ' + b.')

		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '+ a.ngay_ct0 +', '+ convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct0, 112) +')
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '+ b.ngay_ct0 +', '+ convert(char(8), b.ngay_ct0, 112) +')

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @vCode = rtrim(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_mau_ct_dv'
	UPDATE #dt SET ma_mau_ct = @vCode WHERE ISNULL(ma_mau_ct, '') = ''

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @T_tien_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_thue_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_tien AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_thue AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @T_so_luong AS NUMERIC(28, 6)

	CREATE TABLE #v20dmtcthue (stt2 INT IDENTITY(1, 1), ma_tc CHAR(16), ten_tc NVARCHAR(256), ten_tc2 NVARCHAR(256), htkk_yn CHAR(1))
	SET @q = '
insert into #v20dmtcthue(ma_tc, ten_tc, ten_tc2, htkk_yn)
select ma_tc, ten_tc, ten_tc2, htkk_yn from v20dmtcthue where ma_tc in ('''+ replace(@TaxProperty, ', ', ''', ''') + ''') and status = ''1'' order by stt, ma_tc
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#v20dmtcthue', 'ten_tc, ten_tc2', 'nvarchar(1024), nvarchar(1024)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Type = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #v20dmtcthue SET ten_tc = LTRIM(STR(stt2, 3)) + '. ' + ten_tc, ten_tc2 = LTRIM(STR(stt2, 3)) + '. ' + ten_tc2
		INSERT INTO #dt (ma_tc, stt_rec, stt_rec0, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt)
			SELECT ma_tc, ma_tc, '000', 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #v20dmtcthue WHERE ma_tc NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_tc FROM #dt)
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, b.ma_vt, b.dvt1 AS dvt, b.sl_nhap AS so_luong, b.gia_nt, b.gia, b.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, b.tien_nhap AS tien, b.thue_nt, b.thue, b.dien_giai, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #ct70 FROM #dt a, ct70 b
	IF @ItemDetail = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, t_tien_nt, t_tien, t_thue_nt, t_thue, thue_suat INTO #thue FROM #dt
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #thue select a.stt_rec, sum(a.t_tien_nt), sum(a.t_tien), sum(a.t_thue_nt), sum(a.t_thue), max(a.thue_suat) from #dt a ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherPost <> '' THEN 'where ' + @VoucherPost ELSE '' END + ' group by a.stt_rec having count(*) = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #ct70 (stt_rec, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt, gia, tien_nt, tien, thue_nt, thue, dien_giai, stt)
	select a.stt_rec, b.ma_vt, b.dvt1, sum(b.sl_nhap1) - sum(sl_xuat1), 0, 0,
		case when sum(a.t_thue_nt) <> 0 then round(sum(a.t_tien_nt) * abs(sum(b.thue_nt))/abs(sum(a.t_thue_nt)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount_fc) + ') else 0 end,
		case when sum(a.t_thue) <> 0 then round(sum(a.t_tien) * abs(sum(b.thue))/abs(sum(a.t_thue)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount) + ') else 0 end,
		case when sum(a.t_thue_nt) < 0 then -1 else 1 end * abs(sum(b.thue_nt)), case when sum(a.t_thue) < 0 then -1 else 1 end * abs(sum(b.thue)), '''', 0
	from #thue a join r70$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where %[(thue_nt <> 0 or thue <> 0)]% group by a.stt_rec, b.ma_vt, b.dvt1
	order by a.stt_rec, min(b.line_nbr)
'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF @VoucherOrg <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(64)) AS m$, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(64)) AS d$, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS item_yn, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #v
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #v (ma_ct) select distinct a.ma_ct from #dt a where a.ma_ct is not null and ' + @VoucherOrg
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SELECT @q = '
truncate table #thue
insert into #thue select a.stt_rec, sum(a.t_tien_nt), sum(a.t_tien), sum(a.t_thue_nt), sum(a.t_thue), max(a.thue_suat) from #dt a where ' + @VoucherOrg + ' group by a.stt_rec having count(*) = 1
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #v) BEGIN
				UPDATE #v SET m$ = b.m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(b.m$, 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END, d$ = b.d$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(b.d$, 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END
						, item_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_vt' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(b.d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(b.d$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
					FROM #v a LEFT JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
				SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(stt) FROM #v
				WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
					SELECT @q = '
insert into #ct70 (stt_rec, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt, gia, tien_nt, tien, thue_nt, thue, dien_giai, stt)
	select a.stt_rec, ' + CASE WHEN item_yn = 1 THEN 'b.ma_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ', b.dvt, sum(' + CASE WHEN ma_ct IN ('PXC', 'PXD') THEN '-' ELSE '' END + 'b.so_luong), 0, 0
		, case when sum(c.t_tien_nt) <> 0 then round(sum(a.t_tien_nt) * abs(sum(b.tien_nt))/abs(sum(c.t_tien_nt)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount_fc) + ') else sum(a.t_tien_nt) end
		, case when sum(c.t_tien) <> 0 then round(sum(a.t_tien) * abs(sum(b.tien))/abs(sum(c.t_tien)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount) + ') else sum(a.t_tien) end
		, case when sum(a.t_thue_nt) < 0 then -1 else 1 end * case when sum(b.thue_nt) <> 0 then abs(sum(b.thue_nt)) else case when sum(c.t_tien_nt) <> 0 then round(abs(sum(a.t_thue_nt) * sum(b.tien_nt))/abs(sum(c.t_tien_nt)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount_fc) + ') else abs(sum(a.t_thue_nt)) end end
		, case when sum(a.t_thue) < 0 then -1 else 1 end * case when sum(b.thue) <> 0 then abs(sum(b.thue)) else case when sum(c.t_tien) <> 0 then round(abs(sum(a.t_thue) * sum(b.tien))/abs(sum(c.t_tien)), ' + RTRIM(@r_amount) + ') else abs(sum(a.t_thue)) end end
		, ' + CASE WHEN item_yn = 1 THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.dien_giai' END + ', 0
	from #thue a join ' + m$ + ' c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec right join ' + d$ + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec group by a.stt_rec, ' + CASE WHEN item_yn = 1 THEN 'b.ma_vt' ELSE 'b.dien_giai' END + ', b.dvt
	order by a.stt_rec, min(b.line_nbr)
'
						FROM #v WHERE stt = @i
					EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
					SELECT @i = @i + 1
				END
			END
		END

		UPDATE #ct70 SET gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong <> 0 THEN ROUND(tien_nt / so_luong, @r_price_fc) ELSE 0 END, gia = CASE WHEN so_luong <> 0 THEN ROUND(tien / so_luong, @r_price) ELSE 0 END
	END

	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS stt INTO #o FROM #ct70 GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #ct70 SET stt = a.id - o.stt + 1 FROM #ct70 a JOIN #o o ON a.stt_rec = o.stt_rec

	IF @ItemDetail = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT a.stt_rec INTO #r FROM #ct70 a WHERE ISNULL(a.stt_rec, '') <> '' GROUP BY a.stt_rec HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #thue
			INSERT INTO #thue SELECT a.stt_rec, SUM(a.t_tien_nt), SUM(a.t_tien), SUM(a.t_thue_nt), SUM(a.t_thue), MAX(a.thue_suat) FROM #dt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) GROUP BY a.stt_rec HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
			SELECT a.* INTO #ct70Ext FROM #ct70 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)

			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Table '#ct70Ext', '#thue', 'thue_nt', 't_thue_nt', 'm_round_tien_nt', 'thue_nt', 'stt <> 0', 'stt', 'stt_rec'
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Table '#ct70Ext', '#thue', 'thue', 't_thue', 'm_round_tien', 'thue', 'stt <> 0', 'stt', 'stt_rec'
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Table '#ct70Ext', '#thue', 'tien_nt', 't_tien_nt', 'm_round_tien_nt', 'tien_nt', 'stt <> 0', 'stt', 'stt_rec'
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Allocate$Table '#ct70Ext', '#thue', 'tien', 't_tien', 'm_round_tien', 'tien', 'stt <> 0', 'stt', 'stt_rec'
			UPDATE a SET thue_nt = b.thue_nt, thue = b.thue, tien_nt = b.tien_nt, tien = b.tien FROM #ct70 a JOIN #ct70Ext b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt
		END
	END

	SELECT 5 sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS excel
			, CASE WHEN a.stt_rec0 = '000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stt, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ngay_ct0
			, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ma_nt, CAST(a.ma_tc AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_tc, a.ma_so_thue
			, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN k.ma_vt = '' THEN k.dien_giai ELSE CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN l.ten_vt ELSE l.ten_vt2 END END ELSE a.ten_vt END AS ten_vt
			, k.dvt, k.so_luong, k.gia_nt, k.gia, k.stt AS k_stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt3
			, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.tien ELSE a.t_tien END AS t_tien, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.tien_nt ELSE a.t_tien_nt END AS t_tien_nt
			, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.thue ELSE a.t_thue END t_thue, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.thue_nt ELSE a.t_thue_nt END AS t_thue_nt, g.thue_suat
			, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.so_luong * k.gia + k.thue ELSE a.t_thue + a.t_tien END AS t_tt
			, CASE WHEN k.stt IS NOT NULL THEN k.so_luong * k.gia_nt + k.thue_nt ELSE ISNULL(a.t_thue_nt, 0) + ISNULL(a.t_tien_nt, 0) END AS t_tt_nt
			, b.ten_dvcs, b.ten_dvcs2, d.stt_ct_nkc, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, a.ma_ct
			, CASE WHEN a.status = '9' THEN @cancelInvoice ELSE a.ten_kh END AS ten_kh
			, CASE WHEN a.status = '9' THEN @cancelInvoice ELSE h.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh2
			, CASE WHEN a.status = '9' THEN @cancelInvoice ELSE a.ghi_chu END AS ghi_chu
			, e.ten_tc, e.ten_tc2, e.stt2, e.htkk_yn, a.ma_mau_ct, a.ma_thue
		INTO #f FROM #dt a
			LEFT JOIN dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
			LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_thue_no = c.tk
			LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
			LEFT JOIN #v20dmtcthue e ON a.ma_tc = e.ma_tc
			LEFT JOIN dmthue g ON a.ma_thue = g.ma_thue
			LEFT JOIN dmkh h ON a.ma_kh = h.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN #ct70 k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN dmvt l ON k.ma_vt = l.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.ma_mau_ct, d.ma_ct_in, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, k.stt

	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024), @k NVARCHAR(2048)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_tc', @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, 'sysorder, ' + @OrderBy + ', stt_rec, stt_rec0, k_stt'), @k = 'sysorder = 5 and (stt_rec0 <> ''000'' or stt_rec0 is null)'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#f', 'stt3', @k

	SELECT * INTO #report FROM #f

	IF @TaxRate <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT data INTO #taxRate FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@TaxRate, ',') WHERE dbo.ff_IsNumeric(data) = 1
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #taxRate) DELETE #report WHERE thue_suat NOT IN (SELECT data FROM #taxRate)
			ELSE DELETE #report WHERE stt = 0
	END

	UPDATE #report SET t_tien_nt = ISNULL(t_tien_nt, 0), t_thue_nt = ISNULL(t_thue_nt, 0)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2, stt, excel', 'nvarchar(1024), nvarchar(1024), int, int')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, gia_nt = 0 WHERE ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = '' OR RTRIM(ma_nt) IN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0')

	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @T_tien = SUM(t_tien), @T_tien_nt = SUM(t_tien_nt), @T_thue = SUM(t_thue), @T_thue_nt = SUM(t_thue_nt), @T_so_luong = SUM(so_luong)
		FROM #report
		WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, excel, ma_tc, ten_tc, ten_tc2, htkk_yn, ten_kh, ten_kh2, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, stt2)
		SELECT 4, 0, 0, 1, ma_tc, ten_tc, ten_tc2, MAX(htkk_yn), ten_tc, ten_tc2, 0, 0, 0, 0, stt2
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
			GROUP BY ma_tc, ten_tc, ten_tc2, stt2

	UPDATE #report SET k_stt = 0 WHERE k_stt IS NULL
	SET @k = @k + ' and k_stt in (0, 1)'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', @k

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh, ten_kh2, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, so_luong)
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, @s12, @T_tien, @T_tien_nt, @T_thue, @T_thue_nt, @T_so_luong)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_kh, ten_kh2','int, nvarchar(1024), nvarchar(1024)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report
		SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN systotal = 1 THEN SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ISNULL(ten_kh,'')) ELSE ten_kh END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN systotal = 1 THEN SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ISNULL(ten_kh2,'')) ELSE ten_kh2 END,
			ma_tc = REPLACE(STR(stt2, 3), ' ', '0') + ma_tc, ngay_lct = CASE WHEN (ngay_lct IS NULL AND systotal = 1) THEN ngay_ct ELSE ngay_lct END, thue_suat = CASE WHEN (systotal = 1 AND thue_suat IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE thue_suat END,
			excel = ISNULL(excel, 0)

	--Excel
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, excel, ma_tc, ten_kh, ten_kh2, htkk_yn, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, stt2)
		SELECT 6, 0, 0, 1, 'ZZZ', N'Tổng cộng', N'Total', MAX(htkk_yn), SUM(t_tien), SUM(t_tien_nt), SUM(t_thue), SUM(t_thue_nt), stt2
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
			GROUP BY ma_tc, stt2

	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.excel, CASE WHEN a.stt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.stt END AS stt, a.stt2
			, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.so_seri0 ELSE '' END AS so_seri0, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.so_ct0 ELSE '' END AS so_ct0, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.ngay_ct0 ELSE NULL END AS ngay_ct0
			, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.ma_ct0 ELSE '' END AS ma_ct0, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.ma_so_thue ELSE '' END AS ma_so_thue
			, a.ten_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.gia
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' AND (sysorder <> 5 OR k_stt in (0, 1)) THEN a.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' AND (sysorder <> 5 OR k_stt in (0, 1)) THEN a.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_thue_nt, a.thue_suat, a.t_tien, a.t_thue, a.ghi_chu, a.so_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec
			, CASE WHEN k_stt in (0, 1) THEN a.ma_mau_ct ELSE '' END AS ma_mau_ct
			, CASE WHEN b.loai_hd <> '' THEN b.loai_hd ELSE LEFT(a.ma_mau_ct, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.ma_mau_ct, 3, 1) <> '/' THEN 6 ELSE 3 END) END AS loai_hd, a.ma_thue
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmmauct b ON a.ma_mau_ct = b.ma_mau_ct
		ORDER BY a.stt2, a.ma_tc, ISNULL(a.stt3, a.stt), a.stt

	IF (@Circular <> '3')
		SELECT SUM(t_tien) AS t_tien, SUM(t_tien_nt) AS t_tien_nt, SUM(t_thue) AS t_thue, SUM(t_thue_nt) AS t_thue_nt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 6 AND stt2 <> 5
	ELSE
		SELECT SUM(t_tien) AS t_tien, SUM(t_tien_nt) AS t_tien_nt, SUM(t_thue) AS t_thue, SUM(t_thue_nt) AS t_thue_nt FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 6 AND stt2 < 3

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$GetVoucherNumberRegion]
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrentNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@MinNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@MaxNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@NextNumber VARCHAR(32) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @VoucherBook = '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @voucherNumberLen INT
		SELECT @voucherNumberLen = character_maximum_length FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'wrkcolumns' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'so_ct'
		SELECT @NextNumber = CASE WHEN @CurrentNumber = REPLICATE('9', @voucherNumberLen) THEN '' ELSE CAST(@CurrentNumber AS BIGINT) + 1 END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @nextNo BIGINT
		SET @NextNumber = ''

		DECLARE @cr BIT, @cn BIGINT, @cv VARCHAR(33), @cs1 VARCHAR(33), @cs2 VARCHAR(33)
		EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @CurrentNumber, @cr OUT, @cn OUT, @cv OUT, @cs1 OUT, 1, @cs2 OUT, 1

		DECLARE @sr BIT, @sn BIGINT, @sv VARCHAR(33), @ss1 VARCHAR(33), @ss2 VARCHAR(33)
		EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @MinNumber, @sr OUT, @sn OUT, @sv OUT, @ss1 OUT, 1, @ss2 OUT, 1

		DECLARE @en INT
		SELECT @en = dbo.FastBusiness$MaxNumericRegion(@MaxNumber, '')

		IF @cn IS NOT NULL AND LEN(@sv) = LEN(@cv) AND @cn < @en AND (@cn + 1) >= @sn BEGIN
			SELECT @nextNo = @cn + 1, @NextNumber = @cs1 + REPLACE(SPACE(LEN(@cv) - LEN(LTRIM(@nextNo))), ' ', '0') + LTRIM(@nextNo) + @cs2
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_ConvertJobsNorm2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @tk_no VARCHAR(33), @tk_co VARCHAR(33), @tk_no_du VARCHAR(33), @tk_no_gt VARCHAR(33), @tk_co_du VARCHAR(33), @tk_co_gt VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @i INT

	SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_no_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_no_gt, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', tk_no) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_du) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_no_gt) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype INTO #No FROM v20dmvvct WITH(NOLOCK)
	UPDATE #No SET tk_no = tk_no + '%', tk_no_du = tk_no_du + '%', tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt + '%' WHERE xtype = 0
	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #No WHERE xtype = 1
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @tk_no = tk_no, @tk_no_du = tk_no_du, @tk_no_gt = tk_no_gt FROM #No WHERE ma_so = @ma_so
		INSERT INTO #No SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', b.data + '%', '', 2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_du, ',') b
		INSERT INTO #No SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', '', c.data + '%', 3 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_no_gt, ',') c
		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #No WHERE xtype = 1 AND ma_so > @ma_so
	END

	SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_du, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_du, REPLACE(REPLACE(tk_co_gt, ' ', ''), '''', '') AS tk_co_gt, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', tk_co) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_gt) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co_du) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype INTO #Co FROM v20dmvvct WITH(NOLOCK)
	UPDATE #Co SET tk_co = tk_co + '%', tk_co_du = tk_co_du + '%', tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt + '%' WHERE xtype = 0
	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #Co WHERE xtype = 1
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @tk_co = tk_co, @tk_co_du = tk_co_du, @tk_co_gt = tk_co_gt FROM #Co WHERE ma_so = @ma_so
		INSERT INTO #Co SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', b.data + '%', '', 2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_du, ',') b
		INSERT INTO #Co SELECT DISTINCT @ma_so, a.data + '%', '', c.data + '%', 3 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co, ',') a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tk_co_gt, ',') c
		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #Co WHERE xtype = 1 AND ma_so > @ma_so
	END

	--
	DELETE #No WHERE xtype = 1
	DELETE #Co WHERE xtype = 1

	-- Lay bang phat sinh
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
		INTO #ps
		FROM #ct00 a JOIN #No b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND b.tk_no <> '%'
		WHERE Ps_no <> 0 AND a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_du AND b.xtype IN (0, 2)
		GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so
	UNION ALL
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, - SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_no, - SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_no_nt, 0, 0
			FROM #ct00 a JOIN #No b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND b.tk_no <> '%'
			WHERE Ps_co <> 0 AND a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_no_gt AND tk_no_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 3)
			GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so
	UNION ALL
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, 0, 0, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			FROM #ct00 a JOIN #Co b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND b.tk_co <> '%' --a.tk = b.tk_co
			WHERE ps_co <> 0 AND a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_du AND b.xtype IN (0, 2)
			GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so
	UNION ALL
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, 0, 0, - SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_co, - SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			FROM #ct00 a JOIN #Co b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND b.tk_co <> '%' --a.tk = b.tk_co
			WHERE Ps_no <> 0 AND a.tk LIKE b.tk_co AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co_gt AND tk_co_gt <> '%' AND b.xtype IN (0, 3)
			GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so

	-- KET CHUYEN LUY KE SANG NAM SAU
	-- Lay bang luy ke khoi cong va dau ky
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #lk'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv, sum(lk_no), sum(lk_no_nt), sum(lk_no_dk), sum(lk_no_dk_nt), sum(lk_co), sum(lk_co_nt), sum(lk_co_dk), sum(lk_co_dk_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from v20vvlkct with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Tao bang ket chuyen luy ke
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv
			, SUM(lk_no) AS lk_no, SUM(lk_no_nt) AS lk_no_nt
			, SUM(lk_no_dk) AS lk_no_dk, SUM(lk_no_dk_nt) AS lk_no_dk_nt
			, SUM(lk_co) AS lk_co, SUM(lk_co_nt) AS lk_co_nt
			, SUM(lk_co_dk) AS lk_co_dk, SUM(lk_co_dk_nt) AS lk_co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt
			, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
		INTO #kclk
		FROM(
			SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_no_nt, lk_no_dk, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co, lk_co_nt, lk_co_dk, lk_co_dk_nt
					, lk_no * 0 AS ps_no, lk_no * 0 AS ps_no_nt, lk_no * 0 AS ps_co, lk_no * 0 AS ps_co_nt
				FROM #lk
			UNION ALL
				SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt
					FROM #ps
			) a
		GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv
		ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv

	UPDATE #kclk SET lk_no = lk_no + lk_no_dk + ps_no, lk_no_nt = lk_no_nt + lk_no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt
			, lk_co = lk_co + lk_co_dk + ps_co, lk_co_nt = lk_co_nt + lk_co_dk_nt + ps_co_nt
	DELETE #kclk WHERE lk_no + lk_co + lk_no_dk + lk_co_dk + lk_no_nt + lk_co_nt + lk_no_dk_nt + lk_co_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @q = 'delete from v20vvlkct where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	INSERT INTO v20vvlkct (nam, ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @nYear + 1, ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no, lk_co, 0, 0, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt, 0, 0, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #kclk

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReleaseInvoice]
	@TableName VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @tableName) > 0 RETURN

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TablePrime VARCHAR(33), @code VARCHAR(33), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @provider INT

	SELECT @TablePrime = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'm21$' WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'm81$' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'm86$' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'm22$' END, @qUpdate = ''
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'key', '', @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Customer
	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = ma_kh from ' + @TableName + ' a where not exists(select 1 from khhddt b where a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and b.[status] <> 0)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Replacement
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = ''1'' from ' + @TableName + ' a where exists(select 1 from hddt01 b where a.[key] = b.stt_rec1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + '000000 a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) > b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' BEGIN
			-- Check Modify Date
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) > b.datetime2' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode <> 'HD2' THEN '' ELSE ' and stt_rec_hd <> ''''' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF @provider <> 3 BEGIN
			-- Check Status E-Invoice
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' THEN @p ELSE '000000' END + ' a join  hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.tinh_trang_hddt <> ''0'' and exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
			
			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END
		
		-- Update status
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBalanceSheet] --fs20_BalanceSheet--
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportType TINYINT, -- 0: Mẫu chuẩn, 1: Mẫu giữa niên độ
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Check BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	/*
	So sánh với stored rs_rptBalanceSheetForInvestors:
		1. Khác bảng mẫu
		2. Khác phần TT200 (thêm phần lấy phát sinh theo tài khoản)
	*/
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dE1 SMALLDATETIME, @dE2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @yE INT, @yN INT, @yB INT, @y INT, @m_mau_so_ts VARCHAR(33), @m_mau_so_nv VARCHAR(33), @kieu_bc TINYINT
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @tk_du VARCHAR(32), @ts_nv TINYINT, @cong_no TINYINT, @cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @m_cn_dn CHAR(1), @kind CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @strSQLBalUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dBQ2 SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateTo) -- ngày đầu năm dương lịch 01/01 _ dùng tính số dư
		, @dE2 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateTo) -- ngày đầu năm tài chính
		, @dBQ2 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfQuarter(@DateTo) -- ngày đầu quý theo năm tài chính (TT 200)
	SELECT @yE = YEAR(@dE2) -- năm tài chính
		, @yN = YEAR(@DateTo) -- năm báo cáo (Form Filter)
		, @dE1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dE2) -- ngày đầu năm tài chính dương lịch

	SELECT @yB = nam_bd FROM dmstt -- năm bđ nhập liệu
	SELECT @y = CASE WHEN @yN = @yB THEN @yN ELSE @yE END
	SELECT @m_cn_dn = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cn_dn'
	SELECT @kieu_bc = kieu_bc FROM v20dmmaubc WHERE form = @Form

	-- Struct
	SELECT *, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(8)) AS flag, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ss INTO #report FROM v20gltc1 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #glTmp FROM #gl

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_cust FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_acct FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #EdCusts FROM wrkgl
	--TT 200 Begin
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl2 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #glTmp2 FROM #gl2
	SELECT * INTO #glTmp0 FROM #gl2
	SELECT * INTO #gl0 FROM #gl2
	--TT 200 End

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_cust'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no1) as du_no0, sum(du_co1) as du_co0, sum(du_no_nt1) as du_no_nt0, sum(du_co_nt1) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh with (index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by tk, ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, sum(case when nam = @yn then du_no00 else 0 end) as du_no'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_co00 else 0 end) as du_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_no_nt00 else 0 end) as du_no_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_co_nt00 else 0 end) as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_no1 else 0 end) as du_no0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_co1 else 0 end) as du_co0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_no_nt1 else 0 end) as du_no_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_co_nt1 else 0 end) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + '	from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam))	where (nam = @yn or nam= @ye)' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by tk'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@yn', RTRIM(@yn)), '@ye', RTRIM(@ye)), '@y', RTRIM(@y))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #EdCusts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateTo, @Unit, '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''

	-- Lay so lieu tu r00
	DECLARE @y1 INT, @y2 INT, @p1 INT, @p2 INT, @DateStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y1 = y1, @p1 = p1, @y2 = y2, @p2 = p2, @DateStart1 = dStart1, @DateEnd1 = dEnd1, @DateStart2 = dStart2, @DateEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	IF @y1 + @p1 + @y2 + @p2 <> 0
		SELECT @DateStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @DateEnd = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
	ELSE
		SELECT @DateStart = NULL, @DateEnd = NULL

	SET @q = 'insert into #glTmp select tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from pstk$%Partition with (nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #glTmp select tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart1, @DateEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart2, @DateEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	INSERT INTO #gl SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #glTmp GROUP BY tk

	--TT 200 Begin
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE kind = '2') BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = ''
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' or ' END + '(tk like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(tk, '''', '')) + '%''' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(tk_du) = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and tk_du like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(tk_du, '''', '')) + '%''' END + ')' FROM #report WHERE kind = '2'
		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
		--
		SELECT @dTmp = CASE WHEN @ReportType = 0 THEN @dE2 WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN @dBQ2 END
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '#glTmp', '#glTmp2'), 'tk', 'tk, tk_du'), ']%', ' and (' + @Key + ')]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dTmp, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		DECLARE @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME

		SELECT @dTmpTo = @dE2 - 1, @dTmpFrom = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @dTmpTo) + 1
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '#glTmp2', '#glTmp0')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dTmpFrom, @dTmpTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--

		INSERT INTO #gl2 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #glTmp2 GROUP BY tk, tk_du
		INSERT INTO #gl0 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #glTmp0 GROUP BY tk, tk_du
	END
	--TT 200 End

	IF @m_cn_dn = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE2) BEGIN
		DELETE #bal_cust
		INSERT INTO #bal_cust SELECT tk, '', du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0 FROM #bal_acct
	END

	-- Adj Ex: Bg of FY
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DAY(ngay_dn) = DAY(ngay_dn2) AND MONTH(ngay_dn) = MONTH(ngay_dn2)) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) <= @dE2) BEGIN
			-- Struct
			SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #bal_acct0 FROM wrkgl
			SELECT * INTO #bal_acct0Tmp FROM #bal_acct0

			DECLARE @dE2Tmp AS SMALLDATETIME
			SELECT @dE2Tmp = DATEADD(day, -1, @dE2)

			SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct0Tmp select tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by tk'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dE1, @dE2Tmp, @UserID, @Admin

			SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct0Tmp select tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
			SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk where nam = ' + RTRIM(@yE) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + 'group by tk'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			INSERT INTO #bal_acct0 SELECT tk, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #bal_acct0Tmp GROUP BY tk

			DECLARE @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
			UPDATE #bal_acct0 SET @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END
				, du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

			INSERT INTO #bal_acct(tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0)
				SELECT tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #bal_acct0 WHERE tk NOT IN (SELECT tk FROM #bal_acct)

			UPDATE #bal_acct SET du_no0 = ISNULL(b.du_no, 0), du_co0 = ISNULL(b.du_co, 0), du_no_nt0 = ISNULL(b.du_no_nt, 0), du_co_nt0 = ISNULL(b.du_co_nt, 0)
				FROM #bal_acct a LEFT JOIN #bal_acct0 b ON a.tk = b.tk

			DELETE #bal_cust
			INSERT INTO #bal_cust EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dE2, @Unit, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''
		END
	END -- End Adj Ex: Bg of FY

	SELECT * INTO #tCalc FROM #EdCusts WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #tCalc0 FROM #EdCusts WHERE 1 = 0

	SELECT @strSQLBalUpdate = 'declare @du_no numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @strSQLBalUpdate = @strSQLBalUpdate + CHAR(13) + '
		update #bal_table set @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end
			 where %condition%'

	--
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, tk, tk_du, ts_nv, cong_no, kind FROM #report WHERE Kind <> '0' AND ngoai_bang = 0 and tk <> ''
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @tk, @tk_du, @ts_nv, @cong_no, @kind
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @tien0 = 0, @tien = 0, @tien_nt0 = 0, @tien_nt = 0

		IF @kind = 2 BEGIN
			--TT 200 Begin
			IF @ts_nv = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps_no), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt) FROM #gl2 WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' AND tk_du LIKE RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%'
				SELECT @tien0 = SUM(ps_no), @tien_nt0 = SUM(ps_no_nt) FROM #gl0 WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' AND tk_du LIKE RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%'
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps_co), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #gl2 WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' AND tk_du LIKE RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%'
				SELECT @tien0 = SUM(ps_co), @tien_nt0 = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #gl0 WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' AND tk_du LIKE RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%'
			END
			--TT 200 End
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cong_no = 1 BEGIN
				DELETE #tCalc
				DELETE #tCalc0

				INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0 FROM #bal_cust WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
				INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT '', ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh

				IF NOT (@m_cn_dn = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE2)) BEGIN
					SET @strSQL = @strSQLBalUpdate
					SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '#bal_table', '#tCalc')
					SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%condition%', '1 = 1')
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
				END

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #tCalc
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc
				--

				DELETE #tCalc
				DELETE #tCalc0
				INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #EdCusts WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
				INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT '', ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh

				SET @strSQL = @strSQLBalUpdate
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '#bal_table', '#tCalc')
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%condition%', '1 = 1')
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #tCalc
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @ts_nv = 1 BEGIN
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_no0 - du_co0), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_no_nt0 - du_co_nt0) FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no - du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
							UNION ALL
							SELECT ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt FROM #gl WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
						) a
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_co0 - du_no0), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_co_nt0 - du_no_nt0) FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co - du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
							UNION ALL
							SELECT ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt FROM #gl WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
						) a
				END
			END
		END
		UPDATE #report SET tien0 = @tien0, tien = @tien, tien_nt0 = @tien_nt0, tien_nt = @tien_nt WHERE ma_so = @ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @tk, @tk_du, @ts_nv, @cong_no, @kind
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET tien0 = CASE WHEN tien0 IS NULL OR (tien0 < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien0 END
		, tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien END
		, tien_nt0 = CASE WHEN tien_nt0 IS NULL OR (tien_nt0 < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt0 END
		, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien_nt FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
		SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	IF @Check = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @m_mau_so_ts = ma_so FROM #report WHERE form = @Form AND ts_nv = 1 AND ct_tong = 1
		SELECT @m_mau_so_nv = ma_so FROM #report WHERE form = @Form AND ts_nv = 2 AND ct_tong = 1
		IF @m_mau_so_ts <> '' AND @m_mau_so_nv <> '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @ts TABLE(ma_so VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
			DECLARE @nv TABLE(ma_so VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
			DECLARE @compare TABLE(ma_so_ts VARCHAR(32), ma_so_nv VARCHAR(32), tien BIT, tien_nt BIT, tien0 BIT, tien_nt0 BIT)

			INSERT INTO @ts(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_ts
			INSERT INTO @nv(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_nv
			INSERT INTO @compare SELECT a.ma_so, b.ma_so,
					CASE WHEN a.tien <> b.tien THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt <> b.tien_nt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien0 <> b.tien0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt0 <> b.tien_nt0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				FROM @ts a, @nv b

			UPDATE #report SET flag = CASE WHEN b.tien <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END,
					ma_ss = CASE WHEN a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts THEN b.ma_so_nv ELSE b.ma_so_ts END
				FROM #report a JOIN @compare b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts OR a.ma_so = b.ma_so_nv
		END
	END
	SELECT @strSQL = 'select stt as sysorder, in_ck as sysprint, case when cach_tinh = '''' then 1 else 0 end as systotal,
			chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien, tien_nt0, tien0' + CASE WHEN @Check = 1 THEN ', flag, ma_ss' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from #report order by stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostImport$AfterAdjustmentInventory]
	@status CHAR(1),
	@datetime VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @roundQ TINYINT

	SELECT @roundQ = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE LOWER(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 YEAR(ngay_ct) AS nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, so_luong, tien, tien_nt INTO #detail FROM d37$000000

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select YEAR(ngay_ct) AS nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n from ' + CASE WHEN @status = '2' THEN 'indcsd2' ELSE 'indcsd' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC fs_Adjustment$UpdateCurrentStock 'insert', @status

	SELECT @q ='
UPDATE cdvt SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @datetime + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdvt a JOIN (SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt) b ON a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
INSERT INTO cdvt(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @datetime + ''', ''' + @datetime + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt b WHERE b.nam = a.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt

UPDATE cdvitri SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @datetime + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdvitri a JOIN (SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt) b ON a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
INSERT INTO cdvitri(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ''' + @datetime + ''', ''' + @datetime + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri b WHERE b.nam = a.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt

UPDATE cdlo SET ton00 = ton00 + b.so_luong, du00 = du00 + b.tien, du_nt00 = du_nt00 + b.tien_nt, datetime2 = ''' + @datetime + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + '
	FROM cdlo a JOIN (SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo) b ON a.nam = b.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
INSERT INTO cdlo(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)
	SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, ''' + @datetime + ''', ''' + @datetime + ''', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ',''1''
		FROM #detail a
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo b WHERE b.nam = a.nam AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
		GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
'

	IF @status = '1' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @status = '2' OR @status = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'cdvt', 'cdvt2'), 'cdvitri', 'cdvitri2'), 'cdlo', 'cdlo2')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory]
	@categoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@categoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@deptKey NVARCHAR(1023),
	@dataTable VARCHAR(64), 
	@dataDeptColumn VARCHAR(64), 
	@dataUpdateField NVARCHAR(1023) = '',
	@dataUpdateJoin NVARCHAR(1023) = '', 
	@dataUpdateWhere nvarchar(1023) = '', 
	@debug BIT = 0
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @pn_ref VARCHAR(511), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- 1. Category Map Table
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_loai, ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2 INTO #pn FROM hrpnbp
	IF @categoryCode = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #pn SELECT ma_loai, ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2 FROM hrpnbp WHERE ma_loai = @categoryType
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT pn_ref, bac_pn INTO #pnref FROM hrpnbp WHERE ma_loai = @categoryType AND ma_pn = @categoryCode
		INSERT INTO #pn SELECT a.ma_loai, a.ma_pn, a.pn_me, a.pn_ref, a.stt_ref, a.bac_pn, a.ten_pn, a.ten_pn2 FROM hrpnbp a JOIN #pnref b ON a.pn_ref LIKE b.pn_ref + '%'
	END
	
	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, b.ma_bp, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #pnct FROM #pn a, hrbp b
	SET @q = 'insert into #pnct(ma_loai, ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2, ma_bp) select a.*, d.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #pn a join hrkbpnbp c on a.ma_pn = c.ma_pn and a.ma_loai = c.ma_loai join hrbp b on c.ma_bp = b.ma_bp join hrbp d on d.bp_ref like b.bp_ref + ''%'''
	IF @deptKey <> '' SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @deptKey
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.stt_ref, a.ma_pn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	DELETE #pnct FROM #pnct a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pnct b WHERE a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND ((b.pn_ref like a.pn_ref + '%' AND b.bac_pn > a.bac_pn) OR (b.bac_pn = a.bac_pn AND b.id > a.id)))

	-- 2. Convert Department Table to Category Table
	SET @q = 'alter table ' + @dataTable + ' add pn_bp_yn bit null'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update ' + @dataTable + ' set ' + @dataDeptColumn + '=b.ma_pn,pn_bp_yn=1' + CASE WHEN @dataUpdateField <> '' THEN ',' + @dataUpdateField ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @dataTable + ' a join #pnct b on a.' + @dataDeptColumn + '=b.ma_bp' + CASE WHEN @dataUpdateJoin <> '' THEN ' ' + @dataUpdateJoin ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' where isnull(a.' + @dataDeptColumn + ','''') <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @dataUpdateWhere <> '' THEN ' and ' + @dataUpdateWhere ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @dataTable + ' where pn_bp_yn is null'

	IF @debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'alter table ' + @dataTable + ' drop column pn_bp_yn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO




CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFAExchange]	--fs20_FAExchange
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@FAType VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Units VARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)

--	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'status <> ''*'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @FAType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ts like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FAType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and year(a.ngay_mua) * 12 + month(a.ngay_mua) <= ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' * 12 + ' + RTRIM(@Month)

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, cast(0 as bit) as tag, a.* from dmts a'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
