select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup,
		so_lien, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk,	ong_ba,'
		+ CASE WHEN @Internal = 1 THEN 'case when ong_ba <> '''' then rtrim(ong_ba) else rtrim(ten_kh) end as ten_kh, case when ong_ba <> '''' then rtrim(ong_ba) else rtrim(ten_kh2) end as ten_kh2' ELSE 'ten_kh, ten_kh2' END + ',
		dia_chi, dien_giai, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, chuoi_ty_gia,'
		+ CASE WHEN @Internal = 1 THEN ''''' as so_ct_goc, '''' as dien_giai_ct_goc' ELSE 'so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc' END + ',
		t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, ngay, thang, nam, b.line_account' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
	from #m a join (select xgroup,count(tk) as line_account from #d group by xgroup) b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, a.xgroup'
	END

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Bilingual = '1' SELECT @Debit = @Debit + ':', @Credit = @Credit + ':', @Debit2 = @Debit2 + ':', @Credit2 = @Credit2 + ':'

	IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 2 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 2 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, a.xgroup, a.stt, a.tk'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
select convert(char(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + a.stt_rec as stt_rec, a.xgroup, a.tk, a.tien, a.tien_nt, case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit when 2 then @Credit else '''' end as dien_giai,
		case a.in_yn when 1 then @Debit2 when 2 then @Credit2 else '''' end as dien_giai2
	from #d a join #m b on a.xgroup = b.xgroup order by b.ngay_ct desc, b.so_ct desc, a.xgroup, a.stt, a.tk'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Debit nvarchar(128), @Credit nvarchar(128), @Debit2 nvarchar(128), @Credit2 nvarchar(128)', @Debit, @Credit, @Debit2, @Credit2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptProductCostByFactorGroup] --fs20_CoSpCp
	@Period1 NUMERIC(2), 
	@Year1 NUMERIC(4), 
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2), 
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4), 
	@Product VARCHAR(33), 
	@Department VARCHAR(33), 
	@MO VARCHAR(33), 
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT		
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @nh_yt VARCHAR(48),@h1 NVARCHAR(511), @h2 NVARCHAR(511), @Total NVARCHAR(511), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT020'
	SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT021'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	
	
	--Key
	SET @Key = '((a.nam*12 + a.ky) between (' + STR(@Year1*12 + @Period1) + ') and (' + STR(@Year2*12 + @Period2) + '))'
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, c.nh_yt, b.sl_tp, a.gt, a.gt_nt, c.ma_yt INTO #report1 FROM xcdytdd a LEFT JOIN xdmyt c ON a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt, xcdspdd b ORDER BY 1 
	SET @q = 'insert into #report1 select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp as ma_sp, max(a.ma_bp) as ma_bp, max(a.so_lsx) AS so_lsx, isnull(c.nh_yt, '''') AS nh_yt '
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(b.sl_tp) as sl_tp, sum(a.gt) as gt, sum(a.gt_nt) as gt_nt, isnull(c.ma_yt, '''') as ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdytdd a left join xcdspdd b on a.ky = b.ky and a.nam = b.nam'
	SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join xdmyt c on a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt and a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + ' where' + @Key 
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, c.nh_yt, c.ma_yt' 
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report1 SET gt = - gt, gt_nt = - gt_nt WHERE ma_yt IN (SELECT ma_yt FROM xdmyt WHERE cong_tru = '2')

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.nh_yt
			, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS ten_nh_yt, AVG(a.sl_tp) AS sl_tp, SUM(a.gt) AS gt, SUM(a.gt_nt) AS gt_nt
			, RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + RTRIM(a.ma_sp) + RTRIM(a.ma_bp) + LTRIM(a.so_lsx) AS xPivot, MAX(b.ten_ngan) AS ten_nh, MAX(b.ten_ngan2) AS ten_nh2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_sp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE MAX(c.ten_vt2) END AS ten_sp2
		INTO #report 
		FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN xdmnhyt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.nh_yt = b.ma_nh LEFT JOIN dmvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_sp = c.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_bp, a.nh_yt

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_tp INTO #xsltp FROM xctgtsp
	SET @q = 'insert into #xsltp select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, SUM(a.sl_tp) AS sl_tp'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctgtsp a where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx' 
	EXEC sp_executesql @q 

	UPDATE #report SET sl_tp = b.sl_tp FROM #report a JOIN #xsltp b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx	
	DELETE #report WHERE sl_tp IS NULL OR sl_tp = 0

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_lsx, ma_bp, ma_sp', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q		

	-- Cost
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 1, 1, 0, MAX(ma_dvcs), MAX(ma_sp), MAX(ma_bp), MAX(so_lsx), 'zzzzSUM1', @h1, AVG(sl_tp), SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt), xPivot, @h1, @h1, MAX(ten_sp), MAX(ten_sp2) FROM #report GROUP BY xPivot
	
	-- Z
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 1, 1, 0, MAX(ma_dvcs), MAX(ma_sp), MAX(ma_bp), MAX(so_lsx), 'zzzzSUM2', @h2, AVG(sl_tp)
			, CASE WHEN AVG(sl_tp) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(gt)/AVG(sl_tp), 2) END, CASE WHEN AVG(sl_tp) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(gt_nt)/AVG(sl_tp), 4) END, xPivot, @h2, @h2, MAX(ten_sp), MAX(ten_sp2)
		FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY xPivot

	UPDATE #report SET sl_tp = b.sl_tp
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT xPivot, sl_tp FROM #report WHERE sl_tp <> 0) b ON a.xPivot = b.xPivot
		WHERE a.sl_tp = 0
	DELETE FROM #report WHERE xPivot IS NULL

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #stt(id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, xPivot VARCHAR(511))
	INSERT INTO #stt(xPivot) SELECT DISTINCT(xPivot) FROM #report ORDER BY xPivot
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.xPivot = b.xPivot
	DROP TABLE #stt
	
	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 1, 0, 0, NULL, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', nh_yt, NULL, SUM(sl_tp), SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt), 'zzzTOTAL', MAX(ten_nh), MAX(ten_nh2), @Total, @Total
			FROM #report GROUP BY nh_yt
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 6, 1, 0, NULL, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', nh_yt, NULL, SUM(sl_tp), SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt), 'zzzzzTOTAL', MAX(ten_nh), MAX(ten_nh2), @Total, @Total
			FROM #report WHERE sysorder <> 1 GROUP BY nh_yt
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, NULL, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', nh_yt, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 'zzzzTOTAL', '', '', '', '' FROM #report GROUP BY nh_yt
	
	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, NULL, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', '', 0, 0, 0, '', @Total, @Total, '', ''

	-- View
	SELECT a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.sysorder, a.stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.nh_yt AS sysColumn, a.xPivot, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.sl_tp, a.ten_sp, a.ten_sp2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN iSNULL(a.ten_nh, '') ELSE '' END AS sysColumnName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE ISNULL(a.ten_nh2, '') END AS sysColumnName2
		FROM #report a ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.ma_dvcs, a.xPivot, a.nh_yt

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot(name, header)
		SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'gt$' ELSE 'gt_nt$' END, ISNULL(MAX(ten_nh_yt), ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_ngan) ELSE MAX(b.ten_ngan2) END, ''))
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN xdmnhyt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.nh_yt = b.ma_nh GROUP BY a.nh_yt ORDER BY a.nh_yt
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id)
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReplaceInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @r VARCHAR(32), @tinh_trang_hddt CHAR(1), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @VoucherIDReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDateReplace SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherNo VARCHAR(32), @VoucherNoReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherUnit VARCHAR(32), @provider INT

	SELECT @q = '', @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	-- Check idNumber access

	--
	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @q = 'select @VoucherIDReplace = stt_rec_hd_goc, @VoucherNo = so_ct from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherIDReplace varchar(32) output, @VoucherNo varchar(32) output', @VoucherIDReplace OUTPUT, @VoucherNo OUTPUT

	SELECT @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct, @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct, @refp = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherIDReplace


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Modify Date
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = so_ct from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Lock Date of Original Voucher
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @VoucherDateReplace, @UserID, @Unit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Replacement Voucher
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @x = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x char(1) output', @x = @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

	IF (@tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '0') BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END
	--
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @x = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hrm01$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherIDReplace + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x char(1) output', @x = @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

	IF @tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '2' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 6 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END


	--
	SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, ngay_ph = getdate(), nguoi_ph = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--


	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBalanceSheetForInvestors] --fs30_BalanceSheetDT--
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@PrintType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Check BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Giong stored rs_rptBalanceSheet; chi khac bang mau
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dE1 SMALLDATETIME, @dE2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @yE INT, @yN INT, @yB INT, @y INT
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @tk VARCHAR(32), @ts_nv TINYINT, @cong_no TINYINT, @cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @m_cn_dn CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @strSQLBalUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @m_mau_so_ts VARCHAR(32), @m_mau_so_nv VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateTo), @dE2 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateTo)
	SELECT @yE = YEAR(@dE2), @yN = YEAR(@DateTo), @dE1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dE2)
	SELECT @yB = nam_bd FROM dmstt
	SET @y = CASE WHEN @yN = @yB THEN @yN ELSE @yE END
	SELECT @m_cn_dn = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cn_dn'

	-- Struct
	SELECT CAST( '2' AS CHAR(1)) AS kieu_in, *, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(8)) AS flag, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ss INTO #report FROM v20gltcdt WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #glTmp FROM #gl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_cust FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_acct FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #EdCusts FROM wrkgl

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_cust'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_kh, sum(du_no1) as du_no0, sum(du_co1) as du_co0, sum(du_no_nt1) as du_no_nt0, sum(du_co_nt1) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh with (index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by tk, ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, sum(case when nam = @yn then du_no00 else 0 end) as du_no'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_co00 else 0 end) as du_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_no_nt00 else 0 end) as du_no_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yn then du_co_nt00 else 0 end) as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_no1 else 0 end) as du_no0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_co1 else 0 end) as du_co0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_no_nt1 else 0 end) as du_no_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @y then du_co_nt1 else 0 end) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + '	from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam))	where (nam = @yn or nam= @ye)' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by tk'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@yn', RTRIM(@yn)), '@ye', RTRIM(@ye)), '@y', RTRIM(@y))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #EdCusts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateTo, @Unit, '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''

	-- Lay so lieu tu r00
	DECLARE @y1 INT, @y2 INT, @p1 INT, @p2 INT, @DateStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd2 SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y1 = y1, @p1 = p1, @y2 = y2, @p2 = p2, @DateStart1 = dStart1, @DateEnd1 = dEnd1, @DateStart2 = dStart2, @DateEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	IF @y1 + @p1 + @y2 + @p2 <> 0
		SELECT @DateStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @DateEnd = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
	ELSE
		SELECT @DateStart = NULL, @DateEnd = NULL

	SET @q = 'insert into #glTmp select tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt from pstk$%Partition with (nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #glTmp select tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart1, @DateEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart2, @DateEnd2, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #gl SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #glTmp GROUP BY tk
	--

	IF @m_cn_dn = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE2) BEGIN
		DELETE #bal_cust
		INSERT INTO #bal_cust SELECT tk, '', du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0 FROM #bal_acct
	END

	-- Adj Ex: Bg of FY
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DAY(ngay_dn) = DAY(ngay_dn2) AND MONTH(ngay_dn) = MONTH(ngay_dn2))
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) <= @dE2)
				BEGIN
					-- Struct
					SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #bal_acct0 FROM wrkgl
					SELECT * INTO #bal_acct0Tmp FROM #bal_acct0

					DECLARE @dE2Tmp AS SMALLDATETIME
					SELECT @dE2Tmp = DATEADD(day, -1, @dE2)

					SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct0Tmp select tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
					SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by tk'
					EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dE1, @dE2Tmp, @UserID, @Admin

					SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct0Tmp select tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
					SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk where nam = ' + RTRIM(@yE) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by tk'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					INSERT INTO #bal_acct0 SELECT tk, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #bal_acct0Tmp GROUP BY tk

					DECLARE @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
					UPDATE #bal_acct0 SET @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
						, du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END
						, du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

					INSERT INTO #bal_acct(tk, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0)
						SELECT tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
							FROM #bal_acct0
							WHERE tk NOT IN (SELECT tk FROM #bal_acct)

					UPDATE #bal_acct SET du_no0 = ISNULL(b.du_no, 0), du_co0 = ISNULL(b.du_co, 0), du_no_nt0 = ISNULL(b.du_no_nt, 0), du_co_nt0 = ISNULL(b.du_co_nt, 0)
						FROM #bal_acct a LEFT JOIN #bal_acct0 b ON a.tk = b.tk

					DELETE #bal_cust
					INSERT INTO #bal_cust EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dE2, @Unit, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''
				END
		END -- End Adj Ex: Bg of FY

	SELECT * INTO #tCalc FROM #EdCusts WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #tCalc0 FROM #EdCusts WHERE 1 = 0

	SELECT @strSQLBalUpdate = 'declare @du_no numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @strSQLBalUpdate = @strSQLBalUpdate + CHAR(13) + '
		update #bal_table set @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end
			 where %condition%'

	--
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, tk, ts_nv, cong_no FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh = '' AND ngoai_bang = 0
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @tien0 = 0, @tien = 0, @tien_nt0 = 0, @tien_nt = 0

		IF @cong_no = 1
			BEGIN
				DELETE #tCalc
				DELETE #tCalc0
				INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no0, du_co0, du_no_nt0, du_co_nt0 FROM #bal_cust WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'

				INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT '', ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh

				IF NOT (@m_cn_dn = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) > @dE2)) BEGIN
					SET @strSQL = @strSQLBalUpdate
					SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '#bal_table', '#tCalc')
					SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%condition%', '1 = 1')
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
				END

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #tCalc
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc
				--

				DELETE #tCalc
				DELETE #tCalc0
				INSERT INTO #tCalc0 SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #EdCusts WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
				INSERT INTO #tCalc SELECT '', ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc0 GROUP BY ma_kh

				SET @strSQL = @strSQLBalUpdate
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '#bal_table', '#tCalc')
				SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%condition%', '1 = 1')
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #tCalc
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @ts_nv = 1
					BEGIN
						SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_no0 - du_co0), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_no_nt0 - du_co_nt0) FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
						SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no - du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt)
							FROM (
								SELECT du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt FROM #gl WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
							) a
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @tien0 = SUM(du_co0 - du_no0), @tien_nt0 = SUM(du_co_nt0 - du_no_nt0) FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
						SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co - du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt)
							FROM (
								SELECT du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #bal_acct WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
								UNION ALL
								SELECT ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt FROM #gl WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
							) a
					END
			END

		UPDATE #report SET tien0 = @tien0, tien = @tien, tien_nt0 = @tien_nt0, tien_nt = @tien_nt WHERE ma_so = @ma_so
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET tien0 = CASE WHEN tien0 IS NULL OR (tien0 < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien0 END
		, tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien END
		, tien_nt0 = CASE WHEN tien_nt0 IS NULL OR (tien_nt0 < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt0 END
		, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(tien0) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(tien) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt0 = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(tien_nt0) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(tien_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	IF @Check = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @m_mau_so_ts = ma_so FROM #report WHERE form = @Form AND ts_nv = 1 AND ct_tong = 1
		SELECT @m_mau_so_nv = ma_so FROM #report WHERE form = @Form AND ts_nv = 2 AND ct_tong = 1
		IF @m_mau_so_ts <> '' AND @m_mau_so_nv <> '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @ts TABLE(ma_so VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
			DECLARE @nv TABLE(ma_so VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
			DECLARE @compare TABLE(ma_so_ts VARCHAR(32), ma_so_nv VARCHAR(32), tien BIT, tien_nt BIT, tien0 BIT, tien_nt0 BIT)

			INSERT INTO @ts(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_ts
			INSERT INTO @nv(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_nv
			INSERT INTO @compare SELECT a.ma_so, b.ma_so,
					CASE WHEN a.tien <> b.tien THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt <> b.tien_nt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien0 <> b.tien0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt0 <> b.tien_nt0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				FROM @ts a, @nv b

			UPDATE #report SET flag = CASE WHEN b.tien <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END,
					ma_ss = CASE WHEN a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts THEN b.ma_so_nv ELSE b.ma_so_ts END
				FROM #report a JOIN @compare b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts OR a.ma_so = b.ma_so_nv
		END
	END

	-- Xử lý để dùng cho mẫu Excel
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @breakRow INT
		SELECT @breakRow = COUNT(1) + 2 FROM V20GLTCDT WHERE form = @Form AND ts_nv = 1 AND in_ck = 1 AND ngoai_bang = 0
		IF @breakRow IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET ROWCOUNT @breakRow
			UPDATE #report SET kieu_in = 1
			SET ROWCOUNT 0
		END
	END

	SELECT @strSQL = 'select kieu_in, stt as sysorder, in_ck as sysprint, case when cach_tinh = '''' then 1 else 0 end as systotal,'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'chi_tieu' ELSE '''''' END + ' as chi_tieu, '
							 + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'chi_tieu2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as chi_tieu2, '
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + 'ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien, tien_nt0, tien0' + CASE WHEN @Check = 1 THEN ', flag, ma_ss' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from #report order by stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_ConvertItems2NextYear2]
	@nYear INT,
	@Join NVARCHAR(512),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + ''''

	SELECT @q = 'delete cdvt2 from cdvt2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 into #cdvt from cdvt2 z with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = @nYear) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #cdvt select ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdvt a with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + REPLACE(@Join, 'z.ma_kho', 'a.ma_kho') + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and not exists(select 1 from #cdvt b where b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)'
	END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdvt2(nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from #cdvt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70x group by ma_kho, ma_vt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj2 group by ma_kho, ma_vt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdvt2 from cdvt2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT @q = 'delete cdvitri2 from cdvitri2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 into #cdvitri from cdvitri2 z with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = @nYear) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #cdvitri select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdvitri a with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + REPLACE(@Join, 'z.ma_kho', 'a.ma_kho') + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and not exists(select 1 from #cdvitri b where b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)'
	END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdvitri2(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from #cdvitri'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70x group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj2 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdvitri2 from cdvitri2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT @q = 'delete cdlo2 from cdlo2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00 into #cdlo from cdlo2 z with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE nam_bd = @nYear) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_0onvoucher' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #cdlo select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cdlo a with(nolock, index(nam)) ' + REPLACE(@Join, 'z.ma_kho', 'a.ma_kho') + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and not exists(select 1 from #cdlo b where b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt and a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)'
	END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdlo2(nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(ton00), sum(du00), sum(du_nt00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00 from #cdlo'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #ct70x group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #adj2 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ') a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) > 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdlo2 from cdlo2 z' + @Join + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) + abs(du00) + abs(du_nt00) = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMEmployeeSummary]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @step = 0
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'd', 'd', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'd.')
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'd.')

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.stt_rec_nv, d.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv
			, a.ngay_dg, a.t_diem_nv_dg, a.t_diem_ql_dg, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, b.stt_ref, b.bac_bp, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_bp, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_vtr, c.stt AS stt_vtr
		INTO #report FROM hrdgth a, hrnv d, hrbp b, hrvt c	

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.stt_rec_nv, d.ma_nv, rtrim(d.ho_nv) + space(1) + d.ten_nv as ho_ten_nv, a.ngay_dg, a.t_diem_nv_dg, a.t_diem_ql_dg, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, b.stt_ref, b.bac_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', b.ten_bp, c.ten_vtr' ELSE ', b.ten_bp2, c.ten_vtr2' END + ', c.stt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrdgth a with(nolock) join hrnv d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = d.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on d.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c with(nolock) on d.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Get detail Information
	UPDATE #report SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, stt_ref = e.stt_ref, bac_bp = e.bac_bp, ten_bp = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_bp ELSE e.ten_bp2 END
			, vi_tri = b.vi_tri, stt_vtr = f.stt, ten_vtr = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN f.ten_vtr ELSE f.ten_vtr2 END
		FROM #report a JOIN hreqtlvht b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec AND b.tinh_chat = '1'
				AND b.ngay_tu = (SELECT MAX(c.ngay_tu) FROM hreqtlvht c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_nv AND c.ngay_tu <= a.ngay_dg)
			LEFT JOIN hrbp e ON b.bo_phan = e.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt f ON b.vi_tri = f.ma_vtr

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000), @updateStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @DeptKey = REPLACE(@Filter, 'd.', 'b.'), @updateStatement = 'stt_ref = b.stt_ref, ten_bp = b.ten_pn, bac_bp = b.bac_pn' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#report', 'bo_phan', @updateStatement
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, bo_phan, ma_nv INTO #o FROM #report ORDER BY stt_ref, stt_vtr, vi_tri, ma_nv
	SELECT bo_phan, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY bo_phan ORDER BY bo_phan
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv JOIN #g c ON a.bo_phan = c.bo_phan

	-- Parent Dept.
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct a.bo_phan, b.bp_me from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = max(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0) - 1
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct d.ma_bp, d.bp_me from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp d on r.bp_me = d.ma_bp where (d.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN CASE WHEN @Filter <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Filter ELSE '' END ELSE '' END 
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 3, 1, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', null, 0, 0, a.bo_phan, '''', b.stt_ref, b.bac_bp, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ', '''', 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- View
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	--
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_rec_nv, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, t_diem_nv_dg, t_diem_ql_dg
			, ten_vtr, SPACE(2 * (bac_bp - @step)) + ten_bp AS ten_bp, stt_ref AS bp_ref
		FROM #report ORDER BY stt_ref, stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodFixedAssetDepreciation] --fs20_FADepreciationReport--
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType VARCHAR(32),
	@FaDept VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@ReportForm VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @GroupFields VARCHAR(254), @RowFields VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(1024), @s2 NVARCHAR(1024), @s3 NVARCHAR(1024), @s4 NVARCHAR(1024), @s5 NVARCHAR(1024), @s6 NVARCHAR(1024), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT015'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT016'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT095'
	SELECT @s4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT096'
	SELECT @s5 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT004'
	SELECT @s6 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT005'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	SELECT @GroupFields = CASE @Group WHEN '1' THEN 'loai_ts' WHEN '2' THEN 'fa_ma_bp' WHEN '3' THEN 'fa_ma_bp,loai_ts' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @RowFields = CASE @Group WHEN '1' THEN 'isnull(loai_ts, '' '')' WHEN '2' THEN 'isnull(fa_ma_bp, '' '')' WHEN '3' THEN 'isnull(fa_ma_bp, '' '') + isnull(loai_ts, '' '')' ELSE ''' ''' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp AS fa_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, a.ky, a.nam INTO #report FROM ctkhts a JOIN dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '(a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between (' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ') and (' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2) + ')'
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%' + ''''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Key = ' where ' + @Key

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as syprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, a.ky, a.nam'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhts a join dmts c on a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_kh0 > dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))
	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (
								SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK)
									WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
										AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year))
								)
	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND gt_kh_ky_nt = 0
	IF @ReportForm = '20'
		DELETE #report WHERE nguyen_gia_nt = 0 AND gt_kh_ky_nt = 0
	ELSE
		DELETE #report WHERE nguyen_gia = 0 AND gt_kh_ky = 0

	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysColumn VARCHAR(32) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysColumnName NVARCHAR(32) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysRow VARCHAR(128) NULL

	EXECUTE('update #report set sysColumn = replace(str(nam, 4),'' '', ''0'') + replace(str(ky, 2),'' '', ''0''), sysColumnName = replace(str(ky, 2),'' '', ''0'') +''/'' + replace(str(nam, 4),'' '', ''0'')')

	-- Tổng khấu hao
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 9 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, min(stt) as stt, so_the_ts, max(fa_ma_bp) as fa_ma_bp, 0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt, max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ') as ten_ts, max(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END + ') as ten_ts2, max(so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0, max(loai_ts) as loai_ts, max(ky), max(nam), ''1'' AS sysColumn, N''' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN @s3 ELSE @s4 END + ''' AS sysColumnName, max(sysRow) AS sysRow'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @GroupFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @GroupFields
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Nguyên giá
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 9 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, min(stt) as stt, so_the_ts, max(fa_ma_bp) as fa_ma_bp,0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' 0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt, max(ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0, max(loai_ts) as loai_ts, max(ky), max(nam), ''0'' as sysColumn, N''' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN @s5 ELSE @s6 END + ''' AS sysColumnName, max(sysRow) AS sysRow'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @GroupFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @GroupFields
	SELECT @q = @q + ' update #report set gt_kh_ky_nt = b.t_nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky = b.t_nguyen_gia from #report a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.sysorder = 9 and sysColumn = ''0'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @GroupFields <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ky, nam, fa_ma_bp, so_the_ts, stt', 'INT, INT, VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32), INT')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('sysColumn, ' + @GroupFields, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 2
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set sysRow = ' + @RowFields + ' + isnull(so_the_ts, '' '')'
		SELECT @q = @q + 'update #report set sysColumnName = b.sysColumnName from #report a join(select distinct sysColumn, sysColumnName from #report where systotal = 1) b on a.sysColumn = b.sysColumn where a.systotal = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Stt
		SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xGroup INTO #xGroup FROM #report
		EXECUTE('insert into #xGroup (so_the_ts, xGroup) select so_the_ts, ' + @RowFields + ' from #report')
		SELECT so_the_ts, xGroup AS sysRow, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS id INTO #order FROM #xGroup GROUP BY xGroup, so_the_ts

		SELECT sysRow, MAX(stt) as stt into #xorder from #order WHERE so_the_ts IS NULL group by sysRow
		UPDATE #order SET id = a.stt - b.stt FROM #order a join #xorder b on a.sysRow = b.sysRow

		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, MIN(id) AS stt FROM #order GROUP BY so_the_ts)b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set sysRow = so_the_ts where systotal = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #o FROM #report
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #o (so_the_ts) select distinct so_the_ts from #report ' + CASE WHEN @Order <> '' THEN 'order by ' + REPLACE(@Order, '''', '''''') ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	END

	-- Total
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, fa_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, ky, nam, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 0, 1, 0, 0, char(160), '''', null, null, sum(gt_kh_ky), sum(gt_kh_ky_nt), N''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @Total ELSE '' END + ''', N'''+ CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE @Total END + ''', null, null, null, 0, 0, sysColumn, max(sysColumnName), char(9)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report where systotal = 1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = 5 WHERE sysorder <> 0
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ten_ts, ten_ts2, fa_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts, ky, nam, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 1, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, 0, 0, null, null, null, 0, 0, sysColumn, '''', char(10)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report where systotal = 1 group by sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, name NVARCHAR(128) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (name, header) SELECT DISTINCT sysColumn, MAX(sysColumnName) FROM #report GROUP BY sysColumn ORDER BY sysColumn

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = '10' INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_kh_ky$', ' - ' + @s1
	IF @ReportForm = '20' INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_kh_ky_nt$', ' - ' + @s2

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), RTRIM(a.header) FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	SELECT @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, isnull(stt, 0) as stt, isnull(so_the_ts, char(160)) as so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt,' +
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts,' +
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END + ' as ten_ts2' +
		', isnull(so_ky_kh, 0) as so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow from #report order by sysRow, sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_GetEmployeeAnnualLeave]
	@EmployeeIDTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@EmployeeWhere NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @delta INT, @leaveYear NUMERIC(28, 6), @leaveMonth NUMERIC(28, 6), @workingDay VARCHAR(32), @workingHours NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @dateBegin SMALLDATETIME, @dateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @dStrTo CHAR(10), @dStrBegin CHAR(10), @dStrEnd CHAR(10), @year NUMERIC(4, 0), @month INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ref VARCHAR(512), @e CHAR(2), @p SMALLDATETIME, @max INT, @c VARCHAR(512), @l NUMERIC(28, 6), @i INT
	DECLARE @RangeFrom VARCHAR(6), @RangeTo VARCHAR(6)

	SELECT @RangeFrom = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112), @RangeTo = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh2, 112) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @delta = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_nam_tham_nien'
	SELECT @leaveYear = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_nam'
	SELECT @leaveMonth = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_thang'
	SELECT @workingHours = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_gio'
	SELECT @workingDay = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_cong'

	SELECT @month = MONTH(@DateTo), @year = YEAR(@DateTo), @dateBegin = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, STR(@Year, 4) + '0101', 112), @dateEnd = DATEADD(MM, 12, @dateBegin) - 1, @e = RTRIM(DAY(CAST(RTRIM(@year) + '0301' AS SMALLDATETIME) - 1)),
		@dStrTo = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + '''', @dStrBegin = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateBegin, 112) + '''', @dStrEnd = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateEnd, 112) + ''''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #tphepnam(stt_rec CHAR(13), tham_nien FLOAT, phep_dn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_hh NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_tn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_th NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_gh SMALLDATETIME, ref VARCHAR(512))

	-- Process
	SET @q = 'insert into #tphepnam(stt_rec, tham_nien, phep_dn, phep_hh, phep_tn, phep_th, ref)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select r.stt_rec, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(r.ngay_vao, ' + @dStrTo + '), 0, 0, 0, 0, r.bp_ref from hrnv r with(nolock) join ' + @EmployeeIDTable + ' a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	IF @EmployeeWhere <> '' SET @q = @q + ' where (' + @EmployeeWhere + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_tn = CASE WHEN @delta = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(tham_nien / @delta) END + CASE WHEN tham_nien > 1 THEN @leaveYear ELSE @leaveMonth * ROUND(tham_nien * 12, 0) END
	
	-- Department
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.thang, a.ngay INTO #tp0 FROM hrghphep a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(nam_hl) AS nam_hl FROM hrghphep WHERE nam_hl <= @year GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.nam_hl = b.nam_hl
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.so_phep INTO #tp1 FROM hrphepbp a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrphepbp WHERE ngay_hl <= @DateTo GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
	SELECT DISTINCT ref INTO #tref FROM #tphepnam
	SELECT @ref = MIN(ref) FROM #tref
	WHILE @ref IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @p = NULL, @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #tp0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
		IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @p = CASE WHEN a.ngay = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@year) + REPLACE(STR(a.thang, 2), ' ', '0') + CASE WHEN a.thang = 2 AND a.ngay > 28 THEN @e ELSE REPLACE(STR(a.ngay, 2), ' ', '0') END) END
				FROM #tp0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
			UPDATE #tphepnam SET ngay_gh = @p WHERE ref = @ref
		END

		SELECT @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #tp1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
		IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @l = so_phep FROM #tp1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
			SELECT @l = ISNULL(@l, 0)
			UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_tn = phep_tn + @l WHERE ref = @ref
		END
		--
		SELECT @ref = MIN(ref) FROM #tref WHERE ref > @ref
	END

	SELECT @max = MAX(MONTH(ngay_gh)) FROM #tphepnam WHERE ngay_gh IS NOT NULL
	SELECT @max = ISNULL(@max, 0)

	-- Employee
	CREATE TABLE #tp2(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_phep FLOAT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #tp2 select a.stt_rec, a.so_phep from hrphepnv a join ('
	SET @q = @q + 'select r.stt_rec, max(r.ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from hrphepnv r join ' + @EmployeeIDTable + ' a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec where ngay_hl <= ' + @dStrTo + ' group by r.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ') z on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and a.ngay_hl = z.ngay_hl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_tn = phep_tn + b.so_phep FROM #tphepnam a JOIN #tp2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Delta
	TRUNCATE TABLE #tp2
	SET @q = 'insert into #tp2 select r.stt_rec, sum(r.so_phep) from hrphepps r join ' + @EmployeeIDTable + ' a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec where (r.ngay between ' + @dStrBegin + ' and ' + @dStrTo + ') group by r.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_tn = phep_tn + b.so_phep FROM #tphepnam a JOIN #tp2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_dn = b.so_phep, phep_th = b.da_nghi, phep_hh = CASE WHEN ngay_gh IS NOT NULL AND ngay_gh < @DateTo THEN b.da_nghi ELSE 0 END
		FROM #tphepnam a JOIN hrphepnam b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.nam = @year
	--
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @month BEGIN
		SELECT @c = STR(@year, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0')
		IF (@c BETWEEN @RangeFrom AND @RangeTo) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tp2
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #tp2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_ngay) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r join ' + @EmployeeIDTable + ' a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec where ' + CASE WHEN @i = @month THEN '(r.ngay between ' + @dStrBegin + ' and ' + @dStrTo + ') and ' ELSE '' END + 'r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@workingDay, '''', '''''') + ''' group by r.stt_rec'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_th = phep_th + b.so_phep FROM #tphepnam a JOIN #tp2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			--
			IF @i <= @max BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #tp2
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #tp2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_ngay) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r join #tphepnam t on r.stt_rec = t.stt_rec join ' + @EmployeeIDTable + ' a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where r.ngay <= t.ngay_gh and ' + CASE WHEN @i = @month THEN '(r.ngay between ' + @dStrBegin + ' and ' + @dStrTo + ') and ' ELSE '' END + 'r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@workingDay, '''', '''''') + ''' group by r.stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_hh = phep_hh + b.so_phep FROM #tphepnam a JOIN #tp2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			END
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Limit
	UPDATE #tphepnam SET phep_hh = CASE WHEN ngay_gh IS NOT NULL AND ngay_gh < @DateTo AND phep_dn > phep_hh THEN phep_dn - phep_hh ELSE 0 END

	-- Result
	SELECT stt_rec, tham_nien, phep_dn AS phep_dau_nam, phep_hh AS phep_het_han, phep_tn AS phep_trong_nam, phep_th AS phep_thuc_hien, phep_dn + phep_tn - phep_hh - phep_th AS phep_con_lai
		FROM #tphepnam

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$BIPO]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @RefTable VARCHAR(64)
	SET @RefTable = SUBSTRING(@masterTable, 2, 3)

	SELECT ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, loai_ct INTO #$master FROM m94$000000
	SET @s = 'insert into #$master select ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, loai_ct from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$master WHERE loai_ct = '9') RETURN

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ttmh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ngach, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_kh
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM d94$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, so_luong, he_so INTO #detailUpdate FROM d94$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = '
insert into #detailUpdate select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, a.so_luong, a.he_so
	from ' + @detailTable + ' a cross join #$master m join bim02$000000 b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung join bid02$000000 c on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and b.ma_bp0 = m.ma_bp0 and c.ma_kh = m.ma_kh and isnull(a.ngay_giao, m.ngay_ct) between b.ngay_hl_tu and b.ngay_hl_den'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, b.stt_rec_ngach, b.stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.he_so, '''', '''', '''', ''000000'', ''''
from ' + @detailTable + ' a left join #detailUpdate b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
	where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_hd <> '''' or a.stt_rec_ttmh <> '''' or a.stt_rec_nc <> '''' or a.stt_rec_kh <> '''' or b.stt_rec_ngach is not null)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c' + @RefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_ttmh = RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)) FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN bic10$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)) FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_kh <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_kh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c93$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_kh = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @cQAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineQAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ttmh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ngach VARCHAR(64), @dyn_kh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, dyn_hd, dyn_ttmh, dyn_nc, dyn_ngach, dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate
	CREATE TABLE #POEmployee (ma_nv VARCHAR(33))
	SET @s = 'insert into #POEmployee select ma_nv from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	DECLARE @POEmployee VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @POEmployee = ma_nv FROM #POEmployee
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bid10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_dat = sl_dat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bid10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET tien_dat = tien_dat + @nAmount WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bim10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET t_gt_dat_nt = t_gt_dat_nt + @nAmount WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET ma_nv = ''' + RTRIM(@POEmployee) + ''', sl_dh = sl_dh + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @RefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @RefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET t_gt_dh_nt = t_gt_dh_nt + @nAmount WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cQAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ngach <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' SET sl_th = a.sl_th + CASE WHEN m.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / m.he_so, 3) END FROM bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' a JOIN bim02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' m ON a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@nQty numeric(28, 6), @nAmount numeric(28, 6), @nRate numeric(24, 12)', @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_ttmh) AS dyn_ttmh, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc, MAX(dyn_kh) AS dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		
		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @RefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM bid10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bii10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status not in (''4'', ''5'', ''6'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM bii10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bic10$000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bim10$' + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET xstatus = ''5'' WHERE sl_dh > 0 AND stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh < sl_duyet)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PRStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PRStatus = status FROM i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c91$000000 SET status = @PRStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = @PRStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber,@cOAIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisCorrPeriods] --fs_FinancialAnalysis4MultiYear
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@periodCount INT,
	@reportType TINYINT, -- 1 - Chi tiet, 2 - Tong hop
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #t1 FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t1', @UserID, @Admin
	
	-- Giá trị
	INSERT INTO #t1 EXEC rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisTemplate @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, 0, @periodCount, @reportType, @Unit, @Form, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu cho đánh giá
	SELECT ma_so, cot, chu INTO #gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99
		WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearTo AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = @periodCount AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '02'
	IF @Language = 'V' UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '1'
		ELSE UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '2'

	DECLARE @PeriodName NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @PeriodName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'PERIOD'

	-- View
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(period, 3), ' ', '0') AS period, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN bold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dien_giai ELSE dien_giai2 END AS dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dvt ELSE dvt2 END AS dvt
			, danh_gia, ISNULL(gt, 0) AS gt, kind, ma_so, ma_so_in, RTRIM(@YearTo - period + 1) AS xCol --, @PeriodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(period) AS xCol
		FROM #t1 ORDER BY period, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	--SELECT period AS id, 'gt$' + RTRIM(period) AS name, @PeriodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(period) AS header FROM #t1 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
	SELECT period AS id, 'gt$' + RTRIM(period) AS name, RTRIM(@YearTo - period + 1) AS header FROM #t1 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$InputInvoice$Declaration$Insert]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Norm CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''''''), @Norm = REPLACE(@Norm, '''', '''''')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + @VoucherCode + ''' '

	IF @Norm = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_so_thue INTO #dt FROM dmkh

		SET @q = 'insert into #dt select distinct b.ma_so_thue from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where %[' + @Key + ' and isnull(b.ma_so_thue, '''') <> '''' and b.ma_so_thue not in (select ma_so_thue from #dt) and b.ma_so_thue not in (select gia_tri from dmcthddv where chi_tieu = ''1'')]%'
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @check BIT, @mst NVARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @i = 1
		SELECT @n = COUNT(*) FROM #dt
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			SELECT @mst = ma_so_thue FROM #dt WHERE stt = @i
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$CheckTaxCode @mst, @check OUTPUT
			IF @check = 0 DELETE #dt WHERE stt = @i
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		DELETE #dt WHERE ma_so_thue in (SELECT gia_tri FROM dmcthddv)

		INSERT INTO dmcthddv (ma_ct, chi_tieu, gia_tri, ghi_chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2) SELECT @VoucherCode, @Norm, ma_so_thue, '', 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID FROM #dt
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIMaintainPurOrgData] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_loai, a.trong_so, a.ghi_chu, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_loai' + @cE + ' AS ten_loai'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bidmlctdg g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_loai = g.ma_loai'	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 3, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_loai, ten_loai, ghi_chu'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END
