CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CRPRunCalcRequirementCapacity] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ncRound TINYINT
	SELECT @ncRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #crhdcs FROM crhdcs

	-- Lay du lieu tu MPS
	SELECT a.ma_vt, so_dh, ngay_ct AS ngay_ht, sl_dh AS so_luong, a.nguon, b.ma_lo_trinh, ngay_dat
		INTO #mpctyc FROM mpctyc a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.nguon IN ('MO', 'FP', 'PL') AND sl_dh > 0 AND ngay_ct >= @dNow AND dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, ngay_ct) <= @nPeriodCount


	INSERT INTO #crhdcs
		(
			ma_vt, so_dh, nguon, ma_nl, loai_nl, ma_cd, ngay_ht, so_luong, cong_suat, ngay_bd
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
		)
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, a.nguon, d.ma_ccv, 'WC', d.ma_cd, a.ngay_ht, a.so_luong
				, CASE d.loai_cd
					WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN d.cach_tinh = 2 THEN ROUND(a.so_luong * ISNULL(d.nang_suat, 0), @nCRound) ELSE CASE WHEN d.nang_suat <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.so_luong/d.nang_suat, @nCRound) ELSE 0 END END + tg_cho + tg_cai_dat + tg_chuyen + tg_vs
					WHEN 2 THEN d.nang_suat + tg_cho + tg_cai_dat + tg_chuyen + tg_vs
					WHEN 3 THEN d.tg_gc
				END, a.ngay_dat
				, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #mpctyc a
				JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
				JOIN ctrt d ON d.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh

	DELETE #crhdcs WHERE cong_suat <= 0
	TRUNCATE TABLE crhdcs
	INSERT INTO crhdcs SELECT * FROM #crhdcs
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2Book]
	@year AS INT,
	@type AS VARCHAR(32),
	@dept AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@order VARCHAR(254),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc + STR(nam*12 + ky, 6) AS xkey INTO #tmp FROM ctcddc

	-- UnitKey
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'a.nam between ''' + STR(@year - 1, 4) + ''' and ''' + STR(@year, 4) + ''''
	IF @type <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@type, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @dept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@dept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
		, a.ng_giam, a.ng_giam_nt, a.cl_giam, a.cl_giam_nt
		INTO #t FROM ctcddc a

	SET @q = 'insert into #t(ky, nam, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, ng_giam, ng_giam_nt, cl_giam, cl_giam_nt)
			select a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia,
				a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, isnull(a.ng_giam, 0), a.ng_giam_nt, isnull(a.cl_giam, 0), a.cl_giam_nt
				from ctcddc a left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
				where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT MAX(ky) AS ky, ma_dc INTO #tP FROM #t WHERE nam = @year GROUP BY ma_dc
	SELECT MAX(ky) AS ky, ma_dc INTO #tP0 FROM #t WHERE nam = @year - 1 GROUP BY ma_dc

	SELECT ma_dc, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, SUM(gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(gt_da_pb_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt
			, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #tValue FROM #t
		WHERE nam = @year AND ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') FROM #tP)
		GROUP BY ma_dc

	SELECT ma_dc, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, SUM(gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(gt_da_pb_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt
			, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #tValue0 FROM #t
		WHERE nam = @year - 1 AND ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') FROM #tP0)
		GROUP BY ma_dc

	SELECT ma_dc, SUM(ng_giam) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(ng_giam_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, SUM(ng_giam) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(ng_giam_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt
			, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
			, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia
		INTO #curr FROM #t WHERE nam = @year GROUP BY ma_dc

	UPDATE #curr SET nguyen_gia = a.nguyen_gia + b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt + b.nguyen_gia_nt
		, gt_da_pb = a.gt_da_pb + b.gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt = a.gt_da_pb_nt + b.gt_da_pb_nt
		, gt_cl = ISNULL(b.gt_cl, 0), gt_cl_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_cl_nt, 0)
		FROM #curr a LEFT JOIN #tValue b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc

	SELECT ma_dc, SUM(ng_giam) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(ng_giam_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia
		INTO #prev FROM #t WHERE nam = @year - 1 GROUP BY ma_dc

	UPDATE #prev SET gt_da_pb = a.gt_da_pb + b.gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt = a.gt_da_pb_nt + b.gt_da_pb_nt
		FROM #prev a LEFT JOIN #tValue0 b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc

	SELECT ma_dc, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct INTO #t2 FROM gpbdc
		WHERE dbo.ff_BgYear(MONTH(ngay_ct), YEAR(ngay_ct)) = @year AND ma_bp_dc LIKE @dept + '%'
		GROUP BY ma_dc
	SELECT a.ma_dc, MAX(a.ngay_ct) AS ngay_giam, MAX(a.so_ct) AS so_ct_giam
			, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tg_ts) ELSE MAX(b.ten_tg_ts2) END AS ly_do_giam INTO #giam
		FROM gpbdc a LEFT JOIN dmtgcc b ON a.ma_ld_giam = b.ma_tg_ts
		WHERE (RTRIM(a.ma_dc) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112)) IN (SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_dc) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #t2)
			AND ma_bp_dc LIKE @dept + '%'
		GROUP BY a.ma_dc

	--
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_dc
			, b.ngay_tang, b.so_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.nuoc_sx, b.ngay_sd, b.so_hieu_dc
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, b.kieu_pb
			, CAST(ROUND(b.so_ky_pb / 12, 2) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_pb
			, a.nguyen_gia * 0 AS muc_pb, a.nguyen_gia_nt * 0 AS muc_pb_nt, c.gt_da_pb AS pb_dk, c.gt_da_pb_nt AS pb_dk_nt
			, ISNULL(a.gt_da_pb, 0) - ISNULL(c.gt_da_pb, 0) AS pb_ck, ISNULL(a.gt_da_pb_nt, 0) - ISNULL(c.gt_da_pb_nt, 0) AS pb_ck_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb AS pb_lk, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS pb_lk_nt
			, g.ngay_giam, g.so_ct_giam, g.ly_do_giam, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
			, b.loai_dc, b.ten_dc, b.ten_dc2
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
		INTO #report
		FROM #curr a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc LEFT JOIN #prev c ON a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc LEFT JOIN #giam g ON a.ma_dc = g.ma_dc

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_giam = NULL, so_ct_giam = '', ly_do_giam = '' WHERE YEAR(ngay_giam) <> @year

	DECLARE @nRound INT, @nRound_nt INT
	SELECT @nRound  = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nRound_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	UPDATE #report SET muc_pb = CASE WHEN tl_pb <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN kieu_pb = 0 THEN ROUND(nguyen_gia / tl_pb,@nRound) ELSE ROUND(nguyen_gia / 2,@nRound) END ELSE 0 END
		, muc_pb_nt = CASE WHEN tl_pb <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN kieu_pb = 0 THEN ROUND(nguyen_gia_nt / tl_pb, @nRound_nt) ELSE ROUND(nguyen_gia / 2,@nRound) END ELSE 0 END

	UPDATE #report SET muc_pb = nguyen_gia WHERE muc_pb > nguyen_gia
	UPDATE #report SET muc_pb_nt = nguyen_gia_nt WHERE muc_pb_nt > nguyen_gia_nt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ma_dc, stt', '#, INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@order, 'ma_dc')
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @o, '#report', 'stt', '', 1

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dc', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, pb_dk, pb_dk_nt, pb_ck, pb_ck_nt, pb_lk, pb_lk_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, muc_pb, muc_pb_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_tang, ma_dc, ten_dc, ten_dc2, nuoc_sx,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ngay_sd, so_hieu_dc, nguyen_gia_nt, tl_pb, muc_pb_nt, pb_dk_nt, pb_ck_nt, pb_lk_nt, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, pb_dk, muc_pb, pb_ck,'
	SET @q = @q + ' pb_lk, gt_cl, so_ct_giam, ngay_giam, ly_do_giam, ngay_ct, so_ct from #report order by sysorder ' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCorruptedTransactionVouchers] -- fs_VoucherValid
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Accounts NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @d SMALLDATETIME, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME, @k NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @m$ VARCHAR(128), @d$ VARCHAR(128), @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @ct00 TINYINT, @ct70 TINYINT, @ct90 TINYINT, @p00 TINYINT, @ctgt20 TINYINT, @ctgt30 TINYINT, @cttt20 TINYINT, @cttt30 TINYINT
	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'VCInfo30'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'VCInfo31'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tblMaster, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tblDetail, stt_rec, ma_ct, so_ct, ngay_ct, status
			, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct00, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct70, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS p00, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct90, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ctgt20, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ctgt30, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS cttt20, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS cttt30
			, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct00_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct70_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS p00_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ct90_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ctgt20_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ctgt30_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS cttt20_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS cttt30_yn
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	SELECT *, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai INTO #report FROM #tmp
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, status, loai_ct, ct00, ct70, p00, ct90, ctgt20, ctgt30, cttt20, cttt30 INTO #voucher FROM voucher

	-- Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin), @k = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_ct', 'exactinlist', @vouchercode)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey ELSE SET @Key = '1 = 1'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #voucher select distinct ma_ct, status, loai_ct, ct00, ct70, p00, ct90, ctgt20, ctgt30, cttt20, cttt30 from voucher where kt_yn = 1' + CASE WHEN @k IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @k ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT RTRIM(MAX(b.m$)) AS m$, RTRIM(MAX(b.d$)) AS d$,
			MAX(ct00) AS ct00, MAX(ct70) AS ct70, MAX(p00) AS p00, MAX(ct90) AS ct90, MAX(ctgt20) AS ctgt20, MAX(ctgt30) AS ctgt30, MAX(cttt20) AS cttt20, MAX(cttt30) AS cttt30,
			CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(MAX(b.m$)), 1) = '$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS id, a.ma_ct
		INTO #t0 FROM #voucher a JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		GROUP BY a.ma_ct

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, * INTO #t FROM #t0 WHERE m$ <> '' ORDER BY id

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #p00 FROM p00$000000
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE p00 = 1) INSERT INTO #p00 SELECT a.stt_rec FROM p00$000000 a JOIN #t0 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #p00 (stt_rec)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #cttt20 FROM cttt20
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE cttt20 = 1) INSERT INTO #cttt20 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM cttt20 a JOIN #t0 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #cttt20 (stt_rec)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #cttt30 FROM cttt30
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE cttt30 = 1) INSERT INTO #cttt30 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM cttt30 a JOIN #t0 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #cttt30 (stt_rec)


	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #t) BEGIN
		SELECT @m$ = m$, @d$ = d$, @ct00 = ct00, @ct70 = ct70, @p00 = p00, @ct90 = ct90, @ctgt20 = ctgt20, @ctgt30 = ctgt30, @cttt20 = cttt20, @cttt30 = cttt30 FROM #t WHERE stt = @i

		/*
			Bảng voucher: khai báo các ma_ct có post (giá trị 1) hoặc không post (giá trị 0) vào các bảng (ct00, ct70, ct90, p00, ctgt20, ctgt30, cttt20, cttt30)
		*/
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
			+ ' select ''' +  @m$ + ''', ''' + @d$ + ''''
			+ ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.status'
			+ ', c.ct00, c.ct70, c.p00, c.ct90, c.ctgt20, c.ctgt30, c.cttt20, c.cttt30'
			+ CASE WHEN @ct00 = 1 THEN ', case when e.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @ct70 = 1 THEN ', case when f.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @p00 = 1 THEN ', case when g.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @ct90 = 1 THEN ', case when k.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @ctgt20 = 1 THEN ', case when p.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @ctgt30 = 1 THEN ', case when q.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @cttt20 = 1 THEN ', case when y.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ CASE WHEN @cttt30 = 1 THEN ', case when z.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' ELSE ', 0' END
			+ ' from ' + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(@m$), 1) = '$' THEN RTRIM(@m$) + '%Partition' ELSE RTRIM(@m$) END + ' a with(nolock)'
			+ ' join #voucher c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct and a.status = c.status and (a.loai_ct = c.loai_ct or c.loai_ct = '''')'

		IF @ct00 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join (select distinct stt_rec from r00$%Partition) e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
		IF @ct70 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join (select distinct stt_rec from r70$%Partition) f on a.stt_rec = f.stt_rec'
		IF @p00 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join #p00 g with(index(stt_rec)) on a.stt_rec = g.stt_rec'
		IF @ct90 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join (select distinct stt_rec from r90$%Partition) k on a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec'
		IF @ctgt20 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join (select distinct stt_rec from r20$%Partition) p on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec'
		IF @ctgt30 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join (select distinct stt_rec from r30$%Partition) q on a.stt_rec = q.stt_rec'
		IF @cttt20 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join #cttt20 y with(index(stt_rec)) on a.stt_rec = y.stt_rec'
		IF @cttt30 = 1 SET @q = @q + ' left join #cttt30 z with(index(stt_rec)) on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[%Key%]%'
		-- IF RIGHT(RTRIM(@m$), 1) <> '$' SET @q = @q + ' and not exists(select 1 from #tmp x where a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec)'


		IF RIGHT(RTRIM(@m$), 1) = '$' BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Key%', @Key)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @d = @DateFrom
			WHILE @d <= @DateTo BEGIN
				SELECT @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@d), YEAR(@d)), @dEnd = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@d), YEAR(@d))
				IF @dStart < @DateFrom SET @dStart = @DateFrom
				IF @dEnd > @DateTo SET @dEnd = @DateTo

				SET @q2 = REPLACE(@q, '%Key%', @Key + ' and (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + ''')')
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin

				SET @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
			END
		END

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	IF @Type = '2' OR @Type = '*' BEGIN
		-- Kết chuyển sai: chứng từ không khai báo post nhưng các bảng post có dữ liệu
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT *, @s2 FROM #tmp
				WHERE status IS NULL AND (ct00_yn = 1 OR ct70_yn = 1 OR p00_yn = 1 OR ct90_yn = 1 OR ctgt20_yn = 1 OR ctgt30_yn = 1 OR cttt20_yn = 1 OR cttt30_yn = 1)

		DELETE #tmp WHERE status IS NULL

		-- Kết chuyển sai: chứng từ khai báo không post nhưng các bảng post có dữ liệu
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT *, @s2 FROM #tmp
				WHERE (ct00 = 0 AND ct00_yn = 1) OR (ct70 = 0 AND ct70_yn = 1) OR (p00 = 0 AND p00_yn = 1) OR (ct90 = 0 AND ct90_yn = 1) OR (ctgt20 = 0 AND ctgt20_yn = 1) OR (ctgt30 = 0 AND ctgt30_yn = 1) OR (cttt20 = 0 AND cttt20_yn = 1) OR (cttt30 = 0 AND cttt30_yn = 1)
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE status IS NULL

	IF @Type = '1' OR @Type = '*' BEGIN
		-- Xóa các chứng từ khử trùng, ko post ct00
		SELECT @Accounts = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, ' ', ''), '''', '''''') FROM options where name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'
		SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk INTO #tk FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Accounts, ',')

		SELECT DISTINCT tblMaster INTO #t1 FROM #tmp WHERE ma_ct IN ('HDA','HDF','HD1','HD2','HD3','PNA','PNB','PNC','PNG','PXC','PN1','PNE','PXD') AND ct00 = 1 AND ct00_yn = 0
		SELECT @m$ = MIN(tblMaster) FROM #t1
		WHILE @m$ IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #tmp set ct00_yn = 1 from #tmp a join '  + LEFT(@m$, 4) + CASE WHEN LEN(@m$) <> 4 THEN '000000' ELSE '%Partition' END + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where %[exists(select 1 from #tk c where b.tk like c.tk)]%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
			--
			SELECT @m$ = MIN(tblMaster) FROM #t1 WHERE tblMaster > @m$
		END
		DROP TABLE #t1
		-- Xóa các chứng từ nhập tk_vt = tk_du, ko post ct00
		DECLARE @s VARCHAR(1024), @pos INT
		SELECT DISTINCT tblMaster + ';' + tblDetail AS tbl INTO #t2 FROM #tmp WHERE ma_ct IN ('PND','PXA','PXB','PNF') AND ct00 = 1 AND ct00_yn = 0
		SELECT @s = MIN(tbl) FROM #t2
		WHILE @s IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @pos  = CHARINDEX(';', @s)
			SELECT @m$ = SUBSTRING(@s, 1, @pos - 1)
			SELECT @d$ = SUBSTRING(@s, @pos + 1, LEN(@s) - @pos)
			SET @q = 'update #tmp set ct00_yn = 1 from #tmp a join ' + LEFT(@m$, 4) + CASE WHEN LEN(@m$) <> 4 THEN '000000' ELSE '%Partition' END + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec in (select distinct stt_rec from ' + LEFT(@d$, 4) + CASE WHEN LEN(@d$) <> 4 THEN '000000' ELSE '%Partition' END + ' where tk_vt = tk_du and line_nbr = 1)]%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
			--
			SELECT @s = MIN(tbl) FROM #t2 WHERE tbl > @s
		END
		DROP TABLE #t2
		-- Không kết chuyển
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT *, @s1 FROM #tmp
				WHERE (ct00 = 1 AND ct00_yn = 0) OR (ct70 = 1 AND ct70_yn = 0) OR (p00 = 1 AND p00_yn = 0) OR (ct90 = 1 AND ct90_yn = 0) OR (ctgt20 = 1 AND ctgt20_yn = 0) OR (ctgt30 = 1 AND ctgt30_yn = 0) OR (cttt20 = 1 AND cttt20_yn = 0) OR (cttt30 = 1 AND cttt30_yn = 0)
	END

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_ct ELSE b.ten_ct2 END AS ten_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.dien_giai
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct ORDER BY a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	DROP TABLE #t, #t0, #tmp

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReplaceInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceID CHAR(13),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(32),
	@Serial VARCHAR(32),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@Resign BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @InvoiceID = REPLACE(@InvoiceID, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @ref VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @r NVARCHAR(512), @updateFlow BIT

	IF CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct1, 112), @ref = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct0, 112), @updateFlow = cn_qui_trinh FROM hddt05 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID AND stt_rec0 = @InvoiceID

	--
	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	IF @ResultProcess = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END
	--

	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoice @InvoiceID, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	SELECT @r = ' set so_ct0 = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''';'

	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', so_seri_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@Serial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_ct_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = '''  + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + '''  where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @ref + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 4, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ct00' + @r + 'update ct70' + @r + 'update ct90' + @r + 'update r00$' + @p + @r + 'update r70$' + @p + @r + 'update r90$' + @p + @r
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update Flow
	DECLARE @compactMode CHAR(1)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_compact_mode' AND val = '1') SELECT @compactMode = '1' ELSE SELECT @compactMode = '0'
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXA', 'PXB') AND @updateFlow = 1 AND @compactMode = '0' BEGIN
		DECLARE @table VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @table = CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN '84' ELSE '85' END
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc INTO #qt FROM d84$000000
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, wh_so, wh_ln, line_nbr from d84$000000'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#qt', @q
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #qt select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, wh_so, wh_ln, line_nbr from d' + @table + '$' + @ref + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''' or stt_rec_wh <> '''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT line_nbr0, line_nbr1 INTO #mapline FROM hddt05ct WHERE stt_rec0 = @InvoiceID AND line_nbr0 <> 0 AND line_nbr1 <> 0
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #mapline) INSERT #mapline SELECT line_nbr, line_nbr FROM #qt

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt WHERE stt_rec_yc <> '') BEGIN
			DELETE #qt WHERE stt_rec_yc = ''
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt WHERE stt_rec_wh <> '') BEGIN
			DELETE #qt WHERE stt_rec_wh = ''
		END

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update d' + @table + '$' + @p + ' set stt_rec_wh = c.stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh = c.stt_rec0wh, wh_so = c.wh_so, wh_ln = c.wh_ln, stt_rec_yc = c.stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc = c.stt_rec0yc'
				+ ' from d' + @table + '$' + @p + ' a join #mapline b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr1 join #qt c on b.line_nbr0 = c.line_nbr'
				+ ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				+ CHAR(13)
				+ 'update d' + @table + '$' + @ref + ' set stt_rec_wh = '''', stt_rec0wh = '''', wh_so = '''', wh_ln = 0, stt_rec_yc = '''', stt_rec0yc = '''''
				+ ' from d' + @table + '$' + @ref + ' a join #mapline b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr0'
				+ ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DECLARE @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32)
			SELECT @mTable = 'm' + @table + '$' + @p, @dTable = 'd' + @table + '$' + @p
			IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$IS @mTable, @dTable, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1')
				EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$Transaction @dTable, 'c38$', 'm38$', 'd38$', @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
			END
			IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' BEGIN
				exec FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$IT @mTable, @dTable, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
				if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_split' and val = '1')
				exec FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$Transaction @dTable, 'c65$', 'm65$', 'd65$', @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
			END
		END
	END

	--12957--
	CREATE TABLE #stt2 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_bi_mat VARCHAR(512))
	INSERT INTO #stt2 SELECT @VoucherID, @InvoiceNumber, @InvoiceTemplate, @Serial, @SecretNumber
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate '#stt2', @VoucherCode, DEFAULT, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeCancelInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@InvoiceType INT = 0, -- 0: E-Invoice, 1: Other
	@TableResult VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @voucherNo VARCHAR(32), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @voucherUnit VARCHAR(32), @provider INT
	SELECT @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	-- Check idNumber access

	--
	SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @voucherUnit and b.status = 1
	-- Check Unit
	IF @InvoiceType = 0 AND @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @voucherUnit AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Lock Date
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, @UserID, @voucherUnit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 1, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Modify
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = so_ct from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 2, ''' + @code + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @InvoiceType = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 8, datetime3 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	--
	IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 1, 0, '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBalanceSheetMultiPeriod] -- fs20_BalanceSheet4MuntCycle
	@periodType TINYINT,
	@periodCount TINYINT,
	@PeriodFrom TINYINT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @qGL NVARCHAR(4000), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp1 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp2 SMALLDATETIME, @periodAdd INT, @i INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @tk VARCHAR(33), @ts_nv TINYINT, @cong_no TINYINT, @cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @periodAdd = CASE WHEN @periodType = 1 THEN 1
					WHEN @periodType = 2 THEN 3
					WHEN @periodType = 3 THEN 6
					WHEN @periodType = 4 THEN 12 END
	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey

	--cdtk - Lấy số dư đầu kỳ của ngày bắt đầu báo cáo
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdtk FROM cdtk
	--
	INSERT INTO #cdtk EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dateFrom, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key

	-- cdkh - Lấy số dư đầu kỳ của ngày bắt đầu báo cáo
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdkh FROM cdkh
	--
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''
	INSERT INTO #cdkh EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @dateFrom, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @Key

	-- Bảng mẫu
	SELECT ma_so, stt, ts_nv, cong_no, ngoai_bang, khong_am, cach_tinh, tk, tien, tien_nt, bold, in_ck, ids, iscal, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
		INTO #report FROM v20gltc1 WHERE form = @Form
	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Script lấy số liệu từ r00
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	--
	SET @qGL = 'insert into #gl select tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @qGL = @qGL + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by tk, ma_kh'

	-- Script update lấy công nợ chi tiết 1 vế
	SELECT @qUpdate = 'declare @du_no numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + '
		update #t1 set @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end'


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #t1 FROM #cdkh
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS xNgay, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal
		, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien INTO #result FROM v20gltc1

	-- Tính số liệu cho từng kỳ
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i < @periodCount BEGIN
		SElECT @dateTmp1 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*@i, @dateFrom), @dateTmp2 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*(@i+1), @dateFrom) - 1

		TRUNCATE TABLE #gl
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @qGL, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateTmp1, @dateTmp2, @UserID, @Admin

		-- cdtk
		INSERT INTO #cdtk SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #gl GROUP BY tk
		-- cdkh
		INSERT INTO #cdkh SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #gl WHERE ma_kh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk, ma_kh

		-- Scan bảng mẫu các chỉ tiêu số dư
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, tk, ts_nv, cong_no FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh = '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 and tk <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @tien = 0, @tien_nt = 0

			IF @cong_no = 1 BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
				INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #cdkh WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' GROUP BY ma_kh
				EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #t1
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #t1
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @ts_nv = 1 SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no - du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) FROM #cdtk WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
					ELSE SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co - du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) FROM #cdtk WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
			END

			UPDATE #report SET tien = @tien, tien_nt = @tien_nt WHERE ma_so = @ma_so
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c

		UPDATE #report SET tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien END
			, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END

		-- Scan bảng mẫu các chỉ tiêu công thức
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', '') FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 ORDER BY ids
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien_nt FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c

		SELECT @i = @i + 1

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT @i, @dateTmp2, stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien FROM #report
	END

	-- View
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS xRow, CONVERT(CHAR(10), xNgay, 103) AS xNgay
			, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, CASE WHEN ma_so_in = '' THEN ma_so ELSE ma_so_in END AS ma_so_in, bold, tien_nt, tien
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SELECT xPeriod AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, CONVERT(CHAR(10), MAX(xNgay), 103) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #result GROUP BY xPeriod ORDER BY xPeriod
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 20 THEN 'tien_nt$' ELSE 'tien$' END + RTRIM(id)
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ff_GetExRateWithReverse(@nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dVoucher SMALLDATETIME, @dPay SMALLDATETIME, @cCR VARCHAR(33), @nVCType TINYINT, @cIDNumber VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS NUMERIC(24, 12) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nRet NUMERIC(24, 12), @dMin SMALLDATETIME, @dMax SMALLDATETIME, @dCal SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dMin = @dVoucher, @dMax = @dPay
	IF @dVoucher > @dPay SELECT @dMin = @dPay, @dMax = @dVoucher
	SELECT @nRet = @nRate
	IF @nVCType = 1
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cttt21 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ma_nt = @cCR AND ngay_ct >= @dMin AND ((ngay_ct < @dMax) OR (ngay_ct = @dMax AND status = '2')) AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @dCal = MAX(ngay_ct) FROM cttt21 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ma_nt = @cCR AND ngay_ct >= @dMin AND ((ngay_ct < @dMax) OR (ngay_ct = @dMax AND status = '2'))  AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber
					SELECT @nRet = ty_gia_dg FROM cttt21 WHERE ngay_ct = @dCal AND ma_nt = @cCR  AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber
				END
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN	
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM cttt31 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ma_nt = @cCR AND ngay_ct >= @dMin AND ((ngay_ct < @dMax) OR (ngay_ct = @dMax AND status = '2'))  AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @dCal = MAX(ngay_ct) FROM cttt31 WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ma_nt = @cCR AND ngay_ct >= @dMin  AND ((ngay_ct < @dMax) OR (ngay_ct = @dMax AND status = '2'))  AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber
					SELECT @nRet = ty_gia_dg FROM cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @dCal AND ma_nt = @cCR  AND stt_rec_hd = @cIDNumber
				END
		END
	RETURN @nRet
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostAdjustmentInventory]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @StockType TINYINT, @q TINYINT, @b TINYINT, @f TINYINT, @BaseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @status VARCHAR(1)

	SELECT @StockType = ct_nxt FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	--
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @q = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @b = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @f = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #in FROM indcsd a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Get data
	SET @s = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #in select ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Fields('indcsd', @DetailTable, @MasterTable, null) + ' from #detail a, #master b'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @VoucherCode, @MasterTable, '#in', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	SELECT @s = 'update #in set nxt = ' + RTRIM(@StockType) + ', gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, dvt1 = b.dvt, he_so1 = b.he_so, status = ''1'','
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @StockType = 1 THEN 'sl_nhap1 = b.so_luong, sl_xuat1 = 0, tien_nhap = b.tien, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt, tien_xuat = 0, tien_nt_x = 0' ELSE 'sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_xuat1 = b.so_luong, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt' END
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from #in a join ' + @DetailTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join ' + @MasterTable + ' c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	UPDATE #in SET sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so1, @q), sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so1, @q),
		gia_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gia_nt1/he_so1, @f) END, gia = CASE WHEN he_so1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gia1/he_so1, @b) END

	UPDATE #in SET gia_nt0 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, gia0 = 0, tien0 = 0, gia01 = 0, gia_nt01 = 0, ct_dc = 0, px_gia_dd = 0, so_seri = '', ma_khon = '',
		gia_nt21 = 0, gia21 = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, gia2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, tien2 = 0, tk_gv = '', tk_dt = '', cp_nt = 0, cp = 0, thue_suat_nk = 0, nk_nt = 0, nk = 0, tk_thue_nk = '', ma_tt = '',
		cp_thue_yn = 0, thue_suat = 0, thue_nt = 0, thue = 0, tk_thue_no = '', tk_thue_co = '', ck_nt = 0, ck = 0, tk_ck = '',
		so_dh2 = '', so_dh3 = '', ma_nvbh = '',
		stt_rec_dc = '', so_ct0 = '', so_seri0 = ''
	UPDATE #in SET ma_nt = '', ty_gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_nt_x = 0, cp_nt = 0, cp_vc_nt = 0, cp_bh_nt = 0, cp_khac_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency

	SELECT TOP 1 @status = status FROM #master
	DELETE indcsd WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	DELETE indcsd2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	IF @status = '1' OR @status = '3' INSERT INTO indcsd SELECT * FROM #in
	IF @status = '2' OR @status = '3' INSERT INTO indcsd2 SELECT * FROM #in

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodTSAllocationSheet] --fs20_FADepreciationReport--
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType VARCHAR(32),
	@FaDept VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@ReportForm VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @GroupFields VARCHAR(254), @RowFields VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(1024), @s2 NVARCHAR(1024), @s3 NVARCHAR(1024), @s4 NVARCHAR(1024), @s5 NVARCHAR(1024), @s6 NVARCHAR(1024), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT015'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT016'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT097'
	SELECT @s4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT098'
	SELECT @s5 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT004'
	SELECT @s6 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT005'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	SELECT @GroupFields = CASE @Group WHEN '1' THEN 'loai_cc' WHEN '2' THEN 'fx_ma_bp' WHEN '3' THEN 'fx_ma_bp,loai_cc' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @RowFields = CASE @Group WHEN '1' THEN 'isnull(loai_cc, '' '')' WHEN '2' THEN 'isnull(fx_ma_bp, '' '')' WHEN '3' THEN 'isnull(fx_ma_bp, '' '') + isnull(loai_cc, '' '')' ELSE ''' ''' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp AS fx_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts AS loai_cc, a.ky, a.nam INTO #report FROM ctkhcc a JOIN dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '(a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between (' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ') and (' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2) + ')'
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%' + ''''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Key = ' where ' + @Key

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as syprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, a.so_the_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_ts as loai_cc, a.ky, a.nam'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc c on a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_kh0 > dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))
	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (
								SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK)
									WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
										AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year))
								)

	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND gt_kh_ky_nt = 0
	IF @ReportForm = '20'
		DELETE #report WHERE nguyen_gia_nt = 0 AND gt_kh_ky_nt = 0
	ELSE
		DELETE #report WHERE nguyen_gia = 0 AND gt_kh_ky = 0

	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysColumn VARCHAR(32) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysColumnName NVARCHAR(32) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #report ADD sysRow VARCHAR(128) NULL

	EXECUTE('update #report set sysColumn = replace(str(nam, 4),'' '', ''0'') + replace(str(ky, 2),'' '', ''0''), sysColumnName = replace(str(ky, 2),'' '', ''0'') +''/'' + replace(str(nam, 4),'' '', ''0'')')

	-- Tổng phân bổ
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 9 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, min(stt) as stt, so_the_ts, max(fx_ma_bp) as fx_ma_bp, 0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt, max(ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0, max(loai_cc) as loai_cc, max(ky), max(nam), ''1'' AS sysColumn, N''' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN @s3 ELSE @s4 END + ''' AS sysColumnName, max(sysRow) AS sysRow'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @GroupFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @GroupFields
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Nguyên giá
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 9 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, min(stt) as stt, so_the_ts, max(fx_ma_bp) as fx_ma_bp,0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' 0 as nguyen_gia, 0 as nguyen_gia_nt, max(ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0, max(loai_cc) as loai_cc, max(ky), max(nam), ''0'' as sysColumn, N''' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN @s5 ELSE @s6 END + ''' AS sysColumnName, max(sysRow) AS sysRow'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by so_the_ts' + CASE WHEN @GroupFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @GroupFields
	SELECT @q = @q + ' update #report set gt_kh_ky_nt = b.t_nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky = b.t_nguyen_gia from #report a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.sysorder = 9 and sysColumn = ''0'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @GroupFields <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ky, nam, fx_ma_bp, so_the_ts, stt', 'INT, INT, VARCHAR(32), VARCHAR(32), INT')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('sysColumn, ' + @GroupFields, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 2
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set sysRow = ' + @RowFields + ' + isnull(so_the_ts, '' '')'
		SELECT @q = @q + 'update #report set sysColumnName = b.sysColumnName from #report a join(select distinct sysColumn, sysColumnName from #report where systotal = 1) b on a.sysColumn = b.sysColumn where a.systotal = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Stt
		SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xGroup INTO #xGroup FROM #report
		EXECUTE('insert into #xGroup (so_the_ts, xGroup) select so_the_ts, ' + @RowFields + ' from #report')
		SELECT so_the_ts, xGroup AS sysRow, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS id INTO #order FROM #xGroup GROUP BY xGroup, so_the_ts

		SELECT sysRow, MAX(stt) as stt into #xorder from #order WHERE so_the_ts IS NULL group by sysRow
		UPDATE #order SET id = a.stt - b.stt FROM #order a join #xorder b on a.sysRow = b.sysRow

		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, MIN(id) AS stt FROM #order GROUP BY so_the_ts)b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set sysRow = so_the_ts where systotal = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #o FROM #report
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #o (so_the_ts) select distinct so_the_ts from #report ' + CASE WHEN @Order <> '' THEN 'order by ' + REPLACE(@Order, '''', '''''') ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	END

	-- Total
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, fx_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_cc, ky, nam, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 0, 1, 0, 0, char(160), '''', null, null, sum(gt_kh_ky), sum(gt_kh_ky_nt), N''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @Total ELSE '' END + ''', N'''+ CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE @Total END + ''', null, null, null, 0, 0, sysColumn, max(sysColumnName), char(9)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report where systotal = 1 group by sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = 5 WHERE sysorder <> 0
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, fx_ma_bp, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, loai_cc, ky, nam, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 1, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', null, null, 0, 0, '''', '''', null, null, null, 0, 0, sysColumn, '''', char(10)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report where systotal = 1 group by sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, name NVARCHAR(128) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (name, header) SELECT DISTINCT sysColumn, MAX(sysColumnName) FROM #report GROUP BY sysColumn ORDER BY sysColumn

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = '10' INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_kh_ky$', ' - ' + @s1
	IF @ReportForm = '20' INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_kh_ky_nt$', ' - ' + @s2

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), RTRIM(a.header) FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	SELECT @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, isnull(stt, 0) as stt, isnull(so_the_ts, char(160)) as so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt,' +
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts,' +
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END + ' as ten_ts2' +
		', isnull(so_ky_kh, 0) as so_ky_kh, ngay_kh0, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysRow from #report order by sysRow, sysColumn'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PostSalary2GL]
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @Stt_rec CHAR(13), @Nh_dk CHAR(3), @Ma_bp VARCHAR(33), @Ma_phi VARCHAR(33), @Ma_vv VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no VARCHAR(33), @Tk_co VARCHAR(33), @So_ct VARCHAR(33), @Dien_giai NVARCHAR(511), @wsID VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @Date0 DATETIME
	DECLARE @i INT, @count INT, @stt INT, @Line_nbr INT, @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cUnit VARCHAR(33), @unitCode VARCHAR(33), @payType VARCHAR(33), @department VARCHAR(33)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_loai_lg, ma_bp, gt_nt AS tien_nt, gt AS tien INTO #hrluong FROM hrluongth$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_loai_lg, a.ma_bp, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.dien_giai, a.ma_bp_phi, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv
		, IDENTITY(INT) AS stt INTO #hrbtkcl1 FROM hrbtkcl1 a

	--
	SELECT @voucherDate = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@Year, @Period), @Date0 = GETDATE()

	-- Get from Salary
	SELECT @q = ' insert into #hrluong select a.ma_loai_lg, a.ma_bp, sum(b.gt_nt) as tien_nt, sum(b.gt) as tien from (select distinct r.ma_loai_lg, r.ma_bp, r.ma_dvcs, b0.bp_ref from #k r left join hrbp b0 on r.ma_bp = b0.ma_bp) a'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join (select h.*, b1.bp_ref, b1.ma_dvcs from hrluongth$' +  CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) + ' h left join hrbp b1 on h.ma_bp = b1.ma_bp) b on a.ma_loai_lg = b.ma_loai_lg and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.bp_ref like a.bp_ref + ''%'''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.gt_nt + b.gt <> 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_loai_lg, a.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Create
	SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	CREATE TABLE #idNumber (stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
  
	SELECT @i = 1, @count = COUNT(*) FROM #k
	WHILE @i <= @count BEGIN
		SELECT @unitCode = ma_dvcs, @payType = ma_loai_lg, @department = ma_bp FROM #k WHERE stt = @i

		DELETE #idNumber
		-- INSERT INTO #idNumber EXEC fs_GetIdentityNumber @wsID, @VoucherCode, 'hrbtkcl1'
		INSERT INTO #idNumber EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetIdentityNumber @wsID, @VoucherCode, 'hrbtkcl1', @UserID
		SELECT @stt_rec = stt_rec FROM #idNumber

		INSERT INTO #hrbtkcl1 (stt_rec,ma_dvcs,ky,nam,ma_loai_lg,ma_bp,ma_ct,ngay_ct,so_ct,tk_no,tk_co,tien_nt,tien,dien_giai,ma_bp_phi,ma_phi,ma_vv)
			SELECT @stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, @Period, @Year, a.ma_loai_lg, a.ma_bp, @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112), a.tk_no, a.tk_co, b.tien_nt, b.tien, a.ten_bt, a.ma_bp_phi, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv
				FROM hrbtkcl a JOIN #hrluong b ON a.ma_loai_lg = b.ma_loai_lg AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
				WHERE a.ma_dvcs = @unitCode and a.ma_loai_lg = @payType and a.ma_bp = @department
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END


	-- GL 
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, ma_dvcs, so_ct, tk_no, tk_co, tien, tien_nt, ma_bp_phi, ma_phi, ma_vv, dien_giai, stt FROM #hrbtkcl1 ORDER BY stt
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Stt_rec, @cUnit, @So_ct, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tien, @Tien_nt, @Ma_bp, @Ma_phi, @Ma_vv, @Dien_giai, @Stt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @Nh_dk = REPLACE(STR(@Stt, 3), ' ', '0')
			SET @Line_nbr = 1
			SET @So_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(@So_ct, dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct'))

			--
			INSERT INTO #gl (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, Dien_giai, Dien_giai_h, Nh_dk, Line_nbr
					, Tk, Tk_du, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co
					, Ma_kh, Ma_bp, Ma_phi, Ma_vv, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				VALUES (@Stt_rec, @cUnit, @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, @voucherDate, @So_ct, @Dien_giai, @Dien_giai, @Nh_dk, @Line_nbr
					, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tien_nt, 0, '', 0, @Tien, 0
					, '', @Ma_bp, @Ma_phi, @Ma_vv, '', '', '', @UserID, @Date0, @UserID, @Date0, 1)

			SET @Line_nbr = @Line_nbr + 1
			INSERT INTO #gl (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, Dien_giai, Dien_giai_h, Nh_dk, Line_nbr
					, Tk, Tk_du, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co
					, Ma_kh, Ma_bp, Ma_phi, Ma_vv, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				VALUES (@Stt_rec, @cUnit, @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, @voucherDate, @So_ct, @Dien_giai, @Dien_giai, @Nh_dk, @Line_nbr
					, @Tk_co, @Tk_no, 0, @Tien_nt, '', 0, 0, @Tien
					, '', @Ma_bp, @Ma_phi, @Ma_vv, '', '', '', @UserID, @Date0, @UserID, @Date0, 1)

			FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Stt_rec, @cUnit, @So_ct, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tien, @Tien_nt, @Ma_bp, @Ma_phi, @Ma_vv, @Dien_giai, @Stt
		END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strSQL = dbo.ff20_GetSQLAlterNullValue('#gl', 'wrkgl', 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, dien_giai, dien_giai_h, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh, ma_bp ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL


	-- Delete
	DELETE ct00 FROM ct00 a JOIN hrbtkcl1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec JOIN #k c ON b.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs AND b.ma_loai_lg = c.ma_loai_lg AND b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp WHERE b.ky = @Period AND b.nam = @Year
	SELECT @q = 'delete a from r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) + ' a join hrbtkcl1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join #k c on b.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs and b.ma_loai_lg = c.ma_loai_lg and b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp where b.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and b.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE hrbtkcl1 FROM hrbtkcl1 a JOIN #k b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_loai_lg = b.ma_loai_lg AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE a.ky = @Period AND a.nam = @Year

	-- Save
	INSERT INTO hrbtkcl1(stt_rec,ma_dvcs,ky,nam,ma_loai_lg,ma_bp,ma_ct,ngay_ct,so_ct,tk_no,tk_co,tien_nt,tien,dien_giai,ma_bp_phi,ma_phi,ma_vv,datetime0,datetime2,user_id0,user_id2) 
		SELECT stt_rec,ma_dvcs,ky,nam,ma_loai_lg,ma_bp,ma_ct,ngay_ct,so_ct,tk_no,tk_co,tien_nt,tien,dien_giai,ma_bp_phi,ma_phi,ma_vv, @Date0, @Date0, @userID, @userID FROM #hrbtkcl1
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
	
	DECLARE @c INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @Stt_rec = stt_rec, @i = 1, @c = COUNT(*) FROM #gl GROUP BY stt_rec ORDER BY stt_rec
	WHILE @i <= @c BEGIN
		EXEC fs20_AfterUpdateGL @Stt_rec, '', '', @VoucherCode, 1
		SELECT TOP 1 @Stt_rec = stt_rec FROM #gl WHERE stt_rec > @Stt_rec GROUP BY stt_rec ORDER BY stt_rec
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @voucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(64)
		SET @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112)
		--
		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @dyn + ' select a.* from ct00 a join (select distinct stt_rec from #gl) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$BISA]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @RefTable VARCHAR(64)
	SET @RefTable = SUBSTRING(@masterTable, 2, 3)

	SELECT ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct INTO #$master FROM bim06$000000
	SET @s = 'insert into #$master select ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ngach, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_kh
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM bid06$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, so_luong, he_so INTO #detailUpdate FROM bid06$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = '
insert into #detailUpdate select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, a.so_luong, a.he_so
	from ' + @detailTable + ' a cross join #$master m join bim02$000000 b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung join bid02$000000 c on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and b.ma_bp0 = m.ma_bp0 and c.ma_kh = m.ma_kh and isnull(a.ngay_giao, m.ngay_ct) between b.ngay_hl_tu and b.ngay_hl_den'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, b.stt_rec_ngach, b.stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.he_so, '''', ''000000'', ''''
from ' + @detailTable + ' a left join #detailUpdate b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
	where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (a.stt_rec_nc <> '''' or a.stt_rec_kh <> '''' or b.stt_rec_ngach is not null)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)) FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_kh <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_kh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c93$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_kh = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @cQAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineQAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ngach VARCHAR(64), @dyn_kh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, dyn_nc, dyn_ngach, dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate
	CREATE TABLE #POEmployee (ma_nv VARCHAR(33))
	SET @s = 'insert into #POEmployee select ma_nv from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	DECLARE @POEmployee VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @POEmployee = ma_nv FROM #POEmployee
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET ma_nv = ''' + RTRIM(@POEmployee) + ''', sl_dh = sl_dh + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cQAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ngach <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' SET sl_th = a.sl_th + CASE WHEN m.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / m.he_so, 3) END FROM bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' a JOIN bim02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' m ON a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nAmount',  RTRIM(@nAmount)), '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc, MAX(dyn_kh) AS dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET xstatus = ''5'' WHERE sl_dh > 0 AND stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh < sl_duyet)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PRStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PRStatus = status FROM i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c91$000000 SET status = @PRStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = @PRStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrektr]
AS
SELECT     a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ktr, a.ngay_ktr, a.diem, a.ma_kq, a.trong_so, a.ghi_chu, a.tag, a.line_nbr, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
                      b.ten_ktr AS ten_ma_ktr, b.ten_ktr2 AS ten_ma_ktr2, c.ten_kq AS ten_ma_kq, c.ten_kq2 AS ten_ma_kq2
FROM         dbo.hrektr AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmktr AS b ON a.ma_ktr = b.ma_ktr LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmkq AS c ON a.ma_kq = c.ma_kq

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionLotResetTemplate]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@InspectionID CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @part CHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @now SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherIDKey NVARCHAR(1024), @InspectionIDKey NVARCHAR(128), @roundQuantity INT

	SET @InspectionIDKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionID, '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @roundQuantity = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT * INTO #kd FROM bikd WHERE stt_rec = @InspectionID
	SELECT TOP 1 @part = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @now = GETDATE() FROM #kd


	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tonghop FROM bikd00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, ma_diem INTO #o03 FROM bikd03m$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m03 FROM bikd03m$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #d03 FROM bikd03d$000000


	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #tonghop select a.* from bikd00$' + @part + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
		+ CHAR(13) +
		'insert into #o03 select a.stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, a.ma_diem from bikd03m$' + @part + ' a join #tonghop b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec '
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ma_loai_kd, MAX(b.ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct
		INTO #kbdactinh FROM #tonghop a JOIN bikddactinh b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai AND b.ngay_ct <= a.ngay_ct_goc
		WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh = '1'
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ma_loai_kd


	UPDATE #tonghop SET stt_rec_dt = ISNULL(c.stt_rec, ''), sd_diem_kd = ISNULL(c.sd_diem_kd, ''), qd_tung_phan = ISNULL(c.qd_tung_phan, '')
		FROM #tonghop a LEFT JOIN #kbdactinh b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai_kd
			LEFT JOIN bikddactinh c ON c.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND c.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND c.ma_loai = b.ma_loai_kd AND c.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
		WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh = '1'


	SET @q = 'delete a from bikd03d$' + @part + ' a join #o03 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bikd03m$' + @part + ' a join #o03 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bikd02$' + @part + ' a join #o03 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_kd where nhom_du_lieu = ''03'''
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE bikd03c$000000 FROM bikd03c$000000 a JOIN #o03 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tonghop WHERE kd_dac_tinh = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m03(stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_diem, ty_le, so_luong0, dien_giai, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, ghi_chu, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_nguon, kieu_tao, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT '', a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, ISNULL(b.ma_diem, ''), ISNULL(b.ty_le, 100), ROUND(ISNULL(b.ty_le, 100)/100 * a.so_luong0, @roundQuantity),
				a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, '', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nguon, 1, @now, @now, @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #tonghop a LEFT JOIN bikddactinhdiem b ON a.stt_rec_dt = b.stt_rec
			WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh = '1'

		IF @VoucherID <> '' BEGIN
			UPDATE #m03 SET stt_rec = @VoucherID
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @wsID VARCHAR(8), @count INT
			SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
			SELECT stt_rec_kd, ma_diem, CAST('' AS CHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #id FROM #m03 GROUP BY stt_rec_kd, ma_diem
			SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #id
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, 'KD3', @count, @UserID
			UPDATE #m03 SET stt_rec = b.stt_rec FROM #m03 a JOIN #id b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec_kd AND a.ma_diem = b.ma_diem
		END

		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.so_luong0 - a.t_so_luong AS sl_cl
			INTO #cl FROM (SELECT stt_rec_kd, SUM(so_luong0) AS t_so_luong, MIN(stt_rec) AS stt_rec FROM #m03 GROUP BY stt_rec_kd) a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec
		UPDATE #m03 SET so_luong0 = a.so_luong0 + b.sl_cl FROM #m03 a JOIN #cl b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = (SELECT MIN(stt_rec) AS stt_rec FROM #m03) AND b.sl_cl <> 0

		INSERT INTO #d03(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_cd, ten_cd, ten_cd2, ma_ccv, ma_dac_tinh, sl_mau, gia_tri_tu, gia_tri_den, gt_muc_tieu, yeu_cau, pp_kd, tinh_diem_cl, trong_so, ghi_chu, line_nbr)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, c.ma_cd, c.ten_cd, c.ten_cd2, c.ma_ccv, c.ma_dac_tinh,
				CASE WHEN c.so_luong_mau <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN b.he_so <> 0 THEN ROUND(c.so_luong_mau / b.he_so, @roundQuantity) ELSE 0 END ELSE ROUND(a.so_luong0 * c.ty_le_mau/100, @roundQuantity) END,
				c.gia_tri_tu, c.gia_tri_den, c.gt_muc_tieu, c.yeu_cau, c.pp_kd, c.tinh_diem_cl, c.trong_so, c.ghi_chu, c.line_nbr
			FROM #m03 a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec JOIN bikddactinhct c ON c.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_dt
			WHERE b.kd_dac_tinh = '1' AND b.stt_rec_dt <> ''
	END

	INSERT INTO #m03(stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_diem, ty_le, so_luong0, dien_giai, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, ghi_chu, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_nguon, kieu_tao, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT REPLACE(a.stt_rec, 'KD2', 'KD3'), a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, '', 100, a.so_luong0, a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, '', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nguon, 1, @now, @now, @UserID, @UserID
		FROM #tonghop a JOIN bikddmloai b ON b.ma_nguon = a.ma_nguon AND b.ma_loai = a.ma_loai_kd WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh <> '1'

	INSERT INTO #d03(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_cd, ten_cd, ten_cd2, ma_ccv, ma_dac_tinh, sl_mau, gia_tri_tu, gia_tri_den, gt_muc_tieu, yeu_cau, pp_kd, tinh_diem_cl, trong_so, ghi_chu, line_nbr)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, '001', a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, '', '', '', '', '', ROUND(b.so_luong0 * c.ty_le_mau/100, @roundQuantity), 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, '', 1
			FROM #m03 a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec JOIN bikddmloai c ON c.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon AND c.ma_loai = b.ma_loai_kd
			WHERE b.kd_dac_tinh <> '1'

	UPDATE #d03 SET sl_mau = b.so_luong0 FROM #d03 a JOIN #m03 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.sl_mau > b.so_luong0
	UPDATE #m03 SET so_luong = so_luong0

	SET @q = '
	insert into bikd03m$' + @part + ' select * from #m03'
	+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bikd03d$' + @part + ' select * from #d03'
	+ CHAR(13) + 'update a set stt_rec_dt = b.stt_rec_dt, sd_diem_kd = b.sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan = b.qd_tung_phan, so_luong = c.so_luong, datetime2 = a.datetime0, user_id2 = @u
		from bikd00$' + @part + ' a join #tonghop b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join (select stt_rec_kd, sum(so_luong) as so_luong from bikd03m$' + @part + ' group by stt_rec_kd) c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec_kd
		'

	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@now smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID

	UPDATE bikd SET sd_diem_kd = b.sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan = b.qd_tung_phan FROM bikd a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	INSERT INTO bikd03c$000000(stt_rec, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, stt_rec_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_nguon, ma_vung, status, user_id0)
		SELECT stt_rec, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, stt_rec_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_nguon, ma_vung, 1, user_id0 FROM #m03

	-- Reset inspection template
	EXEC bs_PostInspectionResultTemplate '', @Debug

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisMultiPeriods] --fs_FinancialAnalysis4MultiCycle
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@periodType INT,
	@periodCount INT,
	@reportType TINYINT, -- 1 - Chi tiet, 2 - Tong hop
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #t1 FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t1', @UserID, @Admin
	
	-- Giá trị
	INSERT INTO #t1 EXEC rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisTemplate @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, NULL, NULL, @periodType, @periodCount, @reportType, @Unit, @Form, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu cho đánh giá
	SELECT ma_so, cot, chu INTO #gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99
		WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearFrom AND ky2 = @PeriodFrom AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = @periodType AND so_ky = @periodCount AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '03'
	IF @Language = 'V' UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '1'
		ELSE UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '2'

	DECLARE @PeriodName NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @PeriodName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'PERIOD'
	
	-- View
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(period, 3), ' ', '0') AS period, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN bold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dien_giai ELSE dien_giai2 END AS dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dvt ELSE dvt2 END AS dvt
			, danh_gia, ISNULL(gt, 0) AS gt, kind, ma_so, ma_so_in, @PeriodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(period) AS xCol
		FROM #t1 ORDER BY period, stt, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SELECT period AS id, 'gt$' + RTRIM(period) AS name, @PeriodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(period) AS header FROM #t1 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$CheckTaxCode]
	@Tax VARCHAR(32),
	@Result BIT OUT,
	@Order INT = NULL OUT,
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@ErrorMode TINYINT = 0,
	@ErrorCount INT = 0 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Tax = REPLACE(@Tax, '''', ''''''), @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''''''), @Result = 1

	CREATE TABLE #tax (stt INT, ma_so_thue VARCHAR(32), r INT)
	IF @TableName <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #tax select rtrim(' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tax, ' ', ''), ',', '),rtrim(') + '), 0 from ' + @TableName
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE INSERT INTO #tax SELECT 0, RTRIM(@Tax), 0

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE NOT (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 10 OR LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14)) BEGIN
		IF @ErrorMode = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @Result = 0
			SET ROWCOUNT @ErrorCount
			SELECT stt FROM #tax WHERE NOT (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 10 OR LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14)
			SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount - @@rowcount; SET ROWCOUNT 0; IF @ErrorCount = 0 RETURN
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @Result = 0, @Order = MIN(stt) FROM #tax WHERE NOT (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 10 OR LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14)
		END
	END

	IF (@Result = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE LEN(ma_so_thue) > 10)) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE ((LEN(REPLACE(RIGHT(ma_so_thue, 3), '-', '')) <> 3) OR (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14 AND ([dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 12, 3)) = 0 OR SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 11, 1) <> '-')))) BEGIN
			IF @ErrorMode = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @Result = 0
				SET ROWCOUNT @ErrorCount
				SELECT stt FROM #tax WHERE ((LEN(REPLACE(RIGHT(ma_so_thue, 3), '-', '')) <> 3) OR (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14 AND ([dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 12, 3)) = 0 OR SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 11, 1) <> '-')))
				SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount - @@rowcount; SET ROWCOUNT 0; IF @ErrorCount = 0 RETURN
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @Result = 0, @Order = MIN(stt) FROM #tax WHERE ((LEN(REPLACE(RIGHT(ma_so_thue, 3), '-', '')) <> 3) OR (LEN(ma_so_thue) = 14 AND ([dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 12, 3)) = 0 OR SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 11, 1) <> '-')))
			END
		END
	END

	UPDATE #tax SET ma_so_thue = RTRIM(REPLACE(ma_so_thue, '-', ''))
	UPDATE #tax SET ma_so_thue = SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 1, 10)

    IF (@Result = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE [dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](ma_so_thue) = 0)) BEGIN
        IF @ErrorMode = 1 BEGIN
            SELECT @Result = 0
            SET ROWCOUNT @ErrorCount
            SELECT stt FROM #tax WHERE [dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](ma_so_thue) = 0
            SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount - @@rowcount; SET ROWCOUNT 0; IF @ErrorCount = 0 RETURN
        END ELSE BEGIN
