            SELECT @Result = 0, @Order = MIN(stt) FROM #tax WHERE [dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](ma_so_thue) = 0
        END
    END

	IF (@Result = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE [dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](ma_so_thue) = 1)) BEGIN
		UPDATE #tax SET r = CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 1, 1) AS INT) * 31
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 2, 1) AS INT) * 29
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 3, 1) AS INT) * 23
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 4, 1) AS INT) * 19
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 5, 1) AS INT) * 17
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 6, 1) AS INT) * 13
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 7, 1) AS INT) * 7
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 8, 1) AS INT) * 5
		UPDATE #tax SET r = r + CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 9, 1) AS INT) * 3

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tax WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 10, 1) AS INT) <> (10 - (r % 11))) BEGIN
			IF @ErrorMode = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @Result = 0
				SET ROWCOUNT @ErrorCount
				SELECT stt FROM #tax WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 10, 1) AS INT) <> (10 - (r % 11))
				SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount - @@rowcount; SET ROWCOUNT 0; IF @ErrorCount = 0 RETURN
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @Result = 0, @Order = MIN(stt) FROM #tax WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(ma_so_thue, 10, 1) AS INT) <> (10 - (r % 11))
			END	
		END
		
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspection]
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - Create by voucher, 2 - Reset Template, 3 - Adjustment, 4 - Result, 5 - Cancellation, 6 - Decicion
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherID CHAR(13), -- Record of Orginal Voucher, Not Empty in case 1, 4, 5, 6.
	@InspectionID CHAR(13), -- Record of Inspection Lot, Not Empty in case 3, 4, 5, 6.
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),

	@WrkinDelele BIT = 1,  -- Có xóa dữ liệu sổ kho 70/90/biss90 trước khi insert lại khi có chuyển tồn kho.
	@PostStock BIT = 0 OUT,

	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	-- Default Return Value
	SET @PostStock = 0

	-- Process
	IF @Type = '1' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotCreating @VoucherCode, @VoucherID, @WrkinDelele, @PostStock OUT, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug
	IF @Type = '2' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotResetTemplate @VoucherID, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug
	IF @Type = '3' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotAdjustment @VoucherID, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug
	IF @Type = '4' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotResult @VoucherID, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Debug
	IF @Type = '5' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotCancellation @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug
	IF @Type = '6' EXEC bs_PostInspectionLotDecision @VoucherID, @InspectionID, @UserID, @Admin, @Debug


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2DetailIncreaseDecrease]
	@period AS INT,
	@year AS INT,
	@period2 AS INT,
	@year2 AS INT,
	@tsReason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsDept AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@type AS CHAR(1),  -- 1 - Increase, 2 - Decrease
	@isDetail BIT, -- 1 - Detail by Department, 0- None
	@groupBy NVARCHAR(256),
	@unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @cFC VARCHAR(32), @v0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @v1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @c VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @tsIn NVARCHAR(128), @tsOut NVARCHAR(128), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @cFC = val FROM Options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @tsIn = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT058'
	SELECT @tsOut = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT059'
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year), @dTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period2, @year2)) - 1
	SELECT @c = RTRIM(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@groupBy, ','))

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS xGroup INTO #dmccdc0
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
			, CAST(a.ma_dc AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_dc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_dc2, b.ngay_tang, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, c.loai_ps
			, b.loai_dc, b.so_ky_pb, CAST(a.ma_bp_dc AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp_dc, CAST(d.ten_tg_ts AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_ld_dc
			, a.so_luong, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_pb, a.gt_da_pb_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS xGroup
		INTO #report FROM dmdcct a, dmccdc b, ctpsdc c, dmtgcc d

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @userID, @admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @tsReason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_ld_tang like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsReason, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @tsType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @tsDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @type = '1'
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN ((@tsDept = '') AND (@isDetail = 0)) THEN ' and a.loai_ps = 0' ELSE ' and a.loai_ps in (0, 1)' END
	ELSE
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN ((@tsDept = '') AND (@isDetail = 0)) THEN ' and a.loai_ps = 2' ELSE ' and a.loai_ps in (1, 2)' END

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	IF @isDetail = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 6, 1, 2, null, a.ma_dc'
		SET @q = @q + ', space(' + @c + ' + 1) + max(d.ten_bp)'
		SET @q = @q + ', space(' + @c + ' + 1) + max(d.ten_bp2)'
		SET @q = @q + ', max(a.ngay_ct), max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia), a.loai_ps, max(b.loai_dc), null, a.ma_bp_dc'
		IF @type = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ', case when a.loai_ps <> 1 then max(c.ten_tg_ts%l) else N''' + @tsIn + ''' end'
			SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.nguyen_gia_n), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_n), sum(a.gt_da_pb_n), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_n), sum(a.gt_cl_n), sum(a.gt_cl_nt_n)'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ', case when a.loai_ps <> 1 then max(c.ten_tg_ts%l) else N''' + @tsOut + ''' end'
			SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.nguyen_gia_x), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_x), sum(a.gt_cl_x), sum(a.gt_cl_nt_x)'
		END
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ' + a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' from ctpsdc a with(nolock) left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_ld_tg = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmbpcc d on a.ma_bp_dc = d.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + CASE WHEN @type = '1' THEN ' and a.sl_nhap <> 0' ELSE ' and a.sl_xuat <> 0' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.loai_ps'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT xGroup, COUNT(xGroup) AS line INTO #t FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup
		DELETE #report FROM #report a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t b WHERE a.xGroup = b.xGroup AND b.line = 1)
		INSERT INTO #dmccdc0 SELECT DISTINCT ma_dc + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ma_bp_dc ELSE '' END FROM #report
	END
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, max(b.ten_dc), max(b.ten_dc2), max(a.ngay_ct), max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia), a.loai_ps, max(b.loai_dc), max(b.so_ky_pb)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ', a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE ', max(a.ma_bp_dc)' END
	IF @type = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', case when a.loai_ps <> 1 then max(c.ten_tg_ts%l) else N''' + @tsIn + ''' end'
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.nguyen_gia_n), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_n), sum(a.gt_da_pb_n), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_n), sum(a.gt_cl_n), sum(a.gt_cl_nt_n)'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', case when a.loai_ps <> 1 then max(c.ten_tg_ts%l) else N''' + @tsOut + ''' end'
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.nguyen_gia_x), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_x), sum(a.gt_cl_x), sum(a.gt_cl_nt_x)'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ' + a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE ' + max(a.ma_bp_dc)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctpsdc a with(nolock) left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_ld_tg = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + CASE WHEN @type = '1' THEN ' and a.sl_nhap <> 0' ELSE ' and a.sl_xuat <> 0' END
	IF @isDetail = 1 SET @q = @q + ' and not exists(select 1 from #dmccdc0 d where a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ' + a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END + ' = d.xGroup)'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dc, a.loai_ps' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ', a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	IF @isDetail = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, max(b.ten_dc), max(b.ten_dc2), null, max(b.ma_nt), max(b.ty_gia), '''', max(b.loai_dc), max(b.so_ky_pb)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ', a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE ', ''''' END
		SET @q = @q + ', '''', sum(a.sl_nhap) - sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.nguyen_gia_n) - sum(a.nguyen_gia_x), sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_n) - sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_n) - sum(a.gt_da_pb_x), sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_n) - sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt_x), sum(a.gt_cl_n) - sum(a.gt_cl_x), sum(a.gt_cl_nt_n) - sum(a.gt_cl_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ' + a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' from ctpsdc a with(nolock) left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_ld_tg = c.ma_tg_ts'
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		SET @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from #dmccdc0 d where a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ' + a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END + ' = d.xGroup)'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dc' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN ', a.ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--
		SELECT ma_dc, COUNT(ngay_tang) AS ngay, COUNT(loai_ps) AS loai, MAX(ngay_tang) AS ngay_tang, MAX(ten_ld_dc) AS ten_ld_dc INTO #t0
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dc, ngay_tang, loai_ps, ISNULL(ten_ld_dc, '') AS ten_ld_dc from #report where sysorder= 6) a GROUP BY ma_dc HAVING COUNT(ngay_tang) = 1 OR COUNT(loai_ps) = 1
		UPDATE #report SET ngay_tang = CASE WHEN b.ngay = 1 THEN NULL ELSE a.ngay_tang END, ten_ld_dc = CASE WHEN b.loai = 1 THEN '' ELSE a.ten_ld_dc END FROM #report a JOIN #t0 b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc WHERE a.sysorder = 6
		UPDATE #report SET ngay_tang = CASE WHEN b.ngay = 1 THEN b.ngay_tang ELSE NULL END, ten_ld_dc = CASE WHEN b.loai = 1 THEN b.ten_ld_dc ELSE '' END FROM #report a JOIN #t0 b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc WHERE a.sysorder = 5
	END
	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_pb_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cFC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''
	IF @type <> '1' UPDATE #report SET @v0 = gt_da_pb + gt_cl, gt_cl = nguyen_gia - @v0, gt_da_pb = @v0, @v1 = gt_da_pb_nt + gt_cl_nt, gt_cl_nt = nguyen_gia_nt - @v1, gt_da_pb_nt = @v1 WHERE loai_ps = 2

	-- Group/Order
	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@groupBy, '') <> '' THEN @groupBy ELSE 'ma_dc' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, 'sysorder, ma_dc' + CASE WHEN @isDetail = 1 THEN ', ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @groupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'
	--
	IF @groupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@groupBy, 'dc', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Total
	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dc', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Not Exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN
		DELETE #report
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	END

	-- View
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, ngay_tang, ma_nt, ty_gia, loai_ps, loai_dc, so_ky_pb, ma_bp_dc, ten_ld_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'ten_dc' ELSE 'ten_dc2' END + ' as ten_dc'

	IF @groupBy <> ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + @groupBy + ', xGroup, sysorder, stt' + CASE WHEN @isDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_bp_dc', @groupBy) <> 0 THEN '' ELSE ', ma_bp_dc' END ELSE '' END
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by xGroup, sysorder, stt' + CASE WHEN @isDetail = 1 THEN ', ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BankHub$BeforeTransferTransaction]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@BankCode VARCHAR(33),
	@IdNumber VARCHAR(4000),
	@VoucherDate VARCHAR(4000),
	@ListDays VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @code VARCHAR(33), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @limitAmount NUMERIC(19,0), @mes NVARCHAR(512)

	SET @qUpdate = ''

	IF @IdNumber = '' OR @VoucherDate = '' OR @ListDays = '' OR @BankCode = '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS code, '' AS field, '' AS message
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @limitAmount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'mb_limit_amount_nhdt'
	IF @limitAmount IS NULL AND @BankCode = 'MB' SET @limitAmount = 500000000

	CREATE TABLE #id(id INT, stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #d(id INT, ngay_ct VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #d2(id INT, datetime2 VARCHAR(32))

	CREATE TABLE #idPayment(stt_rec VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, datetime2 VARCHAR(32))

	INSERT INTO #id SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@IdNumber, ',')
	INSERT INTO #d SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@VoucherDate, ',')
	INSERT INTO #d2 SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ListDays, ',')

	INSERT INTO #idPayment(stt_rec, ngay_ct, datetime2)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay_ct, c.datetime2 FROM #id a JOIN #d b ON a.id = b.id JOIN #d2 c ON a.id = c.id

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from #idPayment'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = m.so_ct from knnh00$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) join m56$' + @p + ' m with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join #idPayment b on a.stt_rec = b.[stt_rec] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS code, @code AS field, '' AS message
			RETURN
		END

		-- Check Status E-Invoice
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = m.so_ct from knnh00$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) join m56$' + @p + ' m with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join #idPayment b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.tinh_trang <> ''0'' or a.status = ''0'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS code, @code AS field, '' AS message
			RETURN
		END

		-- Check Amount
		IF @BankCode = 'MB' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = m.so_ct from knnh00$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) join m56$' + @p + ' m with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join #idPayment b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where m.t_tt_nt > ' + RTRIM(@limitAmount) + ' and a.loai_gd = ''3'''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS code, @code AS field, '' AS message
				RETURN
			END
		END

		-- Check Special Characters Not Allowed
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = 1 from knnh00$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) join m56$' + @p + ' m with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join #idPayment b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.dien_giai like ''%[^a-z0-9 ,.-]%'' or a.dien_giai collate latin1_general_bin like N''%['' + nchar(128) + ''-'' + nchar(65535) + '']%'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @mes = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Nội dung chuyển tiền tồn tại ký tự không cho phép.' ELSE N'The payment order memo contains disallowed characters.' END
			SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS code, '' AS field, @mes AS message
			RETURN
		END

		-- Update status
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update knnh00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang = ''1'', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from knnh00$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) where exists(select 1 from #idPayment b where a.stt_rec = b.[stt_rec])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS code, '' AS field, '' AS message

	DROP TABLE #id
	DROP TABLE #d
	DROP TABLE #d2
	DROP TABLE #idPayment

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$CancelInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	SELECT @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hrc01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @q = 'select a.keys as so_bi_mat, a.ma_dvcs, a.mau_so from hrm01$' + @p + ' a with(nolock) where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBalanceSheetMultiUnit] -- fs20_BalanceSheet4MuntCycle
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @Total NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @tk VARCHAR(33), @ts_nv TINYINT, @cong_no TINYINT, @cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey

	--cdtk - Lấy số dư đầu kỳ tk
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdtk FROM cdtk
	CREATE INDEX ma_dvcs ON #cdtk(ma_dvcs)
	--
	INSERT INTO #cdtk EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$AccountUnit @DateTo, NULL, '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key

	-- cdkh - Lấy số dư đầu kỳ kh
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdkh FROM cdkh
	CREATE INDEX ma_dvcs ON #cdkh(ma_dvcs)
	--
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''
	INSERT INTO #cdkh EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$CustomerUnit @DateTo, NULL, '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @Key

	-- Bảng mẫu
	SELECT ma_so, stt, ts_nv, cong_no, ngoai_bang, khong_am, cach_tinh, tk, tien, tien_nt, bold, in_ck, ids, iscal, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
		INTO #report FROM v20gltc1 WHERE form = @Form

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Script update lấy công nợ chi tiết 1 vế
	SELECT @qUpdate = 'declare @du_no numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + '
		update #t1 set @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #t1 FROM #cdkh
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xPeriod, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal
		, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien INTO #result FROM v20gltc1

	-- Danh sách dvcs
	CREATE TABLE #dvcs (id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33))
	SET @q = 'insert into #dvcs(ma_dvcs) select rtrim(ma_dvcs) from dmdvcs' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' where ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' order by ma_dvcs'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Tính số liệu cho từng đơn vị
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dvcs WHERE id = @i) BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs FROM #dvcs WHERE id = @i

		-- Scan bảng mẫu các chỉ tiêu số dư
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, tk, ts_nv, cong_no FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh = '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 and tk <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @tien = 0, @tien_nt = 0

			IF @cong_no = 1 BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
				INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #cdkh WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%' GROUP BY ma_kh
				EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

				IF @ts_nv = 1
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt) FROM #t1
				ELSE
					SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #t1
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @ts_nv = 1 SELECT @tien = SUM(du_no - du_co), @tien_nt = SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) FROM #cdtk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
					ELSE SELECT @tien = SUM(du_co - du_no), @tien_nt = SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) FROM #cdtk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk LIKE RTRIM(@tk) + '%'
			END

			UPDATE #report SET tien = @tien, tien_nt = @tien_nt WHERE ma_so = @ma_so
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @tk, @ts_nv, @cong_no
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c

		UPDATE #report SET tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien END
			, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END

		-- Scan bảng mẫu các chỉ tiêu công thức
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT REPLACE(ma_so, '''', ''), REPLACE(cach_tinh, '''', '') FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' AND ngoai_bang = 0 ORDER BY ids
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 tien_nt FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c

		SELECT @i = @i + 1

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT @ma_dvcs, stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien FROM #report
	END

	-- View
	SELECT xPeriod AS xColumn, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS xRow
			, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, CASE WHEN ma_so_in = '' THEN ma_so ELSE ma_so_in END AS ma_so_in, bold, tien_nt, tien
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SElECT id, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END + RTRIM(id) AS name, CAST(RTRIM(ma_dvcs) AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #dvcs ORDER BY id
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien' ELSE 'tien_nt' END, @Total
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_Post$Import$AdjustmentInventory]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@status VARCHAR(1),
	@numeric VARCHAR(4000),
	@string VARCHAR(4000),
	@statement NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @StockType TINYINT, @q TINYINT, @b TINYINT, @f TINYINT, @BaseCurrency VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @StockType = ct_nxt FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	--
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @q = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @b = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @f = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #in FROM indcsd a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d37$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #in select ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Columns('indcsd', @DetailTable, @MasterTable, null) + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = 'update #in set nxt = ' + RTRIM(@StockType) + ', gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, dvt1 = b.dvt, he_so1 = b.he_so, status = ''1'','
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @StockType = 1 THEN 'sl_nhap1 = b.so_luong, sl_xuat1 = 0, tien_nhap = b.tien, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt, tien_xuat = 0, tien_nt_x = 0' ELSE 'sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_xuat1 = b.so_luong, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt' END
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from #in a join ' + @DetailTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join ' + @MasterTable + ' c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = 'update #in set ' + REPLACE(@Numeric, ',', '=0,') + '=0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SELECT @s = 'update #in set ' + REPLACE(@String, ',', '='''',') + '='''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	UPDATE #in SET sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so1, @q), sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so1, @q),
		gia_nt = CASE WHEN he_so1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gia_nt1/he_so1, @f) END, gia = CASE WHEN he_so1 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gia1/he_so1, @b) END
	UPDATE #in SET ma_nt = '', ty_gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_nt_x = 0, cp_nt = 0, cp_vc_nt = 0, cp_bh_nt = 0, cp_khac_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @BaseCurrency

	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF @status = '1' OR @status = '3' INSERT INTO indcsd SELECT * FROM #in
	IF @status = '2' OR @status = '3' INSERT INTO indcsd2 SELECT * FROM #in

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetAdvFilter(
	@strCursor AS VARCHAR(16), 
	@strTable AS VARCHAR(254), 
	@strJoin1 AS VARCHAR(254), 
	@strJoin2 AS VARCHAR(254), 
	@strKey AS NVARCHAR(4000)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @nNum AS INT
	SET @nNum = 0
	SET @strSQL = 'DELETE ' + @strCursor + ' FROM ' + @strCursor
	WHILE @nNum < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strTable)
		BEGIN
			SET @nNum = @nNum + 1
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' LEFT JOIN ' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strTable, @nNum)
			SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ON ' + @strCursor + '.' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strJoin1, @nNum) + ' = ' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strTable, @nNum) + '.' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strJoin2, @nNum)
		END
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@strKey)) <> ''
		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' WHERE NOT(' + @strKey + ')' + CHAR(13)
	ELSE
		SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' WHERE 1=0' + CHAR(13)
	RETURN RTRIM(LTRIM(@strSQL))
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpByDept]
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateInFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateInTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Gender CHAR(1),
	@EmpType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @m NVARCHAR(10), @f NVARCHAR(10), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @i INT, @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	SELECT @m = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001' 
	SELECT @f = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002' 
	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + '''', @Where = '', @Join = '', @Key = '', @Filter = ''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), nguoi_quan_ly NVARCHAR(128), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, ngay_den SMALLDATETIME)

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN @Key ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.ngay_nghi >' + @d1 + ' or a.ngay_nghi is null)'
	IF @DateInFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateInFrom, 112) +  + ''''
	IF @DateInTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateInTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Gender  <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Gender), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Level <> ''SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a3.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a3.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	--
	SELECT @Where = ' and a.ngay_vao <= ' + @d1 + '  and r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and ' +  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c')
	
	SELECT r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, r.nguoi_quan_ly, '1' AS tinh_chat, r.ngay_tu, r.ngay_den INTO #d FROM hreqtlvht r JOIN hrnv e ON r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec WHERE r.tinh_chat = '1' AND r.ngay_tu <= @DateTo AND (e.ngay_nghi IS NULL OR e.ngay_nghi >= @DateTo) AND ((@EmpType = '*') OR (@EmpType = '1' AND e.ngay_chinh_thuc <= @DateTo) OR (@EmpType = '2' AND (e.ngay_chinh_thuc IS NULL OR e.ngay_chinh_thuc > @DateTo)))
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.nguoi_quan_ly, r.ngay_tu, r.ngay_den from #d r left join hrnv a with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Join = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @Where = ' and ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c')

	-- Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.nv_ql, a.ngay_vao, a.ngay_nghi from hrnv a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ngay_vao <= '+ @d1 + ' and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht)' + @Where
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE @EmpType WHEN '1' THEN ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d1 + ')' WHEN '2' THEN ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Report
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, '#report', 'bo_phan'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct a.bo_phan, b.bp_me from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = max(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0) - 1
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct b.ma_bp, b.bp_me from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (b.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT '', '', bo_phan, '', '', NULL, NULL FROM #r

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #v(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #v(stt_rec, bo_phan) select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp order by b.stt_ref, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'select @x = min(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	SELECT stt, bo_phan INTO #order FROM #v WHERE stt_rec = ''

	-- Result
	SELECT @q = 'select v.stt - o.stt as stt, a.bo_phan, b.stt_ref, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + e.ten_nv as ho_va_ten, e.ngay_vao, a.ngay_tu as ngay_bp_bd, a.ngay_den as ngay_bp_kt, e.ngay_vao, rtrim(f.ho_nv) + '' '' + f.ten_nv as nguoi_quan_ly,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' space(2 * (b.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@step) + ')) + case when a.stt_rec = '''' then ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' ELSE '''' end as ten_bp,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ' c.ten_vtr' ELSE ' c.ten_vtr2' END + ' as ten_vtr,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' case when e.gioi_tinh = 1 then N''' + RTRIM(@m) + ''' when e.gioi_tinh = 2 then N''' + RTRIM(@f) + ''' else '''' end as gioi_tinh,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ' d.ten_ttnv' ELSE ' d.ten_ttnv2' END + ' as ten_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #order o on a.bo_phan = o.bo_phan left join #v v on a.stt_rec = v.stt_rec and a.bo_phan = v.bo_phan'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' Left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrdmttnv d on e.tinh_trang_nv = d.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrnv f on a.nguoi_quan_ly = f.ma_nv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt_ref, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptSIHIDeclarationExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@TypeReport TINYINT, -- 1 - QD 1111, 2 - QD 1018
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @i INT, @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @luongnn_yn CHAR(1)
	SELECT @luongnn_yn = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_si_loai_nn'

	-- stt_rec
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	
	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #$keys (text NTEXT)
		INSERT INTO #$keys SELECT @IDNumbers
	END

	DECLARE @l INT, @size INT, @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @size = COL_LENGTH('hrnv', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @i = 1, @l = DATALENGTH(text)/2 FROM #$keys
	WHILE @i + @size <= @l + 1 BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #stt_rec SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(text, @i, @size), '''', '') FROM #$keys
		  SELECT @i = @i + @size + 1
	END
	
	-- Hợp đồng lao động
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ky_hd) AS ngay_ky_hd INTO #hrcthd_1 FROM hrcthd WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_ky_hd <= @ReportDate AND stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #stt_rec) GROUP BY stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ky_hd, a.so_hdld, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.dia_diem, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chuc_vu ELSE a.chuc_vu2 END AS chuc_vu, muc_luong, phu_cap
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_loai ELSE c.ten_loai2 END AS ten_loai
		INTO #hrcthd_2 FROM hrcthd a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #hrcthd_1 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_ky_hd = b.ngay_ky_hd LEFT JOIN hrdmloaihd c ON a.loai_hd = c.ma_loai

	-- Quá trình tham gia bảo hiểm
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec, ngay_thay_doi, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_thay_doi2, can_cu, ty_le_bhxh, ty_le_bhtn, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS dien_giai
		INTO #hreqtlbhht FROM hreqtlbhht
	--
	INSERT INTO #hreqtlbhht(stt_rec, ngay_thay_doi, can_cu, ty_le_bhxh, ty_le_bhtn, dien_giai)
		SELECT stt_rec, ngay_thay_doi, can_cu, ty_le_bhxh, ty_le_bhtn	
				, CASE WHEN cap_bac = '' THEN '' ELSE cap_bac + ', ' END
					+ CASE WHEN chuc_danh = '' THEN '' ELSE chuc_danh + ', ' END
					+ CASE WHEN don_vi = '' THEN '' ELSE don_vi + ', ' END
					+ CASE WHEN dia_chi = '' THEN '' ELSE dia_chi + ', ' END
					+ CASE WHEN @luongnn_yn = '2' THEN RTRIM(luong_co_ban) ELSE RTRIM(hs_luong) + ', ' + RTRIM(hs_pc_chuc_vu) + ', ' + RTRIM(hs_pc_vuot_khung) + '%, ' + RTRIM(hs_pc_tham_nien) + '%, ' + RTRIM(hs_pc_khu_vuc)
				END 
			FROM hreqtlbhht WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_thay_doi <= @ReportDate AND stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #stt_rec)
			ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_thay_doi
	--
	UPDATE #hreqtlbhht SET ngay_thay_doi2 = b.ngay_thay_doi
		FROM #hreqtlbhht a JOIN (SElECT stt_rec, stt - 1 AS stt, ngay_thay_doi FROM #hreqtlbhht) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv as ho_va_ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh'
	SET @q = @q + ', e.ten_dt%l as dan_toc'
	SET @q = @q + ', f.ten_qt%l as quoc_tich'
	
	IF @TypeReport = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_th_tru + '', '' + g.ten_quan%l + '', '' + h.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_th_tru'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_ht + '', '' + g2.ten_quan%l + '', '' + h2.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_ht'	
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_th_tru, a.dia_chi_th_tru_so, a.dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, h.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, g.ten_quan%l as dia_chi_th_tru_quan'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_ht, a.dia_chi_ht_so, a.dia_chi_ht_phuong, h2.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_ht_tinh, g2.ten_quan%l as dia_chi_ht_quan'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.que_quan, a.que_quan_so, a.que_quan_phuong, h3.ten_tinh%l as que_quan_tinh, g3.ten_quan%l as que_quan_quan, a.giam_ho, a.nguoi_than, a.email_cty'
	END

	SET @q = @q + ', a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, a.cmnd_so, cmnd_ngay_hl as ngay_cap_cmnd'
	SET @q = @q + ', k.ten_tinh%l as noi_cap_cmnd'
	SET @q = @q + ', c.so_hdld, c.ngay_ky_hd, c.ngay_hl_tu, c.dia_diem as dia_diem_lv, c.chuc_vu, c.muc_luong, c.phu_cap, c.ten_loai'
	SET @q = @q + ', l.dai_dien_cty%l as dai_dien_cty, l.dia_chi'
	SET @q = @q + ', m.si_no as so_bhxh, m.hi_no as so_bhyt, m.noi_kham, m.quyen_loi'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(month(d.ngay_thay_doi), 2), '' '', ''0'') + ''/'' + rtrim(year(d.ngay_thay_doi)) as tu_thang_nam, replace(str(month(d.ngay_thay_doi2), 2), '' '', ''0'') + ''/'' + rtrim(year(d.ngay_thay_doi2)) as den_thang_nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', d.dien_giai, d.can_cu, d.ty_le_bhxh, d.ty_le_bhtn'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(''' + STR(DAY(@ReportDate), 2)+ ''', '' '', ''0'') as ngay_bc, replace(''' + STR(MONTH(@ReportDate), 2) + ''', '' '', ''0'') as thang_bc, ''' + RTRIM(YEAR(@ReportDate)) + ''' as nam_bc'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join #hrcthd_2 c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join #hreqtlbhht d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmdt e with(nolock) on a.dan_toc = e.ma_dt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmqt f with(nolock) on f.ma_qt = a.quoc_tich'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g with(nolock) on g.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan and g.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h with(nolock) on h.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g2 with(nolock) on g2.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_ht_quan and g2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h2 with(nolock) on h2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
	IF @TypeReport <> 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g3 with(nolock) on g3.ma_quan = a.que_quan_quan and g3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
		SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h3 with(nolock) on h3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh k with(nolock) on k.ma_tinh = a.cmnd_noi_cap'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrtthd l with(nolock) on l.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrttbh m with(nolock) on m.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #stt_rec)'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdcbpsddc]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_dc, b.ten_dc2, c.ten_bp AS ten_bp_tu, c.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp_tu2,
		  d.ten_bp AS ten_bp_den, d.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp_den2
		FROM dcbpsddc a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			LEFT JOIN dmbpcc c ON a.ma_bp_tu = c.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dmbpcc d ON a.ma_bp_den = d.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rpt05KK]--rs_rpt05KK
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@bug char(1) = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @dvt1 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt2 NVARCHAR(16), @dvt3 NVARCHAR(16), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT

	SELECT @dvt1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TXDVT01'
	SELECT @dvt2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TXDVT02'
	SELECT @dvt3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TXDVT03'

	SELECT ma_so, stt, stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, gia_tri, gia_tri AS gia_tri_nt, cach_tinh, truy_van
			, truy_van2, iscal, bold, ng_yn, CASE WHEN ng_yn = 1 THEN @dvt1 ELSE @dvt2 END AS dvt
			, CASE WHEN ng_yn = 1 THEN @dvt1 ELSE @dvt3 END AS dvt_nt, subreport, ids
		INTO #Report FROM t05kk
		WHERE form = @Form --TT156

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) GOTO Result

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, stt_rec AS ma_ns, f004_nt, f005_nt, f010_nt, f011_nt, f012_nt, f013_nt, f014_nt, f015_nt, f016_nt, f017_nt, f018_nt
		, f019_nt, f020_nt, f021_nt, f022_nt, f023_nt, f024_nt, f053_nt, f054_nt, f049_nt, f037_nt, f038_nt, f004, f005, f010, f011, f012, f013, f014, f015, f016, f017, f018, f019
		, f020, f021, f022, f023, f024, f009, f009_nt, f042, f044, f053, f054, f049, f037, f038
		, f061_nt, f061, f062_nt, f062, f050_nt, f050, f051_nt, f051, f052_nt, f052, f056_nt, f056, f057_nt, f057, f058_nt, f058, f060_nt, f060, f069_nt, f069, f001_nt AS so_npt_gt
		INTO #t03 FROM hrt03$0000
	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#Report', @UserID, @Admin, default

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'f005 + f005_nt + f018 + f018_nt > 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN @UnitKey ELSE ' and ' + @UnitKey END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #t03 select a.ma_dvcs, a.stt_rec'
			+ ', a.f004_nt, a.f005_nt, a.f010_nt, a.f011_nt, a.f012_nt, a.f013_nt, a.f014_nt, a.f015_nt, a.f016_nt, a.f017_nt, a.f018_nt, a.f019_nt'
			+ ', a.f020_nt, a.f021_nt, a.f022_nt, a.f023_nt, a.f024_nt, a.f053_nt, a.f054_nt, a.f049_nt, a.f037_nt, a.f038_nt, a.f004, a.f005, a.f010, a.f011, a.f012, a.f013, a.f014, a.f015, a.f016'
			+ ', a.f017, a.f018, a.f019, a.f020, a.f021, a.f022, a.f023, a.f024, a.f009, a.f009_nt, a.f042, a.f044, a.f053, a.f054, a.f049, a.f037, a.f038'
			+ ', f061_nt, f061, f062_nt, f062, f050_nt, f050, f051_nt, f051, f052_nt, f052, f056_nt, f056, f057_nt, f057, f058_nt, f058, f060_nt, f060, f069_nt, f069, 0'
		+ ' from hrt03$' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE @Join + ' where ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #t03 SET so_npt_gt = b.so_npt FROM #t03 a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, COUNT(DISTINCT(ma_pt)) AS so_npt FROM hrttctpt WHERE YEAR(ngay_hl_tu) <= @Year AND (YEAR(ngay_hl_den) = @Year OR ngay_hl_den IS NULL) GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.ma_ns = b.stt_rec

	-- cập nhật gia_tri, gia_tri_nt vào bảng #report
	DECLARE @truy_van VARCHAR(4000), @truy_van2 VARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024), @iscal INT
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE iscal = 0 ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_so = REPLACE(@ma_so, '''', ''''''), @truy_van = REPLACE(@truy_van, '''', ''''''), @truy_van2 = REPLACE(@truy_van2, '''', '''''')

		SET @q = 'update #report set gia_tri = (' + @truy_van + '), gia_tri_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + ') where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%$table$', '#t03')
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set gia_tri = 0 where gia_tri is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set gia_tri_nt = 0 where gia_tri_nt is null and ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	END
	CLOSE cur
	DEALLOCATE cur

	-- Begin Adjust
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, b.truy_van, b.truy_van2, a.tien, a.tien_nt INTO #s1 FROM t05kk_luu a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
	SET @q = 'insert into #s1 select a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, b.truy_van, b.truy_van2, a.tien, a.tien_nt from t05kk_luu a join #report b on replace(replace(b.ma_so, ''['', ''''), '']'', '''') = a.ma_so where b.cach_tinh = '''' and a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year)+ CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #s1) BEGIN
		DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @gt NUMERIC(28, 6), @gt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT RTRIM(Ma_so), RTRIM(ma_dvcs), MAX(truy_van), MAX(truy_van2) FROM #s1 WHERE CHARINDEX('%$table$', truy_van) <> 0 GROUP BY ma_so, ma_dvcs
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @truy_van, @truy_van2
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @gt = 0, @gt_nt = 0
			SELECT @Ma_dvcs = REPLACE(@Ma_dvcs, '''', ''''''), @truy_van = REPLACE(@truy_van, '''', ''''''), @truy_van2 = REPLACE(@truy_van2, '''', '''''')

			SELECT @s = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('WHERE', @truy_van) <> 0 THEN ' and ma_dvcs =' ELSE ' where ma_dvcs = ' END + '''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''''
			SELECT @q = 'select @gt = (' + @truy_van + @s + '), @gt_nt = (' + @truy_van2 + @s + ')'
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%$table$', '#t03')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@gt NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT, @gt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6) OUTPUT', @gt OUTPUT, @gt_nt OUTPUT
			UPDATE #report SET gia_tri = gia_tri - ISNULL(@gt, 0), gia_tri_nt = gia_tri_nt - ISNULL(@gt_nt, 0) WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(ma_so, '[', ''), ']', '') = @Ma_so

			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @truy_van, @truy_van2
		END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		SET @q = 'select ma_so, sum(tien) as tien, sum(tien_nt) as tien_nt into #s2 from #s1 group by ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set gia_tri = a.gia_tri + b.tien, gia_tri_nt = a.gia_tri_nt + b.tien_nt from #report a join #s2 b on REPLACE(REPLACE(a.ma_so, ''['', ''''), '']'', '''') = b.ma_so'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	-- End Adjust

	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, iscal, truy_van, truy_van2 FROM #report WHERE iscal <> 0 AND cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')

		SET @q = 'update #report set gia_tri = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select gia_tri from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
		SET @q = @q + ', gia_tri_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@cach_tinh, '[', '(select gia_tri_nt from #report where ma_so = ''['), ']', ']'')')
		SET @q = @q + ' where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''''
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @ma_so, @cach_tinh, @iscal, @truy_van, @truy_van2
	END
	CLOSE cur
	DEALLOCATE cur

	Result:
	SELECT ma_so, stt, stt_in, chi_tieu, ISNULL(gia_tri, 0) AS gia_tri, ISNULL(gia_tri_nt, 0) AS gia_tri_nt, dvt, dvt_nt, ng_yn, bold, subreport FROM #report ORDER BY stt, ma_so
	SELECT ma_so, stt, stt_in, chi_tieu, ISNULL(gia_tri, 0) AS gia_tri, ISNULL(gia_tri_nt, 0) AS gia_tri_nt, dvt, dvt_nt, ng_yn, bold, subreport FROM #report WHERE subreport = 2 ORDER BY stt, ma_so

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$CD]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTableBPC VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTableBPC VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumberBPC CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @voucherCode CHAR(3), @sourceTable VARCHAR(32), @tableName VARCHAR(32), @ctableName VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dn, tien_nt INTO #afterUpdateCD FROM d51$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec_dh, tien_nt, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh INTO #afterUpdateBPC FROM d52$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdateCD select stt_rec_dn, tien_nt from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dn <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	
	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdateBPC select stt_rec, stt_rec_dh, 0, '''' from ' + @detailTableBPC + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumberBPC, '''', '') + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @voucherCode = RIGHT(stt_rec_dh, 3) FROM #afterUpdateBPC
	SELECT @sourceTable = CASE WHEN @voucherCode = 'PO1' THEN '94$' WHEN @voucherCode = 'PO2' THEN '95$' ELSE '06$' END
		, @tableName = CASE WHEN @voucherCode = 'PA2' THEN 'bim' ELSE 'm' END
		, @ctableName = CASE WHEN @voucherCode = 'PA2' THEN 'bic' ELSE 'c' END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdateBPC) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdateBPC WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #afterUpdateBPC set dyn_dh = rtrim(convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112)) from #afterUpdateBPC a join ' + @ctableName + @sourceTable + '000000 b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec'
		SET @s = @s + ' update #afterUpdateBPC set tien_nt = b.tien_nt from #afterUpdateBPC a join #afterUpdateCD b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_dn'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update Down Payment in PO
	DECLARE @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT @cPOIDNumber = stt_rec_dh, @nAmount = tien_nt, @dyn_dh = dyn_dh FROM #afterUpdateBPC
	
	SET @s = 'update ' + @tableName + @sourceTable + @dyn_dh + ' set tien_da_ut = tien_da_ut + @nAmount where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
	SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@nAmount',  RTRIM(@nAmount))
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrekt]

SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.noi_bo_yn, a.hinh_thuc, a.cap_quyet_dinh, a.bac_kt, a.so_quyet_dinh, a.ngay_ky, a.nguoi_ky, a.ly_do, a.tien, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr,

	FROM hrekt AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN hrdmkt AS b ON a.hinh_thuc = b.ma_kt
