CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialStructureAnalysisCorrePeriod] -- [fs_FinancialStructureAnalysis4MultiYear]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@PeriodCount INT,
	@ReportType TINYINT, -- 1 Chi tiết, 2 - tổng hợp
	@Unit VARCHAR(512), 
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #t1 FROM gltcpt11 WHERE form = @Form
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t1', @UserID, @Admin
	
	-- Giá trị
	INSERT INTO #t1 EXEC rs_rptFinancialStructureAnalysisTemplate @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, 0, @periodCount, @reportType, @Unit, @Form, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	
	-- Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu cho đánh giá
	SELECT ma_so, cot, chu INTO #gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99
		WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearTo AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = @periodCount AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '12'
	IF @Language = 'V' UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '1'
		ELSE UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '2'

	DECLARE @Tt NVARCHAR(1024), @Td_in NVARCHAR(1024), @Tt_in NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @Tt = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'RPT039'
	SELECT @Td_in = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT06'
	SELECT @Tt_in = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT07'
	
	SELECT 1 AS xType, stt, in_ck, ma_so, bold, ISNULL(ts, 0) AS gt, kind, period, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, danh_gia
		INTO #t2 FROM #t1
	INSERT INTO #t2
		SELECT 2 AS xtype, stt, in_ck, ma_so, bold, ISNULL(gt, 0), kind, period, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, danh_gia
			FROM #t1

	-- View
	SELECT xType, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN bold = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, ma_so AS xRow, bold, chi_tieu, danh_gia, gt, 0 as ts, kind, period AS xperiod, ma_so
			, RTRIM(@YearTo - period + 1) AS xPeriodName
			, RTRIM(xType) + REPLACE(STR(period, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn
			, CASE WHEN xType = '1' THEN @Td_in ELSE @Tt_in END AS xTypeName
		FROM #t2 ORDER BY xType, period, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, period, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS header, xtype INTO #pivot FROM #t2 GROUP BY period, xtype ORDER BY xtype, period
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = 'gt$' + RTRIM(id), header = CASE WHEN xtype = 1 THEN RTRIM(@YearTo - period + 1) ELSE REPLACE(@Tt, '%s', RTRIM(@YearTo - period + 1)) END
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoGenerateStocktakingChecking]
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1 - Chênh lệch thiếu, 2 - Chênh lệch thừa
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Action CHAR(1), -- 1 - New, 2 - Delete
	@Field VARCHAR(64) = '' OUT,
	@Message NVARCHAR(512) = '' OUT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @voucherCode CHAR(3), @table VARCHAR(32), @$lockedDate NVARCHAR(512), @d SMALLDATETIME, @p VARCHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @voucherCode = CASE @Type WHEN '1' THEN 'PXA' ELSE 'PND' END,
			@table = CASE @Type WHEN '1' THEN '84$' ELSE '74$' END,
			@$lockedDate = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày giới hạn hoặc ngày khóa sổ.' ELSE N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' END,
			@IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''')

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	CREATE TABLE #p (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #res (stt_rec VARCHAR(32))

	-- Access Right
	IF @admin <> 1 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND (r_new = 1 OR @Action = 2) AND (r_del = 1 OR @Action = 1)) BEGIN
			SELECT @field = 'ma_dvcs', @message = '$NotAuthorized'
			RETURN
		END
	END


	--
	IF @Action = '1' BEGIN
		-- Locked Date
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Date BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
			SELECT @field = 'ngay_ct', @message = @$lockedDate
			RETURN
		END

		INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @voucherCode, @Date, @UserID, @Unit, 1
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @field = 'ngay_ct', @message = @$lockedDate
			RETURN
		END
		--
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttd WHERE stt_rec_yc = @IDNumber AND ma_ct = CASE @Type WHEN '1' THEN 'PXA' ELSE 'PND' END) BEGIN
			SELECT @field = '',
				@message = CASE @Language
					WHEN 'V' THEN
						CASE @Type
							WHEN '1' THEN N'Đã tồn tại phiếu xuất chênh lệch kiểm kê tự động trong kỳ.'
							ELSE N'Đã tồn tại phiếu nhập chênh lệch kiểm kê tự động trong kỳ.' END
					ELSE
						CASE @Type
							WHEN '1' THEN N'The auto-generated issue already exists in period.'
							ELSE N'The auto-generated receipt already exists in period.'
						END
					END
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from c' + RTRIM(@table) + '000000 a with(nolock) where a.ma_dvcs = @Unit and exists(select 1 from cttd b where b.stt_rec_yc = @IDNumber and a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Unit varchar(32), @IDNumber varchar(32)', @Unit, @IDNumber
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			--
			SELECT @q = 'select @d = min(b.ngay_ct) from d' + RTRIM(@table) + @p + ' a left join m' + RTRIM(@table) + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				where rtrim(b.loai_ct) = ''2'' and rtrim(b.ma_gd) = ''5'' and b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and exists(select 1 from cttd c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)'
				+ CASE @Site WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' and a.ma_kho like rtrim(@Site) + ''%''' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime output, @Unit varchar(32), @Site varchar(32)', @d OUTPUT, @Unit, @Site
			--
			IF @d IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @d BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
					SELECT @field = 'ngay_ct', @message = @$lockedDate
					RETURN
				END
				TRUNCATE TABLE #lockedDate
				INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @voucherCode, @d, @UserID, @Unit, 1
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
					SELECT @field = 'ngay_ct', @message = @$lockedDate
					RETURN
				END
			END
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p WHERE p > @p
		END
	END
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMMultiPeriodSummary]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@AppraisalType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @ky NVARCHAR(1024), @diem_tb NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @ky = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @diem_tb = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM039'

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, a.ma_ky, a.nam, b.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_nv, a.t_diem_nv_dg AS diem INTO #report FROM hrdgth a, hrnv b

	SET @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END
	SET @Key = @Key + 'r.nam * 100 + r.ma_ky between ' + RTRIM(@YearFrom * 100 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@YearTo * 100 + @PeriodTo)
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 0, r.ma_ky, r.nam, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @AppraisalType = '1' THEN 'r.t_diem_nv_dg' ELSE 'r.t_diem_ql_dg' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrdgth r with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec_nv = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Avg. Column
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, 0, 0, a.ma_nv, MAX(a.ten_nv), CASE WHEN ISNULL(MAX(b.so_cot), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(a.diem)/MAX(b.so_cot) END
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_nv, COUNT(*) AS so_cot FROM #report WHERE diem > 0 GROUP BY ma_nv) b ON a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv
		GROUP BY a.ma_nv

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_nv INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY ma_nv ORDER BY ma_nv
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, 0, 0, ' ', ' ', 0
	
	-- Report
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt, ma_nv, ten_nv, diem, RTRIM(nam) + REPLACE(STR(ma_ky, 2), ' ', '0') AS xoay
			, CASE WHEN nam = 0 THEN @diem_tb ELSE @ky + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_ky) + '/' + RTRIM(nam) END AS ten_xoay
		FROM #report ORDER BY ma_nv, xoay

	-- Pivot
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS header INTO #pivot
	INSERT INTO #pivot(name, header) SELECT '', @diem_tb
	INSERT INTO #pivot(name, header) SELECT '', @Ky + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_ky) + '/' + RTRIM(nam) FROM #report WHERE nam <> 0 GROUP BY nam, ma_ky ORDER BY nam, ma_ky
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = 'diem$' + RTRIM(id)
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id
	
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$GetUnitMenuRight]
	@SysData VARCHAR(64),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Type TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	CREATE TABLE #t(wmenu_id CHAR(8), menu_id CHAR(8), wmenu_id0 CHAR(8), bar NVARCHAR(128), bar2 NVARCHAR(128), ideny BIT, idisable BIT)
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select wmenu_id, menu_id, wmenu_id0, bar, bar2, 0, 0 from ' + RTRIM(@SysData) + '..wcommand'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM denyunitright WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit) BEGIN
		UPDATE #t SET ideny = 1 FROM #t a JOIN (SELECT r_deny FROM denyunitright WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit) b ON 1 = 1 WHERE PATINDEX('%' + RTRIM(a.wmenu_id) + '%', b.r_deny) > 0
	END
	SET @q = 'update #t set idisable = 1 where wmenu_id in (select wmenu_id from ' + RTRIM(@SysData) + '..wcommand with(nolock) where sysid = ''MenuManagement'' or sysid = ''DenyUnitRight'')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT * FROM #t ORDER BY wmenu_id
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2SituationDetail]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@period2 INT,
	@year2 INT,
	@tsType VARCHAR(32),
	@tsDept VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@tsGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@isDetail BIT, -- 1 - Detail by Department, 0 - None
	@order VARCHAR(254),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cFC VARCHAR(32), @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nMPrev INT, @nYPrev INT, @c VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @c = ''
	SELECT @cFC = val FROM Options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year), @dTo = DATEADD(month, 1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period2, @year2)) - 1
	IF @period = 1
		SELECT @nMPrev = 12, @nYPrev = @year - 1
	ELSE
		SELECT @nMPrev = @period - 1, @nYPrev = @year

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc, ten_dc, loai_dc, ngay_tang, so_ky_pb, gt_pb_ky1, gt_pb_ky_nt1, ma_nt, ty_gia INTO #dmccdc FROM dmccdc
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc INTO #dmccdc0 FROM dmccdc
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, a.ma_dc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp_dc
			, a.so_luong AS sl_dk
			, a.nguyen_gia AS ng_dk, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS ng_dk_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb AS da_pb_dk, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS da_pb_dk_nt
			, a.gt_cl AS cl_dk, a.gt_cl_nt AS cl_dk_nt

			, a.gt_pb_ky AS gt_pb_ky, a.gt_pb_ky_nt AS gt_pb_ky_nt

			, a.so_luong AS sl_nhap, a.so_luong AS sl_xuat
			, a.nguyen_gia AS ng_tang, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS ng_tang_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb AS da_pb_tang, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS da_pb_tang_nt
			, a.gt_cl AS cl_tang, a.gt_cl_nt AS cl_tang_nt
			, a.nguyen_gia AS ng_giam, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS ng_giam_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb AS da_pb_giam, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS da_pb_giam_nt
			, a.gt_cl AS cl_giam, a.gt_cl_nt AS cl_giam_nt

			, a.so_luong AS sl_ck
			, a.nguyen_gia AS ng_ck, a.nguyen_gia_nt AS ng_ck_nt
			, a.gt_da_pb AS da_pb_ck, a.gt_da_pb_nt AS da_pb_ck_nt
			, a.gt_cl AS cl_ck, a.gt_cl_nt AS cl_ck_nt
		INTO #temp FROM ctcddc a
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_dc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_dc2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp_dc, b.loai_dc, b.so_ky_pb, b.gt_pb_ky1, b.gt_pb_ky_nt1, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia
			, a.sl_dk, a.ng_dk, a.ng_dk_nt, a.da_pb_dk, a.da_pb_dk_nt, a.cl_dk, a.cl_dk_nt
			, a.gt_pb_ky, a.gt_pb_ky_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_pb_bq, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_pb_bq_nt
			, a.sl_nhap, a.ng_tang, a.ng_tang_nt, a.da_pb_tang, a.da_pb_tang_nt, a.cl_tang, a.cl_tang_nt
			, a.sl_xuat, a.ng_giam, a.ng_giam_nt, a.da_pb_giam, a.da_pb_giam_nt, a.cl_giam, a.cl_giam_nt
			, a.sl_ck, a.ng_ck, a.ng_ck_nt, a.da_pb_ck, a.da_pb_ck_nt, a.cl_ck, a.cl_ck_nt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS xGroup
		INTO #report
		FROM #temp a, #dmccdc b

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = '', @key2 = '', @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	IF @tsType <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup1 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup2 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsGroup3 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@tsGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @tsDept <> '' SELECT @key2 = ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @unitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #dmccdc
			select a.ma_dc, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'a.ten_dc' ELSE 'a.ten_dc2' END + ',
					a.loai_dc, a.ngay_tang, a.so_ky_pb, a.gt_pb_ky1, a.gt_pb_ky_nt1, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
				from dmccdc a with(nolock)' +
				CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @key ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Begin Period
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp (sysorder, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, sl_dk, ng_dk, ng_dk_nt, da_pb_dk, da_pb_dk_nt, cl_dk, cl_dk_nt)
			select 0, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				from ctcddc a with(nolock)
				where
					exists(select 1 from #dmccdc b where a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc) and
					a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@nMPrev) + ' and
					a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYPrev) + @key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising Period
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp (sysorder, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, ng_tang, ng_tang_nt, da_pb_tang, da_pb_tang_nt, cl_tang, cl_tang_nt, ng_giam, ng_giam_nt, da_pb_giam, da_pb_giam_nt, cl_giam, cl_giam_nt)
			select 1, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n,
					gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x,
					case when ((''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + ''' = '''') and (' + RTRIM(@isDetail) + ' = 0)) then nguyen_gia_x else gt_da_pb_x end,
					case when ((''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + ''' = '''') and (' + RTRIM(@isDetail) + ' = 0)) then nguyen_gia_nt_x else gt_da_pb_nt_x end,
					case when ((''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + ''' = '''') and (' + RTRIM(@isDetail) + ' = 0)) then 0 else gt_cl_x end,
					case when ((''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@tsDept, '''', '''''')) + ''' = '''') and (' + RTRIM(@isDetail) + ' = 0)) then 0 else gt_cl_nt_x end
				from ctpsdc a with(nolock)
				where
					exists(select 1 from #dmccdc b where a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc) and
					(ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''')' +
					CASE WHEN ((@tsDept = '') AND (@isDetail = 0)) THEN ' and a.loai_ps <> 1' ELSE '' END + @key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Allocate Period
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp (sysorder,ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt)
			select 2, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, isnull(gt_pb_ky, 0) + isnull(cl_giam, 0), isnull(gt_pb_ky_nt, 0) + isnull(cl_giam_nt, 0)
				from ctcddc a with(nolock)
				where
					exists(select 1 from #dmccdc b where a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc) and
					((a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between (' + RTRIM(@year * 12 + @period) + ') and (' + RTRIM(@year2 * 12 + @period2) +  '))'
	SET @q = @q + @key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- End Period
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp (sysorder,ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, sl_ck, ng_ck, ng_ck_nt, da_pb_ck, da_pb_ck_nt, cl_ck, cl_ck_nt)
			select 3, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				from ctcddc a with(nolock)
				where
					exists(select 1 from #dmccdc b where a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc)  and
					a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period2) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year2) + @key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Begin Period Special
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp (sysorder, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, sl_dk, ng_dk, ng_dk_nt, da_pb_dk, da_pb_dk_nt, cl_dk, cl_dk_nt)
			select 0, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
				from dmdcct a
				where exists(select 1 from #temp b where a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc and sysorder <> 0) and
					not exists(select 1 from #temp c where a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc and sysorder = 0) and
					not exists(select 1 from ctcddc d where a.ma_dc = d.ma_dc and (nam * 12 + ky) <(' + RTRIM(@year * 12 + @period) + ')) and
					exists(select 1 from #dmccdc e where a.ma_dc = e.ma_dc and year(e.ngay_tang) * 12 + month(e.ngay_tang) < (' + RTRIM(@year * 12 + @period) + ')) ' + @key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	IF @isDetail = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @c = SPACE(2)
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 6, 1, 2, NULL
				, a.ma_dc, @c + MAX(b.ten_bp), @c + MAX(b.ten_bp2), a.ma_bp_dc, MAX(c.loai_dc), NULL, MAX(c.gt_pb_ky1), MAX(c.gt_pb_ky_nt1), '', NULL
				, SUM(a.sl_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_dk), SUM(a.da_pb_dk_nt), SUM(a.cl_dk), SUM(a.cl_dk_nt)
				, SUM(a.gt_pb_ky), SUM(a.gt_pb_ky_nt), 0, 0
				, SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.ng_tang), SUM(a.ng_tang_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_tang), SUM(a.da_pb_tang_nt), SUM(a.cl_tang), SUM(a.cl_tang_nt)
				, SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.ng_giam), SUM(a.ng_giam_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_giam), SUM(a.da_pb_giam_nt), SUM(a.cl_giam), SUM(a.cl_giam_nt)
				, SUM(a.sl_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_ck), SUM(a.da_pb_ck_nt), SUM(a.cl_ck), SUM(a.cl_ck_nt)
				, a.ma_dc
			FROM #temp a JOIN dmbpcc b ON a.ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp JOIN #dmccdc c ON a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc
			GROUP BY a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc
		--
		UPDATE #report SET gt_pb_bq = ROUND((ISNULL(sl_dk, 0) + ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0) - ISNULL(sl_xuat, 0))*gt_pb_ky1, @nRound)
			, gt_pb_bq_nt = ROUND((ISNULL(sl_dk, 0) + ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0) - ISNULL(sl_xuat, 0))*gt_pb_ky_nt1, @nFCRound)
			, cl_giam = ng_giam - da_pb_giam, cl_giam_nt = ng_giam_nt - da_pb_giam_nt
		--
		SELECT xGroup, COUNT(*) AS line INTO #t FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup
		DELETE #report FROM #report a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t b WHERE a.xGroup = b.xGroup AND b.line = 1)
		INSERT INTO #dmccdc0 SELECT DISTINCT ma_dc FROM #report
	END

	--
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, MAX(b.ten_dc), MAX(b.ten_dc), MAX(a.ma_bp_dc), MAX(b.loai_dc), MAX(b.so_ky_pb), MAX(b.gt_pb_ky1), MAX(b.gt_pb_ky_nt1), MAX(b.ma_nt), MAX(b.ty_gia)
			, SUM(a.sl_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_dk), SUM(a.da_pb_dk_nt), SUM(a.cl_dk), SUM(a.cl_dk_nt)
			, SUM(a.gt_pb_ky), SUM(a.gt_pb_ky_nt), 0, 0
			, SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.ng_tang), SUM(a.ng_tang_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_tang), SUM(a.da_pb_tang_nt), SUM(a.cl_tang), SUM(a.cl_tang_nt)
			, SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.ng_giam), SUM(a.ng_giam_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_giam), SUM(a.da_pb_giam_nt), SUM(a.cl_giam), SUM(a.cl_giam_nt)
			, SUM(a.sl_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_ck), SUM(a.da_pb_ck_nt), SUM(a.cl_ck), SUM(a.cl_ck_nt)
			, a.ma_dc
		FROM #temp a JOIN #dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
		WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmccdc0 c WHERE a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc)
		GROUP BY a.ma_dc
	UPDATE #report SET gt_pb_bq = ROUND((ISNULL(sl_dk, 0) + ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0) - ISNULL(sl_xuat, 0))*gt_pb_ky1, @nRound), gt_pb_bq_nt = ROUND((ISNULL(sl_dk, 0) + ISNULL(sl_nhap, 0))*gt_pb_ky_nt1, @nFCRound), cl_giam = ng_giam - da_pb_giam, cl_giam_nt = ng_giam_nt - da_pb_giam_nt WHERE sysorder = 5
	--
	IF @isDetail = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmccdc0) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, MAX(b.ten_dc), MAX(b.ten_dc), '', MAX(b.loai_dc), MAX(b.so_ky_pb), MAX(b.gt_pb_ky1), MAX(b.gt_pb_ky_nt1), MAX(b.ma_nt), MAX(b.ty_gia)
				, SUM(a.sl_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk), SUM(a.ng_dk_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_dk), SUM(a.da_pb_dk_nt), SUM(a.cl_dk), SUM(a.cl_dk_nt)
				, SUM(a.gt_pb_ky), SUM(a.gt_pb_ky_nt), SUM(a.gt_pb_bq), SUM(a.gt_pb_bq_nt)
				, SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.ng_tang), SUM(a.ng_tang_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_tang), SUM(a.da_pb_tang_nt), SUM(a.cl_tang), SUM(a.cl_tang_nt)
				, SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.ng_giam), SUM(a.ng_giam_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_giam), SUM(a.da_pb_giam_nt), SUM(a.cl_giam), SUM(a.cl_giam_nt)
				, SUM(a.sl_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck), SUM(a.ng_ck_nt), SUM(a.da_pb_ck), SUM(a.da_pb_ck_nt), SUM(a.cl_ck), SUM(a.cl_ck_nt)
				, a.ma_dc
			FROM #report a JOIN #dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			WHERE a.sysorder = 6
			GROUP BY a.ma_dc
		UPDATE #report SET ma_dc = '' WHERE sysorder = 6
	END
	--
	UPDATE #report SET ng_dk_nt = 0, da_pb_dk_nt = 0, cl_dk_nt = 0, gt_pb_bq_nt = 0, gt_pb_ky_nt = 0, ng_tang_nt = 0, da_pb_tang_nt = 0, cl_tang_nt = 0, ng_giam_nt = 0, da_pb_giam_nt = 0, cl_giam_nt = 0, ng_ck_nt = 0, da_pb_ck_nt = 0, cl_ck_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cFC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	-- Group/Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString('loai_dc', 'sysorder, ma_dc' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order END + CASE WHEN @isDetail = 1 THEN ', ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'loai_dc', @o, '#report', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup2 ('loai_dc', 'ma_dc', 'ten_dc', 'ma_loai', 'ten_loai',
			'sl_dk, ng_dk, ng_dk_nt, da_pb_dk, da_pb_dk_nt, cl_dk, cl_dk_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt, gt_pb_bq, gt_pb_bq_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, ng_tang, ng_tang_nt, da_pb_tang, da_pb_tang_nt, cl_tang, cl_tang_nt, ng_giam,ng_giam_nt, da_pb_giam, da_pb_giam_nt, cl_giam, cl_giam_nt, sl_ck, ng_ck, ng_ck_nt, da_pb_ck, da_pb_ck_nt, cl_ck, cl_ck_nt',
		'#report', 'dmplcc', '0')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dc', 'sl_dk, ng_dk, ng_dk_nt, da_pb_dk, da_pb_dk_nt, cl_dk, cl_dk_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt, gt_pb_bq, gt_pb_bq_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, ng_tang, ng_tang_nt, da_pb_tang, da_pb_tang_nt, cl_tang, cl_tang_nt, ng_giam,ng_giam_nt, da_pb_giam, da_pb_giam_nt, cl_giam, cl_giam_nt, sl_ck, ng_ck, ng_ck_nt, da_pb_ck, da_pb_ck_nt, cl_ck, cl_ck_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Not Exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN
		DELETE #report
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	END

	-- View
	SET @q = 'select * from #report order by loai_dc, xGroup, sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order END + CASE WHEN @isDetail = 1 THEN ', ma_bp_dc' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vsyssiterights]
AS
	SELECT b.id, b.name, b.comment, b.user_yn, a.ma_kho, c.ten_kho, c.ten_kho2--, a.r_access --CAST(ISNULL(b.r_access, 0) AS BIT) AS r_access
		FROM syssiterights2 a LEFT JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id = b.id LEFT JOIN dmkho c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintCPTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@PrintCD CHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Bilingual CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@printCharge BIT = 0,
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @Debit NVARCHAR(128), @Credit NVARCHAR(128), @Debit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Credit2 NVARCHAR(128), @Desc INT
	DECLARE @m_use_ebanking CHAR(1)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_use_ebanking = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_ebanking'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Debit = cname, @Debit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT053'
	SELECT @Credit = cname, @Credit2 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT054'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, stt_rec, tk_no, tt AS tien, tt_nt AS tien_nt, tt, tt_nt, line_nbr, tt AS thue, tt_nt AS thue_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkcddetail
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, dien_giai AS ten_kh, dien_giai AS ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX, dien_giai AS dien_giaiX2
			, t_tt AS tien, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2
			, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam, CAST(0 AS INT) AS line_nbr
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS tennh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS tennh2, CAST('' AS CHAR(32)) AS tknh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(48)) AS tinhthanh, CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS lien
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS tenkh, CAST('' AS CHAR(24)) AS tk_nh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ngan_hang, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tinh_thanh
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS chuoi_ty_gia, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #report FROM wrkcdtran

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, rtrim(a.ong_ba), rtrim(b.ten_kh), rtrim(b.ten_kh2), a.dia_chi, ' + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_009' AND val = '1') THEN 'a.dien_giai' ELSE 'd.dien_giai' END  + ', N''' + REPLACE(@Credit, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@Credit2, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2'
	SET @q = @q + ' , a.so_ct_goc, a.dien_giai_ct_goc, a.ma_nk, ltrim(a.so_ct), a.tk, a.ty_gia, a.ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' , replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' , isnull(c.ten_nh,'''') as tennh, isnull(c.ten_nh2,'''') as tennh2, isnull(c.tknh,'''') as tknh, isnull(c.tinh_thanh,'''') as tinhthanh, ''1'''
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@m_use_ebanking, '0') = '1' THEN ' , isnull(d.chu_tk, case when b.nguoi_thu_huong <> '''' then b.nguoi_thu_huong else b.ten_kh end) as tenkh, isnull(d.tk_nh, b.tk_nh) as tk_nh, isnull(d.ten_nh, b.ngan_hang) as ngan_hang, isnull(d.tinh_thanh, b.tinh_thanh) as tinh_thanh' ELSE ' , isnull(d.ten_kh, case when b.nguoi_thu_huong <> '''' then b.nguoi_thu_huong else b.ten_kh end) as tenkh, isnull(d.tk_nh, b.tk_nh) as tk_nh, isnull(d.ngan_hang, b.ngan_hang) as ngan_hang, isnull(d.tinh_thanh, b.tinh_thanh) as tinh_thanh' END
	SET @q = @q + ' , dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatStringValue(a.ty_gia), a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m56$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtknh c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk and (c.ma_dvcs = '''' or a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs) left join ' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@m_use_ebanking, '0') = '1' THEN 'knnh00$%Partition' ELSE 'p56' END + ' d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @PrintCD = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 2, stt_rec, tk_no, tt - thue, tt_nt - thue_nt, tt, tt_nt, line_nbr, 0, 0 from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('d56$%Partition') + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select 3, stt_rec, tk_thue_no, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tien, t_tien_nt, line_nbr, 0, 0 from r30$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[' + @key

		IF @printCharge = 0 SET @q = @q + ' and loai_ct > ''0'''

		SET @q = @q + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF @printCharge = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
			SET @q = @q + ' select 4, a.stt_rec, b.tk_cp, a.tien_cp, a.tien_cp_nt, 0, 0, a.line_nbr, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt from f56$%Partition a with(nolock) join ' + dbo.ff30_DTable('m56$%Partition') + ' m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec join dmcpnh b on a.ma_cp = b.ma_cp where %[' + @Key + ']%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		SET @q = 'update #tmp set tt = b.tien_tt, tt_nt = b.tien_tt_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join (select stt_rec, t_tt as tien_tt, t_tt_nt as tien_tt_nt from #report) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @printCharge = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #report SET tien = a.t_tt + b.t_phi, tien_nt = a.t_tt_nt + b.t_phi_nt
				FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien + thue) AS t_phi, SUM(tien_nt + thue_nt) AS t_phi_nt FROM #tmp WHERE sysorder = 4 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		END

		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT MIN(sysorder), 1, 1, stt_rec, '', '', '', '', '', @Debit, @Debit2, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), MAX(tt), MAX(tt_nt), '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', '', tk_no, 0, NULL, '', '', '', MIN(line_nbr), '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, ''
				FROM #tmp
				GROUP BY stt_rec, tk_no

		UPDATE #report SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE sysorder = 4 OR sysorder = 3 OR sysorder = 2

		UPDATE #report SET ong_ba = b.ong_ba, ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ten_kh2 = b.ten_kh2, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, dien_giai = b.dien_giai, ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, ma_nk = b.ma_nk, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ty_gia = b.ty_gia, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia = b.chuoi_ty_gia
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai, ngay, thang, nam, ma_nk, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2, chuoi_ty_gia FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE sysorder = 2 AND line_nbr = 1

		UPDATE #report SET dien_giaix = '', dien_giaix2 = '' WHERE (sysorder = 2 AND line_nbr <> 1) OR sysorder = 3 OR sysorder = 4
	END

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #report where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#report', '#report', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Bilingual = '2' BEGIN
		IF @Desc = 0 SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			ELSE SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #report order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
			select * from (
				select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
					, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2
					, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
					, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''1'' as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia from #report
				union all
				select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
					, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2
					, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
					, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + ''2'' as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia from #report
			) a order by xGroup, sysorder, line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
				select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + case when dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
					, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_in_word
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_nt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_nt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_nt_in_word
					, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
					, tennh, tennh2, tknh, tinhthanh, lien, tenkh, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
					, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia from #report order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
				SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ong_ba, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, dien_giai
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'dien_giaiX + case when dien_giaiX <> '''' THEN '':'' ELSE '''' END' ELSE 'dien_giaiX2 + CASE WHEN dien_giaiX2 <> '''' then '':'' else '''' end' END + ' as dien_giaiX
					, tien, tien_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, ma_nt
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_in_word
					, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 't_tt_nt_in_word' ELSE 't_tt_nt_in_word2' END + ' as t_tt_nt_in_word
					, so_ct_goc, dien_giai_ct_goc, ma_nk, so_ct, tk, ty_gia, ngay_ct, ngay, thang, nam, line_nbr
					, tennh, tennh2, tknh, tinhthanh, lien, tenkh, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + '
					, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, chuoi_ty_gia from #report order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, sysorder, line_nbr'
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterRevertStatusTaxDeduction]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceSerial VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceStatus VARCHAR(32),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@SignValue NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @table VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @importType TINYINT, @r NVARCHAR(512), @vStatus VARCHAR(1), @refVoucherID VARCHAR(32), @e VARCHAR(6)

	SELECT @importType = b.kieu_ph FROM tkhddtdv a JOIN dmkieuphhddt b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE a.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.status = 1
	IF @importType IS NULL SELECT @importType = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_import_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	IF REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') = '' AND @importType = 1 RETURN

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)


	SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM hrc01$000000 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	--
	IF @ResultProcess = 0 RETURN


	DECLARE @provider INT, @isDiscountVoucher TINYINT
	SELECT @isDiscountVoucher = 0
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	IF @provider <> 8 RETURN

	IF CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	--
	IF @InvoiceStatus = '9' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoiceTaxDeduction @VoucherID, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @refVoucherID = stt_rec_hd_goc, @e = convert(char(6), ngay_hd_goc, 112) from hrm01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = @VoucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@refVoucherID varchar(32) output, @e varchar(6) output, @VoucherID varchar(32)', @refVoucherID OUTPUT, @e OUTPUT, @VoucherID
		IF @refVoucherID <> '' AND @InvoiceStatus <> '0' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoice @refVoucherID, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
			SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @e + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = ''4'', user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @refVoucherID + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	SELECT @vStatus = CASE @InvoiceStatus WHEN '9' THEN '9' WHEN '2' THEN '2' WHEN '3' THEN '2' WHEN '4' THEN '9' ELSE '1' END


	SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set status = ''' + @vStatus + ''', mau_so = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', ky_hieu = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceSerial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_hd = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', keys = ''' + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceStatus, '''', '''''') + ''', user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hrc01$000000 set status = ''' + @vStatus + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hri01$' + @p + ' set status = ''' + @vStatus + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptBalanceSheetSummary] --fs30_BalanceSheetUnit
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@cForm CHAR(16),
	@ReportType TINYINT, -- 0: Mẫu chuẩn, 1: Mẫu giữa niên độ
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Check BIT = 0,
	@Nested BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @yE INT, @yN INT, @yB INT, @yC INT, @dE SMALLDATETIME, @StartDateOfYear SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp1 SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp2 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @strsql_bal_update NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(32), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ct_dvcs CHAR(1), @Tk VARCHAR(32), @Tk_du VARCHAR(32), @Ds_ma_dvcs VARCHAR(1024), @Ds_ma_kh VARCHAR(1024), @Ts_nv TINYINT, @Sd_1ve TINYINT, @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @m_cn_dn CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dBQ SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @m_mau_so_ts VARCHAR(32), @m_mau_so_nv VARCHAR(32), @kieu_bc TINYINT

	SELECT @m_cn_dn = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cn_dn'
	SELECT @kieu_bc = kieu_bc FROM v20dmmaubc WHERE form = @cForm

	SELECT @dE = dbo.ff_BgDate(@dTo), @StartDateOfYear = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dTo), @dBQ = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfQuarter(@dTo)
	SELECT @yE = YEAR(@dE), @yN = YEAR(@dTo)
	SELECT @yB = nam_bd FROM dmstt
	SET @yC = CASE WHEN @yN = @yB THEN @yN ELSE @yE END

	-- Struct
	SELECT *, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(8)) AS flag, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ss INTO #report FROM v30gltcth1 WHERE form = @cForm
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl2 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl0 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_cust FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, ps_no AS du_no0, ps_co AS du_co0, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt0, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt0 INTO #bal_acct FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #bal_acct0tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #bal_cust0tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_cust'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, sum(case when nam= @yn then du_no00 else 0 end) as du_no'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_co00 else 0 end) as du_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_no_nt00 else 0 end) as du_no_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_co_nt00 else 0 end) as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_no1 else 0 end) as du_no0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_co1 else 0 end) as du_co0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_no_nt1 else 0 end) as du_no_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_co_nt1 else 0 end) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh with(nolock, index(nam))'
	SET @q = @q + ' where (nam = @yN or nam = @yE)' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@yN', RTRIM(@yN)), '@yE', RTRIM(@yE)), '@yC', RTRIM(@yC))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_dvcs, sum(case when nam= @yn then du_no00 else 0 end) as du_no'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_co00 else 0 end) as du_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_no_nt00 else 0 end) as du_no_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yN then du_co_nt00 else 0 end) as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_no1 else 0 end) as du_no0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_co1 else 0 end) as du_co0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_no_nt1 else 0 end) as du_no_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when nam = @yC then du_co_nt1 else 0 end) as du_co_nt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam))'
	SET @q = @q + ' where (nam = @yN or nam = @yE)' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@yN', RTRIM(@yN)), '@yE', RTRIM(@yE)), '@yC', RTRIM(@yC))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #gl'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) '
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @StartDateOfYear, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, CASE WHEN du_no > 0 THEN du_no ELSE 0 END AS du_no, CASE WHEN du_co > 0 THEN du_co ELSE 0 END AS du_co, CASE WHEN du_no_nt > 0 THEN du_no_nt ELSE 0 END AS du_no_nt, CASE WHEN du_co_nt > 0 THEN du_co_nt ELSE 0 END AS du_co_nt
		INTO #tCust_Ed
		FROM (
			SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, SUM(du_no - du_co) AS du_no, SUM(du_co - du_no) AS du_co, SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) AS du_co_nt
				FROM (
					SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #bal_cust
					UNION ALL (
						SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
							FROM #gl WHERE ma_kh <> '' AND Tk IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 1)
							)
					) a GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh
			) a

	--TT 200 Begin
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE kind = '2' AND tk + tk_du <> '') BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = ''
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' or ' END + '(tk like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(tk, '''', '')) + '%''' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(REPLACE(tk_du, '''', '')) = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and tk_du like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(tk_du, '''', '')) + '%''' END + ')' FROM #report WHERE kind = '2'
		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SELECT @dTmp = CASE WHEN @ReportType = 0 THEN @dE WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN @dBQ END, @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '#gl', '#gl2'), 'tk', 'tk, tk_du'), ']%', ' and (' + @Key + ')]%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dTmp, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin

		DECLARE @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME

		SELECT @dTmpTo = @dE - 1, @dTmpFrom = DATEADD(year, -1, @dTmpTo) + 1
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '#gl2', '#gl0')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dTmpFrom, @dTmpTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--TT 200 End

	-- Adj Ex: Bg of FY
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DAY(ngay_dn) = DAY(ngay_dn2) AND MONTH(ngay_dn) = MONTH(ngay_dn2)) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmstt WHERE DATEADD(yy, 1, dbo.ff_BgDate(ngay_ky1)) <= @dE) BEGIN
			SELECT @dTmp1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dE), @dTmp2 = @dE - 1

			SET @q = 'insert into #bal_acct0tmp'
			SET @q = @q + ' select tk, ma_dvcs, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt'
			SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
			SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
			SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_dvcs'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dTmp1, @dTmp2, @UserID, @Admin

			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT tk, ma_dvcs, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt
				INTO #bal_acct0 FROM #bal_acct0tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs

				du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

			UPDATE #bal_cust SET du_no0 = b.du_no, du_co0 = b.du_co, du_no_nt0 = b.du_no_nt, du_co_nt0 = b.du_co_nt
				FROM #bal_cust a JOIN #bal_cust0 b ON a.tk = b.tk AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		END

			DECLARE @nv TABLE(ma_so VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), tien_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6))
			DECLARE @compare TABLE(ma_so_ts VARCHAR(32), ma_so_nv VARCHAR(32), tien BIT, tien_nt BIT, tien0 BIT, tien_nt0 BIT)

			INSERT INTO @ts(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_ts
			INSERT INTO @nv(ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0) SELECT ma_so, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0 FROM #report WHERE ma_so = @m_mau_so_nv
			INSERT INTO @compare SELECT a.ma_so, b.ma_so,
					CASE WHEN a.tien <> b.tien THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt <> b.tien_nt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien0 <> b.tien0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					CASE WHEN a.tien_nt0 <> b.tien_nt0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				FROM @ts a, @nv b

			UPDATE #report SET flag = CASE WHEN b.tien <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END + CASE WHEN b.tien_nt0 <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END,
					ma_ss = CASE WHEN a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts THEN b.ma_so_nv ELSE b.ma_so_ts END
				FROM #report a JOIN @compare b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so_ts OR a.ma_so = b.ma_so_nv
		END
	END

	--
	SELECT @strSQL = 'select stt as sysorder, in_ck as sysprint, case when cach_tinh = '''' then 1 else 0 end as systotal, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, bold, tien_nt, tien, tien_nt0, tien0'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @Check = 1 THEN ', flag, ma_ss' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from #report order by stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptChangeLaborInformationExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @i INT, @Join NVARCHAR(1023)
	
	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #$keys(text NTEXT)
		INSERT INTO #$keys SELECT @IDNumbers
	END
	
	-- Scan
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	DECLARE @l INT, @size INT, @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @size = COL_LENGTH('hrnv', 'stt_rec')
	SELECT @i = 1, @l = DATALENGTH(text)/2 FROM #$keys
	WHILE @i + @size <= @l + 1 BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #stt_rec SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING(text, @i, @size), '''', '') FROM #$keys
		  SELECT @i = @i + @size + 1
	END
	
	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv as ho_va_ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh'
	SET @q = @q + ', e.ten_dt%l as dan_toc'
	SET @q = @q + ', f.ten_qt%l as quoc_tich'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_th_tru, a.dia_chi_th_tru_so, a.dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, h.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, g.ten_quan%l as dia_chi_th_tru_quan'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.dia_chi_ht, a.dia_chi_ht_so, a.dia_chi_ht_phuong, h2.ten_tinh%l as dia_chi_ht_tinh, g2.ten_quan%l as dia_chi_ht_quan'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.que_quan, a.que_quan_so, a.que_quan_phuong, h3.ten_tinh%l as que_quan_tinh, g3.ten_quan%l as que_quan_quan, a.giam_ho, a.nguoi_than, a.email_cty'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.dien_thoai_nha, a.dien_thoai_dd, case when a.cmnd_so='''' then a.ho_chieu_so else a.cmnd_so end as cmnd_so'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.cmnd_so='''' then a.ho_chieu_ngay_hl else a.cmnd_ngay_hl end as ngay_cap_cmnd'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when a.cmnd_so='''' then p.ten_qt%l else k.ten_tinh%l end as noi_cap_cmnd'
	SET @q = @q + ', l.dai_dien_cty%l as dai_dien_cty, l.dia_chi'
	SET @q = @q + ', m.si_no as so_bhxh'
	SET @q = @q + ', n.ten_kcb%l as noi_kham'
	SET @q = @q + ', o.tn_bhxhtn as muc_thu_nhap_bhxhtn, o.pt_bhxhtn as phuong_thuc_dong_bhxhtn, o.noi_dung_khac, o.ho_so_gk'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(''' + STR(DAY(@ReportDate), 2)+ ''', '' '', ''0'') as ngay_bc, replace(''' + STR(MONTH(@ReportDate), 2) + ''', '' '', ''0'') as thang_bc, ''' + RTRIM(YEAR(@ReportDate)) + ''' as nam_bc'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrnv a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmdt e with(nolock) on a.dan_toc = e.ma_dt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmqt f with(nolock) on f.ma_qt = a.quoc_tich'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g with(nolock) on g.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan and g.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h with(nolock) on h.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g2 with(nolock) on g2.ma_quan = a.dia_chi_ht_quan and g2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h2 with(nolock) on h2.ma_tinh = a.dia_chi_ht_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmquan g3 with(nolock) on g3.ma_quan = a.que_quan_quan and g3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh h3 with(nolock) on h3.ma_tinh = a.que_quan_tinh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmtinh k with(nolock) on k.ma_tinh = a.cmnd_noi_cap'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrtthd l with(nolock) on l.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrttbh m with(nolock) on m.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrdmkcb n with(nolock) on m.noi_kham = n.ma_kcb'	
	SET @q = @q + ' left join hrbhtdtt o with(nolock) on o.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and (o.ngay_hl is null or o.ngay_hl <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112) + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmqt p with(nolock) on p.ma_qt = a.ho_chieu_noi_cap'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #stt_rec) '
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_nv asc, o.ngay_hl desc'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vctcddc]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.loai_dc, b.nh_dc1, b.nh_dc2, b.nh_dc3, b.ten_dc, b.ten_dc2, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2		  
		FROM ctcddc a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			LEFT JOIN dmbpcc c ON a.ma_bp_dc = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptBookLabor]
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @d2 VARCHAR(32), @ma_cong NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	
	SELECT @dateFrom = RTRIM(@Year) + '0101', @dateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Month, @Year), @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = ''
	SELECT @d2 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112)+ ''''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #nv(stt INT IDENTITY(1,1), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_vtr VARCHAR(32))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE @Key END

	IF @Status = '1' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ngay_vao <= ' + @d2 + ' and (r.ngay_nghi is null or r.ngay_nghi > ' + @d2 + ')'
	IF @Status = '2' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' r.ngay_nghi <= ' + @d2 + ' and year(r.ngay_nghi) = '+ RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Status = '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ngay_vao <= ' + @d2 + ' and (r.ngay_nghi is null or r.ngay_nghi >= ''' + RTRIM(@Year) + '0101'')'

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'

	-- Danh sach nhan vien thoa dieu kien loc
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #nv (stt_rec, ma_vtr) select r.stt_rec, r.vi_tri from hrnv r left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'order by r.stt, r.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Vi tri theo qua trinh lam viec
	SELECT r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, MAX(r.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #ctqtlv FROM hreqtlvht r JOIN hrnv e ON r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec WHERE r.tinh_chat = '1' AND r.ngay_tu < @dateTo AND (e.ngay_nghi IS NULL OR e.ngay_nghi >= @dateTo) GROUP BY r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #ctqtlv GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #ctqtlv FROM #ctqtlv a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL
	--
	UPDATE #nv SET ma_vtr = b.vi_tri FROM #nv a JOIN #ctqtlv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Cap dao tao
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_tdhv ELSE ten_tdhv2 END AS trinh_do_cm
		INTO #hrehv FROM hrehv a JOIN #nv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrdmtdhv d ON a.ma_tdhv =  d.ma_tdhv
		WHERE a.ngay_tot_nghiep = (SELECT MAX(ngay_tot_nghiep) AS ngay_tot_nghiep FROM hrehv c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND c.ngay_tot_nghiep <= @dateTo AND mac_dinh_yn = 1) AND a.ngay_tot_nghiep <= @dateTo AND mac_dinh_yn = 1

	-- Chuyen mon
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ten_cm, '')) + ' - ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(e.ten_bac, '')) ELSE RTRIM(ISNULL(d.ten_cm2, '')) + ' - ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(e.ten_bac2, '')) END AS bac_ky_nang
		INTO #hrebcm FROM hrebcm a JOIN #nv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrdmcm d ON a.ma_cm = d.ma_cm LEFT JOIN hrdmbcm e ON a.ma_bac = e.ma_bac
		WHERE a.ngay_hl = (SELECT MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrebcm c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND c.ngay_hl <= @dateTo AND mac_dinh_yn = 1) AND a.ngay_hl <= @dateTo AND mac_dinh_yn = 1

	-- Hop dong
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_loai ELSE d.ten_loai2 END AS loai_hdld
		INTO #hrcthd FROM hrcthd a JOIN #nv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrdmloaihd d ON a.loai_hd = d.ma_loai
		WHERE a.ngay_ky_hd = (SELECT MAX(ngay_ky_hd) AS ngay_ky_hd FROM hrcthd c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND c.ngay_ky_hd <= @dateTo) AND a.ngay_ky_hd <= @dateTo

	-- Tham gia BHXH
	SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec
		INTO #hrttctxh FROM hrttctxh a JOIN #nv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE ngay_hl_tu <= @dateTo AND (ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR YEAR(ngay_hl_den) >= @Year)

	-- Mức lương hiện tại
	SELECT a.stt_rec, luong_co_ban
		INTO #hreqtlkdht FROM hreqtlkdht a WHERE a.ngay_bd = (SELECT MAX(ngay_bd) AS ngay_bd FROM hreqtlkdht b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ngay_bd <= @dateTo AND tinh_chat = 1) AND tinh_chat = 1

	-- Hoc nghe ngan han
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_khoa ELSE b.ten_khoa2 END AS ten_khoa
		INTO #hredt FROM hredt a JOIN hrdtkh b ON a.ma_khoa = b.ma_khoa
			WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #nv c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec) AND YEAR(a.ngay_cap) = @Year AND a.ngay_cap <= @dateTo

	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS dao_tao INTO #dt FROM #hredt

	SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #dt
	WHILE @stt_rec IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = ''
		SELECT @s = @s + ISNULL(ten_khoa, '') + ';' + CHAR(13) FROM #hredt WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
		UPDATE #dt SET dao_tao = LEFT(@s, LEN(@s) - 2) WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
	
		SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #dt WHERE stt_rec > @stt_rec
	END

	-- Ky luat
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kl ELSE b.ten_kl2 END AS ten_kl INTO #hrekl
		FROM hrekl a JOIN hrdmkl b ON a.hinh_thuc = b.ma_kl
			WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #nv c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec) AND YEAR(a.ngay_ky) = @Year AND a.ngay_ky <= @dateTo

	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS ky_luat INTO #kl FROM #hrekl

	SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #kl
	WHILE @stt_rec IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = ''
		SELECT @s = @s + ISNULL(ten_kl, '') + ';' + CHAR(13) FROM #hrekl WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
		UPDATE #kl SET ky_luat = LEFT(@s, LEN(@s) - 2) WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec

		SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #kl WHERE stt_rec > @stt_rec
	END

	-- Tai nạn
	SELECT a.stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tn ELSE b.ten_tn2 END AS ten_tn
		INTO #hretn FROM hretn a JOIN hrdmtn b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_tn
			WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #nv c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec) AND YEAR(a.ngay_tn) = @Year AND a.ngay_tn <= @dateTo AND tn_ld_yn = 1

	SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS tai_nan INTO #tn FROM #hretn

	SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #tn
	WHILE @stt_rec IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = ''
		SELECT @s = @s + ISNULL(ten_tn, '') + ';' + CHAR(13) FROM #hretn WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
		UPDATE #tn SET tai_nan = LEFT(@s, LEN(@s) - 2) WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec

		SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #tn WHERE stt_rec > @stt_rec
	END

	-- Cham cong
	CREATE TABLE #temp(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6))
	CREATE TABLE #cong(stt_rec CHAR(13), nghi_phep NUMERIC(28, 6), nghi_rieng NUMERIC(28, 6), nghi_khong_luong NUMERIC(28, 6), nghi_om NUMERIC(28, 6), nghi_thai NUMERIC(28, 6), lam_them_thuong NUMERIC(28, 6), lam_them_nghi NUMERIC(28, 6), lam_them_le NUMERIC(28, 6))
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp select r.stt_rec, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio), sum(r.so_ngay)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + REPLACE(@Join, 'r.bo_phan', 'r.ma_bp')
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Where + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.ma_cong'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #cong(stt_rec) SELECT stt_rec FROM #nv
	SELECT @s = 'update #cong set %field = b.n from #cong a join (select sum(isnull(so_ngay, 0)) AS n, stt_rec from #temp where ma_cong in (@ma_cong) group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	-- Nghi phep
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_022), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'nghi_phep'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Nghi cong viec rieng
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_023), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'nghi_rieng'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Nghi khong luong
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_024), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'nghi_khong_luong'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Nghi om
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_025), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'nghi_om'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Nghi thai
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_026), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'nghi_thai'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Lam them 150%
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_027), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'lam_them_thuong'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong), 'so_ngay', 'so_gio')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Lam them 200%
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_028), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'lam_them_nghi'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong), 'so_ngay', 'so_gio')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- Lam them 300%
	SELECT @ma_cong = '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(ts_ma_029), '''', ''''''), ',', ''', ''') + '''' FROM hrtsmbc WHERE ma_tsmbc ='TSSQLLD'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%field', 'lam_them_le'), '@ma_cong', @ma_cong), 'so_ngay', 'so_gio')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.stt, e.ma_nv, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + LTRIM(ten_nv) AS ho_ten_nv, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vtr ELSE b.ten_vtr2 END AS vi_tri
			, CASE WHEN e.gioi_tinh = 1 THEN @Male ELSE @Female END AS gioi_tinh, e.ngay_sinh, e.noi_sinh
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN r.ten_qt ELSE r.ten_qt2 END AS quoc_tich
			, RTRIM(ISNULL(e.dia_chi_th_tru_so, '')) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, ''))) + ' - ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(q.ten_quan, ''))) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.ten_tinh, ''))) ELSE RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(q.ten_quan2, ''))) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.ten_tinh2, ''))) END dia_chi
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.cmnd_so, '') <> '' THEN e.cmnd_so ELSE ho_chieu_so END AS so_cmnd
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.cmnd_so, '') <> '' THEN cmnd_ngay_hl ELSE ho_chieu_ngay_hl END AS ngay_cmnd
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.cmnd_so, '') <> '' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN v.ten_tinh ELSE v.ten_tinh2 END ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN x.ten_qt ELSE x.ten_qt2 END END AS noi_cap
			, e.dien_thoai_dd AS dien_thoai, c.ma_so_thue, d.trinh_do_cm, bac_ky_nang, u.loai_hdld, e.ngay_vao AS ngay_lv
			, CASE WHEN g.stt_rec IS NOT NULL THEN 'x' END AS tham_gia_bh, h.si_date2 AS ngay_tg, k.luong_co_ban AS muc_luong, '' AS nang_bac_luong
			, p.nghi_phep, p.nghi_rieng, p.nghi_khong_luong, p.nghi_om, p.nghi_thai, p.lam_them_thuong, p.lam_them_nghi, p.lam_them_le
			, l.dao_tao, m.ky_luat, n.tai_nan, CASE WHEN e.ngay_nghi <= @dateTo THEN e.ngay_nghi ELSE NULL END AS ngay_nghi
			, CASE WHEN e.ngay_nghi <= @dateTo THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN o.ten_ldnv ELSE o.ten_ldnv2 END ELSE '' END AS ly_do, '' AS ghi_chu
		FROM #nv a LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrvt b ON a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr
			LEFT JOIN hrtttncn c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrehv d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrebcm f ON a.stt_rec = f.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hrttctxh g ON a.stt_rec = g.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrttbh h ON a.stt_rec = h.stt_rec AND g.stt_rec = h.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #hreqtlkdht k ON a.stt_rec = k.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #dt l ON a.stt_rec = l.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #kl m ON a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN #tn n ON a.stt_rec = n.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrdmldnv o ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.ly_do_nghi = o.ma_ldnv
			LEFT JOIN #cong p ON a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrdmquan q ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.dia_chi_th_tru_quan = q.ma_quan AND e.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = q.ma_tinh
			LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh i ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = i.ma_tinh
			LEFT JOIN #hrcthd u ON a.stt_rec = u.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN dmqt r ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.quoc_tich = r.ma_qt
			LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh v ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.cmnd_noi_cap = v.ma_tinh
			LEFT JOIN dmqt x ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec AND e.ho_chieu_noi_cap = x.ma_qt
		ORDER BY a.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$Difference]
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@tableGeneralUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableMasterUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableDetailUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_ir, stt_rec0ir, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ir INTO #afterUpdate FROM d71$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_ir, stt_rec0ir, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_ir <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ir <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_ir = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@tableGeneralUpdate)), '''', '''''') + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ir = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s	
	END

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cIRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineIRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_ir VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_ir, stt_rec0ir, so_luong, he_so, dyn_ir FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cIRIDNumber, @cLineIRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_ir
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cIRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ir <> ''
			SET @s = 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableDetailUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_ir + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cIRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineIRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cIRIDNumber, @cLineIRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_ir
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update datetime, user, status...
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_ir, MAX(dyn_ir) AS dyn_ir FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_ir
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cIRIDNumber, @dyn_ir
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cIRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ir <> ''
			SET @s = 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableMasterUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_ir + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cIRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cIRIDNumber, @dyn_ir
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
