		SELECT a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_ktr, a.ngay_ktr, a.diem, a.ma_kq, a.trong_so, b.ten_ktr, b.ten_ktr2, c.ten_kq, c.ten_kq2
			FROM hrektr a 
				LEFT JOIN hrdmktr b on a.ma_ktr = b.ma_ktr
				LEFT JOIN hrdmkq c on a.ma_kq = c.ma_kq
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostGCTran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@step TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF @step <= 1 RETURN

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @u NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct VARCHAR(32), @ma_nt VARCHAR(3), @vType CHAR(1), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME,
		@m_tk_cn_pth VARCHAR(128), @m_tk_cn_ptr VARCHAR(128), @m_gl_tt CHAR(1), @VNumberSize TINYINT, @key NVARCHAR(1024), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32),
		@m_Tk_cl_tg VARCHAR(128), @round TINYINT, @round_Tg TINYINT

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m12$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d12$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #gl FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 *, nh_dk AS nh_dk0, line_nbr AS line_nbr0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xtype, CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS head_item INTO #dGL0 FROM #detail
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS stt, * INTO #dGL FROM #dGL0


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_ct = ma_ct, @ma_nt = ma_nt, @vType = RTRIM(LTRIM(loai_ct)), @ngay_ct = ngay_ct FROM #master


	-- Update free field detail = master
	EXEC rs_UpdateFreeFields @ma_ct, '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', ''

	SELECT nh_dk, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS xtype, --1-N, 0-C
			CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS head_item, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #grtype FROM #detail GROUP BY nh_dk
	UPDATE #grtype SET head_item = dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(id) WHERE id < 36

	SELECT a.*, a.tk AS tk_du, a.tk AS tk0, b.xtype, b.head_item INTO #d1 FROM #detail a JOIN #grtype b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) > 0 AND b.xtype = 1
	SELECT a.*, a.tk AS tk_du, a.tk AS tk0, b.xtype, b.head_item INTO #d2 FROM #detail a JOIN #grtype b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) > 0 AND b.xtype = 0

	SELECT a.* INTO #d12 FROM #detail a WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d1 b WHERE a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk)
	SELECT a.* INTO #d22 FROM #detail a WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d2 b WHERE a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk)

	SET @u = 'ngay_ct0 = case when a.ngay_ct0 is null then b.ngay_ct0 else a.ngay_ct0 end, so_ct0 = case when isnull(a.so_ct0, '''') <> '''' then a.so_ct0 else b.so_ct0 end, ma_kh = case when isnull(a.ma_kh, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_kh else b.ma_kh end, ma_vv = case when isnull(a.ma_vv, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_vv else b.ma_vv end, ma_sp = case when isnull(a.ma_sp, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_sp else b.ma_sp end, ma_bp = case when isnull(a.ma_bp, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_bp else b.ma_bp end, so_lsx = case when isnull(a.so_lsx, '''') <> '''' then a.so_lsx else b.so_lsx end, ma_hd = case when isnull(a.ma_hd, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_hd else b.ma_hd end, ma_ku = case when isnull(a.ma_ku, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_ku else b.ma_ku end, ma_phi = case when isnull(a.ma_phi, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_phi else b.ma_phi end, ma_td1 = case when isnull(a.ma_td1, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td1 else b.ma_td1 end, ma_td2 = case when isnull(a.ma_td2, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td2 else b.ma_td2 end, ma_td3 = case when isnull(a.ma_td3, '''') <> '''' then a.ma_td3 else b.ma_td3 end, gc_td1 = case when isnull(a.gc_td1, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td1 else b.gc_td1 end, gc_td2 = case when isnull(a.gc_td2, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td2 else b.gc_td2 end, gc_td3 = case when isnull(a.gc_td3, '''') <> '''' then a.gc_td3 else b.gc_td3 end, s1 = case when isnull(a.s1, '''') <> '''' then a.s1 else b.s1 end, s2 = case when isnull(a.s2, '''') <> '''' then a.s2 else b.s2 end, s3 = case when isnull(a.s3, '''') <> '''' then a.s3 else b.s3 end, sl_td1 = case when isnull(a.sl_td1, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td1 else b.sl_td1 end, sl_td2 = case when isnull(a.sl_td2, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td2 else b.sl_td2 end, sl_td3 = case when isnull(a.sl_td3, 0) <> 0 then a.sl_td3 else b.sl_td3 end, s4 = case when isnull(a.s4, 0) <> 0 then a.s4 else b.s4 end, s5 = case when isnull(a.s5, 0) <> 0 then a.s5 else b.s5 end, s6 = case when isnull(a.s6, 0) <> 0 then a.s6 else b.s6 end, ngay_td1 = case when not a.ngay_td1 is null then a.ngay_td1 else b.ngay_td1 end, ngay_td2 = case when not a.ngay_td2 is null then a.ngay_td2 else b.ngay_td2 end, ngay_td3 = case when not a.ngay_td3 is null then a.ngay_td3 else b.ngay_td3 end, s7 = case when not a.s7 is null then a.s7 else b.s7 end, s8 = case when not a.s8 is null then a.s8 else b.s8 end, s9 = case when not a.s9 is null then a.s9 else b.s9 end, dien_giai = case when isnull(a.dien_giai, '''') <> '''' then a.dien_giai else b.dien_giai end'

	SET @q = 'update #d1 set tk_du = b.tk, ' + @u + ' from #d1 a join #d12 b on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #d2 set tk_du = b.tk, ' + @u + ' from #d2 a join #d22 b on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#d1', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL0', '#d2', '1 = 1', NULL, NULL, 'line_nbr')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$InsertGroup ('#dGL', '#dGL0', '1 = 1', 'ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', 'nh_dk, line_nbr', NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGL SET nh_dk0 = nh_dk, line_nbr0 = line_nbr, nh_dk = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2), line_nbr = stt

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_co = ps_no, ps_co_nt = ps_no_nt, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0 WHERE xtype = 1
	UPDATE #dGL SET line_nbr = stt + 1, tk = tk_du, tk_du = tk0, ps_no = ps_co, ps_no_nt = ps_co_nt, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0 WHERE xtype = 0

	SET @q = 'update #dGL set ' + @u + ' from #dGL b join #d12 a on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk0 where b.xtype = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #dGL set ' + @u + ' from #dGL b join #d22 a on a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk0 where b.xtype = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#gl', '#dGL', '#gl', '#dGL', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT nh_dk, dien_giai INTO #gd1 FROM #gl WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0
	SELECT nh_dk, dien_giai INTO #gd2 FROM #gl WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0
	UPDATE #gl SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai FROM #gl a JOIN #gd1 b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_no) + ABS(a.ps_no_nt) <> 0
	UPDATE #gl SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai FROM #gl a JOIN #gd2 b ON a.nh_dk = b.nh_dk WHERE ABS(a.ps_co) + ABS(a.ps_co_nt) <> 0


	-- Post to ct00
	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateRemainFields '#gl', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', 'status = 1, so_ctgs = '''', ma_gd = ''''', '', 'dien_giai, ngay_ct0, so_ct0', 'dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai', ''

	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl



	-- Thanh toán
	SELECT @m_gl_tt = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gl_tt'), '0')

	IF @m_gl_tt = '0' OR @vType <> '2' RETURN

	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @m_tk_cn_pth = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_pth'
	SELECT TOP 1 @m_tk_cn_ptr = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_ptr'
	SELECT TOP 1 @round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT TOP 1 @round_Tg = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT TOP 1 @m_Tk_cl_tg = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cl_tg'

	SELECT @VNumberSize = [length] FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('wrkar') and name = 'so_ct'

	SELECT data + '%' AS v INTO #tk_cn_pth from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@m_tk_cn_pth, ',')
	SELECT data + '%' AS v INTO #tk_cn_ptr from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@m_tk_cn_ptr, ',')


	--+ TT50
	SELECT * INTO #detail50 FROM #detail a WHERE ma_kh <> '' AND (@m_tk_cn_pth <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_cn_pth b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.v)) AND ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0
	EXEC FastBusiness$Posting$Allocation @ma_ct, '3', '#master', '#detail50', '', '', 'ps_co_nt', 'ps_co', 'cttt50', @idNumber, 'ma_kh', 'dien_giai, tk'


 	--+ TT60
	SELECT * INTO #detail60 FROM #detail a WHERE ma_kh <> '' AND (@m_tk_cn_ptr <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tk_cn_ptr b WHERE a.tk LIKE b.v)) AND ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0
	EXEC FastBusiness$Posting$Allocation @ma_ct, '3', '#master', '#detail60', '', '', 'ps_no_nt', 'ps_no', 'cttt60', @idNumber, 'ma_kh', 'dien_giai, tk'


	--+ TT20
	IF @m_tk_cn_pth <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #ar FROM cttt20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @key = 'a.ma_kh <> '''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_cn_pth b where a.tk like b.v) and ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ar', '#detail a', @detailTable, 'cttt20', @key)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdate('#ar', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt20', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT a.stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_qd, 0)) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt, 0)) AS t_tt1, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_nt, 0)) AS t_tt_nt1 INTO #t20
			FROM cttt20 a WHERE a.loai_tt = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ar b WHERE a.stt_rec_tt = LEFT(b.stt_rec, 10) + b.stt_rec0) GROUP BY a.stt_rec_tt

		UPDATE #ar SET loai_tt = 0, ma_gd = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + b.stt_rec0, so_ct = CASE WHEN b.so_ct0 = '' THEN a.so_ct ELSE dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(b.so_ct0), @VNumberSize) END,
				ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN b.ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN a.ngay_ct ELSE b.ngay_ct0 END, so_seri = '', ma_nvbh = '',
				t_tien_nt2 = b.ps_no_nt, t_tien2 = b.ps_no, t_thue_nt = 0, t_thue = 0, t_ck_nt = 0, t_ck = 0, t_tt_nt = b.ps_no_nt, t_tt = b.ps_no
			FROM #ar a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

		UPDATE #ar SET t_tt_qd = b.t_tt_qd , t_tt1 = b.t_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = b.t_tt_nt1 FROM #ar a JOIN #t20 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt
		UPDATE #ar SET t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt

		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #p20 FROM cttt20 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
		SET @key = 'exists(select 1 from #tk_cn_pth b where a.tk like b.v) and a.stt_rec_ct <> '''' and ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#p20', '#detail a', @detailTable, 'cttt20', @key)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE #p20 FROM #p20 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_tt)

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdate('#p20', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt20', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.t_tt_nt AS cl_nt, a.t_tt AS cl,
				CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN @baseCurrency ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt_hd, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia_i, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia_hd,
				a.t_tt_nt AS tien_hd_nt, a.t_tt AS tien_hd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_hd, a.so_ct AS so_hd, 0 AS xcl_tg, 0 AS xno_co_cl, 0 * a.t_tt_nt AS tien_cl_tg,
				b.ps_co AS tien, b.ps_co_nt AS tien_nt, b.ps_co AS tien_tt, b.ps_co_nt AS tt_qd0, b.tk AS tk_co, b.line_nbr AS stt
			INTO #cttt20 FROM cttt20 a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_ct JOIN #p20 c ON b.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec0

		SELECT a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0)) + MAX(a.tt_qd0) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt,
					SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_cn, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt_cn, MAX(a.tien_hd_nt) AS tien_hd_nt, MAX(a.tien_hd) AS tien_hd,
					SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0)) AS da_tt_nt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_cn, 0)) AS da_tt
				INTO #pay20 FROM #cttt20 a LEFT JOIN cttt20 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE (b.stt_rec IS NULL OR b.stt_rec <> @idNumber) GROUP BY a.stt_rec
		UPDATE #cttt20 SET cl_nt = cl_nt - b.da_tt_nt, cl = cl - b.da_tt FROM #cttt20 a JOIN #pay20 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt

		UPDATE #p20 SET tt_nt = b.ps_co_nt, tt = b.ps_co, ty_gia_dg = ISNULL(c.ty_gia_hd, a.ty_gia),
				tt_cn = CASE WHEN @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency THEN
							CASE WHEN b.ps_co_nt <> c.cl_nt THEN ROUND(b.ps_co_nt * c.ty_gia_hd, @round)
								WHEN b.ps_co_nt = c.cl_nt THEN c.cl
							ELSE 0 END
						ELSE b.ps_co END,
				tien_cl_no = CASE WHEN c.xcl_tg = 1 AND c.xno_co_cl = 1 THEN ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0) ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_co = CASE WHEN c.xcl_tg = 1 AND c.xno_co_cl = 1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0) END,
				tt_qd = b.ps_co_nt, loai_tt = 1
			FROM #p20 a LEFT JOIN #detail b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr LEFT JOIN #cttt20 c ON a.line_nbr = c.stt

		UPDATE #p20 SET t_tien_nt2 = ISNULL(t_tien_nt2, 0), t_tien2 = ISNULL(t_tien2, 0),
				t_thue_nt = ISNULL(t_thue_nt, 0), t_thue = ISNULL(t_thue, 0), t_ck_nt = ISNULL(t_ck_nt, 0), t_ck = ISNULL(t_ck, 0),
				t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt0, 0), t_tt0 = ISNULL(t_tt0, 0), t_tt_nt1 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt1, 0), t_tt1 = ISNULL(t_tt1, 0),
				ma_tt = ISNULL(ma_tt, ''), so_seri = '', ma_nvbh = '', ma_gd = ISNULL(ma_gd, '')

		INSERT INTO #ar SELECT * FROM #p20


		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #ar) BEGIN
			UPDATE #ar SET tat_toan = ISNULL(tat_toan, 0), t_tt_qd0 = ISNULL(t_tt_qd0, 0), t_tt_qd = ISNULL(t_tt_qd, 0)
			UPDATE #ar SET ma_nt = '', tt_nt = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_ck_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency
			INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar
		END
	END


	--+ TT30
	IF @m_tk_cn_ptr <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #ap FROM cttt30 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @key = 'a.ma_kh <> '''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_cn_ptr b where a.tk like b.v) and ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#ap', '#detail a', @detailTable, 'cttt30', @key)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdate('#ap', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt30', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #ap SET loai_tt = 0, ma_gd = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + b.stt_rec0, so_ct = b.so_ct, ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct,
				ngay_ct0 = CASE WHEN b.ngay_ct0 IS NULL THEN a.ngay_ct ELSE b.ngay_ct0 END, so_ct0 = CASE WHEN b.so_ct0 = '' THEN a.so_ct ELSE dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(b.so_ct0), @VNumberSize) END,
				t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien = 0, t_tien_nt0 = b.ps_co_nt, t_tien0 = b.ps_co, t_cp_nt = 0, t_cp = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, t_nk = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_thue = 0
			FROM #ap a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

		UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_nt = t_tien_nt0 + t_cp_nt, t_tt = t_tien0 + t_cp, t_tt_nt0 = t_tien_nt0 + t_cp_nt, t_tt0 = t_tien0 + t_cp


		SELECT a.* INTO #p30 FROM cttt30 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @key = 'a.ma_kh <> '''' and exists(select 1 from #tk_cn_ptr b where a.tk like b.v) and a.stt_rec_ct <> '''' and ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
		SET @q =  dbo.ff_GetSQLInsert('#p30', '#detail a', @detailTable, 'cttt30', @key)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetSQLUpdate('#p30', '#master', @masterTable, 'cttt30', '1 = 1', '1 = 1', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.t_tt_nt AS cl_nt, a.t_tt AS cl,
				CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN @baseCurrency ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt_hd, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia_i, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = '' THEN 1 ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia_hd,
				a.t_tt_nt AS tien_hd_nt, a.t_tt AS tien_hd, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_hd, a.so_ct AS so_hd, 0 AS xcl_tg, 0 AS xno_co_cl,
				0 * a.t_tt_nt AS tien_cl_tg, b.ps_no AS tien, b.ps_no_nt AS tien_nt, b.ps_no_nt AS tt_qd0, b.tk AS tk_no, b.line_nbr AS stt
			INTO #cttt30 FROM cttt30 a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_ct WHERE b.stt_rec_ct <> ''

		SELECT a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0)) + MAX(a.tt_qd0) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt,
				SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_cn, 0)) + MAX(a.tien) AS t_tt_cn, MAX(a.tien_hd_nt) AS tien_hd_nt, MAX(a.tien_hd) AS tien_hd,
				SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_qd, 0)) AS da_tt_nt, SUM(ISNULL(b.tt_cn, 0)) AS da_tt
			INTO #pay30 FROM #cttt30 a LEFT JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE (b.stt_rec IS NULL OR b.stt_rec <> @idNumber) GROUP BY a.stt_rec
		UPDATE #cttt30 SET cl_nt = cl_nt - b.da_tt_nt, cl = cl - b.da_tt FROM #cttt30 a JOIN #pay30 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt

		UPDATE #p30 SET tt_nt = b.ps_no_nt, tt = b.ps_no, ty_gia_dg = ISNULL(c.ty_gia_hd, a.ty_gia),
				tt_cn = CASE WHEN @ma_nt <> @baseCurrency THEN
							CASE WHEN b.ps_no_nt <> c.cl_nt THEN ROUND(b.ps_no_nt * c.ty_gia_hd, @round)
								WHEN b.ps_no_nt = c.cl_nt THEN c.cl
							ELSE 0 END
						ELSE b.ps_no END,
				tien_cl_no = CASE WHEN NOT (c.xcl_tg = 1 AND c.xno_co_cl = 0) THEN ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0) ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_co = CASE WHEN c.xcl_tg = 1 AND c.xno_co_cl = 0 THEN ISNULL(c.tien_cl_tg, 0) ELSE 0 END,
				tt_qd = b.ps_no_nt, loai_tt = 1
			FROM #p30 a LEFT JOIN #detail b ON a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr LEFT JOIN #cttt30 c ON a.line_nbr = c.stt

		UPDATE #p30 SET so_ct0 = ISNULL(so_ct0, ''),
				t_tien_nt = ISNULL(t_tien_nt, 0), t_tien = ISNULL(t_tien, 0),
				t_tien_nt0 = ISNULL(t_tien_nt0, 0), t_tien0 = ISNULL(t_tien0, 0),
				t_thue_nt = ISNULL(t_thue_nt, 0), t_thue = ISNULL(t_thue, 0),
				t_cp_nt = ISNULL(t_cp_nt, 0), t_cp = ISNULL(t_cp, 0), t_nk_nt = ISNULL(t_nk_nt, 0), t_nk = ISNULL(t_nk, 0), t_tt_nt0 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt0, 0), t_tt0 = ISNULL(t_tt0, 0),
				t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt1 = ISNULL(t_tt_nt1, 0), t_tt1 = ISNULL(t_tt1, 0),
				ma_tt = ISNULL(ma_tt, ''), ma_gd = ISNULL(ma_gd, '')

		INSERT INTO #ap SELECT * FROM #p30


		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #ap) BEGIN
			SELECT a.stt_rec_tt, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_qd, 0)) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt, 0)) AS t_tt1, SUM(ISNULL(a.tt_nt, 0)) AS t_tt_nt1 INTO #t30
				FROM cttt30 a WHERE a.loai_tt = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ap b WHERE a.stt_rec_tt = LEFT(b.stt_rec, 10) + b.stt_rec0) GROUP BY a.stt_rec_tt
			UPDATE #ap SET t_tt_qd = b.t_tt_qd , t_tt1 = b.t_tt1, t_tt_nt1 = b.t_tt_nt1 FROM #ap a JOIN #t30 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt

			UPDATE #ap SET tat_toan = ISNULL(tat_toan, 0), t_tt_qd0 = ISNULL(t_tt_qd0, 0), t_tt_qd = ISNULL(t_tt_qd, 0)
			UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @baseCurrency

			INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap
		END
	END



	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vcthscc
AS
SELECT     a.so_the_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, a.tk_kh, a.tk_ts, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, a.ty_le, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_tang, a.gt_tang_nt, 
                      a.gt_giam, a.gt_giam_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, a.dien_giai, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, 
                      a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, 
                      b.ma_dvcs
FROM         dbo.cthscc AS a INNER JOIN
                      dbo.dmcc AS b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vkhdtthang]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_ct AS ten_ct, b.ten_ct2 AS ten_ct2, b.stt AS stt
		FROM khdtthang a JOIN dmctdt b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vfafc
AS
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.sua_kh, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp,	
			dbo.ff30_FCC(ma_nt) AS ma_nt,	 a.ty_gia,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.nguyen_gia_nt ELSE a.nguyen_gia END AS nguyen_gia,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.nguyen_gia ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.nguyen_gia_nt, ma_nt) END AS nguyen_gia_nt,	
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_da_kh_nt ELSE a.gt_da_kh END AS gt_da_kh,	
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_da_kh ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_da_kh_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_da_kh_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_tang_nt ELSE a.gt_tang END AS gt_tang,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_tang ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_tang_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_tang_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_giam_nt ELSE a.gt_giam END AS gt_giam,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_giam ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_giam_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_giam_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_cl_nt ELSE a.gt_cl END AS gt_cl,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_cl ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_cl_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_cl_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_kh_ky_nt ELSE a.gt_kh_ky END AS gt_kh_ky,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_kh_ky ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_kh_ky_nt,	
			a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2,	 a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3,	
			a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9
		FROM vfa a

GO
CREATE VIEW vthhspbts 
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.so_the_ts, a.ky, a.nam, MAX(b.ten_ts) AS ten_ts, MAX(b.ten_ts2) AS ten_ts2
		FROM cthspbts a LEFT JOIN dmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ky, a.nam
		ORDER BY a.so_the_ts

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ConvertShop2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @UnitKey = '', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, sl_nhap INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = ''
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @UserID = 1, @Admin = 1
	END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #sfctpx select ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, '''', '''', sum(sl_nhap - sl_xuat) from sfctpx$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @q = 'delete cdpx where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into cdpx(nam, ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ton00, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, status)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, sum(ton00), ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ''1'''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from (select ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ton00 from cdpx with(nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, sum(sl_nhap) from #sfctpx group by ma_dvcs, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, ma_lo, loai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri)) a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where abs(ton00) > 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_px, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.loai, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdpx where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ' and abs(ton00) = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSList] --fs20_FXList
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@FaType AS VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @FC VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @FC = val FROM Options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt,
			a.so_the_ts, a.ten_ts AS ten_ts, a.ten_ts2 AS ten_ts2, a.so_hieu_ts AS so_hieu_ts,
			a.so_luong AS so_luong,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS nguyen_gia,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl,
			gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_ky,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS nguyen_gia_nt,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_da_kh_nt,
			CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt,
			gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt,
			a.ngay_mua AS ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0 AS ngay_kh0, a.ngay_giam AS ngay_giam, a.so_ky_kh AS so_ky_kh,
			nh_ts1 AS nh_ts1, nh_ts2 AS nh_ts2, nh_ts3 AS nh_ts3, loai_ts AS loai_cc,
			ma_nt AS ma_nt, ty_gia AS ty_gia,
			a.so_ct AS so_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct, a.tk_ts AS tk_ts, a.tk_kh AS tk_kh, a.tk_cp AS tk_cp, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp, a.ma_phi AS ma_phi
		INTO #report
		FROM dmcc a, ctdmcc b

	--Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_mua between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ts like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FaType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FaDept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(a.ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(a.ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(a.so_hieu_ts) as so_hieu_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(a.so_luong) as so_luong, 0, 0, 0, sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, 0, 0, 0,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt, max(a.ngay_mua) as ngay_mua, max(a.ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(a.ngay_giam) as ngay_giam, max(a.so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh, max(nh_ts1) as nh_ts1, max(nh_ts2) as nh_ts2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' max(nh_ts3) as nh_ts3, max(loai_ts) as loai_cc, max(ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(ty_gia) as ty_gia, '
	SET @q = @q + ' max(a.so_ct), max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.tk_ts), max(a.tk_kh), max(a.tk_cp), max(a.ma_bp), max(a.ma_phi)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmcc a with(nolock) join ctdmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + 'group by a.so_the_ts '
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia,nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt,gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh,gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl = b.gt_cl,gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (
					            SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia,SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh,SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl,SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
		                            	         FROM ctdmcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report)
						         GROUP BY so_the_ts
					         ) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts', 'NUMERIC(5),#')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @FC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	DECLARE @f NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @f = 'sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_ts2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_ts2'
	SET @f = @f + ', so_ct, ngay_ct, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi, so_hieu_ts, so_luong, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, ngay_giam, so_ky_kh'

	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN @Groups <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE 'loai_cc' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Groups <> '' SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup2(@Groups, 'so_the_ts,so_the_ts,so_the_ts', 'ten_ts,ten_ts,ten_ts', 'ma_nh,ma_nh,ma_nh', 'ten_nh,ten_nh,ten_nh', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh', '#report', 'dmnhcc,dmnhcc,dmnhcc', '1,1,1')
	ELSE SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('loai_cc', 'ts', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt,so_ky_kh', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END
	SET @q = 'select ' + @f + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyCPTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @voucherType VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m56$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d56$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112), @voucherType = loai_ct FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số chứng từ', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Khách hàng', N'Customer', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lý do thanh toán', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	SELECT * INTO #tempInfo FROM #bodyInfo

	INSERT INTO #tempInfo SELECT 'so_hd', 100, '', '', N'Số hóa đơn', N'Invoice No.', 'so_hd', 'so_hd2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_hd', 100, '', '', N'Ngày hóa đơn', N'Invoice Date', 'ngay_hd', 'ngay_hd', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tk', 100, '', '', N'TK nợ', N'Debit Account', 'tk', 'tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_kh', 100, '', '', N'Mã khách', N'Customer ID', 'ma_kh', 'ma_kh', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_kh', 300, '', '', N'Tên khách hàng', N'Customer Name', 'ten_kh', 'ten_kh2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_tk', 300, '', '', N'Tên tài khoản', N'Account Description', 'ten_tk', 'ten_tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dien_giai', 300, '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Description', 'dien_giai', 'dien_giai', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien_hd_nt', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền trên hóa đơn', N'Invoice Amount', 'tien_hd_nt', 'tien_hd_nt', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_nt', 100, '', '', N'Ngoại tệ', N'Currency', 'ma_nt', 'ma_nt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk, CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk2,
			b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2,
			RTRIM(a.dien_giai) AS dien_giai,
			CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd, CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), d.ngay_ct, 103) AS ngay_hd,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_kh_i) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_kh, c.ten_kh, c.ten_kh2,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(CASE WHEN d.ma_nt = '' THEN d.t_tt ELSE d.t_tt_nt END, @amountFormat) AS tien_hd_nt, CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.ma_nt, '') = '' THEN @ma_nt0 ELSE d.ma_nt END AS ma_nt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt, @amountFormat) AS tien
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a
			LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk
			LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON a.ma_kh_i = c.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN cttt30 d ON a.stt_rec_tt = d.stt_rec

	IF @voucherType = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('ma_kh', 'ten_kh', 'ten_tk')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
	END

	IF @voucherType = '3' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'ten_tk', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master

	END

	IF @voucherType NOT IN ('3', '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master

	END

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00610', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00610', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', khách hàng: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Customer: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
			+ N' select N''Giấy báo nợ chờ duyệt'', N''Bank debit advice approval waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
			+ N', N''Giấy báo nợ chờ duyệt'', N''Bank debit advice approval waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
			+ ' from #notify$Content'
			+ CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
			+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt giấy báo nợ'', N''Bank debit advice approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
			+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt giấy báo nợ'', N''Bank debit advice approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
			+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticles$TranferData]
	@dang_bc TINYINT, -- dạng báo cáo
	@String NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
    
	DECLARE @i INT, @iCount INT, @row NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @ky CHAR(6), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @gia_tri NUMERIC(28, 6), @q NVARCHAR (4000)

	SELECT @i = 1, @iCount = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@String)
	WHILE @i <= @iCount BEGIN
		SELECT @row = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@String, @i)
		SELECT @ky = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@row, 1, CHAR(255)), @ma_so = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@row, 2, CHAR(255))
				, @ma_dvcs = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@row, 3, CHAR(255)), @gia_tri = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@row, 4, CHAR(255))

		SET @q = 'if not exists(select 1 from gltcptct$' + @ky + ' where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @ma_dvcs + ''' and dang_bc = ' + RTRIM(@dang_bc) + ')'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into gltcptct$' + @ky + ' select ''' + @ma_so + ''', ' + RTRIM(@dang_bc) + ',''' + @ma_dvcs + ''', ' + RTRIM(@gia_tri) + ',0' 
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' else update gltcptct$' + @ky + ' set tien = ' + RTRIM(@gia_tri) + ' where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @ma_dvcs + ''' and dang_bc = ' + RTRIM(@dang_bc)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateFIFOPriceMaster] 
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strDetailTable VARCHAR(24), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @strMasterTable VARCHAR(24), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16)
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @i TINYINT, @sDyn VARCHAR(8000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @sDyn = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		DECLARE @dDate SMALLDATETIME
		SET @dDate = @dFrom
		WHILE @dDate <= @dTo BEGIN
			SET @sDyn = @sDyn + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112) + ','
			SET @dDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dDate)
		END
		SET @sDyn = LEFT(@sDyn, LEN(@sDyn) - 1)
	END

	SET @strSQL = 'DELETE wrkstkmaster'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO wrkstkmaster (stt_rec, t_tien_nt, t_tien)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien) FROM @cDetailTable'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM wrkstkffiis WHERE ma_ct = ' + CHAR(39) + '@ma_ct' + CHAR(39) +')'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'AND ngay_ct >= ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + CHAR(39) + ' AND ngay_ct <= ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + CHAR(39)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'GROUP BY stt_rec'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE @cMasterTable SET t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt FROM @cMasterTable a JOIN wrkstkmaster b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' WHERE a.ngay_ct >= ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + CHAR(39) + ' AND a.ngay_ct <= ' + CHAR(39) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + CHAR(39)

	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_ct FROM wrkstkffiis GROUP BY ma_ct ORDER BY ma_ct
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_ct
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @strDetailTable = RTRIM(m_ctdbfs), @strMasterTable = RTRIM(m_phdbfs) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			SET @i = 0
			WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strDetailTable) BEGIN
				SET @i = @i + 1
				SELECT @cDetailTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strDetailTable, @i))), @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strMasterTable, @i)))
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable), '@ma_ct', @ma_ct)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			IF @sDyn <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @strDetailTable = d$, @strMasterTable = m$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
				IF @strDetailTable <> '' AND @strMasterTable <> '' BEGIN
					SET @i = 0
					WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@sDyn) BEGIN
						SET @i = @i + 1
						SELECT @cDetailTable = @strDetailTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i), @cMasterTable = @strMasterTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i)
						SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable), '@ma_ct', @ma_ct)
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END
				END
			END

			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @ma_ct
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
	DELETE wrkstkmaster
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptOvertimeSheet]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@UnitType CHAR(1),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @i INT, @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @c VARCHAR(32), @Weekday VARCHAR(256), @Sunday VARCHAR(256), @Holiday VARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @Where = '', @Join = '  join #cong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong', @Key = '', @Filter = ''

	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	
	SELECT @Weekday = RTRIM(val) FROM hrkhaibao WHERE id = 'Overtime' AND line_nbr = 1
	SELECT @Sunday = RTRIM(val) FROM hrkhaibao WHERE id = 'Overtime' AND line_nbr = 2
	SELECT @Holiday = RTRIM(val) FROM hrkhaibao WHERE id = 'Overtime' AND line_nbr = 3

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #cong(ma_cong VARCHAR(32), loai INT)
	CREATE TABLE #temp(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), n1 NUMERIC(12, 5), n2 NUMERIC(12, 5), n3 NUMERIC(12, 5))
	CREATE TABLE #report(sysorder INT, loai INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), bp_me VARCHAR(32), bac_bp INT, n1 NUMERIC(12, 5), n2 NUMERIC(12, 5), n3 NUMERIC(12, 5), stt_ref VARCHAR(512), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	IF @EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' --EmpGroup

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #cong (ma_cong, loai) select ma_cong, case'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' when ma_loai in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Weekday), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''') then 1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' when ma_loai in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Sunday), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''') then 2'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' when ma_loai in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Holiday), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''') then 3'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' else 0 end from hrdmcong'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' delete #cong where loai = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	

	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @UnitType = '1' THEN 'so_ngay'  ELSE 'so_gio' END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp (stt_rec, bo_phan, n1, n2, n3) select ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'r.stt_rec' ELSE '''''' END + ', r.ma_bp, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'sum(case when c.loai = 1 then ' + @c + ' else 0 end), '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'sum(case when c.loai = 2 then ' + @c + ' else 0 end), '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'sum(case when c.loai = 3 then ' + @c + ' else 0 end)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'r.stt_rec, ' ELSE '' END + 'r.ma_bp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref)
		SELECT 5, 0, MAX(a.stt_rec), e.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, MAX(b.bp_me), MAX(b.bac_bp), SUM(n1), SUM(n2), SUM(n3), MAX(b.stt_ref)
			FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			GROUP BY a.bo_phan, e.ma_nv ORDER BY a.bo_phan, e.ma_nv

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c1 CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c1 = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #t FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref FROM #report
		SELECT @DeptKey = @Filter
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#t', 'bo_phan', 'stt_ref=b.stt_ref,bac_bp=b.bac_pn', '', '', 1
		TRUNCATE TABLE #report
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref FROM #t ORDER BY bo_phan, ma_nv
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Order
	SELECT bo_phan, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan

	-- Report
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Filter
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	
	-- Total
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref) SELECT 1, 0, '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, ''
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref) SELECT 0, 0, '', '', '', '', 0, SUM(n1), SUM(n2), SUM(n3), '' FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref) SELECT 1, 0, '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, ''
	END

	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, '''', '''', a.bo_phan, max(b.bp_me), max(b.bac_bp), sum(n1), sum(n2), sum(n3), max(b.stt_ref)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a join ' + @c1 + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp group by a.bo_phan'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, n1, n2, n3, stt_ref) select distinct 5, 1, '''', '''', b.ma_bp, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, 0, 0, 0, b.stt_ref from #report r join ' + @c1 + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '1' THEN 'r.loai = 1 and ' ELSE '' END + '(r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and b.ma_bp not in (select bo_phan from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		UPDATE #report SET n1 = a.n1 + b.n1, n2 = a.n2 + b.n2, n3 = a.n3 + b.n3
			FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, SUM(n1) AS n1, SUM(n2) AS n2, SUM(n3) AS n3 FROM #report WHERE (loai = 1 OR @ReportType <> '1') AND bac_bp = @step GROUP BY bp_me) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me
			WHERE (loai = 1 OR @ReportType <> '1')
		--
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	SELECT @q = 'select case when a.ma_nv = '''' then 0 else a.stt - o.stt + 1 end as tt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan,'
	SELECT @q = @q + 'a.n1, a.n2, a.n3, a.n1 + a.n2 + a.n3 as n, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + space(1) + e.ten_nv as ho_ten_nv,'
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when sysorder = 1 or (''' + RTRIM(@ReportType) + ''' = ''1'' and loai = 0 and sysorder <> 0) then '''' else'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' case when a.bo_phan = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@total) + ''' else space(2*(a.bac_bp - ' + RTRIM(@step) + '))'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' + b.ten_bp' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' end end as ten_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #order o on a.bo_phan = o.bo_phan left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join ' + @c1 + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.sysorder, a.stt_ref, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAppendixOfLaborContractExport]
	@IDNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@AppendixNumbers VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @IDNumber NVARCHAR(33), @AppendixNumber NVARCHAR(33), @i INT
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_plhd INTO #report FROM hrplhd
	
	SET @i = 1
	IF @IDNumbers <> '' BEGIN
		WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@IDNumbers) BEGIN
			SELECT @IDNumber = RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@IDNumbers, @i)))
			SET @AppendixNumber = RTRIM(LTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@AppendixNumbers, @i)))
			INSERT INTO #report SELECT @IDNumber, @AppendixNumber
			
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT * FROM #$keys
	END
	
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS xKey
			, REPLICATE('0', 5 - LEN(b.stt)) + RTRIM(b.stt) + SPACE(1) + b.ma_nv + SPACE(1) + LTRIM(a.ma_so_hdld) AS stt_rec
			, b.ma_dvcs, a.so_plhd, c.dai_dien, c.quoc_tich
			, (b.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv) AS ten_nguoi_ld, c.dien_thoai, a.dia_chi_th_tru, a.cmnd_so, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap, a.so_ld
			, b.quoc_tich AS quoc_tich_ld, b.ngay_sinh, b.noi_sinh, a.so_ngay_cap, a.so_noi_cap, a.ma_so_hdld
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.noi_dung_td ELSE a.noi_dung_td2 END AS noi_dung_td
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.thoi_gian_th ELSE a.thoi_gian_th2 END AS thoi_gian_th
			, DAY(b.ngay_sinh) AS ngay_sinh_ld, MONTH(b.ngay_sinh) AS thang_sinh_ld, YEAR(b.ngay_sinh) AS nam_sinh_ld, a.ma_so_hdld AS so_hdld, d.ngay_ky_hd
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.chuc_vu ELSE c.chuc_vu2 END AS chuc_vu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.dai_dien_cty ELSE c.dai_dien_cty2 END AS dai_dien_cty
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.dia_chi ELSE c.dia_chi2 END AS dia_chi
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.nghe_nghiep ELSE a.nghe_nghiep2 END AS nghe_nghiep
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_qt ELSE e.ten_qt2 END AS ten_qt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN f.ten_qt ELSE f.ten_qt2 END AS ten_qt_ld
		FROM #report z LEFT JOIN hrplhd a WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec AND a.so_plhd = z.so_plhd
			LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrtthd c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			LEFT JOIN hrcthd d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ma_so_hdld = d.so_hdld LEFT JOIN dmqt e on c.quoc_tich = e.ma_qt LEFT JOIN dmqt f on b.quoc_tich = f.ma_qt
		ORDER BY b.stt, b.ma_nv, a.ma_so_hdld

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_DeleteTimesheet]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32), 
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32), 
	@UserID INT, 
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @RangeFrom SMALLDATETIME, @RangeTo SMALLDATETIME, @d SMALLDATETIME, @c VARCHAR(512), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Delta INT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0, @RangeFrom = ngay_gh1, @RangeTo = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	IF @DateFrom < @RangeFrom SELECT @DateFrom = @RangeFrom
	IF @DateTo > @RangeTo SELECT @DateTo = @RangeTo

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')		
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @Key = ' where (a.ngay between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END
	
	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'

	-- Delete
	SELECT @s = 'delete hrvrloi from hrvrloi a' + @Join + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @d = @DateFrom, @Delta = YEAR(@DateTo) * 12 + MONTH(@DateTo)
	WHILE YEAR(@d) *12 + MONTH(@d) <= @Delta BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @d, 112)
		SELECT @s = 'delete hrcongct$' + @c + ' from hrcongct$' + @c + ' a' + @Join + @Key
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ' delete hrcongth$' + @c + ' from hrcongth$' + @c + ' a' + @Join + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	
		--
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(month, 1, @d)
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END
GO

		FROM gpbdc a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			LEFT JOIN dmbpcc c ON a.ma_bp_dc = c.ma_bp

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpJoiningInsuranceMonth]
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Total NVARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @Total = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi >= ''' + RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Month, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' + ''')'

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_nv, gt AS nv_bh, gt AS nv_bhxh, gt AS nv_bhyt, gt AS nv_bhtn, gt AS cty_bhxh, gt AS cty_bhyt, gt AS cty_bhtn
		INTO #report FROM hrnv a, hrluongth$000000 b

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from hrnv a with(nolock) where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt INTO #hrluongth FROM hrluongth$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrluongth select stt_rec, ma_loai_lg, sum(gt), sum(gt_nt) from hrluongth$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #report) and ma_loai_lg in (''B00'', ''B01'', ''B02'', ''B03'', ''B04'', ''B05'', ''B06'') group by stt_rec, ma_loai_lg'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Month, @Year, 0, @Month, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin

	UPDATE #report SET nv_bh = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B00'

	UPDATE #report SET nv_bhxh = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B01'
	UPDATE #report SET nv_bhyt = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B02'
	UPDATE #report SET nv_bhtn = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B03'

	UPDATE #report SET cty_bhxh = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B04'
	UPDATE #report SET cty_bhyt = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B05'
	UPDATE #report SET cty_bhtn = gt FROM #report a JOIN #hrluongth b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND b.ma_loai_lg = 'B06'

	DELETE #report WHERE nv_bhxh + nv_bhyt + nv_bhtn + cty_bhxh + cty_bhyt + cty_bhtn = 0
/*
	DECLARE @tl_bhxh1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tl_bhyt1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @tl_bhtn1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Round INT
		SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @tl_bhxh1 = tl_bhxh1, @tl_bhyt1 = tl_bhyt1, @tl_bhtn1 = tl_bhtn1 FROM hrdmtlbh WHERE ngay_hl = (SELECT MAX(ngay_hl) FROM hrdmtlbh WHERE YEAR(ngay_hl) * 12 + MONTH(ngay_hl) <= @Year * 12 + @Month)
	UPDATE #report SET cty_bhxh = CASE WHEN nv_bhxh = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(nv_bh * @tl_bhxh1 / 100, @Round) END
		, cty_bhyt = CASE WHEN nv_bhyt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(nv_bh * @tl_bhyt1 / 100, @Round) END
		, cty_bhtn = CASE WHEN nv_bhtn = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(nv_bh * @tl_bhtn1 / 100, @Round) END
*/


	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, * INTO #report2 FROM #report ORDER BY ma_nv

	INSERT INTO #report2 SELECT 3, '', '', @Total, SUM(nv_bh), SUM(nv_bhxh), SUM(nv_bhyt), SUM(nv_bhtn), SUM(cty_bhxh), SUM(cty_bhyt), SUM(cty_bhtn) FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report2 SELECT 4, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

	SELECT a.sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 5 THEN a.stt ELSE NULL END AS stt
			, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.nv_bh, nv_bhxh, nv_bhyt, nv_bhtn, cty_bhxh, cty_bhyt, cty_bhtn, b.si_no AS so_bh
		FROM #report2 a LEFT JOIN hrttbh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetTaxCode2TaxRate] (@c VARCHAR(32))
RETURNS NUMERIC(28, 6)
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @v NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @c = REPLACE(RTRIM(@c), '''', '')
	IF LEN(@c) = 0 RETURN 0
	SELECT @v = thue_suat FROM dmthuemv WHERE mthue = @c AND xtype = 1 AND status = 1
	IF @v IS NOT NULL RETURN @v
	DECLARE @c2 VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @c2 = REPLACE(REPLACE(@c, 'KHAC:', ''), '%', '')
	RETURN CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(@c2) = 1 THEN CAST(@c2 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) ELSE 0 END
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$IS] --fs_AfterUpdateIssue
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') RETURN

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d84$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_yc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c87$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_yc = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cMRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineMRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET sl_xuat = sl_xuat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, MAX(dyn_yc) AS dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_yc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cMRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND so_luong > sl_xuat)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c87$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CreateFIFOVouchersList]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@cUnit VARCHAR(33), 
	@nCostType TINYINT, 
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)

	DELETE wrkstkffdetail
	INSERT INTO wrkstkffdetail (stt_kho, stt_ntxt0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_dc, stt_rec_pn, nxt, ct_dc, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, px_gia_dd, stt_rec0pn
			, ma_dvcs, ma_nt, ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_vi_trin, ma_lo, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, tien, tien_nt, he_so1, gia1, gia_nt1, so_luong1)
		SELECT c.stt_ntxt AS stt_kho, b.stt_ctntxt AS stt_ntxt0, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_dc, a.stt_rec_pn, a.nxt, a.ct_dc, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.px_gia_dd, a.stt_rec0pn
				, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vi_trin, a.ma_lo, (a.sl_nhap + a.sl_xuat) AS so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt
				, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat AS tien, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, a.he_so1, a.gia1, a.gia_nt1, a.sl_nhap1 + a.sl_xuat1 AS so_luong1
			FROM ct70 a  WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho
			WHERE ngay_ct >= @dFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dTo
				AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
							AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%') 
							AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%') 
							AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%') 
							AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
				AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(a.ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1

	DELETE wrkstkffit
	INSERT INTO wrkstkffit (stt_kho, stt_ntxt0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_dc, stt_rec_pn, nxt, ct_dc, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, px_gia_dd, stt_rec0pn, 
			ma_dvcs, ma_nt, ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_vi_trin, ma_lo, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, tien, tien_nt, he_so1, gia1, gia_nt1, so_luong1, px_co_gia)
		SELECT stt_kho, stt_ntxt0, stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_dc, stt_rec_pn, nxt, ct_dc, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, px_gia_dd, stt_rec0pn, 
				ma_dvcs, ma_nt, ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_vi_trin, ma_lo, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, tien, tien_nt, he_so1, gia1, gia_nt1, so_luong1, 0
			FROM wrkstkffdetail WHERE nxt = 2 ORDER BY ct_dc DESC, ma_vt, ngay_ct, ma_kho, stt_ntxt0, so_ct

	DELETE wrkstkffitem
	INSERT INTO wrkstkffitem (ma_vt, ngay_ct)
		SELECT ma_vt, ngay_ct FROM wrkstkffdetail
			WHERE nxt = 2 
			GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_ct
END
