CREATE VIEW dbo.vfxfc
AS
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.sua_kh, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp
			, dbo.ff30_FCC(ma_nt) AS ma_nt,	 a.ty_gia
			, CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.nguyen_gia_nt ELSE a.nguyen_gia END AS nguyen_gia,	
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.nguyen_gia ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.nguyen_gia_nt, ma_nt) END AS nguyen_gia_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_da_kh_nt ELSE a.gt_da_kh END AS gt_da_kh,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_da_kh ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_da_kh_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_da_kh_nt,	
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_tang_nt ELSE a.gt_tang END AS gt_tang,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_tang ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_tang_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_tang_nt,	
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_giam_nt ELSE a.gt_giam END AS gt_giam,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_giam ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_giam_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_giam_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_cl_nt ELSE a.gt_cl END AS gt_cl,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_cl ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_cl_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_cl_nt,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_kh_ky_nt ELSE a.gt_kh_ky END AS gt_kh_ky,	 
			CASE WHEN ma_nt = dbo.ff30_FC1() THEN a.gt_kh_ky ELSE dbo.ff30_FCVal(a.gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt) END AS gt_kh_ky_nt, 
			a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2,
			a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9 
		FROM vfx a

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSSituationSummary]--[fs20_FXInsDesSummary]
	@PeriodFrom NUMERIC(2), 
	@YearFrom NUMERIC(4), 
	@PeriodTo NUMERIC(2), 
	@YearTo NUMERIC(4), 
	@Department VARCHAR(33), 
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Object VARCHAR(32), 
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Standard, 20 - FC
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @firstcolumn VARCHAR(512)
		, @iColname VARCHAR(32), @iColdatatype VARCHAR(32), @iReftable VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldcode VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname2 VARCHAR(32)
		, @t01 NVARCHAR(1024), @t02 NVARCHAR(1024), @t03 NVARCHAR(1024), @t04 NVARCHAR(1024), @t05 NVARCHAR(1024), @t06 NVARCHAR(1024), @t07 NVARCHAR(1024)
		, @t08 NVARCHAR(1024), @t09 NVARCHAR(1024), @t10 NVARCHAR(1024), @total NVARCHAR(1024), @ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33)

	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Object = CASE @Object WHEN '1' THEN 'loai_ts' WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_nv' END
	SELECT @ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name LIKE 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @t01 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX01'
	SELECT @t02 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX02'
	SELECT @t03 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX03'
	SELECT @t04 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX04'
	SELECT @t05 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX05'
	SELECT @t06 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX06'
	SELECT @t07 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX07'
	SELECT @t08 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX08'
	SELECT @t09 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX09'
	SELECT @t10 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FX10'
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Gán cách lấy dữ liệu từ điều kiện lọc theo @Object
 	CREATE TABLE #tblColumn (colname VARCHAR(32), coldatatype VARCHAR(32), reftable VARCHAR(32), reffieldcode VARCHAR(32), reffieldname VARCHAR(32), reffieldname2 VARCHAR(32))
 	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'loai_ts', 'VARCHAR(33)', 'dmplcc', 'ma_loai', 'ten_ngan', 'ten_ngan2'
 	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'ma_nv', 'VARCHAR(33)', 'dmnv', 'ma_nv', 'ten_nv', 'ten_nv2'
 	SELECT @iColname = colname, @iColdatatype = coldatatype, @iReftable = reftable, @iReffieldcode = reffieldcode, @iReffieldname = reffieldname, @iReffieldname2 = reffieldname2 FROM #tblColumn WHERE colname = @Object

	-- Dau ky
	SELECT TOP 0 a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, c.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt INTO #tbg FROM ctkhcc a, dmts b, dmnv c
	SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16) AS xKey INTO #temp FROM ctkhcc WHERE nam * 12 + ky <  @YearFrom *12 + @PeriodFrom GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in (select xkey from #temp)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_giam is null or b.ngay_giam >= dbo.ff_GetBOP(' + RTRIM(@YearFrom) + ', ' + RTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + '))' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Nguyen gia mua ky truoc
	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, sum(nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_da_kh_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_cl_nt end)'	
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmcc a join ctdmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where year(a.ngay_mua)*12 +  month(a.ngay_mua) < ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and year(a.ngay_mua)*12 + month(a.ngay_mua) < year(a.ngay_kh0)*12 + month(a.ngay_kh0)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (a.ngay_giam is null or a.ngay_giam >= dbo.ff_GetBOP(' + LTRIM(@YearFrom) + ',' + LTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + '))'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.so_the_ts + b.ma_nv not in (select so_the_ts + ma_nv from #tbg)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	-- Gia tri da khau hao dau ky
 	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctdmcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ((not exists(select 1 from #tbg c where c.so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts)) or (not exists(select 1 from ctdmcc e where a.so_the_ts = e.so_the_ts and (e.nam * 12 + e.ky <= ' + RTRIM(@YearFrom) + ' * 12 + ' + RTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + '))))'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_mua < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
/*
 	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(b.gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.gt_da_kh_nt end), 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmcc a join ctdmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where month(a.ngay_mua) = ' + LTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + ' and year(a.ngay_mua) = ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv'
*/
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	-- Cuoi ky
 	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #ted FROM #tbg
	SELECT (so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)) AS xKey INTO #tempend FROM ctkhcc WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @YearTo *12 + @PeriodTo GROUP BY so_the_ts
	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in(select xKey from #tempend)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	-- Cuoi ky mua ky truoc
 	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, sum(nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else nguyen_gia_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_da_kh_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_cl_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmcc a join ctdmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where year(a.ngay_mua)*12 +  month(a.ngay_mua) <= ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ''
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and year(a.ngay_mua)*12 + month(a.ngay_mua) < year(a.ngay_kh0)*12 +  month(a.ngay_kh0)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (a.ngay_giam is null or a.ngay_giam >= dbo.ff_GetBOP(' + LTRIM(@YearFrom) + ',' + LTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + '))'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.so_the_ts + b.ma_nv not in (select so_the_ts + ma_nv from #ted)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv'
 	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Giam trong ky
	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, -sum(a.nguyen_gia), -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', -sum(a.gt_da_kh), -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)' 
	SET @q = @q + ', -SUM(a.gt_cl) AS gt_cl, -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in ('
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select a.so_the_ts + str(max(year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam)), 16) from dmcc a'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_giam_ts <> '''' and (year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM (@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs') + ' group by a.so_the_ts)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp') + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	-- Da het khau hao
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt INTO #ted1 FROM #tbg
 	SET @q = 'insert into #ted1 select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = '''+ @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in( select xKey from #tempend)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_giam is null or b.ngay_giam > dbo.ff_GetEOP(' + LTRIM(@YearTo) + ',' + LTRIM(@PeriodTo) + '))'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp') + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv having sum(gt_cl) = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	-- Tang/giam trong ky
 	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ma_tg_ts, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS loai_tg_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #temptar FROM #ted

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, a.ma_tg_ts, c.loai_tg_ts' 
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.nguyen_gia, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.nguyen_gia_nt end'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.gt_da_kh_nt end'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.gt_cl_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmcc a join ctdmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmnv d on b.ma_nv = d.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_tg_ts <> '''' ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key , 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs') 
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (year(a.ngay_mua) * 12 + month(a.ngay_mua) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_tg_ts, c.loai_tg_ts' 
	SET @q = @q + ', a.nguyen_gia, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctdmcc1 a left join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_tg_ts <> '''' ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.nam * 12 + a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom* 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@YearTo *12 + @PeriodTo)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, '''', ''1'' '
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, a.gt_kh_ky, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_kh_ky_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a left join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on b.ma_giam_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.nam*12 + a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo)
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--Khai bao giam
	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, b.ma_giam_ts, ''2'''
	SET @q = @q + ', a.nguyen_gia, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhcc a left join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgcc c on b.ma_giam_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in(select a.so_the_ts + str(max(year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam)), 16) from dmcc a '
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_giam_ts <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts) ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_bp', 'a.ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
 		INTO #tar FROM #temptar
 		GROUP BY so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts

 	-- Khai bao giam
 	DELETE #ted WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WHERE ma_giam_ts <> '' AND YEAR(ngay_giam)*12 + MONTH(ngay_giam) < @YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo)
 
 	CREATE TABLE #fagroup (xcode VARCHAR(1024), ma VARCHAR(33), ten NVARCHAR(1024))
	CREATE TABLE #tmpX (id INT, ma VARCHAR(33), ten NVARCHAR(1024))
 	SET @q = 'SELECT ' + @iReffieldcode + ' AS ma, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @iReffieldname ELSE @iReffieldname2 END + ' AS ten INTO #tmp0 FROM ' + @iReftable
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma, ten INTO #tmp FROM #tmp0 ORDER BY ma'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' INSERT INTO #tmpX SELECT * FROM #tmp'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' INSERT INTO #fagroup SELECT REPLACE(STR(id, 3), '' '', ''0'') + a.ma, a.ma, a.ten FROM #tmp a'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @iColname = 'so_the_ts' BEGIN
		DELETE #fagroup
		INSERT INTO #fagroup
			SELECT REPLACE(STR(id, 3), ' ', '0') + ma, ma, ten
				FROM #tmpX WHERE ma IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #tbg
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #ted
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #ted1
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #tar
							)
	END

 	CREATE TABLE #tbg0 (ma_dt VARCHAR(33), nguyen_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), nguyen_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
 	CREATE TABLE #ted0 (ma_dt VARCHAR(33), nguyen_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), nguyen_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
 	CREATE TABLE #ted10 (ma_dt VARCHAR(33), nguyen_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), nguyen_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
 	CREATE TABLE #tar0 (ma_dt VARCHAR(33), ma_tg_ts VARCHAR(33), loai_tg_ts TINYINT, nguyen_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), nguyen_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
 
 	SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tbg0'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT @Object, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		FROM ('
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			SELECT @Object, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '				FROM #tbg'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UNION ALl SELECT ma, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #fagroup'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			) a GROUP BY @Object'
 
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #ted0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT @Object, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		FROM ('
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			SELECT @Object, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '				FROM #ted'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UNION ALl SELECT ma, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #fagroup'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			) a GROUP BY @Object'
 
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #ted10'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT @Object, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		FROM ('
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			SELECT @Object, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '				FROM #ted1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UNION ALl SELECT ma, 0, 0 FROM #fagroup'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			) a GROUP BY @Object'
 
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #tar0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '	SELECT @Object, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '		FROM ('
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			SELECT @Object, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '				FROM #tar'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UNION ALl SELECT ma, '''', 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #fagroup'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			UNION ALl SELECT ma, '''', 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #fagroup'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '			) a GROUP BY @Object, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Object', @Object)
 	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS sysorder, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) As sysprint, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS systotal 
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysRow, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1023)) AS sysColumn
			, (SELECT so_the_ts FROM wrkColumns) AS ma_dt, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6))AS tien, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt
			, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS rowformat, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS sysRowName, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS sysColumnName 
		INTO #report
		
 	-- Nguyen gia
 	-- Du dau ky
 	INSERT INTO #report
 		SELECT 5, 1, 0, '01.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 0, '01.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t05, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky chi tiet
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 0, '01.02.01' + '.' + a.ma_tg_ts, b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tg_ts ELSE c.ten_tg_ts2 END, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma LEFT JOIN dmtgcc c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1 AND a.ma_tg_ts <> ''
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten, a.ma_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2
	-- Giam trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.03.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t06, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Giam trong ky chi tiet
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.03.01' + '.' + a.ma_tg_ts, b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tg_ts ELSE c.ten_tg_ts2 END, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma LEFT JOIN dmtgcc c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2 AND a.ma_tg_ts <> ''
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten, a.ma_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.04.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t07, b.ten
			FROM #ted0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten

	-- Da het khau hao
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.04.01.01', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + @t08, b.ten
			FROM #ted10 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Khau hao
	-- Du dau ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t05, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Giam trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.03.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t06, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.04.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t07, b.ten
			FROM #ted0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Gia tri con lai
	-- Du dau ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '03.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '03.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t10, b.ten
			FROM #ted0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Cac dong text
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT DISTINCT 5, 1, 1
 			, a.sysRow, b.sysColumn
 			, b.ma_dt, NULL, NULL
 			, a.rowformat, a.sysRowName, b.sysColumnName
 			FROM (
 				SELECT '01.00.00' AS sysRow, 1 AS rowformat, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t01 AS sysRowName
 				UNION ALL SELECT '02.00.00', 1, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t02
 				UNION ALL SELECT '03.00.00', 1, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t03
 				UNION ALL SELECT '01.02.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
 				UNION ALL SELECT '01.03.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
 				UNION ALL SELECT '01.04.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
 				) a CROSS JOIN #report b
 
 	UPDATE #report SET tien = 0 WHERE tien IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = 0 WHERE tien_nt IS NULL
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dt, tien, tien_nt, rowformat, sysRow, sysRowName, sysColumn, sysColumnName
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysRow, sysColumn

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT MAX(sysColumnName) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY sysColumn ORDER BY sysColumn

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = 10 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'tien$'
	IF @ReportForm = 20 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien_nt$'

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id), RTRIM(a.header) FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	IF @ReportForm = 10 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT COUNT(*) + 1, 'tien', @total FROM #pivot
	IF @ReportForm = 20 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT COUNT(*) + 1, 'tien_nt', @total FROM #pivot

	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyCDTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @voucherType VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m51$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM d51$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112), @voucherType = loai_ct FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số chứng từ', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Khách hàng', N'Customer', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lý do thanh toán', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	SELECT * INTO #tempInfo FROM #bodyInfo

	INSERT INTO #tempInfo SELECT 'so_hd', 100, '', '', N'Số hóa đơn', N'Invoice No.', 'so_hd', 'so_hd2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_hd', 100, '', '', N'Ngày hóa đơn', N'Invoice Date', 'ngay_hd', 'ngay_hd', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tk', 100, '', '', N'TK nợ', N'Debit Account', 'tk', 'tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_kh', 100, '', '', N'Mã khách', N'Customer ID', 'ma_kh', 'ma_kh', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_kh', 300, '', '', N'Tên khách hàng', N'Customer Name', 'ten_kh', 'ten_kh2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_tk', 300, '', '', N'Tên tài khoản', N'Account Description', 'ten_tk', 'ten_tk2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dien_giai', 300, '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Description', 'dien_giai', 'dien_giai', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien_hd_nt', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền trên hóa đơn', N'Invoice Amount', 'tien_hd_nt', 'tien_hd_nt', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ma_nt', 100, '', '', N'Ngoại tệ', N'Currency', 'ma_nt', 'ma_nt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk, CAST(RTRIM(a.tk_no) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tk2,
			b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2,
			RTRIM(a.dien_giai) AS dien_giai,
			CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd, CAST(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.so_ct, '')) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS so_hd2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), d.ngay_ct, 103) AS ngay_hd,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_kh_i) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_kh, c.ten_kh, c.ten_kh2,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(CASE WHEN d.ma_nt = '' THEN d.t_tt ELSE d.t_tt_nt END, @amountFormat) AS tien_hd_nt, CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.ma_nt, '') = '' THEN @ma_nt0 ELSE d.ma_nt END AS ma_nt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt, @amountFormat) AS tien
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a
			LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk
			LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON a.ma_kh_i = c.ma_kh
			LEFT JOIN cttt30 d ON a.stt_rec_tt = d.stt_rec

	IF @voucherType = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('ma_kh', 'ten_kh', 'ten_tk')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, so_hd, so_hd2, tien)
			SELECT '[so_hd]6', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
	END

	IF @voucherType = '3' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'ten_tk', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]4', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master

	END

	IF @voucherType NOT IN ('3', '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #bodyInfo (col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html)
			SELECT col_code, width, col_style, text_style, label_v, label_e, column_v, column_e, encode_html
				FROM #tempInfo
				WHERE col_code NOT IN('so_hd', 'ngay_hd', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh', 'tien_hd_nt', 'ma_nt')
				ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tiền', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master
		INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, tk, tk2, tien)
			SELECT '[tk]3', 'text-align:right', N'Tổng thanh toán', N'Total', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) FROM #master

	END

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00620', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '00620', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', khách hàng: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Customer: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
			+ N' select N''Phiếu chi tiền mặt chờ duyệt'', N''Cash disbursement approval waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
			+ N', N''Phiếu chi tiền mặt chờ duyệt'', N''Cash disbursement approval waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
			+ ' from #notify$Content'
			+ CHAR(13)
			+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
			+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu chi tiền mặt'', N''Cash disbursement approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
			+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt phiếu chi tiền mặt'', N''Cash disbursement approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
			+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Issue$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0,
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0, 
	@External BIT = 0, 
	@OldSite VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@OldLocation VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Action TINYINT = 0,
	@DataType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(16, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @LotNumber VARCHAR(32), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @Location VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32), @Change BIT
	SELECT @Site = @OldSite
	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, gia_ton, lo_yn INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	CREATE TABLE #LotNumber (ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #LotNumber EXEC fs_GetLotNumber @Item
	SELECT @LotNumber = '', @Change = 0

	IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
			SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite, @Change = 1
		ELSE
			UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #LotNumber) SELECT @LotNumber = ma_lo FROM #LotNumber
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
		ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

	IF @External = 1 BEGIN
		IF @LotNumber <> '' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item WHERE (ma_kho <> '' AND ma_kho <> @OldSite) OR (ma_vi_tri <> '' AND ma_vi_tri <> @OldLocation)) BEGIN
			SELECT @Site = CASE WHEN ma_kho = '' THEN @OldSite ELSE ma_kho END, @Location = CASE WHEN @Change = 1 OR ma_vi_tri <> '' THEN ma_vi_tri ELSE @OldLocation END FROM #Item
			EXEC FastBusiness$Current$Stock 0, @Item, @Site, @Location, @LotNumber, @IDNumber, @Rate, @VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @Action, @DataType, @Stock OUTPUT
		END
	END

	SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_kho) AS ma_kho, RTRIM(a.ma_vi_tri) AS ma_vi_tri, RTRIM(@LotNumber) AS ma_lo, RTRIM(@UOM) AS dvt, @Rate AS he_so, RTRIM(@ItemAccount) AS tk_vt, a.gia_ton, 
			CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ma_kho FROM dmvitri WHERE dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, @Stock AS stock
		FROM #Item a

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

	SELECT a.ma_maubc, a.ccode, b.stt AS stt_cn, a.ma_cn, b.ten_cn, b.ten_cn2, a.stt, a.ten, a.ten2
		FROM dmmausoct a LEFT JOIN dmmausokb b ON a.ma_cn = b.ma_cn

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COAllocatedDirectArisingCost]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Dept VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'

	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @Dept <> '' SET @Key = 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt,  th_sp, th_bp, th_lsx, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	SELECT @q =  'insert into #xdmyt select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, ' + CASE WHEN @objectUnit = '1' THEN 'a.th_sp, a.th_bp, a.th_lsx, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx from xdmyt a  join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs' ELSE '0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from xdmyt a' END
	IF @objectUnit = '1' SELECT @q = @q +  CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' where ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
		ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' +  CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey + ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.th_sp = 1' + CASE WHEN @costDept = '1' THEN ' and a.th_bp = 1' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @costMO = '1' THEN ' and a.th_lsx = 1' ELSE '' END + ')'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	IF @objectUnit = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #xdmyt SET x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0
		DELETE #xdmyt WHERE x_dt_bp = 1 AND th_bp = 0
		DELETE #xdmyt WHERE x_dt_lsx = 1 AND th_lsx = 0
	END

	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @Key

	-- Direct Factor
	SET @q = 'delete xctkqpb from xctkqpb a join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into xctkqpb (ma_dvcs, ky, nam, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3'
	SET @q = @q + ', s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ', ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ', a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', getdate(), getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcppstk a with(nolock) join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update table xctpbtg
	SET @q = 'delete xctpbtg from xctpbtg a join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into xctpbtg (ma_dvcs, ky, nam, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, sl_tk'
	SET @q = @q + ', status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3'
	SET @q = @q + ', s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ', ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ', a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, 0, sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt), sum(a.sl_tk)'
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', getdate(), getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, null, null, null'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcppstk a with(nolock) join #xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + '	group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptNegativeStockFIFOItem]
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(128),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'

	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, b.ma_ct, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'case when b.ma_ct in (' + @InvoiceCodes + ') then b.so_ct0 else '''' end' ELSE '''''' END + ' as so_ct0, b.ma_kho, b.ma_vt, case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''V'' then c.ten_vt else c.ten_vt2 end as ten_vt, b.sl_xuat1 as so_luong, b.dvt1 as dvt'
	SET @q = @q + '	from wrkstkffnis a left join ct70 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join dmvt c on b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt left join dmct d on b.ma_ct = d.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key + ' order by b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct' ELSE ' order by b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.so_ct0' END	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReleaseTicket]
	@TableName VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @tableName) > 0 RETURN

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TablePrime VARCHAR(33), @code VARCHAR(33), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @provider INT

	-- Xử lý tên bảng lưu thông tin dữ liệu vé
	SELECT @TablePrime = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'm21$' END, @qUpdate = ''


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check idNumber access
	/*
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'key', '', @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END
	*/

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Replacement

	--

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END

		-- Update status: Gán vé trạng thái chờ xác thực.
		-- Nếu có post thông tin vé vào bảng hddt00$.... => còn nếu lưu luôn các trường này trên bảng gốc master thì đổi tên bảng cho phù hợp
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesGeneralCalcByPeriod]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@sp_id INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Nested BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME, @pStartYear INT, @yStartYear INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q_bal_update NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @dskh TABLE(ma_kh VARCHAR(32))

	SELECT TOP 1 @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
		, @pStartYear = MONTH(ngay_ky1), @yStartYear = YEAR(ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt

	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ct_dvcs CHAR(1), @No_co CHAR(1), @Dau_cuoi CHAR(1), @Cong_tru CHAR(1), @Khong_am CHAR(1)
		, @Tk VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_du VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_0_gt VARCHAR(1023), @Ds_ma_dvcs VARCHAR(1023), @Ds_ma_kh VARCHAR(1023)
		, @Cong_no CHAR(1), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1023), @nDang_bc INT

	DECLARE @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- STRUCT
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #ed_cust FROM cdkh
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #ed_acct FROM cdtk
	SELECT * INTO #t FROM #ed_cust
	SELECT * INTO #t2 FROM #ed_acct

	-------- 2
	DELETE #t
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$CustomerUnit @dTo, '', '', '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = 1'
	INSERT INTO #ed_cust
	SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, CASE WHEN du_no > 0 THEN du_no ELSE 0 END AS du_no, CASE WHEN du_co > 0 THEN du_co ELSE 0 END AS du_co
		, CASE WHEN du_no_nt > 0 THEN du_no_nt ELSE 0 END AS du_no_nt, CASE WHEN du_co_nt > 0 THEN du_co_nt ELSE 0 END AS du_co_nt
		FROM (
			SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no - du_co) AS du_no, SUM(du_co - du_no) AS du_co, SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) AS du_co_nt
				FROM #t a GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_kh
		) a

				, du_no = case when @du_no > 0 then @du_no else 0 end, du_no_nt = case when @du_no_nt > 0 then @du_no_nt else 0 end
				, du_co = case when @du_no < 0 then - @du_no else 0 end, du_co_nt = case when @du_no_nt < 0 then - @du_no_nt else 0 end

						UNION ALL

							FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_dvcs, @Ds_ma_dvcs) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_kh, @Ds_ma_kh) = 1

							FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt) = 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_dvcs, @Ds_ma_dvcs) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_kh, @Ds_ma_kh) = 1

						, @Tien_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN du_co_nt - du_no_nt > 0 THEN du_co_nt - du_no_nt ELSE 0 END) FROM #tCalc
			END ELSE BEGIN

					SELECT @Tien_nt1 = SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) FROM #tCalc1 WHERE (@Khong_am = '0' OR du_no_nt - du_co_nt > 0)

				END
