	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kh, ma_ct, ma_dvcs, sl_xuat, sl_hd, sl_cl)
		VALUES('', '', '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select a.*, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.statusname' ELSE 'e.statusname2' END + ' as status2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct left join dmttct e on a.ma_ct = e.ma_ct and a.status = e.status order by a.' + @GroupBy
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSUsingDepartmentTransfer] --fs20_FXManifestTranferDept
	@Year INT, 
	@FaType VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDepartment VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cFC VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @cFC = val FROM Options WHERE UPPER(RTRIM(name)) = 'M_MA_NT0'

	-- Lay nhung CC co dieu chuyen
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp, a.ky, a.nam
		, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS nguyen_gia , CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS nguyen_gia_nt, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_nt),'') FROM wrkColumns) AS ma_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(24, 12)) AS ty_gia
		INTO #Ts_cbp
		FROM cthscc a LEFT JOIN dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	ORDER BY 1
	
	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDepartment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.status <> ''*'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (year(b.ngay_giam) >= ''' + RTRIM(@Year) + ''' or b.ngay_giam is null)' 
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 
		
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #Ts_cbp select a.so_the_ts, a.ma_bp, a.ky, a.nam, 0, 0, isnull(ma_nt,''''), 0 '
	SET @q = @q + 'from cthscc a left join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key 
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Lay bo phan goc
	INSERT INTO #Ts_cbp
		SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp, MONTH(ngay_mua), YEAR(ngay_mua), 0, 0, ma_nt, ty_gia
			FROM dmcc 
			WHERE status <> '*' AND YEAR(ngay_mua) = @Year AND so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #Ts_cbp)

	-- Trong truong hop len cho ca CC khong dieu chuyen
	IF @Type = '1'
	BEGIN
		-- Key
		SET @Key = 'year(ngay_mua) = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and so_the_ts not in (select so_the_ts from #Ts_cbp)'
		IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
		IF @FaDepartment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDepartment, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
		IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and status <> ''*''' 
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 
		
		--
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
		
		SET @q = 'insert into #Ts_cbp select so_the_ts, ma_bp, month(ngay_mua), year(ngay_mua), 0, 0, ma_nt, ty_gia '
		SET @q = @q + 'from dmcc'
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key 
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Lay nguyen gia
	UPDATE #Ts_cbp SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt
		FROM #Ts_cbp a JOIN (SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt 
						FROM ctdmcc WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #Ts_cbp) 
						GROUP BY so_the_ts) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, 0 AS stt, b.loai_ts, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2
		INTO #report
		FROM #Ts_cbp a LEFT JOIN dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	
	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @cFC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, nam, ky, ma_bp, so_the_ts', 'INT, INT, INT, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup2 ('loai_ts', 'so_the_ts', 'ten_ts', 'ma_loai', 'ten_loai', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt', '#report', 'dmplcc', '0')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Loai_ts AS CHAR(16), @OldThe_ts AS CHAR(8), @The_ts AS CHAR(8), @ky AS INT, @Ma_bp AS CHAR(8), @systotal AS INT, @stt AS INT
	SELECT  @stt = 0, @OldThe_ts = ''

	DECLARE crRep CURSOR FOR SELECT loai_ts, so_the_ts, ky, ma_bp, systotal FROM #report ORDER BY loai_ts, so_the_ts, ky, ma_bp
	OPEN crRep
	FETCH NEXT FROM crRep INTO @Loai_ts, @The_ts, @ky, @Ma_bp, @systotal
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @systotal = 1 BEGIN
			IF @OldThe_ts <> @The_ts BEGIN
				SET @stt = @stt + 1
				UPDATE #report SET stt = @stt WHERE loai_ts = @Loai_ts AND so_the_ts = @The_ts AND ky = @ky AND ma_bp = @Ma_bp
			END ELSE
				UPDATE #report SET stt = NULL WHERE loai_ts = @Loai_ts AND so_the_ts = @The_ts AND ky = @ky AND ma_bp = @Ma_bp		
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @stt = 0
			UPDATE #report SET stt = NULL WHERE loai_ts = @Loai_ts AND so_the_ts = @The_ts AND ky = @ky AND ma_bp = @Ma_bp
		END
		SET @OldThe_ts = @The_ts
		FETCH NEXT FROM crRep INTO @Loai_ts, @The_ts, @ky, @Ma_bp, @systotal
	END
	CLOSE crRep
	DEALLOCATE crRep

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts as ten_ts, '''' as ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_ts, ten_ts2 as ten_ts2,' END + 'nguyen_gia_nt, ' 
	SET @q = @q + 'ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, ma_bp, ky, nam from #report order by loai_ts, sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', ky, ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateNotifyS2Tran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Get Data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM ms2$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM ds2$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT @priority = 0 FROM #master

	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(128), val2 NVARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Yêu cầu', N'Work Order', LTRIM(ma_lsx), LTRIM(ma_lsx) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lệnh sản xuất', N'MO', b.dien_giai, b.dien_giai FROM #master a JOIN phsx b ON a.stt_rec_lsx = b.stt_rec
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Sản phẩm', N'Product', b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2 FROM #master a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt WHERE b.loai_vt IN ('41', '51')
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ca', N'Working Shift', ma_ca, ma_ca FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Sl yêu cầu', N'Work Order Q''ty', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @quantityFormat) AS sl_yc, dbo.ff_NumberFormat(sl_yc, @quantityFormat) AS sl_yc FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master

	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_cd', 100, '', '', N'Công đoạn', N'Operation', 'ma_cd', 'ma_cd', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_cd', 300, '', '', N'Tên công đoạn', N'Operation Name', 'ten_cd', 'ten_cd2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'sl_yc', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'sl_yc', 'sl_yc', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ngay_bd', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Ngày bắt đầu', N'Start Date', 'ngay_bd', 'ngay_bd', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_cd) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_cd, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_cd) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_cd2, c.ten_cd, c.ten_cd2,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS sl_yc, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_bd, 103) AS ngay_bd
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN vsfcnlt c ON a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd AND c.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01520', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01520', 'E', 1, 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + RTRIM(ma_lsx) + N', diễn giải: ' + dien_giai,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + RTRIM(ma_lsx) + N', Memo: ' + dien_giai
		FROM #master

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Phiếu yêu cầu sản xuất chờ duyệt'', N''Work Order waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Phiếu yêu cầu sản xuất chờ duyệt'', N''Work Order waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt yêu cầu sản xuất'', N''Work Order workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt yêu cầu sản xuất'', N''Work Order workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Issue$Site]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @LocationInput BIT
	SELECT @LocationInput = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvitri WHERE ma_kho = @Site) SELECT @LocationInput = 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) BEGIN
		SELECT @ItemAccount = RTRIM(tk_dl) FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		SELECT @ItemAccount = ISNULL(@ItemAccount, '')
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item AND sua_tk_vt = 0)
			SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		ELSE
			SELECT @ItemAccount = ''			
	END

	SELECT RTRIM(@ItemAccount) AS tk_vt, @LocationInput AS vi_tri_yn, @Stock AS stock
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdccdtk]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk as ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs AS ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2 AS ten_dvcs2
		FROM dccdtk a INNER JOIN  dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN  dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ReleaseTicket]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c0 VARCHAR(4000), @c1 VARCHAR(4000), @table VARCHAR(33), @userName NVARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @userName = RTRIM(name) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID


	-- Struct
	-- Master Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.loai_ct, a.ma_gd, a.datetime2, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_thue
			, a.thue_suat, a.ten_phi, a.t_tien, a.t_phi, a.t_thue, a.t_thanh_toan, dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, keys, loai_ve
		INTO #m0 FROM mticket$000000 a

	--Detail Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.line_nbr, a.stt, a.dvt, a.ma_thue, a.thue_suat, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.thue, a.tien, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xu_ly
		INTO #d0 FROM dticket$000000 a


	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #master FROM #m0
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0

	SELECT @c0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#m0', '#master', null, null)
	SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c0 = REPLACE(',' + @c0, ',key,', '[key],'), @c1 = REPLACE(',' + @c1, ',key,', '[key],')

	--++ Master


	-- Integrated

	--++ Detail

	-- External script


	-- Result
	SELECT *, @Unit AS ma_dvcs, 0 AS loai_hd, 1 AS tinh_chat, @userName AS user_name FROM #master ORDER BY id
	SELECT * FROM #detail ORDER BY [key], id

	--
	SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, '' AS ky_hieu, '' AS loai_hd

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesTrialUnit]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ClearBalanceAmount TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@GLAccount TINYINT,
	@Level INT,
	@AccountType TINYINT,
	@ReportType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @DateStart SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SET @DateStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateFrom)
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, 1)
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk
			, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt
			, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt
			, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #t FROM wrkgl

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Temp
	SELECT tk INTO #tk_cn0 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1 AND tk_cn = 0
	SELECT tk INTO #tk_cn1 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1 AND tk_cn = 1
	SELECT tk INTO #loai_tk1 FROM dmtk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE loai_tk = 1

	-- Balance (Year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh with(nolock, index(nam))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and tk in (select tk from #tk_cn1)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, '''', tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and tk in (select tk from #tk_cn0)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (Period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' with(nolock, index(tk))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where tk in (select tk from #tk_cn1)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, '''', tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_co_nt00), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' with(nolock, index(tk))'
		SET @q = @q + ' where tk in (select tk from #tk_cn0)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (Arising)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from #loai_tk1)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Arising
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from #loai_tk1)'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)

		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pskh$%Partition with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[tk in (select tk from #tk_cn1)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select ma_dvcs, '''', tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pstk$%Partition with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[tk in (select tk from #tk_cn0)'
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ']% group by tk, ma_dvcs'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- DC Account
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_kh, tk, SUM(no_dk) AS no_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk) AS co_dk, SUM(co_dk_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(no_ck) AS no_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck) AS co_ck, SUM(co_ck_nt) AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #dc FROM #t WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn1) GROUP BY tk, ma_kh, ma_dvcs

	UPDATE #dc SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END


	-- Account
	SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, SUM(no_dk) AS no_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk) AS co_dk, SUM(co_dk_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(no_ck) AS no_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck) AS co_ck, SUM(co_ck_nt) AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #Trial FROM #t WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn0) GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs

	
	UPDATE #Trial SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	-- Trial
	INSERT INTO #Trial
		SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, SUM(no_dk) AS no_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk) AS co_dk, SUM(co_dk_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(no_ck) AS no_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck) AS co_ck, SUM(co_ck_nt) AS co_ck_nt
		FROM #dc GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs

	DELETE #Trial WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_kh, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt INTO #BalTmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt INTO #TrialTmp FROM #Trial

	--
	DECLARE @Tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT RTRIM(tk) AS tk FROM Dmtk WHERE Loai_tk = 0 ORDER BY tk DESC
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #Trial WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%') BEGIN
			IF @ClearBalanceAmount = 0 BEGIN
				-- Không bù trừ số dư
				INSERT INTO #Trial (ma_dvcs, tk, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt)
					SELECT ma_dvcs, @Tk, SUM(ISNULL(no_dk,0)), SUM(ISNULL(no_dk_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_dk,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_dk_nt,0))
						, SUM(ISNULL(ps_no,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_no_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_co,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_co_nt,0))
						, SUM(ISNULL(no_ck,0)), SUM(ISNULL(no_ck_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_ck,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_ck_nt,0))
					FROM #Trial	WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #loai_tk1) GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs
			END ELSE BEGIN
				-- Bù trừ số dư
				TRUNCATE TABLE #BalTmp
				TRUNCATE TABLE #TrialTmp

				-- 1. Tổng hợp từ tài khoản thường
				INSERT INTO #TrialTmp SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(no_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck), SUM(co_ck_nt)
					FROM #Trial WHERE tk LIKE (@Tk + '%') AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs

				UPDATE #TrialTmp SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = no_dk - co_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
					, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
					, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
					, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
					, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END


				-- 2. Tổng hợp từ tài khoản công nợ

				-- 2a. Phát sinh trong kỳ
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Trial WHERE tk LIKE (@Tk + '%') AND tk IN (SELECT Tk FROM #tk_cn1))
					INSERT INTO #TrialTmp(ma_dvcs, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt)
						SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(Ps_no), SUM(Ps_no_nt), SUM(Ps_co), SUM(Ps_co_nt)
							FROM #Trial WHERE tk LIKE @Tk + '%' AND tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #tk_cn1) GROUP BY ma_dvcs

				-- 2b. Số dư đầu kỳ, cuối kỳ
				INSERT INTO #BalTmp(ma_dvcs, ma_kh, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt)
					SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_kh, SUM(no_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck), SUM(co_ck_nt)
						FROM #dc WHERE tk LIKE (@Tk + '%') GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_kh

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #BalTmp) BEGIN
					UPDATE #BalTmp SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = no_ck - co_ck, @no_ck_nt = no_ck_nt - co_ck_nt
						, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
						, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
						, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
						, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

					INSERT INTO #TrialTmp(ma_dvcs, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt)
						SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(no_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck), SUM(co_ck_nt)
							FROM #BalTmp GROUP BY ma_dvcs
				END

				INSERT INTO #Trial(ma_dvcs, tk, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt)
					SELECT ma_dvcs, @Tk, SUM(ISNULL(no_dk,0)), SUM(ISNULL(no_dk_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_dk,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_dk_nt,0))
						, SUM(ISNULL(ps_no,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_no_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_co,0)), SUM(ISNULL(ps_co_nt,0))
						, SUM(ISNULL(no_ck,0)), SUM(ISNULL(no_ck_nt,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_ck,0)), SUM(ISNULL(co_ck_nt,0))
					FROM #TrialTmp GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			END
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	IF @GLAccount = 1 DELETE #Trial FROM #Trial a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE tk_sc = 0
	IF @Level <> 99 DELETE #Trial FROM #Trial a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE bac_tk > @Level
	IF @AccountType = 1 DELETE #Trial FROM #Trial a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk WHERE loai_tk = 0

	SELECT * FROM #Trial ORDER BY ma_dvcs, tk

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_Arab2Roman(@tNum SQL_VARIANT)
RETURNS VARCHAR(75)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @type CHAR(1), @lResult VARCHAR(75), @lnNum int
	SELECT  @type =  CASE
			WHEN CHARINDEX('CHAR', CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(@tNum, N'BaseType') AS VARCHAR(20)) ) > 0  THEN 'C'
			WHEN CHARINDEX('int', CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(@tNum, N'BaseType') AS VARCHAR(20)) ) > 0   THEN 'N'
			WHEN CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(@tNum, N'BaseType') AS VARCHAR(20))  IN ('real', 'float', 'numeric', 'decimal')  THEN 'N'
			ELSE 'W'
		END 
	
	IF @type = 'W'
		SET @lResult = ''
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @lnNum = CAST(@tNum AS INT) 
			IF @lnNum  BETWEEN 1 AND 3999
				BEGIN    
					DECLARE @RomanNumerals CHAR(7), @lnI TINYINT, @tcNum  VARCHAR(4)
					SELECT @RomanNumerals = 'IVXLCDM', @tcNum = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@lnNum AS VARCHAR(4)))), @lResult = ''
					SET @lnI = DATALENGTH(@tcNum)
					WHILE  @lnI >= 1  
						BEGIN   
							SET @lnNum = CAST(SUBSTRING(@tcNum, DATALENGTH(@tcNum)-@lnI+1, 1) AS SMALLINT)
							SELECT @lResult = @lResult + CASE 
									WHEN @lnNum < 4 THEN REPLICATE(SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2 - 1, 1),@lnNum )
									WHEN @lnNum = 4 THEN SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2 - 1, 1)+SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2, 1)
									WHEN @lnNum < 9 THEN SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2, 1)+REPLICATE(SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2 - 1, 1),@lnNum -5)
									ELSE SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, @lnI*2 - 1, 1)+SUBSTRING(@RomanNumerals, (@lnI+1)*2 - 1, 1) 
								END
							SET @lnI = @lnI - 1
						END
				END
			ELSE
			        SET @lResult = ''
		END
	RETURN  @lResult
END




GO

CREATE PROCEDURE FastBusiness$Calculate$APInvoiceBalance @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT stt_rec INTO #r FROM cttt30 WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND loai_tt = 0
	SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS t_tt_qd, SUM(CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' THEN 0 ELSE tt_nt END) AS t_tt_nt1, SUM(tt) AS t_tt1 INTO #t FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #r) AND loai_tt = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_tt
	UPDATE cttt30 SET t_tt_qd = a.t_tt_qd0 + b.t_tt_qd, t_tt_nt1 = b.t_tt_nt1, t_tt1 = b.t_tt1 FROM cttt30 a JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_tt WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND loai_tt = 0

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[rf_GetCalendarDate](@nPeriod INT, @nYear INT)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @bgDate SMALLDATETIME, @cDate SMALLDATETIME, @month INT
	SELECT @bgDate = ngay_dn2 FROM dmstt	
	SELECT @cDate = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@nYear))) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@bgDate),2), ' ', '0') +  REPLACE(STR(DAY(@bgDate),2), ' ', '0')
	RETURN DATEADD(MONTH, @nPeriod -1, @cDate)
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployeeAnnualLeaveSummary]
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Delta INT, @s NVARCHAR(4000), @WorkingDay VARCHAR(32), @WorkingHours NUMERIC(28, 6), @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @Year INT, @MT INT
	DECLARE @RangeFrom VARCHAR(6), @RangeTo VARCHAR(6), @c VARCHAR(512), @Ref VARCHAR(512), @l NUMERIC(28, 6), @y NUMERIC(28, 6), @m NUMERIC(28, 6), @i INT, @k NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @e CHAR(2), @p SMALLDATETIME, @max INT, @FirstDate SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @xm FLOAT, @xd DECIMAL(20, 6)

	SELECT @RangeFrom = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112), @RangeTo = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_gh2, 112) FROM dmstt
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @EmpKey = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0, @JoinEmp = 0, @MT = MONTH(@DateTo), @Year = YEAR(@DateTo), @e = RTRIM(DAY(CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + '0301' AS SMALLDATETIME) - 1)), @max = 0
	SELECT @FirstDate = (RTRIM(@Year) + '0101')

	SELECT @xm = 12, @xd = CASE WHEN @Year % 4 = 0 THEN 
			CASE WHEN @Year % 100 = 0 THEN 
				CASE WHEN @Year % 400 = 0 THEN 366 ELSE 365 END
			ELSE 366 END
		ELSE 365 END

	SELECT @Delta = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_nam_tham_nien'
	SELECT @y = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_nam'
	SELECT @m = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_thang'
	SELECT @WorkingHours = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_gio'
	SELECT @WorkingDay = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_cong'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), n FLOAT, phep_dn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_hh NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_tn NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_den_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_th NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), 
		phep_them NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_ps NUMERIC(28, 6), phep_them_tn NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_gh SMALLDATETIME, ngay_nghi SMALLDATETIME, ngay_vao SMALLDATETIME, 
		ref VARCHAR(512), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1)
	)

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'
	
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Employee Group
	SELECT @EmployeeCondition = ''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @EmployeeCondition = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@EmployeeCondition)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' OR @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'

	-- Process
	SELECT @k = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' + @Key + ')' END, @c = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @r = '(r.ngay between ''' + RTRIM(@Year) + '0101'' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, n, phep_dn, phep_hh, phep_tn, phep_th, phep_them, phep_ps, ngay_nghi, ngay_vao, ref) select r.stt_rec, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(r.ngay_vao, ' + @c + '), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, r.ngay_nghi, r.ngay_vao, r.bp_ref from hrnv r' + @Join
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where (r.ngay_vao < ' + @c + ' and (r.ngay_nghi is null ' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '20' THEN 'or r.ngay_nghi > ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @FirstDate, 112) + '''' ELSE 'or r.ngay_nghi >= ' + @c END + '))' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition + ' order by r.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF @ReportForm = '20'
		UPDATE #report SET n = b.n FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(ngay_vao, ngay_nghi) AS n FROM #report WHERE ngay_nghi < @DateTo) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET phep_them_tn = CASE WHEN @Delta = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(n / @Delta) END, phep_tn = CASE WHEN @Delta = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(n / @Delta) END + CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN @y ELSE @m * ROUND(n * 12, 0) END

	-- Department
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.thang, a.ngay INTO #p0 FROM hrghphep a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(nam_hl) AS nam_hl FROM hrghphep WHERE nam_hl <= @Year GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.nam_hl = b.nam_hl
	SELECT a.ma_bp, a.so_phep INTO #p1 FROM hrphepbp a JOIN (SELECT ma_bp, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM hrphepbp WHERE ngay_hl <= @DateTo GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl
	SELECT DISTINCT ref INTO #ref FROM #report
	SELECT @Ref = MIN(ref) FROM #ref
	WHILE @Ref IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @p = NULL, @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #p0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @Ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
		IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @p = CASE WHEN a.ngay = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(a.thang, 2), ' ', '0') + CASE WHEN a.thang = 2 AND a.ngay > 28 THEN @e ELSE REPLACE(STR(a.ngay, 2), ' ', '0') END) END
				FROM #p0 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c

			UPDATE #report SET ngay_gh = @p WHERE ref = @Ref
		END

		SELECT @c = MAX(b.bp_ref) FROM #p1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE @Ref LIKE RTRIM(b.bp_ref) + '%'
		IF @c IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @l = so_phep FROM #p1 a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE b.bp_ref = @c
			SELECT @l = ISNULL(@l, 0)
			UPDATE #report SET phep_tn = phep_tn + @l, phep_them = phep_them + @l WHERE ref = @Ref
		END

		--
		SELECT @Ref = MIN(ref) FROM #ref WHERE ref > @Ref
	END

	SELECT @max = MAX(MONTH(ngay_gh)) FROM #report WHERE ngay_gh IS NOT NULL
	SELECT @max = ISNULL(@max, 0)

	-- Employee
	SELECT @c = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	-- Reset Join
	SET @Join = ''
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' OR @JoinEmp = 1 OR @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'

	CREATE TABLE #p2(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_phep FLOAT)
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select a.stt_rec, a.so_phep from hrphepnv a join ('
	SELECT @s = @s + 'select r.stt_rec, max(r.ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from hrphepnv r' + @Join + ' where ngay_hl <= ' + @c + + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ') z on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and a.ngay_hl = z.ngay_hl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	UPDATE #report SET phep_tn = phep_tn + b.so_phep, phep_them = phep_them + b.so_phep FROM #report a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Delta
	TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(r.so_phep) from hrphepps r ' + @Join + ' where ' + @r + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	UPDATE #report SET phep_tn = phep_tn + b.so_phep, phep_ps = phep_ps + b.so_phep FROM #report a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #report SET phep_dn = b.so_phep, phep_th = b.da_nghi, phep_hh = CASE WHEN ngay_gh IS NOT NULL AND ngay_gh < @DateTo THEN b.da_nghi ELSE 0 END
		FROM #report a JOIN hrphepnam b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.nam = @Year
	--
	CREATE TABLE #g(stt_rec CHAR(13), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6))
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #g select a.stt_rec, a.so_gio from hrttchamcong a join ('
	SELECT @s = @s + 'select r.stt_rec, max(r.ngay_tu) as ngay_tu from hrttchamcong r' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @c + ' and (r.ngay_den is null or r.ngay_den >= ' + @c + '))' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition
	SELECT @s = @s + ' group by r.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ') z on a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and a.ngay_tu = z.ngay_tu'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @MT BEGIN
		SELECT @c = STR(@Year, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0')
		IF (@c BETWEEN @RangeFrom AND @RangeTo) BEGIN
			SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_gio) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r' + @Join + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @i = @MT THEN @r + ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@WorkingDay, '''', '''''') + '''' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.stt_rec'
			TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			UPDATE #p2 SET so_phep = 
					CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 AND @WorkingHours = 0 THEN 0
						ELSE ROUND(a.so_phep / CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 THEN @WorkingHours ELSE b.so_gio END, 2)
					END
				FROM #p2 a LEFT JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			UPDATE #report SET phep_th = phep_th + b.so_phep FROM #report a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			--
			IF @i <= @max BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #p2
				SELECT @s = 'insert into #p2 select r.stt_rec, sum(so_gio) from hrcongth$' + @c + ' r join #report t on r.stt_rec = t.stt_rec ' + @Join
				SELECT @s = @s + ' where r.ngay <= t.ngay_gh and ' + CASE WHEN @i = @MT THEN @r + ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(@WorkingDay, '''', '''''') + '''' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'r') + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s

				UPDATE #p2 SET so_phep = 
						CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 AND @WorkingHours = 0 THEN 0
							ELSE ROUND(a.so_phep / CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) = 0 THEN @WorkingHours ELSE b.so_gio END, 2)
						END
					FROM #p2 a LEFT JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				UPDATE #report SET phep_hh = phep_hh + b.so_phep FROM #report a JOIN #p2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			END
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	IF @ReportForm = '20' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET phep_den_ngay =
			CASE WHEN (ngay_vao < @FirstDate AND (ngay_nghi IS NULL OR ngay_nghi > @DateTo)) AND (@DateTo <= ngay_gh OR ngay_gh IS NULL) THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * ((DATEDIFF(DAY,@FirstDate, @DateTo) + 1) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_dn + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao < @FirstDate AND ngay_nghi <= @DateTo) AND (@DateTo <= ngay_gh OR ngay_gh IS NULL) THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * (DATEDIFF(DAY,@FirstDate, ngay_nghi) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_dn + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao >= @FirstDate AND (ngay_nghi IS NULL OR ngay_nghi > @DateTo)) AND (@DateTo <= ngay_gh OR ngay_gh IS NULL) THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * ((DATEDIFF(DAY,ngay_vao, @DateTo) + 1) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_dn + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao >= @FirstDate AND ngay_nghi <= @DateTo) AND (@DateTo <= ngay_gh OR ngay_gh IS NULL) THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * (DATEDIFF(DAY,ngay_vao, ngay_nghi) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_dn + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao < @FirstDate AND (ngay_nghi IS NULL OR ngay_nghi > @DateTo)) AND @DateTo > ngay_gh THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * ((DATEDIFF(DAY,@FirstDate, @DateTo) + 1) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao < @FirstDate AND ngay_nghi <= @DateTo) AND @DateTo > ngay_gh	THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * (DATEDIFF(DAY,@FirstDate, ngay_nghi) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_ps	
				WHEN (ngay_vao >= @FirstDate AND (ngay_nghi IS NULL OR ngay_nghi > @DateTo)) AND @DateTo > ngay_gh THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * ((DATEDIFF(DAY,ngay_vao, @DateTo) + 1) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_ps
				WHEN (ngay_vao >= @FirstDate AND ngay_nghi <= @DateTo) AND @DateTo > ngay_gh	THEN 
					(((@y + phep_them + phep_them_tn) / @xm) * (DATEDIFF(DAY,ngay_vao, ngay_nghi) * @xm / @xd)) + phep_ps
				ELSE 0
			END
		UPDATE #report SET phep_cl = phep_den_ngay - phep_th WHERE (@DateTo <= ngay_gh OR ngay_gh IS NULL)
		UPDATE #report SET phep_cl = phep_den_ngay - phep_th + CASE WHEN phep_dn < phep_hh THEN phep_dn ELSE phep_hh END WHERE ngay_gh < @DateTo
	END

	-- Limit
	UPDATE #report SET phep_hh = CASE WHEN ngay_gh IS NOT NULL AND ngay_gh < @DateTo AND phep_dn > phep_hh THEN phep_dn - phep_hh ELSE 0 END

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, n, phep_dn, phep_hh, phep_tn, phep_th, ref) SELECT '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ''

	IF @ReportForm = '20' BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN b.ma_nv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.stt END AS tt, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, CONVERT(NUMERIC(28, 6), a.n) AS tham_nien, phep_dn, phep_hh, phep_tn, phep_den_ngay, phep_th, phep_cl
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			ORDER BY a.stt
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN b.ma_nv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.stt END AS tt, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, CONVERT(NUMERIC(28, 6), a.n) AS tham_nien, phep_dn, phep_hh, phep_tn, phep_den_ngay, phep_th, phep_dn + phep_tn - phep_hh - phep_th AS phep_cl
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			ORDER BY a.stt
	END
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PD]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1), @biPOYN BIT
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS po_ht_yn, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS varchar(3)) AS refTable
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM d96$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, po_ht_yn' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when xaction = 0 then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64)

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_hd, dyn_sa, dyn_oa, po_ht_yn, refTable FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @biPOYN, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = @biPOYN' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = @biPOYN' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = @biPOYN' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate)), '@biPOYN', RTRIM(@biPOYN))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @biPOYN, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @refTable, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @refTable + '000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable +  + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @refTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status <> ''5'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @SAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @SAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status <> ''6'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status in (''3'', ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @refTable, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrebcm]
AS
SELECT     a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.mac_dinh_yn, a.ma_cm, a.ma_bac, a.ngay_hl, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ten_cm AS ten_ma_cm,
                       b.ten_cm2 AS ten_ma_cm2, c.ten_bac AS ten_ma_bac, c.ten_bac2 AS ten_ma_bac2
FROM         dbo.hrebcm AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmcm AS b ON a.ma_cm = b.ma_cm LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmbcm AS c ON a.ma_bac = c.ma_bac

GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[rs_rptSFCGanttWOReal]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ManufacturerOrder VARCHAR(32),
	@ManufacturerStatus VARCHAR(32),
	@WorkOrder VARCHAR(32),
	@ProductCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Style TINYINT, -- 1: by day, 2: by hour,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin INT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @maxDays INT, @startSeg SMALLDATETIME, @endSeg SMALLDATETIME, @xOffDays VARCHAR(4000), @xColors VARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @pxDateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @pxDateTo SMALLDATETIME, @currentDate SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT m.* INTO #report FROM 
		(SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_cd, b.ngay_bd AS tg_bd, b.ngay_kt AS tg_kt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_ngay, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_gio, a.ten_lsx, c.ten_cd, a.t_so_luong AS so_luong, a.status, a.datetime2,
			CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS tg_bd_th, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS tg_kt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_ngay_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_gio_th, a.t_so_luong AS so_luong_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(5,0)) AS ty_le_th
			FROM ms2$000000 a, ds2$000000 b, ctrt c
		) m  RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lsx, ma_cd, sl_nhap AS sl_th, ngay_ct, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS tg_bd, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS tg_kt, ma_ct INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000
	
	SELECT @maxDays = val FROM options where name = CASE WHEN @Style = 1 THEN 'm_gantt_cot_ngay' ELSE 'm_gantt_cot_gio' END
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin), @currentDate = GETDATE()

	SET @Key = 'a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@ManufacturerStatus, ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' END + @UnitKey + ' or a.ma_dvcs = '''')'
	IF @ManufacturerOrder <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ManufacturerOrder), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WorkOrder <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(@WorkOrder, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ProductCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(@ProductCode, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	SET @q = '
insert into #report(sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, ma_cd, tg_bd, tg_kt, ten_lsx, ten_cd, so_luong, status, datetime2)
	select 1, 2, a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_cd,
			case when b.ngay_bd is not null then convert(char(8), b.ngay_bd, 112) + '' '' + case when isnull(b.gio_bd, '''') = '''' then ''00:00:00'' else b.gio_bd end else null end,
			case when b.ngay_kt is not null then convert(char(8), b.ngay_kt, 112) + '' '' + case when isnull(b.gio_kt, ''00:00'') = ''00:00'' then ''23:59:59'' else b.gio_kt end else null end,' +
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ' a.ten_lsx, d.ten_cd' ELSE ' a.ten_lsx2, d.ten_cd2' END + ', b.so_luong, a.status, a.datetime2
		from ms2$%Partition a with(nolock) join ds2$%Partition b with(nolock) on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
		join ctrt d with(nolock) on d.ma_lo_trinh = a.ma_lo_trinh and d.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
		where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @startSeg = MIN(tg_bd) FROM #report
	IF @startSeg IS NULL SET @startSeg = @DateFrom
	SELECT @endSeg = DATEADD(MINUTE, 1439, DATEADD(DAY, @maxDays - 1, @startSeg))

	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = 3 WHERE (tg_bd IS NOT NULL AND tg_bd > @endSeg) OR (tg_kt IS NOT NULL AND tg_kt < @startSeg)
	
	SELECT @pxDateFrom = MIN(b.ngay_ct), @pxDateTo = MAX(b.ngay_ct) FROM #report a JOIN cs1$000000 b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
	IF @pxDateTo < DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @pxDateFrom) SET @pxDateTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 3, @pxDateFrom)

	SET @q = '
insert into #sfctpx
	select a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.sl_nhap, a.ngay_ct, a.tg_bd, case when convert(char(5), a.tg_kt, 108) = ''00:00'' then dateadd(second, -1, dateadd(d, 1, cast(a.tg_kt as datetime))) else a.tg_kt end, a.ma_ct
		from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock) join #report b on a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx and a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
		where %[((a.xtab = 1 and a.ct_dc = 0 and a.ma_ct = ''SF1'') or (a.loai_ct = ''1'' and a.ma_ct = ''SF8'' and a.loai in ('''', ''20'')))]%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @pxDateFrom, @pxDateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, SUM(sl_th) AS t_sl_th	INTO #slth FROM #sfctpx a GROUP BY a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd
	SELECT a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, MIN(b.tg_bd) AS tg_bd, CASE WHEN c.ma_lsx IS NOT NULL OR a.status = '5' THEN MAX(b.tg_kt) ELSE NULL END AS tg_kt
		INTO #finish 
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #sfctpx b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd 
			LEFT JOIN #slth c ON a.ma_lsx = c.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd AND c.t_sl_th >= a.so_luong
		WHERE b.ma_ct = 'SF1'
		GROUP BY a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.status, c.ma_lsx

	UPDATE #report SET so_luong_th = ISNULL(b.sl_th, 0), tg_bd_th = c.tg_bd, tg_kt_th = c.tg_kt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_lsx, ma_cd, SUM(sl_th) AS sl_th FROM #sfctpx GROUP BY ma_lsx, ma_cd) b ON a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = b.ma_cd LEFT JOIN #finish c ON a.ma_lsx = c.ma_lsx AND a.ma_cd = c.ma_cd 
	UPDATE #report SET so_ngay = DATEDIFF(DAY, tg_bd, tg_kt) + 1 WHERE tg_bd IS NOT NULL AND tg_kt IS NOT NULL
	UPDATE #report SET so_gio = DATEDIFF(HOUR, tg_bd, tg_kt)  WHERE so_ngay IS NOT NULL
	UPDATE #report SET so_ngay_th = DATEDIFF(DAY, tg_bd_th, ISNULL(tg_kt_th, @currentDate)) + 1 WHERE tg_bd_th IS NOT NULL
	UPDATE #report SET so_gio_th = DATEDIFF(HOUR, tg_bd_th, ISNULL(tg_kt_th, @currentDate)) WHERE so_ngay_th IS NOT NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ty_le_th = ROUND(CASE WHEN so_luong <> 0 THEN so_luong_th / so_luong ELSE 0 END * 100, 2)

	INSERT INTO #report(sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_lsx, so_ngay, so_gio) 
		SELECT 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_lsx, '', ten_lsx, SUM(so_ngay), SUM(so_gio) FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_lsx, ten_lsx

	INSERT INTO #report(sysprint, sysorder) SELECT 0, 99
	SET @xOffDays = ''
	SELECT @xOffDays = @xOffDays + CASE WHEN @xOffDays <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_nghi, 112) FROM mdmlichlv WITH(NOLOCk) WHERE ngay_nghi BETWEEN @startSeg AND @endSeg

	IF @xOffDays = '' SELECT @xOffDays = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @startSeg), 112)

	SET @xColors = ''
	SELECT @xColors = @xColors + CASE WHEN @xColors <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + mau FROM dbColor

	SELECT sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, 
		CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_bd, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_bd, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_bd, 108), '') AS gio_bd, 
		CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_kt, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_kt, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_kt, 108), '') AS gio_kt, 
		ISNULL(so_ngay, 0) AS so_ngay, ISNULL(so_gio, 0) AS so_gio, so_luong,
		CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_bd_th, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_bd_th, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_bd_th, 108), '') AS gio_bd_th, 
		CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_kt_th, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_kt_th, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_kt_th, 108), '') AS gio_kt_th, 
		ISNULL(so_ngay_th, 0) AS so_ngay_th, ISNULL(so_gio_th, 0) AS so_gio_th, so_luong_th, ISNULL(ty_le_th, 0) AS ty_le_th,
		CASE WHEN ma_cd <> '' THEN SPACE(3) + '- ' + ten_cd ELSE RTRIM(ma_lsx) + ' - ' + ten_lsx END AS x_name, 
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_paint,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 AND (tg_bd_th IS NOT NULL OR tg_kt_th IS NOT NULL) AND ((tg_bd_th IS NOT NULL AND tg_bd_th <= @endSeg) OR (tg_kt_th IS NULL AND tg_kt_th >= @startSeg)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_paint_th,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN CONVERT(CHAR(8), @startSeg, 112) + ',' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @endSeg, 112) ELSE '' END AS x_paint_day,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN @xOffDays ELSE '' END AS x_off_days,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN @xColors ELSE '' END AS x_colors
	FROM #report ORDER BY sysprint, ma_lsx, sysorder, tg_bd, ma_cd

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionResultTemplate]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13), -- Khi gọi store này bắc buộc phải có các bảng tạm trước gồm: #kd - bikd, #m03 - bikd03m$..., #d03 - bikd03d$..., #tonghop - bikd00$...
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @part CHAR(6), @vcpart CHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @size_so_ct INT, @vcNumber INT, @maxNumber CHAR(12)
	SELECT TOP 1 @part = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #kd
	SELECT @size_so_ct = [length] FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('bim12$000000') AND name = 'so_ct'
	SELECT TOP 1 @vcNumber = so_ct FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'KD4'


	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct, ma_nk INTO #kq FROM bim12$000000
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #kd) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #kq select a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ma_nk from bim12$' + @part + ' a join #kd b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec' + CASE WHEN @VoucherID <> '' THEN ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE '' END
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bid12$' + @part + ' a join #kq b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bii12$' + @part + ' a join #kq b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bim12$' + @part + ' a join #kq b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bic12$000000 a join #kq b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m03) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m12 FROM bim12$000000
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #d12 FROM bid12$000000
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #i12 FROM bii12$000000

		INSERT INTO #m12(stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_nguon, ma_vt, ma_ct, nv_kd, nh_nc, ma_diem, so_luong, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, dien_giai, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_nk, status, datetime0, datetime2, datetime3, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT REPLACE(a.stt_rec, 'KD3', 'KD4'), a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nguon,
				b.ma_vt, 'KD4', '', '', a.ma_diem, a.so_luong, ISNULL(b.ngay_bat_dau, b.ngay_kh_tu), ISNULL(b.ngay_ket_thuc, b.ngay_kh_den), a.dien_giai, a.ngay_lo_kd, '', '', '0', a.datetime2, a.datetime2, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
			FROM #m03 a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec
		UPDATE #m12 SET so_ct = b.so_ct, ma_nk = b.ma_nk FROM #m12 a JOIN #kq b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		SELECT stt_rec, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #vn FROM #m12 WHERE so_ct = '' ORDER BY stt_rec
		UPDATE #m12 SET so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(@vcNumber + b.id), @size_so_ct) FROM #m12 a JOIN #vn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d03) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #d12(stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_cd, ma_dac_tinh, ma_kho, ht_yn, status, sl_mau, so_luong, sl_kd_nh1, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ma_loai_loi, ma_ph_loai, sl_kd_nh3, yeu_cau, pp_kd, ghi_chu, ct_cd_dt, line_nbr)
				SELECT REPLACE(a.stt_rec, 'KD3', 'KD4'), a.stt_rec0, a.ma_cd, a.ma_dac_tinh, b.ma_kho, 0, '0', a.sl_mau, 0, 0, 0, '', '', 0, '', '', '', 0, a.yeu_cau, a.pp_kd, a.ghi_chu, '', a.line_nbr
				FROM #d03 a JOIN #m03 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		END

		INSERT INTO #i12(stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, c$, m$, d$, e$, ma_nguon, ma_vung, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.status, a.user_id0, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec,
				'#10$' + rtrim(a.ma_vt) + '#20$' + rtrim(a.ma_vung) + '#30$' + rtrim(a.ma_kho), '',
				CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN '#00#%$' + RTRIM(c.id) + '$%' ELSE '' END, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_vung, a.ngay_lo_kd, a.so_lo_kd
			FROM #m12 a LEFT JOIN dmkho c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho

		SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i12', '#d12', 'd$', 'ma_cd, ma_dac_tinh, ma_loi', '#10$, #20$, #30$', 'stt_rec', default, default, default, default, default)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 1 @vcpart = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #m12
		SET @q = 'insert into bim12$' + @vcpart + ' select * from #m12'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bid12$' + @vcpart + ' select * from #d12'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bii12$' + @vcpart + ' select * from #i12'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		INSERT INTO bic12$000000(stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_nk, status, user_id0, stt_rec_kd)
			SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_nk, status, user_id0, stt_rec_kd FROM #m12

		SELECT @maxNumber = MAX(so_ct) FROM #m12
		EXEC fs_IncreaseVoucherNo @maxNumber, 'KD4'
	END


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptVATDeclaration] --fs20_VATDeclaration28--
	@MonthFrom INT,
	@MonthTo INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form VARCHAR(16),
	@ReCal TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cOrder0 VARCHAR(16), @cOrder1 VARCHAR(16)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Tk_no VARCHAR(511), @Tk_co VARCHAR(511), @Loai_ct CHAR(2), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @Dbf CHAR(10), @Ma_thue VARCHAR(33), @Thue_suat TINYINT
	DECLARE @Ds NUMERIC(28, 6), @Thue NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ds_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Thue_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @cOrder0 = '0', @cOrder1 = '24', @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@MonthFrom, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@MonthTo, @Year)
	SELECT @DateStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateFrom), @DateEnd = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@MonthFrom -1, @Year)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_co INTO #tk_co
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_no INTO #tk_no
	SELECT stt, stt_in, cach_tinh, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so01, ma_so02, ds_nt, thue_nt, ds, thue, tk_no, tk_co, loai_ct, dbf, ma_thue, thue_suat, type, kind, recal, ids, bold, in_ck INTO #v20glthue3_28 FROM v20glthue3_28 WHERE Form = @Form
	IF @ReCal = 0 UPDATE #v20glthue3_28 SET recal = 0

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#v20glthue3_28', @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gl0 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 INTO #gl_bal FROM cdtk$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_thue, tk_thue_co, tk_du, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt INTO #ctgt20 FROM r20$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_thue, tk_thue_no, tk_du, thue_suat, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt INTO #ctgt30 FROM r30$000000

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @q = 'insert into #gl select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by tk, tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
