			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vtcm_ktt WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END cm_bac_trung
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(ma_cv_ht, '') = '' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_tong WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END END cm_khac
			, ngay_bd_cvdh, ngay_kt_cvdh, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_bd_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_bd_dong)) AS thang_nam_bd_dong, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_kt_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_kt_dong)) AS thang_nam_kt_dong
			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_kxd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_kxd
			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_xd
			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_den END ngay_kt_hd_xd
			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_tong WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN null ELSE h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_khac
			, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_tong WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN null ELSE h.ngay_hl_den END ngay_kt_hd_khac
			, CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 2 THEN @HRM002 ELSE CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 1 THEN @HRM001 ELSE '' END END AS gioi_tinh_ten
			, ngay_vao, ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_den_qtlv, ten_cv_ht, show_stt, CASE WHEN @TypeShow = '1' THEN '1' ELSE show_yn END AS show_yn
		from #report a LEFT JOIN #hd h ON a.stt_rec = h.stt_rec
		order by stt_kieu, kieu_td, stt_loai, a.loai_td, sysorder, stt, ma_nv
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT data AS v INTO #loai_td_gc FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Loai_td_gc, ',')
		IF @RefType = '01' BEGIN
			SELECT a.tt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_nv, ten_cv, so_sbh, gioi_tinh, ngay_sinh
				, _hs_luong_cb0 AS hs_luong_cb0, _luong_cb0 AS luong_cb0, luong0, luong
				, _hs_luong_cb AS hs_luong_cb, _luong_cb AS luong_cb, tu_thang, den_thang, tra_the_yn, a.ghi_chu
				, phu_cap_cv0, phu_cap_vuot0, phu_cap_tn0, phu_cap_kv0, phu_cap_lg0, phu_cap_khac0
				, a.tinh_chat, a.tinh_chat_loai_td
				, ROUND(tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_bh, ROUND(tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_yt
				, ROUND(tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_tn, ROUND(tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam + tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam + tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_dong
				, nop_tang_bh, nop_tang_bh2, nop_tang_bh3, nop_tang_bh4, nop_giam_bh, nop_giam_bh2, nop_giam_bh3, nop_giam_bh4

				, nop_tang_tn, nop_tang_tn2, nop_tang_tn3, nop_tang_tn4, nop_giam_tn, nop_giam_tn2, nop_giam_tn3, nop_giam_tn4
				, so_thang, ld_tang_bh, ld_giam_bh, ld_tang_tn, ld_giam_tn, tt_cu, tt_moi, t_hs_luong, t_luong

				, CASE phu_cap_tn WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_tn0 ELSE phu_cap_tn END AS phu_cap_tn, CASE phu_cap_kv WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_kv0 ELSE phu_cap_kv END AS phu_cap_kv
				, CASE phu_cap_lg WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_lg0 ELSE phu_cap_lg END AS phu_cap_lg, CASE phu_cap_khac WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_khac0 ELSE phu_cap_khac END AS phu_cap_khac
				, b.stt_nv, b.loai_td_bh, c.so_ld, c.ngay_ky_hd, quoc_tich, dan_toc, b.benh_vien, b.ma_tinh_kcb, so_qd_giam, ngay_qd_giam

				, ISNULL(RTRIM(dia_chi_ht_so), '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ht_phuong, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(RTRIM(b.ht_phuong), '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ht_quan, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(RTRIM(b.ht_quan), '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.ht_tinh, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(RTRIM(b.ht_tinh), '') AS lien_he_bh
				, p.tn_bhxhtn, p.pt_bhxhtn, p.noi_dung_khac
				, CASE WHEN a.tinh_chat_loai_td in ('2', '5') THEN c.so_ld ELSE so_qd_giam END AS so_vb
				, CASE WHEN a.tinh_chat_loai_td in ('2', '5') THEN c.ngay_ky_hd ELSE ngay_qd_giam END AS ngay_vb

				, a.ma_so_bhxh, cmnd_so, CASE WHEN cmnd_so <> '' THEN cmnd_so ELSE ho_chieu_so END AS cmnd_ho_chieu
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_bql WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END nha_quan_ly
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vtcm_ktc WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END cm_bac_cao
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vtcm_ktt WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END cm_bac_trung
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(ma_cv_ht, '') = '' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_tong WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END END cm_khac
				, ngay_bd_cvdh, ngay_kt_cvdh, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_bd_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_bd_dong)) AS thang_nam_bd_dong, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_kt_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_kt_dong)) AS thang_nam_kt_dong
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_kxd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_kxd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_xd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_den END ngay_kt_hd_xd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_tong WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN null ELSE h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_khac

				LEFT JOIN #tableInsuranceMAP b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.loai_td = b.loai_td AND a.tinh_chat = b.tinh_chat
				LEFT JOIN #hrcthd c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

		END ELSE IF @RefType = '02' BEGIN
			SELECT DISTINCT data AS v INTO #loai_td_t FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Loai_td_t, ',')

			SELECT a.tt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_nv, ten_cv, so_sbh, gioi_tinh, ngay_sinh
				, _hs_luong_cb0 AS hs_luong_cb0, _luong_cb0 AS luong_cb0, luong0, luong
				, _hs_luong_cb AS hs_luong_cb, _luong_cb AS luong_cb, tu_thang, den_thang, tra_the_yn, a.ghi_chu
				, phu_cap_cv0, phu_cap_vuot0, phu_cap_tn0, phu_cap_kv0, phu_cap_lg0, phu_cap_khac0

				, ROUND(tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_bh, ROUND(tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_yt
				, ROUND(tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_tn, ROUND(tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam + tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam + tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam, @RateRound)/100 AS ty_le_dong
				, nop_tang_bh, nop_tang_bh2, nop_tang_bh3, nop_tang_bh4, nop_giam_bh, nop_giam_bh2, nop_giam_bh3, nop_giam_bh4
				, nop_tang_yt, nop_tang_yt2, nop_tang_yt3, nop_tang_yt4, nop_giam_yt, nop_giam_yt2, nop_giam_yt3, nop_giam_yt4
				, nop_tang_tn, nop_tang_tn2, nop_tang_tn3, nop_tang_tn4, nop_giam_tn, nop_giam_tn2, nop_giam_tn3, nop_giam_tn4
				, so_thang, ld_tang_bh, ld_giam_bh, ld_tang_tn, ld_giam_tn, tt_cu, tt_moi, t_hs_luong, t_luong

				, CASE phu_cap_tn WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_tn0 ELSE phu_cap_tn END AS phu_cap_tn, CASE phu_cap_kv WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_kv0 ELSE phu_cap_kv END AS phu_cap_kv
				, CASE phu_cap_lg WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_lg0 ELSE phu_cap_lg END AS phu_cap_lg, CASE phu_cap_khac WHEN 0 THEN phu_cap_khac0 ELSE phu_cap_khac END AS phu_cap_khac
				, b.stt_nv, b.loai_td_bh, c.so_ld, c.ngay_ky_hd, quoc_tich, dan_toc, b.benh_vien, b.ma_tinh_kcb, so_qd_giam, ngay_qd_giam
				, CASE WHEN @Luong_nn_yn = 2 THEN CASE luong_cb WHEN 0 THEN luong_cb0 ELSE luong_cb END ELSE 0 END AS tien_dong0
				, CASE WHEN @Luong_nn_yn = 1 THEN CASE luong_cb WHEN 0 THEN luong_cb0 ELSE luong_cb END ELSE 0 END AS tien_dong1

				, ma_so_hgd, dia_chi_th_tru_so, dia_chi_ht_so, dien_thoai_dd, giam_ho, CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 2 THEN 'X' ELSE '' END AS nu_yn, a.ngay_tu
				, CASE WHEN (b.tinh_chat = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_bql WHERE v = b.loai_td_bh)) OR (b.tinh_chat = 2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #loai_td_gc WHERE v = b.loai_td_bh)) THEN a.ngay_den ELSE null END AS ngay_den
				, c.ngay_hl_den, c.loai_hd, CASE WHEN si_no = '' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS tinh_trang_so_bh
				, CASE WHEN (tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam) <> 0 THEN 1
					WHEN (tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam) = 0 THEN 2
					WHEN (tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam) = 0 AND (tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam) = 0 THEN 3
					WHEN (tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam) = 0 AND (tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam) = 0 THEN 4
					WHEN (tl_xh_tang + tl_xh_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_tn_tang + tl_tn_giam) <> 0 AND (tl_yt_tang + tl_yt_giam) = 0 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS doi_tuong_bh
				, b.que_quan_phuong AS que_quan_bh, b.th_tru_phuong AS thuong_tru_bh, b.ht_phuong AS hien_tai_bh, tra_bhyt_yn

				, a.ma_so_bhxh, cmnd_so, CASE WHEN cmnd_so <> '' THEN cmnd_so ELSE ho_chieu_so END AS cmnd_ho_chieu
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_bql WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END nha_quan_ly
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vtcm_ktc WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END cm_bac_cao
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vtcm_ktt WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END ELSE '' END cm_bac_trung
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(ma_cv_ht, '') = '' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_vt_tong WHERE v = ma_cv_ht) THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ISNULL(ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_vao), ''), 103) + CASE WHEN ngay_den_qtlv IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(ngay_den_qtlv, ''), 103) END END cm_khac
				, ngay_bd_cvdh, ngay_kt_cvdh, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_bd_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_bd_dong)) AS thang_nam_bd_dong, REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_kt_dong), 2), ' ', '0') + '/' + RTRIM(year(a.ngay_kt_dong)) AS thang_nam_kt_dong
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_kxd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_kxd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_xd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_xd WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN h.ngay_hl_den END ngay_kt_hd_xd
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_tong WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN NULL ELSE h.ngay_hl_tu END ngay_bd_hd_khac
				, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #ds_hdld_tong WHERE v = h.loai_hd) THEN NULL ELSE h.ngay_hl_den END ngay_kt_hd_khac
				, CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 2 THEN @HRM002 ELSE CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 1 THEN @HRM001 ELSE '' END END AS gioi_tinh_ten
				, ngay_vao, ngay_tu_qtlv, ngay_den_qtlv, ten_cv_ht, show_stt, CASE WHEN @TypeShow = '1' THEN '1' ELSE show_yn END AS show_yn
			from #report a LEFT JOIN #hd h ON a.stt_rec = h.stt_rec
				LEFT JOIN #tableInsuranceMAP b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.loai_td = b.loai_td AND a.tinh_chat = b.tinh_chat
				LEFT JOIN #hrcthd c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			order by stt_kieu, kieu_td, stt_loai, a.loai_td, sysorder, stt, ma_nv
		END
	END

	-- PHẦN TỔNG HỢP CHUNG
	-- Lấy dữ liệu cho bảng trả về cuối cùng (1 dòng)
	SELECT
			-- Số lao động tăng/giảm
			ISNULL(SUM(ld_tang_bh), 0) AS bh_ld_tang, ISNULL(SUM(ld_giam_bh), 0) AS bh_ld_giam, ISNULL(SUM(ld_tang_yt), 0) AS yt_ld_tang, ISNULL(SUM(ld_giam_yt), 0) AS yt_ld_giam, ISNULL(SUM(ld_tang_tn), 0) AS tn_ld_tang, ISNULL(SUM(ld_giam_tn), 0) AS tn_ld_giam

			-- Quỹ lương tăng/giảm
			, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_bh), 0) AS bh_luong_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_bh), 0) AS bh_luong_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_yt), 0) AS yt_luong_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_yt), 0) AS yt_luong_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_tn), 0) AS tn_luong_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_tn), 0) AS tn_luong_giam

			-- Số tiền phải đóng tăng/giảm
			, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_bh3), 0) AS bh_nop_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_bh3), 0) AS bh_nop_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_yt3), 0) AS yt_nop_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_yt3), 0) AS yt_nop_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_tn3), 0) AS tn_nop_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_tn3), 0) AS tn_nop_giam

			-- Số tiền điều chỉnh tăng/giảm
			, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_bh2), 0) AS bh_bs_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_bh2), 0) AS bh_bs_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_yt2), 0) AS yt_bs_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_yt2), 0) AS yt_bs_giam, ISNULL(SUM(nop_tang_tn2), 0) AS tn_bs_tang, ISNULL(SUM(nop_giam_tn2), 0) AS tn_bs_giam


			-- Số lao động kỳ trước/kỳ này
			, CAST(0 AS INT) AS bh_ld0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS yt_ld0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS tn_ld0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS bh_ld, CAST(0 AS INT) AS yt_ld, CAST(0 AS INT) AS tn_ld

			-- Tổng quỹ lương kỳ trước/kỳ này
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS bh_luong0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS yt_luong0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tn_luong0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS bh_luong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS yt_luong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tn_luong

			-- Số tiền phải đóng kỳ trước/kỳ này
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS bh_nop0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS yt_nop0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tn_nop0, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS bh_nop, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS yt_nop, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tn_nop

			-- Bảng mức trần bảo hiểm (chỉ lấy 4 mức gần nhất)
			, @ReportDate AS ngay_hh
			, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS thoi_gian1, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS thoi_gian2, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS thoi_gian3, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS thoi_gian4
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tran_bhxh1, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tran_bhxh2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tran_bhxh3, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tran_bhxh4
		--
		INTO #report2 FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 6

	-- 1. Mục A - Phát sinh kỳ này đã đủ dữ liệu, không tính toán thêm

	-- 2. Mục B - Tổng hợp cuối kỳ

	-- Lấy số liệu từ cập nhật đầu kỳ tham gia bảo hiểm
	SELECT TOP 0 ld_bhxh, ld_bhyt, ld_bhtn, luong_bhxh, luong_bhyt, luong_bhtn INTO #hrbh0 FROM hrbhlddk
	--
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #hrbh0 select ld_bhxh, ld_bhyt, ld_bhtn, luong_bhxh, luong_bhyt, luong_bhtn from hrbhlddk where nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'r.', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- BEGIN: Lấy số liệu phát sinh tăng/giảm từ đầu năm đến kỳ/đợt báo cáo (giống phần kết chuyển nhưng dùng string sql)

	-- Begin - Tính mức trần đóng bảo hiểm từng mốc thời gian (lấy theo thay đổi của lương tối thiểu chung)
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, loai_bh, ngay_hl AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den, he_so
		INTO #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 FROM hrmucdbh	WHERE cach_tinh = '1' AND ngay_hl <= @ReportDate ORDER BY loai_bh, ngay_hl DESC

	UPDATE #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 SET stt = b.id - a.id + 1 FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 a JOIN (SELECT MAX(id) AS id, loai_bh FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 GROUP BY loai_bh) b ON a.loai_bh = b.loai_bh
	UPDATE #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 SET ngay_hl_den = b.ngay_hl_tu - 1 FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 a JOIN (SELECT stt, ngay_hl_tu FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG1) b ON a.stt = b.stt - 1

	--
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ngay_hl AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den, luong_tt, luong_tt AS luong_tran_bh INTO #tranBHTmpTG FROM hrdmlttc WHERE ngay_hl <= @ReportDate ORDER BY ngay_hl
	UPDATE #tranBHTmpTG SET ngay_hl_den = b.ngay_hl_tu - 1 FROM #tranBHTmpTG a JOIN (SELECT stt, ngay_hl_tu FROM #tranBHTmpTG) b ON a.stt = b.stt - 1

	--
	SELECT a.stt, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, b.ngay_hl_tu AS ngay_hl_tran_tu, b.ngay_hl_den AS ngay_hl_tran_den, luong_tt, luong_tran_bh, b.loai_bh, b.he_so
		INTO #tranBHTG FROM #tranBHTmpTG a JOIN #hrmucdbhloaiTG1 b ON (b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_hl_tu OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)
	UPDATE #tranBHTG SET luong_tran_bh = ROUND(luong_tran_bh * he_so, @Round)

	-- End - Tính mức trần đóng bảo hiểm từng mốc thời gian (lấy theo thay đổi của lương tối thiểu chung)

	-- Begin - Tính mức trần đóng bảo hiểm từng mốc thời gian (lấy theo thay đổi của lương tối thiểu vùng)
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, loai_bh, ngay_hl AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den, he_so INTO #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 FROM hrmucdbh WHERE cach_tinh = '2' ORDER BY loai_bh, ngay_hl DESC

	UPDATE #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 SET stt = b.id - a.id + 1 FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 a JOIN (SELECT MAX(id) AS id, loai_bh FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 GROUP BY loai_bh) b ON a.loai_bh = b.loai_bh
	UPDATE #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 SET ngay_hl_den = b.ngay_hl_tu - 1 FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 a JOIN (SELECT stt, loai_bh, ngay_hl_tu FROM #hrmucdbhloaiTG2) b ON a.stt = b.stt - 1 AND a.loai_bh = b.loai_bh

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS loai_bh, a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, bac_bp, ngay_hl AS ngay_hl_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_hl_den, luong_tt, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS luong_tran_bh
		INTO #tranBHKVTmpTG FROM hrdmlttv a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE ngay_hl <= @ReportDate ORDER BY a.ma_bp, ngay_hl DESC

	UPDATE #tranBHKVTmpTG SET stt = b.id - a.id + 1 FROM #tranBHKVTmpTG a JOIN (SELECT MAX(id) AS id, ma_bp FROM #tranBHKVTmpTG GROUP BY ma_bp) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	UPDATE #tranBHKVTmpTG SET ngay_hl_den = b.ngay_hl_tu - 1 FROM #tranBHKVTmpTG a JOIN (SELECT stt, ngay_hl_tu, ma_bp FROM #tranBHKVTmpTG) b ON a.stt = b.stt - 1 AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp

	SELECT a.stt, a.ma_bp, bp_ref, bac_bp, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, b.ngay_hl_tu AS ngay_hl_tran_tu, b.ngay_hl_den AS ngay_hl_tran_den, luong_tt, luong_tran_bh, b.loai_bh, he_so
		INTO #tranBHKVTG FROM #tranBHKVTmpTG a JOIN #hrmucdbhloaiTG2 b ON (b.ngay_hl_den >= a.ngay_hl_tu OR a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)

	UPDATE #tranBHKVTG SET luong_tran_bh = ROUND(luong_tt * he_so, @Round)
	-- End - Tính mức trần đóng bảo hiểm từng mốc thời gian (lấy theo thay đổi của lương tối thiểu vùng)

	-- Begin: Lấy dữ liệu phát sinh của các kỳ trước trong năm
	-- Đưa vào bảng tạm
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS stt_rec, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(512)) AS bp_ref, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay, ld_bhxh, ld_bhyt, ld_bhtn, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_xh0, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_yt0, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_tn0, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_xh, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_yt, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb_tn, luong_bhxh AS luong_cb, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_bhxh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_bhyt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_bhtn
		INTO #hrbh0_2 FROM #hrbh0
	--
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #hrbh0_2(stt_rec, bp_ref, ngay, ld_bhxh, ld_bhyt, ld_bhtn, luong_cb_xh0, luong_cb_yt0, luong_cb_tn0, luong_cb, tl_bhxh, tl_bhyt, tl_bhtn)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' select r.stt_rec, r.bp_ref, cast(rtrim(a.nam) + replace(str(a.ky, 2), '' '', ''0'') + ''01'' as smalldatetime)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when (a.tl_xh_tang + a.tl_xh_giam > 0) then case when c.tinh_chat = 1 then 1 when c.tinh_chat = 3 then - 1 else 0 end else 0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when (a.tl_yt_tang + a.tl_yt_giam > 0) then case when c.tinh_chat = 1 then 1 when c.tinh_chat = 3 then - 1 else 0 end else 0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when (a.tl_tn_tang + a.tl_tn_giam > 0) then case when (c.tinh_chat = 1 or c.tinh_chat = 2) then 1 when (c.tinh_chat = 3 or c.tinh_chat = 4) then - 1 else 0 end else 0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when muc_dong_xh0 > 0 and luong_cb0 > muc_dong_xh0 then muc_dong_xh0 else luong_cb0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when muc_dong_yt0 > 0 and luong_cb0 > muc_dong_yt0 then muc_dong_yt0 else luong_cb0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', case when muc_dong_tn0 > 0 and luong_cb0 > muc_dong_tn0 then muc_dong_tn0 else luong_cb0 end'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', luong_cb'
	SELECT @s = @s + ', a.tl_xh_tang + a.tl_xh_giam, a.tl_yt_tang + a.tl_yt_giam, a.tl_tn_tang + a.tl_tn_giam'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from hrbhdstg a join hrnv r on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec join hrdmltdbh c on a.loai_thay_doi = c.ma_loai'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where ((a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.nam * 12 + a.ky < ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ') or (a.nam * 12 + a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ' and a.dot < ' + RTRIM(@Time) + '))'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' and a.ngay_den is null and a.tinh_trang = 1'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @DeptKey <> '' SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @DeptKey
	IF @ChangeType <> '' SELECT @s = @s + ' and a.loai_thay_doi in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@ChangeType), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- End: Lấy dữ liệu phát sinh của các kỳ trước trong năm

	-- Begin cập nhật lại mức lương so với mức trần
		-- Theo tối thiểu chung
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tranBHTG WHERE loai_bh = '1')
		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_xh = CASE WHEN luong_cb > luong_tran_bh THEN luong_tran_bh ELSE luong_cb END FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHTG b ON a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '1'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tranBHTG WHERE loai_bh = '2')
		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_yt = CASE WHEN luong_cb > luong_tran_bh THEN luong_tran_bh ELSE luong_cb END FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHTG b ON a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL)AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '2'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tranBHTG WHERE loai_bh = '3')
		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_tn = CASE WHEN luong_cb > luong_tran_bh THEN luong_tran_bh ELSE luong_cb END FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHTG b ON a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '3'

		-- Theo tối thiểu vùng
	DECLARE @j INT
	SELECT @j = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #tranBHKVTG
	WHILE @j > 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_xh = CASE WHEN luong_cb > ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) THEN ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) ELSE luong_cb END
			FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHKVTG b ON a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref + '%' WHERE b.bac_bp = @j AND luong_cb_xh IS NULL AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '1'

		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_yt = CASE WHEN luong_cb > ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) THEN ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) ELSE luong_cb END
			FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHKVTG b ON a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref + '%' WHERE b.bac_bp = @j AND luong_cb_yt IS NULL AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '2'

		UPDATE #hrbh0_2 SET luong_cb_tn = CASE WHEN luong_cb > ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) THEN ISNULL(b.luong_tran_bh, 0) ELSE luong_cb END
			FROM #hrbh0_2 a JOIN #tranBHKVTG b ON a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref + '%' WHERE b.bac_bp = @j AND luong_cb_tn IS NULL AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_den OR b.ngay_hl_den IS NULL) AND a.ngay >= b.ngay_hl_tran_tu AND (a.ngay <= b.ngay_hl_tran_den OR b.ngay_hl_tran_den IS NULL) AND b.loai_bh = '3'
		SELECT @j = @j - 1
	END

	-- End cập nhật lại mức lương so với mức trần

	-- Cập nhật quỹ lương
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrbh0_2) BEGIN
		-- Insert dữ liệu vào #hrbh0 từ bảng tạm
		SELECT @s = 'insert into #hrbh0(ld_bhxh, ld_bhyt, ld_bhtn, luong_bhxh, luong_bhyt, luong_bhtn)'
		-- Số lao động tham gia bảo hiểm
		SELECT @s = @s + ' select sum(ld_bhxh), sum(ld_bhyt), sum(ld_bhtn)'
		-- Quỹ lương
		SELECT @s = @s + ', sum(case when tl_bhxh > 0 then luong_cb_xh - luong_cb_xh0 else 0 end)'
		SELECT @s = @s + ', sum(case when tl_bhyt > 0 then luong_cb_yt - luong_cb_yt0 else 0 end)'
		SELECT @s = @s + ', sum(case when tl_bhtn > 0 then luong_cb_tn - luong_cb_tn0 else 0 end)'
		--
		SELECT @s = @s + ' from #hrbh0_2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	-- End: Insert dữ liệu cho các dòng có mức lương mới vượt trần bảo hiểm

	-- END: Lấy số liệu phát sinh tăng/giảm từ đầu năm đến kỳ/đợt báo cáo (giống phần kết chuyển nhưng dùng string sql)

	-- Cập nhật số người lao động tham gia bảo hiểm, quỹ lương kỳ trước
	UPDATE #report2 SET bh_ld0 = ISNULL(b.ld_bhxh, 0), yt_ld0 = ISNULL(b.ld_bhyt, 0), tn_ld0 = ISNULL(b.ld_bhtn, 0), bh_luong0 = ISNULL(b.luong_bhxh, 0), yt_luong0 = ISNULL(b.luong_bhyt, 0), tn_luong0 = ISNULL(b.luong_bhtn, 0)
		FROM (SELECT SUM(ld_bhxh) AS ld_bhxh, SUM(ld_bhyt) AS ld_bhyt, SUM(ld_bhtn) AS ld_bhtn, SUM(luong_bhxh) AS luong_bhxh, SUM(luong_bhyt) AS luong_bhyt, SUM(luong_bhtn) AS luong_bhtn FROM #hrbh0) b

	-- Cập nhật số người lao động tham gia bảo hiểm, quỹ lương kỳ này
	UPDATE #report2 SET bh_ld = bh_ld0 + bh_ld_tang - bh_ld_giam, yt_ld = yt_ld0 + yt_ld_tang - yt_ld_giam, tn_ld = tn_ld0 + tn_ld_tang - tn_ld_giam, bh_luong = bh_luong0 + bh_luong_tang - bh_luong_giam, yt_luong = yt_luong0 + yt_luong_tang - yt_luong_giam, tn_luong = tn_luong0 + tn_luong_tang - tn_luong_giam

	-- Cập nhật số tiền phải đóng kỳ trước
	SELECT TOP 1 tl_bhxh0 + tl_bhxh1 AS tl_bhxh, tl_bhyt0 + tl_bhyt1 AS tl_bhyt, tl_bhtn0 + tl_bhtn1 AS tl_bhtn INTO #hrdmtlbh0 FROM hrdmtlbh WHERE ngay_hl <= DATEADD(month, -1, @ReportDate) ORDER BY ngay_hl DESC
	UPDATE #report2 SET bh_nop0 = ROUND(bh_luong0 * b.tl_bhxh / 100, @Round), yt_nop0 = ROUND(yt_luong0 * tl_bhyt / 100, @Round), tn_nop0 = ROUND(tn_luong0 * tl_bhtn / 100, @Round) FROM #hrdmtlbh0 b

	-- Cập nhật số tiền phải đóng kỳ này
	SELECT TOP 1 tl_bhxh0 + tl_bhxh1 AS tl_bhxh, tl_bhyt0 + tl_bhyt1 AS tl_bhyt, tl_bhtn0 + tl_bhtn1 AS tl_bhtn INTO #hrdmtlbh FROM hrdmtlbh WHERE ngay_hl <= @ReportDate ORDER BY ngay_hl DESC
	UPDATE #report2 SET bh_nop = ROUND(bh_luong * tl_bhxh / 100, @Round), yt_nop = ROUND(yt_luong * tl_bhyt / 100, @Round), tn_nop = ROUND(tn_luong * tl_bhtn / 100, @Round) FROM #hrdmtlbh b

	-- 3. Cập nhật bảng mức trần bảo hiểm
	DECLARE @maxStt INT
	SELECT @maxStt = MAX(stt) FROM #tranBH
	IF @Luong_nn_yn = 2 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian1 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh1 = luong_tran_bh FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian2 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh2 = luong_tran_bh FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 1
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian3 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh3 = luong_tran_bh FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 2
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian4 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh4 = luong_tran_bh FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 3
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian1 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh1 = luong_tt FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian2 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh2 = luong_tt FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 1
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian3 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh3 = luong_tt FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 2
		UPDATE #report2 SET thoi_gian4 = ngay_hl_tu, tran_bhxh4 = luong_tt FROM #tranBH WHERE stt = @maxStt - 3
	END

	-- Result 4: tổng hợp chung
	SELECT * FROM #report2

	-- Result 5: Hộ gia đình
	IF @RefCode <> '' AND @RefType = '01' BEGIN
		SELECT b.stt_rec, a.ho_ten AS ho_ten_ch, a.dien_thoai AS dt_ch, loai_so AS loai_gt, ho_khau_so AS so_gt, ISNULL(a.dia_chi, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.tc_ma_phuong, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(f.tc_ma_phuong, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.tc_ma_quan, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(f.tc_ma_quan, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.tc_ma_tinh, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(f.tc_ma_tinh, '') AS dia_chi INTO #chu_ho
			FROM #tableInsuranceMAP b LEFT JOIN hrhgd a WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrmapbhdd f WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tinh = f.f_ma_tinh AND a.ma_quan = f.f_ma_quan AND a.ma_phuong = f.f_ma_phuong AND f.ma_tc = @RefCode
				WHERE ISNULL(b.ma_so_bhxh, '') = '' AND a.chu_ho = 1
		SELECT b.stt_nv, a.ho_ten, a.ma_so_bhxh, si_so AS si_no, a.ngay_sinh, d.ten_qh, a.cmnd_so, a.ghi_chu, c.ho_ten_ch, c.dt_ch, c.loai_gt, c.so_gt, c.dia_chi, b.tinh_chat, b.tinh_chat_loai_td
				, CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 2 THEN @HRM002 ELSE CASE WHEN a.gioi_tinh = 1 THEN @HRM001 ELSE '' END END AS gioi_tinh_ten, ISNULL(f.tc_ma_phuong, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.tc_ma_quan, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(f.tc_ma_quan, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(f.tc_ma_tinh, '') <> '' THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(f.tc_ma_tinh, '') AS noi_cap_ks
			FROM hrhgd a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #tableInsuranceMAP b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #chu_ho c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrdmqhgd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_qh = d.ma_qh LEFT JOIN hrmapbhdd f WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tinh = f.f_ma_tinh AND a.ma_quan = f.f_ma_quan AND a.ma_phuong = f.f_ma_phuong AND f.ma_tc = @RefCode
				WHERE ISNULL(b.ma_so_bhxh, '') = ''
	END
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[cf_GetCapacityOfDays] (@cCapacity VARCHAR(33), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nType TINYINT) --1 - Standard, 2 - Variable, 3 - Critical
RETURNS NUMERIC(19, 5)
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRet NUMERIC(19, 5)
	DECLARE @Tg_ca1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tg_ca2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tg_ca3 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Nc_ca1 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Nc_ca2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @Nc_ca3 NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Hieu_suat NUMERIC(28, 6), @Hs_sd NUMERIC(28, 6), @Pt_lich CHAR(1)

	SELECT @Tg_ca1 = tg_ca1, @Tg_ca2 = tg_ca2, @Tg_ca3 = tg_ca3
			, @Nc_ca1 = nc_ca1, @Nc_ca2 = nc_ca2, @Nc_ca3 = nc_ca3
			, @Hieu_suat = hieu_suat, @Hs_sd = hs_sd, @Pt_lich = pt_lich
		FROM sfdmcumcv WHERE ma_ccv = @cCapacity

	SELECT @nRet = 0

	-- Calc Variable Capacity
	IF @nType <> 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nRet = @nRet + SUM((ISNULL(tg_ca1, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca1, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca2, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca2, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca3, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca3, 0)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(ngay_bd, ngay_kt, @Pt_lich))
				FROM sfctdmcumcv
				WHERE ma_ccv = @cCapacity AND ngay_bd >= @dFrom AND (ngay_kt BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND status = 1
				GROUP BY ma_ccv

			SELECT @nRet = @nRet + SUM((ISNULL(tg_ca1, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca1, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca2, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca2, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca3, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca3, 0)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dFrom, ngay_kt, @Pt_lich))
				FROM sfctdmcumcv
				WHERE ma_ccv = @cCapacity AND ngay_bd < @dFrom AND (ngay_kt BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND status = 1
				GROUP BY ma_ccv

			SELECT @nRet = @nRet + SUM((ISNULL(tg_ca1, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca1, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca2, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca2, 0) + ISNULL(tg_ca3, 0) * ISNULL(nc_ca3, 0)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(CASE WHEN ngay_bd > @dFrom THEN ngay_bd ELSE @dFrom END, @dTo, @Pt_lich))
				FROM sfctdmcumcv
				WHERE ma_ccv = @cCapacity AND ngay_bd <= @dTo AND ngay_kt > @dTo AND status = 1
				GROUP BY ma_ccv
		END
	--

	SELECT @nRet =
		CASE @nType
			WHEN 1 THEN -- Standard
				((@Tg_ca1 * @Nc_ca1) + (@Tg_ca2 * @Nc_ca2) + (@Tg_ca3 * @Nc_ca3)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dFrom, @dTo, @Pt_lich)
			WHEN 2 THEN -- Variable
				(@nRet + ((@Tg_ca1 * @Nc_ca1) + (@Tg_ca2 * @Nc_ca2) + (@Tg_ca3 * @Nc_ca3)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dFrom, @dTo, @Pt_lich)) * @Hieu_suat * @Hs_sd / 10000
			WHEN 3 THEN -- Critical
				@nRet + ((@Tg_ca1 * @Nc_ca1) + (@Tg_ca2 * @Nc_ca2) + (@Tg_ca3 * @Nc_ca3)) * dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dFrom, @dTo, @Pt_lich)
		END

	IF @nRet IS NULL SELECT @nRet = 0
	RETURN @nRet
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PG] --fs_AfterUpdatePG
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 loai_ct INTO #TranType FROM m78$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hd, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hdon, so_luong, he_so
		, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_pn, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hdon, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ttmh
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM d78$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #TranType SELECT loai_ct FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_pn <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hdon = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d94$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hdon <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hdon = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_pn <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_pn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_ttmh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPDIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePDIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_pn VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hdon VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ttmh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_pn, dyn_dh, dyn_hdon, dyn_hd, dyn_ttmh FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = '2') BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
	
	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_pn) AS dyn_pn, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hdon) AS dyn_hdon, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_ttmh) AS dyn_ttmh FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$' + '000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$' + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''6'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END

	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[phlsx] AS SELECT ma_dvcs, stt_rec AS stt_rec, SPACE(4) + so_ct AS so_lsx, dien_giai AS dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giai2 FROM phsx WHERE  status NOT IN ('0', '*')

GO
CREATE PROC [dbo].[rs_rptSFCGanttWOPlan]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ManufacturerOrder VARCHAR(32),
	@ManufacturerStatus VARCHAR(32),
	@WorkOrder VARCHAR(32),
	@ProductCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Style TINYINT, -- 1: by day, 2: by hour,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin INT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @maxDays INT, @startSeg SMALLDATETIME, @endSeg SMALLDATETIME, @xOffDays VARCHAR(4000), @xColors VARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT m.* INTO #report FROM 
		(SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS sysorder,a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_cd, c.kieu_cd, b.ngay_bd AS tg_bd, b.ngay_kt AS tg_kt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_ngay, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(18,0)) AS so_gio, c.cd_truoc, c.cd_sau, a.ten_lsx, c.ten_cd, a.t_so_luong AS so_luong
			FROM ms2$000000 a, ds2$000000 b, ctrt c
		) m  RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	
	SELECT @maxDays = val FROM options where name = CASE WHEN @Style = 1 THEN 'm_gantt_cot_ngay' ELSE 'm_gantt_cot_gio' END

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @Key = 'a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@ManufacturerStatus, ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' END + @UnitKey + ' or a.ma_dvcs = '''')'
	IF @ManufacturerOrder <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ManufacturerOrder), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @WorkOrder <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(@WorkOrder, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ProductCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(@ProductCode, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = '
insert into #report(sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, ma_cd, kieu_cd, tg_bd, tg_kt, cd_truoc, cd_sau, ten_lsx, ten_cd, so_luong)
	select 1, 2, a.stt_rec, a.ma_lsx, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_cd, d.kieu_cd,
			case when b.ngay_bd is not null then convert(char(8), b.ngay_bd, 112) + '' '' + case when isnull(b.gio_bd, '''') = '''' then ''00:00:00'' else b.gio_bd end else null end,
			case when b.ngay_kt is not null then convert(char(8), b.ngay_kt, 112) + '' '' + case when isnull(b.gio_kt, ''00:00'') = ''00:00'' then ''23:59:59'' else b.gio_kt end else null end,
			d.cd_truoc, d.cd_sau,' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ' a.ten_lsx, d.ten_cd' ELSE ' a.ten_lsx2, d.ten_cd2' END + ', b.so_luong
		from ms2$%Partition a with(nolock) join ds2$%Partition b with(nolock) on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
		join ctrt d with(nolock) on d.ma_lo_trinh = a.ma_lo_trinh and d.ma_cd = b.ma_cd
		where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @startSeg = MIN(tg_bd) FROM #report
	IF @startSeg IS NULL SET @startSeg = @DateFrom
	SELECT @endSeg = DATEADD(DAY, @maxDays - 1, @startSeg)

	UPDATE #report SET sysorder = 3 WHERE (tg_bd IS NOT NULL AND tg_bd > @endSeg) OR (tg_kt IS NOT NULL AND tg_kt < @startSeg)
	UPDATE #report SET so_ngay = DATEDIFF(DAY, tg_bd, tg_kt) + 1 WHERE tg_bd IS NOT NULL AND tg_kt IS NOT NULL
	UPDATE #report SET so_gio = DATEDIFF(HOUR, tg_bd, tg_kt) WHERE so_ngay IS NOT NULL
	
	INSERT INTO #report(sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ten_lsx, so_ngay, so_gio) 
		SELECT 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_lsx, '', ten_lsx, SUM(so_ngay), SUM(so_gio) FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_lsx, ten_lsx

	INSERT INTO #report(sysprint, sysorder) SELECT 0, 99
	SET @xOffDays = ''
	SELECT @xOffDays = @xOffDays + CASE WHEN @xOffDays <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_nghi, 112) FROM mdmlichlv WITH(NOLOCk) WHERE ngay_nghi BETWEEN @startSeg AND @endSeg

	SET @xColors = ''
	SELECT @xColors = @xColors + CASE WHEN @xColors <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + mau FROM dbColor

	IF @xOffDays = '' SELECT @xOffDays = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DAY, -1, @startSeg), 112)

	SELECT sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_lsx, ma_cd, kieu_cd, CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_bd, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_bd, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_bd, 108), '') AS gio_bd, 
		CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), tg_kt, 112) AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_kt, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(5), tg_kt, 108), '') AS gio_kt,
		ISNULL(so_ngay, 0) AS so_ngay, ISNULL(so_gio, 0) AS so_gio, cd_truoc, cd_sau, so_luong,
		CASE WHEN ma_cd <> '' THEN SPACE(3) + '- ' + ten_cd ELSE RTRIM(ma_lsx) + ' - ' + ten_lsx END AS x_name, 
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_paint,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN CONVERT(CHAR(8), @startSeg, 112) + ',' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @endSeg, 112) ELSE '' END AS x_paint_day,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN @xOffDays ELSE '' END AS x_off_days,
		CASE WHEN sysorder = 99 THEN @xColors ELSE '' END AS x_colors
	FROM #report ORDER BY sysprint, ma_lsx, sysorder, tg_bd, ma_cd

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostS8Tran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @loai_ct CHAR(1), @rq TINYINT

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @p = RIGHT(@masterTable, 6)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #ms8 FROM ms8$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, a.so_luong AS sl_nhap1, a.so_luong AS sl_xuat1, a.so_luong AS sl_hong1, nh_nc AS ma_nh INTO #ds8 FROM ds8$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #ms8 select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 1 @loai_ct = loai_ct FROM #ms8

	SET @q = 'insert into #ds8 select *, so_luong, so_luong, 0, nh_nc from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- 1. Post nhập xuất tồn
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	UPDATE #ds8 SET sl_nhap1 = CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '1' THEN so_luong ELSE 0 END, sl_xuat1 = CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '1' THEN 0 ELSE so_luong END, sl_hong1 = CASE WHEN loai = '40' THEN so_luong ELSE 0 END

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#ds8', '#sfctpx', '#ds8', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#ms8', '#ds8', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', 'tg_bd = b.ngay_ct, tg_kt = b.ngay_ct'

	UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = '', xtab = CASE WHEN @loai_ct = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
		sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so, @rq), sl_hong = ROUND(sl_hong1*he_so, @rq)

	SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- 2. Post nhân công
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctnc FROM sfctnc$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctnc', '#ds8', '#sfctnc', '#ds8', '(ma_nc <> '''' or ma_nh <> '''') and (loai = '''' or loai = ''20'')', NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctnc', '#ms8', '#ds8', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', 'ma_ccv = '''''

	SET @q = 'insert into sfctnc$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctnc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEIIssueAdjustmentAndReplacementReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@IssueFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@IssueTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT, -- 1 - Điều chỉnh, 2 - Thay thế
	@Status CHAR(1), -- 0. Chưa xác thực, 1. Chờ xác thực, 2. Đã xác thực, 3. Điều chỉnh, 4. Thay thế, 8. Chờ hủy, 9. Hủy
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @m VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32), @t VARCHAR(32), @vCode VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @f NVARCHAR(512), @j NVARCHAR(512)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 c.user_id2 AS nguoi_ph, d.comment AS nguoi_th, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.so_ct_hddt, c.so_seri_hddt, c.mau_hddt, a.so_ct, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt AS tien_nt,
			a.stt_rec AS stt_rec0, a.ma_ct AS ma_ct0, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct0, a.so_ct AS so_ct0, c.so_ct_hddt AS so_ct_hddt0, c.so_seri_hddt AS so_seri_hddt0, c.mau_hddt AS mau_hddt0, a.ma_nt AS ma_nt0, a.t_tien_nt AS tien_nt0, a.ma_kh,
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS m$0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS hddt$0
		INTO #report FROM m84$000000 a, dmkh b, hddt00$000000 c, vsysuserinfo d
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tmp FROM #report

	-- Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin), @Key = '', @Join = '', @t = ''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.tinh_trang_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_ct = ''PX5'''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @IssueFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct1 >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@IssueFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @IssueTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct1 <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@IssueTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

		IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
		IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

		IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_nt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		SELECT @Join = ' join hddt05 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec1'
	END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Get data from hddt00$
	SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN '#tmp' ELSE '#report' END + ' select a.user_id2, c.comment' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.mau_hddt, ' +
		CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN ''''', '''', 0, '''', '''', null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, ''''' ELSE 'b.so_ct1, b.ma_nt1, b.t_tt_nt1, b.stt_rec0, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct0, b.so_ct0, '''', '''', '''', b.ma_nt0, b.t_tt_nt0, b.ma_kh1' END +
		', '''', '''' from hddt00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' left join vsysuserinfo c on a.user_id2 = c.id where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = ''
		IF @IssueFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@IssueFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @IssueTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@IssueTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

		IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
		IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

		IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('$', b.m$) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('000000', b.m$) = 0) THEN RTRIM(b.m$) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) ELSE b.m$ END AS m$,
				CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('$', b.d$) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('000000', b.d$) = 0) THEN RTRIM(b.d$) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) ELSE b.d$ END AS t$
			INTO #voucher FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS m$, stt_rec0, stt_rec INTO #adj FROM #report


		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #voucher) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @m = m$, @t = t$ FROM #voucher
			--
			SELECT @q = '
insert into #report
	select b.nguoi_ph, b.nguoi_th, b.stt_rec, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, b.mau_hddt, a.so_ct, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt , '''', '''', null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, a.ma_kh, '''', ''''
		from ' + RTRIM(@m) + ' a with(nolock) join #tmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.status <> ''0''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
			SELECT @q = @q + '
insert into #adj
	select distinct case when (charindex(''$'', b.c$) > 0 and charindex(''000000'', b.c$) = 0) then rtrim(b.c$) + ''000000'' else b.c$ end,
			case when (charindex(''$'', b.m$) > 0 and charindex(''000000'', b.m$) = 0) then rtrim(b.m$) + ''%Partition'' else b.m$ end, a.stt_rec_px, a.stt_rec
		from ' + RTRIM(@t) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmct9 b with(nolock) on right(a.stt_rec_px, 3) = b.ma_ct
		where a.stt_rec_px <> '''' and exists(select 1 from #report c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			DELETE #voucher WHERE m$ = @m AND t$ = @t
		END
		UPDATE #report SET stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 FROM #report a JOIN #adj b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

		-- Update from table c$
		SELECT DISTINCT c$ INTO #t1 FROM #adj
		SELECT TOP 0 c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS hddt$ INTO #t2 FROM #adj
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @c = c$ FROM #t1

			SELECT @q = '
insert into #t2 select distinct replace(b.m$, ''%Partition'', convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112)), ''hddt00$'' + convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112)
	from ' + RTRIM(@c) + ' a with(nolock) join #adj b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DELETE #t1 WHERE c$ = @c
		END

		-- Update from table master m$
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @m = c$, @t = hddt$ FROM #t2
			--
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = @t AND xtype = 'U')
				SELECT @f = ', so_ct_hddt0 = c.so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt0 = c.so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt0 = c.mau_hddt', @j = ' join ' + RTRIM(@t) + ' c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec'
			ELSE
				SELECT @f = '', @j = ''
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct, so_ct0 = b.so_ct, ma_ct0 = b.ma_ct, ma_nt0 = b.ma_nt, tien_nt0 = b.t_tien_nt' + @f + ' from #report a join ' + RTRIM(@m) + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec' + @j
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			DELETE #t2 WHERE c$ = @m and hddt$ = @t
		END
		DELETE #report WHERE stt_rec0 <> '' AND so_ct0 = '' AND ngay_ct0 IS NULL
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct0, 112) AS p INTO #p FROM #report WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @s = 'update #report set so_ct_hddt0 = b.so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt0 = b.so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt0 = b.mau_hddt from #report a join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec'
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #p) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @t = p FROM #p
			--
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'hddt00$' + @t AND xtype = 'U') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Partition', @t)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			DELETE #p WHERE p = @t
		END
	END


	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec0, ma_ct0, stt_rec, ma_ct, nguoi_th) SELECT '', '', '', '', ''

	-- View
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ff_NumberFormatReplace(@str VARCHAR(255))
RETURNS VARCHAR(255) AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @i INT,@index INT,@pos INT
	SET @i=1
	SET @index=0
	SET @pos=0
	WHILE @i>=1 
	BEGIN
		SET @i=CHARINDEX('.',@str,@pos)
		IF(@i>0) 
		BEGIN
			SET @pos =@i+1
			SET @index=@i	
		END
	END
	SET @str = SUBSTRING(@str,0,@index) + ',' + SUBSTRING(@str,@index+1,LEN(@str)-@index)
	RETURN @str
END





GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaCheck] (@Formula NVARCHAR(1024))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1024)
BEGIN 
	IF @Formula = '' RETURN 1
	DECLARE @i INT, @iFlag BIT, @strRe NVARCHAR(1024), @s NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @i = 1, @iFlag = 1, @strRe = '0 + '
	WHILE @i <= LEN(@Formula) BEGIN
		SET @s = SUBSTRING(@Formula, @i, 1)
		IF @s = '[' BEGIN
			SET @iFlag = 0
			SET @strRe = @strRe + 'NU'
		END
		IF @s = ']' BEGIN
			SET @iFlag = 1
			SET @strRe = @strRe + 'LL'
		END
		IF @iFlag = 1 AND @s <> ']' SET @strRe = @strRe + @s
		SET @i = @i + 1		
	END
	SET @strRe = REPLACE(@strRe, 'NULL', '0')

	RETURN @strRe
END


GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vp00$000000
AS
SELECT     TOP 100 PERCENT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.tien_nt, a.tien, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.datetime2, a.user_id2, b.ten_ct, b.ten_ct2, 
                      c.name, c.comment, c.comment2, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '-', '') AS chuoi_ngay
FROM         dbo.p00$000000 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.dmct AS b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.vsysuserinfo AS c ON a.user_id2 = c.id
ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCShopFloorStockCompareData]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@shop VARCHAR(32),
	@site VARCHAR(32),
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@itemType VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@type CHAR(1), -- 1-Thành phẩm nhập kho, 2-Đối chiếu xuất NVL
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @key0 NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Unit VARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(32), @total NVARCHAR(511), @g NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports where ccode = 'Total'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_vt, ma_kho, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_kho, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_kho, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_px, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_px INTO #r FROM r70$000000

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @Unit = '', @table = CASE WHEN @type = '2' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') THEN 'r70$%Partition' ELSE 'r90$%Partition' END, @g = 'a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt' + CASE WHEN @type = '1' THEN ', a.stt_rec' ELSE '' END
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Số liệu phân xưởng
	SELECT @key0 = 'a.ma_kho <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @key
	IF @shop <> '' SET @key0 = @key0 + ' and a.ma_px like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@shop), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @type = '2' SET @key0 = @key0 + ' and ma_ct = ''SF7'' and loai_ct = ''2'''
	SET @q = ' insert into #r select max(a.stt_rec), a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), sum(sl_xuat)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from sfctpx$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key0 + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ' + @g
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	-- Số liệu kho
	IF @type = '1' SELECT DISTINCT LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + 'PNH' AS stt_rec INTO #stt_rec FROM #r
	SELECT @key0 = CASE WHEN @type = '2' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') THEN 'a.ma_ct = ''PNI'' and a.loai_ct = ''9''' ELSE 'a.ma_ct = ''PNF'' and a.loai_ct = ''9''' END ELSE 'exists (select 1 from #stt_rec z where a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec)' END + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @Key
	SET @q = ' insert into #r select max(a.stt_rec), a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, sum(sl_nhap), sum(sl_xuat), 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key0 + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ' + @g
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin



	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ma_vt, ma_kho, SUM(sl_nhap_kho) AS sl_nhap_kho, SUM(sl_xuat_kho) AS sl_xuat_kho, SUM(sl_nhap_px) AS sl_nhap_px, SUM(sl_xuat_px) AS sl_xuat_px, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #report
		FROM #r GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho HAVING ((@type = '2' AND (SUM(sl_nhap_kho) + SUM(sl_nhap_px) <> 0)) OR (@type <> '2' AND SUM(sl_xuat_kho) + SUM(sl_xuat_px) <> 0)) ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_kho
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report	SELECT 1, 0, 0, '', '', SUM(sl_nhap_kho), SUM(sl_xuat_kho), SUM(sl_nhap_px), SUM(sl_xuat_px) FROM #r
		INSERT INTO #report	SELECT 2, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0
	END ELSE INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0

	-- View
	IF @type = '2'
		SELECT CASE WHEN a.ma_vt = '' THEN 0 ELSE a.stt END AS stt
				, a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, b.dvt
				, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 1 THEN @total ELSE CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END END AS ten_vt
				, a.sl_nhap_kho AS sl_kho, a.sl_nhap_px AS sl_px, a.sl_nhap_kho - a.sl_nhap_px AS chenh_lech
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.stt
	ELSE
		SELECT CASE WHEN a.ma_vt = '' THEN 0 ELSE a.stt END AS stt
				, a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, b.dvt
				, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 1 THEN @total ELSE CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END END AS ten_vt
				, a.sl_nhap_kho AS sl_kho, a.sl_xuat_px AS sl_px, a.sl_nhap_kho - a.sl_xuat_px AS chenh_lech
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt ORDER BY a.sysorder, a.stt

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptVATDeclarationForProject]
	@MonthFrom INT,
	@MonthTo INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form VARCHAR(16),
	@ReCal TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @DateStart SMALLDATETIME, @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cOrder0 VARCHAR(16), @cOrder1 VARCHAR(16)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Tk_no VARCHAR(511), @Tk_co VARCHAR(511), @Loai_ct CHAR(2), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @Dbf  CHAR(10), @Ma_thue VARCHAR(33), @Thue_suat TINYINT

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_co INTO #tk_co
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_no INTO #tk_no
	SELECT stt, stt_in, cach_tinh, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so01, ma_so02, ds_nt, thue_nt, ds, thue, tk_no, tk_co, loai_ct, dbf, ma_thue, thue_suat, type, kind, recal, ids, bold, in_ck INTO #v20glthue3_28da FROM v20glthue3_28da WHERE Form = @Form

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #gl0 select tk, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by tk'

insert into #ctgt30

'

insert into #ctgt20

	SELECT bold, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, stt, stt_in, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so01, ma_so02, ds, ds_nt, thue, thue_nt FROM #v20glthue3_28da ORDER BY Stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_CreateNotifyLIReq]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64),
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @startDate smalldatetime, @dayLeft numeric(5, 2), @ma_nv varchar(32)

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')

	SELECT a.*, a.ghi_chu AS ten_nv INTO #master FROM hrycnghi a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #master select a.*, rtrim(b.ma_nv) + '' - '' + ten from ' + @masterTable + ' a join vhrnv b on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nv = b.ma_nv, @startDate = a.ngay_tu FROM hrycnghi a JOIN vhrnv b ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = @idNumber
	EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$Message$Leave '', @ma_nv, @startDate, 0, @dayLeft OUTPUT, @SysDatabase

	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	SELECT @dCount = 0, @priority = 1, @e$ = ''


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))

	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	INSERT INTO #headContent
		SELECT CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS text_style, CAST(N'Nhân viên' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS label, CAST(N'Employee' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS label2, CAST(RTRIM(ten_nv) AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS val FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày từ', N'Date from', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_tu, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày đến', N'Date to', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_den, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Số ngày', N'Total of days', RTRIM(so_ngay) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Số dư phép trong năm', N'The annual leave balance', RTRIM(@dayLeft)
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Lý do', N'Reason', ly_do FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ghi chú', N'Note', ghi_chu FROM #master

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))

	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '03101', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '03101', 'E', 1, 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END


	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_tu, 103) + N', số ngày: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ngay) + N', lý do: ' + ly_do,
