				WHEN 3 THEN SPACE(@i*2-4) + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN ISNULL(d.ten_lsx, @NoGroup) ELSE ISNULL(d.ten_lsx2, @NoGroup) END
				WHEN 4 THEN SPACE(@i*2-2) + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN ISNULL(e.ten_cd, @NoGroup) ELSE ISNULL(e.ten_cd2, @NoGroup) END
				WHEN 5 THEN SPACE(@i*2) + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN ISNULL(b.ten_vt, @NoGroup) ELSE ISNULL(b.ten_vt2, @NoGroup) END
			END AS ten_vt
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN sfdmxuong c ON a.ma_px = c.ma_px
			LEFT JOIN cs2$000000 d ON a.ma_lsx = d.ma_lsx
			LEFT JOIN ctrt e ON a.ma_cd = e.ma_cd AND d.ma_lo_trinh = e.ma_lo_trinh
		ORDER BY a.ma_px, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_vt, a.sysorder

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_RunGenerateActionMessage] @dTable VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@type TINYINT = 1,  -- Type: 1 MPS, 2 MRP
	@k TINYINT = 0, -- @k = 1 Reports
	@dNow SMALLDATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN	
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @item VARCHAR(33), @sl NUMERIC(28, 6), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @key NVARCHAR(4000), @d CHAR(8)
	SELECT @key = '', @d = CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dNow, 112), @q = 'update ' + @dTable + ' set ma_cb = '''', ngay_yc = null, sl_yc = 0, 
		muc_do = case
			when nguon = ''PO'' then 1
			when nguon = ''PR'' then 2
			when nguon = ''FP'' then 3
			when nguon = ''MO'' then 5
			when nguon = ''PS'' then 6
			when nguon = ''SO'' then 7
			when nguon = ''SF'' then 8
		'

	IF @type = 2 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + '
			when nguon = ''PL'' then 4
			when nguon is null then 9
			else 9
		end, nxt = case 
			when nguon in (''PO'', ''PR'', ''FP'', ''PL'') then 1
			when nguon in (''MO'', ''PS'', ''SO'', ''SF'') then 2
			when nguon is null then 0
			else 0
		end'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + '
			when nguon = ''PL'' and sl_nhap > 0 then 4
			when nguon = ''PL'' and sl_xuat > 0 then 9
			when nguon is null then 9
			else 9
		end, nxt = case 
			when (nguon in (''PO'', ''PR'', ''FP'') or (nguon = ''PL'' and sl_nhap > 0)) then 1
			when (nguon in (''MO'', ''PS'', ''SO'', ''SF'') or (nguon = ''PL'' and sl_xuat > 0)) then 2
			when nguon is null then 0
			else 0 end
		update ' + @dTable + ' set nxt = 2 where sl_nhap = 0 and sl_xuat <> 0 and nguon in (''PS'', ''MO'', ''PL'', ''FP'')
		'				
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT ma_vt, vung_hd, kieu_hd, ton_at, co_lo, so_ngay_dh, tg_th INTO #item FROM dmvt WHERE kieu_hd <> 0
	IF @k = 0 SET @key = ' where ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #item)' -- and ngay_ct >= ''' + @d + ''''
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS stt, ma_vt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton INTO #sl FROM mrctyc
	SET @q = 'insert into #sl select stt, ma_vt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton from ' + @dTable + @key + ' order by ma_vt, ngay_ct, muc_do, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ton_kho INTO #des0 FROM mrctvtky
	SET @q = 'insert into #des0 select ma_vt, ton_kho from ' + CASE WHEN @type = 1 THEN 'mpctvtky' ELSE 'mrctvtky' END
	SET @q = @q + ' where ky = 0' + CASE WHEN @k = 0 THEN ' and ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #item)' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Stock
	SELECT @sl = NULL, @item = NULL
	UPDATE #sl SET @sl = COALESCE(CASE WHEN ma_vt <> COALESCE(@item, '') THEN sl_nhap - sl_xuat ELSE @sl + sl_nhap - sl_xuat END, 0), sl_ton = @sl, @item = ma_vt
	SET @q = 'update %t set sl_ton = b.sl_ton + isnull(c.ton_kho, 0) from %t a join #sl b on a.stt = b.stt and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join #des0 c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt' -- + CASE WHEN @k = 0 THEN ' where a.ngay_ct >= ''' + @d + '''' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%t', @dTable)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT TOP 0 nguon, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc, nxt, muc_do, 0 AS stt, 0 AS id INTO #des FROM mrctyc
	SET @q = 'insert into #des select nguon, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_ton, nc_rong, sl_dh, sl_da_yc, ngay_dat, ma_cb, ngay_yc, sl_yc, nxt, muc_do, stt, stt AS stt2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @dTable + @key + ' order by ma_vt, ngay_ct, muc_do, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Accumulate by Day
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_vt, ngay_ct, SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(sl_ton) AS sl_ton, SUM(sl_ton) AS qty, 0 AS m INTO #t FROM #des GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_ct ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_ct
	SELECT @sl = NULL, @item = NULL	
	UPDATE #t SET @sl = COALESCE(CASE WHEN ma_vt <> COALESCE(@item, '') THEN sl_nhap - sl_xuat ELSE @sl + sl_nhap - sl_xuat END, 0), sl_ton = @sl, @item = ma_vt

	UPDATE #t SET sl_ton = a.sl_ton + b.ton_kho FROM #t a JOIN #des0 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt


	-- Receipt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, id AS o, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_nhap, sl_nhap AS q INTO #r FROM #des WHERE nxt = 1 ORDER BY ma_vt, ngay_ct, muc_do DESC, stt DESC
	SELECT @sl = NULL, @item = NULL, @ngay_ct = NULL
	UPDATE #r SET @sl = COALESCE(CASE WHEN ma_vt <> COALESCE(@item, '') OR ngay_ct <> COALESCE(@ngay_ct, '') THEN sl_nhap ELSE @sl + sl_nhap END, 0), q = @sl, @item = ma_vt, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct

	-- Issue
	SELECT id, ma_vt, ngay_ct, sl_xuat, sl_xuat AS q INTO #i FROM #t WHERE sl_xuat <> 0
	SELECT @sl = NULL, @item = NULL
	UPDATE #i SET @sl = COALESCE(CASE WHEN ma_vt <> COALESCE(@item, '') THEN sl_xuat ELSE @sl + sl_xuat END, 0), q = @sl, @item = ma_vt


/*
	Action Message
*/
	-- 1. Current Stock > Safety Stock and exists Plan Order
	-- 1.1 No Demand in the Future (m = 1)
	UPDATE #t SET qty = sl_ton, m = 1 FROM #t a JOIN #item b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.sl_ton > b.ton_at AND a.sl_nhap > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #i c WHERE c.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND c.ngay_ct > a.ngay_ct)

	-- 1.1.1 Cancel
	UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '05', ngay_yc = NULL, sl_yc = 0 FROM #des a JOIN #r b ON a.id = b.o JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN #t d ON a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = d.ngay_ct WHERE d.qty - b.q >= c.ton_at AND d.m = 1 AND a.ma_cb = ''
	-- 1.1.2 Decrease
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r b JOIN #item c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #t d ON b.ma_vt = d.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct = d.ngay_ct WHERE d.qty - b.q < c.ton_at AND d.m = 1) BEGIN	
		SELECT MIN(b.id) AS id, b.ma_vt, b.ngay_ct INTO #r0 FROM #r b JOIN #item c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #t d ON b.ma_vt = d.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct = d.ngay_ct WHERE d.qty - b.q < c.ton_at AND d.m = 1 GROUP BY b.ma_vt, b.ngay_ct
		
		UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '01', ngay_yc = NULL, sl_yc = c.ton_at - d.qty + b.q FROM #des a JOIN #r b ON a.id = b.o
			JOIN #r0 o ON b.ma_vt = o.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct = o.ngay_ct AND b.id = o.id JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #t d ON a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = d.ngay_ct WHERE d.qty - b.q < c.ton_at AND d.m = 1 AND a.ma_cb = ''									
	END


	-- 1.2 Have Demand in the Future (m = 2)
	UPDATE #t SET qty = sl_ton, m = 2 FROM #t a JOIN #item b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.sl_ton > b.ton_at AND a.sl_nhap > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #i c WHERE c.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND c.ngay_ct > a.ngay_ct)

	SELECT * INTO #i2 FROM #i ORDER BY id DESC

	-- 1.2.1 Reschedule (Defer to...)
	UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '02', ngay_yc = b.ngay_ct, sl_yc = 0
		FROM #des a JOIN #t t ON a.ma_vt = t.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = t.ngay_ct JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #i2 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_ct AND t.sl_ton - b.sl_xuat > c.ton_at JOIN #r d ON a.id = d.o
		WHERE t.sl_ton - b.sl_xuat - d.q >= c.ton_at AND t.m = 2 AND a.ma_cb = ''

	--1.2.3 Change Quantity (Decrease)
	SELECT MIN(b.id) AS id, b.ma_vt, b.ngay_ct INTO #r02 FROM #r b JOIN #item c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #t t ON b.ma_vt = t.ma_vt AND b.ngay_ct = t.ngay_ct JOIN #i2 i ON t.ma_vt = i.ma_vt AND t.ngay_ct < i.ngay_ct WHERE t.sl_ton - i.sl_xuat - b.q >= c.ton_at AND t.m = 2 GROUP BY b.ma_vt, b.ngay_ct
	
	UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '01', ngay_yc = NULL, sl_yc = 0	
		FROM #des a JOIN #t t ON a.ma_vt = t.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = t.ngay_ct JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #i2 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_ct AND t.sl_ton - b.sl_xuat > c.ton_at
			JOIN #r d ON a.id = d.o JOIN #r02 g ON d.ma_vt = g.ma_vt AND d.ngay_ct = g.ngay_ct AND d.id = g.id JOIN #i j ON a.ma_vt = j.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct < j.ngay_ct
		WHERE t.sl_ton - b.sl_xuat - d.q < c.ton_at AND t.sl_ton - j.sl_xuat > c.ton_at AND t.m = 2 AND a.ma_cb = ''

	-- 2. Current Stock < Safety Stock and exists Demand (m = 3)
	UPDATE #t SET qty = sl_ton, m = 3 FROM #t a JOIN #item b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.sl_ton < b.ton_at AND a.sl_xuat > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r c WHERE c.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND c.ngay_ct = a.ngay_ct)

	SELECT ma_vt, ngay_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_yc, nxt, MAX(muc_do) AS muc_do, MIN(muc_do) AS muc_do0 INTO #u FROM #des GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_ct, nxt

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE m = 3) BEGIN				
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct, MAX(a.stt) AS stt INTO #m3 FROM #des a JOIN #u b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct AND a.nxt = b.nxt AND a.muc_do = b.muc_do WHERE a.nxt = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct

		UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '01', ngay_yc = NULL, sl_yc = a.sl_nhap + c.ton_at - b.sl_ton
			FROM #des a JOIN #t b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #m3 s ON a.ma_vt = s.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = s.ngay_ct AND a.stt = s.stt WHERE b.m = 3 AND a.ma_cb = ''			
	END


	-- 3. Current Stock < Safety Stock and not exists Demand (m = 4)
	UPDATE #t SET qty = sl_ton, m = 4 FROM #t a JOIN #item b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.sl_ton < b.ton_at AND a.sl_xuat > 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r c WHERE c.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND c.ngay_ct = a.ngay_ct)

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE m = 4) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #des a JOIN #t b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_ct WHERE b.m = 4) BEGIN
			SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct, MAX(a.stt) AS stt INTO #m4 FROM #des a JOIN #u b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct AND a.nxt = b.nxt AND a.muc_do = b.muc_do WHERE a.nxt = 2 GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct

			UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = '04', ngay_yc = b.ngay_ct, sl_yc = c.ton_at - b.sl_ton
				FROM #des a JOIN #t b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #m4 s ON a.ma_vt = s.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = s.ngay_ct AND a.stt = s.stt WHERE b.m = 4 AND a.ma_cb = ''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT * INTO #r2 FROM #r ORDER BY id DESC
			UPDATE #u SET ngay_yc = b.ngay_ct FROM #u a JOIN #r2 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_ct WHERE a.nxt = 1

			SELECT ma_vt, ngay_yc, MIN(muc_do) AS muc_do INTO #u2 FROM #u WHERE nxt = 1 GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_yc
			SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct, MIN(a.stt) AS stt INTO #m5 FROM #des a JOIN #u2 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_yc AND a.muc_do = b.muc_do WHERE a.nxt = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct

			UPDATE #des SET ma_cb = CASE WHEN a.sl_nhap >= c.ton_at - b.sl_ton THEN '02' ELSE '03' END, ngay_yc = b.ngay_ct, sl_yc = CASE WHEN a.sl_nhap >= c.ton_at - b.sl_ton THEN 0 ELSE c.ton_at - b.sl_ton END
				FROM #des a JOIN #t b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_ct JOIN #item c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN #m5 m ON a.ma_vt = m.ma_vt AND a.ngay_ct = m.ngay_ct AND a.stt = m.stt WHERE b.m = 4 AND a.ma_cb = ''
		END
	END


	--
	SET @q = 'update %t set ma_cb = b.ma_cb, ngay_yc = b.ngay_yc, sl_yc = b.sl_yc from %t a join #des b on a.stt = b.stt and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @k = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + '
			where a.ngay_ct > ''' + @d + '''
			update %t set ma_cb = ''99'', ngay_yc = null, sl_yc = 0 where ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #item) and nxt = 1 and ngay_dat <= ''' + @d + '''
			update %t set ma_cb = ''98'', ngay_yc = null, sl_yc = 0 where ma_vt in (select ma_vt from #item) and nxt = 1 and ngay_ct <= ''' + @d + '''
		'
	END
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%t', @dTable)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ds_SystemGetUnitInfo] -- Lấy đvcs đưa vào combobox trên form
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT = 0,
	@ClientCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Extension VARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	-- Fast Business Online
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM dbreports WHERE xtype = '00' AND ccode = '001'
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @q = 'select rtrim(ma_dvcs) as ma_dvcs, ' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN 'ten_dvcs' ELSE 'ten_dvcs2' END + ' as ten_dvcs into #dvcs from dmdvcs'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' where ' + @UnitKey END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #dvcs(ma_dvcs, ten_dvcs) values ('''', N''' + @s + ''')'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #dvcs order by ma_dvcs'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Receipt$Site]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32), 
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @LocationInput BIT
	SELECT @LocationInput = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvitri WHERE ma_kho = @Site) SELECT @LocationInput = 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) BEGIN
		SELECT @ItemAccount = RTRIM(tk_dl) FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		SELECT @ItemAccount = ISNULL(@ItemAccount, '')
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item AND sua_tk_vt = 0)
			SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		ELSE
			SELECT @ItemAccount = ''			
	END

	SELECT RTRIM(@ItemAccount) AS tk_vt, @LocationInput AS vi_tri_yn, @Stock AS stock
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetInsertItemGroup
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(16), 
	@cRefGroups VARCHAR(16), 
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18), 
	@cRefTable VARCHAR(18), 
	@cFieldName VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT @strReturn = ''

	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'

	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ' + @cGroups + ', ten_XX,ten_XX2,ma_XX, '
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT 2,1,0, a.' + @cGroups + ', '
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.YYY),MAX(b.YYY2),a.' + @cGroups + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN ZZZZ b ON a.' + @cGroups + ' = b.' + @cRefGroups + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + @cGroups
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cGroups + ' IS NULL'
	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cGroups + ' IS NULL'
--	SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cGroups + ' IS NULL'
	SET @strReturn =  REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
	SET @strReturn =  REPLACE(@strReturn, 'YYY', @cFieldName)
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'ZZZZ', @cRefTable)
END
GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetNetBackwardDate (@d SMALLDATETIME, @nDay INT)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nNonWorkingDays INT
	SELECT @dTo = @d, @dFrom = DATEADD(day, - @nDay, @d)
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
		SELECT @dTo = @dFrom -1
		SELECT @dFrom = @dFrom - @nNonWorkingDays
	END
	RETURN @dFrom
END
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetStartDateOfQuarter](@dDate SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @sBgDate SMALLDATETIME, @nDate NUMERIC(2,0), @nMonth NUMERIC(2,0), @nYear NUMERIC(4,0)
	SELECT @sBgDate = ngay_dn2 FROM dmstt

	SET @nDate = DAY(@dDate)
	IF MONTH(@dDate) >= MONTH(@sBgDate) SELECT @nYear = YEAR(@dDate), @nMonth = MONTH(@sBgDate) + ((MONTH(@dDate) - MONTH(@sBgDate))/3) * 3
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @nYear = YEAR(@dDate) - 1, @nMonth = MONTH(@sBgDate) + ((MONTH(@dDate) + 12  - MONTH(@sBgDate))/3) * 3
		IF @nMonth > 12 SELECT @nMonth = @nMonth - 12, @nYear = @nYear + 1
	END
	
	RETURN REPLACE(STR(@nYear, 4), ' ', '0') +  REPLACE(STR(@nMonth, 2), ' ', '0') +  '01'
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckAccountStock]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@ItemAccount VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @x VARCHAR(1)
	SELECT @x = '1'

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ps_no AS gia_tri INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #ct00(stt_rec)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_vt, tk_vt AS tk, tien_nhap AS gia_tri INTO #ct70 FROM r70$000000
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #ct70(stt_rec)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS kt1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS kt2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS kt3 INTO #report FROM r00$000000

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct70 select stt_rec, max(ma_dvcs), max(ma_ct), max(ngay_ct), max(so_ct), max(ma_vt), tk_vt, sum(tien_nhap + tien_xuat) from r70$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ' and not (ma_ct in(''PXA'', ''PND'', ''PXB'', ''PNF'') and tk_vt = tk_du)'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + 'and ' + @UnitKey 
	SELECT @q = @q + ']% group by stt_rec, tk_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select stt_rec, max(ma_dvcs), max(ma_ct), max(ngay_ct), max(so_ct), tk, sum(ps_no + ps_co) from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + 'and ' + @UnitKey 
	SELECT @q = @q + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by stt_rec, tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Có trong ct00 nhưng không có trong ct70
	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, kt1)
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, @x
			FROM #ct00 a LEFT JOIN #ct70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.tk = b.tk
			WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	-- Có trong ct70 nhưng không có trong ct00
	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, kt2)
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, @x
			FROM #ct70 a LEFT JOIN #ct00 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.tk = b.tk
			WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	-- ct00 và ct70 giá trị khác nhau
	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, kt3)
		SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, @x
			FROM #ct00 a JOIN #ct70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.tk = b.tk
			WHERE ABS(a.gia_tri) <> ABS(b.gia_tri)

	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs, MAX(a.ma_ct) AS ma_ct, MAX(a.ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(a.so_ct) AS so_ct, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt1), 0) AS BIT) AS kt1, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt2), 0) AS BIT) AS kt2, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt3), 0) AS BIT) AS kt3, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_ct) ELSE MAX(b.ten_ct2) END AS ten_ct
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec
		ORDER BY MAX(a.ma_dvcs), MAX(a.ngay_ct), MAX(a.ma_ct), MAX(a.so_ct), a.stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEInvoiceStatusCheck]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@KeyList VARCHAR(MAX) = '',
	@Packet BIT = 0,
	@PacketQuantity INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32), @p TINYINT--, @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableName @VoucherCode, @table OUTPUT, @c OUTPUT

	-- Packet
	CREATE TABLE #keyList(stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$keys') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @KeyList = CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000), text) FROM #$keys
	END

	IF @KeyList <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @cPacket VARCHAR(1)
		SELECT @cPacket = CHAR(255)
		INSERT INTO #keyList SELECT data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@KeyList, @cPacket)
	END

	DECLARE @optionPack INT, @optionNumofPack INT, @queryTopRow VARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @optionPack = 0, @queryTopRow = ''

	IF @PacketQuantity < 0 SELECT @PacketQuantity = 0
	IF @Packet = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @optionNumofPack = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_limit_invoice_hddt'
		SELECT @optionPack = val FROM options WHERE name = 'limit_release_packet'
		IF @optionPack > @PacketQuantity SELECT @optionPack = @PacketQuantity
		SELECT @queryTopRow = N' top ' + RTRIM(@optionPack * @optionNumofPack) + ' '
	END

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @p = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_payment_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	CREATE TABLE #name (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))
	CREATE TABLE #payment (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))

	INSERT INTO #name SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI004' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI005' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI006' THEN 2 WHEN ccode = 'EI007' THEN 3 WHEN ccode = 'EI008' THEN 9 WHEN ccode = 'EI009' THEN 8 WHEN ccode = 'EI010' THEN 4 WHEN ccode = 'EI011' THEN 5 WHEN ccode = 'EI012' THEN 6 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI004', 'EI005', 'EI006', 'EI007', 'EI008', 'EI009', 'EI010', 'EI011', 'EI012')

	INSERT INTO #payment SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI014' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI015' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI016' THEN 2 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI014', 'EI015', 'EI016')


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct AS so_ct_hddt, so_seri AS so_seri_hddt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS mau_hddt, ma_kh, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, status AS tinh_trang_hddt, status AS trang_thai_tt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS dich_vu_hddt, t_tt_nt AS t_km_nt INTO #result FROM m81$000000

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @p = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''1'', ''8'') or (isnull(b.trang_thai_tt, '''') = ''1'' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''2'', ''3'')))'
	ELSE SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''1'', ''8'')'

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
	IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @VoucherCode IN('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select'  + @queryTopRow + ' a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, b.mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt, b.tinh_trang_hddt, b.trang_thai_tt, 0' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HDF') THEN CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN ', a.t_km_nt' ELSE ', a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt' END ELSE ', 0' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + CASE WHEN @KeyList <> '' THEN ' join #keyList d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @importType TINYINT
	SELECT @importType = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_import_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, ISNULL(c.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph INTO #type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN dmkieuphhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, c.dich_vu_hddt INTO #unit FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN tkhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1

	--- Update payment status
	UPDATE #result SET dich_vu_hddt = b.dich_vu_hddt, trang_thai_tt = CASE WHEN b.dich_vu_hddt IN (1, 8) THEN a.trang_thai_tt ELSE '' END FROM #result a JOIN #unit b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

	IF @Packet = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS tag, stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, tien_nt + a.t_km_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, c.name AS tinh_trang, a.tinh_trang_hddt, ISNULL(d.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph,
			 ISNULL(a.trang_thai_tt, 0) AS trang_thai_tt, ISNULL(p.name, '') AS thanh_toan, a.dich_vu_hddt
			FROM #result a
				LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
				LEFT JOIN #name c ON a.tinh_trang_hddt = c.code
				LEFT JOIN #type d ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs
				LEFT JOIN #payment p ON a.trang_thai_tt = p.code
			ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct
	END ELSE BEGIN
		ALTER TABLE #result ADD [stt_rec1] [INT] NULL
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct, so_ct AS so_ct_tu, so_ct AS so_ct, 0 AS so_luong, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec_key, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS stt_rec, 0 AS stt_rec1
			INTO #tpackTemp FROM #result
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #tpack FROM #tpackTemp
		CREATE TABLE #tgroup(p VARCHAR(32))

		--
		INSERT INTO #tgroup SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result
		DECLARE @w1 VARCHAR(32)
		DECLARE @w2 VARCHAR(32), @value VARCHAR(MAX)

		SELECT @w1 = MIN(p) FROM #tgroup
		WHILE @w1 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @w2 = '', @value = ''
			TRUNCATE TABLE #tpackTemp
			SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #result1 FROM #result WHERE ma_dvcs = @w1 ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
			UPDATE #result1 SET stt_rec1 = ((id - 1) /@optionNumofPack)

			INSERT INTO #tpackTemp
				SELECT MAX(ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs, MIN(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct_tu, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct
					, MIN(so_ct) AS so_ct_tu, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct
					, COUNT(*) AS so_luong
					, MAX(stt_rec) AS stt_rec_key, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS stt_rec, stt_rec1
						 FROM #result1 GROUP BY stt_rec1 ORDER BY stt_rec1

			SELECT @w2 = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #tpackTemp
			WHILE @w2 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @value = ''
				SELECT @value = ISNULL(@value + CHAR(255), '') + stt_rec FROM #result1 WHERE stt_rec1 = @w2
				UPDATE #tpackTemp SET stt_rec = STUFF(@value, 1, 1, '') WHERE stt_rec1 = @w2
				SELECT @w2 = MIN(stt_rec1) FROM #tpackTemp WHERE stt_rec1 > @w2
			END

			INSERT INTO #tpack(ma_dvcs, ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct, so_ct_tu, so_ct, so_luong, stt_rec_key, stt_rec, stt_rec1)
				SELECT ma_dvcs, ngay_ct_tu, ngay_ct, so_ct_tu, so_ct, so_luong, stt_rec_key, stt_rec, stt_rec1 FROM #tpackTemp ORDER BY stt_rec1

			DROP TABLE #result1
			SELECT @w1 = MIN(p) FROM #tgroup WHERE p > @w1
		END

		SELECT 0 AS tag, *, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, '1' AS ph_yn, '0' AS packet_status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Chưa thực hiện' ELSE N'No Action' END AS packet_status_name, NULL AS packet_bd, NULL AS packet_kt FROM #tpack ORDER BY id

		DROP TABLE #tpack
		DROP TABLE #tpackTemp
		DROP TABLE #tgroup
	END


	DROP TABLE #result
	DROP TABLE #type
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterRevertStatusTicket]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceSerial VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceStatus VARCHAR(32),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@SignValue NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @importType TINYINT, @r NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @importType = b.kieu_ph FROM tkhddtdv a JOIN dmkieuphhddt b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE a.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.status = 1
	IF @importType IS NULL SELECT @importType = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_import_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	IF REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') = '' AND @importType = 1 RETURN

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @table VARCHAR(32), @ref VARCHAR(32), @e VARCHAR(6)

	-- Thông tin bảng lưu vé
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	--
	IF @ResultProcess = 0 RETURN

	DECLARE @provider INT, @isDiscountVoucher TINYINT
	SELECT @isDiscountVoucher = 0
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	IF @provider = 8 AND CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	--
	IF @InvoiceStatus = '9' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelTicket @VoucherID, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @InvoiceStatus <> '0' BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID) BEGIN
				SELECT @ref = REPLACE(stt_rec0, '''', ''), @e = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct0, 112) FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID
				EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelTicket @ref, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

				SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @e + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = ''4'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @ref + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
	END


	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', so_seri_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceSerial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_ct_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceStatus, '''', '''''') + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	--- Gán khóa tra cứu, có thể không cần, do client tự tạo và truyền lên rồi.
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ''' + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @provider = 8 AND @SignValue <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into elogs(stt_rec, user_id, content, datetime2) select ''' + @VoucherID + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', N''' + @SignValue + ''', getdate()'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCashFlowForecastingByDays]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),	
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Stt NUMERIC(4, 0), @Ma_so VARCHAR(32), @Chi_tieu NVARCHAR(512), @Nguon_dl VARCHAR(2), @Thu_chi CHAR(1), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Ma_ct VARCHAR(32), @Chi_tieu_dt NVARCHAR(512)
	DECLARE @BalName NVARCHAR(511), @ds_tk_pth VARCHAR(511), @ds_tk_ptr VARCHAR(511), @i INT, @j INT, @n INT, @m INT, @k INT

	SELECT @BalName = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT085'
	SELECT @ds_tk_pth = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_pth'
	SELECT @ds_tk_ptr = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_cn_ptr'
	SELECT @ds_tk_pth = REPLACE(@ds_tk_pth, '''', ''''''), @ds_tk_ptr = REPLACE(@ds_tk_ptr, '''', '''''')
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #BgAccts FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, ngay_dk01 AS ngay_dk, tien01 AS tien_thu, tien_nt01 AS tien_thu_nt, tien01 AS tien_chi, tien_nt01 AS tien_chi_nt INTO #kh FROM khdttuan
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
			, a.stt_rec, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_dh, b.ma_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten_kh, a.dien_giai, c.nguon_dl
			, a.ps_no AS tien_thu, a.ps_no_nt AS tien_thu_nt, a.ps_no AS tien_chi, a.ps_no_nt AS tien_chi_nt, a.ps_no AS tien_ton, a.ps_no_nt AS tien_ton_nt
		INTO #result FROM wrkgl a, dmkh b, bcdtngay c

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '%date between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	--
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@unitKey) ELSE SELECT @unitKey = ISNULL(@unitKey, '')
	
	-- Data
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bcdtngay WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #BgAccts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dateFrom, NULL, '', 1, 2, @userID, @admin, '', @unitKey
		SELECT @Stt = stt, @Ma_so = ma_so, @Ds_tk = ds_tk FROM bcdtngay WHERE form = @formCode AND kind = '1'
		INSERT INTO #result (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, tien_thu, tien_thu_nt, tien_chi, tien_chi_nt, tien_ton, tien_ton_nt)
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, @Stt, NULL, '', NULL, '', '', @BalName, '', 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(ISNULL(du_no, 0) - ISNULL(du_co, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(du_no_nt, 0) - ISNULL(du_co_nt, 0))
				FROM #BgAccts WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Ds_tk) = 1
	END
	--
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS id, stt, ma_so, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, nguon_dl, thu_chi, ds_tk, ds_chi_tieu INTO #formReport FROM bcdtngay WHERE form = @formCode AND kind <> '1'
	SELECT @n = COUNT(id) FROM #formReport
	SELECT @i = 1 
	WHILE (@i <= @n) BEGIN
		SELECT @Stt = stt, @Ma_so = ma_so, @Chi_tieu = chi_tieu, @Nguon_dl = LTRIM(RTRIM(nguon_dl)), @Thu_chi = thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu = ds_chi_tieu FROM #formReport WHERE id = @i
		SELECT @Nguon_dl = REPLACE(@Nguon_dl, '''', ''''''), @Ds_chi_tieu = REPLACE(@Ds_chi_tieu, '''', '''''')
		--
		IF @Nguon_dl IN ('1', '2') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #result(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 1 THEN 'tien_thu, tien_thu_nt' ELSE 'tien_chi, tien_chi_nt' END + ')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, ' + RTRIM(@Stt) + ', b.ngay_ku, b.so_ku, a.ngay_tt, b.ma_kh, c.ten_kh%l, b.ten_ku%l, ''' + RTRIM(@Nguon_dl) + ''', a.tt, a.tt_nt'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctdmku2 a with(nolock) left join dmku b with(nolock) on a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku left join dmkh c with(nolock) on b.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_ku = ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 1 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ' and ' + @Key
			IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (exists(select 1 from dmkudv d with(nolock) where a.ma_ku = d.ma_ku and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'd.ma_dvcs') + ') or (b.ds_dvcs = ''''))'
			--
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_tt'), '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		IF @Nguon_dl IN ('3', '4') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #result(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 3 THEN 'tien_thu, tien_thu_nt' ELSE 'tien_chi, tien_chi_nt' END + ')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, ' + RTRIM(@Stt) + ', a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, dateadd(day, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0), a.ma_kh, c.ten_kh%l, a.dien_giai, ''' + RTRIM(@Nguon_dl) + ''', t_tt0 - t_tt1, t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 3 THEN 'cttt20' ELSE 'cttt30' END + ' a with(nolock) left join dmtt b with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = b.ma_tt left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.loai_tt = 0 and ((t_tt0 - t_tt1 > 0) or (t_tt_nt0 - t_tt_nt1 > 0)) and ' + @Key
			SELECT @q = @q + ' and dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, N''' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 3 THEN @ds_tk_pth ELSE @ds_tk_ptr END + ''') = 1'
			IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
			--
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'dateadd(day, b.han_tt, a.ngay_ct0)'), '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		IF @Nguon_dl IN ('5', '6') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #result(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 5 THEN 'tien_thu, tien_thu_nt' ELSE 'tien_chi, tien_chi_nt' END + ')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, ' + RTRIM(@Stt) + ', b.ngay_hd, b.so_hd, a.han_tt, b.ma_kh, c.ten_kh%l, b.ten_hd%l, ''' + RTRIM(@Nguon_dl) + ''', a.tien, a.tien_nt'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ctdmhd a with(nolock) left join dmhd b with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd left join dmkh c with(nolock) on b.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_hd = ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 5 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END + ' and ' + @Key
			IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (exists(select 1 from dmhddv d with(nolock) where a.ma_hd = d.ma_hd and ' + REPLACE(@unitKey, 'ma_dvcs', 'd.ma_dvcs') + ') or (b.ds_dvcs = ''''))'
			--
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.han_tt'), '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		--
		IF @Nguon_dl IN ('7', '8') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #kh
			SELECT @m = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ',')
			WHILE @m > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @m, ',')
				SELECT @Chi_tieu_dt = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN ten_ct ELSE ten_ct2 END FROM dmctdt WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct				
				--
				SELECT @j = CASE @Nguon_dl WHEN '7' THEN 12 ELSE 4 END, @k = 1
				WHILE @k <= @j BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'insert into #kh(ma_ct, ngay_dk, ' + CASE WHEN @Thu_chi = 1 THEN 'tien_thu, tien_thu_nt' ELSE 'tien_chi, tien_chi_nt' END + ')'
					SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_ct, a.ngay_dk%k, a.tien%k, a.tien_nt%k'
					SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN 'khdtthang' ELSE 'khdttuan' END + ' a with(nolock)'
					SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' and a.ma_ct = ''' + @Ma_ct + ''''
					IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @unitKey
					SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN 'khdtthang' ELSE 'khdttuan' END + ' b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.nam = b.nam ' + 
						CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.ky = b.ky' END + ' and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv group by nam, ' + 
						CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 7 THEN '' ELSE 'ky, ' END + 'ma_dvcs, ma_bp, ma_vv having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_dk%k'), '%k', REPLACE(STR(@k, 2), ' ', '0'))
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
					--
					SELECT @k = @k + 1
				END
				--
				SELECT @m = @m - 1
			END
			--
			INSERT INTO #result (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, tien_thu, tien_thu_nt, tien_chi, tien_chi_nt, tien_ton, tien_ton_nt)
				SELECT 5, 1, 1, @Stt, ngay_dk, '', ngay_dk, '', '', @Chi_tieu_dt, @Nguon_dl, SUM(tien_thu), SUM(tien_thu_nt), SUM(tien_chi), SUM(tien_chi_nt), 0, 0
					FROM #kh GROUP BY ngay_dk
		END
		--
		IF @Nguon_dl IN ('9', '10') BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #result(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl, ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 9 THEN 'tien_thu, tien_thu_nt' ELSE 'tien_chi, tien_chi_nt' END + ')'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, ' + RTRIM(@Stt) + ', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, c.ten_kh%l, a.dien_giai, ''' + RTRIM(@Nguon_dl) + ''', ' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 9 THEN 'a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt' ELSE 'a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt' END
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from m' + CASE WHEN @Nguon_dl = 9 THEN '57' ELSE '52' END + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.dong_tien_yn = 1 and ' + @Key
			IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @unitKey
			SELECT @q = @q + ']%'
			--
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%date', 'a.ngay_ct'), '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	DECLARE @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	--
	UPDATE #result SET tien_thu = ISNULL(tien_thu, 0), tien_thu_nt = ISNULL(tien_thu_nt, 0) , tien_chi = ISNULL(tien_chi, 0), tien_chi_nt = ISNULL(tien_chi_nt, 0), tien_ton = ISNULL(tien_ton, 0), tien_ton_nt = ISNULL(tien_ton_nt, 0)
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct into #hd FROM #result
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
		-- Dynamic
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #hd select stt_rec, so_ct_hddt from hddt00$%Partition a where %[exists (select 1 from #result b where b.stt_rec is not null and a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec) and a.ma_ct in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')]%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		UPDATE #result SET so_ct0 = b.so_ct FROM #result a JOIN #hd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	END
	
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_ct, so_ct, ISNULL(so_ct0, '') AS so_ct0, ngay_dh, ma_kh, ten_kh, dien_giai, nguon_dl
		, ISNULL(tien_thu, 0) AS tien_thu, ISNULL(tien_thu_nt, 0) AS tien_thu_nt
		, ISNULL(tien_chi, 0) AS tien_chi, ISNULL(tien_chi_nt, 0) AS tien_chi_nt
		, ISNULL(tien_ton, 0) AS tien_ton, ISNULL(tien_ton_nt, 0) AS tien_ton_nt
		INTO #report FROM #result ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_dh, so_ct
	SELECT @tien = SUM(ISNULL(tien_ton, 0)), @tien_nt = SUM(ISNULL(tien_ton_nt, 0)) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 4
	SELECT @tien = ISNULL(@tien, 0), @tien_nt = ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0)
	UPDATE #report SET @tien = @tien + ISNULL(tien_thu, 0) - ISNULL(tien_chi, 0), @tien_nt = @tien_nt + ISNULL(tien_thu_nt, 0) - ISNULL(tien_chi_nt, 0), tien_ton = ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_ton_nt = ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0)

	-- View
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_dh, so_ct
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$OpeningBalance$ConvertCustomer2Account] @Unit VARCHAR(32), @Account VARCHAR(32), @Year INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @StartYear INT, @InputYearOpening INT
	SELECT @StartYear = nam_bd, @InputYearOpening = CASE WHEN MONTH(ngay_ky1) = MONTH(ngay_dn2) and DAY(ngay_ky1) = DAY(ngay_dn2) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM dmstt
	IF @Year > 0 BEGIN
		IF @Year > @StartYear SELECT @InputYearOpening = 0
		SELECT @StartYear = @Year
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cdtk WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND tk = @Account)
		INSERT INTO cdtk(nam, ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, du_no1, du_co1, du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT @StartYear, @Unit, @Account, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), 0, 0

	SELECT tk, SUM(du_no00) AS du_no00, SUM(du_co00) AS du_co00, SUM(du_no_nt00) AS du_no_nt00, SUM(du_co_nt00) AS du_co_nt00, 
			SUM(du_no1) AS du_no1, SUM(du_co1) AS du_co1, SUM(du_no_nt1) AS du_no_nt1, SUM(du_co_nt1) AS du_co_nt1
		INTO #cdkh
		FROM cdkh
		WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND tk = @Account
		GROUP BY tk

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cdkh)
		UPDATE cdtk SET du_no00 = 0, du_co00 = 0, du_no_nt00 = 0, du_co_nt00 = 0, du_no1 = 0, du_co1 = 0, du_no_nt1 = 0, du_co_nt1 = 0
			WHERE nam = @StartYear AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND tk = @Account
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @InputYearOpening = 0
				UPDATE cdtk SET du_no00 = a.du_no00, du_co00 = a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = a.du_co_nt00, 
						du_no1 = a.du_no00, du_co1 = a.du_co00, du_no_nt1 = a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt1 = a.du_co_nt00
					FROM cdtk u JOIN #cdkh a ON u.tk = a.tk WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND u.tk = @Account
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_cn_dn' AND val = 1)
						UPDATE cdtk SET du_no00 = a.du_no00, du_co00 = a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = a.du_co_nt00
							FROM cdtk u JOIN #cdkh a ON u.tk = a.tk WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND u.tk = @Account
					ELSE
						UPDATE cdtk SET du_no00 = a.du_no00, du_co00 = a.du_co00, du_no_nt00 = a.du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00 = a.du_co_nt00, 
								du_no1 = a.du_no1, du_co1 = a.du_co1, 	du_no_nt1 = a.du_no_nt1, du_co_nt1 = a.du_co_nt1
							FROM cdtk u JOIN #cdkh a ON u.tk = a.tk WHERE u.nam = @StartYear AND u.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND u.tk = @Account
				END
		END
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrcthd] AS
SELECT a.*, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan AS ma_bp, b.bp_ref, b.vi_tri, b.bac_quan_ly AS ma_bac, b.ngay_vao, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
	FROM hrcthd a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptWorkSeniorityByDept]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@MinYear INT,
	@Gap INT,
	@Periods INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptLevel INT,
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @sub NVARCHAR(128), @other NVARCHAR(128), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @i INT, @c VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @sub = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total2'
	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + '''', @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = '', @EmployeeCondition = '', @other = '-'

	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @Type = '2' THEN 'Month' ELSE 'Year' END
	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #ctqtlvdk(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), tham_nien NUMERIC(20, 9), loai CHAR(1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key
		
	IF @Level <> ' 'SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a5.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a5.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'


	SELECT @Where = ' and r.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c'), '%a5', 'a')

	-- Count
	SELECT @EmployeeCondition = ''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @EmployeeCondition = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@EmployeeCondition)

	SELECT TOP 0 r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, '1' AS tinh_chat, r.ngay_tu INTO #d FROM hreqtlvht r 
	SET @q = 'insert into #d select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, ''1'', max(r.ngay_tu) from hreqtlvht r join hrnv a ON r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ' and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ')' + @EmployeeCondition
	SET @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL
		
	-- Permanent
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$' + @c + '(a.ngay_chinh_thuc, ' + @d1 + '), 1 from #d r left join hrnv a on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec ' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ') and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Probationary
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, 0, 0 from #d r left join hrnv a on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec ' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ') and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Join = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c'), '%a5', 'a')

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Where = @Where + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Permanent Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$' + @c + '(a.ngay_chinh_thuc, ' + @d1 + '), 1 '
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a ' + @Join + ' where ((a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ') and a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d1 + ' and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Probationary Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, 0, 0 '
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a ' + @Join + ' where ((a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ') and a.ngay_vao <= ' + @d1 + ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ') and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @h CHAR(1)
	SELECT @h = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, '#ctqtlvdk', 'bo_phan'
		
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Report
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(5 AS INT) AS sysorder, a.bo_phan, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot0,	CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot1, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot2, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot3, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot4
		INTO #report FROM #ctqtlvdk a, hrbp b
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select cast(5 as int) as sysorder, a.bo_phan, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.loai = ''0'' then 1 else 0 end) as cot0,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' and a.loai = ''1'' then 1 else 0 end) as cot1,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' and a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.loai = ''1'' then 1 else 0 end) as cot2,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.loai = ''1'' then 1 else 0 end) as cot3,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.loai = ''1'' then 1 else 0 end) as cot4'
	SET @q = @q  + ' from #ctqtlvdk a join ' + @h + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' group by a.bo_phan'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	-- Total
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', 0, SUM(cot0), SUM(cot1), SUM(cot2), SUM(cot3), SUM(cot4) FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, '', '', 0,  0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	END

	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, b.ma_bp, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #report r join ' + @h + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and b.ma_bp not in (select bo_phan from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET cot0 = a.cot0 + b.cot0, cot1 = a.cot1 + b.cot1, cot2 = a.cot2 + b.cot2, cot3 = a.cot3 + b.cot3, cot4  = a.cot4 + b.cot4
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT bp_me, SUM(cot0) AS cot0, SUM(cot1) AS cot1, SUM(cot2) AS cot2, SUM(cot3) AS cot3, SUM(cot4) AS cot4
						FROM #report
						WHERE bac_bp = @step
						GROUP BY bp_me
				) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me
		--
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	---
	IF @DeptLevel <> 0 DELETE #report WHERE bac_bp > @DeptLevel	

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)	
			
	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, b.stt_ref, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as sysprint, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as systotal, case when a.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(@step) + ' then 1 else 0 end as systotal_excel'
	SET @q = @q  + ', a.bo_phan, a.bac_bp, a.cot0, a.cot1, a.cot2, a.cot3, a.cot4, (a.cot0 + a.cot1 + a.cot2 + a.cot3 + a.cot4) as cot5,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' case when sysorder = 1 then '''' else case when a.bo_phan = '''' then N''' + @total + ''' else space(2*(a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' end end as ten_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' from #report a left join ' + @h + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' order by a.sysorder, b.stt_ref'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployeesWithSocialInsuranceBenefitsExport]
	@Time INT,
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),	
	@BenefitTypes VARCHAR(1023),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1: Standard, 2: 919, 3: 636, 5: 166
	@RefCode VARCHAR(33),
	@RefType CHAR(1), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @BaseSalary NUMERIC(28, 6), @n INT, @BaseCurrency VARCHAR(10)
	DECLARE @sTime NVARCHAR(1023), @sMonth NVARCHAR(1023), @sQuarter NVARCHAR(1023), @sYear NVARCHAR(1023), @Arising NVARCHAR(1023), @Adjustment NVARCHAR(1023), @Total NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- 
	SELECT @sTime = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM025'
	SELECT @sMonth = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM026'
	SELECT @sQuarter = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM027'
	SELECT @sYear = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM028'	
	SELECT @Arising = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM029'
	SELECT @Adjustment = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM030'
	SELECT @Total = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	SELECT @BaseCurrency = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'r.')
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.dot = ' + RTRIM(@Time) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'r.')
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmployeeID), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @BenefitTypes <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.loai_tcbh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@BenefitTypes), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS tt2, CAST ('' AS CHAR(1)) AS xKey, b.ma_tc, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_tc, d.loai_tcbh
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh
			, CAST('' AS CHAR(32)) AS so_sbh
			, b.tg_bhxh, b.tien_bhxh, b.tt_bhxh, b.td_bhxh, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_den, b.so_ngay, b.lk_dau_nam, b.st_tc_tk
			, c.dot_xd, c.thang_xd, c.nam_xd, c.so_tien1, c.so_tien2, c.so_tien3, c.so_ngay_cl, c.luy_ke, c.noi_dung, c.ly_do
			, CAST ('' AS CHAR(1)) AS tinh_chat
			, b.ht_tc, b.tk_nhan_tc AS tt_tc_tk, b.dk_muc_huong, b.ghi_chu, b.loai_tc, b.loai_tc AS ma_kieu_me, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_kieu, e.stt as stt_sx_tc, 0 AS xSubGroup, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS ref
		INTO #report
		FROM hrnv a, hrtttcd b, hrdctcd c, hrdmtcbh d, hrdmktcbh e

	-- Arising
	SET @s = 'insert into #report(sysorder, systotal, xKey, ma_tc, ten_tc, loai_tcbh, ma_dvcs, ma_nv, ten_nv, gioi_tinh, ngay_sinh, so_sbh, tg_bhxh, tien_bhxh, tt_bhxh, td_bhxh, ngay_tu, ngay_den, so_ngay, lk_dau_nam, st_tc_tk'
	SET @s = @s + ', ht_tc, tt_tc_tk, dk_muc_huong, ghi_chu, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, ten_kieu, stt_sx_tc, xSubGroup)'
  	SET @s = @s + ' select 5, 1, ''1'', a.ma_tc, b.ten_in' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', b.loai_tcbh, r.ma_dvcs, r.ma_nv, space(5) + rtrim(r.ho_nv) + space(1) + ltrim(r.ten_nv), r.gioi_tinh, r.ngay_sinh'
	SET @s = @s + ', isnull(t.si_no, ''''), a.tg_bhxh, a.tien_bhxh, a.tt_bhxh, a.td_bhxh, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay, a.lk_dau_nam, a.st_tc_tk'
	SET @s = @s + ', a.ht_tc, a.tk_nhan_tc, a.dk_muc_huong, a.ghi_chu, a.loai_tc, h.ma_kieu_me, h.ten_kieu' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', h.stt, 1'
	SET @s = @s + ' from hrtttcd a join hrnv r on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec left join hrttbh t on r.stt_rec = t.stt_rec left join hrdmtcbh b on a.ma_tc = b.ma_tcbh'
	SET @s = @s + ' left join hrdmktcbh h on a.loai_tc = h.ma_kieu'
  	SET @s = @s + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- Adjustment
	SET @s = 'insert into #report(sysorder, systotal, xKey, ma_tc, ten_tc, loai_tcbh, ma_dvcs, ma_nv, ten_nv, gioi_tinh, ngay_sinh, so_sbh, dot_xd, thang_xd, nam_xd, so_tien1, so_tien2, so_tien3, so_ngay_cl, luy_ke, noi_dung, ly_do'
	SET @s = @s + ', ht_tc, tt_tc_tk, dk_muc_huong, ghi_chu, loai_tc, ten_kieu, xSubGroup)'
  	SET @s = @s + ' select 5, 1, ''2'', a.ma_tc, b.ten_in' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', b.loai_tcbh, r.ma_dvcs, r.ma_nv, space(5) + rtrim(r.ho_nv) + space(1) + ltrim(r.ten_nv), r.gioi_tinh, r.ngay_sinh'
	SET @s = @s + ', isnull(t.si_no, ''''), a.dot_xd, a.thang_xd, a.nam_xd, a.so_tien1, a.so_tien2, a.so_tien3, a.so_ngay_cl, a.luy_ke, a.noi_dung, a.ly_do'
	SET @s = @s + ', a.ht_tc, a.tk_nhan_tc, '''', a.ghi_chu, '''', '''', 1'
	SET @s = @s + ' from hrdctcd a join hrnv r on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec left join hrttbh t on r.stt_rec = t.stt_rec left join hrdmtcbh b on a.ma_tc = b.ma_tcbh'
  	SET @s = @s + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- Update Benefit
	UPDATE #report SET tinh_chat = '3', tien_bhxh = b.ty_le FROM #report a JOIN hrdmtcbh b ON a.ma_tc = b.ma_tcbh WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hrdmloaitcbh c WHERE a.loai_tcbh = c.ma_loai AND c.tinh_chat = '3')

	-- Allowance
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv)
		SELECT 4, 0, 0, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, '', SPACE(2) + MAX(ten_tc) FROM #report GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc

	IF @ReportType = '3' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten_nv = SPACE(2) + ten_nv, xSubGroup = 1 WHERE sysorder IN (4, 5) AND (loai_tc <> '' OR loai_tc IS NOT NULL)
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv)
			SELECT 5, 0, 0, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc, '', SPACE(4) + MAX(ten_kieu)
				FROM #report WHERE loai_tc <> '' AND loai_tc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc
	END
	
	IF @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_kieu, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kieu ELSE ten_kieu2 END AS ten_kieu, ma_kieu_me, ma_tcbh, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrdmktcbh FROM hrdmktcbh
		UPDATE #hrdmktcbh SET stt = 1 WHERE ma_kieu_me = ''

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmktcbh a JOIN (SELECT ma_kieu, ma_kieu_me, stt FROM #hrdmktcbh) b ON a.ma_kieu_me = b.ma_kieu WHERE a.stt < b.stt)
			UPDATE #hrdmktcbh SET stt = b.stt + 1 FROM #hrdmktcbh a JOIN (SELECT ma_kieu, ma_kieu_me, stt FROM #hrdmktcbh) b ON a.ma_kieu_me = b.ma_kieu

		DECLARE @ma_tc VARCHAR(33)
		SELECT @ma_tc = MIN(ma_tc) FROM #report WHERE xKey = 1

		WHILE @ma_tc IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrdmktcbh a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE a.ma_kieu = b.ma_kieu_me AND xKey = 1 AND ma_tc = @ma_tc) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT loai_tc FROM #report c WHERE a.ma_kieu = c.loai_tc AND xKey = 1 AND ma_tc = @ma_tc))
  				INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, stt_sx_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv, ref)
					SELECT DISTINCT 5, 0, 0, xKey, loai_tcbh, @ma_tc, ma_kieu, a.ma_kieu_me, a.stt, '', a.ten_kieu, 1
						FROM #hrdmktcbh a LEFT JOIN #report z ON a.ma_kieu = z.ma_kieu_me AND xKey = 1 AND ma_tc = @ma_tc
							WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE a.ma_kieu = b.ma_kieu_me AND xKey = 1 AND ma_tc = @ma_tc)
								AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report c WHERE a.ma_kieu = c.loai_tc AND xKey = 1 AND ma_tc = @ma_tc)
			SELECT @ma_tc = MIN(ma_tc) FROM #report WHERE ma_tc > @ma_tc AND xKey = 1
		END

		UPDATE #report SET ten_nv = ten_nv, xSubGroup = 1 WHERE sysorder IN (4, 5) AND (loai_tc <> '' OR loai_tc IS NOT NULL)
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc, ma_kieu_me, ma_nv, ten_nv)
			SELECT 5, 0, 0, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc, MAX(ma_kieu_me), '', MAX(ten_kieu)
				FROM #report WHERE loai_tc <> '' AND loai_tc IS NOT NULL AND ref IS NULL GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, stt_sx_tc
		UPDATE #report SET stt_sx_tc = b.stt, ten_nv = SPACE(b.stt * 2) + ten_nv FROM #report a JOIN #hrdmktcbh b ON a.loai_tc= b.ma_kieu

		SELECT TOP 0 xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, stt, IDENTITY(INT) AS id INTO #id FROM #report

		INSERT INTO #id(xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, stt)
			SELECT xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, stt
				FROM #report
					WHERE ma_kieu_me = ''
					GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, loai_tc, ma_kieu_me, stt
		UPDATE #id SET stt = id

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report a WHERE sysorder = 5 AND a.loai_tc <> '' AND ma_kieu_me IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #id b WHERE a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.loai_tc = b.loai_tc AND a.ma_kieu_me = b.ma_kieu_me)) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #id
				SELECT a.xKey, a.loai_tcbh, a.ma_tc, a.loai_tc, a.ma_kieu_me, b.stt
					FROM #report a JOIN #id b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.ma_kieu_me = b.loai_tc
						WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #id c WHERE a.xKey = c.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = c.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = c.ma_tc AND a.loai_tc = c.loai_tc AND a.ma_kieu_me = c.ma_kieu_me) AND sysorder = 5 AND a.loai_tc <> ''
		END
		UPDATE #report SET ref = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #id b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.loai_tc = b.loai_tc AND ISNULL(a.ma_kieu_me, '') = b.ma_kieu_me
	END


	-- Allowance Type
	DECLARE @loai_tcbh VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT TOP 1 @loai_tcbh = loai_tcbh FROM #report WHERE xKey = 2 AND sysorder <> 2 ORDER BY loai_tcbh
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv)
		SELECT 3, CASE WHEN xKey = '2' AND loai_tcbh = @loai_tcbh THEN -1 ELSE 0 END, 0, xKey, loai_tcbh, '', '', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_loai) ELSE MAX(b.ten_loai2) END
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmloaitcbh b ON a.loai_tcbh = b.ma_loai GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh

	IF @ReportType = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv INTO #o_4 FROM #report WHERE loai_tc <> '' AND loai_tc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, MIN(id) AS id_min INTO #o_5 FROM #o_4 GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id_min, tt = RTRIM(b.id - c.id_min) FROM #report a JOIN #o_4 b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.stt_sx_tc = b.stt_sx_tc AND a.loai_tc = b.loai_tc AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv JOIN #o_5 c ON a.xKey = c.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = c.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.stt_sx_tc = b.stt_sx_tc AND a.loai_tc = c.loai_tc
	END

	IF @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv INTO #o_1664 FROM #report WHERE loai_tc <> '' AND loai_tc IS NOT NULL AND ten_tc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, MIN(id) AS id_min INTO #o_1665 FROM #o_1664 GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc
		UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id_min + 1, tt = RTRIM(b.id - c.id_min + 1) FROM #report a JOIN #o_1664 b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.stt_sx_tc = b.stt_sx_tc AND a.loai_tc = b.loai_tc AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv JOIN #o_1665 c ON a.xKey = c.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = c.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.stt_sx_tc = b.stt_sx_tc AND a.loai_tc = c.loai_tc
	END

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv INTO #o_1 FROM #report WHERE stt IS NULL GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, MIN(id) AS id_min INTO #o_2 FROM #o_1 GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc

	-- Employee Order
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id_min, tt = RTRIM(b.id - c.id_min)
		FROM #report a JOIN #o_1 b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv JOIN #o_2 c ON a.xKey = c.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = c.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = c.ma_tc

	-- Allowance Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, xKey, loai_tcbh, MIN(id) AS id_min INTO #o_3 FROM #o_2 GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh ORDER BY xKey, loai_tcbh
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id_min
		FROM #report a JOIN #o_2 b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh AND a.ma_tc = b.ma_tc JOIN #o_3 c ON a.xKey = c.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = c.loai_tcbh
		WHERE a.sysorder = 4

	-- Allowance Type Order
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o_3 b ON a.xKey = b.xKey AND a.loai_tcbh = b.loai_tcbh WHERE a.sysorder = 3

	-- Adjustment Arising No.
	SELECT @n = ISNULL(MIN(stt), 0) FROM #report WHERE xKey = 2 AND sysorder = 4
	UPDATE #report SET stt = stt - @n + 1 WHERE xKey = 2 AND sysorder = 4
	SELECT @n = ISNULL(MIN(stt), 0) FROM #report WHERE xKey = 2 AND sysorder = 3
	UPDATE #report SET stt = stt - @n + 1 WHERE xKey = 2 AND sysorder = 3

	-- ABC Order
	UPDATE #report SET tt = CHAR(stt + 64) WHERE sysorder = 3
	
	-- Roman Numerals
	UPDATE #report SET tt = dbo.ff_Arab2Roman(stt) WHERE sysorder = 4 AND (loai_tc = '' OR loai_tc IS NULL)
	IF @ReportType = '3' UPDATE #report SET tt = '-' WHERE sysorder = 5 AND ma_nv = '' AND (loai_tc <> '' AND loai_tc IS NOT NULL)

	IF @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
		-- Symbol
		UPDATE #report SET tt = CASE
			WHEN stt_sx_tc = 1 THEN '-'
			WHEN stt_sx_tc = 2 THEN '+'
			WHEN stt_sx_tc = 3 THEN '*'
			ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(STR('', CAST(stt_sx_tc - 2 AS INT)), ' ', '*'), '0', '*')
		END
		WHERE sysorder = 5 AND ma_nv = ''
	END

	--
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, tt, xKey, ma_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv) SELECT 2, 0, 0, '', '1', '', '', @Arising
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, tt, xKey, ma_tc, ma_nv, ten_nv) SELECT 2, 0, 0, '', '2', '', '', @Adjustment
	
	-- Result: Browse
	IF @ReportType = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT sysorder, tt, ma_nv, CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN '' ELSE SPACE(2) END + ten_nv AS ten_nv, ngay_sinh, so_sbh FROM #report ORDER BY xkey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
			SELECT sysorder, tt, ma_nv, CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN '' ELSE SPACE(2) END + ten_nv AS ten_nv, ngay_sinh, so_sbh FROM #report ORDER BY xkey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv
		END ELSE
			SELECT sysorder, tt, ma_nv, CASE WHEN sysorder = 2 THEN '' ELSE SPACE(2) END + ten_nv AS ten_nv, ngay_sinh, so_sbh FROM #report ORDER BY xkey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, ma_nv
	END

	-- Total
	IF @ReportType = '3' OR @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
		INSERT #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, tt, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, st_tc_tk, so_ngay, ma_nv, ten_nv) SELECT 6, 0, 1, '', xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, 0, SUM(so_ngay), '', @Total FROM #report WHERE sysorder <> 2 AND ma_tc <> '' AND xKey <> '2' GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT #report(sysorder, systotal, xSubGroup, tt, xKey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, st_tc_tk, so_ngay, ma_nv, ten_nv) SELECT 6, 0, 0, '', xKey, loai_tcbh, MAX(ma_tc), SUM(st_tc_tk), 0, '', @Total FROM #report WHERE sysorder <> 2 GROUP BY xKey, loai_tcbh	
	END

	-- Reusult: Arising & Adjustment
	IF @ReportType = '3' BEGIN
		SELECT a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.xSubGroup, a.tt, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh, YEAR(a.ngay_sinh) AS nam_sinh, CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_sinh, 103) AS ngay_sinh2, a.so_sbh, a.tg_bhxh, a.tien_bhxh, a.tt_bhxh, a.td_bhxh, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay, a.lk_dau_nam, a.st_tc_tk, a.dot_xd, a.thang_xd, @sTime + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.dot_xd) + SPACE(1) + @sMonth + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.thang_xd) + SPACE(1) + @sQuarter + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(FLOOR((a.thang_xd + 2)/3)) + SPACE(1) + @sYear + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.nam_xd) AS quy_xd, a.nam_xd, a.so_tien1, a.so_tien2, a.so_tien3, a.so_ngay_cl, a.luy_ke, a.noi_dung, a.ly_do, a.xKey, a.loai_tcbh, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_tu, 103) AS ngay_tu_text, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_den, 103) AS ngay_den_text, a.ht_tc, a.ghi_chu, ISNULL(a.tinh_chat, 0) AS tinh_chat
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmloaitcbh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.loai_tcbh = b.ma_loai WHERE sysorder <> 2 ORDER BY xkey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, sysorder, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @ReportType = '5' BEGIN
			SELECT a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.xSubGroup, a.tt, ma_tc, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.gioi_tinh, a.ngay_sinh, YEAR(a.ngay_sinh) AS nam_sinh, CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_sinh, 103) AS ngay_sinh2, a.so_sbh, a.tg_bhxh, a.tien_bhxh, a.tt_bhxh, a.td_bhxh, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.so_ngay, a.lk_dau_nam, a.st_tc_tk, a.dot_xd, a.thang_xd, @sTime + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.dot_xd) + SPACE(1) + @sMonth + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.thang_xd) + SPACE(1) + @sQuarter + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(FLOOR((a.thang_xd + 2)/3)) + SPACE(1) + @sYear + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.nam_xd) AS quy_xd, a.nam_xd, a.so_tien1, a.so_tien2, a.so_tien3, a.so_ngay_cl, a.luy_ke, a.noi_dung, a.ly_do, a.xKey, a.loai_tcbh, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_tu, 103) AS ngay_tu_text, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_den, 103) AS ngay_den_text, a.ht_tc, a.tt_tc_tk, a.dk_muc_huong, a.ghi_chu, ISNULL(a.tinh_chat, 0) AS tinh_chat
				FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmloaitcbh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.loai_tcbh = b.ma_loai WHERE sysorder <> 2 ORDER BY xkey, loai_tcbh, ma_tc, sysorder, ref, stt_sx_tc, loai_tc, ma_nv
		END ELSE
