					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_kh = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_kh_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh_nt), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				END
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
			END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		UPDATE #report SET gt_cl = gt_th - gt_kh, gt_cl_nt = gt_th_nt - gt_kh_nt

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT RTRIM(@i), stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt FROM #report
		--
		SELECT @dTmpFrom = DATEADD(month, (@i * CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 6 WHEN '4' THEN 12 END), @dateFrom)
			, @pTmpFrom = @pTmpFrom + CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 6 WHEN '4' THEN 12 END
		IF @pTmpFrom > 12  SELECT @pTmpFrom = @pTmpFrom%12, @yTmpFrom = @yTmpFrom + 1
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	--Total
	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT 999, b.stt, b.in_ck, CASE WHEN b.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, MAX(b.stt_in), CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.chi_tieu) ELSE MAX(b.chi_tieu2) END, a.ma_so, MAX(b.ma_so_in), MAX(b.bold)
			, SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th_nt, 0))
			, SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nt, 0))
			, SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th_nt, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nt, 0))
		FROM #sum a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so GROUP BY a.ma_so, b.stt, b.in_ck, b.cach_tinh

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	--
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') FROM #result
	IF @reportForm = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT077'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT078'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT079'
	END
	IF @reportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT080'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT081'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT082'
	END
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN a.header <> '999' THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(RTRIM(a.header), 2) ELSE @Total END + ' - ' + b.header, b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY b.id, a.id

	-- View
	SELECT xPeriod, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_so) AS xRow
		, REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn
		, CASE WHEN xPeriod < 999 THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0'), 2) ELSE @Total END AS xColumnName
		, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, CASE WHEN stt_in <> '' THEN stt_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, CASE WHEN ma_so_in <> '' THEN ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrnv]
AS
SELECT a.stt_rec, a.stt, a.ma_nv, a.ho_nv, a.ten_nv, RTRIM(a.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + LTRIM(a.ten_nv) AS ten, CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Nam' ELSE N'Nữ' END AS gioi_tinh, 
		CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END AS gioi_tinh2, a.ngay_sinh, a.ma_dvcs, a.bo_phan, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2, a.vi_tri, c.ten_vtr, c.ten_vtr2, d.ten_ttnv, d.ten_ttnv2, a.status, a.user_id, a.bp_ref
	FROM hrnv AS a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
		LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
		LEFT JOIN hrdmttnv d ON a.tinh_trang_nv = d.ma_ttnv

AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_vt AS ten_vt0, c.ten_vt AS ten_vt02
		FROM xdmvt2 a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt0 = c.ma_vt
		WHERE 1=0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintTS2Tran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cmDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cMDTable CHAR(10)
	
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'select a.ma_dc, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, max(a.ngay_ct) ngay_gs'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', sum(a.nguyen_gia) nguyen_gia, sum(a.nguyen_gia_nt) nguyen_gia_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', sum(a.gt_da_pb) gt_da_pb, sum(a.gt_da_pb_nt) gt_da_pb_nt, max(a.dien_giai) dien_giai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + RTRIM(dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable)) + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' group by a.ma_dc, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct order by a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' select h.line_nbr, h.ten_pt,h.dvt,h.so_luong,h.gia_tri,h.gia_tri_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + RTRIM(dbo.ff30_DTable(@cMDTable)) + ' h with(nolock)' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' +@cmDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' order by h.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAggregation] -- fs20_Cothcppsky
	@Period NUMERIC(2), 
	@Year NUMERIC(4), 
	@Product VARCHAR(33), 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'

	-- Key	
	SET @Key = 'ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(ma_yt)) in (''' + REPLACE(@CE, ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = 1 BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ma_yt, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, ma_bp0
		INTO #report FROM xcppstk

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, ma_yt, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, ma_bp0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcppstk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' order by ma_yt, ma_bp, ma_bp0, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET sl_tk = - sl_tk, ps_tk = - ps_tk, ps_tk_nt = - ps_tk_nt
		WHERE ma_yt + '$' + ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_yt + '$' + ma_dvcs FROM xdmyt WHERE cong_tru = '2')	
	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_yt, ma_vt) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '', '')

	SET @q = 'select a.*, ' 
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_sp, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_sp2,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vt, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'c.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmvt b on a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_bp0, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ResetInvoicePrintedStatus]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @vcKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(33), @fieldAmount VARCHAR(128)

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sl_in' AND val = '1')
		SELECT TOP 0 '' AS stt_rec, '' AS ma_dvcs, NULL AS ngay_ct, '' AS ma_ct, '' AS ma_ct_in, '' AS so_ct, '' AS ma_kh, 0 AS tien_nt, '' AS ma_nt, '' AS ten_kh, '0' AS status
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = 'a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
		IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and isnull(b.in_yn, 0) = ' + CASE WHEN @Status = 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END

		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		-- Struct
		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.t_tt_nt AS tien_nt, a.ma_nt, b.in_yn INTO #result FROM m81$000000 a, hdin$000000 b

		SELECT @table = CASE
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN 'm81$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD1' THEN 'm21$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD2' THEN 'm22$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD4' THEN 'm25$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD5' THEN 'hddc'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXC' THEN 'm86$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN 'm84$%Partition'
			WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXB' THEN 'm85$%Partition'
			ELSE ''
		END,  @vcKey = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''' and ' + @Key

		SELECT @fieldAmount = CASE WHEN @VoucherCode IN('PXA', 'PXB') THEN ', a.t_tien_nt' ELSE ', a.t_tt_nt' END
		IF @table <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh' + @fieldAmount + ', a.ma_nt, isnull(b.in_yn, 0)' +
				CHAR(13) + ' from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @Status = '1' THEN '' ELSE ' left' END + ' join hdin$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
				CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @vcKey + ']%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		END
		
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, c.ma_ct_in, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN a.in_yn = 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS status
			FROM #result a JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh JOIN dmct c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
			ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_InlistsE](@cItem1 NVARCHAR(511), @strList1 NVARCHAR(4000), @cItem2 NVARCHAR(511), @strList2 NVARCHAR(4000), @nE NUMERIC(28, 6) ) 
RETURNS INT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart1 INT, @nStart2 INT, @nReturn INT, @lcItem1 NVARCHAR(511), @lcItem2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SET @nStart1 = 1
	SET @nStart2 = 1
	SET @nReturn = 0
	SET @cItem1 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem1))
	SET @strList1 = ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@strList1)) + ' ,'
	SET @cItem2 = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem2))
	SET @strList2 = ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@strList2)) + ' ,'
	
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart1) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @lcItem1 =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList1, @nStart1, CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart1) - @nStart1)))
			SET @lcItem2 =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList2, @nStart2, CHARINDEX(',', @strList2,  @nStart2) - @nStart2)))
			IF @lcItem1  = ''
				BEGIN
					IF (@cItem1 LIKE (@lcItem1 + '%'))  AND (@cItem2 LIKE (@lcItem2 + '%')) AND @nE = 0
						BEGIN
							SET @nReturn = 1
							BREAK
						END
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF (@cItem1 LIKE (@lcItem1 + '%'))  AND (@cItem2 LIKE (@lcItem2 + '%')) AND @nE <> 0
						BEGIN
							SET @nReturn = 1
							BREAK
						END
				END
	
			SET @nStart1 = CHARINDEX(',', @strList1,  @nStart1) + 1
			SET @nStart2 = CHARINDEX(',', @strList2,  @nStart2) + 1
		END
	RETURN @nReturn
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PS] --fs_AfterUpdatePS
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 tt_yn INTO #updatePO FROM m86$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS refTable INTO #afterUpdate FROM d86$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #updatePO SELECT tt_yn FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when right(stt_rec_dh, 3) = ''PO1'' then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_sa <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_sa <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_sa, dyn_oa, dyn_hd, refTable FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdvtddx]
AS
SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dk, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.sl_tk, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt, a.sl_gt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.sl_ck, a.dd_ck, 
	a.dd_ck_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, 
	a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, d.ten_yt, d.ten_yt2
FROM	dbo.xcdvtdd AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.xdmyt AS d ON a.ma_yt = d.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs
WHERE (a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dbo.dmstt)) AND (a.ky = 0)


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoice]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@InvoiceType INT = 0 -- 0: E-Invoice, 1: Other
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @refTable CHAR(3), @date DATETIME, @r00 VARCHAR(64), @r70 VARCHAR(64), @r90 VARCHAR(64), @m VARCHAR(64), @d VARCHAR(64), @i VARCHAR(64), @ipIDNumber CHAR(13), @ProcessType CHAR(1), @updateFlow BIT

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @ipIDNumber = (LEFT(@VoucherID, 10) + 'PNF')
	SELECT @ProcessType = '1', @updateFlow = 0
	SELECT @updateFlow = cn_qui_trinh FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec0 = @VoucherID
	SELECT @ProcessType = kieu_xl FROM hddt02 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD1' SELECT @refTable = '21$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c21$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD4' SELECT @refTable = '25$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c25$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @refTable = '81$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SELECT @refTable = '22$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c22$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXC' SELECT @refTable = '86$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c86$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' SELECT @refTable = '26$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM m26$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @refTable = '', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD6' SELECT @refTable = '42$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM m42$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' SELECT @refTable = '84$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c84$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' SELECT @refTable = '85$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c85$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' SELECT @refTable = '', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	IF @ResultProcess = 0 AND @InvoiceType = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 2, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		RETURN
	END

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '', @date = GETDATE()
		IF @InvoiceType = 0 SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 9, status = 9, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ihdtt set status = ''9'' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hdtt set status = ''9'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	IF @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @date = GETDATE(), @r00 = 'r00$' + @p, @r70 = 'r70$' + @p, @r90 = 'r90$' + @p, @m = 'm' + @refTable + @p, @d = 'd' + @refTable + @p, @i = 'i' + @refTable + @p
		IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXD', 'HD6') SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + '000000', @d = 'd' + @refTable + '000000', @i = 'i' + @refTable + '000000'
		IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @m = 'hddc', @d = 'cthddc', @i = 'ihddc'

		IF @ProcessType = '0' BEGIN
			-- Update E-Invoice tab status
			IF @InvoiceType = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 9, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			-- Before Update
			IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' AND @updateFlow = 1 EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SV @m, @d, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
			RETURN
		END

		/*
			 Backup data on trial mode
		*/
		IF @InvoiceType = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_mode_hddt' AND val = '0') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '', @s = '', @Key = ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''

			IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD5' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'delete hddtr00' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtr00 select * from ' + @r00 + @Key
			END

			IF @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HD4', 'PXC', 'PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtr70' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtr70 select * from ' + @r70 + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtr90' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtr90 select * from ' + @r90 + @Key
			END

			IF @VoucherCode NOT IN ('PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtr20' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtr20 select * from r20$' + @p + @Key
			END

			IF @VoucherCode IN('PXC', 'PXD', 'HD5') BEGIN
				DECLARE @inputVATMode CHAR(1), @v NVARCHAR(4000)
				SELECT @v = 'select @inputVAT = case when ' + CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'outvat_yn = 1 then ''0'' else ''1'' end' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'outvat_yn = 1 then ''0'' else ''1'' end' WHEN 'HD5' THEN 'loai_bk = ''2'' then ''1'' else ''0'' end' END + ' from ' + @m + @Key
				EXEC sp_executesql @v, N'@inputVAT char(1) output', @inputVATMode OUTPUT
				IF @inputVATMode = '1' BEGIN
					SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtr30' + @Key
					SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtr30 select * from r30$' + @p + @Key
				END
			END

			IF @VoucherCode IN('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD4', 'HD6') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtcttt20' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtcttt20 select * from cttt20' + @Key
			END

			IF @VoucherCode IN('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD6') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtcttt50' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtcttt50 select * from cttt50' + @Key
			END

			IF @VoucherCode IN('PXC', 'PXD') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete hddtcttt60' + @Key
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into hddtcttt60 select * from cttt60' + @Key
			END

			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		/*
			End Backup
		*/


		-- Update voucher status and modified field
		SELECT @q = '', @s = ''
		IF @InvoiceType = 0 SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 9, status = 9, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		IF @VoucherCode NOT IN ('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c' + @refTable + '000000 set status = ''9'' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i + ' set status = ''9'' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m + ' set status = ''9'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		-- Before Update
		IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SV @m, @d, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
		IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$IS @m, @d, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1')
				EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$Transaction @d, 'c38$', 'm38$', 'd38$', @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
		END
		IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$IT @m, @d, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1')
				EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$Transaction @d, 'c65$', 'm65$', 'd65$', @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
		END


		-- Current Customer Balance
		IF @VoucherCode NOT IN('PXC', 'PXD', 'HD5') EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$CurrentCustomerBalance @r00, @VoucherID, @VoucherCode, 'Edit'


		-- Current Stock
		IF @VoucherCode IN('HDA', 'PXC', 'PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
			DECLARE @Stock TINYINT

			IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'select @stock = case when loai_ct = ''2'' then 1 else 0 end from ' + @m + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stock tinyint output', @Stock OUTPUT
			END ELSE SELECT @Stock = 0

			SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong AS sl_nhap, so_luong AS sl_xuat INTO #currentStock FROM wrksvdetail

			SELECT @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock(@r70, @r90, @VoucherID, @VoucherCode, 'Delete', @Stock)
			EXEC(@s)
			IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' BEGIN
				DELETE #currentStock
				SELECT @s = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock(@r70, @r90, @ipIDNumber, @VoucherCode, 'Delete', @Stock)
				EXEC(@s)
			END
		END


		-- Update Tax
		IF @VoucherCode NOT IN ('PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
			UPDATE ctgt20 SET ma_so_thue = '', ten_vt = '', t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, status = 9, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = @date WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
			SELECT @q = 'update r20$' + @p + ' set ma_so_thue = '''', ten_vt = '''', t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, status = ''9'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		IF @VoucherCode IN('PXC', 'PXD', 'HD5') BEGIN
			DECLARE @inputVAT CHAR(1)
			SELECT @q = 'select @inputVAT = case when ' + CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'outvat_yn = 1 then ''0'' else ''1'' end' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'outvat_yn = 1 then ''0'' else ''1'' end' WHEN 'HD5' THEN 'loai_bk = ''2'' then ''1'' else ''0'' end' END + ' from ' + @m + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@inputVAT char(1) output', @inputVAT OUTPUT
			IF @inputVAT = '1' BEGIN
				UPDATE ctgt30 SET ma_so_thue = '', ten_vt = '', t_tien = 0, t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, status = 9, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = @date WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
				SELECT @q = 'update r30$' + @p + ' set ma_so_thue = '''', ten_vt = '''', t_tien = 0, t_tien_nt = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, status = ''9'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), @date, 113) + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END


		-- Delete payment, allocation
		IF @VoucherCode IN('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD4', 'HD6') DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
		IF @VoucherCode IN('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD6') DELETE cttt50 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
		IF @VoucherCode IN('PXC', 'PXD') DELETE cttt60 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID


		-- Delete gl, in
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD5' BEGIN
			DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
			IF @InvoiceType = '1' DELETE p00$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
			SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @r00 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''

			IF @VoucherCode IN('HDA', 'HD2', 'HD4', 'PXC', 'PXA', 'PXB') BEGIN
				DELETE ct70 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
				DELETE ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @r70 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @r90 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''

				IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' BEGIN
					DELETE ct70 WHERE stt_rec = @ipIDNumber
					DELETE ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @ipIDNumber
					SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @r70 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @ipIDNumber + ''''
					SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @r90 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @ipIDNumber + ''''
				END

			END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSExpensesAllocationByDepartment] --fs20_FXAllocationByDept
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language AS CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total AS NVARCHAR(511), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_cc AS ma_bp, tien AS gt_kh_ky, tien_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt INTO #report FROM ctpbcc
	
	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = '(nam * 12 + ky) between ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_bp_cc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Department, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey 
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_cc, isnull(sum(tien), 0), isnull(sum(tien_nt), 0)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ctpbcc where ' + @Key + ' group by tk_kh, ma_bp_cc, tk_cp order by tk_kh, ma_bp_cc, tk_cp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT '', '', '', 0, 0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt, a.tk_kh, a.tk_kh + a.ma_bp AS tk_kh2, a.tk_cp AS sysColumn, a.ma_bp, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tk ELSE c.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk_kh, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_tk ELSE d.ten_tk2 END AS ten_tk_cp
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_kh = c.tk LEFT JOIN dmtk d ON a.tk_cp = d.tk 
		ORDER BY a.stt

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'gt_kh_ky' ELSE 'gt_kh_ky_nt' END, @total
	INSERT INTO #pivot(name, header) SELECT CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 10 THEN 'gt_kh_ky$' ELSE 'gt_kh_ky_nt$' END, tk_cp FROM #report GROUP BY tk_cp ORDER BY tk_cp
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id - 1) WHERE id > 1
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vsodmduyetlai]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.u_status_name, b.u_status_name2, c.name, c.comment, c.comment2
		FROM dbo.sodmduyetlai a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.sodmttcttg b ON a.u_status = b.u_status AND a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet
			LEFT JOIN dbo.vsysuserinfo c ON a.user_id4 = c.id

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionStatus]
	@InspectionID CHAR(13),
	@Rollback BIT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@InspectionListTable VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@InspectionTemplateTable VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@InspectionResultTable VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@Debug BIT = 0,
	@OutStatus CHAR(1) = '' OUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @part CHAR(6), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @InspectionIDKey NVARCHAR(128), @status CHAR(1), @res BIT

	SELECT @InspectionIDKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionID, '''', '''''') + '''', @status = '1'
	SELECT TOP 1 @part = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM bikd WHERE stt_rec = @InspectionID

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_luong0, qd_tung_phan, sl_qdsd INTO #tt$th FROM bikd00$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #tt$th select stt_rec, so_luong0, qd_tung_phan, sl_qdsd from ' + CASE WHEN @InspectionListTable <> '' THEN @InspectionListTable ELSE 'bikd00$' + @part + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey END
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec, stt_rec_goc, status INTO #tt$vc FROM bikd02$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #tt$vc select nhom_du_lieu, stt_rec, stt_rec_goc, status from ' + CASE WHEN @InspectionResultTable <> '' THEN @InspectionResultTable ELSE 'bikd02$' + @part + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey END
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$vc) BEGIN
		SET @status = '1'
		GOTO ENDUPDATE
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$vc a WHERE nhom_du_lieu = '06') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$th WHERE qd_tung_phan = 0 OR (qd_tung_phan = 1 AND sl_qdsd >= so_luong0)) BEGIN
			SET @status = '4'
			GOTO ENDUPDATE
		END
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$vc a WHERE nhom_du_lieu IN ('04', '05')) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #tt$mau FROM bikd03m$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #tt$mau select stt_rec from ' + CASE WHEN @InspectionTemplateTable <> '' THEN @InspectionTemplateTable ELSE 'bikd03m$' + @part + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@InspectionIDKey, 'a.stt_rec', 'a.stt_rec_kd') END
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$mau a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_goc, MAX(status) AS status FROM #tt$vc WHERE nhom_du_lieu = '04' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc) b ON LEFT(a.stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(b.stt_rec_goc, 10) WHERE ISNULL(b.status, 0) <> '1')
			SET @status = '2'
		ELSE
			SET @status = '3'
		GOTO ENDUPDATE
	END


	ENDUPDATE:
	SET @q = 'update a set status = @status, user_id2 = @u' + CASE WHEN @Rollback = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tt$vc) THEN ', datetime2 = datetime0' ELSE ', datetime2 = getdate()' END+ ' from bikd00$' + @part + ' a where ' + @InspectionIDKey
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@status char(1), @u int', @status, @UserID

	UPDATE bikd SET status = @status WHERE stt_rec = @InspectionID
	SET @OutStatus = @status

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCLaborStatistics]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@invoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@invoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@shift VARCHAR(32),
	@shop VARCHAR(32),
	@wo VARCHAR(32),
	@operation VARCHAR(32),
	@detailBy CHAR(1), -- 1 - Nhân công, 2 - Nhóm nhân công
	@size TINYINT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Unit VARCHAR(1023), @fields VARCHAR(511), @fkey VARCHAR(32), @fname VARCHAR(32), @fjoin VARCHAR(511)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Unit = '', @fields = 'ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_nc, ma_nh, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong',
		@fname = CASE WHEN @detailBy = '1' THEN 'ten_nc%l' ELSE 'ten_nh%l' END,
		@fkey = CASE WHEN @detailBy = '1' THEN 'ma_nc' ELSE 'ma_nh' END,
		@fjoin = CASE WHEN @detailBy = '1' THEN 'left join sfdmnc b on a.ma_nc = b.ma_nc' ELSE 'left join sfdmnhomnc b on a.ma_nh = b.ma_nh' END

	SELECT @key = 'isnull(' + @fkey + ', '''') <> '''''
	IF @invoiceFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@invoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @invoiceTo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@invoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @shift <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_ca like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@shift), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @shop <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_px like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@shop), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @wo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@wo), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @operation <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_cd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@operation), '''', '''''') + '%'''


	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @userID, @admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_nc, ma_nh, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong INTO #t FROM sfctnc$000000
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t(' + @fields + ') select ' + @fields + ' from sfctnc$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']% order by ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ' + @fkey
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @userID, @admin
	--
	UPDATE #t SET stt = stt0
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t)
		INSERT INTO #t (stt, ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_nc, ma_nh, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong)
			SELECT NULL, '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', 0

	--
	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, d.ten_gd%l as ten_gd'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.*, a.' + @fkey + ' as xcode, b.' + @fname + ' as xname, c.ten_vt%l as ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a ' + @fjoin + ' left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmmagd d on a.ma_gd = d.ma_gd and a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct and d.type = ''S'''
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.stt'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_TSExeAllocationTransaction]
	@periodFrom INT,
	@periodTo INT,
	@year INT,
	@voucherCode CHAR(3),
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @Ws_id CHAR(1), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @dien_giai NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Set
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin, 'New')
	SELECT @dien_giai = ISNULL(dien_giai, '') FROM v20dmdg WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@periodFrom, @year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@periodTo, @year)
	SELECT @Ws_id = RTRIM(Val) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_WS_ID'

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 2) AS id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp AS ma_bp_dc, tk AS tk_pb, tk AS tk_cp, ma_kh
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi
		INTO #tctpbcc FROM wrkColumns

	INSERT INTO #tctpbcc(ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi)
		EXEC rs_GetTSDisAlloc @periodFrom, @periodTo, @year, '0', '', @unit, 'New', @language, @userID, @admin

	DECLARE @line_nbr INT
	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr INTO #t FROM r00$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select max(line_nbr) from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(stt_rec)) where %[stt_rec = ''' + @Ws_id + REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@periodTo, 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@periodFrom, 3), ' ', '0') + @voucherCode + ''']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1
	SELECT @line_nbr = ISNULL(MAX(line_nbr), 0) FROM #t
	UPDATE #tctpbcc SET stt = id + @line_nbr

	INSERT INTO #gl (ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, user_id0, user_id2, status, loai_ct, so_ctgs, so_lo, ong_ba, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_nk, so_ct0, ct_nxt, ma_gd, nam, ky, so_dh
			, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi
			, ps_no_nt, ps_no, ps_co_nt, ps_co, line_nbr, nh_dk
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6)
			SELECT @voucherCode, @dTo, @dTo, @userID, @userID, '1', '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', 0, '', 0, 0, ''
				, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi
				, 0, 0, tien_nt, tien, stt, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2)
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0 FROM #tctpbcc

	INSERT INTO #gl (ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, user_id0, user_id2, status, loai_ct, so_ctgs, so_lo, ong_ba, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_nk, so_ct0, ct_nxt, ma_gd, nam, ky, so_dh
			, tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi
			, ps_no_nt, ps_no, ps_co_nt, ps_co, line_nbr, nh_dk
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6)
			SELECT @voucherCode, @dTo, @dTo, @userID, @userID, '1', '', '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', 0, '', 0, 0, ''
				, tk_cp, tk_pb, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi
				, tien_nt, tien, 0, 0, stt + 1, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(FLOOR(stt + 1) / 2)
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0 FROM #tctpbcc

	UPDATE #gl SET datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE(), so_ct = SPACE(dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct') - 6) + REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ' , '0') + REPLACE(STR(@periodTo, 2), ' ' , '0'),
		dien_giai_h = @dien_giai, dien_giai = @dien_giai, stt_rec = @Ws_id + REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@periodTo, 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@periodFrom, 3), ' ', '0') + @voucherCode

	-- Reference
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	--Delete
	EXEC rs_TSDelAllocationTransaction @periodFrom, @periodTo, @year, @voucherCode, @unit, 'New', @language, @userID, @admin

	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	-- Insert into r00
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112) + ' select * from #gl'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Save
	SET @q = 'delete ctpbdc where nam = ' + REPLACE(STR(@year, 4), ' ' , '') + ' and ky between ' + REPLACE(STR(@periodFrom, 2), ' ' , '') + ' and ' + REPLACE(STR(@periodTo, 2), ' ' , '')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	WHILE @periodFrom <= @periodTo BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tctpbcc
		INSERT INTO #tctpbcc (ma_dvcs, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, tien, tien_nt, ma_vv, ma_sp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_ku, ma_phi)
			EXEC rs_GetTSDisAlloc @periodFrom, @periodFrom, @year, '1', '', @unit, 'New', @language, @userID, @admin
		INSERT INTO ctpbdc(ma_dc, ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, tien, tien_nt, ma_nt
					, status, user_id0, user_id2, datetime0, datetime2)
			SELECT ma_dc, @periodFrom, @year
				, ma_dvcs, ma_bp_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, tien, tien_nt, ''
				, '1', @userID, @userID, GETDATE(), GETDATE()
				FROM #tctpbcc
		SET @periodFrom = @periodFrom + 1
	END
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$GetApprovalMailList]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@partition VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherType CHAR(32),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@lastUser INT = 0,
	@isChange BIT = 0,
	@createdUser INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(32), @Amount NUMERIC(19, 2), @CurStatus VARCHAR(32), @p INT, @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @mailUser INT, @datetime2 DATETIME, @unit VARCHAR(32), @Category VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @d SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #m(id int IDENTITY(1,1), stt_rec CHAR(13), user_id INT, type INT, parallel_yn BIT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32), deny_mail_yn BIT)
	CREATE TABLE #tmp(u_status VARCHAR(32), datetime2 DATETIME, ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #ds(user_id INT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #parallel(user_id INT NULL)

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)
	SELECT @masterTable = m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @hisTable = a$ FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ds select user_id4 from ' + @hisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select u_status, datetime2, ma_dvcs, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @CurStatus = u_status, @datetime2 = datetime2, @unit = ma_dvcs, @Category = kieu_duyet FROM #tmp


	-- Unit rights
	SELECT id INTO #user FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE status = 1 AND (admin = 1 OR (admin = 0 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sysunitrights WHERE ma_dvcs = @unit AND r_edit = 1)))

	--Device
	INSERT INTO #m SELECT @idNumber, a.user_id, '2', c.parallel_yn, c.kieu_duyet, c.deny_mail_yn FROM (SELECT * FROM gndmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN gndmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN gndmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
		WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND a.status = 1
			AND c.status = @CurStatus
			AND a.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #ds)
			AND a.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM #user)
			AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE ma_phan_he = 'SM' AND name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @voucherCode CHAR(3)
		SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM gndmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType
		SET @q = 'exec ds_CreateVoucherPending @voucherCode, @idNumber, ''#m'', ''user_id'', @sysDatabaseName'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @voucherCode, @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName
	END

	-- Approval mail (with link)
	DELETE #m WHERE deny_mail_yn = 1


	-- Notification mail (without link)
	IF @lastUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @lastUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @lastUser, '1'
	END

	-- Mail Created User (without link)
	IF @createdUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @createdUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @createdUser, '1'
	END

	--
	IF @isChange = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #parallel SELECT a.user_id FROM #m a JOIN dmxn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE a.parallel_yn = 1
		DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END


	-- Delete valid mail/sms
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_nhan INTO #xn FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
		INSERT INTO #xn SELECT ma_huy FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)

		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from #xn)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END

	-- Delete dmxn, dbxn
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$DeleteLog @sysDatabaseName

	-- Create new mail/sms
	SELECT @p = MIN(id) FROM #m
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @mailUser = user_id FROM #m WHERE id = @p
		SELECT @c1 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6)), @c2 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6))
		INSERT INTO dmxn(stt_rec, user_id, ma_nhan, ma_huy, datetime2) SELECT @idNumber, @mailUser, @c1, @c2, @datetime2
		SET @q = 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c1 + ''', ''1'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c2 + ''', ''0'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m WHERE id > @p
	END


	-- Update datetime2 for valid old mail/sms
	UPDATE dmxn SET datetime2 = @datetime2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)


	SELECT id, stt_rec, user_id, type FROM #m


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdmnvxntn]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ma_nv, b.ten AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan
			, c.bp_ref, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2, d.ten_dvcs, d.ten_dvcs2
		FROM hrdmnvxntn a WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN vhrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dmdvcs d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights](
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32), -- Note: @UnitCode may be blank
	@Site VARCHAR(33), 
	@UserID INT, 
	@Admin BIT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS BEGIN
	IF @Admin = 1 RETURN 1
	-- No limit rights
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @UserID) RETURN 1

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @UserID AND ma_kho = @Site) RETURN 0
	
	RETURN 1
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs_ConvertItemBalanceFromFIFOBalance 
	@nYear INT
 AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nMonth TINYINT
	SELECT @nMonth = MONTH(Ngay_dn) FROM dmstt
	INSERT INTO cdvt (nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT nam, ma_kho,ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
			FROM cdntxt
			WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_ct = ''
			GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt
			HAVING STR(nam, 4) +ma_kho + ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT STR(nam, 4) + ma_kho + ma_vt FROM cdvt )
	
	INSERT INTO cdvitri (nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
			FROM cdntxt
			WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_ct = ''
			GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt
			HAVING STR(nam, 4) +ma_kho + ma_vi_tri + ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT STR(nam, 4) + ma_kho + ma_vi_tri + ma_vt FROM cdvitri )
	
	INSERT INTO cdlo (nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0, '1', MAX(datetime0), MAX(datetime2), 0, 0
			FROM cdntxt
			WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_ct = ''
			GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
			HAVING STR(nam, 4) +ma_kho + ma_vi_tri + ma_vt + ma_lo NOT IN (SELECT STR(nam, 4) + ma_kho + ma_vi_tri + ma_vt + ma_lo FROM cdlo )
	
	UPDATE cdvt SET cdvt.ton00 = a.ton00, cdvt.du00 = a.du00, cdvt.du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
		FROM cdvt JOIN 
			(SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS ton00, SUM(tien) AS du00, SUM(tien_nt) AS du_nt00
				FROM cdntxt
				WHERE ma_ct = ''
				GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vt
				HAVING nam = @nYear
			) a ON a.nam = cdvt.nam AND a.ma_kho = cdvt.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = cdvt.ma_vt
		WHERE cdvt.nam = @nYear
	
	UPDATE cdvitri SET cdvitri.ton00 = a.ton00, cdvitri.du00 = a.du00, cdvitri.du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
		FROM cdvitri JOIN 
			(SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS ton00, SUM(tien) AS du00, SUM(tien_nt) AS du_nt00
				FROM cdntxt
				WHERE ma_ct = ''
				GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt
				HAVING nam = @nYear
			) a ON a.nam = cdvitri.nam AND a.ma_kho = cdvitri.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = cdvitri.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = cdvitri.ma_vt
		WHERE cdvitri.nam = @nYear
	
	UPDATE cdlo SET cdlo.ton00 = a.ton00, cdlo.du00 = a.du00, cdlo.du_nt00 = a.du_nt00
		FROM cdlo JOIN 
			(SELECT nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, SUM(so_luong) AS ton00, SUM(tien) AS du00, SUM(tien_nt) AS du_nt00
				FROM cdntxt
				WHERE ma_ct = ''
				GROUP BY nam, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
				HAVING nam = @nYear
			) a ON a.nam = cdlo.nam AND a.ma_kho = cdlo.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = cdlo.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_vt = cdlo.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = cdlo.ma_lo
		WHERE cdlo.nam = @nYear
	
	UPDATE cdvt SET cdvt.ton00 = 0, cdvt.du00 = 0, cdvt.du_nt00 = 0
		WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND 
			NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM cdntxt WHERE ma_ct = ''  AND nam = @nYear AND ma_kho = cdvt.ma_kho AND ma_vt = cdvt.ma_vt)
	
	UPDATE cdvitri SET cdvitri.ton00 = 0, cdvitri.du00 = 0, cdvitri.du_nt00 = 0
		WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND 
			NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM cdntxt WHERE ma_ct = '' AND  nam = @nYear AND ma_kho = cdvitri.ma_kho AND ma_vi_tri = cdvitri.ma_vi_tri AND ma_vt = cdvitri.ma_vt)
	
	UPDATE cdlo SET cdlo.ton00 = 0, cdlo.du00 = 0, cdlo.du_nt00 = 0
		WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND 
			NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM cdntxt WHERE ma_ct = '' AND  nam = @nYear AND ma_kho = cdlo.ma_kho AND ma_vi_tri = cdlo.ma_vi_tri AND ma_vt = cdlo.ma_vt AND ma_lo = cdlo.ma_lo)
	DELETE cdlo WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
	DELETE cdvitri WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
	DELETE cdvt WHERE nam = @nYear AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = 3) AND ton00 = 0 AND du00 = 0 AND du_nt00 = 0
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableName] @VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), @MTable VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT, @CTable VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @m VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @m = CASE
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN '%m81$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD1' THEN '%m21$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXC' THEN '%m86$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD2' THEN '%m22$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD5' THEN 'hddc'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD6' THEN 'm42$000000'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD3' THEN '%m23$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN '%m76$%Partition'
		ELSE '%m25$%Partition'
	END

	SELECT @CTable = REPLACE(REPLACE(@m, '%Partition', '000000'), '%m', 'c')
	SELECT @MTable = REPLACE(@m, '%m', 'm')

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTicket]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Check idNumber access
	/* - XET QUYEN TRUY CAP
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, '', '', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 RETURN
	*/

	DECLARE @provider INT
	SELECT @provider = dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt WHERE ma_kn = @Account

	IF @provider <> 8 RETURN


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	-- Thong tin bang luu du lieu ve
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD1' SELECT @refTable = '21$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c21$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + @p

	-- Thong tin ve: khoa tra cuu, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ky du lieu
	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt_rec as [key], a.so_bi_mat, rtrim(b.ma_dvcs) as ma_dvcs,''' + @p + ''' as ky from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
