CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCashFlowStatementsByWeek]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@reportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Tuần, 2 - Tháng, 3 - Quý, 4 - Nửa năm, 5 - Năm
	@periodNum INT,
	@planType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mới nhất, 2 - Gốc, 3 - Tùy chọn
	@revision INT,
	@deptCode VARCHAR(33),
	@jobCode VARCHAR(33),
	@unitCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@formCode CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @KindSum CHAR(1), @FieldType VARCHAR(33), @Total NVARCHAR(511), @PeriodCol NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTmpTo SMALLDATETIME, @dTmp SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @pTmpFrom INT, @yTmpFrom INT, @pTmpTo INT, @yTmpTo INT, @pTmp INT, @yTmp INT, @xPediod INT
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Thu_chi CHAR(1), @Ds_chi_tieu VARCHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ma_ct VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @Ds_tk VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_du VARCHAR(512), @Ds_tk_gt VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_loai VARCHAR(512), @Ds_ma_phi VARCHAR(512), @Cong_no CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Gt_th NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_th_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), @Gt_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @dt_tuan_2 VARCHAR(33), @dt_tuan_3 VARCHAR(33), @dt_tuan_4 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @dt_tuan_2 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_2'
	SELECT @dt_tuan_3 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_3'
	SELECT @dt_tuan_4 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'dt_tuan_4'
	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year), @key = ''
		, @dateTo = CASE @reportType
						WHEN '1' THEN
							CASE (@periodNum%4)
								WHEN 1 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom))) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom)), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
								WHEN 2 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom))) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom)), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
								WHEN 3 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom))) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom)), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
								WHEN 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY, - 1, DATEADD(MONTH, ((@periodNum/4)), @dateFrom))
							END
						WHEN '2' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, (@periodNum * 1), @dateFrom))
						WHEN '3' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, (@periodNum * 3), @dateFrom))
						WHEN '4' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, (@periodNum * 6), @dateFrom))
						WHEN '5' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, (@periodNum * 12), @dateFrom))
					END
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @PeriodCol = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @FieldType = RTRIM(field) FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '02'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, tk, tk_du, ma_phi, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_ltc, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #r00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #BgAccount FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #EdAccount FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 tien, tien_nt INTO #kh FROM khdttuan
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt
			, thu_chi AS thu_chi INTO #repNorm FROM bcdttuan
	SELECT TOP 0 gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #valueTmp FROM #repNorm
	SELECT TOP 0 gt_kh, gt_kh_nt INTO #plainTmp FROM #repNorm

	SELECT *, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_th_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_kh_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #report FROM bcdttuan WHERE form = @formCode

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #result FROM #report
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #sum FROM #report

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	-- Key
	IF @deptCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@deptCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @jobCode <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT ma_vv INTO #xdmvv FROM dmvv WHERE ma_vv LIKE RTRIM(@jobCode) + '%'
		SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS xcode, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS code, ma_vv, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, CAST(0 AS  NUMERIC(2)) AS bac_vv INTO #dmvv0 FROM wrkcolumns
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv INTO #dmvv1 FROM #dmvv0
		--
		INSERT INTO #dmvv0 EXEC fs20_JobCalcXStruct
		INSERT INTO #dmvv1 SELECT ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmvv b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
		--
		SELECT @i = MAX(bac_vv) FROM #dmvv1
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #dmvv1(ma_vv, ma_vv_me, bac_vv) SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv_me, a.bac_vv FROM #dmvv0 a WHERE a.bac_vv = (@i + 1) AND a.ma_vv_me <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv_me = b.ma_vv) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmvv1 b WHERE a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		--
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'exists(select 1 from #dmvv1 b where a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv)'
	END
	--
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unitCode, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @unitKey
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key), @unitKey = ISNULL(@unitKey, '')

	-- Get Data Arising
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r00'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ' + CASE WHEN @reportType <> '1' THEN 'month(a.ngay_ct) + year(a.ngay_ct)' ELSE 'case when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= 1) and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT)) + ') then 1 when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= ' +
		RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT)) + ') and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT)) + ') then 2 when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT)) + ') and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT)) + ') then 3 else 4 end + (month(a.ngay_ct) * 4) + (year(a.ngay_ct) * 12 * 4)' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi, a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType)
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ' + CASE WHEN @reportType <> '1' THEN 'month(a.ngay_ct) + year(a.ngay_ct)' ELSE 'case when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= 1) and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT)) + ') then 1 when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= ' +
		RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT)) + ') and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT)) + ') then 2 when (day(a.ngay_ct) >= ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT)) + ') and (day(a.ngay_ct) < ' + RTRIM(CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT)) + ') then 3 else 4 end + (month(a.ngay_ct) * 4) + (year(a.ngay_ct) * 12 * 4)' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_phi, a.' + RTRIM(@FieldType)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Get Data Plan
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #kh'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' select a.tien%xWeek, a.tien_nt%xWeek'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' from khdttuan a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' where nam = %xYear and ky = %xPeriod and ma_ct = ''%xNorm''' + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @key
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @planType = 1 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdttuan b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct having max(b.lan) = a.lan)'
							WHEN @planType = 2 THEN ' and exists(select 1 from khdttuan b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct having min(b.lan) = a.lan )'
												ELSE ' and a.lan = (select max(b.lan) from khdttuan b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct and b.lan <= ' + RTRIM(@revision) +')' END
	-- Scan từng kỳ
	SELECT @i = 1, @dTmpFrom = @dateFrom, @pTmpFrom = @period, @yTmpFrom = @year, @q = ''
	--
	WHILE @i <= @periodNum BEGIN
		SELECT @dTmpTo =
			CASE @reportType
				WHEN '1' THEN
					CASE @i%4
						WHEN 1 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dTmpFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTmpFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
						WHEN 2 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dTmpFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTmpFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
						WHEN 3 THEN RTRIM(YEAR(@dTmpFrom)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTmpFrom), 2), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT) - 1, 2), ' ', '0')
						ELSE DATEADD(day, - 1, RTRIM(YEAR(DATEADD(month, 1, @dTmpFrom))) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(DATEADD(month, 1, @dTmpFrom)), 2), ' ', '0') + '01')
					END
				WHEN '2' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, 1, @dTmpFrom))
				WHEN '3' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, 3, @dTmpFrom))
				WHEN '4' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, 6, @dTmpFrom))
				WHEN '5' THEN DATEADD(day, - 1, DATEADD(month, 12, @dTmpFrom))
			END, @pTmpTo = @pTmpFrom + CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN (@i/4) WHEN '2' THEN 0 WHEN '3' THEN 2 WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 11 END, @yTmpTo = @yTmpFrom
		IF @pTmpTo > 12  SELECT @pTmpTo = @pTmpTo%12, @yTmpTo = @yTmpTo + 1
		IF @reportType = '1' SELECT @xPediod = CASE
			WHEN (DAY(@dTmpFrom) >= 1) AND (DAY(@dTmpFrom) < CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT) - 1) THEN 1
			WHEN (DAY(@dTmpFrom) >= CAST(@dt_tuan_2 AS INT) - 1) AND (DAY(@dTmpFrom) < CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT) - 1) THEN 2
			WHEN (DAY(@dTmpFrom) >= CAST(@dt_tuan_3 AS INT) - 1) AND (DAY(@dTmpFrom) < CAST(@dt_tuan_4 AS INT) - 1) THEN 3 ELSE 4
		END + (MONTH(@dTmpFrom) * 4) + (YEAR(@dTmpFrom) * 12 * 4)

		-- Get Data Balance
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind <> '1') BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '2') BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #BgAccount
				INSERT INTO #BgAccount EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dTmpFrom, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @unitKey
			END
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmctdt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(a.ma_ct, b.ds_chi_tieu) = 1) AND kind = '3') BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #EdAccount
				INSERT INTO #EdAccount EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dTmpTo, NULL, '', 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @unitKey
			END
		END

		-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu báo cáo
		TRUNCATE TABLE #repNorm
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, thu_chi, ds_chi_tieu FROM #report WHERE kind = '1'
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #kh
			TRUNCATE TABLE #valueTmp
			-- Scan từng chỉ tiêu dòng tiền
			SELECT @Ds_chi_tieu = REPLACE(@Ds_chi_tieu, '''', '''''')
			SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Ds_chi_tieu, ','), @KindSum = ''
			WHILE @n > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_ct = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Ds_chi_tieu, @n, ',')
				SELECT @Kind = kind, @Ds_tk = ds_tk, @Ds_tk_du = ds_tk_du, @Ds_tk_gt = ds_tk_gt, @Ds_ma_loai = ds_ma_loai, @Ds_ma_phi = ds_ma_phi, @Cong_no = cong_no FROM dmctdt WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct
				SELECT @Ds_tk = REPLACE(@Ds_tk, '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_du = REPLACE(@Ds_tk_du, '''', ''''''), @Ds_tk_gt = REPLACE(@Ds_tk_gt, '''', '''''')
					, @Ds_ma_loai = REPLACE(@Ds_ma_loai, '''', ''''''), @Ds_ma_phi = REPLACE(@Ds_ma_phi, '''', '''''')
				IF @n = 1 SELECT @KindSum = @Kind
				--
				IF @Ds_tk <> '' BEGIN
					IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'insert into #valueTmp select sum(' + CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN 'ps_no' ELSE 'ps_co' END + ')'
						SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(' + CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN 'ps_no_nt' ELSE 'ps_co_nt' END + '), 0, 0, 0, 0'
						SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r00'
						SELECT @q = @q + ' where dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @Ds_tk + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @Ds_tk_du + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(isnull(ma_ltc, ''''), ''' + @Ds_ma_loai + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_phi, ''' + @Ds_ma_phi + ''') = 1'
						IF @reportType = '1'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' and xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@xPediod)
						ELSE
							SELECT @q = @q + ' and (xPeriod between ' + RTRIM(MONTH(@dTmpFrom) + YEAR(@dTmpFrom)) + ' and ' + RTRIM(MONTH(@dTmpTo) + YEAR(@dTmpTo)) + ')'
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
						--
						IF @Ds_tk_gt <> '' BEGIN
							SELECT @q = 'insert into #valueTmp select sum(' + CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN '- ps_co' ELSE '- ps_no' END + ')'
							SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(' + CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN '- ps_co_nt' ELSE '- ps_no_nt' END + '), 0, 0, 0, 0'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r00'
							SELECT @q = @q + ' where dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + @Ds_tk + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + @Ds_tk_gt + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(isnull(ma_ltc, ''''), ''' + @Ds_ma_loai + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(ma_phi, ''' + @Ds_ma_phi + ''') = 1'
							IF @reportType = '1'
								SELECT @q = @q + ' and xPeriod = ' + RTRIM(@xPediod)
							ELSE
								SELECT @q = @q + ' and (xPeriod between ' + RTRIM(MONTH(@dTmpFrom) + YEAR(@dTmpFrom)) + ' and ' + RTRIM(MONTH(@dTmpTo) + YEAR(@dTmpTo)) + ')'
							EXEC sp_executesql @q
						END
					END
					--
					IF @Kind = '2' BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #valueTmp
							SELECT CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN SUM(du_no - du_co) ELSE SUM(du_co - du_no) END, CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) ELSE SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) END , 0, 0, 0, 0
								FROM #BgAccount WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Ds_tk) = 1
					END
					--
					IF @Kind = '3' BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #valueTmp
							SELECT CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN SUM(du_no - du_co) ELSE SUM(du_co - du_no) END, CASE WHEN @Cong_no = 1 THEN SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) ELSE SUM(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) END , 0, 0, 0, 0
								FROM #EdAccount WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Ds_tk) = 1
					END
				END
				--
				SELECT @pTmp = @pTmpFrom, @yTmp = @yTmpFrom
				IF @reportType = '1' BEGIN
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%xWeek', REPLACE(STR(CASE WHEN (@i%4) <> 0 THEN (@i%4) ELSE 4 END, 2), ' ', '0')), '%xPeriod', REPLACE(STR(@pTmp, 2), ' ', '0')), '%xYear', @yTmp), '%xNorm', @Ma_ct)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END ELSE BEGIN
					WHILE (@yTmp * 12 + @pTmp) <= (@yTmpTo * 12 + @pTmpTo) BEGIN
						SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, 'a.tien%xWeek, a.tien_nt%xWeek', 'a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt'), '%xPeriod', REPLACE(STR(@pTmp, 2), ' ', '0')), '%xYear', @yTmp), '%xNorm', @Ma_ct)
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
						--
						SELECT @pTmp = @pTmp + 1
						IF @pTmp > 12 SELECT @pTmp = 1, @yTmp = @yTmp + 1
					END
				END
				--
				SELECT @n = @n - 1
			END
			--
			INSERT INTO #valueTmp SELECT 0, 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0 FROM #kh
			INSERT INTO #repNorm SELECT @Ma_so, SUM(ISNULL(gt_th, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_th_nt, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_kh, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(gt_kh_nt, 0)), 0, 0, @Thu_chi FROM #valueTmp
			--
			IF @KindSum = '1' BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #sum WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so) UPDATE #sum SET gt_th = a.gt_th + b.gt_th, gt_th_nt = a.gt_th_nt + b.gt_th_nt, gt_kh = a.gt_kh + b.gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = a.gt_kh_nt + b.gt_kh_nt FROM #sum a JOIN #repNorm b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.ma_so = @Ma_so
					ELSE INSERT INTO #sum SELECT @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), 0, 0 FROM #repNorm WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			IF @KindSum = '2' AND @i = 1 BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #sum SELECT @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), SUM(gt_kh), SUM(gt_kh_nt), 0, 0 FROM #repNorm WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			IF @KindSum = '3' AND @i = @periodNum BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #sum SELECT @Ma_so, SUM(gt_th), SUM(gt_th_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #repNorm WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Thu_chi, @Ds_chi_tieu
		END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		UPDATE #repNorm SET gt_th = - gt_th, gt_th_nt = - gt_th_nt, gt_kh = - gt_kh, gt_kh_nt = - gt_kh_nt WHERE thu_chi = 0
		UPDATE #report SET gt_th_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_th_nt, 0), gt_th = ISNULL(b.gt_th, 0), gt_kh_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_kh_nt, 0), gt_kh = ISNULL(b.gt_kh, 0), gt_cl_nt = ISNULL(b.gt_cl_nt, 0), gt_cl = ISNULL(b.gt_cl, 0) FROM #report a JOIN #repNorm b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		--
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_th = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_th) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_th_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_th_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_kh = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_kh) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set gt_kh_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(gt_kh_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				--
				IF @i = @periodNum BEGIN
					INSERT #sum (ma_so) SELECT @Ma_so
					--
					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_th = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_th_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_th_nt), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_kh = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

					SET @strSql = 'update #sum set gt_kh_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select isnull(max(gt_kh_nt), 0) from #sum where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
					SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
					EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
				END
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
			END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR
		--
		UPDATE #report SET gt_cl = gt_th - gt_kh, gt_cl_nt = gt_th_nt - gt_kh_nt

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT RTRIM(@i), stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, stt_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt FROM #report
		--
		SELECT @dTmpFrom = DATEADD(day, 1, @dTmpTo), @pTmpFrom = @pTmpFrom + CASE @reportType WHEN '1' THEN CASE (@i%4) WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN '2' THEN 1 WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4' THEN 6 WHEN '5' THEN 12 END
		IF @pTmpFrom > 12  SELECT @pTmpFrom = @pTmpFrom%12, @yTmpFrom = @yTmpFrom + 1
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	--Total
	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT 999, b.stt, b.in_ck, CASE WHEN b.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, MAX(b.stt_in), CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.chi_tieu) ELSE MAX(b.chi_tieu2) END, a.ma_so, MAX(b.ma_so_in), MAX(b.bold)
			, SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th_nt, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nt, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh, 0)), SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_th_nt, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nt, 0))
		FROM #sum a JOIN #report b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so GROUP BY a.ma_so, b.stt, b.in_ck, b.cach_tinh

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL, stt INT NULL)
	--
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') FROM #result
	IF @reportForm = 10 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT077'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT078'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT079'
	END
	IF @reportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'gt_th_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT080'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'gt_kh_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT081'
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 3, 'gt_cl_nt$', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT082'
	END
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + RTRIM(a.id)
		, CASE WHEN a.header <> '999' THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(RTRIM(a.header), 2) ELSE @Total END + ' - ' + b.header
		, b.id FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY b.id, a.id

	-- View
	SELECT xPeriod, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ma_so) AS xRow, REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS xColumn,
			CASE WHEN xPeriod < 999 THEN @PeriodCol + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0'), 2) ELSE @Total END AS xColumnName, sysorder, sysprint, systotal,
			CASE WHEN stt_in <> '' THEN stt_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS stt_in, chi_tieu, ma_so,
			CASE WHEN ma_so_in <> '' THEN ma_so_in ELSE CHAR(9) END AS ma_so_in, bold, gt_th, gt_th_nt, gt_kh, gt_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
		FROM #result a ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrhtcdk]
AS
SELECT  a.*, e.ma_nv, e.ho_nv, e.ten_nv, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten, e.bo_phan AS ma_bp, e.bp_ref, b.ten_tcbh, b.ten_tcbh2
	FROM hrhtcdk a LEFT JOIN hrdmtcbh b ON a.ma_tc = b.ma_tcbh JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAgeStatisticsDeptPos]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@MinAge INT,
	@Gap INT,
	@Periods INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptLevel INT,
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Permanent, 2 - Probationary, * - All
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @sub NVARCHAR(128), @other NVARCHAR(128), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @i INT, @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @sub = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total2'
	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + '''', @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = '', @other = '-'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #ctqtlvdk(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), tuoi NUMERIC(20, 9))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @Level <> ' 'SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	SELECT @Where = ' and r.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c')

	SELECT @EmployeeCondition = ''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Count
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, '1' AS tinh_chat, ngay_tu INTO #d FROM hreqtlvht
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #d select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, ''1'' as tinh_chat, max(r.ngay_tu) as ngay_tu from hreqtlvht r join hrnv e on r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ' and (e.ngay_nghi is null or e.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ')' + REPLACE(@EmployeeCondition, 'a.', 'e.')
	IF @EmpType = '1' SELECT @q = @q + ' and e.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d1
	IF @EmpType = '2' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (e.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or e.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL	

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_sinh, ' + @d1 + ') from #d r left join hrnv a on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec ' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Join = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c')

	-- Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Year(a.ngay_sinh, ' + @d1 + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a ' + @Join + ' where ((a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ') and a.ngay_vao <= ' + @d1 + ' and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE @EmpType WHEN '1' THEN ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d1 + ')' WHEN '2' THEN ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ')' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, '#ctqtlvdk', 'bo_phan'
		
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Report
	UPDATE #ctqtlvdk SET vi_tri = '' WHERE vi_tri IS NULL

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(5 AS INT) AS sysorder, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_vtr, 
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot1, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot2, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot3, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot4
		INTO #report FROM #ctqtlvdk a, hrbp b
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select cast(5 as int) as sysorder, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, max(isnull(cast(c.stt as int), 999998)) + 1 as stt_vtr,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(case when a.tuoi < ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot1,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(case when a.tuoi >= ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' and a.tuoi < ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(case when a.tuoi >= ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.tuoi < ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot3,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(case when a.tuoi >= ' + LTRIM(@MinAge) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot4'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #ctqtlvdk a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
		
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, bo_phan, '', bp_me, bac_bp, 0, SUM(cot1), SUM(cot2), SUM(cot3), SUM(cot4) FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp

	-- Total
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, SUM(cot1), SUM(cot2), SUM(cot3), SUM(cot4) FROM #report WHERE stt_vtr = 0
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	END

	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, b.ma_bp, '''', b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and stt_vtr = 0 and b.ma_bp not in (select bo_phan from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET cot1 = a.cot1 + b.cot1, cot2 = a.cot2 + b.cot2, cot3 = a.cot3 + b.cot3, cot4  = a.cot4 + b.cot4
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT bp_me, SUM(cot1) AS cot1, SUM(cot2) AS cot2, SUM(cot3) AS cot3, SUM(cot4) AS cot4
						FROM #report
						WHERE bac_bp = @step AND stt_vtr = 0
						GROUP BY bp_me
				) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me
			WHERE a.stt_vtr = 0
		--
		IF @DeptLevel <> 0 AND @step > @DeptLevel BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, b.ma_bp, r.vi_tri, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, stt_vtr, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and stt_vtr <> 0 and b.ma_bp + r.vi_tri not in (select bo_phan + vi_tri from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #report SET cot1 = a.cot1 + b.cot1, cot2 = a.cot2 + b.cot2, cot3 = a.cot3 + b.cot3, cot4  = a.cot4 + b.cot4
				FROM #report a JOIN (
						SELECT bp_me, vi_tri, SUM(cot1) AS cot1, SUM(cot2) AS cot2, SUM(cot3) AS cot3, SUM(cot4) AS cot4
							FROM #report
							WHERE bac_bp = @step AND stt_vtr <> 0
							GROUP BY bp_me, vi_tri
					) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me AND a.vi_tri = b.vi_tri
				WHERE a.stt_vtr <> 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	---
	IF @DeptLevel <> 0 DELETE #report WHERE bac_bp > @DeptLevel	

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)	
		
	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as sysprint, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as systotal, case when stt_vtr = 0 then 0 else 1 end as repeat, case when a.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(@step) + ' and stt_vtr = 0 then 1 else 0 end as systotal_excel'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.bo_phan, a.bac_bp, a.vi_tri, a.cot1, a.cot2, a.cot3, a.cot4, (a.cot1 + a.cot2 + a.cot3 + a.cot4) as cot5,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when sysorder = 1 then '''' else case when a.bo_phan = '''' then N''' + @total + ''' else space(2*(a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' end end as ten_bp,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when sysorder = 0 or sysorder = 1 then '''' else case when a.stt_vtr = 0 then N''' + @sub + ''' else space(2) + case when a.stt_vtr = 999999 then N''' + @other + ''' else ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vtr' ELSE 'c.ten_vtr2' END + ' end end end as ten_vtr'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr order by a.sysorder, b.stt_ref, a.stt_vtr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpProbationPeriodByDept]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@MinYear INT,
	@Gap INT,
	@Periods INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptLevel INT,
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @sub NVARCHAR(128), @other NVARCHAR(128), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @i INT, @c1 VARCHAR(128), @c2 VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @sub = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total2'
	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + '''', @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = '', @EmployeeCondition = '', @other = '-'

	SELECT @c1 = CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Different$Month(' ELSE 'round(cast(datediff(day, ' END, @c2 = CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN ')' ELSE ') as real)/7, 2)' END

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #ctqtlvdk(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), tham_nien NUMERIC(20, 9))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key
		
	IF @Level <> ' 'SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a5.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a5.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	SELECT @Where = ' and r.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c'), '%a5', 'a')

	-- Count
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	
	SELECT TOP 0 r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, '1' AS tinh_chat, r.ngay_tu INTO #d FROM hreqtlvht r 
	SET @q = 'insert into #d select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, ''1'', max(r.ngay_tu) from hreqtlvht r join hrnv a ON r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ' and (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ')' + @EmployeeCondition
	SET @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	-- Probationary
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, ' + @c1 + 'a.ngay_vao, ' + @d1 + @c2 + ' from #d r left join hrnv a on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec ' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d1 + ') and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Join = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	
	IF (@EmployeeCondition <> '') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + SUBSTRING(@EmployeeCondition, 6, LEN(@EmployeeCondition))
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c'), '%a5', 'a')

	-- Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, ' + @c1 + 'a.ngay_vao, ' + @d1 + @c2
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrnv a ' + @Join + ' where ((a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi > ' + @d1 + ') and a.ngay_vao <= ' + @d1 + ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d1 + ') and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, '#ctqtlvdk', 'bo_phan'
		
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Report
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(5 AS INT) AS sysorder, a.bo_phan, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot1, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot2, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot3, CAST(0 AS INT) AS cot4
		INTO #report FROM #ctqtlvdk a, hrbp b
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select cast(5 as int) as sysorder, a.bo_phan, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot1,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' and a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot2,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' and a.tham_nien < ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot3,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' sum(case when a.tham_nien >= ' + LTRIM(@MinYear) + ' + 2 * ' + LTRIM(@Gap) + ' then 1 else 0 end) as cot4'
	SET @q = @q  + ' from #ctqtlvdk a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' group by a.bo_phan'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
		
	-- Total
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', 0, SUM(cot1), SUM(cot2), SUM(cot3), SUM(cot4) FROM #report
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	END

	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, b.ma_bp, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and b.ma_bp not in (select bo_phan from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET cot1 = a.cot1 + b.cot1, cot2 = a.cot2 + b.cot2, cot3 = a.cot3 + b.cot3, cot4  = a.cot4 + b.cot4
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT bp_me, SUM(cot1) AS cot1, SUM(cot2) AS cot2, SUM(cot3) AS cot3, SUM(cot4) AS cot4
						FROM #report
						WHERE bac_bp = @step
						GROUP BY bp_me
				) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me
		--
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	---
	IF @DeptLevel <> 0 DELETE #report WHERE bac_bp > @DeptLevel

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)	
			
	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, b.stt_ref, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as sysprint, case when a.bo_phan = '''' then 0 else 1 end as systotal, case when a.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(@step) + ' then 1 else 0 end as systotal_excel'
	SET @q = @q  + ', a.bo_phan, a.bac_bp, a.cot1, a.cot2, a.cot3, a.cot4, (a.cot1 + a.cot2 + a.cot3 + a.cot4) as cot5,'
	SET @q = @q  + ' case when sysorder = 1 then '''' else case when a.bo_phan = '''' then N''' + @total + ''' else space(2*(a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' end end as ten_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q  + ' order by a.sysorder, b.stt_ref'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAllocationByOtherCostFactor] -- fs20_Copbcpytcp
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(a.ma_yt)) in (''' + REPLACE(@CE, ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
	IF @costUnit = 1 BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp , a.so_lsx AS so_lsx, a.ma_sp AS ma_sp, a.ma_yt AS ma_yt,
			a.he_so AS he_so, a.sl_tk AS sl_tk, a.ps_tk AS ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt AS ps_tk_nt,
			b.hs_yt AS hs_yt, gt_ps AS gt_ps, a.ma_bp0 AS ma_bp0
		INTO #report FROM xctpbtg a, xdmyt b

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_bp , so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_yt, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, hs_yt, gt_ps, ma_bp0)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_yt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(a.he_so), sum(a.sl_tk), sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt), max(b.hs_yt), max(gt_ps), max(a.ma_bp0)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctpbtg a with(nolock) left join xdmyt b with(nolock) on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '')

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_sp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_sp2 
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_POAuthorize]
	(
		@UserID INT,
		@Dept VARCHAR(32),
		@FC VARCHAR(32),
		@Amount NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@Status VARCHAR(32),
		@Category VARCHAR(32),
		@currentDate SMALLDATETIME
	)
RETURNS TINYINT AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRet TINYINT, @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @nRet = 0, @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @currentDate, 121)
	IF EXISTS
		(
			SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM dmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a
				JOIN dmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen
				JOIN dmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
					WHERE a.loai_duyet = '01220' AND a.user_id = @UserID AND a.status = 1 AND (a.ma_nt = '' OR a.ma_nt = @FC)
						AND (a.tien_nt = 0 OR a.tien_nt >= @Amount)
						AND b.status = '1'
						AND c.status = @Status
						AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category
		)
	SELECT @nRet = 1
	RETURN @nRet
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PT]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_pn INTO #afterUpdate FROM d97$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_pn <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_pn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec

	-- Update
	DECLARE @cRCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineRCIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_pn VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, dyn_pn FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @cLineRCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET sl_kt = sl_kt + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s	

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @cLineRCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 	

	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, MAX(dyn_pn) AS dyn_pn FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_pn
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @dyn_pn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET xstatus = CASE WHEN sl_kt >= so_luong THEN ''2'' ELSE ''1'' END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND qc_yn = 1'
		SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @dyn_pn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdvtdd0x]
AS
SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dk, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, 
           a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, 
           b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_vt AS ten_sp, c.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, d.ten_yt, d.ten_yt2
FROM dbo.xcdvtdd0 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
           dbo.dmvt AS b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
           dbo.dmvt AS c ON a.ma_sp = c.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
           dbo.xdmyt AS d ON a.ma_yt = d.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[uCt] ON [dbo].[cttt20] 
FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @b VARBINARY(128)
	SELECT @b = 0x10
	IF @b = (SELECT CONTEXT_INFO FROM master..sysprocesses WHERE spid = @@spid) RETURN

	-- Trong truong hop la phieu thu
	UPDATE cttt20 SET t_tt_qd = t.t_tt_qd - d.tt_qd, t_tt_nt1 = t.t_tt_nt1 - d.tt_nt, t_tt1 = t.t_tt1 - d.tt, tat_toan = 0, ngay_tt = NULL
		FROM cttt20 t JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS tt_qd, SUM(tt_nt) AS tt_nt, SUM(tt) AS tt FROM Deleted WHERE loai_tt = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_tt) d ON t.stt_rec = d.stt_rec_tt


	UPDATE cttt20 SET t_tt_qd = t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd, t_tt_nt1 = t.t_tt_nt1 + i.tt_nt, t_tt1 = t.t_tt1 + i.tt
			, tat_toan = CASE WHEN (t.ma_nt = '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt0) OR (t.ma_nt <> '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt_nt0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
			, ngay_tt = CASE WHEN (t.ma_nt = '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt0) OR (t.ma_nt <> '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt_nt0) THEN NULL ELSE i.ngay_ct END
		FROM cttt20 t JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_tt, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, SUM(tt_qd) AS tt_qd, SUM(tt_nt) AS tt_nt, SUM(tt) AS tt FROM Inserted WHERE loai_tt = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_tt) i ON t.stt_rec = i.stt_rec_tt
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableNameInventory] @VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), @MTable VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT, @CTable VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @m VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @m = CASE
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXA' THEN '%m84$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXB' THEN '%m85$%Partition'
		ELSE 'pxdc'
	END
	SELECT @CTable = REPLACE(REPLACE(@m, '%Partition', '000000'), '%m', 'c')
	SELECT @MTable = REPLACE(@m, '%m', 'm')

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetInspectionFilter]
	@InspectionOrg VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@Key VARCHAR(32),
	@Field VARCHAR(32),
	@Column VARCHAR(32),
	@Reference VARCHAR(32),
	@Return VARCHAR(1024) OUTPUT,
	@Force INT = 0,
	@External VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN

	SELECT @Return = ''
	IF @InspectionOrg = '' BEGIN
		-- Admin
		IF @Admin = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 1)'
			RETURN
		END
		-- Full access rights
		IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bikddmnguon)= (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bisysinspectionrights a JOIN bikddmnguon b ON a.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon WHERE a.user_id = @UserID AND a.r_access = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 1)'
			RETURN
		END
		-- No access rights
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisysinspectionrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF @Force <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = CASE WHEN @InspectionOrg = '' THEN @Field + ' in (select ma_nguon from bisysinspectionrights where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and r_access = 1)' ELSE '(' + @Field + ' = ''' + REPLACE(@InspectionOrg, '''', '') + ''')' END
		IF @Force = 2 SELECT @Return = '(' + @Field + ' = '''' or (' + @Return + '))'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Declare
	CREATE TABLE #t(n INT, c VARCHAR(128), g INT)
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(256), @c2 VARCHAR(256), @m INT, @n INT, @max INT, @i INT, @l INT, @q1 VARCHAR(1), @q2 VARCHAR(1), @u INT, @v INT, @g INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Set
	SELECT @n = 36, @max = 3
	IF @InspectionOrg <> '' BEGIN
		EXECUTE sp_executesql N'select @1 = id from bikddmnguon where ma_nguon = @2', N'@1 int output, @2 varchar(32)', @i OUTPUT, @InspectionOrg
		IF @i IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
			RETURN
		END
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT @i, dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(@i), @i / @n
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select b.id, dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(b.id), b.id / @1 from bisysinspectionrights a join bikddmnguon b on a.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon where a.user_id = @2 and a.r_access = 1 order by b.id'
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q, N'@1 int, @2 int', @n, @UserID
		IF @Key <> '' AND (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g FROM #t) a) > @max BEGIN
			IF @External = '' SELECT @External = @Key
			SELECT @Return = '(' + @Column + ' = '''' or exists(select 1 from ' + @Reference + ' u where u.' + @Key + ' = ' + @Table + '.' + @External + ' and exists(select 1 from bisysinspectionrights r where r.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and r.r_access = 1 and r.' + @Field + ' = u.' + @Field + ')))'
			RETURN
		END
	END
	--
	SELECT @n = -1, @u = -1, @v = 0

	SELECT @i = MIN(n) FROM #t
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @g = g FROM #t WHERE n = @i
		IF @i - 1 = @n AND @g = @u SELECT @v = @v + 1
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF @v > 2 BEGIN
				DELETE #t WHERE n BETWEEN @m + 1 AND @n - 2
				UPDATE #t SET c = LEFT(c, LEN(c) - 1) + '-' WHERE n = @n - 1
			END
			SELECT @m = @i, @v = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @n = @i, @u = @g
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(n) FROM #t WHERE n > @i
	END
	IF @v > 2 BEGIN
		DELETE #t WHERE n BETWEEN @m + 1 AND @n - 2
		UPDATE #t SET c = LEFT(c, LEN(c) - 1) + '-' WHERE n = @n - 1
	END
	--
	SELECT @i = MIN(g) FROM #t
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c1 = MIN(c), @c2 = MAX(c) FROM #t WHERE g = @i
		SELECT @q1 = CASE WHEN @c1 = @c2 THEN '' ELSE '[' END, @q2 = CASE WHEN @c1 = @c2 THEN '' ELSE ']' END,
			@l = LEN(@c1), @c1 = CASE WHEN @l = 1 THEN '' ELSE LEFT(@c1, @l - 1) END + @q1
		SELECT @c1 = @c1 + RIGHT(c, 1) FROM #t WHERE g = @i ORDER BY n
		SELECT @c1 = @Column + ' like ''%#' + @c1 + @q2 + '#%'''
		--
		SELECT @Return = @Return + CASE WHEN @Return = '' THEN '' ELSE ' or ' END + '(' + @c1 + ')'
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(g) FROM #t WHERE g > @i
	END
	SELECT @Return = CASE WHEN @Return = '' THEN '(1 = 0)' ELSE '((' + @Column + ' = '''') or (' + @Return + '))' END

	IF @Key = '' AND LEN(@Return) = 1024 SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSFCMachinesStatistics]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@invoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@invoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@shift VARCHAR(32),
	@shop VARCHAR(32),
	@wo VARCHAR(32),
	@operation VARCHAR(32),
	@transaction VARCHAR(32),
	@size TINYINT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Unit VARCHAR(1023)

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'loai_ct in (''01'', ''02'', ''04'', ''06'', ''10'')', @Unit = ''
	IF @invoiceFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@invoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @invoiceTo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@invoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @shift <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_ca like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@shift), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @shop <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_px like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@shop), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @wo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_lsx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@wo), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @operation <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_cd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@operation), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @transaction <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and ma_gd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@transaction), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @key = @key + ' and isnull(ma_may, '''') <> '''''

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @userID, @admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt0, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_may, gio_bd, gio_kt, so_gio INTO #t FROM sfctmay$000000

	SET @q = ' insert into #t(ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_may, gio_bd, gio_kt, so_gio)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_may, gio_bd, gio_kt, so_gio'
	SET @q = @q + ' from sfctmay$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']% order by ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_may'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @userID, @admin
	--
	UPDATE #t SET stt = stt0
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t)
		INSERT INTO #t (stt, ma_gd, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ca, ma_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_may, gio_bd, gio_kt, so_gio)
			SELECT NULL, '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', 0
	--
	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, d.ten_gd%l as ten_gd'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.*, b.ten_may%l as ten_may'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a left join sfdmmay b on a.ma_may = b.ma_may'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmmagd d on a.ma_gd = d.ma_gd and d.type = ''S'''
	SET @q = @q + ' and ((d.ma_ct = ''SF1'' and d.loai_ct in (''02'', ''04''))'
	SET @q = @q + ' or (d.ma_ct = ''SF6'' and d.loai_ct in (''01'', ''06'', ''10'')))'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.stt'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalMailList]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@partition VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherType CHAR(32),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@lastUser INT = 0,
	@isChange BIT = 0,
	@createdUser INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(32), @Amount NUMERIC(19, 2), @CurStatus VARCHAR(32), @p INT, @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @mailUser INT, @datetime2 DATETIME, @unit VARCHAR(32)
	, @Category VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @d SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #m(id int IDENTITY(1,1), stt_rec CHAR(13), user_id INT, type INT, parallel_yn BIT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32), deny_mail_yn BIT)
	CREATE TABLE #tmp(u_status VARCHAR(32), datetime2 DATETIME, ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #ds(user_id INT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #parallel(user_id INT NULL)

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)
	SELECT @masterTable = m$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @hisTable = a$ FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ds select user_id4 from ' + @hisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select u_status, datetime2, ma_dvcs, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @CurStatus = u_status, @datetime2 = datetime2, @unit = ma_dvcs, @Category = kieu_duyet FROM #tmp


	-- Unit rights
	SELECT id INTO #user FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE status = 1 AND (admin = 1 OR (admin = 0 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sysunitrights WHERE ma_dvcs = @unit AND r_edit = 1)))

	--Device
	INSERT INTO #m SELECT @idNumber, a.user_id, '2', c.parallel_yn, c.kieu_duyet, c.deny_mail_yn FROM (SELECT * FROM sodmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN sodmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN sodmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
		WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND a.status = 1
			AND c.status = @CurStatus
			AND a.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #ds)
			AND a.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM #user)
			AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE ma_phan_he = 'SM' AND name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @voucherCode CHAR(3)
		SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType
		SET @q = 'exec ds_CreateVoucherPending @voucherCode, @idNumber, ''#m'', ''user_id'', @sysDatabaseName'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @voucherCode, @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName
	END

	-- Approval mail (with link)
	DELETE #m WHERE deny_mail_yn = 1

	-- Notification mail (without link)
	IF @lastUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @lastUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @lastUser, '1'
	END

	-- Mail Created User (without link)
	IF @createdUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @createdUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @createdUser, '1'
	END

	--
	IF @isChange = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #parallel SELECT a.user_id FROM #m a JOIN dmxn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE a.parallel_yn = 1
		DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END


	-- Delete valid mail/sms
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_nhan INTO #xn FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
		INSERT INTO #xn SELECT ma_huy FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)

		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from #xn)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END

	-- Delete dmxn, dbxn
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$DeleteLog @sysDatabaseName

	-- Create new mail/sms
	SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @mailUser = user_id FROM #m WHERE id = @p
		SELECT @c1 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6)), @c2 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6))
		INSERT INTO dmxn(stt_rec, user_id, ma_nhan, ma_huy, datetime2) SELECT @idNumber, @mailUser, @c1, @c2, @datetime2
		SET @q = 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c1 + ''', ''1'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c2 + ''', ''0'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m WHERE id > @p
	END


	-- Update datetime2 for valid old mail/sms
	UPDATE dmxn SET datetime2 = @datetime2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)


	SELECT id, stt_rec, user_id, type FROM #m


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
