CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetOrderString(
	@strGroup AS VARCHAR(254),
	@strOrder AS VARCHAR(254))
RETURNS VARCHAR(254) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @i AS INT, @j AS INTEGER
	DECLARE @strOrderTmp AS VARCHAR(254), @wordOrder AS VARCHAR(254), @wordGroup AS VARCHAR(254), @sResult AS VARCHAR(254)
	DECLARE @strGroupTmp AS VARCHAR(254)
	SET @strOrdertmp = REPLACE(UPPER(@strOrder), 'DESC', '')
	SELECT @sResult = '', @i = 0

	WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strGroup)
	BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SET @wordGroup = UPPER(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strGroup, @i))
		SET @j = 0
		SET @strGroupTmp = ''
		WHILE @j < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strOrderTmp)
		BEGIN
			SET @j = @j + 1
			SET @wordOrder = UPPER(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strOrderTmp, @j))
			IF @wordOrder = @wordGroup
				SET @strGroupTmp = dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strOrder, @j)
		END
		IF @strGroupTmp <> ''
			SET @sResult = @sResult +  @strGroupTmp + ','
		ELSE
			SET @sResult = @sResult + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strGroup, @i) + ',' 
	END
	SET @sResult = LEFT(@sResult, LEN(@sResult) - 1)

	SET @j = 0
	WHILE @j < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strOrder)
	BEGIN
		SET @j = @j + 1
		SET @wordOrder = UPPER(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strOrder, @j))
		if dbo.ff_exactinlist(UPPER(@wordOrder),UPPER(@sResult)) <> 1
			SET @sResult = @sResult + ',' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strOrder, @j)
	END
	RETURN @sResult
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetNetForwardDate (@d SMALLDATETIME, @nDay INT)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nNonWorkingDays INT
	SELECT @dFrom = @d, @dTo = DATEADD(day, @nDay, @d)
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @nNonWorkingDays = COUNT(*) FROM mdmlichlv WHERE (ngay_nghi  BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
		SELECT @dFrom = @dTo +1
		SELECT @dTo = @dTo + @nNonWorkingDays
	END
	RETURN @dTo
END
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey](@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), @UserID INT, @Admin BIT)
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @SiteKey VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @SiteKey = ''

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND xin_site_rights = 1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @SiteKey = @SiteKey + '$' + RTRIM(b.id) + '$%' FROM syssiterights a JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho WHERE a.user_id = @UserID ORDER BY b.id
			SELECT @SiteKey = '''#00#' + @SiteKey + ''' like e$'
		END
	END

	RETURN @SiteKey
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEInvoiceUnauthorized]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension CHAR(1) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @table VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @table = CASE
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN 'm81$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD1' THEN 'm21$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXC' THEN 'm86$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD2' THEN 'm22$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD5' THEN 'hddc'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD6' THEN 'm42$000000'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD3' THEN 'm23$%Partition'
		WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN 'm76$%Partition'
		ELSE 'm25$%Partition'
	END

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kh, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, t_tt_nt AS t_km_nt INTO #result FROM m81$000000

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''' and b.stt_rec is null'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_nt' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HDF') THEN CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN ', a.t_km_nt' ELSE ', a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt' END ELSE ', 0' END
	IF @VoucherCode IN('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') BEGIN
		DECLARE @p VARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #ei FROM hddt00$000000
		SELECT @p ='insert into #ei select stt_rec from hddt00$%Partition a where %[ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @p = @p + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		SELECT @p = @p + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @p, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) left join #ei b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) left join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	END

	IF @Extension = '0' SELECT @q = @q + ' join khhddt c with(nolock) on c.ma_kh = a.ma_kh'

	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, a.ma_kh, tien_nt + t_km_nt AS tien_nt, ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		FROM #result a JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTSIssue]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@TSType VARCHAR(33), 
	@TSCode VARCHAR(33), 
	@Employee VARCHAR(33), 
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),	
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_cc, a.ngay_hh, a.so_luong
			, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, b.bo_phan, b.vi_tri, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
		INTO #report FROM hrccctcp a, hrnv b

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' r.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @TSType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.ma_loai like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TSCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.ma_cc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TSCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @TSType <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrcc c on r.ma_cc = c.ma_cc' 

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report(stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec_nv, ma_cc, ngay_hh, so_luong, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, bo_phan, vi_tri, stt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.stt_rec, r.ngay_ct, r.so_ct, r.stt_rec_nv, r.ma_cc, r.ngay_hh, r.so_luong, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(a.ten_nv), a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrccctcp r with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec_nv = a.stt_rec' + @Join 
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_nv, r.ma_cc, r.ngay_ct, r.so_ct, r.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #stt(stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1), sysorder INT)
	INSERT INTO #stt(sysorder) SELECT MIN(sysorder) FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec_nv ORDER BY MIN(sysorder)
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #stt b ON a.sysorder = b.sysorder

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, '' AS ma_nv, '' AS ho_ten_nv, '' AS bo_phan, '' AS vi_tri, '' AS cong_cu, 0 AS so_luong, NULL AS ngay_cap, NULL AS ngay_hh		
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = ' select 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, a.stt, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, b.ten_bp%l as bo_phan, c.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri'
		SELECT @q = @q + ', ten_cc%l as cong_cu, a.so_luong, a.ngay_ct as ngay_cap, a.ngay_hh'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'	
		SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt c with(nolock) on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr left join hrcc v with(nolock) on a.ma_cc = v.ma_cc'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.sysorder'
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeCancelTicket]
	@TableName VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension NVARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @VoucherID VARCHAR(32), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @voucherNo VARCHAR(32), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @provider INT
	SELECT @code = '', @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', ''), @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', '')

	-- Check idNumber access

	SET @q = N'select top 1 @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @VoucherID = [key] from ' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + ' order by ngay_ct asc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherDate smalldatetime output, @VoucherID varchar(32) output', @voucherDate OUTPUT, @VoucherID OUTPUT

	-- Thông tin bảng lưu vé
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm81$' + @p FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1
	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Lock Date
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, @UserID, @Unit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @n INT
	SELECT @q = N'select @n = count(1) from (select convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) as p from ' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + ' group by convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112)) a'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@n int output', @n OUTPUT
	IF @n > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Modify
	SELECT @q = N'select top 1 @code = a.so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@code varchar(32) output', @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Gán vé trạng thái chờ HỦY
	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 8, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCashInBank] --fs_AcountsBalanceInquiry--
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @s NVARCHAR(511)

	SET @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateTo)
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct 
	SELECT TOP 0 a.tk, a.ps_no AS du_no, a.ps_co AS du_co, a.ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl a 

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateTo, @Unit, @Account, 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', 'b.tk_cn = ''1'''

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'tk in (select tk from dmtk where tk_cn = 0 and loai_tk = 1)'	
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select tk, sum(ps_no) as du_no, sum(ps_co)as du_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as du_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) as du_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[status = ''1'' and ' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, ngay_ct, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select tk, sum(du_no00), sum(du_co00), sum(du_no_nt00), sum(du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdtk with(nolock, index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@DateTo)) + ' and ' + @Key 
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk'
	EXEC  sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.tk, MAX(b.loai_tk) AS loai_tk, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt
		INTO #AcountsBalance FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk GROUP BY a.tk
	
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE loai_tk = 0
	DECLARE @Tk VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @Du_no AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_no_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_co AS NUMERIC(28, 6), @Du_co_nt AS NUMERIC(28, 6)
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #AcountsBalance WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%')
			INSERT INTO #AcountsBalance (tk, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt)
				SELECT @Tk, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #AcountsBalance WHERE tk LIKE RTRIM(@Tk) + '%' AND loai_tk = 1
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Tk
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, b.loai_tk AS systotal, a.*
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END AS ten_tk, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END AS ten_tk2
		INTO #report FROM #AcountsBalance a LEFT JOIN dmtk b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmtk)) ON a.tk = b.tk

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, Tk, Du_no, Du_no_nt, Du_co, Du_co_nt) 
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, '', SUM(du_no), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_co_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2) VALUES (1, 0, 0, '', '', '')
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2) VALUES (1, 1, 0, '', '', '')

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2, du_no - du_co AS du, du_no_nt - du_co_nt AS du_nt FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, tk

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpSalaryChanges]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15), @c1 NVARCHAR(128), @c2 NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'
	SELECT @c1 = N'I. ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'STLUONG'
	SELECT @c2 = N'II. ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'SGLUONG'

	-- Struct	
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_bd SMALLDATETIME, tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_bd0 SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END
	
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.ngay_bd >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.ngay_bd <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	-- @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #report(stt_rec, tien, ngay_bd, tien0, ngay_bd0) select r.stt_rec, r.luong_co_ban, r.ngay_bd, 0, null'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hreqtlkdht r with(nolock)  join hrnv a with(nolock)  on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by r.stt_rec, r.ngay_bd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Prev
	UPDATE #report SET tien0 = b.tien, ngay_bd0 = b.ngay_bd FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, tien, ngay_bd, stt + 1 AS stt FROM #report) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(ngay_bd) AS ngay_bd INTO #t FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ngay_bd) AS ngay_bd INTO #prev FROM hreqtlkdht a JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_nt = @Currency AND a.ngay_bd < b.ngay_bd GROUP BY a.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET tien0 = d.luong_co_ban, ngay_bd0 = d.ngay_bd FROM #report r JOIN #t a ON r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND r.ngay_bd = a.ngay_bd
		JOIN #prev c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec JOIN hreqtlkdht d ON c.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND c.ngay_bd = d.ngay_bd

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #result(loai CHAR(1), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32),  tien NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_bd SMALLDATETIME, tien0 NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay_bd0 SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #result (loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, tien, ngay_bd, tien0, ngay_bd0)
		SELECT loai, stt_rec, ma_nv, tien, ngay_bd, tien0, ngay_bd0 FROM (
			SELECT CASE WHEN a.tien > a.tien0 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS loai, a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv,a. tien, a.ngay_bd, a.tien0, a.ngay_bd0
				FROM #report a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			UNION ALL SELECT '1', '', '', 0, NULL, 0, NULL
			UNION ALL SELECT '2', '', '', 0, NULL, 0, NULL
		) a ORDER BY a.loai, a.ma_nv

	SELECT stt, loai INTO #order FROM #result WHERE ma_nv = ''

	SELECT 0 AS sysorder, CASE WHEN a.ma_nv = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt - o.stt AS stt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, 
			CASE WHEN a.ma_nv = '' THEN CASE WHEN a.loai = '1' THEN @c1 ELSE @c2 END ELSE RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + ' ' + RTRIM(e.ten_nv) END AS ho_ten_nv, 
			a.ngay_bd0 AS ngay_bd_lc, a.tien0 AS muc_luong_cu, a.ngay_bd AS ngay_bd_lm, tien AS muc_luong_moi, e.bo_phan, a.loai AS loai_td, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vtr ELSE c.ten_vtr2 END AS vi_tri, 
			CASE WHEN e.gioi_tinh IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN e.gioi_tinh = '1' THEN @Male ELSE @Female END END AS gioi_tinh
		FROM #result a JOIN #order o ON a.loai = o.loai LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON e.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
		ORDER BY a.loai, a.ma_nv

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_PRAuthorize]
	(
		@UserID INT,
		@Dept VARCHAR(32),
		@FC VARCHAR(32),
		@Amount NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@Status VARCHAR(32),
		@Category VARCHAR(32),
		@currentDate SMALLDATETIME
	)
RETURNS TINYINT AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRet TINYINT, @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @nRet = 0, @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @currentDate, 121)
	IF EXISTS
		(
			SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM dmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a
				JOIN dmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen
				JOIN dmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
					WHERE a.loai_duyet = '01205' AND a.user_id = @UserID AND a.status = 1 AND (a.ma_nt = '' OR a.ma_nt = @FC)
						AND (a.ma_bp = '' OR a.ma_bp = @Dept) AND (a.tien_nt = 0 OR a.tien_nt >= @Amount)
						AND b.status = '1'
						AND c.status = @Status
						AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category
		)
	SELECT @nRet = 1
	RETURN @nRet
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$S1]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @rq TINYINT
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec AS stt_rec_yc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_lsx, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_cd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_vt
		, t_so_luong INTO #afterUpdate FROM ms1$000000

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

	SELECT @s = '
insert into #afterUpdate
	select a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec, rtrim(year(b.ngay_ct)) + replace(str(month(b.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) + replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, b.ma_sp, 0
		from ' + @MasterTable + ' a left join cs2$000000 b on a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
			where a.stt_rec = @IDNumber
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32)', @IDNumber

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	DECLARE @cS2IDNumber CHAR(13), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @wo VARCHAR(64), @operation VARCHAR(64), @itemCode VARCHAR(64), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @dyn_px = dyn_px FROM #afterUpdate
	IF @dyn_px <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @s = '
update a
	set t_so_luong = isnull(b.t_so_luong, 0)
from #afterUpdate a
	left join (
			select stt_rec, ma_vt, sum(sl_nhap) as t_so_luong from sfctpx$' + @dyn_px + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and nxt = ''1'' and ma_ct = ''SF1'' group by stt_rec, ma_vt
				) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32)', @IDNumber
	END

	-- Update
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, dyn_yc, dyn_px, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, t_so_luong FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS2IDNumber, @dyn_yc, @dyn_px, @wo, @operation, @itemCode, @nQty
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cS2IDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' AND @dyn_px <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @nQty = ISNULL(@nQty, 0)
			IF @nQty <> 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @s = 'update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set sl_th = sl_th + @nQty where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @nQty numeric(28, 6)', @cS2IDNumber, @nQty

				SELECT @s = '
if exists (
		select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + '
			where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th >= sl_yc
				and exists (select 1 from sfctpx$' + @dyn_px + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and ma_lsx = @wo and ma_vt = @itemCode)
	)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''4'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
else
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''3'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32), @cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @wo varchar(32), @itemCode varchar(32), @UserID int', @IDNumber, @cS2IDNumber, @wo, @itemCode, @UserID
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @s = '
if exists (select 1 from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')
if exists (select 1 from sfctpx$' + @dyn_px + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and ma_lsx = @wo)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''3'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32), @cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @wo varchar(32), @UserID int', @IDNumber, @cS2IDNumber, @wo, @UserID
			END

			SELECT @s = '
declare @S2Status char(1)
select @S2Status = status from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
update cs2$000000 set status = @S2Status where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
update is2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = @S2Status where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @UserID int', @cS2IDNumber, @UserID
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS2IDNumber, @dyn_yc, @dyn_px, @wo, @operation, @itemCode, @nQty
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdytddx]
AS
SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.ps_tk0, a.ps_tk_nt0, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.ps_tk2, a.ps_tk_nt2, a.dd_ck, 
	a.dd_ck_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, 
	a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_yt, c.ten_yt2
FROM	dbo.xcdytdd AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.vdmsp AS b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.xdmyt AS c ON a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
WHERE (a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dbo.dmstt)) AND (a.ky = 0)


GO

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[uSt] ON [dbo].[cttt30] 
FOR INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @b VARBINARY(128)
	SELECT @b = 0x10
	IF @b = (SELECT CONTEXT_INFO FROM master..sysprocesses WHERE spid = @@spid) RETURN

	UPDATE cttt30 SET t_tt_qd = t.t_tt_qd - d.tt_qd, t_tt_nt1 = t.t_tt_nt1 - d.tt_nt, t_tt1 = t.t_tt1 - d.tt, tat_toan = 0, ngay_tt = NULL
		FROM cttt30 t JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS tt_qd, SUM(tt_nt) AS tt_nt, SUM(tt) AS tt FROM Deleted WHERE loai_tt = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_tt) d ON t.stt_rec = d.stt_rec_tt


	UPDATE cttt30 SET t_tt_qd = t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd, t_tt_nt1 = t.t_tt_nt1 + i.tt_nt, t_tt1 = t.t_tt1 + i.tt
			, tat_toan = CASE WHEN (t.ma_nt = '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt0) OR (t.ma_nt <> '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt_nt0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
			, ngay_tt = CASE WHEN (t.ma_nt = '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt0) OR (t.ma_nt <> '' AND t.t_tt_qd + i.tt_qd < t.t_tt_nt0) THEN NULL ELSE i.ngay_ct END
		FROM cttt30 t JOIN (SELECT stt_rec_tt,MAX( ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, SUM(tt_qd) AS tt_qd, SUM(tt_nt) AS tt_nt, SUM(tt) AS tt FROM Inserted WHERE loai_tt = 1 GROUP BY stt_rec_tt) i ON t.stt_rec = i.stt_rec_tt
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetInvoiceInventory]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TableName VARCHAR(128) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @provider INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT @provider = dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt WHERE ma_kn = @Account
	IF @provider <> 8 AND @VoucherID = '' BEGIN
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS p INTO #$stt_rec
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + RTRIM(@TableName)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #$stt_rec select stt_rec, '''' from ' + RTRIM(@TableName)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE INSERT INTO #$stt_rec SELECT @VoucherID, ''


	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'stt_rec', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 RETURN

	IF @provider = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherID AS [key]
		RETURN
	END


	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @p VARCHAR(6), @date DATETIME, @m VARCHAR(64), @refTable CHAR(3), @taxCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' SELECT TOP 1 @refTable = '84$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(a.ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c84$000000 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$stt_rec b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' SELECT TOP 1 @refTable = '85$', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(a.ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM c85$000000 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$stt_rec b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' SELECT TOP 1 @refTable = '', @p = RTRIM(YEAR(a.ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(a.ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM pxdc a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$stt_rec b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)

	SELECT @m = 'm' + @refTable + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PX5' SELECT @m = 'pxdc'

	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @refTable = '' THEN @m ElSE 'c' + @refTable + '000000' END
		SELECT @q = 'update a set p = convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from #$stt_rec a join ' + @c + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.so_bi_mat, b.ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS ky INTO #$invoice FROM hddt01$000000 a, hddt00$000000 b
		SELECT DISTINCT p INTO #$p FROM #$stt_rec
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #$p
		WHILE (@p IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #$invoice select a.stt_rec, a.so_bi_mat, rtrim(b.ma_dvcs), ''' + @p + ''' from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where exists(select 1 from #$stt_rec c where c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #$p WHERE p > @p
		END
		SELECT * FROM #$invoice
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_lct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt INTO #master FROM hddt00$000000
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, b.ngay_ct, b.ngay_lct, rtrim(b.ma_dvcs), '''', rtrim(a.mau_hddt), rtrim(a.so_seri_hddt), rtrim(a.so_ct_hddt) from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @m + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(ma_so_thue) FROM dmdvcskb WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND status = '1'
		IF @taxCode IS NULL SELECT @taxCode = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_thue'
		UPDATE #master SET ma_so_thue = ISNULL(@taxCode, '')

		SELECT stt_rec AS [key], CASE WHEN ngay_lct <= ngay_ct THEN ngay_lct ELSE ngay_ct END AS ngay_tu, CASE WHEN ngay_ct >= ngay_lct THEN ngay_ct ELSE ngay_lct END AS ngay_den, ma_so_thue, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, LTRIM(so_ct_hddt) AS so_ct_hddt, (RTRIM(so_seri_hddt) + LTRIM(so_ct_hddt)) AS so_hd_hddt, CASE WHEN ngay_ct >= ngay_lct THEN ngay_ct ELSE ngay_lct END + 1 AS ngay_den2 FROM #master
	END


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIVendorEvaluationDetailed]
	@PeriodType CHAR(2),
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@SubCriteria VARCHAR(1024),
	@Vendor VARCHAR(1024),
	@VendorGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(1024),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key3 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key4 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key3Old NVARCHAR(4000), @Key4Old NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @joinItem NVARCHAR(1023), @joinVendor NVARCHAR(1023), @tableData NVARCHAR(1023), @p INT, @y INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST (0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST (0 AS INT) AS sysprint, CAST (0 AS INT) AS systotal, CAST (0 AS INT) AS stt
		, a.nam, a.ky, a.loai_ky, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, a.ma_vt, c.ten_vt, a.ma_chi_tieu, d.ten_ct AS ten_chi_tieu
		, a.trong_so AS trong_so, a.diem_so AS diem, a.diem_so AS diem_kn, a.diem_so AS diem_kt, CAST ('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xCustomer, CAST ('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xCriteria, CAST (0 AS INT) AS stt_sx
		INTO #report
		FROM bidgkq00$0000 a, dmkh b, dmvt c, bidmctdg d

	-- PurOrgKey
	SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @joinItem = '', @joinVendor = '', @tableData = CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN 'bidgkqkh00' ELSE 'bidgkq00' END
	IF @ReportType = '1' OR @ItemGroup1 <> '' OR @ItemGroup2 <> '' OR @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @joinItem = ' left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt'
	IF @ReportType = '1' OR @VendorGroup1 <> '' OR @VendorGroup2 <> '' OR @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @joinVendor = ' left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'

	SELECT @Key = ' and a.loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	--
	IF @Vendor <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Vendor, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SELECT @Key3 = @Key
	--
	IF @SubCriteria <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_chi_tieu in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@SubCriteria, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	SELECT @Key4 = @Key
	--
	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Item, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @ReportForm = '20' BEGIN -- Prev
		SELECT @p = MIN(ky) FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType AND nam = @Year
		IF @p = @Period SELECT @p = MAX(ky), @y = @Year - 1 FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType AND nam = @Year - 1
			ELSE SELECT @p = @Period - 1, @y = @Year
		SELECT @p = ISNULL(@p, 0), @y = ISNULL(@y, 0)

		SELECT @Key2 = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@p) + @Key
		SELECT @Key3Old = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@p) + @Key3
		SELECT @Key4Old = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@y) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@p) + @Key4
	END
	-- Current
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + @Key
		, @Key3 = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + @Key3
		, @Key4 = 'a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + @Key4

	-- Current Score
	IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.nam, a.ky, a.loai_ky, a.ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'k.ten_kh' ELSE 'k.ten_kh2' END
		IF (@ReportType = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'v.ten_vt' ELSE 'v.ten_vt2' END ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_chi_tieu, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_ct' ELSE 'd.ten_ct2' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.trong_so as trong_so, a.diem_so as diem, ' + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '20' THEN 'a.diem_so' ELSE '0' END + ' as diem_kn, 0 as diem_kt'
		SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, d.stt'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' left join bidmctdg d with(nolock) on a.ma_chi_tieu = d.ma_ct' + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN ' order by a.ma_kh, d.stt' ELSE ' order by a.ma_kh, d.stt, a.ma_vt' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Old Score
	IF (@ReportForm = '20' AND OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set diem_kt = isnull(b.diem_so, 0) from #report a'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' left join (select a.diem_so, a.ma_chi_tieu, a.ma_kh' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN '' ELSE ', a.ma_vt' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinVendor + @joinItem
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key2 + ') b'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' on a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '0' THEN '' ELSE ' and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Total Group
	SELECT @tableData = 'bidgkqkh02'
	IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 3, 1, 0, null, 0, 0, '''', a.ma_kh, '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', '''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ', 0, a.diem_so, a.diem_so, 0, a.ma_kh, '''', 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from  ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinVendor
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key3
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Comparative
	IF (@ReportForm = '20' AND OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set diem_kt = isnull(b.diem_so, 0)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' left join (select a.diem_so, a.ma_kh'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from  ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinVendor
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key3Old + ') b'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.sysorder = 3'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Item
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @tableData = 'bidgkqkh00'
		IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 4, 1, 0, null, 0, 0, '''', a.ma_kh, '''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
			SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_chi_tieu, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_ct' ELSE 'd.ten_ct2' END
			SELECT @q = @q + ', a.trong_so, a.diem_so, a.diem_so, 0, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu, d.stt'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from  ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' a with(nolock)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' left join bidmctdg d with(nolock) on a.ma_chi_tieu = d.ma_ct' + @joinVendor
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key4
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Comparative
		SELECT @tableData = 'bidgkqkh00'
		IF (@ReportForm = '20' AND OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set diem_kt = isnull(b.diem_so, 0)'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' left join (select a.diem_so, a.ma_kh, a.ma_chi_tieu'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from  ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)'+ @joinVendor
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key4Old + ') b'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_chi_tieu = b.ma_chi_tieu'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.sysorder = 4'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	-- Update
	UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN k.ten_kh ELSE k.ten_kh2 END FROM #report a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmkh k WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh WHERE sysorder = 3
	UPDATE #report SET ma_kh = '', ten_kh = '' WHERE sysorder = 5

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_kh NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ma_kh = '', ten_kh = SPACE(2) + RTRIM(ma_chi_tieu) + CASE WHEN ten_chi_tieu = '' THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + ten_chi_tieu END WHERE sysorder = 4
		UPDATE #report SET ma_chi_tieu = '', ten_kh = SPACE(4) + RTRIM(ma_vt) + CASE WHEN ten_vt = '' THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + ten_vt END, trong_so = 0 WHERE sysorder = 5
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = SPACE(2) + RTRIM(ma_chi_tieu) + CASE WHEN ten_chi_tieu = '' THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + ten_chi_tieu END WHERE sysorder = 5
	END

	-- Browse
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xCustomer, stt_sx, xCriteria, ma_vt, sysorder

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ConvertContracts2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d0 VARCHAR(23)
	--
	SELECT @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')
	SELECT @d0 = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), GETDATE(), 121) + ''''
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = ''

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL OR @UnitKey <> '' SET @Key = ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[ma_hd <> '''' and exists (select 1 from dmhd b where a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd and b.hd_sd_pslk = 1)' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	--
	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdhd where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'insert into cdhd (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00 from cdhd b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + @Key + ' and exists (select 1 from dmhd c where b.ma_hd = c.ma_hd and c.hd_sd_pslk = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd)) a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update cdhd set du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'update cdhd set du_co00 = -du_no00, du_co_nt00 = -du_no_nt00 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key + ' and du_no00 <= 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'update cdhd set du_co00 = 0, du_co_nt00 = 0  where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key + ' and du_no00 >=  0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'update cdhd set du_no00 = 0, du_no_nt00 = 0 where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key + ' and du_no00 < 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
	SELECT @q = @q + 'delete cdhd where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0 and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList]
	@oldList VARCHAR(8000),
	@newList VARCHAR(8000) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000), @count INT, @i INT
	
	CREATE TABLE #t(item VARCHAR(33))
	
	SELECT @count = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@oldList), @s = '', @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @count BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@oldList, @i)
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + item FROM #t ORDER BY item

	SELECT @newList = @s
	DROP TABLE #t

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployee]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One SaleEmployee, 2 Multi SaleEmployee
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceJoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@BalanceWhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@ArisingJoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@ArisingWhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @BalanceKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ArisingKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_nvbh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdnvbh

	SELECT @BalanceKey = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @BalanceKey = @UnitKey

	IF @Account <> '' SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	SET @ArisingKey = @BalanceKey

	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' BEGIN
		SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(@SalesEmployee, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		SET @ArisingKey = @ArisingKey + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(@SalesEmployee, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nvbh <> '''''
		SET @ArisingKey = @ArisingKey + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' <> '''''
	END

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_nvbh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdnvbh a with (nolock, index(nam))'
	IF @BalanceJoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @BalanceJoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @BalanceKey ELSE '' END
	IF @BalanceWhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @BalanceWhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_nvbh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ', sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) '
	IF @ArisingJoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @ArisingJoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @ArisingKey ELSE '' END
	IF @ArisingWhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @ArisingWhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_nvbh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_nvbh order by tk, ma_nvbh'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$GetApprovalMailList]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherType CHAR(1), -- 1 - PR, 2 - PO
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@lastUser INT = 0,
	@isChange BIT = 0,
	@createdUser INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(32), @Amount NUMERIC(19, 2), @CurStatus VARCHAR(32), @p INT, @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @mailUser INT, @datetime2 DATETIME, @unit VARCHAR(32), @Category VARCHAR(32), @d SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #m(id int IDENTITY(1,1), stt_rec CHAR(13), user_id INT, type INT, ma_bp VARCHAR(32), parallel_yn BIT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32), deny_mail_yn BIT)
	CREATE TABLE #tmp(u_status VARCHAR(32), dept_id VARCHAR(32), ma_nt VARCHAR(3), t_tien_nt NUMERIC(19, 2), datetime2 DATETIME, ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #ds(user_id INT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #parallel(user_id INT NULL)

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121)

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #ds select user_id4 from a' + CASE @voucherCode WHEN 'PR1' THEN '91' WHEN 'PR2' THEN '91' WHEN 'PO1' THEN '94' ELSE '95' END + '$000000 where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select u_status, dept_id, ma_nt, t_tien_nt, datetime2, ma_dvcs, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @CurStatus = u_status, @Dept = dept_id, @FC = ma_nt, @Amount = t_tien_nt, @datetime2 = datetime2, @unit = ma_dvcs, @Category = kieu_duyet FROM #tmp


	-- Unit rights
	SELECT id INTO #user FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE status = 1 AND (admin = 1 OR (admin = 0 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sysunitrights WHERE ma_dvcs = @unit AND r_edit = 1)))

	--Device
	INSERT INTO #m SELECT @idNumber, a.user_id, '2', a.ma_bp, c.parallel_yn, c.kieu_duyet, c.deny_mail_yn FROM (SELECT * FROM dmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN dmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN dmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
		WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND a.status = 1 AND a.ma_nt = @FC
			AND (a.ma_bp = '' OR a.ma_bp = @Dept)
			AND (a.tien_nt = 0 OR a.tien_nt >= @Amount)
			AND c.status = @CurStatus
			AND a.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #ds)
			AND a.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM #user)
			AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category
			--AND (c.kieu_duyet = '' OR c.kieu_duyet = @Category)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE ma_phan_he = 'SM' AND name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @vcCode VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @vcCode = CASE WHEN @voucherCode IN ('PR1', 'PR2') THEN 'PR1' ELSE @voucherCode END
		SET @q = 'exec ds_CreateVoucherPending @vcCode, @idNumber, ''#m'', ''user_id'', @sysDatabaseName'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@vcCode varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @vcCode, @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName
	END

	-- Approval mail (with link)
	DELETE #m WHERE deny_mail_yn = 1


	-- Get priority rights
	DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #m GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND ma_bp = '' -- AND kieu_duyet = ''
	-- DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #m GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND kieu_duyet = ''
	-- DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #m GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND kieu_duyet <> '' AND ma_bp = ''

	-- Notification mail (without link)
	IF @lastUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @lastUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @lastUser, '1'
	END

	-- Mail Created User (without link)
	IF @createdUser <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m WHERE user_id = @createdUser) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #m(stt_rec, user_id, type) SELECT @idNumber, @createdUser, '1'
	END

	--
	IF @isChange = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #parallel SELECT a.user_id FROM #m a JOIN dmxn b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE a.parallel_yn = 1
		DELETE #m WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END


	-- Delete valid mail/sms
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_nhan INTO #xn FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
		INSERT INTO #xn SELECT ma_huy FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)

		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from #xn)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)
	END

	-- Delete dmxn, dbxn
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$DeleteLog @sysDatabaseName

	-- Create new mail/sms
	SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @mailUser = user_id FROM #m WHERE id = @p
		SELECT @c1 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6)), @c2 = LOWER(LEFT(NEWID(), 6))
		INSERT INTO dmxn(stt_rec, user_id, ma_nhan, ma_huy, datetime2) SELECT @idNumber, @mailUser, @c1, @c2, @datetime2
		SET @q = 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c1 + ''', ''1'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn values(''' + @c2 + ''', ''0'', ''' + DB_NAME() + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @p = min(id) FROM #m WHERE id > @p
	END


	-- Update datetime2 for valid old mail/sms
	UPDATE dmxn SET datetime2 = @datetime2 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM #parallel)


	SELECT id, stt_rec, user_id, type FROM #m


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
