CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetListVar (@Formular NVARCHAR(1024))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1024)
BEGIN 
	IF @Formular = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @i INT, @iFlag BIT, @strRe NVARCHAR(256)
	SET @i = 1
	SET @iFlag = 0
	SET @strRe = ''
	WHILE @i <= LEN(@Formular)
	BEGIN
		IF SUBSTRING(@Formular, @i, 1) = '[' SET @iFlag = 1
		IF SUBSTRING(@Formular, @i, 1) = ']' SET @iFlag = 0
		IF @iFlag = 1 SET @strRe = @strRe + SUBSTRING(@Formular, @i, 1)
		SET @i = @i + 1		
	END
	SET @strRe = REPLACE(@strRe, ' ', '')
	RETURN CASE WHEN @strRe <> '' THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(@strRe, '[', ','), 2, LEN(@strRe)) ELSE '' END
END




GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_ExactInlist(@cItem VARCHAR(33), @strList NVARCHAR(4000))  
RETURNS INT
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nStart INT, @nReturn INT
	SET  @nStart = 1
	SET  @nReturn = 0
	SET @cItem = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem))
	SET @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@strList)) + ','
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@cItem)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
				BEGIN
					SET @nReturn = 1
					BREAK
				END
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN @nReturn
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEIInvoiceAdjustmentAndReplacementReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT, -- 1 - Điều chỉnh, 2 - Thay thế
	@Status CHAR(1), -- 0. Chưa xác thực, 1. Chờ xác thực, 2. Đã xác thực, 3. Điều chỉnh, 4. Thay thế, 8. Chờ hủy, 9. Hủy
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @m VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32), @t VARCHAR(32), @vCode VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @f NVARCHAR(512), @j NVARCHAR(512)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 c.user_id2 AS nguoi_ph, d.comment AS nguoi_th, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.so_ct_hddt, c.so_seri_hddt, c.mau_hddt, a.so_ct, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt AS tien_nt,
			a.stt_rec AS stt_rec0, a.ma_ct AS ma_ct0, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct0, a.so_ct AS so_ct0, c.so_ct_hddt AS so_ct_hddt0, c.so_seri_hddt AS so_seri_hddt0, c.mau_hddt AS mau_hddt0, a.ma_nt AS ma_nt0, a.t_tien_nt AS tien_nt0, a.ma_kh,
			CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS m$0, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS hddt$0
		INTO #report FROM m81$000000 a, dmkh b, hddt00$000000 c, vsysuserinfo d
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #tmp FROM #report

	-- Key
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin), @Key = '', @Join = '', @t = ''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.tinh_trang_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_ct in (''HD2'', ''HD3'', ''HD4'', ''HD5'', ''HD6'', ''HDF'') and not exists(select 1 from hddt01 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec1)'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct1 >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct1 <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

		IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
		IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

		IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.ma_nt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		SELECT @Join = ' join hddt01 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec1'
	END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Get data from hddt00$
	SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN '#tmp' ELSE '#report' END + ' select a.user_id2, c.comment' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.mau_hddt, ' +
		CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN ''''', '''', 0, '''', '''', null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, ''''' ELSE 'b.so_ct1, b.ma_nt1, b.t_tt_nt1, b.stt_rec0, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct0, b.so_ct0, '''', '''', '''', b.ma_nt0, b.t_tt_nt0, b.ma_kh1' END +
		', '''', '''' from hddt00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' left join vsysuserinfo c on a.user_id2 = c.id where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- HD7
	IF @Type = 2 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #tmp
	select a.user_id2, c.comment' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.mau_hddt, b.so_ct, b.ma_nt, b.t_tt_nt, b.stt_rec_hd, b.ma_ct_hd, null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, b.ma_kh, '''', ''''
		from hddt00$%Partition a with(nolock) join hdtt b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join vsysuserinfo c on a.user_id2 = c.id where %[' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, 'b.so_ct1', 'b.so_ct'), 'b.ma_kh1', 'b.ma_kh'), 'b.ma_nt1', 'b.ma_nt') + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp) BEGIN
			SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('$', b.m$) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('000000', b.m$) = 0) THEN RTRIM(b.m$) + dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(a.ma_ct0, a.stt_rec0) ELSE b.m$ END AS m$, b.ma_ct INTO #v0 FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct0 = b.ma_ct
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #v0) BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @m = m$, @vCode = ma_ct FROM #v0
				--
				SELECT @q = 'update #tmp set ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct, so_ct0 = b.so_ct, ma_nt0 = b.ma_nt, tien_nt0 = b.t_tt_nt + ' + CASE WHEN @vCode = 'HDF' THEN 'b.t_km_nt' ELSE '0' END + ' from #tmp a join ' + RTRIM(@m) + ' b on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				--
				DELETE #v0 WHERE m$ = @m
			END
			INSERT INTO #report SELECT * FROM #tmp
		END
	END

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Key = ''
		IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
		IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

		IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct_hddt >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
		IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.so_ct_hddt <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

		IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('$', b.m$) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('000000', b.m$) = 0) THEN RTRIM(b.m$) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) ELSE b.m$ END AS m$,
				CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('$', b.d$) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('000000', b.d$) = 0) THEN CASE WHEN b.ma_ct IN ('HD4', 'HD6', 'HD3', 'HDF') THEN RTRIM(b.d$) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) ELSE RTRIM(b.m$) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) END ELSE CASE WHEN b.ma_ct in ('HD4', 'HD6', 'HD3', 'HDF') THEN b.d$ ELSE b.m$ END END AS t$, b.ma_ct
			INTO #voucher FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS m$, stt_rec0, stt_rec, ma_ct INTO #adj FROM #report



		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #voucher) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @m = m$, @t = t$, @vCode = ma_ct FROM #voucher
			--
			SELECT @q = '
insert into #report
	select b.nguoi_ph, b.nguoi_th, b.stt_rec, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, b.mau_hddt, a.so_ct, a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt + ' + CASE WHEN @vCode = 'HDF' THEN 'a.t_km_nt' ELSE '0' END + ', '''', '''', null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, a.ma_kh, '''', ''''
		from ' + RTRIM(@m) + ' a with(nolock) join #tmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.status <> ''0''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
			SELECT @q = @q + '
insert into #adj
	select distinct case when (charindex(''$'', b.c$) > 0 and charindex(''000000'', b.c$) = 0) then rtrim(b.c$) + ''000000'' else b.c$ end,
			case when (charindex(''$'', b.m$) > 0 and charindex(''000000'', b.m$) = 0) then rtrim(b.m$) + ''%Partition'' else b.m$ end, a.stt_rec_hd, a.stt_rec, b.ma_ct
		from ' + RTRIM(@t) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmct9 b with(nolock) on right(a.stt_rec_hd, 3) = b.ma_ct
		where a.stt_rec_hd <> '''' and exists(select 1 from #report c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			DELETE #voucher WHERE m$ = @m AND t$ = @t
		END
		UPDATE #report SET stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 FROM #report a JOIN #adj b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		DELETE #report WHERE ma_ct = 'HD2' AND stt_rec0 = ''


		-- Update from table c$
		SELECT DISTINCT c$, ma_ct INTO #t1 FROM #adj
		SELECT TOP 0 c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS hddt$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ct INTO #t2 FROM #adj
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t1) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @c = c$ FROM #t1

			SELECT @q = '
insert into #t2 select distinct replace(b.m$, ''%Partition'', convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112)), ''hddt00$'' + convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112), b.ma_ct
	from ' + RTRIM(@c) + ' a with(nolock) join #adj b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DELETE #t1 WHERE c$ = @c
		END

		-- Update from table master m$
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t2) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @m = c$, @t = hddt$, @vCode = ma_ct FROM #t2
			--
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = @t AND xtype = 'U')
				SELECT @f = ', so_ct_hddt0 = c.so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt0 = c.so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt0 = c.mau_hddt', @j = ' join ' + RTRIM(@t) + ' c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec'
			ELSE
				SELECT @f = '', @j = ''
			SELECT @q = 'update #report set ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct, so_ct0 = b.so_ct, ma_ct0 = b.ma_ct, ma_nt0 = b.ma_nt, tien_nt0 = (b.t_tt_nt + ' + CASE WHEN @vCode = 'HDF' THEN 'b.t_km_nt' ELSE '0' END + ') ' + @f + ' from #report a join ' + RTRIM(@m) + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec' + @j
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			DELETE #t2 WHERE c$ = @m and hddt$ = @t
		END
		DELETE #report WHERE stt_rec0 <> '' AND so_ct0 = '' AND ngay_ct0 IS NULL
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct0, 112) AS p INTO #p FROM #report WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @s = 'update #report set so_ct_hddt0 = b.so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt0 = b.so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt0 = b.mau_hddt from #report a join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec'
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #p) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @t = p FROM #p
			--
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'hddt00$' + @t AND xtype = 'U') BEGIN
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Partition', @t)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			DELETE #p WHERE p = @t
		END
	END


	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec0, ma_ct0, stt_rec, ma_ct, nguoi_th) SELECT '', '', '', '', ''

	-- View
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetOriginalTicket]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Method INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @FieldKey VARCHAR(32), @FieldType VARCHAR(1023), @Join VARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @fkey VARCHAR(32), @type INT, @VCCode CHAR(3), @p VARCHAR(6),@oldIdNumber VARCHAR(32), @oldPattern VARCHAR(32), @oldSerial VARCHAR(32)

	CREATE TABLE #adjust(so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32))

	-- lấy thông tin hóa đơn gốc bị điều chỉnh/ thay thế
	SELECT @type = 1, @VCCode = ma_ct, @fkey = stt_rec0 FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID
			
	SELECT @p = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@VCCode, @fkey)
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #adjust select so_ct_hddt, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt from hddt00$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@fkey, '''', '') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	SELECT @oldIdNumber = LTRIM(RTRIM(so_ct_hddt)), @oldPattern = mau_hddt, @oldSerial = so_seri_hddt FROM #adjust
	
	SELECT RTRIM(@oldPattern) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldSerial) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldIdNumber) + ';' + RTRIM(@type) AS hddt_tt, @fkey AS fkey, @type AS loai_hd

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptClearanceOfObligationsToTheGovernment] --fs20_IncomeStatementPart1
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME,
		@y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME,
		@p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @n INT, @ListAccountRef VARCHAR(128)


	-- Set
	SELECT @ListAccountRef = REPLACE(REPLACE(val, ' ', ''), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tien_thue'
	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc3 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS xtype INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk INTO #accRef FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ListAccountRef, ',')

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	SELECT @s = '
insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type
	from r00$%Partition with(nolock)
	where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%
	group by tk, tk_du
'

	--
	SET @s2 = '
insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type
	from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock)
	where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%
	group by tk, tk_du
'


	-- Trong kỳ
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '1')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '1')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	-- Từ đầu năm tài chính đến trước đầu kỳ
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '2')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '2')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	-- Đầu kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #gl_bal (tk VARCHAR(32), du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), du_co NUMERIC(28, 6), du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), du_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #gl_bal EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom, @Unit, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin



	DECLARE @code VARCHAR(32), @formula NVARCHAR(256)
	DECLARE @tk VARCHAR(32), @tk_du VARCHAR(32), @du_dau NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_cuoi NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @du_dau_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co_nt0 NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_cuoi_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, tk, tk_du FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh = '' AND ma_so <> '' AND kind <> 0
	OPEN cs
	FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @code, @tk, @tk_du
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @du_dau = 0, @ps_no = 0, @ps_co = 0, @ps_no0 = 0, @ps_co0 = 0, @du_cuoi = 0, @du_dau_nt = 0, @ps_no_nt = 0, @ps_co_nt = 0, @ps_no_nt0 = 0, @ps_co_nt0 = 0, @du_cuoi_nt = 0

		-- Số dư
		IF @tk_du = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @du_dau = SUM(ISNULL(du_co, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(du_no, 0)), @du_dau_nt = SUM(ISNULL(du_co_nt, 0)) - SUM(ISNULL(du_no_nt, 0)) FROM #gl_bal WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%')
			SELECT @ps_no = SUM(Ps_no), @ps_co = SUM(Ps_co), @ps_no_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt), @ps_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%') AND xtype = 1
			SELECT @du_cuoi = ISNULL(@du_dau, 0) + ISNULL(@ps_co, 0) - ISNULL(@ps_no, 0), @du_cuoi_nt = ISNULL(@du_dau_nt, 0) + ISNULL(@ps_co_nt, 0) - ISNULL(@ps_no_nt, 0)
		END

		--
		IF RTRIM(@tk_du) = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @ps_no0 = SUM(a.ps_no), @ps_no_nt0 = SUM(a.ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00 a WHERE a.tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk)
			SELECT @ps_no = SUM(a.ps_no), @ps_no_nt = SUM(a.ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00 a WHERE a.tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%') AND a.xtype = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk)
		END


		--
		SELECT @ps_co0 = SUM(Ps_co), @ps_co_nt0 = SUM(Ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%')AND tk_du LIKE (RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%')
		SELECT @ps_co = SUM(Ps_co), @ps_co_nt = SUM(Ps_co_nt)FROM #ct00 WHERE tk LIKE (RTRIM(@tk) + '%')AND tk_du LIKE (RTRIM(@tk_du) + '%') AND xtype = 1

		--
		UPDATE #report SET du_dau = @du_dau, ps_no = @ps_no, ps_co = @ps_co, ps_no0 = @ps_no0, ps_co0 = @ps_co0, du_cuoi = @du_cuoi,
				du_dau_nt = @du_dau_nt, ps_no_nt = @ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = @ps_co_nt, ps_no_nt0 = @ps_no_nt0, ps_co_nt0 = @ps_co_nt0, du_cuoi_nt = @du_cuoi_nt
			WHERE ma_so = @code

		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @code, @tk, @tk_du
	END
	CLOSE cs
	DEALLOCATE cs

	CREATE TABLE #fields(id INT, name VARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #fields SELECT 0, 'du_dau'
		UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'ps_no'
		UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'ps_co'
		UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'ps_no0'
		UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'ps_co0'
		UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'du_cuoi'
		UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'du_dau_nt'
		UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'ps_no_nt'
		UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'ps_co_nt'
		UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'ps_no_nt0'
		UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'ps_co_nt0'
		UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'du_cuoi_nt'

	SELECT @n = MAX(id) FROM #fields

	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'update #report set ' + name + ' = 0 where ' + name + ' is null ' FROM #fields WHERE id = @i
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	DECLARE cs CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN cs
	FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @code, @formula
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #report set %$field = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@formula, '[', '(select max(%$field) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + REPLACE(@code, '''', '') + ''''

			SELECT @i = 0
			WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
				SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(REPLACE(@s, '%$field', name)) FROM #fields WHERE id = @i
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				--
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
			--						--
			FETCH NEXT FROM cs INTO @code, @formula
		END
	CLOSE cs
	DEALLOCATE cs


	SELECT chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so,du_dau, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no0, ps_co0, du_cuoi, du_dau_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_no_nt0, ps_co_nt0, du_cuoi_nt, stt AS sysorder, bold, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
		FROM #report ORDER BY stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateAvgPrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cSite VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemType CHAR(2), 
	@nDeffType TINYINT, 
	@cDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@nUpdateType TINYINT, 
	@nSiteType TINYINT, 
	@cVCDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@nCostType TINYINT, 
	@sIRVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sISVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sIBVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sIPVCCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@sIIVCCodes VARCHAR(64) , 
	@nFCPriceType TINYINT, 
	@nUserID INT, 
	@cSiteGroup VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceList @dFrom, @dTo, @cSite, @cItem, @cItemGroup1, @cItemGroup2, @cItemGroup3, @cItemType, @nSiteType, @nCostType, @nUserID, @cSiteGroup

	SELECT @cSiteGroup = RTRIM(@cSiteGroup) + '%'
	
	DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @stt_rec0 CHAR(3), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @ma_kho VARCHAR(33), @ma_khon VARCHAR(33), @ma_nt CHAR(3), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @nxt TINYINT, @ct_dc TINYINT
	DECLARE @gia NUMERIC (38, 12), @gia_nt NUMERIC (38, 12)
	
	SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_nt, ma_ct, nxt, ct_dc
		INTO #tps
		FROM ct70 WHERE ngay_ct >= @dFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dTo AND ((nxt = 1 AND pn_gia_tb = 1) OR (nxt = 2 AND px_gia_dd <> 1))
			AND ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%') 
			AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%') 
			AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
			AND ma_kho LIKE (RTRIM(@cSite) + '%')
			AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
		ORDER BY stt_rec, stt_rec0
	
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_nt, ma_ct, nxt, ct_dc FROM #tps ORDER BY stt_rec, stt_rec0
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_khon, @ma_nt, @ma_ct, @nxt, @ct_dc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @nSiteType = 2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #wrkstkprice WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho)
				BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_khon, @ma_nt, @ma_ct, @nxt, @ct_dc
					CONTINUE
				END
			ELSE
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #wrkstkprice WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt)
					BEGIN
						FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_khon, @ma_nt, @ma_ct, @nxt, @ct_dc
						CONTINUE
					END

			IF @nSiteType = 2 SELECT @gia_nt = gia_nt, @gia = gia FROM #wrkstkprice WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_kho = @ma_kho
				ELSE SELECT @gia_nt = gia_nt, @gia = gia FROM #wrkstkprice WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt

			IF @gia IS NULL SET @gia = 0 
			IF @gia_nt IS NULL SET @gia_nt = 0 

			EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceIN @ngay_ct, @nSiteType, @nFCPriceType, @sIPVCCodes, @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_vt , @ma_kho, @ma_khon, @ma_nt, @ma_ct, @nxt, @ct_dc, @gia, @gia_nt

			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_khon, @ma_nt, @ma_ct, @nxt, @ct_dc
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nPRound TINYINT, @nFCPRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nRound = 0, @nFCRound = 2, @nPRound = 2, @nFCPRound = 4

	DELETE FROM #wrkstkdetail
	INSERT INTO #wrkstkdetail (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, he_so, ma_nt, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, sl_nhap + sl_xuat, he_so1, ma_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0
			FROM ct70 WHERE stt_rec + stt_rec0 IN (SELECT stt_rec + stt_rec0 FROM #tps)

	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt FROM #wrkstkdetail a JOIN ct70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

	/*
	IF @nSiteType = 2 UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt FROM #wrkstkdetail a JOIN ct70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
		ELSE UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt FROM #wrkstkdetail a JOIN #wrkstkprice b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	*/

	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET tien = ROUND(so_luong*gia, @nRound), tien_nt = ROUND(so_luong*gia_nt, @nFCRound)
	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = ROUND(gia*he_so, @nPRound), 
		gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt*he_so, @nFCPRound)

	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia_nt = gia, tien_nt = tien WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = ''

	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceDetail @dFrom, @dTo
	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceMaster @dFrom, @dTo
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrplhd] AS
SELECT a.*, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv, b.ten_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten, b.bo_phan AS ma_bp, b.bp_ref, b.vi_tri, b.bac_quan_ly AS ma_bac, b.ngay_vao, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2
	FROM hrplhd a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON b.bo_phan = c.ma_bp

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEduStatisticsByDeptPos]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptLevel INT,
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Education VARCHAR(1028),
	@EmpType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Permanent, 2 - Probationary, * - All
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	--Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @sub NVARCHAR(128), @other NVARCHAR(128), @remain NVARCHAR(128), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @i INT, @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @sub = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total2'
	SELECT @remain = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM013'
	SELECT @d = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @Date, 112) + '''', @other = '-', @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri AS ma_vtr, ma_tdhv, ngay_tot_nghiep INTO #r FROM hrnv

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @Level <> ''SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	
	SELECT @Where = ' and r.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c')

	SET @EmployeeCondition = ''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Count
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, '1' AS tinh_chat, ngay_tu INTO #d FROM hreqtlvht
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #d select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, ''1'' as tinh_chat, max(r.ngay_tu) as ngay_tu from hreqtlvht r join hrnv e on r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d + ' and (e.ngay_nghi is null or e.ngay_nghi > ' + @d + ')' + REPLACE(@EmployeeCondition, 'a.', 'e.')
	IF @EmpType = '1' SELECT @q = @q + ' and e.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d
	IF @EmpType = '2' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (e.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or e.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, '''', null from #d r' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu <= ' + @d + ')' + @Where + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Join = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c')

	-- Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, '''', null from hrnv a' + @Join + ' where ((a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi >  ' + @d + ') and a.ngay_vao <= ' + @d + ' and stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition
	IF @EmpType = '1' SELECT @q = @q + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc <= ' + @d
	IF @EmpType = '2' SELECT @q = @q + ' and (a.ngay_chinh_thuc is null or a.ngay_chinh_thuc > ' + @d + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Education
	UPDATE #r SET ma_tdhv = ISNULL(b.ma_tdhv, ''), ngay_tot_nghiep = b.ngay_tot_nghiep FROM #r a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ma_tdhv <> '' AND (b.ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR b.ngay_tot_nghiep <= @Date)
	UPDATE #r SET ma_tdhv = ISNULL(b.ma_tdhv, '') FROM #r a JOIN (
		SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ma_tdhv) AS ma_tdhv, MAX(a.ngay_tot_nghiep) AS ngay_tot_nghiep FROM hrehv a JOIN (
			SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tot_nghiep) AS ngay_tot_nghiep FROM hrehv WHERE mac_dinh_yn = 1 AND (ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep <= @Date) GROUP BY stt_rec
		) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tot_nghiep = b.ngay_tot_nghiep WHERE a.mac_dinh_yn = 1 GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_tdhv = '' OR ((a.ngay_tot_nghiep IS NOT NULL) AND (b.ngay_tot_nghiep IS NOT NULL) AND a.ngay_tot_nghiep < b.ngay_tot_nghiep)

	UPDATE #r SET ma_tdhv = ISNULL(b.ma_tdhv, '') FROM #r a JOIN (
		SELECT a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ma_tdhv) AS ma_tdhv FROM hrehv a JOIN (
			SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tot_nghiep) AS ngay_tot_nghiep FROM hrehv WHERE mac_dinh_yn = 0 AND (ngay_tot_nghiep IS NULL OR ngay_tot_nghiep <= @Date) GROUP BY stt_rec
		) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tot_nghiep = b.ngay_tot_nghiep WHERE a.mac_dinh_yn = 0 GROUP BY a.stt_rec
	) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ma_tdhv = ''

	IF @Education <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'delete #r where ma_tdhv = '''' or (ma_tdhv not in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Education, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Report
	UPDATE #r SET ma_vtr = '' WHERE ma_vtr IS NULL

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, '#r', 'bo_phan'
		
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Where, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_tdhv, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_vtr, CAST(0 AS INT) AS so_nv INTO #report FROM #r a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select a.bo_phan, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_tdhv, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, max(isnull(cast(c.stt as int), 999997)) + 1 as stt_vtr, count(*) as so_nv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c on a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.bo_phan, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_tdhv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(b.stt, 999998), 6), ' ', '0') + a.ma_tdhv AS xPivot, SUM(a.so_nv) AS so_nv, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_ngan), @remain) ELSE ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_ngan2), @remain) END AS sysColumnName
		INTO #total
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrdmtdhv b ON a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv
		GROUP BY REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(b.stt, 999998), 6), ' ', '0') + a.ma_tdhv
		
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT bo_phan, '$', ma_tdhv, bp_me, bac_bp, 0, SUM(so_nv) FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan, bp_me, bac_bp, ma_tdhv

	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct b.ma_bp, r.ma_vtr, r.ma_tdhv, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, r.stt_vtr, 0 from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.stt_vtr = 0 and r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and b.ma_bp + r.ma_vtr + r.ma_tdhv not in (select bo_phan + ma_vtr + ma_tdhv from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET so_nv = a.so_nv + b.so_nv
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT bp_me, ma_vtr, ma_tdhv, SUM(so_nv) AS so_nv FROM #report WHERE bac_bp = @step AND stt_vtr = 0 GROUP BY bp_me, ma_vtr, ma_tdhv
				) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv
			WHERE a.stt_vtr = 0

		IF @DeptLevel <> 0 AND @step > @DeptLevel BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select distinct b.ma_bp, r.ma_vtr, r.ma_tdhv, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, r.stt_vtr, 0 from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and b.ma_bp + r.ma_vtr + r.ma_tdhv not in (select bo_phan + ma_vtr + ma_tdhv from #report))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #report SET so_nv = a.so_nv + b.so_nv
				FROM #report a JOIN (
						SELECT bp_me, ma_vtr, ma_tdhv, SUM(so_nv) AS so_nv FROM #report WHERE bac_bp = @step AND stt_vtr <> 0 GROUP BY bp_me, ma_vtr, ma_tdhv
					) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me AND a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv
				WHERE a.stt_vtr <> 0
		END

		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	--
	IF @DeptLevel <> 0 DELETE #report WHERE bac_bp > @DeptLevel

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #report WHERE bo_phan <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.bo_phan AS sysRow, a.ma_vtr, SPACE(2) + c.ten_vtr AS ten_vtr,
			CAST('' AS CHAR(512)) + STR(a.stt_vtr, 6) + a.ma_vtr AS sysColumn, a.so_nv,
			STR(d.stt, 6) + a.ma_tdhv AS xPivot,
			SPACE(2 * (a.bac_bp - @step)) + b.ten_bp AS sysRowName, 
			d.ten_ngan AS sysColumnName
		INTO #result FROM #report a, hrbp b, hrvt c, hrdmtdhv d

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.bo_phan as sysrow, a.ma_vtr, '
	SELECT @q = @q + ' case when a.stt_vtr = 0 then N''' + RTRIM(@sub) + ''' else '
				+ 'space(2) + case when a.stt_vtr = 999998 then N''' + RTRIM(@other) + ''' else ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vtr' ELSE 'c.ten_vtr2' END + ' end '
				+ 'end as ten_vtr,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' cast(b.stt_ref as char(512)) + replace(str(a.stt_vtr, 6), '' '', ''0'') + a.ma_vtr AS sysColumn, a.so_nv,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' replace(str(isnull(d.stt, 999998), 6), '' '', ''0'') + a.ma_tdhv as xPivot,'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' space(2 * (a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' as sysrowname,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(d.ten_ngan, N''' + RTRIM(@remain) + ''')' ELSE 'isnull(d.ten_ngan2, N''' + RTRIM(@remain) + ''')' END + ' as sysColumnName'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c on a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr left join hrdmtdhv d on a.ma_tdhv = d.ma_tdhv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', '', so_nv, xPivot, @total, sysColumnName FROM #total
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT TOP 1 1, 0, 0, '', '', '', CHAR(10), 0, xPivot, '', '' FROM #result WHERE sysorder <> 0
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 9, 1, 0, '', '', @total, '999999', so_nv, xPivot, '', sysColumnName FROM #total

	SELECT * FROM #result ORDER BY sysorder, sysColumn

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT DISTINCT xPivot FROM #result ORDER BY xPivot
	
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'so_nv$'

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), RTRIM(a.header) FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id
			
	SELECT a.id, a.name, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(b.ten_ngan, @remain) ELSE ISNULL(b.ten_ngan2, @remain) END AS sysColumnName		
		INTO #pivotResult
		FROM #pivot a LEFT JOIN hrdmtdhv b ON a.header = REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 6), ' ', '0') + b.ma_tdhv ORDER BY id
	
	-- Total
	DECLARE @nRow INT
	SELECT @nRow = COUNT(*) + 1 FROM #pivotResult
	INSERT INTO #pivotResult SELECT @nRow, 'so_nv', @total

	SELECT id, name, sysColumnName FROM #pivotResult ORDER BY id

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpSalaryDueIncrease]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay_bd SMALLDATETIME, luong_co_ban NUMERIC(28, 6), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
		
	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.ngay_bd >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.ngay_bd <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	--@q
	SET @q = 'insert into #report(stt_rec, ngay_bd, luong_co_ban) select d.stt_rec, d.ngay_bd, d.luong_co_ban'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hreqtlkddk d with(nolock) join hrnv a with(nolock) on d.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv, d.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(stt_rec, ngay_bd, luong_co_ban) SELECT '', NULL, 0

	SELECT a.stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, '' AS ma_nvo, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + ' ' + RTRIM(e.ten_nv) AS ho_ten_nv, 
			a.ngay_bd AS ngay_td_dk, a.luong_co_ban AS muc_luong_dk, e.bo_phan, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vtr ELSE c.ten_vtr2 END AS vi_tri, 
			CASE WHEN a.stt_rec = '' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN e.gioi_tinh = '1' THEN @Male ELSE @Female END END AS gioi_tinh
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON e.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
		ORDER BY a.stt

	--

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAllocationByProductQuantity] -- fs20_Copbcpslsx
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	
	
	-- Key	
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(a.ma_yt)) in (''' + REPLACE(@CE, ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
	IF @costUnit = 1 BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp, a.so_lsx AS so_lsx, a.ma_sp AS ma_sp, a.ma_yt AS ma_yt
			, a.he_so AS he_so, a.sl_tk AS sl_tk, a.ps_tk AS ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt AS ps_tk_nt	
			, b.hs_yt AS hs_yt, gt_ps AS gt_ps, a.ma_bp0 AS ma_bp0
		INTO #report
		FROM xctpbtg a, xdmyt b
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_yt, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, hs_yt, gt_ps, ma_bp0)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_yt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(a.he_so), sum(a.sl_tk), sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt), max(b.hs_yt), max(gt_ps), a.ma_bp0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctpbtg a with(nolock) left join xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '')

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_sp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_sp2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt				 				
		ORDER BY a.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff20_GetSQLAllocatedValue]
(
	@nAmt NUMERIC(28, 6), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@cFieldAlloc VARCHAR(64), 
	@cFieldKey VARCHAR(16), 
	@cFieldUpdate VARCHAR(16), 
	@nRound TINYINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @cAmt VARCHAR(24)
	IF @nAmt IS NULL SET @nAmt = 0
	SET @cAmt = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@nAmt AS CHAR(20))))
	SET @strSQL = 'DECLARE @nT NUMERIC(28, 6), @nxT NUMERIC(28, 6), @cFieldKeyValue VARCHAR(64)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT @nT = SUM(' + @cFieldAlloc + ') FROM ' + @cTable
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT((@nT IS NULL) OR (@nT = 0))'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'BEGIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cFieldUpdate + '= ROUND(' + @cAmt + '*' + @cFieldAlloc + '/@nT, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@nRound AS CHAR(3)))) + ')'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + 'SELECT @nxT = SUM(' + @cFieldUpdate + ') FROM ' + @cTable
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + 'IF @nxT <> ' + @cAmt
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + 'BEGIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + CHAR(9) + 'SELECT @cFieldKeyValue = RTRIM(MIN(' + @cFieldKey + ')) FROM ' + @cTable
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + CHAR(9) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cFieldUpdate + ' = ' + @cFieldUpdate + ' - @nxT + ' + @cAmt + ' WHERE ' + @cFieldKey + ' = @cFieldKeyValue'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + CHAR(9) + 'END'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'END'
	RETURN @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SA] -- new
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, CAST(1 AS INT) AS he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc INTO #afterUpdate FROM d93$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, 1, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, he_so, dyn_nc FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET sl_pb = sl_pb + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_nc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @dyn_nc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @dyn_nc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdytdd0x]
AS
SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, 
	a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, 
	b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_yt, c.ten_yt2
FROM dbo.xcdytdd0 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.xdmyt AS c ON a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt AND a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMonthlyAverageExRate] -- fs20_GLExchangeRatePosting
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)	

	SET @Key = 'a.thang = ' + CAST(@Month as varchar) + ' and a.nam = ' + CAST(@Year AS VARCHAR)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and (' END + @UnitKey + ' or a.ma_dvcs = '''')'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like'''+ REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'if exists(select top 1 ma_kh from gltggs a where ' + @Key + ')'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.ma_nt, a.tk, a.ma_kh, no_co, ty_gia_gs'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', b.ten_kh, '''' AS ten_kh2, c.ten_tk, '''' AS ten_tk2' ELSE ', '''' AS ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, '''' AS ten_tk, c.ten_tk2' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from gltggs a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtk c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.tk'
	SET @q = @q + ' else select null as sysorder, null as sysprint, null as systotal, '''' as tk, '''' as ma_kh, '''' as no_co, '''' as ma_nt, null as ty_gia_gs, '''' as ten_tk, '''' as ten_tk2, '''' as ten_kh, '''' as ten_kh2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_DAvgUpdatePrice2GL]
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33),
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(64) 
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @nxt TINYINT, @vcList VARCHAR(256), @d SMALLDATETIME, 
		@post_vv TINYINT, @post_sp TINYINT, @post_bp TINYINT, @post_hd TINYINT, @post_ku TINYINT, @post_phi TINYINT, @post_lsx TINYINT, @post_td1 TINYINT, @post_td2 TINYINT, @post_td3 TINYINT


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk_vt AS tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt
		INTO #tintmp0
		FROM wrkin

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tintmp0 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.tk_vt, ' + 
		 'case when a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @vcIBCodes) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@vcIBCodes, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + @vcIBCodes + '''' END + ' then a.tk_gv else a.tk_du end, ' + 
		'a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x' + 
		' from #ps70gl a where exists(select 1 from #stt_rec b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk
	
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_sp = CASE WHEN b.post_sp = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_sp END, 
			ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.post_bp = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_bp END, 
			ma_hd = CASE WHEN b.post_hd = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_hd END, 
			ma_ku = CASE WHEN b.post_ku = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_ku END, 
			ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.post_phi = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_phi END, 
			so_lsx = CASE WHEN b.post_lsx = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.so_lsx END, 
			ma_td1 = CASE WHEN b.post_td1 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td1 END, 
			ma_td2 = CASE WHEN b.post_td2 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td2 END, 
			ma_td3 = CASE WHEN b.post_td3 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td3 END
		FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
	
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt INTO #tintmp FROM #tintmp0
		GROUP BY ma_ct, stt_rec, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tintmp(stt_rec, tk, tk_du)		
	

	-- Update *00
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct INTO #dsct FROM #tintmp
	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @nxt = ct_nxt, @post_vv = post_vv, @post_sp = post_sp, @post_bp = post_bp, @post_hd = post_hd, @post_ku = post_ku, @post_phi = post_phi, @post_lsx = post_lsx, 
				@post_td1 = post_td1, @post_td2 = post_td2, @post_td3 = post_td3 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct

		SELECT @vcList = NULL
		SELECT @vcList = ISNULL(@vcList, '') + CASE WHEN @vcList IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ',' END + ma_ct FROM dmct
			WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM #dsct) AND ct_nxt = @nxt AND post_vv = @post_vv AND post_sp = @post_sp AND post_bp = @post_bp AND
				post_hd = @post_hd AND post_ku = @post_ku AND post_phi = @post_phi AND post_lsx = @post_lsx AND 
				post_td1 = @post_td1 AND post_td2 = @post_td2 AND post_td3 = @post_td3
				
		DELETE #dsct WHERE CHARINDEX(ma_ct, @vcList) > 0
		SELECT @vcList = ' where a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @vcList) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@vcList, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + @vcList + '''' END

		SELECT @key = ''
		IF @post_vv = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
		IF @post_sp = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp'
		IF @post_bp = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
		IF @post_hd = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
		IF @post_ku = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku'
		IF @post_phi = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'
		IF @post_lsx = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
		IF @post_td1 = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_td1 = b.ma_td1'
		IF @post_td2 = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_td2 = b.ma_td2'
		IF @post_td3 = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ma_td3 = b.ma_td3'

		IF @nxt = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #ps00 set ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #ps00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.tk_du = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 0'

			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update #ps00 set ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #ps00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk_du = b.tk and a.tk = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 1'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #ps00 set ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #ps00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.tk_du = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 0'

			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update #ps00 set ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from #ps00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk_du = b.tk and a.tk = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 1'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
					
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIVendorEvaluationSubCriterion]
	@PeriodType CHAR(2),
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(64),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(64),
	@PivotBy VARCHAR(64),
	@SubCriteria VARCHAR(1024),
	@Vendor VARCHAR(1024),
	@VendorGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@VendorGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(1024),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @joinItem NVARCHAR(1023), @joinVendor NVARCHAR(1023), @tableData NVARCHAR(1023), @p INT, @y INT
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @Total NVARCHAR(511)

	DECLARE @i INT, @Tmp VARCHAR(33), @TmpName NVARCHAR(64), @ReportByTmp NVARCHAR(64), @GroupByTmp NVARCHAR(64), @PivotByTmp NVARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @markRound INT
	SELECT @markRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_diem'

	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	SELECT @cNoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT @Key = '', @ReportByTmp = @ReportBy, @GroupByTmp = @GroupBy, @PivotByTmp = @PivotBy, @tableData = CASE WHEN (@ReportBy = '4' OR @GroupBy = '4' OR @PivotBy = '4') THEN 'bidgkq00' ELSE 'bidgkq02' END

	-- Dynamic ...
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2_name VARCHAR(64))
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', '', '', '', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'a.ma_bp0', 'bidmbp0', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'a.ma_kh', 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'a.ma_vt', 'dmvt', 'ma_vt', 'ten_vt'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'a.ma_chi_tieu', 'bidmctdg', 'ma_ct', 'ten_ct'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(rtrim(a.ky), 2), '' '', ''0'')', 'bictdmlkdg', 'ky', 'rtrim(max(b.ky))'

	IF @Language <> 'V' UPDATE #t SET xfield2_name = xfield2_name + '2' WHERE xtype <> 0 AND xtype <> 5
	--
	DECLARE @reportTable VARCHAR(64), @reportField VARCHAR(64), @reportFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @pivotTable VARCHAR(64), @pivotField VARCHAR(64), @pivotFieldName VARCHAR(64)
	--

	SELECT @ReportBy = xfield, @reportTable = xtable2, @reportField = xfield2, @reportFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @ReportBy
	SELECT @GroupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @GroupBy
	SELECT @PivotBy = xfield, @pivotTable = xtable2, @pivotField = xfield2, @pivotFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @PivotBy

	-- PurOrgKey
	SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Join
	SELECT @joinItem = ' left join dmvt v with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = v.ma_vt', @joinVendor = ' left join dmkh k with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = k.ma_kh'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'isnull(' + @ReportBy + ', '''') <> '''' and isnull(' + @PivotBy + ', '''') <> '''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(a.ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') >= ''' + STR(@YearFrom, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom, 8), ' ', '0') + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' or str(a.nam, 4) + replace(str(a.ky, 8), '' '', ''0'') <= ''' + STR(@YearTo, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo, 8), ' ', '0') + ''')'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ky = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PeriodType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey

	IF @SubCriteria <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_chi_tieu in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@SubCriteria, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'

	IF @Vendor <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Vendor, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @VendorGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VendorGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and k.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VendorGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @Item <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Item, '''', ''''''), ', ', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and v.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Score
	DECLARE @m INT, @id INT

	SELECT TOP 0 nam, ky, loai_ky, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_chi_tieu, diem_so AS diem, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS reportBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS groupBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS pivotBy
		INTO #tmp FROM bidgkq00$0000

	SELECT nam, ky, nam * 99 + ky AS id INTO #kbky FROM bictdmlkdg WHERE ma_loai = @PeriodType AND (nam * 99 + ky) >= (@YearFrom * 99 + @PeriodFrom) AND (nam * 99 + ky) <= (@YearTo * 99 + @PeriodTo)
	SELECT @id = MAX(id) FROM #kbky
	WHILE @id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @y = nam, @m = ky FROM #kbky where id = @id

		IF OBJECT_ID(@tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y)) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select distinct a.nam, a.ky, a.loai_ky, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh'
			SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @tableData = 'bidgkq00' THEN ', a.ma_chi_tieu' ELSE ', ''''' END
			SELECT @q = @q + ', a.diem_so'
			SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ReportBy = '' THEN ', ''''' ELSE ', rtrim(isnull(' + @ReportBy + ', ''''))' END
			SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN ', ''''' ELSE ', rtrim(isnull(' + @GroupBy + ', ''''))' END
			SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @PivotBy = '' THEN ', ''''' ELSE CASE WHEN @PivotBy = 'a.ky' THEN ', replace(str(rtrim(' + @PivotBy + '), 2), '' '', ''0'')' ELSE ', rtrim(' + @PivotBy + ')' END END
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableData + '$' + RTRIM(@y) + ' a with(nolock)' + @joinVendor + @joinItem
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@m)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @id = MAX(id) FROM #kbky WHERE id < @id
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @id = NULL
		END
	END

	CREATE INDEX ky_nam ON #tmp(nam, ky)

	-- Begin - Insert chi tiết
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS reportBy, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS reportByName
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS xCol, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS xColName, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS xKey
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS groupBy, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS pivotBy
			, diem_so AS diem
		INTO #report FROM bidgkq00$0000

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, reportBy,'  + CASE WHEN @ReportByTmp = '5' THEN '' + @reportFieldName + ''
			ELSE ' isnull(max(b.' + @reportFieldName + '), N'''')' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', pivotBy, pivotBy'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', groupBy + space(1) + reportBy'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', groupBy, pivotBy, max(diem) as diem'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' (select reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy, round(sum(diem)/count(1), ' + RTRIM(@markRound) + ') as diem'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #tmp a'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' ) a left join ' + @reportTable + ' b on a.reportBy = b.' + @reportField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join ' + @pivotTable + ' c on a.pivotBy = c.' + @pivotField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- End - Insert chi tiết

	-- Begin - Insert group
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET reportByName = SPACE(2) + reportByName

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select 3, 1, 0, 0, '''',' + CASE WHEN @GroupByTmp = '5' THEN '' + @groupFieldName + ''
			ELSE ' isnull(max(' + @groupFieldName + '), N''' + @cNoGroup + ''')' END
		SELECT @q = @q + ', xCol, max(xColName), groupBy, groupBy, '''', 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.groupBy = b.' + @groupField
		SELECT @q = @q + ' where sysorder = 5'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' group by xCol, groupBy'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	-- End - Insert group

	-- Print
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportBy, reportByName, xCol, xColName, xKey, diem)
		SELECT 9, 1, 0, 0, '', @Total, xCol, xColName, 'zzz', diem
			FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 1
	-- End - Insert row total

	-- Stt
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, groupBy, reportBy INTO #o FROM #report WHERE sysorder <> 6 GROUP BY groupBy, reportBy ORDER BY groupBy, reportBy
	SELECT groupBy, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY groupBy
	IF @groupBy = '' SET @i = 1 ELSE SET @i = 0
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id + @i FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.reportBy = b.reportBy AND a.groupBy = b.groupBy JOIN #g c ON a.groupBy = c.groupBy

	--View
	IF @ReportByTmp = '5' UPDATE #report SET reportByName = RIGHT(reportBy, 2) + '/' + LEFT(reportBy, 4) WHERE sysorder = 5
	IF @GroupByTmp = '5' UPDATE #report SET reportByName = RIGHT(xKey, 2) + '/' + LEFT(xKey, 4) WHERE sysorder = 3
	IF @PivotByTmp = '5' UPDATE #report SET xColName = RIGHT(xColName, 2) + '/' + LEFT(xColName, 4)
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, reportByName AS ten_ky, diem, reportBy AS xDetail, xCol, xColName, reportBy, groupBy, pivotBy, xKey
		FROM #report ORDER BY xKey, sysorder, stt, xCol


	--Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT DISTINCT 'diem$', xCol FROM #report ORDER BY xCol
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = name + RTRIM(id), header = CASE WHEN @PivotByTmp = '5' THEN RIGHT(header, 2) + '/' + LEFT(header, 4) ELSE header END

	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$SalesEmployeeCustomer]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One SaleEmployee, 2 Multi SaleEmployee
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@BalanceJoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@BalanceWhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@ArisingJoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@ArisingWhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @BalanceKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ArisingKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, b.ma_nvbh AS ma_nvbh, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl, dmnvbh b

	SELECT @BalanceKey = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @BalanceKey = @UnitKey

	IF @Account <> '' SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		ELSE SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh <> '''''

	SET @ArisingKey = @BalanceKey

	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' BEGIN
		SET @BalanceKey = @BalanceKey + CASE WHEN @BalanceKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(@SalesEmployee, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		SET @ArisingKey = @ArisingKey + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(@SalesEmployee, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdnvbh a with (nolock, index(nam)) '
	IF @BalanceJoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @BalanceJoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + ' and ' + @BalanceKey
	IF @BalanceWhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @BalanceWhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ', a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) '
	IF @ArisingJoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @ArisingJoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @ArisingKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @ArisingKey ELSE '' END
	IF @ArisingWhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @ArisingWhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ', a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh order by tk, ma_nvbh, ma_kh'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UpdateJournalVC]
	@Year INT,
	@BatchNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT, -- 1 Register, 0 Truncate
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @BatchDate SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherList VARCHAR(511), @AccountList VARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @RefAccountList VARCHAR(1023), @DepartmentList VARCHAR(33), @JobList VARCHAR(1023), @DebitCredit TINYINT, @Filter TINYINT, @Unit VARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @ps NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @BatchDate = ngay_ctgs, @DateFrom = ngay_ct1, @DateTo = ngay_ct2, @VoucherList = REPLACE(ds_ct, '''', ''), @AccountList = REPLACE(tk, '''', ''), @RefAccountList = REPLACE(tk_du, '''', ''), @DepartmentList = REPLACE(ma_bp, '''', ''), @JobList = REPLACE(ma_vv, '''', ''), @DebitCredit = no_co, @Filter = loc, @Unit = REPLACE(ma_dvcs, '''', '') FROM ctgs WHERE nam = @Year AND so_ctgs = @BatchNumber

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl

		-- Key
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
		SET @Key = 'status = ''1'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		IF @VoucherList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_ct', 'exactinlist', @VoucherList)
		IF @DepartmentList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_bp', 'inlist', @DepartmentList)
		IF @JobList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('ma_vv', 'inlist', @JobList)
		IF @Filter = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and isnull(so_ctgs, '''') = '''' and ngay_ctgs is null'
		IF @Filter = '3' SET @Key = @Key + ' and isnull(so_ctgs, '''') <> '''' and not ngay_ctgs is null'
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SET @s = 'update r00$%Partition set ngay_ctgs = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @BatchDate, 112) + ''', so_ctgs = ''' + REPLACE(@BatchNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where %[@Key]%'

		SET @Key2 = @Key
		IF @AccountList <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @AccountList)
		IF @RefAccountList <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @RefAccountList)
		IF @DebitCredit = 1 SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0'
		IF @DebitCredit = 2 SET @Key2 = @Key2 + ' and ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0'
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
