				SELECT @m = DATALENGTH(v) FROM #cttemp
				WHILE @m > 0 BEGIN
					SET @q = 'declare @ptr binary(16), @len int'
						+ ' select @s = substring(v, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @m >= 3000 THEN '3000' ELSE LTRIM(@m) END + '), @len = len(@s) from #cttemp'
						+ ' select @ptr = textptr(v) from #cttemp'
						+ ' updatetext #cttemp.v @ptr 0 @len'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@s nvarchar(4000) out', @v out

					INSERT INTO #ct SELECT CASE WHEN @encode_html = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$EncodeHtml(@v) ELSE @v END, ''
					--
					SELECT @m = DATALENGTH(v) FROM #cttemp
				END
				SELECT @m = DATALENGTH(e) FROM #cttemp
				WHILE @m > 0 BEGIN
					SET @q = 'declare @ptr binary(16), @len int'
						+ ' select @s = substring(e, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @m >= 3000 THEN '3000' ELSE LTRIM(@m) END + '), @len = len(@s) from #cttemp'
						+ ' select @ptr = textptr(e) from #cttemp'
						+ ' updatetext #cttemp.e @ptr 0 @len'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@s nvarchar(4000) out', @e out

					INSERT INTO #ct SELECT '', CASE WHEN @encode_html = 1 THEN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$EncodeHtml(@e) ELSE @e END
					--
					SELECT @m = DATALENGTH(e) FROM #cttemp
				END
				INSERT INTO #ct SELECT v2, e2 FROM #cttemp
				--
				SET @c = @c + 1 + CASE WHEN @nColspan > 0 THEN @nColspan - 1 ELSE 0 END
			END

			SET @q = 'insert into #ct select ''</tr>'', ''</tr>'''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @r = @r + 1
		END
		-- End Data

		SELECT @s = '</table>', @v = @s, @e = @s
		INSERT INTO #ct SELECT @v, @e
	END
	IF @strAfterFoot <> ''
		INSERT INTO #ct SELECT @strAfterFoot, @strAfterFoot

	/* End Footer */

	/* Result */
	DECLARE @ptrVal BINARY(16), @ptrVal2 BINARY(16)
	INSERT INTO #content SELECT '', ''
	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(id) FROM #ct
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		SELECT @v = v, @e = e FROM #ct WHERE id = @i
		SELECT @ptrVal = TEXTPTR(content), @ptrVal2 = TEXTPTR(content2) FROM #content
		UPDATETEXT #content.content @ptrVal NULL 0 @v
		UPDATETEXT #content.content2 @ptrVal2 NULL 0 @e
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	/* End Result */

	SELECT * FROM #content

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_LoadEInvoiceConversion]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @table VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(32), @provider INT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableName @VoucherCode, @table OUTPUT, @c OUTPUT

	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct AS so_ct_hddt, so_seri AS so_seri_hddt, ma_kh, ma_nt, t_tt_nt AS tien_nt INTO #result FROM m81$000000

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.tinh_trang_hddt in (''2'', ''3'') and isnull(c.chuyen_doi_yn, ''0'') = ''0'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @VoucherCode IN('PXD', 'HD5', 'HD6') SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ct between '''  + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''

	-- Provider
	IF ISNULL(@provider, 0) <> 8 SET @Key = '1 = 0'

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.so_ct_hddt, b.so_seri_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_nt
		, (a.t_tt_nt + ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDF' THEN 'a.t_km_nt' ELSE '0' END + ')
		from ' + @table + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$%Partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hddt01$%Partition c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			where %[' + @Key + ']%
'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	EXEC FastBusiness$Generate$Key @UserID, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct_hddt, a.so_seri_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.tien_nt, a.ma_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		FROM #result a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptContractBalance]
	@Type TINYINT,
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@Group1 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group0 CHAR(1),-- 1 - Khach hang, 0 - Khong
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(511)

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b1 FROM cdhd
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b2 FROM cdhd
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, a.ma_hd, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt, a.ma_kh, ten_hd, ten_hd2 INTO #report FROM #t a, dmhd b

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_hd <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @Group0 = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_hd1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_hd2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_hd3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = 'left join dmhd b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b2 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$ContractCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Contract, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b1 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Contract @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, @Contract, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_hd, '', du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b1
	END

	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''1'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key+ ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account )
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t select '''', a.ma_hd, ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '1' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ma_hd' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '1' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Summary
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, '''', a.ma_hd, sum(no_dk), sum(no_dk_nt), sum(co_dk), sum(co_dk_nt), sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), sum(no_ck), sum(no_ck_nt), sum(co_ck), sum(co_ck_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_hd)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_hd2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a left join dmhd b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_hd, ten_hd2', 'int, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString('ma_kh', @Order + '_hd' + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END END)
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'hd', 'no_dk, co_dk, ps_no, ps_co, no_ck, co_ck, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @o = @Order + '_hd' + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END END
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_hd, ten_hd2, no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(No_dk), SUM(Co_dk), SUM(No_dk_nt), SUM(Co_dk_nt), SUM(Ps_no), SUM(Ps_no_nt), SUM(Ps_co), SUM(Ps_co_nt), SUM(No_ck), SUM(Co_ck), SUM(No_ck_nt), SUM(Co_ck_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_hd, ten_hd as ten, ten_hd2 as ten2, ma_kh,'
	SET @q = @q + ' no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report order by ma_kh, sysorder, ' + @Order + '_hd' + CASE WHEN @Order = 'ma' THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END END + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptLeaveDetailed]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),	
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @WorkingDay CHAR(2)
	SELECT @Key = ''

	SELECT @WorkingDay = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_phep_cong'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ngay SMALLDATETIME, so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_cong = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkingDay), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + '''' 
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key +  ' and r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec'
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, ngay, so_gio)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, r.ngay, r.so_gio'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by r.stt_rec, r.ngay'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Order
	CREATE INDEX o ON #report (ma_nv, stt)

	SELECT ma_nv, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #v FROM #report GROUP BY ma_nv
	CREATE INDEX o ON #v (ma_nv, stt)

	CREATE TABLE #u(ma_nv VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #u (ma_nv) SELECT DISTINCT ma_nv FROM #v ORDER BY ma_nv
	CREATE INDEX o ON #u (ma_nv)
	
	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, ngay, so_gio) SELECT '', '', NULL, 0

	CREATE INDEX i ON #report ( ma_nv, ngay)
	SELECT CASE WHEN v.stt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE u.stt END AS tt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + ' ' + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, 
		ISNULL(e.vi_tri, '') AS vi_tri, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(t.ten_vtr, '') ELSE ISNULL(t.ten_vtr2, '') END AS ten_vi_tri, a.ngay AS ngay_nghi, a.so_gio
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #v v ON a.ma_nv = v.ma_nv AND a.stt = v.stt
			LEFT JOIN #u u ON a.ma_nv = u.ma_nv			
			LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrvt t ON e.vi_tri = t.ma_vtr
		ORDER BY a.ma_nv, a.ngay

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ARDelExRD](
	@cFC VARCHAR(33),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)
	
	DELETE cttt21 WHERE ngay_ct = @ngay_ct AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) 
		AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM cttt20 WHERE ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND ngay_ct <= @Ngay_ct AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1)
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SR]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 tt_yn INTO #updateSO FROM m76$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd INTO #afterUpdate FROM d76$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #updateSO SELECT tt_yn FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d64$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec

	-- Update SO Qty
	DECLARE @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSOIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_hd FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_xuat = sl_xuat - CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updateSO WHERE tt_yn = 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updateSO WHERE tt_yn = 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_xuat = sl_xuat - CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updateSO WHERE tt_yn = 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updateSO WHERE tt_yn = 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber,  @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber,  @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update SO
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE cddh13 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SCStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @SCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdytdd]
AS
SELECT	a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.ps_tk0, a.ps_tk_nt0, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.ps_tk2, a.ps_tk_nt2, a.dd_ck, 
	a.dd_ck_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, 
	a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_yt, c.ten_yt2
FROM	dbo.xcdytdd AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.vdmsp AS b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.xdmyt AS c ON a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt
WHERE	(a.nam IN
		(SELECT	nam_bd
		FROM	dbo.dmstt)) AND (a.ky = 0)

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vbidmts]
AS
SELECT controller, name, val, valdetail, a.ma_phan_he, a.stt_sx, descript, descript2, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) AS type,
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN SUBSTRING(inputmask, 4, LEN(inputmask)) ELSE '' END AS number_format,
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 2), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_val, 
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 3), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view, 
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 4), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view2, 
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmaskdetail, '^', ','), 2), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmbdetail_val, 
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmaskdetail, '^', ','), 3), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmbdetail_view, 
		CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmaskdetail, '^', ','), 4), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmbdetail_view2,
	
		CASE
			WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4)= 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(val, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask)), '')
			WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', '')) 
		ELSE val END AS val_view,
	
		CASE
			WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(val, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask)), 'E')
			WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', ''))
		ELSE val END AS val_view2,
	
		CASE
			WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 4)= 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(valdetail, SUBSTRING(inputmaskdetail, 5, LEN(inputmaskdetail)), '')
			WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(valdetail, REPLACE(inputmaskdetail, 'FN^', '')) 
		ELSE val END AS valdetail_view,
	
		CASE
			WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetInputmask(valdetail, SUBSTRING(inputmaskdetail, 5, LEN(inputmaskdetail)), 'E')
			WHEN LEFT(inputmaskdetail, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(valdetail, REPLACE(inputmaskdetail, 'FN^', ''))
		ELSE val END AS valdetail_view2,
	
		CASE WHEN inputmask = CHAR(255) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS check_list_yn,
		CASE WHEN [type] = 'C' AND (irregular_yn = 1 OR nb_yn = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS check_yn, irregular_yn,
		controller_lookup, key_lookup, check_lookup, upper_key, kind
	FROM dbo.bidmts a

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintITTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Site1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Site2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Term VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),	
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Reason VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT, 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@DataType CHAR(1) = '2' -- 1: Physics, 2: Book
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey VARCHAR(1024),@q NVARCHAR(4000), @tName VARCHAR(33)

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @tName = '85'
		ELSE SELECT @tName = '65'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon, dien_giai, tien_nt2 AS t_tien_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''	
	IF @Site1 <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site1), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Site2 <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site2), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Term <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Term), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#40$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  CASE 
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'
	
	IF (@Admin = 0) SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey('PXB', @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey
	
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kho, b.ma_khon, b.dien_giai, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i' + @tName + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m' + @tName + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin	

	SELECT DISTINCT 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon, a.dien_giai, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt 
		FROM #tmp a 
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_GetIdentityNumber] 
	@wsID AS CHAR(1), 
	@cCode CHAR(3), 
	@cTable CHAR(16)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @strSQL = 'DECLARE @e INT, @MaxIdentityNumber NUMERIC(9)' + CHAR(13)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'SET @e = 0' + CHAR(13)

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'UPDATE dmstt SET stt_rec = stt_rec + 1' + CHAR(13)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'SELECT @MaxIdentityNumber = stt_rec FROM dmstt' + CHAR(13)

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ' + RTRIM(@cTable) + ' WHERE stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @wsID + CHAR(39) + ' + REPLACE(STR(@MaxIdentityNumber, 9), % %, %0%) + %' + @cCode + '%)' + CHAR(13)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL +  'SELECT @e = 1, @MaxIdentityNumber = @MaxIdentityNumber + 1' + CHAR(13)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'IF @e = 1 UPDATE dmstt SET stt_rec = @MaxIdentityNumber' + CHAR(13)
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + 'SELECT (%' + @wsID +'% + REPLACE(STR(@MaxIdentityNumber, 9), % %, %0%) + %' + @cCode + '%) AS IdNumber' + CHAR(13)

	SELECT @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%', CHAR(39))

	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$TaxInformation$UpdateData]
	@unitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@dateFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@dateTo VARCHAR(32),
	@invoiceType INT, -- 1 - Hóa đơn, 2 - Phiếu xuất, 3 - Vé
	@tableName VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @tableName = REPLACE(@tableName, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = '
delete hddt02$%Partition from hddt02$%Partition a join ' + QUOTENAME(@tableName) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
insert into hddt02$%Partition(stt_rec, tax_status, ma_cqt, content, loai_sd)
	select stt_rec, status, ma_cqt, content, ' + RTRIM(@invoiceType) + ' from ' + @tableName + '
		where %[]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptGetReportData]
	@BaseTable VARCHAR(64),
	@PartitionType INT, -- Loại xử lý phân kỳ: 0 - Không phân kỳ, 1 - Phân kỳ theo yyyyMM, 5 - Phân kỳ theo yyyy.

	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,

	@VoucherFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherTo VARCHAR(32),

	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),

	@PurOrg VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGroup VARCHAR(32),
	@Plant VARCHAR(32),

	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(64), -- Một số trường hợp có dùng Controller: vd xét điều kiện với tab Giao dịch/xét quyền xem giá trị thì bắt buộc phải có
	@SysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64),


	@UnitField VARCHAR(32) = 'a.ma_dvcs', -- Để null hoặc rỗng thì không xét quyền Unit
	@SiteField VARCHAR(32) = 'a.ma_kho', -- Để null hoặc rỗng thì không xét quyền Site
	@PurOrgField VARCHAR(32) = 'a.ma_bp0', -- Để null hoặc rỗng thì không xét quyền Pur Org
	@PurOrgMode TINYINT = 0, -- 0 - Luôn xét quyền theo chuẩn, 1 - xét quyền trường hợp không khai báo quyền pur org thì bỏ qua để xét quyền chuẩn.
	@PurGroupField VARCHAR(32) = 'a.ma_nh0', -- Để null hoặc rỗng thì không xét quyền Pur Group
	@PurGroupMode TINYINT = 0, -- 0 - Luôn xét quyền theo chuẩn, tạm chưa dùng, đặt biến trước để giữ chỗ
	@PlantField VARCHAR(32) = 'a.ma_vung', -- Để null hoặc rỗng thì không xét quyền Plant
	@PlantMode TINYINT = 0, -- 0 - Luôn xét quyền theo chuẩn, 1 - Xét quyền plant theo kiểu bản ghi có plant rỗng xem như được quyền

	@QueryStatement NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@ReturnStatement NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@AutoReturn BIT = 1, -- 1 - Tự động trả kết quả, 0 - Chỉ lưu kết quả vào bảng tạm, không trả kết quả

	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@DataType  TINYINT = 0, -- 0 - Chạy bình thường theo @BaseTable, 1 - Sổ kho theo thực tế, 2 - Sổ kho theo hóa đơn, 3 - Sổ kho theo thực tế và đvt, 4 - Sổ kho theo hóa đơn và đvt

	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declaration
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @size INT, @p CHAR(6), @y INT, @i INT, @n INT, @s NVARCHAR(1024), @s1 NVARCHAR(1024), @s2 NVARCHAR(1024), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @plantKey NVARCHAR(1023), @purGroupKey NVARCHAR(1023), @purOrgKey NVARCHAR(1023), @siteKey NVARCHAR(1023), @unitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @field NVARCHAR(1024), @qField NVARCHAR(1024), @qJoin NVARCHAR(1024), @qGroup VARCHAR(128), @declareStr NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @rFieldOgrinal NVARCHAR(1024), @rField NVARCHAR(1024), @rJoin NVARCHAR(1024), @rOrder NVARCHAR(1024), @rCondition NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @field = '', @key = '', @plantKey = '', @purGroupKey = '', @purOrgKey = '', @siteKey = '', @unitKey = '', @rFieldOgrinal = '', @declareStr = ''
	SELECT @size = character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'wrkcolumns' and column_name = 'so_ct'
	UPDATE #rpt SET value = REPLACE(value, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END), ref = REPLACE(ref, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)

	-- Main Key
	SET @key = CASE WHEN @PartitionType <> 1 THEN 'a.ngay_ct between @dateFrom and @dateTo' ELSE '[1=1]' END
	IF @VoucherFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherFrom), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @VoucherTo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherTo), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''

	-- Right Key
	DECLARE @hasPurOrg BIT
	SET @hasPurOrg = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	IF ISNULL(@UnitField, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter(@UnitField, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	END ELSE IF @Unit <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_dvcs like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF ISNULL(@SiteField, '') <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter @SiteField, @Site, @unitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @siteKey OUTPUT
		IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @siteKey
	END
	IF @Site <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF ISNULL(@PurOrgField, '') <> '' AND (@PurOrgMode = '0' OR (@PurOrgMode = '1' AND @hasPurOrg = 1)) BEGIN
		SELECT @purOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter(@PurOrgField, @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @purOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @purOrgKey
	END
	IF @PurOrg <> '' AND @PurOrgMode = '1' AND @hasPurOrg = 0 SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurOrg), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF ISNULL(@PurGroupField, '') <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter @PurGroupField, @PurGroup, @unitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @purGroupKey OUTPUT, '2'
		IF @purGroupKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @purGroupKey
	END
	IF @PurGroup <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF ISNULL(@PlantField, '') <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter @PlantField, @Plant, @unitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @plantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @plantKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ((' + @plantKey + ') ' + CASE WHEN @Plant = '' AND @PlantMode = '1' THEN 'or ' + @PlantField + ' = ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	END
	IF @Plant <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''



	-- Function Key
	SELECT a.value, b.* INTO #sysfilter FROM #rpt a JOIN rptsysfilter b ON a.ref = b.name WHERE a.name = 'QueryFilter' AND ISNULL(a.value, '') <> ''

	SELECT @key = @key + ' and (' + REPLACE(condition, '[v]', CASE
		WHEN xtype = '' THEN REPLACE(value, '''', '''''')
		WHEN xtype = 'InList' THEN '''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(value, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''''
		ELSE '' END) + ')' FROM #sysfilter
	SELECT @key = @key + ' and (' + value + ref + ')' FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'QueryCondition'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'TransactionKey') BEGIN
		DECLARE @transactionType TINYINT
		SELECT @s1 = ref, @s2 = value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'TransactionKey'
		SELECT @transactionType = value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'TransactionType'
		IF @transactionType IS NULL SET @transactionType = 1
		EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @s1, @s2, @transactionType, @Controller, @SysDatabaseName, 'a.', @key OUTPUT
	END



	-- Dynamic Key
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @filterKey = REPLACE(@filterKey, value, ref) FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'DynamicKey'
		SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(@filterKey, '%[a]', 'a')
	END

	SELECT @key = REPLACE(@key, '[1=1] and ', ''), @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)


	-- Query Config
	SELECT @field = @field + CASE WHEN @field <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN ref <> '' THEN ref + '.' + REPLACE(value, ', ', ', ' + ref + '.') ELSE value END,
		@rFieldOgrinal = @rFieldOgrinal + CASE WHEN @rFieldOgrinal <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + REPLACE(value, ', ', ', a.') FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'Field'
	SELECT @qField = @field, @qJoin = '', @qGroup = ''
	SELECT @qField = @qField + CASE WHEN @qField <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN ref <> '' THEN ref + '.' + REPLACE(value, ', ', ', ' + ref + '.') ELSE value END FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'QueryField'

	SELECT @qJoin = @qJoin + ' ' + xjoin FROM (SELECT DISTINCT xjoin FROM #sysfilter) a
	SELECT @qJoin = @qJoin + ' ' + value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'QueryJoin'
	SELECT @qGroup = value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'QueryGroup'


	-- Query Parameter
	SELECT @s1 = '', @s2 = ''
	SELECT @s1 = @s1 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + name + ' ' + ref, @s2 = @s2 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + name + ' = ' + value FROM #rpt WHERE name LIKE '@%'
	SELECT @s1 = @s1 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + '@' + RTRIM(b.name) + ' ' + ref,
			@s2 = @s2 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + '@' + RTRIM(b.name) + ' = ' + CASE WHEN ref LIKE '%char%' OR ref LIKE '%date%' OR ref LIKE '%text%' THEN '''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(b.val), '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE REPLACE(b.val, '''', '') END
		FROM #rpt a JOIN options b ON a.value = b.name WHERE a.name = '$Options'
	SELECT @s1 = @s1 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + '@' + RTRIM(b.ccode) + ' ' + ref,
			@s2 = @s2 + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + '@' + RTRIM(b.ccode) + ' = N''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.cname ELSE b.cname2 END), '''', '''''') + ''''
		FROM #rpt a JOIN reports b ON a.value = b.ccode WHERE a.name = '$Reports'

	IF @s1 <> '' SET @declareStr = 'declare ' + @s1 + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + @s2


	-- Temp Table
	SET @q = 'select top 0 ' + @qField + char(13) + ' into #report from ' + @BaseTable + ' a' + @qJoin + CASE WHEN @qGroup <> '' THEN ' group by ' + @qGroup ELSE '' END
	IF @PartitionType = 1 SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Partition', '000000')
	IF @PartitionType = 2 SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Partition', '0000')
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select a.name, b.name, a.length, a.xprec, a.xscale from tempdb..syscolumns a left join systypes b on a.xtype = b.xtype and a.xusertype = b.xusertype where a.id = object_id(''tempdb..#report'')'
	CREATE TABLE #col(xname VARCHAR(64), xtype VARCHAR(64), xlength INT, xprec INT, xscale INT, id INT IDENTITY(1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #col EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT) AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS sysprint INTO #report FROM wrkcolumns
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(*) FROM #col
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'alter table #report add ' + xname + ' ' + xtype +
				CASE WHEN xtype IN ('char', 'nchar', 'varchar', 'nvarchar') THEN '(' + RTRIM(xlength) + ')'
				WHEN xtype IN ('numeric') THEN '(' + RTRIM(xprec) + ',' + RTRIM(xscale) + ')' ELSE '' END
			FROM #col WHERE id = @i
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END


	-- Dynamic Field
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Controller <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @TableName, @controller, @SysDatabaseName, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
		SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a'), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a')
	END

	-- Query
	DECLARE @groupDataField NVARCHAR(1024), @groupDataFunction NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @groupDataField = ref, @groupDataFunction = value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'GroupData'
	IF @groupDataField IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #groupData FROM #report
	END

	--
	SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @declareStr <> '' THEN @declareStr + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END, @s = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @groupDataField IS NULL THEN '#report' ELSE '#groupData' END + ' select 5, 1, 1, ' + @qField + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields + ' from '
	IF @DataType <> 0 BEGIN
		IF @DataType = '1' OR @DataType = '3' BEGIN -- 1: thuc te, 3: thuc te dvt
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @s + 'r90$%Partition a with(nolock)'
				+ @qJoin + @queryJoin + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @PartitionType = 1 THEN '%[' + @key + ']%' ELSE @key END + CASE WHEN @qGroup <> '' THEN ' group by ' + @qGroup ELSE '' END

			-- Physics
			DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
			EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
			SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
			SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
		END
		IF @DataType = '2' OR @DataType = '4' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @s + 'r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
				+ @qJoin + @queryJoin + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @PartitionType = 1 THEN '%[' + @key + ']%' ELSE @key END + CASE WHEN @qGroup <> '' THEN ' group by ' + @qGroup ELSE '' END
		END
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @s + @BaseTable + ' a'
			+ @qJoin + @queryJoin + ' where ' + CASE WHEN @PartitionType = 1 THEN '%[' + @key + ']%' ELSE @key END + CASE WHEN @qGroup <> '' THEN ' group by ' + @qGroup ELSE '' END
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		IF @PartitionType = 0 BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dateFrom smalldatetime, @dateTo smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo
		END ELSE IF @PartitionType = 1 BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		END IF @PartitionType = 5 BEGIN
			DECLARE @y1 INT, @y2 INT
			SELECT @y1 = YEAR(@DateFrom), @y2 = YEAR(@DateTo), @y = @y1
			WHILE @y <= @y2 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%Partition', LTRIM(@y))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dateFrom smalldatetime, @dateTo smalldatetime', @DateFrom, @DateTo
				SET @y = @y + 1
			END
		END
	END


	IF @groupDataField IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, ' + @groupDataFunction + CASE WHEN @sumFields <> '' THEN ', ' + @sumFields ELSE '' END + ' from #groupData a group by ' + @groupDataField
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END



	-- ItemOption
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ItemOption') BEGIN
		SELECT @s1 = NULL, @s2 = NULL
		SELECT * INTO #itemOpt FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ItemOption'
		SELECT @s1 = MIN(value) FROM #itemOpt
		WHILE @s1 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @s2 = '[' + REPLACE(REPLACE(ref, ' ', ''), ',', '],[') + ']', @s = '' FROM #itemOpt WHERE value = @s1
			SET @q = 'alter table #report add option_' + @s1 + ' nvarchar(1024)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = ''
			IF CHARINDEX('[bidmvttsvung]', @s2) > 0 SET @q = 'update #report set option_' + @s1 + ' = b.val from #report a join bidmvttsvung b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung where a.option_' + @s1 + ' is null and b.name = ''' + @s1 + ''''
			IF CHARINDEX('[bidmvttsbp0]', @s2) > 0 SET @q = 'update #report set option_' + @s1 + ' = b.val from #report a join bidmvttsbp0 with(nolock) b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 where a.option_' + @s1 + ' is null and b.name = ''' + @s1 + ''''
			IF CHARINDEX('[bidmvtts]', @s2) > 0 SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + 'update #report set option_' + @s1 + ' = b.val from #report a join bidmvtts b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where a.option_' + @s1 + ' is null and b.name = ''' + @s1 + ''''
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @s1 = MIN(value) FROM #itemOpt WHERE value > @s1
		END
	END

	-- CustomerOption
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'VendorOption') BEGIN
		SELECT @s1 = NULL, @s2 = NULL
		SELECT * INTO #vendorOpt FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'VendorOption'
		SELECT @s1 = MIN(value) FROM #vendorOpt
		WHILE @s1 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @s2 = '[' + REPLACE(REPLACE(ref, ' ', ''), ',', '],[') + ']', @s = '' FROM #vendorOpt WHERE value = @s1
			SET @q = 'alter table #report add option_' + @s1 + ' nvarchar(1024)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = ''
			IF CHARINDEX('[bidmncctsbp0]', @s2) > 0 SET @q = 'update #report set option_' + @s1 + ' = b.val from #report a join bidmncctsbp0 with(nolock) b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 where a.option_' + @s1 + ' is null and b.name = ''' + @s1 + ''''
			IF CHARINDEX('[bidmnccts]', @s2) > 0 SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + 'update #report set option_' + @s1 + ' = b.val from #report a join bidmnccts b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where a.option_' + @s1 + ' is null and b.name = ''' + @s1 + ''''
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @s1 = MIN(value) FROM #vendorOpt WHERE value > @s1
		END
	END


	IF ISNULL(@QueryStatement, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = CASE WHEN @declareStr <> '' THEN @declareStr + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + @QueryStatement
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END





	-- GroupRow, GroupName and Order
	DECLARE @groupRowOrder VARCHAR(128), @orderDetail VARCHAR(128), @orderKey VARCHAR(1024), @groupFunctionField VARCHAR(128), @groupFunctionRef NVARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @groupFunctionField = '', @groupFunctionRef = '', @groupRowOrder = '', @orderDetail = '', @orderKey = ''
	SELECT @orderDetail = value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'OrderDetail'

	-- Add Group by Row
	DECLARE @groupOrderField VARCHAR(64), @groupOrderKey VARCHAR(512), @groupOrderMin VARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @groupOrderField = '', @groupOrderKey = '', @groupOrderMin = ''
	SELECT *, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #groupRow FROM #rpt WHERE name IN ('GroupRow', 'GroupRow2', 'GroupRow3') ORDER BY name
	SELECT @n = COUNT(*), @i = 1 FROM #groupRow
	SELECT @groupFunctionRef = value, @groupFunctionField = ref FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'GroupFunction'
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'order_group' + CASE WHEN @i = 1 THEN '' ELSE LTRIM(@i) END, @orderKey = ''
		SELECT @s1 = value FROM #groupRow WHERE stt = @i

		SET @q = 'alter table #report add ' + @s + ' int'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @s2 = CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN @groupOrderField + ', ' ELSE '' END + @s1
		SELECT @orderKey = @orderKey + CASE WHEN @orderKey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + LTRIM(data) + ' = ' + 'b.' + LTRIM(data) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@s2, ',')

		SET @q = 'select ' + @s2 + ', identity(int, 1, 1) as id_g into #g from #report where sysorder = 5 group by ' + @s2 + ' order by '  + @s2 + ' option(maxdop 1)'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ' + @s + ' = b.id_g' + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN ' - c.min_id + 1 ' ELSE '' END + ' from #report a join #g b on ' + @orderKey
				+ CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN ' join (select ' + @groupOrderField + ', min(id_g) as min_id from #g group by ' + @groupOrderField + ') c on ' + @groupOrderKey ELSE '' END
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @groupFunctionField <> ''  BEGIN
			SET @q =  'insert into #report(sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ' + @s1 + ', ' + @s + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN ', ' + @groupOrderField ELSE '' END + ', ' + @groupFunctionField + ')'
				+ ' select ' + LTRIM(@i + 1) + ', 0, 1, ' + @s1 + ', min(' + @s + ')' + CASE WHEN @groupOrderMin <> '' THEN ', ' + @groupOrderMin ELSE '' END + ', ' + @groupFunctionRef
				+ ' from #report where sysorder = 5 group by ' + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN @groupOrderField + ', ' ELSE '' END + @s + ', ' + @s1
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SELECT @groupOrderField = @groupOrderField + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @s,
			@groupOrderKey = @groupOrderKey + CASE WHEN @groupOrderKey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + @s + ' = c.' + @s,
			@groupOrderMin = @groupOrderMin + CASE WHEN @groupOrderMin <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + 'min(' + @s + ')'
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END


	-- Order Number
	IF @orderDetail <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'alter table #report add order_detail int'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = 'select cast(id as int) as id' + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN ', ' + @groupOrderField ELSE '' END + ', identity(int, 1, 1) as id_o into #o'
			+ ' from #report where sysorder = 5 order by ' + CASE WHEN @groupOrderField <> '' THEN @groupOrderField + ', ' ELSE '' END + @orderDetail + ' option(maxdop 1)'

		IF @groupOrderField <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set order_detail = b.id_o - c.min_id + 1' --+ CASE WHEN @groupFunctionField = '' THEN ' + 1' ELSE '' END
				+ ' from #report a join #o b on a.id = b.id join (select ' + @groupOrderField + ', min(id_o) as min_id from #o group by ' + @groupOrderField + ') c on ' + @groupOrderKey + ' where a.sysorder = 5'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set order_detail = b.id_o from #report a join #o b on a.id = b.id where a.sysorder = 5'
		END
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	-- Add GroupName by List
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #groupRow WHERE ref <> '') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'GroupTotal') EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #report add group_name nvarchar(512)'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #groupRow WHERE ref <> '') BEGIN
		SET @i = NULL
		SELECT @i = MIN(stt), @q = '' FROM #groupRow WHERE ref <> ''
		WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @s1 = ref, @s2 = value, @s = '' FROM #groupRow WHERE stt = @i
			SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + LTRIM(data) + ' = b.' + LTRIM(data) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@s2, ',')
			SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + 'update a set group_name = b.group_name from #report a join (' + @s1 + ') b on ' + @s + ' where sysorder = ' + LTRIM(@i + 1)
			SELECT @i = MIN(stt) FROM #groupRow WHERE ref <> '' AND stt > @i
		END

		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set group_name = N''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END), '''', '''''') + ''' where sysorder in (2, 3, 4) and group_name is null' FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NoGroup'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Add Group Total
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'GroupTotal') BEGIN
		SELECT @s1 = REPLACE(value, ' ', ''), @s2 = REPLACE(ref, ' ', ''), @q = '', @s = '', @q = '' FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'GroupTotal'
		SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + data, @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'sum(' + data + ')' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@s1, ',')

		SELECT @q =  'insert into #report(sysorder, systotal, sysprint, ' + @s1 + ', ' + @groupFunctionField + CASE WHEN @totalFields <> '' THEN ', ' + @totalFields ELSE '' END + ')'
			+ ' select 0, 0, 0, N''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END), '''', '''''') + ''', ' + @groupFunctionRef + CASE WHEN @sumTotalFields <> '' THEN ', ' + @sumTotalFields ELSE '' END
			+ ' from #report where ' + CASE WHEN @s2 <> '' THEN @s2 ELSE 'systotal = 1' END
			+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report(sysorder, systotal, sysprint) select 1, 0, 0'
			 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Auto Update Null value
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'UpdateNull') BEGIN
		SELECT *, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #null FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'UpdateNull'
		SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(*), @s = '' FROM #null
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN value <> '' THEN value ELSE '''''' END, @s2 = REPLACE(ref, ' ', '') FROM #null WHERE id = @i
			SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @s <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + data + ' = isnull(' + data + ', ' + @s1 + ')' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@s2, ',')
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set ' + @s
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Limit Value Fields
	IF @Controller <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @valueStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDatabaseName, @valueStatement OUTPUT
		IF @valueStatement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @valueStatement
	END




	-- Return
	IF @AutoReturn = 1 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, systotal, sysprint) SELECT 5, 1, 1

		SELECT @rField = '', @rJoin = '', @rOrder = '', @rCondition = ''
		SELECT @rField = @rField + CASE WHEN @rField <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN ref <> '' THEN ref + '.' + REPLACE(value, ', ', ', ' + ref + '.') ELSE value END FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ReturnField'

		IF CHARINDEX('a.*', @rField) <= 0 SET @rField = @rFieldOgrinal + CASE WHEN @rFieldOgrinal <> '' AND @rField <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + @rField
		SELECT @rJoin = @rJoin + ' ' + value FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ReturnJoin'
		SELECT @rCondition = @rCondition + CASE WHEN @rCondition <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '(' + value + ref + ')' END FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ReturnCondition'

		SELECT @rOrder = @rOrder + CASE WHEN @rOrder <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN ref <> '' THEN ref + '.' + REPLACE(value, ', ', ', ' + ref + '.') ELSE value END FROM #rpt WHERE name = 'ReturnOrder'
		IF @rOrder = '' BEGIN
			IF @groupOrderField <> '' SET @rOrder = @rOrder + CASE WHEN @rOrder <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + @groupOrderField
			SET @rOrder = @rOrder + CASE WHEN @rOrder <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'a.sysorder'
			IF @orderDetail <> '' SET @rOrder = @rOrder + CASE WHEN @rOrder <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'a.order_detail'
		END

		SET @q = CASE WHEN @declareStr <> '' THEN @declareStr + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END
			+ CASE WHEN ISNULL(@ReturnStatement, '') <> '' THEN @ReturnStatement + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END
			+ 'select ' + @rField + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
			+ ' from #report a' + @rJoin + @baseJoin + CASE WHEN @rCondition <> '' THEN ' where ' + @rCondition ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @rOrder <> '' THEN CHAR(13) + ' order by ' + @rOrder ELSE '' END
		IF @Language = 'V' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', '2')
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF ISNULL(@ReturnStatement, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = CASE WHEN @declareStr <> '' THEN @declareStr + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + @ReturnStatement
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT CHAR(13) + @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcDisCoeffByBOM]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@FactorCode VARCHAR(1023),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @nCoeffRound INT, @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nCoeffRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'X_ROUND_HS'
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'
	
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	SELECT @Key2 = CASE WHEN @FactorCode <> '' THEN 'a.ma_yt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@FactorCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE '' END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, loai_yt, sl_sx INTO #ctsl FROM xcdloaiytdd2
	SET @q = 'insert into #ctsl select ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, loai_yt, sum(sl_sx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdloaiytdd2 a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, loai_yt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_sp INTO #tProduct FROM #ctsl
	CREATE INDEX k ON #tProduct(ma_sp)
	
	CREATE TABLE #ctdmtmp (ma_sp VARCHAR(33), ma_vt VARCHAR(33), so_luong NUMERIC(24, 12))
	INSERT INTO #ctdmtmp(ma_sp, ma_vt, so_luong) EXEC xs20_COGetMaterialsFromBOMByProduct @dTo, '#tProduct'

	SET @q = 'update #ctdmtmp set ma_vt = a.ma_vt0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #ctdmtmp b join xdmvt2 a with(nolock) ON b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT ma_sp, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong INTO #ctdm FROM #ctdmtmp GROUP BY ma_sp, ma_vt

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt from xdmyt a with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key2 ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_dvcs, b.ma_yt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS he_so
		INTO #dt FROM wrkin a, #xdmyt b	

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #dt select a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, %ma_bp, %so_lsx, d.ma_dvcs, d.ma_yt, 0 from #ctdm a'
		SET @q = CASE WHEN @costDept = 1 THEN REPLACE(@q, '%ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp') + ' cross join (select distinct ma_bp from #ctsl) b' ELSE REPLACE(@q, '%ma_bp', '''''') END
		SET @q = CASE WHEN @costMO = 1 THEN REPLACE(@q, '%so_lsx', 'c.so_lsx') + ' cross join (select distinct so_lsx from #ctsl) c' ELSE REPLACE(@q, '%so_lsx', '''''') END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #dt select a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, b.ma_bp, c.so_lsx, d.ma_dvcs, d.ma_yt, 0 from #ctdm a'
		SET @q = @q + ' cross join (select distinct ma_bp from #ctsl) b'
		SET @q = @q + ' cross join (select distinct so_lsx from #ctsl) c'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ' cross join (select distinct ma_dvcs, ma_yt from #xdmyt) d'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	
	CREATE INDEX k ON #dt(ma_dvcs, ma_yt)
	
	UPDATE #dt SET he_so = ROUND(so_luong * b.sl_sx, @nCoeffRound)
		FROM #dt a WITH(INDEX(k))
			LEFT JOIN #xdmyt c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt
			JOIN #ctsl b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND c.loai_yt = b.loai_yt

	SET @q = 'delete xctpbtg from xctpbtg a where ' + @Key + ' and ma_yt in (select distinct ma_yt from #dt)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_dvcs, ma_yt INTO #scandt FROM #dt GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_yt ORDER BY ma_yt

	DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_yt VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @i = 1, @n = ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #scandt
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_yt = ma_yt FROM #scandt WHERE id = @i
		INSERT INTO xctpbtg (ma_dvcs, ky, nam, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
			SELECT a.ma_dvcs, @Period, @Year, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, b.ma_bp0, a.he_so, 0, 0, 0
					, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID 
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
				FROM #dt a WITH(INDEX(k)) 
					CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp0 FROM xcppstk WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
				WHERE a.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND a.ma_yt = @ma_yt AND a.he_so <> 0
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO

BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @m + ' set f' + RTRIM(@j) + ' = ''' + @r + ''' where n = ' + RTRIM(@i)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END
