CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight]
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@tableName VARCHAR(32),
	@primaryKey VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@admin INT,
	@result TINYINT OUTPUT,
	@multiUnit CHAR(1) = '0',
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @result = 0

	IF @voucherCode = '' RETURN
	IF @admin = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @result = 1
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @count INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @TablePrime VARCHAR(64), @unit VARCHAR(64), @menuID VARCHAR(32), @k TINYINT, @userID0 INT
	SELECT @menuID = '', @k = 1

	-- Full Read
	IF @sysDatabaseName <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @menuID = ltrim(rtrim(menu_id)) from [' + REPLACE(@sysDatabaseName, '''', '') + ']..wcommand where syscode = @voucherCode'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @menuID varchar(32) output', @voucherCode, @menuID OUTPUT
		IF @menuID <> '' SELECT @k = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID AND CHARINDEX(@menuID + '.101R', r_read) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	END


	SELECT @TablePrime = prime_table FROM dmctktq WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs INTO #$unitRight FROM wrksvtran

	IF @voucherID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @unit = ma_dvcs, @userID0 = user_id0 from ' + @TablePrime + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @unit varchar(64) output, @userID0 int output', @voucherID, @unit OUTPUT, @userID0 OUTPUT
		-- Full Read
		IF @userID <> @userID0 AND @k = 0 BEGIN
			EXEC('drop table #$unitRight')
			RETURN
		END

		INSERT INTO #$unitRight SELECT @unit

		GOTO Result
	END

	IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9A-Za-z_$#]%', @tableName) > 0 RETURN

	-- Full Read
	IF @k = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @k = case when exists(select 1 from ' + @TablePrime + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@primaryKey, '''', '')) + '] where a.user_id0 <> @userID) then 0 else 1 end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@userID int, @k tinyint output', @userID, @k OUTPUT
		IF @k = 0 BEGIN
			EXEC('drop table #$unitRight')
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Multi Unit
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #$unitRight select distinct a.ma_dvcs from ' + @TablePrime + ' a join ' + @tableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@primaryKey, '''', '')) + ']'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @count = COUNT(1) FROM #$unitRight

	IF @count = 0 OR (@count > 1 AND @multiUnit = '0') BEGIN
		EXEC('drop table #$unitRight')
		RETURN
	END

Result:
	SELECT @result = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$unitRight a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysunitrights b WHERE b.user_id = @userID AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND b.r_access = 1)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

	DROP TABLE #$unitRight

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$Discount]
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@isFc BIT,
	@isDiscount BIT,
	@Type INT,
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@amountField VARCHAR(128) OUTPUT,
	@discountField VARCHAR(128) OUTPUT,
	@discountResultField VARCHAR(128) OUTPUT,
	@discountDetailField VARCHAR(128) OUTPUT,
	@discountDetailResultField VARCHAR(128) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Discount
	SELECT @discountField = '', @discountResultField = '', @discountDetailField = '', @discountDetailResultField = ''
	IF @isDiscount = 1 BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode IN ('HD1', 'HD5', 'HD7') SELECT @amountField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN mamount_ck ELSE fcmamount_ck END FROM hddtfields WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND xtype = @Type

		IF @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD5', 'HD7', 'HDF') SELECT @discountField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN ',a.t_ck' ELSE ',a.t_ck_nt' END, @discountDetailField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN ',a.ck' ELSE ',a.ck_nt' END
		ELSE SELECT @discountField = ',0', @discountDetailField = ',0'

		SELECT @discountResultField = ', t_ck', @discountDetailResultField = ', ck'

		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 t_ck from wrksvtran'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn @masterTable, @q

		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ck from wrksvdetail'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn @detailTable, @q
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptContractDetail] --fs20_ARContractDetail--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ContractKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du
			, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, ma_hd
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	--Key		 
	SELECT @Key = 'status = ''1''', @ContractKey = ''
	SELECT @ContractKey = 'a.ma_hd = ''' + REPLACE(@Contract, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @ContractKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', ma_kh, dien_giai, tk_du'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, line_nbr, ma_hd'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk)) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s1 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 =  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'CLBAL'

	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$ContractCustomer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, '', @Customer, 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, '', @ContractKey
	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t

	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1,
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
					)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
				VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
					CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
					)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES  (3, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SELECT a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.sysorder, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk_du
			, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, ma_hd
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report a 
			LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh 
			LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct 
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, c.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcDisCoeffByProductReciept]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@FactorCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @nCoeffRound INT, @isDept TINYINT, @isMO TINYINT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_yt VARCHAR(33), @loai_yt VARCHAR(33), @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)
	
	SELECT @nCoeffRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'X_ROUND_HS'
	SELECT @costDept = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'X_DT_BP'
	SELECT @costMO = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'X_DT_LSX'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @FactorCode <> '' SET @Key = 'a.ma_yt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@FactorCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so INTO #dt FROM xctpbtg
	SELECT * INTO #dttmp FROM #dt
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_bp0, ma_vt INTO #xcppstk FROM xcppstk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
	SET @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs(ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	
	
	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt(ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @objectUnit = '0' THEN '1, ' + @costDept + ', ' + @costMO ELSE 'b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a with(nolock)' 
	IF @objectUnit = '1' SET @q = @q + ' join #dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, ma_yt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF @objectUnit = '1' UPDATE #xdmyt SET x_dt_sp = 1, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0


	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(id) FROM #xdmyt
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_yt = ma_yt, @loai_yt = loai_yt, @isDept = x_dt_bp, @isMO = x_dt_lsx FROM #xdmyt WHERE id = @i
		--
		DELETE xctpbtg WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt

		TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
		INSERT INTO #dt(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
			SELECT @ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, '', '', ROUND(sl_sx, @nCoeffRound)
				FROM xcdloaiytdd2 WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND loai_yt = @loai_yt

		IF @isDept = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_bp <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, b.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END

		IF @isMO = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE so_lsx <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, b.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT so_lsx FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END

		-- Indirect dept
		IF  NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_bp0 <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, b.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp0 FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END
		-- End

		-- Item
		IF  NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_vt <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END
		-- End

		INSERT INTO xctpbtg (ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt
					, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
					, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
					, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
					)			
			SELECT @Period, @Year, @ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, 0, 0, 0
					, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
				FROM #dt
				WHERE he_so <> 0
			--			
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptLeaveTimeDetailed]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@WorkdayList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Key = ''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ngay SMALLDATETIME, ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), stt_ref INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @WorkdayList <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkdayList), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT ma_cong, stt INTO #cong FROM hrdmcong WHERE kieu_cong = 9
	CREATE INDEX o ON #cong (ma_cong)

	SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec join #cong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong'
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ngay, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.stt_rec, max(a.ma_nv), r.ma_bp, r.ngay, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio), sum(r.so_ngay), max(c.stt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.ma_cong, r.stt_rec, r.ngay, r.ma_bp order by r.ma_cong, r.stt_rec, r.ngay, r.ma_bp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Order
	CREATE INDEX o ON #report (ma_cong, ma_nv, stt)

	SELECT ma_cong, ma_nv, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #v FROM #report GROUP BY ma_cong, ma_nv
	CREATE INDEX o ON #v ( ma_cong, ma_nv, stt)

	CREATE TABLE #u(ma_cong VARCHAR(32), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #u (ma_cong, ma_nv) SELECT DISTINCT ma_cong, ma_nv FROM #v ORDER BY ma_cong, ma_nv
	CREATE INDEX o ON #u ( ma_cong, ma_nv)

	SELECT ma_cong, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #u GROUP BY ma_cong

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ngay, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref) SELECT '', '', '', NULL, '', 0, 0, 0
	CREATE INDEX i ON #report (stt_ref, ma_cong, ma_nv, ngay, bo_phan)
	SELECT CASE WHEN v.stt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE u.stt - o.stt + 1 END AS tt, a.stt_rec, a.ngay, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, 
			RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + ' ' + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_cong ELSE c.ten_cong2 END AS ten_cong
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #v v ON a.ma_cong = v.ma_cong AND a.ma_nv = v.ma_nv AND a.stt = v.stt
			LEFT JOIN #u u ON a.ma_cong = u.ma_cong AND a.ma_nv = u.ma_nv
			LEFT JOIN #order o ON a.ma_cong = o.ma_cong
			LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong
		ORDER BY a.stt_ref, a.ma_cong, a.ma_nv, a.ngay, a.bo_phan

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APCalReverseExRD]( 
	@cFC VARCHAR(33),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)

	DECLARE @sReverseAcc VARCHAR(255), @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @sReverseAcc = RTRIM(Val)  FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_DS_TK_DAO'

	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)

	SELECT * INTO #cttt31 FROM cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @Ngay_ct -1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM cttt30 WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1)
	DELETE #cttt31 FROM #cttt31 a JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(b.tk, @sReverseAcc) = 0
	DELETE #cttt31 FROM #cttt31 a JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(b.ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 0
	UPDATE #cttt31 SET ngay_ct = @Ngay_ct, ngay_lct = @Ngay_ct, ky = @nCycle, nam = @nYear, ty_gia_dg = b.ty_gia, tien_cl_no = - a.tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co = - a.tien_cl_co, status = '2'
		FROM #cttt31 a JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec

	UPDATE #cttt31 SET tien_cl_no = - tien_cl_co WHERE tien_cl_no = 0
	UPDATE #cttt31 SET tien_cl_co = - tien_cl_no WHERE tien_cl_co = 0
	UPDATE #cttt31 SET tien_cl_no = 0 WHERE tien_cl_no < 0
	UPDATE #cttt31 SET tien_cl_co = 0 WHERE tien_cl_co < 0

	DELETE cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @Ngay_ct AND ma_nt = @cFC AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM cttt30 WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1)
	INSERT INTO cttt31 SELECT * FROM #cttt31
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$ST]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hopdong
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d67$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_px <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> '''') and giao_yn = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d64$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c81$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_px <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_px = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c66$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_px = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hopdong = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cSVIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSIIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSVIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSIIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSOIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hopdong VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_hd, dyn_px, dyn_dh, dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cLineSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSVIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d81$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cLineSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_px) AS dyn_px, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hopdong) AS dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSVIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m81$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdvtdd]
AS
SELECT	a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_yt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dk, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.sl_tk, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt, a.sl_gt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, a.sl_ck, a.dd_ck, 
	a.dd_ck_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, 
	a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, d.ten_yt, d.ten_yt2
FROM	dbo.xcdvtdd AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.xdmyt AS d ON a.ma_yt = d.ma_yt
WHERE	(1 = 0)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetInputmask](@val NVARCHAR(4000), @strString NVARCHAR(4000), @clan CHAR(1))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
BEGIN
	IF @strString = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @seperate CHAR(1), @result NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @seperate = '^'
	
	DECLARE @index INT, @iVal INT, @strVal NVARCHAR(4000), @strDescript NVARCHAR(4000), @strView NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @index = CHARINDEX(@seperate, @strString)
	SELECT @strVal = LEFT(@strString, @index - 1)
	SELECT @strDescript = SUBSTRING(@strString, @index + 1, LEN(@strString)), @index = CHARINDEX(@seperate, @strDescript)
	SELECT @strView = CASE WHEN @clan = 'E' THEN SUBSTRING(@strDescript, @index + 1, LEN(@strDescript)) ELSE SUBSTRING(@strDescript, 0, @index)END
	SELECT TOP 1 @iVal = id FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@strVal, '@') WHERE data = @val
	SELECT @result = data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@strView, '@') WHERE id = @iVal
	RETURN @result
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_COUpdateProductPrice2GL]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Tran VARCHAR(511), 
	@Dept VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(64), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @vcList VARCHAR(256), 
		@post_vv TINYINT, @post_sp TINYINT, @post_bp TINYINT, @post_hd TINYINT, @post_ku TINYINT, @post_phi TINYINT, @post_lsx TINYINT, @post_td1 TINYINT, @post_td2 TINYINT, @post_td3 TINYINT
	
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.tk_vt AS tk, a.tk_du, 
			a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, 
			a.tien_nhap AS tien, a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, 
			b.post_vv, b.post_sp, b.post_bp, b.post_hd, b.post_ku, b.post_phi, b.post_lsx, b.post_td1, b.post_td2, b.post_td3
		INTO #tintmp0
		FROM ct70 a, dmct b

	SELECT @Tran = REPLACE(@Tran, '''', ''), @Dept = REPLACE(@Dept, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	-- Unit Key
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = 1) SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')

	CREATE TABLE #stt_rec (stt_rec CHAR(13))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt_rec select distinct a.stt_rec from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct join vdmsp c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[nxt = 1 and a.ma_gd' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Tran) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Tran, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + @Tran + '''' END
	IF @Dept <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT @q = @q + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin
	CREATE INDEX i ON #stt_rec(stt_rec)


	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tintmp0 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.tk_vt, a.tk_du, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x, b.post_vv, b.post_sp, b.post_bp, b.post_hd, b.post_ku, b.post_phi, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'b.post_lsx, b.post_td1, b.post_td2, b.post_td3'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct %[where exists(select 1 from #stt_rec c where a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec)]%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin	

	-- Update
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_sp = CASE WHEN b.post_sp = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_sp END, 
			ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.post_bp = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_bp END, 
			ma_hd = CASE WHEN b.post_hd = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_hd END, 
			ma_ku = CASE WHEN b.post_ku = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_ku END, 
			ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.post_phi = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_phi END, 
			so_lsx = CASE WHEN b.post_lsx = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.so_lsx END, 
			ma_td1 = CASE WHEN b.post_td1 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td1 END, 
			ma_td2 = CASE WHEN b.post_td2 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td2 END, 
			ma_td3 = CASE WHEN b.post_td3 = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.ma_td3 END
		FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, tk, tk_du, 
			 ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, 
			SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #tintmp FROM #tintmp0
		GROUP BY ma_ct, stt_rec, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
	CREATE INDEX i ON #tintmp(stt_rec, tk, tk_du)
	
	-- Update *00	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) SELECT @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)
		ELSE SELECT @dyn = ''
		
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct INTO #dsct FROM #tintmp
	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @post_vv = post_vv, @post_sp = post_sp, @post_bp = post_bp, @post_hd = post_hd, @post_ku = post_ku, @post_phi = post_phi, @post_lsx = post_lsx, 
			@post_td1 = post_td1, @post_td2 = post_td2, @post_td3 = post_td3 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct

		SELECT @vcList = NULL
		SELECT @vcList = ISNULL(@vcList, '') + CASE WHEN @vcList IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ',' END + ma_ct FROM dmct
			WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM #dsct) AND post_vv = @post_vv AND post_sp = @post_sp AND post_bp = @post_bp AND
				 post_hd = @post_hd AND post_ku = @post_ku AND post_phi = @post_phi AND post_lsx = @post_lsx AND 
				post_td1 = @post_td1 AND post_td2 = @post_td2 AND post_td3 = @post_td3
		DELETE #dsct WHERE CHARINDEX(ma_ct, @vcList) > 0
		SELECT @vcList = ' where a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @vcList) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@vcList, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + @vcList + '''' END

		SELECT @Key = ''
		IF @post_vv = 1 SELECT @Key = ' and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
		IF @post_sp = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp'
		IF @post_bp = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
		IF @post_hd = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
		IF @post_ku = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku'
		IF @post_phi = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'
		IF @post_lsx = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
		IF @post_td1 = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_td1 = b.ma_td1'
		IF @post_td2 = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_td2 = b.ma_td2'
		IF @post_td3 = 1 SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_td3 = b.ma_td3'

		SELECT @q = 'update ct00 set ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.tk_du = b.tk_du' + @Key + @vcList + ' and (cast(line_nbr as int) % 2) = 0'

		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ct00 set ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk_du = b.tk and a.tk = b.tk_du' + @Key + @vcList + ' and (cast(line_nbr as int) % 2) = 1'

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		-- r00
		IF @dyn <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@q, 'ct00', @dyn)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q	
		END
		
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBISAStatusReport] --rs_rptPOPIStatusReport
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@POFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@POTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@DueDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Status VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@VCType VARCHAR(32),
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PlantKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @Status = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '*', '1, 2, 3, 4, 5')
	SET @GroupBy = CASE WHEN RTRIM(@GroupBy) = '1' THEN  'a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec' WHEN RTRIM(@GroupBy) = '2' THEN  'a.ma_vt, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec' ELSE 'a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.status, a.ma_ct, a.ty_gia, a.ma_nt, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.ngay_giao, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt
		, b.so_luong, b.sl_nhap AS sl_nhan, b.sl_hd, b.sl_tl0, b.sl_tl0 AS sl_cl, a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, b.ma_vung
	INTO #report FROM bim06$000000 a, bid06$000000 b

	SELECT @Key = 'b.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')', @Join = '', @q = ''
	IF @POFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@POFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @POTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@POTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kho0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VCType <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ct = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DueDate IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ngay_giao <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DueDate, 112) + ''' or a.ngay_giao is null)'

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'b.ma_kho0', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or b.ma_kho0 = '''')'

	IF @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('b.ma_bp0', @PurOrgCode, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	END
	IF @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'b.ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGrKey OUTPUT, '2'
		IF @PurGrCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGrCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PurGrKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PurGrKey + ')'
	END
	IF @PlantCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PlantCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PlantKey + ')'
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = '
insert into #report
	select b.ma_dvcs, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.ma_kh, b.status, b.ma_ct, b.ty_gia, b.ma_nt, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.ngay_giao, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.so_luong
			, (a.sl_nhap + a.sl_tl0) as sl_nhan, a.sl_hd, a.sl_tl0, (a.so_luong - a.sl_nhap) as sl_cl, b.stt_rec, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung
		from bid06$%Partition a with(nolock) join bim06$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt_rec, ma_vt, ma_kh, ma_ct, ma_dvcs', 'VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(33), VARCHAR(1023)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, so_luong, sl_nhan, sl_hd, sl_tl0, sl_cl) VALUES(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select a.*, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.statusname' ELSE 'e.statusname2' END + ' as status2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE 'b.ten_kh2' END + ' as ten_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE 'c.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct left join dmttct e on a.ma_ct = e.ma_ct and a.status = e.status order by ' + @GroupBy
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_PostS7Tran]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @loai_ct CHAR(1), @rq TINYINT, @rcIDNumber CHAR(13), @rVCCode CHAR(3), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @dien_giai NVARCHAR(256), @doi_tac NVARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT TOP 1 @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @p = RIGHT(@masterTable, 6)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #master FROM ms7$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, so_luong AS sl_nhap1, so_luong AS sl_nhap, so_luong AS sl_xuat1, so_luong AS sl_xuat INTO #detail FROM ds7$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #sfctpx FROM sfctpx$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select *, so_luong, so_luong, so_luong, so_luong from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_ct = ma_ct, @loai_ct = loai_ct, @dien_giai = dien_giai FROM #master

	SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#sfctpx', '#detail', '#sfctpx', '#detail', NULL, NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$Post$UpdateFields '#sfctpx', '#master', '#detail', 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', '', '', '', ''

	IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
		-- Post xuong
		UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 2, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_vi_tri = '', loai = '', ma_nc = '', ma_nh = '', ma_ca = '', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
			sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so, @rq), sl_nhap = 0, sl_nhap1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, xtab = 1

		SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


		-- Post PNH
		SELECT @rVCCode = 'PNH'
		SELECT @rcIDNumber = LEFT(@idNumber, 10) + @rVCCode

		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #m34 FROM m34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #d34 FROM d34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
		SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #i34 FROM i34$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#m34', '#master', '#m34', '#master', null, null)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Insert('#d34', '#detail', '#d34', '#detail', null, null)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @ma_kh = MAX(ma_kh) FROM sfctnx a WHERE status = '1' AND kind = '1' AND ma_ct = @ma_ct AND loai_ct = @loai_ct AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail b WHERE a.ma_px = b.ma_px)
		SELECT TOP 1 @doi_tac = doi_tac FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = @ma_kh

		UPDATE #m34 SET ma_ct = @rVCCode, stt_rec = @rcIDNumber, loai_ct = '2', ma_gd = '4', ngay_lct = ngay_ct, so_lo = '', ma_nt = @baseCurrency, ma_kh = @ma_kh, ty_gia = 1, ong_ba = @doi_tac, dien_giai = @dien_giai, t_tien_nt = 0, t_tien = 0, status = 0

		UPDATE #d34 SET so_lsx = ISNULL(b.so_lsx, ''), ma_nx = ISNULL(c.ma_nx, ''), ma_bp = ISNULL(m.ma_bp, '') FROM #d34 a JOIN #detail d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = d.stt_rec0 LEFT JOIN cs2$000000 b ON d.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx
			LEFT JOIN sfctnx c ON c.status = '1' AND c.kind = '1' AND c.ma_ct = @ma_ct AND c.loai_ct = @loai_ct AND c.ma_px = d.ma_px
			LEFT JOIN ctrt rt ON rt.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh AND d.ma_cd = rt.ma_cd
			LEFT JOIN sfdmcumcv m ON rt.ma_ccv = m.ma_ccv

		UPDATE #d34 SET ma_ct = @rVCCode, stt_rec = @rcIDNumber, ma_sp = '', ma_bp = ISNULL(ma_bp, ''), ma_vi_tri = '', ma_vv = '', tk_du = '', tk_vt = '', gia = 0, gia_nt = 0, tien = 0, tien_nt = 0, sl_ss = 0, pn_gia_tb = 0, stt_rec_px = '', stt_rec0px = '', ma_hd = '', ma_ku = '', ma_phi = '', so_dh_i = ''
		UPDATE #d34 SET tk_vt = b.tk_vt, tk_du = c.tk FROM #d34 a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt JOIN dmnx c ON a.ma_nx = c.ma_nx

		INSERT INTO #i34 SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, status, user_id0, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec, '#10$' + RTRIM(ma_kh) + '#20$2#30$' + ma_nt, '', '' FROM #m34
		SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i34', '#d34', 'd$', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, tk_vt, ma_nx', '#10$, #20$, #30$, #40$', 'stt_rec', default, default, @rVCCode, 'e$', 1)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = 'delete d34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete m34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete i34$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete c34$000000 where stt_rec = ''' + @rcIDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = 'insert into m34$' + @p + ' select * from #m34'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into d34$' + @p + ' select * from #d34'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into c34$000000 (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, status, user_id0 from #m34'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into i34$' + @p + ' select * from #i34'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q


	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #sfctpx SET nxt = 1, ct_dc = 0, ma_pxn = '', ma_vi_tri = '', loai = '', ma_nc = '', ma_nh = '', ma_ca = '', ma_tc1 = '', ma_tc2 = '', ma_tc3 = '', ma_loai1 = '', ma_loai2 = '', ma_loai3 = '',
			sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so, @rq), sl_xuat = 0, sl_xuat1 = 0, sl_hong = 0, sl_hong1 = 0, xtab = 0

		SET @q = 'insert into sfctpx$' + @p + ' select * from #sfctpx'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	-- End
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcDisCoeffByFactor]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@FactorCode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @nCoeffRound INT, @isDept TINYINT, @isMO TINYINT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @ma_yt VARCHAR(32), @loai_yt VARCHAR(32), @hs_yt VARCHAR(1024), @gt_ps CHAR(1), @sl_sx NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)

	SELECT @costDept = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'
	SELECT @nCoeffRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_round_hs'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @FactorCode <> '' SET @Key = 'ma_yt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@FactorCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0'

	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_yt INTO #hs_yt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so INTO #dt FROM xctpbtg
	SELECT * INTO #dttmp FROM #dt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, hs_yt, gt_ps, cong_tru, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_sp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_bp, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS x_dt_lsx INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #xdmyt2 FROM #xdmyt

	SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_bp0, ma_vt INTO #xcppstk FROM xcppstk WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
	SET @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs(ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt select a.ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, hs_yt, gt_ps, cong_tru,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @objectUnit = '0' THEN '1, ' + @costDept + ', ' + @costMO ELSE 'b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from xdmyt a with(nolock)'
	IF @objectUnit = '1' SET @q = @q + ' join #dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF @objectUnit = '1' UPDATE #xdmyt SET x_dt_sp = 1, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #xdmyt2(ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, hs_yt, gt_ps, cong_tru, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx) select * from #xdmyt where hs_yt <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' order by ma_dvcs, ma_yt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #xcdloaiytdd2 FROM xcdloaiytdd2
	SET @q = 'insert into #xcdloaiytdd2 select * from xcdloaiytdd2 a with(nolock) where nam = @y and ky = @p' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@y int, @p int', @Year, @Period

	SELECT TOP 0 t2.loai_yt, t3.ma_sp, t3.ma_bp, t3.so_lsx, t3.sl_tp, t3.sl_sx, t3.sl_dd_ck
		INTO #t1 FROM #hs_yt t1, #xdmyt t2, #xcdloaiytdd2 t3
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_sx
		INTO #t2 FROM #xcdloaiytdd2

	SELECT @i = 1, @n = MAX(id) FROM #xdmyt2
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_yt = ma_yt, @loai_yt = loai_yt, @hs_yt = hs_yt, @gt_ps = gt_ps, @isDept = x_dt_bp, @isMO = x_dt_lsx FROM #xdmyt2 WHERE id = @i
		--
		TRUNCATE TABLE #hs_yt
		SELECT @hs_yt = REPLACE(REPLACE(@hs_yt, ' ', ''), '''', '')
		INSERT INTO #hs_yt SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@hs_yt, ',')

		--
		TRUNCATE TABLE #t1
		INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT t2.loai_yt, t3.ma_sp, t3.ma_bp, t3.so_lsx, t3.sl_tp, t3.sl_sx, t3.sl_dd_ck
			FROM #hs_yt t1 JOIN xdmyt t2 ON t2.ma_yt LIKE t1.ma_yt JOIN #xcdloaiytdd2 t3 ON t2.loai_yt = t3.loai_yt
			WHERE t2.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND t3.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs

		TRUNCATE TABLE #t2
		INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_sx FROM #xcdloaiytdd2 WHERE loai_yt = @loai_yt

		--
		DELETE xctpbtg WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt
		TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
		INSERT INTO #dt(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
			SELECT @ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, '', '',
					ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.cong_tru = '1' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END *
						CASE WHEN @gt_ps = '3' THEN
								 CASE WHEN (c.sl_tp + c.sl_dd_ck) <> 0 THEN ((a.gt + a.dd_ck) / (c.sl_tp + c.sl_dd_ck)) * ISNULL(d.sl_sx, 0) ELSE 0 END
							ELSE
								CASE WHEN @gt_ps <> '1' THEN gt ELSE ps_tk END
						END
					), @nCoeffRound)
				FROM xcdytdd a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN #xdmyt b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt
					LEFT JOIN #t1 c ON c.loai_yt = b.loai_yt AND c.ma_sp = a.ma_sp AND c.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND c.so_lsx = a.so_lsx
					LEFT JOIN #t2 d ON d.ma_sp = a.ma_sp AND d.ma_bp = a.ma_bp AND d.so_lsx = a.so_lsx
				WHERE a.nam = @Year AND a.ky = @Period AND a.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hs_yt c WHERE a.ma_yt LIKE c.ma_yt)
				GROUP BY a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx

		IF @isDept = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_bp <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, b.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END

		IF @isMO = 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE so_lsx <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, b.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT so_lsx FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END

		-- Indirect dept
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_bp0 <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_vt, b.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_bp0 FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END
		-- End

		-- Item
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #dt WHERE ma_vt <> '') BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dttmp
			INSERT INTO #dttmp(ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so)
				SELECT a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.ma_vt, a.ma_bp0, a.he_so
					FROM #dt a CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #xcppstk WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND ma_yt = @ma_yt) b
			TRUNCATE TABLE #dt
			INSERT INTO #dt SELECT * FROM #dttmp
		END
		-- End

		INSERT INTO xctpbtg (ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt
				, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
				, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
				, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
				)
			SELECT @Period, @Year, @ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_vt, ma_bp0, he_so, 0, 0, 0,
					'1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
					, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
				FROM #dt
				WHERE he_so <> 0

		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @i INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i < 100 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update xa set f' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = ''0''', @i = @i + 1
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField]
	@groupList VARCHAR(1024),
	@orderList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Table VARCHAR(128),
	@Field VARCHAR(128),
	@Key NVARCHAR(1024),
	@debugMode INT = 0
AS  
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @c VARCHAR(128), @s1 VARCHAR(1024), @s2 VARCHAR(1024), @s3 VARCHAR(1024)

	--
	SELECT @q = 'create index iOrder on ' + @Table + '(' + @orderList + ')'

	IF @debugMode > 0 PRINT @q
	IF @debugMode < 2 EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @groupList = ''
		SET @q = 'declare @i int; update ' + @Table + ' set @i = case when @i is null then 1 else @i + 1 end, ' + @Field + ' = @i from ' + @Table + ' with(index(iOrder))'
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 1, @s1 = '', @s2 = '', @s3 = ''
		WHILE @i <= dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@groupList, ',') BEGIN
			SELECT @c = RTRIM(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@groupList, @i, ','))
			SELECT @s1 = @s1 + ', @c' + RTRIM(@i) + ' varchar(128)', @s2 = @s2 + CASE WHEN @s2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @c + ' = @c' + RTRIM(@i), @s3 = @s3 + ', @c' + RTRIM(@i) + ' = ' + @c


			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
		SELECT @q = 'declare @i int' + @s1 + '; update ' + @Table + ' set @i = case when ' + @s2 + ' then @i + 1 else 1 end, ' + @Field + ' = @i' + @s3 + ' from ' + @Table + ' with(index(iOrder))'
	END

	--
	IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' option(maxdop 1)'

	IF @debugMode > 0 PRINT @q
	IF @debugMode < 2 EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
