CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptContractProgress]
	@PaymentPhaseColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@DateCFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateCTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Contract VARCHAR(1024),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(1024),
	@DebitCredit CHAR(1),
	@AccountRef VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(1024),
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023)
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_hd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS dot_tt, ps_no AS da_tt, ps_no_nt AS da_tt_nt INTO #report FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_hd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS dot_tt, ps_no AS da_tt, ps_no_nt AS da_tt_nt INTO #reportInserted FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_hd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS dot_tt, ngay_ct AS han_tt, ps_no AS gia_tri, ps_no_nt AS gia_tri_nt, ngay_ct AS ngay_hd, ps_no AS so_tien, ps_no AS da_tt, ps_no_nt AS so_tien_nt, ps_no_nt AS da_tt_nt INTO #temp FROM wrkgl
	--
	IF ISNULL(@PaymentPhaseColumn, '') = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #temp (ma_hd) VALUES ('')
			SELECT ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, ma_kh, '' AS ten_kh, dot_tt, han_tt, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, ngay_hd, so_tien, da_tt, so_tien AS con_lai, so_tien_nt, da_tt_nt, so_tien_nt AS con_lai_nt FROM #temp
		RETURN
	END
	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@UnitCode), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'b.status = ''1'' and (b.ngay_hd between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateCFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateCTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DebitCredit = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_hd = 2'
	IF @DebitCredit = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_hd = 1'
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select b.ma_hd, b.ma_kh, c.ma_dot, c.han_tt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, b.ngay_hd, c.tien, b.tien*0, c.tien_nt, b.tien*0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmhd b with(nolock) left join ctdmhd c on b.ma_hd = c.ma_hd where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @AccountRef <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @AccountRef)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select a.ma_hd, c.ma_dot'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @DebitCredit = '1' THEN ', sum(a.ps_no - a.ps_co)' ELSE ', sum(a.ps_co - a.ps_no)' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @DebitCredit = '1' THEN ', sum(a.ps_no_nt - a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE ', sum(a.ps_co_nt - a.ps_no_nt)' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmhd b with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd left join ctdmhd c on a.ma_hd = c.ma_hd and c.ma_dot = a.' + @PaymentPhaseColumn
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_hd, c.ma_dot'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateVFrom, @DateVTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	INSERT INTO #reportInserted SELECT ma_hd, dot_tt, sum(da_tt), sum(da_tt_nt) FROM #report GROUP BY ma_hd, dot_tt
	--
	UPDATE #temp SET da_tt = b.da_tt FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN #reportInserted b ON a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.dot_tt = b.dot_tt
	UPDATE #temp SET da_tt_nt = b.da_tt_nt FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN #reportInserted b ON a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd AND a.dot_tt = b.dot_tt
	UPDATE #temp SET da_tt = 0 WHERE da_tt IS NULL
	UPDATE #temp SET da_tt_nt = 0 WHERE da_tt_nt IS NULL
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #temp) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #temp (ma_hd) VALUES ('')
			SELECT ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, ma_kh, '' AS ten_kh, dot_tt, han_tt, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, ngay_hd, so_tien, da_tt, so_tien AS con_lai, so_tien_nt, da_tt_nt, so_tien_nt AS con_lai_nt FROM #temp
		RETURN
	END
	--
	SELECT a.ma_hd, a.dot_tt, a.han_tt, a.ma_kh, a.gia_tri, a.gia_tri_nt, a.ngay_hd
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_hd ELSE b.ten_hd2 END AS ten_hd
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kh ELSE c.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		, a.so_tien, a.da_tt, CONVERT(NUMERIC(28, 6), a.so_tien - a.da_tt) AS con_lai
		, a.so_tien_nt, a.da_tt_nt, CONVERT(NUMERIC(28, 6), a.so_tien_nt - a.da_tt_nt) AS con_lai_nt
	FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmhd b ON a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptCurriculumVitae]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),	
	@Position VARCHAR(1023),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	--Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	
	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''	
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''	
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
		
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec) select a.stt_rec from hrnv a with(nolock) where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select 0 as tag, a.stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_sinh, e.bo_phan, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptLeaveTimeSummary]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@WorkdayList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Key = ''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #temp (stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), stt_ref INT)
	CREATE TABLE #report (stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), stt_ref INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @WorkdayList <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkdayList), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT ma_cong, stt INTO #cong FROM hrdmcong WHERE kieu_cong = 9
	CREATE INDEX o ON #cong (ma_cong)

	SELECT @Join = ' join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec join #cong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong'
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select r.stt_rec, max(a.ma_nv), r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio), sum(r.so_ngay), max(c.stt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.ma_cong, r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	CREATE INDEX o ON #report (ma_cong, ma_nv, stt_rec, bo_phan)

	INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref)
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, SUM(so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(so_ngay) AS so_ngay, MAX(stt_ref) AS stt_ref
			FROM #temp
			GROUP BY ma_cong, ma_nv, stt_rec, bo_phan
			ORDER BY ma_cong, ma_nv, stt_rec, bo_phan

	-- Order
	SELECT ma_cong, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #report GROUP BY ma_cong
	CREATE INDEX o ON #order ( ma_cong)

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref) SELECT '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0

	SELECT a.stt - o.stt + 1 AS tt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, 
			RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + ' ' + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten_nv, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, 
			CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_cong ELSE c.ten_cong2 END AS ten_cong		
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #order o ON a.ma_cong = o.ma_cong
			LEFT JOIN hrnv e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
			LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong
		ORDER BY a.stt_ref, a.ma_cong, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan
	
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APDelReverseExRD](
	@cFC VARCHAR(33),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)
	DECLARE @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	
	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)
	DELETE cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @Ngay_ct AND ma_nt = @cFC AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM cttt30 WHERE dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SV]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 loai_ct, status INTO #TranType FROM m81$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hopdong
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM d81$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #TranType SELECT loai_ct, status FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_px <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d64$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_px <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_px = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c66$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_px = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hopdong = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cSIIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSIIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSOIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hopdong VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_px, dyn_dh, dyn_hopdong FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_xuat = sl_xuat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_xuat = sl_xuat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update status, datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, MAX(dyn_px) AS dyn_px, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hopdong) AS dyn_hopdong FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''6'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF @SOStatus IN (''2'', ''4'', ''5'') BEGIN'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cddh13) INSERT INTO cddh13 SELECT ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''', ngay_ct, ma_kh, @SOStatus FROM m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE UPDATE cddh13 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'END'
			END
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''6'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE status = ''5'' AND stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SCStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = @SCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- UpdateSOCredit
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE status <> '0') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @Tien_hd NUMERIC(28, 6)

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, tien2 AS tien_hd INTO #rollbackUpdate FROM d81$000000
		SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #rollbackUpdate SELECT stt_rec_dh, SUM(tien2 + thue - ck) FROM ' + @detailTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_dh <> '''' GROUP BY stt_rec_dh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '' AND dyn_dh <> '' GROUP BY stt_rec_dh
		OPEN crTran
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @dyn_dh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien_hd = tien_hd FROM #rollbackUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cSOIDNumber
			SET @s = 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET tien_hd = tien_hd + ' + RTRIM(@Tien_hd) + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @dyn_dh
		END
		CLOSE crTran
		DEALLOCATE crTran
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcdvtdd2] 
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, d.ten_yt, d.ten_yt2
		FROM xcdvtdd2 a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN xdmyt d ON a.ma_yt = d.ma_yt
		WHERE 1=0

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BIParameterView]
	@controller VARCHAR(128),
	@table VARCHAR(64),
	@fieldKey VARCHAR(128),
	@whereKey NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = '
SELECT ' + @fieldKey + ', a.name, a.val, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) 
	  = ''CBO^'' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, ''@'', '',''), 5, LEN(inputmask)), CHARINDEX(''^'', 
	  SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, ''@'', '',''), 5, LEN(inputmask))) + 1, LEN(inputmask)), ''^'', '',''), CHARINDEX(a.val, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX(''^'', 
	  SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), ''@'', ''''))) WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = ''FN^'' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.val, REPLACE(inputmask, ''FN^'', '''')) 
	  ELSE a.val END AS val_view, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = ''CBO^'' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, ''@'', '',''), 5, 
	  LEN(inputmask)), CHARINDEX(''^'', SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, ''@'', '',''), 5, LEN(inputmask))) + 1, LEN(inputmask)), ''^'', '',''), CHARINDEX(a.val, 
	  REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX(''^'', SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), ''@'', '''')) 
	  + dbo.ff_GetWordCount(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX(''^'', SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), ''@'', '',''))) WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 2) 
	  = ''FN'' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.val, REPLACE(inputmask, ''FN^'', '''')) ELSE a.val END AS val_view2
FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@table) + ' a JOIN bidmts b ON a.name = b.name WHERE controller = ''' + REPLACE(@controller, '''', '') + '''
' + CASE WHEN @whereKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @whereKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CaclAvgPrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(33), 	
	@item VARCHAR(33), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@itemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(511),
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(511),
	@priceFCType TINYINT,
	@userID INT,
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = '',
	@sysDB VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@debugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #wrkstkprice FROM wrkstkprice
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #wrkstkdetail FROM wrkstkdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #xgia FROM xgia
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #wrkstkbg FROM wrkstkbg


	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_TB_LV' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') AND @siteType = 2 BEGIN
		EXEC xs_CaclAvgPrice @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, @vcDeffCode, 
			@costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, @sysDB, @debugMode

		--
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN
	END

	IF @siteType = 1 BEGIN
		-- Declare
		DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key VARCHAR(512), @admin TINYINT, @multiple INT
		SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
		SELECT @multiple = CASE WHEN MONTH(@dFrom) = MONTH(@dTo) AND YEAR(@dFrom) = YEAR(@dTo) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
		
		-- Struct
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #dmvt FROM dmvt
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho INTO #dmkho FROM dmkho

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmvt select ma_vt from dmvt where gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
		IF @item <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	
		IF @itemType <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
		CREATE INDEX i ON #dmvt(ma_vt)
	
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tinh_x0' AND val = '1')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'm_gia_cl_x0' AND val = '0') BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #tps FROM wrkin
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #ps FROM #tps
			
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + CASE WHEN @multiple = 1 THEN '#tps' ELSE '#ps' END + ' select distinct a.ma_vt from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join #dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[((a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd = 0) or (a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1 and a.ct_dc = 0))]%'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin
			
			IF @multiple = 1 INSERT INTO #ps SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #tps
			CREATE INDEX i ON #ps(ma_vt)
			
			DELETE #dmvt FROM #dmvt a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ps b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		END

		IF @site <> '' OR @siteGroup <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @site <> '' THEN 'ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%''' ELSE '' END
			IF @siteGroup <> '' SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@siteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''

			SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmkho select ma_kho from dmkho where ' + @key
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			CREATE INDEX i ON #dmkho(ma_kho)
		END

		--
		EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables

		EXEC fs_DeleteINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @siteGroup, @updateType
		EXEC xs_CaclBgStock @dFrom, @dTo, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @siteType, @costType, @siteGroup, @userID, @admin

		EXEC fs20_UpdateAvgPrice @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, 
			@vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, '#dmvt', '#dmkho'
		

		EXEC fs_CreateINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, 
			@deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @userID, @admin, @siteGroup, '#dmvt', '#dmkho'
	
		IF @updateType <> 0 EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPrice2GL @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, 
				@vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, '#dmvt', '#dmkho', @sysDB
	
		EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables
	
		--
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN		
	END










	-- Obsolete
	EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables

	DECLARE @nMaxTransfers TINYINT, @iAvgStep TINYINT
	IF @updateType <> 2
		BEGIN
			EXEC fs_DeleteINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @siteGroup
			SET @nMaxTransfers = 1
			IF @siteType = 2
				BEGIN
					CREATE TABLE #tMaxTransfers (nMax TINYINT)
					INSERT INTO #tMaxTransfers EXEC fs_GetMaxTransfers @dFrom, @dTo, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @costType
					SELECT @nMaxTransfers = nMax + 2 FROM #tMaxTransfers
				END
			EXEC fs_CaclBgStock @dFrom, @dTo, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @siteType, @costType, @siteGroup
			SET @iAvgStep = 1
			WHILE @iAvgStep <= @nMaxTransfers
				BEGIN
					SET @iAvgStep = @iAvgStep + 1
					EXEC fs_CaclTransferIn @dFrom, @dTo, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @siteType, @costType, @siteGroup

					EXEC fs20_UpdateAvgPrice @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, 
							@vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup
				END
		END

	IF @deffType <> 0 EXEC fs_CreateINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, 
			@deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @userID, @siteGroup
	IF @updateType <> 0 EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPrice2GL @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, 
			@vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, default, default, @sysDB
	EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CheckExistsObjects]
	@db VARCHAR(32),
	@tbl VARCHAR(32),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@r TINYINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
	SELECT TOP 0 id INTO #c FROM sysobjects

	SELECT @r = 0, @i = 0
	IF CHARINDEX('%Partition', @tbl) = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 1, @q = 'insert into #c select id from ' + RTRIM(@db) + '.dbo.sysobjects where xtype = ' + CHAR(39)  + 'U'  + CHAR(39) + ' and name = ''' + @tbl + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME, @tblOld VARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @DateFrom = MAX(value) FROM (SELECT @DateFrom AS value UNION ALL SELECT ngay_gh1 FROM dmstt) a
		SELECT @DateTo = MIN(value) FROM (SELECT @DateTo AS value UNION ALL SELECT ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt) a

		SELECT @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateFrom), YEAR(@DateFrom)), @dEnd = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateTo), YEAR(@DateTo))
		SELECT @d = @dStart, @tblOld = @tbl

		WHILE @d <= @DateTo BEGIN
			SELECT @tbl = REPLACE(@tblOld, '%Partition', STR(YEAR(@d), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@d), 2), ' ', '0'))
			SET @q = 'insert into #c select id from ' + RTRIM(@db) + '.dbo.sysobjects where xtype = ' + CHAR(39)  + 'U'  + CHAR(39) + ' and name = ''' + @tbl + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d), @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	IF (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM #c) = @i SELECT @r = 1

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintBMTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	--IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.ngay_ct1, a.ngay_ct2, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt'
	IF @Bilingual = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt2'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 7, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'',''ngay_ct1, ngay_ct2'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBISAPerformanceComparison] -- rs_rptPurchaseOrderComparison
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@POFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@POTo VARCHAR(32),
	@DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@VCType VARCHAR(32),
	@Deduction VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@DueDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128),
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PlantKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @nRound INT, @nFCRound INT, @slRound INT

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @nRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @nFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @slRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.status, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.ma_kh, b.dien_giai, a.he_so, b.t_so_luong, b.t_tien, b.t_tien_nt
			, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, b.ma_kho0, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.so_luong AS so_luong_hd, a.gia AS gia_hd, a.gia_nt AS gia_hd_nt, a.tien AS tien_hd, a.tien_nt AS tien_hd_nt, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung
		INTO #t94 FROM bid06$000000 a, bim06$000000 b
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, tien, tien_nt INTO #tHD FROM d71$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien2 AS tien, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt INTO #tgiam FROM r70$000000

	SELECT @Key = ' b.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')', @Join = '', @q = ''
	IF @POFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@POFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @POTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@POTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kho0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VCType <> '*'  SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ct = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DueDate IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ngay_giao <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DueDate, 112) + ''' or a.ngay_giao is null)'

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or a.ma_kho = '''')'

	IF @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('b.ma_bp0', @PurOrgCode, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	END
	IF @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'b.ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGrKey OUTPUT, '2'
		IF @PurGrCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGrCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PurGrKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PurGrKey + ')'
	END
	IF @PlantCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PlantCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PlantKey + ')'
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- PO
	SET @q = '
insert into #t94
	select b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.status, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.ma_kh, b.dien_giai, a.he_so, b.t_so_luong, b.t_tien, b.t_tien_nt
			, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, b.ma_kho0, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, b.ma_bp0, b.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung
		from bid06$%Partition a with(nolock) join bim06$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Invoice
	SET @q = 'insert into #tHD select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_hd, a.stt_rec0hd, a.so_luong * a.he_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from d71$%Partition a with(nolock) join m71$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[b.status in (''1'', ''2'') and exists(select 1 from #t94 c where c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_hd and c.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0hd)]%'
	IF @VCType <> '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @VCType <> '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '71$', '72$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @Deduction = '1' BEGIN
		-- Deduction (Phiếu nhập điều chỉnh giá hàng mua)
		SET @q = '
insert into #tgiam
	select a.stt_rec_hd, a.stt_rec0hd, 0, case when b.loai_ct = ''1'' then -tien else tien end, case when b.loai_ct = ''1'' then -tien_nt else tien_nt end
		from d83$000000 a with(nolock) join m83$000000 b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			where a.ngay_ct between @DateFrom2 and @DateTo2 and b.status in (''1'', ''2'') and exists(select 1 from #tHD c where c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_hd and c.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0hd)
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@DateFrom2 smalldatetime, @DateTo2 smalldatetime', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2

		-- Deduction (Phiếu xuất trả lại nhà cung cấp)
		SET @q = '
insert into #tgiam
	select a.stt_rec_hd, a.stt_rec0hd, -(so_luong * a.he_so), -tien, -tien_nt
		from d86$%Partition a with(nolock) join m86$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			where %[b.status in (''1'', ''2'', ''3'') and exists(select 1 from #tHD c where c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_hd and c.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0hd)]%
'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin

		--
		UPDATE #tHD SET so_luong = a.so_luong + b.so_luong, tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt FROM #tHD a
			JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #tgiam GROUP BY stt_rec, stt_rec0) b
				ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
	END

	SELECT @q = '
update #t94 set so_luong_hd = round(case when isnull(b.so_luong, 0) = 0 then 0 else (isnull(b.so_luong, 0)/isnull(a.he_so, 1)) end, @slRound), tien_hd = isnull(b.tien, 0), tien_hd_nt = isnull(b.tien_nt, 0)
	from #t94 a left join (
		select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, sum(so_luong) as so_luong, sum(tien) as tien, sum(tien_nt) as tien_nt from #tHD group by stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd
		) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd and a.stt_rec0 = stt_rec0hd
update #t94 set gia_hd = case when so_luong_hd = 0 then 0 else round(tien_hd/so_luong_hd, @nRound) end, gia_hd_nt = case when so_luong_hd = 0 then 0 else round(tien_hd_nt/so_luong_hd, @nFCRound) end
if not exists(select 1 from #t94) insert into #t94 (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ma_ct, ma_dvcs) values('''', '''', '''', '''', '''')
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@nRound int, @nFCRound int, @slRound int', @nRound, @nFCRound, @slRound

	SET @q = '
select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.*, a.so_luong_hd - a.so_luong AS so_luong_cl, a.gia_hd - a.gia AS gia_cl, a.gia_hd_nt - a.gia_nt AS gia_cl_nt, a.tien_hd - a.tien AS tien_cl, a.tien_hd_nt - a.tien_nt AS tien_cl_nt, d.ma_ct_in, stt_rec as rp_group
	, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.statusname' ELSE 'e.statusname2' END + ' as status2, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END + '
	, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung
from #t94 a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct left join dmttct e on a.ma_ct = e.ma_ct and a.status = e.status order by a.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialAnalysisMultiPeriodDelete]
	@Unit VARCHAR(512), -- đơn vị
	@PeriodFrom INT, -- kỳ 1
	@YearFrom INT,-- năm 1
	@ReportCode CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo
	@ReportCodeNote CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo dùng cho phần đánh giá
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- dạng báo cáo
	@PeriodType CHAR(1),-- loại kỳ
	@PeriodNo INT, -- số kỳ
	@Form CHAR(16),-- mẫu báo cáo
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @dateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @periodAdd TINYINT, @Year INT, @Year2 INT, @Period INT, @Period2 INT, @i INT

	SELECT @periodAdd =
		CASE 
			WHEN @PeriodType = 1 THEN 1
			WHEN @PeriodType = 2 THEN 3
			WHEN @PeriodType = 3 THEN 6
			WHEN @PeriodType = 4 THEN 12
		END
	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom)

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @iCount INT
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @PeriodNo BEGIN
		SELECT @dateTo = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd, @dateFrom))
		SELECT @Period = MONTH(@dateFrom), @Year = YEAR(@dateFrom)
		SELECT @Period2 = MONTH(@dateTo), @Year2 = YEAR(@dateTo)

		-- Delete giá trị
		DELETE gltcpt99 WHERE ky1 = @Period AND nam1 = @Year AND ky2 = @Period2 AND nam2 = @Year2
			AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = @ReportCode AND dang_bc = @ReportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND cot NOT IN(1, 2)

		SELECT @dateFrom = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dateTo)
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Delete đánh giá
	DELETE gltcpt99 WHERE ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky2 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearFrom
		AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = @ReportCodeNote AND dang_bc = @ReportType AND loai_ky = @PeriodType AND so_ky = @PeriodNo AND form = @Form AND cot IN(1, 2)

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
