CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcEdWipCost]
	@Period TINYINT,
	@Year INT,
	@Dept VARCHAR(33),
	@FactorType VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @PrevPeriod TINYINT, @PrevYear INT, @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k1 NVARCHAR(4000), @k2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @costUnit CHAR(1), @costProduct CHAR(1), @costDept CHAR(1), @costMO CHAR(1), @objectUnit CHAR(1)

	SELECT @costUnit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ky, nam INTO #PrevPeriod FROM xcdytdd

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT @costProduct = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_sp'
	SELECT @costDept = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_bp'
	SELECT @costMO = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'x_dt_lsx'

	-- Key
	SELECT @k1 = '', @k2 = ''
	IF @Dept <> '' SET @k1 = 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k1 = @k1 + CASE WHEN @k1 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
		SELECT @objectUnit = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dtgt_dvcs' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

		SELECT @q = dbo.xf_GetUnitPrevPeriod(@UnitKey, @Period, @Year, 'xcdytdd', '#PrevPeriod', 0)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = dbo.xf_GetUnitPrevPeriod(@UnitKey, @Period, @Year, 'xcdytdd', '#PrevPeriod', 1)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		CREATE INDEX i ON #PrevPeriod(ma_dvcs, ky, nam)
	END ELSE SELECT @objectUnit = '0', @PrevPeriod = dbo.xf20_GetPrevPeriod(@Period, @Year, 'Month'), @PrevYear = dbo.xf20_GetPrevPeriod(@Period, @Year, 'Year')
	SET @k1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k1)

	IF @FactorType <> '' SET @k2 = 'a.loai_yt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FactorType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' AND @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k2 = @k2 + CASE WHEN @k2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @k2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k2)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_yt, loai_yt, dd_ck INTO #xdmyt FROM xdmyt
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #xdmyt select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.loai_yt, a.dd_ck from xdmyt a with(nolock)'
	IF @k2 <> '' SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @k2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cost Object
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, b.x_dt_sp, b.x_dt_bp, b.x_dt_lsx INTO #dmdvcs FROM dmdvcs a, dmdvcskb b
	SELECT @q = ' insert into #dmdvcs (ma_dvcs, x_dt_sp, x_dt_bp, x_dt_lsx)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, isnull(b.x_dt_sp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_bp, 0), isnull(b.x_dt_lsx,0) from dmdvcs a left join dmdvcskb b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and b.status = ''1'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #dmdvcs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #xdmyt a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #dmdvcs.ma_dvcs)

	IF @objectUnit = '1' UPDATE #dmdvcs SET x_dt_sp = @costProduct, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO WHERE x_dt_sp = 0 AND x_dt_bp = 0 AND x_dt_lsx = 0
		ELSE UPDATE #dmdvcs SET x_dt_sp = @costProduct, x_dt_bp = @costDept, x_dt_lsx = @costMO

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.loai_yt, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt,
			 a.dd_ck, a.dd_ck_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_dd_ck, a.gt, a.gt_nt
		INTO #xcdytdd FROM xcdytdd a, xdmyt b

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #xcdytdd select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, max(b.loai_yt) as loai_yt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', sum(dd_dk) as dd_dk, sum(dd_dk_nt) as dd_dk_nt, sum(ps_tk) as ps_tk, sum(ps_tk_nt) as ps_tk_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', 0 as dd_ck, 0 as dd_ck_nt, 0 as sl_tp, 0 as sl_dd_ck, 0 as gt, 0 as gt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ('
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_ck as dd_dk, dd_ck_nt as dd_dk_nt, 0 as ps_tk, 0 as ps_tk_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xcdytdd a with(nolock) '

	IF @costUnit = '1' SET @q = @q + ' where exists(select 1 from #PrevPeriod b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ky = b.ky and a.nam = b.nam)'
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@PrevYear) + ' and a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@PrevPeriod)

	IF @k1 <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @k1
	SELECT @q = @q + ' union all'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, 0, 0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xctkqpb a with(nolock) where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + CASE WHEN @k1 <> '' THEN ' and ' + @k1 ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' ) a join #xdmyt b with(nolock) on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Adj
	SELECT @q = 'update #xcdytdd set dd_dk = b.dd_dk, dd_dk_nt = b.dd_dk_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #xcdytdd a join (select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_dk, dd_dk_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + '  from xcdytdd0 a with(nolock) where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' ) b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #xcdytdd'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, b.loai_yt, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xcdytdd0 a with(nolock) join xdmyt b with(nolock) on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and not exists(select 1 from #xcdytdd c where c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and c.ma_yt = a.ma_yt and c.ma_sp = a.ma_sp and c.ma_bp = a.ma_bp and c.so_lsx = a.so_lsx)'

	IF @k1 <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @k1

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- End

	SELECT @q = 'update #xcdytdd set sl_tp = b.sl_tp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #xcdytdd a join ('
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_tp from xcdspdd a with(nolock) where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ') b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update #xcdytdd set sl_dd_ck = b.sl_dd_ck'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #xcdytdd a join ('
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_dd_ck from xcdloaiytdd2 a with(nolock) where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ') b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.loai_yt = b.loai_yt and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #xcdytdd SET dd_ck = CASE WHEN sl_tp + sl_dd_ck <> 0 THEN ROUND(((dd_dk + ps_tk) / (sl_tp + sl_dd_ck)) * sl_dd_ck, @nRound) ELSE 0 END,
		dd_ck_nt = CASE WHEN sl_tp + sl_dd_ck <> 0 THEN ROUND(((dd_dk_nt + ps_tk_nt) / (sl_tp + sl_dd_ck)) * sl_dd_ck, @nFCRound) ELSE 0 END

	UPDATE #xcdytdd SET dd_ck = 0, dd_ck_nt = 0 FROM #xcdytdd a JOIN xdmyt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt WHERE b.dd_ck = 0

	-- MOs Close
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, dbo.xf20_GetMO(so_ct) AS so_lsx INTO #lsx FROM phsx
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #lsx select ma_dvcs, dbo.xf20_GetMO(so_ct) from phsx a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where (ngay_th2 between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @q = @q + ' and status <> ''*'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, dbo.xf20_GetMO(so_ct)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #xcdytdd SET dd_ck = 0, dd_ck_nt = 0 FROM #xcdytdd a JOIN #lsx b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx
	-- End

	-- From Materials
	SELECT @q = 'update #xcdytdd set dd_ck = b.dd_ck, dd_ck_nt = b.dd_ck_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #xcdytdd a join ('
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_ck, dd_ck_nt from xcdnvldd a with(nolock) where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ' and ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' ) b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- End

	UPDATE #xcdytdd SET gt = dd_dk + ps_tk - dd_ck, gt_nt = dd_dk_nt + ps_tk_nt - dd_ck_nt

	SET @q = 'delete xcdytdd from xcdytdd a where ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year)
	SET @q = @q + ' and exists(select 1 from #xdmyt b where b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt)' + CASE WHEN @k1 <> '' THEN ' and ' + @k1 ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	DELETE #xcdytdd WHERE ma_sp = '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #xcdytdd.ma_dvcs AND a.x_dt_sp = '1')
	DELETE #xcdytdd WHERE ma_bp = '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #xcdytdd.ma_dvcs AND a.x_dt_bp = '1')
	DELETE #xcdytdd WHERE so_lsx = '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmdvcs a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #xcdytdd.ma_dvcs AND a.x_dt_lsx = '1')

	INSERT INTO xcdytdd (ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_dk, dd_dk_nt, ps_tk0, ps_tk_nt0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, gt, gt_nt, ps_tk2, ps_tk_nt2, dd_ck, dd_ck_nt
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
		SELECT @Period, @Year, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_dk, dd_dk_nt, 0, 0, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, gt, gt_nt, 0, 0, dd_ck, dd_ck_nt
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #xcdytdd a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xdmyt b WHERE b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs AND b.ma_yt = a.ma_yt)

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTimesheetDetailed]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@WorkdayList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @i INT, @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Where = '', @Join = '', @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @Filter = ''

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(
		stt_rec CHAR(13), ngay SMALLDATETIME, ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), ma_ca VARCHAR(32), ma_ca_ct VARCHAR(32), 
		so_gio NUMERIC(5, 2), ngay_cham_tu DATETIME, ngay_cham_den DATETIME, ngay_tinh_tu DATETIME, ngay_tinh_den DATETIME, line_nbr INT, stt_ref VARCHAR(512), 
		ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(128), ten_bp NVARCHAR(128), stt INT
	)

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @WorkdayList <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkdayList), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select distinct r.stt_rec, r.ngay, a.ma_nv, r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong, r.ma_ca, r.ma_ca_ct, r.so_gio, r.gio_tu0, r.gio_den0, r.gio_tu, r.gio_den, r.line_nbr, b.stt_ref, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + '' '' + a.ten_nv, '''', 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongct$%Partition r with(nolock) left join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		IF @EmpKey = '' SELECT @DeptKey = @Filter
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#report', 'bo_phan', 'stt_ref = b.stt_ref'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Order
	CREATE INDEX o ON #report (bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay, line_nbr)
	SELECT bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay, MIN(line_nbr) AS line_nbr INTO #v FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay ORDER BY bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay

	SELECT bo_phan, ma_nv, MIN(ngay) AS ngay INTO #t FROM #v GROUP BY bo_phan, ma_nv
	CREATE INDEX i ON #t (bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay)
	DELETE #v FROM #v a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv AND a.ngay = b.ngay WHERE b.ngay IS NULL

	CREATE TABLE #u(bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ngay SMALLDATETIME, line_nbr INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #u SELECT bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay, line_nbr FROM #v ORDER BY bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay, line_nbr

	SELECT bo_phan, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #u GROUP BY bo_phan

	CREATE INDEX i ON #u (bo_phan, ma_nv, ngay, line_nbr)
	UPDATE #report SET stt = u.stt - o.stt + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #order o ON a.bo_phan = o.bo_phan JOIN #u u ON a.bo_phan = u.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = u.ma_nv AND a.ngay = u.ngay AND a.line_nbr = u.line_nbr

	-- Report
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct a.bo_phan, b.bp_me from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @Where = @Where + CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Filter
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = max(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0) - 1
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct b.ma_bp, b.bp_me from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (b.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select @x = min(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select '''', null, '''', a.bo_phan, '''', '''', '''', 0, null, null, null, null, 0, b.stt_ref'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', '''', space(2 * (b.bac_bp - ' + RTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ', 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, '', '', '', 0

	SELECT stt, RTRIM(bo_phan) AS bo_phan, stt_rec, ngay, ma_nv, ho_ten_nv, ma_cong, ma_ca, ma_ca_ct, so_gio, ngay_cham_tu, ngay_cham_den, ngay_tinh_tu, ngay_tinh_den
			, CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_cham_tu, 108) AS cham_tu, CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_cham_den, 108) AS cham_den
			, CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_tinh_tu, 108) AS tinh_tu, CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_tinh_den, 108) AS tinh_den, ten_bp
			, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_cham_tu, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_cham_tu, 108) AS s_ngay_cham_tu, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_cham_den, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_cham_den, 108) AS s_ngay_cham_den
			, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_tinh_tu, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_tinh_tu, 108) AS s_ngay_tinh_tu, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_tinh_den, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(5), ngay_tinh_den, 108) AS s_ngay_tinh_den
		FROM #report ORDER BY stt_ref, ma_nv, ngay, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTaxDeductionStatusCheck]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@ReferenceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@CurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	CREATE TABLE #name (code CHAR(1), name NVARCHAR(128))

	INSERT INTO #name SELECT CASE WHEN ccode = 'EI004' THEN 0 WHEN ccode = 'EI005' THEN 1 WHEN ccode = 'EI006' THEN 2 WHEN ccode = 'EI007' THEN 3 WHEN ccode = 'EI008' THEN 9 WHEN ccode = 'EI009' THEN 8 WHEN ccode = 'EI010' THEN 4 WHEN ccode = 'EI011' THEN 5 WHEN ccode = 'EI012' THEN 6 ELSE '' END,
		CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode IN ('EI004', 'EI005', 'EI006', 'EI007', 'EI008', 'EI009', 'EI010', 'EI011', 'EI012')


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_hd AS so_ct_hddt, ky_hieu AS so_seri_hddt, mau_so AS mau_hddt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh, ten_kh
			, t_tnc_thue_nt, t_tnt_thue_nt, t_thue_nt, ma_nt, tinh_trang_hddt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS dich_vu_hddt
		INTO #result FROM hrm01$000000


	SELECT @Key = 'm.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and m.tinh_trang_hddt in (''1'', ''8'')'

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and m.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and m.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''

	IF @ReferenceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and m.so_hd >= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceFrom, '''', '''''')) + ''''
	IF @ReferenceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and m.so_hd <= ''' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(replace(@ReferenceTo, '''', '''''')) + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmployeeID), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @CurrencyCode <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and m.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	--- Dept
	EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @DeptKey OUTPUT, 1
	IF ISNULL(@DeptKey, '') <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @DeptKey

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #result
	select m.stt_rec, m.ma_dvcs, m.ngay_ct, m.so_ct, m.so_hd, m.ky_hieu, m.mau_so, a.ma_nv, m.ten_kh, m.t_tnc_thue_nt, m.t_tnt_thue_nt, m.t_thue_nt, m.ma_nt, m.tinh_trang_hddt, 8
		from hrm01$%Partition m with(nolock) join hrnv a with(nolock) on m.stt_rec_nv = a.stt_rec
		where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'm.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @importType TINYINT
	SELECT @importType = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_import_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, ISNULL(c.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph INTO #type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN dmkieuphhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, c.dich_vu_hddt INTO #unit FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_dvcs FROM #result) a LEFT JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN tkhddt c ON b.ma_kn = c.ma_kn WHERE b.status = 1


	UPDATE #result SET dich_vu_hddt = b.dich_vu_hddt FROM #result a JOIN #unit b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs

	SELECT stt_rec, @VoucherCode AS ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct_hddt, so_seri_hddt, mau_hddt, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh
			, a.t_tnc_thue_nt, a.t_tnt_thue_nt, a.t_thue_nt, a.ma_nt
			, c.name AS tinh_trang, a.tinh_trang_hddt, ISNULL(d.kieu_ph, @importType) AS kieu_ph, a.dich_vu_hddt
		FROM #result a
			LEFT JOIN #name c ON a.tinh_trang_hddt = c.code
			LEFT JOIN #type d ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCustomerBalance] --fs_CustomersSummary--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Groups VARCHAR(511),
	@Order VARCHAR(511),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b FROM cdkh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt,
			ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt,
			ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #t	FROM wrkgl

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = 'left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	--
	DECLARE @JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000), @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @JoinClause = 'join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk ' + @Join, @WhereClause = 'c.tk_cn = 1' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	INSERT INTO #b EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, NULL, @Account, @Customer, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @JoinClause, @WhereClause
	--
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account )
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0,	sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt,	0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		SET @q = ' insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0,	sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt,	0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pskh$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, @Account AS tk, a.ma_kh, SUM(no_dk) AS no_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk) AS co_dk, SUM(co_dk_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(no_ck) AS no_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck) AS co_ck, SUM(co_ck_nt) AS co_ck_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, MAX(b.nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(b.nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(b.nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3
		INTO #Report
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	DELETE #Report WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'INT, #, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Groups = '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @o = @Groups + ', ' + @Order
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	SET @q = dbo. ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups, 'kh', 'no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh, ten_kh2, no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(no_dk), SUM(co_dk), SUM(no_dk_nt), SUM(co_dk_nt), SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt), SUM(no_ck), SUM(co_ck), SUM(no_ck_nt), SUM(co_ck_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report'
	IF @Groups = '' SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + @Groups + ', sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs_CaclBgStock]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@item VARCHAR(33), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@itemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = '',
	@userID INT,
	@admin TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @y VARCHAR(4), @j VARCHAR(512), @k1 VARCHAR(512), @k2 VARCHAR(512), @round TINYINT, @roundFC TINYINT

	-- Set
	SELECT @round = CAST(RTRIM(val)AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tb_round'
	SELECT @roundFC = @round

	SELECT @y = RTRIM(YEAR(@dFrom)), @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@dFrom), 
		@k1 = 'sum(case when (a.ngay_ct < ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dFrom, 112)  + ''') or (a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb <> 1) or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd = 1) then ', @k2 = ' else 0 end)', 
		@j = ' join #dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	IF @siteGroup <> '' SELECT @j = ' join #dmkho c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
	

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, sl_nhap AS ton_dau, tien_nhap AS du_dau, tien_nt_n AS du_dau_nt INTO #tb FROM wrkin	
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tb select a.ma_vt, sum(a.ton00), sum(a.du00), sum(a.du_nt00) from cdvt a with (index(nam))' + @j + ' where a.nam = ' + @y + ' group by a.ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tb select a.ma_vt, ' + @k1 + 'a.sl_nhap - sl_xuat' + @k2 + ', ' + @k1 + 'a.tien_nhap - tien_xuat' + @k2 + ', ' + @k1 + 'tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x' + @k2 + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @j + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39) + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dTo, @userID, @admin

	--TRUNCATE TABLE wrkstkbg
	INSERT INTO #wrkstkbg(ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt) SELECT ma_vt, '', 0, 0, SUM(ton_dau), SUM(du_dau), SUM(du_dau_nt) FROM #tb GROUP BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #wrkstkbg SET gia = CASE WHEN ton_dau = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(du_dau / ton_dau, @round) END, gia_nt = CASE WHEN ton_dau = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(du_dau_nt / ton_dau, @roundFC) END

	--TRUNCATE TABLE wrkstkprice
	INSERT INTO #wrkstkprice(ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt) SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt FROM #wrkstkbg
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrrmhs]
AS
SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_dot, a.ma_hs, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_bp, a.status, a.gioi_tinh, a.cmnd_so, a.quoc_tich, a.ma_tthn, 
		a.ma_kenh, a.ma_nguon, a.email, RTRIM(a.ho_uv) + SPACE(1) + a.ten_uv AS ho_ten, a.ho_uv, a.ten_uv,
		a.ngay_sinh, DAY(a.ngay_sinh) AS ngay_sinh_ngay, MONTH(a.ngay_sinh) AS ngay_sinh_thang, YEAR(a.ngay_sinh) AS ngay_sinh_nam,
		a.noi_sinh, a.ngay_nop, a.ma_tt, a.muc_luong, a.ngay_lv_dk, a.nguoi_gt, a.dia_chi, a.dien_thoai, a.ghi_chu,
		a.cmnd_noi_cap, a.cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_ngay_hh, a.dan_toc,
		a.ngay_kham, a.chieu_cao, a.can_nang, a.mat_phai, a.mat_trai, a.nhom_mau, a.loai_sk, a.ghi_chu_sk,
		a.cap_dt, a.truong_dt, a.chuong_trinh_dt, a.ngay_dt_tu, a.ngay_dt_den, a.ngay_cap_cc, a.diem_dt, a.xep_loai_dt, a.ghi_chu_dt,
		a.ma_nn, a.bang_cap_nn, a.diem_nn, a.ngay_cap_nn, a.ghi_chu_nn, a.ton_giao, 
		g.ten_tinh AS ten_cmnd_noi_cap, g.ten_tinh2 AS ten_cmnd_noi_cap2,
		h.ten_qt AS ten_qt, h.ten_qt2 AS ten_qt2,
		i.ten_dt AS ten_dt, i.ten_dt2 AS ten_dt2,
		j.ten_tthn AS ten_tthn, j.ten_tthn2 AS ten_tthn2,
		k.ten_nn, k.ten_nn2,
		l.ten_cc AS ten_bc, l.ten_cc2 AS ten_bc2,
		b.ten_dot, b.ten_dot2, c.stt AS stt_bp, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2, 
		d.ten_vtr, d.ten_vtr2, e.ten_tt, e.ten_tt2, a.stt_rec, 
		f.name AS ten_gioi_tinh, f.name2 AS ten_gioi_tinh2,
		m.ten_nguon, m.ten_nguon2,
		n.ten_kenh, n.ten_kenh2,
		o.ten_tg, o.ten_tg2
	FROM hrrmhs a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN hrrmdot b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot
		LEFT JOIN hrbp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		LEFT JOIN hrvt d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vtr = d.ma_vtr
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtths e WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tt = e.ma_tt
		LEFT JOIN hrdirinfo f WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.gioi_tinh = f.code AND f.type  = 'Gender'
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.cmnd_noi_cap = g.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN dmqt h WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.quoc_tich = h.ma_qt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmdt i WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.dan_toc = i.ma_dt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtthn j WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tthn = j.ma_tthn
		LEFT JOIN hrdmnn k WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nn = k.ma_nn
		LEFT JOIN hrdmcc l WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.bang_cap_nn = l.ma_cc
		LEFT JOIN hrdmnguontd m WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nguon = m.ma_nguon
		LEFT JOIN hrdmkenhtd n WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kenh = n.ma_kenh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtg o WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ton_giao = o.ma_tg

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptMultiPeriodLaborFluctuationByDept]
	@NumberPeriods INT,
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptLevel INT,
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Permanent, 2 - Probationary, * - All
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32), 
	@Type TINYINT = 0 -- Type = 1 => View all departments
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @total NVARCHAR(128), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Combine NVARCHAR(1023), @Relate NVARCHAR(1023), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @When NVARCHAR(4000), @Valid NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @d1 VARCHAR(32), @d2 VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @i INT, @p BIT, @n INT, @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @OffsetDate VARCHAR(32), @OffsetDept VARCHAR(64), @OffsetTable VARCHAR(256), @Loop INT, @Sign INT, @Revert VARCHAR(3), @c1 VARCHAR(256), @c2 VARCHAR(256), @EmployeeCondition NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @month NVARCHAR(128), @h0 NVARCHAR(128), @h1 NVARCHAR(128), @h2 NVARCHAR(128), @h3 NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @month = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'J20'
	SELECT @h0 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM057'
	SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM058'
	SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM059'
	SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM060'

	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @p = 0, @DateFrom = DATEADD(MM, @Period - 1, CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, STR(@Year, 4) + '0101', 112)), @DateTo = DATEADD(MM, @NumberPeriods, @DateFrom) - 1
	SELECT @d1 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + '''', @d2 = '''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + '''', @Key = '', @Join = '', @Where = ''


	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #ctqtlvdk(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_vtr VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME)

	CREATE TABLE #qtlv(bo_phan VARCHAR(32), t1 INT)
	CREATE TABLE #delta(ky INT, bo_phan VARCHAR(32), sl INT, ngay INT)

	CREATE TABLE #in(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), bac_quan_ly VARCHAR(32), tinh_chat VARCHAR(32), loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #transfer(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), bac_quan_ly VARCHAR(32), tinh_chat VARCHAR(32), loai_thay_doi VARCHAR(32), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	CREATE TABLE #d(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), vi_tri VARCHAR(32), bac_quan_ly VARCHAR(32), tinh_chat VARCHAR(1), ngay_tu SMALLDATETIME)

	SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu INTO #t FROM #d
	SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu INTO #out FROM #transfer
	
	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, '%a1', '%a1', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', '%r.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a2.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @Level <> ''SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.%l = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a3.%p = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '%a4.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b on r.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on r.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	IF @Level + @Position + @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @p = 1
	SELECT @Where = ' and r.tinh_chat = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'r'), '%a4', 'c'), '%l', 'bac_quan_ly'), '%p', 'vi_tri')

	SELECT @Loop = 0, @Sign = 1, @Revert  = ''
	IF @EmpType = '1' SELECT @Loop = 1, @EmpType = '*'

	Data:
	SELECT @OffsetDate = CASE WHEN @EmpType = '2' THEN 'ngay_hh_tv' ELSE 'ngay_nghi' END, @OffsetDept = CASE WHEN @EmpType = '2' THEN 'bp_chinh_thuc0' ELSE 'bo_phan' END
	SELECT @OffsetTable = CASE WHEN @EmpType = '2' THEN ' (select a.stt_rec from hreqtlvht a join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec where (e.ngay_hh_tv is null or a.ngay_tu <= e.ngay_hh_tv)) p' ELSE 'hreqtlvht' END
	SELECT @c1 = CASE WHEN @EmpType = '2' OR @EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '' THEN ' join hrnv e on r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec' ELSE '' END, @c2 = CASE WHEN @EmpType = '2' THEN '(e.ngay_hh_tv is null or r.ngay_tu <= e.ngay_hh_tv) and ' ELSE '' END

	SET @EmployeeCondition = ''
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and e.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and e.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @EmployeeCondition = @EmployeeCondition + ' and e.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Beginning
	SET @q = 'insert into #d select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, ''1'', max(r.ngay_tu) from hreqtlvht r join hrnv e on r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.ngay_tu < ' + @d1
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @EmpType = '*' THEN ' and (e.ngay_nghi is null or e.ngay_nghi >= ' + @d1 + ')' ELSE ' and ((e.ngay_hh_tv is null or e.ngay_hh_tv >= r.ngay_tu) and (e.ngay_hh_tv is null or e.ngay_hh_tv >= ' + @d1 + '))' END
	SET @q = @q + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #t SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM #d GROUP BY stt_rec
	DELETE #d FROM #d a LEFT JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu WHERE b.stt_rec IS NULL

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ctqtlvdk select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, max(r.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu from #d r' + @Join + ' where (r.ngay_tu < ' + @d1 + ')' + @Where + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	INSERT INTO #qtlv SELECT bo_phan, @Sign * COUNT(*) FROM #ctqtlvdk GROUP BY bo_phan

	-- New
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #delta select year(r.ngay_tu) * 12 + month(r.ngay_tu), r.bo_phan, ' + @Revert + 'count(*), sum(day(r.ngay_tu) - 1) from hreqtlvht r' + @Join + @c1
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' +  @c2 + CASE WHEN @p = 0 THEN ' r.loai_thay_doi not in (''3'', ''4'', ''5'') and ' ELSE '' END + '(r.ngay_tu between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @Where + @EmployeeCondition + ' group by r.bo_phan, year(r.ngay_tu) * 12 + month(r.ngay_tu)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Transfer in
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #in (stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu) select r.stt_rec, r.bo_phan, r.vi_tri, r.bac_quan_ly, r.tinh_chat, r.loai_thay_doi, r.ngay_tu from hreqtlvht r' + @c1
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @c2 + '(r.ngay_tu between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ') and r.tinh_chat = ''1'' and r.loai_thay_doi ' + CASE WHEN @p = 0 THEN ' = ''2''' ELSE ' not in (''1'', ''4'', ''5'')' END + @EmployeeCondition + ' order by r.stt_rec, r.ngay_tu'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Transfer out
	INSERT INTO #transfer(stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu) SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, vi_tri, bac_quan_ly, tinh_chat, loai_thay_doi, ngay_tu FROM hreqtlvht WHERE tinh_chat = '1' AND loai_thay_doi NOT IN ('4', '5') AND ngay_tu <= @DateTo AND stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #in) ORDER BY stt_rec, ngay_tu

	INSERT INTO #out SELECT a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.tinh_chat, a.loai_thay_doi, b.ngay_tu FROM #transfer a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ngay_tu, stt - 1 AS stt FROM #transfer WHERE ngay_tu >= @DateFrom AND (loai_thay_doi = '2' OR (loai_thay_doi = '3' AND @p = 1))) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt = b.stt
	IF @EmpType = '2' DELETE #out FROM #out r JOIN hrnv e ON r.stt_rec = e.stt_rec WHERE (e.ngay_hh_tv IS NOT NULL AND e.ngay_hh_tv <  r.ngay_tu)
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #delta select year(r.ngay_tu) * 12 + month(r.ngay_tu), r.bo_phan, ' + @Revert + '- count(*), sum(datediff(d, r.ngay_tu, dateadd(mm, datediff(m, 0, r.ngay_tu) + 1, 0) - 1)) from #out r' + @Join + ' where (1 = 1)' + @Where + ' group by r.bo_phan, year(r.ngay_tu) * 12 + month(r.ngay_tu)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SELECT @Combine = ''
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Combine = ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Combine = @Combine + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @When = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c'), '%l', 'bac_quan_ly'), '%p', 'vi_tri')
	SELECT @Valid = @When, @Relate = @Combine

	IF @EmpType = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @Relate = ' left join hrbp b on a.' + @OffsetDept + ' = b.ma_bp'
		IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Relate = @Relate + ' left join hrvt c on a.vt_chinh_thuc0 = c.ma_vtr'
		SELECT @Valid = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b'), '%a3', 'a'), '%a4', 'c'), '%l', 'ql_chinh_thuc0'), '%p', 'vt_chinh_thuc0')
	END

	-- Leaving
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #delta select year(a.' + @OffsetDate + ') * 12 + month(a.' + @OffsetDate + '), a.' + @OffsetDept + ', ' + @Revert + '- count(*), sum(datediff(d, a.' + @OffsetDate + ', dateadd(mm, datediff(m, 0, a.' + @OffsetDate + ') + 1, 0) - 1)) from hrnv a' + @Relate + ' where (a.' + @OffsetDate + ' between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ')' + @Valid + REPLACE(@EmployeeCondition, 'e.', 'a.') + ' group by a.' + @OffsetDept + ', year(a.' + @OffsetDate + ') * 12 + month(a.' + @OffsetDate + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Remain
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #qtlv select a.bo_phan, ' + @Revert + 'count(*) from hrnv a' + @Combine + ' where ((a.' + @OffsetDate + ' is null or a.' + @OffsetDate + ' >= ' + @d1 + ') and a.ngay_vao < ' + @d1 + ' and a.stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from hreqtlvht))' + @When + REPLACE(@EmployeeCondition, 'e.', 'a.') + ' group by a.bo_phan'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #delta select year(a.ngay_vao) * 12 + month(a.ngay_vao), a.bo_phan, ' + @Revert + 'count(*), sum(day(a.ngay_vao) - 1) from hrnv a' + @Combine + ' where ((a.' + @OffsetDate + ' is null or a.' + @OffsetDate + ' >= ' + @d1 + ') and (a.ngay_vao between ' + @d1 + ' and ' + @d2 + ') and a.stt_rec not in (select stt_rec from ' + @OffsetTable + '))' + @When + REPLACE(@EmployeeCondition, 'e.', 'a.') + ' group by a.bo_phan, year(a.ngay_vao) * 12 + month(a.ngay_vao)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Loop = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Loop = 0, @EmpType = '2', @Sign = -1, @Revert  = ' - '

		DELETE #d
		DELETE #t
		DELETE #in
		DELETE #transfer
		DELETE #out
		DELETE #ctqtlvdk

		GOTO Data;
	END

	--
	SELECT @n = @Year * 12 + @Period - 1, @d = CAST(RTRIM(@Year) + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' AS SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT ky - @n AS ky, bo_phan, SUM(sl) AS sl, SUM(CASE WHEN sl > 0 THEN sl ELSE 0 END) AS t, SUM(ngay) AS ngay INTO #adj FROM #delta GROUP BY ky - @n, bo_phan
	CREATE INDEX i ON #adj(ky, bo_phan)


	SELECT CAST(1 AS INT) AS ky, bo_phan, SUM(t1) AS dk, CAST(0 AS INT) AS t, CAST(0 AS INT) AS g, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ngay, CAST(0 AS INT) AS so_ngay, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ck INTO #r FROM #qtlv GROUP BY bo_phan
	CREATE INDEX i ON #r(bo_phan)
	INSERT INTO #r SELECT DISTINCT 1, bo_phan, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #adj WHERE bo_phan NOT IN (SELECT bo_phan FROM #r)
	CREATE INDEX j ON #r(ky, bo_phan)

	UPDATE #r SET t = b.t, g = b.t - b.sl, ngay = b.ngay FROM #r a JOIN #adj b ON b.ky = 1 AND a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan
	--
	SELECT @i = 2, @n = @Year * 12 + @Period
	WHILE @i <= @NumberPeriods BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #r SELECT a.ky + 1, a.bo_phan, a.dk + a.t - a.g, ISNULL(b.t, 0), ISNULL(b.t, 0) - ISNULL(b.sl, 0), ISNULL(b.ngay, 0), 0, 0 FROM #r a LEFT JOIN #adj b ON a.ky + 1 = b.ky AND a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan WHERE a.ky = @i - 1
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	UPDATE #r SET ck = dk + t - g, so_ngay = DAY(DATEADD(MM, ky, @d) - 1)

	-- Department
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrbp select a.ma_bp, a.bp_me, a.bp_ref, a.stt_ref, a.bac_bp, a.ten_bp, a.ten_bp2 from hrbp a' + CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'a')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @Type = 1 INSERT INTO #r SELECT 1, a.ma_bp, 0, 0, 0, 0, DAY(DATEADD(MM, 1, @d) - 1), 0 FROM #hrbp a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r b WHERE a.ma_bp = b.bo_phan)
	--
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @When = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'b'), '%a1', 'b'), '%a2', 'b')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @When, '#r', 'bo_phan'

		TRUNCATE TABLE #hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @When, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END


	--
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan AS sysRow, b.bac_bp, b.bp_me, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS sysColumn, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_nv_bq, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_nv_ta, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_nv_ng, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS so_nv_ct
		INTO #report FROM #r a, hrbp b

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #report select a.bo_phan, b.bac_bp, b.bp_me, 
		replace(str(a.ky, 2), '' '', ''0'') + ''/'' + replace(str(month(dateadd(mm, ky - 1, @d)), 2), '' '', ''0'') + ''/'' + rtrim(year(dateadd(mm, ky - 1, @d))),
		round((((a.dk + a.t) * a.so_ngay) - a.ngay)/cast(a.so_ngay as numeric(28, 6)), 2), a.t, a.g, a.ck
	from ' +
CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '#r' ELSE '(select ky, bo_phan, sum(dk) as dk, sum(t) as t, sum(g) as g, sum(ngay) as ngay, max(so_ngay) as so_ngay, sum(ck) as ck from #r group by ky, bo_phan)' END + '
	a left join #hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime', @d = @d

 	-- Total Column
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT sysRow, 0, '', 'ZZZZTOTAL', 
				ROUND(CAST(SUM(so_nv_bq) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) / CAST(@NumberPeriods AS NUMERIC(28, 6)), 2),
				SUM(so_nv_ta), SUM(so_nv_ng),
				ROUND(CAST(SUM(so_nv_ct) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) / CAST(@NumberPeriods AS NUMERIC(28, 6)), 0)
			FROM #report GROUP BY sysRow
	SELECT sysColumn, SUM(so_nv_bq) AS so_nv_bq, SUM(so_nv_ct) AS so_nv_ct, SUM(so_nv_ta) AS so_nv_ta, SUM(so_nv_ng) AS so_nv_ng INTO #total FROM #report GROUP BY sysColumn

	-- Parent Department
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0), @Where = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Filter, '%r', 'a'), '%a1', 'a'), '%a2', 'a')
	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = '
insert into #report(sysRow, sysColumn, bp_me, bac_bp, so_nv_bq, so_nv_ct, so_nv_ta, so_nv_ng)
	select distinct a.ma_bp, r.sysColumn, a.bp_me, @bac - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0
		from #report r join ' + @c + 'hrbp a on r.bp_me = a.ma_bp
		where (r.bac_bp = @bac and a.ma_bp + r.sysColumn not in (select sysRow + sysColumn from #report))
' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN CASE WHEN @Where = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Where END ELSE '' END

		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@bac int', @bac = @step
		--
		UPDATE #report SET so_nv_bq = a.so_nv_bq + b.so_nv_bq, so_nv_ct = a.so_nv_ct + b.so_nv_ct, so_nv_ta = a.so_nv_ta + b.so_nv_ta, so_nv_ng = a.so_nv_ng + b.so_nv_ng
			FROM #report a JOIN (
				SELECT bp_me, sysColumn, SUM(so_nv_bq) AS so_nv_bq, SUM(so_nv_ct) AS so_nv_ct, SUM(so_nv_ta) AS so_nv_ta, SUM(so_nv_ng) AS so_nv_ng
					FROM #report WHERE bac_bp = @step GROUP BY bp_me, sysColumn
			) b ON a.sysRow = b.bp_me AND a.sysColumn = b.sysColumn
		--
		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT sysRow, 0, '', 'ZZZZTOTAL', 
					ROUND(CAST(SUM(so_nv_bq) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) / CAST(@NumberPeriods AS NUMERIC(28, 6)), 2),
					SUM(so_nv_ta), SUM(so_nv_ng),
					ROUND(CAST(SUM(so_nv_ct) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) / CAST(@NumberPeriods AS NUMERIC(28, 6)), 0)
				FROM #report WHERE bac_bp = @step - 1 GROUP BY sysRow
		--
		SET @step = @step - 1
	END

	IF @DeptLevel <> 0 DELETE #report WHERE bac_bp > @DeptLevel

	-- Result
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, b.stt_ref, b.bp_me, a.sysRow, SPACE((b.bac_bp - 1) * 2) + b.ten_bp AS sysRowName, a.sysColumn, SPACE((b.bac_bp - 1) * 2) + b.ten_bp AS sysColumnName, a.so_nv_bq, a.so_nv_ct, a.so_nv_ta, a.so_nv_ng INTO #result FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #result
select 5, 1, 1, b.stt_ref, isnull(b.bp_me, ''''), 
		a.sysrow, space((b.bac_bp - 1) * 2) + isnull(b.ten_bp' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', ''''), 
		a.sysColumn, case a.sysColumn when ''ZZZZTOTAL'' THEN N''' + @Total + ''' else (substring(a.syscolumn, 4, 2)) end, 
		a.so_nv_bq, a.so_nv_ct, a.so_nv_ta, a.so_nv_ng
	from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.sysrow = b.ma_bp
	where a.bac_bp <> 0 or a.sysColumn = ''ZZZZTOTAL''
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q



	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #result SELECT 3, 0, 0, '', '', '', @Total, sysColumn, CASE sysColumn WHEN 'ZZZZTOTAL' THEN @Total ELSE (SUBSTRING(sysColumn, 4, 2)) END, so_nv_bq, so_nv_ct, so_nv_ta, so_nv_ng FROM #total
		UNION ALL SELECT 4, 0, 0, '', '', CHAR(10), '', sysColumn, '', 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #result GROUP BY sysColumn
		UNION ALL SELECT 9, 1, 1, '', '', CHAR(9), @Total, sysColumn, CASE sysColumn WHEN 'ZZZZTOTAL' THEN @Total ELSE (SUBSTRING(sysColumn, 4, 2)) END, so_nv_bq, so_nv_ct, so_nv_ta, so_nv_ng FROM #total

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #sysColumn(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #sysColumn(header) SELECT DISTINCT sysColumn FROM #result ORDER BY sysColumn
	UPDATE #sysColumn SET header = RIGHT(header, LEN(header) - 3)

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'so_nv_bq$', @h0
		UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'so_nv_ct$', @h1
		UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'so_nv_ta$', @h2
		UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'so_nv_ng$', @h3

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, id2 INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN a.header = 'ZTOTAL' THEN @Total + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(b.header) ELSE RTRIM(b.header) + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(a.header) END
		FROM #sysColumn a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_ref, sysRow, sysRowName, sysColumn
			, CASE WHEN sysColumn = 'ZZZZTOTAL' THEN sysColumnName ELSE @Month + SPACE(1) + sysColumnName END AS sysColumnName
			, so_nv_bq, so_nv_ct, so_nv_ta, so_nv_ng
		FROM #result ORDER BY sysorder, sysColumn, stt_ref

	SELECT a.id, a.name, a.header FROM #pivot a ORDER BY a.id



	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APDelExRD](
	@cFC VARCHAR(33),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListDel(@nUserID)
	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)
	DELETE cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @ngay_ct AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC)
		AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM cttt30 WHERE ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND ngay_ct <= @Ngay_ct AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$Transaction]
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@tableGeneralUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableMasterUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableDetailUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_wh INTO #afterUpdate FROM d74$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_wh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_wh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_wh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@tableGeneralUpdate)), '''', '''''') + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_wh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s	
	END

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cWHIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineWHIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_wh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_wh FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @cLineWHIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_wh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cWHIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_wh <> ''
			SET @s = 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableDetailUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_wh + ' SET sl_ss = sl_ss + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @cLineWHIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_wh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update datetime, user, status...
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_wh, MAX(dyn_wh) AS dyn_wh FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_wh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @dyn_wh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cWHIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_wh <> ''
			SET @s = 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableMasterUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_wh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @dyn_wh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_CheckIrregular$Parameter]
	@name NVARCHAR(32),
	@val NVARCHAR(512),
	@result VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @irregular NVARCHAR(128), @p INT
	SELECT @irregular = irregular FROM bidmts WHERE name = @name
	SELECT @result = @name, @p = 1
	IF (RTRIM(@irregular) <> '') BEGIN
		WHILE @p <= LEN(@val) BEGIN
			IF CHARINDEX(SUBSTRING(@val, @p, 1), @irregular) > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @result = NULL
				RETURN
			END
			SET @p = @p + 1
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintIPTran]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Site1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Site2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Term VARCHAR(33),
	@Currency VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),	
	@DebitAccount VARCHAR(1023),
	@Reason VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@Status VARCHAR(32),
	@Owner BIT, 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT,
	@DataType CHAR(1) = '2' -- 1: Physics, 2: Book
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF	

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyMaster NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @tName VARCHAR(33)

	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @tName = '75'
		ELSE SELECT @tName = '55'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ma_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon as ma_khox, dien_giai, tien_nt2 AS t_tien_nt, ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin

	SELECT @Key = '', @KeyMaster = ''	
	IF @Site1 <> '' SET @KeyMaster = '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site1), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Site2 <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site2), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Term <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Term), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @KeyMaster = @KeyMaster + '%#40$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '', '''') + '%'
	IF @KeyMaster <> '' SET @Key = 'm$ like ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@KeyMaster), '%%', '%'), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#10$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
	IF @DebitAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#20$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DebitAccount), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'd$ like '''+ '%#30$' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''	

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  CASE 
		WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @Status) =0 THEN '(a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@Status, '''', '''''') + ''')'
		ELSE '(a.status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Status, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
	END	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.status <> ''*'')'
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'
	
	IF (@Admin = 0) SELECT @SiteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey('PNF', @UserID, 0)
	IF @SiteKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)	

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, b.ma_ct, a.so_ct, b.ma_kho, b.ma_khox, b.dien_giai, b.t_tien_nt, b.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from i' + @tName + '$%Partition a with(nolock) left join m' + @tName + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT DISTINCT 0 AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khox, a.dien_giai, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt 
		FROM #tmp a 
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs_CaclAvgPrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(32), 
	@item VARCHAR(32), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(32), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(32), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(32), 
	@type CHAR(2), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(32), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(64) , 
	@priceFCType TINYINT, 
	@userID INT, 
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@sysDB VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@debugMode INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @nCycle INT, @nYear INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @admin TINYINT, @tPxf VARCHAR(32), @siteTable VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @nCycle = MONTH(@dTo), @nYear = YEAR(@dTo)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #itempxf FROM dmvt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #dmvt FROM dmvt
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmvt select ma_vt from dmvt where gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
	IF @item <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @type <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@type), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmvt(ma_vt)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho INTO #dmkho FROM dmkho
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmkho select ma_kho from dmkho' + CASE WHEN @siteGroup <> '' THEN ' where ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@siteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%''' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	CREATE INDEX i ON #dmkho(ma_kho)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_kho2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nhom, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS r, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(35)) AS c INTO #cd$kho FROM xcdkho
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ma_kho, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, nxt, ct_dc, pn_gia_tb, px_gia_dd, ma_khon, CAST('' AS CHAR(16)) AS c INTO #ct70 FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #BgItem FROM wrkin
	SELECT ma_kho, ma_khon, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #tnhap1 FROM wrkin

	--
	EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables
	EXEC fs_DeleteINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item,  @group1, @group2, @group3, @type, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @siteGroup, @updateType

	IF @updateType <> 2 BEGIN
		EXEC xs_CalcAvg @dFrom, @dTo, @siteGroup, @userID, @admin, @debugMode
		EXEC xs_AvgSSGroupItems @nCycle, @nYear
		EXEC xs_CalcAvgItems @nCycle, @nYear, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @type, @debugMode

		IF @site <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT ma_kho INTO #xdmkho FROM #dmkho WHERE ma_kho LIKE @site + '%'
			CREATE INDEX i ON #xdmkho(ma_kho)
			SET @siteTable = '#xdmkho'
		END ELSE SET @siteTable = '#dmkho'

		EXEC fs20_UpdateAvgPrice @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @type, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, 
			@vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, '#dmvt', @siteTable
	END


	IF @deffType <> 0 OR 1 = 1 BEGIN -- Always running
		SELECT @tPxf = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tinh_x0' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tinh_x1' AND val = '1') THEN '#itempxf' ELSE '#dmvt' END
		EXEC fs_CreateINDeffTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @type, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @userID, @admin, @siteGroup, @tPxf, @siteTable
	END

	IF @updateType <> 0 EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPrice2GL @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @type, @deffType, @deffAcct, @updateType, @siteType, @vcDeffCode, @costType, @vcIRCodes, @vcISCodes, @vcIBCodes, @vcIPCodes, @vcIICodes, @priceFCType, @userID, @siteGroup, '#dmvt', @siteTable, @sysDB

	--EXEC fs_DeleteAvgWrkTables
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Fields] @db1 VARCHAR(32), @db2 VARCHAR(32), @t1 VARCHAR(32), @t2 VARCHAR(32), @s VARCHAR(8000) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #c1 FROM syscolumns
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #c2 FROM #c1

	SET @q = 'insert into #c1 select a.* from ' + RTRIM(@db1) + '.dbo.syscolumns a join ' + RTRIM(@db1) + '.dbo.sysobjects b on a.id = b.id where b.name = ''' + @t1 + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #c2 select a.* from ' + RTRIM(@db2) + '.dbo.syscolumns a join ' + RTRIM(@db2) + '.dbo.sysobjects b on a.id = b.id where b.name = ''' + @t2 + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @s IS NULL THEN '' ELSE @s + ',' END + name FROM #c1 WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM #c2) ORDER BY colorder

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintMOTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	--IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END
	
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt'
	IF @Bilingual = 1 SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt2'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 5, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END
