CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBISATracking] --rs_rptPOFollowReport
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@PRFrom AS VARCHAR(33),
	@PRTo AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(33),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(33),
	@DueDate AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateReport AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Size AS TINYINT,
	@VCType VARCHAR(32) = '*',
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PlantKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @h1 NVARCHAR(511), @h2 NVARCHAR(511), @h3 NVARCHAR(511), @h4 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN form_name ELSE form_name2 END FROM sysrpoptions WHERE form = 'v20POFollow' AND form_type = '222'
	SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN form_name ELSE form_name2 END FROM sysrpoptions WHERE form = 'v20POFollow' AND form_type = '333'
	SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN form_name ELSE form_name2 END FROM sysrpoptions WHERE form = 'v20POFollow' AND form_type = '444'
	SELECT @h4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V'  THEN form_name ELSE form_name2 END FROM sysrpoptions WHERE form = 'v20POFollow' AND form_type = '555'

	--Struct
	SELECT a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.status, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_sa, a.so_ct AS so_dh, b.ma_vt AS ma_vt, b.dvt AS dvt, b.so_luong AS so_luong, b.tien, b.tien_nt, b.gia AS gia, b.gia_nt AS gia_nt, b.thue_suat_nk AS thue_suat_nk
			, b.tien AS nk, b.tien_nt AS nk_nt, b.thue_suat AS thue_suat, b.thue_nt AS thue_nt, b.thue AS thue, a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_tt, b.ngay_giao , b.stt_rec_nc
			, b.tien AS tien1, b.tien_nt AS tien_nt1, b.tien AS tien2, b.tien_nt AS tien_nt2, b.sl_nhap, b.sl_hd, b.stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0sa, c.dept_id AS ma_bp, c.ong_ba, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai
			, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, b.ma_vung
		INTO #master FROM bim06$000000 a, bid06$000000 b, m91$000000 c

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status not in (''1'', ''0'', ''*'') and (b.ngay_giao <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DueDate, 112) + '''' + ' or b.ngay_giao is null)'

	IF @PRFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PRFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @PRTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@PRTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VCType <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ct = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCType), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho0', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or a.ma_kho0 = '''')'

	IF @PurOrgCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrgCode, @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
	END
	IF @PurGrCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGrKey OUTPUT, '2'
		IF @PurGrCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGrCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PurGrKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PurGrKey + ')'
	END
	IF @PlantCode IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'b.ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PlantCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @PlantKey + ')'
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = '
insert into #master
	select a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.status, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.tien + b.thue + b.thue_nk, b.tien_nt + b.thue_nt + b.thue_nk_nt, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.thue_suat_nk, b.thue_nk, b.thue_nk_nt, b.thue_suat
			, b.thue_nt, b.thue, a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_tt, b.ngay_giao, b.stt_rec_nc, b.tien + b.thue, b.tien_nt + b.thue_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, b.sl_nhap, b.sl_hd, b.stt_rec0
			, '''', '''', '''', a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, b.ma_vung
		from bim06$%Partition a with(nolock) join bid06$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'b.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @dyn_nc VARCHAR(6)
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(YEAR(b.ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(b.ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #master a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec_nc <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @dyn_nc
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update #master set ma_bp = b.dept_id, ong_ba = b.ong_ba from #master a join m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' b on a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @dyn_nc
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END

	--Struct for Union All
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec AS stt_rec_sa, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd AS stt_rec0sa INTO #tmp FROM d71$000000

	--Key 71 & exec
	SET @Key = 'a.stt_rec_hd in (select stt_rec_sa from #master) and a.stt_rec in (select stt_rec from m71$%Partition where status = ''2'''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ngay_ct between ' + '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + '''))'
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec_hd, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0hd from d71$%Partition a where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateReport, @UserID, @Admin

	--72
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '71$', '72$')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateReport, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT stt_rec AS stt_rec_hd, MAX(tat_toan) AS tat_toan, SUM(t_tt_qd) AS t_tt_qd INTO #tt FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec_hd FROM #tmp) GROUP BY stt_rec
	SELECT a.stt_rec_sa, MIN(c.tat_toan) AS tat_toan, SUM(t_tt_qd) AS t_tt_qd INTO #report FROM #master a LEFT JOIN #tmp b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa AND a.stt_rec0sa = b.stt_rec0sa LEFT JOIN #tt c ON b.stt_rec_hd = c.stt_rec_hd GROUP BY a.stt_rec_sa, a.stt_rec0sa

	-- Da lap hoa don nhung chua thanh toan
	UPDATE #report SET tat_toan = NULL WHERE tat_toan = 0 AND t_tt_qd = 0

	UPDATE #master SET dien_giai = @h1 WHERE stt_rec_sa IN (SELECT a.stt_rec_sa FROM #master a JOIN #report b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa WHERE status = '5' GROUP BY a.stt_rec_sa HAVING SUM(sl_hd) = 0) --Huy
	UPDATE #master SET dien_giai = @h4 WHERE stt_rec_sa IN (SELECT a.stt_rec_sa FROM #master a JOIN #report b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa GROUP BY a.stt_rec_sa HAVING MIN(tat_toan) = 0) AND dien_giai = '' --Dang thanh toan
	UPDATE #master SET dien_giai = @h4 WHERE stt_rec_sa IN (SELECT a.stt_rec_sa FROM #master a JOIN #report b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa GROUP BY a.stt_rec_sa HAVING MIN(tat_toan) = 1 AND SUM(sl_hd) < SUM(so_luong)) AND dien_giai = '' --Dang thanh toan
	UPDATE #master SET dien_giai = @h3 WHERE stt_rec_sa IN (SELECT a.stt_rec_sa FROM #master a JOIN #report b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa GROUP BY a.stt_rec_sa HAVING MIN(tat_toan) = 1) AND dien_giai = '' --Tat toan
	UPDATE #master SET dien_giai = @h2 WHERE dien_giai = '' --Chua thanh toan

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#master', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- Exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 stt_rec_sa FROM #master) INSERT INTO #master (stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, ma_ct, ma_vt, ma_dvcs) values('', '', '', '', '')

	-- View
	SET @q = '
select a.ma_dvcs, stt_rec_sa as stt_rec_dh, so_dh, loai_ct as ma_ct, ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, so_luong, ma_nt, ty_gia, gia_nt, gia, thue_suat_nk, nk_nt, nk, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue, tien_nt, tien
		, a.ma_tt, ngay_giao, sl_nhap, a.ong_ba, ma_bp, dien_giai, case when a.sl_nhap is null then a.so_luong else a.so_luong - a.sl_nhap end as sl_cl, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, a.ma_vung
		, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END + '
		, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END + '
	from #master a
		left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
	order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_dh, stt_rec_sa, a.ma_vt
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs30_FCConvert4VND
	@cVC CHAR(3), 
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cFCCode VARCHAR(33)
AS
BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') RETURN
	
	DECLARE @cFC1 VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @cFC1 = dbo.ff30_FC1()

	IF @cFCCode = @cFC1
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = ps_no_nt, ps_no_nt = ps_no, ps_co = ps_co_nt, ps_co_nt = ps_co WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
			
			UPDATE ct70 SET gia_nt1 = gia1, gia_nt01 = gia01, gia_nt21 = gia21, gia_nt = gia, tien_nt_n = tien_nhap, tien_nt_x = tien_xuat, gia_nt0 = gia0, tien_nt0 = tien0, cp_vc_nt = cp_vc, cp_bh_nt = cp_bh, cp_khac_nt = cp_khac, cp_nt = cp, nk_nt = nk, gia_nt2 = gia2, tien_nt2 = tien2, thue_nt = thue, ck_nt = ck,
					gia1 = gia_nt1, gia01 = gia_nt01, gia21 = gia_nt21, gia = gia_nt, tien_nhap = tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = tien_nt_x, gia0 = gia_nt0, tien0 = tien_nt0, cp_vc = cp_vc_nt, cp_bh = cp_bh_nt, cp_khac = cp_khac_nt, cp = cp_nt, nk = nk_nt, gia2 = gia_nt2, tien2 = tien_nt2, thue = thue_nt, ck = ck_nt 
				WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
			

			IF EXISTS(SELECT stt_rec_dc FROM ct70 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND stt_rec_dc <> '' AND px_gia_dd = 1 AND nxt = 2)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct70 SET gia_nt1 = gia1, gia_nt01 = gia01, gia_nt21 = gia21, gia_nt = gia, tien_nt_n = tien_nhap, tien_nt_x = tien_xuat, gia_nt0 = gia0, tien_nt0 = tien0, cp_vc_nt = cp_vc, cp_bh_nt = cp_bh, cp_khac_nt = cp_khac, cp_nt = cp, nk_nt = nk, gia_nt2 = gia2, tien_nt2 = tien2, thue_nt = thue, ck_nt = ck,
							gia1 = gia_nt1, gia01 = gia_nt01, gia21 = gia_nt21, gia = gia_nt, tien_nhap = tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = tien_nt_x, gia0 = gia_nt0, tien0 = tien_nt0, cp_vc = cp_vc_nt, cp_bh = cp_bh_nt, cp_khac = cp_khac_nt, cp = cp_nt, nk = nk_nt, gia2 = gia_nt2, tien2 = tien_nt2, thue = thue_nt, ck = ck_nt 
				 		WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec_dc FROM ct70 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND stt_rec_dc <> '' AND nxt = 2)
				END

			UPDATE ct90 SET gia_nt1 = gia1, gia_nt01 = gia01, gia_nt21 = gia21, gia_nt = gia, tien_nt_n = tien_nhap, tien_nt_x = tien_xuat, gia_nt0 = gia0, tien_nt0 = tien0, cp_vc_nt = cp_vc, cp_bh_nt = cp_bh, cp_khac_nt = cp_khac, cp_nt = cp, nk_nt = nk, gia_nt2 = gia2, tien_nt2 = tien2, thue_nt = thue, ck_nt = ck,
					gia1 = gia_nt1, gia01 = gia_nt01, gia21 = gia_nt21, gia = gia_nt, tien_nhap = tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = tien_nt_x, gia0 = gia_nt0, tien0 = tien_nt0, cp_vc = cp_vc_nt, cp_bh = cp_bh_nt, cp_khac = cp_khac_nt, cp = cp_nt, nk = nk_nt, gia2 = gia_nt2, tien2 = tien_nt2, thue = thue_nt, ck = ck_nt 
				WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
			

			IF EXISTS(SELECT stt_rec_dc FROM ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND stt_rec_dc <> '' AND px_gia_dd = 1 AND nxt = 2)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE ct90 SET gia_nt1 = gia1, gia_nt01 = gia01, gia_nt21 = gia21, gia_nt = gia, tien_nt_n = tien_nhap, tien_nt_x = tien_xuat, gia_nt0 = gia0, tien_nt0 = tien0, cp_vc_nt = cp_vc, cp_bh_nt = cp_bh, cp_khac_nt = cp_khac, cp_nt = cp, nk_nt = nk, gia_nt2 = gia2, tien_nt2 = tien2, thue_nt = thue, ck_nt = ck,
							gia1 = gia_nt1, gia01 = gia_nt01, gia21 = gia_nt21, gia = gia_nt, tien_nhap = tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = tien_nt_x, gia0 = gia_nt0, tien0 = tien_nt0, cp_vc = cp_vc_nt, cp_bh = cp_bh_nt, cp_khac = cp_khac_nt, cp = cp_nt, nk = nk_nt, gia2 = gia_nt2, tien2 = tien_nt2, thue = thue_nt, ck = ck_nt 
				 		WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec_dc FROM ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber AND stt_rec_dc <> '' AND nxt = 2)
				END

			UPDATE ctgt20 SET t_tien_nt2 = t_tien2, t_thue_nt = t_thue, t_tien2 = t_tien_nt2, t_thue = t_thue_nt WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
			UPDATE ctgt30 SET gia_nt = gia, t_tien_nt = t_tien, t_thue_nt = t_thue, gia = gia_nt, t_tien = t_tien_nt, t_thue = t_thue_nt WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
		END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialAnalysisPeriodDelete]
	@Unit VARCHAR(512), -- đơn vị
	@PeriodFrom INT, -- kỳ 1
	@YearFrom INT,-- năm 1
	@PeriodTo INT,-- kỳ 2
	@YearTo INT,-- năm 2
	@ReportCode CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo
	@ReportCodeNote CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo dùng cho phần đánh giá
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- dạng báo cáo
	@PeriodType CHAR(1),-- loại kỳ
	@PeriodNo INT, -- số kỳ
	@Form CHAR(16),-- mẫu báo cáo
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	DECLARE @i INT
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @PeriodNo BEGIN
		-- Xóa giá trị
		DELETE gltcpt99 WHERE ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam1 = (@YearFrom + @i - 1) AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND nam2 = (@YearTo + @i - 1)
			AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = @ReportCode AND dang_bc = @ReportType AND loai_ky = @PeriodType AND form = @Form AND so_ky = 1

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Xóa đánh giá
	DELETE gltcpt99 WHERE ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND nam2 = @YearTo
		AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = @ReportCodeNote AND dang_bc = @ReportType AND loai_ky = @PeriodType AND form = @Form AND so_ky = @PeriodNo

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$SFCTransfer$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(16, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32), @LotNumber VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT ma_kho, dvt, lo_yn INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	IF @DefaultSite <> ''
		AND (
			NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode)
			OR (dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 0)
			)
		UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = ''

	CREATE TABLE #LotNumber (ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #LotNumber EXEC fs_GetLotNumber @Item
	SELECT @LotNumber = ''

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #LotNumber) SELECT @LotNumber = ma_lo FROM #LotNumber
	SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_kho) AS ma_kho, RTRIM(@UOM) AS dvt, @Rate AS he_so, RTRIM(@LotNumber) AS ma_lo, a.lo_yn FROM #Item a

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcEdWipCostByEndingMaterials]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@SiteGroup VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nRound INT, @nFCRound INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @m_gia_vt CHAR(1), @m_gia_nh_kho CHAR(1), @table VARCHAR(8)

	SELECT @m_gia_vt = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_vt'
	SELECT @m_gia_nh_kho = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_nh_kho'	
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year)
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END

	-- Site Key
	SELECT @SiteKey = ' and ma_kho = ''''', @table = 'dmgia'
	IF @m_gia_nh_kho = '1' AND @m_gia_vt = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @table = 'dmgia5'
		IF @SiteGroup <> '' SELECT @SiteKey = ' and nhom_kho = ''' + REPLACE(@SiteGroup, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END ELSE
		IF @m_gia_vt = '2'
			IF @Site <> '' SELECT @SiteKey = ' and ma_kho = ''' + REPLACE(@Site, '''', '''''') + ''''

	CREATE TABLE #gia (ma_vt VARCHAR(33), gia NUMERIC(28, 6), gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))

	SELECT @q = 'INSERT INTO #gia(ma_vt, gia, gia_nt) SELECT ma_vt, gia%ii, gia_nt%ii FROM ' + @table + ' WHERE nam = ' + STR(@Year, 4) + @SiteKey
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%ii', REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0'))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update xcdvtdd2 set dd_ck = round(a.sl_ck * b.gia, ' + LTRIM(@nRound) + '), dd_ck_nt = round(a.sl_ck * b.gia_nt, ' + LTRIM(@nFCRound) + ')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xcdvtdd2 a join #gia b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @q = 'delete xcdnvldd from xcdnvldd a where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'insert into xcdnvldd (ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, dd_ck, dd_ck_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ', ' + LTRIM(@Year) + ', ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sum(dd_ck), sum(dd_ck_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , '''', getdate(), getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + LTRIM(@UserID)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '''', '''', '''''
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from xcdvtdd2 a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs_AvgSSGroupItems] @cycle TINYINT, @year INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @item VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @item = MIN(ma_vt) FROM #dmvt
	WHILE @item IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC xs_AvgSSGroupPItem @cycle, @year, @item
		--
		SELECT @item = MIN(ma_vt) FROM #dmvt WHERE ma_vt > @item
	END
END
