CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployeeWorkdaySheet]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@WorkdayList VARCHAR(1024),
	@WorkdayType VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 VARCHAR(32), @Where NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @i INT, @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @WorkingHours NUMERIC(5, 2)
	SELECT @Where = '', @Join = '', @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @Filter = ''

	SELECT @WorkingHours = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS NUMERIC(5, 2)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_gio'

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #temp(stt_rec CHAR(13), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(9, 2), so_ngay NUMERIC(9, 2))
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(9, 2), so_ngay NUMERIC(9, 2), stt_ref VARCHAR(512), ho_ten_nv NVARCHAR(128), ten_bp NVARCHAR(128), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @WorkdayList <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkdayList), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	IF @WorkdayType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'c.ma_loai in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@WorkdayType), '''', ''''''), ',', ''','''), ' ', '') + ''')'
	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = stt_rec FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	END

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on r.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	IF @WorkdayType <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrdmcong c on r.ma_cong = c.ma_cong'
	IF @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' join hrnv a on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec' 

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #temp select r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong, sum(r.so_gio), sum(r.so_ngay)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcongth$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp, r.ma_cong'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'r.ngay', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT stt_rec, bo_phan, ma_cong, SUM(so_gio) AS so_gio, SUM(so_ngay) AS so_ngay INTO #t FROM #temp GROUP BY stt_rec, bo_phan, ma_cong
	INSERT INTO #report(stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref, ho_ten_nv, ten_bp)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, so_ngay, c.stt_ref, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + ' ' + b.ten_nv, ''
			FROM #t a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp
			ORDER BY a.bo_phan, b.ma_nv, a.ma_cong

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @DeptKey = CASE WHEN @JoinEmp = 1 THEN '' ELSE @Filter END
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#report', 'bo_phan', 'stt_ref=b.stt_ref'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Order
	SELECT bo_phan, ma_nv, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #v FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan, ma_nv
	CREATE TABLE #u(bo_phan VARCHAR(32), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #u SELECT bo_phan, ma_nv FROM #v ORDER BY bo_phan, ma_nv
	SELECT bo_phan, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #order FROM #u GROUP BY bo_phan
	
	-- Report
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct a.bo_phan, b.bp_me from #order a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @Where = CASE WHEN @Filter = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Filter
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = max(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0) - 1
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select distinct b.ma_bp, b.bp_me from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on r.bp_me = b.ma_bp where (b.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r))' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN @Where ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = min(b.bac_bp) from #r a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step out
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report(stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref, ho_ten_nv, ten_bp)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select '''', '''', a.bo_phan, '''', 0, 0, b.stt_ref, '''', space(2 * (b.bac_bp - ' + RTRIM(@step) + ')) + b.ten_bp' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #r a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Result
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, stt_ref, ho_ten_nv, ten_bp) SELECT '', '', '', '', 0, 0, '', '', ''
	SELECT CASE WHEN v.stt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE u.stt - o.stt + 1 END AS stt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, RTRIM(a.bo_phan) AS bo_phan, a.ten_bp, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.so_ngay
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN #order o ON a.bo_phan = o.bo_phan
			LEFT JOIN #u u ON a.bo_phan = u.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = u.ma_nv
			LEFT JOIN #v v ON a.bo_phan = v.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = v.ma_nv AND a.stt = v.stt
		ORDER BY a.stt_ref, a.ma_nv, a.ma_cong

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPurchaseJournal] --fs30_AcctsJournal15D--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(1024),
	@AccountRef1 VARCHAR(1024),
	@AccountRef2 VARCHAR(1024),
	@ExcludedAccts VARCHAR(1024),
	@VCs VARCHAR(1024),
	@FCs VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END
			, @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname2 ELSE cname END -- song ngữ
		FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ty_gia, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.dien_giai_h  AS dien_giai
			, a.tk AS tk, a.tk_du AS tk_du, a.ma_nt
			, a.ps_no  AS tien, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS dien_giai2 -- song ngữ
		INTO #tmp
		FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY 1

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ' + CHAR (39) + '1' + CHAR (39)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @VCs <> '' BEGIN
		SET @VCs = REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCs), '''', '''''')
		IF CHARINDEX(',', @VCs) <= 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_ct_in like ''' + @VCs + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VCs, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where b.ma_ct_in like fc.fc)'
	END
	IF @FCs <> '' BEGIN
		SET @FCs = REPLACE(RTRIM(@FCs), '''', '''''')
		IF CHARINDEX(',', @FCs) <= 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + @FCs + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FCs, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where a.ma_nt like fc.fc)'
	END
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + ' isnull(a.ps_co, 0) + isnull(a.ps_co_nt, 0) <> 0 '
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, max(a.ty_gia), a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'max(a.so_ct0)' ELSE '''''' END + ', b.ma_ct_in, max(isnull(b.stt_ct_nkc, '''')), cast(max(a.dien_giai_h) AS nvarchar(511)) '
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, max(a.ma_nt), (sum(a.ps_no) + sum (a.ps_co)), (sum(a.ps_no_nt) + sum(a.ps_co_nt)) '
	SET @q = @q + ', ''''' -- song ngữ
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a  with(nolock) left join dmct b with(index(PK_dmct)) on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ngay_ct, ngay_lct, b.ma_ct_in, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.tk_du, stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS xorder
		, tien AS t_tien, tien_nt AS t_tien_nt, tien AS tien1, tien_nt AS tien_nt1, tien AS tien2, tien_nt AS tien_nt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	SELECT @AccountRef1 = REPLACE(REPLACE(@AccountRef1, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
	SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk_du INTO #accRef1 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@AccountRef1, ',')
	IF @AccountRef1 <> '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder, stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk, tk_du, ma_nt, stt_ct_nkc, t_tien, t_tien_nt, tien1, tien_nt1, tien2, tien_nt2, tien, tien_nt)
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ty_gia), a.ma_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, MAX(a.so_ct0), MAX(a.dien_giai), a.tk, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.tk_du) > 1 THEN RTRIM(@AccountRef1) ELSE MAX(a.tk_du) END, MAX(a.ma_nt), MAX(a.stt_ct_nkc), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0
				FROM #tmp a
				WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef1 b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_du)
				GROUP BY a.ma_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.stt_rec
	END
	SELECT @AccountRef2 = REPLACE(REPLACE(@AccountRef2, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
	SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk_du INTO #accRef2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@AccountRef2, ',')
	IF @AccountRef2 <> '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder, stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk, tk_du, ma_nt, stt_ct_nkc, t_tien, t_tien_nt, tien1, tien_nt1, tien2, tien_nt2, tien, tien_nt)
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, 2, a.stt_rec, MAX(a.ty_gia), a.ma_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, MAX(a.so_ct0), MAX(a.dien_giai), a.tk, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.tk_du) > 1 THEN RTRIM(@AccountRef2) ELSE MAX(a.tk_du) END, MAX(a.ma_nt), MAX(a.stt_ct_nkc), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), 0, 0, SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), 0, 0
				FROM #tmp a
				WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef2 b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_du)
				GROUP BY a.ma_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.stt_rec
	END
	IF(RTRIM(@ExcludedAccts) <> '') BEGIN
		SELECT @ExcludedAccts = REPLACE(REPLACE(@ExcludedAccts, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
		SELECT DISTINCT data + '%' AS tk_du INTO #accExcluded FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ExcludedAccts, ',')
		DELETE #tmp FROM #tmp a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accExcluded b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_du)
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder, stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk, tk_du, stt_ct_nkc, t_tien, t_tien_nt, tien1, tien_nt1, tien2, tien_nt2, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, 5, stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, tk, tk_du, stt_ct_nkc, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, tien, tien_nt
			FROM #tmp a
			WHERE (@AccountRef1 = '' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef1 b WHERE a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_du))
				AND (@AccountRef2 = '' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #accRef2 c WHERE a.tk_du LIKE c.tk_du))

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder, stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, dien_giai2, tk, stt_ct_nkc, t_tien, t_tien_nt, tien1, tien_nt1, tien2, tien_nt2, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 5, 1, 0, 0, stt_rec, MAX(ty_gia), ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, MAX(so_ct0), MAX(dien_giai), '', '', MAX(stt_ct_nkc), SUM(t_tien), SUM(t_tien_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
			FROM #report
			GROUP BY ma_ct0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET dien_giai = '' WHERE systotal = 1

	UPDATE #report SET dien_giai = SPACE(2) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE b.ten_tk2 END
			, dien_giai2 = SPACE(2) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE b.ten_tk END -- song ngữ
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk
		WHERE a.systotal = 1

	UPDATE #report SET tk_du = '' WHERE xorder <> 5

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder, dien_giai, dien_giai2, t_tien, t_tien_nt, tien1, tien_nt1, tien2, tien_nt2, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, 0, @s, @s2 -- song ngữ
				, SUM(t_tien), SUM(t_tien_nt), SUM(tien1), SUM(tien_nt1), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt)
			FROM #report
			WHERE systotal = 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder) VALUES (1, 0, 0, 0)
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder) VALUES (99, 1, 0, 0)
		END
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, xorder) VALUES (1, 1, 0, 0)
	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SELECT sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, ma_ct0, ma_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, tk, tk_du, tien_nt, t_tien_nt, tien_nt1, tien_nt2
			, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tien, tien, tien1, tien2, dien_giai, ISNULL(dien_giai2, '') AS dien_giai2 -- song ngữ
		 FROM #report
		 ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, tk, xorder

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$DiscountDetailTax]
	@isFc BIT,
	@discountType INT,
	@language VARCHAR(1),
	@provider INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @discountText NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @discountText = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT099'


	--
	IF @discountType = '1'
		INSERT INTO #detail([key], ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, ck, xu_ly)
			SELECT [key], CASE WHEN ghi_chuthue = '' THEN @discountText ELSE ghi_chuthue END, '', 0, 0, t_ck, CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN -9 ELSE 0 END, 0, t_ck, '4' FROM #master WHERE t_ck <> 0


	--
	IF @discountType = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @r INT
		IF @isFC = 0 SELECT @r = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
			ELSE SELECT @r = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'


		SELECT TOP 0 a.[key], a.tien, a.thue_suat, a.thue, b.ghi_chuthue, a.ma_thue, b.t_thue, a.tien AS t_thue_tmp, a.tien AS t_thue_cal
			INTO #dDiscount FROM #detail a, #master b

		DECLARE @key1 NVARCHAR(4000), @key2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @key1 = '', @key2 = ''
		SELECT @key1 = @key1 + ',' + RTRIM(thue_suat) FROM dmcqtthuesuat WHERE thue_suat_ck = 1
		SELECT @key2 = @key2 + ',' + RTRIM(thue_suat) FROM dmcqtthuesuat WHERE thue_suat_ck = 2
		SELECT @key1 = STUFF(@key1, 1, 1, ''), @key2 = STUFF(@key2, 1, 1, '')

		-- Update master
		SELECT @q = '
update #master set t_thue5 = round(isnull(b.thue, 0), ' + RTRIM(@r) + ') from #master a join (select [key], sum(thue) as thue from #detail where thue_suat in (' + @key1 + ') group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]
update #master set t_thue10 = t_thue - round(isnull(b.thue, 0), ' + RTRIM(@r) + ') from #master a left join (select [key], sum(thue) as thue from #detail where thue_suat not in (' + @key2 + ') group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]
update #master set t_thue5 = isnull(t_thue5, 0), t_thue10 = isnull(t_thue10, 0)

insert into #ddiscount
select a.[key], sum(a.ck) as tien, max(a.thue_suat) as thue_suat, case when max(a.thue_suat) < 0 then 0 else sum(round(a.ck * a.thue_suat/100, ' + RTRIM(@r) + ')) end, max(b.ghi_chuthue) as ghi_chuthue, a.ma_thue,
		max(b.t_thue) as t_thue, case when max(a.thue_suat) in (' + @key2 + ') then max(b.t_thue10) else sum(a.thue) end as t_thue_tmp,
		case when max(a.thue_suat) > 0 then sum(round(a.tien * a.thue_suat/100, ' + RTRIM(@r) + ')) else sum(0*a.thue) end as t_thue_cal
	from #detail a join #master b on a.[key] = b.[key]
	where b.t_ck <> 0
	group by a.[key], a.ma_thue
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Recal Tax
		UPDATE #detail SET thue = ROUND(a.tien * a.thue_suat / 100, @r) FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.[key] = b.[key] WHERE a.thue_suat > 0 AND b.t_ck <> 0

		-- Allocate
		UPDATE #dDiscount SET thue = t_thue_cal - t_thue_tmp WHERE thue_suat > 0 AND thue_suat IN (SELECT thue_suat FROM dmcqtthuesuat WHERE thue_suat_ck = 2)



		-- Update detail
		INSERT INTO #detail([key], ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, ck, xu_ly)
			SELECT a.[key], CASE WHEN a.ghi_chuthue = '' THEN @discountText ELSE a.ghi_chuthue END, '', 0, 0, a.tien, a.thue_suat, a.thue, a.tien, '3'
				FROM #dDiscount a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue
				WHERE a.tien <> 0
				ORDER BY a.[key], b.stt

	END


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCustomerBalanceOfMultiAccount] -- fs_AcctsCustomers --
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(511),
	@Order VARCHAR(511),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b FROM cdkh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt,
			ps_no AS ps_no, ps_no_nt AS ps_no_nt, ps_co AS ps_co, ps_co_nt AS ps_co_nt,
			ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #t	FROM wrkgl

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = 'left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	--
	DECLARE @JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000), @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @JoinClause = 'join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk ' + @Join, @WhereClause = 'c.tk_cn = 1' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	INSERT INTO #b EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, NULL, @Account, @Customer, 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @JoinClause, @WhereClause
	--
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh is not null'
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.tk in (select tk from dmtk where tk_cn = 1)'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = ' insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0,	sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt,	0, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		SET @q = ' insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_kh, 0, 0, 0, 0,	sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt,	0, 0, 0, 0'
		SET @q = @q + ' from pskh$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--
	INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_no_nt, du_co, du_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #b

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, a.tk AS tk, a.ma_kh, SUM(no_dk) AS no_dk, SUM(no_dk_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(co_dk) AS co_dk, SUM(co_dk_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(no_ck) AS no_ck, SUM(no_ck_nt) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(co_ck) AS co_ck, SUM(co_ck_nt) AS co_ck_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, MAX(b.nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(b.nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(b.nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3
		INTO #report
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_kh

	DELETE #Report WHERE ABS(no_dk) + ABS(no_dk_nt) + ABS(co_dk) + ABS(co_dk_nt) + ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) = 0

	DECLARE @no_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @no_ck NUMERIC(28, 6),@no_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @no_dk = no_dk - co_dk, @no_dk_nt = no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt, @no_ck = @no_dk + ps_no - ps_co, @no_ck_nt = @no_dk_nt + ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt
		, no_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk > 0 THEN @no_dk ELSE 0 END, no_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt > 0 THEN @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_dk = CASE WHEN @no_dk < 0 THEN - @no_dk ELSE 0 END, co_dk_nt = CASE WHEN @no_dk_nt < 0 THEN - @no_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
		, no_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck > 0 THEN @no_ck ELSE 0 END, no_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt > 0 THEN @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
		, co_ck = CASE WHEN @no_ck < 0 THEN - @no_ck ELSE 0 END, co_ck_nt = CASE WHEN @no_ck_nt < 0 THEN - @no_ck_nt ELSE 0 END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'INT, #, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = CASE WHEN RTRIM(@GroupBy) = '' THEN 'tk, ' ELSE @GroupBy + ', tk, ' END + @Order
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	SET @q = dbo. ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy, 'kh', 'no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('kh', ' no_dk, co_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, co_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, tk, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, no_dk, no_dk_nt, co_dk, co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, no_ck, no_ck_nt, co_ck, co_ck_nt from #report'
	IF @GroupBy <> '' SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + @GroupBy + ', sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CaclBgStock]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@nSiteType TINYINT, 
	@nCostType TINYINT, 
	@cSiteGroup VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @cSiteGroup = RTRIM(@cSiteGroup) + '%', @d1 = RTRIM(YEAR(@dFrom)) + '0101', @d2 = @dFrom - 1

	SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, SUM(gia) AS gia, SUM(gia_nt) AS gia_nt, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt
		INTO #tb
		FROM(
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, SUM(gia) AS gia, SUM(gia_nt) AS gia_nt, SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat) AS ton_dau, SUM(tien_nhap - tien_xuat) AS du_dau, SUM(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x) AS du_dau_nt
				FROM ct70 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @d1 AND @d2
					AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
					AND ma_vt IN
					(SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
						AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%')
						AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%')
						AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%')
						AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
				GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho

				UNION ALL(
					SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, 0, 0, SUM(ton00), SUM(du00), SUM(du_nt00) FROM cdvt WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE nam = YEAR(@dFrom)
						AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
						AND ma_vt IN 
						(SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
							AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%')
							AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%')
							AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%')
							AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
					GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho
					)

				UNION ALL(
					SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, 0, 0, SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), SUM(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), SUM(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x)
						FROM ct70 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND nxt = 1 AND pn_gia_tb <> 1
							AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
							AND ma_vt IN 
							(SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
								AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%')
								AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%')
								AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%')
								AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
					GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho
					)

				UNION ALL(
					SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, 0, 0, SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), SUM(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), SUM(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x)
						FROM ct70 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo AND nxt = 2 AND px_gia_dd = 1
							AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
							AND ma_vt IN 
							(SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
								AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%')
								AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%')
								AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%')
								AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
					GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho
					)
			) a
		GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho
		ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_kho

	--DELETE wrkstkbg
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #wrkstkbg FROM wrkstkbg
	IF @nSiteType = 1
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #tb SET ma_kho = ''
			SELECT ma_vt, MAX(ma_kho) AS ma_kho, SUM(gia) AS gia, SUM(gia_nt) AS gia_nt, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt
				INTO #tbi
				FROM #tb
				GROUP BY ma_vt
				ORDER BY ma_vt
			INSERT INTO #wrkstkbg(ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt)
				SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt FROM #tbi
		END
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #wrkstkbg(ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt)
				SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt FROM #tb
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrrmkqktr]
AS
SELECT a.ma_hs, a.ma_vong, a.noi_dung, a.ngay_ktr, a.diem, a.ma_kq, a.tt_hs, a.ghi_chu,
		 b.ten_vong, b.ten_vong2, c.ten_kq, c.ten_kq2, d.ten_tt, d.ten_tt2
	FROM hrrmkqktr a WITH(NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN hrdmvongtd b ON a.ma_vong = b.ma_vong
		LEFT JOIN hrdmkq c ON a.ma_kq = c.ma_kq
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtths d ON a.tt_hs = d.ma_tt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostSOAuthorize] @Action TINYINT, @IDNumber CHAR(13), @UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c64$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = ''

	IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SET @MasterTable = 'm64$' + @Dyn
		SET @DetailTable = 'd64$' + @Dyn
		SET @InquiryTable = 'i64$' + @Dyn
	END
	
	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #master(loai_ct VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ma_tt VARCHAR(32), ma_kh VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(32))
	DECLARE @loai_ct VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_tt VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32), @status VARCHAR(32), @newStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select loai_ct, ngay_ct, ma_tt, ma_kh, status from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @loai_ct = loai_ct, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_tt = ma_tt, @ma_kh = ma_kh, @status = status FROM #master
	DROP TABLE #master
	
	SELECT @newStatus = CASE WHEN @Action = '1' THEN '2' ELSE '6' END
	
	IF @status = '3' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = ''' + @status + ''', status = ''' + @newStatus + ''''
		
		IF @newStatus = '6' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''6'''
		ELSE SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = '''', user_id3 = 0'
		
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @newStatus + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''' + @newStatus + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update r60$' + @Dyn + ' set status = ''' + @newStatus + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		IF @Action = '1' BEGIN
			-- After update
			IF @loai_ct <> '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID
			
			-- cddh13
			IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
				IF @ma_tt <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtt WHERE ma_tt = @ma_tt AND han_tt <> 0) INSERT INTO cddh13 SELECT @idNumber, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, '2'
			END
			
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, 'a64$000000', '4'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DELETE cddh13 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, 'a64$000000', '4'
		END

	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll001] -- hrptPayroll001, hrMailSalary
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Detail, 0 - No
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@MailType TINYINT = 0 --0 - Báo cáo lương, 1 - Mail: Only Browse Table, 2 - Mail: Báo cáo lương và Lưu kết quả
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @i INT, @iCount INT, @t VARCHAR(512)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(8), @Nguon CHAR(1), @Type CHAR(1), @Ds_bp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_loai_lg VARCHAR(256), @Ds_sp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_pc VARCHAR(256), @Ds_cong VARCHAR(256), @Ds_tp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_tn_gt VARCHAR(256), @Cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @keyCurrency NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @HRM054V NVARCHAR(512), @HRM054E NVARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @HRM054V = cname, @HRM054E = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM054'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt INTO #hrluongth FROM hrluongth$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_sp, so_luong, tien, tien_nt INTO #hrluongsp FROM hrluongsp$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien, tien_nt INTO #hrluongpc FROM hrluongpc$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt INTO #hrluongtc FROM hrluongtc$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, loai, ma_tngt, tien, tien_nt INTO #hrluongtngt FROM hrluongtngt$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay INTO #hrcongth FROM hrcongth$000000
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #hrluongth2 FROM hrluongth2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien, tien_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #hrluongpc2 FROM hrluongpc2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #hrluongtc2 FROM hrluongtc2$000000
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_nt
			, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_tu, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_den, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai2
		INTO #detail FROM hrpayroll001

	SELECT ma_so, kind, nguon, type, ds_bp, ds_loai_lg, ds_sp, ds_pc, ds_cong, ds_tp, ds_tn_gt, cach_tinh, ids, bold, in_ck, stt, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2
		INTO #hrpayroll001 FROM hrpayroll001 WITH(nolock) WHERE form = @Form
	CREATE INDEX ma_so ON #hrpayroll001(ma_so)

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#hrpayroll001', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'a.', 1
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	SELECT @Filter = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Filter)

	IF @Employee <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nv = @Employee
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@IDNumber) + ''''
	END

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @MailType = 2 SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'exists(select 1 from #hrsttrec t where t.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'

	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'

	-- Payroll Period
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, a.ngay_tu AS ky_ngay_tu, a.ngay_den AS ky_ngay_den, a.so_ngay, a.so_ngay as so_ngay_cl INTO #hrky FROM hrky a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	INSERT INTO #hrky(ma_bp, bp_ref, ky, nam, ky_ngay_tu, ky_ngay_den, so_ngay) EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$GetPeriod$Department @Period, @Year, @Period, @Year, '', @Filter, 'b', @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB

	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Current Working History
	SELECT @d1 = MIN(ky_ngay_tu), @d2 = MAX(ky_ngay_den) FROM #hrky
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan AS ma_bp, ngay_tu, ngay_den INTO #hreqtlvht0 FROM hreqtlvht
	--
	INSERT INTO #hreqtlvht0 EXEC hs_GetEmployeeWorkingHistory @d1, @d2, 'a.tinh_chat = ''1''', '', 1, '', '', 1

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_nghi, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS nh_nv3, CAST(0 AS INT) AS [user_id]
		INTO #hreqtlvht FROM #hreqtlvht0 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_den) AS ngay_den FROM #hreqtlvht0 GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_den = b.ngay_den
	UPDATE #hreqtlvht SET ngay_nghi = b.ngay_nghi, nh_nv1 = b.nh_nv1, nh_nv2 = b.nh_nv2, nh_nv3 = b.nh_nv3, [user_id] = b.[user_id] FROM #hreqtlvht a JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Employees
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt_rec select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp from #hreqtlvht a with(nolock) join #hrky c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp' + @Join + ' where (a.ngay_nghi is null or a.ngay_nghi >= c.ky_ngay_tu)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Data
	SELECT @s = 'insert into @table select @select from @primeTable with(nolock) where stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #stt_rec)'
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @s = @s + ' and ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongth'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongth$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '2') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongsp'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongsp$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_sp, so_luong, tien, tien_nt')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '3') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongpc'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongpc$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien, tien_nt')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '4') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongtc'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongtc$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon IN ('5', '6')) BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongtngt'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongtngt$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, loai, ma_tngt, tien, tien_nt')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '7') BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #hrcongthtemp(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), ma_cong VARCHAR(32), so_gio NUMERIC(28, 6), so_ngay NUMERIC(12, 5))

		DECLARE @d CHAR(6), @ky_max CHAR(6)
		SELECT @d = CONVERT(CHAR(6), MIN(ky_ngay_tu), 112), @ky_max = CONVERT(CHAR(6), MAX(ky_ngay_den), 112) FROM #hrky
		WHILE @d <= @ky_max BEGIN
			SELECT @t = 'hrcongth$' + @d
			IF OBJECT_ID(@t) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #hrcongthtemp select a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong, sum(a.so_gio), sum(a.so_ngay)'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @t + ' a with(nolock) join #hrky b on a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp'
				SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.ngay between b.ky_ngay_tu and b.ky_ngay_den and stt_rec in (select stt_rec from #stt_rec) group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_cong'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			--
			SELECT @d = CONVERT(CHAR(6), DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d + '01'), 112)
		END

		INSERT INTO #hrcongth SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong, SUM(so_gio), SUM(so_ngay) FROM #hrcongthtemp GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_cong
	END

	IF @ReportType = 1 BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '1' AND CHARINDEX(',', ds_loai_lg) = 0) BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongth2'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongth2$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '3' AND ds_pc <> '' AND CHARINDEX(',', ds_pc) = 0) BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongpc2'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongpc2$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien, tien_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE nguon = '4' AND ds_cong <> '' AND CHARINDEX(',', ds_cong) = 0) BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@table', '#hrluongtc2'), '@primeTable', 'hrluongtc2$%Partition'), '@select', 'stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, 0, @Period, @Year, NULL, @UserID, @Admin
		END
	END

	-- Delete
	IF @Currency <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec INTO #nv0 FROM #hrluongth
		INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongsp a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongpc a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongtc a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongtngt a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrcongth a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		IF @ReportType = 1 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongth2 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
			INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongpc2 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
			INSERT INTO #nv0 SELECT DISTINCT a.stt_rec FROM #hrluongtc2 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
		END
		DELETE #stt_rec FROM #stt_rec a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nv0 b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	END

	-- Alter
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec INTO #tmp FROM hrnv
	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'alter table #tmp add [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '] numeric(28, 6) default 0'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' alter table #tmp add [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '_nt] numeric(28, 6) default 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE ma_so > @ma_so
	END
	INSERT INTO #tmp(stt_rec) SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec FROM #stt_rec

	--
	SELECT @s = 'update #tmp set [@ma_so] = b.gt, [@ma_so_nt] = b.gt_nt from #tmp a join (select stt_rec, sum(@Source) as gt, sum(@Source_nt) as gt_nt from @table where @key group by stt_rec) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s2 = 'insert into #detail(stt_rec, ma_so, gt, gt_nt, ngay_tu, ngay_den) select stt_rec, ''@ma_so'', sum(@Source), sum(@Source_nt), ngay_tu, ngay_den from @table where @key group by stt_rec, ngay_tu, ngay_den'

	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE kind = '1'
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN

		SELECT @ds_loai_lg = ds_loai_lg, @Nguon = nguon, @Type = type, @Ds_bp = ds_bp, @Ds_sp = ds_sp, @Ds_pc = ds_pc, @Ds_cong = ds_cong, @Ds_tp = ds_tp, @Ds_tn_gt = ds_tn_gt
			FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE ma_so = @ma_so

		SET @Key = 'ma_loai_lg in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_loai_lg, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		IF @Ds_bp <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_bp in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_bp, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

		IF @Nguon = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'gt_nt'), '@Source', 'gt'), '@table', '#hrluongth'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @ReportType = 1 AND CHARINDEX(',', @Ds_loai_lg) = 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s2, '@Source_nt', 'gt_nt'), '@Source', 'gt'), '@table', '#hrluongth2'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		IF @Nguon = '2' BEGIN
			IF @Ds_sp <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_sp in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_sp, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongsp'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'so_luong'), '@Source', 'so_luong'), '@table', '#hrluongsp'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		IF @Nguon = '3' BEGIN
			IF @Ds_pc <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_pc in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_pc, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongpc'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @ReportType = 1 AND @Ds_pc <> '' AND CHARINDEX(',', @Ds_pc) = 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s2, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongpc2'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		IF @Nguon = '4' BEGIN
			IF @Ds_cong <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_cong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongtc'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			END ELSE
			IF @Type = '2' BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'so_ngay'), '@Source', 'so_ngay'), '@table', '#hrluongtc'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			END ELSE
			IF @Type = '3' BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'so_gio'), '@Source', 'so_gio'), '@table', '#hrluongtc'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			END
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @Type = '1' AND @ReportType = 1 AND @Ds_cong <> '' AND CHARINDEX(',', @Ds_cong) = 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s2, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongtc2'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		IF @Nguon = '5' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai = ''2'''
			IF @Ds_tp <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_tngt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tp, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongtngt'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		IF @Nguon = '6' BEGIN
			SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai = ''1'''
			IF @Ds_tn_gt <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_tngt in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_tn_gt, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'tien_nt'), '@Source', 'tien'), '@table', '#hrluongtngt'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		IF @Nguon = '7' BEGIN
			SET @Key = ''
			IF @Ds_bp <> '' SET @Key = 'ma_bp in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_bp, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			IF @Ds_cong <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'ma_cong in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Ds_cong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
			IF @Key = '' SELECT @Key = '1=1'
			IF @Type = '3'
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'so_gio'), '@Source', 'so_gio'), '@table', '#hrcongth'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			ELSE
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@Source_nt', 'so_ngay'), '@Source', 'so_ngay'), '@table', '#hrcongth'), '@key', @Key), '@ma_so', RTRIM(@Ma_so))
			IF @Key = '' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, ' where ', '')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE ma_so > @ma_so AND kind = '1'
	END

	-- Formula
	SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #index FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE kind = 2 AND cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	SELECT @iCount = COUNT(id), @i = 1 FROM #index
	WHILE @i <= @iCount BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_so = ma_so, @cach_tinh = cach_tinh FROM #index WHERE id = @i
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp SET [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '] = ' + RTRIM(@Cach_tinh)
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp SET [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '_nt] = ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Cach_tinh), ']', '_nt]')
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- Rotate
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS dien_giai2
		INTO #result FROM #hrpayroll001
	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #result (sysorder, stt_rec, ma_so, gt, gt_nt) select 0, stt_rec, ''' + @ma_so + ''', [' + @ma_so + '], [' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + '_nt] from #tmp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE ma_so > @ma_so
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT TOP 1 @ma_so = ma_so FROM #hrpayroll001 WHERE in_ck = 1 ORDER BY stt, ma_so
	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ma_nv, c.stt_ref, b.stt, a.bo_phan AS ma_bp, b.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ho_ten
			, ISNULL(c.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(c.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2, ISNULL(d.ten_vtr, '') AS ten_vtr, ISNULL(d.ten_vtr2, '') AS ten_vtr2
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.email_cty, '') <> '' THEN email_cty ELSE ISNULL(b.email_ca_nhan, '') END AS email
			, CASE WHEN b.d_language = '' THEN 'V' ELSE b.d_language END AS d_language
		INTO #t FROM #stt_rec a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt d ON b.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #t(stt_rec)

	-- View (browse)
	IF @MailType = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten, ma_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_bp ELSE ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vtr ELSE ten_vtr2 END AS ten_vtr
			FROM #t ORDER BY stt_ref, stt, ma_nv
	END ELSE IF @MailType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @statusScheduled NVARCHAR(511), @statusPending NVARCHAR(511), @statusCompleted NVARCHAR(511)
		SELECT @statusScheduled = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'hrm066'
		SELECT @statusPending = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'hrm067'
		SELECT @statusCompleted = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'hrm068'

		SELECT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten, a.ma_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.ten_bp ELSE a.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp,
				CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.ten_vtr ELSE a.ten_vtr2 END AS ten_vtr, a.email,
				CASE ISNULL(c.status, '0') WHEN '0' THEN '' WHEN '1' THEN @statusScheduled WHEN '2' THEN @statusPending WHEN '3' THEN @statusCompleted ELSE '' END AS status_name
			FROM #t a LEFT JOIN hrmailbcbl c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND c.ky = @Period AND c.nam = @Year
			WHERE a.email <> '' ORDER BY a.stt_ref, a.stt, a.ma_nv

		RETURN
	END IF @MailType = 2 BEGIN
		DELETE hrmailbcbl FROM hrmailbcbl a JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ky = @Period AND a.nam = @Year
		DELETE hrmailbcblct FROM hrmailbcblct a JOIN #t b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.ky = @Period AND a.nam = @Year

		INSERT INTO hrmailbcbl(ky, nam, stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten, ma_bp, ten_bp, ten_vtr, email, d_language, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT @Period, @Year, stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_ten, ma_bp, CASE WHEN d_language = 'v' THEN ten_bp ELSE ten_bp2 END, CASE WHEN d_language = 'v' THEN ten_vtr ELSE ten_vtr2 END, email, d_language, 1, getdate(), getdate(), @UserID, @UserID
				FROM #t ORDER BY stt_ref, stt, ma_nv
	END


	IF @ReportType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_so, MIN(a.ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu, MAX(a.ngay_den) AS ngay_den, CAST(1 AS TINYINT) AS xtype, LEN(MAX(b.chi_tieu)) - LEN(LTRIM(MAX(b.chi_tieu))) AS xspace, LEN(MAX(b.chi_tieu2)) - LEN(LTRIM(MAX(b.chi_tieu2))) AS xspace2 INTO #detail2
			FROM #detail a JOIN #hrpayroll001 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_so
		--
		UPDATE #detail2 SET xtype = 2 WHERE YEAR(ngay_tu) * 12 + MONTH(ngay_tu) <> YEAR(ngay_den) * 12 + MONTH(ngay_den)
		UPDATE #detail2 SET xtype = 3 WHERE YEAR(ngay_tu) <> YEAR(ngay_den)
		--
		UPDATE #detail SET dien_giai = SPACE(xspace + 5) + CASE b.xtype
					WHEN 1 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054V, '%d1', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_tu))), '%d2', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_den)))
					WHEN 2 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054V, '%d1', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_tu)) + '/' + RTRIM(MONTH(a.ngay_tu))), '%d2', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_den)) + '/' + RTRIM(MONTH(a.ngay_den)))
					ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054V, '%d1', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_tu, 103)), '%d2', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_den, 103)) END,
				dien_giai2 = SPACE(xspace2 + 5) + CASE b.xtype
					WHEN 1 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054E, '%d1', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_tu))), '%d2', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_den)))
					WHEN 2 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054E, '%d1', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_tu)) + '/' + RTRIM(MONTH(a.ngay_tu))), '%d2', RTRIM(DAY(a.ngay_den)) + '/' + RTRIM(MONTH(a.ngay_den)))
					ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@HRM054E, '%d1', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_tu, 103)), '%d2', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.ngay_den, 103)) END
			FROM #detail a JOIN #detail2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so

		INSERT INTO #result SELECT 1, stt_rec, ma_so, gt, gt_nt, dien_giai, dien_giai2 FROM #detail
	END

	-- View (report)
	CREATE INDEX ma_so ON #result(ma_so)
	SElECT a.sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, a.stt_rec, e.d_language, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_rec0
			, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 0 THEN b.chi_tieu ELSE a.dien_giai END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 0 THEN b.chi_tieu2 ELSE a.dien_giai2 END AS chi_tieu2
			, a.gt, a.gt_nt, b.bold, b.in_ck, d.ma_nv, d.ho_ten
			, CASE WHEN @MailType <> 2 THEN
					CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_bp ELSE d.ten_bp2 END
				ELSE
					CASE WHEN d.d_language = 'V' THEN d.ten_bp ELSE d.ten_bp2 END
				END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN @MailType <> 2 THEN
					CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_vtr ELSE d.ten_vtr2 END
				ELSE
					CASE WHEN d.d_language = 'V' THEN d.ten_vtr ELSE d.ten_vtr2 END
				END AS ten_vtr
			, 0 AS sysorderX, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS chi_tieuX, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS chi_tieuX2, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gtX, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_ntX, 0 AS boldX, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx2
		INTO #result2
		FROM #result a JOIN #hrpayroll001 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so LEFT JOIN #t c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #t d ON a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec AND a.ma_so = @ma_so
			JOIN #t e ON a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec
		WHERE b.in_ck = 1
		ORDER BY c.stt_ref, c.stt, c.ma_nv, b.stt, a.ma_so, a.sysorder
/*
	-- 2 columns
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #result2 GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #result2 SET stt_sx = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #result2 a JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	DECLARE @c NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @c = MAX(stt_sx) FROM #result2
	SELECT @c = CEILING(@c / 2)

	UPDATE #result2 SET sysorderX = b.sysorder, chi_tieuX = b.chi_tieu, chi_tieuX2 = b.chi_tieu2, gtX = b.gt, gt_ntX = b.gt_nt, boldX = b.bold, sysprint = 1
		FROM #result2 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt_sx - @c AS stt_sx, sysorder, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, gt, gt_nt, bold FROM #result2 WHERE stt_sx > @c) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_sx = b.stt_sx
		WHERE a.stt_sx <= @c
*/
	-- 2 columns
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #result2 GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #result2 SET stt_sx = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #result2 a JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	SELECT stt_rec, CAST(MAX(stt_sx) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS stt_sx INTO #g2 FROM #result2 GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #result2 SET stt_sx2 = CEILING(b.stt_sx / 2) FROM #result2 a JOIN #g2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	--
	UPDATE #result2 SET sysorderX = b.sysorder, chi_tieuX = b.chi_tieu, chi_tieuX2 = b.chi_tieu2, gtX = b.gt, gt_ntX = b.gt_nt, boldX = b.bold
		FROM #result2 a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, stt_sx - stt_sx2 AS stt_sx, sysorder, chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, gt, gt_nt, bold FROM #result2 WHERE stt_sx > stt_sx2) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_sx = b.stt_sx
		WHERE a.stt_sx <= stt_sx2
	UPDATE #result2 SET sysprint = 1 WHERE stt_sx <= stt_sx2

	-- View (report)
	IF @MailType = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT sysorder, 1 AS systotal, sysprint, stt_rec, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, gt, gt_nt, bold, in_ck,
				ma_nv, ho_ten, ten_bp, ten_vtr, sysorderX, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieuX ELSE chi_tieuX2 END AS chi_tieuX, gtX, gt_ntX, boldX
			FROM #result2 ORDER BY id
	END IF @MailType = 2 BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, CASE WHEN d_language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, gt, gt_nt, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
			INTO #mailct FROM #result2 WHERE chi_tieu <> '' AND ((@ReportType = 0 AND in_ck = 1) OR (@ReportType = 1 AND sysprint = 1)) ORDER BY id
		IF @ReportType = 1
			INSERT INTO #mailct(stt_rec, chi_tieu, gt, gt_nt) SELECT stt_rec, CASE WHEN d_language = 'V' THEN chi_tieuX ELSE chi_tieuX2 END AS chi_tieuX, gtX, gt_ntX
				FROM #result2 WHERE chi_tieuX <> '' AND sysprint = 1 ORDER BY id

		INSERT INTO hrmailbcblct(ky, nam, stt_rec, id, chi_tieu, gt, gt_nt) SELECT @Period, @Year, stt_rec, id, chi_tieu, gt, gt_nt FROM #mailct

	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Print23Tran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(10) 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.tk_no, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt2, a.gia, a.tien2, a.dien_giai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, '''+@cVoucher+''', ''tk_no, dvt, dien_giai'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

		FROM dbo.ctgs a  
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$TSIssue]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong INTO #afterUpdate FROM hrccctcp

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	-- Update Quantity
	DECLARE @cTSRequisitionIDNumber CHAR(13), @cTSRequisitionLineNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cTSRequisitionIDNumber, @cTSRequisitionLineNumber, @nQty
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cTSRequisitionIDNumber <> '' AND @nQty <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update hrccctyccp set sl_yc = sl_yc + @nQty where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionLineNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cTSRequisitionIDNumber, @cTSRequisitionLineNumber, @nQty
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cTSRequisitionIDNumber, @cTSRequisitionLineNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cTSRequisitionIDNumber <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'if exists (select 1 from hrccctyccp where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and sl_yc > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update hriccyccp set status = ''4'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists (select 1 from hrccctyccp where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and sl_yc < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update hriccyccp set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'else'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update hriccyccp set status = ''4'' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' and status = ''5'''

			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'declare @TSRequisitionStatus char(1) select @TSRequisitionStatus = status from hriccyccp where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update hrccyccp set status = @TSRequisitionStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cTSRequisitionIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cTSRequisitionIDNumber, @cTSRequisitionLineNumber
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcthspb] 
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_vt AS ten_sp, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2, c.ten_yt, c.ten_yt2
		FROM xcthspb a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN xdmyt c ON a.ma_yt = c.ma_yt
		WHERE 1 = 0
