CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesCalcByPeriod]
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UnitKey VARCHAR(2000),
	@sp_id INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @pStartYear INT, @yStartYear INT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(33), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @Kind CHAR(1), @No_co CHAR(1), @Dau_cuoi CHAR(1), @Cong_tru CHAR(1), @Khong_am CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Tk VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_du VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_0_gt VARCHAR(1023), @Cong_no CHAR(1), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT TOP 1 @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
		, @pStartYear = MONTH(ngay_ky1), @yStartYear = YEAR(ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, a.tk, ps_no AS no_dk, ps_no_nt AS no_dk_nt, ps_co AS co_dk, ps_co_nt AS co_dk_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt
			, ps_no AS no_ck, ps_no_nt AS no_ck_nt, ps_co AS co_ck, ps_co_nt AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #tTrBal FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	INSERT INTO #tTrBal EXEC rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesTrialUnit @dFrom, @dTo, 1, @Unit, '', 0, 99, 0, '', @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	--Arising
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SET @q = 'insert into #gl select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs'
 	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) ma_dvcs, ma_so, kind, no_co, dau_cuoi, khong_am, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt, cong_no, cach_tinh, cong_tru, ids, tien, tien_nt INTO #gltcptct0 FROM gltcptct0
	SET @q = 'insert into #gltcptct0 select b.ma_dvcs AS ma_dvcs, a.ma_so, a.kind, a.no_co, a.dau_cuoi, a.khong_am, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.tk_0_gt, a.cong_no, a.cach_tinh, cong_tru, ids, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from gltcptct0 a, (select ma_dvcs from dmdvcs' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' where ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ') b'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#gltcptct0', @UserID, @Admin

	CREATE INDEX ma_so ON #gltcptct0(ma_so)
	CREATE INDEX ma_dvcs ON #gltcptct0(ma_dvcs)

	IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear BEGIN
		SELECT * INTO #gltcptct1 FROM #gltcptct0 WHERE kind = '1'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt INTO #tmpRes1 FROM #gltcptct1
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt INTO #tmpRes FROM #gltcptct0
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT ma_so, kind, no_co, dau_cuoi, khong_am, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt, cong_no FROM #gltcptct0 WHERE kind IN ('1', '2') AND tk <> '#' AND tk_du <> '#'
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @Kind, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmpRes

		-- Phát sinh
		IF @kind = '2' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmpRes SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END AS ps, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END AS ps_nt
						FROM #gl WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END
						FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END
						FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt) = 0
					) a GROUP BY ma_dvcs
		END

		-- Công nợ
		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = '1' AND @dau_cuoi = '1' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmpRes SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk ELSE co_dk END), SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt END)
				FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 GROUP BY ma_dvcs
		END
		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = '1' AND @dau_cuoi = '2' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmpRes SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck ELSE co_ck END), SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck_nt ELSE co_ck_nt END)
				FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #tmpRes1 SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk ELSE co_dk END), SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt END)
				FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			END
		END
		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = '0' AND @dau_cuoi = '1' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmpRes SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt)
			FROM (
				SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk - co_dk ELSE co_dk - no_dk END) AS tien, 0 AS tien_nt
					FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk - co_dk ELSE co_dk - no_dk END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
				UNION ALL
				SELECT ma_dvcs, 0 AS tien, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt - no_dk_nt END) AS tien_nt
					FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt - no_dk_nt END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			) a GROUP BY ma_dvcs
		END
		IF @kind = '1' AND @Cong_no = '0' AND @dau_cuoi = '2' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmpRes SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt)
			FROM (
				SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck - co_ck ELSE co_ck - no_ck END) AS tien, 0 AS tien_nt
					FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck - co_ck ELSE co_ck - no_ck END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
				UNION ALL
				SELECT ma_dvcs, 0 AS tien, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck_nt - co_ck_nt ELSE co_ck_nt - no_ck_nt END) AS tien_nt
					FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_ck_nt - co_ck_nt ELSE co_ck_nt - no_ck_nt END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			) a GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #tmpRes1 SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk - co_dk ELSE co_dk - no_dk END) AS tien, 0 AS tien_nt
						FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk - co_dk ELSE co_dk - no_dk END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ma_dvcs, 0 AS tien, SUM(CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt - no_dk_nt END) AS tien_nt
						FROM #tTrBal WHERE dbo.ff_ExactInlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 AND (@Khong_am = '0' OR CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN no_dk_nt - co_dk_nt ELSE co_dk_nt - no_dk_nt END > 0) GROUP BY ma_dvcs
				) a GROUP BY ma_dvcs
			END
		END

		UPDATE #gltcptct0 SET tien = a.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt FROM #tmpRes a WHERE ma_so = @ma_so AND #gltcptct0.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs
		IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear UPDATE #gltcptct1 SET tien = a.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt FROM #tmpRes1 a WHERE ma_so = @ma_so AND #gltcptct1.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @Kind, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt, @Cong_no
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	DECLARE @i INT, @xTk_no VARCHAR(8000), @xTk_co VARCHAR(8000), @xTk VARCHAR(8000)
	SELECT tk INTO #acct FROM wrkgl WHERE 1 = 0
	CREATE TABLE #acctlist (tk_du VARCHAR(8000) NULL)
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl00 FROM #gl
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT ma_so, no_co, tk, tk_du, tk_0_gt FROM #gltcptct0 WHERE kind IN ('2') AND (tk = '#' OR tk_du = '#')
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @No_co, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		-- Set variables to 0
		SELECT @xTk_no = '', @xTk_co = '', @xTk = ''
		--
		SET @xTk_no = CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN @Tk ELSE @Tk_du END
		SET @xTk_co = CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN @Tk_du ELSE @Tk END

		DELETE #acct
		DELETE #gl00

		IF @xTk_no = '#' BEGIN
			SET @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@xTk_co) BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@xTk_co, @i)
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #gl00 SELECT * FROM #gl WHERE ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@xTk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @xTk_co) = 1)

			DELETE #acctlist
			INSERT INTO #acctlist SELECT b.tk_du
				FROM #acct a JOIN #gltcptct0 b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk) = 1
				WHERE b.ma_so <> @ma_so AND b.kind = '2' AND b.no_co = '2' AND b.tk <> '' AND b.tk_du <> '' AND b.tk <> '#' AND b.tk_du <> '#'

			DELETE #gl00 FROM #gl00 a JOIN #acctlist b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk_du, b.tk_du) = 1

			DELETE #gl00 WHERE (@xTk_co <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @xTk_co) = 1)
			SELECT @xTk = ISNULL(@xTk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl00) a ORDER BY tk_du
			IF @xTk <> '' SET @xTk = SUBSTRING(@xTk, 2, LEN(@xTk))
		END

		IF @xTk_co = '#' BEGIN
			SET @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@xTk_no) BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@xTk_no, @i)
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #gl00 SELECT * FROM #gl WHERE ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0 AND (@xTk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @xTk_no) = 1)

			DELETE #acctlist
			INSERT INTO #acctlist SELECT b.tk_du
				FROM #acct a JOIN #gltcptct0 b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk) = 1
					WHERE b.ma_so <> @ma_so AND b.kind = '2' AND b.no_co = '1' AND b.tk <> '' AND b.tk_du <> '' AND b.tk <> '#' AND b.tk_du <> '#'
			DELETE #gl00 FROM #gl00 a JOIN #acctlist b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk_du) = 1

			DELETE #gl00 WHERE (@xTk_no <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @xTk_no) = 1)

			SELECT @xTk = ISNULL(@xTk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl00) a ORDER BY tk_du
			IF @xTk <> '' SET @xTk = SUBSTRING(@xTk, 2, LEN(@xTk))
		END

		IF @Tk = '#' SET @Tk = @xTk ELSE SET @Tk_du = @xTk

		TRUNCATE TABLE #tmpRes
		INSERT INTO #tmpRes	SELECT ma_dvcs, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
			FROM (
				SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END AS ps, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END AS ps_nt
					FROM #gl00
				UNION ALL
				SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END
					FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1
				UNION ALL
				SELECT ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co ELSE - ps_no END, CASE WHEN @no_co = 1 THEN - ps_co_nt ELSE - ps_no_nt END
					FROM #gl WHERE @Tk_0_gt <> '' AND @Tk_du = '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt) = 0
				) a GROUP BY ma_dvcs

		UPDATE #gltcptct0 SET tien = a.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt FROM #tmpRes a WHERE ma_so = @ma_so AND #gltcptct0.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_so, @No_co, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Tk_0_gt
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- Manual Data
	SET @q = 'update #gltcptct0 set tien = b.tien, tien_nt = b.tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #gltcptct0 a join gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0')
	SET @q = @q + ' b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.kind = ''9'' and b.dang_bc = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #gltcptct0 SET tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = '1') THEN 0 ELSE tien END
		, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END
	UPDATE #gltcptct0 SET tien = -tien, tien_nt = -tien_nt WHERE cong_tru = '2'

	IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear BEGIN
		UPDATE #gltcptct1 SET tien = CASE WHEN tien IS NULL OR (tien < 0 AND khong_am = '1') THEN 0 ELSE tien END
		, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt IS NULL OR (tien_nt < 0 AND khong_am = 1) THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END
		UPDATE #gltcptct1 SET tien = -tien, tien_nt = -tien_nt WHERE cong_tru = '2'
	END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_dvcs, Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #gltcptct0 WHERE kind = '0' AND ISNULL(cach_tinh, '') <> ''  ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_dvcs, @ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @ma_so = REPLACE(@ma_so, '''', '''''')
			SET @q = 'update #gltcptct0 set tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select top 1 tien from #gltcptct0 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''' and ma_dvcs = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_dvcs) + ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + ''' and ma_dvcs = ''' + RTRIM(@ma_dvcs) + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			--SET @q = 'update #gltcptct0 set tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select top 1 tien_nt from #gltcptct0 where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ''' + @ma_so + ''' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @ma_dvcs + ''''
			--EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #gltcptct0 SET tien = CASE WHEN tien < 0 THEN 0 ELSE tien END, tien_nt = CASE WHEN tien_nt < 0 THEN 0 ELSE tien_nt END WHERE khong_am = '1' AND ma_so = @Ma_so AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs

			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @ma_dvcs, @ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	--INSERT INTO gltcptct9(sp_id, ky, nam, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, ma_so, tien, tien_nt)
	--	SELECT @sp_id, @Period, @Year, 1, ma_dvcs, ma_so, tien, tien_nt FROM #gltcptct0
	--Lưu vào bảng kỳ
	SET @q = 'delete gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0') + ' where dang_bc = 1' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@Period, 2), ' ', '0')
	SET @q = @q + '(ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ma_so, 1, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt from #gltcptct0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Period = @pStartYear AND @Year = @yStartYear BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete gltcptct$ where dang_bc = 1' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into gltcptct$(ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt) select ma_so, 1, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt from #gltcptct1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostSTConfirmation]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@LineIDNumber CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', ''), @LineIDNumber = REPLACE(@LineIDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c67$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @DetailTable = ''
	
	IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SET @DetailTable = 'd67$' + @Dyn		
	END

	IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1')
			SET @q = '
update ' + @DetailTable + '
		set giao_yn = 1
	from ' + @DetailTable + ' a 
	where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and a.stt_rec0 = ''' + @LineIDNumber + '''
		and exists(select 1 from ' + REPLACE(@DetailTable, 'd67$', 'm67$') + ' b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and b.status <> ''*'')
'
		ELSE
			SET @q = 'update ' + @DetailTable + ' set giao_yn = 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec0 = ''' + @LineIDNumber + ''''

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateAvgPrice2GL]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(33),
	@item VARCHAR(33),
	@group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@itemType CHAR(2), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(64) , 
	@priceFCType TINYINT, 
	@userID INT, 
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = '', 
	@itemTable VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@siteTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@sysDB VARCHAR(128) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @nxt TINYINT, @vcList VARCHAR(256), 
		@dynTable VARCHAR(64), @d SMALLDATETIME, @udfString VARCHAR(1024), @udfStruct VARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	IF @itemTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #xItem FROM dmvt
		SELECT @key = ' gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
		IF @item <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @itemType <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xItem select ma_vt from dmvt where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @itemTable = '#xItem'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xItem(ma_vt)
	END
	
	IF @site = '' AND @siteGroup = '' SELECT @siteTable = 'dmkho'
	ELSE IF @siteTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho INTO #xSite FROM dmkho
		SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @site <> '' THEN 'ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%''' ELSE '' END
		IF @siteGroup <> '' SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@siteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xSite select ma_kho from dmkho where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @siteTable = '#xSite'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xSite(ma_kho)

	END

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk_vt AS tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt
		INTO #tintmp0
		FROM wrkin


/*
	UDF
*/
	-- Struct
	SELECT @udfString = ''
	SELECT @udfString = @udfString + CASE WHEN @udfString = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + value FROM sysudf WHERE status = '1' AND type = 'C' AND value NOT IN ('ma_td1', 'ma_td2', 'ma_td3')
	SELECT @udfStruct = 'select top 0 ' + @udfString + ' from wrkin'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#tintmp0', @udfStruct

	-- #groupby (voucherinfo)
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS groupby INTO #groupby FROM wrkgl
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #groupby select a.ma_ct, replace(groupby, '' '', '''') as groupby from ' + REPLACE(@sysDB, '''', '''''') + '..voucherinfo a join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct where b.ct_nxt > 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #groupby SET groupby = (SELECT groupby FROM #groupby WHERE ma_ct = 'PNG') WHERE ma_ct = 'PXG'

	-- #dmct
	SELECT ma_ct, ct_nxt, post_vv, post_sp, post_bp, post_hd, post_ku, post_phi, post_lsx, post_td1, post_td2, post_td3 INTO #dmct FROM dmct WHERE ct_nxt > 0
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#dmct', @udfStruct
	CREATE TABLE #udfField (id INT, data VARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #udfField SELECT id, RTRIM(LTRIM(data)) AS data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@udfString, ',')
	SELECT @q = ''
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + 'update #dmct set ' + data + ' = case when charindex('','' + ''' + data + ''' + '','', '','' + groupby + '','') > 0 then 1 else 0 end from #dmct a join #groupby b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct' FROM #udfField ORDER BY id
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- UDF Field
	SELECT @udfString = ', ' + @udfString
/*
	END UDF
*/

	--
	CREATE TABLE #stt_rec (stt_rec CHAR(13))
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt_rec select distinct a.stt_rec from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) join ' + @itemTable + ' b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @siteTable <> 'dmkho' SELECT @q = @q + ' join ' + @siteTable + ' c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.ma_ct <> ''' + REPLACE(@vcDeffCode, '''', '') + ''' and ((a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1) or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd = 0))]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, 0
	
	CREATE INDEX i ON #stt_rec(stt_rec)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tintmp0 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.nxt, a.tk_vt, ' + 
		 'case when a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @vcIBCodes) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@vcIBCodes, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + REPLACE(@vcIBCodes, '''', '') + '''' END + ' then a.tk_gv else a.tk_du end, ' + 
		'a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x' + @udfString + 
		' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[exists(select 1 from #stt_rec b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)]%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, 0

	
	-- Update
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #tintmp0 SET ma_phi = CASE WHEN a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END, ma_bp = CASE WHEN a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END FROM #tintmp0 a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	-- Update blank
	CREATE TABLE #split (id INT, data VARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #split SELECT id, RTRIM(LTRIM(data)) AS data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@udfString, ',') WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(data)) <> ''
	SELECT @q = ''
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ' + data + ' = case when b.' + data + ' = 0 then '''' else a.' + data + ' end' FROM #split
	SELECT @q = 'update #tintmp0 set ma_sp = case when b.post_sp = 0 then '''' else a.ma_sp end, 
ma_bp = case when b.post_bp = 0 then '''' else a.ma_bp end,
ma_hd = case when b.post_hd = 0 then '''' else a.ma_hd end,
ma_ku = case when b.post_ku = 0 then '''' else a.ma_ku end,
ma_phi = case when b.post_phi = 0 then '''' else a.ma_phi end,
so_lsx = case when b.post_lsx = 0 then '''' else a.so_lsx end,
ma_td1 = case when b.post_td1 = 0 then '''' else a.ma_td1 end,
ma_td2 = case when b.post_td2 = 0 then '''' else a.ma_td2 end,
ma_td3 = case when b.post_td3 = 0 then '''' else a.ma_td3 end' + @q +
' from #tintmp0 a join #dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Group data
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, tien, tien_nt INTO #tintmp FROM #tintmp0
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#tintmp', @udfStruct

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tintmp(stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, tien, tien_nt' + @udfString +
		') select stt_rec, ma_ct, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt)' + @udfString +
		'  from #tintmp0 group by ma_ct, stt_rec, nxt, tk, tk_du, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3' + @udfString
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE INDEX i ON #tintmp(stt_rec, tk, tk_du)

	-- Update *00
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct INTO #dsct FROM #tintmp

	CREATE TABLE #v (ma_ct CHAR(3))
	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @nxt = ct_nxt FROM #dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct

		--
		TRUNCATE TABLE #v
		SELECT @q = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + ' and a.' + data + ' = b.' + data FROM #udfField ORDER BY id
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #v select ma_ct from #dmct a where exists(select 1 from #dmct b where b.ma_ct = ''' + @ma_ct + ''' and a.ct_nxt = b.ct_nxt and a.post_vv = b.post_vv and a.post_sp = b.post_sp and a.post_bp = b.post_bp
and a.post_hd = b.post_hd and a.post_ku = b.post_ku and a.post_phi = b.post_phi and a.post_lsx = b.post_lsx
and a.post_td1 = b.post_td1 and a.post_td2 = b.post_td2 and a.post_td3 = b.post_td3' + @q + ') and exists(select 1 from #dsct c where a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @vcList = NULL
		SELECT @vcList = ISNULL(@vcList, '') + CASE WHEN @vcList IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ',' END + ma_ct FROM #v
		DELETE #dsct WHERE CHARINDEX(ma_ct, @vcList) > 0
		SELECT @vcList = ' where a.ma_ct' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(',', @vcList) > 0 THEN ' in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@vcList, '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE ' = ''' + @vcList + '''' END

		SELECT @key = '', @udfString = ''
		SELECT @udfString = groupby FROM #groupby WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
		IF ISNULL(@udfString, '') <> '' BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #split
			INSERT INTO #split SELECT id, RTRIM(LTRIM(data)) AS data FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@udfString, ',')
			SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.' + data + ' = b.' + data FROM #split
		END

		IF @nxt = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update ct00 set ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.tk_du = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 0'

			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ct00 set ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk_du = b.tk and a.tk = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 1'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update ct00 set ps_co = tien, ps_co_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_no = 0, ps_no_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.tk_du = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 0'

			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ct00 set ps_no = tien, ps_no_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then 0 else tien_nt end, ps_co = 0, ps_co_nt = 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from ct00 a join #tintmp b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk_du = b.tk and a.tk = b.tk_du' + @key + @vcList + ' and (cast(a.line_nbr as int) % 2) = 1'
		END

		-- r00
		SELECT @r = @q, @d = @dFrom
		WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @dynTable = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112)
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, 'ct00', @dynTable)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			
			SET @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
		END
					
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dsct WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIPurchaseInvoiceList] --rs_rptPurchaseInvoiceList--
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1), -- 1: nhap, 2: xuat
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Physics, 3: Physics - UOM
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @queryStatement NVARCHAR(4000), @returnStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
	CREATE TABLE #rpt(name VARCHAR(64), ref VARCHAR(4000), value NVARCHAR(4000))

	-- Query
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryField', '', 'a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, a.ma_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.nh_vt2, b.nh_vt3, b.loai_vt, a.ma_nt'
		+ CASE
			WHEN @Form = '1'
				THEN CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', a.sl_nhap' ELSE ', a.sl_nhap1' END + ' as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'
				ELSE CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', a.sl_xuat' ELSE ', a.sl_xuat1' END + ' as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
			END
		+ CASE
			WHEN @DataType = '1'
				THEN ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, cast(null as nvarchar(32)) as dvt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0'
				ELSE ', a.gia1 as gia, a.gia_nt1 as gia_nt, a.dvt1 as dvt, a.gia01 as gia0, a.gia_nt01 as gia_nt0'
			END
		+ ', a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kho, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryJoin', '', 'left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'OrderDetail', '', @Order

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Customer', @Customer
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Item', @Item
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Job', @Job
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Contract', @Contract
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Department', @Department
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Transaction', @TransactionCode
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup1', @ItemGroup1
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup2', @ItemGroup2
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup3', @ItemGroup3

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'TransactionKey', @VoucherCode, @TransactionList
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', '(a.nxt = ''' + RTRIM(@Form) + ''')'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnField', '', 'sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt_rec as rp_group, b.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, c.ten_kh, c.ten_kh2, isnull(a.dvt, d.dvt) as dvt, d.ten_vt, d.ten_vt2'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnJoin', '', 'left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join dmvt d on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt'

	-- Result
	EXEC bs_rptGetReportData 'r90$%Partition', 1, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @InvoiceFrom, @InvoiceTo, @Unit, @Site, @PurOrgCode, @PurGrCode, @PlantCode, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB
		, default, default, default, 1, default, 1, default, 1, @queryStatement, @returnStatement, default, @TableName, @DataType

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmscsl]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.comment AS user_name0
			, CASE a.status WHEN '0' THEN N'' WHEN '1' THEN N'Đặt lịch' WHEN '2' THEN N'Lỗi' WHEN '3' THEN N'Hoàn thành' WHEN '4' THEN N'Đang thực hiện' END AS status_name
			, CASE a.status WHEN '0' THEN N'' WHEN '1' THEN N'Schedule' WHEN '2' THEN N'Error' WHEN '3' THEN N'Completed' WHEN '4' THEN N'Processing' END AS status_name2
		FROM dmscsl a
			LEFT JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id0 = b.id

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[xs20_COCalcEdWipProduct]
	@Period TINYINT, 
	@Year INT, 
	@Dept VARCHAR(33), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @PrevPeriod TINYINT, @PrevYear INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k1 NVARCHAR(4000), @k2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @costUnit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ky, nam INTO #PrevPeriod FROM xcdytdd

	-- Key
	SELECT @k2 = ''
	IF @Dept <> '' SET @k2 = @k2 + CASE WHEN @k2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @costUnit = '1' BEGIN
		IF @Unit = '' SET @Unit = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@UserID)
		IF @Unit = '' RETURN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')		
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k2 = @k2 + CASE WHEN @k2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

		SELECT @q = dbo.xf_GetUnitPrevPeriod(@UnitKey, @Period, @Year, 'xcdloaiytdd', '#PrevPeriod', 0)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = dbo.xf_GetUnitPrevPeriod(@UnitKey, @Period, @Year, 'xcdloaiytdd', '#PrevPeriod', 1)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		CREATE INDEX i ON #PrevPeriod(ma_dvcs, ky, nam)
	END ELSE SELECT @PrevPeriod = dbo.xf20_GetPrevPeriod(@Period, @Year, 'Month'), @PrevYear = dbo.xf20_GetPrevPeriod(@Period, @Year, 'Year')
	
	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @k2 = @k2 + CASE WHEN @k2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	END
	SET @k2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k2)
	SET @k1 = 'a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year) + CASE WHEN @k2 <> '' THEN ' and ' + @k2 ELSE '' END

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_dd_dk, sl_sx, sl_sx AS sl_nhap, sl_dd_ck
		INTO #xcdloaiytdd0 FROM xcdloaiytdd

	-- Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #xcdloaiytdd0 select ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sum(sl_dd_dk) as sl_dd_dk, sum(sl_sx) as sl_sx, sum(sl_nhap) as sl_nhap, sum(sl_dd_ck) AS sl_dd_ck'
	SET @q = @q + ' from('
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_dd_ck as sl_dd_dk,'
	SET @q = @q + ' cast(0 as NUMERIC(28, 6)) as sl_sx, cast(0 as NUMERIC(28, 6)) as sl_nhap, cast(0 as NUMERIC(28, 6)) as sl_dd_ck'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdloaiytdd a with(nolock) '
	IF @costUnit = '1' SET @q = @q + ' where exists (select 1 from #PrevPeriod b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ky = b.ky and a.nam = b.nam)'
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + LTRIM(@PrevYear) + ' and a.ky = ' + LTRIM(@PrevPeriod)
	
	IF @k2 <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @k2
	SET @q = @q + ' union all'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, a.loai_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_dd_ck'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdloaiytdd a with(nolock) left join xcdspdd b with(nolock) on a.nam = b.nam and a.ky = b.ky and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @k1
	SET @q = @q + ' union all'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_dvcs, b.ma_loai, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, 0, 0, a.sl_tp, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdspdd a with(nolock) cross join xdmloaiyt b with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @k1
	SET @q = @q + ' ) a'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q	

	-- Adj
	SET @q = 'update #xcdloaiytdd0 set sl_dd_dk = c.sl_dd_dk'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #xcdloaiytdd0 b join (select ma_dvcs, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, loai_yt, sl_dd_dk from xcdloaiytdd0 a with(nolock) where ' + @k1 + ') c'
	SET @q = @q + ' on b.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs and b.ma_sp = c.ma_sp and b.ma_bp = c.ma_bp and b.so_lsx = c.so_lsx and b.loai_yt = c.loai_yt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #xcdloaiytdd0 select ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, sl_dd_dk, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xcdloaiytdd0 a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @k1
	SET @q = @q + ' and not exists(select 1 from #xcdloaiytdd0 b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx and a.loai_yt = b.loai_yt)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- End

	DELETE #xcdloaiytdd0 WHERE sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_dd_dk = 0 AND sl_dd_ck = 0

	SELECT ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, SUM(sl_dd_dk) AS sl_dd_dk, SUM(sl_sx) AS sl_sx, SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(sl_dd_ck) AS sl_dd_ck
		INTO #xcdloaiytdd FROM #xcdloaiytdd0
		GROUP BY ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx

	UPDATE #xcdloaiytdd SET sl_sx = sl_nhap + sl_dd_ck - sl_dd_dk

	UPDATE xcdloaiytdd SET sl_sx = b.sl_sx
		FROM xcdloaiytdd a
			JOIN #xcdloaiytdd b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.loai_yt = b.loai_yt AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx
		WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period

	SET @q = 'delete xcdloaiytdd2 from xcdloaiytdd2 a where ' + @k1
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO xcdloaiytdd2(ky, nam, ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx
			, sl_dd_dk, sl_tp, sl_sx, sl_dd_ck0, tl_ht, sl_dd_ck
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3
			, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
		SELECT @Period, @Year, ma_dvcs, loai_yt, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx
				, sl_dd_dk, sl_nhap, sl_sx, 0, 0, sl_dd_ck
				, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, '', '', ''
				, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL
			FROM #xcdloaiytdd

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCustomerBalanceSummary] --fs_CustomersBalance
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Groups VARCHAR(511),
	@Order VARCHAR(511),
	@BalanceType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(511)

	 -- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #b FROM wrkgl

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = 'left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	--
	DECLARE @JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000), @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @JoinClause = 'join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk ' + @Join, @WhereClause = 'c.tk_cn = 1' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	INSERT INTO #b EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, NULL, @Account, @Customer, @BalanceType, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @JoinClause, @WhereClause
	--

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, @Account AS tk, a.ma_kh, SUM(du_no) AS du_no, SUM(du_no_nt) AS du_no_nt, SUM(du_co) AS du_co, SUM(du_co_nt) AS du_co_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_kh2) ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, MAX(b.nh_kh1) AS nh_kh1, MAX(b.nh_kh2) AS nh_kh2, MAX(b.nh_kh3) AS nh_kh3
		INTO #report
		FROM #b a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	DECLARE @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	UPDATE #report SET @du_no = du_no - du_co, @du_no_nt = du_no_nt - du_co_nt
		, du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END
		, du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

	DELETE #report WHERE ABS(du_no) + ABS(du_co) + ABS(du_no_nt) + ABS(du_co_nt) = 0

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'int, #, nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Groups = '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @o = @Groups + ', ' + @Order
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Groups, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	SET @q = dbo. ff_GetInsertGroup(@Groups, 'kh', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, ten_kh, ten_kh2, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, '', @s, @s, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt)
			FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, tk, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt from #report'
	IF @Groups = '' SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + @Groups + ', sysorder, tk, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_CaclTransferIn]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@cItem VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@cItemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@nSiteType TINYINT, 
	@nCostType TINYINT, 
	@cSiteGroup VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT @cSiteGroup = RTRIM(@cSiteGroup) + '%'

	DECLARE @nPRound TINYINT, @nFCPRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nFCPRound = CAST(RTRIM(val)AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gia_tb_round'
	SELECT @nPRound = @nFCPRound
	SELECT * INTO #tbg FROM #wrkstkbg

	IF @nSiteType = 2
		BEGIN
			SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS ps_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS ps_nhap_nt
				INTO #tit
				FROM ct70 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(ngay_ct)) WHERE ngay_ct >= @dFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dTo AND nxt = 1 AND ct_dc = 1 AND pn_gia_tb = 1
					AND ma_kho IN (SELECT ma_kho FROM dmkho WHERE ma_nh LIKE @cSiteGroup)
					AND ma_vt IN 
					(SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE gia_ton = @nCostType AND ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItem) + '%') 
						AND nh_vt1 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup1) + '%')
						AND nh_vt2 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup2) + '%')
						AND nh_vt3 LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemGroup3) + '%')
						AND loai_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@cItemType) + '%'))
				GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_kho
				ORDER BY ma_vt, ma_kho

			INSERT INTO #tbg (ma_vt, ma_kho, ton_dau, gia, gia_nt, du_dau, du_dau_nt)
				SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #tit WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tbg b WHERE #tit.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND #tit.ma_kho = b.ma_kho)
			UPDATE #tbg SET ton_dau = ton_dau + b.sl_nhap, du_dau = du_dau + b.ps_nhap, du_dau_nt = du_dau_nt + b.ps_nhap_nt
				FROM #tbg a JOIN #tit b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
		END

	UPDATE #tbg SET gia = CASE WHEN ton_dau = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(du_dau/ton_dau, @nPRound) END, 
		gia_nt = CASE WHEN ton_dau = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(du_dau_nt/ton_dau, @nFCPRound) END

	--DELETE FROM wrkstkprice
	INSERT INTO #wrkstkprice(ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt) SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt FROM #tbg
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhrrmkqktrct]
AS
SELECT z.ma_hs, a.ma_ktr, a.diem, a.ma_kq, a.trong_so, a.ghi_chu,
		b.ten_ktr, b.ten_ktr2, c.ten_kq AS ten_ma_kq, c.ten_kq2 AS ten_ma_kq2
	FROM hrrmkqktrct a WITH(NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN hrdmktr b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ktr = b.ma_ktr
		LEFT JOIN hrdmkq c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kq = c.ma_kq
		JOIN hrrmkqktr z WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostSOAuthorize] @IDNumber CHAR(13), @UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @roundQuantity INT, @r70 VARCHAR(32), @r90 VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c64$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = ''
	SELECT @roundQuantity = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'

	IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
		SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
		SET @MasterTable = 'm64$' + @Dyn
		SET @DetailTable = 'd64$' + @Dyn
		SET @InquiryTable = 'i64$' + @Dyn
		SELECT @r70 = 'r70$' + @Dyn, @r90 = 'r90$' + @Dyn
	END

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #master(loai_ct VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(32), u_status VARCHAR(32))
	DECLARE @loai_ct VARCHAR(32), @status VARCHAR(32), @u_status VARCHAR(32), @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select loai_ct, status, u_status from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and not exists(select 1 from ' + @DetailTable + ' b where b.stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and (b.sl_hd <> 0 or b.sl_dh <> 0))'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @loai_ct = loai_ct, @status = status, @u_status = u_status FROM #master
	SELECT @voucherCode = 'DXA'
	DROP TABLE #master

	IF @status = '2' AND @u_status <> '2' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = ''' + @status + ''', status = ''0'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''0'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''0'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update r60$' + @Dyn + ' set status = ''0'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Before update
		IF @loai_ct <> '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID

		-- Delete cddh13
		IF @loai_ct = '1' DELETE cddh13 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

		-- Delete revise
		IF @loai_ct = '3' BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong AS sl_nhap, so_luong AS sl_xuat INTO #currentStock FROM d64$000000	
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock(@r70, @r90, @IDNumber, @voucherCode, 'Delete', -1)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END


		--  Delete inventory
		IF @loai_ct = '3' BEGIN
			DELETE ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			SET @q = 'delete ' + @r90 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
		
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, 'a64$000000', '4'
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll002]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Chi tiết theo mức lương, 0 - Không
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 - Nhóm theo bộ phận quản lý, 2 - Bộ phận tính lương, 0 - Không
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s0 NVARCHAR(4000), @s1 NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @s3 VARCHAR(8000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @step INT, @Filter NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_so VARCHAR(32), @ds_loai_lg VARCHAR(256), @total NVARCHAR(511), @bac INT, @i INT, @iCount INT, @t VARCHAR(512),  @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @ResultExtend NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Nguon CHAR(1), @Type CHAR(1), @Ds_bp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_sp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_pc VARCHAR(256), @Ds_cong VARCHAR(256), @Ds_tp VARCHAR(256), @Ds_tn_gt VARCHAR(256), @Cach_tinh VARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @deptKey NVARCHAR(4000), @deptJoin NVARCHAR(1023), @currKey NVARCHAR(4000), @ext VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @ext = CASE @ReportBy WHEN '1' THEN '0' WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE '0' END

	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, bo_phan INTO #stt_rec FROM hrnv
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_loai_lg, gt, gt_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrluongth FROM hrluongth2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_loai_lg, ma_sp, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrluongsp FROM hrluongsp$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, ma_pc, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrluongpc FROM hrluongpc2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_loai_lg, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_tu INTO #hrluongtc FROM hrluongtc2$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_loai_lg, loai, ma_tngt, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrluongtngt FROM hrluongtngt$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_bp0, ma_cong, so_gio, so_ngay, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #hrcongth FROM hrcongth$000000

	SELECT ma_so, kind, nguon, type, ds_bp, ds_loai_luong, ds_sp, ds_pc, ds_cong, ds_tp, ds_tn_gt, cach_tinh, ids, in_ck, stt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN CASE WHEN ten_ngan = '' THEN chi_tieu ELSE ten_ngan END ELSE CASE WHEN ten_ngan2 = '' THEN chi_tieu2 ELSE ten_ngan2 END END AS chi_tieu
		INTO #hrpayroll002 FROM hrpayroll002 WITH(nolock) WHERE form = @Form
	CREATE INDEX ma_so ON #hrpayroll002(ma_so)

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#hrpayroll002', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @deptKey = '', @currKey = '', @ResultExtend = '', @deptJoin = '', @Join = ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp@ext = b.ma_bp left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec join #hrky c on a.ma_bp@ext = c.ma_bp@joinClause', @s0 = '', @s3 = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department0), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'b.') + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @Key
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	SELECT @Filter = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Filter)

	IF @Employee <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_nv = @Employee
		SELECT @IDNumber = ISNULL(@IDNumber, '')
		SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@IDNumber) + ''''
	END
	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'e.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'e.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'e.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(e.ngay_nghi is null or e.ngay_nghi >= c.ky_ngay_tu)'
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @currKey = 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + ' and @curClause'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @deptKey = REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.'), @Key = @Key + ' and @deptClause', @deptJoin = ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Payroll Period
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, b.bp_ref, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, a.ngay_tu AS ky_ngay_tu, a.ngay_den AS ky_ngay_den, a.so_ngay AS so_ngay_ky, a.so_ngay as so_ngay_cl INTO #hrkyTmp FROM hrky a JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	INSERT INTO #hrkyTmp(ma_bp, bp_ref, ky, nam, ky_ngay_tu, ky_ngay_den, so_ngay_ky) EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$GetPeriod$Department @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, '', @Filter, 'b', @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB
	SELECT ma_bp, MIN(ky_ngay_tu) AS ky_ngay_tu INTO #hrky FROM #hrkyTmp GROUP BY ma_bp

	-- Data
	SELECT @s1 = 'insert into @table select @select@primeField from @primeTable a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by @order'
	--
	SELECT @s2 = 'insert into @table select @select@detailField from @detailTable a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' @ExistsKey order by @detailOrder'
	SELECT @s2 = @s2 + CHAR(13) + 'insert into @table select @select@primeField from @primeTable a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' @ExistsKey and not exists(select 1 from @detailTable b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec @notExistsKey) order by @order'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #hrpayroll002 WHERE nguon = '1') BEGIN

	END

	-- Formula
	SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #index FROM #hrpayroll002 WHERE kind = 2 AND cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	SELECT @iCount = COUNT(id), @i = 1 FROM #index
	WHILE @i <= @iCount BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_so = ma_so, @cach_tinh = cach_tinh FROM #index WHERE id = @i
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp SET [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '] = ' + RTRIM(@Cach_tinh)
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = 'UPDATE #tmp SET [' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + '_nt] = ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Cach_tinh), ']', '_nt]')
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	SET @s3 = 'delete #tmp where ' + @s3 + '=0'
	EXEC(@s3)

	-- Rotate
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_bp, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gt_nt INTO #result FROM #hrpayroll002
	SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll002
	WHILE @ma_so IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #result select stt_rec, ma_bp, stt, ''' + @ma_so + ''', [' + @ma_so + '], [' + RTRIM(@ma_so) + '_nt] from #tmp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @ma_so = MIN(ma_so) FROM #hrpayroll002 WHERE ma_so > @ma_so
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, gt, gt_nt INTO #Total FROM #result

	IF @ReportBy = '1' OR @ReportBy = '2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
		SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
		IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, '#result', 'ma_bp'
			EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, '#stt_rec', 'bo_phan'

			SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
			INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
		END

		SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, a.ma_so, a.gt, a.gt_nt, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref INTO #dept FROM #result a, hrbp b
		SET @q = 'insert into #dept select a.ma_bp, a.ma_so, sum(a.gt) as gt, sum(a.gt_nt) as gt_nt, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, max(b.stt_ref) as stt_ref'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #result a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_bp, a.ma_so'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		INSERT INTO #Total SELECT ma_so, SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt) FROM #dept GROUP BY ma_so

		SELECT @bac = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #dept
		WHILE @bac > 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #dept select distinct a.bp_me, a.ma_so, 0, 0, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, b.stt_ref'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #dept a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bp_me = b.ma_bp'
			SET @q = @q + ' where a.bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + CASE WHEN @Filter <> '' AND @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN ' and ' + @Filter ELSE '' END
			SET @q = @q + ' and a.bp_me not in (select distinct ma_bp from #dept where bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + ' - 1)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #dept SET gt = a.gt + b.gt, gt_nt = a.gt_nt + b.gt_nt
				FROM #dept a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, ma_so, SUM(gt) AS gt, SUM(gt_nt) AS gt_nt FROM #dept WHERE bac_bp = @bac GROUP BY bp_me, ma_so) b ON a.ma_bp = b.bp_me AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so
				WHERE a.bac_bp = @bac - 1
			--
			SET @bac = @bac - 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #result SELECT '', ma_bp, 0, ma_so, gt, gt_nt FROM #dept

		SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #dept
	END

	IF @ReportBy = '0' BEGIN
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.stt_rec INTO #o1 FROM #stt_rec a JOIN hrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec ORDER BY b.ma_nv
		CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #o1(stt_rec)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, stt_rec, bo_phan, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #o2 FROM #stt_rec
		SET @q = 'insert into #o2(stt_rec, bo_phan, stt) select a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, 0 as stt from #stt_rec a join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec join ' + @c + 'hrbp c with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp order by c.stt_ref, b.ma_nv'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #o2(stt_rec)
		SELECT bo_phan, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o2 GROUP BY bo_phan
		UPDATE #o2 SET stt = a.id - b.id + 1 FROM #o2 a JOIN #g b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan
	END

	SELECT CAST(5 AS INT) AS sysorder, a.ma_bp, a.stt_rec, a.ma_so, a.stt, a.gt, a.gt_nt, b.ma_nv, b.ho_nv + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ten_nv
		INTO #report FROM #result a LEFT JOIN hrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Total
	IF @ReportBy = '0'
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, '', CHAR(9), ma_so, 0, SUM(gt), SUM(gt_nt), '', @total FROM #result GROUP BY ma_so
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, '', CHAR(9), ma_so, 0, gt, gt_nt, '', @total FROM #Total
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, '', CHAR(10), ma_so, 0, 0, 0, '', '' FROM #result GROUP BY ma_so

	-- View
	IF @ReportBy = '0'
		SELECT a.sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(a.stt, 5), ' ', '0') AS stt_rec, REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 5), ' ', '0') + a.ma_so AS ma_so
				, a.gt, a.gt_nt, ISNULL(c.stt, 0) AS stt2, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, b.chi_tieu, '' AS bo_phan
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #hrpayroll002 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so LEFT JOIN #o1 c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
			WHERE b.in_ck = 1
			ORDER BY a.sysorder, c.stt, b.stt, a.ma_so
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, 1 as systotal, 1 as sysprint, d.stt_ref'
		SET @q = @q + ', isnull(d.stt_ref, '''') + a.stt_rec + rtrim(a.stt) + rtrim(isnull(c.id, 0)) as stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(b.stt, 5), '' '', ''0'') + a.ma_so as ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.gt, a.gt_nt, isnull(c.stt, 0) as stt2, a.ma_nv, isnull(a.ten_nv, '''') as ten_nv, b.chi_tieu'
		SET @q = @q + ', space(2 * (d.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(ISNULL(@step, 0)) + ')) + case when a.stt_rec = '''' then ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_bp' ELSE 'd.ten_bp2' END + ' ELSE '''' end as bo_phan'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #hrpayroll002 b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so left join #o2 c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec and a.ma_bp = c.bo_phan left join ' + @c + 'hrbp d with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where b.in_ck = 1'
		SET @q = @q + ' order by a.sysorder, d.stt_ref, c.stt, b.stt, a.ma_so'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, MAX(b.chi_tieu) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report a JOIN #hrpayroll002 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so WHERE b.in_ck = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_so ORDER BY MAX(b.stt), a.ma_so
	SELECT id, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'gt$' ELSE 'gt_nt$' END + RTRIM(id) AS name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$WI] --fs_AfterUpdateIssue
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '0') RETURN

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d84$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_yc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c87$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_yc = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cMRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineMRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET sl_xuat = sl_xuat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, MAX(dyn_yc) AS dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_yc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cMRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND so_luong > sl_xuat)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c87$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

	a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5,

	dbo.xdmloaiyt b ON a.loai_yt = b.ma_loai LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt c ON a.ma_sp = c.ma_vt
