CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll004]
	@Count INT,
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PayTypeList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@DetailByEmp TINYINT,
	@ReportForm INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @bac INT, @Total NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @ds_loai_luong VARCHAR(1024), @PeriodName NVARCHAR(64), @i INT, @Ky CHAR(6)

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, a.stt_rec, b.ma_bp, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS ky INTO #report FROM hrluongth$000000 a, hrbp b
	SELECT a.* INTO #nv FROM #report a
	
	SELECT @PeriodName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @Total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ' join hrbp b on a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp'
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department0), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'b.')
	SELECT @Filter = @Key
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.'), 
		@Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'
	--
	SELECT @Filter = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Filter)
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @PayTypeList <> '' SELECT @ds_loai_luong = @PayTypeList
		ELSE SELECT @ds_loai_luong = RTRIM(ds_loai_luong) FROM hrPayroll003 WHERE ma_bc = 'PAY04'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_loai_lg in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@ds_loai_luong, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #nv select 5, a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0, max(b.bp_me), max(b.bac_bp), sum(gt), sum(gt_nt), rtrim(%Partition)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrluongth$%Partition a' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' ELSE '' END + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp0'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @Period, @Year, @Count, NULL, NULL, NULL, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @c CHAR(1)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, '#nv', 'ma_bp', 'bp_me = b.pn_me, bac_bp = b.bac_pn'

		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @Filter, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, '', ma_bp, MAX(bp_me), MAX(bac_bp), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ky FROM #nv GROUP BY ma_bp, ky
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, '', '', '', 0, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), ky FROM #nv GROUP BY ky

	-- Report
	SELECT @bac = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #report
	WHILE @bac > 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct 5, '''', b.ma_bp, b.bp_me, ' + LTRIM(STR(@bac)) + ' - 1, 0, 0, a.ky'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bp_me = b.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where (a.bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@bac) + ' and a.bp_me + a.ky not in (select distinct ma_bp + ky from #report))' + CASE WHEN @Filter <> '' AND @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN ' and ' + @Filter ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		UPDATE #report SET tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt
			FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, ky, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt FROM #report WHERE bac_bp = @bac GROUP BY bp_me, ky) b ON a.ma_bp = b.bp_me AND a.ky = b.ky
		--
		SELECT @bac = @bac - 1
	END

	SELECT @bac = ISNULL(MIN(bac_bp), 0) FROM #report WHERE ma_bp <> ''

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 4, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, ky FROM #report ORDER BY ky

	IF @DetailByEmp = 1 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, stt_rec, ma_bp, bp_me, bac_bp, tien, tien_nt, ky FROM #nv
	END

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, case when a.stt_rec = '''' then a.ma_bp else '''' end as ma_bp,'
	SET @q = @q + ' isnull(case when a.sysorder > 4 then replace(space(2*(a.bac_bp - ' + LTRIM(@bac) + ')), '' '', char(160)) else '''' end'
	SET @q = @q + ' + case when a.stt_rec = '''' then ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' else rtrim(c.ma_nv) + '' - '' + rtrim(c.ho_nv) + '' '' + c.ten_nv end, case when a.sysorder = 3 then N''' + @Total + ''' else '''' end) as ten_bp,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when a.sysorder = 5 then b.stt_ref + isnull(c.ma_nv, '''') else case when a.sysorder = 3 then '''' else ''.'' end end as xRow,'
	SET @q = @q + ' a.ky as xColumn, N''' + @PeriodName + ''' + space(1) + right(a.ky, 2) + ''/'' + left(a.ky, 4) as xColumnName, a.tien, a.tien_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' isnull(b.stt_ref, '''') as stt_ref'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp left join hrnv c with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.sysorder, b.stt_ref, xRow, a.ky'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END AS VARCHAR(64)) AS name, @PeriodName + SPACE(1) + RIGHT(ky, 2) + '/' + LEFT(ky, 4) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY ky
	SELECT id, name + RTRIM(id) AS name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	-- Drop
	DROP TABLE #nv
	DROP TABLE #report
	DROP TABLE #pivot

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$App$Columns$Default](@t1 VARCHAR(32), @t2 VARCHAR(32), @f VARCHAR(128), @g VARCHAR(128))
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @s VARCHAR(8000)
	IF @f IS NULL AND @g IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @s IS NULL THEN '' ELSE @s + ',' END + name FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@t1) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @t2)) ORDER BY colorder
		RETURN @s
	END

	IF @g IS NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE @df TABLE (name VARCHAR(128), val VARCHAR(128))
		INSERT INTO @df SELECT a.name, CASE WHEN (b.name LIKE '%char%' OR b.name LIKE '%text%') THEN '''''' WHEN (b.name LIKE '%int%' OR b.name IN ('decimal', 'numeric', 'float', 'real', 'money', 'bit')) THEN '0' ELSE NULL END
			FROM syscolumns a JOIN systypes b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype
			WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@t1)

		SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @s IS NULL THEN '' ELSE @s + ',' END + 
			CASE
				WHEN b.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'a.' + a.name
				WHEN c.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'b.' + a.name
				WHEN d.val IS NOT NULL THEN d.val
				ELSE 'null'
			END
			FROM syscolumns a LEFT JOIN (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @t2)) b ON a.name = b.name LEFT JOIN (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @f)) c ON a.name = c.name LEFT JOIN @df d ON a.name = d.name
			WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID(@t1)
			ORDER BY a.colorder
		RETURN @s
	END

	SELECT @f = REPLACE(@f, ' ', ''), @g = ',' + REPLACE(@g, ' ', '') + ','
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @s IS NULL THEN '' ELSE @s + ',' END + 
			CASE
				WHEN CHARINDEX(',' + RTRIM(a.name) + ',', @g) > 0 THEN a.name
				WHEN CHARINDEX('(' + RTRIM(a.name) + ')', @f) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(@f, CHARINDEX('(' + RTRIM(a.name) + ')', @f) - 3, LEN(a.name) + 5)
				WHEN b.name = 'bit' THEN '0'
				ELSE 'max(' + a.name + ')'
			END
		FROM syscolumns a LEFT JOIN (SELECT xtype, xusertype, name FROM systypes WHERE name <> 'sysname') b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype
		WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID(@t1) AND a.name IN (SELECT name FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @t2))
		ORDER BY a.colorder

	RETURN @s
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdbdashboard] AS
	SELECT a.*,
			b.ten_vung AS f1_name, b.ten_vung2 AS f1_name2,
			c.ten_vung AS f2_name, c.ten_vung2 AS f2_name2,
			d.ten_vung AS f3_name, d.ten_vung2 AS f3_name2,
			e.ten_vung AS f4_name, e.ten_vung2 AS f4_name2,
			b.xml AS f1_xml, c.xml AS f2_xml, d.xml AS f3_xml, e.xml AS f4_xml,
			b.status AS f1_status, c.status AS f2_status, d.status AS f3_status, e.status AS f4_status,
			f.dien_giai, f.dien_giai2, f.status AS controller_status
		FROM dbdashboard a LEFT JOIN dbfield b ON a.f1 = b.field_id
			LEFT JOIN dbfield c ON a.f2 = c.field_id
			LEFT JOIN dbfield d ON a.f3 = d.field_id
			LEFT JOIN dbfield e ON a.f4 = e.field_id 
			LEFT JOIN dbcontroller f ON a.controller = f.controller

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$WS] --fs_AfterUpdatePS
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 tt_yn INTO #updatePO FROM m68$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS refTable INTO #afterUpdate FROM d68$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #updatePO SELECT tt_yn FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when right(stt_rec_dh, 3) = ''PO1'' then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_sa <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #afterUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #afterUpdate set stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0hd from #afterUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_sa <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_sa, dyn_oa, dyn_hd, refTable FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = 0'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan >0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_sa, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vxcdloaiytddx]
AS
SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.loai_yt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dd_dk, a.sl_tp, a.sl_sx, a.sl_dd_ck0, a.tl_ht, a.sl_dd_ck, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, 
		a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, 
		a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, b.ten_loai AS ten_loai_yt, b.ten_loai2 AS ten_loai_yt2, c.ten_vt AS ten_sp, c.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2
	FROM dbo.xcdloaiytdd AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
		dbo.xdmloaiyt AS b ON a.loai_yt = b.ma_loai LEFT OUTER JOIN
		dbo.dmvt AS c ON a.ma_sp = c.ma_vt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptContractsBalance] --fs20_ObjsBalance
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@Date AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Order VARCHAR(128),
	@Group1 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 NVARCHAR(32),
	@Group0 CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @Order = CASE WHEN @Order = '1' THEN 'ten_hd, ten_hd2' ELSE 'ma_hd' END
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b1 FROM cdhd
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #b2 FROM cdhd
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, a.ma_hd, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, a.ma_kh, ten_hd, ten_hd2 INTO #report FROM #t a, dmhd b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_hd, ten_hd2', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--@Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_hd <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @Group0 = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh <> '''''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_hd3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmhd b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b2 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$ContractCustomer @Date, @Unit, @Account, @Contract, '', @BalanceType, '2', @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #b2
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #b1 EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Contract @Date, @Unit, @Account, @Contract, @BalanceType, '2', @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT tk, ma_hd, '', du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt FROM #b1
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0, '''', a.ma_hd, sum(du_no), sum(du_co), sum(du_no_nt), sum(du_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Group0 = '1' THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_hd)' ELSE '''''' END + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_hd2)' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t a left join dmhd b on a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_hd' + CASE @Group0 WHEN '1' THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	IF @Group0 = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @o = 'ma_kh,' + @Order
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_kh', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('ma_kh', 'hd', 'du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt) VALUES (1, 1, 0, 0)
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_hd, ten_hd2, ma_hd, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, stt)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, '', SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt), 0 FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_hd, ten_hd, ten_hd2, Stt) VALUES (1, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0)
	END

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ma_hd, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ten_hd, ten_hd2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ma_kh, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTRClosed]
	@userID INT, 
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT	
	SELECT @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID	

	SET @MasterTable = 'hrdtyc'
	SET @DetailTable = 'hrdtctyc'
	SET @InquiryTable = 'hridtyc'
	SET @HisTable = 'hradtyc'
	
	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and ' + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') THEN 'status not in (''*'', ''3'')' ELSE 'status <> ''3''' END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''3'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''3'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''3'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'
		
	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN		
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterAdjustmentInvoice]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceID CHAR(13),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(33),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(33),
	@Serial VARCHAR(33),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@Resign BIT = 0,
	@TableNameBefore VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@TableNameAfter VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @InvoiceID = REPLACE(@InvoiceID, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @r NVARCHAR(512)

	SELECT @p = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@VoucherCode, @VoucherID)
	IF CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @ResultProcess = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate()'
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @TableNameBefore = '' THEN ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + '''' ELSE ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameBefore) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @keyFields NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @keyFields = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_return_fields_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 'case when charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) > 0 then substring(%b.so_bi_mat, 1, charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) - 1) else %b.so_bi_mat end' ELSE '%b.so_bi_mat' END

	--
	IF @TableNameAfter = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @r = ' set so_ct0 = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''';'

		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', so_seri_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@Serial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_ct_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ''' + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ct00' + @r + 'update ct70' + @r + 'update ct90' + @r + 'update r00$' + @p + @r + 'update r70$' + @p + @r + 'update r90$' + @p + @r

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		-- PadLeft...
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @TableNameAfter + ' set so_ct_hddt = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(so_ct_hddt)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = b.mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt = b.so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt = b.so_ct_hddt, tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameAfter) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13) + @q + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', 'b.') + ' from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameAfter) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'

		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct00 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct00 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct70 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct70 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct90 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct90 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r00$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r70$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r70$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r90$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r90$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	CREATE TABLE #refVCCode([key] VARCHAR(32), stt_rec VARCHAR(32), ma_ct VARCHAR(3), ctable VARCHAR(32), p VARCHAR(6), ck_yn TINYINT)

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' BEGIN
		SELECT @vCode = ma_ct_hd FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
		SELECT @refp = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@vCode, @InvoiceID)

		IF @TableNameAfter <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #refVCCode select b.[key], a.stt_rec_hd, a.ma_ct_hd, '''', '''', 0 from hddc a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE a SET ctable = RTRIM(b.c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(b.c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END FROM #refVCCode a JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #refVCCode set p = convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + QUOTENAME(ctable) + ' a join #refVCCode b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY ctable
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode IN ('HD2', 'HD4', 'HDF') SELECT @refp = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @InvoiceID
			ELSE SELECT @refp = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM c21$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @InvoiceID

		IF @TableNameAfter <> '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @rTable VARCHAR(33), @rField VARCHAR(33)
			SELECT @rTable = rtable, @rField = rfield FROM hddtfields WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND xtype = 2
			SET @q = 'insert into #refVCCode select b.[key], a.@rField, '''', '''', '''', 0 from @rTable a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where a.@rField <> '''''
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@rTable', REPLACE(@rTable, '%Partition', @p)), '@rField', @rField)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF @VoucherCode IN ('HD2', 'HD4', 'HDF') UPDATE #refVCCode SET p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) FROM #refVCCode a JOIN c81$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
				ELSE UPDATE #refVCCode SET p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) FROM #refVCCode a JOIN c21$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		END
	END

	IF @TableNameAfter = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @refp + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 3, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--- Circular 78 --- Discount Voucher
		DECLARE @isDiscountVoucher TINYINT
		SELECT @q = N'select @isDisCountVoucher = isnull(ck_yn, 0) from hddt00$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = @InvoiceID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@isDisCountVoucher tinyint output, @InvoiceID varchar(32)', @isDisCountVoucher OUTPUT, @InvoiceID
		IF ISNULL(@isDiscountVoucher, 0) = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set ck_yn = 1 where stt_rec = @VoucherID'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherID varchar(32)', @VoucherID
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update a set tinh_trang_hddt = 3, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() from hddt00$' + p + ' a join #refVCCode b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY p
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		--- Circular 78 --- Discount Voucher
		SELECT @q = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update a set ck_yn = isnull(b.ck_yn, 0) from #refVCCode a join hddt00$' + p + ' b on a.[stt_rec] = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY p
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set ck_yn = 1 from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join #refVCCode b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where b.ck_yn = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	CREATE TABLE #stt2 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_bi_mat VARCHAR(512))
	IF @TableNameAfter = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #stt2 SELECT @VoucherID, @InvoiceNumber, @InvoiceTemplate, @Serial, @SecretNumber
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt2 select [key], so_ct_hddt, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt,' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', '') + ' from ' + @TableNameAfter
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate '#stt2', @VoucherCode, DEFAULT, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	DROP TABLE #refVCCode
	DROP TABLE #stt2

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIReceiptTransListByItem] --[rs_rptReceiptTransactionListByItem]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order  VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: thuc te, 3: thuc te dvt
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF


	DECLARE @queryStatement NVARCHAR(4000), @returnStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
	CREATE TABLE #rpt(name VARCHAR(64), ref VARCHAR(4000), value NVARCHAR(4000))

	-- Query
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'char(3)', 'm_ma_nt0'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Reports', 'nvarchar(128)', 'Total'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Reports', 'nvarchar(128)', 'NoGroup'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryField', '', 'a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ma_ct, c.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, c.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_vt, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, b.nh_vt1, b.nh_vt2, b.nh_vt3, b.loai_vt, a.ma_nt, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kho, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.line_nbr'
		+ CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', a.sl_nhap' ELSE ', a.sl_nhap1' END + ' as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt' ELSE CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', a.sl_xuat' ELSE ', a.sl_xuat1' END + ' as so_luong, a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt' END
		+ CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', a.gia, a.gia_nt, cast(null as nvarchar(32)) as dvt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0' ELSE ', a.gia1 as gia, a.gia_nt1 as gia_nt, a.dvt1 as dvt, a.gia01 as gia0, a.gia_nt01 as gia_nt0' END
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryJoin', '', 'left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Customer', @Customer
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Item', @Item
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup1', @ItemGroup1
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup2', @ItemGroup2
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup3', @ItemGroup3
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemType', @ItemType
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Job', @Job
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Contract', @Contract
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Department', @Department
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Transaction', @TransactionCode
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'TransactionKey', @VoucherCode, @TransactionList
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', '(a.nxt = ''' + RTRIM(@Form) + ''')'

	-- Statement
	SELECT @queryStatement = 'update #report set gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt0 = 0, tien_nt0 = 0, thue_nt = 0 where ma_nt = '''' or ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0;update #report set ma_ct0 = b.ma_ct_in from #report a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct;'

	-- Process
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'OrderDetail', '', 'ma_vt, sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order ) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order  END + ', stt_ct_nkc, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupFunction', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, nk, nk_nt, thue, thue_nt', 'sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), sum(tien0), sum(tien_nt0), sum(cp), sum(cp_nt), sum(nk), sum(nk_nt), sum(thue), sum(thue_nt)'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupRow', 'select ma_vt, rtrim(ma_vt) + '' - '' + ltrim(ten_vt%l) as group_name from #report where sysorder = 5 group by ma_vt, ten_vt%l', 'ma_vt'

	-- Return
	SELECT @returnStatement = 'update a set sysprint = 0, ten_vt%l = b.ten_vt%l from #report a join (select ma_vt, ten_vt%l from #report where sysorder = 5 group by ma_vt, ten_vt%l) b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where a.sysorder <> 5;'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnField', '', 'sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt_rec as rp_group, b.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ma_ct, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt
		, case when sysorder <> ''5'' then isnull(a.group_name, @NoGroup) else a.dien_giai end as dien_giai, isnull(a.ten_vt, '''') as ten_vt, isnull(a.ten_vt2, '''') as ten_vt2
		, cast(null as varchar(32)) as ma_nx'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnJoin', '', 'left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'

	-- Result
	EXEC bs_rptGetReportData 'r90$%Partition', 1, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @InvoiceFrom, @InvoiceTo, @Unit, @Site, @PurOrgCode, @PurGrCode, @PlantCode, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB
		, default, default, default, 1, default, 1, default, 1, @queryStatement, @returnStatement, default, @TableName, @DataType

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetInsertGroup2
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(48), 
	@cFieldCode VARCHAR(48), 
	@cFieldName VARCHAR(48), 
	@cRefCode VARCHAR(48), 
	@cRefName VARCHAR(48), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18), 
	@cRefTable VARCHAR(48), 
	@cKey AS CHAR(16)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT, @cItemGroupName VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@cGroups), @i = 1, @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	WHILE @nStart > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cGroups, @i)
			IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
			SELECT @cItemGroupName = RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cFieldName, @i))
		
			SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ' + @cItemGroupName + ' NVARCHAR(511)'
			SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ' + @cItemGroupName + '2 NVARCHAR(511)'

			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cItemGroupName + ' = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(' + @cItemGroupName + '), ' + @cItemGroupName + '2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(' + @cItemGroupName + '2) WHERE systotal = 1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ' +  dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cFieldCode, @i) + ', ' + @cItemGroupName + ', ' + @cItemGroupName + '2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cRefName, @i) + '), MAX(b.' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cRefName, @i) + '2), a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ', SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '), SUM(a.') + ')'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cRefTable, @i) + CASE WHEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cKey, @i) = '0' THEN '' ELSE ' WHERE  loai_nh = ' + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@cItemGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) END + ') b'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' ON a.' + @cItemGroup + ' = b.' + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@cRefCode, @i) + '  WHERE a.systotal = 1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')

			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cItemGroupName + ' =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ' + @cItemGroupName + ' IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cItemGroupName + '2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ' + @cItemGroupName + '2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ' + @cItemGroupName + ' = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-1) + RTRIM(' + @cItemGroupName + '), ' + @cItemGroupName + '2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-1) + RTRIM(' + @cItemGroupName + '2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'

			SET @i = @i + 1
			SET @nStart = @nStart - 1
		END
	RETURN @strReturn
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostPRClosedHeaders] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber	
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm91$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd91$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i91$' + @Dyn
	
	--
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = ' declare @xtag2 char(1) select @xtag2 = xtag2 from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag2, xtag2 = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c91$000000 set status = @xtag2  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag2 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	
	-- History Approve
	DECLARE @stt INT
	SELECT @stt = 0
	SELECT @stt = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) + 1 FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	
	SET @q = 'insert into a91$000000(stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ''' + RTRIM(@stt) + ''', status, u_status, ''2'', user_id2, datetime2, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @masterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher]
	@cVCCode CHAR(3),
	@dVC SMALLDATETIME,
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(33),
	@daterules TINYINT = 1,
	@r TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	IF @cVCCode IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_ct, b.ngay_ks, c.ngay_ct1, c.ngay_ct2
			FROM dmct a JOIN dmstt b ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN sysdaterules c ON c.user_id = @nUserID
			WHERE a.ma_ct NOT IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM dmctkks WHERE ks_yn = 0) AND NOT b.ngay_ks IS NULL
		UNION ALL
		SELECT a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ks, c.ngay_ct1, c.ngay_ct2
			FROM dmctks a LEFT JOIN sysdaterules c ON c.user_id = @nUserID WHERE a.ma_ct NOT IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM dmctkks WHERE ks_yn = 0) AND a.user_id = @nUserID AND NOT a.ngay_ks IS NULL
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @nRet INT, @dLocked SMALLDATETIME, @dUnitLocked SMALLDATETIME, @dVCLocked SMALLDATETIME, @dUserFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dUserTo SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @nRet = 1 -- 0: Date Range, 1: None, 2: Locked Date, 3: by Unit, 4: by Voucher, 5: Working Date

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dmctkks WHERE ma_ct = @cVCCode AND ks_yn = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @dLocked = ngay_ks FROM dmstt
	IF @dVC <= @dLocked BEGIN
		SELECT @nRet = @r * 2
		SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @dUnitLocked = ngay_ks FROM dmdvcsks WHERE ma_dvcs = @cUnit
	IF (@dUnitLocked IS NOT NULL) AND @dVC <= @dUnitLocked BEGIN
		SELECT @nRet = @r * 3
		SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @dVCLocked = ngay_ks FROM dmctks WHERE ma_ct = @cVCCode AND user_id = @nUserID
	IF (@dVCLocked IS NOT NULL) AND @dVC <= @dVCLocked BEGIN
		SELECT @nRet = @r * 4
		SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @dUserFrom = ngay_ct1, @dUserTo = ngay_ct2 FROM sysdaterules WHERE user_id = @nUserID
	IF @daterules = 1 BEGIN
		IF (@dUserFrom IS NOT NULL) AND @dVC < @dUserFrom BEGIN
			SELECT @nRet = @r * 5
			SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
			RETURN
		END
		IF (@dUserTo IS NOT NULL) AND @dVC > @dUserTo BEGIN
			SELECT @nRet = @r * 5
			SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SELECT @nRet AS xvalue
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTransactionList] --fs_TransList--
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(1024),
	@Type VARCHAR(1),
	@AccountRef VARCHAR(1024),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@VC VARCHAR(1024),
	@FC VARCHAR(1024),
	@Decription NVARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@VCs VARCHAR(1024),
	@FCs VARCHAR(1024),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Fee VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@MONumber VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@BContract NVARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
				, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kh, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)


	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#report', @TableName, @controller, @sysDatabase, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a')
	--

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @AccountRef <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @AccountRef)
	IF @Type = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_no <> 0'
	IF @Type = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_co <> 0'
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VC <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VC), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FC <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FC), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VCs <> '' BEGIN
		SET @VCs = REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCs), '''', '''''')
		IF CHARINDEX(',', @VCs) <= 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_ct_in like ''' + @VCs + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@VCs, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where b.ma_ct_in like fc.fc)'
	END
	IF @FCs <> '' BEGIN
		SET @FCs = REPLACE(RTRIM(@FCs), '''', '''''')
		IF CHARINDEX(',', @FCs) <= 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + @FCs + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from (select ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FCs, ' ', ''), ',', '%'' fc union all select ''') + '%'') fc where a.ma_nt like fc.fc)'
	END
	IF @Decription <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.dien_giai like N''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Decription), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Fee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Fee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MONumber <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MONumber), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @BContract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@BContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey

	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct' + @queryJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt%sumFields%)'
	SET @q = @q + 'select 0, 0, 0, N''' + REPLACE(@s, '''', '''''') + ''', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)%sumValues% from #report'
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%sumFields%', CASE WHEN @totalFields <> '' THEN ',' + @totalFields ELSE '' END), '%sumValues%', CASE WHEN @sumTotalFields <> '' THEN ',' + @sumTotalFields ELSE '' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)
	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct0, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_kh, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE '''''' END + ' AS ten_kh2' + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseFields
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, nh_dk, abs(ps_co), line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_postOATran]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @qtyRound INT, @priceRound INT, @vcNumber CHAR(12), @vcDate SMALLDATETIME, @vendor VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @qtyRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM bim10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM bid10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Get data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @vcNumber = so_ct, @vcDate = ngay_ct, @vendor = ma_kh FROM #master


	-- Post price
	DECLARE @external NVARCHAR(512), @masterField NVARCHAR(512), @keys NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @keys = 'cn_tt_gia = ''1''', @external = 'status = 1, ncc_tx = 0, tien_nt = c.tien_nt0, gia_nt = c.gia_nt0', @masterField = 'ma_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, ma_dvcs, ma_nh0, ma_bp0, ma_kh, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	EXEC bs_Post2InfoRecord '#master', '#detail', @idNumber, @keys,	@masterField, @external, '0'
	
	-- Post Source List
	DECLARE @xrec CHAR(13), @xrec0 CHAR(3), @wsID VARCHAR(1), @xline INT, @ct_nguon_cung NVARCHAR(4000), @dUpdate SMALLDATETIME, @xStatus CHAR(1)
	CREATE TABLE #idNumber (stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr AS id, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, cd_ncc, ghi_chu INTO #jdata FROM bid01$000000
	SELECT b.stt_rec0, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_kh, b.ma_vt, b.ma_vung, b.ct_nguon_cung INTO #sl FROM #master a join #detail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.ct_nguon_cung <> ''
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #d01 FROM bid01$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, c$, m$, d$, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #i01 FROM bii01$000000

	SELECT @xrec0 = MIN(stt_rec0) FROM #sl
	SET @dUpdate = getdate()
	WHILE @xrec0 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @ct_nguon_cung = '[' + ct_nguon_cung + ']', @xrec = NULL FROM #sl WHERE stt_rec0 = @xrec0
		SELECT @xrec = stt_rec, @xStatus = status FROM #sl a JOIN bim01$000000 b ON a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp0 AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung
			WHERE a.stt_rec0 = @xrec0

		IF @xrec IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @wsID = rtrim(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
			TRUNCATE TABLE #idNumber
			INSERT INTO #idNumber EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetIdentityNumber @wsID, 'P01', 'bim01$000000', @UserID
			SELECT @xrec = stt_rec, @xStatus = '1' FROM #idNumber

			INSERT INTO bim01$000000(stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_vung, dien_giai, status, user_id0, user_id2, datetime0, datetime2)
				SELECT @xrec, ma_dvcs, 'P01', ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_vung, '', '1', @UserID, @UserID, @dUpdate, @dUpdate FROM #sl WHERE stt_rec0 = @xrec0

			SET @q = 'stt_rec = ''' + @xrec + ''''
			EXEC rs_DefaultValue 1, 'bim01$000000', 'stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ma_bp0, ma_vt, ma_vung, dien_giai, status, user_id0, user_id2, datetime0, datetime2', 1, default, @q
		END
		UPDATE bim01$000000 SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = @dUpdate WHERE stt_rec = @xrec

		TRUNCATE TABLE #jdata
		TRUNCATE TABLE #d01
		TRUNCATE TABLE #i01
		EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_nguon_cung, '#jdata', 'id, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, cd_ncc, ghi_chu'
		SELECT @xline = MAX(line_nbr) + 1 FROM bid01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @xrec
		
		INSERT INTO #d01(stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ma_kh, vung_cu, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, cd_ncc, ghi_chu, so_tc, ngay_tc, ma_nguon, line_nbr) 
			SElECT @xrec, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(ISNULL(@xline, 1)), 'P01', a.ma_kh, '', b.ngay_hl_tu, b.ngay_hl_den, b.cd_ncc, b.ghi_chu, @vcNumber, @vcDate, 'PA1', isnull(@xline, 1)
			FROM #sl a CROSS JOIN #jdata b WHERE a.stt_rec0 = @xrec0
				AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bid01$000000 x WHERE x.stt_rec = @xrec AND x.ma_kh = @vendor AND (x.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_tu <= b.ngay_hl_den) AND (x.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR x.ngay_hl_den >= b.ngay_hl_tu))

		EXEC rs_DefaultValue 2, '#d01', 'stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ma_kh, vung_cu, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, cd_ncc, ghi_chu, so_tc, ngay_tc, ma_nguon, line_nbr', 1
		INSERT INTO bid01$000000 SELECT * FROM #d01

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #d01) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #d01
			INSERT INTO #d01 SElECT * FROM bid01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @xrec
			INSERT INTO #i01 SELECT stt_rec, NULL, '', ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, RTRIM(ma_dvcs) + RTRIM(ma_bp0) + RTRIM(ma_vung) + RTRIM(ma_vt) + stt_rec, 
				'#10$' + rtrim(ma_bp0) + '#20$' + rtrim(ma_vung) + '#30$' + rtrim(ma_vt), '' FROM bim01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @xrec
			SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Update$Inquiry('#i01', '#d01', 'd$', 'ma_kh, vung_cu, ma_nguon', '#10$, #20$, #30$', 'stt_rec', default, default, default, default, default)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			DELETE bii01$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @xrec
			INSERT INTO bii01$000000(stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, status, user_id0, c$, m$, d$) 
				SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, '', ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, @xStatus, @UserID, c$, m$, d$ FROM #i01
		END

		--
		SELECT @xrec0 = MIN(stt_rec0) FROM #sl WHERE stt_rec0 > @xrec0
	END
	
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_TSTransfer2NextYear]
	@Year NUMERIC(4,0),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @RightKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @Delta INT, @d SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @d = CONVERT(SMALLDATETIME, STR(@Year, 4) + '1231', 112), @Key = '',@RightKey = '', @Join = '', @JointUnit = 0, @JointDept = 0

	-- Structure	
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nv, ma_cc, so_luong, ngay_hh INTO #res FROM hrccdk
	
	-- Key
	IF @Admin = 0 BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
		IF @Key <> '' SELECT @RightKey = @Key
	END
	SELECT @Key = '(a.ngay_hh is null or ngay_hh > ''' + RTRIM(@d) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 SELECT @Join = ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec'

	-- Lấy đầu kỳ
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #res select a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_cc, a.so_luong, a.ngay_hh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrccdk a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Increase
	SET @q = 'insert into #res select a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_cc, a.so_luong, a.ngay_hh'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrccctcp a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where year(a.ngay_ct) = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Decrease
	SET @q = 'insert into #res select a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_cc, -a.so_luong, a.ngay_hh'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrccctgiam a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where year(a.ngay_ct) = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + ' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Transfer
	IF @RightKey <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete a from hrccdk a left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec where nam = ' + LTRIM(@Year + 1) + ' and ' + @RightKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE DELETE hrccdk WHERE nam = @Year + 1

	INSERT INTO hrccdk(nam, stt_rec_nv, ma_cc, ngay_hh0, ngay_hh, so_luong, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @Year + 1, stt_rec_nv, ma_cc, ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_hh, 112), ''), ngay_hh, SUM(so_luong), '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #res GROUP BY stt_rec_nv, ma_cc, ngay_hh

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO

	FROM dmdvcsks a LEFT JOIN dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
