CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhredt]
AS
SELECT     a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_khoa, ISNULL(b.ten_khoa, '') AS ten_khoa, ISNULL(b.ten_khoa2, '') AS ten_khoa2, ISNULL(b.ma_mh, '') AS ma_mh, ISNULL(c.ten_mh, '') AS ten_mh, 
                      ISNULL(c.ten_mh2, '') AS ten_mh2, ISNULL(b.loai_hinh_dt, '') AS loai_hinh_dt, ISNULL(d.ten_loai, '') AS ten_loai, ISNULL(d.ten_loai2, '') AS ten_loai2, ISNULL(b.ma_dvdt, '') AS ma_dvdt, 
                      ISNULL(e.ten_dvdt, '') AS ten_dvdt, ISNULL(e.ten_dvdt2, '') AS ten_dvdt2, b.ngay_hoc1, b.ngay_hoc2, ISNULL(b.so_gio, 0) AS so_gio, a.diem, a.xep_loai, a.dat_yn, a.ghi_chu
FROM         dbo.hredt AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdtkh AS b ON a.ma_khoa = b.ma_khoa AND b.status <> '*' LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmmh AS c ON b.ma_mh = c.ma_mh LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmlhdt AS d ON b.loai_hinh_dt = d.ma_loai LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmdvdt AS e ON b.ma_dvdt = e.ma_dvdt

GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintT1Tran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_ns, a.tn_ct, a.tn_ct_nt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_ns' + @cE + ' AS ten_ns'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' phns g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ns = g.ma_ns'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 5, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_ns, ten_ns'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2Card]
	@period AS INT, 
	@year AS INT, 
	@type VARCHAR(32),
	@department VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dateTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year)) - 1
	-- Struct
	select top 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc AS ma_bp, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
		INTO #report
		FROM dmccdc a, dmdcct b
	
	-- Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_tang <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	SET @key = @key + ' and a.status <> ''*'''
	IF @type <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@type, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @department <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@department, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey 
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 
				b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
			from dmccdc a with(nolock) left join dmdcct b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			where ' + @key 
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, ma_bp) SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', ''
	SELECT 0 AS tag, * FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #report b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.line_nbr > b.line_nbr WHERE b.line_nbr IS NULL

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalCategory]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@code NVARCHAR(4000),
	@category VARCHAR(32) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Struct
	DECLARE @c AS CHAR(1)
	SET @c = CHAR(253)
	SELECT * INTO #key FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@code, @c)

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @customerGroup1 VARCHAR(1023), @customerGroup2 VARCHAR(1023), @customerGroup3 VARCHAR(1023), @i INT
		, @dvcs_yn VARCHAR(32), @bp_yn VARCHAR(32), @md_yn VARCHAR(32), @kh_yn VARCHAR(32), @vung_yn VARCHAR(32), @bp0_yn VARCHAR(32), @nh0_yn VARCHAR(32), @tien_yn VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @q = '', @key = '', @category = '', @customerGroup1 = '', @customerGroup2 = '', @customerGroup3 = '', @i = 0
	SELECT @dvcs_yn = dvcs_yn, @bp_yn = bp_yn, @md_yn = md_yn, @kh_yn = kh_yn, @vung_yn = vung_yn, @bp0_yn = bp0_yn, @nh0_yn = nh0_yn, @tien_yn = tien_yn FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Key
	IF @dvcs_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.dvcs = '''' or (a.dvcs = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.dvcs = ''1''))'
	END
	
	IF @vung_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_vung = '''' or (a.ma_vung = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_vung = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @bp0_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_bp0 = '''' or (a.ma_bp0 = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_bp0 = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @nh0_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_nh0 = '''' or (a.ma_nh0 = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_nh0 = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @bp_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_bp = '''' or (a.ma_bp = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_bp = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @md_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_md = '''' or (a.ma_md = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_md = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @kh_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @customerGroup1 = nh_kh1, @customerGroup2 = nh_kh2, @customerGroup3 = nh_kh3 FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = (SELECT data FROM #key WHERE id = @i)
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh1 = '''' or (a.nh_kh1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh1 = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh2 = '''' or (a.nh_kh2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh2 = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.nh_kh3 = '''' or (a.nh_kh3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customerGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''' and b.nh_kh3 = ''1''))'
	END

	IF @tien_yn = '1' BEGIN
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.ma_nt = '''' or (a.ma_nt = (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.ma_nt = ''1''))'
		SET @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.tien_tu = 0 or (a.tien_tu <= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.tien = ''1''))'
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (a.tien_den = 0 or (a.tien_den >= (select data from #key where id = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ') and b.tien = ''1''))'
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @category = rtrim(isnull(b.ma_kieu, '''')) from ctkieuduyet a left join dmkieuduyet b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and b.ma_kieu = a.ma_kieu'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where b.loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and a.status = ''1'' and b.status = ''1''' + @key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt, b.ma_kieu'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@category varchar(33) output', @category OUTPUT

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptPayroll007]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Department0 VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@EmployeeID VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Currency VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT, @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @Round INT, @s AS NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_sp, so_luong, tien, tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM hrluongsp$000000

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'c.'

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.loai = 1'

	IF @Department0 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department0), 'a.', 'b.')
	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmployeeID <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(stt_rec, '''', '') FROM hrnv WHERE ma_nv = @EmployeeID
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and r.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	END

	--
	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	IF @Currency <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'r.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''')), 'a.', 'z.')
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @JoinUnit = 1 OR @JoinDept = 1 OR (@Department0 + @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on r.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp'
	IF @JoinEmp = 1 OR (@EmpGroup1 + @EmpGroup2 + @EmpGroup3 <> '') SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrnv c with(nolock) on c.stt_rec = r.stt_rec'
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp z with(nolock) on r.ma_bp = z.ma_bp'

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp0, r.ma_sp, sum(r.so_luong), sum(r.tien), sum(r.tien_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrluongsp$%Partition r with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key + '' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by r.stt_rec, r.ma_bp0, r.ma_sp'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$PayrollExecute @q, @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, NULL, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, NULL, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_sp, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong
			, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS gia_nt
		INTO #report FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_sp

	UPDATE #report SET gia = CASE WHEN so_luong <> 0 THEN ROUND(tien/so_luong, @Round) ELSE 0 END, gia_nt = CASE WHEN so_luong <> 0 THEN ROUND(tien_nt/so_luong, @Round) ELSE 0 END
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, stt_rec, '', '', SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0 FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp INTO #o FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ma_bp, a.ma_sp, b.stt, b.ma_nv, c.stt_ref ORDER BY b.stt, b.ma_nv, c.stt_ref, a.ma_sp

	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id, stt_sx = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(id) AS id INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #report SET stt = a.stt - b.id FROM #report a JOIN #g b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_bp, MIN(stt) AS stt INTO #g2 FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_bp

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), 0, 0 FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 4
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

	-- Result
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, CASE WHEN a.sysorder = 4 OR a.sysorder = 6 THEN 0 ELSE a.stt END AS stt, a.ma_sp, a.stt_sx
			, ISNULL(c.bp_ref, ' ') AS ma_bp, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt
			, ISNULL(REPLICATE('0', 5 - LEN(b.stt)) + RTRIM(b.stt) + SPACE(1) + b.ma_nv, ' ') AS ma_nv
			, ISNULL(CASE a.sysorder WHEN 2 THEN @s WHEN 4 THEN RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv ELSE SPACE(3) + CASE WHEN a.stt > g.stt THEN ' ' ELSE CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_bp ELSE c.ten_bp2 END END END, ' ') AS bo_phan
			, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.ten_sp ELSE d.ten_sp2 END, ' ') AS ten_sp
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrnv b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN hrdmsp d ON a.ma_sp = d.ma_sp LEFT JOIN #g2 g ON a.stt_rec = g.stt_rec AND a.ma_bp = g.ma_bp
		ORDER BY a.stt_sx, a.sysorder

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$WT]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_qt_xdc' AND val = '0') RETURN

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d65$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_yc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c87$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_yc = b.stt_rec
	
	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cMRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineMRIDNumber CHAR(3), @cWIIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineWIIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_tt VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cMRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET sl_xuat = sl_xuat + CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, MAX(dyn_yc) AS dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_yc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cMRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND so_luong > sl_xuat)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @MRStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @MRStatus = status FROM i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c87$000000 SET status = @MRStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = @MRStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

SELECT a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.loai_yt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dd_dk, a.sl_tp, a.sl_sx, a.sl_dd_ck0, a.tl_ht, a.sl_dd_ck, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_RMResultInput$AfterUpdate] 
	@ApplicantID CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @vong_max VARCHAR(32), @tt_hs VARCHAR(33), @tt_tn VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @tt_tn = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tt_tiep_nhan'

	SELECT TOP 0 b.stt, b.ma_vong, b.stt AS stt_ut, a.tt_hs, a.datetime2 INTO #res FROM hrrmkqktr a, hrdmvongtd b
	
	INSERT INTO #res SELECT TOP 1 b.stt, a.ma_vong, 1, a.tt_hs, a.datetime2
		FROM hrrmkqktr a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hrdmvongtd b ON a.ma_vong = b.ma_vong
		WHERE a.ma_hs = @ApplicantID 
		ORDER BY b.stt DESC, a.ma_vong DESC, a.datetime2 DESC
	
	INSERT INTO #res SELECT TOP 1 b.stt, a.ma_vong, 2, a.tt_hs, a.datetime2
		FROM hrrmkqpv a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN hrdmvongtd b ON a.ma_vong = b.ma_vong
		WHERE a.ma_hs = @ApplicantID 
		ORDER BY b.stt DESC, a.ma_vong DESC, a.datetime2 DESC

	SELECT TOP 1 @vong_max = ma_vong, @tt_hs = tt_hs FROM #res ORDER BY stt DESC, ma_vong DESC, stt_ut DESC, datetime2 DESC

	IF @tt_hs IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		UPDATE hrrmhs SET ma_tt = @tt_hs WHERE ma_hs = @ApplicantID
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE hrrmhs SET ma_tt = @tt_tn WHERE ma_hs = @ApplicantID
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTSRequisitionClosed]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	SET @MasterTable = 'hrccyccp'
	SET @DetailTable = 'hrccctyccp'
	SET @InquiryTable = 'hriccyccp'
	SET @HisTable = 'hraccyccp'

	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and ' + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') THEN 'status not in (''*'', ''3'')' ELSE 'status <> ''3''' END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''3'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''3'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''3'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'

	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReplaceInvoice]
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @r VARCHAR(32), @tinh_trang_hddt CHAR(1), @refp VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @VoucherIDReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDateReplace SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherNo VARCHAR(32), @VoucherNoReplace VARCHAR(32), @VoucherUnit VARCHAR(32), @provider INT

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, '', '', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherIDReplace = REPLACE(stt_rec0, '''', ''), @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct0, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct0, @VoucherNo = so_ct1 FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherIDReplace = REPLACE(stt_rec_hd, '''', ''), @VoucherNo = so_ct, @code = ma_ct_hd FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
		SELECT @mTable = CASE @code WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' WHEN 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' END
		SELECT @q = 'select @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = @VoucherIDReplace'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@VoucherIDReplace varchar(32), @VoucherDateReplace smalldatetime output, @VoucherNoReplace varchar(32) output'
			, @VoucherIDReplace, @VoucherDateReplace OUTPUT, @VoucherNoReplace OUTPUT
	END
	SELECT @mTable = '', @q = '', @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @Customer = REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112), @refp = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDateReplace, 112)

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD1' SELECT @mTable = 'm21$' + @p, @dTable = 'd21$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @mTable = 'm81$' + @p, @dTable = 'd81$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXC' SELECT @mTable = 'm86$' + @p, @dTable = 'd86$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' SELECT @mTable = 'm26$000000', @dTable = ''

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SELECT @mTable = 'm22$' + @p, @dTable = 'd22$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD4' SELECT @mTable = 'm25$' + @p, @dTable = 'd25$' + @p
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @mTable = 'hddc', @dTable = ''
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD6' SELECT @mTable = 'm42$000000', @dTable = ''
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' SELECT @mTable = 'hdtt', @dTable = ''

	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Provider not support
	IF @TableName <> '' AND @provider <> 8 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 8 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	IF @TableName <> '' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #pBefore(p VARCHAR(6))
		SET @q = 'insert into #pBefore select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + QUOTENAME(@TableName)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #pBefore) > 1 BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 11 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
			EXEC('drop table #pBefore')
			RETURN
		END
		DROP TABLE #pBefore
	END

	-- Check Customer
	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM khhddt WHERE ma_kh = @Customer AND status <> '0') BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @Customer AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Modify Date
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @code = so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	IF @TableName <> ''	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @code = a.so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) > rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), b.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', ''''))'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@code varchar(32) output', @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Lock Date of Original Voucher
	CREATE TABLE #refVCCode(stt_rec VARCHAR(32), ma_ct_hd VARCHAR(3), stt_rec_hd VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct_hd SMALLDATETIME, so_ct_hd VARCHAR(128), so_ct VARCHAR(128), ctable VARCHAR(32), tinh_trang_hddt VARCHAR(32), loai_ct0 VARCHAR(3), loai_ct1 VARCHAR(3))
	IF @TableName <> ''	BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #refVCCode select a.stt_rec1, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.so_ct1, '''', 0, 0, 0 from hddt01 a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec1 = b.[key]'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #refVCCode SET ctable = CASE ma_ct_hd WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' WHEN 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' END
			SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct_hd, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode ORDER BY ngay_ct_hd
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #refVCCode select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct_hd, a.stt_rec_hd, null, '''', a.so_ct, '''', 0, 0, 0 from hdtt a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			UPDATE #refVCCode SET ctable = CASE ma_ct_hd WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' WHEN 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' END

			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #refVCCode set ngay_ct_hd = b.ngay_ct, so_ct_hd = b.so_ct from #refVCCode a join ' + ctable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY ctable
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	IF @TableName <> '' GOTO  _CheckLockDate

	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @VoucherDateReplace, @UserID, @Unit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END
	GOTO _CheckReplacementVoucher

_CheckLockDate:
	SELECT @code = MIN(ma_ct_hd) FROM #refVCCode
	WHILE @code IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherDateReplace = ngay_ct_hd, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode WHERE ma_ct_hd = @code ORDER BY ngay_ct_hd

		TRUNCATE TABLE #lockedDate
		INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @code, @VoucherDateReplace, @UserID, @Unit, 1
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @code = MIN(ma_ct_hd) FROM #refVCCode WHERE ma_ct_hd > @code
	END

_CheckReplacementVoucher:
	-- Check Replacement Voucher
	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	IF @TableName = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @tinh_trang_hddt = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hddt00$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tinh_trang_hddt char(1) output', @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

		IF (@tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '0') AND @provider <> 3 BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT  @VoucherNo = ''
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @VoucherNo = a.so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' a with(nolock) join hddt00$' + @p + ' b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.tinh_trang_hddt <> ''0'' and exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' c where a.stt_rec = c.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherNo varchar(128) output', @VoucherNo OUTPUT

		IF ISNULL(@VoucherNo, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--

	SELECT @tinh_trang_hddt = NULL
	IF @TableName = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @tinh_trang_hddt = isnull(tinh_trang_hddt, '''') from hddt00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @VoucherDateReplace, 112) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherIDReplace + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@tinh_trang_hddt char(1) output', @tinh_trang_hddt OUTPUT

		IF @tinh_trang_hddt IS NULL OR @tinh_trang_hddt <> '2' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 6 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '', @VoucherNoReplace = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #refVCCode set tinh_trang_hddt = b.tinh_trang_hddt from #refVCCode a join hddt00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112) + ' b on a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 1 @tinh_trang_hddt = tinh_trang_hddt, @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode WHERE tinh_trang_hddt <> '2'
		IF ISNULL(@VoucherNoReplace, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 6 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END


	-- Check Payment of Original Voucher
	IF @TableName <> '' GOTO _CheckPaymentOriginalVoucher
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD6') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@VoucherIDReplace, 10) + '%')) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXC', 'PXD') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt30 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@VoucherIDReplace, 10) + '%')) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec_tt = @VoucherIDReplace) BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
		RETURN
	END
	GOTO _CheckFlow

_CheckPaymentOriginalVoucher:
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD6') BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 b WHERE b.loai_tt = 1 AND b.stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(a.stt_rec_hd, 10) + '%'))
		IF ISNULL(@VoucherNoReplace, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PXC', 'PXD') BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt30 b WHERE b.loai_tt = 1 AND b.stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(a.stt_rec_hd, 10) + '%'))
		IF ISNULL(@VoucherNoReplace, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherNoReplace = so_ct_hd FROM #refVCCode a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 b WHERE b.stt_rec_tt = a.stt_rec_hd)
		IF ISNULL(@VoucherNoReplace, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 7 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

_CheckFlow:
	-- Check Flow
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' BEGIN
		IF @TableName <> '' GOTO _CheckFlowMultiVoucher

		DECLARE @checkStatus BIT
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec0 = @VoucherIDReplace AND cn_qui_trinh = 1) BEGIN
			SET @q = 'if exists(select top 1 1 from d81$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec1 and (stt_rec_dh <> '''' or stt_rec_px <> '''')) set @checkStatus = 1 else set @checkStatus = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec1 char(13), @checkStatus bit out', @VoucherID, @checkStatus OUT
			IF @checkStatus = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 8 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END

			SET @q = 'if (select loai_ct from m81$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec0) <> (select loai_ct from m81$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec1) set @checkStatus = 1 else set @checkStatus = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec0 char(13), @stt_rec1 char(13), @checkStatus bit out', @VoucherIDReplace, @VoucherID, @checkStatus out
			IF @checkStatus = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 9 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END

		SET @q = 'if exists(select top 1 1 from d81$' + @refp + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec and sl_xuat <> 0) set @checkStatus = 1 else set @checkStatus = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec char(13), @checkStatus bit out', @VoucherIDReplace, @checkStatus OUT
		IF @checkStatus = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 10 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
		GOTO _EndCheck

_CheckFlowMultiVoucher:
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hddt01 a JOIN #refVCCode b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec_hd WHERE a.cn_qui_trinh = 1) BEGIN
			SET @q = 'select top 1 @VoucherNo = a.so_ct from d81$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where (a.stt_rec_dh <> '''' or a.stt_rec_px <> '''')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherNo varchar(128) output', @VoucherNo OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@VoucherNo, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 8 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #refVCCode set loai_ct0 = b.loai_ct from #refVCCode a join m81$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112) + ' b on a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112)
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #refVCCode set loai_ct1 = b.loai_ct from #refVCCode a join m81$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec;'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT TOP 1 @VoucherNo = so_ct FROM #refVCCode WHERE loai_ct0 <> loai_ct1
			IF ISNULL(@VoucherNo, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 9 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @q = 'select top 0 so_ct into #vcNo from #refVCCode '
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #vcNo select top 1 a.so_ct from d81$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112) + ' a join #refVCCode b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd where a.sl_xuat <> 0;' FROM #refVCCode GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct_hd, 112)
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 @VoucherNo = so_ct from #vcNo'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherNo varchar(128) output', @VoucherNo OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@VoucherNo, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 10 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' BEGIN
		IF @TableName <> '' GOTO _CheckFlowMultiVoucherHD7

		IF ISNULL(@VoucherIDReplace, '') = '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec <> @VoucherID AND stt_rec_hd = @VoucherID) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 8 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hdtt a WHERE stt_rec <> @VoucherID AND stt_rec_hd = @VoucherIDReplace) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 10 AS typecheck, @VoucherNoReplace AS val
			RETURN
		END
		GOTO _EndCheck

_CheckFlowMultiVoucherHD7:
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #refVCCode WHERE ISNULL(stt_rec_hd, '') = '') BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 5 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hdtt a JOIN #refVCCode b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec <> b.stt_rec) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 8 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hdtt a JOIN #refVCCode b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd WHERE a.stt_rec <> b.stt_rec) BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 10 AS typecheck, @VoucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

_EndCheck:
	--
	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	IF @TableName <> '' SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--

	IF @TableName = '' BEGIN
		DELETE hddt02 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherIDReplace
		INSERT INTO hddt02(stt_rec, kieu_xl) SELECT @VoucherIDReplace, SUBSTRING(@Extension, 5, 1)
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE hddt02 FROM hddt02 a JOIN #refVCCode b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd
		INSERT INTO hddt02(stt_rec, kieu_xl) SELECT stt_rec_hd, SUBSTRING(@Extension, 5, 1) FROM #refVCCode
	END

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignKey]
	@voucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@partition VARCHAR(32),
	@type VARCHAR(32), -- 0. Voucher, 2. Report
	@profile VARCHAR(8000) OUTPUT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @voucherID = REPLACE(@voucherID, '''', ''), @voucherCode = REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', ''), @partition = REPLACE(@partition, '''', ''), @profile = REPLACE(ISNULL(@profile, ''), '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c NVARCHAR(4000), @k NVARCHAR(4000), @j NVARCHAR(4000), @i bit, @m VARCHAR(32), @d VARCHAR(32), @d$Edit VARCHAR(32), @site_yn TINYINT, @acc_yn TINYINT, @dept_yn TINYINT, @book_yn TINYINT, @unit_yn TINYINT, @type_yn TINYINT, @code_yn TINYINT

	SELECT @q = '', @c = '', @k = '', @j = '', @site_yn = 0, @acc_yn = 0, @dept_yn = 0, @book_yn = 0, @unit_yn = 0, @type_yn = 0, @code_yn = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_ttck, a.stt_rec0, a.para_value, b.ma_loai, b.muc_do, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #dmttck FROM dmttckct a, dmttckloai b

	IF ISNULL(@type, '') = '0' BEGIN
		SELECT @m = RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @d = RTRIM(d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(d$, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END
				, @dept_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_bp' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @acc_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'tk' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @site_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_kho' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(d$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @book_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_nk' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @unit_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_dvcs' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @type_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai_ct' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				, @code_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_ct' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
			FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

		SELECT @q = 'select @d$Edit = rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) from ' + @m + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @d$Edit varchar(32) output', @voucherID, @d$Edit OUTPUT

		SELECT SUM(CAST(ma_dvcs AS INT)) AS ma_dvcs, SUM(CAST(ma_ct AS INT)) AS ma_ct, SUM(CAST(loai_ct AS INT)) AS loai_ct, SUM(CAST(nh_kho AS INT)) AS nh_kho, SUM(CAST(ma_kho AS INT)) AS ma_kho, SUM(CAST(ma_bp AS INT)) AS ma_bp, SUM(CAST(tk AS INT)) AS tk, SUM(CAST(ma_nk AS INT)) AS ma_nk, SUM(CAST(user_yn AS INT)) AS user_yn INTO #dmttckloai FROM dmttckloai WHERE [status] = '1'
		IF @voucherCode IN ('PNF','PNI','PXB','PXI') SELECT @site_yn = 2
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #dmttck
	select s.ma_ttck, s.stt_rec0, s.para_value%l, s.ma_loai, s.muc_do, 0
	from ' + @d + ' d
		left join ' + @m + ' m on d.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'
			+ CASE @site_yn
				WHEN 1 THEN ' left join dmkho w on d.ma_kho = w.ma_kho'
				WHEN 2 THEN ' left join dmkho w on m.ma_kho = w.ma_kho'
			ELSE '' END + '
		left join (select distinct a.ma_ttck, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_loai, a.para_value%l, a.status, b.muc_do
				, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nh_kho, a.ma_kho, a.ma_bp, a.tk, a.ma_nk, a.[user_id]
				, b.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs_yn, b.ma_ct as ma_ct_yn, b.loai_ct as loai_ct_yn, b.nh_kho as nh_kho_yn
				, b.ma_kho as ma_kho_yn, b.ma_bp as ma_bp_yn, b.tk as tk_yn, b.ma_nk as ma_nk_yn, b.user_yn from dmttckct a left join dmttckloai b on a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck and a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai) s
			on '
				+ CASE @code_yn WHEN 1 THEN '(m.ma_ct = s.ma_ct or s.ma_ct = '''')' ELSE '(s.ma_ct = ''' + @voucherCode + ''' or s.ma_ct = '''')' END
				+ CASE @dept_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.ma_bp = s.ma_bp or s.ma_bp = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.ma_bp = '''')' END
				+ CASE @acc_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.tk = s.tk or s.tk = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.tk = '''')' END
				+ CASE @book_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.ma_nk = s.ma_nk or s.ma_nk = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.ma_nk = '''')' END
				+ CASE @site_yn
						WHEN 1 THEN ' and (w.ma_nh = s.nh_kho or s.nh_kho = '''') and (d.ma_kho = s.ma_kho or s.ma_kho = '''')'
						WHEN 2 THEN ' and (w.ma_nh = s.nh_kho or s.nh_kho = '''') and (m.ma_kho = s.ma_kho or s.ma_kho = '''')'
					ELSE ' and (s.nh_kho = '''') and (s.ma_kho = '''')' END
				+ CASE @unit_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.ma_dvcs = s.ma_dvcs or s.ma_dvcs = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.ma_dvcs = '''')' END
				+ CASE @type_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and(m.loai_ct = s.loai_ct or s.loai_ct = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.loai_ct = '''')' END
				+ '
	where d.stt_rec = @voucherID and s.[status] = ''1'' and (s.ma_dvcs_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_ct_yn = ''1'' or s.loai_ct_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_bp_yn = ''1'' or s.tk_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_nk_yn = ''1'' or (s.user_yn = ''1'' and s.[user_id] = @userID)' + CASE WHEN @site_yn <> 0 THEN 'or s.nh_kho_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_kho_yn = ''1''' ELSE '' END + ')'
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @userID int', @voucherID, @userID
	END

	IF ISNULL(@type, '') = '2' AND OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#signKey') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #dmttck
			SELECT a.ma_ttck, a.stt_rec0, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN a.para_value ELSE a.para_value2 END, b.ma_loai, b.muc_do, 0
			FROM dmttckct a
				LEFT JOIN dmttckloai b ON a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck AND a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai
				LEFT JOIN #signKey c ON (c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs OR b.ma_dvcs <> '1') AND (c.ma_ct = a.ma_ct OR b.ma_ct <> '1') AND (c.loai_ct = a.loai_ct OR b.loai_ct <> '1') AND (c.nh_kho = a.nh_kho OR b.nh_kho <> '1') AND (c.ma_kho = a.ma_kho OR b.ma_kho <> '1') AND (c.ma_bp = a.ma_bp OR b.ma_bp <> '1') AND (c.tk = a.tk OR b.tk <> '1') AND (c.ma_nk = a.ma_nk OR b.ma_nk <> '1') AND (c.[user_id] = @userID OR b.user_yn <> '1')
			WHERE a.[status] = '1' AND c.ma_dvcs IS NOT NULL AND c.ma_ct IS NOT NULL AND c.loai_ct IS NOT NULL AND c.nh_kho IS NOT NULL AND c.ma_kho IS NOT NULL AND c.ma_bp IS NOT NULL AND c.tk IS NOT NULL AND c.ma_nk IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY a.ma_ttck, b.muc_do, b.ma_loai
	END

	DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmttck b WHERE b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND b.[status] = '1')
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_ttck, MIN(muc_do) AS muc_do INTO #dmttcklvl FROM #dmttck GROUP BY ma_ttck
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttcklvl) DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttcklvl b WHERE b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND b.muc_do <> a.muc_do)

		SELECT ma_ttck, para_value INTO #dmttck2 FROM #dmttck GROUP BY ma_ttck, para_value
		DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck2 b WHERE b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck GROUP BY ma_ttck HAVING COUNT(para_value) > 1)

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_ttck', 'ma_ttck, muc_do, ma_loai, stt_rec0', '#dmttck', 'stt', ''
		DELETE #dmttck WHERE stt <> 1
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_creator' AND val NOT IN ('0', '3')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck WHERE ma_ttck = '90000') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck (ma_ttck, stt_rec0, ma_loai) select ''90000'', '''', rtrim(val) from options s where name = ''r_show_creator'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_date_sign' AND val <> '0') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck WHERE ma_ttck = '95000') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck (ma_ttck, stt_rec0, ma_loai) select ''95000'', '''', rtrim(val) from options s where name = ''r_show_date_sign'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_contact' AND val <> '0') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck WHERE ma_ttck = '85000') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck (ma_ttck, stt_rec0, ma_loai) select ''85000'', '''', rtrim(val) from options s where name = ''r_show_contact'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	SELECT @c = @c + CASE WHEN @c <> '' THEN CHAR(253) ELSE '' END + RTRIM(ma_ttck) + ':' + RTRIM(stt_rec0) + ':' + RTRIM(ma_loai) FROM #dmttck

	--SELECT @profile = RTRIM(@profile) + CASE WHEN @c <> '' THEN CHAR(255) ELSE '' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(@c)) + CHAR(255) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@voucherID)) + CHAR(253) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@voucherCode)) + CHAR(253) + RTRIM(ISNULL(@d$Edit, ''))
	SELECT @profile = RTRIM(@profile) + CHAR(255) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@c)) + CHAR(255) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@voucherID)) + CHAR(253) + LTRIM(RTRIM(@voucherCode)) + CHAR(253) + RTRIM(ISNULL(@d$Edit, ''))

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIPurchaseReportByObjects] -- fs_PORecvAmtByCust
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Supplier AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SupplierGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SupplierGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@SupplierGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@GroupBy INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	CREATE TABLE #rpt(name VARCHAR(64), ref VARCHAR(4000), value NVARCHAR(4000))
	DECLARE @queryStatement NVARCHAR(4000), @returnStatement NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(1024), @refField VARCHAR(2)

	SELECT @refField = CASE @GroupBy
		WHEN 0 THEN 'hd'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'kh'
		WHEN 2 THEN 'nx'
		WHEN 3 THEN 'vv'
		WHEN 4 THEN 'du'
	END

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'int', 'm_round_gia'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'int', 'm_round_gia_nt'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'char(3)', 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Query
	DECLARE @p VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @p = CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 4 THEN REPLACE('a.ma_' + @refField, 'ma_du', 'tk_du') ELSE 'a.ma_' + @refField END
	SELECT @p = @p + CASE WHEN @GroupBy in ('1', '3') THEN ', b.nh_' + @refField + '1, b.nh_' + @refField + '2, b.nh_' + @refField + '3' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @p = @p + ', a.ma_nt, a.sl_nhap as so_luong'
	SELECT @p = @p + CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', gia, gia_nt' ELSE ', gia1 as gia, gia_nt1 as gia_nt' END
	SELECT @p = @p + ', a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryField', '', @p
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Customer', @Supplier
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'CustomerGroup1', @SupplierGroup1
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'CustomerGroup2', @SupplierGroup2
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'CustomerGroup3', @SupplierGroup3
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Item', @Item
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup1', @ItemGroup1
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup2', @ItemGroup2
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup3', @ItemGroup3
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Transaction', @TransactionCode
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Job', @Job
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Department', @Department
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Contract', @Contract

	SELECT @p = 'left join dm' + @refField + ' b on a.ma_' + @refField + ' = b.ma_' + @refField
	SELECT @p = CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 4 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@p, 'a.ma_du', 'a.tk_du'), 'dmdu', 'dmtk'), 'b.ma_du', 'b.tk') ELSE @p END
	SELECT @p = @p + ' left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryJoin', '', @p
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'TransactionKey', @VoucherCode, @TransactionList

	SELECT @p = REPLACE('(a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''') and a.ma_' + @refField + ' <> ''''', 'ma_du', 'tk_du')
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', @p
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', 'a.ct_dc <> 1'
	SET @queryStatement = 'update #report set ma_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then @m_ma_nt0 else ma_nt end, gia = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien / so_luong, @m_round_gia) end, gia_nt = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien_nt / so_luong, @m_round_gia_nt) end'

	-- Process
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'OrderDetail', '', REPLACE('ma_' + @refField, 'ma_du', 'tk_du')
	DECLARE @groupData VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @groupData = CASE WHEN @GroupBy IN ('1', '3')
		THEN 'ma_' + @refField + ', max(nh_' + @refField + '1), max(nh_' + @refField + '2), max(nh_' + @refField + '3)'
		ELSE REPLACE('ma_' + @refField, 'ma_du', 'tk_du')
		END + ', max(ma_nt), sum(so_luong), max(gia), max(gia_nt), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), max(gia0), max(gia_nt0), sum(tien0), sum(tien_nt0), sum(cp), sum(cp_nt), sum(nk), sum(nk_nt), sum(thue), sum(thue_nt)'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupData', REPLACE('ma_' + @refField, 'ma_du', 'tk_du'), @groupData

	IF ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Groups = REPLACE(@Groups, 'om', '_' + @refField)
		INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupRow' + CASE WHEN RIGHT(data, 1) = 1 THEN '' ELSE RIGHT(data, 1) END, 'select ma_nh as ' + data + ', ten_nh%l as group_name from dmnh' + @refField + ' where loai_nh = ''' + right(data, 1)  + '''', data
			FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Groups, ',')
	END

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupTotal', '', 'group_name'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupFunction', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, nk, nk_nt, thue, thue_nt', 'sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), sum(tien0), sum(tien_nt0), sum(cp), sum(cp_nt), sum(nk), sum(nk_nt), sum(thue), sum(thue_nt)'

	-- Return
	SET @returnStatement = 'declare @nMa_nt int; select @nMa_nt = count(*) from (select ma_nt from #report where systotal = 1 group by ma_nt having ma_nt <> '''') a'

	SELECT @p = 'left join dm' + @refField + ' b on a.ma_' + @refField + ' = b.ma_' + @refField
	SELECT @p = CASE WHEN @GroupBy = 4 THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@p, 'a.ma_du', 'a.tk_du'), 'dmdu', 'dmtk'), 'b.ma_du', 'b.tk') ELSE @p END
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnJoin', '', @p
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnField', '', 'sysorder, sysprint, systotal, order_detail as stt, ' + REPLACE('a.ma_' + @refField, 'ma_du', 'tk_du') + ' as ma'
		+ CASE WHEN @Groups <> '' THEN ', space(sysorder) + isnull(a.group_name, ten_' + REPLACE(@refField, 'du', 'tk') + ') as ten, space(sysorder) + isnull(a.group_name, ten_' + REPLACE(@refField, 'du', 'tk') + '2) as ten2' ELSE ', isnull(a.group_name, ten_' + REPLACE(@refField, 'du', 'tk') + ') as ten, isnull(a.group_name, ten_' + REPLACE(@refField, 'du', 'tk') + '2) as ten2' END
		+ ', a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien end as tien
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else  a.tien_nt end as tien_nt
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien0 end as tien0
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien_nt0 end as tien_nt0
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.cp end as cp
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.cp_nt end as cp_nt
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.nk end as nk
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.nk_nt end as nk_nt
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.thue end as thue
		, case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.thue_nt end as thue_nt'

	UPDATE #$query SET filterkey = REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'c')
	-- End
	EXEC bs_rptGetReportData 'r90$%Partition', 1, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @InvoiceFrom, @InvoiceTo, @Unit, @Site, @PurOrgCode, @PurGrCode, @PlantCode, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB
		, default, default, default, 1, default, 1, default, 1, @queryStatement, @returnStatement, default, @TableName, @DataType

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$InputInvoiceTax$UpdateError]
	@ID VARCHAR(16),
	@TaxCode VARCHAR(18),
	@MST VARCHAR(18),
	@Form VARCHAR(32),
	@Serial VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@UserID INT,
	@NotError BIT = 0,
	@ErrorLog NVARCHAR(512) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT @TaxCode = REPLACE(@TaxCode, '''', ''), @MST = REPLACE(@MST, '''', ''), @Form = REPLACE(@Form, '''', ''), @Serial = REPLACE(@Serial, '''', ''), @InvoiceNumber = REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', ''), @ErrorLog = REPLACE(@ErrorLog, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @ErrorCount TINYINT

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'tax_code = ''' + @TaxCode + ''' and mst = ''' + @MST + ''' and mau_so = ''' + @Form + ''' and ky_hieu = ''' + @Serial + ''' and ltrim(rtrim(so_hd)) = ltrim(rtrim(''' + @InvoiceNumber + ''')) and ngay_hd = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @InvoiceDate, 112) + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @NotError = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update t15$%Partition set error_count = 0, error_log = ''''  where %[' +  @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_hd', @InvoiceDate, @InvoiceDate, @UserID, 1
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @ErrorCount = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tax_error_count'

	SELECT @q = 'update t15$%Partition set error_count = error_count + 1, error_log = N''' + @ErrorLog + ''' where %[' +  @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_hd', @InvoiceDate, @InvoiceDate, @UserID, 1
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTransactionListByJob]  -- fs_TransAcctsList
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@AccountList VARCHAR(32),
	@AccountType CHAR(1),
	@ReferenceAccountList VARCHAR(1024),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer  VARCHAR(32),
	@Department  VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract  VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@ForeignCurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Description NVARCHAR(128),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Code1 VARCHAR(32), @Code2 VARCHAR(32), @Name VARCHAR(32), @Name2 VARCHAR(32), @Table CHAR(16)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @Code1 = RTRIM(fcode1), @Code2 = RTRIM(fcode2), @Name = RTRIM(fname1), @Name2 = RTRIM(fname2), @Table = RTRIM(ftable) FROM glreptype WHERE ftype = @Type


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct
				, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai, a.ma_vv
				, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co
				, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkgl a
		LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and isnull(a.ma_vv, '''') <> '''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Description <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.dien_giai like N''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Description), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @AccountType = '1' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ps_no <> 0'
	IF @AccountType = '2' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ps_co <> 0'
	IF @AccountList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @AccountList)
	IF @ReferenceAccountList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @ReferenceAccountList)
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1)'
	IF @ForeignCurrencyCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ForeignCurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey
	--
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv c on a.ma_vv = c.ma_vv'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vv'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, dien_giai)
		SELECT 0, 1, 0, a.ma_vv, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt)
				, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_vv), '') ELSE ISNULL(MAX(b.ten_vv2), '') END + ' - ' + RTRIM(a.ma_vv)
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
			GROUP BY a.ma_vv

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		ORDER BY ma_vv, sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray]
	@jsonString NVARCHAR(4000), /*

format: [[x1, y1, z1], [x2, y2, z2],...]
=> table(int, x varchar, y numeric, z smalldatetime)

*/
	@table VARCHAR(64),
	@insertField VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @c1 CHAR(1), @c2 CHAR(1), @c3 CHAR(1), @i INT, @j INT, @c INT, @m INT, @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c1 = CHAR(251), @c2 = CHAR(15), @c3 = CHAR(252)

	SET @jsonString = REPLACE(@jsonString, '\"', @c1)

	SELECT @i = CHARINDEX('"', @jsonString), @c = 0
	WHILE @i > 0 AND @i <= LEN(@jsonString) BEGIN	
		SET @c = @c + 1
		IF @c % 2 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @j = CHARINDEX('"', @jsonString, @i + 1)
			SELECT @s = SUBSTRING(@jsonString, @i, @j - @i), @s = REPLACE(@s, ',', @c2), @jsonString = SUBSTRING(@jsonString, 0, @i) + @s + SUBSTRING(@jsonString, @j, LEN(@jsonString))
		END 
		SET @i = CHARINDEX('"', @jsonString, @i + 1)
	END
	SELECT @jsonString = SUBSTRING(@jsonString, 3, LEN(@jsonString) - 4), @jsonString = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@jsonString, '''', ''''''), '],[', @c3), '"', '''')

	SELECT * INTO #j1 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@jsonString, @c3)
	SELECT @i = 1, @m = MAX(id) FROM #j1
	WHILE @i <= @m BEGIN
		SELECT @s = REPLACE(data, ',''', ',N'''), @s = REPLACE(@s, @c1, '"'), @s = REPLACE(@s, @c2, ',') FROM #j1 WHERE id = @i
		SET @q = 'insert into ' + @table + CASE WHEN @insertField <> '' THEN '(' + @insertField + ')' ELSE '' END +
			' select ' + LTRIM(@i) + ',' + REPLACE(@s, @c1, '"')
		
		IF @debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCustomerTForm] 
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s32 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @CustomerKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmtk b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_tk, ten_tk2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @CustomerKey = ' a.ma_kh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @CustomerKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(tk))'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5 , 1 , 1, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt)
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_tk2) ELSE '' END
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk GROUP BY tk_du

	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = cname, @s22 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = cname, @s32 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'CLBAL'
	
	CREATE TABLE #t (du NUMERIC(28, 6), du_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, '', 1, 1, @UserID, @Admin, '', @CustomerKey

	SELECT @nDu_dk = du, @nDu_dk_nt = du_nt FROM #t
	DROP TABLE #t
	
	IF @nDu_dk IS NULL SET @nDu_dk = 0
	IF @nDu_dk_nt IS NULL SET @nDu_dk_nt = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	IF @nPs_no IS NULL SET @nPs_no = 0
	IF @nPs_co IS NULL SET @nPs_co = 0
	IF @nPs_no_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_no_nt = 0
	IF @nPs_co_nt IS NULL SET @nPs_co_nt = 0

	SET @nDu_ck = @nDu_dk + @nPs_no - @nPs_co
	SET @nDu_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt + @nPs_no_nt - @nPs_co_nt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (0, 0, 0, @s1, @s12, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_dk_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
			)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (1, 0, 0, @s2, @s22, @nPs_no, @nPs_no_nt, @nPs_co, @nPs_co_nt)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) 
		VALUES (2, 0, 0, @s3, @s32, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt >= 0 THEN @nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck ELSE 0 END, 
			CASE WHEN @nDu_ck_nt < 0 THEN -@nDu_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
			)
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) VALUES (3, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0)

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, tk_du
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcndnlt]
AS
	SELECT *, CASE WHEN nam = 0 THEN N'Tất cả' ELSE RTRIM(nam) END AS luu_tru, CASE WHEN nam = 0 THEN N'All' ELSE RTRIM(nam) END AS luu_tru2 FROM dbo.cndnlt

GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintT2Tran]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_ns, a.tn_ct, a.tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tien_gt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt, thue_nt, thue'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_ns' + @cE + ' AS ten_ns'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' phns g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ns = g.ma_ns'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 11, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_ns, ten_ns'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2CardExport]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@code VARCHAR(4000),
	@dept VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @keyDept NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @q = '', @key = '', @keyDept = ''
	
	IF @code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @code <> '' THEN 'a.ma_dc in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@code, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.ma_dc) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	IF @dept <> '' SET @keyDept = ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@dept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(int, 1,1) AS stt, stt_rec0, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, dien_giai 
		INTO #dcct FROM dmdcct

	SET @q = 'insert into #dcct
		select a.stt_rec0, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai
			from dmdcct a with(nolock)
			where ' + @key + @keyDept
	EXEC sp_executesql @q		

	-- Giảm pb
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(int, 1,1) AS stt, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, ngay_ct AS ngay_giam, so_ct AS so_ct_giam, dien_giai AS ly_do_giam, dien_giai AS ly_do_giam2 INTO #decrease
		FROM gpbdc a
					
	SET @q = 'insert into #decrease
		select a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_dc, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.ten_tg_ts, b.ten_tg_ts2
			from gpbdc a with(nolock)
			left join dmtgcc b with(nolock) on a.ma_ld_giam = b.ma_tg_ts
			where ' + @key + @keyDept
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Master
	SELECT a.ma_dc AS xgroup, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.nuoc_sx, a.nam_sx, b.ma_bp_dc AS ma_bp, c.ten_bp, c.ten_bp2, a.ts_kt, a.so_hieu_dc, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_dc, a.ly_do_dc, d.ngay_giam, ISNULL(d.so_ct_giam, '') AS so_ct_giam, d.ly_do_giam, d.ly_do_giam2
		INTO #master FROM dmccdc a 
			JOIN #dcct b ON b.stt =(SELECT TOP 1 stt FROM #dcct WHERE ma_dc = a.ma_dc)
			LEFT JOIN dmbpcc c ON b.ma_bp_dc = c.ma_bp 
			LEFT JOIN #decrease d ON d.stt =(SELECT TOP 1 stt FROM #decrease WHERE ma_dc = a.ma_dc AND ma_bp_dc = b.ma_bp_dc)
	
	
	-- Chi tiết cddc
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc, nam, ky, nam AS nam_ng, ky AS ky_ng, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt, ng_giam, ng_giam_nt, cl_giam, cl_giam_nt
		INTO #ctcddc FROM ctcddc
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #ctcddc
		select ma_dc, nam, ky, nam AS nam_ng, ky AS ky_ng, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_pb, gt_da_pb_nt, gt_pb_ky, gt_pb_ky_nt, isnull(ng_giam, 0), ng_giam_nt, isnull(cl_giam, 0), cl_giam_nt
			from ctcddc a with(nolock)
			where ' + @key + @keyDept + ' and nam * 12 + ky <= ' + RTRIM(@year * 12 + @period)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Nguyen gia
	SELECT a.ma_dc, SUM(a.nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt		
		INTO #nguyengia
		FROM (SELECT ma_dc, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt FROM #ctcddc WHERE ky_ng = @period AND nam_ng = @year				
				UNION ALL (SELECT ma_dc, ng_giam, ng_giam_nt FROM #ctcddc)) a
		GROUP BY a.ma_dc 		
		
	SELECT ma_dc, nam, MAX(ky) AS ky INTO #tP FROM #ctcddc GROUP BY ma_dc, nam
	
	SELECT ma_dc, nam, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_pb) AS gt_da_pb, SUM(gt_da_pb_nt) AS gt_da_pb_nt
		INTO #tValue FROM #ctcddc
		WHERE ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(nam, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT ma_dc + REPLACE(STR(nam, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ky, 2), ' ', '0') FROM #tP)
		GROUP BY ma_dc, nam					
			
	-- Detail 1	
	SELECT ma_dc, nam, SUM(ng_giam) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(ng_giam_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
		, SUM(gt_pb_ky) + SUM(cl_giam) AS gt_pb_nam, SUM(gt_pb_ky_nt) + SUM(cl_giam_nt) AS gt_pb_nam_nt
		, SUM(ng_giam) AS gt_pb_lk, SUM(ng_giam_nt) AS gt_pb_lk_nt  
		INTO #t FROM #ctcddc GROUP BY ma_dc, nam
		
	UPDATE #t SET nguyen_gia = a.nguyen_gia + ISNULL(b.nguyen_gia, 0), nguyen_gia_nt = a.nguyen_gia_nt + ISNULL(b.nguyen_gia_nt, 0)
			, gt_pb_lk = a.gt_pb_lk + ISNULL(b.gt_da_pb, 0), gt_pb_lk_nt = a.gt_pb_lk_nt + ISNULL(b.gt_da_pb_nt, 0)
		FROM #t a LEFT JOIN #tValue b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.nam = b.nam
	
	SELECT b.ma_dc AS xgroup, b.ma_dc, b.so_ct, b.ngay_ct, c.nguyen_gia, c.nguyen_gia_nt, b.dien_giai
			, a.nam, a.gt_pb_nam, a.gt_pb_nam_nt, a.gt_pb_lk, a.gt_pb_lk_nt
		INTO #detail1 FROM #t a 
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_dc, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(dien_giai) AS dien_giai 
				FROM #dcct GROUP BY ma_dc) b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc 
			LEFT JOIN #nguyengia c ON a.ma_dc = c.ma_dc
			
	-- Detail 2
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc AS xgroup, ma_dc, line_nbr, ten_pt AS ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_nt
		INTO #detail2 FROM dmdcpt
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail2
		select a.ma_dc, a.ma_dc, a.line_nbr, a.ten_pt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_tri, a.gia_tri_nt, b.ma_nt
			from dmdcpt a with(nolock)
			left join dmccdc b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
			where ' + @key + @keyDept

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	UPDATE #detail2 SET gia_tri_nt = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = (select RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0')
	
	-- empty
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_dc INTO #empty FROM #master
	
	INSERT INTO #detail1(xgroup, ma_dc, nam) SELECT ma_dc, '', 0 FROM #empty WHERE ma_dc NOT IN (SELECT ma_dc FROM #detail1)
	INSERT INTO #detail2(xgroup, ma_dc) SELECT ma_dc, '' FROM #empty WHERE ma_dc NOT IN (SELECT ma_dc FROM #detail2)
	
	SELECT * FROM #master
	SELECT * FROM #detail1 ORDER BY nam, ngay_ct, so_ct
	SELECT * FROM #detail2 ORDER BY line_nbr
	
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTheDetailOfSIHIUIPremium]
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @IDNumber VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	DECLARE @so_thang_nvtd INT, @ds_loai_tdbh VARCHAR(512), @Round INT, @dau_ky NVARCHAR(128), @ps_tang NVARCHAR(128), @ps_giam NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @Date VARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @ma_nv VARCHAR(33), @id INT

	SELECT @ds_loai_tdbh = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_si_ds_ltd_g'
	SELECT @so_thang_nvtd = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hr_so_thang_nvtd'
	SELECT @Date = (REPLACE(STR(RTRIM(@Year), 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(RTRIM(@Month), 2), ' ', '0') + '01')
	SELECT @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'

	SELECT @dau_ky = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM069'
	SELECT @ps_tang = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM070'
	SELECT @ps_giam = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM071'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS stt, 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS sysprint, v.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv, v.bo_phan, bp_ref,
		b.si_no, nam, ky, ky_sau_yn, ngay_tu AS ngay_thay_doi, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(8)) AS ma_loai_td, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_loai_td, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS type,
		-- tỷ lệ bh
		a.tl_xh_tang, a.tl_yt_tang, a.tl_tn_tang, a.tl_xh_giam, a.tl_yt_giam, a.tl_tn_giam,
		-- Lương bh
