	update #master set t_tien = t_tien - tien from #master a join (select [key], sum(tien) as tien from #detail where loai = ''07'' group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]
	update #detail set dvt = '''', thue_suat = ''-9'', xu_ly = @processType07 where loai = ''07''
end
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@descriptGoodsType nvarchar(4000), @Language varchar(1), @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10), @fAmount varchar(256), @fAmountFC varchar(256), @processType varchar(2), @processType07 varchar(2)', @descriptGoodsType, @Language, @m_ma_nt0, @fAmount, @fAmountFC, @processType, @processType07
	END

	-- External script
	IF RTRIM(@script) <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @script = REPLACE(@script, '%language', @Language)
		EXEC sp_executesql @script
	END

	-- Discount
	IF @isDiscount = 1 AND @discountType <> '0' BEGIN
		IF @discountType = 2 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'select top 0 t_thue as t_thue5, t_thue as t_thue10 from m81$000000', @isTotalDiscount = 1
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#master', @q
		END

		EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$DiscountDetailTax @isFc, @discountType, @language, @provider
	END

	IF @provider = 8 AND @isDiscount = 1 AND ISNULL(@isDiscountVoucher, 0) = 1 EXEC('update #master set t_ck = b.tien from #master a join (select [key], sum(tien) as tien from #detail group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]')

	-- List
	IF @m_in_bk_yn = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @detail NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @detail = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'

		SET @q = 'update #master set inv_type = ''1'' where ngay_bk is not null and so_bk is not null'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, inv_type, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr) select [key], ten_vtthue, '''', ''1'', 0, 0, t_tt, 0, 0, 1 from #master where inv_type = ''1'''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, inv_type, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr) select [key], replace(replace(replace(replace (N''' + @detail + ''', ''%n'', rtrim(so_bk)), ''%d'', replace(str(day(ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'')), ''%m'', replace(str(month(ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'')), ''%y'', replace(str(year(ngay_bk), 4), '' '', ''0'')), '''', ''1'', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2 from #master where inv_type = ''1'' '
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Note
	IF @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v03$000000 WHERE xu_ly = 1 AND stt_rec = @VoucherID) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr, xu_ly) select @VoucherID, ghi_chuhoadon, '''', 0, 0, 0, -9, 0, 0, ''4'' from v03$000000 where stt_rec = @VoucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherID varchar(32)', @VoucherID
	END

	-- Viettel
	IF @provider = 3 BEGIN
		DECLARE @invoiceForm VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @invoiceForm = RTRIM(LTRIM(mau_so)) FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$%Partition set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@invoiceForm, '''', '''''') + ''' from hddt00$%Partition a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where %[a.tinh_trang_hddt = ''1'']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @q = 'select [key], a.ngay_ct, ltrim(rtrim(so_ct)) as so_ct, rtrim(ma_kh) as ma_kh, ong_ba, convert(char(10), a.ngay_ct, 103) as ngay_hd'
	IF @provider = 3
		SELECT @q = @q + ', case when ''' + @VoucherCode + ''' = ''HD5'' then 2 else 1 end as dc_tt, case when loai_hd = 1 then 0 else 1 end as tang_giam, cast((''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @oldngay_ct, 112) + ''') as smalldatetime) as ngay_ct_goc, thue_suat, N''' + @noteInvoice + ''' as ghi_chu_hd'
	ELSE IF @provider = 4
		SELECT @q = @q + ', 8 as tang_giam, thue_suat, convert(char(10), a.ngay_ct, 126) as ngay_ct1, ''' + @fkey + ''' as key_ref'
	ELSE IF @provider = 8
		SELECT @q = @q + ', 4 as loai_hd,''' + @Unit + ''' as ma_dvcs, ''' + @oldIdNumber + ''' as original_inv, isnull(thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat'
	ELSE
		SELECT @q = @q + ', case when ''' + @VoucherCode + ''' = ''HD5'' then 4 else case when loai_hd = 1 then 3 else 2 end end as loai_hd, isnull(thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat'

	SELECT @q = @q + ', isnull(ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(ma_so_thue, '''') as ma_so_thue, isnull(dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi, isnull(dien_thoai, '''') as dien_thoai, isnull(tk_nh, '''') as tk_nh, case when e_mail <> '''' then e_mail else ''' + REPLACE(@userEmail, '''', '''''') + ''' end as e_mail'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', isnull(hinh_thuc_tt, '''') as hinh_thuc_tt, t_tien, t_thue, t_tt, t_tt_in_word, month(a.ngay_ct) as ky'
	IF @isTotalDiscount = 1 SELECT @q = @q + ' , t_thue5, t_thue10'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''' + RTRIM(@oldPattern) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldSerial) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldIdNumber) + ''' as hddt_tt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @resultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @resultFields END + @masterProviderResultFields + @discountResultField + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN ', t_km' ELSE '' END
	IF @provider = 8 SELECT @q = @q + ', ''3'' as tinh_chat'
	IF @provider = 8 AND @TableName <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ', b.so_ct_hddt as so_hd_goc, b.mau_hddt as mau_hd_goc, b.so_seri_hddt as ky_hieu_hd_goc, b.ngay_ct as ngay_hd_goc'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #master a'
	IF @provider = 8 AND @TableName <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' join #adjust b on a.[key] = b.stt_rec'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select [key], fkey, isnull(ten_vt, '''') as ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN ', xu_ly' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailResultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailResultFields END + @detailProviderResultFields + @discountDetailResultField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #detail order by id'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		IF @VoucherBook <> ''
		SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, LTRIM(RTRIM(ky_hieu)) AS ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(loai_hd)) AS loai_hd FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SELECT @VoucherBook = RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook))
	IF @VoucherBook <> '' SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(mau_so)) AS mau_so, LTRIM(RTRIM(ky_hieu)) AS ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(loai_hd)) AS loai_hd FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInputInvoiceVATStockCompareData]
	@InvoiceDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@SellerName NVARCHAR(512),
	@TaxCode VARCHAR(18),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@Currency VARCHAR(3),
	@AuthenticationStatus CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(8),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	SELECT @InvoiceFrom = REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''), @InvoiceTo = REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''), 
		   @TaxCode = REPLACE(RTRIM(@TaxCode), '''', ''''''),
		   @VoucherCode = REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', ''), @Currency = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Currency), '''', ''), @AuthenticationStatus = REPLACE(@AuthenticationStatus, '''', ''), 
		   @Unit = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @VoucherDateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherDateTo SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, ma_dvcs, mst_cn, ten_cn, mst_kh, ten_kh, ngay_ct, so_ct, mau_so, ky_hieu, t_tien, t_thue, ma_nt, stt_rec_gs, ma_ct_gs, so_ct_gs, ngay_ct_gs, tc_hd, ten_kh AS ten_tt, status, ten_kh AS statusname
		INTO #dt1 FROM m15$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, so_seri0 AS ky_hieu, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_so_thue, t_tien_nt, t_thue_nt, ma_nt, status
		INTO #dt2 FROM r30$000000
		
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, so_seri AS ky_hieu, so_ct, so_ct AS so_ct0, ngay_ct, ngay_ct AS ngay_ct0, ma_so_thue, t_tien_nt2 AS t_tien_nt, t_thue_nt, ma_nt, status
		INTO #dt3 FROM r20$000000

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status <> ''*'''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @SellerName <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ten_cn like N''%' + REPLACE(@SellerName, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TaxCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.mst_cn like ''' + @TaxCode + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct_gs like ''' + @VoucherCode + '%'''
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + @Currency + '%'''
	IF @AuthenticationStatus <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.tc_hd like ''' + @AuthenticationStatus + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--#dt1 - Data Input Invoice
	SET @q = 'insert into #dt1 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.mst_cn, a.ten_cn, a.mst_kh, a.ten_kh, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.mau_so, a.ky_hieu, a.t_tien, a.t_thue
					, a.ma_nt, a.stt_rec_gs, a.ma_ct_gs, a.so_ct_gs, a.ngay_ct_gs
					, isnull(a.tc_hd, 0), case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''v'' then isnull(b.ten_tt, '''') else isnull(b.ten_tt2, '''') end as ten_tt
					, a.status, case when ''' + @Language + ''' = ''v'' then isnull(c.statusname, '''') else isnull(c.statusname2, '''') end as statusname
				from m15$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmtthddv b with(nolock) on isnull(a.tc_hd, 0) = b.ma_tt left join dmttct c with(nolock) on c.ma_ct = ''E05'' and a.status = c.status'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @InvoiceDateFrom, @InvoiceDateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	
	SELECT @VoucherDateFrom = MIN(ngay_ct_gs), @VoucherDateTo = MAX(ngay_ct_gs) FROM #dt1

	-- Data Tax
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.status not in (''0'', ''*'')'
	IF @SellerName <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ten_kh like N''%' + REPLACE(@SellerName, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TaxCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_so_thue like ''' + @TaxCode + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + @VoucherCode + '%'''
	IF @Currency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + @Currency + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	--#dt2 - Data r30
	SET @q = 'insert into #dt2 select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, max(loai_ct), so_seri0 as ky_hieu, max(so_ct), so_ct0, max(ngay_ct), ngay_ct0, ma_so_thue
				, case when isNull(ma_nt, '''') = '''' or rtrim(ma_nt) in (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''m_ma_nt0'') then sum(t_tien) else sum(t_tien_nt) end
				, case when isNull(ma_nt, '''') = '''' or rtrim(ma_nt) in (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''m_ma_nt0'') then sum(t_thue) else sum(t_thue_nt) end
				, ma_nt, max(status)
				from r30$%Partition a'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, so_seri0, ma_so_thue, ma_nt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @VoucherDateFrom, @VoucherDateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	
	--#dt3 - Data r20 (HDF, HD3)
	SET @q = 'insert into #dt3 select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, max(a.loai_ct), a.so_seri as ky_hieu, max(b.so_ct) as so_ct, a.so_ct as so_ct0, max(b.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct as ngay_ct0, a.ma_so_thue
				, case when isNull(a.ma_nt, '''') = '''' or rtrim(a.ma_nt) in (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''m_ma_nt0'') then sum(a.t_tien2) else sum(a.t_tien_nt2) end
				, case when isNull(a.ma_nt, '''') = '''' or rtrim(a.ma_nt) in (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''m_ma_nt0'') then sum(a.t_thue) else sum(a.t_thue_nt) end
				, a.ma_nt, max(a.status)
				from r20$%Partition a join c76$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''HDF'', ''HD3'')]% group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_seri, a.ma_so_thue, a.ma_nt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @InvoiceDateFrom, @InvoiceDateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Result
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nt, a.mst_kh, a.mst_cn, a.ten_cn, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct_i, a.so_ct AS so_ct_i, b.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct_t, b.so_ct AS so_ct_t, a.mau_so, a.ky_hieu
		, a.t_tien AS t_tien_i, a.t_thue AS t_thue_i
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.t_tien_nt, c.t_tien_nt) ELSE b.t_tien_nt END AS t_tien_t
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.t_thue_nt, c.t_thue_nt) ELSE b.t_thue_nt END AS t_thue_t
		, a.tc_hd, a.ten_tt
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec) ELSE ISNULL(b.stt_rec, '') END AS stt_rec_gs
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.ma_ct, c.ma_ct) ELSE ISNULL(b.ma_ct, '') END AS ma_ct_gs
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.so_ct, c.so_ct) ELSE ISNULL(b.so_ct, '') END AS so_ct_gs
		, CASE WHEN a.ma_ct in ('HDF', 'HD3') THEN ISNULL(b.ngay_ct, c.ngay_ct) ELSE b.ngay_ct END AS ngay_ct_gs
		, a.status
		, CASE WHEN a.t_thue <> b.t_thue_nt THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'v' THEN N'Sai thông tin thuế' ELSE N'Invalid tax data' END
			   WHEN ISNULL(b.so_ct, '') = '' AND ISNULL(c.so_ct, '') = '' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'v' THEN N'Chưa lập chứng từ kế toán' ELSE N'Un-extracted' END
			   WHEN ISNULL(b.so_ct, '') = '' OR ISNULL(c.so_ct, '') = '' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'v' THEN N'Đã lập chứng từ kế toán' ELSE N'Extracted' END
			   ELSE a.statusname END AS statusname
		FROM #dt1 a 
			LEFT JOIN #dt2 b ON RTRIM(LTRIM(a.so_ct)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(b.so_ct0)) AND a.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct0 AND a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu AND a.mst_cn = b.ma_so_thue
			LEFT JOIN #dt3 c ON RTRIM(LTRIM(a.so_ct)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(c.so_ct0)) AND a.ngay_ct = c.ngay_ct0 AND a.ky_hieu = c.ky_hieu AND a.mst_cn = c.ma_so_thue
			ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.mst_cn, a.ky_hieu

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIPurchaseSummary]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Groups AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@DataType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @queryStatement NVARCHAR(4000), @returnStatement NVARCHAR(4000)
	CREATE TABLE #rpt(name VARCHAR(64), ref VARCHAR(4000), value NVARCHAR(4000))


	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'int', 'm_round_gia'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'int', 'm_round_gia_nt'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT '$Options', 'char(3)', 'm_ma_nt0'


	-- Query
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryField', '', 'a.ma_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.nh_vt2, b.nh_vt3, b.loai_vt, a.ma_nt, a.sl_nhap as so_luong'
	  + CASE WHEN @DataType = '1' THEN ', gia, gia_nt' ELSE ', gia1 as gia, gia_nt1 as gia_nt' END
	  + ', a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryJoin', '', 'left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Customer', @Customer
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Item', @Item
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup1', @ItemGroup1
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup2', @ItemGroup2
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'ItemGroup3', @ItemGroup3
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Transaction', @TransactionCode
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Job', @Job
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Department', @Department
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryFilter', 'Contract', @Contract

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'TransactionKey', @VoucherCode, @TransactionList
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', '(a.nxt = ''' + @Form + ''')'
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'QueryCondition', '', 'a.ct_dc <> 1'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupData', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt, max(nh_vt1), max(nh_vt2), max(nh_vt3), max(loai_vt), max(ma_nt), sum(so_luong), max(gia), max(gia_nt), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), max(gia0), max(gia_nt0), sum(tien0), sum(tien_nt0), sum(cp), sum(cp_nt), sum(nk), sum(nk_nt), sum(thue), sum(thue_nt)'

	SET @queryStatement = 'update #report set
		ma_nt = case when ma_nt = '''' then @m_ma_nt0 else ma_nt end,
		gia = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien / so_luong, @m_round_gia) end, gia_nt = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien_nt / so_luong, @m_round_gia_nt) end,
		gia0 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien0 / so_luong, @m_round_gia) end, gia_nt0 = case when so_luong = 0 then 0 else round(tien_nt0 / so_luong, @m_round_gia_nt) end'


	-- Process
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'OrderDetail', '', 'ma_vt'
	IF ISNULL(@Groups, '') <> '' BEGIN
	  IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Groups)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupRow', 'select ma_loai_vt as loai_vt, ten_loai_vt%l as group_name from dmloaivt', 'loai_vt'
	  END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupRow' + CASE WHEN RIGHT(data, 1) = 1 THEN '' ELSE RIGHT(data, 1) END, 'select ma_nh as ' + data + ', ten_nh%l as group_name from dmnhvt where loai_nh = ''' + right(data, 1)  + '''', data
		  FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Groups, ',')
	  END
	END
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupFunction', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, cp, cp_nt, nk, nk_nt, thue, thue_nt', 'sum(so_luong), sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), sum(tien0), sum(tien_nt0), sum(cp), sum(cp_nt), sum(nk), sum(nk_nt), sum(thue), sum(thue_nt)'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'GroupTotal', '', 'group_name'


	-- Return
	SET @returnStatement = 'declare @nMa_nt int; select @nMa_nt = count(*) from (select ma_nt from #report where systotal = 1 group by ma_nt having ma_nt <> '''') a'
	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnJoin', '', 'left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	INSERT INTO #rpt SELECT 'ReturnField', '', 'sysorder, sysprint, systotal, order_detail as stt, a.ma_vt'
	  + CASE WHEN @Groups <> '' THEN ', space(sysorder) + isnull(a.group_name, ten_vt) as ten_vt, space(sysorder) + isnull(a.group_name, ten_vt2) as ten_vt2' ELSE ', isnull(a.group_name, ten_vt) as ten_vt, isnull(a.group_name, ten_vt2) as ten_vt2' END
	  + ', a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, b.dvt
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien end as tien
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else  a.tien_nt end as tien_nt
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien0 end as tien0
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.tien_nt0 end as tien_nt0
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.cp end as cp
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.cp_nt end as cp_nt
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.nk end as nk
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.nk_nt end as nk_nt
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.thue end as thue
	  , case when @nMa_nt > 1 and sysorder = 0 then 0 else a.thue_nt end as thue_nt'

	UPDATE #$query SET filterkey = REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	-- End
	EXEC bs_rptGetReportData 'r90$%Partition', 1, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @InvoiceFrom, @InvoiceTo, @Unit, @Site, @PurOrgCode, @PurGrCode, @PlantCode, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB
		, default, default, default, 1, default, 1, default, 1, @queryStatement, @returnStatement, default, @TableName, @DataType, 1

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO





CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey] (@Key NVARCHAR(4000))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
BEGIN
	IF LEN(@Key) > 3000 SET @Key = '(1 = 0)'
	RETURN @Key
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoCreateListInputInvoiceSchedule]
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@Xml VARCHAR(32),
	@ID VARCHAR(16),
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceDate VARCHAR(32),
	@TaxCommon VARCHAR(32),
	@TaxSignTime VARCHAR(32),
	@CommonName VARCHAR(32),
	@SignTime VARCHAR(32),
	@QRCodeImage VARCHAR(32),
    @Pdf VARCHAR(32),
	@ErrorCode VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @TableName = QUOTENAME(REPLACE(@TableName, '''', '')), @Xml = REPLACE(@Xml, '''', ''), @UserID = REPLACE(@UserID, '''', ''), @InvoiceDate = REPLACE(@InvoiceDate, '''', ''),
		@TaxCommon = REPLACE(@TaxCommon, '''', ''), @TaxSignTime = REPLACE(@TaxSignTime, '''', ''), @CommonName = REPLACE(@CommonName, '''', ''), @SignTime = REPLACE(@SignTime, '''', ''), @QRCodeImage = REPLACE(@QRCodeImage, '''', ''),
		@Pdf = REPLACE(@Pdf, '''', ''), @ErrorCode = REPLACE(@ErrorCode, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000)

    SELECT @q = '
while exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ') begin
    declare @id int, @keys char(13), @r nvarchar(4000), @table varchar(32), @xml varbinary(max)

    select top 1 @id = id, @table = (''x15$'' + convert(varchar(6), ' + @InvoiceDate + ', 112)), @xml = ' + @Xml + ' from ' + @TableName + '
	select @keys = lower(replace(newid(),''-'',''''))
	select @r = ''insert into @@table (stt_rec, xml_invoice) select @keys, @xml''
	select @r = replace(@r, ''@@table'', @table)

	insert into mailreceive (unit_code, keys, basetable, user_id, cks_cqt, ngay_ky_cqt, cks_cn, ngay_ky_cn, pdf_path, qrcode, e_code, status, datetime0)
		select ' + @UnitCode + ', @keys, @table, ' + @UserID + ', ' + @TaxCommon + ', ' + @TaxSignTime + ', ' + @CommonName + ', ' + @SignTime + ', '
			 + @Pdf + ', ' + @QRCodeImage + ', ' + @ErrorCode + ', 0, getdate() from ' + @TableName + ' where id = @id

	exec sp_executesql @r, N''@keys varchar(32), @xml varbinary(max)'', @keys, @xml
    delete ' + @TableName + ' where id = @id
end'

    EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTransactionListByManagementObject] -- fs20_TransObjsList
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@AccountList VARCHAR(32),
	@AccountType CHAR(1),
	@ReferenceAccountList VARCHAR(1024),
	@Object VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@ObjectType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Object 1, 2 - Object 2, 3 - Object 3
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Product VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@ForeignCurrencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Description NVARCHAR(128),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@SysDatabase VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @f VARCHAR(32), @objTable VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT @f = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = CASE @ObjectType WHEN '1' THEN '04' WHEN '2' THEN '05' WHEN '3' THEN '06' END
	SELECT @objTable = CASE @ObjectType WHEN 1 THEN 'dmdtqt1' WHEN 2 THEN 'dmdtqt2' WHEN 3 THEN 'dmdtqt3' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, line_nbr
			, tk, tk_du, ma_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dtqt
			, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_ct_nkc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ct0
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and isnull(a.' + RTRIM(@f) + ', '''') <> '''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Object <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.' + RTRIM(@f) + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Object), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Description <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.dien_giai like N''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Description), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @AccountType = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_no <> 0'
	IF @AccountType = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_co <> 0'
	IF @AccountList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @AccountList)
	IF @ReferenceAccountList <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @ReferenceAccountList)
	IF @ForeignCurrencyCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ForeignCurrencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	IF @ObjectGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_dtqt1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ObjectGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_dtqt2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ObjectGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_dtqt3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ObjectGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey
	--
	IF @ObjectGroup1 + @ObjectGroup2 + @ObjectGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join ' + @objTable + ' c with(nolock) on a.' + RTRIM(@f) + ' = c.ma_dtqt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.' + RTRIM(@f)
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmct b with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dtqt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, dien_giai)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 0, 1, 0, a.ma_dtqt, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt), isnull(max(b.ten_dtqt%l), '''') + '' - '' + rtrim(a.ma_dtqt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @objTable + ' b with(nolock) on a.ma_dtqt = b.ma_dtqt group by a.ma_dtqt'
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in (' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- View
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct0, a.ma_dtqt, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh ORDER BY ma_dtqt, sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vlkvv
AS
	SELECT     TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk as ten_tk, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk2, 
			c.ten_dvcs AS ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2 AS ten_dvcs2,
			d.ten_vv as ten_vv, d.ten_vv2 as ten_vv2
		FROM         dbo.lkvv a INNER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk INNER JOIN
		                      dbo.dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs  INNER JOIN
			         dbo.dmvv d ON a.ma_vv = d.ma_vv	
		WHERE     (a.nam IN
		                          (SELECT     nam_bd
		                            FROM          dmstt))
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintGLTranReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Controller VARCHAR(128),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Desc INT, @f NVARCHAR(4000), @$m VARCHAR(64), @$d VARCHAR(64), @$mf VARCHAR(128), @$df VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @q = '', @f = '', @$mf = '', @$df = ''

	SELECT @$m = RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END, @$d = RTRIM(d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(d$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @Voucher
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END

	IF @Voucher = 'PNG' BEGIN
		IF @Code <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Code = REPLACE(@Code, 'PNG', 'PXG')
			SELECT @Key = '(' + @Key + ' or ' + 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @Key = '(' + @Key + ' or exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + left(a.stt_rec, 10) + ''%'', text) > 0))'
		END
	END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai_h, a.ma_nt, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.dien_giai
			, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.dien_giai AS ten_tk, a.dien_giai AS ten_tk2, a.dien_giai AS ten_kh, a.dien_giai AS ten_kh2
			, a.ong_ba, ma_dvcs, loai_ct, ma_bp, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, a.line_nbr AS line_nbr0, a.ps_co AS ps_co0
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl a, dmtk g, dmkh b
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_ct, ong_ba, ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba AS contact_sign INTO #$m FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr INTO #$d FROM wrkin

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai_h, a.ma_nt, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, g.ten_tk, g.ten_tk2, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ong_ba, a.ma_dvcs, a.loai_ct, a.ma_bp, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba, a.line_nbr, abs(a.ps_co)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(stt_rec))'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk g with(nolock) on a.tk = g.tk left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'tk' and id = OBJECT_ID(@$m)) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #$m add tk varchar(32)'
		SELECT @$mf = @$mf + ', tk'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_nk' and id = OBJECT_ID(@$m)) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #$m add ma_nk varchar(32)'
		SELECT @$mf = @$mf + ', ma_nk'
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @Voucher AND ct_nxt <> 0) BEGIN
		IF @Voucher IN ('PNF','PNI','PXB','PXI') BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #$m add ma_kho varchar(32)'
			SELECT @$mf = @$mf + ', ma_kho'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #$d add ma_kho varchar(32)'
			SELECT @$df = @$df + ', ma_kho'
		END
	END
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #$m select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ngay_ct, ong_ba, dept_id, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba' + RTRIM(@$mf) + ' from ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@$m, '000000', '%Partition')) + ' m where exists(select 1 from #tmp t where t.stt_rec = m.stt_rec)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #$d select stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr' + RTRIM(@$df) + ' from ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@$d, '000000', '%Partition')) + ' d where exists(select 1 from #tmp t where t.stt_rec = d.stt_rec)'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Order
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, stt_rec', 'ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, nh_dk, ps_co0, line_nbr0, stt_rec', '#tmp', 'line_nbr', ''

	SELECT a.*, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS stt, CAST(LEFT(a.stt_rec, 10) AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xGroup
			, 0 * a.ps_no AS t_ps_no, 0 * a.ps_no_nt AS t_ps_no_nt, 0 * a.ps_co AS t_ps_co, 0 * a.ps_co_nt AS t_ps_co_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_ps_no_in_word, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_ps_no_in_word2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word2
		INTO #detail FROM #tmp a WHERE line_nbr = 1 ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.stt_rec

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #detail select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, null, '''', '''', '''', a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.tk, a.dien_giai
		, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt, a.ten_tk, a.ten_tk2, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', 0, 0, left(a.stt_rec, 10), 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', ''''
	from #tmp a where line_nbr > 1 order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_ct, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, a.stt_rec
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #detail SET ma_nt = b.ma_nt
		FROM #detail a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ma_nt)AS ma_nt, MAX(line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr

/*
	IF @Controller <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#detail', @Controller, 3, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT, 1
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	END
*/

	UPDATE #detail SET t_ps_no = b.ps_no, t_ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, t_ps_co = b.ps_co, t_ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt
			, t_ps_no_in_word = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, b.ps_no, CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN @Language ELSE 'V' END)
			, t_ps_no_nt_in_word = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, b.ps_no_nt, CASE WHEN @Bilingual = 0 THEN @Language ELSE 'V' END)
			, t_ps_no_in_word2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, b.ps_co, 'E')
			, t_ps_no_nt_in_word2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, b.ps_co_nt, 'E')
		FROM #detail a JOIN (SELECT xGroup, SUM(ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt FROM #detail GROUP BY xGroup) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup
		WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT xGroup, MAX(stt) AS stt FROM #detail GROUP BY xGroup) c WHERE a.xGroup = c.xGroup AND a.stt = c.stt)

	UPDATE #detail SET xGroup = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + xGroup


	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	IF @Voucher IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') SELECT @Bilingual = @Bilingual + 1
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#$m', '#$d', '#detail', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Desc = 0 SELECT @q = 'select *' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, nh_dk, line_nbr, stt_rec'
		ELSE SELECT @q = 'select *' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, ma_ct, nh_dk, line_nbr, stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostPayment]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@AccountField VARCHAR(64),
	@Numeric VARCHAR(4000), 
	@String VARCHAR(4000), 
	@External VARCHAR(4000),
	@Statement NVARCHAR(4000),
	@UpdateInvoiceNumber CHAR(1), -- 1: Update
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1: cttt20, 2: cttt30
	@Detail CHAR(1) = '0'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @t0 NVARCHAR(511), @t2 NVARCHAR(511), @cNoAccounts VARCHAR(511), @cBC VARCHAR(33), @wrk NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT * INTO #ar FROM wrkar
	SELECT * INTO #ap FROM wrkap
	
	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @cNoAccounts = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tk_vt'
	SELECT @t0 = CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN '#ar' ELSE '#ap' END, @t2 = CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'cttt20' ELSE 'cttt30' END, @wrk = CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'wrkar' ELSE 'wrkap' END
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @t0 + ' select ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Columns$Default(@wrk, @DetailTable, @MasterTable, null) + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Detail = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set stt_rec = left(stt_rec, 10) + stt_rec0'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @DetailTable + ' set stt_rec = left(stt_rec, 10) + stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--IF @Numeric <> '' SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ' + REPLACE(@Numeric, ',', '=0,') + '=0'	
	--IF @String <> '' SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN @q + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ' + REPLACE(@String, ',', '='''',') + '='''''
	SELECT @q = ''
	IF @External <> '' SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN @q + CHAR(13) ELSE '' END + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ' + @External + ' from ' + @t0 + ' a join ' + @DetailTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join ' + @MasterTable + ' c on ' + CASE WHEN @Detail = '0' THEN 'a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec' ELSE 'left(a.stt_rec, 10) = left(c.stt_rec,10)' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set loai_tt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt_nt, t_tt0 = t_tt, ma_gd = 0, line_nbr = 1'	
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set t_tt_qd = isnull(t_tt_qd, 0), t_tt1 = isnull(t_tt1, 0), t_tt_nt1 = isnull(t_tt_nt1,0)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ma_nt = '''', t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt0 = 0, ty_gia = 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 't_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_ck_nt = 0' ELSE 't_tien_nt = 0, t_tien_nt0 = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_cp_nt = 0, t_nk_nt = 0' END +' where ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@cBC, '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Type <> '1' SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct where ngay_ct0 is null'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @cNoAccounts <> '' AND @AccountField <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set t_tt_qd = a.t_tt_nt0, tat_toan = 1, ngay_tt = a.ngay_ct from ' + @t0 +' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on ' + CASE WHEN @Detail = '0' THEN 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' ELSE 'left(a.stt_rec,10) = left(b.stt_rec,10)' END + ' where '	
		SELECT @q = @q + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('b.' + @AccountField, 'inlist', @cNoAccounts)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set tat_toan = isnull(tat_toan, 0), t_tt_qd0 = isnull(t_tt_qd0, 0)'
	IF @Type = '1' SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @t0 + ' set ma_nvbh = '''', so_dh = '''', t_ck = 0, nam = 0, ky = 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF @UpdateInvoiceNumber = '1' BEGIN
		DECLARE @Length INT, @UpdateFields VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @Length = dbo.ff_GetDataLength('so_ct')

		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @t0 + ' set so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(so_ct, ' + RTRIM(@Length) + ')'
		IF @Type <> '1' SELECT @q = @q + ', so_ct0 = dbo.ff_PadL(so_ct0, ' + RTRIM(@Length) + ')'		
		EXEC sp_executesql @q		
	END
			
	IF @Type = 1 INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar
		ELSE INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@VoucherType CHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @fmQty VARCHAR(64), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(512), @s2 NVARCHAR(512), @s3 NVARCHAR(512), @s4 NVARCHAR(512), @s5 NVARCHAR(512), @s6 NVARCHAR(512), @s7 NVARCHAR(512), @s8 NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT060'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT061'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT062'
	SELECT @s4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT063'
	SELECT @s5 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT064'
	SELECT @s6 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT065'
	SELECT @s7 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT066'
	SELECT @s8 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT067'
	SELECT @fmQty = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_Duyet = @VoucherType

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.status, a.u_status, a.xtype, a.datetime4, a.user_id4, a.stt, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS stt2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS stt_rec0, b.sl_duyet, b.xstatus, b.ghi_chu, b.xtype AS xtype2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_vt, c.line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS msg, a.comment INTO #tt FROM a91$000000 a, e91$000000 b, d91$000000 c
	SELECT @HisTable = a$ FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tt (a.status, u_status, xtype, datetime4, user_id4, stt, stt2, msg, comment) select status, u_status, xtype, datetime4, user_id4, stt, 0, '''', comment from ' + QUOTENAME(@HisTable) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Approval comment
	SELECT s_status as status, u_status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(u_status_name) ELSE RTRIM(u_status_name2) END AS u_status_name INTO #dmttcttg FROM dmttcttg WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	UPDATE #tt SET msg = N'<br>&nbsp;-  ' + @s1 + N' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.datetime4, 103) + N', ' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.datetime4, 108) +
			N' ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN rtrim(b.comment) ELSE rtrim(b.comment2) END +
			N' ' + CASE WHEN a.xtype = 2 THEN @s3 ELSE @s2 END +
			N' "' + RTRIM(a.u_status) + N' - ' + c.u_status_name + N'"' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(ISNULL(a.comment, '')) = '' THEN '' ELSE ' (' + a.comment + ')' END
		FROM #tt a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id4 = b.id JOIN #dmttcttg c ON a.u_status = c.u_status AND a.status = c.status
		WHERE a.stt2 = 0

	--  Flow Status
	UPDATE #tt SET msg = N'<br>&nbsp;-  ' + @s1 + N' ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.datetime4, 103) + N', ' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.datetime4, 108) +
			N' ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN rtrim(b.comment) ELSE rtrim(b.comment2) END +
			N' ' + @s2 +
			N' "' + RTRIM(a.status) + N' - ' + c.status_name + N'"' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(ISNULL(a.comment, '')) = '' THEN '' ELSE ' (' + a.comment + ')' END
		FROM #tt a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id4 = b.id JOIN (SELECT status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(statusname) ELSE RTRIM(statusname2) END AS status_name FROM dmttct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode) c ON a.status = c.status
		WHERE a.stt2 = 0 AND a.msg = ''


	-- Return data
	CREATE TABLE #m (id INT IDENTITY, smsg VARCHAR(10), msg NVARCHAR(4000), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #m(msg, smsg, msg0, msg1, msg2, msg3, msg4, msg5, msg6, msg7, msg8, msg9) SELECT msg, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '' FROM #tt ORDER BY stt, stt2, line_nbr

	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000), @msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), @id INT, @maxID INT, @f TINYINT
	SELECT @msg0 = '', @id = 1, @f = 0, @maxID = COUNT(1) FROM #m

	WHILE @id <= @maxID BEGIN
		SELECT @msg = msg FROM #m WHERE id = @id

		IF LEN(@msg0 + @msg) > 3800 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #m set msg' + RTRIM(@f) + ' = N''' + REPLACE(@msg0, '''', '''''') + ''' where id = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SELECT @msg0 = '', @f = @f + 1
		END ELSE IF @id = @maxID BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #m set msg' + RTRIM(@f) + ' = N''' + REPLACE(@msg0 + @msg, '''', '''''') + ''' where id = 1'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SELECT @msg0 = @msg0 + @msg, @id = @id + 1
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #m) INSERT INTO #m SELECT '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		ELSE UPDATE #m SET msg0 = @s8 + msg0 WHERE id = 1


	SELECT ISNULL(smsg, '') AS smsg, ISNULL(msg0, '') AS msg0, ISNULL(msg1, '') AS msg1, ISNULL(msg2, '') AS msg2, ISNULL(msg3, '') AS msg3, ISNULL(msg4, '') AS msg4, ISNULL(msg5, '') AS msg5,
		ISNULL(msg6, '') AS msg6, ISNULL(msg7, '') AS msg7, ISNULL(msg8, '') AS msg8, ISNULL(msg9, '') AS msg9 INTO #r FROM #m WHERE id = 1

	UPDATE #r SET smsg = 'none' WHERE msg0 = '' AND msg1 = '' AND msg2 = '' AND msg3 = '' AND msg4 = '' AND msg5 = '' AND msg6 = '' AND msg7 = '' AND msg8 = '' AND msg9 = ''

	SELECT * FROM #r

	DROP TABLE #tt, #m, #r

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckVoucherEditLogDetailView]
	@changeTimes INT,
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @voucherCode = REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', ''), @voucherID = REPLACE(@voucherID, '''', ''), @unit = REPLACE(@unit, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @size TINYINT, @p VARCHAR(6), @r INT, @i INT, @k TINYINT, @prime TINYINT
	DECLARE @t$Prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @t$Prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32), @l$Ref$Table NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @f$ VARCHAR(32), @f$Amount VARCHAR(128), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo0 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo1 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo2 NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @NoDefine = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @LogInfo0 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo0'
	SELECT @LogInfo1 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo1'
	SELECT @LogInfo2 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo2'

	SELECT @p = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112), @changeTimes = @changeTimes + 1
	SELECT @t$Prime$Root = REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END
		, @t$Prime$Root$Log = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(xtable, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + '$log' END END
		, @l$Ref$Table = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT @f$Amount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
	SELECT TOP 1 @size = b.[length] FROM sysobjects a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.id = b.id WHERE a.name = 'm81$000000' and b.name = 'so_ct'
	IF @voucherID = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @voucherID = stt_rec from ' + REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) + ' where ma_dvcs = @unit and so_ct = ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@voucherNumber), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''' and ngay_ct = @voucherDate'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32) output, @unit varchar(32), @voucherDate smalldatetime', @voucherID OUTPUT, @unit, @voucherDate
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xtable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeTable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeLog, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS prime, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, *, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS cType INTO #field FROM #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS user_action, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS old_value, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS new_value, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx INTO #report

	--
	SELECT @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) + ' where ma_dvcs = @unit and so_ct = ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@voucherNumber), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''' and ngay_ct = @voucherDate and stt_rec = @voucherID) select @r = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @unit varchar(32), @voucherDate smalldatetime, @r int output', @voucherID, @unit, @voucherDate, @r OUTPUT
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (gr_id, user_action) SELECT '', ''
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, * FROM #report
		RETURN
	END ELSE SELECT @r = NULL

	SELECT @q = 'select @r = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID and (idLog = @changeTimes or idLog = @changeTimes - 1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @r tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @voucherID, @r OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (gr_id, user_action) SELECT '', ''
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, * FROM #report
		RETURN
	END

	-- Table/Field
	SELECT * INTO #refTable FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@l$Ref$Table, ',')
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT xtable, @t$Prime$Root, @t$Prime$Root$Log, 1 FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
		SELECT data, REPLACE(data, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(data, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(data, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log' END END, 1
		FROM #refTable ORDER BY id

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #field (field, field_name, gr_id, xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
select a.field, a.field_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.gr_id, a.xtable, b.primeTable, b.primeLog, b.prime
from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckfields a left join #table b on a.xtable = b.xtable where a.ma_ct = @voucherCode and a.xtype = ''1'' order by b.stt, a.stt_sx, a.field'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32)', @voucherCode

	UPDATE #field SET cType = CASE WHEN c.name IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN 1 WHEN c.name IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.field = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(a.primeLog) JOIN systypes c on b.xtype = c.xtype and b.xusertype = c.xusertype AND c.name <> 'sysname'
	UPDATE #field SET prime = 0 FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON OBJECT_ID(a.primeLog) = b.id AND b.name = 'stt_rec0'

	-- Data/Log
	SELECT @q = 'select @i = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID and idLog = @changeTimes'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @i tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @voucherID, @i OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #report (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx) select @f$, N''%field_name'', %line, %action, %old_value, %new_value, N''%gr_id'', %stt_sx from %talbe a left join %refTalbe b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec %joinKeyDetail %joinKeyLog where a.stt_rec = @voucherID %whereKey'

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @f$ = field, @t$Prime$Root = primeTable, @t$Prime$Root$Log = primeLog, @prime = prime FROM #field ORDER BY stt
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p)) AND name = @f$) GOTO GetValueNextField
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
			, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
			, '%line', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'a.line_nbr' END)
			, '%action', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '@LogInfo1' ELSE 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end' END)
			, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
			, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
			, '%gr_id', gr_id)
			, '%stt_sx', stt)
			, '%talbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) ELSE @t$Prime$Root$Log END)
			, '%refTalbe', @t$Prime$Root$Log)
			, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' END)
			, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN 'and b.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog = b.idLog + 1' END)
			, '%whereKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes' END)
		FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root$Log, '')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@f$ varchar(32), @voucherID varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
			, @f$, @voucherID, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2

		IF @prime = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
				, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
				, '%line', 'isnull(b.line_nbr, a.line_nbr)')
				, '%action', 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo2 else @LogInfo1 end')
				, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
				, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
				, '%gr_id', gr_id)
				, '%stt_sx', stt)
				, '%talbe', @t$Prime$Root$Log)
				, '%refTalbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) ELSE @t$Prime$Root$Log END)
				, '%joinKeyDetail', 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0')
				, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog + 1 = b.idLog' END)
				, '%whereKey', 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1')
			FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND primeTable = @t$Prime$Root AND primeLog = @t$Prime$Root$Log
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@f$ varchar(32), @voucherID varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
				, @f$, @voucherID, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2

		END


GetValueNextField:
		--
		DELETE #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root$Log, '')
	END
	DELETE #report WHERE ISNULL(old_value, '') = ISNULL(new_value, '')

	-- Not exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (gr_id, user_action) SELECT 'NODEFINE', @LogInfo1

	-- View
	SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #result FROM #report
	SELECT @q = '
select case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else b.gr_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' end as gr_name
		, case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else a.field_name end as field_name
		, a.line_nbr, a.user_action, a.old_value, a.new_value, a.gr_id, a.stt_sx
	from #result a left join ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckgroupfields b on a.gr_id = b.gr_id
	order by b.stt_sx, a.gr_id, a.line_nbr, a.stt_sx, a.user_action, a.field
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@NoDefine nvarchar(128)', @NoDefine

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_TryConvertNumber](@value NVARCHAR(4000))
RETURNS INT
BEGIN
	RETURN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN @value NOT LIKE N'%[^-0-9]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$BISA] -- fs_BeforUpdatePO
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct INTO #$master FROM bim06$000000
	SET @s = 'insert into #$master select ma_kh, ma_bp0, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ngach, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_kh
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM bid06$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ngach, so_luong, he_so INTO #detailUpdate FROM bid06$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = '
insert into #detailUpdate select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, a.so_luong, a.he_so
	from ' + @detailTable + ' a cross join #$master m join bim02$000000 b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung join bid02$000000 c on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and b.ma_bp0 = m.ma_bp0 and c.ma_kh = m.ma_kh and isnull(a.ngay_giao, m.ngay_ct) between b.ngay_hl_tu and b.ngay_hl_den'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select a.stt_rec_nc, a.stt_rec0nc, b.stt_rec_ngach, b.stt_rec0ngach, a.stt_rec_kh, a.stt_rec0kh, a.so_luong, a.tien_nt, a.he_so, '''', ''000000'', '''' 
from ' + @detailTable + ' a left join #detailUpdate b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
	where a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (a.stt_rec_nc <> '''' or a.stt_rec_kh <> '''' or b.stt_rec_ngach is not null)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)) FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_kh <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_kh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c93$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_kh = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @cQAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineQAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ngach VARCHAR(64), @dyn_kh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_ngach, stt_rec0ngach, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, tien_nt, he_so, dyn_nc, dyn_ngach, dyn_kh FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cQAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ngach <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' SET sl_th = a.sl_th - CASE WHEN m.he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty * @nRate / m.he_so, 3) END FROM bid02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' a JOIN bim02$' + @dyn_ngach + ' m ON a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineQAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nAmount',  RTRIM(@nAmount)), '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cQAIDNumber, @cLineQAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nAmount, @nRate, @dyn_nc, @dyn_ngach, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
	
	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc, MAX(dyn_kh) AS dyn_kh FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET xstatus = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh = 0 AND xstatus = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh < sl_duyet)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PRStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PRStatus = status FROM i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c91$000000 SET status = @PRStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = @PRStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vxcdvtdd0]
AS
SELECT	a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_yt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.sl_dk, a.dd_dk, a.dd_dk_nt, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_td1, 
	a.ma_td2, a.ma_td3, a.sl_td1, a.sl_td2, a.sl_td3, a.ngay_td1, a.ngay_td2, a.ngay_td3, a.gc_td1, a.gc_td2, a.gc_td3, a.s1, a.s2, a.s3, a.s4, a.s5, a.s6, a.s7, a.s8, a.s9, 
	b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_vt AS ten_sp, c.ten_vt2 AS ten_sp2
FROM	dbo.xcdvtdd0 AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT OUTER JOIN
	dbo.dmvt AS c ON a.ma_sp = c.ma_vt
WHERE	(1 = 0)

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_RMPeriodInfoInputPrint]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@cDTable VARCHAR(64), 
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	SET @q =  '
select a.line_nbr as stt, a.ma_vtr, isnull(b.ten_vtr' + @cE + ', '''') as ten_vtr, a.ma_bp, isnull(c.ten_bp' + @cE + ', '''') as ten_bp, a.so_luong, a.ma_ht, isnull(d.ten_ht' + @cE + ', '''') as ten_ht into #report
	from ' + REPLACE(@cDTable, '''', '''''') + ' a with(nolock)
		left join hrvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vtr = b.ma_vtr
		left join hrbp c with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
		left join hrrmhttt d with(nolock) on a.ma_ht = d.ma_ht
	where a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' order by a.line_nbr
exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + REPLACE(@cVoucher, '''', '''''') + ''', ''ma_vtr, ten_vtr, ma_bp, ten_bp'','''', ''stt''
select * from #report order by stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReplaceInvoice]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@InvoiceID CHAR(13),
	@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTemplate VARCHAR(32),
	@Serial VARCHAR(32),
	@SecretNumber NVARCHAR(4000),
	@ResultProcess TINYINT, -- 0: Failed, 1: Ok
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Payment INT = 0,
	@Resign BIT = 0,
	@TableNameBefore VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@TableNameAfter VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @InvoiceID = REPLACE(@InvoiceID, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	SELECT @InvoiceNumber = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(@InvoiceNumber)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p CHAR(6), @ref VARCHAR(6), @vCode CHAR(3), @r NVARCHAR(512), @updateFlow BIT, @k VARCHAR(32)

	IF CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) > 0 SELECT @SecretNumber = SUBSTRING(@SecretNumber, 1, CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @SecretNumber) - 1)

	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct1, 112), @ref = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct0, 112), @updateFlow = cn_qui_trinh FROM hddt01 WHERE stt_rec1 = @VoucherID AND stt_rec0 = @InvoiceID
	ELSE SELECT @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @ref = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(ma_ct_hd, stt_rec_hd), @updateFlow = 0 FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

	--
	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	IF @ResultProcess = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate()'
		SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @TableNameBefore = '' THEN ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + '''' ELSE ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameBefore) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END
	--

	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' AND @TableNameAfter = '' EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoice @InvoiceID, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	CREATE TABLE #adjust(stt_rec VARCHAR(32), fkey VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ck_yn TINYINT, ma_ct VARCHAR(3))
	IF @TableNameAfter <> '' BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' SET @q = 'insert into #adjust(stt_rec, fkey, ngay_ct, ma_ct) select a.stt_rec1, a.stt_rec0, a.ngay_ct0, a.ma_ct from hddt01 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec1 = b.[key]'
			ELSE SET @q = 'insert into #adjust(stt_rec, fkey, ma_ct) select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_hd, a.ma_ct_hd from hdtt a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' BEGIN
			SET @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #adjust set ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct from #adjust a join ' + CASE ma_ct WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' WHEN 'HD7' THEN 'hdtt' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' END + ' b on a.fkey = b.stt_rec' FROM #adjust GROUP BY ma_ct
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		SET @q = ''
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #adjust set ck_yn = b.ck_yn from #adjust a join hddt00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) + ' b on a.fkey = b.stt_rec' FROM #adjust GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
			SELECT @k = MIN(fkey) FROM #adjust
			WHILE @k IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterCancelInvoice @k, @VoucherCode, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
				SELECT @k = MIN(fkey) FROM #adjust WHERE fkey > @k
			END
		END
	END

	--
	IF @TableNameAfter <> '' GOTO _UpdateMultiVoucherStatus

	SELECT @r = ' set so_ct0 = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''';'

	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceTemplate, '''', '''''') + ''', so_seri_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@Serial, '''', '''''') + ''', so_ct_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@InvoiceNumber, '''', '''''') + ''', tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = '''  + REPLACE(@SecretNumber, '''', '''''') + '''  where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @ref + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 4, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ct00' + @r + 'update ct70' + @r + 'update ct90' + @r + 'update r00$' + @p + @r + 'update r70$' + @p + @r + 'update r90$' + @p + @r
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--- Circular 78 --- Discount Voucher
	DECLARE @isDiscountVoucher TINYINT
	SELECT @q = N'select @isDisCountVoucher = isnull(ck_yn, 0) from hddt00$' + @ref + ' where stt_rec = @InvoiceID'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@isDisCountVoucher tinyint output, @InvoiceID varchar(32)', @isDisCountVoucher OUTPUT, @InvoiceID
	IF ISNULL(@isDiscountVoucher, 0) = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set ck_yn = 1 where stt_rec = @VoucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherID varchar(32)', @VoucherID
	END
	GOTO _UpdateFlow

_UpdateMultiVoucherStatus:
	DECLARE @keyFields NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @keyFields = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_return_fields_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 'case when charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) > 0 then substring(%b.so_bi_mat, 1, charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) - 1) else %b.so_bi_mat end' ELSE '%b.so_bi_mat' END

	-- PadLeft...
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @TableNameAfter + ' set so_ct_hddt = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(so_ct_hddt)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set mau_hddt = b.mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt = b.so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt = b.so_ct_hddt, tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()' + CASE WHEN @Payment = 1 THEN ', trang_thai_tt = ''2''' ELSE '' END + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameAfter) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	SELECT @q = CHAR(13) + @q + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', 'b.') + ' from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join ' + QUOTENAME(@TableNameAfter) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	IF @VoucherCode <> 'HD7' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct00 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct00 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct70 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct70 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct90 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct90 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r00$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r70$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r70$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r90$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r90$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = ''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update a set tinh_trang_hddt = 4, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() from hddt00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) + ' a join #adjust b on a.stt_rec = b.fkey;' FROM #adjust GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--- Circular 78 --- Discount Voucher
	SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set ck_yn = 1 from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join #adjust b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.ck_yn = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


_UpdateFlow:
	-- Update Flow
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' AND ((@updateFlow = 1) OR (@TableNameAfter <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hddt01 a JOIN #adjust b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.fkey WHERE a.cn_qui_trinh = 1))) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec AS stt_rec1, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, dh_so, dh_ln, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, px_so, px_ln, line_nbr INTO #qt FROM d81$000000
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #qt select stt_rec, ''' + @VoucherID + ''', stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, dh_so, dh_ln, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, px_so, px_ln, line_nbr from d81$' + @ref + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> '''' or stt_rec_px <> '''')'
		IF @TableNameAfter <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)+ 'insert into #qt select a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, a.dh_so, a.dh_ln, a.stt_rec_px, a.stt_rec0px, a.px_so, a.px_ln, a.line_nbr from d81$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) + ' a join #adjust b on a.stt_rec = b.fkey where (a.stt_rec_dh <> '''' or a.stt_rec_px <> '''');' FROM #adjust GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112)
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec0, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec1, line_nbr0, line_nbr1 INTO #mapline FROM hddt01ct
		IF @TableNameAfter = '' INSERT INTO #mapline SELECT stt_rec0, @VoucherID, line_nbr0, line_nbr1 FROM hddt01ct WHERE stt_rec0 = @InvoiceID AND line_nbr0 <> 0 AND line_nbr1 <> 0
		ELSE INSERT INTO #mapline SELECT a.stt_rec0, b.stt_rec, a.line_nbr0, a.line_nbr1 FROM hddt01ct a JOIN #adjust b ON a.stt_rec0 = b.fkey WHERE a.line_nbr0 <> 0 AND a.line_nbr1 <> 0

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #mapline) INSERT #mapline SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec1, line_nbr, line_nbr FROM #qt

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
			DELETE #qt WHERE stt_rec_dh = ''
		END ELSE IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt WHERE stt_rec_px <> '') BEGIN
			DELETE #qt WHERE stt_rec_px = ''
		END

		DECLARE @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt) AND @TableNameAfter = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update d81$' + @p + ' set stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh, dh_so = c.dh_so, dh_ln = c.dh_ln, stt_rec_px = c.stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px = c.stt_rec0px, px_so = c.px_so, px_ln = c.px_ln'
				+ ' from d81$' + @p + ' a join #mapline b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr1 join #qt c on b.line_nbr0 = c.line_nbr'
				+ ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
				+ CHAR(13)
				+ 'update d81$' + @ref + ' set stt_rec_dh = '''', stt_rec0dh = '''', dh_so = '''', dh_ln = 0, stt_rec_px = '''', stt_rec0px = '''', px_so = '''', px_ln = 0'
				+ ' from d81$' + @ref + ' a join #mapline b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr0'
				+ ' where a.stt_rec = ''' + @InvoiceID + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SELECT @mTable = 'm81$' + @p, @dTable = 'd81$' + @p
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SV @mTable, @dTable, @VoucherID, 'Edit', @UserID
		END

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM #qt) AND @TableNameAfter <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update d81$' + @p + ' set stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh, dh_so = c.dh_so, dh_ln = c.dh_ln, stt_rec_px = c.stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px = c.stt_rec0px, px_so = c.px_so, px_ln = c.px_ln'
				+ ' from d81$' + @p + ' a join #mapline b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec1 and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr1 join #qt c on b.stt_rec0 = c.stt_rec and b.line_nbr0 = c.line_nbr'
