	DECLARE @h1 AS  NVARCHAR(511), @h2 AS NVARCHAR(511), @h3 AS NVARCHAR(511), @Ten_ky AS NVARCHAR(511), @NumberOfPeriod NUMERIC(5)
	DECLARE @PeriodNoTmp AS INT

	IF @PeriodType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT032'
		SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT033'
		SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT034'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @h1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT035'
		SELECT @h2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT036'
		SELECT @h3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT037'
	END

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #bal FROM cdvt
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat INTO #tmp FROM r70$000000	
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong INTO #report FROM #tmp

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	IF @ItemType <> '' OR @filterKey <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Tồn kho cuối kỳ
	INSERT #bal EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateTo, @Unit, @Site, @Item, 2, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT @NumberOfPeriod = @PeriodCycle * (@PeriodNo - 1)
	SELECT @DateFrom = CASE WHEN @PeriodType = '1' THEN DATEADD(day, - @NumberOfPeriod, @DateTo) ELSE DATEADD(month,- @NumberOfPeriod, @DateTo) END

	-- Key
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--Lấy phát sinh vào bảng tạm
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.sl_xuat)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and a.nxt = 1' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp'
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.sl_xuat)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and a.nxt = 1' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Xóa vật tư không theo dõi tồn kho
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#bal', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#tmp', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNo - 1
	WHILE @PeriodNoTmp >= 0 BEGIN
		SET @DateFrom = CASE WHEN @PeriodType = '1' THEN DATEADD(day, - (@PeriodCycle*@PeriodNoTmp), @DateTo) ELSE DATEADD(month, - (@PeriodCycle*@PeriodNoTmp), @DateTo) END

		INSERT INTO #report
			SELECT @PeriodNoTmp + 1, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong)
				FROM (
					SELECT ma_vt, so_luong FROM #bal
					UNION ALL (SELECT ma_vt, - sl_nhap FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct > @DateFrom AND ngay_ct <= @dateTo)
					) a
				GROUP BY ma_vt
				HAVING SUM(a.so_luong) >= 0

		SELECT @NumberOfPeriod = @NumberOfPeriod - @PeriodCycle, @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNoTmp - 1 			
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ky - 1, ma_vt, - so_luong FROM #report
	
	SELECT ky, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong
		INTO #report2 FROM #report WHERE ky <> 0 GROUP BY ma_vt, ky

	-- Xóa nếu số lượng nhỏ hơn 0
	DELETE #report2 WHERE so_luong < 0

	-- Thêm các kỳ không có số liệu
	DECLARE @Ma_vt VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNo, @Ma_vt = MIN(ma_vt) FROM #report2
	IF @Ma_vt IS NULL SET @Ma_vt = ''
	WHILE @PeriodNoTmp > 0 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report2 WHERE ky = @PeriodNoTmp)
			INSERT INTO #report2 SELECT @PeriodNoTmp, '', 0, @Ma_vt, 0

		SELECT @PeriodNoTmp = @PeriodNoTmp - 1 			
	END
	
	-- Tên kỳ
	UPDATE #report2 SET ten_ky = REPLACE(@h1, '%n1', RTRIM(@PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky = 1
	UPDATE #report2 SET ten_ky = REPLACE(REPLACE(@h2, '%n1', RTRIM((ky - 1) * @PeriodCycle)), '%n2', RTRIM(ky * @PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky > 1 AND ky < @PeriodNo
	UPDATE #report2 SET ten_ky = REPLACE(@h3, '%n1', RTRIM((@PeriodNo - 1) * @PeriodCycle)) WHERE ky = @PeriodNo
	
	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #o(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, ma_vt VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #o(ma_vt) SELECT DISTINCT(ma_vt) FROM #report2 ORDER BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #report2 SET stt = b.id FROM #report2 a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	--View
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint
			, a.ky, a.ten_ky, a.stt, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong
			, REPLACE(STR(a.ky, 3), ' ', '0') AS sysColumn , b.dvt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
		FROM #report2 a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY stt, ky
		
	-- Pivot	
	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT DISTINCT ky, 'so_luong$' + RTRIM(CAST(ky AS INT)), ten_ky FROM #report2 ORDER BY ky
	SELECT * FROM #pivot

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vfa
AS
	SELECT     *	FROM         dbo.ctkhts

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummary] --fs20_StockSummary--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkcolumns a, cdvt b
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt
			, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien  AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #report FROM #t

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, @Item, 1, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_vt, ma_kho, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #t

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report select a.ma_vt, max(a.ma_kho), 0, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), sum(tien_nhap), sum(tien_nt_n), sum(sl_xuat), sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report select a.ma_vt, max(a.ma_kho), 0, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), sum(tien_nhap), sum(tien_nt_n), sum(sl_xuat), sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	--Nhom lai va tinh ton cuoi
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal,
			0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(b.tk_vt) AS tk_vt,
			MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3,
			SUM(a.ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(a.du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(a.du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt, SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(a.tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap,
			SUM(a.tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(a.tien_xuat)  AS tien_xuat, SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x,
			MAX(a.ton_dau * 0) AS ton_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau * 0) AS du_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau_nt * 0) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #incd1
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmvt)) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt
		ORDER BY 1

	UPDATE #incd1 SET loai_vt = '' where loai_vt IS NULL
	UPDATE #incd1 SET tk_vt = '' where tk_vt IS NULL
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#incd1', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #incd1 SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#incd1', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, tk_vt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3', 'numeric(5), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), n#, char(2), varchar(32), #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #incd1 WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #incd1 WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0
	DELETE FROM #incd1 WHERE systotal = 1 AND ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0 AND ton_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi_nt = 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #incd1 WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#incd1', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#incd1', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF @Group = 'loai_vt' SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt', '#incd1' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
			ELSE IF @Group = 'tk_vt' SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('tk_vt', 'tk', 'vt', 'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt', '#incd1' , 'dmtk', 'ten_tk')
				ELSE SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'vt', 'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt', '#incd1')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'

	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #Incd1(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s1 AS ten_vt, @s12 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau), SUM(du_dau), SUM(du_dau_nt), SUM(sl_nhap), SUM(tien_nhap), SUM(tien_nt_n), SUM(sl_xuat), SUM(tien_xuat), SUM(tien_nt_x), SUM(ton_cuoi), SUM(du_cuoi), SUM(du_cuoi_nt)
			FROM #Incd1
			WHERE systotal = 1

	-- Blank
	INSERT INTO #incd1 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES ('', '', '', '', 1, 0, 0)

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#incd1', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, rtrim(ma_vt) as ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt from #incd1 order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, rtrim(ma_vt) as ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt from #incd1 order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group, 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_COUpdateProductPriceMaster] 
	@TempTable VARCHAR(64),
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @strDetailTable VARCHAR(33), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @strMasterTable VARCHAR(33), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @nNum TINYINT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct INTO #dmct FROM wrkcodetail
	SET @q = 'insert into #dmct select distinct ma_ct from ' + @TempTable + ' order by ma_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dmct
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @strDetailTable = RTRIM(m_ctdbfs), @strMasterTable = RTRIM(m_phdbfs) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
		-- Update dynamic table
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
			DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(64)
			SELECT @dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)
			SELECT @strDetailTable = @strDetailTable + ',d74$' + @dyn, @strMasterTable = @strMasterTable + ',m74$' + @dyn
		END
		SET @nNum = 0
		WHILE @nNum < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strDetailTable)
			BEGIN
				SET @nNum = @nNum + 1
				SET @cDetailTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strDetailTable, @nNum)))
				SET @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strMasterTable, @nNum)))
				TRUNCATE TABLE wrkcomaster
				IF @cDetailTable <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'INSERT INTO wrkcomaster (stt_rec, t_tien_nt, t_tien)'
					SET @q = @q + ' SELECT stt_rec, SUM(tien_nt), SUM(tien) FROM ' + @cDetailTable
					SET @q = @q + ' WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM ' + @TempTable + ' WHERE ma_ct = ''' + @ma_ct + ''')'
					SET @q = @q + ' AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' AND ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'
					SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY stt_rec'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
				IF @cMasterTable <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'UPDATE ' + @cMasterTable + ' SET t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt FROM ' + @cMasterTable + ' a JOIN wrkcomaster b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
					SET @q = @q + ' WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' AND ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #dmct WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END
	TRUNCATE TABLE wrkcomaster
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_UnPostBIOAClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM bic10$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'bim10$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'bid10$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'bii10$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'bia10$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM bia10$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''6'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update bic10$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptDirectCashFlow] --fs20_CashflowD
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousBegin AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousEnd AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mau nam, 2 - Mau giua nien do
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	CREATE TABLE #tmp (tk VARCHAR(1024))
	DECLARE @Kind CHAR(1), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(512), @Tk_co CHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
		, @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_naynt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truocnt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @i INT, @ds_tk VARCHAR(1023)

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME, @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @Type CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DateTo, 112) + '01', @d2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DatePreviousEnd, 112) + '01'
	SELECT @d1 = CASE WHEN @d1 < @DateFrom THEN @DateFrom ELSE @d1 END, @d2 = CASE WHEN @d2 < @DatePreviousBegin THEN @DatePreviousBegin ELSE @d2 END

	--Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc5 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #balanceKN FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceKT FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKN FROM #balanceKN
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #balanceLKKT FROM #balanceKN

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by tk, tk_du'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Balance
	DECLARE @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @WhereClause = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	--
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKN EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceLKKT EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DatePreviousBegin0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKN
	INSERT INTO #balanceKN SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKN' GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT * FROM #balanceLKKT
	INSERT INTO #balanceKT SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKT' GROUP BY tk
	--
	SELECT tk INTO #acct FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0
	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM #ct00 WHERE 1 = 0

	DECLARE Cal_Cur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT kind, ma_so, tk_no, tk_co, [type] FROM #report WHERE kind <> '0'
	OPEN Cal_Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Type
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_no - Du_co), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			--KN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_naynt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			--KT
			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				--LKKN
				SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKN WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
				--LKKT
				SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Du_co - Du_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Du_co_nt - Du_no_nt) FROM #balanceLKKT WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1
			END
		END

		IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
			IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
				IF @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'select @Ky_nay = sum(ps_no), @Ky_naynt = sum(ps_no_nt) from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DateTo, 112) + ' a with(nolock) where (ngay_ct between @d1 and @DateTo) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (@Tk_no = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1) and (@Tk_co = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime, @Tk_no char(512), @Tk_co char(512), @Ky_nay numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_naynt numeric(28, 6) output', @d1, @DateTo, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Ky_nay OUTPUT, @Ky_naynt OUTPUT
					SELECT @q = 'select @Ky_truoc = sum(ps_no), @Ky_truocnt = sum(ps_no_nt) from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DatePreviousEnd, 112) + ' a with(nolock) where (ngay_ct between @d2 and @DatePreviousEnd) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (@Tk_no = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_no) = 1) and (@Tk_co = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d2 smalldatetime, @DatePreviousEnd smalldatetime, @Tk_no char(512), @Tk_co char(512), @Ky_truoc numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_truocnt numeric(28, 6) output', @d2, @DatePreviousEnd, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Ky_truoc OUTPUT, @Ky_truocnt OUTPUT
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'select @Ky_nay = sum(Ps_co), @Ky_naynt = sum(Ps_co_nt)	from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DateTo, 112) + ' a with(nolock) where (ngay_ct between @d1 and @DateTo) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0) and (@Tk_co = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1) and (@Tk_no = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime, @Tk_no char(512), @Tk_co char(512), @Ky_nay numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_naynt numeric(28, 6) output', @d1, @DateTo, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Ky_nay OUTPUT, @Ky_naynt OUTPUT
					SELECT @q = 'select @Ky_truoc = sum(Ps_co), @Ky_truocnt = sum(Ps_co_nt)	from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DatePreviousEnd, 112) + ' a with(nolock) where (ngay_ct between @d2 and @DatePreviousEnd) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0) and (@Tk_co = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk_co) = 1) and (@Tk_no = '''' or dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d2 smalldatetime, @DatePreviousEnd smalldatetime, @Tk_no char(512), @Tk_co char(512), @Ky_truoc numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_truocnt numeric(28, 6) output', @d2, @DatePreviousEnd, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Ky_truoc OUTPUT, @Ky_truocnt OUTPUT
				END
				UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay, Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt, Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt, Lk_kn = @Ky_nay, Lk_kt = @Ky_truoc, Lk_kn_nt = @Ky_naynt, Lk_kt_nt = @Ky_truocnt WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
				GOTO Next
			END

			IF @Tk_no = '#'	BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_co)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_co, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_no
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_co) = 1
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''

				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_co <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so


				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_co = '#' BEGIN
				DELETE #acct
				SET @i = 1
				WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_no)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_no, @i)
						SET @i = @i + 1
					END

				DELETE #gl
				INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1)

				INSERT INTO #tmp
					SELECT b.tk_co
						FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_no) = 1
							WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
				DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1
				DELETE #tmp

				DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_no <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SET @ds_tk = ''
				SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
				IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
				UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
						, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
					FROM #gl
			END

			IF @Tk_no <> '#' AND @Tk_co <> '#' BEGIN
				IF @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)
				END ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)

					SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END)
							, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
						FROM #ct00
						WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
				END
			END
		END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt , Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt
				, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt , Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

Next:

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Type
	END
	CLOSE Cal_Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cal_Cur


	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = 0 WHERE Ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = 0 WHERE ky_naynt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = 0 WHERE Ky_truocnt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = - ky_nay, ky_truoc = - ky_truoc, ky_naynt = - ky_naynt, ky_truocnt = - ky_truocnt
		, Lk_kn = - Lk_kn, Lk_kt = - Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = - Lk_kn_nt, Lk_kt_nt = -  Lk_kt_nt
		WHERE dau = 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_nay) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truoc) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_naynt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truocnt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, ky_naynt, ky_truocnt, lk_kn_nt, lk_kt_nt, ky_nay, ky_truoc, lk_kn, lk_kt, bold, in_ck, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal FROM #report ORDER BY Stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2LiquidationReport]
	@period AS INT, 
	@year AS INT, 
	@type VARCHAR(32),
	@department VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dateTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year)) - 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc AS ma_bp, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
		INTO #report
		FROM dmccdc a, dmdcct b
	
	-- Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)	
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_tang <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	SET @key = @key + ' and a.status <> ''*'''
	IF @type <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@type, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @department <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@department, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey 
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
			
	SET @q = '
insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 
b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
from dmccdc a with(nolock) left join dmdcct b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
where ' + @key

	EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, ma_bp) SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', ''

	SELECT 0 AS tag, * FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #report b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.line_nbr > b.line_nbr WHERE b.line_nbr IS NULL

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Management$GetEvents]
	@type INT,
	@user_id INT,
	@isEvent BIT,
	@date_start SMALLDATETIME,
	@date_end SMALLDATETIME,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(128),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @user_name VARCHAR(30), @restrictUsers VARCHAR(8000), @number_of_date_before INT, @number_of_date_after INT, @now SMALLDATETIME, @Admin BIT


	SELECT @Admin = admin, @restrictUsers = ISNULL(restrict_users, '') FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @user_name = name FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @user_id
	SELECT @now = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)


	IF @date_start IS NULL AND @date_end IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 number_of_date_before, number_of_date_after INTO #option FROM syseventsoptions WHERE user_id = 0 OR user_id = @userID ORDER BY user_id DESC
		SELECT @number_of_date_before = number_of_date_before, @number_of_date_after = number_of_date_after FROM #option
		SELECT @date_start = DATEADD(DAY, ISNULL(0 - @number_of_date_before, -30), @now), @date_end = DATEADD(DAY, ISNULL(@number_of_date_after + 1, 8), @now) FROM #option
	END
	
	SELECT * INTO #sysevents FROM sysevents where event_yn = @isEvent AND start_date >= @date_start AND start_date < @date_end

	SELECT TOP 0 id, id AS id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do,assigned_name, user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), start_date, 108) AS start_date, 
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), end_date, 108) AS end_date, full_day, details, share_user,share_group,private,status, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS comment, CAST(datetime0 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS datetime0
		INTO #t FROM #sysevents



	IF @type = 1 BEGIN -- All
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT a.id, a.id AS id_event, a.event_yn, a.text, a.type, a.muc_do, a.assigned_name, a.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.end_date, 108) AS end_date, a.full_day, a.details, a.share_user, a.share_group, a.private, a.status, rtrim(b.comment), convert(varchar(10), a.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), a.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
					FROM #sysevents a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id0 = b.id
						WHERE a.user_id0 = @user_id or dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@user_name, a.assigned_name) = 1
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT b.id, b.id AS id_event, b.event_yn, b.text, b.type, b.muc_do, b.assigned_name, b.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.end_date, 108) AS end_date, b.full_day, b.details, b.share_user, b.share_group, b.private, b.status, rtrim(c.comment), convert(varchar(10), b.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), b.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
				FROM syseventsuser a JOIN #sysevents b ON a.id_event = b.id AND a.user_id = @userID
					JOIN vsysuserinfo c ON b.user_id0 = c.id
					WHERE a.id_event NOT IN (SELECT id_event FROM #t)
	END



	IF @type = 2 BEGIN -- Mine
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT a.id, a.id AS id_event, a.event_yn, a.text, a.type, a.muc_do, a.assigned_name, a.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.end_date, 108) AS end_date, a.full_day, a.details, a.share_user, a.share_group, a.private, a.status, rtrim(b.comment) AS comment, convert(varchar(10), a.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), a.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
				FROM #sysevents a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id0 = b.id
					WHERE a.user_id0 = @user_id or dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@user_name, a.assigned_name) = 1
	END




	IF @type = 3 -- Share
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT b.id, b.id AS id_event, b.event_yn, b.text, b.type, b.muc_do, b.assigned_name, b.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.end_date, 108) AS end_date, b.full_day, b.details, b.share_user, b.share_group, b.private, b.status, rtrim(c.comment) AS comment, convert(varchar(10), b.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), b.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
				FROM syseventsuser a JOIN #sysevents b ON a.id_event = b.id AND a.user_id = @user_id AND b.user_id0 <> @user_id
					JOIN vsysuserinfo c ON b.user_id0 = c.id



	IF @type = 4 BEGIN -- Employee
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT a.id, a.id AS id_event, a.event_yn, a.text, a.type, a.muc_do, a.assigned_name, a.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), a.end_date, 108) AS end_date, a.full_day, a.details, a.share_user, a.share_group, a.private, a.status, rtrim(b.comment), convert(varchar(10), a.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), a.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
					FROM #sysevents a JOIN vsysuserinfo b ON a.user_id0 = b.id WHERE a.private = 0 and (a.user_id0 = @user_id or dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@user_name, a.assigned_name) = 1)
		INSERT INTO #t(id, id_event, event_yn, text, type, muc_do, assigned_name, user_id, start_date, end_date, full_day, details, share_user, share_group, private, status, comment, datetime0)
			SELECT b.id, b.id AS id_event, b.event_yn, b.text, b.type, b.muc_do, b.assigned_name, b.user_id0 AS user_id, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.start_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.start_date, 108) AS start_date,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), b.end_date, 103) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), b.end_date, 108) AS end_date, b.full_day, b.details, b.share_user, b.share_group, b.private, b.status, rtrim(c.comment), convert(varchar(10), b.datetime0, 103) + ' ' + convert(varchar(8), b.datetime0, 108) AS datetime0
					FROM syseventsuser a JOIN #sysevents b ON a.id_event = b.id AND a.user_id = @user_id
						JOIN vsysuserinfo c ON b.user_id0 = c.id
						WHERE a.id_event NOT IN (SELECT id_event FROM #t)
	END




	EXEC sp_executesql N'alter table #t add drag bit'
	IF @Admin = 1 EXEC('update #t set drag = 1')
	ELSE BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #tmp(edit BIT)
		DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @q = 'declare @uid varchar(32), @r0 int, @c0 nvarchar(256), @r1 int'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select @uid = '''', @r0 = 0, @c0 = ''Events'' while @r0 = 0 and (@uid is not null) and exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..command where sysid = @c0 and menu_id > @uid) begin select @uid = min(menu_id) from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..command where sysid = @c0 and menu_id > @uid'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' if exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..userinfo where id = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' and patindex(''%'' + rtrim(@uid) + ''%'', r_edit) <> 0) select @r0 = 1 end'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' insert into #tmp select @r0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		EXEC('update #t set drag = 0')
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE edit > 0) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #t set drag = 1 where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' or user_id in (select id from vsysuserinfo where dbo.ff_ExactInlist(name, ''' + REPLACE(@restrictUsers, '''', '') + ''') = 1)'
			EXEC(@q)
		END
		DROP TABLE #tmp
	END
	
	CREATE TABLE #status(status CHAR(1), status_name NVARCHAR(128), status_name2 NVARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #status SELECT '0', N'Chưa thực hiện', N'No Action'
	INSERT INTO #status SELECT '1', N'Đang thực hiện', N'In Progress'
	INSERT INTO #status SELECT '2', N'Hoàn thành', N'Completed'
	INSERT INTO #status SELECT '3', N'Tạm dừng', N'Pending'



	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.status_name ELSE b.status_name2 END AS status_name FROM #t a JOIN #status b ON a.status = b.status
	SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @date_start, 103) AS start_date, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @date_end, 103) AS end_date
	DROP TABLE #t, #sysevents, #status

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF 
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[js_CalcBookExRatex]
	@nCycle TINYINT,
	@nYear INT,
	@cFC VARCHAR(3),
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@cSysDB VARCHAR(33),
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Diff TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- Do not remove two following lines
	IF CHARINDEX('''', @cUnit) > 0 RETURN
	IF CHARINDEX('''', @cFC) > 0 RETURN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @nRound TINYINT, @nRoundTG TINYINT, @i INT, @j INT, @dDate SMALLDATETIME, @dPrev SMALLDATETIME, @dDatePrev SMALLDATETIME, @uKey NVARCHAR(4000), @fKey NVARCHAR(4000), @fKeyExt NVARCHAR(4000), @dKey NVARCHAR(4000), @k NVARCHAR(4000),
		@UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000), @cKey NVARCHAR(4000), @cBaseFC CHAR(3),
		@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME,

		@stt_rec CHAR(13), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @tk VARCHAR(33), @tk_du VARCHAR(33), @nh_dk CHAR(3), @ma_kh VARCHAR(33), @ps_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no NUMERIC(38, 12), @ps_co NUMERIC(38, 12),
		@xma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @xtk VARCHAR(33), @xma_kh VARCHAR(33), @xno_co NUMERIC(1), @xty_gia_gs NUMERIC(24, 12),
		@nAmt NUMERIC(38, 12), @nxRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @cDrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), @cCrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33),
		@isContinue INT, @xCust VARCHAR(33), @dyn VARCHAR(64), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @u NVARCHAR(4000), @q00 NVARCHAR(4000)

	DECLARE @du_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @du_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @line_nbr1 INT, @line_nbr2 INT

	-- Set
	SELECT @isContinue = 0, @cUnits = '', @line_nbr1 = -1, @line_nbr2 = -2,
		@dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nCycle),
		@dKey = '(ngay_ct between @dFrom and @dTo)',
		@fKey = 'ma_nt = @cFC', @fKeyExt = 'ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cFC), '''', '''''') + '''',
		@uKey = ''

	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nRoundTG = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT @cBaseFC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SELECT @cDrDeffAcct = tk_pscl_no, @cCrDeffAcct = tk_pscl_co FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt = @cFC


	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Edit')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(@UnitKey) = '(1 = 0)' RETURN
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @uKey = ' and ' + @UnitKey

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)
	END ELSE RETURN


	CREATE TABLE #r (stt_rec CHAR(13))

	SELECT tk, ma_nt, tk_cn, loai_tk, loai_cl_no, loai_cl_co INTO #dmtk
		FROM dmtk WHERE ma_nt = @cFC AND ma_nt <> @cBaseFC AND loai_tk = 1 AND (loai_cl_co = 4 OR loai_cl_no = 4)

	SELECT * INTO #dmtkno FROM #dmtk WHERE loai_cl_no = 4
	SELECT * INTO #dmtkco FROM #dmtk WHERE loai_cl_co = 4

	SELECT * INTO #dmtkcn FROM #dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 1
	SELECT * INTO #dmtkcn1 FROM #dmtkno WHERE tk_cn = 1

	SELECT * INTO #gltgdd FROM gltgdd


	-- 1. Restore
	SELECT @q = 'delete ct00 where (ma_ct = @cVC or (ma_ct = ''JK9'' and loai_ct = 4)) and ' + @fKey + @uKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @dyn + ' where (ma_ct = @cVC or (ma_ct = ''JK9'' and loai_ct = 4)) and ' + @fKey + @uKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT @q = '
update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_no = ps_no where isnull(gt_no, 0) = 0 and ' + @fKey + @uKey + '
update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_co = ps_co where isnull(gt_co, 0) = 0 and ' + @fKey + @uKey + '
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT @q = 'update u set gt_tinh = 1 from ' + @dyn + ' u where ' + @fKey + ' and exists (select tk from #dmtk b where b.tk = u.tk or b.tk = u.tk_du) and (not exists (select 1 from #gltgdd b where b.ma_ct = u.ma_ct))' + @uKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT @q = '
update u set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 from ' + @dyn + ' u where ' + @fKey + ' and ps_no <> 0 and exists(select tk from #dmtkno a where a.tk = u.tk)' + @uKey + '
update u set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 from ' + @dyn + ' u where ' + @fKey + ' and ps_co <> 0 and exists(select tk from #dmtkno a where a.tk = u.tk_du)' + @uKey + '
update u set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 from ' + @dyn + ' u where ' + @fKey + ' and ps_co <> 0 and exists (select tk from #dmtkco a where  a.tk = u.tk)' + @uKey + '
update u set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 from ' + @dyn + ' u where ' + @fKey + ' and ps_no <> 0 and exists (select tk from #dmtkco a where a.tk = u.tk_du)' + @uKey + '
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT @q = 'delete jgltggs where thang = @nCycle and nam = @nYear and ma_nt = @cFC and ma_nt <> @cBaseFC' + @uKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@nCycle int, @nYear int, @cFC varchar(32), @cBaseFC varchar(32)', @nCycle, @nYear, @cFC, @cBaseFC

	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #gl FROM ct00 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #ct00 FROM ct00 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	--2. GL Account
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@dFrom, 1)

	SELECT @q = '
update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where ' + @fKey + @uKey + ' and ma_ct = ''PK2''
update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_no = ps_no where ' + @fKey + @uKey + ' and gt_no = 0
update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_co = ps_co where ' + @fKey + @uKey + ' and gt_co = 0
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC


	-- Openning Balance
	SELECT @cKey = 'tk in (select tk from #dmtk where tk_cn = 0)'
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdtk

	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #t
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)
		from cdtk a with(nolock, index(nam_tk))
			where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4) + ' and ' + @cKey + @uKey + '
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #t
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)
		from cdtk$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with(nolock, index(tk))
			where ' + @cKey + @uKey + '
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #t
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)
		from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))
			where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39) + ' and ' + @cKey + @uKey  + ' and ' + @fKeyExt + ']%
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @nUserID, 0
	-- End



	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #dudau FROM cdtk
	INSERT #dudau SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #t GROUP BY ma_dvcs, tk

	UPDATE #dudau SET @du_no = ISNULL(du_no, 0) - ISNULL(du_co, 0), @du_no_nt = ISNULL(du_no_nt, 0) - ISNULL(du_co_nt, 0),
		du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END,
		du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

	--3. AR/AP Account
	SELECT @cKey = 'tk in (select tk from #dmtk where tk_cn = 1)'
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t2 FROM cdkh

	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #t2
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)
		from cdkh a with (nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_kh))
			where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4) + ' and ' + @cKey + @uKey + '
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
insert into #t2
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)
		from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with (nolock, index(tk_ma_kh))
			where ' + @cKey + @uKey + '
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #t2
	select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)
		from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(ngay_ct))
			where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39) + ' and ' + @cKey + @uKey + ' and ' + @fKeyExt + ']%
				group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @nUserID, 0
	-- End



	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #dudaukh FROM cdkh
	INSERT #dudaukh SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt) FROM #t2 GROUP BY ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh

	UPDATE #dudaukh SET @du_no = ISNULL(du_no, 0) - ISNULL(du_co, 0), @du_no_nt = ISNULL(du_no_nt, 0) - ISNULL(du_co_nt, 0),
		du_no = CASE WHEN @du_no > 0 THEN @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_no_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt > 0 THEN @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END,
		du_co = CASE WHEN @du_no < 0 THEN - @du_no ELSE 0 END, du_co_nt = CASE WHEN @du_no_nt < 0 THEN - @du_no_nt ELSE 0 END

	-- Calculate
	CREATE TABLE #vc (ma_ct CHAR(3), vc_type CHAR(1), m_phdbf VARCHAR(16), m_ctdbf VARCHAR(16), groupby VARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #vc SELECT a.ma_ct, b.type, a.m_phdbf, a.m_ctdbf, '' FROM dmct a JOIN #gltgdd b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE b.type IN ('1', '2')

	SET @q = 'UPDATE #vc SET groupby = b.groupby FROM #vc a JOIN ' + @cSysDB + '..voucherinfo b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, ngay_ct INTO #xCalcDate FROM r00$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #xCalcDate(ngay_ct) select ngay_ct from ' + @dyn + ' a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where ' + @fKey + @uKey + ' and isnull(gt_tinh, 0) = 0 and exists (select 1 from #dmtk b where b.tk = a.tk) group by ngay_ct order by ngay_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_kh, a.du_no - a.du_co AS du_no, a.du_co - a.du_no AS du_co, a.du_no_nt - a.du_co_nt AS du_no_nt, a.du_co_nt - a.du_no_nt AS du_co_nt, 0 AS xtype
		INTO #xCalc0 FROM #dudau a
	INSERT INTO #xCalc0 (ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, xtype)
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.du_no - a.du_co, a.du_co - a.du_no, a.du_no_nt - a.du_co_nt, a.du_co_nt - a.du_no_nt, 0 FROM #dudaukh a

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt INTO #xCalc FROM #xCalc0

	SELECT TOP 0 a.thang, a.nam, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.no_co, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia_gs, b.du_no, b.du_co, b.du_no_nt, b.du_co_nt INTO #jgltggs FROM jgltggs a, #xCalc b

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, * INTO #xUpdateRate FROM #jgltggs

	-- Index
	CREATE INDEX i ON #xCalc0(xtype)

	SELECT @i = 1
	SELECT @dDate = (ngay_ct - 1) FROM #xCalcDate WHERE stt = @i
	SELECT @u = '
insert into #xCalc0 (ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, xtype)
	select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no - ps_co), sum(ps_co - ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt - ps_co_nt), sum(ps_co_nt - ps_no_nt), 0
		from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))
			where %[' + @fKeyExt + @uKey + ' and tk in (select tk from #dmtk)]%
				group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @u, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dDate, @nUserID, 0

	SELECT @q00 = '
insert into ' + @dyn + ' select * from #gl
insert into ct00 select * from #gl
'

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xCalcDate WHERE stt = @i) BEGIN
		SELECT @dDate = ngay_ct FROM #xCalcDate WHERE stt = @i
		IF @i > 1 SELECT @dPrev = ngay_ct FROM #xCalcDate WHERE stt = @i - 1

		SELECT @k = '(ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dDate, 112) + ''') and '

		-- Post
		EXEC js_ExecReUpdateERD @dDate, @cFC, @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin

		-- Specific
		SELECT @q = '
update r00$%Partition set gt_dd = 1 where %[' + @k + @fKeyExt + @uKey + ' and sua_tg_yn = 1]%
update r00$%Partition set gt_dd = 1 where %[' + @k + @fKeyExt + @uKey + ' and loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from #gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0) and tk in (select tk from #dmtkcn)]%
update r00$%Partition set gt_dd = 1 where %[' + @k + @fKeyExt + @uKey + ' and loai_ct = ''1'' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from #gltgdd where kieu_ct = 1) and tk in (select tk from #dmtkcn1)]%
'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dDate, @dDate, @nUserID, 0

		TRUNCATE TABLE #xCalc

		IF @i > 1 BEGIN
			DELETE #xcalc0 WHERE xtype = 1
			SELECT @dDatePrev = (@dDate - 1)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @u, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dPrev, @dDatePrev, @nUserID, 0
		END

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #xcalc0 (ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, xtype)
	select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no - case when gt_dd = 1 then ps_co else 0 end), sum(ps_co - case when gt_dd = 1 then ps_no else 0 end), sum(ps_no_nt - case when gt_dd = 1 then ps_co_nt else 0 end), sum(ps_co_nt - case when gt_dd = 1 then ps_no_nt else 0 end), 1
		from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where %[' + @k + @fKeyExt + @uKey + ' and exists(select tk from #dmtk b where b.tk = a.tk)]%
			group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh
	'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dDate, @dDate, @nUserID, 0

		UPDATE #xCalc0 SET ma_kh = '' FROM #xCalc0 u WHERE EXISTS(SELECT tk FROM #dmtk a WHERE a.tk_cn = 0 AND a.tk = u.tk)

		INSERT INTO #xCalc (ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
			SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, SUM(du_no), SUM(du_co), SUM(du_no_nt), SUM(du_co_nt)
				FROM #xCalc0 a GROUP BY ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #jgltggs(thang, nam, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt)
			SELECT @nCycle, @nYear, @dDate, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh,
				CASE WHEN b.loai_cl_no = 4 THEN 1 WHEN b.loai_cl_co = 4 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, b.ma_nt, 0, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt
				FROM #xCalc a JOIN #dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk

		UPDATE #jgltggs SET ty_gia_gs = ROUND(CAST(du_co AS NUMERIC(38, 12))/ du_co_nt, @nRoundTG) WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND du_co_nt > 0 AND no_co = 1
		UPDATE #jgltggs SET ty_gia_gs = ROUND(CAST(du_no AS NUMERIC(38, 12))/ du_no_nt, @nRoundTG) WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND du_no_nt > 0 AND no_co = 2
		DELETE #jgltggs WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND ty_gia_gs <= 0

		-- Update
		DELETE #xUpdateRate
		INSERT INTO #xUpdateRate (thang, nam, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs)
			SELECT thang, nam, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs FROM #jgltggs WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate

		SELECT @j = MIN(stt) FROM #xUpdateRate
		SELECT @isContinue = 0
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xUpdateRate WHERE stt = @j) BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #ct00

			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@xma_dvcs varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32), @xtk varchar(32), @xma_kh varchar(32), @cVC varchar(32)', @xma_dvcs, @cFC, @xtk, @xma_kh, @cVC

			-- Case Dr Acct, Ex: 331, 311
			IF @xno_co = 1 BEGIN

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
					--
					SELECT @isContinue = 1, @xCust = ma_kh FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #jgltggs WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_nt = @cFC)

						(
							EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dmtk a WHERE a.tk_cn = 1 AND a.tk = @tk_du)

							SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = ABS(line_nbr)
							EXEC sp_executesql @q00
						END

							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_co_nt) + ABS(ps_co) > 0)

							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

							DELETE #gl
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

							UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
							UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
							SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = ABS(line_nbr)
							EXEC sp_executesql @q00
						END
						INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
					END
					--2.3 Ref Acct is DC Acct
					IF (@isContinue = 1) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #jgltggs WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC) BEGIN
						SELECT @nxRate = ty_gia_gs FROM #jgltggs WHERE ngay_ct = @dDate AND ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC
						SELECT @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@nxRate, @nRound),
							@ps_co = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)

						IF @nAmt > @ps_co BEGIN
							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_co = @ps_co, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_no = @ps_co, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

							DELETE #gl
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

							UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
							UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = ABS(line_nbr)
							EXEC sp_executesql @q00
						END
						IF @nAmt < @ps_co BEGIN
							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #ct00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

							DELETE #gl
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

							UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
							UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
							UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

							UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = ABS(line_nbr)
							EXEC sp_executesql @q00
						END
						INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
					END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crTran2 INTO @stt_rec, @ma_dvcs, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
				END
				CLOSE crTran2
				DEALLOCATE crTran2
			END
			SELECT @s = '
delete a from ' + @dyn + ' a where exists(select 1 from #ct00 b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and b.tk = a.tk and b.tk_du = a.tk_du and b.nh_dk = a.nh_dk)
insert into ' + @dyn + ' select * from #ct00
insert into #r select stt_rec from #ct00
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			--
			SELECT @j = @j + 1
		END --End while @j
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END --End while @i

	-- Update
	INSERT INTO jgltggs(thang, nam, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs)
		SELECT thang, nam, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ma_nt, ty_gia_gs FROM #jgltggs

	SELECT @q = 'update a set dien_giai = b.dien_giai, dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai from ' + @dyn + ' a join v20dmdg b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct where a.ma_ct = @cVC and ' + @fKey + @uKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

	SELECT @s = '
delete a from ct00 a where exists(select 1 from #r b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
insert into ct00 select a.* from ' + @dyn + ' a where exists(select 1 from #r b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	-- Rounding Difference
	IF @Diff = 1 EXEC rc_CreateExDeff @dFrom, @dTo, @cFC, 'JK9', @cUnit, '', @nUserID, @Admin, 4

	DROP TABLE #vc, #gl

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Maintain$Log$Delete]
	@voucherDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherList NVARCHAR(4000),
	@unitList NVARCHAR(4000),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@appMode TINYINT = 0, -- 0. View, 1. Delete data matching selected, 2. Delete data matching filter condition, 3. Delete all
	@result TINYINT = 1 OUTPUT,
	@resultMessage NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF @appMode = 0 SELECT TOP 0 0 AS tag, '' AS ma_dvcs, '' AS ma_ct, '' AS so_ct, '' AS ma_kh, '' AS ten_kh, NULL AS ngay_ct, '' AS dien_giai, '' AS ma_nt, '' AS stt_rec
		ELSE SELECT @result = 0, @resultMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
		RETURN
	END
	IF @appMode = '3' SELECT @voucherDateFrom = NULL, @voucherDateTo = NULL, @voucherList = '', @unitList = ''

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @l NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @v$Code VARCHAR(32), @v$Table$List VARCHAR(4000), @m$ VARCHAR(32), @c$ VARCHAR(32), @p VARCHAR(6)

	-- Voucher List Delete Log
	IF @voucherList <> '' SELECT @voucherList = ',' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@voucherList, ' ', '')) + ','
	ELSE SELECT @voucherList = @voucherList + CASE WHEN @voucherList = '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(ma_ct)+ ',' FROM dmct9 WHERE log_voucher = 1

	SELECT @Key = 'b.status = ''*'''
	IF @unitList <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @unitList, 1, 1)
	IF @voucherDateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ngay_ct >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @voucherDateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @voucherDateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @voucherDateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @appMode = '1' BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$keys') IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @result = 0, @resultMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
			RETURN
		END
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys) BEGIN
