			SELECT @result = 0, @resultMessage = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'Chưa có bản ghi nào được chọn, phải đánh dấu trước khi thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'No record selected, please select at least one record to process.' END
			RETURN
		END
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH([text]) < 2049) SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST([text] AS VARCHAR(2048)), ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' FROM #$keys
		ELSE SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)'
		SELECT @voucherList = ',' + RTRIM(CAST([text] AS NVARCHAR(4000))) + ',' FROM #$vList
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS p INTO #p
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS p INTO #c FROM c81$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS m$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS d$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS i$ INTO #dmct9
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS xreftable INTO #dmct4
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS xreftable INTO #t0

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS id, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS data INTO #data
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS s, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #s

	-- Table
	INSERT INTO #dmct9
		SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct, RTRIM(c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END,RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(m$), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END,
				RTRIM(d$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(d$), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END,RTRIM(i$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(i$), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END
			FROM dmct9 WHERE m$ <> '' AND CHARINDEX(',' + ma_ct + ',', @voucherList) > 0

	-- View
	IF @appMode = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS so_ct, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec INTO #report
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct9) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @v$Code = ma_ct, @c$ = c$, @m$ = m$ FROM #dmct9 ORDER BY ma_ct

			TRUNCATE TABLE #c
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #c (stt_rec, p) select a.stt_rec, convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + RTRIM(@c$) + ' a where ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Key, 'b.', 'a.')) + ''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo
			IF CHARINDEX('%partition', @m$) > 0 BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #p
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #p select distinct p from #c'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #p) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @q = '', @p = p FROM #p ORDER BY p
					--
					SELECT @f = ''
					SELECT @f = CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN @f + ',' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(b.name, '''''') FROM tempdb..syscolumns a LEFT JOIN syscolumns b ON a.name = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@m$, '%partition', @p)) WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#report') ORDER BY a.colorder
					SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select ' + RTRIM(@f) + ' from ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@m$, '%partition', @p)) + ' a where exists(select 1 from #c b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
					--
					DELETE #p WHERE p = @p
				END
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @f = ''
				SELECT @f = CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN @f + ',' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(b.name, '''''') FROM tempdb..syscolumns a LEFT JOIN syscolumns b ON a.name = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@m$, '%partition', '000000')) WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#report') ORDER BY a.colorder
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select ' + RTRIM(@f) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@m$) + ' a where exists(select 1 from #c b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			DELETE #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
		END
		SELECT 0 AS tag, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_nt, a.stt_rec
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		RETURN
	END

	-- Maintain
	INSERT INTO #dmct4 SELECT ma_ct, REPLACE(xreftable, ' ', '') AS xreftable FROM dmct4 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct9 b WHERE b.ma_ct = a.ma_ct)
	INSERT INTO #t0 SELECT ma_ct, xreftable FROM #dmct4 a WHERE CHARINDEX(',', xreftable) > 0
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t0) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #data
		SELECT TOP 1 @v$Code = ma_ct, @v$Table$List = xreftable FROM #t0
		--
		INSERT INTO #data SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@v$Table$List, ',')
		DELETE #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
		INSERT INTO #dmct4 SELECT @v$Code, RTRIM(data) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END FROM #data
		--
		DELETE #t0 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
	END
	DELETE #dmct4 FROM #dmct4 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct9 b WHERE b.ma_ct = a.ma_ct AND b.d$ = a.xreftable) OR RIGHT(RTRIM(xreftable), 1) = '$'

	--
	SELECT @s = 'if object_id(''%table'') is not null delete %table from %table a where exists(select 1 from %prime b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and ' + RTRIM(@Key) + ');'
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct9) BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #c
		TRUNCATE TABLE #p

		SELECT TOP 1 @v$Code = ma_ct, @c$ = c$, @m$ = m$ FROM #dmct9 ORDER BY ma_ct

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@c$) AND name = 'ngay_ct') BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #c (stt_rec, p) select a.stt_rec, convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + RTRIM(@c$) + ' a where ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Key, 'b.', 'a.')) + ''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo
			IF CHARINDEX('%partition', @m$) > 0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code AND CHARINDEX('%partition', xreftable) > 0) BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #p select distinct p from #c'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #p) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @q = '', @p = p FROM #p ORDER BY p
					--
					INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(d$, '%partition', @p)) + REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(i$, '%partition', @p)) + CASE WHEN @c$ <> m$ THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(m$, '%partition', @p)) ELSE '' END FROM #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code) INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(RTRIM(xreftable), '%partition', @p)) FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
					--
					DELETE #p WHERE p = @p
				END
			END ELSE BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(d$, '%partition', '000000'))
					+ REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(i$, '%partition', '000000'))
					+ CASE WHEN @c$ <> m$ THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(m$, '%partition', '000000')) ELSE '' END FROM #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code) INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(RTRIM(xreftable), '%partition', '000000')) FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #c (stt_rec, p) select stt_rec, '''' from ' + RTRIM(@c$) + ' where ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Key, 'b.', 'a.'))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo
			INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(d$, '%partition', '000000')) + REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(i$, '%partition', '000000')) + CASE WHEN @c$ <> m$ THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(m$, '%partition', '000000')) ELSE '' END FROM #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code) INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%prime', @c$), '%table', REPLACE(RTRIM(xreftable), '%partition', '000000')) FROM #dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code AND CHARINDEX('%partition', xreftable) <= 0
		END
		INSERT INTO #s (ma_ct, s) SELECT @v$Code, 'delete ' + RTRIM(@c$) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@c$) + ' a where ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@Key, 'b.', 'a.'))
		--
		DELETE #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @v$Code
	END

	-- Execute
	IF @appMode <> 0 BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #s) RETURN
		DECLARE @i INT
		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #s) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @i = stt, @q = s FROM #s ORDER BY stt
			--
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @d2 smalldatetime', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo
			--
			DELETE #s WHERE stt = @i
		END
	END
	SELECT @result = 1, @resultMessage = ''

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$IR]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nm, stt_rec0nm, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nm INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d74$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_nm, stt_rec0nm, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_nm <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nm <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_nm = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nm = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cPDIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePDIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_nm VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nm, stt_rec0nm, so_luong, he_so, dyn_nm FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nm
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nm <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_nm + ' SET sl_ss = sl_ss - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nm
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update status, datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nm, MAX(dyn_nm) AS dyn_nm FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_nm
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @dyn_nm
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nm <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_nm + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @dyn_nm
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$Voucher$Posting$HistoryPI]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Where VARCHAR(4000),
	@Numeric VARCHAR(4000),
	@String VARCHAR(4000),
	@External VARCHAR(4000),
	@Statement NVARCHAR(4000),
	@StockType INT = -1
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @BaseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q TINYINT, @b TINYINT, @f TINYINT

	IF @StockType = -1 SELECT @StockType = ct_nxt FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	SELECT @BaseCurrency = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	--
	SELECT @q = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @b = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @f = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'

	IF @VoucherCode IN('PNE', 'PNC') BEGIN
		DECLARE @dataTable VARCHAR(32)
		IF @VoucherCode = 'PNE' SELECT *, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec_dh, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(3)) AS stt_rec0dh INTO #d83$ FROM d83$000000 WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '' AND stt_rec = @IDNumber
		IF @VoucherCode = 'PNC' BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec_dh, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(3)) AS stt_rec0dh INTO #d73$ FROM d73$000000 WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '' AND stt_rec = @IDNumber
			SELECT @s = 'insert into #d73$ select *, '''' as stt_rec_dh, '''' as stt_rec0dh from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec_hd <> '''' and stt_rec = @IDNumber'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32)', @IDNumber
		END
		SELECT @dataTable = CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PNE' THEN '#d83$' WHEN @VoucherCode = 'PNC' THEN '#d73$' ELSE @DetailTable END

		SELECT @s = 'declare @stt_rec_hd varchar(32), @stt_rec0hd varchar(32), @line_nbr int, @part varchar(6), @str nvarchar(4000)
		select @line_nbr = min(line_nbr) from ' + @dataTable + '
		while @line_nbr is not null begin
			select @stt_rec_hd = stt_rec_hd, @stt_rec0hd = stt_rec0hd from ' + @dataTable + ' where line_nbr = @line_nbr
			select @part = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from c72$000000 where stt_rec = @stt_rec_hd
			select @str = ''update ' + @dataTable + ' set stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh
				from ' + @dataTable + ' a join d72$'' + @part + '' b on a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0
				where b.stt_rec = @stt_rec_hd
			''
			exec sp_executesql @str, N''@stt_rec_hd varchar(32)'', @stt_rec_hd
			select @line_nbr = min(line_nbr) from ' + @dataTable + ' where line_nbr > @line_nbr
		end
		'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.* INTO #h95 FROM bih95$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #h95 select ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Fields('bih95$000000', @DetailTable, @MasterTable, NULL) + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	SELECT @s = @s + CASE WHEN @where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @where

	IF @VoucherCode IN ('PNE', 'PNC') BEGIN
		SELECT @s = REPLACE(@s, @DetailTable, @dataTable)
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update #h95 set stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh from #h95 a join ' + @dataTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT @s = 'update #h95 set nxt = %t, sl_nhap1 = case when %t = 1 then b.so_luong else 0 end, sl_xuat1 = case when %t <> 1 then b.so_luong else 0 end, dvt1 = b.dvt, he_so1 = b.he_so, status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @External <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + @External + ' from #h95 a join ' + @DetailTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join ' + @MasterTable + ' c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%t', RTRIM(@StockType)), '%q', RTRIM(@q)), '%b', RTRIM(@b)), '%f', RTRIM(@f)), '%r', 'round')
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF @VoucherCode <> 'PO2' BEGIN
		DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @part CHAR(6)
		SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh INTO #ref FROM #h95 WHERE stt_rec_dh <> ''

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0 INTO #dataRef FROM #ref

		SELECT stt_rec, CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) AS p INTO #c95 FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec IN(SELECT stt_rec_dh FROM #ref)
		SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #c95
		WHILE @stt_rec IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @part = p FROM #c95 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec
			SELECT @s = 'insert into #dataRef select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec, stt_rec0 from d95$' + @part + ' where stt_rec = @stt_rec and stt_rec_hd <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@stt_rec varchar(32)', @stt_rec
			SELECT @stt_rec = MIN(stt_rec) FROM #c95 WHERE stt_rec > @stt_rec
		END

		INSERT INTO #h95 (stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_gd, ma_nk, nxt, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_seri, ma_kh, ma_khon, ma_kho, ong_ba, dien_giai, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_nvbh, ma_nv, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, he_so1, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt0, tien0, tien_nt2, tien2, ma_tt, po_ht_yn, tt_yn, line_nbr, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
			SELECT b.stt_rec, b.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, ma_gd, ma_nk, nxt, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_seri, ma_kh, ma_khon, ma_kho, ong_ba, dien_giai, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_nvbh, ma_nv, ma_nt, ty_gia, ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, he_so1, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt0, tien0, tien_nt2, tien2, ma_tt, b.po_ht_yn, b.tt_yn, line_nbr, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
			FROM #dataRef a LEFT JOIN #h95 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_dh AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0dh
			WHERE b.stt_rec IS NOT NULL
	END

	IF @Numeric <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'update #h95 set ' + REPLACE(@Numeric, ',', '=0,') + '=0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	IF @String <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @s = 'update #h95 set ' + REPLACE(@String, ',', '='''',') + '='''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	UPDATE #h95 SET sl_nhap = ROUND(sl_nhap1*he_so1, @q), sl_xuat = ROUND(sl_xuat1*he_so1, @q)

	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	DELETE bih95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	INSERT INTO bih95$000000 SELECT * FROM #h95
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCustomersDebtComparisonBookExport] --fs20_CustomerDebt
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvDateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvDateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(4000),
	@isBalance BIT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Bilingual TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Type TINYINT = 0, -- 1 - HDDT, 0 - Default
	@ReportType TINYINT = 1, -- 1: Group by ID Number, 2: Group by ID Number & Ref Account, 3: No group
	@Excel TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s12 NVARCHAR(511), @s22 NVARCHAR(511), @s32 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @nDu_dk NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_dk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nPs_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @nDu_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @nDu_ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @BalKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @stt INT

	IF @Customer = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Customer = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, tk_du, dien_giai, dien_giai AS dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia
		, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no AS du_no, ps_co AS du_co, ps_no_nt AS du_no_nt, ps_co_nt AS du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, nh_dk, line_nbr
	INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	SET @BalKey = ' and ' + CASE WHEN @Customer <> '' THEN 'ma_kh in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Customer, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(ma_kh) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END

	SET @BalKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@BalKey)
	SET @Key = @Key + @BalKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @ReportType = 3 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, tk_du, dien_giai, '''', ma_nt, ty_gia'
		SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, ngay_ct0, isnull(so_ct0, ''''), nh_dk, line_nbr'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, max(ma_ct), max(ngay_ct), max(ngay_lct), max(so_ct), ma_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN 'max(tk_du)' ELSE 'tk_du' END + ', max(dien_giai), '''', max(ma_nt), max(ty_gia)'
		SET @q = @q + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, max(ngay_ct0), isnull(max(so_ct0), ''''), max(nh_dk), max(line_nbr)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_kh, stt_rec' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN '' ELSE ', tk_du' END
	END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	UPDATE #tmp SET ngay_ct0 = NULL, so_ct0 = '' WHERE ma_ct IN ('PT9', 'PC9')

	IF (@InvDateFrom IS NOT NULL) DELETE #tmp WHERE ngay_ct0 < @InvDateFrom
	IF (@InvDateTo IS NOT NULL) DELETE #tmp WHERE ngay_ct0 > @InvDateTo

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
			, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai2, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.du_no, a.du_co, a.du_no_nt, a.du_co_nt, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS ten_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS dia_chi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS ma_so_thue
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS bi_ten_kh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS bi_ten_kh2
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr

	CREATE INDEX i ON #report(stt)

	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, @s12 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname2 ELSE cname END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'OPBAL'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, @s22 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname2 ELSE cname END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'PRAMOUNT'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, @s32 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname2 ELSE cname END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'CLBAL'

	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_no00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_no_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #Balance FROM cdkh
	SELECT @BalKey = 'c.tk_cn = ''1''' + @BalKey
	INSERT INTO #Balance EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom, @Unit, @Account, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, ' join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk', @BalKey

	-- Khách hàng không có phát sinh trong kỳ
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, tk_du, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
		SELECT 5, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', ''
			FROM #Balance WHERE ma_kh NOT IN (SELECT ma_kh FROM #report) GROUP BY ma_kh

	-- Balance group by Customer
	SELECT ma_kh, SUM(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) AS du_dk_nt, SUM(du_no - du_co) AS du_dk INTO #b FROM #Balance GROUP BY ma_kh

	SELECT a.ma_kh, MIN(stt) AS stt, ISNULL(MAX(b.du_dk_nt), 0) AS du_dk_nt, ISNULL(MAX(b.du_dk), 0) AS du_dk,
			SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt, SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co,
			ISNULL(MAX(b.du_dk_nt), 0) + SUM(a.ps_no_nt - a.ps_co_nt) AS du_ck_nt, ISNULL(MAX(b.du_dk), 0) + SUM(a.ps_no - a.ps_co) AS du_ck
		INTO #g FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #b b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh GROUP BY a.ma_kh

	IF @isBalance = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET
				@nDu_nt = CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt THEN ISNULL(b.du_dk_nt, 0) ELSE @nDu_nt END + a.ps_no_nt - a.ps_co_nt, @nDu = CASE WHEN a.stt = b.stt THEN ISNULL(b.du_dk, 0) ELSE @nDu END + a.ps_no - a.ps_co,
				du_no_nt = @nDu_nt, du_no = @nDu
			FROM #report a WITH(INDEX(i)) LEFT JOIN #g b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			OPTION(MAXDOP 1)

		UPDATE #report SET du_co = - du_no, du_no = 0 WHERE du_no < 0
		UPDATE #report SET du_co_nt = - du_no_nt, du_no_nt = 0 WHERE du_no_nt < 0
	END

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
		SELECT 0, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, @s1, @s12, '', 0
				, CASE WHEN du_dk >= 0 THEN du_dk ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_dk < 0 THEN -du_dk ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_dk_nt >= 0 THEN du_dk_nt ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_dk_nt < 0 THEN -du_dk_nt ELSE 0 END
				, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', ''
			FROM #g

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
		SELECT 1, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, @s2, @s22, '', 0, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', '' FROM #g

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
		SELECT 2, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, @s3, @s32, '', 0
				, CASE WHEN du_ck >= 0 THEN du_ck ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_ck < 0 THEN -du_ck ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_ck_nt >= 0 THEN du_ck_nt ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN du_ck_nt < 0 THEN -du_ck_nt ELSE 0 END
				, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', ''
			 FROM #g

	IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', '' FROM #g
		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, ma_kh, dien_giai, dien_giai2, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, du_no, du_co, du_no_nt, du_co_nt, ngay_ct0, so_ct0, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue)
			SELECT -1, 1, 0, '', '', NULL, NULL, '', ma_kh, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, '', '', '', '' FROM #g
	END

	-- Xóa dòng tạm
	DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = 5 AND stt_rec = ''
	DELETE #report WHERE sysorder = -1 AND ma_kh = (SELECT MIN(ma_kh) FROM #report)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @Type = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiVoucher NVARCHAR(511)
		--
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'
		SELECT @eiVoucher = '(a.ma_ct in (' + (SELECT val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt') + '))'
		--
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct = case when b.so_ct_hddt <> '''' then b.so_ct_hddt else ''' + @ei003 + ''' end' +
			' from #report a join hddt00$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where %[' + @eiVoucher + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	SELECT SUM(ps_no) AS no_dk, SUM(ps_co) AS co_dk, SUM(ps_no_nt) AS no_dk_nt, SUM(ps_co_nt) AS co_dk_nt
			, SUM(ps_no * 0) AS ps_no, SUM(ps_no * 0) AS ps_co, SUM(ps_no_nt * 0) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(ps_no_nt * 0) AS ps_co_nt
			, SUM(ps_no * 0) AS no_ck, SUM(ps_no * 0) AS co_ck, SUM(ps_no_nt * 0) AS no_ck_nt, SUM(ps_no_nt * 0) AS co_ck_nt
		INTO #report2 FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 0

	SELECT @nPs_no = SUM(ps_no), @nPs_co = SUM(ps_co), @nPs_no_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nPs_co_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 1
	SELECT @nDu_dk = SUM(ps_no), @nDu_ck = SUM(ps_co), @nDu_dk_nt = SUM(ps_no_nt), @nDu_ck_nt = SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 2
	UPDATE #report2 SET ps_no = @nPs_no, ps_co = @nPs_co, ps_no_nt = @nPs_no_nt, ps_co_nt = @nPs_co_nt, no_ck = @nDu_dk, co_ck = @nDu_ck, no_ck_nt = @nDu_dk_nt, co_ck_nt = @nDu_ck_nt

	IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET bi_ten_kh = b.ten_kh, bi_ten_kh2 = b.ten_kh2, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND sysorder = 0
	END ELSE
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND sysorder = 0

	UPDATE #report SET dien_giai2 = dien_giai WHERE systotal <> 0

	IF @Excel <> 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET dien_giai = CASE WHEN @Excel = 2 AND @Language <> 'V' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(b.ma_kh) + ' - ' END + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END, dien_giai2 = CASE WHEN @Excel = 2 AND @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(b.ma_kh) + ' - ' END + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE b.ten_kh END
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh where sysorder = 4
		UPDATE #report SET sysorder = CASE sysorder
			WHEN 2 THEN 3
			WHEN 1 THEN 2
			WHEN 0 THEN 1
			WHEN 4 THEN 0
			ELSE sysorder
		END WHERE sysorder IN (0, 1, 2, 4);
	END

	IF @Excel = 2 BEGIN
		IF @Language = 'V'
			UPDATE #report SET dien_giai2 = '' WHERE sysorder = 5
		ELSE
			UPDATE #report SET dien_giai = '' WHERE sysorder = 5
	END

	SELECT a.stt, a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_lct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk_du
			, CASE WHEN @Excel = 2 AND @Language <> 'V'  THEN a.dien_giai2 ELSE a.dien_giai END AS dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN @Excel = 2 AND @Language <> 'V' THEN a.dien_giai ELSE a.dien_giai2 END AS dien_giai2
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.du_no, a.du_co, a.du_no_nt, a.du_co_nt
			, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct0, a.ten_kh, a.dia_chi, a.ma_so_thue, a.bi_ten_kh, a.bi_ten_kh2
			, d.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, d.stt_ct_nkc
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.ma_kh, a.ngay_ct, d.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.stt

	SELECT * FROM #report2

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_VoucherNumberMassUpdate]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@BookCode VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCodes VARCHAR(1023),
	@StartCode NVARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type INT, -- 1 - Xem báo cáo, 2 - Thực thi đánh lại số
	@Size INT, -- Kích thước số chứng từ mới
	@Debug INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin INT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1000), @dlsct_hddt CHAR(1), @dlsct_qt CHAR(1), @dlsct_st INT, @dlsct_st2 INT, @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @dlsct_qt = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_dlsct_qt'
	SELECT @dlsct_st = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_thang_kt'
	SELECT @dlsct_st2 = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_so_thang_kt2'
	IF @dlsct_st > 0 SELECT @dlsct_st = @dlsct_st - 1
	IF @dlsct_st2 > 0 SELECT @dlsct_st2 = @dlsct_st2 - 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1') SELECT @dlsct_hddt = '1' ELSE SELECT @dlsct_hddt = '0'

	-- dmct8: type: 1 - bảng gốc, 2 - bảng post, 3 - bảng qui trình (theo 2 option: _qt, _st), 4 - bảng qui trình (theo 1 option: _st), 5 - hddt (theo 1 option: _st), 6 - bảng quy trình lùi (hóa đơn đầu vào)
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_ct, ref_table, ref_key, ref_update, type INTO #dmct8 FROM dmct8
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #dmct8 select ma_ct, ref_table, ref_key, ref_update, type from dmct8 with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where type in (' + CASE WHEN @dlsct_qt = '1' THEN '1, 2, 3, 4, 6' ELSE '1, 2, 4, 6' END + CASE WHEN @dlsct_hddt = '1' THEN ', 5' ELSE '' END + ')'
	--
	IF @VoucherCodes <> ''
		SET @q = @q + ' and ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCodes, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from v20dmctnk where ma_nk = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@BookCode), '''', '''''') + ''')'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_cnsct' AND val = '1') SET @q = @q + ' and ma_ct not in (' + (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt') + ')'
	--
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Data
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @BookCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_nk = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@BookCode), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @VoucherCodes <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCodes, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'Edit')
	IF @UnitKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_cnsct' AND val = '1') SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_ct not in (' + (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt') + ')'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	SELECT a.ma_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, b.ma_ct_in, b.ct_nxt INTO #dmct FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct FROM dmct8 WHERE status = 1) a JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct

	DECLARE @tins VARCHAR(32), @fins NVARCHAR(4000), @f00 NVARCHAR(4000), @f70 NVARCHAR(4000), @f20 NVARCHAR(4000), @fgroup NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec,
				a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt,
				a.ma_vv, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_ku, a.ma_hd, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, b.ma_ct_in
			INTO #report FROM ct00 a, dmct b

		SELECT @tins = '#report', @fins = '',
			@f00 = 'select a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
				+ ', a.ps_co_nt, a.ps_no_nt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_ku, a.ma_hd, a.nh_dk, a.line_nbr, b.ma_ct_in',
			@f70 = 'select a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.tk_du, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_xuat, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
				+ ', a.tien_nt_n, a.tien_nt_x, a.ma_vv, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_ku, a.ma_hd, 0, a.line_nbr, b.ma_ct_in',
			@f20 = 'select a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, '''', a.t_tt, 0, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia'
				+ ', a.t_tt_nt, 0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_ku, a.ma_hd, 0, a.line_nbr, b.ma_ct_in',
			@fgroup = ''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 a.ngay_ct, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part, a.so_ct AS so_ct_cu
			INTO #res FROM r00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL AS b) b ON 1 = 0

		SELECT @tins = '#res',
			@fins = '(ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct, stt_rec, part, so_ct_cu) select a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112), a.so_ct',
			@f00 = '', @f70 = '', @f20 = '',
			@fgroup = ' group by a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec' -- + ' order by a.ngay_ct, b.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct'
	END

	-- Data from ct00
	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @tins + @fins + ' ' + @f00 + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) join #dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and %[' + @Key + ']%' ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + @fgroup
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Data from ct70, ct90
	SET @s = 'insert into ' + @tins + @fins + ' ' + @f70 + ' from %Table$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) join #dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	SET @s = @s + ' where a.status = ''1'' and b.ct_nxt <> 0' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and %[' + @Key + ']%' ELSE '' END
	SET @s = @s + ' and not exists (select 1 from ' + @tins + ' r where r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'
	SET @s = @s + @fgroup
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'r70')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'r90')
	--EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	-- Data from cttt20, cttt30
	SET @s = 'insert into ' + @tins + @fins + ' ' + @f20 + ' from %Table a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) join #dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct %Join'
	SET @s = @s + ' where a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	SET @s = @s + ' and a.status = ''2'' and a.loai_tt = 0 %VoucherKey ' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @s = @s + ' and not exists (select 1 from ' + @tins + ' r where r.ma_ct = a.ma_ct and left(r.stt_rec, 10) = left(a.stt_rec, 10))'
	SET @s = @s + @fgroup
	IF @BookCode = '' BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'cttt20'), '%Join', ''), '%VoucherKey', 'and a.ma_ct in (''HD1'',''HD3'',''HD6'')')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'cttt30'), '%Join', ''), '%VoucherKey', 'and a.ma_ct in (''PN1'',''PXD'')')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @g NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @g = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'cttt20 '), 'a.ma_nk', 'm.ma_nk')
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@g, '%Join', 'join m21$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'), '%VoucherKey', '%[and a.ma_ct = ''HD1'']%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@g, '%Join', 'join m23$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'), '%VoucherKey', '%[and a.ma_ct = ''HD3'']%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@g, '%Join', 'join m42$000000 m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'), '%VoucherKey', 'and a.ma_ct = ''HD6''')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET @g = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%Table', 'cttt30 '), 'a.ma_nk', 'm.ma_nk')
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@g, '%Join', 'join m31$%Partition m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'), '%VoucherKey', '%[and a.ma_ct = ''PN1'']%')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@g, '%Join', 'join m26$000000 m on a.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'), '%VoucherKey', 'and a.ma_ct = ''PXD''')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @Type <> 1 BEGIN
		CREATE INDEX a ON #res(ngay_ct, stt_ct_nkc, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec)
		--
		EXEC('alter table #res add id_stt numeric(12, 0) identity(1,1)')
	END

	-- Result for report
	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec,
				a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt,
				a.ma_vv, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_ku, a.ma_hd,
				CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh, a.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
			ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.stt_ct_nkc, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct

		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @i NUMERIC(12,0), @count NUMERIC(12, 0), @stt_rec VARCHAR(32), @maxNum NUMERIC(12, 0)
	DECLARE @p1 VARCHAR(32), @p2 VARCHAR(32), @p3 VARCHAR(32), @startNum NUMERIC(12,0), @len_p2 INT
	CREATE INDEX stt_rec ON #res(stt_rec)

	DECLARE @r BIT
	EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @StartCode, @r OUT, @startNum OUT, @p2 OUT, @p1 OUT, 1, @p3 OUT, 1
	IF @p2 = '' BEGIN
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT N'Return: has not number'
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @len_p2 = LEN(@p2), @maxNum = REPLICATE('9', @len_p2)
	END

	-- Update Voucher Number for Temp Table
	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #res
	IF (@count + @startNum) > @maxNum OR (LEN(@p1) + @len_p2 + LEN(@p3)) > @Size BEGIN
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT N'Return: @count > @maxNum'
		RETURN -- Dừng xử lý do số chứng từ không đủ
	END

	UPDATE #res SET so_ct = @p1 + RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', @Size) + LTRIM(@startNum + id_stt - 1), @len_p2) + @p3
	UPDATE #res SET so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(so_ct), @Size)

	-- Update Orginal Tables
	DECLARE @tran VARCHAR(32), @partition CHAR(6), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @m INT, @curDate SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_gh1 SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_gh2 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @ref_table VARCHAR(64), @ref_key  NVARCHAR(128), @ref_update NVARCHAR(511), @ref_type INT
	DECLARE @nPartition INT, @nVoucherCode INT

	SELECT @ngay_gh1 = ngay_gh1, @ngay_gh2 = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_ct INTO #vc FROM #res
	SELECT @nVoucherCode = COUNT(*) FROM #vc

	--SET @tran = 'Tran_Update_Tables'
	--IF @Debug = 1 PRINT 'TRANSACTION: ' + @tran
	--BEGIN TRANSACTION @tran
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #vc

		WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id_stt, ref_table, ref_key, ref_update, type INTO #uptables FROM #dmct8 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			SELECT DISTINCT part INTO #partition FROM #res WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			SELECT @i = 1, @count = COUNT(*) FROM #uptables
			SELECT @nPartition = COUNT(*) FROM #partition

			WHILE @i <= @count BEGIN
				SELECT @ref_table = ref_table, @ref_key = ref_key, @ref_update = ref_update, @ref_type = type FROM #uptables WHERE id_stt = @i

				IF CHARINDEX('%Partition', @ref_table) > 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @partition = MIN(part) FROM #partition

					WHILE @partition IS NOT NULL BEGIN
						SET @Key = ''
						IF @nVoucherCode > 1 SET @Key = 'b.ma_ct = ''' + @ma_ct + ''''
						IF @nPartition > 1 SET @Key = CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.part = ''' + @partition + ''''

						SET @q = 'update ' + @ref_table + ' set ' + @ref_update
						SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @ref_table + ' a join #res b with(index(stt_rec)) on ' + @ref_key
						IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
						--
						IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = REPLACE(@ref_table, '%Partition', @partition) AND type = 'U') BEGIN
							SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Replace(@q, '%Partition', @partition, DEFAULT)
							IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @strSQL
							EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
						END
						--
						-- Qui trình đối với các tháng sau đó
						IF ((@ref_type = 3 AND @dlsct_qt = 1) OR @ref_type IN (4, 5)) AND @dlsct_st > 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @m = 1, @curDate = CAST((@partition + '01') AS SMALLDATETIME)
							WHILE @m <= @dlsct_st BEGIN
								SELECT @curDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @curDate)
								IF @curDate <= @ngay_gh2 BEGIN
									IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = REPLACE(@ref_table, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @curDate, 112)) AND type = 'U') BEGIN
										SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Replace(@q, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @curDate, 112), DEFAULT)
										IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @strSQL
										EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
									END
								END ELSE SET @m = @dlsct_st
								--
								SET @m = @m + 1
							END
						END
						--
						-- Qui trình đối với các tháng trước đó (hóa đơn đầu vào)
						IF @ref_type = 6 AND @dlsct_st2 > 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @m = 1, @curDate = CAST((@partition + '01') AS SMALLDATETIME)
							WHILE @m <= @dlsct_st2 BEGIN
								SELECT @curDate = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @curDate)
								IF @curDate >= @ngay_gh1 BEGIN
									IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = REPLACE(@ref_table, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @curDate, 112)) AND type = 'U') BEGIN
										SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Replace(@q, '%Partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @curDate, 112), DEFAULT)
										IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @strSQL
										EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
									END
								END ELSE SET @m = @dlsct_st2
								--
								SET @m = @m + 1
							END
						END

						IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
							--IF @Debug = 1 PRINT 'ROLLBACK: ' + @tran
							--ROLLBACK TRAN @tran
							GOTO End_Transaction
						END
						--
						SELECT @partition = MIN(part) FROM #partition WHERE part > @partition
					END
				END ELSE BEGIN
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = @ref_table AND type = 'U') BEGIN
						SET @q = 'update ' + @ref_table + ' set ' + @ref_update
						SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @ref_table + ' a join #res b with(index(stt_rec)) on ' + @ref_key
						SET @q = @q + ' where b.ma_ct = ''' + @ma_ct + ''''

						IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
						EXEC sp_executesql @q
					END
					IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
						--IF @Debug = 1 PRINT 'ROLLBACK: ' + @tran
						--ROLLBACK TRAN @tran
						GOTO End_Transaction
					END
				END
				--
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
			DROP TABLE #partition
			DROP TABLE #uptables
			--
			SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #vc WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
		END

	End_Transaction:

	--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
		--IF @Debug = 1 PRINT 'COMMIT: ' + @tran
		--COMMIT TRANSACTION @tran
		--
	--END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIPurchaseAnalysis]
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePrevPeriod AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@GroupBy AS VARCHAR(32),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGroup VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Plant VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @Obsolete BIT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 VARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cPRound AS TINYINT, @cPFCRound AS TINYINT
	DECLARE @DateStart SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateStart = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom)
	SELECT @cPRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'
	SELECT @cPFCRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia_nt'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @Obsolete = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END


	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_nt
			, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt
		INTO #temp_kt FROM wrkin
	SELECT * INTO #temp_kn FROM #temp_kt
	SELECT * INTO #temp_lk FROM #temp_kt

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nxt = ''1''', @Join = '', @Key2 = ''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'

	-- BIMode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE @PlantKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurGroupKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(1023)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)
			IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
		END
		IF @PurOrg <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurOrg), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_nh0', @PurGroup, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGroupKey OUTPUT, '2'
			IF @PurGroupKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurGroupKey
		END
		IF @PurGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @Plant, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((' + @PlantKey + ') ' + CASE WHEN @Plant = '' THEN 'or a.ma_vung = ''''' ELSE '' END  + ')'
		IF @Plant <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END

	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT

	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key2 = ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	END

	SET @q = 'select a.ma_vt, ma_nt, a.sl_nhap as so_luong, a.tien_nhap as tien, a.tien_nt_n as tien_nt'

	-- Ky nay
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kn ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kn ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Ky truoc
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kt ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @DateFrom = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @DateFrom)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePrevPeriod, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_kt ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		SET @DateFrom = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @DateFrom)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePrevPeriod, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_lk ' + @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = 'insert into #temp_lk ' + @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + @Key2 + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateFrom, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--
	INSERT INTO #temp_lk SELECT * FROM #temp_kn

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ma_nt
		, sl_nhap AS so_luong_kt, sl_nhap AS so_luong_kn, sl_nhap AS so_luong_lk
		, tien_nhap AS tien_kt, tien_nhap AS tien_kn, tien_nhap AS tien_lk, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt_kt, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt_kn, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt_lk
	INTO #temp FROM wrkin

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_vt, ma_nt
			, so_luong, 0, 0
			, tien, 0, 0, tien_nt, 0, 0
		FROM #temp_kt

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_vt, ma_nt
			, 0, so_luong, 0
			, 0, tien, 0, 0, tien_nt, 0
		FROM #temp_kn

	INSERT INTO #temp
		SELECT ma_vt, ma_nt
			, 0, 0, so_luong
			, 0, 0, tien, 0, 0, tien_nt
		FROM #temp_lk

	UPDATE #temp SET tien_nt_kt = 0, tien_nt_kn = 0, tien_nt_lk = 0 WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt as ma_vt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(c.dvt) as dvt
		, SUM(so_luong_kt) AS so_luong_kt, SUM(so_luong_kn) AS so_luong_kn, SUM(so_luong_lk) AS so_luong_lk
		, SUM(a.tien_kt) AS tien_kt, SUM(a.tien_kn) AS tien_kn, SUM(a.tien_lk) AS tien_lk
		, SUM(a.tien_nt_kt) AS tien_nt_kt, SUM(a.tien_nt_kn) AS tien_nt_kn, SUM(a.tien_nt_lk) AS tien_nt_lk
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		, MAX(c.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(c.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(c.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(c.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
	INTO #report
	FROM #temp a LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
	GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--

	SET @q2 = 'so_luong_kt,so_luong_kn,so_luong_lk,tien_kt,tien_kn,tien_lk,tien_nt_kt,tien_nt_kn,tien_nt_lk'

	IF @GroupBy <> ''
		BEGIN
			IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = 'loai_vt'
				BEGIN
					SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', @q2, '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(254), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(32), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(254), @n TINYINT
					DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @strSum VARCHAR(512)
					SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'NOGROUP'
					SELECT @nStart = 1, @n = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) + ',', @cItemGroups = ''

					SET @strSum = 'so_luong_kt,so_luong_kn,so_luong_lk,tien_kt,tien_kn,tien_lk,tien_nt_kt,tien_nt_kn,tien_nt_lk'
					WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
						BEGIN
							SET @q = ''
							SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart)))
							SET @n = @n + 1
							IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
							SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt = space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = space(1) + rtrim(ten_vt2) where systotal = 1'
							SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_vt,ten_vt,ten_vt2,' + @cItemGroups + ','
							SET @q = @q + @strSum + ') select ' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
							SET @q = @q + 'max(b.ten_nh),max(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',sum(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),sum(a.') + ')'
							SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join (select * from dmnhvt where loai_nh = '
							SET @q = @q + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@cItemGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b on a.' + @cItemGroup + ' = b.ma_nh where a.systotal = 1'
							SET @q = @q + ' group by a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
							SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set ten_vt = space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + '-2) + isnull(N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ', ten_vt), ten_vt2 = space(' + RTRIM(CAST(@n AS CHAR)) + '-2) + isnull(N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ', ten_vt2) where systotal = 0 and not ' + @cItemGroup + ' is null'
							SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
							EXEC sp_executesql @q
						END
				END
		END

	-- Neu cung ma_nt thi tinh SUM(tien_nt)
	SELECT @nSo_Ma_nt = COUNT(ma_nt) FROM (SELECT ma_nt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY ma_nt HAVING ma_nt <> '') a
	IF @nSo_Ma_nt > 1
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong_kt, so_luong_kn, so_luong_lk', '#report')
	ELSE
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', @q2, '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q2 = 'so_luong_kt, so_luong_kn, so_luong_lk, tien_kt as tien0_kt, tien_kn as tien0_kn, tien_lk as tien0_lk, tien_nt_kt as tien_nt0_kt, tien_nt_kn as tien_nt0_kn, tien_nt_lk as tien_nt0_lk'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) <> ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3, ' + @q2 + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@GroupBy, 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END) + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ' + @q2 + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostS2Closed]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @status CHAR(1)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct, @status = status FROM cs2$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @status = '*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'ms2$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'ds2$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'is2$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'as2$000000'


	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status <> ''5'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''5'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update cs2$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	EXEC fs_PostS2Tran @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @idNumber

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'

	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockReport] --fs20_StockBalance
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1 - Thuc te, 2 - Hoa don
	@DisplayForeign BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM cdvt

	--@Key
	SELECT @Key = 'b.vt_ton_kho <> 0'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	INSERT #tmp EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateTo, @Unit, @Site, @Item, @BalanceType, '2', @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt
			, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
			, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmvt)) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	DELETE #report WHERE ISNULL(so_luong, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(tien, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(tien_nt, 0) = 0

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3', 'numeric(5), varchar(32), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), N#, char(2), #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @DisplayForeign = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE so_luong + tien = 0

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt' , 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt FROM #report order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt FROM #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group, 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_CreateNotifyBIOATran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @priceFormat VARCHAR(32), @amountFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Process Info
	DECLARE @processType VARCHAR(32), @columnBottom VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @processType = '', @columnBottom = '5'
	SELECT TOP 1 @processType = xtype FROM bia10$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	IF @processType = '3' SET @columnBottom = '6'

	-- Get Data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM bim10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM bid10$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE ma_nt = @ma_nt0) BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @amountFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @priceFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_gia_nt'
	END

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val2', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024), val2 NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số thỏa thuận', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct), LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103), CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Nhà cung cấp', N'Supplier', b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2 FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai, dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vt', 100, '', '', N'Mã hàng', N'Item', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vt', 300, '', '', N'Tên mặt hàng', N'Item Description', 'ten_vt', 'ten_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dvt', 50, '', '', N'Đvt', N'UOM', 'dvt', 'dvt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'sl_dat', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng đặt hàng', N'Order Quantity', 'sl_dat', 'sl_dat', 0 WHERE @processType = '3'
		UNION ALL SELECT 'sl_nhap', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng nhận', N'Receipt Quantity', 'sl_nhap', 'sl_nhap', 0 WHERE @processType = '3'
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'gia', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Đơn giá', N'Price', 'gia', 'gia', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'tien', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Thành tiền', N'Amount', 'tien', 'tien', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style,
			CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, RTRIM(a.dvt) AS dvt,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.gia_nt0, @priceFormat) AS gia,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien_nt0, @amountFormat) AS tien,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.sl_dat, @quantityFormat) AS sl_dat,
			dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.sl_nhap, @quantityFormat) AS sl_nhap
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Tiền hàng', N'Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tien_nt0, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Chi phí', N'Charges', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_cp_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Thuế', N'Tax', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_thue_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master
	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, tien)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Tổng tiền', N'Total Amount', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat)
		FROM #master

	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000), val2 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #footContent SELECT '', '', N'Bằng chữ', N'In Words', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'V'), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_tt_nt, 'E') FROM #master

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01250', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01250', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SET @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', nhà cung cấp: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh + N', tổng cộng: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt,
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Supplier: ' + RTRIM(a.ma_kh) + ' - ' + b.ten_kh2 + N', Total Amount: ' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_tt_nt, @amountFormat) + ' ' + a.ma_nt
		FROM #master a JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SET @q = 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Thỏa thuận mua hàng chờ duyệt'', N''Outline agreement waiting for approval'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0'
		+ N', N''Thỏa thuận mua hàng chờ duyệt'', N''Outline agreement waiting for approval'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
		+ CHAR(13)
		+ 'insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2)'
		+ N' select N''Tình trạng duyệt thỏa thuận mua hàng'', N''Outline agreement approval workflow process'', content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12'
		+ N', N''Tình trạng duyệt thỏa thuận mua hàng'', N''Outline agreement approval workflow process'', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''''
		+ ' from #notify$Content'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptDirectCashFlowMultiPeriod] --fs20_CashflowD
	@ReportType TINYINT,
	@Count TINYINT,
	@dateStart SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @i AS INT, @n AS INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @qPS NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @periodName NVARCHAR(1024), @dEndPeriod SMALLDATETIME, @Type CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @Kind CHAR(1), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no VARCHAR(512), @Tk_co VARCHAR(512), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_naynt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @periodName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports where UPPER(ccode) = 'PERIOD'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Phát sinh
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	-- Script để lấy dữ liệu từng kỳ
	SET @qPS = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @qPS = @qPS + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) %[where status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @qPS = @qPS + ']% group by tk, tk_du'

	-- Số dư đầu kỳ
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #cdtk FROM cdtk
	INSERT INTO #cdtk EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @dateStart, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @Key
	--
	SELECT * INTO #cdtkTmp FROM #cdtk

	-- Bảng khai báo mẫu
	SELECT stt, ma_so, ma_so_in, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu, cach_tinh, tk_no, tk_co, dau, ky_nay, ky_naynt, bold, in_ck, ids, iscal, kind, [type]
		INTO #report FROM v20gltc5 WHERE form = @Form

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xPeriod, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, ky_naynt, ky_nay INTO #result FROM v20gltc5
	SELECT TOP 0 tk INTO #acct FROM #ct00
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl FROM #ct00
	CREATE TABLE #tmp (tk VARCHAR(1024))

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @DateStart
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
			WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1, @d)
			WHEN @ReportType = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7, @d)
			WHEN @ReportType = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @d)
			WHEN @ReportType = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @d)
			WHEN @ReportType = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @d)
			WHEN @ReportType = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @d) END)
		SELECT @dEndPeriod = CASE WHEN @ReportType IN (3, 4, 5, 6) THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @d2, 112) + '01' ELSE NULL END

		TRUNCATE TABLE #ct00
