						UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay, Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt, Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt, Lk_kn = @Ky_nay, Lk_kt = @Ky_truoc, Lk_kn_nt = @Ky_naynt, Lk_kt_nt = @Ky_truocnt WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
						GOTO Next
					END
					IF @Tk_no = '#'
						BEGIN
							DELETE #acct
							SET @i = 1
							WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_co)
								BEGIN
									INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_co, @i)
									SET @i = @i + 1
								END

							DELETE #gl
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00
										WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1)
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '') AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')
							INSERT INTO #tmp
								SELECT b.tk_no
									FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_co) = 1
										WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
							DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(a.ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
							DELETE #tmp

							DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_co <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so


							SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
									, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
								FROM #gl
							SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
									, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
								FROM #gl
						END
					IF @Tk_co = '#'
						BEGIN
							DELETE #acct
							SET @i = 1
							WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@Tk_no)
								BEGIN
									INSERT INTO #acct SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk_no, @i)
									SET @i = @i + 1
								END

							DELETE #gl
							INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #ct00
										WHERE Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1)
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '') AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')
							INSERT INTO #tmp
								SELECT b.tk_co
									FROM #acct a JOIN #report b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.tk, b.tk_no) = 1
										WHERE b.ma_so <> @Ma_so AND b.kind = '1' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
							DELETE #gl FROM #gl a JOIN #tmp b ON dbo.ff_Inlist(a.Tk_du, b.tk) = 1 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(a.ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
							DELETE #tmp

							DELETE #gl WHERE (@Tk_no <> '' AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk_du
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_co0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KN') a ORDER BY tk
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_no0 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk_du) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_du FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk_du
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_co1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SET @ds_tk = ''
							SELECT @ds_tk = ISNULL(@ds_tk, '') + ',' + RTRIM(tk) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk FROM #gl WHERE type = 'KT') a ORDER BY tk
							IF @ds_tk <> '' SET @ds_tk = SUBSTRING(@ds_tk, 2, LEN(@ds_tk))
							UPDATE #report SET tk_no1 = @ds_tk WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

							SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
									, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
								FROM #gl
							SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
									, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
								FROM #gl
						END
					IF @Tk_no <> '#' AND @Tk_co <> '#'
						BEGIN
							IF @Tk_no <> ''
								BEGIN
									SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
											, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
										FROM #ct00
										WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)
											 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
											 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')

									SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
											, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_no ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_no_nt ELSE 0 END)
										FROM #ct00
										WHERE (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1) AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1)
											 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
											 AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
											, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
										FROM #ct00
										WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0
											AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')
									SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
											, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_co ELSE 0 END), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') THEN Ps_co_nt ELSE 0 END)
										FROM #ct00
										WHERE Ps_co + Ps_co_nt <> 0
											AND (@Tk_co = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1) AND (@Tk_no = '' OR dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_no) = 1)
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_dvcs), @ma_dvcs) > 0 OR @ma_dvcs = '')
											AND (CHARINDEX(RTRIM(ma_kh), @ma_kh) > 0 OR @ma_kh = '')
								END
						END
				END

			UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt , Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt
				, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt , Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt
				WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
Next:
			FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @ma_dvcs, @ma_kh, @Type
		END
	CLOSE Cal_Cur
	DEALLOCATE Cal_Cur

	-- 10 Manual Data
	DECLARE @strSQLMD NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'ky_truoc', '1', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'ky_nay', '2', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'ky_truocnt', '5', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'ky_naynt', '6', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'lk_kt', '3', 'N')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
		SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'lk_kn', '4', 'N')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
		SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'lk_kt_nt', '7', 'N')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
		SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'lk_kn_nt', '8', 'N')
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
	END

	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'chi_tieu', '9', 'C')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD
	SELECT @strSQLMD = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, '', '01', @Form, '#report', 'chi_tieu2', '10', 'C')
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQLMD

	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = 0 WHERE Ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = 0 WHERE ky_naynt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = 0 WHERE Ky_truocnt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = - ky_nay, ky_truoc = - ky_truoc, ky_naynt = - ky_naynt, ky_truocnt = - ky_truocnt
		, Lk_kn = - Lk_kn, Lk_kt = - Lk_kt, Lk_kn_nt = - Lk_kn_nt, Lk_kt_nt = -  Lk_kt_nt
		WHERE dau = 0

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_nay) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truoc) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_naynt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_naynt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Ky_truocnt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Ky_truocnt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kn_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Lk_kt_nt) FROM #report WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, ma_so_in, thuyet_minh, ky_naynt, ky_truocnt, lk_kn_nt, lk_kt_nt, ky_nay, ky_truoc, lk_kn, lk_kt, bold, in_ck, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal FROM #report ORDER BY Stt
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Import$EditLog]
	@tableName VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@tablePartition VARCHAR(32),
	@type VARCHAR(32) -- Not Used
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @rootTable VARCHAR(64), @logRootTable VARCHAR(64), @refTableList VARCHAR(4000), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @logRefTable VARCHAR(64), @logDay INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @idLog INT, @dNow DATETIME
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @owp CHAR(6)

	SELECT @rootTable = '', @logRootTable = '', @refTable = '', @logDay = 366, @q = '', @i = 0, @idLog = 0, @dNow = GETDATE() 


	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 1 @rootTable = REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END,
			@refTableList = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, ' ', ''), '''', ''), @logDay = logday,
			@logRootTable = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(xtable, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + '$log' END END
		FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT * INTO #refTableList FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@refTableList, ',')

	
	-- Log
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS p, CAST(0 AS INT) AS idlog INTO #idlog FROM wrkgl
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #idlog select a.stt_rec, a.p, isnull(max(b.idLog),0) + 1 from ' + @tableName + ' a left join ' + @logRootTable + ' b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec group by a.stt_rec, a.p'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS p INTO #part
	SET @q = 'insert into #part select p from ' + @tablePartition
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @refTable = REPLACE(data, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END
				, @logRefTable = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(data, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(data, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log' END END
			FROM #refTableList WHERE id = @i
		
		SELECT @owp = MIN(p), @s = '' FROM #part
		WHILE @owp IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #logdata select c.idlog, b.* from #idlog a join ' + REPLACE(@refTable, '%Partition', @owp) + ' b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec left join #idlog c on c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec where a.p = ''' + RTRIM(@owp) + ''''
			SELECT @owp = MIN(p) FROM #part where p > @owp
		END
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @logRefTable + ' from ' + @logRootTable + ' a join ' + @logRefTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.idlog = b.idlog where a.[datetime_log] < dateadd(day, -' + RTRIM(@logDay) + ', @dNow)'
			+ CHAR(13) + 'select top 0 cast(0 as int) as idlog, * into #logdata from ' + REPLACE(@refTable, '%Partition', '000000')
			+ @s 
			+ CHAR(13) + '' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@logRefTable,'#logdata', @logRefTable, @logRefTable, '1=1', NULL)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow datetime', @dNow
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList WHERE id > @i
	END


	SELECT @owp = MIN(p), @s = '' FROM #part
	WHILE @owp IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #logdata select c.idlog, @dNow, b.* from #idlog a join ' + REPLACE(@rootTable, '%Partition', @owp) + ' b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec left join #idlog c on c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec where a.p = ''' + RTRIM(@owp) + ''''
		SELECT @owp = MIN(p) FROM #part where p > @owp
	END
	SET @q = 'delete ' + @logRootTable + ' where [datetime_log] < dateadd(day, -' + RTRIM(@logDay) + ', @dNow)'
		+ CHAR(13) + 'select top 0 cast(0 as int) as idlog, @dNow as datetime_log, * into #logdata from ' + REPLACE(@rootTable, '%Partition', '000000')
		+ @s
		+ CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@logRootTable, '#logdata', @logRootTable, @logRootTable, '1=1', NULL)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dNow datetime', @dNow

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[js_ReCaclPaymentERD] @cVC CHAR(3), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @Group VARCHAR(128), @nUserID INT, @nCharge TINYINT = 0, @Admin BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cIDLineNumber CHAR(3), @nRound INT, @cBaseCur VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT * INTO #master FROM wrkcdtran
	SELECT * INTO #detail FROM wrkcddetail
	SELECT * INTO #inputvat FROM wrkinputvat

	CREATE TABLE #fc (ty_gia NUMERIC(38, 20))

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cBaseCur = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #inputvat' + ' select * from ctgt30 where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''' and loai_ct not in (''0'', ''#'')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE sua_tg_yn = 1) RETURN

	DECLARE @nMethod INT, @cAccount VARCHAR(33), @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cCust VARCHAR(33), @cUnit VARCHAR(33), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @cNumber VARCHAR(33), @nRate NUMERIC(38, 20)
		, @cFC VARCHAR(33), @cFC_i VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @cCust = ma_kh, @cUnit = ma_dvcs, @dVC = ngay_ct, @cNumber = so_ct, @cFC = ma_nt FROM #master

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct = '2')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
			OPEN crPaymentERD
			FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @cAccount = tk_no, @nFCAmount = tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber

					SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_no FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
					IF @nMethod = 4
						BEGIN
							DELETE #fc
							INSERT INTO #fc EXEC js_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cVC, @nUserID, default, @Admin

							SELECT @nRate = ty_gia FROM #fc
							UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate, tien = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound), tt = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
						END
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
				END
			CLOSE crPaymentERD
			DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD
		END

	--
	SELECT @cAccount = tk, @nFCAmount = t_tt_nt FROM #master
	SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount

	IF @nMethod = 4 BEGIN
		DELETE #fc
		INSERT INTO #fc EXEC js_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cVC, @nUserID, default, @Admin
		SELECT @nRate = ty_gia FROM #fc

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1', '2'))
			UPDATE #master SET ty_gia = @nRate
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('9'))
			UPDATE #master SET ty_gia_ht = @nRate
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1'))
			BEGIN
				DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT a.stt_rec0, b.ma_nt AS ma_nt_i FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN cttt30 b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec WHERE b.loai_tt = 0 ORDER BY a.line_nbr
				OPEN crPaymentERD
				FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber, @cFC_i
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
						UPDATE #detail SET tien = ROUND(tien_nt * @nRate, @nRound), thue = ROUND(thue_nt * @nRate, @nRound), tt = ROUND(tt_nt * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
						IF @cFC_i = '' SET @cFC_i = @cBaseCur
						IF @cFC_i <> @cFC AND @cFC_i = @cBaseCur
							UPDATE #detail SET tt_qd = tien WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
						--
						FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber, @cFC_i
					END
				CLOSE crPaymentERD
				DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD
			END
	END

	UPDATE #master SET t_thue = b.thue, t_tien = b.tien, t_tt = t_thue + t_tien
		FROM #master a JOIN (
					SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(thue) AS thue
						FROM (
							SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(thue) AS thue FROM #detail
							UNION ALL
							SELECT 0, SUM(t_thue) FROM #inputvat
							) a
					) b ON 1 = 1

	-- F1 - Begin
	SET @q = 'UPDATE @cDetailTable SET ty_gia_ht2 = b.ty_gia_ht2, tien = b.tien, thue = b.thue, tt = b.tt, tt_qd = b.tt_qd FROM @cDetailTable a JOIN #detail b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE @cMasterTable SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, ty_gia_ht = b.ty_gia_ht, t_tien = b.t_tien, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_tt = b.t_tt FROM @cMasterTable a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC fs_PostCDTran %@cMasterTable%, %@cDetailTable%, %@cIDNumber%, %@Group%, 2, null, ' + RTRIM(@nCharge)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cIDNumber', @cIDNumber)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Group', @Group)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%', CHAR(39))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	-- F1 - End


	DROP TABLE #master, #detail, #inputvat, #fc
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPayableReportByInvoiceExRate] --fs20_APDetailByInvoicesExRate--
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@DateGLFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateGLTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVCFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVCTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateReport SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Size TINYINT,
	@BalView TINYINT,
	@ContractGroup CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @nRound TINYINT, @roundExRate TINYINT,
		@differ NVARCHAR(511), @cname NVARCHAR(1023), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @roundExRate = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT @differ = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DIFFER'
	SELECT @cname = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT076'

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, stt_rec, tk, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_qd0, t_tt0, ma_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_qd, t_tt_nt1, tt_nt
			, tt, t_tt1, t_tt_nt, ma_kh, loai_tt, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, t_tt, so_ct, so_ct0, dien_giai, ma_hd
		 INTO #inv FROM wrkap

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.ma_nt <> '''' and a.loai_tt = 0', @PaymentKey = 'a.loai_tt = 1 and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + '''', @PaymentJoin = ''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @s = ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct0 >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct0 <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @DateVCFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVCFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateVCTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVCTo, 112) + ''''
	IF (@DateVCFrom IS NOT NULL OR @DateVCTo IS NOT NULL) SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 is not null'
	IF @Type = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and tat_toan <> 1'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF @Group1 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Group2 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Group3 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	--
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SELECT @Join = 'left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', @PaymentJoin = @Join
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @PaymentKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@PaymentKey)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_tt, tt_qd AS t_tt_qd, tt_cn AS t_tt_cn INTO #payment FROM cttt30
	SET @q = 'insert into #payment select a.stt_rec_tt, sum(a.tt_qd), sum(a.tt_cn) from cttt30 a with(nolock)' + @PaymentJoin + ' where ' + @PaymentKey + ' group by a.stt_rec_tt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

 	SET @q = 'insert into #inv select ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, stt_rec, a.tk, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_qd0, t_tt0, a.ma_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_nt1, a.tt_nt '
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tt, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_kh, a.loai_tt, a.stt_rec_tt, a.ma_ct, a.t_tt, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN 'a.ma_hd' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt30 a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	IF @BalView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk t on a.tk = t.tk left join #payment p on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @BalView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' and isnull(t.tk_cn, 1) <> 0 and isnull(case when a.ma_nt <> '''' then a.t_tt_nt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_qd else a.t_tt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_cn end, 1) > 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.tk, a.t_tt_nt0, a.t_tt_qd0, a.t_tt0, a.ma_tt,
			CASE WHEN a.tt_qd <> 0 THEN b.ma_nt ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt, CASE WHEN a.tt_qd <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.tt_cn / a.tt_qd, @roundExRate) ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia,
			a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_nt1, a.tt_nt, a.tt, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_kh, a.loai_tt, a.stt_rec_tt, a.ma_ct, a.t_tt, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.dien_giai, a.ty_gia * 0 AS ty_gia_dg0, a.tt_qd, a.tt_cn,
			CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN a.ma_hd ELSE '' END AS ma_hd
		INTO #RecDetail
		FROM cttt30 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #inv b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateGLFrom AND @DateGLTo
			AND (a.ngay_ct0 IS NULL OR @DateVCFrom IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct0 >= @DateVCFrom)
			AND (a.ngay_ct0 IS NULL OR @DateVCTo IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct0 <= @DateVCTo)
			AND a.ngay_ct <= @DateReport

	UPDATE #RecDetail SET tt_nt = tt_qd, tt = tt_cn
	UPDATE #RecDetail SET tt_nt = 0 WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #inv WHERE ma_nt = '')

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_qd0, t_tt1 = t_tt_qd0 * CASE ma_nt WHEN '' THEN 1 ELSE ty_gia END FROM #inv

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_qd WHERE ma_nt <> ''
	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #inv SET tt_nt = t_tt_nt1, tt = t_tt1

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_nt, t_tt1 = t_tt WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 0)

	UPDATE #RecDetail SET t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt = 0
	UPDATE #RecDetail SET so_ct0 = so_ct WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(so_ct0, ''))) = ''

	SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) AS stt_rec, b.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct0, SPACE(@Size - 7) + REPLACE(STR(a.nam, 4) + STR(a.ky, 2), ' ', '0') AS so_ct, b.ma_kh, @differ AS dien_giai, b.tk
			, b.ma_nt, a.ty_gia_dg, a.tien_cl_no - a.tien_cl_co AS tien_cl, a.stt_rec_hd, a.status, a.tien_cl_no, a.tien_cl_co, b.ma_hd
		INTO #tbl_cl
		FROM cttt31 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #inv b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec
		WHERE (b.ngay_ct <= @DateReport) AND (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateGLFrom AND @DateGLTo)
			AND (a.ngay_ct <= @DateReport)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#tbl_cl', 'so_ct', 'CHAR(' + LTRIM(STR(@Size)) + ')')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT loai_tt, stt_rec, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_nt, t_tt, ty_gia * 0 AS ty_gia_dg0, t_tt_nt1 AS tt_nt, t_tt1 AS tt, ma_tt, 0 AS status, CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN ma_hd ELSE '' END AS ma_hd INTO #report0 FROM #inv
	INSERT INTO #report0 SELECT loai_tt, stt_rec, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, ty_gia, 0, 0, ty_gia_dg0, tt_nt, tt_cn, '', 0 AS status, ma_hd FROM #RecDetail
	INSERT INTO #report0 SELECT 0, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_hd, '', ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, RTRIM(so_ct), '', ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, 0, 0, tien_cl, ty_gia_dg, 0, 0, '', status, ma_hd FROM #tbl_cl

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*
			, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec1, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct10, a.ma_ct AS ma_ct1, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct1, a.so_ct AS so_ct1
			, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, ten_kh, a.ngay_ct0 + e.han_tt AS ngay_tt0, e.han_tt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_hd
		INTO #report
		FROM #report0 a
				LEFT JOIN dmct c with(nolock) ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
				LEFT JOIN dmkh d with(nolock) ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh
				LEFT JOIN dmtt e with(nolock) ON a.ma_tt = e.ma_tt

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.*'
	SET @q = @q + ' , isnull(b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec) as stt_rec1, isnull(f.ma_ct_in, c.ma_ct_in) as ma_ct10, isnull(b.ma_ct, a.ma_ct) as ma_ct1, isnull(b.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct1, isnull(b.so_ct, a.so_ct) as so_ct1'
	SET @q = @q + ' , isnull(c.ma_ct_in, '''') as ma_ct0, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_kh' ELSE 'd.ten_kh2' END + ', a.ngay_ct0 + e.han_tt as ngay_tt0, e.han_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.ten_hd' else 'g.ten_hd2' END ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report0 a '
	SET @q = @q + '	left join #inv b on a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmct c with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmkh d with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh '
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmtt e with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = e.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmct f with(nolock) on b.ma_ct = f.ma_ct'
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' SET @q = @q + ' left join dmhd g with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = g.ma_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, LEN(stt_rec) - 3) + ma_ct WHERE RIGHT(stt_rec, 3) <> ma_ct AND ma_ct <> ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct0 nvarchar NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct1 nvarchar NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt_rec1 nvarchar NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct nvarchar NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt_rec nvarchar NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN loai_tt int NULL
		INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, status) VALUES (0, 1, 0, 1)
	END
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''

	IF @ContractGroup = '0'
		SELECT systotal, sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, ty_gia_dg0
				, t_tt_nt, tt_nt, t_tt, tt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, tk, dien_giai, ngay_ct, loai_tt
				, ten_kh, ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1 AS xgroup, '' AS ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, '' AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report
			ORDER BY ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1, ngay_ct, CASE WHEN ma_ct <> '' THEN loai_tt ELSE CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 9 ELSE 0.6 END END, ma_ct0, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	ELSE
		SELECT systotal, sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, ty_gia_dg0
				, t_tt_nt, tt_nt, t_tt, tt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, tk, dien_giai, ngay_ct, loai_tt
				, ten_kh, ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1 AS xgroup, ma_hd, ten_hd, CASE WHEN ma_hd = '' THEN '' ELSE ten_hd END AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report
			ORDER BY ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1, ma_hd, ngay_ct, CASE WHEN ma_ct <> '' THEN loai_tt ELSE CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 9 ELSE 0.6 END END, ma_ct0, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PD]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS refTable
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d96$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when xaction = 0 then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64)

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_sa, dyn_hd, dyn_oa, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ', po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + ' WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update PO
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @refTable, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @refTable + '000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable +  + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF ((@cPCIDNumber <> '') AND (NOT (@cPCIDNumber IS NULL))) BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @refTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @SAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @SAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status in (''4'', ''5''))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status in (''3'', ''4''))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))

		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_sa, @refTable, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrky] AS 
	SELECT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(b.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2, ISNULL(b.bp_ref, '') AS bp_ref
		FROM hrky a LEFT JOIN hrbp b on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
