CREATE VIEW [dbo].[voptions]
AS
SELECT name, val, a.ma_phan_he, a.stt, b.stt AS stt_phan_he, descript, descript2, a.wedition, SUBSTRING(inputmask, 0, CHARINDEX('^', inputmask)) AS type, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) 
                      = 'FN^' THEN SUBSTRING(inputmask, 4, LEN(inputmask)) ELSE '' END AS number_format, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) 
                      = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 2), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_val, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) 
                      = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 3), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view1, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) 
                      = 'CBO^' THEN REPLACE(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(inputmask, '^', ','), 4), '@', ',') ELSE '' END AS cmb_view2, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) 
                      = 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, '@', ','), 5, LEN(inputmask)), CHARINDEX('^', 
                      SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, '@', ','), 5, LEN(inputmask))) + 1, LEN(inputmask)), '^', ','), CHARINDEX(val, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX('^', 
                      SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), '@', ''))) WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 3) = 'FN^' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', '')) 
                      ELSE val END AS val_view, CASE WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 4) = 'CBO^' THEN dbo.ff_GetWordNum(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, '@', ','), 5, 
                      LEN(inputmask)), CHARINDEX('^', SUBSTRING(REPLACE(inputmask, '@', ','), 5, LEN(inputmask))) + 1, LEN(inputmask)), '^', ','), CHARINDEX(val, 
                      REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX('^', SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), '@', '')) 
                      + dbo.ff_GetWordCount(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, CHARINDEX('^', SUBSTRING(inputmask, 5, LEN(inputmask))) - 1), '@', ','))) WHEN LEFT(inputmask, 2) 
                      = 'FN' THEN dbo.ff_NumberFormat(val, REPLACE(inputmask, 'FN^', '')) ELSE val END AS val_view2, CASE WHEN inputmask = CHAR(255) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS check_list_yn
	FROM dbo.options a JOIN dmphanhe b ON a.ma_phan_he = b.ma_phan_he
	WHERE a.attribute = '1' AND a.wedition <> '9' AND b.loai_phan_he = '0' AND b.wedition <> '9' AND b.status = '1'

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptListOfDetailedVariance]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, line_nbr, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_ss INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, line_nbr, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat AS sl_xuat_ss INTO #result FROM wrkin

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = 'b.vt_ton_kho <> 0'
	SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Book
	SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, max(a.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct, max(a.so_ct) as so_ct, max(a.so_ct0) as so_ct0, max(a.ma_ct) as ma_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, 0, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Physics
	SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, max(a.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct, max(a.so_ct) as so_ct, max(a.so_ct0) as so_ct0, max(a.ma_ct) as ma_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat), 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Book
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, '', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, max(a.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct, max(a.so_ct) as so_ct, max(a.so_ct0) as so_ct0, max(a.ma_ct) as ma_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, 0, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Report
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_vt2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_kho ELSE '' END AS ten_kho, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN c.ten_kho2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kho2
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmvt)) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmkho c WITH(INDEX(PK_dmkho)) ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho

	-- Total
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kho, ten_kho2, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(sl_nhap_tt), SUM(sl_nhap_ss), SUM(sl_xuat_tt), SUM(sl_xuat_ss) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	-- Result
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_kho, ten_kho2
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoGenerateInputInvoiceSuppliersView]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(16),
	@Supplier VARCHAR(16),
	@Status VARCHAR(1),
	@Type VARCHAR(1), --1. Chưa có mã, 2. Đã cập nhật mã, *. Tất cả
	@Owner BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@ViewAccessMode BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @Supplier = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Supplier), '''', ''''''), @Unit = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''), @Status = REPLACE(@Status, '''', '')

	-- DECLARE
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @advance BIT, @w NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Key = 'status <> ''*'''
	SELECT @advance = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID

	-- STRUCT
	SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS id, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ky_hieu, ten_kh, dia_chi_cn AS dia_chi, mst_cn AS ma_so_thue, tk_nh_cn AS tk_nh, ten_nh_cn AS ngan_hang INTO #tmp FROM m15$000000

	-- KEY
	IF @Status <> '0' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and status = ''' + @Status + ''''
	IF @Owner = 1 OR (@advance = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0) SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	IF @Supplier <> '' BEGIN
		IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUnitFilter @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ma_dvcs', 'ds_dvcs', 'dmkhdv', @w OUTPUT
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and mst_cn = (select ma_so_thue from dmkh where ma_kh = ''' + @Supplier + ''' and status = 1 and cc_yn = 1' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@w,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @w END + ')'
	END ELSE SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and mst_cn not in (select ma_so_thue from dmkh)'

	-- UNITKEY
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'View')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	-- CHECK KEY
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- DATA
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #tmp (id, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ky_hieu, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, tk_nh, ngan_hang)
	select convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) + char(253) + stt_rec, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ky_hieu, ten_cn, dia_chi_cn, mst_cn, tk_nh_cn, ten_nh_cn
		from m15$%Partition where %[' + @Key + ']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- VIEW
	SELECT 0 AS tag, id, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ky_hieu, ten_kh, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, tk_nh, ngan_hang, '' AS ma_ncc FROM #tmp ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseInvoice]
	@TableNameBefore VARCHAR(33),
	@TableNameAfter VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Resign BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	SELECT @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', ''), @TableNameBefore = REPLACE(@TableNameBefore, '''', ''), @TableNameAfter = REPLACE(@TableNameAfter, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TableVoucher VARCHAR(33), @v BIT, @provider INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	SELECT @TableVoucher = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'c21$000000' WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'c81$000000' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'c86$000000' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$000000' WHEN 'HD2' THEN 'c22$000000' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetOptions 'm_payment', @Unit, @v OUTPUT
	IF @v = 1 SELECT @v = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ph_gn_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	-- PadLeft...
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @TableNameAfter + ' set so_ct_hddt = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(so_ct_hddt)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update status for none release invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p1 (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #stt1 (stt_rec CHAR(13))

	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p1 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' +  @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1
		
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate()'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END	
	
	SELECT @q = ' insert into #stt1 select [key] from ' + @TableNameBefore + ' a where not exists(select 1 from ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.[key] = b.[key])'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt1) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p1 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from #stt1 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate()'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join #stt1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1 WHERE p > @p
		END
	END


	-- Update status for release invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p2 (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #stt2 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_bi_mat VARCHAR(512))
	--
	DECLARE @keyFields NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @keyFields = CASE WHEN @provider = 8 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_return_fields_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 'case when charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) > 0 then substring(%b.so_bi_mat, 1, charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) - 1) else %b.so_bi_mat end' ELSE '%b.so_bi_mat' END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt2 select [key], so_ct_hddt, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt' + case when @provider = 8 then ',' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', '') else ', ''''' end + ' from ' + @TableNameAfter
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p2 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from #stt2 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p
			SELECT @q = @q + ' set mau_hddt = b.mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt = b.so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt = b.so_ct_hddt, tinh_trang_hddt = 2, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()'
			IF @v = 1 SELECT @q = @q + ', trang_thai_tt = case when b.gach_no_yn = 1 then ''2'' else ''0'' end'
			IF @provider = 8 AND @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SELECT @q = @q + ', ck_yn = 1'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'

			IF @provider = 8  SELECT @q = CHAR(13) + @q + 'update hddt01$' + @p + ' set so_bi_mat = ' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', 'b.') + ' from hddt01$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct00 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct00 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct70 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct70 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update ct90 set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from ct90 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r00$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r70$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r70$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = CHAR(13)+ @q + 'update r90$' + @p + ' set so_ct0 = b.so_ct_hddt from r90$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'

			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2 WHERE p > @p
		END
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate '#stt2', @VoucherCode, @Unit, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIMultiPeriodPurchaseAnalysisByTwoCriteria]
	@dateStart SMALLDATETIME,
	@Time AS CHAR(1),
	@Count AS TINYINT,
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(32),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(128),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Mẫu chuẩn, 20 - Mẫu ngoại tệ
	@DataType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Thực tế, 2 - Hóa đơn
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@PurOrg VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGroup VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Plant VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @dateEnd  AS SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sNotDefine NVARCHAR(1024), @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @sNotDefine = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt AS reportby, ma_vt AS groupby, tien0 AS tien, tien_nt0 AS tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_ky, reportby, groupby, tien, tien_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_key INTO #report FROM #tmp
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield_name2 VARCHAR(64), xkey VARCHAR(1024))

	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', '', '', '', '', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'a.ma_vt', 'dmvt', 'ma_vt', 'ten_vt', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'b.nh_vt1', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'b.nh_vt2', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'b.nh_vt3', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'a.ma_kh', 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '6', 'c.nh_kh1', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '7', 'c.nh_kh2', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '8', 'c.nh_kh3', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '9', 'a.ma_dvcs', 'dmdvcs', 'ma_dvcs', 'ten_dvcs', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '10', 'a.ma_kho', 'dmkho', 'ma_kho', 'ten_kho', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '11', 'a.ma_bp', 'dmbp', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp', ''

	DECLARE @join VARCHAR(1024), @reportTable VARCHAR(64), @reportField VARCHAR(64), @reportFieldName VARCHAR(64), @reportKey VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64), @groupKey VARCHAR(64)

	SET @Join = ''
	IF (@reportBy BETWEEN 2 AND 4) OR (@groupBy BETWEEN 2 AND 4) SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF (@reportBy BETWEEN 6 AND 8) OR (@groupBy BETWEEN 6 AND 8) SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'

	SELECT @reportBy = xfield, @reportTable = xtable2, @reportField = xfield2, @reportFieldName = xfield_name2, @reportKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @reportBy
	SELECT @groupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield_name2, @groupKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @groupBy

	SELECT @dateEnd = DATEADD(day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 3 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 6 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 12 * @Count, @DateStart)
		END)

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 1, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	-- BIMode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE @PlantKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurGroupKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(1023)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', @PurOrg, @UserID, @Admin)
			IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
		END
		IF @PurOrg <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurOrg), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_nh0', @PurGroup, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGroupKey OUTPUT, '2'
			IF @PurGroupKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurGroupKey
		END
		IF @PurGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nh0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PurGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''

		EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @Plant, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((' + @PlantKey + ') ' + CASE WHEN @Plant = '' THEN 'or a.ma_vung = ''''' ELSE '' END  + ')'
		IF @Plant <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '''''' ELSE @GroupBy END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'sum(tien_nhap), sum(case when (a.ma_nt = '''' or a.ma_nt is null) then 0 else tien_nt_n end)'
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateStart, @dateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateStart, @dateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @dateStart, @d2 = DATEADD(Day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @dateStart) END)
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', N''' + @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) + ''', reportby, groupby, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '''' FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112) + ''' AND ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d2, 112) + ''' GROUP BY reportby, groupby'
		SET @q = @q + ' INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 1, 0, ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', N''' + @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) + ''', reportby, groupby, 0, 0, '''' FROM #tmp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @d) END)
	END

	UPDATE #report SET reportby = CHAR(255) WHERE ISNULL(reportby, '') = ''
	UPDATE #report SET groupby = CHAR(255) WHERE ISNULL(groupby, '') = ''

	--Order
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'create table #o (stt int identity(1, 1) not null, reportby varCHAR(32) not null, groupby varCHAR(32) not null)'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #o select distinct reportby, groupby from #report order by groupby, reportby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, groupby into #o2 from #o group by groupby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = b.stt - c.stt + 1 from #report a join #o b on a.groupby = b.groupby and a.reportby = b.reportby join #o2 c on a.groupby = c.groupby'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'create table #o (stt int identity(1, 1) not null, reportby varCHAR(32) not null)'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #o select distinct reportby from #report order by reportby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = b.stt from #report a join #o b on a.reportby = b.reportby'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Tao group
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 3, 0, 1, 0, ky, max(ten_ky), '''', groupby, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), isnull(max(' + @groupFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), N''' + @sNotDefine + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.groupby = b.' + @groupField + CASE WHEN @groupKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @groupKey END + ' group by ky, groupby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = null where sysorder = 3'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, replace(str(a.ky, 3), '' '', ''0'') as fkey, a.groupby as tkey, a.ten_ky, tien, tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', groupby + reportby + isnull(rtrim(stt), '''') as xkey, case when ten_key <> '''' then ten_key else ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE 'space(2) + ' END + 'isnull(' + @reportFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', N''' + @sNotDefine + ''') end as ten_key'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when reportby = char(255) then '''' else reportby end as xdetail'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @reportTable + ' b ON a.reportby = b.' + @reportField + CASE WHEN @reportKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @reportKey END
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.groupby, a.stt, a.ky'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT ky AS id, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END + RTRIM(ky) AS name, MAX(ten_ky) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY ky ORDER BY ky
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien' ELSE 'tien_nt' END, @sTotal
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticles]
	@PeriodFrom NUMERIC(2)
	, @YearFrom NUMERIC(4)
	, @PeriodTo NUMERIC(2)
	, @YearTo NUMERIC(4)
	, @ReportType TINYINT -- 1 - Chi tiet, 2 - Tong hop
	, @Unit VARCHAR(1023)
	, @Language CHAR(1)
	, @UserID INT
	, @Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @DateFrom = RTRIM(@YearFrom) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodFrom,2),' ', '0') + '01', @DateTo = RTRIM(@YearTo) + REPLACE(STR(@PeriodTo,2),' ', '0') +  + '01'

	-- Chỉ tiêu theo từng đơn vị cơ sở
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_so2, chi_tieu, kind, stt INTO #gltcptct0 FROM gltcptct0
	IF @ReportType = 1
		SET @q = 'insert into #gltcptct0 select b.ma_dvcs, a.ma_so, a.ma_so2, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'a.chi_tieu' ELSE ' a.chi_tieu2' END + ', a.kind, a.stt from gltcptct0 a, (select ma_dvcs from dmdvcs ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' where ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ') b'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'insert into #gltcptct0 select '''', ma_so, ma_so2, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'chi_tieu' ELSE 'chi_tieu2' END + ', kind, stt from gltcptct1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, a.ma_so, a.ma_so2, a.chi_tieu, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.kind, b.ma_dvcs, a.stt INTO #tResult FROM gltcptct0 a, gltcptct$000000 b
	
	-- Check date
	DECLARE @DateKey NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @dStart SMALLDATETIME
	IF @DateFrom > @DateTo BEGIN
		SELECT ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_so2, chi_tieu, tien, tien_nt, kind FROM #tResult	ORDER BY nam, ky, ma_dvcs, stt, ma_so
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #tResult select right(%Partition, 2), left(%Partition, 4), a.ma_so, ma_so2, chi_tieu, isnull(b.tien, 0), isnull(b.tien_nt, 0), kind, a.ma_dvcs, a.stt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #gltcptct0 a left join (select * from gltcptct$%Partition where %[dang_bc = ' + RTRIM(@ReportType)
	IF @ReportType = 1 AND @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @q = @q + ']%) b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT ky, nam, ma_dvcs, ma_so, ma_so2, chi_tieu, tien, tien_nt, kind FROM #tResult ORDER BY nam, ky, ma_dvcs, stt, ma_so

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryVarianceReportForConsolidate]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s AS NVARCHAR(511), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #balancePhysics FROM cdvt
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS so_luong, du00 AS tien, du_nt00 AS tien_nt INTO #balanceBook FROM cdvt

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00 AS ton_dau_tt, ton00 AS ton_dau_ss, ton00 AS sl_nhap_tt, ton00 AS sl_nhap_ss, ton00 AS sl_xuat_tt, ton00 AS sl_xuat_ss INTO #tmp FROM cdvt

	--Key
	SELECT @Key = 'b.vt_ton_kho <> 0'
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #balancePhysics EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, @Item, 1, 2, 1, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #balanceBook EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, @Item, 1, 2, 2, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key

	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, so_luong, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #balancePhysics
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, 0, so_luong, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #balanceBook

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Book
	SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select max(a.ma_kho), a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Physics
	SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat), 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, '', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SET @q = ' insert into #tmp select max(a.ma_kho), a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sum(sl_nhap), 0, sum(sl_xuat)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	-- Report
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt
			, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
			, SUM(ton_dau_tt) AS ton_dau_tt, SUM(ton_dau_ss) AS ton_dau_ss, SUM(sl_nhap_tt) AS sl_nhap_tt, SUM(sl_nhap_ss) AS sl_nhap_ss
			, SUM(sl_xuat_tt) AS sl_xuat_tt, SUM(sl_xuat_ss) AS sl_xuat_ss
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH (INDEX(PK_dmvt)) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3', 'numeric(5), varchar(32), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), N#, char(2), #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau_tt + ton_dau_ss + sl_nhap_tt + sl_nhap_ss + sl_xuat_tt + sl_xuat_ss = 0

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--
	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt' , 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'ton_dau_tt, ton_dau_ss, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'vt', 'ton_dau_tt, ton_dau_ss, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	--
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ton_dau_tt, ton_dau_ss, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(ton_dau_tt), SUM(ton_dau_ss), SUM(sl_nhap_tt), SUM(sl_nhap_ss), SUM(sl_xuat_tt), SUM(sl_xuat_ss) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, '
	SET @q = @q + ' ton_dau_tt, ton_dau_ss, sl_nhap_tt, sl_nhap_ss, sl_xuat_tt, sl_xuat_ss,'
	SET @q = @q + ' (ton_dau_tt + sl_nhap_tt - sl_xuat_tt) as ton_cuoi_tt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' (ton_dau_ss + sl_nhap_ss - sl_xuat_ss) as ton_cuoi_ss,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ((ton_dau_tt + sl_nhap_tt - sl_xuat_tt) - (ton_dau_ss + sl_nhap_ss - sl_xuat_ss)) as sl_cl,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when (sl_nhap_tt - sl_nhap_ss) <> 0 and systotal = 1 then ''1'' else ''0'' end as view_nhap_yn,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when (sl_xuat_tt - sl_xuat_ss) <> 0 and systotal = 1 then ''1'' else ''0'' end as view_xuat_yn'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report'

	IF (RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = '') SET @q = @q + ' order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
		ELSE SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group, 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintOATran] --fs_PrintPOTran
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table VARCHAR(32), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Table = REPLACE(@Table, '''', '')
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia_nt0 as gia_nt, a.gia0 as gia, a.tien_nt0 as tien_nt, a.tien0 as tien, a.thue_nk_nt + a.thue_ttdb_nt + a.thue_bvmt_nt + a.thue_nt as thue_nt, a.thue_nk + a.thue_ttdb + a.thue_bvmt + a.thue as thue'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt' -- song ngữ
	ELSE SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ngay_giao, a.ngay_ct, stt_rec_nc, isnull(b.so_ct, '''') as so_nc'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @Table + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt left outer join c91$000000 b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_giao smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #report alter column ngay_ct smalldatetime null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @Voucher + ''', '''', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 ngay_giao from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BankHub$TransferTransaction]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@BankCode VARCHAR(33),
	@IdNumber VARCHAR(4000),
	@VoucherDate VARCHAR(4000),
	@ListDays VARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @bankAccountUnit CHAR(1)

	IF @IdNumber = '' OR @VoucherDate = '' OR @ListDays = '' OR @BankCode = '' BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS code, '' AS field, '' AS message
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @bankAccountUnit = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_td_tknh_dv'
	SELECT @bankAccountUnit = ISNULL(@bankAccountUnit, '0')

	CREATE TABLE #id(id INT, stt_rec VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #d(id INT, ngay_ct VARCHAR(32))
	CREATE TABLE #d2(id INT, datetime2 VARCHAR(32))

	CREATE TABLE #idPayment(stt_rec VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, datetime2 VARCHAR(32))

	INSERT INTO #id SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@IdNumber, ',')
	INSERT INTO #d SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@VoucherDate, ',')
	INSERT INTO #d2 SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ListDays, ',')

	INSERT INTO #idPayment(stt_rec, ngay_ct, datetime2)
			SELECT a.stt_rec, b.ngay_ct, c.datetime2 FROM #id a JOIN #d b ON a.id = b.id JOIN #d2 c ON a.id = c.id


	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, b.ma_kh, b.dia_chi, b.tk, a.tk_nh, a.chu_tk, a.ma_nh_dt, a.ten_nh, a.chi_nhanh, a.tinh_thanh,
			a.quoc_gia, b.ma_nt, b.t_tt, a.loai_gd, a.dien_giai,  a.phi_nhan_yn, a.ma_gd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS bank_code, a.ma_citad
		INTO #t FROM knnh00$000000 a, m56$000000 b


	SET @q = N'insert into #t
select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, b.ma_kh, b.dia_chi, b.tk, a.tk_nh, a.chu_tk, a.ma_nh_dt, a.ten_nh, a.chi_nhanh, a.tinh_thanh,
			a.quoc_gia, b.ma_nt, b.t_tt_nt, a.loai_gd, a.dien_giai, a.phi_nhan_yn, a.ma_gd, '''', isnull(a.ma_citad, '''')
	from knnh00$%Partition a with(nolock) join m56$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		join #idPayment c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
	where %[a.nh_dt_yn = ''1'']%
'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @BankCode = 'MB' UPDATE #t SET ma_gd = LEFT(REPLACE(NEWID(), '-', ''), 13)
	ELSE UPDATE #t SET ma_gd = REPLACE(NEWID(), '-', '')

	SET @q = N'update knnh00$%Partition set ma_gd = b.ma_gd from knnh00$%Partition a with(nolock) join #t b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @benAccountType VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @benAccountType = '' -- ACCOUNT / CARD

	IF @BankCode IN ('MB', 'OCB') SET @benAccountType = 'ACCOUNT'

	UPDATE #t SET bank_code = b.bank_code FROM #t a JOIN dmmsnh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh_dt = b.ma_nh_dt
	UPDATE #t SET bank_code = b.bank_code_ref FROM #t a JOIN dmmsnh2 b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh_dt = b.ma_nh_dt WHERE b.ma_nh = @BankCode

	IF @BankCode = 'OCB' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE loai_gd = '2') BEGIN
		UPDATE #t SET bank_code = ma_citad WHERE ma_citad <> '' AND loai_gd = '2'
		UPDATE #t SET bank_code = b.citad FROM #t a JOIN dmmsnh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_nh_dt = b.ma_nh_dt WHERE a.ma_citad = ''  AND loai_gd = '2'
	END

	SELECT stt_rec AS IdNumber, a.ma_dvcs AS UnitCode, a.ma_nt AS Currency, CAST(a.t_tt AS NUMERIC(19, 0)) AS Amount, c.cif_code AS CIFCode, c.user_nh AS BankUserName, b.tknh AS SenderAccount, b.chu_tk AS SenderName,
			a.tk_nh AS BenAccount, a.chu_tk AS BenAccountName, a.bank_code AS BenBankCode, a.ten_nh AS BenBankName, a.chi_nhanh AS BenBranchName, @benAccountType AS BenAccountType,
			a.tinh_thanh AS BenCity, a.quoc_gia AS BenCountry, a.loai_gd AS ServiceID, a.dien_giai AS Note, a.phi_nhan_yn AS FeeSide, a.ma_gd AS ClientTransID, '' AS BenCardNumber
		FROM #t a JOIN dmtknh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.tk = b.tk AND (a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs OR @bankAccountUnit = '0')
			JOIN dmknnh c WITH(NOLOCK) ON b.tknh = c.so_tk_nh AND c.ma_nh_dt = @BankCode
			JOIN dmtknhnsd d WITH(NOLOCK) ON c.ma_kn = d.ma_kn AND d.user_id = @UserID

	DROP TABLE #id
	DROP TABLE #d
	DROP TABLE #d2
	DROP TABLE #idPayment
	DROP TABLE #t


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_PrintTSDecrease]
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cE = CASE @cLan WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END

	SET @strSQL =  'select b.ma_nv, rtrim(b.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(b.ten_nv) as ten_nv, a.so_luong, a.ma_cc, a.loai, c.ten_cc' + @cE + ' as ten_cc, a.ngay_hh, a.ghi_chu as dien_giai, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' into #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @cDTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' left join hrnv b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec left join hrcc c on a.ma_cc = c.ma_cc'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 0, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', '''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAllocationByRatio] -- fs20_Copbcphso
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33), 
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @x_round_hs INT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @x_round_hs = val FROM options WHERE name = 'x_round_hs'
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(a.ma_yt)) in (''' + REPLACE(@CE, ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
	IF @costUnit = 1 BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0 AS ma_bp0, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp, a.so_lsx AS so_lsx, a.ma_sp AS ma_sp, a.ma_yt AS ma_yt
			, a.he_so AS he_so, a.sl_tk AS sl_tk, a.ps_tk AS ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt AS ps_tk_nt
			, b.loai_yt AS loai_yt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_sx, a.he_so * 0 AS he_so_dv
		INTO #report FROM xctpbtg a, xdmyt b
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN loai_yt VARCHAR(33) NULL

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_yt, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, loai_yt, sl_sx, he_so_dv)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_yt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' sum(a.he_so), sum(a.sl_tk), sum(a.ps_tk), sum(a.ps_tk_nt), max(b.loai_yt), 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctpbtg a with(nolock) left join xdmyt b with(nolock) on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.loai_yt) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '', '')
	ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET sl_sx = b.sl_sx FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM xcdloaiytdd2 WHERE ky = @Period AND nam = @Year) b 
			ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.loai_yt = b.loai_yt and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
		UPDATE #report SET he_so_dv = CASE WHEN sl_sx = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(he_so/sl_sx, @x_round_hs) END
	END

	SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_sp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_sp2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END




GO
CREATE FUNCTION mf_GetWorkDate (@d SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS SMALLDATETIME
BEGIN 
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mdmlichlv WHERE ngay_nghi = @d)
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(day, -1, @d)

	RETURN @d
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CheckTransfer]
	@id CHAR(3), -- id khai báo ngầm các chức năng
	@define INT, -- id table khai báo
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@dbOrg VARCHAR(32),
	@dbDest VARCHAR(32),
	@key NVARCHAR(4000), -- key dữ liệu transfer
	@type CHAR(1), --1: Danh muc, 2:  Số dư, 3: Chứng từ
	@checkdir INT = 1, -- Kiểm tra lồng mã hay không trong danh mục
	@override INT, -- 0/1
	@transferType INT = 1, --1: db to db, 2: db to file, 3:  file to db
	@checkexists TINYINT,
	@dircheckunit TINYINT,
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @join NVARCHAR(4000), @where NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @i0 INT, @j INT, @count INT, @count0 INT, @tbl VARCHAR(32), @tbl0 VARCHAR(32), @xfield VARCHAR(33), @fref VARCHAR(64), @fcheck VARCHAR(1023), @forg VARCHAR(1023), @tblorg VARCHAR(1023), @f VARCHAR(33), @t VARCHAR(64), @f2 VARCHAR(33), @f0 VARCHAR(33), @f20 VARCHAR(33), @c1 VARCHAR(33), @c2 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, * INTO #check FROM syschecktransfer WHERE id = @id AND status = '1'
	ALTER TABLE #check ALTER COLUMN forg VARCHAR(1023) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #check ALTER COLUMN tblorg VARCHAR(1023) NULL
	ALTER TABLE #check ALTER COLUMN fcheck VARCHAR(1023) NULL

	IF @type = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #check) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #check(id, tbl, field, fref, fcheck, forg, tblorg, xgroup)
			SELECT id, xfile, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(xref, 1, ','), '', '', '', '', '' FROM systransfer WHERE id = @id AND xtype = 'D' AND xcheck = 1 AND status = 1

		INSERT INTO #check(id, tbl, field, fref, fcheck, forg, tblorg, xgroup)
			SELECT id, xfile, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(xref, 1, ','), dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(xref, 2, ','), '', '', '', '' FROM systransfer WHERE id = @id AND xtype = 'G' AND xcheck = 1 AND status = 1
	END

	UPDATE #check SET fcheck = CASE WHEN a.fcheck <> '' THEN a.fcheck + ',' + b.xfield ELSE b.xfield END,
			forg = CASE WHEN a.forg <> '' THEN a.forg + ',' + REPLACE(b.xfield, 'ma_sp', 'ma_vt') ELSE REPLACE(b.xfield, 'ma_sp', 'ma_vt') END,
			tblorg = CASE WHEN a.tblorg <> '' THEN a.tblorg + ',' + b.xtable ELSE b.xtable END
		FROM #check a JOIN sysfreegroup b ON a.xgroup = b.xgroup WHERE ISNULL(a.xgroup, '') <> '' AND b.xfield <> ''


	SELECT TOP 0 id, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec INTO #vc FROM syschecktransfer
	SELECT TOP 0 id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS code, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS coderef INTO #dir FROM syschecktransfer

	IF (@dbOrg = '' OR @dbDest = '' OR @transferType = 2) GOTO Result

	IF @type = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #systransfer WHERE id = @id AND xtblref <> '') SET @key = REPLACE(@key, ' and ', ' and a.')
	SELECT @i = 1
	SELECT @count = MAX(stt) FROM #check

	-- Unicode
	IF @type = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #systransfer WHERE id = @id AND CHARINDEX('1', unicode_yn) > 0) BEGIN
		DECLARE @qFields NVARCHAR(4000), @unicodeFields VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @unicodeFields = unicode_yn FROM #systransfer WHERE id = @id
		SELECT @qFields = 'alter table #dir alter column code %type%; alter table #dir alter column coderef %type2%;'

		IF RTRIM(@unicodeFields) = '1' SELECT @qFields = REPLACE(@qFields, '%type%', 'nvarchar(33)')
		IF dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@unicodeFields, 2, ',') = '1' SELECT @qFields = REPLACE(@qFields, '%type2%', 'nvarchar(33)')
		SELECT @qFields = REPLACE(REPLACE(@qFields, '%type%', 'varchar(33)'), '%type2%', 'varchar(33)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @qFields
	END


	WHILE (@i <= @count) BEGIN
		SELECT @tbl = tbl, @tbl0 = tbl, @xfield = field, @fref = ISNULL(fref, ''), @fcheck = ISNULL(fcheck, ''), @forg = ISNULL(forg, ''), @tblorg = ISNULL(tblorg, '') FROM #check WHERE stt = @i
		IF @transferType = 3 SELECT @tbl0 = 'transfer' + @tbl0 --REPLACE(REPLACE(@tbl0, '$%Partition', '$'), '$000000', '$')

		IF @type = 1 AND @checkdir = 1 AND @override = 0 BEGIN
			-- Duplicate code
			SET @q = 'if exists (select 1 from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a join %dest.dbo.' + @tbl + ' b on ' + CASE WHEN @fref <> '' THEN ' a.' + @fref + ' = b.' + @fref + ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(b.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'' or b.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(a.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'') where ' + @key + ') begin'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into convertmessage select ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@define))) + ', ''' + @id + ''', ''' + @tbl + ''' + a.' + @xfield + ' from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a join %dest.dbo.' + @tbl + ' b on ' + CASE WHEN @fref <> '' THEN ' a.' + @fref + ' = b.' + @fref + ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(b.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'' or b.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(a.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'') where ' + @key
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #dir select ''' + @id + ''', a.' + @xfield + CASE WHEN @fref <> '' THEN ', a.' + @fref ELSE ', ''''' END + ' from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a join %dest.dbo.' + @tbl + ' b on ' + CASE WHEN @fref <> '' THEN ' a.' + @fref + ' = b.' + @fref + ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(a.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(b.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'' or b.' + @xfield + ' like rtrim(a.' + @xfield + ') + ''%'') where ' + @key + ' end'
			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%org', @dbOrg), '%dest', @dbDest)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		IF @dircheckunit = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @fcheck = REPLACE(@fcheck, ',&ds_dvcs', '')
			SELECT @fcheck = REPLACE(@fcheck, '&ds_dvcs', '')
		END
		IF @checkexists = 0 OR @fcheck = '' GOTO Next

		-- Check object exists
		SELECT @i0 = 1, @count0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@fcheck, ',')
		WHILE (@i0 <= @count0) BEGIN
			SELECT @f0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@fcheck, @i0, ','), @f20 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@forg, @i0, ','), @t = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@tblorg, @i0, ',')
			SELECT @f = @f0, @f2 = @f20

			IF CHARINDEX('(', @f0) > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @f = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f0, 1, '('), @f2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f20, 1, '(')
				SELECT @f0 = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f0, '(', ','), '+', ','), ')', ''), ' ', ''), @f20 = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f20, '(', ','), '+', ','), ')', ''), ' ', '')
				SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f0, 2, ','), @c2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f20, 2, ',')
				SELECT @j = 3, @join = ' a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c2

				WHILE (@j <= dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@f0, ',')) BEGIN
					SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f0, @j, ','), @c2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(@f20, @j, ',')
					SET @join = @join + ' and a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c2
					SELECT @j = @j + 1
				END
			END ELSE SELECT @join = ' a.' + @f + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('&', @f) > 0 THEN ' like ''%#'' + ' ELSE ' = ' END + 'rtrim(ltrim(b.' + @f2 + '))' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('&', @f) > 0 THEN ' + ''#%'' having dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(a.' + @f + ', ''#'') - 2 = count(b.' + @f2 + ')' ELSE '' END


			IF CHARINDEX('%', @f) > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @f = REPLACE(@f, '%', ''), @join = REPLACE(@join, '%', '')
				SET @key = @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from %org.dbo.' + @t + ' z where ' + REPLACE(@key, 'a.', 'z.') + ' and a.' + @f + ' = z.' + @f2 + ')'
			END


			IF CHARINDEX('(', @t) > 0 BEGIN
				SET @t = REPLACE(REPLACE(@t, '(', ' b where b.'), ')', ' and ')
				SET @where = 'where %[a.' + @f + ' <> '''' and ' + @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from %dest.dbo.' + @t + @join + ')]%'
			END	ELSE SET @where = 'where %[a.' + @f + ' <> '''' and ' + @key + ' and not exists(select 1 from %dest.dbo.' + @t + ' b where ' + @join + ')]%'


			SET @q = 'if exists (select 1 from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a ' + @where + ') begin'
			IF @type = 1 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into convertmessage select ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@define))) + ', ' + @id + ', ''' + @tbl + ''' + a.' + @xfield + ' from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a ' + @where
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #dir select ''' + @id + ''', a.' + @xfield + CASE WHEN @fref <> '' THEN ', a.' + @fref ELSE ', ''''' END + ' from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a ' + @where
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into convertmessage select ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@define))) + ', ' + @id + ', convert(char(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct  from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a ' + @where
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #vc select distinct ''' + @id + ''', a.stt_rec from %org.dbo.' + @tbl0 + ' a ' + @where
			END

			SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%org', @dbOrg), '%dest', @dbDest), '&', '') + CHAR(13) + ' end'

			IF CHARINDEX('$', @tbl) > 0 EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, @userID, @admin
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%[', ''), ']%', '')
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			SELECT @i0 = @i0 + 1
		END

Next:
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

Result:
	IF @type = 1 SELECT * FROM #dir
	ELSE SELECT * FROM #vc

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[js_ReCaclReceiveERD] @cVC CHAR(3), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @Group VARCHAR(128), @nUserID INT, @nCharge TINYINT = 0, @Admin BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SELECT @cIDNumber = REPLACE(@cIDNumber, '''', ''), @Group = REPLACE(@Group, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @cIDLineNumber CHAR(3), @nRound INT, @cBaseCur VARCHAR(32), @chargeTable VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT * INTO #master FROM wrkcrtran
	SELECT * INTO #detail FROM wrkcrdetail
	SELECT * INTO #xcharge FROM f46$000000

	CREATE TABLE #fc (ty_gia NUMERIC(38, 20))

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @cBaseCur = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master' + ' select * from ' + @cMasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE sua_tg_yn = 1) RETURN

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail' + ' select * from ' + @cDetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @cVC = 'BC1' BEGIN
		SELECT @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(@cMasterTable))
		SET @chargeTable = 'f46$' + SUBSTRING(@cMasterTable, CHARINDEX('$', @cMasterTable) + 1, 6)

		SET @q = 'insert into #xcharge' + ' select * from ' + @chargeTable + ' where tk_du <> '''' and stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END


	DECLARE @nMethod INT, @cAccount VARCHAR(32), @dVC SMALLDATETIME, @cCust VARCHAR(32), @cUnit VARCHAR(32), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @cNumber VARCHAR(32), @nRate NUMERIC(38, 20)

	SELECT @cCust = ma_kh, @cUnit = ma_dvcs, @dVC = ngay_ct, @cNumber = so_ct FROM #master

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct = '2') BEGIN
		DECLARE crPaymentERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
		OPEN crPaymentERD
		FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @cAccount = tk_co, @nFCAmount = tien_nt FROM #detail WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
			IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2 BEGIN
				DELETE #fc
				INSERT INTO #fc EXEC js_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cVC, @nUserID, default, @Admin

				SELECT @nRate = ty_gia FROM #fc
				UPDATE #detail SET ty_gia_ht2 = @nRate, tien = ROUND(@nFCAmount * @nRate, @nRound) WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crPaymentERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		END
		CLOSE crPaymentERD
		DEALLOCATE crPaymentERD		
	END

	-- Charge
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #master WHERE loai_ct IN ('1', '2')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xcharge) BEGIN
		SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, ROUND(t_tien_nt*ty_gia, @nRound) AS ps, t_tien_nt AS ps_nt INTO #erd FROM #master

		DECLARE crFeeERD CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec0 FROM #xcharge ORDER BY line_nbr
		OPEN crFeeERD
		FETCH NEXT FROM crFeeERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @cAccount = tk_du FROM #xcharge WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			SELECT @nMethod = loai_cl_co FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @cAccount
			IF @nMethod <> 0 AND @nMethod <> 2 BEGIN
				DELETE #fc
				INSERT INTO #fc EXEC js_GetERD @cAccount, @nMethod, @dVC, @cCust, @cUnit, @cIDNumber, @nFCAmount, @cVC, @nUserID, '#erd', @Admin

				SELECT @nRate = ty_gia FROM #fc
				UPDATE #xcharge SET ty_gia = @nRate WHERE stt_rec0 = @cIDLineNumber
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM crFeeERD INTO @cIDLineNumber
		END
		CLOSE crFeeERD
		DEALLOCATE crFeeERD
	END

	UPDATE #master SET t_tien = b.tien FROM #master a JOIN (SELECT SUM(tien) AS tien FROM #detail) b ON 1 = 1

	-- F1
	SET @q = 'update @cDetailTable set ty_gia_ht2 = b.ty_gia_ht2, tien = b.tien from @cDetailTable a join #detail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update @cChargeTable SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, tien_cp = b.tien_cp, t_thue = b.t_thue FROM @cChargeTable a JOIN #xcharge b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update @cMasterTable SET t_tien = b.t_tien FROM @cMasterTable a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC fs_PostCRTran %@cMasterTable%, %@cDetailTable%, %@cIDNumber%, %@Group%, 2, default, ' + RTRIM(@nCharge)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable)
	IF @cVC = 'BC1' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cChargeTable', @chargeTable)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@cIDNumber', @cIDNumber)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Group', @Group)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '%', CHAR(39))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DROP TABLE #master, #detail, #fc, #xcharge

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
