CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptReceivableReportByInvoiceExRate] --fs20_ARDetailByInvoicesExRate--
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@DateGLFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateGLTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVCFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateVCTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateReport SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Type TINYINT,
	@Size TINYINT,
	@BalView TINYINT,
	@ContractGroup CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @cname NVARCHAR(1024), @nRound TINYINT, @roundExRate TINYINT,
		@differ NVARCHAR(511), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PaymentJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @roundExRate = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT @differ = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'DIFFER'
	SELECT @cname = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT076'

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, stt_rec, tk, t_tt_nt0, t_tt_qd0, t_tt0, ma_tt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_qd, t_tt_nt1, tt_nt
			, tt, t_tt1, t_tt_nt, ma_kh, loai_tt, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, t_tt, so_ct, dien_giai, ma_hd
		 INTO #inv FROM cttt20

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.ma_nt <> '''' and loai_tt = 0', @PaymentKey = 'a.loai_tt = 1 and a.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + '''', @PaymentJoin = ''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateGLTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @s = ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @DateVCFrom IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVCFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateVCTo IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateVCTo, 112) + ''''
	IF (@DateVCFrom IS NOT NULL OR @DateVCTo IS NOT NULL) SET @Key = @Key + ' and ngay_ct0 is not null'
	IF @Type = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and tat_toan <> 1'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF @Group1 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Group2 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	IF @Group3 <> '' SELECT @s = ' and b.nh_kh3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '''', @Key = @Key + @s, @PaymentKey = @PaymentKey + @s
	--
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' SELECT @Join = 'left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', @PaymentJoin = @Join

	--
	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable))) BEGIN
		SELECT a.name, b.name AS [type], a.prec INTO #struct FROM tempdb..syscolumns a LEFT JOIN tempdb..systypes b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable) AND b.name IN ('char', 'nvarchar', 'varchar', 'decimal', 'int', 'tinyint', 'datetime', 'smalldatetime')
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #struct WHERE name = 'filterkey') BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #t1 (a int)
			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #t1 add ' + [name] + ' ' + RTRIM([type]) + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('char', [type]) > 0 THEN '(' + RTRIM(prec) + ')' ELSE '' END + ' null' FROM #struct
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			ALTER TABLE #t1 DROP COLUMN a
			SELECT TOP 1 * INTO #t2 FROM #t1
			--
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t1 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) <= 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #t2 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) > 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t1', @filterKey OUTPUT
		END
	END
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @PaymentKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@PaymentKey)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_tt, tt_qd AS t_tt_qd, tt_cn AS t_tt_cn INTO #payment FROM cttt20
	SET @q = 'insert into #payment select a.stt_rec_tt, sum(a.tt_qd), sum(a.tt_cn) from cttt20 a with(nolock)' + @PaymentJoin + ' where ' + @PaymentKey + ' group by a.stt_rec_tt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @filterKey = ''
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct INTO #hd FROM #inv
	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') OR @PrintType = 1) AND OBJECT_ID (N'hddt00$' + (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112) FROM dmstt), N'U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Dynamic
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t2', @filterKey OUTPUT
		SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
		--
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #hd select stt_rec, so_ct_hddt from hddt00$%Partition a ' + CASE WHEN @filterKey <> '' THEN 'where %[' + @filterKey + ']%' ELSE '' END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateGLFrom, @DateGLTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		IF @filterKey <> '' DELETE #payment FROM #payment a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hd b WHERE a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec)
	END

 	SET @q = 'insert into #inv select a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.tk, a.t_tt_nt0, a.t_tt_qd0, a.t_tt0, a.ma_tt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_nt1, a.tt_nt '
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tt, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_kh, a.loai_tt, a.stt_rec_tt, a.ma_ct, a.t_tt, a.so_ct, a.dien_giai, ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN 'a.ma_hd' ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from cttt20 a with(nolock) ' + @Join
	IF @BalView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk t on a.tk = t.tk left join #payment p on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @BalView = 0 SET @q = @q + ' and isnull(t.tk_cn, 1) <> 0 and isnull(case when a.ma_nt <> '''' then a.t_tt_nt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_qd else a.t_tt0 - a.t_tt_qd0 - p.t_tt_cn end, 1) > 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @filterKey <> '' DELETE #inv FROM #inv a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hd b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)

	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct0, a.stt_rec, a.tk, a.t_tt_nt0, a.t_tt_qd0, a.t_tt0, a.ma_tt,
			CASE WHEN a.tt_qd <> 0 THEN b.ma_nt ELSE a.ma_nt END AS ma_nt, CASE WHEN a.tt_qd <> 0 THEN ROUND(a.tt_cn / a.tt_qd, @roundExRate) ELSE a.ty_gia END AS ty_gia,
			a.t_tt_qd, a.t_tt_nt1, a.tt_nt, a.tt, a.t_tt1, a.t_tt_nt, a.ma_kh, a.loai_tt, a.stt_rec_tt, a.ma_ct, a.t_tt, a.so_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ty_gia * 0 AS ty_gia_dg0, a.tt_qd, a.tt_cn,
			CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN a.ma_hd ELSE '' END AS ma_hd
		INTO #RecDetail
		FROM cttt20 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #inv b ON a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateGLFrom AND @DateGLTo
			AND (a.ngay_ct0 IS NULL OR @DateVCFrom IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct0 >= @DateVCFrom)
			AND (a.ngay_ct0 IS NULL OR @DateVCTo IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct0 <= @DateVCTo)
			AND a.ngay_ct <= @DateReport

	UPDATE #RecDetail SET tt_nt = tt_qd, tt = tt_cn
	UPDATE #RecDetail SET tt_nt = 0 WHERE stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #inv WHERE ma_nt = '')

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_qd0, t_tt1 = t_tt_qd0 * CASE ma_nt WHEN '' THEN 1 ELSE ty_gia END FROM #inv

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_qd WHERE ma_nt <> ''
	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = 0 WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #inv SET tt_nt = t_tt_nt1, tt = t_tt1

	UPDATE #inv SET t_tt_nt1 = t_tt_nt, t_tt1 = t_tt WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM dmtk WHERE tk_cn = 0)

	UPDATE #RecDetail SET t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt = 0

	SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) AS stt_rec, b.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct0, SPACE(@Size - 7) + REPLACE(STR(a.nam, 4) + STR(a.ky, 2), ' ', '0') AS so_ct, b.ma_kh, @differ AS dien_giai, b.tk
			, b.ma_nt, a.ty_gia_dg, a.tien_cl_co - a.tien_cl_no AS tien_cl, a.stt_rec_hd, a.status, b.ma_hd
		INTO #tbl_cl
		FROM cttt21 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #inv b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec
		WHERE (b.ngay_ct <= @DateReport) AND (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @DateGLFrom AND @DateGLTo)
			AND (a.ngay_ct <= @DateReport)

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#tbl_cl', 'so_ct', 'CHAR(' + LTRIM(STR(@Size)) + ')')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT loai_tt, stt_rec, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, so_ct, ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt_nt, t_tt, ty_gia * 0 AS ty_gia_dg0, t_tt_nt1 AS tt_nt, t_tt1 AS tt, ma_tt, 0 AS status, CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN ma_hd ELSE '' END AS ma_hd INTO #report0 FROM #inv
	INSERT INTO #report0 SELECT loai_tt, stt_rec, stt_rec_tt, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, so_ct, ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, ty_gia, 0, 0, ty_gia_dg0, tt_nt, tt_cn, '', 0 AS status, ma_hd FROM #RecDetail
	INSERT INTO #report0 SELECT 0, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_hd, '', ngay_ct, ngay_ct0, RTRIM(so_ct), ma_kh, tk, dien_giai, ma_nt, 0, 0, tien_cl, ty_gia_dg, 0, 0, '', status, ma_hd FROM #tbl_cl


	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.*
			, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec1, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct10, a.ma_ct AS ma_ct1, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct1, a.so_ct AS so_ct1, a.so_ct AS so_ct0
			, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, ten_kh, a.ngay_ct0 + e.han_tt AS ngay_tt0, e.han_tt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_hd
		INTO #report
		FROM #report0 a
				LEFT JOIN dmct c with(nolock) ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
				LEFT JOIN dmkh d with(nolock) ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh
				LEFT JOIN dmtt e with(nolock) ON a.ma_tt = e.ma_tt

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.*'
	SET @q = @q + ' , isnull(b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec) as stt_rec1, isnull(f.ma_ct_in, c.ma_ct_in) as ma_ct10, isnull(b.ma_ct, a.ma_ct) as ma_ct1, isnull(b.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ct) as ngay_ct1, isnull(b.so_ct, a.so_ct) as so_ct1, '''''
	SET @q = @q + ' , isnull(c.ma_ct_in, '''') as ma_ct0, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_kh' ELSE 'd.ten_kh2' END + ', a.ngay_ct0 + e.han_tt as ngay_tt0, e.han_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ' , ' + CASE WHEN @ContractGroup = '1' THEN CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.ten_hd' else 'g.ten_hd2' END ELSE '''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report0 a '
	SET @q = @q + '	left join #inv b on a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmct c with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmkh d with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh '
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmtt e with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = e.ma_tt'
	SET @q = @q + '	left join dmct f with(nolock) on b.ma_ct = f.ma_ct'
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' SET @q = @q + ' left join dmhd g with(nolock) on a.ma_hd = g.ma_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_ct0 = ngay_ct WHERE ngay_ct0 IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, LEN(stt_rec) - 3) + ma_ct WHERE RIGHT(stt_rec, 3) <> ma_ct AND ma_ct <> ''
	UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct0 NVARCHAR NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct1 NVARCHAR NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt_rec1 NVARCHAR NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ma_ct NVARCHAR NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt_rec NVARCHAR NULL
		ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN loai_tt INT NULL
		INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, status) VALUES (0,1,0,1)
	END
	IF @ContractGroup = '1' UPDATE #report SET ten_hd = @cname WHERE ma_hd = ''

	IF @PrintType = 1 UPDATE #report SET so_ct0 = b.so_ct FROM #report a JOIN #hd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	IF @ContractGroup = '0'
		SELECT systotal, sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, ty_gia_dg0
				, t_tt_nt, tt_nt, t_tt, tt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, tk, dien_giai, ngay_ct, loai_tt
				, ten_kh, ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1 AS xgroup, '' AS ma_hd, '' AS ten_hd, '' AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report
			ORDER BY ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1
				, ngay_ct, CASE WHEN ma_ct <> '' THEN loai_tt ELSE CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 9 ELSE 0.6 END END, ma_ct0, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	ELSE
		SELECT systotal, sysprint, sysorder, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct0, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, ma_nt, ty_gia, ty_gia_dg0
				, t_tt_nt, tt_nt, t_tt, tt, han_tt, ngay_tt0, tk, dien_giai, ngay_ct, loai_tt
				, ten_kh, ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1 AS xgroup, ma_hd, ten_hd, CASE WHEN ma_hd = '' THEN '' ELSE ten_hd END AS ten_hd_ex
			FROM #report
			ORDER BY ma_kh + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct1, 112) + ma_ct10 + ma_ct1 + so_ct1 + stt_rec1, ma_hd, ngay_ct, CASE WHEN ma_ct <> '' THEN loai_tt ELSE CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 9 ELSE 0.6 END END, ma_ct0, ma_ct, so_ct, stt_rec
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter](@InvoiceNumber VARCHAR(32))
RETURNS VARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN
	IF LEN(@InvoiceNumber) > 1 AND LEFT(@InvoiceNumber, 1) = '0'
		RETURN @InvoiceNumber
	ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @Size INT
		SELECT @Size = COL_LENGTH('wrkcolumns', 'so_ct')
		RETURN dbo.ff_PadL(@InvoiceNumber, @Size)
	END

	RETURN @InvoiceNumber
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PG] --fs_BeforeUpdatePG
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 loai_ct INTO #TranType FROM m78$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hd, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hdon, so_luong, he_so
		, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_pn, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hdon, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ttmh
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d78$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #TranType SELECT loai_ct FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_pn <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hdon = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d94$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hdon <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hdon = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_pn <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_pn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_ttmh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPDIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePDIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_pn VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hdon VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ttmh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_pn, dyn_dh, dyn_hdon, dyn_hd, dyn_ttmh FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_pn) AS dyn_pn, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hdon) AS dyn_hdon, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_ttmh) AS dyn_ttmh FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = '2') BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i94$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$' + '000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$' + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @SAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @SAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status in (''4'', ''5'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m94$' + @dyn_hdon + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END

	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostRRClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT	
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @MasterTable = 'hrrmyc'
	SET @DetailTable = 'hrrmycct'
	SET @InquiryTable = 'hrirmyc'
	SET @HisTable = 'hrarmyc'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM hrarmyc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	--
	
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''3'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'
		
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END
