CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Levenshtein] (@s NVARCHAR(4000), @t NVARCHAR(4000), @max INT)
RETURNS INT
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @distance INT, @v NVARCHAR(4000), @start INT, @i INT, @j INT, @k INT, @d INT, @e INT, @left INT, @c NCHAR, @offset INT, @l1 INT, @l2 INT, @delta INT
	SELECT @distance = 0, @start = 1, @l1 = DATALENGTH(@s) / DATALENGTH(LEFT(LEFT(@s, 1) + '.', 1)), @l2 = DATALENGTH(@t) / DATALENGTH(LEFT(LEFT(@t, 1) + '.', 1))

	IF @l1 > @l2 SELECT @v = @s, @i = @l1, @s = @t, @l1 = @l2, @t = @v, @l2 = @i
	SELECT @max = ISNULL(@max, @l2), @delta = @l2 - @l1
	IF @delta > @max RETURN NULL

	WHILE(@l1 > 0 AND SUBSTRING(@s, @l1, 1) = SUBSTRING(@t, @l2, 1)) SELECT @l1 = @l1 - 1, @l2 = @l2 - 1
	IF (@l1 = 0) RETURN @l2
	WHILE (@start < @l1 AND SUBSTRING(@s, @start, 1) = SUBSTRING(@t, @start, 1)) SELECT @start = @start + 1
	IF (@start > 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @l1 = @l1 - (@start - 1), @l2 = @l2 - (@start - 1)
		IF (@l1 <= 0) RETURN @l2
		SELECT @s = SUBSTRING(@s, @start, @l1), @t = SUBSTRING(@t, @start, @l2)
	END

	SELECT @v = '', @j = 1
	WHILE (@j <= @l2) SELECT @v = @v + NCHAR(CASE WHEN @j > @max THEN @max ELSE @j END), @j = @j + 1

	SELECT @offset = @max - @delta, @i = 1
	WHILE (@i <= @l1) BEGIN
		SELECT @distance = @i, @d = @i - 1, @c = SUBSTRING(@s, @i, 1), @j = CASE WHEN @i <= @offset THEN 1 ELSE @i - @offset END, @e = CASE WHEN @i + @max >= @l2 THEN @l2 ELSE @i + @max END
		WHILE (@j <= @e) BEGIN
			SELECT @left = UNICODE(SUBSTRING(@v, @j, 1)), @k = @j
			SELECT @distance = CASE
				WHEN (@c = SUBSTRING(@t, @j, 1)) THEN @d
				ELSE 1 + CASE
					WHEN @d < @left AND @d < @distance THEN @d
					WHEN @left < @distance THEN @left
					ELSE @distance
				END
			END
			SELECT @v = STUFF(@v, @k, 1, NCHAR(@distance)), @d = @left, @j = CASE WHEN (@distance > @max) AND (@k = @i + @delta) THEN @e + 2 ELSE @k + 1 END
		END
		SELECT @i = CASE WHEN @j > @e + 1 THEN @l1 + 1 ELSE @i + 1 END
	END
	RETURN CASE WHEN @distance <= @max THEN @distance ELSE NULL END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoGenerateInputInvoiceSuppliers]
	@SupplierCode VARCHAR(32),
	@DefaultAccount VARCHAR(16),
	@PurchaseAccount VARCHAR(16),
	@Term VARCHAR(2),
	@CreditLimit NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Keys NVARCHAR(4000),
	@Type INT, -- 1. Update, 2. Create
	@Nested BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Result NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
	@Error CHAR(1) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @SupplierCode = REPLACE(@SupplierCode, '''', ''''''), @DefaultAccount = REPLACE(@DefaultAccount, '''', ''''''), @PurchaseAccount = REPLACE(@PurchaseAccount, '''', ''''''), @Term = REPLACE(@Term, '''', ''), @Keys = REPLACE(@Keys, '''', '''''')

	-- DECLARE
	DECLARE @id INT, @data NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(MAX), @u NVARCHAR(4000), @i NVARCHAR(4000), @j NVARCHAR(4000), @part CHAR(6), @err CHAR(1), @kt_mst_trung CHAR(1), @len INT

	-- STRUCT
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_kh AS ma_ncc, ten_cn AS ten_ncc, dia_chi_cn AS dia_chi_ncc, mst_cn AS mst_ncc, tk_nh_cn AS tk_nh_ncc, ten_nh_cn AS ten_nh_ncc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS part INTO #m15 FROM m15$000000
	SELECT *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_ncc INTO #dt FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Keys, ',')
	CREATE TABLE #inner (id INT, data NVARCHAR(4000))
	SELECT @kt_mst_trung = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_mst_trung'
	SELECT @len = max_length / 2 FROM sys.columns WHERE name = 'ngan_hang' and OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID('dmkh')

	-- INSERT #m15
	SELECT @i = 'insert into #m15 (stt_rec, ma_ncc, ten_ncc, dia_chi_ncc, mst_ncc, tk_nh_ncc, ten_nh_ncc, part) select @stt_rec, @supplierCode, ten_cn, dia_chi_cn, mst_cn, tk_nh_cn, ten_nh_cn, @partiton from m15$%Partition where stt_rec = @stt_rec'
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT id, data FROM #dt
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id, @data
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		DECLARE @partiton VARCHAR(6), @stt_rec CHAR(13)
		INSERT INTO #inner SELECT * FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@data, CHAR(253))
		SELECT @partiton = LEFT(data, 6) FROM #inner WHERE id = 1
		SELECT @stt_rec = LEFT(data, 13) FROM #inner WHERE id = 2
		TRUNCATE TABLE #inner
		SELECT @j = REPLACE(@i, '%Partition', @partiton)
		EXEC sp_executeSQl @j, N'@stt_rec char(13), @supplierCode varchar(32), @partiton varchar(6)', @stt_rec, @SupplierCode, @partiton
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id, @data
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	-- MODE 2: CREATE
	IF @Type = 2 BEGIN
		IF @kt_mst_trung = '2' BEGIN
			DECLARE @mst_trung VARCHAR(18)
			SELECT TOP 1 @mst_trung = a.ma_so_thue FROM dmkh a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #m15 b ON a.ma_so_thue = b.mst_ncc
			IF ISNULL(@mst_trung, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @Error = '5',  @Result = @mst_trung
				RETURN
			END
		END

		SELECT MIN(stt_rec) AS stt_rec, MIN(ma_ncc) AS ma_ncc, MIN(ten_ncc) AS ten_ncc, mst_ncc, MIN(dia_chi_ncc) AS dia_chi, MIN(tk_nh_ncc) AS tk_nh, LEFT(MIN(ten_nh_ncc), @len) AS ten_nh INTO #ncc FROM #m15 GROUP BY mst_ncc
		SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, * INTO #ncc2 FROM #ncc ORDER BY stt_rec
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #dmkh FROM dmkh

		-- GEN SUPPLIER
		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AutoCreateSupplier #ncc2, @SupplierCode, @Nested, @err OUT
		IF ISNULL(@err, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Error = @err
			RETURN
		END

		-- CHECK EXISTS:
		DELETE #ncc2 FROM #ncc2 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = a.ma_ncc OR ma_so_thue = a.mst_ncc)

		INSERT INTO #dmkh (ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, tk_nh, ngan_hang, loai_kh)
			SELECT ma_ncc, ten_ncc, '', mst_ncc, dia_chi, tk_nh, ten_nh, CASE WHEN ISNULL(mst_ncc, '') = '' THEN '9' ELSE '1' END
				FROM #ncc2

		-- UPDATE DEFAULT VALUE
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$InputInvoice$UpdateNullValue '#dmkh', 'dmkh', 'ma_ncc, ten_ncc, loai_kh, tk, tk_dc, ma_tt, t_tien_cn, kh_yn, cc_yn, nv_yn, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2', ''
		UPDATE #dmkh SET tk = @DefaultAccount, tk_dc = @PurchaseAccount, ma_tt = @Term, t_tien_cn = @CreditLimit, kh_yn = 1, cc_yn = 1, nv_yn = 0, status = '1', datetime0 = GETDATE(), datetime2 = GETDATE(), user_id0 = @UserID, user_id2 = @UserID
			FROM #dmkh a JOIN #ncc2 b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_ncc
		--INSERT
		INSERT INTO dmkh SELECT * FROM #dmkh a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkh WHERE ma_kh = a.ma_kh)
		UPDATE #m15 SET ma_ncc = b.ma_ncc FROM #m15 a JOIN #ncc2 b ON a.ten_ncc = b.ten_ncc
	END

	IF @Type = '1' UPDATE #dt SET ma_ncc = @SupplierCode

	-- RESULT
	SET @Result = ''
	SELECT @Result = @Result + CASE WHEN @Result = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END + ('''' + data + ';' + RTRIM(ma_ncc) + '''') FROM #dt ORDER BY id DESC

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE fs20_WhenUpdateGroupCode
	@cTableName VARCHAR(16), 
	@cField  VARCHAR(16), 
	@nGroupTypeDel TINYINT, 
	@nGroupTypeIns TINYINT, 
	@cGroupCodeDel VARCHAR(24), 
	@cGroupCodeIns VARCHAR(24)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @nGroupTypeDel = ISNULL(@nGroupTypeDel, 0), @nGroupTypeIns = ISNULL(@nGroupTypeIns, 0), @cGroupCodeDel = ISNULL(@cGroupCodeDel, ''), @cGroupCodeIns = ISNULL(@cGroupCodeIns, '')

	IF @nGroupTypeDel = @nGroupTypeIns AND @cGroupCodeDel = @cGroupCodeIns
		RETURN

	IF @nGroupTypeDel <> 0 
			AND 
				(
					(@nGroupTypeIns = 0) OR (@nGroupTypeDel <> @nGroupTypeIns)
				)
		BEGIN
			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE @cTableName SET @cField = @Blank WHERE @cField = @cGroupCodeDel'
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTableName', @cTableName)
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cField', @cField)
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cGroupCodeDel', CHAR(39) + @cGroupCodeDel + CHAR(39))
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@Blank', CHAR(39) + CHAR(39))
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@nGroupTypeDel, 1))))
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		END

	IF @nGroupTypeDel <> 0 AND @nGroupTypeIns <> 0 AND @nGroupTypeDel = @nGroupTypeIns AND @cGroupCodeDel <> '' AND @cGroupCodeIns <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE @cTableName SET @cField = @cGroupCodeIns WHERE @cField = @cGroupCodeDel'
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cTableName', @cTableName)
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cField', @cField)
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cGroupCodeDel', CHAR(39) + @cGroupCodeDel + CHAR(39))
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cGroupCodeIns', CHAR(39) + @cGroupCodeIns + CHAR(39))
			SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, '%n', RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@nGroupTypeDel, 1))))
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
		END
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$Query$Initialize]
    @MainController VARCHAR(128),
    @TableList VARCHAR(4000),
    @AliasList VARCHAR(4000),
    @UserID INT,
    @Admin BIT,
    @SysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @Admin = 1 RETURN ''

	DECLARE @i INT, @id INT, @TableName VARCHAR(128), @AliasName VARCHAR(128), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @t TABLE(name VARCHAR(128), alias VARCHAR(128), id INT IDENTITY(1,1))

	SELECT @Key = '', @TableName= '',  @AliasName = ''
	SELECT @TableList = @TableList + ',', @AliasList = @AliasList + ','
	SELECT @id = 0, @i = CHARINDEX(',', @TableList)

	WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @TableName = SUBSTRING(@TableList, 0, @i)
		IF (ISNULL(@TableName, '') <> '') INSERT INTO @t SELECT @TableName, @AliasName
		SET @TableList = SUBSTRING(@TableList, @i + 1, LEN(@TableList) - @i)
		SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @TableList, 0)
	END

	SELECT @i = CHARINDEX(',', @AliasList)
	WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @id = id FROM @t WHERE alias = '' AND id <> @id
		SELECT @AliasName = SUBSTRING(@AliasList, 0, @i)
		IF (ISNULL(@AliasName, '') <> '') UPDATE @t SET alias = SUBSTRING(@AliasList, 0, @i) WHERE id = @id
		SET @AliasList = SUBSTRING(@AliasList, @i + 1, LEN(@AliasList)- @i)
		SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @AliasList, 0)
	END

	IF (@MainController = 'SalesInformation' OR @MainController = 'PurchasingInformation' OR @MainController = 'InventoryInformation' OR @MainController = 'BIPurchasingInformation') BEGIN
		-- UnitKey
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('m0.ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

		-- SiteKey
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
		IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

		-- BIMode
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = 1) BEGIN
			DECLARE @PlantKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurGroupKey NVARCHAR(1023), @PurOrgKey NVARCHAR(1023)
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
				SELECT @PurOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('m0.ma_bp0', '', @UserID, @Admin)
				IF @PurOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurOrgKey
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'm0.ma_nh0', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGroupKey OUTPUT, '2'
				IF @PurGroupKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @PurGroupKey
			END

			SELECT @UnitKey = REPLACE(@UnitKey, 'm0.', '')
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'm0.ma_vung', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, '1'
			IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((' + @PlantKey + ') or m0.ma_vung = ''''' + ')'
		END

		IF ISNULL(@Key, '') <> '' SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', a.alias + '.') FROM @t a WHERE name = 'vct70'
		ELSE SELECT @Key = ''
		IF (@Key <> '') SELECT @Key = 'and ' + @Key
		SELECT @Key AS message
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT '' AS message
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryBySite] -- fs20_StockSummary2
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Sites VARCHAR(1024),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Statement NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt
				, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #report FROM #t

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_kho <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, '', @Item, 1, 2, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	IF @Sites <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete #t where ma_kho not in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Sites, ', ', ','), ' ,', ','), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

	END
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM #t

	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Sites <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Sites, ', ', ','), ' ,', ','), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = ' insert into #report select ltrim(a.ma_kho), a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #report select ltrim(a.ma_kho), a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	--Nhom lai va tinh ton cuoi
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal,
			0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho,CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2, MAX(b.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(b.loai_vt) AS loai_vt,
			MAX(b.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(b.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(b.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3,
			SUM(a.ton_dau) AS ton_dau,  SUM(a.du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(a.du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt, SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(a.tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap,
			SUM(a.tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(a.tien_xuat)  AS tien_xuat, 	SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x,
			MAX(a.ton_dau * 0) AS ton_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau * 0) AS du_cuoi, MAX(a.du_dau_nt * 0) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #incd1
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho

	SELECT @q = dbo.ff20_GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#incd1', 'ma_vt',1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #incd1 SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#incd1', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, nh_vt2, nh_vt3', 'numeric(5), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), N#, char(2), #, #, #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @ShowItem = '1'
		DELETE #incd1 WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2'
		DELETE #incd1 WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #incd1 WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) <> 'ma_kho'
		SELECT MAX(sysorder) AS sysorder,MAX(sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(systotal) AS systotal, MAX(stt) AS stt, MAX(ma_kho) AS ma_kho,
				MAX(ma_vt) AS ma_vt, MAX(ten_vt) AS ten_vt,MAX(ten_vt2) AS ten_vt2, MAX(dvt) AS dvt, MAX(loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1,
				MAX(nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			INTO #incd3
			FROM #incd1 GROUP BY ma_vt

	--Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @Group + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	--

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt' , 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt',
				'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt',
				'#incd3' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'ma_kho'
				SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('ma_kho' , 'ma_kho', 'vt',
					'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt',
					'#incd1' , 'dmkho', 'ten_kho')
			ELSE
				SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'vt', 'ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt', '#incd3')
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'ma_kho' BEGIN
		DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(511)
		SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
		SELECT @s1 AS ten_vt, @s12 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			INTO #incd1tt FROM #incd1 WHERE systotal = 1

		INSERT INTO #incd1 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES ('', '', '', '', 1, 0, 0)

		INSERT INTO #incd1 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT '', ten_vt, ten_vt2, '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt FROM #incd1tt
		DELETE FROM #incd1 WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND
			tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0 AND ton_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi_nt = 0 AND sysorder <> 0
		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#incd1', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'
		--
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#incd1', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
		--
		SET @q = 'select * from #incd1 order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group  , 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @s11 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s112 AS NVARCHAR(511)
			SELECT @s11 = cname, @s112 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
			SELECT @s11 AS ten_vt, @s112 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
					SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
					SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
				INTO #incd2tt FROM #Incd3 WHERE systotal = 1

			INSERT INTO #incd3 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES ('', '', '', '', 1, 0, 0)

			INSERT INTO #incd3 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
				SELECT '', ten_vt, ten_vt2, '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt FROM #incd2tt
			DELETE FROM #incd3 WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND
				tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0 AND ton_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi_nt = 0 AND sysorder <> 0
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#incd3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#incd3', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
			IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
			--
			SET @q = 'select * from #incd3 order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group  , 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @s111 AS NVARCHAR(511), @s1112 AS NVARCHAR(511)
			SELECT @s111 = cname, @s1112 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
			SELECT @s111 AS ten_vt, @s1112 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
					SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
					SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
				INTO #incd3tt FROM #Incd3 WHERE systotal = 1

			INSERT INTO #incd3 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES ('', '', '', '', 1, 0, 0)

			INSERT INTO #incd3 (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
				SELECT '', ten_vt, ten_vt2, '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt FROM #incd3tt
			DELETE FROM #incd3 WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND
				tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0 AND ton_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi = 0 AND du_cuoi_nt = 0 AND sysorder <> 0
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#incd3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#incd3', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
			IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
			--
			SET @q = 'select * from #incd3 order by sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetGridFilter]
	@PurField VARCHAR(64),
	@Pur VARCHAR(1024),
	@PurGrField VARCHAR(64),
	@PurGr VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantField VARCHAR(64),
	@Plant VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extention VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@External NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS  

BEGIN
	DECLARE @c CHAR(3), @PurOrgNull BIT, @PurGrNull BIT, @PlantNull BIT
	SELECT @c = '&' + CHAR(255) + ';', @PurOrgNull = SUBSTRING(@Extention, 1, 1), @PurGrNull = SUBSTRING(@Extention, 2, 1), @PlantNull = SUBSTRING(@Extention, 3, 1)
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @c + CASE WHEN @External <> '' THEN @External ELSE '' END
		RETURN
	END
	IF @Admin = 1 SELECT @c + CASE WHEN @External <> '' THEN @External ELSE '' END
	ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PurGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @PlantKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

		IF @PurField <> '' SELECT @PurKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter(@PurField, @Pur, @UserID, @Admin)
		
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @PlantField <> '' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter @PlantField, @Plant, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PlantKey OUTPUT, 1
			IF @PlantKey IS NULL AND @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @PlantKey = @UnitKey
		END
		IF @PurGrField <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter @PurGrField, @PurGr, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @PurGrKey OUTPUT, 2

		SELECT @Key = ''
		IF @PurKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = '(' + @PurKey + CASE WHEN @PurOrgNull = 1 THEN ' or ' + @PurField + ' = ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
		IF @PlantKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(' + @PlantKey + CASE WHEN @PlantNull = 1 THEN ' or ' + @PlantField + ' = ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
		IF @PurGrKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(' + @PurGrKey + CASE WHEN @PurGrNull = 1 THEN ' or ' + @PurGrField + ' = ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'

		SELECT @c + @Key + CASE WHEN @External <> '' THEN CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @External ELSE '' END
	END
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFACard] --fs20_FACard_Detail--
	@nMonth INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@So_the_ts VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @cFC0 VARCHAR(33), @cFC VARCHAR(33), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cFC0 = val FROM options WHERE UPPER(RTRIM(name)) = 'M_MA_NT0'		

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)
		CREATE TABLE #tmp(tmp CHAR(1))
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT 1 FROM dmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts = ''' + @So_the_ts + ''' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp) SELECT @So_the_ts = NULL
	END

	/* HIEUDT: Lay luon bang #master o ngoai store
	SELECT so_the_ts, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, a.ma_bp, nh_ts1, nh_ts2, nh_ts3, nuoc_sx, nam_sx
			, ts_kt, so_hieu_ts, ngay_ct, ngay_giam, ngay_mua, ngay_dc, so_ct, so_ct_giam, ly_do_dc, ly_do_giam, ma_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ts ELSE '' END AS ten_ts, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE ten_ts2 END AS ten_ts2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_bp ELSE '' END AS ten_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp2
		INTO #master
		FROM dmts a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmbpts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp WHERE so_the_ts = @So_the_ts*/

	SELECT @cFC = MAX(ma_nt) FROM dmts WHERE so_the_ts = @So_the_ts --MAX(ma_nt) FROM #master

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS ikey, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai
		INTO #detail11
		FROM (
			SELECT so_ct, ngay_ct, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, MAX(dien_giai) AS dien_giai FROM ctdmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts = @So_the_ts GROUP BY so_ct, ngay_ct
			UNION 
			SELECT a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN a.nguyen_gia ELSE -1 * a.nguyen_gia END AS nguyen_gia
			, CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN a.nguyen_gia_nt ELSE -1 * a.nguyen_gia_nt END AS nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai
				FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmtgts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
				WHERE a.so_the_ts = @So_the_ts AND YEAR(a.ngay_ct) * 12 + MONTH(a.ngay_ct) <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
			) a
		ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1,1) AS ikey, ISNULL(a.nam, b.nam) AS nam, ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nam, 0) AS gt_kh_nam, ISNULL(a.gt_kh_nam_nt, 0) AS gt_kh_nam_nt, ISNULL(b.gt_kh_lk, 0) AS gt_kh_lk,  ISNULL(b.gt_kh_lk_nt, 0) AS gt_kh_lk_nt
		INTO #detail12
		FROM (
			SELECT nam, SUM(gt_kh_nam) AS gt_kh_nam, SUM(gt_kh_nam_nt) AS gt_kh_nam_nt
				FROM (
					SELECT nam, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_nam, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_nam_nt
						FROM ctkhts WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE so_the_ts = @So_the_ts AND nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
						GROUP BY nam
					UNION ALL
					SELECT a.nam, SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * a.gt_da_kh), SUM(CASE WHEN b.loai_tg_ts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * a.gt_da_kh_nt)
						FROM ctdmts1 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dmtgts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_tg_ts = b.ma_tg_ts
						WHERE a.so_the_ts = @So_the_ts AND a.nam * 12 + a.ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth
						GROUP BY a.nam
					) a
				GROUP BY a.nam
			) a FULL JOIN (
					SELECT a.nam, SUM(a.gt_da_kh) AS gt_kh_lk, SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_kh_lk_nt
						FROM ctkhts a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (	
									SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(ky) AS ky, nam FROM ctkhts WITH(NOLOCK)
										WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @nYear * 12 + @nMonth AND so_the_ts = @So_the_ts
										GROUP BY so_the_ts, nam
									) b 
							ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND a.ky = b.ky AND a.nam = b.nam
							WHERE a.so_the_ts = @So_the_ts
						GROUP BY a.nam
					) b ON a.nam = b.nam
			ORDER BY ISNULL(a.nam, b.nam)

	SELECT ISNULL(a.ikey, b.ikey) AS ikey, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.dien_giai, b.nam, b.gt_kh_nam, b.gt_kh_nam_nt, b.gt_kh_lk, b.gt_kh_lk_nt
		INTO #detail1 FROM #detail11 a FULL JOIN #detail12 b ON a.ikey = b.ikey

	SELECT line_nbr, ten_ptkt, dvt, so_luong, gia_tri, gia_tri_nt INTO #detail2 FROM ctctts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts = @So_the_ts

	IF ISNULL(@cFC, '') = '' OR @cFC = @cFC0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #detail1 SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_kh_nam_nt = 0, gt_kh_lk_nt = 0
			UPDATE #detail2 SET gia_tri_nt = 0
		END

	--SELECT * FROM #master
	SELECT * FROM #detail1 ORDER BY ikey
	SELECT * FROM #detail2 ORDER BY line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesAllocationByRawMaterial] -- fs20_Cobcthpbnvl
	@Period NUMERIC(2),
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MO VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@CE VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Unit CHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @x_round_hs INT, @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @costUnit CHAR(1)
	SELECT @x_round_hs = val FROM options WHERE name = 'x_round_hs'
	SELECT @costUnit = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_gt_dvcs'	
	
	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MO <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MO), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CE <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ltrim(rtrim(a.ma_yt)) in (''' + REPLACE(@CE, ', ', ''', ''') + ''')'
	IF @costUnit = 1 BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin)
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp, a.so_lsx AS so_lsx, a.ma_sp AS ma_sp, a.ma_vt AS ma_vt, a.ma_yt
			, a.he_so AS he_so, a.sl_tk AS sl_tk, a.ps_tk AS ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt AS ps_tk_nt
			, b.loai_yt AS loai_yt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_sx, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS he_so_dv
		INTO #report FROM xctpbtg a, xdmyt b

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN loai_yt VARCHAR(33) NULL

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_vt, a.ma_yt, he_so, sl_tk, ps_tk, ps_tk_nt, loai_yt, sl_sx, he_so_dv)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ma_vt, a.ma_yt, a.he_so, a.sl_tk, a.ps_tk, a.ps_tk_nt, b.loai_yt, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from xctpbtg a with(nolock) left join xdmyt b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ma_yt = b.ma_yt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vt, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_dvcs, ma_yt, ma_bp, ma_vt, so_lsx, ma_sp, loai_yt) VALUES(5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '', '')
	ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET sl_sx = b.sl_sx FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM xcdloaiytdd2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ky = @Period AND nam =  @Year) b 
			ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp AND a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx AND a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp AND a.loai_yt = b.loai_yt and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
		UPDATE #report SET he_so_dv = CASE WHEN sl_sx = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(he_so / sl_sx, @x_round_hs) END 
	END
	
	SET @q = 'select a.*, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_sp,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_sp2,'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vt, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'c.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmvt b on a.ma_sp = b.ma_vt left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_yt, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vt, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptApprovalRolesDetail]
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Function VARCHAR(32),
	@ApprovingOfficer VARCHAR(32),
	@Order CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_quyen AS quyen, a.status AS tu_trang_thai, a.status2 AS trang_thai_duyet, a.status0 AS trang_thai_huy, b.ten_quyen AS ten_quyen, c.ma_kieu AS kieu_duyet, c.ten_kieu AS ten_kieu_duyet,
			b.loai_duyet AS chuc_nang, d.ten_loai AS ten_chuc_nang, e.u_status_name AS ten_tu_trang_thai, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_duyet, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_huy,
			j.name AS nguoi_duyet, j.comment AS ten_nguoi_duyet, line_nbr AS line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2
		INTO #report FROM gndmquyenct a, gndmquyen b, gndmkieuduyet c, gndmloaiduyet d, gndmttcttg e, gndmduyet i, vsysuserinfo j

	SET @Key = 'status = 1 and convert(char(8), ngay_hl, 112) <= ' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112)
	IF @Function <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai_duyet like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Function), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ApprovingOfficer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and user_id = ' + (SELECT RTRIM(id) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE name = REPLACE(RTRIM(@ApprovingOfficer), '''', ''''''))
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 user_id, loai_duyet, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2, ma_quyen INTO #gndmduyet FROM gndmduyet

	SET @q = 'insert into #gndmduyet select a.user_id, a.loai_duyet, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_hl2, a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'from gndmduyet a join '
	SET @q = @q + '(select user_id, loai_duyet, max(ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from gndmduyet where ' + @Key + ' group by user_id, loai_duyet) b '
	SET @q = @q + 'on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct a.ma_quyen, a.status, a.status2, a.status0, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_quyen ' ELSE 'b.ten_quyen2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(c.ma_kieu, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(c.ten_kieu, '''') ' ELSE 'isnull(c.ten_kieu2, '''') ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'b.loai_duyet, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_loai ' ELSE 'd.ten_loai2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.u_status_name ' ELSE 'e.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'f.u_status_name ' ELSE 'f.u_status_name2 'END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.u_status_name ' ELSE 'g.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(j.name, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(j.comment, '''') ' ELSE 'isnull(j.comment2, '''') ' END + ', line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'from gndmquyenct a join gndmquyen b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen left join gndmkieuduyet c on b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet and a.kieu_duyet = c.ma_kieu '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join gndmloaiduyet d on d.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet left join gndmttcttg e on e.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and e.u_status = a.status '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join gndmttcttg f on f.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and f.u_status = a.status2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join gndmttcttg g on g.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and g.u_status = a.status0 '
	SET @q = @q + 'join #gndmduyet i on i.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and i.ma_quyen = a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'join vsysuserinfo j on j.id = i.user_id'
	SET @q = @q + ' where b.status = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE FROM #report WHERE nguoi_duyet = ''

	IF @Order = 1
		SELECT chuc_nang, ten_chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, ten_nguoi_duyet, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr
	IF @Order = 2
		SELECT chuc_nang AS nguoi_duyet, ten_chuc_nang AS ten_nguoi_duyet, nguoi_duyet AS chuc_nang, ten_nguoi_duyet AS ten_chuc_nang, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY nguoi_duyet, chuc_nang, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rc_ExecReUpdateExDeff]  @nCycle TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cFC CHAR(3), @cVC CHAR(3), @cUnit VARCHAR(1023), @nUserID INT, @Admin BIT, @Diff TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @dyn VARCHAR(64), @VCList NVARCHAR(1023),
		@cDrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), @cCrDeffAcct VARCHAR(33), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @cUnits VARCHAR(1023), @nRound TINYINT,

		@stt_rec CHAR(13), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @tk VARCHAR(33), @tk_du VARCHAR(33), @nh_dk CHAR(3), @ma_kh VARCHAR(33), @ps_no_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_no NUMERIC(28, 6), @ps_co NUMERIC(28, 6),
		@xma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @xtk VARCHAR(33), @xma_kh VARCHAR(33), @xno_co NUMERIC(1), @xty_gia_gs NUMERIC(24, 12),
		@nAmt NUMERIC(38, 12), @nxRate NUMERIC(24, 12),

		@isContinue INT, @xCust VARCHAR(33), @line_nbr1 INT, @line_nbr2 INT

	-- Set
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS INT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Edit')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(@UnitKey) = '(1 = 0)' RETURN

	SELECT @cDrDeffAcct = tk_pscl_no, @cCrDeffAcct = tk_pscl_co FROM dmnt WHERE ma_nt = @cFC
	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @line_nbr1 = -1, @line_nbr2 = -2
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)
	END ELSE RETURN

	SELECT @Key = 'ma_nt = @cFC', @VCList = '(ma_ct = @cVC' + CASE WHEN @Diff = 0 THEN ')' ELSE ' or (ma_ct = ''JK9'' and loai_ct = 1))' END
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #r00 FROM wrkgl

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ty_gia_gs INTO #gltggs FROM gltggs
	--

	SELECT @q = 'delete ct00 where (ngay_ct between @dFrom and @dTo) and ' + @VCList + ' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dFrom smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime, @cVC varchar(3), @cFC varchar(3)', @dFrom, @dTo, @cVC, @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @dyn + ' where ' + @VCList + ' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(3), @cFC varchar(3)', @cVC, @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 0 where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where loai_ct <> ''5'' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where loai_ct in (''1'', ''9'') and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 0) and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_tk = 1 and tk_cn = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where loai_ct = ''1'' and ma_ct in (select ma_ct from gltgdd where kieu_ct = 1) and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_tk = 1 and tk_cn = 1 and loai_cl_no = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where sua_tg_yn = 1 and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_dd = 1 where ma_ct in (''PK2'') and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_no = ps_no where isnull(gt_no, 0) = 0 and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_co = ps_co where isnull(gt_co, 0) = 0 and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_no <> 0 and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_no = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_co <> 0 and tk_du in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_no = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_co <> 0 and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_co = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_no <> 0 and tk_du in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_co = 1) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gltggs select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ty_gia_gs from gltggs where thang = month(@dTo) and nam = year(@dTo) and ' + @Key + ' order by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3), @dTo smalldatetime', @cFC, @dTo

	CREATE TABLE #r(stt_rec CHAR(13))
	SELECT @isContinue = 0

	DECLARE crEx CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co, ty_gia_gs FROM #gltggs WHERE ty_gia_gs >= 0 ORDER BY ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, no_co
	OPEN crEx
	FETCH NEXT FROM crEx INTO @xma_dvcs, @xtk, @xma_kh, @xno_co, @xty_gia_gs
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		TRUNCATE TABLE #r00
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #r00 select * from ' + @dyn + ' where ma_dvcs = @xma_dvcs and ma_nt = @cFC and (tk = @xtk or tk_du = @xtk) and ma_ct <> @cVC and (gt_dd <> 1 or gt_dd is null)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@xma_dvcs varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32), @xtk varchar(32), @xma_kh varchar(32), @cVC varchar(32)', @xma_dvcs, @cFC, @xtk, @xma_kh, @cVC

		-- Case Dr Acct, Ex: 331, 311
		IF @xno_co = 1 BEGIN
			DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, nh_dk, ma_kh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ps_no, ps_co FROM #r00 WHERE tk = @xtk AND ISNULL(gt_tinh, 0) = 0 AND ps_no <> 0 AND (ma_kh LIKE RTRIM(@xma_kh) + '%')
			OPEN crTran
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @ma_dvcs, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				--
				SELECT @isContinue = 1
				SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

				-- 1.1 Ref Acct not in
				IF (
					NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gltggs WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo))
					) OR
					(
						EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @tk_du AND tk_cn = 1)
						AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gltggs WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 2 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo) AND ma_kh = @xCust)
					)

				BEGIN
					SELECT @isContinue = 0
					SET @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_no_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)
					IF @nAmt > @ps_no BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET gt_tinh = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET gt_tinh = 1 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_no) > 0)
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_co_nt) + ABS(ps_co) > 0)
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0 WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0 WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					 -- Book < VC Ex Rate
					IF @nAmt < @ps_no BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_no) > 0)
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_co_nt) + ABS(ps_co) > 0)

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_no_nt) + ABS(ps_no) > 0)
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk AND (ABS(ps_co_nt) + ABS(ps_co) > 0)
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = 0, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cDrDeffAcct, tk_du = @tk_du, ps_co = 0, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
				END

						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					IF @nAmt < @ps_no BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cDrDeffAcct, tk_du = @Tk_du, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, tk = @Tk_du, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @ps_no, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_no), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					IF @nAmt < @ps_no BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
				END
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @ma_dvcs, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
			END
			CLOSE crTran
			DEALLOCATE crTran

		END

		IF @xno_co <> 1 BEGIN

					END

					IF @nAmt < @ps_co BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2
						SELECT @xCust = ma_kh FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET ma_kh = @xCust

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END
					INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
				END



				-- 2.3 Ref Acct is DC Acct
				IF (@isContinue = 1) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gltggs WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo)) BEGIN
					SELECT @nxRate = ty_gia_gs FROM gltggs WHERE ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs AND tk = @tk_du AND no_co = 1 AND ma_nt = @cFC AND thang = MONTH(@dTo) AND nam = YEAR(@dTo)
					SELECT @nAmt = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@nxRate, @nRound),
						@ps_co = ROUND(@ps_co_nt*@xty_gia_gs, @nRound)

					IF @nAmt > @ps_co BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @ps_co, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @ps_co, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk_du, tk_du = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk_du, tk = @cCrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @xty_gia_gs WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END

					IF @nAmt < @ps_co BEGIN
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_co = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #r00 SET ps_no = @nAmt, gt_tinh = 1, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk

						DELETE #gl
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk = @tk AND tk_du = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r00 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec AND tk_du = @tk AND tk = @tk_du AND nh_dk = @nh_dk
						UPDATE #gl SET line_nbr = @line_nbr2 WHERE line_nbr <> @line_nbr1

						UPDATE #gl SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + @cVC, ma_ct = @cVC
						UPDATE #gl SET tk = @tk, tk_du = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_co = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_no = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr1
						UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @tk, tk = @cDrDeffAcct, ps_no = ABS(@nAmt - @ps_co), ps_co = 0, ty_gia = @nxRate WHERE line_nbr = @line_nbr2

						INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl
					END
					INSERT INTO #r VALUES (@stt_rec)
				END
				--
				FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @stt_rec, @ma_dvcs, @tk, @tk_du, @nh_dk, @ma_kh, @ps_no_nt, @ps_co_nt, @ps_no, @ps_co
			END
			CLOSE crTran
			DEALLOCATE crTran
		END
		SELECT @q = '
delete a from ' + @dyn + ' a where exists(select 1 from #r00 b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and b.tk = a.tk and b.tk_du = a.tk_du and b.nh_dk = a.nh_dk)
insert into ' + @dyn + ' select * from #r00
insert into #r select stt_rec from #r00
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM crEx INTO @xma_dvcs, @xtk, @xma_kh, @xno_co, @xty_gia_gs
	END
	CLOSE crEx
	DEALLOCATE crEx
	--
	UPDATE #ct00 SET line_nbr = ABS(line_nbr)
	UPDATE #ct00 SET dien_giai = b.dien_giai, dien_giai_h = b.dien_giai FROM #ct00 a JOIN v20dmdg b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
	SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @dyn + ' select * from #ct00'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE a FROM ct00 a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)
	SELECT @q = 'insert into ct00 select a.* from ' + @dyn + ' a where exists(select 1 from #r b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Rounding Difference
	IF @Diff = 1 BEGIN
		SET @Key = 'a.tk in (select tk from #gltggs)'
		EXEC rc_CreateExDeff @dFrom, @dTo, @cFC, 'JK9', @cUnit, @Key, @nUserID, @Admin, 1
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END




GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_ChrTran (@cSearchIn NVARCHAR(511), @cSearchFor NVARCHAR(511), @cReplaceWith NVARCHAR(511))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(511) AS 
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @lcRetVal NVARCHAR(128), @cReplaceChar NCHAR(1), @i INT, @j INT, @cChar NCHAR(1)
	SET @lcRetVal = ''
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE 	@i <= LEN(RTRIM(@cSearchIn))
		BEGIN
			SET @cChar = SUBSTRING(@cSearchIn, @i, 1)
			SET @j = dbo.ff_CharIndex(@cChar, @cSearchFor)
			IF @j = 0 
				SET @lcRetVal = @lcRetVal + @cChar
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF LEN(@cReplaceWith) < @j  SET @cReplaceChar = N'' ELSE SET @cReplaceChar = SUBSTRING(@cReplaceWith, @j, 1)
					SET @lcRetVal = @lcRetVal + @cReplaceChar
				END
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
	RETURN @lcRetVal
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ARCalExRD](
	@cFC VARCHAR(32),
	@nRate NUMERIC(24, 12),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRound INT, @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(Val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)

	SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co, t_tt_qd, t_tt_qd0, loai_tt, t_tt0, ma_dvcs, tk INTO #cttt20
		FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 0 AND (tat_toan IS NULL OR tat_toan = 0) AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND ngay_ct <= @Ngay_ct
			AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
	UPDATE #cttt20 SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_qd0 + a.t_tt_qd
		FROM
		(
			SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS t_tt_qd FROM cttt20
				WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt20) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
				GROUP BY stt_rec_tt
		) a JOIN #cttt20 ON a.stt_rec_tt = #cttt20.stt_rec WHERE loai_tt = 0
	UPDATE #cttt20 SET t_tt_nt = t_tt_nt - t_tt_qd, ty_gia_dg = @nRate
	UPDATE #cttt20 SET ty_gia = dbo.ff_GetExRate(ty_gia, ngay_ct, @Ngay_ct, RTRIM(@cFC), 1)

	-- Reupdate
	SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ty_gia INTO #dmtgdg FROM dmtgdg WHERE ky = @nCycle AND nam = @nYear AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
	UPDATE #cttt20 SET ty_gia_dg = b.ty_gia FROM #cttt20 a JOIN #dmtgdg b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.tk = b.tk

	UPDATE #cttt20 SET t_tt = ROUND(t_tt_nt * ty_gia, @nRound), t_tt0 = ROUND(t_tt_nt * ty_gia_dg, @nRound)
	UPDATE #cttt20 SET tien_cl_co = CASE WHEN t_tt0 > t_tt THEN t_tt0 - t_tt ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_no = CASE WHEN t_tt0 > t_tt THEN 0 ELSE t_tt - t_tt0 END

	DELETE cttt21 WHERE ngay_ct = @ngay_ct AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt20)
	INSERT INTO cttt21
		(
			stt_rec_hd, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, ky, nam, tien_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tien, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co,
			status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
		)
	SELECT stt_rec, @ngay_ct, @ngay_ct, @nCycle, @nYear, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt,ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), 0, 0
		FROM #cttt20
		WHERE ABS(tien_cl_no) + ABS(tien_cl_co) > 0
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PM] --fs_BeforeUpdatePM, fs_BeforeUpdatePV
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @RefTable VARCHAR(64), @PORefTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1)
	SELECT @RefTable = SUBSTRING(@masterTable, 2, 3)
	SELECT @PORefTable = CASE WHEN @RefTable = '71$' THEN '94$' ELSE '95$' END
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 loai_ct INTO #TranType FROM m72$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hd, stt_rec AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec AS stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0 AS stt_rec0hdon, so_luong, he_so
		, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_pn, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hdon, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_ttmh
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d72$000000 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #TranType SELECT loai_ct FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_pn <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c' + @PORefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hdon = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d' + @PORefTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hdon <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hdon = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c' + @PORefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hdon = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_pn <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_pn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_ttmh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPDIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePDIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_pn VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hdon VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_ttmh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec0hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_pn, dyn_dh, dyn_hdon, dyn_hd, dyn_ttmh FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhan = sl_nhan - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_nhap = sl_nhap - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cLinePDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, MAX(dyn_pn) AS dyn_pn, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hdon) AS dyn_hdon, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_ttmh) AS dyn_ttmh FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_pn, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hdon, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPDIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_pn <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPDIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @PORefTable + '000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhan < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c' + @PORefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @SAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @SAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cPOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @PORefTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hdon <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @PORefTable + @dyn_hdon + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_ttmh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_ttmh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPDIDNumber, @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @dyn_pn, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hdon, @dyn_hd, @dyn_ttmh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTMRequirement]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTrainingFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTrainingTo SMALLDATETIME,
