	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Subject VARCHAR(32),
	@TrainingType VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.loai_hinh_dt, b.ma_mh, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_mh
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_loai, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, b.stt_rec_nv, c.ma_nv
			, a.ma_bp, d.stt AS stt_mh, a.status INTO #report
		FROM hrdtyc a, hrdtctyc b, hrnv c, hrdmmh d, hrdmlhdt f

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'c.') + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''	
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Subject <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_mh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Subject), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @TrainingType <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_hinh_dt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@TrainingType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'f.')
	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DateTrainingFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.ngay_tu >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTrainingFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DateTrainingTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.ngay_den <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTrainingTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT @Join = ' left join hrdtctyc b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrnv c with(nolock) on b.stt_rec_nv = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrdmmh d with(nolock) on b.ma_mh = d.ma_mh'
	SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrdmlhdt e with(nolock) on b.loai_hinh_dt = e.ma_loai'
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp f with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = f.ma_bp'

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.loai_hinh_dt, b.ma_mh'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', d.ten_mh' ELSE ', d.ten_mh2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', e.ten_loai' ELSE ', e.ten_loai2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, b.stt_rec_nv, isnull(c.ma_nv, ''''), a.ma_bp, d.stt, a.status'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrdtyc a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--Total
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, '', ma_mh, MAX(ten_mh), '', NULL, NULL, '', '', ma_bp, MIN(stt_mh), ''
			FROM #report GROUP BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, ma_bp, ma_mh

	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, '', '', '', NULL, ''

	-- Result
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_bp ELSE c.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp, a.ma_nv, b.ten AS ho_ten_nv, b.ten_vtr, a.ten_mh, a.ten_loai, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den
		, a.status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.statusname ELSE d.statusname2 END AS statusname
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN vhrnv b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN hrbp c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dmttct d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.status = d.status AND d.ma_ct = 'H07'
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, c.bp_ref, a.stt_mh, a.ma_mh, a.ma_nv
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$GetCodeByName]
	@table VARCHAR(32),
	@fieldCode VARCHAR(32),
	@fieldName NVARCHAR(1024),
	@value NVARCHAR(4000),
	@unitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@condition NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@type TINYINT = 1, -- 1 - Equal Comparisons, # - Levenshtein
	@useUnit TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @max INT, @tableUnit VARCHAR(32), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000)


	IF @value = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 '' AS code
		RETURN
	END


	SELECT @unitKey = '', @key = 'status = 1', @tableUnit = @table + 'dv', @unitCode = ISNULL(@unitCode, '')
	IF @useUnit = 1 EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUnitFilter @unitCode, @userID, @admin, @table, @fieldCode, 'ma_dvcs', 'ds_dvcs', @tableUnit, @unitKey OUTPUT
	IF @unitKey <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	IF @condition <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@condition, '''', '''''')

	-- Equal Comparisons
	IF @type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 ' + @fieldCode + ' as code from ' + @table + ' where ' + @key + ' and ' + @fieldName + ' = N''' + REPLACE(@value, '''', '''''') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RETURN
	END


	-- Levenshtein
	SELECT @q = 'select @c = count(1) from ' + @table
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c int output', @i OUTPUT

	SELECT @max = CASE WHEN @i < 3000 THEN 1
		WHEN @i >= 3000 AND @i < 10000 THEN 10
		WHEN @i >= 10000 AND @i < 20000 THEN 5
		ELSE 1 END

	CREATE TABLE #w(code VARCHAR(32), [weight] INT)
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #w select ' + @fieldCode + ', dbo.Levenshtein(N''' + @value + ''', ' + @fieldName + ', ' + RTRIM(@max) + ') from ' + @table
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and dbo.Levenshtein(N''' + @value + ''', ' + @fieldName + ', ' + RTRIM(@max) + ') is not null'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by dbo.Levenshtein(N''' + @value + ''', ' + @fieldName + ', ' + RTRIM(@max) + ') desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Result
	SELECT TOP 1 code FROM #w ORDER BY [weight]


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckVoucherEditLogView]
	@voucherDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@voucherFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherTo VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@owner BIT,
	@modify INT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @size TINYINT, @t$Prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @t$Prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @h VARCHAR(1024), @r0 BIT, @r1 VARCHAR(1024), @r2 VARCHAR(1024), @f1 VARCHAR(1024), @f2 VARCHAR(1024), @f3 VARCHAR(1024), @j VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024), @i INT, @n INT
	DECLARE @u_yn BIT, @n_yn BIT, @d_yn BIT

	SELECT @f1 = '', @f2 = '', @r2 = '', @t$Prime$Root = REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END, @t$Prime$Root$Log = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(xtable, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + '$log' END END FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT TOP 1 @size = [length] FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('m81$000000') AND name = 'so_ct'
	SELECT @r0 = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmreflog WHERE xcode = @voucherCode) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		, @u_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', '000000')) and name = 'ma_dvcs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		, @n_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', '000000')) and name = 'so_ct') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		, @d_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', '000000')) and name = 'ngay_ct') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		, @f3 = ', d.ten_dvcs%l as ten_dvcs, '''' as c1, '''' as c1log, '''' as c2, '''' as c2log, '''' as c3, '''' as c3log, '''' as c4, '''' as c4log, '''' as c5, '''' as c5log', @j = ' left join dmdvcs d on a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs', @o = 'a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct,'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.idLog, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.[datetime0], a.user_id0, a.[datetime2], a.user_id2 INTO #kTmp FROM m81$log a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct_log, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS so_ct_log INTO #k FROM #kTmp

	-- Field
	SELECT name, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #f0 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@t$Prime$Root$Log) ORDER BY colorder
	SELECT name, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #f1 FROM tempdb.dbo.syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#k') ORDER BY colorder
	SELECT name, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #f2 FROM tempdb.dbo.syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#kTmp') ORDER BY colorder
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS name, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #f3

	IF @r0 = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @h = ',' + REPLACE(xhiddenfield, ' ', '') + ',', @r1 = REPLACE(xreffield, ' ', '') FROM dmreflog WHERE xcode = @voucherCode
		INSERT INTO #f3 (name) SELECT RTRIM(data) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@r1, ',') ORDER BY id
		INSERT INTO #f2 SELECT 'ngay_ct_log' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'so_ct_log'
		SELECT @f3 = '', @j = '', @o = @r1 + CASE WHEN RIGHT(@r1, 1) = ',' THEN '' ELSE ',' END

		DELETE #f1 WHERE CHARINDEX(',' + name + ',', @h) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',' + name + ',', REPLACE(@h, ',', '_log,')) > 0
		DELETE #f2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f1 WHERE #f1.id = #f2.id)

		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @r1 + ' from ' + REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', '000000')
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#kTmp', @q
		SELECT @r1 = @r1 + ', ' + RTRIM(name) + ' as ' + RTRIM(name) + '_log', @r2 = @r2 + ', ' + RTRIM(name) + ' as c' + RTRIM(id) + ', ' + RTRIM(name) + '_log as c' + RTRIM(id) + 'log' FROM #f3 ORDER BY id

		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @r1 + ' from ' + REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', '000000')
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#k', @q

		INSERT INTO #f1 (name) SELECT name FROM #f3 UNION ALL SELECT RTRIM(name) + '_log' FROM #f3
		INSERT INTO #f2 (name) SELECT name FROM #f3 UNION ALL SELECT RTRIM(name) + '_log' FROM #f3

		SELECT @i = MAX(id) + 1 FROM #f3
		WHILE (@i <= 5) BEGIN
			SET @r2 = @r2 + ', '''' as c' + RTRIM(@i) + ', '''' as c' + RTRIM(@i) + 'log'
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END
		SELECT @f3 = @r2 + ', '''' as ten_dvcs'
	END

	UPDATE #f2 SET name = '''''' FROM #f2 a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f0 b WHERE b.name = a.name)
	UPDATE #f2 SET name = '$%a.' + RTRIM(name) WHERE name <> ''''''
	IF @r0 = 0 INSERT INTO #f2 SELECT '$%a.ngay_ct_log' AS name UNION ALL SELECT '$%a.so_ct_log'
	SELECT @f1 = @f1 + CASE WHEN @f1 <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + name FROM #f1 ORDER BY id
	SELECT @f2 = @f2 + CASE WHEN @f2 <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + name FROM #f2 ORDER BY id

	-- Data voucher
	SELECT @key = 'exists(select 1 from ' + rtrim(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec)'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.status <> ''*'''
	IF @u_yn = 1 BEGIN
		IF @voucherFrom <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@voucherFrom), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
		IF @voucherTo <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@voucherTo), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	END
	IF @owner = 1 SELECT @key = @key + ' and (a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ')'
	IF ISNULL(@modify, 0) <> 0 SELECT @key = @key + ' and ((a.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + ') or exists(select 1 from ' + rtrim(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and b.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + '))'

	IF @u_yn = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
		IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	END

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Voucher
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #k(' + @f1 + ')
	select ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f2, '$%a.idlog', '0'), '$%a.ngay_ct_log,$%a.so_ct_log', 'a.ngay_ct,a.so_ct'), '$%a', 'a') + '
		from ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root) + ' a
			where %[' + @key + ']%
'
	IF CHARINDEX('%partition', @t$Prime$Root) > 0 EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%[', ''), ']%', '')
		IF @d_yn = 1 SELECT @q = @q + ' and (a.ngay_ct between @voucherDateFrom and @voucherDateTo)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherDateFrom smalldatetime, @voucherDateTo smalldatetime', @voucherDateFrom, @voucherDateTo
	END

	-- Log
	SELECT @q = '
insert into #k(' + @f1 + ')
	select ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f2, '$%a.idlog', 'b.idlog'), '$%a.datetime2,$%a.user_id2', 'b.datetime2,b.user_id2'), '$%a.ngay_ct_log,$%a.so_ct_log', 'c.ngay_ct,c.so_ct'), '$%a', 'a') + '
		from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			left join ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' c on b.stt_rec = c.stt_rec and b.idlog = c.idlog + 1
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	--
	UPDATE #k SET idlog = b.idlog + 1 FROM #k a LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(idlog) AS idlog, stt_rec FROM #k GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.idLog = 0
	DELETE #k WHERE idlog = 1
	UPDATE #k SET idlog = idlog - 1
	--
	IF @r0 = 0 SELECT @q = 'update #k set so_ct_log = b.so_ct, ngay_ct_log = b.ngay_ct from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.idlog = b.idlog'
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @h = ''
		SELECT @h = @h + CASE WHEN @h <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + name + '_log = b.' + name + '' FROM #f3 ORDER BY id
		IF @n_yn = 1 SELECT @h = @h + ', so_ct_log = b.so_ct'
		IF @d_yn = 1 SELECT @h = @h + ', ngay_ct_log = b.ngay_ct'
		SELECT @q = 'update #k set ' + @h + ' from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.idlog = b.idlog'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- View
	SELECT @q = '
select a.*, b.comment%l as comment0, c.comment%l as comment2' + RTRIM(@f3) + '
	from #k a left join vsysuserinfo b on a.[user_id0] = b.id left join vsysuserinfo c on a.[user_id2] = c.id' + RTRIM(@j) + '
	order by ' + RTRIM(@o) + 'a.stt_rec, a.[datetime2], a.idLog
'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AutoCreateSupplier]
	@TempTable VARCHAR(64),
	@SupplierCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Nested BIT,
	@Error CHAR(1) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @cusLength INT, @pre VARCHAR(16), @aft VARCHAR(16), @code VARCHAR(32), @nMax NUMERIC(17, 0), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @len INT, @n INT, @i INT, @f INT, @y VARCHAR(4), @m VARCHAR(2), @d VARCHAR(2), @ma_ncc VARCHAR(16), @stt INT, @count INT, @inMax NUMERIC(17, 0)
	SELECT @cusLength = max_length FROM sys.columns WHERE name = 'ma_kh' and OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID('dmkh')

	SELECT @TempTable = QUOTENAME(REPLACE(RTRIM(@TempTable), '''', '')), @SupplierCode = REPLACE(RTRIM(@SupplierCode), '''', ''''''), @ma_ncc = ''

	SELECT @d = RIGHT('0' + RTRIM(DAY(GETDATE())), 2), @m = RIGHT('0' + RTRIM(MONTH(GETDATE())), 2), @y = RTRIM(YEAR(GETDATE()))
	SELECT @code = UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(@SupplierCode, '[', ''), ']', ''))
	SELECT @code = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@code), 'YYYY' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @y), 'YYY' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 3)), 'YY' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 2)), 'Y' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 1)), 'MM' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @m), 'DD' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @d)

	-- Kiểm tra độ dài
	IF LEN(@code) > @cusLength BEGIN
		SELECT @Error = '1'
		RETURN
	END
	
	-- Kiểm tra phải có vùng tăng số ở cuối
	IF RIGHT(RTRIM(@code), 1) <> '#' BEGIN
		IF (CHARINDEX('TAXCODE', @code, 0) > 0) BEGIN
			GOTO CREATE_TAXCODE;
		END

		SELECT @Error = '1'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Xác định vị trí tăng số
	SELECT @n = LEN(@code)
	SELECT @i = @n, @f = @n
	WHILE @i >= 1 BEGIN
		IF SUBSTRING(@code, @i, 1) = '#' SET @f = @i
			ELSE BREAK
		SET @i = @i - 1
	END
	SELECT @len = @n - @f + 1, @pre = LEFT(@code, @n - @len), @aft = RIGHT(@code, @len)

	-- Get Max Value
	SELECT @nMax = ISNULL(RIGHT(RTRIM(MAX(ma_kh)), @len), 0) FROM dmkh WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_kh LIKE REPLACE(@code, '#', '[0-9]') AND LEN(RTRIM(ma_kh)) = LEN(@code) AND ma_kh LIKE '%[0-9]%'

	SELECT @ma_ncc = @pre + REPLACE(STR(@nMax, @len), ' ', '0')
	IF ISNULL(@ma_ncc, '') = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @Error = '2'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Kiểm tra sau khi tăng số max có vượt ký tự vùng tăng không
	-- Cập nhật ma_kh cho @TempTable
	-- Kiểm tra mã lồng nhau theo tham số @Nested
	SELECT @inMax = CAST(REPLACE(@aft, '#', '9') AS NUMERIC(17, 0)), @nMax = ISNULL(@nMax, 1), @pre = UPPER(@pre)

	SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + @TempTable + ' where len(replace(@pre, ''TAXCODE'', replace(mst_ncc, ''-'', '''')) + replace(str(@nmax + stt, @len), '' '', ''0'')) > @cusLength) begin
	select @error = ''1''
	return
end
if exists (select 1 from ' + @TempTable + ' where stt = (select max(stt) from ' + @TempTable + ') and stt > (@inMax - @nMax)) begin
	select @error = ''3''
	return
end

update ' + @TempTable + ' set ma_ncc = substring(replace(@pre, ''TAXCODE'', replace(mst_ncc, ''-'', '''')) + replace(str(@nmax + stt, @len), '' '', ''0''), 1, @cusLength)

if @nested = 1 begin
	if exists(select 1 from ' + @TempTable + ' a, dmkh b with (nolock index(pk_dmkh)) where (a.ma_ncc like rtrim(b.ma_kh) + ''%'' or b.ma_kh like rtrim(a.ma_ncc) + ''%'')) begin
		select @error = ''4''
		return
	end
end
'

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @q, N'@inMax numeric(17, 0), @nMax numeric(17, 0), @pre varchar(16), @len int, @nested bit, @cusLength int, @error char(1) output', @inMax, @nMax, @pre, @len, @nested, @cusLength, @error OUTPUT
	RETURN

CREATE_TAXCODE:

	SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + @TempTable + ' where len(replace(@code, ''TAXCODE'', replace(mst_ncc, ''-'', ''''))) > @cusLength) begin
	select @error = ''1''
	return
end

update ' + @TempTable + ' set ma_ncc = substring(replace(@code, ''TAXCODE'', replace(mst_ncc, ''-'', '''')), 1, @cusLength)

if @nested = 1 begin
	if exists(select 1 from ' + @TempTable + ' a, dmkh b with (nolock index(pk_dmkh)) where (a.ma_ncc like rtrim(b.ma_kh) + ''%'' or b.ma_kh like rtrim(a.ma_ncc) + ''%'')) begin
		select @error = ''4''
		return
	end
end
'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @q, N'@code varchar(32), @nested bit, @cusLength int, @error char(1) output', @code, @nested, @cusLength, @error OUTPUT

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIInspectionPlan]
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.ma_cd, a.ma_dac_tinh, a.so_luong_mau, a.ty_le_mau, a.gia_tri_tu, a.gia_tri_den, a.yeu_cau, line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_dac_tinh' + @cE + ' AS ten_dac_tinh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmdactinh g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dac_tinh = g.ma_dac_tinh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 4, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''stt, ma_cd, ma_dac_tinh, ten_dac_tinh'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryByLocation] --fs_StockSummaryByLoc
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Location VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	--UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap
			, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt2, 0 AS stt3, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt
		, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, a.ma_vt AS ma, b.ten_vt AS ten, b.ten_vt2 AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt2, stt3, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Location @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, @Location, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vi_tri <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Location <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vi_tri like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Location), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri
			, SUM(a.ton_dau), SUM(a.du_dau), SUM(a.du_dau_nt), SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nt_n), SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.tien_xuat), SUM(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0
			, MAX(b.dvt), MAX(b.loai_vt), MAX(b.nh_vt1), MAX(b.ten_vt), MAX(b.ten_vt2), a.ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_vt), MAX(b.ten_vt2)
		FROM #tmp a left join dmvt b WITH(nolock) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		WHERE a.ma_vi_tri <> '''' GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0 AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat = 0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0
	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1'
		DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2'
		DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 4,1,0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.loai_vt,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a. du_dau),SUM(a. du_dau_nt),SUM(a. sl_nhap),SUM(a. sl_xuat),
					SUM(a. tien_nhap),SUM(a. tien_xuat),SUM(a. tien_nt_n),SUM(a. tien_nt_x),SUM(a. ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a. du_cuoi),SUM(a. du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, a.loai_vt
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 4,1,0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.nh_vt1,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a. du_dau),SUM(a. du_dau_nt),SUM(a. sl_nhap),SUM(a. sl_xuat),
					SUM(a. tien_nhap),SUM(a. tien_xuat),SUM(a. tien_nt_n),SUM(a. tien_nt_x),SUM(a. ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a. du_cuoi),SUM(a. du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, a.nh_vt1
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvitri b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 2,1,0, a.ma_kho,N'' AS ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_kho) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_kho2) AS ten2,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho

	--Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024), @g VARCHAR(1024), @g1 VARCHAR(1024), @w VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri', @w = 'sysorder > 1 and systotal = 1'
	SELECT @g1 = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
		, @o = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g1, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 2
	CREATE TABLE #order2(ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order2 (ma_kho) select ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 2 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt2 = b.stt from #report a join #order2 b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 2

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 3
	CREATE TABLE #order3(ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order3 (ma_vi_tri, ma_kho) select ma_vi_tri, ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 3 or sysorder = 2 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_kho into #group3 from #order3 group by ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt3 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order3 b on a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho join #group3 c on b.ma_kho = c.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 3'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 3
	--
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @s1 AS ten_vt, @s12 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
			SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
			SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #reporttt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal)
		VALUES (' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', 1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT '', ten_vt, ten_vt2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #reporttt

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten2 NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt NVARCHAR(16)

	UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(sysorder * 2) + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ten, ten_vt))), ten2 = SPACE(sysorder*2) + LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(ten2, ten_vt2))), ma = CASE sysorder WHEN 2 THEN ma_kho WHEN 3 THEN ma_vi_tri ELSE ma END, stt = CASE sysorder WHEN 2 THEN dbo.ff_Arab2Roman(stt2) + '.' WHEN 3 THEN CHAR(stt3 + 64) ELSE stt END

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = 'select * from #report order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'select * from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString('ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ' + @Group  , 'sysorder, ' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter]
	@CodeField VARCHAR(64),
	@Code VARCHAR(32),
	@UnitKey VARCHAR(4000),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Return NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
	@Extention VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS  
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @CodeKey NVARCHAR(4000), @n INT, @RangeNumber INT, @f VARCHAR(64), @t VARCHAR(64), @r VARCHAR(64), @xtype TINYINT, @fr VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT @Return = NULL, @xtype = SUBSTRING(@Extention, 1, 1)

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN

	IF @Admin = 1 RETURN

	-- No limit rights
	IF @xtype = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisysplantrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) RETURN
	IF @xtype = 2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurgrouprights WHERE user_id = @UserID) RETURN

	-- Full access rights
	IF ((@xtype = 1) AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmvung a JOIN sysunitrights b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs JOIN bisysplantrights c ON a.ma_vung = c.ma_vung WHERE b.user_id = @UserID AND b.r_access = 1 AND c.user_id = @UserID)
		= (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmvung a JOIN sysunitrights b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs WHERE b.user_id = @UserID AND b.r_access = 1))) RETURN
	IF ((@xtype = 2) AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmnhom0 a JOIN bisyspurgrouprights b ON a.ma_nh = b.ma_nh0 WHERE b.user_id = @UserID) = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmnhom0))) RETURN

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @f = CASE @xtype WHEN 1 THEN 'ma_vung' ELSE 'ma_nh0' END, @fr = CASE @xtype WHEN 1 THEN 'ma_vung' ELSE 'ma_nh' END, @t = CASE @xtype WHEN 1 THEN 'bidmvung' ELSE 'bidmnhom0' END, @r = CASE @xtype WHEN 1 THEN 'bisysplantrights' ELSE 'bisyspurgrouprights' END
	IF @xtype = 2 SELECT @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Code <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.' + RTRIM(@fr) + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Code), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	CREATE TABLE #s(s NVARCHAR(4000))
	SELECT @q = '
declare @s nvarchar(4000)
select @s = isnull(@s, '''') + case when @s is null then '''' else '','' end + rtrim(' + RTRIM(@f) + ')
	from ' + RTRIM(@r) + '
	where user_id = @UserID and ' + RTRIM(@f) + ' in (select ' + RTRIM(@fr) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@t) + ' a' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ')
insert into #s select @s
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@UserID int', @UserID
	SELECT @CodeKey = s FROM #s

	-- Key is invalid
	IF @CodeKey IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@CodeKey, ',')

	-- Only one site
	IF @CodeKey = @Code RETURN

	IF @n = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @CodeField + ' = ''' + @CodeKey + ''')'
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @RangeNumber = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_site_number'
	
	IF @n <= @RangeNumber BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @CodeField + ' in (''' + REPLACE(@CodeKey, ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @CodeField + ' in (select ' + RTRIM(@f) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@r) + ' where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + '))'
		RETURN
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesArisingComparison] --fs20_AccRateDept2Period--
	@DateFrom1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023) ,
	@AccountNoMinus VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Report CHAR(48),
	@Group VARCHAR(128),
	@GroupFee1 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee2 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @strName CHAR(8), @Groups VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @nPs NUMERIC(28, 6), @nPs_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @minPivot AS NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, ma_vv, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, ps_no AS ps2, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_bp' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_vv' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @GroupFee1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @AccountNoMinus <> ''
		SET @Key2 = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'notinlist', @AccountNoMinus)
	ELSE
		SET @Key2 = '(1 = 0)'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	IF @GroupFee1 + @GroupFee2 + @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmphi b on a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'

	SET @s = 'insert into #tmp select a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv, @ReportField'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @s = @s + ' where %[@Key]%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv'

	-- Ky 1
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom1, @DateTo1, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 1 (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom1, @DateTo1, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 2
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 2 (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, ma_vv
			, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(ps2) AS ps2, SUM(ps_nt2) AS ps_nt2
			, SUM(ps2) - SUM(ps) AS ps_cl, SUM(ps_nt2) - SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_cl
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_bp, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_bp2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_vv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_vv2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xKey, CAST('' AS CHAR(64)) AS xDetail
		INTO #report1 FROM #tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, ma_vv

	IF @Report = 'tk' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_tk = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END, ten_tk2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	IF @Report = 'ma_bp' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_bp = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE '' END, ten_bp2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_bp2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_phi = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_phi ELSE '' END, ten_phi2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_phi2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmphi b ON a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi
	IF @Report = 'ma_vv' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_vv = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE '' END, ten_vv2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_vv2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv

	SET @q = 'update #report1 set xDetail = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report1 WHERE xDetail = '' OR xDetail IS NULL
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps + ps_nt + ps2 + ps_nt2 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #report FROM #report1

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select distinct 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, max(tk), max(ma_bp), max(ma_phi), max(ma_vv)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt), sum(ps2), sum(ps_nt2), sum(ps_cl), sum(ps_cl_nt), max(ty_le_cl)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', max(ten_tk), max(ten_tk2), max(ten_bp), max(ten_bp2), max(ten_phi), max(ten_phi2), max(ten_vv), max(ten_vv2), max(xkey), max(xdetail)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #report1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by ' + @Group + '@Comma xDetail'
	IF @Group <> '' SET @q = REPLACE (@q, '@Comma', ',') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE (@q, '@Comma', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ma_vv, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_bp, ten_bp2, ten_vv, ten_vv2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ps = 0 AND ps2 = 0 AND systotal = 1
	IF @Group <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup3(@Group , REPLACE(@Report, 'ma_', ''), 'ps, ps2, ps_nt, ps_nt2, ps_cl, ps_cl_nt,ty_le_cl', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

	UPDATE #report SET tk = ISNULL(tk, ''), ma_phi = ISNULL(ma_phi, ''), ma_bp = ISNULL(ma_bp, ''), ma_vv = ISNULL(ma_vv, ''), xDetail = ISNULL(xDetail, '')

	SET @Groups = REPLACE(@Group, ',', ' + ')
	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = 'update #report set xKey = ' + @Groups +' + xDetail'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'update #report set xKey = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT DISTINCT MAX(sysorder) AS sysorder, MAX(sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(systotal) AS systotal, 0 AS stt, xKey , MAX(xDetail) AS xDetail, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
			, MAX(ma_phi) AS ma_phi, MAX(ma_vv) AS ma_vv, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(ps2) AS ps2,SUM(ps_nt2) AS ps_nt2, SUM(ps_cl) AS ps_cl, SUM(ps_cl_nt) AS ps_cl_nt, MAX(ty_le_cl) AS ty_le_cl, MAX(ty_le_cl) AS ty_le_cl_nt
			, MAX(ten_tk) AS ten_tk, MAX(ten_tk2) AS ten_tk2, MAX(ten_phi) AS ten_phi, MAX(ten_phi2) AS ten_phi2, MAX(ten_bp) AS ten_bp, MAX(ten_bp2) AS ten_bp2, MAX(ten_vv) AS ten_vv, MAX(ten_vv2) AS ten_vv2
		INTO #report3
		FROM #report
		GROUP BY xKey, sysorder

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report3', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ma_vv, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_bp, ten_bp2, ten_vv, ten_vv2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33),NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report3 SET ty_le_cl = CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ps, 0) = 0 OR ps2 = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (ps_cl * 100 / ps) END, ty_le_cl_nt = CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ps_nt, 0) = 0 OR ps_nt2 = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (ps_cl_nt * 100 / ps_nt) END

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @o = 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN @Group = '' THEN ', ' ELSE ', ' + @Group + ', ' END + 'xkey'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	UPDATE #report3 SET stt = NULL WHERE stt = 0
	IF UPPER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 1, 3)) = 'MA_'
		SET @strName = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 'ma_', 'ten_')))
	ELSE
		SET @strName =LTRIM(RTRIM('ten_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report))))

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + ' = N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + '2 = ' +CHAR(39)+ @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' where systotal = 0 and (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName )) + ' is null or ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName )) + ' = N' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'alter table #report3 alter column ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' nvarchar(511) null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' alter table #report3 alter column ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 nvarchar(511) null'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 where sysorder > 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report3) INSERT INTO #report3 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, systotal, sysprint, xDetail, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ma_vv, ps, ps2, ps_nt, ps_nt2, ps_cl, ps_cl_nt, ty_le_cl, ty_le_cl_nt, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' as ten_key, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 as ten_key2 from #report3 order by xKey, sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTSTransfer] @idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @dTranfer SMALLDATETIME, @nYPrev INT, @nMPrev INT, @cKey VARCHAR(1024), @d SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @ma_dc VARCHAR(33), @ma_bp_tu VARCHAR(33), @tk_cp0 VARCHAR(33), @tk_pb0 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @nRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nFCRound = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien_nt'

	SELECT @dTranfer = ngay_ct, @ma_dc = ma_dc, @ma_bp_tu = ma_bp_tu, @cKey = CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + RTRIM(so_ct) + RTRIM(@idNumber) FROM dcbpsddc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmccdc WHERE ma_dc = @ma_dc AND ma_nt = (SELECT val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0')) SELECT @nFCRound = @nRound

	IF MONTH(@dTranfer) = 1 SELECT @nMPrev = 12, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dTranfer) - 1
	ELSE SELECT @nMPrev = MONTH(@dTranfer) - 1, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dTranfer)
	SELECT @tk_cp0 = MAX(tk_cp), @tk_pb0 = MAX(tk_pb) FROM ctpsdc WHERE ma_dc = @ma_dc AND ma_bp_dc = @ma_bp_tu AND stt_rec <> @idNumber AND ngay_ct <= @dTranfer
	SELECT *, tk_pb AS tk_dc INTO #t FROM dcbpsddc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_dc, ma_nt, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #r FROM ctcddc


	-- Get data from ctcddc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, tk_dc, ma_nt, so_luong, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt
			FROM ctcddc WHERE ky = @nMPrev AND nam = @nYPrev AND ma_dc = @ma_dc AND ma_bp_dc = @ma_bp_tu


	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r) SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMPrev, @nYPrev)



	-- Get data from ctpsdc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, MAX(tk_dc), MAX(ma_nt), ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM(nguyen_gia_n - nguyen_gia_x), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM(nguyen_gia_nt_n - nguyen_gia_nt_x), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM((nguyen_gia_n - gt_da_pb_n) - (nguyen_gia_x - gt_da_pb_x)), 0)
				, ISNULL(SUM((nguyen_gia_nt_n - gt_da_pb_nt_n) - (nguyen_gia_nt_x - gt_da_pb_nt_x)), 0)
			FROM ctpsdc WHERE ma_dc = @ma_dc AND ma_bp_dc = @ma_bp_tu AND (@d IS NULL OR ngay_ct > @d)
				AND stt_rec <> @idNumber
				AND CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec < @cKey
			GROUP BY ma_dc, ma_bp_dc



	-- Update
	UPDATE #t SET ma_nt = b.ma_nt
			, nguyen_gia = CASE WHEN b.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong THEN b.nguyen_gia ELSE ROUND(b.nguyen_gia * a.so_luong / b.so_luong, @nRound) END
			, nguyen_gia_nt = CASE WHEN b.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong THEN b.nguyen_gia_nt ELSE ROUND(b.nguyen_gia_nt * a.so_luong / b.so_luong, @nFCRound) END
			, gt_cl = CASE WHEN b.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong THEN b.gt_cl ELSE ROUND(b.gt_cl * a.so_luong / b.so_luong, @nRound) END
			, gt_cl_nt = CASE WHEN b.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 WHEN a.so_luong = b.so_luong THEN b.gt_cl_nt ELSE ROUND(b.gt_cl_nt * a.so_luong / b.so_luong, @nFCRound) END
		FROM #t a JOIN (SELECT ma_dc, ma_bp_dc, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong
							, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
						FROM #r GROUP BY ma_dc, ma_bp_dc
			)b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.ma_bp_tu = b.ma_bp_dc


	-- Post
	DELETE ctpsdc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	INSERT INTO ctpsdc (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc
			, ma_ld_tg, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, loai_ps, ma_nt
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x
			, gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_da_pb_x, gt_da_pb_nt_x
			, gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, gt_cl_x, gt_cl_nt_x
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_tu
				, '', a.tk_dc, @tk_pb0, @tk_cp0, 1, a.ma_nt
				, 0, a.so_luong
				, 0, 0, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt
				, 0, 0, a.nguyen_gia - a.gt_cl, a.nguyen_gia_nt - a.gt_cl_nt
				, 0, 0, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
				, '1', a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
			FROM #t a

		INSERT INTO ctpsdc (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc, ma_bp_dc
			, ma_ld_tg, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, loai_ps, ma_nt
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x
			, gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_da_pb_x, gt_da_pb_nt_x
			, gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, gt_cl_x, gt_cl_nt_x
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc, a.ma_bp_den
				, '', a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, 1, a.ma_nt
				, a.so_luong, 0
				, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, 0, 0
				, a.nguyen_gia - a.gt_cl, a.nguyen_gia_nt - a.gt_cl_nt, 0, 0
				, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, 0, 0
				, '1', a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
			FROM #t a

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$CurrentCustomerBalance]
	@Variable VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Action VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @s = 'select ma_kh, sum(ps_no - ps_co) as du13 into #currentBalance from ' + @Variable
	SET @s = @s + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
 	SET @s = @s + ' and status = ''1'' and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_tk = 1 and tk_cn = 1)'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by ma_kh'
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'update dmkh set du13 = b.du13 - a.du13 from #currentBalance a join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s	
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END
