CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodSalesAnalysis] -- fs20_SOSalesAnalysis4MC
	@Time AS CHAR(1),
	@Count AS INT,
	@DateStart AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo AS VARCHAR(32), 	
	@Customer AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Site AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@SalesEmployee AS VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason AS VARCHAR(32), 
	@Job AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Department AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode AS VARCHAR(254),  
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Size TINYINT, 
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@CalculateTransfer AS CHAR(1),
	@TransactionCode AS VARCHAR(254),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @DateEnd SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024), @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sQuantity NVARCHAR(1024), @sAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @sFCAmount NVARCHAR(1024), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32)
	
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sQuantity = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT001'
	SELECT @sAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT002'
	SELECT @sFCAmount = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT003'

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkin	
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS xCycle, ma_vt, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien2, tien_nt2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS cKey INTO #report FROM wrkin

	SELECT @DateEnd = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12 * @Count, @DateStart) END)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.nxt = ''2''', @Join = ''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and ct_dc <> 1'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @ItemGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	--
	DECLARE @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @ItemGroup + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 + @ItemType <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien2), sum(case when ma_nt = '''' or  ma_nt = ''' + RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) + ''' then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end) from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt, sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien2), sum(case when ma_nt = '''' or  ma_nt = ''' + RTRIM(@m_ma_nt0) + ''' then 0 else a.tien_nt2 end) from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by a.ngay_ct, a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateStart, @DateEnd, @UserID, @Admin	
	END

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @DateStart
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, -1, CASE
				WHEN @Time = 1 THEN DATEADD(Day, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 2 THEN DATEADD(Day, 7, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 3 THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 4 THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 5 THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @d)
				WHEN @Time = 6 THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @d) END)
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, @i, ma_vt, SUM(so_luong), SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @d AND @d2 GROUP BY ma_vt
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 0, @i, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) FROM #tmp
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1	
	END

	-- Order
	CREATE TABLE #o (stt INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, ma_vt VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
	CREATE INDEX o ON #o(ma_vt)
	INSERT INTO #o SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vt
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, 0, '', 0, 0, 0, ''
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS systotal, 1 AS sysprint, a.stt, REPLACE(STR(a.xCycle, 3), ' ', '0') AS xCycle, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, b.dvt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
		ORDER BY a.stt, a.xCycle

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header INT NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header) SELECT DISTINCT xCycle FROM #report ORDER BY xCycle
	
	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'so_luong$', @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien2$', @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien_nt2$', @sFCAmount

	SELECT a.id, b.id AS id2, b.name + LTRIM(a.id) AS name, @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(a.header) + ' - ' + b.header AS header
		INTO #pivot 
		FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b 
	
	-- Total
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 1, 'so_luong', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sQuantity
	IF ((@ReportForm = 20) OR (@ReportForm = 30)) INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sAmount
	IF @ReportForm = 30 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, 2, 'tien_nt2', @sTotal + ' - ' + @sFCAmount

	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id, id2
	DROP TABLE #pivot

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPurchaseApprovalRolesDetail]
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Function VARCHAR(32),
	@ApprovingOfficer VARCHAR(32),
	@Order CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @function_name_pr NVARCHAR(1024), @function_name_po NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @function_name_pr = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT093'
	SELECT @function_name_po = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT094'

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_quyen AS quyen, a.status AS tu_trang_thai, a.status2 AS trang_thai_duyet, a.status0 AS trang_thai_huy, b.ten_quyen AS ten_quyen, c.ma_kieu AS kieu_duyet, c.ten_kieu AS ten_kieu_duyet,
			b.loai_duyet AS chuc_nang, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_chuc_nang, e.u_status_name AS ten_tu_trang_thai, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_duyet, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_huy,
			j.name AS nguoi_duyet, j.comment AS ten_nguoi_duyet, line_nbr AS line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2
		INTO #report FROM dmquyenct a, dmquyen b, dmkieuduyet c, dmttcttg e, dmduyet i, vsysuserinfo j

	SET @Key = 'status = 1 and convert(char(8), ngay_hl, 112) <= ' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112)
	IF @Function <> '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai_duyet = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Function), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ApprovingOfficer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and user_id = ' + (SELECT RTRIM(id) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE name = REPLACE(RTRIM(@ApprovingOfficer), '''', ''''''))
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 user_id, loai_duyet, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2, ma_quyen INTO #dmduyet FROM dmduyet

	SET @q = 'insert into #dmduyet select a.user_id, a.loai_duyet, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_hl2, a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'from dmduyet a join '
	SET @q = @q + '(select user_id, loai_duyet, max(ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from dmduyet where ' + @Key + ' group by user_id, loai_duyet) b '
	SET @q = @q + 'on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct a.ma_quyen, a.status, a.status2, a.status0, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_quyen' ELSE 'b.ten_quyen2' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(c.ma_kieu, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(c.ten_kieu, '''')' ELSE 'isnull(c.ten_kieu2, '''')' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'b.loai_duyet, case when b.loai_duyet = ''1'' then N''' + @function_name_pr + ''' else N''' + @function_name_po + ''' END , '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.u_status_name ' ELSE 'e.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'f.u_status_name ' ELSE 'f.u_status_name2 'END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.u_status_name ' ELSE 'g.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(j.name, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(j.comment, '''') ' ELSE 'isnull(j.comment2, '''') ' END + ', line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'from dmquyenct a join dmquyen b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen left join dmkieuduyet c on b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet and a.kieu_duyet = c.ma_kieu '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join dmttcttg e on e.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and e.u_status = a.status '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join dmttcttg f on f.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and f.u_status = a.status2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join dmttcttg g on g.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and g.u_status = a.status0 '
	SET @q = @q + 'join #dmduyet i on i.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and i.ma_quyen = a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'join vsysuserinfo j on j.id = i.user_id'
	SET @q = @q + ' where b.status = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE FROM #report WHERE nguoi_duyet = ''

	IF @Order = 1
		SELECT chuc_nang, ten_chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, ten_nguoi_duyet, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr
	IF @Order = 2
		SELECT chuc_nang AS nguoi_duyet, ten_chuc_nang AS ten_nguoi_duyet, nguoi_duyet AS chuc_nang, ten_nguoi_duyet AS ten_chuc_nang, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY nguoi_duyet, chuc_nang, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AdvancedWriteOffView]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@ReceivableFrom NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@ReceivableTo NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@TypeInvoice CHAR(1), -- 1 - Not yet, 2 - Overpayments
	@TypeVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1 - AR (20), 2 - AP (30)
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @tableName VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency CHAR(3)

	SELECT @baseCurrency = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_v, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk
		, a.ps_no AS phai_thu, a.ps_no AS da_thu, a.ps_no AS con_pt
		, a.ma_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl a

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.loai_tt = 0' + CASE WHEN @TypeInvoice = '1' THEN ' and a.tat_toan = 0' WHEN @TypeInvoice = '2' THEN ' and ((a.ma_nt = '''' and a.t_tt < a.t_tt_qd) or (a.ma_nt <> '''' and a.t_tt_nt < a.t_tt_qd))' END
		, @tableName = CASE WHEN @TypeVoucher = '1' THEN 'cttt20' ELSE 'cttt30' END, @Join = ''
	--
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.tk like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Account), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_kh3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@CustomerGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	-- Check Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @CustomerGroup1 + @CustomerGroup2 + @CustomerGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, left(a.stt_rec, 10)+ma_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.tk'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when isnull(a.ma_nt, '''') = '''' then a.t_tt else a.t_tt_nt end, a.t_tt_qd'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when isnull(a.ma_nt, '''') = '''' then a.t_tt else a.t_tt_nt end - a.t_tt_qd'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case when isnull(a.ma_nt, '''') = '''' then N''' + @baseCurrency + ''' else rtrim(a.ma_nt) end'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableName + ' a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF ABS(@ReceivableFrom) + ABS(@ReceivableTo) > 0 DELETE #tmp WHERE ISNULL(con_pt, 0) < @ReceivableFrom OR ISNULL(con_pt, 0) > @ReceivableTo

	-- View
	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE b.ten_kh2 END AS ten_kh FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF	
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APCalExRD](
	@cFC VARCHAR(32),
	@nRate NUMERIC(24, 12),
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023))
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRound INT, @Ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @cUnits = dbo.ff_GetUnitRightListNew(@nUserID)
	SELECT @nRound = CAST(RTRIM(Val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @Ngay_ct = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nCycle, @nYear)
	SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co, t_tt_qd, t_tt_qd0, loai_tt, t_tt0, ma_dvcs, tk INTO #cttt30
		FROM cttt30 WHERE loai_tt = 0 AND (tat_toan IS NULL OR tat_toan = 0) AND ma_nt = @cFC AND ngay_ct <= @Ngay_ct
			AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
	UPDATE #cttt30 SET t_tt_qd = t_tt_qd0 + a.t_tt_qd
		FROM
		(
			SELECT stt_rec_tt, SUM(tt_qd) AS t_tt_qd FROM cttt30
				WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec_tt IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt30) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
				GROUP BY stt_rec_tt
		) a JOIN #cttt30 ON a.stt_rec_tt = #cttt30.stt_rec WHERE loai_tt = 0

	UPDATE #cttt30 SET t_tt_nt = t_tt_nt - t_tt_qd, ty_gia_dg = @nRate
	UPDATE #cttt30 SET ty_gia = dbo.ff_GetExRate(ty_gia, ngay_ct, @Ngay_ct, @cFC, 2)


	-- Reupdate
	SELECT ma_dvcs, tk, ty_gia INTO #dmtgdg FROM dmtgdg WHERE ky = @nCycle AND nam = @nYear AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@cFC) AND dbo.ff_InUnitRights(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@cUnit), @cUnits) = 1
	UPDATE #cttt30 SET ty_gia_dg = b.ty_gia FROM #cttt30 a JOIN #dmtgdg b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs AND a.tk = b.tk

	UPDATE #cttt30 SET t_tt = ROUND(t_tt_nt * ty_gia, @nRound), t_tt0 = ROUND(t_tt_nt * ty_gia_dg, @nRound)
	UPDATE #cttt30 SET tien_cl_no = CASE WHEN t_tt0 > t_tt THEN t_tt0 - t_tt ELSE 0 END, tien_cl_co = CASE WHEN t_tt0 > t_tt THEN 0 ELSE t_tt - t_tt0 END

	DELETE cttt31 WHERE ngay_ct = @ngay_ct AND ma_nt = @cFC AND stt_rec_hd IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #cttt30)
	INSERT INTO cttt31
		(
			stt_rec_hd, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, ky, nam, tien_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tien, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co,
			status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2
		)
	SELECT stt_rec, @ngay_ct, @ngay_ct, @nCycle, @nYear, t_tt_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, t_tt,ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co, '1', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), 0, 0
		FROM #cttt30
		WHERE ABS(tien_cl_no) + ABS(tien_cl_co) > 0

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PO] -- fs_BeforUpdatePO
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @RefTable VARCHAR(64)
	SET @RefTable = SUBSTRING(@masterTable, 2, 3)

	CREATE TABLE #voucher(loai_ct CHAR(1))
	SET @s = 'insert into #voucher select loai_ct from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #voucher WHERE loai_ct <> '1') RETURN

	SET @s = 'UPDATE ' + @masterTable + ' SET xtag = status WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_kh
		INTO #afterUpdate FROM d95$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_nc <> '''' or stt_rec_kh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c' + @RefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_kh <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_kh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c93$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_kh = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_kh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, stt_rec_kh, stt_rec0kh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_hd, dyn_nc, dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*@nRate/he_so, 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @RefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_dh = sl_dh - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc, MAX(dyn_kh) AS dyn_kh FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_nc, stt_rec_kh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @RefTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_kh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m93$' + @dyn_kh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET xstatus = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh = 0 AND xstatus = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_dh < sl_duyet)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PRStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PRStatus = status FROM i91$' + @dyn_nc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c91$000000 SET status = @PRStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET status = @PRStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPCIDNumber, @cPRIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_nc, @dyn_kh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmpbky1]
AS
SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT d.tag, d.stt, d.stt_rec, d.ma_dvcs, d.ky, d.nam, d.ma_bt, d.so_ct
		, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.ten_bt, a.loai_pb, a.so_ky_pb, a.ngay_bd, a.ngay_kt
		, a.ma_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.tien_pb, a.tien_pb_nt, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt, a.tien_pb_ky, a.tien_pb_ky_nt
		, a.ma_kh, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.status
		, b.ten_tk AS ten_tk_no, b.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_no2, c.ten_tk AS ten_tk_co, c.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_co2 
		, e.ten_kh, e.ten_kh2
	FROM dbo.dmpbky1 d LEFT JOIN dmpbky a ON d.ma_bt = a.ma_bt 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmtk b ON a.tk_no = b.tk 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmtk c ON a.tk_co = c.tk 
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkh	e ON a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh
	ORDER BY d.ma_dvcs, d.ma_bt, a.tk_no, a.tk_co

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRMRequirement]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateRecruitingFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateRecruitingTo SMALLDATETIME,	
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@Status CHAR(1),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, CAST(NULL AS SMALLDATETIME) AS ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_bp, b.ma_vtr, b.so_luong, b.ky_nang_yc, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, a.status
		INTO #report FROM hrrmyc a, hrrmycct b

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'c', 'c', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'c.') + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'c.')
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DateRecruitingFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.ngay_tu >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateRecruitingFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DateRecruitingTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and (b.ngay_tu <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateRecruitingTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @Status <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.status = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Status), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	SELECT @Join = ' left join hrrmycct b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp c on a.ma_bp = c.ma_bp'

	-- Query
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_bp, b.ma_vtr, b.so_luong, b.ky_nang_yc, b.ngay_tu, b.ngay_den, a.status'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrrmyc a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where a.status = ''2'' and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	----Total
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_bp, '', 0, '', NULL, NULL, ''
			FROM #report GROUP BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, ma_bp

	-- Empty
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', NULL, '', '', '', 0, '', NULL, NULL, ''

	-- Result
	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_luong, a.ky_nang_yc, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE b.ten_bp2 END AS ten_bp
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_vtr ELSE c.ten_vtr2 END AS ten_vtr
			, a.status, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN d.statusname ELSE d.statusname2 END AS statusname
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr
			LEFT JOIN dmttct d WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.status = d.status AND d.ma_ct = 'H10'
		ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, b.bp_ref, c.stt, a.ma_vtr
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckVoucherEditLogDetailViewForm]
	@changeTimes INT,
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@refresh INT = 0,
	@pageIndex INT = 0,
	@pageCount INT = 0,
	@lastPage INT = 0,
	@lastCount INT = 0,
	@firstItem VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@lastItem VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@fieldExternal VARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@tableFilter VARCHAR(128) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @voucherCode = REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', ''), @voucherID = REPLACE(@voucherID, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @r INT, @i INT, @k TINYINT, @prime TINYINT, @$ref BIT, @$c VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @t$Prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @t$Prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32), @l$Ref$Table NVARCHAR(4000), @$primeFilter NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @f$ VARCHAR(32), @f$Amount VARCHAR(128), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo0 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo1 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo2 NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @NoDefine = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @LogInfo0 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo0'
	SELECT @LogInfo1 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo1'
	SELECT @LogInfo2 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo2'
	SELECT @$ref = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmreflog WHERE xcode = @voucherCode) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	SELECT @changeTimes = @changeTimes + 1, @$primeFilter = ''
	SELECT @t$Prime$Root = REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END
		, @t$Prime$Root$Log = CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(xtable), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(xtable, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(xtable)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + '$log' END END
		, @l$Ref$Table = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, '''', ''), ' ', '') FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT @f$Amount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
	SELECT @$c = RTRIM(c$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(c$), 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@$c) AND name = 'ngay_ct') AND CHARINDEX('%partition', @t$Prime$Root) > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @p = convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @$c + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p varchar(6) output, @voucherID varchar(32)', @p OUTPUT, @voucherID
	END ELSE SELECT @p = ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xtable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeTable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeLog, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS prime, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, *, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS cType INTO #field FROM #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS user_action, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS old_value, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS new_value, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx INTO #r0
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS gr_name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #r2 FROM #r0

	--
	SELECT @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID) select @r = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @r int output', @voucherID, @r OUTPUT
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #r0 (gr_id, field, field_name, user_action, line_nbr, old_value, new_value, stt_sx) SELECT '', '', '', '', 0, '', '', 0
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx FROM #r0
		RETURN
	END ELSE SELECT @r = NULL

	SELECT @q = 'select @r = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID and (idLog = @changeTimes or idLog = @changeTimes - 1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @r tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @voucherID, @r OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #r0 (gr_id, user_action) SELECT '', ''
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, * FROM #r0
		RETURN
	END

	-- Table/Field
	SELECT * INTO #refTable FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@l$Ref$Table, ',')
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT xtable, @t$Prime$Root, @t$Prime$Root$Log, 1 FROM dmct4 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
		SELECT data, REPLACE(data, '''', '') + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN '%partition' ELSE '' END
			, CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(data), 1) = '$' THEN REPLACE(data, '''', '') + 'log' ELSE CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(data, '''', ''), 0, CHARINDEX('$', RTRIM(data)) + 1) + 'log' ELSE REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log' END END, 1
		FROM #refTable ORDER BY id

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #field (field, field_name, gr_id, xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
select a.field, a.field_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.gr_id, a.xtable, b.primeTable, b.primeLog, b.prime
from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckfields a left join #table b on a.xtable = b.xtable where a.ma_ct = @voucherCode and a.xtype = ''1'' order by b.stt, a.stt_sx, a.field'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32)', @voucherCode

	UPDATE #field SET cType = CASE WHEN c.name IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN 1 WHEN c.name IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.field = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(a.primeLog) JOIN systypes c on b.xtype = c.xtype and b.xusertype = c.xusertype AND c.name <> 'sysname'
	UPDATE #field SET prime = 0 FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON OBJECT_ID(a.primeLog) = b.id AND b.name = 'stt_rec0'

	-- Data/Log
	SELECT @q = 'select @i = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@t$Prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @voucherID and idLog = @changeTimes'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherID varchar(32), @i tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @voucherID, @i OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #r0 (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx) select @f$, N''%field_name'', %line, %action, %old_value, %new_value, N''%gr_id'', %stt_sx from %talbe a left join %refTalbe b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec %joinKeyDetail %joinKeyLog where a.stt_rec = @voucherID %whereKey'

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @f$ = field, @t$Prime$Root = primeTable, @t$Prime$Root$Log = primeLog, @prime = prime FROM #field ORDER BY stt
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p)) AND name = @f$) GOTO GetValueNextField
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
			, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
			, '%line', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'a.line_nbr' END)
			, '%action', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '@LogInfo1' ELSE 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end' END)
			, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
			, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
			, '%gr_id', gr_id)
			, '%stt_sx', stt)
			, '%talbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) ELSE @t$Prime$Root$Log END)
			, '%refTalbe', @t$Prime$Root$Log)
			, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' END)
			, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN 'and b.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog = b.idLog + 1' END)
			, '%whereKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes' END)
		FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root$Log, '')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@f$ varchar(32), @voucherID varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
			, @f$, @voucherID, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2

		IF @prime = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
				, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
				, '%line', 'isnull(b.line_nbr, a.line_nbr)')
				, '%action', 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo2 else @LogInfo1 end')
				, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
				, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' END)
				, '%gr_id', gr_id)
				, '%stt_sx', stt)
				, '%talbe', @t$Prime$Root$Log)
				, '%refTalbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN REPLACE(@t$Prime$Root, '%partition', @p) ELSE @t$Prime$Root$Log END)
				, '%joinKeyDetail', 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0')
				, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL THEN 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog + 1 = b.idLog' END)
				, '%whereKey', 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1')
			FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND primeTable = @t$Prime$Root AND primeLog = @t$Prime$Root$Log
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@f$ varchar(32), @voucherID varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
				, @f$, @voucherID, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2

		END


GetValueNextField:
		--
		DELETE #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@t$Prime$Root$Log, '')
	END
	DELETE #r0 WHERE ISNULL(old_value, '') = ISNULL(new_value, '')

	-- Not exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r0) INSERT INTO #r0 (gr_id, user_action, line_nbr, old_value, new_value, stt_sx) SELECT 'NODEFINE', @LogInfo1, 0, '', '', 0

	-- View
	SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #r1 FROM #r0
	SELECT @q = '
insert #r2 (gr_name, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else b.gr_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' end, case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else a.field_name end, a.line_nbr, a.user_action, a.old_value, a.new_value, a.gr_id, b.stt_sx
		from #r1 a left join ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckgroupfields b on a.gr_id = b.gr_id order by b.stt_sx, a.gr_id, a.line_nbr, a.stt_sx, a.user_action, a.field
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@NoDefine nvarchar(128)', @NoDefine
	UPDATE #r2 SET stt_rec = REPLACE(STR(stt, 32), ' ', '0')

	IF ISNULL(@tableFilter, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @$primeFilter = isnull(@$primeFilter, '''') + case when isnull(@$primeFilter, '''') = '''' then '''' else '' and '' end + replace(conditional, char(255), '''') from ' + @tableFilter + ' order by id'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@$primeFilter nvarchar(4000) output', @$primeFilter OUTPUT
	END
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Table$Finding '#r2', @refresh, @pageIndex, @pageCount, @lastPage, @lastCount, @firstItem, @lastItem, '', 'stt_rec', @fieldExternal, '', 'stt_rec', @admin, @userID, default, default, default, @$primeFilter

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vcttt30
AS
SELECT     stt_rec_tt AS stt_rec
FROM         dbo.cttt30

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AutoCreateInputInvoiceSchedule]
	@ID VARCHAR(16),
	@LimitImportNumber INT,
	@ImportFromTax BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	CREATE TABLE #idNumber (stt_rec CHAR(13))
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #queue FROM mailreceive
    SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #masterVoucher FROM m15$000000
    SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #detailVoucher FROM d15$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #taxVoucher FROM e15$000000

	DECLARE @importQuery NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(MAX), @check INT
	SELECT @importQuery = 'insert into #queue select top ' + CAST(@LimitImportNumber AS VARCHAR) + ' * from mailreceive order by datetime0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @importQuery

	SELECT keys, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) as tax_code, pdf_path AS path1, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS path2 INTO #output FROM #queue
	SELECT ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt INTO #dmvt FROM dmvt
	DELETE mailreceive WHERE keys IN (SELECT keys FROM #queue)

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #queue) BEGIN
		DECLARE @xml XML, @idNumber VARCHAR(32), @unit_code VARCHAR(32), @pdf_path NVARCHAR(512), @TaxCommonName NVARCHAR(512), @TaxSignTime SMALLDATETIME, @CommonName NVARCHAR(512),
			@SignTime SMALLDATETIME, @QRCodeImage VARBINARY(MAX), @userID INT, @xmlTable VARCHAR(32), @xmlGetID NVARCHAR(4000), @xmlUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @xmlDelete NVARCHAR(4000), @e_code VARCHAR(32)

        TRUNCATE TABLE #masterVoucher
		TRUNCATE TABLE #detailVoucher
		TRUNCATE TABLE #taxVoucher
		TRUNCATE TABLE #lockedDate
		TRUNCATE TABLE #idNumber

		SELECT TOP 1 @idNumber = keys, @unit_code = unit_code, @pdf_path = pdf_path, @TaxCommonName = cks_cqt, @TaxSignTime = ngay_ky_cqt, @CommonName = cks_cn, @SignTime = ngay_ky_cn,
			@userID = user_id, @QRCodeImage = qrcode, @xmlTable = basetable, @e_code = e_code FROM #queue

		SELECT @xmlGetID = 'select @xml = xml_invoice from @@xmltable where stt_rec = @idNumber',
			   @xmlUpdate = 'update @@xmltable set stt_rec = @stt_rec where stt_rec = @idNumber',
			   @xmlDelete = 'delete @@xmltable where stt_rec = @idNumber'
		SELECT @xmlGetID = REPLACE(@xmlGetID, '@@xmltable', @xmlTable),
			   @xmlUpdate = REPLACE(@xmlUpdate, '@@xmltable', @xmlTable),
			   @xmlDelete = REPLACE(@xmlDelete, '@@xmltable', @xmlTable)

		EXEC sp_executesql @xmlGetID, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @xml xml output', @idNumber, @xml OUTPUT

		-- CHECK VOUCHER UNIT
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID AND admin <> 1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysunitrights WHERE user_id = @userID AND ma_dvcs = @unit_code AND r_new = 1) BEGIN
		  EXEC sp_executesql @xmlDelete, N'@idNumber varchar(32)', @idNumber
		  GOTO END_WHILE;
		END

		-- CHECK XML
		IF @xml is NULL BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @xmlDelete, N'@idNumber varchar(32)', @idNumber
			GOTO END_WHILE;
		END

		DECLARE @stt_rec CHAR(13), @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @ky_hieu VARCHAR(32), @mau_so VARCHAR(32), @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_nt VARCHAR(3), @ty_gia NUMERIC(24, 12), @mst_cn VARCHAR(18),
			@ten_cn NVARCHAR(512), @mst_kh VARCHAR(18), @ten_kh NVARCHAR(512), @ma_cqt VARCHAR(128), @loai_hd VARCHAR(32), @ten_loai_hd NVARCHAR(128), @so_bk VARCHAR(64), @ngay_bk SMALLDATETIME, @keys VARCHAR(512),
			@loai_dc VARCHAR(1), @dia_chi_cn NVARCHAR(512), @dien_thoai_cn VARCHAR(32), @fax_cn VARCHAR(32), @email_cn VARCHAR(128), @tk_nh_cn VARCHAR(32),	@ten_nh_cn NVARCHAR(512), @dia_chi_kh NVARCHAR(512), @dien_thoai_kh VARCHAR(32),
			@ma_kh VARCHAR(64), @email_kh VARCHAR(128), @nguoi_mua NVARCHAR(128), @tk_nh_kh VARCHAR(32), @ten_nh_kh NVARCHAR(512), @t_tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_thue NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_ck NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_thanh_toan NUMERIC(28, 6),
			@hinh_thuc_tt NVARCHAR(256), @t_tt_in_words NVARCHAR(256), @qrcode NVARCHAR(4000), @thue_suat_m VARCHAR(32), @t_external NVARCHAR(256), @ten_phi NVARCHAR(4000), @t_phi NVARCHAR(4000), @tc_hd CHAR(1), @loai_hd_lq CHAR(1), @mau_so_hd_lq VARCHAR(32), @ky_hieu_hd_lq VARCHAR(32), @so_hd_lq VARCHAR(32), @ngay_hd_lq SMALLDATETIME,
			@maxLine INT, @mst_tcgp VARCHAR(32), @key_search NVARCHAR(256), @link_search NVARCHAR(256), @urls NVARCHAR(256)

		SELECT @tc_hd = '0', @loai_hd_lq  = '', @mau_so_hd_lq = '', @ky_hieu_hd_lq = '', @so_hd_lq = '', @ngay_hd_lq = NULL, @mst_tcgp = '', @keys = '', @urls = '', @q = ''

		-- GENERATE
		SELECT
			@ky_hieu = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./KHHDon)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@mau_so = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./KHMSHDon)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(ISNULL(T.C.value('(./SHDon)[1]', 'varchar(12)'), ''), 12),
			@ngay_ct = T.C.value('(./NLap)[1]', 'smalldatetime'),
			@ma_nt = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DVTTe)[1]', 'varchar(3)'), 'VND'),
			@ty_gia = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TGia)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TGia)[1]', 'numeric(24, 12)') ELSE 1 END,
			@so_bk = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./SBKe)[1]', 'varchar(64)'), ''),
			@ngay_bk = T.C.value('(./NBKe)[1]', 'smalldatetime'),
			@ten_loai_hd = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./THDon)[1]', 'nvarchar(128)'), ''),
			@hinh_thuc_tt = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./HTTToan)[1]', 'nvarchar(256)'), ''),
			@mst_tcgp = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MSTTCGP)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@loai_hd = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TTKhac/TTin[TTruong = ''InvoiceType'']/DLieu)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@loai_dc = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TTKhac/TTin[TTruong = ''AdjustmentType'']/DLieu)[1]', 'varchar(1)'), '')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/TTChung') T(C)

		-- SEARCHING
		SELECT @key_search = key_search, @link_search = link_search, @q = '' FROM kbtttc WHERE mst_tcgp = @mst_tcgp
		IF ISNULL(@key_search, '') <> '' SELECT @q = 'select @keys = isnull(@xml.value(N''(/HDon/DLHDon/' + @key_search + ''', ''nvarchar(256)''), '''');'
		IF ISNULL(@link_search, '') <> '' SELECT @q = @q + 'select @urls = isnull(@xml.value(N''(/HDon/DLHDon/' + @link_search + ''', ''nvarchar(256)''), '''')'
		IF ISNULL(@q, '') <> '' BEGIN
			BEGIN TRY
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@xml xml, @keys nvarchar(256) output, @urls nvarchar(256) output', @xml, @keys OUTPUT, @urls OUTPUT
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				SELECT @keys = '', @urls = ''
			END CATCH
		END

		-- REFERENCE
		SELECT
			@tc_hd = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TCHDon)[1]', 'char(1)'), '0'),
			@loai_hd_lq = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./LHDCLQuan)[1]', 'char(1)'), ''),
			@mau_so_hd_lq = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./KHMSHDCLQuan)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@ky_hieu_hd_lq = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./KHHDCLQuan)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@so_hd_lq = dbo.ff_PadL(ISNULL(T.C.value('(./SHDCLQuan)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''), 12),
			@ngay_hd_lq = T.C.value('(./NLHDCLQuan)[1]', 'smalldatetime')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/TTChung/TTHDLQuan') T(C)

		IF @tc_hd <> '0' SELECT @tc_hd = CAST((CAST(@tc_hd AS INT) + 1) AS CHAR(1))

		-- SELLER
		SELECT
			@mst_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MST)[1]', 'varchar(18)'), ''),
			@ten_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./Ten)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@dia_chi_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DChi)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@dien_thoai_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./SDThoai)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@email_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DCTDTu)[1]', 'varchar(128)'), ''),
			@fax_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./Fax)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@ten_nh_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TNHang)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@tk_nh_cn = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./STKNHang)[1]', 'varchar(24)'), '')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/NBan') T(C)

		-- BUYER
		SELECT
			@mst_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MST)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@ten_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./Ten)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@dia_chi_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DChi)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@dien_thoai_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./SDThoai)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			@ma_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MKHang)[1]', 'varchar(64)'), ''),
			@nguoi_mua = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./HVTNMHang)[1]', 'nvarchar(128)'), ''),
			@email_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DCTDTu)[1]', 'varchar(128)'), ''),
			@ten_nh_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TNHang)[1]', 'nvarchar(512)'), ''),
			@tk_nh_kh = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./STKNHang)[1]', 'varchar(24)'), '')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/NMua') T(C)

		-- PAYMENT
		SELECT
			@t_tien = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TgTCThue)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TgTCThue)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			@t_thue = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TgTThue)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TgTThue)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			@t_ck = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TTCKTMai)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TTCKTMai)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			@t_thanh_toan = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TgTTTBSo)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TgTTTBSo)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			@t_tt_in_words = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TgTTTBChu)[1]', 'nvarchar(256)'), '')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/TToan') T(C)

		SELECT @t_external = @xml.value('(/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/TToan/TTKhac/TTin[TTruong = ''TaxExternal'']/DLieu)[1]', 'nvarchar(256)')
		SELECT @thue_suat_m = CAST(data AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@t_external, '$') WHERE id = 1

		-- OTHER
		SELECT
			@qrcode = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DLQRCode)[1]', 'nvarchar(4000)'), ''),
			@ma_cqt = ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MCCQT)[1]', 'varchar(128)'), '')
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon') T(C)

		-- CHECK LOCK DATE
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @ngay_ct BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @xmlDelete, N'@idNumber varchar(32)', @idNumber
			GOTO END_WHILE;
		END

		INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher 'E05', @ngay_ct, @userID, @unit_code, 1
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @xmlDelete, N'@idNumber varchar(32)', @idNumber
			GOTO END_WHILE;
		END

		-- CHECKING

		SELECT @check = 1, @q = '
if exists(select 1 from m15$$partition where mst_cn = @mst_cn and so_ct = @so_ct and mau_so = @mau_so and ky_hieu = @ky_hieu and status <> ''*'') begin
	select @check = 0, @stt_rec = stt_rec from m15$$partition where mst_cn = @mst_cn and so_ct = @so_ct and mau_so = @mau_so and ky_hieu = @ky_hieu and status <> ''*''
	if isnull((select path1 from #output where keys = @idNumber), '''') <> '''' begin
		update m15$$partition set pdf_yn = ''1'' where mst_cn = @mst_cn and so_ct = @so_ct and mau_so = @mau_so and ky_hieu = @ky_hieu and status <> ''*''
	end
	return
end'
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q , '$partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @ngay_ct, 112))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@mst_cn varchar(18), @so_ct varchar(32), @mau_so varchar(32), @ky_hieu varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @check int output, @stt_rec char(13) output', @mst_cn, @so_ct, @mau_so, @ky_hieu, @idNumber, @check OUTPUT, @stt_rec OUTPUT;
		IF @check = 0 BEGIN
			EXEC sp_executesql @xmlDelete, N'@idNumber varchar(32)', @idNumber
			DECLARE @path VARCHAR(32)
			SELECT @path = CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), @ngay_ct, 112) + @stt_rec
			UPDATE #output SET tax_code = @mst_kh, path2 = @path WHERE keys = @idNumber AND ISNULL(path1, '') <> '' AND @path NOT IN (SELECT path2 FROM #output)
			SELECT @stt_rec = ''
			GOTO END_WHILE;
		END

		-- GENERATE KEY
		DECLARE @wsID VARCHAR(1)
		SELECT @wsID = rtrim(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
		INSERT INTO #idNumber EXEC FastBusiness$App$GetIdentityNumber @wsID, 'E05', 'c15$000000', @userID
		SELECT @stt_rec = stt_rec FROM #idNumber

		-- MASTER
		INSERT INTO #masterVoucher(stt_rec, ma_ct, ma_dvcs, so_ct, mau_so, ky_hieu, ngay_ct, ma_nt, ty_gia, dia_chi_cn, dia_chi_kh, dien_thoai_cn, dien_thoai_kh, email_cn, email_kh, fax_cn, hinh_thuc_tt, keys, loai_dc, loai_ct, loai_hd, ma_cqt, ma_kh, mst_cn, mst_kh, ngay_bk, nguoi_mua, qrcode, so_bk, t_ck, t_thanh_toan, t_thue, t_tien, thue_suat, t_tt_in_words, ten_cn, ten_kh, ten_loai_hd, ten_nh_cn, ten_nh_kh, tk_nh_cn, tk_nh_kh, cks_cqt, ngay_ky_cqt, cks_cn, ngay_ky_cn, ghi_chu, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ten_phi, t_phi, flag, qrcode_img, pdf_yn, tc_hd, loai_hd_lq, mau_so_hd_lq, ky_hieu_hd_lq, so_hd_lq, ngay_hd_lq, urls)
		VALUES(@stt_rec, 'E05', @unit_code, @so_ct, @mau_so, @ky_hieu, @ngay_ct, @ma_nt, @ty_gia, @dia_chi_cn, @dia_chi_kh, @dien_thoai_cn, @dien_thoai_kh, @email_cn, @email_kh, @fax_cn, @hinh_thuc_tt, @keys, @loai_dc, N'', @loai_hd, @ma_cqt, @ma_kh, @mst_cn, @mst_kh, @ngay_bk, @nguoi_mua, @qrcode, @so_bk, @t_ck, @t_thanh_toan, @t_thue, @t_tien, @thue_suat_m, @t_tt_in_words, @ten_cn, @ten_kh, @ten_loai_hd, @ten_nh_cn, @ten_nh_kh, @tk_nh_cn, @tk_nh_kh, @TaxCommonName, @TaxSignTime, @CommonName, @SignTime, N'', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID, @ten_phi, @t_phi, 0, @QRCodeImage, 0, @tc_hd, @loai_hd_lq, @mau_so_hd_lq, @ky_hieu_hd_lq, @so_hd_lq, @ngay_hd_lq, @urls)

		UPDATE #masterVoucher SET s1 = N'', s2 = N'', s3 = N'', s4 = 0, s5 = 0, s6 = 0

		If LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@pdf_path, ''))) <> '' BEGIN
			UPDATE #masterVoucher SET pdf_yn = 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #detailVoucher(ma_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, tinh_chat, ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tl_ck, ck, ma_thue, tien, line_nbr, xu_ly, km_yn)
		SELECT
            'E05',
			@stt_rec,
			'',
			ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TChat)[1]', 'char(1)'), ''),
			ISNULL(T.C.value('(./MHHDVu)[1]', 'varchar(64)'), ''),
			ISNULL(T.C.value('(./THHDVu)[1]', 'nvarchar(1024)'), ''),
			ISNULL(T.C.value('(./DVTinh)[1]', 'nvarchar(64)'), ''),
			CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./SLuong)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./SLuong)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./DGia)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./DGia)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TLCKhau)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TLCKhau)[1]', 'numeric(5, 2)') ELSE 0 END,
			CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./STCKhau)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./STCKhau)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TSuat)[1]', 'varchar(32)'), ''),
			CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./ThTien)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./ThTien)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY @@TRANCOUNT),
			(SELECT LEFT(data, 1) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TTKhac/TTin[TTruong = ''ExternalValue'']/DLieu)[1]', 'varchar(1000)'), ''), '$') WHERE id = 2),
			(SELECT LEFT(data, 1) FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TTKhac/TTin[TTruong = ''ExternalValue'']/DLieu)[1]', 'varchar(1000)'), ''), '$') WHERE id = 3)
		FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/DSHHDVu/HHDVu') T(C)

		-- Charge Other
		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY @@TRANCOUNT) AS stt, ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TLPhi)[1]', 'nvarchar(1024)'), '') AS ten_phi, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TPhi)[1]', 'varchar(32)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TPhi)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END AS t_phi
			INTO #charge FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/TToan/DSLPhi/LPhi') T(C)
				WHERE ISNULL(T.C.value('(./TLPhi)[1]', 'nvarchar(1024)'), '') NOT IN (SELECT ten_vt FROM #detailVoucher WHERE tinh_chat = '4')
		SELECT @maxLine = MAX(line_nbr) FROM #detailVoucher
		INSERT INTO #detailVoucher(ma_ct, stt_rec, stt_rec0, tinh_chat, ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tl_ck, ck, ma_thue, tien, line_nbr, xu_ly, km_yn)
			SELECT 'E05', @stt_rec, '', '4', '', ten_phi, '', 0, 0, 0, 0, '', t_phi, @maxLine + stt, 'P', ''
				FROM #charge
		DROP TABLE #charge

		UPDATE #detailVoucher SET s1 = N'', s2 = N'', s3 = N'', s4 = 0, s5 = 0, s6 = 0
		UPDATE #detailVoucher SET thue_suat = dbo.ff_GetTaxCode2TaxRate(ma_thue)
		UPDATE #detailVoucher SET ma_vt2 = a.ma_vt FROM #dmvt a WHERE a.ten_vt = #detailVoucher.ten_vt
		UPDATE #detailVoucher SET stt_rec0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(line_nbr)

		-- TAX
		INSERT INTO #taxVoucher(stt_rec,stt_rec0,t_tien,thue_suat,t_thue,line_nbr)
			SELECT
				@stt_rec,
				'',
				CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./ThTien)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./ThTien)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
				T.C.value('(./TSuat)[1]', 'nvarchar(32)'),
				CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(T.C.value('(./TThue)[1]', 'varchar(50)')) = 1 THEN T.C.value('(./TThue)[1]', 'numeric(28, 6)') ELSE 0 END,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY @@TRANCOUNT)
			FROM @xml.nodes('/HDon/DLHDon/NDHDon/TToan/THTTLTSuat/LTSuat') T(C)
		UPDATE #taxVoucher SET stt_rec0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(line_nbr)

		DECLARE @$totalTax NUMERIC(28, 6)
		SELECT @$totalTax = SUM(t_thue) FROM #taxVoucher
		SELECT @$totalTax = ISNULL(@$totalTax, 0)
		IF @t_thue <> @$totalTax SELECT @e_code = @e_code + 'E05030'
		UPDATE #masterVoucher SET i_error = @e_code, status = CASE WHEN @e_code = '' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END, xtype = CASE WHEN @ImportFromTax = 1 THEN '3' ELSE '2' END
		UPDATE #masterVoucher SET ma_ct_gs = '', so_ct_gs = '', tt_gs = '1'

		-- INSERT & POST
		DECLARE @insertPost NVARCHAR(4000)

		SELECT @insertPost = '
update #masterVoucher set i_error = a.i_error + ''E05040'', status = ''1'' from #masterVoucher a with(nolock) join dmdnruiro b with(nolock) on rtrim(a.mst_cn) = rtrim(b.mst) and b.status = ''1''
update #masterVoucher set ma_ct_gs = isnull(b.ma_ct, '''') from #masterVoucher a with(nolock) join dmcthddv b with(nolock) on '','' + replace(ltrim(rtrim(a.email_kh)), '' '', '''') + '','' like ''%,'' + ltrim(rtrim(b.gia_tri)) + '',%'' and b.chi_tieu = ''2'' and b.status = ''1''
update #masterVoucher set ma_ct_gs = isnull(b.ma_ct, '''') from #masterVoucher a with(nolock) join dmcthddv b with(nolock) on rtrim(a.mst_cn) = rtrim(b.gia_tri) and b.chi_tieu = ''1'' and b.status = ''1''

insert into m15$$partition select * from #masterVoucher
insert into d15$$partition select * from #detailVoucher
insert into e15$$partition select * from #taxVoucher

exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInquiryTable ''E05'', ''i15$$partition'', ''m15$$partition'', ''d15$$partition'', ''stt_rec'', @stt_rec, ''ma_nt;#30$; :ma_vt;#20$;d'', default, default, default
exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateGrandTable ''E05'', ''c15$000000'', ''m15$$partition'', ''stt_rec'', @stt_rec, 0
--exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateGeneral ''E05'', ''m15$$partition'', ''d15$$partition'', ''i15$$partition'', ''m15$$partition'', @stt_rec'

		IF @ImportFromTax = 1 SELECT @insertPost = @insertPost + CHAR(13) + '
update t15$$partition set stt_rec_hd = stt_rec, hd_yn = 1, error_count = 0, error_log = '''' from t15$$partition a join #masterVoucher b on a.tax_code = b.mst_kh and a.mst = b.mst_cn and a.mau_so = b.mau_so and a.ky_hieu = b.ky_hieu and cast(a.so_hd as int) = cast(b.so_ct as int) and a.ngay_hd = b.ngay_ct where a.hd_yn = 0
update m15$$partition set tc_hd = b.tt_hd, ngay_ph_tdtt = case when b.tt_hd in (''4'', ''5'', ''6'') then getdate() else null end from m15$$partition a with(nolock) join t15$$partition b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec
'

		SELECT @insertPost = REPLACE(@insertPost, '$partition', CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @ngay_ct, 112))
		EXEC sp_executesql @insertPost, N'@stt_rec varchar(32)', @stt_rec
		EXEC sp_executesql @xmlUpdate, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @stt_rec varchar(32)', @idNumber, @stt_rec
		UPDATE #output SET tax_code = @mst_kh, path2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), @ngay_ct, 112) + @stt_rec WHERE keys = @idNumber

		-- SAVE h15$
		EXEC FastBusiness$InputInvoiceLog$Save @mst_kh, @mau_so, @ky_hieu, @so_ct, @ngay_ct, @userID

		END_WHILE:

		DELETE #queue WHERE keys = @idNumber
	END

	-- RESULT
	DELETE a FROM #output a JOIN #output b ON a.path1 = b.path1 AND a.path2 = '' AND b.path2 <> ''
	DELETE #output WHERE path1 = '' AND path2 = ''

	SELECT tax_code, path1, path2 FROM #output GROUP BY tax_code, path1, path2
	DROP TABLE #queue, #output, #masterVoucher, #detailVoucher

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Log]
	@idnumber CHAR(13),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@partition VARCHAR(32),
	@type VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q1 NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @rootTable VARCHAR(64), @logTable VARCHAR(64), @rootRefTable VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @logDay INT, @p VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @rootTable = '', @logTable = '', @refTable = '', @logDay = 60, @p = '', @q1 = '', @q2 = '', @q = ''
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')
	
	-- struct
	SELECT TOP 1 @rootRefTable = xtable0 + CASE WHEN RIGHT(xtable0, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @refTable = xtable, @logDay = logday FROM dmct5 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND del_ref = 1
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS id, xtable0, xtable INTO #logList FROM dmct5 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND del_ref = 0
	
	SELECT @p = MIN(id) FROM #logList
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @rootTable = xtable0 + CASE WHEN RIGHT(xtable0, 1) = '$' THEN @partition ELSE '' END, @logTable = xtable FROM #logList WHERE id = @p
		SET @q1 = @q1 + 'delete ' + @logTable + ' from ' + @refTable + ' a join ' + @logTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.id = b.id where a.datetime2 < dateadd(day, -' + RTRIM(@logDay) + ', getdate())'
		
		SET @q2 = @q2 + '
			select @idLog as id, * into #LogTemp' + RTRIM(@p) + ' from ' + @rootTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
			select @q = @q + char(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(''' + @logTable + ''', ''#LogTemp' + RTRIM(@p) + ''', ''' + @logTable + ''', ''' + @logTable + ''', ''1=1'', null)
		'
		SELECT @p = MIN(id) FROM #logList WHERE id > @p
	END
	
	SELECT @q = 'declare @idLog int, @q nvarchar(4000)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @idlog = 0, @q = '''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @q1
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @refTable + ' where datetime2 < dateadd(day, -' + RTRIM(@logDay) + ', getdate())'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @idLog = isnull(max(id), 0) + 1 from ' + @refTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idnumber + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + @q2
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @idLog as id, * into #refLogTemp from ' + @rootRefTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @q = @q + char(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(''' + @refTable + ''', ''#refLogTemp'', ''' + @refTable + ''', ''' + @refTable + ''', ''1=1'', null)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec sp_executesql @q'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_CreateNotifyBIILTran]
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@notifyTable VARCHAR(64)
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @header NVARCHAR(4000), @detail NVARCHAR(4000), @footer NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @popupContent NVARCHAR(4000), @popupContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @hContent NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent NVARCHAR(4000), @hContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @dContent2 NVARCHAR(4000), @fContent2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @quantityFormat VARCHAR(32), @dCount INT, @priority VARCHAR(32), @e$ NVARCHAR(4000), @t0 NVARCHAR(4000), @t1 NVARCHAR(4000), @t2 NVARCHAR(4000), @t3 NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Process Info
	DECLARE @processType VARCHAR(32), @columnBottom VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @processType = '', @columnBottom = '3', @t0 = N'Phiếu yêu cầu kiểm định chờ duyệt', @t1 = N'Inspection Lot waiting for approval', @t2 = N'Tình trạng duyệt phiếu yêu cầu kiểm định', @t3 = N'Inspection Lot workflow process'
	SELECT TOP 1 @processType = xtype FROM bia11$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	IF @processType = '3' SELECT @columnBottom = '4'

	-- Get data
	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @masterTable = REPLACE(@masterTable, '''', ''), @detailTable = REPLACE(@detailTable, '''', ''), @notifyTable = REPLACE(@notifyTable, '''', '')
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM bim11$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.* INTO #detail FROM bid11$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber +  ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail select * from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @quantityFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_sl'

	SELECT @dCount = COUNT(*) FROM #detail
	SELECT @priority = 1
	SELECT @e$ = LTRIM(so_ct) + CHAR(253) + CONVERT(CHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) FROM #master


	-- Header
	CREATE TABLE #headInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #headInfo SELECT 'label', 120, '', '', '', '', 'label', 'label2', 0
		UNION ALL SELECT 'val', null, '', '', '', '', 'val', 'val', 1

	CREATE TABLE #headContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(128), label2 NVARCHAR(128), val NVARCHAR(1024))
	INSERT INTO #headContent SELECT '', '', N'Số phiếu', N'Number', LTRIM(so_ct) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Ngày', N'Date', CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), ngay_ct, 103) FROM #master
		UNION ALL SELECT '', '', N'Diễn giải', N'Memo', dien_giai FROM #master


	-- Detail
	CREATE TABLE #bodyInfo(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), col_code VARCHAR(64), width INT, col_style VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label_v NVARCHAR(64), label_e NVARCHAR(64), column_v NVARCHAR(64), column_e NVARCHAR(64), encode_html bit)
	INSERT INTO #bodyInfo SELECT 'ma_vt', 100, '', '', N'Mã hàng', N'Item', 'ma_vt', 'ma_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'ten_vt', 300, '', '', N'Tên mặt hàng', N'Item Description', 'ten_vt', 'ten_vt2', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'dvt', 50, '', '', N'Đvt', N'UOM', 'dvt', 'dvt', 1
		UNION ALL SELECT 'so_luong', 100, 'text-align:right', '', N'Số lượng', N'Quantity', 'so_luong', 'so_luong', 0

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS colspan, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS text_style, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt, CAST(RTRIM(a.ma_vt) AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ma_vt2, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, RTRIM(a.dvt) AS dvt, dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.so_luong, @quantityFormat) AS so_luong
		INTO #bodyContent FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #bodyContent(colspan, text_style, ma_vt, ma_vt2, so_luong)
		SELECT '[ma_vt]' + @columnBottom, 'text-align:right', N'Tổng số lượng', N'Total Quantity', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(t_so_luong, @quantityFormat)
		FROM #master


	-- Footer
	CREATE TABLE #footContent(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), colspan VARCHAR(128), text_style VARCHAR(128), label NVARCHAR(4000), label2 NVARCHAR(4000), val NVARCHAR(4000))

	CREATE TABLE #msgv (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	CREATE TABLE #msge (smsg VARCHAR(10), msg0 NVARCHAR(4000), msg1 NVARCHAR(4000), msg2 NVARCHAR(4000), msg3 NVARCHAR(4000), msg4 NVARCHAR(4000), msg5 NVARCHAR(4000), msg6 NVARCHAR(4000), msg7 NVARCHAR(4000), msg8 NVARCHAR(4000), msg9 NVARCHAR(4000))
	INSERT INTO #msgv EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01260', 'V', 1, 1
	INSERT INTO #msge EXEC FastBusiness$APV$PU$GetApprovalDetail @idNumber, '01260', 'E', 1, 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #msgv WHERE smsg <> 'none') BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 0
		WHILE @i < 10 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #footContent select ''[label]2'', ''font-style:italic'', v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', e.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ', '''' from #msgv v, #msge e where v.msg' + LTRIM(@i) + ' <> '''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	-- Popup
	SELECT @popupContent = N'Ngày: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', số: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', diễn giải: ' + RTRIM(a.dien_giai),
			@popupContent2 = N'Date: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), a.ngay_ct, 103) + N', Number: ' + LTRIM(a.so_ct) + N', Memo: ' + RTRIM(a.dien_giai)
		FROM #master a

	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #notify$Content(content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT)
	INSERT INTO #notify$Content EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$CreateContent '#headInfo','#headContent', '', '<br/>', '#bodyInfo', '#bodyContent', '', '#headInfo', '#footContent', ''

	SELECT @q = '
insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2) select @t0, @t1, content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 0, @t0, @t1, N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''' from #notify$Content
insert into ' + @notifyTable + '(title, title2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, type, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2) select @t2, @t3, content, content2, @idNumber, @priority, @e$, 12, @t2, @t3, N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent, '''', '''''') + ''', N''' + REPLACE(@popupContent2, '''', '''''') + ''' from #notify$Content
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @priority varchar(32), @e$ nvarchar(4000), @t0 nvarchar(4000), @t1 nvarchar(4000), @t2 nvarchar(4000), @t3 nvarchar(4000)', @idNumber, @priority, @e$, @t0, @t1, @t2, @t3

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryByLot]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 : Bao cao theo vat tu - lo , 2: Bao cao theo lo - vat tu
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : Nhom theo kho, vi tri , 2: Chi tiet theo kho, vi tri, 0: Khong xu lý
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Kho, vị trí, vật tư, lô hoặc Kho, vị trí, lô, vật tư
	IF @ReportType = '1' BEGIN
		IF @ReportBy = '1' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryBySiteLocationItemLot @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer
				, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3
				, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @ReportType, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
		IF @ReportBy = '2' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryBySiteLocationLotItem @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer
				, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3
				, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @ReportType, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Vật tư, lô, kho, vị trí hoặc Lô, vật tư, kho, vị trí
	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		IF @ReportBy = '1' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryByItemLotSiteLocation @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer
				, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3
				, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @ReportType, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
		IF @ReportBy = '2' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryByLotItemSiteLocation @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer
				, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3
				, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @ReportType, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Báo cáo chuẩn
	IF @ReportType = '0' BEGIN
		IF @ReportBy = '1' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryByItemLot @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
		IF @ReportBy = '2' BEGIN
			EXEC rs_rptStockSummaryByLotItem @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Site, @Lot, @Unit, @CalculateTransfer, @Item, @ItemType, @ItemGroup1, @ItemGroup2, @ItemGroup3, @Group, @Order, @ShowItem, @ReportBy, @DataType, @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Controller, @SysDB, @DynamicKeyTable
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$GetPurOrgFilter]
	@Pur VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@Key VARCHAR(32),
	@Field VARCHAR(32),
	@Column VARCHAR(32),
	@Reference VARCHAR(32),
	@Return VARCHAR(1024) OUTPUT,
	@Force INT = 0,
	@External VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') RETURN

	SELECT @Return = ''
	IF @Pur = '' BEGIN
		-- Admin
		IF @Admin = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 1)'
			RETURN
		END
		-- Full access rights
		IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bidmbp0)= (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bisyspurorgrights a JOIN bidmbp0 b ON a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp WHERE a.user_id = @UserID AND a.r_access = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 1)'
			RETURN
		END
		-- No access rights
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bisyspurorgrights WHERE user_id = @UserID) BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF @Force <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = CASE WHEN @Pur = '' THEN @Field + ' in (select ma_bp0 from bisyspurorgrights where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and r_access = 1)' ELSE '(' + @Field + ' = ''' + REPLACE(@Pur, '''', '') + ''')' END
		IF @Force = 2 SELECT @Return = '(' + @Field + ' = '''' or (' + @Return + '))'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Declare
	CREATE TABLE #t(n INT, c VARCHAR(128), g INT)
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(256), @c2 VARCHAR(256), @m INT, @n INT, @max INT, @i INT, @l INT, @q1 VARCHAR(1), @q2 VARCHAR(1), @u INT, @v INT, @g INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Set
	SELECT @n = 36, @max = 3
	IF @Pur <> '' BEGIN
		EXECUTE sp_executesql N'select @1 = id from bidmbp0 where ma_bp = @2', N'@1 int output, @2 varchar(32)', @i OUTPUT, @Pur
		IF @i IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
			RETURN
		END
		INSERT INTO #t SELECT @i, dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(@i), @i / @n
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #t select b.id, dbo.ff_Dec2Seq(b.id), b.id / @1 from bisyspurorgrights a join bidmbp0 b on a.ma_bp0 = b.ma_bp where a.user_id = @2 and a.r_access = 1 order by b.id'
