		EXECUTE sp_executesql @q, N'@1 int, @2 int', @n, @UserID
		IF @Key <> '' AND (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g FROM #t) a) > @max BEGIN
			IF @External = '' SELECT @External = @Key
			SELECT @Return = '(' + @Column + ' = '''' or exists(select 1 from ' + @Reference + ' u where u.' + @Key + ' = ' + @Table + '.' + @External + ' and exists(select 1 from bisyspurorgrights r where r.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and r.r_access = 1 and r.' + @Field + ' = u.' + @Field + ')))'
			RETURN
		END
	END
	--
	SELECT @n = -1, @u = -1, @v = 0

	SELECT @i = MIN(n) FROM #t
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @g = g FROM #t WHERE n = @i
		IF @i - 1 = @n AND @g = @u SELECT @v = @v + 1
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF @v > 2 BEGIN
				DELETE #t WHERE n BETWEEN @m + 1 AND @n - 2
				UPDATE #t SET c = LEFT(c, LEN(c) - 1) + '-' WHERE n = @n - 1
			END
			SELECT @m = @i, @v = 0
		END
		--
		SELECT @n = @i, @u = @g
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(n) FROM #t WHERE n > @i
	END
	IF @v > 2 BEGIN
		DELETE #t WHERE n BETWEEN @m + 1 AND @n - 2
		UPDATE #t SET c = LEFT(c, LEN(c) - 1) + '-' WHERE n = @n - 1
	END
	--
	SELECT @i = MIN(g) FROM #t
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @c1 = MIN(c), @c2 = MAX(c) FROM #t WHERE g = @i
		SELECT @q1 = CASE WHEN @c1 = @c2 THEN '' ELSE '[' END, @q2 = CASE WHEN @c1 = @c2 THEN '' ELSE ']' END,
			@l = LEN(@c1), @c1 = CASE WHEN @l = 1 THEN '' ELSE LEFT(@c1, @l - 1) END + @q1
		SELECT @c1 = @c1 + RIGHT(c, 1) FROM #t WHERE g = @i ORDER BY n
		SELECT @c1 = @Column + ' like ''%#' + @c1 + @q2 + '#%'''
		--
		SELECT @Return = @Return + CASE WHEN @Return = '' THEN '' ELSE ' or ' END + '(' + @c1 + ')'
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(g) FROM #t WHERE g > @i
	END
	SELECT @Return = CASE WHEN @Return = '' THEN '(1 = 0)' ELSE '((' + @Column + ' = '''') or (' + @Return + '))' END

	IF @Key = '' AND LEN(@Return) = 1024 SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesArisingComparisonByUnit] --fs20_AccRateDept2PeriodUnit
	@DateFrom1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo1 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo2 SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023) ,
	@AccountNoMinus VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Report CHAR(48),
	@Group VARCHAR(128),
	@GroupFee1 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee2 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @strName CHAR(8), @Groups VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @minPivot AS NVARCHAR(511), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'

	SELECT @Report = CASE @Report
		WHEN '0' THEN 'tk'
		WHEN '1' THEN 'ma_phi'
		WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_dvcs'
	END

	SELECT @Group = CASE @Group
		WHEN '0' THEN 'tk'
		WHEN '1' THEN 'ma_phi'
		WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '2, 1' THEN 'ma_dvcs, ma_phi'
		WHEN '2, 0' THEN 'ma_dvcs, tk'
		WHEN '1, 2' THEN 'ma_phi, ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '1, 0' THEN 'ma_phi, tk'
		WHEN '0, 2' THEN 'tk, ma_dvcs'
		WHEN '0, 1' THEN 'tk, ma_phi'
		ELSE ''
	END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_dvcs, ma_phi, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, ps_no AS ps2, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt2 INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_dvcs' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_dvcs <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @GroupFee1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @AccountNoMinus <> ''
		SET @Key2 = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'notinlist', @AccountNoMinus)
	ELSE
		SET @Key2 = '(1 = 0)'
	--
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	IF @GroupFee1 + @GroupFee2 + @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmphi b on a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'

	SET @s = 'insert into #tmp select a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi, @ReportField'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @s = @s + ' where %[@Key]%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_phi'

	-- Ky 1
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom1, @DateTo1, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 1 (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom1, @DateTo1, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 2
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Ky 2 (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom2, @DateTo2, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, tk, ma_dvcs, ma_phi
			, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(ps2) AS ps2, SUM(ps_nt2) AS ps_nt2
			, SUM(ps2) - SUM(ps) AS ps_cl, SUM(ps_nt2) - SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_cl_nt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS ty_le_cl
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_dvcs, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_dvcs2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xKey, CAST('' AS CHAR(64)) AS xDetail
		INTO #report1
		FROM #tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_dvcs, ma_phi

	IF @Report = 'tk' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_tk = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END, ten_tk2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	IF @Report = 'ma_dvcs' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_dvcs = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_dvcs ELSE '' END, ten_dvcs2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_dvcs2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_phi = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_phi ELSE '' END, ten_phi2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_phi2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmphi b ON a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi
	SET @q = 'update #report1 set xDetail = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report1 WHERE xDetail = '' OR xDetail IS NULL
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps + ps_nt + ps2 + ps_nt2 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #report FROM #report1

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select distinct 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, max(tk), max(ma_dvcs), max(ma_phi)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt), sum(ps2), sum(ps_nt2), sum(ps_cl), sum(ps_cl_nt), max(ty_le_cl)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', max(ten_tk), max(ten_tk2), max(ten_dvcs), max(ten_dvcs2), max(ten_phi), max(ten_phi2), max(xkey), max(xdetail)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #report1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by ' + @Group + '@Comma xDetail'

	IF @Group <> '' SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Comma', ',') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@Comma', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_dvcs, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_dvcs, ten_dvcs2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DELETE #report WHERE ps = 0 AND ps2  = 0 AND systotal = 1
	IF @Group <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup3(@Group , REPLACE(@Report, 'ma_', ''),  'ps, ps2, ps_nt, ps_nt2, ps_cl, ps_cl_nt,ty_le_cl', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

	UPDATE #report SET tk = ISNULL(tk, ''), ma_phi = ISNULL(ma_phi, ''), ma_dvcs = ISNULL(ma_dvcs, ''), xDetail = ISNULL(xDetail, '')

	SET @Groups = REPLACE(@Group,',', ' + ')
	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Groups + ' + xDetail'
	ELSE
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT DISTINCT  MAX(sysorder) AS sysorder, MAX(sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(systotal) AS systotal, 0 AS stt, xKey , MAX(xDetail) AS xDetail, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs
			, MAX(ma_phi) AS ma_phi, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(ps2) AS ps2,SUM(ps_nt2) AS ps_nt2, SUM(ps_cl) AS ps_cl, SUM(ps_cl_nt) AS ps_cl_nt, MAX(ty_le_cl) AS ty_le_cl, MAX(ty_le_cl) AS ty_le_cl_nt
			, MAX(ten_tk) AS ten_tk, MAX(ten_tk2) AS ten_tk2, MAX(ten_phi) AS ten_phi, MAX(ten_phi2) AS ten_phi2, MAX(ten_dvcs) AS ten_dvcs, MAX(ten_dvcs2) AS ten_dvcs2
			 INTO #report3
			 FROM #report
			 GROUP BY xKey, sysorder
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report3', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_dvcs, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_dvcs, ten_dvcs2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33),NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511),  NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report3 SET ty_le_cl = CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ps, 0) = 0 OR ps2 = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (ps_cl * 100 / ps) END, ty_le_cl_nt = CASE WHEN (ISNULL(ps_nt, 0) = 0 OR ps_nt2 = 0) THEN 0 ELSE (ps_cl_nt * 100 / ps_nt) END

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @o = 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN @Group = '' THEN ', ' ELSE ', ' + @Group + ', ' END + 'xkey'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	UPDATE #report3 SET stt = NULL WHERE stt = 0
	IF UPPER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 1, 3)) = 'MA_'
		SET @strName = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 'ma_', 'ten_')))
	ELSE
		SET @strName =LTRIM(RTRIM('ten_' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report))))

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + ' = N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ', ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + '2 =  ' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) +  ' where systotal = 0 and (' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName )) + ' is null or ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName ))  + ' = N' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'alter table #report3 alter column ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' nvarchar(511) null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' alter table #report3 alter column ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 nvarchar(511) null'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 where sysorder > 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report3) INSERT INTO #report3 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select  *, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '  as ten_key,  ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 as ten_key2 from #report3 order by xKey, sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFATransferExport] --fs20_FATransfer_Detail
	@Month INT,
	@Year INT,
	@FACode VARCHAR(4000),
	@Language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @isSysDep BIT
	
	IF @FACode = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @FACode = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @FACode <> '' THEN 'a.so_the_ts in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@FACode, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.so_the_ts) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = 'fa_ma_bp' AND xtableref = 'dmbp') SET @isSysDep = 1 ELSE SET @isSysDep = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, so_the_ts, so_hieu_ts
			, ten_ts2 AS ten_ts, ten_ts2 AS ten_ts2
			, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp2
		INTO #report
		FROM dmts a, dmbpts b RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) c ON 1 = 0
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, so_the_ts, so_hieu_ts,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ',' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'ten_ts2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ',' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE '''''' END + ',' +  CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dmts a  left join ' + CASE WHEN @isSysDep = 0 THEN 'dmbpts' ELSE 'dmbp' END + ' b on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY so_the_ts

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter]
	@SiteField VARCHAR(64),
	@Site VARCHAR(33),
	@UnitKey VARCHAR(4000),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Return NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
AS  
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @n INT, @RangeNumber INT
	SELECT @Return = NULL

	IF @Admin = 1 RETURN

	-- No limit rights
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @UserID) RETURN

	-- Full access rights
	IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dmkho a JOIN sysunitrights b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs JOIN syssiterights c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho WHERE b.user_id = @UserID AND b.r_access = 1 AND c.user_id = @UserID)
		= (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dmkho a JOIN sysunitrights b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs WHERE b.user_id = @UserID AND b.r_access = 1) RETURN

	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	CREATE TABLE #s(s NVARCHAR(4000))
	SET @q = 'declare @s nvarchar(4000)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'set @s = null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select @s = isnull(@s, '''') + case when @s is null then '''' else '','' end + rtrim(ma_kho) from syssiterights'
	SET @q = @q + ' where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and ma_kho in (select ma_kho from dmkho a' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #s select @s'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @SiteKey = s FROM #s

	-- Key is invalid
	IF @SiteKey IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(1 = 0)'
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @n = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordCount(@SiteKey, ',')

	-- Only one site
	IF @SiteKey = @Site RETURN

	IF @n = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @SiteField + ' = ''' + @SiteKey + ''')'
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @RangeNumber = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_site_number'
	
	IF @n <= @RangeNumber BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @SiteField + ' in (''' + REPLACE(@SiteKey, ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @Return = '(' + @SiteField + ' in (select ma_kho from syssiterights where user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + '))'
		RETURN
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmdtqt]
AS
	SELECT 1 AS type, ma_dtqt, ten_dtqt, ten_dtqt2, nh_dtqt1, nh_dtqt2, nh_dtqt3, status FROM dmdtqt1
		UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS type, ma_dtqt, ten_dtqt, ten_dtqt2, nh_dtqt1, nh_dtqt2, nh_dtqt3, status FROM dmdtqt2
		UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS type, ma_dtqt, ten_dtqt, ten_dtqt2, nh_dtqt1, nh_dtqt2, nh_dtqt3, status FROM dmdtqt3

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMultiPeriodSalesAnalysisByTwoCriteria]--[fs20_SOReports]	
	@dateStart SMALLDATETIME,	
	@Time AS CHAR(1),	
	@Count AS TINYINT,	
	@ReportBy VARCHAR(32),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(32),
	@RevenueAccount AS VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Doanh thu, 2 - Chiết khấu
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 	
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Mẫu chuẩn, 20 - Mẫu ngoại tệ
	@DataType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Thực tế, 2 - Hóa đơn
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @dateEnd  AS SMALLDATETIME, @i AS INT
	DECLARE @sPeriod NVARCHAR(1024), @sNotDefine NVARCHAR(1024), @sTotal NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @sNotDefine = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @sPeriod = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'PERIOD'
	SELECT @sTotal = RTRIM(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END) FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ngay_ct, ma_vt AS reportby, ma_vt AS groupby, tien2 AS tien, tien_nt2 AS tien_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysorder, 0 AS systotal, 0 AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_ky, reportby, groupby, tien, tien_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_key INTO #report FROM #tmp
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield_name2 VARCHAR(64), xkey VARCHAR(1024))

	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', '', '', '', '', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'a.ma_vt', 'dmvt', 'ma_vt', 'ten_vt', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'b.nh_vt1', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'b.nh_vt2', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'b.nh_vt3', 'dmnhvt', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'b.nh_vt9', 'dmnhvt2', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '6', 'a.ma_kh', 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '7', 'c.nh_kh1', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 1'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '8', 'c.nh_kh2', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 2'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '9', 'c.nh_kh3', 'dmnhkh', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', 'loai_nh = 3'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '10', 'c.nh_kh9', 'dmnhkh2', 'ma_nh', 'ten_nh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '11', 'a.ma_nvbh', 'dmnvbh', 'ma_nvbh', 'ten_nvbh', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '12', 'a.ma_dvcs', 'dmdvcs', 'ma_dvcs', 'ten_dvcs', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '13', 'a.ma_kho', 'dmkho', 'ma_kho', 'ten_kho', ''
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '14', 'a.ma_bp', 'dmbp', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp', ''

	DECLARE @join VARCHAR(1024), @reportTable VARCHAR(64), @reportField VARCHAR(64), @reportFieldName VARCHAR(64), @reportKey VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64), @groupKey VARCHAR(64)
	
	SET @Join = ''
	IF (@reportBy BETWEEN 2 AND 5) OR (@groupBy BETWEEN 2 AND 5) SELECT @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF (@reportBy BETWEEN 7 AND 10) OR (@groupBy BETWEEN 7 AND 10) SET @Join = @Join + ' left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh'

	SELECT @reportBy = xfield, @reportTable = xtable2, @reportField = xfield2, @reportFieldName = xfield_name2, @reportKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @reportBy
	SELECT @groupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield_name2, @groupKey = xkey FROM #t WHERE xtype = @groupBy

	SELECT @dateEnd = DATEADD(day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 3 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 6 * @Count, @DateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 12 * @Count, @DateStart)
		END)

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'''
	IF @RevenueAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @RevenueAccount)
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, '', 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + ', ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '''''' ELSE @GroupBy END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN 'sum(tien2)' ELSE 'sum(ck)' END + ', sum(case when (a.ma_nt = '''' or a.ma_nt is null) then 0 else ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = 1 THEN 'tien_nt2' ELSE 'ck_nt' END + ' end)'
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateStart, @dateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock, index(ngay_ct))' + @Join + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' group by a.ngay_ct, ' + @ReportBy + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @GroupBy END
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateStart, @dateEnd, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DECLARE @d SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @i = 1, @d = @dateStart, @d2 = DATEADD(Day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @dateStart)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @dateStart) END)
	WHILE @i <= @Count BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', N''' + @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) + ''', reportby, groupby, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), '''' FROM #tmp WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112) + ''' AND ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d2, 112) + ''' GROUP BY reportby, groupby'
		SET @q = @q + ' INSERT INTO #report SELECT TOP 1 5, 1, 1, 0, ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', N''' + @sPeriod + ' ' + RTRIM(@i) + ''', reportby, groupby, 0, 0, '''' FROM #tmp'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1
		SELECT @d2 = DATEADD(Day, - 1, CASE
			WHEN @Time = '1' THEN DATEADD(Month, 1, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '2' THEN DATEADD(Month, 3, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '3' THEN DATEADD(Month, 6, @d)
			WHEN @Time = '4' THEN DATEADD(Month, 12, @d) END)
	END

	UPDATE #report SET reportby = CHAR(255) WHERE ISNULL(reportby, '') = ''
	UPDATE #report SET groupby = CHAR(255) WHERE ISNULL(groupby, '') = ''

	--Order
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'create table #o (stt int identity(1, 1) not null, reportby varchar(32) not null, groupby varchar(32) not null)'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #o select distinct reportby, groupby from #report order by groupby, reportby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, groupby into #o2 from #o group by groupby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = b.stt - c.stt + 1 from #report a join #o b on a.groupby = b.groupby and a.reportby = b.reportby join #o2 c on a.groupby = c.groupby'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'create table #o (stt int identity(1, 1) not null, reportby varchar(32) not null)'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #o select distinct reportby from #report order by reportby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = b.stt from #report a join #o b on a.reportby = b.reportby'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Tao group
	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #report select 3, 0, 1, 0, ky, max(ten_ky), '''', groupby, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt), isnull(max(' + @groupFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), N''' + @sNotDefine + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.groupby = b.' + @groupField + CASE WHEN @groupKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @groupKey END + ' group by ky, groupby'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt = null where sysorder = 3'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- Result
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, replace(str(a.ky, 3), '' '', ''0'') as fkey, a.groupby as tkey, a.ten_ky, tien, tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', groupby + reportby + isnull(rtrim(stt), '''') as xkey, case when ten_key <> '''' then ten_key else ' + CASE WHEN @GroupBy = '' THEN '' ELSE 'space(2) + ' END + 'isnull(' + @reportFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', N''' + @sNotDefine + ''') end as ten_key'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when reportby = char(255) then '''' else reportby end as xdetail'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @reportTable + ' b ON a.reportby = b.' + @reportField + CASE WHEN @reportKey = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and b.' + @reportKey END
	SET @q = @q + ' order by a.groupby, a.stt, a.ky'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT ky AS id, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien$' ELSE 'tien_nt$' END + RTRIM(ky) AS name, MAX(ten_ky) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #report GROUP BY ky ORDER BY ky
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT @Count + 1, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'tien' ELSE 'tien_nt' END, @sTotal
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSOApprovalRolesDetail]
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Function VARCHAR(32),
	@ApprovingOfficer VARCHAR(33),
	@Order CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_quyen AS quyen, a.status AS tu_trang_thai, a.status2 AS trang_thai_duyet, a.status0 AS trang_thai_huy, b.ten_quyen AS ten_quyen, c.ma_kieu AS kieu_duyet, c.ten_kieu AS ten_kieu_duyet,
			b.loai_duyet AS chuc_nang, d.ten_loai AS ten_chuc_nang, e.u_status_name AS ten_tu_trang_thai, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_duyet, e.u_status_name AS ten_trang_thai_huy,
			j.name AS nguoi_duyet, j.comment AS ten_nguoi_duyet, line_nbr AS line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2
		INTO #report FROM sodmquyenct a, sodmquyen b, sodmkieuduyet c, sodmloaiduyet d, sodmttcttg e, sodmduyet i, vsysuserinfo j

	SET @Key = 'status = 1 and convert(char(8), ngay_hl, 112) <= ' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112)
	IF @Function <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and loai_duyet like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Function), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ApprovingOfficer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and user_id = ' + (SELECT RTRIM(id) FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE name = REPLACE(RTRIM(@ApprovingOfficer), '''', ''''''))
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 user_id, loai_duyet, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2, ma_quyen INTO #sodmduyet FROM sodmduyet

	SET @q = 'insert into #sodmduyet select a.user_id, a.loai_duyet, a.ngay_hl, a.ngay_hl2, a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'from sodmduyet a join '
	SET @q = @q + '(select user_id, loai_duyet, max(ngay_hl) as ngay_hl from sodmduyet where ' + @Key + ' group by user_id, loai_duyet) b '
	SET @q = @q + 'on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ngay_hl = b.ngay_hl'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select distinct a.ma_quyen, a.status, a.status2, a.status0, '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_quyen ' ELSE 'b.ten_quyen2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(c.ma_kieu, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(c.ten_kieu, '''') ' ELSE 'isnull(c.ten_kieu2, '''') ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'b.loai_duyet, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_loai ' ELSE 'd.ten_loai2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.u_status_name ' ELSE 'e.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'f.u_status_name ' ELSE 'f.u_status_name2 'END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'g.u_status_name ' ELSE 'g.u_status_name2 ' END + ', '
	SET @q = @q + 'isnull(j.name, ''''), ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'isnull(j.comment, '''') ' ELSE 'isnull(j.comment2, '''') ' END + ', line_nbr, i.ngay_hl, i.ngay_hl2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'from sodmquyenct a join sodmquyen b on a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen left join sodmkieuduyet c on b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet and a.kieu_duyet = c.ma_kieu '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join sodmloaiduyet d on d.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet left join sodmttcttg e on e.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and e.u_status = a.status '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join sodmttcttg f on f.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and f.u_status = a.status2 '
	SET @q = @q + 'left join sodmttcttg g on g.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and g.u_status = a.status0 '
	SET @q = @q + 'join #sodmduyet i on i.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet and i.ma_quyen = a.ma_quyen '
	SET @q = @q + 'join vsysuserinfo j on j.id = i.user_id'
	SET @q = @q + ' where b.status = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE FROM #report WHERE nguoi_duyet = ''

	IF @Order = 1
		SELECT chuc_nang, ten_chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, ten_nguoi_duyet, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY chuc_nang, nguoi_duyet, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr
	IF @Order = 2
		SELECT chuc_nang AS nguoi_duyet, ten_chuc_nang AS ten_nguoi_duyet, nguoi_duyet AS chuc_nang, ten_nguoi_duyet AS ten_chuc_nang, quyen, ten_quyen, kieu_duyet, ten_kieu_duyet, tu_trang_thai, ten_tu_trang_thai, trang_thai_duyet, ten_trang_thai_duyet, trang_thai_huy, ten_trang_thai_huy, ngay_hl, ngay_hl2
			FROM #report ORDER BY nguoi_duyet, chuc_nang, quyen, kieu_duyet, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_AfterUpdateSO]
	@Dyn VARCHAR(33),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @cRoundQty VARCHAR(32), @cTranType VARCHAR(2), @i64$Table VARCHAR(33), @i61$Table VARCHAR(33), @m64$Table VARCHAR(33), @m61$Table VARCHAR(33), @d64$Table VARCHAR(33), @d61$Table VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000) 
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m64 FROM m64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_bg INTO #d64b FROM d64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd INTO #d64c FROM d64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so INTO #d64a FROM d64$000000
	SELECT @i64$Table = 'i64$' + @Dyn, @i61$Table = 'i61$' + @Dyn, @m64$Table = 'm64$' + @Dyn, @m61$Table = 'm61$' + @Dyn, @d64$Table = 'd64$' + @Dyn, @d61$Table = 'd61$' + @Dyn
	SET @q = 'insert into #m64 select * from ' + @m64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @cRoundQty = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE rtrim(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @cTranType =  RTRIM(loai_ct) FROM #m64 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64a select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSQIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSQIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so FROM #d64a
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @cSQIDNumber, @cLineSQIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@cSQIDNumber)) <> '' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@cLineSQIDNumber)) <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update ' + @d61$Table + ' set sl_dh = sl_dh + case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, ' + @cRoundQty + ') end'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@cSCIDNumber)) <> '' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@cLineSCIDNumber)) <> '' BEGIN									
				SET @q = 'update ' + @d64$Table + ' set sl_dh = sl_dh + case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, ' + @cRoundQty + ') end'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @cTranType = '3' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @d64$Table + ' set sl_xuat = sl_xuat + case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, ' + @cRoundQty + ') end,'
					SET @q = @q + 'sl_giao = sl_giao + case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round('+ RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, ' + @cRoundQty + ') end'
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @cSQIDNumber,  @cLineSQIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update SQ
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64b select stt_rec_bg from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec_bg <> '''' and stt_rec0bg <> '''' group by stt_rec_bg'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_bg FROM #d64b
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSQIDNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @q = 'if exists (select 1 from ' + @d61$Table + ' where sl_dh > 0 and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m61$Table + ' set status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''3'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i61$Table + ' set status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''3'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c61$000000 set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''3'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m61$Table + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSQIDNumber
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update SC
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64c select stt_rec_hd from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec_hd <> '''' and stt_rec0hd <> '''' group by stt_rec_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd FROM #d64c
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if exists (select 1 from ' + @d64$Table + ' where sl_xuat > 0 and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')' + CHAR(13) + 'begin'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''5'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''5'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''3'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status <> ''5''' + CHAR(13) + 'end'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists (select 1 from ' + @d64$Table + ' where sl_xuat < so_luong and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')' + CHAR(13) + 'begin'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + CHAR(13) + 'end'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'else begin' + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + 'end'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PS] --fs_BeforeUpdatePS
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1), @biPOYN BIT
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 tt_yn, datetime2 INTO #updatePO FROM m86$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS refTable INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d86$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #updatePO SELECT tt_yn, datetime2 FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when right(stt_rec_dh, 3) = ''PO1'' then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_ttmh <> '''' or stt_rec_sa <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS po_ht_yn, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS datetime2 INTO #infoDelivery FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '' OR stt_rec_sa <> ''
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, datetime2 INTO #h$Delivery FROM #infoDelivery

		SELECT @s = '
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh, max(h.datetime2) from bih94$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_dh = h.stt_rec_dh and d.stt_rec0dh = h.stt_rec0dh and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh, max(h.datetime2) from bih95$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_dh = h.stt_rec_dh and d.stt_rec0dh = h.stt_rec0dh and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_hd, h.stt_rec0hd, max(h.datetime2) from bih06$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_sa = h.stt_rec_hd and d.stt_rec0sa = h.stt_rec0hd and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_hd, h.stt_rec0hd
insert into #infoDelivery select a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh join bih94$000000 c on a.stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
insert into #infoDelivery select a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh join bih95$000000 c on a.stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
insert into #infoDelivery select '''', '''', a.stt_rec_sa, a.stt_rec0sa, isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa and a.stt_rec0sa = b.stt_rec0sa join bih06$000000 c on a.stt_rec_sa = c.stt_rec_hd and a.stt_rec0sa = c.stt_rec0hd and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_sa <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_oa, dyn_sa, dyn_hd, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		
		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cPOIDNumber AND stt_rec0dh = @cLinePOIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cPCIDNumber AND stt_rec0dh = @cLinePCIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_sa = @cSAIDNumber AND stt_rec0sa = @cLineSAIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_sa, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_sa
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''6'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckListEditLogDetailViewForm]
	@changeTimes INT,
	@idFunction VARCHAR(32),
	@field$1 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$2 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$3 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$4 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$5 VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@refresh INT = 0,
	@pageIndex INT = 0,
	@pageCount INT = 0,
	@lastPage INT = 0,
	@lastCount INT = 0,
	@firstItem VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@lastItem VARCHAR(512) = '',
	@fieldExternal VARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@tableFilter VARCHAR(128) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idFunction = REPLACE(@idFunction, '''', ''), @field$1 = REPLACE(@field$1, '''', ''), @field$2 = REPLACE(@field$2, '''', ''), @field$3 = REPLACE(@field$3, '''', ''), @field$4 = REPLACE(@field$4, '''', ''), @field$5 = REPLACE(@field$5, '''', ''), @changeTimes = @changeTimes + 1

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @r INT, @i INT, @i$Ref INT, @k TINYINT, @prime TINYINT, @id$List VARCHAR(128), @id$Field VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @f$ VARCHAR(32), @f$Amount VARCHAR(128), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo0 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo1 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo2 NVARCHAR(128)

	DECLARE @prime$Table VARCHAR(32), @prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32), @list$Table NVARCHAR(4000), @prime$Type CHAR(1), @prime$Log VARCHAR(32), @prime$Ref$Table VARCHAR(32), @ref$Times INT
	DECLARE @f$Key VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Join VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log$Exists VARCHAR(1024), @k$Log VARCHAR(1024), @k$Key VARCHAR(1024), @$primeFilter NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @NoDefine = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @LogInfo0 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo0'
	SELECT @LogInfo1 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo1'
	SELECT @LogInfo2 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo2'
	SELECT @f$Amount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'

	SELECT @f$Key = '', @f$Key$Join = '', @f$Key$Log = '', @f$Key$Log$Exists = '', @prime$Ref$Table = '', @k$Log = '', @k$Key = '', @$primeFilter = ''
	SELECT @prime$Table = xtable, @prime$Root = xtable, @prime$Log = RTRIM(xtable) + '$log', @prime$Root$Log = RTRIM(xtable) + '$log', @list$Table = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, '''', ''), ' ', ''), @prime$Type = xtype, @id$List = controller FROM dmlistlog WHERE id = @idFunction
	SELECT @f$Key = @f$Key + CASE WHEN @f$Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + ' = @field$' + RTRIM(ordinal_position)
			, @f$Key$Join = @f$Key$Join + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Join <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + '_n$a = ' + 'b.' + RTRIM(column_name) + '_n$b'
			, @f$Key$Log = @f$Key$Log + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ' = @field$' + RTRIM(ordinal_position)
			, @f$Key$Log$Exists = @f$Key$Log$Exists + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log$Exists <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ' = %b.' + RTRIM(column_name)
			, @k$Log = @k$Log + case when @k$Log <> '' then ' + ' else '''$'' + ' end + 'rtrim(b.' + column_name + ') + ''$'''
		FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_name = @prime$Root ORDER BY ordinal_position
	IF @prime$Type = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @f$Key = '%a.stt_rec = @field$1', @f$Key$Log = '%a.stt_rec = @field$1', @q = 'select @field$1 = stt_rec from hrnv where ma_nv = @field$1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@field$1 varchar(32) output', @field$1 OUTPUT
	END
	IF @prime$Type = '4'
		SELECT @prime$Root$Log = 'm$list$log', @k$Log = ''
			, @f$Key$Log = '%a.c = @c and %a.k_n = ''$' + CASE @field$1 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$1) + '$' END + CASE @field$2 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$2) + '$' END + CASE @field$3 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$3) + '$' END + CASE @field$4 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$4) + '$' END + CASE @field$5 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$5) + '$' END + ''''
			, @k$Key = '$' + CASE @field$1 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$1) + '$' END + CASE @field$2 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$2) + '$' END + CASE @field$3 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$3) + '$' END + CASE @field$4 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$4) + '$' END + CASE @field$5 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$5) + '$' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xtable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeTable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeLog, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS prime, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, *, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS cType INTO #field FROM #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS user_action, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS old_value, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS new_value, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx INTO #r0
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS stt_rec, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS gr_name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #r2 FROM #r0

	--
	SELECT @q = 'select @r = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ' and (idLog = @changeTimes or idLog = @changeTimes - 1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @r tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @id$List, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @r OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #r0 (gr_id, user_action) SELECT '', ''
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, * FROM #r0
		RETURN
	END

	-- Table/Field
	SELECT * INTO #refTable FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@list$Table, ',')
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT xtable, @prime$Root, @prime$Root$Log, 1 FROM dmlistlog WHERE id = @idFunction
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT data, RTRIM(data), REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log', 1 FROM #refTable WHERE data <> '' ORDER BY id

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #field (field, field_name, gr_id, xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
select a.field, a.field_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.gr_id, a.xtable, b.primeTable, b.primeLog, b.prime
from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckfields a left join #table b on a.xtable = b.xtable where a.ma_ct = @id$List order by b.stt, a.stt_sx, a.field'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@id$List varchar(128)', @id$List

	UPDATE #field SET cType = CASE WHEN c.name IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN 1 WHEN c.name IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC') THEN 2 WHEN c.name IN ('DATETIME', 'SMALLDATETIME') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.field = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(a.xtable) JOIN systypes c on b.xtype = c.xtype and b.xusertype = c.xusertype AND c.name <> 'sysname'
	UPDATE #field SET prime = 0 FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON OBJECT_ID(a.xtable) = b.id AND b.name = 'line_nbr'

	-- Data/Log
	IF @prime$Type = '4' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #$Log FROM d$list$log

		SELECT @q = 'select @r = max(idLog) from m$list$log where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @r tinyint output', @id$List, @r OUTPUT

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #$Log select * from d$list$log where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ' and idlog = @changeTimes - 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @changeTimes int', @id$List, @changeTimes

		SELECT @k$Log = @k$Log + CASE WHEN @k$Log <> '' THEN ' + ' ELSE '''$'' + ' END + CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END + ' + ''$'''
			FROM information_schema.key_column_usage a JOIN #field b ON a.table_name = b.xtable AND a.column_name = b.field ORDER BY a.ordinal_position

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$Log WHERE idLog = @r) BEGIN
			SELECT @i = MIN(stt), @i$Ref = MAX(stt) FROM #field
			WHILE @i <= @i$Ref BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
update #$Log
	set xvalue_new = ' + CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END + '
from #$Log a left join ' + xtable + ' b on a.k_n = ' + @k$Log  + CASE WHEN prime = 0 THEN ' and a.xline_nbr = b.line_nbr' ELSE '' END + '
where a.idLog = @r and a.xtable = ''' + xtable + ''' and a.xfield = ''' + field + '''' FROM #field WHERE stt = @i
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k$Key varchar(1024), @f$Amount varchar(512), @r tinyint', @id$List, @k$Key, @f$Amount, @r
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field WHERE prime = 0) BEGIN
				SELECT gr_id, xtable, field, cType, CAST(0 AS INT) AS r, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #fieldRef FROM #field WHERE prime = 0 ORDER BY gr_id, xtable, field, cType
				UPDATE #fieldRef SET r = b.r FROM #fieldRef a JOIN (SELECT xtable, ISNULL(MAX(xline_nbr), 0) AS r FROM #$Log GROUP BY xtable) b ON a.xtable = b.xtable
				SELECT @i = MIN(stt), @i$Ref = MAX(stt) FROM #fieldRef
				WHILE @i <= @i$Ref BEGIN
					SELECT @q = '
insert into #$Log
	select @c, ' + REPLACE(@k$Log, 'b.', 'a.') + ', @r, ''' + xtable + ''', ''' + field + ''', null
		, ' + CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END + ', a.line_nbr
	from ' + xtable + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@k$Log, 'b.', 'a.') + ' = @k$Key and a.line_nbr > ' + RTRIM(r) FROM #fieldRef WHERE stt = @i
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k$Key varchar(1024), @f$Amount varchar(512), @r tinyint', @id$List, @k$Key, @f$Amount, @r
					SELECT @i = @i + 1
				END
			END
		END

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #r0 (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select a.xfield, b.field_name, a.xline_nbr, case b.prime when 1 then @LogInfo1 else case when a.xvalue_old is not null and a.xvalue_new is null then @LogInfo2 when a.xvalue_old is null and a.xvalue_new is not null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end end, a.xvalue_old, a.xvalue_new, b.gr_id, b.stt
		from #$Log a left join #field b on a.xfield = b.field and a.xtable = b.xtable where ((b.prime = 1 and isnull(a.xvalue_old, '''') <> isnull(a.xvalue_new, '''')) or (b.prime = 0 and (a.xvalue_old <> a.xvalue_new or a.xvalue_old is null or a.xvalue_new is null)) ) and b.field_name is not null
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @changeTimes int, @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)', @id$List, @changeTimes, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2

		GOTO ViewReport
	END
	SELECT @q = 'select @i = min(a.idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', 'a.') + ' and a.idLog = @changeTimes' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @i tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @i OUTPUT, @changeTimes

	SELECT @s = '
insert into #r0 (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select @f$, N''%field_name'', %line, %action, %old_value, %new_value, N''%gr_id'', %stt_sx
		from %talbe a
			left join %refTalbe b on %joinKeyRef %joinKeyDetail %joinKeyLog
		where %whereRefKey %whereKey'

	SELECT @i$Ref = @i
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @f$ = field, @prime$Root = primeTable, @prime$Root$Log = primeLog, @prime = prime FROM #field ORDER BY stt
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@prime$Root) AND name = @f$) GOTO GetValueNextField
		IF @prime$Type = '2' AND @prime$Table = 'hrnv' AND @prime$Ref$Table <> @prime$Root BEGIN
				SELECT @prime$Ref$Table = @prime$Root, @ref$Times = NULL, @i$Ref = NULL
				SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2 and idLog = @changeTimes) begin
	select @ref$Times = idLog from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2 and idLog = @changeTimes
end else if exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2) begin
	select @ref$Times = a.idLog + 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Log) + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' b where b.stt_rec = @field$2 and a.[datetime_log] = b.[datetime2])
end
select @i$Ref = min(a.idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') + ' and a.idLog = @changeTimes'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
					, N'@changeTimes int, @ref$Times int output, @i$Ref int output, @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32)'
					, @changeTimes, @ref$Times OUTPUT, @i$Ref OUTPUT, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5
		END

		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
			, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
			, '%line', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'a.line_nbr' END)
			, '%action', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '@LogInfo1' ELSE 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end' END)
			, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
			, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
			, '%gr_id', gr_id)
			, '%stt_sx', stt)
			, '%talbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN @prime$Root ELSE @prime$Root$Log END)
			, '%refTalbe', @prime$Root$Log)
			, '%joinKeyRef', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', ''), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) END)
			, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' END)
			, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN 'and b.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog = b.idLog + 1' END)
			, '%whereRefKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(@f$Key, '%a', 'a') ELSE REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') END)
			, '%whereKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') AND @prime = 1 THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @ref$Times IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' and @ref$Times - 1 = @changeTimes - 1' END END ELSE 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END END)
		FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root$Log, '')

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@f$ varchar(32), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128), @ref$Times int'
			, @f$, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2, @ref$Times

		IF @prime = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
				, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
				, '%line', 'isnull(b.line_nbr, a.line_nbr)')
				, '%action', 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo2 else @LogInfo1 end')
				, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
				, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
				, '%gr_id', gr_id)
				, '%stt_sx', stt)
				, '%talbe', @prime$Root$Log)
				, '%refTalbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN @prime$Root ELSE @prime$Root$Log END)
				, '%joinKeyRef', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END END), '_n$b', '') ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) END)
				, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@prime$Root$Log) AND name = 'stt_rec0') THEN 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' ELSE 'and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' END)
				, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog + 1 = b.idLog' END)
				, '%whereRefKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(@f$Key, '%a', 'a') ELSE REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') END)
				, '%whereKey', 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END)
			FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND primeTable = @prime$Root AND primeLog = @prime$Root$Log

			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@f$ varchar(32), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
				, @f$, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2
		END
GetValueNextField:
		--
		DELETE #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root$Log, '')
	END

	DELETE #r0 WHERE ISNULL(old_value, '') = ISNULL(new_value, '')

ViewReport:

	-- Not exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r0) INSERT INTO #r0 (gr_id, user_action) SELECT 'NODEFINE', @LogInfo1

	-- View
	SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #r1 FROM #r0
	SELECT @q = '
insert #r2 (gr_name, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else b.gr_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' end
