			, case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else a.field_name end
			, a.line_nbr, a.user_action, a.old_value, a.new_value, a.gr_id, a.stt_sx
		from #r1 a left join ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckgroupfields b on a.gr_id = b.gr_id
		order by b.stt_sx, a.gr_id, a.line_nbr, a.stt_sx, a.user_action, a.field
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@NoDefine nvarchar(128)', @NoDefine
	UPDATE #r2 SET stt_rec = REPLACE(STR(stt, 32), ' ', '0')

	IF ISNULL(@tableFilter, '') <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @$primeFilter = isnull(@$primeFilter, '''') + case when isnull(@$primeFilter, '''') = '''' then '''' else '' and '' end + replace(conditional, char(255), '''') from ' + @tableFilter + ' order by id'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@$primeFilter nvarchar(4000) output', @$primeFilter OUTPUT
	END
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Table$Finding '#r2', @refresh, @pageIndex, @pageCount, @lastPage, @lastCount, @firstItem, @lastItem, '', 'stt_rec', @fieldExternal, '', 'stt_rec', @admin, @userID, default, default, default, @$primeFilter


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateAvgPriceMaster] @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strDetailTable VARCHAR(24), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @strMasterTable VARCHAR(24), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
		@ma_ct CHAR(3), @i TINYINT, @sDyn VARCHAR(8000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dDate SMALLDATETIME
	
	SELECT @sDyn = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @dDate = @dFrom
		WHILE @dDate <= @dTo SELECT @sDyn = @sDyn + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112) + ',', @dDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dDate)
		SELECT @sDyn = LEFT(@sDyn, LEN(@sDyn) - 1)
	END

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #wrkstkmaster FROM wrkstkmaster
	SELECT stt_rec INTO #id FROM #wrkstkdetail GROUP BY stt_rec 

	SELECT @strSQL = 'truncate table #wrkstkmaster' + CHAR(13) +
		' insert into #wrkstkmaster (stt_rec, t_tien_nt, t_tien)' + 
		' select a.stt_rec, sum(a.tien_nt), sum(a.tien) from @cdetailTable a join #id b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
		' group by a.stt_rec' + CHAR(13) + 
		' update @cMasterTable set t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt from @cMasterTable a join #wrkstkmaster b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'

	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #wrkstkdetail
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @strDetailTable = RTRIM(m_ctdbfs), @strMasterTable = RTRIM(m_phdbfs) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
		IF @strDetailTable <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @i = 0
			WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strDetailTable) BEGIN
				SELECT @i = @i + 1, 
					@cDetailTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strDetailTable, @i))), @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strMasterTable, @i))), 
					@q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable), '@ma_ct', @ma_ct)		
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END

		IF @sDyn <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @strDetailTable = d$, @strMasterTable = m$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			IF @strDetailTable <> '' AND @strMasterTable <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @i = 0
				WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@sDyn) BEGIN
					SELECT @i = @i + 1, 
						@cDetailTable = @strDetailTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i), @cMasterTable = @strMasterTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i), 
						@q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable), '@ma_ct', @ma_ct)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
		END

		--
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #wrkstkdetail WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END

	--TRUNCATE TABLE wrkstkmaster
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostBIILClosed]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @status CHAR(1)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct, @status = status FROM bic11$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @status = '*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'bim11$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'bid11$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'bii11$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'bia11$000000'


	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status <> ''5'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''5'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update bic11$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'

	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END
	--
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DELETE dvxlduyet  WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW vthhspbcc 
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.so_the_ts, a.ky, a.nam, MAX(b.ten_ts) AS ten_ts, MAX(b.ten_ts2) AS ten_ts2
		FROM cthspbcc a LEFT JOIN dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		GROUP BY a.so_the_ts, a.ky, a.nam
		ORDER BY a.so_the_ts

GO

CREATE PROC [dbo].[bet_ticket_esport_list]
    @user_id INT = -1,
    @match NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @season NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @type CHAR(1) = '0',
    @clear CHAR(1) = '0',
    @result CHAR(1) = '2',
    @df NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @dt NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT
        t.user_id,
        t.match_id AS match,
        t.code,
        CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS ticket,
        t.money,
        CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19, 2)) AS money_win,
        CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19, 2)) AS fee,
        CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS result_name,
        CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS textColor,
        CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS rowColor,
        CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS rowBold,
        t.clear,
        t.[datetime],
        m.season,
        m.match_time,
        ISNULL(h.team_name, m.home) AS home_name,
        ISNULL(w.team_name, m.way) AS way_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(t.code, 2, CHARINDEX('.', t.code) - 2) AS INT) AS game_no,
        PARSENAME(REPLACE(t.code, '.', '.'), 2) AS market,
        PARSENAME(REPLACE(t.code, '.', '.'), 1) AS side
    INTO #ticket
    FROM bet_ticket_esport t
    JOIN bet_esport_match m ON m.match_id = t.match_id
    LEFT JOIN bet_team h ON h.team = m.home
    LEFT JOIN bet_team w ON w.team = m.way
    WHERE (@user_id = -1 OR t.user_id = @user_id)
        AND (@match = '' OR t.match_id = @match OR ISNULL(h.team_name, m.home) + ' vs ' + ISNULL(w.team_name, m.way) LIKE '%' + @match + '%')
        AND (@season = '' OR m.season = @season)
        AND (@clear = '2' OR ISNULL(t.clear, 0) = TRY_CAST(@clear AS BIT))
        AND (@result IN ('0', '2'))
        AND (@df IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), t.[datetime], 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(5), t.[datetime], 108), ':', '') >= @df)
        AND (@dt IS NULL OR CONVERT(CHAR(8), t.[datetime], 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(5), t.[datetime], 108), ':', '') <= @dt)

    SELECT e.user_id,
           e.match,
           e.code,
           e.ticket,
           CASE WHEN e.game_no = 6 THEN 'BO x' ELSE 'Game ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), e.game_no) END
             + '. '
             + CASE
                 WHEN e.market = 'OU' AND e.side = 'O' THEN N'Tài ' + REPLACE(STR(g.ou_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + CASE WHEN e.game_no = 6 THEN N' game' ELSE N' kill' END
                 WHEN e.market = 'OU' AND e.side = 'U' THEN N'Xỉu ' + REPLACE(STR(g.ou_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + CASE WHEN e.game_no = 6 THEN N' game' ELSE N' kill' END
                 WHEN e.market = 'HC' AND e.side = 'H' THEN e.home_name + CASE WHEN g.hc_line >= 0 THEN ' +' ELSE ' ' END + REPLACE(STR(g.hc_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + CASE WHEN e.game_no = 6 THEN N' game' ELSE N' kill' END
                 WHEN e.market = 'HC' AND e.side = 'W' THEN e.way_name + CASE WHEN g.hc_line <= 0 THEN ' +' ELSE ' ' END + REPLACE(STR(-g.hc_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + CASE WHEN e.game_no = 6 THEN N' game' ELSE N' kill' END
                 WHEN e.market = 'MIN' AND e.side = 'O' THEN N'Tài ' + REPLACE(STR(g.minute_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' phút'
                 WHEN e.market = 'MIN' AND e.side = 'U' THEN N'Xỉu ' + REPLACE(STR(g.minute_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' phút'
                 WHEN e.market = 'DOU' AND e.side = 'O' THEN N'Tài ' + REPLACE(STR(g.dragon_ou_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' rồng'
                 WHEN e.market = 'DOU' AND e.side = 'U' THEN N'Xỉu ' + REPLACE(STR(g.dragon_ou_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' rồng'
                 WHEN e.market = 'DHC' AND e.side = 'H' THEN e.home_name + CASE WHEN g.dragon_hc_line >= 0 THEN ' +' ELSE ' ' END + REPLACE(STR(g.dragon_hc_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' rồng'
                 WHEN e.market = 'DHC' AND e.side = 'W' THEN e.way_name + CASE WHEN g.dragon_hc_line <= 0 THEN ' +' ELSE ' ' END + REPLACE(STR(-g.dragon_hc_line, 19, 2), ' ', '') + N' rồng'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FD' AND e.side = 'H' THEN N'Rồng đầu ' + e.home_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.first_dragon_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FD' AND e.side = 'W' THEN N'Rồng đầu ' + e.way_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.first_dragon_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FIRST' AND e.side = 'H' THEN N'Mạng đầu ' + e.home_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.first_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FIRST' AND e.side = 'W' THEN N'Mạng đầu ' + e.way_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.first_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'THIRD' AND e.side = 'H' THEN N'3 mạng đầu ' + e.home_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.third_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'THIRD' AND e.side = 'W' THEN N'3 mạng đầu ' + e.way_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.third_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FIVE' AND e.side = 'H' THEN N'5 mạng đầu ' + e.home_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.five_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'FIVE' AND e.side = 'W' THEN N'5 mạng đầu ' + e.way_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.five_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'TEN' AND e.side = 'H' THEN N'10 mạng đầu ' + e.home_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.ten_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'TEN' AND e.side = 'W' THEN N'10 mạng đầu ' + e.way_name + ' (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.ten_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'WIN' AND e.side = 'H' THEN e.home_name + N' win (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.win_home_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 WHEN e.market = 'WIN' AND e.side = 'W' THEN e.way_name + N' win (' + dbo.ff_NumberFormat(g.win_way_win, '### ### ###.#0') + ')'
                 ELSE e.code
               END AS ticket_name,
           e.money,
           e.money_win,
           e.fee,
           e.result_name,
           e.textColor,
           e.rowColor,
           e.rowBold,
           e.game_no,
           CAST('esport' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS ticket_type
    INTO #detail
    FROM #ticket e
    JOIN bet_esport_game g ON g.match_id = e.match AND g.game_no = e.game_no

    IF @type = '1'
        SELECT match,
               user_id,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(64)) AS code,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS ticket,
               N'Esports. ' + home_name + ' vs ' + way_name AS ticket_name,
               SUM(money) AS money,
               CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19, 2)) AS money_win,
               CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(19, 2)) AS fee,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS result_name,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS textColor,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS rowColor,
               CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS rowBold,
               CAST('esport' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS ticket_type
        FROM #ticket
        GROUP BY match, user_id, home_name, way_name
        ORDER BY match DESC, user_id
    ELSE
        SELECT *
        FROM #detail
        ORDER BY match DESC, user_id, game_no, code
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryBySiteLocationItemLot]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 : Bao cao theo vat tu - lo , 2: Bao cao theo lo - vat tu
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : Nhom theo kho, vi tri , 2: Chi tiet theo kho, vi tri, 0: Khong xu lý
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @NoDefine = RTRIM(cName), @NoDefine2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nodefine'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap
		, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt2, 0 AS stt3, 0 AS stt4, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt
		, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, c.ten_lo, c.ten_lo2, a.ma_vt AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b, dmlo c
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt2, stt3, stt4, ten_lo, ten_lo2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--  Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SiteLocationItemLot @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, '', @Lot, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Lot <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Lot), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE lo_yn = 1)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ton_dau), sum(a.du_dau), sum(a.du_dau_nt), sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n), sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.dvt), max(b.loai_vt), max(b.nh_vt1), max(c.ten_lo), max(c.ten_lo2), a.ma_lo, max(c.ten_lo), max(c.ten_lo2)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmlo c with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt and a.ma_lo = c.ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_lo', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0
		AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat =0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0

	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_lo NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_lo2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_lo = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_lo), ten_lo2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_lo2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 3,1,0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.loai_vt
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_lo NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_lo2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_lo = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_lo), ten_lo2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_lo2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 3,1,0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.nh_vt1
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_vt) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vt2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 2, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvitri b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 1, 1, 0, a.ma_kho,N'' AS ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_vt, MAX(b.ten_kho) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_kho2) AS ten2,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho

	--Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024), @g VARCHAR(1024), @g1 VARCHAR(1024), @w VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt', @w = 'sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @g1 = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
		, @o = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g1, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 1
	CREATE TABLE #order1(ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order1 (ma_kho) select ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt2 = b.stt from #report a join #order1 b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 1

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 2
	CREATE TABLE #order2(ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order2 (ma_vi_tri, ma_kho) select ma_vi_tri, ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 2 or sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_kho into #group2 from #order2 group by ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt3 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order2 b on a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho join #group2 c on b.ma_kho = c.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 2

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 4
	CREATE TABLE #order3(ma_vt VARCHAR(32), ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order3 (ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_kho) select ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 4 or sysorder = 2 or sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri into #group3 from #order3 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt4 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order3 b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho join #group3 c on b.ma_kho = c.ma_kho and b.ma_vi_tri = c.ma_vi_tri where a.sysorder = 4'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 4

	--
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @s1 AS ten_lo, @s12 AS ten_lo2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
			SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
			SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #reporttt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_lo, ten_lo2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal)
		VALUES (' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', 1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_lo, ten_lo2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT '', ten_lo, ten_lo2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #reporttt

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten2 NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt NVARCHAR(16)

	UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, ten_lo), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, ten_lo2)

	DECLARE @ma VARCHAR(32)
	UPDATE #report SET @ma = CASE sysorder WHEN 1 THEN ma_kho WHEN 2 THEN ma_vi_tri WHEN 3 THEN ma_vt ELSE ma END, ma = @ma,
		ten = CASE WHEN sysorder = 3 THEN SPACE(2.5 * 2) ELSE SPACE(sysorder * 2) END + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 2 THEN @NoDefine ELSE ten END)),
		ten2 = CASE WHEN sysorder = 3 THEN SPACE(2.5 * 2) ELSE SPACE(sysorder * 2) END + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 2 THEN @NoDefine2 ELSE ten2 END))
	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString('ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, sysorder, ' + @Group , @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_DavgUpdatePrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(33), 
	@item VARCHAR(33), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@itemType VARCHAR(33), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcCDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(511), 
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(511) , 
	@priceFCType TINYINT, 
	@userID INT, 
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @tables VARCHAR(24), @tableMasters VARCHAR(24), @detailTable VARCHAR(16), @masterTable VARCHAR(16), @n TINYINT, @pRound TINYINT, @pRoundFC TINYINT, @i INT, 
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @m NVARCHAR(4000), @dynTable VARCHAR(64), @dyn VARCHAR(8000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @currency VARCHAR(32)

	-- Set
	SELECT @currency = '''' + REPLACE(dbo.ff30_FC1(), '''', '') + '''', @pRound = 12, @pRoundFC = 12, @dyn = ''

	-- GL
	IF @updateType <> 0 BEGIN
		CREATE INDEX i ON #ps00(stt_rec, line_nbr)
		UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = b.ps_no, ps_co = b.ps_co, ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt
			FROM ct00 a WITH (INDEX(ngay_ct)) JOIN #ps00 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr
				WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
			
		INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #tbgl
				
		SELECT @d = @dFrom
		WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @dynTable = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112), 
				@q = 'update ' + @dynTable + ' set ps_no = b.ps_no, ps_co = b.ps_co, ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt' + 
					' from ' + @dynTable + ' a join #ps00 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q	
										
			SELECT @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
				
			IF @d - 1 = @dTo BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @dynTable + ' select * from #tbgl'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END									
	END

	IF @updateType = 2 RETURN
		
	-- Inventory
	UPDATE ct70 SET gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia1, gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt1, tien_nhap = b.tien_nhap, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = b.tien_xuat, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt_x
		FROM ct70 a JOIN #ps70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)
		
	INSERT INTO ct70 SELECT * FROM #tbin

	SELECT @d = @dFrom
	WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112), 
			@q = 'update ' + @dynTable + ' set gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia1, gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt1, ' + 
				'tien_nhap = b.tien_nhap, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = b.tien_xuat, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt_x' + 
				' from ' + @dynTable + ' a join #ps70 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @dyn = @dyn + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112) + ','
		SELECT @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
				
		IF @d - 1 = @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @dynTable + ' select * from #tbin'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END



	-- Voucher
	SELECT @dyn = LEFT(@dyn, LEN(@dyn) - 1)
	SELECT d$, m$, ma_ct INTO #dmct9 FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM #ps70)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, gia, gia_nt, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, he_so1 AS he_so, ma_nt
		INTO #wrkstkdetail FROM wrkin
		
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #wrkstkdetail (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, he_so, ma_nt)' + 
		' select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x, a.he_so1, a.ma_nt' + 
		' from #ps70 a where ((a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1) or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd <> 1 and a.ma_ct <> ''HD2''))'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = ROUND(gia * he_so, @pRound), gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt * he_so, @pRoundFC)
	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia_nt = gia, tien_nt = tien WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = ''
		
	SELECT stt_rec, SUM(a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat) AS t_tien, SUM(a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x) AS t_tien_nt INTO #wrkstkmaster
		FROM #ps70gl a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #wrkstkdetail b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec) GROUP BY a.stt_rec

	UPDATE #wrkstkmaster SET t_tien_nt = t_tien WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #wrkstkdetail b WHERE b.stt_rec = #wrkstkmaster.stt_rec AND b.ma_nt = '')

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_ct, RTRIM(b.m_ctdbfs) AS dtable, RTRIM(b.m_phdbfs) AS mtable
		INTO #xcUpdateDetail FROM #wrkstkdetail a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct GROUP BY a.ma_ct, b.m_ctdbfs, b.m_phdbfs ORDER BY a.ma_ct

	CREATE INDEX i1 ON #wrkstkdetail(stt_rec, stt_rec0)
	CREATE INDEX i2 ON #wrkstkmaster(stt_rec)	

	--Detail
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') SELECT @r = 'update @detailTable set gia_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia else b.gia_nt end, ' + 
		'gia = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia_nt else b.gia end, ' + 
		'tien_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien else b.tien_nt end, ' + 
		'tien = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien_nt else b.tien end, ' + 
		' from @detailTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join (select * from #wrkstkdetail where ma_ct = @ma_ct) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec end a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' + 
		' join @masterTable d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
	ELSE SELECT @r = 'update @detailTable set gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia = b.gia, tien_nt = b.tien_nt, tien = b.tien' + 
		' from @detailTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join (select * from #wrkstkdetail where ma_ct = @ma_ct) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'

	SELECT @r = @r + ' where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'

	--Master				
	SELECT @m = 'update @masterTable set t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt from @masterTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join #wrkstkmaster b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
		' where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'

	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #xcUpdateDetail WHERE stt = @i) BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_ct = ma_ct, @tables = dtable, @tableMasters = mtable FROM #xcUpdateDetail WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @n = 0
		WHILE @n < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@tables)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @n = @n + 1
				SELECT @detailTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tables, @n))), @masterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tableMasters, @n)))

				-- Detail
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '@detailTable', @detailTable)
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))		
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				-- Master
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@m, '@masterTable', @masterTable)
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q				
			END
			
		IF @dyn <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @tables = d$, @tableMasters = m$ FROM #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			IF @tables <> '' AND @tableMasters <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @n = 0
				WHILE @n < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@dyn) BEGIN
					SELECT @n = @n + 1
					SELECT @detailTable = @tables + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@dyn, @n), @masterTable = @tableMasters + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@dyn, @n)

					-- d$
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '@detailTable', @detailTable)
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))
					EXEC sp_executesql @q

					-- m$
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(@m, '@masterTable', @masterTable)
					SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
		END

		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateGrandTable]
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@GrandTable VARCHAR(32),
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@PrimaryFields VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@DefaultVoucherBook TINYINT = 0,
	@HandleVoucherNumberKey VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PlantField VARCHAR(32) = 'ma_vung',
	@PurOrgField VARCHAR(32) = 'ma_bp0',
	@PurGroupField VARCHAR(32) = 'ma_nh0',
	@InspectionField VARCHAR(32) = 'ma_nguon'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @InsertVoucherBook VARCHAR(64), @UpdateVoucherBook VARCHAR(64), @v1 NVARCHAR(128), @v2 NVARCHAR(128), @v3 NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @f1 NVARCHAR(128), @f2 NVARCHAR(128), @f3 NVARCHAR(128), @PurOrgRight BIT, @PlantRight BIT, @PurGrRight BIT, @InspectionRight BIT

	SELECT @v1 = '', @v2 = '', @v3 = '', @f1 = '', @f2 = '', @f3 = '', @PurOrgRight = 0, @PlantRight = 0, @PurGrRight = 0, @InspectionRight = 0
	IF OBJECT_ID('dmct7') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		DECLARE @o1 VARCHAR(128), @o2 VARCHAR(128), @e NVARCHAR(4000), @p NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @p = N'@o1 varchar(128) output, @o2 varchar(128) output', @e = 'select @o1 = field, @o2 = ref from dmct7 where ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @e, @p, @o1 OUTPUT, @o2 OUTPUT


		IF ISNULL(@o1, '') <> '' SELECT @v1 = CASE WHEN @o1 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + @o1 END, @v2 = CASE WHEN @o2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' + @o2 END, @v3 = CASE WHEN @o1 = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @o1 + ' = b.' + @o2 END
	END
	IF @DefaultVoucherBook = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_quyen' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') SELECT @InsertVoucherBook = ', ma_nk', @UpdateVoucherBook = ', ma_nk = b.ma_nk'
		ELSE SELECT @InsertVoucherBook = '', @UpdateVoucherBook = ''


	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql N'select @PurOrgRight = x_pur_org, @PlantRight = x_plant, @PurGrRight = x_pur_group, @InspectionRight = x_inspection from dmct where ma_ct = @VoucherCode'
			, N'@VoucherCode varchar(32), @PurOrgRight bit output, @PlantRight bit output, @PurGrRight bit output, @InspectionRight bit output', @VoucherCode, @PurOrgRight OUTPUT, @PlantRight OUTPUT, @PurGrRight OUTPUT, @InspectionRight OUTPUT
		SELECT @f1 = ISNULL(@f1, ''), @f2 = ISNULL(@f2, ''), @f2 = ISNULL(@f2, '')
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@GrandTable) AND name = 'ma_bp0') AND @PurOrgRight = 1 SELECT @f1 = @f1 + ', ma_bp0', @f2 = @f2 + ',' + @PurOrgField, @f3 = @f3 + ', ma_bp0 = b.' + @PurOrgField
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@GrandTable) AND name = 'ma_vung') AND @PlantRight = 1 SELECT @f1 = @f1 + ', ma_vung', @f2 = @f2 + ',' + @PlantField, @f3 = @f3 + ', ma_vung = b.' + @PlantField
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@GrandTable) AND name = 'ma_nh0') AND @PurGrRight = 1 SELECT @f1 = @f1 + ', ma_nh0', @f2 = @f2 + ',' + @PurGroupField, @f3 = @f3 + ', ma_nh0 = b.' + @PurGroupField
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@GrandTable) AND name = 'ma_nguon') AND @InspectionRight = 1 SELECT @f1 = @f1 + ', ma_nguon', @f2 = @f2 + ',' + @InspectionField, @f3 = @f3 + ', ma_nguon = b.' + @InspectionField
	END

	IF ISNULL(@HandleVoucherNumberKey, '') = '' OR @HandleVoucherNumberKey = @IDNumber BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'if not exists(select 1 from ' + @GrandTable + ' where '+ @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + @IDNumber + ''')'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' insert into ' + @GrandTable + ' (stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs' + @InsertVoucherBook + ', status, user_id0' + @v1 + @f1 + ')'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dvcs' + @InsertVoucherBook + ', status, user_id0' + @v2 + @f2 + ' from ' + @MasterTable + ' where ' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		SELECT @q = @q + ' else update ' + @GrandTable + ' set ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct' + @UpdateVoucherBook + ', ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs, status = b.status, user_id0 = b.user_id0' + @v3 + @f3
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @GrandTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on a.' + @PrimaryFields + ' = b.' + @PrimaryFields + ' where a.' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
		EXEC(@q)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @HandleVoucherNumberKey = RIGHT(SPACE(13) + LTRIM(@HandleVoucherNumberKey), 13)
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @GrandTable + ' set stt_rec = b.stt_rec, ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct' + @UpdateVoucherBook + ', ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs, status = b.status, user_id0 = b.user_id0' + @v3 + @f3
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @GrandTable + ' a join ' + @MasterTable + ' b on b.' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' where a.' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + @HandleVoucherNumberKey + ''''
		EXEC(@q)
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptExpensesArisingSummary] --fs20_AccRateDept1Period--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023) ,
	@AccountNoMinus VARCHAR(1023),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@Report VARCHAR(128),
	@Group VARCHAR(128),
	@GroupFee1 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee2 VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupFee3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @strName CHAR(8), @Groups VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @nPs NUMERIC(16), @nPs_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @nLk NUMERIC(16), @n_Lk_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1
	SELECT @cNoGroup = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cName) ELSE RTRIM(cName2) END FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_bp, ma_phi, ma_vv, ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt, ps_no AS lk, ps_no_nt AS lk_nt INTO #tmp FROM wrkgl

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1''', @Join = ''
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_bp' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp <> '''''
	IF @Report = 'ma_vv' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @GroupFee1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_phi3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@GroupFee3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @AccountNoMinus <> ''
		SET @Key2 = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'notinlist', @AccountNoMinus)
	ELSE
		SET @Key2 = '(1 = 0)'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	IF @GroupFee1 + @GroupFee2 + @GroupFee3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmphi b on a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi'

	SET @s = 'insert into #tmp select a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv, @ReportField'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @s = @s + ' where %[@Key]%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv'

	-- Trong ky
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Trong ky (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END + ', 0, 0')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Luy ke
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt)' ELSE 'sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom0, @DateTo0, @UserID, @Admin
	-- Luy ke (giam tru)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', @Key2)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ReportField', '0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'sum(-a.ps_co), sum(-a.ps_co_nt)' ELSE 'sum(-a.ps_no), sum(-a.ps_no_nt)' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom0, @DateTo0, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv
			, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(lk) AS lk, SUM(lk_nt) AS lk_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_tk2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_bp, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_bp2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_phi2
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_vv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_vv2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS xKey, CAST('' AS CHAR(64)) AS xDetail
		INTO #report1 FROM #tmp a GROUP BY a.tk, a.ma_bp, a.ma_phi, a.ma_vv

	IF @Report = 'tk' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_tk = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_tk ELSE '' END, ten_tk2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_tk2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	IF @Report = 'ma_bp' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_bp = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_bp ELSE '' END, ten_bp2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_bp2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
	IF @Report = 'ma_phi' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_phi = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_phi ELSE '' END, ten_phi2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_phi2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmphi b ON a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi
	IF @Report = 'ma_vv' UPDATE #report1 SET ten_vv = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE '' END, ten_vv2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_vv2 ELSE '' END FROM #report1 a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv

	UPDATE #report1 SET ps = ISNULL(ps, 0), ps_nt = ISNULL(ps_nt, 0), lk = ISNULL(lk, 0), lk_nt = ISNULL(lk_nt, 0)
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps + ps_nt + lk + lk_nt = 0

	-- Update luy ke
	UPDATE #report1 SET lk = lk + ps, lk_nt = lk_nt + ps_nt

	SET @q = 'update #report1 set xDetail = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report1 WHERE xDetail = '' OR xDetail IS NULL
	DELETE #report1 WHERE ps = 0 AND lk = 0
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM #report1 WHERE 1 = 0

	SET @q = 'insert into #report '
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select distinct 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, 0 as stt, max(tk), max(ma_bp), max(ma_phi), max(ma_vv)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', sum(ps), sum(ps_nt), sum(lk), sum(lk_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', max(ten_tk), max(ten_tk2), max(ten_bp), max(ten_bp2), max(ten_phi), max(ten_phi2), max(ten_vv), max(ten_vv2), max(xkey), max(xdetail)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #report1'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by ' + @Group + '@Comma xDetail'
	IF @Group <> '' SET @q = REPLACE(@q , '@Comma', ',') ELSE SET @q = REPLACE(@q , '@Comma', '')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_bp, ten_bp2, ten_vv, ten_vv2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ps = 0 AND lk  = 0 AND systotal = 1
	IF @Group <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup3(@Group , REPLACE(@Report, 'ma_', ''), 'ps, ps_nt, lk, lk_nt', '#report')
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	UPDATE #report SET tk = ISNULL(tk, ''), ma_phi = ISNULL(ma_phi, ''), ma_bp = ISNULL(ma_bp, ''), ma_vv = ISNULL(ma_vv, ''), xDetail = ISNULL(xDetail, '')

	SET @Groups = REPLACE(@Group, ',', ' + ')
	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Groups + ' + xDetail'
	ELSE
		SET @q = ' update #report set xKey = ' + @Report
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT DISTINCT MAX(sysorder) AS sysorder, MAX(sysprint) AS sysprint, MAX(systotal) AS systotal, 0 AS stt, xKey , MAX(xDetail) AS xDetail, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(ma_bp) AS ma_bp
			, MAX(ma_phi) AS ma_phi, MAX(ma_vv) AS ma_vv, SUM(ps) AS ps, SUM(ps_nt) AS ps_nt, SUM(lk) AS lk,SUM(lk_nt) AS lk_nt
			, MAX(ten_tk) AS ten_tk, MAX(ten_tk2) AS ten_tk2, MAX(ten_phi) AS ten_phi, MAX(ten_phi2) AS ten_phi2, MAX(ten_bp) AS ten_bp, MAX(ten_bp2) AS ten_bp2, MAX(ten_vv) AS ten_vv, MAX(ten_vv2) AS ten_vv2
		INTO #report3
		FROM #report
		GROUP BY xKey, sysorder

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report3', 'stt, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ma_vv, ten_tk, ten_tk2, ten_phi, ten_phi2, ten_bp, ten_bp2, ten_vv, ten_vv2', 'NUMERIC(5), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(33), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @o = 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN @Group = '' THEN ', ' ELSE ', ' + @Group + ', ' END + 'xkey'
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report3', 'stt', 'sysorder = 5'

	UPDATE #report3 SET stt = NULL WHERE stt = 0
	IF UPPER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 1, 3)) = 'MA_'
		SET @strName = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report)), 'ma_', 'ten_')))
	ELSE
		SET @strName =LTRIM(RTRIM('ten_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Report))))

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + ' = N' + CHAR(39)+ @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( @strName )) + '2 =  ' + CHAR(39)+ @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ' where systotal = 0 and ( ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName )) + ' is null or ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName ))  + ' = N' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ' )'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'alter table #report3 alter column ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' nvarchar(511) null'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' alter table #report3 alter column ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 nvarchar(511) null'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'update #report3 set ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 = space(1) + ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 where sysorder > 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report3) INSERT INTO #report3 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, systotal, sysprint, tk, ma_phi, ma_bp, ma_vv, ps, ps_nt, lk, lk_nt, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + ' as ten_key, ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@strName)) + '2 as ten_key2 from #report3 order by xKey, sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2TransferReportExport]
	@period INT,
	@year INT,
	@code VARCHAR(4000),
	@dept VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @code <> '' THEN 'a.ma_dc in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@code, '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%,'' + rtrim(a.ma_dc) + '',%'', text) > 0)' END
	SELECT @key = @key + ' and a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@period) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@year) 
	IF @dept <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@dept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
			
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_dc, a.so_hieu_dc
			, a.ten_dc2 AS ten_dc, a.ten_dc2 AS ten_dc2
			, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bp2
			, b.ma_bp AS bp_max, b.ma_bp AS bp_min
		INTO #report
		FROM dmccdc a, dmbpcc b RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) c ON 1 = 0
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report' +
	' select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_dc, max(b.so_hieu_dc),' +
	CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'max(b.ten_dc)' ELSE '''''' END + ',' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'max(b.ten_dc2)' END +
	',' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'max(c.ten_bp)' ELSE '''''' END + ',' +  CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '''''' ELSE 'max(c.ten_bp2)' END +
	', max(a.ma_bp_dc), min(a.ma_bp_dc)' +
	' from ctcddc a with(nolock)' +
	' left join dmccdc b on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc' +
	' left join dmbpcc c on a.ma_bp_dc = c.ma_bp' +
	' where ' + @key +
	' group by a.ma_dc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET ten_bp = '', ten_bp2 = '' WHERE bp_max <> bp_min
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, ten_bp, ten_bp2) select 5, 1, 1, 0, '', '', ''
	--
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, so_hieu_dc, ten_dc, ten_dc2, ten_bp, ten_bp2 FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ma_dc

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

		UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS type, loai_nh, ma_nh, ten_nh, ten_nh2, status FROM dmnhdtqt2
		UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS type, loai_nh, ma_nh, ten_nh, ten_nh2, status FROM dmnhdtqt3

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CheckTSDecrease]
	@dDecrease SMALLDATETIME,
	@tsCode VARCHAR(32),
	@tsDept VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@cIDNumber VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@cVCNumber VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmccdc WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode) BEGIN
		SELECT '' AS ma_dvcs, 0 AS nguyen_gia_nt1, 0 AS nguyen_gia1, 0 AS gt_pb_ky_nt1, 0 AS gt_pb_ky1, '' AS ma_nt, '' AS ten_nt, 0 AS nguyen_gia_nt0, 0 AS nguyen_gia0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky_nt0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky0, 0 AS gt_cl_nt, 0 AS gt_cl, 0 AS so_luong, 0 AS t_nguyen_gia_nt, 0 AS t_nguyen_gia, 0 AS so_luong1
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @nYPrev INT, @nMPrev INT, @cKey VARCHAR(1024), @d SMALLDATETIME, @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32), @c CHAR(1)

	-- Do not select value from option
	SELECT @nRound = 12, @nFCRound = 12, @cKey = CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dDecrease, 112) + RTRIM(@cVCNumber) + RTRIM(@cIDNumber)
	SELECT @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmccdc WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_nt = @baseCurrency) SELECT @c = '1' ELSE SELECT @c = '0'

	IF @tsDept = '' BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.nguyen_gia_nt1, a.nguyen_gia1, a.gt_pb_ky_nt1, a.gt_pb_ky1, a.ma_nt, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_nt ELSE b.ten_nt2 END AS ten_nt,0 AS nguyen_gia_nt0, 0 AS nguyen_gia0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky_nt0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky0, 0 AS gt_cl_nt, 0 AS gt_cl, 0 AS so_luong, 0 AS t_nguyen_gia_nt, 0 AS t_nguyen_gia, 0 AS so_luong1
			FROM dmccdc a LEFT JOIN dmnt b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode
		RETURN
	END

	IF MONTH(@dDecrease) = 1 SELECT @nMPrev = 12, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dDecrease) - 1
	ELSE SELECT @nMPrev = MONTH(@dDecrease) - 1, @nYPrev = YEAR(@dDecrease)



	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_dvcs, b.nguyen_gia_nt1, b.nguyen_gia1, b.gt_pb_ky_nt1, b.gt_pb_ky1
		, a.ma_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_nt
		, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.nguyen_gia, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_cl
		, a.so_luong
	INTO #r FROM ctcddc a, dmccdc b



	-- Get data from ctcddc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT b.ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @c = '1' THEN 0 ELSE b.nguyen_gia_nt1 END, b.nguyen_gia1, CASE WHEN @c = '1' THEN 0 ELSE b.gt_pb_ky_nt1 END, b.gt_pb_ky1
			, a.ma_nt, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.ten_nt ELSE c.ten_nt2 END AS ten_nt
			, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.nguyen_gia
			, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_cl
			, a.so_luong
		FROM ctcddc a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc LEFT JOIN dmnt c ON a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt
		WHERE a.ky = @nMPrev AND a.nam = @nYPrev AND a.ma_dc = @tsCode AND a.ma_bp_dc = @tsDept


	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r) SELECT @d = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMPrev, @nYPrev)


	-- Get data from ctpsdc
	INSERT INTO #r
		SELECT MAX(b.ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs, CASE WHEN @c = '1' THEN 0 ELSE MAX(b.nguyen_gia_nt1) END, MAX(b.nguyen_gia1), CASE WHEN @c = '1' THEN 0 ELSE MAX(b.gt_pb_ky_nt1) END, MAX(b.gt_pb_ky1)
			, MAX(a.ma_nt) AS ma_nt, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_nt) ELSE MAX(c.ten_nt2) END AS ten_nt
			, SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt_n - a.nguyen_gia_nt_x), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_n - a.nguyen_gia_x)
			, SUM((a.nguyen_gia_nt_n - a.gt_da_pb_nt_n) - (a.nguyen_gia_nt_x - a.gt_da_pb_nt_x))
			, SUM((a.nguyen_gia_n - a.gt_da_pb_n) - (a.nguyen_gia_x - a.gt_da_pb_x))
			, SUM(a.sl_nhap - a.sl_xuat)
		FROM ctpsdc a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc LEFT JOIN dmnt c ON a.ma_nt = c.ma_nt
		WHERE a.ma_dc = @tsCode AND a.ma_bp_dc = @tsDept AND (@d IS NULL OR a.ngay_ct > @d) -- Optimize by string SQL
			AND a.stt_rec <> @cIDNumber
			AND CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec < @cKey

	-- Result
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #r) BEGIN
		SELECT MAX(a.ma_dvcs) AS ma_dvcs, MAX(a.nguyen_gia_nt1) AS nguyen_gia_nt1, MAX(a.nguyen_gia1) AS nguyen_gia1
			, CASE WHEN SUM(gt_cl_nt) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(a.gt_pb_ky_nt1) END AS gt_pb_ky_nt1,  CASE WHEN SUM(gt_cl) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(a.gt_pb_ky1) END AS gt_pb_ky1
			, MAX(a.ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(a.ten_nt) AS ten_nt
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0) / ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0), @nFCRound) END AS nguyen_gia_nt0
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(a.nguyen_gia), 0) / ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0), @nRound) END AS nguyen_gia0
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), 0) / ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0), @nFCRound) END AS gt_pb_ky_nt0
			, CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(a.gt_cl), 0) / ISNULL(SUM(a.so_luong), 0), @nRound) END AS gt_pb_ky0
			, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong
			, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS t_nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS t_nguyen_gia
			FROM #r a
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 a.ma_dvcs, a.nguyen_gia1, a.nguyen_gia_nt1, a.gt_pb_ky_nt1, a.gt_pb_ky1, a.ma_nt, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_nt ELSE b.ten_nt2 END AS ten_nt,
				0 AS nguyen_gia_nt0, 0 AS nguyen_gia0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky_nt0, 0 AS gt_pb_ky0,
				0 AS gt_cl_nt, 0 AS gt_cl, 0 AS so_luong,
				0 AS t_nguyen_gia_nt, 0 AS t_nguyen_gia
			FROM dmccdc a LEFT JOIN dmnt b ON a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt WHERE a.ma_dc = @tsCode
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrccdk]
AS
SELECT  a.*, e.ma_nv, e.ho_nv, e.ten_nv, RTRIM(e.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + e.ten_nv AS ho_ten, e.bo_phan AS bo_phan, e.vi_tri, e.bac_quan_ly, e.bp_ref, b.ten_cc, b.ten_cc2
	FROM hrccdk a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN hrcc b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_cc = b.ma_cc JOIN hrnv e WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = e.stt_rec

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Handle$VoucherNumber]
	@RandomKey CHAR(13) OUT,
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@GrandTable VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@PrimaryFields VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherNumber VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherNumberLength INT,
	@VoucherNumberType INT,
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherUnit VARCHAR(32),
	@ExtendKey VARCHAR(1024),
	@InsertGrandField VARCHAR(128),
	@InsertGrandValue VARCHAR(1024),
	@UpdateGrand VARCHAR(1024),
	@ExternalCheck TINYINT = 0,
	@ExternalValue VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@InternalCondition NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@ExternalMapCondition NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@ExternalCondition VARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@WithoutChecking BIT = 0,
	@LogGrandTable VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

	DECLARE @randomID CHAR(13), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @parentVoucher CHAR(3), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @internalKey NVARCHAR(1024), @ExternalMapJoin NVARCHAR(1024), @ExternalMapField NVARCHAR(1024), @allKey NVARCHAR(3000)
	SET @allKey = ''

	IF @WithoutChecking = 0 BEGIN
		DECLARE @lockStr NVARCHAR(64)
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_012' AND val = '1') SET @lockStr = ' serializable, updlock' ELSE SET @lockStr = ''

		CREATE TABLE #q (id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), q NVARCHAR(4000))

		SELECT @VoucherNumber = RIGHT(SPACE(@VoucherNumberLength) + RTRIM(@VoucherNumber), @VoucherNumberLength), @VoucherNumber =  REPLACE(@VoucherNumber, '''', ''''''), @key = '', @ExternalMapJoin = '', @ExternalMapField = '', @VoucherNumberType = ABS(@VoucherNumberType)

		SET @key = 'so_ct = ''' + @VoucherNumber + '''' + CASE WHEN @ExtendKey <> '' THEN ' and (' + @ExtendKey + ')' ELSE '' END +
			CASE WHEN @VoucherNumberType = 1 THEN ' and ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @VoucherDate, 112) + ''''
				 WHEN @VoucherNumberType = 2 THEN ' and month(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(MONTH(@VoucherDate), 2) + ' and year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				 WHEN @VoucherNumberType = 3 THEN ' and datepart(qq, ngay_ct) = ' + STR(DATEPART(qq, @VoucherDate), 2) + ' and year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				 WHEN @VoucherNumberType = 4 THEN ' and year(ngay_ct) = ' + STR(YEAR(@VoucherDate), 4)
				 ELSE ''
			END

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = 1) SET @key = @key + ' and status <> ''*'''

		SET @internalKey = CASE WHEN @IDNumber <> '' THEN @PrimaryFields + ' <> ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' and ' ELSE '' END + @key + CASE WHEN @InternalCondition <> '' THEN ' and (' + @InternalCondition + ')' ELSE '' END

		SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS c$, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS k INTO #t
		IF @ExternalCheck = 1 AND OBJECT_ID('dmct7') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @internalKey = @internalKey + ' and ' + REPLACE(k, '%s', @ExternalValue) FROM dmct7 WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
			SELECT @ExternalMapField = 'b.k', @ExternalMapJoin = 'join dmct7 b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @ExternalMapField = ''''''
		END

		INSERT INTO #q SELECT 'select top 1 1 from ' + @GrandTable + ' with(index(so_ct)' + CASE WHEN @lockStr <> '' THEN ',' + @lockStr ELSE '' END + ') where ' + @internalKey

		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.c$, ' + @ExternalMapField + ' from dmct9 a ' + @ExternalMapJoin + ' where a.ma_ct <> ''' + @VoucherCode + ''' and a.c$ <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @ExternalMapCondition <> '' THEN ' and (' + @ExternalMapCondition + ')' ELSE '' END
		IF @VoucherBook <> '' BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_ct in (select ma_ct from v20dmctnk where ma_nk = ''' + @VoucherBook + ''')'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @parentVoucher = ma_ct_me FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
			SET @q = @q + ' and a.ma_ct in (select ma_ct from dmct where ma_ct_me = ''' + @parentVoucher + ''')'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		INSERT INTO #q SELECT 'select top 1 1 from ' + c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @lockStr <> '' THEN ' with(' + @lockStr + ')' ELSE '' END + ' where ' + @key + CASE WHEN k <> '' THEN ' and ' + REPLACE(k, '%s', @ExternalValue) ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @ExternalCondition <> '' THEN ' and (' + @ExternalCondition + ')' ELSE '' END FROM #t
	
		SELECT @allKey = @allKey + CASE WHEN @allKey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END  + 'not exists(' + q + ')' FROM #q
	END

	IF @IDNumber = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @RandomKey = '', @randomID = STR(ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())), 13)
		SET @q ='insert into ' + @GrandTable + ' (stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_dvcs, status' + @InsertGrandField + ')' +
				' select ''' + @randomID + ''', ''' + @VoucherNumber + ''', ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @VoucherDate, 112) + ''', ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherUnit), '''', '''''') + ''', ''L''' + @InsertGrandValue +
				CASE WHEN @allKey <> '' THEN ' where ' + @allKey ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 SET @RandomKey = @randomID
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @RandomKey = '', @randomID = @IDNumber
		IF @LogGrandTable <> '' BEGIN
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#' + @LogGrandTable + '$log') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SET @q = 'insert into #' + @LogGrandTable + '$log select * from ' + @GrandTable + ' where ' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + '''' + CASE WHEN @allKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @allKey ELSE '' END
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		SET @q ='update ' + @GrandTable + ' set so_ct = ''' + @VoucherNumber + ''', ngay_ct = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @VoucherDate, 112) + '''' + @UpdateGrand + ' where ' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + '''' +
			CASE WHEN @allKey <> '' THEN ' and ' + @allKey ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 SET @RandomKey = @randomID
	END
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_APPostFullyPaid4Invoice]
	@cMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Round TINYINT
	CREATE TABLE #p(ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME, so_ct VARCHAR(32), dien_giai NVARCHAR(512), stt_rec_hd VARCHAR(32), line_nbr INT, ngay_hd SMALLDATETIME, so_hd VARCHAR(32), ma_nk VARCHAR(32), ma_vv VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), so_lsx VARCHAR(32), ma_hd VARCHAR(32), ma_ku VARCHAR(32), ma_phi VARCHAR(32))
	SELECT @s = '
insert into #p (ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, dien_giai, stt_rec_hd, line_nbr, ngay_hd, so_hd, ma_nk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi)
	select b.ngay_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.so_ct, b.dien_giai, a.stt_rec_hd, a.line_nbr, a.ngay_hd, a.so_hd, b.ma_nk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi
		from ' + @cDetailTable + ' a join ' + @cMasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where a.stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + '''
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE @dDate AS SMALLDATETIME, @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @IDLine INT
	DECLARE @cPaidAcct AS VARCHAR(33), @cPaidIDNumber CHAR(13), @cBC CHAR(3), @cFC CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @cNavPaidAcct VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #ap FROM wrkap
	SELECT * INTO #r FROM #gl

	SELECT @IDLine = 0
	SELECT @cPaidAcct = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tra_tt'
	SELECT @cNavPaidAcct = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_thu_tt'
	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT TOP 1 @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'

	DECLARE @dien_giai NVARCHAR(511), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @stt_rec_hd VARCHAR(32), @line_nbr INT, @ngay_hd SMALLDATETIME, @so_hd VARCHAR(32), @ma_nk VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @ma_vv VARCHAR(32), @ma_sp VARCHAR(32), @ma_bp VARCHAR(32), @so_lsx VARCHAR(32), @ma_hd VARCHAR(32), @ma_ku VARCHAR(32), @ma_phi VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, dien_giai, stt_rec_hd, line_nbr, ngay_hd, so_hd, ma_nk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi FROM #p ORDER BY line_nbr
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ngay_ct, @ngay_lct, @so_ct, @dien_giai, @stt_rec_hd, @line_nbr, @ngay_hd, @so_hd, @ma_nk, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @cPaidIDNumber = @stt_rec_hd, @cFC = ma_nt, @dDate = @ngay_ct, @nFCAmount = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @cBC THEN t_tt0 ELSE t_tt_nt0 END - t_tt_qd, @nAmount = t_tt0 - CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @cBC THEN t_tt_qd0 ELSE ROUND(t_tt_qd0 * ty_gia,@Round) END FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec_hd
		SELECT @nAmount = @nAmount - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt_cn, 0)) FROM cttt30 WHERE stt_rec_tt = @stt_rec_hd), 0)
		SELECT @nAmount = @nAmount + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(tien_cl_no) - SUM(tien_cl_co) FROM cttt31 WHERE stt_rec_hd = @stt_rec_hd AND nam * 12 + ky < YEAR(@ngay_ct) * 12 + MONTH(@ngay_ct)), 0)

		IF (@nAmount <> 0 OR @nFCAmount <> 0) BEGIN
			SELECT @IDLine = @IDLine + 1

			INSERT INTO #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
				, so_lo, ngay_lo, so_dh, ma_kh, ong_ba, dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk
				, tk, tk_du, ma_gd, ma_nk, ma_nt, ty_gia, nam, ky, line_nbr, status, ngay_ct0, so_ct0
				, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
				, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
			SELECT @cIDNumber, ma_dvcs, @cVC, @ngay_lct, @ngay_ct, @so_ct, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
				, '', NULL, '', ma_kh, '', @dien_giai, @dien_giai, REPLACE(STR(@line_nbr, 3), ' ', '0')
				, tk, @cPaidAcct, ma_gd, @ma_nk, ma_nt, ty_gia, nam, ky, @IDLine, '1', @ngay_hd, @so_hd
				, @nAmount, 0, @nFCAmount, 0
				, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			FROM cttt30
			WHERE stt_rec = @cPaidIDNumber

			DELETE #r
			INSERT INTO #r SELECT * FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine
			SELECT @IDLine = @IDLine + 1

			UPDATE #r SET tk = @cPaidAcct, tk_du = tk, line_nbr = @IDLine, ps_no = 0, ps_co = @nAmount, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = @nFCAmount
			INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r
			--
			IF @nAmount < 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cNavPaidAcct, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_no = 0, ps_co_nt = - @nFCAmount, ps_co = -@nAmount WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine - 1
				UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cNavPaidAcct, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_co = 0, ps_no_nt = - @nFCAmount, ps_no = -@nAmount WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine
			END

			INSERT INTO #ap (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec_tt
						, so_dh, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk, ma_gd, ma_nt, ty_gia
						, t_tt_nt, t_tt, t_tt_qd
						, tt_nt, tt, tt_cn, tt_qd, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co
						, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
						, tat_toan, loai_tt, nam, ky, status
						, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
				SELECT @cIDNumber, ma_dvcs, loai_ct, @cVC, @ngay_lct, @ngay_ct, @so_ct, @cPaidIDNumber
						, '', ma_kh, @dien_giai, tk, ma_gd, ma_nt, ty_gia
						, 0, 0, 0
						, @nFCAmount, @nAmount, @nAmount, @nFCAmount, ty_gia_dg, 0, 0
						, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
						, 0, 1, nam, ky, status
						, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
					FROM cttt30
					WHERE stt_rec = @cPaidIDNumber
		END

		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ngay_ct, @ngay_lct, @so_ct, @dien_giai, @stt_rec_hd, @line_nbr, @ngay_hd, @so_hd, @ma_nk, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr


	UPDATE #gl SET loai_ct = '', so_ctgs = '', ct_nxt = 0, sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0, gc_td1 = '', gc_td2 = '', gc_td3 = ''
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_nt = @cBC WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_nt = '', ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cBC

	-- Khai bao ma phi, bo phan cho tai khoan
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	--
	UPDATE #ap SET So_ct0 = CASE WHEN So_ct0 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE So_ct0 END,
			T_tien_nt = CASE WHEN T_tien_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tien_nt END,
			T_tien = CASE WHEN T_tien IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tien END,
			T_tien_nt0 = CASE WHEN T_tien_nt0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tien_nt0 END,
			T_tien0 = CASE WHEN T_tien0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tien0 END,
			T_thue_nt = CASE WHEN T_thue_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_thue_nt END,
			T_thue = CASE WHEN T_thue IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_thue END,
			T_cp_nt = CASE WHEN T_cp_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_cp_nt END,
			T_cp = CASE WHEN T_cp IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_cp END,
			T_nk_nt = CASE WHEN T_nk_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_nk_nt END,
			T_nk = CASE WHEN T_nk IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_nk END,
			T_tt_nt0 = CASE WHEN T_tt_nt0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tt_nt0 END,
			T_tt0 = CASE WHEN T_tt0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tt0 END,
			T_tt_nt1 = CASE WHEN T_tt_nt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tt_nt1 END,
			T_tt1 = CASE WHEN T_tt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tt1 END,
			T_tt_qd = CASE WHEN T_tt_qd IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE T_tt_qd END,
			t_tt_qd0 = CASE WHEN t_tt_qd0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_qd0 END,
			Tat_toan = CASE WHEN Tat_toan IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE Tat_toan END,
			Ma_tt = CASE WHEN Ma_tt IS NULL THEN '' ELSE Ma_tt END,
			Ma_nt = CASE WHEN Ma_nt = @cBC THEN '' ELSE Ma_nt END,
			Ty_gia = CASE WHEN Ma_nt = @cBC THEN 0 ELSE Ty_gia END

	UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = @cBC WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #ap SET ma_nt = '', tt_qd = tt WHERE ma_nt = @cBC
	UPDATE #ap SET ty_gia_dg = CASE WHEN @cBC = @cFC THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN tt_nt <> 0 THEN tt / tt_nt ELSE 0 END END
	UPDATE #ap SET ma_gd = '', loai_ct = 1, line_nbr = 1, status = 1, sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') AND @cFC = dbo.ff30_FC1() -- 2FCs
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #ap SET
				t_tien = t_tien_nt, t_tien_nt = t_tien,
				t_tien0 = t_tien_nt0, t_tien_nt0 = t_tien0,
				t_cp = t_cp_nt, t_cp_nt = t_cp,
				t_nk = t_nk_nt, t_nk_nt = t_nk,
				t_thue = t_thue_nt, t_thue_nt = t_thue,
				t_tt = t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt = t_tt,
				t_tt0 = t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt0,
				t_tt1 = t_tt_nt1, t_tt_nt1 = t_tt1,
				tt = tt_nt, tt_nt = tt
		END -- End 2FCs

	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	DELETE cttt30 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
	INSERT INTO cttt30 SELECT * FROM #ap

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
