CREATE FUNCTION ff_CharIndex(@cChar NVARCHAR(1), @sString NVARCHAR(1023))
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @i INT, @j INT
	SET @i = 0
	SET @j = 1
		WHILE @j <= LEN(@sString)
			BEGIN
				IF ASCII(SUBSTRING(@sString, @j, 1)) = ASCII(@cChar)
					BEGIN
						SET @i = @j
						BREAK
					END
				SET @j = @j + 1
			END
	RETURN @i
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PT]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_pn INTO #afterUpdate FROM d97$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_pn <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_pn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c96$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_pn = b.stt_rec

	DECLARE @cRCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineRCIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_pn VARCHAR(64)

	-- Update
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, stt_rec0pn, so_luong, he_so, dyn_pn FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @cLineRCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET sl_kt = sl_kt - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec =  ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @cLineRCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_pn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 

	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_pn, MAX(dyn_pn) AS dyn_pn FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_pn
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @dyn_pn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET xstatus = CASE WHEN sl_kt >= so_luong THEN ''2'' ELSE ''1'' END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND qc_yn = 1'
		SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m96$' + @dyn_pn + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cRCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cRCIDNumber, @dyn_pn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_UpdateAvgPriceDetail] @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strDetailTable VARCHAR(24), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16), @strMasterTable VARCHAR(24), @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @dDate SMALLDATETIME, 
		@ma_ct CHAR(3), @i TINYINT, @sDyn VARCHAR(8000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @isUsed2FCs INT, @currency VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @currency = '''' + REPLACE(dbo.ff30_FC1(), '''', '') + '''', @isUsed2FCs = 0, @sDyn = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') SELECT @isUsed2FCs = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SET @dDate = @dFrom
		WHILE @dDate <= @dTo SELECT @sDyn = @sDyn + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112) + ',', @dDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dDate)
		SELECT @sDyn = LEFT(@sDyn, LEN(@sDyn) - 1)
	END	

	IF @isUsed2FCs = 0
		SELECT @strSQL = 'update @cDetailTable set gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia = b.gia, tien_nt = b.tien_nt, tien = b.tien from @cDetailTable a join #wrkstkdetail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
	ELSE 
		SELECT @strSQL = 'update @cDetailTable set gia_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia else b.gia_nt end, ' +
			'gia =  case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia_nt else b.gia end, ' +
			' tien_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien else b.tien_nt end, ' +
			 'tien = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien_nt else b.tien end' +
			 'from @cDetailTable a join #wrkstkdetail b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 join @cMasterTable d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'

	SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #wrkstkdetail
	WHILE @ma_ct IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @strDetailTable = RTRIM(m_ctdbfs), @strMasterTable = RTRIM(m_phdbfs) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
		IF @strMasterTable <>'' BEGIN
			SELECT @i = 0
			WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@strDetailTable)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @i = @i + 1, 
						@cDetailTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strDetailTable, @i))), @cMasterTable = LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@strMasterTable, @i))), 
						@q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
		END

		IF @sDyn <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @strDetailTable = d$, @strMasterTable = m$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
			IF @strDetailTable <> '' AND @strMasterTable <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @i = 0
				WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@sDyn) BEGIN
					SELECT @i = @i + 1, 
						@cDetailTable = @strDetailTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i), @cMasterTable = @strMasterTable + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@sDyn, @i), 
						@q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@strSQL, '@cDetailTable', @cDetailTable), '@cMasterTable', @cMasterTable)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
		END
		--
		SELECT @ma_ct = MIN(ma_ct) FROM #wrkstkdetail WHERE ma_ct > @ma_ct
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_UnPostBIILClosed]
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM bic11$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'bim11$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'bid11$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'bii11$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'bia11$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM bia11$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''5'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update bic11$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE ma_phan_he = 'SM' AND name = 'd_001' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		DECLARE @voucherCode CHAR(3), @d SMALLDATETIME, @voucherType VARCHAR(32), @CurStatus VARCHAR(32), @Category VARCHAR(32), @unit VARCHAR(32)
		--
		CREATE TABLE #m(stt_rec CHAR(13), user_id INT)
		CREATE TABLE #ds(user_id INT NULL)

		SELECT @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 121), @voucherType = '01510'
		SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM dmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType
		--
		SET @q = 'select top 1 @CurStatus = u_status, @Category = kieu_duyet, @unit = ma_dvcs from ' + @MasterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@CurStatus varchar(32) output, @Category varchar(32) output, @unit varchar(32) output', @CurStatus OUTPUT, @Category OUTPUT, @unit OUTPUT

		--
		SET @q = 'insert into #ds select user_id4 from ' + @hisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Unit rights
		SELECT id INTO #user FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE status = 1 AND (admin = 1 OR (admin = 0 AND id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sysunitrights WHERE ma_dvcs = @unit AND r_edit = 1)))
		INSERT INTO #m SELECT @idNumber, a.user_id FROM (SELECT * FROM gndmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN gndmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN gndmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen
			WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND a.status = 1
				AND c.status = @CurStatus
				AND a.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM #ds)
				AND a.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM #user)
				AND c.kieu_duyet = @Category
		SET @q = 'exec ds_CreateVoucherPending @voucherCode, @idNumber, ''#m'', ''user_id'', @sysDatabaseName'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @idNumber varchar(32), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @voucherCode, @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesCalc]
	@PFrom NUMERIC(2), 
	@YFrom NUMERIC(4), 
	@PTo NUMERIC(2), 
	@YTo NUMERIC(4), 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @iPeriod INT, @iYear INT

	-- Key	
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Period table
	CREATE TABLE #tCalcPeriod(ky INT, nam INT)
	SET @i = @YFrom * 12 + @PFrom
	WHILE @i <= @YTo * 12 + @PTo BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #tCalcPeriod SELECT @PFrom, @YFrom
		IF @PFrom = 12 SELECT @PFrom = 1, @YFrom = @YFrom + 1
			ELSE SELECT @PFrom = @PFrom + 1
		SET @i = @YFrom * 12 + @PFrom 
	END

	DECLARE @sp_id INT
	SET @sp_id = @@spid
	--DELETE gltcptct9 WHERE sp_id = @sp_id

	DECLARE iCur CURSOR FOR SELECT ky, nam FROM #tCalcPeriod ORDER BY nam, ky
	OPEN iCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @iPeriod, @iYear
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		EXEC rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesCalcByPeriod @iPeriod, @iYear, @Unit, @UnitKey, @sp_id, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

		----Lưu vào bảng kỳ
		--SET @q = 'delete gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@iYear, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@iPeriod, 2), ' ', '0') + ' where dang_bc = 1' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
		
		--SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@iYear, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@iPeriod, 2), ' ', '0') 
		--SET @q = @q + '(ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt)'
		--SET @q = @q + ' select ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt from gltcptct9'
		--SET @q = @q + ' where dang_bc = 1 and sp_id = ' + RTRIM(@sp_id) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@iPeriod) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@iYear)
		--EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @iPeriod, @iYear
	END
	CLOSE iCur
	DEALLOCATE iCur

	--DELETE gltcptct9 WHERE sp_id = @sp_id
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryBySiteLocationLotItem]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 : Bao cao theo vat tu - lo , 2: Bao cao theo lo - vat tu
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : Nhom theo kho, vi tri , 2: Chi tiet theo kho, vi tri, 0: Khong xu lý
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @NoDefine = RTRIM(cName), @NoDefine2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nodefine'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap
		, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt2, 0 AS stt3, 0 AS stt4, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt
		, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, a.ma_vt AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt2, stt3, stt4, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SiteLocationItemLot @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, '', @Lot, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Lot <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Lot), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE lo_yn = 1)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ton_dau), sum(a.du_dau), sum(a.du_dau_nt), sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n), sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.dvt), max(b.loai_vt), max(b.nh_vt1), max(b.ten_vt), max(b.ten_vt2), a.ma_vt, max(b.ten_vt), max(b.ten_vt2)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0
		AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat =0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0

	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.loai_vt,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.loai_vt
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vt2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vt = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.nh_vt1,
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.nh_vt1
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, MAX(b.ten_lo) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_lo2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmlo b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt and a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 2, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_lo, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vi_tri2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvitri b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 1, 1, 0, a.ma_kho, N'' AS ma_vi_tri, '' AS ma_lo, MAX(b.ten_kho) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_kho2) AS ten2,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_kho

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024), @g VARCHAR(1024), @g1 VARCHAR(1024), @w VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo', @w = 'sysorder = 5'
	SELECT @g1 = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
		, @o = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g1, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 1
	CREATE TABLE #order1(ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order1 (ma_kho) select ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt2 = b.stt from #report a join #order1 b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 1

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 2
	CREATE TABLE #order2(ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order2 (ma_vi_tri, ma_kho) select ma_vi_tri, ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 2 or sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_kho into #group2 from #order2 group by ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt3 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order2 b on a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho join #group2 c on b.ma_kho = c.ma_kho where a.sysorder = 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 2

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 3
	CREATE TABLE #order3(ma_lo VARCHAR(32), ma_vi_tri VARCHAR(32), ma_kho VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order3 (ma_lo, ma_vi_tri, ma_kho) select ma_lo, ma_vi_tri, ma_kho from #report where sysorder = 3 or sysorder = 2 or sysorder = 1 order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri into #group3 from #order3 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt4 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order3 b on a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo and a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho join #group3 c on b.ma_kho = c.ma_kho and b.ma_vi_tri = c.ma_vi_tri where a.sysorder = 3'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 3

	--
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @s1 AS ten_vt, @s12 AS ten_vt2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
			SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
			SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #reporttt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal)
		VALUES (' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', 1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT '', ten_vt, ten_vt2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #reporttt

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten2 NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt NVARCHAR(16)

	UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, ten_vt), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, ten_vt2)

	DECLARE @ma VARCHAR(32)
	UPDATE #report SET @ma = CASE sysorder WHEN 1 THEN ma_kho WHEN 2 THEN ma_vi_tri WHEN 3 THEN ma_lo ELSE ma END,
		ma = @ma, ma_vt = CASE WHEN sysorder = 4 THEN '' ELSE ma_vt END,
		ten = SPACE(sysorder*2) + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 2 THEN @NoDefine ELSE ten END)),
		ten2 = SPACE(sysorder*2) + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 2 THEN @NoDefine2 ELSE ten2 END))

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sysorder, ' + @Order + ', stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString('ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ' + @Group  , 'sysorder, ' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdvhrnvold]
AS
SELECT stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_nv, ten_nv, RTRIM(a.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + LTRIM(a.ten_nv) AS ten, a.bo_phan AS ma_bo_phan, b.ten_bp AS bo_phan, b.ten_bp2 AS bo_phan2, a.bp_ref, c.ten_vtr AS vi_tri, c.ten_vtr2 AS vi_tri2, CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Nam' ELSE N'Nữ' END AS gioi_tinh, CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END AS gioi_tinh2, 
		gioi_tinh AS ma_gioi_tinh, a.stt, ngay_sinh, noi_sinh, cmnd_so, cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap AS ma_cmnd_noi_cap, d.ten_tinh AS cmnd_noi_cap, d.ten_tinh2 AS cmnd_noi_cap2, cmnd_ngay_hh, a.quoc_tich AS ma_quoc_tich, e.ten_qt AS quoc_tich, e.ten_qt2 AS quoc_tich2, 
		a.dan_toc AS ma_dan_toc, f.ten_dt AS dan_toc, f.ten_dt2 AS dan_toc2, a.ton_giao AS ma_ton_giao, g.ten_tg AS ton_giao, g.ten_tg2 AS ton_giao2, a.hon_nhan AS ma_hon_nhan, h.ten_tthn AS hon_nhan, h.ten_tthn2 AS hon_nhan2, dien_thoai_dd, email_cty,
		dia_chi_ht, dia_chi_ht_so, dia_chi_ht_phuong, q.ten_tinh AS dia_chi_ht_tinh, q.ten_tinh2 AS dia_chi_ht_tinh2, dia_chi_ht_tinh AS ma_dia_chi_ht_tinh, dia_chi_ht_quan AS ma_dia_chi_ht_quan, dia_chi_ht_xa AS ma_dia_chi_ht_xa, 
		r.ten_quan AS dia_chi_ht_quan, r.ten_quan2 AS dia_chi_ht_quan2, s.ten_phuong AS dia_chi_ht_xa, s.ten_phuong2 AS dia_chi_ht_xa2, dien_thoai_cty, dien_thoai_nha, email_ca_nhan, giam_ho, nguoi_than, dia_chi_th_tru, dia_chi_th_tru_so, 
		dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, i.ten_tinh AS dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, i.ten_tinh2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_tinh2, a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_quan, j.ten_quan AS dia_chi_th_tru_quan, j.ten_quan2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_quan2, 
		a.dia_chi_th_tru_xa AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_xa, k.ten_phuong AS dia_chi_th_tru_xa, k.ten_phuong2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_xa2, que_quan, que_quan_so, que_quan_phuong, a.que_quan_tinh AS ma_que_quan_tinh, l.ten_tinh AS que_quan_tinh, l.ten_tinh2 AS que_quan_tinh2, 
		a.que_quan_quan AS ma_que_quan_quan, m.ten_quan AS que_quan_quan, m.ten_quan2 AS que_quan_quan2, a.que_quan_xa AS ma_que_quan_xa, n.ten_phuong AS que_quan_xa, n.ten_phuong2 AS que_quan_xa2, ho_chieu_so, ho_chieu_ngay_hl, a.ho_chieu_noi_cap AS ma_ho_chieu_noi_cap, 
		o.ten_qt AS ho_chieu_noi_cap, o.ten_qt2 AS ho_chieu_noi_cap2, ho_chieu_ngay_hh, visa_so, visa_ngay_hl, visa_ngay_hh, a.visa_noi_cap AS ma_visa_noi_cap, p.ten_qt AS visa_noi_cap, p.ten_qt2 AS visa_noi_cap2, ngay_kham, chieu_cao, can_nang, mat_phai, mat_trai, nhom_mau, loai_sk, ghi_chu_sk, t.ten_ttnv, t.ten_ttnv2, a.status,
		a.vi_tri AS ma_vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.nv_ql, a.ma_tdhv, a.ma_nn, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_vao, a.user_id, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
	FROM hrnv AS a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
		LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh d ON a.cmnd_noi_cap = d.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN dmqt e ON a.quoc_tich = e.ma_qt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmdt f ON a.dan_toc = f.ma_dt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtg g ON a.ton_giao = g.ma_tg
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtthn h ON a.hon_nhan = h.ma_tthn
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh i ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = i.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmquan j ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan = j.ma_quan AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = j.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong k ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_xa = k.ma_phuong AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = j.ma_tinh AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan = j.ma_quan
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh l ON a.que_quan_tinh = l.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmquan m ON a.que_quan_quan = m.ma_quan AND a.que_quan_tinh = m.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong n ON a.que_quan_xa = n.ma_phuong AND a.que_quan_tinh = n.ma_tinh AND a.que_quan_quan = n.ma_quan
		LEFT JOIN dmqt o ON a.ho_chieu_noi_cap = o.ma_qt
		LEFT JOIN dmqt p ON a.visa_noi_cap = p.ma_qt
		LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh q ON a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = q.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmquan r ON a.dia_chi_ht_quan = r.ma_quan AND a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = r.ma_tinh
		LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong s ON a.dia_chi_ht_xa = s.ma_phuong AND a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = s.ma_tinh AND a.dia_chi_ht_quan = s.ma_quan
		LEFT JOIN hrdmttnv t ON a.tinh_trang_nv = t.ma_ttnv

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckListEditLogView]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@idFunction VARCHAR(32),
	@modify INT,
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32), @c VARCHAR(128), @prime$Type CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @f$Key VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Name VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Where VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log$Where VARCHAR(1024), @f$Select VARCHAR(1024), @f$Replace VARCHAR(1024)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS idLog, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field_type_log, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field_key_log, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field_type, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field_key, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS field_name
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS c1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS c2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS c3, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS c4, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS c5
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS f1, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS f2, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS f3, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS f4, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS f5
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(256)) AS k
		, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS [datetime0], CAST(NUll AS INT) AS user_id0, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS [datetime2], CAST(NUll AS INT) AS user_id2 INTO #k

	-- Field
	SELECT @prime$Root = xtable, @prime$Root$Log = RTRIM(xtable) + '$log', @prime$Type = xtype, @c = controller FROM dmlistlog WHERE id = @idFunction
	SELECT @f$Key = '', @f$Key$Name = '', @f$Key$Log = '', @f$Key$Where = '', @f$Select = '', @f$Replace = '', @f$Key$Log$Where = '', @dateTo = DATEADD(d, 1, @dateTo)
	IF @prime$Type IN ('1', '2', '3') BEGIN
		SELECT @f$Key = @f$Key + CASE WHEN @f$Key <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(column_name)
				, @f$Key$Name = @f$Key$Name + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Name <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '1' THEN CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_', RTRIM(column_name)) > 0 THEN REPLACE(RTRIM(column_name), 'ma_', 'ten_') ELSE 'ten_' + RTRIM(column_name) END + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END WHEN '3' THEN CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_', RTRIM(column_name)) > 0 THEN REPLACE(RTRIM(column_name), 'ma_', 'ten_') + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END ELSE '' END ELSE '''''' END
				, @f$Key$Log = @f$Key$Log + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ''
				, @f$Key$Where = @f$Key$Where + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%b.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ' = %a.' + RTRIM(column_name)
				, @f$Key$Log$Where = @f$Key$Log$Where + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log$Where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END+ '%b.' + CASE WHEN @prime$Type = '3' THEN CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('ma_', RTRIM(column_name)) > 0 THEN 'field_key_log' ELSE 'field_type_log' END ELSE 'field_key_log' END + ' = ' + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n ' ELSE '' END
			FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_name = @prime$Root ORDER BY ordinal_position

		IF @prime$Type = '3' SELECT @f$Select = '%a.idLog,%a.field_type_log,%a.field_key_log,%a.field_type,%a.field_key,%a.field_name,%a.datetime0,%a.user_id0,%a.datetime2,%a.user_id2', @f$Replace = 'field_type_log,field_key_log,field_type,field_key,field_name'
		ELSE SELECT @f$Select = '%a.idLog,%a.field_key_log,%a.field_key,%a.field_name,%a.datetime0,%a.user_id0,%a.datetime2,%a.user_id2', @f$Replace = 'field_key_log,field_key,field_name'

		--
		SELECT @key = '(a.[datetime2] between @dF and @dTo) and exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' b where ' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Where) + ')'
		IF ISNULL(@modify, 0) <> 0 SELECT @key = @key + ' and ((a.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + ') or exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' b where ' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Where) + ' and b.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + '))'
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #k(' + REPLACE(@f$Select, '%a.', '') + ') select ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Select, '%a.', ''), 'idLog,' + @f$Replace, '0,' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ',' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ',' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Name)) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@key, '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'b.') + '
insert into #k(' + REPLACE(@f$Select, '%a.', '') + ') select ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Select, '%a.', ''), @f$Replace, RTRIM(@f$Key$Log) + ',' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ',' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Name)) + ' from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' a where exists(select 1 from #k b where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Where), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'b.') + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dF smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime', @dateFrom, @dateTo

		SELECT @q = '
update #k set idlog = b.idlog + 1 from #k a left join (select max(idlog) as idlog,' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN 'field_type_log,' ELSE '' END + 'field_key_log from #k group by ' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN 'field_type_log,' ELSE '' END + 'field_key_log) b on ' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN 'a.field_type_log = b.field_type_log and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.field_key_log = b.field_key_log where a.idlog = 0
delete #k where idlog = 1
update #k set idlog = idlog - 1
update #k set ' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Log$Where, '%a.', 'b.'), '%b.', ''), '_log', ''), '_n ', ''), 'and', ',') ELSE 'field_key = b.' + RTRIM(@f$Key) END + ' from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' b on ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Where), '%a.', 'b.'), '%b.', 'a.') + ' and a.idLog = b.idLog'
		IF @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #k set field_name = b.' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Name) + ' from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' b on ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Log$Where, '%a.', 'b.'), '%b.', 'a.'), '_n ', '')
		ELSE SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #k set field_key_log = b.ma_nv, field_key = isnull(c.ma_nv, b.ma_nv), field_name = rtrim(b.ho_nv) + space(1) + rtrim(b.ten_nv) from #k a left join hrnv b on a.field_key_log = b.stt_rec left join hrnv$log c on a.field_key_log = c.stt_rec and a.idlog = c.idlog'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @f$Key = @f$Key + CASE WHEN @f$Key <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN c.name IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), ' + b.name + ', 103)' WHEN c.name IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(' + RTRIM(b.name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(' + RTRIM(b.name) + '))' END
				, @f$Key$Where = @f$Key$Where + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Where <> '' THEN ' + ' ELSE '''$'' + ' END + CASE WHEN c.name IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), %a.' + b.name + ', 103) + ''$'''	WHEN c.name IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(%a.' + RTRIM(b.name) + ' as nvarchar(4000)))) + ''$''' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(%a.' + RTRIM(b.name) + ')) + ''$''' END
				, @f$Select = @f$Select + CASE WHEN @f$Select <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'f' + RTRIM(a.ordinal_position)
				, @f$Replace = @f$Replace + CASE WHEN @f$Replace <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@$f, ' + RTRIM(a.ordinal_position + 1) + ', ''$'')'
				, @f$Key$Log$Where = @f$Key$Log$Where + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log$Where <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'f' + RTRIM(a.ordinal_position) + ' = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@$f, ' + RTRIM(a.ordinal_position + 1) + ', ''$'')'
			FROM information_schema.key_column_usage a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.table_name = OBJECT_NAME(b.id) AND a.column_name = b.name JOIN systypes c ON b.xtype = c.xtype AND b.xusertype = c.xusertype WHERE a.table_name = @prime$Root ORDER BY a.ordinal_position

		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @f$Key$Name = name from syscolumns where id = object_id(@prime$Root) and name like N''ten%'' and name not like N''%_ngan%'' and name ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'not' ELSE '' END + ' like N''%2'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@f$Key$Name varchar(1024) output, @prime$Root varchar(64)', @f$Key$Name OUTPUT, @prime$Root
		SELECT @key = '(a.[datetime2] between @dF and @dTo) and exists(select 1 from m$list$log b where b.c = @c and b.k_n = ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Where, '%a', 'a') + ')'
		IF ISNULL(@modify, 0) <> 0 SELECT @key = @key + ' and ((a.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + ') or exists(select 1 from m$list$log b where b.c = @c and b.k_n = ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Where, '%a', 'a') + ' and b.user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@modify) + '))'
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #k(idLog, field_name, ' + RTRIM(@f$Select) + ', ' + REPLACE(@f$Select, 'f', 'c') + ', k, datetime0, user_id0, datetime2, user_id2) select 0, ' + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Name = '' THEN '''''' ELSE RTRIM(@f$Key$Name) END + ', ' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ', ' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ', ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Where, '%a', 'a') + ', datetime0, user_id0, datetime2, user_id2 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@key, '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'b.') + '
insert into #k(idLog, field_name, ' + RTRIM(@f$Select) + ', ' + REPLACE(@f$Select, 'f', 'c') + ', k, datetime0, user_id0, datetime2, user_id2) select a.idLog, ' + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Name = '' THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Name) END + ', ' + REPLACE(@f$Replace, '@$f', 'a.k') + ', ' + RTRIM(@f$Key) + ', a.k_n, b.datetime0, b.user_id0, a.datetime2, a.user_id2 from m$list$log a join ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' b on a.k_n = ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Where, '%a', 'b') + ' where a.c = @c and exists(select 1 from #k b where b.k = a.k_n)'

		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @dF smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime', @c, @dateFrom, @dateTo

		SELECT @q = '
update #k set idlog = b.idlog + 1 from #k a left join (select max(idlog) as idlog, k from #k group by k) b on a.k = b.k where a.idlog = 0
delete #k where idlog = 1
update #k set idlog = idlog - 1
update #k set ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Log$Where, '@$f', 'b.k') + ' from #k a left join m$list$log b on a.k = b.k_n and a.idLog = b.idLog and b.c = @c
update #k set field_name = ' + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Name = '' THEN '''''' ELSE 'b.' + RTRIM(@f$Key$Name) END + ' from #k a left join ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' b on a.k = ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Where, '%a', 'b') + '
'

		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128)', @c
	END

	-- View
	SELECT @q = 'select a.idLog, a.field_key_log, a.field_key, a.field_name, a.%f, a.[datetime0], a.user_id0, a.[datetime2], a.user_id2, isnull(b.comment%l, '''') as comment0, isnull(c.comment%l, '''') as comment2, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, k from #k a left join vsysuserinfo b on a.[user_id0] = b.id left join vsysuserinfo c on a.[user_id2] = c.id order by a.%o, a.field_key_log, a.[datetime2], a.idlog'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END), 'a.%f, ', CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN 'a.field_type_log, a.field_type, ' ELSE ''''' as field_type_log, '''' as field_type, ' END), 'a.%o, ', CASE @prime$Type WHEN '3' THEN 'a.field_type_log, ' WHEN '4' THEN 'a.k, ' ELSE '' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@tmpTable VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@bilingual TINYINT, -- 1. Standard, 2. Bilingual
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@field NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @masterTable) IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @detailTable) IS NULL RETURN

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @site_yn TINYINT, @acc_yn TINYINT, @dept_yn TINYINT, @book_yn TINYINT
	DECLARE @dateSign SMALLDATETIME, @preparedBy INT

	SELECT @q = '', @s = '', @f = '', @site_yn = 0, @acc_yn = 0, @dept_yn = 0, @book_yn = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, d.ma_ttck, b.stt_rec0, d.para_name, b.para_value, c.ma_loai, c.muc_do, b.xu_ly, b.loai, e.updateClause AS u, e.fromClause AS f, e.joinClause AS j, e.whereClause AS w, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt INTO #dmttck FROM wrkin a, dmttckct b, dmttckloai c, dmttck d, dmttckloaixl e

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_bp' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @masterTable)) SELECT @dept_yn = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_bp' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @detailTable)) SELECT @dept_yn = 2
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_kho' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @detailTable)) SELECT @site_yn = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_kho' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @masterTable)) AND @voucherCode IN ('PNF','PNI','PXB','PXI') SELECT @site_yn = 2
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'tk' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @masterTable)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'tk' and id = OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(m$) + CASE WHEN RIGHT(m$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) SELECT @acc_yn = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ma_nk' AND id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @masterTable)) SELECT @book_yn = 1

	SELECT @q = '
insert into #dmttck (stt_rec, ma_ttck, stt_rec0, para_name, para_value, ma_loai, muc_do, xu_ly, loai, u, f, j, w)
	select d.stt_rec, s.ma_ttck, s.stt_rec0, i.para_name, s.para_value, s.ma_loai, s.muc_do, s.xu_ly, s.loai, s.u, s.f, s.j, s.w
	from ' + RTRIM(@detailTable) + ' d
		left join ' + RTRIM(@masterTable) + ' m on d.stt_rec = m.stt_rec'
			+ CASE @site_yn
				WHEN 1 THEN ' left join dmkho w on d.ma_kho = w.ma_kho'
				WHEN 2 THEN ' left join dmkho w on m.ma_kho = w.ma_kho'
			ELSE '' END + '
		left join (select distinct a.ma_ttck, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_loai
							, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'a.para_value' ELSE 'a.para_value2' END + ' as para_value
							, b.muc_do, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.nh_kho, a.ma_kho, a.ma_bp, a.tk, a.ma_nk, a.[user_id]
							, b.ma_dvcs as ma_dvcs_yn, b.ma_ct as ma_ct_yn, b.loai_ct as loai_ct_yn, b.nh_kho as nh_kho_yn, b.ma_kho as ma_kho_yn, b.ma_bp as ma_bp_yn, b.tk as tk_yn, b.ma_nk as ma_nk_yn, b.user_yn
							, a.xu_ly, a.loai, c.updateClause as u, c.fromClause as f, c.joinClause as j, c.whereClause as w
						from dmttckct a left join dmttckloai b on a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck and a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai left join dmttckloaixl c on a.xu_ly = c.xu_ly and a.loai = c.loai where a.[status] = ''1''
				) s on (m.ma_dvcs = s.ma_dvcs or s.ma_dvcs = '''') and (m.ma_ct = s.ma_ct or s.ma_ct = '''') and (m.loai_ct = s.loai_ct or s.loai_ct = '''')'
				+ CASE @acc_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.tk = s.tk or s.tk = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.tk = '''')' END
				+ CASE @book_yn WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.ma_nk = s.ma_nk or s.ma_nk = '''')' ELSE ' and (s.ma_nk = '''')' END
				+ CASE @dept_yn
						WHEN 1 THEN ' and (m.ma_bp = s.ma_bp or s.ma_bp = '''')'
						WHEN 2 THEN ' and (d.ma_bp = s.ma_bp or s.ma_bp = '''')'
					ELSE ' and (s.ma_bp = '''')' END
				+ CASE @site_yn
						WHEN 1 THEN ' and (w.ma_nh = s.nh_kho or s.nh_kho = '''') and (d.ma_kho = s.ma_kho or s.ma_kho = '''')'
						WHEN 2 THEN ' and (w.ma_nh = s.nh_kho or s.nh_kho = '''') and (m.ma_kho = s.ma_kho or s.ma_kho = '''')'
					ELSE ' and (s.nh_kho = '''') and (s.ma_kho = '''')' END
				+ '
		left join dmttck i on s.ma_ttck = i.ma_ttck
	where (s.ma_dvcs_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_ct_yn = ''1'' or s.loai_ct_yn = ''1'' or s.nh_kho_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_kho_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_bp_yn = ''1'' or s.tk_yn = ''1'' or s.ma_nk_yn = ''1'' or (s.user_yn = ''1'' and s.[user_id] = @userID))
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@userID int', @userID

	DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmttck b WHERE b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND b.[status] = '1')
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck) BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_ttck, MIN(muc_do) AS muc_do INTO #dmttcklvl FROM #dmttck GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_ttck
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttcklvl) DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttcklvl b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck AND b.muc_do <> a.muc_do)

		SELECT stt_rec, ma_ttck, para_value INTO #dmttck2 FROM #dmttck GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_ttck, para_value
		DELETE #dmttck FROM #dmttck a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck2 b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec AND b.ma_ttck = a.ma_ttck GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_ttck HAVING COUNT(para_value) > 1)

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'stt_rec, ma_ttck', 'muc_do, ma_loai, stt_rec0', '#dmttck', 'stt', ''
		DELETE #dmttck WHERE stt <> 1
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_creator' AND val NOT IN ('0', '3')) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck select m.stt_rec, s.ma_ttck, '''', s.para_name, '''', '''', 999, c.xu_ly, c.loai, c.updateClause, c.fromClause, c.joinClause, c.whereClause, 0 from ' + RTRIM(@masterTable) + ' m left join dmttck s on s.para_name = ''preparedByName'' left join dmttckloaixl c on c.xu_ly = ''1'' and loai = (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''r_show_creator'') where not exists(select 1 from #dmttck st where st.para_name = ''preparedByName'' and st.stt_rec = m.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_date_sign' AND val <> '0') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck select m.stt_rec, s.ma_ttck, '''', s.para_name, '''', '''', 999, c.xu_ly, c.loai, c.updateClause, c.fromClause, c.joinClause, c.whereClause, 0 from ' + RTRIM(@masterTable) + ' m left join dmttck s on s.para_name = ''reportDate'' left join dmttckloaixl c on c.xu_ly = ''2'' and loai = (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''r_show_date_sign'') where not exists(select 1 from #dmttck st where st.para_name = ''reportDate'' and st.stt_rec = m.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_show_contact' AND val <> '0') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #dmttck select m.stt_rec, s.ma_ttck, '''', s.para_name, '''', '''', 999, c.xu_ly, c.loai, c.updateClause, c.fromClause, c.joinClause, c.whereClause, 0 from ' + RTRIM(@masterTable) + ' m left join dmttck s on s.para_name = ''contactName'' left join dmttckloaixl c on c.xu_ly = ''3'' and loai = (select rtrim(val) from options where name = ''r_show_contact'') where not exists(select 1 from #dmttck st where st.para_name = ''contactName'' and st.stt_rec = m.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttck) BEGIN
		IF ((@voucherCode IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual = 2) OR (@voucherCode NOT IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual <> 0)) BEGIN
			UPDATE #dmttck SET para_value = b.para_value FROM #dmttck a LEFT JOIN dmttckct b ON  a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck AND a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
			INSERT INTO #dmttck
				SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ma_ttck, a.stt_rec0, a.para_name + '2', b.para_value2, a.ma_loai, a.muc_do, a.xu_ly, a.loai, a.u, a.f, a.j, a.w, a.stt
					FROM #dmttck a LEFT JOIN dmttckct b ON  a.ma_ttck = b.ma_ttck AND a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
			EXEC sp_executesql N'update #dmttck set para_name = ''biReportDate2'', u = replace(u, ''RPT118'', ''RPT119'') where para_name = ''reportDate'';delete #dmttck where para_name = ''reportDate2'''
		END
	END

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#signKey') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = ''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#signKey') AND name = 'ngay_ky') SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 @dateSign = ngay_ky from #signKey'
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#signKey') AND name = 'nguoi_lap') SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select top 1 @preparedBy = nguoi_lap from #signKey'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dateSign smalldatetime output, @preparedBy int output', @dateSign OUTPUT, @preparedBy OUTPUT

		IF @dateSign IS NOT NULL UPDATE #dmttck SET u = REPLACE(b.updateclause, 'getdate()', '@dateSign'), f = b.fromclause, j = b.joinclause, w = b.whereclause FROM #dmttck a LEFT JOIN dmttckloaixl b ON a.xu_ly = b.xu_ly WHERE a.ma_ttck = '95000' AND b.loai = '2'
		IF ((@voucherCode IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual = 2) OR (@voucherCode NOT IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual <> 0)) EXEC sp_executesql N'update #dmttck set u = replace(u, ''RPT118'', ''RPT119'') where para_name = ''biReportDate2'';'
		IF ISNULL(@preparedBy, 0) <> 0 UPDATE #dmttck SET u = b.updateclause, f = b.fromclause, j = REPLACE(b.joinclause, '@userID', '@preparedBy'), w = b.whereclause FROM #dmttck a LEFT JOIN dmttckloaixl b ON a.xu_ly = b.xu_ly WHERE a.ma_ttck = '90000' AND b.loai = '2'
	END
	UPDATE #dmttck SET u = REPLACE(u, 'ong_ba', 'contact_sign') , j = REPLACE(j, 'ong_ba', 'contact_sign') , w = REPLACE(w, 'ong_ba', 'contact_sign') WHERE xu_ly = '3' and loai = '1'

	SELECT *, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #dmttckloaixl FROM #dmttck WHERE xu_ly <> 0 ORDER BY stt
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #dmttckloaixl) BEGIN
		SELECT @i = 1, @nCount = COUNT(*) FROM #dmttckloaixl
		WHILE (@i <= @nCount) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update #dmttck set para_value = ' + RTRIM(u) + ' from ' + RTRIM(f) + ' ' + RTRIM(j) + ' where s.para_name = ''' + RTRIM(para_name) + ''' and s.stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(stt_rec) + '''' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(w) <> '' THEN ' and ' + RTRIM(w) ELSE '' END + '' FROM #dmttckloaixl WHERE id = @i AND u <> ''
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '$%m', @masterTable), '$%d', @detailTable), '$%s', '#dmttck'), '$%u', 'vsysuserinfo'), '%l', CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@userID int, @language char(1), @dateSign smalldatetime, @preparedBy int', @userID, @language, @dateSign, @preparedBy
			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END
	END

	SELECT para_name, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #para FROM dmttck WHERE para_name <> '' ORDER BY para_name
	IF ((@voucherCode IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual = 2) OR (@voucherCode NOT IN ('PT1', 'PC1', 'BN1', 'BC1') AND @bilingual <> 0)) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #para (para_name) SELECT para_name + '2' FROM dmttck ORDER BY para_name
		EXEC sp_executesql N'update #para set para_name = ''biReportDate2'' where para_name = ''reportDate'';delete #para where para_name = ''reportDate2'''
	END

	SELECT @i = 1, @nCount = MAX(id) FROM #para
	WHILE (@i <= @nCount) BEGIN
		SELECT @s = '', @q = ''
		SELECT @f = @f + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name))
				, @s = 'alter table ' + RTRIM(@detailTable) + ' add ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' nvarchar(128) null;' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@tmpTable) <> '' THEN 'alter table ' + RTRIM(@tmpTable) + ' add ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' nvarchar(128) null' ELSE '' END
				, @q = 'update ' + RTRIM(@detailTable) + ' set ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' = isnull(b.para_value, '''') from ' + RTRIM(@detailTable) + ' a left join #dmttck b on a.stt_rec ' + CASE WHEN @voucherCode <> 'PNG' THEN '= b.stt_rec' ELSE 'like left(b.stt_rec, 10) + ''%''' END + ' and b.para_name = ''' + RTRIM(para_name) + ''''
					+ CASE WHEN RTRIM(@tmpTable) <> '' THEN 'update ' + RTRIM(@tmpTable) + ' set ' + QUOTENAME(RTRIM(para_name)) + ' = isnull(b.para_value, '''') from ' + RTRIM(@tmpTable) + ' a left join #dmttck b on a.stt_rec ' + CASE WHEN @voucherCode <> 'PNG' THEN '= b.stt_rec' ELSE 'like left(b.stt_rec, 10) + ''%''' END + ' and b.para_name = ''' + RTRIM(para_name) + '''' ELSE '' END
			FROM #para WHERE id = @i
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT @field = @f

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFABook] --fs20_FABookReport--
	@Year NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType VARCHAR(33),
	@FaDept VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts + STR(nam*12 + ky, 6) AS xkey INTO #tmp FROM ctkhts

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = '1 = 1'
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key =	@Key + ' and b.ma_bp like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaDept, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @s = 'delete #tmp'
	SET @s = @s + ' insert into #tmp select a.so_the_ts + str(max(a.nam*12 + a.ky), 6)'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ctkhts a with(nolock) left join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @s = @s + ' where @Key group by a.so_the_ts'

	-- Nam nay
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', 'dbo.ff_BgYear(a.ky, a.nam) = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt
			, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
			, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl,  SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
			, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia
		INTO #curr
		FROM ctkhts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam*12 + ky, 6) IN (SELECT xkey FROM #tmp)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	-- Nam truoc
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Key', 'dbo.ff_BgYear(a.ky, a.nam) = ' + RTRIM(@Year - 1) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' + @Key END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia
		INTO #prev
		FROM ctkhts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam*12 + ky, 6) IN (SELECT xkey FROM #tmp)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts
			, b.ngay_mua, b.so_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.nuoc_sx, b.ngay_dvsd, b.so_hieu_ts
			, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, CAST(ROUND(b.so_ky_kh / 12, 2) AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tl_kh, a.nguyen_gia * 0 AS muc_kh, a.nguyen_gia_nt * 0 AS muc_kh_nt
			, c.gt_da_kh AS kh_dk, c.gt_da_kh_nt AS kh_dk_nt
			, ISNULL(a.gt_da_kh, 0) - ISNULL(c.gt_da_kh, 0) AS kh_ck, ISNULL(a.gt_da_kh_nt, 0) - ISNULL(c.gt_da_kh_nt, 0) AS kh_ck_nt
			, a.gt_da_kh AS kh_lk, a.gt_da_kh_nt AS kh_lk_nt
			, b.ngay_giam, b.so_ct_giam, b.ly_do_giam, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt
			, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			--, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ts ELSE '' END AS ten_ts, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_ts2 ELSE '' END AS ten_ts2
			, ten_ts, ten_ts2 -- song ngữ
		INTO #report
		FROM #curr a LEFT JOIN dmts b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts LEFT JOIN #prev c ON a.so_the_ts = c.so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_giam = NULL, so_ct_giam = '', ly_do_giam = '' WHERE YEAR(ngay_giam) <> @Year

	DECLARE @nRound INT, @nRound_nt INT
	SELECT @nRound = val FROM options WHERE name LIKE 'm_round_tien'
	SELECT @nRound_nt = val FROM options WHERE name LIKE 'm_round_tien_nt'
	UPDATE #report SET muc_kh = CASE WHEN tl_kh <> 0 THEN ROUND(nguyen_gia / tl_kh,@nRound) ELSE 0 END, muc_kh_nt = CASE WHEN tl_kh <> 0 THEN ROUND(nguyen_gia_nt / tl_kh, @nRound_nt) ELSE 0 END

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'so_the_ts, stt', '#, INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, kh_dk,kh_dk_nt, kh_ck, kh_ck_nt, kh_lk, kh_lk_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, muc_kh, muc_kh_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE systotal=1) UPDATE #report SET sysprint = 1 WHERE sysorder = '-8'

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_mua, so_the_ts, ten_ts, ten_ts2, nuoc_sx,'
	SET @q = @q + ' ngay_dvsd, so_hieu_ts, nguyen_gia_nt, tl_kh, muc_kh_nt, kh_dk_nt, kh_ck_nt, kh_lk_nt, gt_cl_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, kh_dk, muc_kh, kh_ck,'
	SET @q = @q + ' kh_lk, gt_cl, so_ct_giam, ngay_giam, ly_do_giam, ngay_ct, so_ct from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptAMProgress]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryType VARCHAR(32),
	@DeptCategoryCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @step INT, @Filter NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT
	DECLARE @HRM040 NVARCHAR(1024), @HRM041 NVARCHAR(1024), @HRM042 NVARCHAR(1024), @HRM043 NVARCHAR(1024), @HRM044 NVARCHAR(1024), @markRound INT

	--
	SELECT @HRM040 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM040'
	SELECT @HRM041 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM041'
	SELECT @HRM042 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM042'
	SELECT @HRM043 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM043'
	SELECT @HRM044 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM044'
	SELECT @markRound = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_diem'

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Key = '', @Join = '', @step = 0
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'd', 'd', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	SET @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.', 'd.')
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'd.')	

	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SELECT @Filter = @Key

	IF @Employee <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' d.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt, b.stt_rec_nv, d.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ho_ten_nv, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, b.ngay_dg, b.status, a.diem_nv_dg AS tong_dg, a.diem_nv_dg AS nv_dg, a.diem_ql_dg AS ql_dg
		INTO #report FROM hrdgthct a, hrdgth b, hrnv d RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) e ON 1 = 0
	
	-- Lấy số liệu từ cập nhật đánh giá thực hiện công viêc
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 0, max(b.stt_rec_nv), max(d.ma_nv), rtrim(max(d.ho_nv)) + space(1) + max(d.ten_nv), max(d.bo_phan), max(d.vi_tri), max(b.ngay_dg), max(b.status), count(1)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(case when diem_nv_dg > 0 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when diem_ql_dg > 0 then 1 else 0 end)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrdgthct a with(nolock) left join hrdgth b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join hrnv d on b.stt_rec_nv = d.stt_rec' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.readonly_yn = 0 and b.ma_ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and b.nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update tỷ lệ
	UPDATE #report SET nv_dg = CASE WHEN tong_dg = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((nv_dg/tong_dg)*100, @markRound) END, ql_dg = CASE WHEN tong_dg = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((ql_dg/tong_dg)*100, @markRound) END

	-- Lấy thông tin bộ phận, vị trí, bậc của nhân viên theo quá trình làm việc
	UPDATE #report SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, vi_tri = b.vi_tri
		FROM #report a JOIN hreqtlvht b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.stt_rec_nv = b.stt_rec AND b.tinh_chat = '1'
			AND b.ngay_tu = (SELECT MAX(c.ngay_tu) FROM hreqtlvht c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE c.stt_rec = a.stt_rec_nv AND c.ngay_tu <= a.ngay_dg)

	-- Lấy số liệu có trong khai báo chỉ tiêu đánh giá
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 0, a.stt_rec_nv, max(d.ma_nv), rtrim(max(d.ho_nv)) + space(1) + max(d.ten_nv), max(d.bo_phan), max(d.vi_tri), null, null, 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrkbctdg a with(nolock) left join hrnv d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec_nv = d.stt_rec' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam * 100 + a.ky <= ' + RTRIM(@Year * 100 + @Period) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' and d.ngay_nghi is null and a.stt_rec_nv not in (select stt_rec_nv from #report)'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- DeptCategory
	DECLARE @c CHAR(1), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c = CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN '' ELSE '#' END
	IF @DeptCategoryType <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @DeptKey = REPLACE(@Filter, 'd.', 'b.')
		EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategory @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, '#report', 'bo_phan'
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, bp_me, bp_ref, stt_ref, bac_bp, ten_bp, ten_bp2 INTO #hrbp FROM hrbp
		INSERT INTO #hrbp EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DepartmentCategoryData @DeptCategoryType, @DeptCategoryCode, @DeptKey, 'ma_pn, pn_me, pn_ref, stt_ref, bac_pn, ten_pn, ten_pn2'
	END

	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, bo_phan, ma_nv INTO #o FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr ORDER BY b.stt_ref, c.stt, a.vi_tri, a.ma_nv
	SELECT MIN(id) AS id, bo_phan INTO #g FROM #o GROUP BY bo_phan
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.id - c.id + 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan AND a.ma_nv = b.ma_nv JOIN #g c ON a.bo_phan = c.bo_phan

	-- Insert Derpartment Parent
	SELECT TOP 0 a.bo_phan, b.bp_me, b.bac_bp, 0 AS tong_nv, 0 AS nv_dg, 0 AS ql_dg INTO #r FROM #report a, hrbp b
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select a.bo_phan, max(b.bp_me) as bp_me, max(b.bac_bp) as bac_bp, count(1), sum(nv_dg), sum(ql_dg) from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp group by a.bo_phan'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #r
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	WHILE @step > 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #r select distinct d.ma_bp, d.bp_me, d.bac_bp, 0, 0, 0 from #r r join ' + @c + 'hrbp d on r.bp_me = d.ma_bp'
		SET @q = @q + ' where r.bac_bp = ' + RTRIM(@step) + ' and r.bp_me not in (select bo_phan from #r)' + CASE WHEN @DeptCategoryType = '' THEN CASE WHEN @Filter <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Filter ELSE '' END ELSE '' END 
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #r SET tong_nv = a.tong_nv + b.tong_nv, nv_dg = a.nv_dg + b.nv_dg, ql_dg = a.ql_dg + b.ql_dg
			FROM #r a JOIN (SELECT bp_me, SUM(tong_nv) AS tong_nv, SUM(nv_dg) AS nv_dg, SUM(ql_dg) AS ql_dg FROM #r WHERE bac_bp = @step GROUP BY bp_me) b ON a.bo_phan = b.bp_me

		SET @step = @step - 1
	END
	--
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', '', bo_phan, '', NULL, NULL, 0, CASE WHEN tong_nv <> 0 THEN ROUND(nv_dg/tong_nv, @markRound) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN tong_nv <> 0 THEN ROUND(ql_dg/tong_nv, @markRound) ELSE 0 END FROM #r

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report SELECT 0, '', '', '', '', '', NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0

	-- View
	SELECT @q = 'select @x = min(b.bac_bp) from #report a join ' + @c + 'hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp where bo_phan <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x int out', @x = @step OUT
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	--
	SELECT @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.stt, a.stt_rec_nv, a.ma_nv, a.ho_ten_nv, nv_dg, ql_dg, b.stt_ref as bp_ref'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', space(2 * (b.bac_bp - ' + RTRIM(@step) + ')) + ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END + ' AS ten_bp'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vtr' ELSE 'c.ten_vtr2' END + ' AS ten_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', case a.status when 0 then N''' + @HRM040 + ''' when 1 then N''' + @HRM041 + ''' when 2 then N''' + @HRM042 + ''' when 3 then N''' + @HRM043 + ''' else N''' + @HRM044 + ''' end as hoan_thanh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join ' + @c + 'hrbp b with(nolock) on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c with(nolock) on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by b.stt_ref, a.stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UpdateDetailStatementOfCost]
	@DateReport SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form VARCHAR(33),
	@RPCode CHAR(2),
	@Value NVARCHAR(4000)
AS  
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF LEN(@Value) > 3000 RETURN
	DECLARE @i1 INT, @i2 INT, @j INT, @k1 INT, @k2 INT, @valueTemp NVARCHAR(4000), @part NVARCHAR(256), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Code CHAR(16), @DateValue SMALLDATETIME
		
	SELECT @q = '', @Key = '', @Code = ''
	SET @Key = 'dreport = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + ''' and ma_bc = ''' + REPLACE(@RPCode, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_sp = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_bp = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @ManufacturingOrder <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_lsx = ''' + dbo.xf20_GetMO(REPLACE(RTRIM(@ManufacturingOrder), '''', '''''')) + ''''
	IF @Form <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and form = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Form), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_dvcs = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	print @key
	SELECT @i1 = 1, @i2 = CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @Value,  @i1)
	WHILE @i2 > @i1 BEGIN
		SELECT @valueTemp = SUBSTRING(@Value, @i1, @i2 - @i1)

		SELECT @k1 = 1, @k2 = CHARINDEX(CHAR(254), @valueTemp,  @k1), @j = 0		
		WHILE @k2 > @k1 BEGIN
			SELECT @part = SUBSTRING(@valueTemp, @k1, @k2 - @k1)
			IF(@j = 0) BEGIN
				SET @Code = @part
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'if not exists (select top 1 1 from xcobct0 where ' + @Key + ' and ma_so =  ''' + REPLACE(@Code, '''', '''''') + ''' and cot = ''' + LTRIM(@j) + ''')'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into xcobct0(dreport, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_dvcs, ma_bc, form, ma_so, cot, so, chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' values (''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateReport, 112) + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@Product, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@Department, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@ManufacturingOrder, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' 
				SET @q = @q + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@RPCode, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@Form, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + REPLACE(@Code, '''', '''''') + ''', ''' + LTRIM(@j) + ''''
				SET @q = @q + ', 0, '''', ''1'',''' + CONVERT (CHAR, GETDATE(), 109) + ''',''' + CONVERT (CHAR, GETDATE(), 109) + ''', 0, 0)'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update xcobct0 set' + CASE WHEN @j <> 8 THEN ' so = ' + CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(@part) <> 1 THEN '0' ELSE @part END ELSE ' chu = N''' + REPLACE(@part, '''', '''''') + '''' END + ' where ' + @Key + ' and ma_so =  ''' + REPLACE(@Code, '''', '''''') + ''' and cot = ''' + LTRIM(@j) + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			SET @j = @j + 1
			SELECT @k1 = @k2 + 1, @k2 = CHARINDEX(CHAR(254), @valueTemp,  @k2 + 1)
		END
		SELECT @i1 = @i2 + 1, @i2 = CHARINDEX(CHAR(255), @Value,  @i2 + 1)
	END
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$Different$Month](@d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME)
RETURNS NUMERIC(20, 6) AS
BEGIN 
	IF @d1 IS NULL OR @d2 IS NULL RETURN NULL	
	DECLARE @n INT, @r DECIMAL(20, 6), @d SMALLDATETIME, @t DECIMAL(20, 6), @g INT, @l INT
	SELECT @g = 1
	IF (@d2 < @d1) SELECT @g = -1, @d = @d1, @d1 = @d2, @d2 = @d

	SELECT @n = DATEDIFF(month, @d1, @d2), @d = DATEADD(month, @n, @d1)
	IF @d2 = @d SELECT @r = @n
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @d > @d2 SELECT @n = @n - 1, @d = DATEADD(month, -1, @d)
		SELECT @t = DAY(DATEADD(month, 1, CAST(STR(YEAR(@d2), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@d2), 2), ' ', '0') + '01' AS SMALLDATETIME)) - 1), @l = DATEDIFF(day, @d, @d2)
		SELECT @r = @l/@t + @n
	END

	RETURN @g * @r
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTransactionListBySalesEmployees]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32), 
	@Account VARCHAR(1024), 
	@DebitCredit CHAR(1),
	@AccountRef VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployee VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR (32),
	@ForeignCurrency VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesEmployeeColumn VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ngay_ct, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, tk, tk_du, line_nbr, ma_kh, so_ct, so_ct0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_nvbh, nh_dk
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	IF ISNULL(@SalesEmployeeColumn, '') = '' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
		SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, '' AS ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, '' AS ten_kh, '' AS ten_kh2, dien_giai, tk, tk_du, '' AS ma_nvbh, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co FROM #report
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' <> '''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @DebitCredit = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_no <> 0' 
	IF @DebitCredit = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_co <> 0' 
	IF @AccountRef <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @AccountRef)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ForeignCurrency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ForeignCurrency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SalesEmployee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SalesEmployee), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.dien_giai, a.' + @SalesEmployeeColumn + ', nh_dk'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 0 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 0 AS systotal, a.ma_nvbh, MAX(ISNULL(b.ten_nvbh, '')) AS ten_nvbh, MAX(ISNULL(b.ten_nvbh2, '')) AS ten_nvbh2,
			SUM(a.ps_no) AS ps_no, SUM(a.ps_co) AS ps_co, SUM(a.ps_no_nt) AS ps_no_nt, SUM(a.ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt
		INTO #tSum FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnvbh b ON a.ma_nvbh = b.ma_nvbh
		GROUP BY a.ma_nvbh

	SET @q = 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nvbh, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nvbh'
	SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_nvbh' ELSE 'ten_nvbh2' END + ') + '' - '' + rtrim(ma_nvbh)'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt from #tSum'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_nvbh) select 1, 0, 0, ma_nvbh from #tSum '
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh,
