			ISNULL(b.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh, ISNULL(b.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh2, a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.ma_nvbh,
			a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(pk_dmkh)) ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmct c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
		ORDER BY a.ma_nvbh, sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, a.so_ct, stt_rec, nh_dk, ps_co, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ARPostFullyPaid4Invoice]
	@cMasterTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cDetailTable VARCHAR(16),
	@cIDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Round TINYINT
	CREATE TABLE #p(ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME, so_ct VARCHAR(32), dien_giai NVARCHAR(512), stt_rec_hd VARCHAR(32), line_nbr INT, ngay_hd SMALLDATETIME, so_hd VARCHAR(32), ma_nk VARCHAR(32), ma_vv VARCHAR(32), ma_sp VARCHAR(32), ma_bp VARCHAR(32), so_lsx VARCHAR(32), ma_hd VARCHAR(32), ma_ku VARCHAR(32), ma_phi VARCHAR(32))
	SELECT @s = '
insert into #p (ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, dien_giai, stt_rec_hd, line_nbr, ngay_hd, so_hd, ma_nk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi)
	select b.ngay_ct, b.ngay_lct, b.so_ct, b.dien_giai, a.stt_rec_hd, a.line_nbr, a.ngay_hd, a.so_hd, b.ma_nk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi
		from ' + @cDetailTable + ' a join ' + @cMasterTable + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where a.stt_rec = ''' + @cIDNumber + '''
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE @dDate AS SMALLDATETIME, @nAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @nFCAmount NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @IDLine INT
	DECLARE @cPaidAcct AS VARCHAR(33), @cPaidIDNumber CHAR(13), @cBC CHAR(3), @cFC CHAR(3)
	DECLARE @cNavPaidAcct VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT * INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #ar FROM wrkar
	SELECT * INTO #r FROM #gl

	SELECT @IDLine = 0
	SELECT @cPaidAcct = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_thu_tt'
	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @cNavPaidAcct = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_tk_tra_tt'
	SELECT TOP 1 @Round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tien'

	DECLARE @dien_giai NVARCHAR(511), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ngay_lct SMALLDATETIME, @so_ct VARCHAR(32), @stt_rec_hd VARCHAR(32), @line_nbr INT, @ngay_hd SMALLDATETIME, @so_hd VARCHAR(32), @ma_nk VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @ma_vv VARCHAR(32), @ma_sp VARCHAR(32), @ma_bp VARCHAR(32), @so_lsx VARCHAR(32), @ma_hd VARCHAR(32), @ma_ku VARCHAR(32), @ma_phi VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, dien_giai, stt_rec_hd, line_nbr, ngay_hd, so_hd, ma_nk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi FROM #p ORDER BY line_nbr
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ngay_ct, @ngay_lct, @so_ct, @dien_giai, @stt_rec_hd, @line_nbr, @ngay_hd, @so_hd, @ma_nk, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @cPaidIDNumber = @stt_rec_hd, @cFC = ma_nt, @dDate = @ngay_ct, @nFCAmount = CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @cBC THEN t_tt0 ELSE t_tt_nt0 END - t_tt_qd, @nAmount = t_tt0 - CASE WHEN ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @cBC THEN t_tt_qd0 ELSE ROUND(t_tt_qd0 * ty_gia,@Round) END FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec_hd
		SELECT @nAmount = @nAmount - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ISNULL(tt_cn, 0)) FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec_tt = @stt_rec_hd), 0)
		SELECT @nAmount = @nAmount + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(tien_cl_co) - SUM(tien_cl_no) FROM cttt21 WHERE stt_rec_hd = @stt_rec_hd AND nam * 12 + ky < YEAR(@ngay_ct) * 12 + MONTH(@ngay_ct)), 0)

		IF (@nAmount <> 0 OR @nFCAmount <> 0) BEGIN
			SELECT @IDLine = @IDLine + 1

			INSERT INTO #gl (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_lct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
				, so_lo, ngay_lo, so_dh, ma_kh, ong_ba, dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk
				, tk, tk_du, ma_gd, ma_nk, ma_nt, ty_gia, nam, ky, line_nbr, status, ngay_ct0, so_ct0
				, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
				, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
			SELECT @cIDNumber, ma_dvcs, @cVC, @ngay_lct, @ngay_ct, @so_ct, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
				, '', NULL, '', ma_kh, '', @dien_giai, @dien_giai, REPLACE(STR(@line_nbr, 3), ' ', '0')
				, @cPaidAcct, tk, ma_gd, @ma_nk, ma_nt, ty_gia, nam, ky, @IDLine, '1', @ngay_hd, @so_hd
				, @nAmount, 0, @nFCAmount, 0
				, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
			FROM cttt20
			WHERE stt_rec = @cPaidIDNumber

			--
			DELETE #r
			INSERT INTO #r SELECT * FROM #gl WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine
			SELECT @IDLine = @IDLine + 1

			UPDATE #r SET tk = tk_du, line_nbr = @IDLine, ps_no = 0, ps_co = @nAmount, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = @nFCAmount
			UPDATE #r SET tk_du = @cPaidAcct
			INSERT INTO #gl SELECT * FROM #r
			--
			IF @nAmount < 0 BEGIN
				UPDATE #gl SET tk = @cNavPaidAcct, ps_no_nt = 0, ps_no = 0, ps_co_nt = - @nFCAmount, ps_co = -@nAmount WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine - 1
				UPDATE #gl SET tk_du = @cNavPaidAcct, ps_co_nt = 0, ps_co = 0, ps_no_nt = - @nFCAmount, ps_no = -@nAmount WHERE line_nbr = @IDLine
			END

			INSERT INTO #ar (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec_tt
						, so_dh, ma_kh, dien_giai, tk, ma_gd, ma_nt, ty_gia
						, t_tt_nt, t_tt, t_tt_qd
						, tt_nt, tt, tt_cn, tt_qd, ty_gia_dg, tien_cl_no, tien_cl_co
						, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
						, tat_toan, loai_tt, nam, ky, status
						, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)
				SELECT @cIDNumber, ma_dvcs, loai_ct, @cVC, @dDate, @so_ct, @cPaidIDNumber
						, '', ma_kh, @dien_giai, tk, ma_gd, ma_nt, ty_gia
						, 0, 0, 0
						, @nFCAmount, @nAmount, @nAmount, @nFCAmount, ty_gia_dg, 0, 0
						, so_lsx, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3
						, 0, 1, nam, ky, status
						, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @nUserID, @nUserID, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9
					FROM cttt20
					WHERE stt_rec = @cPaidIDNumber
		END
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @ngay_ct, @ngay_lct, @so_ct, @dien_giai, @stt_rec_hd, @line_nbr, @ngay_hd, @so_hd, @ma_nk, @ma_vv, @ma_sp, @ma_bp, @so_lsx, @ma_hd, @ma_ku, @ma_phi
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	UPDATE #gl SET loai_ct = '', so_ctgs = '', ct_nxt = 0, sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0, gc_td1 = '', gc_td2 = '', gc_td3 = ''
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_nt = @cBC WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_nt = '', ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0 WHERE ma_nt = @cBC

	-- Khai bao ma phi, bo phan cho tai khoan
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
	UPDATE #gl SET ma_bp = CASE WHEN b.ma_bp <> '' AND a.ma_bp = '' THEN b.ma_bp ELSE a.ma_bp END, ma_phi = CASE WHEN b.ma_phi <> '' AND a.ma_phi = '' THEN b.ma_phi ELSE a.ma_phi END FROM #gl a JOIN dmpdtk b ON a.tk_du = b.tk

	UPDATE #ar SET t_tien_nt2 = CASE WHEN t_tien_nt2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tien_nt2 END,
			t_tien2 = CASE WHEN t_tien2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tien2 END,
			t_thue_nt = CASE WHEN t_thue_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_thue_nt END,
			t_thue = CASE WHEN t_thue IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_thue END,
			t_ck_nt = CASE WHEN t_ck_nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_ck_nt END,
			t_ck = CASE WHEN t_ck IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_ck END,
			t_tt_nt0 = CASE WHEN t_tt_nt0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_nt0 END,
			t_tt0 = CASE WHEN t_tt0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt0 END,
			t_tt_nt1 = CASE WHEN t_tt_nt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_nt1 END,
			t_tt1 = CASE WHEN t_tt1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt1 END,
			t_tt_qd = CASE WHEN t_tt_qd IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_qd END,
			t_tt_qd0 = CASE WHEN t_tt_qd0 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t_tt_qd0 END,
			tat_toan = CASE WHEN tat_toan IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE tat_toan END,
			ma_tt = CASE WHEN ma_tt IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ma_tt END,
			ma_nt = CASE WHEN ma_nt = @cBC THEN '' ELSE ma_nt END,
			ty_gia = CASE WHEN ma_nt = @cBC THEN 0 ELSE ty_gia END,
			so_seri = '', ma_nvbh = ''

	UPDATE #ar SET ma_nt = @cBC WHERE ma_nt = ''
	UPDATE #ar SET ma_nt = '', tt_qd = tt WHERE ma_nt = @cBC
	UPDATE #ar SET ty_gia_dg = CASE WHEN @cBC = @cFC THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN tt_nt <> 0 THEN tt / tt_nt ELSE 0 END END
	UPDATE #ar SET ma_gd = '', loai_ct = 1, line_nbr = 1, status = 1, sl_td1 = 0, sl_td2 = 0, sl_td3 = 0

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') AND @cFC = dbo.ff30_FC1() -- 2FCs
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #ar SET
				t_tien2 = t_tien_nt2, t_tien_nt2 = t_tien2,
				t_thue = t_thue_nt, t_thue_nt = t_thue,
				t_ck = t_ck_nt, t_ck_nt = t_ck,
				t_tt = t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt = t_tt,
				t_tt0 = t_tt_nt0, t_tt_nt0 = t_tt0,
				t_tt1 = t_tt_nt1, t_tt_nt1 = t_tt1,
				tt = tt_nt, tt_nt = tt
		END -- End 2FCs

	DELETE ct00 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
	INSERT INTO ct00 SELECT * FROM #gl

	DELETE cttt20 WHERE stt_rec = @cIDNumber
	INSERT INTO cttt20 SELECT * FROM #ar
	-- END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterPaymentInvoice]
	@TableNameBefore VARCHAR(33),
	@TableNameAfter VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	SELECT @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', ''), @TableNameBefore = REPLACE(@TableNameBefore, '''', ''), @TableNameAfter = REPLACE(@TableNameAfter, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TableVoucher VARCHAR(33), @m VARCHAR(32), @v BIT
	
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetTableName @VoucherCode, @m OUTPUT, @TableVoucher OUTPUT

	-- Update status for none payment invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p1 (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #stt1 (stt_rec CHAR(13))
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt1 select [key] from ' + @TableNameBefore + ' a where not exists(select 1 from ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.[key] = b.[key])'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt1) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p1 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from #stt1 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set trang_thai_tt = ''0'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate()'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join #stt1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1 WHERE p > @p
		END
	END

	-- Update status for payment invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p2 (p VARCHAR(6))
	
	--
	SELECT @q = 'select @vOut = case when exists(select 1 from ' + @TableNameAfter + ') then 1 else 0 end'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@vOut bit output', @vOut = @v OUTPUT

	IF @v = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p2 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p
			SELECT @q = @q + ' set trang_thai_tt = case when b.gach_no_yn = 1 then ''2'' else ''0'' end, user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime0 = getdate(), datetime2 = getdate()'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2 WHERE p > @p
		END
	END

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$S1]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(64),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @rq TINYINT
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec AS stt_rec_yc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px
		, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_lsx, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_cd, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(16)) AS ma_vt
		, t_so_luong INTO #beforeUpdate FROM ms1$000000

	SELECT @rq = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'

	SELECT @s = '
insert into #beforeUpdate
	select a.stt_rec, b.stt_rec, rtrim(year(b.ngay_ct)) + replace(str(month(b.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) + replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, b.ma_sp, 0
		from ' + @MasterTable + ' a left join cs2$000000 b on a.ma_lsx = b.ma_lsx where a.stt_rec = @IDNumber
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32)', @IDNumber

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	DECLARE @cS2IDNumber CHAR(13), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @wo VARCHAR(64), @operation VARCHAR(64), @itemCode VARCHAR(64), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @dyn_px = dyn_px FROM #beforeUpdate
	IF @dyn_px <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @s = '
update a
	set t_so_luong = isnull(b.t_so_luong, 0)
from #beforeUpdate a
	left join (
			select stt_rec, ma_vt, sum(sl_nhap) as t_so_luong from sfctpx$' + @dyn_px + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and nxt = ''1'' and ma_ct = ''SF1'' group by stt_rec, ma_vt
				) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32)', @IDNumber
	END

	-- Update
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, dyn_yc, ma_lsx, ma_cd, ma_vt, t_so_luong FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS2IDNumber, @dyn_yc, @wo, @operation, @itemCode, @nQty
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cS2IDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @nQty = ISNULL(@nQty, 0)
			IF @nQty <> 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @s = 'update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set sl_th = case when sl_th = 0 then sl_th else sl_th - @nQty end where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @nQty numeric(28, 6)', @cS2IDNumber, @nQty

				SELECT @s = '
if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th > 0 and sl_th < sl_yc)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''3'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th > 0 and sl_th >= sl_yc)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''4'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th <= 0)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @UserID int', @cS2IDNumber, @UserID
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @s = '
if exists (select 1 from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber)
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')
'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32), @cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @UserID int', @IDNumber, @cS2IDNumber, @UserID
			END
			IF @Action = 'Delete' BEGIN
				SELECT @s = '
if not exists(select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th >= 0) or not exists(select 1 from cs1$000000 where stt_rec <> @IDNumber and ma_lsx = @wo) begin
	update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')
end else begin
	if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th > 0 and sl_th < sl_yc)
		update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''3'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
	if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th > 0 and sl_th >= sl_yc)
		update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''4'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
	if exists (select 1 from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber and sl_th <= 0)
		update ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> ''5'' and stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
end'
				EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@IDNumber varchar(32), @cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @wo varchar(64), @UserID int', @IDNumber, @cS2IDNumber, @wo, @UserID
			END

			SELECT @s = '
declare @S2Status char(1)
select @S2Status = status from ms2$' + @dyn_yc + ' where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
update cs2$000000 set status = @S2Status where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
update is2$' + @dyn_yc + ' set status = @S2Status where stt_rec = @cS2IDNumber
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s, N'@cS2IDNumber varchar(32), @UserID int', @cS2IDNumber, @UserID
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cS2IDNumber, @dyn_yc, @wo, @operation, @itemCode, @nQty
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[xf20_GetGatherFields](@Unit VARCHAR(33), @FactorCode VARCHAR(33))
RETURNS VARCHAR(128) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @cRet VARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @cRet = 'ma_yt'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode)
		SELECT @cRet = @cRet + CASE WHEN th_sp = 1 THEN + ', ma_sp' ELSE '' END
					+ CASE WHEN th_bp = 1 THEN + ', ma_bp' ELSE '' END
					+ CASE WHEN th_bp0 = 1 THEN + ', ma_bp0' ELSE '' END
					+ CASE WHEN th_lsx = 1 THEN + ', so_lsx' ELSE '' END
					+ CASE WHEN th_nvl = 1 THEN + ', ma_vt' ELSE '' END
			FROM xdmyt WHERE ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_yt = @FactorCode
	RETURN @cRet
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostTRClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT	
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @MasterTable = 'hrdtyc'
	SET @DetailTable = 'hrdtctyc'
	SET @InquiryTable = 'hridtyc'
	SET @HisTable = 'hradtyc'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM hradtyc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC
	
	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	--
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''3'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$System$CheckImportSiteRights]
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@Field VARCHAR(32),
	@NumberField VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Return INT OUTPUT, 
	@Key VARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@errorMode TINYINT = 0,
	@$errorCount INT = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Return = NULL

	IF @Admin = 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @UserID) RETURN

	IF @errorMode = 1 BEGIN
		SET ROWCOUNT @$errorCount;
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #errorTable(field, row, message) select ''' + @Field + ''', stt, ''00002'' from ' + @Table + ' a where ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE @Key + ' and ' END + 'not exists (select 1 from syssiterights b where b.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and a.' + RTRIM(@Field) + ' = b.ma_kho)'
			+ ' and not exists(select 1 from #errorTable e where e.field = ''' + @Field + ''' and e.row = stt and e.message = ''00002'')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @$errorCount = @$errorCount - @@rowcount; SET ROWCOUNT 0; IF @$errorCount = 0 RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @stt = min(' + RTRIM(@NumberField) + ') from ' + RTRIM(@Table) + ' a' + 
			' where ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE @Key + ' and ' END + 'not exists (select 1 from syssiterights b where b.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' and a.' + RTRIM(@Field) + ' = b.ma_kho)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt int output', @Return OUTPUT
	END

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Report$ConvertFormula]
	@formulaTable VARCHAR(128),
	@resultTable VARCHAR(128),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@formulaGroup VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@formulaOrder VARCHAR(128) = 'id',
	@formulaField VARCHAR(128) = 'ky_nay, ky_nay_nt',
	@formulaStr NVARCHAR(4000) = 'update a set $%formula from $%table a $%join where a.ma_so = ''$%ma_so''',
	@debug TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @formulaTable = REPLACE(REPLACE(@formulaTable, '''', ''), ' ', ''), @resultTable = REPLACE(REPLACE(@resultTable, '''', ''), ' ', '')
		, @formulaGroup = REPLACE(REPLACE(@formulaGroup, '''', ''), ' ', ''), @formulaField = REPLACE(REPLACE(@formulaField, '''', ''), ' ', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(512), @j VARCHAR(8000), @code VARCHAR(128), @k NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @i INT, @n INT, @r INT, @m INT

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @formulaTable) AND name = 'q') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'alter table ' + @formulaTable + ' add q nvarchar(4000) null'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT @c = 'left join $%table $%b on '
	IF @formulaGroup <> '' SELECT @c = @c + 'a.' + RTRIM(data) + ' = $%b.' + RTRIM(data) + ' and ' FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@formulaGroup, ',')

	SELECT id, RTRIM(data) AS f INTO #$f FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@formulaField, ',')

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_so, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS alias INTO #$t

	SELECT @m = COUNT(*) FROM #$f
	SELECT @q = 'select @n = count(*) from ' + RTRIM(@formulaTable)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@n int output', @n OUTPUT

	SELECT @i = 1, @r = 1
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #$t select ''$%g'', ''['' + left(data, charindex('']'', data) - 1) + '']'', char(97 + (min(id)%26)) + rtrim(min(id)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(''$%f'', ''['') where charindex('']'', data) > 0 group by data'
	WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
		SELECT @r = 1, @k = '', @j = ''

		SELECT @q = 'select @code = rtrim(ma_so), @f = rtrim(cach_tinh) from ' + RTRIM(@formulaTable) + ' where ' + @formulaOrder + ' = @i '
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@code varchar(128) output, @f nvarchar(4000) output, @i int', @code OUTPUT, @f OUTPUT, @i
		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '$%g', @code), '$%f', @f)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @f = REPLACE(@f, ma_so, 'isnull(' + alias + '.$%f, 0)'), @j = ISNULL(@j, '') + REPLACE(@c, '$%b', alias) + alias + '.ma_so = ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(ma_so, '[', ''), ']', '') + ''' ' FROM #$t WHERE gr = @code
		WHILE @r <= @m BEGIN
			SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + f + ' = ' + REPLACE(@f, '$%f', f) FROM #$f WHERE id = @r
			SELECT @r = @r + 1
		END

		IF @debug = 1 SELECT @q = 'update a set q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(replace(replace(replace(replace(@f, ''$%formula'', @k), ''$%join'', @j), ''$%table'', @t), ''$%ma_so'', @code)) from ' + RTRIM(@formulaTable) + ' a where a.ma_so = @code'
		ELSE SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@formulaStr, '$%formula', @k), '$%join', @j), '$%table', @resultTable), '$%ma_so', @code))
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@f nvarchar(4000), @k nvarchar(4000), @t nvarchar(128), @j nvarchar(4000), @code varchar(128)', @formulaStr, @k, @resultTable, @j, @code

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	--
	IF @debug = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select * from ' + @formulaTable + ' order by ' + @formulaOrder
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesGeneralCalc]
	@PFrom NUMERIC(2),
	@YFrom NUMERIC(4),
	@PTo NUMERIC(2),
	@YTo NUMERIC(4),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Nested BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	DECLARE @iPeriod INT, @iYear INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT

	-- Period table
	CREATE TABLE #tCalcPeriod(ky INT, nam INT)
	SET @i = @YFrom * 12 + @PFrom
	WHILE @i <= @YTo * 12 + @PTo BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #tCalcPeriod SELECT @PFrom, @YFrom
		IF @PFrom = 12 SELECT @PFrom = 1, @YFrom = @YFrom + 1
			ELSE SELECT @PFrom = @PFrom + 1
		SET @i = @YFrom * 12 + @PFrom 
	END

	DECLARE @sp_id INT
	SET @sp_id = @@spid
	--DELETE gltcptct9 WHERE sp_id = @sp_id

	DECLARE iCur CURSOR FOR SELECT ky, nam FROM #tCalcPeriod ORDER BY nam, ky
	OPEN iCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @iPeriod, @iYear
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		EXEC rs_rptCalculateValueOfFinancialArticlesGeneralCalcByPeriod @iPeriod, @iYear, @sp_id, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @Nested
		
		----Lưu vào bảng kỳ
		--SET @q = 'delete gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@iYear, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@iPeriod, 2), ' ', '0') + ' where dang_bc = 2'
		
		--SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into gltcptct$' + REPLACE(STR(@iYear, 4), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(@iPeriod, 2), ' ', '0') 
		--SET @q = @q + '(ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt)'
		--SET @q = @q + ' select ma_so, dang_bc, ma_dvcs, tien, tien_nt from gltcptct9'
		--SET @q = @q + ' where dang_bc = 2 and sp_id = ' + RTRIM(@sp_id) + ' and ky = ' + RTRIM(@iPeriod) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@iYear)
		--EXEC sp_executesql @q

		FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @iPeriod, @iYear
	END
	CLOSE iCur
	DEALLOCATE iCur

	--DELETE gltcptct9 WHERE sp_id = @sp_id
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostTS2Tran] @idNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRound TINYINT, @nFCRound TINYINT, @ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @ma_nt CHAR(3), @status CHAR(1), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(32)

	-- Do not select value from option
	SELECT @nRound = 12, @nFCRound = 12
	SELECT @ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @ma_nt = ma_nt, @status = status FROM dmccdc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @baseCurrency = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	UPDATE dmdcct SET nguyen_gia1 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(nguyen_gia / so_luong, @nRound) END
		, nguyen_gia_nt1 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(nguyen_gia_nt / so_luong, @nFCRound) END
		, gt_pb_ky1 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt_pb_ky / so_luong, @nRound) END
		, gt_pb_ky_nt1 = CASE WHEN so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt_pb_ky_nt / so_luong, @nFCRound) END
		WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber

	SELECT @idNumber AS stt_rec, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong INTO #dmdcctsl FROM dmdcct WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT TOP 1 stt_rec, nguyen_gia1, nguyen_gia_nt1 INTO #dmdcct FROM dmdcct WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	UPDATE dmccdc SET nguyen_gia1 = b.nguyen_gia1, nguyen_gia_nt1 = b.nguyen_gia_nt1
			, gt_pb_ky1 = CASE WHEN c.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.t_gt_pb_ky / c.so_luong, @nRound) END
			, gt_pb_ky_nt1 = CASE WHEN c.so_luong = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(a.t_gt_pb_ky / c.so_luong, @nRound) END
		FROM dmccdc a LEFT JOIN #dmdcct b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec LEFT JOIN #dmdcctsl c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec = @idNumber

	DELETE ctpsdc WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	INSERT INTO ctpsdc (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_dc
			, ma_ld_tg, tk_dc, tk_pb, tk_cp, loai_ps, ma_nt, ma_bp_dc
			, sl_nhap, sl_xuat
			, nguyen_gia_n, nguyen_gia_nt_n, nguyen_gia_x, nguyen_gia_nt_x
			, gt_da_pb_n, gt_da_pb_nt_n, gt_da_pb_x, gt_da_pb_nt_x
			, gt_cl_n, gt_cl_nt_n, gt_cl_x, gt_cl_nt_x
			, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @idNumber, @ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, b.ngay_tang, a.so_ct, a.ma_dc
				, b.ma_ld_tang, b.tk_dc, b.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, 0, @ma_nt, a.ma_bp_dc
				, a.so_luong, 0
				, a.nguyen_gia, CASE WHEN b.ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE a.nguyen_gia_nt END, 0, 0
				, a.gt_da_pb, CASE WHEN b.ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE a.gt_da_pb_nt END, 0, 0
				, a.gt_cl, CASE WHEN b.ma_nt = @baseCurrency THEN 0 ELSE a.gt_cl_nt END, 0, 0
				, @status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
			FROM dmdcct a LEFT JOIN dmccdc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE b.stt_rec = @idNumber
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIILTran] ---[rs_PrintMRTran]----
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@DetailKey VARCHAR(32),
	@Table VARCHAR(32),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Bilingual TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	--IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SELECT @cE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Bilingual, 0) = 0 THEN '2' ELSE '' END

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.ma_kho, a.ma_lo, b.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt, b.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @DetailKey + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'',''ngay_yc, so_luong'', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAccountSummaryByObjects] --fs20_TransAcctsSummary--
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(33), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy AS VARCHAR(33), 
	@Account VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Type VARCHAR(1), 
	@AccountRef VARCHAR(1024),
	@AccountNonDeduction VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(33), 
	@VC VARCHAR(1024), 
	@FC VARCHAR(1024),
	@Decription NVARCHAR(1024),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@VCs VARCHAR(1024), 
	@FCs VARCHAR(1024),
	@Job VARCHAR(33),
	@Contract VARCHAR(33),
	@Fee VARCHAR(33),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@MONumber VARCHAR(33),
	@Product VARCHAR(33),
	@BContract NVARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @groupTable VARCHAR(64), @groupField VARCHAR(64), @groupFieldName VARCHAR(64)

	-- Khai báo động nhóm theo...
	CREATE TABLE #t (xtype VARCHAR(64), xfield VARCHAR(64), xtable2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2 VARCHAR(64), xfield2_name VARCHAR(64))
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '0', 'tk_du', 'dmtk', 'tk', 'ten_tk'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '1', 'tk', 'dmtk', 'tk', 'ten_tk'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '2', 'ma_kh', 'dmkh', 'ma_kh', 'ten_kh'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '3', 'ma_vv', 'dmvv', 'ma_vv', 'ten_vv'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '4', 'ma_sp', 'dmvt', 'ma_vt', 'ten_vt'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '5', 'ma_bp', 'dmbp', 'ma_bp', 'ten_bp'
	INSERT INTO #t SElECT '6', 'ma_dvcs', 'dmdvcs', 'ma_dvcs', 'ten_dvcs'
	--
	SELECT @GroupBy = xfield, @groupTable = xtable2, @groupField = xfield2, @groupFieldName = xfield2_name FROM #t WHERE xtype = @GroupBy

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #temp FROM wrkgl

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and isnull(a.' + @GroupBy + ', '''') <> ''''', @Join = ''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @AccountRef <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @AccountRef)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VC <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VC), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FC <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FC), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FCs <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and dbo.ff_inlist(a.ma_nt, ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FCs), '''', '''''') + ''') = 1'
	IF @Decription <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.dien_giai like N''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Decription), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Fee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Fee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @MONumber <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_lsx like ''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@MONumber), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Product <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_sp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Product), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @BContract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@BContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VCs <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and dbo.ff_inlist(b.ma_ct_in, ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VCs), '''', '''''') + ''') = 1', @Join = ' left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
		
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select ' + @GroupBy + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by ' + @GroupBy
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Giảm trừ
	IF @AccountNonDeduction <> '' BEGIN
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'notinlist', @AccountNonDeduction)
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
		
		SET @q = 'insert into #temp select ' + @GroupBy + ', sum(-ps_co), sum(-ps_co_nt), sum(-ps_no), sum(-ps_no_nt)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by ' + @GroupBy
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Bảng dữ liệu chính
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #report FROM #temp
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, a.ma, max(b.' + @groupFieldName + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + '), sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #temp a left join ' + @groupTable + ' b on a.ma = b.' + @groupField
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Insert tổng cộng
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt) SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_co_nt) FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten) SELECT 1, 0, 0, ''

	IF @Type = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ps_no + ps_no_nt = 0
	IF @Type = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ps_co + ps_co_nt = 0
	IF @Type = '*' DELETE #report WHERE ps_no + ps_no_nt = 0 AND ps_co + ps_co_nt = 0

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma, ten, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END AS ps, CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END AS ps_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY ma, sysorder

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON	
END

GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryByItemLotSiteLocation]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 : Bao cao theo vat tu - lo , 2: Bao cao theo lo - vat tu
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : Nhom theo kho, vi tri , 2: Chi tiet theo kho, vi tri, 0: Khong xu lý
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @NoDefine = RTRIM(cName), @NoDefine2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nodefine'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap
		, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt2, 0 AS stt3, 0 AS stt4, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt
		, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, c.ten_vi_tri, c.ten_vi_tri2, a.ma_vt AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b, dmvitri c
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt2, stt3, stt4, ten_vi_tri, ten_vi_tri2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--  Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SiteLocationItemLot @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, '', @Lot, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Lot <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Lot), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE lo_yn = 1)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ton_dau), sum(a.du_dau), sum(a.du_dau_nt), sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n), sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.dvt), max(b.loai_vt), max(b.nh_vt1), max(c.ten_vi_tri), max(c.ten_vi_tri2), a.ma_vi_tri, max(c.ten_vi_tri), max(c.ten_vi_tri2)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmvitri c with(nolock) on a.ma_vi_tri = c.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vi_tri', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0
		AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat =0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0

	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vi_tri = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri), ten_vi_tri2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 1,1,0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2), a.ma_vt, '', '',
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.loai_vt
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vi_tri = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri), ten_vi_tri2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 1,1,0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2), a.ma_vt, '', '',
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.nh_vt1
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_kho) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_kho2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.ma_kho

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, '' AS ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_lo) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_lo2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmlo b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 2, 1, 0, a.ma_vt,N'' AS ma_lo, '' AS ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_vt) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vt2) AS ten2,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	--Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024), @g VARCHAR(1024), @g1 VARCHAR(1024), @w VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_vt, ' + @Order + ', ma_kho', @w = 'sysorder > 1 and systotal = 1'
	SELECT @g1 = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
		, @o = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g1, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', @w

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 2
	CREATE TABLE #order1(ma_vt VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order1 (ma_vt) select ma_vt from #report where sysorder = 1 order by ma_vt, ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt2 = b.stt from #report a join #order1 b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where a.sysorder = 2'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 2

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 3
	CREATE TABLE #order2(ma_lo VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order2 (ma_lo, ma_vt) select ma_lo, ma_vt from #report where sysorder = 3 or sysorder = 2 order by ma_vt, ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_vt into #group2 from #order2 group by ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt3 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order2 b on a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt join #group2 c on b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt where a.sysorder = 3'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 3

	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 1 WHERE sysorder = 4
	CREATE TABLE #order3(ma_kho VARCHAR(32), ma_lo VARCHAR(32), ma_vt VARCHAR(32), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	SET @q = 'insert into #order3 (ma_kho, ma_lo, ma_vt) select ma_kho, ma_lo, ma_vt from #report where sysorder = 4 or sysorder = 3 or sysorder = 2 order by ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select min(stt) as stt, ma_vt, ma_lo into #group3 from #order3 group by ma_vt, ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #report set stt4 = b.stt - c.stt from #report a join #order3 b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo and a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt join #group3 c on b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt and b.ma_lo = c.ma_lo where a.sysorder = 4'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE  #report SET systotal = 0 WHERE sysorder = 4

	--
	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'
	SELECT @s1 AS ten_vi_tri, @s12 AS ten_vi_tri2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
			SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
			SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
		INTO #reporttt FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vi_tri, ten_vi_tri2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal)
		VALUES (' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', 1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (ma_vt, ten_vi_tri, ten_vi_tri2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT '', ten_vi_tri, ten_vi_tri2, '', '', '', 0, 0, 0, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #reporttt

	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten2 NVARCHAR(512)
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN stt NVARCHAR(16)

	UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, ten_vi_tri), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, ten_vi_tri2)

	DECLARE @ma VARCHAR(32)
	UPDATE #report SET @ma = CASE sysorder WHEN 2 THEN ma_vt WHEN 3 THEN ma_lo WHEN 4 THEN ma_kho ELSE ma END, ma = @ma,
		ten = CASE WHEN sysorder <> 1 THEN SPACE(sysorder * 2) ELSE '' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 5 THEN @NoDefine ELSE ten END)),
		ten2 = CASE WHEN sysorder <> 1 THEN SPACE(sysorder * 2) ELSE '' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN @ma = '' AND sysorder = 5 THEN @NoDefine2 ELSE ten2 END))

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--
	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, sysorder, ma_vi_tri, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString('ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, sysorder, ' + @Group, 'ma_vi_tri') + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_FIFOUpdatePrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@UpdateType TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @tables VARCHAR(24), @tableMasters VARCHAR(24), @detailTable VARCHAR(16), @masterTable VARCHAR(16), @i INT, @n TINYINT, 
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @m NVARCHAR(4000), @dynTable VARCHAR(64), @dyn VARCHAR(8000), @d SMALLDATETIME, @currency VARCHAR(32)

	-- Set
	SELECT @currency = '''' + REPLACE(dbo.ff30_FC1(), '''', '') + '''', @dyn = ''



	-- GL
	IF @UpdateType <> 0 BEGIN
		CREATE INDEX i ON #ps00(stt_rec, line_nbr)
		UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no = b.ps_no, ps_co = b.ps_co, ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt
			FROM ct00 a JOIN #ps00 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr
		SELECT @d = @dFrom
		WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @dynTable = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112), 
				@q = 'update ' + @dynTable + ' set ps_no = b.ps_no, ps_co = b.ps_co, ps_no_nt = b.ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt = b.ps_co_nt' + 
					' from ' + @dynTable + ' a join #ps00 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SET @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
		END
	END

	IF @UpdateType = 2 RETURN



	-- Inventory
	UPDATE ct70 SET gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia1, gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt1, tien_nhap = b.tien_nhap, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = b.tien_xuat, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt_x
		FROM ct70 a JOIN #ps70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0
		WHERE (a.ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo)

	SELECT @d = @dFrom
	WHILE @d <= @dTo BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112), 
			@q = 'update ' + @dynTable + ' set gia = b.gia, gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia1, gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt1, ' + 
				'tien_nhap = b.tien_nhap, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt_n, tien_xuat = b.tien_xuat, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt_x' + 
				' from ' + @dynTable + ' a join #ps70 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q	
		--
		SELECT @dyn = @dyn + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112) + ',', @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
	END



	-- Voucher
	SELECT @dyn = LEFT(@dyn, LEN(@dyn) - 1)
	SELECT d$, m$, ma_ct INTO #dmct9 FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct IN (SELECT ma_ct FROM #ps70)

	-- Detail
	UPDATE #fifoDetail SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, ma_ct = b.ma_ct, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, gia = b.gia1, gia_nt = b.gia_nt1, tien = b.tien_nhap + b.tien_xuat, tien_nt = b.tien_nt_n + b.tien_nt_x
		FROM #fifoDetail a JOIN #ps70 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0

	UPDATE #fifoDetail SET gia_nt = gia, tien_nt = tien WHERE ma_nt = ''
	SELECT stt_rec, SUM(a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat) AS t_tien, SUM(a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x) AS t_tien_nt INTO #ntxtMaster
		FROM #ps70gl a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #fifoDetail b WHERE b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec) GROUP BY a.stt_rec

	UPDATE #ntxtMaster SET t_tien_nt = t_tien WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #fifoDetail b WHERE b.stt_rec = #ntxtMaster.stt_rec AND b.ma_nt = '')
	
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_ct, RTRIM(b.m_ctdbfs) AS dtable, RTRIM(b.m_phdbfs) AS mtable
		INTO #xcUpdateDetail FROM #fifoDetail a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct GROUP BY a.ma_ct, b.m_ctdbfs, b.m_phdbfs ORDER BY a.ma_ct

	CREATE INDEX i1 ON #fifoDetail(stt_rec, stt_rec0)
	CREATE INDEX i2 ON #ntxtMaster(stt_rec)

	-- Detail
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_use_2fc' AND val = '1') SELECT @r = 'update @detailTable set gia_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia else b.gia_nt end, ' + 
		'gia = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.gia_nt else b.gia end, ' + 
		'tien_nt = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien else b.tien_nt end, ' + 
		'tien = case when d.ma_nt = ' + @currency + ' then b.tien_nt else b.tien end' + 
		' from @detailTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join (select * from #fifoDetail where ma_ct = @ma_ct ) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec end a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' + 
		' join @masterTable d on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
	ELSE SELECT @r = 'update @detailTable set gia_nt = b.gia_nt, gia = b.gia, tien_nt = b.tien_nt, tien = b.tien' + 
		' from @detailTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join (select * from #fifoDetail where ma_ct = @ma_ct) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0'

	SELECT @r = @r + ' where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'

	-- Master				
	SELECT @m = 'update @masterTable set t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt from @masterTable a with(index(ngay_ct)) join #ntxtMaster b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' + 
		' where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112)  + ''')'

	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #xcUpdateDetail WHERE stt = @i) BEGIN
		SELECT @ma_ct = ma_ct, @tables = dtable, @tableMasters = mtable FROM #xcUpdateDetail WHERE stt = @i
		SELECT @tables = d$, @tableMasters = m$ FROM #dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @ma_ct
		IF @tables <> '' AND @tableMasters <> '' BEGIN
			SET @n = 0
			WHILE @n < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@dyn) BEGIN
				SELECT @n = @n + 1
				SELECT @detailTable = @tables + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@dyn, @n), @masterTable = @tableMasters + dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@dyn, @n)

				--d$
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@r, '@detailTable', @detailTable)
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q

				--m$
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@m, '@masterTable', @masterTable)
				SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '@ma_ct', CHAR(39) + @ma_ct + CHAR(39))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
		END
		--
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdvhrnvnew]
AS
SELECT stt_rec_nv, stt_rec, ma_nv, ho_nv, ten_nv, RTRIM(a.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + LTRIM(a.ten_nv) AS ten, a.bo_phan AS ma_bo_phan, b.ten_bp AS bo_phan, b.ten_bp2 AS bo_phan2, a.bp_ref, c.ten_vtr AS vi_tri, c.ten_vtr2 AS vi_tri2, CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Nam' ELSE N'Nữ' END AS gioi_tinh, CASE gioi_tinh WHEN '1' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END AS gioi_tinh2,
	gioi_tinh AS ma_gioi_tinh, a.stt, ngay_sinh, noi_sinh, cmnd_so, cmnd_ngay_hl, a.cmnd_noi_cap AS ma_cmnd_noi_cap, d.ten_tinh AS cmnd_noi_cap, d.ten_tinh2 AS cmnd_noi_cap2, cmnd_ngay_hh, a.quoc_tich AS ma_quoc_tich, e.ten_qt AS quoc_tich, e.ten_qt2 AS quoc_tich2, 
	a.dan_toc AS ma_dan_toc, f.ten_dt AS dan_toc, f.ten_dt2 AS dan_toc2, a.ton_giao AS ma_ton_giao, g.ten_tg AS ton_giao, g.ten_tg2 AS ton_giao2, a.hon_nhan AS ma_hon_nhan, h.ten_tthn AS hon_nhan, h.ten_tthn2 AS hon_nhan2, dien_thoai_dd, email_cty,
	dia_chi_ht, dia_chi_ht_so, dia_chi_ht_phuong, q.ten_tinh AS dia_chi_ht_tinh, q.ten_tinh2 AS dia_chi_ht_tinh2, dia_chi_ht_tinh AS ma_dia_chi_ht_tinh, dia_chi_ht_quan AS ma_dia_chi_ht_quan, dia_chi_ht_xa AS ma_dia_chi_ht_xa, 
	r.ten_quan AS dia_chi_ht_quan, r.ten_quan2 AS dia_chi_ht_quan2, s.ten_phuong AS dia_chi_ht_xa, s.ten_phuong2 AS dia_chi_ht_xa2, dien_thoai_cty, dien_thoai_nha, email_ca_nhan, giam_ho, nguoi_than, dia_chi_th_tru, dia_chi_th_tru_so, 
	dia_chi_th_tru_phuong, a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, i.ten_tinh AS dia_chi_th_tru_tinh, i.ten_tinh2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_tinh2, a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_quan, j.ten_quan AS dia_chi_th_tru_quan, j.ten_quan2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_quan2, 
	a.dia_chi_th_tru_xa AS ma_dia_chi_th_tru_xa, k.ten_phuong AS dia_chi_th_tru_xa, k.ten_phuong2 AS dia_chi_th_tru_xa2, que_quan, que_quan_so, que_quan_phuong, a.que_quan_tinh AS ma_que_quan_tinh, l.ten_tinh AS que_quan_tinh, l.ten_tinh2 AS que_quan_tinh2, 
	a.que_quan_quan AS ma_que_quan_quan, m.ten_quan AS que_quan_quan, m.ten_quan2 AS que_quan_quan2, a.que_quan_xa AS ma_que_quan_xa, n.ten_phuong AS que_quan_xa, n.ten_phuong2 AS que_quan_xa2, ho_chieu_so, ho_chieu_ngay_hl, a.ho_chieu_noi_cap AS ma_ho_chieu_noi_cap, 
	o.ten_qt AS ho_chieu_noi_cap, o.ten_qt2 AS ho_chieu_noi_cap2, ho_chieu_ngay_hh, visa_so, visa_ngay_hl, visa_ngay_hh, a.visa_noi_cap AS ma_visa_noi_cap, p.ten_qt AS visa_noi_cap, p.ten_qt2 AS visa_noi_cap2, ngay_kham, chieu_cao, can_nang, mat_phai, mat_trai, nhom_mau, loai_sk, ghi_chu_sk, t.ten_ttnv, t.ten_ttnv2, a.status,
	a.vi_tri AS ma_vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.nv_ql, a.ma_tdhv, a.ma_nn, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_vao, a.user_id, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.user_id3, a.u_status, a.u_status0, a.kieu_duyet, a.xtag
FROM dvhrnv AS a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp
	LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh d ON a.cmnd_noi_cap = d.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN dmqt e ON a.quoc_tich = e.ma_qt
	LEFT JOIN hrdmdt f ON a.dan_toc = f.ma_dt
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtg g ON a.ton_giao = g.ma_tg
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtthn h ON a.hon_nhan = h.ma_tthn
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh i ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = i.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmquan j ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan = j.ma_quan AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = j.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong k ON a.dia_chi_th_tru_xa = k.ma_phuong AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_tinh = j.ma_tinh AND a.dia_chi_th_tru_quan = j.ma_quan
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh l ON a.que_quan_tinh = l.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmquan m ON a.que_quan_quan = m.ma_quan AND a.que_quan_tinh = m.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong n ON a.que_quan_xa = n.ma_phuong AND a.que_quan_tinh = n.ma_tinh AND a.que_quan_quan = n.ma_quan
	LEFT JOIN dmqt o ON a.ho_chieu_noi_cap = o.ma_qt
	LEFT JOIN dmqt p ON a.visa_noi_cap = p.ma_qt
	LEFT JOIN hrdmtinh q ON a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = q.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmquan r ON a.dia_chi_ht_quan = r.ma_quan AND a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = r.ma_tinh
	LEFT JOIN hrdmphuong s ON a.dia_chi_ht_xa = s.ma_phuong AND a.dia_chi_ht_tinh = s.ma_tinh AND a.dia_chi_ht_quan = s.ma_quan
	LEFT JOIN hrdmttnv t ON a.tinh_trang_nv = t.ma_ttnv

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$Structure$Check]
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32),
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Extension VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@Action VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@ErrorField VARCHAR(64) OUT,
	@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(1024) OUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @Extension = REPLACE(@Extension, '''', ''), @PurOrgCode = REPLACE(@PurOrgCode, '''', ''), @PurGrCode = REPLACE(@PurGrCode, '''', ''), @PlantCode = REPLACE(@PlantCode, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @k VARCHAR(512), @Type TINYINT, @ChkYN BIT, @ChkMessage NVARCHAR(1024), @CheckRight TINYINT
	SELECT @Type = CAST(SUBSTRING(@Extension, 1, 1) AS TINYINT), @CheckRight = CAST(SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) AS TINYINT), @q = '', @k = '', @ChkYN = 1

	SELECT TOP 0 a.name AS f, a.colid AS id INTO #f FROM tempdb..syscolumns a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	IF @Type = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @PurOrgCode = ISNULL(@PurOrgCode, ''), @PurGrCode = ISNULL(@PurGrCode, ''), @PlantCode = ISNULL(@PlantCode, '')
		SELECT @ChkMessage = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN N'Thông tin mua hàng chưa được khai báo trong <span class="Highlight">Khai báo vùng cho đơn vị mua hàng</span>.' ELSE N'Plant has not been declared in <span class="Highlight">Default Plant for Purchasing Organization</span>.' END

		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$detail$check') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #f SELECT name, colid FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$detail$check') AND name IN ('ma_bp0', 'ma_vung')
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f WHERE f = 'ma_vung') BEGIN
				SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.' + RTRIM(f) + ' = b.' + RTRIM(f) FROM #f ORDER BY id
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f WHERE f = 'ma_bp0') SELECT @k = @k + CASE WHEN @k = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(@PurOrgCode = '''' or b.ma_bp0 = @PurOrgCode)'
				SELECT @q = 'if exists(select 1 from #$detail$check a where (exists(select 1 from bidmbp0g1 b where a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung) and not exists(select 1 from bidmbp0g1 b where ' + RTRIM(@k) + '))) select @ChkYN = 0'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@PurOrgCode varchar(32), @PlantCode varchar(32), @ChkYN bit output', @PurOrgCode, @PlantCode, @ChkYN OUTPUT

				IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = @ChkMessage
					RETURN	
				END
			END
		END

		IF (@PurOrgCode <> '' AND @PlantCode <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmbp0g1 WHERE ma_vung = @PlantCode) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bidmbp0g1 WHERE ma_bp0 = @PurOrgCode AND ma_vung = @PlantCode)) BEGIN
			SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = @ChkMessage
			RETURN	
		END
	END

	-- Pur Org, Pur Br, Plant Right
	IF @CheckRight = 1 AND ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @c VARCHAR(32), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @c = CASE @Action WHEN 'New' THEN 'r_new' WHEN 'Edit' THEN 'r_edit' WHEN 'Delete' THEN 'r_del' ELSE 'r_access' END, @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

		IF @PurOrgCode <> '' BEGIN -- bisyspurorgrights
			SELECT @q = 'if (@Admin <> 1 and (not exists(select 1 from bisyspurorgrights where [user_id] = @UserID and ma_bp0 = @PurOrgCode and ' + RTRIM(@c) + ' = 1))) select @ChkYN = 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Admin bit, @UserID int, @PurOrgCode varchar(32), @ChkYN bit output', @Admin, @UserID, @PurOrgCode, @ChkYN OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
				RETURN	
			END
		END
		IF @PurGrCode <> '' BEGIN -- bisyspurgrouprights
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @r OUTPUT, 2
			IF @r IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'if not (' + REPLACE(@r, 'ma_nh0', '@PurGrCode') + ') select @ChkYN = 0'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Admin bit, @UserID int, @PurGrCode varchar(32), @ChkYN bit output', @Admin, @UserID, @PurGrCode, @ChkYN OUTPUT
				IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
					RETURN	
				END
			END
		END

		IF @PlantCode <> '' BEGIN -- bisysplantrights
			EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @r OUTPUT, 1
			IF @r IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'if not (' + REPLACE(@r, 'ma_vung', '@PlantCode') + ') select @ChkYN = 0'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@UserID int, @PlantCode varchar(32), @ChkYN bit output', @UserID, @PlantCode, @ChkYN OUTPUT
				IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
					SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
					RETURN	
				END
			END
		END

		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$detail$check') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE #f
			INSERT INTO #f SELECT name, colid FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#$detail$check') AND name IN ('ma_bp0', 'ma_vung', 'ma_nh0')
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f) BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f WHERE f = 'ma_bp0') BEGIN
					SELECT @q = 'if (@Admin <> 1 and (not exists(select 1 from bisyspurorgrights where [user_id] = @UserID and ma_bp0 in (select ma_bp0 from #$detail$check where ma_bp0 <> '''') and ' + RTRIM(@c) + ' = 1))) select @ChkYN = 0'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@Admin bit, @UserID int, @ChkYN bit output', @Admin, @UserID, @ChkYN OUTPUT
					IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
						SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
						RETURN	
					END
				END
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f WHERE f = 'ma_nh0') BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'ma_nh0', @PurGrCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @r OUTPUT, 2
					IF @r IS NOT NULL BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'if exists(select 1 from #$detail$check where ma_nh0 <> '''' and not (' + RTRIM(@r) + ')) select @ChkYN = 0'
						EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@UserID int, @ChkYN bit output', @UserID, @ChkYN OUTPUT
						IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
							RETURN	
						END
					END
				END
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #f WHERE f = 'ma_vung') BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'ma_vung', @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @r OUTPUT, 1
					IF @r IS NOT NULL BEGIN
						SELECT @q = 'if exists(select 1 from #$detail$check where ma_vung <> '''' and not (' + RTRIM(@r) + ')) select @ChkYN = 0'
						EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@UserID int, @ChkYN bit output', @UserID, @ChkYN OUTPUT
						IF ISNULL(@ChkYN, 1) = 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @ErrorField = '', @ErrorMessage = '$NotAuthorized'
							RETURN	
						END
					END
				END
			END
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFASituationSummary]--fs20_FAInsDesSummary
	@PeriodFrom NUMERIC(2),
	@YearFrom NUMERIC(4),
	@PeriodTo NUMERIC(2),
	@YearTo NUMERIC(4),
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Object VARCHAR(33),
	@ReportForm CHAR(2), -- 10 - Standard, 20 - FC
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @firstcolumn VARCHAR(512)
		, @iColname VARCHAR(32), @iColdatatype VARCHAR(32), @iReftable VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldcode VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname VARCHAR(32), @iReffieldname2 VARCHAR(32)
		, @t01 NVARCHAR(1024), @t02 NVARCHAR(1024), @t03 NVARCHAR(1024), @t04 NVARCHAR(1024), @t05 NVARCHAR(1024), @t06 NVARCHAR(1024), @t07 NVARCHAR(1024)
		, @t08 NVARCHAR(1024), @t09 NVARCHAR(1024), @t10 NVARCHAR(1024), @total NVARCHAR(1024), @ma_nt0 VARCHAR(33)

	DECLARE @UnitKey VARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Object = CASE @Object WHEN '1' THEN 'loai_ts' WHEN '2' THEN 'ma_nv' END
	SELECT @ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name LIKE 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @t01 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA01'
	SELECT @t02 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA02'
	SELECT @t03 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA03'
	SELECT @t04 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA04'
	SELECT @t05 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA05'
	SELECT @t06 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA06'
	SELECT @t07 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA07'
	SELECT @t08 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA08'
	SELECT @t09 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA09'
	SELECT @t10 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'FA10'
	SELECT @total = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'Total'
	DECLARE @number01 NUMERIC(28, 6), @number02 NUMERIC(28, 6), @number03 NUMERIC(28, 6) --Dùng để khai báo bảng

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('b.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Gán cách lấy dữ liệu từ điều kiện lọc theo @Object
	CREATE TABLE #tblColumn (colname VARCHAR(32), coldatatype VARCHAR(32), reftable VARCHAR(32), reffieldcode VARCHAR(32), reffieldname VARCHAR(32), reffieldname2 VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'loai_ts', 'VARCHAR(33)', 'dmplts', 'ma_loai', 'ten_ngan', 'ten_ngan2'
	INSERT INTO #tblColumn SELECT 'ma_nv', 'VARCHAR(33)', 'dmnv', 'ma_nv', 'ten_nv', 'ten_nv2'
	SELECT @iColname = colname, @iColdatatype = coldatatype, @iReftable = reftable, @iReffieldcode = reffieldcode, @iReffieldname = reffieldname, @iReffieldname2 = reffieldname2 FROM #tblColumn WHERE colname = @Object

	-- Dau ky
	SELECT TOP 0 a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, c.ma_nv, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt INTO #tbg FROM ctkhts a, dmts b, dmnv c
	SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16) AS xKey INTO #temp FROM ctkhts WHERE nam * 12 + ky < @YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in (select xKey from #temp)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_giam is null or b.ngay_giam >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Nguyen gia mua ky truoc
	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, sum(nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmts a join ctdmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where year(a.ngay_mua)*12 +  month(a.ngay_mua) < ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and year(a.ngay_mua)*12 + month(a.ngay_mua) < year(a.ngay_kh0)*12 + month(a.ngay_kh0)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (a.ngay_giam is null or a.ngay_giam >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.so_the_ts + b.ma_nv not in (select so_the_ts + ma_nv from #tbg)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #tbg select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when b.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctdmts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ((not exists(select 1 from #tbg c where c.so_the_ts = a.so_the_ts)) or (not exists(select 1 from ctkhts e where a.so_the_ts = e.so_the_ts and (e.nam * 12 + e.ky <= ' + RTRIM(@YearFrom) + ' * 12 + ' + RTRIM(@PeriodFrom) + '))))'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_mua < ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (b.ngay_giam is null or b.ngay_giam >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
