	-- Cuoi ky
 	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #ted FROM #tbg
	SELECT (so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)) AS xKey INTO #tempend FROM ctkhts WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @YearTo *12 + @PeriodTo GROUP BY so_the_ts

	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in(select xKey from #tempend)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Cuoi ky mua ky truoc
 	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, sum(nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else nguyen_gia_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_da_kh), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_da_kh_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + ', sum(gt_cl), sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else gt_cl_nt end)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmts a join ctdmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where year(a.ngay_mua)*12 +  month(a.ngay_mua) <= ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ''
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and year(a.ngay_mua)*12 + month(a.ngay_mua) < year(a.ngay_kh0)*12 +  month(a.ngay_kh0)'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (a.ngay_giam is null or a.ngay_giam >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), dbo.ff_GetBOP(@YearFrom, @PeriodFrom), 112) + ''')'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.so_the_ts + b.ma_nv not in (select so_the_ts + ma_nv from #ted)' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv'
 	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Giam trong ky
	SET @q = 'insert into #ted select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, -sum(a.nguyen_gia), -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', -sum(a.gt_da_kh), -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + ', -SUM(a.gt_cl) AS gt_cl, -sum(case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in ('
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select a.so_the_ts + str(max(year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam)), 16) from dmts a'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_giam_ts <> '''' and (year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM (@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs') + ' group by a.so_the_ts)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp') + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Da het khau hao
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt INTO #ted1 FROM #ted
 	SET @q = 'insert into #ted1 select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, sum(a.nguyen_gia), sum(case when a.ma_nt = '''+ @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end)'

 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp') + ' group by a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv having sum(gt_cl) = 0'

	-- Tang/giam trong ky
	SELECT TOP 0 so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ma_tg_ts, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS loai_tg_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt INTO #temptar FROM #ted

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, a.loai_ts, b.ma_nv, a.ma_tg_ts, c.loai_tg_ts'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.nguyen_gia, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.nguyen_gia_nt end'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.gt_da_kh_nt end'
 	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', b.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else b.gt_cl_nt end'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (year(a.ngay_mua) * 12 + month(a.ngay_mua) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, a.ma_tg_ts, c.loai_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.nguyen_gia, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctdmts1 a left join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgts c on a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_tg_ts <> '''' ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and a.nam * 12 + a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom* 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@YearTo *12 + @PeriodTo)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, '''', ''1'' '
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, a.gt_kh_ky, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_kh_ky_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_cl, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_cl_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhts a left join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgts c on b.ma_giam_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.nam*12 + a.ky between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom*12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo)
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Khai bao giam
	SET @q = 'insert into #temptar select a.so_the_ts, b.loai_ts, a.ma_nv, b.ma_giam_ts, ''2'''
	SET @q = @q + ', a.nguyen_gia, CASE WHEN a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.nguyen_gia_nt end'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gt_da_kh, case when a.ma_nt = ''' + @ma_nt0 + ''' then 0 else a.gt_da_kh_nt end, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from ctkhts a left join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts left join dmtgts c on b.ma_giam_ts = c.ma_tg_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.so_the_ts + str(a.nam * 12 + a.ky, 16) in(select a.so_the_ts + str(max(year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam)), 16) from dmts a '
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_giam_ts <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_dvcs', 'a.ma_dvcs')
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' and (year(a.ngay_giam) * 12 + month(a.ngay_giam) between ' + LTRIM(@YearFrom * 12 + @PeriodFrom) + ' and ' + LTRIM(@YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo) + ')'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' group by a.so_the_ts) ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@Key, 'b.ma_bp', 'a.ma_bp')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
		INTO #tar FROM #temptar
		GROUP BY so_the_ts, loai_ts, ma_nv, ma_tg_ts, loai_tg_ts

	-- Khai bao giam
	DELETE #ted WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmts WHERE ma_giam_ts <> '' AND YEAR(ngay_giam)*12 + MONTH(ngay_giam) < @YearTo * 12 + @PeriodTo)

 	CREATE TABLE #fagroup (xcode VARCHAR(1024), ma VARCHAR(33), ten NVARCHAR(1024))
	CREATE TABLE #tmpX (id INT, ma VARCHAR(33), ten NVARCHAR(1024))
	SET @q = 'select ' + @iReffieldcode + ' as ma, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @iReffieldname ELSE @iReffieldname2 END + ' as ten into #tmp0 from ' + @iReftable
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select identity(int, 1, 1) as id, ma, ten into #tmp from #tmp0 order by ma'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #tmpx select * from #tmp'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #fagroup	select replace(str(id, 3), '' '', ''0'') + ma, ma, ten from #tmp a'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @iColname = 'so_the_ts' BEGIN
		DELETE #fagroup
		INSERT INTO #fagroup
			SELECT REPLACE(STR(id, 3), ' ', '0') + ma, ma, ten
				FROM #tmpX WHERE ma IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #tbg
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #ted
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #ted1
							UNION ALL SELECT so_the_ts FROM #tar
							)
	END

 	--CREATE TABLE #ted0 (ma_dt VARCHAR(33), nguyen_gia NUMERIC(28, 6), nguyen_gia_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_da_kh_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), gt_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))

	SELECT ma_dt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM (gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia
		, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) - SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_cl, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) - SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
			 INTO #t1 FROM #t a GROUP BY a.ma_dt

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS sysorder, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) As sysprint, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS systotal
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysRow, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1023)) AS sysColumn
			, (SELECT so_the_ts FROM wrkColumns) AS ma_dt, @number02 AS tien, @number03 AS tien_nt
			, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(2)) AS rowformat, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS rowtext, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS sysColumnName
		INTO #report

	-- Nguyen gia
	-- Du dau ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t05, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky chi tiet
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.02.01' + '.' + a.ma_tg_ts, b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tg_ts ELSE c.ten_tg_ts2 END, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma LEFT JOIN dmtgts c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1 AND a.ma_tg_ts <> ''
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten, a.ma_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2
	-- Giam trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.03.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t06, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Giam trong ky chi tiet
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.03.01' + '.' + a.ma_tg_ts, b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_tg_ts ELSE c.ten_tg_ts2 END, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma LEFT JOIN dmtgts c ON a.ma_tg_ts = c.ma_tg_ts
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2 AND a.ma_tg_ts <> ''
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten, a.ma_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts, c.ten_tg_ts2
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.04.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t07, b.ten
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Da het khau hao
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '01.04.01.01', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.nguyen_gia), SUM(a.nguyen_gia_nt), 0, SPACE(3 * 3) + @t08, b.ten
			FROM #ted10 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Khau hao
	-- Du dau ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Tang trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t05, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 1
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Giam trong ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.03.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t06, b.ten
			FROM #tar0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			WHERE a.loai_tg_ts = 2
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '02.04.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_da_kh), SUM(a.gt_da_kh_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t07, b.ten
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Gia tri con lai
	-- Du dau ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '03.01.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t04, b.ten
			FROM #tbg0 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Du cuoi ky
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 5, 1, 1, '03.02.00', b.xcode, a.ma_dt, SUM(a.gt_cl), SUM(a.gt_cl_nt), 0, SPACE(1 * 3) + @t10, b.ten
			FROM #t1 a JOIN #fagroup b ON a.ma_dt = b.ma
			GROUP BY b.xcode, a.ma_dt, b.ten
	-- Cac dong text
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT DISTINCT 5, 1, 1
			, a.sysRow, b.sysColumn
			, b.ma_dt, NULL, NULL
			, a.rowformat, a.rowtext, b.sysColumnName
			FROM (
				SELECT '01.00.00' AS sysRow, 1 AS rowformat, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t01 AS rowtext
				UNION ALL SELECT '02.00.00', 1, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t02
				UNION ALL SELECT '03.00.00', 1, SPACE(0 * 3) + @t03
				UNION ALL SELECT '01.02.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
				UNION ALL SELECT '01.03.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
				UNION ALL SELECT '01.04.01', 0, SPACE(2 * 3) + @t09
				) a CROSS JOIN #report b

	UPDATE #report SET tien = 0 WHERE tien IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET tien_nt = 0 WHERE tien_nt IS NULL
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysRow, sysColumn, ma_dt, tien, tien_nt, rowformat, sysColumnName, rowtext AS sysRowName
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysRow, sysColumn

	-- Pivot
	CREATE TABLE #xpivot(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(1024) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot(header) SELECT MAX(sysColumnName) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY sysColumn ORDER BY sysColumn

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn(id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = 10 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'tien$'
	IF @ReportForm = 20 INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 2, 'tien_nt$'

	CREATE TABLE #pivot(id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), RTRIM(a.header) FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b ORDER BY a.id, b.id

	IF @ReportForm = 10 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT COUNT(*) + 1, 'tien', @total FROM #pivot
	IF @ReportForm = 20 INSERT INTO #pivot SELECT COUNT(*) + 1, 'tien_nt', @total FROM #pivot

	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptTMRequirementJobPosition]
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Employee VARCHAR(32),
	@Position VARCHAR(32),
	@Level VARCHAR(32),
	@Option CHAR(1), -- 1 - Chưa học, 2 - Đã học, * - Tất cả
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @EmpKey NVARCHAR(4000), @DeptKey NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @pass NVARCHAR(1024), @fail NVARCHAR(1024), @unCompleted NVARCHAR(1024), @JoinUnit BIT, @JoinDept BIT, @JoinEmp BIT

	SELECT @pass = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM036'
	SELECT @fail = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM037'
	SELECT @unCompleted = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM038'

	-- Key bộ phận
	SELECT @Key = '', @EmpKey = '', @DeptKey = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'b', 'b', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JoinUnit OUTPUT, @JoinDept OUTPUT, @JoinEmp OUTPUT, @EmpKey OUTPUT, 'd.', 1
	IF @Department <> '' SET @DeptKey = ISNULL(@Key, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@Key, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'b.')
	
	-- Lấy số liệu từ yêu cầu đào tạo theo vị trí
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ngay_hl <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112) + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' (a.ngay_hh is null or a.ngay_hh >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112) + ''')'
	IF @DeptKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @DeptKey
	IF @Position <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_bp, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_mh, b.stt_ref, b.bp_ref, b.bac_bp, c.stt AS stt_vtr, d.stt AS stt_mh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS k, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_bp, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS ten_vtr INTO #yc FROM hrdtyctvt a, hrbp b, hrvt c, hrdmmh d
	CREATE INDEX k ON #yc(k)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #yc select a.ma_bp, a.ma_vtr, a.ma_mh, b.stt_ref, rtrim(b.bp_ref) + ''%'', b.bac_bp, c.stt, d.stt, a.ma_bp + a.ma_vtr + a.ma_mh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_bp' ELSE 'b.ten_bp2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vtr' ELSE 'c.ten_vtr2' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from hrdtyctvt a with(nolock) left join hrbp b with(nolock) on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c with(nolock) on a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr left join hrdmmh d with(nolock) on a.ma_mh = d.ma_mh'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Insert cho các bộ phận con
	DECLARE @n INT
	SELECT @n = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #yc
	WHILE @n >= 1 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #yc
			SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_vtr, b.ma_mh, a.stt_ref, '', 0, b.stt_vtr, b.stt_mh, a.ma_bp + b.ma_vtr + b.ma_mh, a.ten_bp, b.ten_vtr
				FROM hrbp a JOIN #yc b ON a.bp_ref LIKE b.bp_ref
				WHERE b.bac_bp = @n AND a.ma_bp + b.ma_vtr + b.ma_mh NOT IN (SELECT k FROM #yc)
		SET @n = @n - 1
	END

	-- Lấy thông tin bộ phận, vị trí của nhân viên theo ngày báo cáo
	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri
		INTO #qtlvht
		FROM hreqtlvht a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_tu) AS ngay_tu FROM hreqtlvht WHERE tinh_chat = 1 AND ngay_tu <= @ReportDate GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_tu = b.ngay_tu

	-- Lấy thông tin từ thông tin nhân viên, các khóa học ngắn hạn
	SET @Key = 'c.ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112) + ''''
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('c.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and d.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and d.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	
	IF @EmpKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @EmpKey
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, c.ma_mh, b.bo_phan, b.vi_tri, a.dat_yn, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS da_hoc, a.ngay_hh AS ngay_hh_cc, b.stt AS stt_nv, b.ma_nv, RTRIM(b.ho_nv) + SPACE(1) + b.ten_nv AS ten_nv, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS k
		INTO #nv FROM hredt a, hrnv b, hrdtkh c
	--
	IF @Option <> '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #nv select a.stt_rec, c.ma_mh, d.bo_phan, d.vi_tri, a.dat_yn, 1, a.ngay_hh, d.stt, d.ma_nv, rtrim(d.ho_nv) + space(1) + d.ten_nv, a.stt_rec + c.ma_mh + convert(char(8), c.ngay_hoc1, 112) + replace(str(a.line_nbr, 5), '' '', ''0'')'
		SET @q = @q + ' from hredt a with(nolock) left join hrdtkh c with(nolock) on a.ma_khoa = c.ma_khoa join hrnv d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- Xóa những dòng trùng, lấy theo ngày học gần nhất
		DELETE #nv WHERE k NOT IN (SELECT MAX(k) FROM #nv GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_mh)
	END

	-- Insert thêm các nhân viên chưa học
	IF @Option <> '2' BEGIN		
		SET @Key = 'a.bo_phan + a.vi_tri in (b.ma_bp + b.ma_vtr) and a.stt_rec + b.ma_mh not in (select stt_rec + ma_mh from #nv)'
		IF @Employee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_nv = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Employee), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @Level <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @EmpKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@EmpKey, 'd.', 'a.')
		SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

		SET @q = 'insert into #nv select a.stt_rec, b.ma_mh, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, 0, 0, NULL, a.stt, a.ma_nv, rtrim(a.ho_nv) + space(1) + a.ten_nv, '''' from hrnv a, #yc b'
		SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Cập nhật lại bộ phận, vị trí theo ngày báo cáo
	UPDATE #nv SET bo_phan = b.bo_phan, vi_tri = b.vi_tri FROM #nv a JOIN #qtlvht b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Data
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS INT ) AS stt, a.stt_rec, a.stt_nv, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ma_mh, b.stt_ref, b.stt_vtr, b.stt_mh
			, CAST(a.dat_yn AS INT) AS dat_yn, CAST(a.da_hoc AS INT) AS da_hoc, a.ngay_hh_cc, b.ten_bp, b.ten_vtr
			, SPACE(2) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN e.ten_mh ELSE e.ten_mh2 END AS ten_mh, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nhom
		INTO #report
		FROM #nv a JOIN #yc b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp AND a.vi_tri = b.ma_vtr AND a.ma_mh = b.ma_mh LEFT JOIN hrdmmh e ON a.ma_mh = e.ma_mh
	ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_mh NVARCHAR(1024)

	-- Group by Dept, Position, Subject
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 4, 0, '', 0, '', '', bo_phan, vi_tri, ma_mh, MAX(stt_ref), MAX(stt_vtr), MAX(stt_mh), -1, -1, NULL, '', '', MAX(ten_mh), 0
			FROM #report GROUP BY bo_phan, vi_tri, ma_mh

	-- Group by Dept, Position
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT 3, 0, '', 0, '', '', bo_phan, vi_tri, '', MAX(stt_ref), MAX(stt_vtr), 0, -1, -1, NULL, '', '', RTRIM(MAX(ten_bp)) + ' - ' + MAX(ten_vtr), 0
			FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 5 GROUP BY bo_phan, vi_tri
	
	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, bo_phan, vi_tri INTO #o FROM #report WHERE sysorder = 3 ORDER BY stt_ref, stt_vtr, vi_tri

	UPDATE #report SET nhom = b.id FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.bo_phan = b.bo_phan AND a.vi_tri = b.vi_tri
	UPDATE #report SET stt = nhom WHERE sysorder = 3

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) BEGIN
		SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS nhom, '' AS ma_mh, '' AS ma_nv, '' AS ten_nv, '' AS ten_mh, '' AS ket_qua, NULL AS ngay_hh_cc
		RETURN
	END

	-- Resut
	SELECT sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, stt, nhom, ma_mh, ma_nv, ten_nv, ten_mh
			, CASE da_hoc WHEN 0 THEN @unCompleted WHEN 1 THEN CASE dat_yn WHEN 1 THEN @pass WHEN 0 THEN @fail END END AS ket_qua, ngay_hh_cc
		FROM #report
		ORDER BY stt_ref, stt_vtr, vi_tri, stt_mh, ma_mh, sysorder, stt_nv, ma_nv

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff20_GetInsertGroup]
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @c3 VARCHAR(32), @c4 VARCHAR(32), @c5 VARCHAR(32), @c6 NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			IF EXISTS(SELECT xfieldkey FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @c1 = xfieldkey, @c2 = xtableref, @c3 = xfieldkeyref, @c4 = xfieldnameref, @c5 = xfieldnameref2, @c6 = xkeyref FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @c1 ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @c1
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1)+RTRIM(ten_XX),ten_XX2 = SPACE(1)+RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.' + @c4 + '),MAX(b.' + @c5 + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ' + @c2 + ' WHERE ' + @c6 + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' b ON a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c3 + ' WHERE a.systotal=1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 = N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2)+RTRIM(ten_XX),ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2)+RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1)+RTRIM(ten_XX),ten_XX2 = SPACE(1)+RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a '
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' WHERE a.systotal=1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2)+RTRIM(ten_XX),ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2)+RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTransactionListByObject] --fs20_TransObjsList
	@Type TINYINT, 
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(1024), 
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(1024), 
	@BContract VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Account VARCHAR(1024), 
	@DebitCredit CHAR(1),
	@AccountRef VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Customer VARCHAR(1024), 
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Job VARCHAR(1024),
	@Contract VARCHAR(1024),
	@Department VARCHAR (1024),
	@Fee VARCHAR(32),
	@ForeignCurrency VARCHAR(1024),
	@Decription NVARCHAR(1024),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@LoanContractType CHAR(1) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @cCode1 VARCHAR(32), @cCode2 VARCHAR(32), @cName VARCHAR(32), @cName2 VARCHAR(32), @cTable VARCHAR(32), @fGroup1 VARCHAR(32), @fGroup2 VARCHAR(32), @fGroup3 VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @cCode1 = RTRIM(fcode1), @cCode2 = RTRIM(fcode2), @cName = RTRIM(fname1), @cName2 = RTRIM(fname2), @cTable = RTRIM(ftable), @fGroup1 = fgroup1, @fGroup2 = fgroup2, @fGroup3 = fgroup3 FROM v20globjtype WHERE ftype = @Type 

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, ngay_ct, ma_ct, stt_rec, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
			, tk, tk_du, line_nbr, ma_kh, so_ct, so_ct0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS dien_giai, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS object, nh_dk
		INTO #report FROM wrkgl

	-- Key		 
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.' + @cCode1 + ' <> '''''
	IF @Type = '8' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ku = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@LoanContractType), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	IF @DebitCredit = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_no <> 0' 
	IF @DebitCredit = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ps_co <> 0' 
	IF @AccountRef <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'inlist', @AccountRef)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@VoucherCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ForeignCurrency <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ForeignCurrency), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''')  + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Fee <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_phi like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Fee), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @BContract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ku like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@BContract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Decription <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.dien_giai like N''%' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Decription), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.' + @fGroup1 + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.' + @fGroup2 + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%''' 
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.' + @fGroup3 + ' like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%''' 

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.line_nbr'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.dien_giai, a.' + @cCode1 + ', nh_dk'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	IF (@Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '') OR (@Type = '8') SET @q = @q + ' left join ' + @cTable + ' b with(nolock) on a.' + @cCode1 + ' = b.' + @cCode2
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'select 0 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 0 as systotal, a.object'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(isnull(b.' + @cName + ', '''')) as ' + @cName + ', max(isnull(b.' + @cName2 + ', '''')) as ' + @cName2
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ps_no) as ps_no, sum(a.ps_co) as ps_co, sum(a.ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(a.ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #tSum from #report a left join ' + @cTable  + ' b on a.object' + ' = b.' + @cCode2
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.object'

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, object' + ', dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, object'
	SET @q = @q + ', rtrim(' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN @cName ELSE @cName2 END + ') + '' - '' + rtrim(object)'
	SET @q = @q + ', ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt from #tSum'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, object) select 1, 0, 0, object from #tSum '
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SET @q = 'select a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.stt_rec,  a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ', isnull(b.ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh2, '''') as ten_kh2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.dien_giai, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.object as ' + @cCode1 + ', a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.ps_no, a.ps_co'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b with(nolock, index(pk_dmkh)) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmct c with(nolock) on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' order by object, sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, a.so_ct, stt_rec, nh_dk, ps_co, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SA] -- new
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, CAST(1 AS INT) AS he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_nc INTO #afterUpdate FROM d93$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #afterUpdate select stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, 1, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate) RETURN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #afterUpdate WHERE stt_rec_nc <> '') UPDATE #afterUpdate SET dyn_nc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #afterUpdate a JOIN c91$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_nc = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	DECLARE @cPRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_nc VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, stt_rec0nc, sl_dat, he_so, dyn_nc FROM #afterUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET sl_pb = sl_pb - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @cLinePRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_nc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_nc, MAX(dyn_nc) AS dyn_nc FROM #afterUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_nc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @dyn_nc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cPRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_nc <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m91$' + @dyn_nc + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPRIDNumber, @dyn_nc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Convert2AllocPeriod]
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@CheckExpireDate BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SET @dTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dFrom) - 1

	SELECT TOP 0 stt, ma_dvcs, ma_bt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt INTO #dmpbky FROM dmpbky

	SET @q = 'insert into #dmpbky select stt, ma_dvcs, ma_bt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt from dmpbky'
			+ ' where ngay_bd <= @dto and ((ngay_kt is null) or (ngay_kt >= @dfrom)) and dbo.ff_InList(ma_dvcs, rtrim(@unit)) = 1 and abs(tien_cl) + abs(tien_cl_nt) > 0'

	IF @CheckExpireDate = 1
		SET @q = @q + ' and (''' + RIGHT('0000' + LTRIM(@Year), 4) + RIGHT('00' + LTRIM(@Period), 2) + '01' + ''' <= convert(char(8), dateadd(month, so_ky_pb - 1, convert(char(6), ngay_bd, 112) + ''01''), 112))'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dfrom smalldatetime, @dto smalldatetime, @unit varchar(1024)', @dFrom, @dTo, @Unit

	SELECT ma_bt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt INTO #ctpbky
		FROM ctpbky
			WHERE STR(nam, 4) + STR(ky, 2) + RTRIM(ma_bt)
					IN (SELECT STR(MAX(nam), 4) + STR(MAX(ky), 2) + RTRIM(ma_bt) FROM ctpbky
							WHERE nam*12 + ky < @Year*12 + @Period AND dbo.ff_InList(ma_dvcs, RTRIM(@Unit)) = 1
								GROUP BY ma_bt)

	DELETE #dmpbky FROM #dmpbky a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ctpbky b WHERE a.ma_bt = b.ma_bt AND (b.tien_cl + b.tien_cl_nt <= 0))

	INSERT INTO dmpbky1 (stt, stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ky, nam, ma_bt, tag, so_ct, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT stt, '', ma_dvcs, @Period, @Year, ma_bt, 0, '', GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #dmpbky
				WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmpbky1 WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND ma_bt = #dmpbky.ma_bt)

	UPDATE dmpbky1 SET tag = 0
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptIncomeStatementDepartments]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@department VARCHAR(4000),
	@unit VARCHAR(4000),
	@form CHAR(16),
	@reportForm CHAR(2), --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dept VARCHAR(32), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @iCount INT, @i INT
	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000), @Tk_kqkd VARCHAR(32), @Ma_so VARCHAR(32), @Tk_no VARCHAR(48), @Tk_co VARCHAR(48), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @Tk_kqkd = (RTRIM(val) + '%') FROM options WHERE name = 'M_TK_KQKD'
	SELECT @department = REPLACE(REPLACE(@department, '''', ''), ', ', ','), @i = 1

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.ma_bp INTO #dept FROM dmbp a JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@department, ',') b ON a.ma_bp = b.data
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc2 WHERE form = @form
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xDept, ma_so, ky_nay, ky_nay_nt INTO #resultTmp FROM v20gltc2
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xDept, stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, thuyet_minh, bold, ky_nay, ky_nay_nt INTO #result FROM v20gltc2

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @userID, @admin

	--
	SELECT ma_so, CAST(RTRIM(tk_no) AS VARCHAR(512)) AS tk_no, CAST(RTRIM(tk_co) AS VARCHAR(512)) AS tk_co, giam_tru INTO #tableNorm FROM #report WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #tableFormula FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	--
	CREATE INDEX xDept ON #resultTmp(xDept)
	CREATE INDEX ma_so ON #resultTmp(ma_so)

	-- Account
	DECLARE @accList VARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @accList = CASE WHEN @accList <> '' THEN @accList + ',' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(RTRIM(tk_no), ', ', ',') + ',' + REPLACE(RTRIM(tk_co), ', ', ',') FROM #tableNorm WHERE tk_no <> '' OR tk_co <> ''
	SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(data)) + '%' AS tk INTO #tk FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@accList, ',') WHERE data <> ''

	-- Norm
	SELECT ma_so, REPLACE(RTRIM(tk_no), ', ', ',') AS tk_no, REPLACE(RTRIM(tk_co), ', ', ',') AS tk_co, giam_tru INTO #tmp FROM #tableNorm WHERE CHARINDEX(',', tk_no) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',', tk_co) > 0
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @Ma_so = ma_so, @Tk_no = tk_no, @Tk_co = tk_co FROM #tmp ORDER BY ma_so
		DELETE #tableNorm WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
		INSERT INTO #tableNorm SELECT a.ma_so, RTRIM(b.data), RTRIM(c.data), a.giam_tru FROM #tmp a CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_no, ',') b CROSS JOIN dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@Tk_co, ',') c WHERE a.ma_so = @Ma_so
		DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
	END
	UPDATE #tableNorm SET tk_no = CASE WHEN tk_no <> '' THEN RTRIM(tk_no) + '%' ELSE '' END, tk_co = CASE WHEN tk_co <> '' THEN RTRIM(tk_co) + '%' ELSE '' END

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'exists(select 1 from #dept b where b.ma_bp = a.ma_bp)'
	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SELECT @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	-- Get Data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select a.ma_bp, rtrim(a.tk), rtrim(a.tk_du), sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt) from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) where %[a.status = ''1'' and ' + @key  + ' and exists(select 1 from #tk tk where a.tk like tk.tk)]% group by a.ma_bp, a.tk, a.tk_du'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Set Data Norm
	-- ++ @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp
		SELECT ma_bp, ma_so, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
			FROM (
				SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_bp, a.ps_co AS ps, a.ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 a JOIN #tableNorm b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_co WHERE b.tk_no = '' AND b.tk_co <> ''
				UNION ALL
				SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_bp, - a.ps_no, - a.ps_no_nt FROM #ct00 a JOIN #tableNorm b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_co WHERE b.giam_tru = 1 AND b.tk_no = '' AND b.tk_co <> '' AND (a.tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd)
				) a
			GROUP BY a.ma_so, a.ma_bp

	-- ++ @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> ''
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp
		SELECT ma_bp, ma_so, SUM(ps), SUM(ps_nt)
			FROM (
				SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_bp, a.ps_no AS ps, a.ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 a JOIN #tableNorm b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_no WHERE b.tk_co = '' AND b.tk_no <> ''
				UNION ALL
				SELECT b.ma_so, a.ma_bp, - a.ps_co, - a.ps_co_nt FROM #ct00 a JOIN #tableNorm b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_no WHERE b.giam_tru = 1 AND b.tk_co = '' AND b.tk_no <> '' AND (a.tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd)
				) a
			GROUP BY a.ma_so, a.ma_bp

	-- ++ @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp
		SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_so, SUM(a.Ps_no), SUM(a.Ps_no_nt)
			FROM #ct00 a
				JOIN #tableNorm b ON a.tk LIKE b.tk_no AND a.tk_du LIKE b.tk_co
			WHERE b.tk_no <> '' AND b.tk_co <> '' AND (a.Ps_no <> 0 OR a.Ps_no_nt <> 0)
			GROUP BY b.ma_so, a.ma_bp

	-- Formula
	INSERT INTO #resultTmp SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ma_so, 0, 0 FROM #dept a CROSS JOIN #tableFormula b
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$ConvertFormula '#tableFormula', '#resultTmp', @userID, @admin, 'xDept'
	UPDATE #resultTmp SET ky_nay = ISNULL(ky_nay, 0), ky_nay_nt = ISNULL(ky_nay_nt, 0)

	-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT b.ma_bp, a.stt, a.in_ck, CASE WHEN a.cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.chi_tieu ELSE a.chi_tieu2 END, a.ma_so, a.thuyet_minh, a.bold, ISNULL(c.ky_nay, 0), ISNULL(c.ky_nay_nt, 0)
			FROM #report a CROSS JOIN #dept b LEFT JOIN #resultTmp c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so AND b.ma_bp = c.xDept

	-- View
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS xRow, xDept AS xColumn , sysorder, sysprint, systotal, chi_tieu, ma_so, thuyet_minh, bold, ky_nay, ky_nay_nt FROM #result a ORDER BY xDept, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, CONVERT(CHAR(10), MAX(xDept), 103) AS header INTO #pivot FROM #result GROUP BY xDept ORDER BY xDept
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 20 THEN 'ky_nay_nt$' ELSE 'ky_nay$' END + RTRIM(id)
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintAPTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@View TINYINT, -- 1: Pdf, 2: Excel
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' --  1: Asc, 2: Desc
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(511), @tk_du VARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', '')

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = N'm_ma_nt0'

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct
			, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt
			, a.tk, c.ten_tk, c.ten_tk2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_tien_in_word, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_tien_nt_in_word
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_tien_in_word2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS t_tien_nt_in_word2
			, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS CHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM m31$000000 a, dmkh b, dmtk c
	ALTER TABLE #master ALTER COLUMN ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME NULL
	SELECT TOP 0 b.line_nbr, b.dien_giai, b.tk_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, a.*, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail INTO #detail FROM #master a, d31$000000 b

	-- Master
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ltrim(a.tk), isnull(c.ten_tk,''''), isnull(c.ten_tk2,'''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''E'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''E'')'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from m31$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.line_nbr, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from d31$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Empty Row
	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PN1'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	--
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct FROM #master GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, ong_ba = b.ong_ba, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ten_kh2 = b.ten_kh2
				, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, tk = b.tk, ten_tk = b.ten_tk, ten_tk2 = b.ten_tk2
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE line_nbr = 1
	UPDATE #detail SET t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt
			, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_thue_nt = b.t_thue_nt
			, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt
			, t_tien_in_word = b.t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word = b.t_tien_nt_in_word
			, t_tien_in_word2 = b.t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tien_nt_in_word2
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

	-- View
	IF @View = 1 BEGIN
		IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', 'PN1', @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT
		IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, dien_giai, tk_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, dien_giai, tk_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, dien_giai, tk_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec AS xGroup
		, dien_giai, tk_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
				, t_tien, t_tien_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tien_in_word AS t_tt_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word AS t_tt_nt_in_word, ngay, thang, nam
			FROM #master
		SELECT line_nbr, dien_giai, tk_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetMonths(
	@d1 AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@d2 AS SMALLDATETIME
	)
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN
	DECLARE @intResult AS INT
	IF @d1 > @d2
		SET @intResult = (YEAR(@d1) * 12 + MONTH(@d1)) - (YEAR(@d2) * 12 + MONTH(@d2))
	ELSE
		SET @intResult = - ((YEAR(@d1) * 12 + MONTH(@d1)) - (YEAR(@d2) * 12 + MONTH(@d2)))
	RETURN @intResult
END





GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_UpdateAvgPrice]
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@site VARCHAR(33), 
	@item VARCHAR(33), 
	@group1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@group3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@itemType CHAR(2), 
	@deffType TINYINT, 
	@deffAcct VARCHAR(33), 
	@updateType TINYINT, 
	@siteType TINYINT, 
	@vcDeffCode CHAR(3), 
	@costType TINYINT, 
	@vcIRCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcISCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIBCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIPCodes VARCHAR(64), 
	@vcIICodes VARCHAR(64) , 
	@priceFCType TINYINT, 
	@userID INT, 
	@siteGroup VARCHAR(33) = '', 
	@itemTable VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@siteTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceList @dFrom, @dTo, @site, @item, @group1, @group2, @group3, @itemType, @siteType, @costType, @userID, @siteGroup

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @i TINYINT, @dynTable VARCHAR(64), @tableList VARCHAR(4000), 
		@round TINYINT, @roundFC TINYINT, @pRound TINYINT, @pRoundFC TINYINT, @j VARCHAR(512), @d SMALLDATETIME

	-- Set	
	SELECT @round = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN'
	SELECT @roundFC = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_TIEN_NT'
	SELECT @pRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA'
	SELECT @pRoundFC = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_ROUND_GIA_NT'
	


	-- Struct
	IF @itemTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt INTO #xItem FROM dmvt
		SELECT @key = ' gia_ton = ' + RTRIM(@costType)
		IF @item <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group1 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group2 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @group3 <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @itemType <> '' SELECT @key = @key + ' and loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''	
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xItem select ma_vt from dmvt where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @itemTable = '#xItem'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xItem(ma_vt)
	END
	
	IF @site = '' AND @siteGroup = '' SELECT @siteTable = 'dmkho'
	ELSE IF @siteTable = '' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho INTO #xSite FROM dmkho
		SELECT @key = CASE WHEN @site <> '' THEN 'ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%''' ELSE '' END
		IF @siteGroup <> '' SELECT @key = @key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'ma_nh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@siteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #xSite select ma_kho from dmkho where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @siteTable = '#xSite'
		CREATE INDEX i ON #xSite(ma_kho)

	END


	SELECT @key = '(a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dTo, 112) + ''')'
	SELECT @j = ' join ' + @itemTable + ' b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @siteTable <> 'dmkho' SELECT @j = @j + ' join ' + @siteTable + ' c on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'

	SELECT @tableList = '', @q = 'update ct70 set gia = p.gia, gia_nt = ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * p.gia_nt, ' + 
		'gia1 = round(p.gia * a.he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@pRound) + '), ' + 
		'gia_nt1 = ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * round(p.gia_nt * a.he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@pRoundFC) + '), ' + 
		'tien_xuat = case when a.nxt = 1 then a.tien_xuat else round(a.sl_xuat * p.gia, ' + RTRIM(@round) + ') end, ' + 
		'tien_nt_x = case when a.nxt = 1 then a.tien_nt_x else ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * round(a.sl_xuat * p.gia_nt, ' + RTRIM(@roundFC) + ') end, ' + 
		'tien_nhap = case when a.nxt <> 1 then a.tien_nhap else round(a.sl_nhap * p.gia, ' + RTRIM(@round) + ') end, ' + 
		'tien_nt_n = case when a.nxt <> 1 then a.tien_nt_n else ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * round(a.sl_nhap * p.gia_nt, ' + RTRIM(@roundFC) + ') end' + 
		' from ct70 a with (index(ngay_ct)) join #wrkstkprice p on a.ma_vt = p.ma_vt' + CASE WHEN @siteType = 2 THEN ' and a.ma_kho = p.ma_kho' ELSE '' END + @j + 
		' where ' + '((a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1 and a.ct_dc = 0) or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd <> 1)) and ' + @key

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @d = @dFrom
		WHILE @d <= @dTo SELECT @tableList = @tableList + 'r70$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112) + ',', @d = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @d)
	END

	-- Update ct70
	--EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update r70
	SELECT @i = 1, @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, ' and ' + @key, ''), ' with (index(ngay_ct))', '')
	WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@tableList) BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = (dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tableList, @i)),
			@r = REPLACE(@q, 'ct70', @dynTable),
			@i = @i + 1
			EXEC sp_executesql @r
	END	



	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, gia, gia_nt, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x INTO #ct70x FROM wrkin
	--SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct70x select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.gia, a.gia_nt, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x from ct70 a with (index(ngay_ct)) ' + @j + ' where ' + @key + ' and a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd <> 1 and ct_dc = 1'
	--EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @i = 1, @q  = 'insert into #ct70x select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.gia, a.gia_nt, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x from @ct70 a with(nolock)' + @j + ' where a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd <> 1 and ct_dc = 1'
	WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@tableList) BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = (dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tableList, @i)), @r = REPLACE(@q, '@ct70', @dynTable), @i = @i + 1
		EXEC sp_executesql @r
	END
	UPDATE #ct70x SET stt_rec = LEFT(stt_rec, 10) + 'PNF'
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ct70x(stt_rec, stt_rec0)



	SELECT @q = 'update @ct70 set gia = b.gia, gia_nt = ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * b.gia_nt, ' + 
		'gia1 = round(b.gia * a.he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@pRound) + '), ' + 
		'gia_nt1 = ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * round(b.gia_nt * a.he_so1, ' + RTRIM(@pRoundFC) + '), ' + 
		'tien_nhap = case when a.sl_nhap = b.sl_xuat then b.tien_xuat else case when a.nxt <> 1 then a.tien_nhap else round(a.sl_nhap * b.gia, ' + RTRIM(@round) + ') end end,' + 
		'tien_nt_n = case when a.sl_nhap = b.sl_xuat then b.tien_nt_x else case when a.nxt <> 1 then a.tien_nt_n else ' + RTRIM(@priceFCType) + ' * round(a.sl_nhap * b.gia_nt, ' + RTRIM(@roundFC) + ') end end' +
		' from @ct70 a with (index(ngay_ct)) join #ct70x b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0 where ' + @key + ' and a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1 and a.ct_dc = 1'

	-- Update ct70
	--SET @r = REPLACE(@q, '@ct70', 'ct70')
	--EXEC sp_executesql @r

	-- Update r70
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, ' and ' + @key, ''), ' with (index(ngay_ct))', '')
	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@tableList) BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = (dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tableList, @i)),
			@r = REPLACE(@q, '@ct70', @dynTable),
			@i = @i + 1
		EXEC sp_executesql @r
	END



	--TRUNCATE TABLE wrkstkdetail
	SELECT @i = 1, @q  = 'insert into #wrkstkdetail (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong, he_so, ma_nt, gia, gia_nt, tien, tien_nt)' + 
		' select a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.ma_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, a.sl_nhap + a.sl_xuat, a.he_so1, a.ma_nt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x' + 
		' from @ct70 a with(nolock)' + @j + ' where ((a.nxt = 1 and a.pn_gia_tb = 1) or (a.nxt = 2 and a.px_gia_dd <> 1))'
	WHILE @i < dbo.ff_GetWordCount(@tableList) BEGIN
		SELECT @dynTable = (dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@tableList, @i)), @r = REPLACE(@q, '@ct70', @dynTable), @i = @i + 1
		EXEC sp_executesql @r
	END

	

	IF @priceFCType = 0 UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET tien_nt = ROUND(so_luong * gia_nt, @roundFC)
	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia = ROUND(gia*he_so, @pRound), gia_nt = ROUND(gia_nt * he_so, @pRoundFC)
	UPDATE #wrkstkdetail SET gia_nt = gia, tien_nt = tien WHERE ma_nt = ''

	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceDetail @dFrom, @dTo
	EXEC fs_UpdateAvgPriceMaster @dFrom, @dTo
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$ResultRecordingDetail$Post]
	@SourceTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DestinationTable VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@ResultType TINYINT = 1 -- 1 insert data, 2 select data
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', ''), @SourceTable = REPLACE(@SourceTable, '''', ''), @DestinationTable = REPLACE(@DestinationTable, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ct_cd_dt NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(13), @stt_rec0 VARCHAR(3), @ma_dac_tinh VARCHAR(32)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dac_tinh, ct_cd_dt, line_nbr INTO #s FROM bid12$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dac_tinh, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu, line_nbr INTO #bia12 FROM bia12$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dac_tinh, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu, line_nbr INTO #d FROM #bia12

	-- Get data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #s select stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dac_tinh, ct_cd_dt, line_nbr from ' + QUOTENAME(@SourceTable) + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and ct_cd_dt <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@IDNumber varchar(13)', @IDNumber

	SELECT @i = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #s
	WHILE (@i IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @stt_rec = stt_rec, @stt_rec0 = stt_rec0, @ma_dac_tinh = ma_dac_tinh, @ct_cd_dt = ct_cd_dt FROM #s WHERE line_nbr = @i
		TRUNCATE TABLE #d
		EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_cd_dt, '#d', 'line_nbr, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu'
		EXEC sp_executesql N'insert into #bia12 (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dac_tinh, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu, line_nbr)
			select @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_dac_tinh, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu, line_nbr from #d order by line_nbr'
			, N'@stt_rec varchar(13), @stt_rec0 varchar(3), @ma_dac_tinh varchar(32), @ma_ct char(3)', @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_dac_tinh, @VoucherCode
		SELECT @i = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #s WHERE line_nbr > @i
	END

	IF @ResultType = 2 BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_dac_tinh, so_luong, ket_qua, dien_giai, danh_gia, sl_kd_nh2, ma_loi, ghi_chu, line_nbr FROM #bia12
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @DestinationTable + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber;insert into ' + QUOTENAME(@DestinationTable) + ' select * from #bia12;'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@IDNumber varchar(13)', @IDNumber

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryByLotItemSiteLocation]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportBy CHAR(1), -- 1 : Bao cao theo vat tu - lo , 2: Bao cao theo lo - vat tu
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : Nhom theo kho, vi tri , 2: Chi tiet theo kho, vi tri, 0: Khong xu lý
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: Thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(511), @NoDefine2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @NoDefine = RTRIM(cName), @NoDefine2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nodefine'

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap
		, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x
		INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, 0 AS stt2, 0 AS stt3, 0 AS stt4, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt
		, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, c.ten_vi_tri, c.ten_vi_tri2, a.ma_vt AS ma, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ten2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b, dmvitri c
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt2, stt3, stt4, ten_vi_tri, ten_vi_tri2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), numeric(5), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvitri]', 'c')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvitri]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmvitri c on a.ma_vi_tri = c.ma_vi_tri'

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	--  Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$SiteLocationItemLot @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, '', @Lot, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Lot <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Lot), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, a.sl_nhap, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with(nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE lo_yn = 1)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ton_dau), sum(a.du_dau), sum(a.du_dau_nt), sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n), sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.dvt), max(b.loai_vt), max(b.nh_vt1), max(c.ten_vi_tri), max(c.ten_vi_tri2), a.ma_vi_tri, max(c.ten_vi_tri), max(c.ten_vi_tri2)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmvitri c with(nolock) on a.ma_vi_tri = c.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vi_tri', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0
		AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat =0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0

	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(UPPER(@Group))) = 'LOAI_VT' BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vi_tri = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri), ten_vi_tri2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_lo, ma_vt, ma_kho, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 2,1,0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2),a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, '',
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, a.loai_vt
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri NVARCHAR(512)
			ALTER TABLE #report ALTER COLUMN ten_vi_tri2 NVARCHAR(512)
			UPDATE #report SET ten_vi_tri = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri), ten_vi_tri2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vi_tri2) WHERE systotal = 1
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_lo, ma_vt, ma_kho, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 2,1,0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, '',
					SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a.du_dau),SUM(a.du_dau_nt),SUM(a.sl_nhap),SUM(a.sl_xuat),
					SUM(a.tien_nhap),SUM(a.tien_xuat),SUM(a.tien_nt_n),SUM(a.tien_nt_x),SUM(a.ton_cuoi),
					SUM(a.du_cuoi),SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, a.nh_vt1
			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_lo, ma_vt, ma_kho, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_kho) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_kho2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_lo, ma_vt, ma_kho, ten, ten2, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, '' AS ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_vt) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_vt2) AS ten2, SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
				SUM(tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(ton_cuoi)  AS ton_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
			FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			WHERE a.systotal = 1
			GROUP BY a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_lo, ma_vt, ma_kho, ten, ten2,ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 1, 1, 0, a.ma_lo, N'' AS ma_vt, '' AS ma_kho, MAX(b.ten_lo) AS ten, MAX(b.ten_lo2) AS ten2,SUM(ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt,
				SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat,
