					, a.doi_tac, a.ma_so_thue, a.dia_chi, a.tk_nh, a.ngan_hang, a.tinh_thanh, a.ma_nt, a.ngay_ct, a.ky_hieu, a.so_ct, a.so_seri, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam
					, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN a.thue_suat0 = 0 AND (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') THEN '\' ELSE RTRIM(CAST(a.thue_suat0 AS INT)) + '%' END ELSE CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' OR so_luong = 0 THEN '\' ELSE c.thue_suat END END AS thue_suat
					, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.thanh_toan, a.thanh_toan2
					, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_nt_in_word, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word2, a.t_tt_in_word2, 0 AS fix_yn
					, a.so_bk, a.ngay_bk, a.thang_bk, a.nam_bk, a.dien_giai, a.customize, a.detail
					, thue_nt, thue
					, thue_nt_10, thue_10, thue_nt_5, thue_5, thue_nt_8, thue_8, thue_nt_0, thue_0, thue_nt_99, thue_99
					, tien_nt_10, tien_10, tien_nt_5, tien_5, tien_nt_8, tien_8, tien_nt_0, tien_0, tien_nt_99, tien_99
				FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
				ORDER BY a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, b.xGroup, a.line_nbr
		ELSE
			SELECT sysprint, line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec + RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
					, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
					, a.doi_tac, a.ma_so_thue, a.dia_chi, a.tk_nh, a.ngan_hang, a.tinh_thanh, a.ma_nt, a.ngay_ct, a.ky_hieu, a.so_ct, a.so_seri, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam
					, CASE WHEN @printVATDataDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN a.thue_suat0 = 0 AND (a.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR a.ma_thue = '') THEN '\' ELSE RTRIM(CAST(a.thue_suat0 AS INT)) + '%' END ELSE CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' OR so_luong = 0 THEN '\' ELSE c.thue_suat END END AS thue_suat
					, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.thanh_toan, a.thanh_toan2
					, a.t_tien2, a.t_tien_nt2, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_nt_in_word, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word2, a.t_tt_in_word2, 0 AS fix_yn
					, a.so_bk, a.ngay_bk, a.thang_bk, a.nam_bk, a.dien_giai, a.customize, a.detail
					, thue_nt, thue
					, thue_nt_10, thue_10, thue_nt_5, thue_5, thue_nt_8, thue_8, thue_nt_0, thue_0, thue_nt_99, thue_99
					, tien_nt_10, tien_10, tien_nt_5, tien_5, tien_nt_8, tien_8, tien_nt_0, tien_0, tien_nt_99, tien_99
				FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec
				ORDER BY a.ngay_ct DESC, a.so_ct DESC, a.stt_rec, b.xGroup, a.line_nbr
	END ELSE
		IF @Desc = 0
			SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
					, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
					, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam, thue_suat
					, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_kh, ten_kh2, thanh_toan, thanh_toan2
					, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word2, t_tt_in_word2, 0 AS fix_yn
					, so_bk, ngay_bk, thang_bk, nam_bk, dien_giai, customize, detail
				FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, b.xGroup, line_nbr
		ELSE
			SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
					, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
					, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam, thue_suat
					, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_kh, ten_kh2, thanh_toan, thanh_toan2
					, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word2, t_tt_in_word2, 0 AS fix_yn
					, so_bk, ngay_bk, thang_bk, nam_bk, dien_giai, customize, detail
				FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b ORDER BY ngay_ct DESC, so_ct DESC, stt_rec, b.xGroup, line_nbr
	IF @Copy = 1 BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
			SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec + RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
		END

		IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
			DECLARE @part CHAR(6), @t VARCHAR(33)
			SELECT DISTINCT part INTO #p FROM #master
			SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #p
			WHILE @part IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @t = REPLACE(@printTable, '%Partition', @part)
				SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @t + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
					+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @t + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @t + ' a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.part = ''' + @part + ''''
					+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
					+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @t + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ''HDA'', 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from #master where part = ''' + @part + ''''
					+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				--
				SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #p WHERE part > @part
			END
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetDayDepreciation] (
	@dFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@dTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@d0 SMALLDATETIME, -- Start date
	@d1 SMALLDATETIME, -- End
	@d2 SMALLDATETIME, -- Stop
	@d3 SMALLDATETIME -- Decrease
) RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @d0 < @dFrom SET @d0 = @dFrom
	IF @d2 IS NOT NULL AND @d1 > @d2 SET @d1 = @d2
	IF @d3 IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @d3 = @d3 - 1
		IF @d1 > @d3 SET @d1 = @d3
	END
	IF @d1 > @dTo SET @d1 = @dTo
	
	IF @d1 >= @d0 RETURN DATEDIFF(DAY, @d0, @d1 + 1)
	RETURN 0
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostDCClosed] @userID INT, @idNumber CHAR(13), @sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c52$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @lastUserID = 0, @xtype = ''

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm52$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd52$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i52$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'a52$000000'
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype FROM a52$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber ORDER BY stt DESC

	IF @lastUserID <> @userID OR @xtype <> '1' BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	--
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status = ''4'' and user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	SET @q = ' declare @xtag char(1) select @xtag = xtag from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = '''+ @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = xtag, xtag = '''', u_status = u_status0, u_status0 = '''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c52$000000 set status = @xtag  where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = @xtag where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2'
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIResultRecording]
	@cLan CHAR(1),
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128),
	@cDTable CHAR(16),
	@eDTable CHAR(16),
	@iDTable CHAR(16),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT rtrim(a.ma_cd) as ma_cd, rtrim(a.ma_dac_tinh) as ma_dac_tinh, a.so_luong, a.sl_mau, a.ket_qua, a.dien_giai, a.danh_gia, a.sl_kd_nh2, a.line_nbr, a.ghi_chu'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_dac_tinh' + @cE + ' AS ten_dac_tinh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', h.ten_loai' + @cE + ' AS ten_danh_gia'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', i.ten_loi' + @cE + ' AS ten_loi'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', z.ten_cd' + @cE + ' AS ten_cd'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', a.ma_cd + a.ma_dac_tinh AS xgroup'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmdactinh g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_dac_tinh = g.ma_dac_tinh'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dmloai h WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.danh_gia = h.ma_loai and h.nhom = ''13'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmloi i WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_loi = i.ma_loi'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@iDTable) + ' z WITH(NOLOCK) ON LEFT(a.stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(z.stt_rec, 10) and a.stt_rec0 = z.stt_rec0'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 '
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@eDTable) + ' a WHERE ' + @cDetailKey + ') BEGIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT '''' AS stt_rec, '''' AS stt_rec0, '''' AS ma_loi, 0 AS sl_loi, '''' AS ma_loai, '''' AS ma_ph_loai, '''' AS ghi_chu, 0 AS line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ', '''' AS ma_kho, '''' AS ten_loi, '''' AS ten_loai, '''' AS ten_ph_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' END'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ELSE BEGIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT a.* '
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', i.ten_loi' + @cE + ' AS ten_loi'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_loai' + @cE + ' AS ten_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', h.ten_ph_loai' + @cE + ' AS ten_ph_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@eDTable) + ' a '
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmloi i WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_loi = i.ma_loi'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmloailoi g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_loai = g.ma_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN bikddmphloailoi h WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ph_loai = h.ma_ph_loai'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey + ' ORDER BY line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' END'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetInsertGroup3
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(4), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	DECLARE @c1 VARCHAR(32), @c2 VARCHAR(32), @c3 VARCHAR(32), @c4 VARCHAR(32), @c5 VARCHAR(32), @c6 NVARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			IF EXISTS(SELECT xfieldkey FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @c1 = xfieldkey, @c2 = xtableref, @c3 = xfieldkeyref, @c4 = xfieldnameref, @c5 = xfieldnameref2, @c6 = xkeyref FROM v20tblref WHERE xfieldkey = @cItemGroup
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @c1 ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @c1
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.' + @c4 + '),MAX(b.' + @c5 + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ' + @c2 + ' WHERE ' + @c6 + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' b ON a.' + @c1 + ' = b.' + @c3 + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @c1 + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					SET @i = @i + 1
					IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),MAX(a.' + @cItemGroup + '),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a '
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' WHERE a.systotal = 1'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2 =  N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + 'WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2 = SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
					SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
				END
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', RTRIM(LTRIM(@cType)))
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockSummaryByItemLot]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Lot VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@CalculateTransfer CHAR(1),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group VARCHAR(1024),
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@ShowItem CHAR(1),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 : vat tu - lo , 2: lo - vat tu
	@DataType TINYINT, -- 1: thuc te , 2: Hoa don
	@ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType BIT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @NoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @NoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--  Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lo, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #t FROM wrkin
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong AS ton_dau, tien AS du_dau, tien_nt AS du_dau_nt, so_luong AS sl_nhap, tien AS tien_nhap, tien_nt AS tien_nt_n, so_luong AS sl_xuat, tien AS tien_xuat, tien_nt AS tien_nt_x INTO #tmp FROM #t
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.*, ton_dau AS ton_cuoi, du_dau AS du_cuoi, du_dau_nt AS du_cuoi_nt, b.dvt, b.loai_vt, b.nh_vt1, b.ten_vt AS ten_lo, b.ten_vt2 AS ten_lo2, b.ma_vt AS ma, b.ten_vt AS ten, b.ten_vt2 AS ten2 INTO #report FROM #tmp a, dmvt b
	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_lo, ten_lo2, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1', 'numeric(5), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), varchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(511), nvarchar(32), char(2), #')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @ItemType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	IF @ItemType + @ItemGroup1 + @ItemGroup2 + @ItemGroup3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	--  Balance
	INSERT INTO #t EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Lot @DateFrom, @Unit, @Site, @Lot, @Item, 1, @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT ma_lo, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 from #t

	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_lo <> '''''
	IF @CalculateTransfer = 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ct_dc <= ' + @CalculateTransfer
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @Lot <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_lo like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Lot), '''', '''''') + '%' + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET  @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		--  Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @q =  'insert into #tmp select a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt, 0, 0, 0, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from r70$%partition a with (nolock) ' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	DELETE #tmp WHERE ma_vt NOT IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM dmvt WHERE lo_yn = 1)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.ma_lo, a.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', sum(a.ton_dau), sum(a.du_dau), sum(a.du_dau_nt), sum(a.sl_nhap), sum(a.tien_nhap), sum(a.tien_nt_n), sum(a.sl_xuat), sum(a.tien_xuat), sum(a.tien_nt_x), 0, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(b.dvt), max(b.loai_vt), max(b.nh_vt1), MAX(c.ten_lo), MAX(c.ten_lo2), a.ma_lo, MAX(c.ten_lo), MAX(c.ten_lo2)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #tmp a left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmlo c with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt and a.ma_lo = c.ma_lo'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#report', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DELETE #report WHERE ton_dau = 0 AND du_dau = 0 AND du_dau_nt = 0 AND sl_nhap = 0 AND sl_xuat = 0
		AND tien_nhap = 0 AND tien_xuat =0 AND tien_nt_n = 0 AND tien_nt_x = 0

	UPDATE #report SET ton_cuoi = ton_dau + sl_nhap - sl_xuat, du_cuoi = du_dau + tien_nhap - tien_xuat, du_cuoi_nt = du_dau_nt + tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x

	IF @ShowItem = '1' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi = 0
	IF @ShowItem = '2' DELETE #report WHERE ton_cuoi <> 0

	-- Show item has only a foreign currency balances
	IF @ShowForeignCurrencyBalanceType = 0 DELETE FROM #report WHERE ton_dau + du_dau + sl_nhap + tien_nhap + sl_xuat + tien_xuat + ton_cuoi + du_cuoi = 0

	--Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024), @g VARCHAR(1024), @g1 VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = 'ma_vt'
	SELECT @g1 = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
		, @o = @g + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END + ', ' + @Order
	IF @Group <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g1, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
	--
	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = 'loai_vt' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ma_vt, ma_lo, ten, ten2, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
				SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.loai_vt, a.ma_vt, '', MAX(b.ten_vt), MAX(b.ten_vt2), SUM(a.ton_dau), SUM(a.du_dau), SUM(a.du_dau_nt), SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nt_n), SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.tien_xuat), SUM(a.tien_nt_x), SUM(a.ton_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt)
					FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.loai_vt, a.ma_vt

			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, loai_vt, ten, ten2, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
				SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.loai_vt, MAX(b.ten_loai_vt),MAX(b.ten_loai_vt2), '', ''
						, SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a. du_dau),SUM(a. du_dau_nt),SUM(a. sl_nhap),SUM(a. sl_xuat)
						, SUM(a. tien_nhap),SUM(a. tien_xuat),SUM(a. tien_nt_n),SUM(a. tien_nt_x),SUM(a. ton_cuoi)
						, SUM(a. du_cuoi),SUM(a. du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmloaivt b ON a.loai_vt = b.ma_loai_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.loai_vt

			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT loai_vt IS NULL
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ma_vt, ma_lo, ten, ten2, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
				SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.nh_vt1, a.ma_vt, '', MAX(b.ten_vt), MAX(b.ten_vt2), SUM(a.ton_dau) AS ton_dau, SUM(a.du_dau) AS du_dau, SUM(a.du_dau_nt) AS du_dau_nt, SUM(a.sl_nhap) AS sl_nhap, SUM(a.tien_nhap) AS tien_nhap, SUM(a.tien_nt_n) AS tien_nt_n, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat, SUM(a.tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat, SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x, SUM(a.ton_cuoi) AS ton_cuoi, SUM(a.du_cuoi) AS du_cuoi, SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt) AS du_cuoi_nt
					FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
					WHERE a.systotal = 1
					GROUP BY a.nh_vt1, a.ma_vt

			INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, nh_vt1, ten, ten2, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
 				SELECT 3, 1, 0, a.nh_vt1, MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),'', ''
 						, SUM(a.ton_dau),SUM(a. du_dau),SUM(a. du_dau_nt),SUM(a. sl_nhap),SUM(a. sl_xuat)
 						, SUM(a. tien_nhap),SUM(a. tien_xuat),SUM(a. tien_nt_n),SUM(a. tien_nt_x),SUM(a. ton_cuoi)
 						, SUM(a. du_cuoi),SUM(a. du_cuoi_nt) FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmnhvt b ON a.nh_vt1 = b.ma_nh
 					WHERE a.systotal = 1
 					GROUP BY a.nh_vt1

			SELECT @NoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @NoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE cCode = 'nogroup'
			UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, @NoGroup), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, @NoGroup2) WHERE systotal = 0 AND NOT nh_vt1 IS NULL
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ma_lo, ten, ten2, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
			SELECT 4, 1, 0, a.ma_vt, '', MAX(b.ten_vt), MAX(b.ten_vt2), SUM(a.ton_dau), SUM(a.du_dau), SUM(a.du_dau_nt), SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nhap), SUM(a.tien_nt_n), SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.tien_xuat), SUM(a.tien_nt_x), SUM(a.ton_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt)
				FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
				WHERE a.systotal = 1
				GROUP BY a.ma_vt
	END

	DECLARE @s1 AS NVARCHAR(128), @s12 AS NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @s1 = cname, @s12 = cname2 FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'total'

	INSERT INTO #report(ma_vt, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, sysorder, sysprint, systotal)
		VALUES ('', '', '', '', '', '', 1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_lo, ten, ten2, dvt, loai_vt, nh_vt1, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, '', @s1, @s12, '', '', '', SUM(a.ton_dau), SUM(a.du_dau), SUM(a.du_dau_nt), SUM(a.sl_nhap), SUM(a.sl_xuat), SUM(a.tien_nhap), SUM(a.tien_xuat), SUM(a.tien_nt_n), SUM(a.tien_nt_x), SUM(a.ton_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi), SUM(a.du_cuoi_nt)
			FROM #report a WHERE systotal = 1

	UPDATE #report SET ten = ISNULL(ten, ten_lo), ten2 = ISNULL(ten2, ten_lo2)
	IF @Group = ''
		UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(2) + ten, ten2 = SPACE(2) + ten2, ma = SPACE(2) + ma WHERE sysorder = 5
	ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(2) + ten, ten2 = SPACE(2) + ten2, ma = SPACE(2) + ma WHERE sysorder = 4
		UPDATE #report SET ten = SPACE(4) + ten, ten2 = SPACE(4) + ten2, ma = SPACE(4) + ma WHERE sysorder = 5
	END
	UPDATE #report SET ma = ma_vt WHERE sysorder = 4

	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement
	--

	SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, '''' as ma_kho, '''' as ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma, ten, ten2, dvt, ton_dau, du_dau, du_dau_nt, sl_nhap, tien_nhap, tien_nt_n, sl_xuat, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x, ton_cuoi, du_cuoi, du_cuoi_nt'
	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@Group)) = ''
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ma_vt, ' + @Order + ', sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@Group, 'ma_vt, ' + @Order + ', sysorder') + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesServiceInvoiceList] --fS_ARList--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Salesman VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1024), -- danh sach cac chung tu chon
	@VoucherCodeList VARCHAR(1024), -- danh sach cac chung tu trong man hinh lookup
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Contact VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @r NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Key2 NVARCHAR(1024), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @s NVARCHAR(512), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @para NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKeyPayment NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct AS so_ct0, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, dien_giai, a.ma_nvbh
			, t_tien2 AS tien2, t_tien_nt2 AS tien_nt2, t_ck AS ck, t_ck_nt AS ck_nt, t_tien2 + a.t_thue - a.t_ck AS pt, t_tien_nt2 + a.t_thue_nt - a.t_ck_nt AS pt_nt
			, t_thue AS thue, t_thue_nt AS thue_nt, a.ma_nt, ty_gia
		INTO #report FROM wrkar a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct ORDER BY 1

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.tk, a.ma_kh, b.ma_vv, a.dien_giai
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.t_thue, a.t_tien2, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tien_nt2
		INTO #ph22 FROM m22$000000 a, d22$000000 b

	-- Para
	SELECT @para = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''), 3, ':')
	SELECT @VoucherCode = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetWordNum(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''), 2, ':'), 1, ';')
	SELECT @filterKeyPayment = '((ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@para, '(-)', ''), '(', ''' and loai_ct = '''), ')', ''), ',', ''') or (ma_ct = ''') + '''))'
	IF CHARINDEX('-', @para) > 0 SELECT @filterKeyPayment = 'not ' + @filterKeyPayment

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @VoucherCodeList <> ''
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCodeList, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	ELSE
		SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_nvbh like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kh like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_vv like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Contact <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_hd like ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contact), '''', '''''') + '%' + CHAR(39)
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'like', @Account)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable))) BEGIN
		SELECT a.name, b.name AS [type], a.prec INTO #struct FROM tempdb..syscolumns a LEFT JOIN tempdb..systypes b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID('tempdb..' + @DynamicKeyTable) AND b.name IN ('char', 'nvarchar', 'varchar', 'decimal', 'int', 'tinyint', 'datetime', 'smalldatetime')
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #struct WHERE name = 'filterkey') BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE #t1 (a int)
			SELECT @q = ''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'alter table #t1 add ' + [name] + ' ' + RTRIM([type]) + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('char', [type]) > 0 THEN '(' + RTRIM(prec) + ')' ELSE '' END + ' null' FROM #struct
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			ALTER TABLE #t1 DROP COLUMN a
			SELECT TOP 1 * INTO #t2 FROM #t1
			--
			SELECT @q = 'insert into #t1 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) <= 0'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #t2 select * from ' + @DynamicKeyTable + ' where charindex(''so_ct_hddt'', filterkey) > 0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t1', @filterKey OUTPUT
		END
	END
	SELECT @Key2 = @Key
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
	IF ISNULL(@filterKeyPayment, '') <> '' SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKeyPayment
	--
	SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report '
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, '''', a.tk, a.ma_kh, isnull(a.ma_vv, ''''), dien_giai, a.ma_nvbh'
	SET @q = @q + ', t_tien2 as tien2, t_tien_nt2 as tien_nt2, isnull(t_ck, 0) as ck, isnull(t_ck_nt, 0) as ck_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', t_tien2 + a.t_thue - isnull(a.t_ck, 0) as pt, t_tien_nt2 + a.t_thue_nt - isnull(a.t_ck_nt, 0) as pt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', t_thue as thue, t_thue_nt as thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_dtable('cttt20') + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' +  CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''') ' + @Key2
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Reset
	SET @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_bp', 'b.ma_bp')
	IF ISNULL(@filterKey, '') <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'b')
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q =  'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, max(a.ma_ct), max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.so_ct), '''', max(a.tk), max(a.ma_kh), isnull(max(b.ma_vv), ''''), max(a.dien_giai), isnull(max(a.ma_nvbh), '''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', - max(t_tien2), case when max(a.ma_nt) <> ''@m_ma_nt0'' then - max(t_tien_nt2) else 0 end, 0, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ', - (max(t_tien2) + max(a.t_thue)), case when max(a.ma_nt) <> ''@m_ma_nt0'' then - (max(t_tien_nt2) + max(a.t_thue_nt)) else 0 end'
	SET @q = @q + ', - max(t_thue), case when max(a.ma_nt) <> ''@m_ma_nt0'' then - max(t_thue_nt) else 0 end'
	SET @q = @q + ', max(a.ma_nt), max(ty_gia)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from m22$%Partition a with(nolock) join d22$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status not in (''*'', ''0'', ''9'')' + @Key + ']%'
	IF ((CHARINDEX(',HD2,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCodeList, ' ', '') + ',') > 0) OR (@VoucherCodeList = '' AND CHARINDEX(',HD2,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', '') + ',') > 0)) BEGIN
		SET @r = @q + ' group by a.stt_rec'
		SET @r = REPLACE(@r, '@m_ma_nt0', @m_ma_nt0)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @r, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	--
	IF ((CHARINDEX(',HD4,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCodeList, ' ', '') + ',') > 0) OR (@VoucherCodeList = '' AND CHARINDEX(',HD4,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', '') + ',') > 0)) BEGIN
		SET @r = ''
		SET @r = @q + ' and loai_ct = ''1'''
		SET @r = @r + ' group by a.stt_rec'
		SET @r = REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '22$', '25$'), '@m_ma_nt0', @m_ma_nt0)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @r, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END
	--
	IF ((CHARINDEX(',HD6,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCodeList, ' ', '') + ',') > 0) OR (@VoucherCodeList = '' AND CHARINDEX(',HD6,', ',' + REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', '') + ',') > 0)) BEGIN
		SET @r = ''
		SET @r = @q + ' and loai_ct = ''1'' and (a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' +  CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''')'
		SET @r = @r + ' group by a.stt_rec'
		SET @r = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@r, '22$%Partition', '42$000000'), '@m_ma_nt0', @m_ma_nt0), '%[', ''), ']%', '')
		EXEC sp_executesql @r
	END

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'

	IF ((ISNULL(@DynamicKeyTable, '') <> '') OR @PrintType = 1) AND OBJECT_ID (N'hddt00$' + (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_gh1, 112) FROM dmstt), N'U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, so_ct INTO #hd FROM #report
		-- Dynamic
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey '#t2', @filterKey OUTPUT
		SET @filterKey = REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a')
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #hd select stt_rec, so_ct_hddt from hddt00$%Partition a where %[exists (select 1 from #report b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)' + CASE WHEN @filterKey <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @filterKey + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		IF @PrintType = 1 UPDATE #report SET so_ct0 = b.so_ct FROM #report a JOIN #hd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		IF @filterKey<> '' DELETE #report FROM #report a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #hd b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	END

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vv, dien_giai, a.ma_nvbh
			, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, thue, thue_nt, a.ma_nt, ty_gia, b.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		INTO #report2
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #report2)
		INSERT INTO #report2 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #report2 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 0, 0)

	INSERT INTO #report2 (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ten_kh, ten_kh2, tien2, tien_nt2, thue, thue_nt, ck, ck_nt, pt, pt_nt, stt_rec, ma_ct0, ma_ct)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, @s, SUM(tien2), SUM(tien_nt2), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(ck), SUM(ck_nt), SUM(pt), SUM(pt_nt), '', '', ''
		FROM #report2
	SELECT * FROM #report2 ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialAnalysisMultiPeriodSave]
	@IDNumber0 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber1 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber2 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber3 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber4 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber5 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber6 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber7 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber8 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@IDNumber9 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@Unit VARCHAR(512), -- đơn vị
	@PeriodFrom INT, -- kỳ 1
	@YearFrom INT,-- năm 1
	@ReportCode CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo
	@ReportCodeNote CHAR(2), -- mã báo cáo dùng cho phần đánh giá
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- dạng báo cáo
	@PeriodType CHAR(1),-- loại kỳ
	@PeriodNo INT, -- số kỳ
	@Form CHAR(16),-- mẫu báo cáo
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	CREATE TABLE #tmp(ma_so VARCHAR(16), cot CHAR(2), chu NVARCHAR(256), so NUMERIC(28, 6), ngay SMALLDATETIME, ky_so INT)
	IF @IDNumber0 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber0
	IF @IDNumber1 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber1
	IF @IDNumber2 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber2
	IF @IDNumber3 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber3
	IF @IDNumber4 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber4
	IF @IDNumber5 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber5
	IF @IDNumber6 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber6
	IF @IDNumber7 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber7
	IF @IDNumber8 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber8
	IF @IDNumber9 <> '' EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisTranferData '#tmp', @IDNumber9

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @periodAdd TINYINT, @Year INT, @Year2 INT, @Period INT, @Period2 INT, @i INT, @PeriodCount INT

	SELECT @periodAdd =
		CASE 
			WHEN @PeriodType = 1 THEN 1
			WHEN @PeriodType = 2 THEN 3
			WHEN @PeriodType = 3 THEN 6
			WHEN @PeriodType = 4 THEN 12
		END
	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom)

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạm
	SELECT MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*(ky_so-1), @dateFrom)) AS ky1, YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*(ky_so-1), @dateFrom)) AS nam1
			, MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*ky_so, @dateFrom) - 1) AS ky2, YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*ky_so, @dateFrom) - 1) AS nam2
			, ma_so, cot, ngay, so, chu
		INTO #tmp2 FROM #tmp WHERE cot NOT IN (1, 2)

	-- Delete giá trị
	DELETE gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99 a JOIN #tmp2 b ON a.ky1 = b.ky1 AND a.nam1 = b.nam1 AND a.ky2 = b.ky2 AND a.nam2 = b.nam2 AND a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND a.cot = b.cot
		WHERE a.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_bc = @ReportCode AND a.dang_bc = @ReportType AND a.loai_ky = 1 AND a.so_ky = 1 AND a.form = @Form

	-- Insert giá trị
	INSERT INTO gltcpt99 (ky1, nam1, ky2, nam2, ma_dvcs, ma_bc, dang_bc, loai_ky, so_ky, form, ma_so, cot, ngay, so, chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT ky1, nam1, ky2, nam2, @Unit, @ReportCode, @ReportType, 1, 1 , @Form, ma_so, cot, ngay, so, chu, 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #tmp2

	-- Delete đánh giá
	DELETE gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99 a JOIN #tmp b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND a.cot = b.cot
		WHERE ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky2 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearFrom AND a.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND a.ma_bc = @ReportCodeNote AND a.dang_bc = @ReportType
			AND a.loai_ky = @PeriodType AND a.so_ky = @PeriodNo AND a.form = @Form AND a.cot IN(1, 2)

	-- Insert đánh giá
	INSERT INTO gltcpt99 (ky1, nam1, ky2, nam2, ma_dvcs, ma_bc, dang_bc, loai_ky, so_ky, form, ma_so, cot, ngay, so, chu, status, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @Unit, @ReportCodeNote, @ReportType, @PeriodType, @PeriodNo, @Form, ma_so, cot, ngay, so, chu, 1, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @UserID, @UserID
			FROM #tmp WHERE cot IN(1, 2)

	--
	DROP TABLE #tmp
	DROP TABLE #tmp2

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$List$EditLog]
	@primeField VARCHAR(1024),
	@oldValue VARCHAR(1024),
	@newValue VARCHAR(1024),
	@controller VARCHAR(128),
	@type VARCHAR(32), -- 1. Edit Logs, 2. Delete Logs
	@tableDestination VARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@dNow DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF ISNULL(@controller, '') = '' RETURN

	SELECT @primeField = REPLACE(REPLACE(@primeField, ' ', ''), '''', ''), @oldValue = REPLACE(@oldValue, '''', ''), @newValue = REPLACE(@newValue, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @idLog INT, @dLog DATETIME, @And CHAR(1), @logDay INT, @$type$Log TINYINT
	DECLARE @rootTable VARCHAR(64), @rootLogTable VARCHAR(64), @rootLogRefTable VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @refLogTable VARCHAR(64), @refTableList VARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @$new$Select VARCHAR(512), @$old$Where VARCHAR(512), @$old$Log$Where VARCHAR(512), @$new$Log$Update VARCHAR(512), @$k$Join VARCHAR(512), @$k$Log VARCHAR(512)
	DECLARE @f$ VARCHAR(1024), @k$Old VARCHAR(1024), @k$New VARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @i = 0, @idLog = 0, @dNow = ISNULL(@dNow, GETDATE()), @And = ',', @logDay = 366, @q = '', @$old$Where = '', @$old$Log$Where = '', @$new$Log$Update = '', @$new$Select = '', @$k$Join = '', @$k$Log= ''

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 1 @rootTable = REPLACE(xtable, '''', ''), @refTableList = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, ' ', ''), '''', ''), @logDay = logday, @rootLogTable = REPLACE(xtable, '''', '') + '$log', @$type$Log = xtype FROM dmlistlog WHERE controller = @controller

	IF ISNULL(@rootTable, '') = '' OR OBJECT_ID(@rootTable) IS NULL RETURN
	IF @tableDestination <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT * INTO #desTableList FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@tableDestination, ',')
		DELETE #desTableList WHERE CHARINDEX(',' + RTRIM(data) + ',', ',' + RTRIM(@refTableList) + ',') <= 0
		DELETE #desTableList WHERE data = @rootTable
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #desTableList) SELECT @refTableList = ''
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @refTableList = ''
			SELECT @refTableList = @refTableList + CASE WHEN @refTableList <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(data) FROM #desTableList
			SELECT @refTableList = REPLACE(REPLACE(@refTableList, ' ', ''), '''', '')
		END
	END
	SELECT * INTO #refTableList FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@refTableList, ',')

	-- Field
	SELECT @dLog = DATEADD(DAY, -@logDay, @dNow)
	IF @$type$Log IN (1, 3, 4) BEGIN
		SELECT * INTO #pField FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@primeField, @And)
		SELECT * INTO #oValue FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@oldValue, @And)
		SELECT * INTO #nValue FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@newValue, @And)

		SELECT a.name AS col, b.name AS col_type, a.[length], a.xprec, a.xscale, RTRIM(d.data) AS value_old, RTRIM(e.data) AS value_new, c.id INTO #pFieldType FROM syscolumns a JOIN systypes b ON a.xtype = b.xtype AND a.xusertype = b.xusertype JOIN #pField c ON a.name = RTRIM(c.data) JOIN #oValue d ON c.id = d.id JOIN #nValue e ON c.id = e.id WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID(@rootTable)
		IF @$type$Log IN (1, 3) BEGIN
			SELECT @$k$Join = @$k$Join + CASE WHEN @$k$Join <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + RTRIM(data) + '_n = b.' + RTRIM(data) + '_n', @$k$Log = @$k$Log + CASE WHEN @$k$Log <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '' + @rootLogTable + '.' + RTRIM(data) + '_n = b.' + RTRIM(data) FROM #pField
			SELECT @$old$Where = @$old$Where + CASE WHEN @$old$Where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(a.data) + ' = ''' + RTRIM(b.data) + '''', @$old$Log$Where = @$old$Log$Where + CASE WHEN @$old$Log$Where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(a.data) + '_n = ''' + RTRIM(b.data) + '''' FROM #pField a JOIN #oValue b ON a.id = b.id
			SELECT @$new$Select = @$new$Select + CASE WHEN @$new$Select <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'cast(' + CASE WHEN c.col_type IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN '''' + RTRIM(b.data) + '''' WHEN c.col_type IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC', 'TINYINT', 'INT') THEN RTRIM(b.data) ELSE 'null' END + ' as ' + RTRIM(c.col_type) + CASE WHEN c.col_type IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN '(' + RTRIM(c.[length]) + ')' WHEN c.col_type IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC') THEN '(' + RTRIM(c.xprec) + ',' + RTRIM(c.xscale) + ')' ELSE '' END + ') as '+ RTRIM(a.data) + '_n'
					, @$new$Log$Update = @$new$Log$Update + CASE WHEN @$new$Log$Update <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(a.data) + '_n = ''' + RTRIM(b.data) + ''''
				FROM #pField a JOIN #nValue b ON a.id = b.id JOIN #pFieldType c ON RTRIM(a.data) = c.col
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @rootLogTable = 'm$list$log', @rootLogRefTable = 'd$list$log', @f$ = '', @k$Old = '', @k$New = '', @$old$Log$Where = 'k_n = @k', @$k$Log = ''
			SELECT @$k$Log = @$k$Log + CASE WHEN @$k$Log <> '' THEN ' + ' ELSE '''$'' + ' END + CASE WHEN col_type IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), b.' + col + ', 103) + ''$''' WHEN col_type IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(col) + ' as nvarchar(4000)))) + ''$''' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(col) + ')) + ''$''' END
				, @$old$Where = @$old$Where + CASE WHEN @$old$Where <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(col) + ' = ' + CASE WHEN col_type IN ('datetime') THEN 'convert(datetime, ''' + value_old + ''', 103)' WHEN col_type IN ('smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(smalldatetime, ''' + value_old + ''', 103)' WHEN col_type IN ('numeric', 'decimal', 'int', 'tinyint') THEN RTRIM(value_old) ELSE '''' + RTRIM(value_old) + '''' END, @k$Old = @k$Old + CASE WHEN @k$Old <> '' THEN '' ELSE '$' END + RTRIM(value_old) + '$', @k$New = @k$New + CASE WHEN @k$New <> '' THEN '' ELSE '$' END + RTRIM(value_new) + '$' FROM #pFieldType ORDER BY id
		END
	END ELSE SELECT @$k$Join = 'a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', @$k$Log = '' + @rootLogTable + '.stt_rec = b.stt_rec', @$old$Where = 'stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@newValue) + '''', @$old$Log$Where = 'stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@newValue) + '''', @$new$Select = '', @$new$Log$Update = ''

	-- Delete
	IF SUBSTRING(@type, 1, 1) = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList
		WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @refLogTable = REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log', @q = 'delete ' + REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log where ' + @$old$Log$Where FROM #refTableList WHERE id = @i
			IF OBJECT_ID(@refLogTable) IS NOT NULL EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList WHERE id > @i
		END
		IF OBJECT_ID(@rootLogTable) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			IF @$type$Log IN (1, 2, 3) SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @rootLogTable + ' where ' + @$old$Log$Where
			ELSE SELECT @q = 'delete m$list$log where c = @c and k_n = @k;delete d$list$log where c = @c and k_n = @k;'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k varchar(1024)', @controller, @k$Old
		END
		RETURN
	END

	-- Logs
	SELECT @q = 'select @idLog = isnull(max(idLog), 0) + 1 from ' + @rootLogTable + ' where ' + @$old$Log$Where + CASE WHEN @$type$Log = 4 THEN ' and c = @c' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @idLog int output, @k varchar(1024)', @controller, @idLog OUTPUT, @k$Old

	IF @$type$Log IN (1, 2, 3) BEGIN
		SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList
		WHILE @i IS NOT NULL AND @$type$Log <> 3 BEGIN
			SELECT @refTable = REPLACE(data, '''', ''), @refLogTable = REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log' FROM #refTableList WHERE id = @i

			IF OBJECT_ID(@refTable) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @logDay <> 0 THEN 'delete ' + @refLogTable + ' from ' + @rootLogTable + ' a join ' + @refLogTable + ' b on ' + RTRIM(@$k$Join) + ' and a.idlog = b.idlog where a.[datetime_log] < @dLog' ELSE '' END + '
select @idLog as idlog' + CASE WHEN @$type$Log IN (1, 3) THEN ', ' + RTRIM(@$new$Select) ELSE '' END + ', * into #Log from ' + @refTable + ' where ' + @$old$Where + '
' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@refLogTable,'#Log', @refLogTable, @refLogTable, '1=1', NULL)
				IF @$type$Log IN (1, 3) SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @refLogTable + ' set ' + @$new$Log$Update + ' where ' + @$old$Log$Where
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idLog int, @dNow datetime, @dLog datetime', @idLog, @dNow, @dLog
			END
			--
			SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList WHERE id > @i
		END

		SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @logDay <> 0 THEN 'delete ' + @rootLogTable + ' where [datetime_log] < @dLog' ELSE '' END + '
select @idLog as idlog, @dNow as datetime_log' + CASE WHEN @$type$Log IN (1, 3) THEN ', ' + RTRIM(@$new$Select) ELSE '' END + ', * into #Log from ' + @rootTable + ' where ' + @$old$Where + '
' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$App$Insert(@rootLogTable, '#Log', @rootLogTable, @rootLogTable, '1=1', null)
		IF @$type$Log IN (1, 3) SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @rootLogTable + ' set ' + @$new$Log$Update + ' where ' + @$old$Log$Where
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idLog int, @dNow datetime, @dLog datetime', @idLog, @dNow, @dLog
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @f$Value VARCHAR(64), @n INT, @f$Amount VARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @f$Amount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'

		-- Delete Logs
		IF @logDay <> 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'delete d$list$log from d$list$log a join m$list$log b on a.c = b.c where b.[datetime_log] < @dLog;delete m$list$log where [datetime_log] < @dLog;'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dLog datetime', @dLog
		END

		-- Detail Logs
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS xtype, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #t

		-- ++ Pri
		INSERT INTO #t (name, xtype) SELECT a.name, b.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN systypes b on a.xtype = b.xtype and a.xusertype = b.xusertype AND b.name <> 'sysname' WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID(@rootTable) AND a.name NOT IN ('datetime0', 'user_id0', 'datetime2', 'user_id2') ORDER BY a.colorder
		SELECT @i = 1, @n = COUNT(id) FROM #t
		WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
			SELECT @q = '
update d$list$log
	set xvalue_new = ' + CASE WHEN xtype IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), b.' + name + ', 103)' WHEN xtype IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + name + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN xtype IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(name) + '))' END + '
	from d$list$log a join ' + RTRIM(@rootTable) + ' b on a.c = @c and a.k_n = @k$Old and a.idLog = (@idlog - 1) and a.xtable = @t and a.xfield = ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''' and a.k_n = (' + RTRIM(@$k$Log) + ') where b.' + REPLACE(@$old$Where, ' and ', ' and b.') + '
delete d$list$log where c = @c and k_n = @k$Old and xtable = @t and xfield = ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''' and (xvalue_old = xvalue_new or (xvalue_old is null and xvalue_new is null))
insert into d$list$log (c, k_n, idlog, xtable, xfield, xvalue_old, xline_nbr)
	select @c, @k$New, @idlog, @t, ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''', ' + CASE WHEN xtype IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), ' + name + ', 103)' WHEN xtype IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(' + name + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN xtype IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(' + RTRIM(name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(' + RTRIM(name) + '))' END + ', 0
	from ' + RTRIM(@rootTable) + ' where ' + @$old$Where FROM #t WHERE id = @i
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@c varchar(128), @k$New varchar(1024), @k$Old varchar(1024), @t varchar(64), @idLog int, @dLog datetime, @dNow datetime, @f$Amount varchar(128)'
				, @controller, @k$New, @k$Old, @rootTable, @idLog, @dLog, @dNow, @f$Amount

			SELECT @i = @i + 1
		END

		-- ++ Ref
		SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList
		WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @$k$Join = '', @f$Value = '', @f$ = ',xline_nbr', @$k$Join = ' and a.xline_nbr = b.line_nbr', @f$Value = ',line_nbr'
			SELECT @refTable = REPLACE(data, '''', '') FROM #refTableList WHERE id = @i

			TRUNCATE TABLE #t
			INSERT INTO #t (name, xtype) SELECT a.name, b.name FROM syscolumns a JOIN systypes b on a.xtype = b.xtype and a.xusertype = b.xusertype AND b.name <> 'sysname' WHERE a.id = OBJECT_ID(@refTable) AND a.name NOT IN ('datetime0', 'user_id0', 'datetime2', 'user_id2') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #pField c WHERE a.name = c.data) ORDER BY a.colorder
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t WHERE name = 'line_nbr') SELECT @$k$Join = ' and a.xline_nbr = b.line_nbr', @f$Value = ',line_nbr'
			ELSE SELECT @f$Value = ',0'
			DELETE #t WHERE name = 'line_nbr'
			SELECT @i = MIN(id), @n = MAX(id) FROM #t
			WHILE @i <= @n BEGIN
				SELECT @q = ''
				SELECT @q = '
update d$list$log
	set xvalue_new = ' + CASE WHEN xtype IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), b.' + name + ', 103)' WHEN xtype IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + name + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN xtype IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(name) + '))' END + '
	from d$list$log a join ' + RTRIM(@refTable) + ' b on a.c = @c and a.k_n = @k$Old and a.idLog = (@idlog - 1) and a.xtable = @t and a.xfield = ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''' and a.k_n = (' + RTRIM(@$k$Log) + ')' + @$k$Join + ' where b.' + REPLACE(@$old$Where, ' and ', ' and b.') + '
insert into d$list$log (c, k_n, idlog, xtable, xfield, xvalue_new' + RTRIM(@f$) + ')
	select @c, @k$Old, @idlog - 1, @t, ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''', ' + CASE WHEN xtype IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), ' + name + ', 103)' WHEN xtype IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(' + name + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN xtype IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(' + RTRIM(name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(' + RTRIM(name) + '))' END + RTRIM(@f$Value) + '
	from ' + RTRIM(@refTable) + ' where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@$k$Log), 'b.', '') + ' = @k$Old and line_nbr > (select isnull(max(xline_nbr), 0) from d$list$log where c = @c and k_n = @k$Old and idLog = (@idlog - 1) and xtable = @t and xfield = ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''')
delete d$list$log where c = @c and k_n = @k$Old and xtable = @t and xfield = ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''' and (xvalue_old = xvalue_new or (xvalue_old is null and xvalue_new is null))
insert into d$list$log (c, k_n, idlog, xtable, xfield, xvalue_old' + RTRIM(@f$) + ')
	select @c, @k$New, @idlog, @t, ''' + RTRIM(name) + ''', ' + CASE WHEN xtype IN ('datetime', 'smalldatetime') THEN 'convert(varchar(32), ' + name + ', 103)' WHEN xtype IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(' + name + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN xtype IN ('text', 'ntext') THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(' + RTRIM(name) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(' + RTRIM(name) + '))' END + RTRIM(@f$Value) + '
	from ' + RTRIM(@refTable) + ' where ' + @$old$Where + ' group by ' + RTRIM(name) + RTRIM(@f$Value) + '' FROM #t WHERE id = @i
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
					, N'@c varchar(128), @k$New varchar(1024), @k$Old varchar(1024), @t varchar(64), @idLog int, @dLog datetime, @dNow datetime, @f$Amount varchar(128)'
					, @controller, @k$New, @k$Old, @refTable, @idLog, @dLog, @dNow, @f$Amount
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
			SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #refTableList WHERE id > @i
		END

		-- Master Logs
		SELECT @q = 'insert into m$list$log (c, k_n, k, idlog, datetime_log, datetime2, user_id2) select @c, @k$New, @k$Old, @idlog, @dNow, datetime2, user_id2 from ' + RTRIM(@rootTable) + ' where ' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@$k$Log, 'b.', '')) + ' = @k$Old;' + CASE WHEN @k$New <> @k$Old THEN 'update m$list$log set k_n = @k$New where c = @c and k_n = @k$Old;update d$list$log set k_n = @k$New where c = @c and k_n = @k$Old;' ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k$New varchar(1024), @k$Old varchar(1024), @t varchar(64), @idLog int, @dLog datetime, @dNow datetime', @controller, @k$New, @k$Old, @rootTable, @idLog, @dLog, @dNow
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptJournalVoucherRegisterBook] -- fs30_JournalVCRegBook15
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(511), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, b.stt AS stt, b.dien_giai AS dien_giai, ps_no  AS tien, ps_no_nt AS tien_nt				
		INTO #report
		FROM wrkgl a LEFT JOIN ctgs b ON a.ngay_ctgs = b.ngay_ctgs AND a.so_ctgs = b.so_ctgs
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.so_ctgs <> '''' and isnull(a.ps_no, 0) + isnull(a.ps_no_nt, 0) <> 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs, max(b.stt) as stt, max(b.dien_giai) as dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q	+ ', sum(ps_no + ps_co) as tien, sum(ps_no_nt + ps_co_nt) as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) left join ctgs b on a.ngay_ctgs = b.ngay_ctgs and a.so_ctgs = b.so_ctgs'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ngay_ctgs, a.so_ctgs'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @s = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE UPPER(ccode) = 'TOTAL'
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) SELECT 0, 0, 0, @s, SUM(Tien), SUM(Tien_nt) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt) VALUES (1, 0, 0, '', 0, 0)

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ngay_ctgs, so_ctgs, dien_giai, tien, tien_nt, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Tag, convert(char(10), ngay_ctgs, 112) as ngay
		FROM #report
		ORDER BY sysorder, ngay_ctgs, stt, so_ctgs

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmttckct]
AS
	SELECT a.*,
		ISNULL(b.ten_dvcs, '') AS ten_ma_dvcs, ISNULL(b.ten_dvcs2, '') AS ten_ma_dvcs2,
		ISNULL(c.ten_ct, '') AS ten_ct, ISNULL(c.ten_ct2, '') AS ten_ct2,
		ISNULL(d.ten_loai, '') AS ten_loai_ct, ISNULL(d.ten_loai2, '') AS ten_loai_ct2,
		ISNULL(e.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh_kho, ISNULL(e.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh_kho2,
		ISNULL(f.ten_kho, '') AS ten_kho, ISNULL(f.ten_kho2, '') AS ten_kho2,
		ISNULL(g.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(g.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2,
		ISNULL(h.ten_tk, '') AS ten_tk, ISNULL(h.ten_tk2, '') AS ten_tk2,
		ISNULL(i.comment, '') AS comment, ISNULL(i.comment2, '') AS comment2,
		ISNULL(k.ten_loai, '') AS ten_loai, ISNULL(k.ten_loai2, '') AS ten_loai2,
		ISNULL(l.ten_nk, '') AS ten_nk, ISNULL(l.ten_nk2, '') AS ten_nk2
	FROM dbo.dmttckct a
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmloaict d ON (a.ma_ct =  '' OR a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct) AND a.loai_ct = d.loai_ct
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkho e ON a.nh_kho = e.ma_nh
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmkho f ON (a.ma_dvcs =  '' OR a.ma_dvcs = f.ma_dvcs) AND a.ma_kho = f.ma_kho
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmbp g ON a.ma_bp = g.ma_bp
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmtk h ON a.tk = h.tk
		LEFT JOIN dbo.vsysuserinfo i ON a.[user_id] = i.id
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmttckloai j ON a.ma_ttck = j.ma_ttck AND a.ma_loai = j.ma_loai
		LEFT JOIN dbo.dmttckloaixl k ON j.xu_ly = k.xu_ly and a.loai = k.loai
		LEFT JOIN dbo.v20dmnk l ON a.ma_nk = l.ma_nk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_BeforUpdateSO]
	@Dyn VARCHAR(33),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @cTranType VARCHAR(2), @i64$Table VARCHAR(33), @i61$Table VARCHAR(33), @m64$Table VARCHAR(33), @m61$Table VARCHAR(33), @d64$Table VARCHAR(33), @d61$Table VARCHAR(33), @q NVARCHAR(4000) 
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m64 FROM m64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_bg INTO #d64b FROM d64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd INTO #d64c FROM d64$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so INTO #d64a FROM d64$000000
	SELECT @i64$Table = 'i64$' + @Dyn, @i61$Table = 'i61$' + @Dyn, @m64$Table = 'm64$' + @Dyn, @m61$Table = 'm61$' + @Dyn, @d64$Table = 'd64$' + @Dyn, @d61$Table = 'd61$' + @Dyn
	SET @q = 'insert into #m64 select * from ' + @m64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @cTranType =  RTRIM(loai_ct) FROM #m64 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber

	-- Update Allocated Qty
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64a select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSQIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSQIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_bg, stt_rec0bg, so_luong, he_so FROM #d64a
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @cSQIDNumber, @cLineSQIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@cSQIDNumber)) <> '' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@cLineSQIDNumber)) <> '' BEGIN
				SET @q = 'update ' + @d61$Table + ' set sl_dh = sl_dh - case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, 3) end'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END
			IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@cSCIDNumber)) <> '' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@cLineSCIDNumber)) <> '' BEGIN									
				SET @q = 'update ' + @d64$Table + ' set sl_dh = sl_dh - case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, 3) end'
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				IF @cTranType = '3' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @d64$Table + ' set sl_xuat = sl_xuat - case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round(' + RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, 3) end,'
					SET @q = @q + 'sl_giao = sl_giao - case when he_so = 0 then 0 else round('+ RTRIM(@nQty*@nRate) + '/he_so, 3) end'
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec0 = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
					EXEC sp_executesql @q
				END
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @cSQIDNumber,  @cLineSQIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update SQ
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64b select stt_rec_bg from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec_bg <> '''' and stt_rec0bg <> '''' group by stt_rec_bg'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_bg FROM #d64b
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSQIDNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @q = 'if not exists (select 1 from ' + @d61$Table + ' where sl_dh > 0 and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m61$Table + ' set status = ''1'' WHERE stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status = ''2'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i61$Table + ' set status = ''1'' WHERE stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status = ''2'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c61$000000 set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ' +  CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and status = ''2'''
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m61$Table + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSQIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSQIDNumber
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update SC
	SET @q = 'insert into #d64c select stt_rec_hd from ' + @d64$Table + ' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + @IDNumber + CHAR(39) + ' and stt_rec_hd <> '''' and stt_rec0hd <> '''' group by stt_rec_hd'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd FROM #d64c
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @q = 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if not exists (select 1 from ' + @d64$Table + ' where sl_xuat > 0 and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')' + CHAR(13) + 'begin'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ' and (status = ''3'' or status = ''4'')' + CHAR(13) + 'end'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'if exists (select 1 from ' + @d64$Table + ' where sl_xuat < so_luong and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + ')' + CHAR(13) + 'begin'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''3'' where status = ''4'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + CHAR(13) + 'end'
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'else begin' + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @m64$Table + ' set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @i64$Table + ' set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c64$000000 set status = ''4'' where status = ''3'' and stt_rec = ' + CHAR(39) + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + CHAR(39) + CHAR(13) + 'end'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSCIDNumber
		END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 
END
