	DELETE FROM #t01 WHERE tn_ct_nt + tien_gt_nt + thue_nt + thue_giam_nt + tn_ct + tien_gt + thue + thue_giam = 0
	SET @q = 'delete t01$' + @y + ' where ky = ' + STR(@Period) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into t01$' + @y + '(ky, ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, thue_nt, thue_giam_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, thue, thue_giam)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ky, ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, thue_nt, thue_giam_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, thue, thue_giam'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t01'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--III. Insert into t02$yyyy
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt_nt AS tn_tt_sqd_nt, thue_nt, tien_gt_nt AS gt_bt_nt, tien_gt_nt AS gt_pt_nt, tien_gt_nt AS gt_tt_nt, tien_gt_nt AS gt_bh_nt, tien_gt_nt AS gt_ht_nt
		, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, tn_tt AS tn_tt_sqd, thue, tien_gt AS gt_bt, tien_gt AS gt_pt, tien_gt AS gt_tt, tien_gt AS gt_bh, tien_gt AS gt_ht INTO #t02 FROM #t01

	--1. Tập hợp phát sinh lũy tiến theo kỳ
	INSERT INTO #t02 SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tien_gt_nt), SUM(tn_tt_nt), 0, SUM(thue_nt), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(tn_ct), SUM(tien_gt), SUM(tn_tt), 0, SUM(thue), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM #t01 a LEFT JOIN tdmloaitn b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_loai WHERE b.kieu_thue = 1 GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns

	--2. Cập nhật lại thu nhập chịu thuế khi có hỗ trợ bảo hiểm
	SELECT a.ma_ns, c.loai_tn, c.ho_tro_bh INTO #luongnet FROM #t02 a 
			JOIN (SELECT m.ma_ns, MAX(n.ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM #t02 m JOIN ctns3 n ON m.ma_ns = n.ma_ns WHERE n.ngay_hl <= @dEd GROUP BY m.ma_ns) b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
			JOIN ctns3 c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ns = c.ma_ns AND b.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX i ON #luongnet(ma_ns)
	
	UPDATE #t02 SET tn_ct_nt = a.tn_ct_nt + d.tien_gt_nt, tn_ct = a.tn_ct + d.tien_gt
		FROM #t02 a JOIN #luongnet b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tien_gt_nt) AS tien_gt_nt, SUM(tien_gt) AS tien_gt FROM #t00 WHERE loai_ct = 1 AND ma_tn IN (@ma_tn_bhxh, @ma_tn_bhyt, @ma_tn_bhtn, @ma_tn_bhnn, @ma_tn_bhk) GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns) d ON a.ma_dvcs = d.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = d.ma_ns
		WHERE b.ho_tro_bh = 1
	
	--3. Tính thu nhập tính thuế
	UPDATE #t02 SET tn_tt_nt = CASE WHEN tn_ct_nt - tien_gt_nt < 0 THEN 0 ELSE tn_ct_nt - tien_gt_nt END, tn_tt = CASE WHEN tn_ct - tien_gt < 0 THEN 0 ELSE tn_ct - tien_gt END

	--4. Tính thu nhập tính thuế sau qui đổi
	UPDATE #t02 SET tn_tt_sqd_nt = CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.loai_tn, 0) <> 1 THEN tn_tt_nt ELSE 0 END, tn_tt_sqd = CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.loai_tn, 0) <> 1 THEN tn_tt ELSE 0 END FROM #t02 a LEFT JOIN #luongnet b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
	
	--5. Tính thu nhập tính thuế sau qui đổi theo biểu thuế lũy tiến qui đổi
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.tn_tt_nt, a.tn_tt_sqd_nt, a.tn_tt, a.tn_tt_sqd INTO #thunhapqd FROM #t02 a JOIN #luongnet b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns WHERE b.loai_tn = 1
	DECLARE @he_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @tn_qd NUMERIC(28, 6), @stt INT
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT he_so, tien AS tn_qd FROM hrhsqdtntt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE tien >= 0 ORDER BY stt DESC
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @he_so, @tn_qd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #thunhapqd SET tn_tt_sqd = tn_tt_sqd + CASE WHEN @he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((tn_tt - @tn_qd) / @he_so, @Round) END, tn_tt = @tn_qd WHERE tn_tt > @tn_qd
		--
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @he_so, @tn_qd
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	UPDATE #t02 SET tn_tt_sqd_nt = ISNULL(b.tn_tt_sqd_nt, 0), tn_tt_sqd = ISNULL(b.tn_tt_sqd, 0) FROM #t02 a JOIN #thunhapqd b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
	

	--6. Tính thuế theo biểu thuế lũy tiến
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.tn_tt_sqd_nt AS tn_tt_nt, a.tn_tt_sqd AS tn_tt, a.thue_nt * 0 AS thue_nt, a.thue * 0 AS thue INTO #thue FROM #t02 a LEFT JOIN #phns b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns WHERE b.tinh_thue_yn = 1
	DECLARE @thue_suat DECIMAL(28, 6), @tn_thang DECIMAL(28, 6), @thue_thang DECIMAL(28, 6)
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ty_le, tien FROM tdmthuelt WHERE tien >= 0 ORDER BY stt DESC
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @thue_suat, @tn_thang
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #thue SET thue = thue + ROUND(((tn_tt - @tn_thang) * @thue_suat / 100), @Round), tn_tt = @tn_thang WHERE tn_tt > @tn_thang
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @thue_suat, @tn_thang
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	UPDATE #t02 SET thue = ISNULL(b.thue, 0), thue_nt = ISNULL(b.thue_nt, 0) FROM #t02 a LEFT JOIN #thue b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
	
	-- Cập nhật lại thu nhập chịu thuế
	UPDATE #t02 SET tn_ct_nt = tn_ct_nt + tn_tt_sqd_nt - tn_tt_nt, tn_ct = tn_ct + tn_tt_sqd - tn_tt
	
	--Giảm trừ
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, ma_tn, SUM(tien_gt_nt) val_nt, SUM(tien_gt) val INTO #tmpgt FROM #t00 WHERE ma_tn = @ma_tn_bt OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_pt OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_tt OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_ht GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns, ma_tn
	SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tien_gt_nt) val_nt, SUM(tien_gt) val INTO #tmpbh FROM #t00 WHERE ma_tn = @ma_tn_bhxh OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_bhyt OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_bhtn OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_bhnn OR ma_tn = @ma_tn_bhk GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns

	--4. Giảm trừ bản thân
	UPDATE #t02 SET gt_bt_nt = val_nt, gt_bt = val FROM #tmpgt a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t02.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t02.ma_ns AND a.ma_tn = @ma_tn_bt

	--5. Giảm trừ người phụ thuộc
	UPDATE #t02 SET gt_pt_nt = val_nt, gt_pt = val FROM #tmpgt a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t02.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t02.ma_ns AND a.ma_tn = @ma_tn_pt

	--6. Giảm trừ bảo hiểm
	UPDATE #t02 SET gt_bh_nt = val_nt, gt_bh = val FROM #tmpbh a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t02.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t02.ma_ns

	--7. Giảm trừ từ thiện
	UPDATE #t02 SET gt_tt_nt = val_nt, gt_tt = val FROM #tmpgt a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t02.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t02.ma_ns AND ma_tn = @ma_tn_tt
	
	--8. Giảm trừ hưu trí tự nguyện
	UPDATE #t02 SET gt_ht_nt = val_nt, gt_ht = val FROM #tmpgt a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t02.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t02.ma_ns AND a.ma_tn = @ma_tn_ht

	DROP TABLE #tmpgt
	DROP TABLE #tmpbh

	--9. Delete old data and insert new data
	DELETE FROM #t02 WHERE tn_ct_nt + tien_gt_nt + gt_bt_nt + gt_pt_nt + gt_bh_nt + gt_tt_nt + tn_ct + tien_gt + gt_bt + gt_pt + gt_bh + gt_tt = 0
	SET @q = 'delete t02$' + @y + ' where ky = ' + STR(@Period) + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into t02$' + @y + '(ky, ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt_sqd_nt, thue_nt, gt_bt_nt, gt_pt_nt, gt_tt_nt, gt_bh_nt, gt_ht_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, tn_tt_sqd, thue, gt_bt, gt_pt, gt_tt, gt_bh, gt_ht)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ' + STR(@Period) + ', ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt_sqd_nt, thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', gt_bt_nt, gt_pt_nt, gt_tt_nt, gt_bh_nt, gt_ht_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, tn_tt_sqd, thue, gt_bt, gt_pt, gt_tt, gt_bh, gt_ht'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #t02'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdku]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_ku, d.ten_ku2
		FROM cdku a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmku d ON a.ma_ku = d.ma_ku	
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_ku

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$ST]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hopdong
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d67$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_hd <> '''' or stt_rec_px <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> '''') and giao_yn = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d64$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c81$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_px <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_px = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c66$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_px = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hopdong = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cSVIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSIIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSVIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSIIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSOIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hopdong VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_hd, dyn_px, dyn_dh, dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cLineSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSVIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d81$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_giao = sl_giao - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cLineSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_px) AS dyn_px, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hopdong) AS dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSVIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m81$' + @dyn_hd + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSVIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSVIDNumber, @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_hd, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIDeliveryAlertsReport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@AlertDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateNumber INT,
	@AlertType VARCHAR(32),
	@VCType VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 2 - Báo cáo cảnh báo thời hạn giao hàng(PO/PI), 3 - Báo cáo cảnh báo thời hạn giao hàng(SA)
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128),
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@PurOrgCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PurGrCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PlantCode VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nSo_Ma_nt AS INT, @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(32), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @d1 = DATEDIFF(day, @DateNumber, @AlertDate), @d2 = DATEADD(day, @DateNumber, @AlertDate)

	-- Struct
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal
		, b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.status, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.ma_kh, b.dien_giai
		, b.t_so_luong, b.t_tt_nt, b.t_tt
		, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, b.ma_kho0 AS ma_kho, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ngay_giao, a.line_nbr
		INTO #report
		FROM d94$000000 a, m94$000000 b

	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SELECT @Join = '', @q = ''
	SELECT @Key = 'b.status = ''2'''

	IF @ReportType = '2' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.loai_ct <> ''9'''
	IF @ReportType = '3' AND @VCType <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + 'and b.loai_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@VCType, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @ReportType = '3' THEN 'a.sl_nhap' ELSE 'a.sl_nhan' END + ' < a.so_luong and po_ht_yn = 0'

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'b.ma_kho0', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + '(' + @SiteKey + ' or b.ma_kho0 = '''')'

	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.ma_kho0 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @AlertType = '*' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d2, 112) + ''' >= a.ngay_giao and a.ngay_giao >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d1, 112) + ''') and a.ngay_giao is not null)'
	IF @AlertType = '1' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d2, 112) + ''' >= a.ngay_giao and a.ngay_giao >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @AlertDate, 112) + ''') and a.ngay_giao is not null)'
	IF @AlertType = '2' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ((''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @AlertDate, 112) + ''' > a.ngay_giao and a.ngay_giao >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d1, 112) + ''') and a.ngay_giao is not null)'

	--
	DECLARE @f$Ext VARCHAR(125), @isBiMode VARCHAR(1)
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$BI$Report$GetFields '#report', @PurOrgCode, @PurGrCode, @PlantCode, @UnitKey, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, NULL, @isBiMode OUTPUT, @Key OUTPUT, @f$Ext OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Key, '%o', 'b'), '%g', 'b'), '%p', 'a'), @f$Ext = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Ext, '%o', 'b'), '%g', 'b'), '%p', 'a')
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, b.ma_dvcs, b.ma_ct, b.ngay_ct, b.so_ct, b.status, b.ma_nt, b.ty_gia, b.ma_kh, b.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', b.t_so_luong, (a.tien_nt + a.thue_nt) as t_tt_nt, (a.tien + a.thue) as t_tt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_vt, a.dvt, b.ma_kho0, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ngay_giao, a.line_nbr' + @f$Ext
	SET @q = @q + ' from d94$%Partition a with(nolock) join m94$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	IF @ReportType = '3' SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'd94$', 'bid06$'), 'm94$', 'bim06$')

	IF @VCType <> '2' OR (@ReportType = '3') EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @VCType <> '1' AND (@ReportType <> '3') BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '94$', '95$')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_vt, ma_ct, ma_dvcs) VALUES(5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '')

	SET @q = 'select a.*, d.ma_ct_in as ma_ct_in, stt_rec as rp_group, datediff(day, ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @AlertDate, 112) + ''', a.ngay_giao) as so_ngay_dh'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'e.statusname' ELSE 'e.statusname2' END + ' as status2' + REPLACE(@f$Ext, 'b.', 'a.')
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct d on a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct left join dmttct e on a.ma_ct = e.ma_ct and a.status = e.status order by a.ngay_ct, d.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vtkhddtdv]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_dvcs as ten_dvcs, b.ten_dvcs2 as ten_dvcs2, c.ten_kn, c.ten_kn2
		FROM tkhddtdv a JOIN dbo.dmdvcs b ON a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs LEFT JOIN tkhddt c on a.ma_kn = c.ma_kn
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_kn

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2ExpensesAllocation] --fs20_FXAllocationSheet--
	@period AS INT,
	@year AS INT,
	@period2 AS INT,
	@year2 AS INT,
	@unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@order VARCHAR(254),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, a.tien AS gt_pb_ky, a.tien_nt AS gt_pb_ky_nt,
			c.ten_tk AS ten_tk_pb, c.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_pb2, d.ten_tk AS ten_tk_cp, d.ten_tk2 AS ten_tk_cp2
		INTO #report FROM ctpbdc a LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON a.tk_pb = c.tk LEFT JOIN dmtk d ON a.tk_cp = d.tk ORDER BY 1

	-- UnitKey
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = '(a.nam * 12 + a.ky) between ' + RTRIM(@year * 12 + @period) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@year2 * 12 + @period2)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL	SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp, sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt),
 max(c.ten_tk) as ten_tk_pb, max(c.ten_tk2) as ten_tk_pb2, max(d.ten_tk) as ten_tk_cp, max(d.ten_tk2) as ten_tk_cp2
 from ctpbdc a
 left join dmtk c on a.tk_pb = c.tk
	left join dmtk d on a.tk_cp = d.tk
 where ' + @Key + ' group by a.tk_pb, a.tk_cp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt', 'INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN @order = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order END
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END

	SET @q = 'select stt, sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk_pb, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'ten_tk_pb as ten_tk_pb, '''' as ten_tk_pb2,' ELSE ' '''' as ten_tk_pb, ten_tk_pb2 as ten_tk_pb2,' END + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' tk_cp, ' + CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN 'ten_tk_cp as ten_tk_cp, '''' as ten_tk_cp2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_tk_cp, ten_tk_cp2 AS ten_tk_cp2,' END + ' gt_pb_ky_nt, gt_pb_ky from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN @order = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @order END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptRMVacancyStatus]
	@ReportDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@FilterBy CHAR(1), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @KeyDepartment NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT, @step INT

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_bp, ma_vtr, so_luong AS sl_yc, so_luong AS sl_ht INTO #report FROM hrrmslnv

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @q = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'a', 'a', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)
	SET @KeyDepartment = @Key
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(%date %o ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ReportDate, 112) + ''' or %date is null)'
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %vtr = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''

	-- Request Quantity
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select b.ma_bp, ma_vtr, sum(so_luong), 0 from hrrmslnv b with(nolock)'
	IF @JointUnit = 1 OR @JointDept = 1 OR @Department <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrbp a on a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%o', '<='), '%date', 'b.ngay_hl'), '%vtr', 'b.ma_vtr')
	SET @q = @q + ' group by b.ma_bp, b.ma_vtr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Current Quantity
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select bo_phan, vi_tri, 0, count(stt_rec) from hrnv a with(nolock) join #report b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp and a.vi_tri = b.ma_vtr where ' + @Key
	IF @Level <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%o', '>'), '%date', 'a.ngay_nghi'), '%vtr', 'a.vi_tri')
	SET @q = @q + 'group by bo_phan, vi_tri'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS sttsx, * INTO #result
		FROM (SELECT CAST(1 AS INT) AS stt1, MAX(a.ma_bp) AS ma_bp, a.ma_vtr, SUM(sl_yc) AS sl_yc, SUM(sl_ht) AS sl_ht
					, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(b.ten_bp) ELSE MAX(b.ten_bp2) END ten_bp, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vtr) ELSE MAX(c.ten_vtr2) END ten_vtr
					, MAX(b.stt_ref) AS stt_ref, MAX(b.bac_bp) AS bac_bp, MAX(b.bp_me) AS bp_me, MAX(c.stt) AS stt_vtr
				FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr
				GROUP BY a.ma_bp, a.ma_vtr
			) z
		ORDER BY stt_ref, stt_vtr, ma_vtr

	-- Delete By @FilterBy
	IF @FilterBy = '1' DELETE #result WHERE sl_yc <= sl_ht
	IF @FilterBy = '2' DELETE #result WHERE sl_yc >= sl_ht
	IF @FilterBy = '3' DELETE #result WHERE sl_yc = sl_ht
	
	--
	SELECT @step = MAX(bac_bp) FROM #result
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	WHILE @step > 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #result select distinct 1, a.ma_bp, '''', 0, 0, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'a.ten_bp' ELSE 'a.ten_bp2' END + ', '''', a.stt_ref, ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' - 1, a.bp_me, 0 from #result r join hrbp a on r.bp_me = a.ma_bp where (r.bac_bp = ' + LTRIM(STR(@step)) + ' and a.ma_bp not in (select ma_bp from #result))'  + CASE WHEN @KeyDepartment = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @KeyDepartment
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @step = @step - 1
	END

	-- Suppress Department
	UPDATE #result SET stt1 = 0 FROM #result a LEFT JOIN(SELECT ma_bp, MIN(sttsx) AS sttsx FROM #result GROUP BY ma_bp HAVING COUNT(ma_bp) > 1) b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		WHERE a.sttsx > b.sttsx 

	-- Empty	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #result) INSERT INTO #result SELECT '1', '', '', 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, '', 0

	-- Result
	SELECT @step = MIN(bac_bp) FROM #result WHERE ma_bp <> ''
	SELECT @step = ISNULL(@step, 0)
	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, stt1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, SPACE(2*(a.bac_bp - @step)) +  ten_bp AS ten_bp, ten_vtr, ma_bp, sl_yc, sl_ht
			, CASE WHEN a.sl_yc - sl_ht > 0 THEN sl_yc - sl_ht END AS sl_thieu, CASE WHEN sl_yc - sl_ht < 0 THEN sl_ht - sl_yc END AS sl_thua
		FROM #result a
		ORDER BY stt_ref, stt_vtr, ma_vtr

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintGLTranExport]
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@TableID VARCHAR(32),
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @Voucher VARCHAR(32), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @Desc INT, @templatePrint CHAR(1), @tableMaster VARCHAR(32), @tableDetail VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @TableID = REPLACE(RTRIM(@TableID), '''', ''), @tableMaster = 'm' + @TableID + '$%Partition', @tableDetail = 'd' + @TableID + '$%Partition', @q = '', @f = '', @Voucher = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @templatePrint = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_mau_in_ktth'

	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.t_ps_no, a.t_ps_no_nt, a.t_ps_co, a.t_ps_co_nt
			, a.dien_giai AS t_ps_no_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word
			, a.dien_giai AS t_ps_no_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, ma_dvcs, ma_nk, ma_ct, loai_ct, dept_id AS ma_bp, [user_id0], datetime0, ong_ba, ong_ba AS contact_sign
		INTO #master FROM wrkgltran a

	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, b.line_nbr, b.dien_giai, b.ma_vv, b.ma_kh, CAST('' AS CHAR(1)) AS ma_kh_yn, b.tk, b.ps_no, b.ps_no_nt, b.ps_co, b.ps_co_nt INTO #detail FROM #master a, wrkgldetail b

	-- Master
	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.t_ps_no, a.t_ps_no_nt, a.t_ps_co,a. t_ps_co_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_ps_no, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_ps_no_nt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_ps_no, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_ps_no_nt, ''V'')'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_ps_no, ''E'')'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_ps_no_nt, ''E'')'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0''), rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct))'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tempdb..syscolumns WHERE name = 'ong_ba' and id = OBJECT_ID(@tableMaster)) THEN ', a.ong_ba, a.ong_ba' ELSE ', '''', ''''' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @tableMaster + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', a.line_nbr, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, '''', a.tk, a.ps_no, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co, a.ps_co_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@tableDetail) + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Empty Row
	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	--
	UPDATE #detail SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct FROM #master GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	UPDATE #detail SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE line_nbr = 1

	UPDATE #detail SET t_ps_no = b.t_ps_no, t_ps_no_nt = b.t_ps_no_nt, t_ps_co = b.t_ps_co, t_ps_co_nt = b.t_ps_co_nt
			, t_ps_no_in_word = b.t_ps_no_in_word, t_ps_no_nt_in_word = b.t_ps_no_nt_in_word
			, t_ps_no_in_word2 = b.t_ps_no_in_word2, t_ps_no_nt_in_word2 = b.t_ps_no_nt_in_word2
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec) c WHERE a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec AND a.line_nbr = c.line_nbr)

	IF @templatePrint = '3' UPDATE #detail SET ma_kh_yn = 1 WHERE stt_rec IN(SELECT stt_rec FROM #detail WHERE ma_kh <> '')
	IF @templatePrint = '2' UPDATE #detail SET ma_kh_yn = 1

	SELECT TOP 1 @Voucher = ma_ct FROM #master where ma_ct <> ''
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	-- View
	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0

	IF @Desc = 0 SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #detail a left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		ELSE SELECT @q = 'select *, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ', ' + @f ELSE '' END + ' from #detail a left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE TRIGGER iDmcltg ON dbo.dmcltg
FOR INSERT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nAuto NUMERIC(18), @nNumber INT
	SELECT @nAuto = MAX(stt_rec) FROM dmcltg
	SELECT @nNumber = stt FROM inserted
	UPDATE dmcltg SET stt_rec = @nAuto + 1 WHERE stt = @nNumber
END

GO
