CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintSPTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@bilingual TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, 0 as km_yn, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien_nt2, a.tien2'
	--Edit BI start
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @bilingual = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt'
									WHEN @bilingual = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' AS ten_vt'
	--Edit BI end	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' AS detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report ' 
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'	
	--Edit BI start
	--SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @bilingual = 0 THEN '' WHEN @bilingual = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI end
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rc_ExecReUpdateERD]  @nCycle TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cFC VARCHAR(33), @cSysDB CHAR(32), @cUnit VARCHAR(1023), @nUserID INT, @Admin BIT, @Diff TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @dyn VARCHAR(64)

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @cIDNumber CHAR(13), @cVC CHAR(3), @d SMALLDATETIME, @e VARCHAR(32), @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME,
		@m_phdbf VARCHAR(16), @m_ctdbf VARCHAR(16), @groupby VARCHAR(128), @cUnits VARCHAR(1023)

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @cUnits = ''
	SELECT @d1 =  ngay_gh1, @d2 = ngay_gh2 FROM dmstt
	IF @dFrom < @d1 SELECT @dFrom = @d1
	IF @dTo > @d2 SELECT @dTo = @d2

	-- Delete Rounding Difference
	SELECT @Key = 'ma_nt = @cFC and ma_ct = ''JK9'' and loai_ct = 1'

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Edit')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(@UnitKey) = '(1 = 0)' RETURN
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)
		SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @dyn + ' where  ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cFC varchar(3)', @cFC
	END ELSE RETURN

	SELECT @q = 'delete ct00 where (ngay_ct between @dFrom and @dTo) and ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dFrom smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime, @cFC varchar(3)', @dFrom, @dTo, @cFC
	--

	CREATE TABLE #vc (ma_ct CHAR(3), vc_type CHAR(1), m_phdbf VARCHAR(16), m_ctdbf VARCHAR(16), groupby VARCHAR(128))
	INSERT INTO #vc SELECT a.ma_ct, b.type, a.m_phdbf, a.m_ctdbf, '' FROM dmct a JOIN gltgdd b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct WHERE b.type IN ('1', '2')

	SELECT @q = 'update #vc set groupby = b.groupby from #vc a join ' + @cSysDB + '..voucherinfo b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.vc_type INTO #r FROM r00$000000 a, #vc b

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #r select a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.vc_type from ' + @dyn + ' a with (index(ngay_ct)) join #vc b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct where ma_nt = @cFC and a.loai_ct in (''1'', ''2'', ''9'')' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' group by a.stt_rec, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, b.vc_type'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@dFrom smalldatetime, @dTo smalldatetime, @cFC varchar(3)', @dFrom, @dTo, @cFC

	DECLARE VCCur CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct FROM #r ORDER BY ngay_ct, vc_type, so_ct
	OPEN VCCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM VCCur INTO @cIDNumber, @cVC, @d
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @e = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @d, 112)
			SELECT @m_phdbf = 'm' + REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(m_phdbf)), 'ph', '') + '$' + @e, @m_ctdbf = 'd' + REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(m_ctdbf)), 'ct', '') + '$' + @e, @groupby = groupby FROM #vc WHERE ma_ct = @cVC

			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #vc WHERE ma_ct = @cVC AND vc_type = '1') BEGIN
				IF @cVC = 'BC1'
					EXEC fs30_ReCaclReceiveERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby, 1
				ELSE
					EXEC fs30_ReCaclReceiveERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby
			END ELSE BEGIN
				IF @cVC = 'BN1'
					EXEC fs30_ReCaclPaymentERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby, 1
				ELSE
					EXEC fs30_ReCaclPaymentERD @cVC, @m_phdbf, @m_ctdbf, @cIDNumber, @groupby
			END

			SELECT @q = '
delete r00$' + @e + ' where stt_rec = @cIDNumber
insert into r00$' + @e + ' select * from ct00 where stt_rec = @cIDNumber
'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cIDNumber varchar(32)', @cIDNumber

			FETCH NEXT FROM VCCur INTO @cIDNumber, @cVC, @d
		END
	CLOSE VCCur
	DEALLOCATE VCCur

	-- Rounding Difference
	IF @Diff = 1 EXEC rc_CreateExDeff @dFrom, @dTo, @cFC, 'JK9', @cUnit, '', @nUserID, @Admin, 1

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PrintBIPQTran]
	@Language CHAR(1), 
	@DetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@Table CHAR(32), 
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@bilingual TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @Language = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	
	--Edit BI start
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @bilingual = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt' WHEN @bilingual = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--Edit BI end
	
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(4000))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@Table) + ' a with(nolock) left outer join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @q <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@Table), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @DetailKey
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr '
	
	--Edit BI start
	  SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 6, ''' + @Voucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @bilingual = 0 THEN '' WHEN @bilingual = 1 THEN ',ten_vt2' END + ''',''so_luong'', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI end
	print @q
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vqhreqtlvht]
AS
SELECT     a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.loai, a.tinh_chat, a.loai_thay_doi, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.bac_quan_ly, a.nguoi_quan_ly, a.ngay_tu, a.ngay_den, a.ly_do, a.so_quyet_dinh, 
                      a.ngay_quyet_dinh, a.nguoi_quyet_dinh, a.ghi_chu, a.line_nbr, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, 
                      CASE loai WHEN '1' THEN N'Công việc hiện tại' ELSE N'Trước đây' END AS ten_loai, CASE loai WHEN '1' THEN N'Current Position' ELSE N'Previous' END AS ten_loai2, 
                      CASE a.tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN N'Công việc chính' ELSE N'Kiêm nhiệm' END AS ten_tinh_chat, 
                      CASE a.tinh_chat WHEN '1' THEN N'Official Position' ELSE N'Concurrent' END AS ten_tinh_chat2, 
                      CASE loai_thay_doi
						WHEN '1' THEN N'Tăng mới'
						WHEN '2' THEN N'Điều chuyển bộ phận'
						WHEN '3' THEN N'Điều chuyển vị trí công việc'
						WHEN '4' THEN N'Ngừng việc'
						ELSE N'Đi làm lại' END AS ten_loai_thay_doi, 
                      CASE loai_thay_doi
						WHEN '1' THEN N'New Employment'
						WHEN '2' THEN N'Department Transfer'
						WHEN '3' THEN N'Position Transfer'
						WHEN '4' THEN N'Suspension'
						ELSE N'Resume Working' END AS ten_loai_thay_doi2, 
                      b.ten_bp AS ten_bo_phan, b.ten_bp2 AS ten_bo_phan2, c.ten_vtr AS ten_vi_tri, c.ten_vtr2 AS ten_vi_tri2, d.ten_bac AS ten_bac_quan_ly, 
                      d.ten_bac2 AS ten_bac_quan_ly2, e.ten AS ten_nguoi_quan_ly
FROM         dbo.hreqtlvht AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrbp AS b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrvt AS c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.hrdmbql AS d ON a.bac_quan_ly = d.ma_bac LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.vhrnv AS e ON a.nguoi_quan_ly = e.ma_nv

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisTemplate]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@periodType TINYINT, -- 0 - Cùng kỳ, 1 - Tháng, 2 - Quý, 3 - 6 Tháng, 4 - Năm
	@periodCount INT, -- Số kỳ
	@reportType TINYINT, -- 1 - Chi tiết, 2 - Tổng hợp
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@UpdateSave TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PeriodFrom2 INT = NULL,
	@YearFrom2 INT = NULL,
	@PeriodTo2 INT = NULL,
	@YearTo2 INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @periodAdd INT, @pStartYear INT, @yStartYear INT
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp0 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp1 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp2 SMALLDATETIME, @totalMonth INT, @i INT, @datediff INT

	SELECT TOP 1 @periodAdd = CASE WHEN @periodType = 1 THEN 1
					WHEN @periodType = 2 THEN 3
					WHEN @periodType = 3 THEN 6
					WHEN @periodType = 4 THEN 12 END
		, @pStartYear = MONTH(ngay_ky1), @yStartYear = YEAR(ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt

	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom)
	IF @periodType = 0 SELECT @dateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@PeriodTo, @YearTo)

	-- Danh sách các kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #period (period INT, dateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, dateTo SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i < @periodCount BEGIN
		IF @periodType = 0 BEGIN -- Cùng kỳ
			SElECT @dateTmp0 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateFrom) - 1, @dateTmp1 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateFrom), @dateTmp2 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateTo)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SElECT @dateTmp0 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*@i, @dateFrom) - 1, @dateTmp1 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*@i, @dateFrom), @dateTmp2 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*(@i+1), @dateFrom) - 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #period SELECT @i + 1, @dateTmp0, @dateTmp1, @dateTmp2
		
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT @totalMonth = dbo.ff_GetMonths(dateTo, dateFrom) + 2 FROM #period WHERE period = 1
	IF @totalMonth IS NULL OR @totalMonth = 0 SELECT @totalMonth = 1

	-- 1. Lấy dữ liệu bảng #tmp, dùng để tính các chỉ tiêu số dư
	-- 1.1 Key
	IF @reportType = 1 SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'dang_bc = ''' + RTRIM(@reportType) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	-- 1.2
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, ma_so, tien INTO #tmp FROM gltcptct$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select %i, cast(right(rtrim(%Partition), 2) as int), cast(left(rtrim(%Partition), 4) as int), ma_so, tien'
	SET @q = @q + ' from gltcptct$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	--
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @q2 = REPLACE(@q, '%i', RTRIM(@i)), @dateTmp0 = dateFrom0, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, NULL, @dateTmp0, @dateTmp2, @UserID, @Admin
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	IF @PeriodFrom = @pStartYear AND @YearFrom = @yStartYear BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, ma_so, tien INTO #tmp0 FROM gltcptct$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp0 select 1, @pStartYear, @yStartYear, ma_so, tien from gltcptct$ with(nolock) where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@pStartYear int, @yStartYear int', @pStartYear, @yStartYear
	END

	-- 2. Lấy dữ liệu từ #tmp vào bảng #tmp2, dùng để tính các chỉ tiêu biểu thức
	-- 2.1 Lấy bảng khai báo mẫu tính toán để biết mã số thuộc kiểu số dư (số dư chỉ lấy kỳ cuối)
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, kind INTO #gltcptctMau FROM gltcptct0
	IF @reportType = 1
		INSERT INTO #gltcptctMau SELECT ma_so, tinh_chat AS kind FROM gltcptct0 
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #gltcptctMau SELECT ma_so, tinh_chat AS kind FROM gltcptct1

	-- 2.2 Bảng tạm
	SELECT TOP 0 period, ma_so, tien AS gt INTO #tmp2 FROM #tmp
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @dateTmp0 = dateFrom0, @dateTmp1 = dateFrom, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		-- Số dư
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', a.ma_so, SUM(a.tien) AS gt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #tmp a JOIN #gltcptctMau b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + ' WHERE b.kind = 1 AND a.period = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ' AND (nam*12+ky = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp2)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp2)) + ')'
		SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY a.ma_so'
		-- Trong kỳ
		SET @q = @q + ' INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', a.ma_so, SUM(a.tien) AS gt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #tmp a JOIN #gltcptctMau b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + ' WHERE b.kind <> 1 AND a.period = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ' AND (nam*12+ky BETWEEN ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp1)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp1)) + ' AND ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp2)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp2)) + ')'
		SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY a.ma_so'
		--
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- 3. Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #reportTmp FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	IF @reportType = 1
		 INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT * FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT * FROM gltcpt01th WHERE form = @Form

	-- 4. Gen bảng tạo mẫu theo số kỳ báo cáo + Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #report FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form

	--Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#reportTmp', @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin
	--	
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @dateTmp1 = dateFrom, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		
		UPDATE #reportTmp SET gt = 0
		
		IF @UpdateSave = 1 BEGIN
			UPDATE #reportTmp SET gt = so FROM #reportTmp a 
				JOIN (SELECT ma_so, so FROM gltcpt99
						WHERE nam1 = YEAR(@dateTmp1) AND ky1 = MONTH(@dateTmp1) AND nam2 = YEAR(@dateTmp2) AND ky2 = MONTH(@dateTmp2) AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '01' AND cot = '3') b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		END
		IF @UpdateSave = 2 BEGIN
			UPDATE #reportTmp SET gt = so FROM #reportTmp a 
					JOIN (SELECT ma_so, so FROM gltcpt99
							WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom2 AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom2 AND nam2 = @YearTo2 AND ky2 = @PeriodTo2 AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '01' AND cot = '5') b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		END
		INSERT INTO #report SELECT @i, * FROM #reportTmp
		SELECT @datediff = DATEDIFF(dd, @dateTmp1, @dateTmp2) + 1
		UPDATE #report SET gt = @datediff, gt_nt = @datediff WHERE period = @i AND kind = 3
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- 6. Scan bảng mẫu #reportTmp và lấy dữ liệu
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(2048), @Loai_sd CHAR(1), @Kind CHAR(1), @gt NUMERIC(28, 6), @sGt NVARCHAR(4000)
	--
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, kind, loai_sd FROM #reportTmp WHERE cach_tinh <> '' AND kind NOT IN (9, 3) ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
		IF @Kind = '2' BEGIN
			-- Kiểu số dư, gồm trung bình đầu kỳ/cuối kỳ và trung bình các kỳ
			-- Kỳ đầu tiên
			UPDATE #report SET gt = ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
					(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
						WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom0) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom0)
						GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
				WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @PeriodFrom = @pStartYear AND @YearFrom = @yStartYear BEGIN

				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp0 a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom)
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			--
			IF @Loai_sd = '1' BEGIN
				-- Trung bình đầu kỳ, cuối kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateTo) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateTo)
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
				--
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt/2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END ELSE BEGIN
				-- Trung bình các kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND (nam * 12 + ky) BETWEEN (YEAR(dateFrom) * 12 + MONTH(dateFrom)) AND (YEAR(dateTo) * 12 + MONTH(dateTo))
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so

				--
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt/@totalMonth WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			-- Kiểu biểu thức
			SELECT @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '{', '(SELECT TOP 1 gt FROM #tmp2 WHERE ma_so='''), '}', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@sGt), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 gt FROM #report WHERE ma_so='''), ']', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET gt = ' + @sGt + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''' AND period = ' + RTRIM(@i)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET gt = 0 WHERE gt IS NULL
	SELECT * FROM #report

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckListEditLogDetailView]
	@changeTimes INT,
	@idFunction VARCHAR(32),
	@field$1 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$2 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$3 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$4 VARCHAR(32),
	@field$5 VARCHAR(32),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@sysDB VARCHAR(64),
	@bug INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idFunction = REPLACE(@idFunction, '''', ''), @field$1 = REPLACE(@field$1, '''', ''), @field$2 = REPLACE(@field$2, '''', ''), @field$3 = REPLACE(@field$3, '''', ''), @field$4 = REPLACE(@field$4, '''', ''), @field$5 = REPLACE(@field$5, '''', ''), @changeTimes = @changeTimes + 1

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @r INT, @i INT, @i$Ref INT, @k TINYINT, @prime TINYINT, @id$List VARCHAR(128), @id$Field VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @f$ VARCHAR(32), @f$Amount VARCHAR(128), @NoDefine NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo0 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo1 NVARCHAR(128), @LogInfo2 NVARCHAR(128)

	DECLARE @prime$Table VARCHAR(32), @prime$Root VARCHAR(32), @prime$Root$Log VARCHAR(32), @list$Table NVARCHAR(4000), @prime$Type CHAR(1), @prime$Log VARCHAR(32), @prime$Ref$Table VARCHAR(32), @ref$Times INT
	DECLARE @f$Key VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Join VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log VARCHAR(1024), @f$Key$Log$Exists VARCHAR(1024), @k$Log VARCHAR(1024), @k$Key VARCHAR(1024)

	SELECT @NoDefine = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'NODEFINE'
	SELECT @LogInfo0 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo0'
	SELECT @LogInfo1 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo1'
	SELECT @LogInfo2 = CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'LogInfo2'
	SELECT @f$Amount = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'

	SELECT @f$Key = '', @f$Key$Join = '', @f$Key$Log = '', @f$Key$Log$Exists = '', @prime$Ref$Table = '', @k$Log = '', @k$Key = ''
	SELECT @prime$Table = xtable, @prime$Root = xtable, @prime$Log = RTRIM(xtable) + '$log', @prime$Root$Log = RTRIM(xtable) + '$log', @list$Table = REPLACE(REPLACE(xreftable, '''', ''), ' ', ''), @prime$Type = xtype, @id$List = controller FROM dmlistlog WHERE id = @idFunction
	SELECT @f$Key = @f$Key + CASE WHEN @f$Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + ' = @field$' + RTRIM(ordinal_position)
			, @f$Key$Join = @f$Key$Join + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Join <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + '_n$a = ' + 'b.' + RTRIM(column_name) + '_n$b'
			, @f$Key$Log = @f$Key$Log + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ' = @field$' + RTRIM(ordinal_position)
			, @f$Key$Log$Exists = @f$Key$Log$Exists + CASE WHEN @f$Key$Log$Exists <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '%a.' + RTRIM(column_name) + CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') THEN '_n' ELSE '' END + ' = %b.' + RTRIM(column_name)
			, @k$Log = @k$Log + case when @k$Log <> '' then ' + ' else '''$'' + ' end + 'rtrim(b.' + column_name + ') + ''$'''
		FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_name = @prime$Root ORDER BY ordinal_position
	IF @prime$Type = '2' BEGIN
		SELECT @f$Key = '%a.stt_rec = @field$1', @f$Key$Log = '%a.stt_rec = @field$1', @q = 'select @field$1 = stt_rec from hrnv where ma_nv = @field$1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@field$1 varchar(32) output', @field$1 OUTPUT
	END
	IF @prime$Type = '4'
		SELECT @prime$Root$Log = 'm$list$log'
			, @f$Key$Log = '%a.c = @c and %a.k_n = ''$' + CASE @field$1 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$1) + '$' END + CASE @field$2 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$2) + '$' END + CASE @field$3 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$3) + '$' END + CASE @field$4 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$4) + '$' END + CASE @field$5 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$5) + '$' END + ''''
			, @k$Key = '$' + CASE @field$1 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$1) + '$' END + CASE @field$2 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$2) + '$' END + CASE @field$3 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$3) + '$' END + CASE @field$4 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$4) + '$' END + CASE @field$5 WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(@field$5) + '$' END

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS xtable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeTable, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS primeLog, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS prime, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, *, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS cType INTO #field FROM #table
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS field, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS field_name, CAST(NUll AS INT) AS line_nbr, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS user_action, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS old_value, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS new_value, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS gr_id, CAST(0 AS INT) AS stt_sx INTO #report

	--
	SELECT @q = 'select @r = min(idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ' and (idLog = @changeTimes or idLog = @changeTimes - 1)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @r tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @id$List, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @r OUTPUT, @changeTimes
	IF @r IS NULL BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #report (gr_id, user_action) SELECT '', ''
		SELECT '' AS gr_name, * FROM #report
		RETURN
	END

	-- Table/Field
	SELECT * INTO #refTable FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@list$Table, ',')
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT xtable, @prime$Root, @prime$Root$Log, 1 FROM dmlistlog WHERE id = @idFunction
	INSERT INTO #table (xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime) SELECT data, RTRIM(data), REPLACE(data, '''', '') + '$log', 1 FROM #refTable WHERE data <> '' ORDER BY id

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #field (field, field_name, gr_id, xtable, primeTable, primeLog, prime)
select a.field, a.field_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ', a.gr_id, a.xtable, b.primeTable, b.primeLog, b.prime
from ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckfields a left join #table b on a.xtable = b.xtable where a.ma_ct = @id$List order by b.stt, a.stt_sx, a.field'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@id$List varchar(128)', @id$List

	UPDATE #field SET cType = CASE WHEN c.name IN ('CHAR', 'NCHAR', 'VARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR') THEN 1 WHEN c.name IN ('DECIMAL', 'NUMERIC') THEN 2 WHEN c.name IN ('DATETIME', 'SMALLDATETIME') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON a.field = b.name AND b.id = OBJECT_ID(a.xtable) JOIN systypes c on b.xtype = c.xtype and b.xusertype = c.xusertype AND c.name <> 'sysname'
	UPDATE #field SET prime = 0 FROM #field a JOIN syscolumns b ON OBJECT_ID(a.xtable) = b.id AND b.name = 'line_nbr'

	-- Data/Log
	IF @prime$Type = '4' BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #$Log FROM d$list$log

		SELECT @q = 'select @r = max(idLog) from m$list$log where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @r tinyint output', @id$List, @r OUTPUT

		SELECT @q = 'insert into #$Log select * from d$list$log where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', '') + ' and idlog = @changeTimes - 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @changeTimes int', @id$List, @changeTimes

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$Log WHERE idLog = @r) BEGIN
			SELECT @i = MIN(stt), @i$Ref = MAX(stt) FROM #field
			WHILE @i <= @i$Ref BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
update #$Log
	set xvalue_new = ' + CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END + '
from #$Log a left join ' + xtable + ' b on a.k_n = ' + @k$Log  + CASE WHEN prime = 0 THEN ' and a.xline_nbr = b.line_nbr' ELSE '' END + '
where a.idLog = @r and a.xtable = ''' + xtable + ''' and a.xfield = ''' + field + '''' FROM #field WHERE stt = @i
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k$Key varchar(1024), @f$Amount varchar(512), @r tinyint', @id$List, @k$Key, @f$Amount, @r
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field WHERE prime = 0) BEGIN
				SELECT gr_id, xtable, field, cType, CAST(0 AS INT) AS r, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #fieldRef FROM #field WHERE prime = 0 ORDER BY gr_id, xtable, field, cType
				UPDATE #fieldRef SET r = b.r FROM #fieldRef a JOIN (SELECT xtable, ISNULL(MAX(xline_nbr), 0) AS r FROM #$Log GROUP BY xtable) b ON a.xtable = b.xtable
				SELECT @i = MIN(stt), @i$Ref = MAX(stt) FROM #fieldRef
				WHILE @i <= @i$Ref BEGIN
					SELECT @q = '
insert into #$Log
	select @c, ' + REPLACE(@k$Log, 'b.', 'a.') + ', @r, ''' + xtable + ''', ''' + field + ''', null
		, ' + CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END + ', a.line_nbr
	from ' + xtable + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@k$Log, 'b.', 'a.') + ' = @k$Key and a.line_nbr > ' + RTRIM(r) FROM #fieldRef WHERE stt = @i
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @k$Key varchar(1024), @f$Amount varchar(512), @r tinyint', @id$List, @k$Key, @f$Amount, @r
					SELECT @i = @i + 1
				END
			END
		END

		SELECT @q = '
insert into #report (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select a.xfield, b.field_name, a.xline_nbr, case b.prime when 1 then @LogInfo1 else case when a.xvalue_old is not null and a.xvalue_new is null then @LogInfo2 when a.xvalue_old is null and a.xvalue_new is not null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end end, a.xvalue_old, a.xvalue_new, b.gr_id, b.stt
		from #$Log a left join #field b on a.xfield = b.field and a.xtable = b.xtable where ((b.prime = 1 and isnull(a.xvalue_old, '''') <> isnull(a.xvalue_new, '''')) or (b.prime = 0 and (a.xvalue_old <> a.xvalue_new or a.xvalue_old is null or a.xvalue_new is null)) ) and b.field_name is not null
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@c varchar(128), @changeTimes int, @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)', @id$List, @changeTimes, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2
		GOTO ViewReport
	END
	SELECT @q = 'select @i = min(a.idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log), '%a.', 'a.') + ' and a.idLog = @changeTimes' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @i tinyint output, @changeTimes int', @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @i OUTPUT, @changeTimes

	SELECT @s = '
insert into #report (field, field_name, line_nbr, user_action, old_value, new_value, gr_id, stt_sx)
	select @f$, N''%field_name'', %line, %action, %old_value, %new_value, N''%gr_id'', %stt_sx
		from %talbe a
			left join %refTalbe b on %joinKeyRef %joinKeyDetail %joinKeyLog
		where %whereRefKey %whereKey'

	-- Debug
	IF @bug = 1 BEGIN
		PRINT @changeTimes
	END


	SELECT @i$Ref = @i
	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #field) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @f$ = field, @prime$Root = primeTable, @prime$Root$Log = primeLog, @prime = prime FROM #field ORDER BY stt
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@prime$Root) AND name = @f$) GOTO GetValueNextField
		IF @prime$Type = '2' AND @prime$Table = 'hrnv' AND @prime$Ref$Table <> @prime$Root BEGIN
				SELECT @prime$Ref$Table = @prime$Root, @ref$Times = NULL, @i$Ref = NULL
				SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2 and idLog = @changeTimes) begin
	select @ref$Times = idLog from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2 and idLog = @changeTimes
end else if exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' where stt_rec = @field$2) begin
	select @ref$Times = a.idLog + 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Log) + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root) + ' b where b.stt_rec = @field$2 and a.[datetime_log] = b.[datetime2])
end
select @i$Ref = min(a.idLog) from ' + RTRIM(@prime$Root$Log) + ' a where ' + REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') + ' and a.idLog = @changeTimes'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
					, N'@changeTimes int, @ref$Times int output, @i$Ref int output, @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32)'
					, @changeTimes, @ref$Times OUTPUT, @i$Ref OUTPUT, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5
		END

		SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
			, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
			, '%line', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'a.line_nbr' END)
			, '%action', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '@LogInfo1' ELSE 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo0 else @LogInfo1 end' END)
			, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
			, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
			, '%gr_id', gr_id)
			, '%stt_sx', stt)
			, '%talbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN @prime$Root ELSE @prime$Root$Log END)
			, '%refTalbe', @prime$Root$Log)
			, '%joinKeyRef', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', ''), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) END)
			, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE prime WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE 'and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' END)
			, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN 'and b.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog = b.idLog + 1' END)
			, '%whereRefKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(@f$Key, '%a', 'a') ELSE REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') END)
			, '%whereKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN CASE WHEN @prime$Type IN ('1', '3') AND @prime = 1 THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN @ref$Times IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' and @ref$Times - 1 = @changeTimes - 1' END END ELSE 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END END)
		FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root$Log, '')


		-- Debug
		IF @bug = 1 BEGIN
			PRINT @i
			PRINT @q
		END

		EXEC sp_executesql @q
			, N'@f$ varchar(32), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128), @ref$Times int'
			, @f$, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2, @ref$Times

		IF @prime = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@s
				, '%field_name', RTRIM(field_name))
				, '%line', 'isnull(b.line_nbr, a.line_nbr)')
				, '%action', 'case when b.line_nbr is null then @LogInfo2 else @LogInfo1 end')
				, '%old_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),a.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(a.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(a.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
				, '%new_value', CASE cType WHEN 2 THEN 'dbo.ff_NumberFormat(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', @f$Amount)' WHEN 3 THEN 'convert(varchar(10),b.' + RTRIM(field) + ', 103)' WHEN 1 THEN 'ltrim(rtrim(b.' + RTRIM(field) + '))' ELSE 'ltrim(rtrim(cast(b.' + RTRIM(field) + ' as nvarchar(4000))))' END)
				, '%gr_id', gr_id)
				, '%stt_sx', stt)
				, '%talbe', @prime$Root$Log)
				, '%refTalbe', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN @prime$Root ELSE @prime$Root$Log END)
				, '%joinKeyRef', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END END), '_n$b', '') ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(@f$Key$Join, '_n$a', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END), '_n$b', CASE WHEN (@prime$Type = '2') THEN '' ELSE '_n' END) END)
				, '%joinKeyDetail', CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@prime$Root$Log) AND name = 'stt_rec0') THEN 'and a.stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0' ELSE 'and a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr' END)
				, '%joinKeyLog', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' ELSE 'and a.idLog + 1 = b.idLog' END)
				, '%whereRefKey', CASE WHEN @i IS NULL OR (@prime$Type = '2' AND @i$Ref IS NULL) THEN REPLACE(@f$Key, '%a', 'a') ELSE REPLACE(@f$Key$Log, '%a', 'a') END)
				, '%whereKey', 'and a.idLog = @changeTimes - 1' + CASE @prime$Type WHEN '2' THEN '' ELSE ' and exists(select 1 from ' + @prime$Table + ' pri where ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@f$Key$Log$Exists), '%a.', 'a.'), '%b.', 'pri.') + ')' END)
			FROM #field WHERE field = @f$ AND primeTable = @prime$Root AND primeLog = @prime$Root$Log


			-- Debug
			IF @bug = 1 BEGIN
				PRINT @q
			END

			EXEC sp_executesql @q
				, N'@f$ varchar(32), @field$1 varchar(32), @field$2 varchar(32), @field$3 varchar(32), @field$4 varchar(32), @field$5 varchar(32), @changeTimes int, @f$Amount varchar(128), @LogInfo0 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo1 nvarchar(128), @LogInfo2 nvarchar(128)'
				, @f$, @field$1, @field$2, @field$3, @field$4, @field$5, @changeTimes, @f$Amount, @LogInfo0, @LogInfo1, @LogInfo2
		END
GetValueNextField:
		--
		DELETE #field WHERE field = @f$ AND ISNULL(primeTable, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root, '') AND ISNULL(primeLog, '') = ISNULL(@prime$Root$Log, '')
	END

	-- Debug
	IF @bug = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM #report
		RETURN
	END

	DELETE #report WHERE ISNULL(old_value, '') = ISNULL(new_value, '')

ViewReport:

	-- Not exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report (gr_id, user_action) SELECT 'NODEFINE', @LogInfo1

	-- View
	SELECT DISTINCT * INTO #result FROM #report
	SELECT @q = '
select case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else b.gr_name' + CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' end as gr_name
		, case a.gr_id when ''NODEFINE'' then @NoDefine else a.field_name end as field_name
		, a.line_nbr, a.user_action, a.old_value, a.new_value, a.gr_id, a.stt_sx
	from #result a left join ' + RTRIM(@sysDB) + '..syscheckgroupfields b on a.gr_id = b.gr_id
	order by b.stt_sx, a.gr_id, a.line_nbr, a.stt_sx, a.user_action, a.field
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@NoDefine nvarchar(128)', @NoDefine

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION xf20_GetPrevPeriod(@nPeriod TINYINT, @nYear INT, @cType VARCHAR(16))
RETURNS INT AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nRetPeriod TINYINT, @nRetYear INT, @nReturn INT
	SET @nReturn = 0
	
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM xcdytdd WHERE nam * 12 + ky = @nYear * 12 + @nPeriod -1 AND ky <> 0)
		SELECT @nRetPeriod = 0, @nRetYear = YEAR(ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt
	ELSE
		IF @nPeriod = 1 SELECT @nRetPeriod = 12, @nRetYear = @nYear - 1
			ELSE SELECT @nRetPeriod = @nPeriod - 1, @nRetYear = @nYear

	IF UPPER(RTRIM(@cType)) = 'MONTH' SET @nReturn = @nRetPeriod
	IF UPPER(RTRIM(@cType)) = 'YEAR' SET @nReturn = @nRetYear

	RETURN @nReturn
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CalcPersonalIncomeTax4Year]
	@Year INT,
	@Type INT, --Thay thế loại thu nhập: 0 - Không, 1 - Có
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @Year BETWEEN YEAR(ngay_gh1) AND YEAR(ngay_gh2)) RETURN
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @y CHAR(4), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @gt_bt NUMERIC(28, 6), @gt_bt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @ds_ma_tn_bh VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_bt VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @ma_tn_pt VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_tt VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_kt1 VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_kt2 VARCHAR(33), @ty_le_gthue NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @tmau_ctru_hdong VARCHAR(33), @tmau_ctru_hdong3 VARCHAR(33), @tmau_kctru VARCHAR(33), @tmau_dautu VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @tmau_chuyen_nhuong VARCHAR(33), @tmau_ban_quyen VARCHAR(33), @tmau_trung_thuong VARCHAR(33), @tmau_kdoanh_kctru VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @ma_tn_ht VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_kt3 VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_hd1 VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_hd2 VARCHAR(33), @ma_tn_hd3 VARCHAR(33), @ma_loai_tn VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @dateFirst SMALLDATETIME, @dateLast SMALLDATETIME, @tinh_lai_npt INT, @muc_gt_npt NUMERIC(28, 6), @muc_gt_npt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @ma_tn_mt_dk_hd VARCHAR(1024), @ma_tn_mt_dk_khd VARCHAR(1024), @ma_tn_mt_dk_kctru VARCHAR(1024), @tmau_truoc_dc VARCHAR(33), @tmau_thue_giam_ctru VARCHAR(33), @tmau_thue_giam_kctru VARCHAR(33), @tmau_chuyen_nhuong_kctru VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @t_thue_gh_pn NUMERIC(28, 6), @t_thue_gh_pn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New'), @UnitKey2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New'), @y = REPLACE(STR(@Year, 4), ' ','0'), @Key = '', @Key2 = '',
		@dateTo = DATEADD(day, -1, STR(@Year + 1) + '0101')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @UnitKey, @Key2 = @UnitKey2
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key), @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)

	SELECT @gt_bt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_gt_bt'
	SELECT @gt_bt_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_gt_bt_nt'
	SELECT @ds_ma_tn_bh = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_bh'
	SELECT @ma_tn_bt = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_bt'
	SELECT @ma_tn_pt = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_pt'
	SELECT @ma_tn_ht = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_ht'
	SELECT @ma_tn_kt1 = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_kt1'
	SELECT @ma_tn_kt2 = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_kt2'
	SELECT @ma_tn_kt3 = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_kt3'
	SELECT @ty_le_gthue = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_tl_giam_kt'

	SELECT @ma_tn_hd1 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hd1'
	SELECT @ma_tn_hd2 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hd2'
	SELECT @ma_tn_hd3 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hd3'

	SELECT @tinh_lai_npt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_tncn_npt'
	SELECT @muc_gt_npt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_gt_pt'
	SELECT @muc_gt_npt_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_gt_pt_nt'

	SELECT @ma_tn_mt_dk_hd = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hddk1'
	SELECT @ma_tn_mt_dk_khd = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hddk2'
	SELECT @ma_tn_mt_dk_kctru = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 't_ma_tn_hddk3'

	SELECT @t_thue_gh_pn = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_thue_gh_pn'
	SELECT @t_thue_gh_pn_nt = val FROM options WHERE name = 't_thue_gh_pn_nt'

	SELECT @tmau_ctru_hdong = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'ctru_hdong'
	SELECT @tmau_ctru_hdong3 = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'ctru_hdong3'
	SELECT @tmau_kctru = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'kctru'
	SELECT @tmau_dautu = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'dau_tu'
	SELECT @tmau_chuyen_nhuong = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'chuyen_nhuong'
	SELECT @tmau_ban_quyen = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'ban_quyen'
	SELECT @tmau_trung_thuong = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'trung_thuong'
	SELECT @tmau_kdoanh_kctru = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'kdoanh_kctru'

	SELECT @tmau_truoc_dc = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'truoc_dieu_chuyen'
	SELECT @tmau_thue_giam_ctru = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'thue_giam_ctru'
	SELECT @tmau_thue_giam_kctru = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'thue_giam_kctru'
	SELECT @tmau_chuyen_nhuong_kctru = RTRIM(val) FROM tmaubc WHERE name = 'chuyen_nhuong_kctru'

	SELECT @ma_loai_tn = 'D01', --Thu nhập từ phí bảo hiểm mua ở nước ngoài
		@dateFirst = RTRIM(@Year) + '0101', @dateLast = RTRIM(@Year) + '1231' -- Người phụ thuộc

	--Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, hop_dong_yn, doi_tuong INTO #phns FROM phns
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_khac, tnct_dc_nt, tnct_dc, thue_dc_nt, thue_dc INTO #tdc FROM tdcthuekt2
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ns, ma_tn, loai_tn, ma_nt, ty_gia, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, ma_thue, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue_giam_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, thue, thue_giam INTO #t00 FROM t00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, thue_nt, thue_giam_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, thue, thue_giam INTO #t01 FROM t01$0000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, tn_tt_sqd_nt, thue_nt, gt_bt_nt, gt_pt_nt, gt_tt_nt, gt_bh_nt, gt_ht_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, tn_tt_sqd, thue, gt_bt, gt_pt, gt_tt, gt_bh, gt_ht INTO #t02 FROM t02$0000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f001_nt, f002_nt, f003_nt, f004_nt, f005_nt, f006_nt, f007_nt, f008_nt, f009_nt, f010_nt, f011_nt
		, f012_nt, f013_nt, f014_nt, f015_nt, f016_nt, f017_nt, f018_nt, f019_nt, f020_nt, f021_nt, f022_nt, f023_nt, f024_nt, f025_nt
		, f026_nt, f027_nt, f028_nt, f029_nt, f030_nt, f031_nt, f032_nt, f033_nt, f034_nt, f035_nt, f036_nt, f037_nt, f038_nt, f039_nt
		, f040_nt, f041_nt, f042_nt, f043_nt, f044_nt, f045_nt, f046_nt, f047_nt, f048_nt, f049_nt, f050_nt, f051_nt, f052_nt, f053_nt, f054_nt
		, f056_nt, f057_nt, f058_nt, f059_nt, f060_nt, f061_nt, f062_nt, f063_nt, f064_nt, f065_nt, f066_nt, f067_nt, f068_nt, f069_nt, f070_nt, f071_nt
		, f001, f002, f003, f004, f005, f006, f007, f008, f009, f010, f011
		, f012, f013, f014, f015, f016, f017, f018, f019, f020, f021, f022, f023, f024, f025
		, f026, f027, f028, f029, f030, f031, f032, f033, f034, f035, f036, f037, f038, f039
		, f040, f041, f042, f043, f044, f045, f046, f047, f048, f049, f050, f051, f052, f053, f054
		, f056, f057, f058, f059, f060, f061, f062, f063, f064, f065, f066, f067, f068, f069, f070, f071
		 INTO #t03 FROM t03$0000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #t03f FROM #t03


	--Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng để tính toán
	DECLARE @i INT
	SET @q = 'insert into #phns select ma_dvcs, ma_ns, tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn, uy_quyen_yn, hop_dong_yn, doi_tuong from phns where status = 1 and year(ngay_vao_cty) <= ' + @y + ' and (ngay_nghi is null or year(ngay_nghi - 1) >= ' + @y + ')' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #tdc select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn, a.tn_khac, sum(a.tnct_dc_nt), sum(a.tnct_dc), sum(a.thue_dc_nt), sum(a.thue_dc) from tdcthuekt2 a left join #phns b on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns where a.nam = ' + @y + ' and b.ma_ns is not null' + CASE WHEN @Key2 <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key2 ELSE '' END + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, a.loai_tn, a.tn_khac'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #t01 select ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn, sum(tn_ct_nt), sum(tien_gt_nt), sum(tn_tt_nt), sum(thue_nt), sum(thue_giam_nt), sum(tn_ct), sum(tien_gt), sum(tn_tt), sum(thue), sum(thue_giam) from t01$' + @y + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ' group by ma_dvcs, ma_ns, loai_tn'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #t02 select ma_dvcs, ma_ns, sum(tn_ct_nt), sum(tien_gt_nt), sum(tn_tt_nt), sum(tn_tt_sqd_nt), sum(thue_nt), sum(gt_bt_nt), sum(gt_pt_nt), sum(gt_tt_nt), sum(gt_bh_nt), sum(gt_ht_nt), sum(tn_ct), sum(tien_gt), sum(tn_tt), sum(tn_tt_sqd), sum(thue), sum(gt_bt), sum(gt_pt), sum(gt_tt), sum(gt_bh), sum(gt_ht) from t02$' + @y + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END + ' group by ma_dvcs, ma_ns'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= 12 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t00 select ma_dvcs, loai_ct, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ns, ma_tn, loai_tn, ma_nt, ty_gia, tn_ct_nt, tien_gt_nt, tn_tt_nt, ma_thue, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue_giam_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt, tn_tt, thue, thue_giam'
			+ ' from t00$' + @y + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ','0') + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.ma_ns, a.tinh_thue_yn, a.tinh_gt_yn, a.hop_dong_yn, a.uy_quyen_yn INTO #ctns4 FROM ctns4 a WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN #phns b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
		JOIN (SELECT ma_ns, MAX(ngay_hl) AS ngay_hl FROM ctns4 WHERE ngay_hl <= @dateTo GROUP BY ma_ns) c ON a.ma_ns = c.ma_ns AND a.ngay_hl = c.ngay_hl
	CREATE INDEX i ON #ctns4(ma_ns)
	UPDATE #phns SET tinh_thue_yn = b.tinh_thue_yn, tinh_gt_yn = b.tinh_gt_yn, hop_dong_yn = b.hop_dong_yn, uy_quyen_yn = b.uy_quyen_yn FROM #phns a JOIN #ctns4 b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns

	IF @tinh_lai_npt = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_ns, ma_pt, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den INTO #temppt
			FROM ctns2 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN #phns b ON b.ma_ns = a.ma_ns
			WHERE ngay_hl_tu <= @dateLast AND (ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR ngay_hl_den >= @dateFirst)

		UPDATE #temppt SET ngay_hl_tu = CASE WHEN YEAR(ngay_hl_tu) < @Year THEN @dateFirst ELSE ngay_hl_tu END, ngay_hl_den = CASE WHEN YEAR(ngay_hl_den) > @Year OR ngay_hl_den IS NULL THEN @dateLast ELSE ngay_hl_den END
			WHERE (YEAR(ngay_hl_tu) < @Year) OR (YEAR(ngay_hl_den) > @Year OR ngay_hl_den IS NULL)

		SELECT ma_ns, ma_pt, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, DATEDIFF(MONTH, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den) + 1 AS thang, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #ttctpt
			FROM #temppt
			ORDER BY ma_ns, ma_pt, ngay_hl_tu

		UPDATE #ttctpt SET thang = thang - 1 FROM #ttctpt a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ttctpt b WHERE a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns AND a.ma_pt = b.ma_pt AND a.id + 1 = b.id AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, a.ngay_hl_den, b.ngay_hl_tu) = 0)
	END

	--Lấy từ t02: chỉ bao gồm các phát sinh theo kỳ
	---f001, f002, f003, f004: TNCT gốc, Tiền giảm trừ gốc, Thu nhập tính thuế gốc, Thuế gốc
	---f037, f038, f039, f040, f047: Tiền giảm trừ bản thân, giảm trừ người phụ thuộc, giảm trừ từ thiện, giảm trừ bảo hiểm, giảm trừ hưu trí tự nguyện
	---f005: TNCT mới
	---f015, f018: Thuế đã khấu trừ, Thuế phải khấu trừ của cá nhân cư trú có HDLD >= 3 tháng
	---f021: Thuế đã khấu trừ (đối tượng ủy quyền quyết toán --> của cá nhân cư trú có HDLD >= 3 tháng)
	SELECT @q = '
	insert into #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f001_nt, f001, f002_nt, f002, f003_nt, f003, f004_nt, f004, f037_nt, f037' + CASE WHEN @tinh_lai_npt = 1 THEN '' ELSE ', f038_nt, f038' END + ', f039_nt, f039, f040_nt, f040, f047_nt, f047, f005_nt, f005, f015_nt, f015, f018_nt, f018, f021_nt, f021)
		select a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct, tien_gt_nt, tien_gt, tn_tt_nt + tn_tt_sqd_nt - tn_tt_nt, tn_tt + tn_tt_sqd - tn_tt, thue_nt, thue
				, case when b.hop_dong_yn = 1 and b.uy_quyen_yn = 1 then ' + RTRIM(@gt_bt_nt) + ' * 12 else gt_bt_nt end
				, case when b.hop_dong_yn = 1 and b.uy_quyen_yn = 1 then ' + RTRIM(@gt_bt) + ' * 12 else gt_bt end
				' + CASE WHEN @tinh_lai_npt = 1 THEN '' ELSE ', gt_pt_nt, gt_pt' END + ', gt_tt_nt, gt_tt, gt_bh_nt, gt_bh, gt_ht_nt, gt_ht
				, tn_ct_nt, tn_ct, thue_nt, thue, thue_nt, thue
				, case when b.hop_dong_yn = 1 and b.uy_quyen_yn = 1 then thue_nt else 0 end
				, case when b.hop_dong_yn = 1 and b.uy_quyen_yn = 1 then thue else 0 end
			from #t02 a left join #phns b on a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
	'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @tinh_lai_npt = 1 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f038_nt, f038)
			SELECT b.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, @muc_gt_npt_nt * so_thang, @muc_gt_npt * so_thang
			FROM (SELECT SUM(thang) AS so_thang, ma_ns FROM #ttctpt GROUP BY ma_ns) a JOIN #phns b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns
	END

	--Lấy từ t01: chỉ bao gồm các phát sinh theo kỳ
	--- f010, f016, f019: TNCT, Thuế đã khấu trừ, Thuế phải khấu trừ của cá nhân cư trú có HDLD < 3 tháng
	--- f011, f017, f020: TNCT, Thuế đã khấu trừ, Thuế phải khấu trừ của cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f025, f026, f045: TNCT, Thuế, TNTT đã khấu trừ từ đầu tư vốn
	--- f027, f028, f046: TNCT, Thuế, TNTT đã khấu trừ từ chuyển nhượng chứng khoán
	--- f029, f030, f031: TNCT, TNTT, Thuế đã khấu trừ từ chuyển nhượng bản quyền hoặc nhượng quyền thương mại
	--- f032, f033, f034: TNCT, TNTT, Thuế đã khấu trừ từ trúng thưởng
	--- f035, f036: TNCT, Thuế đã khấu trừ từ kinh doanh trả cho cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f053, f054: TN từ phí bảo hiểm mua ở nước ngoài, Thuế đã khấu trừ từ phí bảo hiểm mua ở nước ngoài
	--- f061: Thuế được giảm cá nhân cư trú có HDLD < 3 tháng
	--- f062: Thuế được giảm cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f063: Thuế được giảm từ đầu tư vốn
	--- f064: Thuế được giảm từ chuyển nhượng chứng khoán
	--- f065: Thuế được giảm từ chuyển nhượng bản quyền, nhượng quyền thương mại
	--- f066: Thuế được giảm từ trúng thưởng
	--- f067: Thuế được giảm từ kinh doanh cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f068: Thuế được giảm từ chuyển nhượng vốn của cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f070: TNTT từ chuyển nhượng vốn của cá nhân không cư trú
	--- f071: Thuế phát sinh từ chuyển nhượng vốn của cá nhân không cư trú

	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f010_nt, f010, f016_nt, f016, f019_nt, f019)
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue)
			FROM #t01 a LEFT JOIN tdmloaitn b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_loai LEFT JOIN #phns c ON a.ma_ns = c.ma_ns
			WHERE a.loai_tn = @tmau_ctru_hdong3 AND NOT (@Type = 1 AND c.uy_quyen_yn = 1 AND RTRIM(b.ma_loai2) <> '') GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f011_nt, f011, f017_nt, f017)
		SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, SUM(a.tn_ct_nt), SUM(a.tn_ct), SUM(a.thue_nt), SUM(a.thue)
			FROM #t01 a LEFT JOIN tdmloaitn b ON a.loai_tn = b.ma_loai LEFT JOIN #phns c ON a.ma_ns = c.ma_ns
			WHERE a.loai_tn = @tmau_kctru AND NOT (@Type = 1 AND c.uy_quyen_yn = 1 AND RTRIM(b.ma_loai2) <> '') GROUP BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f020_nt, f020)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue) FROM #t01 WHERE loai_tn = @tmau_kctru GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f025_nt, f025, f026_nt, f026, f045_nt, f045, f063_nt, f063) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(tn_tt_nt), SUM(tn_tt), SUM(thue_giam_nt), SUM(thue_giam)
		FROM #t01 WHERE loai_tn = @tmau_dautu GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f027_nt, f027, f028_nt, f028, f046_nt, f046, f064_nt, f064) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(tn_tt_nt), SUM(tn_tt), SUM(thue_giam_nt), SUM(thue_giam)
		FROM #t01 WHERE loai_tn = @tmau_chuyen_nhuong GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f029_nt, f029, f030_nt, f030, f031_nt, f031, f065_nt, f065) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(tn_tt_nt), SUM(tn_tt), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_giam_nt), SUM(thue_giam)
		FROM #t01 WHERE loai_tn = @tmau_ban_quyen GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f032_nt, f032, f033_nt, f033, f034_nt, f034, f066_nt, f066) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(tn_tt_nt), SUM(tn_tt), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_giam_nt), SUM(thue_giam)
		FROM #t01 WHERE loai_tn = @tmau_trung_thuong GROUP BY ma_dvcs, ma_ns
	INSERT INTO #t03(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f035_nt, f035, f036_nt, f036, f067_nt, f067) SELECT ma_dvcs, ma_ns, SUM(tn_ct_nt), SUM(tn_ct), SUM(thue_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_giam_nt), SUM(thue_giam)

	---f009: TNCT cá nhân cư trú có HDLD >= 3 tháng
	---f012: TNCT cá nhân cư trú có HDLD >= 3 tháng (thuộc diện phải khấu trừ)
	---f007: Thu nhập tính thuế mới
	---f013: TNCT cá nhân cư trú có HDLD < 3 tháng (thuộc diện phải khấu trừ)
	---f014: TNCT cá nhân không cư trú (thuộc diện phải khấu trừ)
	UPDATE #t03f SET f006_nt = f037_nt + f038_nt + f039_nt + f040_nt + f047_nt, f006 = f037 + f038 + f039 + f040 + f047, f009_nt = f005_nt, f009 = f005, f012_nt = CASE WHEN f004_nt + f004 > 0 THEN f005_nt ELSE 0 END, f012 = CASE WHEN f004_nt + f004 > 0 THEN f005 ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #t03f SET f007_nt = CASE WHEN f005_nt - f006_nt - f050_nt - f056_nt < 0 THEN 0 ELSE f005_nt - f006_nt - f050_nt - f056_nt END, f007 = CASE WHEN f005 - f006 - f050 - f056 < 0 THEN 0 ELSE f005 - f006 - f050 - f056 END
	UPDATE #t03f SET f013_nt = CASE WHEN thue_nt - thue_giam_nt + thue - thue_giam > 0 THEN f010_nt ELSE 0 END, f013 = CASE WHEN thue_nt - thue_giam_nt + thue - thue_giam > 0 THEN f010 ELSE 0 END FROM #t01 a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t03f.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t03f.ma_ns AND a.loai_tn = @tmau_ctru_hdong3
	UPDATE #t03f SET f014_nt = CASE WHEN thue_nt - thue_giam_nt + thue - thue_giam > 0 THEN f011_nt ELSE 0 END, f014 = CASE WHEN thue_nt - thue_giam_nt + thue - thue_giam > 0 THEN f011 ELSE 0 END FROM #t01 a WHERE a.ma_dvcs = #t03f.ma_dvcs AND a.ma_ns = #t03f.ma_ns AND a.loai_tn = @tmau_kctru

	--Tính thuế lũy tiến, hiện tại chỉ tính cho tiền hạch toán (do FBFF cũng làm vậy)
	SELECT a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ns, f007_nt AS tn_tt_nt, f007 AS tn_tt, f008_nt AS thue_nt, f008 AS thue INTO #thue FROM #t03f a LEFT JOIN #phns b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns WHERE b.hop_dong_yn = 1 AND b.uy_quyen_yn = 1
	DECLARE @thue_suat NUMERIC(28, 6), @tn_nam NUMERIC(28, 6), @thue_nam NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ty_le, tien2 FROM tdmthuelt WHERE tien >= 0 ORDER BY stt DESC
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @thue_suat, @tn_nam
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #thue SET thue = thue + ((tn_tt - @tn_nam) * @thue_suat / 100), tn_tt = @tn_nam WHERE tn_tt > @tn_nam
		FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @thue_suat, @tn_nam
	END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr

	---f008: Thuế mới
	---f042: Thuế miễn giảm cho cá nhân có HĐLĐ >= 3 tháng (làm việc trong khu kinh tế)
	---f044: Thuế miễn giảm cho cá nhân có HĐLĐ < 3 tháng (làm việc trong khu kinh tế)
	---f022: Thuế phải nộp (đối tượng ủy quyền quyết toán)
	---f023: Thuế còn phải nộp (đối tượng ủy quyền quyết toán)
	---f024: Thuế nộp thừa (đối tượng ủy quyền quyết toán)
	---f049: Thuế miễn giảm cho cá nhân không cư trú (làm việc trong khu kinh tế)
	---f069: Thuế được miễn do dưới mức giới hạn phải nộp

	UPDATE #t03f SET f008_nt = ISNULL(b.thue_nt, 0), f008 = ISNULL(b.thue, 0) FROM #t03f a JOIN #thue b ON a.ma_ns = b.ma_ns AND a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs
	UPDATE #t03f SET f042_nt = CASE WHEN f005_nt <> 0 THEN f008_nt * (f041_nt/f005_nt) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END, f042 = CASE WHEN f005 <> 0 THEN f008 * (f041/f005) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #t03f SET f044_nt = CASE WHEN f010_nt <> 0 THEN f019_nt * (f043_nt/f010_nt) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END, f044 = CASE WHEN f010 <> 0 THEN f019 * (f043/f010) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #t03f SET f022_nt = f008_nt - f042_nt, f022 = f008 - f042
	UPDATE #t03f SET f023_nt = CASE WHEN f022_nt - f021_nt > @t_thue_gh_pn_nt THEN f022_nt - f021_nt ELSE 0 END, f023 = CASE WHEN f022 - f021 > @t_thue_gh_pn THEN f022 - f021 ELSE 0 END, f024_nt = CASE WHEN f021_nt - f022_nt > 0 THEN f021_nt - f022_nt ELSE 0 END, f024 = CASE WHEN f021 - f022 > 0 THEN f021 - f022 ELSE 0 END
	UPDATE #t03f SET f049_nt = CASE WHEN f011_nt <> 0 THEN f020_nt * (f048_nt/f011_nt) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END, f049 = CASE WHEN f011 <> 0 THEN f020 * (f048/f011) * ISNULL(@ty_le_gthue, 0)/100 ELSE 0 END
	IF @t_thue_gh_pn_nt <> 0 UPDATE #t03f SET f069_nt = f022_nt - f021_nt WHERE f022_nt - f021_nt <= @t_thue_gh_pn_nt AND f022_nt - f021_nt > 0
	IF @t_thue_gh_pn <> 0 UPDATE #t03f SET f069 = f022 - f021 WHERE f022 - f021 <= @t_thue_gh_pn AND f022 - f021 > 0

	--Xóa dữ liệu cũ và insert dữ liệu mới vào t03$yyyy và t04
	SET @q = 'delete t03$' + @y + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete t04' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into t03$' + @y +
		'(ma_dvcs, ma_ns, f001_nt, f002_nt, f003_nt, f004_nt, f005_nt, f006_nt, f007_nt, f008_nt, f009_nt, f010_nt, f011_nt
		, f012_nt, f013_nt, f014_nt, f015_nt, f016_nt, f017_nt, f018_nt, f019_nt, f020_nt, f021_nt, f022_nt, f023_nt, f024_nt, f025_nt
		, f026_nt, f027_nt, f028_nt, f029_nt, f030_nt, f031_nt, f032_nt, f033_nt, f034_nt, f035_nt, f036_nt, f037_nt, f038_nt, f039_nt
		, f040_nt, f041_nt, f042_nt, f043_nt, f044_nt, f045_nt, f046_nt, f047_nt, f048_nt, f049_nt, f050_nt, f051_nt, f052_nt, f053_nt, f054_nt
		, f056_nt, f057_nt, f058_nt, f059_nt, f060_nt, f061_nt, f062_nt, f063_nt, f064_nt, f065_nt, f066_nt, f067_nt, f068_nt, f069_nt, f070_nt, f071_nt
		, f001, f002, f003, f004, f005, f006, f007, f008, f009, f010, f011
		, f012, f013, f014, f015, f016, f017, f018, f019, f020, f021, f022, f023, f024, f025
		, f026, f027, f028, f029, f030, f031, f032, f033, f034, f035, f036, f037, f038, f039
		, f040, f041, f042, f043, f044, f045, f046, f047, f048, f049, f050, f051, f052, f053, f054
		, f056, f057, f058, f059, f060, f061, f062, f063, f064, f065, f066, f067, f068, f069, f070, f071)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select * from #t03f'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO t04(ma_dvcs, nam, f001_nt, f002_nt, f003_nt, f004_nt, f005_nt, f006_nt, f007_nt, f008_nt, f009_nt, f010_nt, f011_nt
		, f012_nt, f013_nt, f014_nt, f015_nt, f016_nt, f017_nt, f018_nt, f019_nt, f020_nt, f021_nt, f022_nt, f023_nt, f024_nt, f025_nt
		, f026_nt, f027_nt, f028_nt, f029_nt, f030_nt, f031_nt, f032_nt, f033_nt, f034_nt, f035_nt, f036_nt, f037_nt, f038_nt, f039_nt
		, f040_nt, f041_nt, f042_nt, f043_nt, f044_nt, f045_nt, f046_nt
		, f047_nt, f048_nt, f049_nt, f050_nt, f051_nt, f052_nt, f053_nt, f054_nt
		, f056_nt, f057_nt, f058_nt, f059_nt, f060_nt, f061_nt, f062_nt, f063_nt, f064_nt, f065_nt, f066_nt, f067_nt, f068_nt, f069_nt, f070_nt, f071_nt
		, f001, f002, f003, f004, f005, f006, f007, f008, f009, f010, f011
		, f012, f013, f014, f015, f016, f017, f018, f019, f020, f021, f022, f023, f024, f025
		, f026, f027, f028, f029, f030, f031, f032, f033, f034, f035, f036, f037, f038, f039
		, f040, f041, f042, f043, f044, f045, f046, f047, f048, f049, f050, f051, f052, f053, f054
		, f056, f057, f058, f059, f060, f061, f062, f063, f064, f065, f066, f067, f068, f069, f070, f071)
		SELECT ma_dvcs, CAST(@Year AS NUMERIC(4,0))
			, SUM(f001_nt), SUM(f002_nt), SUM(f003_nt), SUM(f004_nt), SUM(f005_nt), SUM(f006_nt), SUM(f007_nt), SUM(f008_nt), SUM(f009_nt), SUM(f010_nt)
			, SUM(f011_nt), SUM(f012_nt), SUM(f013_nt), SUM(f014_nt), SUM(f015_nt), SUM(f016_nt), SUM(f017_nt), SUM(f018_nt), SUM(f019_nt), SUM(f020_nt)
			, SUM(f021_nt), SUM(f022_nt), SUM(f023_nt), SUM(f024_nt), SUM(f025_nt), SUM(f026_nt), SUM(f027_nt), SUM(f028_nt), SUM(f029_nt), SUM(f030_nt)
			, SUM(f031_nt), SUM(f032_nt), SUM(f033_nt), SUM(f034_nt), SUM(f035_nt), SUM(f036_nt), SUM(f037_nt), SUM(f038_nt), SUM(f039_nt), SUM(f040_nt)
			, SUM(f041_nt), SUM(f042_nt), SUM(f043_nt), SUM(f044_nt), SUM(f045_nt), SUM(f046_nt)
			, SUM(f047_nt), SUM(f048_nt), SUM(f049_nt), SUM(f050_nt), SUM(f051_nt), SUM(f052_nt), SUM(f053_nt), SUM(f054_nt)
			, SUM(f056_nt), SUM(f057_nt), SUM(f058_nt), SUM(f059_nt), SUM(f060_nt), SUM(f061_nt), SUM(f062_nt), SUM(f063_nt), SUM(f064_nt), SUM(f065_nt), SUM(f066_nt), SUM(f067_nt), SUM(f068_nt), SUM(f069_nt), SUM(f070_nt), SUM(f071_nt)
			, SUM(f001), SUM(f002), SUM(f003), SUM(f004), SUM(f005), SUM(f006), SUM(f007), SUM(f008), SUM(f009), SUM(f010)
			, SUM(f011), SUM(f012), SUM(f013), SUM(f014), SUM(f015), SUM(f016), SUM(f017), SUM(f018), SUM(f019), SUM(f020)
			, SUM(f021), SUM(f022), SUM(f023), SUM(f024), SUM(f025), SUM(f026), SUM(f027), SUM(f028), SUM(f029), SUM(f030)
			, SUM(f031), SUM(f032), SUM(f033), SUM(f034), SUM(f035), SUM(f036), SUM(f037), SUM(f038), SUM(f039), SUM(f040)
			, SUM(f041), SUM(f042), SUM(f043), SUM(f044), SUM(f045), SUM(f046)
			, SUM(f047), SUM(f048), SUM(f049), SUM(f050), SUM(f051), SUM(f052), SUM(f053), SUM(f054)
			, SUM(f056), SUM(f057), SUM(f058), SUM(f059), SUM(f060), SUM(f061), SUM(f062), SUM(f063), SUM(f064), SUM(f065), SUM(f066), SUM(f067), SUM(f068), SUM(f069), SUM(f070), SUM(f071)
		FROM #t03f GROUP BY ma_dvcs

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
