CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdnvbh]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, ISNULL(e.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh, ISNULL(e.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_nvbh, d.ten_nvbh2
		FROM cdnvbh a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmnvbh d ON a.ma_nvbh = d.ma_nvbh
			LEFT JOIN dmkh e ON a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeCancelInvoice]
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@VoucherDateList VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@InvoiceType INT = 0, -- 0: E-Invoice, 1: Other
	@TableResult VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @voucherNo VARCHAR(32), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @voucherUnit VARCHAR(32), @provider INT
	SELECT @code = '', @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherDateList = REPLACE(@VoucherDateList, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, '', '', @VoucherID, @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD1' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm21$' + @p FROM c21$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD4' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm25$' + @p, @dTable = 'd25$' + @p FROM c25$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm81$' + @p, @dTable = 'd81$' + @p FROM c81$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm22$' + @p FROM c22$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXC' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm86$' + @p FROM c86$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm26$000000' FROM m26$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'hddc' FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD6' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm42$000000', @dTable = 'd42$000000' FROM m42$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXA' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm84$' + @p FROM c84$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXB' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'm85$' + @p FROM c85$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HD7' SELECT @voucherDate = ngay_ct, @voucherUnit = ma_dvcs, @voucherNo = so_ct, @p = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112), @mTable = 'hdtt' FROM hdtt WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID


	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @voucherUnit and b.status = 1
	-- Check Unit
	IF @InvoiceType = 0 AND @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, @voucherUnit AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Lock Date
	CREATE TABLE #lockedDate (r INT)
	INSERT INTO #lockedDate EXEC fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @VoucherCode, @voucherDate, @UserID, @voucherUnit, 1
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #lockedDate WHERE r = 1) BEGIN
		IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 1, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Modify
	SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = so_ct from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherDateList) + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

	IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
		IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 2, ''' + @code + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 2 AS typecheck, @code AS val
		RETURN
	END


	-- Check Payment
	IF @VoucherCode IN('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD6') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND stt_rec LIKE (LEFT(@VoucherID, 10) + '%')) BEGIN
			IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 3, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF @VoucherCode IN('PXC', 'PXD') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt30 WHERE loai_tt = 1 AND LEFT(stt_rec, 10) = LEFT(@VoucherID, 10)) BEGIN
			IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 3, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cttt20 WHERE stt_rec_tt = @VoucherID) BEGIN
		IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 3, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Flow
	IF @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD2', 'HD7', 'PXC', 'PXD') BEGIN
		DECLARE @chk BIT
		SELECT @q = 'select @chk = (select top 1 1 from hdtt where stt_rec_hd = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@chk bit output', @chk OUTPUT
		--
		IF ISNULL(@chk, 0) = 0 AND @VoucherCode = 'HDA' BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'select @chk = (select top 1 1 from ' + @dTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and sl_xuat <> 0)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@chk bit output', @chk OUTPUT
		END
		--
		IF ISNULL(@chk, 0) <> 0 BEGIN
			IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 10, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 10 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Check Adjustment Invoice
	IF @InvoiceType = 1 AND @VoucherCode IN ('HD2', 'HD4', 'HD5', 'HD6') BEGIN
		DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(32), @refID VARCHAR(32), @refVC VARCHAR(3), @period VARCHAR(6)

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_hd, ma_ct_hd, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #inv FROM hddc

			IF @VoucherCode = 'HD5'
				INSERT INTO #inv SELECT stt_rec_hd, ma_ct_hd FROM hddc WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID

			IF @VoucherCode = 'HD2' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #inv select stt_rec_hd, right(stt_rec_hd, 3) from ' + @mTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and isnull(replace(stt_rec_hd, '''''''', ''''), '''') <> '''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			IF @VoucherCode = 'HD4' OR @VoucherCode = 'HD6' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = 'insert into #inv select stt_rec_hd, right(stt_rec_hd, 3) from ' + @dTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(@VoucherID) + ''' and isnull(replace(stt_rec_hd, '''''''', ''''), '''') <> '''''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #inv) BEGIN
				DECLARE @i INT
				SELECT @i = 1, @refID = stt_rec_hd, @refVC = ma_ct_hd FROM #inv WHERE stt = 1
				WHILE @refID IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SELECT @period = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@refVC, @refID)

					SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @output = stt_rec from hddt00$' + @period + ' where stt_rec = ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@refID, '''', '')) + ''''
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@output varchar(32) output', @output = @ID OUTPUT

					IF ISNULL(@ID, '') <> '' BEGIN
						IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
							SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 0, 4, ''' + REPLACE(@voucherNo, '''', '''''') + ''''
							EXEC sp_executesql @q
						END ELSE SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @voucherNo AS val
						RETURN
					END
					--
					SELECT @i = @i + 1, @refID = NULL
					SELECT @refID = stt_rec_hd, @refVC = ma_ct_hd FROM #inv WHERE stt = @i
				END
			END

		END
	END

	--
	IF @InvoiceType = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 8, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	DELETE hddt02 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
	INSERT INTO hddt02(stt_rec, kieu_xl) SELECT @VoucherID, @Extension

	--
	IF @TableResult <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableResult + ' select 1, 0, '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SV]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT,
	@compactMode VARCHAR(32) = '0'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)

	SELECT TOP 0 loai_ct, status INTO #TranType FROM m81$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_px, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hopdong
		INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d81$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #TranType SELECT loai_ct, status FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_px <> '''' or stt_rec_dh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0 = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d64$' + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_px <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_px = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c66$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_px = b.stt_rec
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec <> '') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hopdong = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c64$000000 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cSIIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineSIIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSOIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_px VARCHAR(64), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hopdong VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec, stt_rec0, so_luong, he_so, dyn_px, dyn_dh, dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_xuat = sl_xuat - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END, sl_xuat = sl_xuat - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> ''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET sl_hd = sl_hd - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cLineSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cLineSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @cLineSCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status, datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec, MAX(dyn_px) AS dyn_px, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hopdong) AS dyn_hopdong FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_px, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE loai_ct = 2) BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ' + CASE WHEN @compactMode = '0' THEN '3' ELSE '2' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF @SOStatus IN (''2'', ''4'', ''5'') UPDATE cddh13 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' ELSE DELETE cddh13 WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> '' BEGIN
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ' + CASE WHEN @compactMode = '0' THEN '3' ELSE '2' END + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''4'' OR status = ''5'')'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat < so_luong)'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''5'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''4'''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SCStatus = status FROM i64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c64$000000 SET status = @SCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET status = @SCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @cSOIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			IF @cSCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hopdong <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_hopdong + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSIIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_px <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m66$' + @dyn_px + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSIIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSIIDNumber, @cSOIDNumber, @cSCIDNumber, @dyn_px, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hopdong
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- RollBackSOCredit
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TranType WHERE status <> '0') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @Tien_hd NUMERIC(28, 6)

		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, tien2 AS tien_hd INTO #rollbackUpdate FROM d81$000000
		SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #rollbackUpdate SELECT stt_rec_dh, SUM(tien2 + thue - ck) FROM ' + @detailTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and stt_rec_dh <> '''' GROUP BY stt_rec_dh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '' AND dyn_dh <> '' GROUP BY stt_rec_dh
		OPEN crTran
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @dyn_dh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien_hd = tien_hd FROM #rollbackUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cSOIDNumber
			SET @s = 'UPDATE m64$' + @dyn_dh + ' SET tien_hd = tien_hd - ' + RTRIM(@Tien_hd) + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
			FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cSOIDNumber, @dyn_dh
		END
		CLOSE crTran
		DEALLOCATE crTran
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_GetSQLInsertE
	(
		@cTableInsert VARCHAR(16), 
		@cTableData VARCHAR(16), 
		@cBaseTable VARCHAR(16), 
		@cRefTable VARCHAR(16), 
		@cKey VARCHAR(1024), 
		@cEFileds VARCHAR(128)
	)
RETURNS VARCHAR(8000) AS  
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strReturn VARCHAR(8000), @strFieldsList VARCHAR(1024)
	SET @strFieldsList = dbo.ff_GetFieldsListE(@cBaseTable, @cRefTable, @cEFileds)
	SET @strReturn = 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTableInsert + '(' + @strFieldsList + ')' + ' SELECT ' + @strFieldsList + ' FROM ' + @cTableData + ' WHERE ' + @cKey
	RETURN @strReturn
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Convert2ExRDTrans] @nYear INT AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	INSERT INTO dmcltg1 (stt_rec, nam, stt)
		SELECT stt_rec, @nYear, stt FROM dmcltg
		WHERE status = '1' AND (ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR YEAR(ngay_hl_tu) <= @nYear) AND (ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR YEAR(ngay_hl_den) >= @nYear)
			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dmcltg1 WHERE nam = @nYear AND stt = dmcltg.stt)

	UPDATE dmcltg1 SET tag = 0

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.vsysunitrights
AS
	SELECT a.id, a.name, a.comment, a.user_yn, b.ma_dvcs
			, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_new, 0) AS BIT) AS r_new, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_edit, 0) AS BIT) AS r_edit, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_del, 0) AS BIT) AS r_del, CAST(ISNULL(b.r_access, 0) AS BIT) AS r_access
		FROM vsysuserinfo a LEFT JOIN	sysunitrights2 b ON a.id = b.user_id AND b.ma_dvcs IN (SELECT ma_dvcs FROM dmdvcs)

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintIPTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Controller VARCHAR(32),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@View TINYINT = 1, -- 1: Pdf, 2: Excel
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(33),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(511), @tk_cpxt VARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ong_ba, a.dien_giai, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khox
			, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt , a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM m75$000000 a

	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, b.line_nbr, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.tk_vt, b.ma_nx, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt AS ten_vt2
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail
		INTO #detail FROM #master a, d75$000000 b, dmvt c

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ong_ba, a.dien_giai, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khox, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + '''), '''''
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word, '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word, '''''
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2, '''''
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang, cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @MasterTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkho b with(nolock) on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkho c with(nolock) on a.ma_khox = c.ma_kho'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, '''', '''', '''','
	SET @q = @q + ' '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', 0, 0, 0, '''','
	SET @q = @q + ' a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.ma_nx, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	IF @Voucher = 'PNI' SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PNI'
		ELSE SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PNF'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	UPDATE #detail SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, dien_giai = b.dien_giai
			,ma_kho = b.ma_kho, ma_khox = b.ma_khox
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE line_nbr = 1

	UPDATE #detail SET t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt
			,t_tien_in_word = b.t_tien_in_word, t_tien_in_word2 = b.t_tien_in_word2

		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Desc = 0
		SELECT @q = '
select a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkho b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
		order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	ELSE
		SELECT @q = '
select a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkho b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
		order by a.ngay_ct desc, a.so_ct desc, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIInspectionLotList]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@inspectionFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionTo VARCHAR(32),
	@plant VARCHAR(32),
	@site VARCHAR(32),
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@customer VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionLotOrigin VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionType VARCHAR(32),
	@status CHAR(1),
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @join NVARCHAR(1023), @plantKey NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @siteKey nvarchar(4000), @inspectionKey nvarchar(4000), @len INT

	SELECT TOP 0 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_vt, dvt, so_luong, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_lo, dien_giai, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, status, IDENTITY(INT) AS id
		INTO #report FROM bikd00$000000

	SELECT @join = '', @key = ''
	IF @status <> '*' SELECT @key = 'a.status = ''' + @status + ''''
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @plant, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @plantKey OUTPUT, '1'
	IF @plant <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @plantKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + @plantKey + ')'

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @site, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @siteKey OUTPUT
	IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @siteKey

	SELECT @inspectionKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionFilter ('a.ma_nguon', @inspectionLotOrigin, @userID, @admin)
	IF @inspectionKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @inspectionKey

	IF @site <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @item <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup1 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup2 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup3 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @customer <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @inspectionType <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_loai_kd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SELECT @LEN = character_maximum_length from information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'bikd00$000000' AND column_name = 'so_ct'
	IF @inspectionFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionFrom), '''', ''''''), @len) + ''''
	IF @inspectionTo <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionTo), '''', ''''''), @len) + ''''

	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @unitKey

	IF @itemGroup1 + @itemGroup2 + @itemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_lo, a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, a.status'
	SET @q = @q + ' from bikd00$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @userID, @admin

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT) AS stt, 1 AS id INTO #stt
	INSERT INTO #stt (id) SELECT id FROM #report ORDER BY ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct

	SELECT o.stt, a.*, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.statusname ELSE c.statusname2 END AS trang_thai
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmttct c ON a.status = c.status AND c.ma_ct = 'KD2'
			JOIN #stt o ON a.id = o.id
		ORDER BY o.stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[js_ExecDeleteExDeff]
	@nCycle TINYINT,
	@nYear INT,
	@cFC CHAR(3),
	@cVC CHAR(3),
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin TINYINT,
	@cType CHAR(1) = '1',
	@Diff TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- Do not remove two following lines
	IF CHARINDEX('''', @cUnit) > 0 RETURN
	IF CHARINDEX('''', @cFC) > 0 RETURN

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @VCList NVARCHAR(128)

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetBOP(@nYear, @nCycle), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEOP(@nYear, @nCycle)
	IF @cType = '2' SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'New')
		ELSE SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Delete')

	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(@UnitKey) = '(1 = 0)' RETURN

	SELECT @Key = 'ma_nt = @cFC', @VCList = '(ma_ct = @cVC or (ma_ct = ''JK9'' and loai_ct = 4))'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(64)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @dyn = 'r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dTo, 112)

		SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @dyn + ' where ' + @VCList + ' and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_no = ps_no where (isnull(gt_no, 0) = 0) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set gt_co = ps_co where (isnull(gt_co, 0) = 0) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_no <> 0 and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_no = 4) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_co <> 0 and tk_du in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_no = 4) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC

		--
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_co <> 0 and tk in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_co = 4) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC
		SELECT @q = 'update ' + @dyn + ' set ps_no = gt_no, ps_co = gt_co, gt_tinh = 0 where ps_no <> 0 and tk_du in (select tk from dmtk where loai_cl_co = 4) and ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@cVC varchar(32), @cFC varchar(32)', @cVC, @cFC
	END ELSE RETURN

	--
	SELECT @q = '
delete ct00 where ' + @Key + '
insert into ct00 select * from ' + @dyn + ' where ' + @Key + '
delete jgltggs where thang = @nCycle and nam = @nYear and ma_nt = @cFC' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + '
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@nCycle tinyint, @nYear int, @cFC varchar(3)', @nCycle, @nYear, @cFC
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vgnctkieuduyet]
AS
	SELECT a.*, ISNULL(b.ten_bp, '') AS ten_bp, ISNULL(b.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_bp2, ISNULL(c.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh1, ISNULL(c.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh12, ISNULL(d.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh2, ISNULL(d.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh22
		, ISNULL(e.ten_nh, '') AS ten_nh3, ISNULL(e.ten_nh2, '') AS ten_nh32
		, ISNULL(f.ten_tk, '') AS ten_tk, ISNULL(f.ten_tk2, '') AS ten_tk2
		, ISNULL(i.ten_loai, '') AS ten_loai_ct, ISNULL(i.ten_loai2, '') AS ten_loai_ct2
		, ISNULL(j.ten_bp, '') AS ten_hrbp, ISNULL(j.ten_bp2, '') AS ten_hrbp2
		, ISNULL(k.ten_dvcs, '') AS ten_dvcs, ISNULL(k.ten_dvcs2, '') AS ten_dvcs2
		FROM dbo.gnctkieuduyet a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh c ON a.nh_kh1 = c.ma_nh AND c.loai_nh = '1'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh d ON a.nh_kh2 = d.ma_nh AND d.loai_nh = '2'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmnhkh e ON a.nh_kh3 = e.ma_nh AND e.loai_nh = '3'
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmtk f ON a.tk = f.tk
			LEFT JOIN dbo.gndmkieuduyet g ON a.loai_duyet = g.loai_duyet and a.ma_kieu = g.ma_kieu
			LEFT JOIN dbo.gndmloaiduyet h ON g.loai_duyet = h.loai_duyet
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmloaict i ON h.ma_ct = i.ma_ct and a.loai_ct = i.loai_ct
			LEFT JOIN dbo.hrbp j ON a.ma_hrbp = j.ma_bp
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmdvcs k ON a.dvcs = k.ma_dvcs




GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptAverageCostSheet]
	@Month NUMERIC(4,0), 
	@Year NUMERIC(4,0),
	@Site VARCHAR(33), 
	@Item VARCHAR(33), 
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Order VARCHAR(511), 
	@SiteGroup VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q AS NVARCHAR(4000), @m_gia_vt TINYINT, @m_gia_nh_kho TINYINT, @Key NVARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @m_gia_vt = val FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_VT'
	SELECT @m_gia_nh_kho = val FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_GIA_NH_KHO'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, gia01 AS gia, gia_nt01 AS gia_nt, ma_kho INTO #dmgia FROM dmgia
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vt, ten_vt, dvt INTO #dmvt FROM dmvt

	-- Key for item list
	SET @Key = 'gia_ton = 1'
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #dmvt	select ma_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_vt' ELSE 'ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt, dvt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from dmvt with(nolock) where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'nam = ' + STR(@Year) + ' and ma_vt in(select ma_vt from #dmvt)'
	IF @m_gia_vt = 1 AND @m_gia_nh_kho = 1 BEGIN
		IF @SiteGroup <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nhom_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SiteGroup), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #dmgia'
	SET @q = @q + ' select ma_vt, gia' + REPLACE(STR(@Month, 2), ' ', '0') + ', gia_nt' + REPLACE(STR(@Month, 2), ' ', '0')
	IF @m_gia_vt = 1 AND @m_gia_nh_kho = 1
		SET @q = @q + ', nhom_kho from dmgia5 with(nolock)' 
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + ', ma_kho from dmgia with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.ma_vt, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt
			, b.dvt, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kho ELSE '' END AS ten_kho, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kho2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kho2
		INTO #report
		FROM #dmgia a LEFT JOIN #dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmkho c ON a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho

	IF @m_gia_vt = 1 AND @m_gia_nh_kho = 1
		UPDATE #report SET ten_kho = b.ten_nh, ten_kho2 = b.ten_nh2
			FROM #report a JOIN dmnhkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_nh

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 sysorder FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ma_kho, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_kho, ten_kho2) VALUES (5, 1, 1, '', '', '', '', '', '')

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, gia, gia_nt, ma_kho, ten_kho, ten_kho2 FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, ' + @Order
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$BIPQ]
	@masterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@Action VARCHAR(4),
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dn, stt_rec0dn, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dn INTO #beforeUpdate FROM bid93$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_dn, stt_rec0dn, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dn <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dn = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c92$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dn = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE @PQIDNumber CHAR(13), @dyn_dn VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dn, MAX(dyn_dn) AS dyn_dn FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dn
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @PQIDNumber, @dyn_dn
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @PQIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_dn <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'UPDATE i92$' + @dyn_dn + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@PQIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c92$000000 SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@PQIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m92$' + @dyn_dn + ' SET status = ''2'', user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@PQIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @PQIDNumber, @dyn_dn
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrdmngaynghi]
AS
SELECT a.ma_bp, a.ngay, a.ma_ca, a.ma_cong, a.so_gio, a.loai_nghi, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, b.ten_ca, b.ten_ca2, c.ten_cong, c.ten_cong2
FROM hrdmngaynghi a LEFT JOIN hrdmca b ON a.ma_ca = b.ma_ca
	LEFT JOIN hrdmcong c ON a.ma_cong = c.ma_cong

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTSAllocationSheet] --fs20_FXDistributionReport--
	@Period AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year AS NUMERIC(4),
	@Period2 AS NUMERIC(2),
	@Year2 AS NUMERIC(4),
	@FaType AS VARCHAR(32),
	@FaDept AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 AS VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit AS VARCHAR(1023),
	@Group AS VARCHAR(256),
	@Order VARCHAR(254),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.so_the_ts, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ma_bp),'') FROM wrkColumns) AS fx_ma_bp
		, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
		, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts AS loai_cc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
		, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
	INTO #report
	FROM ctkhcc a JOIN dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS id, a.so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt
			, ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts AS loai_cc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
		INTO #data
			FROM ctkhcc a JOIN dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	SELECT id, so_the_ts, nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi INTO #dataMax FROM #data

	--Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	--Key
	SET @Key = 'a.nam * 12 + a.ky between ' + RTRIM(@Year * 12 + @Period) + ' and ' + RTRIM(@Year2 * 12 + @Period2)
	IF @FaType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.loai_ts like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@FaType, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' b.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @FaDept <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FaDept), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Key = ' where ' + @Key

	SELECT @q = '
	insert into #data select a.nam * 12 + a.ky, a.so_the_ts, a.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt,
			ten_ts, ten_ts2, so_ky_kh, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, loai_ts as loai_cc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia,
			a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
		from ctkhcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
	' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #dataMax SELECT id, so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia), SUM(nguyen_gia_nt), SUM(gt_da_kh), SUM(gt_da_kh_nt), SUM(gt_cl), SUM(gt_cl_nt), MAX(tk_ts), MAX(tk_kh), MAX(tk_cp), MAX(ma_bp), MAX(ma_phi)
		FROM #data a
			WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM #data b WHERE a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts)
			GROUP BY id, so_the_ts

	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, a.so_the_ts, b.ma_bp AS fx_ma_bp,
		b.nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt, b.gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt, b.gt_cl, b.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, a.ten_ts, a.ten_ts2,
		a.so_ky_kh, a.ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0, a.loai_cc, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, b.tk_ts, b.tk_kh, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp, b.ma_phi
	FROM (
			SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(gt_kh_ky) AS gt_kh_ky, SUM(gt_kh_ky_nt) AS gt_kh_ky_nt, MAX(ma_nt) AS ma_nt, MAX(ty_gia) AS ty_gia,
					MAX(ten_ts) AS ten_ts, MAX(ten_ts2) AS ten_ts2, MAX(so_ky_kh) AS so_ky_kh, MAX(ngay_mua) AS ngay_mua, MAX(ngay_kh0) AS ngay_kh0, MAX(loai_cc) AS loai_cc
				FROM #data GROUP BY so_the_ts
		) a LEFT JOIN #dataMax b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ngay_kh0 > dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))

	DELETE #report WHERE gt_kh_ky = 0 AND so_the_ts IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) = dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year))
	)

	UPDATE #report SET gt_cl = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0 WHERE so_the_ts IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE NOT ngay_giam IS NULL
				AND dbo.ff_GetCycles(ngay_giam) <= dbo.ff_GetCycles(dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period2, @Year2))
	)

/*
	SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp INTO #dept FROM cthscc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts + STR(nam * 12 + ky, 16) IN (
		SELECT so_the_ts + STR(MAX(nam * 12 + ky), 16)
			FROM cthscc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nam * 12 + ky <= @Year * 12 + @Period
			GROUP BY so_the_ts
	) AND @Period = @Period2
	INSERT INTO #dept SELECT so_the_ts, ma_bp FROM dmcc WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts NOT IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #dept)

	DELETE #report WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT a.so_the_ts FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts WHERE b.ma_bp NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@FaDept) + '%' ))
	UPDATE #report SET fx_ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		FROM #report a JOIN #dept b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
*/

	SELECT so_the_ts, MAX(nam * 12 + ky) AS so_ky
		INTO #temp
		FROM ctkhcc
		WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report WHERE nguyen_gia IS NULL)
		GROUP BY so_the_ts

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt
		FROM #report a JOIN (
			SELECT a.so_the_ts, 0 AS gt_cl, 0 AS gt_cl_nt, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt
				FROM ctkhcc a JOIN #temp b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts AND (a.nam*12+a.ky) = b.so_ky
				GROUP BY a.so_the_ts
		) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts,ten_ts,ten_ts2', 'INT,#,NVARCHAR(511),NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	IF @Group <> '' BEGIN
		DECLARE @o VARCHAR(128)
		SELECT @o = @Group + ', ' + @Order
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @Group, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup(@Group, 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @Order, '#report', 'stt', ''
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Group <> ''
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts, '''' AS ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi FROM #report ORDER BY ' + @Group + ',sysorder, stt'
	ELSE
		SET @q = 'SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts, '''' AS ten_ts2,' ELSE ' '''' AS ten_ts, ten_ts2,' END + ' so_the_ts, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, so_ky_kh, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialStructureAnalysisTemplate]
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@periodType TINYINT, -- 0 - Cùng kỳ, 1 - Tháng, 2 - Quý, 3 - 6 Tháng, 4 - Năm
	@periodCount INT, -- Số kỳ
	@reportType TINYINT, -- 1 - Chi tiết, 2 - Tổng hợp
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @periodAdd INT, @pStartYear INT, @yStartYear INT
	DECLARE @dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dateTo SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp0 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp1 SMALLDATETIME, @dateTmp2 SMALLDATETIME, @totalMonth INT, @i INT

	SELECT TOP 1 @periodAdd = CASE WHEN @periodType = 1 THEN 1
					WHEN @periodType = 2 THEN 3
					WHEN @periodType = 3 THEN 6
					WHEN @periodType = 4 THEN 12 END
		, @pStartYear = MONTH(ngay_ky1), @yStartYear = YEAR(ngay_ky1) FROM dmstt

	SELECT @dateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom)
	IF @periodType = 0 SELECT @dateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@PeriodTo, @YearTo)
	
	-- Danh sách các kỳ
	CREATE TABLE #period (period INT, dateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, dateFrom SMALLDATETIME, dateTo SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i < @periodCount BEGIN
		IF @periodType = 0 BEGIN -- Cùng kỳ
			SElECT @dateTmp0 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateFrom) - 1, @dateTmp1 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateFrom), @dateTmp2 = DATEADD(YEAR, @i, @dateTo)
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SElECT @dateTmp0 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*@i, @dateFrom) - 1, @dateTmp1 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*@i, @dateFrom), @dateTmp2 = DATEADD(MONTH, @periodAdd*(@i+1), @dateFrom) - 1
		END

		INSERT INTO #period SELECT @i + 1, @dateTmp0, @dateTmp1, @dateTmp2
		
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT @totalMonth = dbo.ff_GetMonths(dateTo, dateFrom) + 2 FROM #period WHERE period = 1
	IF @totalMonth IS NULL OR @totalMonth = 0 SELECT @totalMonth = 1

	-- 1. Lấy dữ liệu bảng #tmp, dùng để tính các chỉ tiêu số dư
	-- 1.1 Key
	IF @reportType = 1 SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SET @Key = 'dang_bc = ''' + RTRIM(@reportType) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	-- 1.2
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, ma_so, tien INTO #tmp FROM gltcptct$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select %i, cast(right(rtrim(%Partition), 2) as int), cast(left(rtrim(%Partition), 4) as int), ma_so, tien'
	SET @q = @q + ' from gltcptct$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	--
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @q2 = REPLACE(@q, '%i', RTRIM(@i)), @dateTmp0 = dateFrom0, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, NULL, @dateTmp0, @dateTmp2, @UserID, @Admin
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END
	--
	IF @PeriodFrom = @pStartYear AND @YearFrom = @yStartYear BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, CAST(0 AS INT) AS ky, CAST(0 AS INT) AS nam, ma_so, tien INTO #tmp0 FROM gltcptct$000000
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp0 select 1, @pStartYear, @yStartYear, ma_so, tien from gltcptct$ with(nolock) where ' + @Key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@pStartYear int, @yStartYear int', @pStartYear, @yStartYear
	END

	-- 2. Lấy dữ liệu từ #tmp vào bảng #tmp2, dùng để tính các chỉ tiêu biểu thức
	-- 2.1 Lấy bảng khai báo mẫu tính toán để biết mã số thuộc kiểu số dư (số dư chỉ lấy kỳ cuối)
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, kind INTO #gltcptctMau FROM gltcptct0
	IF @reportType = 1
		INSERT INTO #gltcptctMau SELECT ma_so, tinh_chat AS kind FROM gltcptct0 
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #gltcptctMau SELECT ma_so, tinh_chat AS kind FROM gltcptct1

	-- 2.2 Bảng tạm
	SELECT TOP 0 period, ma_so, tien AS gt INTO #tmp2 FROM #tmp
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @dateTmp0 = dateFrom0, @dateTmp1 = dateFrom, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		-- Số dư
		SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', a.ma_so, SUM(a.tien) AS gt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #tmp a JOIN #gltcptctMau b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + ' WHERE b.kind = 1 AND a.period = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ' AND (nam*12+ky = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp2)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp2)) + ')'
		SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY a.ma_so'
		-- Trong kỳ
		SET @q = @q + ' INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', a.ma_so, SUM(a.tien) AS gt'
		SET @q = @q + ' FROM #tmp a JOIN #gltcptctMau b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + ' WHERE b.kind <> 1 AND a.period = ' + RTRIM(@i) + ' AND (nam*12+ky BETWEEN ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp1)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp1)) + ' AND ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@dateTmp2)*12+MONTH(@dateTmp2)) + ')'
		SET @q = @q + ' GROUP BY a.ma_so'
		--
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		
		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- 3. Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #reportTmp FROM gltcpt11 WHERE form = @Form
	IF @reportType = 1
		 INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT * FROM gltcpt11 WHERE form = @Form
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #reportTmp SELECT * FROM gltcpt11th WHERE form = @Form

	-- 4. Gen bảng tạo mẫu theo số kỳ báo cáo + Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS period, * INTO #report FROM gltcpt11 WHERE form = @Form

	--Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#reportTmp', @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#reportTmp', @UserID, @Admin, 'cach_tinh2'
	--
	SELECT @i = 1
	WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
		SELECT @dateTmp1 = dateFrom, @dateTmp2 = dateTo FROM #period WHERE period = @i
		
		UPDATE #reportTmp SET gt = 0, ts = 0
		UPDATE #reportTmp SET gt = so FROM #reportTmp a 
			JOIN (SELECT ma_so, so FROM gltcpt99
					WHERE nam1 = YEAR(@dateTmp1) AND ky1 = MONTH(@dateTmp1) AND nam2 = YEAR(@dateTmp2) AND ky2 = MONTH(@dateTmp2) AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '11' AND cot = 3) b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		UPDATE #reportTmp SET ts = so FROM #reportTmp a 
			JOIN (SELECT ma_so, so FROM gltcpt99
					WHERE nam1 = YEAR(@dateTmp1) AND ky1 = MONTH(@dateTmp1) AND nam2 = YEAR(@dateTmp2) AND ky2 = MONTH(@dateTmp2) AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '11' AND cot = 5) b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so

		INSERT INTO #report SELECT @i, * FROM #reportTmp

		SELECT @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- 6. Scan bảng mẫu #reportTmp và lấy dữ liệu
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(2048), @Loai_sd CHAR(1), @Kind CHAR(1), @gt NUMERIC(28, 6), @sGt NVARCHAR(4000)
	--
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, kind, loai_sd FROM #reportTmp WHERE cach_tinh <> '' and kind <> 9 ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
		IF @Kind = '2' BEGIN
			-- Kiểu số dư, gồm trung bình đầu kỳ/cuối kỳ và trung bình các kỳ
			-- Kỳ đầu tiên
			UPDATE #report SET gt = ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
					(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
						WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom0) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom0)
						GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
				WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @PeriodFrom = @pStartYear AND @YearFrom = @yStartYear BEGIN
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
					(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp0 a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
						WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom)
						GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
				WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			--
			IF @Loai_sd = '1' BEGIN
				-- Trung bình đầu kỳ, cuối kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateTo) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateTo)
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
				--
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt/2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END ELSE BEGIN
				-- Trung bình các kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND (nam * 12 + ky) BETWEEN (YEAR(dateFrom) * 12 + MONTH(dateFrom)) AND (YEAR(dateTo) * 12 + MONTH(dateTo))
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
				UPDATE #report SET gt = gt/@totalMonth WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			-- Kiểu biểu thức
			SELECT @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '{', '(SELECT TOP 1 gt FROM #tmp2 WHERE ma_so='''), '}', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@sGt), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 gt FROM #report WHERE ma_so='''), ']', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET gt = ' + @sGt + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''' AND period = ' + RTRIM(@i)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)

				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- Tương tự cho tỷ trọng
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh2, kind, loai_sd FROM #reportTmp WHERE cach_tinh2 <> '' and kind <> 9 ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')
		IF @Kind = '2' BEGIN
			-- Kiểu số dư, gồm trung bình đầu kỳ/cuối kỳ và trung bình các kỳ
			-- Kỳ đầu tiên
			UPDATE #report SET ts = ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
					(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
						WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom0) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom0)
						GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
				WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			IF @PeriodFrom = @pStartYear AND @YearFrom = @yStartYear BEGIN
				UPDATE #report SET ts = ts + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp0 a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateFrom) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateFrom)
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			--
			IF @Loai_sd = '1' BEGIN
				-- Trung bình đầu kỳ, cuối kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET ts = ts + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND a.ky = MONTH(b.dateTo) AND a.nam = YEAR(b.dateTo)
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so

				--
				UPDATE #report SET ts = ts/2 WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END ELSE BEGIN
				-- Trung bình các kỳ
				UPDATE #report SET ts = ts + ISNULL(b.tien, 0) FROM #report a JOIN
						(SELECT a.period, SUM(a.tien) AS tien FROM #tmp a JOIN #period b ON a.period = b.period
							WHERE a.ma_so = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '{', ''), '}', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND (nam * 12 + ky) BETWEEN (YEAR(dateFrom) * 12 + MONTH(dateFrom)) AND (YEAR(dateTo) * 12 + MONTH(dateTo))
							GROUP BY a.period) b ON a.period = b.period
					WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
				UPDATE #report SET ts = ts/@totalMonth WHERE ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			-- Kiểu biểu thức
			SELECT @i = 1
			WHILE @i <= @periodCount BEGIN
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@Cach_tinh), '{', '(SELECT TOP 1 gt FROM #tmp2 WHERE ma_so='''), '}', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @sGt = REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(@sGt), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 ts FROM #report WHERE ma_so='''), ']', ''' and period=' + RTRIM(@i) + ')')
				SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET ts = ' + @sGt + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + @Ma_so + ''' AND period = ' + RTRIM(@i)
				SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh, @Kind, @Loai_sd
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET gt = 0 WHERE gt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ts = 0 WHERE ts IS NULL
	SELECT * FROM #report

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$UpdateLineNumber]
	@Table VARCHAR(32) = '#ln',
	@idField VARCHAR(32) = 'id',
	@keyField VARCHAR(32) = 'c',
	@lnField VARCHAR(32) = 'ln'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @q = 'create clustered index p on ' + @Table + '(' + @idField + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @q = '
	declare @lineNumber int, @keyValue varchar(64), @sequence bit
	select @keyValue = null
	update %table set @sequence = case when %c = @keyValue then 1 else 0 end, @lineNumber = case when @sequence = 1 then @lineNumber + 1 else 1 end, %ln = @lineNumber, @keyValue = %c from %table with (index(p)) option(maxdop 1)
'

	SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%table', @Table), '%ln', @lnField), '%c', @keyField)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$AutoCreateLot]
	@tempTable VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @pre VARCHAR(16), @code VARCHAR(16), @nMax INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @len INT, @n INT, @i INT, @f INT, @m_ma_lo_td VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @ngaynhap SMALLDATETIME, @y VARCHAR(4), @m VARCHAR(2), @d VARCHAR(2)

	SELECT @m_ma_lo_td = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_lo_td'

	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS id, ma_vt, ngay_nhap, ma_lo INTO #temp FROM dmlo
	SET @q = 'insert into #temp select id, ma_vt, ngay_nhap, '''' from ' + @tempTable
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #temp) RETURN
	SELECT @ngaynhap = (SELECT TOP 1 ngay_nhap FROM #temp)
	SELECT @y = RTRIM(YEAR(@ngaynhap)), @m = REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@ngaynhap), 2), ' ', '0'), @d = REPLACE(STR(DAY(@ngaynhap), 2), ' ', '0')

	SELECT @code = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@m_ma_lo_td), 'yyyy' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @y), 'yyy' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 3)), 'yy' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 2)), 'y' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, RIGHT(@y, 1)), 'mm' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @m), 'dd' COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, @d)

	IF RIGHT(@m_ma_lo_td, 1) <> '#' BEGIN 
		SET @q = 'update ' + @tempTable + ' set ma_lo = ''' + @code + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	-- Increa #
	SELECT @n = LEN(@code)
	SELECT @i = @n, @f = @n
	WHILE @i >= 1 BEGIN
		IF SUBSTRING(@code, @i, 1) = '#' SET @f = @i
			ELSE BREAK
		SET @i = @i - 1
	END
	SET @len = @n - @f + 1
	SET @pre = LEFT(@code, @n - @len)

	DECLARE @id INT, @ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @ma_vt2 VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @ma_vt = '', @ma_vt2 = ''
	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT id, ma_vt FROM #temp WHERE ma_vt <> '' ORDER BY ma_vt
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id, @ma_vt
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @ma_vt <> @ma_vt2 BEGIN
			SELECT @nMax = ISNULL(RIGHT(RTRIM(MAX(ma_lo)), @len), 0) FROM dmlo WHERE ma_vt = @ma_vt AND ma_lo LIKE (RTRIM(@pre) + '%') AND LEN(RTRIM(ma_lo)) = @n
			SET @ma_vt2 = @ma_vt
		END
		SET @nMax = @nMax + 1
		UPDATE #temp SET ma_lo = @pre + REPLACE(STR(@nMax, @len), ' ', '0') WHERE id = @id

		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @id, @ma_vt
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @q = 'delete ' + @tempTable
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into ' + @tempTable + ' select * from #temp'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CheckTSDecreaseQty]
	@vcDate SMALLDATETIME,
	@tsCode VARCHAR(33),
	@tsDept VARCHAR(33),
	@quantity NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@nResult INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @nMPrev INT, @nYPrev INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @quantityPrev NUMERIC(28, 6), @quantityRemain NUMERIC(28, 6)
	SELECT @nResult = 0

	IF MONTH(@vcDate) = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @nMPrev = 12, @nYPrev = YEAR(@vcDate) - 1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @nMPrev = MONTH(@vcDate) - 1, @nYPrev = YEAR(@vcDate)
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctcddc WHERE nam = @nYPrev AND ky = @nMPrev AND ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept) BEGIN
		SELECT @quantityPrev = SUM(so_luong) FROM ctcddc WHERE nam = @nYPrev AND ky = @nMPrev AND ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept
		SELECT @dStart = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@vcDate), YEAR(@vcDate))
		SELECT @quantityRemain = @quantityPrev + ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), 0) FROM ctpsdc WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dStart AND @vcDate AND ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept AND loai_ps <> 0 AND stt_rec <> @idNumber
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart = ngay_tang FROM dmccdc WHERE ma_dc = @tsCode
		SELECT @quantityRemain = ISNULL(SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), 0) FROM ctpsdc WHERE ngay_ct BETWEEN @dStart AND @vcDate AND ma_dc = @tsCode AND ma_bp_dc = @tsDept AND stt_rec <> @idNumber
	END

	IF @quantityRemain < @quantity SET @nResult = 1

	RETURN @nResult	

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff20_GetSQLAlterNullValue(
	@cTable VARCHAR(32), --Temporary table(@cTable)
	@cBaseTable VARCHAR(32),
	@strFieldsNotUpdate VARCHAR(1024),
	@strKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @strSQL VARCHAR(8000), @nColID INT, @cName VARCHAR(128), @cType VARCHAR(32)
	SET @strSQL = ''
	SELECT @nColID = MIN(ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK)  WHERE table_name = @cBaseTable
	WHILE @nColID IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @cName =column_name, @cType = LOWER(data_type) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE ordinal_position = @nColID AND table_name = @cBaseTable
		IF EXISTS (SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE  table_name = @cBaseTable AND column_name = @cName ) AND dbo.ff_ExactInlist(@cName, @strFieldsNotUpdate) <> 1
			BEGIN
				SET @strSQL = RTRIM(@strSQL) + CHAR(13) + ' UPDATE ' + @cBaseTable + ' SET ' + @cName  + ' = ' 
					+ CASE WHEN @cType IN ('char','varchar','nchar','nvarchar') THEN ''''''
					 	WHEN @cType IN ('datetime','smalldatetime') THEN 'NULL'
					  	WHEN @cType IN ('uniqueidentifier') THEN  ''''''
					 	WHEN @cType IN ('text','ntext') THEN ''''''
					   	WHEN @cType IN ('binary','varbinary') THEN  'NULL'
					   	WHEN @cType IN ('tinyint','int','float','real','money','smallmoney','numeric','bit')THEN  '0'
					   	ELSE 'NULL' 
				 	END
				 + ' WHERE ' + @cName + ' IS NULL' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@strKey) <> '' THEN ' AND ' + RTRIM(@strKey ) ELSE '' END
			END
		SELECT @nColID = MIN(ordinal_position)  FROM information_schema.COLUMNS (NOLOCK) WHERE table_name = @cBaseTable AND ordinal_position > @nColID
	END
	SET @strSQL = REPLACE(@strSQL, @cBaseTable, @cTable)
	RETURN @strSQL
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdvitri]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, c.dvt AS dvt, c.dvt AS dvt2, ISNULL(d.ten_vi_tri, '') AS ten_vi_tri, ISNULL(d.ten_vi_tri2, '') AS ten_vi_tri2
		FROM cdvitri a JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmvitri d ON a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeReleaseInvoiceInventory]
	@TableName VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TablePrime VARCHAR(33), @code VARCHAR(33), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @provider INT

	SELECT @TablePrime = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'PXA' THEN 'm84$' ELSE 'm85$' END, @qUpdate = ''
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'key', '', @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Customer
	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' AND @VoucherCode = 'PXA' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = ma_kh from ' + @TableName + ' a where not exists(select 1 from khhddt b where a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and b.[status] <> 0)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 4 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(33), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END

		IF @provider <> 3 BEGIN
			-- Check Status E-Invoice
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join  hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.tinh_trang_hddt <> ''0'' and exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(33) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
			
			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END
		
		-- Update status
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$Transaction]
	@detailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@tableGeneralUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableMasterUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@tableDetailUpdate VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_wh INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d74$000000

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_wh <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_wh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_wh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@tableGeneralUpdate)), '''', '''''') + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_wh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cWHIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineWHIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_wh VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_wh, stt_rec0wh, so_luong, he_so, dyn_wh FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @cLineWHIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_wh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cWHIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_wh <> ''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableDetailUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_wh + ' SET sl_ss = sl_ss - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''

		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @cLineWHIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_wh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran 
	
	-- Update status, datetime2, user_id2
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_wh, MAX(dyn_wh) AS dyn_wh FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_wh
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @dyn_wh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''
		IF @cWHIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_wh <> '' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@tableMasterUpdate)), '''', '''''') + @dyn_wh + ' SET user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cWHIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cWHIDNumber, @dyn_wh
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran
