	SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #detail SELECT 1, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, cast(0 as bit) AS km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien'
	SET @q = @q + ', g.ten_vt' + @cLan + ' AS ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ', thue_nt, thue'
	SET @q = @q + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @q = @q + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' WHERE ' + @key

	-- Hiển thị mã hàng trên mẫu in hóa đơn bán hàng
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_vt_ar_yn' AND val = 1) BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET ten_vt = RTRIM(ma_vt) + '' - '' + ten_vt'
	END

	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE #detail SET stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #copy(xGroup INT, ten_lien NVARCHAR(128), ten_lien2 NVARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = 1, @so_lien = so_lien FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVoucher
	SELECT ccode, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '') AS cname, cname2 INTO #reports FROM reports WHERE LEN(ccode) = 5 AND ccode LIKE (RTRIM('LIEN') + '%')
	SELECT @max = COUNT(*) FROM #reports
	WHILE @i <= @so_lien BEGIN
		IF @i <= @max BEGIN
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #copy SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', cname, cname2 FROM #reports WHERE ccode = ''LIEN' + RTRIM(@i) + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #copy VALUES(@i, '', '')
		END
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.sysprint, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt AS gia_nt2, a.tien_nt AS tien_nt2, a.gia AS gia2, a.tien AS tien2, RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
			, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
			, c.doi_tac, c.ma_so_thue, c.dia_chi, c.dien_thoai, c.tk_nh, c.ngan_hang, c.tinh_thanh, c.ma_nt, c.ngay_ct, c.ky_hieu, c.so_ct, c.so_seri, c.ngay, c.thang, c.nam
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (c.thue_suatx = 0 AND (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '')) OR (a.so_luong = 0 AND tien = 0) THEN '\' ELSE dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Einvoice$GetTaxRateName(c.thue_suatx) END ELSE c.thue_suat END AS thue_suat
			, ten_kh, CASE WHEn @Language = 'V' THEN c.thanh_toan ELSE c.thanh_toan2 END AS thanh_toan
			, c.t_tien AS t_tien2, c.t_tien_nt AS t_tien_nt2, c.t_thue, c.t_thue_nt, c.t_tt, c.t_tt_nt, c.t_tt_nt_in_word, c.t_tt_in_word
			, c.dien_giai, c.customize, a.detail

			, a.thue_nt, a.thue
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.tien_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_10, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END AS tien_10
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.tien_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_5, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END AS tien_5
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.tien_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_8, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END AS tien_8
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_0, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END AS tien_0
			, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien_nt ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_99, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien ELSE 0 END AS tien_99
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_10, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_10
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_5, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_5
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_8, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_8
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_0, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_0
			, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_99, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_99
		INTO #report FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
				, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
		FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT xGroup, SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
								, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
							FROM #report WHERE ma_vt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY xGroup
							) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup
	UPDATE #report SET so_lien = '', so_lien2 = '', dien_giai = '', doi_tac = '', ten_kh = '', ma_so_thue = '', dia_chi = '', dien_thoai = '', tk_nh = '', ngan_hang = '', tinh_thanh = '', thanh_toan = '', ma_nt = '', ngay_ct = NULL, ky_hieu = '', so_ct = '', so_seri = '', ngay = '', thang = '', nam = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1
	UPDATE #report SET t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt_in_word = '', t_tt_in_word = '', tien_nt_10 = 0, tien_10 = 0, tien_nt_5 = 0, tien_5 = 0, tien_nt_8 = 0, tien_8 = 0, tien_nt_0 = 0, tien_0 = 0, thue_nt_10 = 0, thue_10 = 0, thue_nt_5 = 0, thue_5 = 0, thue_nt_8 = 0, thue_8 = 0, thue_nt_0 = 0, thue_0 = 0, thue_nt_99 = 0, thue_99 = 0 WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	UPDATE #report SET km_yn = 0
	UPDATE #report SET customize = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1 AND line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	IF @printVATDetail = 0 UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 1
		SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr
	ELSE
	SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup
			, so_lien, so_lien2, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam
			, thue_suat, ten_kh, thanh_toan, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word
			, dien_giai, customize, detail
		FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ConvertContracts2NextYear]
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@CustomerBalance CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d0 VARCHAR(23), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	--
	SELECT @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @dStart = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @dEnd = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')
	SELECT @d0 = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), GETDATE(), 121) + ''''
	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = ''

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL OR @UnitKey <> '' SET @Key = ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gldcsd FROM gldcsd
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, ' + CASE WHEN @CustomerBalance = 1 THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[ma_hd <> '''' and exists (select 1 from dmhd b with(nolock) where a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd and b.hd_sd_pslk = 1)' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd' + CASE WHEN @CustomerBalance = 1 THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gldcsd select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ' + CASE WHEN @CustomerBalance = 1 THEN 'a.ma_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from gldcsd a with(nolock)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ma_hd <> '''' and a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + ''' and exists (select 1 from dmhd b where a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd and b.hd_sd_pslk = 1)' + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd' + CASE WHEN @CustomerBalance = 1 THEN ', a.ma_kh' ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @Key = REPLACE(@Key, 'a.ma_dvcs', 'ma_dvcs')
	--
	SELECT @q = 'delete from cdhd where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key

	IF @CustomerBalance = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'insert into cdhd (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, '''' as ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00 from cdhd b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + @Key + ' and exists (select 1 from dmhd c where b.ma_hd = c.ma_hd and c.hd_sd_pslk = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ') a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'insert into cdhd (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00 from cdhd b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + @Key + ' and exists (select 1 from dmhd c where b.ma_hd = c.ma_hd and c.hd_sd_pslk = 1) and exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 o where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where o.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd o where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where o.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 1) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ') a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, ma_kh'

		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'insert into cdhd (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, ma_kh, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd, '''' as ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + @d0 + ''', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'from (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(du_no00) as du_no00, sum(du_co00) as du_co00, sum(du_no_nt00) as du_no_nt00, sum(du_co_nt00) as du_co_nt00 from cdhd b with(index(nam), nolock) where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + @Key + ' and exists (select 1 from dmhd c where b.ma_hd = c.ma_hd and c.hd_sd_pslk = 1) and exists (select 1 from dmtk d where b.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 0) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #ct00 o where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where o.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 0) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd)'
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13)
		SELECT @q = @q + 'union all (select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt) from #gldcsd o where exists (select 1 from dmtk d where o.tk = d.tk and d.tk_cn = 0) group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_hd)'
		SELECT @q = @q + ') a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_hd'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--

	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update cdhd set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 > 0 then @du_no00 else 0 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 > 0 then @du_no_nt00 else 0 end
				, du_co00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then - @du_no00 else 0 end, du_co_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then - @du_no_nt00 else 0 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete cdhd where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0 and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdvv]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_vv, d.ten_vv2, ISNULL(e.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh, ISNULL(e.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh2
		FROM cdvv a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmvv d ON a.ma_vv = d.ma_vv	
			LEFT JOIN dmkh e ON a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh	
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforePaymentInvoice]
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TablePrime VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @provider INT

	SELECT @TablePrime = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'm21$' WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'm81$' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'm86$' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$' END, @qUpdate = ''	
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'key', '', @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + '000000 a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' BEGIN
			-- Check Modify Date
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END
		
		-- Check Status E-Invoice
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' THEN @p ELSE '000000' END + ' a join  hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where (isnull(b.trang_thai_tt, '''') <> ''0'' or b.tinh_trang_hddt not in (''2'', ''3''' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN ', ''4'', ''9''' ELSE '' END + ')) and exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
		
		
		-- Update status
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set trang_thai_tt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs_ReCalCurrStock] @nYear NUMERIC(4), @cWh VARCHAR(33), @cItem VARCHAR(33), @Stock TINYINT = 0 -- 1 Stock Balance
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @_table VARCHAR(32), @_bal VARCHAR(32), @_detail VARCHAR(32), @_field_group VARCHAR(64), @compact BIT, @StockOnHand BIT, @Split BIT
	DECLARE @tmpYear NUMERIC(4), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	
	SELECT @tmpYear = nam_bd FROM dmstt
	SELECT @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @compact = 0, @StockOnHand = 0, @Split = 0, @q = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_compact_mode' AND val = '1') SELECT @compact = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_onhand' AND val = '1') SELECT @StockOnHand = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @Split = 1

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x INTO #ct70 FROM r70$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, tien_nhap, tien_xuat, tien_nt_n, tien_nt_x INTO #ct70x FROM #ct70

	IF @Stock = 0
		SELECT @q = 'INSERT INTO #ct70 SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap), sum(sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap), sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n), sum(tien_nt_x) FROM r70$%Partition with(nolock) GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	IF (@Stock = 0 AND @Split = 0) BEGIN
		-- Physics key
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, 0, NULL, 1, 1
		SET @k = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@k)
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #ct70x SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap), sum(sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap), sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n), sum(tien_nt_x) FROM r70$%Partition with(nolock) WHERE %[' + REPLACE(@k, '%a.', '') + ']% GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
	END
	IF @Stock = 1 OR @Split = 0
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #ct70x SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_nhap), sum(sl_xuat), sum(tien_nhap), sum(tien_xuat), sum(tien_nt_n), sum(tien_nt_x) FROM r90$%Partition with(nolock) GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, 1, 1

	IF @StockOnHand = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @d0 DATETIME
		SELECT @d0 = GETDATE()

		IF @Stock = 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #ct70 SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt73 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo HAVING NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ct70 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
			INSERT INTO cdvt13(ma_kho, ma_vt, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt73 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt13 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		END

		IF @Stock = 1 OR @Split = 0 BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #ct70x SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt93 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 GROUP BY ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo HAVING NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ct70x b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
			INSERT INTO cdvt213(ma_kho, ma_vt, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt93 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvt213 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)
		END

		IF @compact = 0 BEGIN
			IF @Stock = 1 OR @Split = 0 BEGIN
				INSERT INTO cdvitri213(ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt93 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri213 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri)
				INSERT INTO cdlo213(ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt93 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo213 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
				INSERT INTO cdklo213(ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt93 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdklo213 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
			END

			IF @Stock = 0 BEGIN
				INSERT INTO cdvitri13(ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt73 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdvitri13 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri)
				INSERT INTO cdlo13(ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt73 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdlo13 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
				INSERT INTO cdklo13(ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton13, du13, du_nt13) SELECT DISTINCT ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, 0, 0 FROM cdvt73 a WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdklo13 b WHERE a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
			END
		END
	END

	IF (@nYear = @tmpYear) AND @Stock = 0 AND @Split = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 INTO #cdvt FROM cdvt2 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear
		SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 INTO #cdvitri FROM cdvitri2 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear
		SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00 INTO #cdlo FROM cdlo2 WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear
		
		INSERT INTO #cdvt SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 FROM cdvt a WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cdvt b WHERE b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)
		INSERT INTO #cdvitri SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ton00, du00, du_nt00 FROM cdvitri a WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cdvitri b WHERE b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)
		INSERT INTO #cdlo SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, ton00, du00, du_nt00 FROM cdlo a WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(nam)) WHERE Nam = @nYear AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #cdlo b WHERE b.ma_kho = a.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = b.ma_vi_tri AND b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo)
	END	ELSE SELECT @tmpYear = 1

	--
	SELECT * INTO #t
		FROM (
			SELECT 1 AS id, 'cdvt13' AS _table, 'cdvt' AS _bal, '#ct70' AS _detail, 'ma_kho, ma_vt' AS _field_group
			UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'cdvitri13', 'cdvitri', '#ct70', 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt'
			UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'cdlo13', 'cdlo', '#ct70', 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo'
			UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'cdklo13', 'cdlo', '#ct70', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo'

			UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'cdvt213', CASE WHEN (@nYear = @tmpYear) THEN '#cdvt' ELSE 'cdvt2' END, '#ct70x', 'ma_kho, ma_vt'
			UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'cdvitri213', CASE WHEN (@nYear = @tmpYear) THEN '#cdvitri' ELSE 'cdvitri2' END, '#ct70x', 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt'
			UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'cdlo213', CASE WHEN (@nYear = @tmpYear) THEN '#cdlo' ELSE 'cdlo2' END, '#ct70x', 'ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo'
			UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'cdklo213', CASE WHEN (@nYear = @tmpYear) THEN '#cdlo' ELSE 'cdlo2' END, '#ct70x', 'ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo'
		) a

	IF @compact = 1 DELETE #t WHERE _table NOT IN ('cdvt13', 'cdvt213')
	IF @Stock = 1 DELETE #t WHERE _table IN ('cdvt13', 'cdvitri13', 'cdlo13', 'cdklo13')
	IF @Stock = 0 AND @Split = 1 DELETE #t WHERE _table IN ('cdvt213', 'cdvitri213', 'cdlo213', 'cdklo213')

	--
	SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #t
	WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @_table = _table, @_bal = _bal, @_detail = _detail, @_field_group = _field_group FROM #t WHERE id = @i
		--
		SET @q = 'UPDATE ' + @_table + ' SET ton13 = isnull(a.ton00, 0), du13 = isnull(a.du00, 0), du_nt13 = isnull(a.du_nt00, 0)'
		SET @q = @q + ' 	FROM ('
		SET @q = @q + ' 		SELECT ' + @_field_group + ', SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00'
		SET @q = @q + ' 			FROM ('
		SET @q = @q + ' 				SELECT ' + @_field_group + ', SUM(ton00) AS ton00, SUM(du00) AS du00, SUM(du_nt00) AS du_nt00'
		SET @q = @q + ' 					FROM ' + @_bal
		SET @q = @q + ' 					WHERE ' + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('#', @_bal) > 0 THEN '' ELSE 'nam = ' + STR(@nYear, 4) + ' AND' END + ' ma_kho LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cWh), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_vt LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cItem), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		SET @q = @q + ' 					GROUP BY ' + @_field_group
		SET @q = @q + ' 			UNION ALL('
		SET @q = @q + ' 				SELECT ' + @_field_group + ', SUM(sl_nhap - sl_xuat), SUM(tien_nhap - tien_xuat), SUM(tien_nt_n - tien_nt_x)'
		SET @q = @q + ' 					FROM ' + @_detail
		SET @q = @q + ' 					WHERE ma_kho LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cWh), '''', '''''') + '%'' AND ma_vt LIKE ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@cItem), '''', '''''') + '%'''
		SET @q = @q + ' 					GROUP BY ' + @_field_group
		SET @q = @q + ' 					)'
		SET @q = @q + ' 		)  b'
		SET @q = @q + ' 	GROUP BY ' + @_field_group + ') a JOIN ' + @_table + ' b ON a.' + REPLACE(@_field_group, ', ', ' + a.') + ' = b.' + REPLACE(@_field_group, ', ', ' + b.')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @i = MIN(id) FROM #t WHERE id > @i
	END


	IF @StockOnHand = 1 BEGIN
		IF @Stock = 0
			DELETE cdvt73 FROM cdvt73 WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0
		IF @Stock = 1 OR (@Stock = 0 AND @Split = 0)
			DELETE cdvt93 FROM cdvt93 WITH(INDEX(datetime2)) WHERE datetime2 <= @d0
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$WI] --fs_BeforUpdateIssue
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '0') RETURN
	
	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64)
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_yc INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d84$000000

	SELECT @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, '''''
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_yc <> '''')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN
	UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_yc = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), ' ', '0') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c87$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_yc = b.stt_rec

	-- Update Qty
	DECLARE @cMRIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLineMRIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_yc VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, stt_rec0yc, so_luong, he_so, dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET sl_xuat = sl_xuat - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @cLineMRIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update Status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_yc, MAX(dyn_yc) AS dyn_yc FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_yc
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @cMRIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_yc <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND sl_xuat > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''2'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND (status = ''3'' OR status = ''4'')'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND so_luong > sl_xuat)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + '''  AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @SOStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @SOStatus = status FROM i87$' + @dyn_yc + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c87$000000 SET status = @SOStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m87$' + @dyn_yc + ' SET status = @SOStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cMRIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
			SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
			EXEC sp_executesql @s
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cMRIDNumber, @dyn_yc
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_GLCalReverseExRD]
	@nCycle NUMERIC(2),
	@nYear NUMERIC(4),
	@cVCCode VARCHAR(33),
	@cVCSourceCode VARCHAR(33),
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @cID INT, @cNumber VARCHAR(33)
	EXEC rs_GLDelReverseExRD @nCycle, @nYear, @cVCCode, @cVCSourceCode, @nUserID, @cUnit, 'New'

	DECLARE crTranReverse CURSOR FOR SELECT a.stt, d.so_ct FROM dmcltg0 d JOIN dmcltg a ON d.stt = a.stt JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
		WHERE d.Nam = @nYear AND d.Tag <> 0 AND b.Ma_nt <> '' AND b.Ma_nt NOT IN (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0') ORDER BY a.stt FOR READ ONLY

	OPEN crTranReverse
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTranReverse INTO @cID, @cNumber
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @cNumber = STR(@nYear, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@nCycle, 2), ' ', '0')
		--
		EXEC rs_GLExeReverseExRD @nCycle, @nYear, @cID, @cNumber , @cVCCode, @cVCSourceCode, @nUserID, @cUnit
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTranReverse INTO @cID, @cNumber
	END
	CLOSE crTranReverse
	DEALLOCATE crTranReverse

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseInvoiceTaxDeduction]
	@TableNameBefore VARCHAR(33),
	@TableNameAfter VARCHAR(33),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Resign BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', ''), @TableNameBefore = REPLACE(@TableNameBefore, '''', ''), @TableNameAfter = REPLACE(@TableNameAfter, '''', '')
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TableVoucher VARCHAR(33), @provider INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	SELECT @TableVoucher = 'hrc01$000000'

	-- PadLeft...
	SELECT @q = 'update ' + @TableNameAfter + ' set so_ct_hddt = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetInvoiceFilter(so_ct_hddt)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Update status for none release invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p1 (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #stt1 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32))

	IF @Resign = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p1 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' +  @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1

		SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set nguoi_ph = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate()'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrm01$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = ' insert into #stt1 select [key] from ' + @TableNameBefore + ' a where not exists(select 1 from ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b where a.[key] = b.[key])'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt1) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p1 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from #stt1 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set tinh_trang_hddt = 0, nguoi_ph = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ngay_ph = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate()'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrm01$' + @p + ' a join #stt1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p1 WHERE p > @p
		END
	END


	-- Update status for release invoice
	CREATE TABLE #p2 (p VARCHAR(6))
	CREATE TABLE #stt2 (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(32), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_bi_mat VARCHAR(512))
	--
	DECLARE @keyFields NVARCHAR(4000), @referenceField VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @keyFields = CASE WHEN @provider = 8 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_return_fields_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN 'case when charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) > 0 then substring(%b.so_bi_mat, 1, charindex(char(255), %b.so_bi_mat) - 1) else %b.so_bi_mat end' ELSE '%b.so_bi_mat' END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #stt2 select [key], so_ct_hddt, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt' + case when @provider = 8 then ',' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', '') else ', ''''' end + ' from ' + @TableNameAfter
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #stt2) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #p2 select distinct convert(varchar(6), a.ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableVoucher + ' a where exists(select 1 from #stt2 b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2
		WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'update hrm01$' + @p + ' set status = ''2'', mau_so = b.mau_hddt, ky_hieu = b.so_seri_hddt, so_hd = b.so_ct_hddt, tinh_trang_hddt = 2, keys = ' + REPLACE(@keyFields, '%b.', 'b.') + ', nguoi_ph = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ngay_ph = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime3 = getdate()'
			SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrm01$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hrc01$000000 set status = ''2'' from hrc01$000000 a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update hri01$' + @p + ' set status = ''2'' from hri01$' + @p + ' a join ' + @TableNameAfter + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #p2 WHERE p > @p
		END
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$AfterReleaseUpdate '#stt2', @VoucherCode, @Unit, @Language, @UserID, @Admin
	END


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE VIEW v20vctgt 
AS 
	SELECT a.buoc, RTRIM(a.stored) AS stored, RTRIM(b.para) AS para, RTRIM(b.stored_name) AS stored_name, RTRIM(b.stored_name2) stored_name2, a.status
			, a.ma_gd, a.ma_bp, a.loai_yt, a.ma_yt, a.nhom_kho, a.loai_vt, a.tao_pxcl, a.tk_cl
		FROM v20ctgt a JOIN v20dmgt b ON a.stored = b.stored

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintITTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Controller VARCHAR(32),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@View TINYINT = 1, -- 1: Pdf, 2: Excel
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(33),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(511), @tk_cpxt VARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ong_ba, a.dien_giai, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho,a.ma_khon
			, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt , a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM m85$000000 a

	SELECT TOP 0 a.*, b.line_nbr , b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.gia_nt, b.tien, b.tien_nt, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail
		INTO #detail FROM #master a, d85$000000 b, dmvt c

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ong_ba, a.dien_giai, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + '''), '''''
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, ''' + REPLACE(@Language, '''', '''''') + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word, '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tien, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word, '''''
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2, '''''
	END
		SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.[user_id0], a.datetime0, a.ong_ba, replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') thang,'
	SET @q = @q + '  cast(year(a.ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @MasterTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkho b with(nolock) on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkho c with(nolock) on a.ma_khon = c.ma_kho'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, '''', '''', '''','
	SET @q = @q + ' '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', 0, 0, 0, '''', '
	SET @q = @q + ' a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2' --Service Invoice
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	IF @Voucher = 'PXI' SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PXI'
		ELSE SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PXB'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	UPDATE #detail SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct FROM #detail a JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, dien_giai = b.dien_giai
			,ma_kho = b.ma_kho, ma_khon = b.ma_khon
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE line_nbr = 1

	UPDATE #detail SET t_tien = b.t_tien, t_tien_nt = b.t_tien_nt
			,t_tien_in_word = b.t_tien_in_word, t_tien_in_word2 = b.t_tien_in_word2

		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

	IF @Desc = 0
		SELECT @q = '
select a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, c.ten_kho as ten_khon, c.ten_kho2 as ten_khon2, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkho b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho left join dmkho c on a.ma_khon = c.ma_kho order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	ELSE
		SELECT @q = '
select a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, c.ten_kho as ten_khon, c.ten_kho2 as ten_khon2 , convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkho b on a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho left join dmkho c on a.ma_khon = c.ma_kho order by a.ngay_ct desc, a.so_ct desc, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$AdjustmentInvoiceInventory]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c0 VARCHAR(4000), @c1 VARCHAR(4000), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @mTable VARCHAR(32), @dTable VARCHAR(32), @amountField VARCHAR(128), @amountDetailField VARCHAR(128), @itemField VARCHAR(128), @itemJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @isFc BIT
	DECLARE @isNote BIT, @userEmail VARCHAR(32), @userName NVARCHAR(256)

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_nn_hddt' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') SELECT @Language = 'V'

	SELECT @isNote = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(@Extension, 3, 1) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @isFc = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_fc_hddt' and val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @userEmail = ISNULL(e_mail, ''), @userName = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN comment ELSE comment2 END FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID

	SELECT @mTable = mtable, @dTable = dtable, @amountField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN mamount ELSE fcmamount END, @amountDetailField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN damount ELSE fcdamount END, @itemField = dfield, @itemJoin = djoin1
		FROM hddtfields WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode and xtype = 2

	-- Struct
	--++ Master
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ong_ba, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia
			, b.hd_so, b.hd_ngay, b.hd_cua, b.hd_ve_viec
			, b.ma_so_thue, b.ten_van_chuyen, b.hd_van_chuyen, b.pt_van_chuyen, b.xuat_tai_kho, b.nhap_tai_kho, b.nguoi_nhan
			, e.e_mail AS e_mail, a.so_ct, e.fax, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word
		INTO #master FROM m84$000000 a, v84$000000 b, dmkh e

	--++ Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.stt_rec_px AS fkey, a.ma_vt, a.dien_giai as ten_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(2)) AS xu_ly, a.line_nbr INTO #d0 FROM ctpxdc a


	-- Declare External Fields
	DECLARE @structFields VARCHAR(4000), @structFrom VARCHAR(4000), @queryFields VARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @resultFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFrom VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @detailResultFields VARCHAR(4000), @script NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @structFields = '', @structFrom = '', @queryFields = '', @queryJoin = '', @resultFields = '', @detailStructFields = '', @detailStructFrom = '', @detailQueryFields = '', @detailQueryJoin = '', @detailResultFields = '', @script = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @structFields = REPLACE(struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @structFrom = REPLACE(struct_from, '''', ''''''), @queryFields = REPLACE(query_fields, '''', ''''''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(query_join, '''', ''''''), @resultFields = REPLACE(result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND detail_struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @detailStructFields = REPLACE(detail_struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailStructFrom = REPLACE(detail_struct_from, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryFields = REPLACE(detail_query_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryJoin = REPLACE(detail_query_join, '''', ''''''), @detailResultFields = REPLACE(detail_result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND script <> '')
		SELECT @script = script FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct External Fields
	IF @structFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @structFields + ' from ' + @structFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#master', @q
	END
	IF @detailStructFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @detailStructFields + ' from ' + @detailstructFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q
	END

	-- Integrated
	DECLARE @provider INT
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	IF @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 cast('''' as nvarchar(1024)) as ghi_chuhoadon'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#master', @q
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0
	SELECT @c0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#master', '#master', null, null)
	SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c0 = REPLACE(',' + @c0, ',key,', '[key],'), @c1 = REPLACE(',' + @c1, ',key,', '[key],')

	-- Process
	--++ Master
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ong_ba, a.t_tien_nt, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, b.hd_so, b.hd_ngay, b.hd_cua, b.hd_ve_viec,
		b.ma_so_thue, b.ten_van_chuyen, b.hd_van_chuyen, b.pt_van_chuyen, b.xuat_tai_kho, b.nhap_tai_kho, b.nguoi_nhan, e.e_mail, a.so_ct, e.fax' +
		--- FC
		CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tien, ''' + @Language + ''')'
			ELSE ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		END +

		CASE WHEN @isNote = 1 THEN ', rtrim(isnull(y.xu_ly, ''0'')) + char(255) + case when isnull(y.xu_ly, ''0'') = ''2'' then y.ghi_chuhoadon else '''' end ' ELSE ' ' END +
		'from ' + @mTable + ' a with(nolock) left join vdc$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec left join dmkh e on a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh' +
		CASE WHEN @isNote = 1 THEN ' left join v03$000000 y on a.stt_rec = y.stt_rec' ELSE '' END

	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''']%'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--- FC
	IF @isFc = 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #master set ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') +  ''', ty_gia = 1 where ma_nt <> ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, e_mail INTO #v05 FROM v05$000000
	SELECT @q = ''
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #v05 select stt_rec, e_mail from v05$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE([key], '''', '''''') + '''' FROM #master
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	UPDATE #master SET e_mail = ISNULL(a.e_mail, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.e_mail, '') <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + b.e_mail FROM #master a JOIN #v05 b ON a.[key] = b.stt_rec WHERE ISNULL(b.e_mail, '') <> ''

	--++ Detail
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail(' + @c1 + ') select a.stt_rec, ' + @itemField + ', a.dvt, a.so_luong, ' + @amountDetailField
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailQueryFields END + ', 1, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + @dTable + ' a with(nolock)' + @itemJoin + @detailQueryJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[a.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END), '%table', @mTable)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @fkey VARCHAR(32), @VCCode CHAR(3), @p VARCHAR(6),@oldIdNumber VARCHAR(512), @oldPattern VARCHAR(33), @oldSerial VARCHAR(32), @oldNgay_ct SMALLDATETIME
	CREATE TABLE #adjust(so_ct_hddt VARCHAR(512), mau_hddt VARCHAR(32), so_seri_hddt VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME)
	SELECT TOP 1 @fkey = fkey, @VCCode = RIGHT(fkey, 3) FROM #detail WHERE fkey <> ''

	SELECT @p = dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetPeriod(@VCCode, @fkey)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #adjust(so_ct_hddt, mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt) select so_bi_mat, '''', '''' from hddt01$' + @p + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@fkey, '''', '') + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @oldIdNumber = so_ct_hddt, @oldPattern = mau_hddt, @oldSerial = so_seri_hddt, @oldNgay_ct = ngay_ct FROM #adjust

	-- External script
	IF RTRIM(@script) <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @script = REPLACE(@script, '%language', @Language)
		EXEC sp_executesql @script
	END

	-- Note
	IF @isNote = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v03$000000 WHERE xu_ly = 1 AND stt_rec = @VoucherID)  BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert #detail ([key], fkey, ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr, xu_ly) select @VoucherID, @fkey, ghi_chuhoadon, '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, ''4'' from v03$000000 where stt_rec = @VoucherID'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@VoucherID varchar(32), @fkey varchar(32)', @VoucherID, @fkey
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #adjust) BEGIN
		SELECT @oldIdNumber = ISNULL(@oldIdNumber, ''), @oldPattern = ISNULL(@oldPattern, ''), @oldSerial = ISNULL(@oldSerial, ''), @fkey = ISNULL(@fkey, '')
	END


	-- Result
	SELECT @q = 'select ' + @c0 + ',''' +  @Unit + ''' as ma_dvcs, case when e_mail <> '''' then e_mail else ''' + REPLACE(@userEmail, '''', '''''') + ''' end as email_kh, N''' + REPLACE(@userName, '''', '''''') + ''' as ten_kh, ''' +  @oldIdNumber + ''' as original_inv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''' + RTRIM(@oldPattern) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldSerial) + ';' + RTRIM(@oldIdNumber) + ''' as hddt_tt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @resultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @resultFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ''5'' as tinh_chat, 3 as loai_hd'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #master'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select ' + @c1
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailResultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailResultFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #detail order by id'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	--
	IF @VoucherBook <> ''
		SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, LTRIM(RTRIM(ky_hieu)) AS ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(loai_hd)) AS loai_hd FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_rptBIInspectionResultByCharacteristic]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@inspectionFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionTo VARCHAR(32),
	@plant VARCHAR(32),
	@site VARCHAR(32),
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@itemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@customer VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionLotOrigin VARCHAR(32),
	@inspectionType VARCHAR(32),
	@reportType CHAR(1),
	@status CHAR(1),
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @join NVARCHAR(1023), @plantKey NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @siteKey nvarchar(4000), @inspectionKey nvarchar(4000), @len INT, @part CHAR(6)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_lo, b.ma_diem, a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, a.status, a.sd_diem_kd
		INTO #report FROM bikd00$000000 a, bim12$000000 b
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, CAST('' AS CHAR(6)) AS part INTO #part FROM bic12$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc INTO #date FROM bim12$000000

	SELECT @join = '', @key = 'exists (select 1 from bikd02$%Partition z where z.nhom_du_lieu in (''04'', ''05'') and a.stt_rec = z.stt_rec and left(y.stt_rec, 10) = left(z.stt_rec_goc, 10))'
	SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @status <> '*' THEN 'a.status = ''' + REPLACE(@status, '''', '') + '''' ELSE 'a.status not in (''1'', ''5'')' END
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @plant, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @plantKey OUTPUT, '1'
	IF @plant <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @plantKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + '(' + @plantKey + ')'

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @site, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @siteKey OUTPUT
	IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @siteKey

	SELECT @inspectionKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionFilter ('a.ma_nguon', @inspectionLotOrigin, @userID, @admin)
	IF @inspectionKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + @inspectionKey

	IF @site <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @item <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup1 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup2 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @itemGroup3 <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'c.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@itemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @customer <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @inspectionType <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'a.ma_loai_kd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	SELECT @len = character_maximum_length FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'bikd00$000000' AND column_name = 'so_ct'
	IF @inspectionFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionFrom), '''', ''''''), @len) + ''''
	IF @inspectionTo <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + ' a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionTo), '''', ''''''), @len) + ''''
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @unitKey

	SELECT @join = ' left join bikddmloai b on a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai'
	IF @itemGroup1 + @itemGroup2 + @itemGroup3 <> '' SELECT @join = @join + ' left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'

	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	--
	SET @q = 'insert into #report select left(y.stt_rec, 10) + ''KD4'', a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_lo, y.ma_diem, a.dien_giai, null, null, a.status, a.sd_diem_kd'
	SET @q = @q + ' from bikd00$%Partition a with(nolock) join bikd03m$%Partition y on a.stt_rec = y.stt_rec_kd' + @join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @dateFrom, @dateTo, @userID, @admin

	--
	INSERT INTO #part SELECT stt_rec, ngay_ct, CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM bic12$000000 a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report b WHERE a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)
	SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #part
	WHILE @part IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'insert into #date select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ngay_ket_thuc from bim12$' + @part + ' a where exists (select 1 from #part b where b.part = ''' + @part + ''' and a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @part = MIN(part) FROM #part WHERE part > @part
	END

	UPDATE #report SET ngay_bat_dau = b.ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc = b.ngay_ket_thuc FROM #report a JOIN #date b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.*, CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt,
			CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN c.statusname ELSE c.statusname2 END AS trang_thai,
			CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN d.ten_diem ELSE d.ten_diem2 END AS ten_diem
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dmttct c ON a.status = c.status AND c.ma_ct = 'KD2'
			LEFT JOIN bikddmdiem d ON a.ma_diem = d.ma_diem
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_Print22Tran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.tk_no, a.dvt, 0 as km_yn, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt as gia_nt2, a.gia as gia2, a.tien_nt2, a.tien2, a.dien_giai, a.dien_giai as ten_vt'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' AS detail'
	
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 11, '''+@cVoucher+''', ''tk_no, dien_giai, ten_vt'','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptCheckBalanceSheetDeclaration]	
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT ma_so, ts_nv, cong_no, ngoai_bang, khong_am, cach_tinh, tk, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu INTO #v20gltc1 FROM v20gltc1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE form = @Form AND ISNULL(tk, '') <> '' AND cach_tinh = ''

	SELECT ma_so, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS kt1, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS kt2, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS kt3, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(33)) AS kt4
		INTO #report
		FROM #v20gltc1
		
	-- Tk khai báo sai
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_so, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL AS kt4
		FROM #v20gltc1 a
		WHERE ngoai_bang = '0' AND (LEFT(tk, 1) NOT IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmtk b WHERE a.tk = b.tk))

	-- Chi tiết theo 1 vế công nợ
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_so, tk, CAST(ts_nv AS INT) AS ts_nv INTO #t1 FROM #v20gltc1 WHERE cong_no = '1'
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_so, NULL, 1, NULL, NULL FROM #t1 WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #t1 GROUP BY tk HAVING MIN(ts_nv) <> 1 OR MAX(ts_nv) <> 2)

	-- Giá trị không âm
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_so, tk, CAST(ts_nv AS INT) AS ts_nv INTO #t2 FROM #v20gltc1 WHERE khong_am = '1'
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_so, NULL, NULL, 1, NULL FROM #t2 WHERE tk IN (SELECT tk FROM #t2 GROUP BY tk HAVING MIN(ts_nv) <> 1 OR MAX(ts_nv) <> 2)

	-- Tk trong/ngoại bảng
	/*
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT ma_so, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1 FROM #v20gltc1 WHERE ngoai_bang = '1'
	*/
	SELECT a.ma_so, MAX(chi_tieu) AS chi_tieu, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt1), 0) AS BIT) AS kt1, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt2), 0) AS BIT) AS kt2, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt3), 0) AS BIT) AS kt3--, CAST(ISNULL(MAX(kt4), 0) AS BIT) AS kt4
		FROM #report a JOIN #v20gltc1 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
		GROUP BY a.ma_so
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
