CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$ReleaseInvoice]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherBook VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Extension VARCHAR(1024) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')
	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @c0 VARCHAR(4000), @c1 VARCHAR(4000), @m_kt_hddt CHAR(1), @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33), @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @table VARCHAR(33), @amountField VARCHAR(128), @amountDetailField VARCHAR(128), @taxField VARCHAR(128), @taxJoin VARCHAR(511), @itemField VARCHAR(128), @itemJoin VARCHAR(511), @infoField VARCHAR(511), @infoJoin VARCHAR(511), @signature CHAR(1), @m_in_bk_yn INT
	DECLARE @isFc BIT, @isDiscount BIT, @discountField VARCHAR(128), @discountResultField VARCHAR(128), @discountDetailField VARCHAR(128), @discountDetailResultField VARCHAR(128)
	DECLARE @discountType VARCHAR(32), @isTotalDiscount BIT, @isNote BIT, @userEmail VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @discountType = SUBSTRING(@Extension, 3, 1), @isTotalDiscount = 0

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_nn_hddt' AND RTRIM(val) = '1') SELECT @Language = 'V'
	SELECT @signature = RTRIM(a.kieu_ky_so) FROM dmkysohddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND b.status = 1
	SELECT @signature = CASE WHEN @signature IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ky_hddt' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ELSE @signature END
	SELECT @m_kt_hddt = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_kt_hddt' and val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
	SELECT @isNote = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(@Extension, 4, 1) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @isFc = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_fc_hddt' and val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @isDiscount = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_007' and val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	SELECT @userEmail = ISNULL(e_mail, '') FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @UserID

	SELECT @table = ctable, @amountField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN mamount ELSE fcmamount END, @amountDetailField = CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN damount ELSE fcdamount END, @itemField = dfield, @itemJoin = djoin1, @taxField = tfield, @taxJoin = mjoin1, @infoField = mfield, @infoJoin = mjoin2
		FROM hddtfields WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode and xtype = 1

	-- Struct
	--++ Master
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kh, a.ong_ba, e.ten_kh AS ten_kh, e.ma_so_thue AS ma_so_thue, e.dia_chi AS dia_chi, e.dien_thoai AS dien_thoai, e.tk_nh AS tk_nh, e.e_mail AS e_mail
			, c.ten_ngan AS hinh_thuc_tt, a.ps_no AS t_tien, d.ma_thue AS ma_thue, d.thue_suat AS thue_suat, a.ps_no AS t_thue, a.ps_no AS t_tt, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS ghi_chuthue
		INTO #m0 FROM wrkgl a, khhddt b, dmtt c, dmthue d, dmkh e
	--++ Detail
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec AS [key], a.ma_vt, c.ten_vt AS ten_vt, a.dvt1 AS dvt, a.sl_nhap1 AS so_luong, a.gia1 AS gia, a.tien0 AS tien, a.status AS inv_type
		INTO #d0 FROM wrkin a, dmvt b, wrkoutputvat c


	-- Declare External Fields
	DECLARE @structFields VARCHAR(4000), @structFrom VARCHAR(4000), @queryFields VARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @resultFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailStructFrom VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryFields VARCHAR(4000), @detailQueryJoin VARCHAR(4000), @detailResultFields VARCHAR(4000), @script NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @structFields = '', @structFrom = '', @queryFields = '', @queryJoin = '', @resultFields = '', @detailStructFields = '', @detailStructFrom = '', @detailQueryFields = '', @detailQueryJoin = '', @detailResultFields = '', @script = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @structFields = REPLACE(struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @structFrom = REPLACE(struct_from, '''', ''''''), @queryFields = REPLACE(query_fields, '''', ''''''), @queryJoin = REPLACE(query_join, '''', ''''''), @resultFields = REPLACE(result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND detail_struct_fields <> '')
		SELECT @detailStructFields = REPLACE(detail_struct_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailStructFrom = REPLACE(detail_struct_from, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryFields = REPLACE(detail_query_fields, '''', ''''''), @detailQueryJoin = REPLACE(detail_query_join, '''', ''''''), @detailResultFields = REPLACE(detail_result_fields, '''', '''''') FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND script <> '')
		SELECT @script = script FROM dmhddtbs WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode

	-- Struct External Fields
	IF @structFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @structFields + ' from ' + @structFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q
	END
	IF @detailStructFields <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 ' + @detailStructFields + ' from ' + @detailstructFrom
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q
	END

	-- Integrated
	DECLARE @provider INT, @masterProviderJoin VARCHAR(256), @detailProviderJoin VARCHAR(256), @masterProviderFields VARCHAR(256), @detailProviderFields VARCHAR(256), @masterProviderResultFields VARCHAR(1024), @detailProviderResultFields VARCHAR(256)
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit AND b.status = 1
	SELECT @masterProviderJoin = '', @detailProviderJoin = '', @masterProviderFields = '', @masterProviderResultFields = '', @detailProviderFields = '', @detailProviderResultFields = ''

	SELECT @m_in_bk_yn = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_in_bk_hddt' AND val = '1' AND @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HD1') AND @provider = 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction
	DECLARE @isGoodsType BIT, @descriptGoodsType NVARCHAR(4000), @fAmount NVARCHAR(256), @fAmountFC NVARCHAR(256)
	SELECT @isGoodsType = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_loai_hh_hddt' AND val = '1') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE name = 'loai' AND id = OBJECT_ID(REPLACE('d' + @table, '%Partition', '000000'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	IF @provider = 8 AND @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @fAmount = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien'
		SELECT @fAmountFC = RTRIM(REPLACE(val, '''', '')) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ip_tien_nt'
		SELECT @q = 'select @descriptGoodsType = dien_giai' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END + ' from dmloaihh where loai = ''90'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@descriptGoodsType nvarchar(4000) output', @descriptGoodsType OUTPUT
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 loai from ' + REPLACE('d' + @table, '%Partition', '000000'), @detailQueryFields = @detailQueryFields + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'a.loai'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q
	END

	IF @provider IN (2, 3, 4, 8) BEGIN
		--++ Master
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 a.ngay_lct, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, b.ma_ht_tt, e.ngan_hang' + CASE WHEN @provider <> 4 THEN CASE WHEN @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 THEN ', cast('''' as nvarchar(1024)) as ghi_chuhoadon' ELSE '' END ELSE ', e.fax' END
		IF @m_in_bk_yn = 1 SELECT @q = @q + ', a.so_ct as so_bk, a.ngay_ct as ngay_bk, a.status as inv_type, a.ten_vtthue'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' from m81$000000 a, dmhttthddt b, dmkh e'

		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q


		--++ Detail
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 line_nbr, ma_thue, thue_suat, thue' + CASE WHEN @voucherCode = 'HD2' THEN ', cast(0 as int) as tt_dc' ELSE CASE WHEN @provider <> 4 THEN CASE WHEN @provider = 8 AND @voucherCode = 'HDA' THEN ', cast(0 as int) as km_yn' ELSE '' END ELSE ', cast(0 as int) as km_yn, cast ('''' as varchar(8)) as thue_suat1' END END + ' from d21$000000'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#d0', @q

		SELECT @masterProviderFields = mfields, @masterProviderJoin = mjoin, @masterProviderResultFields = mresultfields, @detailProviderFields = dfields, @detailProviderJoin = djoin, @detailProviderResultFields = dresultfields
			FROM dbo.FastBusiness$EInvoice$GetProviderFields (@VoucherCode, @provider, @Unit, @UserID, 1, @Extension)
	END

	-- Discount
	SELECT @discountField = '', @discountResultField = '', @discountDetailField = '', @discountDetailResultField = ''
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$Discount @voucherCode, @isFc, @isDiscount, 1, '#m0', '#d0', @amountField OUTPUT, @discountField OUTPUT, @discountResultField OUTPUT, @discountDetailField OUTPUT, @discountDetailResultField OUTPUT

	-- Promotion
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select top 0 t_km from m81$000000'
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#m0', @q
	END

	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #master FROM #m0
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, * INTO #detail FROM #d0

	SELECT @c0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#m0', '#master', null, null)
	SELECT @c1 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Ext$Columns('#d0', '#detail', null, null)
	SELECT @c0 = REPLACE(',' + @c0, ',key,', '[key],'), @c1 = REPLACE(',' + @c1, ',key,', '[key],')

	--++ Master
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #master(' + @c0 + ') select a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, rtrim(a.ma_kh), a.ong_ba' + @infoField
	SELECT @q = @q + ', e.dien_thoai, e.tk_nh, ' + CASE WHEN @signature = '1' OR @provider IN (2, 3, 4, 8) THEN 'e.e_mail' ELSE '''''' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ', c.ten_ngan' ELSE ', c.ten_ngan2' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ', ' + @amountField + ', ' + @taxField

	--- FC
	IF @isFc = 0 SELECT @q = @q + ', a.t_thue %p1%, a.t_tt %p2%, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '''''') + ''', a.t_tt %p2%, ''' + @Language + ''')'
	ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', a.t_thue_nt %p1%, a.t_tt_nt %p2%, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt %p2%, ''' + @Language + ''')'

	-- Promotion
	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%p1%', CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN '+ a.t_thue_km' ELSE '+ a.t_thue_km_nt' END), '%p2%', CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN '+ a.t_km + a.t_thue_km' ELSE '+ a.t_km_nt + a.t_thue_km_nt' END)
	ELSE SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%p1%', ''), '%p2%', '')

	IF @VoucherCode IN ('HDA', 'HD1', 'HD5') AND @discountType <> '0' SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ghi_chuthue'
	ELSE SELECT @q = @q + ', '''''

	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @queryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + REPLACE(@queryFields, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END) END
	SELECT @q = @q + @masterProviderFields + @discountField

	IF @VoucherCode = 'HDA' SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @isFc = 0 THEN ', a.t_km' ELSE ', a.t_km_nt' END
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from m' + @table + ' a with(nolock)'

	IF SUBSTRING(@Extension, 2, 1) = '0' SELECT @q = @q + ' join khhddt b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'

	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' join dmkh e with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = e.ma_kh' + @taxJoin + @infoJoin + @queryJoin + @masterProviderJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' z where a.stt_rec = z.[key])]%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, e_mail INTO #v05 FROM v05$000000
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #v05 select a.stt_rec, a.e_mail from v05$%Partition a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.[key]'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	UPDATE #master SET e_mail = ISNULL(a.e_mail, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.e_mail, '') <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + b.e_mail FROM #master a JOIN #v05 b ON a.[key] = b.stt_rec WHERE ISNULL(b.e_mail, '') <> ''

	-- Integrated
	IF @provider IN (2, 3, 4) BEGIN
		DECLARE @defaultPayment NVARCHAR(128), @fieldPayment VARCHAR(33)
		IF @provider IN (2, 3) BEGIN
			SELECT @defaultPayment = RTRIM(ma_ht_tt) FROM dmhttthddt WHERE ma_tt = (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_ts01') AND code = @provider
			SELECT @fieldPayment = 'ma_ht_tt'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @defaultPayment = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_ngan ELSE ten_ngan2 END FROM dmtt WHERE ma_tt = (SELECT RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hddt_ts01')
			SELECT @fieldPayment = 'hinh_thuc_tt'
		END
		--
		SELECT @q = 'update #master set hinh_thuc_tt = case when isnull(' + @fieldPayment + ', '''') = '''' then N''' + ISNULL(@defaultPayment, '') + ''' else rtrim(' + @fieldPayment + ') end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--++ Detail
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #detail(' + @c1 + ') select a.stt_rec, ' + @itemField + ', a.dvt, a.so_luong, ' + @amountDetailField + ', 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailQueryFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailQueryFields END + @detailProviderFields + @discountDetailField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from d' + @table + ' a with(nolock) ' + ' join ' + @TableName + ' z on a.stt_rec = z.[key]' + @itemJoin + @detailQueryJoin + @detailProviderJoin
	SELECT @q = @q + ' order by a.ngay_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)

	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @m_kt_hddt = '1' BEGIN
		IF @provider IN (1, 2, 8)
			UPDATE #master SET thue_suat = -1 WHERE ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0
		ELSE BEGIN
			ALTER TABLE #master ALTER COLUMN thue_suat INT NULL
			UPDATE #master SET thue_suat = NULL, t_thue = 0 WHERE ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0
		END

		-- Integrated
		IF @provider IN (2, 4, 8) BEGIN
			SELECT @q = CASE WHEN @provider = 4 THEN 'update #detail set thue_suat1 = cast(thue_suat as int) ' ELSE '' END
			SELECT @q = @q + 'update #detail ' + CASE WHEN @provider IN (2, 8) THEN 'set thue_suat = -1' ELSE 'set thue_suat1 = ''KCT''' END + ' where (ma_thue = ''' + REPLACE(@r_ma_thue0, '''', '') + '''' + CASE WHEN @provider IN (2) THEN + ' or isnull(ma_thue, '''') = ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	IF @provider = 8 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue1' AND val <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @r_ma_thue1 VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @r_ma_thue1 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue1'
		SELECT @q = '
update #master set thue_suat = -3 where ma_thue = @r_ma_thue1
update #detail set thue_suat = -3 where ma_thue = @r_ma_thue1
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r_ma_thue1 varchar(32)', @r_ma_thue1
	END

	IF @provider = 8 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue2' AND val <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @r_ma_thue2 VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @r_ma_thue2 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue2'
		SELECT @q = '
update #master set thue_suat = -2 where ma_thue = @r_ma_thue2
update #detail set thue_suat = -2 where ma_thue = @r_ma_thue2
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r_ma_thue2 varchar(32)', @r_ma_thue2
	END

	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
update #master set thue_suat = -9 where isnull(ma_thue, '''') = '''';
update #detail set thue_suat = -9 where isnull(ma_thue, '''') = ''''
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--- FC
	IF @isFc = 0 AND @provider IN (2, 3, 4, 8) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #master set ma_nt = ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') + ''', ty_gia = 1 where ma_nt <> ''' + REPLACE(@m_ma_nt0, '''', '') + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Circular 635
	ALTER TABLE #detail ADD xu_ly VARCHAR(2) NULL;
	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'update #detail set xu_ly = ' + CASE @voucherCode WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'case when isnull(km_yn, 0) <> 0 then ''2'' else ''1'' end' WHEN 'HD2' THEN '''3''' ELSE '''1''' END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Circular 78 - 90 - Tax Reduction, 07 - Fee
	IF @provider = 8 AND @isGoodsType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @processType VARCHAR(2), @processType07 VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @processType = xu_ly FROM dmloaihh WHERE loai = '90'
		SELECT @processType07 = xu_ly FROM dmloaihh WHERE loai = '07'

		SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from #detail where loai = ''90'') begin
	select [key], max(line_nbr) + 1 as line_nbr into #og from #detail group by [key]
	select a.[key], a.ma_nt, replace(@descriptGoodsType, ''#dv_tien_giam#'', space(1) + b.ra_2' + CASE @Language WHEN 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END +') as ten_vt into #mTmp from #master a left join dmnt b on b.ma_nt = ' + CASE WHEN @isFc <> 0 THEN 'a.ma_nt' ELSE '@m_ma_nt0' END + ' where exists(select 1 from #detail c where c.loai = ''90'' and c.[key] = a.[key])
	select a.[key], sum(a.tien) as tien, @processType as xu_ly, max(a.line_nbr) as line_nbr into #dTmp from #detail a where a.loai = ''90'' group by a.[key]
	delete #detail where loai = ''90''
	insert into #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, xu_ly, thue_suat, line_nbr) select a.[key], replace(b.ten_vt, ''#so_tien_giam#'', dbo.ff_NumberFormat(a.tien, @fAmount' + CASE WHEN @isFc <> 0 THEN 'FC' ELSE '' END + ')) , '''', 0, 0, 0, a.xu_ly, -9, c.line_nbr from #dTmp a join #mTmp b on a.[key] = b.[key] join #og c on a.[key] = c.[key]
	exec dbo.FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField ''[key]'', ''[key], id'', ''#detail'', ''line_nbr'', ''''
end
if exists(select 1 from #detail where loai = ''07'') begin
	update #master set t_tien = t_tien - tien from #master a join (select [key], sum(tien) as tien from #detail where loai = ''07'' group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]
	update #detail set dvt = '''', thue_suat = ''-9'', xu_ly = @processType07 where loai = ''07''
end
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@descriptGoodsType nvarchar(4000), @Language varchar(1), @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10), @fAmount varchar(256), @fAmountFC varchar(256), @processType varchar(2), @processType07 varchar(2)', @descriptGoodsType, @Language, @m_ma_nt0, @fAmount, @fAmountFC, @processType, @processType07
	END

	-- External script
	IF RTRIM(@script) <> '' BEGIN
		SELECT @script = REPLACE(@script, '%language', @Language)
		EXEC sp_executesql @script
	END

	-- Discount
	IF @isDiscount = 1 AND @discountType <> '0' BEGIN
		IF @discountType = 2 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'select top 0 t_thue as t_thue5, t_thue as t_thue10 from m81$000000', @isTotalDiscount = 1
			EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#master', @q
		END

		EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$DiscountDetailTax @isFc, @discountType, @language, @provider
	END

	IF @provider = 8 AND @isDiscount = 1 AND @voucherCode = 'HD2' EXEC('update #master set t_ck = b.tien from #master a join (select [key], sum(tien) as tien from #detail group by [key]) b on a.[key] = b.[key]')

	-- List
	IF @m_in_bk_yn = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @detail NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT @detail = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'RPT055'

		SET @q = 'update #master set inv_type = ''1'' where ngay_bk is not null and so_bk is not null'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, inv_type, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr) SELECT [key], ten_vtthue, '''', ''1'', 0, 0, t_tt, 0, 0, 1 FROM #master WHERE inv_type = ''1'''
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, inv_type, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr) SELECT [key], REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE (N''' + @detail + ''', ''%n'', RTRIM(so_bk)), ''%d'', replace(str(day(ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'')), ''%m'', replace(str(month(ngay_bk), 2), '' '', ''0'')), ''%y'', replace(str(year(ngay_bk), 4), '' '', ''0'')), '''', ''1'', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2 FROM #master WHERE inv_type = ''1'' '
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Note
	IF @isNote = 1 AND @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT @q = '
if exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' a join v03$000000 b on a.[key] = b.stt_rec where b.xu_ly = 1) begin
	insert #detail ([key], ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien, thue_suat, thue, line_nbr, xu_ly)
		select a.[key], b.ghi_chuhoadon, '''', 0, 0, 0, -9, 0, 0, ''4'' from ' + @TableName + ' a join v03$000000 b on a.[key] = b.stt_rec where b.xu_ly = 1
end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Viettel
	IF @provider = 3 BEGIN
		DECLARE @invoiceForm VARCHAR(32)
		SELECT @invoiceForm = RTRIM(LTRIM(mau_so)) FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

		SELECT @q = 'update hddt00$%Partition set mau_hddt = ''' + REPLACE(@invoiceForm, '''', '''''') + ''' from hddt00$%Partition a join #master b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] where %[a.tinh_trang_hddt = ''1'']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Result
	SELECT @q = 'select [key], ngay_ct, rtrim(ltrim(so_ct)) as so_ct, rtrim(ma_kh) as ma_kh, ong_ba, convert(char(10), ngay_ct, 103) as ngay_hd, ' + CASE WHEN @provider = 3 THEN 'thue_suat' ELSE 'isnull(thue_suat, 0)' END + ' as thue_suat, convert(char(10), ngay_ct, 126) as ngay_ct1'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , isnull(ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(ma_so_thue, '''') as ma_so_thue, isnull(dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi, isnull(dien_thoai, '''') as dien_thoai, isnull(tk_nh, '''') as tk_nh, case when e_mail <> '''' then e_mail else ''' + REPLACE(@userEmail, '''', '''''') + ''' end as e_mail'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' , isnull(hinh_thuc_tt, '''') as hinh_thuc_tt, t_tien, t_thue, t_tt, t_tt_in_word, month(ngay_ct) as ky' + CASE WHEN @Provider = 8 THEN + ',''' + @Unit + ''' as ma_dvcs' ELSE '' END + CASE WHEN @Provider = 8 AND @VoucherCode = 'HD2' THEN + ', 1' ELSE ', 0' END + ' as loai_hd'
	IF @isTotalDiscount = 1 SELECT @q = @q + ' , t_thue5, t_thue10'
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @resultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @resultFields END
	SELECT @q = @q + @masterProviderResultFields + @discountResultField + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HDA' THEN ', t_km' ELSE '' END
	IF @provider = 8 SELECT @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode = 'HD2' THEN '''9''' ELSE '''1''' END + ' as tinh_chat'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #master order by id'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select [key], isnull(ten_vt, '''') as ten_vt, dvt, so_luong, gia, tien' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN ', xu_ly' ELSE '' END
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @detailResultFields = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @detailResultFields END + @detailProviderResultFields + @discountDetailResultField
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #detail order by [key], id'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF @provider = 8 BEGIN
		SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook)) AS mau_so, '' AS ky_hieu, '' AS loai_hd
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @VoucherBook = RTRIM(LTRIM(@VoucherBook))
	IF @VoucherBook <> '' SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(mau_so)) AS mau_so, LTRIM(RTRIM(ky_hieu)) AS ky_hieu, LTRIM(RTRIM(loai_hd)) AS loai_hd FROM dmnkhddt WHERE ma_nk = @VoucherBook

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptIncomeStatement] --fs20_IncomeStatementPart1
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousBegin AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousEnd AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mau nam, 2 - Mau giua nien do
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc2 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		-- Luy ke nam nay
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		-- Luy ke nam truoc
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END
	END

	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(48), @Tk_co CHAR(48), @Giam_tru TINYINT, @Tk_kqkd VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Tk_no, Tk_co, Giam_tru FROM #report WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	SELECT @Tk_kqkd = (RTRIM(val) + '%') FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_TK_KQKD'
	
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
				END
			END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn, 
				Ky_truoc_nt = @Ky_truoc_nt, Ky_nay_nt = @Ky_nay_nt, Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt , Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc = 0 WHERE ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc_nt = 0 WHERE ky_truoc_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay_nt = 0 WHERE ky_nay_nt IS NULL

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSQL = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSQL)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT chi_tieu, chi_tieu2, ma_so, thuyet_minh, stt AS sysorder, ky_nay_nt, ky_truoc_nt, lk_kn_nt, lk_kt_nt, ky_nay, ky_truoc, lk_kn, lk_kt, bold, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal FROM #report ORDER BY Stt

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptStockBalanceSlow] -- fs_StockBalanceSlow2Rotate
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateCount NUMERIC(4, 0),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(128),
	@OrderBy VARCHAR(128),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@DynamicKeyTable VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Key2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @q2 NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateFrom2 SMALLDATETIME, @StartDate SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1024), @m_vt_clc INT, @Obsolete BIT

	SELECT @m_vt_clc = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_vt_clc'
	SELECT @Obsolete = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

	-- Struct
	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vt, sl_nhap AS so_luong, tien_nhap AS tien, tien_nt_n AS tien_nt INTO #bal FROM wrkin
	SELECT ma_vt, ngay_ct AS ngay_nhap, ngay_ct AS ngay_xuat INTO #tmp1 FROM wrkin
	SELECT ma_vt, ngay_ct AS ngay_nhap, ngay_ct AS ngay_xuat INTO #tmp2 FROM wrkin

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = '', @DateFrom = DATEDIFF(dd, @DateCount, @DateTo)
	IF @ItemGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ItemGroup3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @DynamicKeyTable, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[dmvt]', 'b')

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	IF @Key <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'

	INSERT #bal EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Balance$Item @DateFrom, @Unit, '', @Item, '2', '2', @DataType, @UserID, @Admin, @Join, @Key
	DELETE #bal WHERE ISNULL(so_luong, 0) = 0

	SELECT @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Report$GetDeleteNoneInvetoryItem('#bal', 'ma_vt', 1)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Vat tu co xuat trong ky
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT
	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @SiteKey

	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	-- Không xét phiếu xuất điều chuyển khi lấy ps trong sổ kho
	SET @Key = 'a.ma_ct <> ''PXB''' + CASE @Key WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @Key
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	SET @Key2 = @Key

	-- không lấy dữ liệu ngày nhập đối với dữ liệu từ sổ kho
	DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select a.ma_vt, null, max(case when nxt = 2 then a.ngay_ct else null end)'
	IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
		-- Physics
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key2 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key2)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Dau ky
	IF @m_vt_clc = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @StartDate = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@DateFrom), @DateFrom2 = DATEDIFF(dd, 1, @DateFrom)

		IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select ma_vt, ngay_nhap, ngay_xuat from cdvtlc2 with(nolock, index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@StartDate))-- + ' and ma_vt not in (select ma_vt from #tmp1 where ngay_nhap is not null and ngay_xuat is not null)'
			IF @Obsolete = 1 SET @q = @q + ' union all (select ma_vt, ngay_nhap, ngay_xuat from cdvtlc with(nolock, index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@StartDate)) + ' and str(nam, 4) + ma_vt not in (select str(nam, 4) + ma_vt from cdvtlc2 where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@StartDate)) + '))'
		END ELSE
			SET @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select ma_vt, ngay_nhap, ngay_xuat from cdvtlc with(nolock, index(nam)) where nam = ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@StartDate))-- + ' and ma_vt not in (select ma_vt from #tmp1 where ngay_nhap is not null and ngay_xuat is not null)'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Xoa vat tu co xuat trong ky
	DELETE #bal WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #tmp1 WHERE ngay_xuat IS NOT NULL AND (ngay_xuat BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo))

	-- Ngay xuat cuoi
	IF @m_vt_clc = 1 BEGIN
		SET @Key2 = @Key
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp1 select a.ma_vt, max(case when nxt = 1 then a.ngay_ct else null end), max(case when nxt = 2 then a.ngay_ct else null end)'
		IF @DataType = '1' BEGIN
			SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
			SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @StartDate, @DateFrom2, @UserID, @Admin
			SET @Key2 = @Key2 + CASE WHEN @Key2 = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		END
		IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Obsolete = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join
			SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key2 + ']% group by a.ma_vt'
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @StartDate, @DateFrom2, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		INSERT INTO #tmp2 SELECT ma_vt, MAX(ngay_nhap) AS ngay_nhap, MAX(ngay_xuat) AS ngay_xuat FROM #tmp1 WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #bal) GROUP BY ma_vt

		-- Xoa vat tu co ngay nhap trong ky
		DELETE #bal WHERE ma_vt IN (SELECT ma_vt FROM #tmp2 WHERE ngay_nhap BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo)
		DELETE #tmp2 WHERE ngay_nhap BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
	END

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt, a.ma_vt, SUM(so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt
			, MAX(ngay_xuat) AS ngay_xuat, MAX(c.dvt) AS dvt, MAX(c.loai_vt) AS loai_vt, MAX(c.nh_vt1) AS nh_vt1, MAX(c.nh_vt2) AS nh_vt2, MAX(c.nh_vt3) AS nh_vt3
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN MAX(c.ten_vt2) ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		INTO #report
		FROM #bal a LEFT JOIN #tmp2 b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt', 'INT, NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Order
	DECLARE @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @o = @GroupBy + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@OrderBy) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @OrderBy END
	IF @GroupBy <> '' EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @GroupBy, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''
		ELSE EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', @OrderBy, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @GroupBy <> '' BEGIN
		IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) = 'loai_vt'
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertItemGroup('loai_vt', 'ma_loai_vt', 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report' , 'dmloaivt', 'ten_loai_vt')
		ELSE
			SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup(@GroupBy , 'vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('vt', 'so_luong, tien, tien_nt', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	IF RTRIM(LTRIM(@GroupBy)) <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_xuat, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@GroupBy, 'sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@OrderBy) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @OrderBy END) + ', stt'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ngay_xuat, ma_vt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report order by sysorder' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@OrderBy) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @OrderBy END + ', stt'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$JobCustomer]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023),
	@Job VARCHAR(1023),
	@Customer VARCHAR(1023),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Job, 2 Multi Job	
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'', 
	@Type TINYINT = 0 -- 0: Default, 1 - Multi-Account
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdvv

	SELECT @Key = 'a.ma_kh <> ''''', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	IF @Type = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(@Job, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.ma_vv', 'exactinlist', @Job)
		IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.ma_kh', 'exactinlist', @Customer)
	END

	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdvv a with (nolock, index(nam)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4) + ' and ' + @Key
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with(nolock) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ''1'' and ' + @Key
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_vv, ma_kh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_vv, ma_kh order by tk, ma_vv, ma_kh'
	END	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptListOfAutoGeneratedTransactions]
	@PeriodFrom NUMERIC(2,0),
	@PeriodTo NUMERIC(2,0),
	@YearFrom NUMERIC(4,0), 
	@YearTo NUMERIC(4,0),
	@cAction CHAR(2),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS nh_dk, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, dien_giai INTO #gl FROM wrkgl

	SELECT @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@PeriodFrom, @YearFrom), @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@PeriodTo, @YearTo)
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	SELECT @Key = 'ma_ct = ''' + CASE @cAction WHEN '10' THEN 'PK4'
												WHEN '20' THEN 'PK3' 
												WHEN '30' THEN 'PK6' 
												WHEN '40' THEN 'PK2' 
												WHEN '50' THEN 'PK5'
												WHEN '60' THEN 'PK7'
												WHEN '70' THEN 'PXF'
												WHEN '80' THEN 'CO1' END + ''''
	SET @Key = @Key + ' and abs(ps_no) + abs(ps_no_nt) <> 0'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SET @q = 'insert into #gl (tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, dien_giai)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_co_nt) as ps_co_nt, dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']% group by ma_ct, tk, tk_du, dien_giai'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dFrom, @dTo, @UserID, @Admin	

	SELECT 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, a.nh_dk, a.tk, a.tk_du, a.dien_giai, a.ps_no, a.ps_co, a.ps_no_nt, a.ps_co_nt
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN a.dien_giai ELSE '' END AS ten_dg, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN a.dien_giai ELSE '' END AS ten_dg2
		INTO #report
		FROM (SELECT nh_dk, tk, tk_du, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_no * 0 AS ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_no_nt * 0 AS ps_co_nt FROM #gl
				UNION ALL SELECT nh_dk, tk_du, tk, dien_giai, 0, ps_no, 0, ps_no_nt FROM #gl) a

	IF (@cAction = '50' OR @cAction = '60' OR @cAction = '70' OR @cAction = '80') BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'nh_dk, tk, tk_du', 'INT, #, #')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('dg', 'ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt', '#report')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt, ten_dg, ten_dg2
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysorder, nh_dk, CASE WHEN (ps_no + ps_no_nt) <> 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vtdmtn]
AS
SELECT a.ma_tn, a.ten_tn, a.ten_tn2, a.loai_tn, a.loai, c.kieu_thue, a.nguong_thue, a.nguong_thue_nt, a.ma_thue_tp, ISNULL(b.thue_suat, 0) AS thue_suat, a.status, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
	FROM tdmtn AS a LEFT JOIN tdmthuetp b ON a.ma_thue_tp = b.ma_thue
		LEFT JOIN .tdmloaitn c ON c.ma_loai = a.loai_tn

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPXTranMultiCopies]
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@cMTable CHAR(10),
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '', 
	@printVATDetail BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @so_lien INT, @max INT, @cLan CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @ei001 NVARCHAR(511), @ei002 NVARCHAR(511), @ei003 NVARCHAR(511), @eiFields VARCHAR(511), @eiJoin VARCHAR(511), @printTable VARCHAR(32), @printJoin VARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @r_ma_thue0 VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @r_ma_thue0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '''''') FROM options WHERE name = 'r_ma_thue0'
	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	SELECT @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @cLan = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END

	-- Loc trong tep ph
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ky_hieu, a.so_seri, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai
			, b.doi_tac, b.ten_kh, b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan AS thanh_toan, c.ten_ngan2 AS thanh_toan2
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt AS t_tt, a.t_tt_nt AS t_tt_nt
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS thue_suat, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS sd_hddt_yn, CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS in_yn
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize, a.ma_thue, a.thue_suat AS thue_suatx
		INTO #master FROM wrkpstran a, dmkh b, dmtt c

	SELECT @eiFields = ' isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), ''''), a.so_seri, a.so_ct', @eiJoin = '', @printJoin = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sd_hddt' AND val = '1')  BEGIN
		SELECT @ei001 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI001'
		SELECT @ei002 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI002'
		SELECT @ei003 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'EI003'

		DECLARE @d CHAR(6)
		SET @q = 'select @d = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @cMTable  + ' a where ' + @key
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d char(6) out', @d OUT

		SELECT @eiFields = N' isnull(case when w.mau_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei001) + ''' else w.mau_hddt end, isnull(rtrim(k.ky_hieu), '''')),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_seri_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei002) + ''' else w.so_seri_hddt end, a.so_seri),'
				+ N' isnull(case when w.so_ct_hddt = '''' then N''' + RTRIM(@ei003) + ''' else w.so_ct_hddt end, a.so_ct)',
			@eiJoin = ' left join hddt00$' + @d + ' w with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = w.stt_rec'
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_sl_in' AND val = '1')  SELECT @printTable = 'hdin$' + RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6), @printJoin = ' left join ' + @printTable + ' p with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = p.stt_rec'

	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.ma_kh,' + @eiFields + ', a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ong_ba, b.ten_kh' + @cLan + ', b.ma_so_thue, b.dia_chi, b.dien_thoai, b.tk_nh, b.ngan_hang, b.tinh_thanh, c.ten_ngan, c.ten_ngan2'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien, a.t_tien_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', case when d.ma_thue = ''' + @r_ma_thue0 + ''' or d.ma_thue = '''' then ''\'' else cast(cast(d.thue_suat as int) as varchar) + ''%'' end'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_in_word'
	SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word'	
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @eiJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when w.stt_rec is null then 0 else 1 end' END
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @printJoin = '' THEN ', 0' ELSE ', case when p.in_yn = 1 then 1 else 0 end' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END + ', a.ma_thue, d.thue_suat'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @cMTable + ' a with(nolock) left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtt c with(nolock) on a.ma_tt = c.ma_tt left join dmthue d on a.ma_thue = d.ma_thue left join v20dmnk k with(nolock) on a.ma_nk = k.ma_nk' + @eiJoin + @printJoin
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cMTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS sysprint, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_vt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail, thue_nt, thue INTO #detail FROM wrksvdetail a, dmvt b
	
	SET @q =  'insert into #detail select 1, stt_rec, a.line_nbr, cast('''' as nvarchar(33)), 0, dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, gia, a.tien, a.dien_giai'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ', thue_nt, thue'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock)'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#detail'', 10, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt'', '''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #detail set stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #copy(xGroup INT, ten_lien NVARCHAR(128), ten_lien2 NVARCHAR(128))
	SELECT @i = 1, @so_lien = so_lien FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @cVoucher
	SELECT ccode, ISNULL(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END, '') AS cname, cname2 INTO #reports FROM reports WHERE LEN(ccode) = 5 AND ccode LIKE (RTRIM('LIEN') + '%')
	SELECT @max = COUNT(*) FROM #reports
	WHILE @i <= @so_lien BEGIN
		IF @i <= @max BEGIN
			SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #copy SELECT ' + RTRIM(@i) + ', cname, cname2 FROM #reports WHERE ccode = ''LIEN' + RTRIM(@i) + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END ELSE BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #copy VALUES(@i, '', '')
		END
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SELECT a.sysprint, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.ten_vt, a.km_yn, a.dvt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt2, a.tien_nt2, a.gia2, a.tien2, RTRIM(b.xGroup) AS xGroup
			, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien AS so_lien, RTRIM(b.xGroup) + b.ten_lien2 AS so_lien2
			, c.doi_tac, c.ma_so_thue, c.dia_chi, c.dien_thoai, c.tk_nh, c.ngan_hang, c.tinh_thanh, c.ma_nt, c.ngay_ct, c.ky_hieu, c.so_ct, c.so_seri, c.ngay, c.thang, c.nam
			, CASE WHEN @printVATDetail = 1 THEN CASE WHEN (ISNULL(c.thue_suatx, 0) = 0 AND (c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '')) OR (a.so_luong = 0 AND tien2 = 0) THEN '\' ELSE CAST(CAST(c.thue_suatx AS INT) AS VARCHAR(512)) + '%' END ELSE c.thue_suat END AS thue_suat
			, ten_kh, CASE WHEn @Language = 'V' THEN c.thanh_toan ELSE c.thanh_toan2 END AS thanh_toan
			, c.t_tien AS t_tien2, c.t_tien_nt AS t_tien_nt2, c.t_thue, c.t_thue_nt, c.t_tt, c.t_tt_nt, c.t_tt_nt_in_word, c.t_tt_in_word
			, c.dien_giai, c.customize, a.detail
			
			, a.thue_nt, a.thue
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_10, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_10
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_5, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_5
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_8, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_8
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_0, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_0
			, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien_nt2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_nt_99, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.tien2 ELSE 0 END AS tien_99
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_10, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 10 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_10
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_5, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 5 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_5
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_8, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 8 THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_8
			, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_0, CASE WHEN c.thue_suatx = 0 AND c.ma_thue <> @r_ma_thue0 AND c.ma_thue <> '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_0
			, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue_nt ELSE 0 END AS thue_nt_99, CASE WHEN c.ma_thue = @r_ma_thue0 OR c.ma_thue = '' THEN a.thue ELSE 0 END AS thue_99
		INTO #report FROM #detail a CROSS JOIN #copy b LEFT JOIN #master c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

		UPDATE #report SET thue_nt_10 = b.thue_nt_10, thue_10 = b.thue_10, thue_nt_5 = b.thue_nt_5, thue_5 = b.thue_5, thue_nt_8 = b.thue_nt_8, thue_8 = b.thue_8, thue_nt_0 = b.thue_nt_0, thue_0 = b.thue_0, thue_nt_99 = b.thue_nt_99, thue_99 = b.thue_99
				, tien_nt_10 = b.tien_nt_10, tien_10 = b.tien_10, tien_nt_5 = b.tien_nt_5, tien_5 = b.tien_5, tien_nt_8 = b.tien_nt_8, tien_8 = b.tien_8, tien_nt_0 = b.tien_nt_0, tien_0 = b.tien_0, tien_nt_99 = b.tien_nt_99, tien_99 = b.tien_99
			FROM #report a JOIN (
					SELECT xGroup, SUM(tien_nt_10) AS tien_nt_10, SUM(tien_10) AS tien_10, SUM(tien_nt_5) AS tien_nt_5, SUM(tien_5) AS tien_5, SUM(tien_nt_8) AS tien_nt_8, SUM(tien_8) AS tien_8, SUM(tien_nt_0) AS tien_nt_0, SUM(tien_0) AS tien_0, SUM(tien_nt_99) AS tien_nt_99, SUM(tien_99) AS tien_99
							, SUM(thue_nt_10) AS thue_nt_10, SUM(thue_10) AS thue_10, SUM(thue_nt_5) AS thue_nt_5, SUM(thue_5) AS thue_5, SUM(thue_nt_8) AS thue_nt_8, SUM(thue_8) AS thue_8, SUM(thue_nt_0) AS thue_nt_0, SUM(thue_0) AS thue_0, SUM(thue_nt_99) AS thue_nt_99, SUM(thue_99) AS thue_99
						FROM #report GROUP BY xGroup
				) b ON a.xGroup = b.xGroup

	UPDATE #report SET so_lien = '', so_lien2 = '', dien_giai = '', doi_tac = '', ten_kh = '', ma_so_thue = '', dia_chi = '', dien_thoai = '', tk_nh = '', ngan_hang = '', tinh_thanh = '', thanh_toan = '', ma_nt = '', ngay_ct = NULL, ky_hieu = '', so_ct = '', so_seri = '', ngay = '', thang = '', nam = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1
	UPDATE #report SET t_tien2 = 0, t_tien_nt2 = 0, t_thue = 0, t_thue_nt = 0, t_tt = 0, t_tt_nt = 0, t_tt_nt_in_word = '', t_tt_in_word = '', tien_nt_10 = 0, tien_10 = 0, tien_nt_5 = 0, tien_5 = 0, tien_nt_8 = 0, tien_8 = 0, tien_nt_0 = 0, tien_0 = 0, thue_nt_10 = 0, thue_10 = 0, thue_nt_5 = 0, thue_5 = 0, thue_nt_8 = 0, thue_8 = 0, thue_nt_0 = 0, thue_0 = 0, thue_nt_99 = 0, thue_99 = 0 WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	UPDATE #report SET km_yn = 0
	UPDATE #report SET customize = '' WHERE line_nbr > 1 AND line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)
	IF @printVATDetail = 0 UPDATE #report SET thue_suat = '' WHERE line_nbr < (SELECT MAX(line_nbr) FROM #report)

	IF @printVATDetail = 1
		SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr
	ELSE
		SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, ten_vt, km_yn, dvt, so_luong, gia_nt2, tien_nt2, gia2, tien2, xGroup
				, so_lien, so_lien2, doi_tac, ma_so_thue, dia_chi, dien_thoai, tk_nh, ngan_hang, tinh_thanh, ma_nt, ngay_ct, ky_hieu, so_ct, so_seri, ngay, thang, nam
				, thue_suat, ten_kh, thanh_toan, t_tien2, t_tien_nt2, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tt_nt_in_word, t_tt_in_word
				, dien_giai, customize, detail
			FROM #report ORDER BY xGroup, line_nbr

	IF OBJECT_ID(RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select case when a.sd_hddt_yn = 1 or a.in_yn = 1 then b.img_data else null end as ban_sao, rtrim(c.xGroup) as xGroup'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #master a cross join #copy c, ' + RTRIM(@SysDB) + '..reportimage b where b.id = ''' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'copy2' END + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT NULL AS ban_sao, RTRIM(c.xGroup) AS xGroup FROM #master a CROSS JOIN #copy c
	END

	IF @printJoin <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key + ') begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  update ' + @printTable + ' set sl_in = sl_in + 1, in_yn = 1, datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @printTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end else begin'
			+ CHAR(13) + '  insert into ' + @printTable + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, sl_in, in_yn, datetime0, user_id0) select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_ct, 1, 1, getdate(), ' + LTRIM(@UserID) + '  from ' + @cMTable + ' a where ' + @key
			+ CHAR(13) + 'end'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_ConvertManagementObject2NextYear]
	@objType CHAR(1),
	@nYear INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @dtCur VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @objField VARCHAR(64), @objTable VARCHAR(64), @balanceTable VARCHAR(64), @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dtCur = '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), GETDATE(), 113) + '''', @DateFrom = RTRIM(@nYear) + '0101', @DateTo = RTRIM(@nYear) + '1231', @dStart = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '0101', @dEnd = RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + '1231', @UnitKey = '', @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', '')

	IF @objType = '1'
		SELECT TOP 1 @objTable = 'dmdtqt1', @balanceTable = 'cddtqt1', @objField = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '04'
	ELSE IF @objType = '2'
		SELECT TOP 1 @objTable = 'dmdtqt2', @balanceTable = 'cddtqt2', @objField = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '05'
	ELSE IF @objType = '3'
		SELECT TOP 1 @objTable = 'dmdtqt3', @balanceTable = 'cddtqt3', @objField = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '06'

	IF @objTable IS NULL OR @balanceTable IS NULL OR ISNULL(@objField, '') = '' RETURN

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #gldcsd FROM gldcsd

	-- UnitKey
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_004' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET @UnitKey = ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', REPLACE(RTRIM(@Unit), '''', ''''''), @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL SET @UnitKey = ''
		SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @UserID = 1, @Admin = 1
	END

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, ' + @objField + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)
			from r00$%Partition a with(nolock)
			where %[' + @objField + ' <> '''' and exists (select 1 from ' + @objTable + ' b where a.' + @objField + ' = b.ma_dtqt and b.dtqt_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk, ' + @objField
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #gldcsd select ma_dvcs, tk, ' + @objField + ', sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)
			from gldcsd a with(nolock)
			where ' + @objField + ' <> '''' and a.ngay_ct between ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dStart, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @dEnd, 112) + ''' and exists (select 1 from ' + @objTable + ' b where a.' + @objField + ' = b.ma_dtqt and b.dtqt_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, ' + @objField
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SELECT @q = 'delete from ' + @balanceTable + ' where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey + '
		insert into ' + @balanceTable + ' (nam, ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		select ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_dtqt, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00), '''', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + @dtcur + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + '
		from (
				select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, du_no00, du_co00, du_no_nt00, du_co_nt00
					from ' + @balanceTable + ' e with(index(nam), nolock)
					where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and exists (select 1 from ' + @objTable + ' f where e.ma_dtqt = f.ma_dtqt and f.dtqt_sd_pslk = 1)' + @UnitKey + '
				union all
				select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
					from #ct00
				union all
				select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_dtqt, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt
					from #gldcsd
		) a group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_dtqt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SELECT @q = 'declare @du_no00 numeric(28, 6), @du_no_nt00 numeric(28, 6)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '
		update ' + @balanceTable + ' set @du_no00 = du_no00 - du_co00, @du_no_nt00 = du_no_nt00 - du_co_nt00
				, du_no00 = case when @du_no00 > 0 then @du_no00 else 0 end, du_no_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 > 0 then @du_no_nt00 else 0 end
				, du_co00 = case when @du_no00 < 0 then - @du_no00 else 0 end, du_co_nt00 = case when @du_no_nt00 < 0 then - @du_no_nt00 else 0 end
			where nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear + 1) + @UnitKey

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete ' + @balanceTable + ' where du_no00 + du_co00 + du_no_nt00 + du_co_nt00 = 0' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_DeleteAllocTrans]
	@nMF INT,
	@nMT INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@nUserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1023),	
	@cAction VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @cStt_rec CHAR(13), @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	
	IF @cAction = 'Del'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'Delete')
	IF @cAction = 'New'
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'New')

	SELECT @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMT, @nYear)

	--
	SELECT @s = 'DELETE FROM ct00 WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SELECT @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DELETE FROM %r00 WHERE stt_rec = ''%stt_rec'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @s = @s + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	END
	--

	SET @i = @nMF
	WHILE @i <= @nMT BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'DECLARE csTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' AS stt_rec'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' FROM dmpbn WHERE nam = ' + STR(@nYear, 4) + ' AND tag <> 0 AND stt_rec' + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0') + ' <> '''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		OPEN csTran
		FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '%stt_rec', RTRIM(@cStt_rec)), '%r00', 'r00$' + RTRIM(@nYear) + REPLACE(STR(@i, 2), ' ', '0'))
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			FETCH NEXT FROM csTran INTO @cStt_rec
		END
		CLOSE csTran
		DEALLOCATE csTran

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdtd1]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_td, d.ten_td2
		FROM cdtd1 a 
			JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmtd1 d ON a.ma_td = d .ma_td
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_td

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$EInvoice$BeforeClearPaymentInvoice]
	@TableName VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--
	SELECT @TableName = REPLACE(@TableName, '''', ''), @VoucherCode = REPLACE(@VoucherCode, '''', ''), @Unit = REPLACE(@Unit, '''', ''), @Language = REPLACE(@Language, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @p VARCHAR(6), @TablePrime VARCHAR(32), @code VARCHAR(32), @qUpdate NVARCHAR(4000), @provider INT

	SELECT @TablePrime = CASE @VoucherCode WHEN 'HD1' THEN 'm21$' WHEN 'HDA' THEN 'm81$' WHEN 'PXC' THEN 'm86$' WHEN 'PXD' THEN 'm26$' END, @qUpdate = ''
	SELECT TOP 1 @provider = a.dich_vu_hddt FROM tkhddt a JOIN tkhddtdv b ON a.ma_kn = b.ma_kn WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @Unit and b.status = 1

	-- Check idNumber access
	DECLARE @result TINYINT
	EXEC FastBusiness$EInvoice$CheckAccessRight @voucherCode, @TableName, 'key', '', @UserID, @Admin, @result OUTPUT
	IF @result <> 1 BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 99 AS typecheck, '' AS val
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Unit
	IF @provider IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS result, 3 AS typecheck, @Unit AS val
		RETURN
	END

	--
	IF @VoucherCode = 'PXD' BEGIN
		-- Check Modify Date
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + '000000 a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END
	END

	CREATE TABLE #partition(p VARCHAR(6))
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #partition select distinct convert(varchar(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @TableName
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition
	WHILE @p IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' BEGIN
			-- Check Modify Date
			SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + @p + ' a join ' + @TableName + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.[key] and rtrim(replace(replace(replace(convert(varchar(32), a.datetime2, 20), '' '', ''''), '':'', ''''), ''-'', '''')) <> b.datetime2'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT
			IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
				RETURN
			END
		END

		-- Check Status E-Invoice
		SELECT @q = 'select top 1 @codeOut = a.so_ct from ' + @TablePrime + CASE WHEN @VoucherCode <> 'PXD' THEN @p ELSE '000000' END + ' a join  hddt00$' + @p + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where (isnull(b.trang_thai_tt, '''') <> ''2'' or b.tinh_trang_hddt not in (''2'', ''3''' + CASE WHEN @provider = 8 THEN ', ''4'', ''9''' ELSE '' END + ')) and exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@codeOut varchar(32) output', @codeOut = @code OUTPUT

		IF ISNULL(@code, '') <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS result, 1 AS typecheck, @code AS val
			RETURN
		END


		-- Update status
		SELECT @qUpdate = @qUpdate + CHAR(13) + 'update hddt00$' + @p + ' set trang_thai_tt = 1, datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(22), GETDATE(), 113) + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ' from hddt00$' + @p + ' a where exists(select 1 from ' + @TableName + ' b where a.stt_rec = b.[key])'

		--
		SELECT @p = MIN(p) FROM #partition WHERE p > @p
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @qUpdate

	SELECT 1 AS result, 0 AS typecheck, '' AS val

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

		FROM hrrmslnv a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.ma_vtr = c.ma_vtr
