CREATE VIEW sysconstraints 
AS 
	SELECT	constid = convert(int, id),
			id = convert(int, parent_obj),
			colid = convert(smallint, info),
			spare1 = convert(tinyint, 0),
			status = convert(int,
					CASE xtype
						WHEN 'PK' THEN 1 WHEN 'UQ' THEN 2 WHEN 'F' THEN 3
						WHEN 'C' THEN 4 WHEN 'D' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN info != 0			-- CNST_COLUMN / CNST_TABLE
							THEN (16) ELSE (32) END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 16)!=0	-- CNST_CLINDEX
							THEN (512) ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 32)!=0	-- CNST_NCLINDEX
							THEN (1024) ELSE 0 END
					+ (2048)						-- CNST_NOTDEFERRABLE
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 256)!=0	-- CNST_DISABLE
							THEN (16384) ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 512)!=0	-- CNST_ENABLE
							THEN (32767) ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 4)!=0		-- CNST_NONAME
							THEN (131072) ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 1)!=0		-- CNST_NEW
							THEN (1048576) ELSE 0 END
					+ CASE WHEN (status & 1024)!=0	-- CNST_REPL
							THEN (2097152) ELSE 0 END),
			actions = convert(int,  4096),
			error = convert(int, 0)
		FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype in ('C', 'F', 'PK', 'UQ', 'D')  AND (status & 64) = 0

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$BI$AccountAssignment$Post]
	@SourceTable VARCHAR(32),
	@DestinationTable VARCHAR(32),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@ResultType TINYINT = 1 -- 1 insert data, 2 select data
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', ''), @SourceTable = REPLACE(@SourceTable, '''', ''), @DestinationTable = REPLACE(@DestinationTable, '''', '')

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ct_dt_pb NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(13), @stt_rec0 VARCHAR(3), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_vt VARCHAR(32), @ma_loai VARCHAR(32)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_vt, loai_dt, ct_dt_pb, line_nbr INTO #s FROM d91$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_loai, so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_sp, ma_hd, ma_phi, ma_ku, line_nbr INTO #biaa FROM biaa00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT TOP 0 so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr INTO #d FROM #biaa

	-- Get data
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #s select stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_vt, loai_dt, ct_dt_pb, line_nbr from ' + QUOTENAME(@SourceTable) + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber and ct_dt_pb <> '''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@IDNumber varchar(13)', @IDNumber
	SELECT @i = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #s
	WHILE (@i IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @stt_rec = stt_rec, @stt_rec0 = stt_rec0, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_vt = ma_vt, @ma_loai = loai_dt, @ct_dt_pb = ct_dt_pb FROM #s WHERE line_nbr = @i
		TRUNCATE TABLE #d
		EXEC dbo.[FastBusiness$App$ConvertStringArray] @ct_dt_pb, '#d', 'line_nbr, so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi'
		EXEC sp_executesql N'insert into #biaa (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_loai, so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr) select @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ma_ct, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_loai, so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr from #d order by line_nbr'
			, N'@stt_rec varchar(13), @stt_rec0 varchar(3), @ngay_ct smalldatetime, @ma_vt varchar(32), @ma_loai varchar(32), @ma_ct char(3)', @stt_rec, @stt_rec0, @ngay_ct, @ma_vt, @ma_loai, @VoucherCode
		SELECT @i = MIN(line_nbr) FROM #s WHERE line_nbr > @i
	END

	IF @ResultType = 2 BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, ngay_ct, ma_vt, ma_loai, so_luong, ty_le, tk, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, line_nbr FROM #biaa
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = 'delete ' + @DestinationTable + ' where stt_rec = @IDNumber;insert into ' + QUOTENAME(@DestinationTable) + ' select * from #biaa;'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@IDNumber varchar(13)', @IDNumber

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptIncomeStatementbyJob] --fs20_JobIncomeStatement
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME
	, @ParentJob VARCHAR(33)
	, @Job VARCHAR(33)
	, @Type CHAR(1)
	, @Group CHAR(1)
	, @Unit VARCHAR(1023)
	, @ReportForm CHAR(2) --10: Mau chuan, 20: Mau ngoai te
	, @Language CHAR(1)
	, @UserID INT
	, @Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT 0 AS gr, * INTO #v20covvct1 FROM v20covvct1 WHERE form = ''
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @firstcolumn VARCHAR(512), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @StartDate SMALLDATETIME, @Date SMALLDATETIME, @iCount INT, @i INT, @s NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_vv VARCHAR(33), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Ma_vvct CHAR(128), @No_co CHAR(1), @Kind CHAR(1), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(256)
		, @iMa_vvct VARCHAR(33), @iTk_no VARCHAR(128), @iTk_no_du VARCHAR(128), @iTk_no_gt VARCHAR(128), @iTk_co VARCHAR(128), @iTk_co_du VARCHAR(128), @iTk_co_gt VARCHAR(128)
		, @Gr NUMERIC(1), @s1 NVARCHAR(511), @s2 NVARCHAR(511), @s3 NVARCHAR(511), @s4 NVARCHAR(511), @s5 NVARCHAR(511), @s6 NVARCHAR(511), @sTotal NVARCHAR(511)
	--
	SELECT @sTotal = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'TOTAL'
	SELECT @s1 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT01'
	SELECT @s2 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT02'
	SELECT @s3 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT03'
	SELECT @s4 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT04'
	SELECT @s5 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT05'
	SELECT @s6 = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'COVVCT06'

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2)) AS sysorder, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2)) AS sysprint, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2)) AS systotal
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysorderrow, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(512)) AS sysColumn
			, ma_vv AS ma_vv_me, ma_vv, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(16)) AS stt
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS ma_so, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt
			, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2)) AS rowformat, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(2)) AS columnformat
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS sysRowName, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS sysColumnName, 0 AS bac_vv
		INTO #tmp
		FROM wrkColumns

	SELECT *, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS sysColumnEx, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(256)) AS sysColumnNameEx INTO #result FROM #tmp

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ngay_ct INTO #gl FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ngay_ct INTO #gl01 FROM wrkgl

	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt INTO #gl00 FROM v20vvlkct
	SELECT TOP 0 0 AS gr, (SELECT ISNULL(ma_vv, '') FROM wrkColumns) AS ma_vv, ma_so, tien, tien_nt INTO #dt FROM #v20covvct1
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_so, ma_vv, ma_dvcs, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt INTO #tmpAccum FROM v20vvlkct
	--End Struct

	SET @Key = 'ma_vv <> '''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ma_vv = '''' or dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', ma_vv) = 1)'
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and (ma_vv = '''' or ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''')  + '%'')'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = ' insert into #gl select ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) '
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1'' and ' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT @StartDate = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom)
	SELECT @Date = @DateFrom - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #gl01 select ma_vv, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ngay_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) '
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[status = ''1'' and ' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @StartDate, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	INSERT INTO #gl01 SELECT * FROM #gl
	INSERT INTO #tmpAccum EXEC FastBusiness$Accumulate$Norm @DateFrom, @Unit, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = ' if exists(select * from dmstt where day(ngay_dn) = day(ngay_dn2) and month(ngay_dn) = month(ngay_dn2))'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #gl00'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt from v20vvlkct'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where nam = year(@d) and ' + @Key
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' else'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #gl00'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select ma_so, ma_vv, lk_no_dk, lk_co_dk, lk_no, lk_co, lk_no_dk_nt, lk_co_dk_nt, lk_no_nt, lk_co_nt from #tmpAccum'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ' + @Key

	SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '@d', CHAR(39) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1023), @DateFrom, 112) + CHAR(39))
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	DECLARE @xKey1 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey2 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey3 NVARCHAR(4000), @xKey4 NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_so, ma_vvct, no_co FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE kind = '1' ORDER BY ma_so
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_vvct, @No_co
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		DECLARE xCur CURSOR FOR
		SELECT ma_so, tk_no, tk_no_du, tk_no_gt, tk_co, tk_co_du, tk_co_gt FROM v20dmvvct WHERE @Ma_vvct = '' OR dbo.ff_ExactInlist(ma_so, @Ma_vvct) = 1
		OPEN xCur
		FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @iMa_vvct, @iTk_no, @iTk_no_du, @iTk_no_gt, @iTk_co, @iTk_co_du, @iTk_co_gt
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				IF @No_co = '1' BEGIN
					--Debit
					SELECT @xKey1 = '1 = 1', @xKey2 = '1 = 1'
					IF @iTk_no <> '' BEGIN
						SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @iTk_no)
						SET @xKey2 = @xKey1
					END
					IF @iTk_no_du <> '' SET @xKey1 = @xKey1 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @iTk_no_du)
					SET @xKey2 = @xKey2 + CASE WHEN (@iTk_no_gt <> '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @iTk_no_gt) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END
					SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #dt'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 1, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_no, ps_no_nt FROM #gl'
					SET @q = @q + ' WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey1
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 1, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #gl'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey2
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, lk_no_dk, lk_no_dk_nt FROM #gl00 WHERE ma_so = @iMa_vvct'
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_no, ps_no_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey1
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey2
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, lk_no + lk_no_dk, lk_no_nt + lk_no_dk_nt FROM #gl00 WHERE ma_so = @iMa_vvct'
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_no, ps_no_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey1
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey2
				END ELSE BEGIN
					--Credit
					SELECT @xKey3 = '1 = 1', @xKey4 = '1 = 1'
					IF @iTk_co <> '' BEGIN
						SET @xKey3 = @xKey3 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk', 'inlist', @iTk_co)
						SET @xKey4 = @xKey3
					END
					IF @iTk_co_du <> '' SET @xKey3 = @xKey3 + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @iTk_co_du)
					SET @xKey4 = @xKey4 + CASE WHEN (@iTk_co_gt <> '') THEN ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('tk_du', 'inlist', @iTk_co_gt) ELSE ' and 1 = 0' END
					SET @q = 'INSERT INTO #dt'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 1, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #gl'
					SET @q = @q + ' WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey3
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 1, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #gl'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey4
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, lk_co_dk, lk_co_dk_nt FROM #gl00 WHERE ma_so = @iMa_vvct'
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey3
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 2, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey4
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, lk_co + lk_co_dk, lk_co_nt + lk_co_dk_nt FROM #gl00 WHERE ma_so = @iMa_vvct'
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, ps_co, ps_co_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_co) + ABS(ps_co_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey3
					SET @q = @q + '	UNION ALL'
					SET @q = @q + '	SELECT 3, ma_vv, @Ma_so, - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #gl01'
					SET @q = @q + '	WHERE ABS(ps_no) + ABS(ps_no_nt) <> 0 AND ' + @xKey4
				END
				SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '@Ma_so', CHAR(39) + CAST(@Ma_so AS VARCHAR(33)) + CHAR(39)), '@iMa_vvct', CHAR(39) + CAST(@iMa_vvct AS VARCHAR(33)) + CHAR(39))
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				FETCH NEXT FROM xCur INTO @iMa_vvct, @iTk_no, @iTk_no_du, @iTk_no_gt, @iTk_co, @iTk_co_du, @iTk_co_gt
			END
		CLOSE xCur
		DEALLOCATE xCur
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_vvct, @No_co
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	INSERT INTO #dt
		SELECT a.gr, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, 0, 0
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT gr, ma_vv FROM #dt) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT ma_so FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE kind = '1') b
			WHERE STR(a.gr, 2) + a.ma_vv + b.ma_so NOT IN (SELECT STR(gr, 2) + ma_vv + ma_so FROM #dt)

	SELECT gr, ma_vv, ma_so, SUM(tien) AS tien, SUM(tien_nt) AS tien_nt, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS cach_tinh, 0 AS ids
		 INTO #dtSum FROM #dt GROUP BY gr, ma_vv, ma_so

	INSERT INTO #dtSum
		SELECT a.gr, a.ma_vv, b.ma_so, 0, 0, b.cach_tinh, b.ids
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT gr, ma_vv FROM #dt) a
				CROSS JOIN (SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, ids FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE cach_tinh <> '') b

	-- formula
	SELECT DISTINCT ma_so, cach_tinh, ids INTO #r FROM #dtSum WHERE cach_tinh <> ''
	SELECT ma_so, cach_tinh, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #formula FROM #r ORDER BY ids
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$ConvertFormula '#formula', '#dtSum', @userID, @admin, 'gr, ma_vv', default, 'tien, tien_nt'
	UPDATE #dtSum SET tien = ISNULL(tien, 0), tien_nt = ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)

	DELETE #dtSum WHERE gr = 3 AND ma_so IN (SELECT ma_so FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE nh3 = 0)
	DELETE #dtSum WHERE gr = 2 AND ma_so IN (SELECT ma_so FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE nh2 = 0)
	DELETE #dtSum WHERE gr = 1 AND ma_so IN (SELECT ma_so FROM #v20covvct1 WHERE nh1 = 0)

	INSERT INTO #tmp
		SELECT 5, 1, 1
			, a.ma_vv, STR(a.gr, 2) + STR(c.stt, 6) + a.ma_so, b.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, 0
			, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, 0, 0, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE b.ten_vv2 END, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten ELSE c.ten2 END, 0
			FROM #dtSum a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
				LEFT JOIN #v20covvct1 c ON a.ma_so = c.ma_so

	SELECT @firstcolumn = MIN(sysColumn) FROM #tmp
	IF NOT @firstcolumn IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal
				, a.sysorderrow, b.sysColumn, a.ma_vv_me, a.ma_vv, a.stt
				, b.ma_so, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS tien_nt, a.rowformat, b.columnformat, a.sysRowName, b.sysColumnName, b.bac_vv
			INTO #tmp0
			FROM (
				SELECT DISTINCT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysorderrow, ma_vv_me, ma_vv, stt
					, rowformat, sysRowName FROM #tmp WHERE sysorderrow NOT IN (SELECT sysorderrow FROM #tmp WHERE sysColumn = @firstcolumn)
				) a CROSS JOIN (
								SELECT DISTINCT sysColumn, ma_so, columnformat, sysColumnName, bac_vv
									FROM #tmp WHERE sysColumn = @firstcolumn
								) b

		INSERT INTO #tmp SELECT * FROM #tmp0
		DROP TABLE #tmp0
	END
	UPDATE #tmp SET stt = NULL
	SELECT DISTINCT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt INTO #tOrder FROM #tmp WHERE ma_vv <> '' AND (@Group = '0' OR ma_vv_me = '') ORDER BY ma_vv

	UPDATE #tOrder SET systotal = 1
	SET @q = 'update #tmp set stt = b.stt'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from #tmp a join #tOrder b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	IF @Group = '1'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.ma_vv_me = '''''
	ELSE
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where a.systotal = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #tmp SET sysRowName = ISNULL(sysRowName, ''), ma_vv_me = ISNULL(ma_vv_me, ''), tien = ISNULL(tien, 0), tien_nt = ISNULL(tien_nt, 0)

	-- Tạo stt
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField '', 'ma_vv', '#tmp', 'stt', ''

	INSERT INTO #result
		SELECT *, LTRIM(LEFT(sysColumn, 2)) AS sysColumnEx
			, CASE
				WHEN LTRIM(LEFT(sysColumn, 2)) = '1' THEN @s1
				WHEN LTRIM(LEFT(sysColumn, 2)) = '2' THEN @s2
				WHEN LTRIM(LEFT(sysColumn, 2)) = '3' THEN @s3
			END AS sysColumnNameEx
		FROM #tmp
		ORDER BY sysColumn, sysorderrow

	CREATE TABLE #xpivot (id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, header NVARCHAR(4000) NULL, sysColumnNameEx NVARCHAR(4000) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header, sysColumnNameEx) SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, RTRIM(@s4) FROM #v20covvct1 ORDER BY stt, ma_so
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header, sysColumnNameEx) SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, RTRIM(@s5) FROM #v20covvct1 ORDER BY stt, ma_so
	INSERT INTO #xpivot (header, sysColumnNameEx) SELECT CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, RTRIM(@s6) FROM #v20covvct1 ORDER BY stt, ma_so

	CREATE TABLE #xcolumn (id INT, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	IF @ReportForm = 20 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'tien_nt$', N''
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #xcolumn SELECT 1, 'tien$', N''
	END

	CREATE TABLE #pivot (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NULL, header NVARCHAR(128) NULL)
	INSERT INTO #pivot
		SELECT a.id, b.name + LTRIM(a.id), CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.sysColumnNameEx) + CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 20 THEN ' nt ' ELSE '' END + ' - ' + a.header ELSE CASE WHEN @ReportForm = 20 THEN 'FC ' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(a.sysColumnNameEx) + ' - ' + a.header END
			FROM #xpivot a CROSS JOIN #xcolumn b
			ORDER BY a.id, b.id
	DROP TABLE #xcolumn

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#result', 'stt', 'INT')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @Group = '1' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GroupByParentJob '#result', 'sysColumn, sysColumnEx', 'tien, tien_nt'
		UPDATE #result SET systotal = CASE WHEN bac_vv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #order(stt INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL, keyorder VARCHAR(33))
		--INSERT INTO #order(keyorder) SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ma_vv) FROM #result
		INSERT INTO #order(keyorder) SELECT RTRIM(ma_vv) FROM #result GROUP BY ma_vv ORDER BY ma_vv
		UPDATE #result SET stt = b.stt, sysorderrow = REPLACE(STR(b.stt, 10), ' ', '0') FROM #result a LEFT JOIN #order b ON a.ma_vv = b.keyorder
	END

	SELECT sysColumn, MAX(sysColumnName) AS sysColumnName, MAX(sysColumnNameEx) AS sysColumnNameEx INTO #tName FROM #result GROUP BY sysColumn

	IF @Type = '1' BEGIN
		DELETE #result WHERE ma_vv_me <> ''
		UPDATE #result SET rowformat = 0, systotal = 1
	END

	UPDATE #result SET sysColumnName = b.sysColumnName, sysColumnNameEx = b.sysColumnNameEx FROM #result a LEFT JOIN #tName b ON a.sysColumn = b.sysColumn

	SELECT a.sysorder, a.sysprint, a.systotal, a.sysorderrow AS sysRow, a.sysColumn, RTRIM(SPACE(ISNULL(a.bac_vv, 0) * 3) + a.ma_vv) AS ma_vv
			, CASE WHEN a.stt <> 0 THEN a.stt ELSE NULL END AS stt
			, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt
			, SPACE(a.bac_vv * 3) + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vv ELSE b.ten_vv2 END AS sysRowName, ISNULL(a.sysColumnName, '') AS sysColumnName, a.bac_vv, a.sysColumnEx, ISNULL(a.sysColumnNameEx, '') AS sysColumnNameEx
		INTO #report
		FROM #result a LEFT JOIN dmvv b ON a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
		ORDER BY a.sysColumn, a.sysorderrow

	-- Dong tong cong
	DECLARE @maxOrder VARCHAR(1023), @minOrder VARCHAR(1023)
	SELECT @maxOrder = MAX(sysRow) + 'Z', @minOrder = SPACE(1) + MIN(sysRow) FROM #report
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 99, 1, 0, @maxOrder, sysColumn, '', NULL, ma_so, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), @sTotal, MAX(sysColumnName), 0, MAX(sysColumnEx), MAX(sysColumnNameEx) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY sysColumn, ma_so
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 1, 0, 0, @minOrder, sysColumn, CHAR(9), NULL, ma_so, SUM(tien), SUM(tien_nt), @sTotal, MAX(sysColumnName), 0, MAX(sysColumnEx), MAX(sysColumnNameEx) FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY sysColumn, ma_so
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT 2, 0, 0, @minOrder, sysColumn, CHAR(10), NULL, ma_so, 0, 0, '', '', 0, MIN(sysColumnEx), '' FROM #report WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY sysColumn, ma_so

	-- Xu ly cot chua co du lieu
	SELECT TOP 1 sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysRow, sysColumn, ma_vv, stt, ma_so, 0 AS tien, 0 AS tien_nt, sysRowName, sysColumnName, bac_vv, sysColumnEx, sysColumnNameEx INTO #tTop1 FROM #report ORDER BY sysRow, sysColumn
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysRow, ' 1' + STR(b.stt, 6) + b.ma_so, ma_vv, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, sysRowName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, bac_vv, '1', RTRIM(@s1) FROM #tTop1 a, #v20covvct1 b
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysRow, ' 2' + STR(b.stt, 6) + b.ma_so, ma_vv, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, sysRowName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, bac_vv, '2', RTRIM(@s2) FROM #tTop1 a, #v20covvct1 b
	INSERT INTO #report SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, sysRow, ' 3' + STR(b.stt, 6) + b.ma_so, ma_vv, a.stt, a.ma_so, a.tien, a.tien_nt, sysRowName, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten ELSE ten2 END, bac_vv, '3', RTRIM(@s3) FROM #tTop1 a, #v20covvct1 b

	-- Xu ly khong co du lieu nao
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, stt, tien, tien_nt, sysRowName, sysColumnName, sysColumnNameEx, sysColumnEx, sysRow, sysColumn, bac_vv)
			SELECT 5, 1, 1, '', NULL, 0, 0, '', header, sysColumnNameEx, 0, '', id, 0
				FROM #xpivot

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, stt, tien, tien_nt, sysRow, sysRowName, sysColumn, sysColumnName, sysColumnEx, sysColumnNameEx
		FROM #report ORDER BY sysRow, sysColumn
	SELECT * FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	DROP TABLE #xpivot
	DROP TABLE #pivot

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_FaInsertAllocCoeffFromPrePeriod]
	@nPeriod INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nPrePeriod INT, @nPreYear INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @nPeriod = 1 SELECT @nPrePeriod = 12, @nPreYear = @nYear - 1
		ELSE SELECT @nPrePeriod = @nPeriod - 1, @nPreYear = @nYear

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('b.ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	IF @UnitKey IS NULL BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cthspbts WHERE ky = @nPeriod AND nam = @nYear) RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @r BIT
		SELECT @r = 0, @q = 'if exists(select 1 from cthspbts a join dmts b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and ' + @UnitKey + ') set @x = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x bit out', @x = @r OUTPUT
		IF @r = 1 RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into cthspbts (so_the_ts, ky, nam, he_so, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ma_nv, tk_ts, ty_le, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, dien_giai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select so_the_ts, ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod) + ', ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ', he_so, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_ts, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ma_nv, tk_ts, ty_le, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, dien_giai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cthspbts a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPrePeriod) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nPreYear)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists (select 1 from dmts b where a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts and ' + @UnitKey + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$Job]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(1023),
	@Job VARCHAR(1023),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Job, 2 Multi Job	
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'', 
	@Type TINYINT = 0 -- 0: Default, 1 - Multi-Accounts
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDate(@Date)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_vv, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdvv

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Type = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + ' a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(@Job, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCodeFilter('a.ma_vv', 'exactinlist', @Job)
		IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'inlist', @Account)
	END
	
	-- Balance (year)
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_vv, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from cdvv a with (nolock, index(nam)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(YEAR(@Date), 4)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.tk, a.ma_vv'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Arising
	IF @BalanceType = 1 SET @Date = @Date - 1

	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.tk, a.ma_vv, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (index(ma_vv)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.tk, a.ma_vv'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @Date, @UserID, @Admin

	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select tk, ma_vv, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by tk, ma_vv order by tk, ma_vv'
	END	
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostPOAuthorizeHeaders] -- fs_PostPOAuthorizeHeaders
	@UserID INT,
	@Action TINYINT,
	@typeVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1 Đơn hàng trong nước, 2 Đơn hàng nhập khẩu
	@IDNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = ''

	IF @Action = 1 BEGIN
		IF	@typeVoucher = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
			IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
				SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
				SET @MasterTable = 'm94$' + @Dyn
				SET @DetailTable = 'd94$' + @Dyn
				SET @InquiryTable = 'i94$' + @Dyn
				IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c94$000000 set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID				
				END
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
			IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
				SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
				SET @MasterTable = 'm95$' + @Dyn
				SET @DetailTable = 'd95$' + @Dyn
				SET @InquiryTable = 'i95$' + @Dyn
				IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''2'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c95$000000 set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''2'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$PO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID	
				END
			END	
		END
	END 
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF	@typeVoucher = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
			IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
				SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
				SET @MasterTable = 'm94$' + @Dyn
				SET @DetailTable = 'd94$' + @Dyn
				SET @InquiryTable = 'i94$' + @Dyn
				IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c94$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
				END			
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
			IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
				SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
				SET @MasterTable = 'm95$' + @Dyn
				SET @DetailTable = 'd95$' + @Dyn
				SET @InquiryTable = 'i95$' + @Dyn
				IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
					SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c95$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
					SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
				END				
			END	
		END
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	DELETE FROM dmxn where stt_rec = @IDNumber

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END
