CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateAllocPeriod] 
	@Period INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@UserID INT,	
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Delete Alloc
	EXEC rs_DeleteAllocPeriod @Period, @Year, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New'
	
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(6), @TableName VARCHAR(10)

	DECLARE @Stt NUMERIC(18), @Stt_rec VARCHAR(13), @Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(33), @Ma_bt VARCHAR(33), @Ten_bt NVARCHAR(511)
	DECLARE @Tk_no VARCHAR(33), @Tk_co VARCHAR(33), @So_ct CHAR(33), @Ma_nt VARCHAR(33)		
	DECLARE @Ma_kh VARCHAR(33), @Ma_bp VARCHAR(33), @Ma_vv VARCHAR(33), @Ma_hd VARCHAR(33), @Ma_ku VARCHAR(33), @Ma_phi VARCHAR(33), @So_lsx VARCHAR(33), @Ma_sp VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @PeriodTmp INT, @YearTmp INT
	DECLARE @Ws_id CHAR(1)
	
	DECLARE @Ma_ct CHAR(3), @Nh_dk VARCHAR(33), @Line_nbr INT, @m_round_tg INT
	DECLARE @tien_pb_ky NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_pb NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @ky_kt INT
	DECLARE @tien_pb_ky_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_pb_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_cl_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba, dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status
		INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bt, a.ten_bt, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, b.so_ct
			, a.ma_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.tien_pb, a.tien_pb_nt, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt, a.tien_pb_ky, a.tien_pb_ky_nt
			, a.ma_kh, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, a.ngay_kt
		INTO #tmp FROM dmpbky a, dmpbky1 b

	--
	SET @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	SET @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@Period, @Year)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		SET @Partition = STR(YEAR(@dTo), 4) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dTo), 2), ' ', '0')
		SET @TableName = 'r00$' + @Partition
	END ELSE RETURN

	-- UnitKey
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('a.ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin, 'New')

	-- Set default value
	SELECT @Ma_ct = 'PK9', @Nh_dk = '001', @Line_nbr = 1
	SELECT @Ws_id = RTRIM(Val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(Name) = 'M_WS_ID'
	SELECT @m_round_tg = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tg'
	
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.stt, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bt, a.ten_bt, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, b.so_ct'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.tien_pb, a.tien_pb_nt, a.tien_cl, a.tien_cl_nt, a.tien_pb_ky, a.tien_pb_ky_nt'
	SELECT @q = @q + ', a.ma_kh, a.ma_bp, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.so_lsx, a.ma_sp, dateadd(month, a.so_ky_pb - 1, convert(char(6), a.ngay_bd, 112) + ''01'')'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from dmpbky1 b with(nolock) left join dmpbky a with(nolock) on a.ma_bt = b.ma_bt and a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ky = ' + RTRIM(@Period) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@Year)
	SELECT @q = @q + ' and tien_cl + tien_cl_nt > 0 and tag <> 0 ' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	-- Create Alloc
	DECLARE @idMax NUMERIC(18, 0)
	SELECT @Stt = ISNULL(MIN(stt), 0), @idMax = ISNULL(MAX(stt), -1) FROM #tmp
	WHILE (@Stt <= @idMax) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @Ma_dvcs = ma_dvcs, @Ma_bt = ma_bt, @ten_bt = ten_bt, @tk_no = tk_no, @tk_co = tk_co, @so_ct = so_ct, @ma_nt =REPLACE(ma_nt, '''', ''), 
			@tien = tien, @tien_nt = tien_nt, @tien_pb = tien_pb, @tien_pb_nt = tien_pb_nt, @tien_cl = tien_cl, @tien_cl_nt = tien_cl_nt, @tien_pb_ky = tien_pb_ky, @tien_pb_ky_nt = tien_pb_ky_nt, 
			@Ma_kh = ma_kh, @Ma_bp = ma_bp, @Ma_vv = ma_vv, @Ma_hd = ma_hd, @Ma_ku = ma_ku, @Ma_phi = ma_phi, @So_lsx = so_lsx, @Ma_sp = ma_sp, @ky_kt = MONTH(ngay_kt) + YEAR(ngay_kt) * 12
			FROM #tmp WHERE stt = @Stt
		--
		SELECT @Stt_rec = @Ws_id + @Partition + REPLACE(STR(@Stt + 1, 3), ' ', '0') + @Ma_ct
		UPDATE dmpbky1 SET stt_rec = @Stt_rec WHERE nam = @Year AND ky = @Period AND stt = @Stt

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctpbky WHERE ma_bt = @Ma_bt AND nam*12 + ky < @Year*12 + @Period) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @PeriodTmp = ky, @YearTmp = nam FROM ctpbky 
				WHERE ma_bt = @Ma_bt AND nam * 12 + ky < @Year * 12 + @Period ORDER BY nam DESC, ky DESC
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctpbky WHERE ma_bt = @Ma_bt AND nam = @YearTmp AND ky = @PeriodTmp) BEGIN
				SELECT @tien_pb = tien_pb, @tien_pb_nt = tien_pb_nt, @tien_cl = tien_cl, @tien_cl_nt = tien_cl_nt 
					FROM ctpbky WHERE ma_bt = @Ma_bt AND nam = @YearTmp AND ky = @PeriodTmp
			END										
		END

		IF @tien_cl_nt + @tien_cl > 0 BEGIN
			IF @tien_pb_ky_nt > @tien_cl_nt OR (@Year * 12 + @Period) = @ky_kt SELECT @tien_pb_ky_nt = @tien_cl_nt
			IF @tien_pb_ky > @tien_cl OR (@Year * 12 + @Period) = @ky_kt SELECT @tien_pb_ky = @tien_cl		
			SELECT @tien_pb_nt = @tien_pb_nt + @tien_pb_ky_nt, @tien_pb = @tien_pb + @tien_pb_ky					
			SELECT @tien_cl = @tien - @tien_pb
			SELECT @tien_cl_nt = @tien_nt - @tien_pb_nt		

			INSERT INTO ctpbky (ma_dvcs, ky, nam, ma_bt, tk_no, tk_co, ma_nt
					, tien, tien_nt, tien_pb, tien_pb_nt, tien_cl, tien_cl_nt, tien_pb_ky, tien_pb_ky_nt
					, ma_kh, ma_bp, ma_vv, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_sp
					, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2)
				VALUES (@Ma_dvcs, @Period, @Year, @Ma_bt, @tk_no, @tk_co, @ma_nt
						, @tien, @tien_nt, @tien_pb, @tien_pb_nt, @tien_cl, @tien_cl_nt, @tien_pb_ky, @tien_pb_ky_nt
						, @Ma_kh, @Ma_bp, @Ma_vv, @Ma_hd, @Ma_ku, @Ma_phi, @So_lsx, @Ma_sp
						, @UserID, GETDATE(), @UserID, GETDATE())	

			-- ct00
			INSERT INTO #ct00 (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, So_lo, Ngay_lo, Ong_ba
					, Dien_giai_h, Dien_giai, Nh_dk, Line_nbr, Tk, Tk_du
					, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co
					, Ma_kh, Ma_vv, Ma_sp, Ma_bp, Ma_hd, Ma_ku, Ma_phi, So_lsx
					, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				VALUES (@Stt_rec, @Ma_dvcs, @Ma_ct, @dTo, @dTo, @So_ct, '', NULL, ''
						, RTRIM(@Ten_bt), RTRIM(@Ten_bt), @Nh_dk, @Line_nbr, @tk_no, @tk_co
						, @tien_pb_ky_nt, 0, @Ma_nt, 0, @tien_pb_ky, 0
						, @Ma_kh, @Ma_vv, @Ma_sp, @Ma_bp, @Ma_hd, @Ma_ku, @Ma_phi, @So_lsx
						, '', '', '', @UserID, GETDATE(), @UserID, GETDATE(), '1')
			INSERT INTO #ct00 (Stt_rec, Ma_dvcs, Ma_ct, Ngay_ct, Ngay_lct, So_ct, So_lo, Ngay_lo, Ong_ba
					, Dien_giai_h, Dien_giai, Nh_dk, Line_nbr, Tk, Tk_du
					, Ps_no_nt, Ps_co_nt, Ma_nt, Ty_gia, Ps_no, Ps_co
					, Ma_kh, Ma_vv, Ma_sp, Ma_bp, Ma_hd, Ma_ku, Ma_phi, So_lsx
					, Ma_td1, Ma_td2, Ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
				VALUES (@Stt_rec, @Ma_dvcs, @Ma_ct, @dTo, @dTo, @So_ct, '', NULL, ''
						, RTRIM(@Ten_bt), RTRIM(@Ten_bt), @Nh_dk, @Line_nbr + 1, @tk_co, @tk_no
						, 0, @tien_pb_ky_nt, @Ma_nt, 0, 0, @tien_pb_ky
						, @Ma_kh, @Ma_vv, @Ma_sp, @Ma_bp, @Ma_hd, @Ma_ku, @Ma_phi, @So_lsx
						, '', '', '', @UserID, GETDATE(), @UserID, GETDATE(), '1')											
		END
		--
		SELECT @Stt = MIN(stt) FROM #tmp WHERE stt > @Stt
	END

	UPDATE #ct00 SET ty_gia = CASE WHEN ABS(Ps_no_nt - Ps_co_nt) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ABS(Ps_no - Ps_co)/ABS(Ps_no_nt - Ps_co_nt), @m_round_tg) END
	INSERT INTO ct00 (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba, dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status)
		SELECT stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, so_ct, so_lo, ngay_lo, ong_ba, dien_giai_h, dien_giai, nh_dk, line_nbr, tk, tk_du, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, ps_no, ps_co, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, user_id0, datetime0, user_id2, datetime2, status FROM #ct00

	DECLARE @BC VARCHAR(33)
	SELECT @BC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_MA_NT0'
	UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0, ma_nt = '' WHERE ma_ct = @Ma_ct AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = RTRIM(@BC)

	-- Update r00
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		DECLARE GLCur CURSOR FOR
		SELECT DISTINCT stt_rec FROM #ct00
		OPEN GLCur
		FETCH NEXT FROM GLCur INTO @Stt_rec
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			EXEC fs20_AfterUpdateGL @Stt_rec, @TableName, '', @Ma_ct, @UserID
			--
			SELECT @q = 'insert into ' + @TableName + ' select * from ct00 where stt_rec = ''' + @Stt_rec + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM GLCur INTO @Stt_rec
		END
		CLOSE GLCur
		DEALLOCATE GLCur
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdtd2]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_td, d.ten_td2
		FROM cdtd2 a 
			JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmtd2 d ON a.ma_td = d .ma_td
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$WS] --fs_BeforeUpdatePS
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(64),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(64),
	@IDNumber CHAR(13), 
	@Action VARCHAR(4), 
	@UserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Partition VARCHAR(64), @refTable VARCHAR(64), @SARefTable VARCHAR(64), @OARefTable VARCHAR(64), @biTable VARCHAR(64), @biMode CHAR(1), @biPOYN BIT
	SELECT @SARefTable = '06$', @OARefTable = '10$', @biTable = 'bi', @biMode = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode'

	SELECT TOP 0 tt_yn, datetime2 INTO #updatePO FROM m68$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_dh AS stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0dh AS stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_dh, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_oa, CAST('''' AS varchar(6)) AS dyn_sa, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS dyn_hd, CAST('''' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS refTable INTO #beforeUpdate FROM d68$000000

	SET @s = 'INSERT INTO #updatePO SELECT tt_yn, datetime2 FROM ' + @masterTable + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	SET @s = 'insert into #beforeUpdate select stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh'
	SET @s = @s + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ', stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa' ELSE ', '''', '''', '''', ''''' END
	SET @s = @s + ', '''', '''', so_luong, he_so, '''', '''', '''', '''', case when right(stt_rec_dh, 3) = ''PO1'' then ''94$'' else ''95$'' end'
	SET @s = @s + ' from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and (stt_rec_dh <> ''''' + CASE WHEN @biMode = '1' THEN ' or stt_rec_sa <> '''' or stt_rec_ttmh <> ''''' ELSE '' END + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate) RETURN

	IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS po_ht_yn, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS datetime2 INTO #infoDelivery FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '' OR stt_rec_sa <> ''
		SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, datetime2 INTO #h$Delivery FROM #infoDelivery

		SELECT @s = '
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh, max(h.datetime2) from bih94$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_dh = h.stt_rec_dh and d.stt_rec0dh = h.stt_rec0dh and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh, max(h.datetime2) from bih95$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_dh = h.stt_rec_dh and d.stt_rec0dh = h.stt_rec0dh and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_dh, h.stt_rec0dh
insert into #h$Delivery (stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, datetime2) select h.stt_rec_hd, h.stt_rec0hd, max(h.datetime2) from bih06$000000 h where h.stt_rec <> ''' + @IDNumber + ''' and exists(select 1 from #updatePO c where c.datetime2 > h.datetime2) and exists(select 1 from #beforeUpdate d where d.stt_rec_sa = h.stt_rec_hd and d.stt_rec0sa = h.stt_rec0hd and (h.ma_ct = ''PD1'' or (h.ma_ct in (''PXC'', ''PXR'') and h.tt_yn = 1))) group by h.stt_rec_hd, h.stt_rec0hd
insert into #infoDelivery select a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh join bih94$000000 c on a.stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
insert into #infoDelivery select a.stt_rec_dh, a.stt_rec0dh, '''', '''', isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0dh join bih95$000000 c on a.stt_rec_dh = c.stt_rec_dh and a.stt_rec0dh = c.stt_rec0dh and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
insert into #infoDelivery select '''', '''', a.stt_rec_sa, a.stt_rec0sa, isnull(c.po_ht_yn, 0), b.datetime2 from #beforeUpdate a join #h$Delivery b on a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec_sa and a.stt_rec0sa = b.stt_rec0sa join bih06$000000 c on a.stt_rec_sa = c.stt_rec_hd and a.stt_rec0sa = c.stt_rec0hd and b.datetime2 = c.datetime2 where c.ma_ct in (''PD1'', ''PXC'', ''PXR'')
'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_dh <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_dh = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT dyn_dh, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE dyn_dh <> ''
	OPEN c
	FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = 'update #beforeUpdate set stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd = b.stt_rec0hd from #beforeUpdate a join d' + @refTable + @Partition + ' b on a.stt_rec_dh = b.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0dh = b.stt_rec0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Partition, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE c
	DEALLOCATE c

	SET @s = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''94$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c94$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''94$'''
	SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_hd <> '''' AND refTable = ''95$'') UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_hd = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN c95$000000 b ON a.stt_rec_hd = b.stt_rec WHERE a.refTable = ''95$'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_sa <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_sa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_sa = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #beforeUpdate WHERE stt_rec_ttmh <> '') BEGIN
		SET @s = 'UPDATE #beforeUpdate SET dyn_oa = RTRIM(YEAR(ngay_ct)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') FROM #beforeUpdate a JOIN ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 b ON a.stt_rec_ttmh = b.stt_rec'
		EXEC sp_executesql @s
	END

	-- Update PO Qty
	DECLARE @cPCIDNumber CHAR(13), @cPOIDNumber CHAR(13), @cOAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cSAIDNumber CHAR(13), @cLinePCIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLinePOIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineOAIDNumber CHAR(3), @cLineSAIDNumber CHAR(3), @nQty NUMERIC(28, 6), @nRate NUMERIC(24, 12), @dyn_dh VARCHAR(64), @dyn_oa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_sa VARCHAR(64), @dyn_hd VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec0ttmh, stt_rec_sa, stt_rec0sa, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, so_luong, he_so, dyn_dh, dyn_oa, dyn_sa, dyn_hd, refTable FROM #beforeUpdate
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cPOIDNumber AND stt_rec0dh = @cLinePOIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePOIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhan = sl_nhan + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_dh = @cPCIDNumber AND stt_rec0dh = @cLinePCIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLinePCIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			IF ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @biPOYN = po_ht_yn FROM #infoDelivery WHERE stt_rec_sa = @cSAIDNumber AND stt_rec0sa = @cLineSAIDNumber
				SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', po_ht_yn = ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@biPOYN, '0'))
			END
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineSAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET sl_tl = sl_tl - CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_nhap = sl_nhap + CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + ', sl_tl0 = sl_tl0 - CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #updatePO WHERE tt_yn = 1) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@nQty*(@nRate/he_so), 3) END END'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''' AND stt_rec0 = ''' + REPLACE(@cLineOAIDNumber, '''', '') + ''''
		END
		SET @s = REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '@nQty', RTRIM(@nQty)), '@nRate', RTRIM(@nRate))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cLinePOIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cLineOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @cLineSAIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cLinePCIDNumber, @nQty, @nRate, @dyn_dh, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @dyn_hd, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	-- Update status
	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_sa, MAX(dyn_dh) AS dyn_dh, MAX(dyn_hd) AS dyn_hd, MAX(dyn_oa) AS dyn_oa, MAX(dyn_sa) AS dyn_sa, MAX(refTable) AS refTable FROM #beforeUpdate GROUP BY stt_rec_dh, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec_ttmh, stt_rec_sa
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @refTable
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		SET @s = ''

		IF @dyn_dh <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @POStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @POStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @POStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_dh + ' SET status = @POStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPOIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cPCIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_hd <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhan > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhan < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM i' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE c94$000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE m' + @refTable + @dyn_hd + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cPCIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cSAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_sa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND (sl_nhap < so_luong' + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@biMode, '0') = '1' THEN ' AND po_ht_yn = 0' ELSE '' END + '))'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''3'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @PCStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @PCStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @SARefTable + '000000 SET status = @PCStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @SARefTable + @dyn_sa + ' SET status = @PCStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cSAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		IF @cOAIDNumber <> '' AND @dyn_oa <> '' BEGIN
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status <> ''6'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap < so_luong)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''5'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'ELSE'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''4'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''5'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ' + @biTable + 'd' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND sl_nhap > 0)'
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = ''3'' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''' AND status = ''4'''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'DECLARE @OAStatus CHAR(1) SELECT @OAStatus = status FROM ' + @biTable + 'i' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'c' + @OARefTable + '000000 SET status = @OAStatus WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
			SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @biTable + 'm' + @OARefTable + @dyn_oa + ' SET status = @OAStatus, user_id2 = @UserID, datetime2 = GETDATE() WHERE stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@cOAIDNumber, '''', '')  + ''''
		END

		SET @s = REPLACE(@s, '@UserID', RTRIM(@UserID))
		EXEC sp_executesql @s

		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @cPOIDNumber, @cPCIDNumber, @cOAIDNumber, @cSAIDNumber, @dyn_dh, @dyn_hd, @dyn_oa, @dyn_sa, @refTable
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFAList] --fs_FAList--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@FAType VARCHAR(33),
	@FADepartment VARCHAR(33),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(33),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Groups VARCHAR(254),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Order VARCHAR(1023),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @FC VARCHAR(33)
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @FC = val FROM Options WHERE UPPER(RTRIM(name)) = 'M_MA_NT0'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt,
			a.so_the_ts, a.ten_ts AS ten_ts, a.ten_ts2 AS ten_ts2, a.so_hieu_ts AS so_hieu_ts,
			a.so_ct AS so_ct, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_ct, a.tk_ts AS tk_ts, a.tk_kh AS tk_kh, a.tk_cp AS tk_cp, a.ma_bp AS ma_bp, a.ma_phi AS ma_phi,
			b.nguyen_gia AS nguyen_gia, b.nguyen_gia_nt AS nguyen_gia_nt,
			b.gt_da_kh AS gt_da_kh, b.gt_da_kh_nt AS gt_da_kh_nt,
			b.gt_cl AS gt_cl, b.gt_cl_nt AS gt_cl_nt,
			gt_kh_ky AS gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt AS gt_kh_ky_nt,
			a.ngay_mua AS ngay_mua, a.ngay_kh0 AS ngay_kh0, a.ngay_giam AS ngay_giam, a.so_ky_kh AS so_ky_kh,
			nh_ts1 AS nh_ts1, nh_ts2 AS nh_ts2, nh_ts3 AS nh_ts3, loai_ts AS loai_ts,
			ma_nt AS ma_nt, ty_gia AS ty_gia
		INTO #report
		FROM dmts a LEFT JOIN ctdmts b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts
		ORDER BY 1

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SET @Key = 'a.ngay_mua between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @FAType <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_ts like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FAType), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @FADepartment <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@FADepartment), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_ts3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report'
	SET @q = @q + ' select 5, 1, 1, 0,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' a.so_the_ts, max(a.ten_ts) as ten_ts, max(a.ten_ts2) as ten_ts2, max(a.so_hieu_ts) as so_hieu_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' max(a.so_ct), max(a.ngay_ct), max(a.tk_ts), max(a.tk_kh), max(a.tk_cp), max(a.ma_bp), max(a.ma_phi),'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' sum(gt_kh_ky) as gt_kh_ky, sum(gt_kh_ky_nt) as gt_kh_ky_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' max(a.ngay_mua) as ngay_mua, max(a.ngay_kh0) as ngay_kh0, max(a.ngay_giam) as ngay_giam, max(a.so_ky_kh) as so_ky_kh,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' max(nh_ts1) as nh_ts1, max(nh_ts2) as nh_ts2, max(nh_ts3) as nh_ts3, max(loai_ts) as loai_ts,'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' max(ma_nt) as ma_nt, max(ty_gia) as ty_gia'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' from dmts a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' join ctdmts b with(nolock) on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts'
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' where ' + @Key + ' group by a.so_the_ts'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia = b.nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt = b.nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh = b.gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt = b.gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl = b.gt_cl, gt_cl_nt = b.gt_cl_nt
		FROM #report a LEFT JOIN (
					            SELECT so_the_ts, SUM(nguyen_gia) AS nguyen_gia, SUM(nguyen_gia_nt) AS nguyen_gia_nt, SUM(gt_da_kh) AS gt_da_kh, SUM(gt_da_kh_nt) AS gt_da_kh_nt, SUM(gt_cl) AS gt_cl, SUM(gt_cl_nt) AS gt_cl_nt
				                         FROM ctdmts WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE so_the_ts IN (SELECT so_the_ts FROM #report)
						         GROUP BY so_the_ts
					         ) b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, so_the_ts, so_ky_kh', 'numeric(5), #, numeric(16)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #report SET nguyen_gia_nt = 0, gt_da_kh_nt = 0, gt_cl_nt = 0, gt_kh_ky_nt = 0 WHERE RTRIM(ma_nt) = @FC OR ISNULL(ma_nt, '') = ''

	DECLARE @f NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @f = 'sysorder, systotal, sysprint, stt, so_the_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_ts' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'ten_ts2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_ts2'
	SET @f = @f + ', so_ct, ngay_ct, tk_ts, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp, ma_phi, so_hieu_ts, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, ngay_mua, ngay_kh0, ngay_giam, so_ky_kh'

	DECLARE @g VARCHAR(1024), @o VARCHAR(1024)
	SELECT @g = CASE WHEN @Groups <> '' THEN @Groups ELSE 'loai_ts' END, @o = dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, @Order)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField @g, @o, '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @Groups <> '' SET @q = dbo.ff_GetInsertGroup2(@Groups, 'so_the_ts, so_the_ts, so_the_ts', 'ten_ts, ten_ts, ten_ts', 'ma_nh, ma_nh, ma_nh', 'ten_nh, ten_nh, ten_nh', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh', '#report', 'dmnhts, dmnhts, dmnhts', '1,1,1')
	ELSE SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertGroup('loai_ts', 'ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET @q = dbo.ff20_GetInsertTotal('ts', 'nguyen_gia, nguyen_gia_nt, gt_da_kh, gt_da_kh_nt, gt_cl, gt_cl_nt, gt_kh_ky, gt_kh_ky_nt, so_ky_kh', '#report')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report WHERE sysprint = 1) BEGIN DELETE #report; INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (1, 1, 0) END
	SET @q = 'select ' + @f + ' from #report order by ' + dbo.ff_GetOrderString(@g, 'sysorder,' + @Order) + ', stt'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostDCClosed]
	@userID INT, 
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @status CHAR(1)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct, @status = status FROM c52$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @status = '*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID

	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm52$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd52$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i52$' + @Dyn
	SET @HisTable = 'a52$000000'

	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status <> ''4'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag = status, status = ''4'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''4'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c52$000000 set status = ''4'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''4'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1'
		
	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN		
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInputInvoiceExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@VoucherID VARCHAR(4000),
	@BaseTable VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @VoucherID = REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '')

	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @o CHAR(1)

	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'b.stt_rec = ''' + @VoucherID + ''''
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 line_nbr, thue_suat AS tsuat, t_tien AS ttien, t_thue AS tthue INTO #multi FROM e15$000000

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ten_cn, a.mst_cn, a.dia_chi_cn AS dia_chi, a.dien_thoai_cn AS dien_thoai, a.tk_nh_cn AS tk_nh, a.ten_nh_cn AS ten_nh, a.nguoi_mua, a.ten_kh, a.mst_kh, a.dia_chi_kh, a.tk_nh_kh, a.ten_nh_kh, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.thue_suat, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_thue, a.t_ck, a.t_thanh_toan AS t_phi, a.t_thanh_toan
		, a.t_tt_in_words, a.mau_so, a.so_ct AS so_hd, a.ky_hieu, a.ngay_ct AS ngay_hd, a.ngay_ky_cn AS ngay_ph, a.ghi_chu, a.ty_gia, a.loai_dc, a.ma_cqt, a.so_bk, a.ngay_bk
		, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS common_name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS secret_code, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS img_cancel_path, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS img_blank_path, a.cks_cqt, a.ngay_ky_cqt, a.cks_cn, a.ngay_ky_cn, a.qrcode_img, a.keys AS lookup_key, a.urls AS lookup_link
		, b.stt_rec, b.line_nbr, b.ma_vt, b.km_yn, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, b.ck, b.ma_thue, b.thue_suat AS thue_suat_d, b.ten_vt, b.xu_ly, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(512)) AS ten_tc, m.tsuat, a.t_tien AS ttien, a.t_thue AS tthue
			INTO #report FROM m15$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) z ON 1 = 0, d15$000000 b RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) x ON 1 = 0 , #multi m RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) y ON 1 = 0

	-- Data
	SELECT @q = '
declare @ttphi nvarchar(4000), @t_phi numeric(28, 6)
insert into #multi select line_nbr, thue_suat, t_tien, t_thue from e' + @BaseTable + '$%Partition b where  %[' + @key + ']%
select @t_phi = 0
if @ttphi <> '''' begin
	select id, convert(numeric(28, 6), data) as data into #ttphi from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@ttphi, ''$'')
	select @t_phi = sum(data) from #ttphi
	drop table #ttphi
end

insert into #report select a.ten_cn, a.mst_cn, a.dia_chi_cn, a.dien_thoai_cn, a.tk_nh_cn, a.ten_nh_cn, a.nguoi_mua, a.ten_kh, a.mst_kh, a.dia_chi_kh, a.tk_nh_kh, a.ten_nh_kh, a.hinh_thuc_tt, a.thue_suat, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien, a.t_thue, a.t_ck, @t_phi, a.t_thanh_toan
	, a.t_tt_in_words, a.mau_so, a.so_ct, a.ky_hieu, a.ngay_ct, a.ngay_ky_cn, a.ghi_chu, a.ty_gia, a.loai_dc, a.ma_cqt, a.so_bk, a.ngay_bk
    , a.cks_cn as common_name, a.keys as secret_code, '''' as img_cancel_path, '''' as img_blank_path, a.cks_cqt, a.ngay_ky_cqt, a.cks_cn, a.ngay_ky_cn, a.qrcode_img, isnull(a.keys, ''''), isnull(a.urls, '''')
    , b.stt_rec, b.line_nbr, b.ma_vt, b.km_yn, b.dvt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, b.ck, b.ma_thue, b.thue_suat, b.ten_vt, b.xu_ly, t.ten_tc, '''', null, null
	from m' + @BaseTable + '$%Partition a with(nolock)
		right join d' + @BaseTable + '$%Partition b with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec --and b.line_nbr = 1
		join dmcttc t on b.tinh_chat = t.ma_tc
		where %[' + @key + ']%'
	
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @DateFrom, @DateTo, 1, 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_short_key' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @o = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_short_len' AND val = '1') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

		UPDATE #report SET secret_code = b.skey FROM #report a JOIN mapkey b ON a.secret_code = b.[key]
		UPDATE #report SET secret_code = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$FormatShortKeyExport(secret_code, @o)
	END
	
	UPDATE #report SET ty_gia = b.ty_gia, ma_nt = b.ma_nt FROM #report a JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, ty_gia, ma_nt FROM #report b WHERE line_nbr = '1') b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	
	-- View
	UPDATE #report SET tsuat = m.tsuat, ttien = CAST(m.ttien AS NUMERIC), tthue = CAST(m.tthue AS NUMERIC) FROM #multi m WHERE #report.line_nbr = m.line_nbr and m.tsuat <> ''
	
	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY stt_rec, line_nbr

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptFinancialRatioComparison] --fs_FinancialAnalysis4PeriodCompare
	@PeriodFrom INT,
	@YearFrom INT,
	@PeriodTo INT,
	@YearTo INT,
	@Kh_yn TINYINT,
	@Bq_yn TINYINT,
	@Cty_yn TINYINT,
	@ReportType TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023), 
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Sắp xếp lại thứ tự dvcs
	EXEC rs_rptFinancialAnalysisReOrderList @Unit, @Unit OUTPUT

	-- Bảng tạo mẫu
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST(0 AS INT) AS xgroup, * INTO #t1 FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #t2 FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form

	IF @reportType = 1
		INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT * FROM gltcpt01 WHERE form = @Form
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #t2 SELECT * FROM gltcpt01th WHERE form = @Form

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#t2', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Thực hiện
	INSERT INTO #t1 EXEC rs_rptFinancialRatioAnalysisTemplate @PeriodFrom, @YearFrom, @PeriodTo, @YearTo, 0, 1, @reportType, @Unit, @Form, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Lấy dữ liệu từ bảng lưu
	SELECT ma_so, cot, so, chu INTO #gltcpt99 FROM gltcpt99
		WHERE nam1 = @YearFrom AND ky1 = @PeriodFrom AND nam2 = @YearTo AND ky2 = @PeriodTo AND dang_bc = @reportType AND loai_ky = 1 AND so_ky = 1 AND form = @Form AND ma_dvcs = @Unit AND ma_bc = '04'

	-- Kế hoạch
	IF @Kh_yn = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #t2 SET gt = so FROM #t2 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '5'
		INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT 2, * FROM #t2
	END

	-- Bình quân
	IF @Bq_yn = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #t2 SET gt = 0
		UPDATE #t2 SET gt = so FROM #t2 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '7'
		INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT 3, * FROM #t2
	END
	
	-- Công ty khác
	IF @Cty_yn = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE #t2 SET gt = 0
		UPDATE #t2 SET gt = so FROM #t2 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '9'
		INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT 4, * FROM #t2
	END
	
	-- Đánh giá
	IF @Language = 'V' UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '1'
		ELSE UPDATE #t1 SET danh_gia = chu FROM #t1 a JOIN #gltcpt99 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so AND b.cot = '2'

	-- Tiêu đề cột
	DECLARE @sThuc_hien NVARCHAR(511), @sKe_hoach NVARCHAR(511), @sBinh_quan NVARCHAR(511), @sCong_ty NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @sThuc_hien = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT01'
	SELECT @sKe_hoach = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT02'
	SELECT @sBinh_quan = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT03'
	SELECT @sCong_ty = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN cname ELSE cname2 END FROM reports WHERE RTRIM(UPPER(ccode)) = 'GLTCPT04'
	
	-- View
	SELECT REPLACE(STR(xgroup, 2), ' ', '0') AS xPivot, stt, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN bold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
			, ma_so, gt, kind, bold, danh_gia
			, CASE xgroup WHEN 1 THEN @sThuc_hien WHEN 2 THEN @sKe_hoach WHEN 3 THEN @sBinh_quan ELSE @sCong_ty END AS xPivot_name
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE chi_tieu2 END AS chi_tieu
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dien_giai ELSE dien_giai2 END AS dien_giai
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN dvt ELSE dvt2 END AS dvt
		FROM #t1 ORDER BY xgroup, stt, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(128)) AS name, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS header, xgroup INTO #pivot FROM #t1 GROUP BY xgroup ORDER BY xgroup
	UPDATE #pivot SET name = 'gt$' + RTRIM(id), header = CASE xgroup WHEN 1 THEN @sThuc_hien WHEN 2 THEN @sKe_hoach WHEN 3 THEN @sBinh_quan ELSE @sCong_ty END
	SELECT id, name, header FROM #pivot ORDER BY id

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_BIUDMultiView]
	@inspectionDateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@inspectionDateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@inspectionFrom VARCHAR(1024),
	@inspectionTo VARCHAR(1024),
	@inspectionOrigin VARCHAR(32),
	@plant VARCHAR(32),
	@item VARCHAR(32),
	@characteristics CHAR(1), --0 - Không Kđ theo đặc tính, 1 - Có Kđ theo đặc tính, * - Tất cả
	@decision CHAR(1), -- 1 - Sử dụng từng phần, 0 - Không, * - Tất cả
	@status CHAR(1), -- 1 - Chưa tạo quyết định, 2 - Đã tạo quyết định, * - Tất cả
	@size TINYINT,
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @tableName VARCHAR(32), @baseCurrency VARCHAR(3)
	DECLARE @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @plantKey NVARCHAR(4000), @inspectionKey NVARCHAR(4000), @siteKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	--
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong AS sl_lo_kd, a.sl_qdsd, a.ma_vung, a.qd_tung_phan, a.[status] INTO #report FROM bikd00$000000 a, dmvt b, dmttct c

	--
	SET @key = 'a.status not in (''1'', ''5'')'
	IF @inspectionFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionFrom), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @inspectionTo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionTo), '''', ''''''), @size) + ''''
	IF @inspectionOrigin <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_nguon like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@inspectionOrigin), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @plant <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vung like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@plant), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @item <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @characteristics <> '*' SET @key = @key + ' and a.kd_dac_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@characteristics), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @decision <> '*' SET @key = @key + ' and a.qd_tung_phan = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@decision), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @status <> '*' SET @key = @key + ' and a.status = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@status), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', '', @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @siteKey output
	IF @siteKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + '(' + @siteKey + ')'

	EXEC FastBusiness$BI$PurchasingRightFilter 'a.ma_vung', @plant, @unitKey, @userID, @admin, @plantKey output, '1'
	IF @plantKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + '(' + @plantKey + ')'

	SELECT @inspectionKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionFilter('a.ma_nguon', '', @userID, @admin)
	IF @inspectionKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @key = @key + ' and ' + @inspectionKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong0, a.sl_qdsd, a.ma_vung, a.qd_tung_phan, a.[status] from bikd00$%Partition a where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'ngay_ct', @inspectionDateFrom, @inspectionDateTo, @userID, @admin

	-- View
	SELECT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS tag, a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_vt, a.sl_lo_kd, a.sl_qdsd, a.ma_vung, a.qd_tung_phan, a.[status]
			, CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt
			, CASE @language WHEN 'V' THEN c.statusname ELSE c.statusname2 END AS statusname
		FROM #report a
			LEFT JOIN dmvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			JOIN dmttct c WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct AND a.[status] = c.[status]
		ORDER BY a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintPSTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@VAT TINYINT = 0,
	@stock TINYINT = 0,
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SET @strSQL =  'SELECT a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.ma_kho, ' + CASE WHEN @stock <> 1 THEN 'a.tk_vt' ELSE 'cast('''' as varchar(33)) as tk_vt' END + ', a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien'
	IF @VAT = 1 SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ', 0 as km_yn, a.gia as gia2, a.tien as tien2, a.gia_nt as gia_nt2, a.tien_nt as tien_nt2'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + '  AS ten_vt' ELSE ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN 'cast('''' as nvarchar(1))' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' AS detail'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' INTO #report'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' FROM ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN'
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' dmvt g WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + ' WHERE ' + @cDetailKey
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + ' ORDER BY a.line_nbr'

	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'EXEC rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' ELSE ',ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	SET @strSQL = @strSQL + CHAR(13) + 'SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY  line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
END

GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vdmduyet]
AS
	SELECT a.*, b.ten_quyen, b.ten_quyen2, c.name, c.comment, c.comment2, d.ten_bp, d.ten_bp2
		FROM dbo.dmduyet a
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmquyen b ON a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen AND a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet
			LEFT JOIN dbo.vsysuserinfo c ON a.user_id = c.id
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmbp d ON a.ma_bp = d.ma_bp

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptIncomeStatementDepartment] --fs20_IncomeStatementPart1
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousBegin AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousEnd AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mau nam, 2 - Mau giua nien do
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1
	
	-- Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc2 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Department <> '' THEN ' and ma_bp = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '''' ELSE '' END
 	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
 	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s = @s + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + @Key  + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'

	IF @Department <> '' BEGIN 
		-- Nam nay
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		-- Nam truoc
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd, @UserID, @Admin

		IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
			-- Luy ke nam nay
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom0, @DateTo0, @UserID, @Admin

			-- Luy ke nam truoc
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0, @UserID, @Admin
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
		SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), @Type'
		SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
		SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du'

		-- Nam nay
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KN''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KN''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		-- Nam truoc
		SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''KT''')
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
		IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''KT''')
			SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		END

		IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
			-- Luy ke nam nay
			SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
			IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKN''')
				SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
			END

			-- Luy ke nam truoc
			SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
			SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
			EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
			IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', '''LKKT''')
				SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
				EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
			END
		END
	END

	DECLARE @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(48), @Tk_co CHAR(48), @Giam_tru TINYINT, @Tk_kqkd VARCHAR(33), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ky_truoc_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_nay_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Tk_no, Tk_co, Giam_tru FROM #report WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	SELECT @Tk_kqkd = (RTRIM(val) + '%') FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_TK_KQKD'
	
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(ps), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KT'
						) a

				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(ps), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
					FROM (
						SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND type = 'KN'
						UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
							WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND type = 'KN'
						) a

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(ps), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
							) a

					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(ps), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
						FROM (
							SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							UNION ALL
							SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00
								WHERE @Giam_tru = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND (Tk_du NOT LIKE @Tk_kqkd) AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
							) a
				END
			END

		IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_truoc_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KT'
				SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(Ps_no), @Ky_nay_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
					WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND type = 'KN'

				IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
					SELECT @Lk_kt = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT')
					SELECT @Lk_kn = SUM(Ps_no), @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(Ps_no_nt) FROM #ct00
						WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND Ps_no + Ps_no_nt <> 0 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN')
				END
			END

		UPDATE #report SET Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_nay = @Ky_nay , Lk_kt = @Lk_kt, Lk_kn = @Lk_kn, 
				Ky_truoc_nt = @Ky_truoc_nt, Ky_nay_nt = @Ky_nay_nt, Lk_kt_nt = @Lk_kt_nt , Lk_kn_nt = @Lk_kn_nt
			WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Giam_tru
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc = 0 WHERE ky_truoc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = 0 WHERE ky_nay IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_truoc_nt = 0 WHERE ky_truoc_nt IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET ky_nay_nt = 0 WHERE ky_nay_nt IS NULL

	IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn = 0 WHERE Lk_kn IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kt_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kt_nt IS NULL
		UPDATE #report SET Lk_kn_nt = 0 WHERE Lk_kn_nt IS NULL
	END

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_truoc_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_truoc_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			SET @strSql = 'update #report set Ky_nay_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Ky_nay_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

			IF @ReportType = '2' BEGIN
				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kt_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kt_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql

				SET @strSql = 'update #report set Lk_kn_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(select max(Lk_kn_nt) from #report where ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' where ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
				SET @strSql = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@strSql)
				EXEC sp_executesql @strSql
			END

			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	SELECT chi_tieu, chi_tieu2
			, ma_so, thuyet_minh, stt AS sysorder, ky_nay_nt, ky_truoc_nt, lk_kn_nt, lk_kt_nt, ky_nay, ky_truoc, lk_kn, lk_kt, bold
			, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal
		FROM #report ORDER BY Stt

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[fs20_FxInsertAllocCoeffFromPrePeriod]
	@nPeriod INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @nPrePeriod INT, @nPreYear INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF @nPeriod = 1 SELECT @nPrePeriod = 12, @nPreYear = @nYear - 1
		ELSE SELECT @nPrePeriod = @nPeriod - 1, @nPreYear = @nYear

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('b.ma_dvcs', '', @UserID, @Admin, 'New')
	IF @UnitKey IS NULL BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cthspbcc WHERE ky = @nPeriod AND nam = @nYear) RETURN
	END ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @r BIT
		SELECT @r = 0, @q = 'if exists(select 1 from cthspbcc a join dmcc b on a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts where a.ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod) + ' and a.nam = ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ' and ' + @UnitKey + ') set @x = 1'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@x bit out', @x = @r OUTPUT
		IF @r = 1 RETURN
	END

	SELECT @q = 'insert into cthspbcc (so_the_ts, ky, nam, he_so, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_cc, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ma_nv, tk_ts, ty_le, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, dien_giai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9)'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select so_the_ts, ' + RTRIM(@nPeriod) + ', ' + RTRIM(@nYear) + ', he_so, tk_kh, tk_cp, ma_bp_cc, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', ma_nv, tk_ts, ty_le, nguyen_gia, gt_da_kh, gt_tang, gt_giam, gt_cl, gt_kh_ky, dien_giai'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ', datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, sl_td1, sl_td2, sl_td3, ngay_td1, ngay_td2, ngay_td3, gc_td1, gc_td2, gc_td3, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from cthspbcc a'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'where ky = ' + RTRIM(@nPrePeriod) + ' and nam = ' + RTRIM(@nPreYear)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and exists (select 1 from dmcc b where a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts and ' + @UnitKey + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwctkhts2] AS
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.sua_kh, a.ma_nv, a.ky, a.nam, a.ma_bp, a.tk_ts, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.nguyen_gia, a.nguyen_gia_nt, a.gt_da_kh, a.gt_da_kh_nt, 
			a.gt_tang, a.gt_tang_nt, a.gt_giam, a.gt_giam_nt, a.gt_cl, a.gt_cl_nt, a.gt_kh_ky, a.gt_kh_ky_nt, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, b.ma_dvcs AS ma_dvcs, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
		FROM ctkhts AS a JOIN dmts AS b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwthhspbcc] AS
	SELECT a.so_the_ts, a.ky, a.nam, a.he_so, a.tk_kh, a.tk_cp, a.ma_bp_cc, a.ma_kh, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_vv, b.ma_dvcs, b.ten_ts, b.ten_ts2, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, ISNULL(c.ten_kh, '') AS ten_kh,  ISNULL(c.ten_kh2, '') AS ten_kh2
		FROM cthspbcc a JOIN dmcc b ON a.so_the_ts = b.so_the_ts LEFT JOIN dmkh c ON a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CreateAllocTrans]
	@nMF INT,
	@nMT INT,
	@nYear INT,
	@nUserID INT,
	@cUnit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Xoa cac but toan phan bo
	EXEC rs_DeleteAllocTrans @nMF, @nMT, @nYear, @nUserID, @Admin, @cUnit, 'New'

	DECLARE @Stt_rec NUMERIC(18), @Ten_bt NVARCHAR(511), @Tk VARCHAR(32), @Loai_pb TINYINT, @So_ct CHAR(32), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ma_nt VARCHAR(32), @Ty_gia NUMERIC(24, 12), @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE @Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @User_id2 INT, @dFrom SMALLDATETIME, @dTo SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @AccountList NVARCHAR(4000), @Group NVARCHAR(4000), @Field NVARCHAR(4000), @Stt INT
	DECLARE @managementObjectField1 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField2 VARCHAR(32), @managementObjectField3 VARCHAR(32)

	SET @dFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@nMF, @nYear)
	SET @dTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@nMT, @nYear)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' AND val = '1') SELECT @Ma_dvcs = @cUnit
		ELSE SELECT @Ma_dvcs = ''

	SELECT @managementObjectField1 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '04'
	SELECT @managementObjectField2 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '05'
	SELECT @managementObjectField3 = field FROM syspostfields WHERE id = '06'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1 AS ma_dtqt1, ma_td2 AS ma_dtqt2, ma_td3 AS ma_dtqt3, ma_nt, ps_no, ps_no_nt, ps_co, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00 FROM r00$000000

	SELECT a.stt_rec, a.ten_bt, a.tk, a.loai_pb, d.so_ct, d.tien_nt, d.ma_nt, d.ty_gia, d.tien, a.user_id2, a.stt, a.pb_kh_yn, a.pb_vv_yn, a.pb_sp_yn, a.pb_bp_yn, a.pb_hd_yn, a.pb_ku_yn, a.pb_phi_yn, a.pb_lsx_yn, a.pb_td1_yn, a.pb_td2_yn, a.pb_td3_yn
		INTO #tmp FROM dmpbn d JOIN dmpb a ON d.stt_rec = a.stt_rec WHERE d.nam = @nYear AND d.tag <> 0

	--
	SELECT @AccountList = '', @Stt = MIN(stt) FROM #tmp
	WHILE @Stt IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @Tk = LEFT(tk, 3) FROM #tmp WHERE stt = @Stt
		IF CHARINDEX(@Tk, @AccountList) <= 0 SELECT @AccountList = @AccountList + @Tk + ','
		SELECT @Stt = MIN(stt) FROM #tmp WHERE stt > @Stt
	END
	IF RTRIM(@AccountList) <> '' SELECT @AccountList = LEFT(@AccountList, LEN(@AccountList) - 1)
	IF @AccountList <> '' SELECT @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('tk', 'inlist', REPLACE(@AccountList, '''', ''''''))
	--

	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', @cUnit, @nUserID, @Admin, 'New')
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SELECT @Field = '', @Group = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_kh_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_kh,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_kh,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_vv_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_vv,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_vv,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_sp_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_sp,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_sp,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_bp_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_bp,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_bp,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_hd_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_hd,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_hd,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_ku_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_ku,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_ku,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_phi_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'ma_phi,', @Group = @Group + 'ma_phi,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_lsx_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + 'so_lsx,', @Group = @Group + 'so_lsx,' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_td1_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + @managementObjectField1 + ',', @Group = @Group + @managementObjectField1 + ',' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_td2_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + @managementObjectField2 + ',', @Group = @Group + @managementObjectField2 + ',' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tmp WHERE pb_td3_yn = 1) SELECT @Field = @Field + @managementObjectField3 + ',', @Group = @Group + @managementObjectField3 + ',' ELSE SELECT @Field = @Field + ''''','
	IF @Group <> '' SELECT @Group = LEFT(@Group, LEN(@Group) - 1)

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #ct00 select tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ' + @Field + ' ma_nt, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' group by tk, tk_du, ma_dvcs, ma_nt' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Group) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Group END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dFrom, @dTo, 1, 1


	DECLARE crTran CURSOR FOR SELECT stt_rec, ten_bt, tk, loai_pb, so_ct, tien_nt, ma_nt, ty_gia, tien, user_id2 FROM #tmp ORDER BY stt
	OPEN crTran
	FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @Stt_rec, @ten_bt, @tk, @loai_pb, @so_ct, @tien_nt, @ma_nt, @ty_gia, @tien, @user_id2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		-- Phan bo
		SELECT @so_ct = STR(@nYear, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@nMT, 2), ' ', '0')
		EXEC rs_ExecAllocTrans @dFrom, @dTo, @cUnit, @Stt_rec, @ten_bt, @tk, @loai_pb, @so_ct, @tien_nt, @ma_nt, @ty_gia, @tien, @nUserID, @Admin, @Ma_dvcs, @user_id2
		EXEC rs_ExecAllocByExpFactor @dFrom, @dTo, @cUnit, @Stt_rec, @tk, @tien_nt, @tien, @nUserID, @Admin
		FETCH NEXT FROM crTran INTO @Stt_rec, @ten_bt, @tk, @loai_pb, @so_ct, @tien_nt, @ma_nt, @ty_gia, @tien, @user_id2
	END
	CLOSE crTran
	DEALLOCATE crTran

	DECLARE @cBC VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @cBC = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE UPPER(name) = 'M_MA_NT0'
	UPDATE ct00 SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0, ma_nt = '' WHERE ma_ct = 'PK4' AND (ngay_ct BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dTo) AND ma_nt = @cBC

	-- Update r00
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @dTo BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2) BEGIN
		DECLARE @dDate SMALLDATETIME
		SET @dDate = @dFrom
		WHILE @dDate <= @dTo BEGIN
			SELECT @q = 'UPDATE r00$' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), @dDate, 112) + ' SET ps_no_nt = 0, ps_co_nt = 0, ty_gia = 0, ma_nt = '''''
			SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'WHERE ma_ct = ''PK4'' AND ma_nt = ''' + @cBC + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			SET @dDate = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @dDate)
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END



GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdtd3]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_tk, b.ten_tk2, c.ten_dvcs, c.ten_dvcs2, d.ten_td, d.ten_td2
		FROM cdtd3 a 
			JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk
			JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs
			JOIN dmtd3 d ON a.ma_td = d .ma_td
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Generate$DynamicStructure] @voucherCode VARCHAR(32), @sysData VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dmbbnct WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND status = 1) BEGIN
		DELETE dmkqkbkt WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
		RETURN
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @message NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @min CHAR(13), @id INT,
		@accounts VARCHAR(256), @i INT, @count INT, @field VARCHAR(32), @voucherType VARCHAR(128), @unit VARCHAR(32), @fields VARCHAR(4000), @name VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @message = '', @s = ''


	SELECT * INTO #dmtktct FROM dmtktct WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_ct, loai_ct INTO #voucher FROM dmbbnct WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND status = 1
	SELECT stt_rec, ma_truong INTO #ctdmbbnkt FROM ctdmbbnkt WHERE stt_rec IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #voucher)

	CREATE TABLE #check(o int, stt_rec CHAR(13), field VARCHAR(32), voucher_type VARCHAR(32), unit VARCHAR(32), accounts VARCHAR(256), id INT IDENTITY)
	SELECT @s = 'insert into #check select case when a.ma_dvcs <> '''' and loai_ct <> '''' then 2 when loai_ct <> '''' and a.ma_dvcs = '''' then 1 else 0 end o, a.stt_rec, b.ma_truong, c.loai_ct, a.ma_dvcs, ds_tk from ctdmbbnct a join ' + REPLACE(@sysData, '''', '''''') + '..dmtbbn b on a.ma_truong = b.id'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' join #voucher c on a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec'
	SELECT @s = @s + ' order by b.ma_truong, 1 desc, a.ma_dvcs desc, c.loai_ct desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @s

	CREATE TABLE #fields(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_ct CHAR(3), accounts VARCHAR(256), expression NVARCHAR(4000), id INT IDENTITY)
	INSERT INTO #fields
		SELECT a.stt_rec, @voucherCode, RTRIM(field_name), CASE WHEN loai_ct <> '' THEN '([$loai_ct]!=\"' + RTRIM(loai_ct) + '\")||' ELSE '' END
			FROM #ctdmbbnkt a JOIN #dmtktct b ON a.ma_truong = b.id JOIN #voucher c ON a.stt_rec = c.stt_rec

	SELECT @count = MAX(id) FROM #check

	--
	DELETE dmkqkbkt WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	INSERT INTO dmkqkbkt (h_event, ma_ct, expression) SELECT 'Loading', @voucherCode, @message

	-- Initialize
	SELECT @message = 'this._regExp$DefaultUnit=@@unit;this._regExp$Codes=['
	SELECT @i = 0
	WHILE @i < @count BEGIN
