CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CRPOverResource]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@WorkCenter VARCHAR(32),
	@Uom NVARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Coeffi NUMERIC(28, 6), @Round TINYINT, @nPFrom INT, @nPTo INT
	SELECT @Round = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'
	SELECT @Coeffi = CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END FROM crdmdvt WHERE dvt = @Uom

	SELECT @nPFrom = dbo.cf_CRPDate2Period(@DateFrom, @DateTo, 0)
	SELECT @nPTo = dbo.cf_CRPDate2Period(@DateFrom, @DateTo, 1)

	SELECT a.ma_nl, a.ngay_kt AS ky, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN c.ten_ccv ELSE c.ten_ccv2 END AS ten_nl
			, ROUND(CAST(a.cs_dc/@Coeffi AS NUMERIC(13, 5)), @Round) AS cs_du
			, ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(b.cong_suat/@Coeffi, 0) AS NUMERIC(13, 5)), @Round) AS cs_sd
		INTO #report
		FROM crcs a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_nl, ky, SUM(cong_suat) AS cong_suat FROM crhdcs GROUP BY ky, ma_nl) b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ky = b.ky
			LEFT JOIN sfdmcumcv c ON a.ma_nl = c.ma_ccv
		WHERE a.ky BETWEEN @nPFrom AND @nPTo
			AND a.ngay_kt BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
			AND a.ma_nl LIKE (RTRIM(@WorkCenter) + '%')

	DELETE #report WHERE cs_du >= cs_sd

	SELECT * FROM #report ORDER BY ky, ma_nl

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdntxt]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_kho, b.ten_kho2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, c.dvt AS dvt, c.dvt AS dvt2, 
			ISNULL(d.ten_vi_tri, '') AS ten_vi_tri, ISNULL(d.ten_vi_tri2, '') AS ten_vi_tri2, ISNULL(e.ten_lo, '') AS ten_lo, ISNULL(e.ten_lo2, '') AS ten_lo2, b.ma_dvcs AS ma_dvcs
		FROM dbo.cdntxt a JOIN dbo.dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho
			JOIN dbo.dmvt c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmvitri d ON a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho AND a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri
			LEFT JOIN dbo.dmlo e ON a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = e.ma_lo
		WHERE ma_ct = '' AND a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt)
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$Generate$Lot]
	@item VARCHAR(33),
	@site VARCHAR(33),
	@u NVARCHAR(33),
	@coefficient NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@quantity NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@idNumber VARCHAR(33),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(3),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	--

	DECLARE @sl_pb NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_tt NUMERIC(28, 6), @sl_cl NUMERIC(28, 6), @vi_tri_yn BIT, @lo_yn BIT, @kieu_lo INT
	SELECT @vi_tri_yn = 0, @lo_yn = 0
	
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vi_tri, b.ma_lo, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6)) AS sl_tt, b.ngay_nhap, b.ngay_hhsd INTO #res FROM dmvt a, dmlo b

	IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @item) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmdvt WHERE dvt = @u)
			OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syssiterights WHERE user_id = @userID AND ma_kho = @site)) BEGIN

		SELECT ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, 0 AS sl_tt0, 0 AS sl_pb, ngay_nhap, ngay_hhsd, 0 AS nhieu_dvt FROM #res
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @vi_tri_yn = 1 FROM dmvitri WHERE ma_kho = @site
	SELECT @lo_yn = lo_yn, @kieu_lo = kieu_lo FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @item
	SELECT @quantity = @quantity * @coefficient

	IF @lo_yn = 1 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #res SELECT CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_vi_tri ELSE '' END, a.ma_lo, SUM(a.ton13), MAX(b.ngay_nhap), MAX(b.ngay_hhsd)
			FROM cdlo213 a WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dmlo b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo 
			WHERE a.ma_vt = @item AND a.ma_kho = @site AND a.ton13 <> 0
			GROUP BY CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_vi_tri ELSE '' END, a.ma_lo
	END ELSE IF @vi_tri_yn = 1 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #res SELECT ma_vi_tri, '', ton13, NULL, NULL 
			FROM cdvitri213 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_vt = @item AND ma_kho = @site AND ton13 <> 0
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #res SELECT '', '', ton13, NULL, NULL 
			FROM cdvt213 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ma_vt = @item AND ma_kho = @site AND ton13 <> 0
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_onhand' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #res SELECT CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_vi_tri ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @lo_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_lo ELSE '' END, SUM(a.so_luong), MAX(b.ngay_nhap), MAX(b.ngay_hhsd)
			FROM cdvt93 a WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dmlo b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo 
			WHERE a.ma_vt = @item AND a.ma_kho = @site AND a.so_luong <> 0
			GROUP BY CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_vi_tri ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @lo_yn = 1 THEN a.ma_lo ELSE '' END
	END

	DECLARE @partition CHAR(6), @c$ VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @c$ = c$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF (@idNumber <> '') BEGIN
		DECLARE @n NUMERIC(28, 5)
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @c$ + '000000 where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' and status <> ''0'''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @partition OUTPUT
		IF @partition IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @q = 'insert into #res select ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_xuat), null, null'
			SET @q = @q + ' from r90$' + @partition + ' with(nolock)'
			SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + replace(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' and status = ''1'' and ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + ''' and ma_kho = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + ''''
			SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
				-- Physics key
				DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
				EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, 0, NULL, @userID, @admin
				SET @Key = ' and ' + REPLACE(@k, '%a.', '')
				SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

				SET @q = 'insert into #res select ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(sl_xuat), null, null'
				SET @q = @q + ' from r70$' + @partition + ' with(nolock)'
				SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + replace(@idNumber, '''', '''''') + ''' and status = ''1'' and ma_vt = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@item), '''', '''''') + ''' and ma_kho = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@site), '''', '''''') + '''' + @Key
				SET @q = @q + ' group by ma_vi_tri, ma_lo'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q	
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, SUM(sl_tt) AS sl_tt0, SUM(sl_tt) AS sl_tt,  CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(28, 6))  AS sl_pb, ngay_nhap, ngay_hhsd
		INTO #f
		FROM #res
		GROUP BY ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ngay_nhap, ngay_hhsd HAVING SUM(sl_tt) > 0
		ORDER BY CASE WHEN ma_lo <> '' THEN CASE WHEN @kieu_lo = 1 THEN ngay_nhap ELSE ngay_hhsd END ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN SUM(sl_tt) ELSE 1 END, SUM(sl_tt), ma_vi_tri, ma_lo
	
	IF @quantity <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @sl_pb = 0, @sl_cl = @quantity
		UPDATE #f SET @sl_pb = CASE WHEN @sl_cl = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN @sl_cl >= sl_tt THEN sl_tt ELSE @sl_cl END END,
			@sl_tt = CASE WHEN @sl_cl = 0 THEN sl_tt ELSE CASE WHEN @sl_cl >= sl_tt THEN 0 ELSE sl_tt - @sl_cl END END,
			@sl_cl = CASE WHEN @sl_cl = 0 THEN 0 ELSE @sl_cl - @sl_pb END,
			sl_pb = @sl_pb, sl_tt = @sl_tt
	END

	IF @coefficient <> 1 UPDATE #f SET sl_tt0 = CASE WHEN @coefficient <> 0 THEN sl_tt0/@coefficient ELSE 0 END, sl_pb = CASE WHEN @coefficient <> 0 THEN sl_pb/@coefficient ELSE 0 END


	SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_vi_tri) AS ma_vi_tri, RTRIM(a.ma_lo) AS ma_lo, a.sl_tt0, a.sl_pb, a.ngay_nhap, a.ngay_hhsd, b.nhieu_dvt
		FROM #f a JOIN dmvt b ON b.ma_vt = @item
		ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.ma_lo <> '' THEN CASE WHEN @kieu_lo = 1 THEN a.ngay_nhap ELSE a.ngay_hhsd END ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN @vi_tri_yn = 1 THEN a.sl_tt0 ELSE 1 END, a.sl_tt0, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpBirthday]	
	@Period INT,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33), 
	@Gender CHAR(1), 
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1028),
	@OrderByDay CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000)
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END
		
	IF @Period <> 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and month(a.ngay_sinh) = ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(2), @Period)) + ''''		
	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
		
	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec) select a.stt_rec from hrnv a with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by %order'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select a.stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_sinh, e.ngay_vao, e.bo_phan, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END), '%order', CASE WHEN @OrderByDay = '1' THEN 'day(a.ngay_sinh), year(a.ngay_sinh)' ELSE 'a.ma_nv' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PrintISTran] 
	@cLan CHAR(1), 
	@cDetailKey NVARCHAR(128), 
	@cDTable CHAR(10),
	@cVoucher CHAR(3),
	@FormType TINYINT = 0, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@FormID VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @cE CHAR(1), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	IF @cLan = 'V' SET @cE = '' ELSE SET @cE = '2'
	-- Loc trong tep ct
	SELECT @q =  'select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.so_luong,'	
	IF(@cVoucher = 'PNG') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + ' case when a.px_gia_dd = 1 then a.gia else r.gia1 end as gia,'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' case when a.px_gia_dd = 1 then a.gia_nt else r.gia_nt1 end as gia_nt,'
		SELECT @q = @q + ' r.tien_xuat as tien, r.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @FormID IN ('030', '040', '050', '060') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_008' AND RTRIM(LTRIM(val)) = '1')
			SELECT @q = @q + 'gia_nt2 as gia, gia_nt2 as gia_nt, a.tien_nt2 as tien, a.tien_nt2 as tien_nt'
		ELSE
			SELECT @q = @q + 'gia, gia_nt, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
	END
	
	--Edit BI
	SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN ', g.ten_vt' + @cE + ' as ten_vt' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', g.ten_vt, g.ten_vt2' END
	--Edit BI
	SET @q = @q + ', cast(' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END + ' as nvarchar(4000)) as detail'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' into #report' 
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from ' + dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable) + ' a with(nolock) left join dmvt g with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = g.ma_vt'
	IF(@cVoucher = 'PNG') SELECT @q = @q + ' left join ' + REPLACE(dbo.ff30_DTable(@cDTable), 'd78', 'r70') + ' r with(nolock) on left(a.stt_rec, 10) + ''PXG'' = r.stt_rec and a.stt_rec0 = r.stt_rec0'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', RIGHT(RTRIM(@cDTable), 6))
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @cDetailKey
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' order by a.line_nbr'

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#visibleFieldPrint') IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec FastBusiness$Report$VisibleFieldSetting ''#report'',''rs_PrintISTran'''
	END

	--Edit BI	
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'exec rs_InsertEmptyRowByVoucher ''#report'', 9, ''' + @cVoucher + ''', ''ma_vt, dvt, ten_vt' + CASE WHEN @FormType = 0 THEN '' WHEN @FormType = 1 THEN ', ten_vt2' END + ''','''', ''line_nbr'''
	--Edit BI
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'select * from #report order by line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION ff_OprList(@cItem VARCHAR(30), @strList NVARCHAR(1023))  
RETURNS NUMERIC(2, 0)
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @nReturn NUMERIC(2, 0)
	SET  @nReturn = 0
	SET @strList = '+' + REPLACE(@strList, ' ', '') + '+'
	SET @cItem = REPLACE(@cItem, ' ', '')
	IF CHARINDEX('+' + @cItem + '+', @strList) + CHARINDEX('+' + @cItem + '-', @strList) > 0 SET @nReturn = 1
	IF CHARINDEX('-' + @cItem + '+', @strList) + CHARINDEX('-' + @cItem + '-', @strList) > 0 SET @nReturn = -1
	RETURN @nReturn
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow] @Table VARCHAR(128), @Rows INT, @OrderColumn VARCHAR(32), @KeyColumn VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--
	DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(4000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Max VARCHAR(32) = RTRIM(@Rows)

	CREATE TABLE #$v(id INT IDENTITY(1, 1), v VARCHAR(32))
	SELECT @strSQL = ' select top 0 * into #$r from ' + @Table
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' declare @id int select @id = object_id(''tempdb..#$r'')'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' select case when a.name = ''' + @KeyColumn + ''' then ''a.c'''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' when a.name = ''' + @OrderColumn + ''' then ''a.l+b.n+1'''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' when b.name in (''char'', ''nchar'', ''varchar'', ''nvarchar'') then '''''''''''''
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' when b.name in (''decimal'', ''numeric'', ''bigint'', ''float'', ''int'', ''money'', ''real'', ''smallint'', ''smallmoney'', ''tinyint'') then ''0'' else ''null'' end as v'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from tempdb.dbo.syscolumns a join systypes b on a.xtype = b.xtype and a.xusertype = b.xusertype where a.id = @id and b.name <> ''sysname'' order by a.colorder drop table #$r'
	INSERT INTO #$v(v) EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	SELECT @Query = NULL
	SELECT @Query = ISNULL(@Query, '') + CASE WHEN (@Query IS NULL) OR (@Query = '') THEN '' ELSE ',' END + v FROM #$v ORDER BY id

	SELECT @strSQL = ' declare @digit table (d int)'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' insert into @digit select 0 n union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' declare @b table (n int)'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' insert into @b select a.d + b.d * 10 as d from @digit a cross join @digit b where a.d + b.d * 10 < ' + @Max
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' select ' + @KeyColumn + ' c, count(1) n, max(' + @OrderColumn + ') l into #$g from ' + @Table + ' group by stt_rec having count(1) < ' + @Max
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' insert into ' + @Table + ' select ' + @Query + ' from #$g a cross apply (select top (' + @Max + ' - a.n) * from @b) b'
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' drop table #$g'
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	DROP TABLE #$v
	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_LoadPRApproval]
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@PartitionTable VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionPrime VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionField VARCHAR(32),
	@PartitionExpression VARCHAR(512),
	@PartitionDefault VARCHAR(32),
	@PageCount INT, 
	@PrimaryFields VARCHAR(32),
	@InternalFields VARCHAR(4000),
	@ExternalFields VARCHAR(4000),
	@ExternalFromClause VARCHAR(4000),
	@OrderByClause VARCHAR(128), 
	@Admin BIT,
	@UserID INT, 
	@ViewAccessMode BIT, 
	@AppType TINYINT = 0, 
	@Query VARCHAR(128) = '', 
	@ExternalKey NVARCHAR(1024) = '',
	@Force BIT = 0,
	@Language CHAR(1) = '', 
	@Type INT = 0,
	@AppMode BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @RangeFrom SMALLDATETIME, @RangeTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey VARCHAR(1024), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @c VARCHAR(128)
	IF @AppType = 0 SELECT @RangeFrom = ngay_ct1, @RangeTo = ngay_ct2 FROM sysdaterules WHERE user_id = @UserID
	SELECT @UnitKey = NULL, @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 AND @AppType = 0 AND (@ExternalKey = '' OR @Force = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @UnitKey= dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitKey(@UserID)
		IF @UnitKey IS NULL BEGIN
			GOTO QueryEmpty
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF @Admin = 0 AND @AppType = 0 SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @UnitKey
	IF @Admin = 0 AND @ViewAccessMode = 0 SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ')'
	IF @Query <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(' + @PrimaryFields + ' = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@Query)), '''', '''''') + ''')'
	IF @ExternalKey <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  '(' + @ExternalKey + ')'

	CREATE TABLE #r(c VARCHAR(13), expression VARCHAR(32))

	DECLARE @dDate SMALLDATETIME, @i INT, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @RowCount INT, @Ngay_gh1 SMALLDATETIME

	-- Key	
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(not exists(select 1 from a91$000000 where reset = 0 and stt_rec = a.stt_rec and user_id4 = ''' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''' group by stt_rec having count(*) % 2 = 1) and dbo.ff_PrAuthorize(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@UserID))) + ', a.dept_id, a.ma_nt, a.t_tien_nt, a.u_status, a.kieu_duyet, getdate()) = 1)'
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and status in (''1'', ''9'')'
	-- 
	SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #r select top %RowCount ' + @PrimaryFields + ', ' + REPLACE(@PartitionExpression, '{0}', @PartitionField)
	SELECT @strSQL = @strSQL + ' from ' + @PartitionPrime + '%Partition a with(nolock) ' + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' where ' END + @Key + ' order by ' + REPLACE(@OrderByClause, ',', ' desc,')  + '  desc, ' + @PrimaryFields + ' desc'


	-- Data
	SET @Key = ''
	IF @RangeFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  '(ngay_ct >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @RangeFrom, 112) + ''')'
	IF @RangeTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END +  '(ngay_ct <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @RangeTo, 112) + ''')'
	CREATE TABLE #maxDate (ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME)
	SET @q = 'insert into #maxDate select max(ngay_ct) from ' + @PartitionTable + ' with(nolock)' + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' where ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @dDate = ngay_ct FROM #maxDate

	SELECT @i = 1, @RowCount = 0
	SELECT @Ngay_gh1 = ngay_gh1 FROM dmstt
	WHILE @i <= 3 AND @RowCount < @PageCount AND @dDate >= @Ngay_gh1 BEGIN
		SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Replace(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Replace(@strSQL, '%Partition', RTRIM(YEAR(@dDate)) + REPLACE(STR(MONTH(@dDate), 2), ' ', '0'), DEFAULT), '%RowCount', RTRIM(@PageCount - @RowCount), DEFAULT)
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @RowCount = COUNT(1) FROM #r
		SET @dDate = DATEADD(MONTH, - 1, @dDate)
		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #r) BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #t(t$ BIT)
		SELECT @strSQL = 'select top 0 cast('''' as nvarchar(128)) as duyet, cast('''' as nvarchar(128)) as huy, ' + @InternalFields + ' from ' + @PartitionPrime + @PartitionDefault 
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$AddColumn '#t', @strSQL
		ALTER TABLE #t DROP COLUMN t$
		--
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT expression FROM #r ORDER BY expression FOR  READ ONLY
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @c
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SELECT @strSQL = 'insert into #t select (rtrim(t_duyet)+ ''/'' + rtrim(t_dong)), (rtrim(t_huy) + ''/'' + rtrim(t_dong)), ' + @InternalFields + ' from ' + @PartitionPrime + @c + ' a with (nolock) where ' + @PrimaryFields + ' in (select c from #r)'
			EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @c
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
		--
		SET @strSQL =  'select ' + CASE WHEN @AppMode = 1 THEN '0 as line_nbr, 0 as isCheck,' ELSE '' END + ' stt_rec, ma_ct, 0 as duyet_het, tag, duyet, huy, ngay_ct, so_ct, dept_id, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'ten_bp' ELSE 'ten_bp2' END + CASE WHEN @Type = 0 THEN ' as ten_bp' ELSE '' END + ', ma_md, t_tien_nt, ma_nt, xtag, xtag2, a.status from #t ' + @ExternalFromClause + ' order by ' + @OrderByClause
		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL
	END ELSE GOTO QueryEmpty

	GOTO Result;

	QueryEmpty:
	SELECT @strSQL = 'select top 0 ' + @ExternalFields + ' from ' + @PartitionPrime + @PartitionDefault + ' ' + @ExternalFromClause
	EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

	Result:
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$APV$Authorize] (
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@status VARCHAR(32),	
	@category VARCHAR(32),
	@currentDate SMALLDATETIME
)
RETURNS TINYINT AS  
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nRet TINYINT, @d SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @nRet = 0, @d = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @currentDate, 121)
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1
		FROM (SELECT * FROM gndmduyet WHERE @d >= ngay_hl AND (@d <= ngay_hl2 OR ngay_hl2 IS NULL)) a JOIN gndmquyen b ON a.loai_duyet = b.loai_duyet AND a.ma_quyen = b.ma_quyen JOIN gndmquyenct c ON b.loai_duyet = c.loai_duyet AND b.ma_quyen = c.ma_quyen JOIN gndmttcttg d ON a.loai_duyet = d.loai_duyet AND d.loai_duyet = @voucherType AND c.status = d.u_status
		WHERE a.loai_duyet = @voucherType
			AND a.status = '1'
			AND a.user_id = @userID
			AND b.status = '1'
			AND c.status = @status
			AND d.status = '1'
			AND c.kieu_duyet = @category
	)
	SELECT @nRet = 1
	RETURN @nRet
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptTS2ReappraisalReport]
	@period AS INT,
	@year AS INT,
	@type VARCHAR(32),
	@department VARCHAR(32),
	@group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@language CHAR(1),
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @dateTo SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @dateTo = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@period, @year)) - 1
	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 5 AS sysorder, 1 AS sysprint, 1 AS systotal, 0 AS stt
			, b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc AS ma_bp, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
		INTO #report
		FROM dmccdc a, dmdcct b

	-- Unit Key
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)

	-- Key
	SET @key = 'a.ngay_tang <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @dateTo, 112) + ''''
	SET @key = @key + ' and a.status <> ''*'''

	IF @type <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.loai_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@type, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @department <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and b.ma_bp_dc like ''' + RTRIM(REPLACE(@department, '''', '''''')) + '%'''
	IF @group1 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group2 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @group3 <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.nh_dc3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + ' and ' + @unitKey
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)

	SET @q = 'insert into #report select 5, 1, 1, 0, b.line_nbr, a.ma_dc, a.ten_dc, a.ten_dc2, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.tk_dc, a.tk_pb, b.tk_cp, b.ma_bp_dc, a.nh_dc1, a.nh_dc2, a.nh_dc3
 from dmccdc a with(nolock) left join dmdcct b with(nolock) on a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc
 where ' + @key

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_dc, ma_bp) SELECT 5, 1, 1, 0, '', ''

	SELECT 0 AS tag, * FROM #report a LEFT JOIN #report b ON a.ma_dc = b.ma_dc AND a.line_nbr > b.line_nbr WHERE b.line_nbr IS NULL ORDER BY a.ma_dc, a.ngay_tang, a.ngay_pb0, a.so_ky_pb, a.ma_bp

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptIncomeTaxBalanceSheet] --fs_IncomeTaxReport_28--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 	
	@Form VARCHAR(24),
	@Addition TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ma_td3, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, '1' AS status INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT * INTO #glthueqttn_28 FROM glthueqttn_28 WHERE form = @Form

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#glthueqttn_28', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #ct00 select ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ma_td3, sum(ps_no) as ps_no, sum(ps_co) as ps_co, sum(ps_no_nt) as ps_no_nt, sum(ps_co_nt) AS ps_co_nt, ''1'' as status from r00$%Partition with(nolock, index(ngay_ct)) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']% group by ma_dvcs, tk, tk_du, ma_td3'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	DECLARE @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Tk_no CHAR(96), @Tk_co CHAR(96), @Tk_gt CHAR(96), @Ma_td3 VARCHAR(33), @Cong_tru CHAR(1), @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024)
	DECLARE @Tien NUMERIC(28, 6), @Tien_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)
	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Tk_no, Tk_co, Tk_gt, ISNULL(Ma_td3, ''), Cong_tru FROM #glthueqttn_28 WHERE Cach_tinh = '' AND tk_no + tk_co <> ''
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tk_gt, @Ma_td3, @Cong_tru
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN				
		IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(ps), @Tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT ps_co AS ps, ps_co_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_no, - ps_no_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_co) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_gt) = 0 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					) a
		END

		IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(ps), @Tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_gt) = 0 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					) a
		END

		IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
			SELECT @Tien = SUM(ps), @Tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)
				FROM (
					SELECT ps_no AS ps, ps_no_nt AS ps_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_co) = 1 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					UNION ALL
						SELECT - ps_co, - ps_co_nt FROM #ct00 WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk_no) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_gt) = 0 AND ma_td3 LIKE RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'
					) a
		END		

		UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien = @Tien, Tien_nt = @Tien_nt WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so

		IF @Cong_tru = '1'  BEGIN
			UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien = 0 WHERE Tien < 0
			UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien_nt = 0 WHERE Tien_nt < 0
		END
			
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tk_gt, @Ma_td3, @Cong_tru
	END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR

	-- 4 Manual Data	
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData3(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#glthueqttn_28', 'tien', '1', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData3(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#glthueqttn_28', 'tien_nt', '2', 'N')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData3(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#glthueqttn_28', 'chi_tieu', '3', 'C')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @q = dbo.ff_UpdateFLManualData3(@DateFrom, @DateTo, @DateFrom, @DateTo, @Unit, '01', @Form, '#glthueqttn_28', 'chi_tieu2', '4', 'C')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien = 0 WHERE Tien IS NULL
	UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien_nt = 0 WHERE Tien_nt IS NULL

	-- Begin Adjust
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	SET @d1 = CASE WHEN @DateFrom <> dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateFrom), YEAR(@DateFrom)) THEN DATEADD(month, 1, @DateFrom) ELSE @DateFrom END
	SET @d2 = CASE WHEN @DateTo <> dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(MONTH(@DateTo), YEAR(@DateTo)) THEN DATEADD(month, -1, @DateTo) ELSE @DateTo END
	--
	SET @Key = 'b.cach_tinh = '''' and nam * 12 + ky between ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@d1) * 12 + MONTH(@d1)) + ' and ' + RTRIM(YEAR(@d2) * 12 + MONTH(@d2))
	SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(6)) AS ky, b.tk_no, b.tk_co, b.tk_gt, b.ma_td3, a.tien, a.tien_nt INTO #s1 FROM glthueqttn28_luu a JOIN #glthueqttn_28 b ON a.ma_so = b.ma_so
	SET @q = 'insert into #s1 select a.ma_so, a.ma_dvcs, (rtrim(a.nam) + replace(str(a.ky, 2), '' '', ''0'')) as ky, b.tk_no, b.tk_co, b.tk_gt, b.ma_td3, a.tien, a.tien_nt from glthueqttn28_luu a join #glthueqttn_28 b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #s1) BEGIN
		DECLARE @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), @Ky VARCHAR(6)
		CREATE TABLE #ps (ps NUMERIC(28, 6), ps_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	
		DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT RTRIM(Ma_so), RTRIM(ma_dvcs), ky, MAX(Tk_no), MAX(Tk_co), MAX(Tk_gt), ISNULL(MAX(Ma_td3), '') FROM #s1 WHERE tk_no + tk_co <> '' GROUP BY ma_so, ma_dvcs, ky
		OPEN csGLR
		FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @Ky, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tk_gt, @Ma_td3
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN 
			SELECT @tien = 0, @tien_nt = 0
			SELECT @Ma_dvcs = REPLACE(@Ma_dvcs, '''', ''''''), @Tk_no = REPLACE(@Tk_no, '''', ''''''), @Tk_co = REPLACE(@Tk_co, '''', ''''''), @Tk_gt = REPLACE(@Tk_gt, '''', ''''''), @Ma_td3 = REPLACE(@Ma_td3, '''', '''''')

			IF @Tk_no = '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #ps

				SET @q = 'insert into #ps select sum(ps_co), sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_co) + ''') = 1 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ps select -sum(ps_no), -sum(ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_co) + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_gt) + ''') = 0 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)FROM #ps
				UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END

			IF @Tk_co = '' AND @Tk_no <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #ps

				SET @q = 'insert into #ps select sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_no) + ''') = 1 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ps select -sum(ps_co), -sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_no) + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_gt) + ''') = 0 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)FROM #ps
				UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END

			IF @Tk_no <> '' AND @Tk_co <> '' BEGIN
				TRUNCATE TABLE #ps
			
				SET @q = 'insert into #ps select sum(ps_no), sum(ps_no_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_no) + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_co) + ''') = 1 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #ps select -sum(ps_co), -sum(ps_co_nt) from r00$' + @Ky + ' with(nolock) where status = ''1'' and ma_dvcs = ''' + @Ma_dvcs + ''' and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_no) + ''') = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, ''' + RTRIM(@Tk_gt) + ''') = 0 and ma_td3 like ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_td3) + '%'''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
				SELECT @tien = SUM(ps), @tien_nt = SUM(ps_nt)FROM #ps
				UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET tien = tien - ISNULL(@tien, 0), tien_nt = tien_nt - ISNULL(@tien_nt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Ma_dvcs, @Ky, @Tk_no, @Tk_co, @Tk_gt, @Ma_td3
		END
		CLOSE csGLR
		DEALLOCATE csGLR

		--
		SET @q = 'select ma_so, sum(tien) as tien, sum(tien_nt) as tien_nt into #s2 from #s1 group by ma_so'
		SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update #glthueqttn_28 set tien = a.tien + b.tien, tien_nt = a.tien_nt + b.tien_nt from #glthueqttn_28 a join #s2 b on a.ma_so = b.ma_so'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	-- End Adjust

	DECLARE csGLR CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #glthueqttn_28 WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' ORDER BY ids
	OPEN csGLR
	FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Ma_so = REPLACE(@Ma_so, '''', '''''')

			SET @q = 'UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Tien) FROM #glthueqttn_28 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'UPDATE #glthueqttn_28 SET Tien_nt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(@Cach_tinh, '[', '(SELECT MAX(Tien_nt) FROM #glthueqttn_28 WHERE ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ' + CHAR(39) + @Ma_so + CHAR(39)
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM csGLR INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
	CLOSE csGLR
	DEALLOCATE csGLR
	--
	SELECT stt AS sysorder, in_ck AS sysprint, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systotal, stt_in
			, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ma_so, 1, 1) = 'Z' THEN '' ELSE ma_so END AS ma_so
			, tien, tien_nt, @Addition as bo_sung, bold, pl_yn, pl_td
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN chi_tieu ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN chi_tieu2 ELSE '' END AS chi_tieu2
			, CASE WHEN cach_tinh <> '' THEN '0' WHEN tk_no + tk_co <> '' THEN '1' WHEN pl_td = 1 THEN 'X' ELSE '9' END AS kind
		FROM #glthueqttn_28 ORDER BY Stt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
    SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
SET ANSI_NULLS ON



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CRPQuery]
	@WorkCenter VARCHAR(32),
	@UOM NVARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @nHe_so NUMERIC(28, 6), @nCRound TINYINT
	SELECT @nCRound = CAST(RTRIM(val) AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_cs'
	SELECT @nHe_so = CASE WHEN he_so = 0 THEN 1 ELSE he_so END FROM crdmdvt WHERE dvt = @UOM

	SELECT a.ma_nl, a.ky, a.ngay_kt
			, ROUND(a.cs_dc/@nHe_so, @nCRound) AS cs_dc
			, ROUND(a.cs_gh/@nHe_so, @nCRound) AS cs_gh
			, ROUND(b.cong_suat/@nHe_so, @nCRound) AS cong_suat
		INTO #report
		FROM crcs a
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT ma_nl, ky, SUM(cong_suat) AS cong_suat FROM crhdcs WHERE ma_nl = @WorkCenter GROUP BY ky, ma_nl) b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ky = b.ky
		WHERE a.ma_nl = @WorkCenter

	UPDATE #report SET cong_suat = 0 WHERE cong_suat IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET cs_dc = 0 WHERE cs_dc IS NULL
	UPDATE #report SET cs_gh = 0 WHERE cs_gh IS NULL

	SELECT '' as array$, dbo.ff_D2C(ngay_kt) AS ngay_kt, cs_dc, cs_gh, cong_suat FROM #report ORDER BY ma_nl, ky
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcdpx]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, c.ten_loai, c.ten_loai2
		FROM cdpx a
			JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			JOIN sfdmtttk c ON CASE a.loai WHEN '' THEN '10' ELSE a.loai END = c.ma_loai
		WHERE a.nam IN (SELECT nam_bd FROM dmstt)
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_px, a.ma_lsx, a.ma_cd, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo

GO

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.FastBusiness$Function$EncodeScript(@s NVARCHAR(1023))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1023) AS
BEGIN
	RETURN REPLACE(REPLACE(@s, '\', '\\'), '''', '\''')
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$ImportPurchase$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0, 
	@OldSite VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Environment BIT = 0,
	@EnvironmentDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
	@EnvironmentType CHAR(1) = '1'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(19, 5), @Site VARCHAR(32), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32)
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @EnvironmentRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentRate2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentUOM NVARCHAR(33), @EnvironmentAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentPercent NUMERIC(5,2), @EnvironmentAccount VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @Site = @OldSite

	SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, gia_ton, lo_yn, ma_thue_nk, ma_thue, tao_lo INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1, @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item

	IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @DefaultSite AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) AND dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
			SELECT @Site = @DefaultSite
		ELSE
			UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
		ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

	IF @Environment = 1 BEGIN
		IF @EnvironmentDate IS NULL SELECT @EnvironmentDate = GETDATE()
		EXEC rs_EnvironmentTax @Item, @UOM, @EnvironmentDate, @EnvironmentType, @EnvironmentRate OUTPUT, @EnvironmentRate2 OUTPUT, @EnvironmentUOM OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAmount OUTPUT, @EnvironmentPercent OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAccount OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select rtrim(a.ma_kho) as ma_kho, rtrim(a.ma_vi_tri) as ma_vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'N''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@UOM, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as dvt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@Rate, 0)) + ' as he_so, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@ItemAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_vt, a.gia_ton, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'cast(case when exists(select top 1 ma_kho from dmvitri where dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(a.ma_thue_nk) as ma_thue_nk, isnull(b.thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat_nk,rtrim( isnull(b.tk_thue, '''')) as tk_thue_nk, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(a.ma_thue) as ma_thue, isnull(c.thue_suat, 0) as thue_suat, rtrim(isnull(c.tk_thue_no3, '''')) as tk_thue, a.tao_lo'

	IF @Environment = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ',' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentRate, 0)) + ' as he_so_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentAmount, 0)) + ' as muc_thue_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentPercent, 0)) + ' as tl_chiu_thue_mt, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@EnvironmentAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_thue_mt'

	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #item a left join dmthuenk b on a.ma_thue_nk = b.ma_thue left join dmthue c on a.ma_thue = c.ma_thue'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpFamilyMembers]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(1024),
	@Relationship VARCHAR(1024), 
	@DayFrom INT, 
	@DayTo INT,
	@MonthFrom INT, 
	@MonthTo INT,
	@YearFrom INT, 
	@YearTo INT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(1023)

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), bo_phan VARCHAR(32),line_nbr INT)
	
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> '' THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	IF @Relationship <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key +  ' and r.ma_qh in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Relationship, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @DayFrom > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and day(r.ngay_sinh) >= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(2), @DayFrom)) + ''''
	IF @DayTo > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and day(r.ngay_sinh) <= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(2), @DayTo)) + ''''
	IF @MonthFrom > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and month(r.ngay_sinh) >= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(2), @MonthFrom)) + ''''
	IF @MonthTo > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and month(r.ngay_sinh) <= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(2), @MonthTo)) + ''''
	IF @YearFrom > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and year(r.ngay_sinh) >= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(4), @YearFrom)) + ''''
	IF @YearTo > 0 SET @Key = @Key + ' and year(r.ngay_sinh) <= ''' + RTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(4), @YearTo)) + ''''
		
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'
	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec, ma_nv, bo_phan, line_nbr) select r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.bo_phan, r.line_nbr from hregd r join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec =  a.stt_rec' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Result
	CREATE TABLE #order(ma_nv VARCHAR(32), line_nbr INT, stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #order(ma_nv, line_nbr) SELECT a.ma_nv, MIN(a.line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #report a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp GROUP BY b.stt_ref, a.ma_nv ORDER BY b.stt_ref, a.ma_nv

	SELECT @q = ' select o.stt, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao, cast(b.stt_ref as char(512)) + a.bo_phan as bo_phan, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, isnull(c.ten_ttnv%l, '''') as ten_ttnv, isnull(d.ten_vtr%l, '''') as vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'r.ho_ten as ho_ten_nt, r.ngay_sinh as ns_nt, r.ma_qh, j.ten_qh%l as ten_qh, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a left join #order o on a.ma_nv = o.ma_nv and a.line_nbr = o.line_nbr join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hregd r on a.stt_rec = r.stt_rec and a.line_nbr = r.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrdmqhgd j on r.ma_qh = j.ma_qh order by b.stt_ref, a.ma_nv, a.line_nbr'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	--
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMaterialCostListByJob]	--fs30_MaterialTransListByJob2--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@DeducationType CHAR(1),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_vv <> '''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and (dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1)'
	--
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv'
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.ma_kho, a.nxt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.tien_nhap AS tien, a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkin a

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.ma_kho, a.nxt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.sl_nhap + a.sl_xuat as so_luong, a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat as tien, a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x as tien_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(9)) AS stt
			, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.ma_kho, a.nxt
			, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, b.dvt, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vt2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
			, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vv ELSE '' END AS ten_vv, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vv2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vv2
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmvv e ON a.ma_vv = e.ma_vv

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_vv', 'ma_vv, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr', '#report', 'stt', ''

	IF @DeducationType = '1'
		UPDATE #report SET so_luong = - so_luong, tien = - tien, tien_nt = - tien_nt WHERE nxt = 1
	ELSE
		DELETE #report WHERE nxt = 1

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt_rec, stt_rec0', 'NUMERIC(9), CHAR(13), CHAR(3)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- trong stored cu lay cname,cname2 tu glreptype du vao ftype = @ntype , vi chay stored cu thay @ntype = 4 --> cname = ten_vv
	-- cname2 = ten_vv2 --> lay cung luon, ko su dung bang tam nhu stored cu
	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_vv, ten_vv2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv
				, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
				, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
				, SUM(a.so_luong), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt)
			FROM #report a
			GROUP BY a.ma_vv

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv) SELECT 6, 0, 0, ma_vv FROM #report WHERE ma_vv <> (SELECT MAX(ma_vv) FROM #report) GROUP BY ma_vv

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)

	--
	SET @q = 'select a.ma_vv as rp_group, a.* from #report a order by a.ma_vv, sysorder, stt, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPFTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ngay_ct0, a.tk, c.ten_tk, c.ten_tk2
			, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt
			, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word
			, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS CHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM m73$000000 a, dmkh b, dmtk c

	SELECT TOP 0 b.line_nbr, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.ma_kho, b.tk_vt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, a.*, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail INTO #detail FROM #master a, d73$000000 b, dmvt c

	-- Master
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, ltrim(a.so_ct), a.so_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', convert(varchar,a.ngay_ct0, 103), ltrim(a.tk), isnull(c.ten_tk,''''), isnull(c.ten_tk2,'''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''E'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''E'')'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from m73$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.ma_kho, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END

	SET @q = @q + ' from d73$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Empty Row
	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PNC'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	--
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct FROM #master GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, ong_ba = b.ong_ba, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ten_kh2 = b.ten_kh2
				, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, tk = b.tk, ten_tk = b.ten_tk, ten_tk2 = b.ten_tk2, so_ct0 = b.so_ct0, ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE line_nbr = 1
	UPDATE #detail SET t_cp = b.t_cp, t_cp_nt = b.t_cp_nt
			, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_thue_nt = b.t_thue_nt, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt, t_tien_in_word = b.t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word = b.t_tien_nt_in_word
			, t_tien_in_word2 = b.t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tien_nt_in_word2
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

	-- View
	IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', 'PNC', @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Desc = 0
			SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, ten_vt, ten_vt2, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		ELSE
			SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, ten_vt, ten_vt2, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		IF @Desc = 0
			SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		ELSE
			SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xGroup
		, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr
		, customize, detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END
