	IF @FormType = 4 BEGIN -- Bang ke phieu nhap nhom theo dang nhap
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, so_luong, gia0, gia_nt0, gia, gia_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, tien, tien_nt, cp, cp_nt, nk, nk_nt, thue, thue_nt, ma_nx, stt_rec, ma_ct, ten_kh, ten_kh2)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, SUM(so_luong), 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(a.tien0), SUM(a.tien_nt0), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), SUM(cp), SUM(cp_nt), SUM(nk), SUM(nk_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), a.ma_nx, '', ''
					, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_nx) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_nx) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.ma_nx) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_nx2) ELSE '' END
				FROM #report a left join dmnx b on a.ma_nx = b.ma_nx WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY a.ma_nx

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.ty_gia, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_nx' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_nx, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_nx2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_nx2' + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmnx b on a.ma_nx = b.ma_nx left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct' + @baseJoin
		SET @q = @q + ' order by a.ma_nx, a.sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', c.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	IF @FormType = 5 BEGIN -- Bang ke phieu nhap nhom theo tai khoan doi ung
		SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'ten_kh, ten_kh2', 'NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		UPDATE #report SET ten_kh = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_kh ELSE '' END, ten_kh2 = CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN b.ten_kh2 ELSE '' END FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh

		INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, tk_du, so_luong, gia0, gia_nt0, gia, gia_nt, tien0, tien_nt0, tien, tien_nt, cp, cp_nt, nk, nk_nt, thue, thue_nt, ma_nx, stt_rec, ma_ct, ten_kh, ten_kh2)
			SELECT 0, 0, 0, a.tk_du, SUM(so_luong), 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(a.tien0), SUM(a.tien_nt0), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt), SUM(cp), SUM(cp_nt), SUM(nk), SUM(nk_nt), SUM(thue), SUM(thue_nt), a.tk_du, '', ''
					, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.tk_du) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_tk) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN RTRIM(a.tk_du) + ' - ' + MAX(b.ten_tk2) ELSE '' END
				FROM #report a left join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk WHERE systotal = 1 GROUP BY a.tk_du

		EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
		IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

		EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL

		SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.sysorder, a.systotal, a.sysprint, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct, a.ma_ct0, a.so_ct, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.gia0, a.gia_nt0, a.tien, a.tien_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ', a.tien0, a.tien_nt0, a.cp, a.cp_nt, a.nk, a.nk_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.ma_nx, a.tk_du, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vv, a.ma_kh, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.ty_gia, a.ma_nt, a.dien_giai, isnull(a.dvt, '''') as dvt'
		SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_tk' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_tk, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'b.ten_tk2' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_tk2' + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
		SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct' + @baseJoin
		SET @q = @q + ' order by a.tk_du, a.sysorder'  + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' + @Order END + ', c.stt_ct_nkc, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_CRPRunAllocatedCapacity] @dNow SMALLDATETIME, @cDefaultPeriod VARCHAR(33), @nPeriodCount INT, @nUserID INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Set
	DECLARE @i INT, @Ma_vt VARCHAR(33), @So_dh VARCHAR(33), @Ma_nl VARCHAR(33), @Ngay_ht SMALLDATETIME, @Nc_cs NUMERIC(19, 5), @Ma_cd VARCHAR(33), @Loai_cd CHAR(1), @Pt_lich CHAR(1),
		@dNgay_bd SMALLDATETIME, @nSo_ngay NUMERIC(28, 6), @nCong_suat NUMERIC(19, 5), @Cs_chuan NUMERIC(19, 5), @dNgay_ht SMALLDATETIME,
		@cOldMa_vt VARCHAR(33), @cOldSo_dh VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #crhdcs FROM crhdcs

	SELECT DISTINCT a.ma_vt, a.so_dh, a.ma_nl, a.ngay_ht, a.cong_suat, d.loai_cd, ISNULL(d.ma_cd, '') AS ma_cd, ISNULL(e.pt_lich, 0) AS pt_lich
		INTO #tScan FROM crhdcs a
			JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
			LEFT JOIN ctrt d ON d.ma_lo_trinh = b.ma_lo_trinh AND a.ma_nl = d.ma_ccv AND ISNULL(a.ma_cd, '') = ISNULL(d.ma_cd, '')
			LEFT JOIN sfdmcumcv e ON d.ma_ccv = e.ma_ccv
		ORDER BY a.so_dh, a.ma_vt, ma_cd DESC

	SELECT @cOldMa_vt = '', @cOldSo_dh = ''

	DECLARE cr CURSOR FOR SELECT ma_vt, so_dh, ma_nl, ngay_ht, cong_suat, ma_cd, loai_cd, pt_lich FROM #tScan ORDER BY so_dh, ma_vt, ma_cd DESC
	OPEN cr
	FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Ma_vt, @So_dh, @Ma_nl, @Ngay_ht, @Nc_cs, @Ma_cd, @Loai_cd, @Pt_lich
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @dNgay_ht = @Ngay_ht
			IF RTRIM(@cOldMa_vt) = RTRIM(@Ma_vt) AND RTRIM(LTRIM(@cOldSo_dh)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(@So_dh)) SELECT @Ngay_ht = dbo.cf_GetNetBackwardDate(@dNgay_bd, 0, @Pt_lich)
			SELECT @i = dbo.mf_Date2Period(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @Ngay_ht) + 1, @cOldMa_vt = @Ma_vt, @cOldSo_dh = @So_dh

			WHILE @i > 0 AND @Nc_cs > 0
				BEGIN
					IF @Loai_cd = '3' -- Gia cong
						BEGIN
							SELECT @dNgay_bd = dbo.cf_GetNetBackwardDate(DATEADD(Day, - CEILING(@Nc_cs/24), @Ngay_ht), 0, @Pt_lich)
							BREAK
						END

					IF @Ngay_ht <= @dNow
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO #crhdcs (ky, ma_vt, so_dh, ma_nl, ma_cd, cong_suat, so_ngay, ngay_bd, ngay_ht)
								SELECT 1, @Ma_vt, @So_dh, @Ma_nl, @Ma_cd, @Nc_cs, 0, dbo.cf_GetNetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 1, 0, @Pt_lich), @dNgay_ht
							BREAK
						END

					SET @dNgay_bd = dbo.cf_GetNetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 1, 0, @Pt_lich)
					SET @nSo_ngay = dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, @Pt_lich)
					SELECT @Cs_chuan = dbo.cf_GetCapacityOfDays(@Ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, 2)

					IF @Cs_chuan = 0 AND @i > 1
						BEGIN
							SET @i = @i - 1
							SET @dNgay_bd = dbo.cf_GetNetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 1, 0, @Pt_lich)
							SET @nSo_ngay = dbo.cf_GetNetDays(@dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, @Pt_lich)
							SELECT @Cs_chuan = dbo.cf_GetCapacityOfDays(@Ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, 2)
						END

					IF @i > 1
						IF @Cs_chuan >= @Nc_cs
							BEGIN
								SET @nCong_suat = @Nc_cs
								SELECT @dNgay_bd = @Ngay_ht, @nSo_ngay = 0
								WHILE dbo.cf_GetCapacityOfDays(@Ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, 2) < @Nc_cs
									BEGIN
										SET @nSo_ngay = @nSo_ngay + 1
										SET @dNgay_bd = DATEADD(Day, -1, @dNgay_bd)
									END
							END
						ELSE
							SET @nCong_suat = @Cs_chuan
					ELSE
						IF @Cs_chuan >= @Nc_cs
							BEGIN
								SET @nCong_suat = @Nc_cs
								SELECT @dNgay_bd = @Ngay_ht, @nSo_ngay = 0
								WHILE dbo.cf_GetCapacityOfDays(@Ma_nl, @dNgay_bd, @Ngay_ht, 2) < @Nc_cs
									BEGIN
										SET @nSo_ngay = @nSo_ngay + 1
										SET @dNgay_bd = DATEADD(Day, -1, @dNgay_bd)
									END

								SET @dNgay_bd = dbo.cf_GetNetDateAfterNow(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNgay_bd, @dNow, @Pt_lich)
							END
						ELSE
							SET @nCong_suat = @Nc_cs



					INSERT INTO #crhdcs (ky, ma_vt, so_dh, ma_nl, ma_cd, cong_suat, so_ngay, ngay_bd, ngay_ht)
						SELECT @i, @Ma_vt, @So_dh, @Ma_nl, @Ma_cd, @nCong_suat, @nSo_ngay, @dNgay_bd, @dNgay_ht

					SET @Nc_cs = @Nc_cs - @nCong_suat
					SET @Ngay_ht = dbo.mf_GetDOP(@cDefaultPeriod, @dNow, @i - 2, 1)

					SET @i = @i - 1
				END -- END WHILE
			FETCH NEXT FROM cr INTO @Ma_vt, @So_dh, @Ma_nl, @Ngay_ht, @Nc_cs, @Ma_cd, @Loai_cd, @Pt_lich
		END
	CLOSE cr
	DEALLOCATE cr


	DELETE #crhdcs WHERE cong_suat = 0
	UPDATE #crhdcs SET nguon = b.nguon, so_luong = b.so_luong, so_ngay = b.so_ngay
			, status = b.status, datetime0 = b.datetime0, datetime2 = b.datetime2, user_id0 = b.user_id0, user_id2 = b.user_id2
			, ma_td1 = b.ma_td1, ma_td2 = b.ma_td2, ma_td3 = b.ma_td3, sl_td1 = b.sl_td1, sl_td2 = b.sl_td2, sl_td3 = b.sl_td3, ngay_td1 = b.ngay_td1, ngay_td2 = b.ngay_td2, ngay_td3 = b.ngay_td3, gc_td1 = b.gc_td1, gc_td2 = b.gc_td2, gc_td3 = b.gc_td3
			, s1 = b.s1, s2 = b.s2, s3 = b.s3, s4 = b.s4, s5 = b.s5, s6 = b.s6, s7 = b.s7, s8 = b.s8, s9 = b.s9
		FROM #crhdcs a JOIN crhdcs b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.so_dh = b.so_dh AND a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl

	UPDATE #crhdcs SET loai_nl = b.loai_nl, ngay_cuoi_ky = b.ngay_kt, cs_chuan = b.cong_suat, cs_dc = b.cs_dc, cs_gh = b.cs_gh
		FROM #crhdcs a JOIN crcs b ON a.ma_nl = b.ma_nl AND a.ky = b.ky

	TRUNCATE TABLE crhdcs
	INSERT INTO crhdcs SELECT * FROM #crhdcs
END


GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcddtqt1]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, d.ten_dtqt, d.ten_dtqt2
		FROM cddtqt1 a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs JOIN dmdtqt1 d ON a.ma_dtqt = d.ma_dtqt
		WHERE a.nam = (SELECT TOP 1 nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_dtqt

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$SalesInvoice$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@Field VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerID VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Term VARCHAR(32), 
	@Currency VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item VARCHAR(32), 
	@Site VARCHAR(32), 
	@Quantity NUMERIC(28, 6), 
	@SalesAccount VARCHAR(32), 
	@COGSAccount VARCHAR(32), 
	@DiscountAccount VARCHAR(32), 
	@PromotionExpenseAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0,
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0, 
	@External BIT = 0, 
	@OldLocation VARCHAR(32) = '', 
	@IDNumber VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Action TINYINT = 0,
	@DataType TINYINT = 0,
	@ItemTax TINYINT = 0,
	@Environment BIT = 0,
	@EnvironmentDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
	@EnvironmentType CHAR(1) = '1'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(19, 5), @LotNumber VARCHAR(32), @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @SalesAccountType BIT, @COGSAccountType BIT, @DiscountAccountType BIT, @PromotionExpenseAccountType BIT, @OldSite VARCHAR(32), @Location VARCHAR(32), @DefaultSite VARCHAR(32), @Change BIT
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @EnvironmentRate NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentRate2 NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentUOM NVARCHAR(33), @EnvironmentAmount NUMERIC(28, 6), @EnvironmentPercent NUMERIC(5,2), @EnvironmentAccount VARCHAR(33)

	SELECT @OldSite = @Site
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_ck, tk_cpbh, gia_ton, lo_yn, a.ma_thue, b.thue_suat, b.tk_thue_co, c.tk_cn AS thue_cn
		INTO #Item FROM dmvt a, dmthue b, dmtk c

	IF @ItemTax = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #Item SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_ck, tk_cpbh, gia_ton, lo_yn, a.ma_thue, ISNULL(b.thue_suat, 0), '', 0
			 FROM dmvt a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #Item SELECT ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, dvt, tk_vt, tk_dl, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_ck, tk_cpbh, gia_ton, lo_yn, a.ma_thue, ISNULL(b.thue_suat, 0), ISNULL(b.tk_thue_co, ''), ISNULL(c.tk_cn, 0)
			 FROM dmvt a LEFT JOIN dmthue b ON a.ma_thue = b.ma_thue LEFT JOIN dmtk c ON b.tk_thue_co = c.tk WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	END
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1 FROM #Item


	CREATE TABLE #LotNumber (ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #LotNumber EXEC fs_GetLotNumber @Item
	SELECT @LotNumber = '', @Change = 0

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item a JOIN dmkho b ON a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho WHERE b.ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) BEGIN
		SELECT @DefaultSite = ma_kho FROM #Item
		IF @DefaultSite <> '' BEGIN
			IF dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSiteRights(@VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @DefaultSite, @UserID, @Admin) = 1
				SELECT @Change = 1, @Site = @DefaultSite
			ELSE
				UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''
		END
	END ELSE
		UPDATE #Item SET ma_kho = '', ma_vi_tri = ''

	CREATE TABLE #SalesPrices (gia_ban_nt NUMERIC(28, 12), gia_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 12), ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT INTO #SalesPrices EXEC fs_GetSOPrice @Field, @VoucherCode, @VoucherDate, @Term, @Currency, @CustomerID, @Item, @Site, @UOM, @Quantity, @Rate

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #LotNumber) SELECT @LotNumber = ma_lo FROM #LotNumber
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_dl FROM #Item
		ELSE SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM #Item

	SELECT @SalesAccountType = 1, @COGSAccountType = 1, @DiscountAccountType = 1, @PromotionExpenseAccountType = 1
	IF @SalesAccount = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @SalesAccount = tk_dt FROM #Item
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @SalesAccount AND loai_tk = 1) SELECT @SalesAccountType = 0
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_dt = b.tk WHERE b.loai_tk = 1)
			SELECT @SalesAccount = tk_dt FROM #Item
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @SalesAccount AND loai_tk = 1)
				SELECT @SalesAccount = tk_dt, @SalesAccountType = 0 FROM #Item
		END
	END

	IF @COGSAccount = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @COGSAccount = tk_gv FROM #Item
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @COGSAccount AND loai_tk = 1) SELECT @COGSAccountType = 0
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_gv = b.tk WHERE b.loai_tk = 1)
			SELECT @COGSAccount = tk_gv FROM #Item
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @COGSAccount AND loai_tk = 1)
				SELECT @COGSAccount = tk_gv, @COGSAccountType = 0 FROM #Item
		END
	END

	IF @DiscountAccount = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @DiscountAccount = tk_ck FROM #Item
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @DiscountAccount AND loai_tk = 1) SELECT @DiscountAccountType = 0
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_ck = b.tk WHERE b.loai_tk = 1)
			SELECT @DiscountAccount = tk_ck FROM #Item
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @DiscountAccount AND loai_tk = 1)
				SELECT @DiscountAccount = tk_ck, @DiscountAccountType = 0 FROM #Item
		END
	END

	IF @PromotionExpenseAccount = '' BEGIN
		SELECT @PromotionExpenseAccount = tk_cpbh FROM #Item
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @PromotionExpenseAccount AND loai_tk = 1) SELECT @PromotionExpenseAccountType = 0
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk_cpbh = b.tk WHERE b.loai_tk = 1)
			SELECT @PromotionExpenseAccount = tk_cpbh FROM #Item
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtk WHERE tk = @PromotionExpenseAccount AND loai_tk = 1)
				SELECT @PromotionExpenseAccount = tk_cpbh, @PromotionExpenseAccountType = 0 FROM #Item
		END
	END

	IF @External = 1 BEGIN
		IF @LotNumber <> '' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Item WHERE (ma_kho <> '' AND ma_kho <> @OldSite) OR (ma_vi_tri <> '' AND ma_vi_tri <> @OldLocation)) BEGIN
			SELECT @Site = CASE WHEN ma_kho = '' THEN @OldSite ELSE ma_kho END, @Location = CASE WHEN @Change = 1 OR ma_vi_tri <> '' THEN ma_vi_tri ELSE @OldLocation END FROM #Item
			EXEC FastBusiness$Current$Stock 0, @Item, @Site, @Location, @LotNumber, @IDNumber, @Rate, @VoucherCode, @UnitCode, @Action, @DataType, @Stock OUTPUT
		END
	END
	IF @Environment = 1 BEGIN
		IF @EnvironmentDate IS NULL SELECT @EnvironmentDate = GETDATE()
		EXEC rs_EnvironmentTax @Item, @UOM, @EnvironmentDate, @EnvironmentType, @EnvironmentRate OUTPUT, @EnvironmentRate2 OUTPUT, @EnvironmentUOM OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAmount OUTPUT, @EnvironmentPercent OUTPUT, @EnvironmentAccount OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @q = 'select rtrim(a.ma_kho) as ma_kho, rtrim(a.ma_vi_tri) as ma_vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@LotNumber, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as ma_lo, N''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@UOM, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as dvt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@Rate, 0)) + ' as he_so, b.gia_ban_nt, b.gia_nt2, b.ck_nt,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@ItemAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_vt, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@SalesAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_dt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@SalesAccountType, 0)) + ' as kieu_dt, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@COGSAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_gv, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@COGSAccountType, 0)) + ' as kieu_gv, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@DiscountAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_ck, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@DiscountAccountType, 0)) + ' as kieu_ck, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + '''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@PromotionExpenseAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_cpbh, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@PromotionExpenseAccountType, 0)) + ' as kieu_cpbh, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'a.gia_ton, '
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'cast(case when exists(select top 1 ma_kho from dmvitri where dmvitri.ma_kho = a.ma_kho) then 1 else 0 end as bit) as vi_tri_yn, a.lo_yn,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(isnull(a.ma_thue, '''')) as ma_thue, rtrim(isnull(a.thue_suat, 0)) as thue_suat, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@Stock, 0)) + ' as stock,'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'rtrim(isnull(a.tk_thue_co, '''')) as tk_thue_co, rtrim(isnull(a.thue_cn, 0)) as thue_cn'
	IF @Environment = 1 SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ',' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentRate, 0)) + ' as he_so_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentAmount, 0)) + ' as muc_thue_mt, ' + RTRIM(ISNULL(@EnvironmentPercent, 0)) + ' as tl_chiu_thue_mt, ''' + RTRIM(ISNULL(REPLACE(@EnvironmentAccount, '''', ''''''), '')) + ''' as tk_thue_mt'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'from #Item a, #SalesPrices b'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmployee]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33), 
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33), 	
	@Level VARCHAR(33),	
	@Gender CHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33), 
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(1023), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	CREATE TABLE #report(stt_rec CHAR(13), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'is not null' ELSE 'is null' END
	
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrbp b on a.bo_phan = b.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 + @Level <> '' SELECT @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt c on a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr'

	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (stt_rec) select a.stt_rec from hrnv a with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by a.ma_nv'
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' select a.stt, a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_sinh, e.ngay_vao, e.bo_phan, v.ten as nguoi_quan_ly, b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as vi_tri, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' else N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #report a join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join vhrnv v on e.nv_ql = v.ma_nv order by a.stt'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMaterialCostSummaryByJob] -- fs30_MaterialSummaryByJob2
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Account VARCHAR(32),
	@DeducationType CHAR(1),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_vv <> '''''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_du', 'like', @Account)
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and (dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1)'
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv c on a.ma_vv = c.ma_vv'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.ma_vv, a.ma_vt, a.tk_du, a.nxt, a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.tien_nhap AS tien, a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, b.ten_vv, b.ten_vv2, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, c.dvt
		INTO #tmp FROM wrkin a, dmvv b, dmvt c

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ma_vv, a.ma_vt, a.tk_du, a.nxt, (a.sl_nhap + a.sl_xuat) as so_luong, (a.tien_nhap + a.tien_xuat) as tien, '
	SET @q = @q + '(a.tien_nt_n + a.tien_nt_x) as tien_nt,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when b.ten_vv is null then '''' else b.ten_vv end as ten_vv,'
	SET @q = @q + ' case when b.ten_vv2 is null then '''' else b.ten_vv2 end as ten_vv2,'
	SET @q = @q + ' c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, c.dvt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv left join dmvt c on a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @DeducationType = '1'
		UPDATE #tmp SET so_luong = - so_luong, tien = - tien, tien_nt = - tien_nt WHERE nxt = 1
	ELSE
		DELETE #tmp WHERE nxt = 1

	SELECT 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(9)) AS stt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_vt,	MAX(dvt) AS dvt,
			MAX(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vv ELSE '' END) AS ten_vv, MAX(CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vv2 ELSE '' END) AS ten_vv2,
			MAX(CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE '' END) AS ten_vt, MAX(CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vt2 ELSE '' END) AS ten_vt2,
			SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
		INTO #report FROM #tmp a
		GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_vv

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2', 'NUMERIC(5), VARCHAR(32), NVARCHAR(511), NVARCHAR(511)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_vv', 'ma_vv, ma_vt', '#report', 'stt', ''

	SET @q = ' UPDATE #report SET ma_vt = SPACE(1) + ma_vt, ten_vt = SPACE(1)  + RTRIM(ten_vt), ten_vt2 = SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_vt2)'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_vv, ten_vv2, so_luong, tien, tien_nt)
	SELECT 0, 0, 0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv
			, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
			, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
			, SUM(a.so_luong), SUM(a.tien), SUM(a.tien_nt)
		FROM #report a
		GROUP BY a.ma_vv

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv) SELECT 6, 0, 0, ma_vv FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_vv

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES (3, 0, 0)

	DELETE #report WHERE stt IS NULL AND ma_vt IS NULL AND dvt IS NULL

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal) VALUES(0, 0, 0)

	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, stt, ma_vv AS rp_group, ma_vv, ten_vv, ten_vv2,  ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, so_luong, tien, tien_nt
		FROM #report ORDER BY ma_vv, sysorder, ma_vt

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_PostPRClosedHeaders]
	@userID INT, 
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @status CHAR(1)
	SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct, @status = status FROM c91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	IF @status = '*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @UnitKey = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	
	SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
	SET @MasterTable = 'm91$' + @Dyn
	SET @DetailTable = 'd91$' + @Dyn
	SET @InquiryTable = 'i91$' + @Dyn

	--
	SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')
	CREATE TABLE #role(id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #role select 1 from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and status <> ''5'''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END
	
	--
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set xtag2 = status, status = ''5'', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''5'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update c91$000000 set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''5'' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	
	-- History Approve
	DECLARE @stt INT
	SELECT @stt = 0
	SELECT @stt = ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) + 1 FROM a91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	
	SET @q = 'insert into a91$000000(stt_rec, stt, status, u_status, xtype, user_id4, datetime4, reset)'
	SET @q = @q + ' select stt_rec, ''' + RTRIM(@stt) + ''', status, u_status, ''1'', user_id2, datetime2, 0'
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @masterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	

	-- History Detail Approve
	SELECT stt_rec, stt_rec0, sl_duyet, xstatus INTO #hisDetail FROM e91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND stt = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(stt), 0) FROM e91$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber)
	

	-- Delete
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber) BEGIN		
		SET @q = 'delete ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..dbxn where code in (select ma_nhan from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''') or code in (select ma_huy from dmxn where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		DELETE dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPGTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Voucher CHAR(3),
	@Controller VARCHAR(32),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@View TINYINT = 1, -- 1: Pdf, 2: Excel
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(33),
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(511), @tk_cpxt VARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ngay_ct0, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ong_ba, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS ong_ba2
			, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt , CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS nam
			, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt
			, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_tt_nt_in_word2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(511)) AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM wrkpgtran a

	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.tk_vt, b.tk_cpxt, b.so_luong, b.gia_nt, b.tien_nt, b.gia, b.tien, b.line_nbr, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, d.ma_kho
			, a.*, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS tk_no, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS tk_co
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail
		INTO #detail FROM #master a, wrkpgdetail b, dmvt c, dmkho d

	SELECT TOP 0 tk_vt, stt_rec INTO #tkvt FROM wrkpgdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 tk_cpxt, stt_rec INTO #tkcpxt FROM wrkpgdetail
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS tk_no, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(511)) AS tk_co, stt_rec INTO #tk FROM wrkpgdetail

	--
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #tkvt select distinct tk_vt, stt_rec from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	--
	IF LEFT(@DetailTable, 4) = 'd78$' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tkcpxt select distinct tk_cpxt, stt_rec from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tkcpxt select distinct tk, stt_rec from ' + @MasterTable + ' a with(nolock) where %[' + @key + ']%'
	END
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin


	SET @Code = REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', '''''')
	SELECT @i = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordCount(@Code, ',')
	WHILE @i > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @stt_rec = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(@Code, @i, ',')
		SELECT @tk_vt = '', @tk_cpxt = ''
		SELECT @tk_vt = @tk_vt + RTRIM(a.tk_vt) + ', ' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_vt FROM #tkvt WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec) a
		SELECT @tk_cpxt = @tk_cpxt + RTRIM(a.tk_cpxt) + ', ' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tk_cpxt FROM #tkcpxt WHERE stt_rec = @stt_rec) a
		SELECT @tk_vt = LEFT(@tk_vt, CASE WHEN LEN(@tk_vt) > 0 THEN LEN(@tk_vt) - 1 ELSE LEN(@tk_vt) END), @tk_cpxt = LEFT(@tk_cpxt, CASE WHEN LEN(@tk_cpxt) > 0 THEN LEN(@tk_cpxt) - 1 ELSE LEN(@tk_cpxt) END)
		INSERT INTO #tk (tk_no, tk_co, stt_rec) VALUES (@tk_vt, @tk_cpxt, @stt_rec)
		SET @i = @i - 1
	END

	SET @q = 'insert into #master'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ngay_ct0, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, case when a.ong_ba <> '''' then a.ong_ba else ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_kh' ELSE 'b.ten_kh2' END + ' end as ong_ba, '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, a.so_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.ngay_ct0, a.tk, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, case when a.ong_ba <> '''' then a.ong_ba else b.ten_kh end as ong_ba, case when a.ong_ba <> '''' then a.ong_ba else b.ten_kh2 end as ong_ba2'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_in_word'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''') as t_tt_nt_in_word, '''', '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''V'') as t_tt_in_word'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''V'') as t_tt_nt_in_word'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''E'') as t_tt_in_word2'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''E'') as t_tt_nt_in_word2'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba, ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @MasterTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join v00$%Partition d with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = d.stt_rec'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SET @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_cpxt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2, a.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''', '''', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', e.tk_no, e.tk_co'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from ' + @DetailTable + ' a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt left join dmkho c with(nolock) on a.ma_kho = c.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join #tk e with(nolock) on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	IF @extDetailJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extDetailJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Empty Row
	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PNG'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	--
	UPDATE #detail SET tk = b.tk, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, so_seri0 = b.so_seri0, ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0, so_ct0 = b.so_ct0, ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct, dien_giai = b.dien_giai
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(tk) AS tk, MAX(ma_kh) AS ma_kh, MAX(so_seri0) AS so_seri0, MAX(ngay_ct0) AS ngay_ct0, MAX(so_ct0) AS so_ct0, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct, MAX(dien_giai) AS dien_giai FROM #master GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, ong_ba = b.ong_ba, ma_nt = b.ma_nt, ong_ba2 = b.ong_ba2
			, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE line_nbr = 1
	UPDATE #detail SET t_tien0 = b.t_tien0, t_tien_nt0 = b.t_tien_nt0, t_cp = b.t_cp, t_cp_nt = b.t_cp_nt, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_thue_nt = b.t_thue_nt, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt
			, t_tt_in_word = b.t_tt_in_word, t_tt_nt_in_word = b.t_tt_nt_in_word
			, t_tt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_in_word2, t_tt_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tt_nt_in_word2
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
			WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)
	UPDATE #detail SET ma_kh = '', tk = '', so_seri0 = '', so_ct0 = '', ngay_ct0 = NULL, dien_giai = '' WHERE line_nbr <> 1

	-- View
	IF @View = 1 BEGIN
		IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', @Voucher, @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

		IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_cpxt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ma_kho, a.stt_rec
		, a.ma_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh2, '''') as ten_kh2, isnull(b.dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi
		, a.ong_ba, a.tk, isnull(c.ten_tk, '''') as ten_tk, isnull(c.ten_tk2, '''') as ten_tk2
		, a.so_seri0, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word
		, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.dien_giai, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup
		, a.customize, a.detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_cpxt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ma_kho, a.stt_rec
		, a.ma_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh2, '''') as ten_kh2, isnull(b.dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi
		, a.ong_ba, a.tk, isnull(c.ten_tk, '''') as ten_tk, isnull(c.ten_tk2, '''') as ten_tk2
		, a.so_seri0, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word
		, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.dien_giai, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup
		, a.customize, a.detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk order by a.ngay_ct desc, a.so_ct desc, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_cpxt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ma_kho, stt_rec
		, a.ma_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh2, '''') as ten_kh2, isnull(b.dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi
		, a.ong_ba, a.ong_ba2
		, a.tk, isnull(c.ten_tk, '''') as ten_tk, isnull(c.ten_tk2, '''') as ten_tk2
		, a.so_seri0, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word, a.t_tt_in_word2, a.t_tt_nt_in_word2
		, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.dien_giai, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup
		, a.customize, a.detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk order by a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.tk_vt, a.tk_cpxt, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt, a.gia, a.tien, a.line_nbr, a.ten_vt, a.ten_vt2, a.ma_kho, stt_rec
		, a.ma_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh, '''') as ten_kh, isnull(b.ten_kh2, '''') as ten_kh2, isnull(b.dia_chi, '''') as dia_chi
		, a.ong_ba, a.ong_ba2
		, a.tk, isnull(c.ten_tk, '''') as ten_tk, isnull(c.ten_tk2, '''') as ten_tk2
		, a.so_seri0, a.so_ct0, a.ngay_ct0, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_nt, a.ngay, a.thang, a.nam, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt, a.t_tt_in_word, a.t_tt_nt_in_word, a.t_tt_in_word2, a.t_tt_nt_in_word2
		, a.tk_no, a.tk_co, a.dien_giai, convert(varchar(8), a.ngay_ct, 112) + a.so_ct + a.stt_rec as xgroup
		, a.customize, a.detail' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join dmtk c on a.tk = c.tk order by a.ngay_ct desc, a.so_ct desc, a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
		END
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE VIEW vdmsp2 	AS SELECT * FROM dmvt

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$SO$PostAuthorize]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@action CHAR(1), -- 1 - Approve, 2 - Cancel
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@role VARCHAR(33) = '', -- Direct Approval
	@remoteApprove BIT = 0,
	@CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@voucherApproveLog BIT = 1,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @dyn VARCHAR(32), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(32), @detailTable VARCHAR(32), @inquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @r70 VARCHAR(32), @r90 VARCHAR(32), @hisTable VARCHAR(32), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(128),
		@status VARCHAR(32), @uStatus VARCHAR(32), @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @recordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(32), @lastUser INT, @getMailList_yn BIT, @notifyMail BIT,
		@datetime2 DATETIME, @created_mail_yn BIT, @createdUser INT, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @admin BIT, @roundQuantity INT, @voucherCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @status = '', @uStatus = '', @curStatus = '', @recordHasBeenChanged = '', @notifyMail = 0, @lastUser = 0, @created_mail_yn = 0, @createdUser = 0, @getMailList_yn = 1, @UnitKey = '', @admin = 0, @voucherCode = ''
	SELECT @admin = admin FROM vsysuserinfo WHERE id = @userID
	SELECT @roundQuantity = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Direct Approval(approve by voucher)
	IF @role <> '' SET @getMailList_yn = 0

	-- struct
	SELECT @GeneralTable = '', @MasterTable = '', @DetailTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @HisTable = '', @Dyn = ''
	SELECT @GeneralTable = c$, @MasterTable = m$, @DetailTable = d$, @InquiryTable = i$, @HisTable = a$ FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @GeneralTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @Dyn OUTPUT
		IF RIGHT(@MasterTable, 1) = '$' SET @MasterTable = @MasterTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@DetailTable, 1) = '$' SET @DetailTable = @DetailTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@InquiryTable, 1) = '$' SET @InquiryTable = @InquiryTable + @Dyn
	END


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #listuser select max(stt), user_id4 from ' + @HisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idnumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4 having count(*) % 2 = 1'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC


	-- Get Created User
	SET @q = 'select @u = user_id0 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@u int output', @createdUser OUTPUT


	-- Check remote aprrove
	IF @remoteApprove = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @d = datetime2 from ' + @masterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d datetime output', @datetime2 OUTPUT

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmxn WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber AND user_id = @userID AND datetime2 = @datetime2) BEGIN
			SELECT '1' AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END


	-- Get Role
	IF @role = '' BEGIN
		--
		DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @msg = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END

		--
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #listUser WHERE user_id = @userID) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		--
		SELECT @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilterEx('ma_dvcs', '', @userID, @admin, 'Edit')

		--
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_delete_log' AND val = '1') SET @q = @q + ' and status <> ''*'''
		IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SELECT @q = @q + ' and ' + @UnitKey
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		--
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #role) BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @curStatus = u_status, @CategoryApprove = kieu_duyet FROM #role

		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalRole @voucherType, @userID, @curStatus, @CategoryApprove, @role OUTPUT

		IF @role = '' BEGIN
			SELECT @msg AS message
			SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
			RETURN
		END
	END ELSE SELECT @curStatus = '1'

	-- Get next status
	SELECT @uStatus = CASE WHEN @action = '1' THEN status2 ELSE status0 END, @notifyMail = notify_mail_yn, @created_mail_yn = created_mail_yn FROM sodmquyenct WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND ma_quyen = @role AND status = @curStatus AND kieu_duyet = @CategoryApprove
	SELECT @status = s_status FROM sodmttcttg WHERE u_status = @uStatus AND loai_duyet = @voucherType


	-- Key
	SELECT @key = 'stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''', @Status = REPLACE(@Status, '''', '')


	-- Update table
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set'
	SET @q = @q + ' xtag = status, status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status0 = u_status, u_status = ''' + REPLACE(@UStatus, '''', '') + ''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key
	IF @InquiryTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @GeneralTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where ' + @Key
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @voucherCode = 'DXA' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #master(loai_ct VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ma_tt VARCHAR(32), ma_kh VARCHAR(32))
		DECLARE @loai_ct VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_tt VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32)
		SET @q = 'insert into #master select loai_ct, ngay_ct, ma_tt, ma_kh from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT TOP 1 @loai_ct = loai_ct, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_tt = ma_tt, @ma_kh = ma_kh FROM #master
		SELECT @r70 = 'r70$' + @Dyn, @r90 = 'r90$' + @Dyn
		DROP TABLE #master

		-- After update
		IF @loai_ct <> '2' and @status = '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$AfterUpdate$SO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID

		--  r60
		SET @q = 'update r60$' + @Dyn + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- cddh13
		IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
			DELETE cddh13 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			IF @status IN ('1', '2', '4', '5', '9') AND @ma_tt <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtt WHERE ma_tt = @ma_tt AND han_tt <> 0) INSERT INTO cddh13 SELECT @idNumber, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @Status
		END

		-- Revise
		IF @loai_ct = '3' AND @status = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong AS sl_nhap, so_luong AS sl_xuat INTO #currentStock FROM d64$000000
			SET @q = 'insert into #currentStock select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, 0, sum(round(so_luong * he_so, ' + RTRIM(@roundQuantity) + ')) from ' + @detailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo'
			set @q = @q + CHAR(13) + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock(@r70, @r90, @IDNumber, @voucherCode, 'New', -1)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		-- Inventory
		IF @loai_ct = '3' AND @status = '2' BEGIN
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Posting$Inventory @masterTable, @detailTable, @r70, @IDNumber, @voucherCode,
			'pn_gia_tb, ct_dc, gia_nt01, gia01, gia_nt0, gia0, tien_nt0, tien0, cp_thue_yn',
			'tk_du, ma_nx, so_seri, ma_khon, ma_vi_trin, so_dh2, so_dh3, ma_nv, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dc, so_seri0',
			'gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia_nt21 = b.gia_nt2, gia1 = b.gia, gia21 = b.gia2, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt',
			'', -1, 2
			SET @q = 'insert into r90$' + @Dyn + ' select * from ct90 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END


	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '1', @commentApproval

	-- Reset
	SET @q = '
		declare @minReset int, @stt int
		select @minReset = 0, @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @hisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''

		if exists(select 1 from sodmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @HisTable + '
				where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
					and u_status = ''' + @uStatus + '''
					and stt < @stt
					and stt in (select a.stt from ' + @HisTable + ' a
						join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + @HisTable + ' where reset = 0 and stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'')
			update ' + @HisTable + ' set reset = reset + 1 where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and stt > @minReset
		end'

	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	-- Log
	IF @voucherApproveLog = 1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sodmduyetlai WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType AND u_status = @uStatus and (user_id4 = 0 OR user_id4 = @userID)) BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Log @idNumber, @voucherCode, @Dyn, '1'
	END


	-- Mail
	IF @getMailList_yn = 1 BEGIN
		-- Notify Mail
		IF @notifyMail = 0 SET @lastUser = 0
		-- Created Mail
		IF @created_mail_yn = 0 SET @createdUser = 0

		DECLARE @useNotify CHAR(1), @notifyGroup VARCHAR(32)
		SET @notifyGroup = '05'
		SET @q = 'select @r = status from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifygroup where code = ''' + @notifyGroup + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(1) out', @useNotify OUT

		IF @useNotify = '0' BEGIN
			SELECT '' AS message
			EXEC FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @Dyn, @voucherType, @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser
		END ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE @notifyCode VARCHAR(32), @invoke NVARCHAR(4000)
			CREATE TABLE #mail(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)
			INSERT INTO #mail EXEC FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalMailList @idNumber, @Dyn, @voucherType, @sysDatabaseName, @lastUser, 0, @createdUser

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail) BEGIN
				CREATE TABLE #notifyContent(title NVARCHAR(128), title2 NVARCHAR(128), content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT, ref_code VARCHAR(32), s1 VARCHAR(32), e$ NVARCHAR(4000), [type] TINYINT, popup_title NVARCHAR(1024), popup_title2 NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content2 NVARCHAR(1024))
				EXEC rs_CreateNotifySOTran @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, '#notifyContent'

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 2) BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post @notifyGroup, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
						'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 0',
						null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 2', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

					SET @q = 'update ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser set s1 = ma_nhan, s2 = ma_huy from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser a join dmxn b on a.user_id = b.user_id where a.code = @notifyCode and b.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
					EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@notifyCode varchar(32), @stt_rec char(13)', @notifyCode, @idNumber

					IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
					IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
				END
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #mail WHERE [type] = 1) BEGIN
					EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '12', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
						'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 12',
						null, '#mail', 'user_id', 'type = 1', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

					IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
					IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
				END
			END

			IF @invoke IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SELECT '' AS message, @invoke AS notify
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT '' AS message
			END
			SELECT * FROM #mail
		END
	END


	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO



CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ff_GetInsertGroup]
	(
	@cGroups VARCHAR(128), 
	@cType CHAR(2), 
	@strSum VARCHAR(512), 
	@cTable VARCHAR(18)
	)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS  
BEGIN 
	IF @cGroups = '' RETURN ''
	DECLARE @nStart SMALLINT, @strList VARCHAR(128), @cItemGroup VARCHAR(16), @strReturn NVARCHAR(4000), @cItemGroups VARCHAR(128), @i TINYINT
	DECLARE @cNoGroup NVARCHAR(511), @cNoGroup2 NVARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @cNoGroup = RTRIM(cName), @cNoGroup2 = RTRIM(cName2) FROM reports WHERE UPPER(cCode) = 'NOGROUP'
	SELECT  @nStart = 1, @i = 1, @strList = RTRIM(LTRIM(@cGroups)) + ',', @strReturn = '', @cItemGroups = ''
	SELECT @strReturn = 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX NVARCHAR(511)'
	SELECT @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'ALTER TABLE ' + @cTable + ' ALTER COLUMN ten_XX2 NVARCHAR(511)'
	
	WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @strList, @nStart) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @cItemGroup =  RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@strList, @nStart, CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) - @nStart))) 
			SET @i = @i + 1
			IF @cItemGroups = '' SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroup ELSE SET @cItemGroups = @cItemGroups + ',' + @cItemGroup
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX=SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX),ten_XX2=SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO ' + @cTable + ' (sysorder,sysprint,systotal,ma_XX,ten_XX,ten_XX2,' + @cItemGroups + ',' 
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + @strSum + ') SELECT ' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + ',1,0,' + CHAR(39) + CHAR(39) + ','
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + 'MAX(b.ten_nh),MAX(b.ten_nh2),a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.') + ',SUM(a.' + REPLACE(@strSum, ',', '),SUM(a.') + ')'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' FROM ' + @cTable + ' a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dmnhXX WHERE loai_nh = '
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + RTRIM(CAST(RIGHT(@cItemGroup, 1) AS CHAR)) + ') b ON a.' + @cItemGroup + '=b.ma_nh WHERE a.systotal=1'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + ' GROUP BY a.' + REPLACE(@cItemGroups, ',', ',a.')
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX= N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX2= N' + CHAR(39) + @cNoGroup2 + CHAR(39) + ' WHERE ten_XX2 IS NULL AND systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @strReturn = @strReturn + CHAR(13) + 'UPDATE ' + @cTable + ' SET ten_XX=SPACE(' + RTRIM(CAST(@i AS CHAR)) + '-2) + RTRIM(ten_XX), ten_XX2=SPACE(1) + RTRIM(ten_XX2) WHERE systotal=0 AND NOT ' + @cItemGroup + ' IS NULL'
			SET @nStart = CHARINDEX(',', @strList,  @nStart) + 1
		END
	RETURN REPLACE(@strReturn, 'XX', @cType)
END



GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostPOTran]
	@MasterTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@DetailTable VARCHAR(16), 
	@IDNumber CHAR(13),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')
	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ma_ct CHAR(3), @qtyRound INT, @priceRound INT, @vcNumber CHAR(12), @vcDate SMALLDATETIME, @vendor VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT @qtyRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @priceRound = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_gia'

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.* INTO #master FROM m94$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0
	SELECT a.*, 0 AS sl_dat_tt, 0 AS sl_dat_td, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS ct_gia_pv INTO #detail FROM d94$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	-- Get Data
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select *, 0, 0, '''' from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select * from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SELECT @vcNumber = so_ct, @vcDate = ngay_ct, @vendor = ma_kh FROM #master


	-- Post Price
	DECLARE @external NVARCHAR(512), @masterField NVARCHAR(512), @keys NVARCHAR(512)
	SELECT @keys = 'cn_tt_gia = ''1'' and so_tham_chieu = ''''', @external = 'ma_vt_ncc = c.ma_vt0, status = 1, ncc_tx = 0, tien_nt = c.tien_nt, gia_nt = c.gia_nt, ngay_hl_tu = case when b.loai_ct in(''3'', ''4'') then b.ngay_ct else b.ngay_hl_tu end, ngay_hl_den = case when b.loai_ct in(''3'', ''4'') then null else b.ngay_hl_den end', @masterField = 'ma_ct, so_ct, ma_nt, ma_dvcs, ma_nh0, ma_bp0, ma_kh, ngay_hl_tu, ngay_hl_den, dien_giai, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2'
	EXEC bs_Post2InfoRecord '#master', '#detail', @idNumber, @keys,	@masterField, @external, '0'

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptInDirectCashFlow] -- fs20_CashflowID
	@DateFrom AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousBegin AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@DatePreviousEnd AS SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Form CHAR(16),
	@ReportType CHAR(1), -- 1 - Mau nam, 2 - Mau giua nien do
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Kind CHAR(1), @Ma_so VARCHAR(33), @Cong_no NUMERIC(1, 0), @No_co NUMERIC(1, 0), @Dau_cuoi NUMERIC(1, 0), @Khong_am NUMERIC(1, 0), @Tk VARCHAR(1023), @Tk_du VARCHAR(1023)
		, @Cach_tinh NVARCHAR(1024), @strSql NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @Ky_nay NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truoc NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_naynt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Ky_truocnt NUMERIC(28, 6)
		, @Lk_kn NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kn_nt NUMERIC(28, 6), @Lk_kt_nt NUMERIC(28, 6)

	DECLARE @DateFrom0 SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousBegin0 SMALLDATETIME, @DatePreviousEnd0 SMALLDATETIME, @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME, @xType CHAR(1)
	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @s2 NVARCHAR(4000), @s3 NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @p1 INT, @y1 INT, @p2 INT, @y2 INT, @dStart1 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd1 SMALLDATETIME, @dStart2 SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd2 SMALLDATETIME, @Type VARCHAR(4)

	SELECT @DateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DateFrom), @DateTo0 = @DateFrom - 1, @DatePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@DatePreviousBegin), @DatePreviousEnd0 = @DatePreviousBegin - 1
	SELECT @d1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DateTo, 112) + '01', @d2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DatePreviousEnd, 112) + '01'
	SELECT @d1 = CASE WHEN @d1 < @DateFrom THEN @DateFrom ELSE @d1 END, @d2 = CASE WHEN @d2 < @DatePreviousBegin THEN @DatePreviousBegin ELSE @d2 END

	-- Struct
	SELECT * INTO #report FROM v20gltc6 WHERE form = @Form
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt INTO #ct00Tmp FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, tk_du, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct00 FROM wrkgl
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(4)) AS type INTO #ct004Cust FROM wrkgl
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #tempAccts FROM cdtk
	SELECT TOP 0 tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #tempCusts FROM cdkh
	--
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS type INTO #BgAccts FROM #tempAccts
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS type INTO #EdAccts FROM #tempAccts
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS type INTO #BgCusts FROM #tempCusts
	SELECT TOP 0 *, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(33)) AS type INTO #EdCusts FROM #tempCusts

	-- Check Formula
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$CheckFormula '#report', @UserID, @Admin

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	--
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@UnitKey)

	SET @s = 'insert into #ct00Tmp'
	SET @s = @s + ' select tk, tk_du, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt)'
	SET @s = @s + ' from r00$%Partition with(nolock) where %[status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s = @s + ' group by tk, tk_du, ma_kh'
	--
	SET @s2 = 'insert into #ct00'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' select tk, tk_du, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''@Type'''
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' from pstkdu$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s2 = @s2 + ' group by tk, tk_du'
	--
	SET @s3 = 'insert into #ct004Cust'
	SET @s3 = @s3 + ' select tk, ma_kh, sum(ps_no), sum(ps_co), sum(ps_no_nt), sum(ps_co_nt), ''@Type'''
	SET @s3 = @s3 + ' from pskh$%Partition with(nolock) where %[' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ']%'
	SET @s3 = @s3 + ' group by tk, ma_kh'

	-- Nam nay
	SELECT @Type = 'KN'
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom, @DateTo)
	DELETE #ct00Tmp
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, tk_du
	INSERT INTO #ct004Cust SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s3, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Nam truoc
	SELECT @Type = 'KT'
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin, @DatePreviousEnd)
	DELETE #ct00Tmp
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, tk_du
	INSERT INTO #ct004Cust SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s3, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam nay
	SELECT @Type = 'LKKN'
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DateFrom0, @DateTo0)
	DELETE #ct00Tmp
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, tk_du
	INSERT INTO #ct004Cust SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s3, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Luy ke nam truoc
	SELECT @Type = 'LKKT'
	SELECT @p1 = p1, @y1 = y1, @p2 = p2, @y2 = y2, @dStart1 = dStart1, @dEnd1 = dEnd1, @dStart2 = dStart2, @dEnd2 = dEnd2 FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetArisingDateAndPeriod(@DatePreviousBegin0, @DatePreviousEnd0)
	DELETE #ct00Tmp
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @s, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart2, @dEnd2, @UserID, @Admin
	INSERT INTO #ct00 SELECT tk, tk_du, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, tk_du
	INSERT INTO #ct004Cust SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), @Type FROM #ct00Tmp GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	IF @y1 <> 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @dStart1 = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@p1, @y1), @dEnd1 = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@p2, @y2)
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s2, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
		--
		SET @q = REPLACE(@s3, '@Type', @Type)
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, NULL, @dStart1, @dEnd1, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- Balance
	DECLARE @WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @WhereClause = CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN @UnitKey ELSE '' END

	DELETE #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #tempAccts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DateFrom0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT *, 'DateFrom0' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT *, 'DateFrom' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DateFrom' FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKN' GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #EdAccts SELECT *, 'DateTo' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #EdAccts SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DateTo' FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' GROUP BY tk

	DELETE #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #tempAccts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Account @DatePreviousBegin0, NULL, '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, '', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousBegin0' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousBegin' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DatePreviousBegin' FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKT' GROUP BY tk
	INSERT INTO #EdAccts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousEnd' FROM #tempAccts
	INSERT INTO #EdAccts SELECT tk, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DatePreviousEnd' FROM #ct00 WHERE type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' GROUP BY tk

	SET @WhereClause = @WhereClause + CASE WHEN @WhereClause <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + 'b.tk_cn = 1'

	DELETE #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #tempCusts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DateFrom0, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT *, 'DateFrom0' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT *, 'DateFrom' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DateFrom' FROM #ct004Cust WHERE type = 'LKKN' AND ma_kh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	INSERT INTO #EdCusts SELECT *, 'DateTo' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #EdCusts SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DateTo' FROM #ct004Cust WHERE (type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN') AND ma_kh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk, ma_kh

	DELETE #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #tempCusts EXEC FastBusiness$Balance$Customer @DatePreviousBegin0, NULL, '', '', 1, 2, @UserID, @Admin, 'join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk', @WhereClause
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousBegin0' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousBegin' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DatePreviousBegin' FROM #ct004Cust WHERE type = 'LKKT' AND ma_kh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	INSERT INTO #EdCusts SELECT *, 'DatePreviousEnd' FROM #tempCusts
	INSERT INTO #EdCusts SELECT tk, ma_kh, SUM(ps_no), SUM(ps_co), SUM(ps_no_nt), SUM(ps_co_nt), 'DatePreviousEnd' FROM #ct004Cust WHERE (type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT') AND ma_kh IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY tk, ma_kh
	--

	DECLARE Cal_Cur CURSOR FOR
	SELECT Kind, Ma_so, Cong_no, No_co, Dau_cuoi, Khong_am, Tk, Tk_du, [type] FROM #report WHERE Ma_so <> '' AND kind <> '0'
	OPEN Cal_Cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cal_Cur INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Cong_no, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @xType
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		IF @Kind = '1' BEGIN
			IF @xType = '1' BEGIN
				SELECT @q = '
select @Ky_nay = sum(' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no' ELSE 'ps_co' END + '), @Ky_naynt = sum(' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no_nt' ELSE 'ps_co_nt' END + ') from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DateTo, 112) + ' a with(nolock)
	where (ngay_ct between @d1 and @DateTo) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no + ps_no_nt' ELSE 'ps_co + ps_co_nt' END + ' <> 0) and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
					, N'@d1 smalldatetime, @DateTo smalldatetime, @Tk char(512), @Tk_du char(512), @Ky_nay numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_naynt numeric(28, 6) output'
					, @d1, @DateTo, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Ky_nay OUTPUT, @Ky_naynt OUTPUT
				SELECT @q = '
select @Ky_truoc = sum(' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no' ELSE 'ps_co' END + '), @Ky_truocnt = sum(' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no_nt' ELSE 'ps_co_nt' END + ') from r00$' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @DatePreviousEnd, 112) + ' a with(nolock)
	where (ngay_ct between @d2 and @DatePreviousEnd) and status = ''1''' + CASE WHEN @UnitKey IS NOT NULL THEN ' and ' + @UnitKey ELSE '' END + ' and (' + CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN 'ps_no + ps_no_nt' ELSE 'ps_co + ps_co_nt' END + ' <> 0) and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk, @Tk) = 1 and dbo.ff_Inlist(tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q
					, N'@d2 smalldatetime, @DatePreviousEnd smalldatetime, @Tk char(512), @Tk_du char(512), @Ky_truoc numeric(28, 6) output, @Ky_truocnt numeric(28, 6) output'
					, @d2, @DatePreviousEnd, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Ky_truoc OUTPUT, @Ky_truocnt OUTPUT
				UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = @Ky_nay, Ky_truoc = @Ky_truoc, Ky_naynt = @Ky_naynt, Ky_truocnt = @Ky_truocnt, Lk_kn = @Ky_nay, Lk_kt = @Ky_truoc, Lk_kn_nt = @Ky_naynt, Lk_kt_nt = @Ky_truocnt WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
				GOTO Next
			END
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KN' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Lk_kn = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Lk_kn_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKN' OR type = 'KN' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END ELSE 0 END)
				FROM #ct00
				WHERE (type = 'KN' OR type = 'LKKN')
					AND CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no + ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co + ps_co_nt END <> 0
					AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1

			SELECT @Ky_truoc = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Ky_truocnt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'KT' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Lk_kt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no ELSE ps_co END ELSE 0 END)
				, @Lk_kt_nt = SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'LKKT' OR type = 'KT' THEN CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co_nt END ELSE 0 END)
				FROM #ct00
				WHERE (type = 'KT' OR type = 'LKKT')
					AND CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN ps_no + ps_no_nt ELSE ps_co + ps_co_nt END <> 0
					AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1 AND dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk_du, @Tk_du) = 1
		END

		IF @Kind = '2' AND @Cong_no = 0 AND @Dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(
					CASE
						WHEN @No_co = 1 AND @Khong_am = 0 THEN Du_no - Du_co
						WHEN @No_co = 1 AND @Khong_am = 1 THEN dbo.ff_Max(Du_no - Du_co, 0)
						WHEN @No_co = 2 AND @Khong_am = 0 THEN Du_co - Du_no
						WHEN @No_co = 2 AND @Khong_am = 1 THEN dbo.ff_Max(Du_co - Du_no, 0)
						ELSE 0
					END
					)
				, @Ky_naynt = SUM(
					CASE
						WHEN @No_co = 1 AND @Khong_am = 0 THEN Du_no_nt - Du_co_nt
