									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) ELSE 0 END AS du_co_nt
								FROM #EdAccts
								WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1
								GROUP BY dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_Inlist2(Tk, @Tk))
							) a
				END

				IF @Kind = '2' AND @Cong_no = 1 AND @Dau_cuoi = 1 BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN Du_no ELSE Du_co END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN Du_no_nt ELSE Du_co_nt END)
						FROM (
							SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(du_no) - SUM(du_co) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_no) - SUM(du_co) ELSE 0 END AS du_no
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_co) - SUM(du_no) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_co) - SUM(du_no) ELSE 0 END AS du_co
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_no_nt) - SUM(du_co_nt) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_no_nt) - SUM(du_co_nt) ELSE 0 END AS du_no_nt
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) ELSE 0 END AS du_co_nt
								FROM #BgCusts
								WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1
								GROUP BY dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_Inlist2(Tk, @Tk)), ma_kh
							) a
				END

				IF @Kind = '2' AND @Cong_no = 1 AND @Dau_cuoi = 2 BEGIN
					SELECT @Ky_nay = SUM(CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN Du_no ELSE Du_co END)
						, @Ky_naynt = SUM(CASE WHEN @No_co = 1 THEN Du_no_nt ELSE Du_co_nt END)
						FROM (
							SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(du_no) - SUM(du_co) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_no) - SUM(du_co) ELSE 0 END AS du_no
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_co) - SUM(du_no) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_co) - SUM(du_no) ELSE 0 END AS du_co
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_no_nt) - SUM(du_co_nt) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_no_nt) - SUM(du_co_nt) ELSE 0 END AS du_no_nt
									, CASE WHEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) >= 0 THEN SUM(du_co_nt) - SUM(du_no_nt) ELSE 0 END AS du_co_nt
								FROM #EdCusts
								WHERE dbo.ff_Inlist(Tk, @Tk) = 1
								GROUP BY dbo.ff_GetWordNum(@Tk, dbo.ff_Inlist2(Tk, @Tk)), ma_kh
							) a
				END

				UPDATE #report SET Ky_nay = ISNULL(@Ky_nay, 0), Ky_naynt = ISNULL(@Ky_naynt, 0) WHERE Ma_so = @Ma_so
Next:
				FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Kind, @Ma_so, @Cong_no, @No_co, @Dau_cuoi, @Khong_am, @Tk, @Tk_du, @Type
			END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c

		UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = - ky_nay, ky_naynt = - ky_naynt WHERE dau = 0

		-- Scan bảng mẫu các chỉ tiêu công thức
		DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT Ma_so, Cach_tinh FROM #report WHERE Cach_tinh <> '' AND kind = '0' ORDER BY ids
		OPEN c
		FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET ky_nay = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Cach_tinh)), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 ky_nay FROM #report WHERE Ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q

			SET @q = 'UPDATE #report SET ky_naynt = ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Cach_tinh)), '[', '(SELECT TOP 1 ky_naynt FROM #report WHERE Ma_so = '''), ']', ''')') + ' WHERE ma_so = ''' + RTRIM(@Ma_so) + ''''
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetFormulaExecuteCheck(@q)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
			--
			FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @Ma_so, @Cach_tinh
		END
		CLOSE c
		DEALLOCATE c
		-- End - Tính dữ liệu từng kỳ

		-- Tính số dư đầu kỳ cho kỳ sau
		IF @i < @PeriodNo BEGIN
			-- Đầu kỳ tài khoản
			TRUNCATE TABLE #BgAccts
			INSERT INTO #BgAccts SELECT * FROM #EdAccts

			-- Đầu kỳ khách hàng
			TRUNCATE TABLE #BgCusts
			INSERT INTO #BgCusts SELECT * FROM #EdCusts
		END

		-- Insert vào bảng kết quả
		INSERT INTO #result SELECT @i, stt, in_ck, CASE WHEN cach_tinh = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, ky_naynt, ky_nay FROM #report

		SELECT @d = DATEADD(Day, 1, @d2), @i = @i + 1
	END

	-- View
	SELECT sysorder, sysprint, systotal, REPLACE(STR(sysorder, 5), ' ', '0') + ma_so AS xRow, REPLACE(STR(xPeriod, 3), ' ', '0') AS period, @periodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(xPeriod) AS xcol, chi_tieu, ma_so, ma_so_in, bold, ky_naynt, ky_nay
		FROM #result ORDER BY xPeriod, sysorder, ma_so

	-- Pivot
	SElECT xPeriod AS id, CASE WHEN @ReportForm = '10' THEN 'ky_nay$' ELSE 'ky_naynt$' END + RTRIM(xPeriod) AS name, @periodName + SPACE(1) + RTRIM(xPeriod) AS header
		FROM #result GROUP BY xPeriod ORDER BY xPeriod

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptGoodsTransferInOutSituation]
	@DateReport SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@TransferNoFrom VARCHAR(33),
	@TransferNoTo VARCHAR(33),
	@Item VARCHAR(33),
	@SourceSite VARCHAR(33),
	@DestinationSite VARCHAR(33),
	@GroupBy VARCHAR(33),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@DataType CHAR(1),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @UnitKey NVARCHAR(1023), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @SourceSiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @pKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Split BIT
	DECLARE @i INT, @iCount INT, @p VARCHAR(6), @d1 SMALLDATETIME, @d2 SMALLDATETIME
	
	SELECT @GroupBy = CASE WHEN RTRIM(@GroupBy) = '1' THEN  'stt_rec' ELSE 'ma_vt' END
	-- Physics
	DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
	SELECT @pKey = REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') SELECT @Split = 1 ELSE SELECT @Split = 0

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 CAST('' AS VARCHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon, status, ma_ct, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt1 as dvt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, nxt INTO #tmp FROM r70$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 *, sl_xuat - sl_nhap AS sl_cl INTO #report FROM #tmp

	-- UnitKey
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = 'ct_dc = 1 and nxt = 2', @q = ''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'ma_kho', @SourceSite, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SourceSiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SourceSiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SourceSiteKey

	IF @TransferNoFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@TransferNoFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @TransferNoTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@TransferNoTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @Item <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_vt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Item), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @SourceSite <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@SourceSite), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @DestinationSite <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ma_khon like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DestinationSite), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	--
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- PXB
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon, status, ma_ct, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, nxt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @pKey
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Split = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon, status, ma_ct, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, nxt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	-- PNF
	SET @Key = 'ct_dc = 1 and nxt = 1 and exists(select 1 from #tmp b where left(b.stt_rec, 10) = left(a.stt_rec, 10) and b.ma_vt = a.ma_vt)' -- stt_rec_dc in (select stt_rec from #tmp)
	IF @DataType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, null, '''', '''', '''', status, '''', '''', ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, nxt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateReport, @UserID, @Admin

		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @pKey
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType <> 1 OR @Split = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, null, '''', '''', '''', status, '''', '''', ma_vt, dvt1, sl_nhap1, sl_xuat1, nxt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
		SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateReport, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	--
	UPDATE #tmp SET stt_rec = REPLACE(REPLACE(stt_rec, 'PNF', 'PXB'), 'PNI', 'PXI')

	-- Result
	INSERT INTO #report
		SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ma_dvcs), MAX(ngay_ct), MAX(so_ct)
				, MAX(ma_kho), MAX(ma_khon), MAX(status), MAX(ma_ct), MAX(dien_giai), ma_vt, dvt
				, SUM(sl_nhap), SUM(sl_xuat), MAX(nxt), SUM(sl_xuat) - SUM(sl_nhap)
			FROM #tmp GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_vt, dvt
	--
	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#report', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- Exists
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		INSERT INTO #report (stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho, ma_khon, status, ma_ct, dien_giai, ma_vt, dvt, sl_nhap, sl_xuat, sl_cl)
			VALUES('', '', NULL, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 0)

	-- View
	SET @q = 'select a.stt_rec, a.ma_dvcs, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.ma_kho, a.ma_khon, a.ma_ct, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.sl_nhap, a.sl_xuat, a.sl_cl, c.ma_ct_in as ma_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'b.ten_vt' ELSE 'b.ten_vt2' END + ' as ten_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' from #report a left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmct c on a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct order by a.' + @GroupBy
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_UnPostPOAuthorizeHeaders] -- fs_UnPostPOAuthorizeHeaders 
	@UserID INT, 
	@typeVoucher CHAR(1), -- 1 Đơn hàng trong nước, 2 Đơn hàng nhập khẩu
	@IDNumber CHAR(13)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @IDNumber = REPLACE(@IDNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(33), @MasterTable VARCHAR(33), @DetailTable VARCHAR(33), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(33), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	SELECT @Dyn = '', @MasterTable = '', @InquiryTable = ''

	IF @typeVoucher = '1' BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c94$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber		
		IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
			SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
			SET @MasterTable = 'm94$' + @Dyn
			SET @DetailTable = 'd94$' + @Dyn
			SET @InquiryTable = 'i94$' + @Dyn
			IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
				EXEC  FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID
				SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''1'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''	
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c94$000000 set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
			END			
		END		
	END	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @VoucherDate = ngay_ct FROM c95$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @IDNumber
		IF (ISNULL(@VoucherDate, '') <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmstt WHERE @VoucherDate BETWEEN ngay_gh1 AND ngay_gh2)) BEGIN
			SET @Dyn = CONVERT(CHAR(6), @VoucherDate, 112)
			SET @MasterTable = 'm95$' + @Dyn
			SET @DetailTable = 'd95$' + @Dyn
			SET @InquiryTable = 'i95$' + @Dyn
			IF @Dyn <> '' BEGIN
				EXEC  FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$PO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID
				SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable + ' set status = ''1'', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@UserID) + ', datetime2 = GETDATE() where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update c95$000000 set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''1'' where stt_rec = ''' + @IDNumber + ''''
			END			
		END		
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpWithExpiredContract]
	@ContractDateFrom SMALLDATETIME, -- Ngay ky hop dong tu
	@ContractDateTo SMALLDATETIME, -- Ngay ky hop dong den
	@EfectDateFrom SMALLDATETIME, -- Ngay het hieu luc tu
	@EfectDateTo SMALLDATETIME, -- Ngay het hieu luc den
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@ContractType VARCHAR(1024),
	@Type CHAR(1), -- 1: Hợp đồng chính thức, 2: Tthử việc
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT, 
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @JointUnit BIT, @JointDept BIT

	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$DeptRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, 'e', 'e', @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT, @JointUnit OUTPUT, @JointDept OUTPUT
	
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + '(ngay_hl_den between ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @EfectDateFrom, 112) + ''' and ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @EfectDateTo, 112) + ''')'
	IF @ContractDateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ky_hd >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ContractDateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @ContractDateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_ky_hd <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @ContractDateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @ContractType <> ''
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.loai_hd in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(@ContractType), '''', ''''''), ' ', ''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	ELSE
		SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.tinh_chat = ' + RTRIM(@Type)

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department), 'a.', 'e.')
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and e.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and e.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''
	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and e.status = ''1'''

	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS ten_nv, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS bo_phan, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(1024)) AS vi_tri
			, b.ngay_hl_tu AS ngay_bd_hl, b.ngay_hl_den AS ngay_kt_hl, c.ten_loai AS loai_hd, a.stt, a.stt AS stt_sx, 1 AS xtype
		INTO #report FROM hrnv a, hrcthd b, hrdmloaihd c

	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report(stt_rec, ma_nv, ten_nv, bo_phan, vi_tri, ngay_bd_hl, ngay_kt_hl, loai_hd, stt, stt_sx, xtype)'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' select a.stt_rec, e.ma_nv, rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv), b.ten_bp%l, c.ten_vtr%l, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, d.ten_loai%l, e.stt, 0, 0'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from hrcthd a with(nolock) left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrbp b with(nolock) on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrvt c with(nolock) on e.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr left join hrdmloaihd d with(nolock) on a.loai_hd = d.ma_loai'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' where ' + @Key + ' order by e.ma_nv, a.ngay_ky_hd'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	
	-- Order
	SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS stt, stt_rec INTO #o FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec, ma_nv, stt ORDER BY stt, ma_nv
	UPDATE #report SET stt = b.stt, stt_sx = b.stt FROM #report a JOIN #o b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	SELECT stt_rec, MIN(ngay_bd_hl) AS ngay_bd_hl INTO #o2 FROM #report GROUP BY stt_rec
	UPDATE #report SET xtype = 1 FROM #report a JOIN #o2 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec AND a.ngay_bd_hl = b.ngay_bd_hl
	UPDATE #report SET stt = NULL, ma_nv = '', ten_nv = '', bo_phan = '', vi_tri = '' WHERE xtype = 0

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #report)
		SELECT NULL AS stt, '' AS ma_nv, '' AS ten_nv, '' AS bo_phan, '' AS vi_tri, null AS ngay_bd_hl, null AS ngay_kt_hl, '' AS loai_hd
	ELSE
		SElECT a.stt, a.ma_nv, a.ten_nv, a.bo_phan, a.vi_tri, a.ngay_bd_hl, a.ngay_kt_hl, a.loai_hd FROM #report a ORDER BY a.stt_sx

	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vhrccyc]
AS
SELECT a.ma_bp, b.ten_bp, b.ten_bp2, a.vi_tri, c.ten_vtr, c.ten_vtr2, a.ma_cc, d.ten_cc, d.ten_cc2, a.so_luong, a.ngay_hl, a.ghi_chu, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2
	FROM hrccyc a LEFT JOIN hrbp b ON a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp
		LEFT JOIN hrvt c ON a.vi_tri = c.ma_vtr
		LEFT JOIN hrcc d ON a.ma_cc = d.ma_cc

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptSalesInvoiceList] --fs_SORecvTransList--
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@InvoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@InvoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@Salesman VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@SalesAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@ItemAccount VARCHAR(32),
	@Group1 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group2 VARCHAR(32),
	@Group3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Reason VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@Contract VARCHAR(32),
	@Department VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@TransactionCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(1024),
	@FilterType CHAR(1),
	@Form CHAR(1),
	@Size TINYINT,
	@Order VARCHAR(1024),
	@DataType TINYINT,
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@TransactionList VARCHAR(4000) = '',
	@Controller VARCHAR(128) = '',
	@SysDB VARCHAR(64) = '',
	@TableName VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 CHAR(3), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @SiteKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ma_vt, ma_nx, ma_kho, gia, gia_nt, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ma_kh, tk_dt, ma_vv, ma_hd, ma_bp, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, ma_ct, dvt1 AS dvt
			, sl_xuat AS so_luong, tien_xuat AS tien, tien_nt_x AS tien_nt, gia2, gia_nt2, tien2, tien_nt2, ck, ck_nt, thue, thue_nt, tien2 AS pt, tien_nt2 AS pt_nt, line_nbr
		INTO #detail FROM wrkin

	-- Dynamic
	DECLARE @baseFields NVARCHAR(4000), @baseAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @totalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumTotalFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumFields NVARCHAR(4000), @sumAliasFields NVARCHAR(4000), @queryJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @baseJoin NVARCHAR(4000), @filterKey NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicFields '#detail', @TableName, @controller, @SysDB, @Language, 0, @baseFields OUTPUT, @baseAliasFields OUTPUT, @totalFields OUTPUT, @sumTotalFields OUTPUT, @sumFields OUTPUT, @sumAliasFields OUTPUT, @queryJoin OUTPUT, @baseJoin OUTPUT
	SELECT @baseFields = REPLACE(@baseFields, '%a', 'a'), @baseAliasFields = REPLACE(@baseAliasFields, '%a', 'a'), @sumTotalFields = REPLACE(@sumTotalFields, '%a.', ''), @sumFields = REPLACE(@sumFields, '%a', 'a'), @queryJoin = REPLACE(@queryJoin, '%a', 'a'), @baseJoin = REPLACE(@baseJoin, '%a', 'a')

	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.nxt = ''' + RTRIM(@Form) + ''''
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetSiteFilter 'a.ma_kho', @Site, @UnitKey, @UserID, @Admin, @SiteKey OUTPUT

	IF @SiteKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @SiteKey

	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Salesman <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nvbh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Salesman), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Contract <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_hd like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Contract), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Department <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_bp like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Department), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ItemAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_vt', 'like', @ItemAccount)
	IF @SalesAccount <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk_dt', 'like', @SalesAccount)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey
	IF @TransactionCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_gd in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@TransactionCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	EXEC rs_GetTransactionKey @VoucherCode, @TransactionList, 0, @Controller, @SysDB, 'a.', @Key OUTPUT
	--
	IF @Group1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt1 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group1), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt2 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group2), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Group3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and b.nh_vt3 like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Group3), '''', '''''') + '%'''

	EXEC FastBusiness$Report$GetDynamicKey @TableName, @filterKey OUTPUT
	IF @filterKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' ELSE '' END + REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(@filterKey, ''), '%[a]', 'a'), '%[dmvt]', 'b')
	--
	IF @Group1 + @Group2 + @Group3 <> '' OR CHARINDEX('%[dmvt]', @filterKey) > 0 SET @Join = ' left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)


	SET @q = 'insert into #detail select stt_rec, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.gia$, a.gia_nt$'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.ma_kh, a.tk_dt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct, a.dvt1'
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Form = '1' THEN ', a.sl_nhap$, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_nt_n' ELSE ', a.sl_xuat$, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_x'	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.gia2$, a.gia_nt2$, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', (a.tien2 + a.thue - a.ck) AS pt, (a.tien_nt2 + a.thue_nt - a.ck_nt) AS pt_nt, a.line_nbr' + CASE WHEN @baseAliasFields <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + @baseAliasFields

	IF @DataType >= 3
		SET @q = REPLACE(@q, '$', '1')
	ELSE
		SET @q = REPLACE(REPLACE(@q, 'a.dvt1', 'null'), '$', '')

	IF @DataType = '1' OR @DataType = '3' BEGIN
		DECLARE @q2 NVARCHAR(4000)
		SET @q2 = @q + ' from r90$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + @queryJoin
		SET @q2 = @q2 + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q2, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

		-- Physics
		DECLARE @k NVARCHAR(4000)
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$Report$GetPhysicsKey @k OUTPUT, @DataType, @Unit, @UserID, @Admin
		SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + REPLACE(@k, '%a', 'a')
		SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	END
	IF @DataType = '2' OR @DataType = '4' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_instock_split' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		SET  @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @Join + @queryJoin
		SET  @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
		EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	END

	IF @FilterType = '1'
		DELETE #detail WHERE ma_vt NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@Item) + '%') AND stt_rec NOT IN (SELECT stt_rec FROM #detail WHERE ma_vt LIKE (RTRIM(@Item) + '%'))
	ELSE
		DELETE #detail WHERE ma_vt NOT LIKE (RTRIM(@Item) + '%')

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	UPDATE #detail SET gia_nt = 0, tien_nt = 0, gia_nt2 = 0, tien_nt2 = 0, ck_nt = 0, thue_nt = 0, pt_nt = 0
		WHERE ma_nt = '' OR ma_nt = @m_ma_nt0

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #detail) INSERT INTO #detail (stt_rec, ma_ct) VALUES ('', '')

	DECLARE @Statement NVARCHAR(4000)
	EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#detail', @Controller, 1, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Statement OUTPUT
	IF @Statement <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @Statement

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #detail set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END
	--

	SET @q = 'select 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, stt_rec as rp_group, b.ma_ct_in'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.stt_rec, a.ma_vt, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_kh, a.tk_dt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_hd, a.ma_bp, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.ma_ct'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.so_luong, a.tien, a.tien_nt, a.gia2, a.gia_nt2, a.tien2, a.tien_nt2, a.ck, a.ck_nt, a.thue, a.thue_nt, a.pt, a.pt_nt'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_kh, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'c.ten_kh2' ELSE ''''' as ten_kh2' END
	SET @q = @q + ', ISNULL(a.dvt, d.dvt) AS dvt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN 'd.ten_vt' ELSE '''''' END + ' as ten_vt, ' + CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN 'd.ten_vt2' ELSE ''''' as ten_vt2' END + CASE WHEN @baseFields <> '' THEN ',' + @baseFields ELSE '' END
	SET @q = @q + ' from #detail a left join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join dmvt d on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt' + @baseJoin
	SET @q = @q + ' order by ' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(@Order) = '' THEN '1' ELSE @Order END + ', a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_DeleteMultipleVouchers]
	@dateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@dateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@invoiceFrom VARCHAR(32),
	@invoiceTo VARCHAR(32),
	@voucherCode VARCHAR(32),
	@currencyCode VARCHAR(32),
	@unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@dataSource CHAR(1),
	@userYN INT,
	@size TINYINT,
	@userID INT,
	@admin BIT,
	@language VARCHAR(32),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @unitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @l CHAR(1), @controller VARCHAR(128), @access TINYINT, @siteKey VARCHAR(1024), @iTable VARCHAR(64), @oTable VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @purOrg TINYINT, @purGr TINYINT, @plant TINYINT, @purOrgKey NVARCHAR(4000), @purGrKey NVARCHAR(4000), @plantKey NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @inspection TINYINT, @inspectionKey NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @l = CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END, @siteKey = '', @oTable = ''
	SELECT @q = 'declare @controller varchar(128)
select @controller = sysid from ' + REPLACE(@sysDatabaseName, '''', '''''') + '..command where syscode = ''' + REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', '''''') + '''
select @access = ' + REPLACE(@sysDatabaseName, '''', '''''') + '.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetAuthorize (@admin, @userID, @controller, ''Access'')
'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@admin bit, @userID int, @access tinyint output', @admin, @userID, @access OUTPUT

	-- Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report (stt_rec VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, so_ct VARCHAR(32), ma_dvcs VARCHAR(32), status CHAR(1), ma_kh VARCHAR(32), ten_kh NVARCHAR(512), ma_ncc VARCHAR(32), ten_ncc NVARCHAR(512), ma_tn VARCHAR(32), ten_tn NVARCHAR(512), ma_kho_x VARCHAR(32), ma_kho_n VARCHAR(32), tien NUMERIC(28, 6), ma_nt VARCHAR(32), ty_gia NUMERIC(24, 12), dien_giai NVARCHAR(512), trang_thai NVARCHAR(128))
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kbctxoa WHERE xscript <> '' AND xcode = @voucherCode AND status = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @q = xscript FROM kbctxoa WHERE xcode = @voucherCode
		EXEC sp_executesql @q,
			N'@dateFrom smalldatetime, @dateTo smalldatetime, @invoiceFrom varchar(32), @invoiceTo varchar(32), @voucherCode varchar(32), @currencyCode varchar(32), @unit varchar(1024), @dataSource varchar(1), @userYN int, @size tinyint, @userID int, @admin bit, @language varchar(32)',
			@dateFrom, @dateTo, @invoiceFrom, @invoiceTo, @voucherCode, @currencyCode, @unit, @dataSource, @userYN, @size, @userID, @admin, @language
		GOTO Result
	END

	IF @admin = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode AND xin_site_rights = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @iTable = RTRIM(i$), @iTable = @iTable + CASE WHEN RIGHT(@iTable, 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
		SELECT @siteKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetSiteKey(@voucherCode, @userID, 0)
	END
	IF @admin = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql N'select @purOrg = x_pur_org, @purGr = x_pur_group, @plant = x_plant, @inspection = x_inspection from dmct where ma_ct = @voucherCode', N'@voucherCode varchar(32), @purOrg tinyint output, @purGr tinyint output, @plant tinyint output, @inspection tinyint output', @voucherCode, @purOrg OUTPUT, @purGr OUTPUT, @plant OUTPUT, @inspection OUTPUT
		SELECT @purOrg = ISNULL(@purOrg, 0), @purGr = ISNULL(@purGr, 0), @plant = ISNULL(@plant, 0), @inspection = ISNULL(@inspection, 0)
		IF @admin = 0 AND ISNULL(@iTable, '') = '' AND (@purOrg = 2 OR @purGr = 2 OR @plant = 2 OR @inspection = 2) SELECT @iTable = RTRIM(i$), @iTable = @iTable + CASE WHEN RIGHT(@iTable, 1) = '$' THEN '%Partition' ELSE '' END FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	END

	--
	SELECT TOP 1 @q = 'insert into #report(' + fields_browse + ') select ' + fields_data + ' from ' + xtable + ' a ' + xref, @oTable = t$ FROM kbctxoa WHERE xcode = @voucherCode
	IF @iTable <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' join ' + @iTable + ' on a.stt_rec = ' + @iTable + '.stt_rec'
	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', @l)

	-- Key
	SET @key = 'a.status <> ''*'''
	SET @key = @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from dmstt b where (a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_gh1) or (a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_gh2) or (a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks))'
	SET @key = @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from dmctks b where b.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' and b.ma_ct = ''' + REPLACE(@voucherCode, '''', '''') + ''' and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks)'
	SET @key = @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from dmdvcsks b where a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks)'
	SET @key = @key + ' and not exists (select 1 from sysdaterules b where b.user_id = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' and ((b.ngay_ct1 is not null and a.ngay_ct < b.ngay_ct1) or (b.ngay_ct2 is not null and a.ngay_ct > b.ngay_ct2)))'
	IF @dataSource IN ('1', '2') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE name = @oTable AND xtype = 'U') SET @key = @key + ' and ' + CASE WHEN @dataSource = '1' THEN '' ELSE ' not ' END + 'exists (select 1 from ' + @oTable+ ' b where a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec)'
	IF @InvoiceFrom <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct >= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceFrom), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @InvoiceTo <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.so_ct <= ''' + dbo.ff_PadL(REPLACE(RTRIM(@InvoiceTo), '''', ''''''), @Size) + ''''
	IF @currencyCode <> '' SET @key = @key + ' and a.ma_nt like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@currencyCode), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @userYN = 1 SET @key = @key + ' and a.user_id0 = ' + RTRIM(@userID)
	IF ISNULL(@siteKey, '') <> '' SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @siteKey
	SET @unitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('a.ma_dvcs', @unit, @userID, @admin)
	IF @unitKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @unitKey
	--
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_mode' AND val = '1') BEGIN
		IF @admin = 0 AND @purOrg <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @purOrgKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurOrgFilter('a.ma_bp0', '', @UserID, @Admin)
			IF @purOrgKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @purOrgKey
		END
		IF @admin = 0 AND @purGr <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @purGrKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPurGroupKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, @Admin, @purGr)
			IF @purGrKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@purGrKey, '(ma_nh0', '(a.ma_nh0')
		END
		IF @admin = 0 AND @plant <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @plantKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetPlantKey(@VoucherCode, @UserID, @Admin, @plant)
			IF @plantKey <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + REPLACE(@plantKey, '(ma_vung', '(a.ma_vung')
		END
		IF @admin = 0 AND @inspection <> 0 BEGIN
			SET @inspectionKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$BI$GetInspectionFilter('a.ma_nguon', '', @UserID, @Admin)
			IF @inspectionKey IS NOT NULL SET @key = @key + CASE WHEN @key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + @inspectionKey
		END
	END
	--
	SET @key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@key)
	IF @key <> '' SELECT @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'

	IF @dataSource = '1' AND ISNULL(@oTable, '') = '' SELECT @access = 0
	IF @access = 1 EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, null, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 0 AS tag, a.*, @voucherCode AS ma_ct FROM #report a ORDER BY ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec

	Result:
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE VIEW vgltcpt01
AS	
	SELECT * FROM gltcpt01 UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM gltcpt01th)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vcddtqt3]
AS
	SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT a.*, d.ten_dtqt, d.ten_dtqt2
		FROM cddtqt3 a JOIN dmtk b ON a.tk = b.tk JOIN dmdvcs c ON a.ma_dvcs = c.ma_dvcs JOIN dmdtqt3 d ON a.ma_dtqt = d.ma_dtqt
		WHERE a.nam = (SELECT TOP 1 nam_bd FROM dmstt) AND b.status = '1' AND c.status = '1' AND d.status = '1'
		ORDER BY a.nam, a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_dtqt

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$SalesInvoice$Site]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32), 
	@Field VARCHAR(32), 
	@CustomerID VARCHAR(32), 
	@VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Term VARCHAR(32), 
	@Currency VARCHAR(32), 
	@Item VARCHAR(32), 
	@Site VARCHAR(32), 
	@UOM NVARCHAR(32), 
	@Quantity NUMERIC(28, 6), 
	@Rate NUMERIC(28, 6),
	@Stock NUMERIC(28, 5) = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF @Rate = 0 SELECT @Rate = he_so FROM dmqddvt WHERE dvt = @UOM AND (ma_vt = @Item OR ma_vt = '*')
	SELECT @Rate = ISNULL(@Rate, 1)

	DECLARE @ItemAccount VARCHAR(32), @LocationInput BIT
	SELECT @LocationInput = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvitri WHERE ma_kho = @Site) SELECT @LocationInput = 1

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmkho WHERE ma_kho = @Site AND dai_ly_yn = 1 AND ma_dvcs = @UnitCode) BEGIN
		SELECT @ItemAccount = RTRIM(tk_dl) FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		SELECT @ItemAccount = ISNULL(@ItemAccount, '')
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item AND sua_tk_vt = 0)
			SELECT @ItemAccount = tk_vt FROM dmvt WHERE ma_vt = @Item
		ELSE
			SELECT @ItemAccount = ''			
	END
	CREATE TABLE #SalesPrices (gia_ban_nt NUMERIC(28, 12), gia_nt2 NUMERIC(28, 12), ck_nt NUMERIC(28, 6))
	INSERT INTO #SalesPrices EXEC fs_GetSOPrice @Field, @VoucherCode, @VoucherDate, @Term, @Currency, @CustomerID, @Item, @Site, @UOM, @Quantity, @Rate

	SELECT @Rate AS he_so, gia_ban_nt, gia_nt2, ck_nt, RTRIM(@ItemAccount) AS tk_vt, @LocationInput AS vi_tri_yn, @Stock AS stock FROM #SalesPrices

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[hs_rptEmpEducation]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, 
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Department VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@DeptGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@EmpGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Position VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup1 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup2 VARCHAR(33),
	@PosGroup3 VARCHAR(33),
	@Level VARCHAR(33),
	@Gender CHAR(1),
	@Type CHAR(1),
	@AcademicStandard VARCHAR(33),
	@EducationMajor VARCHAR(33),
	@GraduationFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@GraduationTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@EmployeeStatus VARCHAR(33),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Join NVARCHAR(4000), @Male NVARCHAR(15), @Female NVARCHAR(15)	
	SELECT @Male = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM001'
	SELECT @Female = CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN RTRIM(cname) ELSE RTRIM(cname2) END FROM reports WHERE ccode = 'HRM002'

	--Struct
	CREATE TABLE #report(ma_tdhv VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ma_cn VARCHAR(32), ngay_tot_nghiep SMALLDATETIME, truong_hoc NVARCHAR(512))
			
	-- Key
	SELECT @Key = '', @Join = ''
	IF @Admin = 0 EXEC FastBusiness$HRM$AccessRightFilter @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @Key OUTPUT
	SELECT @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + CASE WHEN @EmployeeStatus <> ''  THEN 'a.tinh_trang_nv in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@EmployeeStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'a.status <> ''0''' END

	IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @DateTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_vao <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @DateTo, 112) + ''''
	IF @Position <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.vi_tri = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Position), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Gender <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.gioi_tinh = ''' + REPLACE(@Gender, '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @Type <> '*' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.ngay_chinh_thuc ' + CASE WHEN @Type = '1' THEN 'is not null' ELSE 'is null' END
	IF @Level <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.bac_quan_ly = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Level), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @EmpGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @EmpGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and a.nh_nv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EmpGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ma_tdhv <> '''''
	IF @AcademicStandard <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ma_tdhv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@AcademicStandard), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @EducationMajor <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ma_cn like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@EducationMajor), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @GraduationFrom IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ngay_tot_nghiep >= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @GraduationFrom, 112) + ''''
	IF @GraduationTo IS NOT NULL SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and %a.ngay_tot_nghiep <= ''' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), @GraduationTo, 112) + ''''

	IF @Department <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and ' + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$HRM$GetDeptRightKey(@Department)

	IF @DeptGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @DeptGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and c.nh_bp3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@DeptGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''

	IF @PosGroup1 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup2 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @PosGroup3 <> '' SELECT @Key = @Key + ' and d.nh_vtr3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@PosGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
		
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)
	
	-- Join
	IF @DeptGroup1 + @DeptGroup2 + @DeptGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join hrbp c on a.bo_phan = c.ma_bp'
	IF @PosGroup1 + @PosGroup2 + @PosGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = @Join + ' left join hrvt d on a.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr'
	
	-- @q
	SELECT @q = 'insert into #report (ma_tdhv, stt_rec, ma_nv, ma_cn, ngay_tot_nghiep, truong_hoc) select a.ma_tdhv, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, a.ma_cn, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, a.truong_hoc from hrnv a with(nolock) ' + @Join + ' where ' + REPLACE(@Key, '%a', 'a')
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) + ' insert into #report (ma_tdhv, stt_rec, ma_nv, ma_cn, ngay_tot_nghiep, truong_hoc) select r.ma_tdhv, r.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, r.ma_cn, r.ngay_tot_nghiep, r.truong_hoc from hrehv r join hrnv a with(nolock) on r.stt_rec = a.stt_rec ' + @Join
	SELECT @q = @q + CHAR(13) +  ' where r.stt_rec + r.ma_tdhv + r.ma_cn not in (select stt_rec + ma_tdhv + ma_cn from #report) and (' + REPLACE(@Key, '%a', 'r') + ')'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	CREATE TABLE #result(ma_tdhv VARCHAR(48), ma_tdhv0 VARCHAR(32), stt_rec CHAR(13), ma_nv VARCHAR(32), ma_cn VARCHAR(32), ngay_tot_nghiep SMALLDATETIME, truong_hoc NVARCHAR(512), stt INT NOT NULL IDENTITY (1, 1))
	INSERT INTO #result(ma_tdhv, ma_tdhv0, stt_rec, ma_nv, ma_cn, ngay_tot_nghiep, truong_hoc)
		SELECT STR(b.stt, 16) + a.ma_tdhv, a.ma_tdhv, stt_rec, ma_nv, ma_cn, ngay_tot_nghiep, truong_hoc FROM (
			SELECT ma_tdhv, stt_rec, ma_nv, ma_cn, ngay_tot_nghiep, truong_hoc FROM #report
			UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ma_tdhv, '', '', '', NULL, '' FROM #report
		) a JOIN hrdmtdhv b ON a.ma_tdhv = b.ma_tdhv ORDER BY b.stt, a.ma_tdhv, a.ma_nv

	SELECT stt, ma_tdhv INTO #order FROM #result WHERE ma_nv = ''

	SELECT @q = 'select a.stt - o.stt as stt, a.ma_tdhv, a.stt_rec, a.ma_nv, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when a.ma_nv = '''' then f.ten_tdhv%l else rtrim(e.ho_nv) + '' '' + rtrim(e.ten_nv) end as ho_ten_nv, e.ngay_vao, e.bo_phan, e.tinh_trang_nv, e.vi_tri, a.truong_hoc, a.ma_cn, a.ngay_tot_nghiep, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'b.ten_bp%l as ten_bp, c.ten_ttnv%l as ten_ttnv, d.ten_vtr%l as ten_vi_tri, f.ten_tdhv%l as ten_tdhv, '
	SELECT @q = @q + 'case when e.gioi_tinh = ''1'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Male, '''', '''''') + ''' when e.gioi_tinh = ''2'' then N''' + REPLACE(@Female, '''', '''''') + ''' else '''' end as gioi_tinh'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' from #result a join #order o on a.ma_tdhv = o.ma_tdhv left join hrnv e on a.stt_rec = e.stt_rec left join hrbp b on e.bo_phan = b.ma_bp left join hrdmttnv c on e.tinh_trang_nv = c.ma_ttnv'
	SELECT @q = @q + ' left join hrvt d on e.vi_tri = d.ma_vtr left join hrdmtdhv f on a.ma_tdhv0 = f.ma_tdhv order by a.ma_tdhv, a.ma_nv'

	SELECT @q = REPLACE(@q, '%l', CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN '' ELSE '2' END)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$GetNotify]
	@notifyGroup VARCHAR(32),
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@masterTable VARCHAR(32),
	@detailTable VARCHAR(32),
	@pushNotify BIT,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT,
	@userID INT,
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@tableDataName VARCHAR(128),
	@invoke NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', ''), @tableDataName = REPLACE(@tableDataName, '''', ''), @notifyGroup = REPLACE(@notifyGroup, '''', ''), @sysDatabaseName = REPLACE(@sysDatabaseName, '''', '')

	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @useNotify CHAR(1), @notifyCode VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @useNotify = '0', @notifyCode = ''
	CREATE TABLE #APVNotifyData(id INT, stt_rec CHAR(13), [user_id] INT, [type] INT)


	SET @q = 'select @r = status from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifygroup where code = ''' + @notifyGroup + ''''
	SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'insert into #APVNotifyData(id, stt_rec, user_id, type) select id, stt_rec, user_id, type from ' + QUOTENAME(@tableDataName)
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(1) out', @useNotify OUT

	IF @useNotify <> '0' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #APVNotifyData) BEGIN
			DECLARE @notifyStored VARCHAR(512)
			SELECT @notifyStored = notify_stored FROM(SELECT notify_group, notify_stored FROM dmloaiduyet UNION SELECT notify_group, notify_stored FROM gndmloaiduyet UNION SELECT notify_group, notify_stored FROM sodmloaiduyet) a WHERE notify_group = @notifyGroup
			IF @notifyGroup = '04' SELECT @notifyStored = 'rs_CreateNotifyPITran'

			CREATE TABLE #notifyContent(title NVARCHAR(128), title2 NVARCHAR(128), content NTEXT, content2 NTEXT, ref_code VARCHAR(32), s1 VARCHAR(32), e$ NVARCHAR(4000), [type] TINYINT, popup_title NVARCHAR(1024), popup_title2 NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content NVARCHAR(1024), popup_content2 NVARCHAR(1024))
			IF @notifyGroup NOT IN ('18', '19') BEGIN
				SET @q = 'exec ' + @notifyStored + ' @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, ''#notifyContent'''
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @masterTable varchar(64), @detailTable varchar(64)', @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @q = 'exec ' + @notifyStored + ' @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, ''#notifyContent'', @sysDatabaseName'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@idNumber varchar(32), @masterTable varchar(64), @detailTable varchar(64), @sysDatabaseName varchar(128)', @idNumber, @masterTable, @detailTable, @sysDatabaseName
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #APVNotifyData WHERE [type] = 2) BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post @notifyGroup, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
					'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 0',
					null, '#APVNotifyData', 'user_id', 'type = 2', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

				SET @q = 'update ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser set s1 = ma_nhan, s2 = ma_huy from ' + @sysDatabaseName + '..notifyuser a join dmxn b on a.user_id = b.user_id where a.code = @notifyCode and b.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
				EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@notifyCode varchar(32), @stt_rec char(13)', @notifyCode, @idNumber

				IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
				IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
			END
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #APVNotifyData WHERE [type] = 1) BEGIN
				EXEC FastBusiness$Notify$Post '12', null, null, null, null, null, null, null, '#notifyContent',
					'title, title2, subtitle, subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'title, title2, @subtitle, @subtitle2, content, content2, ref_code, s1, e$, popup_title, popup_title2, popup_content, popup_content2', 'isnull(type, 0) = 12',
					null, '#APVNotifyData', 'user_id', 'type = 1', @userID, @sysDatabaseName, @notifyCode OUT

				IF @pushNotify = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'NotifyPush.NotifyMain.Push(' + @notifyCode + ',)'
				IF @pushNotifyDevice = 1 SET @invoke = ISNULL(@invoke, '') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@invoke, '') <> '' THEN '&' + CHAR(255) + ';' ELSE '' END + 'PushNotifyFCM.PushNotify.SendMessageListID(0, ' + @notifyCode + ', ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')'
			END
		END
	END
	DROP TABLE #APVNotifyData

	-- Remind
	EXEC FastBusiness$APV$Remind$GetMail @idNumber, @sysDatabaseName, @invoke OUTPUT

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptMaterialTransactionListByJob]	-- fs_MaterialTransListByJob
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Reason VARCHAR(32),
	@Site VARCHAR(32),
	@Customer VARCHAR(32),
	@ParentJob VARCHAR(32),
	@Job VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup1 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup2 VARCHAR(32),
	@JobGroup3 VARCHAR(32),
	@Unit VARCHAR(32),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@PrintType TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(1024), @Join NVARCHAR(1024), @q NVARCHAR(4000)

	-- Key
	SELECT @Join = '', @Key = 'a.status = ''1'' and a.ma_vv <> '''' and a.ma_ct <> ''HD2'''
	IF @Reason <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_nx like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Reason), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Site <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kho like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Site), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Customer), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @ParentJob <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and (dbo.ff_IsRelationJob(''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@ParentJob), '''', '''''') + ''', a.ma_vv) = 1)'
	IF @Job <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_vv like ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@Job), '''', '''''') + '%'''
	IF @JobGroup1 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv1 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup1), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup2 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv2 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup2), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and nh_vv3 = ''' + REPLACE(RTRIM(@JobGroup3), '''', '''''') + ''''
	IF @JobGroup1 + @JobGroup2 + @JobGroup3 <> '' SET @Join = ' left join dmvv c on a.ma_vv = c.ma_vv'
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho
		, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_nhap, a.sl_xuat, a.tien_nhap, a.tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n, a.tien_nt_x
	INTO #tmp FROM wrkin a

	SET @q = 'insert into #tmp select a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, ' + CASE WHEN @PrintType = 1 THEN 'a.so_ct0' ELSE '''''' END + ', a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.sl_xuat AS sl_xuat'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.tien_nhap AS tien, a.tien_xuat AS tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_x'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)' + @join
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, @Unit, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	SELECT 5 as sysorder, 1 as sysprint, 1 as systotal, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(9)) AS stt
		, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0, a.ma_ct, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vv, a.ma_nx, a.ma_kho
		, a.ma_nt, a.ty_gia, a.dien_giai, a.tk_vt, a.gia, a.gia_nt, a.sl_nhap AS so_luong, a.sl_xuat AS sl_xuat, a.tien_nhap AS tien
		, a.tien_xuat AS tien_xuat, a.tien_nt_n AS tien_nt, a.tien_nt_x AS tien_nt_x, b.dvt, c.stt_ct_nkc, c.ma_ct_in AS ma_ct0
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE '' END AS ten_vt, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vt2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vt2
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_kh ELSE '' END AS ten_kh, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_kh2 ELSE '' END AS ten_kh2
		, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vv ELSE '' END AS ten_vv, CASE WHEN @Language <> 'V' THEN ten_vv2 ELSE '' END AS ten_vv2
	INTO #report FROM #tmp a LEFT JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct LEFT JOIN dmkh d ON a.ma_kh = d.ma_kh LEFT JOIN dmvv e ON a.ma_vv = e.ma_vv

	SET @q = dbo.ff_GetAlterFieldsNull('#report', 'stt, stt_rec, stt_rec0', 'NUMERIC(9), CHAR(13), CHAR(3)')
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	EXEC FastBusiness$System$UpdateOrderField 'ma_vv', 'ma_vv, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, ma_vt, stt_rec, line_nbr', '#report', 'stt', ''

	INSERT INTO #report (sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, ten_vv, ten_vv2, so_luong, sl_xuat, tien, tien_nt, tien_xuat, tien_nt_x)
		SELECT 0, 0, 0, a.ma_vv, a.ma_vv
			, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
			, MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv, '')), MAX(ISNULL(ten_vv2, ''))
			, SUM(a.so_luong) AS so_luong, SUM(a.sl_xuat) AS sl_xuat
			, SUM(a.tien) AS tien, SUM(a.tien_nt) AS tien_nt
			, SUM(a.tien_xuat) AS tien_xuat, SUM(a.tien_nt_x) AS tien_nt_x
		FROM #report a
		GROUP BY a.ma_vv

	INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv) SELECT 6, 0, 0, ma_vv FROM #report GROUP BY ma_vv

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #report) INSERT INTO #report(sysorder, sysprint, systotal, ma_vv) SELECT 6, 0, 0, ''

	-- EInvoice
	IF @PrintType = 1 BEGIN
		DECLARE @InvoiceCodes VARCHAR(1024)
		SELECT @InvoiceCodes = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ct_hddt'
		SELECT @q = 'update #report set so_ct0 = '''' where ma_ct not in(' + @InvoiceCodes + ')'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	--
	SET @q = 'select ma_vv as rp_group, * from #report order by ma_vv, sysorder, stt, ngay_ct, ma_ct0, so_ct, so_ct0, stt_rec, line_nbr'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Balance$CustomerUnit]
	@Date SMALLDATETIME, 
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Account VARCHAR(33),
	@Customer VARCHAR(33),
	@BalanceType TINYINT, -- 1 - Begining, 2 - Closing
	@ResultType TINYINT, -- 1 One Account, 2 Multi Account
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@JoinClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N'',
	@WhereClause NVARCHAR(4000) = N''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @y INT, @p0 INT, @y0 INT, @dStart SMALLDATETIME, @dEnd SMALLDATETIME
	SELECT @y = y, @y0 = y0, @p0 = p0, @dStart = dStart, @dEnd = dEnd FROM dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetBalanceDateAndPeriod(@Date, @BalanceType)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, du_no00 AS du_no, du_co00 AS du_co, du_no_nt00 AS du_no_nt, du_co_nt00 AS du_co_nt INTO #t FROM cdkh

	SELECT @Key = '', @UnitKey = NULL
	IF @Unit IS NOT NULL SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @UnitKey
	IF @Customer <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh like ''' + REPLACE(@Customer, '''', '''''') + '%'''
		ELSE SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + 'a.ma_kh is not null'
	IF @Account <> '' SET @Key = @Key + CASE WHEN @Key = '' THEN '' ELSE ' and ' END + dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetAccountFilter('a.tk', 'like', @Account)

	-- Balance (year)
	IF @y <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh a with (nolock, index(nam_tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where a.nam = ' + STR(@y, 4)
		SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Balance (period)
	IF @y0 <> 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.du_no00), sum(a.du_co00), sum(a.du_no_nt00), sum(a.du_co_nt00)'
		SET @q = @q + ' from cdkh$' + STR(@y0, 4) + REPLACE(STR(@p0, 2), ' ', '0') + ' a with (nolock, index(tk_ma_kh)) '
		IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
		SET @q = @q + ' where 1 = 1'
		IF @Key <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @Key
		IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
		SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END

	-- Arising
	SET @q = 'insert into #t select a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh, sum(a.ps_no), sum(a.ps_co), sum(a.ps_no_nt), sum(a.ps_co_nt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r00$%Partition a with (nolock, index(tk_ma_kh)) '
	IF @JoinClause <> '' SET @q = @q + @JoinClause
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[a.status = ' + CHAR(39) + '1' + CHAR(39)
	SET @q = @q + CASE WHEN @Key <> '' THEN ' and ' + @Key ELSE '' END
	IF @WhereClause <> '' SET @q = @q + ' and ' + @WhereClause
	SET @q = @q + ']% group by a.ma_dvcs, a.tk, a.ma_kh'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @dStart, @dEnd, @UserID, @Admin
	
	Result:
	IF @ResultType = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, isnull(sum(du_no - du_co), 0) as du, isnull(sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt), 0) as du_nt from #t group by ma_dvcs order by ma_dvcs'
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh, case when sum(du_no - du_co) > 0 then sum(du_no - du_co) else 0 end as du_no, case when sum(du_co - du_no) > 0 then sum(du_co - du_no) else 0 end as du_co'
		SET @q = @q + ', case when sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) > 0 then sum(du_no_nt - du_co_nt) else 0 end as du_no_nt, case when sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) > 0 then sum(du_co_nt - du_no_nt) else 0 end as du_co_nt'
		SET @q = @q + ' from #t group by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh order by ma_dvcs, tk, ma_kh'
	END
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RETURN
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptPrintPVTranExport]
	@DateFrom SMALLDATETIME,
	@DateTo SMALLDATETIME,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1023),
	@Code VARCHAR(4000),
	@Bilingual TINYINT, -- 0: Standard Form, 1: BI Form
	@View TINYINT, -- 1: Pdf, 2: Excel
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@SysDB VARCHAR(32),
	@extMasterSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extMasterJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@extDetailSelect NVARCHAR(2048) = '''',
	@extDetailJoin NVARCHAR(2048) = '',
	@OrderType CHAR(1) = '1' -- 0: options c_011, 1: ASC, 2: DESC
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	DECLARE @m_ma_nt0 VARCHAR(10), @key NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @s NVARCHAR(4000), @f NVARCHAR(4000), @NumberRecord NVARCHAR(128), @nCount INT, @i INT, @Desc INT
	DECLARE @stt_rec VARCHAR(33), @tk_vt VARCHAR(511), @tk_du VARCHAR(511)
	SELECT @Language = REPLACE(RTRIM(@Language), '''', ''), @s = '', @q = '', @f = ''

	SELECT @m_ma_nt0 = REPLACE(RTRIM(val), '''', '') FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	IF @Code = '' BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #$keys WHERE DATALENGTH(text) < 2049) SELECT @Code = CAST(text AS VARCHAR(2048)) FROM #$keys
	END
	SELECT @Key = CASE WHEN @Code <> '' THEN 'a.stt_rec in(''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Code, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')' ELSE 'exists(select 1 from #$keys where patindex(''%'' + a.stt_rec + ''%'', text) > 0)' END
	SET @Key = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetCheckKey(@Key)

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0
			, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ngay_ct0, a.tk, c.ten_tk, c.ten_tk2
			, a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt
			, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word
			, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_in_word2, a.dien_giai AS t_tien_nt_in_word2
			, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id AS ma_bp, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba AS contact_sign
			, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS ngay, CAST('' AS CHAR(2)) AS thang, CAST('' AS CHAR(4)) AS nam
			, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS customize
		INTO #master FROM m71$000000 a, dmkh b, dmtk c

	SELECT TOP 0 b.line_nbr, b.ma_vt, b.dvt, b.ma_kho, b.tk_vt, b.so_luong, b.gia, b.tien, c.ten_vt, c.ten_vt2, a.*, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS detail
		INTO #detail FROM #master a, d71$000000 b, dmvt c

	-- Master
	SET @q = 'insert into #master select a.stt_rec, a.ong_ba, a.ma_kh, b.ten_kh, b.ten_kh2, b.dia_chi, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, a.so_ct0'
	SET @q = @q + ', convert(varchar,a.ngay_ct0, 103), ltrim(a.tk), isnull(c.ten_tk,''''), isnull(c.ten_tk2,'''')'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.t_tien0, a.t_tien_nt0, a.t_cp, a.t_cp_nt, a.t_thue, a.t_thue_nt, a.t_tt, a.t_tt_nt'
	IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''' + @Language + ''')'
		SET @q = @q + ', '''', '''''
	END ELSE IF @Bilingual = 1 BEGIN
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''V'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(''' + @m_ma_nt0 + ''', a.t_tt, ''E'')'
		SET @q = @q + ', dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(a.ma_nt, a.t_tt_nt, ''E'')'
	END
	SET @q = @q + ', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_nk, a.ma_ct, a.loai_ct, a.dept_id, a.datetime0, a.user_id0, a.ong_ba , replace(str(day(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as ngay, replace(str(month(a.ngay_ct), 2), '' '', ''0'') as thang, rtrim(year(a.ngay_ct)) as nam'
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extMasterSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extMasterSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from m71$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmkh b with(nolock) on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh'
	SET @q = @q + ' left join dmtk c with(nolock) on a.tk = c.tk'
	IF @extMasterJoin <> '' SET @q = @q + ' ' + REPLACE(@extMasterJoin, '$partition$current', '%Partition')
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Detail
	SET @q = 'insert into #detail'
	SET @q = @q + ' select a.line_nbr, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.ma_kho, a.tk_vt, a.so_luong, a.gia, a.tien, b.ten_vt, b.ten_vt2'
	SET @q = @q + ', a.stt_rec, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', '''', null, null, '''', '''', '''', '''', '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', ' + CASE WHEN @extDetailSelect = '''' THEN '''''' ELSE @extDetailSelect END
	SET @q = @q + ' from d71$%Partition a with(nolock) left join dmvt b with(nolock) on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @key + ']%'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin

	-- Empty Row
	DECLARE @nEmptyRow INT
	SELECT @nEmptyRow = max_row FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'PNA'
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Dynamic$InsertEmptyRow '#detail', @nEmptyRow, 'line_nbr', 'stt_rec'

	--
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct, so_ct = b.so_ct
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN (SELECT stt_rec, MAX(ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct, MAX(so_ct) AS so_ct FROM #master GROUP BY stt_rec) b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	UPDATE #detail
		SET ngay = b.ngay, thang = b.thang, nam = b.nam, ong_ba = b.ong_ba, ma_kh = b.ma_kh, ten_kh = b.ten_kh, ten_kh2 = b.ten_kh2
				, dia_chi = b.dia_chi, tk = b.tk, ten_tk = b.ten_tk, ten_tk2 = b.ten_tk2, so_ct0 = b.so_ct0, ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0
			FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE line_nbr = 1
	UPDATE #detail SET t_tien0 = b.t_tien0, t_tien_nt0 = b.t_tien_nt0, t_cp = b.t_cp, t_cp_nt = b.t_cp_nt
			, t_thue = b.t_thue, t_thue_nt = b.t_thue_nt, t_tt = b.t_tt, t_tt_nt = b.t_tt_nt, t_tien_in_word = b.t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word = b.t_tien_nt_in_word
			, t_tien_in_word2 = b.t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2 = b.t_tien_nt_in_word2
		FROM #detail a LEFT JOIN #master b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(line_nbr, 5), ' ', '0') IN (SELECT stt_rec + REPLACE(STR(MAX(line_nbr), 5), ' ', '0') FROM #detail GROUP BY stt_rec)

	-- PQGT đầu vào.
/*
	 EXEC FastBusiness$System$GetUpdateValueFields '#detail', @Controller, 3, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @SysDB, @q OUTPUT, 2
	IF @q <> '' EXEC sp_executesql @q
*/
	-- View
	IF @View = 1 BEGIN
		IF ((@OrderType = '0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM options WHERE name = 'c_011' AND val = '1')) OR @OrderType = '2') SELECT @Desc = 1 ELSE SELECT @Desc = 0
		EXEC dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignMulti '#master', '#detail', '', 'PNA', @Bilingual, @Language, @UserID, @Admin, @f OUTPUT

		IF @Bilingual = 0 BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup
		, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, ten_vt, ten_vt2, line_nbr, customize, detail
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup
		, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, ten_vt, ten_vt2, line_nbr, customize, detail
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		END ELSE BEGIN
			IF @Desc = 0
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup
		, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr, customize, detail
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct, so_ct, stt_rec, line_nbr'
			ELSE
				SELECT @q = '
select stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
		, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt
		, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, t_tien_in_word2, t_tien_nt_in_word2
		, ngay, thang, nam, convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct, 112) + so_ct + stt_rec as xgroup
		, ma_vt, ten_vt, ten_vt2, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, line_nbr, customize, detail
		' + CASE WHEN @f <> '' THEN ',' ELSE '' END + RTRIM(@f) + '
	from #detail order by ngay_ct desc, so_ct desc, stt_rec, line_nbr'
		END
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT stt_rec, ong_ba, ma_kh, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_ct0, ngay_ct0, tk, ten_tk, ten_tk2
				, t_tien0, t_tien_nt0, t_cp, t_cp_nt, t_thue, t_thue_nt, t_tt, t_tt_nt, t_tien_in_word, t_tien_nt_in_word, ngay, thang, nam, customize
			FROM #master
		SELECT line_nbr, ma_vt, dvt, ma_kho, tk_vt, so_luong, gia, tien, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN ten_vt ELSE ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt, detail
			FROM #detail ORDER BY line_nbr
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rs_rptEnvironmentalProtectionTaxDeclaration] --fs20_VATDeclaration28--
	@MonthFrom INT,
	@MonthTo INT,
	@Year INT,
	@Circular INT,
	@Unit VARCHAR(1024),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(128),
	@Language CHAR(1),
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	-- Declare
	DECLARE @DateFrom SMALLDATETIME, @DateTo SMALLDATETIME, @UnitKey NVARCHAR(4000), @q NVARCHAR(4000), @Key NVARCHAR(4000), @Round INT
	SELECT @DateFrom = dbo.ff_GetStartDateOfCycle(@MonthFrom, @Year), @DateTo = dbo.ff_GetEndDateOfCycle(@MonthTo, @Year)
	SELECT @Round = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_tl'

	-- Struct
	SELECT TOP 0 b.ma_ct, a.ma_vt, a.ma_pl, a.dvt, sl_xuat1 AS sl_hd, sl_xuat1 AS so_luong, sl_nhap1 AS sl_nhap1, sl_nhap AS sl_nhap, b.thue AS thue_mt INTO #report FROM dmkbtmt a, wrkin b
	SELECT ma_vt, ma_pl, dvt, muc_thue, ngay_hl, ty_le INTO #dmkbtmt FROM dmkbtmt a WHERE loai = '2' AND ngay_hl = (SELECT MAX(ngay_hl) FROM dmkbtmt b WHERE b.loai = '2' AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND b.ngay_hl <= @DateTo)
	SELECT TOP 0 IDENTITY (INT, 1, 1) AS stt, a.ma_vt, a.dvt, a.muc_thue, so_luong, a.ty_le, b.thue_mt INTO #result FROM #dmkbtmt a, #report b

	DELETE #dmkbtmt FROM #dmkbtmt a WHERE ngay_hl < (SELECT MAX(ngay_hl) FROM #dmkbtmt b WHERE a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt)

	-- Unit Key
	SET @UnitKey = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$GetUnitFilter('ma_dvcs', @Unit, @UserID, @Admin)

	SET @Key = 'exists (select 1 from #dmkbtmt b where a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt) and a.thue_mt <> 0'
	IF @VoucherCode <> '' SET @Key = @Key + ' and a.ma_ct in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@VoucherCode, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + ''')'
	IF @UnitKey IS NOT NULL SET @Key = @Key + ' and ' + @UnitKey

	SET @q = ' insert into #report select a.ma_ct, a.ma_vt, '''', a.dvt1, sum(sl_xuat1), sum(sl_xuat), sum(sl_nhap1), sum(sl_nhap), sum(thue_mt)'
	SET @q = @q + ' from r70$%Partition a with(nolock)'
	SET @q = @q + ' where %[' + @Key + ']%'
	SET @q = @q + ' group by a.ma_ct, a.ma_vt, a.dvt1'
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @DateFrom, @DateTo, @UserID, @Admin
	UPDATE #report SET so_luong = -sl_nhap, sl_hd = -sl_nhap1, thue_mt = -thue_mt WHERE sl_nhap <> 0
	UPDATE #report SET ma_pl = b.ma_pl FROM #report a LEFT JOIN dmkbtmt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt

	IF @Circular = '5' BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #result
			SELECT b.ma_pl, MAX(b.dvt), MAX(b.muc_thue) AS muc_thue
				, SUM(ROUND(a.so_luong/ISNULL(c.he_so, 1), @Round)), MAX(b.ty_le), SUM(a.thue_mt)
				FROM #report a JOIN #dmkbtmt b ON a.ma_pl = b.ma_pl AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmqddvt c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND b.dvt = c.dvt
					GROUP BY b.ma_pl
					HAVING SUM(a.so_luong) <> 0
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result) SELECT 0 AS stt, '' AS ma_vt, '' AS dvt, 0 AS muc_thue, 0 AS so_luong, 0 AS ty_le, 0 AS thue_mt, '' AS ten_vt
			ELSE SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_pl ELSE b.ten_pl2 END AS ten_vt FROM #result a JOIN dmpltmt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_pl
	END ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #result
			SELECT a.ma_vt, MAX(b.dvt), ROUND((MAX(b.muc_thue) * MAX(b.ty_le) /100), @Round) AS muc_thue
				, SUM(ROUND(a.so_luong/ISNULL(c.he_so, 1), @Round)), MAX(b.ty_le), SUM(a.thue_mt)
				FROM #report a JOIN #dmkbtmt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt LEFT JOIN dmqddvt c ON b.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND b.dvt = c.dvt
					GROUP BY a.ma_vt
					HAVING SUM(a.so_luong) <> 0
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #result) SELECT 0 AS stt, '' AS ma_vt, '' AS dvt, 0 AS muc_thue, 0 AS so_luong, 0 AS ty_le, 0 AS thue_mt, '' AS ten_vt
			ELSE SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN @Language = 'V' THEN b.ten_vt ELSE b.ten_vt2 END AS ten_vt FROM #result a JOIN dmvt b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt
	END
	--
	SELECT SUM(thue_mt) AS t_thue FROM #result

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$APV$SO$UnPostAuthorize]
	@voucherType VARCHAR(32),
	@userID INT,
	@idNumber CHAR(13),
	@sysDatabaseName VARCHAR(128),
	@language VARCHAR(32),
	@pushNotify BIT = 0,
	@pushNotifyDevice BIT = 0,
	@commentApproval NVARCHAR(4000) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	SELECT @idNumber = REPLACE(@idNumber, '''', '')

	DECLARE @Dyn VARCHAR(32), @GeneralTable VARCHAR(32), @MasterTable VARCHAR(32), @DetailTable VARCHAR(32), @InquiryTable VARCHAR(32), @r70 VARCHAR(32), @r90 VARCHAR(32), @HisTable VARCHAR(32), @VoucherDate SMALLDATETIME,
		@q NVARCHAR(4000), @Status VARCHAR(32), @UStatus VARCHAR(32), @RecordHasBeenChanged VARCHAR(32), @lastUserID INT, @xtype CHAR(1),
		@lastApproveUser INT, @curStatus VARCHAR(32), @dept VARCHAR(32), @FC VARCHAR(3), @amount NUMERIC(19, 3), @userID0 INT, @role VARCHAR(32), @CategoryApprove VARCHAR(32), @datetime4 DATETIME, @nextUStatus VARCHAR(32)
		, @roundQuantity INT, @voucherCode VARCHAR(32), @existsInvoice INT

	SELECT @Status = '', @RecordHasBeenChanged = '', @lastApproveUser = 0, @voucherCode = ''
	SELECT @roundQuantity = CAST(val AS TINYINT) FROM options WHERE lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'
	SELECT @voucherCode = ma_ct FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Struct
	SELECT @GeneralTable = '', @MasterTable = '', @DetailTable = '', @InquiryTable = '', @HisTable = '', @Dyn = ''
	SELECT @GeneralTable = c$, @MasterTable = m$, @DetailTable = d$, @InquiryTable = i$, @HisTable = a$ FROM sodmloaiduyet WHERE loai_duyet = @VoucherType
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'select @p = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from ' + @GeneralTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@p char(6) output', @Dyn OUTPUT
		IF RIGHT(@MasterTable, 1) = '$' SET @MasterTable = @MasterTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@DetailTable, 1) = '$' SET @DetailTable = @DetailTable + @Dyn
		IF RIGHT(@InquiryTable, 1) = '$' SET @InquiryTable = @InquiryTable + @Dyn
	END


	--
	CREATE TABLE #a(user_id4 INT, xtype VARCHAR(32), datetime4 DATETIME)
	SET @q = 'insert into #a select top 1 user_id4, xtype, datetime4 from ' + @HisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' order by stt desc'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT @lastUserID = user_id4, @xtype = xtype, @datetime4 = datetime4 FROM #a


	-- Get history approval list
	CREATE TABLE #listUser(stt INT, user_id INT)
	SET @q = 'insert into #listUser select a.stt, a.user_id4 from ' + @HisTable + ' a join (select stt_rec, max(stt) as stt from ' + @HisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and user_id4 <> ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ' group by stt_rec, user_id4) b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.stt = b.stt and a.xtype = ''1'''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q
	SELECT TOP 1 @lastApproveUser = user_id FROM #listUser ORDER BY stt DESC

	DECLARE @notCheckStatus VARCHAR(32)
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = '9'
	SELECT @notCheckStatus = @notCheckStatus + ',' + status from dmctduyet WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode

	-- Get old status
	IF @lastUserID = @userID AND @xtype = '1' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #role(u_status VARCHAR(32), u_status0 VARCHAR(32), user_id0 INT, kieu_duyet VARCHAR(32))
		SET @q = 'insert into #role select u_status, u_status0, user_id0, kieu_duyet from ' + @masterTable + ' with(nolock) where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and (datetime2 = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), @datetime4, 121) + ''' or status in (''' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@notCheckStatus, ' ', ''), '''', ''''''), ',', ''',''') + '''))'
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT @nextUStatus = u_status, @UStatus = u_status0, @userID0 = user_id0, @CategoryApprove = kieu_duyet FROM #role
		EXEC FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalRole @voucherType, @lastUserID, @UStatus, @CategoryApprove, @role OUTPUT
	END

	--
	IF @UStatus IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Bạn chưa có hoặc chưa được phân quyền thực hiện chức năng này.' ELSE 'You do not have permission to perform this action, please contact your administrator.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Exist Order
	SELECT @q = 'select @existsInvoice = 1 from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and sl_dh <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@existsInvoice int output', @existsInvoice = @existsInvoice OUTPUT
	IF @existsInvoice IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Hợp đồng đã được chuyển sang đơn hàng, không thực hiện được.' ELSE 'A order has been created from this blanket order, it is not able to process.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check Exist Invoice
	SELECT @q = 'select @existsInvoice = 1 from ' + @DetailTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''' and sl_hd <> 0'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@existsInvoice int output', @existsInvoice = @existsInvoice OUTPUT
	IF @existsInvoice IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SELECT CASE WHEN @language = 'V' THEN N'Đơn hàng đã được chuyển sang hóa đơn, không thực hiện được.' ELSE 'A billing has been created from this order, it is not able to process.' END AS message
		SELECT '' AS stt_rec, 0 AS userID, 0 AS xtype
		RETURN
	END
	-- Before Update
	IF @voucherCode = 'DXA' BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #master(loai_ct VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(32), ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, ma_tt VARCHAR(32), ma_kh VARCHAR(32))
		DECLARE @loai_ct VARCHAR(32), @ngay_ct SMALLDATETIME, @ma_tt VARCHAR(32), @ma_kh VARCHAR(32)
		SET @q = 'insert into #master select loai_ct, status, ngay_ct, ma_tt, ma_kh from ' + @MasterTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q
		SELECT TOP 1 @loai_ct = loai_ct, @status = status, @ngay_ct = ngay_ct, @ma_tt = ma_tt, @ma_kh = ma_kh FROM #master
		SELECT @r70 = 'r70$' + @Dyn, @r90 = 'r90$' + @Dyn
		DROP TABLE #master

		-- Before update
		IF @loai_ct <> '2' AND @status = '2' EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$BeforeUpdate$SO @MasterTable, @DetailTable, @IDNumber, 'Edit', @UserID

		-- Delete revise
		IF @loai_ct = '3' AND @status = '2' BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong AS sl_nhap, so_luong AS sl_xuat INTO #currentStock FROM d64$000000
			SET @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock(@r70, @r90, @IDNumber, @voucherCode, 'Delete', -1)
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END


		-- Delete inventory
		IF @loai_ct = '3' AND @status = '2' BEGIN
			DELETE ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			SET @q = 'delete ' + @r90 + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END
	END

	SELECT @status = '0'
	SELECT @Status = s_status FROM sodmttcttg WHERE u_status = @UStatus AND loai_duyet = @voucherType

	-- Update
	SET @q = 'update ' + @MasterTable
	SET @q = @q + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''', u_status = ''' + @UStatus + ''', u_status0 = '''''
	SET @q = @q + ', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate(), user_id3 = ' + RTRIM(@lastApproveUser) + ''
	SET @q = @q + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @InquiryTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' +  @InquiryTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	IF @GeneralTable <> '' SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'update ' + @GeneralTable + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
	EXEC sp_executesql @q

	IF @voucherCode = 'DXA' BEGIN
		-- r60
		SET @q = 'update r60$' + @Dyn + ' set status = ''' + @Status + ''', user_id2 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ', datetime2 = getdate() where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + ''''
		EXEC sp_executesql @q

		-- cddh13

		IF @loai_ct = '1' BEGIN
			DELETE cddh13 WHERE stt_rec = @idNumber
			IF @status IN ('1', '2', '4', '5', '9') AND @ma_tt <> '' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dmtt WHERE ma_tt = @ma_tt AND han_tt <> 0) INSERT INTO cddh13 SELECT @idNumber, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @Status
		END
	END

	-- History
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$Voucher$ApprovalHistory @idNumber, @masterTable, @HisTable, '2', @commentApproval

	-- Reset
	SET @q = '
		declare @minReset int, @stt int
		select @minReset = 0, @stt = 0
		select @stt = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @hisTable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + @idNumber + '''
		if exists(select 1 from sodmduyetlai where loai_duyet = ''' + @voucherType + ''' and u_status = ''' + @nextUStatus + ''' and (user_id4 = 0 or user_id4 = ' + RTRIM(@userID) + ')) begin
			select @minReset = isnull(max(stt), 0) from ' + @HisTable + '
