CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[FastBusiness$Voucher$SFC$Item]
	@UnitCode VARCHAR(32),
	@Item VARCHAR(32),
	@VoucherCode VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@UserID INT = 0,
	@Admin BIT = 0,
	@Routing VARCHAR(32) = '',
	@Operation VARCHAR(32) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @UOM NVARCHAR(32), @Rate NUMERIC(28, 6), @LotNumber VARCHAR(32)

	SELECT a.dvt, a.lo_yn, a.tao_lo, a.nhieu_dvt INTO #Item FROM dmvt a WHERE ma_vt = @Item
	SELECT @UOM = dvt, @Rate = 1 FROM #Item

	CREATE TABLE #LotNumber (ma_lo VARCHAR(32))
	INSERT INTO #LotNumber EXEC fs_GetLotNumber @Item
	SELECT @LotNumber = ''
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #LotNumber) SELECT @LotNumber = ma_lo FROM #LotNumber

	IF (@Routing <> '' AND @Operation <> '') BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @UOM = dvt FROM ctrt WHERE ma_cd = @Operation AND ma_vt = @Item AND ma_lo_trinh = RTRIM(@Routing)
		SELECT @Rate = he_so FROM dmqddvt WHERE dvt = @UOM AND (ma_vt = @Item OR ma_vt = '*')
	END

	SELECT RTRIM(@UOM) AS dvt, @Rate AS he_so, a.lo_yn, a.tao_lo, a.nhieu_dvt, RTRIM(@LotNumber) AS ma_lo FROM #Item a

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END


GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bs_PostInspectionLotCreating]
	@VoucherCode CHAR(3),
	@VoucherID CHAR(13),
	@WrkinDelele BIT,
	@PostStock BIT = 0 OUT,
	@UserID INT,
	@Admin BIT,
	@Debug BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

	--
	DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT, @p CHAR(6), @now SMALLDATETIME, @VoucherIDKey NVARCHAR(1024), @part CHAR(6), @transactionCode CHAR(2), @voucherDate SMALLDATETIME, @originCode VARCHAR(32), @masterTable VARCHAR(512), @detailTable VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @xtable VARCHAR(512), @xfield NVARCHAR(1024), @xkey NVARCHAR(1024), @vendorField VARCHAR(64), @itemField VARCHAR(64), @plantField VARCHAR(64)
	DECLARE @inspectionLength INT, @updateOriginal NVARCHAR(1024), @insertGeneral NVARCHAR(1024), @curID INT, @itemOption BIT, @vendorOption BIT
	DECLARE @postWrkin BIT, @wrkinNumeric NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinString NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinExternal NVARCHAR(1024), @wrkinStatement NVARCHAR(1024), @roundQuantity INT

	IF @VoucherID <> '' SET @VoucherIDKey = 'a.stt_rec_goc = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '') + ''''
	IF @VoucherIDKey IS NULL RETURN


	-- Structure
	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ma_nk, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong0, a.dvt, a.he_so,
			a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_loai_kd, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.kieu_tao_lo, a.kd_dac_tinh, a.stt_rec_dt, a.sd_diem_kd, a.qd_tung_phan, a.dien_giai,
			a.ngay_kh_tu, a.ngay_kh_den, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc,
			a.sl_kq_kd, a.sl_kd_nh1, a.sl_kd_nh2, a.sl_kd_nh3, a.sl_qdsd,
			a.stt_rec_goc, a.ma_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_nk AS ma_nk_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc,
			a.stt_rec AS stt_rec_tc,
			a.status, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi
		INTO #tonghop FROM bikd00$000000 a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0


	SELECT TOP 0 a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_nk_goc, c.ma_dvcs, c.ma_bp0, c.ma_nh0, c.ma_vung, c.ma_nguon,
			a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong AS sl_mau, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, c.ma_loai_kd,
			a.stt_rec_tc, a.stt_rec0tc, a.status, a.xstatus, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi,
			a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, c.chuyen_ton_kho, c.kieu_tao_lo, c.kd_dac_tinh, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS kd_yn,
			d.nv_kd, d.nh_nc, d.ma_diem, d.ngay_bat_dau, d.ngay_ket_thuc, d.ma_dac_tinh, d.ma_cd, d.ma_loi, d.ma_loai_loi, d.ma_ph_loai, d.sl_kd_nh1, d.sl_kd_nh2, d.sl_kd_nh3,
			d.danh_gia, d.ct_cd_dt, d.ghi_chu, d.ma_loai_qd, d.diem_so, d.ma_kq, d.ma_ly_do, d.tt_ton_kho, a.line_nbr
		INTO #nguon FROM bikd01$000000 a CROSS JOIN #tonghop c CROSS JOIN bikd02$000000 d RIGHT JOIN (SELECT TOP 0 NULL a) b ON 1 = 0

	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #m03 FROM bikd03m$000000
	SELECT TOP 0 * INTO #d03 FROM bikd03d$000000

	-- 1. DATA
	SELECT @xtable = c$ + CASE WHEN RIGHT(c$, 1) = '$' THEN '000000' ELSE '' END, @masterTable = m$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @VoucherCode
	IF RIGHT(@masterTable, 1) = '$' BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @d = ngay_ct' + ' from ' + @xtable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@d smalldatetime out', @voucherDate OUT
	END
	SET @xtable = @masterTable + CASE WHEN RIGHT(@masterTable, 1) = '$' THEN CONVERT(CHAR(6), @voucherDate, 112) ELSE '' END
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@xtable) AND name = 'loai_ct') BEGIN
		SELECT @q = 'select @v = loai_ct from ' + @xtable + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@v char(2) out', @transactionCode OUT
	END

	SELECT @roundQuantity = val FROM options WHERE name = 'm_round_sl'


	-- Inspection Lot Origin
	SELECT a.*, ISNULL(d.ma_nguon, '') AS ma_nguon, b.c$, b.m$, b.d$, c.xtable, c.xfield, c.xkey, c.vendor_field, c.item_field, c.plant_field
		INTO #ngct FROM bikdngct a JOIN dmct9 b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct JOIN bikddmct c ON a.ma_ct = c.ma_ct LEFT JOIN bikddmnguon d ON a.ma_ct = d.ma_ct AND a.loai_ct = d.loai_ct
		WHERE a.ma_ct = @VoucherCode AND a.loai_ct = ISNULL(@transactionCode, '')
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ngct WHERE ma_nguon <> '') RETURN

	SELECT TOP 1 @originCode = a.ma_nguon, @xtable = a.xtable, @xfield = a.xfield, @xkey = a.xkey, @vendorField = a.vendor_field, @itemField = a.item_field, @plantField = a.plant_field,
			@itemOption = a.kiem_tra_vt, @vendorOption = a.kiem_tra_ncc,
			@postWrkin = a.chuyen_ton_kho, @wrkinNumeric = b.wrkin_numeric_field, @wrkinString = b.wrkin_string_field, @wrkinExternal = b.wrkin_external_field, @wrkinStatement = b.wrkin_statement
		FROM #ngct a JOIN bikddmct b ON a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct


	-- Issue Data from Voucher
	SET @q = 'insert into #nguon(stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, ma_ct_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_nguon,'
			+ ' ma_kh, dien_giai, ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_loai_kd, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, '
			+ ' status, xstatus, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, line_nbr)'
		+ ' select ' + @xfield + ' from ' + @xtable
		+ ' where %[' + REPLACE(@VoucherIDKey, 'a.stt_rec_goc', 'a.stt_rec') + ']%'
			+ CASE WHEN @xkey <> '' THEN ' and (' + @xkey + ')' ELSE '' END
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'a.ngay_ct', @VoucherDate, @VoucherDate, @UserID, @Admin

	IF @vendorOption = 0 AND @itemOption = 0 BEGIN
		UPDATE #nguon SET kd_yn = 1
	END

	-- Vendor without Inspection
	IF @vendorOption = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.* INTO #kh0 FROM bikdvt a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_vung FROM #nguon) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung
			WHERE (a.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_tu <= @voucherDate) AND (a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_den >= @voucherDate)

		SELECT a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den INTO #kh1
			FROM #kh0 a JOIN (SELECT ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_vung, MAX(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu FROM #kh0 GROUP BY ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_vung) b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu

		UPDATE #nguon SET kd_yn = 0 FROM #nguon a JOIN #kh1 b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung WHERE a.kd_yn IS NULL
	END

	-- Inspection Item
	IF @itemOption = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.ma_loai_kd, a.line_nbr
			INTO #vt1 FROM bidmvtkdvung a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt, ma_vung FROM #nguon WHERE kd_yn IS NULL) k ON a.ma_vt = k.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = k.ma_vung
				JOIN bikddmloai b ON a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai AND b.ma_nguon = @originCode WHERE (a.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_tu <= @voucherDate) AND (a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_den >= @voucherDate)
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.ma_loai_kd
			INTO #vtkdvung FROM #vt1 a
				JOIN (SELECT ma_vt, ma_vung, MAX(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu FROM #vt1 GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_vung) b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu
				JOIN (SELECT ma_vt, ma_vung, ngay_hl_tu, MIN(line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #vt1 GROUP BY ma_vt, ma_vung, ngay_hl_tu) c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = c.ma_vung AND a.ngay_hl_tu = c.ngay_hl_tu AND a.line_nbr = c.line_nbr

		UPDATE #nguon SET ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai_kd, kd_yn = 1 FROM #nguon a JOIN #vtkdvung b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung WHERE a.kd_yn IS NULL


		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.ma_loai_kd, a.line_nbr
			INTO #vt2 FROM bidmvtkd a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_vt FROM #nguon WHERE kd_yn IS NULL) k ON a.ma_vt = k.ma_vt
				JOIN bikddmloai b ON a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai AND b.ma_nguon = @originCode WHERE (a.ngay_hl_tu IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_tu <= @voucherDate) AND (a.ngay_hl_den IS NULL OR a.ngay_hl_den >= @voucherDate)
		SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ngay_hl_tu, a.ngay_hl_den, a.ma_loai_kd
			INTO #vtkd FROM #vt2 a
				JOIN (SELECT ma_vt, MAX(ngay_hl_tu) AS ngay_hl_tu FROM #vt2 GROUP BY ma_vt) b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ngay_hl_tu = b.ngay_hl_tu
				JOIN (SELECT ma_vt, ngay_hl_tu, MIN(line_nbr) AS line_nbr FROM #vt2 GROUP BY ma_vt, ngay_hl_tu) c ON a.ma_vt = c.ma_vt AND a.ngay_hl_tu = c.ngay_hl_tu AND a.line_nbr = c.line_nbr

		UPDATE #nguon SET ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai_kd, kd_yn = 1 FROM #nguon a JOIN #vtkd b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt WHERE a.kd_yn IS NULL
	END






	-- 2. PROCESS
	UPDATE #nguon SET kd_yn = 0 WHERE kd_yn IS NULL
	SELECT TOP 1 @part = CONVERT(CHAR(6), ngay_ct_goc, 112), @curID = 0, @now = GETDATE() FROM #nguon
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nguon WHERE kd_yn = 1) GOTO POST


	-- Inspection Type
	SELECT a.ma_loai, a.ma_nguon, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.kieu_tao_lo, a.kd_dac_tinh, a.ty_le_mau
		INTO #loaikd FROM bikddmloai a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ma_nguon, ma_loai_kd FROM #nguon WHERE ma_nguon <> '' AND ma_loai_kd <> '') b ON a.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon AND a.ma_loai = b.ma_loai_kd WHERE a.status = '1'
	UPDATE #nguon SET chuyen_ton_kho = ISNULL(b.chuyen_ton_kho, ''), kieu_tao_lo = ISNULL(b.kieu_tao_lo, ''), kd_dac_tinh = ISNULL(b.kd_dac_tinh, '')
		FROM #nguon a LEFT JOIN #loaikd b ON a.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon AND a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai WHERE a.kd_yn = 1



	-- 01
	SELECT stt_rec_goc, ma_vt, ma_kho, dvt, MAX(so_ct_goc) AS so_ct_goc, MIN(stt_rec0goc) AS stt_rec0goc, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #t1 FROM #nguon WHERE kieu_tao_lo = '01' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, ma_vt, ma_kho, dvt
	UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = REPLACE(STR(b.id + @curID, 3), ' ', '0')
		FROM #nguon a JOIN #t1 b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.dvt = b.dvt
		WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '01'
	SELECT @curID = @curID + ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #t1


	-- 02
	SELECT stt_rec_goc, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, dvt, MAX(so_ct_goc) AS so_ct_goc, MIN(stt_rec0goc) AS stt_rec0goc, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #t2 FROM #nguon WHERE kieu_tao_lo = '02' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, dvt
	UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = REPLACE(STR(b.id + @curID, 3), ' ', '0')
		FROM #nguon a JOIN #t2 b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.dvt = b.dvt
		WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '02'
	SELECT @curID = @curID + ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #t2

	-- 03
	SELECT stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, MAX(so_ct_goc) AS so_ct_goc, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #t3 FROM #nguon WHERE kieu_tao_lo = '03' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc
	UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = REPLACE(STR(b.id + @curID, 3), ' ', '0')
		FROM #nguon a JOIN #t3 b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.stt_rec0goc = b.stt_rec0goc
		WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '03'
	SELECT @curID = @curID + ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #t3



	-- 04
	SELECT *, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec_goc0 INTO #t4a FROM #nguon a WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '04'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t4a)  BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'KD1'
			UPDATE a SET stt_rec_goc0 = b.stt_rec_goc
				FROM #t4a a JOIN bikd b ON a.stt_rec_goc <> b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_ct_goc = b.ma_ct_goc AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.stt_rec_tc = b.stt_rec_tc
				WHERE ISNULL(a.stt_rec_tc, '') <> ''

		SELECT stt_rec_goc, ma_ct_goc, stt_rec_tc, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_lo, dvt, MIN(stt_rec0goc) AS stt_rec0goc, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
			INTO #t4b FROM #t4a WHERE stt_rec_goc0 = '' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, ma_ct_goc, stt_rec_tc, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_lo, dvt
		UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = REPLACE(STR(b.id + @curID, 3), ' ', '0')
			FROM #nguon a
				JOIN #t4b b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_ct_goc = b.ma_ct_goc AND a.stt_rec_tc = b.stt_rec_tc AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.dvt = b.dvt
			WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '04'
		SELECT @curID = @curID + ISNULL(MAX(id), 0) FROM #t4b

		UPDATE #nguon SET chuyen_ton_kho = 0 FROM #nguon a JOIN #t4a b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.stt_rec0goc = b.stt_rec0goc WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '04' AND a.chuyen_ton_kho = 1 AND b.stt_rec_goc0 <> ''
	END


	-- 05
	SELECT *, CAST('' AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec_goc0 INTO #t5a FROM #nguon a WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '05'
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #t5a)  BEGIN
		IF @VoucherCode <> 'KD1'
			UPDATE a SET stt_rec_goc0 = b.stt_rec_goc
				FROM #t5a a JOIN bikd b ON a.stt_rec_goc <> b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_ct_goc = b.ma_ct_goc AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo

		SELECT stt_rec_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_lo, dvt, MIN(stt_rec0goc) AS stt_rec0goc, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
			INTO #t5b FROM #t5a WHERE stt_rec_goc0 = '' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_kh, ma_vt, ma_kho, ma_lo, dvt

		UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = REPLACE(STR(b.id + @curID, 3), ' ', '0')
			FROM #nguon a JOIN #t5b b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.ma_ct_goc = b.ma_ct_goc AND a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh AND a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_kho = b.ma_kho AND a.ma_lo = b.ma_lo AND a.dvt = b.dvt
			WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '05'

		UPDATE #nguon SET chuyen_ton_kho = 0 FROM #nguon a JOIN #t5a b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.stt_rec0goc = b.stt_rec0goc WHERE a.kieu_tao_lo = '05' AND a.chuyen_ton_kho = 1 AND b.stt_rec_goc0 <> ''
	END


	UPDATE #nguon SET so_ct = '' WHERE so_ct IS NULL


	-- Identity Number
	DECLARE @wsID VARCHAR(8), @count INT, @formatString NVARCHAR(32), @formatStyle CHAR(1), @currentNumber INT
	DECLARE @p1 VARCHAR(32), @p2 VARCHAR(32), @p3 VARCHAR(32), @startNum NUMERIC(12,0), @len_p2 INT, @r BIT, @inspectionSize INT
	SELECT @wsID = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_ws_id'
	SELECT @formatString = UPPER(RTRIM(val)) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_so_lo_kd0'
	SELECT @formatStyle = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_kieu_so_lo_kd'
	SELECT @inspectionSize = character_maximum_length FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'bikd00$000000' AND column_name = 'so_ct'

	SELECT stt_rec_goc, so_ct, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS so_ct_moi, kieu_tao_lo, CAST('' AS VARCHAR(32)) AS ma_diem, stt_rec, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id
		INTO #id1 FROM #nguon WHERE so_ct <> '' GROUP BY stt_rec_goc, so_ct, kieu_tao_lo, stt_rec ORDER BY so_ct

	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #id1
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, 'KD2', @count, @UserID, '#id1', default, default, default, default, default, default, 1


	IF @formatStyle = '2' BEGIN
		EXEC FastBusiness$VoucherNumberRegion @formatString, @r OUT, @startNum OUT, @p2 OUT, @p1 OUT, 1, @p3 OUT, 1

		SELECT @len_p2 = CASE WHEN LEN(@p2) > 4 THEN 4 ELSE LEN(@p2) END
		UPDATE #id1 SET so_ct_moi = RIGHT(@p1 + CASE WHEN LEN(id) > @len_p2 THEN @p2 ELSE RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', @len_p2) + LTRIM(@startNum + id), @len_p2) END + @p3, @inspectionSize)

		UPDATE #nguon SET stt_rec = b.stt_rec, so_ct = dbo.ff_PadL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.so_ct_goc + b.so_ct_moi)), @inspectionSize), ngay_ct = a.ngay_ct_goc
			FROM #nguon a JOIN #id1 b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.so_ct = b.so_ct AND a.kieu_tao_lo = b.kieu_tao_lo
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @currentNumber = ISNULL(so_ct, 0) FROM dmct WHERE ma_ct = 'KD2'
		UPDATE #id1 SET so_ct_moi = id + @currentNumber
		UPDATE #nguon SET stt_rec = b.stt_rec, so_ct = CASE WHEN LEN(so_ct_moi) > @inspectionSize THEN '0' ELSE dbo.ff_PadL(RTRIM(b.so_ct_moi), @inspectionSize) END, ngay_ct = a.ngay_ct_goc
			FROM #nguon a JOIN #id1 b ON a.stt_rec_goc = b.stt_rec_goc AND a.so_ct = b.so_ct AND a.kieu_tao_lo = b.kieu_tao_lo
		UPDATE dmct SET so_ct = so_ct + @count WHERE ma_ct = 'KD2'
	END



	-- Inspection Plan
	SELECT a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ma_loai_kd, MAX(b.ngay_ct) AS ngay_ct
		INTO #kbdactinh FROM #nguon a JOIN bikddactinh b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai AND b.ngay_ct <= a.ngay_ct_goc
		WHERE a.so_ct <> '' AND a.kd_dac_tinh = '1'
		GROUP BY a.ma_vt, a.ma_vung, a.ma_loai_kd

	-- Inspection Template
	SELECT a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_nk_goc, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_nguon,
			a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_vt, a.sl_mau, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.ma_loai_kd,
			a.stt_rec_tc, a.stt_rec0tc, a.status, a.xstatus, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi,
			a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.kieu_tao_lo, a.kd_dac_tinh, a.kd_yn,
			ISNULL(c.stt_rec, '') AS stt_rec_dt, ISNULL(c.sd_diem_kd, '') AS sd_diem_kd, ISNULL(c.qd_tung_phan, '') AS qd_tung_phan
		INTO #chitiet
		FROM #nguon a LEFT JOIN #kbdactinh b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND a.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND a.ma_loai_kd = b.ma_loai_kd
			LEFT JOIN bikddactinh c ON c.ma_vt = b.ma_vt AND c.ma_vung = b.ma_vung AND c.ma_loai = b.ma_loai_kd AND c.ngay_ct = b.ngay_ct
		WHERE a.so_ct <> ''


	-- Inspection Master
	INSERT INTO #tonghop(stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, stt_rec_goc, ma_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ngay_ct_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh,
			ma_vt, ma_lo, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, so_luong0, dvt, he_so, ma_loai_kd, chuyen_ton_kho, kieu_tao_lo, kd_dac_tinh, stt_rec_dt, sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan,
			dien_giai, stt_rec_tc, status, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, MAX(a.ngay_ct_goc), MAX(a.stt_rec_goc), MAX(a.ma_ct_goc), MAX(a.so_ct_goc), MAX(a.ma_nk_goc), MAX(a.ngay_ct_goc), MAX(a.ma_dvcs), MAX(a.ma_bp0), MAX(a.ma_nh0), MAX(a.ma_vung), MAX(a.ma_nguon), MAX(a.ma_kh),
			MAX(a.ma_vt), MAX(a.ma_lo), MAX(a.ma_kho), MAX(a.ma_vi_tri), SUM(a.so_luong), MAX(a.dvt), MAX(a.he_so),
			MAX(a.ma_loai_kd), MAX(a.chuyen_ton_kho), MAX(a.kieu_tao_lo), MAX(a.kd_dac_tinh), MAX(ISNULL(a.stt_rec_dt, '')), MAX(ISNULL(a.sd_diem_kd, '')), MAX(ISNULL(a.qd_tung_phan, '')),
			'', MAX(stt_rec_tc), '1', MAX(a.ma_vv), MAX(a.ma_sp), MAX(a.ma_bp), MAX(a.so_lsx), MAX(a.ma_hd), MAX(a.ma_ku), MAX(a.ma_phi)
		FROM #chitiet a
		GROUP BY a.stt_rec, a.ngay_ct, a.so_ct

	DECLARE @descriptionFormat NVARCHAR(128)
	SELECT @descriptionFormat = RTRIM(val) FROM options WHERE name = 'm_bi_dg_lo_kd'
	UPDATE #tonghop SET dien_giai = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@descriptionFormat, '%s1', LTRIM(RTRIM(a.so_ct))), '%s2', CONVERT(CHAR(10), a.ngay_ct, 103)), '%s3', RTRIM(a.ma_vt)), '%s4', RTRIM(b.ten_vt)), '%s5', RTRIM(b.ten_vt2))
		FROM #tonghop a JOIN dmvt b ON a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt


	-- Inspection Template by Point
	INSERT INTO #m03(stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_diem, ty_le, so_luong0, dien_giai, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, ghi_chu, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_nguon, kieu_tao, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT '', a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, ISNULL(b.ma_diem, ''), ISNULL(b.ty_le, 100), ROUND(ISNULL(b.ty_le, 100)/100 * a.so_luong0, @roundQuantity),
			a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, '', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nguon, 1, @now, @now, @UserID, @UserID
		FROM #tonghop a LEFT JOIN bikddactinhdiem b ON a.stt_rec_dt = b.stt_rec
		WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh = '1'

	INSERT INTO #m03(stt_rec, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_diem, ty_le, so_luong0, dien_giai, ngay_bat_dau, ngay_ket_thuc, ghi_chu, ma_dvcs, ma_vung, ma_kho, ma_nguon, kieu_tao, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)
		SELECT '', a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, '', 100, a.so_luong0, a.dien_giai, a.ngay_bat_dau, a.ngay_ket_thuc, '', a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kho, a.ma_nguon, 1, @now, @now, @UserID, @UserID
		FROM #tonghop a JOIN #loaikd b ON b.ma_nguon = a.ma_nguon AND b.ma_loai = a.ma_loai_kd WHERE a.kd_dac_tinh <> '1'

	SELECT stt_rec_kd, ma_diem, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(13)) AS stt_rec, IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS id INTO #id2 FROM #m03 GROUP BY stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ma_diem
	SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #id2
	EXEC FastBusiness$App$UpdateIdentityNumber @wsID, 'KD3', @count, @UserID, '#id2', default, default, default, default, default, default, 1


	UPDATE #m03 SET stt_rec = b.stt_rec FROM #m03 a JOIN #id2 b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec_kd AND a.ma_diem = b.ma_diem

	SELECT a.stt_rec, b.so_luong0 - a.t_so_luong AS sl_cl
		INTO #cl FROM (SELECT stt_rec_kd, SUM(so_luong0) AS t_so_luong, MIN(stt_rec) AS stt_rec FROM #m03 GROUP BY stt_rec_kd) a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec WHERE b.kd_dac_tinh = '1' AND a.t_so_luong <> b.so_luong0
	UPDATE #m03 SET so_luong0 = a.so_luong0 + b.sl_cl FROM #m03 a JOIN #cl b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.stt_rec = (SELECT MIN(stt_rec) AS stt_rec FROM #m03)

	INSERT INTO #d03(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_cd, ten_cd, ten_cd2, ma_ccv, ma_dac_tinh, sl_mau, gia_tri_tu, gia_tri_den, gt_muc_tieu, yeu_cau, pp_kd, tinh_diem_cl, trong_so, ghi_chu, line_nbr)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, c.stt_rec0, a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, c.ma_cd, c.ten_cd, c.ten_cd2, c.ma_ccv, c.ma_dac_tinh,
			CASE WHEN c.so_luong_mau <> 0 THEN CASE WHEN b.he_so <> 0 THEN ROUND(c.so_luong_mau / b.he_so, @roundQuantity) ELSE 0 END ELSE ROUND(a.so_luong0 * c.ty_le_mau/100, @roundQuantity) END,
			c.gia_tri_tu, c.gia_tri_den, c.gt_muc_tieu, c.yeu_cau, c.pp_kd, c.tinh_diem_cl, c.trong_so, c.ghi_chu, c.line_nbr
		FROM #m03 a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec JOIN bikddactinhct c ON c.stt_rec = b.stt_rec_dt
		WHERE b.kd_dac_tinh = '1' AND b.stt_rec_dt <> ''

	INSERT INTO #d03(stt_rec, stt_rec0, stt_rec_kd, so_lo_kd, ngay_lo_kd, ma_cd, ten_cd, ten_cd2, ma_ccv, ma_dac_tinh, sl_mau, gia_tri_tu, gia_tri_den, gt_muc_tieu, yeu_cau, pp_kd, tinh_diem_cl, trong_so, ghi_chu, line_nbr)
		SELECT a.stt_rec, '001', a.stt_rec_kd, a.so_lo_kd, a.ngay_lo_kd, '', '', '', '', '', ROUND(b.so_luong0 * c.ty_le_mau/100, @roundQuantity), 0, 0, 0, '', '', 0, 0, '', 1
		FROM #m03 a JOIN #tonghop b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec JOIN bikddmloai c ON c.ma_nguon = b.ma_nguon AND c.ma_loai = b.ma_loai_kd
		WHERE b.kd_dac_tinh <> '1'

	UPDATE #d03 SET sl_mau = b.so_luong0 FROM #d03 a JOIN #m03 b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec WHERE a.sl_mau > b.so_luong0
	UPDATE #m03 SET so_luong = so_luong0


	-- 3. POST
	POST:

	DECLARE @$m VARCHAR(64), @$d VARCHAR(64), @stockDataKey NVARCHAR(1024), @qcField BIT, @xstatusField BIT, @stock INT, @stockType INT
	SELECT @$m = m$, @$d = d$ FROM dmct9 WHERE ma_ct = @voucherCode
	SELECT @masterTable = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$0000', @$m) = 0 THEN @$m + @part ELSE @$m END, @detailTable = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('$0000', @$d) = 0 THEN @$d + @part ELSE @$d END
	SELECT @q = '', @qcField = 0, @xstatusField = 0
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable) AND name = 'qc_yn') SELECT @q = 'qc_yn = case when n.kd_yn = 1 and isnull(n.chuyen_ton_kho, '''') = ''1'' then 1 else 0 end', @qcField = 1
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM syscolumns WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(@detailTable) AND name = 'xstatus') SELECT @q = @q + CASE WHEN @q <> '' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 'xstatus = case when n.kd_yn = 1 then ''1'' else '''' end', @xstatusField = 1

	IF @q <> '' BEGIN
		SET @q = 'update a set ' + @q + ' from ' + @detailTable +  ' a join #nguon n on a.stt_rec = n.stt_rec_goc and a.stt_rec0 = n.stt_rec0goc where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec'
		IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
		EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec char(13)', @VoucherID
	END



	-- Post Stock
	IF @postWrkin = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @stock = dl_ton_kho, @stockType = loai_ton_kho FROM #ngct

		--+ Before Post
		IF @WrkinDelele = 1 BEGIN
			SET @q = 'delete biss90$' + @part + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
			IF @stock <> -1 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete r70$' + @part + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
				DELETE ct70 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
			END
			IF @stock <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @q = @q + CHAR(13) + 'delete r90$' + @part + ' where stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + ''''
				DELETE ct90 WHERE stt_rec = @VoucherID
			END
			IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
			EXEC sp_executesql @q
		END

		--+ Post
		SELECT DISTINCT MONTH(ngay_ct_goc) AS m, YEAR(ngay_ct_goc) AS y INTO #insPostKey FROM #nguon WHERE ma_ct_goc = @voucherCode

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #nguon WHERE kd_yn = 1 AND chuyen_ton_kho = '1') BEGIN
			SET @stockDataKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + '''' + CASE WHEN @qcField = 1 THEN ' and a.qc_yn = 1' ELSE '' END
			EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostInventory @masterTable, @detailTable, @voucherCode, '#insPostKey', @wrkinNumeric, @wrkinString, @wrkinExternal, @wrkinStatement, @stock, @stockType, 1, @stockDataKey, 1
		END

		SELECT @PostStock = 1, @stockDataKey = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + REPLACE(@VoucherID, '''', '''''') + '''' + CASE WHEN @qcField = 1 THEN ' and a.qc_yn <> 1' ELSE '' END

		EXEC FastBusiness$Voucher$Import$PostInventory @masterTable, @detailTable, @voucherCode, '#insPostKey', @wrkinNumeric, @wrkinString, @wrkinExternal, @wrkinStatement, @stock, @stockType, 1, @stockDataKey

	END





	-- 4. SAVE INSPECTION
	-- Delete and Save Inspection Books
	DECLARE @insPart CHAR(6)
	SET @q = 'select top 1 @r = convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from bikd a where ' + @VoucherIDKey
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@r char(6) out', @insPart OUT

	SELECT TOP 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, status, datetime0, datetime2 INTO #kd FROM bikd00$000000
	SET @q = 'insert into #kd select stt_rec, ngay_ct, status, datetime0, datetime2 from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @VoucherIDKey + ' and (a.status <> ''5'' or not exists(select 1 from bikd02$' + @insPart +' b where b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec))'
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	DELETE a FROM bikd a JOIN #kd b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
	DELETE bikd03c$000000 FROM bikd03c$000000 a JOIN #kd b ON a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec

	SET @q = 'delete a from bikd00$' + @insPart + ' a join #kd b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec'
		+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bikd01$' + @insPart + ' a where ' + @VoucherIDKey
		+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bikd03d$' + @insPart + ' a join #kd b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec'
		+ CHAR(13) + 'delete a from bikd03m$' + @insPart + ' a join #kd b on a.stt_rec_kd = b.stt_rec'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q


	INSERT INTO bikd(stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_nk, stt_rec_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh,
			ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_lo, stt_rec_tc, kd_dac_tinh, sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan, status, user_id0)
		SELECT stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_nk, stt_rec_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_vung, ma_nguon, ma_kh,
			ma_vt, so_luong0, dvt, he_so, ma_kho, ma_lo, ISNULL(stt_rec_tc, ''), kd_dac_tinh, sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan, status, @UserID
		FROM #tonghop

	INSERT INTO bikd03c$000000(stt_rec, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, stt_rec_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_nguon, ma_vung, status, user_id0)
		SELECT stt_rec, ngay_lo_kd, so_lo_kd, stt_rec_kd, ma_dvcs, ma_nguon, ma_vung, 1, user_id0 FROM #m03

	SET @q = 'insert into bikd00$' + @part + '(stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct, stt_rec_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_ct_goc, ma_dvcs, ma_bp0, ma_nh0, ma_vung, ma_kh, ma_vt, so_luong0, so_luong, dvt, he_so, ma_nguon, ma_loai_kd, chuyen_ton_kho, kieu_tao_lo, '
				+ 'kd_dac_tinh, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, ma_nk, sl_kd_nh1, sl_kd_nh2, sl_kd_nh3, stt_rec_dt, sd_diem_kd, qd_tung_phan, dien_giai, sl_kq_kd, sl_qdsd, '
				+ 'status, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2)'
			+ ' select a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, ''KD2'', a.stt_rec_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ma_dvcs, a.ma_bp0, a.ma_nh0, a.ma_vung, a.ma_kh, a.ma_vt, a.so_luong0, a.so_luong0, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.ma_nguon, a.ma_loai_kd, a.chuyen_ton_kho, a.kieu_tao_lo, '
				+ 'a.kd_dac_tinh, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, '''', 0, 0, 0, a.stt_rec_dt, case when a.kd_dac_tinh = ''1'' and a.stt_rec_dt <> '''' then a.sd_diem_kd else ''0'' end, case when a.kd_dac_tinh = ''1'' and a.stt_rec_dt <> '''' then a.qd_tung_phan else ''0'' end, a.dien_giai, 0, 0,'
				+ 'a.status, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, @now, @now, @u, @u'
			+ ' from #tonghop a'
		+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bikd01$' + @part + '(stt_rec_goc, stt_rec0goc, stt_rec, so_ct, ngay_ct, ma_ct_goc, ngay_ct_goc, so_ct_goc, ma_nk_goc, ma_kh, dien_giai, ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, stt_rec_tc, stt_rec0tc, '
				+ 'ma_vt, so_luong, dvt, he_so, status, xstatus, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, so_lsx, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, datetime0, datetime2, user_id0, user_id2, line_nbr)'
			+ ' select a.stt_rec_goc, a.stt_rec0goc, a.stt_rec, a.so_ct, a.ngay_ct, a.ma_ct_goc, a.ngay_ct_goc, a.so_ct_goc, a.ma_nk_goc, a.ma_kh, a.dien_giai, a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo, a.stt_rec_tc, a.stt_rec0tc, '
				+ 'a.ma_vt, a.so_luong, a.dvt, a.he_so, a.status, a.xstatus, a.ma_vv, a.ma_sp, a.ma_bp, a.so_lsx, a.ma_hd, a.ma_ku, a.ma_phi, a.datetime0, a.datetime2, a.user_id0, a.user_id2, a.line_nbr'
			+ ' from #nguon a where a.so_ct <> '''''
		+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bikd03m$' + @part + ' select * from #m03'
		+ CHAR(13) + 'insert into bikd03d$' + @part + ' select * from #d03'
	IF @Debug = 1 PRINT @q
	EXEC sp_executesql @q, N'@now smalldatetime, @u int', @now, @UserID


	EXEC bs_PostInspectionResultTemplate '', @Debug


	--
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
END
